`src/gfx/codecs/png.js`:

```js
// PNG decoder: color types 0/2/3/4/6, bit depths 1-16, Adam7 interlace, tRNS transparency.
// Output: { width, height, data: Uint8Array RGBA }.
import { inflate } from './inflate.js';
import { crc32 } from '../../core/crc32.js';

export function isPng(b) { return b.length > 8 && b[0] === 0x89 && b[1] === 0x50 && b[2] === 0x4e && b[3] === 0x47; }

export function decodePng(bytes) {
  const dv = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
  let pos = 8;
  let width = 0, height = 0, depth = 8, ctype = 6, interlace = 0;
  let palette = null, trns = null;
  const idat = [];
  while (pos + 8 <= bytes.length) {
    const len = dv.getUint32(pos); const type = String.fromCharCode(bytes[pos + 4], bytes[pos + 5], bytes[pos + 6], bytes[pos + 7]);
    const data = bytes.subarray(pos + 8, pos + 8 + len);
    if (type === 'IHDR') { width = dv.getUint32(pos + 8); height = dv.getUint32(pos + 12); depth = bytes[pos + 16]; ctype = bytes[pos + 17]; interlace = bytes[pos + 20]; }
    else if (type === 'PLTE') palette = data.slice();
    else if (type === 'tRNS') trns = data.slice();
    else if (type === 'IDAT') idat.push(data);
    else if (type === 'IEND') break;
    pos += 12 + len;
  }
  let total = 0; for (const d of idat) total += d.length;
  const comp = new Uint8Array(total); let o = 0; for (const d of idat) { comp.set(d, o); o += d.length; }
  const channels = { 0: 1, 2: 3, 3: 1, 4: 2, 6: 4 }[ctype];
  const bpp = Math.max(1, (channels * depth) >> 3); // bytes per pixel (for filtering), >=1
  const rawSize = passRows(width, height, interlace, channels, depth);
  let raw = inflate(comp, { sizeHint: rawSize * 1.05 + 64 });
  if (raw.length < rawSize) { const r = new Uint8Array(rawSize); r.set(raw); raw = r; } // (truncated data: zero bytes)
  const out = new Uint8Array(width * height * 4);
  const passes = interlace ? [[0, 0, 8, 8], [4, 0, 8, 8], [0, 4, 4, 8], [2, 0, 4, 4], [0, 2, 2, 4], [1, 0, 2, 2], [0, 1, 1, 2]] : [[0, 0, 1, 1]];
  const lut8 = ctype === 3 && depth === 8 ? paletteLut(palette, trns) : palette;
  let rp = 0;
  for (const [sx, sy, dx, dy] of passes) {
    const pw = Math.ceil((width - sx) / dx), ph = Math.ceil((height - sy) / dy);
    if (pw <= 0 || ph <= 0) continue;
    const rowBytes = Math.ceil(pw * channels * depth / 8);
    for (let y = 0; y < ph; y++) {
      const filter = raw[rp++];
      // (rows are unfiltered in place: the previous row of the pass is the rowBytes + 1 bytes before, none for the first)
      unfilter(raw, rp, y ? rp - rowBytes - 1 : -1, rowBytes, bpp, filter);
      const row = raw.subarray(rp, rp + rowBytes); rp += rowBytes;
      if (depth === 8) { unpack8(row, pw, out, ((sy + y * dy) * width + sx) * 4, dx * 4, ctype, lut8, trns); continue; }
      // unpack samples
      for (let x = 0; x < pw; x++) {
        const px = sx + x * dx, py = sy + y * dy;
        const oi = (py * width + px) * 4;
        const samp = (k) => { // k-th sample of the pixel
          const idx = x * channels + k;
          if (depth === 8) return row[idx];
          if (depth === 16) return row[idx * 2];
          const bitPos = idx * depth; const byte = row[bitPos >> 3]; const shift = 8 - depth - (bitPos & 7);
          const v = (byte >> shift) & ((1 << depth) - 1);
          return ctype === 3 ? v : (v * 255) / ((1 << depth) - 1);
        };
        switch (ctype) {
          case 0: { const g = samp(0); out[oi] = out[oi + 1] = out[oi + 2] = g; out[oi + 3] = trns && trns.length >= 2 && ((trns[0] << 8) | trns[1]) === (depth === 16 ? (row[x * 2] << 8) | row[x * 2 + 1] : Math.round(g * ((1 << depth) - 1) / 255)) ? 0 : 255; break; }
          case 2: { out[oi] = samp(0); out[oi + 1] = samp(1); out[oi + 2] = samp(2); out[oi + 3] = 255; if (trns && trns.length >= 6 && out[oi] === trns[1] && out[oi + 1] === trns[3] && out[oi + 2] === trns[5]) out[oi + 3] = 0; break; }
          case 3: { const i = samp(0); out[oi] = palette ? palette[i * 3] : 0; out[oi + 1] = palette ? palette[i * 3 + 1] : 0; out[oi + 2] = palette ? palette[i * 3 + 2] : 0; out[oi + 3] = trns && i < trns.length ? trns[i] : 255; break; }
          case 4: { const g = samp(0); out[oi] = out[oi + 1] = out[oi + 2] = g; out[oi + 3] = samp(1); break; }
          case 6: { out[oi] = samp(0); out[oi + 1] = samp(1); out[oi + 2] = samp(2); out[oi + 3] = samp(3); break; }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return { width, height, data: out };
}

/** Bytes of filtered image data (filter byte + row) of every pass. */
function passRows(width, height, interlace, channels, depth) {
  const passes = interlace ? [[0, 0, 8, 8], [4, 0, 8, 8], [0, 4, 4, 8], [2, 0, 4, 4], [0, 2, 2, 4], [1, 0, 2, 2], [0, 1, 1, 2]] : [[0, 0, 1, 1]];
  let n = 0;
  for (const [sx, sy, dx, dy] of passes) {
    const pw = Math.ceil((width - sx) / dx), ph = Math.ceil((height - sy) / dy);
    if (pw > 0 && ph > 0) n += ph * (Math.ceil(pw * channels * depth / 8) + 1);
  }
  return n;
}

/**
 * The Paeth predictor of a (left), u (up), c (up-left): whichever is closest to a + u - c, ties to a then u. Without
 * branches (the choice is data-dependent: a mispredicted branch per byte otherwise).
 */
function paeth(a, u, c) {
  let pa = u - c, pb = a - c, pc = pa + pb, m; // (p - a, p - b, p - c for p = a + u - c)
  m = pa >> 31; pa = (pa ^ m) - m; m = pb >> 31; pb = (pb ^ m) - m; m = pc >> 31; pc = (pc ^ m) - m;
  const notA = ((pb - pa) | (pc - pa)) >> 31, cOverU = (pc - pb) >> 31; // (-1: pa > pb or pa > pc; pb > pc)
  const uc = u ^ ((u ^ c) & cOverU);
  return a ^ ((a ^ uc) & notA);
}

/**
 * Undo a row's filter in place: the row at b[r..r+len), the previous (already unfiltered) row at b[p..p+len), p < 0 for
 * the first row of a pass (all zero). One loop per filter type; bytes before the row's first pixel have a = c = 0.
 * (Row lengths are whole pixels when bpp > 1.)
 * An unknown filter type leaves the row as it is.
 */
function unfilter(b, r, p, len, bpp, filter) {
  switch (filter) {
    case 1: for (let i = bpp; i < len; i++) b[r + i] += b[r + i - bpp]; break;
    case 2: if (p >= 0) for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) b[r + i] += b[p + i]; break;
    case 3:
      if (p < 0) { for (let i = bpp; i < len; i++) b[r + i] += b[r + i - bpp] >> 1; break; }
      for (let i = 0; i < bpp && i < len; i++) b[r + i] += b[p + i] >> 1;
      for (let i = bpp; i < len; i++) b[r + i] += (b[r + i - bpp] + b[p + i]) >> 1;
      break;
    case 4:
      if (p < 0) { for (let i = bpp; i < len; i++) b[r + i] += b[r + i - bpp]; break; } // (Paeth(a, 0, 0) = a)
      for (let i = 0; i < bpp && i < len; i++) b[r + i] += b[p + i]; // (Paeth(0, b, 0) = b)
      if (bpp === 4) { // (RGBA: the four channels' chains interleaved, each carrying its a and c in registers)
        let a0 = b[r], a1 = b[r + 1], a2 = b[r + 2], a3 = b[r + 3], c0 = b[p], c1 = b[p + 1], c2 = b[p + 2], c3 = b[p + 3];
        for (let i = 4; i + 3 < len; i += 4) {
          const u0 = b[p + i], u1 = b[p + i + 1], u2 = b[p + i + 2], u3 = b[p + i + 3];
          a0 = (b[r + i] + paeth(a0, u0, c0)) & 255; a1 = (b[r + i + 1] + paeth(a1, u1, c1)) & 255;
          a2 = (b[r + i + 2] + paeth(a2, u2, c2)) & 255; a3 = (b[r + i + 3] + paeth(a3, u3, c3)) & 255;
          b[r + i] = a0; b[r + i + 1] = a1; b[r + i + 2] = a2; b[r + i + 3] = a3; c0 = u0; c1 = u1; c2 = u2; c3 = u3;
        }
        break;
      }
      if (bpp === 3) { // (RGB)
        let a0 = b[r], a1 = b[r + 1], a2 = b[r + 2], c0 = b[p], c1 = b[p + 1], c2 = b[p + 2];
        for (let i = 3; i + 2 < len; i += 3) {
          const u0 = b[p + i], u1 = b[p + i + 1], u2 = b[p + i + 2];
          a0 = (b[r + i] + paeth(a0, u0, c0)) & 255; a1 = (b[r + i + 1] + paeth(a1, u1, c1)) & 255; a2 = (b[r + i + 2] + paeth(a2, u2, c2)) & 255;
          b[r + i] = a0; b[r + i + 1] = a1; b[r + i + 2] = a2; c0 = u0; c1 = u1; c2 = u2;
        }
        break;
      }
      for (let ch = 0; ch < bpp && ch < len; ch++) { // (one sample channel at a time: a and c carried in registers)
        let a = b[r + ch], c = b[p + ch];
        for (let i = ch + bpp; i < len; i += bpp) { const u = b[p + i]; a = (b[r + i] + paeth(a, u, c)) & 255; b[r + i] = a; c = u; }
      }
      break;
  }
}

/** The palette as RGBA entries for 256 indices: past the palette black, past tRNS opaque (as the generic path reads). */
function paletteLut(palette, trns) {
  const lut = new Uint8Array(256 * 4);
  for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
    if (palette) { lut[4 * i] = palette[i * 3] ?? 0; lut[4 * i + 1] = palette[i * 3 + 1] ?? 0; lut[4 * i + 2] = palette[i * 3 + 2] ?? 0; }
    lut[4 * i + 3] = trns && i < trns.length ? trns[i] : 255;
  }
  return lut;
}

/**
 * 8-bit samples of one unfiltered row to RGBA at out[o], o += step per pixel (4, or 4 * the Adam7 column step), with
 * the generic path's transparency rules (gray / RGB key colour from tRNS, palette alpha). For palette images `palette`
 * is paletteLut's table.
 */
function unpack8(row, pw, out, o, step, ctype, palette, trns) {
  switch (ctype) {
    case 0: {
      const key = trns && trns.length >= 2 ? (trns[0] << 8) | trns[1] : -1;
      for (let x = 0; x < pw; x++, o += step) { const g = row[x]; out[o] = out[o + 1] = out[o + 2] = g; out[o + 3] = g === key ? 0 : 255; }
      break;
    }
    case 2: {
      const keyed = trns && trns.length >= 6, kr = keyed ? trns[1] : -1, kg = keyed ? trns[3] : -1, kb = keyed ? trns[5] : -1;
      for (let x = 0, i = 0; x < pw; x++, i += 3, o += step) {
        const r = row[i], g = row[i + 1], bl = row[i + 2];
        out[o] = r; out[o + 1] = g; out[o + 2] = bl; out[o + 3] = r === kr && g === kg && bl === kb ? 0 : 255;
      }
      break;
    }
    case 3: { const lut = palette; // (paletteLut's table)
      for (let x = 0; x < pw; x++, o += step) { const k = row[x] * 4; out[o] = lut[k]; out[o + 1] = lut[k + 1]; out[o + 2] = lut[k + 2]; out[o + 3] = lut[k + 3]; }
      break;
    }
    case 4:
      for (let x = 0, i = 0; x < pw; x++, i += 2, o += step) { const g = row[i]; out[o] = out[o + 1] = out[o + 2] = g; out[o + 3] = row[i + 1]; }
      break;
    case 6:
      if (step === 4) { out.set(row.subarray(0, pw * 4), o); break; }
      for (let x = 0, i = 0; x < pw; x++, i += 4, o += step) { out[o] = row[i]; out[o + 1] = row[i + 1]; out[o + 2] = row[i + 2]; out[o + 3] = row[i + 3]; }
      break;
  }
}

// ---- encoder
/**
 * An RGBA image as PNG (8-bit RGBA, no filter, deflate stored blocks: no compression) — small images such as cursors,
 * encoded on the CPU and at once (a canvas' encoder can wait on the GPU process).
 * @param {Uint8Array | Uint8ClampedArray} rgba width * height * 4 bytes, rows top-down
 * @returns {Uint8Array}
 */
export function encodePng(rgba, width, height) {
  const rowBytes = width * 4 + 1, raw = rowBytes * height;
  const blocks = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(raw / 65535));
  const idatLen = 2 + raw + 5 * blocks + 4;
  const out = new Uint8Array(8 + (12 + 13) + (12 + idatLen) + 12);
  const dv = new DataView(out.buffer);
  out.set([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a], 0);
  let p = 8;
  const chunk = (type, len, fill) => {
    dv.setUint32(p, len); for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) out[p + 4 + i] = type.charCodeAt(i);
    fill(p + 8);
    dv.setUint32(p + 8 + len, crc32(out, p + 4, p + 8 + len));
    p += 12 + len;
  };
  chunk('IHDR', 13, (o) => { dv.setUint32(o, width); dv.setUint32(o + 4, height); out[o + 8] = 8; out[o + 9] = 6; out[o + 10] = 0; out[o + 11] = 0; out[o + 12] = 0; });
  chunk('IDAT', idatLen, (o) => {
    out[o] = 0x78; out[o + 1] = 0x01; o += 2;
    let a = 1, b = 0, left = raw, pos = 0; // (adler-32 of the raw bytes, filter bytes included)
    const put = (v) => { out[o++] = v; a = (a + v) % 65521; b = (b + a) % 65521; };
    for (let k = 0; k < blocks; k++) {
      const n = Math.min(65535, left); left -= n;
      out[o] = k === blocks - 1 ? 1 : 0; out[o + 1] = n & 0xff; out[o + 2] = n >> 8; out[o + 3] = ~n & 0xff; out[o + 4] = (~n >> 8) & 0xff; o += 5;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++, pos++) { const y = (pos / rowBytes) | 0, x = pos - y * rowBytes; put(x === 0 ? 0 : rgba[y * width * 4 + x - 1]); }
    }
    dv.setUint32(o, ((b << 16) | a) >>> 0);
  });
  chunk('IEND', 0, () => {});
  return out;
}
```

`src/gfx/d3d-mirror.js`:

```js
// Replay side of the render worker (docs/render-worker.md section 5, D063): a mirror of each Direct3D device — the
// fields the WebGL backend reads, kept equal to the emulator's device at every draw by the recorded state changes —
// and mirror resources with the same ids, sizes, guest memory addresses and dirty state. The backend (WebGLDevice,
// unchanged) runs on the mirror exactly as it runs on the emulator's device in the in-thread path. Used by the render
// worker (src/gfx/render-worker.js) and, on the emulator's own thread, by ?glworker=inline and the tests.
import { OP, VERSION_FIELDS, CONST_FIELDS, RingReader } from './cmd-ring.js';
import { surfacePitch, surfaceBytes } from '../win32/d3d8.js';
import { StateTable } from '../win32/state-table.js';
import { declLayout9 } from './d3d9-shaders.js';

/** One 2D level (or cube face level) or standalone surface: the fields of win32/d3d8.js Surface the backend reads. */
export class MSurface {
  constructor(id, owner, fmt, w, h, usage, pool, level, face, mem) {
    this.id = id; this.owner = owner; this.fmt = fmt; this.width = w; this.height = h; this.usage = usage; this.pool = pool; this.level = level; this.face = face;
    this.pitch = surfacePitch(fmt, w); this.bytes = surfaceBytes(fmt, w, h);
    this.mem = mem; this._dirty = false; this.dirtyRect = null; this.type = 1;
  }
  get dirty() { return this._dirty; }
  set dirty(v) { this._dirty = v; this.dirtyRect = null; if (v && this.owner) this.owner.levelsClean = false; }
  /** the same union of locked rectangles as Surface.markLocked, against this mirror's own upload state */
  markLocked(r) {
    const d = this.dirtyRect, partial = r && (!this._dirty || d);
    this._dirty = true; if (this.owner) this.owner.levelsClean = false;
    this.dirtyRect = !partial ? null : !d ? [r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3]] : [Math.min(d[0], r[0]), Math.min(d[1], r[1]), Math.max(d[2], r[2]), Math.max(d[3], r[3])];
  }
  /** (a readback's memory, allocated by the recorder, is the surface's once the pixels are read: as in the backend) */
  ensureMem() { if (!this.mem && this.pendingMem) { this.mem = this.pendingMem; this.pendingMem = 0; } return this.mem; }
}
/** A texture (2D, cube or volume) with its levels; `slot` / `gen`: acknowledgement of uploaded contents. */
export class MTexture {
  constructor(id, kind, fmt, w, h, d, usage, pool, slot, gen) {
    this.id = id; this.fmt = fmt; this.width = w; this.height = h; if (kind === 3) this.depth = d; this.usage = usage; this.pool = pool;
    this.slot = slot; this.gen = gen; this.acked = -1; this.type = kind === 1 ? 3 : kind === 2 ? 5 : 4;
  }
}
export class MBuffer {
  constructor(id, type, length, usage, fmt, mem, slot, gen) {
    this.id = id; this.type = type; this.length = length; this.usage = usage; this.fmt = fmt; this.mem = mem;
    this.dirty = false; this.dirtyRange = false; this.dirtyLo = 0; this.dirtyHi = 0; this.slot = slot; this.gen = gen; this.acked = -1;
    /** the buffer's own copy of its contents once they travel in the ring (BUF_DATA): uploads read it, not guest memory */
    this.shadow = null;
  }
}

/** The backend-visible state of one Direct3D device (see WebGLDevice: everything it reads from `this.dev`). */
export class DeviceMirror {
  constructor(id, api9, pp, mem, replayer) {
    this.id = id; this.api9 = !!api9; this.pp = pp; this.proc = { mem }; this.mirror = true;
    this.com = { implAt: (rid) => replayer.res.get(rid) ?? null };
    this.rs = new StateTable(256); this.tss = []; if (api9) this.samplers = [];
    this.textures = []; this.streams = []; this.indices = { ib: 0, base: 0 };
    this.viewport = { x: 0, y: 0, w: pp.width, h: pp.height, minZ: 0, maxZ: 1 };
    this.vertexShader = 0; this.pixelShader = 0; this.vertexShaders = new Map(); this.pixelShaders = new Map();
    if (api9) { this.scissor = null; this.fvf = 0; this.vertexDecl = null; this.vsObj = null; this.psObj = null; }
    this.transforms = new Map(); this.transformSlotVersion = new Map();
    this.transformWords = new Map(); this.constWords = [null, null]; this.lightWords = new Map(); // (word views of the matrices, float constants and lights: Replayer.applyFast)
    for (const f of VERSION_FIELDS) this[f] = 0;
    this.lights = new Map(); this.lightEnabled = new Set(); this.material = new Float32Array(17); this.materialWords = new Int32Array(this.material.buffer);
    this.renderTarget = null; this.backBuffers = [];
    this.gfx = null;
  }
}

const memOfBytes = (b) => ({ u8: b, read16: (p) => b[p] | (b[p + 1] << 8) });
const copyBits = (dst, words) => { new Int32Array(dst.buffer, dst.byteOffset, dst.length).set(words); return dst; };

/**
 * Applies recorded commands to device mirrors and their backends. `opts`: mem (guest memory), createBackend(mirror)
 * → a WebGLDevice-like object or null (state only), ack (Int32Array acknowledgement table) or null, onPresent(mirror,
 * frame), onReadback(ticket), onCanvas(w, h), log.
 */
export class Replayer {
  constructor(words, opts) {
    this.reader = new RingReader(words);
    this.mem = opts.mem; this.opts = opts;
    /** the guest memories by index (MEMORY: the first one, then a child process's — docs/processes.md) */
    this.mems = [opts.mem];
    this.devices = new Map(); this.cur = null;
    this.res = new Map(); // resource id -> mirror resource (textures, their levels, surfaces, buffers)
    this.shaders = new Map(); this.decls = new Map();
    this.ack = opts.ack ?? null;
    this.commands = 0;
  }
  /** replay the commands available up to `available` (a word count): returns the number replayed */
  run(available, limit = Infinity) {
    const r = this.reader;
    let n = 0;
    while (r.consumed < available && n < limit) {
      if (!r.next()) continue; // (WRAP)
      this.apply(r);
      n++;
    }
    this.commands += n;
    return n;
  }
  /** a backend device whose uploads acknowledge the contents they read (glTexture / glBuffer) */
  attach(m) {
    const g = this.opts.createBackend?.(m) ?? null;
    m.gfx = g;
    if (g && this.ack) {
      const ack = this.ack, proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(g);
      g.glTexture = function (t) { const r = proto.glTexture.call(this, t); if (t.acked !== t.gen) { t.acked = t.gen; if (t.slot >= 0) ack[t.slot] = t.gen; } return r; };
      g.glBuffer = function (b, kind) { const r = proto.glBuffer.call(this, b, kind); if (b.acked !== b.gen) { b.acked = b.gen; if (b.slot >= 0) ack[b.slot] = b.gen; } return r; };
    }
    return g;
  }
  table(m, t) { return t === 0 ? m.rs : t <= m.tss.length ? m.tss[t - 1] : m.samplers[t - 1 - m.tss.length]; }
  /**
   * The commands of every draw read straight from the ring words (no decoded argument list, no views allocated); the
   * same effects as their general cases below. Returns false for the others (and for uncommon encodings).
   */
  applyFast(r) {
    const I = r.I, p = r.p, m = this.cur;
    switch (r.op) {
      case OP.TSETS: { const e = p + 1 + I[p]; for (let i = p + 1; i < e; i += 3) this.table(m, I[i]).set(I[i + 1], I[i + 2] >>> 0); return true; }
      case OP.VERSION: { const t = I[p + 1]; if (t > 1) return false; m[VERSION_FIELDS[I[p]]] = t === 0 ? I[p + 2] >>> 0 : I[p + 2]; return true; }
      case OP.TEXTURE: m.textures[I[p] >>> 0] = I[p + 1] >>> 0; return true;
      case OP.STREAM: { // stream, id, stride (n), offset (n): the common uint32 encodings
        if (I[p + 2] !== 0 || (I[p + 4] !== 0 && I[p + 4] !== 3)) return false;
        const s = m.streams[I[p] >>> 0]; s.vb = I[p + 1] >>> 0; s.stride = I[p + 3] >>> 0;
        if (I[p + 4] === 0) s.offset = I[p + 5] >>> 0; else if ('offset' in s) s.offset = undefined;
        return true;
      }
      case OP.INDICES: { const t = I[p + 1]; if (t > 1) return false; m.indices.ib = I[p] >>> 0; m.indices.base = t === 0 ? I[p + 2] >>> 0 : I[p + 2]; return true; }
      case OP.CONST: {
        const k = I[p] >>> 0, lo = I[p + 1] >>> 0, n = I[p + 2], dst = m[CONST_FIELDS[k]];
        if (n < 0) return false;
        if (k < 2) { // (floats as their bits: through the array's word view, kept while the array is the same)
          let w = m.constWords[k]; if (w === null || w.buffer !== dst.buffer || w.byteOffset !== dst.byteOffset) w = m.constWords[k] = new Int32Array(dst.buffer, dst.byteOffset, dst.length);
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) w[lo + i] = I[p + 3 + i];
        } else for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) dst[lo + i] = I[p + 3 + i];
        m.gfx?.constTouched?.(k, lo, lo + n);
        return true;
      }
      case OP.XFORM: { // slot, version (uint32), 16 words: the common case
        if (I[p + 1] !== 0 || I[p + 3] !== 16) return false;
        const slot = I[p] >>> 0;
        let x = m.transforms.get(slot), w = m.transformWords.get(slot);
        if (!x) { m.transforms.set(slot, (x = new Float32Array(16))); w = undefined; }
        if (w === undefined || w.buffer !== x.buffer) m.transformWords.set(slot, (w = new Int32Array(x.buffer, x.byteOffset, 16)));
        for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) w[i] = I[p + 4 + i];
        m.transformSlotVersion.set(slot, I[p + 2] >>> 0);
        return true;
      }
      case OP.MATERIAL: { // (the material array is kept: its word view too)
        const n = I[p]; if (n < 0 || n > m.material.length) return false;
        const w = m.materialWords.buffer === m.material.buffer ? m.materialWords : (m.materialWords = new Int32Array(m.material.buffer, m.material.byteOffset, m.material.length));
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) w[i] = I[p + 1 + i];
        return true;
      }
      case OP.LIGHT: {
        const i = I[p] >>> 0, n = I[p + 1]; if (n < 0 || n > 26) return false;
        let l = m.lights.get(i), w = m.lightWords.get(i);
        if (!l) { m.lights.set(i, (l = new Float32Array(26))); w = undefined; }
        if (w === undefined || w.buffer !== l.buffer) m.lightWords.set(i, (w = new Int32Array(l.buffer, l.byteOffset, 26)));
        for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) w[k] = I[p + 2 + k];
        return true;
      }
      case OP.DRAW: m.gfx?.drawPrimitive(I[p] >>> 0, I[p + 1] >>> 0, I[p + 2] >>> 0); return true;
      case OP.DRAW_INDEXED: { const t = I[p + 5]; if (t > 1) return false; m.gfx?.drawIndexedPrimitive(I[p] >>> 0, I[p + 1] >>> 0, I[p + 2] >>> 0, I[p + 3] >>> 0, I[p + 4] >>> 0, t === 0 ? I[p + 6] >>> 0 : I[p + 6]); return true; }
      default: return false;
    }
  }
  apply(r) {
    if (this.cur !== null && this.applyFast(r)) return;
    const a = r.decode(), m = this.cur, g = m?.gfx;
    switch (r.op) {
      case OP.DEVICE: { const d = new DeviceMirror(a[0], a[1], { width: a[2], height: a[3], swap: a[4], count: 1 }, this.mem, this); this.devices.set(a[0], d); this.cur = d; this.attach(d); break; }
      case OP.SELECT: this.cur = this.devices.get(a[0]) ?? null; break;
      case OP.MEMORY: if (this.mems[a[0]]) this.mem = this.mems[a[0]]; else this.opts.log?.(`render: guest memory ${a[0]} unknown`); break;
      case OP.FORGET: {
        const gm = this.mems[a[0]];
        for (const [id, d] of this.devices) if (d.proc?.mem === gm) { d.gfx?.destroy?.(); this.devices.delete(id); if (this.cur === d) this.cur = null; }
        this.mems[a[0]] = null;
        if (this.mem === gm) this.mem = this.mems[0];
        break;
      }
      case OP.DEVICE_DESTROY: { const d = this.devices.get(a[0]); d?.gfx?.destroy?.(); this.devices.delete(a[0]); if (this.cur === d) this.cur = null; break; }
      case OP.PP: m.pp = { width: a[0], height: a[1], swap: a[2], count: a[3] }; break;
      case OP.RESET: g?.reset(m); break;
      case OP.API9: m.api9 = !!a[0]; if (m.api9 && m.samplers === undefined) { m.samplers = []; m.scissor = null; m.fvf = 0; m.vertexDecl = null; m.vsObj = null; m.psObj = null; } break;
      case OP.TABLES: m.rs = new StateTable(256); m.tss = Array.from({ length: a[0] }, () => new StateTable(40)); m.samplers = a[1] ? Array.from({ length: a[1] }, () => new StateTable(16)) : undefined; break;
      case OP.TSET: this.table(m, a[0]).set(a[1], a[2]); break;
      case OP.TSETS: { const w = a[0]; for (let i = 0; i < w.length; i += 3) this.table(m, w[i]).set(w[i + 1], w[i + 2] >>> 0); break; }
      case OP.VIEWPORT: m.viewport = { x: a[0], y: a[1], w: a[2], h: a[3], minZ: a[4], maxZ: a[5] }; break;
      case OP.SCISSOR: m.scissor = a[0] ? { l: a[1], t: a[2], r: a[3], b: a[4] } : null; break;
      case OP.FVF: m.fvf = a[0]; break;
      case OP.DECL: m.vertexDecl = a[0] ? this.decls.get(a[0]) ?? null : null; break;
      case OP.VS9: { const s = a[0] ? this.shaders.get(a[0]) ?? null : null; m.vsObj = s; m.vertexShader = s ? s.handle : 0; break; }
      case OP.PS9: { const s = a[0] ? this.shaders.get(a[0]) ?? null : null; m.psObj = s; m.pixelShader = s ? s.handle : 0; break; }
      case OP.VS8: m.vertexShader = a[0]; if (a[1]) m.vertexShaders.set(a[0], this.shaders.get(a[1])); else m.vertexShaders.delete(a[0]); break;
      case OP.PS8: m.pixelShader = a[0]; if (a[1]) m.pixelShaders.set(a[0], this.shaders.get(a[1])); else m.pixelShaders.delete(a[0]); break;
      case OP.STREAMS: m.streams = Array.from({ length: a[0] }, () => (m.api9 ? { vb: 0, offset: 0, stride: 0 } : { vb: 0, stride: 0 })); break;
      case OP.STREAM: { const s = m.streams[a[0]]; s.vb = a[1]; s.stride = a[2]; if (a[3] !== undefined || 'offset' in s) s.offset = a[3]; break; }
      case OP.INDICES: m.indices.ib = a[0]; m.indices.base = a[1]; break;
      case OP.TEXTURES: m.textures = new Array(a[0]).fill(0); break;
      case OP.TEXTURE: m.textures[a[0]] = a[1]; break;
      case OP.RT: m.renderTarget = this.res.get(a[0]) ?? null; break;
      case OP.BACKBUFFERS: m.backBuffers = Array.from(a[0], (id) => this.res.get(id)); break;
      case OP.VERSION: m[VERSION_FIELDS[a[0]]] = a[1]; break;
      case OP.XFORMS: m.transforms = new Map(); m.transformSlotVersion = new Map(); m.transformWords = new Map(); break;
      case OP.XFORM: {
        if (a[2]) { let x = m.transforms.get(a[0]); if (!x) m.transforms.set(a[0], (x = new Float32Array(16))); copyBits(x, a[2]); } else m.transforms.delete(a[0]);
        if (a[1] === undefined) m.transformSlotVersion.delete(a[0]); else m.transformSlotVersion.set(a[0], a[1]);
        break;
      }
      case OP.LIGHTS: m.lights = new Map(); m.lightEnabled = new Set(); m.lightWords = new Map(); break;
      case OP.LIGHT: { let l = m.lights.get(a[0]); if (!l) m.lights.set(a[0], (l = new Float32Array(26))); copyBits(l, a[1]); break; }
      case OP.LIGHTS_ON: m.lightEnabled = new Set(a[0]); break;
      case OP.MATERIAL: copyBits(m.material, a[0]); break;
      case OP.CONSTS: {
        m.vsConst = new Float32Array(a[0]); m.psConst = new Float32Array(a[1]);
        if (a[2] || a[3] || a[4] || a[5]) { m.vsConstI = new Int32Array(a[2]); m.psConstI = new Int32Array(a[3]); m.vsConstB = new Uint8Array(a[4]); m.psConstB = new Uint8Array(a[5]); }
        break;
      }
      case OP.CONST: {
        const k = a[0], dst = m[CONST_FIELDS[k]], w = a[2];
        if (k < 2) new Int32Array(dst.buffer, dst.byteOffset, dst.length).set(w, a[1]);
        else if (k < 4) dst.set(w, a[1]);
        else for (let i = 0; i < w.length; i++) dst[a[1] + i] = w[i];
        g?.constTouched?.(k, a[1], a[1] + w.length); // (the backend compares only what was written, see WebGLDevice.constTouched)
        break;
      }
      // resources
      case OP.TEX: {
        const [id, kind, fmt, w, h, d, usage, pool, slot, gen, lv] = a;
        const t = new MTexture(id, kind, fmt, w, h, d, usage, pool, slot | 0, gen | 0);
        const n = lv.length / 5;
        const mk = (i, level, face) => new MSurface(lv[5 * i], t, fmt, lv[5 * i + 1], lv[5 * i + 2], usage, pool, level, face, lv[5 * i + 4] >>> 0);
        if (kind === 2) { const per = n / 6; t.faces = []; for (let f = 0; f < 6; f++) { const face = []; for (let i = 0; i < per; i++) { const s = mk(f * per + i, i, f); face.push(s); this.res.set(s.id, s); } t.faces.push(face); } }
        else if (kind === 3) { t.levels = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const lw = lv[5 * i + 1], lh = lv[5 * i + 2], ld = lv[5 * i + 3]; t.levels.push({ width: lw, height: lh, depth: ld, pitch: surfacePitch(fmt, lw), slice: surfaceBytes(fmt, lw, lh), bytes: surfaceBytes(fmt, lw, lh) * ld, mem: lv[5 * i + 4] >>> 0, locked: false }); } }
        else { t.levels = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const s = mk(i, i, 0); t.levels.push(s); this.res.set(s.id, s); } }
        this.res.set(id, t);
        break;
      }
      case OP.SURF: { const s = new MSurface(a[0], null, a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5], 0, 0, a[6]); if (a[7]) s.lockable = true; this.res.set(a[0], s); break; }
      case OP.BUF: this.res.set(a[0], new MBuffer(a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5], a[6] | 0, a[7] | 0)); break;
      case OP.DESTROY: {
        const x = this.res.get(a[0]); if (!x) break;
        g?.destroyResource(x);
        this.res.delete(a[0]);
        // (the emulator frees the memory right after: a mirror object still referenced — a render target the
        // Direct3D layer does not reference-count — sees it gone, as the device's own object does)
        x.mem = 0;
        for (const l of x.levels ?? []) { l.mem = 0; if (l.id !== undefined) this.res.delete(l.id); }
        for (const f of x.faces ?? []) for (const l of f) { l.mem = 0; this.res.delete(l.id); }
        break;
      }
      case OP.SURF_MEM: { const s = this.res.get(a[0]); if (s) s.mem = a[1]; break; }
      case OP.SURF_DIRTY: { const s = this.res.get(a[0]); if (!s) break; if (a[2]) s.markLocked(a[2]); else s.dirty = true; if (s.owner) s.owner.gen = a[1] | 0; break; }
      case OP.BUF_DIRTY: { const b = this.res.get(a[0]); if (!b) break; b.mem = a[4]; b.gen = a[1] | 0; b.dirty = true; g?.bufferUpdated(b, a[2], a[3]); break; }
      case OP.BUF_DATA: {
        const b = this.res.get(a[0]); if (!b) break;
        const bytes = a[3], sh = b.shadow ??= new Uint8Array(b.length);
        sh.set(bytes, a[1]);
        if (a[2] === 0) { b.dirty = true; g?.bufferUpdated(b, a[1], bytes.length); }
        break;
      }
      case OP.TEX_LOD: { const t = this.res.get(a[0]); if (t) t.lod = a[1]; break; }
      case OP.VOL_MEM: { const t = this.res.get(a[0]); const l = t?.levels?.[a[1]]; if (l) { l.mem = a[2]; l.dirty = true; t.gen = a[3] | 0; } break; } // (its memory, or new contents: uploaded at the next use, its generation acknowledged then)
      case OP.SHADER9: { const code = Uint32Array.from(a[3]); this.shaders.set(a[0], { kind: a[1] ? 'ps' : 'vs', code, handle: a[2], version: code[0] >>> 0 }); break; }
      case OP.SHADER8: this.shaders.set(a[0], a[1] ? { handle: a[2], code: Uint32Array.from(a[5]) } : { handle: a[2], decl: Uint32Array.from(a[4]), code: a[5] ? Uint32Array.from(a[5]) : null, usage: a[3] }); break;
      case OP.SHADER_DELETE: { const s = this.shaders.get(a[0]); if (!s) break; this.shaders.delete(a[0]); if (s.decl || s.kind === 'vs') g?.deleteVertexShader(s); else g?.deletePixelShader(s); break; }
      case OP.DECL_DELETE: this.decls.delete(a[0]); break;
      case OP.FORGET: this.res.delete(a[0]); break;
      case OP.DECL_CREATE: { const bytes = a[1].slice(); this.decls.set(a[0], { layout: declLayout9(memOfBytes(bytes), 0), bytes }); break; }
      // work
      case OP.BEGIN_SCENE: g?.beginScene(); break;
      case OP.CLEAR: g?.clear(a[0], a[5] ?? 0, a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4]); break;
      case OP.DRAW: g?.drawPrimitive(a[0], a[1], a[2]); break;
      case OP.DRAW_INDEXED: g?.drawIndexedPrimitive(a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5]); break;
      case OP.DRAW_UP: g?.drawPrimitiveUP(a[0], a[1], a[3], a[2]); break;
      case OP.DRAW_INDEXED_UP: g?.drawIndexedPrimitiveUP(a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[7], a[4], a[6], a[5]); break;
      // (the emulator waits for these two: answered even if the work throws)
      case OP.PRESENT: { const f = a[0]; try { this.opts.beforePresent?.(m, f); g?.present(); } finally { this.opts.onPresent?.(m, f); } break; }
      case OP.READBACK: { const t = a[1]; try { const s = this.res.get(a[0]); if (s) { s.pendingMem = a[2]; if (g) g.readbackSurface(s); s.ensureMem(); } } finally { this.opts.onReadback?.(t); } break; }
      case OP.STRETCH: { const s = this.res.get(a[0]), d = this.res.get(a[1]); if (s && d && g) g.stretchRect(s, a[3] ? Array.from(a[3]) : 0, d, a[4] ? Array.from(a[4]) : 0, a[2]); break; }
      case OP.GAMMA: g?.setGamma(a[0]); break;
      case OP.CANVAS: this.opts.onCanvas?.(a[0], a[1]); break;
      default: throw new Error(`render command ${r.op} unknown`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * The backend-visible differences between an emulator device and its mirror (debugging, ?glworker=check, tests):
 * descriptions of the fields that differ, empty when the mirror is exact.
 */
export function compareDevice(d, m, max = 20) {
  const out = [], bad = (what) => { if (out.length < max) out.push(what); };
  const idOf = (ptr) => (ptr ? d.com.implAt(ptr)?.id ?? -1 : 0);
  const sameBits = (a, b) => { if (!a || !b) return a === b || (!a && !b); if (a.length !== b.length) return false; const x = new Int32Array(a.buffer, a.byteOffset, a.length * a.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT >> 2), y = new Int32Array(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.length * b.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT >> 2); for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) if (x[i] !== y[i]) return false; return true; };
  const sameArr = (a, b) => { if (!a || !b) return !a === !b; if (a.length !== b.length) return false; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if (a[i] !== b[i]) return false; return true; };
  if (!!d.api9 !== m.api9) bad(`api9 ${d.api9} / ${m.api9}`);
  for (const k of ['width', 'height', 'swap']) if (d.pp[k] !== m.pp[k]) bad(`pp.${k} ${d.pp[k]} / ${m.pp[k]}`);
  const tables = (name, A, B) => {
    if ((A?.length ?? -1) !== (B?.length ?? -1)) { bad(`${name}: ${A?.length} tables / ${B?.length}`); return; }
    (A ?? []).forEach((t, i) => { const u = B[i]; if (t.size !== u.size) bad(`${name}[${i}] size ${t.size} / ${u.size}`); for (const [k, v] of t) if (!Object.is(u.get(k), v)) bad(`${name}[${i}].${k} ${v} / ${u.get(k)}`); });
  };
  tables('rs', [d.rs], [m.rs]); tables('tss', d.tss, m.tss); tables('samplers', d.samplers, m.samplers);
  if (d.textures.length !== m.textures.length) bad(`textures.length ${d.textures.length} / ${m.textures.length}`);
  d.textures.forEach((p, i) => { if (idOf(p) !== (m.textures[i] || 0)) bad(`textures[${i}] #${idOf(p)} / #${m.textures[i]}`); });
  d.textures.forEach((p, i) => { const t = p ? d.com.implAt(p) : null, mt = m.textures[i] ? m.com.implAt(m.textures[i]) : null; if (t && mt && (t.lod ?? 0) !== (mt.lod ?? 0)) bad(`texture #${t.id} LOD ${t.lod} / ${mt.lod}`); });
  if (d.streams.length !== m.streams.length) bad(`streams.length ${d.streams.length} / ${m.streams.length}`);
  d.streams.forEach((s, i) => { const t = m.streams[i]; if (!t || idOf(s.vb) !== (t.vb || 0) || s.stride !== t.stride || (s.offset ?? 0) !== (t.offset ?? 0)) bad(`streams[${i}] #${idOf(s.vb)}/${s.stride}/${s.offset} / #${t?.vb}/${t?.stride}/${t?.offset}`); });
  if (idOf(d.indices.ib) !== (m.indices.ib || 0) || d.indices.base !== m.indices.base) bad(`indices #${idOf(d.indices.ib)}/${d.indices.base} / #${m.indices.ib}/${m.indices.base}`);
  for (const k of ['x', 'y', 'w', 'h', 'minZ', 'maxZ']) if (!Object.is(d.viewport[k], m.viewport[k])) bad(`viewport.${k} ${d.viewport[k]} / ${m.viewport[k]}`);
  if (d.api9) {
    if (!d.scissor !== !m.scissor || (d.scissor && ['l', 't', 'r', 'b'].some((k) => d.scissor[k] !== m.scissor[k]))) bad(`scissor ${JSON.stringify(d.scissor)} / ${JSON.stringify(m.scissor)}`);
    if (d.fvf !== m.fvf) bad(`fvf ${d.fvf} / ${m.fvf}`);
    if (!d.vertexDecl !== !m.vertexDecl || (d.vertexDecl && !sameArr(d.vertexDecl.bytes, m.vertexDecl.bytes))) bad('vertexDecl');
    for (const k of ['vsObj', 'psObj']) if (!d[k] !== !m[k] || (d[k] && (d[k].handle !== m[k].handle || !sameArr(d[k].code, m[k].code)))) bad(k);
  } else {
    const vs = d.vertexShaders.get(d.vertexShader), mv = m.vertexShaders.get(m.vertexShader), ps = d.pixelShaders.get(d.pixelShader), mp = m.pixelShaders.get(m.pixelShader);
    if (!vs !== !mv || (vs && (!sameArr(vs.decl, mv.decl) || !sameArr(vs.code, mv.code)))) bad('current vertex shader');
    if (!ps !== !mp || (ps && !sameArr(ps.code, mp.code))) bad('current pixel shader');
  }
  if (d.vertexShader !== m.vertexShader) bad(`vertexShader ${d.vertexShader} / ${m.vertexShader}`);
  if (d.pixelShader !== m.pixelShader) bad(`pixelShader ${d.pixelShader} / ${m.pixelShader}`);
  for (const f of VERSION_FIELDS) if (d[f] !== m[f]) bad(`${f} ${d[f]} / ${m[f]}`);
  if (d.transforms.size !== m.transforms.size) bad(`transforms.size ${d.transforms.size} / ${m.transforms.size}`);
  for (const [k, x] of d.transforms) if (!sameBits(x, m.transforms.get(k))) bad(`transforms[${k}]`);
  if (d.transformSlotVersion.size !== m.transformSlotVersion.size) bad(`transformSlotVersion.size ${d.transformSlotVersion.size} / ${m.transformSlotVersion.size}`);
  for (const [k, v] of d.transformSlotVersion) if (m.transformSlotVersion.get(k) !== v) bad(`transformSlotVersion[${k}] ${v} / ${m.transformSlotVersion.get(k)}`);
  for (const [k, x] of d.lights) if (!sameBits(x, m.lights.get(k))) bad(`lights[${k}]`);
  if (d.lightEnabled.size !== m.lightEnabled.size || [...d.lightEnabled].some((i) => !m.lightEnabled.has(i))) bad(`lightEnabled ${[...d.lightEnabled]} / ${[...m.lightEnabled]}`);
  if (!sameBits(d.material, m.material)) bad('material');
  for (const f of CONST_FIELDS) if (d[f] instanceof Uint8Array ? !sameArr(d[f], m[f]) : !sameBits(d[f], m[f])) bad(f);
  if ((d.renderTarget?.id ?? 0) !== (m.renderTarget?.id ?? 0)) bad(`renderTarget #${d.renderTarget?.id} / #${m.renderTarget?.id}`);
  if (!sameArr(d.backBuffers.map((b) => b.id), m.backBuffers.map((b) => b?.id))) bad('backBuffers');
  return out;
}

```

`src/gfx/d3d-recorder.js`:

```js
// Recording side of the render worker (docs/render-worker.md section 5, D063). In place of the WebGL backend, each
// Direct3D device gets a Recorder as its `gfx`: it records what the backend would read — the device's state changes
// (from the state tables' set hooks, the constant writers, and a comparison of the few other fields at each draw,
// version counters copied as they are), resources by id with their guest memory and dirty rectangles, draws, clears,
// presents — into the command ring (cmd-ring.js) of a RenderLink. The render worker (or ?glworker=inline: the same
// thread) replays them into a device mirror (d3d-mirror.js) that the unchanged backend reads.
//
// The guest memory of resources is read by the render worker later than the draw that uses it, so every write path
// first calls beforeWrite / lockBuffer (fences: wait until no pending command may still read the old contents), and
// memory releases wait the same way (deferFree). A resource's contents are acknowledged by the render worker once
// uploaded (the ack table: the generation of the contents uploaded), after which writes need no wait. Buffers that
// are rewritten while in use (dynamic ones, and any a lock had to wait for) instead copy every written range into the
// ring at Unlock (BUF_DATA): the mirror keeps their contents and never reads their guest memory — no wait, no copy of
// the whole buffer.
import { OP, CTL, VERSION_FIELDS, CONST_FIELDS, RingWriter, TWO32, ACK_SLOTS } from './cmd-ring.js';
import { copyRectsCpu } from './d3d8-webgl.js';
import { fvfLayout, declLayout } from './d3d8-shaders.js';
import { acct, C as ACCT } from '../core/frame-acct.js';

const READONLY = 0x10, NOOVERWRITE = 0x1000;
/** frames recorded ahead of the frames the render worker has shown */
export const MAX_FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT = 2;
/** a wait for the render worker without any progress on its side for this long: it is considered dead */
export const STALL_MS = 30000; // (a software rasterizer on a loaded machine can spend seconds in one GL call)
const NO_RECT = null;
/** copy on write instead of a fence wait for resources up to this size (ORTHROS_RW_COW=0: always wait) */
const COW_MAX = 4 << 20;
const COW = () => globalThis.ORTHROS_RW_COW !== 0;
/** buffer bytes per BUF_DATA command */
const BUF_CHUNK = 1 << 20;
const DYNAMIC = 0x200;
const EMPTY_STATS = { draws: 0, programs: 0, uploads: 0, errors: 0, vaos: 0 };
/** the recorder entry points the recording probe times */
const REC_ENTRIES = ['drawPrimitive', 'drawIndexedPrimitive', 'drawPrimitiveUP', 'drawIndexedPrimitiveUP', 'clear', 'present', 'readbackSurface', 'stretchRect', 'bufferUpdated', 'surfaceDirty', 'surfaceMem', 'beginScene', 'reset', 'setGamma', 'destroyResource'];
/** parts of the recording the probe also times (inclusive, a figure each): the recorder's, then the link's */
const REC_SUBS = ['flush', 'syncTables', 'syncTexture', 'syncStream', 'syncTransforms', 'syncLights', 'syncConsts', 'putVersion', 'workDone', 'noteSet', 'constTouched', 'transformTouched', 'lockBuffer', 'beforeWrite', 'ensureRes'];
const LINK_SUBS = ['bufData', 'publish', 'mayRead'];

/**
 * Pending buffer bytes (RenderLink.lazyAdd) copied more widely than a draw reads when that is cheaper than bounding it:
 * a pending range of at most LAZY_PIECE bytes that a draw meets is copied whole, and a buffer with at most LAZY_ALL
 * bytes pending is copied whole at a draw that reads it (no index scan). Copying more is always right.
 */
const LAZY_PIECE = 16384, LAZY_ALL = 32768;
const pendingBytes = (p) => { let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 2) n += p[i + 1] - p[i]; return n; };
/** index of the first [lo, hi) pair of sorted disjoint ranges `p` (flat) that ends after `x` (p.length: none) */
const pairAfter = (p, x) => { let a = 0, b = p.length >> 1; while (a < b) { const m = (a + b) >> 1; if (p[2 * m + 1] > x) b = m; else a = m + 1; } return 2 * a; };
/** the recorded resource (texture of a level, else the resource itself) */
const recOf = (r) => (r.owner ?? r).rec;

export class RenderLink {
  /**
   * @param {{ words: Int32Array, ctl?: Int32Array, ack?: Int32Array, replayer?: any, log?: (m: string) => void, onFail?: (reason: string) => void }} o
   * `replayer`: inline mode (the commands replayed on this thread when needed); else `ctl`/`ack` are shared with a render worker.
   */
  constructor(o) {
    this.w = new RingWriter(o.words, (need) => this.waitSpace(need));
    this.ctl = o.ctl ?? null; this.ack = o.ack ?? null; this.replayer = o.replayer ?? null;
    this.log = o.log ?? (() => {}); this.onFail = o.onFail ?? null; this.stallMs = o.stallMs ?? STALL_MS;
    this.gen = 0; this.frames = 0; this.tickets = 0;
    this.freeSlots = []; this.nextSlot = 0;
    this.lastWorkEnd = 0; // ring position after the last command that may read bound resources (draws, clears...)
    this.deferred = []; // memory releases waiting for the render worker: [addr, position] pairs
    this.recorders = new Set(); this.curDev = -1; this.nextDeviceId = 1; this.nextObjId = 1;
    // (the mirror's ids of shaders and vertex declarations: kept here, not on the guest's objects, which snapshots save)
    this.objIds = new WeakMap();
    this.proc = null; this.failed = false;
    // (buffers whose contents travel in the ring with written bytes not copied yet — see lazyAdd; the vertex layouts'
    // streams by declaration object or FVF code — Recorder.streamsRead; the stale-read check, ORTHROS_VB_CHECK)
    this.u16 = null; this.u32 = null; this.lazyN = 0; this.layoutsByObj = new WeakMap(); this.layoutsByFvf = new Map(); this.vbCheck = null; this.checkStep();
    this.published = 0; this.notifiedAt = 0; this.drawsSinceNotify = 0;
    this.stats = { gpuWaitMs: 0, waits: 0, fenceWaits: 0, fenceMs: 0, frameWaits: 0, frameMs: 0, readbackMs: 0, readbacks: 0, ringWaits: 0, eagerBufs: 0, bufDataBytes: 0, bufDataCalls: 0, ixScans: 0, ixScanned: 0, vbChecked: 0, vbStale: 0, deferredFrees: 0, cows: 0, cowBytes: 0, fenceTex: 0, fenceBuf: 0 };
  }
  /** words the render worker has consumed (its 32-bit counter widened against what was produced) */
  consumedNow() {
    const w = this.w;
    if (this.replayer) return (w.consumed = this.replayer.reader.consumed);
    const tail = Atomics.load(this.ctl, CTL.TAIL) >>> 0, lo = w.produced % TWO32;
    return (w.consumed = w.produced - ((lo - tail + TWO32) % TWO32));
  }
  /** make the commands recorded so far visible; `urgent`: wake the render worker (inline: replay them now) */
  publish(urgent = false) {
    if (this.failed) return;
    const w = this.w;
    if (this.replayer) { if (urgent) this.drain(w.produced); return; }
    if (this.published !== w.produced) { this.published = w.produced; Atomics.store(this.ctl, CTL.HEAD, w.produced % TWO32 | 0); }
    if ((urgent || this.drawsSinceNotify >= 32 || w.produced - this.notifiedAt > 16384) && this.notifiedAt !== w.produced && Atomics.load(this.ctl, CTL.SLEEP)) { this.notifiedAt = w.produced; this.drawsSinceNotify = 0; Atomics.notify(this.ctl, CTL.HEAD); }
    if (this.deferred.length) this.releaseDeferred();
  }
  /** inline: replay up to `pos` on this thread */
  drain(pos) {
    const r = this.replayer;
    if (r.reader.consumed < pos) { const t0 = performance.now(); r.run(this.w.produced); this.replayMs = (this.replayMs ?? 0) + performance.now() - t0; }
    this.w.consumed = r.reader.consumed;
  }
  /** wait until `cond()` (re-checked as the render worker advances `word`), counting the time; false if the worker failed */
  waitFor(cond, word, kind) {
    if (cond()) return true;
    if (this.failed) return false;
    const ap = acct.enter(ACCT.render); // (frame accounting: the game thread waits for the render worker)
    try { return this.waitForNow(cond, word, kind); } finally { acct.leave(ap); }
  }
  waitForNow(cond, word, kind) {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    this.publish(true);
    if (this.replayer) { this.drain(this.w.produced); this.account(kind, t0); return cond(); }
    const ctl = this.ctl;
    Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.EMU_WAIT, 1);
    let beat = Atomics.load(ctl, CTL.HEARTBEAT), tail = Atomics.load(ctl, CTL.TAIL), still = t0;
    while (!cond()) {
      Atomics.notify(ctl, CTL.HEAD);
      Atomics.wait(ctl, word, Atomics.load(ctl, word), 20);
      const b = Atomics.load(ctl, CTL.HEARTBEAT), t = Atomics.load(ctl, CTL.TAIL), now = performance.now();
      if (b !== beat || t !== tail) { beat = b; tail = t; still = now; }
      // (no progress, or never the answer)
      if (now - still > this.stallMs || now - t0 > 3 * this.stallMs || Atomics.load(ctl, CTL.READY) < 0) { Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.EMU_WAIT, 0); this.fail(`render worker stalled for ${((now - still) / 1000).toFixed(1)} s waiting for ${kind}`); this.account(kind, t0); return false; }
      if (this.failed) break;
    }
    Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.EMU_WAIT, 0);
    this.account(kind, t0);
    return !this.failed;
  }
  account(kind, t0) {
    const ms = performance.now() - t0, s = this.stats;
    s.gpuWaitMs += ms; s.waits++;
    if (kind === 'fence') { s.fenceWaits++; s.fenceMs += ms; } else if (kind === 'frame') { s.frameWaits++; s.frameMs += ms; } else if (kind === 'readback') s.readbackMs += ms; else if (kind === 'ring') s.ringWaits++;
  }
  waitConsumed(pos, kind) { return this.waitFor(() => this.consumedNow() >= pos, CTL.TAIL, kind); }
  /** the ring is full: wait until the render worker has consumed enough (`need`: produced count wanted) */
  waitSpace(need) {
    const size = this.w.size;
    if (this.replayer) { this.drain(this.w.produced); return; }
    if (!this.waitConsumed(need - size, 'ring')) throw new Error('render worker gone while the command ring was full');
  }
  fail(reason) {
    if (this.failed) return;
    this.failed = true;
    this.w.waitSpace = () => { this.w.consumed = this.w.produced; }; // (nobody reads the ring any more: whatever is still recorded is dropped)
    this.log(`render worker: ${reason}; rendering goes on in this thread`);
    for (let i = 0; i < this.deferred.length; i += 2) this.proc?.vmem.release(this.deferred[i]);
    this.deferred.length = 0;
    this.onFail?.(reason);
  }
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- resources: ids, fences, memory
  slot() { return this.freeSlots.length ? this.freeSlots.pop() : this.nextSlot < ACK_SLOTS ? this.nextSlot++ : -1; }
  newRec(r, slotted) { const gen = ++this.gen; return (r.rec = { id: r.id, slot: slotted ? this.slot() : -1, gen, gen0: gen, lastRef: 0, binds: 0, destroyed: false, eager: false }); }
  /** latest ring position of a command that may read the resource's guest memory */
  lastRefOf(rr) { return rr.binds > 0 && this.lastWorkEnd > rr.lastRef ? this.lastWorkEnd : rr.lastRef; }
  /** may a command not yet replayed still read the resource's guest memory? */
  mayRead(rr) {
    const e = this.lastRefOf(rr);
    if (e <= this.w.consumed) return false;
    if (e <= this.consumedNow()) return false;
    return !(rr.slot >= 0 && this.ack !== null && this.ack[rr.slot] === (rr.gen | 0));
  }
  /**
   * Before the guest writes a resource's memory (`r`: a surface — texture level or standalone —, a volume texture):
   * while a pending command may still read the old contents, a surface of at most COW_MAX bytes gets new memory with
   * the contents copied (copy on write: the pending commands read the old block, released once they are replayed),
   * anything else waits.
   */
  beforeWrite(r) {
    const rr = recOf(r);
    if (!rr || this.failed || rr.destroyed || !this.mayRead(rr)) return;
    if (r.bytes !== undefined && r.owner !== undefined) { // (a surface)
      if (!r.mem) return; // (no memory yet: nothing a pending command could read)
      if (r.bytes <= COW_MAX && COW()) {
        const vmem = r.dev.proc.vmem, addr = vmem.alloc(Math.max(r.bytes, 16), 4, 'd3d8:surface-cow') >>> 0;
        if (addr) {
          r.dev.proc.mem.copy(addr, r.mem, r.bytes);
          this.deferred.push(r.mem, this.lastRefOf(rr));
          r.mem = addr; // (recorded: the commands after this point read the new memory)
          this.stats.cows++; this.stats.cowBytes += r.bytes;
          return;
        }
      }
    }
    this.stats.fenceTex++;
    this.waitConsumed(this.lastRefOf(rr), 'fence');
  }
  fence(rr) {
    if (!rr || this.failed || rr.destroyed || !this.mayRead(rr)) return;
    this.waitConsumed(this.lastRefOf(rr), 'fence');
  }
  bind(rr) { if (rr) rr.binds++; }
  unbind(rr) { if (rr) { rr.binds--; if (this.lastWorkEnd > rr.lastRef) rr.lastRef = this.lastWorkEnd; } }
  ref(rr) { if (rr) rr.lastRef = this.w.produced; }
  /**
   * A buffer locked for writing (Buffer.Lock). A buffer whose contents travel in the ring (`eager`: dynamic buffers
   * from their first use, others once a lock found them still read by pending commands) needs nothing: the render
   * worker never reads its guest memory. Otherwise, while a pending command may still read it, wait — then its
   * contents travel in the ring from now on.
   */
  lockBuffer(b, flags, off = 0, size = 0) {
    const rr = b.rec;
    if ((flags & READONLY) || !rr || this.failed || rr.eager || !this.mayRead(rr)) return;
    // NOOVERWRITE: the application does not write data pending draws use — but a pending upload may take more than
    // what the draws use: the whole buffer at its first upload (as after a context loss), and the union of the
    // ranges written since its last upload: waited for when the locked range meets them
    if ((flags & NOOVERWRITE) && rr.slot >= 0 && this.ack !== null && this.ack[rr.slot] - rr.gen0 >= 0 && !this.pendingOverlap(rr, off, size ? off + size : b.length)) return;
    this.stats.fenceBuf++;
    if (!this.waitConsumed(this.lastRefOf(rr), 'fence')) return;
    // (its contents as they are now, before the guest writes: what the mirror's pending dirty ranges upload too)
    rr.eager = true; this.stats.eagerBufs++;
    this.bufData(b, 0, b.length, 1);
  }
  /**
   * Copy guest bytes [start, start + size) of a buffer into the ring (BUF_DATA, in chunks): kind 0 written by the
   * guest (dirty in the mirror), 1 its contents as they are.
   */
  bufData(b, start, size, kind) {
    const W = this.w, u8 = this.proc.mem.u8, end = Math.min(b.length, start + size);
    for (let o = start; o < end; o += BUF_CHUNK) {
      const n = Math.min(BUF_CHUNK, end - o), p = W.begin(OP.BUF_DATA, 4 + ((n + 3) >> 2)), I = W.I, a = (b.mem + o) >>> 0;
      I[p] = b.id; I[p + 1] = o; I[p + 2] = kind; I[p + 3] = n;
      W.U8.set(u8.subarray(a, a + n), (p + 4) * 4);
    }
    if (end > start) { this.stats.bufDataBytes += end - start; this.stats.bufDataCalls++; }
    const rr = b.rec;
    if (this.vbCheck !== null && rr) { // (the check's copy of what the mirror buffer holds: its whole contents at the switch, then each copy)
      if (!rr.model && kind === 1 && start === 0 && end >= b.length) rr.model = new Uint8Array(b.length);
      if (rr.model && end > start) rr.model.set(u8.subarray((b.mem + start) >>> 0, (b.mem + end) >>> 0), start);
    }
  }
  /**
   * Bytes [lo, hi) of a buffer whose contents travel in the ring were written by the guest: copied when a draw reads
   * them (lazyTake), not at Unlock — bytes a lock writes but no draw reads before they are written again (or the buffer
   * is released) never travel. `rr.lz`: the bytes where the mirror's copy may differ from guest memory, sorted
   * [lo, hi) pairs; past 32 ranges the first two merge (a wider range: more bytes copied, never fewer).
   */
  lazyAdd(rr, lo, hi) {
    if (!(hi > lo)) return;
    const p = rr.lz ??= [];
    if (p.length === 0) this.lazyN++;
    let i = pairAfter(p, lo - 1);
    let j = i;
    while (j < p.length && p[j] <= hi) { if (p[j] < lo) lo = p[j]; if (p[j + 1] > hi) hi = p[j + 1]; j += 2; }
    p.splice(i, j - i, lo, hi);
    if (p.length > 64) p.splice(0, 4, p[0], Math.max(p[1], p[3]));
  }
  /** a draw reads bytes [lo, hi) of buffer `b` (contents in the ring): those not copied yet go now (BUF_DATA, written) */
  lazyTake(b, rr, lo, hi) {
    const p = rr.lz;
    if (!p || p.length === 0 || !(hi > lo)) return;
    for (let i = pairAfter(p, lo); i < p.length;) {
      const a = p[i], e = p[i + 1];
      if (a >= hi) break;
      const whole = e - a <= LAZY_PIECE, x = whole || a > lo ? a : lo, y = whole || e < hi ? e : hi; // (a short range: all of it — one copy, no split)
      this.bufData(b, x, y - x, 0);
      if (a < x && y < e) { p.splice(i + 2, 0, y, e); p[i + 1] = x; i += 4; } else if (a < x) { p[i + 1] = x; i += 2; } else if (y < e) { p[i] = y; i += 2; } else p.splice(i, 2);
    }
    if (p.length === 0) this.lazyN--;
  }
  /** ORTHROS_VB_CHECK (at each present): the stale-read check on or off, its counts logged every 600 frames */
  checkStep() {
    const on = !!globalThis.ORTHROS_VB_CHECK;
    if (on && this.vbCheck === null) { this.vbCheck = { frames: 0 }; this.log('render record: VB check on (buffers that switch to ring copies from now on)'); }
    else if (!on && this.vbCheck !== null) { this.vbCheck = null; this.log(`render record: VB check off: ${this.stats.vbChecked} draws checked, ${this.stats.vbStale} read stale data`); }
    if (this.vbCheck !== null && ++this.vbCheck.frames % 600 === 0) this.log(`render record: VB check: ${this.stats.vbChecked} draws checked, ${this.stats.vbStale} read stale data (${this.vbCheck.frames} frames)`);
  }
  /** a buffer's pending bytes forgotten (released, or its whole contents copied) */
  lazyDrop(rr) { if (rr.lz?.length) { rr.lz.length = 0; this.lazyN--; } }
  /** do the ranges written but not yet uploaded (generations past the acknowledged one) meet [lo, hi)? */
  pendingOverlap(rr, lo, hi) {
    const p = rr.pend; if (!p) return false;
    const acked = this.ack[rr.slot];
    let j = 0, hit = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 3) { if (p[i] - acked <= 0) continue; p[j++] = p[i]; p[j++] = p[i + 1]; p[j++] = p[i + 2]; if (p[i + 1] < hi && lo < p[i + 2]) hit = true; }
    p.length = j;
    return hit;
  }
  /** A resource's memory released: later if a pending command may still read it (true: the release is taken care of). */
  deferFree(rr, addr) {
    if (!rr || this.failed) return false;
    if (rr.eager) return false; // (the render worker never reads its guest memory)
    if (this.mayRead(rr)) { this.deferred.push(addr, this.lastRefOf(rr)); this.stats.deferredFrees++; return true; }
    return false;
  }
  releaseDeferred() {
    const c = this.consumedNow(), d = this.deferred;
    let j = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 2) { if (d[i + 1] <= c) this.proc?.vmem.release(d[i]); else { d[j++] = d[i]; d[j++] = d[i + 1]; } }
    d.length = j;
  }
  /**
   * Recording cost probe (ORTHROS_REC_TIME=<frames>, a worker debug global: harness dbg:): the recorders' entry points
   * (draws, clears, presents, readbacks, blits, dirty records, with the state sync they run) timed over that many
   * frames, the waits for the render worker taken out; one report logged. The state-table and constant hooks run
   * inside the Direct3D setters and are not counted (tools/render-record-bench.mjs measures everything).
   */
  recTimeStep() {
    const T = this.recTime;
    if (T) {
      if (--T.left > 0) return;
      for (const r of T.wrapped) for (const k of REC_ENTRIES) delete r[k];
      this.recTime = null;
      for (const r of T.wrapped) for (const k of REC_SUBS) delete r[k];
      for (const k of LINK_SUBS) delete this[k];
      const F = T.frames, ms = T.ms - (this.stats.gpuWaitMs - T.wait0) - T.n * T.overhead / 1000;
      // (the parts, inclusive — nested parts are inside their caller's figure; the hooks run inside the Direct3D setters)
      const parts = [...T.sub].filter(([, e]) => e.n).sort((a, b) => b[1].ms - a[1].ms).map(([k, e]) => `${k} ${((e.ms - e.n * T.inner / 1000) / F).toFixed(3)} (${(e.n / F).toFixed(0)})`).join(', ');
      this.log(`render record: ${(ms / F).toFixed(3)} ms per frame over ${F} frames (${T.n} entry calls, ${(T.n / F).toFixed(0)} per frame, timer ${T.overhead.toFixed(3)} us each taken out; waits ${(this.stats.gpuWaitMs - T.wait0).toFixed(0)} ms excluded); commands ${((this.w.produced - T.words0) * 4 / F / 1024).toFixed(0)} KiB per frame; parts, ms per frame (calls): ${parts}`);
      return;
    }
    const want = globalThis.ORTHROS_REC_TIME; if (!want) return;
    globalThis.ORTHROS_REC_TIME = undefined;
    const now = performance.now.bind(performance);
    const t = { ms: 0, n: 0, depth: 0, left: Number(want) || 60, frames: Number(want) || 60, wait0: this.stats.gpuWaitMs, words0: this.w.produced, wrapped: [...this.recorders] };
    { let x = 0; const c0 = now(); for (let i = 0; i < 20000; i++) { const a = now(); x += now() - a; } t.overhead = (now() - c0) * 1000 / 20000; t.inner = x * 1000 / 20000; } // (a timed empty span: its whole cost, and the part inside the span)
    for (const r of t.wrapped) for (const k of REC_ENTRIES) {
      const f = Recorder.prototype[k];
      r[k] = function () { if (t.depth++) { try { return f.apply(this, arguments); } finally { t.depth--; } } const t0 = now(); try { return f.apply(this, arguments); } finally { t.depth--; t.ms += now() - t0; t.n++; } };
    }
    // (the parts: inclusive time and calls of each, whoever calls them)
    t.sub = new Map();
    const part = (o, k, f) => { const e = { ms: 0, n: 0 }; t.sub.set(k, e); o[k] = function () { const t0 = now(); try { return f.apply(this, arguments); } finally { e.ms += now() - t0; e.n++; } }; };
    for (const r of t.wrapped) for (const k of REC_SUBS) part(r, k, Recorder.prototype[k]);
    for (const k of LINK_SUBS) part(this, k, RenderLink.prototype[k]);
    this.recTime = t;
    this.log(`render record: timing the recording over ${t.frames} frames`);
  }
  /** the statistics of a device's backend (inline: the backend itself; render worker: its last report) */
  statsFor(id) { return (this.replayer ? this.replayer.devices.get(id)?.gfx?.stats : this.remoteStats?.get(id)) ?? EMPTY_STATS; }
  /** the display's size changed (the canvas frames are presented on) */
  canvas(w, h) { if (!this.failed) this.w.put(OP.CANVAS, w, h); }
}

/** The `gfx` of one Direct3D device: records its work into a RenderLink (see the file comment). */
export class Recorder {
  constructor(link, dev) {
    this.link = link; this.dev = dev; this.w = link.w; this.id = link.nextDeviceId++;
    link.recorders.add(this); link.proc ??= dev.proc;
    this.mem = dev.proc.mem;
    this.dirtyT = []; this.dirtyK = []; this.nDirty = 0; // state table sets since the last flush (table, key): a count, not the arrays' length (shrinking an array costs)
    this.texHook = 0; this.streamHook = 0; this.shaderHook = false; this.xfDirty = []; this.nXf = 0;
    this.srKey = undefined; this.sr = null; // (streamsRead: the last layout's streams)
    this.fbos = new Set(); // surfaces the backend holds a framebuffer for (its `fbos` keys): StretchRect's GPU path
    this.s = { api9: !!dev.api9, rs: null, tss: null, samplers: null, pp: null, bb: null, rt: undefined, rtRes: null, vp: null, sc: undefined, fvf: undefined, decl: undefined, vs: undefined, ps: undefined, vs8: undefined, vs8o: undefined, ps8: undefined, ps8o: undefined,
      texArr: null, tex: [], texRes: [], streamsArr: null, sVb: [], sStride: [], sOff: [], sRes: [], indices: null, ib: undefined, ibase: undefined, ibRes: null,
      versions: new Array(VERSION_FIELDS.length).fill(NaN), xf: null, xfSlots: null, xfVer: NaN, lights: null, lightVer: NaN, lightSize: -1, lightShadow: new Map(), enabled: [], enabledSet: null, material: null, matArr: null, matW: null,
      consts: CONST_FIELDS.map(() => null), cWords: CONST_FIELDS.map(() => null), cLo: new Array(6).fill(Infinity), cHi: new Array(6).fill(-1) };
    link.curDev = this.id;
    const pp = dev.pp;
    this.w.put(OP.DEVICE, this.id, dev.api9 ? 1 : 0, pp.width >>> 0, pp.height >>> 0, pp.swap >>> 0);
  }
  /** the backend's statistics (render worker: its last report) */
  get stats() { return this.link.statsFor(this.id); }
  sel() { const L = this.link; if (L.curDev !== this.id) { L.curDev = this.id; this.w.c1(OP.SELECT, this.id); } }
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- hooks from the Direct3D layer
  noteSet(t, k) {
    if (k < t.v.length) { if (t.recMark[k]) return; t.recMark[k] = 1; }
    const n = this.nDirty++; this.dirtyT[n] = t; this.dirtyK[n] = k;
  }
  setTexture(st) { this.texHook |= 1 << st; }
  setStreamSource(n) { this.streamHook |= 1 << n; }
  setIndices() { this.s.ib = NaN; }
  createVertexShader() { this.shaderHook = true; }
  createPixelShader() { this.shaderHook = true; }
  deleteVertexShader(sh) { this.shaderHook = true; this.deleteShader(sh); }
  deletePixelShader(sh) { this.shaderHook = true; this.deleteShader(sh); }
  deleteShader(sh) { const id = this.link.objIds.get(sh); if (id && !this.link.failed) { this.sel(); this.w.c1(OP.SHADER_DELETE, id); this.link.objIds.delete(sh); } }
  constTouched(k, lo, hi) { const s = this.s; if (lo < s.cLo[k]) s.cLo[k] = lo; if (hi > s.cHi[k]) s.cHi[k] = hi; }
  surfaceDirty(sf, rect) {
    const rr = recOf(sf); if (!rr || rr.destroyed || this.link.failed) return;
    const gen = rr.gen = ++this.link.gen;
    if (rect) { const p = this.w.begin(OP.SURF_DIRTY, 7), I = this.w.I; I[p] = sf.id; I[p + 1] = gen; I[p + 2] = 4; I[p + 3] = rect[0]; I[p + 4] = rect[1]; I[p + 5] = rect[2]; I[p + 6] = rect[3]; }
    else this.w.put(OP.SURF_DIRTY, sf.id, gen, NO_RECT);
  }
  surfaceMem(sf) { const rr = recOf(sf); if (rr && !rr.destroyed && !this.link.failed && sf !== this.readbackOf) this.w.c2(OP.SURF_MEM, sf.id, sf.mem); }
  volumeMem(t, i) { if (t.rec && !t.rec.destroyed && !this.link.failed) this.w.put(OP.VOL_MEM, t.id, i, t.levels[i].mem, t.rec.gen | 0); }
  // (new contents of a volume level: a new generation, as surfaceDirty's — until the render worker uploads it, a write
  // to the texture waits for the commands that still read it, beforeWrite)
  volumeUpdated(t, i) { const rr = recOf(t); if (rr && !rr.destroyed && !this.link.failed) rr.gen = ++this.link.gen; this.volumeMem(t, i); }
  // (IDirect3DBaseTexture::SetLOD: the mirror's texture follows it — the backend's sampler reads it; not yet recorded:
  // ensureRes sends it with the texture)
  textureLod(t) { if (t.rec && !t.rec.destroyed && !this.link.failed) this.w.c2(OP.TEX_LOD, t.id, t.lod >>> 0); }
  bufferUpdated(b, start = 0, size = b.length) {
    const rr = b.rec; if (!rr || rr.destroyed || this.link.failed) return;
    rr.wgen++;
    if (rr.eager) { // (copied when a draw reads it — ORTHROS_VB_LAZY=0: now, as a whole)
      if (globalThis.ORTHROS_VB_LAZY === 0) { this.sel(); this.link.bufData(b, start, size, 0); } else this.link.lazyAdd(rr, start, Math.min(b.length, start + size));
      return;
    }
    rr.gen = ++this.link.gen;
    // (the ranges not yet uploaded, for lockBuffer: past 16 of them the two oldest merge — a wider range, never a lost one)
    const pend = rr.pend ??= [];
    if (pend.length >= 48) { pend[3] = Math.max(pend[0], pend[3]); pend[4] = Math.min(pend[1], pend[4]); pend[5] = Math.max(pend[2], pend[5]); pend.splice(0, 3); }
    pend.push(rr.gen, start, start + size);
    this.sel();
    const p = this.w.begin(OP.BUF_DIRTY, 5), I = this.w.I; I[p] = b.id; I[p + 1] = rr.gen; I[p + 2] = start; I[p + 3] = size; I[p + 4] = b.mem;
  }
  beforeWrite(r) { this.link.beforeWrite(r); }
  lockBuffer(b, flags, off, size) { this.link.lockBuffer(b, flags, off, size); }
  deferFree(r, addr) { return this.link.deferFree(r.rec, addr); }
  createTexture() {} createBuffer() {} createSurface() {} surfaceUpdated() {}
  setTransform() {} setViewport() {} setMaterial() {} setLight() {} lightEnable() {} setClipPlane() {} setRenderState() {} setTextureStageState() {} setSamplerState() {}
  setVertexShader() {} setVertexShaderConstant() {} setPixelShader() {} setPixelShaderConstant() {} setRenderTarget() {} setCursor() {} endScene() {}
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- resources by id
  ensureRes(r) {
    if (!r) return 0;
    const o = r.owner ?? r;
    if (o.rec) return r.id;
    const L = this.link, W = this.w;
    if (o.levels || o.faces) { // textures: their levels (with ids) and memory
      const kind = o.faces ? 2 : o.depth ? 3 : 1, rr = L.newRec(o, true);
      const list = o.faces ? o.faces.flat() : o.levels, lv = new Array(list.length * 5);
      for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) { const l = list[i]; lv[5 * i] = l.id ?? 0; lv[5 * i + 1] = l.width; lv[5 * i + 2] = l.height; lv[5 * i + 3] = l.depth ?? 1; lv[5 * i + 4] = l.mem; }
      W.put(OP.TEX, o.id, kind, o.fmt, o.width, o.height, o.depth ?? 1, o.usage, o.pool, rr.slot >>> 0, rr.gen, lv);
      if (o.lod) W.c2(OP.TEX_LOD, o.id, o.lod >>> 0);
    } else if (o.length !== undefined) { // buffers
      const rr = L.newRec(o, true);
      rr.buf = o; rr.wgen = 0; rr.lz = null; rr.ix = null; rr.model = null;
      W.put(OP.BUF, o.id, o.type, o.length, o.usage, o.fmt, o.mem, rr.slot >>> 0, rr.gen);
      // (a dynamic buffer, rewritten while draws that read it are pending: its contents travel in the ring)
      if (o.usage & DYNAMIC) { rr.eager = true; L.stats.eagerBufs++; L.bufData(o, 0, o.length, 1); }
    } else { // standalone surfaces (render targets, back buffers, depth, offscreen): never read by the render worker
      L.newRec(o, false);
      W.put(OP.SURF, o.id, o.fmt, o.width, o.height, o.usage, o.pool, o.mem, o.lockable ? 1 : 0);
    }
    return r.id;
  }
  destroyResource(r) {
    const rr = r.rec; if (!rr || rr.destroyed) return;
    rr.destroyed = true;
    this.link.lazyDrop(rr);
    if (rr.slot >= 0) this.link.freeSlots.push(rr.slot);
    // (destroyed while bound — a state block's texture is not reference-counted — its pointer may come back as
    // another object: every binding is resolved again at the next flush)
    if (rr.binds > 0) for (const x of this.link.recorders) { x.texHook = -1; x.streamHook = -1; x.s.ib = NaN; }
    for (const l of r.levels ?? (r.faces ? r.faces.flat() : r.type === 1 ? [r] : [])) if (l.id !== undefined) this.fbos.delete(l.id);
    this.lastTarget = null;
    if (this.link.failed) return;
    this.sel(); this.w.c1(OP.DESTROY, r.id);
  }
  shaderId(sh, dx9) {
    if (!sh) return 0;
    let id = this.link.objIds.get(sh); if (id) return id;
    this.link.objIds.set(sh, id = this.link.nextObjId++);
    if (dx9) this.w.put(OP.SHADER9, id, sh.kind === 'ps' ? 1 : 0, sh.handle >>> 0, sh.code);
    else this.w.put(OP.SHADER8, id, sh.decl ? 0 : 1, sh.handle >>> 0, sh.usage, sh.decl ?? null, sh.code ?? null);
    return id;
  }
  /** a vertex declaration released (VertexDecl.destroy) */
  declDestroyed(d) { const id = this.link.objIds.get(d); if (id && !this.link.failed) { this.w.c1(OP.DECL_DELETE, id); this.link.objIds.delete(d); } }
  declId(d) {
    if (!d) return 0;
    let id = this.link.objIds.get(d);
    if (!id) { this.link.objIds.set(d, id = this.link.nextObjId++); this.w.put(OP.DECL_CREATE, id, d.bytes); }
    return id;
  }
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- state
  /** Record every backend-visible change of the device since the last flush (before each command that reads them). */
  flush() {
    const d = this.dev, s = this.s, L = this.link, W = this.w;
    this.sel();
    // render / stage / sampler state tables
    if (!!d.api9 !== s.api9) { s.api9 = !!d.api9; W.c1(OP.API9, s.api9 ? 1 : 0); }
    if (d.rs !== s.rs || d.tss !== s.tss || d.samplers !== s.samplers) this.syncTables();
    else if (this.nDirty) { // (one TSETS command for the uint32 values — nearly all of them)
      const T = this.dirtyT, K = this.dirtyK, nd = this.nDirty;
      const p0 = W.begin(OP.TSETS, 1 + 3 * nd), I = W.I;
      let q = p0 + 1;
      for (let i = 0; i < nd; i++) {
        const t = T[i], k = K[i], v = t.get(k);
        if (k < t.v.length) t.recMark[k] = 0;
        if ((v >>> 0) === v && (k >>> 0) === k) { I[q] = t.recId; I[q + 1] = k; I[q + 2] = v; q += 3; }
        else (this.oddSets ??= []).push(t.recId, k, v);
      }
      I[p0] = q - p0 - 1;
      if (q < p0 + 1 + 3 * nd) { I[p0 - 1] = OP.TSETS | ((q - p0) << 8); W.produced -= p0 + 1 + 3 * nd - q; } // (the unused end given back)
      if (this.oddSets?.length) { const o = this.oddSets; for (let i = 0; i < o.length; i += 3) W.put(OP.TSET, o[i], o[i + 1] >>> 0, o[i + 2]); o.length = 0; }
      this.nDirty = 0;
    }
    if (d.pp !== s.pp) { s.pp = d.pp; W.put(OP.PP, d.pp.width >>> 0, d.pp.height >>> 0, d.pp.swap >>> 0, d.pp.count >>> 0); }
    if (d.backBuffers !== s.bb) {
      for (const b of s.bb ?? []) if (!d.backBuffers.includes(b) && b.rec && !b.rec.destroyed) { b.rec.destroyed = true; W.c1(OP.FORGET, b.id); } // (replaced by Reset)
      s.bb = d.backBuffers; for (const b of d.backBuffers) this.ensureRes(b); W.put(OP.BACKBUFFERS, d.backBuffers.map((b) => b.id));
    }
    if (d.renderTarget !== s.rt) {
      const rt = d.renderTarget; s.rt = rt;
      this.ensureRes(rt);
      const nres = rt?.owner ? rt.owner.rec : null; // (a texture level: its texture may be uploaded when its framebuffer is made)
      if (s.rtRes !== nres) { L.unbind(s.rtRes); L.bind(nres); s.rtRes = nres; }
      W.c1(OP.RT, rt ? rt.id : 0);
    }
    if (d.viewport !== s.vp) { const v = d.viewport; s.vp = v; W.put(OP.VIEWPORT, v.x, v.y, v.w, v.h, v.minZ, v.maxZ); }
    if (d.api9) {
      if (d.scissor !== s.sc) { const c = d.scissor; s.sc = c; if (c) W.put(OP.SCISSOR, 1, c.l, c.t, c.r, c.b); else W.put(OP.SCISSOR, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0); }
      if (d.fvf !== s.fvf) { s.fvf = d.fvf; W.put(OP.FVF, d.fvf); }
      if (d.vertexDecl !== s.decl) { s.decl = d.vertexDecl; W.c1(OP.DECL, this.declId(d.vertexDecl)); }
      if (d.vsObj !== s.vs) { s.vs = d.vsObj; W.c1(OP.VS9, this.shaderId(d.vsObj, true)); }
      if (d.psObj !== s.ps) { s.ps = d.psObj; W.c1(OP.PS9, this.shaderId(d.psObj, true)); }
    } else if (this.shaderHook || d.vertexShader !== s.vs8 || d.pixelShader !== s.ps8) {
      this.shaderHook = false;
      const vo = d.vertexShaders.get(d.vertexShader) ?? null, po = d.pixelShaders.get(d.pixelShader) ?? null;
      if (d.vertexShader !== s.vs8 || vo !== s.vs8o) { s.vs8 = d.vertexShader; s.vs8o = vo; const id = this.shaderId(vo, false); W.put(OP.VS8, d.vertexShader, id); }
      if (d.pixelShader !== s.ps8 || po !== s.ps8o) { s.ps8 = d.pixelShader; s.ps8o = po; const id = this.shaderId(po, false); W.put(OP.PS8, d.pixelShader, id); }
    }
    // textures of the stages (by object: a pointer may be reused by another object once released)
    const tx = d.textures;
    if (tx !== s.texArr) {
      s.texArr = tx; W.c1(OP.TEXTURES, tx.length);
      for (const r of s.texRes) L.unbind(r);
      s.tex = new Array(tx.length).fill(0); s.texRes = new Array(tx.length).fill(null); this.texHook = -1;
    }
    // (every change of a stage's texture goes through gfx.setTexture — SetTexture, state blocks — or replaces the array)
    if (this.texHook) { // (the stages it names, lowest first)
      for (let m = this.texHook, n = tx.length; m !== 0; m &= m - 1) { const i = 31 - Math.clz32(m & -m); if (i >= n) break; this.syncTexture(i); }
      this.texHook = 0;
    }
    // vertex streams and indices
    const st = d.streams;
    if (st !== s.streamsArr) {
      s.streamsArr = st; W.c1(OP.STREAMS, st.length);
      for (const r of s.sRes) L.unbind(r);
      s.sVb = new Array(st.length).fill(0); s.sStride = new Array(st.length).fill(0); s.sOff = new Array(st.length).fill(d.api9 ? 0 : undefined); s.sRes = new Array(st.length).fill(null);
      this.streamHook = -1;
    }
    // (every change of a stream goes through gfx.setStreamSource, or replaces the array)
    if (this.streamHook) { // (the streams it names, lowest first)
      for (let m = this.streamHook, n = st.length; m !== 0; m &= m - 1) { const i = 31 - Math.clz32(m & -m); if (i >= n) break; this.syncStream(i, st[i]); }
      this.streamHook = 0;
    }
    if (d.indices !== s.indices || d.indices.ib !== s.ib || d.indices.base !== s.ibase) {
      const ix = d.indices; s.indices = ix; s.ib = ix.ib; s.ibase = ix.base;
      const r = ix.ib ? d.com.implAt(ix.ib) : null, nres = r ? (this.ensureRes(r), r.rec) : null;
      if (nres !== s.ibRes) { L.unbind(s.ibRes); L.bind(nres); s.ibRes = nres; }
      const base = ix.base;
      if ((base >>> 0) === base) { const p = W.begin(OP.INDICES, 3), I = W.I; I[p] = r ? r.id : 0; I[p + 1] = 0; I[p + 2] = base; } else W.put(OP.INDICES, r ? r.id : 0, base);
    }
    // transforms, lights, material, constants
    if (d.transformVersion !== s.xfVer || d.transforms !== s.xf || d.transformSlotVersion !== s.xfSlots) this.syncTransforms();
    if (d.lightVersion !== s.lightVer || d.lights !== s.lights || d.lights.size !== s.lightSize || d.lightEnabled !== s.enabledSet || d.lightEnabled.size !== s.enabled.length) this.syncLights();
    this.syncConsts();
    // version counters, as they are (the mirror never recomputes them; fields read by name: VERSION_FIELDS order)
    const V = s.versions;
    if (d.stateVersion !== V[0]) this.putVersion(0, d.stateVersion);
    if (d.programVersion !== V[1]) this.putVersion(1, d.programVersion);
    if (d.transformVersion !== V[2]) this.putVersion(2, d.transformVersion);
    if (d.lightVersion !== V[3]) this.putVersion(3, d.lightVersion);
    if (d.viewportVersion !== V[4]) this.putVersion(4, d.viewportVersion);
    if (d.constVersion !== V[5]) this.putVersion(5, d.constVersion);
    if (d.transformAllVersion !== V[6]) this.putVersion(6, d.transformAllVersion);
    if (d.vsConstVersion !== undefined && d.vsConstVersion !== V[7]) this.putVersion(7, d.vsConstVersion);
    if (d.psConstVersion !== undefined && d.psConstVersion !== V[8]) this.putVersion(8, d.psConstVersion);
  }
  putVersion(i, v) {
    const W = this.w; this.s.versions[i] = v;
    if ((v >>> 0) === v) { const p = W.begin(OP.VERSION, 3), I = W.I; I[p] = i; I[p + 1] = 0; I[p + 2] = v; } else W.put(OP.VERSION, i, v);
  }
  syncTables() {
    const d = this.dev, s = this.s, W = this.w;
    for (const t of [s.rs, ...(s.tss ?? []), ...(s.samplers ?? [])]) if (t && t.rec === this) t.rec = null;
    s.rs = d.rs; s.tss = d.tss; s.samplers = d.samplers;
    const all = [d.rs, ...d.tss, ...(d.samplers ?? [])];
    W.c2(OP.TABLES, d.tss.length, d.samplers ? d.samplers.length : 0);
    all.forEach((t, id) => {
      t.rec = this; t.recId = id; t.recMark = new Uint8Array(t.v.length);
      for (const [k, v] of t) W.put(OP.TSET, id, k >>> 0, v);
    });
    this.nDirty = 0;
  }
  syncTexture(i) {
    const d = this.dev, s = this.s, L = this.link, ptr = d.textures[i];
    const r = ptr ? d.com.implAt(ptr) : null, old = s.texRes[i], nres = r ? (this.ensureRes(r), r.rec) : null;
    s.tex[i] = ptr;
    if (nres === old && ptr) return;
    L.unbind(old); L.bind(nres); s.texRes[i] = nres;
    this.w.c2(OP.TEXTURE, i, r ? r.id : 0);
  }
  syncStream(i, x) {
    const d = this.dev, s = this.s, L = this.link;
    const r = x.vb ? d.com.implAt(x.vb) : null, nres = r ? (this.ensureRes(r), r.rec) : null;
    if (nres === s.sRes[i] && x.vb === s.sVb[i] && x.stride === s.sStride[i] && x.offset === s.sOff[i]) return; // (set again: nothing the mirror does not hold)
    s.sVb[i] = x.vb; s.sStride[i] = x.stride; s.sOff[i] = x.offset;
    if (nres !== s.sRes[i]) { L.unbind(s.sRes[i]); L.bind(nres); s.sRes[i] = nres; }
    const W = this.w, stride = x.stride, off = x.offset;
    if ((stride >>> 0) === stride && (off >>> 0) === off) { const p = W.begin(OP.STREAM, 6), I = W.I; I[p] = i; I[p + 1] = r ? r.id : 0; I[p + 2] = 0; I[p + 3] = stride; I[p + 4] = 0; I[p + 5] = off; } // (the common cases, encoded in place)
    else if ((stride >>> 0) === stride && off === undefined) { const p = W.begin(OP.STREAM, 5), I = W.I; I[p] = i; I[p + 1] = r ? r.id : 0; I[p + 2] = 0; I[p + 3] = stride; I[p + 4] = 3; } // (Direct3D 8: no offset)
    else W.put(OP.STREAM, i, r ? r.id : 0, stride, off);
  }
  /** a transform slot changed (Device.touchTransform: every change of a matrix goes through it) */
  transformTouched(slot) { const x = this.xfDirty, n = this.nXf; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (x[i] === slot) return; x[n] = slot; this.nXf = n + 1; }
  syncTransforms() {
    const d = this.dev, s = this.s, W = this.w, x = this.xfDirty;
    if (d.transforms !== s.xf || d.transformSlotVersion !== s.xfSlots) {
      s.xf = d.transforms; s.xfSlots = d.transformSlotVersion;
      W.c0(OP.XFORMS);
      const slots = new Set([...d.transforms.keys(), ...d.transformSlotVersion.keys()]);
      for (const k of slots) this.putXform(k);
    } else for (let i = 0, n = this.nXf; i < n; i++) this.putXform(x[i]);
    this.nXf = 0;
    s.xfVer = d.transformVersion;
  }
  putXform(slot) {
    const d = this.dev, m = d.transforms.get(slot), ver = d.transformSlotVersion.get(slot), W = this.w;
    if (m && m.length === 16 && (ver >>> 0) === ver) { // (the common case, encoded in place)
      const p = W.begin(OP.XFORM, 20), I = W.I;
      I[p] = slot; I[p + 1] = 0; I[p + 2] = ver; I[p + 3] = 16;
      W.F.set(m, p + 4); // (same element type: a copy of the bytes, bit-exact)
      return;
    }
    W.put(OP.XFORM, slot >>> 0, ver, m ? new Int32Array(m.buffer, m.byteOffset, m.length) : null);
  }
  syncLights() {
    const d = this.dev, s = this.s, W = this.w;
    if (d.lights !== s.lights || d.lightEnabled !== s.enabledSet) { s.lights = d.lights; s.enabledSet = d.lightEnabled; s.lightShadow = new Map(); s.enabled = []; s.material = null; W.c0(OP.LIGHTS); }
    // (each light compared as words with the copy last recorded; its word view kept while the device keeps its array)
    const lights = d.lights, shadow = s.lightShadow;
    for (const i of lights.keys()) {
      const l = lights.get(i);
      let e = shadow.get(i);
      if (e === undefined || e.arr !== l) { const w = new Int32Array(l.buffer, l.byteOffset, l.length); e = { arr: l, w, sh: e?.sh?.length === w.length ? e.sh : null }; shadow.set(i, e); }
      const w = e.w, n = w.length;
```
