`src/gfx/render-worker.js`:

```js
// Render worker (docs/render-worker.md, D063): replays the Direct3D work the emulator records (cmd-ring.js) into
// device mirrors read by the unchanged WebGL backend, on its own OffscreenCanvas and WebGL2 context, and posts each
// presented frame to the page. Guest memory is shared with the emulator worker: resource contents are read from it
// (the emulator's fences keep them stable until read), readback pixels written into it while the emulator waits.
import { createWebGLBackend } from './d3d8-webgl.js';
import { programsPost } from './program-id.js';
import { Replayer } from './d3d-mirror.js';
import { CTL } from './cmd-ring.js';
import { replayLoop, publishTail } from './render-loop.js';
import { GuestMemory } from '../cpu/memory.js';
import { refreshApiOpt } from '../core/api-opt.js';

let ctl = null, port = null, replayer = null, backend = null, canvas = null;
const replay = { ms: 0, frames: 0, commands: 0, waitMs: 0 };
const log = (msg) => port?.postMessage({ type: 'log', kind: 'gfx', msg });

self.onmessage = (e) => {
  const m = e.data;
  if (m.type === 'init') { try { init(m); } catch (err) { self.postMessage({ type: 'failed', reason: String(err?.stack ?? err) }); if (ctl) Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.READY, -1); } }
  else if (m.type === 'memory') { replayer.mems[m.index] = new GuestMemory({ memory: m.memory }); Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.MEMORIES, m.index); Atomics.notify(ctl, CTL.MEMORIES); } // (a child process's: docs/processes.md)
  else if (m.type === 'dbg') { const [k, v] = String(m.kv ?? '').split('='); if (/^ORTHROS_[A-Z0-9_]+$/.test(k)) globalThis[k] = v === undefined || v === '' ? undefined : Number.isNaN(Number(v)) ? v : Number(v); refreshApiOpt(); }
  else if (m.type === 'capture') { const d = backend?.device; if (d) { if (m.at !== undefined) d.captureAt = d.frame + 1; if (m.draws !== undefined) d.captureDraws = !!m.draws; if (m.count !== undefined) d.countFrames = m.count; } }
  else if (m.type === 'loseContext') { const ext = backend?.gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context'); if (ext) { ext.loseContext(); setTimeout(() => ext.restoreContext(), m.ms ?? 500); } else log('d3d-webgl: WEBGL_lose_context unavailable'); }
};

function init(m) {
  const o = m.opts ?? {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(o.globals ?? {})) globalThis[k] = v;
  ctl = new Int32Array(m.ctl); port = m.port;
  const mem = new GuestMemory({ memory: m.memory });
  canvas = new OffscreenCanvas(o.width || 1024, o.height || 768);
  const dump = (name, w, h, rgba) => { try { const c = new OffscreenCanvas(w, h); c.getContext('2d').putImageData(new ImageData(new Uint8ClampedArray(rgba.buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer ? rgba.buffer : rgba.slice().buffer, rgba.buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer ? rgba.byteOffset : 0, w * h * 4), w, h), 0, 0); c.convertToBlob({ type: 'image/png' }).then((b) => b.arrayBuffer()).then((ab) => port.postMessage({ type: 'dump', name, data: ab }, [ab])); } catch (err) { log(`dump ${name} failed: ${err.message}`); } };
  backend = createWebGLBackend(canvas, log, dump);
  if (!backend) { Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.READY, -1); self.postMessage({ type: 'failed', reason: 'WebGL2 unavailable in the render worker' }); return; }
  programSync(o.programs);
  replayer = new Replayer(new Int32Array(m.ring), {
    mem, ack: new Int32Array(m.ack), createBackend: (mirror) => backend.createDevice(mirror),
    // (?glworker=compare-worker: the back buffer of every `compareEvery`-th frame sent for comparison, no frame shown)
    beforePresent: o.compareEvery ? (mirror, frame) => { if (frame % o.compareEvery === 0 && mirror.gfx) { const snap = mirror.gfx.readBackBuffer(); self.postMessage({ type: 'compare', frame, snap }, [snap.px.buffer]); } } : null,
    onPresent: (mirror, frame) => {
      let bitmap = null;
      try { bitmap = canvas.transferToImageBitmap(); } catch { /* context lost: no frame until restored */ }
      // (ORTHROS_RW_NO_PRESENT=1, a debug global: frames rendered but not handed to the page — what the page's hand-off costs it)
      if (bitmap) { if (o.noPresent || globalThis.ORTHROS_RW_NO_PRESENT) bitmap.close(); else port.postMessage({ type: 'frame', layer: 'gl', bitmap }, [bitmap]); }
      replay.frames++;
      Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.SHOWN, frame); Atomics.notify(ctl, CTL.SHOWN);
    },
    onReadback: (ticket) => { publishTail(ctl, replayer); Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.READBACK, ticket); Atomics.notify(ctl, CTL.READBACK); },
    onCanvas: (w, h) => { if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) { canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h; } },
  });
  canvas.addEventListener?.('webglcontextrestored', () => Atomics.add(ctl, CTL.EPOCH, 1));
  Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.READY, 1);
  self.postMessage({ type: 'ready', renderer: String(backend.gl.getParameter(backend.gl.RENDERER)) });
  setInterval(postStats, 500);
  replayLoop(ctl, replayer, backend, replay, () => false, log).catch((e) => { log(`render worker: replay loop stopped: ${e?.stack ?? e}`); });
}

function postStats() {
  const pc = backend.programCache, devices = [];
  for (const [id, m] of replayer.devices) if (m.gfx) devices.push([id, { ...m.gfx.stats }]);
  const pcs = { queueLength: pc.queue.length, started: pc.started, hits: pc.hits, pending: pc.pending, resolved: pc.resolved ?? 0, caughtUp: pc.caughtUp ?? 0, resolveMs: pc.resolveMs ?? 0, resolveMaxMs: pc.resolveMaxMs ?? 0, polls: pc.polls ?? 0, pollMs: pc.pollMs ?? 0, startMs: pc.startMs ?? 0, resolvedHits: pc.resolvedHits ?? 0, parallel: pc.parallel };
  self.postMessage({ type: 'stats', devices, programCache: pcs, replay: { ...replay, commands: replayer.commands } });
}

/** GL programs of earlier sessions compiled ahead, this session's new ones sent back (as the in-thread path does) */
function programSync(url) {
  if (!url) return;
  const pc = backend.programCache;
  fetch(url).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : [])).then((list) => { if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) { pc.queue.push(...list); log(`programs: ${list.length} learned from earlier sessions, compiled ahead in the render worker${pc.parallel ? ' (parallel compilation)' : ''}`); } }).catch(() => {});
  setInterval(() => {
    if (!pc.learned.length && !pc.used.length) return;
    fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: programsPost(pc.learned.splice(0), pc.used.splice(0)) }).catch(() => {});
  }, 5000);
}
```

```js

// Browser ports can also use the session resolver for their multiplayer identity.
import { createHash, randomBytes, randomUUID, scrypt as scryptCallback, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { gunzipSync } from 'node:zlib';

import { forwardedOrigin, sameOrigin } from './request-origin.js';

const scrypt = promisify(scryptCallback);
const COOKIE = 'orthros_session';
const OAUTH_COOKIE = 'orthros_oauth', SIGNUP_COOKIE = 'orthros_google'; // (a Google sign-in under way; a new player choosing a name)
const FLOW_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;
const SESSION_MS = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const MAX_BACKUP = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_HISTORY = 20;
const MAX_USER_BYTES = 512 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_SITE_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
const USERNAME = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{2,31}$/;
const GAME = /^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,127}$/;
const HASH = /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/;
const DEFAULT_ORIGIN = 'https://orthros.chalco.website';

function sha256(value) { return createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex'); }
function reply(res, status, value, headers = {}) {
  const body = JSON.stringify(value);
  res.writeHead(status, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body), 'Cache-Control': 'no-store', ...headers });
  res.end(body);
}
function cookie(token, secure, maxAge = Math.floor(SESSION_MS / 1000)) {
  return `${COOKIE}=${token}; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=${maxAge}${secure ? '; Secure' : ''}`;
}
function requestToken(req, name = COOKIE) {
  const raw = req.headers.cookie?.split(';').map((x) => x.trim()).find((x) => x.startsWith(`${name}=`));
  const token = raw?.slice(name.length + 1) ?? '';
  return /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(token) ? token : null;
}
function html(res, status, body, headers = {}) {
  res.writeHead(status, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', 'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body), 'Cache-Control': 'no-store',
    'Referrer-Policy': 'no-referrer', 'X-Frame-Options': 'DENY', ...headers });
  res.end(body);
}
/** A page's own address to come back to (a path of this site), or the home screen. */
const backPath = (value) => (typeof value === 'string' && value.length <= 2048 && value.startsWith('/') && !value.startsWith('//') && !value.includes('\\') ? value : '/');
function sendBytes(res, row) {
  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream', 'Content-Length': row.data.length,
    'Cache-Control': 'private, no-store', 'X-Orthros-Backup-Hash': row.hash,
    'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${row.game_id}-v${row.version}.orthros-save"` });
  res.end(row.data);
}
async function readBody(req, max) {
  const chunks = []; let n = 0;
  for await (const chunk of req) {
    n += chunk.length;
    if (n > max) { const error = new Error('too large'); error.status = 413; throw error; }
    chunks.push(chunk);
  }
  return Buffer.concat(chunks);
}
function clientIp(req) {
  return String(req.headers['x-forwarded-for'] ?? req.socket.remoteAddress ?? '').split(',')[0].trim();
}
function validBackup(bytes, game) {
  try {
    const raw = gunzipSync(bytes, { maxOutputLength: 128 * 1024 * 1024 });
    const data = JSON.parse(raw.toString('utf8'));
    if (data?.format !== 'orthros-profile' || data.version !== 1 || data.game !== game ||
        !Array.isArray(data.files) || data.files.length > 10000) return false;
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const file of data.files) {
      if (typeof file.path !== 'string' || !file.path || file.path.length > 1024 ||
          file.path.startsWith('/') || file.path.includes('\\') ||
          file.path.split('/').some((part) => !part || part === '.' || part === '..') ||
          typeof file.data !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(file.data) ||
          (file.mtime !== undefined && !Number.isFinite(file.mtime)) ||
          seen.has(file.path)) return false;
      seen.add(file.path);
    }
    return true;
  } catch { return false; }
}

export function createAccountApi(dir, { publicOrigin = DEFAULT_ORIGIN, allowedGame = () => true, maxUserBytes = MAX_USER_BYTES, google: googleSettings = null } = {}) {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  const db = new DatabaseSync(path.join(dir, 'accounts.sqlite'));
  db.exec('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000; PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;');
  db.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
      token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS port_tokens (
      token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      installation TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sessions_expiry ON sessions(expires_at);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS backups (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      game_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      size INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, data BLOB NOT NULL,
      UNIQUE(user_id, game_id, version)
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS backups_latest ON backups(user_id, game_id, version DESC);
    -- (other ways to sign in to an account: Google, its subject; an account made with Google has no password, '')
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS identities (
      provider TEXT NOT NULL, subject TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      email TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(provider, subject)
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS identities_user ON identities(user_id);
  `);
  const google = googleClient(dir, googleSettings);
  const flows = new Map(), signups = new Map(); // (Google sign-ins under way: by state; new players choosing a name: by cookie)
  const keep = (map, key, value) => {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (map.size > 500) for (const [k, v] of map) if (v.expires <= now) map.delete(k);
    if (map.size > 2000) map.delete(map.keys().next().value);
    map.set(key, { ...value, expires: now + FLOW_MS });
  };
  const take = (map, key) => { const v = key ? map.get(key) : null; if (key) map.delete(key); return v && v.expires > Date.now() ? v : null; };
  const limits = new Map();
  const sessionStmt = db.prepare(`SELECT u.id, u.username FROM sessions s JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id
    WHERE s.token_hash=? AND s.expires_at>?`);
  function session(req) {
    const token = requestToken(req);
    return token ? sessionStmt.get(sha256(token), Date.now()) : null;
  }
  function limited(req, action, max, windowMs) {
    const now = Date.now(), key = `${clientIp(req)}:${action}`;
    const rec = limits.get(key);
    if (!rec || now >= rec.until) { limits.set(key, { count: 1, until: now + windowMs }); return false; }
    rec.count++;
    if (limits.size > 10000) for (const [k, v] of limits) if (v.until <= now) limits.delete(k);
    return rec.count > max;
  }
  async function passwordHash(password, salt = randomBytes(16).toString('hex')) {
    const hash = await scrypt(password, Buffer.from(salt, 'hex'), 64);
    return `${salt}:${hash.toString('hex')}`;
  }
  async function verifyPassword(password, stored) {
    if (!stored) { await passwordHash('no-password'); return false; } // (an account made with Google: no password yet)
    const [salt, expected] = stored.split(':');
    const hash = await passwordHash(password, salt);
    return timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(hash.split(':')[1], 'hex'), Buffer.from(expected, 'hex'));
  }
  async function jsonBody(req) {
    const bytes = await readBody(req, 4096);
    try { return JSON.parse(bytes.toString('utf8')); } catch { return null; }
  }
  /** What a page knows of its player: the name, the Google address linked (or null), whether a password is set. */
  function publicUser(user) {
    const g = db.prepare("SELECT email FROM identities WHERE user_id=? AND provider='google'").get(user.id);
    const record = db.prepare('SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id=?').get(user.id);
    return { username: user.username, google: g ? g.email || true : null, password: !!record?.password_hash };
  }
  /** A new session's cookies (and the older /api-scoped one cleared). */
  function sessionCookies(user, secure) {
    const token = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires_at<=?').run(Date.now());

  async function googleRoute(req, res, url, secure) {

    // that origin's — each name the site is served under registered in the Google client)

    if (p === '/api/account/google/unlink' && req.method === 'POST') {

      } catch (e) { db.exec('ROLLBACK'); throw e; }

      return reply(res, 200, { user: publicUser(user), title: S.title, message: S.signedIn(user.username) },
        { 'Set-Cookie': [...sessionCookies(user, secure), flowCookie(SIGNUP_COOKIE, '', secure, 'Strict', 0)] });
    }

  }

  const api = async (req, res) => {
    const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost');

    }
    if (p === '/api/account' && req.method === 'DELETE') {
      const user = session(req); if (!user) return reply(res, 401, { error: 'Connexion requise.' });
      const body = await jsonBody(req);
      const record = db.prepare('SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id=?').get(user.id);
      if (!record) return reply(res, 403, { error: 'Mot de passe incorrect.' });
      // (without a password — an account made with Google — its name typed again confirms)
      if (!record.password_hash ? body?.username !== user.username : typeof body?.password !== 'string' || !await verifyPassword(body.password, record.password_hash))
        return reply(res, 403, { error: record.password_hash ? 'Mot de passe incorrect.' : 'Saisis ton identifiant pour confirmer.' });
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM users WHERE id=?').run(user.id);
      return reply(res, 200, { ok: true }, { 'Set-Cookie': [cookie('', secure, 0), `${COOKIE}=; Path=/api; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=0${secure ? '; Secure' : ''}`] });
    }
    if (!p.startsWith('/api/cloud')) return reply(res, 404, { error: 'Introuvable.' });
    const user = session(req); if (!user) return reply(res, 401, { error: 'Connexion requise.' });
    const scope = req.headers['x-orthros-player-scope'];
    if (scope && scope !== sha256(user.id).slice(0, 24)) return reply(res, 401, { error: 'Le compte actif a changé. Relance le jeu depuis ton compte.' });
    if (p === '/api/cloud' && req.method === 'GET') {
      const rows = db.prepare(`SELECT b.game_id game, b.version, b.hash, b.size, b.created_at updatedAt
        FROM backups b JOIN (SELECT game_id, MAX(version) version FROM backups WHERE user_id=? GROUP BY game_id) h
        ON h.game_id=b.game_id AND h.version=b.version WHERE b.user_id=? ORDER BY b.game_id`).all(user.id, user.id);
      return reply(res, 200, { games: rows });
    }
    const m = /^\/api\/cloud\/([^/]+)(?:\/(history|[0-9]+))?$/.exec(p);
    if (!m || !GAME.test(m[1]) || !allowedGame(m[1])) return reply(res, 404, { error: 'Jeu introuvable.' });
    const game = m[1], tail = m[2];
    if (req.method === 'GET' && tail === 'history') {
      const rows = db.prepare('SELECT version,hash,size,created_at createdAt FROM backups WHERE user_id=? AND game_id=? ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 20').all(user.id, game);
      return reply(res, 200, { versions: rows });
    }
    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      const row = tail ? db.prepare('SELECT * FROM backups WHERE user_id=? AND game_id=? AND version=?').get(user.id, game, Number(tail))
        : db.prepare('SELECT * FROM backups WHERE user_id=? AND game_id=? ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1').get(user.id, game);
      return row ? sendBytes(res, row) : reply(res, 404, { error: 'Sauvegarde introuvable.' });
    }
    if (req.method === 'DELETE' && !tail) {
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM backups WHERE user_id=? AND game_id=?').run(user.id, game);
      return reply(res, 200, { ok: true });
    }
    if (req.method === 'PUT' && !tail) {
      if (limited(req, 'upload', 20, 60_000)) return reply(res, 429, { error: 'Trop d’envois. Réessaie dans une minute.' });
      const parent = String(req.headers['x-orthros-parent-hash'] ?? '');
      if (parent !== 'none' && !HASH.test(parent)) return reply(res, 400, { error: 'Version de départ invalide.' });
      if (Number(req.headers['content-length'] ?? 0) > MAX_BACKUP) return reply(res, 413, { error: 'Sauvegarde trop volumineuse.' });
      const bytes = await readBody(req, MAX_BACKUP);
      if (bytes.length < 20 || bytes[0] !== 0x1f || bytes[1] !== 0x8b) return reply(res, 400, { error: 'Fichier de sauvegarde invalide.' });
      if (!validBackup(bytes, game)) return reply(res, 400, { error: 'Contenu de sauvegarde invalide.' });
      const hash = sha256(bytes);
      db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');
      try {
        const head = db.prepare('SELECT hash,version FROM backups WHERE user_id=? AND game_id=? ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1').get(user.id, game);
        const actual = head?.hash ?? 'none';
        if (actual !== parent) { db.exec('ROLLBACK'); return reply(res, 409, { error: 'Une autre sauvegarde existe en ligne.', remoteHash: actual }); }
        if (actual === hash) { db.exec('ROLLBACK'); return reply(res, 200, { hash, unchanged: true }); }
        const version = (head?.version ?? 0) + 1;
        let bytesUsed = db.prepare('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size),0) total FROM backups WHERE user_id=?').get(user.id).total;
        // (over the account's space: its oldest versions go first — never a game's latest — before the upload is refused;
        // the saves are sent automatically while playing, the history is the part that can give way)
        if (bytesUsed + bytes.length > maxUserBytes) {
          const old = db.prepare(`SELECT b.id, b.size FROM backups b WHERE b.user_id=? AND b.version < (SELECT MAX(version) FROM backups x WHERE x.user_id=b.user_id AND x.game_id=b.game_id) ORDER BY b.created_at`).all(user.id);
          for (const row of old) {
            if (bytesUsed + bytes.length <= maxUserBytes) break;
            db.prepare('DELETE FROM backups WHERE id=?').run(row.id); bytesUsed -= row.size;
          }
        }
        if (bytesUsed + bytes.length > maxUserBytes) { db.exec('ROLLBACK'); return reply(res, 413, { error: 'Espace cloud plein (512 Mo). Supprime une ancienne copie en ligne.' }); }
        const siteBytes = db.prepare('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size),0) total FROM backups').get().total;
        if (siteBytes + bytes.length > MAX_SITE_BYTES) { db.exec('ROLLBACK'); return reply(res, 507, { error: 'L’espace cloud du site est plein.' }); }
        db.prepare('INSERT INTO backups(user_id,game_id,version,hash,size,created_at,data) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)')
          .run(user.id, game, version, hash, bytes.length, Date.now(), bytes);
        db.prepare('DELETE FROM backups WHERE user_id=? AND game_id=? AND version<=?').run(user.id, game, version - MAX_HISTORY);
        db.exec('COMMIT');
        return reply(res, 201, { hash, version });
      } catch (e) { db.exec('ROLLBACK'); throw e; }
    }
    return reply(res, 405, { error: 'Méthode refusée.' });
  };
  api.session = session;
  api.googleEnabled = () => google.enabled();
  api.registerPortToken = (user, installation, token) => {
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM port_tokens WHERE expires_at<=?').run(Date.now());
    db.prepare('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO port_tokens VALUES(?,?,?,?)').run(sha256(token), user.id, installation, Date.now() + SESSION_MS);
  };
  api.ownsPortToken = (user, installation, token) => !!db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM port_tokens WHERE token_hash=? AND user_id=? AND installation=? AND expires_at>?')
    .get(sha256(token), user.id, installation, Date.now());
  return api;
}

```

`src/host/br-cache-worker.js`:

```js
// The precompressed units' generator (src/host/br-cache.js): a child process of the server, niced, one job at a time —
// brotli at quality 11 costs seconds of a core per MiB, which must never run on the server's own threads (its fs reads
// and the request path share libuv's pool). A job: { id, file, size, mtimeMs, light: { head, from, size } | null,
// start, end, dir, name, meta, minGain }: the bytes [start, end) of the file (of its light copy), read here, the file
// checked unchanged before and after; the unit written to <dir>/<name>.br — or an empty <name>.raw when brotli saves
// less than `minGain` (sent as they are) — through a temporary file renamed (never a partial unit). With `pcm`, the
// unit's audio form too (docs/slow-network.md "Audio units"): the range's PCM sound — the file's RIFF WAVE sounds
// (pcm-units.js scanWaves, kept in <dir>/waves.json), else the trial layouts for a file with none — coded losslessly
// (src/vfs/pcm-codec.js), checked by decoding it, brotli on top, written to <name>.pcm.br when its bytes are at most
// `pcmGain` of the brotli unit's wire bytes (`brWire`, or the one made now), else an empty <name>.pcm.raw. `br` false:
// the brotli unit is kept already, only the audio form is made. Answers { id, bytes, raw, pcm: { bytes, raw } | null }
// or { id, stale } or { id, error }.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';
import { readLight } from './light-copies.js';
import { encodePcm, decodePcm, pcmCodedBytes } from '../vfs/pcm-codec.js';
import { scanWaves, regionsIn, trialRegion, PCM_SHARE_MIN } from './pcm-units.js';

const same = (st, job) => st.size === job.size && st.mtimeMs === job.mtimeMs;
const readRange = (job, buf) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  const done = (err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve());
  if (job.light) return readLight(job.file, { ...job.light, head: Buffer.from(job.light.head) }, job.start, job.end, buf, 0, done);
  fs.open(job.file, 'r', (err, fd) => {
    if (err) return reject(err);
    fs.read(fd, buf, 0, buf.length, job.start, (err2, n) => { fs.close(fd, () => {}); done(err2 ?? (n === buf.length ? null : new Error('short read'))); });
  });
});
const writeAtomic = (file, data) => { const tmp = `${file}.tmp-${process.pid}`; fs.writeFileSync(tmp, data); fs.renameSync(tmp, file); };
const brotli = (buf, quality) => zlib.brotliCompressSync(buf, { params: {
  [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_QUALITY]: quality,
  [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_LGWIN]: buf.length > 1 << 18 ? 22 : 18, // (window: 4 MiB for a block, 256 KiB for a piece: the unit fits)
  [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_SIZE_HINT]: buf.length,
} });

/** the RIFF WAVE sounds of the job's file version: kept in its unit directory (one scan of the file per version) */
const wavesOf = (job) => {
  const f = path.join(job.dir, 'waves.json');
  try { const w = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')); if (w.size === job.size && w.mtimeMs === job.mtimeMs) return w.waves; } catch { /* none yet */ }
  const waves = scanWaves(job.file);
  writeAtomic(f, JSON.stringify({ size: job.size, mtimeMs: job.mtimeMs, waves }));
  return waves;
};

/** the audio form of `buf` (the job's range) when it pays against `wire` bytes: the bytes to write, or null */
function audioForm(job, buf, wire) {
  const waves = wavesOf(job), u = new Uint8Array(buf.buffer, buf.byteOffset, buf.length);
  let regions = regionsIn(waves, job.start, job.end);
  if (!waves.length) { const t = trialRegion(u, wire); regions = t ? [t] : []; } // (no sound headers in the file: a trial)
  // (sound in a small part of the unit cannot save the 5 % asked of it: not tried — a second brotli 11 run for nothing)
  if (regions.reduce((a, r) => a + r.len, 0) < u.length * PCM_SHARE_MIN) return null;
  const c = encodePcm(u, regions);
  const coded = pcmCodedBytes(c);
  if (!coded) return null;
  const d = decodePcm(c); // (never a unit that does not decode to the file's bytes)
  if (!Buffer.from(d.buffer, d.byteOffset, d.length).equals(buf)) throw new Error('pcm: round trip differs');
  // (brotli on top: the bytes between the sounds — headers, other members — compress; coded samples do not)
  const out = brotli(c, coded < u.length * 0.95 ? 11 : 4);
  return out.length <= wire * job.pcmGain ? out : null;
}

async function run(job) {
  if (!same(fs.statSync(job.file), job)) return { stale: true };
  const buf = Buffer.alloc(job.end - job.start);
  await readRange(job, buf);
  if (!same(fs.statSync(job.file), job)) return { stale: true }; // (replaced while read)
  fs.mkdirSync(job.dir, { recursive: true });
  const metaFile = path.join(job.dir, 'meta.json');
  if (!fs.existsSync(metaFile)) writeAtomic(metaFile, JSON.stringify(job.meta));
  let bytes = 0, raw = false, wire = job.brWire;
  if (job.br !== false) {
    const out = brotli(buf, 11);
    raw = !(out.length < buf.length * job.minGain);
    writeAtomic(path.join(job.dir, job.name + (raw ? '.raw' : '.br')), raw ? Buffer.alloc(0) : out);
    bytes = raw ? 0 : out.length; wire = raw ? buf.length : out.length;
  }
  let pcm = null;
  if (job.pcm && !job.light) {
    const out = audioForm(job, buf, wire ?? buf.length);
    if (!same(fs.statSync(job.file), job)) return { stale: true }; // (replaced meanwhile: its waves too)
    writeAtomic(path.join(job.dir, job.name + '.pcm' + (out ? '.br' : '.raw')), out ?? Buffer.alloc(0));
    pcm = { bytes: out ? out.length : 0, raw: !out };
  }
  return { bytes, raw, pcm };
}

// (the server gone meanwhile: the answer dropped — a send on a closed channel would throw EPIPE out of the process)
const answer = (m) => { if (process.connected) process.send(m, () => {}); };
process.on('message', (job) => {
  run(job).then((r) => answer({ id: job.id, ...r }), (e) => answer({ id: job.id, error: String(e?.message ?? e) }));
});
process.on('disconnect', () => process.exit(0)); // (the server gone: nothing to do it for)

```

`src/host/br-cache.js`:

```js
// Precompressed transport units for /gamez (docs/slow-network.md "Precompressed units"), every runtime's game data:
// ranges of a file version (or of its light copy) kept on disk compressed at brotli's best (quality 11: ~20-28 % fewer
// bytes than the gzip-4 a request gets on the fly, measured on Morrowind, GTA and Half-Life data), served as they are
// to a request of exactly that shape that accepts br (Content-Encoding: br, the browser decodes it). A unit is a whole
// 1 MiB block — the file's tail for its last one — or a single 64 KiB piece (unitOf in src/vfs/http-backend.js: the
// shapes the shared reader asks for). Brotli 11 costs seconds of a core per MiB: units are made in the background by a
// forked child niced to 19 (src/host/br-cache-worker.js), one at a time, paused while the machine is loaded or the
// disk full — the launch sets first (every manifest's head side by side; one live miss every WANT_EVERY of their
// units meanwhile), then the units requests missed, then each launch set's blocks learned by pieces whole, then more of
// the learned orders; a request that misses goes the dynamic way and asks for its unit (the misses waiting kept across
// a restart: <dir>/wanted.json). Nothing is ever served stale: a unit's
// key is the file's resolved real path, size and mtime (and the light copy's shape), the generator checks the file
// before and after reading it, and a sweep removes the units of files gone or changed.
//
// Layout: <dir>/<k[0:2]>/<k>/ per file version (k: the key's sha1) — meta.json { path, size, mtimeMs, light, ... } and
// one file per unit, b<block>.br or p<piece>.br (an empty .raw when brotli saved too little: sent as is, never made
// again). Audio units (docs/slow-network.md "Audio units", src/vfs/pcm-codec.js): beside a unit, b<block>.pcm.br /
// p<piece>.pcm.br — its PCM transport container, brotli on top — for the requests that decode it (`&pc=1`), or an
// empty .pcm.raw (no sound found there, or it did not pay); waves.json: where the file's RIFF WAVE sounds are
// (src/host/pcm-units.js, found once per file version). Light copies have none. The index is rebuilt from the disk at
// start. Least recently used out when over `maxBytes`, down to `lowBytes`; the units of each manifest's launch set (the
// head of its learned order, `sources`) are pinned — out last, at most `pinShare` of the budget.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import os from 'node:os';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { fork } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { BLOCK, CHUNK } from '../vfs/http-backend.js';
import { ESM_FORMAT, LIGHT_SIDE, lightCopy, zeroWithin } from './light-copies.js';

const WORKER = path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), 'br-cache-worker.js');
/** a unit kept compressed only when brotli makes it this much of its bytes at most (as the dynamic path's test) */
const MIN_GAIN = 0.92;
/** live misses waiting for their unit, at most (the oldest out first) */
const MAX_WANTED = 4096;
/**
 * one live miss made every this many launch-set units while the walk's first pass runs (see nextJob): that pass took
 * days on the live server — paused under load, its launch sets growing with each deploy, started again at each restart
 * —, and the misses waited behind all of it (2026-10-27: 291 of the owner's 451 BFME blocks missed five days earlier
 * still without a unit)
 */
export const WANT_EVERY = 8;
/** the live misses kept on the disk (a restart — each deploy — dropped them): <dir>/WANTED_FILE, written this long after a change */
const WANTED_FILE = 'wanted.json', WANTED_WRITE_MS = 5000;
/** the pinned part of an automatic budget: the launch sets' bytes times this (their sizes are estimates, a version's set grows) */
const PIN_SLACK = 1.25;

/** the unit's file name in its version's directory */
export const unitName = (u) => `${u.kind}${u.index}`;
/** the name of a unit's PCM transport form (pcm-codec.js) */
const PCM = '.pcm';
/** an audio unit kept when its wire bytes are this much of the brotli unit's at most */
export const PCM_MIN_GAIN = 0.95;
/** [start, end) of unit `u` of a file of `size` bytes */
export const unitRange = (u, size) => {
  const n = u.kind === 'b' ? BLOCK : CHUNK, start = u.index * n;
  return [start, Math.min(size, start + n)];
};

/**
 * The pinned budget `cap` split between the launch sets (`wants`: each one's bytes when known — its wire size, the
 * home's "playable after" —, else null): one whose size is known weighs it, one whose size is not an equal part of
 * the budget (as every one did before: Morrowind's 98 MB launch set was evictable past its 1/16, while small ones
 * left their part unused); what the known ones leave goes to all equally (the head of each order past its launch set).
 */
export function pinShares(wants, cap) {
  const n = wants.length; if (!n) return [];
  const equal = cap / n, weights = wants.map((w) => (Number.isFinite(w) && w > 0 ? w : equal));
  const total = weights.reduce((a, w) => a + w, 0);
  return total <= cap ? weights.map((w) => w + (cap - total) / n) : weights.map((w) => (w * cap) / total);
}

/**
 * The cache. opts: { dir, maxBytes (1.5 GiB — unset: at least that, grown to the launch sets, fitBudget, up to maxAutoBytes, 8 GiB, from minBytes, 1.5 GiB), lowBytes (0.9 × maxBytes), pinShare (0.5), sources: () => [{ name,
 * units: () => iterator of { file, st, light, unit }, want (bytes of its launch set, or null), whole (optional: () =>
 * iterator of the same — its launch set's blocks learned by pieces, whole: the shape a fast link asks for them, made
 * first in the second pass, unpinned) }] (the launch sets, in
 * their order: the first `pinShare` of the budget shared between them by their size (pinShares) is pinned, then more
 * of each while under `lowBytes`; walked side by side, made before the live misses for the pinned part, after them for
 * the rest — one live miss every WANT_EVERY of the pinned part's units: see nextJob), loadLimit (24: the 1-minute load
 * average generation waits under, half the machine's 48 cores), diskLimit (0.85: the disk's used fraction it waits
 * under), pauseMs (30000), idleMs (60000: the child kept that long without work), sweepMs (hourly: the sweep and the
 * launch sets again), log, onMade (tests: (file, unit) for each unit made), generate (false: nothing made — a frozen
 * copy served as it is, for measurements: tools/data-matrix.mjs) }.
 */
export function createBrCache(opts) {
  const dir = path.resolve(opts.dir);
  // (a budget that is not a positive number — NaN from a bad flag — would never evict, nor stop seeding: the default)
  const setBytes = Number.isFinite(opts.maxBytes) && opts.maxBytes > 0 ? opts.maxBytes : null;
  const baseBytes = setBytes ?? opts.minBytes ?? 1536 * 1024 * 1024, pinShare = opts.pinShare ?? 0.5;
  // (not set by the operator: the budget grows with the catalog's launch sets — see fitBudget —, up to maxAutoBytes)
  const maxAutoBytes = opts.maxAutoBytes ?? 8 * 1024 ** 3;
  let maxBytes = baseBytes, lowBytes = 0, pinCap = 0, pinWant = 0;
  const budget = (max) => {
    maxBytes = max;
    lowBytes = Number.isFinite(opts.lowBytes) && opts.lowBytes >= 0 ? opts.lowBytes : Math.floor(maxBytes * 0.9);
    pinCap = maxBytes * pinShare;
  };
  budget(baseBytes);
  /**
   * The budget for the launch sets `wants` (sources' bytes, null when unknown: the mean of the known ones): their sum
   * pinned with PIN_SLACK, the pinned share of a budget grown to hold it — the default 1.5 GiB held 0.8 GB pinned
   * where the catalog's 17 versions want ~1.3 GB: the units the launch sets need evicted each other, 2-30 % of them
   * made on the live server at a given time —; a budget set by the operator stays as set.
   */
  const fitBudget = (wants) => {
    const known = wants.filter((w) => Number.isFinite(w) && w > 0), mean = known.length ? known.reduce((a, w) => a + w, 0) / known.length : 0;
    pinWant = wants.reduce((a, w) => a + (Number.isFinite(w) && w > 0 ? w : mean), 0);
    if (setBytes === null) budget(Math.min(maxAutoBytes, Math.max(baseBytes, Math.ceil((pinWant * PIN_SLACK) / pinShare))));
  };
  const loadLimit = opts.loadLimit ?? 24, diskLimit = opts.diskLimit ?? 0.85, pauseMs = opts.pauseMs ?? 30000, idleMs = opts.idleMs ?? 60000;
  const log = opts.log ?? (() => {});
  // (audio units: on unless opts.pcm is false — never for a light copy)
  const pcmOn = opts.pcm !== false;
  const pcmFor = (light) => pcmOn && !light;
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });

  /** k -> { dir, meta, units: Map(name -> { bytes, raw, lastHit, pinned }) } */
  const entries = new Map();
  let total = 0, pinnedBytes = 0;
  const counts = { hits: 0, misses: 0, generated: 0, stale: 0, failed: 0, evicted: 0, swept: 0, pcmHits: 0, pcmMade: 0 };
  let paused = null, closed = false;

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- keys
  const reals = new Map(); // file -> its resolved real path (bounded: the oldest out)
  const realOf = (file) => {
    let r = reals.get(file);
    if (r === undefined) {
      try { r = fs.realpathSync.native(file); } catch { r = file; }
      reals.set(file, r); if (reals.size > 65536) reals.delete(reals.keys().next().value);
    }
    return r;
  };
  // (the light copy's shape in the key too: a new LIGHT_SIDE, or a copy made differently, is another version)
  // (lightFormat: a copy redrawn in place — a WAD's, light-copies.js lightWad — or with payloads zeroed in place — a TES3
  // file's, esmZeroRanges: its rules' version — told apart from one cut from the file)
  const formatOf = (copy) => (copy.mips ? 'wad1' : copy.format ?? null);
  const metaOf = (file, st, light) => ({ path: realOf(file), size: st.size, mtimeMs: st.mtimeMs, ...(light ? { light: true, lightSide: LIGHT_SIDE, lightSize: light.copy.size, lightFrom: light.copy.from, ...(formatOf(light.copy) ? { lightFormat: formatOf(light.copy) } : {}) } : {}) });
  const keyOf = (meta) => crypto.createHash('sha1').update([meta.path, meta.size, meta.mtimeMs, meta.light ? `light\0${meta.lightSide}\0${meta.lightSize}\0${meta.lightFrom}${meta.lightFormat ? '\0' + meta.lightFormat : ''}` : ''].join('\0')).digest('hex');
  const dirOf = (k) => path.join(dir, k.slice(0, 2), k);
  const entryOf = (file, st, light, make = false) => {
    const meta = metaOf(file, st, light), k = keyOf(meta);
    let e = entries.get(k);
    if (!e && make) entries.set(k, e = { k, dir: dirOf(k), meta, units: new Map() });
    return e ? e : { k, dir: dirOf(k), meta, units: null };
  };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- index
  const addUnit = (e, name, bytes, raw, lastHit, pinned) => {
    const old = e.units.get(name);
    if (old) dropUnit(e, name, false);
    e.units.set(name, { bytes, raw, lastHit, pinned });
    total += bytes; if (pinned) pinnedBytes += bytes;
  };
  const dropUnit = (e, name, unlink = true) => {
    const u = e.units.get(name); if (!u) return;
    e.units.delete(name); total -= u.bytes; if (u.pinned) pinnedBytes -= u.bytes;
    if (unlink) fs.unlink(path.join(e.dir, name + (u.raw ? '.raw' : '.br')), () => {});
  };
  const dropEntry = (e) => {
    for (const name of [...e.units.keys()]) dropUnit(e, name, false);
    entries.delete(e.k);
    return fs.promises.rm(e.dir, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {});
  };
  const pin = (u) => { if (!u.pinned) { u.pinned = true; pinnedBytes += u.bytes; } };

  /** the index from the disk (unfinished files and directories without meta out) */
  const load = async () => {
    let tops; try { tops = await fs.promises.readdir(dir); } catch { return; }
    for (const top of tops) {
      if (!/^[0-9a-f]{2}$/.test(top)) continue;
      let ks; try { ks = await fs.promises.readdir(path.join(dir, top)); } catch { continue; }
      for (const k of ks) {
        const d = path.join(dir, top, k);
        let meta = null; try { meta = JSON.parse(await fs.promises.readFile(path.join(d, 'meta.json'), 'utf8')); } catch { /* none */ }
        if (!meta || keyOf(meta) !== k) { await fs.promises.rm(d, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {}); continue; }
        const e = { k, dir: d, meta, units: new Map() };
        entries.set(k, e);
        let names; try { names = await fs.promises.readdir(d); } catch { names = []; }
        for (const n of names) {
          const m = /^([bp]\d+(?:\.pcm)?)\.(br|raw)$/.exec(n);
          if (!m) { if (n !== 'meta.json' && n !== 'waves.json') fs.unlink(path.join(d, n), () => {}); continue; }
          try { const s = await fs.promises.stat(path.join(d, n)); addUnit(e, m[1], s.size, m[2] === 'raw', s.mtimeMs, false); } catch { /* gone */ }
        }
      }
    }
  };

  /** the versions of files gone or changed out (and of light copies of another shape) */
  const sweep = async () => {
    for (const e of [...entries.values()]) {
      if (closed) return;
      let ok = e.units.size > 0 && (!e.meta.light || e.meta.lightSide === LIGHT_SIDE);
      if (ok) try { const s = await fs.promises.stat(e.meta.path); ok = s.isFile() && s.size === e.meta.size && s.mtimeMs === e.meta.mtimeMs; } catch { ok = false; }
      if (!ok && entries.get(e.k) === e && !(job && job.k === e.k)) { counts.swept++; await dropEntry(e); }
    }
  };

  /**
   * least recently used units out, the unpinned ones first, down to `to` bytes — never the raw markers (empty files:
   * nothing freed, brotli run again for them later; the sweep removes them once their file changed)
   */
  const evict = (to = lowBytes) => {
    if (total <= to) return;
    const all = [];
    for (const e of entries.values()) for (const [name, u] of e.units) if (u.bytes > 0) all.push([u.pinned ? 1 : 0, u.lastHit, e, name]);
    all.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]);
    for (const [, , e, name] of all) {
      if (total <= to) break;
      dropUnit(e, name); counts.evicted++;
      if (!e.units.size && !(job && job.k === e.k)) dropEntry(e);
    }
  };
  const diskUse = () => { try { const s = fs.statfsSync(dir); return s.blocks ? 1 - s.bavail / s.blocks : 0; } catch { return 0; } };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- generation
  /** live misses: id -> { file, st, light, unit, count } (kept in WANTED_FILE: saveWanted, loadWanted) */
  const wanted = new Map();
  /** launch-set units made since the last live miss (the first pass: one miss every WANT_EVERY) */
  let seedRun = 0;
  /** the launch sets being walked: { sources: [{ name, it, used, share, done }], pass } */
  let seeding = null;
  let job = null, pumping = null, child = null, childIdle = null, nextId = 1;
  /** the launch sets' pinning under way (pinNow): nothing made before it is over */
  let seedPins = null;
  const replies = new Map();

  const startChild = () => {
    if (child) return child;
    child = fork(WORKER, [], { stdio: ['ignore', 'inherit', 'inherit', 'ipc'], serialization: 'advanced' });
    try { os.setPriority(child.pid, 19); } catch { /* not allowed: as it is */ }
    const c = child;
    // (the ids sent to this child: its exit fails those only — a child started after it, while it was stopping, keeps its own)
    c.mine = new Set();
    c.on('message', (m) => { c.mine.delete(m.id); const r = replies.get(m.id); if (r) { replies.delete(m.id); r(m); } });
    c.on('exit', () => {
      if (child === c) child = null;
      for (const id of c.mine) { const r = replies.get(id); replies.delete(id); r?.({ id, error: 'generator exited' }); }
      c.mine.clear();
    });
    return c;
  };
  const stopChild = () => { const c = child; child = null; if (c) { try { c.disconnect(); } catch { /* gone */ } c.kill(); } };
  const ask = (msg) => new Promise((resolve) => {
    clearTimeout(childIdle);
    const c = startChild(), id = nextId++;
    c.channel?.ref?.();
    replies.set(id, resolve); c.mine.add(id);
    try { c.send({ ...msg, id }); } catch (e) { replies.delete(id); c.mine.delete(id); resolve({ id, error: String(e) }); }
  }).finally(() => {
    child?.channel?.unref?.(); // (an idle generator keeps no process alive)
    clearTimeout(childIdle); childIdle = setTimeout(stopChild, idleMs); childIdle.unref?.();
  });

  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => { setTimeout(r, ms).unref?.(); }); // (a paused generation keeps no process alive)
  /** waits while the machine is loaded or the disk too full (evicting meanwhile); false once closed */
  const free = async () => {
    for (;;) {
      if (closed) return false;
      const load = os.loadavg()[0], disk = diskUse();
      if (disk > diskLimit) evict();
      if (load < loadLimit && disk <= diskLimit) { paused = null; return true; }
      if (!paused) log(`br-cache: generation paused (load ${load.toFixed(1)}, disk ${(disk * 100).toFixed(0)} %)`);
      paused = { load, disk };
      await sleep(pauseMs);
    }
  };

  /** what of the unit is still to make: { br, pcm } (each true when missing), or null: nothing */
  const missing = (file, st, light, unit) => {
    const us = entryOf(file, st, light).units, name = unitName(unit);
    const br = !us?.has(name), pcm = pcmFor(light) && !us?.has(name + PCM);
    return br || pcm ? { br, pcm } : null;
  };
  /**
   * The next unit to make: the launch sets' (the first pass of the learned orders, pinned) first — every new player
   * asks for them, where a live miss is one session's read, that session served already —, but for the most asked live
   * miss every WANT_EVERY of them; then the live misses, then more of the learned orders (null: nothing). The orders are walked side by side, the one with the fewest
   * bytes made first: the head of every manifest's order before the tail of any (walked one after the other, the last
   * manifest's launch set waited for every other's share — hours of brotli 11).
   */
  const nextJob = async () => {
    const sd = seeding; // (read again meanwhile, hourly: that walk goes on instead)
    // (the first pass yields to the most asked live miss every WANT_EVERY units: that pass is hours of brotli 11 at
    // best, days when paused under load and started again at each restart — the misses never reached otherwise)
    if (sd && sd.pass === 0 && !(wanted.size && seedRun >= WANT_EVERY)) {
      const j = await nextSeed(sd);
      if (j) { seedRun++; return j; }
      if (seeding !== sd) return j;
    }
    // (a miss made meanwhile — by the walk, or asked before the index was loaded: every unit missing then — dropped
    // here, not spent: its slot would have made nothing, the real misses behind it waiting WANT_EVERY units more each)
    for (;;) {
      let best = null;
      for (const [id, w] of wanted) if (!best || w.count > best[1].count) best = [id, w];
      if (!best) break;
      wanted.delete(best[0]); wantedChanged();
      const w = best[1];
      if (missing(w.file, w.st, w.light, w.unit)) { seedRun = 0; return { ...w, pin: false }; }
    }
    return sd && seeding === sd ? nextSeed(sd) : null;
  };
  /** the next unit of the launch sets' walk `sd` not made yet, in its current pass (see nextJob), or null */
  const nextSeed = async (sd) => {
    let steps = 0;
    for (; sd.pass < 2; sd.pass++) {
      for (;;) {
        if (++steps % 64 === 0) await new Promise((r) => setImmediate(r)); // (the walk resolves paths: in slices)
        if (closed || seeding !== sd) return null;
        // first pass: each source's share of the pinned budget; second: more while under lowBytes
        if (sd.pass === 0 ? pinnedBytes >= pinCap : total >= lowBytes) break;
        // (the second pass: each source's launch-set blocks whole first — `whole` —, side by side, then its order's rest)
        let s = null, w = false;
        if (sd.pass > 0) for (const c of sd.sources) if (c.whole && (!s || c.used < s.used)) { s = c; w = true; }
        if (!s) for (const c of sd.sources) if (!c.done && (sd.pass > 0 || c.used < c.share) && (!s || c.used < s.used)) s = c;
        if (!s) break;
        const n = w ? s.whole.next() : s.it.next();
        if (n.done) { if (w) s.whole = null; else s.done = true; continue; }
        const { file, st, light, unit } = n.value;
        const e = entryOf(file, st, light), u = e.units?.get(unitName(unit)), up = e.units?.get(unitName(unit) + PCM);
        if (u && (up || !pcmFor(light))) { if (sd.pass === 0) { pin(u); if (up) pin(up); } s.used += u.bytes + (up?.bytes ?? 0); continue; }
        return { file, st, light, unit, pin: sd.pass === 0, source: s };
      }
      if (sd.pass === 0) { sd.pass = 1; return null; } // (the live misses before the second pass)
    }
    if (seeding === sd) seeding = null;
    return null;
  };

  const generate = async (j) => {
    const { file, light, unit } = j;
    let st; try { st = await fs.promises.stat(file); } catch { counts.stale++; return; }
    if (st.size !== j.st.size || st.mtimeMs !== j.st.mtimeMs) { counts.stale++; return; }
    const name = unitName(unit), [start, end] = unitRange(unit, light ? light.copy.size : st.size);
    if (!(start < end)) return;
    // (a TES3 copy's zeroed payloads: those of the unit's range only — the file's map is ~3 MB —, the map made
    // asynchronously at its first job: light-copies.js esmZeroMap)
    const c = light?.copy;
    let zero = null;
    if (c?.format === ESM_FORMAT) {
      try { zero = zeroWithin(await c.zeroMap(), start, end); } catch (err) { counts.failed++; log(`br-cache: ${file} ${name}: ${err?.message ?? err}`); return; }
      if (closed) return;
    }
    const e = entryOf(file, st, light, true);
    const old = e.units.get(name), br = !old, pcm = pcmFor(light) && !e.units.has(name + PCM);
    if (!br && !pcm) return;
    job = e;
    try {
      // (the audio form against the brotli unit's wire bytes: the one made now, or the one kept)
      const r = await ask({ file, size: st.size, mtimeMs: st.mtimeMs, light: c ? { head: c.head, from: c.from, size: c.size, ...(c.mips ? { mips: c.mips } : {}), ...(zero ? { format: c.format, zero } : {}) } : null, start, end, dir: e.dir, name, meta: e.meta, minGain: MIN_GAIN,
        br, pcm, brWire: old ? (old.raw ? end - start : old.bytes) : null, pcmGain: PCM_MIN_GAIN });
      if (r.error) { counts.failed++; log(`br-cache: ${file} ${name}: ${r.error}`); return; }
      if (r.stale) { counts.stale++; return; }
      if (closed || entries.get(e.k) !== e) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      if (br) addUnit(e, name, r.bytes, r.raw, now, j.pin && pinnedBytes + r.bytes <= pinCap);
      if (r.pcm) { addUnit(e, name + PCM, r.pcm.bytes, r.pcm.raw, now, j.pin && pinnedBytes + r.pcm.bytes <= pinCap); if (!r.pcm.raw) counts.pcmMade++; }
      if (j.source) j.source.used += (br ? r.bytes : 0) + (r.pcm?.bytes ?? 0);
      counts.generated++;
      opts.onMade?.(file, unit); // (tests: the order units are made in)
    } finally { job = null; }
    if (total > maxBytes) evict();
  };

  const pump = () => {
    if (pumping || closed || opts.generate === false) return pumping; // (frozen: a measurement serves what is there)
    pumping = (async () => {
      try {
        await ready;
        for (;;) {
          if (!(await free())) break;
          await seedPins; // (the launch sets pinned before anything is made: see pinNow)
          const j = await nextJob();
          if (!j) { if (seeding || wanted.size) continue; break; } // (the launch sets read again meanwhile: the new walk)
          await generate(j);
        }
      } catch (e) { log(`br-cache: ${e?.stack ?? e}`); } finally { pumping = null; }
    })();
    return pumping;
  };

  /**
   * The launch sets' units already made pinned at once, each source up to its share (the walk's first pass in order,
   * without making anything): until 2026-10-22 the pins were dropped at each reseed (start, hourly) and given back only
   * as the walk reached them — a walk that made one missing unit with the cache full evicted the oldest unpinned units
   * first, i.e. the launch sets made earliest of the sources not walked yet (live, 2026-10-22: Half-Life's and
   * Counter-Strike's launch sets gone while 1.5 GB of the cache held one session's misses).
   */
  const pinNow = async (list, shares, sd) => {
    let steps = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      let used = 0;
      for (const { file, st, light, unit } of list[i].units()) {
        if (++steps % 256 === 0) await new Promise((r) => setImmediate(r)); // (in slices: requests go on meanwhile)
        if (closed || seeding !== sd || used >= shares[i]) break;
        // (its audio form too, counted as the walk counts it: nextSeed)
        const us = entryOf(file, st, light).units, name = unitName(unit);
        const u = us?.get(name), up = pcmFor(light) ? us?.get(name + PCM) : null;
        if (u) { pin(u); used += u.bytes; }
        if (up) { pin(up); used += up.bytes; }
      }
    }
  };
  const readSources = () => { let list = []; if (opts.sources) try { list = opts.sources() ?? []; } catch (e) { log(`br-cache: sources: ${e}`); } return list; };
  const reseed = () => {
    if (!opts.sources || closed) return;
    const list = readSources();
    fitBudget(list.map((s) => s.want));
    const shares = pinShares(list.map((s) => s.want), pinCap);
    const sd = seeding = list.length ? { sources: list.map((s, i) => ({ name: s.name, it: s.units()[Symbol.iterator](), whole: s.whole?.()[Symbol.iterator]() ?? null, used: 0, share: shares[i], done: false })), pass: 0 } : null;
    for (const e of entries.values()) for (const u of e.units.values()) u.pinned = false;
    pinnedBytes = 0;
    // (the pins first, then the walk that makes what is missing: no eviction meanwhile finds them unpinned)
    if (sd) seedPins = pinNow(list, shares, sd).catch((e) => log(`br-cache: pins: ${e}`));
    pump();
  };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- the misses kept
  // (a frozen copy — a measurement's — keeps its directory as it is: nothing written)
  const keepWanted = opts.generate !== false;
  const wantedPath = path.join(dir, WANTED_FILE);
  let wantedTimer = null;
  /**
   * the kept misses read back (loadWanted): nothing written before — a miss asked while the index loads (seconds on the
   * live cache, a restart with a player on) would otherwise write a file of that miss alone over the kept queue, before
   * it is read; `wantedDirty`: one asked meanwhile, written once loaded
   */
  let wantedLoaded = false, wantedDirty = false;
  /** the live misses as kept: [{ file, size, mtimeMs, light: { size, from } | null, unit: 'b3', count }] */
  const wantedList = () => [...wanted.values()].map((w) => ({ file: w.file, size: w.st.size, mtimeMs: w.st.mtimeMs,
    light: w.light ? { size: w.light.copy.size, from: w.light.copy.from } : null, unit: unitName(w.unit), count: w.count }));
  /** the misses written now (a new file renamed over the old one: never half of it) */
  const saveWanted = () => {
    clearTimeout(wantedTimer); wantedTimer = null;
    if (!keepWanted || !wantedLoaded) return;
    try { fs.writeFileSync(wantedPath + '.new', JSON.stringify(wantedList())); fs.renameSync(wantedPath + '.new', wantedPath); } catch (e) { log(`br-cache: ${WANTED_FILE}: ${e}`); }
  };
  /** the misses changed: written a few seconds later (a burst of misses, one write) */
  const wantedChanged = () => {
    if (!keepWanted || wantedTimer || closed) return;
    if (!wantedLoaded) { wantedDirty = true; return; }
    wantedTimer = setTimeout(saveWanted, WANTED_WRITE_MS); wantedTimer.unref?.();
  };
  /**
   * The misses an earlier process kept, those of files unchanged (size and mtime; a light copy of the same shape,
   * found again: lightCopy) and still missing, back in the queue — before the ones asked since, which they do not
   * replace (a count adds up; the ones asked since checked again too: asked before the index was loaded, every unit
   * was missing). Gathered apart, joined at once at the end: a miss asked during its stats is not overwritten.
   */
  const loadWanted = async () => {
    try { await readWanted(); } finally {
      wantedLoaded = true;
      if (wantedDirty || wanted.size) { wantedDirty = false; wantedChanged(); }
    }
  };
  const readWanted = async () => {
    let list; try { list = JSON.parse(await fs.promises.readFile(wantedPath, 'utf8')); } catch { list = []; }
    if (!Array.isArray(list)) list = [];
    const kept = new Map();
    for (const w of list.slice(-MAX_WANTED)) {
      const m = /^([bp])(\d+)$/.exec(w?.unit ?? ''); if (!m || typeof w.file !== 'string') continue;
      let st; try { st = await fs.promises.stat(w.file); } catch { continue; }
      if (!st.isFile() || st.size !== w.size || st.mtimeMs !== w.mtimeMs) continue;
      let light = null;
      if (w.light) {
        const copy = lightCopy(w.file, st);
        if (!copy || copy.size !== w.light.size || copy.from !== w.light.from) continue;
        light = { file: w.file, st, copy };
      }
      const unit = { kind: m[1], index: Number(m[2]) };
      if (!missing(w.file, st, light, unit)) continue;
      kept.set(`${entryOf(w.file, st, light).k}#${w.unit}`, { file: w.file, st: { size: st.size, mtimeMs: st.mtimeMs }, light, unit, count: Math.max(1, Number(w.count) || 1) });
    }
    for (const [id, w] of wanted) {
      if (!missing(w.file, w.st, w.light, w.unit)) continue;
      const o = kept.get(id); if (o) o.count += w.count; else kept.set(id, w);
    }
    wanted.clear();
    for (const [id, w] of kept) wanted.set(id, w);
    while (wanted.size > MAX_WANTED) wanted.delete(wanted.keys().next().value);
  };

  // (the budget fitted before anything is evicted: a restart kept what a grown budget held)
  // (a load that fails still reads the kept misses back before any is written: see wantedLoaded)
  const ready = (async () => { await load(); await sweep(); await loadWanted(); if (opts.sources) fitBudget(readSources().map((s) => s.want)); evict(maxBytes); })()
    .catch(async (e) => { log(`br-cache: load: ${e}`); if (!wantedLoaded) await loadWanted().catch((e2) => log(`br-cache: ${WANTED_FILE}: ${e2}`)); });
  ready.then(() => { reseed(); if (wanted.size) pump(); }); // (the misses kept: made even without launch sets)
  const timer = setInterval(() => { sweep().then(reseed); }, opts.sweepMs ?? 3600e3); timer.unref?.();

  return {
    dir,
    ready,
    /**
     * The unit `unit` of `file` (`st`: its fs.Stats; `light`: its light copy, resolveLightFile's), or null: { path,
     * bytes, raw } — raw: brotli saved too little, the range goes as it is.
     */
    lookup(file, st, light, unit) {
      const e = entryOf(file, st, light), name = unitName(unit), u = e.units?.get(name);
      if (!u) { counts.misses++; return null; }
      counts.hits++; u.lastHit = Date.now();
      return { path: path.join(e.dir, name + (u.raw ? '.raw' : '.br')), bytes: u.bytes, raw: u.raw };
    },
    /**
     * The unit's audio form (a PCM transport container, brotli on top: pcm-codec.js), for a request that decodes it, or
     * null (none: the brotli unit or the dynamic way then): { path, bytes }.
     */
    lookupPcm(file, st, light, unit) {
      if (!pcmFor(light)) return null;
      const e = entryOf(file, st, light), u = e.units?.get(unitName(unit) + PCM);
      if (!u || u.raw) return null;
      counts.pcmHits++; u.lastHit = Date.now();
      return { path: path.join(e.dir, unitName(unit) + PCM + '.br'), bytes: u.bytes };
    },
    /**
     * the bytes the unit `unit` of `file` takes on the wire when made (its compressed size, or raw's: its range's; its
     * audio form's when smaller — every page decodes it), else null: not a hit
     */
    size(file, st, light, unit) {
      const us = entryOf(file, st, light).units, u = us?.get(unitName(unit));
      if (!u) return null;
      const p = pcmFor(light) ? us.get(unitName(unit) + PCM) : null, pw = p && !p.raw ? p.bytes : Infinity;
      if (!u.raw) return Math.min(u.bytes, pw);
      const [start, end] = unitRange(unit, light ? light.copy.size : st.size);
      return Math.min(end - start, pw);
    },
    /** a unit found missing on the disk (evicted meanwhile, removed by hand): out of the index */
    drop(file, st, light, unit) { const e = entryOf(file, st, light); if (e.units) dropUnit(e, unitName(unit), false); },
    /** an audio form found missing or bad: out of the index (made again when asked) */
    dropPcm(file, st, light, unit) { const e = entryOf(file, st, light); if (e.units) dropUnit(e, unitName(unit) + PCM, true); },
    /** a request missed the unit: made next (before the launch sets), the most asked first */
    want(file, st, light, unit) {
      if (closed || !missing(file, st, light, unit)) return;
      const id = `${entryOf(file, st, light).k}#${unitName(unit)}`, w = wanted.get(id);
      if (w) w.count++;
      else {
        wanted.set(id, { file, st: { size: st.size, mtimeMs: st.mtimeMs }, light, unit, count: 1 });
        if (wanted.size > MAX_WANTED) wanted.delete(wanted.keys().next().value);
      }
      wantedChanged(); pump();
    },
    /** the launch sets read again (the learned orders changed) */
    reseed,
    sweep,
    /** resolves once nothing is left to make (tests) */
    async drain() { await ready; while (pumping) await pumping; },
    // (units: the brotli ones; pcmUnits: the audio forms made — their tried-and-not-kept markers not counted)
    stats: () => ({ units: [...entries.values()].reduce((n, e) => n + [...e.units.keys()].filter((k) => !k.endsWith(PCM)).length, 0),
      pcmUnits: [...entries.values()].reduce((n, e) => n + [...e.units].filter(([k, u]) => k.endsWith(PCM) && !u.raw).length, 0), bytes: total, pinnedBytes, pinCap: Math.round(pinCap), pinWant: Math.round(pinWant), maxBytes, wanted: wanted.size, seeding: !!seeding, paused, ...counts }),
    /** the live misses written now (a process about to exit: server.js's SIGTERM) */
    flush() { if (wantedTimer) saveWanted(); },
    close() { if (!closed && wantedTimer) saveWanted(); closed = true; clearInterval(timer); clearTimeout(childIdle); stopChild(); },
  };
}

```

`src/host/browser-host.js`:

```js
// Browser host (runs inside the worker): display over worker-owned OffscreenCanvases (2D layer for
// GDI surfaces, WebGL2 layer for Direct3D) whose complete frames are handed to the page as
// ImageBitmaps, input from the page through a SharedArrayBuffer ring, audio through a float ring
// consumed by an AudioWorklet, cooperative waits (the worker returns to its event loop between
// slices). Frames are explicit on purpose: a placeholder canvas committed automatically at the end
// of a worker task showed half-drawn or missing frames under load.
import { acct, C as ACCT, FrameStats } from '../core/frame-acct.js';
import { encodePng } from '../gfx/codecs/png.js';
import { hostWaiter } from '../core/host-wait.js';

// (the page's side of the rings — their layout, the input events — in their own module: the home page imports them
// without this host's graph, src/host/host-proto.js)
export { CTL, IN_RING, EV, BUTTON_AT_CURSOR, decodeInput, AUDIO_RING_FRAMES, AUDIO_RATE } from './host-proto.js';
import { CTL, IN_RING, decodeInput, AUDIO_RING_FRAMES, AUDIO_RATE } from './host-proto.js';

export class BrowserDisplay {
  constructor(host, canvas2d, canvasGl, width, height) {
    this.host = host;
    this.canvas2d = canvas2d; this.canvasGl = canvasGl;
    this.width = width; this.height = height; this.bpp = 32; this.fullscreen = false;
    this.frames = 0; this.title = ''; this.cursorVisible = true;
    this.modes = [[640, 480], [800, 600], [1024, 768], [1152, 864], [1280, 720], [1280, 800], [1280, 960], [1280, 1024], [1366, 768], [1440, 900], [1600, 900], [1600, 1200], [1680, 1050], [1920, 1080], [1920, 1200]];
    this.ctx = canvas2d.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
    this.desk = null; this.row = null; // full desktop image on the 2D layer (transferToImageBitmap blanks the canvas)
    this.glActive = false;
    this.videoFrame = null; this.videoFrameCtx = null; this.videoLayer = null; this.videoLayerCtx = null; this.videoShown = false; this.videoFrames = 0; this.videoYuv = null; this.videoYuvFailed = false; // (the video layer: presentVideo)
    this.resize(width, height);
  }
  resize(w, h) {
    this.width = w; this.height = h;
    if (this.canvas2d.width !== w || this.canvas2d.height !== h) { this.canvas2d.width = w; this.canvas2d.height = h; }
    // (recorded Direct3D work: the canvas resized in order with the recorded presents, where they are replayed)
    if (this.host.gfx?.canvasResized) this.host.gfx.canvasResized(w, h);
    else if (this.canvasGl.width !== w || this.canvasGl.height !== h) { this.canvasGl.width = w; this.canvasGl.height = h; }
    this.ctx = this.canvas2d.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
    this.desk = new ImageData(w, h); new Uint32Array(this.desk.data.buffer).fill(0xff000000);
    this.row = new Uint32Array(w);
    this.host.post({ type: 'mode', width: w, height: h, fullscreen: this.fullscreen });
  }
  /** Present a GDI surface region at (x, y) on the 2D layer: update the desktop image, hand a frame to the page. */
  present(surface, x, y, w = surface.width, h = surface.height) {
    const W = this.width, H = this.height;
    const x0 = Math.max(0, x), y0 = Math.max(0, y), x1 = Math.min(W, x + w), y1 = Math.min(H, y + h);
    if (x1 <= x0 || y1 <= y0) return;
    const ap = acct.enter(ACCT.present);
    try { this.present2d(surface, x, y, x0, y0, x1, y1); } finally { acct.leave(ap); }
  }
  present2d(surface, x, y, x0, y0, x1, y1) {
    const W = this.width;
    const px = new Uint32Array(this.desk.data.buffer);
    const row = this.row, cw = x1 - x0;
    for (let yy = y0; yy < y1; yy++) {
      surface.readRow(yy - y, x0 - x, cw, row);
      const o = yy * W + x0;
      for (let i = 0; i < cw; i++) { const c = row[i]; px[o + i] = 0xff000000 | ((c & 0xff) << 16) | (c & 0xff00) | ((c >> 16) & 0xff); } // 0x00RRGGBB -> ABGR bytes R,G,B,A
    }
    this.ctx.putImageData(this.desk, 0, 0);
    const bitmap = this.canvas2d.transferToImageBitmap();
    this.host.post({ type: 'frame', layer: '2d', bitmap }, [bitmap]);
    this.frames++;
    this.host.framePresented();
  }
  /** Hand the Direct3D frame just presented (blitted into the GL canvas) to the page. */
  presentGl() {
    if (this.host.remoteGl) { if (!this.glActive) { this.glActive = true; this.host.post({ type: 'gl', active: true }); } return; } // (a render worker posts the frames)
    let bitmap;
    try { bitmap = this.canvasGl.transferToImageBitmap(); } catch { return; } // (WebGL context lost: no frame until it is restored)
    this.host.post({ type: 'frame', layer: 'gl', bitmap }, [bitmap]);
    if (!this.glActive) { this.glActive = true; this.host.post({ type: 'gl', active: true }); }
  }
  /** the display-sized video layer, cleared, and its context */
  videoCanvas() {
    if (!this.videoLayer || this.videoLayer.width !== this.width || this.videoLayer.height !== this.height) { this.videoLayer = new OffscreenCanvas(this.width, this.height); this.videoLayerCtx = this.videoLayer.getContext('2d'); }
    const ctx = this.videoLayerCtx;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.width, this.height);
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    return ctx;
  }
  videoDone() {
    const bitmap = this.videoLayer.transferToImageBitmap();
    this.host.post({ type: 'frame', layer: 'video', bitmap }, [bitmap]);
    // (shown after its new picture is in place: not the previous movie's last one for a page frame)
    if (!this.videoShown) { this.videoShown = true; this.host.post({ type: 'video', visible: true }); }
    this.videoFrames++;
  }
  /**
   * A movie picture (RGBA, w x h; its part `crop`) shown on the video layer, above the GDI and Direct3D layers, stretched
   * to `rect` in screen coordinates (DirectShow's video window, quartz.js). The layer is display-sized and transparent
   * around it.
   */
  presentVideo(rgba, w, h, rect, crop = null) {
    const ap = acct.enter(ACCT.present);
    try {
      if (!this.videoFrame || this.videoFrame.width !== w || this.videoFrame.height !== h) { this.videoFrame = new OffscreenCanvas(w, h); this.videoFrameCtx = this.videoFrame.getContext('2d'); }
      this.videoFrameCtx.putImageData(new ImageData(rgba, w, h), 0, 0);
      const c = crop ?? { x: 0, y: 0, w, h };
      this.videoCanvas().drawImage(this.videoFrame, c.x, c.y, c.w, c.h, rect.x, rect.y, rect.w, rect.h);
      this.videoDone();
    } finally { acct.leave(ap); }
  }
  /**
   * The same from the decoded 4:2:0 planes ({ y, cb, cr, stride, cstride }; `crop`: the visible part, even origin): a
   * WebCodecs VideoFrame drawn on the layer — the color conversion and scaling are the canvas's (the GPU's), not this
   * thread's. False when VideoFrame is unavailable (the caller converts to RGBA). (?dbg=ORTHROS_VIDEO_RGBA=1: always
   * false, for comparisons.)
   */
  presentVideoYuv(p, crop, rect) {
    if (typeof VideoFrame === 'undefined' || globalThis.ORTHROS_VIDEO_RGBA || this.videoYuvFailed) return false;
    const ap = acct.enter(ACCT.present);
    let vf = null;
    try {
      const ch = (p.y.length / p.stride) | 0, ys = p.stride * ch, cs = p.cstride * (ch >> 1);
      if (!this.videoYuv || this.videoYuv.length !== ys + 2 * cs) this.videoYuv = new Uint8Array(ys + 2 * cs);
      const buf = this.videoYuv;
      buf.set(p.y.subarray(0, ys), 0); buf.set(p.cb.subarray(0, cs), ys); buf.set(p.cr.subarray(0, cs), ys + cs);
      vf = new VideoFrame(buf, {
        format: 'I420', codedWidth: p.stride, codedHeight: ch, timestamp: 0,
        visibleRect: { x: crop.x, y: crop.y, width: crop.w, height: crop.h },
        layout: [{ offset: 0, stride: p.stride }, { offset: ys, stride: p.cstride }, { offset: ys + cs, stride: p.cstride }],
        colorSpace: { primaries: 'smpte170m', transfer: 'smpte170m', matrix: 'smpte170m', fullRange: false },
      });
      this.videoCanvas().drawImage(vf, rect.x, rect.y, rect.w, rect.h);
      this.videoDone();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      this.videoYuvFailed = true; // (from now on the RGBA path)
      this.host.post({ type: 'log', kind: 'warn', msg: `video layer: VideoFrame path unavailable (${e.message}), RGBA conversion instead` });
      return false;
    } finally { vf?.close(); acct.leave(ap); }
  }
  hideVideo() { if (this.videoShown) { this.videoShown = false; this.host.post({ type: 'video', visible: false }); } }
  setMode(width, height, bpp, fullscreen) {
    this.fullscreen = fullscreen; this.bpp = bpp || 32;
    this.resize(width, height);
    return true;
  }
  setTitle(t) { this.title = t; this.host.post({ type: 'title', title: t }); }
  showCursor(v) { if (this.cursorVisible !== v) { this.cursorVisible = v; this.host.post({ type: 'cursor', visible: v }); } }
  /**
   * The guest's current cursor (SetCursor): a system cursor id (IDC_*) or an image cursor (frames + animation
   * steps, see gfx/gdi/cursor.js). Image frames are encoded once per cursor as PNG and defined on the page, which
   * shows them as an animated CSS cursor.
   */
  setCursor(key, image, systemId) {
    if (this.cursorKey === key) return;
    this.cursorKey = key;
    if (!image) { this.host.post({ type: 'cursor-set', system: systemId ?? 32512 }); return; }
    this.cursorDefs ??= new Map();
    if (this.cursorDefs.has(key)) { this.host.post({ type: 'cursor-set', id: key }); return; }
    this.cursorDefs.set(key, true);
    // (encoded here, on the CPU: a 2D canvas is drawn by the GPU process — behind a GPU backlog, creating one waited
    // for all of it, a 7 s frame when a game switched to an animated cursor)
    const pngs = image.frames.map((f) => { const png = encodePng(f.rgba, f.w, f.h); return png.buffer; });
    this.host.post({ type: 'cursor-def', id: key, frames: image.frames.map((f, i) => ({ png: pngs[i], hotX: f.hotX, hotY: f.hotY })), steps: image.steps }, pngs);
    this.host.post({ type: 'cursor-set', id: key });
  }
}

export class BrowserHost {
  /**
   * @param {{ clock: any, ctl: Int32Array, inputRing: Int32Array, audioRing: Float32Array, canvas2d: OffscreenCanvas, canvasGl: OffscreenCanvas, width: number, height: number, post: (m: any) => void }} o
   */
  constructor(o) {
    this.clock = o.clock;
    this.ctl = o.ctl; this.inputRing = o.inputRing; this.audioRing = o.audioRing;
    this.post = o.post;
    this.cooperative = true; // vm.runFor hands long waits back to the event loop
    this.display = new BrowserDisplay(this, o.canvas2d, o.canvasGl, o.width, o.height);
    this.inputQueue = [];
    this.exitCode = null;
    this.framesPresented = 0;
    this.lastFrameAt = 0;
    this.frameTimes = []; this.frameTimesAt = []; // rolling window for the live stats (durations, presentation times)
    this.frameLog = []; // every frame since start as (presented at ms, frame time ms) pairs — whole-run percentiles
    this.gfx = null; // Direct3D backend factory, installed by the worker when WebGL2 is available
    this.frameHook = () => { const t0 = performance.now(); this.display.presentGl(); this.presentMs += performance.now() - t0; this.framePresented(); };
    this.presentMs = 0;
    // slow-frame diagnostics: the worker installs `frameProbe()` (counters snapshot) and `onSlowFrame(dt, deltas)`
    this.frameProbe = null; this.onSlowFrame = null; this.lastProbe = null; this.slowFrameLogs = 0; this.slowFrameFrom = 0;
    // per-frame time accounting (frame-acct.js): every frame's categories, by interval and by phase
    this.frameAcct = new FrameStats();
    this.lastCats = null; // (the categories of the last frame: the slow-frame diagnostics)
    // (fields the worker and the audio path set later, declared here: one hidden class, see Vm's constructor)
    this.dxtPool = null; this.wake = null; this.onUserInput = null; // (a click / a printable character, before the guest sees it: profile-seed.js)
    this.playerActions = 0; // (clicks and key presses so far: the session's automatic snapshot stops at the first, snapshot-watch.js)
    this.audioHook = null; this.interval = null; this.waitMs = 0;
    this.audioPeak = 0; this.audioMs = 0; this.audioFrames = 0; this.audioDiag = 0; this.chunk = null;
    this.audioLead = undefined; this.audioUnderSeen = 0; this.audioCalmSince = 0;
    this.audioVm = null; // (the machine whose voice table the page's AudioWorklet mixes: pointAudio)
  }
  /**
   * The page's AudioWorklet mixes `vm`'s DirectSound buffers from its guest memory (the worker's direct mix): the voice
   * table made once DirectSound exists, and handed to the page again whenever the machine the page follows changes — a
   * child process taking the foreground, its parent taking it back when it ends (core/procs.js) — so the worklet never
   * goes on mixing a machine that left. The table it leaves is marked as no longer mixed (its ring path, if it plays on).
   * @param {() => SharedArrayBuffer} makeTable a new voice table
   */
  pointAudio(vm, makeTable) {
    const a = vm.audio;
    if (!a || (this.audioVm === vm && a.voices)) return false;
    if (!a.voices) a.attachVoices(makeTable());
    const prev = this.audioVm?.audio;
    if (prev && prev !== a && prev.voices) prev.voices[2] = 0;
    this.audioVm = vm;
    this.post({ type: 'audio-voices', memory: vm.mem.memory.buffer, voices: a.voices.buffer });
    return true;
  }
  /** A process of the machine ended and was released (core/procs.js reap): nothing here keeps its machine. */
  forgetProcess(v) {
    if (this.audioVm === v) this.audioVm = null;
    if (v.mem?.memory) this.gfx?.forgetMemory?.(v.mem.memory);
  }
  /** Drain the shared input ring into the local queue. */
  pump() {
    const ring = this.inputRing, ctl = this.ctl;
    const head = Atomics.load(ctl, CTL.IN_HEAD);
    let tail = Atomics.load(ctl, CTL.IN_TAIL);
    while (tail !== head) {
      const i = (tail % (IN_RING / 4)) * 4;
      const word = ring[i], ev = decodeInput(word, ring[i + 1], ring[i + 2], ring[i + 3]);
      tail = (tail + 1) | 0;
      if (!ev) continue;
      this.inputQueue.push(ev);
      if (ev.type === 'mousedown' || ev.type === 'keydown') this.playerActions++;
      if (ev.type === 'mousedown') this.onUserInput?.(false);
      else if (ev.type === 'char' && ev.code >= 0x20) this.onUserInput?.(true);
    }
    Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.IN_TAIL, tail);
  }
  nextWake() { return undefined; }
  /**
   * Nested waits (inside callbacks) block the worker briefly; woken early by input. `io`: the guest thread waits for a
   * file read (frame accounting: `ioWait`, else `wait` — the game's pacing).
   */
  waitEvent(ms, io = false) {
    let t = Math.min(ms, 50);
    // (a wait for a deadline — a guest timeout, a timer, a throttled Sleep(0) — wakes at it on a coarse host timer; the
    // deadlock watch's long waits are plain: core/host-wait.js)
    const precise = ms <= 50, deadline = performance.now() + t;
    this.audioHook?.(); // (the audio ring filled before blocking: a nested wait must not starve the output)
    // (deferrable work of the worker done in the wait first — the game waits anyway: see idleWork in worker.js)
    if (this.idleWork && t >= 1) { const t0 = performance.now(), p = acct.enter(ACCT.host); this.idleWork(t); acct.leave(p); }
    const cat = io ? ACCT.ioWait : ACCT.wait, ap = acct.enter(cat);
    const t0 = acct.stamp(), acc0 = acct.acc[cat];
    const r = hostWaiter.waitUntil(this.ctl, CTL.WAKE, 0, deadline, precise);
    acct.leave(ap);
    // (frame accounting: the host's wake-up past the deadline is lateness, not the game's pacing — Windows' coarse timer
    // shows here; before 2026-10-22 it stayed in `wait`. Not a frame limiter's earlier waits: waking them late does not
    // lengthen the frame — host-wait.js earlyPacingWait)
    if (r === 'timed-out' && precise && hostWaiter.lastLate > 0) acct.move(cat, ACCT.late, Math.min(hostWaiter.lastLate, acct.acc[cat] - acc0));
    this.waitMs = (this.waitMs ?? 0) + acct.stamp() - t0;
    this.pump();
  }
  pollInput() { this.pump(); return this.inputQueue.length ? this.inputQueue.splice(0) : null; }
  /** The guest cursor moved (SetCursorPos, ClipCursor, the input up to the page's move `seq`): the page's captured cursor follows. */
  cursorPos(x, y, seq) { this.post({ type: 'cursor-pos', x, y, seq }); }
  onExit(code) { this.exitCode = code; } // (the worker posts the exit, with the failure report)
  /** Frame-time percentiles over the frames presented after `fromMs` (performance.now() based). */
  frameStats(fromMs = 0) {
    const dts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.frameLog.length; i += 2) if (this.frameLog[i] >= fromMs) dts.push(this.frameLog[i + 1]);
    if (!dts.length) return null;
    dts.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const q = (x) => dts[Math.min(dts.length - 1, Math.floor(x * dts.length))];
    const over33 = dts.filter((d) => d > 33).length;
    const span = (this.frameLog[this.frameLog.length - 2] - fromMs) / 1000;
    return { frames: dts.length, seconds: span, fps: dts.length / span, p50: q(0.5), p90: q(0.9), p99: q(0.99), max: dts[dts.length - 1], over33, over50: dts.filter((d) => d > 50).length };
  }
  framePresented() {
    this.framesPresented++;
    const cats = acct.frame(), now = acct.stamp(); // (the clock read of the frame boundary, unless the accounting's clock is off)
    this.lastCats = cats;
    if (this.lastFrameAt) {
      const dt = now - this.lastFrameAt; this.frameTimes.push(dt); this.frameTimesAt.push(now);
      this.frameAcct.add(dt, cats, now, acct.lastReads);
```
