```js
      // (the last 10 s of frames, at most 600: a loading phase's long frames leave the live percentiles once it is over)
      while (this.frameTimes.length > 600 || (this.frameTimesAt.length && now - this.frameTimesAt[0] > 10000)) { this.frameTimes.shift(); this.frameTimesAt.shift(); } this.frameLog.push(now, dt); this.probeFrame(dt);
      const iv = this.interval ??= { max: 0, slow33: 0, slow50: 0 }; // (per stats interval: the live frame-rate display)
      if (dt > iv.max) iv.max = dt; if (dt > 33.4) iv.slow33++; if (dt > 50) iv.slow50++;
    }
    else this.probeFrame(0);
    this.lastFrameAt = now;
  }
  /** Snapshot the probe counters every frame; report the deltas of a frame longer than 33 ms (at most 300 reports). */
  probeFrame(dt) {
    if (!this.frameProbe) return;
    const p = this.frameProbe(); p.presentMs = this.presentMs;
    const prev = this.lastProbe; this.lastProbe = p;
    if (!prev || dt <= 33 || !this.onSlowFrame || this.slowFrameLogs >= 5000 || performance.now() < (this.slowFrameFrom ?? 0)) return;
    this.slowFrameLogs++;
    const d = {}; for (const k of Object.keys(p)) d[k] = typeof p[k] === 'number' ? Math.round((p[k] - (prev[k] ?? 0)) * 100) / 100 : p[k];
    this.onSlowFrame(dt, d);
  }
  /**
   * Fill the audio ring ahead of the output using the VM mixer. The lead adapts: every new underrun (the worker was
   * busy longer than the lead: a translation burst, a loading stall) adds 1024 frames up to 12288 (~280 ms: the ring holds 16384, filled in chunks of 512), and 30 s
   * without one takes 1024 back down to 4096 (~93 ms).
   */
  renderAudio(vm) {
    const audio = vm.audio; if (!audio) return;
    if (audio.worklet) { // (the AudioWorklet mixes from guest memory: only the play cursors to advance and publish)
      audio.tick();
      const pk = audio.voicesF[1]; if (pk > (this.audioPeak ?? 0)) this.audioPeak = pk; audio.voicesF[1] = 0;
      return;
    }
    // (the play cursors follow the VM clock even when nothing is rendered: an output that does not consume — an
    // AudioContext suspended until the player's first click — must not stop the game's cursors and notifications)
    audio.tick();
    const ctl = this.ctl;
    const now = performance.now(), under = Atomics.load(ctl, CTL.AUDIO_UNDERRUNS);
    if (this.audioLead === undefined) { this.audioLead = 4096; this.audioUnderSeen = under; this.audioCalmSince = now; }
    if (under !== this.audioUnderSeen) { this.audioUnderSeen = under; this.audioLead = Math.min(12288, this.audioLead + 1024); this.audioCalmSince = now; }
    else if (now - this.audioCalmSince > 30000 && this.audioLead > 4096) { this.audioLead -= 1024; this.audioCalmSince = now; }
    const aheadFrames = this.audioLead;
    const cap = AUDIO_RING_FRAMES;
    let w = Atomics.load(ctl, CTL.AUDIO_WRITE); const r = Atomics.load(ctl, CTL.AUDIO_READ);
    let avail = (w - r) | 0; // frames queued
    if (avail < 0) avail = 0;
    if (!this.chunk) this.chunk = new Float32Array(512 * 2);
    let peak = this.audioPeak ?? 0;
    const t0 = performance.now(); let rendered = 0;
    while (avail < aheadFrames) {
      rendered += 512;
      audio.render(this.chunk, 512, AUDIO_RATE);
      for (let i = 0; i < 512; i++) { const idx = ((w + i) % cap) * 2; const l = this.chunk[2 * i], r = this.chunk[2 * i + 1]; this.audioRing[idx] = l; this.audioRing[idx + 1] = r; const a = Math.max(Math.abs(l), Math.abs(r)); if (a > peak) peak = a; }
      w = (w + 512) | 0; avail += 512;
      Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.AUDIO_WRITE, w);
    }
    this.audioPeak = peak; // highest sample level since the last stats report (proves the mixer produces sound)
    if (rendered) { this.audioMs = (this.audioMs ?? 0) + (performance.now() - t0); this.audioFrames = (this.audioFrames ?? 0) + rendered; }
    if ((this.audioDiag = (this.audioDiag ?? 0) + 1) % 500 === 1 && [...audio.buffers].some((b) => b.playing && !b.primary)) vm.log('audio', `mixer: peak ${peak.toFixed(3)} queued ${avail} frames; buffers ${[...audio.buffers].map((b) => `${b.primary ? 'P' : 'S'}:${b.playing ? 'play' : 'stop'}/${b.looping ? 'loop' : 'once'} pos ${b.pos}/${b.size} vol ${b.volume} freq ${b.freq}`).join(' | ')}`);
  }
}

```

`src/host/cli.js`:

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Orthros CLI runner (Node, headless): boots a game folder + manifest, runs it, reports.
//
//   node src/host/cli.js <manifest.json|game-folder> [options]
//     --interp            use the reference interpreter instead of the JIT
//     --log a,b,c         log kinds (loader,warn,crash,api,win,file,thread,jit,debug,all)
//     --seconds N         stop after N seconds of host time (default: unlimited)
//     --status FILE       write the unknown-import list into FILE (between markers)
//     --trace-api         alias for --log api
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { Vm, GuestCrash } from '../core/vm.js';
import { Vfs, MemBackend, normalizeWin, mountGameCdrom } from '../vfs/vfs.js';
import { NodeBackend } from '../vfs/node-backend.js';
import { applyProfileMoves } from '../vfs/profile-moves.js';
import { OverlayBackend } from '../vfs/overlay-backend.js';
import { RealClock } from '../core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from './display.js';
import { Registry } from '../win32/registry.js';
import { keyRemap } from '../win32/vk-scan.js';
import { folderManifest, withDefaults } from './manifest.js';
import { loadGameCatalog, defaultGameManifest, DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR } from './game-catalog.js';

function parseArgs(argv) {
  const o = { positional: [], log: null, interp: false, seconds: 0, status: null, profile: false, progress: 0 };
  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
    const a = argv[i];
    if (a === '--interp') o.interp = true;
    else if (a === '--log') o.log = argv[++i].split(',');
    else if (a === '--trace-api') o.log = [...(o.log ?? ['loader', 'warn', 'crash']), 'api'];
    else if (a === '--seconds') o.seconds = +argv[++i];
    else if (a === '--status') o.status = argv[++i];
    else if (a === '--profile') o.profile = true;
    else if (a === '--progress') o.progress = +argv[++i];
    else o.positional.push(a);
  }
  return o;
}

/** Load a manifest (json file) or the folder's manifest (its manifest.json, else synthesized: see manifest.js). */
export function loadManifest(target) {
  if (target.endsWith('.json')) {
    if (path.basename(target) === 'manifest.json') {
      const spec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(target, 'utf8'));
      if (spec.schemaVersion === 1) {
        const manifest = defaultGameManifest(path.dirname(target));
        return { manifest, dir: manifest.folder };
      }
    }
    const manifest = withDefaults(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(target, 'utf8')));
    if (manifest.baseFolder) manifest.baseFolder = path.resolve(path.dirname(target), manifest.baseFolder);
    return { manifest, dir: path.resolve(path.dirname(target), manifest.folder ?? '.') };
  }
  if (fs.existsSync(path.join(target, 'manifest.json')) && JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(target, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8')).schemaVersion === 1) {
    const manifest = defaultGameManifest(target);
    return { manifest, dir: manifest.folder };
  }
  const manifest = folderManifest(target);
  return { manifest, dir: manifest.folder };
}

/** Build the VFS: game folder read-only under the mount point, writable user dirs in memory. */
export function makeVfs(manifest, dir, saveDir) {
  const vfs = new Vfs();
  const root = new MemBackend();
  vfs.mount('C:\\', root);
  for (const d of ['Windows', 'Windows\\System32', 'Windows\\Temp', 'Users', 'Users\\Player', 'Users\\Player\\Temp', 'Users\\Player\\AppData', 'Users\\Player\\AppData\\Roaming', 'Users\\Player\\AppData\\Local', 'Users\\Player\\Documents', 'Program Files', 'Program Files\\Common Files', 'Game']) root.mkdir(d);
  const gameFiles = manifest.baseFolder ? new OverlayBackend([dir, manifest.baseFolder]) : new NodeBackend(dir, { readOnly: !manifest.writableGameFolder });
  vfs.mount(manifest.mount, gameFiles);
  mountGameCdrom(vfs, manifest, gameFiles);
  for (const dependency of manifest.extraMounts ?? []) {
    const catalogDir = manifest.gameId ? path.resolve(manifest.folder, '../../..') : DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR;
    const depManifest = loadGameCatalog(catalogDir).get(dependency.manifest);
    if (!depManifest) throw new Error(`missing game dependency ${dependency.manifest}`);
    root.mkdir(dependency.mount.replace(/^C:\\/, ''));
    vfs.mount(dependency.mount, depManifest.baseFolder
      ? new OverlayBackend([depManifest.folder, depManifest.baseFolder])
      : new NodeBackend(depManifest.folder, { readOnly: true }));
  }
  if (saveDir) {
    // the user profile lives on disk (saves, settings): standard profile subdirectories must exist there
    for (const d of ['', 'Temp', 'AppData/Roaming', 'AppData/Local', 'AppData/LocalLow', 'Documents', 'Desktop', 'Saved Games']) fs.mkdirSync(path.join(saveDir, d), { recursive: true });
    const profile = new NodeBackend(saveDir);
    // (files the manifest says the game keeps elsewhere now: put there before it starts, as the page does — profile-moves.js)
    const { moved } = applyProfileMoves(profile, manifest.profileMoves);
    if (moved.length) console.log(`[orthros] profile: ${moved.length} entr${moved.length === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'} moved to the game's new place (manifest profileMoves)`);
    vfs.mount('C:\\Users\\Player', profile);
  }
  return vfs;
}

export function writeStatus(file, proc, vm) {
  if (!file || !fs.existsSync(file)) return;
  const lines = [];
  const items = [...proc.unknownImports].sort((a, b) => b[1].calls - a[1].calls);
  if (!items.length) lines.push('- (aucun)');
  for (const [k, v] of items) lines.push(`- \`${k}\` (référencé par ${v.from}, ${v.calls} appel${v.calls > 1 ? 's' : ''})`);
  const text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  const marker = '## Imports Win32 inconnus (rempli automatiquement à partir de M4)';
  const i = text.indexOf(marker);
  if (i < 0) return;
  const head = text.slice(0, i + marker.length);
  fs.writeFileSync(file, head + '\n' + lines.join('\n') + '\n');
}

export async function main(argv) {
  const o = parseArgs(argv);
  if (!o.positional.length) { console.error('usage: node src/host/cli.js <manifest.json|folder> [--interp] [--log kinds] [--seconds N] [--status STATUS.md]'); process.exit(2); }
  const { manifest, dir } = loadManifest(o.positional[0]);
  if ((manifest.runtime ?? 'win32') !== 'win32') { console.error(`${manifest.name}: a browser port (runtime ${manifest.runtime}), not a Windows game: open it from the home page (docs/browser-ports.md)`); process.exit(2); }
  const saveDir = manifest.saveDir ? path.resolve(path.dirname(o.positional[0]), manifest.saveDir) : null;
  const vfs = makeVfs(manifest, dir, saveDir);
  const clock = new RealClock();
  const host = new HeadlessHost({ clock, width: manifest.display.width, height: manifest.display.height });
  host.keyMap = keyRemap(manifest.keys); // (the manifest's key remap: user32.js remapKey)
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host, jit: !o.interp, logKinds: o.log ?? ['loader', 'warn', 'crash', 'win', 'thread'], apiHist: true, profile: o.profile });
  vm.onStdout = (s) => process.stdout.write(s);
  // registry: generic defaults + manifest seed + values persisted from earlier runs (in the save dir)
  vm.registry = new Registry();
  vm.registry.seed(manifest.registry);
  const regFile = saveDir ? path.join(saveDir, 'registry.json') : null;
  if (regFile && fs.existsSync(regFile)) { try { vm.registry.load(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(regFile, 'utf8'))); } catch (e) { console.error(`[orthros] bad ${regFile}: ${e.message}`); } }
  const saveRegistry = () => { if (regFile && vm.registry.dirty) { fs.writeFileSync(regFile, JSON.stringify(vm.registry.toJSON(), null, 1)); vm.registry.dirty = false; } };
  const exePath = normalizeWin(manifest.mount + '\\' + manifest.exe);
  const t0 = performance.now();
  let code = null;
  try {
    vm.createProcess({ exePath, args: manifest.args, env: manifest.env, dllOverrides: manifest.dllOverrides, cwd: manifest.cwd ? normalizeWin(manifest.mount + '\\' + manifest.cwd) : undefined });
    if (o.seconds) {
      const deadline = t0 + o.seconds * 1000;
      vm.deadline = deadline;
      vm.host.waitEvent = (ms) => { clock.sleep(Math.min(ms, 50)); if (performance.now() > deadline) throw new Error('time limit'); };
      const dt = vm.dispatchThunk.bind(vm);
      vm.dispatchThunk = (t, i) => { if (performance.now() > deadline) throw new Error('time limit'); return dt(t, i); };
    }
    if (o.progress) {
      vm.progressEvery = o.progress * 1000; vm.progressAt = performance.now() + vm.progressEvery;
      vm.onProgress = (t) => {
        const top = vm.profile ? [...vm.profile].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 3).map(([k, v]) => `${vm.proc.symbolize(k << 6)} ${(100 * v / vm.slices).toFixed(0)}%`).join(', ') : '';
        console.log(`[progress] t=${((performance.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(0)}s heap=${(process.memoryUsage().heapUsed / 1048576).toFixed(0)}MB api=${vm.apiCalls} slices=${vm.slices} regions=${vm.jit?.stats.regions}/live ${vm.jit?.stats.live} inval=${vm.jit?.stats.invalidations}/${vm.jit?.stats.dropped} thread=${t.id} eip=${vm.proc.symbolize(t.cpu.eip)} threads=${vm.proc.threads.length} ${top}`);
        if (vm.profile) vm.profile.clear(); vm.slices = 0;
      };
    }
    code = vm.run();
    console.log(`\n[orthros] process exited with code ${code} after ${((performance.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s, ${vm.apiCalls} API calls`);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof GuestCrash) console.log(`\n[orthros] ${e.report}`);
    else if (e.message === 'time limit') {
      console.log(`\n[orthros] time limit reached after ${o.seconds}s, ${vm.apiCalls} API calls`);
      // (several processes, core/procs.js: each one's state)
      for (const v of vm.group?.vms ?? [vm]) { const t = v.lastThread; if (t && !v.proc.exited) console.log(`${vm.group ? `[process ${v.proc.pid} ${v.proc.exe?.name}, ${v.apiCalls} API calls] ` : ''}${v.crashReport(t, 'time limit (state of the last running thread)')}`); }
    }
    else { console.log(`\n[orthros] host error: ${e.stack}`); }
  }
  saveRegistry();
  if (vm.jit) console.log(`[orthros] jit: ${JSON.stringify(vm.jit.stats)}${vm.deferredCalls ? ` deferred COM call batches: ${vm.deferredCalls}` : ''}`);
  if (vm.apiHistCounts) console.log('[orthros] top API calls: ' + [...vm.apiHist()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 25).map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`).join(' '));
  if (vm.profile) { const total = vm.slices || 1; console.log(`[orthros] profile: ${vm.slices} slices of 100k instructions (~${(vm.slices / 10).toFixed(0)}M instructions)`); for (const [k, v] of [...vm.profile].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 20)) console.log(`  ${(100 * v / total).toFixed(1).padStart(5)}%  ${vm.proc.symbolize(k << 6)}`); }
  console.log(`[orthros] modules: ${vm.proc?.moduleList.map((m) => m.name).join(', ')}`);
  for (const v of vm.group?.vms.slice(1) ?? []) console.log(`[orthros] child process ${v.proc.pid} ${v.proc.exe?.name}: ${v.proc.exited ? `exited with code ${v.proc.exitCode}` : 'running'}, ${v.apiCalls} API calls; modules: ${v.proc.moduleList.map((m) => m.name).join(', ')}${v.firstD3DCall ? `; first Direct3D call: ${v.firstD3DCall.name} after ${v.firstD3DCall.apiCalls} API calls` : ''}`);
  const unknown = [...(vm.proc?.unknownImports ?? [])];
  if (vm.firstD3DCall) console.log(`[orthros] first Direct3D call: ${vm.firstD3DCall.name} from ${vm.firstD3DCall.from} after ${vm.firstD3DCall.apiCalls} API calls`);
  console.log(`[orthros] unknown imports: ${unknown.length}` + (unknown.length ? '\n  ' + unknown.sort((a, b) => b[1].calls - a[1].calls).map(([k, v]) => `${k} (${v.calls}, from ${v.from})`).join('\n  ') : ''));
  if (o.status && vm.proc) writeStatus(o.status, vm.proc, vm);
  process.exitCode = code === null ? 1 : 0;
}

if (import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`) main(process.argv.slice(2));
```

`src/host/display.js`:

```js
// Host abstraction seen by the VM/window manager: a display to present surfaces on, an input
// event source, and scheduler hooks. HeadlessHost is used by Node tests and the CLI runner;
// the browser worker host lives in src/host/web/.

export class HeadlessHost {
  /**
   * @param {{ clock: any, width?: number, height?: number }} opts
   */
  constructor(opts) {
    this.clock = opts.clock;
    this.display = new HeadlessDisplay(opts.width ?? 1024, opts.height ?? 768);
    /** pending input events (see user32 input handling for the event shapes) */
    this.inputQueue = [];
    /** scripted events: [{ at: ms, ev }] delivered when the clock passes `at` */
    this.script = [];
    this.exitCode = null;
    this.onFrame = null;
  }

  /** Called by the scheduler when idle: move due scripted events into the input queue. */
  pump() {
    const now = this.clock.now();
    while (this.script.length && this.script[0].at <= now) this.inputQueue.push(this.script.shift().ev);
  }

  /** Earliest time an external event is known to arrive (for the scheduler). */
  nextWake() { return this.script.length ? this.script[0].at : undefined; }

  /** Block up to ms waiting for an event (virtual clock: just advance). */
  waitEvent(ms) {
    const next = this.nextWake();
    const target = Math.min(this.clock.now() + ms, next ?? Infinity);
    this.clock.sleepUntil(target);
    this.pump();
  }

  pollInput() { this.pump(); return this.inputQueue.length ? this.inputQueue.splice(0) : null; }

  onExit(code) { this.exitCode = code; }

  /** Queue an input event to be delivered at virtual time `at` (ms). */
  at(ms, ev) { this.script.push({ at: ms, ev }); this.script.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at); }
}

export class HeadlessDisplay {
  constructor(width, height) {
    this.width = width;
    this.height = height;
    this.bpp = 32;
    this.fullscreen = false;
    this.frames = 0;
    /** last presented frame: { x, y, width, height, pixels: Uint32Array (0x00RRGGBB) } */
    this.last = null;
    this.title = '';
    this.cursorVisible = true;
    this.modes = [[640, 480], [800, 600], [1024, 768], [1280, 720], [1280, 1024], [1600, 1200], [1920, 1080]];
  }

  /** Present a surface region at screen position (x, y). Copies the pixels (headless). */
  present(surface, x, y, w = surface.width, h = surface.height) {
    const pixels = new Uint32Array(w * h);
    const row = new Uint32Array(w);
    for (let yy = 0; yy < h; yy++) { surface.readRow(yy, 0, w, row); pixels.set(row, yy * w); }
    this.last = { x, y, width: w, height: h, pixels };
    this.frames++;
  }

  pixelAt(x, y) {
    const f = this.last;
    if (!f || x < f.x || y < f.y || x >= f.x + f.width || y >= f.y + f.height) return -1;
    return f.pixels[(y - f.y) * f.width + (x - f.x)];
  }

  setMode(width, height, bpp, fullscreen) {
    this.width = width; this.height = height; this.bpp = bpp || 32; this.fullscreen = fullscreen;
    return true;
  }

  setTitle(t) { this.title = t; }
  showCursor(v) { this.cursorVisible = v; }
}
```

`src/host/engine-content.js`:

```js
// Engine files addressed by their content (docs/browser-ports.md "Engine files by content"): every file a browser
// port's page loads from its engine release (GoldSrc/Xash3D, re3, OpenMW) is given to the page — and to the home's
// "Prepare" — under /engines/_c/<sha256>/<name>, immutable, instead of /engines/<release>/<path>. Engine releases come
// often (Arsenal r2 -> r12, OpenMW r1 -> r11, reVC r1 -> r3) and change a file or two: a player coming back after one
// keeps, in the browser's HTTP cache, every file whose bytes did not change (Arsenal r11 -> r12: xash.wasm, the
// renderer, the menu, extras.pk3, the module graph — only the game's own modules fetched again), where release-keyed
// URLs made all of them new.
// A file's address is the sha256 of its bytes as read here — hashed once per file, size and mtime, in the background
// (one at a time), its release URL given meanwhile —, never only a release.json's word: a file replaced since its
// release was written (a copy of another release, then one file restored with its old mtime) must not take, immutable
// for a year in every browser, an address another release's bytes own. What a release.json says (`files`
// [{ path, sha256, bytes }] or { path: sha256 }; OpenMW's `engineFiles` { basename: sha256 }) is checked against the
// hash: a mismatch logged, the file addressed by what it holds. An ES module graph (scripts importing their siblings by
// relative paths: Xash3D's engine/) is addressed as one tree, /engines/_c/<tree sha256>/<path in the tree>, the tree's
// sha256 made of its members' paths and sha256s: unchanged scripts keep their URLs, relative imports resolve in the
// tree. The server serves a content URL only for a file it hashed from an installed release whose bytes are still the
// ones hashed (size and mtime checked at each request) — a request arriving while the server hashes (just restarted:
// addresses given by the previous process) waits for the hashing (served()) —; the release URLs keep answering for the
// pages already open with them.
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { engineFile } from './goldsrc.js';

/** The URL prefix of the engine files by content. */
export const CONTENT_PREFIX = '/engines/_c/';
const SHA256 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
/** A script of a module graph (in a tree), by its name. */
const SCRIPT = /\.m?js$/;

/**
 * The sha256s a release.json says of its files: Map(rel -> { sha, bytes|null }). Its `files` as a list of
 * { path, sha256, bytes } (Xash3D releases) or a map { path: sha256 } (re3 releases); OpenMW's `engineFiles`
 * { basename: sha256 } for the entries of its `files` list with that basename (one each: an ambiguous name says nothing).
 */
export function declaredShas(release) {
  const out = new Map();
  const files = release?.files;
  if (Array.isArray(files)) {
    for (const f of files) if (f && typeof f === 'object' && typeof f.path === 'string' && SHA256.test(f.sha256 ?? '')) out.set(f.path, { sha: f.sha256, bytes: Number.isFinite(f.bytes) ? f.bytes : null });
  } else if (files && typeof files === 'object') {
    for (const [p, s] of Object.entries(files)) if (typeof s === 'string' && SHA256.test(s)) out.set(p, { sha: s, bytes: null });
  }
  const named = release?.engineFiles;
  if (named && typeof named === 'object' && Array.isArray(files)) {
    for (const [base, sha] of Object.entries(named)) {
      if (typeof sha !== 'string' || !SHA256.test(sha)) continue;
      const at = files.filter((f) => typeof f === 'string' && path.posix.basename(f) === base);
      if (at.length === 1 && !out.has(at[0])) out.set(at[0], { sha, bytes: null });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * The functions a release.json says its engine exports to its page (`exports`: [{ name, ... }] — OpenMW's
 * orthros_file_updated, its files loaded again in place): Set(name).
 */
export const exportNames = (release) => new Set((Array.isArray(release?.exports) ? release.exports : []).map((e) => e?.name).filter((n) => typeof n === 'string'));

/** A tree's sha256: its members' paths in the tree and sha256s, in order (a member renamed or changed: a new tree). */
export const treeSha = (members) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update('orthros-engine-tree-1\n' + [...members].sort((a, b) => (a[0] < b[0] ? -1 : a[0] > b[0] ? 1 : 0)).map(([p, s]) => `${p}\0${s}\n`).join('')).digest('hex');

/**
 * The engine files by content of the releases in `enginesDir`: `sha(release, rel)` (null while hashed — started then
 * — or not installed), `pending(release, rel)` (its hashing runs or waits), `hashed(release, rel)` (a promise of its
 * sha256 once hashed, null when it cannot be), `url(release, rel)` (its content URL, or null: the release URL
 * meanwhile), `pageUrls(release, rels, tree)` ({ rel: URL } of those addressed by content now — the scripts under
 * `tree`, a release directory ending in '/', as one tree, all or none —), `lookup(sha, rest)` (the file a request of
 * /engines/_c/<sha>/<rest> is served, or null), `served(sha, rest, { reindex, ms })` (the same, a promise waiting — at
 * most `ms` — for the hashing running: `reindex(force)` asks the server's releases again — `force`: once a hashing drained
 * since, else throttled by the server —),
 * `hashing()` (files being hashed or waiting to be), `exports(release)` (the names its release.json says the engine
 * exports: exportNames, read again when it changes).
 */
export function engineContent({ enginesDir, log = () => {} }) {
  const releases = new Map(); // release -> { size, mtimeMs, declared: Map } (its release.json, read again when it changes)
  const hashes = new Map(); // "<file>\0<size>\0<mtime>" -> sha256 | null (being hashed) | false (failed)
  const waits = new Map(); // "<file>\0<size>\0<mtime>" -> { promise, resolve } of hashed() while hashed
  let idle = null; // { promise, resolve } of served()'s wait for the queue to drain, while it runs
  let drains = 0, asked = 0; // the queue's drains, and at which one served() last asked the releases again
  const files = new Map(); // sha256 -> Map(file -> { size, mtimeMs, names: Set(basename) }) — what the route serves
  const trees = new Map(); // tree sha256 -> Map(path in the tree -> sha256)
  const queue = []; let running = false;
  const declaredOf = (release) => {
    const f = engineFile(enginesDir, release, 'release.json'); if (!f) return null;
    let st; try { st = fs.statSync(f); } catch { return null; }
    const c = releases.get(release);
    if (c && c.size === st.size && c.mtimeMs === st.mtimeMs) return c;
    let declared = new Map(), exports = new Set();
    try { const r = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')); declared = declaredShas(r); exports = exportNames(r); } catch { /* unreadable: hashed */ }
    const v = { size: st.size, mtimeMs: st.mtimeMs, declared, exports };
    releases.set(release, v);
    return v;
  };
  /** The scripts of the release under directory `dir` (release paths), walked once per release.json. */
  const scriptsOf = (release, dir) => {
    const r = declaredOf(release); if (!r) return [];
    r.scripts ??= new Map();
    if (!r.scripts.has(dir)) {
      const out = [], root = engineFile(enginesDir, release, 'release.json') && path.join(enginesDir, release);
      const walk = (rel, depth) => {
        let ents = []; try { ents = fs.readdirSync(path.join(root, rel), { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return; }
        for (const e of ents) {
          if (e.name.startsWith('.')) continue;
          if (e.isDirectory() && depth < 8) walk(rel + e.name + '/', depth + 1);
          else if (SCRIPT.test(e.name)) out.push(rel + e.name);
        }
      };
      if (root) walk(dir, 0);
      r.scripts.set(dir, out.sort());
    }
    return r.scripts.get(dir);
  };
  const pump = () => {
    if (running) return;
    if (!queue.length) { drains++; if (idle) { const r = idle.resolve; idle = null; r(); } return; }
    running = true;
    const { key, file, st, name, release, rel } = queue.shift(), h = crypto.createHash('sha256');
    // (indexed at once: a content address given before a restart is served as soon as its file is hashed again)
    const done = (v) => {
      hashes.set(key, v);
      if (v) {
        index(v, file, st, name);
        // (the release's word checked: a file changed since it was written is addressed by what it holds)
        const d = declaredOf(release)?.declared.get(rel);
        if (d && d.sha !== v) log(`engine file ${release}/${rel}: sha256 ${v}, not the ${d.sha} its release.json says (addressed by its bytes)`);
      }
      const w = waits.get(key); if (w) { waits.delete(key); w.resolve(v || null); }
      running = false; pump();
    };
    fs.createReadStream(file, { highWaterMark: 1 << 20 }).on('data', (b) => h.update(b))
      .on('error', (e) => { log(`engine file ${file}: ${e.message}`); done(false); }).on('end', () => done(h.digest('hex')));
  };
  const index = (sha, file, st, name) => {
    let at = files.get(sha); if (!at) files.set(sha, at = new Map());
    let e = at.get(file);
    if (!e || e.size !== st.size || e.mtimeMs !== st.mtimeMs) at.set(file, e = { size: st.size, mtimeMs: st.mtimeMs, names: new Set() });
    e.names.add(name); // (the name the release gives it: its URL's last part)
    return sha;
  };
  /** The release's file: { file, st, key } — its real path, size and mtime, the key of its hash —, or null. */
  const fileOf = (release, rel) => {
    const file = engineFile(enginesDir, release, rel); if (!file) return null;
    let st; try { st = fs.statSync(file); } catch { return null; }
    return { file, st: { size: st.size, mtimeMs: st.mtimeMs }, key: `${file}\0${st.size}\0${st.mtimeMs}` };
  };
  const sha = (release, rel) => {
    const f = fileOf(release, rel); if (!f) return null;
    const h = hashes.get(f.key);
    if (h) return index(h, f.file, f.st, path.posix.basename(rel));
    if (h === undefined) { hashes.set(f.key, null); queue.push({ ...f, name: path.posix.basename(rel), release, rel }); pump(); }
    return null;
  };
  const url = (release, rel) => { const s = sha(release, rel); return s ? `${CONTENT_PREFIX}${s}/${encodeURIComponent(path.posix.basename(rel))}` : null; };
  return {
    sha,
    exports(release) { return declaredOf(release)?.exports ?? new Set(); },
    pending(release, rel) { const f = fileOf(release, rel); return !!f && hashes.get(f.key) === null; },
    hashed(release, rel) {
      const s = sha(release, rel), f = fileOf(release, rel);
      if (s || !f || hashes.get(f.key) !== null) return Promise.resolve(s);
      let w = waits.get(f.key);
      if (!w) { let resolve; const promise = new Promise((r) => { resolve = r; }); waits.set(f.key, w = { promise, resolve }); }
      return w.promise;
    },
    url,
    pageUrls(release, rels, tree = null) {
      const out = {}, members = [];
      for (const rel of new Set(rels)) {
        if (tree && rel.startsWith(tree) && SCRIPT.test(rel)) { members.push(rel); continue; }
        const u = url(release, rel); if (u) out[rel] = u;
      }
      if (members.length) {
        // (the tree: every script under its directory, not only those listed — a module the graph imports is in it)
        const all = new Set([...members, ...scriptsOf(release, tree)]);
        const shas = [...all].map((rel) => [rel.slice(tree.length), sha(release, rel)]);
        if (shas.every(([, s]) => s)) {
          const t = treeSha(shas);
          trees.set(t, new Map(shas));
          for (const p of members.map((rel) => rel.slice(tree.length))) out[tree + p] = `${CONTENT_PREFIX}${t}/${p.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/')}`;
        }
      }
      return out;
    },
    lookup(s, rest) {
      if (!SHA256.test(s ?? '') || typeof rest !== 'string') return null;
      // (a tree's member: its own content, by its sha256)
      const t = trees.get(s);
      if (t) { const m = t.get(rest); return m ? this.lookup(m, path.posix.basename(rest)) : null; }
      const at = files.get(s); if (!at || rest.includes('/')) return null;
      for (const [file, e] of at) {
        if (!e.names.has(rest)) continue;
        // (the bytes hashed only: a file changed or gone since is out of the index)
        let st = null; try { st = fs.statSync(file); } catch { /* gone */ }
        if (st && st.size === e.size && st.mtimeMs === e.mtimeMs) return file;
        at.delete(file);
      }
      if (!at.size) files.delete(s);
      return null;
    },
    async served(s, rest, { reindex = () => {}, ms = 60000 } = {}) {
      let file = this.lookup(s, rest); if (file || !SHA256.test(s ?? '')) return file;
      // (not indexed: a release installed since, or hashed now — a server just restarted: addresses the previous process
      // gave —: the releases asked again — at once after a hashing drained since, a tree known only once all its
      // members are hashed —, the hashing waited for)
      const end = Date.now() + ms;
      for (;;) {
        if (drains !== asked) { asked = drains; reindex(true); } else reindex(false);
        if ((file = this.lookup(s, rest)) || !(queue.length || running) || Date.now() >= end) return file;
        if (!idle) { let resolve; const promise = new Promise((r) => { resolve = r; }); idle = { promise, resolve }; }
        let timer; await Promise.race([idle.promise, new Promise((r) => { timer = setTimeout(r, end - Date.now()); timer.unref?.(); })]); clearTimeout(timer);
      }
    },
    hashing() { return queue.length + (running ? 1 : 0); },
  };
}

```

`src/host/game-catalog.js`:

```js
// The production catalog is entirely described by data/games/<game>/manifest.json.
// A game's base files are overlaid by the selected version's files.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { withDefaults } from './manifest.js';
import { resolveGameFile, releaseGameFiles } from './game-files.js';
import { goldsrcProblem, DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR } from './goldsrc.js';
import { openmwProblem } from './openmw.js';
import { re3Problem } from './re3.js';
import { mmoProblem } from './mmo.js';
import { profileMovesProblem } from '../vfs/profile-moves.js';
import { keyRemapProblem } from '../win32/vk-scan.js';

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
export const DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR = path.join(ROOT, 'data/games');
const ID = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$/;
const WIN_MOUNT = /^[A-Za-z]:\\[^/:*?"<>|]*$/;
const own = (obj, key) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, key);
const fail = (file, message) => { throw new Error(`${file}: ${message}`); };
const directory = (p) => { try { return fs.statSync(p).isDirectory(); } catch { return false; } };
const RUNTIMES = ['win32', 'goldsrc', 'openmw', 're3'];
const COVER_FILE = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\.(png|jpe?g|svg|webp)$/i;
const safePath = (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0 && !path.isAbsolute(value) && !value.includes('\\') && value.split('/').every((part) => part && part !== '.' && part !== '..');

/**
 * A game folder's manifest and its versions. `enginesDir`: the browser ports' engine releases (an re3 or GoldSrc port's
 * release's game files lie over its version's: `overlays`).
 */
export function loadGameFolder(gameDir, { enginesDir = DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR } = {}) {
  const file = path.join(gameDir, 'manifest.json');
  if (!fs.existsSync(file)) fail(file, 'manifest.json obligatoire pour chaque jeu');
  let spec;
  try { spec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')); } catch (error) { fail(file, `JSON invalide: ${error.message}`); }
  if (!spec || Array.isArray(spec) || typeof spec !== 'object') fail(file, 'objet JSON attendu');
  if (spec.schemaVersion !== 1) fail(file, 'schemaVersion doit être 1');
  if (!ID.test(spec.id ?? '') || spec.id !== path.basename(gameDir)) fail(file, 'id doit correspondre au nom du dossier');
  if (typeof spec.name !== 'string' || !spec.name.trim()) fail(file, 'name obligatoire');
  if (!directory(path.join(gameDir, 'base'))) fail(file, 'dossier base/ manquant');
  if (!Array.isArray(spec.versions) || !spec.versions.length) fail(file, 'versions doit contenir au moins une version');
  if (spec.defaults !== undefined && (!spec.defaults || Array.isArray(spec.defaults) || typeof spec.defaults !== 'object')) fail(file, 'defaults doit être un objet');
  const defaults = spec.defaults ?? {};
  for (const key of ['folder', 'baseFolder', 'gameId', 'id', 'dir', 'requires', 'formerGame', 'extraMounts', 'saveDir', 'coverPath', 'saveKey', 'overlays', 'dataMounts', 'underlays', 'underlayOwners']) if (own(defaults, key)) fail(file, `defaults.${key} est réservé`);
  const versions = new Map();
  for (const entry of spec.versions) {
    if (!entry || Array.isArray(entry) || typeof entry !== 'object') fail(file, 'entrée de version invalide');
    if (!ID.test(entry.id ?? '') || versions.has(entry.id)) fail(file, `id de version invalide ou dupliqué: ${entry.id}`);
    if (!safePath(entry.dir) || entry.dir.includes('/')) fail(file, `${entry.id}: dir doit nommer un dossier de versions/`);
    if (!directory(path.join(gameDir, 'versions', entry.dir))) fail(file, `${entry.id}: dossier versions/${entry.dir} manquant`);
    if (typeof entry.version !== 'string' || !entry.version.trim()) fail(file, `${entry.id}: version obligatoire`);
    const runtime = entry.runtime ?? defaults.runtime ?? 'win32';
    if (!RUNTIMES.includes(runtime)) fail(file, `${entry.id}: runtime inconnu: ${runtime}`);
    if (runtime === 'win32' && !safePath(entry.exe)) fail(file, `${entry.id}: exe doit être un chemin relatif sûr`);
    if (entry.languages !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(entry.languages) || !entry.languages.length || !entry.languages.every((v) => typeof v === 'string' && /^[a-z]{2}(?:-[A-Z]{2})?$/.test(v)))) fail(file, `${entry.id}: languages invalide`);
    // (win32: another game's version mounted at its own drive path; goldsrc, re3, openmw: its files beneath this
    // version's, no mount)
    const layered = runtime === 'goldsrc' || runtime === 're3' || runtime === 'openmw';
    if (entry.requires !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(entry.requires) || !entry.requires.every((d) => d && ID.test(d.game ?? '') && ID.test(d.version ?? '') && (layered ? d.mount === undefined : WIN_MOUNT.test(d.mount ?? ''))))) fail(file, `${entry.id}: requires invalide`);
    for (const key of ['folder', 'baseFolder', 'gameId', 'saveDir', 'extraMounts', 'coverPath', 'saveKey', 'overlays', 'dataMounts', 'underlays', 'underlayOwners']) if (own(entry, key)) fail(file, `${entry.id}: ${key} est généré depuis le dossier`);
    // (a version moved from another game folder: the browser's saves keep that installation's key — the port's saveKey)
    if (entry.formerGame !== undefined && (!ID.test(entry.formerGame) || entry.formerGame === spec.id)) fail(file, `${entry.id}: formerGame doit nommer un autre dossier de jeu`);
    const { id, dir, requires, formerGame, ...version } = entry;
    const installation = `orthros-port:${formerGame ?? spec.id}:${dir}`;
    const manifest = withDefaults({ ...defaults, ...version, runtime, name: spec.name, gameId: spec.id,
      folder: path.join(gameDir, 'versions', dir), baseFolder: path.join(gameDir, 'base'),
      saveDir: path.join(ROOT, 'build/saves', id) });
    if (!WIN_MOUNT.test(manifest.mount)) fail(file, `${id}: mount invalide`);
    if (manifest.modified !== undefined && typeof manifest.modified !== 'boolean') fail(file, `${id}: modified doit être un booléen`);
    // (a shared world, any runtime: src/host/mmo.js)
    { const problem = mmoProblem(manifest.mmo); if (problem) fail(file, `${id}: ${problem}`); }
    // (files of the player's profile the game keeps elsewhere now: moved at each start, src/vfs/profile-moves.js)
    { const problem = profileMovesProblem(manifest.profileMoves); if (problem) fail(file, `${id}: ${problem}`); }
    // (light copies of the textures for a slow link, src/host/light-copies.js: the browser ports — a Windows game reads
    // its files as they are —, unless the version says false)
    if (manifest.lightCopies !== undefined && typeof manifest.lightCopies !== 'boolean') fail(file, `${id}: lightCopies doit être un booléen`);
    manifest.lightCopies = runtime !== 'win32' && manifest.lightCopies !== false;
    // (the player's keys as the game gets them: user32.js remapKey)
    { const problem = keyRemapProblem(manifest.keys); if (problem) fail(file, `${id}: ${problem}`); }
    if (runtime === 'win32' && !resolveGameFile(manifest, manifest.exe)) fail(file, `${id}: exécutable ${manifest.exe} absent de base/ et versions/${dir}/`);
    if (runtime === 'goldsrc') {
      const problem = goldsrcProblem(manifest.goldsrc);
      if (problem) fail(file, `${id}: ${problem}`);
      manifest.saveKey = installation; // (the installation, game/version folder: the page's saved profile)
      // (the release's own game files over the version's — the files Orthros builds, as the bots' meshes: game data, not
      // archives the page fetches whole —; none while the release has no gamefiles/)
      manifest.overlays = [releaseGameFiles(enginesDir, manifest.goldsrc.engine)];
    }
    if (runtime === 'openmw') {
      const problem = openmwProblem(manifest.openmw);
      if (problem) fail(file, `${id}: ${problem}`);
      manifest.saveKey = installation;
      // (the engine release's own data — its asset pack — served with the game's files, under _engine/)
      manifest.dataMounts = [{ at: '_engine', dir: path.join(enginesDir, manifest.openmw.engine, 'moddata') }];
    }
    if (runtime === 're3') {
      const problem = re3Problem(manifest.re3);
      if (problem) fail(file, `${id}: ${problem}`);
      manifest.saveKey = installation;
      // (the engine release's own game files over the version's, whatever their case — none while it is not installed)
      manifest.overlays = [releaseGameFiles(enginesDir, manifest.re3.engine)];
    }
    // (an image beside manifest.json, for a game whose own files hold none a browser displays)
    if (manifest.coverFile !== undefined) {
      if (!COVER_FILE.test(manifest.coverFile) || !fs.statSync(path.join(gameDir, manifest.coverFile), { throwIfNoEntry: false })?.isFile()) fail(file, `${id}: coverFile doit nommer une image à côté de manifest.json`);
      manifest.coverPath = path.join(gameDir, manifest.coverFile);
    }
    if (manifest.languageFileAliases !== undefined) {
      const aliases = manifest.languageFileAliases;
      if (!aliases || Array.isArray(aliases) || typeof aliases !== 'object') fail(file, `${id}: languageFileAliases invalide`);
      for (const [language, paths] of Object.entries(aliases)) {
        if (!manifest.languages?.includes(language) || !paths || Array.isArray(paths) || typeof paths !== 'object') fail(file, `${id}: languageFileAliases.${language} invalide`);
        const seen = new Set();
        for (const [from, to] of Object.entries(paths)) {
          if (!safePath(from) || !safePath(to) || seen.has(from.toLowerCase()) || !resolveGameFile(manifest, from) || !resolveGameFile(manifest, to))
            fail(file, `${id}: alias de fichier invalide: ${from} -> ${to}`);
          seen.add(from.toLowerCase());
        }
      }
    }
    // (files of the version for one language only — hidden from the game in the others)
    if (manifest.languageFiles !== undefined) {
      const lf = manifest.languageFiles;
      if (!lf || Array.isArray(lf) || typeof lf !== 'object') fail(file, `${id}: languageFiles invalide`);
      for (const [language, paths] of Object.entries(lf)) {
        if (!manifest.languages?.includes(language) || !Array.isArray(paths) || !paths.every((p) => safePath(p) && resolveGameFile(manifest, p))) fail(file, `${id}: languageFiles.${language} : fichiers du jeu pour une langue de la version`);
      }
    }
    versions.set(id, { manifest, requires: requires ?? [] });
  }
  if (!versions.has(spec.defaultVersion)) fail(file, 'defaultVersion doit désigner une version');
  return { spec, versions };
}

export function loadGameCatalog(root = DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR, extra = null, { enginesDir = DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR } = {}) {
  const catalog = new Map(), sources = new Map();
  if (!directory(root)) throw new Error(`Dossier des jeux introuvable: ${root}`);
  for (const ent of fs.readdirSync(root, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (!ent.isDirectory()) continue;
    const game = loadGameFolder(path.join(root, ent.name), { enginesDir });
    for (const [id, item] of game.versions) {
      if (catalog.has(id)) throw new Error(`Identifiant de version dupliqué: ${id}`);
      catalog.set(id, item.manifest);
      sources.set(id, { game: game.spec.id, requires: item.requires });
    }
  }
  for (const [id, source] of sources) {
    const deps = [];
    for (const dep of source.requires) {
      if (dep.version === id || sources.get(dep.version)?.game !== dep.game) throw new Error(`${id}: dépendance introuvable ou invalide: ${dep.game}/${dep.version}`);
      // (the required game's language key too: the player's language set on both, as their installers do)
      const req = catalog.get(dep.version);
      deps.push({ mount: dep.mount, manifest: dep.version, ...(req.languageRegistryKey ? { languageRegistryKey: req.languageRegistryKey, languages: req.languages ?? [] } : {}) });
    }
    if (deps.length && catalog.get(id).runtime === 'win32') catalog.get(id).extraMounts = deps;
  }
  // (the UDP ports of the dedicated servers and their rooms: one version each)
  const ports = new Map();
  const tcpPorts = new Map();
  for (const [id, m] of catalog) {
    if (m.runtime === 'openmw' && m.openmw.multiplayer) {
      const p = m.openmw.multiplayer.port;
      if (tcpPorts.has(p)) throw new Error(`${id}: port TCP ${p} déjà pris par ${tcpPorts.get(p)}`);
      tcpPorts.set(p, id);
    }
    const mp = m.runtime === 'goldsrc' ? m.goldsrc?.multiplayer : null; if (!mp) continue;
    const own = [mp.port];
    if (mp.rooms) for (let p = mp.rooms.ports[0]; p <= mp.rooms.ports[1]; p++) own.push(p);
    for (const p of own) { if (ports.has(p)) throw new Error(`${id}: port UDP ${p} déjà pris par ${ports.get(p)}`); ports.set(p, id); }
  }
  // (a GoldSrc version's required versions lie beneath its own files, in order, with theirs: a mod over its game; an
  // re3 version's, of any runtime, the same way — a recompiled engine over the original game's files, as a game of its
  // own on the home without a copy of them; an OpenMW version's too — its mod stack over the original game's files;
  // a required version's own requires followed for a port only)
  // (each underlay folder with the version it is the folder of — `underlayOwners`: [{ manifest, dirs }]: the files the
  // tree takes from them are that version's, stored and fetched under its name by the browsers — game-files.js
  // listGameTree, docs/slow-network.md "Files of a required version")
  const underlays = (id, seen) => {
    if (seen.includes(id)) throw new Error(`dépendance circulaire: ${[...seen, id].join(' -> ')}`);
    const own = catalog.get(id).runtime;
    return sources.get(id).requires.flatMap((dep) => {
      const m = catalog.get(dep.version);
      if (own === 'goldsrc' && m.runtime !== 'goldsrc') throw new Error(`${id}: ${dep.version} n'est pas un portage goldsrc`);
      return [{ manifest: dep.version, dirs: [m.folder, m.baseFolder] }, ...(m.runtime === 'win32' ? [] : underlays(dep.version, [...seen, id]))];
    });
  };
  for (const [id, source] of sources) {
    const runtime = catalog.get(id).runtime;
    if (!source.requires.length || runtime === 'win32') continue;
    const owners = underlays(id, []);
    catalog.get(id).underlays = owners.flatMap((o) => o.dirs);
    catalog.get(id).underlayOwners = owners.map((o) => ({ manifest: o.manifest, dirs: o.dirs.filter(Boolean) }));
  }
  for (const [id, manifest] of extra ?? []) catalog.set(id, manifest);
  return catalog;
}

export function defaultGameManifest(gameDir) {
  const dir = path.resolve(gameDir);
  const { spec } = loadGameFolder(dir);
  return loadGameCatalog(path.dirname(dir)).get(spec.defaultVersion);
}
```
