`src/host/game-files.js`:

```js
// A game's base installation and a version's overrides form one read-only folder (a port's engine release's game
// files over both, the files of the versions a GoldSrc port requires beneath).
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { ESM_FORMAT, LIGHT_DIR, lightCopy } from './light-copies.js';
import { isMediaFile } from '../vfs/game-tree.js';

/**
 * A port's engine release's own game files (`gamefiles/`, present or not), laid over its version's whatever the
 * runtime (re3, GoldSrc: game-catalog.js puts it in the manifest's `overlays`): files Orthros builds itself — reVC's
 * texts, the Counter-Strike bots' navigation meshes, Half Strike's models and sounds — served as the game's own data
 * (/gamez, light copies, the learned order, the OPFS store), not as engine files fetched whole before the start.
 */
export const releaseGameFiles = (enginesDir, release) => path.join(enginesDir, release, 'gamefiles');

export function gameLayers(manifest) {
  // (underlays: the folders of versions a GoldSrc port requires, beneath its own; overlays: folders over the version's
  // own, a port's engine release's game files, releaseGameFiles — both from game-catalog.js)
  return [...(manifest.overlays ?? []), ...(manifest.baseFolder ? [manifest.folder, manifest.baseFolder] : [manifest.folder]), ...(manifest.underlays ?? [])];
}

/**
 * List one layer, replacing same-named entries without changing the guest-visible path. `mark(file, entry)`: each
 * file's entry completed (its light copy's size); `seen`: every folder looked at (there or not) pushed to it.
 */
function mergeDir(layers, mark = null, seen = null, rel = '') {
  const node = { dirs: {}, files: {} }, entries = new Map();
  for (const dir of layers) {
    seen?.push(dir);
    if (!dir || !fs.existsSync(dir)) continue;
    for (const ent of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const key = ent.name.toLowerCase();
      if (ent.isDirectory()) {
        const previous = entries.get(key);
        if (!previous) entries.set(key, { name: ent.name, dirs: [path.join(dir, ent.name)] });
        else if (previous.dirs) previous.dirs.push(path.join(dir, ent.name));
      } else if (ent.isFile() && !entries.has(key)) {
        entries.set(key, { name: ent.name, file: path.join(dir, ent.name) });
      }
    }
  }
  for (const entry of entries.values()) {
    const at = rel ? `${rel}/${entry.name}` : entry.name;
    if (entry.dirs) node.dirs[entry.name] = mergeDir(entry.dirs, mark, seen, at);
    else {
      const st = fs.statSync(entry.file), e = node.files[entry.name] = { size: st.size, mtime: st.mtimeMs };
      if (isMediaFile(entry.name, st.size)) e.media = true; // (game-tree.js: after the rest on a link that is not fast)
      mark?.(entry.file, st, e, at);
    }
  }
  return node;
}

/**
 * The game's files as the browsers read them: its layers, and the folders of its engine's release it serves beside them
 * (`dataMounts`: [{ at, dir }] — an engine's own data, as OpenMW's asset pack, under a folder of its own, `at`; not part
 * of the game's layers, which a native server laying out the game reads too). With manifest.lightCopies, a file that has
 * a light copy (light-copies.js) tells its size: `light` — a content file's (a TES3 file's) with `contentLight` only
 * (the version's engine reads it light: launch-set.js CONTENT_EXPORT). A media file by its format (isMediaFile,
 * game-tree.js) is marked `media: true`. `seen`: the folders it was listed from pushed to it (dirsStamp: whether it changed since).
 * `ownerOf(id)`: the manifest of a version the tree's underlays belong to (manifest.underlayOwners, game-catalog.js) —
 * a file taken from one is marked `owner: <id>` (fileOwner): the browsers store and fetch it under that version.
 */
export function listGameTree(manifest, seen = null, ownerOf = null, { contentLight = false } = {}) {
  // (a content file's light copy — a TES3 file's, ESM_FORMAT — only for an engine that reads it light and says when it
  // is done: `contentLight`, its release's CONTENT_EXPORT — launch-set.js)
  const light = manifest.lightCopies ? (file, st, e) => { const c = lightCopy(file, st); if (c && (contentLight || c.format !== ESM_FORMAT)) e.light = c.size; } : null;
  const owner = ownerOf && manifest.underlayOwners?.length ? fileOwner(manifest, ownerOf, seen) : null;
  const mark = light && owner ? (file, st, e, rel) => { light(file, st, e); owner(file, st, e, rel); } : light ?? owner;
  const tree = mergeDir(gameLayers(manifest), mark, seen);
  for (const { at, dir } of manifest.dataMounts ?? []) { if (fs.existsSync(dir)) tree.dirs[at] = mergeDir([dir], mark, seen, at); else seen?.push(dir); }
  return tree;
}

/**
 * listGameTree's marker of the files a version takes from another (its underlays): (file, st, entry, rel) marks the
 * entry `owner: <id>` when the first of the versions it requires (manifest.underlayOwners, in order) whose own path
 * `rel` — what /gamez/<id>/<rel> serves, resolveGameFile: through its overlays, data mounts and version folder — is this
 * very file (the same device and inode: the file of the folder they share, or a hard link of it in the version's own
 * folder — Morrowind Vanilla+ FR keeps GOTY FR's archives so —, the same size and time then: the browsers' block keys
 * agree), and, when it has a light copy, when that version serves light copies too. Any other file stays the version's
 * own (fetched as before): one the owner's folder overrides (two versions of one game folder share its base), one the
 * owner hides. The folders the owners' paths were resolved in pushed to `seen` (a file added there changes the answer).
 */
function fileOwner(manifest, ownerOf, seen) {
  const owners = [];
  for (const { manifest: id } of manifest.underlayOwners) { const m = ownerOf(id); if (m && !owners.some((o) => o.id === id)) owners.push({ id, m }); }
  // (resolveGameFile's listings, each folder listed once — and pushed to `seen` then)
  const memo = new Map(), set = memo.set.bind(memo);
  memo.set = (dir, l) => { seen?.push(dir); return set(dir, l); };
  for (const { m } of owners) for (const d of [...gameLayers(m), ...(m.dataMounts ?? []).map((x) => x.dir)]) if (d && !memo.has(d)) listing(d, memo);
  return (file, st, e, rel) => {
    for (const o of owners) {
      const at = resolveGameFile(o.m, rel, memo); if (!at) continue;
      let ost; try { ost = at === file ? st : fs.statSync(at); } catch { continue; }
      if (ost.ino !== st.ino || ost.dev !== st.dev || ost.size !== st.size || ost.mtimeMs !== st.mtimeMs) continue;
      if (e.light && !o.m.lightCopies) return;
      e.owner = o.id; return;
    }
  };
}

/**
 * The state of folders (listGameTree's `seen`): a file or folder added, removed or renamed in one of them — a version,
 * a map, an engine release installed — changes it; a folder there or gone too. One stat a folder, not one a file (a
 * game has ~50 times more files than folders: Morrowind and its mods, 42 000 files in 565 folders).
 */
export function dirsStamp(dirs) {
  let stamp = '', now = Date.now();
  for (const dir of dirs) {
    try {
      const st = fs.statSync(dir);
      // (changed within DirListings.RECENT_MS: a stamp of its own each time — two changes in one tick of the file
      // system's clock leave the same mtime, the second one unseen)
      stamp += now - Math.max(st.mtimeMs, st.ctimeMs) < DirListings.RECENT_MS ? `r${Math.random()};` : `${st.ino}:${st.mtimeMs}:${st.ctimeMs};`;
    } catch { stamp += '-;'; }
  }
  return stamp;
}

/**
 * The folders' listings kept across requests (a `memo` of resolveGameFile), each checked at each use by one stat of its
 * folder — a file added, removed or renamed there changes the folder's mtime: listed again. Without it each /gamez
 * request listed every folder of its path in every layer (readdir of a texture folder of thousands of files: under 20
 * players, 5.5 s of the server's thread in 30 s, measured). At most `maxNames` names kept (least recently used out).
 */
export class DirListings {
  constructor(maxNames = 400000) { this.maxNames = maxNames; this.names = 0; this.map = new Map(); this.pending = new Map(); }
  // (null: the folder changed within the last RECENT_MS — a file system's times are coarse, a few ms on Linux: two
  // changes in one tick leave the same mtime —, listed again at each use until it is older)
  static stamp(dir) {
    try {
      const st = fs.statSync(dir);
      return Date.now() - Math.max(st.mtimeMs, st.ctimeMs) < DirListings.RECENT_MS ? null : `${st.ino}:${st.mtimeMs}:${st.ctimeMs}`;
    } catch { return '-'; }
  }
  get(dir) {
    const stamp = DirListings.stamp(dir), e = this.map.get(dir);
    if (e && stamp !== null && e.stamp === stamp) { this.map.delete(dir); this.map.set(dir, e); return e.l; }
    if (e) { this.map.delete(dir); this.names -= e.n; }
    this.pending.set(dir, stamp); // (the folder's state before it is listed: changed while listed, listed again next time)
    return undefined;
  }
  set(dir, l) {
    const stamp = this.pending.has(dir) ? this.pending.get(dir) : DirListings.stamp(dir); this.pending.delete(dir);
    const old = this.map.get(dir); if (old) { this.map.delete(dir); this.names -= old.n; }
    const n = (l?.kinds.size ?? 0) + 1;
    this.map.set(dir, { stamp, l, n }); this.names += n;
    for (const [k, v] of this.map) { if (this.names <= this.maxNames || k === dir) break; this.map.delete(k); this.names -= v.n; }
    return this;
  }
  get size() { return this.map.size; }
}
DirListings.RECENT_MS = 2000;

/**
 * The light copy of a version's path under LIGHT_DIR: { file, st, copy } (light-copies.js), or null — a content file's
 * (a TES3 file's, ESM_FORMAT) with `contentLight` only (the version's engine reads it light, as listGameTree's).
 */
export function resolveLightFile(manifest, rel, memo = null, { contentLight = false } = {}) {
  const parts = rel.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter(Boolean);
  if (!manifest.lightCopies || parts[0] !== LIGHT_DIR) return null;
  const file = resolveGameFile(manifest, parts.slice(1).join('/'), memo); if (!file) return null;
  let st; try { st = fs.statSync(file); } catch { return null; }
  const copy = lightCopy(file, st);
  return copy && (contentLight || copy.format !== ESM_FORMAT) ? { file, st, copy } : null;
}

/**
 * Resolve a guest path through all layers, with the version taking precedence (a data mount's under its folder).
 * `memo` (a Map): the folders' listings kept between calls — many paths resolved at once (a launch set's).
 */
export function resolveGameFile(manifest, rel, memo = null) {
  const top = rel.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter(Boolean)[0];
  const mount = (manifest.dataMounts ?? []).find((m) => m.at === top);
  if (mount) return resolveIn([mount.dir], rel.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter(Boolean).slice(1).join('/'), memo);
  return resolveIn(gameLayers(manifest), rel, memo);
}

/**
 * A folder's entries: { kinds: name -> 'file' | 'dir' | null (neither), lower: lower-case name -> its first name }, or
 * null (no such folder); from `memo` when it has them. A link is what it points to.
 */
function listing(dir, memo) {
  let l = memo?.get(dir);
  if (l === undefined) {
    l = null;
    try {
      const kinds = new Map(), lower = new Map();
      for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
        let kind = e.isFile() ? 'file' : e.isDirectory() ? 'dir' : null;
        if (e.isSymbolicLink()) try { const st = fs.statSync(path.join(dir, e.name)); kind = st.isFile() ? 'file' : st.isDirectory() ? 'dir' : null; } catch { kind = null; }
        kinds.set(e.name, kind);
        if (!lower.has(e.name.toLowerCase())) lower.set(e.name.toLowerCase(), e.name);
      }
      l = { kinds, lower };
    } catch { /* not a folder */ }
    memo?.set(dir, l);
  }
  return l;
}

function resolveIn(layers, rel, memo = null) {
  let dirs = layers;
  const parts = rel.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter(Boolean);
  if (!parts.length || parts.some((p) => p === '.' || p === '..')) return null;
  for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
    const nextDirs = [];
    let file = null;
    for (const dir of dirs) {
      const l = listing(dir, memo); if (!l) continue;
      const hit = l.kinds.has(parts[i]) ? parts[i] : l.lower.get(parts[i].toLowerCase());
      if (!hit) continue;
      const p = path.join(dir, hit), kind = l.kinds.get(hit);
      if (kind === 'file') { if (!nextDirs.length) { file = p; break; } continue; }
      if (kind === 'dir') nextDirs.push(p);
    }
    if (file) return i === parts.length - 1 ? file : null;
    if (!nextDirs.length) return null;
    dirs = nextDirs;
  }
  return null;
}

```

`src/host/goldsrc.js`:

```js
// GoldSrc browser ports (docs/browser-ports.md): a game version whose manifest says "runtime": "goldsrc" does not run in
// the Win32 runtime. Its page (src/ports/goldsrc/) runs a pinned third-party GoldSrc engine compiled to WebAssembly,
// installed outside Git in data/engines/<release>/, over the game's own files (/game/<manifest>/). This module checks
// such a manifest entry, tells whether its engine release is installed, links the game's layers for the native
// dedicated server, and relays multiplayer: one WebSocket per player to the version's dedicated server on a localhost
// UDP port. Nothing here names a game: engine release, game directory, modules, maps and ports come from the manifest.
import dgram from 'node:dgram';
import http from 'node:http';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { gameLayers, resolveGameFile } from './game-files.js';
import { sameOrigin } from './request-origin.js';

export const DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../../data/engines');
const ID = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$/;
const MAP = /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$/;
const COMMAND = /^[\x20-\x7e]{1,200}$/;
// (console commands of a manifest: one per entry, none chained)
const commandsOk = (list) => Array.isArray(list) && list.every((c) => typeof c === 'string' && COMMAND.test(c) && !c.includes(';'));
/** The archives a version mounts in its game folder (release paths): the engine's own by default. */
export const goldsrcExtras = (g) => g.extras ?? ['engine/valve/extras.pk3'];
const safePath = (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0 && !path.isAbsolute(value) && !value.includes('\\') && value.split('/').every((part) => part && part !== '.' && part !== '..' && !part.startsWith('.'));
const isObject = (value) => !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);

/** What is wrong with a version's `goldsrc` entry, or null. */
export function goldsrcProblem(g) {
  if (!isObject(g)) return 'goldsrc obligatoire pour le runtime goldsrc';
  if (!ID.test(g.engine ?? '')) return 'goldsrc.engine doit nommer une release de data/engines/';
  if (!safePath(g.gameDir) || g.gameDir.includes('/')) return 'goldsrc.gameDir doit nommer un dossier du jeu';
  if (!isObject(g.modules) || !['client', 'server'].every((k) => safePath(g.modules[k])) || (g.modules.menu !== undefined && !safePath(g.modules.menu))) return 'goldsrc.modules.client et .server (et .menu) doivent être des chemins de la release';
  if (g.solo === undefined && g.multiplayer === undefined) return 'goldsrc.solo ou goldsrc.multiplayer obligatoire';
  if (g.solo !== undefined && (!isObject(g.solo) || !MAP.test(g.solo.map ?? ''))) return 'goldsrc.solo.map invalide';
  if (g.solo?.commands !== undefined && !commandsOk(g.solo.commands)) return 'goldsrc.solo.commands : commandes de console, une par entrée';
  if (g.extras !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(g.extras) || !g.extras.every((e) => safePath(e) && /\.pk3$/i.test(e)) || new Set(g.extras.map((e) => path.posix.basename(e).toLowerCase())).size !== g.extras.length)) return 'goldsrc.extras : archives .pk3 de la release, de noms distincts';
  // (a game language's own: engine arguments, console commands at the start, release archives — the player's choice of
  // the version's `languages`, docs/game-frame.md)
  if (g.languages !== undefined && (!isObject(g.languages) || !Object.entries(g.languages).every(([code, l]) => /^[a-z]{2}$/.test(code) && isObject(l)
    && (l.args === undefined || (Array.isArray(l.args) && l.args.every((a) => typeof a === 'string' && /^[-+]?[A-Za-z0-9_.]{1,40}$/.test(a))))
    && (l.commands === undefined || commandsOk(l.commands))
    && (l.extras === undefined || (Array.isArray(l.extras) && l.extras.every((e) => safePath(e) && /\.pk3$/i.test(e))))
    && (l.overlays === undefined || (isObject(l.overlays) && Object.entries(l.overlays).every(([from, to]) => [from, to].every((d) => typeof d === 'string' && safePath(d) && !d.includes('/')) && from.toLowerCase() !== to.toLowerCase()))))))
    return 'goldsrc.languages : { <langue>: { args, commands, extras, overlays: { <dossier traduit>: <dossier du jeu> } } }';
  if (g.multiplayer !== undefined) {
    const mp = g.multiplayer;
    if (!isObject(mp) || !MAP.test(mp.map ?? '') || !Number.isInteger(mp.port) || mp.port < 1024 || mp.port > 65535 || !ID.test(mp.server ?? '')) return 'goldsrc.multiplayer : server, port (1024-65535) et map obligatoires';
    if (mp.maxPlayers !== undefined && (!Number.isInteger(mp.maxPlayers) || mp.maxPlayers < 2 || mp.maxPlayers > 32)) return 'goldsrc.multiplayer.maxPlayers invalide';
    if (mp.gameLibrary !== undefined && !safePath(mp.gameLibrary)) return 'goldsrc.multiplayer.gameLibrary doit être un chemin de la release';
    if (mp.commands !== undefined && !commandsOk(mp.commands)) return 'goldsrc.multiplayer.commands : commandes de console, une par entrée';
    if (mp.mapImage !== undefined && (typeof mp.mapImage !== 'string' || !mp.mapImage.includes('{map}') || !safePath(mp.mapImage.replaceAll('{map}', 'm')))) return 'goldsrc.multiplayer.mapImage : chemin du dossier du jeu avec {map}';
    if (mp.maps !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(mp.maps) || !mp.maps.length || !mp.maps.every((n) => typeof n === 'string' && MAP.test(n)))) return 'goldsrc.multiplayer.maps : noms de cartes';
    if (mp.mapGroups !== undefined && !mapGroupsOk(mp.mapGroups)) return 'goldsrc.multiplayer.mapGroups : [{ id, label, prefix et/ou maps, short, icon, description }], ids distincts';
    if (mp.rooms !== undefined) {
      const r = mp.rooms, [first, last] = Array.isArray(r?.ports) ? r.ports : [];
      if (!isObject(r) || !Number.isInteger(first) || !Number.isInteger(last) || first < 1024 || last > 65535 || last < first || last - first >= 8 || (mp.port >= first && mp.port <= last)) return 'goldsrc.multiplayer.rooms.ports : [premier, dernier], 8 ports au plus, hors du port du serveur';
      if (r.bots !== undefined && (!isObject(r.bots) || !Number.isInteger(r.bots.max) || r.bots.max < 1 || r.bots.max > 31 || !commandsOk(r.bots.commands ?? []) || !(r.bots.commands ?? []).some((c) => c.includes('{n}')))) return 'goldsrc.multiplayer.rooms.bots : max (1-31) et commands, l\'une avec {n}';
      if (r.options !== undefined && !roomOptionsOk(r.options)) return 'goldsrc.multiplayer.rooms.options : [{ id, label, default, choices: [{ id, label, commands }] }], ids distincts';
      if (r.bots?.args !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(r.bots.args) || !r.bots.args.every((a) => typeof a === 'string' && /^-[a-z0-9_]{1,32}$/.test(a)))) return 'goldsrc.multiplayer.rooms.bots.args : options de ligne de commande (-nom)';
    }
  }
  return null;
}

const OPTION_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/;
const idOk = (id) => typeof id === 'string' && OPTION_ID.test(id);
const labelOk = (l, max = 60) => typeof l === 'string' ? l.length > 0 && l.length <= max : isObject(l) && Object.entries(l).length > 0 && Object.entries(l).every(([k, v]) => /^[a-z]{2}$/.test(k) && typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 0 && v.length <= max);
const PREFIX = /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,32}$/;
/**
 * The lobby's map groups (multiplayer.mapGroups: a game's classic modes, say): each an id, a label, the maps it holds —
 * those whose name begins with its `prefix` (one or several) and/or those it names (`maps`) — and, for the page, a
 * `short` label (the map cards' badge), an `icon` and a `description`. A map goes to the first group naming it, else to
 * the first whose prefix it has; the others are the page's "other maps".
 */
function mapGroupsOk(groups) {
  if (!Array.isArray(groups) || !groups.length || groups.length > 12 || new Set(groups.map((g) => g?.id)).size !== groups.length) return false;
  return groups.every((g) => isObject(g) && idOk(g.id) && labelOk(g.label)
    && (g.short === undefined || labelOk(g.short, 16)) && (g.description === undefined || labelOk(g.description, 160))
    && (g.icon === undefined || (typeof g.icon === 'string' && /^[^\p{Cc}]{1,16}$/u.test(g.icon)))
    && (g.prefix !== undefined || g.maps !== undefined)
    && (g.prefix === undefined || (typeof g.prefix === 'string' ? PREFIX.test(g.prefix) : Array.isArray(g.prefix) && g.prefix.length > 0 && g.prefix.length <= 8 && g.prefix.every((p) => typeof p === 'string' && PREFIX.test(p))))
    && (g.maps === undefined || (Array.isArray(g.maps) && g.maps.length > 0 && g.maps.length <= 500 && g.maps.every((n) => typeof n === 'string' && MAP.test(n)))));
}
/** The map groups as the page gets them (GET /api/rooms). */
export const mapGroupsFor = (mp) => (mp.mapGroups ?? []).map(({ id, label, short, icon, description, prefix, maps }) => ({ id, label, short, icon, description, prefix, maps }));
/** A room's settings a player chooses (rooms.options): each a few choices, each its server commands. */
function roomOptionsOk(options) {
  if (!Array.isArray(options) || options.length > 8 || new Set(options.map((o) => o?.id)).size !== options.length) return false;
  return options.every((o) => isObject(o) && idOk(o.id) && labelOk(o.label) && [o.bots, o.show].every((b) => b === undefined || typeof b === 'boolean')
    && Array.isArray(o.choices) && o.choices.length >= 2 && o.choices.length <= 12
    && o.choices.every((c) => isObject(c) && idOk(c.id) && labelOk(c.label) && commandsOk(c.commands ?? []))
    && new Set(o.choices.map((c) => c.id)).size === o.choices.length && o.choices.some((c) => c.id === o.default));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the rooms: the games players create
// A version whose multiplayer names `rooms` gets, beside its permanent server (room 0), up to one room per port of its
// range, created on demand with a name, a map, a size and bots, and stopped once empty (tools/goldsrc/server.mjs).

/** The UDP port of a room. */
export const roomPort = (mp, index) => (index === 0 ? mp.port : mp.rooms.ports[0] + index - 1);
/** How many rooms players may create. */
export const roomSlots = (mp) => (mp.rooms ? mp.rooms.ports[1] - mp.rooms.ports[0] + 1 : 0);
/** A room's name as players read it: printable, no quotes nor console separators, 32 characters at most. */
export const roomName = (value) => String(value ?? '').normalize('NFC').replace(/[\p{C}"\\;]/gu, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 32);
/** Two room names that read the same (case, compatibility forms). */
export const sameRoomName = (a, b) => roomName(a).normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase() === roomName(b).normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase();

/** The visitor's address: the one the local reverse proxy (Caddy, trusting Cloudflare's) put last, else the socket's. */
export function clientAddress(req) {
  const remote = String(req.socket?.remoteAddress ?? '');
  const local = /^(127\.|::1$|::ffff:127\.)/.test(remote);
  const forwarded = String(req.headers['x-forwarded-for'] ?? '').split(',').map((v) => v.trim()).filter(Boolean).at(-1);
  return local && forwarded ? forwarded : remote;
}

/**
 * A request to create a room, checked: { name, map (one of `maps`), maxPlayers (2 to the server's), bots (0 to the
 * rooms' max, none without bots) }, or a message saying what is wrong.
 */
export function roomRequest(body, mp, maps) {
  const name = roomName(body?.name), map = String(body?.map ?? ''), maxPlayers = Number(body?.maxPlayers ?? mp.maxPlayers ?? 16), bots = Number(body?.bots ?? 0);
  if (name.length < 2) return { error: 'name' };
  if (!maps.includes(map)) return { error: 'map' };
  if (!Number.isInteger(maxPlayers) || maxPlayers < 2 || maxPlayers > (mp.maxPlayers ?? 16)) return { error: 'maxPlayers' };
  if (!Number.isInteger(bots) || bots < 0 || bots > (mp.rooms?.bots?.max ?? 0) || bots >= maxPlayers) return { error: 'bots' };
  // (each option a choice of its own, its default when none: rooms.options)
  const options = {};
  for (const o of mp.rooms?.options ?? []) {
    const wanted = body?.options?.[o.id] ?? o.default;
    if (!o.choices.some((c) => c.id === wanted)) return { error: 'options' };
    options[o.id] = wanted;
  }
  return { room: { name, map, maxPlayers, bots, options } };
}

/** The server commands of a room's chosen options (an option whose bots: true goes only with bots). */
export const roomOptionCommands = (mp, room) => (mp.rooms?.options ?? [])
  .filter((o) => !o.bots || room.bots > 0)
  .flatMap((o) => o.choices.find((c) => c.id === room.options?.[o.id])?.commands ?? []);

/** A map's picture for the lobby (multiplayer.mapImage, a file of the game folder: the game's own overview), or null. */
export function mapImageFile(manifest, map) {
  const mp = manifest?.goldsrc?.multiplayer;
  if (!mp?.mapImage || !MAP.test(map ?? '')) return null;
  return resolveGameFile(manifest, `${manifest.goldsrc.gameDir}/${mp.mapImage.replaceAll('{map}', map)}`);
}

/** The answer of a dedicated server to `info 49` (its name, map, clients, maximum), or null. */
export function parseServerInfo(bytes) {
  const text = Buffer.from(bytes).toString('latin1');
  if (!text.startsWith('\xff\xff\xff\xffinfo\n\\')) return null;
  const parts = text.slice(10).split('\\'), info = {};
  for (let i = 0; i + 1 < parts.length; i += 2) info[parts[i]] = parts[i + 1];
  const players = Number(info.numcl), max = Number(info.maxcl);
  return info.map && Number.isFinite(players) && Number.isFinite(max) ? { name: info.host ?? '', map: info.map, players, max } : null;
}

/** The modes a version offers, in the page's order. */
export const goldsrcModes = (g) => [...(g?.solo ? ['solo'] : []), ...(g?.multiplayer ? ['multiplayer'] : [])];

/** A file of an installed engine release (no traversal, no symlink leaving the release), or null. */
export function engineFile(enginesDir, release, rel) {
  if (!ID.test(release ?? '') || !safePath(rel)) return null;
  try {
    const root = fs.realpathSync(path.join(enginesDir, release)), file = fs.realpathSync(path.join(root, rel));
    return file.startsWith(root + path.sep) && fs.statSync(file).isFile() ? file : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

/** The engine release and every module the version names are installed. */
export function goldsrcInstalled(manifest, enginesDir) {
  const g = manifest.goldsrc;
  return !!engineFile(enginesDir, g.engine, 'release.json') && ['engine/index.js', 'engine/xash.wasm', ...Object.values(g.modules), ...goldsrcExtras(g)].every((f) => engineFile(enginesDir, g.engine, f));
}

/**
 * The engine release's files a GoldSrc page loads at its start (src/ports/goldsrc/play.js: the engine's module graph,
 * its WebAssembly, the renderer, the menu, the game modules and the extras), release-relative: those installed.
 */
export function goldsrcEngineFiles(manifest, enginesDir) {
  const g = manifest.goldsrc;
  const js = ['index.js', 'constants.js', 'xash3d.js', 'net/index.js', 'net/net.js', 'net/emNet.js', 'generated/xash.js', 'utils/index.js', 'utils/queue.js', 'utils/rb.js'].map((f) => 'engine/' + f);
  const files = [...js, 'engine/xash.wasm', 'engine/filesystem_stdio.wasm', g.modules.menu ?? 'engine/libmenu.wasm', g.modules.client, g.modules.server, 'engine/libref_webgl2.wasm', ...goldsrcExtras(g)];
  return [...new Set(files)].filter((f) => typeof f === 'string' && engineFile(enginesDir, g.engine, f));
}

/** The engine's ES module graph, a directory of the release: addressed as one tree (engine-content.js). */
export const GOLDSRC_MODULE_TREE = 'engine/';

/**
 * Every engine release file a GoldSrc page may load (release-relative, installed): those of its start
 * (goldsrcEngineFiles) and the archives of each of its languages (goldsrc.languages.<code>.extras).
 */
export function goldsrcPageFiles(manifest, enginesDir) {
  const g = manifest.goldsrc;
  const own = Object.values(g.languages ?? {}).flatMap((l) => (Array.isArray(l?.extras) ? l.extras : []));
  return [...new Set([...goldsrcEngineFiles(manifest, enginesDir), ...own.filter((f) => typeof f === 'string' && engineFile(enginesDir, g.engine, f))])];
}

/**
 * What the version's game server precaches at every map's load without the map naming it — its clients load it too —,
 * as its engine release declares (release.json `mapPrecache`, tools/goldsrc/release-gamefiles.py: a build's generated
 * assets its game DLL precaches), relative to the game folder: the page announces them with each map it loads
 * (src/ports/goldsrc/bsp-reads.js mapReads). [] for a release that declares none, or a malformed list.
 */
export function goldsrcMapPrecache(manifest, enginesDir) {
  const f = engineFile(enginesDir, manifest.goldsrc?.engine, 'release.json');
  try {
    const list = f ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')).mapPrecache : undefined;
    return Array.isArray(list) && list.every(safePath) ? list : [];
  } catch { return []; }
}

/** The browser launch page of a port. */
export const portLaunchUrl = (name, manifest) => `/ports/${manifest.runtime}/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/`;

/**
 * The version's files as one directory for the native dedicated server (it reads a single directory): `dest` is
 * rebuilt with a symbolic link per file, version files replacing same-named base files whatever their case, as the page
 * sees them. Returns the number of files linked.
 */
export function linkGameLayers(manifest, dest) {
  fs.rmSync(dest, { recursive: true, force: true });
  let count = 0;
  const walk = (dirs, out) => {
    fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
    const entries = new Map();
    for (const dir of dirs) {
      let list; try { list = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { continue; }
      for (const ent of list) {
        const key = ent.name.toLowerCase(), prev = entries.get(key), p = path.join(dir, ent.name);
        if (ent.isDirectory()) { if (!prev) entries.set(key, { name: ent.name, dirs: [p] }); else prev.dirs?.push(p); }
        else if (ent.isFile() && !prev) entries.set(key, { name: ent.name, file: p });
      }
    }
    for (const e of entries.values()) {
      if (e.dirs) walk(e.dirs, path.join(out, e.name));
      else { fs.symlinkSync(e.file, path.join(out, e.name)); count++; }
    }
  };
  walk(gameLayers(manifest), dest);
  return count;
}

/**
 * The rooms of a version (GET /api/rooms/<manifest>: its servers, maps and limits; POST: a room created, checked here
 * first, its answer carrying the room's key; DELETE /api/rooms/<manifest>/<index> { key }: a created room closed by
 * whoever holds its key), asked of its server manager on 127.0.0.1:<goldsrc.multiplayer.port> over TCP
 * (tools/goldsrc/server.mjs). A creation or a closing needs the page's origin; an address has one creation in flight
 * at a time (30 a minute in all). `handle(req, res, url)` answers or returns false.
 */
export function roomsApi({ getManifest, request = managerRequest, now = () => Date.now(), identify = () => undefined }) {
  // (per address, the creation it has in flight — one at a time; every creation of the last minute, all addresses: a
  // flood guard. No delay between one's creations: one live room each is the manager's rule)
  const inFlight = new Set(), recent = [], PER_MINUTE = 30;
  const handle = (req, res, url) => {
    const m = /^\/api\/rooms\/([^/]+)(?:\/(\d{1,2}))?$/.exec(url.pathname);
    if (!m) return false;
    const send = (status, body) => { res.writeHead(status, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' }); res.end(JSON.stringify(body)); };
    const man = getManifest(decodeURIComponent(m[1])), mp = man?.runtime === 'goldsrc' ? man.goldsrc?.multiplayer : null;
    if (!mp) { send(404, { error: 'none' }); return true; }
    if (m[2] !== undefined) {
      // (a room closed: its key, checked by the manager)
      if (req.method !== 'DELETE') { send(405, { error: 'method' }); return true; }
      if (!sameOrigin(req) || !mp.rooms) { send(403, { error: 'forbidden' }); return true; }
      let body = '';
      req.on('data', (d) => { body += d; if (body.length > 512) req.destroy(); });
      req.on('end', () => {
        let key; try { key = JSON.parse(body)?.key; } catch { send(400, { error: 'json' }); return; }
        if (typeof key !== 'string' || !/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(key)) { send(403, { error: 'forbidden' }); return; }
        request(mp.port, 'DELETE', { key }, `/rooms/${Number(m[2])}`).then(([status, out]) => send(status, out), () => send(503, { error: 'offline' }));
      });
      return true;
    }
    if (req.method === 'GET') {
      // (the options' choices for the page: ids and labels, not their commands; the maps' groups)
      const options = (mp.rooms?.options ?? []).map((o) => ({ id: o.id, label: o.label, default: o.default, bots: !!o.bots, show: !!o.show, choices: o.choices.map((c) => ({ id: c.id, label: c.label })) }));
      const mapGroups = mapGroupsFor(mp);
      request(mp.port, 'GET', null).then(([, body]) => send(200, { ...body, options, mapGroups, mapImages: !!mp.mapImage, creatable: !!mp.rooms }), () => send(200, { rooms: [], maps: [], options, mapGroups, slots: 0, offline: true, creatable: false }));
      return true;
    }
    if (req.method !== 'POST') { send(405, { error: 'method' }); return true; }
    if (!sameOrigin(req) || !mp.rooms) { send(403, { error: 'forbidden' }); return true; }
    // (on a server with accounts, a room is created by a signed-in player: identify() null)
    if (identify(req) === null) { send(401, { error: 'signin' }); return true; }
    const who = clientAddress(req), t = now();
    while (recent.length && t - recent[0] > 60000) recent.shift();
    if (inFlight.has(who) || recent.length >= PER_MINUTE) { send(429, { error: 'wait' }); return true; }
    // (the slot taken at once: requests sent together cannot all pass the check)
    inFlight.add(who); recent.push(t);
    let done = false;
    const finish = () => { if (!done) { done = true; inFlight.delete(who); } };
    const release = () => { finish(); const i = recent.indexOf(t); if (i >= 0) recent.splice(i, 1); };
    res.on('close', finish);
    let body = '';
    req.on('data', (d) => { body += d; if (body.length > 2048) { release(); req.destroy(); } });
    req.on('end', () => {
      let wanted; try { wanted = JSON.parse(body); } catch { release(); send(400, { error: 'json' }); return; }
      const checked = roomRequest(wanted, mp, [wanted?.map].filter((x) => typeof x === 'string')); // (the map is the manager's to check)
      if (checked.error && checked.error !== 'map') { release(); send(400, { error: checked.error }); return; }
      // (`by`: one live room per address, the manager's to keep)
      request(mp.port, 'POST', { name: wanted.name, map: wanted.map, maxPlayers: wanted.maxPlayers, bots: wanted.bots ?? 0, options: wanted.options ?? {}, by: who })
        .then(([status, out]) => { if (status !== 201) release(); send(status, out); }, () => { release(); send(503, { error: 'offline' }); });
    });
    return true;
  };
  return { handle };
}

/** An HTTP request to a version's server manager: [status, json]. */
export function managerRequest(port, method, body, where = '/rooms') {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const data = body ? Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(body)) : null; // (its length given: Node sends a DELETE's body unframed otherwise)
    const req = http.request({ host: '127.0.0.1', port, path: where, method, timeout: method === 'POST' ? 30000 : 2000, headers: data ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Content-Length': data.length } : {} }, (res) => {
      let text = ''; res.on('data', (d) => { text += d; }); res.on('end', () => { try { resolve([res.statusCode, JSON.parse(text)]); } catch (error) { reject(error); } });
    });
    req.on('timeout', () => req.destroy(new Error('timeout'))); req.on('error', reject);
    req.end(data ?? undefined);
  });
}

/**
 * Multiplayer relay: a WebSocket upgrade on /api/udp/<manifest> becomes UDP sockets to the version's dedicated servers
 * on 127.0.0.1 — never another destination. Without `?rooms`, one socket to its permanent server
 * (goldsrc.multiplayer.port). With `?rooms` (the page's own), each message carries the room it goes to or comes from in
 * its first byte (255: to every room, the game's LAN search), each room its own socket. Same-origin pages only (a page
 * elsewhere cannot use this server as a relay), at most `maxClients` at once, idle connections closed after two
 * minutes. `accept(req, socket)` completes the WebSocket handshake and returns a peer (lan.js).
 */
export function udpRelay({ getManifest, accept, identify = () => undefined, maxClients = 64, log = () => {} }) {
  const clients = new Set();
  let serial = 0;
  const handle = (req, socket, url) => {
    const m = /^\/api\/udp\/([^/]+)$/.exec(url.pathname);
    if (!m) return false;
    const man = getManifest(decodeURIComponent(m[1])), mp = man?.runtime === 'goldsrc' ? man.goldsrc?.multiplayer : null;
    // (the refusal, then the socket closed for good: a client keeping its side open would hold it forever)
    // (on a server with accounts, a signed-in player only: identify() null)
    if (!mp || !sameOrigin(req) || clients.size >= maxClients || identify(req) === null) { socket.end('HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n', () => socket.destroy()); return true; }
    const tagged = url.searchParams.has('rooms'), count = 1 + roomSlots(mp);
    // (each player its own loopback address: the engine limits queries and connections per address — one for all
    // would let one player's queries starve everyone's, the manager's included; 127.64.0.0/16, never 127.0.0.1)
    const n = serial++ % 65000 + 1, address = `127.64.${n >> 8}.${n & 255}`;
    // (a budget of packets a second: a game sends some tens; the LAN search, every room at once, a few)
    const budget = { at: Date.now(), packets: 0, searches: 0 };
    const allowed = (search) => {
      const t = Date.now(); if (t - budget.at >= 1000) { budget.at = t; budget.packets = 0; budget.searches = 0; }
      if (++budget.packets > 500) return false;
      return !search || ++budget.searches <= 4;
    };
    /** @type {Map<number, { udp: any, ready: boolean, pending: Buffer[] }>} */
    const sockets = new Map();
    let closed = false, peer = null;
    const open = (index) => {
      let s = sockets.get(index);
      if (s) return s;
      const udp = dgram.createSocket('udp4');
      s = { udp, ready: false, pending: [] }; sockets.set(index, s);
      // (a room that is not running refuses its packets: that socket goes, the others stay)
      udp.on('error', (e) => { if (index === 0 && !tagged) { log(`udp relay ${m[1]}: ${e.message}`); peer?.close(); } else { sockets.delete(index); try { udp.close(); } catch { /* closed */ } } });
      udp.on('message', (bytes) => {
        if (socket.writableLength > 1024 * 1024) { peer?.close(); return; }
        peer?.send(tagged ? Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([index]), bytes]) : bytes);
      });
      udp.bind(0, address, () => udp.connect(roomPort(mp, index), '127.0.0.1', () => { if (closed) return; s.ready = true; for (const p of s.pending.splice(0)) udp.send(p); }));
      return s;
    };
    const send = (index, msg) => {
      const s = open(index);
      if (s.ready) s.udp.send(msg); else if (s.pending.length < 32) s.pending.push(msg); else peer?.close();
    };
    peer = accept(req, socket, (msg, text) => {
      if (text) return;
      if (!tagged) { if (allowed(false)) send(0, msg); return; }
      if (msg.length < 2) return;
      const index = msg[0], data = msg.subarray(1);
      if (!allowed(index === 255)) return;
      if (index === 255) { for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) send(i, data); } else if (index < count) send(index, data);
    }, () => { closed = true; clients.delete(peer); for (const s of sockets.values()) { try { s.udp.close(); } catch { /* not bound */ } } });
    if (!peer) return true;
    clients.add(peer);
    socket.setTimeout(120000, () => peer.close());
    if (!tagged) open(0);
    return true;
  };
  return { handle, clients };
}
```

`src/host/google-signin.js`:

```js
// Signing in to the Orthros account with Google: OpenID Connect, authorization code flow with PKCE, all on the server
// (no Google script in the pages — they open a small window on /api/account/google/start). The routes, accounts and
// sessions are in accounts.js; here: the client's settings, Google's addresses, the code exchange, the ID token's
// checks, the username offered to a new player and the small pages the window shows.
// The client: <accounts dir>/google.json, { "clientId": "…", "clientSecret": "…" } — a "Web application" OAuth client
// of the Google Cloud console whose redirect URIs are <public origin>/api/account/google/callback, one for each name the
// site is served under (a front proxy's: accounts.js forwardedOrigin). Without it, no button.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

export const GOOGLE = {
  auth: 'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth',
  token: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
  issuers: ['https://accounts.google.com', 'accounts.google.com'],
};

/**
 * The Google client of an accounts folder. `override`: settings given directly ({ clientId, clientSecret, auth, token,
 * fetch } — the tests' fake Google); otherwise google.json, read again when it changes (dropped in without a restart).
 */
export function googleClient(dir, override = null) {
  let cached = null, stamp = null;
  const settings = () => {
    if (override) return override;
    const file = path.join(dir, 'google.json');
    let st; try { st = fs.statSync(file); } catch { cached = null; stamp = null; return null; }
    if (stamp !== st.mtimeMs) {
      stamp = st.mtimeMs; cached = null;
      try {
        const c = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
        if (typeof c?.clientId === 'string' && c.clientId && typeof c.clientSecret === 'string' && c.clientSecret) cached = { clientId: c.clientId, clientSecret: c.clientSecret };
        else console.error(`${file}: clientId and clientSecret expected`);
      } catch (e) { console.error(`${file}: ${e.message}`); }
    }
    return cached;
  };
  return {
    enabled: () => !!settings(),
    /** Google's sign-in page for this flow. */
    authUrl({ state, nonce, challenge, redirectUri, lang }) {
      const c = settings();
      const q = new URLSearchParams({ client_id: c.clientId, redirect_uri: redirectUri, response_type: 'code', scope: 'openid email profile',
        state, nonce, code_challenge: challenge, code_challenge_method: 'S256', prompt: 'select_account', hl: lang === 'fr' ? 'fr' : 'en' });
      return `${c.auth ?? GOOGLE.auth}?${q}`;
    },
    /**
     * The code exchanged for the player's identity: the ID token's claims ({ sub, email, email_verified, name, … }), checked
     * (issuer, audience, expiry, nonce). It comes straight from Google's token endpoint over TLS, which stands for its
     * signature (OpenID Connect Core 3.1.3.7).
     */
    async exchange({ code, verifier, redirectUri, nonce }) {
      const c = settings(); if (!c) throw new Error('Google sign-in is not configured');
      const res = await (c.fetch ?? fetch)(c.token ?? GOOGLE.token, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
        body: new URLSearchParams({ code, client_id: c.clientId, client_secret: c.clientSecret, redirect_uri: redirectUri, grant_type: 'authorization_code', code_verifier: verifier }),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) });
      const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!res.ok || typeof body.id_token !== 'string') throw new Error(`token endpoint: ${res.status} ${body.error ?? ''}`.trim());
      const parts = body.id_token.split('.');
      if (parts.length !== 3) throw new Error('ID token: not a JWT');
      let claims; try { claims = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(parts[1], 'base64url').toString('utf8')); } catch { throw new Error('ID token: unreadable'); }
      const now = Date.now() / 1000;
      const aud = Array.isArray(claims.aud) ? claims.aud : [claims.aud];
      if (!GOOGLE.issuers.includes(claims.iss)) throw new Error('ID token: issuer');
      if (!aud.includes(c.clientId) || (aud.length > 1 && claims.azp !== c.clientId)) throw new Error('ID token: audience');
      if (typeof claims.exp !== 'number' || claims.exp < now - 60) throw new Error('ID token: expired');
      if (claims.nonce !== nonce) throw new Error('ID token: nonce');
      if (typeof claims.sub !== 'string' || !claims.sub || claims.sub.length > 255) throw new Error('ID token: subject');
      return claims;
    },
  };
}

/** A username for a new player, from their Google name or address, free on this server (`taken(name)`). */
export function suggestUsername(claims, taken) {
  const clean = (s) => String(s ?? '').normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '.').replace(/[^a-z0-9._-]/g, '').replace(/^[._-]+/, '').slice(0, 24);
  const email = typeof claims.email === 'string' ? claims.email.split('@')[0].split('+')[0] : '';
  const base = [clean(email), clean(claims.given_name), clean(claims.name)].find((s) => s.length >= 3) ?? 'joueur';
  if (!taken(base)) return base;
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    const name = `${base.slice(0, 24)}${Math.floor(10 + Math.random() * (i < 20 ? 90 : 9990))}`;
    if (!taken(name)) return name;
  }
  return `joueur${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
}
```

```js
// The page and its game worker share these: the control words and the input ring in SharedArrayBuffers, the input
// events' encoding, the audio ring's size and rate. Their own module, without the host's graph (browser-host.js,
// frame accounting, PNG): the page (src/host/web/main.js) imports them at its first load, home included.
export const CTL = { IN_HEAD: 0, IN_TAIL: 1, WAKE: 2, STOP: 3, AUDIO_WRITE: 4, AUDIO_READ: 5, AUDIO_UNDERRUNS: 6, POINTER_LOCK: 7, FOCUS: 8, SIZE: 64 };
export const IN_RING = 4096; // int32 slots (4 per event)
// (MOUSEREL: a captured mouse's motion — a, b the device counts (movementX/Y), c the cursor's motion in screen pixels
// packed as two int16 (y high), the type word's bits 8+ the page's sequence number of the move. A button event's `a`
// with BUTTON_AT_CURSOR: pressed where the guest cursor is — the captured mouse's position is the guest's)
export const EV = { MOUSEMOVE: 1, MOUSEDOWN: 2, MOUSEUP: 3, WHEEL: 4, KEYDOWN: 5, KEYUP: 6, CHAR: 7, FOCUS: 8, MOUSEREL: 9 };
export const BUTTON_AT_CURSOR = 0x100;
/**
 * One input ring entry as the window manager's event (user32.js inputEvent), or null.
 * @param {number} word the type word (type in bits 0-7, a sequence number above)
 */
export function decodeInput(word, a, b, c) {
  switch (word & 0xff) {
    case EV.MOUSEMOVE: return { type: 'mousemove', x: a, y: b, dx: (c << 16) >> 16, dy: c >> 16 };
    case EV.MOUSEREL: return { type: 'mousemove', rel: true, dx: a, dy: b, gdx: (c << 16) >> 16, gdy: c >> 16, seq: word >>> 8 };
    case EV.MOUSEDOWN: case EV.MOUSEUP: { const ev = { type: (word & 0xff) === EV.MOUSEDOWN ? 'mousedown' : 'mouseup', button: a & 0xff, x: b, y: c }; if (a & BUTTON_AT_CURSOR) ev.rel = true; return ev; }
    case EV.WHEEL: return { type: 'wheel', delta: a / 120, x: b, y: c };
    case EV.KEYDOWN: return { type: 'keydown', vk: a, scan: b & 0xff, extended: (b & 0x100) !== 0, repeat: c };
    case EV.KEYUP: return { type: 'keyup', vk: a, scan: b & 0xff, extended: (b & 0x100) !== 0 };
    case EV.CHAR: return { type: 'char', code: a };
    case EV.FOCUS: return { type: 'focus', focused: a !== 0 };
  }
  return null;
}
export const AUDIO_RING_FRAMES = 16384; // stereo frames
export const AUDIO_RATE = 44100;
```

```js
// Frame types of the virtual LAN (src/host/lan.js: the relay; src/win32/winsock.js: the emulated sockets; the page's
// worker: the link). Frame: type u8, source address (4 bytes a.b.c.d), source port (u16 big-endian), destination
// address, destination port, then the payload.
export const LAN = Object.freeze({ UDP: 1, SYN: 2, ACCEPT: 3, RST: 4, DATA: 5, FIN: 6, HEADER: 13 });
```

`src/host/lan.js`:

```js
// Virtual LAN (D061): every player of a game on this server is on one simulated local network. Each page's worker opens
// a WebSocket to /api/lan?room=<game>; the server gives it an address in 10.77.0.0/16 and relays the packets its
// emulated Winsock sends: UDP datagrams (to one address, or broadcast to every other member of the room) and the frames
// of emulated TCP connections (open, accepted, refused/reset, data, close), routed by destination address. The server
// sets the source address of every frame (no spoofing) and answers an open towards nobody with a reset.
//
// Frame (binary WebSocket message): type u8, source address (4 bytes, a.b.c.d), source port (u16, big-endian),
// destination address, destination port, payload. Control messages (text, JSON) from the server: {type:'hello', ip,
// peers, name} on joining (name: the player's Orthros account, the emulated machine's host name), {type:'peers', peers}
// when the room changes, {type:'refused', reason} before closing — on a server with accounts, only a signed-in player
// joins (the Orthros account is a player's only identity).
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { LAN } from './lan-proto.js';
export { LAN };
const MAX_FRAME = 256 * 1024;

/** A minimal RFC 6455 server side over the socket of an HTTP upgrade (text/binary messages, ping/pong, close). */
class WsPeer {
  constructor(socket, onMessage, onClose, log = () => {}, maxMessage = Infinity, onPong = null) {
    this.socket = socket; this.onPong = onPong; this.onMessage = onMessage; this.onClose = onClose; this.buf = Buffer.alloc(0); this.parts = []; this.closed = false; this.log = log;
    this.maxMessage = maxMessage; this.partBytes = 0; // (a message's frames so far: a fragmented message is capped as a whole)
    socket.on('data', (d) => { this.buf = this.buf.length ? Buffer.concat([this.buf, d]) : d; try { this.parse(); } catch (e) { this.why = `error: ${e.message}`; this.close(); } });
    socket.on('close', () => { this.why ??= 'connection closed'; this.finish(); }); socket.on('error', (e) => { this.why ??= `socket error: ${e.message}`; this.finish(); });
    // (an upgraded socket of the HTTP server stays half open when the page's side ends without a close message)
    socket.on('end', () => { this.why ??= 'connection ended'; this.close(); });
    socket.setNoDelay(true);
  }
  parse() {
    for (;;) {
      const b = this.buf; if (b.length < 2) return;
      const fin = (b[0] & 0x80) !== 0, op = b[0] & 15, masked = (b[1] & 0x80) !== 0;
      let len = b[1] & 127, o = 2;
      if (len === 126) { if (b.length < 4) return; len = b.readUInt16BE(2); o = 4; } else if (len === 127) { if (b.length < 10) return; len = Number(b.readBigUInt64BE(2)); o = 10; }
      if (len > MAX_FRAME) { this.why = `frame of ${len} bytes`; this.close(); return; }
      if (op < 8 && this.partBytes + len > this.maxMessage) { this.why = `message over ${this.maxMessage} bytes`; this.close(); return; }
      if (b.length < o + (masked ? 4 : 0) + len) return;
      const mask = masked ? b.subarray(o, o + 4) : null; o += masked ? 4 : 0;
      const data = Buffer.from(b.subarray(o, o + len)); if (mask) for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) data[i] ^= mask[i & 3];
      this.buf = b.subarray(o + len);
      if (op === 8) { this.why = `closed by the page (${data.length >= 2 ? data.readUInt16BE(0) : '-'})`; this.close(); return; }
      if (op === 9) { this.sendRaw(10, data); continue; }
      if (op === 10) { this.onPong?.(); continue; }
      if (op !== 0) this.op = op;
      this.parts.push(data); this.partBytes += len;
      if (fin) { const msg = this.parts.length === 1 ? this.parts[0] : Buffer.concat(this.parts); this.parts = []; this.partBytes = 0; this.onMessage(msg, this.op === 1); }
    }
  }
  sendRaw(op, data) {
    if (this.closed) return;
    const n = data.length, head = n < 126 ? Buffer.from([0x80 | op, n]) : n < 65536 ? Buffer.from([0x80 | op, 126, n >> 8, n & 255]) : (() => { const h = Buffer.alloc(10); h[0] = 0x80 | op; h[1] = 127; h.writeBigUInt64BE(BigInt(n), 2); return h; })();
    try { this.socket.write(Buffer.concat([head, data])); } catch (e) { this.why ??= `write: ${e.message}`; this.finish(); }
  }
  /** A ping frame: the page's browser answers it by itself (a pong: `onPong`), its timers throttled or not. */
  ping() { this.sendRaw(9, Buffer.alloc(0)); }
  send(msg) { if (typeof msg === 'string') this.sendRaw(1, Buffer.from(msg)); else this.sendRaw(2, msg); }
  close() { if (!this.closed) { try { this.sendRaw(8, Buffer.alloc(0)); } catch { /* gone */ } } this.finish(); try { this.socket.end(); } catch { /* gone */ } }
  finish() { if (this.closed) return; this.closed = true; this.onClose(); }
}

/**
 * Complete the WebSocket handshake of an HTTP upgrade: a peer, or null (the socket destroyed) when it is not one.
 * `maxMessage`: the largest message taken (all its frames together); a bigger one closes the connection. `onPong`: called
 * at each pong (the answer to the peer's ping()).
 */
export function acceptWebSocket(req, socket, onMessage, onClose, log, { maxMessage = Infinity, onPong = null } = {}) {
  const key = req.headers['sec-websocket-key'];
  if ((req.headers.upgrade ?? '').toLowerCase() !== 'websocket' || !key) { socket.destroy(); return null; }
  const accept = crypto.createHash('sha1').update(key + '258EAFA5-E914-47DA-95CA-C5AB0DC85B11').digest('base64');
  socket.write(`HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\nSec-WebSocket-Accept: ${accept}\r\n\r\n`);
  return new WsPeer(socket, onMessage, onClose, log, maxMessage, onPong);
}

/** A host name from an account name: what Windows allows in one (letters, digits, dash), 12 characters at most. */
export const lanName = (username) => String(username ?? '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9-]/g, '').slice(0, 12) || null;

/**
 * WebSocket upgrades on /api/lan: the virtual LAN of each game (room). handle() returns false for other paths.
 * `identify(req)`: the signed-in player ({ username }), null when none, undefined on a server without accounts.
 */
export function lanUpgrades(log = () => {}, { identify = () => undefined } = {}) {
  const rooms = new Map(); // room -> Map(ip string -> peer)
  const ipOf = (b, o) => `${b[o]}.${b[o + 1]}.${b[o + 2]}.${b[o + 3]}`;
  const handle = (req, socket, url) => {
    if (url.pathname !== '/api/lan') return false;
    if ((req.headers.upgrade ?? '').toLowerCase() !== 'websocket' || !req.headers['sec-websocket-key']) { socket.destroy(); return true; }
    const user = identify(req);
    if (user === null) {
      const ws = acceptWebSocket(req, socket, () => {}, () => {}, log);
      ws?.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'refused', reason: 'sign-in' })); ws?.close();
      return true;
    }
    const roomName = (url.searchParams.get('room') ?? 'default').slice(0, 64);
    const room = rooms.get(roomName) ?? new Map(); rooms.set(roomName, room);
    let n = 2; while (room.has(`10.77.${n >> 8}.${n & 255}`) || (n & 255) === 0 || (n & 255) === 255) n++;
    const ip = `10.77.${n >> 8}.${n & 255}`, ipBytes = ip.split('.').map(Number);
    const announce = () => { for (const p of room.values()) p.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'peers', peers: room.size })); };
    const peer = { ip, ws: null };
    peer.ws = acceptWebSocket(req, socket, (msg, text) => {
      if (text || msg.length < LAN.HEADER) return;
      msg[1] = ipBytes[0]; msg[2] = ipBytes[1]; msg[3] = ipBytes[2]; msg[4] = ipBytes[3]; // (the source is the sender)
      const dst = ipOf(msg, 7), type = msg[0];
      if (type === LAN.UDP && (dst === '255.255.255.255' || dst === '10.77.255.255')) { for (const p of room.values()) if (p !== peer) p.ws.send(msg); return; }
      const to = room.get(dst);
      if (to) { to.ws.send(msg); return; }
      if (type === LAN.UDP) return; // (a datagram to nobody: lost, as on a network)
      if (type === LAN.SYN) { // (nobody there: refused)
        const r = Buffer.from(msg.subarray(0, LAN.HEADER)); r[0] = LAN.RST;
        msg.copy(r, 1, 7, 13); msg.copy(r, 7, 1, 7);
        peer.ws.send(r);
      }
    }, () => { room.delete(ip); if (!room.size) rooms.delete(roomName); else announce(); log(`lan: ${ip} left ${roomName} (${peer.ws.why ?? '?'}; ${room.size} left)`); });
    room.set(ip, peer);
    peer.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'hello', ip, peers: room.size, name: lanName(user?.username) }));
    announce();
    log(`lan: ${ip} joined ${roomName} (${room.size} in the room)`);
    return true;
  };
  return { rooms, handle };
}
```
