```js
      : opts.snapshotJobs === true ? new SnapshotJobs({ root: ROOT, url: () => `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`, logDir: path.join(opts.learnDir, 'snapshots') })
        : opts.snapshotJobs;
  // operator-made sets (seedcanon-<manifest>.json, tools/profile-seed-make.mjs): offered first, whatever the sessions
  // report (a first launch's settings depend on the emulated machine's speed, so independent reports rarely agree);
  // read again when the file changes (written by the tool while this server runs)
  const canonCache = new Map(); // manifest -> { mtime, sets }
  const canonFor = (name, lang) => {
    if (!opts.learnDir) return null;
    const f = path.join(opts.learnDir, seedCanonFile(name));
    let mtime = 0; try { const st = fs.statSync(f); mtime = `${st.mtimeMs}:${st.size}:${st.ino}`; } catch { /* none */ }
    let c = canonCache.get(name);
    if (!c || c.mtime !== mtime) {
      let sets = [];
      if (mtime) { try { sets = canonSets(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8'))); } catch { /* damaged: none */ } }
      canonCache.set(name, c = { mtime, sets });
    }
    return c.sets.find((s) => s.lang === lang) ?? null;
  };
  const seedFor = (name, lang) => {
    const canon = canonFor(name, lang);
    if (canon) return { key: canon.key, files: canon.files.map(([p, d]) => ({ path: p, data: d })) };
    let best = null;
    for (const s of seedsOf(name).sets) if (s.lang === lang && s.sessions.length >= seedQuorum && (!best || s.sessions.length > best.sessions.length || (s.sessions.length === best.sessions.length && s.at > best.at))) best = s;
    return best ? { key: best.key, files: best.files.map(([p, d]) => ({ path: p, data: d })) } : { files: [] };
  };

  /**
   * Learned code heat, per manifest: the code ranges (module, offset, length) that ran in the sessions' translations
   * (their visit flags), posted by the worker; /api/heat/<manifest> returns them merged per module ({ module: [rva, len,
   * ...] }) for the JIT's region formation (src/cpu/jit/heat.js: a region leaves out the successors that never ran).
   * Kept in opts.learnDir/heat-<manifest>.json when set.
   */
  const heatLearned = new Map(); // manifest -> Map(module -> RangeHeat of offsets)
  const heatFile = (name) => opts.learnDir && path.join(opts.learnDir, `heat-${learnName(name)}.json`);
  const heatOf = (name) => {
    let m = heatLearned.get(name);
    if (!m) {
      m = new Map(); heatLearned.set(name, m);
      const f = heatFile(name);
      if (f) try { for (const [mod, list] of Object.entries(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')))) { const h = new RangeHeat(); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < list.length; i += 2) h.add(list[i], list[i] + list[i + 1]); h.merge(); m.set(mod, h); } } catch { /* none yet */ }
    }
    return m;
  };
  const heatJson = (name) => { const o = Object.create(null); for (const [mod, h] of heatOf(name)) { const p = h.pairs(), l = []; for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 2) l.push(p[i], p[i + 1] - p[i]); o[mod] = l; } return o; };
  let heatDirty = new Set(), heatTimer = null;
  // (bounds per manifest: modules, and merged ranges over all its modules — a client posting scattered ranges cannot grow
  // the file or the answers past ~HEAT_RANGES pairs)
  const HEAT_MODULES = 256, HEAT_RANGES = 400000;
  const learnHeat = (name, list) => {
    const m = heatOf(name);
    let total = 0; for (const h of m.values()) total += h.size;
    for (const e of Array.isArray(list) ? list : []) {
      if (total >= HEAT_RANGES) break;
      if (!Array.isArray(e) || typeof e[0] !== 'string' || e[0].length > 64 || !Number.isInteger(e[1]) || e[1] < 0 || e[1] >= 0x40000000 || !Number.isInteger(e[2]) || e[2] <= 0 || e[2] > 0x100000) continue;
      const mod = e[0].toLowerCase();
      let h = m.get(mod);
      if (!h) { if (m.size >= HEAT_MODULES) continue; h = new RangeHeat(); m.set(mod, h); }
      h.add(e[1], e[1] + e[2]); total++;
    }
    for (const h of m.values()) h.merge();
    if (heatFile(name)) {
      heatDirty.add(name);
      heatTimer ??= setTimeout(() => {
        heatTimer = null;
        for (const n of heatDirty) { const f = heatFile(n); try { fs.writeFileSync(f + '.tmp', JSON.stringify(heatJson(n))); fs.renameSync(f + '.tmp', f); } catch { /* next time */ } }
        heatDirty = new Set();
      }, opts.learnWriteMs ?? 20000);
      heatTimer.unref?.();
    }
  };

  /** compressed range transport totals (requests, bytes read, bytes sent, encoding time) */
  // (split by kind: `demand` the game's own reads (&s=), `bg` the background downloads (&p=1); `ms` the time from the
  // request to the last byte handed to the socket, simulated link included)
  // (testing: opts.netTrace, a file — one line per compressed range answered: start s, duration s, kind, file, range, bytes sent,
  // and how the units saw it: hit / raw / miss / none, pcm1 for an audio unit)
  const netTrace = opts.netTrace ? (line) => { try { fs.appendFileSync(opts.netTrace, line + '\n'); } catch { /* no trace */ } } : null;
  const netStats = { requests: 0, raw: 0, sent: 0, encodeMs: 0, cacheHits: 0, brHits: 0, joined: 0, demand: { requests: 0, sent: 0, ms: 0 }, want: { requests: 0, sent: 0, ms: 0, aborted: 0 }, places: { posts: 0, records: 0, dropped: 0, gets: 0, found: 0 }, bg: { requests: 0, sent: 0, ms: 0, aborted: 0 } };
  /** encoded ranges kept for the next players (key: file, mtime, range, encoding), least recently used first out */
  const encodedCache = new Map(); let encodedBytes = 0;
  const ENCODED_CACHE_MAX = opts.encodedCacheBytes ?? 256 * 1024 * 1024;
  /** ranges being encoded: key -> { joined: the requests of the same range waiting for it, job: its queued job, kind } */
  const encoding = new Map();
  /**
   * The ranges encoded on the fly, at most ENCODE_JOBS at once, the game's own reads (demand) before the background
   * ones: each takes a thread of libuv's pool (4) for its read and its compression, which the other requests' file
   * reads share — under 20 players ~120 compressions waited there at once, each with its range and its encoder's
   * state (the server's resident memory 180 MB -> 1.6 GB, measured), the game's reads behind the downloads. A request
   * whose client left before its turn is not encoded (`wanted` false: `drop` instead).
   */
  // (the pool's size less two, its other requests' reads; every third job a background one when both wait: the
  // downloads that make a game's next reads local go on under a busy server. Between the two, `want`: the ranges an
  // engine announced it reads next (&w=1, docs/slow-network.md "Announced reads") — its load waits for them, after the
  // game's reads of the moment)
  const ENCODE_JOBS = opts.encodeJobs ?? Math.max(2, (Number(process.env.UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE) || 4) - 2);
  const encodeQueue = { demand: [], want: [], bg: [] };
  let encodeRunning = 0, encodePicks = 0;
  const encodePump = () => {
    while (encodeRunning < ENCODE_JOBS) {
      const bgTurn = ++encodePicks % 3 === 0 && encodeQueue.bg.length > 0;
      const j = (bgTurn ? encodeQueue.bg.shift() : encodeQueue.demand.shift() ?? encodeQueue.want.shift() ?? encodeQueue.bg.shift()); if (!j) return;
      if (!j.wanted()) { j.drop(); continue; }
      encodeRunning++;
      let once = false;
      j.run(() => { if (once) return; once = true; encodeRunning--; encodePump(); });
    }
  };
  /** a job queued in `kind`'s queue (returned: a demand request joining it may move it to the demand queue) */
  const encodeSlot = (kind, wanted, run, drop) => { const j = { wanted, run, drop }; (encodeQueue[kind] ?? encodeQueue.demand).push(j); encodePump(); return j; };
  /** brotli's window for `n` bytes: the smallest that holds them (10..24 bits; the ring is 2^lgwin - 16) */
  const brWindow = (n) => { let w = 10; while (w < 24 && (1 << w) - 16 < n) w++; return w; };
  // (`light`: a light copy of `file` — resolveLightFile — its bytes instead of the file's)
  const sendRangeEncoded = (req, res, file, r, kind = 'demand', light = null) => {
    const tReq = performance.now();
    let st = light?.st; if (!st) try { st = fs.statSync(file); } catch { return send(res, 404, 'not found'); }
    const rm = /^(\d+)-(\d+)$/.exec(r);
    if (!rm) return send(res, 400, 'bad range');
    const start = Number(rm[1]), end = Math.min(Number(rm[2]), light ? light.copy.size : st.size);
    if (!(start < end) || end - start > 64 * 1024 * 1024) return send(res, 416, 'bad range');
    const accept = String(req.headers['accept-encoding'] ?? '');
    // (on the fly: zstd, else brotli at a quality that costs about gzip's time — Cloudflare forwards gzip and br only —,
    // else gzip)
    const br = /\bbr\b/.test(accept);
    let enc = zlib.zstdCompress && /\bzstd\b/.test(accept) ? 'zstd' : br ? 'br' : /\bgzip\b/.test(accept) ? 'gzip' : null;
    // (&pad=1: one byte (0) before the range — a page that reads it as text, the only synchronous binary read of a
    // window, x-user-defined, drops it; without it a range starting with a byte-order mark would be decoded as UTF-8/16)
    const pad = /[?&]pad=1(&|$)/.test(req.url) ? 1 : 0;
    const reply = (body, encoding) => {
      netStats.requests++; netStats.raw += end - start; netStats.sent += body.length;
      const k = netStats[kind]; k.requests++;
      let finished = false;
      res.on('finish', () => { finished = true; k.sent += body.length; k.ms += performance.now() - tReq; netTrace?.(`${(tReq / 1000).toFixed(1)} ${((performance.now() - tReq) / 1000).toFixed(2)} ${kind === 'bg' && /[?&]a=1/.test(req.url) ? 'ahead' : kind} ${path.basename(file)} ${start}-${end} ${body.length}${unitSeen ? ' ' + unitSeen : ''}${codec ? ' ' + codec : ''}`); });
      res.on('close', () => { if (!finished && k.aborted !== undefined) k.aborted++; });
      const h = headers({ 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream', 'Content-Length': body.length, 'X-Orthros-Raw': end - start });
      // (X-Orthros-Unit: how the precompressed units saw the request — hit, raw (kept as is), miss, or none: not a unit)
      if (unitSeen) h['X-Orthros-Unit'] = unitSeen;
      if (codec) h['X-Orthros-Codec'] = codec;
      if (encoding) h['Content-Encoding'] = encoding;
      const go = () => { if (!res.headersSent) res.writeHead(200, h); res.end(body); };
      // (simulated link: the headers after the round trip, the body once it crossed — the client's time to the first
      // byte is the round trip, as on a real connection)
      if (link) viaLink(res, body.length, go, () => { res.writeHead(200, h); res.flushHeaders(); }); else go();
    };
    // a unit made ahead (br-cache.js: a whole block or a single piece, brotli 11) when the request is one and takes br;
    // missed, it is asked for (made in the background) and this request goes the dynamic way
    const unit = brCache && br && !pad ? unitOf(start, end, light ? light.copy.size : st.size) : null;
    // (&pc=1: the page decodes the audio units — a PCM transport container, X-Orthros-Codec: pcm1, src/vfs/pcm-codec.js —;
    // one made is sent before the brotli unit, its bytes fewer)
    let codec = null, unitSeen = null;
    const pcm = unit && /[?&]pc=1(&|$)/.test(req.url) ? brCache.lookupPcm(file, st, light, unit) : null;
    if (pcm) {
      return fs.readFile(pcm.path, (err, body) => {
        if (!err && body.length === pcm.bytes) { netStats.pcmHits = (netStats.pcmHits ?? 0) + 1; codec = 'pcm1'; unitSeen = 'hit'; return reply(body, 'br'); }
        brCache.dropPcm(file, st, light, unit); brUnit();
      });
    }
    return brUnit();
    function brUnit() {
      const pre = unit && brCache.lookup(file, st, light, unit);
      unitSeen = brCache && br && !pad ? (unit ? (pre ? (pre.raw ? 'raw' : 'hit') : 'miss') : 'none') : null;
      if (unit) brCache.want(file, st, light, unit); // (made when missing — the unit, or its audio form)
      if (pre?.raw) enc = null; // (brotli saves too little there: as it is)
      else if (pre) {
        return fs.readFile(pre.path, (err, body) => {
          if (!err && body.length === pre.bytes) { netStats.brHits++; return reply(body, 'br'); }
          brCache.drop(file, st, light, unit); unitSeen = 'miss'; brCache.want(file, st, light, unit); dynamic();
        });
      }
      dynamic();
    }
    function dynamic() {
      const key = `${light ? LIGHT_DIR + '|' : ''}${file}|${st.mtimeMs}|${start}-${end}|${enc}|${pad}`;
      const hit = encodedCache.get(key);
      if (hit) { encodedCache.delete(key); encodedCache.set(key, hit); netStats.cacheHits++; return reply(hit.body, hit.encoding); }
      // (the same range being encoded for another player — a launch set's blocks, asked by every new one —: its answer)
      const waiting = encoding.get(key);
      if (waiting) {
        netStats.joined++;
        // (a game's read joining a background request still queued: the job moves to the demand queue — else the read
        // would wait behind the downloads; an announced one joining a download, to the want queue)
        const rank = { bg: 0, want: 1, demand: 2 };
        if (rank[kind] > rank[waiting.kind]) {
          const q = encodeQueue[waiting.kind], i = q.indexOf(waiting.job);
          if (i >= 0) { q.splice(i, 1); encodeQueue[kind].push(waiting.job); }
          waiting.kind = kind;
        }
        // (its res kept: the job is still wanted while any of its clients is)
        const cb = (err, entry) => (err ? send(res, 500, String(err)) : reply(entry.body, entry.encoding)); cb.res = res;
        waiting.joined.push(cb); return;
      }
      const read = (buf, done) => (light ? readLight(file, light.copy, start, end, buf, pad, done) : fs.open(file, 'r', (err, fd) => {
        if (err) return done(err);
        fs.read(fd, buf, pad, end - start, start, (err2, n) => { fs.close(fd, () => {}); done(err2 ?? (n === end - start ? null : new Error('short read'))); });
      }));
      if (!enc) { const buf = Buffer.alloc(end - start + pad); return read(buf, (err) => (err ? send(res, 500, String(err)) : reply(buf, null))); }
      const pending = { joined: [], job: null, kind }; encoding.set(key, pending);
      const finish = (err, entry) => { encoding.delete(key); if (err) send(res, 500, String(err)); else reply(entry.body, entry.encoding); for (const f of pending.joined) f(err, entry); };
      pending.job = encodeSlot(kind, () => !res.destroyed || pending.joined.some((f) => !f.res.destroyed), (release) => {
        const buf = Buffer.alloc(end - start + pad);
        read(buf, (err) => {
          if (err) { release(); return finish(err); }
          const t0 = performance.now();
          const done = (err3, out) => {
            release();
            netStats.encodeMs += performance.now() - t0;
            // (not worth it: sent as is — the encoded form is still cached, as the raw bytes)
            const entry = !err3 && out.length < buf.length * 0.92 ? { body: out, encoding: enc } : { body: buf, encoding: null };
            encodedCache.set(key, entry); encodedBytes += entry.body.length;
            for (const [k, v] of encodedCache) { if (encodedBytes <= ENCODED_CACHE_MAX) break; encodedCache.delete(k); encodedBytes -= v.body.length; }
            finish(null, entry);
          };
          if (enc === 'zstd') zlib.zstdCompress(buf, { params: { [zlib.constants.ZSTD_c_compressionLevel]: 3 } }, done);
          // (a window no larger than the range: brotli's encoder state is sized by it — 4 MiB rings for 64 KiB pieces)
          else if (enc === 'br') zlib.brotliCompress(buf, { params: { [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_QUALITY]: 5, [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_SIZE_HINT]: buf.length, [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_LGWIN]: brWindow(buf.length) } }, done);
          else zlib.gzip(buf, { level: 4 }, done);
        });
      }, () => finish(new Error('gone')));
    }
  };

  const accountApi = opts.accountsDir ? createAccountApi(opts.accountsDir, { publicOrigin: opts.accountOrigin, allowedGame: (game) => !!getManifest(game), ...(opts.accountMaxUserBytes ? { maxUserBytes: opts.accountMaxUserBytes } : {}), ...(opts.accountGoogle ? { google: opts.accountGoogle } : {}) }) : null;
  // (the Orthros account is a player's only identity: undefined on a server without accounts, null when nobody is signed in)
  const identify = (req) => (accountApi ? accountApi.session(req) ?? null : undefined);
  // the shared worlds of the versions whose manifest has an `mmo` entry (src/host/mmo.js): none without accounts
  const mmoDir = accountApi ? path.resolve(opts.mmoDir ?? path.join(opts.accountsDir, 'mmo')) : null;
  const mmo = mmoApi({ getManifest, identify, dir: mmoDir, log: opts.mmoLog ?? ((m) => console.log(m)), ...(opts.mmoNow ? { now: opts.mmoNow } : {}) });
  // Localized OpenMW masters need separate simulations, caches and save histories.
  // (`ok`: openmwInstalled's answers by version, kept for one answer — /api/manifests asks it of each version for each
  // of its languages)
  const openmwOk = (target, man, memo, ok) => {
    if (!ok) return openmwInstalled(man, enginesDir, memo);
    if (!ok.has(target)) ok.set(target, openmwInstalled(man, enginesDir, memo));
    return ok.get(target);
  };
  function portLanguages(man, id, memo = null, ok = null) {
    if (man.runtime !== 'openmw' || !man.openmw.languageVersions) return {};
    const languageLaunchUrls = {}, languageVersions = {};
    for (const [code, target] of Object.entries(man.openmw.languageVersions)) {
      const other = getManifest(target);
      if (other?.runtime === 'openmw' && other.gameId === man.gameId && other.languages?.includes(code) && openmwOk(target, other, memo, ok)) {
        languageLaunchUrls[code] = portLaunchUrl(target, other);
        if (target !== id) languageVersions[code] = target; // (the version a language runs: the home's card prepares and downloads it)
      }
    }
    // Keep the current language visible even while another localization is incomplete.
    for (const code of man.languages ?? []) languageLaunchUrls[code] ??= portLaunchUrl(id, man);
    return { languages: Object.keys(languageLaunchUrls), contentLanguages: man.languages ?? [], languageLaunchUrls, languageVersions };
  }
  const mapImages = new Map(); // (the lobby's map pictures, compressed: file|mtime -> { raw, gzip, zstd })
  const rooms = roomsApi({ getManifest, identify, ...(opts.roomsRequest ? { request: opts.roomsRequest } : {}) });
  const openmw = openmwProxy({ getManifest, session: accountApi?.session, ownsToken: accountApi?.ownsPortToken });
  const openmwAccounts = accountBridge({ accountsDir: opts.accountsDir, accountApi, getManifest });
  const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
    let url; try { url = new URL(req.url, 'http://x'); } catch { return send(res, 400, 'bad path'); }
    const p = requestPath(url.pathname);
    if (p === null) return send(res, 400, 'bad path');
    try {
      if (openmwAccounts.handle(req, res, url) || openmw.handle(req, res, url) || mmo.handle(req, res, url)) return;
      // (the multiplayer rooms of a browser port, from its server manager)
      if (p.startsWith('/api/rooms/') && rooms.handle(req, res, url)) return;
      // (a map's picture for the lobby: the game's own overview, multiplayer.mapImage)
      { const m = /^\/api\/map-image\/([^/]+)\/([^/]+)$/.exec(p);
        if (m) {
          const file = mapImageFile(getManifest(m[1]), m[2]); if (!file) return send(res, 404, 'no picture');
          // (compressed once, kept: an 8-bit bitmap of the game shrinks several times; the browser draws it)
          let st; try { st = fs.statSync(file); } catch { return send(res, 404, 'no picture'); }
          const key = `${file}|${st.mtimeMs}`; let packed = mapImages.get(key);
          if (!packed) { const raw = fs.readFileSync(file); packed = { raw, gzip: zlib.gzipSync(raw, { level: 9 }), zstd: zlib.zstdCompressSync?.(raw) ?? null }; mapImages.set(key, packed); if (mapImages.size > 200) mapImages.delete(mapImages.keys().next().value); }
          const accept = String(req.headers['accept-encoding'] ?? ''), enc = packed.zstd && /\bzstd\b/.test(accept) ? 'zstd' : /\bgzip\b/.test(accept) ? 'gzip' : null;
          const body = enc ? packed[enc] : packed.raw;
          res.writeHead(200, headers({ 'Content-Type': MIME[path.extname(file).toLowerCase()] ?? 'application/octet-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=86400', 'Vary': 'Accept-Encoding', 'Content-Length': body.length, ...(enc ? { 'Content-Encoding': enc } : {}) }));
          return res.end(req.method === 'HEAD' ? undefined : body);
        } }
      if (p === '/api/account' || p.startsWith('/api/account/') || p === '/api/cloud' || p.startsWith('/api/cloud/')) {
        if (!accountApi) return send(res, 503, 'accounts unavailable');
        accountApi(req, res).catch((e) => { console.error('account API:', e); if (!res.headersSent) send(res, e.status ?? 500, 'account API error'); else res.destroy(); });
        return;
      }
      if (p === '/api/config') return send(res, 200, JSON.stringify({ version: buildVersion(), defaultManifest: opts.defaultManifest ?? null, telemetry: !!opts.telemetryDir, accounts: !!accountApi, google: !!accountApi?.googleEnabled(), mmo: !!mmoDir, encodedRanges: true, prefetch: true, programCache: true, regionCache: true, profileSeed: true }), { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
      // (the sources snapshots depend on, docs/snapshot.md: a page keeps its snapshot of a game only while they are the same)
      if (p === '/api/snapshot-sources') return send(res, 200, JSON.stringify(snapshotSourcesHash(ROOT)), { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache' });
      if (p === '/api/telemetry' && req.method === 'POST') {
        if (!opts.telemetryDir) return send(res, 404, 'telemetry off');
        let body = '', size = 0;
        req.on('data', (d) => { size += d.length; if (size <= 256 * 1024) body += d; });
        req.on('end', () => {
          if (size > 256 * 1024) return send(res, 413, 'too large');
          let rec; try { rec = JSON.parse(body); } catch { return send(res, 400, 'bad json'); }
          // (a passive session record, perf-record.js: its own size limit, checked and rebuilt from its known fields)
          if (rec?.event === 'perf') {
            if (size > PERF_MAX_BYTES) return send(res, 413, 'too large');
            const v = sanitizePerfRecord(rec); if (!v.ok) return send(res, 400, v.error);
            rec = v.rec;
          }
          const day = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
          fs.appendFile(path.join(opts.telemetryDir, `telemetry-${day}.jsonl`), JSON.stringify({ at: new Date().toISOString(), ...rec }) + '\n', () => {});
          send(res, 204, '');
        });
        return;
      }
      if (p === '/' || p === '/index.html') return sendHome(req, res);
      // (the privacy policy and the terms of use, at public addresses: the home screen, the account window and Google's sign-in link to them)
      if (p === '/privacy' || p === '/terms') return sendFile(req, res, path.join(ROOT, `src/host/web/${p.slice(1)}.html`), MIME['.html']);
      if (p === '/api/manifests') {
        refreshCatalog();
        const memo = listings, ok = new Map(); // (the folders' listings, the OpenMW versions' checks: shared by the versions)
        const out = [...manifests].map(([name, m]) => {
          let bytes = null;
          try { if (fs.existsSync(m.folder) && (!m.baseFolder || fs.existsSync(m.baseFolder))) bytes = treeBytes(gameTree(name, m)); } catch { /* folder missing */ }
          const runtime = runtimeOf(m), port = runtime !== 'win32';
          return { name, title: m.name ?? name, gameId: m.gameId ?? name, version: m.version ?? null,
            versionOrder: m.versionOrder ?? 0, languages: m.languages ?? [], ...portLanguages(m, name, memo, ok), runtime, exe: port ? null : m.exe,
            modes: runtime === 'goldsrc' ? goldsrcModes(m.goldsrc) : runtime === 'openmw' ? openmwModes(m.openmw) : runtime === 're3' ? re3Modes(m.re3) : null, launchUrl: port ? portLaunchUrl(name, m) : null,
            description: m.description ?? null, descriptionFr: m.descriptionFr ?? null,
            hidden: !!m.hidden, modified: !!m.modified, cover: !!coverFile(m), bytes, owners: (m.underlayOwners ?? []).map((o) => o.manifest), launch: bytes === null ? null : launchOf(name, m), saveKey: port ? m.saveKey ?? null : null, mmo: !!m.mmo,
            available: bytes !== null && (runtime !== 'goldsrc' || goldsrcInstalled(m, enginesDir)) && (runtime !== 'openmw' || openmwOk(name, m, memo, ok)) && (runtime !== 're3' || re3Installed(m, enginesDir)) };
        });
        return send(res, 200, JSON.stringify(out), { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
      }
      let m = /^\/api\/manifest\/([^/]+)$/.exec(p);
      if (m) {
        const man = getManifest(m[1]); if (!man) return send(res, 404, 'no such manifest');
        const launchUrl = runtimeOf(man) !== 'win32' ? portLaunchUrl(m[1], man) : undefined;
        // (an re3 port: the engine module its page imports, a path of its release — the manifest's, else the release's own)
        const re3 = runtimeOf(man) === 're3' ? { re3: { ...man.re3, module: re3Module(man, enginesDir) } } : {};
        // (a port's engine files by content: the page loads those, its release's own address for the others)
        const engineUrls = runtimeOf(man) !== 'win32' ? { engineUrls: engineUrlsOf(man) } : {};
        // (a GoldSrc port: what its game server precaches at every map's load, its release says — announced with the map)
        const mapPrecache = runtimeOf(man) === 'goldsrc' ? { mapPrecache: goldsrcMapPrecache(man, enginesDir) } : {};
        return send(res, 200, JSON.stringify({ ...man, folder: undefined, baseFolder: undefined, underlays: undefined, underlayOwners: undefined, owners: (man.underlayOwners ?? []).map((o) => o.manifest), overlays: undefined, dataMounts: undefined, saveDir: undefined, coverPath: undefined, launchUrl, ...re3, ...engineUrls, ...mapPrecache, ...portLanguages(man, m[1]) }), { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
      }
      m = /^\/api\/cover\/([^/]+)$/.exec(p);
      if (m) { // the game's own image named by its manifest (a splash screen), found whatever the case of its path
        const man = getManifest(m[1]), f = man && coverFile(man);
        if (!f) return send(res, 404, 'no cover');
        // (the home's: a light copy once made, light-covers.js — ?full: the image itself)
        const light = covers && !url.searchParams.has('full') ? covers.file(f) : null;
        if (light) return sendFile(req, res, light, 'image/webp', { 'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=86400' });
        const ext = path.extname(f).toLowerCase();
        // (the light copy still being made: the full image under the same address, not kept for a day by the browser or a proxy)
        const pending = !!covers && !url.searchParams.has('full') && covers.pending(f);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': MIME[ext]?.startsWith('image/') ? MIME[ext] : 'image/jpeg', 'Cache-Control': pending ? 'no-cache' : 'public, max-age=86400', 'Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy': 'same-origin',
          ...(ext === '.svg' ? { 'Content-Security-Policy': "default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; sandbox" } : {}) }); // (an SVG opened by itself runs nothing)
        pipeFile(res, f);
        return;
      }
      m = /^\/api\/tree\/([^/]+)$/.exec(p);
      if (m) { const man = getManifest(m[1]); if (!man) return send(res, 404, 'no such manifest'); return sendTree(req, res, m[1], man); }
      // compressed ranges: /gamez/<manifest>/<path>?r=<start>-<end> (end exclusive), the bytes encoded with zstd, brotli
      // or gzip when that saves enough (a unit made ahead at brotli 11 when there is one: br-cache.js) (Content-Encoding: the browser decodes before the page sees them), else sent as they are;
      // /gamez/<manifest>/.light/<path>: the file's light copy (light-copies.js), when the version has them
      m = /^\/gamez\/([^/]+)\/(.*)$/.exec(p);
      if (m) {
        const man = getManifest(m[1]); if (!man) return send(res, 404, 'no such manifest');
        const light = m[2].startsWith(LIGHT_DIR + '/') ? resolveLightFile(man, m[2], listings, { contentLight: engineContentLight(man) }) : null;
        const file = light ? light.file : resolveGameFile(man, m[2], listings); if (!file) return send(res, 404, 'not found');
        const r = url.searchParams.get('r') ?? '', rm = /^(\d+)-(\d+)$/.exec(r);
        // (&w=1: a range the engine announced it reads next — not a read, not learned; queued between the game's reads
        // and the background's, counted apart: netStats.want)
        const announced = !!url.searchParams.get('w');
        if (rm && !url.searchParams.get('p') && !announced) learnRead(m[1], m[2], Number(rm[1]), Number(rm[2]), url.searchParams.get('s'));
        return sendRangeEncoded(req, res, file, r, announced ? 'want' : url.searchParams.get('p') || url.searchParams.get('a') ? 'bg' : 'demand', light);
      }
      m = /^\/api\/regions\/([^/]+)$/.exec(p);
```

`src/host/sim-link.js`:

```js
// Simulated player connection for the test server (--net <ms>:<Mbit/s>): every answer waits a round trip, then its bytes
// cross ONE link whose rate the answers in transfer share equally (as TCP flows sharing a player's access link do). A
// model where each answer had the whole rate to itself would make parallel downloads look free and hide the one thing
// that matters over a real connection: a background download slows the game's own reads down while both are in flight.

export class SimLink {
  /**
   * @param {{ delayMs: number, bytesPerSec: number }} net
   * @param {{ now?: () => number, setTimer?: (fn: () => void, ms: number) => any, clearTimer?: (t: any) => void }} [clock]
   *   (a fake clock for the tests)
   */
  constructor(net, clock = {}) {
    this.delayMs = net.delayMs; this.rate = net.bytesPerSec / 1000; // bytes per ms
    this.now = clock.now ?? (() => performance.now());
    this.setTimer = clock.setTimer ?? ((fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms));
    this.clearTimer = clock.clearTimer ?? ((t) => clearTimeout(t));
    /** transfers on the link: { left (bytes), go } */
    this.active = [];
    this.last = this.now();
    this.timer = null;
  }

  /**
   * Send an answer of `bytes` bytes: `go()` runs when its last byte has crossed the link (a round trip, then its share
   * of the link); `onStart()` (optional) when its first byte arrives, after the round trip (the answer's headers: a
   * client sees its time to the first byte, as on a real link). Returns a cancel function (the client went away: the
   * transfer leaves the link).
   */
  send(bytes, go, onStart = null) {
    const t = { left: Math.max(1, bytes), go, cancelled: false };
    const startTimer = this.setTimer(() => { if (t.cancelled) return; onStart?.(); this.advance(); this.active.push(t); this.schedule(); }, this.delayMs);
    return () => {
      if (t.cancelled) return;
      t.cancelled = true; this.clearTimer(startTimer);
      const i = this.active.indexOf(t);
      if (i >= 0) { this.advance(); this.active.splice(i, 1); this.schedule(); }
    };
  }

  /** Bytes moved since the last event, shared equally by the transfers in flight. */
  advance() {
    const now = this.now(), n = this.active.length;
    if (n) { const share = (now - this.last) * this.rate / n; for (const t of this.active) t.left -= share; }
    this.last = now;
  }

  /** Finish the transfers done, then wake up when the next one will be. */
  schedule() {
    if (this.timer !== null) { this.clearTimer(this.timer); this.timer = null; }
    const done = this.active.filter((t) => t.left <= 0.5);
    if (done.length) this.active = this.active.filter((t) => t.left > 0.5);
    for (const t of done) { t.cancelled = true; t.go(); }
    if (!this.active.length) return;
    const min = Math.min(...this.active.map((t) => t.left));
    this.timer = this.setTimer(() => { this.timer = null; this.advance(); this.schedule(); }, Math.max(0, min * this.active.length / this.rate));
  }
}
```

`src/host/snapshot-sources.js`:

```js
// The sources a snapshot depends on (docs/snapshot.md, stage 2): a snapshot taken by one version of Orthros is restored
// only by a version whose state-owning code is the same. These are the modules the emulator worker loads — the machine,
// its API modules, the host set-up that builds its start — followed from their roots through their imports, except the
// executors and backends a restore rebuilds anyway: the JIT's translator (its tables are left out of a snapshot) and the
// GPU backends (a restored device is one they have never seen) —, and the game data's transport, the host side of the
// game files (the mounts are host objects, state:false in src/core/vm-snapshot.js, a file reopened by its path): how
// bytes come (http-backend.js, net-link.js, opfs-store.js, pcm-codec.js through them), when (game-data.js,
// launch-set.js, playable-watch.js) and when a snapshot is taken (snapshot-watch.js). Their frequent changes then keep
// snapshots valid — until 2026-10-28 48 of the 246 key changes of the month were data-only commits (the 4 of
// 10-27), each a cold start of 35-50 s to the menu for a returning player instead of a restore. Which files the guest
// sees and their sizes stay in the key through the version's tree itself (src/host/web/snapshot-key.js); game-tree.js
// (KEPT) holds only the tree's helpers. How the guest's stat/readdir/open are answered from that tree — case folding,
// a listing's order, a directory's date: HttpBackend.lookup/stat/readdir — is out with http-backend.js, pinned by a
// test instead (tests/snapshot-lint.test.js): a change there fails it and must change the key too (moved into a kept
// module), never ship as a data-only deploy. (Which part serves a file, game-data.js's partOf, is out as well: the
// owner's copy holds the same bytes.) tests/snapshot-lint.test.js also checks that no module left out registers snapshot
// state, and that the data modules are out.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';

export const SNAPSHOT_SOURCE_ROOTS = Object.freeze(['src/core/vm.js', 'src/host/web/worker.js']);
/** The game data's host side (see above): not followed. */
export const DATA_TRANSPORT = Object.freeze(['src/vfs/game-data.js', 'src/vfs/http-backend.js', 'src/vfs/launch-set.js', 'src/vfs/net-link.js',
  'src/vfs/opfs-store.js', 'src/vfs/playable-watch.js', 'src/host/snapshot-watch.js']);
/** Modules kept in the closure though reached only through the data transport: the game tree's helpers (game-tree.js). */
export const KEPT = Object.freeze(['src/vfs/game-tree.js']);
/**
 * Modules not followed: the JIT (but for the guest memory layout it shares with the API modules), the GPU backends and
 * the game data's transport.
 */
export const notSnapshotSource = (rel) => (/^src\/cpu\/jit\//.test(rel) && rel !== 'src/cpu/jit/runtime.js') || /^src\/gfx\/[^/]+$/.test(rel) || DATA_TRANSPORT.includes(rel);

const IMPORTS = [
  /\bimport\s+(?:[^'"`;]*?\s+from\s+)?['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g, // static imports, side-effect imports
  /\bexport\s+[^'"`;]*?\s+from\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g, // re-exports
  /\bimport\(\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]\s*\)/g, // dynamic imports of a literal
  /\bnew\s+URL\(\s*['"]([^'"]+\.m?js)['"]\s*,\s*import\.meta\.url\s*\)/g, // workers
];

/** Every module in the closure (paths relative to `root`, '/'-separated, sorted). */
export function snapshotSourceFiles(root) {
  const seen = new Set(), todo = [...SNAPSHOT_SOURCE_ROOTS, ...KEPT];
  while (todo.length) {
    const rel = todo.pop();
    if (seen.has(rel)) continue;
    seen.add(rel);
    let text; try { text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, rel), 'utf8'); } catch { continue; }
    for (const re of IMPORTS) for (const m of text.matchAll(re)) {
      const spec = m[1];
      if (!spec.startsWith('.') && !spec.startsWith('/src/')) continue; // (node: builtins: the Node host only)
      const dep = spec.startsWith('/') ? spec.slice(1) : path.posix.normalize(path.posix.join(path.posix.dirname(rel), spec));
      if (!notSnapshotSource(dep)) todo.push(dep);
    }
  }
  return [...seen].filter((f) => fs.existsSync(path.join(root, f))).sort();
}

let cache = null;
/** { hash, files }: SHA-256 of the closure's paths and contents (recomputed when one of them changed, at most every 10 s). */
export function snapshotSourcesHash(root) {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (cache?.root === root && now - cache.at < 10000) return cache.value;
  const files = snapshotSourceFiles(root);
  const stamp = files.map((f) => { try { const s = fs.statSync(path.join(root, f)); return `${f}:${s.size}:${s.mtimeMs}`; } catch { return f; } }).join('\n');
  if (cache?.root === root && cache.stamp === stamp) { cache.at = now; return cache.value; }
  const h = crypto.createHash('sha256');
  for (const f of files) { h.update(f + '\0'); h.update(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, f))); h.update('\0'); }
  const value = { hash: h.digest('hex').slice(0, 32), files: files.length };
  cache = { root, at: now, stamp, value };
  return value;
}
```

`src/host/snapshot-store.js`:

```js
// Shared snapshots (docs/snapshot.md, stage 3): for a player who has none of their own, the snapshot a new player's
// session took on this server — a headless browser started for it (tools/snapshot-publish.mjs, through the browser
// slots), which published it here. Per game version, language and snapshot key (the page's: Orthros' state-owning
// sources, the version's files, the options that change the machine), with the shared first-launch profile it started
// from (a new player's profile: profile-seed.js) — another one since makes it stale. Stored compressed (gzip, and brotli
// for the browsers that take it), the two most recent keys per game version and language.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { pipeline } from 'node:stream/promises';

const safe = (s) => s.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '_');
export const SNAPSHOT_KEY = /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/;

export class SnapshotStore {
  /** @param {string} dir where they are kept (created) */
  constructor(dir, { keep = 2 } = {}) { this.dir = dir; this.keep = keep; }
  base(name, lang, key) { return path.join(this.dir, safe(name), `${safe(lang || 'none')}-${key}`); }
  /** What is kept of one ({ bytes, seed, at, gz, br }), or null. */
  meta(name, lang, key) {
    try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(this.base(name, lang, key) + '.json', 'utf8')); } catch { return null; }
  }
  /**
   * Keep the snapshot in file `src` (moved away): compressed, its record written last (`extra`: what it applies to
   * besides its key — the first-launch profile it started from). Older keys of the same game version and language go.
   */
  async put(name, lang, key, src, extra = {}) {
    const base = this.base(name, lang, key);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(base), { recursive: true });
    fs.rmSync(base + '.json', { force: true });
    await pipeline(fs.createReadStream(src), zlib.createGzip({ level: 6 }), fs.createWriteStream(base + '.gz.tmp'));
    await pipeline(fs.createReadStream(src), zlib.createBrotliCompress({ params: { [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_QUALITY]: 5, [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_LGWIN]: 24 } }), fs.createWriteStream(base + '.br.tmp'));
    const bytes = fs.statSync(src).size;
    fs.renameSync(base + '.gz.tmp', base + '.gz'); fs.renameSync(base + '.br.tmp', base + '.br'); fs.rmSync(src, { force: true });
    const rec = { bytes, gz: fs.statSync(base + '.gz').size, br: fs.statSync(base + '.br').size, at: new Date().toISOString(), ...extra };
    fs.writeFileSync(base + '.json.tmp', JSON.stringify(rec)); fs.renameSync(base + '.json.tmp', base + '.json');
    this.prune(name, lang);
    return rec;
  }
  /** Only the `keep` most recent keys of a game version and language. */
  prune(name, lang) {
    const dir = path.join(this.dir, safe(name)), prefix = `${safe(lang || 'none')}-`;
    let recs; try { recs = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => f.startsWith(prefix) && f.endsWith('.json')); } catch { return; }
    const byAge = recs.map((f) => ({ f, t: fs.statSync(path.join(dir, f)).mtimeMs })).sort((a, b) => b.t - a.t);
    for (const { f } of byAge.slice(this.keep)) for (const ext of ['.json', '.gz', '.br']) fs.rmSync(path.join(dir, f.slice(0, -5) + ext), { force: true });
  }
  /** The file to send for an Accept-Encoding header: { file, encoding, size } (brotli when taken), or null. */
  open(name, lang, key, accept = '') {
    const m = this.meta(name, lang, key);
    if (!m) return null;
    const br = /\bbr\b/.test(accept), base = this.base(name, lang, key);
    return br ? { file: base + '.br', encoding: 'br', size: m.br, meta: m } : { file: base + '.gz', encoding: 'gzip', size: m.gz, meta: m };
  }
}

/**
 * The publishing sessions, one at a time: a headless browser opened on this server as a new player of a game version and
 * language (tools/snapshot-publish.mjs, through tools/with-browser-slot.sh: the project's browser budget and the load
 * limit), which posts each snapshot it keeps with its token. The same key is not tried again within `retryMs`.
 */
export class SnapshotJobs {
  constructor({ root, url, logDir, retryMs = 6 * 3600e3, timeoutS = 1500 }) {
    this.root = root; this.url = url; this.logDir = logDir; this.retryMs = retryMs; this.timeoutS = timeoutS;
    this.queue = []; this.running = null; this.tried = new Map(); this.tokens = new Map();
  }
  /** Queue a session for (game version, language, key) unless one ran or is waiting. */
  want(name, lang, key) {
    const id = `${name}|${lang}|${key}`, t = this.tried.get(id);
    if ((t && Date.now() - t < this.retryMs) || this.running?.id === id || this.queue.some((j) => j.id === id)) return false;
    this.queue.push({ id, name, lang, key }); this.next();
    return true;
  }
  /** The job a POST's token belongs to (it must name the same game version, language and key), or null. */
  job(token, name, lang, key) { const j = this.tokens.get(token); return j && j.name === name && j.lang === lang && j.key === key ? j : null; }
  next() {
    if (this.running || !this.queue.length) return;
    const j = this.running = this.queue.shift(), token = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    this.tried.set(j.id, Date.now()); this.tokens.set(token, j);
    fs.mkdirSync(this.logDir, { recursive: true });
    const log = fs.openSync(path.join(this.logDir, `publish-${safe(j.name)}-${safe(j.lang || 'none')}.log`), 'w');
    const args = ['node', 'tools/snapshot-publish.mjs', j.name, '--url', this.url(), '--lang', j.lang, '--key', j.key, '--token', token];
    const child = spawn('timeout', [String(this.timeoutS), path.join(this.root, 'tools/with-browser-slot.sh'), ...args], { cwd: this.root, stdio: ['ignore', log, log] });
    let ended = false;
    const done = () => { if (ended) return; ended = true; fs.closeSync(log); this.tokens.delete(token); this.running = null; this.next(); };
    child.on('exit', done); child.on('error', done);
  }
}

/**
 * The same requests kept in a file for a runner outside this server (tools/snapshot-jobs.mjs): a server that may not
 * start browsers itself — a sandboxed service, with no home nor the shared /tmp of the browser slots — only queues them,
 * each with its token. A request stays two hours (the runner's session posts meanwhile); the same key is not queued
 * again within `retryMs`.
 */
export class SnapshotQueue {
  constructor(file, { retryMs = 6 * 3600e3, ttlMs = 2 * 3600e3, max = 32 } = {}) {
    this.file = file; this.retryMs = retryMs; this.ttlMs = ttlMs; this.max = max;
    try { this.jobs = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')).jobs ?? []; } catch { this.jobs = []; }
  }
  save() {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(this.file), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(this.file + '.tmp', JSON.stringify({ v: 1, jobs: this.jobs })); fs.renameSync(this.file + '.tmp', this.file);
  }
  want(name, lang, key) {
    const now = Date.now();
    this.jobs = this.jobs.filter((j) => now - j.at < Math.max(this.ttlMs, this.retryMs));
    if (this.jobs.some((j) => j.name === name && j.lang === lang && j.key === key) || this.jobs.length >= this.max) return false;
    this.jobs.push({ name, lang, key, token: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex'), at: now });
    this.save();
    return true;
  }
  job(token, name, lang, key) {
    const j = this.jobs.find((x) => x.token === token);
    return j && j.name === name && j.lang === lang && j.key === key && Date.now() - j.at < this.ttlMs ? j : null;
  }
}
```

`src/host/snapshot-watch.js`:

```js
// When a session takes its automatic snapshot (docs/snapshot.md, stage 2): once the game has settled on a screen — it
// opened no file for a while as it went on presenting frames: a loading step is over — at the next quiet point of the
// machine. Again at each later settled stretch after more files were opened (an intro that streams its video settles
// too: the menu after it is a later point, more start-up work skipped), until the player's first click or key: the
// state from there holds their choices. A capture refused (a movie playing, a kind of state not supported yet) is tried
// again after the next settled stretch, a few times. A snapshot is kept once the session went on running after it (not
// the state of a launch about to fail) — if the profile is still as its machine saw it (the game may have written its
// settings just after); else dropped, and taken again later. A session restored from a snapshot goes on the same way.

export class SnapshotWatch {
  /**
   * @param {{ quietMs?: number, minFps?: number, tries?: number, keepMs?: number, keepFrames?: number }} [o]
   *   quietMs: no file opened for that long, with at least minFps frames per second meanwhile; keepMs / keepFrames: how
   *   long the session must go on after the capture for the snapshot to be kept
   */
  constructor({ quietMs = 4000, minFps = 5, tries = 4, keepMs = 20000, keepFrames = 100, opens = 0 } = {}) {
    this.quietMs = quietMs; this.minFps = minFps; this.left = tries; this.keepMs = keepMs; this.keepFrames = keepFrames;
    this.opens = -1; this.since = 0; this.frames = 0;
    this.base = opens; // (files opened when the machine was last as a snapshot has it: taken, or restored from)
    this.taken = null; // ({ at, frames, opens }: a capture waiting to be kept)
    this.last = false; // (the player acted: the capture waiting is the last one)
    this.done = false;
  }
  /** Each pump: true when a capture should be tried now (`opens`: files the game opened so far; `frames`: presented). */
  due(now, frames, opens) {
    if (this.done || this.last || this.taken) return false;
    if (opens !== this.opens) { this.opens = opens; this.since = now; this.frames = frames; return false; }
    return opens !== this.base && now - this.since >= this.quietMs && frames - this.frames >= (this.quietMs / 1000) * this.minFps;
  }
  /** The capture was tried: taken, or refused (another settled stretch first, while tries are left). */
  tried(ok, now, frames) {
    if (ok) { this.taken = { at: now, frames, opens: this.opens }; return; }
    if (--this.left <= 0) this.done = true;
    this.since = now; this.frames = frames;
  }
  /** Each pump after a capture: true when the session went on long enough for the snapshot to be kept (then kept / dropped). */
  ripe(now, frames) { return !!this.taken && !this.done && now - this.taken.at >= this.keepMs && frames - this.taken.frames >= this.keepFrames; }
  /** Kept: another one at a later settled stretch, after more files were opened. */
  kept() { this.base = this.taken.opens; this.taken = null; if (this.last) this.done = true; }
  /** Not kept (the profile changed meanwhile): another settled stretch, while tries are left. */
  dropped(now, frames) { this.taken = null; this.tried(false, now, frames); if (this.last) this.done = true; }
  /** The player clicked or pressed a key: no capture from now on (the one waiting may still be kept). */
  stop() { this.last = true; if (!this.taken) this.done = true; }
}
```

`src/host/web/account.js`:

```js
// The Orthros account: the only identity of a player, on the home screen and on every game page (Windows games,
// browser ports). Who is signed in, signing in / up / out, and the accounts API's messages in the page's language.
// (The API itself: src/host/accounts.js; it answers in French, translated here for the English pages.)

const ERR_EN = {
  'Origine refusée.': 'Origin refused.', 'Origine requise.': 'Origin required.', 'Trop de tentatives. Réessaie plus tard.': 'Too many attempts. Try again later.', 'Trop de tentatives.': 'Too many attempts.',
  'Identifiant : 3 à 32 caractères, lettres, chiffres, point, tiret ou souligné.': 'Username: 3 to 32 characters, letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.',
  'Le mot de passe doit contenir de 10 à 128 caractères.': 'The password must be 10 to 128 characters long.', 'Cet identifiant est déjà pris.': 'This username is already taken.',
  'Identifiant ou mot de passe incorrect.': 'Wrong username or password.', 'Connexion requise.': 'Sign-in required.', 'Le nouveau mot de passe doit contenir de 10 à 128 caractères.': 'The new password must be 10 to 128 characters long.',
  'Mot de passe actuel incorrect.': 'Current password is wrong.', 'Mot de passe incorrect.': 'Wrong password.', 'Introuvable.': 'Not found.', 'Jeu introuvable.': 'Game not found.', 'Sauvegarde introuvable.': 'Save not found.',
  'Trop d’envois. Réessaie dans une minute.': 'Too many uploads. Try again in a minute.', 'Version de départ invalide.': 'Invalid starting version.', 'Sauvegarde trop volumineuse.': 'Save too large.',
  'Fichier de sauvegarde invalide.': 'Invalid save file.', 'Contenu de sauvegarde invalide.': 'Invalid save content.', 'Une autre sauvegarde existe en ligne.': 'Another save exists online.',
  'Espace cloud plein (512 Mo). Supprime une ancienne copie en ligne.': 'Cloud space full (512 MB). Delete an old online copy.', 'L’espace cloud du site est plein.': 'The site’s cloud space is full.', 'Méthode refusée.': 'Method not allowed.',
  'Le compte actif a changé. Relance le jeu depuis ton compte.': 'The signed-in account changed. Start the game again from your account.',
  'Crée un compte Orthros ou connecte-toi pour jouer en multijoueur.': 'Create an Orthros account or sign in to play multiplayer.',
  'Saisis ton identifiant pour confirmer.': 'Type your username to confirm.', 'Connexion avec Google indisponible.': 'Google sign-in is unavailable.',
  'Définis d’abord un mot de passe : sans Google, ce sera ta seule façon de te connecter.': 'Set a password first: without Google, it will be your only way to sign in.',
};
/** A message of the accounts API in language `lang` (the API's own text is French). */
export const errorText = (message, lang) => (lang === 'fr' ? message : ERR_EN[message] ?? message);

/** An answer of the accounts API: its JSON, or an Error carrying its message (in `lang`) and HTTP status. */
export async function accountFetch(path, { method = 'GET', body, lang = 'en', headers = {} } = {}) {
  let response;
  try {
    response = await fetch(path, { method, credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', headers: body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...headers } : headers, body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined });
  } catch { const e = new Error(lang === 'fr' ? 'Erreur de connexion.' : 'Connection error.'); e.status = 0; throw e; }
  if (!response.ok) {
    let message = null; try { message = (await response.json()).error; } catch { /* not JSON */ }
    const e = new Error(errorText(message, lang) || (lang === 'fr' ? 'Erreur de connexion.' : 'Connection error.')); e.status = response.status; throw e;
  }
  return response.json();
}

let current = null, google = false;
const listeners = new Set();
/**
 * The server's accounts and who is signed in: { accounts: whether this server has accounts, google: whether it signs in
 * with Google, user: { username, google: address | true | null, password: whether one is set } | null }.
 * Asked once per page (`fresh`: asked again).
 */
export function accountState({ fresh = false } = {}) {
  if (!current || fresh) {
    current = (async () => {
      const config = await fetch('/api/config', { cache: 'no-store' }).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : {})).catch(() => ({}));
      if (!config.accounts) return { accounts: false, google: false, user: null };
      google = !!config.google;
      try { return { accounts: true, google, user: (await accountFetch('/api/account')).user ?? null }; } catch { return { accounts: true, google, user: null }; }
    })();
  }
  return current;
}
/** Told of every sign-in and sign-out made on this page: fn({ accounts, user }). Returns the unsubscribe. */
export function onAccountChange(fn) { listeners.add(fn); return () => listeners.delete(fn); }
function changed(user) {
  current = Promise.resolve({ accounts: true, google, user });
  for (const fn of listeners) { try { fn({ accounts: true, google, user }); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } }
  return user;
}
/** Sign in (`mode` 'login') or create the account ('register'); resolves to the user, rejects with a readable Error. */
export async function signIn(mode, username, password, lang = 'en') {
  const result = await accountFetch('/api/account/' + (mode === 'register' ? 'register' : 'login'), { method: 'POST', body: { username, password }, lang });
  return changed(result.user);
}
export async function signOut(lang = 'en') {
  await accountFetch('/api/account/logout', { method: 'POST', lang });
  changed(null);
}
/**
 * Sign in or create the account with Google (`link`: Google added to the signed-in account), in a small window: the page
 * keeps running, the window tells its outcome over a channel of the origin (its opener is cut off by the pages'
 * cross-origin isolation) and closes. A blocked window: the whole page goes to Google and comes back.
 * Resolves to the outcome: { result: 'signed-in' | 'linked' | 'cancelled' | 'taken' | 'hasOther' | 'failed' | …, ok, username? }
 * — never when the player just closes the window.
 */
export function googleSignIn(lang = 'en', { link = false } = {}) {
  const flow = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 12).padEnd(8, '0');
  const q = new URLSearchParams({ lang, flow, ...(link ? { link: '1' } : {}) });
  const w = 480, ht = 680, left = Math.max(0, screenX + (outerWidth - w) / 2), top = Math.max(0, screenY + (outerHeight - ht) / 2);
  const channel = new BroadcastChannel('orthros-account');
  const win = window.open(`/api/account/google/start?${q}&popup=1`, 'orthros-google', `popup,width=${w},height=${ht},left=${Math.round(left)},top=${Math.round(top)}`);
  if (!win) { channel.close(); location.assign(`/api/account/google/start?${q}&back=${encodeURIComponent(location.pathname + location.search)}`); return new Promise(() => {}); }
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    channel.onmessage = async (e) => {
      if (e.data?.type !== 'google' || e.data.flow !== flow) return;
      channel.close();
      if (e.data.ok) { const st = await accountState({ fresh: true }); changed(st.user); }
      resolve(e.data);
    };
  });
}
/** What a Google outcome says to the player, in `lang`. */
export function googleText(outcome, lang) {
  const fr = lang === 'fr';
  const T = { cancelled: fr ? 'Connexion avec Google annulée.' : 'Google sign-in cancelled.', taken: fr ? 'Ce compte Google est déjà lié à un autre compte Orthros.' : 'This Google account is already linked to another Orthros account.',
    hasOther: fr ? 'Ton compte Orthros est déjà lié à un autre compte Google.' : 'Your Orthros account is already linked to another Google account.',
```

`src/host/web/audio-worklet.js`:

```js
// AudioWorklet output. Two modes:
// - ring: stereo float frames produced by the game's worker (its DirectSound mixer) are pulled from a shared ring;
// - direct (once the worker sends the voice table and the guest memory, both shared): the DirectSound buffers are
//   mixed here, on the audio thread, straight from guest memory, following the play cursors the worker publishes
//   (dsound.js, VOICE_BASE): a busy game worker (loading, a long frame) no longer starves the output — like a sound
//   card reading its buffers by DMA while the program does something else.
const VOICE_BASE = 16, VOICE_INTS = 16, MAX_VOICES = 128; // (dsound.js: the same layout)

class OrthrosOutput extends AudioWorkletProcessor {
  constructor(o) {
    super();
    const p = o.processorOptions;
    this.ring = new Float32Array(p.audio);
    this.ctl = new Int32Array(p.ctl);
    this.frames = p.frames; this.W = p.write; this.R = p.read; this.U = p.underruns;
    this.direct = false;
    this.port.onmessage = (e) => {
      const m = e.data;
      if (m.type !== 'voices') return;
      this.u8 = new Uint8Array(m.memory); this.i16 = new Int16Array(m.memory); this.f32 = new Float32Array(m.memory);
      this.v = new Int32Array(m.voices); this.vf = new Float32Array(m.voices);
      this.pos = new Float64Array(MAX_VOICES); this.gens = new Int32Array(MAX_VOICES).fill(-1); this.done = new Uint8Array(MAX_VOICES);
      this.direct = true;
    };
  }
  process(inputs, outputs) {
    const out = outputs[0], l = out[0], r = out[1] ?? out[0];
    const n = l.length;
    if (this.direct) { this.mix(l, r, n); return true; }
    let rd = Atomics.load(this.ctl, this.R);
    const wr = Atomics.load(this.ctl, this.W);
    let avail = (wr - rd) | 0;
    if (avail < n) { if (wr !== 0) Atomics.add(this.ctl, this.U, 1); l.fill(0); r.fill(0); return true; } // (before the first write the game has no sound yet: not an underrun)
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const idx = ((rd + i) % this.frames) * 2; l[i] = this.ring[idx]; r[i] = this.ring[idx + 1]; }
    rd = (rd + n) | 0;
    Atomics.store(this.ctl, this.R, rd);
    return true;
  }
  mix(l, r, n) {
    l.fill(0); r.fill(0);
    const V = this.v;
    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_VOICES; i++) if (V[VOICE_BASE + i * VOICE_INTS] === 1) this.voice(i, l, r, n);
    let peak = this.vf[1];
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const a = Math.max(Math.abs(l[k]), Math.abs(r[k])); if (a > peak) peak = a; }
    this.vf[1] = peak;
    V[0] = (V[0] + n) | 0; // (frame counter: the worker publishes cursors with its value)
    V[2] = 1;
  }
  voice(i, l, r, n) {
    const V = this.v, o = VOICE_BASE + i * VOICE_INTS;
    const gen = Atomics.load(V, o + 1);
    const addr = V[o + 2], size = V[o + 3], align = V[o + 4], bits = V[o + 5], ch = V[o + 6], isF = V[o + 7], freq = V[o + 8], loop = V[o + 9];
    const gl = this.vf[o + 10], gr = this.vf[o + 11], cursor = V[o + 12], pub = V[o + 13];
    if (Atomics.load(V, o + 1) !== gen || !size || !align || !freq) return; // (being rewritten: next quantum)
    const total = Math.floor(size / align), step = freq / sampleRate;
    if (this.gens[i] !== gen) { this.gens[i] = gen; this.pos[i] = cursor / align; this.done[i] = 0; } // (started, moved: from the cursor)
    else {
      // follow the cursor when it was published recently (a worker that stalls publishes nothing: the mix goes on)
      const age = (V[0] - pub) | 0;
      if (age >= 0 && age < sampleRate * 0.2) {
        let expected = cursor / align + age * step;
        if (loop) expected %= total;
        let lag = expected - this.pos[i];
        if (loop) { lag = ((lag % total) + total) % total; if (lag > total / 2) lag -= total; }
        if (Math.abs(lag) > Math.min(freq * 0.08, total * 0.25)) { this.pos[i] = expected; this.done[i] = 0; } // (80 ms, a quarter of a short loop)
      }
    }
    if (this.done[i] || (gl === 0 && gr === 0 && !loop)) { if (!this.done[i]) this.pos[i] += n * step; return; }
    const bytes = bits >> 3, u8 = this.u8, i16 = this.i16, f32 = this.f32;
    const sample = (fi, c) => {
      const a = addr + fi * align + (ch === 1 ? 0 : c * bytes);
      return isF ? f32[a >> 2] : bits === 8 ? (u8[a] - 128) / 128 : i16[a >> 1] / 32768;
    };
    let frame = this.pos[i];
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      let fi = Math.floor(frame);
      if (fi >= total) { if (!loop) { this.done[i] = 1; break; } frame -= total; fi -= total; }
      const t = frame - fi, fj = fi + 1 < total ? fi + 1 : loop ? 0 : fi;
      const l0 = sample(fi, 0), l1 = sample(fj, 0), r0 = ch > 1 ? sample(fi, 1) : l0, r1 = ch > 1 ? sample(fj, 1) : l1;
      l[k] += (l0 + (l1 - l0) * t) * gl; r[k] += (r0 + (r1 - r0) * t) * gr;
      frame += step;
    }
    this.pos[i] = loop ? frame % total : frame;
  }
}
registerProcessor('orthros-output', OrthrosOutput);
```

```js
// The bench suite (docs/real-machine-bench.md, "The bench suite"): `/?benchsuite=<suite>` measures every game of the
// suite in a row in the player's browser — one link, the tab left in front ~15 minutes. Each game runs in a frame of
// this page, its own page as a player opens it (the Win32 page with its bench mode; a browser port's page), with the
// game's normal profile in this browser; the banner above says which game, how far, the phase. Every game ends with a
// `bench` record of the same shape (bench.js BenchRun: the per-phase frame time percentiles, work, frames > 40 ms, GPU
// time, data waits, the host-timing probe, the renderer): the Win32 page measures its worker's frames and sends its
// own; for a port this page runs the BenchRun, the port's frames measured from outside its page (page-meter.js) and
// its input given to it (dom-input.js), and sends it. A game that fails, stops or overstays is recorded so and the
// next one starts. At the end: the summary, one `bench-suite` record (every game's results), what was sent, a button
// to send again and one to copy. The suites and their benches: tools/scenarios/bench/index.json (`suites`).
// `?benchsuite=<bench>[,<bench>...]` runs those benches as a suite of their own (`&manifest=`, `&gameLang=`: the
// version and the game language of those); `&gldiscard=1` (this server's
// software GPU: the rasterizer discarded) reaches every game; `&benchauto=1` starts without the click.

/** seconds a game's frame is given beyond its bench's maxSeconds before the suite moves on without its record */
export const GRACE_S = 90;
/** the URL parameters of the suite's page passed on to each game's page */
export const PASSED = ['gldiscard', 'glworker', 'dbg', 'encoded', 'prefetch', 'netlog', 'snapshot']; // (snapshot=0: cold starts)

/**
 * The suite `spec` (a suite of index.json, or bench names separated by commas), each bench loaded (bench.js loadBench).
 * `manifest`: the version for a suite of one bench. Throws a message for the player.
 */
export async function loadSuite(spec, { manifest = null, gameLang = null, fetcher = fetch } = {}) {
  const res = await fetcher(BENCH_DIR + 'index.json');
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(W.noList(res.status));
  const index = await res.json(), suites = index.suites ?? [];
  let suite = suites.find((s) => s.name === spec);
  if (!suite) {
    const names = String(spec ?? '').split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!names.length || !names.every((n) => (index.benches ?? []).some((b) => b.name === n))) throw new Error(W.noSuite(spec, suites.map((s) => s.name).join(', ')));
    suite = { name: names.join(','), title: null, benches: names.map((bench) => ({ bench, ...(names.length === 1 && manifest ? { manifest } : {}), ...(gameLang ? { gameLang } : {}) })) };
  }
  const items = [];
  for (const it of suite.benches) items.push({ ...it, def: await loadBench(it.bench, it.manifest ?? null, fetcher) });
  return { name: suite.name, title: suite.title ?? null, items };
}

/** The suite's announced minutes: its benches' `minutes`, summed. */
export const suiteMinutes = (suite) => Math.round(suite.items.reduce((a, it) => a + (it.def.minutes ?? it.def.maxSeconds / 60), 0));

/**
 * The address of a game's page in the suite: the Win32 page in bench mode, or the port's page (`def.page`: under the
 * version's launch address, `launch`: the /api/manifests entry). `run`: { run, name, index, of }; `pass`: the suite
 * page's parameters passed on.
 */
export function itemUrl(item, run, { origin, launch = null, pass = new URLSearchParams() } = {}) {
  const def = item.def, lang = item.gameLang ?? null;
  const q = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const k of PASSED) if (pass.has(k)) q.set(k, pass.get(k));
  q.set('benchrun', run.run); q.set('benchsuitename', run.name); q.set('benchindex', String(run.index)); q.set('benchof', String(run.of));
  if (lang) q.set('gameLang', lang);
  if (!def.runtime || def.runtime === 'win32') {
    const u = new URL('/', origin); u.searchParams.set('bench', def.name); u.searchParams.set('manifest', def.manifest); u.searchParams.set('benchauto', '1');
    for (const [k, v] of q) u.searchParams.set(k, v);
    return u.href;
  }
  const base = (lang && launch?.languageLaunchUrls?.[lang]) || launch?.launchUrl;
  if (!base) throw new Error(`${def.manifest}: no page for this version on this server`);
  const u = new URL(def.page ?? '', new URL(base, origin));
  for (const [k, v] of q) u.searchParams.set(k, v);
  return u.href;
}

const r1 = (v) => (typeof v === 'number' ? Math.round(v * 10) / 10 : v ?? null);
/** A game's result in the suite's record and summary: its outcome and, per phase, the figures read first. */
export function compactResult(rec) {
  return {
    bench: rec.bench, title: rec.title ?? null, runtime: rec.runtime ?? 'win32', manifest: rec.manifest ?? null, outcome: rec.outcome, detail: rec.detail ?? null,
    seconds: rec.seconds ?? null, renderer: rec.renderer ?? null, firstLaunch: !!rec.firstLaunch, display: rec.display ?? null,
    interrupted: rec.interrupted ?? null, sent: rec.sent ?? null, session: rec.session ?? null,
    phases: (rec.phases ?? []).map((p) => ({
      label: p.label, seconds: p.seconds ?? null, fps: p.fps ?? null, dt: p.dt ?? null, per40: p.per40 ?? null, slow40: p.slow40 ?? null,
      work: p.work ? { p50: r1(p.work.p50), p99: r1(p.work.p99) } : null,
      gpu: p.gpu?.frames ? { p50: p.gpu.p50, p99: p.gpu.p99, mean: p.gpu.mean, frames: p.gpu.frames } : p.gpu?.state ? { state: p.gpu.state } : null,
      dataWaitMs: p.dataWaitMs ?? null, drawsPerFrame: p.drawsPerFrame ?? null,
    })),
    hostTiming: (rec.hostTiming ?? []).slice(0, 1).map((p) => ({ atomicsWait1: p.atomicsWait1?.p50 ?? null, setTimeout1: p.setTimeout1?.p50 ?? null, battery: p.battery ?? null })),
  };
}

/** The suite's own record: every game's result (compactResult), the machine, the counts. */
export function suiteRecord(suite, run, results, env, { outcome = 'done', seconds = 0, version = null } = {}) {
  const count = (o) => results.filter((r) => r.outcome === o).length;
  return {
    event: 'bench-suite', suite: suite.name, title: suite.title, run, version, outcome, seconds: Math.round(seconds),
    games: results.length, done: count('done'), failed: results.length - count('done'),
    results: results.map(compactResult), env,
  };
}

/** A record lost with its game's page (no result in time): the suite still says what happened. */
export function lostRecord(item, run, detail) {
  return { event: 'bench', bench: item.def.name, title: item.def.title ?? null, runtime: item.def.runtime ?? 'win32', manifest: item.def.manifest, outcome: 'lost', detail, seconds: null, phases: [], marks: [], suite: run };
}

const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' })[c]);
```
