```js
/**
 * The page's part (main.js ?benchsuite=): `deps` { machine() → Promise<env>, version, telemetry (the server keeps
 * records), log }.
 */
export async function startSuite(spec, deps) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  document.getElementById('menu')?.classList.add('hidden');
  if (!document.getElementById('suiteCss')) { const st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'suiteCss'; st.textContent = CSS; document.head.appendChild(st); }
  const banner = document.createElement('div'); banner.id = 'suite'; document.body.appendChild(banner);
  let suite;
  try { suite = await loadSuite(spec, { manifest: params.get('manifest'), gameLang: params.get('gameLang') }); } catch (e) { banner.innerHTML = `<b>${W.title}</b><div class="st">${esc(e.message ?? e)}</div>`; return null; }
  const runner = new SuiteRun(suite, { ...deps, banner, params });
  window.orthrosSuite = runner; // (the harness's view: tools/bench-suite-check.mjs)
  if (params.get('benchauto') === '1') runner.run();
  else runner.intro();
  return runner;
}

export class SuiteRun {
  constructor(suite, deps) {
    this.suite = suite; this.d = deps; this.banner = deps.banner; this.params = deps.params ?? new URLSearchParams();
    this.run_ = `${Date.now().toString(36)}${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
    this.results = []; this.state = 'intro'; this.current = null; this.stopAll = false; this.sends = [];
  }
  get runId() { return this.run_; }
  intro() {
    const m = suiteMinutes(this.suite), n = this.suite.items.length;
    this.banner.innerHTML = `<div><b>${W.title}</b></div><div class="st">${esc(W.about(m, n))}</div><ol>${this.suite.items.map((it) => `<li>${esc(it.def.title ?? it.def.name)}</li>`).join('')}</ol><div><button id="suiteStart">${W.start}</button><button class="quiet" id="suiteCancel">${W.cancel}</button></div>`;
    this.banner.querySelector('#suiteStart').onclick = () => this.run();
    this.banner.querySelector('#suiteCancel').onclick = () => { location.href = '/?menu'; };
  }
  async run() {
    if (this.state !== 'intro') return;
    this.state = 'running'; this.t0 = performance.now();
    this.banner.innerHTML = `<div class="ln"></div><div class="st"></div><div class="bar"><i style="width:0"></i></div><button class="quiet" id="suiteSkip">${W.skip}</button><button class="quiet" id="suiteStop">${W.stop}</button>`;
    this.banner.querySelector('#suiteSkip').onclick = () => this.current?.skip('skipped');
    this.banner.querySelector('#suiteStop').onclick = () => { this.stopAll = true; this.current?.skip('aborted'); };
    let launches = [];
    try { launches = await (await fetch('/api/manifests')).json(); } catch { launches = []; }
    const of = this.suite.items.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < of && !this.stopAll; i++) {
      const item = this.suite.items[i], run = { run: this.run_, name: this.suite.name, index: i + 1, of };
      let rec;
      try { rec = await this.game(item, run, launches.find((m) => m.name === item.def.manifest) ?? null); }
      catch (e) { rec = { ...lostRecord(item, run, String(e?.message ?? e)), outcome: 'failed' }; }
      this.results.push(rec);
      this.d.log?.('bench', `suite ${i + 1}/${of} ${item.def.name}: ${rec.outcome}${rec.detail ? ` (${rec.detail})` : ''}`);
    }
    this.state = 'finishing';
    await this.finish();
  }
  /** The banner's lines now. */
  show(i, of, title, line) {
    const ln = this.banner.querySelector('.ln'), st = this.banner.querySelector('.st'), bar = this.banner.querySelector('.bar i');
    if (ln) ln.innerHTML = `<b>${i}/${of}</b> ${esc(title)} · ${fmtTime((performance.now() - this.t0) / 1000)}`;
    if (st) st.textContent = line;
    if (bar) bar.style.width = `${Math.round(((i - 1) / of) * 100)}%`;
  }
  /** One game: its page in the frame, measured until its record; then the page left as a player leaves it. */
  async game(item, run, launch) {
    const def = item.def, url = itemUrl(item, run, { origin: location.origin, launch, pass: this.params });
    const frame = document.createElement('iframe');
    frame.id = 'suiteFrame'; frame.allow = 'autoplay; fullscreen; cross-origin-isolated; gamepad'; frame.src = url;
    // (the game's page has the focus, as a page a player opened: its window active — not "paused while inactive")
    frame.addEventListener('load', () => { try { frame.contentWindow?.focus(); } catch { /* gone */ } });
    document.body.insertBefore(frame, this.banner);
    const t0 = performance.now(), title = def.title ?? def.name, deadline = ((def.maxSeconds ?? 900) + GRACE_S) * 1000;
    const port = !!def.runtime && def.runtime !== 'win32';
    const g = port ? this.portGame(item, run, frame) : this.win32Game(frame);
    this.current = g;
    let rec = null;
    try {
      while (!rec) {
        await sleep(250);
        rec = g.result();
        const secs = (performance.now() - t0) / 1000;
        this.show(run.index, run.of, title, g.line(secs));
        if (!rec && performance.now() - t0 > deadline) { g.skip('timeout'); for (let k = 0; k < 40 && !(rec = g.result()); k++) await sleep(250); rec ??= lostRecord(item, run, `no result after ${Math.round(deadline / 1000)} s`); }
      }
      rec = plain(rec);
      // (the port's record: sent by this page; the Win32 page sent its own — again here if it could not)
      if (port || rec.sent === false || rec.outcome === 'lost') rec.sent = await this.send(rec, `${this.run_}.${run.index}`);
    } finally {
      this.current = null;
      await g.leave().catch(() => {});
      try { frame.src = 'about:blank'; } catch { /* gone */ }
      await sleep(1500); frame.remove(); await sleep(1500);
    }
    return rec;
  }
  /** A Win32 game: its page plays its bench (bench.js in the frame); its record read there. */
  win32Game(frame) {
    const o = () => { try { return frame.contentWindow?.orthros ?? null; } catch { return null; } };
    let skipped = null;
    return {
      result: () => { const s = o(); return s?.benchResult && s.benchSent !== undefined ? s.benchResult : null; },
      line: (secs) => {
        const s = o(), b = s?.bench, [k, n] = b?.player?.progress ?? [0, 0], w = b?.player?.waiting;
        if (!b?.t0) return `${W.loading} · ${Math.round(secs)} s`;
        return `${W.phase} ${b.label} · ${k}/${n}${w ? ` · ${W.waiting}` : ''}${s.stats ? ` · ${Math.round(s.stats.fps ?? 0)} fps` : ''}`;
      },
      skip: (why) => { skipped = why; o()?.bench?.finish(why === 'timeout' ? 'timeout' : 'aborted', why); },
      leave: async () => { const sh = frame.contentWindow?.orthrosShell; if (sh?.save) await Promise.race([sh.save(), sleep(15000)]); },
      get skipped() { return skipped; },
    };
  }
  /** A browser port: its page in the frame, measured from here (page-meter.js), its bench played by a BenchRun here. */
  portGame(item, run, frame) {
    const def = item.def, discard = this.params.get('gldiscard') === '1';
    const winOf = () => { try { return frame.contentWindow; } catch { return null; } };
    const state = { manifest: def.manifest, version: this.d.version ?? null, runtime: def.runtime, status: 'loading', stats: null, mode: null, renderer: null };
    let meter = null, done = null, input = domInput(winOf);
    const bench = new BenchRun(def, {
      state, input, quiet: true, suite: run, log: this.d.log, machine: this.d.machine,
      postWorker: (m) => { if (m.type === 'mark') bench.onPhase(meter ? meter.phase(m.label) : { label: m.label, frames: 0, text: '' }); },
      sendRecord: async () => true, // (sent by the suite once it has it: game())
      onDone: (rec) => { done = rec; },
    });
    // (the meter in the port's window as soon as its page is there; its status and canvas looked at each time)
    const look = setInterval(() => {
      const w = winOf(); if (!w) return;
      let href = ''; try { href = w.location.href; } catch { return; }
      if (href === 'about:blank' || !w.document) return;
      if (!w.__orthrosPageMeter) {
        meter?.stop(); meter = new PageMeter(w, { discard, onStats: (m) => { state.stats = m; bench.onStats(m); } }); meter.install();
      }
      const c = w.document.querySelector('canvas');
      if (c?.clientWidth) state.mode = { width: c.clientWidth, height: c.clientHeight };
      state.renderer = meter?.renderer ?? state.renderer;
      const ps = w.portSession?.state;
      state.status = ps === 'error' ? 'crashed' : ps === 'ended' ? 'exited' : 'running';
      if (ps === 'ended') state.exitCode = w.portSession.exitCode ?? 0;
    }, 100);
    bench.begin();
    return {
      result: () => (done ? { ...done, display: done.display ?? (state.mode ? `${state.mode.width}x${state.mode.height}` : null) } : null),
      line: () => {
        const [k, n] = bench.player.progress, w = bench.player.waiting, s = state.stats;
        return `${W.phase} ${bench.label} · ${k}/${n}${w ? ` · ${W.waiting}` : ''}${s ? ` · ${Math.round(s.fps ?? 0)} fps` : ''}`;
      },
      skip: (why) => { bench.finish(why === 'timeout' ? 'timeout' : why, why); },
      leave: async () => {
        clearInterval(look); input.release(); meter?.stop();
        const sh = winOf()?.orthrosShell; if (sh?.save) await Promise.race([sh.save(), sleep(15000)]);
      },
    };
  }
  /** One record to the server's telemetry (a session of its own, marked as this suite's); whether it was kept. */
  async send(rec, session) {
    if (!this.d.telemetry) return false;
    this.env ??= await this.d.machine?.().catch(() => null);
    const body = { session, game: rec.manifest ?? null, bench: this.run_, env: this.env, samples: [{ t: Date.now(), ...rec }] };
    try { const r = await fetch('/api/telemetry', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body), keepalive: JSON.stringify(body).length < 60000 }); return r.ok; } catch { return false; }
  }
  async finish() {
    this.env ??= await this.d.machine?.().catch(() => null);
    const seconds = (performance.now() - this.t0) / 1000;
    this.record = suiteRecord(this.suite, this.run_, this.results, this.env, { outcome: this.stopAll ? 'aborted' : 'done', seconds, version: this.d.version ?? null });
    this.record.sent = await this.send(this.record, `${this.run_}.0`);
    this.state = 'done';
    this.banner.remove();
    this.showResult();
  }
  /** Records not kept by the server sent again (the games' and the suite's). */
  async resend() {
    for (const r of this.results) if (r.sent === false) r.sent = await this.send(r, `${this.run_}.${r.suite?.index ?? 0}`);
    this.record.results = this.results.map(compactResult);
    if (!this.record.sent) this.record.sent = await this.send(this.record, `${this.run_}.0`);
  }
  sentLine() {
    const all = [...this.results, this.record], bad = all.filter((r) => !r.sent).length;
    return bad ? W.notSent(bad, all.length) : W.sent(all.length);
  }
  showResult() {
    const el = document.createElement('div'); el.id = 'suiteResult';
    const cls = (fps) => (fps >= 29.5 ? 'good' : fps >= 20 ? 'warn' : 'bad');
    const rows = this.results.map((r) => {
      const ph = (r.phases ?? []).filter((p) => p.label !== 'start'), name = esc(r.title ?? r.bench), out = `<span class="${r.outcome === 'done' ? 'good' : 'bad'}">${esc(W.outcomes[r.outcome] ?? r.outcome)}</span>`;
      if (!ph.length) return `<tr class="first"><td class="l g">${name}</td><td class="l">${out}</td><td class="l" colspan="8">${esc(r.detail ?? '')}</td></tr>`;
      return ph.map((p, i) => `<tr${i ? '' : ' class="first"'}><td class="l g">${i ? '' : name}</td><td class="l">${i ? '' : out}</td><td class="l">${esc(p.label)}</td><td>${p.seconds ?? '–'} s</td><td class="${cls(p.fps ?? 0)}">${p.fps ?? '–'}</td><td>${p.dt ? `${p.dt.p50} / ${p.dt.p90} / ${p.dt.p99}` : '–'}</td><td>${p.per40 ?? '–'}</td><td>${p.work ? `${r1(p.work.p50)} / ${r1(p.work.p99)}` : '–'}</td><td>${p.gpu?.frames ? `${p.gpu.p50} / ${p.gpu.p99}` : p.gpu?.state === 'unavailable' ? 'n/a' : '–'}</td><td>${p.dataWaitMs ?? '–'}</td></tr>`).join('');
    }).join('');
    const e = this.env ?? {}, probe = this.results.find((r) => r.hostTiming?.length)?.hostTiming?.[0];
    const renderers = [...new Set(this.results.map((r) => r.renderer).filter(Boolean))];
    const interrupted = this.results.filter((r) => r.interrupted && (r.interrupted.hiddenSeconds || r.interrupted.blurs)).map((r) => r.title ?? r.bench);
    el.innerHTML = `<h2>${this.stopAll ? W.stopped : W.done} — ${esc(this.suite.title ?? this.suite.name)}</h2>
<div class="m">${esc(e.gpu ?? '')} · ${e.cores ?? '?'} cores${e.memGB ? ` · ${e.memGB} GB` : ''} · ${esc(e.screen ?? '')} · ${fmtTime(this.record.seconds)}${renderers.length ? `\n${W.renderer}: ${esc(renderers.join(' | '))}` : ''}${probe ? `\n${W.timers}: ${esc(probeLine(probe))}` : ''}${interrupted.length ? `\n${W.hidden}: ${esc(interrupted.join(', '))}` : ''}</div>
<table><tr>${W.head.map((x, i) => `<th${i < 3 ? ' class="l"' : ''}>${x}</th>`).join('')}</tr>${rows}</table>
<div class="m" id="suiteSent">${esc(this.sentLine())}</div>
<button id="suiteResend" class="${this.record.sent && this.results.every((r) => r.sent) ? 'quiet' : ''}">${W.resend}</button><button id="suiteCopy">${W.copy}</button><button class="quiet" id="suiteClose">${W.close}</button>`;
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    el.querySelector('#suiteResend').onclick = async (ev) => { ev.target.disabled = true; await this.resend(); el.querySelector('#suiteSent').textContent = this.sentLine(); ev.target.disabled = false; };
    el.querySelector('#suiteCopy').onclick = async (ev) => { try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify({ suite: this.record, records: this.results }, null, 1)); ev.target.textContent = W.copied; } catch { ev.target.textContent = W.copyFailed; } };
    el.querySelector('#suiteClose').onclick = () => { location.href = '/?menu'; };
  }
}

```

`src/host/web/bench.js`:

```js
// Bench mode of the page (docs/real-machine-bench.md): `?bench=<name>` plays a scripted scenario of
// tools/scenarios/bench/ in the player's own browser — the harness's scenario language (src/host/scenario.js), the
// harness's phase marks (each mark closes a phase measured by the worker's frame accounting) — shows a banner while it
// runs and a summary at the end, and sends one `bench` telemetry record: the per-phase results with the machine.
// The bench suite (bench-suite.js: every game in a row, ?benchsuite=) runs the same BenchRun for the browser ports, its
// frames measured by page-meter.js and its input given to the port's page (dom-input.js), its banner its own.
import { parseScenario, unsupportedSteps, ScenarioPlayer, PLAYER_KINDS, PORT_KINDS } from '../scenario.js';
import { PerfWindow, compactPhase } from '../perf-summary.js';
import { scanCodeOfVk } from '../../win32/vk-scan.js';
import { benchNetwork, fmtRate, fmtBytes, received } from './net-status.js';
import { AudioStats } from './sound.js';
import { pickLang } from './lang.js';
import { runTimingProbe, probeLine } from './timing-probe.js';

// (the page's words: English or French, as the rest of the page — lang.js)
const FR = pickLang() === 'fr';
const W = FR ? {
  noList: (st) => `la liste des mesures est indisponible (HTTP ${st})`, noBench: (n, list) => `aucune mesure nommée « ${n} » — disponibles : ${list}`,
  notFor: (n, m, v) => `la mesure « ${n} » est pour ${m}, pas ${v}`, cannot: (f, why) => `le scénario ${f} ne peut pas être joué ici : ${why}`, harnessOnly: (src) => `étape « ${src} » (banc de test seulement)`,
  title: 'Mesure de performance', about: (m) => `Environ ${m} minute${m > 1 ? 's' : ''} (plus au premier lancement : les fichiers du jeu se téléchargent d’abord). Le jeu est joué automatiquement : ne touche ni à la souris ni au clavier et garde cet onglet au premier plan jusqu’au bilan.`,
  start: 'Lancer la mesure', cancel: 'Annuler', running: 'Mesure en cours — ne touche à rien', stop: 'Arrêter la mesure', stoppedByPlayer: 'arrêtée par le joueur',
  done: (ok, why) => (ok ? 'Mesure terminée' : `Mesure arrêtée (${why})`), gpuUnknown: 'GPU inconnu', cores: 'cœurs', render: 'rendu', inThread: 'dans le fil', display: 'affichage',
  connection: 'connexion', roundTrip: 'aller-retour', receivedLine: (all, game, bg) => `${all} reçus (lectures du jeu ${game}, arrière-plan ${bg})`,
  hidden: (s, b) => `attention : l’onglet a été masqué ${s} s / a perdu le focus ${b} fois : ces phases ne sont pas représentatives`,
  head: ['phase', 'durée', 'img/s', 'image ms p50 / p90 / p99', '&gt;33 ms /min', '&gt;40', '&gt;50', '&gt;100', 'GPU ms p50 / p99', 'dessins /image', 'réveils en retard ms/image (attente active)', 'image moyenne (ms)'],
  timer: 'minuteries de ce navigateur (retard ms)',
  sent: 'Les résultats ont été envoyés au serveur. Merci !', notSent: 'Les résultats n’ont pas pu être envoyés (télémétrie désactivée sur ce serveur) : utilise « Copier les résultats ».',
  yours: 'Le jeu est à toi maintenant : clique dedans pour capturer la souris, Échap la libère.', copy: 'Copier les résultats', close: 'Fermer et jouer', copied: 'Copié', copyFailed: 'Échec de la copie',
} : {
  noList: (st) => `the list of measurements is unavailable (HTTP ${st})`, noBench: (n, list) => `no measurement named "${n}" — available: ${list}`,
  notFor: (n, m, v) => `the measurement "${n}" is for ${m}, not ${v}`, cannot: (f, why) => `the scenario ${f} cannot be played here: ${why}`, harnessOnly: (src) => `step "${src}" (harness only)`,
  title: 'Performance measurement', about: (m) => `About ${m} minute${m > 1 ? 's' : ''} (longer on a first launch: the game files download first). The game is played automatically: do not touch the mouse or the keyboard and keep this tab in front until the summary appears.`,
  start: 'Start the measurement', cancel: 'Cancel', running: 'Measurement in progress — do not touch', stop: 'Stop the measurement', stoppedByPlayer: 'stopped by the player',
  done: (ok, why) => (ok ? 'Measurement complete' : `Measurement stopped (${why})`), gpuUnknown: 'GPU unknown', cores: 'cores', render: 'render', inThread: 'in-thread', display: 'display',
  connection: 'connection', roundTrip: 'round trip', receivedLine: (all, game, bg) => `${all} received (game reads ${game}, background ${bg})`,
  hidden: (s, b) => `warning: the tab was hidden ${s} s / lost the focus ${b} time(s): those phases are not representative`,
  head: ['phase', 'time', 'fps', 'frame ms p50 / p90 / p99', '&gt;33 ms /min', '&gt;40', '&gt;50', '&gt;100', 'GPU ms p50 / p99', 'draws /frame', 'wake-ups late ms/frame (spin)', 'mean frame (ms)'],
  timer: 'this browser\'s timers (lateness ms)',
  sent: 'The results were sent to the server. Thank you!', notSent: 'The results could not be sent (telemetry is off on this server): use "Copy the results".',
  yours: 'The game is yours now: click it to capture the mouse, Escape releases it.', copy: 'Copy the results', close: 'Close and play', copied: 'Copied', copyFailed: 'Copy failed',
};

export const BENCH_DIR = '/tools/scenarios/bench/';
/** the pointer steps, and the least time between two of them (ms) */
const INPUT_KINDS = new Set(['move', 'click', 'rclick', 'down', 'up']), INPUT_GAP_MS = 300;

/**
 * The bench `name` (tools/scenarios/bench/index.json), its scenario parsed. `manifest`: the version asked for in the
 * URL, if any (it must be one the bench lists). Throws a message for the player when the bench cannot run.
 */
export async function loadBench(name, manifest = null, fetcher = fetch) {
  const res = await fetcher(BENCH_DIR + 'index.json');
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(W.noList(res.status));
  const list = (await res.json()).benches ?? [];
  const def = list.find((b) => b.name === name);
  if (!def) throw new Error(W.noBench(name, list.map((b) => b.name).join(', ')));
  if (manifest && !def.manifests.includes(manifest)) throw new Error(W.notFor(name, def.manifests.join(', '), manifest));
  const text = await (await fetcher(BENCH_DIR + def.file)).text();
  const { steps, errors } = parseScenario(text);
  // (a browser port's bench — `runtime` re3, goldsrc, openmw; `page`: its page under the version's launch address —
  // plays the ports' steps too)
  const bad = unsupportedSteps(steps, def.runtime && def.runtime !== 'win32' ? PORT_KINDS : PLAYER_KINDS);
  if (errors.length || bad.length) throw new Error(W.cannot(def.file, [...errors, ...bad.map((s) => W.harnessOnly(s.src))].join('; ')));
  return { ...def, manifest: manifest ?? def.manifests[0], steps };
}

const CSS = `
#bench { position: fixed; left: 50%; top: 10px; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 60; max-width: min(720px, 94vw); background: rgba(14,15,20,.94); border: 1px solid rgba(224,189,110,.55); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; color: #e8e2d2; font: 13px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.6); text-align: center; }
#bench b { color: #e0bd6e; } #bench .st { font: 12px/1.5 ui-monospace, monospace; color: #b8bcc8; margin-top: 4px; }
#bench button, #benchResult button { margin: 8px 4px 0; font: 600 13px system-ui; color: #e8e2d2; background: rgba(201,165,90,.2); border: 1px solid rgba(201,165,90,.5); padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; }
#bench button.quiet, #benchResult button.quiet { background: transparent; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.2); color: #b8bcc8; }
#benchResult { position: fixed; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); z-index: 61; max-width: 96vw; max-height: 90vh; overflow: auto; background: rgba(14,15,20,.97); border: 1px solid rgba(224,189,110,.55); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 20px; color: #d9dce3; font: 13px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.7); }
#benchResult h2 { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 700 18px system-ui; color: #f2ead6; } #benchResult .m { font: 12px/1.5 ui-monospace, monospace; color: #9fa4b0; white-space: pre-wrap; }
#benchResult table { border-collapse: collapse; margin: 10px 0; font: 12px ui-monospace, monospace; }
#benchResult th, #benchResult td { padding: 3px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; } #benchResult th:first-child, #benchResult td:first-child, #benchResult td.l { text-align: left; }
#benchResult .good { color: #8fd18f; } #benchResult .warn { color: #e0bd6e; } #benchResult .bad { color: #ff8b8b; }
`;
const fmtTime = (s) => `${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(Math.floor(s % 60)).padStart(2, '0')}`;
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' })[c]);

/**
 * The game's input from the Win32 page's input ring (push / EV / typeText): what BenchRun gives its steps to. A port's
 * page gets the same calls from dom-input.js.
 */
export function ringInput(push, EV, typeText) {
  return {
    move: (x, y) => push(EV.MOUSEMOVE, x, y, 0),
    button: (b, down, x, y) => { push(EV.MOUSEMOVE, x, y, 0); push(down ? EV.MOUSEDOWN : EV.MOUSEUP, b, x, y); },
    key: (vk, scan, down) => push(down ? EV.KEYDOWN : EV.KEYUP, vk, scan || scanCodeOfVk(vk), 0),
    text: (s) => typeText(s),
  };
}

/**
 * One bench run in this page. `deps`: the page's pieces — state (window.orthros: mode, stats, status, manifest...),
 * input (move, button, key, text and, for a port, command / look / glide — or push / EV / typeText: the input ring),
 * postWorker ({ type: 'mark' }: the phase's report comes back through onPhase), sendRecord(record) → Promise<boolean>
 * (telemetry; false: not sent), machine() → Promise<object>, headless (no banner interaction: starts at once), quiet
 * (no banner nor summary: the bench suite shows its own), suite (the suite run this bench is part of, kept in the
 * record), capture() (the mouse captured: the summary closed to play).
 */
export class BenchRun {
  constructor(def, deps) {
    this.def = def; this.d = deps; this.state = deps.state;
    this.input = deps.input ?? ringInput(deps.push, deps.EV, deps.typeText);
    this.player = new ScenarioPlayer(def.steps, { from: def.coords ?? null, display: () => (this.state.mode ? [this.state.mode.width, this.state.mode.height] : null) });
    this.win = new PerfWindow(); this.phases = []; this.extras = []; this.marks = []; this.anchors = [];
    this.audio = new AudioStats(); // (the page feeds it: the sound of the run, sent with the record)
    this.label = 'start'; this.hiddenSeconds = 0; this.blurs = 0; this.finished = false; this.t0 = null;
    // (host-timing probes — timing-probe.js: how late this browser wakes a worker up — at the start and at each mark)
    this.probes = []; this.probing = null;
    if (!document.getElementById('benchCss')) { const st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'benchCss'; st.textContent = CSS; document.head.appendChild(st); }
    this.el = document.createElement('div'); this.el.id = 'bench'; document.body.appendChild(this.el);
    if (deps.headless || deps.quiet) this.el.style.display = 'none'; // (the harness's bare frame: its screenshots without the banner; the suite's own banner)
  }
  /** The banner before the start: what will happen; `onStart` once the player agrees (a click: audio may start). */
  intro(onStart, onCancel) {
    const minutes = Math.max(1, Math.round((this.def.minutes ?? this.def.maxSeconds / 60)));
    this.el.innerHTML = `<div><b>${W.title}</b> — ${esc(this.def.title ?? this.def.name)}</div><div class="st">${W.about(minutes)}</div><button id="benchStart">${W.start}</button><button class="quiet" id="benchCancel">${W.cancel}</button>`;
    this.el.querySelector('#benchStart').onclick = () => onStart();
    this.el.querySelector('#benchCancel').onclick = () => { this.el.remove(); onCancel?.(); };
  }
  /** The game is starting: the scenario's clock begins (its times count from the launch, as in the harness). */
  begin() {
    this.t0 = performance.now(); this.state.benchActive = true;
    this.el.innerHTML = `<div><b>${W.running}</b></div><div class="st"></div><button class="quiet" id="benchAbort">${W.stop}</button>`;
    this.el.querySelector('#benchAbort').onclick = () => this.finish('aborted', W.stoppedByPlayer);
    this.onVis = () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') this.hiddenAt = performance.now(); else if (this.hiddenAt) { this.hiddenSeconds += (performance.now() - this.hiddenAt) / 1000; this.hiddenAt = null; } };
    // (a focus loss: the page's focus gone elsewhere — not into a frame of its own: the bench suite's game page)
    this.onBlur = () => setTimeout(() => { if (!document.hasFocus()) this.blurs++; }, 0);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this.onVis); addEventListener('blur', this.onBlur);
    this.timer = setInterval(() => this.tick(), 100);
    this.probe('start');
  }
  /** A host-timing probe now (one at a time; `label`: the phase it opens), kept with the record. */
  probe(label) {
    if (this.probing || this.d.timingProbe === null) return;
    const q = Number((/(?:^|,)ORTHROS_HOST_TIMER_Q=([\d.]+)/.exec(new URLSearchParams(globalThis.location?.search ?? '').get('dbg') ?? '') ?? [])[1]) || 0;
    const at = this.t0 === null ? 0 : Math.round((performance.now() - this.t0) / 100) / 10;
    this.probing = (this.d.timingProbe ?? runTimingProbe)(q).then((r) => { if (r) this.probes.push({ label, at, ...r }); }).catch(() => {}).finally(() => { this.probing = null; });
  }
  onStats(m) { if (this.t0 !== null && !this.finished) this.win.add(m, { t: Date.now(), visible: document.visibilityState === 'visible', fullscreen: !!document.fullscreenElement, status: this.state.status }); }
  onPhase(rep) { this.phases.push(rep); }
  tick() {
    if (this.finished) return;
    const now = (performance.now() - this.t0) / 1000, st = this.state;
    if (st.status === 'exited' || st.status === 'crashed') { this.finish(st.status, st.status === 'crashed' ? 'emulation error' : `the game exited (code ${st.exitCode})`); return; }
    if (now > (this.def.maxSeconds ?? 900)) { const w = this.player.waiting; this.finish('timeout', `not finished after ${this.def.maxSeconds ?? 900} s${w ? `; waiting at step "${w.src}"` : ''}`); return; }
    // (pointer steps that fell due together — the page's timer late under load — go one per INPUT_GAP_MS: two clicks
    // delivered in the same instant reach the game as down, down, up, up, and the menu takes neither)
    (this.pending ??= []).push(...this.player.tick(now, st.stats));
    while (this.pending.length) {
      const a = this.pending[0], input = INPUT_KINDS.has(a.kind);
      if (input && performance.now() - (this.lastInputAt ?? -1e9) < INPUT_GAP_MS) break;
      this.pending.shift(); this.perform(a);
      if (input) this.lastInputAt = performance.now();
    }
    if (this.player.done && !this.pending.length) { this.finish('done', null); return; }
    if (Math.floor(now) === this.shownAt) return; // (the banner's line once a second)
    this.shownAt = Math.floor(now);
    const [k, n] = this.player.progress, w = this.player.waiting;
    const line = this.el.querySelector('.st');
    // (the game waiting for its files: the banner says so, with the rate — a slow link's results read as such)
    const net = st.stats?.net, dl = net?.waiting ? ` · downloading game data ${net.bw > 0 ? fmtRate(net.bw) : ''} (${fmtBytes(received(net))} received)` : '';
    if (line) line.textContent = `${fmtTime(now)} · phase ${this.label} · step ${k}/${n}${w ? ` · waiting for ${w.kind === 'waitfps' ? 'the game to run' : 'the next screen'}` : ''}${dl}${st.stats ? ` · ${Math.round(st.stats.fps ?? 0)} fps` : ''}`;
  }
  perform(a) {
    const inp = this.input, [x, y] = a.args;
    switch (a.kind) {
      case 'move': inp.move(x, y); break;
      // (a click holds the button ~100 ms and a key press likewise, as the harness and a person do)
      case 'click': case 'rclick': { const b = a.kind === 'click' ? 0 : 1; inp.button(b, true, x, y); setTimeout(() => inp.button(b, false, x, y), 100); break; }
      case 'down': inp.button(0, true, x, y); break;
      case 'up': inp.button(0, false, x, y); break;
      case 'key': { const vk = a.args[0], scan = a.args[1] || 0; inp.key(vk, scan, true); setTimeout(() => inp.key(vk, scan, false), 100); break; }
      case 'keydown': case 'keyup': inp.key(a.args[0], a.args[1] || 0, a.kind === 'keydown'); break;
      case 'text': inp.text(String(a.args[0])); break;
      // (a port's own: its console, a captured mouse's look, its debug teleport — page-meter.js's hooks)
      case 'cmd': inp.command?.(String(a.args[0])); break;
      case 'look': inp.look?.(...a.args); break;
      case 'glide': inp.glide?.(a.args); break;
      case 'mark': this.mark(String(a.args[0]), a.at); break;
      case 'waitfps': case 'waitframe': this.anchors.push({ step: a.step.src, at: Math.round(a.at * 10) / 10 }); break;
      default: break; // (shot, blur, focus: harness steps without effect here)
    }
  }
  /** A phase boundary: the worker closes the phase (its frame report comes back as a 'phase' message). */
  mark(label, at) {
    this.d.postWorker({ type: 'mark', label });
    this.extras.push({ label: this.label, at: this.marks.length ? this.marks[this.marks.length - 1].at : 0, window: this.win.take() });
    // (what the network had carried by then: the time of a phase on a slow link reads with it)
    const net = this.state.stats?.net;
    // (a port's: the reads its engine waited for, page-meter.js — the same keys)
    const data = this.state.stats?.data;
    this.marks.push({ label, at: Math.round(at * 10) / 10, ...(net ? { netBytes: received(net), netDemandMs: Math.round(net.demandMs ?? 0) } : data ? { netBytes: data.bytes ?? 0, netDemandMs: Math.round(data.waitMs ?? 0), dataWaits: data.waits ?? 0 } : {}) });
    this.label = label;
    if (label !== 'end') this.probe(label);
  }
  async finish(outcome, detail) {
    if (this.finished) return;
    this.finished = true; clearInterval(this.timer); this.state.benchActive = false;
    document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', this.onVis); removeEventListener('blur', this.onBlur);
    this.onVis?.();
    const seconds = this.t0 === null ? 0 : (performance.now() - this.t0) / 1000;
    // (the last phase closed unless the scenario's last mark was "end")
    if (this.label !== 'end') this.mark('end', seconds);
    for (let i = 0; i < 40 && this.phases.length < this.marks.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
    if (this.probing) await Promise.race([this.probing, new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5000))]);
    const phases = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.extras.length; i++) {
      const rep = this.phases[i], x = this.extras[i], w = x.window;
      if (x.label === 'end') continue;
      // (the time the game waited for its data in the phase: the network's demand reads, a port's engine's reads)
      const m0 = this.marks[i - 1], m1 = this.marks[i];
      const dataWaitMs = m1?.netDemandMs !== undefined ? m1.netDemandMs - (m0?.netDemandMs ?? 0) : null;
      phases.push({ ...(compactPhase(rep) ?? { label: x.label }), label: x.label, at: x.at, drawsPerFrame: w?.drawsPerFrame ?? null, gpu: w?.gpu ?? null, glCalls: w?.glCalls ?? null, render: w?.render ?? null, busy: w?.busy ?? null, visible: w?.visible ?? null, dataWaitMs });
    }
    const st = this.state;
    const record = {
      event: 'bench', bench: this.def.name, title: this.def.title ?? null, runtime: this.def.runtime ?? st.runtime ?? 'win32', manifest: st.manifest, version: st.version ?? null, outcome, detail,
      ...(this.d.suite ? { suite: this.d.suite } : {}), // (bench-suite.js: { run, name, index, of } — the suite run this bench is part of)
      seconds: Math.round(seconds), firstLaunch: !!st.firstLaunch,
      // (the machine's start: 'own' / 'shared' snapshot restored, 'failed' one that could not be, null a usual start —
      // docs/snapshot.md; a ?bench page shares the players' snapshots since 2026-10-27, its own before)
      snapshot: st.snapshotFailed ? 'failed' : st.snapshotFrom ?? null, display: st.mode ? `${st.mode.width}x${st.mode.height}` : null,
      options: st.perfOptions ?? null, marks: this.marks, anchors: this.anchors, phases,
      interrupted: { hiddenSeconds: Math.round(this.hiddenSeconds), blurs: this.blurs },
      audio: this.audio.take(), // (sound.js: context state, worklet output, mix level, buffers over the run)
      network: benchNetwork(st.stats?.net), // (the measured link: bytes/s, round trip, the game's reads and the background downloads)
      hostTiming: this.probes, // (timing-probe.js: Atomics.wait / setTimeout / hop lateness and the battery, at the start and each mark)
      env: await this.d.machine().catch(() => null),
    };
    // (the WebGL renderer the game drew with: a port's context's, page-meter.js; the Win32 page's machine line's)
    record.renderer = st.renderer ?? record.env?.gpu ?? null;
    st.benchResult = record;
    let sent = false;
    try { sent = await this.d.sendRecord(record); } catch { sent = false; }
    record.sent = sent; st.benchSent = sent;
    this.d.log?.('bench', `${outcome}${detail ? ` (${detail})` : ''}: ${phases.map((p) => `${p.label} ${p.seconds ?? '?'} s ${p.fps ?? '?'} fps p99 ${p.dt?.p99 ?? '?'} ms`).join('; ')}; record ${sent ? 'sent' : 'not sent (telemetry off)'}`);
    this.el.remove();
    this.d.onDone?.(record);
    if (!this.d.headless && !this.d.quiet) this.showResult(record);
  }
  showResult(r) {
    const el = document.createElement('div'); el.id = 'benchResult';
    const cls = (fps) => (fps >= 29.5 ? 'good' : fps >= 20 ? 'warn' : 'bad');
    const rows = r.phases.map((p) => `<tr><td>${esc(p.label)}</td><td>${p.seconds ?? '–'} s</td><td class="${cls(p.fps ?? 0)}">${p.fps ??     const e = r.env ?? {};
    el.innerHTML = `<h2>${W.done(r.outcome === 'done', esc(r.outcome))} — ${esc(r.title ?? r.bench)}</h2>
<div class="m">${esc(r.detail ?? '')}${r.detail ? '\n' : ''}${esc(e.gpu ?? W.gpuUnknown)} · ${e.cores ?? '?'} ${W.cores}${e.memGB ? ` · ${e.memGB} GB` : ''} · ${esc(e.screen ?? ${r.hostTiming?.length ? `<div class="m">${W.timer}:\n${r.hostTiming.map((p) => `${esc(p.label)} (${p.at} s): ${esc(probeLine(p))}`).join('\n')}</div>` : ''}
<div class="m">${r.sent ? W.sent : W.notSent}</div>
<div class="m">${W.yours}</div>
<button id="benchCopy">${W.copy}</button><button class="quiet" id="benchClose">${W.close}</button>`;
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    el.querySelector('#benchCopy').onclick = async (ev) => { try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify(r, null, 1)); ev.target.textContent = W.copied; } catch { ev.target.textContent = W.copyFailed; } };
    // (the game is the player's from here: closing the summary captures the mouse, as a click in the game does)
    el.querySelector('#benchClose').onclick = () => { el.remove(); this.d.capture?.(); };
  }
}

```

`src/host/web/cloud-sync.js`:

```js
// A game's saves kept on the player's Orthros account, the same way for every runtime (Windows games, browser ports):
// the profile (the files the game wrote: saves, settings) restored from the account before the game starts, sent
// after it changed, while the game runs and when it ends. The page says where its files are (`read`, `write`); the
// account API (src/host/accounts.js) keeps the versions, 20 per game, and refuses an upload made from a version that
// is not its latest (another device sent one meanwhile): nothing is overwritten without the player's choice.
//
// What this browser knows of the account's copy, per account and game (localStorage orthros.sync.<user>.<game>):
//   parent — the hash of the account's version this profile was last in step with,
//   local  — the hash of the profile's content then.
// A profile whose content hash is still `local` has nothing new; an account whose latest hash is still `parent` has
// nothing new either. Both new: a conflict, settled by the player.

const FORMAT = 'orthros-profile';
export const MAX_BACKUP = 64 * 1024 * 1024;

/**
 * What to do before the game starts, from what is known (null: never in step on this device), the account's latest
 * hash (null: no copy on the account), whether the profile is empty and whether its content is the one last in step.
 * @returns {'none'|'same'|'push'|'restore'|'compare'|'conflict'}
 *   compare: no record on this device, a profile and a copy on the account — the same content or a conflict, known
 *   once the copy is downloaded (sameContent()).
 */
export function decide({ known, remoteHash, localEmpty, localUnchanged }) {
  if (!remoteHash) return localEmpty ? 'none' : 'push';
  if (known && remoteHash === known.parent) return localUnchanged ? 'same' : 'push';
  if (localEmpty) return 'restore';
  if (!known) return 'compare';
  return localUnchanged ? 'restore' : 'conflict';
}

const hex = (buf) => Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf), (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
export const sha256 = async (bytes) => hex(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', bytes));
function toBase64(bytes) {
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) s += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
  return btoa(s);
}
function fromBase64(s) {
  const bin = atob(s), out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return out;
}
const pipe = async (bytes, stream) => new Uint8Array(await new Response(new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(stream)).arrayBuffer());
const validPath = (p) => typeof p === 'string' && p.length > 0 && p.length <= 1024 && !p.startsWith('/') && !p.includes('\\') && !/[\x00-\x1f]/.test(p) && p.split('/').every((x) => x && x !== '.' && x !== '..');

/**
 * The profile's files as the account keeps them: { raw (the JSON's bytes, whose hash is the content's), files }.
 * `files`: [{ path ('/'-separated, relative), data: Uint8Array }]; sorted by path, so the same content is the same bytes.
 */
export function encodeProfile(game, files) {
  const list = files.filter((f) => validPath(f.path)).sort((a, b) => (a.path < b.path ? -1 : a.path > b.path ? 1 : 0));
  const json = JSON.stringify({ format: FORMAT, version: 1, game, files: list.map((f) => ({ path: f.path, data: toBase64(f.data) })) });
  return new TextEncoder().encode(json);
}
/** The files of an account's copy (gzip bytes), checked: [{ path, data: Uint8Array }] and the raw JSON's bytes. */
export async function decodeProfile(game, gz) {
  const raw = await pipe(gz, new DecompressionStream('gzip'));
  const doc = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(raw));
  if (doc?.format !== FORMAT || doc.version !== 1 || doc.game !== game || !Array.isArray(doc.files)) throw new Error('not a save of this game');
  for (const f of doc.files) if (!validPath(f.path) || typeof f.data !== 'string') throw new Error('invalid save path');
  return { raw, files: doc.files.map((f) => ({ path: f.path, data: fromBase64(f.data) })) };
}

/**
 * A game's saves on the account of `user` (null: not signed in — nothing leaves the browser).
 * `read()`: the profile's files now; `write(files)`: the profile replaced by these (the page keeps the previous one
 * aside when it can). `onStatus(status)`: { state, ...} — off (not signed in), idle, saving, saved ({ at, version }),
 * error ({ message }), conflict ({ remote }), toobig.
 */
export class CloudSave {
  constructor({ game, user, read, write, onStatus = () => {}, fetchImpl = (...a) => fetch(...a), storage = globalThis.localStorage }) {
    Object.assign(this, { game, user, read, write, onStatus, fetchImpl, storage });
    this.status = { state: user ? 'idle' : 'off' };
    this.remote = null; // (the account's latest: { hash, version, at })
    this.busy = null; this.again = false;
  }
  get key() { return `orthros.sync.${this.user}.${this.game}`; }
  get known() { try { return JSON.parse(this.storage.getItem(this.key)); } catch { return null; } }
  set known(v) { try { this.storage.setItem(this.key, JSON.stringify(v)); this.storage.setItem(`orthros.owner.${this.game}`, this.user); } catch { /* storage off */ } }
  /** Which account this browser's profile of the game was last in step with (null: none). */
  owner() { try { return this.storage.getItem(`orthros.owner.${this.game}`); } catch { return null; } }
  set(status) { this.status = status; try { this.onStatus(status); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } }
  url(tail = '') { return `/api/cloud/${encodeURIComponent(this.game)}${tail}`; }

  /**
   * The account's latest copy's hash, from the account's list (a few hundred bytes: on a slow link, the copy itself is
   * downloaded only when it is needed); null when there is none.
   */
  async remoteHead() {
    const r = await this.fetchImpl('/api/cloud', { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'same-origin' });
    if (r.status === 401) throw Object.assign(new Error('signed out'), { status: 401 });
    if (!r.ok) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`), { status: r.status });
    return (await r.json()).games?.find((g) => g.game === this.game)?.hash ?? null;
  }
  /** The account's latest copy: its gzip bytes and hash, or null when there is none. */
  async fetchRemote() {
    const r = await this.fetchImpl(this.url(), { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'same-origin' });
    if (r.status === 404) { this.remote = null; return null; }
    if (r.status === 401) throw Object.assign(new Error('signed out'), { status: 401 });
    if (!r.ok) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`), { status: r.status });
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer()), hash = r.headers.get('X-Orthros-Backup-Hash') ?? await sha256(bytes);
    return { bytes, hash };
  }

  /**
   * Before the game starts: the account's copy put in place when it is newer, the profile sent when it is, a conflict
   * told (resolve(): the player's choice). Resolves to the decision taken ('none', 'same', 'push', 'restore',
   * 'conflict'); a network failure leaves the profile as it is ('offline').
   */
  async pull() {
    if (!this.user) return 'none';
    let head, remote = null, files, raw;
    try {
      [head, files] = await Promise.all([this.remoteHead(), this.read()]);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e.status === 401) { this.user = null; this.set({ state: 'off' }); return 'none'; }
      this.set({ state: 'error', message: e.message }); return 'offline';
    }
    raw = encodeProfile(this.game, files);
    const localHash = await sha256(raw), known = this.known, owner = this.owner();
    // (a profile last in step with another account: not this player's — kept aside, the account's own put in place)
    const foreign = !!owner && owner !== this.user && files.length > 0;
    let what = foreign ? (head ? 'restore' : 'reset') : decide({ known, remoteHash: head, localEmpty: files.length === 0, localUnchanged: known?.local === localHash });
    if (['restore', 'compare', 'conflict'].includes(what)) {
      try { remote = await this.fetchRemote(); } catch (e) { this.set({ state: 'error', message: e.message }); return 'offline'; }
      if (!remote) what = files.length ? 'push' : 'none'; // (gone meanwhile)
    } else if (head) remote = { hash: head };
    let decoded = null;
    if (what === 'compare') {
      decoded = await decodeProfile(this.game, remote.bytes).catch(() => null);
      what = decoded && await sha256(decoded.raw) === localHash ? 'same' : 'conflict';
    }
    this.remoteHash = remote?.hash ?? null;
    if (what === 'same') { this.known = { parent: remote.hash, local: localHash }; this.set({ state: 'saved', at: Date.now() }); }
    else if (what === 'restore') { await this.applyRemote(remote, decoded); }
    else if (what === 'reset') { await this.write([]); this.known = { parent: 'none', local: await sha256(encodeProfile(this.game, [])) }; this.set({ state: 'idle' }); }
    else if (what === 'push') { await this.push(); }
    else if (what === 'conflict') { this.conflict = remote; this.set({ state: 'conflict' }); }
    else this.set({ state: 'idle' });
    return what;
  }
  async applyRemote(remote, decoded = null) {
    const doc = decoded ?? await decodeProfile(this.game, remote.bytes);
    await this.write(doc.files);
    this.known = { parent: remote.hash, local: await sha256(encodeProfile(this.game, doc.files)) };
    this.remoteHash = remote.hash;
    this.set({ state: 'saved', at: Date.now() });
  }
  /** A conflict settled: 'account' puts the account's copy in place, 'device' sends this profile over it. */
  async resolve(choice) {
    const remote = this.conflict ?? await this.fetchRemote(); this.conflict = null;
    if (choice === 'account' && remote) return this.applyRemote(remote);
    this.remoteHash = remote?.hash ?? null;
    return this.push({ force: true });
  }

  /**
   * The profile sent when it changed since it was last in step (`force`: over the account's latest even if it moved).
   * One at a time: a call during a send runs once more after it.
   */
  push({ force = false } = {}) {
    if (!this.user || this.status.state === 'conflict' && !force) return Promise.resolve(this.status);
    if (this.busy) { this.again = true; return this.busy; }
    this.busy = this.send(force).finally(() => { this.busy = null; if (this.again) { this.again = false; this.push(); } });
    return this.busy;
  }
  async send(force) {
    let files;
    try { files = await this.read(); } catch (e) { this.set({ state: 'error', message: e.message }); return this.status; }
    const raw = encodeProfile(this.game, files), localHash = await sha256(raw), known = this.known;
    if (!force && known && known.local === localHash && (this.remoteHash ?? known.parent) === known.parent) { if (this.status.state !== 'saved') this.set({ state: 'saved', at: Date.now() }); return this.status; }
    if (!files.length && !known) { this.set({ state: 'idle' }); return this.status; }
    const gz = await pipe(raw, new CompressionStream('gzip'));
    if (gz.length > MAX_BACKUP) { this.set({ state: 'toobig', bytes: gz.length }); return this.status; }
    // (never in step on this device: sent as a first copy — the account refuses it when it has one, a conflict)
    const parent = force ? (this.remoteHash ?? 'none') : (known?.parent ?? 'none');
    this.set({ state: 'saving' });
    let r;
    try { r = await this.fetchImpl(this.url(), { method: 'PUT', credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream', 'X-Orthros-Parent-Hash': parent }, body: gz }); }
    catch (e) { this.set({ state: 'error', message: e.message, retry: true }); return this.status; }
    const body = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (r.status === 409) { this.remoteHash = body.remoteHash ?? null; this.conflict = null; this.set({ state: 'conflict' }); return this.status; }
    if (r.status === 401) { this.user = null; this.set({ state: 'off' }); return this.status; }
    if (!r.ok) { this.set({ state: 'error', message: body.error ?? `HTTP ${r.status}`, retry: r.status === 429 || r.status >= 500 }); return this.status; }
    this.known = { parent: body.hash, local: localHash }; this.remoteHash = body.hash;
    this.set({ state: 'saved', at: Date.now(), version: body.version ?? null });
    return this.status;
  }
}
```

```js
let lang = pickLang();
const t = (key, ...args) => { const v = TEXT[lang][key] ?? TEXT.en[key] ?? key; return typeof v === 'function' ? v(...args) : v; };
const fmtBytes = (n) => {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) return '—';
  const units = lang === 'fr' ? ['o', 'Ko', 'Mo', 'Go', 'To'] : ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
  let i = 0; while (n >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) { n /= 1024; i++; }
  return n.toLocaleString(lang, { maximumFractionDigits: n < 10 && i ? 1 : 0 }) + ' ' + units[i];
};
const stamp = (ms) => ms ? new Date(ms).toLocaleString(lang, { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }) : '—';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- state
const app = {
  tab: 'general', open: false, busy: false, account: null, accountsOn: null, cloud: new Map(), storage: null,
  games: new Map(), accountMode: 'login', expanded: null, histories: new Map(), message: '', tone: 'info', opened: new Set(),
};
const showAll = new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('all');
const state = () => window.orthros;
const activeGame = (game) => state()?.manifest === game && ['running', 'loading', 'starting'].includes(state()?.status);
const nameOf = (game) => app.games.get(game)?.title ?? game;
/**
 * The other versions that read version `game`'s files (/api/manifests `owners`: the versions whose files a version
 * takes — they are stored under their owner, game-data.js): its cache is theirs too, counted and cleared here only.
 */
const readers = (game) => [...app.games].filter(([n, g]) => n !== game && g.owners.includes(game)).map(([n]) => n);
const versionOf = (game) => app.games.get(game)?.version ?? null;
/** The account's copy of a Windows game's profile kept in this browser (cloud-sync.js), with its latest hash as listed. */
const cloudFor = (game) => {
  const c = new CloudSave({ game, user: app.account?.username, read: () => profileFiles(game, state()), write: (files) => replaceProfile(game, files, state()) });
  c.remoteHash = app.cloud.get(game)?.hash ?? null;
  return c;
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- server
async function api(path, options = {}) {
  const response = await fetch(path, { credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', ...options });
  if (!response.ok) {
    let error; try { error = (await response.json()).error; } catch { error = null; }
    const issue = new Error(errorText(error, lang) || t('errConnection'));
    issue.status = response.status;
    throw issue;
  }
  return response;
}
async function jsonApi(path, method = 'GET', body) {
  const response = await api(path, { method, headers: body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}, body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined });
  return response.json();
}
async function refresh({ account = false } = {}) {
  if (account) {
    const config = await fetch('/api/config').then((r) => r.json()).catch(() => ({}));
    app.accountsOn = !!config.accounts; app.google = !!config.google;
    try { app.account = app.accountsOn ? (await jsonApi('/api/account')).user : null; } catch { app.account = null; }
  }
  const [storage, manifests] = await Promise.all([scanStorage(), fetch('/api/manifests').then((r) => r.json()).catch(() => [])]);
  app.games = new Map(manifests.map((m) => [m.name, { title: m.title ?? m.name, version: m.runtime === 'openmw' ? [m.version, (m.contentLanguages ?? m.languages ?? []).join('/').toUpperCase()].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') : m.version ?? null, hidden: !!m.hidden, runtime: m.runtime, launchUrl: m.launchUrl, saveKey: m.saveKey ?? null, owners: Array.isArray(m.owners) ? m.owners : [] }]));
  // (the browser ports' data: their own databases, beside the Windows games' OPFS folders — one row a game, both counted)
  try {
    for (const r of await scanPorts(manifests.filter((m) => m.saveKey).map((m) => ({ name: m.name, saveKey: m.saveKey })))) {
      const row = storage.games.find((g) => g.game === r.game);
      if (row) { row.profile += r.profile; row.cache += r.cache; row.port = true; } else storage.games.push(r);
    }
  } catch { /* IndexedDB unavailable */ }
  app.storage = storage;
  if (app.account) {
    try { app.cloud = new Map((await jsonApi('/api/cloud')).games.map((g) => [g.game, g])); } catch { app.cloud = new Map(); }
  } else app.cloud = new Map();
  render();
}
/** Runs an action: the status line says what is going on, then what came out of it; the window is redrawn after. */
async function run(label, task, reload = true) {
  if (app.busy) return;
  app.busy = true; app.tone = 'info'; app.message = label + '…'; render();
  try {
    const result = await task();
    app.tone = 'ok'; app.message = result || t('done');
    if (reload) await refresh();
  } catch (error) { app.tone = 'error'; app.message = error.message || String(error); render(); }
  finally { app.busy = false; render(); }
}

  d.ontoggle = () => { if (d.open) app.opened.add(key); else app.opened.delete(key); };
  return d;

/** A question inside the window. Resolves to true / false, or to the typed password when `password` is set — the typed
 * username when `password` is 'username' — (null if cancelled). */
function ask({ title, text, ok, danger = false, password = false }) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const finish = (value) => { asking.hidden = true; asking.replaceChildren(); resolve(value); };
    const input = password === 'username' ? h('input', { type: 'text', class: 'dm-input', autocomplete: 'off', 'aria-label': t('username') })
      : password ? h('input', { type: 'password', class: 'dm-input', autocomplete: 'current-password', 'aria-label': t('password') }) : null;
    const no = h('button', { type: 'button', class: 'dm-btn ghost', onclick: () => finish(password ? null : false) }, t('cancel'));
    const yes = h('button', { type: 'button', class: 'dm-btn ' + (danger ? 'danger solid' : 'primary'), onclick: () => finish(password ? (input.value || null) : true) }, ok);
    asking.replaceChildren(h('div', { class: 'dm-ask-card' + (danger ? ' danger' : ''), role: 'alertdialog', 'aria-modal': 'true', 'aria-label': title },
      icon(danger ? 'alert' : 'check'), h('h3', {}, title), h('p', {}, text), input, h('div', { class: 'dm-actions end' }, no, yes)));
    asking.onkeydown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); askEscapedAt = Date.now(); finish(password ? null : false); }
      else if (e.key === 'Enter' && input && e.target === input) { e.preventDefault(); yes.click(); }
    };
    asking.hidden = false; (input ?? no).focus();
  });
}

// The two launch options are checkboxes of the page (main.js reads them by id): they are wrapped once in a switch, which lives

}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- tab: this device
function gameRow(game, data) {
  const has = !!(data?.profile || data?.cache), card = h('article', { class: 'dm-game' + (has ? '' : ' empty') });
  const version = versionOf(game), port = (app.games.get(game)?.runtime ?? 'win32') !== 'win32';
  card.append(h('div', { class: 'dm-game-top' },
    h('div', { class: 'dm-game-icon', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, (nameOf(game)[0] ?? 'O').toUpperCase()),
    h('div', { class: 'dm-game-id' }, h('strong', {}, nameOf(game)), version ? h('span', { class: 'dm-tag' }, version) : null),
    has ? h('div', { class: 'dm-figs' },
      h('span', {}, t('saves'), h('b', {}, fmtBytes(data.profile ?? 0))),
      h('span', { title: t('cacheHelp') }, t('cache'), h('b', {}, fmtBytes(data.cache ?? 0)))) : null));
  // (a browser port: its saves come back from the account at its start — no import here)
  card.append(row(data?.profile ? btn(t('export'), () => exportLocal(game), { variant: 'primary', ico: 'download', key: 'export:' + game, small: true }) : null,
    port ? null : btn(t('import'), () => pickImport(game), { variant: 'ghost', ico: 'upload', key: 'import:' + game, small: true })));
  if (has) card.append(fold('clean:' + game, t('clean'),
    data.cache ? h('div', { class: 'dm-clean' }, h('div', {}, h('strong', {}, t('cleanCache') + ' · ' + fmtBytes(data.cache)), h('p', {}, t('cleanCacheText')), readers(game).length ? h('p', {}, t('sharedWith', readers(game).map(nameOf).join(', '))) : null, app.games.get(game)?.owners.length ? h('p', {}, t('keptUnder', app.games.get(game).owners.map(nameOf).join(', '))) : null), btn(t('cleanCache'), () => clearCache(game), { variant: 'danger', ico: 'trash', key: 'cache:' + game, small: true })) : null,
    data.profile ? h('div', { class: 'dm-clean' }, h('div', {}, h('strong', {}, t('cleanSaves') + ' · ' + fmtBytes(data.profile)), h('p', {}, t('cleanSavesText'))), btn(t('cleanSaves'), () => clearProfile(game), { variant: 'danger', ico: 'trash', key: 'saves:' + game, small: true })) : null));
  if (port && has) card.append(h('p', { class: 'dm-playing' }, icon('alert'), t('portOpen')));
  if (activeGame(game)) card.append(h('p', { class: 'dm-playing' }, icon('alert'), t('playing')));
  return card;
}
function renderDevice() {
  content.append(head(t('tabDevice'), t('deviceTitle'), t('deviceLead')));
  const st = app.storage;
  if (!st) { content.append(h('div', { class: 'dm-skeleton' }, h('i'), h('i'), h('i'))); return; }
  const pct = st.quota ? Math.min(100, Math.max(st.usage ? 1 : 0, st.usage / st.quota * 100)) : 0;
  content.append(h('div', { class: 'dm-stats' },
    h('div', { class: 'dm-stat' }, h('span', { class: 'dm-k' }, t('used')), h('strong', { class: 'dm-big' }, fmtBytes(st.usage)),
      st.quota ? h('div', { class: 'dm-meter', role: 'img', 'aria-label': Math.round(pct) + '%' }, h('i', { style: `width:${pct}%` })) : null,
      h('small', {}, st.quota ? t('ofQuota', fmtBytes(st.quota)) : t('quotaUnknown'))),
    h('div', { class: 'dm-stat' + (st.persistent ? ' good' : ' warn') }, h('span', { class: 'dm-k' }, t('protection')),
      h('strong', { class: 'dm-state' }, icon(st.persistent ? 'shield' : 'alert'), st.persistent ? t('protectionOn') : t('protectionOff')),
      h('small', {}, st.persistent ? t('protectionOnText') : t('protectionOffText')),
      st.persistent ? null : btn(t('protectionAsk'), () => run(t('protectionWork'), async () => ((await navigator.storage.persist()) ? t('protectionDone') : t('protectionDenied'))), { variant: 'primary', key: 'persist', small: true }))));
  const names = new Set([...app.games].filter(([, g]) => showAll || !g.hidden).map(([n]) => n));
  for (const g of st.games) if (g.profile || g.cache) names.add(g.game);
  const sorted = [...names].sort((a, b) => nameOf(a).localeCompare(nameOf(b)) || String(versionOf(b)).localeCompare(String(versionOf(a)), undefined, { numeric: true }));
  const dataOf = (g) => st.games.find((x) => x.game === g);
  const withData = sorted.filter((g) => dataOf(g)?.profile || dataOf(g)?.cache), without = sorted.filter((g) => !withData.includes(g));
  content.append(h('h3', { class: 'dm-section' }, t('games')));
  if (!sorted.length) content.append(panel('box', t('noGames'), t('noGamesText')));
  else {
    if (withData.length) content.append(h('div', { class: 'dm-list' }, withData.map((g) => gameRow(g, dataOf(g)))));
    if (without.length) content.append(fold('nodata', t('noData', without.length), h('div', { class: 'dm-list' }, without.map((g) => gameRow(g, dataOf(g))))));
  }
  if (st.asides.length) {
    content.append(h('h3', { class: 'dm-section' }, t('asides')), h('p', { class: 'dm-sub' }, t('asidesText')));
    content.append(h('div', { class: 'dm-list tight' }, st.asides.map((item) => {
      const m = /^orthros-(.+)-aside-(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d)T(\d\d)-(\d\d)/.exec(item.name), when = m ? new Date(`${m[2]}T${m[3]}:${m[4]}:00Z`).getTime() : 0;
      return h('div', { class: 'dm-line' }, h('span', {}, h('strong', {}, m ? nameOf(m[1]) : item.name), h('small', {}, (when ? stamp(when) + ' · ' : '') + fmtBytes(item.bytes))),
        btn(t('delete'), () => removeAside(item), { variant: 'danger', ico: 'trash', key: 'aside:' + item.name, small: true }));
    })));
  }
  const others = (st.others ?? []).filter((item) => item.bytes > 0);
  if (others.length) {
    content.append(h('h3', { class: 'dm-section' }, t('others')), h('p', { class: 'dm-sub' }, t('othersText')));
    content.append(h('div', { class: 'dm-list tight' }, others.map((item) => {
      const name = t('otherNames')[item.name] ?? item.name;
      return h('div', { class: 'dm-line' }, h('span', {}, h('strong', {}, name), h('small', {}, fmtBytes(item.bytes))),
        btn(t('cacheOk'), () => run(t('wCache'), async () => {
          if (!await ask({ title: t('cacheAsk', name), text: t('cacheAskText'), ok: t('cacheOk'), danger: true })) return t('cancelled');
          await removeOther(item.name); return t('rCache');
        }), { variant: 'danger', ico: 'trash', key: 'other:' + item.name, small: true }));
    })));
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- tab: online
function cloudRow(game) {
  const remote = app.cloud.get(game), local = app.storage?.games.find((g) => g.game === game), card = h('article', { class: 'dm-game cloud' });
  const version = versionOf(game), port = (app.games.get(game)?.runtime ?? 'win32') !== 'win32';
  card.append(h('div', { class: 'dm-game-top' },
    h('div', { class: 'dm-game-icon', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, icon('cloud')),
    h('div', { class: 'dm-game-id' }, h('strong', {}, nameOf(game)), version ? h('span', { class: 'dm-tag' }, version) : null),
    h('div', { class: 'dm-figs one' }, remote ? h('span', {}, t('online'), h('b', {}, `${t('version', remote.version)} · ${fmtBytes(remote.size)}`), h('small', {}, stamp(remote.updatedAt))) : h('span', { class: 'dim' }, t('noCopy')))));
  card.append(row(local?.profile ? btn(t('send'), () => uploadGame(game, true), { variant: 'primary', ico: 'upload', key: 'send:' + game, small: true }) : null,
    remote && !port ? btn(t('restore'), () => restoreCloud(game), { variant: 'ghost', ico: 'restore', key: 'restore:' + game, small: true }) : null,
    remote ? btn(t('history'), () => toggleHistory(game), { variant: 'ghost', ico: 'clock', key: 'history:' + game, small: true }) : null));
  if (port) card.append(h('p', {}, t('portSaves')), h('a', { href: app.games.get(game).launchUrl }, t('playPort')));
  if (app.expanded === game) {
    card.append(h('div', { class: 'dm-history' }, (app.histories.get(game) ?? []).map((v) => h('div', { class: 'dm-line' },
      h('span', {}, h('strong', {}, t('version', v.version)), h('small', {}, `${stamp(v.createdAt)} · ${fmtBytes(v.size)}`)),
      row(!port ? btn(t('restore'), () => restoreCloud(game, v.version), { variant: 'ghost', ico: 'restore', small: true }) : null, btn(t('downloadBtn'), () => downloadCloud(game, v.version), { variant: 'ghost', ico: 'download', small: true }))))));
  }
  if (remote) card.append(fold('online:' + game, t('more'), h('div', { class: 'dm-clean' }, h('div', {}, h('strong', {}, t('deleteOnline'))), btn(t('deleteOnline'), () => deleteCloud(game), { variant: 'danger', ico: 'trash', key: 'del:' + game, small: true }))));
  return card;
}
function renderCloud() {
  content.append(head(t('tabCloud'), t('cloudTitle'), t('cloudLead')));
  if (!app.account) {
    content.append(panel('cloud', t('cloudOffTitle'), app.accountsOn === false ? t('accountsOff') : t('cloudOffText'),
      app.accountsOn === false ? null : btn(t('signIn'), () => { app.tab = 'account'; render(); }, { variant: 'primary', key: 'signin' })));
    return;
  }
  content.append(h('div', { class: 'dm-bar' }, h('div', {}, h('strong', {}, t('signedAs', app.account.username)), h('small', {}, t('keeps'))),
    btn(t('syncAll'), () => run(t('wSync'), syncAll), { variant: 'primary', ico: 'sync', key: 'sync' })));
  const names = new Set([...app.cloud.keys(), ...(app.storage?.games ?? []).filter((g) => g.profile > 0).map((g) => g.game)]);
  const sorted = [...names].sort((a, b) => nameOf(a).localeCompare(nameOf(b)));
  content.append(h('h3', { class: 'dm-section' }, t('games')));
  content.append(sorted.length ? h('div', { class: 'dm-list' }, sorted.map(cloudRow)) : panel('box', t('noSaves'), t('noSavesText')));

}

      h('button', { type: 'submit', class: 'dm-btn primary', disabled: app.busy }, hasPassword ? t('changePasswordBtn') : t('setPasswordBtn')));
    pw.onsubmit = (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(pw)); run(t('wPassword'), async () => { await jsonApi('/api/account/password', 'POST', data); pw.reset(); if (!hasPassword) { app.account = { ...app.account, password: true }; accountChanged(app.account); } return hasPassword ? t('passwordChanged') : t('passwordSet'); }, false); };
    content.append(fold('password', hasPassword ? t('changePassword') : t('setPassword'), pw));
    content.append(h('div', { class: 'dm-zone' }, h('div', {}, h('strong', {}, t('deleteAccount')), h('p', {}, t('deleteAccountText'))),
      btn(t('deleteAccountBtn'), () => deleteAccount(), { variant: 'danger', ico: 'trash', key: 'delaccount' })), legal());
    return;
  }
  const seg = h('div', { class: 'dm-seg', role: 'tablist' }, ['login', 'register'].map((mode) => h('button', { type: 'button', role: 'tab', 'aria-selected': String(app.accountMode === mode), class: app.accountMode === mode ? 'on' : '', disabled: app.busy,
    onclick: () => { app.accountMode = mode; render(); } }, t(mode))));
  const form = h('form', { class: 'dm-form' }, field(t('username'), 'text', 'username', 'username'), field(t('password'), 'password', 'password', app.accountMode === 'login' ? 'current-password' : 'new-password'),
    h('button', { type: 'submit', class: 'dm-btn primary', disabled: app.busy }, app.accountMode === 'login' ? t('login') : t('createBtn')));
  form.onsubmit = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault(); const data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));
    run(app.accountMode === 'login' ? t('wLogin') : t('wRegister'), async () => {
      const result = await jsonApi('/api/account/' + app.accountMode, 'POST', data);
      app.account = result.user; form.reset(); updateAccountButton(); accountChanged(result.user);
      await refresh(); await syncAll(); return t('connected');
    });
  };
  if (app.google) content.append(h('button', { type: 'button', class: 'dm-google-btn', disabled: app.busy, 'data-k': 'google', onclick: () => withGoogle(false) }, googleMark(), t('google')), h('div', { class: 'dm-or' }, h('span', {}, t('or'))));
  content.append(seg, form, h('p', { class: 'dm-foot' }, t('accountRules')), legal());
}
const googleMark = () => { const s = h('span', { class: 'dm-g', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }); s.innerHTML = GOOGLE_G; return s; };
/** Google in its own window: the status line waits for it without blocking this one (the player may close it). */
async function withGoogle(link) {
  app.tone = 'info'; app.message = t('googleWindow'); render();
  const r = await googleSignIn(lang, { link });
  if (!r.ok) { app.tone = 'error'; app.message = googleText(r, lang); render(); return; }
  if (link) { app.tone = 'ok'; app.message = googleText(r, lang); await refresh({ account: true }); return; }
  await run(t('wLogin'), async () => { await refresh({ account: true }); updateAccountButton(); await syncAll(); return t('connected'); });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- actions
const portKey = (game) => app.games.get(game)?.saveKey ?? null;
/** A port's saves as one archive (the account's format): null when it has none. */
async function archivePort(game) {
  const files = await portFiles(portKey(game)); if (!files.length) return null;
  return new Uint8Array(await new Response(new Blob([encodeProfile(game, files)]).stream().pipeThrough(new CompressionStream('gzip'))).arrayBuffer());
}
async function exportLocal(game) {
  return run(t('wExport'), async () => {
    const bytes = portKey(game) ? await archivePort(game) : await archiveProfile(game, state());
    if (!bytes) throw new Error(t('rNoSave'));
    download(bytes, game + '-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + '.orthros-save');
    return t('rExported', fmtBytes(bytes.length));
  }, false);
}
const picker = h('input', { type: 'file', accept: '.orthros-save,.gz', hidden: true });
document.body.append(picker);
let importGame = null;
function pickImport(game) {
  if (activeGame(game)) { app.tone = 'error'; app.message = t('rQuit'); render(); return; }
  importGame = game; picker.value = ''; picker.click();
}
picker.onchange = () => {
  const file = picker.files?.[0], game = importGame;
  if (!file || !game) return;
  run(t('wImport'), async () => {
    const archive = await parseArchive(await file.arrayBuffer(), game);
    if (!await ask({ title: t('importAsk', nameOf(game)), text: t('importAskText'), ok: t('importOk') })) return t('cancelled');
    return t('rImported', await restoreProfile(game, archive, state()));
  });
};
function clearCache(game) {
  return run(t('wCache'), async () => {
    if (!await ask({ title: t('cacheAsk', nameOf(game)), text: t('cacheAskText'), ok: t('cacheOk'), danger: true })) return t('cancelled');
    // (a port: the files its earlier pages kept in its database too)
    if (portKey(game)) await clearPortCache(portKey(game));
    await removeCache(game, state());
    return t('rCache');
  });
}
function clearProfile(game) {
  return run(t('wSaves'), async () => {
    if (!await ask({ title: t('savesAsk', nameOf(game)), text: t('savesAskText'), ok: t('savesOk'), danger: true })) return t('cancelled');
    if (portKey(game)) await clearPortSaves(portKey(game)); else await removeProfile(game, state());
    return t('rSaves');
  });
}
function removeAside(item) {
  return run(t('wAside'), async () => {
    if (!await ask({ title: t('asideAsk'), text: t('asideAskText'), ok: t('delete'), danger: true })) return t('cancelled');
    await (await navigator.storage.getDirectory()).removeEntry(item.name, { recursive: true }); return t('rAside');
  });
}
async function uploadGame(game, force = false) {
  return run(t('wSend'), async () => {
    const remote = app.cloud.get(game), c = cloudFor(game);
    if (remote && force && !await ask({ title: t('publishAsk'), text: t('publishAskText'), ok: t('publishOk') })) return t('cancelled');
    const st = force ? await c.resolve('device') : await c.push();
    return outcome(st, true);
  });
}
/** A CloudSave status as the window's result line (or its error). */
function outcome(st, sent) {
  if (st.state === 'saved') return sent ? t('rSent', st.version) : t('rAlready');
  if (st.state === 'conflict') throw new Error(t('rDiffers'));
  if (st.state === 'toobig') throw new Error(t('rTooBig'));
  if (st.state === 'error') throw new Error(errorText(st.message, lang) || t('errConnection'));
  if (st.state === 'off') throw new Error(t('cloudOffText'));
  return t('done');
}
/** Every Windows game's profile kept in this browser sent when it changed; the conflicts left for the player. */
async function syncAll() {
  // (only the games the server lists — the account keeps no other —, and a profile the account could take: each is
  // read whole into memory, several times its size)
  const rows = (app.storage?.games ?? []).filter((g) => g.profile > 0 && g.profile <= MAX_RAW && !activeGame(g.game) && app.games.has(g.game) && (app.games.get(g.game).runtime ?? 'win32') === 'win32');
  let uploaded = 0, conflicts = 0;
  for (const item of rows) {
    const c = cloudFor(item.game), st = await c.push();
    if (st.state === 'conflict') conflicts++;
    else if (st.state === 'saved' && st.version) { uploaded++; app.cloud.set(item.game, { game: item.game, hash: c.remoteHash, version: st.version, size: 0, updatedAt: Date.now() }); }
  }
  return t('rSynced', uploaded, conflicts);
}
async function restoreCloud(game, version) {
  return run(t('wRestore'), async () => {
    if (activeGame(game)) throw new Error(t('rQuit'));
    if (!await ask({ title: t('restoreAsk', nameOf(game)), text: t('restoreAskText'), ok: t('importOk') })) return t('cancelled');
    if (!version || version === app.cloud.get(game)?.version) { await cloudFor(game).resolve('account'); return t('rRestored', true); }
    // (an older version of the history: put in place, this device's copy kept aside; the account's latest unchanged)
    const archive = await parseArchive(new Uint8Array(await (await api('/api/cloud/' + encodeURIComponent(game) + '/' + version)).arrayBuffer()), game);
    return t('rRestored', await restoreProfile(game, archive, state()));
  });
}
async function downloadCloud(game, version) {
  return run(t('wDownload'), async () => {
    download(new Uint8Array(await (await api('/api/cloud/' + encodeURIComponent(game) + '/' + version)).arrayBuffer()), game + '-v' + version + '.orthros-save');
    return t('rVersion', version);
  }, false);
}
async function deleteCloud(game) {
  return run(t('wDeleteOnline'), async () => {
    if (!await ask({ title: t('deleteOnlineAsk', nameOf(game)), text: t('deleteOnlineAskText'), ok: t('delete'), danger: true })) return t('cancelled');
    await api('/api/cloud/' + encodeURIComponent(game), { method: 'DELETE' });
    try { localStorage.removeItem(`orthros.sync.${app.account?.username}.${game}`); } catch { /* storage off */ }
    return t('rDeleted');
  });
}
async function toggleHistory(game) {
  if (app.expanded === game) { app.expanded = null; render(); return; }
  return run(t('wHistory'), async () => {
    app.histories.set(game, (await jsonApi('/api/cloud/' + encodeURIComponent(game) + '/history')).versions); app.expanded = game;
    return t('rHistory');
  }, false);
}
async function deleteAccount() {
  return run(t('wAccount'), async () => {
    // (an account made with Google, without a password: its name typed again)
    const byName = app.account?.password === false;
    const answer = await ask({ title: t('accountAsk'), text: byName ? t('accountAskTextName') : t('accountAskText'), ok: t('deleteAccountBtn'), danger: true, password: byName ? 'username' : true });
    if (!answer) return t('cancelled');
    if (!await ask({ title: t('finalAsk'), text: t('finalAskText'), ok: t('finalOk'), danger: true })) return t('cancelled');
    await jsonApi('/api/account', 'DELETE', byName ? { username: answer.trim().toLowerCase() } : { password: answer });
    app.account = null; app.cloud.clear(); updateAccountButton(); accountChanged(null);
    return t('rAccountDeleted');
  });
}
```
