`src/host/web/data-meter-worker.js`:

```js
// The indicator data-meter.js shows while a game waits for its game data, drawn here so that it moves while the page's
// thread is held by the engine's read: shown when the page has painted nothing for a second and asked for game data
// meanwhile (or for three seconds whatever it does), or when the engine's reads have waited for the network a second
// and a half (an engine that suspends meanwhile: the page goes on painting); gone once neither has held for a moment
// (LINGER_MS: reasons that come and go do not make it blink).
const TEXT = {
  en: { data: 'Loading the game data', busy: 'Loading…', mb: 'MB', rate: 'MB/s',
    dataNote: 'Not stuck: the game is receiving its files. Faster next time.', busyNote: 'Not stuck: the game is working.',
    wait: 'If Chrome says the page is not responding, choose “Wait”.' },
  fr: { data: 'Chargement des données du jeu', busy: 'Chargement…', mb: 'Mo', rate: 'Mo/s',
    dataNote: 'Pas bloqué : le jeu reçoit ses fichiers. Plus rapide la prochaine fois.', busyNote: 'Pas bloqué : le jeu travaille.',
    wait: 'Si Chrome dit que la page ne répond pas, choisis « Attendre ».' },
};
let ctx = null, dpr = 1, S = TEXT.en, num = new Intl.NumberFormat('en', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 });
/** once shown, the indicator stays this long (ms) after its reasons are gone, its "reading" line too */
const LINGER_MS = 1500;
let beat = performance.now(), hidden = false, shown = false, since = 0, wanted = 0, readingAt = -Infinity;
let reads = 0, done = 0, pending = 0, lastRead = 0;
const marks = [];   // [time, bytes received] of the last seconds: the rate
let arrived = null, seen = 0, waitSince = null, waitLast = 0;   // (Orthros' streaming: its count of the bytes arrived, shared — exact, live)

/** Data asked for or arriving (a pause of 5 s: a new count). */
function arrive(now, bytes) {
  if (now - lastRead > 5000) { reads = done = pending = 0; marks.length = 0; }
  reads++; done += bytes; lastRead = now;
  marks.push([now, done]); while (marks.length > 2 && marks[0][0] < now - 4000) marks.shift();
}

onmessage = (e) => {
  const m = e.data, now = performance.now();
  if (m.canvas) {
    ctx = m.canvas.getContext('2d'); dpr = m.dpr || 1; S = TEXT[m.lang] ?? TEXT.en; num = new Intl.NumberFormat(m.lang, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 });
    // (a first, empty frame while the page's thread is free: the page shows this canvas's frames from then on, its
    // thread held or not — not before it has taken one)
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 1, 1);
    // (each font the indicator uses drawn once soon, while the page's thread is free, then wiped: a font's first use
    // in this worker waits for that thread — the whole hold long, were it the first one; measured in a real start:
    // one frame drawn in a 50 s hold)
    for (const at of [300, 3000]) setTimeout(warm, at);
    return;
  }
  if (m.beat) { beat = now; return; }
  if ('hidden' in m) { hidden = !!m.hidden; beat = now; return; }
  if (m.arrived) { arrived = new Int32Array(m.arrived); seen = Atomics.load(arrived, 2); return; }
  if (m.read) {
    // (one read at a time: a new piece asked for is the end of the previous one — counted so when no exact count)
    if (arrived) arrive(now, 0); else { arrive(now, pending); pending = m.read; }
  }
};

setInterval(() => {
  const now = performance.now();
  if (arrived) { const cur = Atomics.load(arrived, 2), d = (cur - seen) | 0; seen = cur; if (d > 1) arrive(now, d); }
  const waiting = !!arrived && Atomics.load(arrived, 6) > 0;
  // (a wait goes on while the engine's reads wait one after the other: over once none has waited for a second)
  if (waiting) { waitSince ??= now; waitLast = now; } else if (now - waitLast > 1000) waitSince = null;
  // (since the page's last frame — its thread held —, or since the engine's reads began to wait — the page painting)
  const sinceFrame = now - beat, sinceWait = waitSince === null ? 0 : now - waitSince;
  const held = Math.max(sinceFrame, sinceWait);
  const reading = waiting || (reads > 0 && now - lastRead < sinceFrame + 500);
  const want = !!ctx && !hidden && ((sinceFrame > 1000 && reading) || sinceFrame > 3000 || sinceWait > 1500);
  // (its seconds counted from the start of the wait it shows, not reset by a frame the page paints meanwhile)
  if (want) { if (!shown) since = now - held; wanted = now; if (reading) readingAt = now; }
  if (ctx && !hidden && (want || (shown && now - wanted < LINGER_MS))) draw(now, now - readingAt < LINGER_MS); else if (shown) clear();
}, 100);

const FONTS = ['600 15px system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif', '700 17px system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif', '600 13px system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif', '12.5px system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif'];
function warm() {
  if (shown) return;
  const glyphs = Object.values(S).join(' ') + ' 0123456789 % / · , .';
  for (const font of FONTS) { ctx.font = font; ctx.fillText(glyphs, 0, 20); }
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, ctx.canvas.width, ctx.canvas.height);
}

function clear() { ctx.clearRect(0, 0, ctx.canvas.width, ctx.canvas.height); shown = false; readingAt = -Infinity; }

function draw(now, reading) {
  shown = true;
  const c = ctx, W = c.canvas.width / dpr, H = c.canvas.height / dpr;
  c.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0); c.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  c.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,14,20,0.9)'; c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(214,166,92,0.55)'; c.lineWidth = 1;
  c.beginPath(); c.roundRect(0.5, 0.5, W - 1, H - 1, 10); c.fill(); c.stroke();
  // (the step of the game's data being read, when earlier sessions tell how much of it remains: Orthros' streaming,
  // ctrl[4], [5]; once all they learned has come, the step goes on with no known end — no total, no percentage)
  const kb = arrived ? Atomics.load(arrived, 4) : 0, of = arrived ? Atomics.load(arrived, 5) : 0;
  const known = reading && of > 0 && num.format(kb / 1024) !== num.format(of / 1024);
  const pct = known ? Math.min(99, Math.floor(kb / of * 100)) : -1;
  const held = now - since;
  // the bar: filled as far as the step is, a light running along it — the proof the page is alive
  const bx = 16, by = H - 12, bw = W - 32, run = ((now / 1400) % 1) * (bw + 120) - 120;
  c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'; c.beginPath(); c.roundRect(bx, by, bw, 5, 2.5); c.fill();
  c.save(); c.beginPath(); c.roundRect(bx, by, bw, 5, 2.5); c.clip();
  if (pct >= 0) { c.fillStyle = 'rgba(232,160,64,0.85)'; c.fillRect(bx, by, bw * pct / 100, 5); }
  const g = c.createLinearGradient(bx + run, 0, bx + run + 120, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,214,140,0)'); g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,214,140,0.9)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,214,140,0)');
  c.fillStyle = g; c.fillRect(bx + run, by, 120, 5); c.restore();
  c.textBaseline = 'alphabetic'; c.textAlign = 'left'; c.fillStyle = '#f2e6cf'; c.font = '600 15px system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
  c.fillText(reading ? S.data : S.busy, 16, 25);
  if (pct >= 0) { c.textAlign = 'right'; c.fillStyle = '#f0aa46'; c.font = '700 17px system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif'; c.fillText(`${pct} %`, W - 16, 26); c.textAlign = 'left'; }
  // the second line: what arrived (of how much), how fast, for how long
  let rate = 0;
  if (marks.length > 1 && now - marks[0][0] > 800) rate = (done - marks[0][1]) / ((now - marks[0][0]) / 1000) / 1048576;
  const parts = [];
  if (reading) parts.push(known ? `${num.format(kb / 1024)} / ${num.format(of / 1024)} ${S.mb}` : `${num.format(kb > 0 ? kb / 1024 : done / 1048576)} ${S.mb}`);
  if (reading && rate > 0.05) parts.push(`${num.format(rate)} ${S.rate}`);
  parts.push(`${Math.floor(held / 1000)} s`);
  c.font = '600 13px system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif'; c.fillStyle = '#f0aa46'; c.fillText(parts.join(' · '), 16, 46);
  c.font = '12.5px system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif'; c.fillStyle = 'rgba(242,230,207,0.72)';
  // (Chrome offers to close a page that has not answered a click for a while: it is only waiting)
  c.fillText(held > 8000 ? S.wait : reading ? S.dataNote : S.busyNote, 16, 66);
}
```

`src/host/web/data-meter.js`:

```js
// The indicator every game shows while it waits for its game data (CLAUDE.md "Standardization": the engines that run
// in the page — imported by the GoldSrc and re3 pages, put into the OpenMW engine's page by the server, withFrameMeter).
// An engine reading its files synchronously holds the page's thread while they come (the page cannot paint: a minute or
// more when a new game or a new area needs hundreds of MB); one that suspends meanwhile (JSPI) does not, but waits all
// the same. The indicator is drawn by a worker (data-meter-worker.js, an OffscreenCanvas: its frames reach the screen
// without the page's thread) from the game data's shared counters (src/vfs/data-client.js: bytes received, the step's
// size, the reads waiting — attach()) and from the frames it stops getting. Over the top page (the Orthros page around
// an engine's frame, its loading screen too), under its header.
(() => {
  if (typeof OffscreenCanvas !== 'function' || !HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.transferControlToOffscreen) return;
  let lang = null;
  try { lang = localStorage.getItem('orthros.lang'); } catch { /* storage off */ }
  if (!lang) lang = (navigator.languages?.length ? navigator.languages : [navigator.language]).map((l) => String(l).slice(0, 2).toLowerCase()).find((l) => ['fr', 'en'].includes(l)) ?? 'en';
  const meter = new Worker('/src/host/web/data-meter-worker.js');
  const send = Worker.prototype.postMessage;
  Worker.prototype.postMessage = function (m, ...rest) {
    // (without the game data — OpenMW's own streaming, ?sfs=upstream —: a piece its worker is asked for, { start, end,
    // gen, url | id }, the page's thread waiting for it next)
    if (this !== meter && m && typeof m.gen === 'number' && typeof m.start === 'number' && typeof m.end === 'number') send.call(meter, { read: m.end - m.start });
    return send.call(this, m, ...rest);
  };
  // (the game data, src/vfs/data-client.js, hands over its counters: read live)
  window.orthrosDataMeter = { attach(buffer) { send.call(meter, { arrived: buffer }); } };
  let last = 0;
  const beat = (t) => { if (t - last > 100) { last = t; send.call(meter, { beat: 1 }); } requestAnimationFrame(beat); };
  requestAnimationFrame(beat);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => send.call(meter, { hidden: document.hidden }));
  const place = () => {
    let doc = document;
    try { if (window.top.document.body) doc = window.top.document; } catch { /* another origin's page: this one */ }
    const w = 480, h = 90, dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    const canvas = doc.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width = w * dpr; canvas.height = h * dpr; canvas.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    Object.assign(canvas.style, { position: 'fixed', left: '50%', top: '56px', transform: 'translateX(-50%)', width: w + 'px', height: h + 'px', maxWidth: '96vw', zIndex: '2147483647', pointerEvents: 'none' });
    doc.body.append(canvas);
    addEventListener('pagehide', () => canvas.remove());
    const off = canvas.transferControlToOffscreen();
    send.call(meter, { canvas: off, dpr, lang }, [off]);
  };
  if (document.body) place(); else addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', place);
})();
```

`src/host/web/data-store.js`:

```js
// Browser-only profile and cache operations. Nothing here sends game files to the server.
const PROFILE_PREFIX = 'orthros-';
const CACHE_PREFIX = 'orthros-files-';
// (a game's snapshot of its machine, docs/snapshot.md: regenerable like the cache, counted and cleared with it)
export const SNAPSHOT_PREFIX = 'orthros-snapshot-';
// (the page's other folders under the profiles' prefix — never a game's profile, which the account's sync reads whole
// and sends: the translated code kept across sessions, one file per game, <game>.bin (src/cpu/jit/bg-translate.js),
// counted and cleared with that game's cache; the OpenMW page's file copies of 2026-10-20 (src/ports/openmw/
// legacy-copies.js: taken into the game data at a file's first read), of no single game)
const JIT_CACHE = 'orthros-jitcache';
const OTHER_CACHES = ['orthros-streamfs-1'];
// (a restore's folder left by a page closed meanwhile: a copy, like the ones kept aside)
const LEFT_ASIDE = /-aside-\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT|-restore-\d+$/;
const ARCHIVE_FORMAT = 'orthros-profile';
const MAX_FILES = 10000;
// (a profile at most this large: an archive of it can be restored, the account's sync reads it)
export const MAX_RAW = 128 * 1024 * 1024;

export function formatBytes(n) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) return '—';
  if (n < 1024) return n + ' o';
  const units = ['Ko', 'Mo', 'Go', 'To'];
  let i = -1;
  do { n /= 1024; i++; } while (n >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1);
  return n.toLocaleString('fr-FR', { maximumFractionDigits: n < 10 ? 1 : 0 }) + ' ' + units[i];
}

async function dirBytes(dir) {
  let bytes = 0, files = 0, locked = 0;
  for await (const [, handle] of dir.entries()) {
    if (handle.kind === 'directory') {
      const sub = await dirBytes(handle);
      bytes += sub.bytes; files += sub.files; locked += sub.locked;
    } else {
      try { bytes += (await handle.getFile()).size; files++; } catch { locked++; }
    }
  }
  return { bytes, files, locked };
}

export async function scanStorage() {
  const root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();
  const games = new Map(), asides = [], others = [];
  const rowOf = (game) => games.get(game) ?? games.set(game, { game, profile: 0, cache: 0, files: 0, locked: 0 }).get(game);
  for await (const [name, handle] of root.entries()) {
    if (handle.kind !== 'directory') continue;
    if (name === JIT_CACHE) {
      for await (const [file, h] of handle.entries()) {
        if (h.kind !== 'file' || !file.endsWith('.bin')) continue;
        const row = rowOf(file.slice(0, -4));
        try { row.cache += (await h.getFile()).size; } catch { row.locked++; } // (a running game's: open)
      }
    } else if (OTHER_CACHES.includes(name)) {
      others.push({ name, ...await dirBytes(handle) });
    } else if (name.startsWith(CACHE_PREFIX) || name.startsWith(SNAPSHOT_PREFIX)) {
      const row = rowOf(name.slice((name.startsWith(CACHE_PREFIX) ? CACHE_PREFIX : SNAPSHOT_PREFIX).length));
      const size = await dirBytes(handle);
      row.cache += size.bytes; row.locked += size.locked;
    } else if (name.startsWith(PROFILE_PREFIX)) {
      const game = name.slice(PROFILE_PREFIX.length);
      const size = await dirBytes(handle);
      if (LEFT_ASIDE.test(game)) {
        asides.push({ name, ...size });
      } else {
        const row = rowOf(game);
        row.profile = size.bytes; row.files = size.files; row.locked += size.locked;
      }
    }
  }
  const quota = await navigator.storage.estimate();
  return { games: [...games.values()].sort((a, b) => a.game.localeCompare(b.game)), asides, others,
    usage: quota.usage ?? 0, quota: quota.quota ?? 0, persistent: await navigator.storage.persisted?.() ?? false };
}

function validPath(name) {
  return typeof name === 'string' && name.length > 0 && name.length <= 1024 &&
    !name.startsWith('/') && !name.includes('\\') && !/[\x00-\x1f]/.test(name) &&
    name.split('/').every((p) => p && p !== '.' && p !== '..');
}
function base64(bytes) {
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000)
    s += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
  return btoa(s);
}
function unbase64(s) {
  const binary = atob(s), bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
  return bytes;
}
async function collect(dir, prefix, out) {
  for await (const [name, handle] of dir.entries()) {
    const path = prefix ? prefix + '/' + name : name;
    if (handle.kind === 'directory') await collect(handle, path, out);
    else out.push({ path, data: base64(new Uint8Array(await (await handle.getFile()).arrayBuffer())) });
  }
}
async function activeFiles(game, state) {
  const worker = state?.worker;
  if (!worker || state.manifest !== game || !['running', 'loading', 'starting'].includes(state.status)) return null;
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => { worker.removeEventListener('message', onMessage); reject(new Error('Le jeu ne répond pas à la demande de sauvegarde.')); }, 20000);
    function onMessage(event) {
      if (event.data?.type !== 'profile') return;
      clearTimeout(timeout); worker.removeEventListener('message', onMessage);
      resolve(event.data.files);
    }
    worker.addEventListener('message', onMessage);
    worker.postMessage({ type: 'profile-dump' });
  });
}
/**
 * The profile's files a player keeps (cloud-sync.js): [{ path, data: Uint8Array }], from the running game when it is
 * this one, else from this browser's copy. The profile's Temp folder is left out (the game's scratch files).
 */
export async function profileFiles(game, state) {
  let files = await activeFiles(game, state);
  if (!files) {
    const root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();
    let dir; try { dir = await root.getDirectoryHandle(PROFILE_PREFIX + game); } catch { return []; }
    files = [];
    await collect(dir, '', files);
  }
  return files.filter((f) => !/^temp(\/|$)/i.test(f.path)).map((f) => ({ path: f.path, data: unbase64(f.data) }));
}
/** This browser's profile of the game replaced by `files` ([{ path, data: Uint8Array }]); the previous one kept aside. */
export async function replaceProfile(game, files, state) {
  return restoreProfile(game, { files: files.map((f) => ({ path: f.path, data: base64(f.data) })) }, state);
}
export async function archiveProfile(game, state) {
  let files = await activeFiles(game, state);
  if (!files) {
    const root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();
    let dir; try { dir = await root.getDirectoryHandle(PROFILE_PREFIX + game); } catch { return null; }
    files = [];
    await collect(dir, '', files);
  }
  if (!files.length) return null;
  files.sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
  const json = JSON.stringify({ format: ARCHIVE_FORMAT, version: 1, game, files });
  const stream = new Blob([json]).stream().pipeThrough(new CompressionStream('gzip'));
  return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());
}
export async function parseArchive(bytes, expectedGame) {
  if (bytes.byteLength > 64 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error('Fichier trop volumineux.');
  let archive;
  try {
    const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'));
    archive = JSON.parse(await new Response(stream).text());
  } catch { throw new Error('Ce fichier ne contient pas une sauvegarde Orthros valide.'); }
  if (archive?.format !== ARCHIVE_FORMAT || archive.version !== 1 || archive.game !== expectedGame || !Array.isArray(archive.files))
    throw new Error('Cette sauvegarde ne correspond pas à ce jeu.');
  if (archive.files.length > MAX_FILES) throw new Error('Trop de fichiers dans la sauvegarde.');
  const seen = new Set(); let total = 0;
  for (const file of archive.files) {
    if (!validPath(file.path) || seen.has(file.path) || typeof file.data !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(file.data))
      throw new Error('Chemin ou contenu de sauvegarde invalide.');
    seen.add(file.path); total += file.data.length * 3 / 4;
    if (total > MAX_RAW) throw new Error('Sauvegarde trop volumineuse une fois décompressée.');
  }
  return archive;
}
async function copyDirectory(source, target) {
  for await (const [name, handle] of source.entries()) {
    if (handle.kind === 'directory') await copyDirectory(handle, await target.getDirectoryHandle(name, { create: true }));
    else { const writer = await (await target.getFileHandle(name, { create: true })).createWritable(); await writer.write(await handle.getFile()); await writer.close(); }
  }
}
async function writeArchive(dir, archive) {
  for (const file of archive.files) {
    const parts = file.path.split('/');
    let target = dir;
    for (const part of parts.slice(0, -1)) target = await target.getDirectoryHandle(part, { create: true });
    const writer = await (await target.getFileHandle(parts.at(-1), { create: true })).createWritable();
    await writer.write(unbase64(file.data)); await writer.close();
  }
}
export async function restoreProfile(game, archive, state) {
  if (state?.manifest === game && ['running', 'loading', 'starting'].includes(state.status))
    throw new Error('Quitte ce jeu avant de restaurer ses sauvegardes.');
  const root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();
  const name = PROFILE_PREFIX + game, tempName = name + '-restore-' + Date.now();
  const temp = await root.getDirectoryHandle(tempName, { create: true });
  try { await writeArchive(temp, archive); } catch (e) { await root.removeEntry(tempName, { recursive: true }); throw e; }
  let previous = null;
  try { previous = await root.getDirectoryHandle(name); } catch { /* first profile */ }
  const asideName = previous ? name + '-aside-' + new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-') : null;
  if (previous) await copyDirectory(previous, await root.getDirectoryHandle(asideName, { create: true }));
  try {
    if (previous) await root.removeEntry(name, { recursive: true });
    await copyDirectory(temp, await root.getDirectoryHandle(name, { create: true }));
  } catch (e) {
    await root.removeEntry(name, { recursive: true }).catch(() => {});
    if (asideName) await copyDirectory(await root.getDirectoryHandle(asideName), await root.getDirectoryHandle(name, { create: true }));
    throw e;
  } finally { await root.removeEntry(tempName, { recursive: true }).catch(() => {}); }
  return asideName;
}
export async function removeCache(game, state) {
  if (state?.manifest === game && ['running', 'loading', 'starting'].includes(state.status))
    throw new Error('Quitte ce jeu avant de vider son cache.');
  const root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();
  await root.removeEntry(SNAPSHOT_PREFIX + game, { recursive: true }).catch(() => {}); // (often none)
  await root.getDirectoryHandle(JIT_CACHE).then((d) => d.removeEntry(game + '.bin')).catch(() => {}); // (often none)
  await root.removeEntry(CACHE_PREFIX + game, { recursive: true }).catch((e) => { if (e?.name !== 'NotFoundError') throw e; }); // (none: only translated code)
}
/** One of the page's other folders (scanStorage's `others`), removed. */
export async function removeOther(name) {
  if (!OTHER_CACHES.includes(name)) throw new Error('Dossier inconnu.');
  await (await navigator.storage.getDirectory()).removeEntry(name, { recursive: true });
}
export async function removeProfile(game, state) {
  if (state?.manifest === game && ['running', 'loading', 'starting'].includes(state.status))
    throw new Error('Quitte ce jeu avant de supprimer ses sauvegardes.');
  const root = await navigator.storage.getDirectory();
  await root.removeEntry(PROFILE_PREFIX + game, { recursive: true });
}
export function download(bytes, filename) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: 'application/octet-stream' }));
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url; link.download = filename; link.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60000);
}
export async function hashBytes(bytes) {
  const digest = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', bytes));
  return [...digest].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the browser ports' storage
// IndexedDB, named after the installation (the manifest's saveKey): a GoldSrc or re3 port's database ('profile': the
// engine's writable files — saves, settings: GoldSrc's under /rwdir/, re3's relative to its game folder —, 'content':
// the game files fetched, whole or as 64 KiB pieces, their size in their key), an OpenMW port's IDBFS databases (the
// installation's, and one per account: saveKey:user:<scope>).
const PORT_PIECE = 1 << 16;
const portDbs = async (saveKey) => (await indexedDB.databases?.() ?? []).map((d) => d.name).filter((n) => n === saveKey || n?.startsWith(saveKey + ':'));
function openDb(name) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const r = indexedDB.open(name);
    r.onupgradeneeded = () => { r.transaction.abort(); }; // (never one that does not exist yet)
    r.onsuccess = () => resolve(r.result); r.onerror = () => reject(r.error);
  });
}
const req = (r) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => { r.onsuccess = () => resolve(r.result); r.onerror = () => reject(r.error); });
const sizeOf = (v) => (v == null ? 0 : ArrayBuffer.isView(v) || v instanceof ArrayBuffer ? v.byteLength : typeof v === 'string' ? v.length
  : Array.isArray(v) ? v.reduce((n, e) => n + sizeOf(e?.data ?? e), 0) : typeof v === 'object' ? sizeOf(v.contents ?? v.data) : 0);
/** Each port's data in this browser: [{ game, profile (bytes of saves), cache (bytes of game files), port: true }]. */
export async function scanPorts(ports) {
  const rows = [];
  for (const { name, saveKey } of ports) {
    let profile = 0, cache = 0;
    for (const dbName of await portDbs(saveKey)) {
      let db; try { db = await openDb(dbName); } catch { continue; }
      try {
        for (const store of db.objectStoreNames) {
          const os = db.transaction(store).objectStore(store);
          if (store === 'content') {
            for (const k of await req(os.getAllKeys())) { const m = /\n(\d+)\n[^\n]*(\n#\d+)?$/.exec(String(k)); cache += m ? (m[2] ? PORT_PIECE : Number(m[1])) : 0; }
          } else for (const v of await req(os.getAll())) profile += sizeOf(v);
        }
      } finally { db.close(); }
    }
    if (profile || cache) rows.push({ game: name, profile, cache, files: 0, locked: 0, port: true });
  }
  return rows;
}
/** A port's saves as the account keeps them (cloud-sync.js): [{ path, data }] — GoldSrc's tree, re3's, OpenMW's /userdata. */
export async function portFiles(saveKey) {
  const files = [];
  for (const dbName of await portDbs(saveKey)) {
    let db; try { db = await openDb(dbName); } catch { continue; }
    try {
      if ([...db.objectStoreNames].includes('profile')) {
        for (const f of await req(db.transaction('profile').objectStore('profile').get('files')) ?? []) {
          if (f.path.startsWith('/rwdir/')) files.push({ path: f.path.slice(7), data: f.data });
          else if (!f.path.startsWith('/')) files.push({ path: f.path, data: f.data }); // (re3: relative already)
        }
      } else if ([...db.objectStoreNames].includes('FILE_DATA')) {
        const os = db.transaction('FILE_DATA').objectStore('FILE_DATA'), keys = await req(os.getAllKeys()), values = await req(os.getAll());
        // (an account's database: its files under a folder of its own name)
        const prefix = dbName === saveKey ? '' : dbName.slice(saveKey.length + 1).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '_') + '/';
        keys.forEach((k, i) => { const v = values[i]; if (v?.contents && String(k).startsWith('/userdata/')) files.push({ path: prefix + String(k).slice(10), data: new Uint8Array(v.contents) }); });
      }
    } finally { db.close(); }
  }
  return files;
}
/** A port's game files fetched in this browser, deleted (fetched again when needed). */
export async function clearPortCache(saveKey) {
  for (const dbName of await portDbs(saveKey)) {
    const db = await openDb(dbName);
    try { if ([...db.objectStoreNames].includes('content')) await req(db.transaction('content', 'readwrite').objectStore('content').clear()); } finally { db.close(); }
  }
}
/** A port's saves in this browser, deleted (GoldSrc's profile entries, OpenMW's IDBFS databases). */
export async function clearPortSaves(saveKey) {
  for (const dbName of await portDbs(saveKey)) {
    const db = await openDb(dbName), stores = [...db.objectStoreNames];
    try { if (stores.includes('profile')) await req(db.transaction('profile', 'readwrite').objectStore('profile').clear()); } finally { db.close(); }
    if (!stores.includes('profile') && stores.includes('FILE_DATA')) await req(indexedDB.deleteDatabase(dbName));
  }
}
```

`src/host/web/dom-input.js`:

```js
// Scripted input for a browser port's page (the bench suite, bench-suite.js): what BenchRun's steps do (bench.js
// ringInput: move, button, key, text — and a port's command, look, glide) as DOM events of the port's own window, those
// its engine listens to (SDL on Emscripten: keys on the window, the mouse on its canvas, a captured mouse's movement),
// constructed in that window's realm. Pointer coordinates are the canvas' CSS pixels (BenchRun scales the scenario's to
// the canvas' size: state.mode). Console commands and the debug teleport go to the port page's hooks
// (page-meter.js benchHooks: command(text), teleport(x, y, z)).
import { domKeyOfVk } from '../../win32/vk-scan.js';
import { benchHooks } from './page-meter.js';

/** the time a typed character's key is held, and between two characters (ms): an engine reading its keys once a frame sees each */
export const TYPE_HOLD_MS = 120, TYPE_GAP_MS = 240;
/** the period of a glide's teleports (ms) */
export const GLIDE_MS = 33;

/**
 * @param {() => Window | null} winOf the port's window now (a frame's page may be replaced)
 * @param {{ canvas?: (win: Window) => Element | null }} [o]
 */
export function domInput(winOf, o = {}) {
  const canvasOf = o.canvas ?? ((w) => w.document.querySelector('canvas'));
  const held = new Set(); let buttons = 0, glide = null, lastXY = [0, 0];
  const ctx = () => { const w = winOf(); if (!w) return null; let c = null; try { c = canvasOf(w); } catch { c = null; } return { w, c, d: w.document }; };
  const hooks = () => { try { return benchHooks(winOf()); } catch { return null; } };
  const keyEvent = (type, vk, extra = {}) => {
    const x = ctx(), k = domKeyOfVk(vk); if (!x || !k) return;
    const init = { key: k.key, code: k.code, keyCode: k.keyCode, which: k.keyCode, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true, view: x.w, ...extra };
    const ev = new x.w.KeyboardEvent(type, init);
    // (keyCode / which: legacy fields some engines read — set when the constructor ignored them)
    if (ev.keyCode !== init.keyCode) { try { Object.defineProperty(ev, 'keyCode', { get: () => init.keyCode }); Object.defineProperty(ev, 'which', { get: () => init.keyCode }); } catch { /* read-only */ } }
    (x.c ?? x.d.activeElement ?? x.d.body ?? x.d).dispatchEvent(ev);
  };
  const mouseEvent = (type, x0, y0, extra = {}) => {
    const x = ctx(); if (!x?.c) return;
    const r = x.c.getBoundingClientRect(), clientX = r.left + x0, clientY = r.top + y0;
    const init = { clientX, clientY, screenX: clientX, screenY: clientY, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true, view: x.w, buttons, ...extra };
    const Ctor = type.startsWith('pointer') ? x.w.PointerEvent : x.w.MouseEvent;
    x.c.dispatchEvent(new Ctor(type, type.startsWith('pointer') ? { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', isPrimary: true, ...init } : init));
  };
  return {
    move(x, y) { const dx = x - lastXY[0], dy = y - lastXY[1]; lastXY = [x, y]; mouseEvent('pointermove', x, y, { movementX: dx, movementY: dy }); mouseEvent('mousemove', x, y, { movementX: dx, movementY: dy }); },
    button(b, down, x, y) {
      this.move(x, y);
      const bit = b === 0 ? 1 : b === 1 ? 2 : 4, button = b === 1 ? 2 : b === 2 ? 1 : 0; // (BenchRun's 0 left, 1 right; the DOM's 0 left, 2 right)
      buttons = down ? buttons | bit : buttons & ~bit;
      mouseEvent(down ? 'pointerdown' : 'pointerup', x, y, { button });
      mouseEvent(down ? 'mousedown' : 'mouseup', x, y, { button });
      if (!down) mouseEvent(b === 1 ? 'contextmenu' : 'click', x, y, { button });
    },
    key(vk, scan, down) {
      if (down) { keyEvent('keydown', vk, { repeat: held.has(vk) }); held.add(vk); const k = domKeyOfVk(vk); if (k?.key.length === 1) keyEvent('keypress', vk, { charCode: k.key.charCodeAt(0) }); }
      else { held.delete(vk); keyEvent('keyup', vk); }
    },
    /** Typed one character after the other (an engine that reads its keys once a frame sees each one). */
    text(s) {
      let at = 0;
      for (const ch of String(s)) {
        const vk = /[a-z]/i.test(ch) ? ch.toUpperCase().charCodeAt(0) : /[0-9]/.test(ch) ? ch.charCodeAt(0) : ch === ' ' ? 0x20 : 0;
        if (!vk) continue;
        setTimeout(() => this.key(vk, 0, true), at); setTimeout(() => this.key(vk, 0, false), at + TYPE_HOLD_MS); at += TYPE_GAP_MS;
      }
    },
    command(text) { hooks()?.command?.(text); },
    /** A captured mouse moved by dx, dy in `n` steps over `ms`. */
    look(dx, dy, n = 1, ms = 0) {
      const steps = Math.max(1, n | 0);
      for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) setTimeout(() => mouseEvent('mousemove', lastXY[0], lastXY[1], { movementX: dx / steps, movementY: dy / steps }), (ms / steps) * i);
    },
    /** [x0, y0, vx, vy, z]: the player carried in a straight line by the port's teleport hook, until the next glide (none: stop). */
    glide(args) {
      if (glide) { clearInterval(glide); glide = null; }
      if (!args?.length) return;
      const [x0, y0, vx, vy, z] = args, t0 = performance.now();
      glide = setInterval(() => { const t = (performance.now() - t0) / 1000; try { hooks()?.teleport?.(x0 + vx * t, y0 + vy * t, z); } catch { /* the engine not there yet */ } }, GLIDE_MS);
    },
    /** Every key still held let go, the glide stopped (the bench ended). */
    release() { for (const vk of [...held]) this.key(vk, 0, false); if (glide) { clearInterval(glide); glide = null; } },
  };
}
```

`src/host/web/dom.js`:

```js
/** Tiny element builder: h('div', { class: 'x', onclick }, child, ...) — `on*` props are handlers, null / false props and children are skipped. */
export function h(tag, props = {}, ...kids) {
  const el = document.createElement(tag);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(props)) {
    if (v == null || v === false) continue;
    if (k === 'class') el.className = v; else if (k.startsWith('on')) el[k] = v; else if (k === 'style') el.style.cssText = v; else el.setAttribute(k, v === true ? '' : v);
  }
  for (const kid of kids.flat()) if (kid != null && kid !== false) el.append(kid.nodeType ? kid : document.createTextNode(kid));
  return el;
}
```

`src/host/web/download-worker.js`:

```js
// "Download the whole game first" (home screen, docs/slow-network.md): a dedicated worker downloads a game version —
// and the versions it requires (manifest extraMounts) — into the same OPFS block stores the game's worker reads
// (orthros-files-<manifest>), before the game runs. The learned order comes first (what the game needs first), then
// every other block. Stopped and started again (another visit), it resumes: the stored blocks are skipped.
// "Prepare" (the home's card): the launch sets only, the version's and those of the versions it requires
// (src/vfs/launch-set.js: what earlier sessions read before their game was playable, as this link reads it), their
// pieces as the game's own startup set fetches them; resumed the same way (the pieces here are skipped) — the game
// language's own launch set (`lang`) —, and a browser port's engine release first (`engine`: its URLs, /api/manifests
// launch.engineFiles, immutable: into the browser's HTTP cache, where the page's first launch finds them). A version
// whose engine reloads in place (`reloads`: /api/manifests launch.reloads, launch-set.js lightLaunch) is prepared in two
// stages on a fast link: its light launch set — what its game reads before it plays without waiting: 'Ready' once
// here —, then the files themselves of the fast link's set (`upgrade` in the progress: what the game would load again
// sharp), the second stage stopped like the first (Play, another download).
// "Probe" (the home, on its arrival: `probe`): what the stores of the versions played before hold — their launch sets
// and their whole files —, so that the card says "Ready" from the store's contents, not only after a Prepare.
// Messages in: { type: 'download' | 'launch', name, bw, lang?, engine?, reloads? }, { type: 'probe', items: [{ name, lang?,
// engine?, reloads? }], bw }, { type: 'stop' }. Out: { type: 'progress', kind ('whole' | 'launch'), bytes, total, stored,
// engine (of them: the engine's wire bytes), bw, ratio, running, done, error, upgrade? ({ bytes, total }: the second
// stage's) }, { type: 'probed', name, lang, missing?, launch?, whole? }
// (probe), then { type: 'stopped' } once the stores are closed (the game's worker may open them).
// The files a version takes from one it requires go to that version's store (game-data.js openVersion's shared parts,
// learnedOrders): a version prepared or probed counts them there — what another version that reads them stored too —
// and in its own store (what it kept of them before the owners: UnderStore); the owner's store held by another tab's
// game, they are prepared into its own store, as before.
import { openVersion, openData, openStore, openStoreNow, storeExists, storeLocks, learnedOrders, UnderStore } from '../../vfs/game-data.js';
import { launchSet, setBytes, lightLaunch } from '../../vfs/launch-set.js';

let stopping = false, running = false;
/** the engine files' requests in flight (stop aborts them) */
const aborts = new Set();
const post = (m) => self.postMessage(m);

/**
 * An engine file's answer's sizes: { wire (bytes on the wire, 0 when not said), decoded (bytes of its body, 0 when not
 * said) } — a brotli answer says them in X-Orthros-Wire-Length / X-Orthros-Decoded-Length (server.js sendBrotli), its
 * Content-Length (when it has one) being the wire's; a plain one's Content-Length is both.
 */
export function engineSizes(h) {
  const enc = h.get('content-encoding'), len = Number(h.get('content-length')) || 0;
  const wire = Number(h.get('x-orthros-wire-length')) || len;
  return { wire, decoded: Number(h.get('x-orthros-decoded-length')) || (enc ? 0 : wire) };
}
/** `raw` decoded bytes of an engine file as wire bytes: in proportion when both sizes are known, else as they are. */
export const wireOf = (raw, wire, decoded) => (wire && decoded ? Math.min(wire, Math.round(raw * wire / decoded)) : wire ? Math.min(wire, raw) : raw);

/**
 * The engine release's files into the HTTP cache (`progress`: { bytes, total }, their wire bytes as far as known); true
 * once all came, false when stopped.
 */
async function fetchEngine(urls, progress) {
  // (ENGINE_PARTS files at once: one at a time, a release of 17 small files was a round trip each — Half-Life's at
  // 150 ms; the page loads them side by side too)
  let next = 0, failed = null;
  const one = async () => {
    while (next < urls.length && !failed) {
      const url = urls[next++];
      try { if (!(await engineFile(url, progress))) return; } catch (e) { failed ??= e; }
    }
  };
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(ENGINE_PARTS, urls.length) }, one));
  if (stopping) return false;
  if (failed) throw failed;
  return true;
}
const ENGINE_PARTS = 4;
/** The HTTP cache has the engine file at `url`: no request — "only-if-cached" answers from it or fails. */
const engineCached = (url) => fetch(url, { cache: 'only-if-cached', mode: 'same-origin' }).then((r) => { r.body?.cancel().catch(() => {}); return r.ok; }).catch(() => false);
/** One engine file into the HTTP cache (see fetchEngine): true, false when stopped. */
async function engineFile(url, progress) {
  if (stopping) return false;
  if (await engineCached(url)) return true;
  const ctl = new AbortController(); aborts.add(ctl);
  let counted = 0; // (this file's bytes in progress.bytes: files come side by side)
  try {
    const r = await fetch(url, { signal: ctl.signal });
    if (!r.ok || !r.body) throw new Error(`the engine file ${url} could not be downloaded (${r.status})`);
    const reader = r.body.getReader(), { wire, decoded } = engineSizes(r.headers);
    // (what came, in wire bytes — the unit of the total, /api/manifests launch.engine —: the body comes decoded)
    let raw = 0;
    const count = (n) => { progress.bytes += n - counted; counted = n; };
    for (;;) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read(); if (done) break;
      raw += value.length;
      count(wireOf(raw, wire, decoded));
    }
    count(wire || raw);
  } catch (e) {
    if (stopping) return false;
    throw e;
  } finally { aborts.delete(ctl); }
  return true;
}

/** (exported for a harness: tools/prepare-bench.mjs — `hooks.openStore`: the stores, the browser's OPFS ones without it) */
export async function download(name, bw, kind = 'whole', lang = null, engine = null, hooks = {}, reloads = false) {
  running = true; stopping = false;
  const stores = [];
  let parts = [], net = null, timer = null, launch = null, eng = null, upgrade = null;
  const report = (extra = {}) => {
    let bytes = parts.reduce((a, p) => a + (p.progress.started ? p.progress.bytes : 0), 0), total = parts.reduce((a, p) => a + p.total, 0);
    let stored = parts.reduce((a, p) => a + (p.progress.stored ?? 0), 0);
    // (the launch set: its pieces here now, counted again — those the reader kept, fetched now or before)
    if (launch) {
      bytes = 0; total = 0; stored = 0;
      for (const l of launch) { const b = setBytes(l.files, l.set); bytes += b.here; total += b.bytes; stored += l.stored; }
      if (eng) { bytes += eng.bytes; total += eng.total; }
    }
    // (the second stage's: the full files' set, its pieces here — counted apart, 'Ready' said by every report of it)
    if (upgrade) {
      let ub = 0, ut = 0;
      for (const u of upgrade) { const b = setBytes(u.files, u.set); ub += b.here; ut += b.bytes; }
      extra = { done: true, upgrade: { bytes: ub, total: ut }, ...extra };
    }
    const s = net?.snapshot();
    post({ type: 'progress', kind, name, bytes, total, stored, engine: eng?.total ?? 0, bw: s?.bw ?? null, ratio: net ? net.ratio() : 1, received: s ? s.bgBytes + s.demandBytes : 0, running, ...extra });
  };
  try {
    // (the game data every Orthros game reads, src/vfs/game-data.js: the version and those it requires, their stores)
    // (a shared part's — the owner's store — may be held by another tab's game: its files then kept in this version's
    // store, as before the owners — openVersion —, not a failed Prepare)
    const store = async (n, primary, shared) => {
      const st = await (hooks.openStore ?? openStore)(n);
      if (!st && shared) return null;
      if (!st) throw new Error('this browser cannot keep the game files (storage unavailable, or the game is open in another tab)');
      stores.push(st);
      return st;
    };
    const version = await openVersion(name, { bw, store });
    net = version.net;
    if (kind === 'launch') {
      // (every part's launch set: the version's and those of the versions it requires — the game reads them too —, each
      // from its own learned order; the version's first)
      const lists = await learnedOrders(version, lang);
      // (the light set first for an engine that reloads in place, on any link: lightLaunch)
      const light = lightLaunch(net.fast(), reloads), full = net.fast() && reloads;
      launch = version.parts.map((p, i) => {
        const set = launchSet(p.files, lists[i], !light);
        return { p, files: p.files, set, stored: setBytes(p.files, set).here, progress: { bytes: 0, blocks: 0, done: false } };
      });
      // (the engine release first: the page loads it before reading any game file)
      const urls = Array.isArray(engine?.files) ? engine.files.filter((u) => typeof u === 'string' && u.startsWith('/engines/')) : [];
      if (urls.length) eng = { bytes: 0, total: Number(engine.bytes) || 0 };
      timer = setInterval(() => report(), 500);
      if (eng && !(await fetchEngine(urls, eng))) { running = false; report({ done: false }); return; }
      if (eng) eng.bytes = eng.total = Math.max(eng.bytes, eng.total);
      for (const l of launch) {
        if (l.set.length) await l.files.prefetch(l.set, l.progress, () => stopping, { learnedOnly: true });
        else l.progress.done = true;
        if (stopping) break;
        if (!l.progress.done) { running = false; throw new Error(l.p.store.failed ? 'the browser storage is full or unavailable' : 'the server stopped answering: try again later'); }
      }
      if (full && !stopping) {
        // (ready: said at once, then the full files of the fast link's set — what the light copies stand for —, each part's
        // in its order; their end, a stop or a failure leave it ready)
        upgrade = version.parts.map((p, i) => ({ p, files: p.files, set: launchSet(p.files, lists[i], true), progress: { bytes: 0, blocks: 0, done: false } }));
        report();
        for (const u of upgrade) {
          if (u.set.length) await u.files.prefetch(u.set, u.progress, () => stopping, { learnedOnly: true });
          if (stopping || !u.progress.done) break;
        }
        running = false;
        report({ done: true });
        return;
      }
      running = false;
      report({ done: !stopping && launch.every((l) => l.progress.done) });
      return;
    }
    const orders = await learnedOrders(version);
    parts = version.parts.map((p, i) => ({ ...p, order: orders[i], progress: { bytes: 0, total: 0, done: false } }));
    timer = setInterval(() => report(), 500);
    for (const p of parts) {
      p.progress.started = true;
      await p.files.downloadAll(p.progress, () => stopping, { alone: true, order: p.order });
      if (stopping) break;
      if (!p.progress.done) throw new Error(p.store.failed ? 'the browser storage is full or unavailable' : 'the server stopped answering: try again later');
    }
    running = false;
    report({ done: !stopping && parts.every((p) => p.progress.done) });
  } catch (e) {
    running = false;
    report({ error: String(e?.message ?? e) });
  } finally {
    clearInterval(timer);
    for (const s of stores) { try { s.close(); } catch { /* closed */ } }
    post({ type: 'stopped', name });
  }
}

/**
 * The probe's count of a version (its stores' locks held): each part's store opened into `stores` (one only when it
 * exists — `has`: the version's own), its launch set as this link reads it and its whole blocks here: { bytes, here, wb,
 * wt }. A shared part (the files of a version another owns) counts its owner's store and what the stores of the parts
 * reading them kept of them before the owners (UnderStore, as the game reads them) — the owner's store held by another
 * tab's game: those only. Throws when a store cannot be told (unknown, another context holds it).
 */
async function countStores(version, orders, stores, exists, open, has = true, reloads = false) {
  const parts = [], opened = new Map();
  for (const [i, p] of version.parts.entries()) {
    const kept = i === 0 ? has : await exists(p.name);
    if (kept === null && !p.shared) throw new Error('unknown');
    let st = kept ? await open(p.name) : null;
    if (kept && !st && !p.shared) throw new Error('busy'); // (another tab's game holds it: unknown)
    if (st) stores.push(st);
    if (p.shared) {
      const below = version.parts.filter((q) => q.owned?.has(p.name) && opened.get(q.name)).map((q) => opened.get(q.name));
      if (below.length) st = new UnderStore(st, below);
    }
    opened.set(p.name, st);
    parts.push(await openData(p.name, { tree: p.files.tree, store: st, net: version.net })); // (its own files: files.tree)
  }
  // (a version whose engine reloads in place: its light set on every link — a light copy or its file whole, lightLaunch)
  const fast = !lightLaunch(version.net.fast(), reloads);
  let bytes = 0, here = 0, wb = 0, wt = 0;
  for (const [i, p] of parts.entries()) {
    const b = setBytes(p.files, launchSet(p.files, orders[i], fast));
    bytes += b.bytes; here += b.here;
    const w = p.files.storedBytes(); wb += w.bytes; wt += w.total;
  }
  return { bytes, here, wb, wt };
}

/**
 * The home's probe (docs/slow-network.md "The card from the store"): for each item { name, lang, engine } in turn (the
 * resume game first: the page's order), what this browser holds of the version — posted as { type: 'probed', name,
 * lang, launch: { bytes, total, engine, engineFiles, done } | null (no launch set known), whole: { bytes, total, done } },
 * or { missing: true } when its store does not exist, nor that of a version owning files it reads (manifest `owners`:
 * those files are kept there — one played before holds them) (never played, or evicted: nothing here). A store's directory is
 * looked up first (openStore creates it). The network first (manifest, trees, learned orders, the engine's files only if
 * cached), the stores then, opened only to count and closed at once: a stop (Play, Prepare) finds them closed but for
 * that moment — `running` is true only then, so a stop at any other time answers 'stopped' at once —, under the stores'
 * Web Locks taken without waiting (game-data.js storeLocks: a game opening one in this tab or another waits that moment
 * out instead of running without its store; one opening it now leaves the item unknown). Unknown (a store another
 * context holds, an error, OPFS unavailable): nothing posted for the item. The launch set as this link reads it
 * (launchSet: a store filled on a thin link holds light copies — no wait there, the files' pieces to fetch on a fast
 * one; an item's `reloads`, an engine that reloads in place: its light set on every link — a store filled light on a
 * thin link is ready on a fast one too —, lightLaunch). (exported for a test — `hooks`: { openStore (no lock taken: the probe holds it), exists }.)
 */
export async function probe(items, bw, hooks = {}) {
  stopping = false;
  const exists = hooks.exists ?? storeExists, open = hooks.openStore ?? openStoreNow;
  try {
    for (const it of Array.isArray(items) ? items : []) {
      if (stopping) break;
      const name = String(it?.name ?? ''), lang = typeof it?.lang === 'string' && it.lang ? it.lang : null;
      if (!name) continue;
      const has = await exists(name);
      if (has === null || stopping) continue;
      let manifest = null;
      if (!has) {
        // (its own store not here: the stores of the versions owning files it reads may hold them)
        try { manifest = await fetch(`/api/manifest/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)); } catch { /* unknown */ }
        if (stopping) break;
        const owners = Array.isArray(manifest?.owners) ? manifest.owners.filter((o) => typeof o === 'string') : [];
        if (!(await Promise.all(owners.map(exists))).some(Boolean)) { post({ type: 'probed', name, lang, missing: true }); continue; }
      }
      const stores = [];
      try {
        // (the network, no store held: the version and those it requires, their learned orders, the engine's files)
        const version = await openVersion(name, { bw, store: null, ...(manifest ? { manifest } : {}) });
        const orders = await learnedOrders(version, lang);
        const urls = Array.isArray(it.engine?.files) ? it.engine.files.filter((u) => typeof u === 'string' && u.startsWith('/engines/')) : [];
        const cached = (await Promise.all(urls.map(engineCached))).filter(Boolean).length;
        const engTotal = urls.length ? Number(it.engine.bytes) || 0 : 0, engHere = urls.length ? Math.round(engTotal * cached / urls.length) : 0;
        if (stopping) break;
        // (the stores, under their locks: opened, counted, closed — a required version's only when it exists, else
        // nothing of it is here)
        running = true;
        const { bytes, here, wb, wt } = await storeLocks(version.parts.map((p) => p.name), async (locked) => {
          if (!locked) throw new Error('busy'); // (a game opening one now: unknown)
          // (closed before the locks go, whatever happens: a game waiting on them opens them next)
          try { return await countStores(version, orders, stores, exists, open, has, it.reloads === true); } finally { for (const s of stores.splice(0)) { try { s.close(); } catch { /* closed */ } } }
        }, { ifAvailable: true });
        const launch = bytes > 0 ? { bytes: here + engHere, total: bytes + engTotal, engine: engTotal, engineFiles: urls, done: here >= bytes && cached === urls.length } : null;
        post({ type: 'probed', name, lang, launch, whole: { bytes: wb, total: wt, done: wt > 0 && wb >= wt } });
      } catch { /* unknown: nothing said */ } finally {
        for (const s of stores) { try { s.close(); } catch { /* closed */ } }
        running = false;
      }
    }
  } finally {
    running = false;
    post({ type: 'stopped', name: null });
  }
}

// (a worker's; imported elsewhere — a test — its helpers only)
if (typeof WorkerGlobalScope !== 'undefined' && self instanceof WorkerGlobalScope) self.onmessage = (e) => {
  const m = e.data ?? {};
  if (m.type === 'stop') { stopping = true; for (const c of aborts) c.abort(); if (!running) post({ type: 'stopped', name: m.name ?? null }); return; }
  if (m.type === 'probe' && !running) { probe(m.items, Number(m.bw) || undefined); return; }
  if ((m.type === 'download' || m.type === 'launch') && !running) {
    download(String(m.name), Number(m.bw) || undefined, m.type === 'launch' ? 'launch' : 'whole', typeof m.lang === 'string' && m.lang ? m.lang : null, m.engine ?? null, {}, m.reloads === true);
  }
};

```

`src/host/web/download.js`:

```js
// "Download the whole game first", the page's side (docs/slow-network.md): one download worker at a time
// (download-worker.js), its progress kept in localStorage so a later visit shows where it stopped and resumes from
// there (the blocks already stored are skipped). The home screen draws it (home.js); starting a game stops it first.
// "Prepare" is the same with the launch set only (kind 'launch': what earlier sessions read before their game was
// playable, src/vfs/launch-set.js), and the card's "playable after X MB" line (launchStatus). The home's probe (`probe`:
// what the stores of the versions played before hold) writes the same progress, so that the lines tell the store's
// contents whoever filled it — a game played, a Prepare, a download — or that it is gone (evicted, cleared).
import { fmtRate, fmtBytes, fmtDuration } from './net-status.js';
import { pageStorage } from './storage-persist.js';
import { linkRate } from '../../vfs/data-client.js';
import { FAST_BPS } from '../../vfs/net-link.js';
import { lightLaunch } from '../../vfs/launch-set.js';

// (a launch set is a game language's own: "Prepare" in one language is not the other's)
const KEY = (name, kind = 'whole', lang = null) => (kind === 'launch' ? 'orthros.launch.' : 'orthros.download.') + name + (kind === 'launch' && lang ? '.' + lang : '');
const load = (name, kind, lang) => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY(name, kind, lang)) ?? 'null'); } catch { return null; } };
const save = (name, kind, lang, v) => { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY(name, kind, lang), JSON.stringify(v)); } catch { /* storage off */ } };
const forget = (name, kind, lang) => { try { localStorage.removeItem(KEY(name, kind, lang)); } catch { /* storage off */ } };
const savedBw = () => linkRate.get() ?? null;

/**
 * What a game version's download looks like now: { state: 'none' | 'running' | 'paused' | 'done' | 'error', bytes,
 * total, bw, eta (s), pct, text, detail } — `text` the short line the home screen shows (`lang` 'en' or 'fr'), `detail`
 * the whole of it (its tooltip: the rate, the error).
 */
export function downloadStatus(st, total, lang = 'en', ratio = 0.75) {
  const bw = st?.bw ?? savedBw();
  const t = st?.total || total || 0, bytes = Math.min(t, st?.bytes ?? 0);
  const left = Math.max(0, t - bytes), eta = bw ? left * (st?.ratio ?? ratio) / bw : null;
  const state = st?.done ? 'done' : st?.error ? 'error' : st?.running ? 'running' : bytes > 0 ? 'paused' : 'none';
  const pct = t ? Math.floor(100 * bytes / t) : 0;
  const fr = lang === 'fr', B = (n) => fmtBytes(n, lang), R = (b) => fmtRate(b, lang), D = (s) => fmtDuration(s, lang), T = (s) => fmtDuration(s, lang, true);
  const text = state === 'done' ? (fr ? `Dans ce navigateur (${B(t)})` : `In this browser (${B(t)})`)
    : state === 'running' ? `${B(bytes)} / ${B(t)}${eta !== null ? ` · ${T(eta)}${fr ? ' restantes' : ' left'}` : ''}`
    : state === 'paused' ? (fr ? `${pct} % téléchargé${eta !== null ? ` · encore ${T(eta)}` : ''}` : `${pct}% downloaded${eta !== null ? ` · ${T(eta)} more` : ''}`)
    : state === 'error' ? (fr ? 'Téléchargement arrêté' : 'Download stopped')
    : (fr ? `Jeu complet : ${B(t)}${eta !== null ? ` · ${T(eta)}` : ''}` : `Whole game: ${B(t)}${eta !== null ? ` · ${T(eta)}` : ''}`);
  const detail = state === 'done' ? (fr ? `Dans ce navigateur (${B(t)}) : démarre sans téléchargement` : `In this browser (${B(t)}): starts without downloading`)
    : state === 'running' ? `${B(bytes)} / ${B(t)} (${pct} %)${bw ? ` · ${R(bw)}` : ''}${eta !== null ? ` · ${D(eta)}${fr ? ' restantes' : ' left'}` : ''}`
    : state === 'paused' ? (fr ? `${pct} % téléchargé (${B(bytes)} / ${B(t)})${eta !== null ? ` · encore ${D(eta)} à ${R(bw)}` : ''}` : `${pct}% downloaded (${B(bytes)} of ${B(t)})${eta !== null ? ` · ${D(eta)} more at ${R(bw)}` : ''}`)
    : state === 'error' ? (fr ? `Téléchargement arrêté : ${st.error}` : `Download stopped: ${st.error}`)
    : (fr ? `Tout télécharger d’abord : ${B(t)}${eta !== null ? `, ${D(eta)} à ${R(bw)}` : ''}` : `Download the whole game first: ${B(t)}${eta !== null ? `, ${D(eta)} at ${R(bw)}` : ''}`);
  return { state, bytes, total: t, bw, eta, pct, text, detail };
}

/**
 * The launch a card shows for game language `gameLang`: that language's own (/api/manifests `launch.langs`: the launch
 * set its sessions read, e.g. its translated texts), else the version's.
 */
export const launchFor = (launch, gameLang) => (gameLang && launch?.langs?.[gameLang]) || launch || null;

/**
 * The card's "playable after X MB" line for a version's launch (/api/manifests `launch`: launch-set.js launchSummary),
 * or null when the server does not know it yet: { state: 'none' | 'running' | 'paused' | 'done' | 'error', bytes (of
 * the launch set here), total, eta (s, null while the link is not measured), pct, text (short), detail (whole) }. `o.bw`: the link's rate (wire
 * bytes/s; linkRate's by default) — on a link that is not fast the light copies' set, the files' on a fast one (the light
 * one there too for an engine that reloads in place, `launch.reloads`: launch-set.js lightLaunch); `o.st`:
 * the "Prepare" progress (Downloads.get(name, 'launch', lang): its engine's bytes, `engine`, counted in its own); `o.whole`:
 * the whole download's (done: nothing to wait for). A "Prepare" whose engine files (`engineFiles`) are no longer the
 * launch's (an OpenMW game's lean package made since: the page asks for it, not for the package that was cached; an
 * engine release since, its changed files under new content addresses — src/host/engine-content.js) is not done: its
 * engine is to fetch again (the launch set is here; the files kept under the same addresses are found in the HTTP
 * cache, not downloaded: download-worker.js engineCached).
 */
export function launchStatus(launch, o = {}, lang = 'en') {
  if (!launch || !(launch.bytes > 0)) return null;
  const bw = o.bw === undefined ? savedBw() : o.bw, fast = bw >= FAST_BPS;
  let st = o.st ?? null;
  if (st?.done && Array.isArray(st.engineFiles) && !sameFiles(st.engineFiles, launch.engineFiles ?? [])) st = { ...st, done: false, bytes: Math.max(0, (st.bytes ?? 0) - (st.engine ?? 0)) };
  // (the light copies' set on a link that is not fast, and on every link for an engine that reloads in place — its big
  // loads read them first, its files upgrades after: lightLaunch)
  const light = lightLaunch(fast, launch.reloads);
  const size = light ? launch.lightBytes ?? launch.bytes : launch.bytes, wire = (light ? launch.lightWire ?? launch.wire : launch.wire) ?? size * 0.75;
  // (what "Prepare" already brought: its own count of the set it fetched — and of the engine's files, when it fetched
  // them —, the rest in proportion)
  const withEngine = st?.engine > 0 ? st.engine : 0;
  const t = st?.total || size + withEngine, bytes = Math.min(t, st?.bytes ?? 0), left = Math.max(0, 1 - bytes / t);
  const eta = bw > 0 ? (wire + withEngine) * left / bw : null, pct = Math.floor(100 * bytes / t);
  const state = o.whole?.done || st?.done ? 'done' : st?.error ? 'error' : st?.running ? 'running' : bytes > 0 ? 'paused' : 'none';
  const fr = lang === 'fr', B = (n) => fmtBytes(n, lang), R = (b) => fmtRate(b, lang), D = (s) => fmtDuration(s, lang), T = (s) => fmtDuration(s, lang, true);
  // (the engine's own download, at a first launch only: said beside, not counted — a browser that ran it has it)
  const first = launch.engine > 0 && state === 'none', engineShort = first ? (fr ? ` (+ ${B(launch.engine)} de moteur)` : ` (+ ${B(launch.engine)} of engine)`) : '';
  const after = eta !== null ? ` · ${T(eta)}` : '';
  const text = state === 'done' ? (fr ? 'Prêt : démarre sans attendre' : 'Ready: starts without waiting')
    : state === 'running' ? (fr ? `Préparation : ${B(bytes)} / ${B(t)}${after}` : `Preparing: ${B(bytes)} / ${B(t)}${after}`)
    : state === 'error' ? (fr ? 'Préparation arrêtée' : 'Preparing stopped')
    : state === 'paused' ? (fr ? `Jouable après encore ${B(t - bytes)}${after}` : `Playable after ${B(t - bytes)} more${after}`)
    : (fr ? `Jouable après ${B(size)}${engineShort}${after}` : `Playable after ${B(size)}${engineShort}${after}`);
  const engine = first ? (fr ? ` (+ ${B(launch.engine)} de moteur au premier lancement${bw > 0 ? `, ${D(launch.engine / bw)}` : ''})` : ` (+ ${B(launch.engine)} of engine at the first launch${bw > 0 ? `, ${D(launch.engine / bw)}` : ''})`) : '';
  // (a second stage under way — the files themselves after the light set, download-worker.js —: said in the detail)
  const up = state === 'done' && st?.running && st.upgrade?.total > 0 ? st.upgrade : null;
  const upText = up ? (fr ? ` · images nettes : ${B(up.bytes)} / ${B(up.total)}` : ` · sharp textures: ${B(up.bytes)} / ${B(up.total)}`) : '';
  const detail = state === 'done' ? (fr ? `Prêt : démarre sans attendre le réseau (${B(size)} dans ce navigateur)${upText}` : `Ready: starts without waiting for the network (${B(size)} in this browser)${upText}`)
    : state === 'running' ? (fr ? `Préparation : ${B(bytes)} / ${B(t)} (${pct} %)${eta !== null ? ` · ${D(eta)} restantes` : ''}` : `Preparing: ${B(bytes)} of ${B(t)} (${pct}%)${eta !== null ? ` · ${D(eta)} left` : ''}`)
    : state === 'error' ? (fr ? `Préparation arrêtée : ${st.error}` : `Preparing stopped: ${st.error}`)
    : state === 'paused' ? (fr ? `Jouable après encore ${B(t - bytes)} (${pct} % prêt)${eta !== null ? `, ${D(eta)} à ta connexion (${R(bw)})` : ''}` : `Playable after ${B(t - bytes)} more (${pct}% ready)${eta !== null ? `, ${D(eta)} at your link (${R(bw)})` : ''}`)
    : (fr ? `Jouable après ${B(size)}${eta !== null ? `, ${D(eta)} à ta connexion (${R(bw)})` : ''}${engine}` : `Playable after ${B(size)}${eta !== null ? `, ${D(eta)} at your link (${R(bw)})` : ''}${engine}`);
  return { state, bytes, total: t, eta, pct, text, detail };
}

const sameFiles = (a, b) => a.length === b.length && a.every((u, i) => u === b[i]);

export class Downloads {
  constructor() { this.worker = null; this.name = null; this.kind = null; this.lang = null; this.listeners = new Set(); this.live = new Map(); this.storage = pageStorage(); this.closed = false; }
  /**
   * the last known progress of `name` (`kind`: 'whole', else 'launch' — "Prepare", of game language `lang`; this
   * visit's, else the one kept from an earlier visit)
   */
  get(name, kind = 'whole', lang = null) { return this.live.get(KEY(name, kind, lang)) ?? load(name, kind, lang); }
  onChange(fn) { this.listeners.add(fn); return () => this.listeners.delete(fn); }
  emit(name) { for (const fn of this.listeners) fn(name); }
  running(name, kind = 'whole', lang = null) { return this.name === name && this.kind === kind && (kind !== 'launch' || this.lang === lang) && !!this.worker; }
  /**
   * Start (or resume) the download of `name` (`kind` 'launch': its launch set only — `o.lang`'s, and `o.launch`'s engine
   * files first: /api/manifests launch.engineFiles; `o.launch.reloads`: the light set, then the files — download-worker.js);
   * another one running stops first.
   */
  async start(name, kind = 'whole', o = {}) {
    const lang = kind === 'launch' ? o.lang ?? null : null;
    if (this.running(name, kind, lang)) return;
    this.storage.ask(); // (before the first write: persistent storage asked, storage-persist.js)
    await this.stop();
    const w = this.worker = new Worker(new URL('./download-worker.js', import.meta.url), { type: 'module' });
    const key = KEY(name, kind, lang);
    this.name = name; this.kind = kind; this.lang = lang;
    const engine = kind === 'launch' && o.launch?.engineFiles?.length ? { files: o.launch.engineFiles, bytes: o.launch.engine ?? 0 } : null;
    w.onmessage = (e) => {
      const m = e.data;
      if (m.type === 'progress') {
        const v = { bytes: m.bytes, total: m.total, engine: m.engine ?? 0, ...(kind === 'launch' ? { engineFiles: engine?.files ?? [] } : {}), ...(m.upgrade ? { upgrade: m.upgrade } : {}), bw: m.bw, ratio: m.ratio, running: !!m.running, done: !!m.done, error: m.error ?? null, at: Date.now() };
        this.live.set(key, v); save(name, kind, lang, { ...v, running: false });
        linkRate.set(m.bw);
        this.emit(name);
      } else if (m.type === 'stopped') {
        const v = this.live.get(key); if (v) { v.running = false; save(name, kind, lang, v); }
        if (this.worker === w) { w.terminate(); this.worker = null; this.name = null; this.kind = null; this.lang = null; }
        this.stopped?.(); this.stopped = null;
        this.emit(name);
      }
    };
    w.onerror = (e) => { const v = { ...(this.get(name, kind, lang) ?? {}), running: false, error: e.message || 'the download stopped' }; this.live.set(key, v); w.terminate(); if (this.worker === w) { this.worker = null; this.name = null; this.kind = null; this.lang = null; } this.emit(name); };
    w.postMessage({ type: kind === 'launch' ? 'launch' : 'download', name, bw: savedBw(), lang, engine, reloads: kind === 'launch' && o.launch?.reloads === true });
    this.live.set(key, { ...(load(name, kind, lang) ?? {}), running: true, error: null, done: false }); this.emit(name);
  }
  /**
   * Probe the stores of `items` ([{ name, lang, engine? (/api/manifests launch: { files, bytes }), reloads? (its
   * launch.reloads) }], in the order
   * given — the resume game first —, one at a time, in the download worker: its `probe`) and keep what they hold as
   * the lines' progress (`probed`). Nothing while a download runs, nor once a game is chosen (forGame); a download
   * started or a game's Play stops it first (stop(): the stores closed).
   */
  probe(items) {
    if (this.closed || this.worker || !items?.length || typeof Worker !== 'function') return;
    const w = this.worker = new Worker(new URL('./download-worker.js', import.meta.url), { type: 'module' });
    this.name = null; this.kind = 'probe'; this.lang = null;
    const done = () => { w.terminate(); if (this.worker === w) { this.worker = null; this.name = null; this.kind = null; this.lang = null; } this.stopped?.(); this.stopped = null; };
    w.onmessage = (e) => { const m = e.data; if (m.type === 'probed') this.probed(m); else if (m.type === 'stopped') done(); };
    w.onerror = done;
    w.postMessage({ type: 'probe', items: items.map((i) => ({ name: i.name, lang: i.lang ?? null, engine: i.engine ?? null, reloads: i.reloads === true })), bw: savedBw() });
  }
  /**
   * A probe's answer (download-worker.js `probe`) kept as the progress of the launch (of game language `m.lang`) and
   * of the whole download: what the store holds of the launch set as this link reads it; a store gone (`missing`)
   * clears them. Never over a download of this visit's (its own count is live).
   */
  probed(m) {
    const at = Date.now();
    for (const [kind, lang, got] of [['launch', m.lang ?? null, m.launch], ['whole', null, m.whole]]) {
      const key = KEY(m.name, kind, lang); if (this.live.get(key)?.running) continue;
      if (m.missing || !got || (kind === 'whole' && !(got.bytes > 0))) {
        if (m.missing || kind === 'whole') { this.live.delete(key); forget(m.name, kind, lang); }
        continue;
      }
      const v = { bytes: got.bytes, total: got.total, engine: got.engine ?? 0, ...(kind === 'launch' ? { engineFiles: got.engineFiles ?? [] } : {}), bw: null, ratio: null, running: false, done: !!got.done, error: null, at, probed: true };
      this.live.set(key, v); save(m.name, kind, lang, v);
    }
    this.emit(m.name);
  }
  /**
   * A game was chosen (Play): no probe starts from now on (a timer's, a late one), the running download or probe stopped
   * — resolves once its stores are closed (the game's worker opens them next).
   */
  forGame() { this.closed = true; return this.stop(); }
  /** Stop the running download (its stores closed: a game may open them); resolves once stopped. */
  stop() {
    const w = this.worker; if (!w) return Promise.resolve();
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const t = setTimeout(() => { w.terminate(); if (this.worker === w) { this.worker = null; this.name = null; this.kind = null; this.lang = null; } resolve(); }, 5000);
      this.stopped = () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); };
      w.postMessage({ type: 'stop', name: this.name });
    });
  }
}
```

`src/host/web/embers.js`:

```js
// Rising embers behind the home screen: a few dozen square sparks (pixel art, like the hound) drifting up from the
// hound's feet and the bottom of the window. One canvas, one requestAnimationFrame loop; stop() ends it for good —
// nothing here may compete with the emulator for the frame budget once a game starts.
const COLORS = ['#ffd9a0', '#ffb56b', '#f8901f', '#f8901f', '#e0242a', '#b75d14'];

/**
 * @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas  fixed, full-window canvas
 * @param {() => ({ x: number, y: number, w: number } | null)} [origin]  where sparks are born besides the window's
 *   bottom edge (viewport coordinates: the hound's feet), or null when it is out of view
 * @returns {{ stop(): void }}
 */
export function startEmbers(canvas, origin = () => null) {
  const still = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  if (still) return { stop() {} };
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const sparks = [];
  let w = 0, h = 0, dpr = 1, raf = 0, last = 0, t = 0, stopped = false;
  const rnd = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);

  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    w = canvas.clientWidth; h = canvas.clientHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(w * dpr); canvas.height = Math.round(h * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    const want = Math.max(24, Math.min(70, Math.round(w * h / 26000)));
    while (sparks.length < want) sparks.push(spawn({}, true));
    sparks.length = want;
  }
  /** (Re)birth of a spark; `anywhere`: at a random height (the first fill), else at its source. */
  function spawn(s, anywhere = false) {
    const o = Math.random() < 0.6 ? origin() : null;
    s.x = o ? o.x + rnd(0, o.w) : rnd(0, w);
    s.y = anywhere ? rnd(0, h) : (o ? o.y : h) + rnd(0, 24);
    s.vx = rnd(-7, 7); s.vy = -rnd(16, 52);
    s.size = Math.random() < 0.12 ? 4 : Math.random() < 0.5 ? 3 : 2;
    s.age = anywhere ? rnd(0, 6) : 0; s.ttl = rnd(4.5, 10);
    s.phase = rnd(0, 6.28); s.color = COLORS[(Math.random() * COLORS.length) | 0];
    return s;
  }
  function frame(now) {
    if (stopped) return;
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - (last || now)) / 1000); last = now; t += dt;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    for (const s of sparks) {
      s.age += dt;
      if (s.age > s.ttl || s.y < -8) { spawn(s); continue; }
      s.x += (s.vx + Math.sin(t * 0.9 + s.phase) * 9) * dt; s.y += s.vy * dt;
      const life = s.age / s.ttl, fade = Math.sin(Math.PI * life) ** 0.8;
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, fade * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 6 + s.phase)) * 0.9);
      ctx.fillStyle = s.color;
      const q = 2; // (snapped to a 2 px grid: the stepped movement of pixel art)
      ctx.fillRect(Math.round(s.x / q) * q, Math.round(s.y / q) * q, s.size, s.size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  const ro = new ResizeObserver(resize); ro.observe(canvas);
  resize();
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  return { stop() { stopped = true; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); ro.disconnect(); ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); } };
}
```

`src/host/web/escape.js`:

```js
// Escape and the captured mouse, the same for every game's page (the Windows runtime, the browser ports): the first
// Escape goes to the game, the next one frees the mouse (the owner's rule: a game's own Escape — its menu, closing a
// window — must not cost the mouse).
// In full screen the keyboard is locked (shell.js lockKeys): Escape reaches the page while the mouse stays captured, so
// the page decides — the first press passes to the game, the next is kept from it and frees the mouse (a press with the
// mouse free goes to the game; holding Escape still leaves full screen). Out of full screen the browser frees the mouse
// at the first press and keeps the key from the page — a rule no page can change (checked with real key presses,
// Chrome 153): the game is sent that Escape all the same, and a click in the game captures the mouse again.

const KEY = { key: 'Escape', code: 'Escape', keyCode: 27 };

/**
 * Escape's rule for the game in `win` (this page's window, or a same-origin frame's: the engine page of a port).
 * @param {Window} win
 * @returns {{ sent: number }} (how many Escapes were sent to the game for the browser — for tests)
 */
export function escapeToGame(win = window) {
  const doc = win.document, out = { sent: 0 };
  if (win.__orthrosEscape) return win.__orthrosEscape;
  win.__orthrosEscape = out;
  let armed = false, keepUp = false, lastDown = -1e9, ours = -1e9, screenChange = -1e9;
  // (the mouse freed by a page's own code — the game's menu, a question of the page — is no Escape)
  const proto = win.Document.prototype, exit = proto.exitPointerLock;
  proto.exitPointerLock = function (...args) { ours = win.performance.now(); return exit.apply(this, args); };
  win.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape' || !e.isTrusted) return;
    lastDown = win.performance.now();
    if (e.repeat) return;
    if (!doc.pointerLockElement) { armed = false; return; }
    if (!armed) { armed = true; return; }   // (the first: the game's)
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    armed = false; keepUp = true;
    doc.exitPointerLock();
  }, true);
  win.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape' || !keepUp) return;
    keepUp = false; e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
  }, true);
  const screen = () => { screenChange = win.performance.now(); };
  doc.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', screen);
  try { if (win.top !== win) win.top.document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', screen); } catch { /* another origin */ }
  doc.addEventListener('pointerlockchange', () => {
    if (doc.pointerLockElement) { armed = false; return; }
    const at = win.performance.now();
    if (at - ours < 500) return;
    // (the browser freed it: an Escape it kept from the page — unless the page got the key, the window lost the focus,
    // the tab was left or full screen was left by holding Escape)
    setTimeout(() => {
      let full = false; try { full = !!(doc.fullscreenElement || win.top.document.fullscreenElement); } catch { /* another origin */ }
      if (doc.pointerLockElement || full || lastDown > at - 400 || screenChange > at - 1500 || doc.visibilityState !== 'visible' || !doc.hasFocus()) return;
      press(win); out.sent++;
    }, 120);
  });
  return out;
}

/** An Escape press and release, as the game's keyboard handlers read them. */
function press(win) {
  const target = win.document.activeElement ?? win.document.body;
  for (const [type, delay] of [['keydown', 0], ['keyup', 80]]) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const e = new win.KeyboardEvent(type, { key: KEY.key, code: KEY.code, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: win });
      for (const name of ['keyCode', 'which']) Object.defineProperty(e, name, { get: () => KEY.keyCode });
      target.dispatchEvent(e);
    }, delay);
  }
}
```
