`src/host/web/sound.js`:

```js
// The page's sound output, kept playing under the browser's autoplay rules, and what a session's telemetry says about
// it. Chrome creates an AudioContext suspended unless the page has had a user activation (a click, a key), and
// suspends or interrupts one for reasons of its own (output device change, system audio session): the context is
// resumed at every gesture while it is not running, the page shows a "click to enable sound" button meanwhile, and
// the telemetry summaries carry the context state, the worklet's progress, the mixer's level and the game's sound
// buffers — a player's "no sound" can then be told apart: context suspended, worklet stalled, or a silent mix.

/** user activation events (the ones that let a page start audio) */
export const GESTURES = ['pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'keydown', 'touchend', 'click'];

/**
 * Resume `ctx` at each user gesture on `target` while it is not running. Capture phase on the window: no handler of
 * the page (the game's input, a bench swallowing the player's input) can stop it. `onTry` is told before each
 * attempt. Returns a function removing the listeners.
 * @param {{ state: string, resume: () => Promise<void> }} ctx
 * @param {EventTarget} target
 */
export function resumeOnGesture(ctx, target, onTry) {
  const h = () => {
    if (ctx.state === 'running' || ctx.state === 'closed') return;
    onTry?.();
    ctx.resume().catch(() => { /* not allowed yet: the next gesture tries again */ });
  };
  for (const t of GESTURES) target.addEventListener(t, h, { capture: true });
  return () => { for (const t of GESTURES) target.removeEventListener(t, h, { capture: true }); };
}

/**
 * Whether the page shows the "click to enable sound" button: the game runs, sound is set up, and the context is not
 * running (suspended by the autoplay policy, interrupted by the system) for `graceMs` (a context resuming takes a
 * moment after a click).
 */
export function soundHintNeeded({ status, ctxState, notRunningSince, now, graceMs = 1500 }) {
  if (status !== 'running' && status !== 'starting') return false;
  if (!ctxState || ctxState === 'running' || ctxState === 'closed') return false;
  return notRunningSince !== null && now - notRunningSince >= graceMs;
}

/**
 * The audio part of a telemetry summary, accumulated over the summary's window (~20 s of stats messages). Bounded:
 * a dozen scalars per summary.
 */
export class AudioStats {
  constructor() {
    this.resumes = 0; this.changes = 0; this.error = null; this.lastFrames = null; this.lastAt = null;
    this.reset();
  }
  reset() { this.n = 0; this.running = 0; this.peak = 0; this.playing = 0; this.buffers = 0; this.frames = 0; this.seconds = 0; }
  /** the context changed state (statechange) */
  noteChange() { this.changes++; }
  /** a resume attempted at a gesture */
  noteResume() { this.resumes++; }
  /** setting up the output failed */
  noteError(msg) { if (!this.error) this.error = String(msg).slice(0, 200); }
  /**
   * One worker stats message `m` (audioPeak, audioBuffers, audioPlaying, audioDecodeFailures), with the context
   * (`ctx`: state, sampleRate, outputLatency, baseLatency; null: no output set up) and the output's frame counter
   * (`frames`: frames the AudioWorklet has played so far, null when unknown; `src`: which counter — a change of
   * counter starts the count again) at time `t` (ms).
   */
  add(m, ctx, frames, t, src = null) {
    this.n++;
    if (ctx?.state === 'running') this.running++;
    this.peak = Math.max(this.peak, m.audioPeak ?? 0);
    this.playing = Math.max(this.playing, m.audioPlaying ?? 0);
    this.buffers = Math.max(this.buffers, m.audioBuffers ?? 0);
    this.decodeFailures = m.audioDecodeFailures ?? 0;
    this.mix = m.audioMix ?? null;
    if (ctx) { this.ctx = ctx.state; this.rate = ctx.sampleRate; this.latency = Math.round(((ctx.outputLatency || 0) + (ctx.baseLatency || 0)) * 1000); }
    if (src !== this.src) { this.src = src; this.lastFrames = null; }
    if (frames !== null && frames !== undefined) {
      if (this.lastFrames !== null && t > this.lastAt) { this.frames += (frames - this.lastFrames) | 0; this.seconds += (t - this.lastAt) / 1000; }
      this.lastFrames = frames; this.lastAt = t;
    }
  }
  /** The window's record (null when nothing was added), and a new window. */
  take() {
    if (!this.n) return null;
    const r = {
      ctx: this.ctx ?? 'none', rate: this.rate ?? null, lat: this.latency ?? null,
      run: Math.round((this.running / this.n) * 100) / 100, // (share of the window with the context running)
      out: this.seconds > 0 ? Math.round(this.frames / this.seconds) : null, // (frames/s the worklet played: ~rate when it runs, 0 stalled)
      mix: this.mix ?? null, peak: Math.round(this.peak * 1000) / 1000, play: this.playing, bufs: this.buffers,
      dec: this.decodeFailures ?? 0, resumes: this.resumes, changes: this.changes,
      ...(this.error ? { err: this.error } : {}),
    };
    this.reset();
    return r;
  }
}

/**
 * What a session's audio records (AudioStats.take() of its summaries, oldest first) say, for tools/telemetry-report:
 * { verdict, ...figures }. verdict: 'none' (no record: an older build, or no game ran), 'error' (the output failed),
 * 'suspended' (the context never ran: the player did not click the page), 'stalled' (running, but the worklet played
 * nothing), 'silent' (the game's buffers played but the mix stayed at zero), 'quiet' (no buffer played: no sound
 * from the game so far), 'ok' (sound reached the output).
 */
export function audioVerdict(records) {
  const rs = records.filter(Boolean);
  if (!rs.length) return { verdict: 'none' };
  const max = (k) => Math.max(...rs.map((r) => r[k] ?? 0));
  const ran = rs.filter((r) => (r.run ?? 0) > 0), out = ran.map((r) => r.out).filter((x) => x !== null && x !== undefined);
  const f = {
    states: [...new Set(rs.map((r) => r.ctx))].join('/'), rate: rs.findLast((r) => r.rate)?.rate ?? null,
    run: Math.round((rs.reduce((a, r) => a + (r.run ?? 0), 0) / rs.length) * 100) / 100,
    out: out.length ? Math.round(out.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / out.length) : null,
    peak: max('peak'), play: max('play'), bufs: max('bufs'), dec: max('dec'), resumes: max('resumes'), changes: max('changes'),
    err: rs.find((r) => r.err)?.err ?? null, mix: rs.findLast((r) => r.mix)?.mix ?? null,
  };
  // (the level while the context ran: the worker mixes into the ring before the first click too — a peak then was never heard)
  const heard = Math.max(0, ...ran.map((r) => r.peak ?? 0));
  const verdict = f.err && !ran.length ? 'error' : !ran.length ? 'suspended' : f.out !== null && f.out < 1000 ? 'stalled' : heard > 0 ? 'ok' : f.play > 0 ? 'silent' : 'quiet';
  return { verdict, ...f };
}

/** one line on a session's sound (audioVerdict) */
export const audioText = (a) => `sound: ${a.verdict.toUpperCase()} — context ${a.states}${a.rate ? ` @${a.rate} Hz` : ''}, running ${Math.round(a.run * 100)}% of the time, output ${a.out ?? '?'} frames/s (${a.mix ?? '?'} mix), mix peak ${a.peak}, buffers playing ≤ ${a.play} of ${a.bufs}${a.dec ? `, ${a.dec} audio decoder failure(s)` : ''}, ${a.resumes} resume(s) at gestures, ${a.changes} state change(s)${a.err ? `; error: ${a.err}` : ''}`;

```

`src/host/web/storage-persist.js`:

```js
// The browser's storage of the game data, the same for every runtime (CLAUDE.md "Standardization", docs/slow-network.md
// "Persistent storage"): a page asks once, before its first write of game data, that the origin's storage be persistent
// (StorageManager.persist: Chrome grants or refuses silently, by the site's engagement — no prompt; a best-effort origin's
// stores may be evicted when the disk runs short), and the telemetry of every runtime says what the browser gave
// ({ persisted, usage, quota }: withStorage — the Windows games' page, the ports' event records, the perf records of
// perf-page.js). Page side only: persist() does not exist in workers (they have persisted() and estimate()).

const MiB = 1 << 20;
/** bytes as whole MiB (the telemetry needs no more: a quota to the byte tells the disk) */
const mib = (n) => (Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 ? Math.round(n / MiB) : null);

/**
 * The origin's storage now: { persisted (true, false; null unknown), usageMB, quotaMB } — null without a StorageManager.
 * @param {any} [nav] the navigator (a test's)
 */
export async function storageState(nav = globalThis.navigator) {
  const sm = nav?.storage; if (!sm) return null;
  const [persisted, est] = await Promise.all([
    Promise.resolve().then(() => sm.persisted?.()).catch(() => null),
    Promise.resolve().then(() => sm.estimate?.()).catch(() => null),
  ]);
  return { persisted: typeof persisted === 'boolean' ? persisted : null, usageMB: mib(est?.usage), quotaMB: mib(est?.quota) };
}

/**
 * Ask that the origin's storage be persistent unless it is (never throws): storageState() after it, with `asked` (the
 * page called persist() — a refusal leaves `persisted` false) — null without a StorageManager.
 */
export async function askPersist(nav = globalThis.navigator) {
  const sm = nav?.storage; if (!sm) return null;
  let asked = false;
  try { if (typeof sm.persist === 'function' && (await sm.persisted?.()) !== true) { asked = true; await sm.persist(); } } catch { /* refused */ }
  const st = await storageState(nav);
  return st && { ...st, asked };
}

/**
 * A page's storage, for its telemetry: `ask()` (once a page: before its first write of game data — the game's start, a
 * Prepare or a download; the later calls the same promise) then `state`, the last known (null until known).
 */
export function pageStorage(nav = globalThis.navigator) {
  const s = {
    /** @type {{ persisted: boolean|null, usageMB: number|null, quotaMB: number|null, asked?: boolean }|null} */
    state: null,
    asking: null,
    ask() { return (s.asking ??= askPersist(nav).then((st) => (s.state = st), () => null)); },
    /** the state read again (the usage grows as the game data comes), `asked` kept */
    read() { return storageState(nav).then((st) => (s.state = st && { ...st, asked: !!s.state?.asked }), () => s.state); },
  };
  return s;
}

/** A telemetry env with the storage's state (`storage`: pageStorage's, null while unknown) — every runtime's. */
export const withStorage = (env, storage) => ({ ...env, storage: storage ?? null });

```

`src/host/web/timing-probe.js`:

```js
// Host-timing probe (docs/real-machine-bench.md, docs/thread-scheduling.md "Host wake-up overshoot"): how late this
// browser wakes a worker up — Atomics.wait(1 ms), setTimeout(0) and setTimeout(1) (chained from their own callbacks, as
// a timer loop runs), a MessageChannel hop — and the battery state. On Windows the first three follow the system timer
// (15.625 ms by default, ~1 ms while a 1 ms resolution is held — Chrome drops it on battery): what made the frame
// limiter's waits oversleep. The bench runs it in a small worker of its own (the emulator's worker keeps running: the
// timer resolution is the process's) at the start and at each phase mark; its results go into the bench record and the
// summary panel. Runs in Node as well (the tests).
import { quantised } from '../../core/host-wait.js';

/** samples per kind */
export const PROBE_SAMPLES = 24;

/** { n, mean, p50, p90, max } of the overshoots (ms, rounded to 0.01) */
export function summarise(v) {
  if (!v.length) return null;
  const s = Float64Array.from(v).sort(), q = (x) => s[Math.min(s.length - 1, Math.floor(x * s.length))], r = (x) => Math.round(x * 100) / 100;
  return { n: s.length, mean: r(s.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / s.length), p50: r(q(0.5)), p90: r(q(0.9)), max: r(s[s.length - 1]) };
}

/**
 * Measure the wake-ups. `q`: an injected coarse timer (ORTHROS_HOST_TIMER_Q, ms) applied to the timed waits — the probe
 * then shows what it would measure on such a host (a check of the reporting path, flagged `injected`).
 * @returns {Promise<{ atomicsWait1, atomicsWait1Timer, setTimeout0, setTimeout1, messageHop, injected }>}
 */
export async function measureHostTiming({ n = PROBE_SAMPLES, q = 0, now = () => performance.now() } = {}) {
  const sab = new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4));
  const waitMs = (ms) => { const t0 = now(); Atomics.wait(sab, 0, 0, quantised(t0, ms, q)); return now() - t0 - ms; };
  const out = { injected: q || 0 };
  // Atomics.wait(1): the emulator's own short waits (sched idle, the Sleep(0) throttle)
  let v = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) v.push(waitMs(1));
  out.atomicsWait1 = summarise(v);
  // the same while a short timer is pending (Chrome may raise the timer resolution for pending short timers)
  const pending = setTimeout(() => {}, 4);
  v = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) v.push(waitMs(1));
  clearTimeout(pending);
  out.atomicsWait1Timer = summarise(v);
  // setTimeout(d) chained from its own callback (overshoot past d; after 5 nested levels HTML clamps to 4 ms)
  const chain = (d) => new Promise((resolve) => {
    const r = []; let t0 = now();
    const step = () => { r.push(now() - t0 - d); if (r.length >= n) { resolve(r); return; } t0 = now(); setTimeout(step, d > 0 ? quantised(t0, d, q) : 0); };
    setTimeout(step, d > 0 ? quantised(t0, d, q) : 0);
  });
  out.setTimeout0 = summarise(await chain(0));
  out.setTimeout1 = summarise(await chain(1));
  // a MessageChannel hop (the worker's pump between slices)
  v = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const ch = new MessageChannel(), r = []; let t0 = now();
    ch.port1.onmessage = () => { r.push(now() - t0); if (r.length >= n) { ch.port1.close(); resolve(r); return; } t0 = now(); ch.port2.postMessage(0); };
    ch.port2.postMessage(0);
  });
  out.messageHop = summarise(v);
  return out;
}

/** The battery as the page sees it ({ charging, level } or null without the Battery Status API). */
export async function batteryState(nav = globalThis.navigator) {
  try { const b = await nav?.getBattery?.(); return b ? { charging: !!b.charging, level: Math.round(b.level * 100) / 100 } : null; } catch { return null; }
}

/** One line for a person: the Atomics.wait / setTimeout / hop overshoots (p50 / p90 ms) and the battery. */
export function probeLine(p) {
  if (!p) return '';
  const f = (s) => (s ? `+${s.p50} / ${s.p90}` : '–');
  const bat = p.battery ? `; battery ${Math.round(p.battery.level * 100)} %${p.battery.charging ? ' charging' : ' on battery'}` : '';
  return `Atomics.wait(1) ${f(p.atomicsWait1)} (timer pending ${f(p.atomicsWait1Timer)}), setTimeout(0) ${f(p.setTimeout0)}, setTimeout(1) ${f(p.setTimeout1)}, hop ${p.messageHop ? `${p.messageHop.p50} / ${p.messageHop.p90}` : '–'} ms (p50 / p90)${bat}${p.injected ? ` [injected ${p.injected} ms timer]` : ''}`;
}

/**
 * The page side: a probe worker (this module) asked for a measurement; resolves to its results with the battery, or
 * null when workers or SharedArrayBuffer are missing. `q`: the injected timer, if any.
 */
export function runTimingProbe(q = 0, timeoutMs = 10000) {
  if (typeof Worker === 'undefined' || typeof SharedArrayBuffer === 'undefined') return Promise.resolve(null);
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let w;
    try { w = new Worker(import.meta.url, { type: 'module', name: 'orthros-timing-probe' }); } catch { resolve(null); return; }
    const done = (r) => { clearTimeout(timer); try { w.terminate(); } catch { /* gone */ } resolve(r); };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => done(null), timeoutMs);
    w.onmessage = async (e) => done({ ...e.data, battery: await batteryState() });
    w.onerror = () => done(null);
    w.postMessage({ q });
  });
}

// (this module as the probe worker)
if (typeof WorkerGlobalScope !== 'undefined' && globalThis.name === 'orthros-timing-probe') {
  globalThis.onmessage = async (e) => { globalThis.postMessage(await measureHostTiming({ q: Number(e.data?.q) || 0 })); };
}
```
