```js
void IN_RING; void AUDIO_RING_FRAMES;

/**
 * The link to the server's virtual LAN (src/host/lan.js, D061): host.lan for the emulated Winsock — the address the
 * server gave, send() of a frame — and the frames received handed to it between guest time slices. Reconnects after a
 * drop (the address may then change: a game in progress loses its peers, as on a real network cable pulled).
 */
function connectLan(h, room) {
  if (typeof WebSocket === 'undefined') return;
  const lan = h.lan = { ip: null, peers: 0, ws: null, sent: 0, received: 0 };
  lan.send = (type, src, dst, payload) => {
    const ws = lan.ws; if (!ws || ws.readyState !== 1) return;
    const f = new Uint8Array(LAN.HEADER + (payload?.length ?? 0)), dv = new DataView(f.buffer);
    f[0] = type; dv.setUint32(1, src.ip, true); dv.setUint16(5, src.port); dv.setUint32(7, dst.ip, true); dv.setUint16(11, dst.port);
    if (payload) f.set(payload, LAN.HEADER);
    ws.send(f); lan.sent++;
  };
  const open = () => {
    const ws = new WebSocket(`${location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss' : 'ws'}://${location.host}/api/lan?room=${encodeURIComponent(room)}`);
    ws.binaryType = 'arraybuffer'; lan.ws = ws;
    ws.onmessage = (e) => {
      if (typeof e.data === 'string') {
        let m; try { m = JSON.parse(e.data); } catch { return; }
        if (m.type === 'hello') { lan.ip = m.ip; lan.name = m.name ?? null; log('net', `LAN: address ${m.ip}${m.name ? ` (${m.name})` : ''}, ${m.peers} player${m.peers > 1 ? 's' : ''} of this game on the server`); }
        if (m.type === 'refused') { lan.refused = true; log('net', `LAN: ${m.reason ?? 'refused'}`); post({ type: 'lan', ip: null, peers: 0, refused: true }); }
        if (m.peers !== undefined) { lan.peers = m.peers; post({ type: 'lan', ip: lan.ip, peers: m.peers }); }
        return;
      }
      const f = new Uint8Array(e.data); if (f.length < LAN.HEADER) return;
      const dv = new DataView(f.buffer);
      lan.received++;
      vm?.lanDeliver?.(f[0], { ip: dv.getUint32(1, true), port: dv.getUint16(5) }, { ip: dv.getUint32(7, true), port: dv.getUint16(11) }, f.subarray(LAN.HEADER));
      h.wake?.();
    };
    // (refused — no Orthros account signed in: not again until the next start)
    ws.onclose = (e) => { lan.ws = null; if (lan.refused) return; log('net', `LAN: link closed (${e.code}${e.reason ? ' ' + e.reason : ''}), reconnecting`); post({ type: 'lan', ip: null, peers: 0 }); setTimeout(open, 3000); };
  };
  open();
}
```

`src/loader/pe.js`:

```js
// PE32 image loader: parses headers, maps sections into guest memory (relocating if the
// preferred base is taken), resolves imports against builtin API modules or other loaded PE
// modules, and exposes exports, TLS and resource directories.

const DIR = Object.freeze({
  EXPORT: 0, IMPORT: 1, RESOURCE: 2, EXCEPTION: 3, SECURITY: 4, BASERELOC: 5, DEBUG: 6,
  TLS: 9, LOADCONFIG: 10, BOUND_IMPORT: 11, IAT: 12, DELAY_IMPORT: 13,
});
export { DIR as PE_DIR };

export class PeError extends Error {}

/** Parsed (not yet mapped) PE32 image. */
export class PeImage {
  /** @param {Uint8Array} bytes */
  constructor(bytes) {
    this.bytes = bytes;
    const dv = (this.dv = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength));
    if (bytes.length < 0x40 || dv.getUint16(0, true) !== 0x5a4d) throw new PeError('not a PE file (no MZ)');
    const pe = dv.getUint32(0x3c, true);
    if (pe + 24 > bytes.length || dv.getUint32(pe, true) !== 0x00004550) throw new PeError('no PE signature');
    this.machine = dv.getUint16(pe + 4, true);
    if (this.machine !== 0x14c) throw new PeError(`unsupported machine 0x${this.machine.toString(16)} (only i386)`);
    this.numSections = dv.getUint16(pe + 6, true);
    this.timestamp = dv.getUint32(pe + 8, true);
    const optSize = dv.getUint16(pe + 20, true);
    this.characteristics = dv.getUint16(pe + 22, true);
    this.isDll = (this.characteristics & 0x2000) !== 0;
    const opt = pe + 24;
    if (dv.getUint16(opt, true) !== 0x10b) throw new PeError('not PE32');
    this.entryRva = dv.getUint32(opt + 16, true);
    this.imageBase = dv.getUint32(opt + 28, true);
    this.sectionAlign = dv.getUint32(opt + 32, true);
    this.fileAlign = dv.getUint32(opt + 36, true);
    this.sizeOfImage = dv.getUint32(opt + 56, true);
    this.sizeOfHeaders = dv.getUint32(opt + 60, true);
    this.subsystem = dv.getUint16(opt + 68, true);
    this.dllCharacteristics = dv.getUint16(opt + 70, true);
    this.stackReserve = dv.getUint32(opt + 72, true);
    this.stackCommit = dv.getUint32(opt + 76, true);
    this.heapReserve = dv.getUint32(opt + 80, true);
    const ndirs = dv.getUint32(opt + 92, true);
    this.dirs = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(ndirs, 16); i++) {
      this.dirs.push({ rva: dv.getUint32(opt + 96 + 8 * i, true), size: dv.getUint32(opt + 100 + 8 * i, true) });
    }
    while (this.dirs.length < 16) this.dirs.push({ rva: 0, size: 0 });
    this.sections = [];
    let sh = opt + optSize;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.numSections; i++, sh += 40) {
      let name = '';
      for (let k = 0; k < 8 && bytes[sh + k]; k++) name += String.fromCharCode(bytes[sh + k]);
      this.sections.push({
        name,
        virtualSize: dv.getUint32(sh + 8, true),
        rva: dv.getUint32(sh + 12, true),
        rawSize: dv.getUint32(sh + 16, true),
        rawPtr: dv.getUint32(sh + 20, true),
        characteristics: dv.getUint32(sh + 36, true),
      });
    }
  }

  /** Read a NUL-terminated string at a file offset. */
  cstr(off) {
    let s = '';
    while (off < this.bytes.length && this.bytes[off]) s += String.fromCharCode(this.bytes[off++]);
    return s;
  }
}

/**
 * A module mapped in guest memory.
 * @typedef {object} PeModule
 * @property {string} name lowercase file name, e.g. 'lotrbfme.exe'
 * @property {string} path guest path
 * @property {number} base
 * @property {number} size
 * @property {number} entry absolute entry point (0 if none)
 * @property {boolean} isDll
 * @property {Map<string, number>} exports name -> address (or forwarder string via forwards)
 * @property {Map<number, number>} ordinals ordinal -> address
 * @property {Map<string, string>} forwards name -> "dll.name"
 * @property {Array<{dll: string, name: string|null, ordinal: number|null, iat: number}>} imports
 * @property {PeImage} image
 */

/**
 * Map an image into guest memory.
 * @param {PeImage} img
 * @param {import('../cpu/memory.js').GuestMemory} mem
 * @param {import('../win32/vmem.js').VMem} vmem
 * @param {{ name: string, path: string, preferredBase?: number }} opts
 * @returns {PeModule}
 */
export function mapImage(img, mem, vmem, opts) {
  const size = alignUp(img.sizeOfImage, 0x1000);
  let base = opts.preferredBase ?? img.imageBase;
  if (!vmem.isFree(base, size)) base = 0;
  base = vmem.reserve(size, base, 'image:' + opts.name);
  if (!base) throw new PeError(`cannot map ${opts.name}: no address space`);
  vmem.commit(base, size, 0x40 /* PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE */);
  mem.fill(base, size, 0);
  // headers
  mem.writeBytes(base, img.bytes.subarray(0, Math.min(img.sizeOfHeaders, img.bytes.length)));
  for (const s of img.sections) {
    const n = Math.min(s.rawSize, s.virtualSize || s.rawSize);
    if (n > 0 && s.rawPtr + n <= img.bytes.length) mem.writeBytes(base + s.rva, img.bytes.subarray(s.rawPtr, s.rawPtr + n));
  }
  setSectionProtections(img, vmem, base);
  const mod = {
    name: opts.name.toLowerCase(),
    path: opts.path,
    base,
    size,
    entry: img.entryRva ? base + img.entryRva : 0,
    isDll: img.isDll,
    exports: new Map(),
    ordinals: new Map(),
    forwards: new Map(),
    imports: [],
    image: img,
    tls: null,
    refCount: 1,
    attached: false,
  };
  if (base !== img.imageBase) relocate(mod, mem);
  parseExports(mod, mem);
  parseImports(mod, mem);
  parseTls(mod, mem);
  return mod;
}

function alignUp(v, a) { return (v + a - 1) & ~(a - 1); }

/**
 * Page protections as the Windows loader leaves them: headers read-only, each section by its characteristics
 * (execute / read / write; writable sections copy-on-write, as a freshly mapped image reports them). Not enforced
 * on memory accesses: seen by VirtualQuery, VirtualProtect's previous protection and IsBad*Ptr. Images whose
 * sections are aligned below the page size share pages between sections and stay execute-read-write.
 */
function setSectionProtections(img, vmem, base) {
  if (img.sectionAlign < 0x1000) return;
  vmem.protect(base, alignUp(Math.max(1, img.sizeOfHeaders), 0x1000), 0x02 /* PAGE_READONLY */);
  for (const s of img.sections) {
    const c = s.characteristics >>> 0, x = c & 0x20000000, r = c & 0x40000000, w = c & 0x80000000;
    const prot = x ? (w ? 0x80 : r ? 0x20 : 0x10) : w ? 0x08 : r ? 0x02 : 0x01; // (EXECUTE_)WRITECOPY / (EXECUTE_)READ / EXECUTE / READONLY / NOACCESS
    const size = alignUp(Math.max(s.virtualSize, s.rawSize, 1), 0x1000);
    if (s.rva + size <= img.sizeOfImage + 0xfff) vmem.protect(base + s.rva, size, prot);
  }
}

function relocate(mod, mem) {
  const dir = mod.image.dirs[DIR.BASERELOC];
  const delta = (mod.base - mod.image.imageBase) | 0;
  if (!dir.rva || !dir.size) {
    if (delta !== 0 && mod.image.dirs[DIR.IMPORT].rva) throw new PeError(`${mod.name}: relocated without .reloc`);
    return;
  }
  let p = mod.base + dir.rva;
  const end = p + dir.size;
  while (p + 8 <= end) {
    const pageRva = mem.read32(p), blockSize = mem.read32(p + 4);
    if (blockSize < 8) break;
    const n = (blockSize - 8) >> 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const e = mem.read16(p + 8 + 2 * i);
      const type = e >> 12, off = e & 0xfff;
      const a = mod.base + pageRva + off;
      if (type === 3) mem.write32(a, (mem.read32(a) + delta) >>> 0);
      else if (type === 1) mem.write16(a, (mem.read16(a) + (delta >> 16)) & 0xffff);
      else if (type === 2) mem.write16(a, (mem.read16(a) + (delta & 0xffff)) & 0xffff);
      // type 0: padding
    }
    p += blockSize;
  }
}

function parseExports(mod, mem) {
  const dir = mod.image.dirs[DIR.EXPORT];
  if (!dir.rva || !dir.size) return;
  const b = mod.base, e = b + dir.rva;
  const ordBase = mem.read32(e + 16);
  const nFuncs = mem.read32(e + 20), nNames = mem.read32(e + 24);
  const funcs = b + mem.read32(e + 28), names = b + mem.read32(e + 32), nameOrds = b + mem.read32(e + 36);
  const isForwarder = (rva) => rva >= dir.rva && rva < dir.rva + dir.size;
  for (let i = 0; i < nFuncs; i++) {
    const rva = mem.read32(funcs + 4 * i);
    if (!rva) continue;
    if (isForwarder(rva)) mod.forwards.set('#' + (ordBase + i), mem.readCString(b + rva));
    else mod.ordinals.set(ordBase + i, b + rva);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < nNames; i++) {
    const name = mem.readCString(b + mem.read32(names + 4 * i));
    const idx = mem.read16(nameOrds + 2 * i);
    const rva = mem.read32(funcs + 4 * idx);
    if (!rva) continue;
    if (isForwarder(rva)) mod.forwards.set(name, mem.readCString(b + rva));
    else mod.exports.set(name, b + rva);
  }
}

function parseImports(mod, mem) {
  const dir = mod.image.dirs[DIR.IMPORT];
  if (!dir.rva) return;
  const b = mod.base;
  let d = b + dir.rva;
  for (;;) {
    const oft = mem.read32(d), nameRva = mem.read32(d + 12), ft = mem.read32(d + 16);
    if (!nameRva && !ft) break;
    const dll = mem.readCString(b + nameRva).toLowerCase();
    let lookup = b + (oft || ft), iat = b + ft;
    for (;;) {
      const v = mem.read32(lookup);
      if (!v) break;
      if (v & 0x80000000) mod.imports.push({ dll, name: null, ordinal: v & 0xffff, iat });
      else mod.imports.push({ dll, name: mem.readCString(b + v + 2), ordinal: null, iat });
      lookup += 4; iat += 4;
    }
    d += 20;
  }
}

function parseTls(mod, mem) {
  const dir = mod.image.dirs[DIR.TLS];
  if (!dir.rva || dir.size < 24) return;
  const t = mod.base + dir.rva;
  const start = mem.read32(t), end = mem.read32(t + 4), indexAddr = mem.read32(t + 8), callbacks = mem.read32(t + 12), zeroFill = mem.read32(t + 16);
  const cbs = [];
  if (callbacks) {
    for (let p = callbacks; ; p += 4) { const cb = mem.read32(p); if (!cb) break; cbs.push(cb); if (cbs.length > 64) break; }
  }
  mod.tls = { start, end, indexAddr, callbacks: cbs, zeroFill, size: (end - start) + zeroFill, index: -1 };
}

/**
 * Find a resource by type/name/language in the resource directory. Type/name may be numbers
 * (ids) or strings. Returns { addr, size } or null.
 */
export function findResource(mod, mem, type, name, lang = -1) {
  const dir = mod.image.dirs[DIR.RESOURCE];
  if (!dir.rva) return null;
  const root = mod.base + dir.rva;
  const walk = (tbl, key) => {
    const nNamed = mem.read16(tbl + 12), nId = mem.read16(tbl + 14);
    for (let i = 0; i < nNamed + nId; i++) {
      const e = tbl + 16 + 8 * i;
      const id = mem.read32(e), off = mem.read32(e + 4);
      let match;
      if (key === -1 || key === undefined) match = true;
      else if (id & 0x80000000) {
        if (typeof key !== 'string') continue;
        const sa = root + (id & 0x7fffffff);
        const len = mem.read16(sa);
        const s = mem.readWString(sa + 2, len);
        match = s.toLowerCase() === key.toLowerCase();
      } else match = typeof key === 'number' && id === key;
      if (match) return off;
    }
    return null;
  };
  const t = walk(root, type);
  if (t === null || !(t & 0x80000000)) return null;
  const n = walk(root + (t & 0x7fffffff), name);
  if (n === null || !(n & 0x80000000)) return null;
  const l = walk(root + (n & 0x7fffffff), lang);
  if (l === null || l & 0x80000000) return null;
  const entry = root + l;
  return { addr: mod.base + mem.read32(entry), size: mem.read32(entry + 4) };
}
```

`src/media/avi-source.js`:

```js
// AVI files for the DirectShow path (RIFF 'AVI '): the first video and audio streams, read progressively; video through
// the Video for Windows codecs Windows ships with (vfw-codecs.js), sound as in WAVE files (PCM / ADPCM, wav-source.js)
// or MPEG audio (layers I / II here, layer III through the browser). Same playing interface as MpegSource; pictures as
// RGBA ({ rgba, width, height }).
import { MediaError, AsyncAudio } from './mpeg-source.js';
import { WaveDecoder } from './wav-source.js';
import { readBitmapInfo, vfwDecoder } from './vfw-codecs.js';
import { MpegAudioDecoder } from './mpeg-audio.js';
import { mpegAudioHeader } from './mpeg-ps.js';

const CHUNK = 256 * 1024;
const id4 = (b, i) => String.fromCharCode(b[i], b[i + 1], b[i + 2], b[i + 3]);
const u16 = (b, i) => b[i] | (b[i + 1] << 8), u32 = (b, i) => (b[i] | (b[i + 1] << 8) | (b[i + 2] << 16) | (b[i + 3] << 24)) >>> 0;

/** an AVI file's first bytes? */
export const isAvi = (b) => b.length >= 12 && id4(b, 0) === 'RIFF' && id4(b, 8) === 'AVI ';

export class AviSource {
  constructor(file, head, opts = {}) {
    this.file = file; this.log = opts.log ?? (() => {});
    this.size = file.size();
    this.kind = 'avi'; this.videoStart = 0; this.audioStart = 0; this.audioLayer = 0;
    // the header list (hdrl) and where the movi list starts (the header may extend past the first bytes read)
    let b = head;
    const need = (n) => { if (n > b.length && b.length < this.size) b = file.read(0, Math.min(this.size, Math.max(n, 2 * b.length))); return n <= b.length; };
    let i = 12, streams = [], movi = -1, usPerFrame = 0, frames = 0;
    while (movi < 0 && need(i + 12)) {
      const id = id4(b, i), n = u32(b, i + 4);
      if (id === 'LIST') {
        const type = id4(b, i + 8);
        if (type === 'movi') { movi = i + 12; this.moviEnd = Math.min(this.size, i + 8 + n); break; }
        if (type === 'hdrl') {
          if (!need(i + 8 + n)) throw new MediaError('corrupt', 'AVI header');
          for (let j = i + 12; j + 8 <= i + 8 + n;) {
            const cid = id4(b, j), cn = u32(b, j + 4);
            if (cid === 'avih') { usPerFrame = u32(b, j + 8); frames = u32(b, j + 24); }
            else if (cid === 'LIST' && id4(b, j + 8) === 'strl') streams.push(this.streamList(b, j + 12, Math.min(j + 8 + cn, i + 8 + n))); // (a damaged size: not past the header list)
            j += 8 + cn + (cn & 1);
          }
        }
        i += 8 + n + (n & 1);
        continue;
      }
      i += 8 + n + (n & 1);
    }
    if (movi < 0) throw new MediaError('corrupt', 'AVI without movi list');
    this.moviStart = movi;
    // the streams played: the first video and audio ones that can be decoded
    const vids = streams.findIndex((s) => s.type === 'vids'), auds = streams.findIndex((s) => s.type === 'auds');
    this.vIndex = -1; this.aIndex = -1; this.video = null; this.audio = null;
    if (vids >= 0) {
      const s = streams[vids];
      if (s.bih && vfwDecoder(s.bih, s.handler)) { this.vIndex = vids; this.vs = s; this.video = true; this.width = s.bih.width; this.height = s.bih.height; this.fps = s.rate / (s.scale || 1); this.videoStart = s.start * (s.scale || 1) / (s.rate || 1); }
      else this.videoUnsupported = `AVI video ${s.handlerName || ''} (compression ${s.bih ? s.bih.compression.toString(16) : '?'})`;
    }
    if (auds >= 0) {
      const s = streams[auds];
      this.aIndex = auds; this.as = s; this.audioRate = s.wfx.rate; this.audioChannels = s.wfx.channels;
      this.audioMpeg = s.wfx.tag === 0x50 || s.wfx.tag === 0x55;
      this.audioAsync = s.wfx.tag === 0x55 && AsyncAudio.available();
      try { if (!this.audioMpeg) new WaveDecoder(s.wfx); this.audio = !this.audioMpeg || s.wfx.tag === 0x50 || this.audioAsync; } catch { this.audio = false; }
      if (!this.audio) { this.audioUnsupported = `AVI audio format 0x${s.wfx.tag.toString(16)}`; this.audioLayer = s.wfx.tag === 0x55 ? 3 : 0; }
    }
    if (this.videoUnsupported) this.log(`${this.videoUnsupported}: no decoder, the file plays without pictures`);
    if (this.audioUnsupported) this.log(`${this.audioUnsupported}: no decoder, the file plays without sound`);
    if (!this.video && !this.audio) throw new MediaError('unsupported', this.videoUnsupported ?? this.audioUnsupported ?? 'AVI without streams');
    this.duration = this.video ? (this.vs.length || frames) / this.fps : usPerFrame * frames / 1e6;
    if (!this.duration && this.audio) this.duration = (this.as.length * (this.as.scale || 1) / (this.as.rate || 1)) || 0;
    this.reset();
  }
  /** a strl list: { type, handler, scale, rate, start, length, sampleSize, bih | wfx } */
  streamList(b, i, end) {
    const s = {};
    end = Math.min(end, b.length);
    for (let j = i; j + 8 <= end;) {
      const cid = id4(b, j), n = u32(b, j + 4), d = j + 8;
      if (cid === 'strh') { s.type = id4(b, d); s.handlerName = id4(b, d + 4); s.handler = u32(b, d + 4); s.scale = u32(b, d + 20); s.rate = u32(b, d + 24); s.start = u32(b, d + 28); s.length = u32(b, d + 32); s.sampleSize = u32(b, d + 44); }
      else if (cid === 'strf') {
        if (s.type === 'vids' && n >= 40) s.bih = readBitmapInfo(b, d, n);
        else if (s.type === 'auds' && n >= 14) s.wfx = { tag: u16(b, d), channels: u16(b, d + 2), rate: u32(b, d + 4), align: u16(b, d + 12), bits: n >= 16 ? u16(b, d + 14) : 0, extra: b.slice(d + 16, d + n) };
      }
      j += 8 + n + (n & 1);
    }
    return s;
  }
  reset() {
    this.vdec = this.video ? vfwDecoder(this.vs.bih, this.vs.handler) : null;
    this.adec?.close?.();
    this.adec = !this.audio ? null : this.audioMpeg ? (this.audioAsync ? new AsyncAudio('mp3', this.audioRate, this.audioChannels, this.log) : new MpegAudioDecoder()) : new WaveDecoder(this.as.wfx);
    this.buf = new Uint8Array(0); this.bufAt = this.moviStart; this.parsePos = this.moviStart; // (file bytes from bufAt, parsed up to parsePos)
    this.loadPos = this.moviStart; this.loading = null; this.loadError = null; this.eof = false;
    this.vq = []; this.aq = []; // queued video chunks (frame data) and audio chunks
    this.frameIndex = 0; this.picture = null; this.videoDone = !this.video; this.audioDone = !this.audio;
    this.audioPos = 0; this.submitPos = 0; this.mpegBuf = new Uint8Array(0);
    this.stats = { decoded: 0, skipped: 0, overtaken: 0, late: 0, decodeMs: 0 };
  }
  get bytesPerSecond() { return this.duration ? this.size / this.duration : 1 << 20; }
  /** read and parse ahead to stream time t + 2 s (see MpegSource.load) */
  load(t, maxChunks = 4) {
    const want = Math.min(this.moviEnd, Math.ceil((t + 2) * this.bytesPerSecond) + CHUNK);
    let n = 0;
    while (!this.eof && this.loadPos < want && n < maxChunks && !this.loading) {
      const len = Math.min(CHUNK, this.moviEnd - this.loadPos);
      const p = this.file.prepare?.(this.loadPos, len);
      if (p) { this.loading = p; p.then(() => { this.loading = null; }, (e) => { this.loading = null; this.loadError = e; }); break; }
      const bytes = this.file.read(this.loadPos, len);
      if (!bytes.length) { this.eof = true; break; }
      this.append(bytes); this.loadPos += bytes.length; n++;
      if (this.loadPos >= this.moviEnd) this.eof = true;
    }
    this.parse();
    return false;
  }
  append(bytes) {
    const keep = this.buf.subarray(this.parsePos - this.bufAt);
    const nb = new Uint8Array(keep.length + bytes.length); nb.set(keep); nb.set(bytes, keep.length);
    this.buf = nb; this.bufAt = this.parsePos;
  }
  /** the complete chunks of the movi list read so far, queued by stream */
  parse() {
    const b = this.buf;
    for (;;) {
      const i = this.parsePos - this.bufAt;
      if (i + 8 > b.length) break;
      const id = id4(b, i), n = u32(b, i + 4);
      if (id === 'LIST') { this.parsePos += 12; continue; } // ('rec ' groups: their chunks follow)
      if (id === 'idx1' || this.parsePos + 8 > this.moviEnd) { this.parsePos = this.moviEnd; this.eof = true; break; }
      if (i + 8 + n > b.length) break;
      const stream = (b[i] - 48) * 10 + (b[i + 1] - 48), kind = id.slice(2);
      const data = b.subarray(i + 8, i + 8 + n);
      if (stream === this.vIndex && (kind === 'dc' || kind === 'db')) this.vq.push(data);
      else if (stream === this.vIndex && kind === 'pc') this.vq.push({ palette: data.slice() });
      else if (stream === this.aIndex && kind === 'wb') this.aq.push(data);
      this.parsePos += 8 + n + (n & 1);
    }
    if (this.eof && this.parsePos >= this.loadPos - 8) this.parsedAll = true;
  }
  frameTime(i) { return this.videoStart + i / this.fps; }
  /** the picture due at stream time t (every frame decoded in order: they depend on each other) */
  pictureAt(t) {
    if (!this.vdec) return null;
    const st = this.stats, t0 = performance.now();
    let shown = null;
    while (!this.videoDone && this.frameTime(this.frameIndex) <= t) {
      const c = this.vq[0];
      if (!c) { if (this.eof) this.videoDone = true; break; }
      this.vq.shift();
      if (c.palette) { const p = c.palette, first = p[0], count = p[1] || 256, entries = []; for (let k = 0; k < count && 4 + 4 * k + 3 < p.length; k++) entries.push((p[4 + 4 * k] << 16) | (p[5 + 4 * k] << 8) | p[6 + 4 * k]); this.vdec.setPalette(first, entries); continue; }
      if (c.length) { try { this.vdec.decode(c); } catch { this.errors = (this.errors ?? 0) + 1; } }
      this.frameIndex++; st.decoded++;
      if (shown) st.overtaken++;
      shown = { rgba: new Uint8ClampedArray(this.vdec.frame.buffer), width: this.width, height: this.height };
      st.late = Math.max(st.late, t - this.frameTime(this.frameIndex - 1));
    }
    st.decodeMs += performance.now() - t0;
    if (shown) this.picture = shown;
    return shown;
  }
  get videoEnd() { return !this.vdec ? 0 : this.videoDone ? this.frameTime(this.frameIndex) : Infinity; }
  get audioEnd() { return !this.adec ? 0 : this.audioDone ? this.audioPos / this.audioRate : Infinity; }
  ended(t) { return this.videoDone && this.audioDone && t >= this.videoEnd && t >= this.audioEnd || !!this.failed; }
  audioUntil(t, out) {
    const a = this.adec; if (!a) return;
    if (!this.audioMpeg) {
      while (!this.audioDone && this.audioPos / this.audioRate < t) {
        const c = this.aq.shift();
        if (!c) { if (this.eof && this.parsedAll) this.audioDone = true; return; }
        const n = Math.floor(c.length / this.as.wfx.align); if (!n) continue;
        const smp = a.decode(c, n);
        out(smp, this.audioPos / this.audioRate); this.audioPos += smp[0].length;
      }
      return;
    }
    // MPEG audio: chunks joined into a stream and cut into frames
    for (;;) {
      if (this.audioAsync ? a.flushing || this.submitPos / this.audioRate >= t + 1 : this.audioDone || this.audioPos / this.audioRate >= t) break;
      const f = this.nextMpegFrame();
      if (!f) { if (this.eof && this.parsedAll) { if (this.audioAsync) a.flush(); else this.audioDone = true; } break; }
      const [b, at, h] = f;
      if (this.audioAsync) { a.submit(b.slice(at, at + h.bytes), this.submitPos / this.audioRate); this.submitPos += h.samples; continue; }
      const d = a.decodeFrame(b, at); if (!d) continue;
      out(d.samples, this.audioPos / this.audioRate); this.audioPos += d.samples[0].length;
    }
    if (this.audioAsync) { for (const d of a.take()) { this.audioPos += d.samples[0].length; out(d.samples, d.start); } if (a.failed || a.flushed && !a.ready.length) this.audioDone = true; }
  }
  nextMpegFrame() {
    for (;;) {
      let b = this.mpegBuf, i = 0;
      while (i + 4 <= b.length) {
        const h = mpegAudioHeader(b, i);
        if (h && h.bytes) { if (i + h.bytes > b.length) break; this.mpegBuf = b.subarray(i + h.bytes); return [b, i, h]; }
        i++;
      }
      this.mpegBuf = b.subarray(i);
      const c = this.aq.shift(); if (!c) return null;
      const nb = new Uint8Array(this.mpegBuf.length + c.length); nb.set(this.mpegBuf); nb.set(c, this.mpegBuf.length); this.mpegBuf = nb;
    }
  }
  close() { this.adec?.close?.(); this.file.close?.(); }
}
```

`src/media/bits.js`:

```js
// Bit reader and variable-length code tables for the MPEG decoders (src/media). Big-endian bit order, as the MPEG
// bitstreams are written. The reader works on a byte array padded with zeros (reads past the end see zero bits).

export class BitReader {
  /** @param {Uint8Array} bytes @param {number} [start] byte offset @param {number} [end] byte end (exclusive) */
  constructor(bytes, start = 0, end = bytes.length) {
    // (4 zero bytes of padding: peek() reads a 32-bit window without bounds checks)
    if (bytes.length < end + 4) { const p = new Uint8Array(end + 4); p.set(bytes.subarray(0, end)); bytes = p; }
    this.b = bytes; this.pos = start * 8; this.end = end * 8;
  }
  /** the next n bits (n <= 24) without consuming them */
  peek(n) {
    const p = this.pos, i = p >>> 3, b = this.b;
    const w = ((b[i] << 24) | (b[i + 1] << 16) | (b[i + 2] << 8) | b[i + 3]) >>> 0;
    return ((w << (p & 7)) >>> 0) >>> (32 - n);
  }
  /** read n bits (n <= 24) */
  read(n) { const v = this.peek(n); this.pos += n; return v; }
  /** read n bits (n <= 32) */
  read32(n) { if (n <= 24) return this.read(n); const hi = this.read(n - 16); return hi * 65536 + this.read(16); }
  skip(n) { this.pos += n; }
  get left() { return this.end - this.pos; }
  align() { this.pos = (this.pos + 7) & ~7; }
  /** at a start code prefix (0x000001, byte aligned)? */
  atStartCode() { return (this.pos & 7) === 0 && this.peek(24) === 1; }
  /**
   * Move to the next start code (byte aligned 00 00 01 xx) at or after the current position: returns its code byte
   * (the reader is placed after it) or -1 at the end.
   */
  nextStartCode() {
    this.align();
    const b = this.b, end = this.end >>> 3;
    for (let i = this.pos >>> 3; i + 3 < end; i++) {
      if (b[i + 2] > 1) { i += 2; continue; } // (no prefix can end at i + 2: skip ahead)
      if (b[i] === 0 && b[i + 1] === 0 && b[i + 2] === 1) { this.pos = (i + 4) * 8; return b[i + 3]; }
    }
    this.pos = this.end;
    return -1;
  }
}

/**
 * A prefix code as a lookup table indexed by the next `bits` bits. `codes`: [bit string, value] pairs.
 * lookup(br) consumes the code and returns its value (or `invalid` when the bits match no code: a corrupt stream).
 */
export class Vlc {
  constructor(codes, invalid = -0x7fff) {
    const bits = Math.max(...codes.map(([s]) => s.length));
    this.bits = bits; this.invalid = invalid;
    this.len = new Uint8Array(1 << bits);
    this.val = new Int32Array(1 << bits).fill(invalid);
    for (const [s, v] of codes) {
      const n = s.length, base = parseInt(s, 2) << (bits - n);
      for (let j = 0; j < 1 << (bits - n); j++) {
        if (this.len[base + j]) throw new Error(`Vlc: code ${s} overlaps another code`);
        this.len[base + j] = n; this.val[base + j] = v;
      }
    }
  }
  read(br) {
    const i = br.peek(this.bits), n = this.len[i];
    if (!n) { br.skip(1); return this.invalid; }
    br.skip(n);
    return this.val[i];
  }
}
```

`src/media/mpeg-audio.js`:

```js
// MPEG-1 / MPEG-2 (low sampling frequencies) audio decoder, layers I and II (ISO/IEC 11172-3, 13818-3), written from
// the standard: frame headers, bit allocation, scale factors (with their selection information), grouped and ungrouped
// samples, requantization, joint stereo (intensity) and the polyphase synthesis filterbank. Layer III is not decoded
// here (decode() reports it unsupported). Output: 32-bit float samples, one array per channel.
import { BitReader } from './bits.js';
import { mpegAudioHeader } from './mpeg-ps.js';
import { SYNTH_WINDOW_HALF } from './mpeg-audio-window.js';

// ---- layer II bit allocation tables (11172-3 annex B.2, 13818-3 annex B.1): per subband, the bits of the allocation
// index and the quantization of each index (number of steps; 0 = none)
const Q_A = [0, 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, 127, 255, 511, 1023, 2047, 4095, 8191, 16383, 32767, 65535];
const Q_B = [0, 3, 5, 7, 9, 15, 31, 63, 127, 255, 511, 1023, 2047, 4095, 8191, 65535];
const Q_C = [0, 3, 5, 7, 9, 15, 31, 65535];
const Q_D = [0, 3, 5, 65535];
const Q_E = [0, 3, 5, 9, 15, 31, 63, 127, 255, 511, 1023, 2047, 4095, 8191, 16383, 32767];
const Q_F = [0, 3, 5, 9, 15, 31, 63, 127];
// MPEG-2 low sampling frequencies (13818-3 table B.1)
const Q_L1 = [0, 3, 5, 7, 9, 15, 31, 63, 127, 255, 511, 1023, 2047, 4095, 8191, 16383];
const Q_L2 = [0, 3, 5, 9, 15, 31, 63, 127];
const Q_L3 = [0, 3, 5, 9];
const rep = (n, nbal, q) => Array.from({ length: n }, () => ({ nbal, q }));
export const ALLOC_TABLES = {
  a: [...rep(3, 4, Q_A), ...rep(8, 4, Q_B), ...rep(12, 3, Q_C), ...rep(4, 2, Q_D)], // 27 subbands
  b: [...rep(3, 4, Q_A), ...rep(8, 4, Q_B), ...rep(12, 3, Q_C), ...rep(7, 2, Q_D)], // 30
  c: [...rep(2, 4, Q_E), ...rep(6, 3, Q_F)], // 8
  d: [...rep(2, 4, Q_E), ...rep(10, 3, Q_F)], // 12
  lsf: [...rep(4, 4, Q_L1), ...rep(7, 3, Q_L2), ...rep(19, 2, Q_L3)], // 30
};
/** the layer II allocation table of a frame (by sampling frequency and bit rate per channel) */
export function allocTable(h) {
  if (h.version !== 1) return ALLOC_TABLES.lsf;
  const perChannel = h.bitrate / 1000 / (h.mode === 3 ? 1 : 2);
  if (perChannel <= 48) return h.rate === 32000 ? ALLOC_TABLES.d : ALLOC_TABLES.c;
  if (perChannel <= 80) return ALLOC_TABLES.a;
  return h.rate === 48000 ? ALLOC_TABLES.a : ALLOC_TABLES.b;
}
/** steps -> [bits per sample (or per group of 3), grouped] */
const QUANT = new Map([[3, [5, true]], [5, [7, true]], [9, [10, true]]]);
for (let b = 3; b <= 16; b++) QUANT.set((1 << b) - 1, [b, false]);
/** scale factors: 2 * 2^(-i/3) */
export const SCALE = Float64Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) => (i < 63 ? 2 * Math.pow(2, -i / 3) : 0));

// ---- polyphase synthesis: N[i][k] = cos((16 + i)(2k + 1) pi / 64); the 512-sample window D from its first half
const NMAT = new Float64Array(64 * 32);
for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) for (let k = 0; k < 32; k++) NMAT[i * 32 + k] = Math.cos((16 + i) * (2 * k + 1) * Math.PI / 64);
/** D[0..511] (11172-3 table B.3): D[512 - i] = -D[i], except D[512 - i] = D[i] for i a multiple of 64 */
export const SYNTH_WINDOW = (() => {
  const d = new Float64Array(512);
  for (let i = 0; i <= 256; i++) d[i] = SYNTH_WINDOW_HALF[i] / 65536;
  for (let i = 257; i < 512; i++) d[i] = (i % 64 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * d[512 - i];
  return d;
})();

/** Synthesis state of one channel: the V vector history (1024) as a ring. */
export class Synth {
  constructor() { this.v = new Float64Array(1024); this.off = 0; }
  /** 32 subband samples -> 32 PCM samples written to out[o..o+31] */
  run(s, out, o, D = SYNTH_WINDOW) {
    this.off = (this.off - 64) & 1023;
    const v = this.v, off = this.off;
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
      let acc = 0; const r = i * 32;
      for (let k = 0; k < 32; k++) acc += NMAT[r + k] * s[k];
      v[(off + i) & 1023] = acc;
    }
    // U[i*64 + j] = V[i*128 + j], U[i*64 + 32 + j] = V[i*128 + 96 + j]; out[j] = sum_i U[j + 32 i] * D[j + 32 i]
    for (let j = 0; j < 32; j++) {
      let acc = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        const vi = (i >> 1) * 128 + (i & 1 ? 96 : 0) + j;
        acc += v[(off + vi) & 1023] * D[j + 32 * i];
      }
      out[o + j] = acc;
    }
  }
  /** the 16 window inputs U[j + 32 i] of output sample j after the last run (tools/mpa-window-fit.mjs) */
  inputs(j, out) { for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) out[i] = this.v[(this.off + (i >> 1) * 128 + (i & 1 ? 96 : 0) + j) & 1023]; }
}

export class MpegAudioDecoder {
  constructor() {
    this.synth = [new Synth(), new Synth()];
    this.sb = [new Float64Array(32), new Float64Array(32)];
    this.pcm = new Float64Array(32);
    this.header = null; this.errors = 0; this.unsupported = null;
  }
  /**
   * Decode one frame (bytes from its header; at least header.bytes long): { channels, rate, samples: Float32Array[] }
   * or null (not a layer I / II frame, or corrupt).
   */
  decodeFrame(b, at = 0) {
    const h = mpegAudioHeader(b, at);
    if (!h || !h.bytes) return null;
    if (h.layer === 3) { this.unsupported = 'layer III'; return null; }
    this.header = h;
    const br = new BitReader(b, at, at + h.bytes);
    br.skip(32);
    if (h.crc) br.skip(16);
    const nch = h.channels, out = [new Float32Array(h.samples), nch > 1 ? new Float32Array(h.samples) : null].slice(0, nch);
    try { if (h.layer === 1) this.layer1(br, h, out); else this.layer2(br, h, out); } catch { this.errors++; return null; }
    return { channels: nch, rate: h.rate, samples: out };
  }

  layer1(br, h, out) {
    const nch = h.channels, bound = h.mode === 1 ? (h.modeExt + 1) * 4 : 32;
    const alloc = [new Uint8Array(32), new Uint8Array(32)], scf = [new Float64Array(32), new Float64Array(32)];
    for (let sb = 0; sb < 32; sb++) for (let ch = 0; ch < nch; ch++) {
      if (sb >= bound && ch === 1) { alloc[1][sb] = alloc[0][sb]; continue; }
      const a = br.read(4); if (a === 15) throw new Error('bad allocation'); alloc[ch][sb] = a;
    }
    for (let sb = 0; sb < 32; sb++) for (let ch = 0; ch < nch; ch++) if (alloc[ch][sb]) scf[ch][sb] = SCALE[br.read(6)];
    const codes = new Int32Array(32);
    for (let s = 0; s < 12; s++) {
      for (let sb = 0; sb < 32; sb++) for (let ch = 0; ch < nch; ch++) {
        const a = alloc[ch][sb];
        if (!a) { this.sb[ch][sb] = 0; continue; }
        const nb = a + 1, steps = (1 << nb) - 1;
        if (!(sb >= bound && ch === 1)) codes[sb] = br.read(nb);
        this.sb[ch][sb] = (2 * codes[sb] - (steps - 1)) / steps * scf[ch][sb];
      }
      for (let ch = 0; ch < nch; ch++) this.emit(ch, out[ch], s * 32);
    }
  }

  layer2(br, h, out) {
    const nch = h.channels, table = allocTable(h), sblimit = table.length;
    const bound = h.mode === 1 ? Math.min((h.modeExt + 1) * 4, sblimit) : sblimit;
    const alloc = [new Int32Array(32), new Int32Array(32)];
    for (let sb = 0; sb < sblimit; sb++) {
      const nbal = table[sb].nbal;
      if (sb < bound) for (let ch = 0; ch < nch; ch++) alloc[ch][sb] = table[sb].q[br.read(nbal)];
      else { const q = table[sb].q[br.read(nbal)]; alloc[0][sb] = q; alloc[1][sb] = q; }
    }
    const scfsi = [new Uint8Array(32), new Uint8Array(32)];
    for (let sb = 0; sb < sblimit; sb++) for (let ch = 0; ch < nch; ch++) if (alloc[ch][sb]) scfsi[ch][sb] = br.read(2);
    const scf = [new Float64Array(96), new Float64Array(96)]; // [part * 32 + sb]
    for (let sb = 0; sb < sblimit; sb++) for (let ch = 0; ch < nch; ch++) {
      if (!alloc[ch][sb]) continue;
      let a, b, c;
      switch (scfsi[ch][sb]) {
        case 0: a = br.read(6); b = br.read(6); c = br.read(6); break;
        case 1: a = b = br.read(6); c = br.read(6); break;
        case 2: a = b = c = br.read(6); break;
        default: a = br.read(6); b = c = br.read(6); break;
      }
      scf[ch][sb] = SCALE[a]; scf[ch][32 + sb] = SCALE[b]; scf[ch][64 + sb] = SCALE[c];
    }
    const samp = [new Float64Array(96), new Float64Array(96)]; // [3 samples][32 subbands] of the granule, per channel
    const codes = new Int32Array(3);
    for (let gr = 0; gr < 12; gr++) {
      const part = (gr >> 2) * 32;
      for (let sb = 0; sb < sblimit; sb++) {
        for (let ch = 0; ch < nch; ch++) {
          const steps = alloc[ch][sb];
          if (!steps) { samp[ch][sb] = samp[ch][32 + sb] = samp[ch][64 + sb] = 0; continue; }
          if (!(sb >= bound && ch === 1)) {
            const [bits, grouped] = QUANT.get(steps);
            if (grouped) { let c = br.read(bits); for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { codes[k] = c % steps; c = (c / steps) | 0; } }
            else for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) codes[k] = br.read(bits);
          }
          const f = scf[ch][part + sb];
          for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) samp[ch][k * 32 + sb] = (2 * codes[k] - (steps - 1)) / steps * f;
        }
      }
      for (let ch = 0; ch < nch; ch++) {
        for (let sb = sblimit; sb < 32; sb++) samp[ch][sb] = samp[ch][32 + sb] = samp[ch][64 + sb] = 0;
        for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { this.sb[ch].set(samp[ch].subarray(k * 32, k * 32 + 32)); this.emit(ch, out[ch], (gr * 3 + k) * 32); }
      }
    }
  }

  emit(ch, out, o) {
    this.synth[ch].run(this.sb[ch], this.pcm, 0);
    for (let j = 0; j < 32; j++) out[o + j] = this.pcm[j];
  }
}
```

`src/media/mpeg-ps.js`:

```js
// MPEG program / system stream demultiplexer (ISO/IEC 11172-1, and the MPEG-2 program stream pack header of
// 13818-1): packs, system headers and PES packets, incrementally (bytes are pushed as they arrive). Payloads of the
// first video stream (0xE0-0xEF) and the first audio stream (0xC0-0xDF) are handed to callbacks with their
// presentation time stamps (90 kHz units, or null).

/** What a media file holds, from its first bytes: 'mpeg-ps' | 'mpeg-video' | 'mpeg-audio' | null. */
export function probeMpeg(head) {
  const b = head;
  if (b.length >= 4 && b[0] === 0 && b[1] === 0 && b[2] === 1) {
    if (b[3] === 0xba) return 'mpeg-ps';
    if (b[3] === 0xb3) return 'mpeg-video';
  }
  // an MPEG audio elementary stream: an ID3v2 tag, or two consecutive frame headers
  if (b.length >= 3 && b[0] === 0x49 && b[1] === 0x44 && b[2] === 0x33) return 'mpeg-audio';
  if (b.length >= 4 && b[0] === 0xff && (b[1] & 0xe0) === 0xe0) {
    const n = mpegAudioFrameBytes(b, 0);
    if (n > 0 && (b.length < n + 2 || (b[n] === 0xff && (b[n + 1] & 0xe0) === 0xe0))) return 'mpeg-audio';
  }
  return null;
}

const BITRATES = { // kbit/s by [version 1 / 2][layer 1..3][index]
  1: [null, [0, 32, 64, 96, 128, 160, 192, 224, 256, 288, 320, 352, 384, 416, 448], [0, 32, 48, 56, 64, 80, 96, 112, 128, 160, 192, 224, 256, 320, 384], [0, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 80, 96, 112, 128, 160, 192, 224, 256, 320]],
  2: [null, [0, 32, 48, 56, 64, 80, 96, 112, 128, 144, 160, 176, 192, 224, 256], [0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 80, 96, 112, 128, 144, 160], [0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 80, 96, 112, 128, 144, 160]],
};
const RATES = { 3: [44100, 48000, 32000], 2: [22050, 24000, 16000], 0: [11025, 12000, 8000] };
/** The MPEG audio frame header at b[i]: its fields, or null. */
export function mpegAudioHeader(b, i) {
  if (b[i] !== 0xff || (b[i + 1] & 0xe0) !== 0xe0) return null;
  const ver = (b[i + 1] >> 3) & 3, layerBits = (b[i + 1] >> 1) & 3, prot = b[i + 1] & 1;
  const bri = b[i + 2] >> 4, sri = (b[i + 2] >> 2) & 3, pad = (b[i + 2] >> 1) & 1;
  if (ver === 1 || layerBits === 0 || bri === 15 || sri === 3) return null;
  const layer = 4 - layerBits, rate = RATES[ver][sri], bitrate = BITRATES[ver === 3 ? 1 : 2][layer][bri] * 1000;
  const mode = b[i + 3] >> 6, modeExt = (b[i + 3] >> 4) & 3;
  let bytes = 0;
  if (bitrate) bytes = layer === 1 ? ((12 * bitrate / rate | 0) + pad) * 4 : layer === 3 && ver !== 3 ? (72 * bitrate / rate | 0) + pad : (144 * bitrate / rate | 0) + pad;
  return { version: ver === 3 ? 1 : ver === 2 ? 2 : 2.5, layer, crc: !prot, bitrate, rate, pad, mode, modeExt, channels: mode === 3 ? 1 : 2, bytes, samples: layer === 1 ? 384 : layer === 3 && ver !== 3 ? 576 : 1152 };
}
/** bytes of the MPEG audio frame at b[i] (0: not a frame header, or free format) */
export function mpegAudioFrameBytes(b, i) { return mpegAudioHeader(b, i)?.bytes ?? 0; }

/** 33-bit time stamp of 5 bytes ('xxxx' marker bits ignored) */
function timeStamp(b, i) { return ((b[i] >> 1) & 7) * 1073741824 + (b[i + 1] << 22 | (b[i + 2] >> 1) << 15 | b[i + 3] << 7 | b[i + 4] >> 1); }

export class MpegPsDemuxer {
  /** @param {{ video?: (bytes: Uint8Array, pts: number|null) => void, audio?: (bytes: Uint8Array, pts: number|null) => void }} sinks */
  constructor(sinks) {
    this.sinks = sinks;
    this.buf = new Uint8Array(1 << 16); this.len = 0; this.pos = 0;
    this.videoId = -1; this.audioId = -1; this.ended = false;
    this.firstScr = null; this.lastPts = null; this.mpeg2 = false;
  }
  push(bytes) {
    if (this.pos > 0) { this.buf.copyWithin(0, this.pos, this.len); this.len -= this.pos; this.pos = 0; }
    if (this.len + bytes.length > this.buf.length) { let n = this.buf.length; while (n < this.len + bytes.length) n *= 2; const nb = new Uint8Array(n); nb.set(this.buf.subarray(0, this.len)); this.buf = nb; }
    this.buf.set(bytes, this.len); this.len += bytes.length;
    this.parse();
  }
  parse() {
    const b = this.buf;
    while (!this.ended) {
      let i = this.pos;
      // resynchronize on the next start code (garbage between packets is skipped)
      while (i + 3 < this.len && !(b[i] === 0 && b[i + 1] === 0 && b[i + 2] === 1)) i++;
      this.pos = i;
      if (i + 4 > this.len) return;
      const id = b[i + 3];
      if (id === 0xb9) { this.pos = i + 4; this.ended = true; return; } // end of the program stream
      if (id === 0xba) { // pack header
        if (i + 12 > this.len) return;
        if ((b[i + 4] & 0xc0) === 0x40) { // MPEG-2: 10 bytes + stuffing
          if (i + 14 > this.len) return;
          this.mpeg2 = true;
          const n = 14 + (b[i + 13] & 7);
          if (i + n > this.len) return;
          this.pos = i + n;
        } else {
          if (this.firstScr === null) this.firstScr = timeStamp(b, i + 4);
          this.pos = i + 12;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (id < 0xb9) { this.pos = i + 3; continue; } // (a stray start code)
      // system header, PES packets, padding: a 16-bit length
      if (i + 6 > this.len) return;
      const n = (b[i + 4] << 8) | b[i + 5];
      if (i + 6 + n > this.len) return;
      this.packet(id, i + 6, i + 6 + n);
      this.pos = i + 6 + n;
    }
  }
  packet(id, start, end) {
    const isVideo = id >= 0xe0 && id <= 0xef, isAudio = id >= 0xc0 && id <= 0xdf;
    if (!isVideo && !isAudio) return;
    if (isVideo) { if (this.videoId < 0) this.videoId = id; else if (id !== this.videoId) return; }
    if (isAudio) { if (this.audioId < 0) this.audioId = id; else if (id !== this.audioId) return; }
    const b = this.buf;
    let i = start, pts = null;
    if ((b[i] & 0xc0) === 0x80) { // MPEG-2 PES header
      const flags = b[i + 1], hlen = b[i + 2];
      if (flags & 0x80) pts = timeStamp(b, i + 3);
      i += 3 + hlen;
    } else {
      while (i < end && b[i] === 0xff) i++; // stuffing
      if ((b[i] & 0xc0) === 0x40) i += 2; // STD buffer
      if ((b[i] & 0xf0) === 0x20) { pts = timeStamp(b, i); i += 5; }
      else if ((b[i] & 0xf0) === 0x30) { pts = timeStamp(b, i); i += 10; }
      else if (b[i] === 0x0f) i++;
    }
    if (i >= end) return;
    if (pts !== null) this.lastPts = Math.max(this.lastPts ?? 0, pts);
    const payload = b.slice(i, end);
    (isVideo ? this.sinks.video : this.sinks.audio)?.(payload, pts);
  }
}

/** The largest presentation time stamp (90 kHz) in a chunk of a program stream (its last bytes: the duration), or null. */
export function lastPtsIn(bytes) {
  let best = null;
  const d = new MpegPsDemuxer({ video: (_, p) => { if (p !== null) best = Math.max(best ?? 0, p); }, audio: (_, p) => { if (p !== null) best = Math.max(best ?? 0, p); } });
  // (the chunk starts anywhere: begin at its first pack header)
  let i = 0; while (i + 4 < bytes.length && !(bytes[i] === 0 && bytes[i + 1] === 0 && bytes[i + 2] === 1 && bytes[i + 3] === 0xba)) i++;
  d.push(bytes.subarray(i));
  return best;
}
/** The first presentation time stamp (90 kHz) of a program stream's first bytes, or null. */
export function firstPtsIn(bytes) {
  let best = null;
  const d = new MpegPsDemuxer({ video: (_, p) => { if (p !== null && best === null) best = p; }, audio: (_, p) => { if (p !== null && best === null) best = p; } });
  d.push(bytes);
  return best;
}
```

`src/media/mpeg-source.js`:

```js
// An MPEG media file being played: MPEG-1 system / program streams, MPEG-1 video elementary streams and MPEG audio
// elementary streams (layers I and II), read progressively from a file of the virtual file system, demultiplexed and
// decoded on demand as the playback clock advances. The playback code (src/win32/quartz.js) asks for the picture to
// show at a stream time and for the audio up to a stream time.
import { probeMpeg, MpegPsDemuxer, mpegAudioHeader, lastPtsIn } from './mpeg-ps.js';
import { Mpeg1VideoDecoder } from './mpeg1-video.js';
import { MpegAudioDecoder } from './mpeg-audio.js';

const CHUNK = 256 * 1024;
export const HEAD = 256 * 1024;
const TAIL = 128 * 1024;

/** An error opening a media file: `code` is 'not-found' | 'unsupported' | 'corrupt'. */
export class MediaError extends Error { constructor(code, msg) { super(msg); this.code = code; } }

/** Accumulates MPEG audio elementary-stream bytes and cuts whole frames. */
class AudioFrames {
  constructor() { this.buf = new Uint8Array(1 << 15); this.len = 0; this.pos = 0; }
  push(bytes) {
    if (this.pos > 0) { this.buf.copyWithin(0, this.pos, this.len); this.len -= this.pos; this.pos = 0; }
    if (this.len + bytes.length > this.buf.length) { let n = this.buf.length; while (n < this.len + bytes.length) n *= 2; const b = new Uint8Array(n); b.set(this.buf.subarray(0, this.len)); this.buf = b; }
    this.buf.set(bytes, this.len); this.len += bytes.length;
  }
  /** the next whole frame as [buffer, offset, header] (null: more bytes needed); garbage between frames is skipped */
  next() {
    const b = this.buf;
    while (this.pos + 4 <= this.len) {
      if (b[this.pos] === 0x49 && b[this.pos + 1] === 0x44 && b[this.pos + 2] === 0x33 && this.pos + 10 <= this.len) { // ID3v2 tag
        const n = 10 + ((b[this.pos + 6] & 0x7f) << 21 | (b[this.pos + 7] & 0x7f) << 14 | (b[this.pos + 8] & 0x7f) << 7 | (b[this.pos + 9] & 0x7f));
        if (this.pos + n > this.len) return null;
        this.pos += n; continue;
      }
      const h = mpegAudioHeader(b, this.pos);
      if (!h || !h.bytes) { this.pos++; continue; }
      if (this.pos + h.bytes > this.len) return null;
      const at = this.pos; this.pos += h.bytes;
      return [b, at, h];
    }
    return null;
  }
}

export class MpegSource {
  /**
   * @param {{ size: () => number, read: (off: number, len: number) => Uint8Array, prepare?: (off: number, len: number) => Promise<any>|null, close?: () => void }} file
   * @param {{ log?: (msg: string) => void }} [opts]
   */
  constructor(file, opts = {}, head = file.read(0, Math.min(file.size(), HEAD))) {
    this.file = file; this.log = opts.log ?? (() => {});
    this.size = file.size();
    this.kind = probeMpeg(head);
    if (!this.kind) throw new MediaError('unsupported', 'not an MPEG stream');
    this.head = head;
    this.video = null; this.audio = null; this.width = 0; this.height = 0; this.fps = 0; this.aspect = 1;
    this.audioRate = 0; this.audioChannels = 0; this.videoStart = 0; this.audioStart = 0; this.duration = 0;
    this.probe(head);
    this.reset();
  }

  /** stream properties from the first bytes (and the last ones: the duration of a program stream) */
  probe(head) {
    let vPts = null, aPts = null;
    const vdec = new Mpeg1VideoDecoder(), afr = new AudioFrames();
    const take = (k) => k === 'video' ? (b, pts) => { vdec.push(b); if (vPts === null && pts !== null) vPts = pts; } : (b, pts) => { afr.push(b); if (aPts === null && pts !== null) aPts = pts; };
    if (this.kind === 'mpeg-ps') { const d = new MpegPsDemuxer({ video: take('video'), audio: take('audio') }); d.push(head); }
    else if (this.kind === 'mpeg-video') vdec.push(head);
    else afr.push(head);
    vdec.readSequenceHeader();
    // (MPEG-2 video — DVD-style program streams: no decoder here, as on a Windows without an MPEG-2 decoder: the other
    // streams are rendered alone)
    if (vdec.mpeg2) { this.videoUnsupported = 'MPEG-2 video'; this.log('MPEG-2 video: no decoder here, the stream plays without pictures'); }
    else if (vdec.seq) { this.video = true; this.width = vdec.seq.width; this.height = vdec.seq.height; this.fps = vdec.seq.rate; this.bitRate = vdec.seq.bitRate; }
    const af = afr.next();
    if (af) {
      const h = af[2];
      // (layer III: decoded by the browser — WebCodecs — when it can, asynchronously)
      this.audioAsync = h.layer === 3 && AsyncAudio.available();
      this.audio = h.layer !== 3 || this.audioAsync; this.audioLayer = h.layer; this.audioRate = h.rate; this.audioChannels = h.channels; this.audioBitRate = h.bitrate;
      if (h.layer === 3 && !this.audio) this.log('MPEG audio layer III: no decoder here (WebCodecs), the stream plays without sound');
    }
    if (!this.video && !this.audio) throw new MediaError('unsupported', this.videoUnsupported ?? (af ? 'MPEG audio layer III' : 'no MPEG-1 video or MPEG audio stream'));
    // times: the first time stamps of the streams, relative to the earliest
    if (this.kind === 'mpeg-ps') {
      const base = Math.min(vPts ?? Infinity, aPts ?? Infinity);
      if (base !== Infinity) { this.videoStart = vPts !== null ? (vPts - base) / 90000 : 0; this.audioStart = aPts !== null ? (aPts - base) / 90000 : 0; }
      const tail = this.size > HEAD ? this.file.read(Math.max(0, this.size - TAIL), Math.min(TAIL, this.size)) : head;
      const last = lastPtsIn(tail);
      if (last !== null && base !== Infinity && last > base) this.duration = (last - base) / 90000 + (this.video ? 1 / this.fps : 0);
    }
    // a variable bit rate audio stream's frame count, in its first frame (the Xing / Info or VBRI header)
    if (!this.duration && this.kind === 'mpeg-audio' && af) { const n = vbrFrames(af[0], af[1], af[2]); if (n) this.duration = n * af[2].samples / af[2].rate; }
    if (!this.duration) {
      const rate = this.kind === 'mpeg-audio' ? this.audioBitRate : this.bitRate + (this.audioBitRate || 0);
      // (a video elementary stream's bit rate field is often the 'variable' marker: no estimate from it)
      if (rate && (this.kind !== 'mpeg-video' || this.bitRate !== 0x3ffff * 400)) this.duration = this.size * 8 / rate;
    }
  }

  /** back to the start of the stream (decoders and demultiplexer reset) */
  reset() {
    this.vdec = this.video ? new Mpeg1VideoDecoder() : null;
    this.adec?.close?.();
    this.adec = !this.audio ? null : this.audioAsync ? new AsyncAudio('mp3', this.audioRate, this.audioChannels, this.log) : new MpegAudioDecoder();
    this.submitPos = 0; // (asynchronous decoding: samples handed to the decoder)
    this.afr = new AudioFrames();
    this.demux = this.kind === 'mpeg-ps' ? new MpegPsDemuxer({ video: (b) => this.vdec?.push(b), audio: (b) => this.afr.push(b) }) : null;
    this.loadPos = 0; this.loading = null; this.loadError = null;
    this.frameIndex = 0; // next picture in display order
    // decoded / skipped (B pictures dropped undecoded) / overtaken (decoded, a later one shown at once) pictures, the
    // largest lateness of a picture (s), decoding time (ms)
    this.stats = { decoded: 0, skipped: 0, overtaken: 0, late: 0, decodeMs: 0 };
    this.picture = null; // the last picture shown: { y, cb, cr, ... } (valid until the next decode)
    this.videoDone = !this.video;
    this.audioPos = 0; // samples decoded (per channel)
    this.audioDone = !this.audio;
    this.feed(this.head);
    this.loadPos = this.head.length;
    if (this.loadPos >= this.size) this.endOfData();
  }
  feed(bytes) {
    if (this.demux) this.demux.push(bytes);
    else if (this.kind === 'mpeg-video') this.vdec.push(bytes);
    else this.afr.push(bytes);
  }
  endOfData() { this.vdec?.end(); this.eof = true; }
  get bytesPerSecond() { return this.duration ? this.size / this.duration : 1 << 20; }

  /**
   * Read ahead so that data up to stream time `t` + 2 s is demultiplexed. Without a network wait pending, reads at most
   * `maxChunks` chunks synchronously (data already local); a range still on the network is fetched asynchronously
   * (file.prepare) and taken at a later call. Returns true while data is missing for time `t` itself.
   */
  load(t, maxChunks = 4) {
    const want = Math.min(this.size, Math.ceil((t + 2) * this.bytesPerSecond) + CHUNK);
    let n = 0;
    while (!this.eof && this.loadPos < want && n < maxChunks && !this.loading) {
      const len = Math.min(CHUNK, this.size - this.loadPos);
      const p = this.file.prepare?.(this.loadPos, len);
      if (p) { this.loading = p; p.then(() => { this.loading = null; }, (e) => { this.loading = null; this.loadError = e; }); break; }
      const bytes = this.file.read(this.loadPos, len);
      if (!bytes.length) { this.endOfData(); break; }
      this.feed(bytes); this.loadPos += bytes.length; n++;
      if (this.loadPos >= this.size) this.endOfData();
    }
    return !this.eof && this.loadPos < Math.min(this.size, Math.ceil(t * this.bytesPerSecond));
  }

  /** time of picture i (display order) */
  frameTime(i) { return this.videoStart + i / this.fps; }
  /**
   * The picture to show at stream time t: decodes forward to the last picture due at t. Returns the new picture, or
   * null when the one shown before is still current (or no picture is available yet). Pictures skipped over (the
   * caller late) are B pictures dropped undecoded when possible.
   */
  pictureAt(t) {
    if (!this.vdec) return null;
    let shown = null;
    const st = this.stats, t0 = performance.now();
    while (!this.videoDone && this.frameTime(this.frameIndex) <= t) {
      // (another picture already due after this one: a B picture can be skipped)
      this.vdec.skipB = this.frameTime(this.frameIndex + 1) <= t;
      const p = this.vdec.decode();
      if (!p) { if (this.vdec.done) this.videoDone = true; break; }
      this.frameIndex++;
      if (p.skipped) st.skipped++; else { st.decoded++; if (shown) st.overtaken++; shown = p; }
      st.late = Math.max(st.late, t - this.frameTime(this.frameIndex - 1));
    }
    st.decodeMs += performance.now() - t0;
    this.vdec.skipB = false;
    if (shown) this.picture = shown;
    return shown;
  }
  /** stream time at which the video ends (its last picture's display ends), once known */
  get videoEnd() { return !this.vdec ? 0 : this.videoDone ? this.frameTime(this.frameIndex) : Infinity; }
  get audioEnd() { return !this.adec ? 0 : this.audioDone ? this.audioStart + this.audioPos / this.audioRate : Infinity; }
  /** all streams over at stream time t */
  ended(t) { return this.videoDone && this.audioDone && t >= this.videoEnd && t >= this.audioEnd || !!this.failed; }

  /**
   * Decode audio up to stream time t: calls out(samplesPerChannel[], startTime) for each decoded frame. Stops when
   * data is missing.
   */
  audioUntil(t, out) {
    if (!this.adec) return;
    if (this.audioAsync) return this.audioUntilAsync(t, out);
    while (!this.audioDone && this.audioStart + this.audioPos / this.audioRate < t) {
      const f = this.afr.next();
      if (!f) { if (this.eof) this.audioDone = true; return; }
      const [b, at] = f;
      const d = this.adec.decodeFrame(b, at);
      if (!d) continue;
      const start = this.audioStart + this.audioPos / this.audioRate;
      this.audioPos += d.samples[0].length;
      out(d.samples, start);
    }
  }
  /** the same through an asynchronous decoder: frames handed to it 1 s ahead of t, its output delivered as it comes */
  audioUntilAsync(t, out) {
    const a = this.adec;
    while (!a.flushing && this.audioStart + this.submitPos / this.audioRate < t + 1) {
      const f = this.afr.next();
      if (!f) { if (this.eof) a.flush(); break; }
      const [b, at, h] = f;
      a.submit(b.slice(at, at + h.bytes), this.audioStart + this.submitPos / this.audioRate);
      this.submitPos += h.samples;
    }
    for (const d of a.take()) { this.audioPos += d.samples[0].length; out(d.samples, d.start); }
    if (a.failed || a.flushed && !a.ready.length) this.audioDone = true;
  }
  close() { this.adec?.close?.(); this.file.close?.(); }
}

/** frames of a variable bit rate MPEG audio stream from the header in its first frame (Xing / Info, VBRI), or 0 */
export function vbrFrames(b, at, h) {
  const be = (i) => ((b[i] << 24) | (b[i + 1] << 16) | (b[i + 2] << 8) | b[i + 3]) >>> 0;
  const tag = (i, s) => i + 4 <= at + h.bytes && String.fromCharCode(b[i], b[i + 1], b[i + 2], b[i + 3]) === s;
  // (after the side information: 32 / 17 bytes for MPEG-1 stereo / mono, 17 / 9 for MPEG-2)
  const x = at + 4 + (h.crc ? 2 : 0) + (h.version === 1 ? (h.channels === 1 ? 17 : 32) : (h.channels === 1 ? 9 : 17));
  if (h.layer === 3 && (tag(x, 'Xing') || tag(x, 'Info')) && be(x + 4) & 1) return be(x + 8);
  if (tag(at + 36, 'VBRI')) return be(at + 36 + 14);
  return 0;
}

/** failures of the browser's audio decoder in this worker (telemetry: a movie or stream without sound) */
export const audioDecodeStats = { failures: 0 };

/**
 * A browser audio decoder (WebCodecs AudioDecoder) behind the synchronous interface: frames submitted with their start
 * time, decoded samples taken later (float, one array per channel, as many channels as the stream declares).
 */
export class AsyncAudio {
  static available() { return typeof globalThis.AudioDecoder === 'function' && typeof globalThis.EncodedAudioChunk === 'function'; }
  constructor(codec, rate, channels, log = () => {}) {
    this.channels = channels; this.ready = []; this.failed = false; this.flushing = false; this.flushed = false;
    this.dec = new globalThis.AudioDecoder({
      output: (d) => {
        try {
          const n = d.numberOfFrames, nch = d.numberOfChannels, samples = [];
          for (let c = 0; c < channels; c++) { const a = new Float32Array(n); d.copyTo(a, { planeIndex: Math.min(c, nch - 1), format: 'f32-planar' }); samples.push(a); }
          this.ready.push({ samples, start: d.timestamp / 1e6 });
        } finally { d.close(); }
      },
      error: (e) => { if (!this.failed) { audioDecodeStats.failures++; log(`audio decoder (${codec}) failed: ${e.message ?? e}`); } this.failed = true; },
    });
    try { this.dec.configure({ codec, sampleRate: rate, numberOfChannels: channels }); } catch (e) { this.failed = true; audioDecodeStats.failures++; log(`audio decoder (${codec}) unavailable: ${e.message}`); }
  }
  submit(bytes, start) {
    if (this.failed) return;
    try { this.dec.decode(new globalThis.EncodedAudioChunk({ type: 'key', timestamp: Math.round(start * 1e6), data: bytes })); } catch (e) { if (!this.failed) audioDecodeStats.failures++; this.failed = true; }
  }
  flush() {
    if (this.flushing) return;
    this.flushing = true;
    if (this.failed) { this.flushed = true; return; }
    this.dec.flush().then(() => { this.flushed = true; }, () => { this.flushed = true; });
  }
  take() { return this.ready.length ? this.ready.splice(0) : this.ready; }
  close() { try { if (this.dec.state !== 'closed') this.dec.close(); } catch { /* closed */ } }
}
```
