```js
/** dct_coeff_next: [code without the sign bit, run, level]; '10' is end of block, '000001' the escape */
export const DCT_CODES = [['11', 0, 1], ['011', 1, 1], ['0100', 0, 2], ['0101', 2, 1], ['00101', 0, 3], ['00111', 3, 1], ['00110', 4, 1], ['000110', 1, 2],
  ['000111', 5, 1], ['000101', 6, 1], ['000100', 7, 1], ['0000110', 0, 4], ['0000100', 2, 2], ['0000111', 8, 1], ['0000101', 9, 1], ['00100110', 0, 5],
  ['00100001', 0, 6], ['00100101', 1, 3], ['00100100', 3, 2], ['00100111', 10, 1], ['00100011', 11, 1], ['00100010', 12, 1], ['00100000', 13, 1],
  ['0000001010', 0, 7], ['0000001100', 1, 4], ['0000001011', 2, 3], ['0000001111', 4, 2], ['0000001001', 5, 2], ['0000001110', 14, 1], ['0000001101', 15, 1],
  ['0000001000', 16, 1], ['000000011101', 0, 8], ['000000011000', 0, 9], ['000000010011', 0, 10], ['000000010000', 0, 11], ['000000011011', 1, 5],
  ['000000010100', 2, 4], ['000000011100', 3, 3], ['000000010010', 4, 3], ['000000011110', 6, 2], ['000000010101', 7, 2], ['000000010001', 8, 2],
  ['000000011111', 17, 1], ['000000011010', 18, 1], ['000000011001', 19, 1], ['000000010111', 20, 1], ['000000010110', 21, 1], ['0000000011010', 0, 12],
  ['0000000011001', 0, 13], ['0000000011000', 0, 14], ['0000000010111', 0, 15], ['0000000010110', 1, 6], ['0000000010101', 1, 7], ['0000000010100', 2, 5],
  ['0000000010011', 3, 4], ['0000000010010', 5, 3], ['0000000010001', 9, 2], ['0000000010000', 10, 2], ['0000000011111', 22, 1], ['0000000011110', 23, 1],
  ['0000000011101', 24, 1], ['0000000011100', 25, 1], ['0000000011011', 26, 1], ['00000000011111', 0, 16], ['00000000011110', 0, 17], ['00000000011101', 0, 18],
  ['00000000011100', 0, 19], ['00000000011011', 0, 20], ['00000000011010', 0, 21], ['00000000011001', 0, 22], ['00000000011000', 0, 23],
  ['00000000010111', 0, 24], ['00000000010110', 0, 25], ['00000000010101', 0, 26], ['00000000010100', 0, 27], ['00000000010011', 0, 28],
  ['00000000010010', 0, 29], ['00000000010001', 0, 30], ['00000000010000', 0, 31], ['000000000011000', 0, 32], ['000000000010111', 0, 33],
  ['000000000010110', 0, 34], ['000000000010101', 0, 35], ['000000000010100', 0, 36], ['000000000010011', 0, 37], ['000000000010010', 0, 38],
  ['000000000010001', 0, 39], ['000000000010000', 0, 40], ['000000000011111', 1, 8], ['000000000011110', 1, 9], ['000000000011101', 1, 10],
  ['000000000011100', 1, 11], ['000000000011011', 1, 12], ['000000000011010', 1, 13], ['000000000011001', 1, 14], ['0000000000010011', 1, 15],
  ['0000000000010010', 1, 16], ['0000000000010001', 1, 17], ['0000000000010000', 1, 18], ['0000000000010100', 6, 3], ['0000000000011010', 11, 2],
  ['0000000000011001', 12, 2], ['0000000000011000', 13, 2], ['0000000000010111', 14, 2], ['0000000000010110', 15, 2], ['0000000000010101', 16, 2],
  ['0000000000011111', 27, 1], ['0000000000011110', 28, 1], ['0000000000011101', 29, 1], ['0000000000011100', 30, 1], ['0000000000011011', 31, 1]];
const DCT_EOB = 0x10000, DCT_ESC = 0x20000;

let tables = null;
function vlcTables() {
  if (tables) return tables;
  const dct = new Vlc([['10', DCT_EOB], ['000001', DCT_ESC], ...DCT_CODES.map(([s, run, level]) => [s, (run << 8) | level])]);
  tables = {
    addr: new Vlc(MB_ADDR_CODES), cbp: new Vlc(CBP_CODES), motion: new Vlc(MOTION_CODES), dcLuma: new Vlc(DC_LUMA_CODES), dcChroma: new Vlc(DC_CHROMA_CODES), dct,
    type: { [PIC_I]: new Vlc(MB_TYPE_CODES[PIC_I]), [PIC_P]: new Vlc(MB_TYPE_CODES[PIC_P]), [PIC_B]: new Vlc(MB_TYPE_CODES[PIC_B]), [PIC_D]: new Vlc(MB_TYPE_CODES[PIC_D]) },
  };
  return tables;
}

// ---- inverse DCT: separable, in double precision; C[k][n] = c(k)/2 * cos((2n+1)k pi/16)
const IDCT = new Float64Array(64);
for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) for (let n = 0; n < 8; n++) IDCT[k * 8 + n] = (k === 0 ? Math.SQRT1_2 : 1) / 2 * Math.cos((2 * n + 1) * k * Math.PI / 16);
const tmp = new Float64Array(64);
/** The definition, term by term (tests: the reference of idct8x8). */
export function idct8x8Reference(blk) {
  const out = new Float64Array(64);
  for (let y = 0; y < 8; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 8; x++) {
    let s = 0;
    for (let v = 0; v < 8; v++) for (let u = 0; u < 8; u++) s += blk[v * 8 + u] * IDCT[u * 8 + x] * IDCT[v * 8 + y];
    out[y * 8 + x] = s;
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) blk[i] = Math.round(out[i]);
}
// 1-D 8-point inverse DCT by even / odd halves: x[n] = e[n] + o[n], x[7-n] = e[n] - o[n]; constants with the 1/2 scale
const C1 = Math.cos(Math.PI / 16) / 2, C2 = Math.cos(2 * Math.PI / 16) / 2, C3 = Math.cos(3 * Math.PI / 16) / 2, C4 = Math.cos(4 * Math.PI / 16) / 2;
const C5 = Math.cos(5 * Math.PI / 16) / 2, C6 = Math.cos(6 * Math.PI / 16) / 2, C7 = Math.cos(7 * Math.PI / 16) / 2;
function idct1d(s, o, st, d, od, dt) {
  const x0 = s[o], x1 = s[o + st], x2 = s[o + 2 * st], x3 = s[o + 3 * st], x4 = s[o + 4 * st], x5 = s[o + 5 * st], x6 = s[o + 6 * st], x7 = s[o + 7 * st];
  const a0 = (x0 + x4) * C4, a1 = (x0 - x4) * C4, b0 = x2 * C2 + x6 * C6, b1 = x2 * C6 - x6 * C2;
  const e0 = a0 + b0, e3 = a0 - b0, e1 = a1 + b1, e2 = a1 - b1;
  const o0 = x1 * C1 + x3 * C3 + x5 * C5 + x7 * C7;
  const o1 = x1 * C3 - x3 * C7 - x5 * C1 - x7 * C5;
  const o2 = x1 * C5 - x3 * C1 + x5 * C7 + x7 * C3;
  const o3 = x1 * C7 - x3 * C5 + x5 * C3 - x7 * C1;
  d[od] = e0 + o0; d[od + 7 * dt] = e0 - o0; d[od + dt] = e1 + o1; d[od + 6 * dt] = e1 - o1;
  d[od + 2 * dt] = e2 + o2; d[od + 5 * dt] = e2 - o2; d[od + 3 * dt] = e3 + o3; d[od + 4 * dt] = e3 - o3;
}
/**
 * In place: coefficients (natural order) -> spatial values rounded to the nearest integer (double precision: within
 * the IEEE 1180 accuracy bounds). Rows of zeros skip their pass; a block with only its DC term is a constant.
 */
export function idct8x8(blk) {
  let rows = 0;
  for (let v = 0; v < 8; v++) {
    const o = v * 8;
    if (blk[o] | blk[o + 1] | blk[o + 2] | blk[o + 3] | blk[o + 4] | blk[o + 5] | blk[o + 6] | blk[o + 7]) rows |= 1 << v;
  }
  if (rows === 0) return;
  if (rows === 1 && !(blk[1] | blk[2] | blk[3] | blk[4] | blk[5] | blk[6] | blk[7])) { blk.fill(Math.round(blk[0] / 8)); return; }
  for (let v = 0; v < 8; v++) { // along x, per row of vertical frequency v
    if (rows & (1 << v)) idct1d(blk, v * 8, 1, tmp, v * 8, 1);
    else for (let x = 0; x < 8; x++) tmp[v * 8 + x] = 0;
  }
  for (let x = 0; x < 8; x++) idct1d(tmp, x, 8, tmp, x, 8); // along y (in place per column: inputs read first)
  for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) blk[i] = Math.round(tmp[i]);
}

class Frame {
  constructor(mbw, mbh) {
    this.stride = mbw * 16; this.cstride = mbw * 8;
    this.y = new Uint8Array(this.stride * mbh * 16);
    this.cb = new Uint8Array(this.cstride * mbh * 8); this.cr = new Uint8Array(this.cstride * mbh * 8);
    this.type = 0; this.temporalRef = 0;
  }
}

export class Mpeg1VideoDecoder {
  constructor() {
    this.buf = new Uint8Array(1 << 16); this.len = 0; this.pos = 0; this.eos = false; this.done = false;
    this.seq = null; // { width, height, rate, aspect, bitRate }
    this.intraMatrix = DEFAULT_INTRA_MATRIX.slice(); this.nonIntraMatrix = new Uint8Array(64).fill(16);
    this.ref0 = null; this.ref1 = null; this.bframe = null; this.spare = null;
    this.pending = null; // the newest reference picture, shown when the next one is decoded (display order)
    this.pictures = 0; this.errors = 0;
    this.blk = new Int32Array(64);
    this.skipB = false; // a caller behind schedule: B pictures (no other picture depends on them) are dropped undecoded
  }
  /** append elementary-stream bytes */
  push(bytes) {
    if (this.pos > 0 && this.pos >= this.len >> 1) { this.buf.copyWithin(0, this.pos, this.len); this.len -= this.pos; this.pos = 0; }
    if (this.len + bytes.length + 4 > this.buf.length) { let n = this.buf.length; while (n < this.len + bytes.length + 4) n *= 2; const b = new Uint8Array(n); b.set(this.buf.subarray(0, this.len)); this.buf = b; }
    this.buf.set(bytes, this.len); this.len += bytes.length;
    this.buf.fill(0, this.len, this.len + 4); // (zero padding: the bit reader reads a word past the end)
  }
  /** no more bytes: the last picture can be decoded and the last reference shown */
  end() { this.eos = true; }
  /** index of the next start code at or after byte i (or -1) */
  findStart(i) {
    const b = this.buf, end = this.len;
    for (; i + 3 < end; i++) {
      if (b[i + 2] > 1) { i += 2; continue; }
      if (b[i] === 0 && b[i + 1] === 0 && b[i + 2] === 1) return i;
    }
    return -1;
  }
  /** Decode until a picture is ready for display: the picture, or null (more data needed, or the end: `done`). */
  decode() {
    for (;;) {
      const s = this.findStart(this.pos);
      if (s < 0) {
        if (this.eos) return this.flush();
        if (this.len > 3) this.pos = this.len - 3; // (a start code may straddle the boundary)
        return null;
      }
      const code = this.buf[s + 3];
      if (code === 0xb3) { // sequence header: up to 12 + 128 bytes
        if (this.len - s < 140 && !this.eos) { this.pos = s; return null; }
        this.sequenceHeader(s + 4); this.pos = s + 4; continue;
      }
      if (code === 0x00) { // picture: all of it (up to the next picture, GOP, sequence header or end)
        let e = s + 4;
        for (;;) {
          e = this.findStart(e);
          if (e < 0) break;
          const c = this.buf[e + 3];
          if (c === 0x00 || c === 0xb3 || c === 0xb7 || c === 0xb8) break;
          e += 4;
        }
        if (e < 0) { if (!this.eos) { this.pos = s; return null; } e = this.len; }
        this.pos = e;
        if (!this.seq) continue; // (no sequence header yet: nothing to decode with)
        const out = this.picture(s + 4, e);
        if (out) return out;
        continue;
      }
      if (code === 0xb7) { this.pos = s + 4; const out = this.flushRef(); if (out) return out; continue; } // sequence end
      this.pos = s + 4; // GOP, user data, extensions, slices outside of a picture: skipped
    }
  }
  /** Parse the first sequence header in the bytes pushed so far (no picture decoded): true when found. */
  readSequenceHeader() {
    for (let s = this.findStart(0); s >= 0; s = this.findStart(s + 4)) {
      if (this.buf[s + 3] !== 0xb3) continue;
      this.sequenceHeader(s + 4);
      // MPEG-2 video: a sequence extension (extension start code, identifier 1) follows the header (13818-2 6.2.2)
      const e = this.findStart(s + 4);
      if (e >= 0 && this.buf[e + 3] === 0xb5 && this.buf[e + 4] >> 4 === 1) this.mpeg2 = true;
      return !!this.seq;
    }
    return false;
  }
  flush() { const out = this.flushRef(); if (!out) this.done = true; return out; }
  flushRef() { const p = this.pending; this.pending = null; return p ? this.output(p) : null; }

  sequenceHeader(at) {
    const br = new BitReader(this.buf, at, this.len);
    const width = br.read(12), height = br.read(12), aspect = br.read(4), rateCode = br.read(4), bitRate = br.read(18);
    br.skip(1); br.skip(10); br.skip(1); // marker, vbv_buffer_size, constrained_parameters_flag
    if (br.read(1)) { for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) this.intraMatrix[ZIGZAG[i]] = br.read(8); } else this.intraMatrix.set(DEFAULT_INTRA_MATRIX);
    if (br.read(1)) { for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) this.nonIntraMatrix[ZIGZAG[i]] = br.read(8); } else this.nonIntraMatrix.fill(16);
    if (!width || !height) return;
    if (!this.seq || this.seq.width !== width || this.seq.height !== height) {
      this.mbw = (width + 15) >> 4; this.mbh = (height + 15) >> 4;
      this.ref0 = this.ref1 = this.pending = null;
      this.frames = [new Frame(this.mbw, this.mbh), new Frame(this.mbw, this.mbh), new Frame(this.mbw, this.mbh)];
      this.bframe = new Frame(this.mbw, this.mbh);
    }
    this.seq = { width, height, aspect, rate: PICTURE_RATES[rateCode] || 25, bitRate: bitRate * 400 };
  }

  output(f) { return { y: f.y, cb: f.cb, cr: f.cr, width: this.seq.width, height: this.seq.height, stride: f.stride, cstride: f.cstride, type: f.type }; }

  picture(start, end) {
    const br = new BitReader(this.buf, start, end);
    const temporalRef = br.read(10), type = br.read(3); br.skip(16);
    let fullFwd = 0, fwdCode = 0, fullBwd = 0, bwdCode = 0;
    if (type === PIC_P || type === PIC_B) { fullFwd = br.read(1); fwdCode = br.read(3); }
    if (type === PIC_B) { fullBwd = br.read(1); bwdCode = br.read(3); }
    if (type < PIC_I || type > PIC_D) { this.errors++; return null; }
    if (type === PIC_B && (!this.ref0 || !this.ref1)) return null; // (a B picture before two references: an open GOP's start, not shown)
    if (type === PIC_P && !this.ref1) return null;
    if (type === PIC_B && this.skipB) return { skipped: true, type }; // (counted: the display order's timing stays right)
    this.pictures++;
    let cur;
    if (type === PIC_B) cur = this.bframe;
    else cur = this.frames.find((f) => f !== this.ref1 && f !== this.ref0) ?? this.frames.find((f) => f !== this.ref1);
    cur.type = type; cur.temporalRef = temporalRef;
    this.pic = { type, fullFwd, fwdCode, fullBwd, bwdCode, cur, fwd: type === PIC_B ? this.ref0 : this.ref1, bwd: type === PIC_B ? this.ref1 : null };
    // slices
    br.pos = start * 8;
    for (;;) {
      const code = br.nextStartCode();
      if (code < 0) break;
      if (code >= 0x01 && code <= 0xaf) { try { this.slice(br, code); } catch (e) { this.errors++; } }
    }
    if (type === PIC_B) return this.output(cur);
    // a reference picture: the previous one is shown now (B pictures between them come after it in display order)
    this.ref0 = this.ref1; this.ref1 = cur;
    const prev = this.pending; this.pending = cur;
    return prev ? this.output(prev) : null;
  }

  slice(br, vpos) {
    const T = vlcTables(), pic = this.pic, mbw = this.mbw, mbh = this.mbh;
    let quant = br.read(5);
    while (br.read(1)) br.skip(8); // extra_information_slice
    let addr = (vpos - 1) * mbw - 1;
    const dc = [1024, 1024, 1024];
    let fx = 0, fy = 0, bx = 0, by = 0; // motion vector predictors (forward, backward)
    let lastFwd = false, lastBwd = false; // the previous macroblock's prediction (skipped B macroblocks repeat it)
    let mfx = 0, mfy = 0, mbx = 0, mby = 0; // the vectors in use (half-pel units)
    let first = true;
    const total = mbw * mbh;
    while (br.left > 0) {
      let inc = 0;
      for (;;) {
        const v = T.addr.read(br);
        if (v === STUFFING) continue;
        if (v === ESCAPE) { inc += 33; continue; }
        if (v < 0) throw new Error('bad macroblock address increment');
        inc += v; break;
      }
      if (!first && inc > 1) { // skipped macroblocks
        dc[0] = dc[1] = dc[2] = 1024;
        if (pic.type === PIC_P) { fx = fy = 0; mfx = mfy = 0; }
        for (let a = addr + 1; a < addr + inc && a < total; a++) {
          if (pic.type === PIC_P) this.predict(a, true, 0, 0, false, 0, 0);
          else this.predict(a, lastFwd, mfx, mfy, lastBwd, mbx, mby);
        }
      }
      first = false;
      addr += inc;
      if (addr >= total) throw new Error('macroblock address out of the picture');
      const type = T.type[pic.type].read(br);
      if (type < 0) throw new Error('bad macroblock type');
      if (type & MB_QUANT) quant = br.read(5);
      if (type & MB_INTRA) {
        fx = fy = bx = by = 0; lastFwd = lastBwd = false;
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) this.block(br, addr, i, true, quant, dc);
      } else {
        dc[0] = dc[1] = dc[2] = 1024;
        if (type & MB_FWD) {
          fx = this.motion(br, pic.fwdCode, fx); fy = this.motion(br, pic.fwdCode, fy);
          mfx = pic.fullFwd ? fx << 1 : fx; mfy = pic.fullFwd ? fy << 1 : fy;
        } else if (pic.type === PIC_P) { fx = fy = 0; mfx = mfy = 0; }
        if (type & MB_BWD) {
          bx = this.motion(br, pic.bwdCode, bx); by = this.motion(br, pic.bwdCode, by);
          mbx = pic.fullBwd ? bx << 1 : bx; mby = pic.fullBwd ? by << 1 : by;
        }
        const useFwd = pic.type === PIC_P || (type & MB_FWD) !== 0, useBwd = (type & MB_BWD) !== 0;
        this.predict(addr, useFwd, mfx, mfy, useBwd, mbx, mby);
        lastFwd = useFwd; lastBwd = useBwd;
        const cbp = type & MB_PATTERN ? T.cbp.read(br) : 0;
        if (cbp < 0) throw new Error('bad coded block pattern');
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) if (cbp & (32 >> i)) this.block(br, addr, i, false, quant, dc);
      }
      if (pic.type === PIC_D) br.skip(1);
      if (br.peek(23) === 0) break; // (a start code, or the zero padding after the stream: the end of the slice)
    }
  }

  motion(br, fcode, pred) {
    const code = vlcTables().motion.read(br);
    if (code < 0) throw new Error('bad motion code');
    let d = code;
    if (code !== 0) {
      const neg = br.read(1);
      const rsize = fcode - 1;
      if (rsize > 0) d = ((code - 1) << rsize) + br.read(rsize) + 1;
      if (neg) d = -d;
    }
    const f = 1 << (fcode - 1);
    let v = pred + d;
    if (v > (f << 4) - 1) v -= f << 5; else if (v < -(f << 4)) v += f << 5;
    return v;
  }

  /** the prediction of macroblock `addr` (forward, backward or their average) written into the current picture */
  predict(addr, useFwd, fx, fy, useBwd, bx, by) {
    const pic = this.pic, cur = pic.cur, mbw = this.mbw;
    const mx = addr % mbw, my = (addr / mbw) | 0;
    const f = useFwd ? pic.fwd : null, b = useBwd ? pic.bwd : null;
    if (!f && !b) return;
    const yo = my * 16 * cur.stride + mx * 16, co = my * 8 * cur.cstride + mx * 8;
    const H = this.mbh * 16;
    copyBlock(cur.y, yo, cur.stride, f, b, 'y', mx * 16, my * 16, 16, fx, fy, bx, by, cur.stride, H);
    // chroma vectors: half the luma ones, truncated toward zero
    const cfx = (fx / 2) | 0, cfy = (fy / 2) | 0, cbx = (bx / 2) | 0, cby = (by / 2) | 0;
    copyBlock(cur.cb, co, cur.cstride, f, b, 'cb', mx * 8, my * 8, 8, cfx, cfy, cbx, cby, cur.cstride, H >> 1);
    copyBlock(cur.cr, co, cur.cstride, f, b, 'cr', mx * 8, my * 8, 8, cfx, cfy, cbx, cby, cur.cstride, H >> 1);
  }

  block(br, addr, i, intra, quant, dc) {
    const T = vlcTables(), blk = this.blk;
    blk.fill(0);
    let n;
    if (intra) {
      const size = (i < 4 ? T.dcLuma : T.dcChroma).read(br);
      if (size < 0) throw new Error('bad dc size');
      let diff = 0;
      if (size) { diff = br.read(size); if (!(diff & (1 << (size - 1)))) diff = diff - (1 << size) + 1; }
      const p = i < 4 ? 0 : i - 3;
      dc[p] += diff * 8; // (the predictors kept in units of the reconstructed DC: dc * 8)
      blk[0] = dc[p];
      n = 0;
    } else n = -1;
    const matrix = intra ? this.intraMatrix : this.nonIntraMatrix;
    let firstCoef = !intra;
    for (;;) {
      if (this.pic.type === PIC_D) break; // (D pictures: the DC coefficients only)
      let run, level;
      if (firstCoef && br.peek(1) === 1) { br.skip(1); run = 0; level = br.read(1) ? -1 : 1; }
      else {
        const v = T.dct.read(br);
        if (v === DCT_EOB) break;
        if (v === DCT_ESC) {
          run = br.read(6); level = br.read(8);
          if (level === 0) level = br.read(8); else if (level === 128) level = br.read(8) - 256; else if (level > 128) level -= 256;
        } else if (v < 0) throw new Error('bad dct coefficient');
        else { run = v >> 8; level = v & 0xff; if (br.read(1)) level = -level; }
      }
      firstCoef = false;
      n += run + 1;
      if (n > 63) throw new Error('dct coefficient index past 63');
      const pos = ZIGZAG[n];
      let c = intra ? ((level * 2 * quant * matrix[pos]) / 16) | 0 : (((level * 2 + Math.sign(level)) * quant * matrix[pos]) / 16) | 0;
      if ((c & 1) === 0 && c !== 0) c -= Math.sign(c);
      blk[pos] = c > 2047 ? 2047 : c < -2048 ? -2048 : c;
    }
    idct8x8(blk);
    const cur = this.pic.cur, mbw = this.mbw, mx = addr % mbw, my = (addr / mbw) | 0;
    let plane, stride, o;
    if (i < 4) { plane = cur.y; stride = cur.stride; o = (my * 16 + (i >> 1) * 8) * stride + mx * 16 + (i & 1) * 8; }
    else { plane = i === 4 ? cur.cb : cur.cr; stride = cur.cstride; o = my * 8 * stride + mx * 8; }
    for (let y = 0; y < 8; y++, o += stride) {
      for (let x = 0; x < 8; x++) {
        let v = blk[y * 8 + x];
        if (v > 255) v = 255; else if (v < -256) v = -256;
        if (!intra) v += plane[o + x];
        plane[o + x] = v < 0 ? 0 : v > 255 ? 255 : v;
      }
    }
  }
}

/** a block's reference samples gathered with the picture edges extended (a vector pointing out of the picture) */
const edge = new Uint8Array(17 * 17), predB = new Uint8Array(256);
/**
 * out[oo + r * ostride + c] = the size x size block of `ref` at (x + vx/2, y + vy/2), vx / vy in half pels (averages of
 * 2 or 4 samples, rounded up, for the half positions).
 */
function fetch(out, oo, ostride, ref, stride, H, x, y, size, vx, vy) {
  const ix = x + (vx >> 1), iy = y + (vy >> 1), hx = vx & 1, hy = vy & 1;
  let src = ref, ss = stride, so = iy * stride + ix;
  if (ix < 0 || iy < 0 || ix + size + hx > stride || iy + size + hy > H) {
    for (let r = 0; r <= size; r++) {
      const yy = iy + r < 0 ? 0 : iy + r >= H ? H - 1 : iy + r;
      for (let c = 0; c <= size; c++) { const xx = ix + c < 0 ? 0 : ix + c >= stride ? stride - 1 : ix + c; edge[r * 17 + c] = ref[yy * stride + xx]; }
    }
    src = edge; ss = 17; so = 0;
  }
  if (hx && hy) {
    for (let r = 0; r < size; r++, so += ss, oo += ostride) for (let c = 0; c < size; c++) out[oo + c] = (src[so + c] + src[so + c + 1] + src[so + ss + c] + src[so + ss + c + 1] + 2) >> 2;
  } else if (hx) {
    for (let r = 0; r < size; r++, so += ss, oo += ostride) for (let c = 0; c < size; c++) out[oo + c] = (src[so + c] + src[so + c + 1] + 1) >> 1;
  } else if (hy) {
    for (let r = 0; r < size; r++, so += ss, oo += ostride) for (let c = 0; c < size; c++) out[oo + c] = (src[so + c] + src[so + ss + c] + 1) >> 1;
  } else {
    for (let r = 0; r < size; r++, so += ss, oo += ostride) for (let c = 0; c < size; c++) out[oo + c] = src[so + c];
  }
}
function copyBlock(dst, o, dstride, f, b, plane, x, y, size, fx, fy, bx, by, stride, H) {
  if (f && b) {
    fetch(dst, o, dstride, f[plane], stride, H, x, y, size, fx, fy);
    fetch(predB, 0, 16, b[plane], stride, H, x, y, size, bx, by);
    for (let r = 0, k = 0; r < size; r++, o += dstride, k += 16) for (let c = 0; c < size; c++) dst[o + c] = (dst[o + c] + predB[k + c] + 1) >> 1;
  } else if (f) fetch(dst, o, dstride, f[plane], stride, H, x, y, size, fx, fy);
  else fetch(dst, o, dstride, b[plane], stride, H, x, y, size, bx, by);
}
```

`src/media/open.js`:

```js
// The media files the DirectShow path plays (quartz.js RenderFile): the source for a file, by its first bytes.
import { MpegSource, MediaError, HEAD } from './mpeg-source.js';
import { WavSource, isWave, parseWave, isMpegWaveTag, subFile } from './wav-source.js';
import { AviSource, isAvi } from './avi-source.js';

/**
 * @param {{ size: () => number, read: (off: number, len: number) => Uint8Array, prepare?: (off: number, len: number) => Promise<any>|null, close?: () => void }} file
 * @param {{ log?: (msg: string) => void }} [opts]
 * @returns {MpegSource|WavSource|AviSource} (throws MediaError: 'unsupported' / 'corrupt')
 */
export function openMedia(file, opts = {}) {
  const head = file.read(0, Math.min(file.size(), HEAD));
  if (!head.length) throw new MediaError('corrupt', 'empty file');
  if (isAvi(head)) return new AviSource(file, head, opts);
  if (isWave(head)) {
    const w = parseWave(file, head);
    // (MPEG audio in a WAVE file — format 0x50 / 0x55, what Windows' ACM decodes: its data chunk played as an MPEG stream)
    if (isMpegWaveTag(w.fmt.tag)) return new MpegSource(subFile(file, w.dataStart, w.dataSize), opts);
    return new WavSource(file, head, opts);
  }
  return new MpegSource(file, opts, head);
}
export { MediaError };
```

`src/media/vfw-codecs.js`:

```js
// The video codecs Windows ships with (the "Video for Windows" set its DirectShow AVI decompressor uses): uncompressed
// DIBs, Microsoft RLE (BI_RLE8 / BI_RLE4), Microsoft Video 1 (CRAM) and Cinepak (cvid). Each decoder draws into a
// persistent top-down frame of 32-bit pixels (little-endian ABGR words: R, G, B, A bytes), as delta frames update the
// previous picture.

/** BITMAPINFOHEADER fields + palette (0x00RRGGBB entries) of a video stream's format */
export function readBitmapInfo(b, at, len) {
  const dv = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset + at, len);
  const size = dv.getUint32(0, true), width = dv.getInt32(4, true), height = dv.getInt32(8, true), bits = dv.getUint16(14, true), compression = dv.getUint32(16, true);
  let colors = len >= 36 ? dv.getUint32(32, true) : 0;
  if (!colors && bits <= 8) colors = 1 << bits;
  const palette = new Uint32Array(256);
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(colors, 256) && size + 4 * i + 4 <= len; i++) { const o = size + 4 * i; palette[i] = (dv.getUint8(o + 2) << 16) | (dv.getUint8(o + 1) << 8) | dv.getUint8(o); }
  return { width, height: Math.abs(height), bottomUp: height > 0, bits, compression, palette };
}
const fourcc = (s) => (s.charCodeAt(0) | (s.charCodeAt(1) << 8) | (s.charCodeAt(2) << 16) | (s.charCodeAt(3) << 24)) >>> 0;
const BI_RGB = 0, BI_RLE8 = 1, BI_RLE4 = 2, BI_BITFIELDS = 3;
const rgb = (r, g, b) => (0xff000000 | (b << 16) | (g << 8) | r) >>> 0;
const pal = (c) => rgb((c >> 16) & 255, (c >> 8) & 255, c & 255);
const c555 = (v) => rgb(((v >> 10) & 31) * 255 / 31 | 0, ((v >> 5) & 31) * 255 / 31 | 0, (v & 31) * 255 / 31 | 0);

/**
 * A decoder for a stream's compression (fourcc or BI_* value) — { decode(bytes, keyframe), frame: Uint32Array top-down,
 * width, height, setPalette(entries) } — or null when it is not one of these.
 */
export function vfwDecoder(info, handler = 0) {
  const c = info.compression, w = info.width, h = info.height;
  if (!(w > 0 && h > 0 && w <= 8192 && h <= 8192)) return null; // (a damaged header: no decompressor takes it)
  const frame = new Uint32Array(w * h).fill(0xff000000);
  const P = new Uint32Array(256); for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) P[i] = pal(info.palette[i]);
  const base = { frame, width: w, height: h, setPalette(first, entries) { for (let i = 0; i < entries.length && first + i < 256; i++) P[first + i] = pal(entries[i]); } };
  const row = (y) => (info.bottomUp ? h - 1 - y : y) * w; // (the frame row of a stored row)
  if (c === BI_RGB || c === BI_BITFIELDS) {
    const bits = info.bits, stride = ((w * bits + 31) >> 5) << 2;
    if (![8, 16, 24, 32].includes(bits) && !(bits === 4 || bits === 1)) return null;
    return { ...base, decode(b) {
      for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        const o = y * stride, r = row(y);
        if (o + stride > b.length) break;
        for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
          let v;
          if (bits === 24) v = rgb(b[o + 3 * x + 2], b[o + 3 * x + 1], b[o + 3 * x]);
          else if (bits === 32) v = rgb(b[o + 4 * x + 2], b[o + 4 * x + 1], b[o + 4 * x]);
          else if (bits === 16) v = c555(b[o + 2 * x] | (b[o + 2 * x + 1] << 8)); // (BI_RGB 16-bit: 5-5-5)
          else if (bits === 8) v = P[b[o + x]];
          else if (bits === 4) v = P[(b[o + (x >> 1)] >> (x & 1 ? 0 : 4)) & 15];
          else v = P[(b[o + (x >> 3)] >> (7 - (x & 7))) & 1];
          frame[r + x] = v;
        }
      }
    } };
  }
  if (c === BI_RLE8 || c === BI_RLE4) {
    const four = c === BI_RLE4;
    const put = (x, y, v) => { if (x < w && y < h) frame[row(y) + x] = P[v]; };
    return { ...base, decode(b) {
      let x = 0, y = 0, i = 0;
      while (i + 1 < b.length && y < h) {
        const n = b[i++], v = b[i++];
        if (n) { for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) put(x++, y, four ? (k & 1 ? v & 15 : v >> 4) : v); continue; }
        if (v === 0) { x = 0; y++; } // end of line
        else if (v === 1) break; // end of bitmap
        else if (v === 2) { x += b[i++]; y += b[i++]; } // delta
        else { // absolute run of v pixels, padded to a word
          const bytes = four ? (v + 1) >> 1 : v;
          for (let k = 0; k < v; k++) put(x++, y, four ? (k & 1 ? b[i + (k >> 1)] & 15 : b[i + (k >> 1)] >> 4) : b[i + k]);
          i += bytes + (bytes & 1);
        }
      }
    } };
  }
  const cc = c === 0 ? handler : c;
  if (cc === fourcc('CRAM') || cc === fourcc('cram') || cc === fourcc('MSVC') || cc === fourcc('msvc') || cc === fourcc('WHAM') || cc === fourcc('wham')) return msvideo1(base, info, row);
  if (cc === fourcc('cvid') || cc === fourcc('CVID')) return cinepak(base, info);
  return null;
}

/**
 * Microsoft Video 1, 16-bit form: 4x4 blocks from the bottom-left, 1, 2 or 8 colors (5-5-5) each. (The 8-bit form, with
 * palette indexes, is not decoded: vfwDecoder answers null.)
 */
function msvideo1(base, info, row) {
  if (info.bits !== 16) return null;
  const { frame, width: w, height: h } = base;
  const bw = w >> 2, bh = h >> 2;
  const px = (bx, by, k, v) => { frame[row(by * 4 + (k >> 2)) + bx * 4 + (k & 3)] = v; }; // (k: pixel k of the block, from its first stored row)
  return { ...base, decode(b) {
    let i = 0, skip = 0;
    for (let by = 0; by < bh; by++) {
      for (let bx = 0; bx < bw; bx++) {
        if (skip > 0) { skip--; continue; }
        if (i + 2 > b.length) return;
        const a = b[i++], f = b[i++];
        if (a === 0 && f === 0) return; // (end of the picture: the rest unchanged)
        if ((f & 0xfc) === 0x84) { skip = ((f - 0x84) << 8) + a - 1; continue; } // (blocks unchanged)
        if (f < 0x80) { // 16 flag bits, one per pixel: 2 colors, or 8 (a pair per 2x2 quadrant) when the first has its top bit
          const flags = (f << 8) | a, ca = b[i] | (b[i + 1] << 8);
          if (ca & 0x8000) {
            const cols = []; for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) cols.push(c555(b[i + 2 * k] | (b[i + 2 * k + 1] << 8)));
            i += 16;
            for (let k = 0; k < 16; k++) { const q = ((k >> 3) << 1) | ((k & 3) >> 1); px(bx, by, k, cols[2 * q + (((flags >> k) & 1) ^ 1)]); }
          } else {
            const cb = b[i + 2] | (b[i + 3] << 8); i += 4;
            const colors = [c555(cb), c555(ca)];
            for (let k = 0; k < 16; k++) px(bx, by, k, colors[(flags >> k) & 1]);
          }
        } else { const v = c555((f << 8) | a); for (let k = 0; k < 16; k++) px(bx, by, k, v); } // (one color)
      }
    }
  } };
}

/** Cinepak: strips of 4x4 blocks, each from one (V1, doubled) or four (V4) entries of the strip's 2x2 codebooks */
function cinepak(base) {
  const { frame, width: W, height: H } = base;
  const books = []; // per strip: { v1: Uint32Array(256 * 4), v4: Uint32Array(256 * 4) } — 2x2 pixels per entry
  const book = () => ({ v1: new Uint32Array(1024).fill(0xff000000), v4: new Uint32Array(1024).fill(0xff000000) });
  const clamp = (v) => (v < 0 ? 0 : v > 255 ? 255 : v);
  const yuv = (y, u, v) => rgb(clamp(y + 2 * v), clamp(y - (u >> 1) - v), clamp(y + 2 * u));
  const be16 = (b, i) => (b[i] << 8) | b[i + 1], be32 = (b, i) => ((b[i] << 24) | (b[i + 1] << 16) | (b[i + 2] << 8) | b[i + 3]) >>> 0;
  function loadBook(dst, b, i, end, partial, gray) {
    const n = gray ? 4 : 6;
    let k = 0;
    while (i < end && k < 256) {
      let mask = 0xffffffff;
      if (partial) { if (i + 4 > end) break; mask = be32(b, i); i += 4; }
      for (let bit = 31; bit >= 0 && k < 256; bit--, k++) {
        if (!(mask >>> bit & 1)) continue;
        if (i + n > end) return;
        const u = gray ? 0 : (b[i + 4] << 24) >> 24, v = gray ? 0 : (b[i + 5] << 24) >> 24;
        for (let p = 0; p < 4; p++) dst[4 * k + p] = yuv(b[i + p], u, v);
        i += n;
      }
    }
  }
  return { ...base, decode(b) {
    if (b.length < 10) return;
    const flags = b[0], strips = be16(b, 8);
    let i = 10, y0 = 0;
    for (let s = 0; s < strips && i + 12 <= b.length; s++) {
      const size = be16(b, i + 2), top = be16(b, i + 4), left = be16(b, i + 6), bottom = be16(b, i + 8), right = be16(b, i + 10);
      const end = Math.min(b.length, i + size);
      const sy0 = top ? top : y0, sy1 = top ? bottom : y0 + bottom; // (a zero top: the strip follows the previous one, `bottom` its height)
      if (!books[s]) books[s] = book();
      if (s > 0 && !(flags & 1)) { books[s].v1.set(books[s - 1].v1); books[s].v4.set(books[s - 1].v4); } // (codebooks inherited)
      const bk = books[s];
      let j = i + 12;
      while (j + 4 <= end) {
        const id = be16(b, j), csize = be16(b, j + 2), cend = Math.min(end, j + csize);
        if (csize < 4) break;
        const d = j + 4;
        switch (id) {
          case 0x2000: case 0x2100: case 0x2400: case 0x2500: loadBook(bk.v4, b, d, cend, (id & 0x100) !== 0, (id & 0x400) !== 0); break;
          case 0x2200: case 0x2300: case 0x2600: case 0x2700: loadBook(bk.v1, b, d, cend, (id & 0x100) !== 0, (id & 0x400) !== 0); break;
          case 0x3000: case 0x3100: case 0x3200: blocks(bk, b, d, cend, id, left, sy0, right, sy1); break;
        }
        j += csize;
      }
      y0 = sy1; i += size;
    }
  } };
  function blocks(bk, b, i, end, id, x0, y0, x1, y1) {
    let mask = 0, bit = 0; // (flag words read as needed, most significant bit first)
    const flag = () => { if (!bit) { if (i + 4 > end) return -1; mask = be32(b, i); i += 4; bit = 32; } bit--; return mask >>> bit & 1; };
    const right = Math.min(x1 || W, W);
    for (let y = y0; y < Math.min(y1, H); y += 4) {
      for (let x = x0; x < right; x += 4) {
        let mode; // 0 skip, 1 V1, 4 V4
        if (id === 0x3200) mode = 1;
        else if (id === 0x3000) { const f = flag(); if (f < 0) return; mode = f ? 4 : 1; }
        else { const f = flag(); if (f < 0) return; if (!f) mode = 0; else { const g = flag(); if (g < 0) return; mode = g ? 4 : 1; } }
        if (mode === 0) continue;
        if (mode === 1) {
          if (i >= end) return;
          const e = 4 * b[i++];
          for (let q = 0; q < 4; q++) { const v = bk.v1[e + q], qx = x + (q & 1) * 2, qy = y + (q >> 1) * 2; fill(qx, qy, v, v, v, v); }
        } else {
          if (i + 4 > end) return;
          for (let q = 0; q < 4; q++) { const e = 4 * b[i++], qx = x + (q & 1) * 2, qy = y + (q >> 1) * 2; fill(qx, qy, bk.v4[e], bk.v4[e + 1], bk.v4[e + 2], bk.v4[e + 3]); }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  function fill(x, y, a, c, d, e) {
    if (y < H) { const o = y * W + x; if (x < W) frame[o] = a; if (x + 1 < W) frame[o + 1] = c; }
    if (y + 1 < H) { const o = (y + 1) * W + x; if (x < W) frame[o] = d; if (x + 1 < W) frame[o + 1] = e; }
  }
}
```

`src/media/wav-source.js`:

```js
// RIFF WAVE files for the DirectShow path (a game playing music or speech with IGraphBuilder::RenderFile): PCM
// (8 / 16 / 24 / 32-bit integers, 32 / 64-bit floats, WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE), IMA ADPCM and Microsoft ADPCM — the formats
// Windows decodes with its built-in codecs. Same playing interface as MpegSource (audio only).
import { MediaError } from './mpeg-source.js';

const TAG_PCM = 1, TAG_MSADPCM = 2, TAG_FLOAT = 3, TAG_IMAADPCM = 0x11, TAG_EXTENSIBLE = 0xfffe;
const CHUNK = 256 * 1024;

export const IMA_STEPS = new Int32Array([7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16, 17, 19, 21, 23, 25, 28, 31, 34, 37, 41, 45, 50, 55, 60, 66, 73, 80, 88, 97, 107, 118, 130, 143,
  157, 173, 190, 209, 230, 253, 279, 307, 337, 371, 408, 449, 494, 544, 598, 658, 724, 796, 876, 963, 1060, 1166, 1282, 1411, 1552, 1707, 1878, 2066, 2272, 2499,
  2749, 3024, 3327, 3660, 4026, 4428, 4871, 5358, 5894, 6484, 7132, 7845, 8630, 9493, 10442, 11487, 12635, 13899, 15289, 16818, 18500, 20350, 22385, 24623, 27086,
  29794, 32767]);
const IMA_INDEX = [-1, -1, -1, -1, 2, 4, 6, 8];
const MS_ADAPT = [230, 230, 230, 230, 307, 409, 512, 614, 768, 614, 512, 409, 307, 230, 230, 230];
const MS_COEFS = [[256, 0], [512, -256], [0, 0], [192, 64], [240, 0], [460, -208], [392, -232]];

/** A RIFF WAVE file's first bytes? */
export const isWave = (b) => b.length >= 12 && b[0] === 0x52 && b[1] === 0x49 && b[2] === 0x46 && b[3] === 0x46 && b[8] === 0x57 && b[9] === 0x41 && b[10] === 0x56 && b[11] === 0x45;

const u16 = (b, i) => b[i] | (b[i + 1] << 8), s16 = (b, i) => (u16(b, i) << 16) >> 16, u32 = (b, i) => (b[i] | (b[i + 1] << 8) | (b[i + 2] << 16) | (b[i + 3] << 24)) >>> 0;

/** IMA ADPCM block (one per channel interleaved by 4 bytes) -> float samples per channel; `n` samples per channel */
export function decodeImaBlock(b, at, len, ch, n, out) {
  const pred = [], idx = [];
  for (let c = 0; c < ch; c++) { pred[c] = s16(b, at + 4 * c); idx[c] = Math.min(88, b[at + 4 * c + 2]); out[c][0] = pred[c] / 32768; }
  let p = at + 4 * ch, s = 1;
  while (s < n && p < at + len) {
    for (let c = 0; c < ch; c++) { // 8 samples per channel from 4 bytes
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        const nib = (b[p + 4 * c + (k >> 1)] >> ((k & 1) * 4)) & 15, step = IMA_STEPS[idx[c]];
        let d = step >> 3; if (nib & 1) d += step >> 2; if (nib & 2) d += step >> 1; if (nib & 4) d += step;
        let v = pred[c] + (nib & 8 ? -d : d); v = v > 32767 ? 32767 : v < -32768 ? -32768 : v;
        pred[c] = v; idx[c] = Math.max(0, Math.min(88, idx[c] + IMA_INDEX[nib & 7]));
        if (s + k < n) out[c][s + k] = v / 32768;
      }
    }
    p += 4 * ch; s += 8;
  }
  return Math.min(n, s);
}
/** Microsoft ADPCM block -> float samples per channel */
export function decodeMsBlock(b, at, len, ch, n, out, coefs = MS_COEFS) {
  const pi = [], delta = [], s1 = [], s2 = [];
  let p = at;
  for (let c = 0; c < ch; c++) pi[c] = Math.min(b[p++], coefs.length - 1);
  for (let c = 0; c < ch; c++) { delta[c] = s16(b, p); p += 2; }
  for (let c = 0; c < ch; c++) { s1[c] = s16(b, p); p += 2; }
  for (let c = 0; c < ch; c++) { s2[c] = s16(b, p); p += 2; }
  for (let c = 0; c < ch; c++) { out[c][0] = s2[c] / 32768; if (n > 1) out[c][1] = s1[c] / 32768; }
  let s = 2, c = 0, hi = true;
  while (s < n && p < at + len) {
    const nib = hi ? b[p] >> 4 : b[p] & 15; if (!hi) p++; hi = !hi;
    const signed = nib & 8 ? nib - 16 : nib, [k1, k2] = coefs[pi[c]];
    let v = ((s1[c] * k1 + s2[c] * k2) >> 8) + signed * delta[c];
    v = v > 32767 ? 32767 : v < -32768 ? -32768 : v;
    s2[c] = s1[c]; s1[c] = v;
    delta[c] = Math.max(16, (MS_ADAPT[nib] * delta[c]) >> 8);
    out[c][s] = v / 32768;
    if (++c === ch) { c = 0; s++; }
  }
  return Math.min(n, s);
}

/**
 * The format and the data chunk of a WAVE file: { fmt: { tag, channels, rate, align, bits, extra }, dataStart, dataSize }
 * (the header may be longer than the first bytes read: more are read then). Throws MediaError.
 */
export function parseWave(file, head) {
  const size = file.size();
  let b = head, i = 12, fmt = null, dataStart, dataSize;
  for (;;) {
    if (i + 8 > b.length) { if (b.length >= size) break; b = file.read(0, Math.min(size, i + 65536)); continue; }
    const id = String.fromCharCode(b[i], b[i + 1], b[i + 2], b[i + 3]), n = u32(b, i + 4);
    if (id === 'fmt ') {
      if (i + 8 + n > b.length) { if (b.length >= size) break; b = file.read(0, Math.min(size, i + 8 + n)); continue; }
      fmt = { tag: u16(b, i + 8), channels: u16(b, i + 10), rate: u32(b, i + 12), align: u16(b, i + 20), bits: u16(b, i + 22), extra: b.slice(i + 24, i + 8 + n) };
      if (fmt.tag === TAG_EXTENSIBLE && n >= 40) fmt.tag = u16(b, i + 32); // (the sub-format GUID's first word)
    } else if (id === 'data') { dataStart = i + 8; dataSize = Math.min(n, size - i - 8); break; }
    i += 8 + n + (n & 1);
  }
  if (!fmt || dataStart === undefined) throw new MediaError('corrupt', 'WAVE file without fmt / data');
  if (!fmt.channels || !fmt.rate || !fmt.align) throw new MediaError('corrupt', 'WAVE format');
  return { fmt, dataStart, dataSize };
}
/** WAVE format tags of MPEG audio (layers I / II, layer III): the data chunk is an MPEG audio stream */
export const isMpegWaveTag = (tag) => tag === 0x50 || tag === 0x55;
/** a part of a file seen as a file (offsets from `start`) */
export function subFile(file, start, size) {
  return { size: () => size, read: (o, n) => file.read(start + o, Math.max(0, Math.min(n, size - o))), prepare: file.prepare ? (o, n) => file.prepare(start + o, Math.max(0, Math.min(n, size - o))) : undefined, close: () => file.close?.() };
}

/** Samples of a WAVE format (WAVEFORMATEX fields: tag, channels, rate, align, bits, extra), by whole blocks. */
export class WaveDecoder {
  constructor(fmt) {
    const pcm = fmt.tag === TAG_PCM && [8, 16, 24, 32].includes(fmt.bits), flt = fmt.tag === TAG_FLOAT && (fmt.bits === 32 || fmt.bits === 64);
    if (!pcm && !flt && fmt.tag !== TAG_IMAADPCM && fmt.tag !== TAG_MSADPCM) throw new MediaError('unsupported', `WAVE format tag 0x${fmt.tag.toString(16)}`);
    // (a damaged header: no channel, a rate no sound device plays, or PCM blocks that are not whole samples per channel —
    // refused as a parser does, rather than decoded as garbage or a 64 Ki-channel / 4 GHz stream allocated)
    if (!fmt.channels || fmt.channels > 32 || !fmt.align || !fmt.rate || fmt.rate > 1000000) throw new MediaError('corrupt', 'WAVE format');
    if ((pcm || flt) && (fmt.align % fmt.channels || ![1, 2, 3, 4, 8].includes(fmt.align / fmt.channels) || (flt && fmt.align / fmt.channels < 4))) throw new MediaError('corrupt', 'WAVE format: block align');
    if ((fmt.tag === TAG_IMAADPCM && fmt.align <= 4 * fmt.channels) || (fmt.tag === TAG_MSADPCM && fmt.align <= 7 * fmt.channels)) throw new MediaError('corrupt', 'WAVE format: ADPCM block align');
    this.fmt = fmt;
    if (fmt.tag === TAG_IMAADPCM) this.blockSamples = (fmt.align - 4 * fmt.channels) * 8 / (4 * fmt.channels) + 1;
    else if (fmt.tag === TAG_MSADPCM) {
      this.blockSamples = fmt.extra.length >= 4 ? u16(fmt.extra, 2) : (fmt.align - 7 * fmt.channels) * 2 / fmt.channels + 2;
      const nc = fmt.extra.length >= 6 ? u16(fmt.extra, 4) : 0;
      this.coefs = nc ? Array.from({ length: nc }, (_, k) => [s16(fmt.extra, 6 + 4 * k), s16(fmt.extra, 8 + 4 * k)]) : MS_COEFS;
    } else this.blockSamples = 1;
  }
  /** n blocks -> float samples per channel */
  decode(b, n) {
    const f = this.fmt, ch = f.channels, count = n * this.blockSamples;
    const out = Array.from({ length: ch }, () => new Float32Array(count));
    if (f.tag === TAG_IMAADPCM || f.tag === TAG_MSADPCM) {
      const view = Array.from({ length: ch });
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < ch; c++) view[c] = out[c].subarray(k * this.blockSamples);
        if (f.tag === TAG_IMAADPCM) decodeImaBlock(b, k * f.align, f.align, ch, this.blockSamples, view);
        else decodeMsBlock(b, k * f.align, f.align, ch, this.blockSamples, view, this.coefs);
      }
      return out;
    }
    const bps = f.align / ch, dv = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.length);
    for (let s = 0; s < n; s++) for (let c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
      const o = s * f.align + c * bps;
      let v;
      if (f.tag === TAG_FLOAT) v = bps === 8 ? dv.getFloat64(o, true) : dv.getFloat32(o, true);
      else if (bps === 1) v = (b[o] - 128) / 128;
      else if (bps === 2) v = dv.getInt16(o, true) / 32768;
      else if (bps === 3) v = ((b[o] | b[o + 1] << 8 | b[o + 2] << 16) << 8 >> 8) / 8388608;
      else v = dv.getInt32(o, true) / 2147483648;
      out[c][s] = v;
    }
    return out;
  }
}

export class WavSource {
  constructor(file, head, opts = {}) {
    this.file = file; this.log = opts.log ?? (() => {});
    this.size = file.size();
    this.kind = 'wav'; this.video = null; this.audio = true; this.width = 0; this.height = 0; this.fps = 0;
    this.audioStart = 0; this.videoStart = 0; this.audioLayer = 0;
    const { fmt, dataStart, dataSize } = parseWave(file, head);
    this.dataStart = dataStart; this.dataSize = dataSize;
    this.dec = new WaveDecoder(fmt);
    this.fmt = fmt; this.blockSamples = this.dec.blockSamples;
    this.audioRate = fmt.rate; this.audioChannels = fmt.channels;
    const blocks = Math.floor(this.dataSize / fmt.align);
    this.duration = blocks * this.blockSamples / fmt.rate;
    this.reset();
  }
  reset() {
    this.readPos = 0; // bytes of the data chunk decoded
    this.audioPos = 0; this.audioDone = false; this.videoDone = true; this.frameIndex = 0; this.picture = null; this.eof = false;
    this.loading = null; this.loadError = null; this.failed = false;
    this.stats = { decoded: 0, skipped: 0, overtaken: 0, late: 0, decodeMs: 0 };
  }
  load() { return false; } // (read as decoded: audioUntil)
  pictureAt() { return null; }
  get videoEnd() { return 0; }
  get audioEnd() { return this.audioDone ? this.audioPos / this.audioRate : Infinity; }
  ended(t) { return this.audioDone && t >= this.audioEnd || this.failed; }
  frameTime() { return Infinity; }
  /** decode up to stream time t: out(samplesPerChannel[], startTime) per piece (waits for data on the network: later) */
  audioUntil(t, out) {
    const f = this.fmt, align = f.align;
    while (!this.audioDone && this.audioPos / f.rate < t) {
      const left = this.dataSize - this.readPos;
      if (left < align) { this.audioDone = true; return; }
      const len = Math.min(left - left % align, CHUNK - CHUNK % align);
      const off = this.dataStart + this.readPos;
      if (this.loading) return;
      const p = this.file.prepare?.(off, len);
      if (p) { this.loading = p; p.then(() => { this.loading = null; }, (e) => { this.loading = null; this.loadError = e; this.audioDone = true; }); return; }
      const b = this.file.read(off, len);
      if (b.length < align) { this.audioDone = true; return; }
      const n = Math.floor(b.length / align);
      const samples = this.decode(b, n);
      out(samples, this.audioPos / f.rate);
      this.audioPos += samples[0].length; this.readPos += n * align;
    }
  }
  decode(b, n) { return this.dec.decode(b, n); }
  close() { this.file.close?.(); }
}
```

`src/media/yuv.js`:

```js
// 4:2:0 Y'CbCr (ITU-R BT.601, studio range: Y' 16-235, Cb / Cr 16-240 around 128) -> RGBA bytes.

const FIX = 1 << 16;
const YT = new Int32Array(256), RV = new Int32Array(256), GU = new Int32Array(256), GV = new Int32Array(256), BU = new Int32Array(256);
for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
  YT[i] = Math.round(1.164383 * (i - 16) * FIX) + FIX / 2; // (+ 1/2: rounding)
  RV[i] = Math.round(1.596027 * (i - 128) * FIX);
  GU[i] = Math.round(-0.391762 * (i - 128) * FIX);
  GV[i] = Math.round(-0.812968 * (i - 128) * FIX);
  BU[i] = Math.round(2.017232 * (i - 128) * FIX);
}
// clamping to 0..255 by table: (value >> 16) + OFF covers -19 - 258 .. 278 + 258
const OFF = 512, CL = new Uint8Array(1536);
for (let i = 0; i < CL.length; i++) CL[i] = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, i - OFF));
const LITTLE = new Uint8Array(new Uint32Array([1]).buffer)[0] === 1;

/**
 * Convert the w x h rectangle at (x0, y0) (even) of a picture { y, cb, cr, stride, cstride } into `out` (RGBA,
 * w * h * 4 bytes, opaque).
 */
export function yuv420ToRgba(p, x0, y0, w, h, out) {
  const { y: Y, cb: U, cr: V, stride, cstride } = p;
  if (!LITTLE || out.byteOffset & 3) return slow(p, x0, y0, w, h, out);
  const o32 = new Uint32Array(out.buffer, out.byteOffset, w * h);
  let o = 0;
  for (let r = 0; r < h; r++) {
    const yr = (y0 + r) * stride + x0, cr = ((y0 + r) >> 1) * cstride + (x0 >> 1);
    for (let c = 0; c < w; c += 2) {
      const u = U[cr + (c >> 1)], v = V[cr + (c >> 1)];
      const rv = RV[v], guv = GU[u] + GV[v], bu = BU[u];
      let yy = YT[Y[yr + c]];
      o32[o++] = 0xff000000 | CL[((yy + bu) >> 16) + OFF] << 16 | CL[((yy + guv) >> 16) + OFF] << 8 | CL[((yy + rv) >> 16) + OFF];
      if (c + 1 < w) { yy = YT[Y[yr + c + 1]]; o32[o++] = 0xff000000 | CL[((yy + bu) >> 16) + OFF] << 16 | CL[((yy + guv) >> 16) + OFF] << 8 | CL[((yy + rv) >> 16) + OFF]; }
    }
  }
  return out;
}
function slow(p, x0, y0, w, h, out) {
  const { y: Y, cb: U, cr: V, stride, cstride } = p;
  let o = 0;
  for (let r = 0; r < h; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < w; c++) {
      const x = x0 + c, ci = ((y0 + r) >> 1) * cstride + (x >> 1), yy = YT[Y[(y0 + r) * stride + x]], u = U[ci], v = V[ci];
      out[o] = CL[((yy + RV[v]) >> 16) + OFF]; out[o + 1] = CL[((yy + GU[u] + GV[v]) >> 16) + OFF]; out[o + 2] = CL[((yy + BU[u]) >> 16) + OFF]; out[o + 3] = 255;
      o += 4;
    }
  }
  return out;
}
```

`src/ports/goldsrc/bsp-reads.js`:

```js
// A GoldSrc map's load, announced (docs/browser-ports.md "Map loads announced"): the engine (a pinned third-party binary,
// unchanged) reads its files synchronously, one at a time — each piece it lacks a round trip of the page's thread. Its
// map's file says much of what the load reads next: once the engine has read a maps/<map>.bsp (BSP v30) up to its entity
// and texture lumps, the page parses them and announces (GameData.want, `wait: false`: the engine waits through its own
// reads) what the load certainly reads, fetched in parallel by the data worker, the engine's reads joining them:
// - the textures the texture lump names, each the lump of the WAD the engine finds it in — the worldspawn's `wad` list,
//   searched from its end, as the engine does —, read from the WAD directories the page parsed when the engine read them
//   (it mounts the archives at its start; src/vfs/wad3.js). A texture whose pixels the map holds is read from the map
//   unless the engine's `r_wadtextures` is set (Mod_LoadTextureData: the WAD's copy first then — default 0; a game's
//   config sets it, Half-Life's does): announced from a WAD only then (`wadTextures`);
// - the worldspawn's sky (`skyname`: gfx/env/<name><side> — six pictures);
// - the entities' own files: a `model` key's .mdl / .spr, an ambient_generic's sound (`message`, under sound/);
// - the files beside the map that its load reads: its node graph and its bots' navigation mesh (maps/graphs/<map>.nod,
//   maps/<map>.nav — read by the map's server only: when the page certainly runs it, `server`), its overview
//   (overviews/<map>.txt and its picture);
// - the entries of maps/<map>.res when there is one (a map's own list of its files — those of the kinds above), a second
//   list once its text is here (the engine never reads it: fetched announced, not learned, the page's thread not held);
// - what the game's server precaches at every map's load without the map naming it (`mapPrecache`: its engine release
//   says so — a build's generated assets its game DLL precaches; /api/manifest mapPrecache), last — the map's own files
//   first —, whoever runs the server: its clients load what it precaches.
// Only files the game has (the engine's search order: the game's folder first, then the others it mounts); nothing the
// page holds already. Engine conventions only (GoldSrc's formats and folders): no game's own names.

import { wadEntries, wadHeader, WAD_ENTRY, WAD_MIPTEX } from '../../vfs/wad3.js';

/** BSP version of GoldSrc's maps. */
export const BSP_VERSION = 30;
/** Lumps of a v30 BSP; its header's bytes (version, then offset and length of each). */
export const BSP_LUMPS = 15, BSP_HEADER = 4 + BSP_LUMPS * 8;
/** The sky's six pictures: gfx/env/<skyname><side>. */
export const SKY_SIDES = ['rt', 'bk', 'lf', 'ft', 'up', 'dn'];
/** A list label's map name at most this long (GameData.want keeps 80 characters). */
const LABEL_MAP = 60;

/**
 * A v30 BSP's lumps from its header (`head`, its first BSP_HEADER bytes at least) in a file of `size` bytes:
 * [{ off, len }] × BSP_LUMPS, or null (not a v30 BSP, or a lump past the file's end).
 * @param {Uint8Array} head
 * @param {number} size
 */
export function bspLumps(head, size) {
  if (head.length < BSP_HEADER) return null;
  const v = new DataView(head.buffer, head.byteOffset, head.byteLength);
  if (v.getInt32(0, true) !== BSP_VERSION) return null;
  const lumps = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < BSP_LUMPS; i++) {
    const off = v.getInt32(4 + i * 8, true), len = v.getInt32(8 + i * 8, true);
    if (off < 0 || len < 0 || off + len > size) return null;
    lumps.push({ off, len });
  }
  return lumps;
}

/**
 * Bytes that read as an entity lump: text starting with '{' (after blanks) — the engine tells it this way from the planes'
 * lump of the maps that swap the two first lumps.
 * @param {Uint8Array | null} b
 */
export function looksLikeEntities(b) {
  if (!b) return false;
  for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) { const c = b[i]; if (c === 0x7b) return true; if (c > 0x20) return false; }
  return false;
}

/**
 * The entities of an entity lump's text: [{ key: value }] — keys lower case, values as written. Tolerant as the engine's
 * parser: quoted or bare tokens, `//` comments, a truncated last entity dropped.
 * @param {string} text
 */
export function parseEntities(text) {
  const out = [];
  let i = 0, cur = null, key = null;
  const n = text.length;
  while (i < n) {
    const c = text[i];
    if (c <= ' ') { i++; continue; }
    if (c === '/' && text[i + 1] === '/') { while (i < n && text[i] !== '\n') i++; continue; }
    if (c === '{') { cur = {}; key = null; i++; continue; }
    if (c === '}') { if (cur) out.push(cur); cur = null; i++; continue; }
    let tok;
    if (c === '"') { const e = text.indexOf('"', i + 1); if (e < 0) break; tok = text.slice(i + 1, e); i = e + 1; }
    else { const s = i; while (i < n && text[i] > ' ' && text[i] !== '"' && text[i] !== '{' && text[i] !== '}') i++; tok = text.slice(s, i); }
    if (!cur) continue;
    if (key === null) key = tok.toLowerCase(); else { cur[key] = tok; key = null; }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * The textures a texture lump names (`b`: the lump's bytes): [{ name (lower case), external }] — external: its pixels are
 * not in the map (the miptex's first offset 0), the engine reads them from a WAD. Each name once, in the lump's order.
 * @param {Uint8Array} b
 */
export function bspTextures(b) {
  if (b.length < 4) return [];
  const v = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.byteLength), n = v.getInt32(0, true), out = [], seen = new Set();
  if (!(n > 0) || 4 + n * 4 > b.length) return out;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const at = v.getInt32(4 + i * 4, true);
    if (at < 0 || at + 40 > b.length) continue; // (-1: a texture left out of the map)
    let name = '';
    for (let k = at; k < at + 16 && b[k]; k++) name += String.fromCharCode(b[k]);
    name = name.toLowerCase();
    if (!name || seen.has(name)) continue;
    seen.add(name);
    out.push({ name, external: v.getUint32(at + 24, true) === 0 });
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * The value the last statement of a console script (`text`: a .cfg / .rc file, a command line) gives the console variable
 * `cvar` — `cvar value` or `cvar "value"`, statements split by lines and `;` outside quotes, `//` comments skipped —, or
 * null when none does. The engine's own settings as it reads them: a page that cannot query its variables.
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {string} cvar
 */
export function configSetting(text, cvar) {
  let value = null;
  const want = cvar.toLowerCase();
  for (const line of String(text ?? '').split(/\r?\n/)) {
    let stmt = '', quoted = false;
    const statements = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
      const c = line[i];
      if (c === '"') quoted = !quoted;
      if (!quoted && c === '/' && line[i + 1] === '/') break;
      if (!quoted && c === ';') { statements.push(stmt); stmt = ''; continue; }
      stmt += c;
    }
    statements.push(stmt);
    for (const st of statements) {
      const m = /^\s*"?([^\s"]+)"?\s+(?:"([^"]*)"?|(\S+))/.exec(st);
      if (m && m[1].toLowerCase() === want) value = m[2] ?? m[3];
    }
  }
  return value;
}

/** A path as the engine writes it in a map: back slashes, a leading slash, blanks — its relative form, or ''. */
const relPath = (p) => String(p ?? '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\/+/, '');
/** A `wad` key's archive (a full path of the mapper's disk): its base name without extension, lower case. */
const wadName = (p) => relPath(p).split('/').pop().replace(/\.wad$/i, '').toLowerCase();

/** The adder of a list of reads: [{ h, off?, len? }], each once (a whole file, or an archive's lump). */
function readList() {
  const entries = [], seen = new Set();
  const add = (h, off, len) => {
    if (!h) return;
    const k = `${h.name}\n${h.path}\n${off ?? 0}\n${len ?? -1}`;
    if (seen.has(k)) return;
    seen.add(k); entries.push(off === undefined ? { h } : { h, off, len });
  };
  return { entries, add };
}

/**
 * The files a maps/<map>.res lists (`res` its text) that the game has (`find`, as for mapReads), of the kinds a map's load
 * reads — a WAD's lumps are its textures', the map is read already: [{ h }], each once.
 * @param {string} res
 * @param {(rel: string) => object | null} find
 */
export function resReads(res, find) {
  const { entries, add } = readList();
  for (const line of String(res ?? '').split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const r = relPath(line.replace(/\/\/.*$/, ''));
    if (!r || /\.(wad|bsp)$/i.test(r) || !/\.(mdl|spr|wav|tga|bmp|txt|nod)$/i.test(r)) continue;
    add(find(r));
  }
  return entries;
}

/**
 * What a map's load certainly reads, from its parsed lumps: [{ h, off?, len? }] (a whole file, or an archive's lump),
 * each once. `find(rel)`: the game file the engine finds at a path relative to its folders (a handle), or null;
 * `wad(name)`: the WAD the engine finds by that base name — { h, dir: Map(texture name → { pos, disk }) } its miptex
 * entries —, or null (not in the game, or its directory not known); `res`: maps/<map>.res's text, or null;
 * `wadTextures`: the engine's r_wadtextures is set — a texture the map holds is read from a WAD that has it (else from the
 * map: only the external ones announced); `server`: the page runs the map's server (its node graph and navigation mesh
 * read); `mapPrecache`: the paths, relative to the game folder, the game's server precaches at every map's load (its
 * clients load them too: announced whoever runs it).
 * @param {{ map: string, entities: object[], textures: { name: string, external: boolean }[],
 *   find: (rel: string) => object | null, wad: (name: string) => { h: object, dir: Map<string, { pos: number, disk: number }> } | null,
 *   res?: string | null, wadTextures?: boolean, server?: boolean, mapPrecache?: string[] }} o
 * @returns {{ entries: { h: object, off?: number, len?: number }[], textures: number, missing: number }}
 *   textures: the textures announced from a WAD; missing: the external ones not found (a WAD whose directory is not
 *   known, or not in the game — an embedded one is read from the map then)
 */
export function mapReads({ map, entities, textures, find, wad, res = null, wadTextures = false, server = false, mapPrecache = [] }) {
  const { entries, add } = readList();
  const file = (rel) => { const r = relPath(rel); if (r) add(find(r)); };
  const world = entities.find((e) => (e.classname ?? '').toLowerCase() === 'worldspawn') ?? entities[0] ?? {};
  // (the WADs the map names that the game has, in their order; a texture from the last one that has it)
  const wads = [], names = new Set();
  for (const p of String(world.wad ?? '').split(';')) {
    const name = wadName(p); if (!name || names.has(name)) continue;
    names.add(name);
    const w = wad(name); if (w) wads.push(w);
  }
  let found = 0, missing = 0;
  for (const t of textures) {
    if (!t.external && !wadTextures) continue;
    let hit = null;
    for (let j = wads.length - 1; j >= 0 && !hit; j--) { const e = wads[j].dir.get(t.name); if (e) hit = { h: wads[j].h, e }; }
    if (hit) { add(hit.h, hit.e.pos, hit.e.disk); found++; } else if (t.external) missing++;
  }
  // (the sky: a picture a side, TGA or else BMP)
  const sky = relPath(world.skyname);
  if (sky && !sky.includes('/')) for (const side of SKY_SIDES) { const base = `gfx/env/${sky}${side}`; add(find(base + '.tga') ?? find(base + '.bmp')); }
  // (the entities' models and sprites — a brush model, '*n', is the map's own —, and the ambient sounds)
  for (const e of entities) {
    if (/\.(mdl|spr)$/i.test(e.model ?? '')) file(e.model);
    const cls = (e.classname ?? '').toLowerCase(), snd = relPath(e.message);
    if (cls === 'ambient_generic' && /\.wav$/i.test(snd) && !snd.startsWith('!')) file(/^sound\//i.test(snd) ? snd : `sound/${snd}`);
  }
  // (beside the map: its node graph and its bots' navigation mesh — the server's —, its overview and the picture it
  // names, else its own name's)
  const m = relPath(map).toLowerCase();
  if (server) { file(`maps/graphs/${m}.nod`); file(`maps/${m}.nav`); }
  const ov = find(`overviews/${m}.txt`);
  if (ov) { add(ov); add(find(`overviews/${m}.bmp`) ?? find(`overviews/${m}.tga`)); }
  // (the map's own list: its files of those kinds)
  if (res) for (const e of resReads(res, find)) add(e.h);
  // (what the game's server precaches at every map's load, its release says — its clients load it: whoever runs it —,
  // after the map's own files)
  for (const rel of mapPrecache) file(rel);
  return { entries, textures: found, missing };
}

/**
 * The map loads of the engine's file system announced: each maps/<map>.bsp node among `nodes` (as phaseOnRead: an open
 * that has read half the file at least is a load, not a listing that reads its header and entities — which announces
 * nothing) parsed once its header, entity and texture lumps are in the page (GameData.peek — after the read that brought
 * them), and what that load reads announced (mapReads → GameData.want, label 'textures:<map>', wait false). The WADs'
 * directories are parsed as the engine reads them (each .wad node's reads: at its mount, while those pieces are certainly
 * in the page — the page's pieces are a cache a long session evicts). maps/<map>.res, when the game has one and the page
 * has not its text, is announced with the load (label 'res:<map>') and fetched in the background (GameData.ensure: the
 * announced request joined — not learned as a read, nor reported as used: peek), its entries announced as a second list
 * once it is here. Returns how many map files are watched.
 * @param {object} FS the engine's FS
 * @param {Iterable<object>} nodes the game's file nodes (mountFiles)
 * @param {import('../../vfs/data-client.js').GameData} data
 * @param {{ name: string, files: { path: string, at?: string }[], root: string, gameDir: string, log?: (text: string) => void,
 *   wadTextures?: () => boolean, server?: () => boolean, mapPrecache?: string[], announced?: (map: string) => void }} o
 *   files: the game's files as the engine sees them (languageFiles: `at` where a language's file goes); root: where they
 *   are mounted; gameDir: the game's folder (searched first); wadTextures: the engine's r_wadtextures is set now (default
 *   false: the external textures only); server: the page certainly runs the map's server now (default false); mapPrecache:
 *   what the game's server precaches at every map's load (mapReads); announced:
 *   told after each load's announce (outside the engine's read: a task of its own)
 */
export function announceMapLoads(FS, nodes, data, o) {
  const log = o.log ?? (() => {}), root = o.root.replace(/\/+$/, '') + '/', gameDir = String(o.gameDir ?? '').toLowerCase();
  // (the engine's view: lower-case path → the version's path; its folders, the game's first)
  const byAt = new Map(), dirs = [];
  for (const f of o.files) {
    const at = (f.at ?? f.path).toLowerCase(); byAt.set(at, f.path);
    const top = at.split('/')[0]; if (at.includes('/') && !dirs.includes(top)) dirs.push(top);
  }
  dirs.sort((a, b) => (b === gameDir) - (a === gameDir));
  const handle = (at) => { const p = byAt.get(at); return p === undefined ? null : data.file(o.name, p); };
  const find = (rel) => { const r = rel.toLowerCase(); for (const d of dirs) { const h = handle(`${d}/${r}`); if (h) return h; } return null; };
  // (each WAD's miptex directory — by its path —, parsed from the page's pieces once they hold it)
  const dirs3 = new Map();
  const wadDir = (h) => {
    let d = dirs3.get(h.path);
    if (d) return d;
    const head = data.peek(h, 0, 12), hd = head && wadHeader(head, h.size);
    const bytes = hd && data.peek(h, hd.dir, hd.n * WAD_ENTRY);
    if (!bytes) return null;
    d = new Map();
    for (const e of wadEntries(bytes, hd.n, h.size)) if (e.type === WAD_MIPTEX && !d.has(e.name)) d.set(e.name, { pos: e.pos, disk: e.disk });
    dirs3.set(h.path, d);
    return d;
  };
  const wad = (name) => { const h = find(`${name}.wad`), d = h && wadDir(h); return d ? { h, dir: d } : null; };
  const text = (b) => new TextDecoder('latin1').decode(b);
  /** maps/<map>.res's entries announced once its text is fetched (in the background: nothing waits for it). */
  const announceRes = (map, resH) => {
    const label = `res:${map.slice(0, LABEL_MAP)}`;
    data.want([{ h: resH }], { label, wait: false });
    data.ensure(resH, 0, resH.size, true).then(() => {
      const b = data.peek(resH, 0, resH.size); if (!b) return;
      const list = resReads(text(b), find), n = list.length ? data.want(list, { label, wait: false }) : 0;
      log(`Map ${map}: ${n} of ${list.length} reads of its .res announced`);
    }, (e) => log(`Map ${map}: ${resH.path} not read (${e?.message ?? e})`));
  };
  /** The load of map `map` (`h` its .bsp): announced when its lumps are in the page — true once done or impossible. */
  const announce = (map, h) => {
    const head = data.peek(h, 0, BSP_HEADER); if (!head) return false;
    const lumps = bspLumps(head, h.size); if (!lumps) return true;
    const l0 = data.peek(h, lumps[0].off, lumps[0].len), l1 = data.peek(h, lumps[1].off, lumps[1].len), tex = data.peek(h, lumps[2].off, lumps[2].len);
    const ents = looksLikeEntities(l0) ? l0 : looksLikeEntities(l1) ? l1 : null;
    if (!ents || !tex) return false;
    const resH = find(`maps/${map}.res`), resB = resH && data.peek(resH, 0, resH.size);
    // (its .res first, small: its entries' list sooner)
    if (resH && !resB) announceRes(map, resH);
    const wadTextures = !!o.wadTextures?.(), server = !!o.server?.();
    const r = mapReads({ map, entities: parseEntities(text(ents)), textures: bspTextures(tex), find, wad, res: resB ? text(resB) : null, wadTextures, server, mapPrecache: o.mapPrecache ?? [] });
    const n = r.entries.length ? data.want(r.entries, { label: `textures:${map.slice(0, LABEL_MAP)}`, wait: false }) : 0;
    log(`Map ${map}: ${n} of ${r.entries.length} reads announced (${r.textures} textures from WADs${r.missing ? `, ${r.missing} not found` : ''}${wadTextures ? ', r_wadtextures' : ''}${server ? ', its server' : ''})`);
    if (o.announced) setTimeout(() => o.announced(map), 0);
    return true;
  };
  let watched = 0;
  for (const node of nodes) {
    const path = FS.getPath(node); if (!path.startsWith(root)) continue;
    const at = path.slice(root.length).toLowerCase();
    // (a WAD: its directory parsed after the engine's reads of it, until it is)
    if (at.endsWith('.wad')) {
      const h = handle(at); if (!h) continue;
      const ops = node.stream_ops, read = ops.read;
      node.stream_ops = { ...ops, read(stream, buffer, offset, length, position) {
        const n = read(stream, buffer, offset, length, position);
        if (!dirs3.has(h.path)) { try { wadDir(h); } catch { /* not a WAD3: the engine says so */ } }
        return n;
      } };
      continue;
    }
    const map = /\/maps\/([^/]+)\.bsp$/i.exec(path)?.[1].toLowerCase(); if (!map) continue;
    const h = handle(at); if (!h) continue;
    const ops = node.stream_ops, read = ops.read, size = node.usedBytes;
    node.stream_ops = { ...ops, read(stream, buffer, offset, length, position) {
      const n = read(stream, buffer, offset, length, position);
      stream.orthrosMapRead = (stream.orthrosMapRead ?? 0) + Math.max(0, n);
      if (!stream.orthrosAnnounced && stream.orthrosMapRead * 2 >= size) {
        try { stream.orthrosAnnounced = announce(map, h); } catch (e) { stream.orthrosAnnounced = true; log(`Map ${map}: not announced (${e?.message ?? e})`); }
      }
      return n;
    } };
    watched++;
  }
  return watched;
}
```
