```js
/**
 * A map's picture as a small image for the lobby: the game's overview drawn smaller, its keyed colour (pure green, which
 * the game shows as transparent) turned into the panel's dark; kept for the page's life. Null when there is none.
 */
const thumbs = new Map();
export function mapThumb(name, map, w = 240) {
  const key = `${name}/${map}/${w}`;
  if (!thumbs.has(key)) thumbs.set(key, new Promise((resolve) => {
    const img = new Image(); img.decoding = 'async';
    img.onload = () => {
      try {
        // (the key replaced at full size, before smoothing blends it into its neighbours: no green fringe)
        const W = img.naturalWidth, H = img.naturalHeight, full = document.createElement('canvas'); full.width = W; full.height = H;
        const f = full.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true }); f.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
        const px = f.getImageData(0, 0, W, H), d = px.data;
        for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i + 1] > 230 && d[i] < 40 && d[i + 2] < 40) { d[i] = 22; d[i + 1] = 24; d[i + 2] = 30; }
        f.putImageData(px, 0, 0);
        const h = Math.round(w * H / Math.max(1, W)), c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h;
        const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high'; g.drawImage(full, 0, 0, w, h);
        resolve(c.toDataURL('image/webp', 0.85));
      } catch { thumbs.delete(key); resolve(null); }
    };
    img.onerror = () => { thumbs.delete(key); resolve(null); }; // (tried again next time)
    img.src = `/api/map-image/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/${encodeURIComponent(map)}`;
  }));
  return thumbs.get(key);
}

/**
 * The maps by group (multiplayer.mapGroups, in their order, then the others under `group: null`), each group's maps
 * sorted: a map goes to the first group naming it in `maps`, else to the first with one of its `prefix`es (any case).
 * Groups left empty are dropped.
 */
export function groupMaps(maps, groups = []) {
  const low = (v) => String(v).toLowerCase();
  const of = (m) => {
    const named = groups.findIndex((g) => (g.maps ?? []).some((n) => low(n) === low(m)));
    return named >= 0 ? named : groups.findIndex((g) => [g.prefix ?? []].flat().some((p) => low(m).startsWith(low(p))));
  };
  const sections = groups.map((group) => ({ group, maps: [] })), rest = { group: null, maps: [] };
  for (const m of maps) { const i = of(m); (i >= 0 ? sections[i] : rest).maps.push(m); }
  const byName = (a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, 'en', { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
  return [...sections, rest].filter((s) => s.maps.length).map((s) => ({ ...s, maps: s.maps.sort(byName) }));
}

/** The address the page's engine reaches a room at: the relay routes it (play.js Relay). */
export const roomAddress = (index) => `10.87.0.${index + 1}:27015`;

const el = (tag, props = {}, ...children) => {
  const e = document.createElement(tag);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(props)) { if (k === 'class') e.className = v; else if (k.startsWith('on')) e.addEventListener(k.slice(2), v); else if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== false) e.setAttribute(k, v === true ? '' : v); }
  for (const c of children.flat()) if (c !== null && c !== undefined && c !== false) e.append(c);
  return e;
};

/**
 * The lobby of a version: `onJoin(room)` when the player joins one; `nickname()` the player's name (the default game
 * name); `signedIn()` whether an Orthros account is signed in — multiplayer is for signed-in players: joining or
 * creating without one calls `needAccount()` instead. Returns its element and what shows, hides and refreshes it.
 */
export function createLobby({ name, lang, onJoin, nickname, signedIn = () => true, needAccount = () => {}, log = () => {} }) {
  const S = STRINGS[lang] ?? STRINGS.en;
  const label = (l) => (typeof l === 'string' ? l : l?.[lang] ?? l?.en ?? Object.values(l ?? {})[0] ?? '');
  const list = el('ul', { class: 'lb-rooms' }), note = el('p', { class: 'lb-note' }), online = el('span', { class: 'lb-online' });
  const nameInput = el('input', { id: `lb-name-${name}`, maxlength: '32', required: true, autocomplete: 'off', spellcheck: 'false' });
  const mapsGrid = el('div', { class: 'lb-maps', role: 'listbox', 'aria-label': S.map }), mapsCount = el('span', { class: 'lb-count' });
  const chips = el('div', { class: 'lb-chips hidden', role: 'radiogroup', 'aria-label': S.map });
  const settings = el('div', { class: 'lb-settings' }), message = el('p', { class: 'lb-msg', role: 'status', id: `lb-msg-${name}` });
  const nameError = el('p', { class: 'lb-fielderr hidden', id: `lb-nameerr-${name}` });
  const submit = el('button', { type: 'submit', class: 'primary' }, S.submit);
  // (the chosen map, large, and the game as it will be)
  const previewImgs = el('div', { class: 'lb-pv-imgs' }), previewNoImg = el('span', { class: 'lb-noimg' });
  const previewBadge = el('span', { class: 'lb-badge hidden' }), previewName = el('b', { class: 'lb-pv-name' }), previewMap = el('span', { class: 'lb-pv-map' });
  const previewDesc = el('p', { class: 'lb-pv-desc hidden' }), summary = el('dl', { class: 'lb-summary' }), slots = el('div', { class: 'lb-slots', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }), slotsText = el('p', { class: 'lb-slotstext' });
  const heading = (n, text, ...extra) => el('h4', { class: 'lb-step-title' }, el('span', { class: 'lb-num', 'aria-hidden': 'true' }, String(n)), text, ...extra);
  const form = el('form', { class: 'lb-create hidden', 'aria-labelledby': `lb-title-${name}` },
    el('div', { class: 'lb-formhead' }, el('h4', { id: `lb-title-${name}` }, S.createTitle), el('p', {}, S.createLead)),
    el('div', { class: 'lb-main' },
      el('section', { class: 'lb-sec lb-namesec' }, heading(1, el('label', { for: nameInput.id }, S.stepName)), nameInput, nameError),
      el('section', { class: 'lb-sec lb-mapsec' }, heading(2, S.stepMap, mapsCount), chips, mapsGrid),
      el('section', { class: 'lb-sec lb-rulesec' }, heading(3, S.stepRules), settings)),
    el('aside', { class: 'lb-side' },
      el('div', { class: 'lb-ticket' },
        el('div', { class: 'lb-preview' }, previewNoImg, previewImgs, previewBadge, el('div', { class: 'lb-pv-caption' }, previewName, previewMap)),
        previewDesc,
        el('div', { class: 'lb-sumhead' }, S.summary),
        summary, slots, slotsText)),
    // (the buttons below the form, kept in view while it scrolls)
    el('div', { class: 'lb-actions' }, message, el('div', { class: 'lb-buttons' }, el('button', { type: 'button', class: 'lb-cancel', onclick: () => toggleForm(false) }, S.cancel), submit)));
  const createButton = el('button', { type: 'button', class: 'lb-new', onclick: () => toggleForm(true) }, S.create);
  const root = el('section', { class: 'lobby' }, el('header', {}, el('h3', {}, S.title), online, createButton), form, list, note);
  let data = null, timer = null, busy = false, filled = false;
  // (the form's choices)
  const choice = { map: null, maxPlayers: 10, bots: 0, options: {} };
  const steppers = {}, segments = {};
  let groupOf = () => null; // (a map's group, once the maps are known)

  function toggleForm(open) {
    if (open && !signedIn()) { needAccount(); return; }
    const was = !form.classList.contains('hidden');
    form.classList.toggle('hidden', !open); createButton.classList.toggle('hidden', open); root.classList.toggle('creating', open); clearError();
    if (open) {
      if (!nameInput.value) nameInput.value = S.defaultName(nickname()).slice(0, 32);
      syncSummary();
      root.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
      nameInput.focus({ preventScroll: true }); nameInput.select();
      showChosen();
    } else if (was) createButton.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }
  /**
   * The chosen map's card scrolled into the maps' view, below its group's title (the maps' scroll-padding-top) — its
   * group from the top when the card shows so. (Offsets: the maps' box is the cards' offset parent.)
   */
  function showChosen() {
    const chosen = mapsGrid.querySelector('.lb-map[aria-selected="true"]'), group = chosen?.closest('.lb-group'); if (!chosen || group.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
    const pad = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(mapsGrid).scrollPaddingTop) || 0;
    mapsGrid.scrollTop = Math.max(0, chosen.offsetTop + chosen.offsetHeight - group.offsetTop <= mapsGrid.clientHeight ? group.offsetTop : chosen.offsetTop - pad);
  }
  /** The form closed (Escape: the overlay's own handler asks first). True when it showed. */
  function closeForm() {
    if (form.classList.contains('hidden')) return false;
    if (!busy) toggleForm(false);
    return true;
  }
  form.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => { if (event.key === 'Escape') { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); closeForm(); } });
  nameInput.addEventListener('input', () => { if (nameInput.hasAttribute('aria-invalid')) clearError(); syncSummary(); });

  /** An error the server returned: below the buttons, and on its field when it has one (marked, described, focused). */
  function showError(text, field) {
    message.textContent = text; message.classList.add('error');
    const control = field === 'name' || field === 'taken' ? nameInput : field === 'map' ? mapsGrid.querySelector('.lb-map[tabindex="0"]')
      : field === 'bots' || field === 'maxPlayers' ? settings.querySelector('.lb-step button:not(:disabled)') : null;
    if (!control) return;
    control.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true'); control.setAttribute('aria-describedby', control === nameInput ? nameError.id : message.id);
    if (control === nameInput) { nameError.textContent = text; nameError.classList.remove('hidden'); }
    control.focus();
  }
  function clearError() {
    message.textContent = ''; message.classList.remove('error'); nameError.classList.add('hidden');
    for (const c of form.querySelectorAll('[aria-invalid]')) { c.removeAttribute('aria-invalid'); c.removeAttribute('aria-describedby'); }
  }

  /** A number chosen with − and +, within [min(), max()]. */
  function stepper(key, title, min, max) {
    const value = el('output', { 'aria-live': 'polite' }), minus = el('button', { type: 'button', 'aria-label': `${title} ${S.less}` }, '−'), plus = el('button', { type: 'button', 'aria-label': `${title} ${S.more}` }, '+');
    const sync = () => { choice[key] = Math.min(max(), Math.max(min(), choice[key])); value.textContent = key === 'bots' && !choice.bots ? S.none : String(choice[key]); minus.disabled = choice[key] <= min(); plus.disabled = choice[key] >= max(); };
    minus.onclick = () => { choice[key]--; syncAll(); }; plus.onclick = () => { choice[key]++; syncAll(); };
    steppers[key] = sync;
    return el('div', { class: 'lb-row lb-steprow' }, el('span', { class: 'lb-label' }, title), el('div', { class: 'lb-step', role: 'group', 'aria-label': title }, minus, value, plus));
  }
  /** One of an option's choices, as buttons side by side. */
  function segmented(option) {
    const row = el('div', { class: 'lb-seg', role: 'radiogroup', 'aria-label': label(option.label), style: `--n: ${option.choices.length}` });
    for (const c of option.choices) row.append(el('button', { type: 'button', role: 'radio', 'data-id': c.id, title: label(c.label), onclick: () => { choice.options[option.id] = c.id; syncAll(); } }, label(c.label)));
    arrows(row, () => [...row.children], (b) => { choice.options[option.id] = b.dataset.id; syncAll(); });
    const field = el('div', { class: 'lb-row' + (option.choices.length > 3 ? ' wide' : '') }, el('span', { class: 'lb-label' }, label(option.label)), row);
    segments[option.id] = () => {
      field.classList.toggle('hidden', !!option.bots && !choice.bots);
      for (const b of row.children) { const on = b.dataset.id === choice.options[option.id]; b.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(on)); b.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1; }
    };
    return field;
  }
  function syncAll() {
    if (message.classList.contains('error')) clearError();
    for (const f of Object.values(steppers)) f();
    for (const f of Object.values(segments)) f();
    steppers.maxPlayers?.(); // (the bots' maximum depends on the size, and the other way)
    syncSummary();
  }
  /** The summary beside the form: the game's name over its map, its size, bots and options. */
  function syncSummary() {
    previewName.textContent = nameInput.value.trim() || S.noName;
    const group = groupOf(choice.map);
    previewMap.textContent = choice.map ?? '';
    previewBadge.replaceChildren(...badgeContent(group, true)); previewBadge.classList.toggle('hidden', !group);
    previewDesc.textContent = group?.description ? label(group.description) : ''; previewDesc.classList.toggle('hidden', !group?.description);
    const rows = [[S.size, String(choice.maxPlayers)]];
    if (data?.bots) rows.push([S.botsLabel, choice.bots ? String(choice.bots) : S.none]);
    for (const o of data?.options ?? []) {
      if (o.bots && !choice.bots) continue;
      rows.push([label(o.label), label(o.choices.find((c) => c.id === choice.options[o.id])?.label)]);
    }
    summary.replaceChildren(...rows.map(([k, v]) => el('div', {}, el('dt', {}, k), el('dd', {}, v))));
    const free = Math.max(0, choice.maxPlayers - choice.bots);
    slots.replaceChildren(...Array.from({ length: choice.maxPlayers }, (_, i) => el('i', { class: i < free ? 'free' : 'bot' })));
    slotsText.textContent = S.slots(free, choice.bots);
  }
  /** A group's badge: its icon and its short label (or its label). */
  const badgeContent = (group, long = false) => (group ? [group.icon ? el('span', { class: 'lb-icon' }, group.icon) : null, label(long ? group.label : group.short ?? group.label)] : []);
  /**
   * The chosen map's picture: the card's (already drawn) at once, then the larger one, each faded in over the previous
   * map's, which stays until then; its name over a pattern only when it has no picture.
   */
  let previewFor = null, previewWidth = 0;
  function showPreview(map) {
    previewFor = map; previewWidth = 0; previewNoImg.textContent = map.replace(/^[a-z]+_/, '');
    if (!data?.mapImages) { previewImgs.replaceChildren(); return; }
    let failed = 0;
    for (const w of [240, 640]) mapThumb(name, map, w).then((url) => {
      if (previewFor !== map) return;
      if (!url) { if (++failed === 2) previewImgs.replaceChildren(); return; }
      if (w < previewWidth) return;
      previewWidth = w;
      const img = el('img', { src: url, alt: '', draggable: 'false' }); previewImgs.append(img);
      setTimeout(() => { if (img.isConnected) while (previewImgs.firstChild !== img) previewImgs.firstChild.remove(); }, 400); // (after its fade)
    });
  }
  function pickMap(map) {
    choice.map = map;
    for (const card of mapsGrid.querySelectorAll('.lb-map')) { card.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(card.dataset.map === map)); card.tabIndex = card.dataset.map === map ? 0 : -1; }
    if (previewFor !== map) showPreview(map);
    if (message.classList.contains('error')) clearError();
    syncSummary();
  }
  /**
   * Arrows, Home and End move the choice within a group (one Tab stop each: the chosen element). In a grid (`grid`),
   * up and down go to the nearest element of the row above or below, as drawn (rows broken by the groups' titles).
   */
  function arrows(container, items, pick, grid = false) {
    container.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      const list = items(), i = list.indexOf(document.activeElement); if (i < 0) return;
      let next;
      if (grid && (event.key === 'ArrowDown' || event.key === 'ArrowUp')) next = nearestRow(list, list[i], event.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1);
      else {
        const step = { ArrowRight: 1, ArrowLeft: -1, ArrowDown: 1, ArrowUp: -1, Home: -Infinity, End: Infinity }[event.key];
        if (step === undefined) return;
        next = list[Math.max(0, Math.min(list.length - 1, i + step))];
      }
      event.preventDefault();
      pick(next); next.focus(); next.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
    });
  }
  function nearestRow(list, from, dir) {
    const r = from.getBoundingClientRect(), cx = r.left + r.width / 2;
    const boxes = list.map((e) => [e, e.getBoundingClientRect()]).filter(([, b]) => (dir > 0 ? b.top >= r.bottom - 2 : b.bottom <= r.top + 2));
    if (!boxes.length) return from;
    const top = dir > 0 ? Math.min(...boxes.map(([, b]) => b.top)) : Math.max(...boxes.map(([, b]) => b.top));
    const row = boxes.filter(([, b]) => Math.abs(b.top - top) < 2);
    return row.reduce((best, cur) => (Math.abs(cur[1].left + cur[1].width / 2 - cx) < Math.abs(best[1].left + best[1].width / 2 - cx) ? cur : best))[0];
  }
  const visibleCards = () => [...mapsGrid.querySelectorAll('.lb-map')].filter((c) => !c.closest('.lb-group.hidden'));
  arrows(mapsGrid, visibleCards, (card) => pickMap(card.dataset.map), true);

  function fillForm() {
    if (filled || !data?.maps?.length) return;
    filled = true;
    mapsCount.textContent = S.maps(data.maps.length);
    const sections = groupMaps(data.maps, data.mapGroups ?? []), grouped = sections.some((s) => s.group);
    const mapGroup = new Map(sections.flatMap((s) => s.maps.map((m) => [m, s.group])));
    groupOf = (m) => mapGroup.get(m) ?? null;
    // (a card a map: its picture when the version has them, its name over a pattern otherwise or when it fails)
    // (the pictures when a card comes into view: a few hundred kilobytes each)
    const seen = data.mapImages && 'IntersectionObserver' in window ? new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      for (const e of entries) {
        if (!e.isIntersecting) continue;
        seen.unobserve(e.target);
        mapThumb(name, e.target.dataset.map).then((url) => { if (url) e.target.prepend(el('img', { src: url, alt: '', draggable: 'false' })); else setTimeout(() => seen.observe(e.target), 15000); });
      }
    }, { rootMargin: '120px', scrollMargin: '120px' }) : null; // (in the window, as the maps' box and the page's clip them)
    // (a section a group, its title above its cards; the others last. Without groups, the cards alone)
    const groupEls = sections.map((s, n) => {
      const cards = s.maps.map((m) => {
        const card = el('button', { type: 'button', class: 'lb-map', role: 'option', 'data-map': m, title: m, onclick: () => pickMap(m) },
          el('span', { class: 'lb-noimg' }, m.replace(/^[a-z]+_/, '')), s.group ? el('span', { class: 'lb-badge' }, ...badgeContent(s.group)) : null, el('span', { class: 'lb-mapname' }, m));
        seen?.observe(card);
        return card;
      });
      const id = `lb-g-${name}-${n}`;
      return el('div', { class: 'lb-group', role: 'group', 'aria-labelledby': grouped ? id : undefined, 'data-group': s.group?.id ?? '' },
        grouped ? el('div', { class: 'lb-grouptitle', id }, s.group?.icon ? el('span', { class: 'lb-icon' }, s.group.icon) : null, el('span', {}, s.group ? label(s.group.label) : S.other), el('span', { class: 'lb-count' }, String(s.maps.length))) : null,
        el('div', { class: 'lb-cards' }, ...cards));
    });
    mapsGrid.append(...groupEls);
    // (the groups as filters above the maps: all, or one)
    if (grouped) {
      const filter = (id) => {
        for (const g of groupEls) g.classList.toggle('hidden', id !== null && g.dataset.group !== id);
        for (const c of chips.children) { const on = c.dataset.group === (id ?? '*'); c.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(on)); c.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1; }
        mapsGrid.scrollTop = 0;
        // (one Tab stop in the maps still: the chosen one, else the first shown)
        for (const c of mapsGrid.querySelectorAll('.lb-map')) c.tabIndex = c.dataset.map === choice.map ? 0 : -1;
        const shown = visibleCards(); if (shown.length && !shown.some((c) => c.tabIndex === 0)) shown[0].tabIndex = 0;
      };
      const chip = (id, text, count, icon) => el('button', { type: 'button', class: 'lb-chip', role: 'radio', 'data-group': id, 'aria-checked': 'false', onclick: () => filter(id === '*' ? null : id) },
        icon ? el('span', { class: 'lb-icon' }, icon) : null, text, el('span', { class: 'lb-count' }, String(count)));
      chips.append(chip('*', S.all, data.maps.length), ...sections.map((s) => chip(s.group?.id ?? '', s.group ? label(s.group.label) : S.other, s.maps.length, s.group?.icon)));
      arrows(chips, () => [...chips.children], (c) => filter(c.dataset.group === '*' ? null : c.dataset.group));
      chips.classList.remove('hidden'); filter(null);
    }
    const first = data.rooms?.find((r) => r.permanent)?.map;
    pickMap(data.maps.includes(first) ? first : sections[0].maps[0]);
    const maxPlayers = data.maxPlayers ?? 16;
    choice.maxPlayers = Math.min(10, maxPlayers); choice.bots = data.bots ? Math.min(4, data.bots.max) : 0;
    const counts = el('div', { class: 'lb-counts' }, stepper('maxPlayers', S.size, () => Math.max(2, choice.bots + 1), () => maxPlayers));
    if (data.bots) counts.append(stepper('bots', S.botsLabel, () => 0, () => Math.min(data.bots.max, choice.maxPlayers - 1)));
    settings.append(counts);
    for (const o of data.options ?? []) { choice.options[o.id] = o.default; settings.append(segmented(o)); }
    syncAll();
  }

  // (the rooms this browser created: their keys, kept to close them — index -> { key, since })
  const keysName = `orthros-rooms:${name}`;
  const keys = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(keysName) ?? '{}') ?? {}; } catch { return {}; } };
  const saveKeys = (k) => { try { localStorage.setItem(keysName, JSON.stringify(k)); } catch { /* private mode: not kept */ } };
  let closeFailedAt = 0; const closingNow = new Set(); // (rooms whose closing this page sent: their button stays disabled)
  const keyOf = (r) => { const k = keys()[r.index]; return k && k.since === r.since ? k.key : null; };
  async function closeRoom(r, button) {
    const key = keyOf(r); if (!key || !confirm(S.closeConfirm(r.name))) return;
    if (closingNow.has(r.index)) return;
    closingNow.add(r.index); button.disabled = true; button.textContent = S.closing;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/rooms/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/${r.index}`, { method: 'DELETE', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ key }) });
      if (res.status !== 200 && res.status !== 404) throw new Error(String(res.status));
      const k = keys(); delete k[r.index]; saveKeys(k);
    } catch (error) { log('Lobby: closing ' + error.message); closeFailedAt = Date.now(); }
    closingNow.delete(r.index);
    await refresh();
  }

  /** The room's shown settings (its options with `show`), by their labels. */
  const shownOptions = (r) => (data?.options ?? []).filter((o) => o.show && (!o.bots || r.bots > 0) && r.options?.[o.id]).map((o) => label(o.choices.find((c) => c.id === r.options[o.id])?.label));
  function render() {
    const rooms = data?.rooms ?? [];
    const humans = rooms.reduce((t, r) => t + r.humans, 0);
    online.textContent = humans ? S.online(humans) : '';
    createButton.classList.toggle('hidden', !data?.creatable || !form.classList.contains('hidden'));
    note.textContent = data?.offline ? S.offline : Date.now() - closeFailedAt < 8000 ? S.closeFailed : !rooms.length ? S.empty : '';
    list.replaceChildren(...rooms.map((r) => {
      const full = r.players >= r.maxPlayers;
      const meta = [r.map, S.players(r.players, r.maxPlayers), r.bots ? S.bots(r.bots) : null, ...shownOptions(r), r.permanent ? S.permanent : S.since(Math.floor((Date.now() - r.since) / 60000))].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
      const thumb = data?.mapImages ? el('span', { class: 'thumb' }) : null;
      if (thumb) mapThumb(name, r.map).then((url) => { if (url) thumb.style.backgroundImage = `url(${url})`; });
      const mine = !r.permanent && !!keyOf(r);
      const close = mine ? el('button', { type: 'button', class: 'end', disabled: !!r.closing || closingNow.has(r.index), title: S.close, onclick: (e) => closeRoom(r, e.currentTarget) }, r.closing || closingNow.has(r.index) ? S.closing : S.close) : null;
      return el('li', { class: 'room' + (r.permanent ? ' permanent' : '') + (mine ? ' mine' : '') }, thumb,
        el('div', { class: 'info' }, el('b', {}, r.name), el('span', {}, mine ? `${S.mine} · ${meta}` : meta)), close,
        el('button', { type: 'button', class: 'join', disabled: full || !r.up, onclick: () => (signedIn() ? onJoin(r) : needAccount()) }, r.closing ? S.closing : !r.up ? S.starting : full ? S.full : S.join));
    }));
    // (the keys of rooms gone: forgotten)
    if (data && !data.offline && Array.isArray(data.rooms)) {
      const k = keys(), live = new Set(rooms.map((r) => `${r.index}:${r.since}`));
      const kept = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(k).filter(([i, v]) => live.has(`${i}:${v?.since}`)));
      if (Object.keys(kept).length !== Object.keys(k).length) saveKeys(kept);
    }
  }
  async function refresh() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/rooms/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
      data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || !Array.isArray(data?.rooms)) data = { rooms: [], maps: [], offline: true };
    }
    catch (error) { log('Lobby: ' + error.message); data = { rooms: [], maps: [], offline: true }; }
    try { fillForm(); } finally { render(); }
  }
  form.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault(); if (busy) return;
    clearError(); busy = true; submit.disabled = true; message.textContent = S.creating;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/rooms/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: nameInput.value, map: choice.map, maxPlayers: choice.maxPlayers, bots: choice.bots, options: choice.options }) });
      const out = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (res.status !== 201) {
        const here = out.error === 'owned' && (data?.rooms ?? []).some((r) => !r.permanent && keyOf(r));
        showError((here ? S.errors.ownedHere : S.errors[out.error]) ?? S.errors.start, out.error); return;
      }
      if (out.key && out.room) saveKeys({ ...keys(), [out.room.index]: { key: out.key, since: out.room.since } });
      toggleForm(false); await refresh(); onJoin(out.room);
    } catch { showError(S.errors.offline); }
    finally { busy = false; submit.disabled = false; }
  });

  return {
    el: root,
    /** Shown: refreshed now and every 4 s. */
    show() { refresh(); clearInterval(timer); timer = setInterval(refresh, 4000); },
    hide() { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; },
    refresh,
    closeForm,
    get rooms() { return data?.rooms ?? []; },
  };
}
```

```js
window.portSession = session;
let shell = null, cloud = null;
// Async asset loading outlives the original click. Resume the engine's audio on the next user gesture.
const audioContexts = new Set(), NativeAudioContext = globalThis.AudioContext;
if (NativeAudioContext) globalThis.AudioContext = class extends NativeAudioContext {
  constructor(...args) { super(...args); audioContexts.add(this); }
};
// (the engine's output measured: its level the last seconds, for the "sound blocked" hint and the session's report)
const audioMeter = { peak: 0, heard: 0 };
const NativeConnect = AudioNode.prototype.connect;
AudioNode.prototype.connect = function (target, ...rest) {
  if (target instanceof AudioDestinationNode && !target.context.__meter) {
    const meter = target.context.__meter = target.context.createAnalyser(); meter.fftSize = 1024;
    NativeConnect.call(this, meter);
  } else if (target instanceof AudioDestinationNode) NativeConnect.call(this, target.context.__meter);
  return NativeConnect.call(this, target, ...rest);
};

  const buf = new Float32Array(1024); let peak = 0;
  for (const context of audioContexts) { if (!context.__meter) continue; context.__meter.getFloatTimeDomainData(buf); for (const v of buf) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(v)); }

}, 250);

}

  log(`Page error: ${event.message}`); report('error', { message: String(event.message).slice(0, 300), where: 'page' });
});
window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', event => { log(`Unhandled: ${event.reason?.message ?? event.reason}`); report('error', { message: String(event.reason?.message ?? event.reason).slice(0, 300), where: 'promise' }); });

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- what the server learns of a session (/api/telemetry)
// (its start, its errors with the end of the engine's log, its end with its length and frame rate; a few a session)
/** the passive session record (perf-page.js: every 2 min of play and at the end, docs/real-machine-bench.md) */
let perfRecord = null;
/** the browser's storage of the game data: persistent asked at the start, its state in the telemetry (storage-persist.js) */
const storage = pageStorage();
const telemetry = portEvents({ port: 'goldsrc', state: () => session.state, storage, bench: params.get('benchrun') });
const report = (event, data) => telemetry.report(event, data);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the loading screen and passing messages
const toast = (text, ms = 5000) => shell?.toast(text, ms);
/** A status line: in the loading screen while it shows, then as a passing message over the game. */
const status = (text, error = false) => shell?.phase(text, error);
/** The start's steps (engine, files, game), each weighing its usual share of the wait; never going back. */
const progress = { weights: { engine: 0.2, files: 0.6, game: 0.2 }, parts: {} };
function step(k, state, value = '', fraction = undefined) {
  shell.step(k, state, value);
  progress.parts[k] = state === 'skip' ? null : fraction ?? (state === 'done' ? 1 : progress.parts[k] ?? 0);
  let weight = 0, done = 0;
  for (const [key, f] of Object.entries(progress.parts)) if (f !== null) { weight += progress.weights[key]; done += progress.weights[key] * f; }
  shell.progress(weight ? done / weight * 100 : 0);
}
function hideLoader() {
  if (!shell || shell.loader.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
  shell.hideLoader();
  shell.running = true; shell.watchPointer(document);
  gameData?.mark('playable'); // (the game shown: what it read until now is its launch set, src/vfs/launch-set.js)
  status(S.running);
  if (lobbyOverlay.classList.contains('hidden')) lobby?.hide();
}
const fail = error => {
  const crashed = !!engine; // (an engine that ran: its saves are kept, a new start reloads the page — a stopped engine cannot start again)
  session.state = 'error'; shell?.showLoader(); status(S.failed + (error.message ?? error), true); log(error.stack ?? error);
  report('crash', { message: String(error.message ?? error).slice(0, 300), crashed, log: logs.slice(-30).map((l) => l.slice(0, 200)) });
  relay?.close(); if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
  if (shell) shell.choices.replaceChildren(Object.assign(document.createElement('div'), { className: 'acts' }));
  const again = document.createElement('button'); again.type = 'button'; again.className = 'primary'; again.textContent = S.restart; again.onclick = () => location.reload();
  shell?.choices.querySelector('.acts')?.append(again);
  if (crashed) save().then(() => cloud?.push()).catch((e) => log('Profile save failed: ' + e.message));
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the game's place: the window under the header
// (SDL sizes the game's screen to the canvas' size on the page: the game renders at the size it is shown, without
// bars; a mouse position maps one to one)
function fit() {
  const stage = $('stage'), canvas = $('canvas'), w = Math.max(320, stage.clientWidth), h = Math.max(240, stage.clientHeight);
  if (canvas.style.width === w + 'px' && canvas.style.height === h + 'px') return;
  canvas.style.width = w + 'px'; canvas.style.height = h + 'px';
  // (SDL measures it again at the window's resize only: the header hidden or shown changes none)
  if (session.state === 'running') queueMicrotask(() => dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')));
}
addEventListener('resize', fit);
document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', fit);
// (the engine's glue resets the canvas' style when it sets its size: put back)
new MutationObserver(fit).observe($('canvas'), { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style', 'width', 'height'] });
fit();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the mouse
// The engine captures the mouse itself when the game takes it (SDL's relative mode: pointer lock at the next input
// event) and frees it in its menus and console, its cursor shown there. A click captures it again only while the game
// wants it — its cursor hidden: after the browser released it (Esc) — never in a menu, where the mouse must stay free.
const wantsMouse = () => session.state === 'running' && $('canvas').style.cursor === 'none';
// (how to capture the mouse: told the first time the game wants it — the game starts on its menu, where it is free)
let captureTold = false;
new MutationObserver(() => {
  if (captureTold || !wantsMouse() || document.pointerLockElement) return;
  captureTold = true; toast(S.capture, 7000);
}).observe($('canvas'), { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] });
escapeToGame(window); // (the first Escape to the game, the next frees the mouse)
$('canvas').addEventListener('pointerdown', () => { if (wantsMouse() && document.pointerLockElement !== $('canvas')) $('canvas').requestPointerLock()?.catch?.(() => {}); });
$('canvas').addEventListener('contextmenu', (event) => event.preventDefault());
// (the engine frees the mouse for its menus a moment after the lock ends: only a release by the player is told)
document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange', () => setTimeout(() => { if (!document.pointerLockElement && wantsMouse() && !stopped) toast(S.released, 4000); }, 150));
/** The header's mouse indicator clicked: the game gets the mouse when it wants it, else the keys. */
function giveMouse() {
  $('canvas').focus();
  if (wantsMouse()) $('canvas').requestPointerLock()?.catch?.(() => {}); else toast(S.capture, 5000);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the header's frame rate
// (a frame is a main loop iteration that drew: the engine may run some without rendering, under its fps_max)
let draws = 0;
for (const type of [globalThis.WebGL2RenderingContext, globalThis.WebGLRenderingContext]) {
  if (!type) continue;
  for (const method of ['drawArrays', 'drawElements']) {
    const original = type.prototype[method];
    type.prototype[method] = function (...args) { draws++; return original.apply(this, args); };
  }
}
const perf = { frames: [], samples: [], lastDraws: 0, started: 0 };
function onFrame() {
  if (draws === perf.lastDraws) return;
  perf.lastDraws = draws; perf.frames.push(performance.now());
  if (perf.frames.length > 400) perf.frames.splice(0, perf.frames.length - 400);
  if (session.state === 'running' && ++perf.started === 10) hideLoader(); // (its first images: the game is shown)
}
setInterval(() => {
  const now = performance.now(), recent = perf.frames.filter((t) => t > now - 500);
  const gaps = recent.slice(1).map((t, i) => t - recent[i]).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  perf.samples.push({ fps: recent.length * 2, max: gaps.at(-1) ?? 0, p99: gaps[Math.floor(gaps.length * 0.99)] ?? 0 });
  if (perf.samples.length > 120) perf.samples.shift();
  shell?.setFps(perf.samples, session.state !== 'running' || perf.started < 10 ? 'loading' : document.hidden ? 'paused' : 'running');
}, 500);
/** The session's end, once: its length and frame rate. */
function endReport() { perfRecord?.end(); telemetry.end({ frames: frameStats(), audio: audioState() }); }
/** The last minute's frame rate and slowest frames, for the session's report. */
function frameStats() {
  const a = perf.samples.filter((x) => x.fps > 0); if (!a.length) return null;
  return { fps: Math.round(a.reduce((t, x) => t + x.fps, 0) / a.length), p99: Math.round(Math.max(...a.map((x) => x.p99))) };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the player: the Orthros account
/** The name in the game: the account's (letters, digits, '.', '_', '-'), or a guest's for a player not signed in. */
const guestName = `Guest${100 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 900)}`;
const playerName = () => (shell?.account?.username ?? '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_.-]/g, '').slice(0, 24) || guestName;
const signedIn = () => !!shell?.account || shell?.accounts === false;

  if (choice) window.orthrosData?.open?.('account');
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the installation
const name = decodeURIComponent(location.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean)[2] ?? '');
const sessionId = crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll('-', '').slice(0, 24);
let config, tree, files, gameData, lobby = null, pendingConnect = null;
/** A room of the lobby joined: the engine told to connect, or once it runs. */
function joinRoom(room) {
  const address = roomAddress(room.index);
  closeLobby();
  if (session.state === 'running') { log(`Joining ${room.name} (${address})`); engine.Cmd_ExecuteString(`connect ${address}`); $('canvas').focus(); return; }
  pendingConnect = address;
}
// (over the game: the header's button opens it; the keys typed in it stay its own — the engine listens to the page's)
const lobbyOverlay = $('lobbyOverlay');
const lobbyButton = Object.assign(document.createElement('button'), { type: 'button', id: 'tbLobby', className: 'pill rooms hidden', textContent: S.lobby, title: S.lobbyTitle });
function openLobby() {
  if (!lobby) return;
  document.exitPointerLock?.(); lobbyOverlay.querySelector('.panel').prepend(lobby.el); lobby.el.classList.remove('hidden'); lobbyOverlay.classList.remove('hidden'); lobby.show();
  lobbyOverlay.querySelector('.close').focus(); // (the keys typed then are the overlay's)
}
function closeLobby() {
  if (lobbyOverlay.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
  lobbyOverlay.classList.add('hidden'); lobby?.hide();
  // (before the game shows: back in the loading screen, among its choices)
  if (session.state !== 'running' || !shell.loader.classList.contains('hidden')) { shell.choices.append(lobby.el); lobby.show(); }
  else $('canvas').focus();
}
lobbyButton.addEventListener('click', () => (lobbyOverlay.classList.contains('hidden') ? openLobby() : closeLobby()));
lobbyOverlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => { if (event.target === lobbyOverlay) closeLobby(); });
lobbyOverlay.querySelector('.close').addEventListener('click', closeLobby);
// (while it shows, no key reaches the engine: keys aimed elsewhere are caught before the engine's listeners; those of
// the overlay's own controls reach them, then stop at the overlay)
for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup', 'keypress']) {
  addEventListener(type, (event) => {
    if (lobbyOverlay.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
    // (Escape: the creation form first, when it shows, then the overlay)
    if (type === 'keydown' && event.key === 'Escape') { event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation(); if (!lobby?.closeForm()) closeLobby(); return; }
    if (!lobbyOverlay.contains(event.target)) { event.stopImmediatePropagation(); lobbyOverlay.querySelector('.close').focus(); }
  }, { capture: true });
  lobbyOverlay.addEventListener(type, (event) => event.stopPropagation());
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the profile on the account (cloud-sync.js)
// (what the account keeps: the game's writable folder less what the engine makes again — logs, screenshots, bots'
// navigation meshes, the decals' cache)
const KEEP = (path) => !/(^|\/)(screenshots|logs)\//i.test(path) && !/\.(log|nav|hpk)$/i.test(path);
const toCloud = (list) => (list ?? []).filter((f) => f.path.startsWith('/rwdir/')).map((f) => ({ path: f.path.slice(7), data: f.data })).filter((f) => KEEP(f.path));
function newCloud(username) {
  return new CloudSave({
    game: name, user: username, onStatus: (s) => shell.setSave(s),
    read: async () => toCloud(engine?.em && session.state === 'running' ? writableSnapshot(engine.em.FS) : await readStorage(db, 'profile', 'files')),
    // (before the engine starts only: the previous profile kept aside in the same store)
    write: async (list) => {
      const old = await readStorage(db, 'profile', 'files');
      if (old?.length) await writeStorage(db, 'profile', `aside-${new Date().toISOString()}`, old);
      await writeStorage(db, 'profile', 'files', list.map((f) => ({ path: '/rwdir/' + f.path, data: f.data })));
    },
  });
}
/**
 * Signed in while the game runs: its name and multiplayer opened; its profile sent to the account, unless the account
 * has another one — then the player chooses: restart with the account's, or this browser's sent over it.
 */
async function lateSignIn(user) {
  if (engine && session.state === 'running') engine.Cmd_ExecuteString(`name "${playerName()}"`);
  if (relay) { relay.enabled = true; relay.open(); }
  if (config?.goldsrc.multiplayer) toast(S.online(user.username), 5000);
  if (cloud || !db) return;
  cloud = newCloud(user.username);
  const head = await cloud.remoteHead().catch(() => null);
  cloud.remoteHash = head;
  if (!head) { if (session.state === 'running') await save(); cloud.push(); return; }
  const choice = await shell.ask({ title: S.lateTitle, text: S.lateText(config.name), buttons: [{ value: 'account', label: S.lateAccount, primary: true }, { value: 'device', label: S.lateDevice }] });
  if (choice === 'account') { stopped = true; if (timer) clearInterval(timer); if (cloudTimer) clearInterval(cloudTimer); try { const remote = await cloud.fetchRemote(); if (remote) await cloud.applyRemote(remote); } finally { location.reload(); } }
  else if (choice === 'device') { await save(); cloud.resolve('device'); }
  else cloud.set({ state: 'conflict' });
}

async function save() {
  if (!db || !engine?.em || saving || stopped) return saving; // (stopped: the page goes, or the account's copy replaces this one)
  saving = writeStorage(db, 'profile', 'files', writableSnapshot(engine.em.FS));
  try { await saving; session.lastSaveAt = Date.now(); } finally { saving = null; }
}
session.save = save;

/**
 * The multiplayer relay (/api/udp/<manifest>?rooms): the version's servers, each packet tagged with its room in its
 * first byte. The engine reaches room i at 10.87.0.<i+1>:27015 (lobby.js roomAddress; 127.0.0.1:8080 too, room 0); a
 * broadcast — the game's LAN search — goes to every room, and each answers from its own address, so the game's own
 * server list shows them all. Opened when the engine starts with a signed-in player (`enabled`), opened again at the
 * next packet once closed (the server closes idle ones).
 */
class Relay {
  constructor(url, enabled) { this.url = url; this.enabled = enabled; this.socket = null; this.queue = []; this.closed = false; this.used = 0; this.from = new Map(); this.joined = false; }
  open() {
    if (this.closed || !this.enabled || (this.socket && this.socket.readyState <= WebSocket.OPEN)) return;
    const socket = this.socket = new WebSocket(this.url); socket.binaryType = 'arraybuffer';
    socket.onopen = () => { session.multiplayer = 'connected'; for (const data of this.queue.splice(0)) socket.send(data); };
    socket.onmessage = (event) => {
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(event.data); if (bytes.length < 2) return;
      this.used = performance.now();
      // (an answer comes from the address the engine used for that room: its connection knows no other)
      const [ip, port] = this.from.get(bytes[0]) ?? [[10, 87, 0, bytes[0] + 1], 27015];
      engine.net.incoming.enqueue({ data: bytes.subarray(1), ip, port });
    };
    socket.onclose = () => {
      session.multiplayer = 'disconnected';
      // (told only when it was in use: a game on the server loses its connection, the next packet opens a new one)
      if (!this.closed && !stopped && performance.now() - this.used < 5000) status(S.lost, true);
    };
  }
  /** The room a packet goes to: 255 for a broadcast; null for an address that is none of theirs (dropped). */
  room(ip, port) {
    if (ip[3] === 255 || (ip[0] === 255 && ip[1] === 255)) return 255;
    if (ip[0] === 10 && ip[1] === 87 && ip[2] === 0 && ip[3] >= 1 && ip[3] <= 9) return ip[3] - 1;
    if (ip[0] === 127 && ip[1] === 0 && ip[2] === 0 && ip[3] === 1 && port === 8080) return 0;
    return null;
  }
  send(packet) {
    if (!this.enabled) return; // (no account: no multiplayer — the game's LAN search finds nothing)
    const index = this.room(packet.ip, packet.port);
    if (index === null) return;
    if (index !== 255) this.from.set(index, [[...packet.ip], packet.port]);
    // (the engine joined a server of the relay's — GoldSrc's connectionless `connect`, \xff\xff\xff\xff then the word —:
    // from then on a map it loads may be another's, its server not the page's — bsp-reads.js `server`)
    if (!this.joined && index !== 255 && isConnect(packet.data)) this.joined = true;
    const data = new Uint8Array(packet.data.length + 1); data[0] = index; data.set(packet.data, 1);
    this.open();
    if (this.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) { if (this.socket.bufferedAmount < 1024 * 1024) this.socket.send(data); }
    else if (this.queue.length < 64) this.queue.push(data);
  }
  close() { this.closed = true; this.socket?.close(); }
}

/** A GoldSrc connectionless packet asking a server to connect (\xff\xff\xff\xff "connect ..."). */
function isConnect(d) {
  const word = 'connect';
  if (!d || d.length < 4 + word.length || d[0] !== 255 || d[1] !== 255 || d[2] !== 255 || d[3] !== 255) return false;
  for (let i = 0; i < word.length; i++) if (d[4 + i] !== word.charCodeAt(i)) return false;
  return true;
}

function attachNet(Net) {
  class BrowserNet extends Net {
    recvfrom(...args) {
      const result = super.recvfrom(...args);
      // The published wrapper uses 73; this Emscripten libc uses EAGAIN=6.
      // Empty nonblocking receives must not become persistent engine errors.
      if (result < 0 && this.em) this.em.setValue(this.em.Module.ccall('getErrnoLocation', 'number', [], []), 6, 'i32');
      return result;
    }
  }
  const endpoint = new URL(`/api/udp/${encodeURIComponent(name)}?rooms`, location.href); endpoint.protocol = location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
  relay = new Relay(endpoint, signedIn());
  engine.net = new BrowserNet({ sendto: (packet) => relay.send(packet) });
  relay.open();
}

// The HUD's scale (the engine's hud_scale: the width of a virtual screen the HUD is drawn on, which the engine scales to
// the game's width): none up to about 1920 × 1080, then by half steps — 1.5 at 2560 × 1440, 2.5 at 3840 × 2160 — so its
// texts and menus keep their size on a large screen instead of shrinking; 0 turns it off. Read at the engine's start.
function hudScale(width, height) {
  const factor = Math.floor(Math.min(width / 1280, height / 720) * 2) / 2;
  return factor > 1 ? Math.round(width / factor) : 0;
}

/** The game's language: the one chosen on the home screen (?gameLang=, else remembered), among the version's. */
function gameLanguage(man) {
  const options = man.languages ?? [];
  let wanted = params.get('gameLang'); if (!options.includes(wanted)) { try { wanted = localStorage.getItem('orthros.gameLanguage.' + (man.gameId ?? name)); } catch { wanted = null; } }
  return options.includes(wanted) ? wanted : options.includes(lang) ? lang : options.includes('en') ? 'en' : options[0] ?? null;
}

const fmtMB = (bytes) => `${(bytes / 1048576).toFixed(bytes < 10485760 ? 1 : 0)} MB`;
/** The game started at once: the account's saves first, then the engine, the files, the game's own start. */
async function start() {
  session.state = 'starting';
  storage.ask(); // (before the game data's first write: the store, the saves — storage-persist.js)
  perfRecord ??= portPerf({ runtime: 'goldsrc', storage, game: name, session: telemetry.session, version: config.version ?? null, bench: params.get('benchrun'), phase: () => session.state, data: () => portDataSummary(gameData), gl: () => canvasGl($('canvas')), draws: () => draws });
  if (!crossOriginIsolated) throw new Error(S.isolated);
  // (each engine file by its content when the server gives it, else under its release: engineUrls)
  const g = config.goldsrc, at = engineUrls(config, g.engine), language = gameLanguage(config);
  // (the game data opened now — its worker, the version's store, the learned order's list —, beside the account's saves
  // and the engine's download, ready by the time the engine's file system takes its files: openPortData)
  gameData ??= openPortData({ name, tree, manifest: config, session: sessionId, lang: language, log });
  step('engine', 'active'); step('files', ''); step('game', '');
  db = await openStorage(config.saveKey);
  const who = await shell.ready;
  if (who.user) {
    status(S.account);
    cloud = newCloud(who.user.username);
    const what = await cloud.pull().catch((e) => { log('Account saves: ' + e.message); return 'offline'; });
    if (what === 'conflict') await shell.resolveConflict(cloud);
  }
  status(S.init);
  const { Xash3D, Net, DEFAULT_SERVER_LIBRARY } = await import(at('engine/index.js'));
  const width = $('canvas').clientWidth || 1024, height = $('canvas').clientHeight || 768;
  // (a language's own arguments and folders, goldsrc.languages.<code> — the engine's, as the version's release has them)
  const own = g.languages?.[language] ?? {};
  engine = session.engine = new Xash3D({
    canvas: $('canvas'),
    // (-dll: the engine opens the server module under the name the wrapper preloaded it with, not the one the game's
    // liblist.gam names — another name finds no library and the local server never starts; the size, the canvas'
    // on the page — SDL takes it again on every change; ?debug: the engine's developer messages from its start)
    // (the HUD's scale from the largest size the game takes — full screen: the engine reads it at its start only, and
    // its virtual width still fits a smaller window)
    arguments: ['-windowed', '-noip6', '-game', g.gameDir, '-dll', DEFAULT_SERVER_LIBRARY, '-rodir', '/rodir', '-basedir', '/rwdir', '-width', String(width), '-height', String(height), ...(own.args ?? []), ...(params.has('debug') ? ['-dev', '2'] : []), '+hud_scale', String(hudScale(Math.max(width, screen.width), Math.max(height, screen.height)))],
    libraries: {
      xash: at('engine/xash.wasm'), filesystem: at('engine/filesystem_stdio.wasm'),
      menu: at(g.modules.menu ?? 'engine/libmenu.wasm'), client: at(g.modules.client), server: at(g.modules.server),
      render: { gl4es: at('engine/libref_webgl2.wasm') }
    },
    module: { print: log, printErr: log, onAbort: reason => fail(new Error(String(reason))), postMainLoop: onFrame }
  });
  if (g.multiplayer) attachNet(Net);
  const t = performance.now();
  await engine.init();
  step('engine', 'done', `${((performance.now() - t) / 1000).toFixed(1)} s`);
  const FS = engine.em.FS;
  // (the game's writable folder, with its maps folder: files the game writes there, as its bots' navigation meshes)
  FS.mkdirTree('/rodir'); FS.mkdirTree('/rwdir/' + g.gameDir + '/maps');
  restoreSnapshot(FS, await readStorage(db, 'profile', 'files'));
  // (the game's files: its whole tree now — a language's folders over the ones they translate —, what earlier sessions
  // read first loaded before the start, the rest later)
  const shown = languageFiles(files, own.overlays, Object.values(g.languages ?? {}).flatMap((l) => Object.keys(l.overlays ?? {})));
  const t0 = performance.now();
  step('files', 'active', fmtMB(0), 0);
  let nodes;
  ({ nodes } = await mountPortFiles(gameData, { name, files: shown, FS, root: '/rodir', log, db,
    onCopy: (bytes) => step('files', 'active', fmtMB(bytes), 0), onProgress: (progress) => shell.setData(progress) }));
  session.files = gameData;
  // (each map the engine loads — its .bsp read — a phase of the game data: the server learns what each map's load reads,
  // in its order, and the next sessions load it ahead — GameData.phase)
  phaseOnRead(FS, nodes, gameData, (p) => /\/maps\/([^/]+)\.bsp$/i.exec(p)?.[1].toLowerCase() ?? null);
  // (and what a map's load reads, told by its .bsp once read — its textures' WAD lumps, sky, models, sounds —, fetched in
  // parallel instead of a round trip each: bsp-reads.js; ?mapreads=0 turns it off, to compare)
  // (a map's own textures read from the WADs only when the engine's r_wadtextures is set — a game's config sets it; this
  // build answers no console query (its output never reaches the page), so the value is the last one the configuration
  // the engine reads sets — its .cfg / .rc files as it reads them, the arguments and commands the page gives it —:
  // configSetting; the node graph only while the page certainly runs the map's server — no remote server joined
  // through the relay)
  const mapCvars = { wadTextures: false };
  const setting = (text) => { const v = configSetting(text, 'r_wadtextures'); if (v !== null) mapCvars.wadTextures = Number(v) !== 0; };
  setting([...(own.args ?? [])].join(' ').replace(/(^|\s)\+/g, '\n'));
  const fsRead = FS.read;
  FS.read = function (stream, buffer, offset, length, position, canOwn) {
    const n = fsRead.call(this, stream, buffer, offset, length, position, canOwn);
    // (the text the stream read so far, read again whole: a statement across two reads is read once complete)
    if (n > 0 && /\.(cfg|rc)$/i.test(stream.path ?? '') && (stream.orthrosCfg ?? '').length < 1 << 20) {
      setting(stream.orthrosCfg = (stream.orthrosCfg ?? '') + new TextDecoder('latin1').decode(buffer.subarray(offset, offset + n)));
    }
    return n;
  };
  if (params.get('mapreads') !== '0') {
    announceMapLoads(FS, nodes, gameData, { name, files: shown, root: '/rodir', gameDir: g.gameDir, log,
      wadTextures: () => mapCvars.wadTextures, server: () => !relay?.joined, mapPrecache: config.mapPrecache ?? [] });
  }
  const loaded = await gameData.startup((p) => {
    const f = p.total ? p.bytes / p.total : 1, secs = (performance.now() - t0) / 1000;
    step('files', 'active', `${fmtMB(p.bytes)}${secs > 1 ? ` · ${(p.bytes / 1048576 / secs).toFixed(1)} MB/s` : ''}`, f); status(S.files(Math.round(f * 100)));
  });
  session.startup = { ...gameData.snapshot(), startupBytes: loaded.total, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0) };
  log(`Startup files: ${JSON.stringify(session.startup)}`);
  // (the release's archives the engine mounts from the game folder: its own extras by default, goldsrc.extras)
  for (const extra of [...(g.extras ?? ['engine/valve/extras.pk3']), ...(own.extras ?? [])]) {
    const extrasResponse = await fetch(at(extra));
    if (!extrasResponse.ok) throw new Error(S.engineFiles);
    FS.writeFile(`/rodir/${g.gameDir}/${extra.split('/').pop()}`, new Uint8Array(await extrasResponse.arrayBuffer()));
  }
  step('files', 'done', fmtMB(loaded.total));
  FS.chdir('/rwdir');
  step('game', 'active', '', 0.2); status(S.starting);
  // (main() only schedules the engine's start: it runs once the engine's WebAssembly libraries are loaded, which
  // can be after this — no console command before it has run; the reads are learned from its start)
  const M = engine.em.Module, started = new Promise((resolve) => {
    const initialized = M.onRuntimeInitialized; M.onRuntimeInitialized = () => { gameData.start(); initialized?.(); };
    M.postRun = [...(Array.isArray(M.postRun) ? M.postRun : M.postRun ? [M.postRun] : []), resolve];
  });
  engine.main();
  await started;
  step('game', 'active', '', 0.6);
  engine.Cmd_ExecuteString('developer ' + (params.has('debug') ? '1' : '0'));
  // (the renderer's error checks — glGetError after its passes each frame and after each texture upload — only with
  // ?debug: each one waits for the browser's GPU process, about 10 a frame; docs/browser-ports.md, "Measured")
  engine.Cmd_ExecuteString('gl_check_errors ' + (params.has('debug') ? '1' : '0'));
  // (the world's surfaces from buffers the renderer fills once a map, gl_vbo — not re-sent a polygon at a time with
  // its own buffer upload and state: about 85 draws a frame instead of 700 in Counter-Strike; ?vbo=0, or a manifest's
  // commands, turn it off)
  engine.Cmd_ExecuteString('gl_vbo ' + (params.get('vbo') === '0' ? '0' : '1'));
  engine.Cmd_ExecuteString(`name "${playerName()}"`); engine.Cmd_ExecuteString('setinfo "_vgui_menus" "0"');
  // (the game's main menu: its single player and its multiplayer — a game it creates gets the manifest's settings,
  // bots included; Orthros' server answers its LAN search; the language's own commands)
  for (const command of [...(g.solo?.commands ?? []), ...(own.commands ?? [])]) { engine.Cmd_ExecuteString(command); setting(command); }
  // (a room chosen in the lobby during the loading: joined at once)
  if (pendingConnect) { log(`Joining ${pendingConnect}`); engine.Cmd_ExecuteString(`connect ${pendingConnect}`); pendingConnect = null; }
  session.command = command => engine.Cmd_ExecuteString(command);
  session.state = 'running'; report('start', { engine: g.engine, signedIn: !!shell.account });
  setTimeout(() => report('audio', audioState()), 60000); // (a minute in: is the game heard?)
  timer = setInterval(() => save().catch(error => { log('Profile save failed: ' + error.message); status(S.saveFailed, true); }), 10000);
  // (the account's copy: a minute after a change at most — CloudSave sends only what changed)
  cloudTimer = setInterval(() => { if (cloud && session.state === 'running') cloud.push(); }, 60000);
  $('canvas').focus();
}

/**
 * Back to the games: the game's settings written, the profile kept here and on the account; false when it could not
 * be sent. (The engine is not asked to quit: the page goes, and this release's quit can stop on an error of its own.)
 */
async function quit() {
  if (session.state !== 'running') return true;
  try {
    engine?.Cmd_ExecuteString('host_writeconfig'); await save();
    const sent = cloud ? await cloud.push() : null;
    return !sent || !['error', 'toobig', 'conflict'].includes(sent.state);
  } catch (error) { log('Quit: ' + (error?.message ?? error)); return false; }
}

async function fullscreen() {
  try { await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen({ navigationUI: 'hide' }); } catch (error) { status(error.message, true); return; }
  await lockKeys();
  $('canvas').focus();
  if (wantsMouse()) $('canvas').requestPointerLock()?.catch?.(() => {}); // (in the game: the mouse captured at once, as the Windows games')
}

try {
  const [manifestResponse, treeResponse] = await Promise.all([fetch(`/api/manifest/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`), fetch(`/api/tree/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`)]);
  if (!manifestResponse.ok || !treeResponse.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${manifestResponse.ok ? treeResponse.status : manifestResponse.status}`);
  config = session.config = await manifestResponse.json();
  if (config.runtime !== 'goldsrc') throw new Error('not a GoldSrc installation');
  tree = await treeResponse.json(); files = treeFiles(tree);
  shell = createShell({
    title: config.name, version: config.version, gameLanguage: gameLanguage(config), cover: `/api/cover/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, subtitle: S.subtitle,
    steps: Object.entries(S.steps).map(([k, label]) => ({ k, label })), tips: S.tips, extras: [lobbyButton],
    onQuit: quit, onFullscreen: fullscreen, onMouse: giveMouse, onSignedIn: lateSignIn, saves: () => cloud,
    onLoaderHidden: fit,
  });
  shell.sound.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio);
  // (the multiplayer lobby: among the loading screen's choices while the game loads, over the game after it)
  if (config.goldsrc.multiplayer) {
    lobby = createLobby({ name, lang, log, nickname: playerName, signedIn, needAccount, onJoin: joinRoom });
    shell.choices.append(lobby.el); lobby.show();
    lobbyButton.classList.remove('hidden');
  }
  await start();
} catch (error) { if (shell) fail(error); else document.body.textContent = S.failed + (error.message ?? error); }

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden && session.state === 'running') save().then(() => cloud?.push()).catch(log); });
window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => {
  if (session.state === 'running') endReport();
  // (the game's server told the player left, through the relay before it closes — its socket sends what it queued
  // first: otherwise the server keeps the player until its timeout, a minute, and the same account coming back meanwhile
  // plays as "name (1)" beside its own still body)
  if (session.state === 'running' && relay?.socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) { try { engine.Cmd_ExecuteString('disconnect'); } catch (error) { log(error); } }
  stopped = true; if (timer) clearInterval(timer); relay?.close(); gameData?.close(); });
```

`src/ports/goldsrc/storage.js`:

```js
/** Store writable profiles per installation, independently from content caches and engine releases. */
export async function openStorage(key) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const request = indexedDB.open(key, 1);
    request.onupgradeneeded = () => { request.result.createObjectStore('profile'); request.result.createObjectStore('content'); };
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error); request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
  });
}
export function readStorage(db, store, key) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const request = db.transaction(store).objectStore(store).get(key);
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error); request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
  });
}
export function writeStorage(db, store, key, value) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(store, 'readwrite'); tx.objectStore(store).put(value, key);
    tx.oncomplete = resolve; tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error); tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}
/** Several entries ([key, value]) in one transaction. */
export function writeManyStorage(db, store, entries) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(store, 'readwrite'), os = tx.objectStore(store);
    for (const [key, value] of entries) os.put(value, key);
    tx.oncomplete = resolve; tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error); tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}
export function storageKeys(db, store) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const request = db.transaction(store).objectStore(store).getAllKeys();
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error); request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
  });
}
/** Every entry of `store`, in one pass (a cursor): fn(key, value) for each; resolved at the end. */
export function eachStorage(db, store, fn) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const request = db.transaction(store).objectStore(store).openCursor();
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    request.onsuccess = () => { const c = request.result; if (!c) { resolve(); return; } try { fn(c.key, c.value); } catch (e) { reject(e); return; } c.continue(); };
  });
}
export function removeStorage(db, store, keys) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(store, 'readwrite'), os = tx.objectStore(store);
    for (const key of keys) os.delete(key);
    tx.oncomplete = resolve; tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error); tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}
export function writableSnapshot(FS, root = '/rwdir') {
  const files = [];
  function walk(dir) {
    for (const name of FS.readdir(dir)) {
      if (name === '.' || name === '..') continue;
      const file = dir + '/' + name, stat = FS.stat(file);
      if (FS.isDir(stat.mode)) walk(file);
      else if (FS.isFile(stat.mode)) files.push({ path: file, data: FS.readFile(file) });
    }
  }
  walk(root); return files;
}
export function restoreSnapshot(FS, files) {
  for (const file of files ?? []) {
    if (!file.path.startsWith('/rwdir/') || file.path.includes('..') || file.path.includes('\\')) throw new Error('Invalid save path');
    FS.mkdirTree(file.path.slice(0, file.path.lastIndexOf('/'))); FS.writeFile(file.path, file.data);
  }
}
```

`src/ports/openmw/account-bridge.js`:

```js
// Same-origin launcher requests. Native credentials are private and independent of Orthros passwords.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createHmac, createHash } from 'node:crypto';

export const playerScope = (user) => createHash('sha256').update(user.id).digest('hex').slice(0, 24);
export function accountBridge({ accountsDir, accountApi, getManifest }) {
  const pending = new Map(), issued = new WeakSet(), budgets = new Map();
  async function launch(user, man) {
    const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(accountsDir, 'openmw.json'), 'utf8'));
    const operator = config.operators?.[man.id];
    // Catalog ids are passed explicitly below; no username-based adoption of legacy accounts.
    if (!operator || typeof config.secret !== 'string' || config.secret.length < 32) throw new Error('bridge unavailable');
    const key = playerScope(user), name = `orthros-${key}@players.invalid`;
    const password = createHmac('sha256', config.secret).update(`${key}:${man.openmw.multiplayer.port}`).digest('base64url');
    const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${man.openmw.multiplayer.port}`;
    async function request(route, body, token, method = 'POST') {
      const r = await fetch(base + route, { method, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', ...(token ? { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}) },
        ...(method === 'GET' ? {} : { body: JSON.stringify(body) }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) });
      return { ok: r.ok, status: r.status, data: await r.json() };
    }
    let login = await request('/auth/password', { name, password });
    if (!login.ok && login.status === 401) {
      const owner = await request('/admin/api/login', operator);
      if (!owner.ok || !owner.data.token) throw new Error('operator unavailable');
      try {
        const created = await request('/admin/api/accounts/create', { name, password, role: '' }, owner.data.token);
        if (!created.ok) throw new Error('player creation failed');
      } finally { await request('/admin/api/logout', {}, owner.data.token); }
      login = await request('/auth/password', { name, password });
    }
    if (!login.ok || !login.data.ticket || !login.data.locker) throw new Error('player login failed');
    const token = login.data.locker, profile = await request('/auth/profile', null, token, 'GET');
    if (!profile.ok) throw new Error('profile unavailable');
    let username = profile.data.username;
    if (profile.data.needsProfile) {
      const stem = user.username.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '').slice(0, 14).padEnd(3, '0');
      let updated = await request('/auth/profile', { username: stem, email: name }, token);
      if (!updated.ok) updated = await request('/auth/profile', { username: stem.slice(0, 12) + key.slice(0, 8), email: name }, token);
      if (!updated.ok) throw new Error('profile creation failed');
      username = (await request('/auth/profile', null, token, 'GET')).data.username;
    }
    accountApi.registerPortToken(user, man.id, token);
    return { ticket: login.data.ticket, account: login.data.account, locker: token, username };
  }
  function reply(res, status, data) {
    res.writeHead(status, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'private, no-store' }); res.end(JSON.stringify(data));
  }
  return {
    handle(req, res, url) {
      const m = /^\/api\/openmw\/([^/]+)\/launch$/.exec(url.pathname);
      if (!m) return false;
      const man = getManifest(m[1]);
      if (man?.runtime !== 'openmw' || !man.openmw.multiplayer) { reply(res, 404, { error: 'Version multijoueur introuvable.' }); return true; }
      if (req.method !== 'POST') { reply(res, 405, { error: 'POST requis.' }); return true; }
      let origin; try { origin = new URL(req.headers.origin); } catch { /* refused below */ }
      if (!origin || !['http:', 'https:'].includes(origin.protocol) || origin.host !== req.headers.host) { reply(res, 403, { error: 'Origine refusée.' }); return true; }
      const user = accountApi?.session(req);
      if (!user) { reply(res, 401, { error: 'Crée un compte Orthros ou connecte-toi pour jouer en multijoueur.' }); return true; }
      req.resume();
      const key = `${m[1]}:${user.id}`, now = Date.now(), budget = budgets.get(key);
      if (budget && now < budget.until && budget.count >= 6) { reply(res, 429, { error: 'Trop de lancements. Réessaie dans une minute.' }); return true; }
      budgets.set(key, { until: budget?.until > now ? budget.until : now + 60000, count: budget?.until > now ? budget.count + 1 : 1 });
      if (budgets.size > 10000) for (const [k, b] of budgets) if (b.until < now) budgets.delete(k);
      if (!pending.has(key)) pending.set(key, launch(user, { ...man, id: m[1] }).finally(() => pending.delete(key)));
      pending.get(key).then((result) => {
        // Concurrent requests must not receive the same one-use game ticket.
        if (issued.has(result)) return reply(res, 409, { error: 'Lancement déjà en cours.' });
        issued.add(result);
        reply(res, 200, result);
      }).catch(() => reply(res, 503, { error: 'Connexion au multijoueur indisponible. Réessaie dans un instant.' }));
      return true;
    },
  };
}
```

`src/ports/openmw/boot-reads.js`:

```js
// The OpenMW engine page's boot reads announced (docs/openmw.md "Scripts announced at the boot"): the engine reads its
// data folders' Lua scripts, their localisation and the post-processing shaders one small file at a time — at its boot
// (LuaManager::initConfiguration, the scripts' `require` chains, L10n::MessageBundles::load, a script's YAML::LoadAll),
// then again at a saved game's load (StateManager::loadGame: every object's scripts loaded anew, ScriptsContainer::
// addScript) and in play —, each a synchronous read: one round trip a file for every file not in the page (a mod added
// since the player's last visit, a new device: 200-450 serial reads on a 2 MB/s, 85 ms link, 20-40 s of a frozen page).
// No announce of the engine covers them, and the learned order brings them one at a time behind the game's reads. The
// page knows them all before the engine starts: the files it mounted, in the data folders' order. So, once the mounts
// are over, the files the engine's VFS will resolve (a later data folder's file wins over an earlier one of the same
// name, as the engine's own lookup) whose kind is one of these text formats are announced in one list (GameData.want
// `wait: false`: fetched at once, in parallel, the engine's reads joining them), the smallest first (many round trips
// for few bytes), bounded.

/** the kinds of file announced: Lua scripts and their content lists, YAML (localisation, a script's data), shaders */
export const BOOT_KINDS = /\.(?:lua|omwscripts|ya?ml|omwfx)$/i;
/** a file bigger than this is left to the engine's own reads (a script's data file read in part, a mod's mistake) */
export const BOOT_FILE_MAX = 8 << 20;
/** the most bytes (the files' own) one boot's list asks */
export const BOOT_BYTES = 32 << 20;
/** the most files one boot's list asks */
export const BOOT_FILES = 4096;

/**
 * The name the engine's VFS knows an engine path by (its data folder's root left out, lowercased), or null: `/mwdata/
 * <name>` (the game's folder) and `/mwmods/<mod>/<name>` (a mod's), as the engine page mounts them; other mounts (the
 * engine's asset pack archive, a file the player picked) are not loose files of a data folder.
 */
export function vfsName(enginePath) {
  const p = String(enginePath ?? '');
  const m = /^\/mwdata\/(.+)$/.exec(p) ?? /^\/mwmods\/[^/]+\/(.+)$/.exec(p);
  return m ? m[1].toLowerCase() : null;
}

/**
 * The boot's list: `mounts` [enginePath, h] in the order mounted (the data folders' order: a later one wins), `h` the
 * game data's handle ({ size }; a source of elsewhere — `src` — left out). Returns [{ h, off: 0, len: -1 }], the files the
 * engine resolves whose name is one of BOOT_KINDS, each at most `maxFile` bytes, the smallest first, cut at `maxBytes` /
 * `maxFiles` in that order.
 */
export function bootReads(mounts, { maxFile = BOOT_FILE_MAX, maxBytes = BOOT_BYTES, maxFiles = BOOT_FILES } = {}) {
  const byName = new Map();
  for (const [path, h] of mounts) {
    const name = vfsName(path);
    if (name === null || !BOOT_KINDS.test(name)) continue;
    // (the name resolved to the last data folder's file — an earlier one's never read —, whatever its size)
    byName.set(name, h);
  }
  const files = [...byName.values()].filter((h) => h && h.src === undefined && h.size > 0 && h.size <= maxFile).sort((a, b) => a.size - b.size);
  const out = [];
  let bytes = 0;
  for (const h of files) {
    if (out.length >= maxFiles || bytes + h.size > maxBytes) break;
    bytes += h.size;
    out.push({ h, off: 0, len: -1 });
  }
  return out;
}
```
