`src/ports/openmw/cloud.js`:

```js
// Bridge the engine's saved user state (excluding logs and screenshots) to Orthros versioned account backups.
// Game data is excluded. IDBFS remains the working cache; optimistic hashes protect other devices.
(() => {
  window.orthrosCloudInstall = (FS, game, scope) => {
    const original = FS.syncfs.bind(FS), key = `orthros.openmw.cloud.${scope}.${game}`;
    const endpoint = `/api/cloud/${encodeURIComponent(game)}`;
    let parent = 'none', uploading = false, queued = false, blocked = false, lastHash = null;
    // (told to the Orthros page around the engine: its header's save indicator — states as cloud-sync.js's)
    const notify = (state, message = '') => {
      if (window.parent !== window) window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'orthros-save-status', state, message, error: state === 'error' || state === 'conflict' }, location.origin);
    };
    let pending = Promise.resolve(true);
    const digest = async (bytes) => Array.from(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', bytes)), (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    async function transform(bytes, decompress = false) {
      return new Uint8Array(await new Response(new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(decompress ? new DecompressionStream('gzip') : new CompressionStream('gzip'))).arrayBuffer());
    }
    const savedState = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) ?? '{}'); } catch { return {}; } };
    const remember = (dirty) => localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({ parent, dirty }));
    // (each file's last reading — its size, date and base64 — and the files as the account last took them: a sync that
    // changed nothing reads, encodes and hashes nothing; the engine page syncs every 15 s, and reading every save each
    // time cost 78 ms per MB of saves on the page's thread)
    const known = new Map();
    let sent = null;
    const base64 = (bytes) => {
      if (typeof bytes.toBase64 === 'function') return bytes.toBase64();
      let data = '';
      for (let n = 0; n < bytes.length; n += 0x8000) data += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(n, n + 0x8000));
      return btoa(data);
    };
    /** The profile's files: { path, full, size, mtime } (mtime: milliseconds, undefined when the file system has none). */
    function list(root = '/userdata', prefix = '', out = []) {
      for (const name of FS.readdir(root)) {
        if (name === '.' || name === '..' || name.toLowerCase() === 'screenshots' || /\.log(?:\.\d+)?$/i.test(name)) continue;
        const full = `${root}/${name}`, relative = prefix + name, st = FS.stat(full);
        if (FS.isDir(st.mode)) list(full, relative + '/', out);
        else if (FS.isFile(st.mode)) {
          const t = typeof st.mtime?.getTime === 'function' ? st.mtime.getTime() : st.mtime;
          out.push({ path: relative, full, size: st.size, mtime: Number.isFinite(t) ? t : undefined });
        }
      }
      return out;
    }
    /**
     * The profile's files with their base64 and date (mtime, ms: kept by the account's copy — a device that restores
     * it tells the newest save, streamfs.js's guess of the save the player loads): a file read again only when its
     * size or date changed.
     */
    function collect(files = list()) {
      return files.map((f) => {
        const k = known.get(f.path), at = f.mtime !== undefined ? { mtime: f.mtime } : {};
        if (k && f.mtime !== undefined && k.size === f.size && k.mtime === f.mtime) return { path: f.path, data: k.data, ...at };
        const data = base64(FS.readFile(f.full));
        known.set(f.path, { size: f.size, mtime: f.mtime, data });
        return { path: f.path, data, ...at };
      });
    }
    /** The same files, with the same bytes, as the account last took (a file written again unchanged: the same). */
    const unchanged = (files) => !!sent && files.length === sent.size && files.every((f) => sent.get(f.path) === f.data);
    function clear(root = '/userdata') {
      for (const n of FS.readdir(root)) {
        if (n === '.' || n === '..') continue;
        const p = `${root}/${n}`;
        if (FS.isDir(FS.stat(p).mode)) { clear(p); FS.rmdir(p); } else FS.unlink(p);
      }
    }
    async function restore() {
      notify('saving');
      const r = await fetch(endpoint, { cache: 'no-store', headers: { 'X-Orthros-Player-Scope': scope } });
      if (!r.ok && r.status !== 404) throw new Error('Impossible de charger les sauvegardes du compte. Réessaie avant de jouer.');
      const remote = r.ok ? new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer()) : null;
      parent = r.ok ? r.headers.get('X-Orthros-Backup-Hash') : 'none';
      const local = savedState();
      if (local.dirty && local.parent !== parent) {
        blocked = true;
        throw new Error('Conflit de sauvegardes : cet appareil a des changements non envoyés et une autre partie existe en ligne. Garde cet onglet et sa copie locale.');
      }
      // A failed upload on this device can resume only if the cloud head has not moved.
      if (remote && !local.dirty) {
        const doc = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(await transform(remote, true)));
        if (doc.format !== 'orthros-profile' || doc.game !== game || !Array.isArray(doc.files)) throw new Error('Sauvegarde en ligne invalide.');
        for (const f of doc.files) if (typeof f.path !== 'string' || f.path.startsWith('/') || f.path.includes('\\') || f.path.split('/').some((p) => !p || p === '.' || p === '..')) throw new Error('Chemin de sauvegarde invalide.');
        clear();
        let undated = false;
        for (const f of doc.files) {
          const p = `/userdata/${f.path}`; FS.mkdirTree(p.slice(0, p.lastIndexOf('/')));
          FS.writeFile(p, Uint8Array.from(atob(f.data), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0)));
          // (its date as the account's copy kept it; a copy of an earlier page has none: the restore's)
          if (Number.isFinite(f.mtime) && typeof FS.utime === 'function') FS.utime(p, f.mtime, f.mtime); else undated = true;
        }
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => original(false, (e) => e ? reject(e) : resolve()));
        // (a file rewritten without its date — its date the restore's —: streamfs.js's guess of the save the player loads
        // (save-place.js chooseSave) does not trust the dates then)
        if (undated) window.orthrosProfileRestored = true;
      }
      remember(!!local.dirty);
      notify(local.dirty ? 'idle' : 'saved');
    }
    async function upload() {
      if (blocked) return;
      if (uploading) { queued = true; return; }
      uploading = true;
      try {
        const files = collect();
        if (lastHash !== null && unchanged(files)) { remember(false); return; }
        const raw = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({ format: 'orthros-profile', version: 1, game, files }));
        const hash = await digest(raw);
        if (hash === lastHash) { sent = new Map(files.map((f) => [f.path, f.data])); remember(false); return; }
        remember(true); notify('saving');
        const bytes = await transform(raw);
        const r = await fetch(endpoint, { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'X-Orthros-Player-Scope': scope, 'X-Orthros-Parent-Hash': parent, 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream' }, body: bytes });
        if (!r.ok) {
          if (r.status === 409 || r.status === 401) blocked = true;
          throw new Error(r.status === 409 ? 'Conflit : une autre sauvegarde existe en ligne. La copie locale est conservée ; synchronisation suspendue.' : 'Sauvegarde conservée sur cet appareil. Envoi au compte impossible ; garde cet onglet ouvert pour réessayer.');
        }
        parent = (await r.json()).hash; lastHash = hash; sent = new Map(files.map((f) => [f.path, f.data])); remember(false);
        notify('saved');
        return true;
      } catch (e) { notify(blocked && /Conflit/.test(e.message) ? 'conflict' : 'error', e.message); return false; }
      finally { uploading = false; if (queued) { queued = false; upload(); } }
    }
    FS.syncfs = (populate, callback) => original(populate, (err) => {
      if (err) return callback?.(err);
      if (populate) {
        restore().then(() => callback?.(null)).catch((e) => {
          blocked = true; notify(/Conflit/.test(e.message) ? 'conflict' : 'error', e.message);
          // Never start the engine with missing or conflicting account data.
          const panel = document.createElement('p'); panel.setAttribute('role', 'alert'); panel.textContent = e.message;
          document.body.prepend(panel);
        });
      } else { remember(true); pending = upload(); callback?.(null); }
    });
    // (the Orthros page leaves: what the engine wrote synced, then sent — answered with whether it reached the account)
    window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
      if (e.origin !== location.origin || e.source !== window.parent || e.data?.type !== 'orthros-flush') return;
      const answer = (ok) => window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'orthros-flushed', ok }, location.origin);
      if (blocked) { answer(false); return; }
      try { FS.syncfs(false, () => Promise.resolve(pending).then((ok) => answer(ok !== false && !blocked && !savedState().dirty), () => answer(false))); } catch { answer(false); }
    });
    window.addEventListener('online', () => { if (!blocked) upload(); });
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', (event) => {
      if (savedState().dirty || uploading) { event.preventDefault(); event.returnValue = ''; }
    });
  };
})();
```

`src/ports/openmw/frame-meter.js`:

```js
// Put into the OpenMW engine's pages by the Orthros server (src/host/server.js): what the Orthros page around the
// engine shows in its header — the frame rate (a frame: an animation frame in which the engine drew) and whether the
// game has the mouse — and on its loading screen (the engine's download). Told to the page by messages of its origin;
// nothing changes in the engine. The frames' last measure is the engine page's too (window.orthrosFrames: its view
// distance's growth holds while frames are long, view-grow.js).
(() => {
  const framed = window.parent !== window;
  const tell = (m) => { if (framed) window.parent.postMessage(m, location.origin); };
  let draws = 0, seen = 0, frames = [], glc = null;
  // (an engine drawing on its own thread, OPENMW_ORTHROS_DRAWTHREAD: no WebGL call on this page — its frames are the
  // pictures it hands to the page, window.__omwDrawThreadFrames; no GPU time then, gl() stays null)
  const drawn = () => draws + (window.__omwDrawThreadFrames ?? 0);
  for (const type of [window.WebGL2RenderingContext, window.WebGLRenderingContext]) {
    if (!type) continue;
    for (const method of ['drawArrays', 'drawElements', 'drawArraysInstanced', 'drawElementsInstanced', 'drawRangeElements']) {
      const original = type.prototype[method]; if (!original) continue;
      type.prototype[method] = function (...args) { draws++; glc = this; return original.apply(this, args); };
    }
  }
  const tick = (t) => { const d = drawn(); if (d !== seen) { seen = d; frames.push(t); } requestAnimationFrame(tick); };
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  // the engine's frame timed whole (its pump, Module._omw_pump_frame): `done(ms, suspendedMs)` once it ended — a frame
  // that suspends while it waits for the game's files (the Orthros build's JSPI, orthros-r20.patch) returns a promise
  // and ends when it settles, its time then the whole of it, `suspendedMs` the part the engine stood suspended
  // (Module.orthrosSuspendedMs) —; `f` timed returned (the bench hooks below, tools/openmw/perf.mjs)
  window.orthrosFrameTimer = (f, done) => function (...a) {
    const M = window.Module, t0 = performance.now(), s0 = M?.orthrosSuspendedMs ?? 0;
    const end = () => { try { done(performance.now() - t0, (M?.orthrosSuspendedMs ?? 0) - s0); } catch { /* the meter's */ } };
    let r;
    try { r = f.apply(this, a); } catch (e) { end(); throw e; }
    if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') r.then(end, end); else end();
    return r;
  };
  setInterval(() => {
    const now = performance.now(); frames = frames.filter((t) => t > now - 1000);
    const recent = frames.filter((t) => t > now - 500), gaps = recent.slice(1).map((t, i) => t - recent[i]).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const m = { type: 'orthros-frames', fps: recent.length * 2, max: gaps.at(-1) ?? 0, p99: gaps[Math.floor(gaps.length * 0.99)] ?? 0, total: drawn() > 0 };
    window.orthrosFrames = m; tell(m);
  }, 500);
  // the bench suite around this page (src/host/web/bench-suite.js, ?benchrun=): what its frame measurement and scripted
  // input use (page-meter.js hooks) — the engine's work a frame (its pump, Module._omw_pump_frame, timed), its debug
  // teleport, its data reads waited for (streamfs.js)
  if (/[?&]benchrun=/.test(location.search)) {
    let workMs = 0;
    const wrap = setInterval(() => {
      const M = window.Module, f = M?._omw_pump_frame; if (!f || f.orthrosTimed) return;
      const timed = window.orthrosFrameTimer(f, (ms) => { workMs += ms; });
      timed.orthrosTimed = true; M._omw_pump_frame = timed; clearInterval(wrap);
    }, 100);
    window.orthrosBenchHooks = {
      workMs: () => (window.Module?._omw_pump_frame?.orthrosTimed ? workMs : undefined),
      teleport: (x, y, z) => window.Module?._omw_debug_teleport?.(x, y, z),
      data: () => { const s = window.__streamfsStats; return s ? { waits: s.misses ?? 0, waitMs: s.stallMs ?? 0, bytes: s.fetchedBytes ?? 0 } : null; },
    };
  }
  // the passive session record (src/host/web/perf-page.js, docs/real-machine-bench.md "Passive session records"): the
  // engine's frames (browser frames with draws), its GPU time on its context, the game data's waits (streamfs.js),
  // the phase (loading, the menus, the world: view-grow.js), the quality tier (tier.js) and the browser's storage — the
  // Orthros page's (play.js asks persistence as the game starts), else this page's own, asked here
  Promise.all([import('/src/host/web/perf-page.js'), import('/src/ports/openmw/view-grow.js'), import('/src/host/web/storage-persist.js')]).then(([perf, view, sp]) => {
    const id = decodeURIComponent(location.pathname.split('/')[3] ?? '');
    let storage = null; try { storage = framed ? window.parent.orthrosStorage ?? null : null; } catch { /* another origin */ }
    if (!storage) { storage = sp.pageStorage(); storage.ask(); }
    window.orthrosPerf = perf.portPerf({ runtime: 'openmw', game: id, session: Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 14), version: null, bench: new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('benchrun'),
      tier: () => window.orthrosTierChoice?.tier ?? null, phase: () => (!drawn() ? 'loading' : view.inWorld(window) ? 'world' : 'menu'),
      data: () => perf.portDataSummary(window.StreamFS?.data?.() ?? null),
      gl: () => glc, draws: drawn, storage });
  }).catch((e) => console.warn('[orthros perf]', e));
  // the engine's loading status (Module.setStatus, src/host/openmw.js): its package download, "Downloading data...
  // (x/y)" many times a second (a few told), then "Running..."
  if (!framed) return;
  let told = 0;
  window.orthrosStatus = (text) => {
    if (!text) return;
    const now = performance.now(), got = /\((\d+)\/(\d+)\)/.exec(text);
    if (got && +got[1] < +got[2] && now - told < 250) return;   // (the last one always: the download's end)
    told = now; tell({ type: 'orthros-status', text: String(text) });
  };
  const lock = () => tell({ type: 'orthros-pointer', locked: !!document.pointerLockElement });
  document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange', lock);
  // (the page asks: the game gets the mouse — a click on its canvas does the same)
  window.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
    if (e.origin !== location.origin || e.source !== window.parent || e.data?.type !== 'orthros-capture') return;
    const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); canvas?.focus(); canvas?.requestPointerLock?.()?.catch?.(() => {});
  });
  lock();
})();
```

`src/ports/openmw/input-keys.js`:

```js
// The keyboard layout every OpenMW player gets on Orthros: Activate on E, Jump on Space. The engine's defaults are that
// since orthros-r9.patch (Morrowind's own were the reverse: Activate on Space, Jump on E). A player's saved bindings
// (input_v3.xml in the engine's user config, written when the Options window closes, kept on the account) may still
// hold the old pair: swapped once, before the engine reads them, when Activate is on Space and Jump on E exactly — any
// other layout is the player's own choice and stays. A marker file beside them records that the file was looked at,
// so the old pair chosen again later in Options stays too. Other bindings, mouse and controller ones, are untouched.
// Loaded by the engine page before its engine starts (src/host/openmw.js withInputKeys); the page calls
// window.orthrosInputKeys(FS) once its user files are in place (IDBFS and the account's copy restored).

export const INPUT_FILE = '/userdata/config/openmw/input_v3.xml';
export const MARK_FILE = '/userdata/config/openmw/orthros-input.json';
/** MWInput::Actions (apps/openmw/mwinput/actions.hpp): the controls' names in the file */
export const ACTIVATE = 9, JUMP = 11;
/** SDL scancodes */
export const SPACE = 44, E = 8;

/**
 * The bindings file `xml` with the old pair swapped (Activate's key E, Jump's Space), or null when it does not hold
 * exactly that pair. Only the two `key` attributes change: the file stays as the engine (ICS, TinyXML) wrote it.
 */
export function swapOldPair(xml) {
  const keyOf = (name) => {
    // (a control's element: <Control name="N" …> its binders </Control>; one without bindings is self-closing)
    for (const open of xml.matchAll(/<Control\b[^>]*>/g)) {
      if (open[0].endsWith('/>') || !new RegExp(`\\sname="${name}"`).test(open[0])) continue;
      const start = open.index + open[0].length, end = xml.indexOf('</Control>', start);
      if (end < 0) return null;
      for (const b of xml.slice(start, end).matchAll(/<KeyBinder\b[^>]*>/g)) {
        if (!/\sdirection="INCREASE"/.test(b[0])) continue;
        const key = /\skey="(\d+)"/.exec(b[0]);
        if (!key) return null;
        return { key: Number(key[1]), at: start + b.index + key.index, text: key[0] };
      }
      return null;
    }
    return null;
  };
  const activate = keyOf(ACTIVATE), jump = keyOf(JUMP);
  if (activate?.key !== SPACE || jump?.key !== E) return null;
  // (the later one first: the earlier one's offset stays right)
  const edits = [[activate, E], [jump, SPACE]].sort((a, b) => b[0].at - a[0].at);
  let out = xml;
  for (const [b, key] of edits) out = out.slice(0, b.at) + ` key="${key}"` + out.slice(b.at + b.text.length);
  return out;
}

/**
 * The player's saved bindings brought to the layout, once (`FS`: the engine's Emscripten file system, its user files
 * loaded). Returns what it did: 'done' (looked at in an earlier session), 'none' (no saved bindings: the engine's
 * defaults apply — nothing recorded, a file written later is looked at then), 'swapped' or 'kept' (recorded).
 */
export function migrate(FS, now = () => new Date().toISOString()) {
  if (FS.analyzePath(MARK_FILE).exists) return 'done';
  if (!FS.analyzePath(INPUT_FILE).exists) return 'none';
  const swapped = swapOldPair(FS.readFile(INPUT_FILE, { encoding: 'utf8' }));
  if (swapped !== null) FS.writeFile(INPUT_FILE, swapped);
  FS.writeFile(MARK_FILE, JSON.stringify({ keys: 'activate-e-jump-space', result: swapped !== null ? 'swapped' : 'kept', at: now() }) + '\n');
  return swapped !== null ? 'swapped' : 'kept';
}

// Second change of the layout (orthros-r23.patch): Toggle POV on V, Tab left free (in Vanilla+ a UI Modes overlay opens the
// inventory with it, as I). A saved file whose Toggle POV is on Tab gets it on V, once, when no control uses V already.
export const POV_MARK_FILE = '/userdata/config/openmw/orthros-input-pov.json';
export const TOGGLE_POV = 30;
export const TAB = 43, V = 25;

/** The bindings file `xml` with Toggle POV moved from Tab to V, or null when it is not on Tab or V is taken. */
export function movePov(xml) {
  const binders = [];
  for (const open of xml.matchAll(/<Control\b[^>]*>/g)) {
    if (open[0].endsWith('/>')) continue;
    const name = /\sname="(\d+)"/.exec(open[0]);
    const start = open.index + open[0].length, end = xml.indexOf('</Control>', start);
    if (!name || end < 0) return null;
    for (const b of xml.slice(start, end).matchAll(/<KeyBinder\b[^>]*>/g)) {
      const key = /\skey="(\d+)"/.exec(b[0]);
      if (key) binders.push({ control: Number(name[1]), key: Number(key[1]), increase: /\sdirection="INCREASE"/.test(b[0]), at: start + b.index + key.index, text: key[0] });
    }
  }
  const pov = binders.find((b) => b.control === TOGGLE_POV && b.increase);
  if (pov?.key !== TAB || binders.some((b) => b.key === V)) return null;
  return xml.slice(0, pov.at) + ` key="${V}"` + xml.slice(pov.at + pov.text.length);
}

/** The saved bindings' Toggle POV moved from Tab to V, once (as migrate: 'done', 'none', 'moved' or 'kept'). */
export function migratePov(FS, now = () => new Date().toISOString()) {
  if (FS.analyzePath(POV_MARK_FILE).exists) return 'done';
  if (!FS.analyzePath(INPUT_FILE).exists) return 'none';
  const moved = movePov(FS.readFile(INPUT_FILE, { encoding: 'utf8' }));
  if (moved !== null) FS.writeFile(INPUT_FILE, moved);
  FS.writeFile(POV_MARK_FILE, JSON.stringify({ keys: 'toggle-pov-v', result: moved !== null ? 'moved' : 'kept', at: now() }) + '\n');
  return moved !== null ? 'moved' : 'kept';
}

// Third change (orthros-r24.patch, the owner, 2026-11-08): Left Shift is the sprint's (RUN!, a mod's action, its key
// given by the version), walking and running toggled with Left Alt. A saved file whose Run (held) is on Left Shift loses
// that key, and its Always Run toggle on Caps Lock moves to Left Alt when no control uses Left Alt; once.
export const RUN_MARK_FILE = '/userdata/config/openmw/orthros-input-run.json';
export const RUN = 17, ALWAYS_RUN = 23;
export const LSHIFT = 225, LALT = 226, CAPSLOCK = 57;

/** The bindings file `xml` with Run's Left Shift dropped and Always Run moved from Caps Lock to Left Alt (when free), or null: nothing to change. */
export function moveRun(xml) {
  const binders = [];
  for (const open of xml.matchAll(/<Control\b[^>]*>/g)) {
    if (open[0].endsWith('/>')) continue;
    const name = /\sname="(\d+)"/.exec(open[0]);
    const start = open.index + open[0].length, end = xml.indexOf('</Control>', start);
    if (!name || end < 0) return null;
    for (const b of xml.slice(start, end).matchAll(/[ \t]*<KeyBinder\b[^>]*>\r?\n?/g)) {
      const key = /\skey="(\d+)"/.exec(b[0]);
      if (key) binders.push({ control: Number(name[1]), key: Number(key[1]), increase: /\sdirection="INCREASE"/.test(b[0]), at: start + b.index, line: b[0], keyAt: start + b.index + key.index, keyText: key[0] });
    }
  }
  const edits = [];
  const run = binders.find((b) => b.control === RUN && b.key === LSHIFT);
  if (run) edits.push({ at: run.at, len: run.line.length, text: '' });
  const always = binders.find((b) => b.control === ALWAYS_RUN && b.increase && b.key === CAPSLOCK);
  if (always && !binders.some((b) => b.key === LALT)) edits.push({ at: always.keyAt, len: always.keyText.length, text: ` key="${LALT}"` });
  if (!edits.length) return null;
  let out = xml;
  for (const e of edits.sort((x, y) => y.at - x.at)) out = out.slice(0, e.at) + e.text + out.slice(e.at + e.len);
  return out;
}

/** The saved bindings' Run off Left Shift and Always Run on Left Alt, once ('done', 'none', 'moved' or 'kept'). */
export function migrateRun(FS, now = () => new Date().toISOString()) {
  if (FS.analyzePath(RUN_MARK_FILE).exists) return 'done';
  if (!FS.analyzePath(INPUT_FILE).exists) return 'none';
  const moved = moveRun(FS.readFile(INPUT_FILE, { encoding: 'utf8' }));
  if (moved !== null) FS.writeFile(INPUT_FILE, moved);
  FS.writeFile(RUN_MARK_FILE, JSON.stringify({ keys: 'run-shift-sprint-alt-toggle', result: moved !== null ? 'moved' : 'kept', at: now() }) + '\n');
  return moved !== null ? 'moved' : 'kept';
}

/** Into the engine page `win`: window.orthrosInputKeys(FS) for its user files' setup (never throws: the game starts). */
export function install(win = globalThis) {
  win.orthrosInputKeys = (FS) => {
    let pov = 'error';
    try { pov = migratePov(FS); } catch (e) { console.warn('[orthros keys]', e); }
    if (pov === 'moved') console.info('[orthros keys] saved bindings: Toggle POV on V');
    let run = 'error';
    try { run = migrateRun(FS); } catch (e) { console.warn('[orthros keys]', e); }
    if (run === 'moved') console.info('[orthros keys] saved bindings: Run off Left Shift, Always Run on Left Alt');
    try { return migrate(FS); } catch (e) { console.warn('[orthros keys]', e); return 'error'; }
  };
}
```

`src/ports/openmw/legacy-copies.js`:

```js
// The copies of an OpenMW installation's files that earlier versions of its page kept in this browser, taken into the
// game data every Orthros game reads (src/vfs/data-worker.js: the version's OPFS block store) before a file's first
// read, then removed — the player does not download again what is here. Imported by the data worker (adoptLegacy), told
// each mounted file by streamfs.js. The copies: Orthros' streaming of 2026-10-20 (OPFS orthros-streamfs-1/: a copy of
// each file at its offsets, <hash>.d, with a map of its 64 KB blocks, <hash>.m — a small file whole, no map) and the
// release's (Cache API mwdata-chunks-v1: 2 MB pieces).

const OLD_BLOCK = 65536, OLD_SMALL = 1 << 20, OLD_CHUNK = 2 << 20, RUN = 16 << 20;

/** The name an earlier page gave a file's copy (two 32-bit FNV-1a of its key). */
function oldName(key) {
  let h1 = 0x811c9dc5, h2 = 0x01000193 ^ key.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < key.length; i++) { const c = key.charCodeAt(i); h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ c, 0x01000193); h2 = Math.imul(h2 ^ c, 0x01000193) ^ (h2 >>> 13); }
  return (h1 >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0') + (h2 >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

/** What is there to take, listed once: the copies' directory and its names; the release's pieces by file. */
let kept = null;
function listing() {
  return (kept ??= (async () => {
    let dir = null; const names = new Set(), pieces = new Map();
    try { dir = await (await navigator.storage.getDirectory()).getDirectoryHandle('orthros-streamfs-1'); for await (const n of dir.keys()) names.add(n); } catch { dir = null; }
    let cache = null;
    if (await caches.has('mwdata-chunks-v1').catch(() => false)) {
      cache = await caches.open('mwdata-chunks-v1');
      for (const req of await cache.keys()) {
        const m = /^https:\/\/sfs\.chunk\/([^/]+)\/(\d+)$/.exec(req.url); if (!m) continue;
        const key = decodeURIComponent(m[1]), at = key.indexOf('@'); if (at < 0) continue;
        const url = key.slice(0, at);
        (pieces.get(url) ?? pieces.set(url, []).get(url)).push({ req, key, at: Number(m[2]) });
      }
    }
    return { dir, names, cache, pieces };
  })());
}

/**
 * The copies of one file ({ url: its URL path, size, mtime: as the engine page mounted it }), handed to keep(at, bytes)
 * and removed.
 */
export async function adopt({ url, size, mtime }, keep) {
  const { dir, names, cache, pieces } = await listing();
  const base = oldName(`${url}@${size}@${mtime}`);
  if (dir && names.has(base + '.d')) {
    const copy = await (await dir.getFileHandle(base + '.d')).getFile();
    if (size <= OLD_SMALL) { if (copy.size === size) keep(0, new Uint8Array(await copy.arrayBuffer())); }
    else if (names.has(base + '.m')) {
      const map = new Uint8Array(await (await (await dir.getFileHandle(base + '.m')).getFile()).arrayBuffer());
      const blocks = Math.ceil(size / OLD_BLOCK), here = (k) => (map[k >> 3] >> (k & 7)) & 1;
      for (let k = 0; k < blocks;) {
        if (!here(k)) { k++; continue; }
        let e = k; while (e + 1 < blocks && here(e + 1) && (e + 1 - k) * OLD_BLOCK < RUN) e++;
        const at = k * OLD_BLOCK, end = Math.min(size, (e + 1) * OLD_BLOCK);
        if (end <= copy.size) keep(at, new Uint8Array(await copy.slice(at, end).arrayBuffer()));
        k = e + 1;
      }
    }
    for (const n of [base + '.d', base + '.m']) if (names.has(n)) { await dir.removeEntry(n).catch(() => {}); names.delete(n); }
  }
  for (const p of pieces.get(url) ?? []) {
    if (p.key.startsWith(`${url}@${size}@`) && p.key.endsWith(`@${OLD_CHUNK}`)) {
      const hit = await cache.match(p.req);
      const b = hit ? new Uint8Array(await hit.arrayBuffer()) : null;
      if (b && b.length === Math.min(OLD_CHUNK, size - p.at)) keep(p.at, b);
    }
    await cache.delete(p.req).catch(() => {});
  }
  pieces.delete(url);
}
```

`src/ports/openmw/place-lead.js`:

```js
// The OpenMW engine page's guesses of the player's next place in play (docs/openmw.md "In play: crossings and doors"):
// the learned set (GET /api/places, what the engine announced when some player loaded that place) of the exterior grid
// the player is heading into — the cell after the one just entered, in the same direction: a whole cell's walk ahead
// (~27 s at a run), where the engine's own preload starts ~4 s before the crossing —, fetched by the page (streamfs.js)
// at the place's priority (GameData.want `prio: 'place'`: the link's idle time only, below the game's reads, a load's
// and the launch set). No engine change: the cell comes from view.lua's report. No door guess: standing at a door gives
// under a second of warning where a guess needs ~10 s at 300 KB/s to save anything, and each door passed would spend
// the session's bounds (docs/openmw.md, the door runs). Bounded for thin links:
// a guess takes its set's meshes and terrain only — never textures (a wrong guess on a mod's textures costs tens of MB;
// the load reads them, light first on a link that is not fast) —, LEAD.bytes of them at most, each place once a
// session, LEAD.sessionBytes in all; a place the server never learned costs one small GET. Off unless the page asks
// (?lead=1): measured, the learned order already brings a taught row before the player (docs/openmw.md, the A/B).

export const LEAD = {
  /** the kinds of a learned set a guess fetches (the server's list: [path, start, end, kind]) */
  kinds: ['meshes', 'terrain'],
  /** the most of the files' own bytes one guess asks for (a town's row of meshes: ~3-6 MB; the light copies are less) */
  bytes: 8 << 20,
  /** the most a session's guesses ask for in all (then none: a player wandering on a thin link pays nothing more) */
  sessionBytes: 64 << 20,
  /** the most places a session guesses (the GETs) */
  places: 64,
};

/** A view.lua cell report ('x y', '' inside) as [x, y], or null. */
export function parseCell(text) {
  const m = /^\s*(-?\d+)\s+(-?\d+)\s*$/.exec(String(text ?? ''));
  return m ? [Number(m[1]), Number(m[2])] : null;
}

/**
 * The exterior grid the player reaches next going on as they did: from the cell `prev` into its neighbour `cur` (view.lua
 * reports, 'x y'), the cell after `cur` the same way — the learned places' key 'x,y' (the grid centre the engine
 * announces a crossing for: the player's cell). null when the step was no neighbour's (a teleport, a door, a load).
 */
export function nextRow(prev, cur) {
  const a = parseCell(prev), b = parseCell(cur);
  if (!a || !b) return null;
  const dx = b[0] - a[0], dy = b[1] - a[1];
  if ((!dx && !dy) || Math.abs(dx) > 1 || Math.abs(dy) > 1) return null;
  return `${b[0] + dx},${b[1] + dy}`;
}

/**
 * A guess's entries from the server's list ([[path, start, end, kind]], or under `list`): `kinds` only, in the list's
 * order, cut once `bytes` of the files' own would pass (`size(path)`: the file's size, null when the tree has no such
 * file — left out). [{ path, off, len }] (len -1: to the file's end) and their bytes.
 */
export function leadEntries(doc, { kinds = LEAD.kinds, bytes = LEAD.bytes, size }) {
  const list = Array.isArray(doc) ? doc : Array.isArray(doc?.list) ? doc.list : [];
  const out = [];
  let n = 0;
  for (const x of list) {
    const [p, a, b, kind] = Array.isArray(x) ? x : [x?.path, x?.start, x?.end, x?.kind];
    if (typeof p !== 'string' || !kinds.includes(kind)) continue;
    const s = size(p);
    if (s === null || s === undefined) continue;
    const off = Math.max(0, Number(a) || 0), end = b === undefined || b === null || Number(b) < 0 ? s : Math.min(s, Number(b));
    if (!(end > off)) continue;
    if (n + end - off > bytes) break;
    n += end - off;
    out.push({ path: p, off, len: end === s ? -1 : end - off });
  }
  return { entries: out, bytes: n };
}

/**
 * The guesses of one page: `look(state)` at each poll with the engine's reports (window.omw.state) returns the places to
 * ask now — the next row after a crossing —, each place once;
 * `spent(bytes)` counts what a guess asked (LEAD.sessionBytes in all, then nothing more is guessed). `snapshot()`: the
 * counters (guessed, bytes, the last places).
 */
export function createLead(limits = LEAD) {
  const s = { cell: null, asked: new Set(), bytes: 0, last: [] };
  const fresh = (place) => place && !s.asked.has(place) && s.asked.size < limits.places && s.bytes < limits.sessionBytes;
  return {
    look(state) {
      const out = [], cell = state?.['orthros.cell'];
      if (typeof cell === 'string' && cell !== s.cell) {
        const next = nextRow(s.cell, cell);
        s.cell = cell;
        if (fresh(next)) out.push(next);
      }
      for (const p of out) { s.asked.add(p); s.last.push(p); if (s.last.length > 8) s.last.shift(); }
      return out;
    },
    spent(bytes) { s.bytes += Math.max(0, Number(bytes) || 0); },
    snapshot() { return { guessed: s.asked.size, bytes: s.bytes, last: [...s.last] }; },
  };
}
```

```js
/** Back to the games: the engine's page sends what is not on the account yet (cloud.js), 15 s at most. */
function flush() {
  if (session.state !== 'running' || mode !== 'solo' || !shell.account || !frame.contentWindow) return Promise.resolve(true);
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const done = (ok) => { removeEventListener('message', on); clearTimeout(t); resolve(ok); };
    const on = (e) => { if (e.source === frame.contentWindow && e.data?.type === 'orthros-flushed') done(!!e.data.ok); };
    const t = setTimeout(() => done(false), 15000);
    addEventListener('message', on);
    frame.contentWindow.postMessage({ type: 'orthros-flush' }, location.origin);
  });
}
```

`src/ports/openmw/save-place.js`:

```js
// Where an OpenMW saved game loads (docs/openmw.md "Anticipated places"), read from the save itself without the engine:
// the page predicts the place the player will load from the menu and fetches that place's files (the server's learned
// place sets, GET /api/places) while the engine boots and the player sits in the menu. The place's key is the engine's
// own (orthros-r10.patch: its announced reads' labels '<kind>:<place>'): 'x,y' for an exterior cell — the grid centre
// the engine announces for, the player's cell —, the interior's id lowercased as the engine lowercases it (ASCII only,
// Misc::StringUtils::lowerCase).
//
// The save (.omwsave, components/esm3): records of a 16-byte header (name, u32 size, u32, u32 flags), each a run of
// subrecords (name, u32 size); strings UTF-8 without a terminator, their length the subrecord's. The TES3 header first
// (FORM: the format version, 0 when absent), then SAVE (savedgame.cpp: PLNA player, PLLE level, PLCE the cell's display
// name — localized, a region's name for an unnamed exterior: no key —, TIME played, DESC, DEPE content files…), then the
// world's records; PLAY (player.cpp) holds the player's cell just before LKEP: format > 26 a NAME RefId (u8 tag: 6 an
// exterior cell, int32 x, int32 y; 2 a string to the subrecord's end; 1 a u32 length and the string), up to 26 the old
// CellId (SPAC the worldspace or the interior's name, CIDX int32 x, y for an exterior).
// No state here: the page (streamfs.js) holds what it found; the hint is the browser's storage, read each time.

/** Where the engine page keeps its saves (IDBFS, one folder per character): the engine's user data folder (r8, seen), its XDG data home's. */
export const SAVES_DIRS = ['/userdata/saves', '/userdata/data-home/openmw/saves'];
/** The last format whose PLAY cell is the old CellId (SPAC, CIDX) — components/esm3/formatversion.hpp MaxUseEsmCellIdFormatVersion. */
const MAX_CELLID_FORMAT = 26;
/** A save's records are walked up to this many (PLAY comes after the journal, dialogue and scripts' records: a few thousand). */
const MAX_RECORDS = 200000;
/** A save this much newer than the hint is newer (the hint of a save written: its own date; clocks of one page). */
const HINT_SLACK_MS = 2000;
/** The SAVE record's subrecords not read (the screenshot: tens of KB a save). */
const SAVE_SKIP = new Set(['SCRN']);

const text = (bytes) => new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
/** ASCII-only lower case, as the engine's (an interior id's accented letters stay as they are). */
export const engineLower = (s) => String(s).replace(/[A-Z]+/g, (m) => m.toLowerCase());

/**
 * The place a RefId of a save's PLAY record names (`b`: its bytes): 'x,y' (an exterior cell of ESM3), the lowercased
 * interior id, or null (another kind of id: no place of ours).
 */
function refIdPlace(b) {
  if (!b.length) return null;
  const v = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.byteLength);
  if (b[0] === 6 && b.length >= 9) return `${v.getInt32(1, true)},${v.getInt32(5, true)}`;
  if (b[0] === 2) return engineLower(text(b.subarray(1))) || null;
  if (b[0] === 1 && b.length >= 5) return engineLower(text(b.subarray(5, 5 + v.getUint32(1, true)))) || null;
  return null;
}

/**
 * A save's header and place: { format, player, level, cellName, timePlayed, desc, contentFiles, place } (place null:
 * no PLAY record, or a cell of another kind), or null when it is no OpenMW save (not TES3 then SAVE, cut short). `src`:
 * the save's bytes, or a reader { size, read(at, n) → Uint8Array of up to n bytes at `at` } — only the records' headers
 * and the TES3, SAVE and PLAY records' bodies are read (not the screenshot nor the world's records before PLAY).
 * @param {Uint8Array | { size: number, read: (at: number, n: number) => Uint8Array }} src
 */
export function parseSave(src) {
  const r = src instanceof Uint8Array ? { size: src.length, read: (at, k) => src.subarray(at, at + k) } : src;
  if (!r || !(r.size >= 32) || typeof r.read !== 'function') return null;
  const n = r.size;
  const name = (b, at) => String.fromCharCode(b[at], b[at + 1], b[at + 2], b[at + 3]);
  /** the record at `at`: { name, size } of its 16-byte header, or null past the end */
  const head = (at) => {
    if (at + 16 > n) return null;
    const b = r.read(at, 16);
    return b.length < 16 ? null : { name: name(b, 0), size: new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, 16).getUint32(4, true) };
  };
  /**
   * the subrecords of the record at `at` (`h` its header): [name, data] in order — those named in `skip` passed over by
   * their headers, their bodies not read (the SAVE record's screenshot)
   */
  const subs = function* (at, h, skip = null) {
    const end = Math.min(n, at + 16 + h.size);
    if (!skip) {
      const bytes = r.read(at + 16, end - at - 16), m = bytes.length, v = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, m);
      for (let p = 0; p + 8 <= m;) {
        const size = v.getUint32(p + 4, true);
        if (p + 8 + size > m) return;
        yield [name(bytes, p), bytes.subarray(p + 8, p + 8 + size)];
        p += 8 + size;
      }
      return;
    }
    for (let p = at + 16; p + 8 <= end;) {
      const sh = r.read(p, 8);
      if (sh.length < 8) return;
      const s = name(sh, 0), size = new DataView(sh.buffer, sh.byteOffset, 8).getUint32(4, true);
      if (p + 8 + size > end) return;
      yield [s, skip.has(s) ? new Uint8Array(0) : r.read(p + 8, size)];
      p += 8 + size;
    }
  };
  let h = head(0);
  if (h?.name !== 'TES3') return null;
  const info = { format: 0, player: '', level: 0, cellName: '', timePlayed: 0, desc: '', contentFiles: [], place: null };
  for (const [s, d] of subs(0, h)) if (s === 'FORM' && d.length >= 4) info.format = new DataView(d.buffer, d.byteOffset, 4).getUint32(0, true);
  let at = 16 + h.size;
  h = head(at);
  if (h?.name !== 'SAVE') return null;
  for (const [s, d] of subs(at, h, SAVE_SKIP)) {
    const dv = new DataView(d.buffer, d.byteOffset, d.byteLength);
    if (s === 'PLNA') info.player = text(d);
    else if (s === 'PLLE' && d.length >= 4) info.level = dv.getInt32(0, true);
    else if (s === 'PLCE') info.cellName = text(d);
    else if (s === 'TIME' && d.length >= 8) info.timePlayed = dv.getFloat64(0, true);
    else if (s === 'DESC') info.desc = text(d);
    else if (s === 'DEPE') info.contentFiles.push(text(d));
  }
  // (the world's records skipped by their sizes up to PLAY; its cell: the NAME — the old SPAC/CIDX — just before LKEP,
  // the object state's own NAME subrecords (the player's reference id) before it)
  for (let k = 0; k < MAX_RECORDS; k++) {
    at += 16 + h.size;
    h = head(at);
    if (!h) break;
    if (h.name !== 'PLAY') continue;
    let last = null, spac = null, cidx = null;
    for (const [s, d] of subs(at, h)) {
      if (s === 'NAME') last = d;
      else if (s === 'SPAC') { spac = d; cidx = null; } else if (s === 'CIDX' && d.length >= 8) cidx = d;
      else if (s === 'LKEP') {
        if (info.format > MAX_CELLID_FORMAT) info.place = last ? refIdPlace(last) : null;
        else if (cidx) { const dv = new DataView(cidx.buffer, cidx.byteOffset, 8); info.place = `${dv.getInt32(0, true)},${dv.getInt32(4, true)}`; }
        else info.place = spac ? engineLower(text(spac)) || null : null;
        break;
      }
    }
    break;
  }
  return info;
}

/**
 * A reader of the file at `path` of Emscripten's FS `fs` (parseSave's: its bytes read where asked, FS.read — not the
 * whole save copied, FS.readFile —), and its close; an FS without open/read: its readFile's bytes.
 */
function fileReader(fs, path, size) {
  if (typeof fs.open !== 'function' || typeof fs.read !== 'function') { const b = fs.readFile(path); return { size: b.length, read: (at, k) => b.subarray(at, at + k), close() {} }; }
  const stream = fs.open(path, 'r');
  return {
    size,
    read(at, k) { const b = new Uint8Array(Math.max(0, Math.min(k, size - at))); const got = fs.read(stream, b, 0, b.length, at); return got < b.length ? b.subarray(0, got) : b; },
    close() { try { fs.close(stream); } catch { /* closed */ } },
  };
}

/**
 * The saves the engine page holds (`fs`: Emscripten's FS), each parsed: [{ path, character, mtime (ms), info }] —
 * those that are no save (parseSave null) left out. `dirs`: the saves folders (SAVES_DIRS), each one folder per
 * character; `since`: only those written after it (ms; the others not read).
 */
export function listSaves(fs, dirs = SAVES_DIRS, since = -Infinity) {
  const out = [];
  const ls = (d) => { try { return fs.readdir(d).filter((x) => x !== '.' && x !== '..'); } catch { return []; } };
  for (const dir of dirs) {
    for (const character of ls(dir)) {
      for (const file of ls(`${dir}/${character}`)) {
        if (!/\.omwsave$/i.test(file)) continue;
        const path = `${dir}/${character}/${file}`;
        try {
          const st = fs.stat(path), t = st.mtime?.getTime?.() ?? Number(st.mtime), mtime = Number.isFinite(t) ? t : 0;
          if (!(mtime > since)) continue;
          const r = fileReader(fs, path, Number(st.size) || 0);
          let info = null;
          try { info = parseSave(r); } finally { r.close(); }
          if (info) out.push({ path, character, mtime, info });
        } catch { /* unreadable: left out */ }
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * The save the player will most likely load, and its place: { save, place, why } — why 'hint': the place the page
 * remembered (where the last game the page loaded from the menu started, or of the last save written: placeHint) is a
 * save's, and no save is newer than the hint (by HINT_SLACK_MS; a save written since — in another tab, on another device
 * — says more); 'newest': the newest save by date — not when the profile was just restored from the account without
 * its dates (`restored`: their dates the restore's) —; 'time': the most time played. Null without a save that names a place.
 * @param {{ path: string, mtime: number, info: { place: string|null, timePlayed: number } }[]} saves
 * @param {{ hint?: { place: string, at: number }|string|null, restored?: boolean }} o
 */
export function chooseSave(saves, { hint = null, restored = false } = {}) {
  const ok = saves.filter((s) => s.info?.place);
  if (!ok.length) return null;
  const best = (list, score) => list.reduce((a, b) => (score(b) > score(a) ? b : a));
  const newest = (x) => x.mtime + x.info.timePlayed * 1e-9;
  const h = typeof hint === 'string' ? { place: hint, at: 0 } : hint;
  if (h?.place) {
    const there = ok.filter((x) => x.info.place === h.place);
    if (there.length && (restored || !ok.some((x) => x.mtime > (Number(h.at) || 0) + HINT_SLACK_MS))) return { save: best(there, newest), place: h.place, why: 'hint' };
  }
  const s = restored ? best(ok, (x) => x.info.timePlayed) : best(ok, newest);
  return { save: s, place: s.info.place, why: restored ? 'time' : 'newest' };
}
/** The place an announced batch's label names ('<kind>:<place>', orthros-r10.patch): { kind, place }, or null. */
export function labelPlace(label) {
  const m = /^(meshes|textures|terrain):(.+)$/s.exec(String(label ?? ''));
  return m ? { kind: m[1], place: m[2] } : null;
}

/**
 * The place the player last started from the menu or saved at, per installation (localStorage
 * 'orthros.place.<manifest>': { place, at (ms, the page's clock: the save's date, or the load's) } as JSON — a bare place
 * of an earlier page: at 0): set by the page at the first load of a session the engine announces and at each save it
 * writes (streamfs.js). `storage`: the page's (null: none).
 */
// snapshot: no state — the browser's storage, read each time
export const placeHint = {
  /** @returns {{ place: string, at: number } | null} */
  get(manifest, storage = globalThis.localStorage) {
    let v = null;
    try { v = storage?.getItem(`orthros.place.${manifest}`) || null; } catch { return null; }
    if (!v) return null;
    try { const o = JSON.parse(v); if (o && typeof o.place === 'string' && o.place) return { place: o.place, at: Number(o.at) || 0 }; } catch { /* a bare place */ }
    return { place: v, at: 0 };
  },
  set(manifest, place, storage = globalThis.localStorage, at = Date.now()) {
    if (place) try { storage?.setItem(`orthros.place.${manifest}`, JSON.stringify({ place: String(place).slice(0, 128), at: Number(at) || 0 })); } catch { /* storage off */ }
  },
};
```

`src/ports/openmw/streamfs.js`:

```js
// The OpenMW engine page's file streaming (its StreamFS interface: init, mount, mountLocal, mountBlob, setUrl, stats,
// window.__streamfsStats; and data, for the page's view distance, view-grow.js — src/host/openmw.js swaps the
// release's streamfs.js for this file): the installation's files from the game data every Orthros game reads
// (src/vfs/data-client.js, emscripten-files.js — CLAUDE.md "Standardization"), the engine's own mounts mapped onto the
// version's tree: mwdata/<file> → <file>, mwdata/mods/<part>/<file> → mods/<part>/<file>, moddata/<file> →
// _engine/<file> (the engine release's asset pack, a data mount of the manifest). Files of elsewhere (a signed address, a file the player picked, a Blob) go through the same worker. A copy
// an earlier page kept of a file (legacy-copies.js) is taken before its first read. The player first in the world marks
// the session playable (GameData.mark). The places the engine announces it loads are learned by the server
// (POST /api/places), and the place the player's saved game will load is predicted from the saves and fetched while
// the engine boots and the player sits in the menu (docs/openmw.md "Anticipated places", save-place.js); in play, the
// learned set of the next exterior row is fetched ahead the same way (docs/openmw.md "In
// play: crossings and doors", place-lead.js).
(() => {
  'use strict';
  // (a classic script — the page calls StreamFS synchronously — loading the shared modules at once: they are here long
  // before the engine's first mount, which comes after its own requests)
  const modules = Promise.all([import('/src/vfs/data-client.js'), import('/src/vfs/emscripten-files.js'), import('/src/ports/openmw/view-grow.js'), import('/src/ports/openmw/save-place.js'), import('/src/ports/openmw/boot-reads.js')]);

  const PLACE_ENTRIES = 8192;

  const LEAD_POLL_MS = 500;
  /** how often the engine page is looked at for the end of its mounts (announceBoot), and for how long at most */
  const MOUNTS_POLL_MS = 100, MOUNTS_WAIT_MS = 120000;

  /** A parameter of the page (this engine page's, else the play page's around it: same origin), or null. */
  function pageParam(key) {
    const of = (w) => { try { return new URLSearchParams(w.location.search).get(key); } catch { return null; } };
    return of(window) ?? (window.parent && window.parent !== window ? of(window.parent) : null);
  }

  /** The tree path of an engine mount's URL (one of this installation's served files), or null. */
  function treePath(url) {

   * when that report changes — a file queued twice counted twice until then).
   */
  function reloadBacklog() {

    if (done !== q.seen) { q.seen = done; q.queued = 0; }

  }

  /** The game data opened (once): its worker started, the version's tree, store and learned order's list asked. */

    // is not an unhandled rejection, the engine page's log opened on it; holdRun reports it at that need())

    return S.data;
  }

  function need() {

      S.data.budget = cacheBytes();

      if (S.packaged) S.data.prefetchNow();
      // (the engine's start held until the worker answered: its first reads wait synchronously, the page's thread
      // spinning, and Chrome hands a module worker the messages sent before its scripts ran through the page's thread —
      // a read before then is never answered: the engine's boot after a short manifest fetch, "the game data worker
      // stopped answering" 30 s later, the archive unreadable. The engine page's preRun holds its own dependencies until

      // multiplayer, which has no Orthros script, the world joined and simulated: view-grow.js inWorld — the game shown
      // in play, after the menu and the load): the launch set's mark, src/vfs/launch-set.js
      const inWorld = setInterval(() => { if (M.inWorld(window)) { clearInterval(inWorld); S.data.mark('playable'); } }, 500);
      // (a texture read light, its file here now: loaded again in place by an engine that can — the Orthros build's
      // orthros_file_updated, docs/slow-network.md "Engines that reload in place" —, that load choosing the file itself;
      // the rest of a load under way keeps the light copy: repick. Told with its bytes in the page — GameData.realInPage,
      // ?realinpage=0 on this page or the play page: told as they come, the engine's read waiting for the worker)
      const canReload = () => typeof Module !== 'undefined' && !!Module._orthros_file_updated;

        for (const k of keys) {

          if (!h || !S.data.lightRead(h)) continue;

          try { if (update) { if (update(at)) { reloadBacklog(); S.reloadQ.queued++; } S.data.reloaded(); } } catch (e) { console.warn('[streamfs] reload', at, e?.message ?? e); }
        }
      });
      // (an engine that reloads in place: its loads read the light copies first on every link that is not fast, their
      // files soon after them — GameData.reloads; its export seen once the engine's module is instantiated)
      // (a big load read light first on a fast link too, GameData.lightFirst — ?lightfirst=0 on this page or the play

      try { Object.defineProperty(window, '__streamfsStats', { configurable: true, get: () => S.data.snapshot() }); } catch { /* defined */ }
      // (the scripts the engine reads at its boot and at a save's load, announced once its mounts are over: the engine

      // or its content load said, whichever first; ?bootreads=0 on this page or the play page: the engine's reads alone)
      if (pageParam('bootreads') !== '0') {

      } else S.boot = { off: true };

    }
    return S.data;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the boot's scripts

  /**
   * The data folders' scripts, localisation and shaders the engine will read (boot-reads.js: the files its VFS resolves,
   * small first, bounded), announced once in one list — GameData.want `wait: false`: fetched at once in parallel, what
   * the page or the store holds already left out, the engine's reads of them joining their requests — instead of a
   * round trip each at its boot and at a save's load (docs/openmw.md "Scripts announced at the boot"). Once, after the
   * mounts (S.byPath: every file mounted, in the data folders' order).
   */
  function announceBoot() {
    if (S.boot !== null || !S.started || S.closed) return;
    const entries = M.bootReads(S.byPath);
    const bytes = entries.reduce((t, e) => t + e.h.size, 0);
    S.boot = { files: entries.length, bytes, asked: 0, atMs: Math.round(performance.now()) };
    if (entries.length) S.boot.asked = S.data.want(entries, { wait: false, label: 'boot:scripts' });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- anticipated places

  /** `fn()` polled every `ms`, `n` times at most: true once it holds, false once given up. */
  const until = (fn, ms, n) => new Promise((resolve) => {
    if (fn()) { resolve(true); return; }
    let k = 0;
    const t = setInterval(() => { const ok = !!fn(); if (ok || ++k >= n) { clearInterval(t); resolve(ok); } }, ms);
  });
  /** A multiplayer session (the engine page's __omwMPEnabled): the server decides where the player spawns, its solo saves say nothing. */
  const multiplayer = () => !!window.__omwMPEnabled;
  /**
   * The place the player's saved game will load, fetched before the click (docs/openmw.md "Anticipated places"): once
   * the saves are readable — the engine page's __idbfsReady: IDBFS populated, the account's profile restored (cloud.js
   * answers the populate after it) — and the engine draws its first frame (its boot over, the player at the menu), the
   * saves parsed (save-place.js: their records' headers, read in place), one chosen (the remembered place, the newest,
   * the most played: chooseSave), its learned set asked of the server and fetched in the background at the place's
   * priority (GameData.want `prio: 'place'`: the link's idle time, below the game's reads, a load's and the launch set).
   * A save loaded elsewhere loses nothing: its load announces its own (orthrosWillRead). Then the saves the engine
   * writes are watched: their place is the hint for the next session. Not in multiplayer.
   */
  async function anticipate() {
    if (!await until(() => !!window.__idbfsReady && typeof FS !== 'undefined', 250, 480)) return;
    await window.__idbfsReady;
    if (multiplayer()) return;
    // (the saves read, the set asked and fetched once the engine draws its first frame, not while it boots: requests
    // beside the boot's delayed the engine's first read by 1.7 s with a warm store, 4.5 s on a new device (1.8 MB/s,
    // 90 ms; place-load.mjs), though the link was free — the page's and its worker's time, not the link's —, and so
    // would reading every save on the page's thread; an engine that never says it draws: after BOOT_WAIT_MS)
    await until(() => window.Module?.__omwRunning !== undefined, 250, BOOT_WAIT_MS / 250);
    if (multiplayer()) return;
    const P = M.savePlace, saves = P.listSaves(FS);
    watchSaves(saves.reduce((t, x) => Math.max(t, x.mtime), -Infinity));
    const pick = P.chooseSave(saves, { hint: P.placeHint.get(name, window.localStorage ?? null), restored: !!window.orthrosProfileRestored });
    if (!pick) return;
    S.predicted = { place: pick.place, why: pick.why, save: pick.save.path, listed: 0, asked: 0 };
    await S.data.ready;
    const r = await fetch(`${placesUrl}?place=${encodeURIComponent(pick.place)}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) return;
    const entries = placeEntries(await r.json());
    S.predicted.listed = entries.length;
    if (!entries.length) return;
    S.predicted.atMs = Math.round(performance.now());
    S.predicted.asked = S.data.want(entries, { prio: 'place', label: 'place:' + pick.place });
  }
  /**
   * The player's next place guessed in play (place-lead.js: the exterior grid after the one just entered, the same
   * way), its learned set's meshes and terrain asked at the place's priority — never textures, bounded a guess and a session. Looked at every
   * LEAD_POLL_MS once the player is in the world; one look's GETs at a time. `lead`: place-lead.js, loaded only then
   * (off by default: the page fetches nothing more). Stopped by StreamFS.close (S.leadTimer; a module that arrives after
   * the close starts nothing).
   */
  function leadInPlay(lead) {
    if (S.closed) return;
    const L = S.lead = lead.createLead();
    let busy = false;
    S.leadTimer = setInterval(() => {
      if (busy || !M.inWorld(window)) return;
      const places = L.look(window.omw?.state);
      if (!places.length) return;
      busy = true;
      (async () => {
        await S.data.ready;
        for (const place of places) {
          const r = await fetch(`${placesUrl}?place=${encodeURIComponent(place)}`, { cache: 'no-store' }).catch(() => null);
          if (!r?.ok) continue;
          const { entries, bytes } = lead.leadEntries(await r.json(), { size: (p) => S.data.file(name, p)?.size ?? null });
          if (!entries.length) continue;
          L.spent(bytes);
          S.data.want(entries.map((e) => ({ h: S.data.file(name, e.path), off: e.off, len: e.len })), { prio: 'place', label: 'lead:' + place });
        }
      })().catch((e) => console.warn('[streamfs] lead', e?.message ?? e)).finally(() => { busy = false; });
    }, LEAD_POLL_MS);
  }
  /**
   * A place's set as the server lists it ([[path, start, end]] — end exclusive, absent or -1: the file's end —, or
   * { path, start, end }; bare or under `list`) to the game data's entries: the tree's files (others left out).
   */
  function placeEntries(doc) {
    const list = Array.isArray(doc) ? doc : Array.isArray(doc?.list) ? doc.list : [];
    const out = [];
    let bytes = 0;
    for (const x of list.slice(0, PLACE_ENTRIES)) {
      const [p, a, b] = Array.isArray(x) ? x : [x?.path, x?.start, x?.end];
      const h = typeof p === 'string' ? S.data.file(name, p) : null;
      if (!h) continue;
      const off = Math.max(0, Number(a) || 0), end = b === undefined || b === null ? -1 : Number(b);
      const len = Number.isFinite(end) && end >= 0 ? Math.max(0, end - off) : -1;
      // (cut at PLACE_BYTES, the list's order kept: a bad answer does not fill the store either)
      bytes += len < 0 ? Math.max(0, (h.size ?? 0) - off) : len;
      if (bytes > PLACE_BYTES) break;
      out.push({ h, off, len });
    }
    return out;
  }
  /** The saves the engine writes from now (after `since`, ms): the newest one's place remembered (placeHint, at its date). */
  function watchSaves(since) {
    const t = setInterval(() => {
      if (typeof FS === 'undefined') { clearInterval(t); return; }
      for (const x of M.savePlace.listSaves(FS, undefined, since).sort((a, b) => a.mtime - b.mtime)) {
        since = Math.max(since, x.mtime);
        if (x.info.place) M.savePlace.placeHint.set(name, x.info.place, window.localStorage ?? null, x.mtime);
      }
    }, SAVES_WATCH_MS);
  }
  /**
   * An announced batch of a load (`label` '<kind>:<place>', `entries` the game data's) to the server's learned places
   * (POST /api/places): its records [tree path, start, end) — the files themselves, never their light copies (each
   * player's link picks) —, with the place and kind. The session's first load (the game the player started from the
   * menu: a save, or a new game) remembered as the hint (placeHint) — not the cells the player walks through after it
   * (a hub revisited would steal the next prediction from the save written elsewhere: the saves written set it), not a
   * terrain read-ahead's (the view point's cell), not in multiplayer (the server's world, not a solo save's).
   */
  function learnPlace(label, entries) {
    const at = M?.savePlace?.labelPlace(label);
    if (!at) return;
    if (!S.hinted && at.kind !== 'terrain' && !multiplayer()) { S.hinted = true; M.savePlace.placeHint.set(name, at.place, window.localStorage ?? null); }
    const records = [];
    for (const { h, off, len } of entries) {
      if (h.src !== undefined || h.name !== name) continue;
      const a = Math.max(0, Math.min(h.size, off)), b = len < 0 ? h.size : Math.min(h.size, a + len);
      if (b > a) records.push([h.path, a, b]);
    }
    if (!records.length || typeof fetch !== 'function') return;
    fetch(placesUrl, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ session: S.session, place: at.place, kind: at.kind, records }) }).catch(() => {});
  }

  /** The Emscripten engine's run (its main) held until `ready` settles (a page without the engine's globals: nothing). */
  function holdRun(ready) {
    const add = typeof addRunDependency === 'function' ? addRunDependency : globalThis.Module?.addRunDependency;
    const remove = typeof removeRunDependency === 'function' ? removeRunDependency : globalThis.Module?.removeRunDependency;
    if (typeof add !== 'function' || typeof remove !== 'function') return;
    add('orthros-game-data');
    ready.then(() => remove('orthros-game-data'), (e) => { console.warn('[streamfs]', e?.message ?? e); remove('orthros-game-data'); });
  }

  function node(path, h) {
    // (asyncReads: an engine that suspends while it waits — the Orthros build's JSPI, orthros-r20.patch — asks for a
    // read's bytes first, GameData.soon; any other engine reads synchronously, as before)
    const n = M.fileNode(FS, path, need(), h, { mmap: false, asyncReads: true, log: (t) => console.warn('[streamfs]', t) });
    S.byPath.set(path, h); S.byNode.set(n, h); S.byEnginePath.clear();
    return n;
  }

  /**
   * The mounted file the engine's VFS knows as `name` (a data folder's path: sound/fx/a.wav, any case): the last one
   * mounted whose path ends with it (later mounts override, as the engine's later data folders), or null.
   */
  function byName(name) {
    if (S.indexed !== S.byPath.size) {
      S.names = new Map(); S.indexed = S.byPath.size;
      for (const [path, h] of S.byPath) {
        const p = path.toLowerCase();
        for (let i = p.indexOf('/'); i >= 0; i = p.indexOf('/', i + 1)) S.names.set(p.slice(i), h);
      }
    }
    return S.names.get('/' + String(name).toLowerCase().replace(/\\/g, '/')) ?? null;
  }
  // (asked by the Orthros build of the engine before it loads a sound played once, orthros-r2.patch: false — the file
  // not in the page yet, fetched now in the background — and the engine skips that play instead of the page's thread
  // waiting for the network; a file not streamed here: true)
  window.orthrosFileReady = (name) => {
    const h = S.data && byName(name);
    return !h || S.data.readable(h);
  };
  // (asked by the Orthros build of the engine before a preload between frames reads a file — a mesh or a texture, in
  // an archive or not —, orthros-r5.patch: the engine's own path of the file it opens (an archive's: the archive) and
  // the bytes it reads (size < 0: to the end); false — not all in the page yet, fetched now in the background — and the
  // engine puts that work off a frame or more instead of the page's thread waiting for the network; a file not
  // streamed here: true)
  window.orthrosRangeReady = (path, offset, size) => {
    const h = S.data && byEngine(path);
    return !h || S.data.readable(h, offset, size);
  };
  // (the same question asked only, nothing fetched — the Orthros build's loading screen choosing a splash image already in
  // the page, orthros-r20.patch: GameData.here; a file not streamed here: true)
  window.orthrosRangeHere = (path, offset, size) => {
    const h = S.data && byEngine(path);
    return !h || S.data.here(h, offset, size);
  };
  /** The game file the engine opens as `path` (its file system's: an archive's for a file in it), or null (not streamed here). */
  function byEngine(path) {
    let h = S.byEnginePath.get(path);
    if (h === undefined) {
      h = null;
      try { h = S.byNode.get(FS.lookupPath(path, { follow: true }).node) ?? null; } catch { /* not a file here */ }
      S.byEnginePath.set(path, h);
    }
    return h;
  }
  // (the Orthros build's content load, orthros-r13.patch (docs/slow-network.md "Content files light before the menu"):
  // said before it reads its content files — their light copies read from then on, on every link: their land and cell
  // references' details zeroed —, and once they are loaded — the files themselves from then on, for every read of every
  // reader it keeps open; an engine that says nothing reads the files as they are; ?contentlight=0 on this page or the
  // play page around it: the files as they are all along — the pictures compared, tools/openmw/frame-compare.mjs)
  // (the content load starts after every mount: the boot's scripts announced now if the engine page did not say its mods
  // were in — announceBoot)
  window.orthrosContentLoading = () => {
    try { if (S.boot === null && S.data && pageParam('bootreads') !== '0') announceBoot(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[streamfs] boot', e?.message ?? e); }
    if (pageParam('contentlight') !== '0') S.data?.contentLoading();
  };
  window.orthrosContentLoaded = () => { S.data?.contentLoaded(); };
  // (the engine's reads of its content files for ids only — a cell's references listed: its search through every cell —,
  // `on` 1 then 0: served from the light copies, what the content load read, once it is loaded too — GameData.contentIds)
  window.orthrosContentIds = (on) => { S.data?.contentIds(!!on); };
  // (announced reads, the Orthros build's scene changes (its announced-reads patch, docs/slow-network.md "Announced reads"): before
  // it loads cells, the engine says what it reads — `list`: records 'enginePath\x1Foffset\x1Fsize' (size -1: to the end;
  // an archive's path and range for a file in it) separated by '\x1E', `label` '<meshes|textures|terrain>:<place>' — then
  // waits once (orthrosReadWait) instead of a round trip per file: fetched in parallel by the game data (GameData.want).
  // Returns how many are not in the page yet (0: nothing to wait for); paths not streamed here are left out.)
  window.orthrosWillRead = (list, label) => {
    if (!S.started) return 0;
    const entries = [];
    for (const rec of String(list ?? '').split('\x1E')) {
      if (!rec) continue;
      const [path, off, size] = rec.split('\x1F'), h = byEngine(path);
      if (h) entries.push({ h, off: Number(off) || 0, len: size === undefined || size === '' ? -1 : Number(size) });
    }
    S.place = String(label ?? ''); // (what the load is for: the learned places)
    learnPlace(S.place, entries);
    return entries.length ? S.data.want(entries, S.place) : 0;
  };
  // (the engine waits for what it announced, at most `timeoutMs`: 1 when it is all here (or failed — its reads say why),
  // 0 on time out (its reads fetch the rest); 1 at once without game data)
  window.orthrosReadWait = (timeoutMs) => {
    if (!S.started) return 1;
    const ms = Number(timeoutMs);
    return S.data.wantWait(Number.isFinite(ms) && ms >= 0 ? ms : 15000) ? 1 : 0;
  };
  // (the same wait for an engine that suspends meanwhile — the Orthros build's JSPI, orthros-r20.patch: the answer within
  // `spinMs` of the page's thread, else a promise of it — GameData.wantWaitSoon)
  window.orthrosReadWaitSoon = (timeoutMs, spinMs) => {
    if (!S.started) return 1;
    const ms = Number(timeoutMs), spin = Number(spinMs);
    const r = S.data.wantWaitSoon(Number.isFinite(ms) && ms >= 0 ? ms : 15000, Number.isFinite(spin) && spin >= 0 ? spin : undefined);
    return typeof r === 'boolean' ? (r ? 1 : 0) : r.then((ok) => (ok ? 1 : 0));
  };

  window.StreamFS = {
    stats() { return S.started ? S.data.snapshot() : {}; },
    /** The place predicted for the player's save (anticipate): { place, why, save, listed, asked, atMs (when asked, the page's clock) }, or null. */
    place() { return S.predicted; },
    /** The boot's announced scripts (announceBoot): { files, bytes, asked, atMs }, { off: true } (?bootreads=0), or null (not yet). */
    boot() { return S.boot; },
    /** The places guessed in play (leadInPlay): { guessed, bytes, last }, or null (none yet, or no ?lead=1). */
    leads() { return S.lead?.snapshot() ?? null; },
    /**
     * The engine's waits for its files that suspended it instead of holding the page's thread (the Orthros build's JSPI,
     * orthros-r20.patch — its export orthros_jspi; Module.orthrosBlocked): { on, suspendedMs, blocked, frames, soonSpins, soonSpinMs,
     * soonSuspends, soonWaits } — `on` false for an engine that does not; frames: the frames pumped plain (play) and
     * promising (a load's), Module.orthrosFrames —, or null before the engine's script ran.
     */
    jspi() {
      const m = typeof Module !== 'undefined' ? Module : null;
      if (!m) return null;
      const s = S.started ? S.data.stats : {};
      return { on: m.orthrosJspi === 1 && typeof m._orthros_jspi === 'function', suspendedMs: Math.round(m.orthrosSuspendedMs ?? 0), blocked: m.orthrosBlocked ?? null, frames: m.orthrosFrames ? { ...m.orthrosFrames } : null,
        soonSpins: s.soonSpins ?? 0, soonSpinMs: Math.round(s.soonSpinMs ?? 0), soonSuspends: s.soonSuspends ?? 0, soonWaits: s.soonWaits ?? 0 };
    },
    /** The game data (data-client.js GameData), once the engine used it (its first mount): null before (opened earlier). */
    data() { return S.started ? S.data : null; },
    /** The game data closed, opened or used (a test; the page's leaving closes its worker anyway). */
    close() { S.closed = true; if (S.leadTimer) { clearInterval(S.leadTimer); S.leadTimer = null; } S.data?.close(); },
    init() {
      if (!self.crossOriginIsolated) throw new Error('streamfs needs crossOriginIsolated (COOP/COEP)');
      need();
    },
    /** A file at `url`, `size` bytes (`mtime`: the date the engine page knows): the installation's, or of elsewhere. */
    mount(path, url, size, mtime) {
      const data = need(), rel = treePath(url);
      if (rel === null) return node(path, data.source({ url: new URL(url, location.href).href, size, label: path }));
      // (a copy an earlier page kept of it: taken before its first read — legacy-copies.js, in the data worker)
      S.legacy.push({ name, path: rel, module: '/src/ports/openmw/legacy-copies.js', args: { url: new URL(url, location.href).pathname, size, mtime: mtime || 0 } });
      if (S.legacy.length === 1) queueMicrotask(() => data.legacy(S.legacy.splice(0)));
      S.byKey.set(name + '\n' + rel.toLowerCase(), path);
      return node(path, data.fileAs(name, rel, size));
    },
    /** A new address for a file of elsewhere (signed addresses expire). */
    setUrl(path, url) { const h = S.byPath.get(path); if (h?.src !== undefined) S.data.setSourceUrl(h, new URL(url, location.href).href); },
    /** A file the player picked (FileSystemFileHandle). */
    mountLocal(path, handle, size) { return node(path, need().source({ handle, size, label: path })); },
    /** A Blob (a file the page keeps in the browser's Cache API). */
    mountBlob(path, blob, size) { return node(path, need().source({ blob, size, label: path })); },
  };

})();
```

`src/ports/openmw/tier.js`:

```js
// The OpenMW engine page's quality tier (its TIER: view distance, object paging's small-feature size, the shadow map's
// resolution and distance, water's render size, the page's file cache) from the machine's GPU and the frames measured,
// not from navigator.deviceMemory alone — which Chrome caps at 8, so every laptop of 8 GB or more got 'high' (an 8192
// shadow map, a 16384 view distance): a software renderer (SwiftShader, llvmpipe…) gets 'low', an integrated GPU 'mid',
// a discrete one 'high'; deviceMemory of 4 or less still means 'low'. A session whose frames stayed long in the world
// (FRAMES) on a tier above 'low' has the next session start a tier lower, on that same GPU. What a tier sets beyond the
// page's table: tierSettings (the water's refraction). ?tier= and the player's own Options (the engine's user settings,
// read over the page's defaults) still win. Loaded by the engine page before its
// engine starts (src/host/openmw.js, withQualityTier): the page's tier choice calls window.orthrosTier(deviceMemory).
import { gpuClass, gpuInfo } from '../../host/web/gpu-class.js';
import { inWorld as worldShown } from './view-grow.js';

export const TIERS = ['low', 'mid', 'high'];
const BY_GPU = { software: 'low', integrated: 'mid', discrete: 'high' };
export const KEY = 'orthros.openmw.tier';
export const FRAMES = {
  /** the page's frame meter (frame-meter.js) looked at this often, in the world… */
  everyMs: 2000,
  /** …this many looks (a minute) before a verdict, once per session… */
  looks: 30,
  /** …a tier lower next time when the median of its p99 frame gaps passed this (under 20 frames a second) */
  slowP99Ms: 50,
};

/**
 * What a tier sets beyond the engine page's TIER table. The water's refraction draws the scene a second time each frame
 * water is in view (its render-to-texture camera: the whole cull and draw again); OpenMW's own default is off, the
 * engine page turned it on for every tier. Measured on the integrated GPUs' tier (docs/openmw.md, r9): the engine's
 * work p50 18.2-19.2 -> 16.7-16.8 ms a frame at Seyda Neen. On 'high' only; the player's Options still win.
 */
export const tierSettings = (tier) => ({ refraction: tier === 'high', ...(VIEW[tier] ? { vd: VIEW[tier], fog: fogFor(VIEW[tier]) } : {}) });

/**
 * The view distance a tier asks over the engine page's TIER table (the owner, 2026-11-01: "la distance d'affichage est
 * courte"): 'mid' 12288 -> 16384 (2 cells), 'high' 16384 -> 20480 (2.5 cells); measured on the GPU-less server, mid glide: 20480 cost ~25 % of the frames a second (23 -> 17), 16384 ~12 % (23 -> 20); 'low' keeps the page's 8192.
 * Then (the owner, 2026-11-08, on his Iris Xe at 16384: "fluide, on peut même augmenter encore") 'mid' 20480 (2.5 cells,
 * the measure above), 'high' 24576 (3 cells). The distant
 * land fog follows it as the page set it for 12288 (start at the view distance, end at 4/3 of it: the vista's edge into
 * the sky blend). A tier whose frames stay slow still steps down a tier (FRAMES), and the player's Options still win.
 */
export const VIEW = { mid: 20480, high: 24576 };
export const fogFor = (vd) => ({ start: vd, end: Math.round(vd * 4 / 3) });

const lower = (t) => TIERS[Math.max(0, TIERS.indexOf(t) - 1)];
const min = (a, b) => TIERS[Math.min(TIERS.indexOf(a), TIERS.indexOf(b))];

/**
 * The tier: `gpu` the renderer string (null: unknown), `deviceMemory` navigator's (0: unknown), `saved` what an earlier
 * session stored ({ gpu, tier }: a tier lower measured there, used on the same GPU only).
 */
export function chooseTier({ gpu = null, deviceMemory = 0, saved = null } = {}) {
  const kind = gpuClass(gpu);
  // (the page's own rule for what the GPU does not say: 8 GB or more high, 4 or less low, else mid)
  const memory = deviceMemory >= 8 ? 'high' : deviceMemory > 0 && deviceMemory <= 4 ? 'low' : 'mid';
  let tier = BY_GPU[kind] ? (deviceMemory > 0 && deviceMemory <= 4 ? 'low' : BY_GPU[kind]) : memory;
  if (saved && saved.gpu === (gpu ?? null) && TIERS.includes(saved.tier)) tier = min(tier, saved.tier);
  return { tier, kind };
}

/**
 * One look at the frames (`s`: { looks, p99s, done }): the frame meter's last measure `frames` ({ p99 }), whether the
 * player is in the world. Returns the tier for the next session once decided (a lower one), else null.
 */
export function framesLook(s, { frames, inWorld, tier }) {
  if (s.done || !inWorld || !frames || !Number.isFinite(frames.p99) || !(frames.p99 > 0)) return null;
  s.p99s.push(frames.p99);
  if (s.p99s.length < FRAMES.looks) return null;
  s.done = true;
  const median = [...s.p99s].sort((a, b) => a - b)[s.p99s.length >> 1];
  return median > FRAMES.slowP99Ms && tier !== 'low' ? lower(tier) : null;
}

/**
 * Into the engine page `win` before its engine starts: window.orthrosTier(deviceMemory) for the page's tier choice,
 * window.orthrosTierChoice what it chose and why, and the frames' look once the tier is used. `o.gpu`, `o.storage`,
 * `o.inWorld`, `o.setInterval`, `o.clearInterval`: a test's.
 */
export function install(win = globalThis, o = {}) {
  const storage = o.storage ?? win.localStorage;
  const gpu = o.gpu !== undefined ? o.gpu : gpuInfo().renderer;
  let saved = null;
  try { saved = JSON.parse(storage?.getItem(KEY) ?? 'null'); } catch { /* none */ }
  win.orthrosTierSettings = tierSettings;
  win.orthrosTier = (deviceMemory) => {
    const { tier, kind } = chooseTier({ gpu, deviceMemory: Number(deviceMemory) || 0, saved });
    win.orthrosTierChoice = { tier, gpu, kind, deviceMemory: Number(deviceMemory) || null, saved };
    // (a tier forced by the address, ?tier=, is the page's own: no verdict on it)
    if (!/[?&]tier=/.test(win.location?.search ?? '')) watch(tier);
    return tier;
  };
  const watch = (tier) => {
    const s = { p99s: [], done: false };
    // (the world shown — joined and simulated —, the one test of view-grow.js: no loading's frames in the looks)
    const inWorld = o.inWorld ?? (() => worldShown(win));
    const timer = (o.setInterval ?? setInterval)(() => {
      const next = framesLook(s, { frames: win.orthrosFrames, inWorld: inWorld(), tier });
      if (next) { try { storage?.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify({ gpu: gpu ?? null, tier: next })); } catch { /* full */ } }
      if (s.done) (o.clearInterval ?? clearInterval)(timer);
    }, FRAMES.everyMs);
  };
  return { gpu };
}

```

`src/ports/openmw/ui-l10n.js`:

```js
// Put into the OpenMW engine's pages by the Orthros server (src/host/openmw.js, withFrameMeter): the engine page's own
// interface — loading, multiplayer tour, social panel, chat, messages, the character choice — in the language of the
// Orthros page (the visitor's choice, else the browser's: as src/host/web/lang.js). Only the texts the engine writes
// are touched, by exact phrase (or a phrase's start, for the ones ending with a name or a number); the game is not.
(() => {
  let lang = null;
  try { lang = localStorage.getItem('orthros.lang'); } catch { /* storage off */ }
  if (!lang) lang = (navigator.languages?.length ? navigator.languages : [navigator.language]).map((l) => String(l).slice(0, 2).toLowerCase()).find((l) => ['fr', 'en'].includes(l)) ?? 'en';
  if (lang !== 'fr') return;

    ['Friend request sent to ', 'Demande d’ami envoyée à '], ['Could not add: ', 'Ajout impossible : '], ['Now visible to: ', 'Visible maintenant par : '],
    ['Joining ', 'Connexion à '], ['Continue with ', 'Continuer avec '], ['Unexpected error: ', 'Erreur inattendue : '], ['Upload failed: ', 'Envoi impossible : '],
    ['Could not load the game engine (', 'Impossible de charger le moteur du jeu ('], ['Your sign-in could not be verified (', 'Ta connexion n’a pas pu être vérifiée ('],
    ['Redirecting to ', 'Redirection vers '],
  ];
```
