```js
  K.OpenThread = [3, (c) => { const t = c.proc.thread(c.arg(2)); return t ? c.proc.handles.create(t) : c.fail(E.INVALID_PARAMETER); }];
  K.SwitchToThread = [0, (c) => (vm.sched.yieldFrom(c.thread, true) ? 1 : 0)];
  // Sleep(0) storms: a thread spinning on Sleep(0) (frame limiter, flag polling) with nothing else to run would
  // burn the whole worker; after 32 back-to-back yields within 50 µs of each other it sleeps for 1 ms instead —
  // the granularity a Windows timer gives Sleep anyway. One other API call between two Sleep(0)s is part of the
  // pattern (the frame limiter reads timeGetTime each turn: Sleep(0) + timeGetTime = 2 calls); any more resets it.
  // The throttled sleep is part of the streak: its re-executed call (the thread woken after the 1 ms) completes it and
  // the streak goes on from the wake-up — a spin that was throttled keeps being throttled at each Sleep(0) until real
  // work or other calls come between. Measured at the end of each park instead, the 1 ms always broke the streak and
  // every throttle was followed by 32 more unthrottled turns (tools/sleepspin-bench.mjs: ~480 Sleep(0) and ~1000
  // scheduling decisions per 16 ms frame). ?dbg=ORTHROS_SLEEP0_KEEP_STREAK=0: the former behaviour (measurement).
  const sleep = (c, ms) => {
    const keepStreak = globalThis.ORTHROS_SLEEP0_KEEP_STREAK === undefined || !!Number(globalThis.ORTHROS_SLEEP0_KEEP_STREAK); // (read each time: in-session A/B)
    const t = c.thread, st = t.sleepStats ??= { zero: 0, short: 0, long: 0, streak: 0, last: 0, throttled: 0, parked: false, paceN: 0, paceLast: 0, paceApi: 0, paceEnds: null };
    if (ms === 0) {
      if (st.parked) { // (the throttled sleep's re-executed call, after its wake-up: done)
        st.parked = false;
        if (t.resuming && keepStreak) { vm.sched.park(t, NEVER, 1, 'sleep'); st.last = vm.clock.now(); st.lastApi = vm.apiCalls; paceWoke(t, st); return; }
      }
      st.zero++;
      if (vm.sleepSites) { const k = `t${t.id} ${c.proc.symbolize(c.retAddr)}`; vm.sleepSites.set(k, (vm.sleepSites.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); } // (diagnostics, startbench --sleeps: the call sites)
      const now = vm.clock.now(); // (the guest's clock: the host's time on a real clock, kept in a snapshot)
      paceStep(t, st, now);
      const gapOk = now - st.last < 0.05, apiOk = vm.apiCalls - st.lastApi <= 2;
      if (gapOk && apiOk) st.streak++; else { st.streak = 0; if (!gapOk) st.brokeGap = (st.brokeGap ?? 0) + 1; else st.brokeApi = (st.brokeApi ?? 0) + 1; } // (diagnostics: why streaks end)
      st.last = now; st.lastApi = vm.apiCalls;
      // (no thread this yield would run: none ready of a priority at least this thread's — a lower one waits for the
      // processor, as on Windows, and runs during the throttle's 1 ms instead. ?dbg=ORTHROS_SLEEP0_ANY_READY=1: any
      // ready thread prevents the throttle, the behaviour before 2026-10-22, for measurement)
      if (st.streak >= 32 && !(globalThis.ORTHROS_SLEEP0_ANY_READY ? vm.sched.hasRunnable(t) : vm.sched.hasYieldTarget(t))) {
        st.throttled++;
        if (vm.sched.park(t, NEVER, 1, 'sleep') === PARK) { st.parked = true; return PARK; }
        if (keepStreak) { st.last = vm.clock.now(); st.lastApi = vm.apiCalls; } // (a nested wait: the 1 ms has passed here)
        paceWoke(t, st);
        return;
      }
      if (vm.sched.yieldFrom(t)) st.yields = (st.yields ?? 0) + 1; // (diagnostics: a ready thread ran)
      else if (vm.sched.hasRunnable(t)) st.lowerReady = (st.lowerReady ?? 0) + 1; // (diagnostics: only lower priorities ready)
      paceWoke(t, st);
      return;
    }
    if (ms <= 2) {
      if (t.resuming) { const r = vm.sched.park(t, NEVER, ms, 'sleep', undefined, true); paceWoke(t, st); return r === PARK ? PARK : undefined; } // (its re-executed call: done)
      st.short++;
      paceStep(t, st, vm.clock.now());
    } else st.long++;
    const r = vm.sched.park(t, NEVER, ms === INFINITE ? INFINITE : ms, 'sleep', undefined, true);
    if (r === PARK) return PARK;
    if (ms <= 2) paceWoke(t, st); // (a nested wait: over here)
    return undefined;
  };
  // Pacing loops (core/host-wait.js, docs/thread-scheduling.md "Host wake-up overshoot"): a thread polling the clock
  // with short sleeps — Sleep(0), Sleep(1), Sleep(2) with at most PACE_CALLS of its own other API calls between the
  // end of one and the next (timeGetTime, QueryPerformanceCounter: often on the JIT's fast paths, not counted at all) —
  // is a frame limiter; the loop ends where the thread does more (its frame's work). Its ends give its period; the
  // predicted end of the current loop goes to the host's waits, which then wake precisely for its last waits.
  const PACE_CALLS = 2;
  /** a new short sleep of `t` at guest time `now` (not a re-executed call) */
  const paceStep = (t, st, now) => {
    if (t.apiCalls - st.paceApi > PACE_CALLS + 1) { // (+1: this Sleep, counted at its dispatch)
      if (st.paceN >= 2) {
        if (globalThis.ORTHROS_PACE_LOG) { const e = pacePredict(st, st.paceLast); vm.logFn('timer', `pace: t${t.id} loop of ${st.paceN + 1} sleeps ended at ${st.paceLast.toFixed(2)} ms, predicted ${e < 0 ? 'none' : `${e.toFixed(2)} (${(st.paceLast - e).toFixed(2)} ms later)`}`); }
        paceEnded(st, st.paceLast);
      }
      st.paceN = 0;
    } else st.paceN++;
    if (st.paceN >= 2) {
      const end = pacePredict(st, now);
      if (end >= 0 && vm.clock.real) hostWaiter.pace(performance.now() + vm.clock.real(end - now));
    }
  };
  /** a short sleep of `t` returned (its wake-up: the loop's end if the thread goes on with other work) */
  const paceWoke = (t, st) => { st.paceLast = vm.clock.now(); st.paceApi = t.apiCalls; };
  function NEVER() { return false; } // (a sleep's wake condition: the timeout alone)
  K.Sleep = [1, (c) => sleep(c, c.arg(0))]; // (undefined, or PARK: the thread parks)
  K.SleepEx = [2, (c) => (sleep(c, c.arg(0)) === PARK ? PARK : 0)];
  K.QueueUserAPC = [3, (c) => { const t = c.proc.handles.getAs(c.arg(1), 'thread'); if (!t) return 0; t.apcQueue.push({ fn: c.arg(0), arg: c.arg(2) }); return 1; }];

  // TLS
  K.TlsAlloc = [0, (c) => {
    const s = c.proc.tlsSlots;
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) if (!s[i]) { s[i] = 1; for (const t of c.proc.threads) tlsSet(c, t, i, 0); return i; }
    return c.fail(E.NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY) | 0xffffffff;
  }];
  K.TlsFree = [1, (c) => { const i = c.arg(0); if (i >= c.proc.tlsSlots.length) return c.fail(E.INVALID_PARAMETER); c.proc.tlsSlots[i] = 0; return 1; }];
  K.TlsGetValue = [1, (c) => { const i = c.arg(0); if (i >= 1088) return c.fail(E.INVALID_PARAMETER); c.thread.lastError = 0; return tlsGet(c, c.thread, i); }];
  K.TlsSetValue = [2, (c) => { const i = c.arg(0); if (i >= 1088) return c.fail(E.INVALID_PARAMETER); tlsSet(c, c.thread, i, c.arg(1)); return 1; }];
  function tlsExpansion(c, t) {
    let p = mem.read32(t.teb + 0xf94);
    if (!p) { p = c.proc.processHeap.alloc(1024 * 4, true); mem.write32(t.teb + 0xf94, p); }
    return p;
  }
  function tlsGet(c, t, i) { return i < 64 ? mem.read32(t.teb + TEB_TLS_SLOTS + 4 * i) : mem.read32(tlsExpansion(c, t) + 4 * (i - 64)); }
  function tlsSet(c, t, i, v) { if (i < 64) mem.write32(t.teb + TEB_TLS_SLOTS + 4 * i, v); else mem.write32(tlsExpansion(c, t) + 4 * (i - 64), v); }

  // Critical sections (guest-memory layout: +4 LockCount, +8 RecursionCount, +12 OwningThread)
  K.InitializeCriticalSection = [1, (c) => { const p = c.arg(0); mem.write32(p, 0); mem.write32(p + 4, 0xffffffff); mem.write32(p + 8, 0); mem.write32(p + 12, 0); mem.write32(p + 16, 0); mem.write32(p + 20, 0); }];
  K.InitializeCriticalSectionAndSpinCount = [2, (c) => { K.InitializeCriticalSection[1](c); mem.write32(c.arg(0) + 20, c.arg(1)); return 1; }];
  K.SetCriticalSectionSpinCount = [2, (c) => { const p = c.arg(0); const o = mem.read32(p + 20); mem.write32(p + 20, c.arg(1)); return o; }];
  K.DeleteCriticalSection = [1, (c) => { const p = c.arg(0); mem.write32(p + 4, 0xffffffff); mem.write32(p + 8, 0); mem.write32(p + 12, 0); }];
  K.EnterCriticalSection = [1, (c) => {
    const p = c.arg(0), tid = c.thread.id, proc = c.proc, ret = c.retAddr; // (the claim runs at wake-up, outside this call context)
    // a re-executed call was given the section at wake-up (claim below): the owner check would look recursive
    if (!c.thread.resuming && mem.read32(p + 12) === tid) { mem.write32(p + 8, mem.read32(p + 8) + 1); mem.write32(p + 4, mem.read32(p + 4) + 1); return; }
    if (c.thread.resuming) c.proc.syncTrace(`critsec 0x${p.toString(16)} re-executed by t${tid} (wakeResult=${c.thread.wakeResult}) lock=${mem.readS32(p + 4)} owner=t${mem.read32(p + 12)}`, 'cs');
    const detail = () => `critsec 0x${p.toString(16)} lock=${mem.readS32(p + 4)} rec=${mem.read32(p + 8)} owner=t${mem.read32(p + 12)}`;
    vm.sched.block(c.thread, () => mem.readS32(p + 4) === -1, INFINITE, detail, (atWake) => {
      if (atWake) proc.syncTrace(`critsec 0x${p.toString(16)} handed to t${tid} (parked from ${proc.symbolize(ret)})`, 'cs');
      mem.write32(p + 4, 0); mem.write32(p + 8, 1); mem.write32(p + 12, tid);
    });
  }];
  K.TryEnterCriticalSection = [1, (c) => {
    const p = c.arg(0), tid = c.thread.id;
    if (mem.read32(p + 12) === tid) { mem.write32(p + 8, mem.read32(p + 8) + 1); mem.write32(p + 4, mem.read32(p + 4) + 1); return 1; }
    if (mem.readS32(p + 4) !== -1) return 0;
    mem.write32(p + 4, 0); mem.write32(p + 8, 1); mem.write32(p + 12, tid);
    return 1;
  }];
  K.LeaveCriticalSection = [1, (c) => {
    const p = c.arg(0);
    const rec = mem.read32(p + 8) - 1;
    mem.write32(p + 8, rec);
    mem.write32(p + 4, mem.read32(p + 4) - 1);
    if (rec <= 0) { if (mem.read32(p + 12) !== c.thread.id) c.proc.syncTrace(`critsec 0x${p.toString(16)} left by t${c.thread.id} but owned by t${mem.read32(p + 12)}`, 'cs'); mem.write32(p + 12, 0); mem.write32(p + 4, 0xffffffff); mem.write32(p + 8, 0); vm.sched.signal(); }
  }];

  // Interlocked (single JS thread: plain memory ops)
  K.InterlockedIncrement = [1, (c) => { const p = c.arg(0); const v = (mem.read32(p) + 1) >>> 0; mem.write32(p, v); return v; }];
  K.InterlockedDecrement = [1, (c) => { const p = c.arg(0); const v = (mem.read32(p) - 1) >>> 0; mem.write32(p, v); return v; }];
  K.InterlockedExchange = [2, (c) => { const p = c.arg(0); const o = mem.read32(p); mem.write32(p, c.arg(1)); return o; }];
  K.InterlockedExchangeAdd = [2, (c) => { const p = c.arg(0); const o = mem.read32(p); mem.write32(p, (o + c.arg(1)) >>> 0); return o; }];
  K.InterlockedCompareExchange = [3, (c) => { const p = c.arg(0); const o = mem.read32(p); if (o === c.arg(2)) mem.write32(p, c.arg(1)); return o; }];
  K.InterlockedExchangePointer = K.InterlockedExchange;
  K.InterlockedCompareExchangePointer = K.InterlockedCompareExchange;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- synchronization objects
  K.CreateEventA = [4, (c) => createNamed(c, c.str(3), () => ({ type: 'event', manual: c.arg(1) !== 0, signaled: c.arg(2) !== 0 }), c.arg(0))];
  K.CreateEventW = [4, (c) => createNamed(c, c.wstr(3), () => ({ type: 'event', manual: c.arg(1) !== 0, signaled: c.arg(2) !== 0 }), c.arg(0))];
  K.OpenEventA = [3, (c) => openNamed(c, c.str(2), 'event')];
  K.OpenEventW = [3, (c) => openNamed(c, c.wstr(2), 'event')];
  K.SetEvent = [1, (c) => { const o = c.proc.handles.getAs(c.arg(0), 'event'); if (!o) return c.fail(E.INVALID_HANDLE); o.signaled = true; signalAll(); return 1; }];
  K.ResetEvent = [1, (c) => { const o = c.proc.handles.getAs(c.arg(0), 'event'); if (!o) return c.fail(E.INVALID_HANDLE); o.signaled = false; return 1; }];
  // (the waiters woken while it is signaled — of every process: an auto-reset one is taken by the first, on wake)
  K.PulseEvent = [1, (c) => { const o = c.proc.handles.getAs(c.arg(0), 'event'); if (!o) return c.fail(E.INVALID_HANDLE); o.signaled = true; if (vm.group) { for (const v of vm.group.vms) if (v.proc && !v.proc.exited) v.sched.wakeBlocked(); } else vm.sched.wakeBlocked(); o.signaled = false; return 1; }];
  K.CreateMutexA = [3, (c) => createNamed(c, c.str(2), () => new Mutex(mutexStates, c.arg(1) ? c.thread.id : 0), c.arg(0))];
  K.CreateMutexW = [3, (c) => createNamed(c, c.wstr(2), () => new Mutex(mutexStates, c.arg(1) ? c.thread.id : 0), c.arg(0))];
  K.OpenMutexA = [3, (c) => openNamed(c, c.str(2), 'mutex')];
  K.OpenMutexW = [3, (c) => openNamed(c, c.wstr(2), 'mutex')];
  K.ReleaseMutex = [1, (c) => {
    const o = c.proc.handles.getAs(c.arg(0), 'mutex'); if (!o) return c.fail(E.INVALID_HANDLE);
    if (o.handle === globalThis.ORTHROS_TRACE_HANDLE && (c.thread !== c.proc.threads[0] || o.owner !== c.thread.id)) vm.log('sync', `release 0x${c.arg(0).toString(16)} by t${c.thread.id} from ${c.proc.symbolize(c.retAddr)} owner=t${o.owner} count=${o.count}`);
    if (o.owner !== c.thread.id) { c.proc.syncTrace(`mutex 0x${o.handle.toString(16)} release by t${c.thread.id} REFUSED (owner t${o.owner})`); return c.fail(288); }
    if (--o.count === 0) { o.owner = 0; signalAll(); if (o.waiters) o.waiters = mutexWaited(); }
    return 1;
  }];
  /** a thread parked in a wait that may be for a mutex (MX_WAITERS is recomputed from it: conservative) */
  const mutexWaited = () => vm.sched.threads.some((t) => t.state === TS.BLOCKED && typeof t.blockReason === 'string' && (t.blockReason.startsWith('wait:mutex') || t.blockReason === 'waitmany'));
  K.CreateSemaphoreA = [4, (c) => createNamed(c, c.str(3), () => ({ type: 'semaphore', count: c.sarg(1), max: c.sarg(2) }), c.arg(0))];
  K.CreateSemaphoreW = [4, (c) => createNamed(c, c.wstr(3), () => ({ type: 'semaphore', count: c.sarg(1), max: c.sarg(2) }), c.arg(0))];
  K.OpenSemaphoreA = [3, (c) => openNamed(c, c.str(2), 'semaphore')];
  K.OpenSemaphoreW = [3, (c) => openNamed(c, c.wstr(2), 'semaphore')];
  K.ReleaseSemaphore = [3, (c) => { const o = c.proc.handles.getAs(c.arg(0), 'semaphore'); if (!o) return c.fail(E.INVALID_HANDLE); c.out32(2, o.count); if (o.count + c.sarg(1) > o.max) return c.fail(298); o.count += c.sarg(1); signalAll(); return 1; }];
  K.CreateWaitableTimerA = [3, (c) => createNamed(c, c.str(2), () => ({ type: 'timer', manual: c.arg(1) !== 0, signaled: false, due: Infinity, period: 0 }))];
  K.SetWaitableTimer = [6, (c) => {
    const o = c.proc.handles.getAs(c.arg(0), 'timer'); if (!o) return c.fail(E.INVALID_HANDLE);
    const due = mem.dv.getBigInt64(c.arg(1), true); const now = vm.clock.now();
    o.due = due < 0n ? now + Number(-due) / 10000 : filetimeToMs(due) - vm.clock.wall() + now;
    o.period = c.sarg(2); o.signaled = false;
    c.proc.timers.push({ due: o.due, timer: o, kind: 'waitable' });
    return 1;
  }];
  K.CancelWaitableTimer = [1, (c) => { const o = c.proc.handles.getAs(c.arg(0), 'timer'); if (!o) return c.fail(E.INVALID_HANDLE); o.due = Infinity; c.proc.timers = c.proc.timers.filter((t) => t.timer !== o); return 1; }];

  // Waits claim their object at wake-up time (sched.block `claim`): a released mutex goes to the parked waiter
  // before the releasing thread can take it back, and never to a second thread in between.
  const waitOne = (c, h, ms, alertable) => {
    const o = waitObject(c, h);
    if (o && o.handle === globalThis.ORTHROS_TRACE_HANDLE) { const r = waitOneImpl(c, o, h, ms, alertable); if (c.thread !== c.proc.threads[0] || r !== 0) vm.log('sync', `wait 0x${(h >>> 0).toString(16)} by t${c.thread.id} (${ms}) from ${c.proc.symbolize(c.retAddr)} -> ${r} owner=t${o.owner} count=${o.count}`); return r; } // (debugging: --dbg ORTHROS_TRACE_HANDLE=<first handle>)
    return waitOneImpl(c, o, h, ms, alertable);
  };
  const waitOneImpl = (c, o, h, ms, alertable) => {
    if (!o) { c.setLastError(E.INVALID_HANDLE); return WAIT_FAILED; }
    if (o === c.thread) { c.setLastError(E.INVALID_HANDLE); return WAIT_FAILED; }
    const t = c.thread;
    // the common case, an object already available (an uncontended mutex): taken at once, no wait record (block's
    // own first test, without the closures it needs to park the thread)
    // (a poll, timeout 0, of an object not signaled: WAIT_TIMEOUT at once, likewise)
    if (t.wakeResult === undefined && !(alertable && t.apcQueue.length)) { if (isSignaled(o, t)) return consumeSignal(o, t); if (ms === 0) return WAIT_TIMEOUT; }
    const to = ms === INFINITE ? INFINITE : ms;
    if (o.type === 'mutex' && t.wakeResult === undefined) o.waiters = true; // (about to park: releases go through JavaScript)
    const ok = vm.sched.park(t, () => isSignaled(o, t) || (alertable && t.apcQueue.length > 0), to, o.waitReason ??= `wait:${o.type} 0x${(o.handle ?? 0).toString(16)}`,
      () => (isSignaled(o, t) ? consumeSignal(o, t) : 0xc0), true);
    if (ok === PARK) return PARK; // (the thread parks: the handlers return it to the dispatcher)
    if (alertable && t.apcQueue.length) runApcs(c);
    if (!ok) return WAIT_TIMEOUT;
    return t.wakeValue;
  };
  const runApcs = (c) => { while (c.thread.apcQueue.length) { const a = c.thread.apcQueue.shift(); vm.callGuest(c.thread, a.fn, [a.arg]); } };
  K.WaitForSingleObject = [2, (c) => waitOne(c, c.arg(0), c.arg(1), false)];
  K.WaitForSingleObjectEx = [3, (c) => waitOne(c, c.arg(0), c.arg(1), c.arg(2) !== 0)];
  const waitMany = (c, n, ph, all, ms, alertable) => {
    const objs = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const o = waitObject(c, mem.read32(ph + 4 * i)); if (!o) { c.setLastError(E.INVALID_HANDLE); return WAIT_FAILED; } objs.push(o); }
    const t = c.thread;
    if (t.wakeResult === undefined) for (const o of objs) if (o.type === 'mutex') o.waiters = true;
    // (plain loops: the condition is evaluated at every scheduling pass while the thread is parked)
    const ready = () => { if (all) { for (let i = 0; i < objs.length; i++) if (!isSignaled(objs[i], t)) return false; return true; } for (let i = 0; i < objs.length; i++) if (isSignaled(objs[i], t)) return true; return false; };
    const claim = () => {
      if (!ready()) return 0xc0; // alertable wake-up for APCs
      if (all) { let r = WAIT_OBJECT_0; for (const o of objs) { const rr = consumeSignal(o, t); if (rr === WAIT_ABANDONED) r = WAIT_ABANDONED; } return r; }
      let i = 0; while (!isSignaled(objs[i], t)) i++;
      return consumeSignal(objs[i], t) + i;
    };
    const ok = vm.sched.block(t, () => ready() || (alertable && t.apcQueue.length > 0), ms === INFINITE ? INFINITE : ms, 'waitmany', claim, true);
    if (alertable && t.apcQueue.length) runApcs(c);
    if (!ok) return WAIT_TIMEOUT;
    return t.wakeValue;
  };
  K.WaitForMultipleObjects = [4, (c) => waitMany(c, c.arg(0), c.arg(1), c.arg(2) !== 0, c.arg(3), false)];
  K.WaitForMultipleObjectsEx = [5, (c) => waitMany(c, c.arg(0), c.arg(1), c.arg(2) !== 0, c.arg(3), c.arg(4) !== 0)];
  K.SignalObjectAndWait = [4, (c) => {
    const s = waitObject(c, c.arg(0));
    if (!c.thread.resuming) { if (s?.type === 'event') s.signaled = true; else if (s?.type === 'mutex') { if (--s.count === 0) s.owner = 0; } else if (s?.type === 'semaphore') s.count++; signalAll(); }
    return waitOne(c, c.arg(1), c.arg(2), c.arg(3) !== 0);
  }];

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- memory
  // failed allocations are legitimate (callers must handle them) but often the cause of a degraded behaviour: the first
  // ones are reported with the reserved address space
  // snapshot: diagnostics
  let allocFailures = 0;
  const allocFailed = (c, what) => { if (++allocFailures <= 8) vm.warn(`${what} failed: out of address space (${(c.proc.vmem.reservedBytes?.() / 2 ** 20 | 0) || '?'} MiB reserved) from ${c.proc.symbolize(c.retAddr)}`); };
  K.VirtualAlloc = [4, (c) => {
    const addr = c.arg(0), size = c.arg(1), type = c.arg(2), prot = c.arg(3);
    const vmem = c.proc.vmem;
    if (size === 0) return c.fail(E.INVALID_PARAMETER);
    if (type & MEM_RESERVE || (type & MEM_COMMIT && (!addr || vmem.query(addr).state === 0x10000))) {
      const base = vmem.reserve(size, addr, 'valloc', { topDown: (type & MEM_TOP_DOWN) !== 0 });
      if (!base) { allocFailed(c, `VirtualAlloc(0x${addr.toString(16)}, ${size}, 0x${type.toString(16)})`); return c.fail(E.NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY); }
      if (type & MEM_COMMIT) { vmem.commit(base, base === (addr & ~0xffff) && addr ? addr + size - base : size, prot); mem.fill(base, alignPage(size), 0); }
      return base;
    }
    if (type & MEM_COMMIT) {
      const b = vmem.commit(addr, size, prot);
      if (!b) return c.fail(E.INVALID_ADDRESS);
      return b;
    }
    return c.fail(E.INVALID_PARAMETER);
  }];
  K.VirtualFree = [3, (c) => {
    const addr = c.arg(0), size = c.arg(1), type = c.arg(2);
    const vmem = c.proc.vmem;
    if (type & MEM_RELEASE) { const q = vmem.query(addr); if (!vmem.release(addr)) return c.fail(E.INVALID_ADDRESS); vm.invalidateCode(addr, q.size || 0x1000); return 1; }
    if (type & MEM_DECOMMIT) { vmem.decommit(addr, size); vm.invalidateCode(addr, size || 0x1000); return 1; }
    return c.fail(E.INVALID_PARAMETER);
  }];
  K.VirtualProtect = [4, (c) => { const o = c.proc.vmem.protect(c.arg(0), c.arg(1), c.arg(2)); if (o < 0) return c.fail(E.INVALID_ADDRESS); c.out32(3, o); if (c.arg(2) & 0xf0) vm.invalidateCode(c.arg(0), c.arg(1)); return 1; }];
  K.VirtualQuery = [3, (c) => {
    const a = c.arg(0), w = api.windowAt(a), p = c.arg(1);
    // (a builtin DLL's image: committed image pages; its section alignment is below a page, so Windows maps it as one
    // PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY region)
    const page = a & ~0xfff;
    const q = w ? { base: page, allocBase: w.base, allocProtect: 0x80, size: w.end - page, state: 0x1000, protect: 0x80, type: 0x1000000 } : c.proc.vmem.query(a);
    mem.write32(p, q.base); mem.write32(p + 4, q.allocBase); mem.write32(p + 8, q.allocProtect ?? 0); mem.write32(p + 12, q.size);
    mem.write32(p + 16, q.state); mem.write32(p + 20, q.protect); mem.write32(p + 24, q.type);
    return 28;
  }];
  K.VirtualLock = [2, () => 1];
  K.VirtualUnlock = [2, () => 1];
  K.FlushInstructionCache = [3, (c) => { vm.invalidateCode(c.arg(1), c.arg(2) || 0x1000); return 1; }];
  K.ReadProcessMemory = [5, (c) => { mem.copy(c.arg(2), c.arg(1), c.arg(3)); c.out32(4, c.arg(3)); return 1; }];
  K.WriteProcessMemory = [5, (c) => { mem.copy(c.arg(1), c.arg(2), c.arg(3)); c.out32(4, c.arg(3)); return 1; }];
  K.GlobalMemoryStatus = [1, (c) => {
    const p = c.arg(0);
    mem.write32(p, 32); mem.write32(p + 4, 30); mem.write32(p + 8, 0x7fff0000); mem.write32(p + 12, 0x60000000);
    mem.write32(p + 16, 0xffffffff); mem.write32(p + 20, 0xc0000000); mem.write32(p + 24, 0x7ffe0000); mem.write32(p + 28, 0x70000000);
  }];
  K.GlobalMemoryStatusEx = [1, (c) => {
    const p = c.arg(0);
    mem.write32(p + 4, 30);
    mem.write64(p + 8, 0x7fff0000n); mem.write64(p + 16, 0x60000000n); mem.write64(p + 24, 0xffffffffn); mem.write64(p + 32, 0xc0000000n);
    mem.write64(p + 40, 0x7ffe0000n); mem.write64(p + 48, 0x70000000n); mem.write64(p + 56, 0n);
    return 1;
  }];

  // Heaps
  const heapOf = (c, h) => c.proc.handles.getAs(h, 'heap');
  K.HeapCreate = [3, (c) => c.proc.createHeap({ initial: c.arg(1), max: c.arg(2), tag: 'user' }).handle];
  K.HeapDestroy = [1, (c) => { const h = heapOf(c, c.arg(0)); if (!h || h === c.proc.processHeap) return c.fail(E.INVALID_HANDLE); h.destroy(); c.proc.heaps = c.proc.heaps.filter((x) => x !== h); c.proc.handles.map.delete(c.arg(0)); return 1; }];
  K.HeapAlloc = [3, (c) => { const h = heapOf(c, c.arg(0)); if (!h) return c.fail(E.INVALID_HANDLE); const p = h.alloc(c.arg(2), (c.arg(1) & 8) !== 0); if (vm.heapProv) vm.heapProv(c, 'alloc', p, c.arg(2)); if (!p) { allocFailed(c, `HeapAlloc(0x${c.arg(0).toString(16)}, ${c.arg(2)})`); c.setLastError(E.NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY); } return p; }];
  K.HeapFree = [3, (c) => { const h = heapOf(c, c.arg(0)); if (!h) return c.fail(E.INVALID_HANDLE); if (!c.arg(2)) return 1; if (vm.heapProv) vm.heapProv(c, 'free', c.arg(2), 0); if (!h.free_(c.arg(2))) { vm.warn(`HeapFree: bad pointer ${c.arg(2).toString(16)} from ${c.proc.symbolize(c.retAddr)}` + ((vm.badFrees = (vm.badFrees ?? 0) + 1) <= 2 ? '\n' + vm.crashReport(c.thread, 'HeapFree of a pointer that is no heap block') : '')); return c.fail(E.INVALID_PARAMETER); } return 1; }];
  K.HeapReAlloc = [4, (c) => { const h = heapOf(c, c.arg(0)); if (!h) return c.fail(E.INVALID_HANDLE); const p = h.realloc(c.arg(2), c.arg(3), (c.arg(1) & 8) !== 0, (c.arg(1) & 0x10) !== 0); if (vm.heapProv) { vm.heapProv(c, 'realloc-from', c.arg(2), 0); vm.heapProv(c, 'realloc', p, c.arg(3)); } if (!p) c.setLastError(E.NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY); return p; }];
  K.HeapSize = [3, (c) => { const h = heapOf(c, c.arg(0)); if (!h) return 0xffffffff; const s = h.size(c.arg(2)); return s < 0 ? 0xffffffff : s; }];
  K.HeapValidate = [3, (c) => { const h = heapOf(c, c.arg(0)); return h && h.validate(c.arg(2)) ? 1 : 0; }];
  K.HeapCompact = [2, () => 0x10000];
  K.HeapLock = [1, () => 1];
  K.HeapUnlock = [1, () => 1];
  K.HeapWalk = [2, (c) => c.fail(E.NO_MORE_ITEMS)];
  K.HeapSetInformation = [4, () => 1];
  K.HeapQueryInformation = [5, () => 0];

  // Global/Local (fixed-pointer semantics on the process heap)
  const galloc = (c, flags, size) => { const p = c.proc.processHeap.alloc(size, (flags & 0x40) !== 0); if (vm.heapProv) vm.heapProv(c, 'galloc', p, size); if (!p) c.setLastError(E.NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY); return p; };
  K.GlobalAlloc = [2, (c) => galloc(c, c.arg(0), c.arg(1))];
  K.LocalAlloc = [2, (c) => galloc(c, c.arg(0), c.arg(1))];
  K.GlobalFree = [1, (c) => (c.arg(0) === 0 || (vm.heapProv && vm.heapProv(c, 'gfree', c.arg(0), 0), false) || c.proc.processHeap.free_(c.arg(0)) ? 0 : c.arg(0))];
  K.LocalFree = K.GlobalFree;
  K.GlobalLock = [1, (c) => c.arg(0)];
  K.LocalLock = K.GlobalLock;
  K.GlobalUnlock = [1, () => 1];
  K.LocalUnlock = K.GlobalUnlock;
  K.GlobalHandle = [1, (c) => c.arg(0)];
  K.LocalHandle = K.GlobalHandle;
  K.GlobalSize = [1, (c) => Math.max(c.proc.processHeap.size(c.arg(0)), 0)];
  K.LocalSize = K.GlobalSize;
  K.GlobalFlags = [1, () => 0];
  K.LocalFlags = K.GlobalFlags;
  K.GlobalReAlloc = [3, (c) => c.proc.processHeap.realloc(c.arg(0), c.arg(1), (c.arg(2) & 0x40) !== 0)];
  K.LocalReAlloc = K.GlobalReAlloc;
  K.GlobalCompact = [1, () => 0x100000];

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- modules
  const modHandle = (m) => (m.builtin ? m.base || api.moduleBase(m.name) : m.base);
  // (the module containing an address: a mapped image, or a builtin DLL's image in the thunk area)
  const moduleAt = (c, a) => { const m = c.proc.moduleByAddr(a); if (m) return m; const w = api.windowAt(a); return w ? c.proc.modules.get(w.dll) ?? { name: w.dll, builtin: true, base: w.base } : null; };
  K.GetModuleHandleA = [1, (c) => { const n = c.str(0); if (!n) return c.proc.exe.base; const m = c.proc.modules.get(ApiRegistry.norm(n)); return m ? modHandle(m) : c.fail(E.MOD_NOT_FOUND); }];
  K.GetModuleHandleW = [1, (c) => { const n = c.wstr(0); if (!n) return c.proc.exe.base; const m = c.proc.modules.get(ApiRegistry.norm(n)); return m ? modHandle(m) : c.fail(E.MOD_NOT_FOUND); }];
  K.GetModuleHandleExA = [3, (c) => {
    let m;
    if (c.arg(0) & 4) m = moduleAt(c, c.arg(1));
    else { const n = c.str(1); m = n ? c.proc.modules.get(ApiRegistry.norm(n)) : c.proc.exe; }
    if (!m) return c.fail(E.MOD_NOT_FOUND);
    c.out32(2, modHandle(m)); return 1;
  }];
  K.GetModuleHandleExW = [3, (c) => {
    let m;
    if (c.arg(0) & 4) m = moduleAt(c, c.arg(1));
    else { const n = c.wstr(1); m = n ? c.proc.modules.get(ApiRegistry.norm(n)) : c.proc.exe; }
    if (!m) return c.fail(E.MOD_NOT_FOUND);
    c.out32(2, modHandle(m)); return 1;
  }];
  const loadLib = (c, name) => {
    if (!name) return c.fail(E.INVALID_PARAMETER);
    const before = c.proc.moduleList.length;
    const m = c.proc.loadModule(name);
    if (!m) { vm.warn(`LoadLibrary(${name}) failed`); return c.fail(E.MOD_NOT_FOUND); }
    // attach newly loaded native modules (dependencies first)
    for (let i = before; i < c.proc.moduleList.length; i++) { const nm = c.proc.moduleList[i]; if (!nm.attached) vm.attachModule(c.thread, nm); }
    return modHandle(m);
  };
  K.LoadLibraryA = [1, (c) => loadLib(c, c.str(0))];
  K.LoadLibraryW = [1, (c) => loadLib(c, c.wstr(0))];
  K.LoadLibraryExA = [3, (c) => loadLib(c, c.str(0))];
  K.LoadLibraryExW = [3, (c) => loadLib(c, c.wstr(0))];
  K.FreeLibrary = [1, (c) => 1];
  K.FreeLibraryAndExitThread = [2, (c) => vm.exitThread(c.thread, c.arg(1)), { noreturn: true }];
  K.DisableThreadLibraryCalls = [1, () => 1];
  K.GetProcAddress = [2, (c) => {
    const m = c.proc.moduleByHandle(c.arg(0));
    if (!m) return c.fail(E.MOD_NOT_FOUND);
    const a = c.arg(1);
    const byOrd = a < 0x10000;
    const name = byOrd ? null : mem.readCString(a);
    if (m.builtin) {
      if (byOrd) { const d = api.dlls.get(m.name); const n = d?.ordinals.get(a); if (!n) { vm.warn(`GetProcAddress(${m.name}, #${a}) unknown`); return c.fail(E.PROC_NOT_FOUND); } return api.thunkFor(m.name, n); }
      if (!api.lookup(m.name, name)) { vm.warn(`GetProcAddress(${m.name}, ${name}) -> NULL (not implemented)`); return c.fail(E.PROC_NOT_FOUND); }
      return api.thunkFor(m.name, name);
    }
    const addr = c.proc.resolveExport(m, name, byOrd ? a : null, c.proc.exe);
    return addr || c.fail(E.PROC_NOT_FOUND);
  }];
  const modFileName = (c, wide) => {
    const m = c.proc.moduleByHandle(c.arg(0));
    if (!m) return c.fail(E.MOD_NOT_FOUND);
    const s = c.proc.moduleFileName(m);
    const buf = c.arg(1), size = c.arg(2);
    if (!size) return 0;
    const n = Math.min(s.length, size - 1);
    if (wide) mem.writeWString(buf, s.slice(0, n), size); else mem.writeCString(buf, s.slice(0, n), size);
    if (n < s.length) c.setLastError(E.INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER); else c.setLastError(0);
    return n;
  };
  K.GetModuleFileNameA = [3, (c) => modFileName(c, false)];
  K.GetModuleFileNameW = [3, (c) => modFileName(c, true)];

  // Resources
  const findRes = (c, type, name, lang) => {
    const m = c.proc.moduleByHandle(c.arg(0));

  /**
   * CreateProcess (docs/processes.md): the image found as Windows finds it — the application name, else the command
   * line's first token (quoted, or the shortest run of its words naming a file, `.exe` added to a name without an
   * extension) in the creator's folder, the current directory, then the system folders — runs in a machine of its own
   * (core/procs.js), with the creator's environment (or the block given), current directory, DLL overrides and, with
   * bInheritHandles, its inheritable handles. CREATE_SUSPENDED (4) leaves the main thread suspended.
   */
  function createProcess(c, app, cmd, cwd, wide) {
    const proc = c.proc, flags = c.arg(5) >>> 0;

    if (!image) { vm.warn(`${what} failed: image not found`); return c.fail(E.FILE_NOT_FOUND); }
    const bytes = vm.vfs.readFile(image);
    if (!bytes || bytes.length < 0x40 || bytes[0] !== 0x4d || bytes[1] !== 0x5a) { vm.warn(`${what} failed: ${image} is not a Windows program`); return c.fail(193); } // ERROR_BAD_EXE_FORMAT

    const inherit = c.arg(4) !== 0;

      child = vm.spawnProcess({ exePath: image, exeBytes: bytes, cmdline: cmd ?? `"${image}"`, cwd: cwd ? proc.path(cwd) : proc.cwd, env,
        dllOverrides: Object.fromEntries(proc.dllOverrides) }); // (its handles — windows too — from blocks of its own: core/procs.js)
    } catch (e) { vm.warn(`${what} failed: ${e.message}`); return c.fail(e.processLimit || e instanceof RangeError ? E.NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY : 193); } // (too many processes, no address space for its memory; else its image did not load)
    const cp = child.proc, main = cp.threads[0];

    vm.warn(`${what}: process ${cp.pid} (${image}, main thread ${main.id})${inherit ? `, ${cp.handles.inherit?.size ?? 0} handle(s) inherited` : ''}`);
    return 1;
  }
  /** the image CreateProcess runs (null: none) */
  function findImage(proc, app, cmd) {
    const exists = (p) => { const st = vm.vfs.stat(p); return st && !st.isDir ? p : null; };
    const dirs = [proc.exeDir, proc.cwd, 'C:\\Windows\\System32', 'C:\\Windows'];
    const absolute = (n) => /^[a-z]:|^\\/i.test(n);
    const look = (name, explicit) => {
      for (const n of /\.[^\\.]*$/.test(name) ? [name] : [name + '.exe', name]) {
        if (absolute(n) || explicit) { const p = exists(proc.path(n)); if (p) return p; if (absolute(n)) continue; } // (an application name: relative to the current directory)
        for (const d of dirs) { const p = exists(proc.path(d + '\\' + n)); if (p) return p; }
      }
      return null;
    };
    if (app) return look(app, true);
    const s = (cmd ?? '').trim();
    if (s.startsWith('"')) { const e = s.indexOf('"', 1); return look(e < 0 ? s.slice(1) : s.slice(1, e), false); }
    const words = s.split(/[ \t]+/);
    for (let i = 1; i <= words.length; i++) { const p = look(words.slice(0, i).join(' '), false); if (p) return p; }
    return null;
  }
  /** an environment block (k=v\0 ... \0) as an object */
  function readEnvBlock(p, wide) {

    for (let n = 0; n < 4096; n++) {
      const s = wide ? mem.readWString(p) : mem.readCString(p);
      if (!s) break;
      p += (s.length + 1) * (wide ? 2 : 1);
      const i = s.indexOf('=', 1); if (i > 0) out[s.slice(0, i)] = s.slice(i + 1);
    }
    return out;
  }
```

`src/win32/mappings.js`:

```js
// The paging file's mappings (CreateFileMapping(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE): shared memory) — their bytes and their views
// (kernel32-file.js MapViewOfFile / UnmapViewOfFile, core/procs.js across processes; docs/processes.md).
//
// A mapping keeps its bytes in `data` (grown to the end of the furthest view: a large section viewed through small
// windows costs what its views cover). A view is a copy in its process's guest memory, `{ vm, base, off, n, ver }`. One
// process at a time — the mapping's `holder` — may have views ahead of `data`: the process that runs, the only one that
// can write. Before another process's guest code touches the mapping (its turn, a view it maps or unmaps) the holder's
// bytes go into `data` (release), and that process's views are brought up to date (acquire) — only those `data` changed
// since they were filled (`ver`, the mapping's version, moved by every change). A process that only waits, or a mapping
// nobody wrote, costs nothing at a switch.
//
// The holder's views go into `data` as a difference: a byte is taken from a view only where the view differs from what
// `data` held before (`prev`), so a stale view — a second view of the same bytes in one process, which does not see the
// first one's writes (two views never alias here) — never overwrites a newer byte.

/**
 * The bytes of `src` [base, base + n) that differ from `prev` [off, off + n) into `data` [off, off + n).
 * @returns {boolean} whether any byte differed
 */
function merge(data, prev, src, base, off, n) {
  let changed = false, i = 0;
  if (((base | off) & 3) === 0 && n >= 4) {
    const w = n >>> 2;
    const s32 = new Int32Array(src.buffer, src.byteOffset + base, w), p32 = new Int32Array(prev.buffer, prev.byteOffset + off, w);
    if (prev === data) {
      for (let k = 0; k < w; k++) { const x = s32[k]; if (x !== p32[k]) { p32[k] = x; changed = true; } }
    } else {
      for (let k = 0; k < w; k++) {
        if (s32[k] === p32[k]) continue;
        changed = true;
        for (let b = k << 2, e = b + 4; b < e; b++) if (src[base + b] !== prev[off + b]) data[off + b] = src[base + b];
      }
    }
    i = w << 2;
  }
  for (; i < n; i++) if (src[base + i] !== prev[off + i]) { data[off + i] = src[base + i]; changed = true; }
  return changed;
}

/**
 * The holder's views into the mapping's bytes (it stops being ahead of them).
 * @returns {number} bytes compared (diagnostics: ProcessGroup.syncBytes)
 */
export function releaseMapping(m) {
  const h = m.holder;
  if (!h) return 0;
  m.holder = null;
  let views = 0, bytes = 0;
  for (const v of m.views) if (v.vm === h) views++;
  if (!views) return 0;
  const data = m.data, prev = views > 1 ? data.slice() : data; // (several views: each compared to the bytes before any of them)
  let changed = false;
  for (const v of m.views) {
    if (v.vm !== h) continue;
    if (merge(data, prev, h.mem.u8, v.base, v.off, v.n)) changed = true;
    bytes += v.n;
  }
  if (changed) {
    m.ver++;
    if (views === 1) for (const v of m.views) if (v.vm === h) v.ver = m.ver; // (its one view is what the bytes are now)
  }
  return bytes;
}

/**
 * `vm` is about to run guest code that may touch the mapping: the holder's bytes released, `vm`'s views brought up to
 * date, `vm` the holder.
 * @returns {number} bytes moved (diagnostics)
 */
export function acquireMapping(vm, m) {
  if (m.holder === vm) return 0;
  let bytes = m.holder ? releaseMapping(m) : 0;
  for (const v of m.views) {
    if (v.vm !== vm || v.ver === m.ver) continue;
    vm.mem.u8.set(m.data.subarray(v.off, v.off + v.n), v.base); v.ver = m.ver; bytes += v.n;
  }
  m.holder = vm;
  return bytes;
}

/**
 * The bytes [0, end) available in `data` (zeros past what views covered so far); false when the host cannot allocate
 * them (the caller fails with ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY).
 */
export function growMapping(m, end) {
  if (m.data && m.data.length >= end) return true;
  let d;
  try { d = new Uint8Array(end); } catch { return false; }
  if (m.data) d.set(m.data);
  m.data = d;
  return true;
}

/** `vm`'s views of `m` written back and removed (an unmap of all of them, the process ending) */
export function dropViews(vm, m) {
  releaseMapping(m);
  m.views = m.views.filter((x) => x.vm !== vm);
}

```

`src/win32/mci.js`:

```js
// winmm.dll MCI (Media Control Interface): the digital video and wave audio devices (MPEGVideo, AVIVideo,
// digitalvideo, waveaudio) through mciSendString and mciSendCommand — the other way Windows programs play a movie or a
// sound file. Each open device plays its file with a MoviePlayer (movie-player.js: the formats of docs/media-playback.md):
// pictures in the device's window (its own, a window given by `window handle`, a child of `parent`, or full screen),
// sound through the DirectSound mixer, MM_MCINOTIFY to the callback window, `wait` blocking the caller until the end.
// Other device types (cdaudio, sequencer...) answer as before (MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_ID), so programs go on without them.
import { snapKnown, snapClass } from '../core/snapshot.js';
import { MoviePlayer, MediaClock, RUNNING, PAUSED } from './movie-player.js';
import { INFINITE } from '../core/sched.js';

const MCIERR = {
  INVALID_DEVICE_ID: 257, UNRECOGNIZED_KEYWORD: 259, UNRECOGNIZED_COMMAND: 261, INVALID_DEVICE_NAME: 263, DEVICE_OPEN: 265, MISSING_PARAMETER: 273,
  UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION: 274, FILE_NOT_FOUND: 275, OUTOFRANGE: 282, DEVICE_TYPE_REQUIRED: 287, DUPLICATE_ALIAS: 289, BAD_TIME_FORMAT: 293, INVALID_FILE: 296,
  NONAPPLICABLE_FUNCTION: 302, MISSING_DEVICE_NAME: 292, EXTENSION_NOT_FOUND: 281,
};
const MM_MCINOTIFY = 0x3b9, NOTIFY_SUCCESSFUL = 1, NOTIFY_SUPERSEDED = 2, NOTIFY_ABORTED = 4, NOTIFY_FAILURE = 8;
const MODE = { 524: 'not ready', 525: 'stopped', 526: 'playing', 528: 'seeking', 529: 'paused', 530: 'open' };
const MODE_STOP = 525, MODE_PLAY = 526, MODE_PAUSE = 529;
// mciSendCommand messages and flags
const MCI_OPEN = 0x803, MCI_CLOSE = 0x804, MCI_PLAY = 0x806, MCI_SEEK = 0x807, MCI_STOP = 0x808, MCI_PAUSE = 0x809, MCI_INFO = 0x80a, MCI_GETDEVCAPS = 0x80b,
  MCI_SET = 0x80d, MCI_STATUS = 0x814, MCI_CUE = 0x830, MCI_WINDOW = 0x841, MCI_PUT = 0x842, MCI_WHERE = 0x843, MCI_RESUME = 0x855, MCI_SETAUDIO = 0x873;
const F_NOTIFY = 1, F_WAIT = 2, F_FROM = 4, F_TO = 8, F_OPEN_SHAREABLE = 0x100, F_OPEN_ELEMENT = 0x200, F_OPEN_ALIAS = 0x400, F_OPEN_TYPE_ID = 0x1000, F_OPEN_TYPE = 0x2000,
  F_DGV_OPEN_WS = 0x10000, F_DGV_OPEN_PARENT = 0x20000, F_SEEK_START = 0x100, F_SEEK_END = 0x200, F_STATUS_ITEM = 0x100, F_SET_TIME_FORMAT = 0x400,
  F_PLAY_FULLSCREEN = 0x02000000, F_PLAY_REPEAT = 0x10000, F_WINDOW_HWND = 0x10000, F_WINDOW_STATE = 0x40000, F_PUT_RECT = 0x10000, F_PUT_SOURCE = 0x20000,
  F_PUT_DESTINATION = 0x40000, F_PUT_WINDOW = 0x200000;
const FORMAT_MS = 0, FORMAT_FRAMES = 3;
const WS_CHILD = 0x40000000;
/** device types played here, and the type of a file by its extension (the [MCI Extensions] of Windows) */
const TYPES = new Set(['mpegvideo', 'avivideo', 'digitalvideo', 'waveaudio']);
const BY_EXT = { avi: 'avivideo', wav: 'waveaudio', mpg: 'mpegvideo', mpeg: 'mpegvideo', mpe: 'mpegvideo', m1v: 'mpegvideo', mpa: 'mpegvideo', mp2: 'mpegvideo', mp3: 'mpegvideo', dat: 'mpegvideo' };

/** split a command string into words ("quoted" words keep their spaces) */
export function mciWords(s) {
  const out = []; let i = 0;
  while (i < s.length) {
    while (i < s.length && /\s/.test(s[i])) i++;
    if (i >= s.length) break;
    if (s[i] === '"') { const j = s.indexOf('"', i + 1); out.push(s.slice(i + 1, j < 0 ? s.length : j)); i = j < 0 ? s.length : j + 1; }
    else { let j = i; while (j < s.length && !/\s/.test(s[j])) j++; out.push(s.slice(i, j)); i = j; }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * @param {import('./api.js').ApiRegistry} api
 * @param {import('../core/vm.js').Vm} vm
 */
export function registerMci(api, vm) {
  const mem = vm.mem;
  vm.media ??= new MediaClock(vm);
  const log = (m) => vm.log('video', `mci: ${m}`);
  /** @type {Map<number, Device>} */
  const devices = snapKnown(vm, 'mci.devices', new Map());
  const ids = snapKnown(vm, 'mci.ids', { next: 1 });

  class Device {
    constructor(proc, type, alias) {
      this.id = 0; this.type = type; this.alias = alias; this.proc = proc; // (the id: once opened)
      this.format = type === 'avivideo' ? FORMAT_FRAMES : FORMAT_MS;
      this.win = { hwnd: 0, parent: 0, style: 0, shown: true, fullScreen: false, at: null };
      this.dst = null; this.srcRect = null;
      this.notify = null; // { hwnd } of the pending play's notification
      this.repeat = false; this.waiting = false;
      this.player = new MoviePlayer(vm, proc, {
        log: (m) => log(`${this.alias ?? this.id}: ${m}`),
        onComplete: () => this.ended(),
        onError: () => this.finishNotify(NOTIFY_FAILURE),
        rect: () => this.screenRect(), source: () => this.srcRect, visible: () => this.visible(),
      });
    }
    get name() { return this.alias ?? String(this.id); }
    visible() { return this.player.hasVideo && (this.win.fullScreen || this.win.shown) && (this.player.state !== 0 || this.player.shown); }
    /** the video's place on the screen: full screen, the destination in the window, or the window's client area at the video's size */
    screenRect() {
      const p = this.player, W = vm.wm?.screen.width ?? 640, H = vm.wm?.screen.height ?? 480;
      if (this.win.fullScreen) return { x: 0, y: 0, w: W, h: H };
      let ox, oy;
      const target = this.win.hwnd ? vm.wm?.windows.get(this.win.hwnd) : this.win.parent ? vm.wm?.windows.get(this.win.parent) : null;
      if (this.win.at) { ox = this.win.at.x; oy = this.win.at.y; if (target && (this.win.hwnd || this.win.style & WS_CHILD)) { ox += target.client.l; oy += target.client.t; } }
      else if (target) { ox = target.client.l; oy = target.client.t; } // (a window given, or a child of the parent at its top left corner)
      else { ox = (W - p.width) >> 1; oy = (H - p.height) >> 1; } // (its own window, centered)
      const d = this.dst ?? (this.win.at && !this.win.hwnd ? { x: 0, y: 0, w: this.win.at.w, h: this.win.at.h } : { x: 0, y: 0, w: p.width, h: p.height });
      return { x: ox + d.x, y: oy + d.y, w: d.w, h: d.h };
    }
    /** a time in the device's format -> seconds, and back */
    toSec(v) { return this.format === FORMAT_FRAMES ? v / (this.player.src?.fps || 25) : v / 1000; }
    fromSec(s) { return Math.round(this.format === FORMAT_FRAMES ? s * (this.player.src?.fps || 25) : s * 1000); }
    get length() { const p = this.player; return this.format === FORMAT_FRAMES && p.hasVideo ? (p.src.vs?.length || Math.round(p.duration * p.src.fps)) : this.fromSec(p.duration); }
    mode() { const p = this.player; return p.state === RUNNING && !p.completed ? MODE_PLAY : p.state === PAUSED ? MODE_PAUSE : MODE_STOP; }
    /** the previous play's notification, if any, with a result; a new one to come */
    finishNotify(flag) {
      const n = this.notify; this.notify = null;
      if (!n) return;
      const w = vm.wm?.windows.get(n.hwnd);
      if (w) vm.wm.post(w, MM_MCINOTIFY, flag, this.id);
    }
    ended() {
      if (this.repeat) { this.player.seek(this.fromTime ?? 0); this.player.completed = false; return; }
      this.player.stop();
      this.finishNotify(NOTIFY_SUCCESSFUL);
    }
    play({ from, to, notify, fullScreen, repeat }) {
      const p = this.player;
      this.finishNotify(NOTIFY_SUPERSEDED);
      if (from !== undefined) p.seek(Math.min(this.toSec(from), p.duration));
      else if (p.completed || p.position() >= p.stopTime) p.seek(0); // (played to the end: from the start again)
      p.stopPos = to !== undefined ? Math.min(this.toSec(to), p.duration) : null;
      this.fromTime = from !== undefined ? this.toSec(from) : 0;
      this.win.fullScreen = !!fullScreen; this.repeat = !!repeat;
      if (notify) this.notify = { hwnd: notify };
      if (p.state !== RUNNING) p.run();
      else { p.completed = false; vm.media.wake(); }
    }
    close() { this.finishNotify(NOTIFY_ABORTED); this.player.close(); devices.delete(this.id); log(`${this.name}: closed`); }
  }
  for (const C of [Device]) snapClass(vm, C, { name: `mci.${C.name}` }); // (snapshots: core/vm-snapshot.js)

  const byName = (n) => {
    if (n === undefined) return null;
    const l = n.toLowerCase();
    for (const d of devices.values()) if ((d.alias && d.alias.toLowerCase() === l) || String(d.id) === l) return d;
    return null;
  };
  /** open a device: { error } or { device } */
  function open(c, { type, element, alias, parent, style, notify }) {
    if (!type && element) {
      const bang = element.indexOf('!');
      if (bang > 0) { type = element.slice(0, bang); element = element.slice(bang + 1); }
      else { const ext = /\.([^.\\/]+)$/.exec(element)?.[1]?.toLowerCase(); type = BY_EXT[ext]; if (!type) return { error: ext ? MCIERR.EXTENSION_NOT_FOUND : MCIERR.INVALID_DEVICE_ID }; }
    }
    type = type?.toLowerCase();
    if (!type || !TYPES.has(type)) return { error: MCIERR.INVALID_DEVICE_ID }; // (cdaudio, sequencer, ...: as before)
    if (!element) return { error: MCIERR.UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION }; // (a device without a file: recording, not here)
    if (alias && byName(alias)) return { error: MCIERR.DUPLICATE_ALIAS };
    const d = new Device(c.proc, type, alias ?? null);
    const path = c.proc.path(element);
    const r = d.player.open(path);
    if (!r.ok) { d.player.close(); log(`open ${path}: ${r.message}`); return { error: r.code === 'not-found' ? MCIERR.FILE_NOT_FOUND : MCIERR.INVALID_FILE }; }
    d.win.parent = parent ?? 0; d.win.style = style ?? 0;
    d.id = ids.next++; devices.set(d.id, d);
    log(`open ${path} as ${type} ${d.name} (id ${d.id})`);
    if (notify) { const w = vm.wm?.windows.get(notify); if (w) vm.wm.post(w, MM_MCINOTIFY, NOTIFY_SUCCESSFUL, d.id); }
    return { device: d };
  }
  /** wait (the caller's thread) for the end of a play started with `wait` */
  function waitEnd(c, d, started) {
    if (c.thread.wakeResult === undefined && !started) return 0;
    vm.sched.block(c.thread, () => !devices.has(d.id) || d.player.state !== RUNNING || d.player.completed || d.player.failed, INFINITE, 'MCI play wait');
    return 0;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- mciSendString
  function sendString(c, cmd, ret, retLen, callback) {
    const w = mciWords(cmd ?? ''), verb = (w.shift() ?? '').toLowerCase();
    const out = (s) => { if (ret && retLen) mem.writeCString(ret, String(s).slice(0, retLen - 1), retLen); return 0; };
    if (ret && retLen) mem.write8(ret, 0);
    if (!verb) return MCIERR.MISSING_DEVICE_NAME;
    const flags = new Set(w.map((x) => x.toLowerCase()));
    const after = (k, n = 1) => { const i = w.findIndex((x) => x.toLowerCase() === k); return i < 0 ? undefined : n === 1 ? w[i + 1] : w.slice(i + 1, i + 1 + n); };
    const notify = flags.has('notify') ? callback : 0;
    if (verb === 'open') {
      const target = w[0];
      if (!target) return MCIERR.MISSING_DEVICE_NAME;
      const typeArg = after('type'), isType = !typeArg && TYPES.has(target.toLowerCase()) && !/[.\\/]/.test(target);
      const r = open(c, { type: typeArg ?? (isType ? target : undefined), element: isType ? after('element') : target, alias: after('alias'), parent: after('parent') !== undefined ? parseInt(after('parent'), 10) >>> 0 : 0, style: flags.has('child') ? WS_CHILD : 0, notify });
      if (r.error) return r.error;
      return out(r.device.id);
    }
    if (verb === 'sysinfo') { if (flags.has('quantity')) return out(devices.size); return out(''); }
    const name = w[0], all = name?.toLowerCase() === 'all';
    if (verb === 'close' && all) { for (const d of [...devices.values()]) d.close(); return 0; }
    const d = byName(name);
    if (!d) {
      // (a device name never opened: "play file.avi" opens it on the fly, as MCI's auto-open)
      if (verb === 'play' && name && /\.[^.\\/]+$/.test(name)) { const r = open(c, { element: name }); if (r.error) return r.error; return sendString(c, cmd.replace(/^\s*play\s+("[^"]*"|\S+)/i, `play ${r.device.id}`), ret, retLen, callback); }
      return name ? MCIERR.INVALID_DEVICE_NAME : MCIERR.MISSING_DEVICE_NAME;
    }
    const p = d.player, num = (v) => (v === undefined ? undefined : parseInt(v, 10));
    switch (verb) {
      case 'play': {
        const resumed = c.thread.wakeResult !== undefined;
        if (!resumed) d.play({ from: num(after('from')), to: num(after('to')), notify, fullScreen: flags.has('fullscreen'), repeat: flags.has('repeat') });
        return flags.has('wait') ? waitEnd(c, d, true) : 0;
      }
      case 'stop':
        d.finishNotify(NOTIFY_ABORTED); p.stop();
        if (notify) { d.notify = { hwnd: notify }; d.finishNotify(NOTIFY_SUCCESSFUL); } // (the stop's own notification)
        return 0;
      case 'pause': p.pause(); return 0;
      case 'resume': if (p.state === PAUSED) p.run(); return 0;
      case 'seek': {
        const to = after('to'); if (to === undefined) return MCIERR.MISSING_PARAMETER;
        d.finishNotify(NOTIFY_ABORTED); p.stop();
        p.seek(to.toLowerCase() === 'start' ? 0 : to.toLowerCase() === 'end' ? p.duration : d.toSec(num(to)));
        return 0;
      }
      case 'close': d.close(); return 0;
      case 'status': {
        const item = w.slice(1).filter((x) => !/^(notify|wait)$/i.test(x)).join(' ').toLowerCase();
        switch (item) {
          case 'mode': return out(MODE[d.mode()]);
          case 'length': return out(d.length);
          case 'position': return out(d.fromSec(p.position()));
          case 'ready': case 'media present': return out('true');
          case 'number of tracks': return out(1);
          case 'time format': return out(d.format === FORMAT_FRAMES ? 'frames' : 'milliseconds');
          case 'window handle': return out(d.win.hwnd || d.win.parent || 0);
          case 'frame rate': return out(Math.round((p.src?.fps || 0) * 1000));
          default: return MCIERR.UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION;
        }
      }
      case 'set': {
        const tf = after('format');
        if (flags.has('time') && tf) { const f = tf.toLowerCase(); if (f === 'milliseconds' || f === 'ms') d.format = FORMAT_MS; else if (f === 'frames' && p.hasVideo) d.format = FORMAT_FRAMES; else return MCIERR.BAD_TIME_FORMAT; }
        if (flags.has('audio')) p.setVolume(flags.has('off') ? -10000 : 0);
        return 0;
      }
      case 'setaudio': { const v = num(after('to')); if (flags.has('volume') && v !== undefined) p.setVolume(v <= 0 ? -10000 : Math.round(2000 * Math.log10(Math.min(v, 1000) / 1000))); return 0; }
      case 'window': {
        if (!p.hasVideo) return MCIERR.UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION;
        const h = after('handle'), st = after('state');
        if (h !== undefined) d.win.hwnd = h.toLowerCase() === 'default' ? 0 : parseInt(h, 10) >>> 0;
        if (st !== undefined) d.win.shown = !/^(hide|minimize|minimized)$/i.test(st);
        p.refresh(); return 0;
      }
      case 'put': {
        if (!p.hasVideo) return MCIERR.UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION;
        const at = after('at', 4)?.map(Number);
        if (!at || at.length < 4 || at.some(Number.isNaN)) return MCIERR.MISSING_PARAMETER;
        const r = { x: at[0], y: at[1], w: at[2], h: at[3] };
        if (flags.has('destination')) d.dst = r; else if (flags.has('source')) d.srcRect = { l: r.x, t: r.y, w: r.w, h: r.h }; else d.win.at = r;
        p.refresh(); return 0;
      }
      case 'where': {
        if (!p.hasVideo) return MCIERR.UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION;
        const s = d.screenRect();
        if (flags.has('source')) { const r = d.srcRect ?? { l: 0, t: 0, w: p.width, h: p.height }; return out(`${r.l} ${r.t} ${r.w} ${r.h}`); }
        if (flags.has('window')) { const a = d.win.at; return out(a ? `${a.x} ${a.y} ${a.w} ${a.h}` : `0 0 ${p.width} ${p.height}`); }
        const r = d.dst ?? { x: 0, y: 0, w: s.w, h: s.h };
        return out(`${r.x} ${r.y} ${r.w} ${r.h}`);
      }
      case 'info': return out(flags.has('file') ? p.path ?? '' : d.type === 'avivideo' ? 'Video for Windows' : d.type === 'waveaudio' ? 'Sound' : 'DirectShow');
      case 'capability': return out(flags.has('device') && flags.has('type') ? 'digitalvideo' : 'true');
      case 'cue': case 'update': case 'realize': case 'signal': return 0;
      default: return MCIERR.UNRECOGNIZED_COMMAND;
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- mciSendCommand
  const strArg = (a, wide) => (a ? (wide ? mem.readWString(a) : mem.readCString(a)) : undefined);
  function sendCommand(c, id, msg, flags, parms, wide) {
    const P = parms, cb = P ? mem.read32(P) : 0, notify = flags & F_NOTIFY ? cb : 0;
    if (msg === MCI_OPEN) {
      if (!P) return MCIERR.MISSING_PARAMETER;
      const tp = mem.read32(P + 8);
      // (MCI_OPEN_TYPE_ID: a device type number — the wave / video ones are not told apart by number here: type from the file)
      const type = flags & F_OPEN_TYPE ? (flags & F_OPEN_TYPE_ID ? undefined : strArg(tp, wide)) : undefined;
      const element = flags & F_OPEN_ELEMENT ? strArg(mem.read32(P + 12), wide) : undefined;
      const alias = flags & F_OPEN_ALIAS ? strArg(mem.read32(P + 16), wide) : undefined;
      const r = open(c, { type, element, alias, parent: flags & F_DGV_OPEN_PARENT ? mem.read32(P + 24) : 0, style: flags & F_DGV_OPEN_WS ? mem.read32(P + 20) : 0, notify });
      if (r.error) return r.error;
      mem.write32(P + 4, r.device.id);
      return 0;
    }
    if (id === 0xffff && msg === MCI_CLOSE) { for (const d of [...devices.values()]) d.close(); return 0; } // (MCI_ALL_DEVICE_ID)
    const d = devices.get(id);
    if (!d) return MCIERR.INVALID_DEVICE_ID;
    const p = d.player;
    switch (msg) {
      case MCI_PLAY: {
        const resumed = c.thread.wakeResult !== undefined;
        if (!resumed) d.play({ from: flags & F_FROM ? mem.read32(P + 4) : undefined, to: flags & F_TO ? mem.read32(P + 8) : undefined, notify, fullScreen: flags & F_PLAY_FULLSCREEN, repeat: flags & F_PLAY_REPEAT });
        return flags & F_WAIT ? waitEnd(c, d, true) : 0;
      }
      case MCI_STOP: d.finishNotify(NOTIFY_ABORTED); p.stop(); return 0;
      case MCI_PAUSE: p.pause(); return 0;
      case MCI_RESUME: if (p.state === PAUSED) p.run(); return 0;
      case MCI_CLOSE: d.close(); return 0;
      case MCI_SEEK: d.finishNotify(NOTIFY_ABORTED); p.stop(); p.seek(flags & F_SEEK_START ? 0 : flags & F_SEEK_END ? p.duration : flags & F_TO ? d.toSec(mem.read32(P + 4)) : p.pos); return 0;
      case MCI_STATUS: {
        if (!(flags & F_STATUS_ITEM) || !P) return MCIERR.MISSING_PARAMETER;
        const item = mem.read32(P + 8);
        const v = item === 1 ? d.length : item === 2 ? d.fromSec(p.position()) : item === 3 ? 1 : item === 4 ? d.mode() : item === 5 || item === 7 ? 1 : item === 6 ? d.format : item === 8 ? 1 : null;
        if (v === null) return MCIERR.UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION;
        mem.write32(P + 4, v >>> 0); return 0;
      }
      case MCI_SET: if (flags & F_SET_TIME_FORMAT) { const f = mem.read32(P + 4); if (f !== FORMAT_MS && !(f === FORMAT_FRAMES && p.hasVideo)) return MCIERR.BAD_TIME_FORMAT; d.format = f; } return 0;
      case MCI_WINDOW:
        if (!p.hasVideo) return MCIERR.UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION;
        if (flags & F_WINDOW_HWND) d.win.hwnd = mem.read32(P + 4);
        if (flags & F_WINDOW_STATE) d.win.shown = mem.read32(P + 8) !== 0; // (SW_HIDE: hidden)
        p.refresh(); return 0;
      case MCI_PUT: {
        if (!p.hasVideo) return MCIERR.UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION;
        if (!(flags & F_PUT_RECT)) return 0;
        const r = { x: mem.readS32(P + 4), y: mem.readS32(P + 8), w: mem.readS32(P + 12), h: mem.readS32(P + 16) }; // (RECT fields: left, top, width, height)
        if (flags & F_PUT_DESTINATION) d.dst = r; else if (flags & F_PUT_SOURCE) d.srcRect = { l: r.x, t: r.y, w: r.w, h: r.h }; else if (flags & F_PUT_WINDOW) d.win.at = r;
        p.refresh(); return 0;
      }
      case MCI_WHERE: {
        if (!p.hasVideo) return MCIERR.UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION;
        const s = d.screenRect(), r = flags & F_PUT_SOURCE ? { x: d.srcRect?.l ?? 0, y: d.srcRect?.t ?? 0, w: d.srcRect?.w ?? p.width, h: d.srcRect?.h ?? p.height } : flags & F_PUT_WINDOW ? (d.win.at ?? { x: 0, y: 0, w: p.width, h: p.height }) : (d.dst ?? { x: 0, y: 0, w: s.w, h: s.h });
        mem.write32(P + 4, r.x); mem.write32(P + 8, r.y); mem.write32(P + 12, r.w); mem.write32(P + 16, r.h); return 0;
      }
      case MCI_SETAUDIO: case MCI_CUE: case MCI_INFO: case MCI_GETDEVCAPS: return MCIERR.UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTION;
      default: return MCIERR.UNRECOGNIZED_COMMAND;
    }
  }

  const errorText = (e) => ({ 0: 'The specified command was carried out.', [MCIERR.INVALID_DEVICE_ID]: 'Invalid MCI device ID. The file may be corrupt, or not in the correct format.', [MCIERR.UNRECOGNIZED_COMMAND]: 'The driver cannot recognize the specified command.', [MCIERR.INVALID_DEVICE_NAME]: 'The specified device is not open or is not recognized by MCI.' }[e] ?? `MCI error ${e}.`);

    mciSendStringA: [4, (c) => { const s = c.str(0); const r = sendString(c, s, c.arg(1), c.arg(2), c.arg(3)); vm.log('video', `mciSendString("${s}") -> ${r}`); return r; }],

    mciSendCommandA: [4, traced('mciSendCommand', (c) => sendCommand(c, c.arg(0), c.arg(1), c.arg(2), c.arg(3), false))],
    mciSendCommandW: [4, traced('mciSendCommandW', (c) => sendCommand(c, c.arg(0), c.arg(1), c.arg(2), c.arg(3), true))],
    mciGetErrorStringA: [3, (c) => { if (c.arg(1) && c.arg(2)) mem.writeCString(c.arg(1), errorText(c.arg(0)), c.arg(2)); return 1; }],
    mciGetErrorStringW: [3, (c) => { if (c.arg(1) && c.arg(2)) mem.writeWString(c.arg(1), errorText(c.arg(0)), c.arg(2)); return 1; }],
    mciGetDeviceIDA: [1, (c) => byName(c.str(0))?.id ?? 0],
    mciGetDeviceIDW: [1, (c) => byName(c.wstr(0))?.id ?? 0],
  });
}
```

```js
/** GUID at address as lowercase "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx" */
export function guidOf(mem, a) {
  if (!a) return '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
  const h = (v, n) => v.toString(16).padStart(n, '0');
  const b = [];
  for (let i = 8; i < 16; i++) b.push(h(mem.read8(a + i), 2));
  return `${h(mem.read32(a), 8)}-${h(mem.read16(a + 4), 4)}-${h(mem.read16(a + 6), 4)}-${b[0]}${b[1]}-${b.slice(2).join('')}`;
}
export function parseGuid(mem, s, a) {
  const m = s.replace(/[{}]/g, '').toLowerCase().match(/^([0-9a-f]{8})-([0-9a-f]{4})-([0-9a-f]{4})-([0-9a-f]{4})-([0-9a-f]{12})$/);
  if (!m) return false;
  mem.write32(a, parseInt(m[1], 16)); mem.write16(a + 4, parseInt(m[2], 16)); mem.write16(a + 6, parseInt(m[3], 16));
  const tail = m[4] + m[5];
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) mem.write8(a + 8 + i, parseInt(tail.slice(2 * i, 2 * i + 2), 16));
  return true;
}
export function writeGuid(mem, a, s) { return parseGuid(mem, s, a); }
function bstrAlloc(c, s) {
  const p = c.proc.processHeap.alloc(2 * (s.length + 1) + 4);
  c.mem.write32(p, 2 * s.length);
  c.mem.writeWString(p + 4, s);
  return p + 4;
}
```

`src/win32/movie-player.js`:

```js
// The playback engine behind the Windows media APIs (DirectShow's filter graph manager in quartz.js, MCI's digital
// video and wave devices in mci.js): a media file of the virtual file system (src/media) played on the VM clock — its
// pictures shown on the host display's video layer in a rectangle the API's window state gives, its sound through the
// DirectSound mixer, the end reported to the API. vm.media (MediaClock) advances the playing ones from the scheduler.
import { openMedia, MediaError } from '../media/open.js';
import { yuv420ToRgba } from '../media/yuv.js';

export const STOPPED = 0, PAUSED = 1, RUNNING = 2;
const AUDIO_LEAD = 0.25; // seconds of sound written ahead of the play cursor

/** The playing players, advanced by the scheduler (sched.js: wakeBlocked calls tick, nextWake asks for the next due time). */
export class MediaClock {
  constructor(vm) { this.vm = vm; this.players = new Set(); this.due = Infinity; }
  tick(now) {
    if (now < this.due) return;
    if (!this.players.size) { this.due = Infinity; return; } // (nothing playing: the scheduler no longer calls in)
    let due = Infinity;
    for (const p of [...this.players]) {
      try { due = Math.min(due, p.tick(now)); } catch (e) { this.vm.warn(`media: playback of ${p.path} failed: ${e.stack ?? e}`); p.fail(); }
    }
    this.due = due;
  }
  nextWake() { return this.players.size ? this.due : Infinity; }
  /** a player started or moved: advanced at the next pass */
  wake() { this.due = 0; this.tick(this.vm.clock.now()); }
}

/**
 * @typedef {{
 *   log?: (msg: string) => void,
 *   onComplete?: () => void,   every stream ended (or the stop position reached) while running
 *   onError?: () => void,      the file could not be read on
 *   rect: () => { x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number },   where the pictures go (screen coordinates)
 *   source?: () => ({ l: number, t: number, w: number, h: number } | null),   the part of the picture shown (null: all)
 *   visible: () => boolean,
 * }} PlayerHooks
 */
export class MoviePlayer {
  /** @param {any} vm @param {any} proc @param {PlayerHooks} hooks */
  constructor(vm, proc, hooks) {
    this.vm = vm; this.proc = proc; this.hooks = hooks; this.log = hooks.log ?? (() => {});
    this.src = null; this.path = null; this.state = STOPPED; this.completed = false; this.failed = false;
    this.pos = 0; // stream position (seconds) while not running; at a run: the position it started from
    this.runAt = 0; // VM clock (ms) when the current run started
    this.stopPos = null; // stop position (seconds; null: the end)
    this.volume = 0; this.balance = 0; // (1/100 dB)
    this.voice = null; this.pending = []; this.rgba = null; this.shown = false; this.due = 0;
    this.presented = 0; this.presentMs = 0; this.closed = null;
  }
  /**
   * Open a file (a guest path): { ok: true, left: null | 'video' | 'audio' (a stream without a decoder, left out) } or
   * { ok: false, code: 'not-found' | 'unknown' | 'unsupported' | 'corrupt', message }.
   */
  open(path) {
    const vm = this.vm, st = vm.vfs.stat(path);
    if (!st || st.isDir) { this.log(`open ${path}: not found`); return { ok: false, code: 'not-found', message: 'not found' }; }
    const f = vm.vfs.open(path, {});
    if (!f) return { ok: false, code: 'not-found', message: 'not found' };
    try { this.src = openMedia(f, { log: this.log }); } catch (e) {
      f.close();
      const code = !(e instanceof MediaError) || e.code === 'corrupt' ? 'corrupt' : /layer III|MPEG-2|AVI (video|audio)|format tag/.test(e.message) ? 'unsupported' : 'unknown';
      return { ok: false, code, message: e.message };
    }
    this.path = path;
    const s = this.src;
    this.log(`${path}: ${s.kind}${s.video ? `, video ${s.width}x${s.height} ${s.fps.toFixed(2)} fps` : ''}${s.audio ? `, audio ${s.audioRate} Hz ${s.audioChannels} ch` : ''}, ${s.duration.toFixed(2)} s`);
    return { ok: true, left: s.videoUnsupported ? 'video' : (s.audioLayer === 3 || s.audioUnsupported) && !s.audio ? 'audio' : null };
  }
  get hasVideo() { return !!this.src?.video; }
  get hasAudio() { return !!this.src?.audio; }
  get width() { return this.src?.width ?? 0; }
  get height() { return this.src?.height ?? 0; }
  get duration() { return this.src?.duration ?? 0; }
  /** where playback ends (seconds): the stop position, else the duration (unknown: no end before the streams') */
  get stopTime() { return this.stopPos ?? (this.duration || Infinity); }
  /** the stream position now (seconds) */
  position(now = this.vm.clock.now()) {
    if (this.state !== RUNNING) return this.pos;
    return Math.min(this.pos + (now - this.runAt) / 1000, Math.max(this.stopTime, this.pos));
  }

  // ---- states
  run() {
    if (this.state === RUNNING || !this.src) { this.state = RUNNING; return; }
    if (this.state === STOPPED) this.completed = false;
    this.state = RUNNING; this.runAt = this.vm.clock.now();
    this.vm.media.players.add(this);
    this.startAudio();
    this.vm.media.wake();
  }
  pause() {
    if (this.state === RUNNING) this.pos = this.position();
    this.halt(); this.state = PAUSED;
    if (this.src) this.showPosition();
  }
  stop() {
    if (this.state === RUNNING) this.pos = this.position();
    this.halt(); this.state = STOPPED;
  }
  halt() { this.voice?.stop(); this.vm.media.players.delete(this); }
  fail() { this.failed = true; this.halt(); this.hooks.onError?.(); }
  close() {
    this.halt(); this.hideVideo();
    this.voice?.destroy(); this.voice = null;
    this.src?.close(); this.closed = this.src; this.src = null;
  }

  /** move to stream position `t` (seconds): decoders restarted at the beginning and run forward when going back */
  seek(t) {
    const s = this.src; if (!s) return;
    t = Math.max(0, Math.min(t, this.duration || t));
    const running = this.state === RUNNING;
    if (running) this.voice?.stop();
    if (t < this.position()) s.reset();
    // (forward: decode to the position without showing; the sound before it is dropped; not lateness)
    s.load(t, Infinity);
    if (s.video) { const late = s.stats.late; s.pictureAt(t); s.stats.late = late; }
    s.audioUntil(t, () => {});
    this.pending = []; // (decoded before the seek: another part of the stream)
    this.pos = t; this.completed = false;
    if (running) { this.runAt = this.vm.clock.now(); this.startAudio(); this.vm.media.wake(); }
    else this.showPosition();
  }
  setVolume(v) { this.volume = v; this.voice?.setVolume(v); }
  setBalance(v) { this.balance = v; this.voice?.setPan(v); }

  // ---- playback (vm.media.tick)
  tick(now) {
    const s = this.src;
    if (!s || this.state !== RUNNING) return Infinity;
    const t = this.position(now);
    s.load(t);
    if (s.loadError && !this.failed) { this.vm.warn(`media: ${this.path}: read failed (${s.loadError.message ?? s.loadError})`); this.fail(); return Infinity; }
    if (s.video) { const p = s.pictureAt(t); if (p) this.present(p); }
    if (this.voice) this.feedAudio(now);
    if (!this.completed && (s.ended(t) || t >= this.stopTime)) {
      this.completed = true;
      this.log(`complete at ${t.toFixed(2)} s: ${this.report()}`);
      this.voice?.stop();
      this.hooks.onComplete?.();
    }
    // the next wake-up: the next picture, or the next sound refill
    let next = Infinity;
    if (s.video && !s.videoDone) next = this.runAt + (s.frameTime(s.frameIndex) - this.pos) * 1000;
    if (this.voice && !this.completed) next = Math.min(next, now + 40);
    if (!this.completed && next === Infinity) next = now + 20; // (waiting for data or for the end)
    return this.due = Math.max(next, now + 1);
  }
  /** playback statistics (the 'video' log) */
  report(s = this.src ?? this.closed) {
    if (!s) return '';
    const st = s.stats, n = st.decoded + st.skipped;
    return `${s.frameIndex} pictures (${this.presented} shown, ${st.overtaken} decoded and overtaken, ${st.skipped} B skipped${s.vdec?.errors ? `, ${s.vdec.errors} damaged` : ''}), decoding ${n ? (st.decodeMs / Math.max(1, st.decoded)).toFixed(1) : 0} ms per picture, showing ${(this.presentMs / Math.max(1, this.presented)).toFixed(1)} ms, lateness up to ${(st.late * 1000).toFixed(0)} ms; ${(s.audioPos / (s.audioRate || 1)).toFixed(2)} s of sound`;
  }

  // ---- pictures
  present(p) {
    const disp = this.vm.host?.display;
    this.shown = true;
    if (!this.hooks.visible() || !disp?.presentVideo) return;
    const s = this.src, r = this.hooks.source?.() ?? { l: 0, t: 0, w: s.width, h: s.height };
    const x = r.l & ~1, y = r.t & ~1, sw = Math.max(1, Math.min(r.w, s.width - x)), sh = Math.max(1, Math.min(r.h, s.height - y));
    const rect = this.hooks.rect(), t0 = performance.now();
    // (an RGBA picture — AVI codecs — as it is; 4:2:0 planes as they are when the host converts them itself — WebCodecs
    // in the browser; else converted to RGBA here)
    if (p.rgba) disp.presentVideo(p.rgba, p.width, p.height, rect, { x: r.l, y: r.t, w: Math.min(r.w, s.width - r.l), h: Math.min(r.h, s.height - r.t) });
    else if (!disp.presentVideoYuv?.(p, { x, y, w: sw, h: sh }, rect)) {
      const n = sw * sh * 4;
      if (!this.rgba || this.rgba.length !== n) this.rgba = new Uint8ClampedArray(n);
      yuv420ToRgba(p, x, y, sw, sh, this.rgba);
      disp.presentVideo(this.rgba, sw, sh, rect);
    }
    this.presented++; this.presentMs += performance.now() - t0;
  }
  /**
   * The picture at the current position (paused, or after a seek): decoded now — or the next one when none is due yet
   * (a paused renderer shows the first picture it receives).
   */
  showPosition() {
    const s = this.src;
    if (!s?.video) return;
    let p = s.pictureAt(this.pos) ?? s.picture;
    if (!p && !s.videoDone) { s.load(s.frameTime(s.frameIndex)); p = s.pictureAt(s.frameTime(s.frameIndex)); }
    if (p) this.present(p);
  }
  hideVideo() { if (this.shown) { this.shown = false; this.vm.host?.display?.hideVideo?.(); } }
  /** the window moved, was shown or hidden: the current picture again, or the layer hidden */
  refresh() {
    if (!this.hooks.visible()) this.hideVideo();
    else if (this.src?.picture) this.present(this.src.picture);
  }

  // ---- sound: decoded samples written ahead of the DirectSound play cursor
  startAudio() {
    const s = this.src, vm = this.vm;
    if (!s?.audio || !vm.createAudioStream) return;
    if (!this.voice) {
      // (a stream format no sound device takes — a damaged header: played without sound rather than failing the API call)
      if (!(s.audioRate >= 1 && s.audioRate <= 1000000 && s.audioChannels >= 1 && s.audioChannels <= 32)) { if (!this.noSound) { this.noSound = true; vm.warn(`media: ${this.path}: sound ${s.audioRate} Hz ${s.audioChannels} ch not played`); } return; }
      this.voice = vm.createAudioStream(this.proc, s.audioRate, s.audioChannels, 1);
    }
    this.ringView().fill(0);
    this.voice.setVolume(this.volume); this.voice.setPan(this.balance);
    this.voiceAt = vm.clock.now(); this.voiceFrom = this.pos; this.written = 0;
    this.pending = this.pending.filter((b) => b.start + b.samples[0].length / s.audioRate > this.pos);
    this.voice.start();
  }
  /** the sound ring: 16-bit samples in guest memory */
  ringView() { return new Int16Array(this.vm.mem.u8.buffer, this.voice.addr, this.voice.frames * this.src.audioChannels); }
  feedAudio(now) {
    const s = this.src, rate = s.audioRate, ch = s.audioChannels, ring = this.ringView(), frames = this.voice.frames;
    const played = Math.floor((now - this.voiceAt) / 1000 * rate);
    if (this.written < played) this.written = played; // (fell behind: the part already played is lost)
    const target = Math.min(played + Math.floor(AUDIO_LEAD * rate), played + frames - 1);
    s.audioUntil(this.voiceFrom + target / rate, (samples, start) => this.pending.push({ samples, start }));
    const pend = this.pending;
    while (this.written < target) {
      const b = pend[0];
      const f0 = b ? Math.round((b.start - this.voiceFrom) * rate) : Infinity;
      if (f0 > this.written) { // a gap (no sound decoded for it yet, or the stream over): silence
        const end = Math.min(f0, target);
        for (let f = this.written; f < end; f++) { const o = (f % frames) * ch; ring[o] = 0; if (ch > 1) ring[o + 1] = 0; }
        this.written = end;
        if (!b) break;
        continue;
      }
      const n = b.samples[0].length, from = this.written - f0, end = Math.min(n, target - f0);
      const L = b.samples[0], R = b.samples[ch > 1 ? 1 : 0];
      for (let i = from; i < end; i++) {
        const o = ((f0 + i) % frames) * ch;
        const l = L[i] * 32768, r = R[i] * 32768;
        ring[o] = l > 32767 ? 32767 : l < -32768 ? -32768 : l;
        if (ch > 1) ring[o + 1] = r > 32767 ? 32767 : r < -32768 ? -32768 : r;
      }
      this.written = f0 + Math.max(from, end);
      if (end >= n) pend.shift();
    }
  }
}

```

```js
/** struct tm of a time_t (UTC; local with a zone: minutes east of UTC at an instant, tm_isdst when it is not the standard offset) */
function tmOf(c, t, zone) {
  const mem = c.mem;
  const p = c.proc.crtTm ?? (c.proc.crtTm = c.proc.processHeap.alloc(36, true));
  const utc = t * 1000, off = zone ? zone(utc) : 0;
  const d = new Date(utc + off * 60000);
  mem.write32(p, d.getUTCSeconds()); mem.write32(p + 4, d.getUTCMinutes()); mem.write32(p + 8, d.getUTCHours()); mem.write32(p + 12, d.getUTCDate());
  mem.write32(p + 16, d.getUTCMonth()); mem.write32(p + 20, d.getUTCFullYear() - 1900); mem.write32(p + 24, d.getUTCDay());
  const start = Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1); mem.write32(p + 28, Math.floor((d.getTime() - start) / 86400000));
  const y = d.getUTCFullYear(), std = zone ? Math.min(zone(Date.UTC(y, 0, 1)), zone(Date.UTC(y, 6, 1))) : 0;
  mem.write32(p + 32, off !== std ? 1 : 0);
  return p;
}

/** Minimal sscanf: %d %i %u %x %f %s %c %n, widths, %*. Returns the number of assignments. */
export function sscanf(c, input, fmt, argAddr) {
  const mem = c.mem;
  let ip = 0, ap = argAddr, count = 0;
  const nextArg = () => { const v = mem.read32(ap); ap += 4; return v; };
  for (let i = 0; i < fmt.length; i++) {
    const ch = fmt[i];
    if (/\s/.test(ch)) { while (ip < input.length && /\s/.test(input[ip])) ip++; continue; }
    if (ch !== '%') { if (input[ip] !== ch) return count; ip++; continue; }
    i++;
    let suppress = false; if (fmt[i] === '*') { suppress = true; i++; }
    let width = ''; while (fmt[i] >= '0' && fmt[i] <= '9') width += fmt[i++];
    let mod = ''; while ('hlL'.includes(fmt[i])) mod += fmt[i++];
    const conv = fmt[i];
    const w = width ? +width : Infinity;
    if (conv !== 'c' && conv !== 'n' && conv !== '%') while (ip < input.length && /\s/.test(input[ip])) ip++;
    let m;
    switch (conv) {
      case 'd': case 'i': case 'u': m = input.slice(ip).match(conv === 'i' ? /^[-+]?(0x[0-9a-f]+|0[0-7]*|\d+)/i : /^[-+]?\d+/); if (!m) return count; ip += Math.min(m[0].length, w); if (!suppress) { const v = parseInt(m[0].slice(0, w), conv === 'i' && /^0x/i.test(m[0]) ? 16 : 10); const a = nextArg(); if (mod === 'h') mem.write16(a, v); else mem.write32(a, v >>> 0); count++; } break;
      case 'x': case 'X': m = input.slice(ip).match(/^[-+]?(0x)?[0-9a-f]+/i); if (!m) return count; ip += Math.min(m[0].length, w); if (!suppress) { mem.write32(nextArg(), parseInt(m[0].slice(0, w), 16) >>> 0); count++; } break;
      case 'f': case 'g': case 'e': case 'E': case 'G': m = input.slice(ip).match(/^[-+]?(\d+\.?\d*([eE][-+]?\d+)?|\.\d+([eE][-+]?\d+)?)/); if (!m) return count; ip += Math.min(m[0].length, w); if (!suppress) { const v = parseFloat(m[0].slice(0, w)); const a = nextArg(); if (mod === 'l' || mod === 'L') mem.writeF64(a, v); else mem.writeF32(a, v); count++; } break;
      case 's': m = input.slice(ip).match(/^\S+/); if (!m) return count; { const s = m[0].slice(0, w); ip += s.length; if (!suppress) { mem.writeCString(nextArg(), s); count++; } } break;
      case 'c': { const n = width ? +width : 1; if (ip + n > input.length) return count; if (!suppress) { const a = nextArg(); for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) mem.write8(a + k, input.charCodeAt(ip + k)); count++; } ip += n; break; }
      case 'n': if (!suppress) mem.write32(nextArg(), ip); break;
      case '%': if (input[ip] !== '%') return count; ip++; break;
      case '[': { let j = i + 1; let neg = false; if (fmt[j] === '^') { neg = true; j++; } let set = ''; if (fmt[j] === ']') { set += ']'; j++; } while (j < fmt.length && fmt[j] !== ']') set += fmt[j++]; i = j; let s = ''; while (ip < input.length && s.length < w && (set.includes(input[ip]) !== neg)) s += input[ip++]; if (!s.length) return count; if (!suppress) { mem.writeCString(nextArg(), s); count++; } break; }
      default: return count;
    }
  }
  return count;
}

export { decodeBytes };
```
