`src/win32/state-table.js`:

```js
// Device state words (render / texture stage / sampler states) by small integer key: the Map interface the
// Direct3D devices and the WebGL backend use (get, set, has, iteration in first-set order, keys, size) over a
// plain array, as a draw reads dozens of them. Keys outside [0, capacity) (never set by well-formed code) go to a
// Map so that a stray value does not turn the array into a dictionary.
export class StateTable {
  /** @param {number} capacity @param {Iterable<[number, number]>} [init] */
  constructor(capacity, init) {
    this.v = new Array(capacity).fill(undefined);
    this.order = [];
    this.extra = null;
    /** a recorder told of every set (render worker: the device's state changes, see gfx/d3d-recorder.js), or null */
    this.rec = null;
    /** moves at every set (a consumer caching what it derived from the table compares it, with the table's identity) */
    this.ver = 0;
    /** shadow entries in guest memory (runtime.js DEFER_F_*): u32 view, word index of key 0, number of keys */
    this.sh = null; this.shBase = 0; this.shN = 0;
    /**
     * watched key groups (watchKeys): per key in [0, capacity) a bit per group, and per group a counter moving at every
     * set of one of its keys — a consumer deriving something from a few keys compares that counter instead of `ver`
     */
    this.watch = null; this.wv = null;
    if (init) for (const [k, x] of init) this.set(k, x);
  }
  /** Watch `keys` as group `g` (0..7): `wv[g]` moves at every set of one of them from now on. */
  watchKeys(g, keys) {
    this.watch ??= new Uint8Array(this.v.length); this.wv ??= new Uint32Array(8);
    for (const k of keys) if (k >= 0 && k < this.v.length) this.watch[k] |= 1 << g;
  }
  /**
   * Mirror keys [0, n) into guest memory from `addr` as (known, value) word pairs — the issued-state filter of the
   * JIT's fast path reads them: every change made here is written there (a value that is not a 32-bit word: unknown).
   */
  attachShadow(u32, addr, n) {
    this.sh = u32; this.shBase = addr >>> 2; this.shN = n;
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) this.writeShadow(k, this.get(k));
  }
  writeShadow(k, x) {
    const i = this.shBase + 2 * k;
    if (x !== undefined && x === x >>> 0) { this.sh[i] = 1; this.sh[i + 1] = x; } else this.sh[i] = 0;
  }
  get(k) { return k >= 0 && k < this.v.length ? this.v[k] : this.extra?.get(k); }
  has(k) { return this.get(k) !== undefined; }
  set(k, x) {
    this.ver++;
    if (k >= 0 && k < this.v.length) { if (this.v[k] === undefined) this.order.push(k); this.v[k] = x; }
    else { if (!(this.extra ??= new Map()).has(k)) this.order.push(k); this.extra.set(k, x); }
    if (this.rec !== null) this.rec.noteSet(this, k);
    if (this.watch !== null && k >= 0 && k < this.watch.length) { const b = this.watch[k]; if (b !== 0) for (let g = 0; g < 8; g++) if (b & (1 << g)) this.wv[g]++; }
    if (this.sh && k >= 0 && k < this.shN) this.writeShadow(k, x);
    return this;
  }
  get size() { return this.order.length; }
  keys() { return this.order.values(); }
  *entries() { for (const k of this.order) yield [k, this.get(k)]; }
  [Symbol.iterator]() { return this.entries(); }
}
```

`src/win32/strings.js`:

```js
// Code page conversions used by the A/W API pairs and by MultiByteToWideChar & co.
// Supported: CP_ACP/1252 (Windows-1252), 28591 (Latin-1), 437/850 approximated as Latin-1,
// 65001 (UTF-8), 1200 (UTF-16LE).

const CP1252_HIGH = [
  0x20ac, 0xfffd, 0x201a, 0x0192, 0x201e, 0x2026, 0x2020, 0x2021, 0x02c6, 0x2030, 0x0160, 0x2039, 0x0152, 0xfffd, 0x017d, 0xfffd,
  0xfffd, 0x2018, 0x2019, 0x201c, 0x201d, 0x2022, 0x2013, 0x2014, 0x02dc, 0x2122, 0x0161, 0x203a, 0x0153, 0xfffd, 0x017e, 0x0178,
];
// the five undefined slots (0x81, 0x8D, 0x8F, 0x90, 0x9D) round-trip as U+0081... like Windows does
for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) if (CP1252_HIGH[i] === 0xfffd) CP1252_HIGH[i] = 0x80 + i;
const CP1252_REVERSE = new Map();
for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) CP1252_REVERSE.set(CP1252_HIGH[i], 0x80 + i);

export const CP_ACP = 0, CP_OEMCP = 1, CP_UTF8 = 65001;

/** The view itself, or a copy when it lies over shared memory (the guest memory can be shared between workers:
 * TextDecoder and ImageData refuse such views). */
export const unshared = (v) => (typeof SharedArrayBuffer !== 'undefined' && v.buffer instanceof SharedArrayBuffer ? v.slice() : v);

/** Bytes (Uint8Array) -> JS string for a code page. */
export function decodeBytes(bytes, cp = CP_ACP) {
  if (cp === CP_UTF8) return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(unshared(bytes));
  if (cp === 1200) { let s = ''; for (let i = 0; i + 1 < bytes.length; i += 2) s += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i] | (bytes[i + 1] << 8)); return s; }
  let s = '';
  const win = cp === 0 || cp === 1 || cp === 1252;
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
    const b = bytes[i];
    s += String.fromCharCode(win && b >= 0x80 && b < 0xa0 ? CP1252_HIGH[b - 0x80] : b);
  }
  return s;
}

/** JS string -> bytes for a code page (unmappable -> '?'). Returns { bytes, lossy }. */
export function encodeString(s, cp = CP_ACP, defaultChar = 0x3f) {
  if (cp === CP_UTF8) return { bytes: new TextEncoder().encode(s), lossy: false };
  if (cp === 1200) { const b = new Uint8Array(s.length * 2); for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { const c = s.charCodeAt(i); b[2 * i] = c & 0xff; b[2 * i + 1] = c >> 8; } return { bytes: b, lossy: false }; }
  const out = new Uint8Array(s.length);
  let lossy = false;
  const win = cp === 0 || cp === 1 || cp === 1252;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c < 0x80 || (c >= 0xa0 && c <= 0xff)) out[i] = c;
    else if (win && CP1252_REVERSE.has(c)) out[i] = CP1252_REVERSE.get(c);
    else if (c >= 0x80 && c < 0xa0 && !win) out[i] = c;
    else { out[i] = defaultChar; lossy = true; }
  }
  return { bytes: out, lossy };
}

export function upperA(s) { return caseMap(s, true, CP_ACP); }
export function lowerA(s) { return caseMap(s, false, CP_ACP); }

/**
 * Windows case mapping (LCMapString LCMAP_UPPER/LOWERCASE, CharUpper/CharLower): character by character, the
 * length never changes ('ß' stays 'ß', not 'SS') and, for ANSI strings (`cp` given), a character whose mapping
 * the code page cannot represent is left as it is ('µ' stays 'µ').
 */
export function caseMap(s, upper, cp = null) {
  let out = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    const ch = s[i];
    let m = upper ? ch.toUpperCase() : ch.toLowerCase();
    if (m.length !== 1) m = ch;
    else if (cp !== null) { const c = m.charCodeAt(0); if (!(c < 0x80 || (c >= 0xa0 && c <= 0xff) || ((cp === 0 || cp === 1 || cp === 1252) && CP1252_REVERSE.has(c)))) m = ch; }
    out += m;
  }
  return out;
}
```

`src/win32/timezone.js`:

```js
// The guest's time zone: the host's (the browser's), as Windows describes it to programs. A zone is a function
// giving the offset of local time from UTC, in minutes east, at a UTC instant (the host's: -Date#getTimezoneOffset).
// From it: local <-> UTC conversions and the TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION of the current year (bias, the daylight-saving
// rule as "n-th weekday of a month at a local hour", names).

const HOUR = 3600000;

/** @typedef {(utcMs: number) => number} Zone (minutes east of UTC at that instant) */

/** @type {Zone} */
export const utcZone = () => 0;
/** @type {Zone} */
export const hostZone = (ms) => -new Date(ms).getTimezoneOffset();

/**
 * @typedef {{ year: number, month: number, dayOfWeek: number, day: number, hour: number, minute: number }} TzDate
 *   a SYSTEMTIME transition rule: year 0 (every year), month 1-12, weekday 0-6 (Sunday 0), day = occurrence 1-5 (5: last)
 * @typedef {{ bias: number, standardBias: number, daylightBias: number, standardDate: TzDate | null,
 *   daylightDate: TzDate | null, standardName: string, daylightName: string }} TimeZoneInfo (biases in minutes, UTC = local + bias)
 */

/** The transition rule of a local date-time (a UTC-like ms of the local wall clock). */
function ruleOf(localMs) {
  const d = new Date(localMs);
  const month = d.getUTCMonth(), dom = d.getUTCDate();
  const last = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), month, dom + 7)).getUTCMonth() !== month;
  return { year: 0, month: month + 1, dayOfWeek: d.getUTCDay(), day: last ? 5 : Math.ceil(dom / 7), hour: d.getUTCHours(), minute: d.getUTCMinutes() };
}

/** The instant (local wall-clock ms) a rule designates in a year. */
export function ruleLocalMs(rule, year) {
  const first = Date.UTC(year, rule.month - 1, 1);
  let dom = 1 + ((rule.dayOfWeek - new Date(first).getUTCDay() + 7) % 7) + 7 * (rule.day - 1);
  const days = new Date(Date.UTC(year, rule.month, 0)).getUTCDate();
  while (dom > days) dom -= 7; // (occurrence 5: the last one)
  return Date.UTC(year, rule.month - 1, dom, rule.hour, rule.minute);
}

/** Offset changes of a zone during a year: [{ at (UTC ms), from, to }] (hourly scan, then to the minute). */
function transitions(zone, year) {
  const out = [];
  let t = Date.UTC(year, 0, 1), prev = zone(t);
  const end = Date.UTC(year + 1, 0, 1);
  for (t += HOUR; t <= end; t += HOUR) {
    const o = zone(t);
    if (o === prev) continue;
    let lo = t - HOUR, hi = t; // zone(lo) = prev, zone(hi) = o
    while (hi - lo > 60000) { const mid = lo + Math.max(1, Math.floor((hi - lo) / 120000)) * 60000; if (zone(mid) === prev) lo = mid; else hi = mid; }
    out.push({ at: hi, from: prev, to: o });
    prev = o;
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION of a zone for a year: the standard offset is the smaller one, daylight saving the larger;
 * without two offsets in the year, no daylight rule.
 * @param {Zone} zone
 * @param {number} year
 * @param {{ standard?: string, daylight?: string }} [names]
 * @returns {TimeZoneInfo}
 */
export function timeZoneInfo(zone, year, names = {}) {
  const tr = transitions(zone, year);
  const jan = zone(Date.UTC(year, 0, 1)), jul = zone(Date.UTC(year, 6, 1));
  const std = Math.min(jan, jul), dst = Math.max(jan, jul);
  const standardName = names.standard ?? (std === 0 && dst === 0 ? 'Coordinated Universal Time' : 'Standard Time');
  const daylightName = names.daylight ?? (std === 0 && dst === 0 ? 'Coordinated Universal Time' : 'Daylight Time');
  const start = tr.find((x) => x.from === std && x.to === dst), stop = tr.find((x) => x.from === dst && x.to === std);
  if (std === dst || !start || !stop) return { bias: 0 - std, standardBias: 0, daylightBias: 0, standardDate: null, daylightDate: null, standardName, daylightName };
  return {
    bias: 0 - std, standardBias: 0, daylightBias: std - dst,
    daylightDate: ruleOf(start.at + std * 60000), // (the local standard time at which daylight saving starts)
    standardDate: ruleOf(stop.at + dst * 60000), // (the local daylight time at which it ends)
    standardName, daylightName,
  };
}

/** Minutes east of UTC that a TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION gives at a UTC instant (its daylight rule applied). */
export function tziOffsetAt(tzi, utcMs) {
  const std = -tzi.bias;
  if (!tzi.daylightDate?.month || !tzi.standardDate?.month) return std - tzi.standardBias;
  const year = new Date(utcMs + std * 60000).getUTCFullYear();
  const dst = std - tzi.daylightBias;
  const start = ruleLocalMs(tzi.daylightDate, year) - std * 60000; // (UTC instants)
  const stop = ruleLocalMs(tzi.standardDate, year) - dst * 60000;
  const inDst = start < stop ? utcMs >= start && utcMs < stop : utcMs >= start || utcMs < stop; // (southern hemisphere: across the new year)
  return inDst ? dst : std - tzi.standardBias;
}

/** UTC ms of a local wall-clock time in a zone (an ambiguous or skipped hour resolves to the offset before the change). */
export function localToUtc(zone, localMs) {
  let utc = localMs - zone(localMs) * 60000;
  utc = localMs - zone(utc) * 60000;
  return utc;
}

/** Time zone names of the host (Intl), e.g. "Central European Standard Time" / "Central European Summer Time". */
export function hostZoneNames(year) {
  try {
    const f = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZoneName: 'long' });
    const name = (ms) => f.formatToParts(new Date(ms)).find((p) => p.type === 'timeZoneName')?.value;
    const jan = Date.UTC(year, 0, 1), jul = Date.UTC(year, 6, 1);
    const [std, dst] = hostZone(jan) <= hostZone(jul) ? [jan, jul] : [jul, jan];
    return { standard: name(std), daylight: name(dst) };
  } catch { return {}; }
}
```

```js
// user32.dll: window classes and windows, message queues, painting, timers, input, display
// modes, and the DefWindowProc behaviour games rely on. Rendering goes through the software GDI
// (src/gfx/gdi) onto per-window client surfaces which are presented by the host display.
import { E } from './errors.js';
import { INFINITE, WAIT_OBJECT_0, WAIT_TIMEOUT, WAIT_FAILED, PARK } from '../core/sched.js';
import { makeDC, gdiOf, crToRgb, parseBitmapInfo, dibSurface, fillRect, blit, dcFont } from './gdi32.js';
import { allocSurface, freeSurface } from '../gfx/gdi/surface.js';
import { clipRect, rectEmpty } from '../gfx/gdi/raster.js';
import { parseCursorFile } from '../gfx/gdi/cursor.js';
import { caseMap, decodeBytes, encodeString } from './strings.js';
import { formatPrintf } from './wsprintf.js';

import { isSignaled, consumeSignal, waitObject, allocString } from './kernel32.js';

export const WM = Object.freeze({
  CREATE: 1, DESTROY: 2, MOVE: 3, SIZE: 5, ACTIVATE: 6, SETFOCUS: 7, KILLFOCUS: 8, ENABLE: 0xa, SETREDRAW: 0xb, SETTEXT: 0xc, GETTEXT: 0xd,
  GETTEXTLENGTH: 0xe, PAINT: 0xf, CLOSE: 0x10, QUIT: 0x12, ERASEBKGND: 0x14, SHOWWINDOW: 0x18, ACTIVATEAPP: 0x1c, SETCURSOR: 0x20,
  MOUSEACTIVATE: 0x21, GETMINMAXINFO: 0x24, WINDOWPOSCHANGING: 0x46, WINDOWPOSCHANGED: 0x47, DISPLAYCHANGE: 0x7e, NCCREATE: 0x81, NCDESTROY: 0x82,
  NCCALCSIZE: 0x83, NCHITTEST: 0x84, NCPAINT: 0x85, NCACTIVATE: 0x86, GETDLGCODE: 0x87, KEYDOWN: 0x100, KEYUP: 0x101, CHAR: 0x102, DEADCHAR: 0x103,
  SYSKEYDOWN: 0x104, SYSKEYUP: 0x105, SYSCHAR: 0x106, COMMAND: 0x111, SYSCOMMAND: 0x112, TIMER: 0x113, MOUSEMOVE: 0x200, LBUTTONDOWN: 0x201,
  LBUTTONUP: 0x202, LBUTTONDBLCLK: 0x203, RBUTTONDOWN: 0x204, RBUTTONUP: 0x205, RBUTTONDBLCLK: 0x206, MBUTTONDOWN: 0x207, MBUTTONUP: 0x208,
  MBUTTONDBLCLK: 0x209, MOUSEWHEEL: 0x20a, XBUTTONDOWN: 0x20b, XBUTTONUP: 0x20c, SIZING: 0x214, CAPTURECHANGED: 0x215, ENTERSIZEMOVE: 0x231,
  EXITSIZEMOVE: 0x232, MOUSELEAVE: 0x2a3, USER: 0x400, APP: 0x8000,
});

const WS_CHILD = 0x40000000, WS_VISIBLE = 0x10000000, WS_DISABLED = 0x08000000, WS_POPUP = 0x80000000, WS_MINIMIZE = 0x20000000, WS_MAXIMIZE = 0x01000000;
const WS_CAPTION = 0x00c00000, WS_BORDER = 0x00800000, WS_DLGFRAME = 0x00400000, WS_THICKFRAME = 0x00040000, WS_SYSMENU = 0x00080000;
const WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW = 0x80, WS_EX_DLGMODALFRAME = 1, WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE = 0x200, WS_EX_TOPMOST = 8;
const CW_USEDEFAULT = 0x80000000;
const PM_REMOVE = 1;
// system cursors (IDC_*) and the hit-test codes of WM_SETCURSOR's default processing
const IDC_ARROW = 32512, IDC_IBEAM = 32513, IDC_SIZENWSE = 32642, IDC_SIZENESW = 32643, IDC_SIZEWE = 32644, IDC_SIZENS = 32645;
const HT = { ERROR: -2, NOWHERE: 0, CLIENT: 1, CAPTION: 2, LEFT: 10, RIGHT: 11, TOP: 12, TOPLEFT: 13, TOPRIGHT: 14, BOTTOM: 15, BOTTOMLEFT: 16, BOTTOMRIGHT: 17, BORDER: 18 };
const VK = { LBUTTON: 1, RBUTTON: 2, MBUTTON: 4, SHIFT: 0x10, CONTROL: 0x11, MENU: 0x12, CAPITAL: 0x14, LSHIFT: 0xa0, RSHIFT: 0xa1, LCONTROL: 0xa2, RCONTROL: 0xa3, LMENU: 0xa4, RMENU: 0xa5 };
const CAPTION_H = 19, FRAME_THICK = 4, FRAME_THIN = 1, FRAME_DLG = 3, MENU_H = 19;


/** Window manager: one per process. */
export class WindowManager {
  /** @param {import('../core/vm.js').Vm} vm */
  constructor(vm) {
    this.vm = vm;
    this.nextClassAtom = 0xc100; // (atoms of the classes the program registers)
    this.proc = vm.proc;
    this.mem = vm.mem;
    this.host = vm.host;
    const d = vm.host?.display;
    this.screen = { width: d?.width ?? 1024, height: d?.height ?? 768, bpp: d?.bpp ?? 32 };
    /** @type {Map<number, any>} hwnd -> window */
    this.windows = new Map();
    /** @type {Map<string, any>} class name (lower) -> class */
    this.classes = new Map();
    this.classByAtom = new Map();
    this.zorder = []; // top-level windows, front first
    this.focus = 0; this.active = 0; this.capture = 0; this.foreground = 0;
    this.cursor = { x: this.screen.width >> 1, y: this.screen.height >> 1 };
    this.keyState = new Uint8Array(256);
    this.asyncPressed = new Uint8Array(256); // keys and buttons pressed since the last GetAsyncKeyState of each (its bit 0)
    /** @type {((ev: any) => void)[]} */
    this.rawListeners = [];
    this.clip = null; // ClipCursor's rectangle (screen coordinates), null: none
    this.inputSeq = 0; // the host's latest captured-mouse move taken (reportCursor: the page reconciles its cursor with it)
    this.deferSends = false;
    // how the game reads the mouse (the 'input' log's summary every 5 s): moves taken, GetCursorPos / SetCursorPos
    // calls, DirectInput mouse reads (dinput8.js)
    this.mouseStats = { moves: 0, get: 0, set: 0, clip: 0, diState: 0, diData: 0, diItems: 0, at: 0, shown: '' };
    // the system cursor (see updateCursor): ShowCursor's display count (0 at start: a mouse is installed), SetCursor's
    // shape (0: none; the arrow at start, as over the desktop), the exclusive DirectInput mice acquired (hide it)
    this.showCursorCount = 0;
    this.sysCursors = new Map();
    this.cursorHiders = new Set();
    this.cursorState = ''; this.cursorCalls = 0; // (the 'input' log: the last state logged, ShowCursor calls logged)
    this.dirty = false;
    this.lastPresent = -1;
    this.presentInterval = 8;
    this.cursorHandle = this.systemCursor(IDC_ARROW);
    this.clipboard = null;
    this.hooks = [];
    this.nextTimerId = 0x100;
    this.desktop = this.makeWindow({ cls: null, style: WS_VISIBLE, exStyle: 0, x: 0, y: 0, w: this.screen.width, h: this.screen.height, parent: null, title: '', desktop: true });
    this.registerBuiltinClasses();
    this.presentedOnce = false;
  }

  registerBuiltinClasses() {
    for (const name of ['BUTTON', 'STATIC', 'EDIT', 'LISTBOX', 'COMBOBOX', 'SCROLLBAR', '#32770', 'MDICLIENT', 'MSCTLS_TRACKBAR32', 'RICHEDIT']) {
      this.classes.set(name.toLowerCase(), { name, wndProc: 'builtin', style: 0, cbClsExtra: 0, cbWndExtra: 4, hInstance: 0, hIcon: 0, hCursor: 0, hbrBackground: 0, menuName: 0, atom: this.nextClassAtom++, extra: new Uint8Array(0), builtin: true });
    }
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ geometry
  ncSizes(style, exStyle) {
    let l = 0, t = 0;
    if ((style & WS_CAPTION) === WS_CAPTION) { l = (style & WS_THICKFRAME) ? FRAME_THICK : FRAME_DLG; t = l + CAPTION_H; }
    else if (style & WS_THICKFRAME) { l = FRAME_THICK; t = FRAME_THICK; }
    else if (style & WS_DLGFRAME) { l = FRAME_DLG; t = FRAME_DLG; }
    else if (style & WS_BORDER) { l = FRAME_THIN; t = FRAME_THIN; }
    if (exStyle & WS_EX_DLGMODALFRAME) { l += FRAME_DLG; t += FRAME_DLG; }
    if (exStyle & WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE) { l += 2; t += 2; }
    return { l, t, r: l, b: l };
  }

  makeWindow(o) {
    const w = {
      type: 'window', hwnd: 0, cls: o.cls, style: o.style >>> 0, exStyle: o.exStyle >>> 0, parent: o.parent, owner: o.owner ?? null, children: [],
      rect: { l: o.x, t: o.y, r: o.x + o.w, b: o.y + o.h }, client: null, title: o.title ?? '', wndProc: o.cls?.wndProc ?? 'builtin',
      userData: 0, id: o.id ?? 0, hInstance: o.hInstance ?? 0, extra: new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(Math.max(o.cls?.cbWndExtra ?? 0, 4))),
      visible: (o.style & WS_VISIBLE) !== 0, enabled: (o.style & WS_DISABLED) === 0, surface: null, invalid: null, eraseBkgnd: true,
      thread: this.vm.current, timers: new Map(), props: new Map(), desktop: !!o.desktop, minimized: false, maximized: false, destroyed: false,
      hasMenu: !!o.menu, menu: o.menu ?? 0, paintDC: null,
    };
    w.hwnd = this.proc.handles.create(w);
    this.windows.set(w.hwnd, w);
    this.layout(w);
    return w;
  }

  /** Compute client rect (screen coords) and (re)allocate the client surface for top-level windows. */
  layout(w) {
    const nc = w.desktop || (w.style & WS_CHILD) ? { l: 0, t: 0, r: 0, b: 0 } : this.ncSizes(w.style, w.exStyle);
    if (w.hasMenu && !(w.style & WS_CHILD)) nc.t += MENU_H;
    w.client = { l: w.rect.l + nc.l, t: w.rect.t + nc.t, r: Math.max(w.rect.r - nc.r, w.rect.l + nc.l), b: Math.max(w.rect.b - nc.b, w.rect.t + nc.t) };
    if (w.desktop || w.style & WS_CHILD) return;
    const cw = Math.max(1, w.client.r - w.client.l), ch = Math.max(1, w.client.b - w.client.t);
    if (!w.surface || w.surface.width !== cw || w.surface.height !== ch) {
      const old = w.surface;
      w.surface = allocSurface(this.proc, cw, ch, 'window');
      if (old) { blit(w.surface, { l: 0, t: 0, r: cw, b: ch }, 0, 0, Math.min(cw, old.width), Math.min(ch, old.height), old, 0, 0); freeSurface(this.proc, old); }
    }
  }

  topLevel(w) { while (w && w.style & WS_CHILD && w.parent && !w.parent.desktop) w = w.parent; return w; }
  clientW(w) { return w.client.r - w.client.l; }
  clientH(w) { return w.client.b - w.client.t; }

  /** DC for a window's client area (child windows draw into their top-level's surface). */
  windowDC(c, w, clipToInvalid = false) {
    const top = this.topLevel(w);
    if (!top.surface) return makeDC(this.proc, allocSurface(this.proc, 1, 1, 'nodc'), { hwnd: w.hwnd, window: w });
    const ox = w.client.l - top.client.l, oy = w.client.t - top.client.t;
    let clip = { l: ox, t: oy, r: ox + this.clientW(w), b: oy + this.clientH(w) };
    clip = clipRect(clip, { l: 0, t: 0, r: top.surface.width, b: top.surface.height });
    if (clipToInvalid && w.invalid) clip = clipRect(clip, { l: w.invalid.l + ox, t: w.invalid.t + oy, r: w.invalid.r + ox, b: w.invalid.b + oy });
    const dc = makeDC(this.proc, top.surface, { hwnd: w.hwnd, window: w, ox, oy, clip });
    dc.baseClip = { ...clip };
    return dc;
  }

  touch(w) { this.dirty = true; }

  /** Present the front-most visible top-level window (rate limited unless forced). */
  present(force = false) {
    if (!this.dirty && !force) return;
    if (this.vm.group && this.vm.group.foreground !== this.vm) return; // (a background process: not on the display, core/procs.js)
    const now = this.vm.clock.now();
    if (!force && this.presentedOnce && now - this.lastPresent < this.presentInterval) return;
    const d = this.host?.display;
    if (!d) { this.dirty = false; return; }
    const top = this.zorder.find((w) => w.visible && !w.minimized && w.surface);
    if (top) { d.present(top.surface, top.client.l, top.client.t); this.presentedOnce = true; }
    this.lastPresent = now;
    this.dirty = false;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ messages
  queueOf(thread) { return thread.msgQueue ?? (thread.msgQueue = { msgs: [], quit: null, thread }); }

  /**
   * Host input's sent message for window `w` waits for the window's thread unless that thread is the one running now
   * (host input pumped by its own PeekMessage / GetMessage or another call of its own: delivered at once, as before)
   * with nothing sent to it still waiting (the order kept).
   */
  mustDefer(w) {
    const wt = w.thread ?? this.proc.threads[0], cur = this.vm.current;
    return cur !== wt || cur.state !== TS.RUNNING || (this.queueOf(wt).sent?.length ?? 0) > 0;
  }
  /** A sent message (or a step of host input, `fn`) waiting for the thread of window `w` (deliverSent). */
  deferToThread(w, item) {
    const q = this.queueOf(w.thread ?? this.proc.threads[0]);
    // (one WM_SETCURSOR waiting per window: the latest — every mouse move sends one, the queue keeps its other messages)
    if (item.msg === WM.SETCURSOR && q.sent?.length) { const i = q.sent.findIndex((s) => s.msg === WM.SETCURSOR && s.w === item.w); if (i >= 0) q.sent.splice(i, 1); }
    (q.sent ??= []).push(item);
    if (q.sent.length > 256) q.sent.shift();
  }
  send(w, msg, wParam, lParam) {
    if (!w || w.destroyed && msg !== WM.NCDESTROY) return 0;
    // (host input — focus changes, a click activating the window — is processed wherever the queue is pumped: in
    // a wait condition no guest thread runs, in another thread's API call not the window's thread. Its sent messages
    // wait in the window thread's queue and are delivered by that thread's next GetMessage / PeekMessage, as Windows
    // delivers messages sent from another thread)
    if (this.deferSends && this.mustDefer(w)) { this.deferToThread(w, { w, msg, wParam: wParam >>> 0, lParam: lParam >>> 0 }); return 0; }
    const proc = w.wndProc;
    if (typeof proc === 'number') return this.vm.callGuest(this.vm.current, proc, [w.hwnd, msg, wParam >>> 0, lParam >>> 0]) >>> 0;
    return this.defWindowProc(w, msg, wParam >>> 0, lParam >>> 0) >>> 0;
  }

  post(w, msg, wParam, lParam, thread = null) {
    const q = this.queueOf(thread ?? w?.thread ?? this.proc.threads[0]);
    q.msgs.push({ hwnd: w ? w.hwnd : 0, msg, wParam: wParam >>> 0, lParam: lParam >>> 0, time: this.tick(), pt: { ...this.cursor } });
  }

  /** a message's time: GetTickCount's value (the 15.625 ms tick, core/timer-res.js; 0x1000000: TICK_BASE) */
  tick() { return (0x1000000 + (this.vm.timerRes ? this.vm.timerRes.tickCount(this.vm.clock.now()) : Math.floor(this.vm.clock.now()))) >>> 0; }

  writeMsg(addr, m) {
    const mem = this.mem;
    mem.write32(addr, m.hwnd); mem.write32(addr + 4, m.msg); mem.write32(addr + 8, m.wParam); mem.write32(addr + 12, m.lParam);
    mem.write32(addr + 16, m.time); mem.write32(addr + 20, m.pt.x); mem.write32(addr + 24, m.pt.y);
  }

  matches(m, hwndFilter, min, max) {
    if (hwndFilter && m.hwnd !== hwndFilter) {
      // child windows of the filter also match
      let w = this.windows.get(m.hwnd); let ok = false;
      while (w) { if (w.hwnd === hwndFilter) { ok = true; break; } w = w.parent; }
      if (!ok) return false;
    }
    if (max && (m.msg < min || m.msg > max)) return false;
    if (!max && min && m.msg < min) return false;
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Convert host input into posted messages. A mouse button release waits (at most 250 ms) until the game has presented
   * a frame since the press: a game sampling the button state once per frame would otherwise miss a click shorter than
   * one of its frames — a person's ~100 ms click during an emulation hitch. Only with a rendering Direct3D device (a
   * frame count to watch); the events after a held release wait with it (order kept).
   */
  pump() {
    if (this.vm.group && this.vm.group.foreground !== this.vm) return; // (input goes to the foreground process: core/procs.js)
    const evs = this.host?.pollInput?.();
    if (evs) (this.pendingInput ??= []).push(...evs);
    const q = this.pendingInput;
    // (not re-entered: a message sent synchronously while an event is processed — WM_SETCURSOR at each mouse move, an
    // activation — runs the game's window procedure, which may call GetCursorPos / GetAsyncKeyState; those see the
    // state so far and leave the remaining events to this loop, as Windows reads input only in GetMessage / PeekMessage)
    if (!q?.length || this.pumping) return;
    const dev = this.vm.d3dDevice, frames = dev && !dev.lost ? dev.frames : null, now = this.vm.clock.now();
    if (now - this.mouseStats.at >= 5000) this.logMouseStats(now);
    this.pumping = true;
    try {
      while (q.length) {
        const ev = q[0];
        if (ev.type === 'mouseup' && frames !== null) {
          const d = this.pressedAt?.[ev.button];
          if (d && d.frames === frames && now - d.t < 250) { this.heldSince ??= now; break; }
        }
        if (this.heldSince !== undefined && this.heldSince !== null) { this.heldMs = (this.heldMs ?? 0) + now - this.heldSince; this.heldSince = null; }
        if (ev.type === 'mousedown') (this.pressedAt ??= [])[ev.button] = { frames, t: now };
        q.shift(); // (taken before it is processed: never processed twice)
        const out = this.remapKey(ev);
        if (out) this.inputEvent(out);
      }
    } finally { this.pumping = false; }
    this.reportCursor();
  }
  /** The 'input' log: how the game read the mouse over the last seconds (which of its paths a camera uses). */
  logMouseStats(now) {
    const s = this.mouseStats; s.at = now;
    if (!this.vm.logKinds?.has('input')) return;
    const line = `moves ${s.moves}, GetCursorPos ${s.get}, SetCursorPos ${s.set}, ClipCursor ${s.clip}${this.clip ? ` (${this.clip.l},${this.clip.t}-${this.clip.r},${this.clip.b})` : ''}, DirectInput mouse state ${s.diState} / buffered ${s.diData} (${s.diItems} items), cursor ${this.cursor.x},${this.cursor.y}`;
    s.moves = s.get = s.set = s.clip = s.diState = s.diData = s.diItems = 0;
    if (line !== s.shown) { s.shown = line; this.vm.log('input', `mouse reads (5 s): ${line}`); }
  }

  windowAt(x, y) {
    for (const w of this.zorder) {
      if (!w.visible || w.minimized) continue;
      if (x >= w.rect.l && x < w.rect.r && y >= w.rect.t && y < w.rect.b) {
        // descend into visible children
        let cur = w;
        let found = true;
        while (found) {
          found = false;
          for (const ch of cur.children) if (ch.visible && x >= ch.client.l && x < ch.client.r && y >= ch.client.t && y < ch.client.b) { cur = ch; found = true; break; }
        }
        return cur;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Switch the display mode (ChangeDisplaySettings, or a fullscreen Direct3D device): resizes the host
   * display and the desktop window, then broadcasts WM_DISPLAYCHANGE. Zero sizes restore the default.
   */
  setDisplayMode(w, h, bpp = 32, fullscreen = false) {
    const d = this.host?.display;
    if (d && d.defaultWidth === undefined) { d.defaultWidth = d.width; d.defaultHeight = d.height; }
    if (!w || !h) { w = d?.defaultWidth ?? this.screen.width; h = d?.defaultHeight ?? this.screen.height; }
    if (d) d.setMode(w, h, bpp, fullscreen);
    this.screen = { width: w, height: h, bpp, fullscreen };
    this.desktop.rect = { l: 0, t: 0, r: w, b: h }; this.desktop.client = { l: 0, t: 0, r: w, b: h };
    this.vm.log('win', `display mode ${w}x${h}x${bpp}${fullscreen ? ' fullscreen' : ''}`);
    for (const x of this.zorder) this.post(x, WM.DISPLAYCHANGE, bpp, (h << 16) | w);
  }

  mkFlags() {
    let f = 0;
    if (this.keyState[VK.LBUTTON] & 0x80) f |= 1; if (this.keyState[VK.RBUTTON] & 0x80) f |= 2; if (this.keyState[VK.SHIFT] & 0x80) f |= 4;
    if (this.keyState[VK.CONTROL] & 0x80) f |= 8; if (this.keyState[VK.MBUTTON] & 0x80) f |= 0x10;
    return f;
  }

  /** The cursor's bounds: the screen, within the ClipCursor rectangle when one is set (inclusive pixel limits). */
  cursorBounds() {
    let l = 0, t = 0, r = this.screen.width - 1, b = this.screen.height - 1;
    const c = this.clip;
    if (c) { l = Math.max(l, c.l); t = Math.max(t, c.t); r = Math.min(r, c.r - 1); b = Math.min(b, c.b - 1); if (r < l) r = l; if (b < t) b = t; }
    return { l, t, r, b };
  }
  /** A position inside the cursor's bounds. */
  clampCursor(x, y) { const k = this.cursorBounds(); return { x: Math.max(k.l, Math.min(k.r, x | 0)), y: Math.max(k.t, Math.min(k.b, y | 0)) }; }
  /** SetCursorPos: the cursor moves there (within its bounds), without any mouse motion for the raw input readers. */
  setCursorPos(x, y) { this.cursor = this.clampCursor(x, y); this.mouseStats.set++; this.reportCursor(); }
  /** The guest cursor's position to the host (the page draws the captured mouse's cursor there), when it changed. */
  reportCursor() {
    const c = this.cursor, r = this.reported;
    if (r && r.x === c.x && r.y === c.y && r.seq === this.inputSeq) return;
    this.reported = { x: c.x, y: c.y, seq: this.inputSeq };
    this.host?.cursorPos?.(c.x, c.y, this.inputSeq);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ the system cursor
  // Windows draws the cursor when its display count (ShowCursor) is >= 0, it has a shape (SetCursor: NULL removes it
  // until the next SetCursor) and no exclusive DirectInput mouse is acquired (DirectInput hides it meanwhile). The
  // shape is set again at each mouse move over a window by WM_SETCURSOR (DefWindowProc: the class cursor in the client
  // area, the arrow or a sizing cursor elsewhere). The host shows exactly that: the page draws no cursor of its own.
  /** The shared handle of a system cursor (LoadCursor(NULL, IDC_*) returns the same one every time, as Windows does). */
  systemCursor(id) {
    let h = this.sysCursors.get(id);
    if (!h) { h = this.proc.handles.create({ type: 'gdi', kind: 'cursor', id, stock: true, shared: true }); this.sysCursors.set(id, h); }
    return h;
  }
  /** SetCursor: the cursor's shape (0: none). Returns the previous one. */
  setCursorShape(h) { const p = this.cursorHandle; this.cursorHandle = h >>> 0; if (this.cursorHandle !== p) this.updateCursor(); return p; }
  /** ShowCursor: the display count changed by +1 / -1; returns the new count. */
  showCursor(show) { this.showCursorCount += show ? 1 : -1; this.updateCursor(); return this.showCursorCount; }
  /** An exclusive DirectInput mouse acquired (`on`) or unacquired / released: the cursor is hidden while one is. */
  cursorHiddenBy(dev, on) { const n = this.cursorHiders.size; if (on) this.cursorHiders.add(dev); else this.cursorHiders.delete(dev); if (this.cursorHiders.size !== n) this.updateCursor(); }
  // (DirectInput's hiding lasts while the application is in the foreground: deactivated — the page lost the focus — its
  // foreground devices are unacquired on Windows, the cursor shows again over its window)
  cursorVisible() { return this.showCursorCount >= 0 && this.cursorHandle !== 0 && (this.cursorHiders.size === 0 || this.appInactive === true); }
  /** The cursor's state to the host (its shape, then whether it shows); logged ('input') when it changes. */
  updateCursor() {
    const { h, vis, o } = this.cursorToHost();
    // (logged when it shows or hides, and when its shape changes while shown: a game hiding it at every WM_SETCURSOR
    // would log every mouse move otherwise)
    const key = vis ? `shown ${h}` : 'hidden';
    if (key !== this.cursorState) {
      this.cursorState = key;
      if (this.vm.logKinds?.has('input')) this.vm.log('input', `cursor ${vis ? 'shown' : 'hidden'} (display count ${this.showCursorCount}, ${!h ? 'no shape' : o?.image ? `image cursor ${o.file ?? h.toString(16)}` : `system cursor ${o?.id ?? '?'}`}${this.cursorHiders.size ? ', exclusive DirectInput mouse acquired' : ''})`);
    }
  }
  /** After a snapshot's restore (core/vm-snapshot.js): the new host shows what the captured one did — mode, title, cursor. */
  resumeHost() {
    const d = this.host?.display, s = this.screen;
    if (d && (d.width !== s.width || d.height !== s.height || d.fullscreen !== (s.fullscreen ?? false))) {
      if (d.defaultWidth === undefined) { d.defaultWidth = d.width; d.defaultHeight = d.height; }
      d.setMode(s.width, s.height, s.bpp, s.fullscreen ?? false);
    }
    if (this.shownTitle !== undefined) d?.setTitle?.(this.shownTitle);
    this.cursorToHost();
  }
  cursorToHost() {
    const d = this.vm.group && this.vm.group.foreground !== this.vm ? null : this.host?.display, h = this.cursorHandle, vis = this.cursorVisible();
    const o = h ? this.proc.handles.getAs(h, 'gdi') : null;
    if (o?.kind === 'cursor') d?.setCursor?.(o.image ? h : 'sys' + (o.id || IDC_ARROW), o.image ?? null, o.id || IDC_ARROW);
    d?.showCursor?.(vis);
    return { h, vis, o };
  }
  /** The hit-test code of a screen point in window `w` (as DefWindowProc's WM_NCHITTEST answers for its frame). */
  hitTest(w, x, y) {
    const c = w.client;
    if (x >= c.l && x < c.r && y >= c.t && y < c.b) return HT.CLIENT;
    if (x < w.rect.l || x >= w.rect.r || y < w.rect.t || y >= w.rect.b) return HT.NOWHERE;
    if (w.style & WS_THICKFRAME) {
      const k = 4, left = x < w.rect.l + k, right = x >= w.rect.r - k, top = y < w.rect.t + k, bottom = y >= w.rect.b - k;
      if (top) return left ? HT.TOPLEFT : right ? HT.TOPRIGHT : HT.TOP;
      if (bottom) return left ? HT.BOTTOMLEFT : right ? HT.BOTTOMRIGHT : HT.BOTTOM;
      if (left) return HT.LEFT;
      if (right) return HT.RIGHT;
    }
    return y < c.t && (w.style & WS_CAPTION) === WS_CAPTION ? HT.CAPTION : HT.BORDER;
  }
  /**
   * The mouse moved or a button changed over window `w` (mouse not captured): WM_SETCURSOR (wParam the window, lParam
   * hit-test code and mouse message) lets the window set the cursor's shape; outside any window, the desktop's arrow.
   */
  setCursorAt(w, x, y, mouseMsg) {
    if (!w || w.desktop) { this.setCursorShape(this.systemCursor(IDC_ARROW)); return; }
    this.send(w, WM.SETCURSOR, w.hwnd, ((mouseMsg & 0xffff) << 16) | (this.hitTest(w, x, y) & 0xffff));
  }

  /**
   * The player's key as the game gets it: the manifest's remap (`keys`, host.keyMap: vk-scan.js keyRemap — WASD
   * scrolling a game that scrolls with the arrows) changes its virtual key and scan code, and drops the character it
   * typed (`null`: the event dropped). Not while the game awaits text (textInput: its letters typed as they are), nor
   * with Ctrl or Alt held (the game's own shortcuts). A key goes up as it went down, whatever changed meanwhile.
   */
  remapKey(ev) {
    const map = this.host?.keyMap;
    if (!map) return ev;
    const dropChar = this.remapDropChar; this.remapDropChar = false; // (the page sends a key's character right after it)
    if (ev.type === 'char') return dropChar ? null : ev;
    if (ev.type !== 'keydown' && ev.type !== 'keyup') return ev;
    const from = (ev.extended ? 0x100 : 0) | (ev.scan & 0xff), held = (this.remapHeld ??= {});
    let to = held[from];
    if (ev.type === 'keyup') delete held[from];
    else if (to === undefined) {
      const chord = ((this.keyState[VK.CONTROL] | this.keyState[VK.MENU]) & 0x80) !== 0, text = this.textInput(), mapped = map.get(from);
      to = held[from] = chord || text ? null : mapped ?? null;
      if (mapped) this.vm.log('input', `key ${from.toString(16)} ${to ? `-> vk ${to.vk.toString(16)} scan ${to.scan.toString(16)}` : `as it is (${chord ? 'Ctrl/Alt held' : 'text input'})`}`);
    }
    if (!to) return ev;
    if (ev.type === 'keydown') this.remapDropChar = true;
    return { ...ev, vk: to.vk, scan: to.scan & 0xff, extended: to.scan > 0xff };
  }
  /**
   * The game awaits text: the focused window has an input context (Imm*), and the game shows its text fields that way —
   * it associates a context of its own with them, or turns its IME off elsewhere (a null context). Without either, no
   * sign of a text field: false.
   */
  textInput() {
    const w = this.windows.get(this.focus) ?? this.windows.get(this.active);
    if (!w || w.imc === 0) return false;
    return (w.imc !== undefined && w.imc !== this.defaultImc) || !!this.imeOff;
  }
  /** The process's default input context (ImmGetContext of a window never given another one). */
  defaultInputContext() { return (this.defaultImc ??= this.proc.handles.create({ type: 'imc' })); }

  inputEvent(ev) {
    const defer = this.deferSends; this.deferSends = true; // (its sent messages wait for the window's thread: send())
    try { this.inputEvent1(ev); } finally { this.deferSends = defer; }
  }
  inputEvent1(ev) {
    if (ev.type === 'mousemove') {
      // a captured mouse (ev.rel): relative motion — ev.dx/dy the device's counts (raw input readers, unclamped), the
      // cursor moved by gdx/gdy screen pixels from where it is (a SetCursorPos warp included), within its bounds; an
      // absolute position otherwise. The cursor stays in its bounds (screen, ClipCursor) either way.
      if (ev.rel) { ev.x = this.cursor.x + (ev.gdx ?? ev.dx); ev.y = this.cursor.y + (ev.gdy ?? ev.dy); if (ev.seq !== undefined) this.inputSeq = ev.seq; }
      const p = this.clampCursor(ev.x, ev.y); ev.x = p.x; ev.y = p.y;
      if (ev.dx === undefined) { ev.dx = ev.x - this.cursor.x; ev.dy = ev.y - this.cursor.y; }
    }
    for (const l of this.rawListeners) l.onRaw(ev); // raw input consumers (DirectInput devices: onRaw(ev))
    switch (ev.type) {
      case 'mousemove': {
        this.mouseStats.moves++;
        this.cursor = { x: ev.x, y: ev.y };
        const w = this.capture ? this.windows.get(this.capture) : this.windowAt(ev.x, ev.y);
        if (!this.capture) this.setCursorAt(w, ev.x, ev.y, WM.MOUSEMOVE); // (the window under the cursor sets its shape)
        if (w && !w.desktop) this.post(w, WM.MOUSEMOVE, this.mkFlags(), ((ev.y - w.client.t) & 0xffff) << 16 | ((ev.x - w.client.l) & 0xffff));
        break;
      }
      case 'mousedown': case 'mouseup': {
        // (a captured mouse's buttons press where the guest cursor is; else at the host pointer's position)
        if (ev.rel || ev.x === undefined) { ev.x = this.cursor.x; ev.y = this.cursor.y; } else { const p = this.clampCursor(ev.x, ev.y); ev.x = p.x; ev.y = p.y; }
        this.cursor = { x: ev.x, y: ev.y };
        const vk = [VK.LBUTTON, VK.RBUTTON, VK.MBUTTON][ev.button] ?? VK.LBUTTON;
        this.keyState[vk] = ev.type === 'mousedown' ? 0x80 : 0;
        if (ev.type === 'mousedown') this.asyncPressed[vk] = 1;
        const w = this.capture ? this.windows.get(this.capture) : this.windowAt(ev.x, ev.y);
        const base = [WM.LBUTTONDOWN, WM.RBUTTONDOWN, WM.MBUTTONDOWN][ev.button] ?? WM.LBUTTONDOWN;
        const msg = ev.type === 'mousedown' ? (ev.dbl ? base + 2 : base) : base + 1;
        if (!this.capture) this.setCursorAt(w, ev.x, ev.y, msg);
        if (!w || w.desktop) break;
        if (ev.type === 'mousedown') this.activate(this.topLevel(w), true);
        this.vm.log('input', `mouse ${ev.type} button ${ev.button} at ${ev.x},${ev.y} -> hwnd=${w.hwnd.toString(16)} msg=${msg.toString(16)} client ${ev.x - w.client.l},${ev.y - w.client.t}${this.capture ? ' (captured)' : ''}`);
        this.post(w, msg, this.mkFlags(), ((ev.y - w.client.t) & 0xffff) << 16 | ((ev.x - w.client.l) & 0xffff));
        break;
      }
      case 'wheel': {
        const w = this.windows.get(this.focus) ?? this.windowAt(ev.x ?? this.cursor.x, ev.y ?? this.cursor.y);
        if (w && !w.desktop) this.post(w, WM.MOUSEWHEEL, ((ev.delta * 120) & 0xffff) << 16 | this.mkFlags(), ((ev.y ?? this.cursor.y) & 0xffff) << 16 | ((ev.x ?? this.cursor.x) & 0xffff));
        break;
      }
      case 'keydown': case 'keyup': {
        const down = ev.type === 'keydown';
        const vk = ev.vk & 0xff;
        if (down) this.lastKeyVk = vk;
        const wasDown = (this.keyState[vk] & 0x80) !== 0;
        if (down) { if (!wasDown) { this.keyState[vk] ^= 1; this.asyncPressed[vk] = 1; } this.keyState[vk] |= 0x80; } else this.keyState[vk] &= 1;
        // generic modifier state
        if (vk === VK.LSHIFT || vk === VK.RSHIFT) this.keyState[VK.SHIFT] = (this.keyState[VK.LSHIFT] | this.keyState[VK.RSHIFT]) & 0x80;
        if (vk === VK.LCONTROL || vk === VK.RCONTROL) this.keyState[VK.CONTROL] = (this.keyState[VK.LCONTROL] | this.keyState[VK.RCONTROL]) & 0x80;
        if (vk === VK.LMENU || vk === VK.RMENU) this.keyState[VK.MENU] = (this.keyState[VK.LMENU] | this.keyState[VK.RMENU]) & 0x80;
        const w = this.windows.get(this.focus) ?? this.windows.get(this.active);
        if (!w) break;
        const alt = (this.keyState[VK.MENU] & 0x80) !== 0;
        const sys = alt || vk === VK.MENU || vk === VK.LMENU || vk === VK.RMENU || vk === 0x79;
        const msg = down ? (sys ? WM.SYSKEYDOWN : WM.KEYDOWN) : (sys ? WM.SYSKEYUP : WM.KEYUP);
        const scan = (ev.scan ?? 0) & 0xff, ext = ev.extended ? 1 : 0;
        const lParam = (ev.repeat ?? 1) | (scan << 16) | (ext << 24) | (sys && alt ? 1 << 29 : 0) | (wasDown ? 1 << 30 : 0) | (down ? 0 : 1 << 31);
        this.post(w, msg, vk, lParam >>> 0);
        break;
      }
      case 'char': {
        // The host knows the character the key produced (layout aware). Like Windows, WM_CHAR only comes out of
        // TranslateMessage: attach the character to the pending WM_KEYDOWN instead of posting a second message.
        if (this.lastKeyVk === undefined) break;
        this.pendingChars ??= [];
        this.pendingChars.push({ vk: this.lastKeyVk, code: ev.code });
        if (this.pendingChars.length > 64) this.pendingChars.shift();
        break;
      }
      case 'focus': {
        const w = this.windows.get(this.active);
        // (the device's loss / reactivation and the WM_ACTIVATEAPP that tells the game go together: deferred as one to
        // the window's thread like the message — a focus loss and return taken in one batch then reach the game as
        // deactivated (device lost), WM_ACTIVATEAPP 0, reactivated, WM_ACTIVATEAPP 1, not both device changes first)
        const activate = () => {
          for (const d of this.vm.d3dDevices ?? []) d.onActivate(ev.focused); // (fullscreen Direct3D devices are lost meanwhile)
          if (w) this.send(w, WM.ACTIVATEAPP, ev.focused ? 1 : 0, 0);
        };
        if (w && this.deferSends && this.mustDefer(w)) this.deferToThread(w, { fn: activate }); else activate();
        if (!ev.focused) this.keyState.fill(0);
        this.appInactive = !ev.focused; this.updateCursor();
        break;
      }
      case 'close': {
        const w = this.zorder.find((x) => x.visible);
        if (w) this.post(w, WM.CLOSE, 0, 0);
        break;
      }
      case 'resize': break;
    }
  }

  /** Windows owned by a thread with pending paint. */
  paintPending(thread, hwndFilter) {
    for (const w of this.windows.values()) {
      if (w.destroyed || !w.visible || w.minimized || !w.invalid || rectEmpty(w.invalid)) continue;
      if (w.thread !== thread) continue;
      if (hwndFilter && w.hwnd !== hwndFilter) continue;
      // ancestors must be visible
      let p = w.parent, ok = true; while (p && !p.desktop) { if (!p.visible) { ok = false; break; } p = p.parent; }
      if (ok) return w;
    }
    return null;
  }

  dueTimer(thread, hwndFilter) {
    let now = -1; // (the clock read only when a timer of the thread is there: PeekMessage polling loops call this)
    for (const t of this.proc.timers) {
      if (t.kind !== 'wm' || t.thread !== thread) continue;
      if (hwndFilter && t.hwnd !== hwndFilter) continue;
      if (now < 0) now = this.vm.clock.now();
      if (t.due <= now) return t;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * PeekMessage core. Returns a message object or null.
   */
  peek(thread, hwndFilter, min, max, remove, deliver = false) {
    this.pump();
    const q = this.queueOf(thread);
    if (deliver) this.deliverSent(thread); // (the thread's own GetMessage / PeekMessage: messages sent to it first)
    for (let i = 0; i < q.msgs.length; i++) {
      const m = q.msgs[i];
      if (!this.matches(m, hwndFilter, min, max)) continue;
      if (remove) q.msgs.splice(i, 1);
      return m;
    }
    if (q.quit !== null && (!max || (WM.QUIT >= min && WM.QUIT <= max))) {
      const m = { hwnd: 0, msg: WM.QUIT, wParam: q.quit >>> 0, lParam: 0, time: this.tick(), pt: { ...this.cursor } };
      if (remove) q.quit = null;
      return m;
    }
    const inRange = (msg) => !max ? (!min || msg >= min) : msg >= min && msg <= max;
    if (inRange(WM.TIMER)) {
      const t = this.dueTimer(thread, hwndFilter);
      if (t) {
        if (remove) { const now = this.vm.clock.now(); t.due += t.elapse; if (t.due < now) t.due = now + t.elapse; t.due = this.vm.timerRes?.tickAt(t.due) ?? t.due; }
        return { hwnd: t.hwnd, msg: WM.TIMER, wParam: t.id, lParam: t.proc, time: this.tick(), pt: { ...this.cursor } };
      }
    }
    if (inRange(WM.PAINT)) {
      const w = this.paintPending(thread, hwndFilter);
      if (w) return { hwnd: w.hwnd, msg: WM.PAINT, wParam: 0, lParam: 0, time: this.tick(), pt: { ...this.cursor } };
    }
    return null;
  }

  /** a message to take (wait conditions): a posted one, or one sent to the thread (its GetMessage delivers it) */
  hasMessage(thread, hwndFilter, min, max) { return this.peek(thread, hwndFilter, min, max, false) !== null || this.queueOf(thread).sent?.length > 0; }

  /** The messages sent to `thread` by host input (send() while deferSends), delivered in order on that thread. */
  deliverSent(thread) {
    const q = this.queueOf(thread);
    while (q.sent?.length) { const s = q.sent.shift(); if (s.fn) s.fn(); else this.send(s.w, s.msg, s.wParam, s.lParam); }
  }

  /** WM_QUIT handling and dispatch of a retrieved message. */
  dispatch(m) {
    if (m.msg === WM.TIMER && m.lParam) {
      return this.vm.callGuest(this.vm.current, m.lParam, [m.hwnd, WM.TIMER, m.wParam, this.tick()]);
    }
    const w = this.windows.get(m.hwnd);
    if (!w) return 0;
    if (m.msg === WM.PAINT) { const r = this.send(w, WM.PAINT, 0, 0); if (w.invalid && !rectEmpty(w.invalid)) { w.invalid = null; } this.present(); return r; }
    return this.send(w, m.msg, m.wParam, m.lParam);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ window lifecycle
  findClass(nameOrAtom, wide) {
    if (typeof nameOrAtom === 'number') {
      if (nameOrAtom < 0x10000) return this.classByAtom.get(nameOrAtom) ?? null;
      nameOrAtom = wide ? this.mem.readWString(nameOrAtom) : this.mem.readCString(nameOrAtom);
    }
    return this.classes.get(nameOrAtom.toLowerCase()) ?? null;
  }

  registerClass(cls) {
    const key = cls.name.toLowerCase();
    if (this.classes.has(key) && !this.classes.get(key).builtin) return 0;
    cls.atom = this.nextClassAtom++;
    this.classes.set(key, cls);
    this.classByAtom.set(cls.atom, cls);
    return cls.atom;
  }

  createWindow(c, p) {
    const cls = this.findClass(p.className, p.wide);
    if (!cls) { c.setLastError(E.CANNOT_FIND_WND_CLASS); this.vm.warn(`CreateWindowEx: unknown class ${typeof p.className === 'number' && p.className < 0x10000 ? '#' + p.className : p.className}`); return 0; }
    const style = p.style >>> 0, exStyle = p.exStyle >>> 0;
    const isChild = (style & WS_CHILD) !== 0;
    let parent = p.parent ? this.windows.get(p.parent) ?? null : null;
    if (isChild && !parent) { c.setLastError(E.INVALID_PARAMETER); return 0; }
    let x = p.x | 0, y = p.y | 0, w = p.w | 0, h = p.h | 0;
    if ((p.x >>> 0) === CW_USEDEFAULT) { x = 0; y = 0; }
    if ((p.w >>> 0) === CW_USEDEFAULT) { const nc = this.ncSizes(style, exStyle); w = 640 + nc.l + nc.r; h = 480 + nc.t + nc.b; }
    if (isChild) { x += parent.client.l; y += parent.client.t; }
    const win = this.makeWindow({ cls, style, exStyle, x, y, w, h, parent: isChild ? parent : this.desktop, owner: !isChild && parent ? parent : null, title: p.title ?? '', id: isChild ? p.menu : 0, menu: isChild ? 0 : p.menu, hInstance: p.hInstance });
    win.visible = false; // becomes visible via ShowWindow below
    if (isChild) parent.children.push(win); else this.zorder.unshift(win);
    // CREATESTRUCT
    const cs = this.proc.processHeap.alloc(48, true);
    const mem = this.mem;
    const nameStr = p.titleAddr ?? 0, classStr = p.classAddr ?? 0;
    mem.write32(cs, p.lpParam); mem.write32(cs + 4, p.hInstance); mem.write32(cs + 8, p.menu); mem.write32(cs + 12, p.parent);
    mem.write32(cs + 16, h); mem.write32(cs + 20, w); mem.write32(cs + 24, p.y); mem.write32(cs + 28, p.x); mem.write32(cs + 32, style);
    mem.write32(cs + 36, nameStr); mem.write32(cs + 40, classStr); mem.write32(cs + 44, exStyle);
    // WM_GETMINMAXINFO, WM_NCCREATE, WM_NCCALCSIZE, WM_CREATE
    const mmi = this.proc.processHeap.alloc(40, true);
    mem.write32(mmi + 8, this.screen.width); mem.write32(mmi + 12, this.screen.height); mem.write32(mmi + 24, 112); mem.write32(mmi + 28, 27);
    mem.write32(mmi + 32, this.screen.width + 12); mem.write32(mmi + 36, this.screen.height + 12);
    if (!isChild) this.send(win, WM.GETMINMAXINFO, 0, mmi);
    this.proc.processHeap.free_(mmi);
    if (!this.send(win, WM.NCCREATE, 0, cs)) { this.destroyWindow(win, true); this.proc.processHeap.free_(cs); return 0; }
    const rc = this.proc.processHeap.alloc(16, true);
    mem.write32(rc, win.rect.l); mem.write32(rc + 4, win.rect.t); mem.write32(rc + 8, win.rect.r); mem.write32(rc + 12, win.rect.b);
    this.send(win, WM.NCCALCSIZE, 0, rc);
    this.proc.processHeap.free_(rc);
    const r = this.send(win, WM.CREATE, 0, cs);
    this.proc.processHeap.free_(cs);
    if ((r | 0) === -1) { this.destroyWindow(win, true); return 0; }
    this.send(win, WM.SIZE, 0, (this.clientH(win) << 16) | (this.clientW(win) & 0xffff));
    this.send(win, WM.MOVE, 0, (((win.client.t - (isChild ? parent.client.t : 0)) & 0xffff) << 16) | ((win.client.l - (isChild ? parent.client.l : 0)) & 0xffff));
    if (style & WS_VISIBLE) this.showWindow(win, style & WS_MAXIMIZE ? 3 : style & WS_MINIMIZE ? 2 : 5);
    this.vm.log('win', `CreateWindow "${cls.name}" "${win.title}" hwnd=${win.hwnd.toString(16)} ${w}x${h} client ${this.clientW(win)}x${this.clientH(win)} style=${style.toString(16)}`);
    return win.hwnd;
  }

  /**
   * A top-level window shown by a background process (core/procs.js) takes the display when the foreground process
   * shows none (a launcher's hidden window, then its game's): the window manager the page shows is that one.
   */
  claimDisplay() {
    const g = this.vm.group;
    if (!g || g.foreground === this.vm) return;
    const f = g.foreground.wm;
    if (!f || f.proc !== g.foreground.proc || !f.zorder.some((x) => x.visible && !x.minimized)) g.setForeground(this.vm);
  }

  showWindow(w, cmd) {
    const was = w.visible;
    let show;
    switch (cmd) {
      case 0: show = false; break;
      case 2: case 6: case 7: show = true; w.minimized = true; break;
      case 3: show = true; w.maximized = true; if (!(w.style & WS_CHILD)) { this.setWindowPos(w, 0, 0, this.screen.width, this.screen.height, 0); } break;
      case 9: show = true; w.minimized = false; break;
      default: show = true; break;
    }
    if (show !== was) {
      w.visible = show;
      if (show) w.style |= WS_VISIBLE; else w.style &= ~WS_VISIBLE;
      if (show && !(w.style & WS_CHILD)) this.claimDisplay();
      this.send(w, WM.SHOWWINDOW, show ? 1 : 0, 0);
    }
    if (show && !(w.style & WS_CHILD) && cmd !== 4 && cmd !== 7 && cmd !== 8 && !w.minimized) this.activate(w, true);
    if (show) this.invalidate(w, null, true);
    if (show) this.send(w, WM.SIZE, w.minimized ? 1 : w.maximized ? 2 : 0, (this.clientH(w) << 16) | (this.clientW(w) & 0xffff));
    return was ? 1 : 0;
  }

  activate(w, setFocus) {
    if (!w || w.desktop) return;
    const prev = this.windows.get(this.active);
    if (prev === w) { if (setFocus && this.focus !== w.hwnd) this.setFocus(w); return; }
    if (prev && !prev.destroyed) { this.send(prev, WM.NCACTIVATE, 0, 0); this.send(prev, WM.ACTIVATE, 0, w.hwnd); }
    this.active = w.hwnd; this.foreground = w.hwnd;
    // bring to front
    const i = this.zorder.indexOf(w); if (i > 0) { this.zorder.splice(i, 1); this.zorder.unshift(w); }
    if (!prev) this.send(w, WM.ACTIVATEAPP, 1, 0);
    this.send(w, WM.NCACTIVATE, 1, 0);
    this.send(w, WM.ACTIVATE, 1, prev ? prev.hwnd : 0);
    if (setFocus) this.setFocus(w);
    this.dirty = true;
  }

  setFocus(w) {
    const prev = this.windows.get(this.focus);
    if (prev === w) return prev ? prev.hwnd : 0;
    this.focus = w ? w.hwnd : 0;
    if (prev && !prev.destroyed) this.send(prev, WM.KILLFOCUS, w ? w.hwnd : 0, 0);
    if (w) this.send(w, WM.SETFOCUS, prev ? prev.hwnd : 0, 0);
    return prev ? prev.hwnd : 0;
  }

  invalidate(w, rect, erase) {
    if (!w || w.destroyed) return;
    const full = { l: 0, t: 0, r: this.clientW(w), b: this.clientH(w) };
    const r = rect ? clipRect(rect, full) : full;
    if (rectEmpty(r) && rect) return;
    w.invalid = w.invalid ? { l: Math.min(w.invalid.l, r.l), t: Math.min(w.invalid.t, r.t), r: Math.max(w.invalid.r, r.r), b: Math.max(w.invalid.b, r.b) } : r;
    if (erase) w.eraseBkgnd = true;
  }

  validate(w, rect) {
    if (!w.invalid) return;
    if (!rect) { w.invalid = null; return; }
    // approximate: if the rect covers the invalid area, clear it
    const i = w.invalid;
    if (rect.l <= i.l && rect.t <= i.t && rect.r >= i.r && rect.b >= i.b) w.invalid = null;
  }

  setWindowPos(w, x, y, cx, cy, flags) {
    const SWP_NOSIZE = 1, SWP_NOMOVE = 2, SWP_NOZORDER = 4, SWP_NOACTIVATE = 0x10, SWP_SHOWWINDOW = 0x40, SWP_HIDEWINDOW = 0x80, SWP_FRAMECHANGED = 0x20;
    const isChild = (w.style & WS_CHILD) !== 0;
    const base = isChild ? w.parent.client : { l: 0, t: 0 };
    const oldRect = { ...w.rect }, oldClient = { ...w.client };
    let nl = flags & SWP_NOMOVE ? w.rect.l : base.l + x, nt = flags & SWP_NOMOVE ? w.rect.t : base.t + y;
    let nw = flags & SWP_NOSIZE ? w.rect.r - w.rect.l : cx, nh = flags & SWP_NOSIZE ? w.rect.b - w.rect.t : cy;
    // WINDOWPOS struct for WINDOWPOSCHANGING/CHANGED
    const wp = this.proc.processHeap.alloc(28, true);
    const mem = this.mem;
    mem.write32(wp, w.hwnd); mem.write32(wp + 4, 0); mem.write32(wp + 8, nl - base.l); mem.write32(wp + 12, nt - base.t); mem.write32(wp + 16, nw); mem.write32(wp + 20, nh); mem.write32(wp + 24, flags);
    this.send(w, WM.WINDOWPOSCHANGING, 0, wp);
    nl = base.l + mem.readS32(wp + 8); nt = base.t + mem.readS32(wp + 12); nw = mem.readS32(wp + 16); nh = mem.readS32(wp + 20);
    const dx = nl - w.rect.l, dy = nt - w.rect.t;
    w.rect = { l: nl, t: nt, r: nl + nw, b: nt + nh };
    if (flags & SWP_FRAMECHANGED) { /* nc sizes derive from style */ }
    this.layout(w);
    if (dx || dy) this.moveChildren(w, dx, dy);
    if (flags & SWP_SHOWWINDOW) this.showWindow(w, 5);
    if (flags & SWP_HIDEWINDOW) this.showWindow(w, 0);
    if (!(flags & SWP_NOZORDER) && !isChild) { const i = this.zorder.indexOf(w); if (i > 0) { this.zorder.splice(i, 1); this.zorder.unshift(w); } }
    if (!(flags & SWP_NOACTIVATE) && !isChild && w.visible) this.activate(w, false);
    mem.write32(wp + 24, flags);
    this.send(w, WM.WINDOWPOSCHANGED, 0, wp);
    this.proc.processHeap.free_(wp);
    const sizeChanged = oldClient.r - oldClient.l !== this.clientW(w) || oldClient.b - oldClient.t !== this.clientH(w);
    const moved = oldRect.l !== w.rect.l || oldRect.t !== w.rect.t;
    if (sizeChanged) { this.send(w, WM.SIZE, w.maximized ? 2 : 0, (this.clientH(w) << 16) | (this.clientW(w) & 0xffff)); this.invalidate(w, null, true); }
    if (moved) this.send(w, WM.MOVE, 0, (((w.client.t - base.t) & 0xffff) << 16) | ((w.client.l - base.l) & 0xffff));
    this.dirty = true;
    return 1;
  }

  moveChildren(w, dx, dy) {
    for (const ch of w.children) { ch.rect.l += dx; ch.rect.r += dx; ch.rect.t += dy; ch.rect.b += dy; ch.client.l += dx; ch.client.r += dx; ch.client.t += dy; ch.client.b += dy; this.moveChildren(ch, dx, dy); }
  }

  destroyWindow(w, silent = false) {
    if (!w || w.destroyed) return 0;
    for (const ch of [...w.children]) this.destroyWindow(ch, silent);
    if (!silent) { this.send(w, WM.DESTROY, 0, 0); }
    w.destroyed = true;
    if (!silent) this.send(w, WM.NCDESTROY, 0, 0);
    if (w.parent) w.parent.children = w.parent.children.filter((x) => x !== w);
    const zi = this.zorder.indexOf(w); if (zi >= 0) this.zorder.splice(zi, 1);
    if (this.focus === w.hwnd) this.focus = 0;
    if (this.active === w.hwnd) { this.active = 0; const next = this.zorder.find((x) => x.visible); if (next) this.activate(next, true); }
    if (this.capture === w.hwnd) this.capture = 0;
    if (this.foreground === w.hwnd) this.foreground = 0;
    this.proc.timers = this.proc.timers.filter((t) => t.hwnd !== w.hwnd);
    // drop queued messages for the window
    for (const t of this.proc.threads) if (t.msgQueue) t.msgQueue.msgs = t.msgQueue.msgs.filter((m) => m.hwnd !== w.hwnd);
    if (w.surface) { freeSurface(this.proc, w.surface); w.surface = null; }
    this.windows.delete(w.hwnd);
    this.proc.handles.map.delete(w.hwnd);
    this.dirty = true;
    return 1;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ DefWindowProc
  defWindowProc(w, msg, wParam, lParam) {
    const mem = this.mem;
    switch (msg) {
      case WM.NCCREATE: return 1;
      case WM.NCCALCSIZE: return 0;
      case WM.NCHITTEST: return 1; // HTCLIENT
      case WM.NCACTIVATE: return 1;
      case WM.NCPAINT: return 0;
      case WM.NCDESTROY: return 0;
      case WM.CREATE: return 0;
      case WM.PAINT: {
        // validate and erase (as if BeginPaint/EndPaint were called)
        const dc = this.beginPaint(w, null);
        this.endPaint(w, dc);
        return 0;
      }
      case WM.ERASEBKGND: {
        const dc = this.proc.handles.getAs(wParam, 'gdi');
        const br = w.cls?.hbrBackground ?? 0;
        if (!dc || !br) return 0;
        const color = this.brushColor(br);
        if (color === null) return 0;
        fillRect(dc.surface, dc.clip, dc.clip.l, dc.clip.t, dc.clip.r, dc.clip.b, color);
        this.dirty = true;
        return 1;
      }
      case WM.CLOSE: this.destroyWindow(w); return 0;
      case WM.SETTEXT: w.title = lParam ? mem.readCString(lParam) : ''; this.shownTitle = w.title; this.host?.display?.setTitle?.(w.title); return 1;
      case WM.GETTEXT: { if (!wParam) return 0; const n = Math.min(w.title.length, wParam - 1); mem.writeCString(lParam, w.title.slice(0, n)); return n; }
      case WM.GETTEXTLENGTH: return w.title.length;
      case WM.SETCURSOR: {
        // a child asks its parent first (TRUE: the parent set the cursor); the client area takes the class cursor (a
        // class without one: the application sets it), the frame the arrow or a sizing cursor
        if ((w.style & WS_CHILD) && w.parent && !w.parent.desktop && this.send(w.parent, WM.SETCURSOR, wParam, lParam)) return 1;
        const ht = (lParam << 16) >> 16;
        if (ht === HT.CLIENT) {
          const h = w.cls?.hCursor || (w.cls?.builtin ? this.systemCursor(w.cls.name === 'EDIT' || w.cls.name === 'RICHEDIT' ? IDC_IBEAM : IDC_ARROW) : 0);
          if (!h) return 0;
          this.setCursorShape(h); return 1;
        }
        if (ht === HT.ERROR || ht === HT.NOWHERE) return 0;
        const id = { [HT.LEFT]: IDC_SIZEWE, [HT.RIGHT]: IDC_SIZEWE, [HT.TOP]: IDC_SIZENS, [HT.BOTTOM]: IDC_SIZENS, [HT.TOPLEFT]: IDC_SIZENWSE, [HT.BOTTOMRIGHT]: IDC_SIZENWSE, [HT.TOPRIGHT]: IDC_SIZENESW, [HT.BOTTOMLEFT]: IDC_SIZENESW }[ht] ?? IDC_ARROW;
        this.setCursorShape(this.systemCursor(id)); return 1;
      }
      case WM.MOUSEACTIVATE: return 1; // MA_ACTIVATE
      case WM.ACTIVATE: if ((wParam & 0xffff) !== 0) this.setFocus(w); return 0;
      case WM.SYSCOMMAND: {
        const cmd = wParam & 0xfff0;
        if (cmd === 0xf060) { this.send(w, WM.CLOSE, 0, 0); return 0; } // SC_CLOSE
        if (cmd === 0xf020) { w.minimized = true; return 0; }
        if (cmd === 0xf120) { w.minimized = false; return 0; }
        return 0;
      }
      case WM.SYSKEYDOWN: if (wParam === 0x73 && this.keyState[VK.MENU] & 0x80) { this.post(w, WM.SYSCOMMAND, 0xf060, 0); } return 0; // Alt+F4
      case WM.WINDOWPOSCHANGED: return 0;
      case WM.GETMINMAXINFO: return 0;
      case WM.SETREDRAW: return 0;
      case WM.SHOWWINDOW: return 0;
      case WM.KEYDOWN: case WM.KEYUP: case WM.CHAR: case WM.SYSKEYUP: case WM.SYSCHAR: return 0;
      case 0x7b: return 0; // WM_CONTEXTMENU
      case 0x2a1: return 0; // WM_MOUSEHOVER
      case 0x5: return 0;
      default: return 0;
    }
  }

  brushColor(h) {
    if (h < 0x20 && h > 0) return this.sysColor(h - 1); // COLOR_xxx + 1
    const b = this.proc.handles.getAs(h, 'gdi');
    if (!b || b.kind !== 'brush' || b.style === 1) return null;
    return b.color;
  }

  sysColor(i) {
    const T = { 0: 0xc0c0c0, 1: 0x004e98, 2: 0x0a246a, 3: 0x808080, 4: 0xd4d0c8, 5: 0xffffff, 6: 0x000000, 7: 0x000000, 8: 0x000000, 9: 0xffffff, 10: 0x808080, 11: 0xd4d0c8, 12: 0x808080, 13: 0x0a246a, 14: 0xffffff, 15: 0xd4d0c8, 16: 0x808080, 17: 0x808080, 18: 0x000000, 19: 0xd4d0c8, 20: 0xffffff, 21: 0x404040, 22: 0xd4d0c8, 23: 0x000000, 24: 0xffffe1, 25: 0x000000, 26: 0x0000ff, 27: 0x3a6ea5, 28: 0xa6caf0, 29: 0xd4d0c8, 30: 0xd4d0c8 };
    return T[i] ?? 0;
  }

  beginPaint(w, psAddr) {
    const dc = this.windowDC(this.vm.ctx, w, true);
    const inv = w.invalid ?? { l: 0, t: 0, r: this.clientW(w), b: this.clientH(w) };
    const erase = w.eraseBkgnd;
    if (psAddr) {
      const mem = this.mem;
      mem.write32(psAddr, dc.handle); mem.write32(psAddr + 4, erase ? 1 : 0);
      mem.write32(psAddr + 8, inv.l); mem.write32(psAddr + 12, inv.t); mem.write32(psAddr + 16, inv.r); mem.write32(psAddr + 20, inv.b);
      mem.fill(psAddr + 24, 40, 0);
    }
    w.invalid = null; w.eraseBkgnd = false;
    if (erase) { if (!this.send(w, WM.ERASEBKGND, dc.handle, 0) && psAddr) this.mem.write32(psAddr + 4, 1); }
    w.paintDC = dc;
    return dc;
  }

  endPaint(w, dc) {
    if (dc) { this.proc.handles.map.delete(dc.handle); }
    w.paintDC = null;
    this.dirty = true;
    this.present();
  }

  screenDC(c) {
    const top = this.zorder.find((w) => w.visible && w.surface) ?? null;
    if (top) { const dc = makeDC(this.proc, top.surface, { hwnd: 0, window: top, ox: -top.client.l, oy: -top.client.t }); return dc.handle; }
    const s = allocSurface(this.proc, this.screen.width, this.screen.height, 'screen');
    const dc = makeDC(this.proc, s, {});
    dc.ownsBitmap = null; dc.screenSurface = s;
    return dc.handle;
  }
}

/** Ensure a window manager exists for the current process. */
export function wmOf(vm) {
  if (!vm.wm || vm.wm.proc !== vm.proc) vm.wm = new WindowManager(vm);
  return vm.wm;
}

// =============================================================================================
/**
 * @param {import('./api.js').ApiRegistry} api
 * @param {import('../core/vm.js').Vm} vm
 */
export function registerUser32(api, vm) {
  const mem = vm.mem;
  const U = {};
  const wm = () => wmOf(vm);
  const win = (h) => { const w = wm().windows.get(h >>> 0); return w && !w.destroyed ? w : null; };
  const readRect = (a) => ({ l: mem.readS32(a), t: mem.readS32(a + 4), r: mem.readS32(a + 8), b: mem.readS32(a + 12) });
  const writeRect = (a, r) => { mem.write32(a, r.l); mem.write32(a + 4, r.t); mem.write32(a + 8, r.r); mem.write32(a + 12, r.b); };
  const strOrAtom = (a, wide) => (a < 0x10000 ? a : wide ? mem.readWString(a) : mem.readCString(a));

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- classes
  const regClass = (c, ex, wide) => {
    const p = c.arg(0) + (ex ? 4 : 0);
    const nameA = mem.read32(p + 36);
    const name = nameA < 0x10000 ? `#${nameA}` : wide ? mem.readWString(nameA) : mem.readCString(nameA);
    const cls = { name, wndProc: mem.read32(p + 4), style: mem.read32(p), cbClsExtra: mem.read32(p + 8), cbWndExtra: mem.read32(p + 12), hInstance: mem.read32(p + 16), hIcon: mem.read32(p + 20), hCursor: mem.read32(p + 24), hbrBackground: mem.read32(p + 28), menuName: mem.read32(p + 32), hIconSm: ex ? mem.read32(p + 40) : 0, extra: new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(Math.max(mem.read32(p + 8), 4))) };
    const atom = wm().registerClass(cls);
    if (!atom) return c.fail(E.CLASS_ALREADY_EXISTS);
    vm.log('win', `RegisterClass "${name}" wndproc=${cls.wndProc.toString(16)}`);
    return atom;
  };
  U.RegisterClassA = [1, (c) => regClass(c, false, false)];
  U.RegisterClassW = [1, (c) => regClass(c, false, true)];
  U.RegisterClassExA = [1, (c) => regClass(c, true, false)];
  U.RegisterClassExW = [1, (c) => regClass(c, true, true)];
  U.UnregisterClassA = [2, (c) => { const cls = wm().findClass(strOrAtom(c.arg(0), false), false); if (!cls || cls.builtin) return 0; wm().classes.delete(cls.name.toLowerCase()); wm().classByAtom.delete(cls.atom); return 1; }];
  U.UnregisterClassW = [2, (c) => { const cls = wm().findClass(strOrAtom(c.arg(0), true), true); if (!cls || cls.builtin) return 0; wm().classes.delete(cls.name.toLowerCase()); return 1; }];
  const getClassInfo = (c, ex, wide) => {
    const cls = wm().findClass(strOrAtom(c.arg(1), wide), wide);
    if (!cls) return c.fail(E.CLASS_DOES_NOT_EXIST);
    const p = c.arg(2) + (ex ? 4 : 0);
    if (ex) mem.write32(c.arg(2), 48);

  /**
   * The window managers of the top-level windows the desktop shows: this process's, then the other live processes' of

  const desktopWms = () => {
    const own = wm();
    if (!vm.group) return [own];
    const out = [own];
    for (const v of vm.group.vms) if (v !== vm && v.proc && !v.proc.exited && v.wm && v.wm.proc === v.proc) out.push(v.wm);
    return out;
  };

    return 0;
  };
```
