`tests/async-read.test.js`:

```js
// ReadFile on a file whose data arrives asynchronously (vm.asyncReads, the HTTP backend's prepare()): the guest sees the
// same results as with synchronous reads, and a thread parked on such a read does not hold up a thread waiting for it
// inside a callback (a nested wait, during which no promise can settle).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { Vfs, MemBackend } from '../src/vfs/vfs.js';
import { RealClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';

const EXE = new URL('../build/pe/asyncread.exe', import.meta.url).pathname;
const SIZE = 200000, PIECE = 65536, DELAY = 150;

/** A network-like backend: a piece not fetched yet is fetched synchronously by read(), or asynchronously by prepare(). */
class NetBackend extends MemBackend {
  constructor(data) { super(); this.here = new Set(); this.stats = { sync: 0, async: 0 }; this.data = data; }
  stat(rel) { return rel.toLowerCase() === 'data.bin' ? { size: SIZE, isDir: false, mtime: 0 } : super.stat(rel); }
  open(rel) {
    if (rel.toLowerCase() !== 'data.bin') return null;
    const b = this;
    const pieces = (off, len) => { const out = []; const end = Math.min(off + len, SIZE); for (let p = Math.floor(off / PIECE); p * PIECE < end; p++) out.push(p); return off >= end ? [] : out; };
    return {
      size: () => SIZE,
      prepare(off, len) {
        const miss = pieces(off, len).filter((p) => !b.here.has(p));
        if (!miss.length) return null;
        b.stats.async++;
        return new Promise((res) => setTimeout(() => { for (const p of miss) b.here.add(p); res(); }, DELAY));
      },
      read(off, len) {
        const miss = pieces(off, len).filter((p) => !b.here.has(p));
        if (miss.length) { b.stats.sync++; for (const p of miss) b.here.add(p); }
        const end = Math.min(off + len, SIZE);
        return off >= end ? new Uint8Array(0) : b.data.slice(off, end);
      },
      write: () => 0, truncate() {}, close() {},
    };
  }
}

async function runExe(asyncReads) {
  const data = new Uint8Array(SIZE); for (let i = 0; i < SIZE; i++) data[i] = (i * 7 + (i >> 8)) & 0xff;
  const vfs = new Vfs();
  const test = new MemBackend();
  const net = new NetBackend(data);
  vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend());
  vfs.mount('C:\\Test', test);
  vfs.mount('C:\\Net', net);
  test.open('asyncread.exe', { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(EXE));
  const clock = new RealClock();
  const host = new HeadlessHost({ clock, width: 320, height: 200 });
  host.cooperative = true;
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host, logKinds: ['warn', 'crash'] });
  vm.asyncReads = asyncReads;
  vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\asyncread.exe' });
  let code;
  for (;;) { // (the browser worker's pump: runFor, then back to the event loop)
    const r = vm.runFor(performance.now() + 20);
    if (r.state === 'exited') { code = r.code; break; }
    await new Promise((res) => {
      const t = setTimeout(res, r.state === 'sleep' ? Math.max(0, r.until - performance.now()) : r.state === 'idle' ? 5 : 0);
      host.wake = () => { clearTimeout(t); res(); };
    });
  }
  return { code, out: vm.stdout.join(''), stats: net.stats };
}

test('asynchronous ReadFile: the synchronous path\'s results (pointer, OVERLAPPED, EOF), no stall under a nested wait', { skip: !fs.existsSync(EXE) && 'build/pe/asyncread.exe missing (make pe-tests)' }, async () => {
  const want = await runExe(false);
  assert.equal(want.code, 0, want.out);
  assert.equal(want.stats.async, 0);
  assert.match(want.out, /^read 0: ret=1 got=16 sum=\d+ ptr=16\n/);
  assert.match(want.out, /read 1: ret=1 got=100 sum=\d+ ptr=70100 err=0\n/);
  assert.match(want.out, /read 2: ret=1 got=40 sum=\d+ ptr=200000\n/);
  assert.match(want.out, /read 3: ret=0 got=0 sum=0 err=38\n/);
  assert.match(want.out, /ovl: 0 100 70000\n/);
  assert.match(want.out, /nested wait=0 got=64 sum=\d+ quick=1\n/);
  const got = await runExe(true);
  // (reads 0-2 and the late read park; the late one is woken by the nested wait and fetches synchronously)
  assert.deepEqual(got.stats, { sync: 1, async: 4 });
  assert.equal(got.out, want.out);
  assert.equal(got.code, 0);
});
```

`tests/audio-worklet-mix.test.js`:

```js
// The AudioWorklet's direct mixer (audio-worklet.js) against the reference: a 16-bit stereo buffer at 22050 Hz, played
// looping from its cursor, mixed at 44100 Hz with gains — the same samples as linear interpolation gives, cursor
// snapping on a new generation, one-shot end, and resynchronisation to a fresh cursor.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

let Processor = null;
globalThis.AudioWorkletProcessor = class { constructor() { this.port = { onmessage: null }; } };
globalThis.registerProcessor = (name, cls) => { Processor = cls; };
globalThis.sampleRate = 44100;
await import('../src/host/web/audio-worklet.js');
const { VOICE_BASE, VOICE_INTS, VOICE_TABLE_BYTES } = await import('../src/win32/dsound.js');

function setup() {
  const memory = new SharedArrayBuffer(1 << 16), voices = new SharedArrayBuffer(VOICE_TABLE_BYTES);
  const p = new Processor({ processorOptions: { audio: new SharedArrayBuffer(8), ctl: new SharedArrayBuffer(64), frames: 1, write: 0, read: 1, underruns: 2 } });
  p.port.onmessage({ data: { type: 'voices', memory, voices } });
  return { p, mem: new DataView(memory), v: new Int32Array(voices), vf: new Float32Array(voices) };
}
const ADDR = 0x1000, FRAMES = 1000;
function fill(mem) { for (let i = 0; i < FRAMES; i++) { mem.setInt16(ADDR + 4 * i, Math.round(Math.sin(i / 7) * 20000), true); mem.setInt16(ADDR + 4 * i + 2, Math.round(Math.cos(i / 5) * 10000), true); } }
function voice(v, vf, { gen = 1, cursor = 0, loop = 1, gl = 0.5, gr = 0.25, playing = 1, pub = 0 } = {}) {
  const o = VOICE_BASE; // slot 0
  v[o] = playing; v[o + 2] = ADDR; v[o + 3] = FRAMES * 4; v[o + 4] = 4; v[o + 5] = 16; v[o + 6] = 2; v[o + 7] = 0; v[o + 8] = 22050; v[o + 9] = loop;
  vf[o + 10] = gl; vf[o + 11] = gr; v[o + 12] = cursor; v[o + 13] = pub; Atomics.store(v, o + 1, gen);
}
const render = (p, n = 128) => { const l = new Float32Array(n), r = new Float32Array(n); p.process([], [[l, r]]); return [l, r]; };
const ref = (mem, frame, ch) => { const s = (f) => mem.getInt16(ADDR + (f % FRAMES) * 4 + 2 * ch, true) / 32768; const fi = Math.floor(frame), t = frame - fi; return s(fi) + (s(fi + 1) - s(fi)) * t; };

test('the worklet mixes a looping buffer from its cursor, with gains and resampling', () => {
  const { p, mem, v, vf } = setup(); fill(mem);
  voice(v, vf, { cursor: 40 * 4 });
  let frame = 40;
  for (let q = 0; q < 20; q++) { // 2560 output frames: 1280 buffer frames, the loop wraps once
    const [l, r] = render(p);
    for (let k = 0; k < 128; k++, frame = (frame + 0.5) % FRAMES) { assert.ok(Math.abs(l[k] - 0.5 * ref(mem, frame, 0)) < 1e-6, `L q${q} k${k}`); assert.ok(Math.abs(r[k] - 0.25 * ref(mem, frame, 1)) < 1e-6, `R q${q} k${k}`); }
  }
  assert.equal(v[0], 20 * 128, 'frame counter'); assert.equal(v[2], 1, 'mixing');
  assert.ok(vf[1] > 0.2, 'peak');
});

test('a new generation snaps to the cursor; a one-shot stops at its end; a fresh cursor resynchronises', () => {
  const { p, mem, v, vf } = setup(); fill(mem);
  voice(v, vf, { cursor: (FRAMES - 10) * 4, loop: 0 });
  const [l] = render(p); // 20 output frames from the last 10 buffer frames, then silence
  assert.ok(Math.abs(l[0] - 0.5 * ref(mem, FRAMES - 10, 0)) < 1e-6);
  assert.ok(l.slice(21).every((x) => x === 0), 'silent past the end');
  voice(v, vf, { gen: 2, cursor: 100 * 4 }); // Play again from 100
  const [l2] = render(p);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(l2[0] - 0.5 * ref(mem, 100, 0)) < 1e-6, 'from the new cursor');
  // cursor published now (pub = the frame counter) 300 frames away from the mix position: resync
  voice(v, vf, { gen: 2, cursor: 500 * 4, pub: v[0] });
  const [l3] = render(p);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(l3[0] - 0.5 * ref(mem, 500, 0)) < 1e-6, 'resynchronised');
  // an old publication (as when the worker stalls): no resync, the mix goes on
  voice(v, vf, { gen: 2, cursor: 900 * 4, pub: (v[0] - 44100) | 0 });
  const [l4] = render(p);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(l4[0] - 0.5 * ref(mem, 564, 0)) < 1e-6, 'continued from 564');
});
```

`tests/authenticode.test.js`:

```js
// Authenticode verification (WinVerifyTrust): hashes against node:crypto, and PE files signed here (PKCS#7 built by
// hand, RSA key from node:crypto) verified, then tampered with in every part the signature covers.
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { hash, createHash, verifyAuthenticode, peLayout, TRUST_E_NOSIGNATURE, TRUST_E_BAD_DIGEST, TRUST_E_SUBJECT_FORM_UNKNOWN } from '../src/win32/authenticode.js';

test('md5 / sha1 / sha256 match node:crypto, whole and in pieces', () => {
  let seed = 7; const rnd = () => (seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0);
  for (let n = 0; n < 200; n++) {
    const b = crypto.randomBytes(rnd() % 700);
    for (const k of ['md5', 'sha1', 'sha256']) {
      const want = crypto.createHash(k).update(b).digest('hex');
      assert.equal(Buffer.from(hash(k, b)).toString('hex'), want);
      const h = createHash(k);
      for (let o = 0; o < b.length;) { const s = Math.min(b.length - o, 1 + rnd() % 90); h.update(b.subarray(o, o + s)); o += s; }
      assert.equal(Buffer.from(h.digest()).toString('hex'), want);
    }
  }
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- DER builder
const len = (n) => (n < 128 ? [n] : n < 256 ? [0x81, n] : n < 65536 ? [0x82, n >> 8, n & 255] : [0x83, n >> 16, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255]);
const tlv = (tag, ...parts) => { const body = Buffer.concat(parts.map((p) => Buffer.from(p))); return Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([tag, ...len(body.length)]), body]); };
const seq = (...p) => tlv(0x30, ...p), set = (...p) => tlv(0x31, ...p), ctx0 = (...p) => tlv(0xa0, ...p);
const int = (n) => tlv(2, [n]);
const oct = (b) => tlv(4, b);
const oid = (s) => { const a = s.split('.').map(Number), out = [a[0] * 40 + a[1]]; for (const v of a.slice(2)) { const enc = [v & 0x7f]; for (let x = Math.floor(v / 128); x; x = Math.floor(x / 128)) enc.unshift(0x80 | (x & 0x7f)); out.push(...enc); } return tlv(6, out); };
const NULL = Buffer.from([5, 0]);
const ALG = { md5: '1.2.840.113549.2.5', sha1: '1.3.14.3.2.26', sha256: '2.16.840.1.101.3.4.2.1' };

/** A small PE32 file (headers, two sections, some trailing data). */
function makePe(extra = 0) {
  const f = Buffer.alloc(0x600 + extra);
  f.write('MZ', 0); f.writeUInt32LE(0x80, 0x3c); f.write('PE\0\0', 0x80);
  f.writeUInt16LE(0x14c, 0x84); f.writeUInt16LE(2, 0x86); f.writeUInt16LE(224, 0x94);
  const opt = 0x98; f.writeUInt16LE(0x10b, opt); f.writeUInt32LE(0x1234, opt + 64); f.writeUInt32LE(16, opt + 92);
  for (let i = 0x200; i < f.length; i++) f[i] = (i * 31) & 255;
  return f;
}
/** Sign: the certificate table appended (8-aligned), its directory entry set. Returns the signed file. */
function sign(pe, kind = 'sha256', { key = crypto.generateKeyPairSync('rsa', { modulusLength: 1024 }), attrs = true } = {}) {
  const f = Buffer.from(pe), certOff = (f.length + 7) & ~7;
  const L = peLayout(f);
  const pad = Buffer.alloc(certOff - f.length);
  // image digest: everything but the checksum and the directory entry (the table is not there yet)
  const h = crypto.createHash(kind); h.update(f.subarray(0, L.checksum)); h.update(f.subarray(L.checksum + 4, L.secEntry)); h.update(f.subarray(L.secEntry + 8)); h.update(pad);
  const spcValue = [seq(oid('1.3.6.1.4.1.311.2.1.15'), seq()), seq(seq(oid(ALG[kind]), NULL), oct(h.digest()))];
  const spc = seq(...spcValue), spcBody = Buffer.concat(spcValue);
  const serial = int(0x2a), issuer = seq(set(seq(oid('2.5.4.3'), tlv(0x0c, Buffer.from('Orthros test')))));
  const spki = key.publicKey.export({ type: 'spki', format: 'der' });
  const tbs = seq(ctx0(int(2)), serial, seq(oid('1.2.840.113549.1.1.11'), NULL), issuer, seq(tlv(0x17, Buffer.from('200101000000Z')), tlv(0x17, Buffer.from('400101000000Z'))), issuer, spki);
  const cert = seq(tbs, seq(oid('1.2.840.113549.1.1.11'), NULL), tlv(3, Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0]), crypto.sign('sha256', tbs, key.privateKey)])));
  let signerParts;
  if (attrs) {
    const a = [seq(oid('1.2.840.113549.1.9.3'), set(oid('1.3.6.1.4.1.311.2.1.4'))), seq(oid('1.2.840.113549.1.9.4'), set(oct(crypto.createHash(kind).update(spcBody).digest())))];
    const asSet = set(...a), sig = crypto.sign(kind, asSet, key.privateKey);
    signerParts = [int(1), seq(issuer, serial), seq(oid(ALG[kind]), NULL), tlv(0xa0, ...a), seq(oid('1.2.840.113549.1.1.1'), NULL), oct(sig)];
  } else signerParts = [int(1), seq(issuer, serial), seq(oid(ALG[kind]), NULL), seq(oid('1.2.840.113549.1.1.1'), NULL), oct(crypto.sign(kind, spcBody, key.privateKey))];
  const sd = seq(int(1), set(seq(oid(ALG[kind]), NULL)), seq(oid('1.3.6.1.4.1.311.2.1.4'), ctx0(spc)), ctx0(cert), set(seq(...signerParts)));
  const p7 = seq(oid('1.2.840.113549.1.7.2'), ctx0(sd));
  const wlen = (8 + p7.length + 7) & ~7, win = Buffer.alloc(wlen);
  win.writeUInt32LE(wlen, 0); win.writeUInt16LE(0x200, 4); win.writeUInt16LE(2, 6); p7.copy(win, 8);
  const out = Buffer.concat([f, pad, win]);
  out.writeUInt32LE(certOff, L.secEntry); out.writeUInt32LE(wlen, L.secEntry + 4);
  out.writeUInt32LE(0xbeef, L.checksum); // (the checksum is outside the digest)
  return { file: out, certOff, key };
}

test('signed PE files verify; unsigned and tampered ones do not', () => {
  for (const kind of ['sha256', 'sha1', 'md5']) {
    for (const attrs of [true, false]) {
      for (const extra of [0, 3]) {
        const { file, certOff } = sign(makePe(extra), kind, { attrs });
        assert.equal(verifyAuthenticode(new Uint8Array(file)).status, 0, `${kind} attrs ${attrs} extra ${extra}`);
        // the checksum changed after signing: still valid
        const c = Buffer.from(file); c.writeUInt32LE(0x55, peLayout(c).checksum); assert.equal(verifyAuthenticode(new Uint8Array(c)).status, 0);
        // a byte of a section changed: bad digest
        const t = Buffer.from(file); t[0x300] ^= 1; assert.equal(verifyAuthenticode(new Uint8Array(t)).status, TRUST_E_BAD_DIGEST);
        // a header byte changed
        const t2 = Buffer.from(file); t2[0x40] ^= 1; assert.equal(verifyAuthenticode(new Uint8Array(t2)).status, TRUST_E_BAD_DIGEST);
        // the signature itself changed (its last byte)
        const t3 = Buffer.from(file); const p7len = t3.readUInt32LE(certOff); let last = certOff + p7len - 1; while (t3[last] === 0) last--; t3[last] ^= 1;
        assert.notEqual(verifyAuthenticode(new Uint8Array(t3)).status, 0);
        // the table cut off by the end of the file
        assert.equal(verifyAuthenticode(new Uint8Array(file.subarray(0, file.length - 8))).status, TRUST_E_NOSIGNATURE);
      }
    }
  }
});

test('a signature by another key than the certificate\'s fails', () => {
  const { file } = sign(makePe(), 'sha256');
  const other = sign(makePe(), 'sha256');
  // the encrypted digest (the signer info's last 128 bytes, 1024-bit keys) replaced by the other key's: the image and
  // attribute digests still match, the RSA signature no longer verifies with the certificate's key
  const a = Buffer.from(file), b = other.file, end = (f) => { let e = f.length; while (f[e - 1] === 0) e--; return e; };
  a.set(b.subarray(end(b) - 128, end(b)), end(a) - 128);
  assert.equal(verifyAuthenticode(new Uint8Array(a)).why, 'signature does not verify');
});

test('files without a signature, and files that are not PE', () => {
  assert.equal(verifyAuthenticode(new Uint8Array(makePe())).status, TRUST_E_NOSIGNATURE);
  assert.equal(verifyAuthenticode(new Uint8Array(Buffer.from('hello world, not a PE file at all.......................................'))).status, TRUST_E_SUBJECT_FORM_UNKNOWN);
});

test('answered from the headers alone when there is no readable certificate table', () => {
  const pe = makePe(), { file } = sign(makePe(), 'sha256');
  assert.equal(verifyAuthenticode(new Uint8Array(pe).subarray(0, 0x200), pe.length).status, TRUST_E_NOSIGNATURE);
  // the table announced past the end of the file (an executable cut after signing)
  assert.equal(verifyAuthenticode(new Uint8Array(file).subarray(0, 0x200), file.length - 64).why, 'certificate table past the end of the file');
});

test('truncated or malformed headers and corrupted signatures are answered, never thrown (the guest\'s call must return)', () => {
  let seed = 11; const rnd = (n) => ((seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0) >>> 8) % n;
  const { file, certOff } = sign(makePe(), 'sha256');
  // the file cut at every length through its headers (e_lfanew 0x80; the security directory entry ends at 0x120)
  for (let n = 0; n <= 0x140; n++) { const r = verifyAuthenticode(new Uint8Array(file.subarray(0, n))); assert.equal(typeof r.status, 'number', `cut at ${n}`); }
  for (let n = 0x40; n <= 0x140; n++) assert.equal(typeof verifyAuthenticode(new Uint8Array(file.subarray(0, n)), file.length).status, 'number', `headers cut at ${n}`);
  // e_lfanew anywhere (past the end, near it), random bytes after it
  for (let i = 0; i < 3000; i++) {
    const n = 64 + rnd(400), f = new Uint8Array(n); for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) f[j] = rnd(256);
    f[0] = 0x4d; f[1] = 0x5a; const pe = rnd(n + 8); f[0x3c] = pe & 255; f[0x3d] = pe >> 8; f[0x3e] = 0; f[0x3f] = 0;
    if (pe + 4 <= n) f.set([0x50, 0x45, 0, 0], pe);
    assert.equal(typeof verifyAuthenticode(f).status, 'number'); assert.equal(typeof verifyAuthenticode(f, 1 << 20).status, 'number');
  }
  // random bytes of the certificate table changed: answered, and never 'signed'
  for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
    const t = new Uint8Array(file); for (let k = 1 + rnd(4); k > 0; k--) { const o = certOff + 8 + rnd(t.length - certOff - 8); t[o] ^= 1 + rnd(255); }
    const r = verifyAuthenticode(t); assert.equal(typeof r.status, 'number');
  }
});

```

```js
// The real-machine measurement kit (docs/real-machine-bench.md): the frame-time histogram, the scenario language and
// its player (src/host/scenario.js), the telemetry summaries (src/host/perf-summary.js), the GPU / GL call probe
// (src/gfx/gpu-probe.js) and the bench definitions of tools/scenarios/bench.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

const rng = (seed) => () => { seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; return seed / 2 ** 32; };

test('histogram buckets: contiguous, increasing, every duration inside its bucket', () => {
  let prevUpper = 0;
  for (let b = 0; b < HIST_N - 1; b++) { const u = histUpper(b); assert.ok(u > prevUpper, `bucket ${b}`); prevUpper = u; }
  assert.equal(histUpper(HIST_N - 1), Infinity);
  const r = rng(7);
  for (let i = 0; i < 20000; i++) {
    const ms = r() < 0.5 ? r() * 120 : r() * 8000;
    const b = histBucket(ms);
    assert.ok(b >= 0 && b < HIST_N);
    assert.ok(ms < histUpper(b) || b === HIST_N - 1, `${ms} in ${b}`);
    if (b > 0) assert.ok(ms >= histUpper(b - 1), `${ms} above bucket ${b - 1}`);
  }
  assert.equal(histBucket(0), 0); assert.equal(histBucket(-3), 0); assert.equal(histBucket(NaN), 0);
  assert.equal(histBucket(33.4), 33); assert.equal(histBucket(100), 100); assert.equal(histBucket(299.9), 139); assert.equal(histBucket(300), 140); assert.equal(histBucket(1e6), HIST_N - 1);
});

test('histogram quantiles match the sorted durations to the bucket width', () => {
  const r = rng(11);
  for (let trial = 0; trial < 200; trial++) {
    const n = 1 + Math.floor(r() * 3000), dts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) dts.push(r() < 0.9 ? 10 + r() * 30 : 30 + r() * (r() < 0.5 ? 200 : 3000));
    const h = new Array(HIST_N).fill(0); for (const d of dts) h[histBucket(d)]++;
    const sorted = [...dts].sort((a, b) => a - b), max = sorted[n - 1];
    for (const q of [0.5, 0.9, 0.99, 1]) {
      const exact = sorted[Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor(q * n))], got = histQuantile(h, q, max);
      const b = histBucket(exact);
      assert.ok(got >= exact - 1e-9 && got <= Math.min(histUpper(b), max), `q ${q}: ${got} for ${exact}`);
    }
    // (sparse round trip)
    assert.deepEqual(histAddSparse(new Array(HIST_N).fill(0), histSparse(h)), h);
  }
  assert.equal(histQuantile(new Array(HIST_N).fill(0), 0.5), null);
});

test('FrameStats intervals carry the slow counts and the frame-time histogram', () => {
  const fs_ = new FrameStats(1000), cats = new Float64Array(N_CATS);
  const dts = [10, 20, 33.4, 33.5, 39, 41, 50, 51, 99, 101, 250];
  for (const dt of dts) { cats.fill(0); cats[C.guest] = dt; fs_.add(dt, cats, 0); }
  const iv = fs_.takeInterval();
  assert.equal(iv.frames, dts.length);
  assert.equal(iv.s33, dts.filter((d) => d > 33.4).length);
  assert.equal(iv.s40, dts.filter((d) => d > 40).length);
  assert.equal(iv.s50, dts.filter((d) => d > 50).length);
  assert.equal(iv.s100, dts.filter((d) => d > 100).length);
  const h = histAddSparse(new Array(HIST_N).fill(0), iv.h);
  assert.equal(h.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), dts.length);
  for (const d of dts) assert.ok(h[histBucket(d)] > 0);
  assert.equal(fs_.takeInterval(), null);
});

test('scenario parsing: the harness form, new lines, comments, anchors and relative times', () => {
  const { steps, errors } = parseScenario('# a comment\n+3:key:27;+6:key:27\n10:waitframe:10,30,150,100000;0:mark:menu\n8:click:216,555;9:text:Or:thros;12:waitfps:15;0:mark:play;30:keydown:87;31.2:keyup:87');

  assert.deepEqual(steps[2].args, [10, 30, 150, 100000]);

  assert.deepEqual(unsupportedSteps(parseScenario('1:waitpixel:1,2,3,4,5;2:dbg:X=1;3:click:1,2;4:shot').steps).map((s) => s.kind), ['waitpixel', 'dbg']);
  assert.ok(inRanges(20, [10, 30, 150, 1e5]) && inRanges(200, [10, 30, 150, 1e5]) && !inRanges(60, [10, 30, 150, 1e5]) && !inRanges(-1, [1, 100]));

/** Drive a player: stats every 0.5 s from `statsAt(t)`, ticks every 0.1 s; the actions with their times. */
function play(player, statsAt, until) {
  const out = []; let stats = null, seq = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= until * 10; i++) {
    const t = i / 10;
    if (i % 5 === 0) { const s = statsAt(t); stats = s ? { ...s, seq: ++seq, dt: 0.5 } : null; }
    for (const a of player.tick(t, stats)) out.push({ ...a, t });
  }
  return out;
}

test('player: absolute times, +N from the first Direct3D frame, waits hold the steps after them', () => {
  const { steps } = parseScenario('2:move:1,1;+1:key:27;5:waitfps:20;0:mark:play;2:click:10,10');
  const p = new ScenarioPlayer(steps);
  // Direct3D frames from t = 4; fps above 20 from t = 10
  const acts = play(p, (t) => ({ fps: t >= 10 ? 30 : 5, d3d: t >= 4 ? { frames: Math.round((t - 4) * 30), draws: 0 } : null }), 30);
  const at = (k) => acts.find((a) => a.kind === k)?.t;
  assert.equal(at('move'), 2);
  assert.equal(at('key'), 5.5); // (the first frame is seen in the 4.5 s sample)
  const anchor = at('waitfps');
  assert.ok(anchor >= 12.5 && anchor <= 13, `waitfps anchor ${anchor}`); // 3 s of samples above 20 from t = 10
  assert.equal(at('mark'), anchor); assert.ok(Math.abs(at('click') - (anchor + 2)) < 1e-9);
  assert.ok(p.done); assert.equal(p.phase, 'play');
  assert.deepEqual(acts.find((a) => a.kind === 'key').args, [27]);
});

test('player: waitframe checks once a second, needs new frames and 3 checks in range', () => {
  const { steps } = parseScenario('0:waitframe:10,30,150,1000;0:mark:menu');
  const p = new ScenarioPlayer(steps);
  // 20 draws per frame from t = 5, but no new frame between t = 6 and t = 9 (a slow screen)
  let frames = 0, draws = 0, last = -1;
  const acts = play(p, (t) => { if (t >= 5 && !(t >= 6 && t < 9) && t !== last) { frames += 15; draws += 300; last = t; } return { fps: 30, d3d: { frames, draws } }; }, 20);
  const m = acts.find((a) => a.kind === 'waitframe');
  assert.ok(m, 'waitframe satisfied');
  // checks at 5 (20 draws/frame: 1), 6 (2), 7 and 8 (no new frame: the count holds, as in the harness), 9 (3)
  assert.equal(m.t, 9);
  assert.equal(m.dpf, 20);
  // out of range: never satisfied
  const q = new ScenarioPlayer(parseScenario('0:waitframe:40,100').steps);
  let f = 0; assert.equal(play(q, () => ({ d3d: { frames: (f += 10), draws: f * 20 } }), 20).length, 0);
  assert.equal(q.waiting.kind, 'waitframe');
});

test('player: pointer coordinates scaled from the scenario space to the display', () => {
  const { steps } = parseScenario('0:click:216,555;0:move:799,599;0:key:65;0:down:0,0');

  const p = new ScenarioPlayer(steps, { from: [800, 600], display: () => display });
  const acts = p.tick(0, null);
  assert.deepEqual(acts.map((a) => a.args), [[276, 710], [1023, 767], [65], [0, 0]]);
  display = [800, 600];
  const p2 = new ScenarioPlayer(steps, { from: [800, 600], display: () => display });
  assert.deepEqual(p2.tick(0, null)[0].args, [216, 555]);
});

/** a stats message as the worker posts it */
function statsMsg({ dts = [], d3d = null, gl = null, render = 'worker' } = {}) {
  const fs_ = new FrameStats(100), cats = new Float64Array(N_CATS);
  for (const dt of dts) { cats.fill(0); cats[C.guest] = dt * 0.6; cats[C.sleep] = dt * 0.4; fs_.add(dt, cats); }
  return { dt: 0.5, fps: dts.length * 2, busy: 50, mips: 100, acct: fs_.takeInterval(), d3d, gl, render };
}

test('PerfWindow: percentiles, slow-frame rates, categories and counter differences', () => {
  const w = new PerfWindow();
  const r = rng(3), all = [];
  let d3dFrames = 100, draws = 1000;
  const gpu = { state: 'on', frames: 0, ms: 0, max: 0, over16: 0, over33: 0, disjoint: 0, lost: 0, hist: new Array(HIST_N).fill(0) };
  const glc = { state: 'on', frames: 0, calls: 0, draws: 0 };
  const g = { gpuWaitMs: 0, fenceMs: 0, frameMs: 0, replayMs: 0, readbackMs: 0 };
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const dts = []; for (let k = 0; k < 15; k++) { const d = r() < 0.95 ? 30 + r() * 5 : 60 + r() * 80; dts.push(d); all.push(d); }
    d3dFrames += 15; draws += 15 * 300;
    for (let k = 0; k < 15; k++) { const ms = 5 + r() * 10; gpu.frames++; gpu.ms += ms; gpu.hist[histBucket(ms)]++; if (ms > gpu.max) gpu.max = ms; }
    if (i === 10) { glc.frames += 30; glc.calls += 30 * 2500; glc.draws += 30 * 300; }
    g.gpuWaitMs += 15 * 2; g.replayMs += 15 * 4;
    w.add(statsMsg({ dts, d3d: { frames: d3dFrames, draws, gpu: structuredClone(gpu), glCalls: { ...glc } }, gl: { ...g } }), { t: 1000 + i * 500, visible: true });
  }
  const s = w.take();
  const sorted = [...all].sort((a, b) => a - b), n = all.length;
  assert.equal(s.frames, n); assert.equal(s.seconds, 20); assert.equal(s.fps, n / 20);
  assert.equal(s.s33, all.filter((d) => d > 33.4).length); assert.equal(s.s100, all.filter((d) => d > 100).length);
  for (const [q, k] of [[0.5, 'p50'], [0.9, 'p90'], [0.99, 'p99']]) { const exact = sorted[Math.floor(q * n)]; assert.ok(s.dt[k] >= exact && s.dt[k] <= exact + 5, `${k} ${s.dt[k]} vs ${exact}`); }
  assert.equal(s.dt.max, Math.round(sorted[n - 1]));
  // the first message is the base of the counters: its own draws and GPU frames are not in the window
  assert.equal(s.d3dFrames, 39 * 15); assert.equal(s.drawsPerFrame, 300);
  assert.equal(s.gpu.state, 'on'); assert.equal(s.gpu.frames, 39 * 15); assert.ok(s.gpu.p50 >= 5 && s.gpu.p50 <= 16 && s.gpu.p99 <= 16);
  assert.deepEqual(s.glCalls, { frames: 30, perFrame: 2500, drawsPerFrame: 300 });
  assert.ok(Math.abs(s.render.waitMs - 39 * 15 * 2 / n) < 0.01);
  assert.ok(s.cats.guest > 0 && s.cats.sleep > 0 && s.work > 0);
  assert.equal(s.renderMode, 'worker'); assert.equal(s.visible, 1);
  // the next window starts from this one's counters; a counter that restarted (new device) counts from zero
  w.add(statsMsg({ dts: [30, 31], d3d: { frames: 4, draws: 40, gpu: { state: 'unavailable' }, glCalls: { state: 'unavailable' } } }));
  const s2 = w.take();
  assert.equal(s2.d3dFrames, 4); assert.equal(s2.drawsPerFrame, 10); assert.deepEqual(s2.gpu, { state: 'unavailable' }); assert.deepEqual(s2.glCalls, { state: 'unavailable' });
  assert.equal(w.take(), null);
});

test('SummaryClock: one summary every 20 s of samples, capped', () => {
  const c = new SummaryClock(20000, 3);
  let got = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 400; i++) if (c.add(statsMsg({ dts: [33, 33] }))) got++;
  assert.equal(got, 3); // (400 samples = 200 s = 10 periods, 3 sent)
  const d = new SummaryClock(20000, 100); let first = -1;

/** a WebGL2 context double with the timer query extension (results available `lag` presents later) */
function fakeTimerGl({ lag = 2, ext = true, nsOf = () => 8e6 } = {}) {
  const st = { calls: 0, frame: 0, disjoint: false, queries: [], active: null };
  class Ctx {
    getExtension(n) { return ext && n === 'EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2' ? { TIME_ELAPSED_EXT: 0x88bf, GPU_DISJOINT_EXT: 0x8fbb } : null; }
    createQuery() { const q = { id: st.queries.length }; st.queries.push(q); return q; }
    beginQuery(t, q) { assert.equal(st.active, null); st.active = q; q.begin = st.frame; }
    endQuery() { st.active.end = st.frame; st.active.ns = nsOf(st.active.id); st.active = null; }
    deleteQuery(q) { q.deleted = true; }
    getParameter(p) { if (p === 0x8fbb) { const d = st.disjoint; st.disjoint = false; return d; } return 0; }
    getQueryParameter(q, p) { if (p === this.QUERY_RESULT_AVAILABLE) return st.frame - q.end >= lag; return q.ns; }
    drawElements() { st.calls++; }
    uniform4fv() { st.calls++; }
  }
  Ctx.prototype.QUERY_RESULT_AVAILABLE = 0x8867; Ctx.prototype.QUERY_RESULT = 0x8866;
  return { gl: new Ctx(), st };
}

test('GPU probe: timed windows, results read when available, disjoint results dropped', () => {
  let now = 0;
  const { gl, st } = fakeTimerGl({ nsOf: (id) => (id % 10 === 0 ? 40e6 : 8e6) });
  const p = new GpuProbe(gl, { now: () => now, wrapGl: false });
  assert.equal(p.stats.gpu.state, 'on'); assert.equal(p.stats.glCalls.state, 'unavailable');
  const frame = () => { st.frame++; p.frame(); now += 16; };
  while (now < 3000 + 60 * 16) frame(); // (the first window opens at 3 s)
  assert.ok(p.cur && p.pending.length > 0 && p.pending.length <= 3, 'in flight: the current frame and the ones not yet available');
  while (now < 3000 + (WINDOW_FRAMES + 10) * 16) frame();
  assert.equal(p.stats.gpu.frames, WINDOW_FRAMES); assert.equal(p.pending.length, 0); assert.equal(p.cur, null);
  assert.equal(p.stats.gpu.over33, WINDOW_FRAMES / 10); assert.ok(Math.abs(p.stats.gpu.ms - (WINDOW_FRAMES * 0.9 * 8 + WINDOW_FRAMES * 0.1 * 40)) < 1e-6);
  assert.equal(histQuantile(p.stats.gpu.hist, 0.5), 9); assert.equal(Math.round(p.stats.gpu.max), 40);
  assert.ok(st.queries.every((q) => q.deleted || q === p.cur));
  // the next window comes PERIOD_MS later; a disjoint operation drops what was in flight
  while (now < 3000 + PERIOD_MS + 100) frame();
  assert.ok(p.pending.length > 0);
  const inFlight = p.pending.length; st.disjoint = true; frame();
  assert.ok(p.stats.gpu.disjoint >= inFlight);
  // without the extension: unavailable, no query ever made
  const plain = fakeTimerGl({ ext: false }); const q = new GpuProbe(plain.gl, { now: () => now, wrapGl: false });
  for (let i = 0; i < 400; i++) { now += 16; q.frame(); }
  assert.equal(q.stats.gpu.state, 'unavailable'); assert.equal(plain.st.queries.length, 0);
});

test('GPU probe: a GPU far behind leaves frames untimed rather than piling queries', () => {
  let now = 5000;
  const { gl, st } = fakeTimerGl({ lag: 1e9 });
  const p = new GpuProbe(gl, { now: () => now, wrapGl: false });
  for (let i = 0; i < 400; i++) { st.frame++; p.frame(); now += 16; } // (a window from 8 s)
  assert.ok(p.pending.length <= 16); assert.ok(p.stats.gpu.lost > 0); assert.equal(p.stats.gpu.frames, 0);
  // a result that never comes is given up after 240 presents: the queries after it are read again
  const lost = p.stats.gpu.lost;
  for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) { st.frame++; p.frame(); now += 16; }
  assert.ok(p.stats.gpu.lost >= lost + 16 && p.pending.length === 0, `lost ${p.stats.gpu.lost}, pending ${p.pending.length}`);
  p.reset(); assert.equal(p.pending.length, 0);
});

test('GL call counter: windows of GL_FRAMES frames every GL_PERIOD_MS, unwrapped after, away while busy', () => {
  let now = 0;
  const { gl, st } = fakeTimerGl({ ext: false });
  const p = new GpuProbe(gl, { now: () => now, wrapGl: true });
  const frame = (calls) => { for (let i = 0; i < calls; i++) { gl.uniform4fv(); if (i % 10 === 0) gl.drawElements(); } p.frame(); now += 20; };
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(gl), orig = proto.uniform4fv;
  while (now <= 5000) frame(50);
  assert.notEqual(proto.uniform4fv, orig, 'wrapped during the window');
  assert.ok(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(gl, 'uniform4fv'), 'never an own property of the context (V8 dictionary mode)');
  for (let i = 0; i < GL_FRAMES; i++) frame(50);
  assert.equal(proto.uniform4fv, orig, 'unwrapped after'); assert.deepEqual(Object.getOwnPropertyNames(gl), []);
  assert.equal(p.stats.glCalls.frames, GL_FRAMES); assert.equal(p.stats.glCalls.calls / GL_FRAMES, 55); assert.equal(p.stats.glCalls.draws / GL_FRAMES, 5);
  assert.ok(st.calls > 0);
  // busy (a capture or GL timing wraps methods itself): the window is dropped and no new one starts
  while (now < 5000 + GL_PERIOD_MS + 50) frame(5);
  assert.ok(p.glWrapped);
  p.busy = true; assert.ok(!p.glWrapped); assert.equal(proto.uniform4fv, orig);
  for (let i = 0; i < 2000; i++) frame(1);
  assert.equal(p.stats.glCalls.frames, GL_FRAMES);
});

test('GL call counter: contexts sharing a prototype count their own calls; the methods come back in any stop order', () => {
  let now = 0;
  const a = fakeTimerGl({ ext: false }), proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(a.gl);
  const b = { gl: new a.gl.constructor() }, origU = proto.uniform4fv, origD = proto.drawElements;
  const pa = new GpuProbe(a.gl, { now: () => now, wrapGl: true }), pb = new GpuProbe(b.gl, { now: () => now, wrapGl: true });
  for (const [first, second] of [[pa, pb], [pb, pa]]) {
    now += GL_PERIOD_MS + 5000;
    pa.frame(); pb.frame();
    assert.ok(pa.glWrapped && pb.glWrapped);
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) a.gl.uniform4fv(); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) b.gl.drawElements();
    assert.equal(pa.glCount, 7); assert.equal(pa.glDraws, 0); assert.equal(pb.glCount, 3); assert.equal(pb.glDraws, 3);
    first.busy = true; first.busy = false;
    assert.notEqual(proto.uniform4fv, origU, 'still counting for the other context');
    b.gl.drawElements(); a.gl.uniform4fv();
    assert.equal((second === pa ? pa : pb).glCount, second === pa ? 8 : 4);
    for (let i = 0; i < GL_FRAMES; i++) second.frame();
    assert.equal(proto.uniform4fv, origU); assert.equal(proto.drawElements, origD);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.getOwnPropertyNames(a.gl), []); assert.deepEqual(Object.getOwnPropertyNames(b.gl), []);
  }
});
```

```js
// (src/host/scenario.js), the suite's definitions (tools/scenarios/bench/index.json), the frames of a port's page
// measured from outside it (src/host/web/page-meter.js), the scripted DOM input (dom-input.js), the virtual keys as DOM
// keys (src/win32/vk-scan.js), the suite's addresses and records (bench-suite.js), and its report
// (tools/telemetry-report.mjs --suite).

/** Drive a player: stats every 0.5 s from `statsAt(t)`, ticks every 0.1 s; the actions with their times. */
function play(player, statsAt, until) {
  const out = []; let stats = null, seq = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= until * 10; i++) {
    const t = i / 10;
    if (i % 5 === 0) { const s = statsAt(t); stats = s ? { ...s, seq: ++seq, dt: 0.5 } : null; }
    for (const a of player.tick(t, stats)) out.push({ ...a, t });
  }
  return out;
}

test('nudge: its key pressed every N s while the next wait holds, none once the wait is satisfied', () => {
  const { steps, errors } = parseScenario('0:mark:menu\n2:nudge:32,3\n2:waitframe:80,100000\n0:mark:city\n5:key:13\n6:waitfps:1000');
  assert.deepEqual(errors, []);
  // (frames from the start: 10 draws a frame until 20 s, then 100)
  let frames = 0, draws = 0;
  const acts = play(new ScenarioPlayer(steps), (t) => { frames += 30; draws += 30 * (t < 20 ? 10 : 100); return { fps: 60, d3d: { frames, draws } }; }, 40);
  const nudges = acts.filter((a) => a.kind === 'key' && a.args[0] === 32).map((a) => a.t);
  const anchor = acts.find((a) => a.kind === 'waitframe').t;
  assert.ok(anchor > 20 && anchor < 24, `anchor ${anchor}`);
  assert.equal(nudges[0], 2); // (at once: the wait holds from the start)
  for (let i = 1; i < nudges.length; i++) assert.ok(Math.abs(nudges[i] - nudges[i - 1] - 3) < 0.11, `every 3 s: ${nudges}`);
  assert.ok(nudges.every((t) => t < anchor) && nudges.length >= 6, `${nudges} before ${anchor}`);
  assert.ok(acts.some((a) => a.kind === 'key' && a.args[0] === 13 && Math.abs(a.t - anchor - 5) < 0.11), 'the steps after the wait still run');
  // (a nudge needs a key and a period)
  assert.ok(parseScenario('0:nudge:32').errors.length && parseScenario('0:nudge:32,0').errors.length);
});

  for (const k of PLAYER_KINDS) assert.ok(PORT_KINDS.has(k), k);
});

/** A port's window, enough for the meter: WebGL prototypes, frames driven by hand, a canvas, hooks. */
function fakeWindow() {
  let now = 0;
  const cbs = [];
  class WebGL2RenderingContext { constructor() { this.enabled = new Set(); this.ext = null; } drawArrays() {} drawElements() {} enable(c) { this.enabled.add(c); } disable(c) { this.enabled.delete(c); } getExtension(n) { return n === 'WEBGL_debug_renderer_info' ? { UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL: 1 } : null; } getParameter(k) { return k === 1 ? 'Test GPU' : null; } isContextLost() { return false; } }
  const W = {
    WebGL2RenderingContext, performance: { now: () => now },
    requestAnimationFrame: (cb) => { cbs.push(cb); return cbs.length; },
    setInterval: () => 1, clearInterval: () => {},
    orthrosBenchHooks: null,
    /** One browser frame at time t: the callbacks asked for before it, each with t. */
    frame(t, during) { now = t; const run = cbs.splice(0); for (const cb of run) cb(t); during?.(); },
    set now(v) { now = v; }, get now() { return now; },
  };
  return W;
}

test('page meter: a frame is a browser frame the engine drew in; its work, its data waits, the phase report', () => {
  const W = fakeWindow();
  let waited = 0;
  W.orthrosBenchHooks = { data: () => ({ waits: 1, waitMs: waited, bytes: 10 }) };
  const m = new PageMeter(W); m.install();
  const gl = new W.WebGL2RenderingContext();
  // (the engine's loop: in each frame it asks for the next one after 10 ms of work and draws 5 times; every 4th
  // browser frame it skips — no draw: not a frame; at frame 20 it waited 30 ms for its data)
  const engine = (t) => { W.requestAnimationFrame(engine); };
  W.requestAnimationFrame(engine);
  let t = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
    t += 1000 / 60;
    W.frame(t, () => {
      if (i % 4 === 3) return;
      if (i === 20) waited += 30;
      for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) gl.drawArrays();
      W.now = t + 10; W.requestAnimationFrame(() => {}); // (its request for the next frame, at the end of its work)
    });
  }
  assert.equal(m.renderer, 'Test GPU');
  assert.ok(m.frames >= 89 && m.frames <= 91, `frames ${m.frames}`);
  assert.equal(m.draws, 450);
  const fr = m.frames;
  const first = m.emit();
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { t += 1000 / 60; W.frame(t, () => { for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) gl.drawArrays(); }); }
  const s = m.emit();
  assert.equal(s.d3d.frames, m.frames); assert.equal(s.d3d.draws, m.framesDraws);
  assert.equal(s.d3d.gpu.state, 'unavailable'); // (a context without TIME_ELAPSED queries)
  assert.deepEqual(s.data, { waits: 1, waitMs: 30, bytes: 10 });
  assert.equal(s.d3d.frames - first.d3d.frames, 5); // (a frame counted at the next browser frame: the last one still to come)
  const ph = compactPhase(m.phase('play'));
  assert.equal(ph.label, 'start');
  // (shown frames: 3 of 4 browser frames — gaps of 16.7 ms and every third one 33.3 ms)
  assert.ok(Math.abs(ph.dt.p50 - 16.7) < 0.2 && Math.abs(ph.dt.max - 33) <= 1, JSON.stringify(ph.dt));
  assert.ok(Math.abs(ph.work.p50 - 10) < 0.2, `work ${JSON.stringify(ph.work)}`); // (10 ms each, the 30 ms wait within the frame's work)
  assert.equal(ph.slow40, 0);
  assert.ok(ph.mean.ioWait > 0, JSON.stringify(ph.mean));
  // (the stats message feeds the summaries as the Win32 worker's does)
  const w = new PerfWindow(); w.add(first); w.add(s); const sum = w.take();
  assert.ok(sum.frames > 0 && sum.drawsPerFrame === 5, JSON.stringify(sum));
});

test('page meter: a port\'s own count of its engine\'s work (hooks.workMs) wins over the animation frames\' measure', () => {
  const W = fakeWindow();
  let work = 0;
  W.orthrosBenchHooks = { workMs: () => work };

  const ph = compactPhase(m.phase('x'));
  assert.ok(Math.abs(ph.work.p50 - 7) < 0.2, JSON.stringify(ph.work));
});

test('virtual keys as DOM keys, and back', () => {

/** A window that records the events dispatched to its canvas, with the DOM's event constructors' shape. */
function eventWindow() {
  const events = [];
  class Ev { constructor(type, init) { Object.assign(this, init); this.type = type; } }
  const canvas = { getBoundingClientRect: () => ({ left: 10, top: 50 }), dispatchEvent: (e) => { events.push(e); return true; } };
  const W = { KeyboardEvent: Ev, MouseEvent: Ev, PointerEvent: Ev, document: { querySelector: () => canvas, body: canvas }, orthrosBenchHooks: null };
  return { W, events };
}

test('DOM input: keys with their code and keyCode (a keypress for a character), clicks at the canvas\' place, the port\'s console and teleport', async () => {
  const { W, events } = eventWindow();
  const tele = [], cmds = [];
  W.orthrosBenchHooks = { command: (c) => cmds.push(c), teleport: (x, y, z) => tele.push([x, y, z]) };
  const inp = domInput(() => W);
  inp.key(0x57, 0, true); inp.key(0x57, 0, true); inp.key(0x57, 0, false);
  assert.deepEqual(events.map((e) => [e.type, e.code, e.keyCode, !!e.repeat]), [['keydown', 'KeyW', 87, false], ['keypress', 'KeyW', 87, false], ['keydown', 'KeyW', 87, true], ['keypress', 'KeyW', 87, false], ['keyup', 'KeyW', 87, false]]);
  events.length = 0;
  inp.button(1, true, 100, 200); inp.button(1, false, 100, 200);
  const downs = events.filter((e) => e.type === 'mousedown' || e.type === 'mouseup');
  assert.deepEqual(downs.map((e) => [e.type, e.button, e.clientX, e.clientY, e.buttons]), [['mousedown', 2, 110, 250, 2], ['mouseup', 2, 110, 250, 0]]);
  assert.ok(events.some((e) => e.type === 'contextmenu'));
  inp.command('map c1a0'); assert.deepEqual(cmds, ['map c1a0']);
  events.length = 0;
  inp.text('Ab1');
  await sleep(TYPE_GAP_MS * 3 + 200);
  assert.deepEqual(events.filter((e) => e.type === 'keydown').map((e) => e.code), ['KeyA', 'KeyB', 'Digit1']);
  assert.deepEqual(events.filter((e) => e.type === 'keyup').map((e) => e.code), ['KeyA', 'KeyB', 'Digit1']);
  inp.glide([100, 200, 0, 300, 5000]);
  await sleep(150);
  inp.glide([]); const n = tele.length; await sleep(80);
  assert.ok(n >= 2 && tele.length === n, `teleports ${n} then ${tele.length}`);
  assert.ok(tele.every(([x, , z]) => x === 100 && z === 5000) && tele.at(-1)[1] > 200, JSON.stringify(tele.at(-1)));
  inp.key(0x41, 0, true); events.length = 0; inp.release();
  assert.deepEqual(events.map((e) => e.type), ['keyup']);
});

const fetcher = async (u) => {
  const f = new URL(String(u).replace('/tools/scenarios/bench/', ''), BENCH);
  return { ok: fs.existsSync(f), status: 404, json: async () => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')), text: async () => fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8') };
};

test('suite: loaded by name or as a list of benches; the games\' addresses', async () => {
  const all = await loadSuite('all', { fetcher });

  assert.ok(suiteMinutes(all) >= 12 && suiteMinutes(all) <= 20, `${suiteMinutes(all)} minutes`);
  const two = await loadSuite('halflife-c1a0,cs-bots', { fetcher });
  assert.deepEqual(two.items.map((i) => i.def.name), ['halflife-c1a0', 'cs-bots']);
  const fr = await loadSuite('bfme1-108-short', { fetcher, gameLang: 'fr', manifest: 'bfme1-108' });
  assert.equal(fr.items[0].gameLang, 'fr'); assert.equal(fr.items[0].def.manifest, 'bfme1-108');
  await assert.rejects(loadSuite('bfme1-108-short', { fetcher, manifest: 'bfme2' })); // (a version the bench does not play)
  await assert.rejects(loadSuite('nothing', { fetcher }));
  await assert.rejects(loadSuite('halflife-c1a0,nothing', { fetcher }));
  const run = { run: 'r1', name: 'all', index: 1, of: 7 }, pass = new URLSearchParams('gldiscard=1&lang=fr&dbg=X=1');
  const w = new URL(itemUrl(all.items[0], run, { origin: 'https://o.example', pass }));
  assert.equal(w.pathname, '/');
  assert.deepEqual(Object.fromEntries(w.searchParams), { bench: 'bfme1-108-short', manifest: 'bfme1-108', benchauto: '1', gldiscard: '1', dbg: 'X=1', benchrun: 'r1', benchsuitename: 'all', benchindex: '1', benchof: '7', gameLang: 'fr' });
  // (a cold-start suite, ?benchsuite=...&snapshot=0: each game's page starts without a snapshot, main.js snapshotsOn)
  assert.equal(new URL(itemUrl(all.items[0], run, { origin: 'https://o.example', pass: new URLSearchParams('snapshot=0') })).searchParams.get('snapshot'), '0');
  const mw = all.items[4], launch = { launchUrl: '/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-vanilla-plus-fr/', languageLaunchUrls: { en: '/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-vanilla-plus-en/' } };
  const p = new URL(itemUrl(mw, { ...run, index: 5 }, { origin: 'https://o.example', launch, pass }));

  assert.equal(p.searchParams.get('start'), '-2,-9'); assert.equal(p.searchParams.get('src'), 'hosted'); assert.ok(p.searchParams.has('novid'));
  assert.equal(p.searchParams.get('benchrun'), 'r1'); assert.equal(p.searchParams.get('gldiscard'), '1');

  assert.equal(hl.pathname, '/ports/goldsrc/half-life-original-en/');
  assert.throws(() => itemUrl(all.items[5], run, { origin: 'https://o.example', launch: null }));
});

/** A game's bench record as BenchRun makes it. */
const record = (bench, manifest, runtime, outcome, run, index, fps = 30) => ({
  event: 'bench', bench, title: bench, runtime, manifest, outcome, detail: outcome === 'done' ? null : 'why', seconds: 90, renderer: 'ANGLE (Intel, Iris Xe)', suite: { run, name: 'all', index, of: 3 },
  marks: [{ label: 'play', at: 10 }, { label: 'end', at: 70 }],
  phases: [{ label: 'start', seconds: 10, fps: 20 }, { label: 'play', seconds: 60, frames: 60 * fps, fps, dt: { p50: 33.3, p90: 35, p99: 41, max: 90 }, per40: 3, slow40: 3, work: { p50: 12.3456, p90: 20, p99: 30.04 }, gpu: { state: 'on', frames: 240, p50: 8, p99: 15, mean: 9 }, dataWaitMs: 120, drawsPerFrame: 300 }],
  hostTiming: [{ label: 'start', at: 0, atomicsWait1: { p50: 14.2, p90: 15 }, setTimeout1: { p50: 14.9 }, battery: { charging: true, level: 0.8 } }],
```
