`tests/goldsrc-bsp-reads.test.js`:

```js
// A GoldSrc map's load announced (src/ports/goldsrc/bsp-reads.js, docs/browser-ports.md "Map loads announced"): a
// synthetic BSP v30 and WAD3 archives — the lumps, the entities, the textures found in the WADs as the engine finds them,
// the sky, the entities' files, the files beside the map; a map's own textures from a WAD only with r_wadtextures, its
// node graph only when the page runs its server — and the page's hook: a listing's read announces nothing (its .res
// neither), a load's announces its reads once (the WAD lumps as the light copy the archive is read as, from the
// directory parsed when the engine read it), its .res fetched announced and its entries a second list, never reported
// as the engine's reads; the shared WAD3 reader.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { bspLumps, bspTextures, parseEntities, looksLikeEntities, mapReads, resReads, announceMapLoads, configSetting, BSP_HEADER, BSP_LUMPS } from '../src/ports/goldsrc/bsp-reads.js';
import { wadEntries, wadHeader, WAD_MIPTEX } from '../src/vfs/wad3.js';
import { GameData } from '../src/vfs/data-client.js';

const enc = (s) => new TextEncoder().encode(s);
const cat = (parts) => { const n = parts.reduce((a, b) => a + b.length, 0), out = new Uint8Array(n); let at = 0; for (const p of parts) { out.set(p, at); at += p.length; } return out; };

/** A WAD3: lumps [name, type, bytes] in order, then the directory. Returns { bytes, at: name → { pos, disk } }. */
function wad3(lumps) {
  const parts = [new Uint8Array(12)], dir = new Uint8Array(lumps.length * 32), dv = new DataView(dir.buffer), at = {};
  let pos = 12;
  lumps.forEach(([name, type, b], i) => {
    dv.setInt32(i * 32, pos, true); dv.setInt32(i * 32 + 4, b.length, true); dv.setInt32(i * 32 + 8, b.length, true); dir[i * 32 + 12] = type;
    dir.set(enc(name).subarray(0, 15), i * 32 + 16);
    at[name.toLowerCase()] = { pos, disk: b.length };
    parts.push(b); pos += b.length;
  });
  const head = parts[0], hv = new DataView(head.buffer);
  head.set(enc('WAD3')); hv.setInt32(4, lumps.length, true); hv.setInt32(8, pos, true);
  return { bytes: cat([...parts, dir]), at };
}
/** A miptex: its 40-byte head (name, size, level offsets: 0 when its pixels are elsewhere), then `pixels` bytes. */
function miptex(name, pixels = 0) {
  const b = new Uint8Array(40 + pixels), v = new DataView(b.buffer);
  b.set(enc(name).subarray(0, 15)); v.setUint32(16, 16, true); v.setUint32(20, 16, true);
  if (pixels) v.setUint32(24, 40, true);
  return b;
}
/** A v30 BSP: lump 0 the entities' text (lump 1 with `swap`), lump 2 the textures (names; '+name' embedded; null: -1). */
function bsp(entities, textures, { swap = false, filler = 4096 } = {}) {
  const ents = enc(entities + '\0');
  const heads = textures.map((t) => (t === null ? null : t.startsWith('+') ? miptex(t.slice(1), 256) : miptex(t)));
  const offs = [], body = []; let o = 4 + textures.length * 4;
  for (const h of heads) { offs.push(h ? o : -1); if (h) { body.push(h); o += h.length; } }
  const tl = new Uint8Array(4 + textures.length * 4), tv = new DataView(tl.buffer);
  tv.setInt32(0, textures.length, true); offs.forEach((x, i) => tv.setInt32(4 + i * 4, x, true));
  const texLump = cat([tl, ...body]), planes = new Uint8Array(filler).fill(3);
  const lumps = Array.from({ length: BSP_LUMPS }, () => new Uint8Array(0));
  lumps[swap ? 1 : 0] = ents; lumps[swap ? 0 : 1] = planes; lumps[2] = texLump; lumps[3] = new Uint8Array(filler).fill(9);
  const head = new Uint8Array(BSP_HEADER), hv = new DataView(head.buffer); hv.setInt32(0, 30, true);
  let at = BSP_HEADER;
  lumps.forEach((l, i) => { hv.setInt32(4 + i * 8, at, true); hv.setInt32(8 + i * 8, l.length, true); at += l.length; });
  return cat([head, ...lumps]);
}

const ENTITIES = `{
"classname" "worldspawn"
"wad" "\\quiver\\valve\\halflife.wad;c:\\maps\\Other.WAD;\\gone\\nothere.wad"
"skyname" "night"
}
// a comment
{ "classname" "env_sprite" "model" "sprites/glow.spr" }
{ "classname" "func_door" "model" "*3" }
{ "classname" "cycler" "model" "models\\Thing.mdl" }
{ "classname" "ambient_generic" "message" "ambience/wind.wav" }
{ "classname" "ambient_generic" "message" "!SENTENCE_1" }
{ "classname" "trigger_once" "message" "not/a/sound.wav" }
{ "classname" "info_target" "model" "models/missing.mdl" }`;

test('a v30 BSP\'s lumps, entities (either of the first two lumps) and textures, read as the engine reads them', () => {
  const b = bsp(ENTITIES, ['Wall1', '+emb1', null, 'wall1', 'gone']);
  const lumps = bspLumps(b, b.length);
  assert.equal(lumps.length, BSP_LUMPS);
  assert.equal(bspLumps(b, lumps[3].off + lumps[3].len - 1), null, 'a lump past the file\'s end');
  const v = b.slice(); v[0] = 29; assert.equal(bspLumps(v, v.length), null, 'not v30');
  const ents = parseEntities(new TextDecoder('latin1').decode(b.subarray(lumps[0].off, lumps[0].off + lumps[0].len)));
  assert.equal(ents.length, 8);
  assert.equal(ents[0].wad.split(';').length, 3); assert.equal(ents[0].skyname, 'night'); assert.equal(ents[3].model, 'models\\Thing.mdl');
  assert.deepEqual(bspTextures(b.subarray(lumps[2].off, lumps[2].off + lumps[2].len)), [{ name: 'wall1', external: true }, { name: 'emb1', external: false }, { name: 'gone', external: true }]);
  const s = bsp(ENTITIES, ['wall1'], { swap: true }), sl = bspLumps(s, s.length);
  assert.ok(!looksLikeEntities(s.subarray(sl[0].off, sl[0].off + sl[0].len)) && looksLikeEntities(s.subarray(sl[1].off, sl[1].off + sl[1].len)), 'the entities in lump 1');
  assert.deepEqual(parseEntities('{ "a" "1" } { "b" "2"'), [{ a: '1' }], 'a truncated entity dropped');
});

test('the shared WAD3 reader: header and directory entries, names without case, entries past the file left out', () => {
  const w = wad3([['WALL1', WAD_MIPTEX, miptex('WALL1', 64)], ['pic', 0x42, new Uint8Array(20)]]);
  const hd = wadHeader(w.bytes, w.bytes.length);
  assert.deepEqual(hd, { n: 2, dir: w.bytes.length - 64 });
  assert.equal(wadHeader(w.bytes, w.bytes.length - 1), null, 'a directory past the end');
  const e = wadEntries(w.bytes.subarray(hd.dir), hd.n, w.bytes.length);
  assert.deepEqual(e.map((x) => [x.name, x.pos, x.disk, x.type]), [['wall1', 12, 104, WAD_MIPTEX], ['pic', 116, 20, 0x42]]);
  assert.equal(wadEntries(w.bytes.subarray(hd.dir), hd.n, 100).length, 0);
  const bad = w.bytes.slice(); bad[3] = 0x32; assert.equal(wadHeader(bad, bad.length), null, 'WAD2');
});

test('what a map\'s load reads: each texture from the last WAD of the map\'s list that has it, the sky, the entities\' files, the files beside the map (its server\'s node graph and bots\' mesh), what the game\'s server precaches', () => {
  const files = new Map(), h = (p) => { const k = p.toLowerCase(); if (!files.has(k)) files.set(k, { name: 'v', path: p, size: 100 }); return files.get(k); };
  const have = new Set(['cstrike/gfx/env/nightrt.tga', 'cstrike/gfx/env/nightbk.tga', 'cstrike/gfx/env/nightlf.tga', 'cstrike/gfx/env/nightft.tga', 'cstrike/gfx/env/nightup.tga',
    'valve/gfx/env/nightdn.bmp', 'valve/sprites/glow.spr', 'cstrike/models/thing.mdl', 'valve/sound/ambience/wind.wav', 'cstrike/maps/graphs/m1.nod', 'cstrike/overviews/m1.txt',
    'cstrike/overviews/m1.bmp', 'cstrike/models/fromres.mdl', 'cstrike/sound/res/a.wav', 'cstrike/maps/m1.nav', 'cstrike/models/pet/a.mdl', 'valve/sound/pet/a.wav']);
  const find = (rel) => { for (const d of ['cstrike', 'valve']) if (have.has(`${d}/${rel.toLowerCase()}`)) return h(`${d}/${rel.toLowerCase()}`); return null; };
  const hl = h('valve/halflife.wad'), other = h('cstrike/other.wad');
  const wads = { halflife: { h: hl, dir: new Map([['wall1', { pos: 100, disk: 50 }], ['emb1', { pos: 200, disk: 60 }], ['solo', { pos: 300, disk: 70 }]]) },
    other: { h: other, dir: new Map([['wall1', { pos: 1000, disk: 80 }]]) } };
  const textures = [{ name: 'wall1', external: true }, { name: 'emb1', external: false }, { name: 'solo', external: true }, { name: 'gone', external: true }, { name: 'mapown', external: false }];
  const res = '// list\r\nmodels/fromres.mdl\r\nother.wad\r\nmaps/m1.bsp\r\nsound/res/a.wav\r\nsound/res/missing.wav\r\n';
  // (the release's list of what the game's server precaches at every map's load: after the map's own files, a path the
  // game has not skipped, one already announced not twice)
  const mapPrecache = ['models/pet/a.mdl', 'sound/pet/a.wav', 'sound/pet/gone.wav', 'models/thing.mdl'];
  const r = mapReads({ map: 'M1', entities: parseEntities(ENTITIES), textures, find, wad: (n) => wads[n] ?? null, res, wadTextures: true, server: true, mapPrecache });
  const got = r.entries.map((e) => (e.off === undefined ? e.h.path : `${e.h.path}@${e.off}+${e.len}`));
  assert.deepEqual(got, ['cstrike/other.wad@1000+80', 'valve/halflife.wad@200+60', 'valve/halflife.wad@300+70',
    'cstrike/gfx/env/nightrt.tga', 'cstrike/gfx/env/nightbk.tga', 'cstrike/gfx/env/nightlf.tga', 'cstrike/gfx/env/nightft.tga', 'cstrike/gfx/env/nightup.tga', 'valve/gfx/env/nightdn.bmp',
    'valve/sprites/glow.spr', 'cstrike/models/thing.mdl', 'valve/sound/ambience/wind.wav', 'cstrike/maps/graphs/m1.nod', 'cstrike/maps/m1.nav', 'cstrike/overviews/m1.txt', 'cstrike/overviews/m1.bmp',
    'cstrike/models/fromres.mdl', 'cstrike/sound/res/a.wav', 'cstrike/models/pet/a.mdl', 'valve/sound/pet/a.wav']);
  assert.equal(r.textures, 3); assert.equal(r.missing, 1, 'the external texture no WAD has; the map\'s own embedded one is read from the map');
  // (r_wadtextures 0 — the engine's default —: a texture the map holds is read from the map, not from a WAD that has it;
  // a client of another's server: no node graph, no navigation mesh — what that server precaches still, its client loads it)
  const own = mapReads({ map: 'M1', entities: parseEntities(ENTITIES), textures, find, wad: (n) => wads[n] ?? null, res, mapPrecache });
  const ownGot = own.entries.map((e) => (e.off === undefined ? e.h.path : `${e.h.path}@${e.off}+${e.len}`));
  assert.deepEqual(ownGot, got.filter((x) => x !== 'valve/halflife.wad@200+60' && x !== 'cstrike/maps/graphs/m1.nod' && x !== 'cstrike/maps/m1.nav'));
  assert.equal(own.textures, 2); assert.equal(own.missing, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(resReads(res, find).map((e) => e.h.path), ['cstrike/models/fromres.mdl', 'cstrike/sound/res/a.wav']);
  // (no wad key, no sky, nothing beside it: nothing but the entities' files)
  const bare = mapReads({ map: 'm2', entities: [{ classname: 'worldspawn' }], textures: [{ name: 'wall1', external: true }], find: () => null, wad: () => null });
  assert.deepEqual(bare, { entries: [], textures: 0, missing: 1 });
});

/** A GameData of a fake worker (its messages kept) over a tree of `files` (path → bytes; `lights`: same-size light copies). */
function pageData(files, lights = []) {
  const told = [], fake = { onmessage: null, postMessage: (m) => told.push(m), terminate() {} };
  const data = new GameData({ name: 'v', worker: fake });
  const tree = { dirs: {}, files: {} };
  for (const [p, b] of Object.entries(files)) {
    const parts = p.split('/'); let node = tree;
    for (const d of parts.slice(0, -1)) node = node.dirs[d] ??= { dirs: {}, files: {} };
    node.files[parts.at(-1)] = { size: b.length, mtime: 1, ...(lights.includes(p) ? { light: b.length } : {}) };
  }
  data.trees = { v: tree };
  return { data, told };
}

test('the page\'s hook: a listing\'s read of a map announces nothing; its load announces its reads once, at once, the WAD lumps as the copy the archive is read as; its .res a second list, not the engine\'s reads', async () => {
  // (the textures far from the header and the directory: the pieces the engine read at the mount are not theirs)
  const w = wad3([['pad1', 0x42, new Uint8Array(140000)], ['wall1', WAD_MIPTEX, miptex('wall1', 1024)], ['emb1', WAD_MIPTEX, miptex('emb1', 2048)], ['pad2', 0x42, new Uint8Array(140000)]]);
  const map = bsp(ENTITIES.replace('Other.WAD', 'none.wad'), ['wall1', '+emb1', 'gone'], { filler: 70000 });
  const files = { 'valve/maps/m1.bsp': map, 'valve/halflife.wad': w.bytes, 'valve/sprites/glow.spr': new Uint8Array(500), 'valve/models/thing.mdl': new Uint8Array(900),
    'valve_fr/sound/ambience/wind.wav': new Uint8Array(700), 'valve/maps/m1.res': enc('models/thing.mdl\nsprites/glow.spr\n') };
  const { data, told } = pageData(files, ['valve/halflife.wad']);
  try {
    // (the archive mounted at the engine's start, read light — the link not measured —: its directory in the page as the light copy's)
    const hw = data.file('v', 'valve/halflife.wad');
    assert.notEqual(data.pick(hw, 0), hw, 'read light');
    const lw = data.fileAs('v', '.light/valve/halflife.wad', hw.size), last = Math.floor((w.bytes.length - 64) / 65536);
    data.keep(lw, 0, w.bytes.subarray(0, 65536)); data.keep(lw, last, w.bytes.subarray(last * 65536));
    data.keep(data.file('v', 'valve/maps/m1.bsp'), 0, files['valve/maps/m1.bsp']); // (m1.res: not in the page)
    // (a language's folder over the game's: the engine's path is where it goes)
    const shown = Object.keys(files).map((p) => (p.startsWith('valve_fr/') ? { path: p, at: 'valve/' + p.slice(9) } : { path: p }));
    const hb = data.file('v', 'valve/maps/m1.bsp');
    const node = { path: '/rodir/valve/maps/m1.bsp', usedBytes: map.length, stream_ops: { read: (s, buf, off, len, pos) => data.read(hb, buf, off, len, pos) } };
    const wadNode = { path: '/rodir/valve/halflife.wad', usedBytes: w.bytes.length, stream_ops: { read: (s, buf, off, len, pos) => data.read(hw, buf, off, len, pos) } };
    const FS = { getPath: (n) => n.path }, logs = [], told2 = [];
    const opts = { name: 'v', files: shown, root: '/rodir', gameDir: 'valve', log: (t) => logs.push(t), wadTextures: () => true, announced: (m) => told2.push(m) };
    assert.equal(announceMapLoads(FS, [node, wadNode, { path: '/rodir/valve/sprites/glow.spr', stream_ops: {} }], data, opts), 1);
    // (the engine mounts the archive: its header, then its directory — parsed then; later, those pieces leave the page)
    const wb = new Uint8Array(w.bytes.length);
    wadNode.stream_ops.read({}, wb, 0, 12, 0); wadNode.stream_ops.read({}, wb, 0, 64, w.bytes.length - 64);
    data.cache.clear(); data.held = 0;
    data.keep(hb, 0, map); data.used.length = 0;
    const buf = new Uint8Array(map.length);
    // (a listing: the header and the entities — not half the file)
    const listing = {};
    node.stream_ops.read(listing, buf, 0, BSP_HEADER, 0);
    node.stream_ops.read(listing, buf, 0, 600, BSP_HEADER);
    assert.equal(told.filter((m) => m.want || m.read).length, 0, 'nothing announced, its .res neither');
    // (a load: the whole file, in two reads — announced after the read that reaches half, once)
    const load = {};
    node.stream_ops.read(load, buf, 0, BSP_HEADER, 0);
    assert.equal(told.filter((m) => m.want).length, 0);
    node.stream_ops.read(load, buf, BSP_HEADER, map.length - BSP_HEADER, BSP_HEADER);
    const wants = told.filter((m) => m.want);
    assert.equal(wants.length, 2, 'posted at once, the page\'s thread never yielding: its .res, then its reads');
    assert.deepEqual(wants[0].want.list, [['v', 'valve/maps/m1.res', 0, files['valve/maps/m1.res'].length]]);
    assert.equal(wants[0].want.label, 'res:m1'); assert.equal(wants[0].want.wait, false);
    const ask = told.find((m) => m.read);
    assert.ok(ask && ask.read.path === 'valve/maps/m1.res' && told.indexOf(ask) > told.indexOf(wants[0]), 'its .res fetched in the background, after its announce (the request joined)');
    const { want } = wants[1];
    assert.equal(want.seq, 0); assert.equal(want.wait, false); assert.equal(want.label, 'textures:m1');
    assert.deepEqual(want.list, [['v', '.light/valve/halflife.wad', w.at.wall1.pos, w.at.wall1.disk], ['v', '.light/valve/halflife.wad', w.at.emb1.pos, w.at.emb1.disk],
      ['v', 'valve/sprites/glow.spr', 0, 500], ['v', 'valve/models/thing.mdl', 0, 900], ['v', 'valve_fr/sound/ambience/wind.wav', 0, 700]]);
    assert.ok(hw.pin && !hw.pin.real, 'the archive\'s next open reads the light copy announced');
    assert.equal(data.wantSeq, 0, 'no batch: wantWait never waits for it');
    assert.match(logs.at(-1), /^Map m1: 5 of 5 reads announced \(2 textures from WADs, 1 not found, r_wadtextures\)$/);
    node.stream_ops.read(load, buf, 0, map.length, 0);
    assert.equal(told.filter((m) => m.want).length, 2, 'once an open');
    // (its .res here: its entries a second list — those the page has not —; its bytes never reported as the engine's)
    data.worker.onmessage({ data: { id: ask.read.id, bytes: files['valve/maps/m1.res'].slice() } });
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5));
    const third = told.filter((m) => m.want)[2];
    assert.ok(third, 'the .res\'s list');
    assert.equal(third.want.label, 'res:m1');
    assert.deepEqual(third.want.list, [['v', 'valve/models/thing.mdl', 0, 900], ['v', 'valve/sprites/glow.spr', 0, 500]]);
    assert.ok(![...data.used, ...told.flatMap((m) => m.used ?? [])].some(([, p]) => /\.res$/.test(p)), 'not reported as used');
    assert.deepEqual(told2, ['m1'], 'told after the announce, outside the read');
  } finally { data.close(); }
});

test('GameData.peek: the page\'s bytes without a fetch — the file\'s, or its same-layout light copy\'s —, null when some are missing', () => {
  const { data } = pageData({ 'a.wad': new Uint8Array(200000), 'b.bin': new Uint8Array(100) }, ['a.wad']);
  try {
    const a = data.file('v', 'a.wad'), light = data.fileAs('v', '.light/a.wad', a.size), b = data.file('v', 'b.bin');
    const bytes = Uint8Array.from({ length: 200000 }, (_, i) => (i * 7) & 255);
    assert.equal(data.peek(a, 0, 10), null);
    data.keep(light, 1, bytes.subarray(65536, 131072));
    assert.deepEqual(data.peek(a, 70000, 100), bytes.subarray(70000, 70100), 'from the light copy');
    assert.equal(data.peek(a, 60000, 10000), null, 'a piece missing');
    data.keep(a, 0, bytes.subarray(0, 65536)); data.keep(a, 1, bytes.subarray(65536, 131072));
    assert.deepEqual(data.peek(a, 60000, 10000), bytes.subarray(60000, 70000), 'across two pieces of the file');
    assert.equal(data.peek(b, 0, 10), null);
    assert.equal(data.sameLayout(a, light), true);
  } finally { data.close(); }
});

test('a console variable as the engine\'s configuration sets it: the last statement wins, quotes, `;`, comments, case', () => {
  const cfg = '// r_wadtextures "9"\nbind "w" "+forward"\nR_WadTextures "1"\nsv_cheats 0; r_wadtextures 0 ; echo "a;r_wadtextures 5"\nr_wadtexturesx 7\n';
  assert.equal(configSetting(cfg, 'r_wadtextures'), '0');
  assert.equal(configSetting('r_wadtextures "1"\r\n', 'r_wadtextures'), '1');
  assert.equal(configSetting('\nr_wadtextures 1\n', 'r_wadtextures'), '1', 'a command line\'s +r_wadtextures 1');
  assert.equal(configSetting('gl_vbo 1', 'r_wadtextures'), null);
});

```

`tests/goldsrc-release-gamefiles.test.js`:

```js
// A GoldSrc release's own archives as loose game files (tools/goldsrc/release-gamefiles.py, docs/browser-ports.md
// "The release's own game files"): each member under gamefiles/<the archive's folder>/, listed in release.json, its
// time its bytes'; what the game's server precaches at every map's load listed (mapPrecache); a release derived from an
// installed one without rebuilding it; collisions and an installed release refused.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const TOOL = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../tools/goldsrc/release-gamefiles.py');
const run = (...args) => spawnSync('python3', ['-I', TOOL, ...args], { encoding: 'utf8' });
const sha = (s) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex');

/** A .pk3 (zip) at `file` with `members` { name: text }, written by Python's zipfile. */
function pk3(file, members) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  const r = spawnSync('python3', ['-I', '-c', 'import json, sys, zipfile\nwith zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1], "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:\n  for n, t in json.loads(sys.argv[2]).items(): z.writestr(n, t)', file, JSON.stringify(members)]);
  assert.equal(r.status, 0, String(r.stderr));
}

function release(t) {
  const engines = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-release-gamefiles-'));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(engines, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const dir = path.join(engines, 'rel-r1');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'engine'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'engine', 'xash.wasm'), 'wasm');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'release.json'), JSON.stringify({ id: 'rel-r1', engine: 'e', files: [{ path: 'engine/xash.wasm', sha256: sha('wasm'), bytes: 4 }] }));
  pk3(path.join(dir, 'mod', 'cstrike', 'bots.pk3'), { 'BotProfile.db': 'profiles', 'maps/m1.nav': 'mesh 1', 'maps/m2.nav': 'mesh 2' });
  pk3(path.join(dir, 'mod', 'cstrike', 'pets.pk3'), { 'models/pet/a.mdl': 'model', 'sound/pet/a.wav': 'sound' });
  return { engines, dir };
}

test('an archive\'s members as loose files under gamefiles/<its folder>/, each listed in release.json with its digest', (t) => {
  const { dir } = release(t);
  const r = run(dir, 'mod/cstrike/bots.pk3', '--map-precache=mod/cstrike/pets.pk3');
  assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stderr); assert.match(r.stdout, /5 game files/);
  assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'gamefiles', 'cstrike', 'maps', 'm2.nav'), 'utf8'), 'mesh 2');
  assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'gamefiles', 'cstrike', 'models', 'pet', 'a.mdl'), 'utf8'), 'model');
  const meta = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'release.json'), 'utf8'));
  assert.deepEqual(meta.gameFilesFrom, ['mod/cstrike/bots.pk3', 'mod/cstrike/pets.pk3']);
  // (the archive marked: its members, relative to the game folder — the page announces them with each map)
  assert.deepEqual(meta.mapPrecache, ['models/pet/a.mdl', 'sound/pet/a.wav']);
  assert.deepEqual(meta.files.map((f) => f.path), ['engine/xash.wasm', 'gamefiles/cstrike/BotProfile.db', 'gamefiles/cstrike/maps/m1.nav', 'gamefiles/cstrike/maps/m2.nav',
    'gamefiles/cstrike/models/pet/a.mdl', 'gamefiles/cstrike/sound/pet/a.wav']);
  assert.deepEqual(meta.files[2], { path: 'gamefiles/cstrike/maps/m1.nav', sha256: sha('mesh 1'), bytes: 6 });
  // (the archives stay: an older manifest's goldsrc.extras names them)
  assert.ok(fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'mod', 'cstrike', 'bots.pk3')));
});

test('a loose file\'s time is its bytes\': two builds whose archives differ in time only give the same keys, a changed file another', (t) => {
  const { dir } = release(t), { dir: again } = release(t);
  // (the second build's archive written later, one member changed at the same size)
  pk3(path.join(again, 'mod', 'cstrike', 'bots.pk3'), { 'BotProfile.db': 'profiles', 'maps/m1.nav': 'mesh 1', 'maps/m2.nav': 'mesh 3' });
  fs.utimesSync(path.join(again, 'mod', 'cstrike', 'bots.pk3'), new Date('2030-01-01'), new Date('2030-01-01'));
  assert.equal(run(dir, 'mod/cstrike/bots.pk3').status, 0); assert.equal(run(again, 'mod/cstrike/bots.pk3').status, 0);
  const time = (d, rel) => fs.statSync(path.join(d, 'gamefiles', 'cstrike', rel)).mtimeMs;
  assert.equal(time(again, 'maps/m1.nav'), time(dir, 'maps/m1.nav'));
  assert.equal(time(again, 'BotProfile.db'), time(dir, 'BotProfile.db'));
  assert.notEqual(time(again, 'maps/m2.nav'), time(dir, 'maps/m2.nav'), 'same size, other bytes: another key');
  assert.notEqual(time(dir, 'maps/m1.nav'), time(dir, 'maps/m2.nav'));
  for (const rel of ['maps/m1.nav', 'maps/m2.nav']) {
    const s = time(again, rel) / 1000;
    assert.ok(s >= Date.UTC(1980, 0, 1) / 1000 && s < Date.now() / 1000, 'from 1980, never in the future');
  }
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'release.json'), 'utf8')).mapPrecache, undefined, 'none marked: no list');
});

test('two archives giving one path, a member outside its folder, a path already there: refused', (t) => {
  const { dir } = release(t);
  pk3(path.join(dir, 'mod', 'cstrike', 'more.pk3'), { 'MAPS/M1.NAV': 'other mesh' });
  assert.match(run(dir, 'mod/cstrike/bots.pk3', 'mod/cstrike/more.pk3').stderr, /in mod\/cstrike\/bots\.pk3 and mod\/cstrike\/more\.pk3/);
  pk3(path.join(dir, 'mod', 'cstrike', 'evil.pk3'), { '../escape.txt': 'x' });
  assert.match(run(dir, 'mod/cstrike/evil.pk3').stderr, /outside its folder/);
  assert.equal(fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'gamefiles', 'escape.txt')), false);
  const { dir: again } = release(t);
  assert.equal(run(again, 'mod/cstrike/bots.pk3').status, 0);
  assert.match(run(again, 'mod/cstrike/bots.pk3').stderr, /already in the release/);
  assert.match(run(again, 'engine/xash.wasm').stderr, /not an archive/);
});

test('a release derived from an installed one: its files copied, its id and origin, the archives\' members; never over an installed one', (t) => {
  const { engines, dir } = release(t);
  const r = run('--derive', engines, 'rel-r1', 'rel-r2', 'mod/cstrike/bots.pk3');
  assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stderr);
  const meta = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(engines, 'rel-r2', 'release.json'), 'utf8'));
  assert.equal(meta.id, 'rel-r2'); assert.equal(meta.derivedFrom, 'rel-r1'); assert.equal(meta.engine, 'e');
  assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(engines, 'rel-r2', 'engine', 'xash.wasm'), 'utf8'), 'wasm');
  assert.equal(fs.statSync(path.join(engines, 'rel-r2', 'engine', 'xash.wasm')).mtimeMs, fs.statSync(path.join(dir, 'engine', 'xash.wasm')).mtimeMs, 'times kept');
  assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(engines, 'rel-r2', 'gamefiles', 'cstrike', 'maps', 'm1.nav'), 'utf8'), 'mesh 1');
  assert.equal(fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'gamefiles')), false, 'the installed release untouched');
  assert.equal(fs.readdirSync(engines).some((n) => n.startsWith('.')), false, 'no staging left');
  assert.match(run('--derive', engines, 'rel-r1', 'rel-r2', 'mod/cstrike/bots.pk3').stderr, /never overwritten/);
  assert.match(run('--derive', engines, 'rel-r2', 'rel-r3', 'mod/cstrike/pets.pk3').stderr, /gamefiles\/ already/);
  pk3(path.join(dir, 'mod', 'cstrike', 'evil.pk3'), { '../escape.txt': 'x' });
  assert.match(run('--derive', engines, 'rel-r1', 'rel-r4', 'mod/cstrike/evil.pk3').stderr, /outside its folder/);
  assert.deepEqual(fs.readdirSync(engines).sort(), ['rel-r1', 'rel-r2'], 'a refused derivation leaves nothing');
});

test('the lock: only the builds that say gameFiles get loose files (an older id rebuilds as pinned); a precached asset in such a build only', () => {
  const lock = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(path.dirname(TOOL), 'lock.json'), 'utf8'));
  const builds = new Map(lock.modules.builds.map((b) => [b.id, b]));
  for (const id of ['xash3d-web-1.2.2-cs16-15278ca-r2', 'xash3d-web-1.2.2-cs16-15278ca-arsenal-r12']) assert.equal(builds.get(id).gameFiles, undefined, id);
  for (const id of ['xash3d-web-1.2.2-cs16-15278ca-r3', 'xash3d-web-1.2.2-cs16-15278ca-arsenal-r13']) assert.equal(builds.get(id).gameFiles, true, id);

  assert.match(script, /if build_spec\.get\('gameFiles'\):\n\s+archives = /);
});
```

```js
async function serve(t, opts) {
  const server = createServer({ ...opts, lanLog: () => {} });
  await new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  t.after(() => new Promise((resolve) => { server.closeAllConnections?.(); server.close(resolve); }));
  return `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
}

/** A raw WebSocket client (the Origin header set at will): send() binary messages, receive() the next one. */
function wsConnect(url, origin = new URL(url).origin, headers = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = http.get(url, { headers: { Connection: 'Upgrade', Upgrade: 'websocket', Origin: origin, 'Sec-WebSocket-Version': '13', 'Sec-WebSocket-Key': randomBytes(16).toString('base64'), ...headers } });
    req.on('error', reject);
    req.on('response', (res) => { res.resume(); reject(new Error(`HTTP ${res.statusCode}`)); });
    req.on('upgrade', (_res, socket, head) => {
      let buf = head; const waiting = [], queued = [];
      socket.on('data', (d) => {
        buf = Buffer.concat([buf, d]);
        while (buf.length >= 2) {
          let len = buf[1] & 127, o = 2;
          if (len === 126) { if (buf.length < 4) return; len = buf.readUInt16BE(2); o = 4; }
          if (buf.length < o + len) return;
          const msg = Buffer.from(buf.subarray(o, o + len)), op = buf[0] & 15; buf = buf.subarray(o + len);
          if (op !== 2) continue;
          if (waiting.length) waiting.shift()(msg); else queued.push(msg);
        }
      });
      resolve({
        send(payload) {
          const data = Buffer.from(payload), mask = randomBytes(4), head2 = Buffer.alloc(data.length < 126 ? 2 : 4);
          head2[0] = 0x82;
          if (data.length < 126) head2[1] = 0x80 | data.length; else { head2[1] = 0x80 | 126; head2.writeUInt16BE(data.length, 2); }
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] ^= mask[i & 3];
          socket.write(Buffer.concat([head2, mask, data]));
        },
        receive: () => (queued.length ? Promise.resolve(queued.shift()) : new Promise((done, fail) => { const tm = setTimeout(() => fail(new Error('timeout')), 3000); waiting.push((m) => { clearTimeout(tm); done(m); }); })),
        close: () => socket.destroy(),
      });
    });
  });
}

test('multiplayer: each player gets its own UDP socket to the version\'s local server, same-origin only', async (t) => {
  const udp = dgram.createSocket('udp4'), senders = new Set();
  await new Promise((resolve) => udp.bind(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  t.after(() => udp.close());
  udp.on('message', (msg, from) => { senders.add(from.port); udp.send(msg, from.port, from.address); });
  const { games, engines } = fixture(t, { goldsrc: goldsrc({ multiplayer: { server: 'srv', port: udp.address().port, map: 'dm' } }) });
  const base = await serve(t, { gamesDir: games, enginesDir: engines });
  const players = [await wsConnect(`${base}/api/udp/gs-orig`), await wsConnect(`${base}/api/udp/gs-orig`)];
  try {
    const payloads = [Buffer.from([0, 255, 7, 8]), Buffer.alloc(300, 42)];
    await Promise.all(players.map(async (p, i) => { const back = p.receive(); p.send(payloads[i]); assert.deepEqual(await back, payloads[i]); }));
    assert.equal(senders.size, 2);
  } finally { players.forEach((p) => p.close()); } // (before the server closes: it waits for its sockets)
  await assert.rejects(wsConnect(`${base}/api/udp/gs-orig`, 'http://elsewhere.example'), /403/);
  // (the site under another name — a front proxy's X-Forwarded-Host —: its pages get a socket, another site's still not)
  const mirror = { 'X-Forwarded-Host': 'orthros.mirror.test' };
  (await wsConnect(`${base}/api/udp/gs-orig`, 'https://orthros.mirror.test', mirror)).close();
  await assert.rejects(wsConnect(`${base}/api/udp/gs-orig`, 'https://elsewhere.test', mirror), /403/);
  await assert.rejects(wsConnect(`${base}/api/udp/win-1`), /403/);
  await assert.rejects(wsConnect(`${base}/api/udp/none`), /403/);
  // (the virtual LAN of the Windows games shares the upgrade path)
  const lan = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = http.get(`${base}/api/lan?room=x`, { headers: { Connection: 'Upgrade', Upgrade: 'websocket', 'Sec-WebSocket-Version': '13', 'Sec-WebSocket-Key': randomBytes(16).toString('base64') } });
    req.on('upgrade', (res, socket) => { socket.destroy(); resolve(res.statusCode); }); req.on('response', (res) => resolve(res.statusCode)); req.on('error', reject);
  });
  assert.equal(lan, 101);
});

  const { root, games, engines } = fixture(t);

  assert.equal(after.dirs.valve.dirs.models.files['pet.mdl'].size, 5);

  assert.deepEqual(await precache(), []);
  fs.writeFileSync(meta, JSON.stringify({ id: ENGINE, mapPrecache: ['models/pet.mdl', 'sound/pet/a.wav'] }));

  const info = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/manifest/mod-1`)).json();

test('rooms: a version\'s rooms are checked, their ports one version\'s each', (t) => {

  assert.throws(() => loadGameCatalog(games), /multiplayer.maps/);
  editManifest(gs, (spec) => { spec.versions[0].goldsrc = goldsrc({ multiplayer: mp({ rooms: { ports: [28000, 28003], bots: { max: 6, commands: ['bot_quota {n}'], args: ['-bots'] } } }) }); });
  const m = loadGameCatalog(games).get('gs-orig').goldsrc.multiplayer;
  assert.deepEqual([roomSlots(m), roomPort(m, 0), roomPort(m, 1), roomPort(m, 4)], [4, 27999, 28000, 28003]);
  // (another version whose server takes one of these ports)
  const other = path.join(games, 'gs2'); fs.cpSync(gs, other, { recursive: true });

  assert.throws(() => loadGameCatalog(games), /port UDP 28002/);
});

test('rooms: a created room is closed with its key, from the page\'s origin only', async (t) => {
  const seen = [];
  const manager = http.createServer((req, res) => {
    let body = ''; req.on('data', (d) => { body += d; });
    req.on('end', () => { seen.push([req.method, req.url, body]); res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }); res.end('{"closed":2}'); });
  });
  await new Promise((resolve) => manager.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve)); t.after(() => manager.close());
  const port = manager.address().port;
  const { games, engines } = fixture(t, { goldsrc: goldsrc({ multiplayer: { server: 'srv', port, map: 'dm', rooms: { ports: [port + 1, port + 2] } } }) });
  const base = await serve(t, { gamesDir: games, enginesDir: engines });
  const key = 'ab'.repeat(16);
  const del = (headers, body) => fetch(`${base}/api/rooms/gs-orig/2`, { method: 'DELETE', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...headers }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  assert.equal((await del({}, { key })).status, 403); // (no Origin)
  assert.equal((await del({ Origin: 'http://elsewhere.example' }, { key })).status, 403);
  assert.equal((await del({ Origin: base }, { key: 'not-a-key' })).status, 403);
  assert.equal(seen.length, 0);
  const res = await del({ Origin: base }, { key });
  assert.equal(res.status, 200); assert.deepEqual(await res.json(), { closed: 2 });
  assert.deepEqual(seen, [['DELETE', '/rooms/2', JSON.stringify({ key })]]);
  assert.equal((await fetch(`${base}/api/rooms/gs-orig/2`)).status, 405);
});

test('rooms: the page\'s relay tags each packet with its room, a broadcast reaches every room', async (t) => {
  const echo = async (tag) => {
    const udp = dgram.createSocket('udp4'); await new Promise((resolve) => udp.bind(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve)); t.after(() => udp.close());
    udp.on('message', (msg, from) => udp.send(Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([tag]), msg]), from.port, from.address));
    return udp.address().port;
  };
  const [a, b] = [await echo(0xa0), await echo(0xb1)];
  const { games, engines } = fixture(t, { goldsrc: goldsrc({ multiplayer: { server: 'srv', port: a, map: 'dm', rooms: { ports: [b, b] } } }) });
  const base = await serve(t, { gamesDir: games, enginesDir: engines });
  const ws = await wsConnect(`${base}/api/udp/gs-orig?rooms`);
  try {
    let back = ws.receive(); ws.send([1, 9, 9]); assert.deepEqual([...await back], [1, 0xb1, 9, 9]);
    back = ws.receive(); ws.send([0, 7]); assert.deepEqual([...await back], [0, 0xa0, 7]);
    ws.send([5, 1, 2]); // (no such room: dropped)
    ws.send([255, 3]);
    const both = [await ws.receive(), await ws.receive()].map((m) => [...m]).sort((x, y) => x[0] - y[0]);
    assert.deepEqual(both, [[0, 0xa0, 3], [1, 0xb1, 3]]);
  } finally { ws.close(); }
});

test('check: a player is in the game once signed on, and walks — a spectator outside any team only drifts', () => {
  // (a live run's logs: connected to the relay, still loading; then the engine's signon line)
  const loading = ['[10:12:18] Adding directory: cstrike/custom/', '[10:12:44] Setting up renderer...'];

  // (the page's string form, as the check evaluates it there)

  // (a live run: the player in a team walked 250 units; the one left at its team menu drifted one)

  assert.ok(distance(' 1742.03 -519.969 -79.9688 ', ' 1742.49 -518.989 -80.2454 ') < 2);
  assert.ok(Number.isNaN(distance(undefined, ' 1 2 3 '))); assert.ok(Number.isNaN(distance(' 1 2 ', ' 1 2 3 ')));

  const check = fs.readFileSync(new URL('../tools/goldsrc/check.mjs', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
  const moved = Number(check.match(/const MOVED = (\d+);/)?.[1]);
  assert.ok(moved > 2 && moved < 200, 'MOVED between a drift and a walk');
  assert.match(check, /distance\(before, after\) >= MOVED\)\) throw/);
  // (the join keys pressed only after the signon wait)
  assert.ok(check.indexOf('(${signedOn})(portSession.logs)') > 0 && check.indexOf('(${signedOn})(portSession.logs)') < check.indexOf("keys.split(',')"));
});
```

`tests/google-signin.test.js`:

```js
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { once } from 'node:events';
import { createServer } from '../src/host/server.js';
import { suggestUsername } from '../src/host/google-signin.js';

// A fake Google: its sign-in page is never visited — the test reads the state and nonce from the address the server
// sends the window to, and its token endpoint answers with an ID token for whichever player the next code names.
function fakeGoogle() {
  const codes = new Map();
  const jwt = (claims) => ['{"alg":"RS256"}', JSON.stringify(claims), 'sig'].map((s, i) => (i < 2 ? Buffer.from(s).toString('base64url') : s)).join('.');
  const google = {
    clientId: 'client-1.apps.googleusercontent.com', clientSecret: 'secret', auth: 'https://google.test/auth', token: 'https://google.test/token',
    fetch: async (url, init) => {
      const form = new URLSearchParams(init.body.toString());
      const issued = codes.get(form.get('code'));
      if (!issued || form.get('client_secret') !== 'secret' || createHash('sha256').update(form.get('code_verifier')).digest('base64url') !== issued.challenge ||
          form.get('redirect_uri') !== issued.redirectUri)
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'invalid_grant' }), { status: 400 });
      codes.delete(form.get('code'));
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ id_token: jwt({ iss: 'https://accounts.google.com', aud: google.clientId, exp: Date.now() / 1000 + 3600, nonce: issued.nonce, ...issued.claims }) }));
    },
  };
  return { google, issue: (location, claims, nonce) => { const q = new URL(location).searchParams; const code = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
    codes.set(code, { challenge: q.get('code_challenge'), nonce: nonce ?? q.get('nonce'), redirectUri: q.get('redirect_uri'), claims }); return { state: q.get('state'), code }; } };
}

test('Google sign-in: a new player chooses a name, comes back signed in, links and unlinks; flows bound to their browser', async () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-google-'));
  const games = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-google-games-'));
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(games, 'fixture', 'base'), { recursive: true }); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(games, 'fixture', 'versions', 'v1'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(games, 'fixture', 'base', 'game.exe'), 'MZ');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(games, 'fixture', 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, id: 'fixture', name: 'Fixture', defaultVersion: 'g1', versions: [{ id: 'g1', dir: 'v1', version: '1', exe: 'game.exe' }] }));
  const fake = fakeGoogle();
  const server = createServer({ accountsDir: dir, gamesDir: games, accountOrigin: 'http://localhost:8080', accountGoogle: fake.google });
  server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1'); await once(server, 'listening');
  const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:' + server.address().port;
  const cookieOf = (res, name) => res.headers.getSetCookie().map((c) => c.split(';')[0]).find((c) => c.startsWith(name + '=') && c.length > name.length + 1);
  const get = (route, cookie) => fetch(base + route, { redirect: 'manual', headers: cookie ? { Cookie: cookie } : {} });
  const post = (route, body, cookie) => fetch(base + route, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body), headers: { Origin: 'http://localhost:8080', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(cookie ? { Cookie: cookie } : {}) } });
  const me = async (cookie) => (await (await get('/api/account', cookie)).json()).user;
  /** start → Google → callback: the callback's answer, with the flow's own cookie unless `cookie` says otherwise. */
  const flow = async (claims, { link = null, nonce, binding } = {}) => {
    const start = await get(`/api/account/google/start?lang=fr&popup=1&flow=abcdefgh1${link ? '&link=1' : ''}`, link);
    assert.equal(start.status, 302);
    const location = start.headers.get('location');
    assert.match(location, /^https:\/\/google\.test\/auth\?/);
    assert.equal(new URL(location).searchParams.get('redirect_uri'), 'http://localhost:8080/api/account/google/callback');
    assert.equal(new URL(location).searchParams.get('code_challenge_method'), 'S256');
    assert.match(start.headers.getSetCookie()[0], /SameSite=Lax/);
    const { state, code } = fake.issue(location, claims, nonce);
    return get(`/api/account/google/callback?state=${state}&code=${code}`, binding ?? cookieOf(start, 'orthros_oauth'));
  };
  try {
    assert.equal((await (await get('/api/config')).json()).google, true);
    // (a new player: the name page, then the account)
    const first = await flow({ sub: '111', email: 'ana.lopez@gmail.com', given_name: 'Ana', name: 'Ana López' });
    assert.equal(first.status, 200);
    const page = await first.text();
    assert.match(page, /Bienvenue, Ana/); assert.match(page, /value="ana\.lopez"/); assert.match(page, /ana\.lopez@gmail\.com/);
    const signup = cookieOf(first, 'orthros_google');
    assert.equal((await post('/api/account/google/complete', { mode: 'create', username: 'Bad name!' }, signup)).status, 400);
    const made = await post('/api/account/google/complete', { mode: 'create', username: 'ana_l' }, signup);
    assert.equal(made.status, 200);
    const ana = cookieOf(made, 'orthros_session');
    assert.deepEqual(await me(ana), { username: 'ana_l', google: 'ana.lopez@gmail.com', password: false });
    assert.equal((await post('/api/account/google/complete', { mode: 'create', username: 'ana_2' }, signup)).status, 400, 'a name page serves once');
    assert.equal((await post('/api/account/login', { username: 'ana_l', password: '' })).status, 401, 'no password: no password sign-in');
    // (she comes back: signed in at once, the window tells the page)
    const again = await flow({ sub: '111', email: 'ana.lopez@gmail.com' });
    const html = await again.text();
    assert.match(html, /Connecté en tant que ana_l/); assert.match(html, /"result":"signed-in"/); assert.match(html, /"flow":"abcdefgh1"/);
    assert.equal((await me(cookieOf(again, 'orthros_session'))).username, 'ana_l');
    // (a flow serves once, and only in the browser that started it; Google's checks)
    const start = await get('/api/account/google/start?lang=en');
    const { state, code } = fake.issue(start.headers.get('location'), { sub: '111' });
    assert.equal((await get(`/api/account/google/callback?state=${state}&code=${code}`, 'orthros_oauth=' + 'a'.repeat(64))).status, 400);
    assert.equal((await get(`/api/account/google/callback?state=${state}&code=${code}`, cookieOf(start, 'orthros_oauth'))).status, 400, 'used up');
    assert.equal((await flow({ sub: '111' }, { nonce: 'other' })).status, 502);
    const denied = await get('/api/account/google/start?lang=en'); const s2 = new URL(denied.headers.get('location')).searchParams.get('state');
    assert.match(await (await get(`/api/account/google/callback?state=${s2}&error=access_denied`, cookieOf(denied, 'orthros_oauth'))).text(), /Google sign-in cancelled/);
    // (a password account links Google; the same Google account cannot go to a second one)
    const bob = cookieOf(await post('/api/account/register', { username: 'bob', password: 'long secret password' }), 'orthros_session');
    assert.match(await (await flow({ sub: '222', email: 'bob@example.com' }, { link: bob })).text(), /"result":"linked"/);
    assert.equal((await me(bob)).google, 'bob@example.com');
    assert.match(await (await flow({ sub: '111' }, { link: bob })).text(), /"result":"taken"/);
    assert.equal((await get('/api/account/google/start?link=1')).status, 401, 'linking needs a signed-in account');
    // (a new Google account, an existing Orthros one: its password links them)
    const carol = cookieOf(await post('/api/account/register', { username: 'carol', password: 'carol long password' }), 'orthros_session');
    const third = cookieOf(await flow({ sub: '333', email: 'c@example.com' }), 'orthros_google');
    assert.equal((await post('/api/account/google/complete', { mode: 'existing', username: 'carol', password: 'wrong password!' }, third)).status, 401);
    assert.equal((await post('/api/account/google/complete', { mode: 'existing', username: 'bob', password: 'long secret password' }, third)).status, 409, 'bob has his Google already');
    const linked = await post('/api/account/google/complete', { mode: 'existing', username: 'carol', password: 'carol long password' }, third);
    assert.equal(linked.status, 200); assert.equal((await me(carol)).google, 'c@example.com');
    // (no password: unlinking refused until one is set; then a password sign-in works)
    assert.equal((await post('/api/account/google/unlink', {}, ana)).status, 409);
    assert.equal((await post('/api/account/password', { newPassword: 'ana new password' }, ana)).status, 200);
    assert.equal((await post('/api/account/google/unlink', {}, ana)).status, 200);
    assert.deepEqual(await me(ana), { username: 'ana_l', google: null, password: true });
    assert.equal((await post('/api/account/login', { username: 'ana_l', password: 'ana new password' })).status, 200);
    // (an account made with Google is deleted with its name typed again)
    const dan = cookieOf(await post('/api/account/google/complete', { mode: 'create', username: 'dan' }, cookieOf(await flow({ sub: '444' }), 'orthros_google')), 'orthros_session');
    const del = (body) => fetch(base + '/api/account', { method: 'DELETE', body: JSON.stringify(body), headers: { Origin: 'http://localhost:8080', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Cookie: dan } });
    assert.equal((await del({ username: 'nope' })).status, 403);
    assert.equal((await del({ username: 'dan' })).status, 200);
    assert.equal(await me(dan), null);
    // (the site under another name — a front proxy's, its X-Forwarded-Host —: Google comes back to that name, the code
    // exchanged with it, the name page's form accepted from there)
    const mirror = { 'X-Forwarded-Host': 'orthros.mirror.test', 'X-Forwarded-Proto': 'https', 'X-Forwarded-For': '203.0.113.7' };
    const viaMirror = await fetch(base + '/api/account/google/start?lang=en&popup=1', { redirect: 'manual', headers: mirror });
    const mirrorLocation = viaMirror.headers.get('location');
    assert.equal(new URL(mirrorLocation).searchParams.get('redirect_uri'), 'https://orthros.mirror.test/api/account/google/callback');
    assert.match(viaMirror.headers.getSetCookie()[0], /; Secure/);
    const issued = fake.issue(mirrorLocation, { sub: '555', email: 'eve@example.com', given_name: 'Eve' });
    const named = await fetch(base + `/api/account/google/callback?state=${issued.state}&code=${issued.code}`, { redirect: 'manual', headers: { ...mirror, Cookie: cookieOf(viaMirror, 'orthros_oauth') } });
    assert.equal(named.status, 200, 'the code exchanged with the redirection it was issued for');
    const eve = await fetch(base + '/api/account/google/complete', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ mode: 'create', username: 'eve' }),
      headers: { ...mirror, Origin: 'https://orthros.mirror.test', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Cookie: cookieOf(named, 'orthros_google') } });
    assert.equal(eve.status, 200);
    assert.equal((await me(cookieOf(eve, 'orthros_session'))).username, 'eve');
  } finally {
    server.close(); await once(server, 'close');
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync(games, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});
```

`tests/heap-corruption.test.js`:

```js
// A program writing past its block overwrites the next boundary tag (our footer; on Windows, the next header — which
// its heap rarely checks): freeing the blocks around it must neither throw (a footer read as a huge size once sent
// the emulator out of the address space: BFME2 on a player's machine) nor merge blocks through inconsistent tags.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { VMem } from '../src/win32/vmem.js';
import { Heap } from '../src/win32/heap.js';
import { heapDamageLines } from '../src/core/vm.js';

test('heap: frees next to an overwritten footer or free-list link stay inside the heap', () => {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const heap = new Heap({ mem, vmem: new VMem() });
  const a = heap.alloc(24), b = heap.alloc(24), c = heap.alloc(24);
  assert.equal(heap.free_(a), true);
  mem.write32(a + 24, (b - 12 + 0x10000000) >>> 0); // (a's footer, 4 bytes past its 24: a size sending b's backward merge past 2 GB)
  assert.equal(heap.free_(b), true, 'the backward merge of b reads the damaged footer');
  mem.write32(b, 0x90000000); mem.write32(b + 4, 0xfffffff8); // (links of a freed block overwritten)
  assert.equal(heap.free_(c), true);
  for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) assert.ok(heap.alloc(8 + (i % 40)), 'allocations go on');
  assert.equal(heap.free_(0x7ffffff0), false);
});

test('heap: every block 8-aligned (HeapAlloc on Windows), through splits, frees and merges', () => {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const heap = new Heap({ mem, vmem: new VMem() });
  const live = [];
  let seed = 7; const rnd = (n) => { seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; return seed % n; };
  for (let i = 0; i < 5000; i++) {
    if (live.length && rnd(3) === 0) { const k = rnd(live.length); assert.equal(heap.free_(live[k]), true); live.splice(k, 1); continue; }
    const p = heap.alloc(1 + rnd(300)); assert.ok(p); assert.equal(p & 7, 0, `block ${p.toString(16)} 8-aligned`); live.push(p);
  }
});

// A block the program keeps writing after freeing it: its free-list link then points anywhere — into another heap, just
// below a thread's stack — where the "size" read is garbage (0xffffffff). Handing that out gave a 2 MiB buffer that ran
// over the main thread's stack (BFME2's first launch, the player's crash). The list is cut there instead.
test('heap: a free-list link overwritten after free never hands out memory outside the heap', () => {
  const mem = new GuestMemory(), vmem = new VMem();
  const other = new Heap({ mem, vmem, tag: 'other' }), heap = new Heap({ mem, vmem, tag: 'user' });
  const victim = other.alloc(64);
  mem.write32(victim - 8, 0xffffffff); // (what the stray link's target reads as a size)
  const a = heap.alloc(4000);
  assert.equal(heap.free_(a), true);
  mem.write32(a, victim); // (the program writes into the freed block: its "next" link now leads into the other heap)
  const inHeap = (p, n) => heap.chunks.some((c) => p >= c.base && p + n <= c.base + c.size);
  for (const n of [4000, 2 << 20, 64]) {
    const p = heap.alloc(n);
    assert.ok(p, `alloc(${n}) succeeds`);
    assert.ok(inHeap(p, n), `alloc(${n}) = ${p.toString(16)} lies inside the heap`);
    assert.notEqual(p, victim);
  }
});

// Links of freed blocks rewritten into a loop (each pointing at the other, both valid free blocks too small for the
// request): the search through that list never ended. It is cut where it closes; the blocks stay usable.
test('heap: a free list the program turned into a loop is cut, the allocation goes on', () => {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const heap = new Heap({ mem, vmem: new VMem() });
  const a = heap.alloc(1100), x = heap.alloc(16), b = heap.alloc(1200), y = heap.alloc(16);
  assert.ok(x && y);
  assert.equal(heap.free_(a), true); assert.equal(heap.free_(b), true); // (one list: b -> a)
  assert.equal(mem.read32(b), a);
  mem.write32(a, b); // (a's next link now leads back to b)
  const p = heap.alloc(1500);
  assert.ok(p && p !== a && p !== b, 'served from elsewhere');
  assert.equal(heap.stats.loopedLists, 1);
  assert.equal(heap.alloc(1150), b, 'the blocks of the list are still found');
  assert.equal(heap.alloc(1050), a);
  // a block linked to itself behind another one (c -> d -> d ...)
  const c = heap.alloc(1300), z = heap.alloc(496), d = heap.alloc(1100), w = heap.alloc(496); // (separators of a size no free block has)
  assert.ok(z && w);
  assert.equal(heap.free_(d), true); assert.equal(heap.free_(c), true); // (c -> d)
  mem.write32(d, d);
  assert.ok(![c, d].includes(heap.alloc(1900)));
  assert.equal(heap.stats.loopedLists, 2);
  assert.equal(mem.read32(d), 0);
  assert.equal(heap.alloc(1250), c);
  assert.equal(heap.alloc(1050), d);
  // the crash / hang report lists a heap whose only damage is a looping list
  const clean = new Heap({ mem, vmem: new VMem(), tag: 'clean' });
  heap.tag = 'looped';
  assert.deepEqual(heapDamageLines([clean, heap]), ['heap looped: 0 overwritten boundary tags, 0 broken free lists, 2 looping free lists']);
});
```

`tests/heap-lookup.test.js`:

```js
// Heap chunk lookup (Heap.chunkOf through the granule map) and allocation walk: the same chunk as the linear scan for
// any address, and the same blocks, in the same order, as the linear-scan heap it replaced — free lists overwritten
// by the program included (which block a game gets back decides its reuse patterns, see docs/thread-scheduling.md).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { VMem } from '../src/win32/vmem.js';
import { Heap } from '../src/win32/heap.js';

const MAGIC_FREE = 0x46524855;
/** seeded 32-bit generator (mulberry32: every bit usable, unlike a power-of-two LCG's low bits) */
const rng = (seed) => () => {
  seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
  let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
  t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
  return (t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0;
};

const alignUp = (x, a) => Math.ceil(x / a) * a;
const classIndex = (s) => { if (s <= 512) return s >> 3; let c = 65; for (let k = 1024; k < s && c < 127; k <<= 1) c++; return c; };
const plausible = (p) => p === 0 || (p >= 0x10000 && p < 0x7eb00000 && (p & 7) === 0);

/**
 * The heap before the granule map: linear chunk scan, the allocation walk and the reallocation as they were (reads
 * through read32, zeroing through fill); free_, size, freeBlockOk are unchanged (they look chunks up by this.chunkOf).
 */
class LinearHeap extends Heap {
  chunkOf(addr) { return this.chunkScan(addr); }
  alloc(size, zero = false) {
    size = Math.max(16, alignUp(size >>> 0, 8));
    if (size > 0x7fffffff) return 0;
    const m = this.mem;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
      for (let c = classIndex(size); c < 128; c++) {
        let b = this.heads[c], prev = 0, mark = b, steps = 0, span = 1;
        while (b) {
          const bs = m.read32(b - 8);
          if (!this.freeBlockOk(b, bs)) { if (prev) m.write32(prev, 0); else this.heads[c] = 0; this.stats.brokenLists = (this.stats.brokenLists ?? 0) + 1; break; }
          if (bs >= size) {
            this.unlink(b, c);
            const rem = bs - size;
            if (rem >= 32) { m.write32(b - 8, size); m.write32(b + size, size); this.setFree(b + size + 16, rem - 16); }
            m.write32(b - 4, 0x4f524855);
            if (zero) m.fill(b, m.read32(b - 8), 0);
            return b;
          }
          prev = b; b = m.read32(b);
          if (!plausible(b)) break;
          // (the cut of a looping list, which the walk did not have: without it such a program never ends)
          if (b === mark) { this.cutLoop(c, mark); break; }
          if (++steps === span) { mark = b; span *= 2; steps = 0; }
        }
      }
      if (!this.grow(size + 48)) return 0;
    }
    return 0;
  }
  realloc(addr, size, zero = false, inPlaceOnly = false) {
    const m = this.mem;
    if (!addr) return inPlaceOnly ? 0 : this.alloc(size, zero);
    const old = this.size(addr);
    if (old < 0) return 0;
    size = Math.max(16, alignUp(size >>> 0, 8));
    if (size <= old) return addr;
    const nextU = addr + old + 16;
    if (m.read32(nextU - 4) === MAGIC_FREE && this.freeBlockOk(nextU, m.read32(nextU - 8))) {
      const ns = m.read32(nextU - 8);
      const avail = old + 16 + ns;
      if (avail >= size) {
        this.unlink(nextU, classIndex(ns));
        const rem = avail - size;
        if (rem >= 32) { m.write32(addr - 8, size); m.write32(addr + size, size); this.setFree(addr + size + 16, rem - 16); }
        else { m.write32(addr - 8, avail); m.write32(addr + avail, avail); }
        if (zero) m.fill(addr + old, m.read32(addr - 8) - old, 0);
        return addr;
      }
    }
    if (inPlaceOnly) return 0;
    const n = this.alloc(size, false);
    if (!n) return 0;
    m.copy(n, addr, old);
    if (zero) m.fill(n + old, size - old, 0);
    this.free_(addr);
    return n;
  }
}

test('heap: chunkOf through the granule map finds the chunk the linear scan finds, for any address', () => {
  const mem = new GuestMemory(), vmem = new VMem(), rnd = rng(11);
  // two heaps growing in turn: their chunks interleave in the address space, some larger than the 1 MB growth
  const a = new Heap({ mem, vmem, tag: 'a' }), b = new Heap({ mem, vmem, tag: 'b' });
  const probe = (h) => {
    const addrs = [-1, -8, 0, 0x10000, 0x7fffffff, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff, 2 ** 32 + 0x1000, 2 ** 32 + h.chunks[0].base + 64];
    for (const c of [...a.chunks, ...b.chunks]) for (const d of [-16, -8, -1, 0, 1, 8, 16, 23, 24, 25, 0x8000, 0xffff, 0x10000]) addrs.push(c.base + d, c.base + c.size + d - 8, c.base + c.size + d);
    for (let i = 0; i < 20000; i++) addrs.push(rnd() >>> 1, rnd());
    for (const x of addrs) assert.equal(h.chunkOf(x), h.chunkScan(x), `chunkOf(0x${x.toString(16)}) in heap ${h.tag} (${h.chunks.length} chunks)`);
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    for (const h of [a, b]) assert.ok(h.alloc(i % 5 === 0 ? 0x180000 + (rnd() % 0x80000) : 0xa0000 + (rnd() % 0x60000)));
    if (i % 3 === 0) { probe(a); probe(b); }
  }
  assert.ok(a.gmap && b.gmap, 'the granule maps are in use');
  probe(a); probe(b);
  a.destroy();
  assert.equal(a.chunkOf(b.chunks[3].base + 64), null);
  assert.equal(b.chunkOf(b.chunks[3].base + 64), b.chunks[3]);
});

test('heap: chunks sharing a granule (not 64 KB aligned) are found by the scan', () => {
  // (VMem hands out 64 KB granules; a heap given unaligned chunks all the same looks them up correctly)
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  let next = 0x200000 + 0x8000;
  const vmem = { alloc: (size) => { const p = next; next += size + 0x4000; return p; }, release: () => true };
  const h = new Heap({ mem, vmem }), rnd = rng(5);
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) assert.ok(h.alloc(0xc0000));
  assert.ok(h.gmap);
  for (const c of h.chunks) for (let d = -0x10008; d <= c.size + 0x10008; d += 4) assert.equal(h.chunkOf(c.base + d), h.chunkScan(c.base + d));
  for (let i = 0; i < 20000; i++) { const x = 0x200000 + (rnd() % (next - 0x200000)); assert.equal(h.chunkOf(x), h.chunkScan(x)); }
});

/**
 * The same random program on the heap and on the linear-scan heap, each in its own guest memory: the same results, the
 * same memory, the same free lists. The program frees blocks twice, frees addresses that are no block, writes into
 * freed blocks (links into the other heap, into nothing, implausible; sizes) and past the end of its blocks.
 */
function differential(seed, ops) {
  const run = (HeapClass) => {
    const mem = new GuestMemory(), vmem = new VMem(), rnd = rng(seed);
    const heap = new HeapClass({ mem, vmem, tag: 'user' }), other = new HeapClass({ mem, vmem, tag: 'other' });
    const live = [], freed = [], out = [];
    const pick = (arr) => arr[rnd() % arr.length];
    const recent = (arr) => arr[arr.length - 1 - rnd() % Math.min(arr.length, 12)]; // (blocks likely still free)
    /** what the program reads back from a block it got (zeroed or not): a digest of its first and last bytes */
    const digest = (p, n) => {
      let d = 0x811c9dc5;
      n = Math.min(n, 0x7f000000 - p);
      for (let o = 0; o + 4 <= n; o += o < 4096 || o + 4096 >= n ? 4 : n - 4096 - o) d = Math.imul(d ^ mem.read32(p + o), 16777619) >>> 0;
      return d;
    };
    for (let i = 0; i < ops; i++) {
      const r = rnd() % 100, h = rnd() % 4 === 0 ? other : heap;
      if (r < 35 || !live.length) {
        const big = rnd() % 50 === 0, size = big ? 0x40000 + (rnd() % 0x180000) : rnd() % 4 === 0 ? 513 + (rnd() % 6000) : 1 + (rnd() % 600);
        const p = h.alloc(size, rnd() % 3 === 0);
        out.push(p, p && digest(p, h.size(p))); if (p) live.push([h, p]);
      } else if (r < 65) {
        const k = rnd() % live.length, [lh, p] = live[k];
        live.splice(k, 1); freed.push([lh, p]);
        out.push(lh.free_(p));
      } else if (r < 80) {
        const k = rnd() % live.length, [lh, p] = live[k];
        const n = lh.realloc(p, rnd() % 3000, rnd() % 2 === 0, rnd() % 4 === 0);
        out.push(n, n && digest(n, lh.size(n))); if (n) live[k] = [lh, n];
      } else if (r < 83 && freed.length) {
        const [fh, p] = pick(freed); out.push(fh.free_(p)); // (double free)
      } else if (r < 85) {
        out.push(h.free_((rnd() & 0x7ffffff8) >>> 0), h.size(rnd() >>> 1)); // (no block)
      } else if (r < 88 && freed.length) {
        // writes into a freed block (still free or reused since): its next / prev links or its header's size
        const [, p] = recent(freed), w = rnd() % 9;
        const target = w === 0 && live.length ? pick(live)[1] : w === 1 ? pick(freed)[1] : w === 2 ? 0x90000000 : w === 3 ? (p + 8 + (rnd() % 64) * 8)
          : w === 4 ? rnd() >>> 0 : w === 5 ? rnd() % 0x10000 : w === 6 ? 0x7eb00000 + (rnd() % 0x1000) * 8 : (rnd() & 0x7ffffff8) >>> 0;
        if (w === 8) mem.write32(p - 8, rnd() % 4096); else mem.write32(p + (rnd() % 2) * 4, target);
      } else if (r < 90 && freed.length) {
        // a link to a fake free block (header, magic, footer as the program left them): inside the freed block, or ending
        // at its chunk's end sentinel; with sizes small, unaligned, aligned
        const [fh, p] = recent(freed), ch = fh.chunkScan(p);
        const fs = [8, 12, 20, 36, 4 + 8 * (rnd() % 40), 16 + 8 * (rnd() % 40)][rnd() % 6];
        const q = ch && rnd() % 2 ? ch.base + ch.size - 8 - fs : p + 16 + (rnd() % 8) * 8;
        if (q + fs < 0x7f000000) {
          mem.write32(q - 8, fs); mem.write32(q - 4, rnd() % 5 ? MAGIC_FREE : 0x4f524855); mem.write32(q + fs, rnd() % 5 ? fs : fs + 8);
          mem.write32(p, q);
        }
      } else if (r < 97 && live.length) {
        // the program's data in a live block (what a block handed out again, zeroed or not, still holds)
        const [lh, p] = pick(live), s = lh.size(p);
        if (s >= 8 && p + s < 0x7f000000) {
          mem.write32(p, rnd() | 1); mem.write32(p + s - 4, rnd() | 1);
          for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) mem.write32(p + 4 * (rnd() % (s >> 2)), rnd() | 1);
        }
      } else if (live.length) {
        // writes past the end of a live block: its footer, the next block's header
        const [lh, p] = pick(live), s = lh.size(p);
        if (s >= 0 && p + s < 0x7f000000) mem.write32(p + s + (rnd() % 4) * 4, rnd() % 3 === 0 ? MAGIC_FREE : rnd() % 512);
      }
    }
    const blocks = [];
    for (const h of [heap, other]) { h.walk((u, s, used) => blocks.push(u, s, used)); }
    const chunks = [heap, other].map((h) => h.chunks.map((c) => [c.base, c.size]));
    const stats = [heap, other].map((h) => JSON.stringify(h.stats));
    const heads = [heap, other].map((h) => Array.from(h.heads));
    return { mem, out, blocks, chunks, stats, heads, maps: [heap.gmap !== null, other.gmap !== null] };
  };
  const x = run(Heap), y = run(LinearHeap);
  assert.deepEqual(x.out, y.out, 'same results');
  assert.deepEqual(x.chunks, y.chunks, 'same chunks');
  assert.deepEqual(x.heads, y.heads, 'same free-list heads');
  assert.deepEqual(x.stats, y.stats, 'same counters (lists cut, boundary tags)');
  assert.deepEqual(x.blocks, y.blocks, 'same blocks');
  for (const cs of x.chunks) for (const [base, size] of cs) assert.equal(Buffer.compare(x.mem.bytes(base, size), y.mem.bytes(base, size)), 0, `chunk ${base.toString(16)} same bytes`);
  return x;
}

test('heap: allocations, frees and reallocations identical to the linear-scan heap (random programs, damaged lists)', () => {
  let maps = 0, cut = 0;
  for (const seed of [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]) {
    const x = differential(seed, 6000);
    maps += x.maps.filter(Boolean).length;
    cut += x.stats.filter((s) => s.includes('brokenLists')).length;
  }
  assert.ok(maps >= 6, `the granule map took over in the grown heaps (${maps})`);
  assert.ok(cut >= 3, `damaged lists were met and cut (${cut})`);
});
```

`tests/hidden-class.test.js`:

```js
// The objects the dispatcher reads on every slice and API call (the Vm, its threads, the JIT and its stats) keep the
// property set their constructor gives them: a property added later is a new hidden class for V8, and the dispatcher's
// loads of `vm.*` / `thread.*`, seeing several, went megamorphic (a stub-cache lookup each). Same keys in the same
// order is what one hidden class needs.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { Vfs, MemBackend } from '../src/vfs/vfs.js';
import { VirtualClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';

const PE_DIR = new URL('../build/pe/', import.meta.url).pathname;
const skip = (name) => !fs.existsSync(PE_DIR + name) && `build/pe/${name} missing (make pe-tests)`;

function boot(exeName, jit) {
  const vfs = new Vfs();
  const t = new MemBackend();
  vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend());
  vfs.mount('C:\\Test', t);
  t.open(exeName, { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(PE_DIR + exeName));
  // (the images gdiplus.exe loads: without them it uses the null bitmap data it gets, a fault as on Windows)
  if (exeName === 'gdiplus.exe') for (const f of ['rgb.png', 'base.jpg']) t.open(f, { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(new URL(`./fixtures/codec/${f}`, import.meta.url).pathname));
  const clock = new VirtualClock();
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host: new HeadlessHost({ clock, width: 800, height: 600 }), jit, logKinds: ['crash'], nullPage: exeName === 'seh.exe' ? true : undefined }); // (seh.exe: its null-page cases read)
  return vm;
}

for (const exe of ['threads.exe', 'sync.exe', 'window.exe', 'seh.exe', 'asyncread.exe', 'dx.exe', 'dx9.exe', 'gdiplus.exe', 'net.exe']) {
  test(`${exe}: the Vm, its threads and the JIT keep their constructors' properties`, { skip: skip(exe) }, () => {
    const vm = boot(exe, true);
    const same = (o, keys, what) => { const now = Object.keys(o); assert.deepEqual(now, keys, `${what}: added ${now.filter((k) => !keys.includes(k)).join(', ')}`); };
    const vmKeys = Object.keys(vm), jitKeys = Object.keys(vm.jit), statsKeys = Object.keys(vm.jit.stats);
    vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\' + exe });
    const threadKeys = Object.keys(vm.proc.threads[0]);
    vm.run();
    same(vm, vmKeys, 'Vm');
    same(vm.jit, jitKeys, 'Jit');
    same(vm.jit.stats, statsKeys, 'Jit stats');
    assert.ok(vm.proc.threads.length >= 1);
    for (const th of vm.proc.threads) same(th, threadKeys, `thread ${th.id}`);
  });
}
```

`tests/home-preload.test.js`:

```js
// The home's module graph preloaded (src/host/module-graph.js, server.js sendHome): the page carries a
// <link rel="modulepreload"> for every module of its static graph below its first level, its validator its content's
// (a 304 while nothing changed), the page as it is with opts.homePreload false.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';
import http from 'node:http';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { moduleGraph, withPreloads, staticImports } from '../src/host/module-graph.js';
import { createServer } from '../src/host/server.js';

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const HOME = path.join(ROOT, 'src/host/web/index.html');
const get = (url, headers = {}) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => http.get(url, { headers }, (res) => {
  const parts = []; res.on('data', (d) => parts.push(d)); res.on('end', () => resolve({ res, body: Buffer.concat(parts) }));
}).on('error', reject));

test('module graph: levels from the page, deeper ones preloaded before the first module script', () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-graph-'));
  try {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'w'));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'w/index.html'), '<link rel="stylesheet" href="/w/s.css"><script type="module" src="/w/a.js"></script>');
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'w/s.css'), '');
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'w/a.js'), "import { b } from './b.js';\n// import './not.js';\nimport('./later.js');\n");
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'w/b.js'), "export * from './c.js';\nimport './a.js';\n");
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'w/c.js'), "import './gone.js';\n");
    const g = moduleGraph(dir, path.join(dir, 'w/index.html'));
    assert.deepEqual([...g.level].map(([f, d]) => [path.relative(dir, f), d]), [['w/a.js', 1], ['w/b.js', 2], ['w/c.js', 3]], 'a missing module out, a cycle once');
    assert.deepEqual([...g.dynamic].map((f) => path.relative(dir, f)), ['w/later.js']);
    assert.deepEqual(g.css.map((f) => path.relative(dir, f)), ['w/s.css']);
    assert.equal(withPreloads(dir, g.text, g.level),
      '<link rel="stylesheet" href="/w/s.css"><link rel="modulepreload" href="/w/b.js">\n<link rel="modulepreload" href="/w/c.js">\n<script type="module" src="/w/a.js"></script>');
    assert.deepEqual(staticImports("export const x = 1;\nimport y from '/z.js'"), ['/z.js']);
  } finally { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test('server: the home carries its graph\'s deeper levels, revalidated by its content; off: as it is', async (t) => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-home-')); t.after(() => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'man'));
  const servers = [createServer({ manifests: path.join(dir, 'man') }), createServer({ manifests: path.join(dir, 'man'), homePreload: false })];
  for (const s of servers) { await new Promise((r) => s.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r)); t.after(() => new Promise((r) => { s.closeAllConnections(); s.close(r); })); }
  const [on, off] = servers.map((s) => `http://127.0.0.1:${s.address().port}`);
  const g = moduleGraph(ROOT, HOME), deep = [...g.level].filter(([, d]) => d >= 2).map(([f]) => '/' + path.relative(ROOT, f));
  assert.ok(deep.length > 0);
  const plain = await get(`${on}/`);
  assert.equal(plain.res.statusCode, 200);
  const text = plain.body.toString();
  const links = [...text.matchAll(/<link rel="modulepreload" href="([^"]+)">/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
  assert.deepEqual(links.slice().sort(), deep.slice().sort(), 'every module of levels 2+, once');
  assert.ok(!links.includes('/src/host/web/main.js'), 'not the page\'s own scripts');
  assert.ok(text.indexOf('modulepreload') < text.indexOf('<script type="module"'));
  // (brotli for a browser that takes it, the same page)
  const br = await get(`${on}/`, { 'Accept-Encoding': 'br' });
  assert.equal(br.res.headers['content-encoding'], 'br');
  assert.equal(zlib.brotliDecompressSync(br.body).toString(), text);
  // (a returning browser: 304 by the page's content)
  const etag = plain.res.headers.etag;
  assert.equal((await get(`${on}/`, { 'If-None-Match': etag, 'Accept-Encoding': 'br' })).res.statusCode, 304);
  assert.equal((await get(`${on}/index.html`, { 'If-None-Match': 'W/"other"' })).res.statusCode, 200);
  // off: the file as it is
  assert.deepEqual((await get(`${off}/`)).body, fs.readFileSync(HOME));
});
```
