`tests/host-wait.test.js`:

```js
// Host wake-up overshoot (src/core/host-wait.js, docs/thread-scheduling.md "Host wake-up overshoot"): the injected
// coarse timer, the overshoot estimate, the adaptive waits (early wake-up, a spin only for a frame limiter's last
// waits), the pacing-loop prediction, the frame-relevant lateness, the timer arming; and a guest frame limiter without
// catch-up (build/pe/pacing.exe) on an injected 15.625 ms host timer: its frames back to its period with the adaptive
// waits, ~47 ms without — the owner's Windows numbers.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { quantised, OvershootEstimate, HostWaiter, paceEnded, pacePredict, hostWaiter, PACE_SLACK_MS } from '../src/core/host-wait.js';
import { measureHostTiming, summarise, probeLine } from '../src/host/web/timing-probe.js';
import { PerfWindow, compactPhase } from '../src/host/perf-summary.js';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { Vfs, MemBackend } from '../src/vfs/vfs.js';
import { RealClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';

/** Run `f` with the debug globals `g` set (then restored). */
function withGlobals(g, f) {
  const prev = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(g)) { prev[k] = globalThis[k]; if (v === undefined) delete globalThis[k]; else globalThis[k] = v; }
  try { return f(); } finally { for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(prev)) { if (v === undefined) delete globalThis[k]; else globalThis[k] = v; } }
}

/**
 * A fake host: a clock advancing only when waited on (and by `tick` per clock read: a spin advances it), and a host
 * wait that ends at the first `q` boundary at or after the time asked (q 0: `over` ms late), never notified.
 */
function fakeHost({ q = 15.625, over = 0, tick = 0.01, t = 1000.3 } = {}) {
  const h = { t, waits: [], reads: 0 };
  h.now = () => { h.reads++; const v = h.t; h.t += tick; return v; };
  h.wait = (arr, idx, value, ms) => { h.waits.push(ms); const end = h.t + ms; h.t = q > 0 ? Math.ceil(end / q - 1e-9) * q : end + over; return 'timed-out'; };
  return h;
}

test('quantised: whole milliseconds, then the first multiple of the quantum at or after the end', () => {
  assert.equal(quantised(3, 1, 0), 1);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(quantised(3, 1, 15.625) - 12.625) < 1e-9);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(quantised(15, 1, 15.625) - 16.25) < 1e-9); // (16 > 15.625: the next tick)
  assert.ok(Math.abs(quantised(3.4, 0.3, 1) - 1.6) < 1e-9); // (0.3 -> 1 ms, ends at 4.4 -> 5)
  assert.ok(Math.abs(quantised(31.25, 15.625, 15.625) - 31.25) < 1e-9); // (15.625 -> 16 ms: past the next tick)
  withGlobals({ ORTHROS_HOST_TIMER_Q: 15.625 }, () => assert.ok(Math.abs(quantised(3, 1) - 12.625) < 1e-9)); // (the switch)
  assert.equal(quantised(3, 0, 15.625), 0);
});

test('OvershootEstimate: the second largest of the recent samples (one stall does not raise it, a coarse timer does)', () => {
  const e = new OvershootEstimate();
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) e.add(0.05);
  e.add(30); // (a garbage collection)
  assert.ok(e.value < 0.1, `${e.value}`);
  e.add(14); e.add(9);
  assert.equal(e.value, 14);
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) e.add(0.06);
  assert.ok(e.value < 0.1, 'the window forgets');
});

test('HostWaiter: a precise host is waited on plainly (no spin, no early wake-up)', () => {
  withGlobals({ ORTHROS_ADAPTIVE_SLEEP: undefined, ORTHROS_HOST_TIMER_Q: undefined }, () => {
    const h = fakeHost({ q: 0, over: 0.06 }), w = new HostWaiter(h.now, h.wait), arr = new Int32Array(1);
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { w.pace(h.t + 0.5); w.waitUntil(arr, 0, 0, h.t + 1); }
    const s = w.take();
    assert.equal(s.wait.spins, 0); assert.equal(s.wait.early, 0); assert.equal(h.waits.length, 20);
    assert.ok(s.est < 0.1);
  });
});

test('HostWaiter: on a coarse host a frame limiter\'s last waits are spun to the deadline, the others wait', () => {
  withGlobals({ ORTHROS_ADAPTIVE_SLEEP: undefined, ORTHROS_HOST_TIMER_Q: undefined }, () => {
    const h = fakeHost(), w = new HostWaiter(h.now, h.wait), arr = new Int32Array(1);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) w.waitUntil(arr, 0, 0, h.t + 1); // (the estimate learns the coarse timer)
    assert.ok(w.est.value > 10, `estimate ${w.est.value}`);
    // no pacing loop known: a 1 ms wait is a plain host wait (its overshoot accepted: no long spin)
    let d = h.t + 1, n = h.waits.length; w.waitUntil(arr, 0, 0, d);
    assert.equal(h.waits.length, n + 1); assert.ok(h.t - d > 1, 'overslept');
    assert.ok(w.lastLate > 1, 'late for the frame: no loop known');
    // a loop predicted to end 1.5 ms from now: its 1 ms wait is spun, exactly to the deadline
    w.take();
    d = h.t + 1; w.pace(h.t + 1.5); n = h.waits.length; w.waitUntil(arr, 0, 0, d);
    assert.equal(h.waits.length, n, 'no host wait'); assert.ok(h.t >= d && h.t - d < 0.05, `woke ${h.t - d} ms after`);
    const s = w.take(); assert.equal(s.wait.spins, 1); assert.ok(s.wait.spinMs > 0.9 && s.wait.spinMs < 1.1);
    // the same loop 40 ms before its end: an early wait, waited on (late, but not for the frame)
    w.pace(h.t + 40); d = h.t + 1; n = h.waits.length; w.waitUntil(arr, 0, 0, d);
    assert.equal(h.waits.length, n + 1); assert.equal(w.lastLate, 0);
    // a deadline far away: woken earlier by the estimate, the rest waited again
    w.pace(0); d = h.t + 60; n = h.waits.length; w.waitUntil(arr, 0, 0, d);
    assert.ok(h.waits.length >= n + 2 && h.waits[n] < 60 - 10, `asks ${h.waits.slice(n)}`);
    // the switch off: one plain host wait, even at the loop's end
    withGlobals({ ORTHROS_ADAPTIVE_SLEEP: 0 }, () => { w.pace(h.t + 1.5); d = h.t + 1; n = h.waits.length; w.waitUntil(arr, 0, 0, d); assert.equal(h.waits.length, n + 1); assert.ok(h.t - d > 1); });
    // a wait without a deadline that matters (the deadlock watch's): plain, not counted
    w.take(); w.pace(h.t + 1.5); d = h.t + 1; n = h.waits.length; w.waitUntil(arr, 0, 0, d, false);
    assert.equal(h.waits.length, n + 1); assert.equal(w.take().wait.spins, 0);
  });
});

test('HostWaiter: a notified wait returns at once; the window\'s switches reported as its waits saw them', () => {
  withGlobals({ ORTHROS_ADAPTIVE_SLEEP: undefined, ORTHROS_HOST_TIMER_Q: 15.625 }, () => {
    const h = fakeHost({ q: 0 }), w = new HostWaiter(h.now, (a, i, v, ms) => { h.t += 0.2; return 'ok'; }), arr = new Int32Array(1);
    assert.equal(w.waitUntil(arr, 0, 0, h.t + 5), 'ok');
    withGlobals({ ORTHROS_ADAPTIVE_SLEEP: 0 }, () => w.waitUntil(arr, 0, 0, h.t + 5));
    const s = w.take(); assert.equal(s.q, 15.625); assert.equal(s.adaptive, 'mixed'); assert.equal(s.wait.waits, 2);
  });
});

test('HostWaiter.timerArm: armed earlier by the timers\' overshoot, the injected quantum applied', () => {
  withGlobals({ ORTHROS_ADAPTIVE_SLEEP: undefined, ORTHROS_HOST_TIMER_Q: undefined }, () => {
    const w = new HostWaiter(() => 0, () => 'timed-out');
    assert.deepEqual(w.timerArm(10, 0), { ask: 10, delay: 10 });
    w.noteTimer(4, 4); w.noteTimer(5, 5);
    assert.equal(w.timerArm(10, 0).ask, 6);
    assert.equal(w.timerArm(3, 0).ask, 3, 'a wake-up within the estimate: armed plainly');
    withGlobals({ ORTHROS_HOST_TIMER_Q: 15.625 }, () => assert.ok(Math.abs(w.timerArm(3, 1).delay - 14.625) < 1e-9));
    withGlobals({ ORTHROS_ADAPTIVE_SLEEP: 0 }, () => assert.equal(w.timerArm(10, 0).ask, 10));
    assert.equal(w.take().timer.waits, 2);
  });
});

test('pacing loops: the next end from the period (second shortest interval), a late end ignored, a pause forgotten', () => {
  const st = {};
  for (const t of [0, 33.3, 66.6, 100]) paceEnded(st, t);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(pacePredict(st, 110) - 133.3) < 1e-9);
  paceEnded(st, 147); // (one late frame)
  assert.ok(Math.abs(pacePredict(st, 150) - 180.3) < 1e-9, `${pacePredict(st, 150)}`);
  assert.equal(pacePredict(st, 180.3 + PACE_SLACK_MS + 1), -1, 'past the end: no prediction');
  paceEnded(st, 5000); // (a pause)
  assert.equal(st.paceEnds.length, 1); assert.equal(pacePredict(st, 5001), -1);
  const odd = {}; for (const t of [0, 33.3, 40, 73.3, 106.6]) paceEnded(odd, t); // (one short loop in between)
  assert.ok(Math.abs(pacePredict(odd, 110) - 139.9) < 1e-9, `${pacePredict(odd, 110)}`);
  const few = {}; for (const t of [0, 33, 66]) paceEnded(few, t);
  assert.equal(pacePredict(few, 70), -1, 'three ends: too few');
});

test('frame summaries and bench phases carry the host waits', () => {
  const win = new PerfWindow();
  const acct = { frames: 15, h: [33, 15], max: 34, w: 10, c: { wait: 20 } };
  win.add({ dt: 0.5, acct, hostWait: { waits: 100, overMs: 50, lateMs: 30, spins: 10, spinMs: 5, est: 14, timerEst: 3 } });
  win.add({ dt: 0.5, acct, hostWait: { waits: 300, overMs: 150, lateMs: 60, spins: 40, spinMs: 35, est: 14.5, timerEst: 3 } });
  const s = win.take();
  assert.deepEqual(s.hostWait, { waits: 200, overMean: 0.5, lateMsPerFrame: 1, spinMsPerFrame: 1, est: 14.5, timerEst: 3 });
  const ph = compactPhase({ label: 'menu', frames: 100, hostWait: { wait: { waits: 10, overMean: 1, overMax: 15, lateMs: 50, hist: [1], spins: 3, spinMs: 20 }, est: 14, timerEst: 2, timer: null, q: 15.625, adaptive: true } });
  assert.equal(ph.hostWait.lateMsPerFrame, 0.5); assert.equal(ph.hostWait.spinMsPerFrame, 0.2); assert.equal(ph.hostWait.injected, 15.625);
});

test('timing probe: Atomics.wait / setTimeout / hop overshoots measured, the injected timer seen', async () => {
  assert.deepEqual(summarise([3, 1, 2]), { n: 3, mean: 2, p50: 2, p90: 3, max: 3 });
  const p = await measureHostTiming({ n: 6 });
  for (const k of ['atomicsWait1', 'atomicsWait1Timer', 'setTimeout0', 'setTimeout1', 'messageHop']) assert.equal(p[k].n, 6, k);
  assert.ok(p.atomicsWait1.p50 < 5, `this host: ${probeLine(p)}`);
  const c = await measureHostTiming({ n: 4, q: 15.625 });
  assert.ok(c.atomicsWait1.p50 > 5 && c.setTimeout1.p50 > 5, probeLine(c));
  assert.match(probeLine({ ...c, battery: { charging: false, level: 0.42 } }), /Atomics\.wait\(1\) \+[\d.]+ \/ [\d.]+.*battery 42 % on battery \[injected 15\.625 ms timer\]/);
});

const PE = new URL('../build/pe/pacing.exe', import.meta.url).pathname;
const skip = !fs.existsSync(PE) && 'build/pe/pacing.exe missing (make pe-tests)';

/** pacing.exe on the real clock with the debug globals `g`: its frame intervals (ms, sorted) after the first ten. */
function runPacing(g) {
  return withGlobals(g, () => {
    const vfs = new Vfs(), t = new MemBackend();
    vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend());
    vfs.mount('C:\\Test', t);
    t.open('pacing.exe', { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(PE));
    const clock = new RealClock();
    const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host: new HeadlessHost({ clock }), jit: true, logKinds: ['warn', 'crash'] });
    vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\pacing.exe' });
    const marks = [], dispatch = vm.dispatchThunk.bind(vm);
    vm.dispatchThunk = (th, i) => { if (vm.api.thunk(i)?.name === 'GetVersion') marks.push(performance.now()); return dispatch(th, i); };
    hostWaiter.take();
    const code = vm.run();
    assert.equal(code, 0);
    const iv = marks.slice(11).map((x, k) => x - marks[10 + k]).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    return { iv, p50: iv[iv.length >> 1], p90: iv[Math.floor(iv.length * 0.9)], hw: hostWaiter.take() };
  });
}

test('a frame limiter on an injected 15.625 ms host timer: ~47 ms frames, back to its 33 ms with the adaptive waits', { skip }, (t) => {
  const off = runPacing({ ORTHROS_HOST_TIMER_Q: 15.625, ORTHROS_ADAPTIVE_SLEEP: 0 });
  const on = runPacing({ ORTHROS_HOST_TIMER_Q: 15.625, ORTHROS_ADAPTIVE_SLEEP: undefined });
  const msg = `off p50 ${off.p50.toFixed(1)} p90 ${off.p90.toFixed(1)}, on p50 ${on.p50.toFixed(1)} p90 ${on.p90.toFixed(1)} (spin ${on.hw.wait?.spinMs} ms)`;
  t.diagnostic(msg);
  assert.ok(off.p50 > 40, msg); // (each frame: the last throttled Sleep(0) wakes at the next 15.625 ms tick)
  // (p90 under 42, not 37: a real-clock run descheduled by a loaded machine — make test's parallel files, load ~30 —
  // measured p90 38.0 with p50 33.7; the coarse timer without the fix puts every frame at ~47)
  assert.ok(on.p50 < 35.5 && on.p90 < 42, msg);
  assert.ok(on.hw.wait.spins > 0 && off.hw.wait.spins === 0, msg);
  // (bounded CPU: the spin covers the loop's last ~estimate ms, not the whole wait — under half of the 33 ms frame)
  assert.ok(on.hw.wait.spinMs / on.iv.length < 20, msg);
});
```

`tests/http-backend-ahead-budget.test.js`:

```js
// The learned read-ahead's budget (NetLink.aheadBudget, HttpBackend.pumpAhead — docs/slow-network.md "Read-ahead by the
// link's bandwidth-delay product"): requests in flight by the link's class, on a fast HTTP/2 link as many as keep two
// bandwidth-delay products in flight; and the whole-block pass's blocks on their way registered (blockFlights), so the
// pieces ahead skip them and a parked read joins them rather than asking the same bytes twice at once.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { HttpBackend, BLOCK, CHUNK } from '../src/vfs/http-backend.js';
import { NetLink, AHEAD_REQUESTS, AHEAD_REQUESTS_MID, AHEAD_REQUESTS_MAX, AHEAD_BDP, AHEAD_BYTES_MIN } from '../src/vfs/net-link.js';

const SIZE = 48 * BLOCK;
const byteAt = (i) => (i * 29 + (i >> 10)) & 0xff;
const bytes = (a, b) => Uint8Array.from({ length: b - a }, (_, k) => byteAt(a + k));
const tree = () => ({ dirs: {}, files: { 'f.big': { size: SIZE, mtime: 1 } } });

globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = class {
  open(m, url) { this.url = url; }
  setRequestHeader(k, v) { this.range = v; }
  send() { const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(this.range); this.status = 206; this.response = bytes(+a, +b + 1).buffer; }
};
function fakeFetch() {
  const calls = [];
  const fn = (url, init = {}) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(init.headers.Range);
    const call = { start: +a, end: +b + 1, signal: init.signal, settled: false,
      release: () => { if (call.settled) return; call.settled = true; resolve({ status: 206, headers: { get: () => null }, arrayBuffer: async () => bytes(+a, +b + 1).buffer }); } };
    init.signal?.addEventListener('abort', () => { if (!call.settled) { call.settled = true; reject(new DOMException('aborted', 'AbortError')); } });
    calls.push(call);
  });
  return { calls, fn };
}
const tick = (ms = 0) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
async function withFetch(body) {
  const real = globalThis.fetch, f = fakeFetch();
  globalThis.fetch = f.fn;
  try { await body(f.calls); } finally { globalThis.fetch = real; }
}
class MemStore {
  constructor() { this.m = new Map(); this.failed = false; }
  get map() { return this.m; }
  get(k) { return this.m.get(k)?.slice() ?? null; }
  put(k, b) { if (!this.m.has(k)) this.m.set(k, b.slice()); }
  flush() {}
}
/** a link measured at `bw` bytes/s with a round trip of `rtt` ms, over `protocol` (fixed: the fake answers measure nothing) */
const link = (bw, rtt = 85, protocol = 'h2') => { const net = new NetLink({ bw, protocol, fixed: true }); net.measured = true; net.rtt = rtt; return net; };

test('ahead budget: a thin link and HTTP/1.x a few requests, a mid link more, a fast HTTP/2 link by its bandwidth-delay product', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(link(85e3).aheadBudget(), { requests: AHEAD_REQUESTS, bytes: Infinity }, 'thin');
  assert.deepEqual(link(1.8e6).aheadBudget(), { requests: AHEAD_REQUESTS_MID, bytes: Infinity }, 'between thin and fast');
  assert.deepEqual(new NetLink({}).aheadBudget(), { requests: AHEAD_REQUESTS_MID, bytes: Infinity }, 'not measured yet');
  assert.deepEqual(link(8e6, 85, 'http/1.1').aheadBudget(), { requests: AHEAD_REQUESTS, bytes: Infinity }, 'fast, HTTP/1.1: six connections shared with the game');
  assert.deepEqual(new NetLink({ fixed: true }).aheadBudget(), { requests: AHEAD_REQUESTS, bytes: Infinity }, 'fixed, not measured (local policies)');
  const f = link(8e6, 85).aheadBudget();
  assert.equal(f.requests, AHEAD_REQUESTS_MAX);
  assert.equal(f.bytes, Math.round(AHEAD_BDP * 8e6 * 0.085), 'two bandwidth-delay products');
  assert.equal(link(3.5e6, 10).aheadBudget().bytes, AHEAD_BYTES_MIN, 'a short round trip: a mid link\'s pieces at least');
});

test('fast HTTP/2 link: the learned pieces ahead keep about two bandwidth-delay products in flight, AHEAD_REQUESTS_MID pieces at least; none asked twice', { timeout: 20000 }, () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  for (const [bw, rtt] of [[8e6, 85], [3.5e6, 20], [40e6, 150]]) {
    calls.length = 0;
    const store = new MemStore(), net = link(bw, rtt);
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/a/', tree(), { store, net });
    b.fillBackground = () => {}; b.noteMiss = () => {};
    let stopped = false;
    // (40 learned entries, one 64 KiB piece of each: a map's small files)
    b.prefetch(Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => ['f.big', i, 0b1, i]), {}, () => stopped);
    try {
      await tick();
      b.chunks.set('f.big#0', bytes(0, CHUNK)); b.chunkBytes += CHUNK;
      b.open('f.big').read(10, 10); // (the game reads entry 0: the next entries' pieces go ahead)
      await tick(30);
      const ahead = calls.filter((c) => c.end - c.start === CHUNK);
      const wanted = () => { const { bytes: budget } = net.aheadBudget(); let n = 0; while (n < AHEAD_REQUESTS_MAX && (n < AHEAD_REQUESTS || n * CHUNK < budget)) n++; return n; };
      const want = wanted();
      assert.equal(ahead.length, want, `${bw / 1e6} MB/s, ${rtt} ms: ${want} requests ahead`);
      assert.equal(b.learned.inBytes, want * CHUNK);
      // (the whole-block pass beside them: never the same bytes at once)
      const seen = new Set();
      for (const c of calls) for (let p = Math.floor(c.start / CHUNK); p * CHUNK < c.end; p++) { assert.ok(!seen.has(p), `piece ${p} asked twice`); seen.add(p); }
      // (one comes: its bytes counted down, another goes — or waits for its turn on the link — within the budget as the
      // link is measured again: here its round trip, the fake answer's, shorter — AHEAD_REQUESTS_MID still at least)
      ahead[0].release(); await tick(30);
      assert.equal(b.learned.inBytes, b.learned.inFlight * CHUNK);
      assert.ok(want >= AHEAD_REQUESTS_MID && b.learned.inFlight >= AHEAD_REQUESTS_MID && b.learned.inFlight <= want);
    } finally { stopped = true; for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(30); for (const c of calls) c.release(); }
  }
}));

test('a mid link keeps AHEAD_REQUESTS_MID ahead, a fast HTTP/1.1 one AHEAD_REQUESTS', { timeout: 20000 }, () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  for (const [net, want] of [[link(1.8e6), AHEAD_REQUESTS_MID], [link(8e6, 85, 'http/1.1'), AHEAD_REQUESTS]]) {
    calls.length = 0;
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/a/', tree(), { store: new MemStore(), net });
    b.fillBackground = () => {}; b.noteMiss = () => {};
    let stopped = false;
    b.lastSyncFetchAt = performance.now() + 1e9; // (the learned pass waits on a link that is not fast)
    b.prefetch(Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => ['f.big', i, 0b1, i]), {}, () => stopped);
    try {
      await tick();
      b.chunks.set('f.big#0', bytes(0, CHUNK)); b.chunkBytes += CHUNK;
      b.open('f.big').read(10, 10);
      await tick(30);
      assert.equal(b.learned.inFlight, want);
    } finally { stopped = true; for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(30); for (const c of calls) c.release(); }
  }
}));

test('fast link: a block the whole-block pass downloads is on its way — the pieces ahead skip it, a parked read joins it', { timeout: 20000 }, () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const store = new MemStore();
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/a/', tree(), { store, net: link(8e6, 85) });
  b.fillBackground = () => {}; b.noteMiss = () => {};
  let stopped = false;
  const pf = b.prefetch([['f.big', 3, 0xffff, 0]], {}, () => stopped);
  try {
    for (let i = 0; i < 250 && !calls.length; i++) await tick(20);
    assert.deepEqual(calls.map((c) => [c.start / BLOCK, c.end / BLOCK]), [[3, 4]], 'the whole block');
    assert.ok(b.blockFlights.has('f.big#3'), 'registered as on its way');
    // (the game reads in it: it waits for that request rather than asking its bytes again)
    const read = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 3 * BLOCK + 10, 3 * BLOCK + 20, false);
    await tick(30);
    assert.equal(calls.length, 1, 'no second request for the same bytes');
    calls[0].release();
    await read; await pf;
    assert.ok(store.m.has(`f.big#${SIZE}#1#3`), 'stored');
    assert.ok(!b.blockFlights.has('f.big#3'), 'no longer on its way');
    assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
  } finally { stopped = true; for (const c of calls) c.release(); }
}));

test('fast HTTP/2 link: whole learned blocks ahead stay bounded by bytes — AHEAD_REQUESTS of them, as before, not a count of pieces', { timeout: 20000 }, () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const net = link(8e6, 85), b = new HttpBackend('/game/a/', tree(), { store: new MemStore(), net });
  b.fillBackground = () => {}; b.noteMiss = () => {};
  let stopped = false;
  b.lastSyncFetchAt = performance.now() + 1e9; // (the game busy: the whole-block pass beside it one request at most)
  b.prefetch(Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => ['f.big', i, 0xffff, i]), {}, () => stopped);
  try {
    await tick();
    b.chunks.set('f.big#0', bytes(0, CHUNK)); b.chunkBytes += CHUNK;
    b.open('f.big').read(10, 10);
    await tick(30);
    const blocks = calls.filter((c) => c.end - c.start === BLOCK && b.flights.has(`f.big#${c.start / CHUNK}`));
    assert.ok(3 * BLOCK > net.aheadBudget().bytes, 'three blocks past the budget');
    assert.equal(blocks.length, AHEAD_REQUESTS);
    assert.equal(b.learned.inFlight, AHEAD_REQUESTS);
  } finally { stopped = true; for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(30); for (const c of calls) c.release(); }
}));

test('fast link: a whole-block pass request still waiting for its turn is given up to the pieces ahead; a started one is skipped', { timeout: 20000 }, () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const net = link(8e6, 85), b = new HttpBackend('/game/a/', tree(), { store: new MemStore(), net });
  b.fillBackground = () => {}; b.noteMiss = () => {};
  let stopped = false;
  // (the link's turns closed to whole blocks: the pass's requests wait in NetLink.waiters, as behind a load's reads)
  const mayStart = net.mayStart.bind(net); let open = false;
  net.mayStart = (...a) => (open || a[2] < BLOCK ? mayStart(...a) : false);
  b.prefetch([['f.big', 0, 0b1, 0], ['f.big', 5, 0b11, 1], ['f.big', 9, 0b1, 2]], {}, () => stopped);
  try {
    for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !b.blockFlights.has('f.big#5'); i++) await tick(10);
    const pass = b.blockFlights.get('f.big#5');
    assert.ok(pass && net.waiters.includes(pass.w), 'the pass\'s block 5 queued');
    b.chunks.set('f.big#0', bytes(0, CHUNK)); b.chunkBytes += CHUNK;
    b.open('f.big').read(10, 10);
    await tick(30);
    assert.ok(!net.waiters.includes(pass.w) && b.blockFlights.get('f.big#5') !== pass, 'given up');
    const p5 = calls.filter((c) => c.start >= 5 * BLOCK && c.start < 6 * BLOCK);
    assert.deepEqual(p5.map((c) => [c.start, c.end]), [[5 * BLOCK, 5 * BLOCK + 2 * CHUNK]], 'its learned pieces go ahead, once');
  } finally { stopped = true; open = true; for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(30); for (const c of calls) c.release(); }
}));

test('fast link: a read that joined the whole-block pass\'s request finds its block in memory though the store dropped it', { timeout: 20000 }, () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const store = new MemStore(); store.put = () => {}; // (full: every block dropped)
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/a/', tree(), { store, net: link(8e6, 85) });

    assert.ok(b.cache.has('f.big#3'), 'in memory');
  } finally { stopped = true; for (const c of calls) c.release(); }
}));
```

`tests/http-backend-ahead-review.test.js`:

```js
// Review: the learned prefetch pass must terminate when the store keeps nothing (a full in-memory store drops new
// blocks silently), instead of downloading the same entry again and again.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { HttpBackend } from '../src/vfs/http-backend.js';

const MiB = 1 << 20;
const SIZE = 4 * MiB;
const byteAt = (i) => (i * 31 + (i >> 9)) & 0xff;
const bytes = (a, b) => Uint8Array.from({ length: b - a }, (_, k) => byteAt(a + k));
const tree = () => ({ dirs: {}, files: { 'f.big': { size: SIZE, mtime: 1 } } });

test('learned prefetch: a store that refuses every block does not make the pass loop forever', async () => {
  const real = globalThis.fetch;
  let calls = 0;
  globalThis.fetch = async (url, init = {}) => {
    calls++;
    const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(init.headers.Range);
    return { status: 206, arrayBuffer: async () => bytes(+a, +b + 1).buffer };
  };
  try {
    const full = { map: new Map(), failed: false, put() {}, get: () => null, flush() {} }; // (full: drops every put)
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/r/', tree(), { store: full });
    b.fillBackground = () => {};
    const progress = {};
    let stopped = false;
    const pf = b.prefetch([['f.big', 0], ['f.big', 2], ['f.big', 3]], progress, () => stopped);
    for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !progress.done; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
    stopped = true; await pf;
    assert.ok(progress.done, 'the pass ends');
    assert.equal(calls, 2, 'each entry downloaded once (2 and 3 in one request)');
  } finally { globalThis.fetch = real; }
});
```

`tests/http-backend-ahead.test.js`:

```js
// Learned prefetch that follows the game: the server learns which 64 KiB pieces sessions read in each block, the
// backend follows the game's position in the learned list (whole blocks from there on) and fetches the learned pieces
// of the next entries ahead of the game's reads. Fake fetch (answers released by the test) and fake synchronous XHR.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { HttpBackend, BLOCK, CHUNK } from '../src/vfs/http-backend.js';
import { NetLink } from '../src/vfs/net-link.js';

const MiB = 1 << 20;
const SIZE = 8 * MiB;
const byteAt = (i) => (i * 29 + (i >> 10)) & 0xff;
const bytes = (a, b) => Uint8Array.from({ length: b - a }, (_, k) => byteAt(a + k));
const tree = () => ({ dirs: {}, files: { 'f.big': { size: SIZE, mtime: 1 } } });

const syncReqs = [];
globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = class {
  open(m, url) { this.url = url; }
  setRequestHeader(k, v) { this.range = v; }
  send() { const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(this.range); syncReqs.push([+a, +b + 1]); this.status = 206; this.response = bytes(+a, +b + 1).buffer; }
};
function fakeFetch() {
  const calls = [];
  const fn = (url, init = {}) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(init.headers.Range);
    const call = { url, start: +a, end: +b + 1, signal: init.signal, settled: false,
      release: () => { if (call.settled) return; call.settled = true; resolve({ status: 206, arrayBuffer: async () => bytes(+a, +b + 1).buffer }); } };
    init.signal?.addEventListener('abort', () => { if (!call.settled) { call.settled = true; reject(new DOMException('aborted', 'AbortError')); } });
    calls.push(call);
  });
  return { calls, fn };
}
const tick = (ms = 0) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
async function withFetch(body) {
  const real = globalThis.fetch, f = fakeFetch();
  globalThis.fetch = f.fn;
  try { await body(f.calls); } finally { globalThis.fetch = real; }
}
const memStore = () => { const map = new Map(); return { map, failed: false, has: (k) => map.has(k), put: (k, v) => { if (!map.has(k)) map.set(k, v.slice()); }, get: (k) => map.get(k)?.slice() ?? null, flush() {} }; };
const addPiece = (b, c) => { b.chunks.set(`f.big#${c}`, bytes(c * CHUNK, (c + 1) * CHUNK)); b.chunkBytes += CHUNK; };

test('learned prefetch: whole blocks from the game\'s position in the list on, then the ones before it', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const store = memStore();
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/a/', tree(), { store });
  b.fillBackground = () => {}; // (the blocks the game touches are not fetched by the block fill here)
  b.lastSyncFetchAt = performance.now() + 1e9; // the game is reading: the prefetch waits
  const progress = {};
  const pf = b.prefetch([['f.big', 0], ['f.big', 1], ['f.big', 5], ['f.big', 6], ['f.big', 3]], progress);
  await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.length, 0);
  addPiece(b, 5 * (BLOCK / CHUNK));
  assert.deepEqual(b.open('f.big').read(5 * MiB + 3, 10), bytes(5 * MiB + 3, 5 * MiB + 13)); // the game reaches entry 2
  assert.equal(b.learned.pos, 2);
  b.lastSyncFetchAt = -1e9;
  for (let i = 0; i < 20 && !calls.length; i++) await tick(20);
  assert.deepEqual([calls[0].start, calls[0].end], [6 * MiB, 7 * MiB], 'the entry past the game first (block 5 is not stored: the game only read a piece of it)');
  for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !progress.done; i++) { for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(20); }
  await pf;
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((c) => c.start / MiB), [6, 3, 0, 5], 'then the rest of the list past it, then from the start (0 and 1 in one request)');
  for (const i of [0, 1, 3, 5, 6]) assert.ok(store.has(`f.big#${SIZE}#1#${i}`), `block ${i} stored`);
}));

test('learned pieces: fetched ahead of the game, not aborted by its reads, waited for by a parked read', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const store = memStore();
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/b/', tree(), { store });
  b.fillBackground = () => {}; b.noteMiss = () => {}; // (the learned pieces alone: no block downloads for the reads that miss)
  b.lastSyncFetchAt = performance.now() + 1e9; // (the whole-block pass stays out of the way)
  const P = BLOCK / CHUNK;
  let stopped = false;
  b.prefetch([['f.big', 0, 0b1], ['f.big', 1, 0b100], ['f.big', 2, 0b1011], ['f.big', 3, 0xffff], ['f.big', 4, 0b1], ['f.big', 7]], {}, () => stopped);
  await tick();
  addPiece(b, 0);
  const f = b.open('f.big');
  assert.deepEqual(f.read(100, 50), bytes(100, 150)); // the game reads entry 0: the next entries' pieces are fetched
  const ranges = calls.map((c) => [c.start, c.end]);
  assert.deepEqual(ranges, [[MiB + 2 * CHUNK, MiB + 3 * CHUNK], [2 * MiB, 2 * MiB + 2 * CHUNK], [2 * MiB + 3 * CHUNK, 2 * MiB + 4 * CHUNK]],
    'the learned pieces of entries 1 and 2 (runs of pieces), three requests at most');
  // the game reads synchronously elsewhere: the requests ahead go on
  f.read(6 * MiB + 5, 10);
  assert.ok(calls.every((c) => !c.signal.aborted));
  // a parked read of a piece in flight waits for it instead of asking again
  const p = f.prepare(MiB + 2 * CHUNK + 7, 100);
  assert.ok(p);
  await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.length, 3, 'no second request for that piece');
  calls[0].release();
  await p;
  const n = syncReqs.length;
  assert.deepEqual(f.read(MiB + 2 * CHUNK + 7, 100), bytes(MiB + 2 * CHUNK + 7, MiB + 2 * CHUNK + 107));
  assert.equal(syncReqs.length, n, 'served from the pieces fetched ahead');
  // a request slot freed: the next entry (every piece learned) is fetched as its whole block, stored
  await tick();
  assert.deepEqual([calls[3].start, calls[3].end], [3 * MiB, 4 * MiB]);
  for (const c of calls) c.release();
  await tick(10);
  assert.ok(store.has(`f.big#${SIZE}#1#3`), 'a block wanted whole is stored');
  assert.ok(b.chunks.has(`f.big#${2 * P + 3}`));
  // entry 5 has no mask (learned before masks): left to the whole-block pass
  assert.ok(calls.every((c) => c.start < 7 * MiB));
  assert.equal(b.stats.aheadRequests, 5);
  stopped = true;
}));

test('server: the learned list carries the pieces sessions read in each block', async () => {
  const fs = await import('node:fs'), path = await import('node:path'), os = await import('node:os'), http = await import('node:http');
  const { createServer } = await import('../src/host/server.js');
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-mask-'));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'a.big'), bytes(0, 3 * MiB));
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'man')); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'man', 'g.json'), JSON.stringify({ name: 'g', folder: dir, exe: 'x.exe' }));
  const learnDir = path.join(dir, 'learn'); fs.mkdirSync(learnDir);
  // an earlier learned file, from before masks: its block stays without a mask until a session reads it
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(learnDir, 'prefetch-g.json'), JSON.stringify([['a.big#2', 5, 1], ['a.big#0', 1, 3]]));
  const server = createServer({ manifests: path.join(dir, 'man'), learnDir });
  await new Promise((r) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
  const get = async (u) => { const r = await new Promise((res, rej) => http.get(base + u, res).on('error', rej)); const parts = []; for await (const d of r) parts.push(d); return Buffer.concat(parts); };
  try {
    await get(`/gamez/g/a.big?r=${MiB}-${MiB + 10}&s=s1`);
    await get(`/gamez/g/a.big?r=${MiB + 3 * CHUNK + 1}-${MiB + 3 * CHUNK + 5}&s=s1`); // (same session, same block)
    await get(`/gamez/g/a.big?r=${MiB + 5 * CHUNK}-${MiB + 7 * CHUNK}&s=s2`);
    await get(`/gamez/g/a.big?r=${MiB + 9 * CHUNK}-${MiB + 10 * CHUNK}&p=1`); // (a prefetch request: not learned)
    await get(`/gamez/g/a.big?r=${CHUNK - 1}-${CHUNK + 1}&s=s2`); // (across a piece boundary)
    const list = JSON.parse(await get('/api/prefetch/g'));
    const byKey = Object.fromEntries(list.map(([p, b, m]) => [`${p}#${b}`, m]));
    assert.equal(byKey['a.big#1'], 0b1101001, 'pieces 0, 3 (session 1), 5 and 6 (session 2)');
    assert.equal(byKey['a.big#0'], 0b11);
    assert.equal(byKey['a.big#2'], 0, 'no mask learned yet (0: unknown)');
    const e2 = list.find(([p, b]) => b === 2);
    assert.equal(e2.length, 4); assert.ok(Number.isInteger(e2[3]) && e2[3] >= 0, 'the time it was first needed (ms)');
  } finally { server.close(); fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test('learned prefetch: runs beside a block fill that always has blocks to fetch, leaves it the block it is fetching', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const store = memStore();
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/c/', tree(), { store });
  b.lastSyncFetchAt = -1e9;
  // the game keeps touching new blocks: the fill always has one more to fetch (here: it never ends)
  b.want.set('f.big#2', { path: 'f.big', size: SIZE, mtime: 1, index: 2 });
  b.want.set('f.big#6', { path: 'f.big', size: SIZE, mtime: 1, index: 6 });
  b.fillBackground();
  await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1, 'the fill downloads block 2');
  const progress = {};
  const pf = b.prefetch([['f.big', 2], ['f.big', 4], ['f.big', 6]], progress);
  for (let i = 0; i < 20 && calls.length < 2; i++) await tick(20);
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((c) => c.start / MiB), [2, 4], 'the prefetch goes on beside the fill, without block 2 (the fill\'s)');
  calls[1].release(); // block 4, stored by the prefetch
  for (let i = 0; i < 20 && calls.length < 3; i++) await tick(20);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 3);
  assert.equal(calls[2].start / MiB, 6, 'then block 6 (the fill has not reached it)');
  calls[2].release();
  for (let i = 0; i < 20 && !store.has(`f.big#${SIZE}#1#6`); i++) await tick(20);
  calls[0].release(); // block 2: the fill installs and stores it
  for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !progress.done; i++) await tick(20);
  await pf;
  for (let i = 0; i < 40 && b.filling; i++) await tick(10);
  assert.equal(b.filling, false);
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((c) => c.start / MiB), [2, 4, 6], 'the fill does not fetch block 6 again (stored by the prefetch), nor the prefetch block 2');
  for (const i of [2, 4, 6]) assert.ok(store.has(`f.big#${SIZE}#1#${i}`), `block ${i} stored`);
}));

test('during a load the learned pieces ahead go only while the game follows the order; a jump elsewhere or reads outside it silence them', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const files = {}; for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) files[`e${i}.dat`] = { size: 2 * CHUNK, mtime: 1 };
  files['save.dat'] = { size: 4 * CHUNK, mtime: 1 };
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/a/', { dirs: {}, files }, { store: memStore(), net: new NetLink({ bw: 1.5e6, fixed: true }) });
  b.fillBackground = () => {};
  let stopped = true;
  await b.prefetch(Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => [`e${i}.dat`, 0, 0b1, i * 10]), {}, () => stopped); // (the entries only)
  stopped = false;
  const rank = (c) => Number(/e(\d+)\.dat/.exec(c.url)[1]);
  const w = b.net.wait(); // (the game blocked on a read: a load)
  assert.ok(b.net.silenced());
  b.noteBlock('e20.dat', 0); await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.length, 0, 'a first touch at another place: not followed yet, nothing ahead during the load');
  b.noteBlock('e21.dat', 0); b.noteBlock('e22.dat', 0); await tick();
  assert.ok(b.learned.tracked, 'followed: three first touches going forward');
  assert.ok(calls.length > 0 && calls.every((c) => rank(c) > 22), `the load's next reads, during it: ${calls.map(rank)}`);
  for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(); await tick();
  // (a jump back in the order: another place — not followed any more, nothing more ahead)
  b.noteBlock('e3.dat', 0);
  assert.equal(b.learned.tracked, false);
  for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(); await tick();
  const n = calls.length;
  b.noteBlock('e4.dat', 0); await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.length, n, 'one step is not yet following');
  b.noteBlock('e5.dat', 0); await tick();
  assert.ok(calls.length > n, 'followed again');
  // (reads outside the order — a save file — lose the position)
  for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) b.noteBlock('save.dat', k);
  assert.equal(b.learned.tracked, false);
  b.net.waitEnd(w);
  for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick();
}));

// (`n` learned entries of one piece each, the backend between thin and fast, the list in place — its pass stopped)
async function learnedEntries(n = 40) {
  const files = {}; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) files[`e${i}.dat`] = { size: 2 * CHUNK, mtime: 1 };
  const net = new NetLink({ bw: 1.5e6, fixed: true });
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/a/', { dirs: {}, files }, { store: memStore(), net });
  b.fillBackground = () => {};
  let stopped = true;
  await b.prefetch(Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => [`e${i}.dat`, 0, 0b1, i * 10]), {}, () => stopped);
  stopped = false;
  return { b, net, rank: (c) => Number(/e(\d+)\.dat/.exec(c.url)[1]) };
}

test('ahead pieces queued before the position was followed go during the load once it is (their forLoad read at their turn)', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const { b, net, rank } = await learnedEntries();
  const dem = net.begin('demand', 512 << 10); // (a read of the game's on the link: the ahead requests wait for their turn)
  b.noteBlock('e20.dat', 0); await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.length, 0); assert.ok(net.waiters.length > 0, 'queued, not followed yet');
  const ws = [net.wait(), net.wait(), net.wait()]; // (a load begins)
  assert.ok(net.silenced());
  b.noteBlock('e21.dat', 0); b.noteBlock('e22.dat', 0);
  assert.ok(b.learned.tracked);
  net.end(dem, 512 << 10); await tick();
  assert.ok(net.silenced(), 'still loading');
  assert.ok(calls.length > 0 && calls.every((c) => rank(c) > 20), `the ones queued before go now: ${calls.map(rank)}`);
  for (const w of ws) net.waitEnd(w);
  for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick();
}));

test('a few first touches out of order (the engine\'s threads) keep the position followed; reads mostly outside the order lose it, and the turns queued meanwhile wait', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const { b, net } = await learnedEntries(120);
  const ws = [net.wait(), net.wait(), net.wait()];
  for (const [r, tracked] of [[20, false], [21, false], [23, true], [22, true], [24, true], [25, true]]) {
    b.noteBlock(`e${r}.dat`, 0); assert.equal(b.learned.tracked, tracked, `after e${r}`);
  }
  assert.equal(b.learned.pos, 25);
  await tick(); assert.ok(calls.length > 0, 'its pieces ahead go during the load');
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(); }
  // (a demand read fills the link: the next ahead turns queue — forLoad while followed)
  const dem = net.begin('demand', 512 << 10);
  b.noteBlock('e26.dat', 0); await tick();
  const n = calls.length, queued = net.waiters.length;
  assert.ok(queued > 0, 'queued behind the demand read');
  // (three blocks outside the order for each one in it: not the place the order describes)
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) b.noteBlock('save.dat', k);
  b.noteBlock('e27.dat', 0);
  for (let k = 3; k < 6; k++) b.noteBlock('save.dat', k);
  assert.equal(b.learned.tracked, false, 'mostly outside the order');
  net.end(dem, 512 << 10); await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.length, n, 'the turns queued while followed wait for the load now');
  for (const w of ws) net.waitEnd(w);
  for (let i = 0; i < 30 && calls.length === n; i++) await tick(30);
  assert.ok(calls.length > n, 'after the load');
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(); }
}));

```

`tests/http-backend-async.test.js`:

```js
// HTTP game file backend, asynchronous side: the background downloads (whole blocks a random read touched, the
// learned prefetch) and the asynchronous reads (fetchAhead, a parked ReadFile) share the network. Modeled with a fake
// fetch whose answers are released by the test in a chosen order, and a fake synchronous XHR.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { HttpBackend, BLOCK, CHUNK } from '../src/vfs/http-backend.js';

const MiB = 1 << 20;
const SIZE = 8 * MiB;
const byteAt = (i) => (i * 13 + (i >> 9)) & 0xff;
const bytes = (a, b) => Uint8Array.from({ length: b - a }, (_, k) => byteAt(a + k));
const tree = (size = SIZE) => ({ dirs: {}, files: { 'f.big': { size, mtime: 1 } } });

const syncReqs = [];
globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = class {
  open(m, url) { this.url = url; }
  setRequestHeader(k, v) { this.range = v; }
  send() { const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(this.range); syncReqs.push([+a, +b]); this.status = 206; this.response = bytes(+a, +b + 1).buffer; }
};

/** fetch stand-in: every call pending until released; honors AbortSignal. */
function fakeFetch() {
  const calls = [];
  const fn = (url, init = {}) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(init.headers.Range);
    const call = { start: +a, end: +b + 1, bg: !!init.signal, signal: init.signal, settled: false,
      release: () => { if (call.settled) return; call.settled = true; resolve({ status: 206, arrayBuffer: async () => bytes(+a, +b + 1).buffer }); },
      fail: () => { if (call.settled) return; call.settled = true; reject(new TypeError('Failed to fetch')); } };
    init.signal?.addEventListener('abort', () => { if (!call.settled) { call.settled = true; reject(new DOMException('aborted', 'AbortError')); } });
    calls.push(call);
  });
  return { calls, fn };
}
const tick = (ms = 0) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
async function withFetch(body) {
  const real = globalThis.fetch, f = fakeFetch();
  globalThis.fetch = f.fn;
  try { await body(f.calls); } finally { globalThis.fetch = real; }
}

test('async read: a background download aborted for a foreground fetch does not restart while that fetch runs', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/a/', tree()); b.noteMiss = () => {}; // (the block fill alone: see the missed-block test)
  b.lastSyncFetchAt = -1e9;
  b.want.set('f.big#0', { path: 'f.big', size: SIZE, mtime: 1, index: 0 });
  b.fillBackground();
  await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.filter((c) => c.bg).length, 1, 'the background download started');
  const ahead = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 3 * MiB, 3 * MiB + 10, false);
  assert.equal(calls[0].signal.aborted, true, 'the background download gave way');
  await tick(250); // (longer than the pause after a synchronous read)
  assert.equal(calls.filter((c) => c.bg).length, 1, 'no background download while the game waits for its fetch');
  calls.find((c) => !c.bg).release();
  await ahead;
  for (let i = 0; i < 40 && calls.filter((c) => c.bg).length < 2; i++) await tick(20);
  assert.equal(calls.filter((c) => c.bg).length, 2, 'the background download resumes afterwards');
  calls[calls.length - 1].release();
  for (let i = 0; i < 40 && b.filling; i++) await tick(10);
  assert.ok(b.cache.has('f.big#0'));
}));

test('async read: every background download in flight (prefetch and block fill) gives way to the game', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const store = new Map(); store.map = store; store.put = (k, v) => store.set(k, v); store.failed = false;
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/b/', tree(), { store }); b.noteMiss = () => {};
  b.lastSyncFetchAt = -1e9;
  const progress = {};
  const pf = b.prefetch([['f.big', 5]], progress);
  await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1, 'prefetch downloading');
  // a read whose pieces are here already queues its block: the block fill starts while the prefetch runs
  b.chunks.set('f.big#0', bytes(0, CHUNK)); b.chunkBytes += CHUNK;
  assert.deepEqual(b.open('f.big').read(10, 20), bytes(10, 30));
  await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.length, 2, 'block fill downloading too');
  // the game needs the network synchronously: both downloads stop
  b.open('f.big').read(6 * MiB, 10);
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((c) => c.signal.aborted), [true, true], 'both background downloads aborted');
  b.lastSyncFetchAt = -1e9;
  for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !progress.done; i++) { for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(20); }
  assert.equal(progress.done, true);
  assert.ok(store.has(`f.big#${SIZE}#1#5`), 'the prefetched block made it after the abort');
  for (let i = 0; i < 40 && b.filling; i++) { for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(20); }
  assert.ok(b.cache.has('f.big#0'), 'the filled block made it after the abort');
}));

test('async read: a download a parked read waits for is not aborted by another thread\'s asynchronous read', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/c/', tree()); b.noteMiss = () => {};
  b.lastSyncFetchAt = -1e9;
  b.want.set('f.big#0', { path: 'f.big', size: SIZE, mtime: 1, index: 0 });
  b.fillBackground();
  await tick();
  const bg = calls[0];
  let t1done = false;
  const t1 = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 100, 200, false).then(() => { t1done = true; }); // waits for block 0
  const t2 = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 2 * MiB, 2 * MiB + 10, false); // another thread, other block
  calls[1].release(); await t2;
  b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 3 * MiB, 3 * MiB + 10, false); // a third one while thread 1 still waits
  assert.equal(bg.signal.aborted, false, 'the block thread 1 waits for keeps downloading');
  assert.equal(t1done, false);
  bg.release(); await t1;
  await tick(10);
  assert.ok(b.cache.has('f.big#0'), 'thread 1 finds its block');
  for (const c of calls) c.release();
}));

test('async read: pieces fetched ahead stay within the piece cache bound', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const size = 100 * MiB;
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/d/', tree(size)); b.noteMiss = () => {};
  b.fillBackground = () => {}; // (no background downloads: the pieces alone)
  for (let bi = 0; bi < 80; bi++) {
    const p = b.fetchAhead('f.big', size, 1, bi * BLOCK, (bi + 1) * BLOCK, false); // a random read of a whole block, by pieces
    calls[calls.length - 1].release(); await p;
  }
  assert.ok(b.chunkBytes <= 64 * MiB, `piece cache ${b.chunkBytes / MiB} MiB`);
  let sum = 0; for (const v of b.chunks.values()) sum += v.length;
  assert.equal(sum, b.chunkBytes);
}));

/** Read [a, z) of `f` in 256 KiB reads, checking the bytes. */
const readSeq = (f, a, z) => { for (let pos = a; pos < z; pos += 256 << 10) assert.deepEqual(f.read(pos, Math.min(256 << 10, z - pos)), bytes(pos, Math.min(pos + (256 << 10), z))); };

test('read-ahead: a file read whole has its next blocks fetched asynchronously; its reads then find them here', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const size = 12 * MiB;
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/e/', tree(size));
  b.fillBackground = () => {}; // (the read-ahead alone)
  const f = b.open('f.big'), n0 = syncReqs.length;
  // (the first MiB by pieces, then the file is being read whole: 4 blocks at once, then the next ones ahead)
  readSeq(f, 0, 3 * MiB + (256 << 10));
  // (block 0, read by pieces again and again, is fetched whole too: see noteMiss)
  assert.deepEqual(calls.filter((c) => c.start < MiB).map((c) => [c.start, c.end]), [[0, MiB]]);
  const ahead = calls.filter((c) => c.start >= MiB);
  assert.ok(ahead.length >= 1, 'blocks fetched ahead of the reader');
  assert.ok(ahead.every((c) => c.start % BLOCK === 0 && c.start >= 3 * MiB && c.end <= 8 * MiB), `within the window past the reader (${ahead.map((c) => [c.start / MiB, c.end / MiB])})`);
  assert.equal(b.gameBusy(0), true, 'background downloads wait while the reader\'s blocks are on their way');
  // a parked read of a block on its way waits for that download instead of asking again
  const before = calls.length;
  const p = f.prepare(ahead[0].start, 64 << 10);
  assert.ok(p, 'the block is not here yet');
  assert.equal(calls.length, before, 'no second request for a block on its way');
  for (const c of calls) c.release();
  await p; await tick();
  const nSync = syncReqs.length;
  readSeq(f, 3 * MiB + (256 << 10), 8 * MiB);
  assert.equal(syncReqs.length, nSync, 'the blocks fetched ahead served the reads');
  // the reader moves on: the window moves with it, never past the file's end
  for (let pos = 8 * MiB; pos < size; pos += MiB) { for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(); readSeq(f, pos, pos + MiB); }
  assert.ok(calls.every((c) => c.end <= size), 'nothing past the end');
  assert.ok(syncReqs.slice(n0).every(([, z]) => z < 5 * MiB), `no synchronous request past the first whole blocks (${syncReqs.slice(n0).map(([a, z]) => [a, z - a + 1])})`);
  for (let bi = 5; bi < 12; bi++) assert.equal(calls.filter((c) => c.start <= bi * MiB && bi * MiB < c.end).length, 1, `block ${bi} asked once`);
  for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick();
  assert.equal(b.readAheadPending, 0); assert.equal(b.blockFlights.size, 0);
}));

test('read-ahead: a failed download leaves the read to fetch the block itself, with the exact bytes', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const size = 6 * MiB;
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/g/', tree(size));
  b.fillBackground = () => {};
  const f = b.open('f.big');
  readSeq(f, 0, 3 * MiB + (256 << 10));
  assert.ok(calls.length >= 1);
  const p = f.prepare(3 * MiB + (256 << 10), 2 * MiB); // (a parked read reaching block 5, on its way)
  const failed = calls.length;
  for (const c of calls) c.fail();
  let done = false; p.then(() => { done = true; });
  for (let i = 0; i < 20 && !done; i++) { await tick(); for (const c of calls.slice(failed)) c.release(); }
  assert.ok(done, 'the parked read ends');
  assert.ok(calls.length > failed, 'it asked for the block itself');
  assert.equal(b.readAheadPending, 0);
  const n = syncReqs.length;
  assert.deepEqual(f.read(3 * MiB + (256 << 10), 2 * MiB), bytes(3 * MiB + (256 << 10), 5 * MiB + (256 << 10)));
  assert.equal(syncReqs.length, n, 'the parked read\'s own fetch served the read');
  for (const c of calls) c.release();
}));

test('missed block: a read that misses a block fetches its pieces and the whole block beside them; the next reads wait for the block', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/h/', tree());
  b.fillBackground = () => {}; // (the background fill would wait for a quiet network anyway)
  const f = b.open('f.big');
  const n0 = syncReqs.length;
  const p1 = f.prepare(3 * MiB + 1000, 100); // a miss: its piece, and the block whole
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((c) => [c.start, c.end]).sort((x, y) => y[1] - x[1]), [[3 * MiB, 4 * MiB], [3 * MiB, 3 * MiB + CHUNK]]);
  calls.find((c) => c.end === 3 * MiB + CHUNK).release(); await p1; // (the piece answers first: the read goes on)
  assert.deepEqual(f.read(3 * MiB + 1000, 100), bytes(3 * MiB + 1000, 3 * MiB + 1100));
  const p2 = f.prepare(3 * MiB + 9 * CHUNK, 100); // another read of the block waits for it
  assert.ok(p2);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 2, 'no request of its own');
  for (const c of calls) c.release(); await p2;
  assert.ok(b.cache.has('f.big#3'));
  assert.deepEqual(f.read(3 * MiB + 9 * CHUNK, 100), bytes(3 * MiB + 9 * CHUNK, 3 * MiB + 9 * CHUNK + 100));
  assert.equal(syncReqs.length, n0, 'every read served without a synchronous request');
  // at most MISSED_BLOCK_FLIGHTS (2) such downloads at once: a third missed block gets its pieces only
  const ps = [5, 6, 7].map((bi) => f.prepare(bi * MiB + 10, 10));
  assert.equal(calls.filter((c) => c.end - c.start === MiB).length, 3, `${calls.map((c) => [c.start / MiB, (c.end - c.start) / 1024])}`);
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(); }
  await Promise.all(ps);
  assert.equal(b.missFlights, 0); assert.equal(b.readAheadPending, 0);
}));

test('shared connection: the game\'s reads through one mount come first for the background downloads of the others', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const link = new Set();
  const game = new HttpBackend('/game/main/', tree(), { link }), dep = new HttpBackend('/game/dep/', tree(), { link });
  game.noteMiss = () => {}; dep.noteMiss = () => {};
  game.lastSyncFetchAt = dep.lastSyncFetchAt = -1e9;
  dep.want.set('f.big#0', { path: 'f.big', size: SIZE, mtime: 1, index: 0 });
  dep.fillBackground();
  await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1, 'the required game\'s block fill downloads');
  const p = game.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 3 * MiB, 3 * MiB + 10, false); // the game waits for a read of its own folder
  assert.equal(calls[0].signal.aborted, true, 'the other mount\'s background download gave way');
  assert.equal(dep.gameBusy(0), true, 'and waits while the game\'s read is in flight');
  await tick(250);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 2, 'no background download meanwhile');
  calls[1].release(); await p;
  for (let i = 0; i < 40 && calls.length < 3; i++) await tick(20);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 3, 'the background download resumes afterwards');
  calls[2].release();
  for (let i = 0; i < 40 && dep.filling; i++) await tick(10);
  assert.ok(dep.cache.has('f.big#0'));
}));

test('near blocks: the blocks next to a missed one are fetched last, by the background fill, once the network is quiet', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/n/', tree());
  b.missFlights = 2; // (no whole-block download of the missed block itself here: the near blocks alone)
  b.noteMiss('f.big', SIZE, 1, 3);
  assert.deepEqual([...b.near.keys()], ['f.big#1', 'f.big#2', 'f.big#4', 'f.big#5']);
  b.noteMiss('f.big', SIZE, 1, 0); // (the file's first block: no block before it)
  assert.deepEqual([...b.near.keys()], ['f.big#1', 'f.big#2', 'f.big#4', 'f.big#5']);
  b.want.set('f.big#6', { path: 'f.big', size: SIZE, mtime: 1, index: 6 }); // a block the game touched
  b.lastSyncFetchAt = performance.now() - 200; // (quiet for 200 ms: enough for it, not for the near blocks)
  b.fillBackground();
  for (let i = 0; i < 20 && !calls.length; i++) await tick(10);
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((c) => c.start / MiB), [6], 'the touched block first');
  calls[0].release();
  for (let i = 0; i < 100 && calls.length < 2; i++) await tick(10);
  assert.equal(calls[1].start / MiB, 1, 'then the near ones, oldest first');
  b.cache.set('f.big#2', bytes(2 * MiB, 3 * MiB)); // (here meanwhile: not fetched)
  for (let n = 1; n < 10; n++) { for (const c of calls) c.release(); await tick(60); }
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((c) => c.start / MiB), [6, 1, 4, 5]);
  assert.equal(b.near.size, 0);
  for (let i = 0; i < 40 && b.filling; i++) await tick(10);
  assert.equal(b.filling, false);
}));

test('read-ahead: a parked read of a file read whole waits for the blocks it covers only', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/w/', tree());
  b.fillBackground = () => {}; b.noteMiss = () => {};
  const p1 = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 2 * MiB + 100, 2 * MiB + 100 + CHUNK, true);
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((c) => [c.start / MiB, c.end / MiB]), [[2, 3]], 'one block, not four');
  calls[0].release(); await p1;
  const p2 = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 3 * MiB, 5 * MiB + 10, true); // (a read across three blocks: all three)
  assert.deepEqual(calls.slice(1).map((c) => [c.start / MiB, c.end / MiB]), [[3, 6]]);
  calls[1].release(); await p2;
  for (const i of [2, 3, 4, 5]) assert.ok(b.cache.has(`f.big#${i}`));
}));

test('async read: a read of bytes another read is fetching joins its request (a background ask, then the forced read of the same bytes)', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/j/', tree()); b.noteMiss = () => {};
  b.lastSyncFetchAt = -1e9;
  // (an entry over two whole blocks, read by pieces: the background ask's fetchAhead)
  const first = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 2 * MiB, 4 * MiB, false);
  await tick();
  const asked = calls.filter((c) => !c.bg).length;
  assert.ok(asked >= 1, 'the first read fetches');
  // (the same bytes read again before they came — and a part of them: nothing asked again)
  let second = false, part = false;
  const s = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 2 * MiB, 4 * MiB, false).then(() => { second = true; });
  const q = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 3 * MiB + 100, 3 * MiB + 200, false).then(() => { part = true; });
  await tick(20);
  assert.equal(calls.filter((c) => !c.bg).length, asked, 'the second and third reads join the requests on their way');
  assert.ok(b.stats.fgJoined > 0);
  assert.equal(second || part, false, 'they wait for them');
  for (const c of calls) c.release();
  await Promise.all([first, s, q]);
  assert.equal(calls.filter((c) => !c.bg).length, asked, 'still one request each once they came');
  assert.equal(b.fgFlights.size, 0, 'the flights are cleared');
  assert.deepEqual(b.open('f.big').read(2 * MiB + 5, 100), bytes(2 * MiB + 5, 2 * MiB + 105));
  assert.deepEqual(b.open('f.big').read(4 * MiB - 100, 100), bytes(4 * MiB - 100, 4 * MiB));
  // (a failed request: the read that joined it fetches by itself)
  const f1 = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 6 * MiB, 6 * MiB + 1000, false);
  await tick();
  const n = calls.length;
  const f2 = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 6 * MiB, 6 * MiB + 1000, false);
  await tick(20);
  assert.equal(calls.length, n, 'joined');
  calls[n - 1].fail();
  await f1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 50 && calls.length === n; i++) await tick(10);
  assert.equal(calls.length, n + 1, 'the joiner asks again once the request failed');
  calls[n].release();
  await f2;
  assert.deepEqual(b.open('f.big').read(6 * MiB, 1000), bytes(6 * MiB, 6 * MiB + 1000));
}));

test('async read: a background ask of bytes a read is fetching joins that read\'s request (the converse: the read first, then an announced ask of the same blocks)', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/k/', tree()); b.noteMiss = () => {}; b.fillBackground = () => {};
  b.lastSyncFetchAt = -1e9;
  // (a demand read of an entry over two whole blocks: its fetchAhead, bulk — the blocks whole)
  const read = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 2 * MiB, 4 * MiB, true);
  await tick();
  const fg = calls.filter((c) => !c.bg);
  assert.equal(fg.length, 1, 'the read fetches the two blocks');
  // (then the background asks the same bytes: a part of them through the pieces' path, all of them through the
  // background request itself — neither goes on the link)
  const P = CHUNK, c0 = (2 * MiB) / P, c1 = (4 * MiB) / P - 1;
  let partDone = null, nowDone = null;
  const part = b.fetchPartBg('f.big', SIZE, 1, c0 + 3, c0 + 5, [0, 0], () => false, false, { reason: 'announced', forLoad: true }).then((r) => { partDone = r; });
  const now = b.fetchBackgroundNow('f.big', 2 * MiB, 4 * MiB, null, false, false, 'announced').then((d) => { nowDone = d; });
  await tick(20);
  assert.equal(calls.filter((c) => c.bg).length, 0, 'no background request for bytes the read brings');
  assert.equal(b.stats.bgJoinedFg, 2);
  assert.equal(partDone, null, 'they wait for the read\'s request');
  fg[0].release();
  await Promise.all([read, part, now]);
  assert.equal(partDone, true, 'the pieces came');
  assert.deepEqual(nowDone, bytes(2 * MiB, 4 * MiB), 'the bytes the read brought');
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1, 'one request in all');
  assert.equal(b.fgFlights.size, 0);
  // (bytes partly on their way: asked as before — whole, on the link)
  const r2 = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 5 * MiB, 5 * MiB + 10, false);
  await tick();
  const n = calls.length;
  const half = b.fetchBackgroundNow('f.big', 5 * MiB, 5 * MiB + 2 * P, null, false, false, 'pf');
  await tick();
  assert.equal(calls.length, n + 1, 'a range not wholly on its way is fetched');
  for (const c of calls) c.release();
  assert.deepEqual(await half, bytes(5 * MiB, 5 * MiB + 2 * P));
  await r2;
  // (a failed read: the background ask that joined it fetches by itself)
  const r3 = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 6 * MiB, 6 * MiB + 1000, false);
  await tick();
  const m = calls.length;
  const again = b.fetchBackgroundNow('f.big', 6 * MiB, 6 * MiB + 1000, null, false, false, 'announced');
  await tick(20);
  assert.equal(calls.length, m, 'joined');
  calls[m - 1].fail();
  await r3;
  for (let i = 0; i < 50 && calls.length === m; i++) await tick(10);
  assert.equal(calls.length, m + 1, 'asked again once the read\'s request failed');
  assert.equal(b.stats.bgJoinedFgMissed, 1);
  calls[m].release();
  assert.deepEqual(await again, bytes(6 * MiB, 6 * MiB + 1000));
}));
```

`tests/http-backend-fastlink.test.js`:

```js
// HTTP game file backend on a measured fast link with a real round trip (docs/slow-network.md "A fast link far away"):
// the learned prefetch keeps several requests in flight (one while the game reads from the network), a game read
// does not abort the background downloads in flight, and one read covering several whole blocks none of which is here
// fetches them in one request.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { HttpBackend, BLOCK } from '../src/vfs/http-backend.js';
import { NetLink } from '../src/vfs/net-link.js';

const SIZE = 12 * BLOCK + 5000;
const byteAt = (i) => (i * 29 + (i >> 10)) & 0xff;
const bytes = (a, b) => Uint8Array.from({ length: b - a }, (_, k) => byteAt(a + k));
const tree = () => ({ dirs: {}, files: { 'f.big': { size: SIZE, mtime: 1 } } });

const syncReqs = [];
globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = class {
  open(m, url) { this.url = url; }
  setRequestHeader(k, v) { this.range = v; }
  send() { const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(this.range); syncReqs.push([+a, +b + 1]); this.status = 206; this.response = bytes(+a, +b + 1).buffer; }
};

function fakeFetch() {
  const calls = [];
  const fn = (url, init = {}) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(init.headers.Range);
    const call = { start: +a, end: +b + 1, bg: !!init.signal, signal: init.signal, settled: false,
      release: () => { if (call.settled) return; call.settled = true; resolve({ status: 206, headers: { get: () => null }, arrayBuffer: async () => bytes(+a, +b + 1).buffer }); } };
    init.signal?.addEventListener('abort', () => { if (!call.settled) { call.settled = true; reject(new DOMException('aborted', 'AbortError')); } });
    calls.push(call);
  });
  return { calls, fn };
}
const tick = (ms = 0) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
async function withFetch(body) {
  const real = globalThis.fetch, f = fakeFetch();
  globalThis.fetch = f.fn;
  try { await body(f.calls); } finally { globalThis.fetch = real; }
}
class MemStore {
  constructor() { this.m = new Map(); this.failed = false; }
  get map() { return this.m; }
  get(k) { return this.m.get(k)?.slice() ?? null; }
  put(k, b) { if (!this.m.has(k)) this.m.set(k, b.slice()); }
  flush() {}
}
/** a link measured at 7 MB/s with a 75 ms round trip (as the owner's) */
const fastFar = () => { const net = new NetLink({ bw: 7e6 }); net.measured = true; net.rtt = 75; return net; };

test('fast link far away: the learned prefetch keeps several requests in flight, one while the game reads from the network', { timeout: 20000 }, () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const store = new MemStore();
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/a/', tree(), { store, net: fastFar() });
  const list = [0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10].map((i) => ['f.big', i, 0xffff, i]);
  const progress = {};
  let stopped = false; // (a failed assertion leaves no prefetch loop running: the test file ends)
  const pf = b.prefetch(list, progress, () => stopped);
  const until = async (ok) => { for (let i = 0; i < 250 && !ok(); i++) await tick(20); };
  try {
  await until(() => calls.length >= 3); await tick(30);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 3, 'three requests side by side');
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((c) => c.start / BLOCK), [0, 2, 4], 'in the learned order, none twice');
  b.fgPending = 1; // (the game waits for a read from the network: one request at a time meanwhile)
  calls[0].release(); calls[1].release();
  await tick(150);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 3, 'none more while one is in flight and the game reads');
  calls[2].release();
  await until(() => calls.length >= 4); await tick(150);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 4, 'one at a time while the game reads');
  b.fgPending = 0;
  await until(() => calls.length >= 6);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 6);
  for (const c of calls) c.release();
  await pf;
  } finally { stopped = true; for (const c of calls) c.release(); }
  assert.equal(progress.done, true);
  for (const i of [0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10]) assert.ok(store.m.has(`f.big#${SIZE}#1#${i}`), `block ${i} stored`);
}));

test('fast link far away: a game read leaves the background downloads in flight alone (a link not measured aborts them)', { timeout: 20000 }, () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  for (const [net, aborted] of [[fastFar(), false], [new NetLink({ fixed: true }), true]]) {
    calls.length = 0;
    const store = new MemStore();
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/a/', tree(), { store, net }); b.noteMiss = () => {};
    let stopped = false;
    const pf = b.prefetch([['f.big', 3, 0xffff, 0]], {}, () => stopped);
    try {
    for (let i = 0; i < 250 && !calls.length; i++) await tick(20);
    assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
    const ahead = b.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 1, 8 * BLOCK, 8 * BLOCK + 10, false);
    assert.equal(calls[0].signal.aborted, aborted);
    for (const c of calls) c.release();
    await ahead; await tick(20);
    for (const c of calls) c.release();
    for (let i = 0; i < 250 && !store.m.has(`f.big#${SIZE}#1#3`); i++) { await tick(20); for (const c of calls) c.release(); }
    await pf;
    assert.ok(store.m.has(`f.big#${SIZE}#1#3`), 'the prefetched block made it');
    } finally { stopped = true; for (const c of calls) c.release(); }
  }
}));

test('a read covering several whole blocks none of which is here: one request (then by blocks where something is here)', () => {
  syncReqs.length = 0;
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/a/', tree(), { net: fastFar() });
  b.noteMiss = () => {}; b.fillBackground = async () => {};
  const f = b.open('f.big');
  assert.deepEqual(f.read(0, 5 * BLOCK), bytes(0, 5 * BLOCK));
  assert.deepEqual(syncReqs, [[0, 5 * BLOCK]], 'five blocks in one request');
  // a piece of block 7 here already: blocks 5-6 together, then block 7 by its missing pieces, blocks 8-11 and the tail together
  syncReqs.length = 0;
  f.read(7 * BLOCK + 100, 10); // (a random read: block 7's first piece)
  syncReqs.length = 0;
  assert.deepEqual(b.open('f.big').read(5 * BLOCK, SIZE - 5 * BLOCK), bytes(5 * BLOCK, SIZE));
  assert.deepEqual(syncReqs[0], [5 * BLOCK, 7 * BLOCK]);
  assert.deepEqual(syncReqs.at(-1), [8 * BLOCK, SIZE], 'the last blocks and the tail in one');
});
```
