`tests/http-backend-fuzz.test.js`:

```js
// Randomized exactness check of the HTTP game file backend: every read must return exactly the file's bytes, whatever
// mix of 64 KiB pieces, whole blocks, background downloads (completing, failing or aborted at random moments),
// asynchronous prepare() fetches, the persistent store (shared by two versions of the files: another mtime), the
// offline copy, the prefetch and injected range request failures. FUZZ_SEEDS=n runs more seeds.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { HttpBackend, BLOCK, CHUNK } from '../src/vfs/http-backend.js';
import { NetLink } from '../src/vfs/net-link.js';

function rng(seed) { let s = seed >>> 0 || 1; return () => { s ^= s << 13; s >>>= 0; s ^= s >>> 17; s ^= s << 5; s >>>= 0; return s / 4294967296; }; }

const SIZES = { 'a.big': 3 * BLOCK + 12345, 'b.big': BLOCK - 1000, 'c.big': 2 * BLOCK, 'd.big': 5 * CHUNK + 7, 'e.big': 0, 'f.big': 1, 'g.big': BLOCK + CHUNK, 'h.big': 9 * BLOCK + 3 }; // (h: long enough for the read-ahead of a file read whole)
const NAMES = Object.keys(SIZES);
/** two versions of the folder: /game/v7/ (mtime 7) and /game/v8/ (mtime 8, other bytes, same sizes) */
const VERSIONS = { 7: {}, 8: {} };
for (const [n, size] of Object.entries(SIZES)) {
  const r = rng(size + n.charCodeAt(0));
  VERSIONS[7][n] = Uint8Array.from({ length: size }, () => (r() * 256) | 0);
  VERSIONS[8][n] = VERSIONS[7][n].map((x, i) => x ^ (1 + (i % 251)));
}
const fileOfUrl = (url) => { const m = /\/game\/v(\d+)\/Data\/([^/?]+)/.exec(url); return VERSIONS[m[1]][decodeURIComponent(m[2])]; };

class MemStore {
  constructor() { this.m = new Map(); this.failed = false; }
  get map() { return this.m; }
  get(k) { return this.m.get(k)?.slice() ?? null; }
  put(k, b) { if (!this.m.has(k)) this.m.set(k, b.slice()); }
  drop(k) { this.m.delete(k); }
  flush() {}
}

/** `bw`: a measured link rate (bytes/s, fixed) shared by both folders — thin and mid links take other paths (pieces kept in the store, background turns) */
async function run(seed, bw = null) {
  const R = rng(seed), ri = (n) => Math.floor(R() * n);
  const xhrFaults = [];
  const pending = []; // fetches (background, prefetch, offline copy, prepare) not answered yet
  const realXhr = globalThis.XMLHttpRequest, realFetch = globalThis.fetch, realNow = performance.now;
  let clock = 0;
  performance.now = () => (clock += 1000); // (every wait for a quiet network passes at once)
  globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = class {
    open(m, url) { this.url = url; }
    setRequestHeader(k, v) { this.range = v; }
    send() {
      const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(this.range), data = fileOfUrl(this.url);
      const fault = xhrFaults.shift();
      if (fault === 'network') throw new Error('NetworkError');
      if (fault === 'full') { this.status = 200; this.response = data.slice().buffer; return; } // (a server ignoring Range)
      this.status = fault === 'status' ? 503 : 206;
      this.response = data.slice(+a, fault === 'short' ? +a + Math.floor((+b - +a) / 2) : +b + 1).buffer;
    }
  };
  globalThis.fetch = (url, init = {}) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(init.headers.Range), data = fileOfUrl(url);
    const p = { resolve, reject, a: +a, b: +b, data };
    init.signal?.addEventListener('abort', () => { const i = pending.indexOf(p); if (i >= 0) pending.splice(i, 1); reject(new Error('AbortError')); });
    pending.push(p);
  });
  const settle = (p) => {
    const k = R();
    if (k < 0.08) p.reject(new Error('NetworkError'));
    else if (k < 0.14) p.resolve({ status: 500, arrayBuffer: async () => new ArrayBuffer(0) });
    else if (k < 0.2) p.resolve({ status: 206, arrayBuffer: async () => p.data.slice(p.a, p.a + Math.floor((p.b - p.a) / 2)).buffer });
    else if (k < 0.25) p.resolve({ status: 200, arrayBuffer: async () => p.data.slice().buffer });
    else p.resolve({ status: 206, arrayBuffer: async () => p.data.slice(p.a, p.b + 1).buffer });
  };
  const tick = async (n = 3) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) await new Promise((r) => setImmediate(r)); };
  const settleSome = async () => { for (let n = ri(3); n > 0 && pending.length; n--) settle(pending.splice(ri(pending.length), 1)[0]); await tick(); };
  let sides = [], finished = false;
  const net = bw ? new NetLink({ bw, fixed: true }) : null;
  try {
    const store = R() < 0.7 ? new MemStore() : null;
    const tree = (mtime) => ({ dirs: { Data: { files: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(SIZES).map(([n, size]) => [n, { size, mtime }])) } }, files: {} });
    const cacheBlocks = 1 + ri(10); // (down to a cache smaller than the read-ahead)
    // (odd seeds: the two folders share one connection, as a game and a game it requires do: see HttpBackend.link)
    const link = seed % 2 ? new Set() : undefined;
    sides = [7, 8].map((v) => {
      const b = new HttpBackend(`/game/v${v}/`, tree(v), { store, cacheBlocks, retryWaits: [0, 0], link, ...(net ? { net } : {}) });
      return { v, b, files: VERSIONS[v], handles: NAMES.map((n) => b.open(`Data/${n}`)), offline: null };
    });
    const doRead = (s, fi, off, len) => {
      const name = NAMES[fi], data = s.files[name];
      let fail = false;
      if (R() < 0.1) { const k = ri(4); if (k === 3) { xhrFaults.push('status', 'status', 'status'); fail = true; } else xhrFaults.push(['network', 'status', 'short', 'full'][k]); }
      let got;
      try { got = s.handles[fi].read(off, len); } catch (e) { if (!fail) throw e; xhrFaults.length = 0; return; }
      xhrFaults.length = 0;
      const end = Math.min(off + len, data.length), want = off >= end ? new Uint8Array(0) : data.subarray(off, end);
      assert.equal(got.length, want.length, `seed ${seed}: v${s.v} ${name} @${off} +${len}: ${got.length} bytes, not ${want.length}`);
      assert.ok(Buffer.from(got).equals(Buffer.from(want)), `seed ${seed}: v${s.v} ${name} @${off} +${len}: wrong bytes`);
    };
    const randRange = (size) => {
      const off = R() < 0.05 ? size + ri(10) : ri(size + 1);
      const k = R(); const len = k < 0.05 ? 0 : k < 0.5 ? 1 + ri(4096) : k < 0.85 ? 1 + ri(3 * CHUNK) : 1 + ri(3 * BLOCK);
      return [off, len];
    };
    for (let step = 0; step < 400; step++) {
      const s = sides[R() < 0.75 ? 0 : 1], op = R(), fi = ri(NAMES.length), size = SIZES[NAMES[fi]];
      if (op < 0.35) doRead(s, fi, ...randRange(size));
      else if (op < 0.55) { // a sequential run (a stream or a file read whole)
        let [off] = randRange(size); const piece = R() < 0.5 ? 4096 : 1 + ri(200000);
        for (let i = 0, n = 1 + ri(40); i < n; i++) { doRead(s, fi, off, piece); off += piece; if (R() < 0.2) await settleSome(); }
      } else if (op < 0.75) { // an asynchronous read: prepare, answer the fetches (or not), meanwhile other reads, then the read
        const [off, len] = randRange(size);
        const p = s.handles[fi].prepare(off, len);
        if (p) {
          let done = false; p.then(() => { done = true; });
          for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !done; i++) { if (R() < 0.3) { const g = ri(NAMES.length); doRead(sides[ri(2)], g, ...randRange(SIZES[NAMES[g]])); } await settleSome(); }
        }
        doRead(s, fi, off, len);
      } else if (op < 0.99) await settleSome();
      else if (store && op < 0.995) { // the prefetch of blocks an earlier session needed
        const list = []; for (let i = 0, n = 1 + ri(8); i < n; i++) { const f = ri(NAMES.length); list.push([`Data/${NAMES[f]}`, ri(Math.ceil(SIZES[NAMES[f]] / BLOCK) + 1), ...(R() < 0.7 ? [R() < 0.2 ? 0xffff : 1 + ri(0xffff)] : [])]); } // (learned pieces: fetched ahead of the reads that follow)
        s.b.prefetch(list, {}, () => finished || R() < 0.01);
      } else if (store && !s.offline) { s.offline = {}; s.b.downloadAll(s.offline, () => finished); }
      // invariants: every piece, block and stored block holds its version's bytes
      if (step % 25 !== 24) continue;
      for (const { b, files } of sides) {
        let bytes = 0;
        for (const [k, v] of b.chunks) {
          const c = +k.slice(k.lastIndexOf('#') + 1), d = files[k.slice(0, k.lastIndexOf('#')).split('/').pop()];
          bytes += v.length;
          assert.ok(Buffer.from(v).equals(Buffer.from(d.subarray(c * CHUNK, c * CHUNK + CHUNK))), `seed ${seed}: piece ${k}`);
        }
        assert.equal(b.chunkBytes, bytes, `seed ${seed}: piece byte count`);
        for (const [k, v] of b.cache) {
          const i = +k.slice(k.lastIndexOf('#') + 1), d = files[k.slice(0, k.lastIndexOf('#')).split('/').pop()];
          assert.ok(Buffer.from(v).equals(Buffer.from(d.subarray(i * BLOCK, i * BLOCK + BLOCK))), `seed ${seed}: block ${k}`);
        }
      }
      if (store) for (const [k, v] of store.m) {
        const [p, , mtime, i] = k.split('#'), d = VERSIONS[mtime][p.split('/').pop()];
        // (a piece kept from a link that is not fast: '#c<piece>')
        const want = i.startsWith('c') ? d.subarray(+i.slice(1) * CHUNK, +i.slice(1) * CHUNK + CHUNK) : d.subarray(+i * BLOCK, +i * BLOCK + BLOCK);
        assert.ok(Buffer.from(v).equals(Buffer.from(want)), `seed ${seed}${bw ? ` bw ${bw}` : ''}: stored ${k}`);
      }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 200 && pending.length; i++) { settle(pending.shift()); await tick(); }
    if (process.env.FUZZ_STATS) console.log(seed, sides.map((s) => JSON.stringify(s.b.stats)).join(' '), store?.m.size);
  } finally {
    // (the background loops still running end: nothing wanted, the network quiet, the fetches in flight failed)
    finished = true;
    for (const { b } of sides) { b.want.clear(); b.near.clear(); b.lastSyncFetchAt = -Infinity; }
    for (const p of pending.splice(0)) p.reject(new Error('NetworkError'));
    if (net) { for (const w of net.waiters.splice(0)) w.resolve(false); if (net.timer !== null) { net.clearTimer(net.timer); net.timer = null; } }
    globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = realXhr; globalThis.fetch = realFetch; performance.now = realNow;
  }
}

test('http backend: a memory cache smaller than the read-ahead (?cache=2) still returns the block just fetched', () => {
  const size = 5 * BLOCK, data = Uint8Array.from({ length: size }, (_, i) => (i * 31) >> 3);
  const realXhr = globalThis.XMLHttpRequest, realFetch = globalThis.fetch;
  globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = class {
    open() {} setRequestHeader(k, v) { this.range = v; }
    send() { const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(this.range); this.status = 206; this.response = data.slice(+a, +b + 1).buffer; }
  };
  delete globalThis.fetch;
  try {
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/small/', { dirs: {}, files: { x: { size, mtime: 1 } } }, { cacheBlocks: 2 });
    const f = b.open('x');
    f.read(0, BLOCK);
    // sequential: 4 blocks fetched in one request, the first of them evicted at once by the 2-block cache
    assert.ok(Buffer.from(f.read(BLOCK, 3 * BLOCK)).equals(Buffer.from(data.subarray(BLOCK, 4 * BLOCK))));
  } finally { globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = realXhr; if (realFetch) globalThis.fetch = realFetch; }
});

test('http backend (randomized): pieces evicted in the middle of a read (past 64 MiB of pieces) — the read stays exact', () => {
  const size = 72 * BLOCK + 777, data = new Uint8Array(size);
  for (let i = 0; i < size; i += 4096) data[i] = (i >>> 12) & 0xff, data[i + 1] = (i >>> 20) & 0xff;
  for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) data[i] ^= i & 0xff;
  const realXhr = globalThis.XMLHttpRequest, realFetch = globalThis.fetch;
  globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = class {
    open() {} setRequestHeader(k, v) { this.range = v; }
    send() { const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(this.range); this.status = 206; this.response = data.slice(+a, +b + 1).buffer; }
  };
  delete globalThis.fetch; // (no background downloads: the pieces pile up)
  try {
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/big/', { dirs: {}, files: { 'x.bin': { size, mtime: 1 } } }, { cacheBlocks: 8 });
    const f = b.open('x.bin'), R = rng(99), ri = (n) => Math.floor(R() * n);
    for (let i = 0; i < +(process.env.EVN ?? 4000); i++) {
      const off = ri(size), len = R() < 0.5 ? 1 + ri(3 * CHUNK) : 1 + ri(200), got = f.read(off, len);
      const want = data.subarray(off, Math.min(size, off + len));
      assert.ok(Buffer.from(got).equals(Buffer.from(want)), `@${off} +${len}`);
      if (i % 3 === 0) f.lastEnd = -1; // (random, not a stream)
    }
    assert.ok(b.chunkBytes <= 64 << 20);
  } finally { globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = realXhr; if (realFetch) globalThis.fetch = realFetch; }
});

test('http backend (randomized): reads return exactly the file bytes under pieces, blocks, background fills and failures', async () => {
  const seeds = process.env.FUZZ_SEEDS ? +process.env.FUZZ_SEEDS : 30;
  for (let s = 1; s <= seeds; s++) await run(s * 7919);
});

  const seeds = process.env.FUZZ_SEEDS ? +process.env.FUZZ_SEEDS : 20;

```

`tests/http-backend-slow.test.js`:

```js
// HTTP game file backend on a thin link (docs/slow-network.md): the game's reads fetch what they need (pieces, plus a
// little measured past a stream), the pieces are kept in the persistent store (a second launch reads them locally) and
// become whole blocks once all are here, no speculative whole blocks go in the background, the learned pieces come in
// the learned order, and the offline copy follows the learned order first and resumes.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { HttpBackend, BLOCK, CHUNK } from '../src/vfs/http-backend.js';
import { NetLink } from '../src/vfs/net-link.js';
import { MemBlockStore } from '../src/vfs/opfs-store.js';

const MiB = 1 << 20;
const P = BLOCK / CHUNK;
const SIZE = 6 * MiB + 4321;
const byteAt = (i) => (i * 11 + (i >> 10)) & 0xff;
const bytes = (a, b) => Uint8Array.from({ length: b - a }, (_, k) => byteAt(a + k));
const tree = () => ({ dirs: {}, files: { 'f.big': { size: SIZE, mtime: 3 }, 'g.big': { size: 2 * MiB, mtime: 3 } } });
const thin = () => new NetLink({ bw: 85000, fixed: true });

const syncReqs = [];
globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = class {
  open(m, url) { this.url = url; }
  setRequestHeader(k, v) { this.range = v; }
  getResponseHeader() { return null; }
  send() { const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(this.range); syncReqs.push([+a, +b + 1]); this.status = 206; this.response = bytes(+a, +b + 1).buffer; }
};
/** fetch stand-in answering at once (a microtask later) */
function withFetch(body) {
  const real = globalThis.fetch, calls = [];
  globalThis.fetch = async (url, init = {}) => {
    const m = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(init.headers?.Range ?? '') ?? /[?&]r=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(url);
    const a = +m[1], e = init.headers?.Range ? +m[2] + 1 : +m[2];
    calls.push({ url, start: a, end: e });
    return { status: 206, headers: { get: () => null }, arrayBuffer: async () => bytes(a, e).buffer };
  };
  return Promise.resolve(body(calls)).finally(() => { globalThis.fetch = real; });
}
const settle = async (n = 20) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1)); };
/** `body(d)` with backend `d`'s link held closed as it sets; open again afterwards, failed or not (no turn left waiting on a timer) */
const withLinkOf = async (d, body) => { try { await body(d); } finally { d.net.mayStart = () => true; d.net.kick(); } };

test('thin link: a random read fetches its pieces only, keeps them in the store; a second launch reads them locally', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const store = new MemBlockStore();
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/s/', tree(), { store, net: thin() });
  const f = b.open('f.big'), n0 = syncReqs.length;
  assert.deepEqual(f.read(2 * MiB + 1000, 300), bytes(2 * MiB + 1000, 2 * MiB + 1300));
  assert.deepEqual(syncReqs.slice(n0), [[2 * MiB, 2 * MiB + CHUNK]], 'one piece');
  await settle();
  assert.equal(calls.length, 0, 'no whole block in the background (16 times the bytes on a thin link)');
  assert.equal(b.want.size, 0);
  assert.ok(store.map.has(`f.big#${SIZE}#3#c${(2 * MiB) / CHUNK}`), 'the piece is kept');
  // a later session (same store): no request
  const b2 = new HttpBackend('/game/s/', tree(), { store, net: thin() }), n1 = syncReqs.length;
  assert.deepEqual(b2.open('f.big').read(2 * MiB + 1000, 300), bytes(2 * MiB + 1000, 2 * MiB + 1300));
  assert.equal(syncReqs.length, n1, 'read from the stored piece');
  // all of a block's pieces here: the block itself is stored, its pieces dropped
  const g = b2.open('g.big');
  for (let c = 0; c < BLOCK / CHUNK; c++) g.read(c * CHUNK + 5, 10);
  assert.ok(store.map.has(`g.big#${2 * MiB}#3#0`), 'block 0 assembled and stored');
  assert.ok(![...store.map.keys()].some((k) => k.startsWith(`g.big#${2 * MiB}#3#c`) && Number(k.split('#c')[1]) < 16), 'its pieces dropped');
  assert.deepEqual(g.read(BLOCK - 100, 200), bytes(BLOCK - 100, BLOCK + 100));
}));

test('thin link: a file read in sequence is fetched a little past each read, never 4 MiB at once; the rest comes ahead in small requests, whole blocks once it is read whole', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/q/', tree(), { net: thin() });
  const f = b.open('f.big'), n0 = syncReqs.length;
  for (let pos = 0; pos < 2 * MiB; pos += 32 << 10) { assert.deepEqual(f.read(pos, 32 << 10), bytes(pos, pos + (32 << 10))); await settle(2); }
  const sync = syncReqs.slice(n0);
  assert.ok(sync.length > 0);
  assert.ok(sync.every(([a, z]) => z - a <= 2 * CHUNK), `sync requests small (${sync.map(([a, z]) => (z - a) / 1024)} KiB)`);
  assert.ok(calls.length > 0, 'pieces fetched ahead of the reader');
  // (its first MiB: requests of the link's size; past STREAM_BYTES — the file read whole —: whole blocks, the server's
  // units, two at most past the reader)
  const isBlock = (c) => c.start % BLOCK === 0 && c.end === Math.min(SIZE, c.start + BLOCK);
  assert.ok(calls.every((c) => c.end - c.start <= b.net.backgroundBytes() || isBlock(c)), `background requests of the link's size or whole blocks: ${calls.map((c) => `${c.start >> 10}+${(c.end - c.start) >> 10}`)} KiB`);
  assert.ok(calls.filter((c) => c.start < MiB).every((c) => c.end - c.start <= b.net.backgroundBytes()), 'not read whole yet: pieces');
  assert.ok(calls.some(isBlock), 'read whole: whole blocks');
  assert.ok(b.stats.wholeAheads > 0);
  assert.ok(calls.every((c) => c.start < 5 * MiB), 'not far past the reader: its block and two past it at most');
}));

test('thin link: a file read whole keeps two whole blocks on their way past its reader (one during a load), its own block by pieces; a block with a piece here by its pieces; a media file never', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const tr = { dirs: { Music: { dirs: {}, files: { 'track.mp3': { size: 6 * MiB, mtime: 3, media: true } } } }, files: tree().files };
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/wa/', tr, { net: thin() });
  b.net.mayStart = () => true; // (the turns at once: the cut of the requests is what is checked)
  const mid = MiB + 5 * CHUNK + 100;
  // (the reader stays at `mid` while its read-ahead's answers come: the rest of its block first, three requests at most
  // on their way, then the two blocks past it)
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { b.readAheadParts('f.big', SIZE, 3, mid, 0, 40, mid); await settle(); }
  const got = calls.map((c) => [c.start, c.end]);
  assert.ok(got.filter(([a]) => a < 2 * MiB).every(([a, e]) => e - a <= b.net.backgroundBytes() && e <= 2 * MiB), `the reader's block by pieces: ${JSON.stringify(got)}`);
  assert.equal(got.filter(([a]) => a < 2 * MiB).length, P - 5, 'all of its rest');
  assert.deepEqual(got.filter(([a]) => a >= 2 * MiB), [[2 * MiB, 3 * MiB], [3 * MiB, 4 * MiB]], 'then two whole blocks, nothing past them');
  // (at a block's start: that block and the next whole; a block with a piece here: its missing pieces)
  calls.length = 0;
  const c = new HttpBackend('/game/wb/', tr, { net: thin() }); c.net.mayStart = () => true;
  c.addPieces('f.big', 3 * P + 4, 3 * P + 4, bytes(3 * MiB + 4 * CHUNK, 3 * MiB + 5 * CHUNK), { size: SIZE, mtime: 3 });
  c.readAheadParts('f.big', SIZE, 3, 2 * MiB, 0, 40, 2 * MiB); await settle();
  const got2 = calls.map((x) => [x.start, x.end]);
  assert.deepEqual(got2[0], [2 * MiB, 3 * MiB], JSON.stringify(got2));
  assert.ok(got2.slice(1).every(([a, e]) => a >= 3 * MiB && e - a <= c.net.backgroundBytes() && !(a <= 3 * MiB + 4 * CHUNK && e > 3 * MiB + 4 * CHUNK)), `block 3 by its missing pieces: ${JSON.stringify(got2)}`);
  // (during a load: one whole block past the reader)
  calls.length = 0;
  const d = new HttpBackend('/game/wc/', tr, { net: thin() });
  const w = d.net.wait(); assert.ok(d.net.silenced()); d.net.mayStart = () => true;
  d.readAheadParts('f.big', SIZE, 3, 2 * MiB, 0, 40, 2 * MiB); await settle();
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((x) => [x.start, x.end]), [[2 * MiB, 3 * MiB], [3 * MiB, 4 * MiB]], 'during a load: the reader\'s next block (it ends on a block boundary) and one past it');
  d.net.waitEnd(w);
  // (a reader of few reads, or a short run: as before, no whole block; a media stream: its own seconds, no block)
  for (const [p, size, reads, run] of [['f.big', SIZE, 4, 2 * MiB], ['f.big', SIZE, 40, 512 << 10], ['Music/track.mp3', 6 * MiB, 400, 3 * MiB]]) {
    calls.length = 0;
    const e = new HttpBackend('/game/wd/', tr, { net: thin() }); e.net.mayStart = () => true;
    e.readAheadParts(p, size, 3, 2 * MiB, 20000, reads, run); await settle();
    assert.ok(calls.every((x) => x.end - x.start <= e.net.backgroundBytes()), `${p} ${reads} ${run}: ${JSON.stringify(calls.map((x) => [x.start, x.end]))}`);
    assert.equal(e.stats.wholeAheads ?? 0, 0);
  }
}));

test('thin link: whole blocks only for a file read from its start or a long run; never again a block on its way whole; one waiting for its turn at a time, dropped once its reader moved away', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const mk = (name) => { const b = new HttpBackend(`/game/${name}/`, tree(), { net: thin() }); b.net.mayStart = () => true; return b; };
  // (a 2 MiB run that did not start at the file's start — an archive's adjacent entries —: pieces; 4 MiB and more: blocks)
  const a = mk('wr');
  a.readAheadParts('f.big', SIZE, 3, 3 * MiB, 0, 40, 2 * MiB); await settle();
  assert.ok(calls.length > 0 && calls.every((x) => x.end - x.start <= a.net.backgroundBytes()), JSON.stringify(calls.map((x) => [x.start, x.end])));
  assert.equal(a.stats.wholeAheads ?? 0, 0);
  calls.length = 0;
  const a2 = mk('wr2');
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { a2.readAheadParts('f.big', SIZE, 3, 4 * MiB + 100, 0, 40, 4 * MiB); await settle(); }
  assert.ok(a2.stats.wholeAheads > 0 && calls.some((x) => x.start === 5 * MiB && x.end === 6 * MiB), JSON.stringify(calls.map((x) => [x.start, x.end])));
  // (blocks 2 and 3 on their way whole — the read-ahead of a link that was fast a moment ago —: not asked again)
  calls.length = 0;
  const c = mk('wf'), never = new Promise(() => {});
  c.blockFlights.set('f.big#2', never); c.blockFlights.set('f.big#3', never);
  c.readAheadParts('f.big', SIZE, 3, 2 * MiB, 0, 40, 2 * MiB); await settle();
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((x) => [x.start, x.end]), [[4 * MiB, 5 * MiB]], 'the block past them only');
  // (the link busy: the first whole block waits for its turn, no second one behind it; the reader reads elsewhere: dropped)
  calls.length = 0;
  for (const moved of [true, false]) {
    const d = new HttpBackend(`/game/wq${moved}/`, tree(), { net: thin() });
    d.net.mayStart = () => false;
    d.open('f.big').read(MiB, MiB); // (the reader: its run ends at 2 MiB)
    await settle(); calls.length = 0;
    d.readAheadParts('f.big', SIZE, 3, 2 * MiB, 0, 40, 2 * MiB);
    assert.equal(d.net.waiters.length, 1, 'one whole block waiting');
    if (moved) d.open('g.big').read(0, 100);
    await settle(); calls.length = 0;
    d.net.mayStart = () => true; d.net.kick(); await settle();
    const got = calls.map((x) => [x.start, x.end]);
    if (moved) assert.ok(!got.some(([s0, e0]) => s0 === 2 * MiB && e0 === 3 * MiB), `dropped: ${JSON.stringify(got)}`);
    else assert.deepEqual(got[0], [2 * MiB, 3 * MiB], 'fetched once its turn came');
  }
}));

test('thin link: a read-ahead of pieces waiting for its turn is dropped once its reader moved away, unless a read waits for it', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  // (a 1 MiB run read from the middle of the file — an archive's entries —: pieces ahead, not a whole block)
  for (const how of ['moved', 'stayed', 'parked']) {
    const d = new HttpBackend(`/game/pq${how}/`, tree(), { net: thin() });
    await withLinkOf(d, async () => {
    d.net.mayStart = () => false;
    d.open('f.big').read(2 * MiB, MiB);
    await settle(); calls.length = 0;
    d.readAheadParts('f.big', SIZE, 3, 3 * MiB, 0, 40, MiB);
    // (every read-ahead waiting for its turn, the range each asks)
    const flights = [...new Set([...d.flights.entries()].filter(([k]) => k.startsWith('f.big#')).map(([, f]) => f))];
    const ranges = flights.map((f) => { const cs = [...d.flights.entries()].filter(([, g]) => g === f).map(([k]) => +k.split('#')[1]); return [Math.min(...cs) * CHUNK, (Math.max(...cs) + 1) * CHUNK]; });
    assert.ok(ranges.length >= 2 && (d.stats.wholeAheads ?? 0) === 0, `pieces waiting for their turn: ${JSON.stringify(ranges)}`);
    assert.equal(d.net.waiters.length, ranges.length);
    assert.ok(ranges.some(([s0]) => s0 === 3 * MiB));
    // (a parked read of the first one's bytes: HttpBackend.fetchAhead, what ReadFile waits on — it promotes that one)
    const parked = how === 'parked' ? d.fetchAhead('f.big', SIZE, 3, 3 * MiB, 3 * MiB + 100, false) : null;
    if (how !== 'stayed') d.open('g.big').read(0, 100);
    await settle(); calls.length = 0;
    d.net.mayStart = () => true; d.net.kick(); await settle();
    if (parked) await parked;
    const got = calls.filter((x) => x.url.includes('f.big')).map((x) => [x.start, x.end]);
    const fetched = (rg) => got.some(([s0, e0]) => s0 <= rg[0] && e0 >= rg[1]);
    for (const rg of ranges) {
      const keep = how === 'stayed' || (how === 'parked' && rg[0] === 3 * MiB);
      assert.equal(fetched(rg), keep, `${how}: ${JSON.stringify(rg)} ${keep ? 'fetched' : 'dropped'} (${JSON.stringify(got)})`);
    }
    assert.equal(got.length, how === 'stayed' ? ranges.length : how === 'parked' ? 1 : 0, `${how}: ${JSON.stringify(got)}`);
    // (each dropped read-ahead counted once, however many times the link looked at the queue)
    d.net.kick(); await settle();
    assert.equal(d.stats.aheadsDropped ?? 0, how === 'moved' ? ranges.length : how === 'parked' ? ranges.length - 1 : 0, how);
    assert.equal(d.net.waiters.length, 0);
    });
  }
}));

test('thin link: a stream read from inside an archive keeps its queued read-ahead while another file is read in turn', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  // (music from one archive, ambience from another, each read a little at a time by the audio thread: neither is media
  // in the tree; each drops nothing of the other's)
  for (const stream of [true, false]) {
    const d = new HttpBackend(`/game/as${stream}/`, tree(), { net: thin() });
    const f = d.open('f.big'), g = d.open('g.big');
    await withLinkOf(d, async () => {
    d.net.mayStart = () => false;
    // (a stream: STREAM_READS reads in sequence, 256 KiB from 2 MiB — or a short run of 4 reads, not a stream)
    const n = stream ? 20 : 4, R = 16 << 10;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) f.read(2 * MiB + i * R, R);
    assert.equal(d.streams.has('f.big'), stream);
    const fEnd = 2 * MiB + n * R;
    // (its read-ahead asked past the reader, waiting for its turn)
    d.readAheadParts('f.big', SIZE, 3, fEnd, 16000, n, n * R);
    const waiting = d.net.waiters.filter((w) => [...d.flights.entries()].some(([k, fl]) => k.startsWith('f.big#') && fl.w === w));
    assert.ok(waiting.length >= 1, 'f.big read ahead, waiting');
    // (the other file read in turn: the backend's latest reader is g.big's now, again and again)
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { g.read(i * R, R); d.net.kick(); }
    if (stream) assert.ok(waiting.every((w) => d.net.waiters.includes(w)), 'still queued');
    await settle(); calls.length = 0;
    d.net.mayStart = () => true; d.net.kick(); await settle();
    const got = calls.filter((x) => x.url.includes('f.big'));
    assert.equal(d.net.waiters.length, 0);
    if (stream) {
      // (every one of them, the one past the reader's last byte too)
      assert.equal(got.length, waiting.length, `fetched: ${JSON.stringify(got)}`);
      assert.ok(got.some((x) => x.start === fEnd), `the bytes past the reader: ${JSON.stringify(got)}`);
      assert.equal(d.stats.aheadsDropped ?? 0, 0);
    } else {
      assert.equal(got.length, 0, `not a stream: dropped (${JSON.stringify(got)})`);
      assert.equal(d.stats.aheadsDropped, waiting.length);
    }
    // (a read elsewhere in the archive ends the stream: its next read-ahead drops again once its reader moved away)
    if (stream) {
      f.read(4 * MiB, 100); assert.ok(!d.streams.has('f.big'));
    }
    });
  }
}));

test('thin link: the learned prefetch fetches the learned pieces in order from the game\'s position, nothing else', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const store = new MemBlockStore();
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/p/', tree(), { store, encoded: true, net: thin() });
  b.gameBusy = () => false;
  const progress = {};
  // block 4 of f.big: pieces 1 and 2; block 0 of g.big: piece 0; block 1 of f.big: mask unknown (0)
  await b.prefetch([['f.big', 4, 0b110, 0], ['g.big', 0, 0b1, 100], ['f.big', 1, 0, 200]], progress);
  // (one 64 KiB piece per request: what 85 KB/s carries in BG_SECONDS, rounded up to a piece)
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((c) => [c.url.split('?')[0].split('/').pop(), c.start, c.end]), [['f.big', 4 * MiB + CHUNK, 4 * MiB + 2 * CHUNK], ['f.big', 4 * MiB + 2 * CHUNK, 4 * MiB + 3 * CHUNK], ['g.big', 0, CHUNK]]);
  assert.ok(calls.every((c) => c.url.includes('&p=1')), 'asked as background downloads');
  assert.ok(progress.done);
  assert.ok(store.map.has(`f.big#${SIZE}#3#c${4 * 16 + 1}`) && store.map.has(`g.big#${2 * MiB}#3#c0`));
  // the step estimate: what the learned entries past the position still need
  const b2 = new HttpBackend('/game/p/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, net: thin() });
  b2.learned = { entries: [{ path: 'f.big', size: SIZE, mtime: 3, index: 4, mask: 0b110, t: 0 }, { path: 'g.big', size: 2 * MiB, mtime: 3, index: 0, mask: 1, t: 100 }, { path: 'f.big', size: SIZE, mtime: 3, index: 1, mask: 0, t: 60000 }], pos: -1, rankOf: new Map() };
  assert.equal(b2.stepEstimate().bytes, 3 * CHUNK, 'up to the pause: two pieces and one piece');
}));

test('offline copy: the learned blocks first, then the rest; a second start resumes (stored blocks skipped)', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const store = new MemBlockStore();

  const asked = new Map(); for (const c of calls) { const k = `${c.url.split('?')[0]}#${c.start}`; asked.set(k, (asked.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); }
  assert.ok([...asked.values()].every((v) => v === 1), 'no range asked twice');

test('thin link: a parked read of pieces whose background request waits for its turn makes it go at once (no wait behind the game\'s other reads)', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  const net = thin(), b = new HttpBackend('/game/u/', tree(), { net });
  const f = b.open('f.big');
  const busy = net.begin('demand', CHUNK); // (another thread's read on its way: background turns wait on a thin link)
  const part = b.fetchPartBg('f.big', SIZE, 3, 32, 33, [5, 300]);
  await settle();
  assert.equal(calls.length, 0, 'waits for its turn');
  const p = f.prepare(32 * CHUNK + 10, 100);
  assert.ok(p, 'the read parks');
  await settle();
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1, 'promoted: started although a game read is in flight');
  assert.equal(await part, true);
  await p;
  const n0 = syncReqs.length;
  assert.deepEqual(f.read(32 * CHUNK + 10, 100), bytes(32 * CHUNK + 10, 32 * CHUNK + 110));
  assert.equal(syncReqs.length, n0, 'the read finds the pieces here');
  net.end(busy, CHUNK);
}));

test('thin link: a synchronous read aborts a background request for the same bytes; the read is exact and the aborted pieces are not kept half', async () => {
  const real = globalThis.fetch, pending = [];
  globalThis.fetch = (url, init = {}) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const m = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(init.headers?.Range ?? ''), a = +m[1], e = +m[2] + 1;
    const p = { a, e, resolve: () => resolve({ status: 206, headers: { get: () => null }, arrayBuffer: async () => bytes(a, e).buffer }) };
    init.signal?.addEventListener('abort', () => { p.aborted = true; reject(new DOMException('aborted', 'AbortError')); });
    pending.push(p);
  });
  try {
    const store = new MemBlockStore(), net = thin(), b = new HttpBackend('/game/v/', tree(), { store, net });
    const f = b.open('f.big');
    const part = b.fetchPartBg('f.big', SIZE, 3, 48, 48, [5, 0]);
    await settle();
    assert.equal(pending.length, 1);
    assert.deepEqual(f.read(48 * CHUNK + 7, 1000), bytes(48 * CHUNK + 7, 48 * CHUNK + 1007));
    assert.ok(pending[0].aborted, 'the background request for the same bytes went away');
    assert.equal(await part, false);
    assert.ok(store.map.has(`f.big#${SIZE}#3#c48`), 'the piece kept from the read');
    assert.deepEqual(store.get(`f.big#${SIZE}#3#c48`), bytes(48 * CHUNK, 49 * CHUNK));
    assert.equal(net.inflight.bg, 0); assert.equal(net.bgFlights.size, 0);
  } finally { globalThis.fetch = real; }
});

test('download first on a thin link: one block per request (a 4 MiB request would take 50 s), four on a fast one', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {

test('a link between thin and fast: a learned block wanted whole goes as the block (the server\'s unit), not as pieces; a slower one by pieces', () => withFetch(async (calls) => {
  // 1 MB/s: backgroundBytes() is 320 KiB, a block crosses the link in about 1 s (within WHOLE_BLOCK_SECONDS)
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/u/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, net: new NetLink({ bw: 1e6, fixed: true }) });
  b.gameBusy = () => false;
  assert.ok(b.net.backgroundBytes() < BLOCK && b.wholeBlockFits());
  // block 2 of f.big: every piece learned; block 4: pieces 1 and 2 (no whole block for those)
  await b.prefetch([['f.big', 2, 0xffff, 0], ['f.big', 4, 0b110, 10]], {}, () => false, { learnedOnly: true });
  const got = calls.map((c) => [c.start, c.end]);
  assert.deepEqual(got[0], [2 * MiB, 3 * MiB], `the whole block in one request: ${JSON.stringify(got)}`);
  assert.deepEqual(got.slice(1), [[4 * MiB + CHUNK, 4 * MiB + 2 * CHUNK], [4 * MiB + 2 * CHUNK, 4 * MiB + 3 * CHUNK]], 'the learned pieces of the other one');
  assert.ok(b.peekBlockHere('f.big', SIZE, 3, 2), 'the block kept whole');
  // 300 KB/s: a block would take ~3.5 s — while the game runs, by pieces, backgroundBytes() at a time
  calls.length = 0;
  const s = new HttpBackend('/game/u2/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, net: new NetLink({ bw: 400e3, fixed: true }) });
  s.gameBusy = () => false;
  assert.equal(s.wholeBlockFits(), false);
  await s.prefetch([['f.big', 2, 0xffff, 0]], {}, () => false);
  assert.ok(calls.length > 1 && calls.every((c) => c.end - c.start <= s.net.backgroundBytes()), `by pieces: ${calls.map((c) => (c.end - c.start) >> 10)} KiB`);
  // before the game starts (learnedOnly: a startup set, Prepare), nothing of the game's on the link: the block whole on
  // a thin link too (its unit: ~16 % fewer bytes than pieces brotli makes on the fly, 1 request instead of 16); a light
  // copy's pieces as they are made (by pieces)
  for (const bw of [400e3, 85e3]) {
    calls.length = 0;
    const t = new HttpBackend('/game/u3/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, net: new NetLink({ bw, fixed: true }) });
    t.gameBusy = () => false;
    await t.prefetch([['f.big', 2, 0xffff, 0], ['f.big', 4, 0b110, 10]], {}, () => false, { learnedOnly: true });
    const got2 = calls.map((c) => [c.start, c.end]);
    assert.deepEqual(got2[0], [2 * MiB, 3 * MiB], `${bw}: the whole block in one request: ${JSON.stringify(got2)}`);
    assert.ok(got2.slice(1).every(([a, e]) => a >= 4 * MiB && e <= 4 * MiB + 3 * CHUNK), `${bw}: the other one's learned pieces: ${JSON.stringify(got2)}`);
    assert.ok(t.peekBlockHere('f.big', SIZE, 3, 2), 'the block kept whole');
  }
}));

test('a fast link before the game starts (learnedOnly): the learned pieces only, several requests at once, none again of those here; while the game runs, whole blocks one at a time', async () => {
  const real = globalThis.fetch;
  let now = 0, most = 0, asked = [];
  globalThis.fetch = async (url) => {
    const [, a, e] = /[?&]r=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(url); asked.push([+a, +e]);
    now++; most = Math.max(most, now);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5)); now--;
    return { status: 206, headers: { get: () => null }, arrayBuffer: async () => bytes(+a, +e).buffer };
  };
  try {
    const files = {}; for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) files[`s${i}.txt`] = { size: 5000 + i, mtime: 3 };
    files['f.big'] = { size: SIZE, mtime: 3 };
    const list = Object.keys(files).filter((p) => p !== 'f.big').map((p, i) => [p, 0, 1, i]);
    const run = async (opts) => {
      const store = new MemBlockStore(), b = new HttpBackend('/game/q/', { dirs: {}, files }, { store, encoded: true, net: new NetLink({ bw: 20e6, fixed: true }) });
      b.gameBusy = () => false; most = 0; asked = [];
      // (block 1 of f.big: its learned pieces 0 and 3 here already — fetched by pieces before the link was measured)
      store.put(b.pieceKey('f.big', SIZE, 3, 16), bytes(MiB, MiB + CHUNK)); store.put(b.pieceKey('f.big', SIZE, 3, 19), bytes(MiB + 3 * CHUNK, MiB + 4 * CHUNK));
      const p = {}; await b.prefetch([...list, ['f.big', 1, 0b1001, 20], ['f.big', 2, 0b0110, 30]], p, () => false, opts);
      assert.ok(p.done);
      for (const [path, f] of Object.entries(files)) if (path !== 'f.big') assert.ok(b.peekBlockHere(path, f.size, 3, 0) || b.pieceHere(path, f.size, 3, 0), `${path} stored`);
      // (kept in the store, not only in memory: a fast link keeps whole blocks only otherwise — the pass fetched the same
      // pieces again and again once the memory's pieces were trimmed: Morrowind Vanilla+'s launch set, 56 000 requests)
      if (opts.learnedOnly) for (const c of [33, 34]) assert.ok(store.map.has(b.pieceKey('f.big', SIZE, 3, c)), `piece ${c} in the store`);
      return { most, asked: [...asked] };
    };
    const before = await run({ learnedOnly: true });
    assert.ok(before.most >= 4 && before.most <= 8, `requests at once: ${before.most}`);
    assert.ok(!before.asked.some(([a, e]) => a < 2 * MiB && e > MiB), `nothing of the block whose learned pieces are here: ${JSON.stringify(before.asked)}`);
    assert.deepEqual(before.asked.filter(([a]) => a >= 2 * MiB), [[2 * MiB + CHUNK, 2 * MiB + 2 * CHUNK], [2 * MiB + 2 * CHUNK, 2 * MiB + 3 * CHUNK]], 'the other block\'s learned pieces, not the block (its units)');
    const playing = await run({});
    assert.ok(playing.most <= 2, `one request at a time while the game runs (two blocks of one cut at their units): ${playing.most}`);
    assert.ok(playing.asked.some(([a]) => a === MiB), 'the whole block, the game running (the rest of it comes too)');
  } finally { globalThis.fetch = real; }
});

test('a block completed by the pieces of one request is stored once, as the block (its pieces not put and dropped: the store appends)', () => withFetch(async () => {
  for (const net of [new NetLink({ bw: 20e6, fixed: true }), thin()]) {
    const store = new MemBlockStore(), puts = [], put = store.put.bind(store);
    store.put = (k, v) => { puts.push(k); return put(k, v); };
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/once/', tree(), { store, encoded: true, net });
    b.gameBusy = () => false;
    // (block 2: every piece learned — whole; block 4: two pieces — kept as pieces)
    await b.prefetch([['f.big', 2, 0xffff, 0], ['f.big', 4, 0b110, 10]], {}, () => false, { learnedOnly: true });
    assert.ok(b.peekBlockHere('f.big', SIZE, 3, 2), 'block 2 kept whole');
    const own = (lo, hi) => puts.filter((k) => { const c = /#c(\d+)$/.exec(k); return c && +c[1] >= lo && +c[1] < hi; });
    assert.deepEqual(own(32, 48), [], `no piece of block 2 put: ${puts}`);
    assert.equal(puts.filter((k) => k.endsWith('#2')).length, 1, 'the block once');
    assert.deepEqual(own(64, 80).sort(), [b.pieceKey('f.big', SIZE, 3, 65), b.pieceKey('f.big', SIZE, 3, 66)].sort(), 'block 4\'s pieces kept');
  }
}));

test('learnedOnly with a full store: an entry the store did not keep is asked once (not again each time the memory evicts it)', async () => {
  const real = globalThis.fetch;
  const asked = [];
  globalThis.fetch = async (url) => {
    const [, a, e] = /[?&]r=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(url); asked.push([+a, +e]);
    return { status: 206, headers: { get: () => null }, arrayBuffer: async () => bytes(+a, +e).buffer };
  };
  try {
    const files = { 'f.big': { size: SIZE, mtime: 3 } };
    // (a store that keeps nothing, a memory cache of one block: every block evicted by the next)
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/full/', { dirs: {}, files }, { store: new MemBlockStore(0), encoded: true, net: new NetLink({ bw: 20e6, fixed: true }) });
    b.gameBusy = () => false;

    const p = {}; await b.prefetch(list, p, () => asked.length > 40, { learnedOnly: true });
    assert.ok(p.done, `the pass ended by itself after ${asked.length} requests`);
    const per = new Map(); for (const [a] of asked) { const k = Math.floor(a / MiB); per.set(k, (per.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); }
    assert.deepEqual([...per.values()], [1, 1, 1, 1], `each block asked once: ${JSON.stringify(asked)}`);
  } finally { globalThis.fetch = real; }

/** fetch stand-in answering after `ms`, each call with its time (performance.now) */
function withSlowFetch(ms, body) {
  const real = globalThis.fetch, calls = [];
  globalThis.fetch = async (url, init = {}) => {
    const m = /[?&]r=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(url), a = +m[1], e = +m[2];
    calls.push({ url, start: a, end: e, at: performance.now(), bg: url.includes('p=1') });
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
    return { status: 206, headers: { get: () => null }, arrayBuffer: async () => bytes(a, e).buffer };
  };
  return Promise.resolve(body(calls)).finally(() => { globalThis.fetch = real; });
}
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

test('between thin and fast: during a run of parked reads (a load) the block fill and the upgrades wait for its end, then go', () => withSlowFetch(30, async (calls) => {
  const tr = { dirs: { Splash: { dirs: {}, files: { 'pic.tga': { size: 3 * MiB, mtime: 3, light: 197000 } } } }, files: { 'level.dat': { size: 48 * MiB, mtime: 3 }, 'tex.dds': { size: 300000, mtime: 3, light: 40000 } } };
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/l/', tr, { encoded: true, net: new NetLink({ bw: 1.5e6, fixed: true }) });
  const f = b.open('level.dat');
  // (a picture's light copy read on a link that is not fast: its file is never fetched after it)
  b.upgrade('Splash/pic.tga', { soon: true });
  assert.equal(b.upgrades.size, 0, 'a picture is not upgraded'); assert.equal(b.stats.pictureKept, 1);
  // (the load: reads far apart, each parked — the game waits —, the engine's work between them; a texture read light
  // early in it, its file wanted soon)
  let runEnd = 0, dense = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    if (i === 2) dense = performance.now(); // (from its third wait on, a load: the first two may be play's)
    // (4 blocks apart: past the blocks near a missed one, which the fill may bring before the load is dense)
    const at = i * 4 * MiB + 12345, p = f.prepare(at, 4096, true);
    assert.ok(p, `read ${i} needs the network`);
    await p; assert.deepEqual(f.read(at, 4096), bytes(at, at + 4096));
    if (i === 1) b.upgrade('tex.dds', { soon: true });
    runEnd = performance.now();
    if (i < 9) await sleep(200); // (> the fill's 150 ms: it used to go in each of these gaps)
  }
  assert.ok(b.want.size > 0, 'the blocks the load touched are wanted');
  const during = calls.filter((c) => c.bg && c.at >= dense && c.at < runEnd);
  assert.deepEqual(during.map((c) => c.url), [], 'nothing of the background during the load');
  b.near.clear(); // (the blocks near the missed ones: not what this test looks at — the fill goes on with the rest sooner)
  for (let k = 0; k < 400 && !b.net.bgBy.upgrade; k++) await sleep(25);
  const after = calls.filter((c) => c.bg);
  assert.ok(after.some((c) => c.at >= runEnd + 400) && after.every((c) => c.at < dense || c.at >= runEnd + 400), 'after the gap that ends the load');
  assert.ok(after.some((c) => c.url.includes('tex.dds')), 'the upgrade too, once the game is quiet');
  assert.ok(!calls.some((c) => c.url.includes('pic.tga')));
  const by = b.net.snapshot().bgBy;
  assert.ok(by.want?.requests > 0 && by.upgrade?.requests > 0, JSON.stringify(by));
  // (on a fast link a picture is upgraded as any light copy)
  const fast = new HttpBackend('/game/l/', tr, { encoded: true, net: new NetLink({ bw: 200e6, fixed: true }) });
  fast.fillBackground = () => {}; fast.upgrade('Splash/pic.tga'); assert.equal(fast.upgrades.size, 3);
  for (const q of [b.want, b.near, b.later, b.upgrades]) q.clear(); // (the fill stops: the next test's fetch is its own)
  while (b.filling) await sleep(20);
}));
```

`tests/http-backend-want.test.js`:

```js
// Announced reads (docs/slow-network.md "Announced reads", HttpBackend.wantList): the ranges an engine says its next
// reads take are fetched in parallel as transport units (a window of requests in flight, in the list's order, `w=1`),
// not asked again when here or on their way, joined by a parked read of the same bytes (which makes a queued one go
// first), allowed during a load's silence, retried on a network failure and settled false when they fail.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { HttpBackend, BLOCK, CHUNK } from '../src/vfs/http-backend.js';
import { NetLink } from '../src/vfs/net-link.js';
import { MemBlockStore } from '../src/vfs/opfs-store.js';

const MiB = 1 << 20;
const byteAt = (i) => (i * 13 + (i >> 9)) & 0xff;
const bytes = (a, b) => Uint8Array.from({ length: b - a }, (_, k) => byteAt(a + k));
/** 60 small files (one piece each: a mesh, a light texture) and a 2.5 MiB archive */
const tree = () => {
  const files = { 'arc.bsa': { size: 2.5 * MiB, mtime: 7 } };
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) files[`m${i}.nif`] = { size: 20000 + i, mtime: 7 };
  return { dirs: {}, files };
};
/** a link neither thin nor fast (1.5 MB/s), as the slow-network measures */
const mid = () => new NetLink({ bw: 1.5e6, fixed: true });

/**
 * fetch stand-in: answers held until release() (or at once with `auto`); `fail(url)` → 'status' (404), 'throw' (network
 * down) or null. Returns { calls, inFlight, maxInFlight, release }.
 */
function heldFetch({ auto = false, fail = () => null } = {}) {
  const real = globalThis.fetch, waiting = [];
  const s = { calls: [], inFlight: 0, maxInFlight: 0, release() { for (const f of waiting.splice(0)) f(); } };
  globalThis.fetch = (url, init = {}) => {
    const m = /[?&]r=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(url) ?? /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(init.headers?.Range ?? '');
    const a = +m[1], e = /[?&]r=/.test(url) ? +m[2] : +m[2] + 1;
    s.calls.push({ url, start: a, end: e, file: url.split('?')[0].split('/').pop() });
    s.inFlight++; s.maxInFlight = Math.max(s.maxInFlight, s.inFlight);
    const how = fail(url);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const go = () => {
        s.inFlight--;
        if (how === 'throw') return reject(new TypeError('network down'));
        if (how === 'status') return resolve({ status: 404, headers: { get: () => null }, arrayBuffer: async () => new ArrayBuffer(0) });
        resolve({ status: 206, headers: { get: () => null }, arrayBuffer: async () => bytes(a, e).buffer });
      };
      if (auto) queueMicrotask(go); else waiting.push(go);
    });
  };
  s.restore = () => { globalThis.fetch = real; };
  return s;
}
const settle = async (n = 20) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1)); };

test('announced files are fetched in parallel (a window of unit requests, w=1, in order), kept; announced again: nothing asked', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch(), store = new MemBlockStore();
  try {
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/v/', tree(), { store, encoded: true, session: 'sess', net: mid() });
    const list = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => [`m${i}.nif`, 0, -1]);
    const done = b.wantList(list, { label: 'meshes:-2,6' });
    await settle(5);
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 32, 'the window: 32 requests at once, before any answer');
    assert.deepEqual(F.calls.map((c) => c.file), list.slice(0, 32).map(([p]) => p), 'in the list\'s order');
    assert.ok(F.calls.every((c) => /[?&]w=1/.test(c.url) && !/[?&]p=1/.test(c.url) && !/[?&]s=/.test(c.url)), 'announced: w=1, no session (not learned)');
    assert.ok(F.calls.every((c) => c.start === 0 && c.end === 20000 + Number(c.file.slice(1, -4))), 'each one unit: the file, its only block');
    assert.equal(b.net.loading(), true, 'the game waits for them: a load (the rest of the background keeps quiet)');
    F.release(); await settle(5); F.release(); await settle(5);
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(done), list.map(() => true));
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 40);
    assert.equal(b.stats.wantLabel, 'meshes:-2,6');
    assert.ok(store.map.has(`m39.nif#20039#7#0`), 'kept in the store as its block');
    assert.deepEqual(b.open('m7.nif').read(100, 50), bytes(100, 150), 'read from here');
    const again = b.wantList(list);
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(again), list.map(() => true));
    await settle(2);
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 40, 'here already: nothing asked');
    assert.equal(b.net.snapshot().bgBy.announced.requests, 40, 'counted as the announced reads\' in the link\'s producers');
  } finally { F.restore(); }
});

test('an archive range: its whole blocks as block units, a partial block as its pieces; size -1 to the end', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch({ auto: true });
  try {
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/v/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, net: mid() });
    // [0.5 MiB - 10, end): piece-aligned tail of block 0, all of block 1, block 2 (the file's tail, 0.5 MiB) whole
    const r = await Promise.all(b.wantList([['arc.bsa', MiB / 2 - 10, -1]]));
    assert.deepEqual(r, [true]);
    const got = F.calls.map((c) => [c.start, c.end]).sort((x, y) => x[0] - y[0]);
    const want = [];
    for (let c = (MiB / 2 - CHUNK) / CHUNK; c < MiB / CHUNK; c++) want.push([c * CHUNK, (c + 1) * CHUNK]);
    want.push([MiB, 2 * MiB], [2 * MiB, 2.5 * MiB]);
    assert.deepEqual(got, want);
    assert.ok(b.peekBlockHere('arc.bsa', 2.5 * MiB, 7, 1) && b.peekBlockHere('arc.bsa', 2.5 * MiB, 7, 2), 'whole blocks installed');
  } finally { F.restore(); }
});

test('what is on its way is joined, not asked again; a parked read of a queued unit joins it and makes it go first', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch();
  try {
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/v/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, net: mid() });
    // (a learned piece already on its way: fetchPartBg registers it as a flight)
    const own = b.fetchPartBg('m0.nif', 20000, 7, 0, 0, [2, 0]);
    await settle(2);
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 1);
    const list = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => [`m${i}.nif`, 0, -1]);
    const done = b.wantList(list);
    await settle(2);
    assert.equal(F.calls.filter((c) => c.file === 'm0.nif').length, 1, 'm0 joined the flight on its way');
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 1 + 32, 'the window full');
    // (m38: queued behind the window — a parked read of it waits for that unit, promoted past the window)
    const f = b.open('m38.nif');
    const parked = f.prepare(0, 100, true);
    assert.ok(parked, 'the read is not here: parked');
    await settle(2);
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 1 + 33, 'the queued unit went at once');
    assert.equal(F.calls.at(-1).file, 'm38.nif');
    assert.ok(/[?&]w=1/.test(F.calls.at(-1).url), 'as the announced request (no demand request of the same bytes)');
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { F.release(); await settle(3); }
    await parked; await own;
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(done), list.map(() => true));
    assert.equal(F.calls.filter((c) => c.file === 'm38.nif').length, 1, 'm38 asked once');
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 1 + 40 - 1, 'every file once (m0 by its flight)');
    assert.deepEqual(f.read(0, 100), bytes(0, 100));
  } finally { F.restore(); }
});

test('during a load\'s silence the announced units go; the other background waits', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch();
  try {
    const net = mid(), b = new HttpBackend('/game/v/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, net });
    // (a load: a dense run of reads the game waits for — NetLink.wait)
    const toks = [net.wait(), net.wait(), net.wait()];
    assert.equal(net.silenced(), true);
    const bg = b.fetchPartBg('m50.nif', 20050, 7, 0, 0, [5, 0]);
    await settle(2);
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 0, 'a background download waits for the load to end');
    const done = b.wantList([['m1.nif', 0, -1], ['m2.nif', 0, -1]]);
    await settle(2);
    assert.deepEqual(F.calls.map((c) => c.file).sort(), ['m1.nif', 'm2.nif'], 'the announced ones go (forLoad, urgent)');
    F.release(); await settle(3);
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(done), [true, true]);
    for (const t of toks) net.waitEnd(t);
    // (the load over: the background goes)
    for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !F.calls.some((c) => c.file === 'm50.nif'); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
    F.release(); await bg;
    assert.ok(F.calls.some((c) => c.file === 'm50.nif'));
  } finally { F.restore(); }
});

test('a queued background flight it joins goes first: the list\'s own silence does not hold it (no wait for the engine\'s timeout)', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch({ auto: true });
  try {
    const net = mid(), b = new HttpBackend('/game/v/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, net });
    // (a background piece (prefetch, fill, a learned piece no longer followed: not forLoad) queued behind a load's silence)
    const toks = [net.wait(), net.wait(), net.wait()];
    const bg = b.fetchPartBg('m50.nif', 20050, 7, 0, 0, [5, 0]);
    await settle(2);
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 0, 'held by the silence');
    for (const t of toks) net.waitEnd(t);
    // (the announced list's own wait keeps the link silenced; the joined flight must go all the same)
    const done = b.wantList([['m50.nif', 0, -1], ['m1.nif', 0, -1]]);
    assert.equal(net.silenced(), true, 'the list\'s wait: a load');
    let settled = false; const all = Promise.all(done).then((r) => { settled = true; return r; });
    for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !settled; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5));
    assert.equal(settled, true, 'the list settled (the joined flight was promoted)');
    assert.deepEqual(await all, [true, true]);
    assert.equal(F.calls.filter((c) => c.file === 'm50.nif').length, 1, 'joined, not asked again');
    assert.equal(await bg, true);
  } finally { F.restore(); }
});

test('failures: an answer refused fails at once, a network failure after its retries; the wait ends with them', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch({ auto: true, fail: (url) => (/m3\.nif/.test(url) ? 'status' : /m4\.nif/.test(url) ? 'throw' : null) });
  try {
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/v/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, net: mid(), retryWaits: [1, 1, 1] });
    const r = await Promise.all(b.wantList([['m3.nif', 0, -1], ['m4.nif', 0, -1], ['m5.nif', 0, -1], ['nope.nif', 0, -1]]));
    assert.deepEqual(r, [false, false, true, false]);
    assert.equal(F.calls.filter((c) => c.file === 'm3.nif').length, 1, 'refused: not asked again');
    assert.equal(F.calls.filter((c) => c.file === 'm4.nif').length, 3, 'network down: asked again twice');
    assert.equal(b.stats.wantFailed, 2);
    assert.equal(b.flights.size, 0, 'no flight left behind');
    await settle(2);
    assert.equal(b.net.waitsNow.size, 0, 'the link\'s wait over');
  } finally { F.restore(); }
});

test('a whole block already read ahead (blockFlights) is joined', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch();
  try {
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/v/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, net: mid() });

    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(done), [true]);
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 0);
    assert.equal(BLOCK, MiB);
  } finally { F.restore(); }
});

test('while an announced list is missing nothing is fetched ahead from the learned order; once here, it is', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch();
  let stopped = false;
  try {
    const files = { 'f.big': { size: 8 * MiB, mtime: 1 }, 'm0.nif': { size: 20000, mtime: 1 } };
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/w/', { dirs: {}, files }, { store: new MemBlockStore(), net: mid() });
    b.fillBackground = () => {}; b.noteMiss = () => {}; b.lastSyncFetchAt = performance.now() + 1e9; // (the learned pieces alone)
    const pass = b.prefetch([['f.big', 0, 0b1], ['f.big', 1, 0b100], ['f.big', 2, 0b1]], {}, () => stopped);
    await settle(2);
    const done = b.wantList([['m0.nif', 0, -1]], { label: 'meshes:0,0' });
    await settle(2);
    assert.deepEqual(F.calls.map((c) => c.file), ['m0.nif']);
    b.chunks.set('f.big#0', bytes(0, CHUNK)); b.chunkBytes += CHUNK;
    assert.deepEqual(b.open('f.big').read(100, 50), bytes(100, 150)); // the game reaches the learned list's entry 0
    await settle(2);
    assert.deepEqual(F.calls.map((c) => c.file), ['m0.nif'], 'nothing ahead while the announced file is missing');
    F.release();
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(done), [true]);
    await settle(5);
    assert.deepEqual(F.calls.slice(1).map((c) => [c.file, c.start]), [['f.big', MiB + 2 * CHUNK], ['f.big', 2 * MiB]], 'the learned pieces ahead once it is here');
    stopped = true; F.release(); await pass;
  } finally { stopped = true; F.release(); F.restore(); }
});

test('a list the engine waits for through its own reads (wait false) holds neither the link nor the learned read-ahead', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch();
  let stopped = false;
  try {
    const files = { 'f.big': { size: 8 * MiB, mtime: 1 }, 'm0.nif': { size: 20000, mtime: 1 } };
    const net = mid(), b = new HttpBackend('/game/w/', { dirs: {}, files }, { store: new MemBlockStore(), net });
    b.fillBackground = () => {}; b.noteMiss = () => {}; b.lastSyncFetchAt = performance.now() + 1e9; // (the learned pieces alone)
    const pass = b.prefetch([['f.big', 0, 0b1], ['f.big', 1, 0b100], ['f.big', 2, 0b1]], {}, () => stopped);
    await settle(2);
    const done = b.wantList([['m0.nif', 0, -1]], { label: 'textures:m1', wait: false });
    await settle(2);
    assert.equal(net.waitsNow.size, 0, 'no wait of the link\'s');
    assert.equal(b.wantLists, 0); assert.equal(b.wantLoose, 1);
    assert.ok(b.loadUnderWay(), 'a load under way all the same');
    b.chunks.set('f.big#0', bytes(0, CHUNK)); b.chunkBytes += CHUNK;
    assert.deepEqual(b.open('f.big').read(100, 50), bytes(100, 150)); // the game reaches the learned list's entry 0
    await settle(2);
    assert.deepEqual(F.calls.slice(1).map((c) => [c.file, c.start]), [['f.big', MiB + 2 * CHUNK], ['f.big', 2 * MiB]], 'the learned pieces ahead meanwhile');
    F.release();
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(done), [true]);
    await settle(2);
    assert.equal(b.wantLoose, 0);
    stopped = true; F.release(); await pass;
  } finally { stopped = true; F.release(); F.restore(); }
});

test('on an HTTP/1.x origin a list the engine waits for through its reads keeps connections free (WANT_REQUESTS_H1_LOOSE); a waited list does not', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch();
  try {
    const net = new NetLink({ bw: 1.5e6, fixed: true, protocol: 'http/1.1' });
    assert.equal(net.h1(), true); assert.equal(new NetLink({ protocol: 'h2' }).h1(), false);
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/v/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, net });
    const loose = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => [`m${i}.nif`, 0, -1]);
    const done = b.wantList(loose, { label: 'textures:m', wait: false });
    await settle(5);
    assert.deepEqual(F.calls.map((c) => c.file), ['m0.nif', 'm1.nif', 'm2.nif', 'm3.nif'], 'four at once, in the list\'s order: two of the six connections left');
    // (a list the engine waits for: its own window, past the held units)
    const waited = b.wantList([['m20.nif', 0, -1], ['m21.nif', 0, -1]], { label: 'meshes:0,0' });
    await settle(5);
    assert.deepEqual(F.calls.slice(4).map((c) => c.file), ['m20.nif', 'm21.nif']);
    // (a parked read of a held unit: it goes at once)
    const parked = b.open('m8.nif').prepare(0, 100, true);
    assert.ok(parked, 'the read is not here: parked');
    await settle(5);
    assert.equal(F.calls.at(-1).file, 'm8.nif', 'a parked read\'s unit goes past the window');
    for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) { F.release(); await settle(5); }
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(done), loose.map(() => true));
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(waited), [true, true]);
    assert.ok(F.maxInFlight <= 7, `at most four loose units beside the others and the parked read's (${F.maxInFlight})`);
    await parked;
  } finally { F.release(); F.restore(); }
});

// A predicted place (wantList `prio: 'place'`, docs/openmw.md "Anticipated places"): the set of the place a saved game
// will load, fetched while the link is idle before the player clicks — background turns below the game's reads, a
// load's and the launch set, not learned, no wait of the link's, joined (and promoted) by what the game then needs.
test('a predicted place: background requests (p=1, not learned), a small window, held by a load\'s silence, no wait of the link\'s', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch();
  try {
    const net = mid(), b = new HttpBackend('/game/v/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, session: 'sess', net });
    const toks = [net.wait(), net.wait(), net.wait()];
    const list = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => [`m${i}.nif`, 0, -1]);
    const done = b.wantList(list, { prio: 'place', label: 'place:-2,6' });
    await settle(3);
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 0, 'not forLoad nor urgent: a load holds it');
    assert.equal(net.waitsNow.size, 3, 'no wait of its own (the engine waits for nothing)');
    assert.equal(b.wantLists, 0, 'the learned read-ahead is not paused for it');
    assert.equal(b.stats.placeLabel, 'place:-2,6');
    assert.equal(b.stats.wantLabel, undefined, 'not an announced load\'s label');
    for (const t of toks) net.waitEnd(t);
    for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !F.calls.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
    assert.ok(F.calls.length > 0 && F.calls.length <= 8, `its window (${F.calls.length} requests)`);
    assert.ok(F.calls.every((c) => /[?&]p=1/.test(c.url) && !/[?&]w=1/.test(c.url) && !/[?&]s=/.test(c.url)), 'background, not learned');
    for (let i = 0; i < 40 && F.calls.length < 10; i++) { F.release(); await settle(3); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5)); }
    F.release();
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(done), list.map(() => true));
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 10);
    assert.equal(b.stats.placeUnits, 10);
    assert.equal(b.stats.wantUnits, undefined);
    assert.equal(net.snapshot().bgBy.place.requests, 10, 'counted as the place\'s');
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(b.wantList(list, { prio: 'place' })), list.map(() => true), 'asked again: here already');
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 10);
  } finally { F.restore(); }
});

test('a predicted place\'s queued unit that an announced list (or a parked read) needs goes at once, asked once; announced units first', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch();
  try {
    const net = mid(), b = new HttpBackend('/game/v/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, net });
    const toks = [net.wait(), net.wait(), net.wait()];
    const place = b.wantList(Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => [`m${i}.nif`, 0, -1]), { prio: 'place' });
    await settle(3);
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 0);
    // (the player loaded that place: the engine announces some of the same files — joined, promoted past the silence)
    const done = b.wantList([['m7.nif', 0, -1], ['m1.nif', 0, -1], ['m20.nif', 0, -1]]);
    await settle(3);
    assert.deepEqual(F.calls.map((c) => c.file).sort(), ['m1.nif', 'm20.nif', 'm7.nif']);
    // (a parked read of another of the place's units: it goes too)
    const parked = b.open('m9.nif').prepare(0, 100, true);
    await settle(3);
    assert.ok(F.calls.some((c) => c.file === 'm9.nif'));
    F.release(); await settle(3);
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(done), [true, true, true]);
    await parked;
    for (const t of toks) net.waitEnd(t);
    for (let i = 0; i < 60 && F.calls.length < 11; i++) { F.release(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10)); }
    F.release();
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(place), Array(10).fill(true));
    for (const f of ['m1.nif', 'm7.nif', 'm9.nif']) assert.equal(F.calls.filter((c) => c.file === f).length, 1, `${f} asked once`);
    // (announced units waiting for their requests (the window full): a place's wait for them)
    const a2 = b.wantList(Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => [`m${10 + i}.nif`, 0, -1]).filter(([p]) => p !== 'm20.nif'));
    const p2 = b.wantList(Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => [`m${50 + i}.nif`, 0, -1]), { prio: 'place' });
    await settle(3);
    const n0 = F.calls.length;
    assert.equal(b.placeQ.length, 5, 'queued behind the announced ones');
    assert.ok(!F.calls.some((c) => /m5[0-4]\./.test(c.file)));
    let over = false; const all2 = Promise.all([...a2, ...p2]).then((r) => { over = true; return r; });
    for (let i = 0; i < 300 && !over; i++) { F.release(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5)); }
    assert.ok((await all2).every(Boolean));
    const order = F.calls.slice(n0 - 32).map((c) => c.file);
    assert.ok(order.findIndex((f) => /m5[0-4]\./.test(f)) > order.indexOf('m49.nif'), 'the place\'s after every announced unit');
  } finally { F.restore(); }
});

test('a predicted place\'s queued units an announced list names go under the announced window, in its order — not all at once', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch();
  try {
    const net = mid(), b = new HttpBackend('/game/v/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, net });
    const tok = net.wait(); // (a load's silence: the place's units stay queued)
    const files = Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, i) => [`m${i}.nif`, 0, -1]);
    const place = b.wantList(files, { prio: 'place' });
    await settle(3);
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 0);
    // (the player loads that place: the engine announces the same files, the other way round)
    const announced = [...files].reverse(), done = b.wantList(announced);
    await settle(3);
    // (the place's first PLACE_REQUESTS_THIN… — 8 — had their requests already, waiting for their turn: a load's own now,
    // by the link's rules; the 52 still queued joined the announced queue, the window's 32 of them at once)
    const ann = F.calls.filter((c) => /[?&]w=1/.test(c.url)), early = F.calls.filter((c) => !/[?&]w=1/.test(c.url));
    assert.equal(ann.length, 32, 'the window, not the 52 promoted at once');
    assert.ok(early.length <= 8, `the place's own requests only (${early.length})`);
    assert.deepEqual(ann.map((c) => c.file), announced.filter(([p]) => !early.some((c) => c.file === p)).slice(0, 32).map(([p]) => p), 'in the announcement\'s order');
    for (let i = 0; i < 60 && F.calls.length < 60; i++) { F.release(); await settle(2); }
    F.release();
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(done), Array(60).fill(true));
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(place), Array(60).fill(true));
    assert.equal(F.calls.length, 60, 'each asked once');
    assert.ok(F.maxInFlight <= 40, `at most the window and the place's own in flight (${F.maxInFlight})`);
    assert.equal(b.stats.placeAdopted, 60 - early.length);
    net.waitEnd(tok);
  } finally { F.restore(); }
});

test('the learned order\'s launch set goes before a predicted place, the rest of the order after it', async () => {
  const files = { 'a.bin': { size: 2 * MiB, mtime: 1 }, 'b.bin': { size: 2 * MiB, mtime: 1 } };
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/w/', { dirs: {}, files }, { store: new MemBlockStore(), net: mid() });
  b.fillBackground = () => {}; b.noteMiss = () => {};
  const prios = [];
  // (each learned piece as if fetched: here at once)
  b.fetchPartBg = (path, size, mtime, c0, c1, prio) => { prios.push([path, prio[0]]); b.chunks.set(`${path}#${c0}`, new Uint8Array(CHUNK)); return Promise.resolve(true); };
  const real = globalThis.fetch; globalThis.fetch = () => Promise.reject(new Error('none'));
  try {
    const list = [['a.bin', 0, 0b1], ['b.bin', 0, 0b1]]; list.first = 1;
    await b.prefetch(list, {}, () => false, { first: 1 });
    let placePrio = null;
    b.fetchBackground = (path, s, e, onStart, abortable, learn, turn) => { placePrio = turn.prio[0]; return Promise.resolve(undefined); };
    await Promise.all(b.wantList([['a.bin', MiB, MiB + 100]], { prio: 'place' }));
    assert.deepEqual([...new Set(prios.map(([p]) => p))], ['a.bin', 'b.bin']);
    prios.splice(1, prios.findIndex(([p]) => p === 'b.bin') - 1);
    assert.ok(prios[0][1] < placePrio && placePrio < prios[1][1], `launch set ${prios[0][1]} < place ${placePrio} < the rest ${prios[1][1]}`);
  } finally { globalThis.fetch = real; }
});

test('on a fast link the upgrades of light copies wait for an announced list (the engine reads nothing meanwhile), then go', async () => {
  const F = heldFetch();
  try {
    const net = new NetLink({ bw: 12e6, fixed: true });
    assert.equal(net.fast(), true); assert.equal(net.silenced(), false, 'a fast link: the gate does not silence');
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/v/', tree(), { store: new MemBlockStore(), encoded: true, session: 'sess', net });
    const done = b.wantList([['m0.nif', 0, -1], ['m1.nif', 0, -1]], { label: 'textures:-2,6' });
    await settle(3);
    assert.equal(b.loadUnderWay(), true, 'a list waited for: a load under way');
    // (an earlier place's light copy read: its file queued, `soon`; the game read nothing for long — it spins on the wait)
    b.upgrade('arc.bsa', { soon: true });
    assert.ok(b.upgrades.size > 0);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1800));
    assert.ok(!F.calls.some((c) => c.file === 'arc.bsa'), `no upgrade during the load: ${JSON.stringify(F.calls.map((c) => c.file))}`);
    F.release();
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(done), [true, true]);
    assert.equal(b.loadUnderWay(), false);
    for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !F.calls.some((c) => c.file === 'arc.bsa'); i++) { F.release(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 25)); }
    assert.ok(F.calls.some((c) => c.file === 'arc.bsa'), 'the upgrade once the load is over');
    for (let i = 0; i < 100 && b.upgrades.size; i++) { F.release(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10)); }
    b.upgrades.clear(); F.release();
  } finally { F.restore(); }
});
```

`tests/http-backend-whole.test.js`:

```js
// After the learned prefetch, an archive the game keeps reading at random (blocks missed in WHOLE_AFTER_MISSES distinct
// places) is wanted whole: its other blocks queued for the background fill — not before the prefetch is over, not
// without a block store, not for a media file nor a stream; the files wanted whole filled in order (laterNext: the one
// the game waited on latest, else the latest wanted). Fake synchronous XHR (the game's reads), fill not run.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { HttpBackend } from '../src/vfs/http-backend.js';

const MiB = 1 << 20, SIZE = 8 * MiB;
const byteAt = (i) => (i * 29 + (i >> 10)) & 0xff;
const bytes = (a, b) => Uint8Array.from({ length: b - a }, (_, k) => byteAt(a + k));
globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = class {
  open(m, url) { this.url = url; }
  setRequestHeader(k, v) { this.range = v; }
  send() { const [, a, b] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(this.range); this.status = 206; this.response = bytes(+a, +b + 1).buffer; }
};
// (fetch exists, never answers: the block downloads a miss starts stay in flight)
const realFetch = globalThis.fetch;
const memStore = () => { const map = new Map(); return { map, failed: false, has: (k) => map.has(k), put: (k, v) => { if (!map.has(k)) map.set(k, v.slice()); }, get: (k) => map.get(k)?.slice() ?? null, flush() {} }; };
function backend({ done = true, store = true, media = false } = {}) {
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/w/', { dirs: {}, files: { 'f.big': { size: SIZE, mtime: 1, ...(media ? { media: true } : {}) } } }, store ? { store: memStore() } : {});
  b.fillBackground = () => {}; // (what is queued, not its download)
  b.learnedDone = done;
  return b;
}
const wanted = (b) => [...b.later.values()].map((w) => w.index).sort((x, y) => x - y);

test('a file missed in 3 distinct blocks after the learned prefetch: wanted whole, once (when turned on)', async () => {
  globalThis.fetch = () => new Promise(() => {});
  globalThis.ORTHROS_WHOLE_AFTER_MISSES = 1;
  try {
    const b = backend(), f = b.open('f.big');
    f.read(2 * MiB + 100, 10); f.read(5 * MiB + 100, 10); f.read(5 * MiB + 9000, 10);
    assert.deepEqual(wanted(b), [], 'two distinct blocks: not yet');
    f.read(7 * MiB + 100, 10);
    const w = wanted(b);
    assert.ok(w.length >= 5 && w.every((i) => i >= 0 && i < 8), `the rest of the file wanted: ${w}`);
    assert.equal(b.missedAfter.get('f.big'), true);
    assert.equal(b.stats.wholeAfterMisses, 1);
    b.later.clear(); f.read(0, 10); f.read(3 * MiB, 10);
    assert.deepEqual(wanted(b), [], 'asked once');
    for (const [o, why] of [[{ done: false }, 'the learned prefetch still running'], [{ store: false }, 'no block store'], [{ media: true }, 'a media file']]) {
      const c = backend(o), g = c.open('f.big');
      for (const blk of [1, 3, 4, 6]) g.read(blk * MiB + 100, 10);
      assert.deepEqual(wanted(c), [], why);
    }
  } finally { globalThis.fetch = realFetch; delete globalThis.ORTHROS_WHOLE_AFTER_MISSES; }
});

test('by default a file missed after the learned prefetch is not wanted whole (the download doubled for little)', async () => {
  globalThis.fetch = () => new Promise(() => {});
  try {
    const b = backend(), f = b.open('f.big');
    for (const at of [2, 5, 7, 9]) f.read(at * MiB + 100, 10);
    assert.deepEqual(wanted(b), []);
  } finally { globalThis.fetch = realFetch; }
});

test('files wanted whole fill file by file: the one the game waited on latest first, else the latest wanted; blocks in order', async () => {
  globalThis.fetch = () => new Promise(() => {});
  try {
    const tree = { dirs: {}, files: { 'sfx.raw': { size: 4 * MiB, mtime: 1 }, 'gta3.img': { size: 3 * MiB, mtime: 1 }, 'other.dat': { size: 2 * MiB, mtime: 1 } } };
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/w/', tree, { store: memStore() });
    b.fillBackground = () => {};
    const next = () => { const [, w] = b.laterNext(); return `${w.path}#${w.index}`; };
    // (a bank wanted whole at the engine's start, an archive at the new game's: the archive first, from its block 0)
    b.wantWhole('sfx.raw'); b.wantWhole('gta3.img');
    assert.equal(next(), 'gta3.img#0', 'the latest file wanted whole, its first block');
    b.later.delete('gta3.img#0'); assert.equal(next(), 'gta3.img#1', 'its blocks in order');
    // (an ask of a sample the game goes on past — not held: a skipped sample, readable() — is no wait)
    // (its fetch never answers: the read stays parked)
    b.open('sfx.raw').prepare(2 * MiB + 100, 100);
    assert.equal(next(), 'gta3.img#1', 'a read the game did not wait for does not reorder');
    // (the game waits on the bank — a held read of a sample —, then on the archive)
    b.open('sfx.raw').prepare(3 * MiB + 100, 100, true);
    assert.equal(next(), 'sfx.raw#0', 'the file the game waited on goes first, from its first block still missing');
    b.open('gta3.img').read(2 * MiB + 100, 10); // (a synchronous read: fetchRange)
    assert.equal(next(), 'gta3.img#1', 'the game\'s latest wait: the archive');
    // (a file the game waited on, wanted whole after: first — its wait the latest)
    b.open('other.dat').read(100, 10); b.wantWhole('other.dat');
    assert.equal(next(), 'other.dat#0', 'waited on before it was wanted whole: first');
    for (const k of [...b.later.keys()]) if (k.startsWith('other.dat') || k.startsWith('gta3.img')) b.later.delete(k);
    assert.equal(next(), 'sfx.raw#0', 'the archive whole: the bank');
  } finally { globalThis.fetch = realFetch; }
});

test('a read the game went on past never outranks one it was blocked on (the fill keeps to the archive)', async () => {
  globalThis.fetch = () => new Promise(() => {});
  try {
    const tree = { dirs: {}, files: { 'sfx.raw': { size: 4 * MiB, mtime: 1 }, 'gta3.img': { size: 3 * MiB, mtime: 1 } } };
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/w/', tree, { store: memStore() });
    b.fillBackground = () => {};
    const next = () => { const [, w] = b.laterNext(); return w.path; };
    b.wantWhole('gta3.img'); b.wantWhole('sfx.raw');
    // (the archive's held read, then many unheld sample asks and a background fetch of the bank: still the archive)
    b.open('gta3.img').prepare(MiB + 10, 10, true);
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) b.open('sfx.raw').prepare(i * 300 * 1024 + 7, 100);
    b.fetchAhead('sfx.raw', 4 * MiB, 1, 3 * MiB + 100, 3 * MiB + 200, false);
    assert.equal(next(), 'gta3.img');
  } finally { globalThis.fetch = realFetch; }
});
```
