`tests/jit-chaining.test.js`:

```js
// Region chaining: a translated region tail-calls the next region directly when the jump target
// is already translated (registers/lazy flags travel as parameters, see translate.js emitChain).
// Hand-built loops are split into several regions with explicit boundaries and checked against
// the reference interpreter; the stop address and untranslated targets must still return to
// the dispatcher.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, ST, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-sse.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { MAX_BLOCKS } from '../src/cpu/jit/translate.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const ARITH = F.CF | F.PF | F.AF | F.ZF | F.SF | F.OF;
const hex = (v) => '0x' + (v >>> 0).toString(16);

function makeExec(useJit, opts = {}) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  const I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
  const jit = useJit ? new Jit(mem, I, { smc: true, ...opts }) : null;
  return {
    mem, cpu, I, jit,
    run(stopAt, boundaries, maxInsns = 1000000) {
      I.cache.clear();
      if (!jit) return I.run({ stopAt, maxInsns });
      jit.boundaries = new Set([...boundaries, stopAt]);
      jit.cpu = cpu;
      return jit.run({ stopAt, maxInsns });
    },
  };
}

/** Tiny assembler for the handful of encodings used here (32-bit operand/address size). */
class Asm {
  constructor(base) { this.base = base; this.bytes = []; this.labels = new Map(); this.fixups = []; }
  get pc() { return this.base + this.bytes.length; }
  label(name) { this.labels.set(name, this.pc); return this; }
  emit(...b) { this.bytes.push(...b); return this; }
  imm32(v) { return this.emit(v & 0xff, (v >> 8) & 0xff, (v >> 16) & 0xff, (v >>> 24) & 0xff); }
  movEcxImm(v) { return this.emit(0xb9).imm32(v); }
  movEaxImm(v) { return this.emit(0xb8).imm32(v); }
  addEaxEcx() { return this.emit(0x01, 0xc8); }
  subEaxImm8(v) { return this.emit(0x83, 0xe8, v & 0xff); }
  decEcx() { return this.emit(0x49); }
  incEdx() { return this.emit(0x42); }
  /** rel32 jump/jcc to a label */
  jmp(name) { this.emit(0xe9); this.fixups.push([this.bytes.length, name]); return this.imm32(0); }
  jcc(cc, name) { this.emit(0x0f, 0x80 | cc); this.fixups.push([this.bytes.length, name]); return this.imm32(0); }
  fld1() { return this.emit(0xd9, 0xe8); }
  faddSt0St0() { return this.emit(0xd8, 0xc0); }
  fstpQword(addr) { return this.emit(0xdd, 0x1d).imm32(addr); }
  hlt() { return this.emit(0xf4); }
  finish() {
    for (const [at, name] of this.fixups) {
      const target = this.labels.get(name); if (target === undefined) throw new Error('label ' + name);
      const rel = target - (this.base + at + 4);
      this.bytes[at] = rel & 0xff; this.bytes[at + 1] = (rel >> 8) & 0xff; this.bytes[at + 2] = (rel >> 16) & 0xff; this.bytes[at + 3] = (rel >>> 24) & 0xff;
    }
    return Uint8Array.from(this.bytes);
  }
}

function load(E, code) {
  E.cpu.reset();
  E.mem.fill(DATA, 0x1000, 0);
  E.mem.fill(CODE, 0x1000, 0xcc);
  E.mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
  E.cpu.eip = CODE;
  E.cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800;
  E.cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
}
function snapshot(E) {
  const s = { eip: hex(E.cpu.eip), eflags: hex(E.cpu.eflags & ARITH), regs: [], top: E.cpu.fpuTop, mem: Buffer.from(E.mem.bytes(DATA, 64)).toString('hex') };
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) s.regs.push(hex(E.cpu.reg(k)));
  return s;
}

// eax = sum(1..N) computed by a loop whose body spans three regions (region boundary at L1 only:
// a region whose entry is itself a boundary is discovered as a single block, so L2 is left to
// become a region entry through the `jmp L2` exit of L1 and keeps its two blocks):
//   entry:  mov ecx, N ; mov eax, 0        -> falls into L1 (boundary)
//   L1:     add eax, ecx ; jmp L2          (region; every iteration chains L1 -> L2)
//   L2:     dec ecx ; jz end ; jmp L1      (region of two blocks: the not-taken jz falls through
//                                           inside the region, which charges the instruction
//                                           budget; the jmp chains L2 -> L1 with lazy DEC flags)
//   end:    hlt                            (stop address)
const N = 1000;
function loopProgram() {
  const a = new Asm(CODE);
  a.movEcxImm(N).movEaxImm(0);
  a.label('L1').addEaxEcx().jmp('L2');
  a.label('L2').decEcx().jcc(0x4, 'end').jmp('L1'); // jz end
  a.label('end').hlt();
  return { code: a.finish(), L1: a.labels.get('L1'), L2: a.labels.get('L2'), end: a.labels.get('end') };
}

test('a loop split across regions chains between them and matches the interpreter', () => {
  const { code, L1, L2, end } = loopProgram();
  const EI = makeExec(false), EJ = makeExec(true);
  load(EI, code); load(EJ, code);
  assert.equal(EI.run(end, []), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(EJ.run(end, [L1]), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(EJ), snapshot(EI));
  assert.equal(EJ.cpu.eax, (N * (N + 1)) / 2);
  assert.equal(EJ.cpu.eip, end);
  assert.ok(EJ.jit.stats.regions >= 3, `regions: ${EJ.jit.stats.regions}`);
  // every iteration crosses L1 -> L2 and L2 -> L1 (minus the first entries that miss the hash table)
  assert.ok(EJ.jit.stats.chained >= 2 * N - 4, `chained: ${EJ.jit.stats.chained}`);
  assert.equal(EJ.mem.read32(EJ.cpu.base + ST.TRANSITIONS), 0, 'counter harvested');
});

test('chaining never targets the stop address or an untranslated region', () => {
  const { code, L1, L2, end } = loopProgram();
  const EJ = makeExec(true);
  load(EJ, code);
  // stop at L2: the first pass through L1 must halt at L2 even once L2 gets translated later
  assert.equal(EJ.run(L2, [L1]), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(EJ.cpu.eip, L2);
  assert.equal(EJ.cpu.eax, N); assert.equal(EJ.cpu.ecx, N);
  const chainedBefore = EJ.jit.stats.chained;
  // run to the end from L2 (translating it), then restart the whole program with L2 translated:
  // the L1 -> L2 transition must still stop at L2 when L2 is the stop address
  assert.equal(EJ.run(end, [L1]), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(EJ.cpu.eax, (N * (N + 1)) / 2);
  assert.ok(EJ.jit.stats.chained > chainedBefore, 'chained after both regions exist');
  const chainedMid = EJ.jit.stats.chained;
  EJ.cpu.eip = CODE; EJ.cpu.eax = 0; EJ.cpu.ecx = 0;
  assert.equal(EJ.run(L2, [L1]), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(EJ.cpu.eip, L2);
  assert.equal(EJ.cpu.eax, N); assert.equal(EJ.cpu.ecx, N);
  // exactly one transition chained (entry -> L1); L1 -> L2 returned to the dispatcher instead
  assert.equal(EJ.jit.stats.chained, chainedMid + 1, 'no chained transition into the stop address');
  // stop at L1 while looping: the L2 -> L1 back edge must halt at L1 with the lazy DEC flags folded
  EJ.cpu.eip = L2; EJ.cpu.ecx = 5; EJ.cpu.eax = 7;
  assert.equal(EJ.run(L1, [L1]), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(EJ.cpu.eip, L1);
  assert.equal(EJ.cpu.ecx, 4);
  assert.equal(EJ.cpu.eflags & F.ZF, 0);
  assert.equal(EJ.mem.read32(EJ.cpu.base + ST.LZ_OP), 0, 'lazy flags materialized at the halt');
});

test('the instruction budget still ends a chained loop with time slices', () => {
  const { code, L1, L2, end } = loopProgram();
  const EI = makeExec(false), EJ = makeExec(true);
  load(EI, code); load(EJ, code);
  assert.equal(EI.run(end, []), EXIT.HALT);
  // warm up: translate everything, then rerun in slices of a few instructions
  assert.equal(EJ.run(end, [L1]), EXIT.HALT);
  load(EJ, code);
  let slices = 0, r;
  for (;;) {
    r = EJ.run(end, [L1], 50);
    if (r !== EXIT.TIMESLICE) break;
    slices++;
    assert.ok(EJ.jit.remaining() <= 0, 'budget exhausted at the time slice');
    assert.equal(EJ.mem.read32(EJ.cpu.base + ST.LZ_OP), 0, 'lazy flags materialized at the time slice');
    assert.ok(slices < N, 'runaway');
  }
  assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT);
  assert.ok(slices >= 10, `slices: ${slices}`);
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(EJ), snapshot(EI));
});

test('chaining with the chain option disabled produces the same results and no transitions', () => {
  const { code, L1, L2, end } = loopProgram();
  const EJ = makeExec(true, { chain: false });
  assert.equal(EJ.jit.chaining, false);
  load(EJ, code);
  assert.equal(EJ.run(end, [L1]), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(EJ.cpu.eax, (N * (N + 1)) / 2);
  assert.equal(EJ.jit.stats.chained, 0);
});

test('x87 TOP and lazy flags survive a chained transition', () => {
  // L0: fld1 ; sub eax, 1 ; jmp L1      (TOP changes, lazy SUB flags pending at the exit)
  // L1: fadd st0, st0 ; fstp [DATA] ; jz L2 ; inc edx   (flags evaluated in the next region)
  // L2: hlt
  const a = new Asm(CODE);
  a.label('L0').fld1().subEaxImm8(1).jmp('L1');
  a.label('L1').faddSt0St0().fstpQword(DATA).jcc(0x4, 'L2').incEdx();
  a.label('L2').hlt();
  const code = a.finish();
  const L1 = a.labels.get('L1'), L2 = a.labels.get('L2');
  for (const eax of [1, 2]) {
    const EI = makeExec(false), EJ = makeExec(true);
    load(EI, code); load(EJ, code);
    EI.cpu.eax = eax; EJ.cpu.eax = eax;
    // translate L1 first so the L0 -> L1 jump chains
    EJ.cpu.eip = L1; assert.equal(EJ.run(L2, [L1]), EXIT.HALT);
    load(EJ, code); EJ.cpu.eax = eax;
    assert.equal(EI.run(L2, []), EXIT.HALT);
    assert.equal(EJ.run(L2, [L1]), EXIT.HALT);
    assert.deepEqual(snapshot(EJ), snapshot(EI), `eax=${eax}`);
    assert.equal(EJ.mem.f64[DATA >>> 3], 2);
    assert.equal(EJ.cpu.edx, eax === 1 ? 0 : 1);
    assert.ok(EJ.jit.stats.chained >= 1, `chained: ${EJ.jit.stats.chained}`);
  }
});

test('a jump chain longer than MAX_BLOCKS spans several regions and chains through them', () => {
  // a straight chain of MAX_BLOCKS*3 tiny blocks `inc edx ; jmp next`, run twice
  const a = new Asm(CODE);
  const n = MAX_BLOCKS * 3;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) a.label('b' + i).incEdx().jmp('b' + (i + 1));
  a.label('b' + n).hlt();
  const code = a.finish();
  const end = a.labels.get('b' + n);
  const EJ = makeExec(true);
  load(EJ, code);
  assert.equal(EJ.run(end, []), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(EJ.cpu.edx, n);
  assert.ok(EJ.jit.stats.regions >= 3, `regions: ${EJ.jit.stats.regions}`);
  assert.equal(EJ.jit.stats.chained, 0, 'first pass: every region was a translation miss');
  load(EJ, code);
  assert.equal(EJ.run(end, []), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(EJ.cpu.edx, n);
  assert.ok(EJ.jit.stats.chained >= EJ.jit.stats.regions - 1, `chained: ${EJ.jit.stats.chained} regions: ${EJ.jit.stats.regions}`);
});

test('interpreter ranges (debugging): code in a range runs in the interpreter, never inside a region, with the same result', () => {
  // mov ecx, 300 ; eax = 0 ; loop: add eax, ecx ; [range: sub eax, 3 ; inc edx] ; dec ecx ; jnz loop ; hlt
  const a = new Asm(CODE);
  a.movEcxImm(300).movEaxImm(0).label('loop').addEaxEcx().label('r0').subEaxImm8(3).incEdx().label('r1').decEcx().jcc(5, 'loop').label('end').hlt();
  const code = a.finish(), end = a.labels.get('end'), lo = a.labels.get('r0'), hi = a.labels.get('r1');
  const EI = makeExec(false); load(EI, code); assert.equal(EI.run(end, []), EXIT.HALT);
  for (const slice of [1e6, 37]) {
    const EJ = makeExec(true, { interpRanges: [[lo, hi]] }); load(EJ, code);
    let r, n = 0;
    do r = EJ.run(end, [], slice); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE && ++n < 1e5);
    assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT);
    assert.deepEqual([EJ.cpu.eax, EJ.cpu.edx], [EI.cpu.eax, EI.cpu.edx], `slice ${slice}`);
    assert.ok(EJ.jit.stats.interpRangeSteps >= 600, 'the range ran in the interpreter');
    for (const r2 of EJ.jit.regions) for (const b of r2.blocks) assert.ok(b.end <= lo || b.eip >= hi, 'no block overlapping the range translated');
  }
});
```

`tests/jit-code-cache-crash.test.js`:

```js
// Translated code cache (code-cache.js), review: the file's records survive a session cut short at any write (the
// tab closed mid-append, mid-supersede, mid-eviction or mid-compaction) — the next load either starts over or finds
// only entries whose bodies are exactly what was added for that entry, extent and bytes; compactions moving records
// larger than one move span (MOVE_SPAN) keep every byte.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { CodeCache, MemStore } from '../src/cpu/jit/code-cache.js';

/** a store whose writes stop at the n-th (the tab closed): every later write, truncate and flush throws */
class CutStore {
  constructor(inner, n) { this.inner = inner; this.n = n; }
  cut() { if (this.n-- <= 0) throw new Error('cut'); }
  size() { return this.inner.size(); }
  read(at, len) { return this.inner.read(at, len); }
  write(at, b) { this.cut(); this.inner.write(at, b); }
  truncate(n) { this.cut(); this.inner.truncate(n); }
  flush() { this.cut(); this.inner.flush(); }
}

test('code cache: a session cut short at any write leaves a file that loads to correct entries or starts over', () => {
  let rs = 4242;
  const r = (n) => { rs = (Math.imul(rs, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0; return (rs >>> 8) % n; };
  const u8 = new Uint8Array(0x10000);
  let cuts = 0, restarts = 0, hits = 0, compactCuts = 0;
  for (let trial = 0; trial < 120; trial++) {
    const store = new MemStore(), MAX = 8000 + r(16000);
    const model = new Map(); // key -> Set of bodies ever added for it (a cut add may or may not have landed)
    for (let session = 0; session < 12; session++) {
      const cutAt = r(3) === 0 ? r(60) : Infinity;
      const cs = new CutStore(store, cutAt);
      let c;
      try { c = new CodeCache(cs, 'k', MAX); } catch { cuts++; continue; }
      if (c.stats.reset) { restarts++; model.clear(); }
      try {
        for (let n = 0; n < 30; n++) {
          const eip = 0x100 * (1 + r(16)), shape = r(3), nb = 1 + ((eip >> 8) + shape) % 3, ext = [];
          for (let b = 0, a = eip; b < nb; b++) { const end = a + 1 + ((a + shape) % 6); ext.push({ eip: a, end }); a = end + 1; }
          const prog = r(4) === 0 ? 1 : 0, snap = [];
          for (const b of ext) for (let a = b.eip; a < b.end; a++) { u8[a] = (a * 7 + prog * 13) & 0xff; snap.push(u8[a]); }
          const key = `${eip}|${ext.map((b) => `${b.eip}-${b.end}`).join(',')}|${prog}`;
          const hit = c.lookup(eip, null, ext, Uint8Array.from(snap), [], null, u8);
          if (hit) {
            hits++;
            assert.ok(model.get(key)?.has(hit.code.join(',')), `trial ${trial} session ${session}: a hit is a body added for exactly this`);
            continue;
          }
          const code = Array.from({ length: 40 + r(900) }, () => r(256));
          (model.get(key) ?? model.set(key, new Set()).get(key)).add(code.join(','));
          c.add({ eip, fpcIn: null, blocks: ext.map((b, i) => ({ ...b, index: i })), deps: [], stats: {}, snap: Uint8Array.from(snap), code: Uint8Array.from(code) });
          if (r(6) === 0) c.maintain();
        }
        c.flush();
      } catch (e) {
        assert.equal(e.message, 'cut');
        cuts++;
        if (c.store.inner.size() >= 16 && new DataView(store.read(12, 4).buffer).getUint32(0, true) & 1) compactCuts++;
      }
    }
  }
  assert.ok(cuts > 20 && restarts > 0 && compactCuts > 0 && hits > 200, `cuts ${cuts} (in a compaction ${compactCuts}), restarts ${restarts}, hits ${hits}`);
});

test('code cache: a compaction moving records larger than a move span keeps them byte for byte', () => {
  const store = new MemStore(), MB = 1 << 20, MAX = 24 * MB;
  const body = (eip, n) => { const b = new Uint8Array(n); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) b[i] = (eip * 31 + i * 7 + (i >> 11)) & 0xff; return b; };
  const ext = (eip) => [{ eip, end: eip + 4 }], snap = Uint8Array.of(1, 2, 3, 4);
  const entry = (eip, n) => ({ eip, fpcIn: null, blocks: [{ eip, end: eip + 4, index: 0 }], deps: [], stats: {}, snap, code: body(eip, n) });
  const sizes = { 0x1000: 5 * MB, 0x2000: 3 * MB, 0x3000: 2 * MB + 17, 0x4000: 6 * MB, 0x5000: 1 * MB + 3 };
  let c = new CodeCache(store, 'k', MAX);
  for (const [a, n] of Object.entries(sizes)) assert.ok(c.add(entry(+a, n)));
  // session 2 reuses some, session 3 adds past the bound: the others evicted, the kept ones moved over them
  c = new CodeCache(store, 'k', MAX);
  for (const a of [0x2000, 0x4000, 0x5000]) assert.ok(c.lookup(a, null, ext(a), snap, []));
  c = new CodeCache(store, 'k', MAX);
  assert.ok(c.lookup(0x4000, null, ext(0x4000), snap, []));
  assert.ok(c.add(entry(0x6000, 7 * MB)));
  c.maintain();
  assert.ok(c.stats.compactions >= 1 && c.stats.evicted >= 1, `compactions ${c.stats.compactions}, evicted ${c.stats.evicted}`);
  c = new CodeCache(store, 'k', MAX);
  for (const a of [0x4000, 0x6000]) {
    const hit = c.lookup(a, null, ext(a), snap, []);
    assert.ok(hit, `kept ${a.toString(16)}`);
    assert.deepEqual(hit.code, body(a, a === 0x6000 ? 7 * MB : sizes[a]), `${a.toString(16)} byte for byte`);
  }
  assert.ok(store.size() <= MAX);
});
```

`tests/jit-code-cache-heat-adversarial.test.js`:

```js
// Adversarial review of the translated-code cache under code heat (bg-translate.js heatRecorder / sameHeat,
// code-cache.js lookup `accept`, translate.js patchVisitSlots): random programs mixing integer code, x87 arithmetic
// under control-word changes (FLDCW: x87-mode versions of regions, translated on the main thread from the blocks of a
// first version that may come from the cache), divisions that may fault and calls, run over several sessions sharing
// ONE cache. Each session is a new Jit with the background translator and visit flags: a heat drawn from a small pool
// (so that sessions repeat an earlier heat — reuse — or bring another one), sometimes grown mid-session between two
// batches of learned entries (random instruction addresses, random x87 modes: covered entries under heat cuts), flag
// bytes and table indexes shifted, half the programs with a small cache bound (entries superseded, evicted, the file
// compacted between and during sessions), half with the worker idle after each session (shapes refreshed under the
// grown heat). Every run ends as the interpreter does, and every region the background worker
// answered — reused or translated — has the extent, block numbering, x87 mode and visit flags a fresh translation
// under the session's heat of the moment gives.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { decode } from '../src/cpu/decoder.js';
import { RangeHeat } from '../src/cpu/jit/heat.js';
import { translateRegion, allocBlockCounters, discoverRegion, VisitSlots } from '../src/cpu/jit/translate.js';
import { MemStore } from '../src/cpu/jit/code-cache.js';
import { handleMessage, sensitive, touched } from '../src/cpu/jit/bg-translate.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const ARITH = F.CF | F.PF | F.AF | F.ZF | F.SF | F.OF;
let seed = 90210;
const rnd = (n) => { seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0; return (seed >>> 8) % n; };
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
const R3 = () => rnd(4);
const CWS = [0x027f, 0x007f, 0x0c7f, 0x037f];
const unit = () => {
  switch (rnd(9)) {
    case 0: return [0x01, 0xc0 | (R3() << 3) | R3()];
    case 1: return [0x83, 0xc0 | (rnd(8) << 3) | R3(), rnd(256)];
    case 2: return [0x89, 0x46 | (R3() << 3), 4 * rnd(16)];
    case 3: return [0xd1, 0xe0 | (rnd(2) ? 8 : 0) | R3()];
    case 4: return [0x31, 0xd2, 0xf7, 0xf3];
    case 5: return [0xd9, 0x6e, 0x70 + 2 * rnd(4)];
    case 6: {
      const op = [[0xd8, 0x46], [0xd8, 0x4e], [0xd8, 0x66]][rnd(3)];
      return [0xd9, 0x46, 4 * rnd(16), ...op, 4 * rnd(16), 0xd9, 0x5e, 4 * rnd(16)];
    }
    case 7: return [0xdb, 0x46, 4 * rnd(16), 0xdb, 0x5e, 4 * rnd(16)];
    default: return [0x31, 0xdb];
  }
};
function gen() {
  const nb = 4 + rnd(10), nf = 1 + rnd(3);
  const kinds = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) kinds.push('b');
  for (let i = 0; i < nf; i++) kinds.splice(rnd(kinds.length + 1), 0, 'f');
  kinds.unshift('b');
  const fns = kinds.map((k, i) => (k === 'f' ? i : -1)).filter((i) => i >= 0), blocksIdx = kinds.map((k, i) => (k === 'b' ? i : -1)).filter((i) => i >= 0);
  const out = [], start = [], fix = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < kinds.length; i++) {
    start[i] = out.length;
    if (kinds[i] === 'f') { for (let k = rnd(3); k >= 0; k--) out.push(...unit()); out.push(0xc3); continue; }
    out.push(0x4f, 0x0f, 0x84); fix.push([out.length, -1]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0);
    for (let k = rnd(4); k > 0; k--) out.push(...unit());
    const tgt = blocksIdx[rnd(blocksIdx.length)];
    switch (rnd(4)) {
      case 0: out.push(0x0f, 0x80 + rnd(16)); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); break;
      case 1: out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); break;
      case 2: out.push(0xe8); fix.push([out.length, fns[rnd(fns.length)]]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0);
        if (i + 1 < kinds.length && kinds[i + 1] === 'f') { out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, blocksIdx[rnd(blocksIdx.length)]]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); }
        break;
      default: if (i + 1 < kinds.length && kinds[i + 1] === 'f') { out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); } break;
    }
  }
  if (kinds[kinds.length - 1] === 'f') { out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, 0]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); }
  const end = out.length; out.push(0xf4);
  for (const [at, t] of fix) out.splice(at, 4, ...le((t < 0 ? end : start[t]) - (at + 4)));
  return { code: Uint8Array.from(out), end };
}
const V = [0, 1, 2, 0x7f, 0x80, 0xffff, 0x3f800000, 0x7fffffff, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff, 0x12345678];
const val = () => (rnd(2) ? V[rnd(V.length)] : ((rnd(65536) << 16) | rnd(65536)) >>> 0);
const input = () => ({ regs: [val(), val(), val(), val(), rnd(0x1000)], edi: 20 + rnd(300), cw: CWS[rnd(CWS.length)], data: Array.from({ length: 16 }, () => (rnd(3) ? [0x3f800000, 0x40490fdb, 0xc2c80000, 0x4b000001, 0x3eaaaaab][rnd(5)] : val())) });
function init(mem, cpu, inp) {
  cpu.reset(); mem.fill(DATA, 0x1000, 0);
  inp.data.forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(DATA + 0x100 + 4 * i, v));
  CWS.forEach((cw, i) => mem.write16(DATA + 0x170 + 2 * i, cw));
  [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx] = inp.regs; cpu.edi = inp.edi; cpu.esi = DATA + 0x100; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; cpu.eip = CODE;
  cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF | (inp.regs[4] & ARITH);
  mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, inp.cw);
}
const stateOf = (r, mem, cpu) => [r, cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx, cpu.esp, cpu.edi, cpu.eflags & ARITH, cpu.eip, mem.read16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW), mem.u8[cpu.base + ST.FPU_TOP] & 7].map((v) => (v >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ') + ' ' + [...mem.bytes(DATA + 0x100, 0x80), ...mem.bytes(DATA + 0x700, 0x100)].join(',');
function setup(code, shared) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory({ shared }), cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  mem.fill(CODE, 0x1000, 0xcc); mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
  return { mem, cpu };
}
/** random [lo, hi) pairs over the instructions (each ran or not) */
function randomPairs(addrs) {
  const p = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < addrs.length; i++) if (rnd(3)) p.push(addrs[i], i + 1 < addrs.length ? addrs[i + 1] : addrs[i] + 1);
  return p;
}
const tick = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));

test('code cache under heat, adversarial: sessions sharing one cache, heats repeated / changed / grown, x87 modes, covered entries', async () => {
  let hits = 0, missHeat = 0, missExtent = 0, versions = 0, covered = 0, checked = 0, grown = 0, superseded = 0, evicted = 0, compactions = 0, refreshed = 0;
  for (let t = 0; t < 40; t++) {
    const { code, end } = gen();
    const scratch = new GuestMemory(); scratch.writeBytes(CODE, code);
    const addrs = [];
    for (let a = 0; a <= end;) { addrs.push(CODE + a); a = decode(scratch, CODE + a).next - CODE; }
    const store = new MemStore(), maxBytes = rnd(2) ? undefined : 6000 + rnd(30000); // (a small bound: evictions, compactions)
    const idle = rnd(2) === 0; // (the background worker idle after each session: room made, shapes refreshed under the grown heat)
    const pool = [null, randomPairs(addrs), randomPairs(addrs), addrs.length ? [CODE, CODE + end + 1] : null];
    const coldMin = 1 + rnd(3);
    for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) {
      const inp = input();
      const ref = setup(code, false); init(ref.mem, ref.cpu, inp);
      const want = stateOf(new Interp(ref.mem, ref.cpu).run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: 1e7 }), ref.mem, ref.cpu);
      const { mem, cpu } = setup(code, true);
      if (rnd(2)) allocBlockCounters(mem, 1 + rnd(5000)); // (the session's flag bytes elsewhere)
      init(mem, cpu, inp);
      const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true, visit: true, coldExits: true, coldMin });
      jit.cpu = cpu;
      for (let i = rnd(20); i > 0; i--) jit.reserveFn();
      const heat0 = pool[rnd(pool.length)];
      let grownNow = !!heat0;
      if (heat0) jit.heatAdd(heat0);
      // the heat the background worker sees, mirrored here: the translation a reused region must equal
      const mirror = new RangeHeat(); if (heat0) mirror.addPairs(heat0);
      const replies = [];
      let bgOpts = null;
      jit.attachBackground({ postMessage: (msg) => {
        if (msg.type === 'init') bgOpts = msg.opts;
        handleMessage(msg.type === 'init' ? { ...msg, cache: { key: 'test|adv', store, maxBytes, idleMs: idle ? 1 : undefined, refreshGapMs: 0 } } : msg, (r) => replies.push(r));
      } });
      await tick();
      const learnedOf = () => addrs.filter(() => rnd(3) === 0).map((a) => [a, rnd(3) ? CWS[rnd(4)] & 0xf00 : null]);
      const answer = (hasHeat) => {
        for (const rep of replies.splice(0)) {
          if (rep.type !== 'batch') continue;
          hits += rep.cacheHits ?? 0;
          for (const it of rep.items) {
            if (it.covered) { covered++; continue; }
            if (it.k < 0) continue;
            // a fresh translation under the heat of now, with the region's own flag bytes: same extent, numbering,
            // x87 mode, flagged blocks
            const flags = new Map((it.stats.visits ?? []).map(([e, , a]) => [e, a]));
            const fresh = translateRegion(mem, it.eip, { ...bgOpts, heat: hasHeat ? mirror : null, visitSlots: { get: (_m, e) => flags.get(e) ?? 0x7ff00000 }, fnIdx: it.fnIdx, fpcAssume: it.fpc });
            assert.deepEqual(it.blocks.map((b) => [b.eip, b.end, b.index]), fresh.blocks.map((b) => [b.eip, b.end, b.index]), `program ${t} session ${k} region ${it.eip.toString(16)}: extent / numbering`);
            assert.equal(it.fpc, fresh.fpcAssume, 'x87 mode');
            assert.deepEqual((it.stats.visits ?? []).map((v) => v[0]), (fresh.stats.visits ?? []).map((v) => v[0]), `program ${t} session ${k} region ${it.eip.toString(16)}: flagged blocks`);
            checked++;
          }
          jit.bgInstall(rep);
        }
      };
      jit.bgPrewarm(learnedOf()); await tick(); await tick();
      answer(!!heat0);
      // the heat grown mid-session (visit flags harvested, a later learned list)
      if (rnd(2)) {
        const more = randomPairs(addrs);
        if (more.length) { jit.heatAdd(more); mirror.addPairs(more); grown++; grownNow = true; }
        jit.bgPrewarm(learnedOf()); await tick(); await tick();
        answer(!!heat0 || more.length > 0);
      }
      const slice = [1e7, 1, 3, 17][rnd(4)];
      let r;
      for (let n = 0; ; n++) {
        if (n > 1e6) throw new Error('runaway');
        r = jit.run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: slice });
        if (r !== EXIT.TIMESLICE) break;
      }
      CpuState.foldLazyFlags?.(cpu);
      assert.equal(stateOf(r, mem, cpu), want, `program ${t} session ${k} slice ${slice}: ${Buffer.from(code).toString('hex')}`);
      versions += jit.stats.fpuVersions ?? 0;
      if (idle) {
        // (until the refresh pass the grown heat asks for is done, 2 s at most)
        let st = null;
        for (let w = 0; w < 200; w++) {
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
          handleMessage({ type: 'cache-stats' }, (rep) => { st = rep.cache; });
          if (!grownNow || st?.refreshPasses > 0) break;
        }
        refreshed += st?.refreshed ?? 0;
      }
      if (jit.bg.cache) { missHeat += jit.bg.cache.missHeat; missExtent += jit.bg.cache.missExtent; superseded += jit.bg.cache.superseded; evicted += jit.bg.cache.evicted; compactions += jit.bg.cache.compactions; }
    }
  }
  assert.ok(hits > 100, `regions reused: ${hits}`);
  assert.ok(missHeat > 10, `other heat answers: ${missHeat}`);
  assert.ok(missExtent > 10, `other extents: ${missExtent}`);
  assert.ok(superseded > 10 && evicted > 5 && compactions > 3 && refreshed > 10, `superseded ${superseded}, evicted ${evicted}, compactions ${compactions}, refreshed ${refreshed}`);
  assert.ok(versions > 5, `x87-mode versions: ${versions}`);
  assert.ok(covered > 20, `covered entries: ${covered}`);
  assert.ok(grown > 20 && checked > 500, `heat grown ${grown}, regions checked ${checked}`);
});

test('refresh filter: a region none of whose heat-sensitive addresses gained heat keeps its extent and visit flags', () => {
  // (bg-translate.js sensitive / touched: a refresh pass discovers again only the regions the added heat touches)
  let same = 0, rediscovered = 0, changed = 0;
  for (let t = 0; t < 300; t++) {
    const { code, end } = gen();
    const mem = new GuestMemory(); mem.fill(CODE, 0x1000, 0xcc); mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
    const addrs = [];
    for (let a = 0; a <= end;) { addrs.push(CODE + a); a = decode(mem, CODE + a).next - CODE; }
    const coldMin = 1 + rnd(3), h1 = new RangeHeat();
    if (rnd(4)) h1.addPairs(randomPairs(addrs));
    const more = randomPairs(addrs).filter((_, i, p) => i % 2 === 0 && rnd(4) === 0).flatMap((lo) => [lo, lo + 1 + rnd(6)]);
    const h2 = new RangeHeat(); h2.addPairs(h1.pairs()); h2.addPairs(more);
    const delta = new RangeHeat(); delta.addPairs(more); delta.merge();
    const opts = { coldExits: true, coldMin, visit: true };
    const shape = (h, entry) => {
      const blocks = discoverRegion(mem, entry, { ...opts, heat: h }).blocks;
      const flagged = translateRegion(mem, entry, { ...opts, heat: h, visitSlots: new VisitSlots() }).stats.visits?.map((v) => v[0]) ?? [];
      return { blocks, key: JSON.stringify([blocks.map((b) => [b.eip, b.end]), flagged]) };
    };
    for (const entry of addrs.filter(() => rnd(3) === 0)) {
      const a = shape(h1, entry), b = shape(h2, entry);
      if (!touched(sensitive(a.blocks), delta)) { same++; assert.equal(b.key, a.key, `program ${t} entry ${entry.toString(16)}: untouched, the same shape`); }
      else { rediscovered++; if (b.key !== a.key) changed++; }
    }
  }
  assert.ok(same > 200 && rediscovered > 200 && changed > 50, `untouched ${same}, rediscovered ${rediscovered} (changed ${changed})`);
});
```

`tests/jit-code-cache-heat.test.js`:

```js
// Translated code kept across sessions (code-cache.js, bg-translate.js) under code heat (heat.js, cold exits and
// visit flags): a cached region is reused only where the heat of the session gives its extent and flags every block
// the heat does not know to have run — another heat cutting the region otherwise (another extent) or leaving such a
// block unflagged is another translation, which supersedes the earlier shape of the same code —, its visit flags move
// to the session's own flag bytes (those of blocks the heat learned since to a byte never harvested), and the learned
// entries a heat-cut region no longer holds are not skipped as covered. Every run matches the reference interpreter.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { translateRegion, patchVisitSlots, VisitSlots, allocBlockCounters } from '../src/cpu/jit/translate.js';
import { MemStore } from '../src/cpu/jit/code-cache.js';
import { handleMessage } from '../src/cpu/jit/bg-translate.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const tick = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
/** (timers of the background worker's idle moments: waits until `f()`, 5 s at most) */
const until = async (f) => { for (let t = 0; t < 500 && !f(); t++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10)); };
// CODE+0  dec ecx ; jz COLD          (the cold successor: taken once, at the last iteration of ecx)
// CODE+3  inc eax ; dec ebp ; jnz CODE
// CODE+7  hlt                        (stopAt: never executed — its block entered, its flag set)
// CODE+8  COLD: inc edx ; jmp CODE+3
const PROGRAM = Uint8Array.of(0x49, 0x74, 0x05, 0x40, 0x4d, 0x75, 0xf9, 0xf4, 0x42, 0xeb, 0xf8);
const STOP = CODE + 7, COLD = CODE + 8;
// heats (pairs lo, hi): every block ran; all but the cold block (the jz ran: its cold successor is cut out);
// the cold block only (the jz never ran: nothing cut, the other blocks flagged); none (every block flagged)
const H = { all: [CODE, CODE + 11], cut: [CODE, CODE + 8], coldOnly: [COLD, CODE + 11], none: null };

function machine(regs) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory({ shared: true });
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE); cpu.reset();
  mem.fill(CODE, 0x1000, 0xcc); mem.writeBytes(CODE, PROGRAM);
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebp] = regs; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, 0x027f);
  return { mem, cpu, interp: new Interp(mem, cpu) };
}
const state = (c) => [c.eax, c.ecx, c.edx, c.ebp, c.eip].map((x) => (x >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ');
function reference(regs) {
  const m = machine(regs);
  const r = m.interp.run({ stopAt: STOP, maxInsns: 1e6 });
  return { r, s: state(m.cpu) };
}

/**
 * One session: the background translator with the cache (`store`), the heat `heat` known before the learned entries
 * are asked, `shiftFlags` flag bytes taken first (the session's visit flags elsewhere than the last one's), `over`
 * in-session options. Returns the run, the batch items, the background stats and the visits harvested after the run.
 */
async function session(store, heat, { regs = [0, 3, 0, 10], learned = [[CODE, null]], shiftFlags = 0, over = null, skipFns = 0, maxBytes, idleMs, refresh } = {}) {
  const m = machine(regs);
  if (shiftFlags) allocBlockCounters(m.mem, shiftFlags);
  const jit = new Jit(m.mem, m.interp, { smc: true, visit: true, warn: (s) => { throw new Error(s); } });
  jit.cpu = m.cpu;
  for (let i = 0; i < skipFns; i++) jit.reserveFn();
  if (heat) jit.heatAdd(heat);
  const replies = [];
  jit.attachBackground({ postMessage: (msg) => handleMessage(msg.type === 'init' ? { ...msg, cache: { key: 'test|heat', store, maxBytes, idleMs, refresh } } : msg, (r) => replies.push(r)) });
  if (over) jit.switchOpts(over);
  await tick();
  jit.bgPrewarm(learned); await tick(); await tick();
  const items = [];
  for (const rep of replies.splice(0)) if (rep.type === 'batch') { items.push(...rep.items); jit.bgInstall(rep); }
  let r, k = 0;
  do r = jit.run({ stopAt: STOP, maxInsns: 1e6 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE && ++k < 1e5);
  const visited = jit.harvestVisits();
  const ran = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < visited.length; i += 2) ran.push(visited[i] - CODE);
  return { r, s: state(m.cpu), items, bg: jit.bg, ran: ran.sort((a, b) => a - b), installed: jit.bg.installed };
}

test('code cache with heat: a region cached under one heat is reused where the heat of now gives its translation', async () => {
  const store = new MemStore(), ref = reference([0, 3, 0, 10]);
  const run = async (name, opts) => {
    const s = await session(store, H[name], opts);
    assert.equal(s.r, ref.r, name); assert.equal(s.s, ref.s, `${name}: like the interpreter`);
    assert.equal(s.installed, 1, `${name}: the learned region installed`);
    return s;
  };
  // heat that cuts the cold block out: added, then reused by a session with the same heat
  let s = await run('cut');
  assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 0); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.added, 1);
  s = await run('cut', { skipFns: 9 });
  assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 1, 'same heat: reused');
  // every block ran: the region holds the cold block (another extent) — not the cut one's code
  s = await run('all');
  assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 0, 'another heat (another extent): translated again');
  assert.equal(s.bg.cache.missExtent, 1); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.added, 1);
  s = await run('all');
  assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 1);
  // no heat: the same extent as 'all' (nothing cut either way), but every block needs a visit flag — the entry of
  // 'all' flags none: translated again (and the entry of 'all', the same code, superseded)
  s = await run('none');
  assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 0, 'the same extent, blocks the heat does not know left unflagged: translated again');
  assert.equal(s.bg.cache.missHeat, 1); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.added, 1); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.superseded, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(s.ran, [0, 3, 7, 8], 'the blocks that ran, from the visit flags');
  s = await run('none', { shiftFlags: 777 });
  assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 1, 'no heat again: reused');
  assert.deepEqual(s.ran, [0, 3, 7, 8], 'reused: its visit flags moved to this session\'s flag bytes');
  // the heat grows with the same extent (the jz never ran: nothing cut; the cold block ran): the entry flagging every
  // block serves, the flag of the block the heat knows sent to the sink byte — the harvest reports the others only
  s = await run('coldOnly', { shiftFlags: 1234 });
  assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 1, 'a grown heat, the same extent: reused'); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.added, 0);
  assert.deepEqual(s.ran, [0, 3, 7], 'reused: the blocks the heat knows are not reported');
  s = await run('all', { shiftFlags: 64 });
  assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 1, 'every block known: reused, every flag to the sink');
  assert.deepEqual(s.ran, [], 'nothing reported');
  // a heat cutting the region: another extent, translated; the earlier shape of the same code superseded
  s = await run('cut');
  assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 0); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.missExtent, 1); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.superseded, 1);
  assert.equal(s.bg.cache.loaded, 1, 'one shape per code kept');
  s = await run('cut', { shiftFlags: 99 });
  assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 1); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.loaded, 1);
});

test('code cache with heat: past its bound, the cache makes room when the background worker is idle', async () => {
  const store = new MemStore(), ref = reference([0, 3, 0, 10]), head = 16 + 'test|heat'.length;
  let s = await session(store, H.none);
  const other = new MemStore(); await session(other, H.cut);
  const rl = store.size() - head, maxBytes = head + rl + (other.size() - head) - 1; // (the second record: 1 byte past it)
  // another shape of the same code: added past the bound (the earlier one superseded), the file compacted only once
  // no batch came for idleMs
  s = await session(store, H.cut, { maxBytes, idleMs: 200, refresh: false });
  assert.equal(s.s, ref.s); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.superseded, 1); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.added, 1);
  assert.ok(store.size() > maxBytes, 'past the bound until idle');
  await until(() => store.size() === other.size());
  assert.equal(store.size(), other.size(), 'compacted when idle: the superseded record gone');
  s = await session(store, H.cut, { maxBytes });
  assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 1); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.loaded, 1); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.dead, 0);
});

test('code cache with heat: an idle background worker keeps the shape the heat grown in the session gives', async () => {
  // the jz never taken (ecx large): the run teaches that the jz ran and the cold block did not — the next session's
  // heat cuts the cold block out. Refreshed when idle, the cut shape is in the cache before that session asks for it.
  const regs = [0, 100, 0, 10], ref = reference(regs);
  for (const refresh of [true, false]) {
    const store = new MemStore();
    let s = await session(store, H.none, { regs, idleMs: 1, refresh });
    assert.equal(s.s, ref.s); assert.deepEqual(s.ran, [0, 3, 7]);
    await until(() => { let st = null; handleMessage({ type: 'cache-stats' }, (rep) => { st = rep.cache; }); return !refresh || st?.refreshPasses > 0; });
    s = await session(store, H.cut, { regs, shiftFlags: 321, refresh: false });
    assert.equal(s.s, ref.s, 'like the interpreter');
    assert.equal(s.installed, 1);
    if (refresh) { assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 1, 'refreshed: the cut shape reused'); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.loaded, 1, 'the uncut shape superseded'); }
    else { assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 0); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.missExtent, 1); }
  }
});

test('code cache with heat: in-session options are neither looked up nor kept', async () => {
  const store = new MemStore(), ref = reference([0, 3, 0, 10]);
  let s = await session(store, H.cut);
  assert.equal(s.bg.cache.added, 1);
  s = await session(store, H.cut, { over: { layout: false } });
  assert.equal(s.s, ref.s);
  assert.equal(s.bg.cacheHits, 0); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.added, 0); assert.equal(s.bg.cache.misses, 0);
});

test('code cache with heat: a learned entry is skipped as covered only when the heat-cut region holds it', async () => {
  const ref = reference([0, 3, 0, 10]), learned = [[CODE, null], [COLD, null]];
  for (const store of [new MemStore(), null]) { // (with the cache, then the same from it)
    const st = store ?? new MemStore();
    for (let pass = 0; pass < (store ? 2 : 1); pass++) {
      // every block ran: the cold block is a block of the entry's region
      let s = await session(st, H.all, { learned });
      assert.equal(s.s, ref.s);
      assert.ok(s.items.find((it) => it.eip === COLD).covered, 'held by the region of CODE');
      // the cold block cut out of the entry's region: its own region, translated and installed
      s = await session(st, H.cut, { learned });
      assert.equal(s.s, ref.s);
      const it = s.items.find((x) => x.eip === COLD);
      assert.ok(!it.covered && it.k >= 0, 'not held by the cut region: translated');
      assert.equal(s.installed, 2);
    }
  }
});

test('visit flags moved to other flag bytes: the same body as a translation with those bytes', () => {
  const m = machine([0, 3, 0, 10]);
  const opts = { chain: true, smc: true, visit: true, fnIdx: 3 };
  const a = translateRegion(m.mem, CODE, { ...opts, visitSlots: new VisitSlots() });
  allocBlockCounters(m.mem, 4321); // (another thread's flags in between)
  const slotsB = new VisitSlots();
  const b = translateRegion(m.mem, CODE, { ...opts, visitSlots: slotsB });
  assert.ok(a.stats.visits.length >= 3 && a.stats.visitSites.length === 2 * a.stats.visits.length);
  assert.notDeepEqual([...a.code], [...b.code]);
  const sites = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < a.stats.visitSites.length; i += 2) sites.push([a.stats.visitSites[i + 1], slotsB.get(m.mem, a.stats.visitSites[i])]);
  assert.deepEqual([...patchVisitSlots(a.code.slice(), sites)], [...b.code]);
  assert.throws(() => patchVisitSlots(a.code.slice(), [[a.stats.visitSites[1] + 1, sites[0][1]]]), /not a visit flag store/);
});
```
