`tests/jit-code-cache.test.js`:

```js
// Translated code kept across sessions (code-cache.js, bg-translate.js): a second session reuses the first one's
// translations (moved to other table indexes) only for code whose extent, bytes and inline-API slots are the same, and
// runs exactly like the reference interpreter — randomized programs (flags across blocks, x87 under several precision
// modes, memory, self-modifying code, faults), whole and time-sliced, with two threads sharing the translations.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { translateRegion, patchAltSlot } from '../src/cpu/jit/translate.js';
import { handleMessage } from '../src/cpu/jit/bg-translate.js';
import { CodeCache, MemStore, moduleClosureText, hashText } from '../src/cpu/jit/code-cache.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000, CW = DATA + 0x100;
const tick = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
let seed = 7;
const rnd = (n) => { seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; return (seed >>> 8) % n; };

// ---- program generator: blocks of flag writers / readers, x87, memory and SMC snippets joined by forward jumps,
// looped by `dec ebp ; jnz CODE`; the first instruction (mov ebx, imm32) is the one the SMC snippet rewrites
const W = () => [[0xd3, 0xe0], [0x01, 0xd0], [0x28, 0xd0], [0x66, 0x39, 0xd0], [0x48], [0x42], [0x11, 0xd0], [0x18, 0xd0], [0xd3, 0xe8], [0x21, 0xd0], [0xf7, 0xd8], [0x0f, 0xaf, 0xc2], [0x89, 0xc1, 0x83, 0xe1, 0x1f]][rnd(13)];
const R = () => { const cc = rnd(16); return [[0x0f, 0x90 + cc, 0xc3, 0x8d, 0x34, 0x73], [0x47], [0x0f, 0x40 + cc, 0xf8], [0x13, 0xf8]][rnd(4)]; };
const X87 = () => [0xdd, 0x05, ...le(DATA + 8), 0xdc, 0x05, ...le(DATA + 16), 0xdc, 0x0d, ...le(DATA + 24), 0xdd, 0x1d, ...le(DATA + 8)]; // x = (x + a) * b
const CWSET = () => [0xd9, 0x2d, ...le(CW + 2 * rnd(3))]; // fldcw: 24, 53 or 64-bit precision
const MEM = () => [[0xa3, ...le(DATA + 32)], [0x01, 0x15, ...le(DATA + 36)]][rnd(2)];
const SMC = () => [0xa3, ...le(CODE + 1)]; // mov [CODE+1], eax: the next iteration's mov ebx, imm32
function gen({ x87 = true, mem = true, smc = true, fault = false } = {}) {
  const nb = 4 + rnd(6), blocks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
    const body = [];
    for (let k = rnd(4); k > 0; k--) {
      const r = rnd(10);
      body.push(...(r < 4 ? W() : r < 7 ? R() : r === 7 && x87 ? (rnd(3) ? X87() : CWSET()) : r === 8 && mem ? MEM() : r === 9 && smc && rnd(3) === 0 ? SMC() : W()));
    }
    blocks.push(body);
  }
  const out = [0xbb, ...le(rnd(1 << 30))], fix = [], start = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
    start[i] = out.length; out.push(...blocks[i]);
    const t = rnd(4);
    if (i < nb - 1 && t < 3) { const tgt = i + 1 + rnd(nb - i - 1); if (t === 0) out.push(0xe9); else out.push(0x0f, 0x80 + rnd(16)); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); }
  }
  start[nb] = out.length;
  out.push(0x4d, 0x0f, 0x85, ...le(-(out.length + 7)));
  out.push(...(fault ? [0x0f, 0x0b] : [0xf4])); // (ud2: an invalid opcode fault / hlt)
  for (const [at, tgt] of fix) out.splice(at, 4, ...le(start[tgt] - (at + 4)));
  return Uint8Array.from(out);
}
const V = [0, 1, 0x7f, 0x80, 0xffff, 0x7fffffff, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff, 0x12345678];
const val = () => (rnd(3) ? V[rnd(V.length)] : ((rnd(65536) << 16) | rnd(65536)) >>> 0);

function machine({ shared = false, code, regs, bg = null }) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory({ shared });
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE); cpu.reset();
  mem.fill(CODE, 0x1000, 0xcc); mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
  mem.writeF64(DATA + 8, 1.25); mem.writeF64(DATA + 16, 0.1); mem.writeF64(DATA + 24, 0.7);
  mem.write16(CW, 0x007f); mem.write16(CW + 2, 0x027f); mem.write16(CW + 4, 0x037f);
  const setRegs = (c, r) => { c.eip = CODE; c.esp = DATA + 0x800; [c.eax, c.ecx, c.edx, c.ebx, , , c.esi, c.edi] = r; c.ebp = 6; c.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF | (r[8] & 0x8d5); mem.write16(c.base + ST.FPU_CW, 0x027f); };
  setRegs(cpu, regs);
  const interp = new Interp(mem, cpu);
  let jit = null, replies = null;
  if (bg) {
    jit = new Jit(mem, interp, { smc: true, warn: (m) => { throw new Error(m); } });
    jit.cpu = cpu; replies = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < bg.skipFns; i++) jit.reserveFn(); // (another session: other table indexes)
    jit.attachBackground({ postMessage: (m) => handleMessage(m.type === 'init' ? { ...m, cache: bg.cache } : m, (r) => replies.push(r)) });
  }
  return { mem, cpu, interp, jit, replies, setRegs };
}
const state = (c, mem) => [c.eax, c.ecx, c.edx, c.ebx, c.esi, c.edi, c.ebp, c.eflags & 0x8d5, c.eip, ...[0, 4, 8, 12].map((o) => mem.read32(DATA + 32 + o) >>> 0)].map((x) => (x >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ');
// (the run stops at the final hlt — privileged: never executed — or runs into the final ud2's fault)
const end = (code) => (code[code.length - 1] === 0xf4 ? CODE + code.length - 1 : CODE + code.length + 0x100);

/** reference: the interpreter alone */
function reference(code, regs) {
  const m = machine({ code, regs });
  const r = m.interp.run({ stopAt: end(code), maxInsns: 1e6 });
  return { r, s: state(m.cpu, m.mem) };
}
/** the entries a plain JIT run translated at a miss (what the server would have learned) */
function learnedOf(code, regs) {
  const m = machine({ code, regs });
  const jit = new Jit(m.mem, m.interp, { smc: true }); jit.cpu = m.cpu; jit.learned = [];
  let r, n = 0; do r = jit.run({ stopAt: end(code), maxInsns: 1e6 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE && ++n < 1e5);
  return jit.learned.map(([eip, fpc]) => [eip, fpc]);
}
/** a session with the background translator and the cache: learned regions installed first, then a (sliced) run */
async function session(code, regs, cache, skipFns, learned, slice) {
  const m = machine({ shared: true, code, regs, bg: { cache, skipFns } });
  await tick();
  if (learned.length) { m.jit.bgPrewarm(learned); await tick(); await tick(); for (const rep of m.replies.splice(0)) if (rep.type === 'batch') m.jit.bgInstall(rep); }
  let r, k = 0;
  do r = m.jit.run({ stopAt: end(code), maxInsns: slice || 1e6 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE && ++k < 1e6);
  return { r, s: state(m.cpu, m.mem), bg: m.jit.bg, misses: m.jit.stats.misses };
}

test('code cache: a body moved to another table index differs only by its alt slot offset', () => {
  const code = Uint8Array.from([...X87(), 0x48, 0x75, 0xf0 - 19, 0xf4]);
  const m = machine({ code, regs: [1, 2, 3, 4, 0, 0, 5, 6, 0] });
  const a = translateRegion(m.mem, CODE, { chain: true, smc: true, fnIdx: 10, fpcAssume: 0x200 });
  const b = translateRegion(m.mem, CODE, { chain: true, smc: true, fnIdx: 54321, fpcAssume: 0x200 });
  assert.ok(a.altAt > 0 && a.altAt === b.altAt);
  assert.notDeepEqual(a.code, b.code);
  assert.deepEqual([...patchAltSlot(a.code.slice(), a.altAt, 54321)], [...b.code]);
  const g = translateRegion(m.mem, CODE, { chain: true, smc: true, fnIdx: 10, fpcAssume: null });
  assert.equal(g.altAt, -1); // (a generic translation: no alt slot)
});

test('code cache: randomized programs reuse an earlier session translations and match the interpreter', async () => {
  const key = 'test|translator', store = new MemStore();
  let reused = 0, programs = 0, mutatedMisses = 0;
  for (let t = 0; t < 36; t++) {
    const fault = t % 6 === 5;
    const code = gen({ fault }), regs = [val(), rnd(40), val(), 0, val(), val(), 0, 0, rnd(0x1000)];
    const ref = reference(code, regs);
    const learned = learnedOf(code, regs);
    // session 1 fills the cache, session 2 (other table indexes) reuses it; whole and time-sliced runs
    const s1 = await session(code, regs, { key, store }, 0, learned, 0);
    assert.equal(s1.r, ref.r, `program ${t}`); assert.equal(s1.s, ref.s, `program ${t} session 1: ${Buffer.from(code).toString('hex')}`);
    for (const slice of [0, 3, 17]) {
      const s2 = await session(code, regs, { key, store }, 37 + slice, learned, slice);
      assert.equal(s2.r, ref.r, `program ${t} slice ${slice}`);
      assert.equal(s2.s, ref.s, `program ${t} slice ${slice}: ${Buffer.from(code).toString('hex')}`);
      assert.equal(s2.bg.cacheHits, learned.length, 'every learned region reused');
      reused += s2.bg.cacheHits;
    }
    // the same program with another first immediate (bytes differ): the region holding it is not reused
    const mutated = code.slice(); mutated[2] ^= 0x5a;
    const refM = reference(mutated, regs), learnedM = learnedOf(mutated, regs);
    const s3 = await session(mutated, regs, { key, store }, 5, learnedM, 3);
    assert.equal(s3.r, refM.r); assert.equal(s3.s, refM.s, `program ${t} mutated`);
    if (s3.bg.cacheHits < learnedM.length) mutatedMisses++;
    programs++;
  }
  assert.ok(reused >= programs * 3, `reused ${reused}`);
  assert.equal(mutatedMisses, programs, 'the mutated entry region is translated again');
});

test('code cache: two threads run the reused translations, each like the interpreter', async () => {
  const key = 'test|threads', store = new MemStore();
  for (let t = 0; t < 12; t++) {
    const code = gen({ mem: false, smc: false, x87: false });
    const ra = [val(), rnd(40), val(), 0, val(), val(), 0, 0, rnd(0x1000)], rb = [val(), rnd(40), val(), 0, val(), val(), 0, 0, rnd(0x1000)];
    const refA = reference(code, ra), refB = reference(code, rb);
    const learned = learnedOf(code, ra);
    await session(code, ra, { key, store }, 0, learned, 0);
    const m = machine({ shared: true, code, regs: ra, bg: { cache: { key, store }, skipFns: 3 } });
    await tick();
    m.jit.bgPrewarm(learned); await tick(); await tick(); for (const rep of m.replies.splice(0)) if (rep.type === 'batch') m.jit.bgInstall(rep);
    const cpuB = new CpuState(m.mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE + 0x1000); cpuB.reset(); m.setRegs(cpuB, rb);
    const cpus = [m.cpu, cpuB], res = [null, null];
    for (let k = 0; k < 1e5 && (res[0] === null || res[1] === null); k++) {
      const i = k & 1; if (res[i] !== null) continue;
      m.jit.cpu = cpus[i]; m.interp.cpu = cpus[i];
      const r = m.jit.run({ stopAt: end(code), maxInsns: 5 });
      if (r !== EXIT.TIMESLICE) res[i] = r;
    }
    assert.equal(res[0], refA.r); assert.equal(res[1], refB.r);
    assert.equal(state(m.cpu, m.mem).split(' ').slice(0, 9).join(' '), refA.s.split(' ').slice(0, 9).join(' '), `program ${t} thread A`);
    assert.equal(state(cpuB, m.mem).split(' ').slice(0, 9).join(' '), refB.s.split(' ').slice(0, 9).join(' '), `program ${t} thread B`);
  }
});

test('code cache: entries need the same extent, bytes and inline-API slots; another key empties it; a cut tail is dropped', () => {
  const store = new MemStore();
  let c = new CodeCache(store, 'k1');
  const e = { eip: 0x1000, fpcIn: 0x200, fpcOut: 0x200, altAt: -1, blocks: [{ eip: 0x1000, end: 0x1004, index: 0 }], deps: [0x5000, 0x7f000010, 3], stats: { native: 2, fallback: 0, calls: null, counters: -1 }, hints: [3, 1], snap: Uint8Array.of(1, 2, 3, 4), code: Uint8Array.of(9, 9, 9) };
  assert.ok(c.add(e));
  c = new CodeCache(store, 'k1'); // (read back)
  assert.equal(c.stats.loaded, 1);
  const ext = [{ eip: 0x1000, end: 0x1004 }];
  const hit = c.lookup(0x1000, 0x200, ext, Uint8Array.of(1, 2, 3, 4), [0x5000, 0x7f000010, 3]);
  assert.deepEqual([...hit.code], [9, 9, 9]); assert.deepEqual(hit.hints, [3, 1]); assert.equal(hit.fpcOut, 0x200);
  assert.equal(c.lookup(0x1000, null, ext, Uint8Array.of(1, 2, 3, 4), [0x5000, 0x7f000010, 3]), null, 'another x87 mode asked');
  assert.equal(c.lookup(0x1000, 0x200, ext, Uint8Array.of(1, 2, 3, 5), [0x5000, 0x7f000010, 3]), null, 'other bytes');
  assert.equal(c.lookup(0x1000, 0x200, [{ eip: 0x1000, end: 0x1005 }], Uint8Array.of(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), [0x5000, 0x7f000010, 3]), null, 'other extent');
  assert.equal(c.lookup(0x1000, 0x200, ext, Uint8Array.of(1, 2, 3, 4), [0x5000, 0x7f000020, 3]), null, 'the slot holds another thunk');
  // a record cut short (a session ended mid-write): dropped, the file cut back
  const full = store.size();
  assert.ok(c.add({ ...e, eip: 0x2000 }));
  store.truncate(store.size() - 2);
  c = new CodeCache(store, 'k1');
  assert.equal(c.stats.loaded, 1); assert.equal(store.size(), full);
  // another translator: emptied
  c = new CodeCache(store, 'k2');
  assert.equal(c.stats.loaded, 0); assert.ok(c.stats.reset);
  assert.equal(new CodeCache(store, 'k2').stats.loaded, 0);
  // bounded
  const small = new CodeCache(new MemStore(), 'k', 400); // (bounded)
  assert.ok(small.add(e)); assert.ok(!small.add({ ...e, eip: 0x3000, code: new Uint8Array(200) }));
  // full: this session's entries are never evicted (a first session fills it and stops adding); a later session
  // evicts the entries no session used for longest and compacts the file
  const fs2 = new MemStore(), big = { ...e, code: new Uint8Array(300) }, at = (eip) => ({ ...big, eip, blocks: [{ eip, end: eip + 4, index: 0 }] });
  const ext2 = (eip) => [{ eip, end: eip + 4 }], snap = Uint8Array.of(1, 2, 3, 4), deps = [0x5000, 0x7f000010, 3];
  const probe = new CodeCache(new MemStore(), 'k'); probe.add(at(0x1000));
  const rl = probe.end - probe.headLen, head = probe.headLen; // (one record's bytes)
  for (const soft of [false, true]) {
    // (soft: the 4th record fits below 9/8 of the bound — written, the room made at the next idle moment; else at once)
    const max = head + 3 * rl + (soft ? Math.ceil(rl * 0.7) : 10), fs3 = new MemStore();
    let f = new CodeCache(fs3, 'k', max);
    assert.ok(f.add(at(0x1000)) && f.add(at(0x2000)) && f.add(at(0x3000)));
    if (soft) {
      assert.ok(f.add(at(0x5000))); assert.ok(f.end > max && f.pending, 'past the bound: room asked for an idle moment');
      assert.ok(f.maintain()); assert.equal(f.stats.compactions, 0); assert.ok(f.full, 'first session: its own entries fill it');
      assert.ok(!f.add(at(0x6000)));
    }
    else assert.ok(!f.add(at(0x4000)), 'first session: its own entries fill it');
    f = new CodeCache(fs3, 'k', max); // (session 2: reuses 0x3000)
    assert.equal(f.stats.loaded, soft ? 4 : 3);
    assert.ok(f.lookup(0x3000, 0x200, ext2(0x3000), snap, deps));
    if (soft) assert.ok(f.lookup(0x5000, 0x200, ext2(0x5000), snap, deps));
    // (session 3: reuses 0x2000, adds 0x4000: down to 3/4 of the bound, the least recently used first — 0x1000
    // (session 1), then 0x3000 / 0x5000 (session 2) — evicted, 0x2000 (this session's) kept)
    f = new CodeCache(fs3, 'k', max);
    assert.ok(f.lookup(0x2000, 0x200, ext2(0x2000), snap, deps));
    assert.ok(f.add(at(0x4000)));
    assert.equal(f.stats.evicted, soft ? 3 : 2); assert.equal(f.stats.compactions, 1);
    for (const a of [0x1000, 0x3000, 0x5000]) assert.equal(f.lookup(a, 0x200, ext2(a), snap, deps), null, `evicted ${a.toString(16)}`);
    for (const a of [0x2000, 0x4000]) assert.ok(f.lookup(a, 0x200, ext2(a), snap, deps), `kept ${a.toString(16)}`);
    assert.ok(fs3.size() === f.end && f.end < head + 3 * rl && f.end === f.headLen + f.live && f.stats.dead === 0, 'compacted');
    f = new CodeCache(fs3, 'k', max); // (read back after the compaction)
    assert.equal(f.stats.loaded, 2); assert.equal(f.stats.dead, 0);
    for (const a of [0x2000, 0x4000]) assert.deepEqual([...f.lookup(a, 0x200, ext2(a), snap, deps).code], [...big.code]);
  }
});

test('code cache: one shape per code (superseded entries), variants for other code, LRU eviction, compaction, interrupted compaction', () => {
  // random sessions over a small file: what a lookup returns is always what was added for exactly that entry, extent,
  // bytes and deps; entries of the same code under another shape are superseded; the file never passes its bound
  let rs = 12345;
  const r = (n) => { rs = (Math.imul(rs, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0; return (rs >>> 8) % n; };
  const u8 = new Uint8Array(0x10000);
  const store = new MemStore(), MAX = 24000;
  const model = new Map(); // "eip:fpc|extent|bytes" -> body (what was added last for it)
  let hits = 0, superseded = 0, evicted = 0, compactions = 0, variants = 0;
  for (let session = 0; session < 60; session++) {
    const c = new CodeCache(store, 'k', MAX);
    assert.ok(store.size() <= MAX + MAX / 8);
    for (let n = 0; n < 40; n++) {
      // (a region's shape: one of three per address, the heat of the moment)
      const eip = 0x100 * (1 + r(24)), fpc = r(4) ? null : 0x200, shape = r(3), nb = 1 + ((eip >> 8) + shape) % 3, ext = [];
      for (let b = 0, a = eip; b < nb; b++) { const end = a + 1 + ((a + shape) % 6); ext.push({ eip: a, end }); a = end + ((a + b) % 3); }
      // the code there: one of two programs at that address (variants), its bytes in memory now
      const prog = r(5) === 0 ? 1 : 0;
      const snap = [];
      for (const b of ext) for (let a = b.eip; a < b.end; a++) { u8[a] = (a * 7 + prog * 13) & 0xff; snap.push(u8[a]); }
      const key = `${eip}:${fpc}|${ext.map((b) => `${b.eip}-${b.end}`).join(',')}|${prog}`;
      const hit = c.lookup(eip, fpc, ext, Uint8Array.from(snap), [], null, u8);
      if (hit) {
        hits++;
        assert.ok(model.has(key), 'a hit is for an entry added for exactly this');
        assert.deepEqual([...hit.code], model.get(key));
        continue;
      }
      const code = Array.from({ length: 50 + r(400) }, () => r(256));
      const before = c.stats.superseded;
      if (c.add({ eip, fpcIn: fpc, blocks: ext.map((b, i) => ({ ...b, index: i })), deps: [], stats: {}, snap: Uint8Array.from(snap), code: Uint8Array.from(code) })) model.set(key, code);
      if (c.stats.superseded > before) superseded++;
      assert.ok(c.end <= MAX + MAX / 8 && store.size() === c.end);
      let perKey = 0; for (const [k, l] of c.map) { assert.ok(l.length <= 4, `variants of ${k}`); if (l.length > 1) perKey++; }
      variants = Math.max(variants, perKey);
      if (r(8) === 0) { c.maintain(); assert.ok(c.full || c.end <= MAX, 'room made at an idle moment'); }
    }
    evicted += c.stats.evicted; compactions += c.stats.compactions;
    c.flush();
  }
  assert.ok(hits > 100 && superseded > 50 && evicted > 20 && compactions > 3 && variants > 0, `hits ${hits} superseded ${superseded} evicted ${evicted} compactions ${compactions} variants ${variants}`);
  // a compaction cut short (state left in the header): the next load starts over
  const c = new CodeCache(store, 'k', MAX);
  assert.ok(c.stats.loaded > 0);
  c.writeHead(1);
  const d = new CodeCache(store, 'k', MAX);
  assert.equal(d.stats.loaded, 0); assert.match(d.stats.reset, /interrupted/);
});

test('code cache: the key covers the import closure of the translator modules', async () => {
  const files = { 'http://x/src/a.js': "import { b } from './b.js';\nimport './c/d.js';\nexport const a = 1;", 'http://x/src/b.js': "export { e } from '../src/e.js'; // import './nope.js'", 'http://x/src/c/d.js': 'x', 'http://x/src/e.js': 'e' };
  const got = [];
  const parts = await moduleClosureText(['http://x/src/a.js'], async (u) => { got.push(u); if (!(u in files)) throw new Error('missing ' + u); return files[u]; });
  // (a specifier seen in a comment is fetched too: one that does not exist counts as missing, the key stays defined)
  assert.deepEqual(got.sort(), [...Object.keys(files), 'http://x/src/nope.js'].sort());
  const k1 = hashText(parts);
  assert.equal(hashText(await moduleClosureText(['http://x/src/a.js'], async (u) => { if (!(u in files)) throw new Error('missing'); return files[u]; })), k1);
  files['http://x/src/e.js'] = 'e2';
  assert.notEqual(hashText(await moduleClosureText(['http://x/src/a.js'], async (u) => { if (!(u in files)) throw new Error('missing'); return files[u]; })), k1);
});

```

`tests/jit-cold-exits.test.js`:

```js
// Regions shaped by block heat (translate.js opts.coldExits with a heat map, Jit.collectHeat): a branch successor the
// counted run never executed is left out of the region and becomes an exit. Random programs (blocks joined by
// conditional branches, jumps and calls, EDI counting down to a bounded end) are first run with block counters on
// some inputs, the heat collected, then run on other inputs — which take edges the counted run never took — with the
// cold exits: the same registers, flags, stack and data as the interpreter, whole and time-sliced (a slice may end
// at a cold exit instead of the next backward transfer: the dispatcher checks the budget at every region entry, as
// for any region boundary). Also with a
// heat map naming random instructions (any heat is exact: only the regions' extent changes) and under self-modifying code.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { decode } from '../src/cpu/decoder.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const ARITH = F.CF | F.PF | F.AF | F.ZF | F.SF | F.OF;
let seed = 777;
const rnd = (n) => { seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0; return (seed >>> 8) % n; };
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
const R3 = () => [0, 1, 2, 3][rnd(4)]; // eax ecx edx ebx
const alu = () => [[0x01, 0xc0 | (R3() << 3) | R3()], [0x83, 0xc0 | (rnd(8) << 3) | R3(), rnd(256)], [0x8d, 0x40 | (R3() << 3) | R3(), rnd(128)], [0xd1, 0xe0 | (rnd(2) ? 8 : 0) | R3()],
  [0x89, 0x46 | (R3() << 3), 4 * rnd(16)]][rnd(5)]; // (... mov [esi+d8], r: stores into the data)

/** blocks `dec edi ; jz end ; <alu>* ; <terminator>` (Jcc / JMP to a random block, CALL of a leaf function, fallthrough) */
function gen() {
  const nb = 4 + rnd(10), nf = 1 + rnd(3);
  const kinds = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) kinds.push('b');
  for (let i = 0; i < nf; i++) kinds.splice(rnd(kinds.length + 1), 0, 'f');
  kinds.unshift('b');
  const fns = kinds.map((k, i) => (k === 'f' ? i : -1)).filter((i) => i >= 0), blocksIdx = kinds.map((k, i) => (k === 'b' ? i : -1)).filter((i) => i >= 0);
  const out = [], start = [], fix = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < kinds.length; i++) {
    start[i] = out.length;
    if (kinds[i] === 'f') { for (let k = rnd(3); k >= 0; k--) out.push(...alu()); out.push(0xc3); continue; }
    out.push(0x4f, 0x0f, 0x84); fix.push([out.length, -1]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0);
    for (let k = rnd(3); k > 0; k--) out.push(...alu());
    const tgt = blocksIdx[rnd(blocksIdx.length)];
    switch (rnd(4)) {
      case 0: out.push(0x0f, 0x80 + rnd(16)); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); break;
      case 1: out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); break;
      case 2: out.push(0xe8); fix.push([out.length, fns[rnd(fns.length)]]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0);
        if (i + 1 < kinds.length && kinds[i + 1] === 'f') { out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, blocksIdx[rnd(blocksIdx.length)]]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); }
        break;
      default: if (i + 1 < kinds.length && kinds[i + 1] === 'f') { out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); } break;
    }
  }
  if (kinds[kinds.length - 1] === 'f') { out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, 0]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); }
  const end = out.length; out.push(0xf4);
  for (const [at, t] of fix) out.splice(at, 4, ...le((t < 0 ? end : start[t]) - (at + 4)));
  return { code: Uint8Array.from(out), end };
}

/** run from CODE to the end (interpreter when `jit` is null), time slices of `slice` instructions */
function run(mem, cpu, jit, end, input, slice) {
  cpu.reset(); mem.fill(DATA, 0x1000, 0);
  [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx] = input.regs; cpu.edi = input.edi; cpu.esi = DATA + 0x100; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; cpu.eip = CODE;
  cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF | (input.regs[4] & ARITH);
  const slices = [];
  let r;
  for (;;) {
    if (jit) { jit.cpu = cpu; r = jit.run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: slice }); } else r = new Interp(mem, cpu).run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: 1e7 });
    if (r !== EXIT.TIMESLICE) break;
    slices.push(`${(cpu.eip >>> 0).toString(16)}/${jit.remaining()}`);
    if (slices.length > 1e5) throw new Error('runaway');
  }
  if (jit) CpuState.foldLazyFlags?.(cpu);
  const state = [r, cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx, cpu.esp, cpu.edi, cpu.eflags & ARITH, cpu.eip].map((v) => (v >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ') + ' ' + [...mem.bytes(DATA + 0x100, 0x40), ...mem.bytes(DATA + 0x700, 0x100)].join(',');
  return { state, slices: slices.join(' ') };
}
const V = [0, 1, 0x7f, 0x80, 0xffff, 0x7fffffff, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff, 0x12345678];
const val = () => (rnd(2) ? V[rnd(V.length)] : ((rnd(65536) << 16) | rnd(65536)) >>> 0);
const input = (edi) => ({ regs: [val(), val(), val(), val(), rnd(0x1000)], edi });
function setup(code) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory(), cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  mem.fill(CODE, 0x1000, 0xcc); mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
  return { mem, cpu };
}

test('cold exits from a counted or visited run: random programs on other inputs match the interpreter, whole and time-sliced', () => {
  let left = 0;
  for (let t = 0; t < 60; t++) {
    const { code, end } = gen();
    // counted run: short (few edges taken), then the heat of its translations — block counters (collectHeat) or, every
    // other program, visit flags (harvestVisits: the ranges a session sends to the server)
    const { mem, cpu } = setup(code);
    const visits = t % 2 === 1;
    const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), visits ? { smc: true, visit: true } : { smc: true, blockCounts: true });
    for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) run(mem, cpu, jit, end, input(20 + rnd(20)), 1e7);
    if (visits) jit.harvestVisits(); else jit.collectHeat();
    const heat = jit.heat;
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      const inp = input(100 + rnd(400));
      // (the reference: the interpreter on a fresh memory)
      const ref = setup(code); const exp = run(ref.mem, ref.cpu, null, end, inp, 0);
      for (const slice of [1e7, 1, 5]) {
        const a = setup(code), b = setup(code);
        const ja = new Jit(a.mem, new Interp(a.mem, a.cpu), { smc: true });
        const jb = new Jit(b.mem, new Interp(b.mem, b.cpu), { smc: true, coldExits: true, coldMin: 2 }); jb.heat = heat;
        const off = run(a.mem, a.cpu, ja, end, inp, slice), on = run(b.mem, b.cpu, jb, end, inp, slice);
        const msg = `program ${t} input ${k} slice ${slice}: ${Buffer.from(code).toString('hex')}`;
        assert.equal(on.state, exp.state, msg);
        assert.equal(off.state, exp.state, msg);
        if (slice === 1e7) left += jb.regions.length > ja.regions.length;
      }
    }
  }
  assert.ok(left > 10, `programs whose cold edges were taken later (more regions): ${left}`);
});

test('cold exits under an arbitrary heat map and self-modifying code match the interpreter', () => {
  let smc = 0;
  for (let t = 0; t < 120; t++) {
    const g = gen(), body = [...g.code], imms = [];
    const scratch = new GuestMemory(); scratch.writeBytes(CODE, g.code);
    const addrs = [];
    for (let a = 0; a < g.end;) { const insn = decode(scratch, CODE + a); addrs.push(CODE + 5 + a); if (body[a] === 0x83 && (body[a + 1] & 0xc0) === 0xc0) imms.push(a + 2); a = insn.next - CODE; }
    if (!imms.length) continue;
    const at = 5 + imms[rnd(imms.length)];
    // call patch ; <body ... hlt> ; patch: mov [CODE+at], al ; inc al ; ret
    const code = Uint8Array.from([0xe8, ...le(body.length), ...body, 0xa2, ...le(CODE + at), 0xfe, 0xc0, 0xc3]), end = 5 + g.end;
    // a random heat map: each instruction executed (many times) or never
    const heat = new Map([[CODE, 1000]]);
    for (const a of addrs) if (rnd(3)) heat.set(a, rnd(2) ? 1000 : 1 + rnd(100));
    const inp = input(100 + rnd(300));
    // (the interpreter decoding afresh: the program patches itself)
    const want = (() => {
      const { mem, cpu } = setup(code); cpu.reset(); mem.fill(DATA, 0x1000, 0);
      [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx] = inp.regs; cpu.edi = inp.edi; cpu.esi = DATA + 0x100; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF | (inp.regs[4] & ARITH);
      const I = new Interp(mem, cpu); I.cache = new (class extends Map { set() { return this; } })();
      const r = I.run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: 1e7 });
      return [r, cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx, cpu.esp, cpu.edi, cpu.eflags & ARITH, cpu.eip].map((v) => (v >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ') + ' ' + Buffer.from(mem.bytes(CODE, code.length)).toString('hex');
    })();
    for (const slice of [1e7, 3]) {
      const { mem, cpu } = setup(code); mem.fill(DATA, 0x1000, 0);
      const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true, coldExits: true, coldMin: 2 }); jit.heat = heat; jit.cpu = cpu;
      [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx] = inp.regs; cpu.edi = inp.edi; cpu.esi = DATA + 0x100; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF | (inp.regs[4] & ARITH);
      let r;
      for (let n = 0; ; n++) {
        if (n > 1e6) throw new Error('runaway');
        r = jit.run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: slice });
        if (r === EXIT.SMC) { const len = mem.read32(cpu.base + ST.EXIT_LEN) || 16; mem.write32(cpu.base + ST.EXIT_LEN, 0); jit.invalidate(cpu.exitArg, len); smc++; continue; }
        if (r !== EXIT.TIMESLICE) break;
      }
      CpuState.foldLazyFlags?.(cpu);
      const got = [r, cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx, cpu.esp, cpu.edi, cpu.eflags & ARITH, cpu.eip].map((v) => (v >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ') + ' ' + Buffer.from(mem.bytes(CODE, code.length)).toString('hex');
      assert.equal(got, want, `program ${t} slice ${slice}: ${Buffer.from(code).toString('hex')}`);
    }
  }
  assert.ok(smc > 50, `SMC exits: ${smc}`);
});

test('visit flags: the harvested ranges are the translated blocks that ran, each reported once', () => {
  for (let t = 0; t < 80; t++) {
    const { code, end } = gen();
    const inp = input(30 + rnd(200));
    // the instructions the interpreter executes
    const ran = new Set([CODE + end]); // (the stop address's block counts as entered: its flag is set before the stop check)
    { const { mem, cpu } = setup(code); cpu.reset(); mem.fill(DATA, 0x1000, 0); [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx] = inp.regs; cpu.edi = inp.edi; cpu.esi = DATA + 0x100; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; cpu.eip = CODE;
      cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF | (inp.regs[4] & ARITH);
      const I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
      for (let n = 0; n < 1e6 && (cpu.eip >>> 0) !== CODE + end; n++) { ran.add(cpu.eip >>> 0); if (I.run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: 1 }) !== EXIT.TIMESLICE) break; } }
    const { mem, cpu } = setup(code);
    const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true, visit: true });
    const half = run(mem, cpu, jit, end, inp, 1e7);
    void half;
    // (odd programs: the pass cut into steps of budget 0 — a time check every 64 regions)
    let pairs; if (t & 1) { while (!(pairs = jit.harvestVisitsStep(0))); } else pairs = jit.harvestVisits();
    assert.equal(jit.harvestVisits().length, 0, 'reported once');
    const covered = new Set();
    for (let i = 0; i < pairs.length; i += 2) {
      for (let a = pairs[i]; a < pairs[i + 1];) { assert.ok(ran.has(a), `program ${t}: ${a.toString(16)} reported, never executed`); covered.add(a); a = decode(mem, a).next; }
    }
    for (const a of ran) if (a !== CODE + end && a >= CODE && a < CODE + code.length) assert.ok(covered.has(a) || jit.heat.has(a), `program ${t}: ${a.toString(16)} executed, not in the heat`);
  }
});

import { RangeHeat, LearnedHeat, VISITED } from '../src/cpu/jit/heat.js';
test('RangeHeat merges ranges; LearnedHeat applies module ranges once per module', () => {
  const h = new RangeHeat();
  h.add(100, 110); h.add(105, 120); h.add(200, 201); h.add(120, 130);
  assert.equal(h.get(99), 0); assert.equal(h.get(100), VISITED); assert.equal(h.get(129), VISITED); assert.equal(h.get(130), 0); assert.equal(h.get(200), VISITED); assert.equal(h.get(201), 0);
  assert.deepEqual([...h.pairs()], [100, 130, 200, 201]);
  const L = new LearnedHeat({ 'a.dll': [0x10, 4, 0x2000, 8], 'b.exe': [0x1000, 0x10] });
  assert.deepEqual(L.apply([{ name: 'A.DLL', base: 0x400000, size: 0x1000 }]), [0x400010, 0x400014]); // (the range beyond the image dropped)
  assert.equal(L.apply([{ name: 'a.dll', base: 0x400000, size: 0x1000 }]), null);
  assert.deepEqual(L.apply([{ name: 'a.dll', base: 0x400000, size: 0x1000 }, { name: 'b.exe', base: 0x800000, size: 0x2000 }]), [0x801000, 0x801010]);
});

// The x87-mode versions of a region repeat its blocks under the same numbers (a version's guard passes the block index
// it was entered with to the next one): a version translated after the heat grew keeps the first version's extent
// (discoverRegion opts.onlyBlocks) instead of falling back to the mode tested at run time.
test('x87-mode versions keep the first version\'s blocks when the heat grows meanwhile', () => {
  // E: fldz ; fld1 ; faddp ; test eax, eax ; jz L1 ; fld1 ; faddp ; L1: fld1 ; faddp ; fstp dword [esi] ; hlt
  const code = [0xd9, 0xee, 0xd9, 0xe8, 0xde, 0xc1, 0x85, 0xc0, 0x74, 0x04, 0xd9, 0xe8, 0xde, 0xc1, 0xd9, 0xe8, 0xde, 0xc1, 0xd9, 0x1e, 0xf4];
  const cold = CODE + 10, L1 = CODE + 14, stop = CODE + code.length - 1;
  const mem = new GuestMemory(), cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset(); mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code));
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true });
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  const heat = new RangeHeat(); heat.add(CODE, cold); heat.add(L1, stop + 1); // (the fallthrough of the jz never ran)
  jit.heat = heat;
  const go = (cw, eax) => {
    mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, cw); cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.eax = eax; cpu.esi = DATA; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; mem.write32(DATA, 0);
    let r; do r = jit.run({ stopAt: stop, maxInsns: 1e6 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
    assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT);
    return mem.readF32(DATA);
  };
  assert.equal(go(0x027f, 0), 2);
  const first = jit.regionAt(CODE);
  assert.ok(!first.blocks.some((b) => b.eip === cold), 'the cold block left out');
  heat.add(cold, L1); // (it runs now)
  assert.equal(go(0x027f, 1), 3);
  assert.equal(go(0x007f, 1), 3); // (another mode: a version of the region)
  assert.equal(go(0x0c7f, 0), 2);
  assert.ok((jit.stats.fpuVersions ?? 0) >= 2, `versions chained: ${jit.stats.fpuVersions}`);
  for (const v of first.versions) assert.deepEqual(v.blocks.map((b) => [b.eip, b.index]), first.blocks.map((b) => [b.eip, b.index]));
});

// Threads: three guest threads run one program (each its own registers, stack and data) alternated every few
// instructions under cold exits from a random heat; each ends as the interpreter does on its own inputs.
test('cold exits with threads alternated every few instructions: each thread matches the interpreter', () => {
  for (let t = 0; t < 60; t++) {
    const { code, end } = gen();
    const scratch = new GuestMemory(); scratch.writeBytes(CODE, code);
    const heat = new Map([[CODE, 1000]]);
    for (let a = 0; a < end;) { if (rnd(3)) heat.set(CODE + a, 1000); a = decode(scratch, CODE + a).next - CODE; }
    const inputs = [0, 1, 2].map(() => input(50 + rnd(300)));
    const init = (cpu, inp, k) => {
      cpu.reset(); [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx] = inp.regs; cpu.edi = inp.edi; cpu.esi = DATA + 0x100 + 0x1000 * k; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800 + 0x1000 * k; cpu.eip = CODE;
      cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF | (inp.regs[4] & ARITH);
    };
    const stateOf = (r, cpu, mem, k) => [r, cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx, cpu.esp, cpu.edi, cpu.eflags & ARITH, cpu.eip].map((v) => (v >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ') + ' ' + [...mem.bytes(DATA + 0x100 + 0x1000 * k, 0x40), ...mem.bytes(DATA + 0x700 + 0x1000 * k, 0x100)].join(',');
    const want = inputs.map((inp, k) => {
      const { mem, cpu } = setup(code); mem.fill(DATA, 0x4000, 0); init(cpu, inp, k);
      const r = new Interp(mem, cpu).run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: 1e7 });
      return stateOf(r, cpu, mem, k);
    });
    for (const slice of [2, 7]) {
      const mem = new GuestMemory(); mem.fill(CODE, 0x1000, 0xcc); mem.writeBytes(CODE, code); mem.fill(DATA, 0x4000, 0);
      const cpus = inputs.map((inp, k) => { const c = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE + k * 0x1000); init(c, inp, k); return c; });
      const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpus[0]), { smc: true, coldExits: true, coldMin: 2 }); jit.heat = heat;
      const res = [null, null, null];
      for (let turn = 0; res.some((x) => x === null); turn++) {
        if (turn > 1e6) throw new Error('runaway');
        const k = turn % 3; if (res[k] !== null) continue;
        jit.cpu = cpus[k];
        const r = jit.run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: slice });
        if (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE) continue;
        CpuState.foldLazyFlags?.(cpus[k]);
        res[k] = stateOf(r, cpus[k], mem, k);
      }
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) assert.equal(res[k], want[k], `program ${t} thread ${k} slice ${slice}: ${Buffer.from(code).toString('hex')}`);
    }
  }
});

import { VisitSlots, translateRegion } from '../src/cpu/jit/translate.js';
import { BLOCK_COUNTS_BASE } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
test('visit flags: one byte per block address, shared by the regions holding the block', () => {
  // A: inc eax ; jmp C — B: inc ecx ; jmp C — C: dec edi ; jnz A ; hlt (C in the regions of A and of B)
  const code = [0x40, 0xeb, 0x02, 0x41, 0x90, 0x4f, 0x75, 0xf8, 0xf4];
  const mem = new GuestMemory(); mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code));
  const slots = new VisitSlots();
  const ra = translateRegion(mem, CODE, { visit: true, visitSlots: slots }), rb = translateRegion(mem, CODE + 3, { visit: true, visitSlots: slots });
  const flagOf = (r, eip) => r.stats.visits.find((v) => v[0] === eip)?.[2];
  assert.ok(flagOf(ra, CODE + 5) >= BLOCK_COUNTS_BASE);
  assert.equal(flagOf(ra, CODE + 5), flagOf(rb, CODE + 5), 'block C: the same byte in both regions');
  assert.notEqual(flagOf(ra, CODE), flagOf(rb, CODE + 3));
  assert.equal(new Set([...ra.stats.visits, ...rb.stats.visits].map((v) => v[2])).size, slots.map.size, 'one byte per distinct block');
});
```

`tests/jit-cold-tier.test.js`:

```js
// The JIT's cold tier (Jit.runCold): with a background translator, a missed entry is asked of it and its code
// interpreted meanwhile, up to a number of instructions per entry (then translated on the spot). Same results as
// translated code; an instruction writing a page holding translated code is translated (its store then leaves with
// an SMC exit and the stale translation is dropped); code rewritten where nothing is translated is decoded again;
// faults are precise; the entries reach the background worker and its regions are installed.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { handleMessage } from '../src/cpu/jit/bg-translate.js';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { Vfs, MemBackend } from '../src/vfs/vfs.js';
import { VirtualClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';

const hex = (s) => Uint8Array.from(s.replace(/\s+/g, '').match(/../g).map((h) => parseInt(h, 16)));
const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000, OUT = 0x10001000, CW = 0x10002000;
// the x87 loop of jit-prewarm.test.js (mode switches, a local call, a conditional branch), 20 iterations
const X87_LOOP = hex('b914000000d906d84e04d99f00020000f7c1010000007404d92beb03d96b02d94608d8760cdd1ccfe8040000004975d5f4d97b08d96b04d94610db9c8f00010000d96b08c3');

function setup(code, { cold = true, bg = true, interpCpu = undefined } = {}) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory({ shared: true });
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
  [1.1, 3.3, 1.0, 3.0, 2.7].forEach((v, i) => mem.writeF32(DATA + 4 * i, v));
  mem.write16(CW, 0x027f); mem.write16(CW + 2, 0x007f); mem.write16(CW + 4, 0x0c7f);
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x8000; cpu.esi = DATA; cpu.edi = OUT; cpu.ebx = CW; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, 0x007f);
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, interpCpu === undefined ? cpu : interpCpu), { smc: true, coldTier: cold, warn: (m) => { throw new Error(m); } });
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  const replies = [];
  if (bg) jit.attachBackground({ postMessage: (m) => handleMessage(m, (r) => replies.push(r)) });
  return { mem, cpu, jit, replies };
}
/** run to the end as the VM does: time slices go on, SMC exits invalidate the range written */
function runAll({ jit, mem, cpu }) {
  for (let n = 0; n < 1e5; n++) {
    const r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e5 });
    if (r === EXIT.SMC) {
      const len = mem.read32(cpu.base + ST.EXIT_LEN) || 16; mem.write32(cpu.base + ST.EXIT_LEN, 0);
      jit.interp.invalidate(cpu.exitArg, len); jit.invalidate(cpu.exitArg, len);
      continue;
    }
    if (r !== EXIT.TIMESLICE) return r;
  }
  throw new Error('no end');
}
const regs = (cpu) => [cpu.eax, cpu.ebx, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.esi, cpu.edi, cpu.esp, cpu.ebp, cpu.eip].map((v) => v >>> 0);

test('x87 code run by the cold tier gives the translated code\'s results; its entries go to the background worker', () => {
  const a = setup(X87_LOOP, { cold: false });
  assert.equal(runAll(a), EXIT.HALT);
  const b = setup(X87_LOOP);
  assert.equal(runAll(b), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.deepEqual(regs(b.cpu), regs(a.cpu));
  assert.equal(Buffer.from(b.mem.bytes(OUT, 0x300)).toString('hex'), Buffer.from(a.mem.bytes(OUT, 0x300)).toString('hex'));
  assert.equal(b.mem.read16(b.cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW), a.mem.read16(a.cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW));
  assert.ok(b.jit.stats.coldEntries >= 1 && b.jit.stats.coldSteps > 100, JSON.stringify(b.jit.stats));
  assert.equal(b.jit.stats.misses, 1, 'nothing translated on this thread but the final HLT (never interpreted)');
  const sent = b.jit.flushCold();
  assert.equal(sent, b.jit.stats.coldEntries);
  for (const r of b.replies) b.jit.bgInstall(r);
  assert.equal(b.jit.bg.installed, sent);
  // a second run of the same code: the installed regions, no interpretation
  const steps = b.jit.stats.coldSteps;
  b.cpu.eip = CODE; b.cpu.esp = DATA + 0x8000; b.cpu.esi = DATA; b.cpu.edi = OUT; b.cpu.ebx = CW;
  assert.equal(runAll(b), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(b.jit.stats.coldSteps, steps);
  assert.equal(b.jit.stats.misses, 1);
});

test('a hot loop is translated on the spot once its entry has run COLD_LIMIT instructions', () => {
  // mov ecx, 100000; L: add eax, ecx; dec ecx; jnz L; hlt
  const s = setup(hex('b9a0860100 01c8 49 75fb f4'));
  assert.equal(runAll(s), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(s.cpu.eax >>> 0, (100000 * 100001 / 2) >>> 0);
  assert.ok(s.jit.stats.coldHot >= 1 && s.jit.stats.misses >= 1, JSON.stringify(s.jit.stats));
  assert.ok(s.jit.stats.coldSteps < 5000, 'interpreted a bounded number of instructions');
});

test('a store into a page holding translated code is not interpreted: the translation is dropped (SMC)', () => {
  const FN = CODE + 0x3000;
  // main: nop; mov byte [FN+1], 2; call FN; hlt     FN: mov eax, 1; ret
  const code = new Uint8Array(0x3006);
  code.set(hex('90 c605' + [FN + 1].map((v) => [0, 8, 16, 24].map((k) => ((v >>> k) & 255).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')).join('') + '02'), 0);
  const call = CODE + 8, rel = (FN - (call + 5)) >>> 0;
  code.set([0xe8, rel & 255, (rel >>> 8) & 255, (rel >>> 16) & 255, rel >>> 24, 0xf4], 8);
  code.set(hex('b801000000c3'), 0x3000);
  const s = setup(code);
  s.jit.translate(FN, null, null); // (FN translated: its page is flagged)
  s.cpu.esp = DATA + 0x8000;
  assert.equal(runAll(s), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(s.cpu.eax >>> 0, 2, 'the rewritten FN ran');
});

test('code rewritten where nothing is translated is decoded again by the cold tier', () => {
  const s = setup(hex('b805000000 f4')); // mov eax, 5; hlt
  assert.equal(runAll(s), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(s.cpu.eax, 5);
  assert.equal(s.jit.stats.misses, 1, 'the HLT only');
  s.mem.write32(CODE + 1, 7); // (no SMC exit: the page holds no translation)
  s.cpu.eip = CODE;
  assert.equal(runAll(s), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(s.cpu.eax, 7);
});

test('a fault in interpreted code is precise (EIP at the instruction)', () => {
  const s = setup(hex('90 31c9 f7f1 f4')); // nop; xor ecx, ecx; div ecx; hlt
  assert.equal(runAll(s), EXIT.FAULT);
  assert.equal(s.cpu.exitArg, 0, '#DE');
  assert.equal(s.cpu.eip >>> 0, CODE + 3);
  assert.equal(s.jit.stats.misses, 0, 'interpreted');
});

test('without a background translator the cold tier is not used', () => {
  const s = setup(X87_LOOP, { bg: false });
  assert.equal(runAll(s), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.ok(!s.jit.stats.coldEntries);
  assert.ok(s.jit.stats.misses >= 1);
});

// ---- whole programs: the test PEs give the same output with the cold tier (regions installed between slices)
const PE_DIR = new URL('../build/pe/', import.meta.url).pathname;
function bootPe(exe, cold) {
  const vfs = new Vfs(), dir = new MemBackend(); vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend()); vfs.mount('C:\\Test', dir);
  dir.open(exe, { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(PE_DIR + exe));
  const clock = new VirtualClock(), host = new HeadlessHost({ clock, width: 800, height: 600 });
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host, jit: true, sharedMemory: true, logKinds: ['warn', 'crash'], nullPage: exe === 'seh.exe' ? true : undefined }); // (seh.exe: its null-page cases read)
  if (cold) {
    const replies = [];
    vm.jit.attachBackground({ postMessage: (m) => handleMessage(m, (r) => replies.push(r)) });
    vm.jit.coldTier = true;
    const sliceEnd = vm.sliceEnd.bind(vm);
    vm.sliceEnd = (t, o) => { vm.jit.flushCold(); for (const r of replies.splice(0)) vm.jit.bgInstall(r); return sliceEnd(t, o); };
  }
  vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\' + exe });
  return vm;
}
for (const exe of ['hello.exe', 'seh.exe', 'threads.exe', 'sync.exe', 'bench.exe', 'dx9state.exe']) {
  test(`${exe}: the same output with the cold tier`, { skip: !fs.existsSync(PE_DIR + exe) && `build/pe/${exe} missing (make pe-tests)` }, () => {
    const a = bootPe(exe, false), codeA = a.run();
    const b = bootPe(exe, true), codeB = b.run();
    assert.equal(codeB, codeA);
    assert.equal(b.stdout.join(''), a.stdout.join(''));
    assert.ok(b.jit.stats.coldEntries > 0, 'code interpreted by the cold tier');
    assert.ok(b.jit.stats.misses < a.jit.stats.misses, `fewer translations on the game thread: ${b.jit.stats.misses} vs ${a.jit.stats.misses} (${b.jit.bg.installed} from the background)`);
  });
}

// stores the cold tier must leave to translation: a dword straddling into the next page, which holds translated code,
// and a push whose stack slot is in a page holding translated code
test('a store straddling into a page holding translated code, and a push onto one, are not interpreted', () => {
  const FN = CODE + 0x3000;
  // main: nop; mov dword [FN-2], 0x02b80000 (bytes 00 00 | b8 02: FN's first two bytes, FN becomes mov eax, 2);
  // call FN; hlt     FN: mov eax, 1; ret
  const code = new Uint8Array(0x3006);
  const a = FN - 2;
  code.set([0x90, 0xc7, 0x05, a & 255, (a >>> 8) & 255, (a >>> 16) & 255, a >>> 24, 0x00, 0x00, 0xb8, 0x02], 0);
  const call = CODE + 11, rel = (FN - (call + 5)) >>> 0;
  code.set([0xe8, rel & 255, (rel >>> 8) & 255, (rel >>> 16) & 255, rel >>> 24, 0xf4], 11);
  code.set(hex('b801000000c3'), 0x3000);
  const s = setup(code);
  s.jit.translate(FN, null, null);
  assert.equal(runAll(s), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(s.cpu.eax >>> 0, 2, 'the rewritten FN ran');

  // a push whose slot is in a page holding translated code (ESP just past FN's first dword) is left to translation (the
  // cold tier's gate; translated code does not catch such a push as SMC either: stack stores are not checked)
  const t = setup(hex('68b8020000 f4'));
  t.jit.translate(FN, null, null);
  t.cpu.esp = FN + 4;
  assert.equal(t.jit.coldSafe(CODE), null);
  t.cpu.esp = FN - 0x100; // (the slot in the page before: interpreted)
  assert.notEqual(t.jit.coldSafe(CODE), null);
});

test('a new entry is checked with the running thread\'s registers, whatever thread the interpreter ran last', () => {
  // (a machine restored from a snapshot: its interpreter has run no thread yet — the check read null registers)
  // (entered at its second instruction, fld dword [esi]: an entry with a memory operand)
  const enter = (x) => { x.cpu.eip = CODE + 5; x.cpu.ecx = 20; return x; };
  const a = enter(setup(X87_LOOP, { cold: false }));
  assert.equal(runAll(a), EXIT.HALT);
  const b = enter(setup(X87_LOOP, { interpCpu: null }));
  assert.equal(runAll(b), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.deepEqual(regs(b.cpu), regs(a.cpu));
});

```

`tests/jit-control-flow.test.js`:

```js
// Control flow inside a translated region (translate.js planUnits / jumpTo): forward branches are
// plain `br`s, innermost loops are WASM loops, everything else goes through the region's
// dispatcher. Random control-flow graphs (overlapping and nested loops, jumps into loop bodies,
// flags live across edges) run under the JIT, whole and in small time slices (which re-enter
// regions in the middle of their loops), and must match the reference interpreter.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-sse.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const ARITH = F.CF | F.PF | F.AF | F.ZF | F.SF | F.OF;
const hex = (v) => '0x' + (v >>> 0).toString(16);
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];

function rng(seed) {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return () => { s = (s + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0; let t = s; t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
}

/**
 * n blocks; block k: adc ebx, imm (CF from the predecessor) ; dec esi ; jz exit ; add eax, imm ;
 * rol eax, r ; xor ebx, eax ; add ecx, ebx ; inc dword [DATA + 4 * (k & 15)] ; bt eax, bit ;
 * jc/jnc <random block> ; then a jmp to a random block, or a fallthrough.
 */
function program(seed, n) {
  const R = rng(seed), pick = (m) => Math.floor(R() * m);
  const bytes = [], fix = [], at = [];
  const imm32 = (v) => bytes.push(v & 0xff, (v >> 8) & 0xff, (v >> 16) & 0xff, (v >>> 24) & 0xff);
  const rel = (target) => { fix.push([bytes.length, target]); imm32(0); };
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    at[k] = CODE + bytes.length;
    bytes.push(0x81, 0xd3); imm32(pick(0x10000));
    bytes.push(0x4e, 0x0f, 0x84); rel('exit');
    bytes.push(0x05); imm32((R() * 0x100000000) | 0);
    bytes.push(0xc1, 0xc0, 1 + pick(31), 0x31, 0xc3, 0x01, 0xd9, 0xff, 0x05); imm32(DATA + 4 * (k & 15));
    bytes.push(0x0f, 0xba, 0xe0, pick(32));
    // bias toward nearby targets (tight loops) with some far ones
    const near = () => Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, k + pick(7) - 4));
    bytes.push(0x0f, 0x82 + pick(2)); rel(R() < 0.7 ? near() : pick(n));
    if (R() < 0.3 || k === n - 1) { bytes.push(0xe9); rel(R() < 0.6 ? near() : pick(n)); }
  }
  const exit = CODE + bytes.length;
  bytes.push(0xf4);
  for (const [o, t] of fix) {
    const v = (t === 'exit' ? exit : at[t]) - (CODE + o + 4);
    bytes[o] = v & 0xff; bytes[o + 1] = (v >> 8) & 0xff; bytes[o + 2] = (v >> 16) & 0xff; bytes[o + 3] = (v >>> 24) & 0xff;
  }
  return { code: Uint8Array.from(bytes), exit };
}

/**
 * Flags live across block boundaries: every block ends with a random flag-setting instruction (cmp/add/
 * test/and/inc/dec at 8, 16 and 32 bits, and kinds without an inline path: shl, neg, imul, bt) followed
 * by a jcc, and the successors start by consuming those flags (jcc on any condition, setcc, cmovcc,
 * adc/sbb, inc: CF preserved) before anything else writes them.
 */
function flagsProgram(seed, n) {
  const R = rng(seed), pick = (m) => Math.floor(R() * m);
  const bytes = [], fix = [], at = [];
  const imm32 = (v) => bytes.push(v & 0xff, (v >> 8) & 0xff, (v >> 16) & 0xff, (v >>> 24) & 0xff);
  const rel = (target) => { fix.push([bytes.length, target]); imm32(0); };
  const near = (k) => Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, k + pick(7) - 4));
  const SETTERS = [
    () => bytes.push(0x3c, pick(256)), () => { bytes.push(0x66, 0x3d, pick(256), pick(256)); }, () => { bytes.push(0x3d); imm32((R() * 2 ** 32) | 0); }, // cmp al/ax/eax, imm
    () => bytes.push(0x00, 0xc3), () => bytes.push(0x66, 0x01, 0xc3), () => bytes.push(0x01, 0xc3), // add bl,al / bx,ax / ebx,eax
    () => bytes.push(0xa8, pick(256)), () => bytes.push(0x66, 0xa9, pick(256), pick(256)), () => bytes.push(0x21, 0xc3), // test al / test ax / and ebx,eax
    () => bytes.push(0xfe, 0xcb), () => bytes.push(0x66, 0x47), () => bytes.push(0x47), () => bytes.push(0x4f), // dec bl, inc di, inc edi, dec edi
    () => bytes.push(0xc1, 0xe3, 1 + pick(31)), () => bytes.push(0xf7, 0xdb), () => bytes.push(0x0f, 0xaf, 0xd8), () => bytes.push(0x0f, 0xba, 0xe0, pick(32)), // shl, neg, imul, bt
  ];
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    at[k] = CODE + bytes.length;
    switch (pick(6)) { // consumer of the predecessor's flags
      case 0: bytes.push(0x0f, 0x80 + pick(16)); rel(k === n - 1 ? 'exit' : k + 1 + pick(Math.min(4, n - 1 - k))); break; // jcc (a block of its own; forward: no fuel-free cycle)
      case 1: bytes.push(0x0f, 0x90 + pick(16), 0xc2); break; // setcc dl
      case 2: bytes.push(0x0f, 0x40 + pick(16), 0xd9); break; // cmovcc ebx, ecx
      case 3: bytes.push(0x81, 0xd3); imm32(pick(0x10000)); break; // adc ebx, imm
      case 4: bytes.push(0x81, 0xd9); imm32(pick(0x10000)); break; // sbb ecx, imm
      default: bytes.push(0x42); // inc edx (keeps CF)
    }
    bytes.push(0x4e, 0x0f, 0x84); rel('exit');
    bytes.push(0x05); imm32((R() * 0x100000000) | 0);
    bytes.push(0xc1, 0xc0, 1 + pick(31), 0x31, 0xc3, 0x01, 0xd9, 0x31, 0xd7); // rol eax ; xor ebx,eax ; add ecx,ebx ; xor edi,edx
    SETTERS[pick(SETTERS.length)]();
    bytes.push(0x0f, 0x80 + pick(16)); rel(R() < 0.7 ? near(k) : pick(n));
    if (R() < 0.25 || k === n - 1) { bytes.push(0xe9); rel(near(k)); }
  }
  const exit = CODE + bytes.length;
  bytes.push(0xf4);
  for (const [o, t] of fix) {
    const v = (t === 'exit' ? exit : at[t]) - (CODE + o + 4);
    bytes[o] = v & 0xff; bytes[o + 1] = (v >> 8) & 0xff; bytes[o + 2] = (v >> 16) & 0xff; bytes[o + 3] = (v >>> 24) & 0xff;
  }
  return { code: Uint8Array.from(bytes), exit };
}

function makeExec(useJit, opts = {}) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  const I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
  const jit = useJit ? new Jit(mem, I, { smc: true, ...opts }) : null;
  return {
    mem, cpu, jit,
    load(code, fuel) {
      cpu.reset();
      mem.fill(DATA, 0x1000, 0);
      mem.fill(CODE, 0x4000, 0xcc);
      mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
      cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; cpu.esi = fuel; cpu.eax = 0x12345678;
      cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
    },
    run(stopAt, maxInsns) {
      if (!jit) return I.run({ stopAt, maxInsns });
      jit.cpu = cpu;
      return jit.run({ stopAt, maxInsns });
    },
  };
}
function snapshot(E) {
  const s = { eip: hex(E.cpu.eip), eflags: hex(E.cpu.eflags & ARITH), regs: [], mem: Buffer.from(E.mem.bytes(DATA, 64)).toString('hex') };
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) s.regs.push(hex(E.cpu.reg(k)));
  return s;
}

test('random control flow: whole runs and time-sliced runs match the interpreter (innermost and nested structured loops)', () => {
  let loops = 0, dispatches = 0;
  for (let seed = 1; seed <= 80; seed++) {
    const nestLoops = seed > 40;
    const n = 3 + ((seed % 40) * 7) % 58; // up to 60 blocks: some regions exceed MAX_BLOCKS
    const { code, exit } = program(seed % 40 + 1, n);
    const fuel = 3000;
    const EI = makeExec(false);
    EI.load(code, fuel);
    assert.equal(EI.run(exit, 1e7), EXIT.HALT, `seed ${seed}: interpreter`);
    const want = snapshot(EI);
    const EJ = makeExec(true, { nestLoops });
    EJ.load(code, fuel);
    assert.equal(EJ.run(exit, 1e7), EXIT.HALT, `seed ${seed}: jit`);
    assert.deepEqual(snapshot(EJ), want, `seed ${seed}: whole run`);
    // translated code re-entered after every time slice, at whatever block the budget ran out
    for (const slice of [5, 17, 61]) {
      EJ.load(code, fuel);
      let r, k = 0;
      while ((r = EJ.run(exit, slice)) === EXIT.TIMESLICE) assert.ok(++k < 1e6, 'runaway');
      assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT, `seed ${seed} slice ${slice}`);
      assert.deepEqual(snapshot(EJ), want, `seed ${seed}: slices of ${slice}`);
    }
    loops += EJ.jit.stats.regions; dispatches += EJ.jit.stats.fallbackSteps;
  }
  assert.equal(dispatches, 0, 'no interpreter fallback');
});

test('flags consumed at block entry (every lazy kind and size) match the interpreter', () => {
  for (let seed = 100; seed < 160; seed++) {
    const n = 4 + (seed * 5) % 40;
    const { code, exit } = flagsProgram(seed, n);
    const EI = makeExec(false);
    EI.load(code, 2000);
    assert.equal(EI.run(exit, 1e7), EXIT.HALT, `seed ${seed}: interpreter`);
    const want = snapshot(EI);
    const EJ = makeExec(true);
    EJ.load(code, 2000);
    assert.equal(EJ.run(exit, 1e7), EXIT.HALT, `seed ${seed}: jit`);
    assert.deepEqual(snapshot(EJ), want, `seed ${seed}: whole run`);
    EJ.load(code, 2000);
    let r, k = 0;
    while ((r = EJ.run(exit, 23)) === EXIT.TIMESLICE) assert.ok(++k < 1e6, 'runaway');
    assert.deepEqual(snapshot(EJ), want, `seed ${seed}: time slices`);
  }
});

test('returns to call sites of the same region stay in the region and match the interpreter', () => {
  // main: mov ecx, 300 ; L: call f ; add eax, ebx ; push 7 ; call g4 ; call g ; dec ecx ; jnz L ;
  //       push X ; ret (a return to a non-call site) ; X: hlt
  // f: add ebx, 3 ; call g ; ret        g: xor eax, ebx ; rol eax, 5 ; ret        g4: add ebx, [esp+4] ; ret 4
  const bytes = [], fix = [], at = {};
  const imm32 = (v) => bytes.push(v & 0xff, (v >> 8) & 0xff, (v >> 16) & 0xff, (v >>> 24) & 0xff);
  const label = (n) => { at[n] = CODE + bytes.length; };
  const call = (n) => { bytes.push(0xe8); fix.push([bytes.length, n, 'rel']); imm32(0); };
  bytes.push(0xb9); imm32(300);
  label('L'); call('f'); bytes.push(0x01, 0xd8, 0x6a, 7); call('g4'); call('g'); bytes.push(0x49, 0x0f, 0x85); fix.push([bytes.length, 'L', 'rel']); imm32(0);
  bytes.push(0x68); fix.push([bytes.length, 'X', 'abs']); imm32(0); bytes.push(0xc3);
  label('X'); bytes.push(0xf4);
  label('f'); bytes.push(0x83, 0xc3, 3); call('g'); bytes.push(0xc3);
  label('g'); bytes.push(0x31, 0xd8, 0xc1, 0xc0, 5, 0xc3);
  label('g4'); bytes.push(0x03, 0x5c, 0x24, 0x04, 0xc2, 4, 0);
  for (const [o, n, kind] of fix) {
    const v = kind === 'abs' ? at[n] : at[n] - (CODE + o + 4);
    bytes[o] = v & 0xff; bytes[o + 1] = (v >> 8) & 0xff; bytes[o + 2] = (v >> 16) & 0xff; bytes[o + 3] = (v >>> 24) & 0xff;
  }
  const code = Uint8Array.from(bytes);
  const EI = makeExec(false);
  EI.load(code, 0);
  assert.equal(EI.run(at.X, 1e7), EXIT.HALT);
  const want = snapshot(EI);
  const EJ = makeExec(true);
  EJ.load(code, 0);
  assert.equal(EJ.run(at.X, 1e7), EXIT.HALT);
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(EJ), want, 'whole run');
  assert.ok(EJ.jit.stats.chained < 50, `returns chained back into the region: ${EJ.jit.stats.chained}`);
  for (const slice of [3, 11]) {
    EJ.load(code, 0);
    let r, k = 0;
    while ((r = EJ.run(at.X, slice)) === EXIT.TIMESLICE) assert.ok(++k < 1e6, 'runaway');
    assert.deepEqual(snapshot(EJ), want, `slices of ${slice}`);
  }
});

test('x87 regions specialized for the control word in force: entered under another mode, replaced by run-time tested code', () => {
  // fld dword [DATA+0x100] ; fmul dword [DATA+0x104] ; fadd dword [DATA+0x108] ; fstp qword [DATA+0x110] ; fldcw [DATA+0x120] ; fld1 ; fadd dword [DATA+0x104] ; fstp dword [DATA+0x118] ; hlt
  const bytes = [0xd9, 0x05, ...le(DATA + 0x100), 0xd8, 0x0d, ...le(DATA + 0x104), 0xd8, 0x05, ...le(DATA + 0x108), 0xdd, 0x1d, ...le(DATA + 0x110),
    0xd9, 0x2d, ...le(DATA + 0x120), 0xd9, 0xe8, 0xd8, 0x05, ...le(DATA + 0x104), 0xd9, 0x1d, ...le(DATA + 0x118), 0xf4];
  const code = Uint8Array.from(bytes), end = CODE + bytes.length - 1;
  const setup = (E, cw, cwNew) => {
    E.load(code, 0);
    E.mem.writeF32(DATA + 0x100, 1 / 3); E.mem.writeF32(DATA + 0x104, 3.0000002); E.mem.writeF32(DATA + 0x108, 1e-9); E.mem.write16(DATA + 0x120, cwNew);
    E.mem.write16(E.cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, cw);
  };
  const result = (E) => [E.mem.readF64(DATA + 0x110), E.mem.readF32(DATA + 0x118), E.mem.read16(E.cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW)];
  for (const [cw, cwNew] of [[0x007f, 0x027f], [0x027f, 0x007f], [0x0c7f, 0x007f], [0x047f, 0x087f]]) {
    const EI = makeExec(false); setup(EI, cw, cwNew); assert.equal(EI.run(end, 1e6), EXIT.HALT);
    // translated under `cw`, then run again under the other control words
    const EJ = makeExec(true); setup(EJ, cw, cwNew); assert.equal(EJ.run(end, 1e6), EXIT.HALT);
    assert.deepEqual(result(EJ), result(EI), `cw ${cw.toString(16)}`);
    for (const other of [0x007f, 0x027f, 0x0c7f]) {
      const EI2 = makeExec(false); setup(EI2, other, cwNew); assert.equal(EI2.run(end, 1e6), EXIT.HALT);
      setup(EJ, other, cwNew); assert.equal(EJ.run(end, 1e6), EXIT.HALT);
      assert.deepEqual(result(EJ), result(EI2), `translated under ${cw.toString(16)}, run under ${other.toString(16)}`);
    }
    if (cw !== 0x007f) assert.ok(EJ.jit.stats.fpuModeMisses >= 1, 'a specialized region left on a mode mismatch');
  }
});

test('flags liveness: partial flag writers (rotates, bit tests, inc/dec, clc/stc) mixed with readers and full writers match the interpreter', () => {
  // straight-line random integer code over eax..edi (esp untouched), with jcc to the next instruction to split blocks
  const R = rng(4242), pick = (n) => Math.floor(R() * n);
  const reg = () => [0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7][pick(7)]; // not esp
  const modrm = (r, rm) => 0xc0 | (r << 3) | rm;
  const EDGE = [0, 1, 2, 0x7f, 0x80, 0xff, 0x100, 0x7fff, 0x8000, 0xffff, 0x10000, 0x7fffffff, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff, 0xfffffffe, 0x80000001, 0x7ffffffe, 0x7e, 0x81, 0xfe, 0x7ffe, 0x8001];
  const ops = [
    () => [0x01 + 8 * [0, 1, 4, 5, 6, 7][pick(6)], modrm(reg(), reg())], // add/or/and/sub/xor/cmp r, r
    () => [0x85, modrm(reg(), reg())], // test
    () => [0xf7, modrm(3, reg())], // neg
    () => [0x40 + reg()], () => [0x48 + reg()], // inc / dec
    () => [0xc1, modrm(pick(2), reg()), pick(32)], // rol / ror imm
    () => [0xd3, modrm(pick(2), reg())], // rol / ror cl
    () => [0xd1, modrm(2 + pick(2), reg())], // rcl / rcr 1
    () => [0xc1, modrm([4, 5, 7][pick(3)], reg()), pick(32)], // shl / shr / sar imm
    () => [0xd3, modrm([4, 5, 7][pick(3)], reg())], // shl / shr / sar cl
    () => [0x0f, 0xba, modrm(4 + pick(4), reg()), pick(32)], // bt / bts / btr / btc imm
    () => [0x0f, [0xa3, 0xab, 0xb3, 0xbb][pick(4)], modrm(reg(), reg())], // bt* r, r
    () => [[0xf8, 0xf9, 0xf5][pick(3)]], // clc / stc / cmc
    () => [0x11 + 8 * pick(2), modrm(reg(), reg())], // adc / sbb
    () => [0x0f, 0x90 + pick(16), modrm(0, [0, 1, 2, 3][pick(4)])], // setcc r8
    () => [0x0f, 0x40 + pick(16), modrm(reg(), reg())], // cmovcc
    () => [0x9f], () => [0x9e], // lahf / sahf
    () => [0x9c, 0x58 + [0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7][pick(7)]], // pushf ; pop r
    () => [0x0f, 0x80 + pick(16), 0, 0, 0, 0], // jcc to the next instruction: a block boundary
    () => [0x89, modrm(reg(), reg())], // mov (transparent)
    () => { const v = EDGE[pick(EDGE.length)]; return [0xb8 + reg(), v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24]; }, // mov r, edge value
    () => { const v = EDGE[pick(EDGE.length)]; return [0xb8 + reg(), v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24]; },
    () => { // edge value, a flag writer on it, then a condition read at once (setcc / cmovcc / jcc)
      const r = reg(), v = EDGE[pick(EDGE.length)], w = [[0x40 + r], [0x48 + r], [0xf7, modrm(3, r)], [0x83, modrm(0, r), 1], [0x83, modrm(5, r), 1], [0xd1, modrm(5, r)], [0xd1, modrm(7, r)],
        [0xd1, modrm(4, r)], [0x83, modrm(2, r), 0], [0x83, modrm(3, r), 0], [0x85, modrm(r, r)], [0x0f, 0xaf, modrm(r, r)], [0xc1, modrm(pick(2), r), 1 + pick(31)]][pick(13)];
      const rd = [[0x0f, 0x90 + pick(16), modrm(0, [0, 1, 2, 3][pick(4)])], [0x0f, 0x40 + pick(16), modrm(reg(), reg())], [0x0f, 0x80 + pick(16), 0, 0, 0, 0]][pick(3)];
      return [0xb8 + r, v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24, ...w, ...rd];
    },
    () => [0x8d, 0x04 | (reg() << 3), (reg() << 3) | [0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7][pick(6)]], // lea r, [base + index] (transparent)
  ];
  for (let seed = 0; seed < 300; seed++) {
    const bytes = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      bytes.push(...ops[pick(ops.length)]());
    }
    bytes.push(0x9c, 0x5e, 0xf4); // pushf ; pop esi ; hlt  (every flag observed at the end)
    const code = Uint8Array.from(bytes), end = CODE + bytes.length - 1;
    const init = (E) => { E.load(code, 0); const R2 = rng(seed + 1); E.cpu.eax = (R2() * 2 ** 32) >>> 0; E.cpu.ecx = (R2() * 2 ** 32) >>> 0; E.cpu.edx = (R2() * 2 ** 32) >>> 0; E.cpu.ebx = (R2() * 2 ** 32) >>> 0; E.cpu.ebp = (R2() * 2 ** 32) >>> 0; E.cpu.edi = (R2() * 2 ** 32) >>> 0; };
    const EI = makeExec(false); init(EI); assert.equal(EI.run(end, 1e6), EXIT.HALT);
    const EJ = makeExec(true); init(EJ); assert.equal(EJ.run(end, 1e6), EXIT.HALT);
    const st = (E) => { const s = snapshot(E); s.esiFlags = hex(E.cpu.esi & (0x8d5 | 0x400)); return s; };
    assert.deepEqual(st(EJ), st(EI), `seed ${seed}`);
  }
});

test('every condition after every flag writer on boundary values, in the same block and across a block boundary, matches the interpreter', () => {
  const EDGE = [0, 1, 2, 0x7f, 0x80, 0xff, 0x100, 0x7fff, 0x8000, 0xffff, 0x7fffffff, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff, 0x80000001, 0x7ffffffe, 0x7e, 0xfe, 0x8001];
  // writers on eax (ecx = 3 as a second operand / shift count)
  const WRITERS = [[0x40], [0x48], [0xfe, 0xc0], [0x66, 0x48], [0xf7, 0xd8], [0xf6, 0xd8], [0x83, 0xc0, 0x01], [0x83, 0xe8, 0x01], [0x04, 0x01], [0x66, 0x2d, 0x01, 0x00],
    [0x83, 0xd0, 0x00], [0x83, 0xd8, 0x00], [0x01, 0xc8], [0x29, 0xc8], [0x85, 0xc0], [0x84, 0xc0], [0xd1, 0xe8], [0xd1, 0xf8], [0xd1, 0xe0], [0xc1, 0xe8, 0x03], [0xc0, 0xf8, 0x03],
    [0xd3, 0xe8], [0x0f, 0xaf, 0xc1], [0xf7, 0xe1], [0x0f, 0xa4, 0xc8, 0x03], [0x3c, 0x80], [0x66, 0x3d, 0x00, 0x80]];
  for (const w of WRITERS) for (const v of EDGE) for (const split of [false, true]) {
    const bytes = [];
    for (let cc = 0; cc < 16; cc++) {
      // stc/clc give adc/sbb a known carry-in; setcc into cl, accumulated in ebx
      bytes.push(0xb8, v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24, 0xb9, 3, 0, 0, 0, cc & 1 ? 0xf9 : 0xf8, ...w);
      if (split) bytes.push(0x0f, 0x80 + ((cc + 5) & 15), 0, 0, 0, 0); // jcc to the next instruction: the reader starts a block
      bytes.push(0x0f, 0x90 + cc, 0xc1, 0xd1, 0xe3, 0x09, 0xcb); // setcc cl ; shl ebx, 1 ; or ebx, ecx
    }
    bytes.push(0xf4);
    const code = Uint8Array.from(bytes), end = CODE + bytes.length - 1;
    const EI = makeExec(false); EI.load(code, 0); EI.cpu.ebx = 0; assert.equal(EI.run(end, 1e6), EXIT.HALT);
    const EJ = makeExec(true); EJ.load(code, 0); EJ.cpu.ebx = 0; assert.equal(EJ.run(end, 1e6), EXIT.HALT);
    // mul/imul define only CF/OF (the others are undefined and differ between the executors): their conditions are O, B (and negations)
    const mask = (w[0] === 0x0f && w[1] === 0xaf) || (w[0] === 0xf7 && w[1] === 0xe1) ? 0b1111 << 12 : 0xffff;
    assert.equal(EJ.cpu.ebx & mask, EI.cpu.ebx & mask, `writer ${w.map((b) => b.toString(16)).join(' ')} on ${v.toString(16)}${split ? ' (reader in the next block)' : ''}`);
  }
});

test('push / pop of segment registers match the interpreter (selector only, upper bytes of the slot kept)', () => {
  // push 0xaabbccdd ; pop eax ; push ds ; pop es ; push es ; pop eax ; push ss ; pop ds ; push fs ; pop gs ; push gs ; pop ecx ; hlt
  // (the slot reused by `push ds` still holds 0xaabbccdd: its upper half must survive the 16-bit store)
  const code = Uint8Array.from([0x68, 0xdd, 0xcc, 0xbb, 0xaa, 0x58, 0x1e, 0x07, 0x06, 0x58, 0x16, 0x1f, 0x0f, 0xa0, 0x0f, 0xa9, 0x0f, 0xa8, 0x59, 0xf4]);
  const end = CODE + code.length - 1;
  const segs = (E) => [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => E.mem.read16(E.cpu.base + ST.SEG + 2 * i));
  const run = (jit) => { const E = makeExec(jit); E.load(code, 0); [0x23, 0x1b, 0x23, 0x2b, 0x3b, 0x33].forEach((v, i) => E.mem.write16(E.cpu.base + ST.SEG + 2 * i, v)); assert.equal(E.run(end, 1e6), EXIT.HALT); return { s: snapshot(E), segs: segs(E) }; };
  const I = run(false), J = run(true);
  assert.deepEqual(J, I);
  assert.equal(I.s.regs[0], '0xaabb002b', 'DS (0x2b) through ES, the upper half of the reused slot kept');
});

test('code rewritten by string stores (rep movsb / stosb, single movsd) is retranslated', () => {
  // main: call F ; mov ebx, eax ; <copy F2 over F> ; call F ; hlt       F: mov eax, 1 ; ret      F2 (data): mov eax, 2 ; ret
  const F = CODE + 0x100, F2 = DATA + 0x100;
  for (const copy of [
    [0xbe, ...le(F2), 0xbf, ...le(F), 0xb9, 6, 0, 0, 0, 0xfc, 0xf3, 0xa4], // mov esi, F2 ; mov edi, F ; mov ecx, 6 ; cld ; rep movsb
    [0xbe, ...le(F2), 0xbf, ...le(F), 0xfc, 0xa5, 0xa5], // two movsd
    [0xbf, ...le(F + 1), 0xb0, 0x02, 0xfc, 0xaa], // mov edi, F+1 ; mov al, 2 ; stosb   (the immediate of mov eax, 1)
  ]) {
    const main = [0xe8, ...le(F - (CODE + 5)), 0x89, 0xc3, ...copy];
    const at = main.length; main.push(0xe8, ...le(F - (CODE + at + 5)), 0xf4);
    const code = new Uint8Array(0x110); code.set(main, 0); code.set([0xb8, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0xc3], 0x100);
    const EJ = makeExec(true);
    EJ.load(code, 0);
    EJ.mem.writeBytes(F2, Uint8Array.from([0xb8, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0xc3, 0x90, 0x90]));
    // as the VM does: an SMC exit invalidates the written range (EXIT_ARG, EXIT_LEN) and resumes
    let r, smc = 0;
    while ((r = EJ.run(CODE + main.length - 1, 1e6)) === EXIT.SMC) {
      const len = EJ.mem.read32(EJ.cpu.base + ST.EXIT_LEN) || 16; EJ.mem.write32(EJ.cpu.base + ST.EXIT_LEN, 0);
      EJ.jit.invalidate(EJ.cpu.exitArg, len); smc++;
    }
    assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT);
    assert.ok(smc >= 1, 'the string store left with SMC');
    assert.deepEqual([EJ.cpu.ebx, EJ.cpu.eax], [1, 2], `copy ${copy.map((b) => b.toString(16)).join(' ')}`);
  }
});

// Flags liveness across the blocks of a region (translate.js regionFlagsLiveness): INC keeps CF only when a successor
// reads it before writing it. A loop `inc ecx ; jmp B` / B: `cmp ; jb`: CF dead at A's end, no flags helper call
// for the INC; the same loop with `adc ebx, 0` first in B: CF live, carried through the INC (ebx counts the passes).
test('flags liveness across blocks: INC computes the preserved CF only when a successor reads it', async () => {
  const { translateRegion, IMP_FLAGS } = await import('../src/cpu/jit/translate.js');
  const { OP } = await import('../src/cpu/decoder.js');
  const cases = [
    { name: 'dead', code: [0x41, 0xeb, 0x00, 0x83, 0xf9, 0x0a, 0x72, 0xf8, 0xf4], incCalls: 0 }, // A: inc ecx ; jmp B / B: cmp ecx,10 ; jb A ; hlt
    { name: 'live', code: [0xf9, 0x41, 0xeb, 0x00, 0x83, 0xd3, 0x00, 0x83, 0xf9, 0x0a, 0x72, 0xf5, 0xf4], ebx: 10 }, // stc ; A: inc ecx ; jmp B / B: adc ebx,0 ; cmp ecx,10 ; jb A ; hlt
  ];
  for (const k of cases) {
    const code = Uint8Array.from(k.code), exit = CODE + code.length - 1;
    const EI = makeExec(false); EI.load(code, 0); EI.cpu.ecx = 0; EI.cpu.ebx = 0;
    assert.equal(EI.run(exit, 1e5), EXIT.HALT);
    const EJ = makeExec(true); EJ.load(code, 0); EJ.cpu.ecx = 0; EJ.cpu.ebx = 0;
    assert.equal(EJ.run(exit, 1e5), EXIT.HALT);
    assert.deepEqual(snapshot(EJ), snapshot(EI), k.name);
    if (k.ebx !== undefined) assert.equal(EJ.cpu.ebx, k.ebx, `${k.name}: CF carried through the INC across the jump`);
    if (k.incCalls !== undefined) {
      const { stats } = translateRegion(EJ.mem, CODE, {});
      const calls = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < (stats.calls ?? []).length; i += 2) if (stats.calls[i] === IMP_FLAGS && stats.calls[i + 1] === OP.INC) calls.push(i);
      assert.equal(calls.length, k.incCalls, `${k.name}: flags helper calls for the INC`);
    }
  }
});
```

`tests/jit-decode-error-exit.test.js`:

```js
// A block ended by an undecodable instruction (discoverRegion: TERM_EXIT with decodeError) leaves the region there for
// the interpreter, which raises the fault with the exact state: the instructions before it done, EIP at it. (The block
// used to end without any exit: the code ran on into the next block's — or trapped, the fault then reported with the
// registers of the region's entry.)
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
function run(code, useJit, slice = 0) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory(), cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE); cpu.reset();
  mem.fill(CODE, 0x1000, 0xcc); mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code));
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; cpu.eax = 5; cpu.ecx = 3; cpu.ebp = 4; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  const interp = new Interp(mem, cpu);
  let r;
  if (!useJit) r = interp.run({ maxInsns: 1e5 });
  else {
    const jit = new Jit(mem, interp, { smc: true }); jit.cpu = cpu;
    let k = 0; do r = jit.run({ maxInsns: slice || 1e5 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE && ++k < 1e5);
  }
  return `${r} eip=${(cpu.eip >>> 0).toString(16)} eax=${cpu.eax} ecx=${cpu.ecx} ebp=${cpu.ebp} esp=${(cpu.esp >>> 0).toString(16)} fl=${(cpu.eflags & 0x8d5).toString(16)}`;
}

test('an undecodable instruction faults where it is, after the instructions before it', () => {
  const programs = [
    [0x40, 0x0f, 0x00, 0x00, 0x40, 0xf4], // inc eax ; (0f 00 /0: undecodable here)
    [0x0f, 0x00, 0x00], // at the region's entry
    [0x40, 0x41, 0x74, 0x02, 0x0f, 0x00, 0x00, 0x48, 0xf4], // after a conditional branch not taken
    [0x49, 0x75, 0x03, 0x0f, 0x00, 0x00, 0x48, 0xeb, 0xf7], // in a loop: reached once the counter is 0
    [0x4d, 0x74, 0x03, 0x40, 0xeb, 0xfa, 0x0f, 0x00, 0x00, 0xf4], // loop exit into it (ebp counts down)
    [0x40, 0x07, 0x00, 0xe9, 0x0f, 0x00, 0x00, 0x40, 0xf4], // after pop es ; add cl, ch
  ];
  for (const p of programs) {
    const ref = run(p, false);
    assert.match(ref, /^4 /, 'the interpreter faults');
    for (const slice of [0, 1, 2]) assert.equal(run(p, true, slice), ref, `${Buffer.from(p).toString('hex')} slice ${slice}`);
  }
});
```
