`tests/jit-defer-filter-fx.test.js`:

```js
// Issued-state filter of the fixed-function lights, the material and the Direct3D 9 FVF (runtime.js DEFER_FX_*), against
// the real Direct3D 8 / 9 devices (d3d8.js, d3d9.js): random call sequences — lights set again with the same words, with
// -0 for +0, NaN members, types that are not floats, null pointers, lights out of the shadowed range, switches with odd
// BOOL values, declarations that reset the FVF, state blocks, Reset, an effect commit that sets lights and the FVF behind
// the shadow's back, drains at random points — run through the JIT (calls queued, filtered, drained before every call
// left to JavaScript, as Vm.dispatchThunk does) and through a reference device that executes every call in order. The
// filter may only drop calls that change nothing: the devices must agree at every draw (queued too: compared when it
// runs), version counters included. Also: a queued call carrying a structure (a transform) leaves the filter on.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory, THUNK_BASE } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { registerDirect3D8 } from '../src/win32/d3d8.js';
import { registerDirect3D9 } from '../src/win32/d3d9.js';
import { DEFER_QUEUE, DEFER_SPEC, DEFER_RAW, DEFER_WORDS, COM_MARKER, COMMIT_LIST, FAST_STATS, COMMIT_LIST_WORDS, FX_OWNER, SHADOW_OWNER } from '../src/cpu/jit/runtime.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, SLOTS = 0x10000100, STACK = 0x10090000, DATA = 0x10100000, HEAP = 0x11000000, THUNK_SIZE = 16;
const FX = 0x10004100, FX_HANDLES = 0x10006000, FX_LIST = 0x10007800;
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
const push = (v) => [0x68, ...le(v)];
const callSlot = (i) => [0xff, 0x15, ...le(SLOTS + 4 * i)];

/** guest memory, a bump allocator, COM objects as com.js lays them out (+4 marker, +12 the fast paths' word) */
function d3dWorld(api9, gfx = null) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  let top = HEAP;
  const alloc = (n) => { const a = top; top += (Math.max(n, 16) + 15) & ~15; return a; };
  const vmem = { alloc, release() {} };
  const proc = { mem, vmem, processHeap: { alloc, free_() {} }, symbolize: () => '?' };
  const objects = new Map();
  const com = {
    objects, interface() {}, supports: () => true,
    create(p, iface, impl) { const ptr = alloc(24); mem.write32(ptr + 4, COM_MARKER); const obj = { ptr, impl, refs: 1, proc: p }; objects.set(ptr, obj); impl.comObject = obj; return ptr; },
    objectAt: (ptr) => objects.get(ptr >>> 0) ?? null, implAt: (ptr) => objects.get(ptr >>> 0)?.impl ?? null,
    addRef: (o) => ++o.refs, release: (o) => --o.refs, unpin() {}, dispose() {},
  };
  const vm = { mem, com, proc, host: { gfx }, log() {}, clock: { now: () => 0 }, recentApiCalls: () => [], startApiBurst() {} };
  const defs = {};
  registerDirect3D8({ define(dll, d) { Object.assign(defs, d); } }, vm); registerDirect3D9({ define(dll, d) { Object.assign(defs, d); } }, vm);
  const ctx = (args) => ({ args, proc, thread: { id: 1 }, retAddr: 0, arg(i) { return (this.args[i] ?? 0) >>> 0; }, sarg(i) { return (this.args[i] ?? 0) | 0; }, argF32(i) { const b = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(4)); b.setUint32(0, this.args[i] ?? 0, true); return b.getFloat32(0, true); }, out32(i, v) { const a = this.arg(i); if (a) mem.write32(a, v >>> 0); } });
  const pp = alloc(64);
  if (api9) [320, 240, 22, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 75, 0, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(pp + 4 * i, v));
  else [320, 240, 22, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 75, 0, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(pp + 4 * i, v));
  const d3dPtr = defs[api9 ? 'Direct3DCreate9' : 'Direct3DCreate8'][1](ctx([api9 ? 32 : 220]));
  const out = alloc(16);
  com.implAt(d3dPtr).CreateDevice(ctx([d3dPtr, 0, 1, 0, 0x40, pp, out]));
  const devPtr = mem.read32(out), dev = com.implAt(devPtr);
  // a vertex declaration (Direct3D 9): position only
  let decl = 0;
  if (api9) { const el = alloc(32); [0, 0x00020000, 0, 0, 0xff, 0x00110000, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(el + 4 * i, v)); mem.write32(el + 16, 0x000000ff); mem.write32(el + 20, 0x00000011); dev.CreateVertexDeclaration(ctx([devPtr, el, out])); decl = mem.read32(out); }
  return { mem, dev, devPtr, ctx, pp, decl, alloc };
}

const f32w = (x) => { const b = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(4)); b.setFloat32(0, x, true); return b.getUint32(0, true); };
/** the structures the program points to (the same addresses in both worlds): light and material variants */
function writeData(mem) {
  const lights = [], mats = [];
  const base = [3, ...[0.5, 0.25, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0, 1, 2, 3, -0.5, -1, 0, 100, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0.7, 0.3].map(f32w)];
  const variants = [
    base, // and a copy at another address: same words
    base,
    base.map((w, k) => (k === 6 ? 0x80000000 : w)), // -0 where the light holds +0
    base.map((w, k) => (k === 1 ? f32w(0.75) : w)), // another diffuse
    base.map((w, k) => (k === 0 ? 1 : w)), // another type (a point light)
    base.map((w, k) => (k === 0 ? 0x01000001 : w)), // a type no float holds exactly
    base.map((w, k) => (k === 9 ? 0x7fc00001 : w)), // a NaN member
    base.map((w, k) => (k === 9 ? 0x7f800000 : w)), // +inf
  ];
  let a = DATA;
  for (const v of variants) { v.forEach((w, k) => mem.write32(a + 4 * k, w)); lights.push(a); a += 128; }
  const mbase = [0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 1, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 8].map(f32w);
  const mvar = [mbase, mbase, mbase.map((w, k) => (k === 8 ? 0x80000000 : w)), mbase.map((w, k) => (k === 16 ? f32w(16) : w)), mbase.map((w, k) => (k === 3 ? 0xffc00000 : w))];
  for (const v of mvar) { v.forEach((w, k) => mem.write32(a + 4 * k, w)); mats.push(a); a += 128; }
  const xf = a; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) mem.write32(xf + 4 * i, f32w(i % 5 === 0 ? 1 : 0.5)); a += 64;
  return { lights, mats, xf };
}

function methodsOf(api9) {
  const I = `com.dll!IDirect3DDevice${api9 ? 9 : 8}::`;
  const list = [['SetLight', 2], ['LightEnable', 2], ['SetMaterial', 1], ['SetRenderState', 2], ['SetTransform', 2], ['DrawPrimitive', 3], ['BeginStateBlock', 0], ['EndStateBlock', 1], ['Reset', 1], ['ApplyStateBlock', 1], ['TestCooperativeLevel', 0]];
  if (api9) list.push(['SetFVF', 1], ['SetVertexDeclaration', 1]);
  const m = list.map(([n, argc]) => [I + n, argc]);
  m.push(['com.dll!ID3DXEffect::CommitChanges', 0]);
  return m;
}

function randomProgram(seed, n, api9, data, W) {
  let x = seed >>> 0;
  const rnd = (k) => { x = (Math.imul(x, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return (x >>> 8) % k; };
  const M = Object.fromEntries(methodsOf(api9).map(([k], i) => [k.split('::')[1], i]));
  const calls = [];
  const light = () => (rnd(8) === 0 ? 0 : data.lights[rnd(data.lights.length)]); // (null now and then: INVALIDCALL)
  const idx = () => (rnd(8) === 0 ? 8 + rnd(3) : rnd(3));
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const r = rnd(100);
    if (r < 30) calls.push([M.SetLight, [W.devPtr, idx(), light()]]);
    else if (r < 55) calls.push([M.LightEnable, [W.devPtr, idx(), [0, 1, 1, 1, 0x80][rnd(5)]]]);
    else if (r < 65) calls.push([M.SetMaterial, [W.devPtr, rnd(10) === 0 ? 0 : data.mats[rnd(data.mats.length)]]]);
    else if (r < 70) calls.push([M.SetRenderState, [W.devPtr, [7, 137][rnd(2)], rnd(2)]]);
    else if (r < 74) calls.push([M.SetTransform, [W.devPtr, 256, data.xf]]);
    else if (api9 && r < 82) calls.push([M.SetFVF, [W.devPtr, [0, 0x142, 0x152][rnd(3)]]]);
    else if (api9 && r < 85) calls.push([M.SetVertexDeclaration, [W.devPtr, rnd(3) === 0 ? 0 : W.decl]]);
    else if (r < 89) calls.push([M.DrawPrimitive, [W.devPtr, 4, 0, 1]]); // (queued: the state compared when it runs)
    else if (r < 92) calls.push([M.TestCooperativeLevel, [W.devPtr]]); // (handled in JavaScript: the queue runs)
    else if (r < 94) calls.push([M.CommitChanges, [FX]]);
    else if (r < 95) { // (a state block recorded: lights apply at once, the FVF is recorded)
      calls.push([M.BeginStateBlock, [W.devPtr]]);
      for (let k = rnd(3); k >= 0; k--) calls.push([M.LightEnable, [W.devPtr, rnd(2), rnd(2)]], [M.SetLight, [W.devPtr, rnd(2), light()]]);
      if (api9) calls.push([M.SetFVF, [W.devPtr, [0x142, 0x152][rnd(2)]]], [M.SetVertexDeclaration, [W.devPtr, rnd(2) ? W.decl : 0]]);
      calls.push([M.EndStateBlock, [W.devPtr, W.alloc(16)]]);
    }
    else if (r < 96) calls.push([M.Reset, [W.devPtr, W.pp]]);
    else if (r < 97) calls.push([M.ApplyStateBlock, [W.devPtr, 1 + rnd(3)]]); // (Direct3D 9: the FVF / declaration it holds)
    else calls.push([M.DrawPrimitive, [W.devPtr, 4, 0, 1]]);
  }
  return calls;
}

/** what the backend reads of these states (bitwise), and the version counters */
function stateOf(dev) {
  const lights = [...dev.lights].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]).map(([i, l]) => [i, [...new Int32Array(l.buffer, l.byteOffset, l.length)]]);
  return JSON.stringify([lights, [...dev.lightEnabled], [...new Int32Array(dev.material.buffer, dev.material.byteOffset, 17)], dev.fvf ?? null, dev.vertexDecl ? 1 : 0, dev.rs.get(7), dev.rs.get(137), dev.stateVersion, dev.programVersion, dev.lightVersion, dev.transformVersion]);
}

/** the effect's CommitChanges: sets a light switch and the FVF (states the device shadows but commit lists do not name) */
function commit(W, api9, n) {
  const c = W.ctx([W.devPtr, n % 3, n % 2]);
  W.dev.LightEnable(c);
  if (api9) W.dev.SetFVF(W.ctx([W.devPtr, n % 2 ? 0x142 : 0x152]));
}

function call(W, api9, name, args, st) {
  if (name === 'CommitChanges') return commit(W, api9, ++st.commits);
  if (name === 'DrawPrimitive') { st.draws.push(stateOf(W.dev)); return; }
  return W.dev[name](W.ctx(args));
}

function runReference(seed, n, api9) {
  const W = d3dWorld(api9), data = writeData(W.mem);
  const calls = randomProgram(seed, n, api9, data, W);
  const names = methodsOf(api9).map(([k]) => k.split('::')[1]);
  const st = { commits: 0, draws: [] };
  for (const [m, a] of calls) call(W, api9, names[m], a, st);
  st.draws.push(stateOf(W.dev));
  return { draws: st.draws };
}

function runJitted(seed, n, api9, switching = false) {
  const W = d3dWorld(api9), { mem } = W, data = writeData(mem);
  const calls = randomProgram(seed, n, api9, data, W);
  const methods = methodsOf(api9), names = methods.map(([k]) => k.split('::')[1]);
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE); cpu.reset();
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true }); jit.cpu = cpu;
  methods.forEach(([k], i) => { jit.markFast(i, k, true); mem.write32(SLOTS + 4 * i, THUNK_BASE + i * THUNK_SIZE); });
  // the effect: an Orthros object with a handle block (+12) and a commit list naming no shadowed state
  mem.write32(FX + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(FX + 12, FX_HANDLES); mem.write32(FX_HANDLES + FX_OWNER, FX);
  mem.write32(FX_LIST, W.dev.shadow); mem.write32(FX_LIST + 4, 0); mem.write32(FX + COMMIT_LIST, FX_LIST);
  void COMMIT_LIST_WORDS;
  const code = [];
  for (const [m, args] of calls) { for (let i = args.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) code.push(...push(args[i])); code.push(...callSlot(m)); }
  code.push(0xf4);
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code));
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = STACK; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  const st = { commits: 0, draws: [] };
  const drain = () => {
    const nb = mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE);
    mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE, 0); mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE + 4, 0); mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE + 8, 0);
    for (let p = DEFER_QUEUE + 16, end = p + nb; p < end;) {
      const idx = mem.read32(p), argc = mem.read32(p + 4), spec = mem.read32(DEFER_SPEC + 4 * idx), words = spec & DEFER_RAW ? mem.read32(p + 24) >>> 2 : (spec >>> 8) & DEFER_WORDS;
      call(W, api9, names[idx], Array.from({ length: argc }, (_, i) => mem.read32(p + 8 + 4 * i)), st);
      p += 4 * (2 + argc + words);
    }
  };
  const dropped0 = mem.read32(FAST_STATS);
  let r, x = seed * 7919;
  const rnd = () => (x = (Math.imul(x, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0) >>> 24;
  for (let k = 0; k < 100000; k++) {
    // (switching: short time slices — the measurement switch, dbg:ORTHROS_DRAW_OPT_OFF, arrives between slices, calls
    // queued or not; and now and then at a call left to JavaScript, before its queue runs)
    r = jit.run({ maxInsns: switching ? 1 + rnd() : 1e7 });
    if (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE) { if (rnd() < 32) jit.setDrawOpt(!!jit.drawOptOff); continue; }
    if (r !== EXIT.THUNK) break;
    if (switching && rnd() < 32) jit.setDrawOpt(!!jit.drawOptOff);
    drain();
    if (jit.drawOptPending) { jit.drawOptPending = false; jit.setFxSpecs(true); } // (as Vm.drainDeferred)
    const idx = cpu.exitArg, argc = methods[idx][1] + 1, args = Array.from({ length: argc }, (_, i) => mem.read32(cpu.esp + 4 + 4 * i));
    const eax = call(W, api9, names[idx], args, st) ?? 0;
    cpu.eip = mem.read32(cpu.esp); cpu.esp += 4 + 4 * argc; cpu.eax = eax >>> 0;
  }
  assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(cpu.esp, STACK, 'stdcall returns');
  drain();
  st.draws.push(stateOf(W.dev));
  return { draws: st.draws, dropped: mem.read32(FAST_STATS) - dropped0 };
}

for (const api9 of [true, false]) {
  test(`lights / material / FVF filter (Direct3D ${api9 ? 9 : 8}): the devices agree at every draw with the reference that executes every call`, () => {
    let dropped = 0;
    for (let seed = 1; seed <= 30; seed++) {
      const ref = runReference(seed, 300, api9);
      const jit = runJitted(seed, 300, api9);
      assert.equal(jit.draws.length, ref.draws.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < ref.draws.length; i++) assert.equal(jit.draws[i], ref.draws[i], `seed ${seed}, draw ${i}`);
      dropped += jit.dropped;
    }
    assert.ok(dropped > 1000, `the filter drops the redundant calls (${dropped})`);
  });
  test(`lights / material / FVF filter (Direct3D ${api9 ? 9 : 8}): the same with the measurement switch (queued draws and this filter off / on) flipped at random points`, () => {
    for (let seed = 101; seed <= 115; seed++) {
      const ref = runReference(seed, 300, api9);
      const jit = runJitted(seed, 300, api9, true);
      assert.equal(jit.draws.length, ref.draws.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < ref.draws.length; i++) assert.equal(jit.draws[i], ref.draws[i], `seed ${seed}, draw ${i}`);
    }
  });
}

test('lights filter: a light set again with its own words, and its switch, never reach JavaScript', () => {
  const W = d3dWorld(true), { mem } = W, data = writeData(mem);
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE); cpu.reset();
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true }); jit.cpu = cpu;
  const methods = methodsOf(true); methods.forEach(([k], i) => { jit.markFast(i, k, true); mem.write32(SLOTS + 4 * i, THUNK_BASE + i * THUNK_SIZE); });
  const M = Object.fromEntries(methods.map(([k], i) => [k.split('::')[1], i]));
  const names = methods.map(([k]) => k.split('::')[1]);
  const runCode = (emitAll) => {
    const code = [];
    const emit = (m, args) => { for (let i = args.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) code.push(...push(args[i])); code.push(...callSlot(m)); };
    emitAll(emit); code.push(0xf4);
    mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code)); jit.invalidate?.(CODE, code.length);
    cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = STACK; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
    assert.equal(jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e7 }), EXIT.HALT);
  };
  const drain = () => { // (the queued calls run on the device, as Vm.drainDeferred does)
    const nb = mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE); mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE, 0); mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE + 8, 0);
    for (let p = DEFER_QUEUE + 16, end = p + nb; p < end;) {
      const idx = mem.read32(p), argc = mem.read32(p + 4), words = (mem.read32(DEFER_SPEC + 4 * idx) >>> 8) & DEFER_WORDS;
      W.dev[names[idx]](W.ctx(Array.from({ length: argc }, (_, i) => mem.read32(p + 8 + 4 * i))));
      p += 4 * (2 + argc + words);
    }
  };
  // JavaScript sets light 1, enables it and sets the material
  W.dev.SetLight(W.ctx([W.devPtr, 1, data.lights[0]])); W.dev.LightEnable(W.ctx([W.devPtr, 1, 1])); W.dev.SetMaterial(W.ctx([W.devPtr, data.mats[0]]));
  W.dev.SetRenderState(W.ctx([W.devPtr, 7, 1]));
  // the program sets them again with -0 where they hold +0 (queued: the handlers find nothing changed and write the
  // shadow entries back), then repeats the calls with their own words 50 times, a transform (a queued structure) and
  // a redundant render state between them
  const d0 = mem.read32(FAST_STATS), v0 = W.dev.lightVersion;
  runCode((emit) => { emit(M.SetLight, [W.devPtr, 1, data.lights[2]]); emit(M.SetMaterial, [W.devPtr, data.mats[2]]); });
  assert.equal(mem.read32(FAST_STATS) - d0, 0, '-0 for +0: queued');
  drain();
  assert.equal(W.dev.lightVersion, v0, 'nothing changed');
  runCode((emit) => { for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) { emit(M.SetTransform, [W.devPtr, 256, data.xf]); emit(M.SetLight, [W.devPtr, 1, data.lights[1]]); emit(M.LightEnable, [W.devPtr, 1, 1]); emit(M.SetMaterial, [W.devPtr, data.mats[1]]); emit(M.SetRenderState, [W.devPtr, 7, 1]); } });
  assert.equal(mem.read32(FAST_STATS) - d0, 200, 'every light, switch, material and render state set dropped');
  assert.equal(mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE), 50 * 4 * (2 + 3 + 16), 'only the transforms queued');
});

for (const api9 of [true, false]) {
  test(`queued draws (Direct3D ${api9 ? 9 : 8}): run in order with the state of their call, before the next call handled in JavaScript`, () => {
    const seen = [];
    const gfx = { createDevice: (dev) => ({
      drawPrimitive: (type, start, count) => seen.push(['draw', type, start, count, dev.rs.get(7), dev.fvf ?? dev.vertexShader]),
      drawIndexedPrimitive: (type, minIdx, numV, start, count, base) => seen.push(['drawIndexed', type, minIdx, numV, start, count, base ?? null, dev.rs.get(7), dev.fvf ?? dev.vertexShader]),
    }) };
    const W = d3dWorld(api9, gfx), { mem } = W;
    const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE); cpu.reset();
    const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true }); jit.cpu = cpu;
    const I = `com.dll!IDirect3DDevice${api9 ? 9 : 8}::`;
    const methods = [[I + 'SetRenderState', 2], [I + 'DrawPrimitive', 3], [I + 'DrawIndexedPrimitive', api9 ? 6 : 5], [I + 'TestCooperativeLevel', 0], [I + (api9 ? 'SetFVF' : 'SetVertexShader'), 1]];
    methods.forEach(([k], i) => { jit.markFast(i, k, true); mem.write32(SLOTS + 4 * i, THUNK_BASE + i * THUNK_SIZE); });
    const code = [];
    const emit = (m, args) => { for (let i = args.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) code.push(...push(args[i])); code.push(...callSlot(m)); code.push(0xa3, ...le(0x10007000 + 4 * (code.length & 0xff))); }; // (EAX stored after each call)
    emit(0, [W.devPtr, 7, 1]); emit(4, [W.devPtr, 0x142]); emit(1, [W.devPtr, 4, 3, 2]);
    emit(0, [W.devPtr, 7, 0]); emit(4, [W.devPtr, 0x152]);
    emit(2, api9 ? [W.devPtr, 4, -5, 1, 30, 6, 10] : [W.devPtr, 4, 1, 30, 6, 10]);
    emit(3, [W.devPtr]);
    code.push(0xf4);
    mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code));
    cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = STACK; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF; cpu.eax = 0x12345678;
    const r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 });
    assert.equal(r, EXIT.THUNK, 'the first call left to JavaScript');
    assert.equal(cpu.exitArg, 3, 'TestCooperativeLevel: the draws were queued');
    assert.deepEqual(seen, [], 'nothing drawn yet');
    // (Vm.dispatchThunkBody: the queue runs before the call)
    const names = methods.map(([k]) => k.split('::')[1]);
    const nb = mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE); mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE, 0);
    for (let p = DEFER_QUEUE + 16, end = p + nb; p < end;) {
      const idx = mem.read32(p), argc = mem.read32(p + 4), words = (mem.read32(DEFER_SPEC + 4 * idx) >>> 8) & DEFER_WORDS;
      W.dev[names[idx]](W.ctx(Array.from({ length: argc }, (_, i) => mem.read32(p + 8 + 4 * i))));
      p += 4 * (2 + argc + words);
    }
    assert.deepEqual(seen, [['draw', 4, 3, 2, 1, 0x142], api9 ? ['drawIndexed', 4, 1, 30, 6, 10, -5, 0, 0x152] : ['drawIndexed', 4, 1, 30, 6, 10, null, 0, 0x152]]);
    assert.equal(W.dev.draws, 2);
    assert.equal(cpu.esp, STACK - 4 - 4 * 1, 'the queued calls returned (stdcall): only the pending call\'s argument and return address on the stack');
  });
}

```

`tests/jit-defer-filter.test.js`:

```js
// Issued-state filter of the deferred Direct3D state setters (runtime.js DEFER_F_*) and the COM AddRef/Release fast
// path (FID_ADDREF/FID_RELEASE). The filter drops a set whose value the device's shadow entry holds — the state as of
// every call issued so far, queued ones included — so it must never change what the device ends up with nor the
// sequence of state changes its handlers see: randomized call sequences (repeated values, out-of-range keys, state
// block recording, effect passes that change states behind the shadow's back, drains at random points) are run
// through the JIT and through a reference that executes every call in order.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory, THUNK_BASE } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { DEFER_QUEUE, DEFER_SPEC, DEFER_WORDS, REFS_ANY, SHADOW_BYTES, SHADOW_RS, SHADOW_TSS, SHADOW_SAMP, SHADOW_TEX, SHADOW_STREAM, SHADOW_IB, COM_MARKER, COM_REFS, FAST_STATS, COMMIT_LIST, FX_OWNER, SHADOW_OWNER } from '../src/cpu/jit/runtime.js';
import { StateTable } from '../src/win32/state-table.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, SLOTS = 0x10000100, DEV = 0x10004000, FX = 0x10004100, SB = 0x10005000, TEX = 0x10004200, STACK = 0x10090000, THUNK_SIZE = 16;
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
const push = (v) => [0x68, ...le(v)];
const callSlot = (i) => [0xff, 0x15, ...le(SLOTS + 4 * i)];
const METHODS = [
  ['com.dll!IDirect3DDevice9::SetRenderState', 2], ['com.dll!IDirect3DDevice9::SetTextureStageState', 3], ['com.dll!IDirect3DDevice9::SetSamplerState', 3],
  ['com.dll!ID3DXEffect::CommitChanges', 0], ['com.dll!IDirect3DDevice9::BeginStateBlock', 0], ['com.dll!IDirect3DDevice9::EndStateBlock', 0],
  ['com.dll!IDirect3DDevice9::BeginScene', 0], ['com.dll!IDirect3DTexture9::AddRef', 0], ['com.dll!IDirect3DTexture9::Release', 0], ['com.dll!IDirect3DDevice9::SetTexture', 2],
  ['com.dll!IDirect3DDevice9::SetStreamSource', 4], ['com.dll!IDirect3DDevice9::SetIndices', 1],
];
const M = Object.fromEntries(METHODS.map(([k], i) => [k.split('::')[1] + (k.includes('Texture9::') ? '9' : ''), i]));

/** A device model: the handlers' semantics for these calls (redundant sets change nothing; recording only records). */
class Model {
  constructor(shadow) {
    this.rs = new StateTable(256, [[7, 1], [20, 5]]);
    this.tss = Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => new StateTable(40, [[1, 4]]));
    this.samp = Array.from({ length: 20 }, () => new StateTable(16, [[5, 2]]));
    this.recording = false; this.recorded = 0; this.commits = 0; this.log = [];
    this.textures = new Array(20).fill(0); this.streams = Array.from({ length: 16 }, () => [0, 0, 0]); this.ib = 0; // (the bindings, as d3d8.js / d3d9.js keep them)
    this.shadow = shadow;
    if (shadow) { for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) this.shadowSet(SHADOW_TEX + i, 0); for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) this.shadowSet(SHADOW_STREAM + i, 0); this.shadowSet(SHADOW_IB, 0); }
    if (shadow) {
      const { u32 } = shadow, e = (i) => SB + 16 + 8 * i;
      this.rs.attachShadow(u32, e(SHADOW_RS), 256);
      this.tss.forEach((t, i) => t.attachShadow(u32, e(SHADOW_TSS + 40 * i), 40));
      this.samp.slice(0, 16).forEach((t, i) => t.attachShadow(u32, e(SHADOW_SAMP + 16 * i), 16));
    }
  }
  shadowSet(i, v) { if (!this.shadow) return; const a = SB + 16 + 8 * i; this.shadow.mem.write32(a, 1); this.shadow.mem.write32(a + 4, v); }
  /** SetTexture (Device8.bindTexture): recorded while a state block records; a binding changed is logged */
  bind(st, t) {
    if (this.recording) { this.recorded++; return; }
    if (st >= 20) return;
    if (this.textures[st] !== t) { this.textures[st] = t; this.log.push(`tex${st}=${t}`); }
    if (st < 16) this.shadowSet(SHADOW_TEX + st, t);
  }
  set(table, key, v, what) {
    if (this.recording) { this.recorded++; return; }
    if (!table) return; // (an invalid stage: D3DERR_INVALIDCALL)
    if (table.get(key) === v) return;
    table.set(key, v); this.log.push(`${what}=${v}`);
  }
  call(m, a) {
    switch (m) {
      case M.SetRenderState: return this.set(this.rs, a[1], a[2], `rs${a[1]}`);
      case M.SetTextureStageState: return this.set(this.tss[a[1]], a[2], a[3], `tss${a[1]}.${a[2]}`);
      case M.SetSamplerState: return this.set(this.samp[a[1]], a[2], a[3], `samp${a[1]}.${a[2]}`);
      case M.CommitChanges: { const n = ++this.commits; this.set(this.rs, 7, n % 3, 'rs7'); this.set(this.tss[0], 1, n % 2, 'tss0.1'); this.set(this.samp[2], 5, n % 4, 'samp2.5'); this.bind(3, 0x5000 + n % 2); return; }
      case M.SetTexture: return this.bind(a[1], a[2]);
      case M.SetStreamSource: { // (Direct3D 9: applied even while a state block records)
        if (a[1] >= 16) return;
        const s = this.streams[a[1]];
        if (s[0] !== a[2] || s[1] !== a[3] || s[2] !== a[4]) { s[0] = a[2]; s[1] = a[3]; s[2] = a[4]; this.log.push(`stream${a[1]}=${s}`); }
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.shadowSet(SHADOW_STREAM + 3 * a[1] + i, s[i]);
        return;
      }
      case M.SetIndices: if (this.ib !== a[1]) { this.ib = a[1]; this.log.push(`ib=${a[1]}`); } this.shadowSet(SHADOW_IB, a[1]); return;
      case M.BeginStateBlock: this.recording = true; if (this.shadow) this.shadow.mem.write32(SB, 0); return;
      case M.EndStateBlock: this.recording = false; if (this.shadow) this.shadow.mem.write32(SB, 1); return;
      case M.BeginScene: this.log.push('draw'); return;
    }
  }
  state() { return JSON.stringify([[...this.rs], this.tss.map((t) => [...t]), this.samp.map((t) => [...t]), this.textures, this.streams, this.ib]); }
}

function randomProgram(seed, n) {
  let x = seed >>> 0;
  const rnd = (k) => { x = (Math.imul(x, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return (x >>> 8) % k; };
  const calls = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const r = rnd(100);
    // few keys and values: many sets repeat the current value; a few keys out of the shadow's range
    if (r < 40) calls.push([M.SetRenderState, [DEV, rnd(10) === 0 ? 256 + rnd(4) : [7, 20, 27, 137][rnd(4)], rnd(3)]]);
    else if (r < 65) calls.push([M.SetTextureStageState, [DEV, rnd(12) === 0 ? 8 : rnd(3), rnd(12) === 0 ? 40 : [1, 2, 33][rnd(3)], rnd(3)]]);
    else if (r < 88) calls.push([M.SetSamplerState, [DEV, rnd(12) === 0 ? 16 + rnd(3) : rnd(4), rnd(12) === 0 ? 16 : [5, 6][rnd(2)], rnd(4)]]);
    else if (r < 93) calls.push([M.CommitChanges, [FX]]);
    else if (r < 94) calls.push([M.SetTexture, [DEV, rnd(10) === 0 ? 16 + rnd(4) : rnd(4), [0, 0x5000, 0x5001][rnd(3)]]]);
    else if (r < 95) calls.push([M.SetStreamSource, [DEV, rnd(10) === 0 ? 16 : rnd(2), [0, 0x6000][rnd(2)], [0, 32][rnd(2)], [24, 32][rnd(2)]]]);
    else if (r < 96) calls.push([M.SetIndices, [DEV, [0, 0x7000, 0x7100][rnd(3)]]]);
    else if (r < 97) calls.push([M.BeginScene, [DEV]]);
    else if (r < 98) calls.push([M.BeginStateBlock, [DEV]]), calls.push(...Array.from({ length: 1 + rnd(4) }, () => [M.SetRenderState, [DEV, [7, 20][rnd(2)], rnd(3)]]), [M.EndStateBlock, [DEV]]);
    else calls.push([M.BeginScene, [DEV]]);
  }
  return calls;
}

function setup() {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true });
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  METHODS.forEach(([k], i) => { jit.markFast(i, k, true); mem.write32(SLOTS + 4 * i, THUNK_BASE + i * THUNK_SIZE); });
  return { mem, cpu, jit };
}

/** Run guest code made of `calls` through the JIT; calls left to JavaScript drain the queue first, as Vm.dispatchThunk does. */
function runJit(env, calls, model, onThunk) {
  const { mem, cpu, jit } = env;
  const code = [];
  for (const [m, args] of calls) { for (let i = args.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) code.push(...push(args[i])); code.push(...callSlot(m)); }
  code.push(0xf4);
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code));
  jit.invalidate?.(CODE, code.length);
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = STACK; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  const drain = () => {
    const n = mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE);
    mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE, 0); mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE + 4, 0); mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE + 8, 0);
    for (let p = DEFER_QUEUE + 16, end = p + n; p < end;) {
      const idx = mem.read32(p), argc = mem.read32(p + 4), words = (mem.read32(DEFER_SPEC + 4 * idx) >>> 8) & DEFER_WORDS;
      model.call(idx, Array.from({ length: argc }, (_, i) => mem.read32(p + 8 + 4 * i)));
      p += 4 * (2 + argc + words);
    }
  };
  let r, toJs = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < 100000; k++) {
    r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e7 });
    if (r !== EXIT.THUNK) break;
    toJs++;
    drain();
    const idx = cpu.exitArg, argc = METHODS[idx][1] + 1, args = Array.from({ length: argc }, (_, i) => mem.read32(cpu.esp + 4 + 4 * i));
    const eax = onThunk ? onThunk(idx, args) : (model.call(idx, args), 0);
    cpu.eip = mem.read32(cpu.esp); cpu.esp += 4 + 4 * argc; cpu.eax = eax >>> 0;
  }
  assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(cpu.esp, STACK, 'stdcall returns');
  drain();
  return toJs;
}

test('issued-state filter: randomized call sequences end in the same state with the same changes as executing every call', () => {
  let dropped = 0;
  for (let seed = 1; seed <= 40; seed++) {
    const env = setup(), { mem } = env;
    mem.write32(DEV + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(DEV + 12, SB); mem.write32(FX + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(FX + 12, 0x10006000); mem.write32(0x10006000 + FX_OWNER, FX);
    mem.fill(SB, SHADOW_BYTES, 0); mem.write32(SB, 1); mem.write32(SB + SHADOW_OWNER, DEV);
    // odd seeds: the effect lists the states its CommitChanges sets (forgotten when it is queued); even: no list (the
    // filter waits for the queue to run)
    if (seed % 2) { const L = 0x10007800, e = [SHADOW_RS + 7, SHADOW_TSS + 1, SHADOW_SAMP + 16 * 2 + 5, SHADOW_TEX + 3]; mem.write32(L, SB); mem.write32(L + 4, e.length); e.forEach((x, i) => mem.write32(L + 8 + 4 * i, x)); mem.write32(FX + COMMIT_LIST, L); }
    const calls = randomProgram(seed, 400);
    const ref = new Model(null);
    for (const [m, a] of calls) ref.call(m, a);
    const dev = new Model({ u32: mem.u32, mem });
    const dropped0 = mem.read32(FAST_STATS);
    // (draws and state block calls go to JavaScript: the queue runs at random points of the sequence)
    runJit(env, calls, dev);
    assert.equal(dev.state(), ref.state(), `seed ${seed}: final state`);
    assert.deepEqual(dev.log, ref.log, `seed ${seed}: state changes in order`);
    assert.equal(dev.recorded, ref.recorded, `seed ${seed}: sets recorded by state blocks`);
    dropped += mem.read32(FAST_STATS) - dropped0;
  }
});

test('issued-state filter: a device without a shadow block, or another object, queues every set', () => {
  const env = setup(), { mem } = env;
  mem.write32(DEV + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(DEV + 12, 0);
  const dev = new Model(null);
  const calls = Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => [M.SetRenderState, [DEV, 7, 1]]);
  const before = mem.read32(FAST_STATS);
  runJit(env, calls, dev);
  assert.equal(mem.read32(FAST_STATS), before, 'nothing dropped');
});

test('issued-state filter: a block that does not name the object (a released device\'s pointer, its memory now another object\'s) is not trusted', () => {
  // (the block at +12 holds the values the calls set, enabled: only SHADOW_OWNER differs)
  for (const owner of [DEV, FX]) {
    const env = setup(), { mem } = env;
    mem.write32(DEV + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(DEV + 12, SB); mem.fill(SB, SHADOW_BYTES, 0); mem.write32(SB, 1); mem.write32(SB + SHADOW_OWNER, owner);
    mem.write32(SB + 16 + 8 * (SHADOW_RS + 7), 1); mem.write32(SB + 16 + 8 * (SHADOW_RS + 7) + 4, 1);
    const before = mem.read32(FAST_STATS), snap = Array.from(mem.bytes(SB, SHADOW_BYTES));
    runJit(env, Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => [M.SetRenderState, [DEV, 7, 2]]), new Model(null));
    if (owner === DEV) { assert.equal(mem.read32(FAST_STATS) - before, 5, 'its own block: the repeated sets dropped'); continue; }
    assert.equal(mem.read32(FAST_STATS), before, 'nothing dropped');
    assert.deepEqual(Array.from(mem.bytes(SB, SHADOW_BYTES)), snap, 'the block untouched');
  }
});

test('COM AddRef/Release: counted in guest memory by the fast path; the last Release and pending reference changes go to JavaScript', () => {
  const env = setup(), { mem, cpu } = env;
  mem.write32(TEX + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(TEX + COM_REFS, 1);
  const results = [];
  const calls = [[M.AddRef9, [TEX]], [M.AddRef9, [TEX]], [M.Release9, [TEX]], [M.Release9, [TEX]], [M.Release9, [TEX]]];
  // record each result: the program stores EAX after every call
  const code = [];
  calls.forEach(([m, a], i) => { code.push(...push(a[0]), ...callSlot(m), 0xa3, ...le(0x10007000 + 4 * i)); });
  code.push(0xf4);
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code));
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = STACK; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  const toJs = [];
  for (;;) {
    const r = env.jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 });
    if (r !== EXIT.THUNK) { assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT); break; }
    toJs.push(cpu.exitArg);
    const n = mem.read32(TEX + COM_REFS) - 1; mem.write32(TEX + COM_REFS, n); if (!n) mem.write32(TEX + 4, 0); // (JavaScript: the last reference)
    cpu.eip = mem.read32(cpu.esp); cpu.esp += 8; cpu.eax = n;
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < calls.length; i++) results.push(mem.read32(0x10007000 + 4 * i));
  assert.deepEqual(results, [2, 3, 2, 1, 0]);
  assert.deepEqual(toJs, [M.Release9], 'only the last Release left the JIT');

  // a queued SetTexture may take a reference: AddRef waits for JavaScript (which runs the queue first)
  mem.write32(TEX + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(TEX + COM_REFS, 1);
  const code2 = [...push(TEX), ...push(0), ...push(DEV), ...callSlot(M.SetTexture), ...push(TEX), ...callSlot(M.AddRef9), 0xf4];
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code2));
  env.jit.invalidate?.(CODE, code2.length);
  mem.write32(DEV + 4, COM_MARKER);
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = STACK;
  const r = env.jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 });
  assert.equal(r, EXIT.THUNK);
  assert.equal(cpu.exitArg, M.AddRef9, 'AddRef with a SetTexture queued goes to JavaScript');
  assert.equal(mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE + 4), REFS_ANY, 'a device without its shadow block: anyone\'s count may change');
});

test('COM AddRef/Release with Direct3D 9 bindings queued: on the fast path with the counts the queue will leave; results, final counts and no count reaching 0 early, as executing every call', () => {
  const OBJS = [0x10004400, 0x10004440, 0x10004480, 0x100044c0, 0x10004500]; // (textures, a vertex buffer, an index buffer: COM objects)
  for (let seed = 1; seed <= 40; seed++) {
    const env = setup(), { mem, cpu } = env;
    mem.write32(DEV + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(DEV + 12, SB); mem.fill(SB, SHADOW_BYTES, 0); mem.write32(SB, 1); mem.write32(SB + SHADOW_OWNER, DEV);
    for (const o of OBJS) { mem.write32(o + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(o + COM_REFS, 3); }
    // the device as d3d9.js keeps it (bindings take and drop references; the shadow follows), and its reference twin
    const world = (refsOf, setRefs, shadow) => {
      const tex = new Array(16).fill(0), streams = Array.from({ length: 16 }, () => [0, 0, 0]); let ib = 0, commits = 0;
      const sh = (i, v) => { if (shadow) { mem.write32(SB + 16 + 8 * i, 1); mem.write32(SB + 16 + 8 * i + 4, v); } };
      if (shadow) { for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) sh(SHADOW_TEX + i, 0); for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) sh(SHADOW_STREAM + i, 0); sh(SHADOW_IB, 0); }
      const swap = (old, nu) => { if (old === nu) return; if (nu) setRefs(nu, refsOf(nu) + 1); if (old) setRefs(old, refsOf(old) - 1); };
      return {
        bound: () => ({ tex, streams, ib, commits }),
        call(m, a) {
          if (m === M.SetTexture) { if (a[1] >= 16) return; swap(tex[a[1]], a[2]); tex[a[1]] = a[2]; sh(SHADOW_TEX + a[1], a[2]); }
          else if (m === M.SetStreamSource) { if (a[1] >= 16) return; const s = streams[a[1]]; swap(s[0], a[2]); s[0] = a[2]; s[1] = a[3]; s[2] = a[4]; for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) sh(SHADOW_STREAM + 3 * a[1] + i, s[i]); }
          else if (m === M.SetIndices) { swap(ib, a[1]); ib = a[1]; sh(SHADOW_IB, a[1]); }
          else if (m === M.AddRef9) { const n = refsOf(a[0]) + 1; setRefs(a[0], n); return n; }
          else if (m === M.Release9) { const n = refsOf(a[0]) - 1; setRefs(a[0], n); return n; }
          else if (m === M.BeginScene) { // (as an effect commit: textures bound behind the shadow's back, its entries forgotten — their values stale)
            commits++;
            for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { const t = OBJS[(i + commits) % 3]; swap(tex[i], t); tex[i] = t; if (shadow) mem.write32(SB + 16 + 8 * (SHADOW_TEX + i), 0); }
          }
          return 0;
        },
      };
    };
    const refRefs = new Map(OBJS.map((o) => [o, 3]));
    const ref = world((o) => refRefs.get(o), (o, n) => refRefs.set(o, n), false);
    // (in program order no count reaches 0 — the program never releases a last reference —, so a count reaching 0 in the
    // queued world is an object destroyed while still referenced: a fast-path Release made before queued releases)
    let lowest = Infinity;
    const dev = world((o) => mem.read32(o + COM_REFS) | 0, (o, n) => { lowest = Math.min(lowest, n); mem.write32(o + COM_REFS, n); }, true);
    let x = seed;
    const rnd = (k) => { x = (Math.imul(x, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return (x >>> 8) % k; };
    const calls = [], want = [];
    const keeps = (old, nu) => !old || old === nu || refRefs.get(old) >= 2; // (a binding replaced never drops a last reference)
    for (let i = 0; calls.length < 300; i++) {
      const r = rnd(100), o = OBJS[rnd(OBJS.length)], b = ref.bound();
      let call;
      if (r < 25) { const st = rnd(3), t = [0, OBJS[0], OBJS[1], OBJS[2]][rnd(4)]; if (keeps(b.tex[st], t)) call = [M.SetTexture, [DEV, st, t]]; }
      else if (r < 35) { const n = rnd(2), vb = [0, OBJS[3]][rnd(2)]; if (keeps(b.streams[n][0], vb)) call = [M.SetStreamSource, [DEV, n, vb, 0, 32]]; }
      else if (r < 42) { const x = [0, OBJS[4]][rnd(2)]; if (keeps(b.ib, x)) call = [M.SetIndices, [DEV, x]]; }
      else if (r < 66) call = [M.AddRef9, [o]];
      else if (r < 97) { if (refRefs.get(o) >= 2) call = [M.Release9, [o]]; } // (counts kept low: releases as often as the program can)
      else { // (handled in JavaScript: the queue runs; then textures bound behind the shadow — no last reference dropped on the way)
        const n = new Map(refRefs);
        const ok = [0, 1, 2].every((st) => { const old = b.tex[st], nu = OBJS[(st + b.commits + 1) % 3]; if (old === nu) return true; n.set(nu, n.get(nu) + 1); if (!old) return true; n.set(old, n.get(old) - 1); return n.get(old) >= 1; });
        if (ok) call = [M.BeginScene, [DEV]];
      }
      if (!call) continue;
      const res = ref.call(call[0], call[1]);
      if (call[0] === M.AddRef9 || call[0] === M.Release9) want.push([calls.length, res]);
      calls.push(call);
    }
    // (the program stores EAX after every AddRef / Release)
    const code = [];
    calls.forEach(([m, a], i) => { for (let k = a.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) code.push(...push(a[k])); code.push(...callSlot(m)); if (m === M.AddRef9 || m === M.Release9) code.push(0xa3, ...le(0x10008000 + 4 * i)); });
    code.push(0xf4);
    mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code)); env.jit.invalidate?.(CODE, code.length);
    cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = STACK; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
    const drain = () => {
      const nb = mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE); mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE, 0); mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE + 4, 0); mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE + 8, 0);
      for (let p = DEFER_QUEUE + 16, end = p + nb; p < end;) { const idx = mem.read32(p), argc = mem.read32(p + 4); dev.call(idx, Array.from({ length: argc }, (_, i) => mem.read32(p + 8 + 4 * i))); p += 4 * (2 + argc); }
    };
    let fastRefs = 0, jsRefs = 0;
    for (;;) {
      const r = env.jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e7 });
      if (r !== EXIT.THUNK) { assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT); break; }
      drain();
      const idx = cpu.exitArg, argc = METHODS[idx][1] + 1, args = Array.from({ length: argc }, (_, i) => mem.read32(cpu.esp + 4 + 4 * i));
      if (idx === M.AddRef9 || idx === M.Release9) jsRefs++;
      const eax = dev.call(idx, args) ?? 0;
      cpu.eip = mem.read32(cpu.esp); cpu.esp += 4 + 4 * argc; cpu.eax = eax >>> 0;
    }
    drain();
    for (const [i, r] of want) assert.equal(mem.read32(0x10008000 + 4 * i) | 0, r, `seed ${seed}: call ${i} returns`);
    for (const o of OBJS) assert.equal(mem.read32(o + COM_REFS) | 0, refRefs.get(o), `seed ${seed}: count of ${o.toString(16)}`);
    assert.ok(lowest >= 1, `seed ${seed}: a count reached ${lowest} while references remained`);
    fastRefs += want.length - jsRefs;
    assert.ok(fastRefs > 0);
  }
});

test('issued-state filter: an effect commit list that misses a state it sets is caught by the randomized comparison', () => {
  // (the test's sensitivity: CommitChanges sets samp2.5, the list forgets only rs7 and tss0.1)
  let mismatches = 0;
  for (let seed = 1; seed <= 20; seed++) {
    const env = setup(), { mem } = env;
    mem.write32(DEV + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(DEV + 12, SB); mem.write32(FX + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(FX + 12, 0x10006000); mem.write32(0x10006000 + FX_OWNER, FX);
    mem.fill(SB, SHADOW_BYTES, 0); mem.write32(SB, 1); mem.write32(SB + SHADOW_OWNER, DEV);
    const L = 0x10007800, e = [SHADOW_RS + 7, SHADOW_TSS + 1]; mem.write32(L, SB); mem.write32(L + 4, e.length); e.forEach((x, i) => mem.write32(L + 8 + 4 * i, x)); mem.write32(FX + COMMIT_LIST, L);
    const calls = randomProgram(seed, 400);
    const ref = new Model(null); for (const [m, a] of calls) ref.call(m, a);
    const dev = new Model({ u32: mem.u32, mem });
    runJit(env, calls, dev);
    if (dev.state() !== ref.state() || JSON.stringify(dev.log) !== JSON.stringify(ref.log)) mismatches++;
  }
  assert.ok(mismatches > 0, 'an incomplete list makes the filter drop sets it must not');
});

test('measurement switch: AddRef/Release back to JavaScript and the filter off, then on once the queue is empty', async () => {
  const env = setup(), { mem, cpu } = env;
  mem.write32(TEX + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(TEX + COM_REFS, 1);
  const runAddRef = () => {
    const code = [...push(TEX), ...callSlot(M.AddRef9), 0xf4];
    mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code)); env.jit.invalidate?.(CODE, code.length);
    cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = STACK; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
    return env.jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 });
  };
  env.jit.setRefFast(false);
  assert.equal(runAddRef(), EXIT.THUNK, 'switched off: AddRef handled in JavaScript');
  env.jit.setRefFast(true);
  assert.equal(runAddRef(), EXIT.HALT, 'switched on: the fast path again');
  assert.equal(mem.read32(TEX + COM_REFS), 2);

  // Vm.setApiFastPaths: the devices' filter flag follows; switched on while calls are queued, it waits for the drain
  const { Vm } = await import('../src/core/vm.js');
  const flags = [];
  const fakeVm = { jit: env.jit, mem, d3dDevices: new Set([{ shadowOn() { flags.push(fakeVm.stateFilterOff ? 0 : 1); } }]) };
  Vm.prototype.setApiFastPaths.call(fakeVm, false);
  assert.deepEqual(flags, [0]);
  mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE, 8);
  Vm.prototype.setApiFastPaths.call(fakeVm, true);
  assert.deepEqual(flags, [0], 'not while the queue holds calls');
  assert.equal(fakeVm.shadowResync, true);
  mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE, 0);
  Vm.prototype.setApiFastPaths.call(fakeVm, true);
  assert.deepEqual(flags, [0, 1]);
});
```

`tests/jit-defer-handle.test.js`:

```js
// Deferred COM calls given a handle (runtime.js DEFER_HANDLE — the D3DX effect parameter setters): queued by the
// dispatcher's fast path only when the handle lies in the handle block the object keeps at +12; a parameter name
// (a string the game may overwrite before the queue runs) or any other value goes to JavaScript at once. The queued
// record holds the arguments and a copy of the vector taken at the call.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory, THUNK_BASE } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { DEFER_QUEUE, DEFER_HANDLE_BYTES, COM_MARKER, FX_OWNER } from '../src/cpu/jit/runtime.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, SLOT = 0x10000100, OBJ = 0x10004000, HB = 0x10005000, VEC = 0x10006000, NAME = 0x10002000, IDX = 5, THUNK_SIZE = 16;
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
const push = (v) => [0x68, ...le(v)];
const setVector = (h) => [...push(VEC), ...push(h), ...push(OBJ), 0xff, 0x15, ...le(SLOT)]; // effect->SetVector(h, &vec)

test('effect setters: queued with a handle of the object, left to JavaScript with a name or a foreign value', () => {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from([...setVector(HB + 8), ...setVector(NAME), ...setVector(HB + DEFER_HANDLE_BYTES), ...setVector(HB + DEFER_HANDLE_BYTES - 4), 0xf4]));
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true });
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  jit.markFast(IDX, 'com.dll!ID3DXEffect::SetVector', true);
  mem.write32(SLOT, THUNK_BASE + IDX * THUNK_SIZE);
  mem.write32(OBJ + 12, HB); mem.write32(OBJ + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(HB + FX_OWNER, OBJ); // (a live effect: its block names it)
  [1.5, -2, 3.25, 4].forEach((v, i) => mem.writeF32(VEC + 4 * i, v));
  mem.writeCString(NAME, 'g_color');
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = 0x10009000; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  const toJs = [];
  let r;
  for (let n = 0; n < 100; n++) {
    r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 });
    if (r !== EXIT.THUNK) break;
    toJs.push(mem.read32(cpu.esp + 8)); // (the handle; the JavaScript handler's part: stdcall return)
    cpu.eip = mem.read32(cpu.esp); cpu.esp += 16; cpu.eax = 0;
  }
  assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT);
  assert.deepEqual(toJs, [NAME, HB + DEFER_HANDLE_BYTES], 'a name and a value past the block leave');
  assert.equal(cpu.esp, 0x10009000, 'stdcall returns');
  const bytes = mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE), rec = (k) => DEFER_QUEUE + 16 + k * 36;
  assert.equal(bytes, 2 * 36, 'two records: thunk, argc, 3 arguments, the vector');
  for (const [k, h] of [[0, HB + 8], [1, HB + DEFER_HANDLE_BYTES - 4]]) {
    const p = rec(k);
    assert.deepEqual([mem.read32(p), mem.read32(p + 4), mem.read32(p + 8), mem.read32(p + 12), mem.read32(p + 16)], [IDX, 3, OBJ, h, p + 20]);
    assert.deepEqual([0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => mem.readF32(p + 20 + 4 * i)), [1.5, -2, 3.25, 4]);
  }
});

// DEFER_OBJ (ID3DXEffect::CommitChanges, EndPass): queued while the object's word at +12 is set, left to JavaScript
// once it is cleared (an effect with an application state manager: applying states calls guest code at the call).
test('effect CommitChanges: queued while the object allows it, left to JavaScript otherwise', () => {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  const commit = [...push(OBJ), 0xff, 0x15, ...le(SLOT)]; // effect->CommitChanges()
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from([...commit, ...commit, 0xf4]));
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true });
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  jit.markFast(IDX, 'com.dll!ID3DXEffect::CommitChanges', true);
  mem.write32(SLOT, THUNK_BASE + IDX * THUNK_SIZE);
  mem.write32(OBJ + 12, HB); mem.write32(OBJ + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(HB + FX_OWNER, OBJ); // (a live effect: its block names it)
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = 0x10009000; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  let toJs = 0, r;
  for (let n = 0; n < 100; n++) {
    r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 });
    if (r !== EXIT.THUNK) break;
    toJs++;
    cpu.eip = mem.read32(cpu.esp); cpu.esp += 8; cpu.eax = 0;
    mem.write32(OBJ + 12, 0); // (never reached: the first call is queued)
  }
  assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(toJs, 0, 'both calls queued');
  assert.equal(cpu.esp, 0x10009000, 'stdcall returns');
  assert.equal(mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE), 2 * 12, 'two records: thunk, argc, this');
  assert.deepEqual([mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE + 16), mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE + 20), mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE + 24)], [IDX, 1, OBJ]);

  // the word cleared: the same code goes to JavaScript
  mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE, 0);
  mem.write32(OBJ + 12, 0);
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = 0x10009000;
  toJs = 0;
  for (let n = 0; n < 100; n++) {
    r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 });
    if (r !== EXIT.THUNK) break;
    toJs++;
    cpu.eip = mem.read32(cpu.esp); cpu.esp += 8; cpu.eax = 0;
  }
  assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(toJs, 2);
  assert.equal(mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE), 0, 'nothing queued');
});
```

`tests/jit-defer-raw.test.js`:

```js
// ID3DXEffect::SetRawValue(h, data, offset, bytes) on the JIT's deferred queue (runtime.js DEFER_RAW): queued with a copy
// of its `bytes` bytes taken at the call (a later write to the source changes nothing), the data argument pointing at
// the copy; a byte count that is not whole words or past DEFER_RAW_MAX, a null data pointer, or a name instead of a
// handle go to JavaScript at once. Vm.drainDeferred then runs the handler on the record: the same arguments and bytes.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory, THUNK_BASE } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { DEFER_QUEUE, DEFER_RAW_MAX, COM_MARKER, FX_OWNER } from '../src/cpu/jit/runtime.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, SLOT = 0x10000100, OBJ = 0x10004000, HB = 0x10005000, DATA = 0x10006000, NAME = 0x10002000, IDX = 5, THUNK_SIZE = 16;
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
const push = (v) => [0x68, ...le(v)];
const setRaw = (h, data, off, bytes) => [...push(bytes), ...push(off), ...push(data), ...push(h), ...push(OBJ), 0xff, 0x15, ...le(SLOT)];

test('SetRawValue: queued with a copy of its bytes, odd sizes / big sizes / null data / names to JavaScript; drained with the same arguments and bytes', () => {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  const calls = [[HB + 8, DATA, 4, 12], [HB + 8, DATA, 0, 6], [HB + 12, DATA, 0, DEFER_RAW_MAX + 4], [HB + 12, 0, 0, 8], [NAME, DATA, 0, 8], [HB + 16, DATA + 16, 8, DEFER_RAW_MAX]];
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from([...calls.flatMap((a) => setRaw(...a)), 0xf4]));
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true });
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  jit.markFast(IDX, 'com.dll!ID3DXEffect::SetRawValue', true);
  mem.write32(SLOT, THUNK_BASE + IDX * THUNK_SIZE);
  mem.write32(OBJ + 12, HB); mem.write32(OBJ + 4, COM_MARKER); mem.write32(HB + FX_OWNER, OBJ); // (a live effect: its block names it)
  for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) mem.write32(DATA + 4 * i, 0x1000 + i);
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = 0x10009000; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  const toJs = [];
  let r;
  for (let n = 0; n < 100; n++) {
    r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 });
    if (r !== EXIT.THUNK) break;
    toJs.push([1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => mem.read32(cpu.esp + 4 + 4 * i)));
    cpu.eip = mem.read32(cpu.esp); cpu.esp += 24; cpu.eax = 0;
  }
  assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(cpu.esp, 0x10009000, 'stdcall returns');
  assert.deepEqual(toJs, [calls[1], calls[2], calls[3], calls[4]], 'the other four leave');
  for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) mem.write32(DATA + 4 * i, 0xdead); // (written after the calls: the copies keep the values of the call)

  // drained: the handler sees the record's arguments, the data argument pointing at the copy
  const seen = [];
  const def = { fn: (c) => { const [h, data, off, bytes] = [1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => c.arg(i)); seen.push([c.arg(0), h, off, bytes, Array.from({ length: bytes >>> 2 }, (_, i) => mem.read32(data + 4 * i))]); return 0; } };
  const fake = { mem, ctx: { mem, arg(i) { return mem.read32(this.sp + 4 + 4 * i); } }, apiHistCounts: null, api: { thunks: { [IDX]: { def } } }, proc: {}, apiCalls: 0, d3dDevices: null };
  Vm.prototype.drainDeferred.call(fake, { cpu });
  assert.equal(mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE), 0, 'queue emptied');
  assert.deepEqual(seen, [
    [OBJ, HB + 8, 4, 12, [0x1000, 0x1001, 0x1002]],
    [OBJ, HB + 16, 8, DEFER_RAW_MAX, Array.from({ length: DEFER_RAW_MAX / 4 }, (_, i) => 0x1004 + i)],
  ]);
});
```

`tests/jit-defer-technique.test.js`:

```js
// ID3DXEffect's technique calls on the JIT's deferred queue (runtime.js DEFER_TECH / DEFER_BEGIN / DEFER_END):
// SetTechnique, Begin and End are queued like the parameter setters — Begin's pass count answered at once from the
// technique slot, End making the issued-state filter forget the states its restore may set. Random engine-shaped call
// sequences (techniques by handle, by name, invalid handles, techniques without passes, Begin with and without saving
// states, BeginPass out of range, commits, the application's own state sets — often the values a pass or a restore
// leaves —, state blocks, End without Begin) run as guest code through the JIT, with JavaScript draining the queue
// before every call it handles, and on a reference executing every call in order: the same results (EAX, the pass
// counts written), the same device state at every draw and at the end. A restore list missing a state is caught.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { THUNK_BASE } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { DEFER_QUEUE, DEFER_SPEC, DEFER_RAW, DEFER_WORDS, COM_MARKER, FAST_STATS, FX_SLOTS, FX_OWNER, SHADOW_RS, SHADOW_TSS, SHADOW_SAMP, SHADOW_TEX } from '../src/cpu/jit/runtime.js';
import { d3dEnv } from './d3d-random.js';
import { defineEffects } from '../src/win32/d3dx9-effect.js';
import { effectBinary, shader, op } from './fx-build.js';
import { PT, PC } from '../src/win32/d3dx9-fxparse.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, SLOTS = 0x10000100, STACK = 0x10090000, RESULTS = 0x10100000, THUNK_SIZE = 16;
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
const push = (v) => [0x68, ...le(v)];
const callSlot = (i) => [0xff, 0x15, ...le(SLOTS + 4 * i)];
// [interface method, stack arguments after `this`]; 'Observe' (a draw: the device state recorded) is handled in JavaScript
const METHODS = [
  ['ID3DXEffect::SetTechnique', 1], ['ID3DXEffect::Begin', 2], ['ID3DXEffect::BeginPass', 1], ['ID3DXEffect::CommitChanges', 0], ['ID3DXEffect::EndPass', 0],
  ['ID3DXEffect::End', 0], ['ID3DXEffect::SetInt', 2], ['ID3DXEffect::SetTexture', 2], ['IDirect3DDevice9::SetRenderState', 2], ['IDirect3DDevice9::SetTextureStageState', 3],
  ['IDirect3DDevice9::SetTexture', 2], ['IDirect3DDevice9::SetSamplerState', 3], ['IDirect3DDevice9::BeginStateBlock', 0], ['IDirect3DDevice9::EndStateBlock', 1], ['IDirect3DDevice9::Observe', 0],
  ['IDirect3DDevice9::SetTransform', 2], ['ID3DXEffect::SetVector', 2],
];
const M = Object.fromEntries(METHODS.map(([k], i) => [k.split('::')[1] + (k.startsWith('IDirect3DDevice9') && k.endsWith('SetTexture') ? '9' : ''), i]));

const I = { cls: PC.SCALAR, type: PT.INT }, tex = { cls: PC.OBJECT, type: PT.TEXTURE }, samplerT = { cls: PC.OBJECT, type: PT.SAMPLER2D };
const vec4 = { cls: PC.VECTOR, type: PT.FLOAT, rows: 1, cols: 4 };
/** effect k: techniques of one and two passes (render, stage, sampler states and textures — constants, parameters, expressions), one without passes */
function effect(k) {
  const vs = shader(true, [['C', 2, 0, 1, vec4]]), ps = shader(false, [['S0', 3, 0, 1, samplerT]]);
  const ge1 = { literals: [1], insns: [[0x2030, 1, [{ table: 2, offset: 0 }, { table: 1, offset: 0 }], { table: 4, offset: 0 }]], inputs: [['R', 2, 0, 1, I]] };
  return effectBinary({
    params: [{ name: 'R', t: I }, { name: 'C', t: vec4 }, { name: 'Tex0', t: tex }, { name: 'Tex1', t: tex },
      { name: 'S0', t: samplerT, samplers: [[[op('texture'), 0, 'Tex0'], [op('samp', 6), 0, 2], [op('samp', 1), 0, 'R']]] }],
    techniques: [
      { name: 'T0', passes: [
        { name: 'P0', states: [{ op: op('vs'), value: vs }, { op: op('ps'), value: ps }, { op: op('rs', 7), value: 1 }, { op: op('rs', 22), ref: 'R' }, { op: op('rs', 27), expr: ge1 },
          { op: op('tss', 1), index: 0, value: 4 + k }, { op: op('texture'), index: 1, ref: 'Tex1' }, { op: op('sampler'), index: 0, ref: 'S0' }] },
        { name: 'P1', states: [{ op: op('rs', 7), value: 0 }, { op: op('rs', 14), value: 1 }, { op: op('tss', 2), index: 1, value: 2 }, { op: op('samp', 5), index: 2, value: 3 }] }] },
      { name: 'T1', passes: [{ name: 'P0', states: [{ op: op('rs', 27), value: 1 }, { op: op('rs', 20), value: 5 + k }, { op: op('rs', 14), ref: 'R' }, { op: op('texture'), index: 3, ref: 'Tex0' }] }] },
      { name: 'T2', passes: [] },
    ],
  });
}

/** an environment: device, two effects, textures; `jit`: guest code through the JIT (else the reference runs every call) */
function session(jit) {
  const E = d3dEnv(null, false, null), { mem, ctx, com, vm } = E;
  const out = E.alloc(64), pp = E.alloc(64);
  [320, 240, 22, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 75, 0, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(pp + 4 * i, v));
  const d3d = E.defs.Direct3DCreate9[1](ctx([32]));
  assert.equal(com.implAt(d3d).CreateDevice(ctx([d3d, 0, 1, 0, 0x40, pp, out])), 0);
  const devPtr = mem.read32(out), dev = com.implAt(devPtr);
  mem.write32(devPtr + 4, COM_MARKER);
  Object.assign(vm, { effectCtx: null, callGuest: () => 0, log: () => {} });
  const X = {}; com.interface ??= () => {};
  defineEffects(X, vm, { callMethod: (c, self, name, args) => com.implAt(self)[name](ctx([self, ...args])), textBuffer: () => 0 });
  const fxs = [0, 1].map((k) => {
    const bytes = effect(k), src = E.alloc(bytes.length); mem.writeBytes(src, bytes);
    assert.equal(X.D3DXCreateEffect[1](ctx([devPtr, src, bytes.length, 0, 0, 0, 0, out, 0])), 0);
    const ptr = mem.read32(out), fx = com.implAt(ptr); mem.write32(ptr + 4, COM_MARKER);
    const name = (s) => { const p = E.alloc(s.length + 1); mem.writeCString(p, s); return p; };
    const h = (s) => fx.GetParameterByName(ctx([ptr, 0, name(s)])) >>> 0;
    return { ptr, fx, techs: ['T0', 'T1', 'T2'].map((t) => fx.GetTechniqueByName(ctx([ptr, name(t)])) >>> 0), techNames: ['T0', 'T1'].map(name), R: h('R'), Tex0: h('Tex0'), Tex1: h('Tex1') };
  });
  const textures = []; for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { dev.CreateTexture(ctx([devPtr, 16, 16, 1, 0, 21, 1, out, 0])); textures.push(mem.read32(out)); com.objectAt(textures[i]).refs += 1e6; }
  const S = { E, mem, ctx, com, dev, devPtr, fxs, textures, draws: [], sbOut: E.alloc(16) };
  /** a call of METHODS[m] with its arguments (`this` first), as the COM dispatcher makes it */
  S.call = (m, args) => {
    if (m === M.Observe) { S.draws.push(S.state()); return 0; }
    const name = METHODS[m][0].split('::')[1], impl = com.implAt(args[0]);
    const r = impl[name](ctx(args));
    return r === undefined ? 0 : r >>> 0;
  };
  S.state = () => JSON.stringify([[...dev.rs].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]), dev.tss.slice(0, 3).map((t) => [...t].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])), dev.samplers.slice(0, 3).map((t) => [...t].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])),
    dev.textures.slice(0, 4), dev.vsObj?.comObject?.ptr ?? 0, dev.psObj?.comObject?.ptr ?? 0, Array.from(dev.vsConst.subarray(0, 4))]);
  if (jit) {
    const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE); cpu.reset();
    S.cpu = cpu; S.jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true }); S.jit.cpu = cpu;
    METHODS.forEach(([k], i) => { S.jit.markFast(i, `com.dll!${k}`, true); mem.write32(SLOTS + 4 * i, THUNK_BASE + i * THUNK_SIZE); });
  }
  return S;
}

/** a random engine-shaped sequence of [method, args] (the same for every session: addresses are equal between them) */
function program(S, seed, n) {
  let x = seed >>> 0;
  const rnd = (k) => { x = (Math.imul(x, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return (x >>> 8) % k; };
  const calls = [], { fxs, devPtr, textures } = S;
  let out = 0;
  const devStates = () => { // (the application's own states: often those the effects' passes and restores leave)
    const r = rnd(10);
    if (r < 5) calls.push([M.SetRenderState, [devPtr, [7, 14, 20, 22, 27][rnd(5)], rnd(3) === 0 ? 5 + rnd(2) : rnd(3)]]);
    else if (r < 7) calls.push([M.SetTextureStageState, [devPtr, rnd(3), [1, 2][rnd(2)], [2, 4, 5][rnd(3)]]]);
    else if (r < 8) calls.push([M.SetSamplerState, [devPtr, rnd(3), [1, 5, 6][rnd(3)], rnd(4)]]);
    else calls.push([M.SetTexture9, [devPtr, rnd(4), [0, ...textures][rnd(4)]]]);
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const f = fxs[rnd(2)], r = rnd(100);
    if (r < 3) { calls.push([M.BeginStateBlock, [devPtr]]); for (let k = rnd(3); k >= 0; k--) devStates(); calls.push([M.EndStateBlock, [devPtr, S.sbOut]]); continue; }
    if (r < 8) { calls.push([M.End, [f.ptr]]); continue; } // (an End out of place)
    for (let k = rnd(4); k > 0; k--) devStates();
    // the technique: by handle (mostly), by name, a parameter's handle (invalid), one without passes
    const t = rnd(20);
    calls.push([M.SetTechnique, [f.ptr, t < 14 ? f.techs[rnd(2)] : t < 16 ? f.techNames[rnd(2)] : t < 18 ? f.R : f.techs[2]]]);
    if (rnd(3) === 0) calls.push([M.SetInt, [f.ptr, f.R, rnd(3)]]);
    if (rnd(4) === 0) calls.push([M.SetTexture, [f.ptr, [f.Tex0, f.Tex1][rnd(2)], [0, ...textures][rnd(4)]]]);
    calls.push([M.Begin, [f.ptr, rnd(5) === 0 ? 0 : RESULTS + 4 * (out++ % 1024), [0, 0, 1, 2, 6][rnd(5)]]]);
    if (rnd(6) === 0) continue; // (Begin without the rest)
    if (rnd(12) === 0) { calls.push([M.End, [f.ptr]]); continue; } // (End at once: its Begin still queued)
    const passes = 1 + rnd(2);
    for (let p = 0; p < passes; p++) {
      calls.push([M.BeginPass, [f.ptr, rnd(8) === 0 ? 2 : p]]);
      for (let d = rnd(3); d >= 0; d--) {
        if (rnd(2)) calls.push([M.SetInt, [f.ptr, f.R, rnd(3)]]);
        if (rnd(3) === 0) devStates();
        calls.push([M.CommitChanges, [f.ptr]]);
        calls.push([M.Observe, [devPtr]]);
      }
      calls.push([M.EndPass, [f.ptr]]);
    }
    if (rnd(8) !== 0) calls.push([M.End, [f.ptr]]);
    if (rnd(3) === 0) calls.push([M.Observe, [devPtr]]);
  }
  return calls;
}

/** run `calls` as guest code through the JIT; every call left to JavaScript drains the queue first (Vm.dispatchThunk) */
function runJit(S, calls, hook) {
  const { mem, cpu, jit } = S;
  const code = [];
  calls.forEach(([m, args], i) => { for (let k = args.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) code.push(...push(args[k])); code.push(...callSlot(m), 0xa3, ...le(RESULTS + 0x10000 + 4 * i)); });
  code.push(0xf4);
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code)); jit.invalidate(CODE, code.length);
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = STACK; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  const drain = () => {
    const n = mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE);
    mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE, 0); mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE + 4, 0); mem.write32(DEFER_QUEUE + 8, 0);
    for (let p = DEFER_QUEUE + 16, end = p + n; p < end;) {
      const idx = mem.read32(p), argc = mem.read32(p + 4), spec = mem.read32(DEFER_SPEC + 4 * idx), words = spec & DEFER_RAW ? mem.read32(p + 24) >>> 2 : (spec >>> 8) & DEFER_WORDS;
      S.call(idx, Array.from({ length: argc }, (_, i) => mem.read32(p + 8 + 4 * i)));
      p += 4 * (2 + argc + words);
    }
  };
  const toJs = new Array(METHODS.length).fill(0);
  let r;
  for (let k = 0; k < 1e6; k++) {
    r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e7 });
    if (r !== EXIT.THUNK) break;
    drain();
    const idx = cpu.exitArg, argc = METHODS[idx][1] + 1, args = Array.from({ length: argc }, (_, i) => mem.read32(cpu.esp + 4 + 4 * i));
    toJs[idx]++;
    const eax = S.call(idx, args);
    hook?.(S);
    cpu.eip = mem.read32(cpu.esp); cpu.esp += 4 + 4 * argc; cpu.eax = eax >>> 0;
  }
  assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT);
  assert.equal(cpu.esp, STACK, 'stdcall returns');
  drain();
  return toJs;
}

/** the reference: every call in order, its result stored as the guest program stores EAX */
function runRef(S, calls) { calls.forEach(([m, args], i) => S.mem.write32(RESULTS + 0x10000 + 4 * i, S.call(m, args))); }

/** every shadow entry the filter trusts (known) holds the device's state (after the last drain) */
function shadowCheck(S, where) {
  const { mem, dev } = S, sb = dev.shadow;
  const check = (i, v, what) => { const a = sb + 16 + 8 * i; if (mem.read32(a)) assert.equal(mem.read32(a + 4), (v ?? 0) >>> 0, `${where}: shadow ${what}`); };
  for (let k = 0; k < 256; k++) if (dev.rs.get(k) !== undefined || mem.read32(sb + 16 + 8 * (SHADOW_RS + k))) check(SHADOW_RS + k, dev.rs.get(k), `rs${k}`);
  for (let st = 0; st < 8; st++) for (let t = 0; t < 40; t++) if (dev.tss[st].get(t) !== undefined) check(SHADOW_TSS + 40 * st + t, dev.tss[st].get(t), `tss${st}.${t}`);
  for (let r = 0; r < 16; r++) for (let t = 0; t < 16; t++) if (dev.samplers[r].get(t) !== undefined) check(SHADOW_SAMP + 16 * r + t, dev.samplers[r].get(t), `samp${r}.${t}`);
  for (let st = 0; st < 16; st++) check(SHADOW_TEX + st, dev.textures[st], `tex${st}`);
}

function compare(A, B, calls, where) {
  for (let i = 0; i < calls.length; i++) assert.equal(A.mem.read32(RESULTS + 0x10000 + 4 * i), B.mem.read32(RESULTS + 0x10000 + 4 * i), `${where}: result of call ${i} (${METHODS[calls[i][0]][0]})`);
  for (let i = 0; i < 1024; i++) assert.equal(A.mem.read32(RESULTS + 4 * i), B.mem.read32(RESULTS + 4 * i), `${where}: pass count ${i}`);
  assert.equal(A.draws.length, B.draws.length, `${where}: draws`);
  for (let i = 0; i < A.draws.length; i++) assert.equal(A.draws[i], B.draws[i], `${where}: device state at draw ${i}`);
  assert.equal(A.state(), B.state(), `${where}: final device state`);
}

test('effect technique calls queued: the same results, pass counts and device states as running every call in order', () => {
  const queued = new Array(METHODS.length).fill(0), total = new Array(METHODS.length).fill(0);
  let dropped = 0;
  for (let seed = 1; seed <= 20; seed++) {
    const A = session(true), B = session(false), calls = program(A, seed, 160);
    const d0 = A.mem.read32(FAST_STATS);
    const toJs = runJit(A, calls);
    runRef(B, calls);
    compare(A, B, calls, `seed ${seed}`);
    shadowCheck(A, `seed ${seed}`);
    dropped += A.mem.read32(FAST_STATS) - d0;
    for (const [m] of calls) { total[m]++; queued[m]++; }
    toJs.forEach((n, m) => { queued[m] -= n; });
  }
  // (the fast paths did their part: most technique calls queued, redundant sets dropped)
  assert.ok(queued[M.SetTechnique] > total[M.SetTechnique] / 2, `SetTechnique queued ${queued[M.SetTechnique]} of ${total[M.SetTechnique]}`);
  assert.ok(queued[M.Begin] > total[M.Begin] / 2, `Begin queued ${queued[M.Begin]} of ${total[M.Begin]}`);
  assert.ok(queued[M.End] > total[M.End] / 2, `End queued ${queued[M.End]} of ${total[M.End]}`);
  assert.equal(queued[M.BeginPass], 0, 'BeginPass in JavaScript');
  assert.ok(dropped > 50, `redundant sets dropped: ${dropped}`);
});

test('effect technique calls queued: Begin answers the pass count of the technique set last, JavaScript the rest (no technique, no passes, a state manager)', () => {
  const A = session(true), f = A.fxs[0], { mem } = A;
  const calls = [[M.SetTechnique, [f.ptr, f.techs[0]]], [M.Begin, [f.ptr, RESULTS, 0]], [M.End, [f.ptr]], [M.SetTechnique, [f.ptr, f.techs[1]]], [M.Begin, [f.ptr, RESULTS + 4, 1]], [M.End, [f.ptr]],
    [M.SetTechnique, [f.ptr, f.techs[2]]], [M.Begin, [f.ptr, RESULTS + 8, 0]], [M.SetTechnique, [f.ptr, f.R]]];
  const toJs = runJit(A, calls);
  assert.deepEqual([0, 1, 2].map((i) => mem.read32(RESULTS + 4 * i)), [2, 1, 0]);
  assert.equal(mem.read32(RESULTS + 0x10000 + 4 * 8), 0x8876086c, 'a parameter handle: D3DERR_INVALIDCALL');
  assert.deepEqual([toJs[M.SetTechnique], toJs[M.Begin], toJs[M.End]], [2, 1, 0], 'technique without passes and parameter handle in JavaScript');
  assert.equal(mem.read32(A.fxs[0].fx.handleBlock + FX_SLOTS), 0, 'technique slot: no passes');
  // a state manager set: every technique call to JavaScript (its +12 cleared)
  const B = session(true), g = B.fxs[1];
  g.fx.SetStateManager(B.ctx([g.ptr, 0x10200000]));
  const toJs2 = runJit(B, [[M.SetTechnique, [g.ptr, g.techs[1]]], [M.Begin, [g.ptr, RESULTS, 0]], [M.End, [g.ptr]]]);
  assert.deepEqual([toJs2[M.SetTechnique], toJs2[M.Begin], toJs2[M.End]], [1, 1, 1]);
  // the measurement switch (dbg:ORTHROS_FX_DEFER_OFF, and the D3DX fast paths' switch): to JavaScript, then queued again
  const C = session(true), h = C.fxs[0], seq = [[M.SetTechnique, [h.ptr, h.techs[1]]], [M.Begin, [h.ptr, RESULTS, 0]], [M.End, [h.ptr]]], n = (t) => [t[M.SetTechnique], t[M.Begin], t[M.End]];
  C.jit.setFxDefer(false); assert.deepEqual(n(runJit(C, seq)), [1, 1, 1], 'switched off');
  C.jit.setFxDefer(true); assert.deepEqual(n(runJit(C, seq)), [0, 0, 0], 'switched on');
  C.jit.setD3dxFast(false); assert.deepEqual(n(runJit(C, seq)), [1, 1, 1], 'with the D3DX fast paths off');
  C.jit.setD3dxFast(true); assert.deepEqual(n(runJit(C, seq)), [0, 0, 0], 'and on');
});

test('effect technique calls queued: a restore list missing a state is caught by the randomized comparison', () => {
  // (the test's sensitivity: every list published by Begin loses its last entry)
  let mismatches = 0;
  for (let seed = 1; seed <= 16; seed++) {
    const A = session(true), B = session(false), calls = program(A, seed, 160);
    const cut = new Set();
    const hook = (S) => { for (const f of S.fxs) { const L = S.mem.read32(f.fx.handleBlock + FX_SLOTS + 4), n = L ? S.mem.read32(L + 4) : 0; if (L && n > 0 && n < 0xffffffff && !cut.has(L)) { cut.add(L); S.mem.write32(L + 4, n - 1); } } };
    runJit(A, calls, hook); runRef(B, calls);
    try { compare(A, B, calls, `seed ${seed}`); } catch { mismatches++; }
  }
  assert.ok(mismatches > 0, 'an incomplete restore list makes the filter drop sets it must not');
});

test('queued setters carrying a structure (SetTransform, an effect\'s SetVector) leave the filter on, the reference counts alone and the effect\'s lists untouched', () => {
  const A = session(true), f = A.fxs[0], { mem, devPtr } = A;
  const MAT = 0x10180000; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) mem.writeF32(MAT + 4 * i, i % 5 === 0 ? 1 : 0.5);
  // (a pass begun first: the effect has published its commit list; the program stops at the first call left to JavaScript)
  runJit(A, [[M.SetTechnique, [f.ptr, f.techs[0]]], [M.Begin, [f.ptr, 0, 0]], [M.BeginPass, [f.ptr, 0]]]);
  const list = mem.read32(f.ptr + 20), entries = mem.read32(list + 4), restore = mem.read32(f.fx.handleBlock + FX_SLOTS + 4), slot = mem.read32(f.fx.handleBlock + FX_SLOTS);
  assert.ok(list && entries > 0 && restore, 'commit and restore lists published');
  const rs7 = A.dev.rs.get(7), d0 = mem.read32(FAST_STATS);
  const { cpu, jit } = A, code = [...push(MAT), ...push(256), ...push(devPtr), ...callSlot(M.SetTransform), ...push(MAT), ...push(f.R), ...push(f.ptr), ...callSlot(M.SetVector),
    ...push(rs7), ...push(7), ...push(devPtr), ...callSlot(M.SetRenderState), 0xf4];
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code)); jit.invalidate(CODE, code.length);
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = STACK;
  assert.equal(jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 }), EXIT.HALT, 'all three on the fast path');
  assert.deepEqual([mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE + 4), mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE + 8)], [0, 0], 'no reference change pending, the filter on');
  assert.equal(mem.read32(FAST_STATS) - d0, 1, 'the redundant render state dropped');
  assert.deepEqual([mem.read32(list + 4), mem.read32(f.fx.handleBlock + FX_SLOTS + 4), mem.read32(f.fx.handleBlock + FX_SLOTS)], [entries, restore, slot], 'the effect\'s lists and technique slot untouched');
  const rec = DEFER_QUEUE + 16 + 4 * (2 + 3 + 16);
  assert.deepEqual([mem.read32(rec + 8), mem.read32(rec + 12)], [f.ptr, f.R], 'SetVector recorded with its handle');
});

test('effect technique calls queued: an End whose Begin is not the one that published the restore list (a Begin queued again, no End between) leaves the filter right', () => {
  const A = session(true), B = session(false), f = A.fxs[0], d = A.devPtr;
  // Begin of T0 run (BeginPass in JavaScript), no End; T1 begun again and ended while queued; then the states T0's and
  // T1's restores set, sent again with the values they had before (redundant only if the shadow is right)
  const calls = [[M.SetRenderState, [d, 27, 0]], [M.SetRenderState, [d, 20, 2]], [M.SetRenderState, [d, 14, 0]], [M.SetTexture9, [d, 3, 0]],
    [M.SetTechnique, [f.ptr, f.techs[0]]], [M.Begin, [f.ptr, RESULTS, 0]], [M.BeginPass, [f.ptr, 0]], [M.CommitChanges, [f.ptr]], [M.EndPass, [f.ptr]],
    [M.SetTechnique, [f.ptr, f.techs[1]]], [M.Begin, [f.ptr, RESULTS + 4, 0]], [M.End, [f.ptr]],
    [M.SetRenderState, [d, 27, 0]], [M.SetRenderState, [d, 20, 2]], [M.SetRenderState, [d, 14, 0]], [M.SetTexture9, [d, 3, 0]], [M.SetRenderState, [d, 7, 1]], [M.Observe, [d]]];
  runJit(A, calls); runRef(B, calls);
  compare(A, B, calls, 'begun twice');
  shadowCheck(A, 'begun twice');
});

// variants: 'stale' the freed object keeps only its +0/+12/+16/+20 words (Com.dispose's clearing undone); 'marker' its
// COM marker too, so the handle block's FX_OWNER word is the only guard left; 'owner' the handle block names it again,
// so the COM marker is the only guard left
for (const variant of ['stale', 'marker', 'owner']) test(`a released effect (${variant}): calls through a pointer kept after the Release reach JavaScript, the freed blocks are not written`, () => {
  // (Windows: the interface is gone, its memory the heap's; Orthros: the fast path must not trust the object's words —
  // here the stale words a heap leaves in the freed object, +12 the handle block and +20 the commit list, both freed too
  // and handed to another allocation)
  const A = session(true), f = A.fxs[0], { mem, com, E } = A, ptr = f.ptr;
  runJit(A, [[M.SetTechnique, [ptr, f.techs[0]]], [M.Begin, [ptr, RESULTS, 0]], [M.BeginPass, [ptr, 0]], [M.CommitChanges, [ptr]], [M.EndPass, [ptr]], [M.End, [ptr]],
    [M.SetTechnique, [ptr, f.techs[0]]], [M.Begin, [ptr, RESULTS, 0]], [M.BeginPass, [ptr, 0]]]);
  const hb = f.fx.handleBlock, commit = mem.read32(ptr + 20), restore = f.fx.techniques[0].restoreList;
  assert.ok(hb && commit && restore, 'blocks published');
  const words = [mem.read32(ptr), mem.read32(ptr + 12), mem.read32(ptr + 16), mem.read32(ptr + 20)];
  assert.equal(mem.read32(ptr + 4), COM_MARKER); assert.equal(mem.read32(hb + FX_OWNER), ptr, 'the block names its effect');
  // the release (com.js: dispose); the heap keeps the freed bytes (no debug fill), and another allocation reuses them
  E.proc.processHeap.free_ = () => {};
  com.release(com.objectAt(ptr));
  assert.equal(com.objectAt(ptr), null);
  assert.equal(mem.read32(ptr + 12), 0, 'dispose clears the handle block word'); assert.equal(mem.read32(ptr + 20), 0, 'and the commit list word');
  assert.notEqual(mem.read32(ptr + 4), COM_MARKER, 'no marker after the release');
  mem.write32(ptr, words[0]); mem.write32(ptr + 12, words[1]); mem.write32(ptr + 16, words[2]); mem.write32(ptr + 20, words[3]);
  if (variant === 'marker') mem.write32(ptr + 4, COM_MARKER);
  const blocks = [[hb, FX_SLOTS + 16], [commit, 64], [restore, 64]];
  const fill = (a, n) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 4) mem.write32(a + i, 0x01000001 + i); };
  blocks.forEach(([a, n]) => fill(a, n));
  if (variant === 'owner') mem.write32(hb + FX_OWNER, ptr);
  const before = blocks.map(([a, n]) => Array.from(mem.bytes(a, n)));
  const q0 = mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE);
  const S = { ...A, call: (m, args) => (com.implAt(args[0]) ? A.call(m, args) : 0x80004003) }; // (com.js dispatch: E_POINTER)
  const toJs = runJit(S, [[M.SetTechnique, [ptr, f.techs[0]]], [M.Begin, [ptr, RESULTS + 8, 0]], [M.SetInt, [ptr, f.R, 1]], [M.CommitChanges, [ptr]], [M.EndPass, [ptr]], [M.End, [ptr]]]);
  assert.deepEqual([toJs[M.SetTechnique], toJs[M.Begin], toJs[M.SetInt], toJs[M.CommitChanges], toJs[M.EndPass], toJs[M.End]], [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1], 'every call to JavaScript');
  assert.equal(q0, 0); assert.equal(mem.read32(DEFER_QUEUE), 0, 'nothing queued');
  blocks.forEach(([a, n], i) => assert.deepEqual(Array.from(mem.bytes(a, n)), before[i], `freed block ${i} untouched`));
  assert.equal(mem.read32(RESULTS + 8), 0, 'no pass count written');
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) assert.equal(mem.read32(RESULTS + 0x10000 + 4 * i), 0x80004003, `call ${i}: E_POINTER`);
});
```
