`tests/jit-exit-flags.test.js`:

```js
// The lazy flag state at the JIT's exits (translate.js): what a region leaves in the state block when it exits in the
// middle of a block (a self-modifying-code exit after a store, a time slice at a back edge) must be the flags the guest
// sees at the resume address.
// 1. A read-modify-write instruction whose store hits a page holding translated code exits after the instruction
//    (EXIT.SMC): its own flags must be in the state (INC/DEC/NEG/ADC/SBB/shifts/SHLD/XADD... used to set the lazy kind
//    after the store, so that exit flushed the new operands with the previous instruction's kind).
// 2. Where no flag is live at the resume address (every path from it writes the flags before reading them: the region's
//    liveness), a time-slice exit writes "no lazy op" instead of the lazy operands, so that they are not kept live
//    around loops for the exit path alone; flags that are live are still exact. SMC exits keep the whole lazy state
//    (their store may rewrite the code the liveness was computed on). JIT against the interpreter, whole and
//    time-sliced runs.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-sse.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { listRegion } from '../src/cpu/jit/listing.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
const ARITH = F.CF | F.PF | F.AF | F.ZF | F.SF | F.OF;

/** Run `code` at CODE (ending in HLT) under the interpreter or the JIT (SMC exits handled as the VM does: the written
 * range invalidated, the run resumed); `slice`: instructions per run() call (time slices). */
function run(code, useJit, { slice = 1e7, init = () => {} } = {}) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code));
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x8000; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  init(mem, cpu);
  const I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
  if (!useJit) I.cache = new (class extends Map { set() { return this; } })(); // (stores into code: decode afresh)
  const jit = useJit ? new Jit(mem, I, { smc: true }) : null;
  if (jit) jit.cpu = cpu;
  const end = CODE + code.length - 1;
  let r, smc = 0, runs = 0;
  for (;;) {
    r = useJit ? jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: slice }) : I.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: slice });
    runs++;
    if (r === EXIT.SMC) { const len = mem.read32(cpu.base + ST.EXIT_LEN) || 16; mem.write32(cpu.base + ST.EXIT_LEN, 0); jit.invalidate(cpu.exitArg, len); smc++; continue; }
    if (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE) { assert.ok(runs < 1e6, 'runaway'); continue; }
    break;
  }
  assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT, `exit ${r}`);
  if (useJit) CpuState.foldLazyFlags?.(cpu);
  return { regs: [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx, cpu.esp, cpu.ebp, cpu.esi, cpu.edi].map((v) => v >>> 0), flags: cpu.eflags & ARITH, mem: [...mem.bytes(DATA, 64)], smc };
}

// ---- 1. flags of an instruction whose store takes the SMC exit
// the data word sits in the code's own page, after the HLT: a store there leaves the region (translated code page)
const WORD = CODE + 0x800;
/** mov edi, WORD ; mov eax, 0x80000001 ; cmp eax, 3 (a SUB lazy op first) ; stc/clc ; <insn [edi]> ; pushfd ; pop ebx ; hlt */
function smcProgram(insn, carry) {
  return [0xbf, ...le(WORD), 0xb8, ...le(0x80000001), 0x83, 0xf8, 0x03, carry ? 0xf9 : 0xf8, 0xb9, ...le(0x7ffffffe), ...insn, 0x9c, 0x5b, 0xf4];
}
const RMW = [
  ['inc dword [edi]', [0xff, 0x07]],
  ['dec dword [edi]', [0xff, 0x0f]],
  ['inc byte [edi]', [0xfe, 0x07]],
  ['neg dword [edi]', [0xf7, 0x1f]],
  ['not dword [edi] (no flags)', [0xf7, 0x17]],
  ['adc dword [edi], ecx', [0x11, 0x0f]],
  ['sbb dword [edi], ecx', [0x19, 0x0f]],
  ['add dword [edi], ecx', [0x01, 0x0f]],
  ['shl dword [edi], 1', [0xd1, 0x27]],
  ['shr dword [edi], 3', [0xc1, 0x2f, 0x03]],
  ['sar word [edi], 1', [0x66, 0xd1, 0x3f]],
  ['rol dword [edi], 1', [0xd1, 0x07]],
  ['rcl dword [edi], 1', [0xd1, 0x17]],
  ['shld [edi], ecx, 4', [0x0f, 0xa4, 0x0f, 0x04]],
  ['shrd [edi], ecx, 4', [0x0f, 0xac, 0x0f, 0x04]],
  ['xadd [edi], ecx', [0x0f, 0xc1, 0x0f]],
  ['cmpxchg [edi], ecx (equal)', [0x0f, 0xb1, 0x0f]],
  ['bts dword [edi], 5', [0x0f, 0xba, 0x2f, 0x05]],
  ['setc byte [edi]', [0x0f, 0x92, 0x07]],
];
for (const [name, insn] of RMW) {
  for (const [label, value] of (name.startsWith('cmpxchg') ? [['0x80000001 (equal)', 0x80000001]] : [['0x7fffffff', 0x7fffffff], ['0xffffffff', 0xffffffff], ['1', 1], ['0x80000001', 0x80000001]])) {
    for (const carry of [false, true]) {
      test(`SMC exit after ${name}, [edi] = ${label}, CF ${carry ? 1 : 0}: its flags reach the state block`, () => {
        const code = smcProgram(insn, carry);
        const init = (mem) => mem.write32(WORD, value);
        const want = run(code, false, { init }), got = run(code, true, { init });
        assert.ok(got.smc >= 1, 'the store takes the SMC exit');
        assert.deepEqual(got.regs, want.regs);
        assert.equal(got.flags, want.flags);
      });
    }
  }
}

// ---- 2. in-region exits where the flags are dead at the resume address
// a counting loop: L: mov edx, [esi+ecx*4] ; add eax, edx ; mov [edi+ecx*4], eax ; inc ecx ; cmp ecx, ebx ; jb L ; <tail> ; hlt
// the back edge's time-slice exit resumes at L, whose first flag access is the ADD (a write): flags dead there
const LOOP = [0x8b, 0x14, 0x8e, 0x01, 0xd0, 0x89, 0x04, 0x8f, 0x41, 0x39, 0xd9, 0x72, 0xf3];
const TAILS = [
  ['hlt', []],
  ['setb dl (the loop\'s last CMP read after it)', [0x0f, 0x92, 0xc2]],
  ['adc eax, 0', [0x83, 0xd0, 0x00]],
  ['pushfd ; pop edx', [0x9c, 0x5a]],
];
const loopInit = (mem, cpu) => { cpu.esi = DATA; cpu.edi = DATA + 0x100; cpu.ebx = 13; cpu.ecx = 0; cpu.eax = 0xfffffff0; for (let k = 0; k < 16; k++) mem.write32(DATA + 4 * k, (k * 0x10000001) >>> 0); };
for (const [name, tail] of TAILS) {
  for (const slice of [1e7, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7]) {
    test(`loop with dead flags at its back edge, tail ${name}, slices of ${slice}`, () => {
      const code = [0x31, 0xc0, 0x2d, ...le(0x10), ...LOOP, ...tail, 0xf4]; // xor eax, eax ; sub eax, 16 ; loop ; tail ; hlt
      const want = run(code, false, { slice, init: loopInit }), got = run(code, true, { slice, init: loopInit });
      assert.deepEqual(got.regs, want.regs);
      assert.equal(got.flags, want.flags);
      assert.deepEqual(got.mem, want.mem);
    });
  }
}
// the same loop with the flags live at its head (an ADC reading the CMP's carry across the back edge): the exit keeps them
const LOOP_LIVE = [0x8b, 0x14, 0x8e, 0x11, 0xd0, 0x89, 0x04, 0x8f, 0x41, 0x39, 0xd9, 0x72, 0xf3]; // adc eax, edx instead of add
for (const slice of [1e7, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]) {
  test(`loop with flags live at its back edge (ADC), slices of ${slice}`, () => {
    const code = [0x31, 0xc0, 0x2d, ...le(0x10), ...LOOP_LIVE, 0x9c, 0x5a, 0xf4];
    const want = run(code, false, { slice, init: loopInit }), got = run(code, true, { slice, init: loopInit });
    assert.deepEqual(got.regs, want.regs);
    assert.equal(got.flags, want.flags);
    assert.deepEqual(got.mem, want.mem);
  });
}
// a store into the loop's own code page at every iteration, flags dead after it (the SMC exit resumes at the INC)
test('SMC exits in a loop with dead flags after the store', () => {
  // L: add eax, 5 ; mov [edi], eax ; inc ecx ; cmp ecx, ebx ; jb L ; hlt   (edi -> a word of the code page)
  const code = [0x83, 0xc0, 0x05, 0x89, 0x07, 0x41, 0x39, 0xd9, 0x72, 0xf6, 0xf4];
  const init = (mem, cpu) => { cpu.edi = WORD; cpu.ebx = 6; cpu.ecx = 0; cpu.eax = 0x7ffffff0; };
  const want = run(code, false, { init }), got = run(code, true, { init });
  assert.ok(got.smc >= 1);
  assert.deepEqual(got.regs, want.regs);
  assert.equal(got.flags, want.flags);
});

test('the time-slice exit of a back edge whose flags are dead does not use the lazy operands', () => {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const code = [...LOOP, 0xf4];
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code));
  const { groups } = listRegion(mem, CODE, { smc: true });
  const jcc = groups.find((g) => /\bjb\b/.test(g.label));
  assert.ok(jcc, 'the JB is listed');
  const i = jcc.ops.indexOf('i32 0'); // (the exit path: the lazy op cleared)
  assert.ok(jcc.ops.includes('set lzop'), `the exit clears the lazy op: ${jcc.ops.join(' | ')}`);
  void i;
  // with the flags live at the head (ADC), the exit keeps the lazy state
  const mem2 = new GuestMemory();
  mem2.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from([...LOOP_LIVE, 0xf4]));
  const j2 = listRegion(mem2, CODE, { smc: true }).groups.find((g) => /\bjb\b/.test(g.label));
  assert.ok(!j2.ops.includes('set lzop'), 'live flags: the lazy state is kept');
});
// the store taking the SMC exit rewrites the code right after it: a JMP (flags dead: its target's CMP writes them) becomes
// a JZ reading the ZF of the CMP before the store — the SMC exit keeps the whole lazy state (the region's liveness was
// computed on the old bytes)
test('SMC exit whose store turns the next JMP into a JZ: the flags before the store survive', () => {
  // mov edi, L ; mov eax, 5 ; cmp eax, 5 ; mov byte [edi], 0x74 ; L: jmp +2 ; mov bl, 1 ; cmp eax, eax ; hlt
  const pre = [0xbf, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0xb8, ...le(5), 0x83, 0xf8, 0x05, 0xc6, 0x07, 0x74];
  pre.splice(1, 4, ...le(CODE + pre.length));
  const code = [...pre, 0xeb, 0x02, 0xb3, 0x01, 0x39, 0xc0, 0xf4];
  const want = run(code, false), got = run(code, true);
  assert.ok(got.smc >= 1, 'the store takes the SMC exit');
  assert.equal(want.regs[3] & 0xff, 0, 'the JZ is taken');
  assert.deepEqual(got.regs, want.regs);
});
```

`tests/jit-fast-d3dx.test.js`:

```js
// Pure D3DX math on the dispatcher's WASM fast path (fast-d3dx.js): D3DXMatrixInverse and D3DXVec{2,3,4}CatmullRom
// give the JavaScript handlers' results bit for bit (outputs, determinant, return value, untouched output of a singular
// matrix, outputs aliasing inputs; a NaN's sign and payload aside), without leaving the translated code; the cofactor table is the handler's own text.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { GuestMemory, THUNK_BASE } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { defineD3DXMath } from '../src/win32/d3dx9-math.js';
import { d3dxFastId } from '../src/cpu/jit/fast-d3dx.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, SLOTS = 0x10000100, DATA = 0x10002000, OUTEAX = 0x10001000, THUNK_SIZE = 16;
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
const NAMES = ['D3DXMatrixInverse', 'D3DXVec2CatmullRom', 'D3DXVec3CatmullRom', 'D3DXVec4CatmullRom'];
const ARGC = [3, 6, 6, 6];

const ARGS = 0x10000800;
const envs = new Map();
/** one translated program per function: push its arguments (from ARGS) right to left, call [slot], store eax, hlt */
function env(name) {
  let e = envs.get(name);
  if (e) return e;
  const k = NAMES.indexOf(name), prog = [];
  for (let i = ARGC[k] - 1; i >= 0; i--) prog.push(0xff, 0x35, ...le(ARGS + 4 * i));
  prog.push(0xff, 0x15, ...le(SLOTS + 4 * k), 0xa3, ...le(OUTEAX), 0xf4);
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(prog));
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true, now: () => 0 });
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  NAMES.forEach((n, i) => { jit.markFast(i + 1, `d3dx9_27.dll!${n}`, true); mem.write32(SLOTS + 4 * i, THUNK_BASE + (i + 1) * THUNK_SIZE); });
  const ref = new GuestMemory({ sizeBytes: 1 << 29 });
  const X = {}; defineD3DXMath(X, ref);
  envs.set(name, (e = { k, mem, cpu, jit, ref, X }));
  return e;
}
/** run NAME(args) translated (fast path) and through the JavaScript handler, on the same initial data */
function both(name, args, init, dataBytes = 0x400) {
  const { k, mem, cpu, jit, ref, X } = env(name);
  mem.fill(DATA, dataBytes, 0); init(mem);
  args.forEach((a, i) => mem.write32(ARGS + 4 * i, a));
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = 0x10009000; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  assert.equal(jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 }), EXIT.HALT, `${name}: no exit to JavaScript`);
  assert.equal(cpu.esp, 0x10009000, 'stdcall returns');
  const fast = { eax: mem.read32(OUTEAX), data: mem.bytes(DATA, dataBytes).slice() };
  // reference: the handler
  ref.fill(DATA, dataBytes, 0); init(ref);
  const u32 = new Uint32Array(1), f32 = new Float32Array(u32.buffer);
  assert.equal(X[name][0], ARGC[k]);
  const r = X[name][1]({ arg: (i) => args[i] >>> 0, argF32: (i) => { u32[0] = args[i]; return f32[0]; } });
  return { fast, ref: { eax: (r ?? 0) >>> 0, data: ref.bytes(DATA, dataBytes).slice() } };
}

const f32bits = (v) => { const b = new Float32Array([v]); return new Uint32Array(b.buffer)[0]; };
let seed = 12345;
const rnd = () => { seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0; return seed / 2 ** 32; };
const value = () => { const r = rnd(); if (r < 0.05) return 0; if (r < 0.08) return -0; if (r < 0.1) return 1; if (r < 0.12) return [Infinity, -Infinity, NaN, 1e-40, 3e38][Math.floor(rnd() * 5)]; return (rnd() - 0.5) * 10 ** Math.floor(rnd() * 8 - 3); };
const writeF = (mem, a, vals) => vals.forEach((v, i) => mem.writeF32(a + 4 * i, v));
/**
 * Memory as 32-bit words, every f32 NaN as one value: the sign and payload of a NaN an operation produces depend on the
 * operand order the engine's compiler picks (the JavaScript handler itself gives either sign, interpreted or optimized).
 */
const words = (bytes) => Array.from(new Uint32Array(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.length >> 2), (w) => ((w & 0x7f800000) === 0x7f800000 && (w & 0x7fffff) ? 'NaN' : w));

test('the cofactor table is d3dx9-math.js inverse() as written', async () => {
  const src = fs.readFileSync(new URL('../src/win32/d3dx9-math.js', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
  const { COFACTORS_FOR_TEST } = await import('../src/cpu/jit/fast-d3dx.js');
  for (let k = 0; k < 16; k++) {
    const m = new RegExp(`inv\\[${k}\\] = ([^;]+);`).exec(src);
    assert.ok(m, `inv[${k}] in the handler`);
    assert.equal(COFACTORS_FOR_TEST[k], m[1], `inv[${k}]`);
  }
});

test('thunk names of every d3dx9_NN.dll map to the fast ids, other DLLs do not', () => {
  assert.equal(d3dxFastId('d3dx9_43.dll!D3DXMatrixInverse'), d3dxFastId('d3dx9_24.dll!D3DXMatrixInverse'));
  assert.ok(d3dxFastId('d3dx9_30.dll!D3DXVec3CatmullRom') > 0);
  assert.equal(d3dxFastId('kernel32.dll!D3DXMatrixInverse'), undefined);
  assert.equal(d3dxFastId('d3dx9_30.dll!D3DXMatrixMultiply'), undefined);
  assert.equal(d3dxFastId('d3dx9_30.dll!toString'), undefined);
});

test('D3DXMatrixInverse: the handler\'s bits (random, singular, non-finite, aliased output, no determinant pointer)', () => {
  const M = DATA, OUT = DATA + 0x100, DET = DATA + 0x200;
  for (let iter = 0; iter < 3000; iter++) {
    const m = Array.from({ length: 16 }, value);
    if (iter % 10 === 1) { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) m[4 + i] = m[i]; } // singular
    if (iter % 10 === 2) m.fill(0);
    if (iter % 10 === 3) { m.fill(0); m[0] = m[5] = m[10] = m[15] = 1; m[12] = value(); }
    const alias = iter % 4 === 0, noDet = iter % 3 === 0;
    const out = alias ? M : OUT;
    const init = (mem) => { writeF(mem, M, m); for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) mem.write32(OUT + 4 * i, 0xdeadbeef); mem.write32(DET, 0xcafef00d); };
    const { fast, ref } = both('D3DXMatrixInverse', [out, noDet ? 0 : DET, M], init);
    assert.equal(fast.eax, ref.eax, `return value, case ${iter}`);
    assert.deepEqual(words(fast.data), words(ref.data), `memory, case ${iter}: ${m.join(',')}`);
  }
});

test('D3DXVec{2,3,4}CatmullRom: the handler\'s bits (random points and s, output aliasing each input)', () => {
  const P = [DATA, DATA + 0x20, DATA + 0x40, DATA + 0x60], OUT = DATA + 0x80;
  for (const name of ['D3DXVec2CatmullRom', 'D3DXVec3CatmullRom', 'D3DXVec4CatmullRom']) {
    for (let iter = 0; iter < 1500; iter++) {
      const pts = P.map(() => Array.from({ length: 4 }, value));
      const s = iter % 7 === 0 ? [0, 1, -1, 0.5, NaN, 2][iter % 6] : (rnd() - 0.25) * 2;
      const out = iter % 5 === 4 ? OUT : P[iter % 5];
      const init = (mem) => { pts.forEach((p, i) => writeF(mem, P[i], p)); for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) mem.write32(OUT + 4 * i, 0xdeadbeef); };
      const { fast, ref } = both(name, [out, P[0], P[1], P[2], P[3], f32bits(s)], init, 0x100);
      assert.equal(fast.eax, ref.eax, `${name} return value`);
      assert.deepEqual(words(fast.data), words(ref.data), `${name} memory, case ${iter}`);
    }
  }
});

test('a pointer outside the WASM memory goes to JavaScript (an exit at the thunk)', () => {
  const prog = [0x68, ...le(0), 0x68, ...le(0), 0x68, ...le(0x7ffffff0), 0xff, 0x15, ...le(SLOTS), 0xf4];
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(prog));
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true, now: () => 0 });
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  jit.markFast(1, 'd3dx9_27.dll!D3DXMatrixInverse', true); mem.write32(SLOTS, THUNK_BASE + THUNK_SIZE);
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = 0x10009000; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  assert.equal(jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 }), EXIT.THUNK);
  assert.equal(cpu.eip, THUNK_BASE + THUNK_SIZE);
});
```

`tests/jit-fast-time.test.js`:

```js
// Time APIs answered by the dispatcher's fast path from the VM clock (runtime.js fastApi 19/28/20, env.mmTime /
// env.tickCount / env.now): timeGetTime and GetTickCount give the milliseconds from TICK_BASE as their JavaScript handlers
// do (wrapping at 2^32; each from its own counter, core/timer-res.js),
// QueryPerformanceCounter the clock in 100 ns units (nothing written through a null pointer), all without an exit.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory, THUNK_BASE } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { TICK_BASE } from '../src/cpu/jit/runtime.js';
import { TimerResolution } from '../src/core/timer-res.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, SLOTS = 0x10000100, OUT = 0x10001000, THUNK_SIZE = 16;
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
const call = (k) => [0xff, 0x15, ...le(SLOTS + 4 * k)];
const store = (a) => [0xa3, ...le(a)]; // mov [a], eax
const push = (v) => [0x68, ...le(v)];
const PROGRAM = [...call(0), ...store(OUT), ...call(1), ...store(OUT + 4), ...push(OUT + 8), ...call(2), ...store(OUT + 16), ...push(0), ...call(2), ...store(OUT + 20), 0xf4];

const res = new TimerResolution(); res.begin(1); // (timeGetTime by 1 ms, GetTickCount by the 15.625 ms tick)
function run(now) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(PROGRAM));
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true, now: () => now, mmTime: () => res.mmTime(now), tickCount: () => res.tickCount(now) });
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  ['winmm.dll!timeGetTime', 'kernel32.dll!GetTickCount', 'kernel32.dll!QueryPerformanceCounter'].forEach((key, k) => { jit.markFast(k + 1, key, true); mem.write32(SLOTS + 4 * k, THUNK_BASE + (k + 1) * THUNK_SIZE); });
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = 0x10009000; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  assert.equal(jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 }), EXIT.HALT, 'no exit to JavaScript');
  assert.equal(cpu.esp, 0x10009000, 'stdcall returns');
  return { tgt: mem.read32(OUT), gtc: mem.read32(OUT + 4), qpc: mem.read64(OUT + 8), qpcRet: mem.read32(OUT + 16), qpcNull: mem.read32(OUT + 20) };
}

test('time APIs from the VM clock without leaving the translated code, the JavaScript handlers\' values', () => {
  for (const now of [0, 1234.75, 1234.7, 5e6 + 0.999, 2 ** 32 + 17.5]) {
    const r = run(now), ms = (TICK_BASE + Math.floor(now)) >>> 0;
    assert.equal(r.tgt, ms, `timeGetTime at ${now}`);
    assert.equal(r.gtc, (TICK_BASE + Math.floor(Math.floor(now / 15.625) * 15.625)) >>> 0, `GetTickCount at ${now}`);
    assert.equal(r.qpc, BigInt(Math.floor(now * 10000)), `QueryPerformanceCounter at ${now}`);
    assert.deepEqual([r.qpcRet, r.qpcNull], [1, 1]);
  }
});
```

`tests/jit-fpu-mode-guard.test.js`:

```js
// x87 regions are specialized for the precision/rounding mode in force at their entry; an in-region transfer made
// after a mode write (FLDCW...) checks the mode and leaves the region when it differs (Emitter.fpuModeGuard). Here a
// loop switches between 24- and 53-bit precision on every iteration (FLDCW on both arms of a branch) and calls a
// function that saves the control word, sets truncation for an FISTP and restores it before its RET (a local return
// inside the region): every result stored must be the interpreter's, under both initial modes and any time slice.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';

//    mov ecx,20
// L: fld [esi] ; fmul [esi+4] ; fstp dword [edi+0x200] ; test ecx,1 ; jz A ; fldcw [ebx] ; jmp C
// A: fldcw [ebx+2]
// C: fld [esi+8] ; fdiv [esi+12] ; fstp qword [edi+ecx*8] ; call F ; dec ecx ; jnz L ; hlt
// F: fnstcw [ebx+8] ; fldcw [ebx+4] ; fld [esi+16] ; fistp dword [edi+ecx*4+0x100] ; fldcw [ebx+8] ; ret
const CODE_HEX = 'b914000000d906d84e04d99f00020000f7c1010000007404d92beb03d96b02d94608d8760cdd1ccfe8040000004975d5f4d97b08d96b04d94610db9c8f00010000d96b08c3';
const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000, OUT = 0x10001000, CW = 0x10002000;
const bytes = Uint8Array.from(CODE_HEX.match(/../g).map((h) => parseInt(h, 16)));
const HLT = CODE + bytes.indexOf(0xf4);

function setup(cw0) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, bytes);
  [1.1, 3.3, 1.0, 3.0, 2.7].forEach((v, i) => mem.writeF32(DATA + 4 * i, v));
  mem.write16(CW, 0x027f); mem.write16(CW + 2, 0x007f); mem.write16(CW + 4, 0x0c7f); // 53-bit, 24-bit, 24-bit truncating
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x8000; cpu.esi = DATA; cpu.edi = OUT; cpu.ebx = CW; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, cw0);
  return { mem, cpu };
}
const result = ({ mem, cpu }) => ({ out: Buffer.from(mem.bytes(OUT, 0x300)).toString('hex'), cw: mem.read16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW) }); // (EIP after HLT: the JIT reports the HLT itself)

test('regions specialized for an x87 mode check it on in-region transfers after FLDCW (loops, local calls/returns)', () => {
  for (const cw0 of [0x007f, 0x027f]) {
    const ref = setup(cw0);
    const I = new Interp(ref.mem, ref.cpu);
    assert.equal(I.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 }), EXIT.HALT);
    const want = result(ref);
    for (const slice of [1e6, 23, 7]) {
      const s = setup(cw0);
      const jit = new Jit(s.mem, new Interp(s.mem, s.cpu), { smc: true });
      jit.cpu = s.cpu;
      let r, n = 0;
      do r = jit.run({ maxInsns: slice }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE && ++n < 1e5);
      assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT, `cw ${cw0.toString(16)} slice ${slice}: exit ${r}`);
      assert.deepEqual(result(s), want, `cw ${cw0.toString(16)} slice ${slice}`);
      if (slice === 1e6) assert.equal(jit.stats.fallback, 0, 'no interpreter fallback in the loop');
    }
  }
});

// FST(P) m32 under a directed rounding known statically (a region specialized for it) rounds inline (no kernel):
// every rounding control at 53- and 64-bit precision, on values at the edges — overflow past the largest float,
// denormals, underflow to zero, both zeros, 2^24 + 1, NaN.
test('FSTP m32 under directed rounding at 53/64-bit precision: the interpreter\'s results for edge values', () => {
  // xor ecx,ecx ; L: fld qword [esi+ecx*8] ; fstp dword [edi+ecx*4] ; inc ecx ; cmp ecx,16 ; jne L ; hlt
  const code = Uint8Array.from('31c9dd04ced91c8f4183f91075f4f4'.match(/../g).map((h) => parseInt(h, 16)));
  const values = [1 / 3, -1 / 3, 1e39, -1e39, 3.4028235677973366e38, -3.4028235677973366e38, 1e-40, -1e-40, 1e-50, -1e-50, 0, -0, 16777217, -16777217, NaN, 2.5];
  const run = (cw, useJit) => {
    const mem = new GuestMemory();
    const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
    cpu.reset();
    mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
    values.forEach((v, i) => mem.writeF64(DATA + 8 * i, v));
    cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x8000; cpu.esi = DATA; cpu.edi = OUT; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
    mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, cw);
    const I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
    let r;
    if (useJit) { const jit = new Jit(mem, I, { smc: true }); jit.cpu = cpu; r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 }); assert.equal(jit.stats.fallback, 0); }
    else r = I.run({ maxInsns: 1e6 });
    assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT);
    return Buffer.from(mem.bytes(OUT, 4 * values.length)).toString('hex');
  };
  for (const pc of [0x200, 0x300]) for (const rc of [0x000, 0x400, 0x800, 0xc00]) {
    const cw = 0x7f | pc | rc;
    assert.equal(run(cw, true), run(cw, false), `control word ${cw.toString(16)}`);
  }
});
```

`tests/jit-heat-adversarial.test.js`:

```js
// Adversarial review of heat-shaped regions (translate.js opts.coldExits, heat.js): random programs mixing integer
// code, x87 arithmetic under control-word changes (FLDCW inside the program: x87-mode versions of regions), divisions
// that may fault (#DE: precise exits) and calls, run several times on ONE Jit whose heat is replaced between runs by
// another random heat (heat growing and shrinking between sessions, successors marked cold that then run), with
// random code ranges invalidated between runs (translated again under the new heat, as after self-modifying code),
// the initial x87 mode changing between runs, whole and time-sliced. Every run ends as the interpreter does: exit
// code, EIP, registers, flags, x87 control word and TOP, data.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { decode } from '../src/cpu/decoder.js';
import { RangeHeat } from '../src/cpu/jit/heat.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const ARITH = F.CF | F.PF | F.AF | F.ZF | F.SF | F.OF;
let seed = 4343;
const rnd = (n) => { seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0; return (seed >>> 8) % n; };
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
const R3 = () => rnd(4); // eax ecx edx ebx
const CWS = [0x027f, 0x007f, 0x0c7f, 0x037f]; // (at esi+0x70.., loaded by FLDCW)
const unit = () => {
  switch (rnd(9)) {
    case 0: return [0x01, 0xc0 | (R3() << 3) | R3()];
    case 1: return [0x83, 0xc0 | (rnd(8) << 3) | R3(), rnd(256)];
    case 2: return [0x89, 0x46 | (R3() << 3), 4 * rnd(16)]; // mov [esi+d8], r
    case 3: return [0xd1, 0xe0 | (rnd(2) ? 8 : 0) | R3()];
    case 4: return [0x31, 0xd2, 0xf7, 0xf3]; // xor edx, edx ; div ebx (#DE when ebx = 0)
    case 5: return [0xd9, 0x6e, 0x70 + 2 * rnd(4)]; // fldcw [esi+0x70+2k]
    case 6: { // fld dword [esi+a] ; fadd / fmul / fsub dword [esi+b] ; fstp dword [esi+c]
      const op = [[0xd8, 0x46], [0xd8, 0x4e], [0xd8, 0x66]][rnd(3)];
      return [0xd9, 0x46, 4 * rnd(16), ...op, 4 * rnd(16), 0xd9, 0x5e, 4 * rnd(16)];
    }
    case 7: return [0xdb, 0x46, 4 * rnd(16), 0xdb, 0x5e, 4 * rnd(16)]; // fild / fistp dword (rounding control)
    default: return [0x31, 0xdb]; // xor ebx, ebx (divisions by zero likelier)
  }
};

/** blocks `dec edi ; jz end ; <unit>* ; <terminator>` (Jcc / JMP to a random block, CALL of a leaf function, fallthrough) */
function gen() {
  const nb = 4 + rnd(10), nf = 1 + rnd(3);
  const kinds = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) kinds.push('b');
  for (let i = 0; i < nf; i++) kinds.splice(rnd(kinds.length + 1), 0, 'f');
  kinds.unshift('b');
  const fns = kinds.map((k, i) => (k === 'f' ? i : -1)).filter((i) => i >= 0), blocksIdx = kinds.map((k, i) => (k === 'b' ? i : -1)).filter((i) => i >= 0);
  const out = [], start = [], fix = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < kinds.length; i++) {
    start[i] = out.length;
    if (kinds[i] === 'f') { for (let k = rnd(3); k >= 0; k--) out.push(...unit()); out.push(0xc3); continue; }
    out.push(0x4f, 0x0f, 0x84); fix.push([out.length, -1]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0);
    for (let k = rnd(4); k > 0; k--) out.push(...unit());
    const tgt = blocksIdx[rnd(blocksIdx.length)];
    switch (rnd(4)) {
      case 0: out.push(0x0f, 0x80 + rnd(16)); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); break;
      case 1: out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); break;
      case 2: out.push(0xe8); fix.push([out.length, fns[rnd(fns.length)]]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0);
        if (i + 1 < kinds.length && kinds[i + 1] === 'f') { out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, blocksIdx[rnd(blocksIdx.length)]]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); }
        break;
      default: if (i + 1 < kinds.length && kinds[i + 1] === 'f') { out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); } break;
    }
  }
  if (kinds[kinds.length - 1] === 'f') { out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, 0]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); }
  const end = out.length; out.push(0xf4);
  for (const [at, t] of fix) out.splice(at, 4, ...le((t < 0 ? end : start[t]) - (at + 4)));
  return { code: Uint8Array.from(out), end };
}

const V = [0, 1, 2, 0x7f, 0x80, 0xffff, 0x3f800000, 0x7fffffff, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff, 0x12345678];
const val = () => (rnd(2) ? V[rnd(V.length)] : ((rnd(65536) << 16) | rnd(65536)) >>> 0);
const input = () => ({ regs: [val(), val(), val(), val(), rnd(0x1000)], edi: 20 + rnd(300), cw: CWS[rnd(CWS.length)], data: Array.from({ length: 16 }, () => (rnd(3) ? [0x3f800000, 0x40490fdb, 0xc2c80000, 0x4b000001, 0x3eaaaaab][rnd(5)] : val())) });
function init(mem, cpu, inp) {
  cpu.reset(); mem.fill(DATA, 0x1000, 0);
  inp.data.forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(DATA + 0x100 + 4 * i, v));
  CWS.forEach((cw, i) => mem.write16(DATA + 0x170 + 2 * i, cw));
  [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx] = inp.regs; cpu.edi = inp.edi; cpu.esi = DATA + 0x100; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; cpu.eip = CODE;
  cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF | (inp.regs[4] & ARITH);
  mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, inp.cw);
}
const stateOf = (r, mem, cpu) => [r, cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx, cpu.esp, cpu.edi, cpu.eflags & ARITH, cpu.eip, mem.read16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW), mem.u8[cpu.base + ST.FPU_TOP] & 7].map((v) => (v >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ') + ' ' + [...mem.bytes(DATA + 0x100, 0x80), ...mem.bytes(DATA + 0x700, 0x100)].join(',');
function setup(code) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory(), cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  mem.fill(CODE, 0x1000, 0xcc); mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
  return { mem, cpu };
}
function randomHeat(addrs) {
  const h = rnd(2) ? new RangeHeat() : new Map();
  for (let i = 0; i < addrs.length; i++) {
    if (rnd(3) === 0) continue; // never ran
    if (h instanceof Map) h.set(addrs[i], rnd(4) ? 1000 : 1 + rnd(100));
    else h.add(addrs[i], i + 1 < addrs.length ? addrs[i + 1] : addrs[i] + 1);
  }
  return h;
}

test('heat replaced between runs, code invalidated, x87 modes, faults: every run matches the interpreter', () => {
  let faults = 0, versions = 0, regionsMore = 0;
  for (let t = 0; t < 80; t++) {
    const { code, end } = gen();
    const scratch = new GuestMemory(); scratch.writeBytes(CODE, code);
    const addrs = [];
    for (let a = 0; a <= end;) { addrs.push(CODE + a); a = decode(scratch, CODE + a).next - CODE; }
    const { mem, cpu } = setup(code);
    const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true, coldExits: true, coldMin: 1 + rnd(3) });
    jit.cpu = cpu;
    for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
      const inp = input();
      const ref = setup(code); init(ref.mem, ref.cpu, inp);
      const want = stateOf(new Interp(ref.mem, ref.cpu).run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: 1e7 }), ref.mem, ref.cpu);
      jit.heat = rnd(5) ? randomHeat(addrs) : null;
      if (rnd(3) === 0) { const a = addrs[rnd(addrs.length)]; jit.invalidate(a, 1 + rnd(16)); }
      const before = jit.regions.length;
      init(mem, cpu, inp);
      const slice = [1e7, 1, 3, 17][rnd(4)];
      let r;
      for (let n = 0; ; n++) {
        if (n > 1e6) throw new Error('runaway');
        r = jit.run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: slice });
        if (r !== EXIT.TIMESLICE) break;
      }
      CpuState.foldLazyFlags?.(cpu);
      if (r === EXIT.FAULT) faults++;
      if (jit.regions.length > before) regionsMore++;
      assert.equal(stateOf(r, mem, cpu), want, `program ${t} run ${k} slice ${slice}: ${Buffer.from(code).toString('hex')}`);
    }
    versions += jit.stats.fpuVersions ?? 0;
  }
  assert.ok(faults > 20, `runs ending in #DE: ${faults}`);
  assert.ok(versions > 5, `x87-mode versions: ${versions}`);
  assert.ok(regionsMore > 50, `runs translating new regions: ${regionsMore}`);
});

// Visit flags allocated after the area is full: no allocation keeps advancing the shared bump index (it would
// eventually wrap and hand out addresses outside the area), and nothing outside the area is written.
import { VisitSlots, allocBlockCounters } from '../src/cpu/jit/translate.js';
import { BLOCK_COUNTS_BASE, BLOCK_COUNTS_SLOTS } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
test('visit flags: an exhausted counter area stays exhausted (the bump index stops advancing)', () => {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const slots = new VisitSlots();
  let n = 0;
  while (slots.get(mem, 0x1000 + n) >= 0) n++;
  assert.ok(n > 300000 && n <= 4 * BLOCK_COUNTS_SLOTS, `flags allocated: ${n}`);
  const idx = mem.i32[BLOCK_COUNTS_BASE >>> 2];
  for (let i = 0; i < 1000; i++) assert.equal(slots.get(mem, 0x900000 + i), -1);
  assert.equal(allocBlockCounters(mem, 2048), -1);
  assert.equal(mem.i32[BLOCK_COUNTS_BASE >>> 2], idx, 'bump index unchanged once full');
  // (a wrapped index — negative — is refused too)
  mem.i32[BLOCK_COUNTS_BASE >>> 2] = -0x7ffffff0;
  assert.equal(allocBlockCounters(mem, 1024), -1);
});
```

`tests/jit-heat-harvest.test.js`:

```js
// Incremental heat harvest (Jit.harvestVisitsStep) and the linear RangeHeat.merge, checked against copies of the
// algorithms they replaced: a whole harvest pass over every live region, and a merge sorting all ranges again.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { RangeHeat } from '../src/cpu/jit/heat.js';

let seed = 0x5eed1234;
const rnd = (n) => { seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0; return (seed >>> 8) % n; };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the previous algorithms (reference copies)
/** the previous Jit.harvestVisits over the live regions ({ visits: [[eip, end, flag address], ...] | null }) */
function oldHarvest(u8, regions) {
  const out = [], seen = new Set();
  for (const r of regions) {
    const v = r.visits; if (!v) continue;
    let left = 0;
    for (const e of v) {
      if (e[2] < 0) continue;
      if (u8[e[2]]) { if (!seen.has(e[0])) { seen.add(e[0]); out.push(e[0], e[1]); } e[2] = -1; } else left++;
    }
    if (!left) r.visits = null;
  }
  return out;
}
/** the previous RangeHeat.merge: lo/hi of the merged ranges lo0/hi0 and the added ones */
function oldMerge(lo0, hi0, addLo, addHi) {
  const n = lo0.length + addLo.length, idx = new Array(n), L = new Float64Array(n), H = new Float64Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < lo0.length; i++) { L[i] = lo0[i]; H[i] = hi0[i]; }
  for (let i = 0; i < addLo.length; i++) { L[lo0.length + i] = addLo[i]; H[lo0.length + i] = addHi[i]; }
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) idx[i] = i;
  idx.sort((a, b) => L[a] - L[b]);
  const lo = [], hi = [];
  for (const i of idx) {
    if (lo.length && L[i] <= hi[hi.length - 1]) { if (H[i] > hi[hi.length - 1]) hi[hi.length - 1] = H[i]; } else { lo.push(L[i]); hi.push(H[i]); }
  }
  return { lo: Int32Array.from(lo), hi: Int32Array.from(hi) };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- harvest
/**
 * A Jit reduced to what the harvest uses (guest bytes, the regions with visit flags, heatAdd), and a mirror of its
 * regions for the old harvest: add() registers a region in both (as Jit.register), drop() drops it (as Jit.dropOne).
 */
function world() {
  const u8 = new Uint8Array(1 << 15), slots = new Map(); // (one flag per block address, as VisitSlots)
  const jit = Object.create(Jit.prototype);
  jit.mem = { u8 }; jit.visitRegions = []; jit.harvestAt = 0; jit.harvestKept = 0; jit.harvestOut = null; jit.harvestSeen = null;
  jit.added = []; jit.heatAdd = (pairs) => { for (const x of pairs) jit.added.push(x); };
  const regions = [], live = []; let nextId = 1;
  const w = {
    u8, slots, jit, live, regions,
    add() {
      const visits = [], used = new Set(), id = nextId++;
      for (let b = 0, nb = 1 + rnd(12); b < nb; b++) {
        const eip = 0x400000 + 16 * rnd(800); if (used.has(eip)) continue; used.add(eip);
        let a = slots.get(eip); if (a === undefined) { a = 16 + slots.size; slots.set(eip, a); }
        visits.push([eip, eip + id, a]); // (a block's end tells its region: a pair reported twice shows)
      }
      const r = { visits: visits.length ? visits : null, alive: true }, twin = { visits: r.visits && r.visits.map((e) => e.slice()) };
      r.twin = twin; regions.push(r); live.push(twin);
      if (r.visits) jit.visitRegions.push(r);
    },
    drop() {
      const l = regions.filter((r) => r.alive); if (!l.length) return;
      const r = l[rnd(l.length)]; r.alive = false; r.visits = null; live.splice(live.indexOf(r.twin), 1);
    },
    setFlags(n) { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) u8[16 + rnd(Math.max(1, slots.size))] = 1; },
  };
  return w;
}
const keys = (p) => { const s = []; for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 2) s.push(`${p[i]}-${p[i + 1]}`); return s; };
const eipsOf = (p) => { const s = new Set(); for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 2) s.add(p[i]); return s; };
const BUDGETS = [0, 1e-6, 0.02, Infinity];

test('harvestVisitsStep: a pass gives exactly the old harvest\'s pairs (budgets 0, tiny, Infinity), the heat gets them', () => {
  for (let t = 0; t < 300; t++) {
    const w = world(), budget = BUDGETS[rnd(BUDGETS.length)];
    for (let i = 0, n = rnd(400); i < n; i++) w.add();
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 4; pass++) {
      w.setFlags(rnd(pass ? 60 : 300));
      if (pass) for (let i = 0, n = rnd(40); i < n; i++) w.add(); // (blocks already reported, translated again)
      let out, steps = 0;
      while (!(out = w.jit.harvestVisitsStep(budget))) steps++;
      if (budget === Infinity) assert.equal(steps, 0);
      const old = oldHarvest(w.u8, w.live);
      assert.deepEqual(keys(out).sort(), keys(old).sort(), `trial ${t} pass ${pass}`);
      assert.deepEqual(w.jit.added.splice(0), out, 'added to the heat');
      // the regions left are those with a flag not set yet, in registration order
      assert.deepEqual(w.jit.visitRegions.map((r) => r.twin), w.live.filter((r) => r.visits));
    }
    for (let a = 16; a < 16 + w.slots.size; a++) w.u8[a] = 1;
    assert.deepEqual(keys(w.jit.harvestVisits()).sort(), keys(oldHarvest(w.u8, w.live)).sort());
    assert.equal(w.jit.visitRegions.length, 0);
    assert.equal(w.jit.harvestVisits().length, 0);
  }
});

test('harvestVisitsStep: flags set and regions registered between steps — each reported once, same blocks as the old harvest', () => {
  for (let t = 0; t < 300; t++) {
    const w = world(), budget = BUDGETS[rnd(3)]; // (budgets that cut passes)
    for (let i = 0, n = 64 + rnd(400); i < n; i++) w.add();
    const got = [], want = [];
    let cut = 0;
    for (let round = 0; round < 40; round++) {
      const k = rnd(3);
      if (k === 0) w.setFlags(1 + rnd(20)); else if (k === 1) w.add();
      const out = w.jit.harvestVisitsStep(budget);
      if (out) { got.push(...keys(out)); want.push(...eipsOf(oldHarvest(w.u8, w.live))); } else cut++;
    }
    let out; while (!(out = w.jit.harvestVisitsStep(budget))); got.push(...keys(out)); want.push(...eipsOf(oldHarvest(w.u8, w.live)));
    out = w.jit.harvestVisits(); got.push(...keys(out)); want.push(...eipsOf(oldHarvest(w.u8, w.live))); // (flags set during the last pass)
    assert.equal(new Set(got).size, got.length, `trial ${t}: a region's block reported twice`);
    assert.deepEqual(new Set(got.map((s) => Number(s.split('-')[0]))), new Set(want), `trial ${t}`);
    for (const s of got) assert.ok(w.u8[w.slots.get(Number(s.split('-')[0]))], 'reported flag set');
    if (budget === 0) assert.ok(cut > 0);
  }
});

test('harvestVisitsStep: regions dropped between steps — their flags not reported after the drop, the others all reported', () => {
  for (let t = 0; t < 300; t++) {
    const w = world(), budget = BUDGETS[rnd(3)];
    for (let i = 0, n = 64 + rnd(400); i < n; i++) w.add();
    const got = [];
    for (let round = 0; round < 40; round++) {
      const k = rnd(4);
      if (k === 0) w.setFlags(1 + rnd(20)); else if (k === 1) w.add(); else if (k === 2) w.drop();
      const out = w.jit.harvestVisitsStep(budget);
      if (out) got.push(...keys(out));
    }
    // (as a real drop: what a dropped region found before its drop was reported; nothing of it after)
    let out; while (!(out = w.jit.harvestVisitsStep(budget))); got.push(...keys(out));
    got.push(...keys(w.jit.harvestVisits()));
    assert.equal(new Set(got).size, got.length, `trial ${t}: reported twice`);
    for (const s of got) assert.ok(w.u8[w.slots.get(Number(s.split('-')[0]))], 'reported flag set');
    // every set flag of a live region was reported (by it or by another region holding the block)
    const eips = new Set(got.map((s) => Number(s.split('-')[0])));
    for (const r of w.regions) if (r.alive) for (const e of r.twin.visits ?? []) if (e[2] >= 0 && w.u8[e[2]]) assert.ok(eips.has(e[0]), `trial ${t}: ${e[0].toString(16)} missed`);
    assert.ok(w.jit.visitRegions.every((r) => r.alive && r.visits));
  }
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- merge
test('RangeHeat.merge: lo/hi identical to sorting all ranges (overlapping, nested, adjacent, duplicate, empty ranges)', () => {
  for (let t = 0; t < 2000; t++) {
    const h = new RangeHeat();
    let lo = new Int32Array(0), hi = new Int32Array(0), aLo = [], aHi = [];
    const span = [50, 400, 5000, 0x7ff00000][rnd(4)];
    for (let op = 0, n = 1 + rnd(30); op < n; op++) {
      const k = rnd(10);
      if (k < 6) {
        const pairs = [];
        for (let i = 0, m = t % 10 === 0 && op % 3 === 0 ? rnd(3000) : rnd(25); i < m; i++) { // (and a few new ranges among many: runs copied)
          const a = rnd(span), kind = rnd(6);
          const b = Math.min(0x7fffffff, kind === 0 ? a : kind === 1 ? a - rnd(3) : a + 1 + rnd(kind === 2 ? 3 : kind === 3 ? 64 : 4000)); // (empty, reversed, short, long, nesting)
          pairs.push(a, b);
          if (rnd(5) === 0) pairs.push(b, Math.min(0x7fffffff, b + rnd(9))); // (adjacent)
          if (rnd(7) === 0) pairs.push(a, b); // (duplicate)
        }
        h.addPairs(rnd(2) ? pairs : Int32Array.from(pairs));
        for (let i = 0; i + 1 < pairs.length; i += 2) if (pairs[i + 1] > pairs[i]) { aLo.push(pairs[i]); aHi.push(pairs[i + 1]); }
      } else if (k < 8) {
        h.merge(); ({ lo, hi } = oldMerge(lo, hi, aLo, aHi)); aLo = []; aHi = [];
        assert.deepEqual([...h.lo], [...lo], `trial ${t} lo`); assert.deepEqual([...h.hi], [...hi], `trial ${t} hi`); assert.equal(h.size, lo.length);
      } else {
        ({ lo, hi } = oldMerge(lo, hi, aLo, aHi)); aLo = []; aHi = [];
        for (let q = 0; q < 8; q++) {
          const a = q < 4 && lo.length ? [lo, hi][q & 1][rnd(lo.length)] - (q >> 1) : rnd(span + 10);
          let want = false; for (let i = 0; i < lo.length; i++) if (lo[i] <= a && a < hi[i]) want = true;
          assert.equal(h.has(a), want, `trial ${t} has ${a}`);
        }
      }
    }
    ({ lo, hi } = oldMerge(lo, hi, aLo, aHi));
    assert.deepEqual([...h.pairs()], [...lo].flatMap((x, i) => [x, hi[i]]));
  }
});
```

`tests/jit-ifcvt.test.js`:

```js
// If-conversion (translate.js ifcvtPlan / emitIfcvt): looped programs of random blocks ending in branches over short
// arms — triangles, mirrored triangles (the arm after the loop, jumping back) and diamonds — whose arms hold every kind
// of instruction the conversion accepts (moves, loads, LEA, ALU with registers / immediates / memory, INC/DEC/NEG/NOT,
// shifts by constants and CL, SETcc, CMOVcc, XCHG, CDQ/CWDE, BSWAP, 8/16-bit forms) and loads through a pointer the
// branch guards (an arm not taken must not touch its address: some are beyond the guest memory). Whole and time-sliced
// JIT runs, with and without if-conversion, against the interpreter: registers, arithmetic flags, EIP, exit code; the
// translations are checked to have converted branches.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
let seed = 7;
const rnd = (n) => { seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; return (seed >>> 8) % n; };
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
function makeExec(jitOpts) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory(); const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE); const I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
  const jit = jitOpts ? new Jit(mem, I, { smc: true, ...jitOpts }) : null;
  return {
    mem, cpu, jit,
    load(code, regs) {
      cpu.reset(); mem.fill(CODE, 0x10000, 0xcc); mem.fill(DATA, 0x1000, 0); mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
      for (let i = 0; i < 0x100; i++) mem.write32(DATA + 4 * i, Math.imul(i + 1, 0x9e3779b1));
      cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx, cpu.esi] = regs; cpu.edi = DATA + 0x40; cpu.ebp = 5;
      cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF | (regs[5] & 0x8d5);
    },
    run(stopAt, maxInsns) { if (!jit) return I.run({ stopAt, maxInsns }); jit.cpu = cpu; return jit.run({ stopAt, maxInsns }); },
  };
}
const R4 = () => rnd(4); // eax ecx edx ebx
/** an instruction an arm may hold (register destinations eax..ebx; loads from [edi+d8]) */
function armInsn() {
  const r = R4(), s = R4(), d8 = rnd(32) * 4, cc = rnd(16), n = rnd(8);
  switch (rnd(24)) {
    case 0: return [0x89, 0xc0 | (s << 3) | r]; // mov r, s
    case 1: return [0xb8 + r, ...le(rnd(1 << 30) * 3)]; // mov r, imm32
    case 2: return [0x8b, 0x40 | (r << 3) | 7, d8]; // mov r, [edi+d8]
    case 3: return [0x0f, 0xb6, 0x40 | (r << 3) | 7, d8 + rnd(4)]; // movzx r, byte [edi+d8]
    case 4: return [0x0f, 0xbf, 0x40 | (r << 3) | 7, d8]; // movsx r, word [edi+d8]
    case 5: return [0x8d, 0x44 | (r << 3), (2 << 6) | (s << 3) | R4(), rnd(256)]; // lea r, [b + s*4 + d8]
    case 6: return [0x01 | (n << 3), 0xc0 | (s << 3) | r]; // alu r, s
    case 7: return [0x83, 0xc0 | (n << 3) | r, rnd(256)]; // alu r, imm8
    case 8: return [0x03 | (n << 3), 0x40 | (r << 3) | 7, d8]; // alu r, [edi+d8]
    case 9: return [0xf7, 0xc0 | r, ...le(rnd(1 << 16) << rnd(16))]; // test r, imm32
    case 10: return [0x40 + r]; case 11: return [0x48 + r]; // inc / dec
    case 12: return [0xf7, 0xd8 | r]; case 13: return [0xf7, 0xd0 | r]; // neg / not
    case 14: return [0xc1, 0xe0 | ([4, 5, 7][rnd(3)] << 3) | r, rnd(32)]; // shl/shr/sar r, imm
    case 15: return r === 1 ? [0xd1, 0xe0 | r] : [0xd3, 0xe0 | ([4, 5, 7][rnd(3)] << 3) | r]; // shift r, cl
    case 16: return [0x0f, 0x90 + cc, 0xc0 | (rnd(2) ? r : r + 4)]; // setcc r8 (al..bl, ah..bh)
    case 17: return [0x0f, 0x40 + cc, 0xc0 | (r << 3) | s]; // cmovcc r, s
    case 18: return [0x87, 0xc0 | (s << 3) | r]; // xchg r, s
    case 19: return [rnd(2) ? 0x99 : 0x98]; // cdq / cwde
    case 20: return [0x0f, 0xc8 + r]; // bswap
    case 21: return [0x88, 0xc0 | (r << 3) | (s + 4 * rnd(2))]; // mov r8, r8 (high bytes too)
    case 22: return [0x66, 0x01 | (n << 3), 0xc0 | (s << 3) | r]; // 16-bit alu
    default: return [0x13 | (rnd(2) << 4), 0xc0 | (r << 3) | s]; // adc / sbb r, s
  }
}
/** a flag writer before a branch (or in a block body) */
function flagWriter() {
  const r = R4(), s = R4();
  switch (rnd(8)) {
    case 6: return [0x3b, 0x40 | (r << 3) | 7, rnd(32) * 4]; // cmp r, [edi+d8] (data: if-converted by the heuristic too)
    case 7: return [0x8b, 0x40 | (r << 3) | 7, rnd(32) * 4, 0x85, 0xc0 | (r << 3) | r]; // mov r, [edi+d8] ; test r, r
    case 0: return [0x39, 0xc0 | (s << 3) | r]; // cmp r, s
    case 1: return [0x85, 0xc0 | (s << 3) | r]; // test r, s
    case 2: return [0x83, 0xf8 | r, rnd(256)]; // cmp r, imm8
    case 3: return [0x40 + r]; // inc r
    case 4: return [0x29, 0xc0 | (s << 3) | r]; // sub r, s
    default: return [0xd1, 0xe8 | r]; // shr r, 1
  }
}
const arm = (max) => { const out = []; const n = 1 + rnd(max); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push(...armInsn()); return out; };
/**
 * A program: a loop (EBP times) over blocks, each a few flag writers / arm instructions then one of: a triangle
 * (jcc over an arm), a guarded load (test esi ; js over `mov r, [esi]`: esi may lie beyond the guest memory), a diamond
 * (jcc T ; arm ; jmp M ; T: arm ; M:), a mirrored triangle (jcc to an arm after the loop's end, which jumps back), or
 * nothing. Ends with `dec ebp ; jnz top ; hlt`.
 */
function gen() {
  const out = [], fix = [], tails = [];
  const nb = 2 + rnd(5);
  for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
    for (let k = rnd(3); k > 0; k--) out.push(...(rnd(2) ? flagWriter() : armInsn()));
    const cc = rnd(16);
    switch (rnd(6)) {
      case 0: case 1: { // triangle
        out.push(...flagWriter());
        const a = arm(3); out.push(0x70 + cc, a.length, ...a); break;
      }
      case 2: { // guarded load through esi
        out.push(0x85, 0xf6); // test esi, esi
        const a = [0x8b, 0x06 | (R4() << 3), ...(rnd(2) ? arm(1) : [])]; // mov r, [esi] (; one more)
        out.push(0x78, a.length, ...a); break; // js over it
      }
      case 3: { // diamond
        out.push(...flagWriter());
        const a = arm(2), b = arm(2);
        out.push(0x70 + cc, a.length + 2, ...a, 0xeb, b.length, ...b); break;
      }
      case 4: { // mirrored triangle: the arm placed after the loop
        out.push(...flagWriter());
        out.push(0x0f, 0x80 + cc); const at = out.length; out.push(0, 0, 0, 0);
        tails.push({ at, back: out.length, body: arm(3) }); break;
      }
      default: break;
    }
  }
  out.push(0x4d, 0x0f, 0x85, ...le(-(out.length + 7))); // dec ebp ; jnz top
  const end = out.length; out.push(0xf4); // hlt
  for (const t of tails) {
    fix.push([t.at, out.length]);
    out.push(...t.body, 0xe9); out.push(...le(t.back - (out.length + 4)));
  }
  for (const [at, tgt] of fix) out.splice(at, 4, ...le(tgt - (at + 4)));
  return { code: Uint8Array.from(out), end };
}
const V = [0, 1, 0x7f, 0x80, 0xff, 0x100, 0x7fff, 0x8000, 0xffff, 0x7fffffff, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff, 0x12345678, 0xdeadbeef];
const val = () => (rnd(3) ? V[rnd(V.length)] : ((rnd(65536) << 16) | rnd(65536)) >>> 0);
const ptr = () => [DATA + 4 * rnd(64), 0x80000000 + rnd(1 << 20) * 4, 0xfffffffc, DATA + 0x100][rnd(4)] >>> 0;
const state = (E) => [E.cpu.eax, E.cpu.ecx, E.cpu.edx, E.cpu.ebx, E.cpu.esi, E.cpu.edi, E.cpu.ebp, E.cpu.eflags & 0x8d5, E.cpu.eip].map((x) => (x >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ');

test('random branches over short arms: if-converted translations match the interpreter, whole and time-sliced', () => {
  let converted = 0, heuristic = 0;
  for (let t = 0; t < 250; t++) {
    const { code, end } = gen();
    const regs = [val(), rnd(40), val(), val(), ptr(), rnd(0x1000)];
    const EI = makeExec(null); EI.load(code, regs); const ri = EI.run(CODE + end, 1e5);
    for (const [opts, slice] of [[{ ifcvt: 'all' }, 0], [{ ifcvt: 'all' }, 1], [{ ifcvt: 'all' }, 3], [{ ifcvt: 'all' }, 17], [{ ifcvt: true }, 0], [{ ifcvt: false }, 0]]) {
      const EJ = makeExec(opts); EJ.load(code, regs);
      let r, k = 0;
      while ((r = EJ.run(CODE + end, slice || 1e5)) === EXIT.TIMESLICE && ++k < 1e6);
      if (opts.ifcvt === 'all' && !slice) converted += EJ.jit.stats.ifcvt;
      if (opts.ifcvt === true) heuristic += EJ.jit.stats.ifcvt;
      const msg = `program ${t}, ${JSON.stringify(opts)} slices ${slice}: ${Buffer.from(code).toString('hex')} regs ${regs.map((x) => (x >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ')}`;
      assert.equal(r, ri, msg);
      assert.equal(state(EJ), state(EI), msg);
    }
  }
  assert.ok(converted > 200 && heuristic > 50 && heuristic < converted, `branches converted: ${converted}, by the data heuristic: ${heuristic}`);
});
```

`tests/jit-imul-dead.test.js`:

```js
// opts.imulDead (translate.js HANDLERS[OP.IMUL]): a 32-bit two- or three-operand IMUL whose next instruction writes every
// arithmetic flag computes the low half alone (no 64-bit product for CF / OF). Randomized programs of IMUL forms
// (register, memory, imm8, imm32 operands, values overflowing or not) followed by flag writers (CMP, TEST, ADD, SAR by a
// constant, another IMUL), by flag readers of CF / OF (JO / JC / SETO / ADC / PUSHFD...) or by instructions keeping
// the flags (MOV, LEA, a store to memory), in blocks joined by Jcc / JMP and time-sliced: JIT with imulDead on and off
// against the interpreter, every register, the flags and memory compared. Also: the fast form is used where it may be.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { listRegion } from '../src/cpu/jit/listing.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
let seed = 11;
const rnd = (n) => { seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; return (seed >>> 8) % n; };
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
function makeExec(jitOpts) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory(); const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE); const I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
  const jit = jitOpts ? new Jit(mem, I, { smc: true, ...jitOpts }) : null;
  return { mem, cpu, load(code, regs) { cpu.reset(); mem.fill(CODE, 0x10000, 0xcc); mem.fill(DATA, 0x1000, 0); mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
    mem.write32(DATA + 0x100, regs[2] ^ 0x5a5aa5a5); mem.write32(DATA + 0x104, regs[0] * 3 + 7);
    cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx, , , cpu.esi, cpu.edi] = regs; cpu.ebp = DATA + 0x100; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF | (regs[8] & 0x8d5); },
    run(stopAt, maxInsns) { if (!jit) return I.run({ stopAt, maxInsns }); jit.cpu = cpu; return jit.run({ stopAt, maxInsns }); } };
}
// IMUL forms on eax / edx (ecx is the loop counter)
const M = () => {
  switch (rnd(7)) {
    case 0: return [0x0f, 0xaf, 0xc2]; // imul eax, edx
    case 1: return [0x0f, 0xaf, 0x55, 0x00]; // imul edx, [ebp]
    case 2: return [0x6b, 0xc0, rnd(256)]; // imul eax, eax, imm8
    case 3: return [0x69, 0xd0, ...le((rnd(65536) << 16 | rnd(65536)) >>> 0)]; // imul edx, eax, imm32
    case 4: return [0x0f, 0xaf, 0x45, 0x04]; // imul eax, [ebp+4]
    case 5: return [0x66, 0x0f, 0xaf, 0xc2]; // imul ax, dx (16-bit: not the fast form)
    default: return [0x6b, 0xd2, 0x7f]; // imul edx, edx, 127
  }
};
// what follows: flag writers, readers of CF / OF (and the rest), instructions keeping the flags
const N = () => {
  const cc = rnd(16);
  switch (rnd(14)) {
    case 0: return [0x39, 0xd0]; // cmp eax, edx
    case 1: return [0x85, 0xc0]; // test eax, eax
    case 2: return [0x01, 0xc2]; // add edx, eax
    case 3: return [0xc1, 0xf8, 1 + rnd(31)]; // sar eax, imm
    case 4: return [0x0f, 0x90, 0xc3, 0x8d, 0x34, 0x73]; // seto bl ; lea esi, [ebx+esi*2]
    case 5: return [0x0f, 0x92, 0xc3, 0x8d, 0x34, 0x73]; // setc bl ; lea esi, [ebx+esi*2]
    case 6: return [0x13, 0xf8]; // adc edi, eax
    case 7: return [0x9c, 0x5b, 0x81, 0xe3, ...le(0x8d5), 0x8d, 0x34, 0x73]; // pushfd ; pop ebx ; and ebx, 0x8d5 ; lea esi,...
    case 8: return [0x89, 0xc3]; // mov ebx, eax (flags kept)
    case 9: return [0x89, 0x45, 0x08]; // mov [ebp+8], eax (a store, flags kept)
    case 10: return [0x8d, 0x7c, 0x07, 0x01]; // lea edi, [edi+eax+1]
    case 11: return [0x0f, 0x40 + cc, 0xf8]; // cmovcc edi, eax
    case 12: return [0x47]; // inc edi (keeps CF)
    default: return M();
  }
};
function gen() {
  const nb = 5 + rnd(6), blocks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) { const body = []; const n = 1 + rnd(4); for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) body.push(...M(), ...N()); blocks.push(body); }
  const out = []; const fix = []; const start = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
    start[i] = out.length; out.push(...blocks[i]);
    const t = rnd(4);
    if (i < nb - 1 && t < 3) { const tgt = i + 1 + rnd(nb - i - 1); const cc = rnd(16);
      if (t === 0) out.push(0xe9); else out.push(0x0f, 0x80 + cc); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); }
  }
  start[nb] = out.length; out.push(0x49, 0x0f, 0x85, ...le(-(out.length + 7)), 0xf4); // dec ecx ; jnz start ; hlt
  for (const [at, tgt] of fix) out.splice(at, 4, ...le(start[tgt] - (at + 4)));
  return Uint8Array.from(out);
}
const V = [0, 1, 2, 0x7f, 0x80, 0xffff, 0x10000, 0x7fffffff, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff, 0x12345678, 0x40000000, 0xdeadbeef];
const val = () => rnd(3) ? V[rnd(V.length)] : (rnd(65536) << 16 | rnd(65536)) >>> 0;

test('imulDead: random IMUL programs match the interpreter (on and off, whole and time-sliced)', () => {
  for (let t = 0; t < 120; t++) {
    const code = gen(); const end = CODE + code.length - 1;
    const regs = [val(), 1 + rnd(20), val(), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, rnd(0x1000)];
    const EI = makeExec(null); EI.load(code, regs); const ri = EI.run(end, 1e5);
    const snap = (E) => [E.cpu.eax, E.cpu.ecx, E.cpu.edx, E.cpu.ebx, E.cpu.esi, E.cpu.edi, E.cpu.eflags & 0x8d5, E.cpu.eip, E.mem.read32(DATA + 0x100), E.mem.read32(DATA + 0x108)].map((x) => (x >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ');
    const a = snap(EI);
    for (const imulDead of [true, false]) for (const slice of [0, 2, 5, 13]) {
      const EJ = makeExec({ imulDead }); EJ.load(code, regs); let r, k = 0;
      while ((r = EJ.run(end, slice || 1e5)) === EXIT.TIMESLICE && ++k < 1e5);
      const what = `program ${t}, imulDead ${imulDead}, slices ${slice}: ${Buffer.from(code).toString('hex')} regs ${regs.map((x) => x.toString(16)).join(' ')}`;
      assert.equal(r, ri, what);
      assert.equal(snap(EJ), a, what);
    }
  }
});

test('imulDead: no 64-bit product when the next instruction overwrites the flags, one when they are read', () => {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const ops = (code, opts = {}) => { mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code)); return listRegion(mem, CODE, { imulDead: true, ...opts }).text; };
  // imul eax, edx ; cmp eax, 5 ; ret
  assert.doesNotMatch(ops([0x0f, 0xaf, 0xc2, 0x83, 0xf8, 0x05, 0xc3]), /i64mul/);
  // imul eax, edx ; jo +0 ; ret: OF read
  assert.match(ops([0x0f, 0xaf, 0xc2, 0x70, 0x00, 0xc3]), /i64mul/);
  // imul eax, edx ; mov [ebp], eax ; cmp eax, 5 ; ret: a store between, the flags kept exact
  assert.match(ops([0x0f, 0xaf, 0xc2, 0x89, 0x45, 0x00, 0x83, 0xf8, 0x05, 0xc3]), /i64mul/);
  // off: always the 64-bit product
  assert.match(ops([0x0f, 0xaf, 0xc2, 0x83, 0xf8, 0x05, 0xc3], { imulDead: false }), /i64mul/);
});
```

`tests/jit-inline-api.test.js`:

```js
// Fast APIs run inline in regions (translate.js inlineApiOf / emitInlineApi) against the dispatcher's fast path
// (runtime.js fastApi) that they reproduce: every inlinable API through `call dword ptr [slot]`, two through an import
// stub `jmp dword ptr [slot]`, and a TLS index beyond the TEB's slots (left to the JavaScript handler: an exit, handled
// here) — registers, memory, the TEB and a critical section must end identical with and without inlining, under any
// time slice.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory, THUNK_BASE } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { PROC_CONSTS } from '../src/cpu/jit/runtime.js';

const CODE_HEX = '';
const CODE = 0x20000000, SLOTS = 0x10000100, OUT = 0x10001000, TEB = 0x10002000, CS = 0x10003000, COUNTER = 0x10003100;
const THUNK_SIZE = 16;
const APIS = ['SetLastError', 'GetLastError', 'TlsGetValue', 'TlsSetValue', 'EnterCriticalSection', 'LeaveCriticalSection', 'InterlockedIncrement', 'InterlockedDecrement', 'InterlockedExchange', 'InterlockedExchangeAdd', 'InterlockedCompareExchange', 'GetCurrentThreadId', 'GetCurrentProcessId', 'GetProcessHeap'];
const bytes = Uint8Array.from(CODE_HEX.match(/../g).map((h) => parseInt(h, 16)));

function run(inlineApi, slice) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, bytes);
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true, inlineApi });
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  APIS.forEach((n, k) => { jit.markFast(k + 1, `kernel32.dll!${n}`, true); mem.write32(SLOTS + 4 * k, THUNK_BASE + (k + 1) * THUNK_SIZE); });
  mem.write32(TEB + 0x20, 0x4d2); mem.write32(TEB + 0x24, 0x800); mem.write32(TEB + 0x34, 0);
  for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) mem.write32(TEB + 0xe10 + 4 * i, 0x1000 + i);
  mem.write32(CS + 4, -1); mem.write32(CS + 8, 0); mem.write32(CS + 12, 0);
  mem.write32(COUNTER, 13);
  mem.write32(PROC_CONSTS, 0x777);
  cpu.fsBase = TEB; cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = 0x10008000; cpu.edi = OUT; cpu.esi = CS; cpu.ebp = COUNTER; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  let r, n = 0, handled = 0;
  for (;;) {
    r = jit.run({ maxInsns: slice });
    if (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE && ++n < 1e5) continue;
    if (r === EXIT.THUNK) { // the JavaScript handler's part: TlsGetValue of an index beyond the TEB's slots
      const ret = mem.read32(cpu.esp);
      assert.equal(cpu.eip, THUNK_BASE + 3 * THUNK_SIZE, 'only TlsGetValue(70) leaves');
      cpu.eax = 0xabcd; cpu.esp = cpu.esp + 8; cpu.eip = ret; handled++;
      continue;
    }
    break;
  }
  assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT);
  return {
    state: { out: Buffer.from(mem.bytes(OUT, 64)).toString('hex'), teb: Buffer.from(mem.bytes(TEB + 0x20, 24)).toString('hex'), cs: Buffer.from(mem.bytes(CS, 16)).toString('hex'), counter: mem.read32(COUNTER), esp: cpu.esp, eax: cpu.eax, handled },
    inlined: jit.stats.inlineApi ?? 0,
  };
}

test('fast APIs inline in regions: the dispatcher fast path\'s results, with calls and import stubs, any time slice', () => {
  const want = run(false, 1e6);
  assert.equal(want.inlined, 0);
  assert.deepEqual(want.state.handled, 1);
  assert.equal(want.state.counter, 99);
  assert.equal(Buffer.from(want.state.out, 'hex').readUInt32LE(52), 0, 'TlsGetValue clears the last error');
  for (const slice of [1e6, 13, 3]) {
    const got = run(true, slice);
    assert.deepEqual(got.state, want.state, `slice ${slice}`);
    if (slice === 1e6) assert.ok(got.inlined >= 16, `call sites inlined: ${got.inlined}`);
  }
});
```

`tests/jit-layout.test.js`:

```js
// Block layout in reverse postorder (translate.js opts.layout, layoutBlocks): random programs of blocks joined by
// forward and backward conditional branches, jumps, and calls to leaf functions placed before or after their callers
// (so that in address order their returns go backward through the region's dispatch, and forward in reverse
// postorder), every block counting down EDI to a bounded end. The JIT with the layout matches the interpreter (registers,
// arithmetic flags, the stack written by the calls), whole and time-sliced; and its time slices end at the same
// addresses, after the same instruction counts, as without the layout (the budget is checked on the transfers backward
// in address order whatever the emission order: the threads' interleavings do not change).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { decode } from '../src/cpu/decoder.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const ARITH = F.CF | F.PF | F.AF | F.ZF | F.SF | F.OF;
let seed = 4242;
const rnd = (n) => { seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0; return (seed >>> 8) % n; };
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
const R3 = () => [0, 1, 2, 3][rnd(4)]; // eax ecx edx ebx
const alu = () => [[0x01, 0xc0 | (R3() << 3) | R3()], [0x83, 0xc0 | (rnd(8) << 3) | R3(), rnd(256)], [0x8d, 0x40 | (R3() << 3) | R3(), rnd(128)], [0xd1, 0xe0 | (rnd(2) ? 8 : 0) | R3()]][rnd(4)];

/**
 * blocks: k of them, each `dec edi ; jz end ; <alu>* ; <terminator>`, the terminator a Jcc / JMP to a random block, a CALL
 * to one of the leaf functions, or a fallthrough; the leaf functions (`<alu>* ; ret`) are placed among the blocks.
 */
function gen() {
  const nb = 4 + rnd(8), nf = 1 + rnd(3);
  const kinds = []; // 'b' block, 'f' function
  for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) kinds.push('b');
  for (let i = 0; i < nf; i++) kinds.splice(rnd(kinds.length + 1), 0, 'f');
  kinds.unshift('b'); // (the entry is a block)
  const fns = kinds.map((k, i) => (k === 'f' ? i : -1)).filter((i) => i >= 0), blocksIdx = kinds.map((k, i) => (k === 'b' ? i : -1)).filter((i) => i >= 0);
  const out = [], start = [], fix = []; // fix: [at, target index, rel32]
  for (let i = 0; i < kinds.length; i++) {
    start[i] = out.length;
    if (kinds[i] === 'f') { for (let k = rnd(3); k >= 0; k--) out.push(...alu()); out.push(0xc3); continue; }
    out.push(0x4f, 0x0f, 0x84); fix.push([out.length, -1]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); // dec edi ; jz end
    for (let k = rnd(3); k > 0; k--) out.push(...alu());
    const tgt = blocksIdx[rnd(blocksIdx.length)];
    switch (rnd(4)) {
      case 0: out.push(0x0f, 0x80 + rnd(16)); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); break; // jcc
      case 1: out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); break; // jmp
      case 2: out.push(0xe8); fix.push([out.length, fns[rnd(fns.length)]]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); // call fn, then on
        if (i + 1 < kinds.length && kinds[i + 1] === 'f') { out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, blocksIdx[rnd(blocksIdx.length)]]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); }
        break;
      default: if (i + 1 < kinds.length && kinds[i + 1] === 'f') { out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, tgt]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); } break; // fallthrough (not into a function)
    }
  }
  // the last block falls through to the end
  if (kinds[kinds.length - 1] === 'f') { out.push(0xe9); fix.push([out.length, 0]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); }
  const end = out.length; out.push(0xf4);
  for (const [at, t] of fix) out.splice(at, 4, ...le((t < 0 ? end : start[t]) - (at + 4)));
  return { code: Uint8Array.from(out), end };
}
function run(code, end, regs, jitOpts, slice) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory(), cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset(); mem.fill(CODE, 0x1000, 0xcc); mem.writeBytes(CODE, code); mem.fill(DATA, 0x1000, 0);
  [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx] = regs; cpu.edi = 200 + rnd(300); cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; cpu.eip = CODE;
  cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF | (regs[4] & ARITH);
  const I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
  const jit = jitOpts ? new Jit(mem, I, { smc: true, ...jitOpts }) : null;
  if (jit) jit.cpu = cpu;
  const slices = [];
  let r;
  for (;;) {
    r = jit ? jit.run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: slice }) : I.run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: 1e7 });
    if (r !== EXIT.TIMESLICE) break;
    slices.push(`${(cpu.eip >>> 0).toString(16)}/${jit.remaining()}`);
    if (slices.length > 1e5) throw new Error('runaway');
  }
  if (jit) CpuState.foldLazyFlags?.(cpu);
  const state = [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx, cpu.esp, cpu.edi, cpu.eflags & ARITH, cpu.eip].map((v) => (v >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ') + ' ' + [...mem.bytes(DATA + 0x700, 0x100)].join(',');
  return { r, state, slices: slices.join(" "), jit };
}
const V = [0, 1, 0x7f, 0x80, 0xffff, 0x7fffffff, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff, 0x12345678];
const val = () => (rnd(2) ? V[rnd(V.length)] : ((rnd(65536) << 16) | rnd(65536)) >>> 0);

test('reverse-postorder layout: random programs with in-region calls and backward branches match the interpreter, with the same time slices', () => {
  for (let t = 0; t < 200; t++) {
    const { code, end } = gen();
    const regs = [val(), val(), val(), val(), rnd(0x1000)];
    const s0 = seed;
    const want = run(code, end, regs, null, 0);
    for (const slice of [1e7, 1, 3, 7]) {
      seed = s0; const off = run(code, end, regs, { layout: false }, slice);
      seed = s0; const on = run(code, end, regs, { layout: true }, slice);
      const msg = `program ${t} slice ${slice}: ${Buffer.from(code).toString('hex')} regs ${regs.map((x) => (x >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ')}`;
      assert.equal(on.r, want.r, msg);
      assert.equal(on.state, want.state, msg);
      assert.equal(off.state, want.state, msg);
      assert.equal(on.slices, off.slices, `time slices: ${msg}`);
    }
  }
});

// A region none of whose transfers goes back through its dispatcher has a block instead of the dispatch loop
// (translate.js dispatchBlock): the same random programs, whole and sliced, match the interpreter and give the same time
// slices with and without it; both kinds of region occur.
test('a dispatcher no transfer goes back through is a block: random programs match the interpreter, same time slices', () => {
  let blocks = 0, regions = 0;
  for (let t = 0; t < 200; t++) {
    const { code, end } = gen();
    const regs = [val(), val(), val(), val(), rnd(0x1000)];
    const s0 = seed;
    const want = run(code, end, regs, null, 0);
    for (const slice of [1e7, 1, 5]) {
      seed = s0; const off = run(code, end, regs, { dispatchBlock: false }, slice);
      seed = s0; const on = run(code, end, regs, { dispatchBlock: true }, slice);
      const msg = `program ${t} slice ${slice}: ${Buffer.from(code).toString('hex')}`;
      assert.equal(on.r, want.r, msg);
      assert.equal(on.state, want.state, msg);
      assert.equal(off.state, want.state, msg);
      assert.equal(on.slices, off.slices, `time slices: ${msg}`);
      blocks += on.jit.stats.dispatchBlocks ?? 0; regions += on.jit.stats.regions;
      assert.equal(off.jit.stats.dispatchBlocks ?? 0, 0);
    }
  }
  assert.ok(blocks > 0 && blocks < regions, `regions with a dispatch block: ${blocks} of ${regions}`);
});

// The x87-mode versions of a region (jit.js EXIT_FPUMODE: the guard of one version tail-calls the next with the block
// index it was entered with) must number their blocks alike. A region whose first version was translated in another
// layout (the background worker with other options than the emulator's translations, as after an in-session switch)
// must not get a version under another numbering: the entry's index would select another block there.
import { handleMessage } from '../src/cpu/jit/bg-translate.js';
test('x87-mode versions of a region translated under different layouts are not chained (block numbers differ)', () => {
  // L0 (lower address, reached from the entry): fld1 ; faddp ; fstp dword [esi] ; hlt — entry E: fldz ; fld1 ; faddp... ; jmp L0
  const L0 = [0xd9, 0xe8, 0xde, 0xc1, 0xd9, 0x1e, 0xf4]; // fld1 ; faddp st1 ; fstp dword [esi] ; hlt
  const E = [0xd9, 0xee, 0xd9, 0xe8, 0xde, 0xc1, 0xd9, 0xe8, 0xde, 0xc1, 0xe9]; // fldz ; fld1 ; faddp ; fld1 ; faddp ; jmp L0
  const code = [...L0, 0x90, 0x90, 0x90, ...E];
  code.push(...le(0 - (code.length + 4)));
  const entry = CODE + L0.length + 3, stop = CODE + L0.length - 1;
  const mem = new GuestMemory({ shared: true }), cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset(); mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(code));
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true, layout: true });
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  const replies = [];
  jit.attachBackground({ postMessage: (m) => handleMessage(m, (r) => replies.push(r)) }); // (its translations: layout on)
  jit.opts.layout = false; // (the emulator's own translations: address order)
  mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, 0x027f);
  jit.bgPrewarm([[entry, 0x200]]);
  jit.bgInstall(replies[0]);
  assert.equal(jit.bg.installed, 1);
  for (const cw of [0x007f, 0x027f, 0x0c7f]) {
    mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, cw); cpu.eip = entry; cpu.esi = DATA; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; mem.write32(DATA, 0);
    let r; do r = jit.run({ stopAt: stop, maxInsns: 1e6 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
    assert.equal(r, EXIT.HALT, `cw ${cw.toString(16)}`);
    assert.equal(mem.readF32(DATA), 3, `cw ${cw.toString(16)}: 0 + 1 + 1 + 1 stored`);
  }
});

// Self-modifying code and threads under the layout: a routine called first stores AL into the immediate of one of the
// program's ALU-with-imm8 instructions (an SMC exit, the region translated again). One thread against the interpreter; two threads
// sharing the code (each patching it), alternated every few instructions: the same results and the same time slices
// with and without the layout (the interleaving does not change).
function genSmc() {
  const g = gen(), body = [...g.code], imms = [];
  // (the program's `ALU r, imm8` instructions, found by decoding it from its start: every byte of it is code)
  const scratch = new GuestMemory(); scratch.writeBytes(CODE, g.code);
  for (let a = 0; a < g.end;) { const insn = decode(scratch, CODE + a); if (body[a] === 0x83 && (body[a + 1] & 0xc0) === 0xc0) imms.push(a + 2); a = insn.next - CODE; }
  if (!imms.length) return null;
  const at = 5 + imms[rnd(imms.length)]; // (the body follows a 5-byte CALL)
  // call patch ; <body ... hlt> ; patch: mov [CODE+at], al ; inc al ; ret
  const out = [0xe8, ...le(body.length), ...body, 0xa2, ...le(CODE + at), 0xfe, 0xc0, 0xc3];
  return { code: Uint8Array.from(out), end: 5 + g.end };
}
function runThreads(code, end, regs, jitOpts, slice, nThreads) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  mem.fill(CODE, 0x1000, 0xcc); mem.writeBytes(CODE, code); mem.fill(DATA, 0x2000, 0);
  const I0 = new Interp(mem, new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE));
  if (!jitOpts) I0.cache = new (class extends Map { set() { return this; } })(); // (stores into code: decode afresh)
  const jit = jitOpts ? new Jit(mem, I0, { smc: true, ...jitOpts }) : null;
  const threads = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < nThreads; k++) {
    const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE + k * 0x1000); cpu.reset();
    [cpu.eax, cpu.ecx, cpu.edx, cpu.ebx] = regs.slice(0, 4).map((v) => (v + k * 0x1111) >>> 0);
    cpu.edi = 150 + 37 * k; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800 + k * 0x800; cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF | (regs[4] & ARITH);
    threads.push({ cpu, done: false, r: 0 });
  }
  const trace = [];
  for (let turn = 0; threads.some((t) => !t.done); turn++) {
    if (turn > 1e6) throw new Error('runaway');
    const t = threads[turn % nThreads]; if (t.done) continue;
    let r;
    if (jit) { jit.cpu = t.cpu; r = jit.run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: slice }); } else { I0.cpu = t.cpu; r = I0.run({ stopAt: CODE + end, maxInsns: 1e7 }); }
    if (r === EXIT.SMC) { const len = mem.read32(t.cpu.base + ST.EXIT_LEN) || 16; mem.write32(t.cpu.base + ST.EXIT_LEN, 0); jit.invalidate(t.cpu.exitArg, len); trace.push('smc'); turn--; continue; }
    if (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE) { trace.push(`${turn % nThreads}:${(t.cpu.eip >>> 0).toString(16)}/${jit.remaining()}`); continue; }
    t.done = true; t.r = r;
  }
  if (jit) for (const t of threads) CpuState.foldLazyFlags?.(t.cpu);
  const regsOf = (t) => [t.r, t.cpu.eax, t.cpu.ecx, t.cpu.edx, t.cpu.ebx, t.cpu.esp, t.cpu.edi, t.cpu.eflags & ARITH, t.cpu.eip].map((v) => (v >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ');
  return { state: threads.map(regsOf).join(' | ') + ' code ' + Buffer.from(mem.bytes(CODE, code.length)).toString('hex'), trace: trace.join(' ') };
}
test('reverse-postorder layout with self-modifying code and threads: one thread matches the interpreter; two alternated threads give the same results and slices with and without it', () => {
  let n = 0, smc = 0;
  for (let t = 0; t < 150; t++) {
    const p = genSmc(); if (!p) continue; n++;
    const regs = [val(), val(), val(), val(), rnd(0x1000)];
    const msg = `program ${t}: ${Buffer.from(p.code).toString('hex')} regs ${regs.map((x) => (x >>> 0).toString(16)).join(' ')}`;
    const want = runThreads(p.code, p.end, regs, null, 0, 1);
    for (const slice of [1e7, 5]) assert.equal(runThreads(p.code, p.end, regs, { layout: true }, slice, 1).state, want.state, `${msg} slice ${slice}`);
    for (const slice of [3, 11]) {
      const on = runThreads(p.code, p.end, regs, { layout: true }, slice, 2), off = runThreads(p.code, p.end, regs, { layout: false }, slice, 2);
      assert.equal(on.state, off.state, `${msg} two threads, slice ${slice}`);
      assert.equal(on.trace, off.trace, `${msg} two threads, slice ${slice}: time slices`);
      smc += on.trace.split('smc').length - 1;
    }
  }
  assert.ok(n > 80 && smc > n, `programs with self-modifying code: ${n}, SMC exits: ${smc}`);
});
```
