`tests/light-copies.test.js`:

```js
// Light copies (src/host/light-copies.js, docs/slow-network.md "Light copies"): a DDS texture without its finest mip
// levels — the format's cases —, marked in a browser port's tree and served under .light/ (its ranges, its read reports).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { lightDds, lightTga, tgaLight, lightCopy, readLight, esmZeroRanges, zeroWithin, LIGHT_SIDE, TGA_LIGHT_FROM, ESM_FORMAT, ESM_LIGHT_FROM } from '../src/host/light-copies.js';
import { listGameTree, resolveLightFile } from '../src/host/game-files.js';
import { createServer } from '../src/host/server.js';

/** A DDS texture: its header (DX10's too when `dxgi`), then its levels' bytes (each level's bytes its own value). */
export function dds({ w, h, mips, four = 'DXT1', bits = 0, rgb = false, dxgi = 0, caps2 = 0, pitch = false, cut = 0 }) {
  const head = Buffer.alloc(dxgi ? 148 : 128);
  head.write('DDS ', 0, 'latin1'); head.writeUInt32LE(124, 4);
  head.writeUInt32LE(0x1007 | 0x20000 | (pitch ? 0x8 : 0x80000), 8); head.writeUInt32LE(h, 12); head.writeUInt32LE(w, 16); head.writeUInt32LE(mips, 28);
  head.writeUInt32LE(32, 76); head.writeUInt32LE(rgb ? 0x41 : 0x4, 80);
  if (!rgb) head.write(dxgi ? 'DX10' : four, 84, 'latin1'); else head.writeUInt32LE(bits, 88);
  head.writeUInt32LE(caps2, 112);
  if (dxgi) { head.writeUInt32LE(dxgi, 128); head.writeUInt32LE(3, 132); head.writeUInt32LE(1, 140); }
  const unit = rgb ? bits / 8 : dxgi ? 16 : four === 'DXT1' ? 8 : 16, levels = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < mips; i++) {
    const lw = Math.max(1, w >> i), lh = Math.max(1, h >> i);
    levels.push(Buffer.alloc(rgb ? lw * lh * unit : Math.ceil(lw / 4) * Math.ceil(lh / 4) * unit, i + 1));
  }
  const all = Buffer.concat([head, ...levels]);
  return { bytes: all.subarray(0, all.length - cut), levels, head };
}

test('a large DDS texture\'s light copy leaves its finest levels out: the same format, the header telling the smaller size', () => {
  assert.equal(LIGHT_SIDE, 256);
  const t = dds({ w: 1024, h: 1024, mips: 11 }), c = lightDds(t.bytes.subarray(0, 148), t.bytes.length), cut = t.levels[0].length + t.levels[1].length;
  assert.equal(c.from, 128 + cut); assert.equal(c.size, t.bytes.length - cut);
  assert.equal(c.head.readUInt32LE(16), 256); assert.equal(c.head.readUInt32LE(12), 256); assert.equal(c.head.readUInt32LE(28), 9);
  assert.equal(c.head.readUInt32LE(20), t.levels[2].length, 'the linear size of its first level');
  // (a long texture: its longest side down to LIGHT_SIDE, its levels as they are)
  const long = dds({ w: 2048, h: 8192, mips: 14, four: 'DXT5' }), cl = lightDds(long.bytes, long.bytes.length);
  assert.deepEqual([cl.head.readUInt32LE(16), cl.head.readUInt32LE(12), cl.head.readUInt32LE(28)], [64, 256, 9]);
  assert.deepEqual(long.bytes.subarray(cl.from, cl.from + 16), Buffer.alloc(16, 6), 'from its sixth level on');
  // (uncompressed, its pitch; DX10 with a block-compressed format)
  const rgba = dds({ w: 1024, h: 512, mips: 3, rgb: true, bits: 32, pitch: true }), cr = lightDds(rgba.bytes, rgba.bytes.length);
  assert.deepEqual([cr.head.readUInt32LE(16), cr.head.readUInt32LE(12), cr.head.readUInt32LE(20), cr.head.readUInt32LE(28)], [512, 256, 2048, 2], 'two levels kept at least');
  // (a short chain: two levels kept, its side above LIGHT_SIDE then)
  const short = dds({ w: 2048, h: 2048, mips: 4 }), cs = lightDds(short.bytes, short.bytes.length);
  assert.deepEqual([cs.head.readUInt32LE(16), cs.head.readUInt32LE(28)], [512, 2]);
  const bc7 = dds({ w: 2048, h: 2048, mips: 12, dxgi: 98 }), c7 = lightDds(bc7.bytes, bc7.bytes.length);
  assert.equal(c7.head.length, 148); assert.equal(c7.from, 148 + bc7.levels.slice(0, 3).reduce((n, l) => n + l.length, 0));
  // (nothing to gain, or not as its header says: none)
  for (const [what, x] of [['small', dds({ w: 256, h: 256, mips: 9 })], ['no levels below', dds({ w: 2048, h: 2048, mips: 1 })], ['two levels only', dds({ w: 1024, h: 1024, mips: 2 })],
    ['a cube', dds({ w: 1024, h: 1024, mips: 11, caps2: 0x200 })], ['cut short', dds({ w: 1024, h: 1024, mips: 11, cut: 9 })]]) assert.equal(lightDds(x.bytes, x.bytes.length), null, what);
  assert.equal(lightDds(Buffer.from('not a texture at all, not at all, no'), 36), null);
});

test('a browser port\'s tree tells its textures\' light size, served under .light/ and learned from read reports; a Windows game\'s does not', async (t) => {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-light-')); t.after(() => fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const games = path.join(root, 'games'), engines = path.join(root, 'engines'), game = path.join(games, 'mw');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(game, 'base/Textures'), { recursive: true }); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(game, 'versions/1'), { recursive: true });
  const big = dds({ w: 1024, h: 1024, mips: 11 });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(game, 'base/Textures/big.dds'), big.bytes); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(game, 'base/Textures/small.dds'), dds({ w: 256, h: 256, mips: 9 }).bytes);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(game, 'base/Game.esm'), 'esm');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(game, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, id: 'mw', name: 'MW', defaultVersion: 'mw-1', defaults: { runtime: 'openmw' },
    versions: [{ id: 'mw-1', dir: '1', version: '1', openmw: { engine: 'e1', files: ['Game.esm'] } }] }));
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(engines, 'e1/moddata'), { recursive: true });
  const server = createServer({ gamesDir: games, enginesDir: engines });
  await new Promise((r) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r)); t.after(() => new Promise((r) => { server.closeAllConnections(); server.close(r); }));
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
  const cut = big.levels[0].length + big.levels[1].length, tree = await (await fetch(base + '/api/tree/mw-1')).json(), light = big.bytes.length - cut;
  assert.equal(tree.dirs.Textures.files['big.dds'].light, light); assert.equal(tree.dirs.Textures.files['small.dds'].light, undefined);
  const got = Buffer.from(await (await fetch(`${base}/gamez/mw-1/.light/Textures/big.dds?r=100-${light}`)).arrayBuffer());
  const want = Buffer.concat([lightDds(big.bytes, big.bytes.length).head, big.bytes.subarray(128 + cut)]);
  assert.deepEqual(got, want.subarray(100));
  assert.equal((await fetch(`${base}/gamez/mw-1/.light/Textures/small.dds?r=0-10`)).status, 404);
  assert.equal((await fetch(`${base}/gamez/mw-1/.light/Game.esm?r=0-3`)).status, 404);
  const prefetch = `${base}/api/prefetch/mw-1`;
  await fetch(prefetch, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ session: 's', reads: [['.light/Textures/big.dds', 0, light, 5], ['.light/Textures/big.dds', 0, light + 1, 6]] }) });
  assert.deepEqual(await (await fetch(prefetch)).json(), [['.light/Textures/big.dds', 0, (1 << Math.ceil(light / 65536)) - 1, 5]], 'its pieces; a read past its end left out');
  // (a Windows game reads its files as they are)
  assert.equal(listGameTree({ folder: path.join(game, 'versions/1'), baseFolder: path.join(game, 'base'), lightCopies: false }).dirs.Textures.files['big.dds'].light, undefined);
});

/** An uncompressed TGA picture: its header (an image ID of `id` bytes), then its pixels (`pixel(x, y, c)`). */
function tga({ w, h, bpp = 24, type = 2, id = 0, desc = 0, cmap = 0, pixel = (x, y, c) => (x + 2 * y + 3 * c) & 255 }) {
  const px = bpp / 8, head = Buffer.alloc(18 + id);
  head[0] = id; head[1] = cmap; head[2] = type; head.writeUInt16LE(w, 12); head.writeUInt16LE(h, 14); head[16] = bpp; head[17] = desc;
  const pixels = Buffer.alloc(w * h * px);
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) for (let c = 0; c < px; c++) pixels[(y * w + x) * px + c] = pixel(x, y, c);
  return Buffer.concat([head, pixels]);
}

test('a TGA picture of a screen\'s size has a light copy: a smaller TGA of its own, each pixel the mean of those it stands for', async (t) => {
  assert.equal(TGA_LIGHT_FROM, 1024);
  // (Morrowind's loading screens: 1024 × 1024, 24-bit, 3 MB — 256 × 256, 192 KB)
  const big = tga({ w: 1024, h: 1024, id: 5, desc: 0x20, pixel: (x, y, c) => (c === 0 ? (x % 4) * 20 : c === 1 ? 200 : (y >> 2) & 255) });
  const shape = lightTga(big, big.length);
  assert.deepEqual([shape.lw, shape.lh, shape.step, shape.size], [256, 256, 4, 18 + 256 * 256 * 3]);
  const light = tgaLight(big, shape);
  assert.equal(light.length, shape.size);
  assert.deepEqual([light[0], light[2], light.readUInt16LE(12), light.readUInt16LE(14), light[16], light[17]], [0, 2, 256, 256, 24, 0x20], 'no image ID, the same format and origin');
  // (pixel (x, y): the mean of its 4 × 4 — blue (x % 4) * 20 → 30, green 200, red the row's)
  for (const [x, y] of [[0, 0], [17, 3], [255, 255]]) assert.deepEqual([...light.subarray(18 + (y * 256 + x) * 3, 18 + (y * 256 + x) * 3 + 3)], [30, 200, y], `pixel ${x}, ${y}`);
  // (32-bit with alpha, a long one; greyscale)
  const rgba = lightTga(tga({ w: 2048, h: 512, bpp: 32, pixel: () => 7 }), 18 + 2048 * 512 * 4);
  assert.deepEqual([rgba.lw, rgba.lh, rgba.step, rgba.px], [256, 64, 8, 4]);
  const grey = tga({ w: 1024, h: 768, bpp: 8, type: 3, pixel: (x) => (x & 1 ? 100 : 0) });
  assert.deepEqual([...tgaLight(grey, lightTga(grey, grey.length)).subarray(18, 22)], [50, 50, 50, 50]);
  // (none: a smaller picture — a menu's, an icon —, a colour map, run-length encoded, interleaved, a strip thinner than
  // a block — its rows would be averaged with bytes past the picture —, cut short)
  const rle = tga({ w: 1024, h: 1024 }); rle[2] = 10;
  for (const [what, x] of [['small', tga({ w: 512, h: 512 })], ['colour map', tga({ w: 1024, h: 1024, bpp: 8, type: 1, cmap: 1 })],
    ['run-length', rle], ['interleaved', tga({ w: 1024, h: 1024, desc: 0x40 })], ['a ramp', tga({ w: 1024, h: 1, bpp: 32, pixel: () => 200 })],
    ['a tall strip', tga({ w: 3, h: 2048 })]]) assert.equal(lightTga(x, x.length), null, what);
  assert.equal(lightTga(tga({ w: 2048, h: 8 }), 18 + 2048 * 8 * 3).lh, 1, 'a strip as thick as a block: its one row');
  assert.equal(lightTga(big, big.length - 1), null, 'cut short');
  // (the server's copy: all of it made from the file, read by ranges)
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-light-tga-')); t.after(() => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const file = path.join(dir, 'Splash_A.tga'); fs.writeFileSync(file, big);
  const c = lightCopy(file, fs.statSync(file));
  assert.equal(c.size, shape.size); assert.equal(c.from, big.length);
  const buf = Buffer.alloc(1000);
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => readLight(file, c, 5000, 6000, buf, 0, (err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve())));
  assert.deepEqual(buf, light.subarray(5000, 6000));
});

/**
 * A WAD3 archive: miptex lumps [name, w, h] (each level's pixels a pattern of its own), then a lump of another type;
 * `again`: indices of lumps the directory lists a second time (another entry, the same bytes)
 */
function wad(textures, again = []) {
  const lumps = [];
  for (const [name, w, h] of textures) {
    const sizes = [w * h, (w * h) / 4, (w * h) / 16, (w * h) / 64], head = Buffer.alloc(40);
    head.write(name, 0, 'latin1'); head.writeUInt32LE(w, 16); head.writeUInt32LE(h, 20);
    let o = 40; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { head.writeUInt32LE(o, 24 + i * 4); o += sizes[i]; }
    const levels = sizes.map((n, i) => Buffer.from(Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => (k * (i + 3) + (k >> 5)) & 0xff)));
    lumps.push([0x43, Buffer.concat([head, ...levels, Buffer.from([0, 1]), Buffer.alloc(768, 7), Buffer.alloc(2)])]);
  }
  lumps.push([0x42, Buffer.from('a qpic, left as it is')]);
  const parts = [Buffer.alloc(12)], dir = [];
  let at = 12;
  for (const [type, b] of lumps) { const e = Buffer.alloc(32); e.writeInt32LE(at, 0); e.writeInt32LE(b.length, 4); e.writeInt32LE(b.length, 8); e[12] = type; dir.push(e); parts.push(b); at += b.length; }
  for (const i of again) { const e = Buffer.from(dir[i]); e.write('again', 16, 'latin1'); dir.push(e); }
  parts[0].write('WAD3', 0, 'latin1'); parts[0].writeInt32LE(dir.length, 4); parts[0].writeInt32LE(at, 8);
  return Buffer.concat([...parts, ...dir]);
}

test('a WAD3 archive\'s light copy keeps its size and offsets, each texture\'s finest level redrawn from the next; any range of it reads the same', async () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-wad-'));
  try {
    const bytes = wad([['big', 128, 64], ['small', 32, 32], ['wide', 256, 128]]), f = path.join(dir, 'maps.WAD');
    fs.writeFileSync(f, bytes);
    const c = lightCopy(f, fs.statSync(f));
    assert.equal(c.size, bytes.length, 'the same size');
    assert.equal(c.mips.length, 8, 'two textures lightened: 32 × 32 is under WAD_LIGHT_FROM');
    const read = (a, b) => new Promise((res, rej) => { const buf = Buffer.alloc(b - a + 3); readLight(f, c, a, b, buf, 3, (e) => (e ? rej(e) : res(buf.subarray(3)))); });
    const all = await read(0, bytes.length);
    // (the expected copy: level 0 of each lightened texture from its level 1, pixel (x, y) from (x/2, y/2); the rest as it is)
    const want = Buffer.from(bytes);
    for (let k = 0; k < c.mips.length; k += 4) {
      const [d0, w, h, s1] = c.mips.slice(k, k + 4);
      for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) want[d0 + y * w + x] = bytes[s1 + (y >> 1) * (w / 2) + (x >> 1)];
    }
    assert.deepEqual(all, want);
    assert.notDeepEqual(all, bytes);
    let s = 9;
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; const a = s % bytes.length; s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; const b = a + 1 + (s % (bytes.length - a)); assert.deepEqual(await read(a, b), want.subarray(a, b), `${a}-${b}`); }
    // not a WAD3, or no texture to lighten: none
    const other = path.join(dir, 'other.wad'); fs.writeFileSync(other, Buffer.concat([Buffer.from('WAD2'), bytes.subarray(4)]));
    assert.equal(lightCopy(other, fs.statSync(other)), null);
    const tiny = path.join(dir, 'tiny.wad'); fs.writeFileSync(tiny, wad([['s', 16, 16]]));
    assert.equal(lightCopy(tiny, fs.statSync(tiny)), null);
  } finally { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test('a WAD3 archive whose directory lists a texture twice: each texture lightened once, the copy the same from any range', async () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-wad-again-'));
  try {
    const textures = [['big', 128, 64], ['wide', 256, 128]];
    const once = wad(textures), bytes = wad(textures, [1, 0]), f = path.join(dir, 'again.wad'), g = path.join(dir, 'once.wad');
    fs.writeFileSync(f, bytes); fs.writeFileSync(g, once);
    const c = lightCopy(f, fs.statSync(f)), c1 = lightCopy(g, fs.statSync(g));
    assert.equal(c.size, bytes.length);
    // (the same lumps at the same offsets: the archive differs only in its directory, after them)
    assert.deepEqual(c.mips, c1.mips, 'two textures, each once — level 0 overlapping another\'s is left out');
    assert.equal(c.mips.length, 8);
    for (let k = 4; k < c.mips.length; k += 4) assert.ok(c.mips[k] >= c.mips[k - 4] + c.mips[k - 3] * c.mips[k - 2], 'sorted, none overlapping');
    const read = (a, b) => new Promise((res, rej) => { const buf = Buffer.alloc(b - a); readLight(f, c, a, b, buf, 0, (e) => (e ? rej(e) : res(buf))); });
    const want = Buffer.from(bytes);
    for (let k = 0; k < c.mips.length; k += 4) {
      const [d0, w, h, s1] = c.mips.slice(k, k + 4);
      for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) want[d0 + y * w + x] = bytes[s1 + (y >> 1) * (w / 2) + (x >> 1)];
    }
    assert.deepEqual(await read(0, bytes.length), want);
    assert.notDeepEqual(want, bytes);
    let s = 5;
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; const a = s % bytes.length; s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; const b = a + 1 + (s % (bytes.length - a)); assert.deepEqual(await read(a, b), want.subarray(a, b), `${a}-${b}`); }
  } finally { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

/**
 * A BSP v30 map: lumps 0 (entities), 1 (planes) as filler bytes, lump 2 the textures — miptex [name, w, h] with their
 * pixels (each level a pattern of its own), [name, w, h, true] one its WAD holds (offsets 0), a -1 entry (left out) —,
 * then lumps 3-14 filler bytes.
 */
function bsp(textures) {
  const mips = [];
  for (const [name, w, h, external] of textures) {
    const head = Buffer.alloc(40); head.write(name, 0, 'latin1'); head.writeUInt32LE(w, 16); head.writeUInt32LE(h, 20);
    if (external) { mips.push(head); continue; }
    const sizes = [w * h, (w * h) / 4, (w * h) / 16, (w * h) / 64];
    let o = 40; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { head.writeUInt32LE(o, 24 + i * 4); o += sizes[i]; }
    mips.push(Buffer.concat([head, ...sizes.map((n, i) => Buffer.from(Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => (k * (i + 5) + (k >> 6)) & 0xff))), Buffer.from([0, 1]), Buffer.alloc(768, 9), Buffer.alloc(2)]));
  }
  const n = mips.length + 1, dir = Buffer.alloc(4 + n * 4); dir.writeInt32LE(n, 0);
  let o = dir.length; mips.forEach((m, i) => { dir.writeInt32LE(o, 4 + i * 4); o += m.length; }); dir.writeInt32LE(-1, 4 + mips.length * 4);
  const lumps = Array.from({ length: 15 }, (_, i) => (i === 2 ? Buffer.concat([dir, ...mips]) : Buffer.from(Array.from({ length: 300 + i * 17 }, (_, k) => (k * 7 + i) & 0xff))));
  const head = Buffer.alloc(4 + 15 * 8); head.writeInt32LE(30, 0);
  let at = head.length; lumps.forEach((l, i) => { head.writeInt32LE(at, 4 + i * 8); head.writeInt32LE(l.length, 8 + i * 8); at += l.length; });
  return { bytes: Buffer.concat([head, ...lumps]), head };
}

test('a BSP v30 map has no light copy, its textures embedded or not: the engine checksums its texture lump in multiplayer (a client whose map differs from its server\'s is disconnected)', async () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-bsp-'));
  try {
    const { bytes, head } = bsp([['wall', 128, 64], ['tiny', 32, 32], ['sky', 256, 256, true], ['floor', 64, 64]]);
    for (const name of ['c1a0.bsp', 'DE_DUST2.BSP']) {
      const f = path.join(dir, name); fs.writeFileSync(f, bytes);
      assert.equal(lightCopy(f, fs.statSync(f)), null, name);
    }
    // (what a GoldSrc page parses of a map — src/ports/goldsrc/bsp-reads.js — reads its lumps through the shared reader)
    const { bspLumps } = await import('../src/ports/goldsrc/bsp-reads.js');
    const lumps = bspLumps(bytes, bytes.length);
    assert.equal(lumps.length, 15);
    assert.deepEqual(lumps[2], { off: head.readInt32LE(4 + 2 * 8), len: head.readInt32LE(8 + 2 * 8) });
  } finally { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- TES3 content files

/** A TES3 subrecord: its name, its payload (a string's bytes, a buffer, or `n` bytes of `fill`). */
const sub = (name, data) => { const b = Buffer.isBuffer(data) ? data : Buffer.from(String(data), 'latin1'); const h = Buffer.alloc(8); h.write(name, 0, 'latin1'); h.writeUInt32LE(b.length, 4); return Buffer.concat([h, b]); };
const u32 = (v) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(4); b.writeUInt32LE(v); return b; };
const filled = (n, v) => Buffer.alloc(n, v);
/** A TES3 record: its name and subrecords. */
const rec = (name, subs) => { const body = Buffer.concat(subs), h = Buffer.alloc(16); h.write(name, 0, 'latin1'); h.writeUInt32LE(body.length, 4); return Buffer.concat([h, body]); };
/**
 * A TES3 file: its header, a LAND record, an exterior CELL with references (one with a key, one deleted, a moved
 * reference's group), an interior's, a dialogue's padding to `size`.
 */
function tes3(size = ESM_LIGHT_FROM + 4096) {
  const parts = [
    rec('TES3', [sub('HEDR', filled(300, 1))]),
    rec('CELL', [sub('NAME', 'Seyda Neen\0'), sub('DATA', filled(12, 2)), sub('RGNN', 'Bitter Coast\0'), sub('NAM0', u32(3)),
      sub('FRMR', u32(1)), sub('NAME', 'chest_small\0'), sub('XSCL', filled(4, 9)), sub('ANAM', 'fargoth\0'), sub('KNAM', 'key_chest\0'), sub('FLTV', u32(50)), sub('DATA', filled(24, 7)),
      sub('FRMR', u32(2)), sub('NAME', 'barrel_01\0'), sub('DELE', u32(0)), sub('DATA', filled(24, 8)),
      sub('MVRF', u32(5)), sub('CNDT', filled(8, 3)), sub('FRMR', u32(5)), sub('NAME', 'mudcrab\0'), sub('DATA', filled(24, 6)),
      sub('FRMR', u32(6)), sub('NAME', 'rock_01\0'), sub('DATA', filled(24, 5)), sub('XSCL', filled(4, 4))]),
    rec('LAND', [sub('INTV', filled(8, 1)), sub('DATA', u32(15)), sub('VNML', filled(12675, 0x41)), sub('VHGT', filled(4232, 0x42)),
      sub('WNAM', filled(81, 0x43)), sub('VCLR', filled(12675, 0x44)), sub('VTEX', filled(512, 0x45))]),
    rec('CELL', [sub('NAME', 'Arrille\'s Tradehouse\0'), sub('DATA', filled(12, 1)), sub('FRMR', u32(9)), sub('NAME', 'arrille\0'), sub('DATA', filled(24, 2)), sub('ANAM', 'x\0')]),
  ];
  const used = parts.reduce((n, b) => n + b.length, 0);
  parts.push(rec('INFO', [sub('INAM', filled(size - used - 24, 0x55))]));
  return Buffer.concat(parts);
}
/** The TES3 file's subrecords: [record, subrecord, payload offset, payload bytes], in order. */
function subsOf(b) {
  const out = [];
  for (let p = 0; p + 16 <= b.length;) {
    const r = b.toString('latin1', p, p + 4), e = p + 16 + b.readUInt32LE(p + 4);
    for (let s = p + 16; s + 8 <= e;) { const n = b.toString('latin1', s, s + 4), z = b.readUInt32LE(s + 4); out.push([r, n, s + 8, b.subarray(s + 8, s + 8 + z)]); s += 8 + z; }
    p = e;
  }
  return out;
}
/** A cell's references as the engine's content load counts them (ESMStore::countAllCellRefsAndMarkKeys): number, object, key, deleted. */
function refTuples(b) {
  const out = []; let cur = null;
  for (const [r, n, , d] of subsOf(b)) {
    if (r !== 'CELL') { cur = null; continue; }
    if (n === 'FRMR') out.push(cur = { num: d.readUInt32LE(0), id: '', key: '', deleted: false });
    else if (cur && n === 'NAME') cur.id = d.toString('latin1');
    else if (cur && n === 'KNAM') cur.key = d.toString('latin1');
    else if (cur && n === 'DELE') cur.deleted = true;
  }
  return out;
}

test('a TES3 content file\'s light copy: its size and offsets, the land payloads and the references\' details zeroed, what the content load reads kept', async () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-esm-'));
  try {
    const bytes = tes3(), f = path.join(dir, 'Morrowind.esm');
    fs.writeFileSync(f, bytes);
    const c = lightCopy(f, fs.statSync(f));
    assert.equal(c.size, bytes.length, 'the same size');
    assert.equal(c.format, ESM_FORMAT);
    const read = (a, b) => new Promise((res, rej) => { const buf = Buffer.alloc(b - a + 3); readLight(f, c, a, b, buf, 3, (e) => (e ? rej(e) : res(buf.subarray(3)))); });
    const all = await read(0, bytes.length);
    // (every record and subrecord header in place: the same subrecords at the same offsets)
    assert.deepEqual(subsOf(all).map(([r, n, at, d]) => [r, n, at, d.length]), subsOf(bytes).map(([r, n, at, d]) => [r, n, at, d.length]));
    const zeroed = (d) => d.every((x) => x === 0);
    const light = subsOf(all), real = subsOf(bytes);
    for (let i = 0; i < real.length; i++) {
      const [r, n] = real[i], kept = light[i][3].equals(real[i][3]);
      const what = `${r}.${n} #${i}`;
      if (r === 'LAND') assert.equal(kept, ['INTV', 'DATA', 'WNAM'].includes(n), what);
      if (r === 'LAND' && !kept) assert.ok(zeroed(light[i][3]), what);
    }
    // (a cell's own header kept; each reference's number, object, key and deleted flag kept, its details zeroed; a moved
    // reference's group kept whole — the content load reads it all: Store<Cell>::handleMovedCellRefs)
    const cell = (i) => light[i][3], at = (r, n, k = 0) => real.map((x, i) => [x, i]).filter(([x]) => x[0] === r && x[1] === n)[k][1];
    for (const n of ['NAME', 'DATA', 'RGNN', 'NAM0']) assert.ok(cell(at('CELL', n)).equals(real[at('CELL', n)][3]), `the header's ${n}`);
    assert.ok(zeroed(cell(at('CELL', 'XSCL'))) && zeroed(cell(at('CELL', 'ANAM'))) && zeroed(cell(at('CELL', 'FLTV'))), 'details of reference 1');
    assert.ok(zeroed(cell(at('CELL', 'DATA', 1))) && zeroed(cell(at('CELL', 'DATA', 2))), 'positions of references 1 and 2');
    assert.ok(cell(at('CELL', 'DATA', 3)).equals(real[at('CELL', 'DATA', 3)][3]), 'the moved reference\'s position kept');
    assert.ok(cell(at('CELL', 'CNDT')).equals(real[at('CELL', 'CNDT')][3]));
    assert.ok(zeroed(cell(at('CELL', 'DATA', 4))) && zeroed(cell(at('CELL', 'XSCL', 1))), 'the reference after the moved group: zeroed again');
    assert.ok(zeroed(cell(at('CELL', 'DATA', 6))) && zeroed(cell(at('CELL', 'ANAM', 1))), 'an interior\'s references too');
    assert.ok(cell(at('INFO', 'INAM')).equals(real[at('INFO', 'INAM')][3]), 'other records as they are');
    assert.deepEqual(refTuples(all), refTuples(bytes), 'the references the content load counts: the same');
    assert.deepEqual(refTuples(bytes).map((r) => [r.num, r.key, r.deleted]), [[1, 'key_chest\0', false], [2, '', true], [5, '', false], [6, '', false], [9, '', false]]);
    // (any range reads as the whole copy's bytes there; the map made once, sorted, its ranges merged)
    let seed = 7;
    for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) {
      seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; const a = seed % bytes.length; seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0;
      const b = Math.min(bytes.length, a + 1 + (seed % 40000));
      assert.deepEqual(await read(a, b), all.subarray(a, b), `${a}-${b}`);
    }
    const z = esmZeroRanges(bytes);
    for (let i = 2; i < z.length; i += 2) assert.ok(z[i] > z[i - 1], 'sorted, apart');
    // (a job's share: the ranges within a unit, clipped)
    const mid = (z[0] + z[1]) >> 1, w = zeroWithin(z, mid, z[3]);
    assert.deepEqual([...w], [mid, z[1], z[2], z[3]]);
  } finally { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test('a TES3 file has a light copy from ESM_LIGHT_FROM on, by its header (not its name alone); its tree marks it only for an engine that reads it light', () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-esm-'));
  try {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'base'));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'base', 'Big.esm'), tes3());
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'base', 'Small.esp'), tes3(64 << 10));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'base', 'Fake.esm'), Buffer.alloc(ESM_LIGHT_FROM + 10, 1));
    const stat = (n) => fs.statSync(path.join(dir, 'base', n));
    assert.equal(lightCopy(path.join(dir, 'base', 'Big.esm'), stat('Big.esm')).size, stat('Big.esm').size);
    assert.equal(lightCopy(path.join(dir, 'base', 'Small.esp'), stat('Small.esp')), null, 'under ESM_LIGHT_FROM');
    assert.equal(lightCopy(path.join(dir, 'base', 'Fake.esm'), stat('Fake.esm')), null, 'no TES3 header');
    const man = { folder: path.join(dir, 'v'), baseFolder: path.join(dir, 'base'), lightCopies: true };
    assert.equal(listGameTree(man).files['Big.esm'].light, undefined, 'an engine that does not say it reads it light: not marked');
    assert.equal(listGameTree(man, null, null, { contentLight: true }).files['Big.esm'].light, stat('Big.esm').size);
    assert.equal(listGameTree({ ...man, lightCopies: false }, null, null, { contentLight: true }).files['Big.esm'].light, undefined, 'a Windows game');
    // (served the same way: resolveLightFile)
    assert.equal(resolveLightFile(man, '.light/Big.esm'), null, 'not served to an engine that reads the file');
    assert.equal(resolveLightFile(man, '.light/Big.esm', null, { contentLight: true }).copy.size, stat('Big.esm').size);
  } finally { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test('a TES3 copy\'s map made asynchronously, the same as esmZeroRanges\'; a file gone when it is made: the read fails, nothing thrown', async () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-esm-map-'));
  try {
    // (records past ESM_WALK_SLICE: the walk resumed between turns of the event loop)
    const file = path.join(dir, 'Big.esm'), bytes = tes3(3 << 20); fs.writeFileSync(file, bytes);
    const c = lightCopy(file, fs.statSync(file));
    const z = await c.zeroMap();
    assert.deepEqual([...z], [...esmZeroRanges(bytes)]); assert.equal(c.zeroMap(), c.zeroMap(), 'made once');
    const gone = path.join(dir, 'Gone.esm'); fs.writeFileSync(gone, bytes);
    const g = lightCopy(gone, fs.statSync(gone)); fs.rmSync(gone);
    const err = await new Promise((r) => readLight(gone, g, 0, 100, Buffer.alloc(100), 0, r));
    assert.ok(err, 'the read fails');
    fs.writeFileSync(gone, bytes);
    assert.equal(await new Promise((r) => readLight(gone, g, 0, 100, Buffer.alloc(100), 0, r)), null, 'a failure not kept: made again');
  } finally { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});
```

```js
// The home's light covers (src/host/light-covers.js, server.js /api/cover).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';

const haveWebp = ffmpeg.status === 0 && /libwebp/.test(ffmpeg.stdout);
const get = (port, p) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  http.get({ host: '127.0.0.1', port, path: p }, (res) => { const parts = []; res.on('data', (d) => parts.push(d)); res.on('end', () => resolve({ status: res.statusCode, headers: res.headers, body: Buffer.concat(parts) })); }).on('error', reject);
});
/** a 1920 × 1080 noisy JPEG made by ffmpeg (a cover of a game's size) */
const makeJpeg = (file) => spawnSync('ffmpeg', ['-v', 'error', '-y', '-f', 'lavfi', '-i', 'testsrc2=size=1920x1080:rate=1,noise=alls=60:allf=t', '-frames:v', '1', '-q:v', '2', file]).status === 0;

  const f = path.join(d, 'c.jpg'); fs.writeFileSync(f, Buffer.alloc(4096, 1));

  assert.equal(c.file(f), null);
  assert.equal(c.file(path.join(d, 'cover.svg')), null);

test('light covers: a 960 px WebP made in the background, then served by /api/cover (?full: the image)', { skip: !haveWebp && 'no ffmpeg with libwebp' }, async (t) => {
  const games = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-covg-')); t.after(() => fs.rmSync(games, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const g = path.join(games, 'demo');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(g, 'base'), { recursive: true }); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(g, 'versions', '1.0'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(g, 'base', 'demo.exe'), 'MZ');
  assert.ok(makeJpeg(path.join(g, 'cover.jpg')));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(g, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, id: 'demo', name: 'demo', defaultVersion: 'demo-10', versions: [{ id: 'demo-10', dir: '1.0', version: '1.0', exe: 'demo.exe', coverFile: 'cover.jpg' }] }));
  const coverDir = path.join(games, '..', path.basename(games) + '-covers'); t.after(() => fs.rmSync(coverDir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const server = createServer({ gamesDir: games, coverDir, lanLog: () => {}, brCacheLog: () => {} });
  await new Promise((r) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r)); t.after(() => new Promise((r) => { server.closeAllConnections?.(); server.close(r); }));
  const port = server.address().port, full = fs.statSync(path.join(g, 'cover.jpg')).size;
  const first = await get(port, '/api/cover/demo-10');
  assert.equal(first.status, 200); assert.equal(first.headers['content-type'], 'image/jpeg'); assert.equal(first.body.length, full);
  let r = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) { r = await get(port, '/api/cover/demo-10'); if (r.headers['content-type'] === 'image/webp') break; await new Promise((s) => setTimeout(s, 50)); }
  assert.equal(r.headers['content-type'], 'image/webp');
  assert.ok(r.body.length < full / 2, `${r.body.length} of ${full}`);
  assert.equal(r.body.subarray(0, 4).toString(), 'RIFF');
  // (its width: VP8 bitstream's, or VP8X's canvas)
  const kind = r.body.subarray(12, 16).toString();
  const width = kind === 'VP8X' ? 1 + r.body.readUIntLE(24, 3) : kind === 'VP8 ' ? r.body.readUInt16LE(26) & 0x3fff : null;
  assert.equal(width, COVER_WIDTH);
  assert.equal((await get(port, '/api/cover/demo-10?full=1')).body.length, full);
});

test('light covers: a cover ffmpeg cannot convert is marked, not tried again at each request — again once it changes', async (t) => {
  const d = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-cov-')); t.after(() => fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  // (a stand-in ffmpeg: counts its starts, fails as on an image it cannot read)
  const count = path.join(d, 'count'), fake = path.join(d, 'ffmpeg');
  fs.writeFileSync(fake, `#!/bin/sh\necho x >> '${count}'\necho 'Invalid data found when processing input' >&2\nexit 1\n`); fs.chmodSync(fake, 0o755);
  const starts = () => (fs.existsSync(count) ? fs.readFileSync(count, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).length : 0);
  const logs = [];
  const f = path.join(d, 'c.webp'); fs.writeFileSync(f, Buffer.alloc(4096, 1));
  const c = lightCovers({ dir: path.join(d, 'out'), ffmpeg: fake, log: (m) => logs.push(m) });
  assert.equal(c.pending(f), true);
  assert.equal(await c.make(f), null);
  assert.equal(starts(), 1); assert.equal(logs.length, 1);
  assert.equal(c.pending(f), false, 'marked: the full image is the cover');
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) assert.equal(c.file(f), null);
  assert.equal(await c.make(f), null);
  assert.equal(starts(), 1, 'not spawned again'); assert.equal(logs.length, 1);
  // (the cover changed: tried again)
  fs.writeFileSync(f, Buffer.alloc(5000, 2));
  assert.equal(c.pending(f), true);
  assert.equal(await c.make(f), null);
  assert.equal(starts(), 2);
  assert.equal(c.pending(path.join(d, 'cover.svg')), false, 'an SVG: none to wait for');
});

  // (made with no request for it: the server started it)

  for (let i = 0; i < 200 && made() < 2; i++) await new Promise((s) => setTimeout(s, 50));
```

```js
// GetLocaleInfo values: the LCTYPE constants of winnls.h map to the en-US values (a C runtime's setlocale reads the

test('GetLocaleInfo en-US values by LCTYPE', () => {
  const LOCALE_ILANGUAGE = 0x1, LOCALE_SENGLANGUAGE = 0x1001, LOCALE_SABBREVLANGNAME = 0x3, LOCALE_IDEFAULTCODEPAGE = 0xb,
    LOCALE_IDEFAULTANSICODEPAGE = 0x1004, LOCALE_SDECIMAL = 0xe, LOCALE_STHOUSAND = 0xf, LOCALE_SGROUPING = 0x10,

  assert.equal(localeInfoValue(LOCALE_ILANGUAGE), '0409');

  assert.equal(localeInfoValue(LOCALE_SDATE), '/');
  assert.equal(localeInfoValue(LOCALE_STIME), ':');
```

`tests/manifest.test.js`:

```js
// Manifests synthesized for bare game folders (`orthros run <folder>`): the main executable is picked by
// generic rules — installers/tools skipped, a name matching the folder preferred, then the largest.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pickExe, folderManifest } from '../src/host/manifest.js';

function folder(name, files) {
  const dir = path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-man-')), name);
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  for (const [f, size] of Object.entries(files)) { fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(dir, f)), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, f), Buffer.alloc(size)); }
  return dir;
}

test('pickExe: installers and tools are skipped, the folder name wins, then the size', () => {
  assert.equal(pickExe(folder('Space Racer', { 'setup.exe': 900, 'unins000.exe': 800, 'SpaceRacer.exe': 10, 'editor.exe': 500 })), 'SpaceRacer.exe');
  assert.equal(pickExe(folder('mygame', { 'Setup.exe': 900, 'game.exe': 300, 'tool.exe': 100, 'Uninstall.exe': 999 })), 'game.exe');
  assert.equal(pickExe(folder('x', { 'bin/run.exe': 5, 'data/readme.txt': 1 })), 'bin/run.exe'); // one level down
  assert.equal(pickExe(folder('y', { 'setup.exe': 5 })), 'setup.exe'); // nothing else: better than nothing
  assert.equal(pickExe(folder('z', { 'a.txt': 5 })), null);
});

test('folderManifest: the folder manifest.json and explicit options take precedence over the guess', () => {
  const dir = folder('g', { 'a.exe': 10, 'b.exe': 20 });
  assert.equal(folderManifest(dir).exe, 'b.exe');
  assert.equal(folderManifest(dir, { exe: 'a.exe' }).exe, 'a.exe');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ exe: 'a.exe', args: '-win' }));
  const m = folderManifest(dir);
  assert.deepEqual([m.exe, m.args, m.mount, m.folder], ['a.exe', '-win', 'C:\\Game', dir]);
});
```

`tests/mci.test.js`:

```js
// MCI digital video (src/win32/mci.js) driven by a Win32 program (tools/pe/mci.c): mciSendString — open with a type
// and an alias, window, put / where, play notify (MM_MCINOTIFY), status, seek, play wait, frames, from / to, close,
// errors — and mciSendCommand (open by element, play wait, status, close), over the same playback engine as DirectShow.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { Vfs, MemBackend } from '../src/vfs/vfs.js';
import { VirtualClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';
import { makeAvi } from './media-avi-writer.js';
import { mciWords } from '../src/win32/mci.js';

const PE_DIR = new URL('../build/pe/', import.meta.url).pathname;
const MOVIE = new URL('./fixtures/media/movie.mpg', import.meta.url).pathname;
const skip = !fs.existsSync(PE_DIR + 'mci.exe') && 'build/pe/mci.exe missing (make pe-tests)';

test('MCI command strings: words and quoted names', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(mciWords('open "C:\\Movies\\My Intro.avi" type avivideo alias intro'), ['open', 'C:\\Movies\\My Intro.avi', 'type', 'avivideo', 'alias', 'intro']);
  assert.deepEqual(mciWords('  play   intro  from 0 to 100 notify '), ['play', 'intro', 'from', '0', 'to', '100', 'notify']);
});

test('mci.exe: MPEG movie through mciSendString, AVI through mciSendCommand', { skip }, () => {
  const vfs = new Vfs(), dir = new MemBackend();
  vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend()); vfs.mount('C:\\Test', dir);
  dir.open('mci.exe', { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(PE_DIR + 'mci.exe'));
  dir.open('movie.mpg', { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(MOVIE));
  dir.open('clip.avi', { create: true }).write(0, makeAvi(96, 64, 12, 10).bytes);
  const clock = new VirtualClock();
  const host = new HeadlessHost({ clock, width: 800, height: 600 });
  const shown = []; let hidden = 0;
  host.display.presentVideo = (rgba, w, h, rect) => shown.push({ at: clock.now(), w, h, rect: { ...rect } });
  host.display.hideVideo = () => { hidden++; };
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host, logKinds: ['warn', 'crash'] });
  vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\mci.exe' });
  assert.equal(vm.run(), 0);
  const res = Object.fromEntries(vm.stdout.join('').trim().split('\n').map((l) => l.split('=')));
  assert.equal(res.missing, '275', 'MCIERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND');
  assert.equal(res.cdaudio, '257', 'other device types: as before');
  assert.equal(res['unknown name'], '263', 'MCIERR_INVALID_DEVICE_NAME');
  assert.equal(res.open, '0'); assert.equal(res['open id'], '1'); assert.equal(res['device id'], '1');
  assert.ok(Math.abs(Number(res.length) - 1200) < 60, `length ${res.length}`);
  assert.equal(res.mode, 'stopped');
  assert.equal(res.window, '0'); assert.equal(res.put, '0'); assert.equal(res.where, '8 6 128 96');
  assert.equal(res.play, '0'); assert.equal(res['mode playing'], 'playing');
  const e = Number(res['elapsed ms']);
  assert.ok(e >= 1150 && e <= 1350, `played in ${e} ms`);
  assert.equal(res.notified, '1'); assert.equal(res['notify flag'], '1', 'MCI_NOTIFY_SUCCESSFUL'); assert.equal(res['notify id'], '1');
  assert.equal(res['mode after'], 'stopped');
  assert.ok(Math.abs(Number(res.position) - 1200) < 60, `position ${res.position}`);
  assert.equal(res.seek, '0'); assert.equal(res['play wait'], '0');
  const w = Number(res['elapsed wait ms']);
  assert.ok(w >= 1150 && w <= 1350, `play wait returned after ${w} ms`);
  assert.equal(res.frames, '0'); assert.ok(['29', '30'].includes(res['length frames']), `length ${res['length frames']} frames`); // (an MPEG stream's length: from its last time stamps)
  const part = Number(res['part ms']);
  assert.ok(part >= 380 && part <= 480, `from frame 10 to 20 in ${part} ms`);
  assert.equal(res.close, '0'); assert.equal(res['closed name'], '263');
  // the pictures: in the given window's client area at the destination rectangle
  const owner = [...vm.wm.windows.values()].find((x) => x.title === 'mci');
  const firstAvi = shown.findIndex((x) => x.rect.w === 96 && x.rect.h === 64), mpeg = shown.slice(0, firstAvi);
  assert.ok(mpeg.length >= 50, `${mpeg.length} pictures of the MPEG movie`);
  for (const s of mpeg) assert.deepEqual(s.rect, { x: owner.client.l + 8, y: owner.client.t + 6, w: 128, h: 96 });
  // the AVI through mciSendCommand: its own window (centered, natural size), played to the end, closed
  assert.equal(res['cmd open'], '0'); assert.equal(res['cmd play wait'], '0');
  const ce = Number(res['cmd elapsed ms']);
  assert.ok(ce >= 1150 && ce <= 1350, `AVI played in ${ce} ms`);
  assert.equal(res['cmd mode'], '525', 'MCI_MODE_STOP'); assert.equal(res['cmd length'], '12', 'AVIVideo: frames by default');
  assert.equal(res['cmd close'], '0');
  const avi = shown.filter((s) => s.rect.w === 96 && s.rect.h === 64);
  assert.ok(avi.length >= 10, `${avi.length} pictures of the AVI`);
  assert.deepEqual(avi[0].rect, { x: (800 - 96) >> 1, y: (600 - 64) >> 1, w: 96, h: 64 });
  assert.ok(hidden >= 2, 'the layer hidden at each close');
});
```

`tests/media-audio-files.test.js`:

```js
// Audio files of the DirectShow path (src/media): RIFF WAVE (PCM, float, IMA / Microsoft ADPCM) and MPEG audio layer III
// through the browser's asynchronous decoder (WebCodecs AudioDecoder, here a stand-in; tools/media-browser-check.mjs
// checks the real one against ffmpeg).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { openMedia } from '../src/media/open.js';

const rng = (seed) => () => { seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; return seed / 4294967296; };
const f32 = (b) => new Float32Array(b.buffer.slice(b.byteOffset, b.byteOffset + b.length));
let ffmpeg = false;
try { execFileSync('ffmpeg', ['-version'], { stdio: 'ignore' }); ffmpeg = true; } catch { /* not installed */ }
const ff = (...a) => execFileSync('ffmpeg', ['-nostdin', '-loglevel', 'error', '-y', ...a]);

/** a WAVE file: format tag, channels, rate, bits, block align, data bytes (and the cbSize extension bytes) */
function wave(tag, ch, rate, bits, align, data, ext = new Uint8Array(0)) {
  const fmtLen = 16 + (tag === 1 || tag === 3 ? 0 : 2 + ext.length), b = new Uint8Array(12 + 8 + fmtLen + 8 + data.length), dv = new DataView(b.buffer);
  const str = (o, s) => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) b[o + i] = s.charCodeAt(i); };
  str(0, 'RIFF'); dv.setUint32(4, b.length - 8, true); str(8, 'WAVE'); str(12, 'fmt '); dv.setUint32(16, fmtLen, true);
  dv.setUint16(20, tag, true); dv.setUint16(22, ch, true); dv.setUint32(24, rate, true); dv.setUint32(28, rate * align, true); dv.setUint16(32, align, true); dv.setUint16(34, bits, true);
  if (fmtLen > 16) { dv.setUint16(36, ext.length, true); b.set(ext, 38); }
  str(20 + fmtLen, 'data'); dv.setUint32(24 + fmtLen, data.length, true); b.set(data, 28 + fmtLen);
  return b;
}
const fileOf = (b) => ({ size: () => b.length, read: (o, n) => b.subarray(o, o + n) });
function playAll(s) { const ch = []; s.audioUntil(1e9, (smp, start) => ch.push({ smp, start })); return ch; }

test('RIFF WAVE: integer and float PCM decoded exactly, in pieces with their times', () => {
  const r = rng(9), n = 70000; // (several 256 KiB reads at 16-bit stereo)
  const v = Float64Array.from({ length: 2 * n }, () => Math.round((r() * 2 - 1) * 32767) / 32768);
  const s16 = new Uint8Array(4 * n), dv = new DataView(s16.buffer); v.forEach((x, i) => dv.setInt16(2 * i, Math.round(x * 32768), true));
  const fl = new Uint8Array(8 * n), fv = new DataView(fl.buffer); v.forEach((x, i) => fv.setFloat32(4 * i, x, true));
  const u8 = Uint8Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => 128 + Math.round(v[i] * 127));
  for (const [file, ch, check] of [[wave(1, 2, 44100, 16, 4, s16), 2, (c, i) => v[i * 2 + c]], [wave(3, 2, 48000, 32, 8, fl), 2, (c, i) => Math.fround(v[i * 2 + c])], [wave(1, 1, 11025, 8, 1, u8), 1, (c, i) => (u8[i] - 128) / 128]]) {
    const s = openMedia(fileOf(file));
    assert.equal(s.kind, 'wav'); assert.equal(s.audioChannels, ch); assert.ok(!s.video);
    const pieces = playAll(s);
    assert.ok(s.audioDone && s.ended(s.audioEnd));
    let i = 0;
    for (const p of pieces) { assert.ok(Math.abs(p.start - i / s.audioRate) < 1e-9); for (let k = 0; k < p.smp[0].length; k++, i++) for (let c = 0; c < ch; c++) assert.equal(p.smp[c][k], Math.fround(check(c, i))); }
    assert.equal(i, n); assert.ok(Math.abs(s.duration - n / s.audioRate) < 1e-9);
  }
  assert.throws(() => openMedia(fileOf(wave(0x161, 2, 44100, 16, 4, new Uint8Array(100)))), /format tag 0x161/); // (Windows Media Audio: not here)
});

test('RIFF WAVE against ffmpeg: 24-bit PCM, IMA ADPCM, Microsoft ADPCM', { skip: !ffmpeg && 'ffmpeg not installed' }, () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-wav-'));
  try {
    for (const [codec, ch, rate, min] of [['pcm_s24le', 2, 48000, 200], ['adpcm_ms', 1, 22050, 200], ['adpcm_ms', 2, 44100, 200], ['adpcm_ima_wav', 1, 22050, 38], ['adpcm_ima_wav', 2, 44100, 38]]) {
      // (IMA ADPCM: the reference algorithm's step arithmetic, which ffmpeg computes otherwise: a rounding difference)
      const w = path.join(dir, 'a.wav'), pcm = path.join(dir, 'a.f32');
      ff('-f', 'lavfi', '-i', `anoisesrc=d=1.2:c=pink:r=${rate}:a=0.4`, '-ac', String(ch), '-ar', String(rate), '-c:a', codec, w);
      ff('-i', w, '-f', 'f32le', '-c:a', 'pcm_f32le', pcm);
      const s = openMedia(fileOf(fs.readFileSync(w))), ref = f32(fs.readFileSync(pcm));
      let se = 0, sp = 0, n = 0;
      for (const p of playAll(s)) { for (let i = 0; i < p.smp[0].length; i++, n++) for (let c = 0; c < ch; c++) { const y = ref[n * ch + c]; se += (p.smp[c][i] - y) ** 2; sp += y * y; } }
      assert.equal(n, ref.length / ch, codec);
      const snrdb = se ? 10 * Math.log10(sp / se) : Infinity;
      assert.ok(snrdb > min, `${codec} ${ch} ch: SNR ${snrdb.toFixed(1)} dB`);
    }
  } finally { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }

test('MPEG audio layer III through an asynchronous decoder (WebCodecs interface): ahead, in order, the end, a failure', async () => {
  // a stand-in for the browser's AudioDecoder: each chunk decodes (later) to its frame's samples, all equal to its start
  const made = [];
  class FakeDecoder {
    constructor(init) { this.init = init; this.queue = []; this.state = 'unconfigured'; made.push(this); }
    configure(c) { this.config = c; this.state = 'configured'; if (c.codec !== 'mp3') throw new Error('codec'); }
    decode(chunk) { this.queue.push(chunk); setTimeout(() => this.drain(), 1); }
    drain() {
      for (const ch of this.queue.splice(0)) {
        if (this.failAt !== undefined && ch.timestamp >= this.failAt) { this.init.error(new Error('broken')); return; }
        this.init.output({ numberOfFrames: 1152, numberOfChannels: this.config.numberOfChannels, timestamp: ch.timestamp, copyTo: (a) => a.fill(ch.timestamp / 1e6), close() {} });
      }
    }
    flush() { return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => { this.drain(); r(); }, 2)); }
    close() { this.state = 'closed'; }
  }
  // an MP3-like elementary stream: layer III frame headers (MPEG-1, 128 kbit/s, 44.1 kHz, stereo) with empty bodies
  const frame = new Uint8Array(417); frame.set([0xff, 0xfb, 0x90, 0x00]);
  const nframes = 120, data = new Uint8Array(417 * nframes); for (let i = 0; i < nframes; i++) data.set(frame, 417 * i);
  const saved = [globalThis.AudioDecoder, globalThis.EncodedAudioChunk];
  assert.throws(() => openMedia(fileOf(data)), /layer III/, 'no decoder: unsupported, as before');
  globalThis.AudioDecoder = FakeDecoder; globalThis.EncodedAudioChunk = class { constructor(o) { Object.assign(this, o); } };
  try {
    const s = openMedia(fileOf(data));
    assert.ok(s.audio && s.audioAsync); assert.equal(s.audioRate, 44100); assert.equal(s.audioChannels, 2);
    const got = [];
    let t = 0, maxAhead = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < 400 && !s.ended(t); k++) {
      t += 0.05; s.audioUntil(t, (smp, start) => got.push({ smp, start }));
      maxAhead = Math.max(maxAhead, s.submitPos / 44100 - t);
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3));
    }
    assert.ok(s.audioDone, 'the end once the decoder is flushed');
    assert.ok(maxAhead > 0.9 && maxAhead < 1.1, `submitted ${maxAhead.toFixed(2)} s ahead`);
    assert.equal(got.length, nframes);
    got.forEach((g, i) => { assert.ok(Math.abs(g.start - i * 1152 / 44100) < 1e-6); assert.equal(g.smp.length, 2); assert.ok(Math.abs(g.smp[1][0] - g.start) < 1e-6); });
    // a decoder failing midway: the stream ends (silent from there) instead of waiting forever
    const s2 = openMedia(fileOf(data));
    made.at(-1).failAt = 1e6; // (from 1 s on)
    let t2 = 0, n2 = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < 400 && !s2.ended(t2); k++) { t2 += 0.05; s2.audioUntil(t2, () => n2++); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3)); }
    assert.ok(s2.audioDone && n2 < nframes && n2 >= 30, `${n2} frames before the failure`);
    // the same stream in a WAVE file (format 0x55, as Windows' ACM plays it): its data chunk as an MPEG stream
    const s3 = openMedia(fileOf(wave(0x55, 2, 44100, 0, 1, data, new Uint8Array(12))));
    assert.ok(s3.audioAsync); assert.equal(s3.kind, 'mpeg-audio');
    const got3 = [];
    for (let t3 = 0, k = 0; k < 400 && !s3.ended(t3); k++) { t3 += 0.05; s3.audioUntil(t3, (smp, start) => got3.push(start)); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3)); }
    assert.equal(got3.length, nframes);
  } finally { [globalThis.AudioDecoder, globalThis.EncodedAudioChunk] = saved; }
});
```

`tests/media-avi-writer.js`:

```js
// A small AVI written for the tests (media-avi.test.js, quartz.test.js).
/** RIFF chunk / list writers */
const le32 = (v) => [v & 255, (v >> 8) & 255, (v >> 16) & 255, (v >>> 24) & 255], le16 = (v) => [v & 255, (v >> 8) & 255];
const ascii = (s) => [...s].map((c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
const chunk = (id, data) => { const d = [...data]; return [...ascii(id), ...le32(d.length), ...d, ...(d.length & 1 ? [0] : [])]; };
const list = (type, items) => { const d = [...ascii(type), ...items.flat()]; return [...ascii('LIST'), ...le32(d.length), ...d]; };

/** an AVI: W x H 8-bit paletted frames (bottom-up), 8 kHz mono 16-bit PCM, a palette change at frame 2, 'rec ' lists */
export function makeAvi(W, H, nframes, fps) {
  const pal = Array.from({ length: 256 }, (_, i) => [i, 255 - i, (i * 7) & 255, 0]).flat();
  const bih = [...le32(40), ...le32(W), ...le32(H), ...le16(1), ...le16(8), ...le32(0), ...le32(0), ...le32(0), ...le32(0), ...le32(256), ...le32(0), ...pal];
  const wfx = [...le16(1), ...le16(1), ...le32(8000), ...le32(16000), ...le16(2), ...le16(16)];
  const strh = (type, handler, scale, rate, length, sampleSize) => [...ascii(type), ...ascii(handler), ...le32(0), ...le32(0), ...le32(0), ...le32(scale), ...le32(rate), ...le32(0), ...le32(length), ...le32(0), ...le32(0xffffffff), ...le32(sampleSize), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
  const avih = [...le32(Math.round(1e6 / fps)), ...le32(0), ...le32(0), ...le32(0x10), ...le32(nframes), ...le32(0), ...le32(2), ...le32(0), ...le32(W), ...le32(H), ...le32(0), ...le32(0), ...le32(0), ...le32(0)];
  const hdrl = list('hdrl', [chunk('avih', avih), list('strl', [chunk('strh', strh('vids', '\0\0\0\0', 1, fps, nframes, 0)), chunk('strf', bih)]), list('strl', [chunk('strh', strh('auds', '\0\0\0\0', 1, 8000, nframes * 8000 / fps, 2)), chunk('strf', wfx)])]);
  const frames = [], sound = [], items = [];
  const spf = 8000 / fps;
  for (let f = 0; f < nframes; f++) {
    const px = new Uint8Array(W * H); for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) px[y * W + x] = (x * 3 + y * 5 + f * 11) & 255; // (stored rows: bottom-up)
    px[0] = 0; px[1] = 1; // (the entries the palette change replaces)
    frames.push(px);
    const pcm = new Int16Array(spf); for (let i = 0; i < spf; i++) pcm[i] = ((f * spf + i) * 37 % 2000) - 1000;
    sound.push(pcm);
    const rec = [chunk('01wb', new Uint8Array(pcm.buffer)), chunk('00db', px)];
    if (f === 2) rec.unshift(chunk('00pc', [0, 2, 0, 0, 10, 20, 30, 0, 40, 50, 60, 0])); // (entries 0-1 change)
    items.push(f % 2 ? list('rec ', rec) : rec.flat());
  }
  const movi = list('movi', items);
  const body = [...ascii('AVI '), ...hdrl, ...chunk('JUNK', new Uint8Array(30)), ...movi, ...chunk('idx1', new Uint8Array(16))];
  return { bytes: new Uint8Array([...ascii('RIFF'), ...le32(body.length), ...body]), frames, sound, pal };
}
```

```js
// AVI files of the DirectShow path (src/media/avi-source.js, vfw-codecs.js): a file written here (uncompressed DIB frames
// + PCM, palette changes, 'rec ' lists, idx1) decoded exactly; Cinepak, Microsoft Video 1, Microsoft RLE, uncompressed
// DIBs and the audio formats against ffmpeg when it is installed.
import { test } from 'node:test';

test('AVI written here: paletted frames, a palette change, interleaved PCM, timing', () => {
  const W = 12, H = 8, fps = 10, N = 7;
  const { bytes, frames, sound, pal } = makeAvi(W, H, N, fps);
  const s = openMedia(fileOf(bytes));
  assert.equal(s.kind, 'avi'); assert.equal(s.width, W); assert.equal(s.height, H); assert.equal(s.fps, fps);
  assert.equal(s.audioRate, 8000); assert.equal(s.audioChannels, 1); assert.ok(Math.abs(s.duration - N / fps) < 1e-9);
  const P = pal.slice(); let shown = 0, samples = [];
  for (let t = 0; t < 2 && !s.ended(t); t += 0.025) {
    s.load(t);
    const p = s.pictureAt(t);
    if (p) {
      const f = s.frameIndex - 1;
      if (f === 2) P.splice(0, 8, 30, 20, 10, 0, 60, 50, 40, 0); // (PALETTEENTRY: red, green, blue; P: as RGBQUAD, blue first)
      for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
        const v = frames[f][(H - 1 - y) * W + x], o = 4 * (y * W + x);
        assert.deepEqual(Array.from(p.rgba.subarray(o, o + 4)), [P[4 * v + 2], P[4 * v + 1], P[4 * v], 255], `frame ${f} (${x}, ${y})`);
      }
      assert.ok(Math.abs(s.frameTime(f) - f / fps) < 1e-9 && s.frameTime(f) <= t);
      shown++;
    }
    s.audioUntil(t + 0.1, (smp, start) => { assert.ok(Math.abs(start - samples.length / 8000) < 1e-9); samples.push(...smp[0]); });
  }
  assert.equal(shown, N); assert.equal(s.frameIndex, N);
  const want = sound.flatMap((a) => Array.from(a, (v) => v / 32768));
  assert.deepEqual(samples, want);
});

test('AVI codecs against ffmpeg: Cinepak (color, gray, strips), Microsoft Video 1, RLE8, DIB 8 / 16 / 24-bit; audio formats', { skip: !ffmpeg && 'ffmpeg not installed' }, () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-avi-'));
  try {
    const W = 160, H = 120;
    const cases = [
      ['testsrc2', ['-c:v', 'cinepak', '-g', '30', '-max_strips', '4', '-min_strips', '2'], 50],

      ['testsrc2', ['-c:v', 'msvideo1'], 50],
      ['testsrc2', ['-c:v', 'msrle', '-pix_fmt', 'pal8'], 99],
      ['testsrc2', ['-c:v', 'rawvideo', '-pix_fmt', 'bgr24'], 99],
      ['testsrc2', ['-c:v', 'rawvideo', '-pix_fmt', 'pal8'], 99],
      ['testsrc2', ['-c:v', 'rawvideo', '-pix_fmt', 'rgb555le'], 50], // (5-bit expansion: rounding)
    ];
    for (const [src, opts, min] of cases) {
      const avi = path.join(dir, 'v.avi'), rgba = path.join(dir, 'v.rgba');
      ff('-f', 'lavfi', '-i', `${src}=size=${W}x${H}:rate=15`, '-t', '2', ...opts, avi);
      ff('-i', avi, '-f', 'rawvideo', '-pix_fmt', 'rgba', rgba);

      let worst = 99;
      for (let k = 0; k < 30; k++) {
        const t = k / 15 + 0.001; s.load(t); const p = s.pictureAt(t);

        for (let i = 0; i < F; i++) if ((i & 3) !== 3) se += (p.rgba[i] - r[i]) ** 2;
        worst = Math.min(worst, se ? 10 * Math.log10(255 * 255 * W * H * 3 / se) : 99);
      }
      assert.ok(worst >= min, `${opts.join(' ')}: worst picture ${worst.toFixed(1)} dB`);

    for (const [codec, ch, rate, exact] of [['pcm_s16le', 2, 22050, true], ['adpcm_ms', 1, 22050, true], ['adpcm_ima_wav', 2, 44100, false], ['mp2', 2, 44100, false]]) {

      const b = fs.readFileSync(pcm), ref = new Float32Array(b.buffer.slice(b.byteOffset, b.byteOffset + b.length)), s = openMedia(fileOf(fs.readFileSync(avi)));
      assert.equal(s.audioChannels, ch); assert.equal(s.audioRate, rate);
      let n = 0, se = 0, sp = 0;
      for (let t = 0; t < 3 && !s.audioDone; t += 0.1) { s.load(t); s.audioUntil(t, (smp) => { for (let i = 0; i < smp[0].length; i++, n++) for (let c = 0; c < ch; c++) { const y = ref[n * ch + c] ?? 0; se += (smp[c][i] - y) ** 2; sp += y * y; } }); }

    }
```

`tests/media-damaged-files.test.js`:

```js
// Damaged AVI and WAVE files (src/media): opening and playing them ends in bounded time — a chunk size or a header
// field out of range (a 4 GiB strl list, a 16 M-pixel-wide frame, 65535 channels, a 4 GHz rate) is refused or skipped,
// never walked byte by byte nor allocated: the movie player runs on the emulator's thread, so a stall freezes the game.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { openMedia } from '../src/media/open.js';
import { makeAvi } from './media-avi-writer.js';

const rng = (seed) => () => { seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; return seed / 4294967296; };
function wave(tag, ch, rate, bits, align, data, ext = new Uint8Array(0)) {
  const fmtLen = 16 + (tag === 1 || tag === 3 ? 0 : 2 + ext.length), b = new Uint8Array(12 + 8 + fmtLen + 8 + data.length), dv = new DataView(b.buffer);
  const str = (o, s) => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) b[o + i] = s.charCodeAt(i); };
  str(0, 'RIFF'); dv.setUint32(4, b.length - 8, true); str(8, 'WAVE'); str(12, 'fmt '); dv.setUint32(16, fmtLen, true);
  dv.setUint16(20, tag, true); dv.setUint16(22, ch, true); dv.setUint32(24, rate, true); dv.setUint32(28, rate * align, true); dv.setUint16(32, align, true); dv.setUint16(34, bits, true);
  if (fmtLen > 16) { dv.setUint16(36, ext.length, true); b.set(ext, 38); }
  str(20 + fmtLen, 'data'); dv.setUint32(24 + fmtLen, data.length, true); b.set(data, 28 + fmtLen);
  return b;
}
const fileOf = (b) => ({ size: () => b.length, read: (o, n) => b.subarray(o, o + n) });
/** open and play `b` for up to 4 s of stream time: the wall time it took */
function playMs(b) {
  const t0 = performance.now();
  let s;
  try { s = openMedia(fileOf(b)); } catch { return performance.now() - t0; } // (refused: what RenderFile reports)
  try {
    for (let t = 0; t < 4 && !s.ended(t); t += 0.04) { s.load(t); if (s.video) s.pictureAt(t); s.audioUntil(t, () => {}); }
  } catch { /* (an exception while playing: the player's failure, quartz.js EC_ERRORABORT) */ }
  return performance.now() - t0;
}

test('damaged AVI / WAVE headers: refused or played in bounded time', () => {
  // the cases found by mutation: a strl list claiming 4 GiB, a frame 16 M pixels wide, 65535 channels, a 4 GHz rate
  const avi = makeAvi(32, 16, 8, 10).bytes;
  const at = (id) => { for (let i = 0; i + 4 < avi.length; i++) if (String.fromCharCode(...avi.subarray(i, i + 4)) === id) return i; return -1; };
  const hugeList = Uint8Array.from(avi), strl = at('strl') - 8; hugeList.set([0xf0, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff], strl + 4);
  const wide = Uint8Array.from(avi), strf = at('strf'); wide.set([0x20, 0x00, 0xff, 0x00], strf + 8 + 4);
  for (const [name, b] of [['4 GiB strl', hugeList], ['16 M-pixel frame', wide], ['65535 channels', wave(1, 65535, 22050, 16, 4, new Uint8Array(4000))], ['4 GHz', wave(1, 2, 0xffffffff, 16, 4, new Uint8Array(4000))], ['align 1 for 16-bit stereo', wave(1, 2, 22050, 16, 1, new Uint8Array(4000))]]) {
    const ms = playMs(b);
    assert.ok(ms < 500, `${name}: ${ms.toFixed(0)} ms`);
  }
  // random mutations of the header and of the whole file
  const imaExt = new Uint8Array([0xf9, 0x01]);
  const bases = { avi, wav: wave(1, 2, 22050, 16, 4, new Uint8Array(4000).map((_, i) => i * 7)), ima: wave(0x11, 1, 22050, 4, 256, new Uint8Array(2048).map((_, i) => i * 13), imaExt) };
  const r = rng(124);
  for (const [name, base] of Object.entries(bases)) {
    for (let k = 0; k < 150; k++) {
      const b = Uint8Array.from(base), n = 1 + Math.floor(r() * 12);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) b[Math.floor(r() * (k % 2 ? b.length : Math.min(b.length, 300)))] = r() < 0.3 ? 0xff : r() < 0.5 ? 0 : Math.floor(r() * 256);
      const ms = playMs(r() < 0.2 ? b.subarray(0, Math.floor(r() * b.length)) : b);
      assert.ok(ms < 1000, `${name} mutation ${k}: ${ms.toFixed(0)} ms`);
    }
  }
});
```

`tests/media-files.test.js`:

```js
// Media files after the rest (docs/slow-network.md "Media files after the rest"): the server marks movies, music and
// long sounds in the tree by format; on a link that is not fast the learned order puts them after every other entry
// and the startup set leaves them out; the offline copy downloads them last; no guessed blocks for a media file the
// game is not streaming.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { isMediaFile, MEDIA_WAV_BYTES, treeFiles } from '../src/vfs/game-tree.js';
import { listGameTree } from '../src/host/game-files.js';
import { HttpBackend, BLOCK, CHUNK } from '../src/vfs/http-backend.js';
import { NetLink } from '../src/vfs/net-link.js';
import { MemBlockStore } from '../src/vfs/opfs-store.js';
import { forLink, startupHead } from '../src/vfs/launch-set.js';

const MiB = 1 << 20;
const byteAt = (i) => (i * 7 + (i >> 9)) & 0xff;
const bytes = (a, b) => Uint8Array.from({ length: b - a }, (_, k) => byteAt(a + k));
const tree = () => ({
  dirs: { Video: { dirs: {}, files: { 'intro.bik': { size: 3 * MiB, mtime: 1, media: true } } } },
  files: { 'data.bsa': { size: 3 * MiB, mtime: 1 }, 'title.mp3': { size: 2 * MiB, mtime: 1, media: true } },
});
const mid = () => new NetLink({ bw: 1 << 20, fixed: true }); // (neither thin nor fast)

test('media files by format: movies, music, a long .wav; not a short sound nor a game archive', () => {
  for (const n of ['a.bik', 'B.BK2', 'm.mp3', 'm.ogg', 'v.avi', 'v.mpg', 'v.wmv', 'v.smk', 'v.webm']) assert.ok(isMediaFile(n, 10), n);
  assert.ok(isMediaFile('speech.wav', MEDIA_WAV_BYTES));
  assert.ok(!isMediaFile('click.wav', MEDIA_WAV_BYTES - 1));
  for (const n of ['data.bsa', 'tex.dds', 'game.big', 'bik']) assert.ok(!isMediaFile(n, 1 << 30), n);
});

test('the server\'s tree marks media files (media: true), and the tree\'s file list keeps the mark', () => {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-media-'));
  try {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, 'Video'));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'Video', 'logo.bik'), 'x');
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'click.wav'), 'x');
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'speech.wav'), Buffer.alloc(MEDIA_WAV_BYTES));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'data.bsa'), 'x');
    const t = listGameTree({ folder: root });
    assert.equal(t.dirs.Video.files['logo.bik'].media, true);
    assert.equal(t.files['speech.wav'].media, true);
    assert.equal(t.files['click.wav'].media, undefined);
    assert.equal(t.files['data.bsa'].media, undefined);
    const list = Object.fromEntries(treeFiles(t).map((f) => [f.path, !!f.media]));
    assert.deepEqual(list, { 'Video/logo.bik': true, 'click.wav': false, 'speech.wav': true, 'data.bsa': false });
  } finally { fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test('learned order on a link that is not fast: media entries after all the others, in their order; the startup set without them', () => {
  const part = { files: new HttpBackend('/game/m/', tree()) };
  const list = [['Video/intro.bik', 0, 0xffff, 0], ['data.bsa', 0, 1, 100], ['title.mp3', 0, 0xffff, 200], ['data.bsa', 1, 1, 300], ['Video/intro.bik', 1, 0xffff, 400]];
  assert.deepEqual(forLink(part.files, list, false).map(([p, b]) => `${p}#${b}`), ['data.bsa#0', 'data.bsa#1', 'Video/intro.bik#0', 'title.mp3#0', 'Video/intro.bik#1']);
  assert.deepEqual(forLink(part.files, list, true), list, 'a fast link: the order as learned');
  assert.deepEqual(startupHead(part.files, forLink(part.files, list, false), false).map(([p, b]) => `${p}#${b}`), ['data.bsa#0', 'data.bsa#1']);
  // (the pause before the media: a gap of the startup set measured between the entries left)
  const paused = [['data.bsa', 0, 1, 0], ['title.mp3', 0, 1, 1000], ['data.bsa', 1, 1, 1900], ['data.bsa', 2, 1, 9000]];
  assert.deepEqual(startupHead(part.files, forLink(part.files, paused, false), false).map(([p, b]) => `${p}#${b}`), ['data.bsa#0', 'data.bsa#1']);
  assert.deepEqual(startupHead(part.files, forLink(part.files, paused, true), true).map(([p, b]) => `${p}#${b}`), ['data.bsa#0', 'title.mp3#0', 'data.bsa#1']);
});

test('offline copy: the media files\' blocks after every other block, learned ones first among them', async () => {
  const real = globalThis.fetch, calls = [];
  globalThis.fetch = async (url) => {
    const [, a, e] = /[?&]r=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(url).map(Number);
    calls.push(`${decodeURIComponent(url.split('?')[0].split('/').slice(3).join('/'))}#${a / BLOCK}`);
    return { status: 206, headers: { get: () => null }, arrayBuffer: async () => bytes(a, e).buffer };
  };
  try {
    const store = new MemBlockStore();
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/o/', tree(), { store, encoded: true, net: new NetLink({ bw: 64 << 20, fixed: true }) });
    const p = {};
    await b.downloadAll(p, () => false, { alone: true, order: [['title.mp3', 1], ['data.bsa', 2], ['Video/intro.bik', 0]] });
    assert.ok(p.done);
    const firstMedia = calls.findIndex((c) => /\.(mp3|bik)#/.test(c));
    assert.ok(calls.slice(0, firstMedia).every((c) => c.startsWith('data.bsa#')) && calls.slice(firstMedia).every((c) => !c.startsWith('data.bsa#')), calls.join(' '));
    assert.equal(calls[0], 'data.bsa#2', 'the learned block first');
    assert.deepEqual(calls.slice(firstMedia, firstMedia + 2), ['title.mp3#1', 'Video/intro.bik#0'], 'the learned media blocks first among the media');
  } finally { globalThis.fetch = real; }
});

test('no guessed blocks for a media file the game is not streaming: neither near a miss nor the next ones; a stream keeps them', () => {
  const real = globalThis.fetch, realXhr = globalThis.XMLHttpRequest;
  globalThis.fetch = async () => { throw new Error('no background fetch in this test'); };
  globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = class {
    open(m, url) { this.url = url; }
    setRequestHeader(k, v) { this.range = v; }
    getResponseHeader() { return null; }
    send() { const [, a, z] = /bytes=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(this.range); this.status = 206; this.response = bytes(+a, +z + 1).buffer; }
  };
  try {
    const b = new HttpBackend('/game/g/', tree(), { net: mid() });
    b.fillBackground = () => {};
    assert.ok(b.isMedia('title.mp3') && b.isMedia('Video/intro.bik') && !b.isMedia('data.bsa'));
    const out = new Uint8Array(100);
    // a game archive: the block, the next ones and those near it are guessed
    b.readPieces('data.bsa', 3 * MiB, 1, 1, MiB, MiB + 100, out, 0, 2);
    assert.deepEqual(out, bytes(MiB, MiB + 100));
    assert.ok(b.want.has('data.bsa#2') && b.near.has('data.bsa#0'));
    // a media file not streamed: its own block only
    b.readPieces('title.mp3', 2 * MiB, 1, 0, 0, 100, out, 0, 2);
    assert.deepEqual(out, bytes(0, 100));
    assert.ok(b.want.has('title.mp3#0'));
    assert.ok(!b.want.has('title.mp3#1') && !b.near.has('title.mp3#1'), 'no next nor near block');
    // being streamed: as any file
    b.streams.add('Video/intro.bik');
    b.readPieces('Video/intro.bik', 3 * MiB, 1, 0, CHUNK, CHUNK + 100, out, 0, 2);
    assert.ok(b.want.has('Video/intro.bik#1') && b.near.has('Video/intro.bik#1'));
  } finally { globalThis.fetch = real; globalThis.XMLHttpRequest = realXhr; }
});

test('the link as last measured: fast from FAST_BPS, not fast below it nor when never measured (a page skips its intro videos)', async () => {
  const { linkRate } = await import('../src/vfs/data-client.js');
  const { FAST_BPS } = await import('../src/vfs/net-link.js');
  const real = globalThis.localStorage, items = new Map();
  globalThis.localStorage = { getItem: (k) => items.get(k) ?? null, setItem: (k, v) => items.set(k, String(v)) };
  try {
    assert.equal(linkRate.fast(), false, 'never measured');
    linkRate.set(FAST_BPS - 1); assert.equal(linkRate.fast(), false);
    linkRate.set(FAST_BPS); assert.equal(linkRate.fast(), true);
  } finally { if (real === undefined) delete globalThis.localStorage; else globalThis.localStorage = real; }
});
```
