`tests/media-mpeg.test.js`:

```js
// MPEG decoders of the DirectShow path (src/media): bitstream tables, inverse DCT, MPEG-1 video and MPEG audio layer II
// against reference decodings (tests/fixtures/media, made with ffmpeg; more configurations when ffmpeg is installed),
// the program stream demultiplexer fed in arbitrary pieces, playback timing, and damaged streams.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { Vlc } from '../src/media/bits.js';
import { Mpeg1VideoDecoder, idct8x8, idct8x8Reference, MB_ADDR_CODES, MB_TYPE_CODES, CBP_CODES, MOTION_CODES, DC_LUMA_CODES, DC_CHROMA_CODES, DCT_CODES } from '../src/media/mpeg1-video.js';
import { MpegAudioDecoder, SYNTH_WINDOW, ALLOC_TABLES } from '../src/media/mpeg-audio.js';
import { MpegPsDemuxer, probeMpeg } from '../src/media/mpeg-ps.js';
import { MpegSource } from '../src/media/mpeg-source.js';
import { yuv420ToRgba } from '../src/media/yuv.js';

const FIX = (n) => fs.readFileSync(new URL(`./fixtures/media/${n}`, import.meta.url));
const MOVIE = FIX('movie.mpg');
const f32 = (b) => new Float32Array(b.buffer.slice(b.byteOffset, b.byteOffset + b.length));
const rng = (seed) => () => { seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0; return seed / 4294967296; };

function demux(bytes) {
  const v = [], a = [];
  new MpegPsDemuxer({ video: (b) => v.push(b), audio: (b) => a.push(b) }).push(bytes);
  return { video: Buffer.concat(v), audio: Buffer.concat(a) };
}
function decodeVideo(es) {
  const d = new Mpeg1VideoDecoder(); d.push(es); d.end();
  const out = [];
  for (let f; (f = d.decode());) out.push({ type: f.type, y: f.y.slice(), cb: f.cb.slice(), cr: f.cr.slice(), stride: f.stride, cstride: f.cstride, width: f.width, height: f.height });
  return { frames: out, errors: d.errors };
}
function psnr(f, ref, w, h) {
  let se = 0, n = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) { const e = f.y[y * f.stride + x] - ref[y * w + x]; se += e * e; n++; }
  for (const [pl, off] of [[f.cb, w * h], [f.cr, w * h * 5 / 4]]) for (let y = 0; y < h / 2; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w / 2; x++) { const e = pl[y * f.cstride + x] - ref[off + y * w / 2 + x]; se += e * e; n++; }
  return se ? 10 * Math.log10(255 * 255 * n / se) : 99;
}
function decodeAudio(es) {
  const d = new MpegAudioDecoder(), ch = [];
  for (let i = 0; i + 4 <= es.length;) { const f = d.decodeFrame(es, i); if (!f) { i++; continue; } ch.push(f); i += d.header.bytes; }
  return ch;
}
function snr(frames, ref, nch) {
  let se = 0, sp = 0, t = 0;
  for (const f of frames) { for (let s = 0; s < f.samples[0].length; s++) for (let c = 0; c < nch; c++) { const y = ref[(t + s) * nch + c]; if (y === undefined) continue; se += (f.samples[c][s] - y) ** 2; sp += y * y; } t += f.samples[0].length; }
  return 10 * Math.log10(sp / se);
}

test('variable-length code tables: prefix-free, every value once, Kraft sums', () => {
  const kraft = (codes) => codes.reduce((s, [c]) => s + 2 ** -c.length, 0);
  for (const codes of [MB_ADDR_CODES, CBP_CODES, MOTION_CODES, DC_LUMA_CODES, DC_CHROMA_CODES, ...Object.values(MB_TYPE_CODES)]) {
    new Vlc(codes); // (throws on overlapping codes)
    assert.equal(new Set(codes.map(([, v]) => v)).size, codes.length);
    assert.ok(kraft(codes) <= 1);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(CBP_CODES.map(([, v]) => v).sort((a, b) => a - b), Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) => i));
  const dct = [['10'], ['000001'], ...DCT_CODES];
  new Vlc(dct.map(([c], i) => [c, i]));
  assert.equal(new Set(DCT_CODES.map(([, r, l]) => `${r}/${l}`)).size, DCT_CODES.length);
  // dct_coeff_next: the only unused codes are those starting with 12 zeros (11172-2 table B.5c)
  assert.ok(Math.abs(kraft(dct) - (1 - 2 ** -12)) < 1e-12, `dct kraft ${kraft(dct)}`);
});

test('inverse DCT: the fast transform rounds as the definition (random sparse and dense blocks)', () => {
  const r = rng(7);
  let off = 0;
  for (let n = 0; n < 3000; n++) {
    const blk = new Int32Array(64), dense = n % 3 === 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) if (dense || r() < 0.08) blk[i] = Math.round((r() * 2 - 1) * (r() < 0.2 ? 2048 : 200));
    const a = blk.slice(), b = blk.slice();
    idct8x8(a); idct8x8Reference(b);
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) { const d = Math.abs(a[i] - b[i]); assert.ok(d <= 1, `block ${n}: ${a[i]} vs ${b[i]}`); off += d; }
  }
  assert.ok(off < 10, `${off} values off by one (a .5 rounded the other way)`);
});

test('MPEG-1 video: the fixture decodes as the reference (I, P, B pictures, display order)', () => {
  const { video } = demux(MOVIE);
  const { frames, errors } = decodeVideo(video);
  assert.equal(errors, 0);
  assert.equal(frames.length, 30);
  assert.deepEqual(frames.slice(0, 7).map((f) => f.type), [1, 3, 3, 2, 3, 3, 2]);
  const ref = FIX('movie-video-ref.yuv'), F = 96 * 64 * 3 / 2;
  [0, 1, 3, 29].forEach((n, i) => { const p = psnr(frames[n], ref.subarray(i * F), 96, 64); assert.ok(p > 50, `picture ${n}: ${p.toFixed(1)} dB`); });
});

test('MPEG audio layer II: the fixture decodes as the reference; the synthesis window', () => {
  const { audio } = demux(MOVIE);
  const frames = decodeAudio(audio);
  assert.equal(frames[0].rate, 32000); assert.equal(frames[0].channels, 1);
  const ref = f32(FIX('movie-audio-ref.f32'));
  const s = snr(frames.slice(0, 4), ref, 1);
  assert.ok(s > 100, `SNR ${s.toFixed(1)} dB`);
  assert.equal(SYNTH_WINDOW[256] * 65536, 75038);
  for (let i = 1; i < 256; i++) assert.equal(SYNTH_WINDOW[512 - i], (i % 64 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * SYNTH_WINDOW[i]);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(ALLOC_TABLES).map(([k, t]) => [k, t.length])), { a: 27, b: 30, c: 8, d: 12, lsf: 30 });
});

test('program stream demultiplexer: the same streams whatever the pieces it is fed in', () => {
  const whole = demux(MOVIE);
  assert.equal(probeMpeg(MOVIE), 'mpeg-ps');
  const r = rng(3);
  for (let k = 0; k < 20; k++) {
    const v = [], a = [], d = new MpegPsDemuxer({ video: (b) => v.push(b), audio: (b) => a.push(b) });
    for (let i = 0; i < MOVIE.length;) { const n = 1 + Math.floor(r() * (k < 10 ? 50 : 5000)); d.push(MOVIE.subarray(i, i + n)); i += n; }
    assert.ok(Buffer.concat(v).equals(whole.video)); assert.ok(Buffer.concat(a).equals(whole.audio));
  }
});

test('MpegSource: pictures and sound on the stream clock, late pictures skipped, seeking back', () => {
  const file = { size: () => MOVIE.length, read: (o, n) => MOVIE.subarray(o, o + n) };
  const s = new MpegSource(file);
  assert.equal(s.kind, 'mpeg-ps'); assert.equal(s.width, 96); assert.equal(s.height, 64); assert.equal(s.fps, 25);
  assert.equal(s.audioRate, 32000); assert.equal(s.audioChannels, 1);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(s.duration - 1.2) < 0.05, `duration ${s.duration}`);
  let shown = 0, samples = 0, t = 0;
  for (; t < 5 && !s.ended(t); t += 0.005) {
    s.load(t);
    const p = s.pictureAt(t);
    if (p) { shown++; assert.ok(s.frameTime(s.frameIndex - 1) <= t); }
    s.audioUntil(t + 0.2, (smp, start) => { assert.ok(Math.abs(start - s.audioStart - samples / 32000) < 1e-9); samples += smp[0].length; });
  }
  assert.equal(shown, 30); assert.equal(s.frameIndex, 30);
  assert.ok(t >= s.videoEnd && Math.abs(t - 1.2) < 0.06, `ended at ${t}`);
  assert.equal(samples, 34 * 1152);
  // a late caller: B pictures due before the one shown are not decoded
  s.reset();
  s.load(10, Infinity);
  assert.ok(s.pictureAt(0.9));
  assert.ok(s.stats.skipped >= 10, `${s.stats.skipped} skipped`); assert.equal(s.frameIndex, 23);
  // RGBA conversion of the picture shown (mid-gray luma, neutral chroma -> gray)
  const p = { y: new Uint8Array([126, 126, 235, 16]), cb: new Uint8Array([128]), cr: new Uint8Array([128]), stride: 2, cstride: 1 };
  assert.deepEqual(Array.from(yuv420ToRgba(p, 0, 0, 2, 2, new Uint8ClampedArray(16))), [128, 128, 128, 255, 128, 128, 128, 255, 255, 255, 255, 255, 0, 0, 0, 255]);
});

test('Y\'CbCr -> RGBA: the word-at-a-time conversion writes what the per-byte one does (random planes and crops)', () => {
  const r = rng(5);
  for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) {
    const W = 2 * (1 + Math.floor(r() * 40)), H = 2 * (1 + Math.floor(r() * 30));
    const p = { y: Uint8Array.from({ length: W * H }, () => r() * 256), cb: Uint8Array.from({ length: W * H / 4 }, () => r() * 256), cr: Uint8Array.from({ length: W * H / 4 }, () => r() * 256), stride: W, cstride: W / 2 };
    const x = 2 * Math.floor(r() * W / 4), y = 2 * Math.floor(r() * H / 4), w = 1 + Math.floor(r() * (W - x)), h = 1 + Math.floor(r() * (H - y));
    const fast = yuv420ToRgba(p, x, y, w, h, new Uint8ClampedArray(w * h * 4));
    const slow = yuv420ToRgba(p, x, y, w, h, new Uint8ClampedArray(new ArrayBuffer(w * h * 4 + 1), 1, w * h * 4)); // (unaligned: per byte)
    assert.deepEqual(Array.from(fast), Array.from(slow));
  }
});

test('damaged streams: decoding goes on (no exception, no endless loop)', () => {
  const r = rng(11);
  for (let k = 0; k < 30; k++) {
    const b = Buffer.from(MOVIE);
    for (let i = 0; i < 5 + k * 3; i++) b[Math.floor(r() * b.length)] = Math.floor(r() * 256);
    const { video, audio } = demux(b);
    const v = decodeVideo(video);
    assert.ok(v.frames.length <= 40);
    decodeAudio(audio);
    const file = { size: () => b.length, read: (o, n) => b.subarray(o, o + n) };
    let s; try { s = new MpegSource(file); } catch { continue; }
    for (let t = 0; t < 3 && !s.ended(t); t += 0.04) { s.load(t); s.pictureAt(t); s.audioUntil(t, () => {}); }
  }
});

// ---- more configurations against ffmpeg's decoders (when installed)
let ffmpeg = false;
try { execFileSync('ffmpeg', ['-version'], { stdio: 'ignore' }); ffmpeg = true; } catch { /* not installed */ }
const ff = (...a) => execFileSync('ffmpeg', ['-nostdin', '-loglevel', 'error', '-y', ...a]);

test('MPEG-1 video against ffmpeg: motion range, quantizer matrices, picture structures', { skip: !ffmpeg && 'ffmpeg not installed' }, () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-mpeg-'));
  try {
    const cases = [
      ['testsrc2=size=176x144:rate=25', ['-bf', '2', '-g', '12', '-q:v', '3']],
      ['mandelbrot=size=320x240:rate=30', ['-bf', '3', '-g', '30', '-b:v', '600k', '-me_range', '64']], // (large vectors: f_code > 1)
      ['testsrc=size=208x112:rate=24', ['-bf', '0', '-g', '9', '-q:v', '12', '-intra_matrix', Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) => 8 + (i * 3) % 50).join(',')]],
      ['life=size=160x128:rate=25:mold=10', ['-bf', '1', '-g', '6', '-qmin', '1', '-qmax', '31', '-b:v', '200k']],
    ];
    for (const [src, opts] of cases) {
      const es = path.join(dir, 'v.m1v'), yuv = path.join(dir, 'v.yuv');
      ff('-f', 'lavfi', '-i', src, '-t', '2', '-c:v', 'mpeg1video', ...opts, '-f', 'mpeg1video', es);
      ff('-idct', 'simple', '-i', es, '-fps_mode', 'passthrough', '-f', 'rawvideo', '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p', yuv);
      const [w, h] = src.match(/size=(\d+)x(\d+)/).slice(1).map(Number);
      const { frames, errors } = decodeVideo(fs.readFileSync(es));
      const ref = fs.readFileSync(yuv), F = w * h * 3 / 2;
      assert.equal(errors, 0, src);
      assert.equal(frames.length, ref.length / F, src);
      const worst = Math.min(...frames.map((f, i) => psnr(f, ref.subarray(i * F), w, h)));
      assert.ok(worst > 45, `${src}: worst picture ${worst.toFixed(1)} dB`);
    }
  } finally { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test('MPEG audio layer II against ffmpeg: allocation tables, joint stereo, low sampling frequencies', { skip: !ffmpeg && 'ffmpeg not installed' }, () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-mpa-'));
  try {
    const cases = [[48000, 2, '384k', 'mp2'], [44100, 2, '128k', 'mp2'], [32000, 1, '48k', 'mp2'], [48000, 2, '64k', 'mp2'], [22050, 2, '64k', 'mp2'], [24000, 1, '96k', 'mp2'],
      [48000, 2, '64k', 'libtwolame']];
    for (const [rate, ch, br, enc] of cases) {
      const es = path.join(dir, 'a.mp2'), pcm = path.join(dir, 'a.f32');
      try { ff('-f', 'lavfi', '-i', `anoisesrc=d=1.5:c=pink:r=${rate}:a=0.3`, '-ac', String(ch), '-c:a', enc, ...(enc === 'libtwolame' ? ['-mode', 'joint_stereo', '-psymodel', '0'] : []), '-b:a', br, '-ar', String(rate), es); } catch { if (enc === 'libtwolame') continue; throw new Error(`ffmpeg ${enc}`); }
      ff('-c:a', 'mp2float', '-i', es, '-f', 'f32le', pcm);
      const frames = decodeAudio(fs.readFileSync(es));
      const s = snr(frames, f32(fs.readFileSync(pcm)), ch);
      assert.ok(s > 100, `${rate} Hz ${ch} ch ${br} ${enc}: SNR ${s.toFixed(1)} dB`);
    }
  } finally { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});
```

`tests/mmo-link.test.js`:

```js
// The page's end of a shared world (src/host/web/mmo-link.js, docs/mmo.md section 6): its records, the engine's queue
// (drain), overflow, reconnection with LINK_RESET, refusal, away, backpressure — over a fake WebSocket and a fake clock.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createMmoLink, LINK, RECORD, LIMITS, BACKOFF_MS, clientRecord, pingRecord, awayRecord, linkResetRecord, serverRecords, parseRefused, splitRecords } from '../src/host/web/mmo-link.js';

/** a fake clock: timers fire when the test advances the time */
function clock() {
  let now = 0; const list = [];
  const add = (fn, ms, every) => { const t = { at: now + ms, fn, every }; list.push(t); return t; };
  const remove = (t) => { const i = list.indexOf(t); if (i >= 0) list.splice(i, 1); };
  return {
    now: () => now,
    pending: () => list.length,
    timers: { setTimeout: (fn, ms) => add(fn, ms, 0), clearTimeout: remove, setInterval: (fn, ms) => add(fn, ms, ms), clearInterval: remove },
    advance(ms) {
      const end = now + ms;
      for (;;) {
        list.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at); const t = list[0];
        if (!t || t.at > end) break;
        now = t.at; if (t.every) t.at += t.every; else list.shift();
        t.fn();
      }
      now = end;
    },
  };
}
/** a fake WebSocket: the test opens, feeds, fails it */
function fakeSockets() {
  const all = [];
  class FakeSocket {
    constructor(url) { this.url = url; this.readyState = 0; this.sent = []; this.bufferedAmount = 0; this.closedWith = null; all.push(this); }
    send(data) {
      if (this.readyState !== 1) throw new Error('InvalidStateError');
      this.sent.push(Uint8Array.from(data));
    }
    close(code = 1000) { if (this.readyState >= 2) return; this.readyState = 3; this.closedWith = code; this.onclose?.({ code, reason: '' }); }
    accept() { this.readyState = 1; this.onopen?.({}); }
    receive(...records) { const bytes = concat(records); this.onmessage?.({ data: bytes.buffer.slice(bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteOffset + bytes.length) }); }
    fail(code = 1006) { this.readyState = 3; this.onclose?.({ code, reason: '' }); }
    /** every record sent, in order: { type, body } */
    records() { const out = []; for (const m of this.sent) for (let o = 0; o + 3 <= m.length;) { const len = m[o] | (m[o + 1] << 8); out.push({ type: m[o + 2], body: m.subarray(o + 3, o + 2 + len) }); o += 2 + len; } return out; }
  }
  return { all, FakeSocket, last: () => all.at(-1) };
}
const concat = (parts) => { const out = new Uint8Array(parts.reduce((n, p) => n + p.length, 0)); let o = 0; for (const p of parts) { out.set(p, o); o += p.length; } return out; };
/** a server record: u16 len | type | from | body */
const serverRecord = (type, from, body = []) => { const out = new Uint8Array(4 + body.length); out[0] = (body.length + 2) & 255; out[1] = (body.length + 2) >> 8; out[2] = type; out[3] = from; out.set(body, 4); return out; };
const refusedRecord = (reason, detail = '') => serverRecord(RECORD.REFUSED, 255, [reason, detail.length, ...Buffer.from(detail, 'latin1')]);
function setup() {
  const c = clock(), s = fakeSockets(), states = [], logs = [];
  const link = createMmoLink({ url: 'ws://host/api/mmo/v/ws', WebSocketImpl: s.FakeSocket, now: c.now, timers: c.timers, log: (l) => logs.push(l), onState: (st, l) => states.push([st, l.joined()]) });
  return { c, s, link, states, logs };
}
/** the engine's drain into a fresh heap: the messages it got */
function drainAll(link, cap = 1 << 20, ptr = 16) {
  const heap = new Uint8Array(ptr + cap), n = link.drain(heap, ptr, cap);
  if (n <= 0) return n;
  const out = [];
  for (let o = ptr; o < ptr + n;) { const len = heap[o] | (heap[o + 1] << 8) | (heap[o + 2] << 16) | (heap[o + 3] << 24); out.push(heap.slice(o + 4, o + 4 + len)); o += 4 + len; }
  return out;
}
const HELLO = clientRecord(0x01, [1, 0, 0]);

test('mmo link: its records are framed as the protocol says', () => {
  assert.deepEqual([...clientRecord(0x0D, [0x34, 0x12])], [3, 0, 0x0D, 0x34, 0x12]);
  const ping = pingRecord(1234.5);
  assert.deepEqual([...ping.subarray(0, 3)], [9, 0, RECORD.PING]);
  assert.equal(new DataView(ping.buffer).getFloat64(3, true), 1234.5);
  assert.deepEqual([...awayRecord(true)], [3, 0, RECORD.AWAY, 1, 1]);
  assert.deepEqual([...awayRecord(false)], [3, 0, RECORD.AWAY, 1, 0]);
  assert.deepEqual([...linkResetRecord()], [2, 0, 0xFE, 255]);
  const two = concat([serverRecord(0x87, 255, [1, 2, 3]), refusedRecord(2, 'no world'), Uint8Array.of(9, 0, 0x20)]);
  const recs = serverRecords(two);
  assert.equal(recs.length, 2, 'the truncated third record ends the walk');
  assert.deepEqual([recs[0].type, recs[0].from, [...recs[0].body]], [0x87, 255, [1, 2, 3]]);
  assert.deepEqual(parseRefused(recs[1].body), { reason: 2, detail: 'no world' });
  assert.deepEqual(parseRefused(Uint8Array.of(1)), { reason: 1, detail: '' });
});

test('mmo link: bytes over 64 KB are sent in several messages, cut between records', () => {
  const rec = (n, v) => { const r = clientRecord(0x23, new Uint8Array(n - 3).fill(v)); return r; };
  const small = concat([rec(100, 1), rec(200, 2)]);
  const parts = splitRecords(small, 250);
  assert.deepEqual(parts.map((p) => p.length), [100, 200], 'cut at the record boundary');
  const many = concat(Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => rec(4000, i)));
  const cut = splitRecords(many);
  assert.ok(cut.length === 3 && cut.every((p) => p.length <= LIMITS.message && p.length % 4000 === 0));
  assert.deepEqual(concat(cut), many);
  const huge = concat([rec(10, 1), rec(65000, 2), rec(10, 3)]);
  assert.deepEqual(splitRecords(huge, 1000).map((p) => p.length), [10, 65000, 10], 'a record bigger than the limit goes alone');
  assert.deepEqual(splitRecords(small, 1 << 20), [small]);
});

test('mmo link: reliable data waits for the first connection, unreliable data is dropped meanwhile', () => {
  const { s, link, states } = setup();
  assert.equal(link.state(), LINK.CLOSED);
  assert.equal(link.send(HELLO), false, 'closed: nothing sent');
  assert.equal(link.open(), LINK.CONNECTING);
  assert.equal(link.open(), LINK.CONNECTING, 'idempotent'); assert.equal(s.all.length, 1);
  assert.equal(s.last().url, 'ws://host/api/mmo/v/ws'); assert.equal(s.last().binaryType, 'arraybuffer');
  assert.equal(link.send(HELLO), true);
  assert.equal(link.send(clientRecord(0x20, [1, 2, 3]), true), false, 'unreliable while connecting');
  assert.equal(link.send(new Uint8Array(LIMITS.connectingQueue)), false, 'over the 1 MB kept while connecting');
  s.last().accept();
  assert.equal(link.state(), LINK.OPEN);
  assert.deepEqual(s.last().records().map((r) => r.type), [0x01]);
  assert.equal(link.send(clientRecord(0x0A, [2, 104, 105])), true);
  assert.equal(link.send(clientRecord(0x20, [0]), true), true);
  assert.deepEqual(s.last().records().map((r) => r.type), [0x01, 0x0A, 0x20]);
  assert.deepEqual(states.map(([st]) => st), [LINK.CONNECTING, LINK.OPEN]);
});

test('mmo link: unreliable data is dropped while the socket is backed up, reliable data still goes', () => {
  const { s, link } = setup();
  link.open(); s.last().accept(); link.send(HELLO);
  s.last().bufferedAmount = LIMITS.unreliableBuffered + 1;
  assert.equal(link.send(clientRecord(0x20, [1]), true), false);
  assert.equal(link.send(clientRecord(0x0A, [1, 65])), true);
  s.last().bufferedAmount = 0;
  assert.equal(link.send(clientRecord(0x20, [1]), true), true);
  assert.deepEqual(s.last().records().map((r) => r.type), [0x01, 0x0A, 0x20]);
  assert.equal(link.stats().dropped, 1);
});

test('mmo link: the engine drains whole messages as u32 length + bytes, at its pointer, within its room', () => {
  const { s, link } = setup();
  link.open(); s.last().accept();
  assert.equal(link.drain(new Uint8Array(64), 0, 64), 0, 'nothing yet');
  const a = serverRecord(0x81, 255, [1, 8]), b = serverRecord(0x8A, 3, [0, 1, 65, 2, 104, 105]);
  s.last().receive(a); s.last().receive(b);
  const heap = new Uint8Array(100).fill(0xEE), n = link.drain(heap, 10, 90);
  assert.equal(n, 4 + a.length + 4 + b.length);
  assert.equal(heap[9], 0xEE, 'nothing before the pointer');
  assert.deepEqual([...heap.subarray(10, 14)], [a.length, 0, 0, 0]);
  assert.deepEqual([...heap.subarray(14, 14 + a.length)], [...a]);
  assert.deepEqual([...heap.subarray(14 + a.length, 18 + a.length)], [b.length, 0, 0, 0]);
  assert.equal(heap[10 + n], 0xEE, 'nothing after');
  assert.equal(link.drain(heap, 10, 90), 0, 'taken');
  // (a room for the first message only: the second waits for the next drain)
  s.last().receive(a); s.last().receive(b);
  assert.equal(link.drain(heap, 0, 4 + a.length + 4 + b.length - 1), 4 + a.length);
  assert.deepEqual(drainAll(link).map((m) => [...m]), [[...b]]);
  // (a message bigger than the engine's room is dropped, the next ones still come)
  s.last().receive(serverRecord(0x8E, 255, new Array(200).fill(7))); s.last().receive(a);
  assert.deepEqual(drainAll(link, 64).map((m) => [...m]), [[...a]]);
  assert.equal(link.stats().droppedMessages, 1);
  // (a coalesced message stays whole: the engine walks its records)
  s.last().receive(a, b);
  assert.deepEqual(drainAll(link).map((m) => m.length), [a.length + b.length]);
  // (a large length is written little-endian on four bytes)
  const big = serverRecord(0x8E, 255, new Array(70000 - 4).fill(1));
  s.last().receive(big);
  const h = new Uint8Array(80000); assert.equal(link.drain(h, 0, 80000), 70004);
  assert.deepEqual([...h.subarray(0, 4)], [70000 & 255, (70000 >> 8) & 255, 70000 >> 16, 0]);
});

test('mmo link: over 8 MB waiting, everything waiting is dropped and the engine told once (-1)', () => {
  const { s, link, logs } = setup();
  link.open(); s.last().accept();
  const chunk = serverRecord(0x21, 2, new Array(60000).fill(1));
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.ceil(LIMITS.inbound / chunk.length) + 1; i++) s.last().receive(chunk);
  assert.equal(link.stats().overflows, 1);
  assert.ok(logs.some((l) => /resynchronises/.test(l)));
  assert.equal(link.drain(new Uint8Array(16), 0, 16), -1);
  assert.equal(drainAll(link).length, 1, 'only what came after the overflow');
  s.last().receive(serverRecord(0x87, 255, [1]));
  assert.equal(drainAll(link).length >= 1, true);
  assert.equal(link.drain(new Uint8Array(16), 0, 16), 0, 'told once');
});

test('mmo link: an unexpected close reconnects with backoff, then LINK_RESET reaches the engine before anything new', () => {
  const { c, s, link, states } = setup();
  link.open(); s.last().accept(); link.send(HELLO);
  s.last().receive(serverRecord(RECORD.WELCOME, 255, [0]));
  assert.equal(link.joined(), true);
  s.last().fail();
  assert.equal(link.state(), LINK.WAITING); assert.equal(link.joined(), false);
  assert.equal(link.send(clientRecord(0x0A, [1, 65])), false, 'nothing kept for a session that ended');
  c.advance(BACKOFF_MS[0] - 1); assert.equal(s.all.length, 1);
  c.advance(1); assert.equal(s.all.length, 2, 'again after 1 s');
  assert.equal(link.state(), LINK.WAITING, 'reconnecting is still waiting');
  // (failures in a row: 2, 4, 8, then every 15 s)
  for (const [i, ms] of [[3, 2000], [4, 4000], [5, 8000], [6, 15000], [7, 15000]]) {
    s.last().fail(); c.advance(ms - 1); assert.equal(s.all.length, i - 1); c.advance(1); assert.equal(s.all.length, i, `after ${ms} ms`);
  }
  s.last().accept();
  assert.equal(link.state(), LINK.OPEN);
  assert.equal(link.send(clientRecord(0x20, [1]), true), false, 'held until the engine took LINK_RESET');
  assert.equal(link.send(HELLO), false);
  s.last().receive(serverRecord(0x87, 255, [2]));
  c.advance(LIMITS.heartbeatMs); assert.equal(s.last().sent.length, 0, 'no PING before the engine speaks');
  const got = drainAll(link);
  assert.deepEqual(got.map((m) => [...m]), [[...serverRecord(RECORD.WELCOME, 255, [0])], [2, 0, 0xFE, 255], [...serverRecord(0x87, 255, [2])]],
    'the old connection\'s messages not taken yet, LINK_RESET, then the new connection\'s');
  assert.equal(link.send(HELLO), true, 'then the engine speaks');
  assert.deepEqual(s.last().records().map((r) => r.type), [0x01]);
  assert.deepEqual(states, [[LINK.CONNECTING, false], [LINK.OPEN, false], [LINK.OPEN, true], [LINK.WAITING, true], [LINK.WAITING, false], [LINK.OPEN, false]],
    'joined; the connection lost while in the world (told before the world goes); one wait however many attempts; open again');
  // (a connection that lasted starts the backoff over)
  c.advance(LIMITS.stableMs); s.last().fail();
  c.advance(BACKOFF_MS[0]); assert.equal(s.all.length, 8);
});

test('mmo link: the first connection failing reconnects too; its queued HELLO is dropped and LINK_RESET asks again', () => {
  const { c, s, link } = setup();
  link.open(); link.send(HELLO);
  s.last().fail();
  assert.equal(link.state(), LINK.WAITING);
  c.advance(BACKOFF_MS[0]); s.last().accept();
  assert.equal(s.last().sent.length, 0, 'the first connection\'s queue went with it');
  assert.deepEqual(drainAll(link).map((m) => m[2]), [RECORD.LINK_RESET]);
});

test('mmo link: REFUSED stops the reconnection until open() again; the engine still gets the record', () => {
  const { c, s, link } = setup();
  link.open(); s.last().accept(); link.send(HELLO);
  s.last().receive(refusedRecord(1, 'sign-in'));
  assert.equal(link.state(), LINK.REFUSED);
  assert.equal(link.refusal(), 1); assert.equal(link.refusalDetail(), 'sign-in');

  assert.deepEqual([got[0][2], got[0][4]], [RECORD.REFUSED, 1]);
  assert.equal(link.send(HELLO), false);
  assert.equal(link.open(), LINK.CONNECTING, 'a new start');
  assert.equal(link.refusal(), 0);
  s.last().accept();
  assert.equal(drainAll(link), 0, 'no LINK_RESET: a first connection');
  // (a refusal after a server restart: the reconnection stops there)
  link.send(HELLO); s.last().fail(); c.advance(BACKOFF_MS[0]); s.last().accept();
  s.last().receive(refusedRecord(5, ''));
  assert.equal(link.state(), LINK.REFUSED); assert.equal(link.refusal(), 5);
  c.advance(60000); assert.equal(s.all.length, 3);
});

test('mmo link: PING every 15 s once the engine spoke, with the page clock; from traffic too when timers lag', () => {
  const { c, s, link } = setup();
  link.open(); s.last().accept();

test('mmo link: away is sent at once, again with each beat while away, and never before the engine spoke', () => {
  const { c, s, link } = setup();
  link.open(); s.last().accept();
  link.away(true);
  assert.equal(s.last().sent.length, 0);
  link.send(HELLO);
  c.advance(LIMITS.heartbeatMs);
  const beat = s.last().records();
  assert.deepEqual(beat.map((r) => r.type), [0x01, RECORD.PING, RECORD.AWAY], 'the beat: PING then AWAY again');
  assert.deepEqual([...beat[2].body], [1, 1], 'source 1 (the page), away');
  assert.equal(s.last().sent.length, 2, 'PING and AWAY in one message');

  link.away(false);
  assert.deepEqual([...s.last().sent.at(-1)], [3, 0, RECORD.AWAY, 1, 0]);
  c.advance(LIMITS.heartbeatMs);
  assert.equal(s.last().records().at(-1).type, RECORD.PING, 'not away: PING alone');
  link.away(true);
  assert.deepEqual([...s.last().sent.at(-1)], [3, 0, RECORD.AWAY, 1, 1]);
  assert.equal(link.stats().away, true);
});

test('mmo link: close() forgets everything and stays closed; drop() reconnects as after a network failure', () => {

test('mmo link: renew() — the account changed: a link in use connects again (LINK_RESET, the engine says HELLO as the new account), a refused one opens again, a closed one stays closed', () => {
  const { c, s, link, states } = setup();
  assert.equal(link.renew(), LINK.CLOSED); assert.equal(s.all.length, 0, 'closed: the engine has not asked for it');
  // (refused — the engine waits on a sign-in —, then signed in: open again, a first connection)

  assert.deepEqual(drainAll(link).map((m) => [...m]), [[...linkResetRecord()]]);

  link.renew(); assert.equal(link.state(), LINK.WAITING);
  c.advance(BACKOFF_MS[1]); assert.equal(s.all.length, 4);
  link.close();
});

test('mmo link: over a real WebSocket to the server\'s own socket code (lan.js acceptWebSocket)', async (t) => {
  const http = await import('node:http');
  const { acceptWebSocket } = await import('../src/host/lan.js');
  const peers = [], got = [];
  const server = http.createServer();
  server.on('upgrade', (req, socket) => {
    const peer = acceptWebSocket(req, socket, (msg) => {
      got.push([...msg]);
      if (msg[2] === 0x01) peer.send(Buffer.from(concat([serverRecord(0x81, 255, [0, 8]), serverRecord(RECORD.WELCOME, 255, [1])])));
    }, () => {}, () => {});
    peers.push(peer);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  t.after(() => { for (const p of peers) p.close(); server.close(); });
  const link = createMmoLink({ url: `ws://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/api/mmo/x/ws` });
  t.after(() => link.close());
  const waitFor = async (what, ms = 5000) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; while (!what()) { if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10)); } };
  const take = () => drainAll(link) || [];
  link.open(); link.send(HELLO);
  await waitFor(() => link.joined());
  assert.deepEqual(got[0], [...HELLO], 'the HELLO queued while connecting went first');
  assert.deepEqual(take().map((m) => m.length), [11], 'one message, its two records');
  // (a large send cut between records: the server takes each part)
  const big = concat(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => clientRecord(0x23, new Uint8Array(4000).fill(i))));
  assert.equal(link.send(big), true);
  await waitFor(() => got.length >= 3);
  assert.equal(got.slice(1).reduce((n, m) => n + m.length, 0), big.length); assert.ok(got.slice(1).every((m) => m.length <= LIMITS.message));
  // (the server's side gone: the page reconnects after 1 s, LINK_RESET reaches the engine, the engine says HELLO again)
  peers[0].socket.destroy();
  await waitFor(() => link.state() === LINK.WAITING);
  await waitFor(() => link.state() === LINK.OPEN, 4000);
  assert.deepEqual(take().map((m) => m[2]), [RECORD.LINK_RESET]);
  link.send(HELLO);
  await waitFor(() => link.joined());
  // (a refusal: the socket closes, no reconnection)
  peers[1].send(Buffer.from(refusedRecord(5, 'joined elsewhere')));
  await waitFor(() => link.state() === LINK.REFUSED);
  assert.equal(link.refusalDetail(), 'joined elsewhere');
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1300));
  assert.equal(peers.length, 2, 'no new connection after the refusal');
  link.close();
});
```

`tests/mmo.test.js`:

```js
// Shared worlds ("MMO", src/host/mmo.js, protocol src/host/mmo-proto.js): the manifest's `mmo` entry, the status route,
// refusals, the lobby (characters), joining, the relay and its ownership rules, departures, records and locks, chat,
// world changes by admins, the world clock frozen while nobody is there, persistence across a restart, and the limits.
// Players are real Orthros accounts of a server with accounts; their WebSockets are Node's own (Cookie and Origin set).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import http from 'node:http';
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { createServer } from '../src/host/server.js';
import { loadGameCatalog } from '../src/host/game-catalog.js';
import { mmoProblem, mmoSettings } from '../src/host/mmo.js';
import { MMO_C as C, MMO_S as S, MMO_REFUSED as R, MMO_RESULT as CR, MMO_DENIED as D, MMO_NOBODY as NOBODY, mmoClientRecord, mmoServerRecords, mmoPlayerId } from '../src/host/mmo-proto.js';

const SCRATCH = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-scratch', 'mmo-test');
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

/** A games folder: one game, a version with a shared world (`mmo`) and one without; no engine needed. */
function fixture(t, mmo = { maxCharacters: 2, maxPlayers: 3 }) {
  fs.mkdirSync(SCRATCH, { recursive: true });
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(SCRATCH, 'run-')), closers = [];
  // (the servers closed first — closing saves the worlds — then the folder removed)
  t.after(async () => {
    for (const close of closers) await close();
    fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
    try { fs.rmdirSync(SCRATCH); } catch { /* another run's still there */ }
  });
  const games = path.join(root, 'games'), game = path.join(games, 'city');
  for (const d of ['base', 'versions/online', 'versions/solo']) fs.mkdirSync(path.join(game, d), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(game, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, id: 'city', name: 'City', defaultVersion: 'city-online', defaults: { runtime: 're3' },
    versions: [{ id: 'city-online', dir: 'online', version: '1', re3: { engine: 'eng-1' }, mmo }, { id: 'city-solo', dir: 'solo', version: '1', re3: { engine: 'eng-1' } }] }));
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, 'engines'));
  return { root, games, game, engines: path.join(root, 'engines'), accounts: path.join(root, 'accounts'), mmoDir: path.join(root, 'accounts', 'mmo'), closers };
}
/** The server's clock: still unless the test moves it (rates, the world's minutes and silences exactly as the test says). */
const clock = () => { let t = Date.now(); const now = () => t; now.skip = (ms) => { t += ms; }; return now; };

async function serve(t, f, opts = {}) {
  const now = opts.mmoNow ?? clock();
  const server = createServer({ gamesDir: f.games, enginesDir: f.engines, accountsDir: f.accounts, lanLog: () => {}, mmoLog: () => {}, mmoNow: now, ...opts });
  await new Promise((r) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
  let closing = null;
  const close = () => (closing ??= new Promise((r) => { server.closeAllConnections?.(); server.close(r); }));
  f.closers.push(close);
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
  let ip = 0;
  /** A new account (its own forwarded address: registrations are limited per address), its session cookie. */
  const account = async (username) => {
    ip++;
    const r = await fetch(base + '/api/account/register', { method: 'POST', headers: { Origin: base, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Forwarded-For': `10.77.${ip >> 8}.${ip & 255}` }, body: JSON.stringify({ username, password: 'orthros-test-password' }) });
    assert.equal(r.status, 200, `register ${username}`);
    return r.headers.get('set-cookie').split(';')[0];
  };
  return { server, base, now, close, account };
}

/** Record bodies, little-endian. */
const w = () => {
  const parts = [], o = {
    u8: (v) => { parts.push(Buffer.from([v & 255])); return o; },
    u16: (v) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(2); b.writeUInt16LE(v); parts.push(b); return o; },
    u32: (v) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(4); b.writeUInt32LE(v >>> 0); parts.push(b); return o; },
    i32: (v) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(4); b.writeInt32LE(v); parts.push(b); return o; },
    f32: (v) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(4); b.writeFloatLE(v); parts.push(b); return o; },
    f64: (v) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(8); b.writeDoubleLE(v); parts.push(b); return o; },
    str8: (s) => { const b = Buffer.from(s, 'latin1'); parts.push(Buffer.from([b.length]), b); return o; },
    bytes: (b) => { parts.push(Buffer.from(b)); return o; },
    done: () => Buffer.concat(parts),
  };
  return o;
};
const rd = (b) => {
  let o = 0;
  const take = (n) => { assert.ok(o + n <= b.length, 'record too short'); const v = b.subarray(o, o + n); o += n; return v; };
  const r = { take, u8: () => take(1)[0], u16: () => take(2).readUInt16LE(0), u32: () => take(4).readUInt32LE(0), i32: () => take(4).readInt32LE(0),
    f32: () => take(4).readFloatLE(0), f64: () => take(8).readDoubleLE(0), str8: () => take(r.u8()).toString('latin1'), left: () => b.length - o };
  return r;
};
const lobbyOf = (body) => {
  const r = rd(body), out = { admin: r.u8(), maxCharacters: r.u8(), username: r.str8(), characters: [] };
  for (let n = r.u8(); n > 0; n--) out.characters.push({ id: r.u32(), name: r.str8(), skin: r.str8(), money: r.i32(), online: r.u8() });
  return out;
};
const infoOf = (r) => ({ slot: r.u8(), rank: r.u32(), admin: r.u8(), away: r.u8(), name: r.str8(), skin: r.str8() });
const worldOf = (r) => {
  const out = { baseMs: r.f64(), baseMinutes: r.f64(), msPerMinute: r.f32(), vars: {} };
  for (let n = r.u8(); n > 0; n--) { const id = r.u8(); out.vars[id] = r.i32(); }
  return out;
};
const welcomeOf = (body) => {
  const r = rd(body), out = { slot: r.u8(), tag: r.u16(), serverMs: r.f64(), admin: r.u8(), charId: r.u32(), name: r.str8(), skin: r.str8() };
  out.state = Buffer.from(r.take(r.u16())); out.world = worldOf(r); out.players = [];
  for (let n = r.u8(); n > 0; n--) out.players.push(infoOf(r));
  assert.equal(r.left(), 0);
  return out;
};
const resultOf = (body) => ({ op: body[0], status: body[1], id: body.readUInt32LE(2) });
const ownerOf = (body) => ({ netid: body.readUInt32LE(0), owner: body[4], previous: body[5] });
const recordOf = (body) => { const r = rd(body); return { key: r.u16(), holder: r.u8(), data: Buffer.from(r.take(r.u16())) }; };
const chatOf = (body) => { const r = rd(body); return { kind: r.u8(), name: r.str8(), text: r.str8() }; };
const pstate = (x, y, z) => w().f32(x).f32(y).f32(z).bytes([1, 2, 3]).done();
const estate = (netid, flags, x, y, z) => w().u32(netid).u8(2).u8(flags).f32(x).f32(y).f32(z).bytes([7, 7]).done();

/** A WebSocket of the shared world: its server records kept in order of arrival, taken by type. */
class Peer {
  constructor(ws) {
    this.ws = ws; this.inbox = []; this.messages = []; this.closed = false; this.wake = null;
    ws.binaryType = 'arraybuffer';
    ws.addEventListener('message', (e) => {
      const recs = mmoServerRecords(new Uint8Array(e.data)).map((r) => ({ type: r.type, from: r.from, body: Buffer.from(r.body) }));
      this.messages.push(recs.map((r) => r.type));
      this.inbox.push(...recs); this.wake?.();
    });
    this.done = new Promise((resolve) => ws.addEventListener('close', () => { this.closed = true; this.wake?.(); resolve(); }));
  }
  static open(ctx, cookie, version = 'city-online', origin = ctx.base) {
    const ws = new WebSocket(`${ctx.base.replace('http', 'ws')}/api/mmo/${version}/ws`, { headers: { ...(cookie ? { Cookie: cookie } : {}), Origin: origin } });
    const p = new Peer(ws);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ws.addEventListener('open', () => resolve(p)); ws.addEventListener('error', () => reject(new Error('websocket error'))); });
  }
  /** Records sent in one message: [type, body]... */
  send(...records) { this.ws.send(Buffer.concat(records.map(([type, body]) => mmoClientRecord(type, body ?? Buffer.alloc(0))))); }
  async next(type, ms = 3000) {
    const deadline = Date.now() + ms;
    for (;;) {
      const i = this.inbox.findIndex((r) => r.type === type);
      if (i >= 0) return this.inbox.splice(i, 1)[0];
      const left = deadline - Date.now();
      if (this.closed || left <= 0) throw new Error(`no record 0x${type.toString(16)} (${this.closed ? 'closed' : 'timeout'}; inbox: ${this.inbox.map((r) => r.type.toString(16))})`);
      await new Promise((r) => { const tm = setTimeout(r, left); this.wake = () => { clearTimeout(tm); r(); }; });
      this.wake = null;
    }
  }
  /** None of `type` within `ms` (default: every record type). */
  async quiet(type = null, ms = 150) {
    await sleep(ms);
    const got = this.inbox.filter((r) => type === null || r.type === type);
    assert.equal(got.length, 0, `unexpected records: ${got.map((r) => r.type.toString(16))}`);
  }
  clear() { this.inbox = []; this.messages = []; }
  close() { this.ws.close(); return this.done; }
}

async function hello(p) { p.send([C.HELLO, w().u16(1).u8(0).done()]); return lobbyOf((await p.next(S.LOBBY)).body); }
/** A lobby request answered by CHAR_RESULT then LOBBY (the clock moved on a little: lobby requests are limited to 5/s). */
async function lobbyRequest(ctx, p, type, body) {
  ctx.now.skip(250);
  p.send([type, body]);
  const result = resultOf((await p.next(S.CHAR_RESULT)).body);
  return { ...result, lobby: lobbyOf((await p.next(S.LOBBY)).body) };
}
const create = (ctx, p, name, skin = 'player') => lobbyRequest(ctx, p, C.CHAR_CREATE, w().str8(name).str8(skin).done());
async function join(ctx, p, id) { ctx.now.skip(250); p.send([C.JOIN, w().u32(id).done()]); return welcomeOf((await p.next(S.WELCOME)).body); }
/** A signed-in player in the world: its socket, its WELCOME. */
async function player(ctx, cookie, name, skin = 'player') {
  const p = await Peer.open(ctx, cookie);
  const lobby = await hello(p);
  const known = lobby.characters.find((c) => c.name === name);
  const id = known ? known.id : (await create(ctx, p, name, skin)).id;
  const welcome = await join(ctx, p, id);
  return { p, welcome, id };
}
/** An upgrade request answered by HTTP (a refused handshake): its status. */
function rawUpgrade(base, route, headers) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = http.get(base + route, { headers: { Connection: 'Upgrade', Upgrade: 'websocket', 'Sec-WebSocket-Version': '13', 'Sec-WebSocket-Key': randomBytes(16).toString('base64'), ...headers } });
    req.on('error', reject);
    req.on('response', (res) => { res.resume(); resolve(res.statusCode); });
    req.on('upgrade', (_res, socket) => { socket.destroy(); resolve(101); });
  });
}

test('a version\'s `mmo` entry: checked by the catalog (any runtime) and the schema alike, its defaults', (t) => {
  for (const ok of [undefined, {}, { maxCharacters: 1 }, { maxCharacters: 16, maxPlayers: 2 }, { maxPlayers: 32 }, { records: [[256, 267]] }, { records: [[0, 0], [5, 65535]] }])
    assert.equal(mmoProblem(ok), null, JSON.stringify(ok));
  for (const bad of [null, [], 'yes', true, { maxCharacters: 0 }, { maxCharacters: 17 }, { maxCharacters: 2.5 }, { maxCharacters: '8' }, { maxPlayers: 1 }, { maxPlayers: 33 }, { maxPlayers: 16, world: 'x' },
    { records: [] }, { records: [[2, 1]] }, { records: [[0, 65536]] }, { records: [[1]] }, { records: [256, 267] }, { records: [[1.5, 2]] }, { records: Array(65).fill([0, 1]) }])
    assert.match(mmoProblem(bad), /^mmo :/, JSON.stringify(bad));
  assert.deepEqual(mmoSettings({}), { maxCharacters: 8, maxPlayers: 16 });
  assert.deepEqual(mmoSettings({ maxPlayers: 4 }), { maxCharacters: 8, maxPlayers: 4 });
  assert.deepEqual(mmoSettings({ records: [[256, 267]] }), { maxCharacters: 8, maxPlayers: 16, records: [[256, 267]] });
  const f = fixture(t);
  const catalog = loadGameCatalog(f.games, null, { enginesDir: f.engines });
  assert.deepEqual(catalog.get('city-online').mmo, { maxCharacters: 2, maxPlayers: 3 });
  assert.equal(catalog.get('city-solo').mmo, undefined);
  const edit = (fn) => { const file = path.join(f.game, 'manifest.json'), spec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')); fn(spec); fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(spec)); };
  edit((spec) => { spec.versions[0].mmo = { maxPlayers: 64 }; });
  assert.throws(() => loadGameCatalog(f.games, null, { enginesDir: f.engines }), /city-online: mmo :/);
  // (in defaults too, and on a Windows game: nothing ties a shared world to a runtime)
  edit((spec) => { delete spec.versions[0].mmo; spec.defaults.mmo = { maxPlayers: 4 }; });
  assert.equal(loadGameCatalog(f.games, null, { enginesDir: f.engines }).get('city-solo').mmo.maxPlayers, 4);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(f.game, 'base', 'game.exe'), 'MZ');
  edit((spec) => { delete spec.defaults.mmo; spec.versions[0] = { id: 'city-online', dir: 'online', version: '1', runtime: 'win32', exe: 'game.exe', mmo: { maxCharacters: 3 } }; });
  assert.equal(loadGameCatalog(f.games, null, { enginesDir: f.engines }).get('city-online').mmo.maxCharacters, 3);
  // (the schema says the same)
  const schema = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(new URL('../docs/game-manifest.schema.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8')).properties.versions.items.properties.mmo;
  assert.equal(schema.additionalProperties, false);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(schema.properties).sort(), ['maxCharacters', 'maxPlayers', 'records']);
  assert.deepEqual([schema.properties.records.minItems, schema.properties.records.maxItems, schema.properties.records.items.items.minimum, schema.properties.records.items.items.maximum], [1, 64, 0, 65535]);
  for (const [key, [lo, hi, def]] of Object.entries({ maxCharacters: [1, 16, 8], maxPlayers: [2, 32, 16] })) {
    const s = schema.properties[key];
    assert.deepEqual([s.type, s.minimum, s.maximum, s.default], ['integer', lo, hi, def]);
    assert.equal(mmoProblem({ [key]: lo - 1 }) === null, false); assert.equal(mmoProblem({ [key]: lo }), null);
    assert.equal(mmoProblem({ [key]: hi }), null); assert.equal(mmoProblem({ [key]: hi + 1 }) === null, false);
  }
});

test('the status route, the home\'s flags and the socket\'s refusals: other sites, nobody signed in, no shared world, another protocol', async (t) => {
  const f = fixture(t), ctx = await serve(t, f);
  const status = async (id, cookie) => { const r = await fetch(`${ctx.base}/api/mmo/${id}`, { headers: cookie ? { Cookie: cookie } : {} }); return [r.status, r.headers.get('cache-control'), await r.json()]; };
  assert.deepEqual(await status('city-online'), [200, 'no-store', { enabled: true, signedIn: false, admin: false, players: 0, maxPlayers: 3 }]);
  assert.deepEqual((await status('city-solo'))[2], { enabled: false, signedIn: false, admin: false, players: 0, maxPlayers: 0 });
  assert.equal((await status('nothing-here'))[0], 404);
  const manifests = await (await fetch(ctx.base + '/api/manifests')).json();
  assert.deepEqual(['city-online', 'city-solo'].map((id) => manifests.find((m) => m.name === id).mmo), [true, false]);
  assert.equal((await (await fetch(ctx.base + '/api/config')).json()).mmo, true);
  assert.deepEqual((await (await fetch(ctx.base + '/api/manifest/city-online')).json()).mmo, { maxCharacters: 2, maxPlayers: 3 }, 'the page reads the version\'s settings');
  const cookie = await ctx.account('alice');
  assert.deepEqual((await status('city-online', cookie))[2], { enabled: true, signedIn: true, admin: false, players: 0, maxPlayers: 3 });
  // (another site's page — or none — gets no socket: a plain 403)
  assert.equal(await rawUpgrade(ctx.base, '/api/mmo/city-online/ws', { Cookie: cookie, Origin: 'http://elsewhere.example' }), 403);
  assert.equal(await rawUpgrade(ctx.base, '/api/mmo/city-online/ws', { Cookie: cookie }), 403);
  assert.equal(await rawUpgrade(ctx.base, '/api/mmo/city-online/ws', { Cookie: cookie, Origin: ctx.base }), 101);
  // (the site under another name — a front proxy's X-Forwarded-Host —: its pages get a socket, another site's still not)
  assert.equal(await rawUpgrade(ctx.base, '/api/mmo/city-online/ws', { Cookie: cookie, Origin: 'https://orthros.mirror.test', 'X-Forwarded-Host': 'orthros.mirror.test' }), 101);
  assert.equal(await rawUpgrade(ctx.base, '/api/mmo/city-online/ws', { Cookie: cookie, Origin: 'https://elsewhere.test', 'X-Forwarded-Host': 'orthros.mirror.test' }), 403);
  // (refusals the page can read: REFUSED, then the socket closed)
  const refused = async (cookie2, version, records = []) => {
    const p = await Peer.open(ctx, cookie2, version);
    if (records.length) p.send(...records);
    const r = await p.next(S.REFUSED); await p.done;
    return [r.body[0], rd(r.body.subarray(1)).str8()];
  };
  assert.deepEqual(await refused(null, 'city-online'), [R.SIGN_IN, 'sign-in needed']);
  assert.equal((await refused(cookie, 'city-solo'))[0], R.NO_WORLD);
  assert.equal((await refused(cookie, 'nothing-here'))[0], R.NO_WORLD);
  assert.equal((await refused(cookie, 'city-online', [[C.HELLO, w().u16(2).u8(0).done()]]))[0], R.PROTOCOL);
  // (a record too short for its type: DENIED, the connection kept)
  const p = await Peer.open(ctx, cookie);
  p.send([C.HELLO, w().u16(1).u8(1).done()], [C.PING, w().u8(1).done()], [C.PING, w().f64(3).done()]);
  await p.next(S.LOBBY);
  assert.deepEqual([...(await p.next(S.DENIED)).body], [C.PING, D.INVALID]);
  await p.next(S.PONG);
  assert.equal(p.closed, false);
});
```
