```js
/**
 * A link of `rate` bytes/s shared equally by the answers on it (as the harness's SimLink: a 50 ms round trip, then the
 * bytes), `pattern(now, active, start)` starting requests; the estimates after the first 20 s.
 */
function shared(rate, pattern, seconds = 120) {
  let now = 0; const n = new NetLink({ now: () => now, setTimer: () => 0, clearTimer: () => {} });
  const active = [], seen = [];
  const start = (kind, bytes) => active.push({ tok: n.begin(kind, bytes), left: bytes, bytes, wait: 50 });
  while (now < seconds * 1000) {
    pattern(now, active, start);
    const flowing = active.filter((a) => a.wait <= 0);
    for (const a of active) if (a.wait > 0 && (a.wait -= 10) <= 0) n.firstByte(a.tok);
    for (const a of flowing) a.left -= rate * 0.01 / flowing.length;
    now += 10;
    for (const a of [...active]) if (a.left <= 0) { active.splice(active.indexOf(a), 1); n.end(a.tok, a.bytes, a.bytes); }
    if (now > 20000 && now % 1000 === 0 && n.bw) seen.push(n.bw);
  }
  return { min: Math.min(...seen), max: Math.max(...seen) };
}

test('net link: answers sharing the link, a long one beside small ones — the rate is not read several times too low', () => {
  for (const rate of [85000, 1e6]) {
    // three answers of different sizes always on the link (a long one's time no longer counts without its bytes)
    const a = shared(rate, (now, active, start) => { while (active.length < 3) start('bg', 65536 * (1 + active.length)); });
    assert.ok(a.min > rate * 0.85 && a.max < rate * 1.15, `${rate} B/s, three at once: measured ${Math.round(a.min)}-${Math.round(a.max)}`);
    // a game read of 1 MiB every 20 s, small background answers one after the other beside it
    const b = shared(rate, (now, active, start) => { if (now % 20000 === 0) start('demand', 1 << 20); if (!active.some((x) => x.tok.kind === 'bg')) start('bg', 65536); });
    assert.ok(b.min > rate * 0.75 && b.max < rate * 1.15, `${rate} B/s, long and small: measured ${Math.round(b.min)}-${Math.round(b.max)}`);
  }
});
```

```js
// The proxy log's readers (tools/net-proxy.mjs): a request's kind from its URL (an `a=1` read carries the session too),
// a game data read's path and decoded size, its file category (a light copy's full file read later: an upgrade), and a
// stretch of the log — the game's own reads, their spacing and waits, the background's bytes by kind and category.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';
import { urlKind, dataRead, fileCategory, loadWindow, readLog, summarize } from '../tools/net-proxy.mjs';

const M = '/gamez/mw';
const rec = (t, url, wire, ms, first = 45) => ({ t, url, kind: 'x', status: 200, wire, first, ms });

test('net-proxy log: kinds, reads and categories', () => {
  assert.equal(urlKind(`${M}/Data/a.nif?r=0-10&s=abc`), 'demand');

  assert.equal(dataRead(`${M}/Morrowind.bsa?r=0-5&p=1`).decoded, 5);
  assert.equal(dataRead('/api/tree/mw'), null);
  const cat = (p, o) => fileCategory(dataRead(`${M}/${p}?r=0-1`), o);
  assert.equal(cat('.light/Textures/a.dds'), 'light');
  assert.equal(cat('Textures/a.dds', { lightSeen: new Set(['Textures/a.dds']) }), 'upgrade');
  assert.equal(cat('Textures/a.dds'), 'texture');
  assert.equal(cat('Splash/Splash_x.tga'), 'Splash');
  assert.equal(cat('mods/hd/video/intro.bik'), 'Video');

  assert.equal(cat('Meshes/x/a.nif'), 'mesh');
  assert.equal(cat('Tribunal.bsa'), 'archive');
  assert.equal(cat('Morrowind.esm'), 'content');
  assert.equal(cat('_engine/a.omwaddon'), '_engine');
  assert.equal(cat('a.txt'), 'other');
});

test('net-proxy log: a stretch — demand spacing and waits, background by kind and category, upgrades', () => {
  const recs = [
    rec(0, `${M}/.light/Textures/a.dds?r=0-1000&s=x`, 700, 100),            // before: the light copy read
    rec(1000, `${M}/Meshes/a.nif?r=0-2000&s=x`, 1200, 100),                 // the stretch's reads: 1000, 1200, 1500
    rec(1050, `${M}/Textures/a.dds?r=0-1000000&p=1`, 600_000, 400),         // its upgrade, inside
    rec(1200, `${M}/.light/Textures/b.dds?r=0-500&s=x`, 400, 100),
    rec(1300, `${M}/Video/intro.bik?r=0-500000&s=x&a=1`, 300_000, 200),     // ahead, a movie
    rec(1500, `${M}/Morrowind.bsa?r=0-4000&s=x`, 3000, 200, 90),
    rec(1900, `${M}/Music/a.mp3?r=0-400000&p=1`, 400_000, 200),             // half inside the stretch
    { t: 1950, mark: { kind: 'playable' }, url: '/api/prefetch/mw' },
    rec(1960, '/__qa/mark?x', 300, 5),
    rec(3000, `${M}/Meshes/b.nif?r=0-10&s=x`, 210, 50),                     // after
  ];
  const w = loadWindow(recs, 1000, 2000);
  assert.equal(w.ms, 1000);

  assert.equal(w.backgroundByCategory.upgrade, 0.6);
  assert.equal(w.backgroundByCategory.Video, 0.3);
  assert.equal(w.backgroundByCategory.Music, 0.2);
  assert.deepEqual(w.backgroundByKind.ahead, { Video: 0.3 });
  assert.equal(w.backgroundMB, 1.1);
  assert.equal(w.wireMB.other, 0); // (the marker: 300 bytes)
  // (the whole log's summary skips the mark line)
  assert.equal(summarize(recs).requests, 9);
});
```

`tests/net-proxy.test.js`:

```js
// The player's-link proxy (tools/net-proxy.mjs, docs/slow-network.md "Measuring"): an answer crosses a round trip and
// the link's rate, a text answer sent as it is goes gzip on the way (Cloudflare), a data report's mark is seen and
// listed, one JSON line per request with its wire bytes and unit.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import http from 'node:http';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';
import { startProxy } from '../tools/net-proxy.mjs';

test('net-proxy: round trip and rate, edge gzip of text, marks, JSON log', async () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-net-proxy-'));
  const BIN = Buffer.alloc(100_000, 7), TEXT = 'orthros '.repeat(4000);
  const posted = [];
  const origin = http.createServer((req, res) => {
    const body = []; req.on('data', (c) => body.push(c));
    req.on('end', () => {
      if (req.method === 'POST') { posted.push(Buffer.concat(body).toString()); res.writeHead(204); res.end(); return; }
      if (req.url.startsWith('/bin')) { res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': 'application/octet-stream', 'content-length': BIN.length, 'x-orthros-unit': 'hit' }); res.end(BIN); return; }
      res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'content-length': Buffer.byteLength(TEXT) }); res.end(TEXT);
    });
  });
  await new Promise((r) => origin.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
  const log = path.join(dir, 'log.jsonl');
  const proxy = await startProxy({ upstream: `127.0.0.1:${origin.address().port}`, listen: 0, rate: 500e3, rtt: 80, log, http1: true });
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${proxy.port}`;
  try {
    // (100 KB at 500 KB/s after a round trip of 80 ms: 280 ms at least)
    const t = performance.now();
    const r = await fetch(`${base}/bin?r=0-100000&p=1`);
    const got = Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer()), ms = performance.now() - t;
    assert.ok(got.equals(BIN), 'the answer as sent');
    assert.ok(ms >= 260 && ms < 2000, `round trip and rate: ${ms.toFixed(0)} ms`);
    // (a text answer: gzip on the way, the client gets it decoded)
    const raw = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => http.get(`${base}/api/x`, { headers: { 'accept-encoding': 'gzip, br' } }, (res) => {
      const parts = []; res.on('data', (c) => parts.push(c)); res.on('end', () => resolve({ enc: res.headers['content-encoding'], body: Buffer.concat(parts) }));
    }).on('error', reject));
    assert.equal(raw.enc, 'gzip');
    assert.equal(zlib.gunzipSync(raw.body).toString(), TEXT);
    // (a data report's mark: forwarded, seen, listed — not forwarded itself)
    await fetch(`${base}/api/prefetch/game`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ mark: { kind: 'playable' } }) });
    assert.deepEqual(posted.map((p) => JSON.parse(p).mark.kind), ['playable'], 'the report reached the origin');
    const marks = await (await fetch(`${base}/__proxy/marks`)).json();
    assert.equal(marks.length, 1); assert.equal(marks[0].mark.kind, 'playable'); assert.equal(marks[0].url, '/api/prefetch/game');
  } finally { await proxy.close(); origin.close(); }
  const lines = fs.readFileSync(log, 'utf8').trim().split('\n').map((l) => JSON.parse(l));
  const bin = lines.find((l) => l.url?.startsWith('/bin'));
  assert.equal(bin.kind, 'bg'); assert.equal(bin.unit, 'hit'); assert.equal(bin.wire, BIN.length + 200); assert.ok(bin.ms >= 260);
  const text = lines.find((l) => l.url === '/api/x');
  assert.equal(text.enc, 'gzip'); assert.ok(text.wire < 2000, `the gzip bytes on the wire: ${text.wire}`);
  assert.ok(lines.some((l) => l.mark?.kind === 'playable'), 'the mark in the log');
  fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});
```

`tests/node-scenario.test.js`:

```js
// tools/node-scenario.mjs (startbench --input): the steps parsed as the page parses them (src/host/scenario.js) and
```

`tests/null-page.test.js`:

```js
// The null page (src/cpu/nullpage.js): guest reads and writes in the first 64 KiB fault as on Windows — an access
// violation at the instruction, nothing of it done, with the address and the read/write flag — in the reference
// interpreter and in the JIT alike. Hand-written forms (every kind of memory operand the rule names), then random
// programs (null, small, valid pointers through loads, stores, read-modify-writes, string instructions, null tests and
// if-converted arms) run in time slices, against the interpreter.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory, SMC_MAP_BASE } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { decode } from '../src/cpu/decoder.js';
import { nullChecks } from '../src/cpu/nullpage.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-sse.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import '../src/cpu/jit/translate-sse-float.js';
import '../src/cpu/jit/translate-sse-int.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000, DATA_SIZE = 0x10000;
const ARITH = F.CF | F.PF | F.AF | F.ZF | F.SF | F.OF;
const hex = (v) => '0x' + (v >>> 0).toString(16);
const bytesOf = (s) => Uint8Array.from(s.match(/../g), (b) => parseInt(b, 16));
function prng(seed) { let x = seed >>> 0 || 1; return () => { x ^= x << 13; x >>>= 0; x ^= x >>> 17; x ^= x << 5; x >>>= 0; return x; }; }

/** an executor: the interpreter, or the JIT with translator options */
function makeExec(jitOpts, mode = true) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  const I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
  I.nullPage = mode; // (nullpage.js nullPageMode: true reads and writes, 'writes', false)
  const jit = jitOpts ? new Jit(mem, I, { smc: true, nullPage: mode, ...jitOpts }) : null;
  return {
    mem, cpu, I, jit,
    /** run from CODE to `end` in slices of `slice` instructions; the exit code */
    run(end, slice = 1e6, total = 2e6) {
      I.cache.clear();
      if (jit) { jit.reset(); jit.boundaries = new Set([end]); jit.cpu = cpu; }
      for (let left = total; left > 0; left -= slice) {
        const r = jit ? jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: slice }) : I.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: slice });
        if (r !== EXIT.TIMESLICE && !(r === EXIT.NONE && !jit)) return r;
        if (!jit && cpu.exit !== EXIT.NONE && cpu.exit !== EXIT.TIMESLICE) return cpu.exit;
      }
      return EXIT.TIMESLICE;
    },
    get fault() { return jit ? jit.lastFault : I.lastFault; },
  };
}

// (zero, as in a process: nothing can store there — the JIT clears what a plain store wrote before leaving, see NC_STORE_SMC)
const NULL_FILL = 0;
/** identical start state: code at CODE, a pattern in the null page and DATA, registers */
function load(E, code, regs, seed = 1) {
  const { mem, cpu } = E, r = prng(seed);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.fill(CODE, 0x1000, 0xcc); mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
  mem.fill(0, 0x10000, NULL_FILL);
  for (let i = 0; i < DATA_SIZE; i += 4) mem.write32(DATA + i, r());
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) cpu.setReg(k, 0);
  cpu.esp = DATA + DATA_SIZE - 0x100;
  cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  cpu.fsBase = DATA + 0x8000; cpu.gsBase = 0;
  mem.u8[SMC_MAP_BASE + (CODE >>> 12)] = 0;
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(regs)) cpu[k] = v >>> 0;
  cpu.eip = CODE;
}
function nullPageIntact(mem) { const b = mem.bytes(0, 0x10000); for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) if (b[i] !== NULL_FILL) return `byte ${hex(i)} = ${hex(b[i])}`; return 'intact'; }
function snapshot(E) {
  const { mem, cpu } = E;
  const s = { eip: hex(cpu.eip), eflags: hex(cpu.eflags & ARITH), regs: [], xmm: [], top: cpu.fpuTop, tw: cpu.fpuTw, nullPage: nullPageIntact(mem), data: Buffer.from(mem.bytes(DATA, DATA_SIZE)).toString('base64') };
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) s.regs.push(hex(cpu.reg(k)));
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) s.xmm.push(Buffer.from(mem.bytes(cpu.xmmAddr(k), 16)).toString('hex'));
  return s;
}

// [form, code (hex), registers, offset of the faulting instruction in the code, fault address, write] — or no fault
const P = DATA + 0x400; // a valid pointer
const FORMS = [
  ['mov eax,[ecx+8]', '8b4108', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 8, false],
  ['mov [ecx+0x7ffc],eax', '8981fc7f0000', { ecx: 0, eax: 0x1234 }, 0, 0x7ffc, true],
  ['add dword [ecx],1 (read first)', '830101', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 0, false],
  ['call [ecx+0x10] (null vtable)', 'ff5110', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 0x10, false],
  ['push dword [ecx+4]', 'ff7104', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 4, false],
  ['pop dword [ecx+0xc] (ESP unchanged)', '8f410c', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 0xc, true],
  ['movzx eax,byte [ecx+0xffff]', '0fb681ffff0000', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 0xffff, false],
  ['mov eax,[ecx+0x10000]: the first mapped address', '8b8100000100', { ecx: 0 }, -1],
  ['mov eax,[ecx-4] at 0xffff', '8b41fc', { ecx: 0x10003 }, 0, 0xffff, false],
  ['mov eax,[ecx-4] at 0x10000', '8b41fc', { ecx: 0x10004 }, -1],
  ['mov eax,[ecx-4], ECX null: past the user address space', '8b41fc', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 0xfffffffc, false],
  ['mov eax,[ecx+0x7ffe0000] (KUSER_SHARED_DATA)', '8b810000fe7f', { ecx: 0 }, -1],
  ['mov eax,[ecx+0x7fff0000]', '8b810000ff7f', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 0x7fff0000, false],
  ['lea eax,[ecx+8]: no access', '8d4108', { ecx: 0 }, -1],
  ['nop dword [ecx]: no access', '0f1f01', { ecx: 0 }, -1],
  ['prefetcht0 [ecx]: no access', '0f1809', { ecx: 0 }, -1],
  ['rep movsd from null (ECX kept)', 'f3a5', { esi: 0, edi: P, ecx: 4 }, 0, 0, false],
  ['rep movsd to null', 'f3a5', { esi: P, edi: 0x100, ecx: 4 }, 0, 0x100, true],
  ['rep stosd, zero count: no access', 'f3ab', { edi: 0, ecx: 0 }, -1],
  ['stosb', 'aa', { edi: 0x20, eax: 0x41 }, 0, 0x20, true],
  ['lodsd', 'ad', { esi: 0x30 }, 0, 0x30, false],
  ['repe cmpsb', 'f3a6', { esi: P, edi: 0, ecx: 3 }, 0, 0, false],
  ['xlatb', 'd7', { ebx: 0, eax: 0x41 }, 0, 0x41, false],
  ['bt [ecx],edx: bit string in the null page', '0fa311', { ecx: 0, edx: 8 }, 0, 0, false],
  ['bt [ecx],edx: bit string past it', '0fa311', { ecx: 0, edx: 0x80000 }, -1],
  ['bt [ecx],edx: bit string back into it', '0fa311', { ecx: 0x10000, edx: 0xffffffe0 }, 0, 0xfffc, false],
  ['bts [ecx],3', '0fba2903', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 0, false],
  ['cmpxchg [ecx],edx', '0fb111', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 0, false],
  ['xchg [ecx],eax', '8701', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 0, false],
  ['sete [ecx+1]', '0f944101', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 1, true],
  ['cmove eax,[ecx], condition false (still read)', '0f4401', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 0, false],
  ['fld dword [edx]', 'd902', { edx: 0x40 }, 0, 0x40, false],
  ['fld1 ; fstp qword [edx] (the stack kept)', 'd9e8dd1a', { edx: 0x48 }, 2, 0x48, true],
  ['fld1 ; fistp dword [edx] (the stack kept)', 'd9e8db1a', { edx: 0x48 }, 2, 0x48, true],
  ['fld1 ; fstp tbyte [edx] (the stack kept)', 'd9e8db3a', { edx: 0x40 }, 2, 0x40, true],
  ['fldz ; fst dword [edx+0x10]', 'd9eed95210', { edx: 0x40 }, 2, 0x50, true],
  ['movups [edx],xmm0', '0f1102', { edx: 0x50 }, 0, 0x50, true],
  ['movaps xmm1,[edx]', '0f280a', { edx: 0x60 }, 0, 0x60, false],
  ['mov eax,[0x1234] (absolute)', 'a134120000', {}, 0, 0x1234, false],
  ['mov eax,fs:[0x18]: TEB-relative', '64a118000000', {}, -1],
  ['mov eax,[esp+4]: the stack', '8b442404', {}, -1],
  ['mov eax,[bx+si] (16-bit addressing: always below 64 KiB)', '678b00', { ebx: P, esi: 0x10 }, 0, (P + 0x10) & 0xffff, false],
  ['cmpxchg8b [esi]', '0fc70e', { esi: 0 }, 0, 0, false],
  ['movsd from null', 'a5', { esi: 0, edi: P }, 0, 0, false],
  ['movsd from and to null (the source first)', 'a5', { esi: 0x10, edi: 0x20 }, 0, 0x10, false],
  ['fnstcw [ecx+2]', 'd97902', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 2, true],
  ['inc dword [ecx+0x20]', 'ff4120', { ecx: 0 }, 0, 0x20, false],
  ['mov ebx,5 ; add eax,ebx ; mov [ecx],eax (mid-block, earlier effects kept)', 'bb0500000001d88901', { ecx: 0, eax: 3 }, 7, 0, true],
  ['mov eax,[esi+eax*4+0x20]', '8b448620', { esi: 0, eax: 0x10 }, 0, 0x60, false],
  ['mov dword [edi+ecx*2],7', 'c7044f07000000', { edi: 0x100, ecx: 0x10 }, 0, 0x120, true],
  ['sub eax,[ebp-8] (EBP is checked)', '2b45f8', { ebp: 8 }, 0, 0, false],
  // (two operands through different registers — [edi+ecx*4] and [edx*4]: each its own check, not one group)
  ['mov eax,[edi+ecx*4] ; mov ebx,[edx*4]', '8b048f8b1c9500000000', { edi: P, ecx: 0, edx: 0 }, 3, 0, false],
  ['xchg [edi+ecx*4],eax ; xchg [edx*4],ebx', '87048f871c9500000000', { edi: P, ecx: 0, edx: 0, ebx: 0x2222 }, 3, 0, false],
];

for (const mode of [true, 'writes']) for (const [jitName, jitOpts] of [['jit', {}], ['jit, if-conversion everywhere', { ifcvt: 'all' }]]) {
  test(`null-page accesses fault before the instruction, as on Windows (${mode === true ? 'reads and writes' : 'writes only, the default'}; interpreter, ${jitName})`, () => {
    const EI = makeExec(null, mode), EJ = makeExec(jitOpts, mode);
    for (const [name, code, regs, at0, addr, write] of FORMS) {
      const c = bytesOf(code), end = CODE + c.length;
      // (writes only: the forms whose faulting instruction writes the operand fault the same; the others run on in both
      // executors alike — a read of the null page gives zeros, as before)
      let at = at0;
      if (mode === 'writes' && at >= 0) { load(EI, c, regs); if (!write && !nullChecks(decode(EI.mem, CODE + at)).some((k) => k.writes && !k.str)) at = -2; }
      for (const slice of [1e6, 1]) {
        for (const E of [EI, EJ]) load(E, c, regs);
        const before = EJ.jit.stats.native;
        const ri = EI.run(end, slice), rj = EJ.run(end, slice);
        const si = snapshot(EI), sj = snapshot(EJ);
        if (at === -2) assert.equal(rj, ri, `${name}: jit ${rj}, interpreter ${ri}`);
        else if (at < 0) {
          assert.equal(ri, EXIT.HALT, `${name}: interpreter ${ri} ${EI.fault?.message ?? ''}`);
          assert.equal(rj, EXIT.HALT, `${name}: jit ${rj} ${EJ.fault?.message ?? ''}`);
        } else {
          for (const [E, r, s, who] of [[EI, ri, si, 'interpreter'], [EJ, rj, sj, 'jit']]) {
            assert.equal(r, EXIT.FAULT, `${name}: ${who} exit ${r}`);
            assert.equal(E.cpu.exitArg, 14, `${name}: ${who} vector`);
            assert.equal(s.eip, hex(CODE + at), `${name}: ${who} EIP at the instruction`);
            assert.equal(E.fault.faultAddr, addr, `${name}: ${who} fault address`);
            assert.equal(E.fault.write, write, `${name}: ${who} read/write`);
          }
        }
        // (writes only: a read-modify-write's flags at its fault are the instruction's own in the JIT, see NC_RMW_SMC)
        assert.deepEqual(mode === 'writes' && ri === EXIT.FAULT ? { ...sj, eflags: si.eflags } : sj, si, `${name} (slice ${slice}): jit state differs from the interpreter`);
        assert.equal(si.nullPage, 'intact', `${name}: the null page written`);
        if (slice > 1 && !/^cmpxchg8b/.test(name)) assert.ok(EJ.jit.stats.native > before, `${name}: translated natively`); // (CMPXCHG8B: an interpreter fallback)
      }
    }
  });
}

test('a repeated string instruction walking into the null page faults at that element in the interpreter (the JIT checks the start)', () => {
  // std ; rep stosd ; cld — EDI 0x10004, 0x10000, then 0xfffc: two elements stored, ECX and EDI at the third
  const EI = makeExec(null), c = bytesOf('fdf3abfc');
  load(EI, c, { edi: 0x10004, ecx: 3, eax: 0x11223344 });
  assert.equal(EI.run(CODE + c.length), EXIT.FAULT);
  assert.equal(EI.cpu.eip, CODE + 1); assert.equal(EI.cpu.ecx, 1); assert.equal(EI.cpu.edi, 0xfffc);
  assert.equal(EI.fault.faultAddr, 0xfffc); assert.equal(EI.fault.write, true);
  assert.equal(EI.mem.read32(0x10000), 0x11223344); assert.equal(nullPageIntact(EI.mem), 'intact');
});

test('with the check off (ORTHROS_NULL_PAGE_OPEN), the null page is plain memory again — what the test above would miss', () => {
  const EI = makeExec(null), EJ = makeExec({ nullPage: false });
  EI.I.nullPage = false;
  const c = bytesOf('8981fc7f0000'), end = CODE + c.length;
  for (const E of [EI, EJ]) { load(E, c, { ecx: 0, eax: 0x1234 }); assert.equal(E.run(end), EXIT.HALT); assert.equal(E.mem.read32(0x7ffc), 0x1234); }
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- random programs
const REGS = [0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7]; // eax ecx edx ebx esi edi (EBP: the loop counter, ESP: the stack)
const modrm = (mod, reg, rm) => (mod << 6) | (reg << 3) | rm;
/** [reg + disp8] operand bytes (no SIB: rm 4 is ESP, excluded; EBP base needs a displacement anyway) */
const mem8 = (reg, base, disp) => [modrm(1, reg, base), disp & 0xff];
function randomProgram(r, nInsns, nulls, negDisp = true) {
  const pick = (a) => a[r() % a.length];
  const out = [];
  const body = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nInsns; i++) {
    const d = pick(REGS), b = pick(REGS), disp = r() % 4 === 0 && negDisp ? 0x100 - (r() % 8) * 4 : (r() % 32) * 4;
    switch (r() % 14) {
      case 0: case 1: body.push([0x8b, ...mem8(d, b, disp)]); break; // mov d,[b+disp]
      case 2: body.push([0x89, ...mem8(d, b, disp)]); break; // mov [b+disp],d
      case 3: body.push([0x01, ...mem8(d, b, disp)]); break; // add [b+disp],d
      case 4: body.push([0x3b, ...mem8(d, b, disp)]); break; // cmp d,[b+disp] (no pointer sums: past 2 GiB, see NC_STORE_SMC)
      case 5: body.push([0x8d, ...mem8(d, b, disp & 0x7c)]); break; // lea d,[b+disp] (not below: a register past 2 GiB, see NC_STORE_SMC)
      case 6: if (nulls) body.push([0x31, modrm(3, d, d)]); else body.push([0x89, modrm(3, b, d)]); break; // xor d,d (a null pointer)
      case 7: body.push([0x83, modrm(3, 0, d), (r() % 16) * 4]); break; // add d,imm8
      case 8: body.push([0x89, modrm(3, b, d)]); break; // mov d,b
      case 9: { // test b,b ; jz/jnz over a load through b (a null test, its mirror: the arm loads through null)
        const ld = [0x8b, ...mem8(d === b ? pick(REGS.filter((x) => x !== b)) : d, b, disp)];
        body.push([0x85, modrm(3, b, b), r() & 1 ? 0x74 : 0x75, ld.length, ...ld]); break;
      }
      case 10: body.push([0x0f, 0xb6, ...mem8(d, b, disp)]); break; // movzx d,byte [b+disp]
      case 11: body.push([0xff, ...mem8(6, b, disp)]); break; // push [b+disp]
      case 12: body.push([0x58 + pick([0, 1, 2, 3])]); break; // pop (balances the pushes)
      default: { // a string instruction (DF clear): movsd / stosd / lodsd, sometimes repeated a few times
        const op = pick([0xa5, 0xab, 0xad]);
        if (r() & 1) body.push([0xb9, r() % 3, 0, 0, 0, 0xf3, op]); else body.push([op]);
      }
    }
  }
  // mov ebp,K ; body ; dec ebp ; jnz body (a loop: the JIT region's back edge)
  out.push(0xbd, 3 + (r() % 4), 0, 0, 0);
  const flat = body.flat();
  out.push(...flat, 0x4d);
  const back = -(flat.length + 1 + 6);
  out.push(0x0f, 0x85, back & 0xff, (back >> 8) & 0xff, (back >> 16) & 0xff, (back >> 24) & 0xff);
  return Uint8Array.from(out);
}

for (const mode of [true, 'writes']) test(`random programs through null, small and valid pointers: the JIT faults where the interpreter does, sliced and not (${mode === true ? 'reads and writes' : 'writes only'})`, () => {
  const EI = makeExec(null, mode);
  const EJs = [makeExec({}, mode), makeExec({ ifcvt: 'all' }, mode)];
  const r = prng(mode === true ? 0x6e756c6c : 0x77726974);
  let faults = 0, clean = 0, skipped = 0;
  for (let n = 0; n < 300; n++) {
    // a third of the programs without null pointers (those reach the end), the others with rare or frequent ones
    const pNull = [0, 1 / 64, 1 / 4][n % 3 === 0 ? 0 : 1 + (r() % 2)];
    // (writes only: no negative displacements — an unchecked load from [null - 8] runs past the guest memory, where the
    // interpreter reads undefined bytes and the JIT traps: not this test's subject)
    const code = randomProgram(r, 6 + (r() % 10), pNull > 0, mode === true), end = CODE + code.length;
    // pointers: null, small (in the null page), at its end, valid; DATA holds such pointers too (what loads bring)
    const bad = [0, 0x10 + (r() % 0x100) * 4, 0xff00], good = [DATA + 0x100 + (r() % 0x800) * 4, DATA + 0x2000, DATA + 0x4000 + (r() % 0x100) * 4];
    const ptr = (q) => (q() / 2 ** 32 < pNull ? bad[q() % bad.length] : good[q() % good.length]);
    const regs = {}; for (const k of ['eax', 'ecx', 'edx', 'ebx', 'esi', 'edi']) regs[k] = ptr(r);
    const seed = r();
    const fillPtrs = (E) => { const q = prng(seed); for (let i = 0; i < DATA_SIZE; i += 4) E.mem.write32(DATA + i, ptr(q)); };
    const slice = [1e6, 1 + (r() % 7), 37][n % 3];
    load(EI, code, regs); fillPtrs(EI);
    const ri = EI.run(end, slice);
    const si = snapshot(EI);
    // (writes only: an unchecked load past the guest memory — [null - 4] — is a WebAssembly trap in the JIT, an
    // imprecise fault, as before the null page was checked: not compared)
    if (ri === EXIT.FAULT && !EI.fault.nullPage) { skipped++; continue; }
    if (ri === EXIT.FAULT) faults++; else clean++;
    for (const EJ of EJs) {
      load(EJ, code, regs); fillPtrs(EJ);
      const rj = EJ.run(end, slice);
      // (a plain store past the guest memory — [null - 4] — traps in the JIT, an imprecise fault: see NC_STORE_SMC)
      if (ri === EXIT.FAULT && EI.fault.faultAddr >= 0x80000000 && EI.fault.write && rj === EXIT.FAULT && !EJ.fault?.nullPage) continue;
      const label = `program ${n} (slice ${slice}, ${EJ.jit.opts.ifcvt ? 'ifcvt' : 'default'}): ${Buffer.from(code).toString('hex')} regs ${JSON.stringify(regs)}`;
      assert.equal(rj, ri, `${label}: exit ${rj}, interpreter ${ri} (${EI.fault?.message ?? ''} / ${EJ.fault?.message ?? ''})`);
      if (ri === EXIT.FAULT) { assert.equal(EJ.fault.faultAddr, EI.fault.faultAddr, label); assert.equal(EJ.fault.write, EI.fault.write, label); }
      // (at a fault, the arithmetic flags no later instruction reads before writing them may be an older instruction's in
      // the JIT: dead flags are not computed — what an exception handler could see in its CONTEXT, as for every fault in
      // translated code; see Emitter.deadFlagsExit)
      const sj = snapshot(EJ);
      assert.deepEqual(ri === EXIT.FAULT ? { ...sj, eflags: si.eflags } : sj, si, `${label}: state differs`);
    }
    assert.equal(si.nullPage, 'intact');
  }
  assert.ok(faults > 40 && clean > 40 && skipped < 60, `both outcomes exercised (${faults} faults, ${clean} clean, ${skipped} not compared)`);
});
```

`tests/openmw-boot-reads.test.js`:

```js
// The OpenMW engine page's boot reads announced (src/ports/openmw/boot-reads.js, streamfs.js announceBoot — docs/openmw.md
// "Scripts announced at the boot"): the data folders' scripts, localisation and shaders the engine's VFS resolves, in one
// list once the mounts are over, instead of a round trip each at the engine's boot and at a save's load.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import vm from 'node:vm';
import { bootReads, vfsName, BOOT_FILE_MAX } from '../src/ports/openmw/boot-reads.js';

const SRC = fs.readFileSync(new URL('../src/ports/openmw/streamfs.js', import.meta.url), 'utf8')
  .replaceAll("import('/src/", `import('${new URL('../src/', import.meta.url).href}`);

test('vfsName: a data folder\'s file by the name the engine resolves', () => {
  assert.equal(vfsName('/mwdata/Scripts/A.lua'), 'scripts/a.lua');
  assert.equal(vfsName('/mwmods/ui-toolkit-0/scripts/UI/x.lua'), 'scripts/ui/x.lua');
  assert.equal(vfsName('/mods/openmw-web-assets.bsa'), null, 'the engine\'s asset pack: not a loose file of a data folder');
  assert.equal(vfsName('/mwmods/only-a-folder'), null);
});

test('bootReads: the files the engine resolves (a later data folder wins), their kinds, the smallest first, bounded', () => {
  const h = (size, extra = {}) => ({ size, ...extra });
  const overridden = h(10), winner = h(30), big = h(BOOT_FILE_MAX + 1), elsewhere = h(5, { src: 1 });
  const mounts = [
    ['/mwdata/Morrowind.esm', h(80 << 20)],
    ['/mwmods/a-0/scripts/a/init.lua', h(400)],
    ['/mwmods/a-0/scripts/a/menu.LUA', overridden],
    ['/mwmods/a-0/a.omwscripts', h(50)],
    ['/mwmods/a-0/l10n/A/fr.yaml', h(200)],
    ['/mwmods/a-0/questData/quests.yml', h(3000)],
    ['/mwmods/a-0/shaders/bloom.omwfx', h(900)],
    ['/mwmods/a-0/textures/a.png', h(70)],
    ['/mwmods/a-0/meshes/a.nif', h(60)],
    ['/mwmods/a-0/readme.txt', h(20)],
    ['/mwmods/b-0/Scripts/A/Menu.lua', winner],
    ['/mwmods/b-0/scripts/huge.lua', big],
    ['/mwmods/b-0/scripts/picked.lua', elsewhere],
    ['/mods/openmw-web-assets.bsa', h(1 << 20)],
  ];
  const sizes = (list) => list.map((e) => e.h.size);
  const all = bootReads(mounts);
  assert.deepEqual(sizes(all), [30, 50, 200, 400, 900, 3000], 'scripts, content lists, YAML, shaders; small first');
  assert.ok(all.every((e) => e.off === 0 && e.len === -1), 'whole files');
  assert.ok(all.some((e) => e.h === winner) && !all.some((e) => e.h === overridden), 'the later data folder\'s file only (any case)');
  assert.ok(!all.some((e) => e.h === big), 'a file over the bound left to the engine\'s reads');
  assert.ok(!all.some((e) => e.h === elsewhere), 'a source of elsewhere left out');
  assert.deepEqual(sizes(bootReads(mounts, { maxBytes: 300 })), [30, 50, 200], 'cut at the bytes bound');
  assert.deepEqual(sizes(bootReads(mounts, { maxFiles: 2 })), [30, 50], 'cut at the files bound');
  assert.deepEqual(bootReads([]), []);
});

/** streamfs.js in a context with an engine page's file system; `search`: the page's query. */
function page(search = '') {
  const workers = [];
  const RealWorker = globalThis.Worker;
  globalThis.Worker = class { constructor() { this.sent = []; workers.push(this); } postMessage(m) { this.sent.push(m); } };
  const nodes = new Map(), intervals = new Set();
  const FS = {
    ErrnoError: class extends Error { constructor(n) { super(`errno ${n}`); this.errno = n; } },
    mkdirTree() {},
    createFile(dir, name) { const n = { stream_ops: {}, node_ops: {} }; nodes.set(`${dir}/${name}`, n); return n; },
    lookupPath(p) { const n = nodes.get(p); if (!n) throw new FS.ErrnoError(44); return { node: n }; },
  };
  const ctx = vm.createContext({
    console, URL, URLSearchParams, Promise, Map, WeakMap, Math, Object, Error, Number, String, queueMicrotask, decodeURIComponent, FS, performance,
    self: { crossOriginIsolated: true }, location: { pathname: '/ports/openmw/mw-x/app/index.html', href: 'https://o.test/ports/openmw/mw-x/app/index.html' + search, origin: 'https://o.test', search },
    setInterval: (f, ms) => { const t = setInterval(f, ms); intervals.add(t); return t; }, clearInterval: (t) => { intervals.delete(t); clearInterval(t); }, setTimeout, clearTimeout,
  });
  ctx.window = ctx; ctx.globalThis = ctx; ctx.window.parent = ctx;
  vm.runInContext(SRC, ctx, { importModuleDynamically: vm.constants.USE_MAIN_CONTEXT_DEFAULT_LOADER });
  const close = () => { ctx.StreamFS?.close?.(); for (const t of intervals) clearInterval(t); globalThis.Worker = RealWorker; };
  return { ctx, workers, close };
}
const tick = (ms = 10) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
async function boot(ctx, workers) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) { try { ctx.StreamFS.init(); break; } catch (e) { if (!/not loaded yet/.test(e.message)) throw e; await tick(); } }
  const w = workers[0]; assert.ok(w, 'the game data opened');
  w.onmessage({ data: { ready: { trees: {}, kept: {}, manifest: {}, real: [] } } });
  const app = 'https://o.test/ports/openmw/mw-x/app/';
  ctx.StreamFS.mount('/mwdata/Morrowind.esm', app + 'mwdata/Morrowind.esm', 80 << 20);
  ctx.StreamFS.mount('/mwmods/a-0/scripts/a/init.lua', app + 'mwdata/mods/a-0/scripts/a/init.lua', 400);
  ctx.StreamFS.mount('/mwmods/a-0/scripts/a/menu.lua', app + 'mwdata/mods/a-0/scripts/a/menu.lua', 10);
  ctx.StreamFS.mount('/mwmods/a-0/l10n/A/fr.yaml', app + 'mwdata/mods/a-0/l10n/A/fr.yaml', 200);
  ctx.StreamFS.mount('/mwmods/b-0/scripts/a/menu.lua', app + 'mwdata/mods/b-0/scripts/a/menu.lua', 30);
  return w;
}

test('streamfs: the boot\'s scripts announced in one list once the engine page\'s mods are mounted, the later folder\'s file', async () => {
  const { ctx, workers, close } = page();
  try {
    const w = await boot(ctx, workers);
    await tick(250);
    assert.equal(w.sent.filter((m) => m.want).length, 0, 'not while the mounts go on');
    assert.equal(ctx.StreamFS.boot(), null);
    ctx.__serverMods = { dirs: ['/mwmods/a-0', '/mwmods/b-0'] }; // (the engine page: every mod mounted)
    for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !w.sent.some((m) => m.want); i++) await tick(20);
    const sent = w.sent.filter((m) => m.want);
    assert.equal(sent.length, 1, 'one list');
    assert.deepEqual(sent[0].want, { seq: 0, list: [['mw-x', 'mods/b-0/scripts/a/menu.lua', 0, 30], ['mw-x', 'mods/a-0/l10n/A/fr.yaml', 0, 200], ['mw-x', 'mods/a-0/scripts/a/init.lua', 0, 400]], label: 'boot:scripts', wait: false },
      'fetched at once, not waited for (the engine\'s reads join them); the overridden file and the content file left out');
    assert.deepEqual({ ...ctx.StreamFS.boot(), atMs: 0 }, { files: 3, bytes: 630, asked: 3, atMs: 0 });
    ctx.orthrosContentLoading(); // (the content load after: nothing announced again)
    assert.equal(w.sent.filter((m) => m.want).length, 1, 'once');
  } finally { close(); }
});

test('streamfs: the boot\'s scripts announced at the content load when the engine page never says its mods are in; ?bootreads=0: none', async () => {
  {
    const { ctx, workers, close } = page();
    try {
      const w = await boot(ctx, workers);
      ctx.orthrosContentLoading();
      const sent = w.sent.filter((m) => m.want);
      assert.equal(sent.length, 1, 'at the content load');
      assert.equal(sent[0].want.list.length, 3);
    } finally { close(); }
  }
  {
    const { ctx, workers, close } = page('?bootreads=0');
    try {
      const w = await boot(ctx, workers);
      ctx.__serverMods = { dirs: [] };
      await tick(250);
      ctx.orthrosContentLoading();
      assert.equal(w.sent.filter((m) => m.want).length, 0, 'the engine\'s reads alone');
      assert.equal(ctx.StreamFS.boot()?.off, true);
    } finally { close(); }
  }
});
```

```js
  assert.ok(hook, 'the ?omwenv= hook');
  const run = (search) => { const ENV = {}; new Function('location', 'ENV', hook)({ search }, ENV); return ENV; };
  assert.deepEqual(run('?tier=mid&omwenv=OPENMW_ORTHROS_UNIFORMS=0,OPENMW_ORTHROS_VAO=0'), { OPENMW_ORTHROS_UNIFORMS: '0', OPENMW_ORTHROS_VAO: '0' });
  assert.deepEqual(run('?omwenv=HOME=/x,LD_PRELOAD=a,OPENMW_ORTHROS_X=a%20b'), {}, 'other names, or values with spaces, never');
});

test('r10 patch: read-ahead of a cell change — the page told the files about to be read, a bounded wait, then the textures the NIFs name', () => {
  // (the release is r9 plus this patch, r9's exports; the patch stays clear of r9's files)

  const patch = fs.readFileSync(path.join(tools, 'patches/orthros-r10.patch'), 'utf8');
  const added = patch.split('\n').filter((l) => l.startsWith('+')).join('\n');

    assert.ok(!files.includes(f), f);
  for (const k of [
    // (the contract with src/ports/openmw/streamfs.js: one call per batch, records 'path\x1Foffset\x1Fsize' joined by '\x1E')
    'var f = globalThis.orthrosWillRead;', 'f(UTF8ToString($0, $1), UTF8ToString($2, $3))', "list += '\\x1E';", "list += '\\x1F';",
    'var f = globalThis.orthrosReadWait;', 'MAIN_THREAD_EM_ASM_INT', 'emscripten_is_main_runtime_thread()',
    // (the files' ranges shared by r5's readiness and the read-ahead)
    'bool orthrosRange(std::string& path, std::uint64_t& offset, std::uint64_t& size) const override',
    // (two phases, each wait bounded; labels '<kind>:<place>')
    'void SceneManager::orthrosPrefetch(', 'constexpr double waitMs = 15000;', '"meshes:" + std::string(place)',

    assert.ok(added.includes(k), k);
  // (the grid's read-ahead just before the terrain's setup and synchronous preload, and only in the web build)
  const scene = patch.slice(patch.indexOf('+++ b/openmw/apps/openmw/mwworld/scene.cpp'));
  const grid = scene.indexOf('+        // Orthros (orthros-r10.patch): the grid\'s cells about to load');
  assert.ok(grid > 0 && grid < scene.indexOf('\n         mPreloader->setTerrain(mRendering.getTerrain());', grid));
  assert.ok(scene.lastIndexOf('+#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__', grid) > 0);

test('r13 patch: the content load told to the page (its content files light until then), the cells\' ranges read ahead or put off', () => {
  const file = path.join(tools, 'patches/orthros-r13.patch');
  const patch = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'), added = patch.split('\n').filter((l) => l.startsWith('+')).join('\n');
  // (an r13 build, once in the lock: r12's patches and its own, its exports r12's and the content's — launch-set.js
  // CONTENT_EXPORT: the server marks its versions' content files light only then)
  const r13 = lock.builds.find((b) => b.patches.includes('orthros-r13.patch'));
  if (r13) {
    assert.equal(r13.patches.at(-1), 'orthros-r13.patch'); assert.equal(r13.patches.at(-2), 'orthros-r12.patch');
    assert.ok(r13.exports.some((e) => e.name === 'orthros_content_light'), 'CONTENT_EXPORT among its exports');
  }
  for (const k of [
    // (the export, and the hooks around World::loadData: light from its start, the files from its end)
    'extern "C" EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE int orthros_content_light()', 'VFS::orthrosContentLoad(false);', 'VFS::orthrosContentLoad(true);',
    'globalThis.orthrosContentLoaded : globalThis.orthrosContentLoading',
    // (a cell's ranges: each content file's CELL context, an exterior's LAND context)
    'void orthrosCellRanges(const MWWorld::ESMStore& store, const ESM::Cell& cell, bool refs, bool land,',
    'for (const ESM::ESM_Context& context : cell.mContextList)', 'bool orthrosLandRange(const ESM::Land& land, VFS::OrthrosRange& out)',
    'std::size_t orthrosWillReadRanges(std::span<const OrthrosRange> ranges, std::string_view label)',
    // (announced and waited for before the loads that read them; put off between frames until there)
    'orthrosReadCells(records, "meshes:" + std::to_string(playerCellX) + "," + std::to_string(playerCellY));',
    'orthrosReadCells(records, "meshes:" + Misc::StringUtils::lowerCase(cellName));',
    'if (VFS::orthrosWillReadRanges(ranges, "terrain:" + place) > 0)', 'orthrosReadSavedCells(filepath);', '"cells:save"',
    'if (!VFS::orthrosRangesReady(ranges))', 'orthrosCellReady(mWorld.getWorldModel().getExterior(cellIndex, false))',
    // (a cell's references listed by their ids — a search through every cell — read from the light copies)
    'void orthrosContentIds(bool on)', 'var f = globalThis.orthrosContentIds;'])
    assert.ok(added.includes(k), k);
  // (the ids-only guard inside CellStore::listRefs(const ESM::Cell&), before its readers are restored)
  const cells = patch.slice(patch.indexOf('+++ b/openmw/apps/openmw/mwworld/cellstore.cpp'));
  const guard = cells.indexOf('} orthrosIdsOnly;');
  assert.ok(guard > cells.indexOf('void CellStore::listRefs(const ESM::Cell& cell)') && guard < cells.indexOf('// Load references from all plugins that do something with this cell.'));
  assert.ok(cells.indexOf('OrthrosIdsOnly() { VFS::orthrosContentIds(true); }') > 0 && cells.indexOf('~OrthrosIdsOnly() { VFS::orthrosContentIds(false); }') > 0);
  // (the hooks around the whole content load: the content files, the groundcover's, the references counted)
  const world = patch.slice(patch.indexOf('+++ b/openmw/apps/openmw/mwworld/worldimp.cpp'));
  const on = world.indexOf('VFS::orthrosContentLoad(false);'), off = world.indexOf('VFS::orthrosContentLoad(true);');
  assert.ok(on > 0 && on < world.indexOf(' loadContentFiles(fileCollections, contentFiles, encoder, listener);'));
  assert.ok(off > world.indexOf(' mStore.validateRecords(mReaders);'));
  // (the grid's cells read ahead before getExterior loads their references)
  const scene = patch.slice(patch.indexOf('+++ b/openmw/apps/openmw/mwworld/scene.cpp'));
  const read = scene.indexOf('orthrosReadCells(records, "meshes:" + std::to_string(');
  assert.ok(read > 0 && read < scene.indexOf('\n             std::vector<CellStore*> cells;', read));
});

test('r20 patch: the frame and the boot suspend on a read the page does not answer within a few ms (JSPI), worker threads\' reads at once, the page\'s calls after the frame; no put-off of distant chunks', () => {
  const patch = fs.readFileSync(path.join(tools, 'patches/orthros-r20.patch'), 'utf8'), added = patch.split('\n').filter((l) => l.startsWith('+')).join('\n');
  // (r19 plus its patch; its exports r19's and the JSPI mark — the page tells the release by it; its built files pinned,
  // its package r19's: the lean copy made for r18 applies)
  const r19 = lock.builds.find((b) => b.id === 'openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r19'), r20 = lock.builds.find((b) => b.id === 'openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20');
  assert.ok(r20, 'r20 is a build');
  assert.deepEqual(r20.patches, [...r19.patches, 'orthros-r20.patch']);
  assert.deepEqual(r20.exports.filter((x) => x.name !== 'orthros_jspi'), r19.exports);
  const e = r20.exports.find((x) => x.name === 'orthros_jspi');
  assert.ok(e, 'orthros_jspi among its exports'); assert.equal(e.returns, 'number'); assert.deepEqual(e.args, []);
  assert.ok(r20.exports.some((x) => x.name === 'orthros_content_light'), 'r13\'s exports kept');
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(r20.files).sort(), ['openmw.data', 'openmw.js', 'openmw.wasm']);
  assert.equal(r20.files['openmw.data'], r19.files['openmw.data']); assert.notEqual(r20.files['openmw.wasm'], r19.files['openmw.wasm']);
  for (const f of ['openmw/apps/openmw/engine.cpp', 'openmw/apps/openmw/main.cpp', 'openmw/apps/openmw/mwgui/loadingscreen.cpp', 'openmw/apps/openmw/mwgui/savegamedialog.cpp',
    'openmw/apps/openmw/mwstate/statemanagerimp.cpp', 'openmw/components/vfs/manager.cpp', 'play/index.html', 'wasm-build/link-openmw.sh', 'wasm-build/orthros-jspi.js'])
    assert.ok(patch.includes(`+++ b/${f}`), f);
  // (the multiplayer script's fix and its Lua test are r18's, not this patch's)
  for (const f of ['openmw/files/data/scripts/mp/interp.lua', 'wasm-build/lua-tests/run.lua']) assert.ok(!patch.includes(`+++ b/${f}`), f);
  // (the link: JSPI, the frame a promising export — main() is by default —, the library after the system's)
  for (const k of ['-sJSPI=1 "-sJSPI_EXPORTS=[\'omw_pump_frame\']"', '--js-library "$ROOT/wasm-build/orthros-jspi.js"', 'extern "C" EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE int orthros_jspi()',
    'orthros_jspi_enter(0);', 'orthros_jspi_leave(0);', 'orthros_jspi_enter(1);', 'orthros_jspi_leave(1);', 'return orthros_read_wait(timeoutMs) != 0;',
    // (the engine's loads told to the glue: its loading screen on and off)
    'orthros_jspi_loading(1);', 'orthros_jspi_loading(0);'])
    assert.ok(added.includes(k), k);
  const lib = patch.slice(patch.indexOf('+++ b/wasm-build/orthros-jspi.js'));
  // (a read spins first — the store's answers — and suspends only on the page's promise; the announced wait alike)
  for (const k of ['s.soon ? s.soon(position, length, orthrosSpinMs())', "OPENMW_ORTHROS_JSPI_SPIN_MS", "OPENMW_ORTHROS_JSPI_PLAY_SPIN_MS", "ENV['OPENMW_ORTHROS_JSPI'] === '0'",
    'var r = soon(timeoutMs, J.spinMs);', 'Module.orthrosLoading = () => J.boot > 0 || J.loading > 0 || J.loadFrame > 0;', "if (!r || typeof r.then != 'function') return r ? 1 : 0;", 'orthros_fd_read_async__async: true', 'orthros_fd_sync_async__async: true',
    // (suspends only under a promising export, one at a time, in a load — or in play when allowed, ?jspiplay=N)
    "'OrthrosJspi.on > 0 && !OrthrosJspi.plain && !OrthrosJspi.suspended && !OrthrosJspi.off && (OrthrosJspi.boot > 0 || OrthrosJspi.loading > 0 || OrthrosJspi.loadFrame > 0 || OrthrosJspi.playSpinMs >= 0)'"])
    assert.ok(lib.includes(k), k);
  // (the C library's read is the plain import — never suspending: a worker thread's read proxied here, a plain frame's,

  // (the C library's read timed only when proxied from a worker thread)

  for (const k of ['__wrap___wasi_fd_read', '__wrap___wasi_fd_sync', '__wrap_emscripten_sleep', 'if (emscripten_is_main_runtime_thread() && orthros_jspi_may())\n+        return orthros_fd_read_async(fd, iovs, n, nread);',

test('r20: a read suspends in a load (the boot, a loading screen) after a short wait, never in play unless allowed (?jspiplay=N); the loads nest; a loading screen\'s frame presented', async () => {
  const patch = fs.readFileSync(path.join(tools, 'patches/orthros-r20.patch'), 'utf8');
  const file = patch.slice(patch.indexOf('+++ b/wasm-build/orthros-jspi.js'));
  const lib = file.slice(file.indexOf('\n') + 1).split('\n').filter((l) => l.startsWith('+')).map((l) => l.slice(1)).join('\n');
  // (a library entry `  name: (args) => body,` — on one line, or a block closed by `  },`)
  const fn = (name) => {
    const at = lib.indexOf(`\n  ${name}: (`); assert.ok(at >= 0, name);
    const from = at + name.length + 5, line = lib.slice(from, lib.indexOf('\n', from));
    return line.endsWith('{') ? lib.slice(from, lib.indexOf('\n  },', from) + 4) : line.replace(/,$/, '');
  };
  // (the defaults: never in play, a loading screen's frame presented at most every 200 ms)
  assert.ok(lib.includes('spinMs: 10, playSpinMs: -1, presentMs: 200, presentedAt: 0, breathMs: 100, settleMs: 3000, plain: 0, want: 0, hint: 0, hintOff: false, plainOff: false, loadFrame: 0, glMs: 50, glMaxMs: 300, glAt: 0, freedAt: 0'));
  const J = { on: 0, boot: 0, loading: 0, ready: true, suspended: 0, off: false, plain: 0, want: 0, spinMs: 10, playSpinMs: -1, presentMs: 200, presentedAt: 0, settleMs: 3000, after: [] };
  const may = fn('$orthrosMaySuspend').replace(/^\(\) => \{\{\{ ASYNCIFY == 2 \? '(.*)' : 'false' \}\}\}$/, '$1');
  const maySuspend = () => new Function('OrthrosJspi', `return ${may};`)(J);
  const make = (src) => new Function('OrthrosJspi', 'orthrosJspiReady', 'orthrosFlush', 'orthrosMaySuspend', 'orthrosSuspend', 'orthrosNote', `return ${src};`)(J, () => {}, () => {}, maySuspend, (p, path, kind, then) => p.then(() => then(true)), () => {});
  const enter = make(fn('orthros_jspi_enter')), leave = make(fn('orthros_jspi_leave')), loading = make(fn('orthros_jspi_loading')), spin = make(fn('$orthrosSpinMs'));
  enter(1); assert.equal(spin(), 10, 'the boot (main): a load'); assert.ok(maySuspend(), 'the boot may suspend'); leave(1);
  enter(0); assert.ok(!maySuspend(), 'a frame in play never suspends');
  loading(1); loading(1); assert.equal(spin(), 10, 'a loading screen on (nested)'); assert.ok(maySuspend());
  loading(0); assert.equal(spin(), 10, 'still on'); loading(0); assert.ok(maySuspend(), 'off: the rest of the load\'s frame still a load');
  leave(0); enter(0); assert.ok(!maySuspend(), 'the next frame: play again');
  J.playSpinMs = 100; assert.ok(maySuspend(), '?jspiplay=100: may in play'); assert.equal(spin(), 100); J.playSpinMs = -1;
  loading(0); assert.equal(J.loading, 0, 'never below 0'); leave(0);
  // (a loading screen's frame: presented — a suspension until the browser's rendering update — in a load only, at most
  // every presentMs, never with ?jspipresent=0)
  const present = make(fn('orthros_jspi_present'));
  const raf = globalThis.requestAnimationFrame; globalThis.requestAnimationFrame = (f) => setTimeout(f, 1);
  try {
    enter(0); assert.equal(present(), undefined, 'in play: nothing');
    J.presentedAt = -1e9; loading(1); const p = present(); assert.ok(p && typeof p.then === 'function', 'in a load: suspends'); await p;
    assert.ok(J.presentedAt > 0, 'presented now'); assert.equal(present(), undefined, 'not again within presentMs');
    J.presentedAt = -1e9; J.presentMs = 0; assert.equal(present(), undefined, '?jspipresent=0: never'); J.presentMs = 200;
    loading(0); leave(0);
  } finally { if (raf) globalThis.requestAnimationFrame = raf; else delete globalThis.requestAnimationFrame; }
  assert.ok(patch.includes('+        if (orthros_jspi_may())\n+            orthros_jspi_present();'), 'LoadingScreen::draw presents its frame');
  // (in a load, a read gives the page's thread a turn when it had none for breathMs — never in play, never with 0)
  const breath = make(fn('$orthrosBreath'));
  const MC = globalThis.MessageChannel;
  J.breathMs = 100; J.freedAt = 0;
  enter(0); assert.equal(breath(), null, 'in play: none');
  loading(1); assert.equal(breath(), null, 'the first read of a load starts the count'); assert.ok(J.freedAt > 0);
  assert.equal(breath(), null, 'not within breathMs');
  J.freedAt = performance.now() - 150; const b = breath(); assert.ok(b && typeof b.then === 'function', 'held 150 ms: a turn'); await b;
  J.freedAt = performance.now() - 150; J.breathMs = 0; assert.equal(breath(), null, '?jspibreath=0: never'); J.breathMs = 100;
  loading(0); leave(0); assert.equal(globalThis.MessageChannel, MC);
  assert.ok(lib.includes("var breath = orthrosBreath();\n    if (breath) return orthrosSuspend(breath, null, 'breath', () => orthrosRead(fd, iov, iovcnt, offset, pnum));"));
  assert.ok(lib.includes('J.freedAt = performance.now();'), 'every suspension frees the page: the count restarts');
  // (the load's progress breathes too)
  assert.equal((patch.match(/\+            orthros_jspi_breathe\(\);/g) ?? []).length, 2, 'setProgress and increaseProgress');
  assert.ok(lib.includes("orthros_jspi_breathe: () => {\n    var breath = orthrosBreath();\n    if (breath) return orthrosSuspend(breath, null, 'breath', () => {});"));
  // (an announced wait is a load's: it may suspend in play — a cell change's read-ahead comes before its loading
  // screen —, after the load's short wait)
  const wait = fn('orthros_read_wait');
  assert.ok(wait.includes("{{{ ASYNCIFY == 2 ? 'J.on > 0 && !J.plain && !J.suspended && !J.off' : 'false' }}}") && wait.includes('soon(timeoutMs, J.spinMs)'), wait);
  assert.ok(!wait.includes('orthrosMaySuspend()'));
  assert.ok(lib.includes("if (kind === 'present') { b.presents++; b.presentMs += ms; return; }"));
  // (not a budget of the frame's waits: measured, it put suspensions back in play — docs/openmw.md)
  assert.ok(!lib.includes('orthrosAsk') && !lib.includes('J.spun'));
  assert.equal(J.on, 0); assert.equal(J.boot, 0);
  // (the suspensions in play counted apart: Module.orthrosBlocked.play / playMs)
  assert.ok(lib.includes("if (kind !== 'proxied' && !(OrthrosJspi.boot > 0 || OrthrosJspi.loading > 0 || OrthrosJspi.loadFrame > 0)) { b.play++; b.playMs += ms; }"));
  assert.ok(lib.includes("J.playSpinMs = play;"));
});

test('r20: a frame of play is plain (never suspending), a load put off to a promising frame; the suspending imports only when the engine may; a load\'s end waits for the GPU', async () => {
  const patch = fs.readFileSync(path.join(tools, 'patches/orthros-r20.patch'), 'utf8');
  const file = patch.slice(patch.indexOf('+++ b/wasm-build/orthros-jspi.js'));
  const lib = file.slice(file.indexOf('\n') + 1).split('\n').filter((l) => l.startsWith('+')).map((l) => l.slice(1)).join('\n');
  const fn = (name) => {
    const at = lib.indexOf(`\n  ${name}: (`); assert.ok(at >= 0, name);
    const from = at + name.length + 5, line = lib.slice(from, lib.indexOf('\n', from));
    return line.endsWith('{') ? lib.slice(from, lib.indexOf('\n  },', from) + 4) : line.replace(/,$/, '');
  };
  const J = { on: 0, boot: 0, loading: 0, ready: true, suspended: 0, off: false, plain: 0, want: 0, settleMs: 3000, after: [] };
  const tmpl = (src) => src.replace(/\{\{\{ ASYNCIFY == 2 \? '([^']*)' : '[^']*' \}\}\}/g, '$1');
  const may0 = fn('$orthrosMaySuspend').replace(/^\(\) => /, '');
  const maySuspend = () => new Function('OrthrosJspi', `return ${tmpl(may0)};`)(J);
  const make = (src) => new Function('OrthrosJspi', 'orthrosJspiReady', 'orthrosMaySuspend', 'orthrosSuspend', 'orthrosGpuIdle', 'orthrosNote', `return ${tmpl(src)};`)(J, () => {}, maySuspend, (p, path, kind, then) => p.then(() => then(true)), () => Promise.resolve(), () => {});
  const enter = make(fn('orthros_jspi_enter')), leave = make(fn('orthros_jspi_leave').replace('queueMicrotask(orthrosFlush)', '0')), plain = make(fn('orthros_jspi_plain')), defer = make(fn('orthros_jspi_defer')), may = make(fn('orthros_jspi_may')), loading = make(fn('orthros_jspi_loading'));
  // (a plain frame: nothing suspends, a load asked put off — the next frame wanted promising)
  plain(1); enter(0); assert.equal(may(), 0, 'a plain frame never calls a suspending import'); loading(1); assert.ok(!maySuspend(), 'not even under a loading screen');
  loading(0); assert.equal(defer(), 1, 'a load put off'); assert.equal(J.want, 1); leave(0); plain(0);
  // (the next frame, promising: the want cleared, the load now; reads may suspend in its load)
  enter(0); assert.equal(J.want, 0); assert.equal(defer(), 0, 'in a promising frame the load runs now'); assert.equal(may(), 1);
  loading(1); assert.ok(maySuspend()); J.suspended = 1; assert.equal(may(), 0, 'a call that reaches the engine while it is suspended: plain imports'); J.suspended = 0;
  // (the load's end: the GPU's queue waited for, the page's thread free — in a load only, never with ?jspisettle=0)
  const settle = make(fn('orthros_jspi_settle'));
  const p = settle(); assert.ok(p && typeof p.then === 'function', 'a load\'s end suspends'); await p;
  J.settleMs = 0; assert.equal(settle(), undefined, '?jspisettle=0: never'); J.settleMs = 3000;
  loading(0); leave(0); enter(0); assert.equal(settle(), undefined, 'in play: never'); leave(0);
  J.off = true; plain(1); enter(0); assert.equal(defer(), 0, 'JSPI off: loads at once'); leave(0); plain(0); J.off = false;
  assert.equal(J.on, 0); assert.equal(J.plain, 0);
  // (the page's pump: the plain export unless a load is wanted or on, or ?jspiplain=0; a frame timer wrapping the pump wraps the choice)
  for (const k of ["if (typeof plain == 'function' && !J.plainOff && !J.want && !J.hint && J.boot === 0 && J.loading === 0) { Module.orthrosFrames.plain++; return plain(...a); }",
    "Object.defineProperty(Module, '_omw_pump_frame', { configurable: true, enumerable: true, get: () => pump, set: (f) => { if (!promising) { promising = f; pump = choose; } else pump = f; } });",
    "J.plainOff = ENV['OPENMW_ORTHROS_JSPI_PLAIN'] === '0';", 'c.fenceSync(c.SYNC_GPU_COMMANDS_COMPLETE, 0)', 'c.getSyncParameter(s, c.SYNC_STATUS) === c.SIGNALED'])
    assert.ok(lib.includes(k), k);
  assert.ok(patch.includes('+        if (mNestedLoadingCount == 1)\n+            if (orthros_jspi_may())\n+                orthros_jspi_settle();'), 'the outermost loading screen\'s end settles');
  // (a framebuffer's status under a loading screen (or in the boot): asked once the GPU
  // ran its queue, the engine suspended meanwhile; at most every glMs, never in play, never with ?jspigl=0)
  const J2 = { on: 1, boot: 0, loading: 0, plain: 0, suspended: 0, off: false, loadFrame: 0, glMs: 50, glAt: 0 };
  const gl = new Function('OrthrosJspi', 'orthrosMaySuspend', 'orthrosSuspend', 'orthrosGpuIdle', `return ${fn('orthros_gl_settle')};`)(J2, () => true, (p, path, kind, then) => p.then(() => then(true)), () => Promise.resolve());
  assert.equal(gl(), undefined, 'in play: never');
  const loading2 = new Function('OrthrosJspi', 'orthrosNote', `return ${fn('orthros_jspi_loading')};`)(J2, () => {});
  loading2(1); const g1 = gl(); assert.ok(g1 && typeof g1.then === 'function', 'under a loading screen: suspends'); await g1;
  assert.equal(gl(), undefined, 'not again within glMs');
  // (the rest of the load's frame after its loading screen — the world's first draw —: none since r20dev-c, the GPU's
  // fence there only cost the world its wait)
  loading2(0); assert.equal(J2.loadFrame, 1, 'the rest of the load\'s frame'); J2.glAt = -1e9;
  assert.equal(gl(), undefined, 'after the loading screen: none'); loading2(1);
  J2.glAt = -1e9; J2.glMs = 0; assert.equal(gl(), undefined, '?jspigl=0: never');
  // (the promising exports' stacks made deep first — 1,024 plain wasm frames at their base —: Chromium's native stack
  // walker, which stops at 255 frames, never reaches a JSPI stack's end, past which it read and crashed the renderer;
  // the plain frame goes straight to the work)
  for (const k of ['constexpr int ORTHROS_JSPI_DEPTH = 1024;', 'return orthrosDeep(ORTHROS_JSPI_DEPTH, fn, arg);', 'g_orthrosDeepSink = g_orthrosDeepSink + 1;',
    'extern "C" EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE void omw_pump_frame()\n+{\n+    orthros_jspi_deep(', '+    orthros_jspi_plain(1);\n+    orthrosPumpFrame();\n+    orthros_jspi_plain(0);',
    'const int status = orthros_jspi_deep(', 'return Debug::wrapApplication(&runApplication, a->argc, a->argv, "OpenMW");'])
    assert.ok(patch.includes(k), k);
  for (const k of ['-Wl,--wrap=glCheckFramebufferStatus -Wl,--wrap=emscripten_glCheckFramebufferStatus', 'unsigned int __wrap_glCheckFramebufferStatus(unsigned int target)', "ENV.OPENMW_ORTHROS_JSPI_GL_MS=", 'if (J.on === 0 && J.loading === 0) J.loadFrame = 0;'])
    assert.ok(patch.includes(k), k);
});

/**
 * The r20 library's WebSocket setter wrappers (wasm-build/orthros-jspi.js, from the patch), run against a stand-in
 * WebSocket: `wrap` true makes another script wrap the same setters first, as a debugging tool or a test's counter
 * would (its getter the native one: it answers the tool's own function, never the library's).
 */
function r18Sockets({ wrap, variant = (code) => code }) {
  const patch = fs.readFileSync(path.join(tools, 'patches/orthros-r20.patch'), 'utf8');
  const file = patch.slice(patch.indexOf('+++ b/wasm-build/orthros-jspi.js'));
  const lib = file.slice(file.indexOf('\n') + 1).split('\n').filter((l) => l.startsWith('+')).map((l) => l.slice(1)).join('\n');
  const from = lib.indexOf("    if (typeof WebSocket != 'undefined') {"), to = lib.indexOf('\n#endif', from);
  assert.ok(from > 0 && to > from, 'the WebSocket block in orthros-jspi.js');
  class WebSocket { constructor() { this.native = {}; } fire(name, e) { this.native[name]?.call(this, e); } }
  for (const name of ['onopen', 'onmessage', 'onerror', 'onclose'])
    Object.defineProperty(WebSocket.prototype, name, { configurable: true, enumerable: true, get() { return this.native[name] ?? null; }, set(fn) { this.native[name] = fn; } });
  const seen = [];
  if (wrap) {
    for (const name of ['onmessage', 'onopen']) {
      const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(WebSocket.prototype, name);
      Object.defineProperty(WebSocket.prototype, name, { configurable: true, enumerable: true, get: d.get, set(fn) { d.set.call(this, typeof fn == 'function' ? function (e) { seen.push(name); return fn.call(this, e); } : fn); } });
    }
  }
  const J = { suspended: 0, after: [], flushing: false };
  const orthrosLater = (fn) => { if (J.suspended > 0 || (J.after.length > 0 && !J.flushing)) { J.after.push(fn); return true; } fn(); return false; };
  const flush = () => { J.flushing = true; while (J.after.length) J.after.shift()(); J.flushing = false; };
  const webSockets = { allocated: [null] };
  new Function('WebSocket', 'webSockets', 'orthrosLater', variant(lib.slice(from, to)))(WebSocket, webSockets, orthrosLater);
  return { WebSocket, webSockets, J, flush, seen };
}

test('r20: the engine\'s WebSocket events reach it — after the frame while suspended — with or without another script wrapping the setters; dropped once its handler is replaced or its socket deleted', () => {
  for (const wrap of [false, true]) {
    const { WebSocket, webSockets, J, flush, seen } = r18Sockets({ wrap });
    const ws = new WebSocket(), got = [];
    webSockets.allocated.push(ws);
    ws.onopen = () => got.push('open');
    ws.onmessage = (e) => got.push(e.data);
    ws.fire('onopen', {}); ws.fire('onmessage', { data: 'm1' });
    assert.deepEqual(got, ['open', 'm1'], `wrap ${wrap}: delivered at once`);
    // (the engine suspended: put off, in order, delivered at the frame's end)
    J.suspended = 1; ws.fire('onmessage', { data: 'm2' }); ws.fire('onmessage', { data: 'm3' });
    assert.deepEqual(got, ['open', 'm1'], `wrap ${wrap}: put off while suspended`);
    J.suspended = 0; flush();
    assert.deepEqual(got, ['open', 'm1', 'm2', 'm3'], `wrap ${wrap}: after the frame, in order`);
    if (wrap) assert.deepEqual(seen, ['onopen', 'onmessage', 'onmessage', 'onmessage'], 'the other script still sees every event');
    // (a handler replaced while an event of the old one is queued: dropped)
    J.suspended = 1; ws.fire('onmessage', { data: 'old' });
    const got2 = []; ws.onmessage = (e) => got2.push(e.data);
    J.suspended = 0; flush();
    assert.deepEqual(got.slice(4), [], `wrap ${wrap}: the old handler's queued event dropped`);
    ws.fire('onmessage', { data: 'new' });
    assert.deepEqual(got2, ['new'], `wrap ${wrap}: the new handler gets the next event`);
    // (the socket deleted — emscripten_websocket_delete: out of webSockets.allocated — with an event queued: dropped)
    J.suspended = 1; ws.fire('onmessage', { data: 'gone' });
    webSockets.allocated.splice(webSockets.allocated.indexOf(ws), 1);
    J.suspended = 0; flush();
    assert.deepEqual(got2, ['new'], `wrap ${wrap}: a deleted socket's queued event dropped`);
    // (a socket the engine did not make — the page's own —: its handler untouched, never put off)
    const own = new WebSocket(), mine = [];
    own.onmessage = (e) => mine.push(e.data);
    J.suspended = 1; own.fire('onmessage', { data: 'page' }); J.suspended = 0;
    assert.deepEqual(mine, ['page'], `wrap ${wrap}: the page's own socket not put off`);
  }
  // (the check the first two-client run broke on — the handler compared through the socket's getter —: with another
  // script wrapping the setters, every event of the engine dropped; this test catches it)
  const { WebSocket, webSockets } = r18Sockets({ wrap: true, variant: (code) => { assert.ok(code.includes('(current.get(socket) || {})[key] === wrapped')); return code.replace('(current.get(socket) || {})[key] === wrapped', 'd.get.call(socket) === wrapped'); } });
  const ws = new WebSocket(), got = [];
  webSockets.allocated.push(ws);
  ws.onmessage = (e) => got.push(e.data);
  ws.fire('onmessage', { data: 'm' });
  assert.deepEqual(got, [], 'the getter-based check drops the engine\'s events');
});
```

`tests/openmw-cloud.test.js`:

```js
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { runInNewContext } from 'node:vm';
import { gzipSync, gunzipSync } from 'node:zlib';
import { webcrypto } from 'node:crypto';

const source = fs.readFileSync(new URL('../src/ports/openmw/cloud.js', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
const tick = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
function browser(remote = null, state = null, { dates = true } = {}) {
  const files = new Map(), storage = new Map(), messages = [], writes = [], events = {}, reads = [], times = new Map();
  let clock = 1000;
  if (state) storage.set('orthros.openmw.cloud.user.game', JSON.stringify(state));
  let cloud = remote ? gzipSync(JSON.stringify({ format: 'orthros-profile', version: 1, game: 'game', files: remote })) : null;
  let head = cloud ? 'remote-head' : 'none', fail = false, failStatus = 409;
  const FS = {
    syncfs(_populate, cb) { cb(null); },
    readdir(root) { const prefix = root + '/'; return ['.', '..', ...new Set([...files.keys()].filter((p) => p.startsWith(prefix)).map((p) => p.slice(prefix.length).split('/')[0]))]; },
    // (as MEMFS: a file's size and date — the date of its last write, a Date —; `dates` false: a file system without)
    stat(p) { return files.has(p) ? { mode: 1, size: files.get(p).length, mtime: dates ? new Date(times.get(p) ?? 0) : undefined } : { mode: 2 }; },
    isDir: (m) => m === 2, isFile: (m) => m === 1,
    readFile: (p) => { reads.push(p); return files.get(p); }, writeFile: (p, b) => { files.set(p, new Uint8Array(b)); times.set(p, clock++); },
    mkdirTree() {}, unlink: (p) => files.delete(p), rmdir() {},
    ...(dates ? { utime: (p, _a, m) => { times.set(p, m); } } : {}),
  };
  const window = { parent: { postMessage: (m) => messages.push(m) }, addEventListener: (n, cb) => events[n] = cb };
  runInNewContext(source, { window, document: { createElement: () => ({ setAttribute() {} }), body: { prepend() {} } },
    crypto: webcrypto, TextEncoder, TextDecoder, Blob, Response, CompressionStream, DecompressionStream, Uint8Array,
    btoa: (s) => Buffer.from(s, 'binary').toString('base64'), atob: (s) => Buffer.from(s, 'base64').toString('binary'), location: { origin: 'https://orthros.test' },
    localStorage: { getItem: (k) => storage.get(k), setItem: (k, v) => storage.set(k, v) },
    fetch: async (_url, options) => {
      assert.equal(options.headers['X-Orthros-Player-Scope'], 'user');
      if (options.method === 'PUT') {
        writes.push(options);
        if (fail) return new Response('{}', { status: failStatus });
        assert.equal(options.headers['X-Orthros-Parent-Hash'], head);
        cloud = Buffer.from(options.body); head = 'head-' + writes.length;
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ hash: head }));
      }
      return cloud ? new Response(cloud, { headers: { 'X-Orthros-Backup-Hash': head } }) : new Response('{}', { status: 404 });
    },
  });
  window.orthrosCloudInstall(FS, 'game', 'user');
  // (`put`: a write by the engine, its date the next millisecond)
  return { FS, files, storage, times, messages, writes, events, window, reads, fail: (status = 409) => { fail = true; failStatus = status; }, recover: () => { fail = false; }, put: (p, b) => FS.writeFile(p, b),
    cloud: () => JSON.parse(gunzipSync(cloud)), sync: () => new Promise((r) => FS.syncfs(false, r)),
    ready: () => new Promise((r) => FS.syncfs(true, r)) };
}
async function uploaded(b, count) {
  for (let n = 0; n < 100 && (b.writes.length < count || b.messages.at(-1)?.state !== 'saved'); n++) await tick();
  assert.equal(b.writes.length, count); assert.equal(b.messages.at(-1).state, 'saved');
}

test('OpenMW restores full account files before boot and uploads binary saves with optimistic hashes', async () => {
  const b = browser([{ path: 'saves/old.omwsave', data: 'AP9h' }]);
  b.files.set('/userdata/stale', new Uint8Array([4]));
  await b.ready();
  assert.equal(b.files.has('/userdata/stale'), false);
  assert.deepEqual([...b.files.get('/userdata/saves/old.omwsave')], [0, 255, 97]);
  b.files.set('/userdata/saves/new.omwsave', new Uint8Array([0, 1, 254]));
  await b.sync(); await uploaded(b, 1);
  assert.equal(b.cloud().files.find((f) => f.path === 'saves/new.omwsave').data, 'AAH+');
  b.files.set('/userdata/config/openmw/openmw.log', new Uint8Array([99]));
  await b.sync(); await tick();
  assert.equal(b.writes.length, 1, 'unchanged files do not grow backup history');
  assert.equal(JSON.parse([...b.storage.values()][0]).dirty, false);
  b.files.set('/userdata/saves/new.omwsave', new Uint8Array([5]));
  await b.sync(); await uploaded(b, 2);
  assert.equal(b.writes[1].headers['X-Orthros-Parent-Hash'], 'head-1');
});

test('OpenMW cloud conflicts preserve local saves, suspend uploads and warn before closing', async () => {
  const b = browser(); await b.ready();
  b.files.set('/userdata/save', new Uint8Array([9])); b.fail(); await b.sync();
  for (let n = 0; n < 100 && !b.messages.at(-1)?.error; n++) await tick();
  assert.match(b.messages.at(-1).message, /Conflit/); assert.equal(b.messages.at(-1).state, 'conflict');
  assert.deepEqual([...b.files.get('/userdata/save')], [9]);
  assert.equal(JSON.parse([...b.storage.values()][0]).dirty, true);
  let warned = false; b.events.beforeunload({ preventDefault() { warned = true; } }); assert.ok(warned);
  await b.sync(); await tick(); assert.equal(b.writes.length, 1);
});

test('OpenMW refuses boot when an unsent local copy conflicts with another device', async () => {
  const b = browser([{ path: 'save', data: 'AA==' }], { dirty: true, parent: 'older-head' });
  b.files.set('/userdata/save', new Uint8Array([9]));
  let booted = false; b.FS.syncfs(true, () => { booted = true; });
  for (let n = 0; n < 100 && !b.messages.at(-1)?.error; n++) await tick();
  assert.equal(booted, false); assert.match(b.messages.at(-1).message, /Conflit/);
  assert.deepEqual([...b.files.get('/userdata/save')], [9]); assert.equal(b.writes.length, 0);
});

test('OpenMW answers the Orthros page\'s flush once the account has the saves', async () => {
  const b = browser(); await b.ready();
  b.files.set('/userdata/saves/a.omwsave', new Uint8Array([1, 2]));
  b.events.message({ origin: 'https://orthros.test', source: {}, data: { type: 'orthros-flush' } }); // (not the page around it: ignored)
  await tick(); assert.equal(b.messages.filter((m) => m.type === 'orthros-flushed').length, 0);
  b.events.message({ origin: 'https://orthros.test', source: b.window.parent, data: { type: 'orthros-flush' } });
  for (let n = 0; n < 100 && !b.messages.some((m) => m.type === 'orthros-flushed'); n++) await tick();
  assert.equal(b.messages.find((m) => m.type === 'orthros-flushed').ok, true);
  assert.equal(b.writes.length, 1);
  assert.equal(b.cloud().files[0].path, 'saves/a.omwsave');
});

test('OpenMW syncs that changed nothing read, encode and send nothing; a file written again unchanged is not sent', async () => {
  for (const dates of [true, false]) {
    const b = browser(null, null, { dates }); await b.ready();
    b.put('/userdata/saves/a.omwsave', new Uint8Array(300000).fill(7)); b.put('/userdata/config/settings.cfg', new TextEncoder().encode('[Video]\n'));
    await b.sync(); await uploaded(b, 1);
    b.reads.length = 0;
    await b.sync(); await tick();
    assert.equal(b.writes.length, 1);
    if (dates) assert.deepEqual(b.reads, [], 'nothing read when no file changed');
    // (the engine writes its settings again every 15 s, the same bytes: read, found the same, not sent)
    b.reads.length = 0; b.put('/userdata/config/settings.cfg', new TextEncoder().encode('[Video]\n'));
    await b.sync(); await tick();
    assert.equal(b.writes.length, 1, 'the same bytes: nothing sent');
    if (dates) assert.deepEqual(b.reads, ['/userdata/config/settings.cfg'], 'only the file written again');
    assert.equal(JSON.parse([...b.storage.values()][0]).dirty, false);
    // (a save changed, one removed, one added: sent)
    b.put('/userdata/saves/a.omwsave', new Uint8Array(300000).fill(8)); await b.sync(); await uploaded(b, 2);
    assert.equal(b.cloud().files.find((f) => f.path === 'saves/a.omwsave').data, Buffer.alloc(300000, 8).toString('base64'));
    b.files.delete('/userdata/saves/a.omwsave'); await b.sync(); await uploaded(b, 3);
    assert.deepEqual(b.cloud().files.map((f) => f.path), ['config/settings.cfg']);
    b.put('/userdata/saves/b.omwsave', new Uint8Array([1])); await b.sync(); await uploaded(b, 4);
    assert.deepEqual(b.cloud().files.map((f) => f.path).sort(), ['config/settings.cfg', 'saves/b.omwsave']);
  }
});

test('OpenMW sends again after a failed upload, even when nothing changed since', async () => {
  const b = browser(); await b.ready();
  b.put('/userdata/save', new Uint8Array([1])); await b.sync(); await uploaded(b, 1);
  b.put('/userdata/save', new Uint8Array([2])); b.fail(503); await b.sync();
  for (let n = 0; n < 100 && b.messages.at(-1)?.state !== 'error'; n++) await tick();
  assert.equal(b.writes.length, 2); assert.equal(JSON.parse([...b.storage.values()][0]).dirty, true, 'not on the account yet');
  b.recover(); await b.sync(); await uploaded(b, 3);
  assert.equal(b.cloud().files[0].data, 'Ag==', 'the change the failed upload had');
});

test('OpenMW keeps each file\'s date through the account: restored with it, the profile not marked undated', async () => {

  b.put('/userdata/saves/p/a.omwsave', new Uint8Array([1])); b.put('/userdata/saves/p/b.omwsave', new Uint8Array([2]));
  await b.sync(); await uploaded(b, 1);
  const sent = Object.fromEntries(b.cloud().files.map((f) => [f.path, f.mtime]));
  assert.deepEqual(sent, { 'saves/p/a.omwsave': b.times.get('/userdata/saves/p/a.omwsave'), 'saves/p/b.omwsave': b.times.get('/userdata/saves/p/b.omwsave') });

  assert.equal(c.times.get('/userdata/saves/p/a.omwsave'), 5000); assert.equal(c.times.get('/userdata/saves/p/b.omwsave'), 7000);
  assert.equal(c.window.orthrosProfileRestored, undefined, 'dates kept: not a restore\'s');
  // (an account's copy of an earlier page, without dates: the restore's dates, said)
  const d = browser([{ path: 'saves/p/a.omwsave', data: 'AQ==' }]); await d.ready();
  assert.equal(d.window.orthrosProfileRestored, true);
});
```

`tests/openmw-input-keys.test.js`:

```js
// The OpenMW players' keyboard layout (src/ports/openmw/input-keys.js, put into the engine page by src/host/openmw.js
// withInputKeys): Activate on E, Jump on Space — a saved bindings file holding Morrowind's old pair swapped once.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { swapOldPair, migrate, install, INPUT_FILE, MARK_FILE } from '../src/ports/openmw/input-keys.js';
import { withInputKeys, withProgressiveView } from '../src/host/openmw.js';
import { DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR } from '../src/host/goldsrc.js';

// (as the engine's ICS writes it through TinyXML: a control per action, named by its id; Activate 9, Jump 11)
const control = (name, binders) => binders === null
  ? `    <Control name="${name}" autoChangeDirectionOnLimitsAfterStop="false" autoReverseToInitialValue="false" initialValue="0" stepSize="MAX" stepsPerSeconds="MAX" />\n`
  : `    <Control name="${name}" autoChangeDirectionOnLimitsAfterStop="false" autoReverseToInitialValue="false" initialValue="0" stepSize="MAX" stepsPerSeconds="MAX">\n${binders.map((b) => `        ${b}\n`).join('')}        <Channel number="${name}" direction="DIRECT" />\n    </Control>\n`;
const file = ({ activate = 44, jump = 8, extra = '' } = {}) => '<Controller>\n'
  + control(1, null)
  + control(3, ['<KeyBinder key="26" direction="INCREASE" />'])
  + control(9, [`<KeyBinder key="${activate}" direction="INCREASE" />`, '<MouseButtonBinder button="4" direction="INCREASE" />'])
  + control(10, ['<KeyBinder key="9" direction="INCREASE" />'])
  + control(11, [`<KeyBinder key="${jump}" direction="INCREASE" />`])
  + control(19, ['<KeyBinder key="44" direction="DECREASE" />', '<KeyBinder key="8" direction="INCREASE" />'])
  + extra + '</Controller>\n';

test('the old pair (Activate on Space, Jump on E) swapped, and nothing else in the file', () => {
  const before = file(), after = swapOldPair(before);
  assert.equal(after, file({ activate: 8, jump: 44 }));
});

test('any other layout is the player\'s own: left as it is', () => {
  assert.equal(swapOldPair(file({ activate: 8, jump: 44 })), null, 'already the layout');
  assert.equal(swapOldPair(file({ activate: 44, jump: 20 })), null, 'Jump moved by the player');
  assert.equal(swapOldPair(file({ activate: 18, jump: 8 })), null, 'Activate moved by the player');
  assert.equal(swapOldPair(file().replace(/<Control name="11"[\s\S]*?<\/Control>\n/, '')), null, 'no Jump control');
  assert.equal(swapOldPair(file().replace('<KeyBinder key="44" direction="INCREASE" />', '')), null, 'Activate on the mouse only');
  assert.equal(swapOldPair(''), null);
  assert.equal(swapOldPair('<Controller>\n    <Control name="9" stepSize="MAX">\n'), null, 'a cut file');
});

/** An Emscripten FS of a few files (analyzePath, readFile utf8, writeFile). */
function memFs(files = {}) {
  const m = new Map(Object.entries(files));
  return {
    files: m,
    analyzePath: (p) => ({ exists: m.has(p) }),
    readFile: (p, o) => { assert.equal(o?.encoding, 'utf8'); if (!m.has(p)) throw new Error('ENOENT'); return m.get(p); },
    writeFile: (p, d) => { m.set(p, String(d)); },
  };
}

test('once per player: swapped and recorded; recorded, never again — the old pair chosen later in Options stays', () => {
  const FS = memFs({ [INPUT_FILE]: file() });
  assert.equal(migrate(FS, () => 'T'), 'swapped');
  assert.equal(FS.files.get(INPUT_FILE), file({ activate: 8, jump: 44 }));
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(FS.files.get(MARK_FILE)), { keys: 'activate-e-jump-space', result: 'swapped', at: 'T' });
  FS.files.set(INPUT_FILE, file());
  assert.equal(migrate(FS), 'done');
  assert.equal(FS.files.get(INPUT_FILE), file(), 'the player\'s choice after the swap');
});

test('a file of the player\'s own layout recorded as kept; no file: the engine\'s defaults, nothing recorded yet', () => {
  const own = memFs({ [INPUT_FILE]: file({ activate: 18, jump: 8 }) });
  assert.equal(migrate(own, () => 'T'), 'kept');
  assert.equal(own.files.get(INPUT_FILE), file({ activate: 18, jump: 8 }));
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(own.files.get(MARK_FILE)).result, 'kept');
  const fresh = memFs();
  assert.equal(migrate(fresh), 'none');
  assert.equal(fresh.files.size, 0, 'a file the engine writes later is looked at then');
  fresh.files.set(INPUT_FILE, file());
  assert.equal(migrate(fresh), 'swapped', 'an older engine\'s defaults saved meanwhile');
});

test('installed in the page: a failing file system never stops the game', () => {
  const win = {};
  install(win);
```
