`tests/openmw-lean.test.js`:

```js
// The OpenMW engine package without what a game of its own never reads (src/host/openmw-lean.js, docs/openmw.md "The
// engine's package"): the same package, the example world's and ICU's unused root copy's bytes zeroed, made once per
// content by a niced child, loaded by a game of its own, at an address every release with that package shares.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import http from 'node:http';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';
import { leanPackages, leanRanges, leanRewrites, leanIcuData, packageFiles, withLeanPackage, LEAN_RULE, ICU_DROPPED } from '../src/host/openmw-lean.js';
import { createServer } from '../src/host/server.js';
import { engineContent } from '../src/host/engine-content.js';

const LOCATE = 'locateFile: function(path){ return __ENGINE_DIR + path; }';

/**
 * An engine release with a package: /resources/a (3 bytes), /gamedata/b (5), /gamedata/c/d (4), ICU's two copies
 * (/icu/icudt68l.dat, the opened one, 2; /icudt68l.dat, 2). `o.id`: the release (eng), `o.build` its build (abc123),
 * `o.sha`: release.json says its package's sha256 (true by default; false: not said), `o.wasm` its wasm's bytes.
 */
function release(root, o = {}) {
  const id = o.id ?? 'eng', b = o.build ?? 'abc123', dir = path.join(root, 'engines', id), build = path.join(dir, 'e', b);
  fs.mkdirSync(build, { recursive: true });
  const files = [['/resources/a', 'RES'], ['/gamedata/b', 'BBBBB'], ['/gamedata/c/d', 'DDDD'], ['/icu/icudt68l.dat', 'IC'], ['/icudt68l.dat', 'IC']];
  let at = 0; const meta = [];
  for (const [name, body] of files) { meta.push(`{filename:"${name}",start:${at},end:${at + body.length}}`); at += body.length; }
  const data = files.map((f) => f[1]).join(''), sha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(build, 'openmw.data'), data);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(build, 'openmw.js'), `loadPackage({files:[${meta.join(',')}],remote_package_size:${at}})`);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(build, 'openmw.wasm'), o.wasm ?? 'wasm');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'release.json'), JSON.stringify({ runtime: 'openmw', files: [`e/${b}/openmw.data`, `e/${b}/openmw.js`, `e/${b}/openmw.wasm`],
    ...(o.sha === false ? {} : { engineFiles: { 'openmw.js': '0'.repeat(64), 'openmw.wasm': '1'.repeat(64), 'openmw.data': sha } }) }));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'index.html'), `<script>var Module = { ${LOCATE} };</script>`);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'launcher.html'), '');
  return { dir, build, sha };
}
/** The lean package of release(): the resources and the opened ICU copy, the rest zeroed. */
const LEAN = 'RES' + '\0'.repeat(9) + 'IC' + '\0\0';
const until = async (fn, ms = 20000) => { const t0 = Date.now(); for (;;) { const v = await fn(); if (v) return v; if (Date.now() - t0 > ms) throw new Error('timed out'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); } };

test('the lean package\'s ranges: the example world, and ICU\'s root copy only beside the copy the engine opens', () => {
  const js = (names) => `loadPackage({files:[${names.map((n, i) => `{filename:"${n}",start:${i * 10},end:${i * 10 + 10}}`).join(',')}]})`;
  assert.deepEqual(packageFiles(js(['/resources/a', '/gamedata/b'])).map((f) => f.name), ['/resources/a', '/gamedata/b']);
  assert.deepEqual(leanRanges(js(['/resources/a', '/gamedata/b', '/icu/icudt68l.dat', '/icudt68l.dat'])), [[10, 20], [30, 40]]);
  assert.deepEqual(leanRanges(js(['/icudt68l.dat', '/resources/a', '/icu/icudt68l.dat'])), [[0, 10]], 'by name, wherever it is');
  assert.deepEqual(leanRanges(js(['/resources/a', '/gamedata/b', '/icu/icudt68l.dat'])), [[10, 20]], 'a release without the root copy');
  assert.deepEqual(leanRanges(js(['/resources/a', '/gamedata/b', '/icudt68l.dat'])), [[10, 20]], 'the root copy alone: kept, the engine may read it');
  assert.deepEqual(leanRanges(js(['/resources/icudt68l.dat', '/gamedata/b'])), [[10, 20]]);
});

/**
 * ICU common data ("CmnD", little-endian ASCII) of `items` ([name, body] — sorted by name here, as ICU's tool writes
 * them): a 32-byte data header, the table (count, then name/data offsets from the table), the names, the items 16-aligned.
 */
function icuData(items) {
  items = [...items].sort((a, b) => (a[0] < b[0] ? -1 : 1));
  const hs = 32, header = Buffer.alloc(hs);
  header.writeUInt16LE(hs, 0); header[2] = 0xda; header[3] = 0x27; header.writeUInt16LE(20, 4); header[10] = 2; header.write('CmnD', 12, 'latin1');
  const names = Buffer.concat(items.map(([n]) => Buffer.from(`${n}\0`, 'latin1'))), tableLen = 4 + 8 * items.length;
  let data = (tableLen + names.length + 15) & ~15;
  const table = Buffer.alloc(tableLen), parts = []; let name = tableLen;
  table.writeUInt32LE(items.length, 0);
  items.forEach(([n, body], i) => {
    table.writeUInt32LE(name, 4 + 8 * i); table.writeUInt32LE(data, 8 + 8 * i); name += n.length + 1;
    const b = Buffer.alloc((body.length + 15) & ~15); Buffer.from(body, 'latin1').copy(b); parts.push(b); data += b.length;
  });
  const pad = Buffer.alloc(((tableLen + names.length + 15) & ~15) - tableLen - names.length);
  return Buffer.concat([header, table, names, pad, ...parts]);
}
/** The items of ICU common data: { name: body (to its next item's start, trailing zeros cut) } — as ICU looks them up. */
function icuItems(b) {
  const hs = b.readUInt16LE(0), n = b.readUInt32LE(hs), out = {}, at = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) at.push([hs + b.readUInt32LE(hs + 4 + 8 * i), hs + b.readUInt32LE(hs + 8 + 8 * i)]);
  at.forEach(([name, data], i) => { out[b.toString('latin1', name, b.indexOf(0, name))] = b.toString('latin1', data, i + 1 < n ? at[i + 1][1] : b.length).replace(/\0+$/, ''); });
  return out;
}
const ICU_ITEMS = [['icudt68l/root.res', 'MAIN-ROOT'], ['icudt68l/fr.res', 'FRFR'], ['icudt68l/plurals.res', 'PLURALS'], ['icudt68l/coll/root.res', 'COLLROOT'],
  ['icudt68l/coll/fr.res', 'COLLFR'], ['icudt68l/curr/fr.res', 'CURRFR'], ['icudt68l/lang/fr.res', 'LANGFR'], ['icudt68l/zone/fr.res', 'ZONEFR'],
  ['icudt68l/brkitr/word.brk', 'WORDBRK'], ['icudt68l/region/fr.res', 'REGIONFR'], ['icudt68l/unit/fr.res', 'UNITFR'], ['icudt68l/rbnf/fr.res', 'RBNFFR'],
  ['icudt68l/translit/root.res', 'TRANSLIT']];

test('rule 3: ICU\'s common data without the feature trees the engine never opens — its table rewritten, same length, kept items at their offsets', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(ICU_DROPPED, ['brkitr', 'coll', 'rbnf', 'translit', 'unit', 'zone']);
  const icu = icuData(ICU_ITEMS), lean = leanIcuData(icu);
  assert.equal(lean.length, icu.length);
  assert.deepEqual(icuItems(lean), { 'icudt68l/curr/fr.res': 'CURRFR', 'icudt68l/fr.res': 'FRFR', 'icudt68l/lang/fr.res': 'LANGFR', 'icudt68l/plurals.res': 'PLURALS',
    'icudt68l/region/fr.res': 'REGIONFR', 'icudt68l/root.res': 'MAIN-ROOT' }, 'the kept items, found by name as ICU finds them');
  const names = Object.keys(icuItems(lean)); assert.deepEqual(names, [...names].sort(), 'still sorted (binary search)');
  for (const [n, body] of ICU_ITEMS) {
    const at = icu.indexOf(Buffer.from(body, 'latin1'));
    if (ICU_DROPPED.includes(n.split('/')[1])) { assert.equal(lean.indexOf(Buffer.from(body, 'latin1')), -1, `${n}: zeroed`); assert.equal(lean.indexOf(Buffer.from(n, 'latin1')), -1, `${n}: its name too`); }
    else assert.equal(lean.toString('latin1', at, at + body.length), body, `${n}: at its offset`);
  }
  assert.ok(lean.subarray(0, 32).equals(icu.subarray(0, 32)), 'the data header as it was');
  // (not ICU's common data, or nothing to drop: left whole)
  assert.equal(leanIcuData(Buffer.from('IC')), null);
  assert.equal(leanIcuData(icuData(ICU_ITEMS.filter(([n]) => !ICU_DROPPED.includes(n.split('/')[1])))), null);
  const big = Buffer.from(icu); big[8] = 1; assert.equal(leanIcuData(big), null, 'big-endian: not this format');
  const bad = Buffer.from(icu); bad.writeUInt32LE(1e6, 32); assert.equal(leanIcuData(bad), null, 'a table past the end');
  // (the package's rewrite: the opened copy only, by name)
  const js = `loadPackage({files:[{filename:"/icu/icudt68l.dat",start:0,end:${icu.length}},{filename:"/icudt68l.dat",start:${icu.length},end:${2 * icu.length}}]})`;
  const rw = leanRewrites(js);
  assert.deepEqual(rw.map((r) => [r.start, r.end]), [[0, icu.length]]);
  assert.ok(rw[0].rewrite(icu).equals(lean)); assert.equal(rw[0].rewrite(Buffer.from('IC')).toString(), 'IC', 'not ICU data: as it is');
});

test('rule 3 made by the child: the opened ICU copy rewritten in place across read chunks, the rest as rules 1-2', async (t) => {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-lean-icu-')); t.after(() => fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  // (ICU data larger than the child's 1 MiB reads, not aligned to them: its rewrite spans several chunks)
  const filler = Array.from({ length: 300 }, (_, i) => [`icudt68l/coll/x${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}.res`, `C${i}`.repeat(1200)]);
  const icu = icuData([...ICU_ITEMS, ...filler, ...Array.from({ length: 300 }, (_, i) => [`icudt68l/l${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}.res`, `L${i}`.repeat(1200)])]);
  assert.ok(icu.length > 2 << 20);
  const files = [['/resources/a', Buffer.alloc(700001, 7)], ['/gamedata/b', Buffer.from('BBBBB')], ['/icu/icudt68l.dat', icu], ['/icudt68l.dat', icu], ['/resources/z', Buffer.from('ZZ')]];
  let at = 0; const meta = [];
  for (const [name, body] of files) { meta.push(`{filename:"${name}",start:${at},end:${at + body.length}}`); at += body.length; }
  const data = Buffer.concat(files.map((f) => f[1])), dir = path.join(root, 'e');
  fs.mkdirSync(dir); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'openmw.data'), data); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'openmw.js'), `loadPackage({files:[${meta.join(',')}]})`);
  const out = path.join(root, 'lean.br'), sha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
  const { fork } = await import('node:child_process');
  const code = await new Promise((res) => fork(new URL('../src/host/openmw-lean-worker.js', import.meta.url).pathname, [path.join(dir, 'openmw.data'), path.join(dir, 'openmw.js'), out, sha]).on('exit', res));
  assert.equal(code, 0);
  const got = zlib.brotliDecompressSync(fs.readFileSync(out)), want = Buffer.concat([files[0][1], Buffer.alloc(5), leanIcuData(icu), Buffer.alloc(icu.length), files[4][1]]);
  assert.equal(got.length, data.length); assert.ok(got.equals(want), 'the package: the opened ICU copy rewritten at its offset, the root copy and the example zeroed');
});

test('the lean package: keyed by the package\'s content, made once, loaded unless the page boots the example', async (t) => {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-lean-')); t.after(() => fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const { build, sha } = release(root);
  release(root, { id: 'eng2', build: 'def456', wasm: 'wasm2' }); // (the next release: another wasm, the same package)
  const logs = [], dir = path.join(root, 'cache'), lean = leanPackages({ dir, enginesDir: path.join(root, 'engines'), log: (m) => logs.push(m) });
  assert.equal(lean.url('eng'), null, 'not made yet: the release\'s own package meanwhile');
  assert.equal(lean.pending('eng'), true, 'being made');
  assert.equal(lean.url('eng2'), null); assert.equal(lean.pending('eng2'), true, 'the same content: the same making');
  // (the file is renamed in place before the maker's log line arrives: wait for both)
  const url = await until(() => logs.some((l) => /bytes in/.test(l)) && lean.url('eng'));
  assert.equal(lean.pending('eng'), false);
  assert.equal(lean.decoded('eng'), 16, 'the decoded bytes: the release\'s package\'s');
  assert.equal(url, `/engines/_c/${sha}/lean${LEAN_RULE}/`);
  assert.equal(lean.url('eng2'), url, 'every release with that package: one address');
  assert.equal(logs.filter((l) => /bytes in/.test(l)).length, 1, `made once: ${logs}`);
  const c = lean.contentFile(sha, `lean${LEAN_RULE}/openmw.data`);
  assert.equal(c.file, path.join(dir, '_c', sha, `lean${LEAN_RULE}`, 'openmw.data.br')); assert.equal(c.decoded, 16);
  assert.equal(zlib.brotliDecompressSync(fs.readFileSync(c.file)).toString('latin1'), LEAN, 'same size and offsets, the unread bytes zeroed');
  assert.equal(lean.size('eng'), fs.statSync(c.file).size); assert.equal(lean.size('eng2'), lean.size('eng'));
  assert.equal(lean.contentFile('f'.repeat(64), `lean${LEAN_RULE}/openmw.data`), null, 'another content: none');
  assert.equal(lean.contentFile(sha, 'lean9/openmw.data'), null); assert.equal(lean.contentFile('../x', `lean${LEAN_RULE}/openmw.data`), null);
  // (an earlier server's release-keyed address: its own file while kept, else this content's; another build's: none)
  assert.equal(lean.file('eng', `lean1/${path.basename(build)}/openmw.data`), c.file);
  const old = path.join(dir, 'eng', 'lean1', 'abc123', 'openmw.data.br'); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(old), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(old, 'old');
  assert.equal(lean.file('eng', 'lean1/abc123/openmw.data'), old);
  assert.equal(lean.file('eng', 'lean1/ffff/openmw.data'), null, 'another build: none');
  assert.equal(lean.file('eng', 'e/abc123/openmw.data'), null);
  assert.equal(lean.url('other'), null);
  // (the page: the lean package for openmw.data unless ?nomw; the rest from the release)
  const page = withLeanPackage(`var Module = { ${LOCATE} };`, url);
  const locate = (search) => new Function('window', 'location', '__ENGINE_DIR', `${page.replace('var Module =', 'return')}`)({}, { search }, '/engines/eng/e/abc123/').locateFile;
  assert.equal(locate('?src=hosted')('openmw.data'), `${url}openmw.data`);
  assert.equal(locate('?src=hosted')('openmw.wasm'), '/engines/eng/e/abc123/openmw.wasm');
  assert.equal(locate('?nomw')('openmw.data'), '/engines/eng/e/abc123/openmw.data', 'the example world: the whole package');
  assert.equal(withLeanPackage('x', null), 'x');
});

test('the lean package: keyed by the package\'s bytes as hashed, said or not by the release; a making that fails makes nothing', async (t) => {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-lean-hash-')); t.after(() => fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const { sha } = release(root, { sha: false });
  const lean = leanPackages({ dir: path.join(root, 'cache'), enginesDir: path.join(root, 'engines') });
  assert.equal(lean.url('eng'), null); assert.equal(lean.pending('eng'), true, 'hashed, then made');
  assert.equal(await until(() => lean.url('eng')), `/engines/_c/${sha}/lean${LEAN_RULE}/`);
  // (a release.json whose sha256 is not its package's — a package replaced since —: keyed by what the package holds,
  // the mismatch logged by the shared hashing, engine-content.js)
  const { dir } = release(root, { id: 'bad', build: 'bad000' });
  const rj = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'release.json'), 'utf8')); rj.engineFiles['openmw.data'] = 'e'.repeat(64);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'release.json'), JSON.stringify(rj));
  const logs = [], bad = leanPackages({ dir: path.join(root, 'cache2'), enginesDir: path.join(root, 'engines'), log: (m) => logs.push(m) });
  assert.equal(bad.url('bad'), null); assert.equal(bad.pending('bad'), true);
  assert.equal(await until(() => bad.url('bad')), `/engines/_c/${sha}/lean${LEAN_RULE}/`, 'never under the sha256 it says');
  assert.match(logs.join('\n'), new RegExp(`openmw.data: sha256 ${sha}, not the ${'e'.repeat(64)}`));
  assert.ok(!fs.existsSync(path.join(root, 'cache2', '_c', 'e'.repeat(64))));
  // (a making that fails — its file cannot be written —: nothing given, nothing pending, not tried again this run)
  const cache3 = path.join(root, 'cache3'); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(cache3, '_c', sha, `lean${LEAN_RULE}`, 'openmw.data.br'), { recursive: true });
  const logs3 = [], failing = leanPackages({ dir: cache3, enginesDir: path.join(root, 'engines'), log: (m) => logs3.push(m) });
  failing.url('eng'); await until(() => /failed/.test(logs3.join('\n')));
  assert.equal(failing.url('eng'), null); assert.equal(failing.pending('eng'), false);
});

test('while the current rule\'s lean package is made, or after its making failed: the newest one already on disk', async (t) => {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-lean-old-')); t.after(() => fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const { sha } = release(root);
  const put = (f, body) => { fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(f), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(f, body); return f; };
  // (an earlier server's release-keyed lean1: given at once, while this content's lean package is made; then this one)
  const dir = path.join(root, 'cache'), old = put(path.join(dir, 'eng', 'lean1', 'abc123', 'openmw.data.br'), 'old-lean1');
  const lean = leanPackages({ dir, enginesDir: path.join(root, 'engines') });
  assert.equal(lean.url('eng'), '/engines/eng/lean1/abc123/', 'the earlier server\'s file meanwhile');
  assert.equal(lean.pending('eng'), false, 'a package to prepare: the one the page asks for');
  assert.equal(lean.size('eng'), fs.statSync(old).size);
  assert.equal(lean.file('eng', 'lean1/abc123/openmw.data'), old, 'served at that address');
  assert.equal(await until(() => (lean.url('eng') ?? '').includes('/_c/') && lean.url('eng')), `/engines/_c/${sha}/lean${LEAN_RULE}/`, 'then this content\'s');
  // (an earlier rule's file of this content: preferred to the release-keyed one)
  if (LEAN_RULE > 1) {
    const dir2 = path.join(root, 'cache2'); put(path.join(dir2, 'eng', 'lean1', 'abc123', 'openmw.data.br'), 'old');
    const prev = put(path.join(dir2, '_c', sha, `lean${LEAN_RULE - 1}`, 'openmw.data.br'), 'prev-rule');
    // (its package hashed already — the server's engine files by content, shared —: this content's files at once)
    const content = engineContent({ enginesDir: path.join(root, 'engines') }); assert.equal(await content.hashed('eng', 'e/abc123/openmw.data'), sha);
    const l2 = leanPackages({ dir: dir2, enginesDir: path.join(root, 'engines'), content });
    assert.equal(l2.url('eng'), `/engines/_c/${sha}/lean${LEAN_RULE - 1}/`); assert.equal(l2.size('eng'), fs.statSync(prev).size);
    assert.equal(l2.contentFile(sha, `lean${LEAN_RULE - 1}/openmw.data`).file, prev);
    await until(() => l2.url('eng') === `/engines/_c/${sha}/lean${LEAN_RULE}/`);
  }
  // (a making that fails — its file cannot be written —: the old file for the rest of the run)
  release(root, { id: 'bad', build: 'bad000' });
  const dir3 = path.join(root, 'cache3'); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir3, '_c', sha, `lean${LEAN_RULE}`, 'openmw.data.br'), { recursive: true });
  const logs = [], l3 = leanPackages({ dir: dir3, enginesDir: path.join(root, 'engines'), log: (m) => logs.push(m) });
  assert.equal(l3.url('bad'), null); assert.equal(l3.pending('bad'), true);
  await until(() => /failed/.test(logs.join('\n')));
  assert.equal(l3.url('bad'), null, 'failed, nothing older: the release\'s own package'); assert.equal(l3.pending('bad'), false);
  const kept = put(path.join(dir3, 'bad', 'lean1', 'bad000', 'openmw.data.br'), 'kept');
  assert.equal(l3.url('bad'), '/engines/bad/lean1/bad000/'); assert.equal(l3.size('bad'), fs.statSync(kept).size); assert.equal(l3.pending('bad'), false);
  // (a release that does not say its sha256, being hashed: the release-keyed file needs only the build)
  release(root, { id: 'unsaid', build: 'aaa111', sha: false }); // (the same package: the same content once hashed)
  const dir4 = path.join(root, 'cache4'); put(path.join(dir4, 'unsaid', 'lean1', 'aaa111', 'openmw.data.br'), 'x');
  const l4 = leanPackages({ dir: dir4, enginesDir: path.join(root, 'engines') });
  assert.equal(l4.url('unsaid'), '/engines/unsaid/lean1/aaa111/'); assert.equal(l4.pending('unsaid'), false);
  await until(() => l4.url('unsaid') === `/engines/_c/${sha}/lean${LEAN_RULE}/`);
});

test('the server makes and serves the lean package of a game of its own, not of the example world', async (t) => {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-lean-srv-')); t.after(() => fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const { build, sha } = release(root);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(build, 'openmw.wasm.br'), zlib.brotliCompressSync(Buffer.from('wasm')));
  const games = path.join(root, 'games');
  const mk = (id, openmw) => { const g = path.join(games, id); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(g, 'base'), { recursive: true }); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(g, 'versions/1'), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(g, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, id, name: id, defaultVersion: `${id}-1`, defaults: { runtime: 'openmw' }, versions: [{ id: `${id}-1`, dir: '1', version: '1', openmw: { engine: 'eng', ...openmw } }] })); return g; };
  const game = mk('game', { files: ['Game.esm'] });
  mk('demo', { example: true, files: [] });
  const server = createServer({ gamesDir: games, enginesDir: path.join(root, 'engines'), brCacheDir: path.join(root, 'brcache'), brCacheLog: () => {} });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(game, 'base/Game.esm'), 'esm'); // (installed once the server runs: its lean package not started yet)
  await new Promise((r) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r)); t.after(() => new Promise((r) => { server.closeAllConnections(); server.close(r); }));
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`, page = (id) => fetch(`${base}/ports/openmw/${id}-1/app/index.html`).then((r) => r.text());
  // (a card's engine files: not the release's own package while the lean one is being made — "Prepare" would cache
  // what the page stops asking for —, the lean one once made)
  await fetch(`${base}/api/prefetch/game-1`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ session: 's', reads: [['Game.esm', 0, 3, 5]], mark: { kind: 'playable' } }) });
  const engineFiles = async () => (await (await fetch(`${base}/api/manifests`)).json()).find((m) => m.name === 'game-1').launch.engineFiles;
  // (the release's files by their content once hashed — not by the sha256s its release.json says: engine-content.js —;
  // never the release's own package)
  const hash = (f) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(path.join(build, f))).digest('hex');
  const js = `/engines/_c/${hash('openmw.js')}/openmw.js`, wasm = `/engines/_c/${hash('openmw.wasm')}/openmw.wasm`;
  const first = await until(async () => { const f = await engineFiles(); return f.includes(js) && f.includes(wasm) && f; });
  assert.ok(!first.some((u) => /openmw\.data$/.test(u) && !u.includes('/lean')), `its making just started: ${first}`);
  const leanFile = path.join(root, 'brcache', 'engines', '_c', sha, `lean${LEAN_RULE}`, 'openmw.data.br'), leanUrl = `/engines/_c/${sha}/lean${LEAN_RULE}/openmw.data`;
  await until(() => fs.existsSync(leanFile));
  // (a server started with the game installed: made from its start, before any card or page asked for it)
  const other = createServer({ gamesDir: games, enginesDir: path.join(root, 'engines'), brCacheDir: path.join(root, 'brcache2'), brCacheLog: () => {} });
  t.after(() => other.close());
  await until(() => fs.existsSync(path.join(root, 'brcache2', 'engines', '_c', sha, `lean${LEAN_RULE}`, 'openmw.data.br')));
  let html = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 400 && !html.includes('lean'); i++) { html = await page('game'); if (!html.includes('lean')) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); }
  assert.match(html, new RegExp(`/engines/_c/${sha}/lean${LEAN_RULE}/`));
  assert.deepEqual(await engineFiles(), [leanUrl, js, wasm]);
  assert.ok(!(await page('demo')).includes('lean'), 'the example world loads the whole package');
  const r = await fetch(base + leanUrl, { headers: { 'Accept-Encoding': 'br' } });
  assert.equal(r.status, 200); assert.equal(r.headers.get('content-encoding'), 'br');
  assert.equal(r.headers.get('cache-control'), 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable');
  // (no Content-Length — Emscripten counts the decoded bytes against it —; the sizes said for "Prepare"'s count)
  assert.equal(r.headers.get('content-length'), null);
  assert.equal(r.headers.get('x-orthros-wire-length'), String(fs.statSync(leanFile).size)); assert.equal(r.headers.get('x-orthros-decoded-length'), '16');
  assert.equal(Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer()).toString('latin1'), LEAN, 'decoded by the client');
  assert.equal((await fetch(base + leanUrl, { headers: { 'Accept-Encoding': 'identity' } }).then((x) => x.arrayBuffer())).byteLength, 16, 'without brotli: decoded by the server');
  // (a range asked: the brotli body whole, as without one — not the package decoded here, ~26 times its bytes live)
  const ranged = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => http.get(base + leanUrl, { headers: { 'Accept-Encoding': 'br', Range: 'bytes=0-0' } }, (res) => {
    const parts = []; res.on('data', (d) => parts.push(d)); res.on('end', () => resolve({ res, body: Buffer.concat(parts) }));
  }).on('error', reject));
  assert.equal(ranged.res.statusCode, 200); assert.equal(ranged.res.headers['content-encoding'], 'br');
  assert.deepEqual(ranged.body, fs.readFileSync(leanFile), 'the brotli file as it is');
  assert.equal((await fetch(`${base}/engines/_c/${'f'.repeat(64)}/lean${LEAN_RULE}/openmw.data`)).status, 404, 'another content');
  assert.equal((await fetch(`${base}/engines/_c/${sha}/lean${LEAN_RULE}/openmw.wasm`)).status, 404);
  // (the release-keyed address a page opened before gave: still answered, another build's not)
  const old = await fetch(`${base}/engines/eng/lean1/abc123/openmw.data`, { headers: { 'Accept-Encoding': 'br' } });
  assert.equal(old.status, 200); assert.equal(old.headers.get('x-orthros-decoded-length'), '16'); assert.equal(Buffer.from(await old.arrayBuffer()).toString('latin1'), LEAN);
  assert.equal((await fetch(`${base}/engines/eng/lean1/ffff/openmw.data`)).status, 404);
  // (an engine file's brotli sibling, and the port's own .br path: the same answer)
  for (const u of ['/engines/eng/e/abc123/openmw.wasm', '/ports/openmw/game-1/app/e/abc123/openmw.wasm.br']) {
    const w = await fetch(base + u, { headers: { 'Accept-Encoding': 'br' } });
    assert.equal(w.headers.get('content-encoding'), 'br', u); assert.equal(w.headers.get('content-length'), null, u);
    assert.equal(w.headers.get('x-orthros-wire-length'), String(fs.statSync(path.join(build, 'openmw.wasm.br')).size), u);
    assert.equal(w.headers.get('x-orthros-decoded-length'), '4', u); assert.equal(await w.text(), 'wasm', u);
  }
});
```

`tests/openmw-overlay-check.test.js`:

```js
// tools/openmw/overlay-check.mjs: an overlay of the engine's built-in scripts against the release's packed original,
// every overlay's installed file against its sha256.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { checkOverlays } from '../tools/openmw/overlay-check.mjs';

const sha = (s) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex');

test('overlays of built-in scripts: refused when the release changed the original; installed files checked', (t) => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-overlay-check-'));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const release = (id, text) => {
    const e = path.join(dir, 'engines', id, 'e', 'abc'); fs.mkdirSync(e, { recursive: true });
    const pad = 'xxxx', data = pad + text + 'tail';
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(e, 'openmw.data'), data);
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(e, 'openmw.js'), `loadPackage({files:[{filename:"/resources/vfs/scripts/a.lua",start:${pad.length},end:${pad.length + text.length}},{filename:"/x",start:0,end:4}]})`);
  };
  release('r1', 'original'); release('r2', 'changed');
  const game = path.join(dir, 'game'), file = 'scripts/a.lua', over = 'overlay';
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(game, 'versions', 'en', 'mods', 'p', 'scripts'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(game, 'versions', 'en', 'mods', 'p', file), over);
  const write = (o) => fs.writeFileSync(path.join(game, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ versions: [{ id: 'v', dir: 'en', openmw: { engine: 'r1',
    mods: [{ id: 'm', installed: true, parts: [{ dir: 'mods/p' }], overlays: [{ of: 'openmw built-in', file, originalSha256: sha('original'), sha256: sha(over), ...o }] }] } }] }));
  const enginesDir = path.join(dir, 'engines'), man = path.join(game, 'manifest.json');
  write({});
  assert.deepEqual(checkOverlays(man, { enginesDir }), []);
  assert.match(checkOverlays(man, { enginesDir, engine: 'r2' })[0], /r2's built-in is .* regenerate or withdraw/, 'the next release changed the original');
  write({ file: 'scripts/b.lua' });
  assert.ok(checkOverlays(man, { enginesDir }).some((m) => /no longer has this built-in file/.test(m)));
  write({ sha256: sha('other') });
  assert.match(checkOverlays(man, { enginesDir })[0], /installed file differs/);
});
```

`tests/openmw-place-lead.test.js`:

```js
// The OpenMW page's guesses of the player's next place in play (src/ports/openmw/place-lead.js): the next exterior row
// after a crossing (no door guess), a guess's entries (meshes and terrain only, bounded) and the session's bounds.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { LEAD, parseCell, nextRow, leadEntries, createLead } from '../src/ports/openmw/place-lead.js';

test('place-lead: the next row, the same way as the last crossing', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(parseCell('-2 -9'), [-2, -9]); assert.equal(parseCell(''), null); assert.equal(parseCell('-2,-9'), null);
  assert.equal(nextRow('-2 -9', '-2 -8'), '-2,-7');
  assert.equal(nextRow('0 0', '-1 -1'), '-2,-2', 'diagonal');
  assert.equal(nextRow('3 1', '4 1'), '5,1');
  // (no neighbour's step: a teleport, a door out, the first report)
  for (const [a, b] of [['-2 -9', '-2 -7'], ['', '-3 -2'], [null, '-3 -2'], ['-2 -9', '-2 -9'], ['-2 -9', '']]) assert.equal(nextRow(a, b), null, `${a} -> ${b}`);
});

test('place-lead: a guess takes its set\'s meshes and terrain, within its bytes, the tree\'s files only', () => {
  const sizes = { 'Morrowind.bsa': 1e9, 'Meshes/a.nif': 5000, 'Textures/t.dds': 4e6 };
  const size = (p) => sizes[p] ?? null;
  const doc = { list: [['Morrowind.bsa', 1000, 3000, 'meshes'], ['Textures/t.dds', 0, -1, 'textures'], ['Meshes/a.nif', 0, -1, 'meshes'], ['gone.nif', 0, 10, 'meshes'], ['Morrowind.bsa', 9000, 9500, 'terrain']] };
  assert.deepEqual(leadEntries(doc, { size }), { entries: [{ path: 'Morrowind.bsa', off: 1000, len: 2000 }, { path: 'Meshes/a.nif', off: 0, len: -1 }, { path: 'Morrowind.bsa', off: 9000, len: 500 }], bytes: 7500 });
  // (cut once the next would pass the bound, the order kept; a bare list as well)
  assert.deepEqual(leadEntries(doc.list, { size, bytes: 6000 }).entries.map((e) => e.path), ['Morrowind.bsa']);
  assert.deepEqual(leadEntries(null, { size }), { entries: [], bytes: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual(LEAD.kinds, ['meshes', 'terrain'], 'never textures');
});

test('place-lead: each place guessed once, the session bounded', () => {
  const L = createLead();
  const at = (cell, door = '') => L.look({ 'orthros.cell': cell, 'orthros.door': door });
  assert.deepEqual(at('-2 -9'), [], 'the first report: no direction yet');
  assert.deepEqual(at('-2 -8'), ['-2,-7']);
  assert.deepEqual(at('-2 -8'), [], 'the same cell: nothing new');
  // (no door guess: under a second of warning, and every door passed would spend the bounds)
  assert.deepEqual(at('-2 -8', 'seyda neen, arrille\'s tradehouse'), []);
  assert.deepEqual(at(''), [], 'inside: no row');
  assert.deepEqual(at('-2 -8'), [], 'out again: a door is no neighbour\'s step');
  assert.deepEqual(at('-2 -7'), ['-2,-6']);
  assert.deepEqual(at('-2 -8'), ['-2,-9']);
  assert.deepEqual(at('-2 -7'), [], 'that row asked once');
  L.spent(1e6);
  assert.deepEqual(L.snapshot(), { guessed: 3, bytes: 1e6, last: ['-2,-7', '-2,-6', '-2,-9'] });
  const tight = createLead({ ...LEAD, places: 1 });
  tight.look({ 'orthros.cell': '0 0' }); assert.deepEqual(tight.look({ 'orthros.cell': '0 1' }), ['0,2']);
  assert.deepEqual(tight.look({ 'orthros.cell': '0 2' }), [], 'past the places bound');
  const spent = createLead({ ...LEAD, sessionBytes: 10 });
  spent.spent(10); spent.look({ 'orthros.cell': '0 0' });
  assert.deepEqual(spent.look({ 'orthros.cell': '0 1' }), [], 'past the session\'s bytes');
});
```

`tests/openmw-player-defaults.test.js`:

```js
// A version's defaults for the player's own Lua settings (tools/openmw/player-defaults.mjs): one generated Orthros data
// root whose PLAYER script gives each value once per player profile, over the engine's registered default only, records
// it, and does nothing on a native simulation peer; the manifest records the root, its entries and its policy.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { installPlayerDefaults, playerDefaultsEntries, playerDefaultsScript, playerDefaultsWithdrawalScript, withdrawPlayerDefaults } from '../tools/openmw/player-defaults.mjs';
import { openmwProblem } from '../src/host/openmw.js';

const DEFAULTS = [
  { group: 'SettingsOMWControls', key: 'alwaysRun', value: true, default: false },
  { group: 'SettingsOMWCameraThirdPerson', key: 'maxDistance', value: 400, default: 800 },
  { group: 'SettingsMyMod', key: 'mode', value: 'modern', default: 'classic' },
];

function fixture(t) {
  const game = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-player-defaults-'));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(game, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const data = path.join(game, 'versions/one/mods/input-0'); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(data, 'scripts/orthros_qol'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(data, 'Input.omwscripts'), 'PLAYER: scripts/orthros_qol/input_defaults.lua\n');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(data, 'scripts/orthros_qol/input_defaults.lua'), '-- earlier defaults\n');
  const spec = { versions: [{ id: 'one', dir: 'one', openmw: { engine: 'engine', files: ['Game.esm'], mods: [
    { id: 'input', name: 'Input', installed: true, parts: [{ dir: 'mods/input-0', sentinel: 'Input.omwscripts', plugins: ['Input.omwscripts'], archives: [] }] },
  ] } }] };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(game, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify(spec));
  return { game, data };
}

test('player defaults: checked entries, plain Lua values only', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(playerDefaultsEntries(DEFAULTS), DEFAULTS);
  for (const bad of [[], {}, [{ group: 'Settings X', key: 'a', value: true, default: false }], [{ group: 'S', key: "a'", value: true, default: false }],
    [{ group: 'S', key: 'a', value: true }], [{ group: 'S', key: 'a', value: "x'); os.exit() --", default: 'y' }], [{ group: 'S', key: 'a', value: { x: 1 }, default: 1 }],
    [{ group: 'S', key: 'a', value: 1e21, default: 0 }], [{ group: 'S', key: 'a', value: true, default: true }],
    [{ group: 'S', key: 'a', value: true, default: false }, { group: 'S', key: 'a', value: true, default: false }]])
    assert.throws(() => playerDefaultsEntries(bad), Error, JSON.stringify(bad));
  const lua = playerDefaultsScript(DEFAULTS, 'OrthrosPlayerDefaults');
  assert.match(lua, /^-- Generated by Orthros/);
  assert.match(lua, /if ok and mp\.isSystem and mp\.isSystem\(\) then return \{\} end/, 'nothing on a simulation peer');
  assert.ok(lua.includes("    { 'SettingsOMWControls', 'alwaysRun', true, false },\n"));
  assert.ok(lua.includes("    { 'SettingsOMWCameraThirdPerson', 'maxDistance', 400, 800 },\n"));
  assert.ok(lua.includes("    { 'SettingsMyMod', 'mode', 'modern', 'classic' },\n"));
  assert.ok(lua.includes("storage.playerSection('OrthrosPlayerDefaults')"));
  // (given only over the registered default or an unset value, then recorded whatever the value: never again; the
  // record says which: given, or the player's value kept)
  assert.match(lua, /if not records:get\(record\) then[\s\S]*if current == nil or current == d\[4\] then[\s\S]*records:set\(record, 'given'\)\n            else\n                records:set\(record, 'kept'\)/);
  assert.ok(!lua.includes('records:set(record, true)'));
  assert.match(lua, /engineHandlers = \{ onInit = apply, onLoad = apply \}/);
});

test('player defaults: one generated root, the earlier roots and their records untouched, recorded in the manifest', (t) => {
  const f = fixture(t), before = fs.readFileSync(path.join(f.data, 'scripts/orthros_qol/input_defaults.lua'));
  assert.deepEqual(installPlayerDefaults(f.game, 'one', DEFAULTS),
    { plugin: 'Orthros Player Defaults.omwscripts', script: 'scripts/orthros_player_defaults/player.lua', records: 'OrthrosPlayerDefaults', entries: 3 });
  const root = path.join(f.game, 'versions/one/mods/orthros-player-defaults-0');
  assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'Orthros Player Defaults.omwscripts'), 'utf8'), 'PLAYER: scripts/orthros_player_defaults/player.lua\n');
  assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'scripts/orthros_player_defaults/player.lua'), 'utf8'), playerDefaultsScript(DEFAULTS, 'OrthrosPlayerDefaults'));
  assert.equal(fs.statSync(path.join(root, 'scripts/orthros_player_defaults/player.lua')).mode & 0o777, 0o644);
  assert.deepEqual(fs.readFileSync(path.join(f.data, 'scripts/orthros_qol/input_defaults.lua')), before);
  const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(f.game, 'manifest.json'))).versions[0].openmw;
  assert.equal(openmwProblem(config), null);
  const mod = config.mods.at(-1);
  assert.equal(mod.id, 'orthros-player-defaults');
  assert.deepEqual(mod.playerDefaults, DEFAULTS);
  assert.match(mod.generatedSha256, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
  assert.deepEqual(mod.parts, [{ dir: 'mods/orthros-player-defaults-0', source: 'generated player settings defaults', sentinel: 'Orthros Player Defaults.omwscripts',
    plugins: ['Orthros Player Defaults.omwscripts'], archives: [], files: 2, bytes: mod.parts[0].bytes }]);
  assert.deepEqual(config.mods[0].parts[0].plugins, ['Input.omwscripts'], 'the earlier root keeps its plugin');
  // (never twice, never over an existing root; a second root with its own id, plugin and records)
  const manifest = fs.readFileSync(path.join(f.game, 'manifest.json'));
  assert.throws(() => installPlayerDefaults(f.game, 'one', DEFAULTS), /already installed/);
  assert.throws(() => installPlayerDefaults(f.game, 'one', DEFAULTS, { id: 'Bad Id' }), /Invalid mod id/);
  assert.deepEqual(fs.readFileSync(path.join(f.game, 'manifest.json')), manifest);
  assert.deepEqual(installPlayerDefaults(f.game, 'one', [{ group: 'SettingsMyMod', key: 'extra', value: 2, default: 1 }], { id: 'orthros-player-defaults-2' }),
    { plugin: 'Orthros Player Defaults 2.omwscripts', script: 'scripts/orthros_player_defaults_2/player.lua', records: 'OrthrosPlayerDefaults2', entries: 1 });
});

test('player defaults: withdrawn, the registered default back once where the value was given and is still held', (t) => {
  const lua = playerDefaultsWithdrawalScript(DEFAULTS, 'OrthrosPlayerDefaults');
  assert.match(lua, /^-- Generated by Orthros \(tools\/openmw\/player-defaults\.mjs --withdraw\)/);
  assert.match(lua, /if ok and mp\.isSystem and mp\.isSystem\(\) then return \{\} end/, 'nothing on a simulation peer');
  assert.ok(lua.includes("storage.playerSection('OrthrosPlayerDefaultsRestored')"));
  assert.ok(lua.includes("    { 'SettingsMyMod', 'mode', 'modern', 'classic' },\n"));
  // (only a record saying given - or the older true - and never restored; only over the value it gave)
  assert.match(lua, /if \(done == true or done == 'given'\) and not restored:get\(record\) then[\s\S]*if section:get\(d\[2\]\) == d\[3\] then[\s\S]*section:set\(d\[2\], d\[4\]\)[\s\S]*restored:set\(record, true\)/);

  const f = fixture(t);
  installPlayerDefaults(f.game, 'one', DEFAULTS);
  const root = path.join(f.game, 'versions/one/mods/orthros-player-defaults-0'), script = path.join(root, 'scripts/orthros_player_defaults/player.lua');
  const before = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(f.game, 'manifest.json'))).versions[0].openmw.mods.at(-1);
  assert.throws(() => withdrawPlayerDefaults(f.game, 'one', { id: 'orthros-player-defaults-2' }), /not installed/);
  const out = withdrawPlayerDefaults(f.game, 'one', { because: 'test' });
  assert.equal(out.withdrawn, 3);
  assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(script, 'utf8'), lua);
  assert.equal(fs.statSync(script).mode & 0o777, 0o644);
  const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(f.game, 'manifest.json'))).versions[0].openmw;
  assert.equal(openmwProblem(config), null);
  const mod = config.mods.at(-1);
  assert.deepEqual(mod.playerDefaults, []);
  assert.deepEqual(mod.withdrawn.entries, DEFAULTS);
  assert.equal(mod.withdrawn.because, 'test');
  assert.equal(mod.withdrawn.generatedSha256Before, before.generatedSha256);
  assert.equal(out.generatedSha256, mod.generatedSha256);
  assert.notEqual(mod.generatedSha256, before.generatedSha256);
  assert.equal(mod.parts[0].bytes, Buffer.byteLength('PLAYER: scripts/orthros_player_defaults/player.lua\n') + Buffer.byteLength(lua));
  // (once: nothing left to withdraw; and never over files that are not the generated ones)
  assert.throws(() => withdrawPlayerDefaults(f.game, 'one'), /no entries/);
  installPlayerDefaults(f.game, 'one', [{ group: 'SettingsMyMod', key: 'extra', value: 2, default: 1 }], { id: 'orthros-player-defaults-2' });
  fs.appendFileSync(path.join(f.game, 'versions/one/mods/orthros-player-defaults-2-0/scripts/orthros_player_defaults_2/player.lua'), '-- edited\n');
  assert.throws(() => withdrawPlayerDefaults(f.game, 'one', { id: 'orthros-player-defaults-2' }), /differ from the generated/);
});
```

`tests/openmw-save-place.test.js`:

```js
// Where an OpenMW saved game loads (src/ports/openmw/save-place.js, docs/openmw.md "Anticipated places"): a save made
// here byte for byte as the engine writes one (components/esm3: TES3 with FORM, SAVE, the world's records, PLAY with the
// player's cell just before LKEP), its place read as the engine's announced reads name it; the save the player most
// likely loads chosen (the remembered place, the newest, the most played after a restore from the account).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { parseSave, listSaves, chooseSave, labelPlace, placeHint, engineLower, SAVES_DIRS } from '../src/ports/openmw/save-place.js';

const enc = (s) => new TextEncoder().encode(s);
const u32 = (n) => { const b = new Uint8Array(4); new DataView(b.buffer).setUint32(0, n, true); return b; };
const i32 = (n) => { const b = new Uint8Array(4); new DataView(b.buffer).setInt32(0, n, true); return b; };
const f64 = (n) => { const b = new Uint8Array(8); new DataView(b.buffer).setFloat64(0, n, true); return b; };
const cat = (...parts) => { const out = new Uint8Array(parts.reduce((n, p) => n + p.length, 0)); let at = 0; for (const p of parts) { out.set(p, at); at += p.length; } return out; };
const sub = (name, data) => cat(enc(name), u32(data.length), data);
const rec = (name, ...subs) => { const body = cat(...subs); return cat(enc(name), u32(body.length), u32(0), u32(0), body); };
/** a RefId as writeHNRefId writes it (format > 23): an exterior cell, or an unsized string */
const exterior = (x, y) => cat(Uint8Array.of(6), i32(x), i32(y));
const stringId = (s) => cat(Uint8Array.of(2), enc(s));

/** A save of format `format` whose player stands in `cell` (a PLAY NAME RefId; up to 26: [SPAC, CIDX?]). */
function save({ format = 38, cell, time = 12.5, player = 'Nérévarine', cellName = "Ald'ruhn" }) {
  const play = format > 26
    ? [sub('NAME', stringId('player')), sub('DATA', new Uint8Array(24)), sub('NAME', cell), sub('LKEP', new Uint8Array(8)), sub('CURD', i32(0))]
    : [sub('NAME', enc('player')), sub('DATA', new Uint8Array(24)), ...cell, sub('LKEP', new Uint8Array(8))];
  return cat(
    rec('TES3', ...(format ? [sub('FORM', u32(format))] : []), sub('HEDR', new Uint8Array(300))),
    rec('SAVE', sub('PLNA', enc(player)), sub('PLLE', i32(7)), sub('PLCL', stringId('warrior')), sub('PLCE', enc(cellName)),
      sub('TSTM', new Uint8Array(12)), sub('TIME', f64(time)), sub('DESC', enc('Quicksave')), sub('DEPE', enc('Morrowind.esm')),
      sub('DEPE', enc('Tribunal.esm')), sub('SCRN', new Uint8Array(5000)), sub('CDAY', i32(3)), sub('CHLT', new Uint8Array(4)), sub('MHLT', new Uint8Array(4))),
    rec('GAME', sub('GMDT', new Uint8Array(40))),
    rec('JOUR', sub('JEDA', enc('x'.repeat(3000)))),
    // (a record named PLAY's neighbours: a cell's own NAME subrecords are no player's cell)
    rec('CELL', sub('NAME', stringId('Balmora')), sub('DATA', new Uint8Array(12))),
    rec('PLAY', ...play),
    rec('CSTA', sub('NAME', exterior(9, 9))),
  );
}

test('the place of a save: an exterior cell \'x,y\', an interior\'s id lowercased (ASCII, as the engine), the header\'s fields', () => {
  const ext = parseSave(save({ cell: exterior(-2, 6) }));
  assert.equal(ext.place, '-2,6');
  assert.equal(ext.format, 38);
  assert.equal(ext.player, 'Nérévarine');
  assert.equal(ext.level, 7);
  assert.equal(ext.cellName, "Ald'ruhn", 'the display name (not the key)');
  assert.equal(ext.timePlayed, 12.5);
  assert.equal(ext.desc, 'Quicksave');
  assert.deepEqual(ext.contentFiles, ['Morrowind.esm', 'Tribunal.esm']);
  assert.equal(parseSave(save({ cell: exterior(-12345, 0) })).place, '-12345,0');
  assert.equal(parseSave(save({ cell: stringId("Ald'ruhn, Maison des Guildes ÉCLAT") })).place, "ald'ruhn, maison des guildes Éclat", 'ASCII letters only, as Misc::StringUtils::lowerCase');
  assert.equal(parseSave(save({ cell: cat(Uint8Array.of(1), u32(5), enc('Vivec'), enc('junk')) })).place, 'vivec', 'a sized string id');
  assert.equal(parseSave(save({ cell: Uint8Array.of(0) })).place, null, 'an empty id: no place');
  assert.equal(engineLower('ABC é Z'), 'abc é z');
});

test('an older save (format 26 and below): the old CellId (SPAC, CIDX for an exterior)', () => {
  assert.equal(parseSave(save({ format: 21, cell: [sub('SPAC', enc('sys::default')), sub('CIDX', cat(i32(3), i32(-7)))] })).place, '3,-7');
  assert.equal(parseSave(save({ format: 0, cell: [sub('SPAC', enc('Seyda Neen, Census and Excise Office'))] })).place, 'seyda neen, census and excise office');
});

test('not a save: another file, a header alone, cut short', () => {
  assert.equal(parseSave(enc('not a save at all, not at all, not at all')), null);
  assert.equal(parseSave(new Uint8Array(4)), null);
  const full = save({ cell: exterior(1, 2) });
  assert.equal(parseSave(full.subarray(0, 40)), null, 'TES3 alone: no SAVE');
  const cut = parseSave(full.subarray(0, full.length - 80));
  assert.ok(cut && cut.player === 'Nérévarine' && cut.place === null, 'PLAY cut short: the header, no place');
  // (a record whose size runs past the file: the walk stops)
  const bad = full.slice(), jour = Buffer.from(bad).indexOf('JOUR');
  new DataView(bad.buffer).setUint32(jour + 4, 0x7fffffff, true);
  assert.equal(parseSave(bad).place, null);
});

/** Emscripten's FS, as far as listSaves reads it: { '/dir/char/file': { bytes, mtime } } */
function fakeFS(files) {
  const dirs = new Map();
  for (const p of Object.keys(files)) {
    const parts = p.split('/');
    for (let i = 1; i < parts.length; i++) {
      const d = parts.slice(0, i).join('/') || '/';
      if (!dirs.has(d)) dirs.set(d, new Set());
      dirs.get(d).add(parts[i]);
    }
  }
  return {
    reads: 0,
    readdir(d) { const s = dirs.get(d); if (!s) throw new Error('ENOENT'); return ['.', '..', ...s]; },
    stat(p) { const f = files[p]; if (!f) return { mtime: new Date(0) }; return { mtime: new Date(f.mtime) }; },
    readFile(p) { this.reads++; return files[p].bytes; },
  };
}

test('the saves of every character in both folders, each parsed; those written after a date only', () => {
  const [a, b] = SAVES_DIRS;
  const fs = fakeFS({
    [`${a}/player/Quicksave.omwsave`]: { bytes: save({ cell: exterior(-2, 6), time: 10 }), mtime: 1000 },
    [`${a}/player/notes.txt`]: { bytes: enc('x'), mtime: 5000 },
    [`${b}/Nerevar/Autosave.omwsave`]: { bytes: save({ cell: stringId('Vivec, Arena') }), mtime: 3000 },
    [`${b}/Nerevar/broken.omwsave`]: { bytes: enc('nothing'), mtime: 4000 },
  });
  const all = listSaves(fs);
  assert.deepEqual(all.map((s) => [s.character, s.mtime, s.info.place]).sort(), [['Nerevar', 3000, 'vivec, arena'], ['player', 1000, '-2,6']]);
  fs.reads = 0;
  assert.deepEqual(listSaves(fs, SAVES_DIRS, 2000).map((s) => s.path), [`${b}/Nerevar/Autosave.omwsave`]);
  assert.equal(fs.reads, 2, 'the older one not read (the broken one is, and left out)');
  assert.deepEqual(listSaves(fakeFS({})), [], 'no saves folder');
});

test('a save read by its records\' headers through FS.read — the screenshot and the world\'s records before PLAY not read', () => {
  const bytes = save({ cell: exterior(-2, 6) }), path = `${SAVES_DIRS[0]}/player/Quicksave.omwsave`;
  const fs = fakeFS({ [path]: { bytes, mtime: 1000 } });
  let read = 0, open = 0, closed = 0;
  Object.assign(fs, {
    stat: (p) => ({ mtime: new Date(1000), size: p === path ? bytes.length : 0 }),
    open: () => { open++; return { fd: 3 }; },
    read: (stream, buf, off, len, pos) => { const b = bytes.subarray(pos, pos + len); buf.set(b, off); read += b.length; return b.length; },
    close: () => { closed++; },
    readFile: () => { throw new Error('not the whole save'); },
  });
  const [s] = listSaves(fs);
  assert.equal(s.info.place, '-2,6'); assert.equal(s.info.timePlayed, 12.5);
  assert.equal(open, 1); assert.equal(closed, 1);
  assert.ok(read < bytes.length - 8000, `${read} of ${bytes.length} bytes read`);
});

test('the save chosen: the remembered place when a save is there, else the newest, else (a profile restored) the most played', () => {
  const s = (place, mtime, timePlayed) => ({ path: place, mtime, info: { place, timePlayed } });
  const saves = [s('-2,6', 1000, 50), s('vivec, arena', 3000, 20), s(null, 9000, 99)];
  assert.deepEqual(chooseSave(saves, { hint: { place: '-2,6', at: 3000 } }), { save: saves[0], place: '-2,6', why: 'hint' });
  assert.equal(chooseSave(saves, { hint: { place: '-2,6', at: 900 } }).place, 'vivec, arena', 'a save newer than the hint: the newest');
  assert.equal(chooseSave(saves, { hint: { place: '-2,6', at: 1000 }, restored: true }).why, 'hint', 'dates of a restore: the hint');
  assert.equal(chooseSave(saves, { hint: '-2,6' }).why, 'newest', 'a bare place of an earlier page: no date, any save newer');
  assert.equal(chooseSave(saves, { hint: { place: '0,0', at: 9000 } }).place, 'vivec, arena', 'a hint with no save there: the newest');
  const two = [s('-2,6', 1000, 50), s('-2,6', 2000, 10)];
  assert.equal(chooseSave(two, { hint: { place: '-2,6', at: 5000 } }).save, two[1], 'the newest save of the hinted place');
  assert.deepEqual(chooseSave(saves), { save: saves[1], place: 'vivec, arena', why: 'newest' });
  assert.deepEqual(chooseSave(saves, { restored: true }), { save: saves[0], place: '-2,6', why: 'time' }, 'dates rewritten by the restore: the most played');
  assert.equal(chooseSave([s('a', 5, 1), s('b', 5, 2)]).place, 'b', 'same date: the most played');
  assert.equal(chooseSave([s(null, 1, 1)]), null);
  assert.equal(chooseSave([]), null);
});

test('an announced batch\'s label names its place; the hint is the browser\'s storage, per installation', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(labelPlace('meshes:-2,6'), { kind: 'meshes', place: '-2,6' });
  assert.deepEqual(labelPlace("textures:ald'ruhn, temple"), { kind: 'textures', place: "ald'ruhn, temple" });
  assert.deepEqual(labelPlace('terrain:3,4'), { kind: 'terrain', place: '3,4' });
  assert.equal(labelPlace('place:3,4'), null);
  assert.equal(labelPlace('meshes:'), null);
  assert.equal(labelPlace(null), null);
  const m = new Map(), storage = { getItem: (k) => m.get(k) ?? null, setItem: (k, v) => m.set(k, v) };
  assert.equal(placeHint.get('mw-fr', storage), null);
  placeHint.set('mw-fr', '-2,6', storage, 1234);
  assert.deepEqual(placeHint.get('mw-fr', storage), { place: '-2,6', at: 1234 });
  assert.equal(placeHint.get('mw-en', storage), null);
  m.set('orthros.place.mw-old', 'balmora'); assert.deepEqual(placeHint.get('mw-old', storage), { place: 'balmora', at: 0 }, 'a bare place of an earlier page');
  m.delete('orthros.place.mw-old');
  assert.deepEqual([...m.keys()], ['orthros.place.mw-fr']);
  assert.equal(placeHint.get('mw-fr', null), null, 'no storage');
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => placeHint.set('mw-fr', 'x', { getItem() { throw new Error('denied'); } }));
});
```

```js
  const releases = { [lock.id]: upstream };
  const releaseOf = (id) => releases[id];
  assert.deepEqual(openmwGatewayImage(upstream, releaseOf, lock), { image: lock.serverBuild.image, base: lock.serverImage, tag: lock.serverBuild.tag });
  // (a release built here: its upstream's)

  assert.throws(() => openmwGatewayImage({ id: 'x' }, releaseOf, lock), /No pinned server image/);
  assert.throws(() => openmwGatewayImage(upstream, releaseOf, { ...lock, serverBuild: { ...lock.serverBuild, image: '' } }), /not pinned/);
```

`tests/openmw-settings.test.js`:

```js
// The engine page's settings defaults a version adds (src/host/openmw.js withSettingsDefaults, put into the page by
// src/host/server.js): OpenMW's locales in the version's language first, English after, dialogue topics coloured, then
// the version's own (manifest openmw.settings) — appended to what the page writes to /settings.cfg, under the player's
// own settings.cfg; and the version's own for its native simulation peers (openmwSimSettings, tools/openmw/server.mjs).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createServer } from '../src/host/server.js';
import { OPENMW_SIM_SETTINGS, openmwLocales, openmwProblem, openmwSettingsDefaults, openmwSimSettings, openmwVersionSettings, withSettingsDefaults } from '../src/host/openmw.js';
import { DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR } from '../src/host/goldsrc.js';
import { DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR } from '../src/host/game-catalog.js';

/**
 * OpenMW's settings file reader (components/settings/parser.cpp, SettingsFileParser::loadSettingsFile) on a text: a
 * `[section]` header (again or not) sets the section, `key = value` trimmed, '#' a comment. With `overrideExisting`
 * (the additional defaults, settings.cpp) a later key replaces an earlier one, else a key seen twice is an error.
 */
function loadSettings(text, settings, overrideExisting) {
  let category = '';
  const skip = (line, i) => { while (i < line.length && /\s/.test(line[i])) i++; return i; };
  for (const line of text.split('\n')) {
    let i = skip(line, 0);
    if (i >= line.length || line[i] === '#') continue;
    if (line[i] === '[') {
      const end = line.indexOf(']', i);
      if (end < 0) throw new Error('unterminated category');
      category = line.slice(i + 1, end).trim(); i = end + 1;
    }
    i = skip(line, i);
    if (i >= line.length) continue;
    if (!category) throw new Error('empty category name');
    const eq = line.indexOf('=', i);
    if (eq < 0) throw new Error('unterminated setting name');
    const key = `[${category}] ${line.slice(i, eq).trim()}`, value = line.slice(eq + 1).trim();
    if (!overrideExisting && settings.has(key)) throw new Error(`duplicate setting: ${key}`);
    settings.set(key, value);
  }
  return settings;
}

/**
 * The engine's settings (Settings::Manager::load): `defaults` (its settings-default.cfg), the page's /settings.cfg as
 * additional defaults (overriding), the player's own settings.cfg over them — a key's value as the engine reads it.
 */
function engineSettings(defaults, pageCfg, userCfg = '') {
  const d = loadSettings(defaults, new Map(), false);
  loadSettings(pageCfg, d, true);
  const user = loadSettings(userCfg, new Map(), false);
  return (key) => user.get(key) ?? d.get(key);
}

/** The settings the page writes, as its script runs: `pageScript` around the write, `vars` its variables. */
function written(pageScript, vars = {}) {
  const files = new Map(), log = [];
  const FS = { writeFile: (p, d) => files.set(p, String(d)) };
  new Function('FS', 'append', ...Object.keys(vars), pageScript)(FS, (t) => log.push(t), ...Object.values(vars));
  return { cfg: files.get('/settings.cfg'), log };
}

const ENGINE_DEFAULTS = '[GUI]\ncolor topic enable = false\ncolor topic specific = 0.45 0.5 0.8 1\nsubtitles = false\n[General]\nanisotropy = 4\npreferred locales = en\ngmst overrides l10n = true\n'
  + '[Game]\nbest attack = false\nshow owned = 0\nstrength influences hand to hand = 0\nNPCs avoid collisions = false\n[Map]\nallow zooming = false\n[Video]\nframerate limit = 300\n';
const PAGE = "var settingsCfg = '[Video]\\nwindow mode = 2\\n' + '[General]\\n' + 'anisotropy = 16\\n';\n"
  + "FS.writeFile('/settings.cfg', settingsCfg);\nappend('[cfg] render resolution');";

test('a version\'s locales: its languages first, then English; nothing but locale codes', () => {
  assert.equal(openmwLocales({ languages: ['fr'] }), 'fr,en');
  assert.equal(openmwLocales({ languages: ['en'] }), 'en');
  assert.equal(openmwLocales({ languages: ['fr', 'en'] }), 'fr,en');
  assert.equal(openmwLocales({ languages: ['de-AT'] }), 'de-AT,en');
  assert.equal(openmwLocales({}), 'en', 'no languages: OpenMW\'s own default');
  assert.equal(openmwLocales(null), 'en');
  assert.equal(openmwLocales({ languages: ['fr\n[GUI]', '../x', 'FR', 3] }), 'en', 'no other text in the settings file');
  assert.deepEqual(openmwSettingsDefaults({ languages: ['fr'] }), { General: { 'preferred locales': 'fr,en' }, GUI: { 'color topic enable': 'true' } });
});

test('the page\'s defaults with the version\'s after them: its own [General] keys kept, a [GUI] section, the player\'s settings over them', () => {
  const out = withSettingsDefaults(PAGE, { languages: ['fr'] });
  assert.equal(withSettingsDefaults('<html>no settings write</html>', { languages: ['fr'] }), '<html>no settings write</html>', 'another page: unchanged');
  const { cfg, log } = written(out);
  assert.equal(cfg, '[Video]\nwindow mode = 2\n[General]\nanisotropy = 16\n\n[General]\npreferred locales = fr,en\n[GUI]\ncolor topic enable = true\n');
  assert.deepEqual(log, ['[orthros] settings defaults: [General] preferred locales = fr,en; [GUI] color topic enable = true', '[cfg] render resolution']);
  const get = engineSettings(ENGINE_DEFAULTS, cfg);
  assert.equal(get('[General] preferred locales'), 'fr,en');
  assert.equal(get('[General] anisotropy'), '16', '[General] opened again: the page\'s own key kept');
  assert.equal(get('[General] gmst overrides l10n'), 'true');
  assert.equal(get('[GUI] color topic enable'), 'true');
  assert.equal(get('[GUI] color topic specific'), '0.45 0.5 0.8 1', 'OpenMW\'s own colours');
  assert.equal(get('[Video] window mode'), '2');
  // (the Options menu's Language choice, written to the player's settings.cfg, wins; their file without it: the default)
  assert.equal(engineSettings(ENGINE_DEFAULTS, cfg, '[General]\npreferred locales = en\n')('[General] preferred locales'), 'en');
  assert.equal(engineSettings(ENGINE_DEFAULTS, cfg, '[Video]\ngamma = 1.4\n')('[General] preferred locales'), 'fr,en');
  assert.equal(engineSettings(ENGINE_DEFAULTS, cfg, '[GUI]\ncolor topic enable = false\n')('[GUI] color topic enable'), 'false');
  // (a key written twice is an error in the player's file only: the additional defaults take the later one)
  assert.equal(loadSettings('[General]\npreferred locales = en\n[General]\npreferred locales = fr,en\n', new Map(), true).get('[General] preferred locales'), 'fr,en');
  assert.throws(() => loadSettings('[General]\na = 1\n[General]\na = 2\n', new Map(), false), /duplicate setting/);
  const en = written(withSettingsDefaults(PAGE, { languages: ['en'] })).cfg;
  assert.equal(engineSettings(ENGINE_DEFAULTS, en)('[General] preferred locales'), 'en');
  assert.equal(engineSettings(ENGINE_DEFAULTS, en)('[GUI] color topic enable'), 'true');
});

test('a version\'s own settings: OpenMW\'s names and plain values only, after Orthros\' own, under the player\'s choices', () => {
  const base = { engine: 'v1', files: ['Morrowind.esm'] };
  const settings = { Game: { 'best attack': true, 'show owned': 3, 'NPCs avoid collisions': true }, GUI: { subtitles: true },
    Map: { 'allow zooming': true }, General: { 'preferred locales': 'de,en' }, 'Post Processing': { 'chain': 'bloom,adjustments' } };
  assert.equal(openmwProblem({ ...base, settings }), null);
  assert.equal(openmwProblem({ ...base, settings: {} }), null);
  assert.equal(openmwProblem({ ...base, settings: { Game: { 'swim upward coef': -0.5 } } }), null);
  for (const bad of [[], 'x', null, { Game: [] }, { Game: { 'best attack': null } }, { Game: { 'best attack': { a: 1 } } },
    { Game: { 'best attack': ['true'] } }, { Game: { 'best attack': Infinity } }, { Game: { 'a': 1e21 } },
    { 'Game]\n[Video': { a: 1 } }, { '': { a: 1 } }, { ' Game': { a: 1 } }, { Game: { 'a = 1\nb': 1 } }, { Game: { 'a=b': 1 } },
    { Game: { '# a': 1 } }, { Game: { 'best attack ': true } }, { Game: { a: 'x\ny' } }, { Game: { a: '</script><script>alert(1)' } },
    { Game: { a: ' padded' } }, { Game: { a: 'x'.repeat(201) } }, { Game: { ['k'.repeat(65)]: 1 } }, { Game: { __proto__x: 1 } }])
    assert.ok(openmwProblem({ ...base, settings: bad }), JSON.stringify(bad));
  assert.deepEqual(openmwVersionSettings({ openmw: { ...base, settings } }), {
    Game: { 'best attack': 'true', 'show owned': '3', 'NPCs avoid collisions': 'true' }, GUI: { subtitles: 'true' },
    Map: { 'allow zooming': 'true' }, General: { 'preferred locales': 'de,en' }, 'Post Processing': { chain: 'bloom,adjustments' } });
  assert.deepEqual(openmwVersionSettings({ openmw: { ...base, settings: { Game: { a: 'x\ny' } } } }), {}, 'invalid: none');
  assert.deepEqual(openmwVersionSettings({}), {});
  // (Orthros' own first, the version's after them: a key of both is the version's)
  const man = { languages: ['fr'], openmw: { ...base, settings } };
  assert.deepEqual(openmwSettingsDefaults(man), {
    General: { 'preferred locales': 'de,en' }, GUI: { 'color topic enable': 'true', subtitles: 'true' },
    Game: { 'best attack': 'true', 'show owned': '3', 'NPCs avoid collisions': 'true' }, Map: { 'allow zooming': 'true' },
    'Post Processing': { chain: 'bloom,adjustments' } });
  const { cfg, log } = written(withSettingsDefaults(PAGE, man));
  assert.equal(cfg.split('[General]').length - 1, 2, 'the page\'s [General], then Orthros\' — one block each');
  assert.match(log[0], /^\[orthros\] settings defaults: \[General\] preferred locales = de,en; \[GUI\] color topic enable = true; \[GUI\] subtitles = true; \[Game\] best attack = true; /);
  const get = engineSettings(ENGINE_DEFAULTS, cfg);
  assert.equal(get('[Game] best attack'), 'true');
  assert.equal(get('[Game] show owned'), '3');
  assert.equal(get('[GUI] subtitles'), 'true');
  assert.equal(get('[Map] allow zooming'), 'true');
  assert.equal(get('[GUI] color topic enable'), 'true');
  assert.equal(get('[Game] strength influences hand to hand'), '0', 'a key the version does not name: the engine\'s');
  // (the player's own settings.cfg — the Options menu's Best attack, Subtitles — still wins; their file without them: the version's)
  const player = engineSettings(ENGINE_DEFAULTS, cfg, '[Game]\nbest attack = false\n[GUI]\nsubtitles = false\n');
  assert.equal(player('[Game] best attack'), 'false');
  assert.equal(player('[GUI] subtitles'), 'false');
  assert.equal(player('[Game] show owned'), '3');
  // (a value that could end the page's script is refused, so the page gets none of an invalid set)
  assert.equal(written(withSettingsDefaults(PAGE, { languages: ['en'], openmw: { ...base, settings: { Game: { a: '</script>' } } } })).cfg.includes('[Game]'), false);
});

test('the simulation peers: the version\'s settings as additional defaults, the gateway\'s own peer settings over them', () => {
  assert.equal(OPENMW_SIM_SETTINGS, '/usr/local/etc/openmw/settings.cfg');
  const man = { openmw: { engine: 'v1', files: ['Morrowind.esm'], settings: {
    Game: { 'NPCs avoid collisions': true, 'strength influences hand to hand': 2 }, Video: { 'framerate limit': 60 } } } };

  assert.ok(!/preferred locales|color topic/.test(text), 'the page\'s own defaults stay in the page');
  // (the native engine's config dirs for a peer: the image's global one — defaults.bin, this file as additional defaults —
  // then the world's peer-config, whose settings.cfg the gateway writes at each world start: the last, the peer's own)
  const peerCfg = '# GENERATED by openmw-mp for the Phase H simulation peer. Edits are overwritten.\n[Video]\nframerate limit = 20\nvsync mode = 0\n';
  const get = engineSettings(ENGINE_DEFAULTS, text, peerCfg);
  assert.equal(get('[Game] NPCs avoid collisions'), 'true');
  assert.equal(get('[Game] strength influences hand to hand'), '2');
  assert.equal(get('[Video] framerate limit'), '20', 'the gateway\'s pacing wins');
  assert.equal(get('[Game] best attack'), 'false');
  // (a version without settings: a comment only, nothing changed)
  const none = openmwSimSettings({ openmw: { engine: 'v1', files: ['x'] } });
  assert.equal(none.split('\n').filter((l) => l && !l.startsWith('#')).length, 0);
  assert.equal(engineSettings(ENGINE_DEFAULTS, none, peerCfg)('[Game] NPCs avoid collisions'), 'false');
});

test('the installed versions\' settings are OpenMW\'s, with values of their type', () => {
  const source = path.join(DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR, 'src/openmw-web-v1.5.3/openmw-web-v1.5.3/openmw/files/settings-default.cfg');
  if (!fs.existsSync(source) || !fs.existsSync(DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR)) return;
  const defaults = loadSettings(fs.readFileSync(source, 'utf8'), new Map(), false);
  const kind = (v) => /^(true|false)$/.test(v) ? 'boolean' : /^-?\d+$/.test(v) ? 'integer' : /^-?\d*\.\d+$/.test(v) ? 'number' : 'text';
  for (const game of fs.readdirSync(DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR)) {
    let spec; try { spec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR, game, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8')); } catch { continue; }
    for (const v of [spec.defaults ?? {}, ...(spec.versions ?? [])]) {
      for (const [section, kv] of Object.entries(openmwVersionSettings(v))) for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(kv)) {
        const name = `${game} ${v.id ?? 'defaults'} [${section}] ${key}`, engine = defaults.get(`[${section}] ${key}`);
        // (an unknown key in additional defaults is kept without a word, and never read)
        assert.ok(engine !== undefined, `${name}: not an OpenMW setting`);
        assert.ok(kind(engine) === kind(value) || (kind(engine) === 'number' && kind(value) === 'integer'), `${name} = ${value}: OpenMW's is ${engine}`);
      }
    }
  }
});

test('the releases\' settings block: the settings written once, the whole file read as OpenMW reads it', () => {
  const source = path.join(DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR, 'src/openmw-web-v1.5.3/openmw-web-v1.5.3/openmw/files/settings-default.cfg');

    const get = engineSettings(engineDefaults, cfg);
    assert.equal(get('[General] preferred locales'), 'fr,en', id);
    assert.equal(get('[General] anisotropy'), '16', id);

    assert.equal(get('[Video] resolution x'), '1280', id);
  }
});
```
