`tests/openmw-streamfs.test.js`:

```js
// The OpenMW engine page's file streaming (src/ports/openmw/streamfs.js): the engine's start (its Emscripten run) held
// until the game data worker answered — its first reads wait synchronously, and Chrome hands a module worker the
// messages sent before its scripts ran through the page's thread: a read before then is never answered (the engine's
// boot right after a short manifest fetch, "the game data worker stopped answering" 30 s later, Morrowind.bsa unreadable).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import vm from 'node:vm';

const SRC = fs.readFileSync(new URL('../src/ports/openmw/streamfs.js', import.meta.url), 'utf8')
  .replaceAll("import('/src/", `import('${new URL('../src/', import.meta.url).href}`);

test('the engine does not run before the game data worker answered (its run dependency)', async () => {
  const workers = [];
  globalThis.Worker ??= class { constructor() { this.sent = []; workers.push(this); } postMessage(m) { this.sent.push(m); } };
  const deps = [], timers = [];
  const ctx = vm.createContext({
    console, URL, Promise, Map, WeakMap, Math, Object, Error, queueMicrotask, decodeURIComponent,
    self: { crossOriginIsolated: true }, location: { pathname: '/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html', href: 'https://o.test/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html' },
    setInterval: (f, ms) => { timers.push(f); return timers.length; }, clearInterval() {},
    addRunDependency: (id) => deps.push(['add', id]), removeRunDependency: (id) => deps.push(['remove', id]),
  });
  ctx.window = ctx; ctx.globalThis = ctx; ctx.window.parent = ctx;
  try {
    vm.runInContext(SRC, ctx, { importModuleDynamically: vm.constants.USE_MAIN_CONTEXT_DEFAULT_LOADER });
    // (opened as soon as the shared modules are loaded, beside the engine's download — docs/slow-network.md "Opened
    // early" —, the run held only once the engine uses it: before its script ran there is no run to hold)
    for (let i = 0; i < 50 && workers.length === 0; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
    assert.equal(workers.length, 1, 'the game data opened before the engine asked');
    assert.deepEqual(deps, [], 'no run held yet');
    assert.ok(!workers[0].sent.some((m) => m.start), 'not started yet');
    assert.equal(workers[0].sent[0].init.orderAtOpen, true, 'the learned order\'s list asked at the open');
    ctx.__omwLruDefault = 192; // (the engine page's tier, set by its preRun: after the open)
    ctx.StreamFS.init();
    assert.equal(workers.length, 1, 'the same game data');
    assert.equal(ctx.StreamFS.data().budget, 192 << 20, 'its bytes kept as the tier says at the engine\'s first use');
    assert.ok(workers[0].sent.some((m) => m.start), 'started at the engine\'s first use');
    assert.deepEqual(deps, [['add', 'orthros-game-data']], 'held while the worker has not answered');
    ctx.StreamFS.init(); assert.equal(workers.length, 1, 'once');
    workers[0].onmessage({ data: { ready: { trees: {}, kept: {}, manifest: {}, real: [] } } });
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
    assert.deepEqual(deps, [['add', 'orthros-game-data'], ['remove', 'orthros-game-data']], 'released once it answered');
  } finally { ctx.StreamFS?.close?.(); }
});

// The game data opened early, before the engine's first use (seconds later: its download): an open that fails meanwhile
// (/api/tree 5xx) is not an unhandled rejection — the engine page's log opened on it —; the engine's first use reports it.
test('a game data open failing before the engine asked is not an unhandled rejection', async (t) => {
  const RealWorker = globalThis.Worker, workers = [], unhandled = [], onUnhandled = (e) => unhandled.push(e);
  globalThis.Worker = class { constructor() { this.sent = []; workers.push(this); } postMessage(m) { this.sent.push(m); } };
  process.on('unhandledRejection', onUnhandled);
  t.after(() => { globalThis.Worker = RealWorker; process.off('unhandledRejection', onUnhandled); });
  const deps = [];
  const ctx = vm.createContext({
    console: { ...console, warn() {}, error() {} }, URL, Promise, Map, WeakMap, Math, Object, Error, queueMicrotask, decodeURIComponent,
    self: { crossOriginIsolated: true }, location: { pathname: '/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html', href: 'https://o.test/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html' },
    setInterval: () => 0, clearInterval() {},
    addRunDependency: (id) => deps.push(['add', id]), removeRunDependency: (id) => deps.push(['remove', id]),
  });
  ctx.window = ctx; ctx.globalThis = ctx; ctx.window.parent = ctx;
  try {
    vm.runInContext(SRC, ctx, { importModuleDynamically: vm.constants.USE_MAIN_CONTEXT_DEFAULT_LOADER });
    for (let i = 0; i < 50 && workers.length === 0; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
    assert.equal(workers.length, 1, 'opened early');
    workers[0].onmessage({ data: { failed: '/api/tree/morrowind-goty-en: HTTP 502' } });
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
    assert.equal(unhandled.length, 0, `unhandled: ${unhandled.map(String)}`);
    // (the engine's first use: the same game data, its failure handled there)
    ctx.StreamFS.init();
    assert.equal(workers.length, 1, 'the same game data');
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
    assert.equal(unhandled.length, 0);
  } finally { ctx.StreamFS?.close?.(); }
});

// The link after the engine's package (docs/openmw.md): once Emscripten's file_packager package is in (its run
// dependency 'datafile_<name>' removed — the packager calls Module.removeRunDependency, set by the engine's script after
// this one ran), the game data's learned order is asked to load now (GameData.prefetchNow; the worker decides by its store).
test('the engine\'s package in: the game data asked to load its learned order now, before or after the game data opened', async () => {
  const RealWorker = globalThis.Worker;
  {
    const workers = [], deps = [];
    globalThis.Worker = class { constructor() { this.sent = []; workers.push(this); } postMessage(m) { this.sent.push(m); } };
    const ctx = vm.createContext({
      console, URL, Promise, Map, WeakMap, Math, Object, Error, queueMicrotask, decodeURIComponent,
      self: { crossOriginIsolated: true }, location: { pathname: '/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html', href: 'https://o.test/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html' },
      setInterval: () => 0, clearInterval() {}, Module: {},
    });
    ctx.window = ctx; ctx.globalThis = ctx; ctx.window.parent = ctx;
    try {
      vm.runInContext(SRC, ctx, { importModuleDynamically: vm.constants.USE_MAIN_CONTEXT_DEFAULT_LOADER });
      const init = async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) { try { ctx.StreamFS.init(); return; } catch (e) { if (!/not loaded yet/.test(e.message)) throw e; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10)); } } };
      await init(); // (the shared modules loaded: the hook installed; this first init opens the game data)
      const w = workers[0]; assert.ok(w, 'the game data opened');
      // (the engine's script, run after this one: its function set on Module, then the packager's call through it)
      ctx.Module.removeRunDependency = (id) => deps.push(id);
      ctx.Module.removeRunDependency('wasm-instantiate');
      assert.equal(w.sent.filter((m) => m.prefetch).length, 0, 'not for another dependency');
      ctx.Module.removeRunDependency('datafile_openmw.data');
      assert.deepEqual(deps, ['wasm-instantiate', 'datafile_openmw.data'], 'the engine\'s own function still called');
      assert.equal(w.sent.filter((m) => m.prefetch).length, 1, 'asked once the package is in');
      assert.ok(w.sent.findIndex((m) => m.start) < w.sent.findIndex((m) => m.prefetch), 'after the engine\'s start');
    } finally { ctx.StreamFS?.close?.(); }
  }
  // (the package in before the game data opened — a fast link: the manifest fetch after it —: asked at the open)
  const workers = [];
  globalThis.Worker = class { constructor() { this.sent = []; workers.push(this); } postMessage(m) { this.sent.push(m); } };
  const ctx = vm.createContext({
    console, URL, Promise, Map, WeakMap, Math, Object, Error, queueMicrotask, decodeURIComponent,
    self: { crossOriginIsolated: true }, location: { pathname: '/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html', href: 'https://o.test/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html' },
    setInterval: () => 0, clearInterval() {}, Module: { removeRunDependency() {} },
  });
  ctx.window = ctx; ctx.globalThis = ctx; ctx.window.parent = ctx;
  try {
    vm.runInContext(SRC, ctx, { importModuleDynamically: vm.constants.USE_MAIN_CONTEXT_DEFAULT_LOADER });
    const hooked = () => !!Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(ctx.Module, 'removeRunDependency')?.get;
    for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !hooked(); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
    assert.ok(hooked(), 'the hook installed once the shared modules are loaded');
    ctx.Module.removeRunDependency('datafile_openmw.data');
    assert.equal(workers.length, 1, 'the game data opened with the modules (docs/slow-network.md "Opened early")');
    assert.equal(workers[0].sent.filter((m) => m.prefetch || m.start).length, 0, 'not started before the engine uses it');
    ctx.StreamFS.init();
    assert.equal(workers[0].sent.filter((m) => m.prefetch).length, 1, 'asked as the engine first uses it');
  } finally { ctx.StreamFS?.close?.(); globalThis.Worker = RealWorker; }
});

test('announced reads (orthrosWillRead / orthrosReadWait): engine paths to the game data\'s handles, an archive\'s range as it, one batch', async () => {
  const workers = [], RealWorker = globalThis.Worker;
  globalThis.Worker = class { constructor() { this.sent = []; workers.push(this); } postMessage(m) { this.sent.push(m); } };
  // (the engine's file system, enough for the file nodes: a node per created file, found by its path)
  const nodes = new Map();
  const FS = {
    ErrnoError: class extends Error { constructor(n) { super(`errno ${n}`); this.errno = n; } },
    mkdirTree() {},
    createFile(dir, name) { const n = { stream_ops: {}, node_ops: {} }; nodes.set(`${dir}/${name}`, n); return n; },
    lookupPath(p) { const n = nodes.get(p); if (!n) throw new FS.ErrnoError(44); return { node: n }; },
  };
  const ctx = vm.createContext({
    console, URL, Promise, Map, WeakMap, Math, Object, Error, Number, String, queueMicrotask, decodeURIComponent, FS, performance,
    self: { crossOriginIsolated: true }, location: { pathname: '/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html', href: 'https://o.test/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html', origin: 'https://o.test' },
    setInterval: () => 0, clearInterval() {},
  });
  ctx.window = ctx; ctx.globalThis = ctx; ctx.window.parent = ctx;
  try {
    vm.runInContext(SRC, ctx, { importModuleDynamically: vm.constants.USE_MAIN_CONTEXT_DEFAULT_LOADER });
    assert.equal(ctx.orthrosWillRead('x\x1F0\x1F-1', 'meshes:0,0'), 0, 'no game data yet: nothing announced');
    assert.equal(ctx.orthrosReadWait(100), 1, 'nor waited for');
    ctx.orthrosContentLoading(); // (the engine's content load said before the game data opened: nothing)
    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) { try { ctx.StreamFS.init(); break; } catch (e) { if (!/not loaded yet/.test(e.message)) throw e; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10)); } }
    const w = workers[0]; assert.ok(w, 'the game data opened');
    w.onmessage({ data: { ready: { trees: {}, kept: {}, manifest: {}, real: [] } } });
    const app = 'https://o.test/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/';
    ctx.StreamFS.mount('/data/Morrowind.bsa', app + 'mwdata/Morrowind.bsa', 5000000);
    ctx.StreamFS.mount('/data/Meshes/x/a.nif', app + 'mwdata/Meshes/x/a.nif', 9000);
    const list = ['/data/Morrowind.bsa\x1F1048576\x1F70000', '/data/Meshes/x/a.nif\x1F0\x1F-1', '/data/nothing.nif\x1F0\x1F-1', ''].join('\x1E');
    assert.equal(ctx.orthrosWillRead(list, 'meshes:-2,6'), 2, 'two not in the page (the unknown path left out)');
    const data = ctx.StreamFS.data();
    // (posted with its wait window's other lists: at the wait, or once the page's thread yields — GameData.wantFlush)
    assert.equal(w.sent.filter((m) => m.want).length, 0);
    data.wantFlush();
    const sent = w.sent.find((m) => m.want);
    assert.deepEqual(sent.want, { seq: 1, from: 1, list: [['morrowind-goty-en', 'Morrowind.bsa', 1048576, 70000], ['morrowind-goty-en', 'Meshes/x/a.nif', 0, 9000]], label: 'meshes:-2,6' });
    assert.equal(ctx.orthrosReadWait(5), 0, 'not settled: time out');
    assert.equal(ctx.orthrosReadWait(15000), 1, 'nothing announced since the last wait: nothing to wait for');
    // (the next batch's window starts after the one that timed out)
    ctx.StreamFS.mount('/data/Meshes/x/b.nif', app + 'mwdata/Meshes/x/b.nif', 9000);
    assert.equal(ctx.orthrosWillRead('/data/Meshes/x/b.nif\x1F0\x1F-1', 'meshes:-2,7'), 1);
    data.wantFlush();
    assert.equal(w.sent.filter((m) => m.want).at(-1).want.from, 2);
    Atomics.store(data.ctrl, 12, 2);
    assert.equal(ctx.orthrosReadWait(15000), 1, 'settled (ctrl[12] at the batch)');
    assert.equal(data.snapshot().wantTimeouts, 1);
    // (the engine's content load (orthros-r13.patch): its content files light until it says it is over, for good)
    assert.equal(data.content, 'real');
    ctx.orthrosContentLoading(); assert.equal(data.content, 'light');
    ctx.orthrosContentLoaded(); assert.equal(data.content, 'done');
    // (a cell's references listed by their ids: the copies again, said back after)
    ctx.orthrosContentIds(1); assert.equal(data.contentIdsDepth, 1);
    ctx.orthrosContentIds(0); assert.equal(data.contentIdsDepth, 0);
  } finally { ctx.StreamFS?.close?.(); globalThis.Worker = RealWorker; }
});

// Anticipated places (docs/openmw.md "Anticipated places"): each announced batch posted to the server's learned places
// with its place (the files themselves: tree paths and ranges), the place remembered; once the saves are readable the
// save the player most likely loads is parsed (save-place.js), its place's learned set asked of the server and handed
// to the game data at the place's priority (GameData.want prio 'place': the worker's wantPlace, no wait window).
test('anticipated places: announced batches learned (POST /api/places), the predicted save\'s place fetched at the place\'s priority, saves written remembered', async () => {
  const workers = [], RealWorker = globalThis.Worker;
  globalThis.Worker = class { constructor() { this.sent = []; workers.push(this); } postMessage(m) { this.sent.push(m); } };
  const { parseSave } = await import('../src/ports/openmw/save-place.js');
  // (a save as the engine writes one: TES3 FORM 38, SAVE, PLAY with the player's cell RefId before LKEP)
  const u32 = (n) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(4); b.writeUInt32LE(n); return b; }, i32 = (n) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(4); b.writeInt32LE(n); return b; };
  const sub = (n, d) => Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(n), u32(d.length), d]);
  const rec = (n, ...s) => { const body = Buffer.concat(s); return Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(n), u32(body.length), u32(0), u32(0), body]); };
  const f64 = (n) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(8); b.writeDoubleLE(n); return b; };
  const save = (cell, time) => new Uint8Array(Buffer.concat([rec('TES3', sub('FORM', u32(38)), sub('HEDR', Buffer.alloc(300))),
    rec('SAVE', sub('PLNA', Buffer.from('player')), sub('TIME', f64(time))), rec('PLAY', sub('NAME', cell), sub('LKEP', Buffer.alloc(8)))]));
  const ext = (x, y) => Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([6]), i32(x), i32(y)]), int = (s) => Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([2]), Buffer.from(s)]);
  assert.equal(parseSave(save(ext(-2, 6), 1)).place, '-2,6');
  // (the engine's file system: the mounted files' nodes, and the saves folders)
  const nodes = new Map(), saves = new Map([['/userdata/saves/player/Quicksave.omwsave', { bytes: save(ext(-2, 6), 30), mtime: 2000 }], ['/userdata/saves/player/old.omwsave', { bytes: save(int('Vivec, Arena'), 90), mtime: 1000 }]]);
  const FS = {
    ErrnoError: class extends Error { constructor(n) { super(`errno ${n}`); this.errno = n; } },
    mkdirTree() {},
    createFile(dir, name) { const n = { stream_ops: {}, node_ops: {} }; nodes.set(`${dir}/${name}`, n); return n; },
    lookupPath(p) { const n = nodes.get(p); if (!n) throw new FS.ErrnoError(44); return { node: n }; },
    readdir(d) {
      const out = new Set();
      for (const p of saves.keys()) if (p.startsWith(d + '/')) out.add(p.slice(d.length + 1).split('/')[0]);
      if (!out.size) throw new FS.ErrnoError(44);
      return ['.', '..', ...out];
    },
    stat(p) { return { mtime: new Date(saves.get(p)?.mtime ?? 0) }; },
    readFile(p) { return saves.get(p).bytes; },
  };
  const store = new Map(), localStorage = { getItem: (k) => store.get(k) ?? null, setItem: (k, v) => store.set(k, String(v)) };
  const calls = [], intervals = [];
  let places = [['Meshes/x/a.nif', 0, 9000], ['Morrowind.bsa', 1048576, 1118576], { path: 'Textures/t.dds' }, ['nope.nif', 0, -1]];
  const fetch = async (url, init = {}) => { calls.push({ url, init }); return { ok: true, json: async () => places }; };
  const ctx = vm.createContext({
    console, URL, Promise, Map, WeakMap, Math, Object, Error, Number, String, JSON, Array, queueMicrotask, decodeURIComponent, encodeURIComponent, FS, fetch, localStorage,
    self: { crossOriginIsolated: true }, location: { pathname: '/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html', href: 'https://o.test/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html', origin: 'https://o.test' },
    setInterval: (f) => { intervals.push(f); return intervals.length; }, clearInterval() {},
    __idbfsReady: Promise.resolve(), performance, Module: {},
  });
  ctx.window = ctx; ctx.globalThis = ctx; ctx.window.parent = ctx;
  const tick = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5));
  try {
    vm.runInContext(SRC, ctx, { importModuleDynamically: vm.constants.USE_MAIN_CONTEXT_DEFAULT_LOADER });
    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) { try { ctx.StreamFS.init(); break; } catch (e) { if (!/not loaded yet/.test(e.message)) throw e; await tick(); } }
    const w = workers[0];
    const tree = { dirs: { Meshes: { dirs: { x: { files: { 'a.nif': { size: 9000 }, 'b.nif': { size: 9000 } } } } }, Textures: { files: { 't.dds': { size: 40000, light: 9000 } } } }, files: { 'Morrowind.bsa': { size: 5000000, mtime: 1 } } };
    w.onmessage({ data: { ready: { trees: { 'morrowind-goty-en': tree }, kept: {}, manifest: {}, real: [] } } });
    for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !calls.length; i++) await tick();
    await tick();
    // (the engine still booting — no first frame —: the set asked of the server, not fetched yet)
    assert.ok(!w.sent.some((m) => m.wantPlace), 'not while the engine boots');
    ctx.Module.__omwRunning = false; // (the engine's first frame)
    for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !w.sent.some((m) => m.wantPlace); i++) { for (const f of intervals) f(); await tick(); }
    // (no hint: the newest save — Quicksave at -2,6 — its place's learned set asked, handed to the worker at the place's priority)
    assert.deepEqual(calls.map((c) => c.url), ['/api/places/morrowind-goty-en?place=-2%2C6']);
    const sent = w.sent.find((m) => m.wantPlace).wantPlace;
    assert.equal(sent.label, 'place:-2,6');
    assert.deepEqual(sent.list.slice(0, 2), [['morrowind-goty-en', 'Meshes/x/a.nif', 0, 9000], ['morrowind-goty-en', 'Morrowind.bsa', 1048576, 70000]]);
    assert.equal(sent.list.length, 3, 'the tree\'s files (an unknown path left out)');
    assert.ok(/^(Textures\/t\.dds|\.light\/Textures\/t\.dds)$/.test(sent.list[2][1]), 'a texture as this link reads it (its light copy or the file)');
    assert.ok(!w.sent.some((m) => m.want), 'no announced batch (nothing the engine waits for)');
    const { atMs, ...predicted } = ctx.StreamFS.place();
    assert.deepEqual(predicted, { place: '-2,6', why: 'newest', save: '/userdata/saves/player/Quicksave.omwsave', listed: 3, asked: 3 });
    assert.equal(typeof atMs, 'number');
    assert.equal(ctx.StreamFS.data().wantSeq, 0, 'outside the wait window');

    // (a load the engine announces: its batch to the learned places — the files themselves, their ranges —, the place remembered)
    const app = 'https://o.test/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/';
    ctx.StreamFS.mount('/data/Morrowind.bsa', app + 'mwdata/Morrowind.bsa', 5000000);
    ctx.StreamFS.mount('/data/Meshes/x/b.nif', app + 'mwdata/Meshes/x/b.nif', 9000);
    ctx.orthrosWillRead(['/data/Morrowind.bsa\x1F2000\x1F100', '/data/Meshes/x/b.nif\x1F0\x1F-1', '/data/elsewhere.nif\x1F0\x1F-1'].join('\x1E'), "meshes:ald'ruhn, temple");
    const post = calls.find((c) => c.init.method === 'POST');
    assert.equal(post.url, '/api/places/morrowind-goty-en');
    const body = JSON.parse(post.init.body);
    assert.deepEqual({ ...body, session: typeof body.session }, { session: 'string', place: "ald'ruhn, temple", kind: 'meshes', records: [['Morrowind.bsa', 2000, 2100], ['Meshes/x/b.nif', 0, 9000]] });
    const hint = () => JSON.parse(store.get('orthros.place.morrowind-goty-en'));
    assert.equal(hint().place, "ald'ruhn, temple");
    ctx.orthrosWillRead('/data/Meshes/x/b.nif\x1F0\x1F-1', 'nolabel');
    assert.equal(calls.filter((c) => c.init.method === 'POST').length, 1, 'a batch without a place: not learned');
    // (the cells walked through after the session's first load: learned, not the hint)
    ctx.orthrosWillRead('/data/Meshes/x/b.nif\x1F0\x1F-1', 'meshes:-3,-2');
    assert.equal(calls.filter((c) => c.init.method === 'POST').length, 2);
    assert.equal(hint().place, "ald'ruhn, temple", 'a later cell: not the hint');

    // (a save the engine writes: its place is the hint)
    saves.set('/userdata/saves/player/new.omwsave', { bytes: save(int('Balmora, Lucky Lockup'), 5), mtime: 9000 });
    for (const f of intervals) f();
    assert.deepEqual(hint(), { place: 'balmora, lucky lockup', at: 9000 }, 'at the save\'s date');
  } finally { ctx.StreamFS?.close?.(); globalThis.Worker = RealWorker; }
});

test('in play (?lead=1): the next row\'s learned set asked ahead at the place\'s priority, meshes and terrain only; none by default', async () => {
  const workers = [], RealWorker = globalThis.Worker;
  globalThis.Worker = class { constructor() { this.sent = []; workers.push(this); } postMessage(m) { this.sent.push(m); } };
  const run = async (search) => {
    const calls = [], intervals = [], cleared = [];
    const lists = { '-2,-7': [['Meshes/x/a.nif', 0, -1, 'meshes'], ['Textures/t.dds', 0, -1, 'textures'], ['Morrowind.bsa', 1000, 3000, 'terrain']], 'balmora, guild': [['Meshes/x/b.nif', 0, -1, 'meshes']] };
    const fetch = async (url, init = {}) => { calls.push(url); const q = new URL(url, 'https://o.test').searchParams.get('place'); return { ok: true, json: async () => ({ list: lists[q] ?? [] }) }; };
    const ctx = vm.createContext({
      console, URL, URLSearchParams, Promise, Map, WeakMap, Set, Math, Object, Error, Number, String, JSON, Array, queueMicrotask, decodeURIComponent, encodeURIComponent, fetch,
      self: { crossOriginIsolated: true }, location: { pathname: '/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html', href: 'https://o.test/ports/openmw/morrowind-goty-en/app/index.html', origin: 'https://o.test', search },
      setInterval: (f) => { intervals.push(f); return intervals.length; }, clearInterval: (id) => { cleared.push(id); }, performance, Module: {},
      omw: { state: {} },
    });
    ctx.window = ctx; ctx.globalThis = ctx; ctx.window.parent = ctx;
    const tick = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5));
    try {
      vm.runInContext(SRC, ctx, { importModuleDynamically: vm.constants.USE_MAIN_CONTEXT_DEFAULT_LOADER });
      for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) { try { ctx.StreamFS.init(); break; } catch (e) { if (!/not loaded yet/.test(e.message)) throw e; await tick(); } }
      const w = workers.at(-1);
      const tree = { dirs: { Meshes: { dirs: { x: { files: { 'a.nif': { size: 9000 }, 'b.nif': { size: 7000 } } } } }, Textures: { files: { 't.dds': { size: 40000, light: 9000 } } } }, files: { 'Morrowind.bsa': { size: 5000000, mtime: 1 } } };
      w.onmessage({ data: { ready: { trees: { 'morrowind-goty-en': tree }, kept: {}, manifest: {}, real: [] } } });
      const step = async (state) => { Object.assign(ctx.omw.state, state); for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { for (const f of intervals) f(); await tick(); } };
      // (not in the world yet: nothing; then the first cell, a crossing north, a door — no guess)
      await step({ 'orthros.cell': '-2 -9' });
      await step({ 'orthros.view': '8192 8192' });
      await step({ 'orthros.cell': '-2 -8' });
      await step({ 'orthros.door': 'Balmora, Guild' });
      const out = { calls, sent: w.sent.filter((m) => m.wantPlace).map((m) => m.wantPlace), leads: ctx.StreamFS.leads() };
      // (the page's close stops the lead's polling: its interval — the one that looks at the player's place — cleared)
      const leadIds = intervals.map((f, i) => (/\.look\(/.test(String(f)) ? i + 1 : 0)).filter(Boolean);
      ctx.StreamFS.close();
      out.leadIntervals = leadIds.length; out.leadCleared = leadIds.every((id) => cleared.includes(id));
      return out;
    } finally { ctx.StreamFS?.close?.(); }
  };
  try {
    const on = await run('?src=hosted&lead=1');
    assert.deepEqual(on.calls, ['/api/places/morrowind-goty-en?place=-2%2C-7']);
    assert.deepEqual(on.sent.map((s) => s.label), ['lead:-2,-7']);
    // (the row's meshes and terrain — the texture left out —, the files' ranges)
    assert.deepEqual(on.sent[0].list, [['morrowind-goty-en', 'Meshes/x/a.nif', 0, 9000], ['morrowind-goty-en', 'Morrowind.bsa', 1000, 2000]]);
    assert.deepEqual(on.leads, { guessed: 1, bytes: 9000 + 2000, last: ['-2,-7'] });
    assert.deepEqual([on.leadIntervals, on.leadCleared], [1, true], 'StreamFS.close clears the lead\'s interval');
    const off = await run('?src=hosted');
    assert.equal(off.leadIntervals, 0);
    assert.deepEqual([off.calls, off.sent, off.leads], [[], [], null]);
  } finally { globalThis.Worker = RealWorker; }
});
```

`tests/openmw-tier.test.js`:

```js
// The OpenMW engine page's quality tier from the GPU and the frames measured (src/ports/openmw/tier.js, put into the
// page by src/host/openmw.js withQualityTier), and the GPU's kind every runtime reads (src/host/web/gpu-class.js).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { gpuClass } from '../src/host/web/gpu-class.js';

test('the GPU\'s kind from the renderer string WebGL gives', () => {
  const cases = {
    'ANGLE (Google, Vulkan 1.3.0 (SwiftShader Device (Subzero) (0x0000C0DE)), SwiftShader driver)': 'software',
    'ANGLE (Mesa, llvmpipe (LLVM 15.0.7, 256 bits), OpenGL 4.5)': 'software',
    'ANGLE (Microsoft, Microsoft Basic Render Driver Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)': 'software',
    'ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (0x00009A49) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)': 'integrated',
    'ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics 620 (0x00005917) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)': 'integrated',
    'ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics (0x00001638) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)': 'integrated',

    // (the laptops' integrated Arc: Meteor Lake, Lunar Lake, Arrow Lake)
    'ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Arc(TM) Graphics (0x00007D55) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)': 'integrated',

test('the tier: software low, integrated mid, discrete high; 4 GB or less low; an unknown GPU as the page\'s own rule', () => {
  const tier = (gpu, deviceMemory, saved) => chooseTier({ gpu, deviceMemory, saved }).tier;
  const iris = 'ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (0x00009A49) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)';
  const rtx = 'ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 (0x00002704) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)';
  const swift = 'ANGLE (Google, Vulkan 1.3.0 (SwiftShader Device (Subzero) (0x0000C0DE)), SwiftShader driver)';
  assert.equal(tier(iris, 8), 'mid', 'the owner\'s case: an 8 GB+ laptop with Iris Xe, high before');
  assert.equal(tier(rtx, 8), 'high'); assert.equal(tier(rtx, 0), 'high', 'deviceMemory unknown');
  assert.equal(tier(swift, 32), 'low', 'software rendering, whatever the memory');
  assert.equal(tier(rtx, 4), 'low'); assert.equal(tier(iris, 2), 'low');
  assert.deepEqual([8, 4, 0, 6].map((m) => tier(null, m)), ['high', 'low', 'mid', 'mid'], 'unknown GPU: deviceMemory as before');
  // (a session's frames measured long: a tier lower on that GPU only)
  assert.equal(tier(rtx, 8, { gpu: rtx, tier: 'mid' }), 'mid');
  assert.equal(tier(rtx, 8, { gpu: iris, tier: 'low' }), 'high', 'another GPU: not its verdict');
  assert.equal(tier(iris, 8, { gpu: iris, tier: 'high' }), 'mid', 'never higher than the GPU says');
});

test('a minute in the world with long frames: the next session a tier lower; short frames, or menus, leave it', () => {
  const run = (p99, tier = 'high', inWorld = true) => {
    const s = { p99s: [], done: false }; let next = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < FRAMES.looks + 5; i++) next = framesLook(s, { frames: { p99 }, inWorld, tier }) ?? next;
    return { next, done: s.done };
  };
  assert.deepEqual(run(80), { next: 'mid', done: true });
  assert.deepEqual(run(80, 'mid'), { next: 'low', done: true });
  assert.deepEqual(run(80, 'low'), { next: null, done: true });
  assert.deepEqual(run(30), { next: null, done: true });
  assert.deepEqual(run(80, 'high', false), { next: null, done: false }, 'not in the world: no look');
});

test('installed in the page: its tier choice asks it, the verdict stored for the next session, ?tier= left alone', () => {
  const rtx = 'ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 (0x00002704) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)';
  const storage = new Map(), store = { getItem: (k) => storage.get(k) ?? null, setItem: (k, v) => storage.set(k, v) };
  let tick = null;
  const win = { location: { search: '' }, orthrosFrames: { p99: 90 } };
  install(win, { gpu: rtx, storage: store, inWorld: () => true, setInterval: (f) => { tick = f; return 1; }, clearInterval: () => { tick = null; } });
  assert.equal(win.orthrosTier(8), 'high'); assert.equal(win.orthrosTierChoice.kind, 'discrete');
  while (tick) tick();
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(storage.get(KEY)), { gpu: rtx, tier: 'mid' });
  const next = { location: { search: '' } };
  install(next, { gpu: rtx, storage: store, inWorld: () => false, setInterval: () => 1, clearInterval() {} });
  assert.equal(next.orthrosTier(8), 'mid', 'the next session');
  let watched = false; const forced = { location: { search: '?tier=high' } };
  install(forced, { gpu: rtx, storage: store, setInterval: () => { watched = true; return 1; }, clearInterval() {} });
  forced.orthrosTier(8); assert.equal(watched, false, '?tier=: no verdict');
});

test('the engine page asks the tier module before its own rule, its log saying the GPU\'s kind', () => {
  const html = `<html><head></head><body><script>
    var __tier = (/[?&]tier=(low|mid|high)/.exec(location.search) || [])[1]
              || (__devMem >= 8 ? 'high' : (__devMem > 0 && __devMem <= 4 ? 'low' : 'mid'));
    append('[tier] '+__tier+' (navigator.deviceMemory='+(__devMem||'unknown')+')');
  </script></body></html>`;
  const out = withQualityTier(html);
  assert.ok(out.startsWith(`<html><head><script>window.orthrosTierReady = import('/src/ports/openmw/tier.js')`));
  assert.ok(out.includes("|| (window.orthrosTier ? window.orthrosTier(__devMem) : (__devMem >= 8 ? 'high'"));
  assert.ok(out.includes("(window.orthrosTierChoice ? ' (gpu: '+window.orthrosTierChoice.kind+')' : '')"));
  for (const id of ['openmw-web-v1.5.3', 'openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r1', 'openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r2', 'openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r3', 'openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r4']) {
    const release = path.join(DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR, id, 'index.html');
    if (!fs.existsSync(release)) continue;
    const real = withQualityTier(fs.readFileSync(release, 'utf8'));
    for (const k of ['orthrosTierReady = import', 'window.orthrosTier(__devMem)', 'orthrosTierChoice.kind']) assert.equal(real.split(k).length - 1, 1, `${id}: ${k}`);
  }

test('installed in the page: the world as view-grow.js sees it (joined and simulated) — no look while it still loads', () => {
```

```js
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { guardClientUi } from '../tools/openmw/guard-client-ui.mjs';
import { openmwProblem } from '../src/host/openmw.js';

function fixture(t, declaration = 'PLAYER: scripts/menu/player.lua\nMENU: scripts/menu/settings.lua\nCUSTOM: scripts/menu/actor.lua\n') {
  const game = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-ui-compat-'));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(game, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const data = path.join(game, 'versions/one/mods/menu-0'); fs.mkdirSync(data, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(data, 'Menu.omwscripts'), declaration);
  const spec = { versions: [{ id: 'one', dir: 'one', openmw: { engine: 'engine', files: ['Game.esm'], mods: [
    { id: 'menu', name: 'Menu', installed: true, parts: [{ dir: 'mods/menu-0', sentinel: 'Menu.omwscripts', plugins: ['Menu.omwscripts'], archives: [] }] },
  ] } }] };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(game, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify(spec));
  return { game, data, declaration };
}

test('OpenMW client UI guards preserve the author files and give both peers one matching plugin selection', (t) => {
  const f = fixture(t), result = guardClientUi(f.game, 'one', ['menu']);
  assert.deepEqual(result, { plugins: ['Menu.omwscripts'], wrappers: 2 });
  assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(f.data, 'Menu.omwscripts'), 'utf8'), f.declaration);
  const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(f.game, 'manifest.json'))).versions[0].openmw;
  assert.equal(openmwProblem(config), null);
  assert.deepEqual(config.mods.flatMap((m) => m.parts.flatMap((p) => p.plugins)), ['Menu.omwscripts']);
  const compat = path.join(f.game, 'versions/one', config.mods.at(-1).parts[0].dir);
  const entries = fs.readFileSync(path.join(compat, 'Menu.omwscripts'), 'utf8').trim().split('\n');
  assert.equal(entries[2], 'CUSTOM: scripts/menu/actor.lua', 'Explicit attachment keeps its registered script identity');
  for (const [index, entry] of entries.slice(0, 2).entries()) {
    const wrapper = fs.readFileSync(path.join(compat, entry.split(': ')[1]), 'utf8');
    assert.match(wrapper, /mp\.isSystem\(\) then return \{\} end/);
    assert.ok(wrapper.includes(index ? 'scripts.menu.settings' : 'scripts.menu.player'));
  }
  const manifest = fs.readFileSync(path.join(f.game, 'manifest.json'));
  assert.throws(() => guardClientUi(f.game, 'one', ['menu']), /already installed/);
  assert.deepEqual(fs.readFileSync(path.join(f.game, 'manifest.json')), manifest);
});

/** One more installed script mod in the fixture's version (its plugin `<Id>.omwscripts` holding `declaration`). */
function addMod(f, id, declaration) {
  const data = path.join(f.game, `versions/one/mods/${id}-0`), plugin = `${id}.omwscripts`, file = path.join(f.game, 'manifest.json');
  fs.mkdirSync(data, { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(data, plugin), declaration);
  const spec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file));
  spec.versions[0].openmw.mods.push({ id, name: id, installed: true, parts: [{ dir: `mods/${id}-0`, sentinel: plugin, plugins: [plugin], archives: [] }] });
  fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(spec));
  return { data, plugin };
}

test('OpenMW guards only the selected declaration types of a mod with gameplay scripts; the rest still runs on simulation peers', (t) => {
  const f = fixture(t), declaration = 'MENU: scripts/inv/settings.lua\nGLOBAL: scripts/inv/global.lua\nPLAYER: scripts/inv/player.lua\n'
    + 'CUSTOM: scripts/inv/equip.lua\nCONTAINER: scripts/inv/container.lua\nARMOR, BOOK: scripts/inv/item.lua\n';
  const inv = addMod(f, 'inv', declaration), only = addMod(f, 'world', 'GLOBAL: scripts/world/global.lua\n');
  assert.throws(() => guardClientUi(f.game, 'one', ['world:MENU,PLAYER']), /No enabled UI script plugin: world/, 'nothing of those types to guard');
  assert.throws(() => guardClientUi(f.game, 'one', ['inv:menu']), /Expected <mod-id>, <mod-id>:TYPE,TYPE or <mod-id>:SOLO/);
  const result = guardClientUi(f.game, 'one', ['menu', 'inv:MENU,PLAYER']);
  assert.deepEqual(result, { plugins: ['Menu.omwscripts', 'inv.omwscripts'], wrappers: 4 });
  assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(inv.data, inv.plugin), 'utf8'), declaration, 'the author file is unchanged');
  const mods = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(f.game, 'manifest.json'))).versions[0].openmw.mods, compat = mods.at(-1);
  assert.deepEqual(mods.find((m) => m.id === 'inv').parts[0].plugins, [], 'the plugin selection moves to the generated root');
  assert.deepEqual(mods.find((m) => m.id === 'world').parts[0].plugins, [only.plugin]);
  assert.deepEqual(compat.guardedPlugins, [{ mod: 'menu', plugin: 'Menu.omwscripts' }, { mod: 'inv', plugin: 'inv.omwscripts', guardedTypes: ['MENU', 'PLAYER'] }]);
  assert.deepEqual(compat.unguardedEntries.map((e) => e.entry), ['GLOBAL: scripts/inv/global.lua', 'CONTAINER: scripts/inv/container.lua', 'ARMOR, BOOK: scripts/inv/item.lua']);
  const generated = fs.readFileSync(path.join(f.game, 'versions/one', compat.parts[0].dir, inv.plugin), 'utf8');
  assert.equal(generated, 'MENU: scripts/orthros_client_ui/2.lua\nGLOBAL: scripts/inv/global.lua\nPLAYER: scripts/orthros_client_ui/3.lua\n'
    + 'CUSTOM: scripts/inv/equip.lua\nCONTAINER: scripts/inv/container.lua\nARMOR, BOOK: scripts/inv/item.lua\n');
});

test('OpenMW guards declarations written with the author\'s separators and spaces; a mod\'s content file stays in its root', (t) => {
  const f = fixture(t), declaration = 'PLAYER: scripts\\Max\\combat juice\\player.lua\r\nNPC, CREATURE: scripts\\Max\\combat juice\\actor.lua\r\n'
    + 'MENU: scripts\\Max\\combat juice\\menu.lua\r\n';
  const mod = addMod(f, 'juice', declaration), file = path.join(f.game, 'manifest.json');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(mod.data, 'Juice.omwaddon'), 'TES3');
  const spec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file)); spec.versions[0].openmw.mods.at(-1).parts[0].plugins.unshift('Juice.omwaddon');
  fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(spec));
  // a whole-mod guard still refuses a content file: only script-only addons are UI-only
  assert.throws(() => guardClientUi(f.game, 'one', ['juice']), /Only script-only UI addons/);
  assert.deepEqual(guardClientUi(f.game, 'one', ['juice:MENU,PLAYER'], { id: 'juice-ui-compat' }), { plugins: [mod.plugin], wrappers: 2 });
  const mods = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file)).versions[0].openmw.mods, root = path.join(f.game, 'versions/one/mods/juice-ui-compat-0');
  assert.deepEqual(mods.find((m) => m.id === 'juice').parts[0].plugins, ['Juice.omwaddon'], 'the content file stays enabled in its own root');
  assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(mod.data, mod.plugin), 'utf8'), declaration, 'the author file is unchanged');
  assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, mod.plugin), 'utf8'), 'PLAYER: scripts/orthros_juice_ui/0.lua\n'
    + 'NPC, CREATURE: scripts\\Max\\combat juice\\actor.lua\nMENU: scripts/orthros_juice_ui/1.lua\n');
  assert.match(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'scripts/orthros_juice_ui/0.lua'), 'utf8'), /require\("scripts\.Max\.combat juice\.player"\)/);
  assert.match(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'scripts/orthros_juice_ui/1.lua'), 'utf8'), /require\("scripts\.Max\.combat juice\.menu"\)/);
  assert.equal(openmwProblem({ engine: 'engine', files: ['Game.esm'], mods }), null);
  // a path whose module name would resolve elsewhere (a dot in a folder) is refused
  addMod(f, 'dotted', 'PLAYER: scripts/v1.2/player.lua\n');
  assert.throws(() => guardClientUi(f.game, 'one', ['dotted'], { id: 'dotted-ui-compat' }), /Unsupported UI script declaration/);
});
```

`tests/openmw-ui-l10n.test.js`:

```js
// The OpenMW engine page's own interface in the Orthros page's language (src/ports/openmw/ui-l10n.js), on a small
// stand-in of a page: whole phrases, phrases ending with a name, attributes, and nothing when the page is English.
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { runInNewContext } from 'node:vm';

const source = fs.readFileSync(new URL('../src/ports/openmw/ui-l10n.js', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
const text = (v) => ({ nodeType: 3, nodeValue: v, parentNode: null });
function el(name, attrs = {}, ...kids) {
  const e = { nodeType: 1, nodeName: name, attrs: { ...attrs }, childNodes: kids, getAttribute: (a) => e.attrs[a] ?? null, setAttribute: (a, v) => { e.attrs[a] = v; } };
  for (const k of kids) k.parentNode = e;
  return e;
}
function run(lang, body) {
  const observed = [];
  const document = { body, documentElement: {}, addEventListener() {} };
  runInNewContext(source, { document, localStorage: { getItem: () => lang }, navigator: { languages: ['en-US'] }, MutationObserver: class { constructor(fn) { observed.push(fn); } observe() {} } });
  return { document, mutate: (records) => observed[0]?.(records) };
}

test('the engine page in French: phrases, names kept, attributes, never in a script', () => {
  const tour = text('You are in the world'), next = text('Next ▸'), request = text('Friend request sent to Nerevar'), invite = text('Vivec invited you to join them.');
  const chat = el('INPUT', { placeholder: 'Type a message…', type: 'text' }), other = text('Sanglant Seyda Neen'), script = text('Close');
  const body = el('BODY', {}, el('DIV', {}, tour, next), el('P', {}, request, invite), chat, el('SPAN', {}, other), el('SCRIPT', {}, script));
  const page = run('fr', body);
  assert.equal(tour.nodeValue, 'Tu es dans le monde'); assert.equal(next.nodeValue, 'Suivant ▸');
  assert.equal(request.nodeValue, 'Demande d’ami envoyée à Nerevar'); assert.equal(invite.nodeValue, 'Vivec t’invite à le rejoindre.');
  assert.equal(chat.attrs.placeholder, 'Écris un message…');
  assert.equal(other.nodeValue, 'Sanglant Seyda Neen', 'a text it does not know: left as it is');
  assert.equal(script.nodeValue, 'Close', 'never in a script');
  assert.equal(page.document.documentElement.lang, 'fr');
  // (written later by the engine)
  const late = text('Connection lost');
  page.mutate([{ type: 'childList', addedNodes: [el('DIV', {}, late)] }]);
  assert.equal(late.nodeValue, 'Connexion perdue');
});

test('the engine page stays English for an English page', () => {
  const tour = text('You are in the world');
  run('en', el('BODY', {}, el('DIV', {}, tour)));
  assert.equal(tour.nodeValue, 'You are in the world');
});
```

`tests/openmw-view.test.js`:

```js
// The OpenMW engine page's view distance on a link that is not fast (src/ports/openmw/view-grow.js, view.lua; the
// page's hooks put in by src/host/openmw.js withProgressiveView): short at boot, raised by steps as the game data is
// quiet and the frames short, its far loads light; the player's own setting wins; Orthros' script always loaded.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { VIEW, VIEW_FILE, CONTENT, growStep, parseView, install, inWorld } from '../src/ports/openmw/view-grow.js';
import { withProgressiveView } from '../src/host/openmw.js';
import { DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR } from '../src/host/goldsrc.js';

const LUA = fs.readFileSync(new URL('../src/ports/openmw/view.lua', import.meta.url), 'utf8');

test('the view grows by steps in an exterior, the game data quiet and the frames short, up to the tier\'s distance', () => {
  const s = { phase: 'wait', start: 8192, target: 12288, value: 8192, since: 0 };
  const look = (o) => growStep(s, { report: { live: s.value, base: 8192 }, exterior: true, quiet: true, framesOk: true, now: 0, ...o });
  assert.deepEqual(growStep(s, { report: null, exterior: true, quiet: true, framesOk: true, now: 0 }), {}, 'not in the world yet');
  assert.deepEqual(look({ exterior: false }), {}, 'inside: held');
  assert.deepEqual(look({ quiet: false }), {}, 'a read waited: held');
  assert.deepEqual(look({ framesOk: false }), {}, 'long frames: held');
  assert.deepEqual(look({ now: 1000 }), { write: 10240, prefer: 'light' }, 'a step: its loads light');
  assert.equal(s.phase, 'loading');
  assert.deepEqual(growStep(s, { report: { live: 8192, base: 8192 }, exterior: true, quiet: true, framesOk: true, now: 9000 }), {}, 'not applied by the script yet');
  assert.deepEqual(look({ now: 2000 }), {}, 'applied, not quiet for long enough since');
  assert.deepEqual(look({ now: 1000 + VIEW.quietMs, quiet: false }), {}, 'its loads wait');
  assert.deepEqual(look({ now: 1000 + VIEW.quietMs }), { prefer: null }, 'loaded');
  assert.equal(s.phase, 'wait');
  assert.deepEqual(look({ now: 5000 }), { write: 12288, prefer: 'light' });
  assert.deepEqual(look({ now: 9000 }), { prefer: null }); assert.equal(s.phase, 'done');
  assert.deepEqual(look({ now: 20000 }), {}, 'done: left alone');
});

test('the player\'s own view distance (saved, or changed in Options) stops the growth', () => {
  const s = { phase: 'loading', start: 8192, target: 16384, value: 10240, since: 0 };
  assert.deepEqual(growStep(s, { report: { live: 14336, base: 14336 }, exterior: true, quiet: true, framesOk: true, now: 9000 }), { prefer: null });
  assert.equal(s.phase, 'stopped');
  assert.deepEqual(parseView('10240 8192'), { live: 10240, base: 8192 }); assert.equal(parseView(undefined), null); assert.equal(parseView('x'), null);
});

/** An engine page's stand-ins: its window, its FS, the game data's quiet, a clock. */
function page({ slow, streamfs = true }) {
  const files = new Map(), dirs = [], ticks = [], data = { quiet: () => true, kind: 'unset', prefer(k) { this.kind = k; } };
  const win = { omw: { state: {} }, ...(streamfs ? { StreamFS: { data: () => data } } : {}) };
  const FS = { mkdirTree: (d) => dirs.push(d), writeFile: (f, t) => files.set(f, t) };
  let t = 0;
  return { win, FS, files, dirs, ticks, data, at: (v) => { t = v; }, o: { lua: LUA, slow, now: () => t, setInterval: (f) => { ticks.push(f); return 1; }, clearInterval: () => {} } };
}

test('on a link that is not fast the engine boots short and Orthros\' script steers its view; the content always loaded', async () => {
  const p = page({ slow: true });
  const g = await install(p.win, p.o);
  assert.equal(p.win.orthrosViewBoot('16384'), '8192'); assert.equal(p.win.orthrosViewStart, 8192); assert.equal(p.win.orthrosViewTarget, 16384);
  const cfg = p.win.orthrosContent(p.FS, ['data=/mwdata', 'content=Morrowind.esm']);
  assert.deepEqual(cfg.slice(-1), [`content=${CONTENT}`]);
  assert.equal(p.files.get('/resources/vfs/orthros.omwscripts'), 'PLAYER: scripts/orthros/view.lua\n');
  assert.equal(p.files.get('/resources/vfs/scripts/orthros/view.lua'), LUA);
  assert.equal(p.files.get(VIEW_FILE), '8192 8192');
  assert.equal(p.win.orthrosContent(p.FS, cfg).filter((l) => l === `content=${CONTENT}`).length, 1, 'once');
  assert.equal(p.ticks.length, 1, 'its look every half second');
  p.win.omw.state['orthros.view'] = '8192 8192'; p.win.omw.state['orthros.cell'] = '-3 -2';
  p.win.orthrosFrames = { p99: 200 }; p.at(1000); g.tick();
  assert.equal(p.files.get(VIEW_FILE), '8192 8192', 'long frames: held');
  p.win.orthrosFrames = { p99: 16 }; p.at(1000 + VIEW.holdMs); g.tick();
  assert.equal(p.files.get(VIEW_FILE), '10240 8192'); assert.equal(p.data.kind, 'light');
  p.win.omw.state['orthros.view'] = '10240 8192'; p.at(1000 + VIEW.holdMs + VIEW.quietMs); g.tick();
  assert.equal(p.data.kind, null, 'the step loaded: the link decides again');
});

test('the usual frame is play\'s: the boot\'s half seconds without frames (an engine whose boot yields to the page) never make it 0', async () => {
  const p = page({ slow: true });
  const g = await install(p.win, p.o);
  p.win.orthrosViewBoot('16384'); p.win.orthrosContent(p.FS, []);
  // (a boot of 30 s that gives the page its turns: no frame drawn, p99 0 — none of it counted)
  p.win.orthrosFrames = { p99: 0 };
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { p.at(i * 500); g.tick(); }
  assert.deepEqual(p.win.orthrosViewState().p99s, [], 'nothing sampled before the world');
  p.win.omw.state['orthros.view'] = '8192 8192'; p.win.omw.state['orthros.cell'] = '-3 -2';
  // (in the world at 20 fps: a p99 of 66 ms — long against the fixed bound while the usual frame is unknown, 5 s)
  p.win.orthrosFrames = { p99: 66 };
  let t = 30000;
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { p.at(t += 500); g.tick(); }
  assert.equal(p.win.orthrosViewState().p99s.length, 10);
  const longAt = p.win.orthrosViewState().longAt;
  p.at(t += 500); g.tick();
  assert.equal(p.win.orthrosViewState().longAt, longAt, 'once known, the usual frame is not a long one');
  p.at(t = longAt + VIEW.holdMs); g.tick();
  assert.equal(p.files.get(VIEW_FILE), '10240 8192', 'raised as soon as the frames are as usual for holdMs');
  // (the look before the fix: the boot's zeros counted — the median 0 for 30 s, every 66 ms frame a long one)
  const zeros = [...Array(60).fill(0)], usual = [...zeros.slice(10), ...Array(10).fill(66)].sort((a, b) => a - b)[30];
  assert.ok(66 > Math.max(VIEW.longFrameMs, VIEW.longFactor * usual), 'counted, the boot\'s zeros held the raise');
});

test('on a fast link (or the release\'s own streaming) the engine boots at its tier\'s distance, the script left idle', async () => {
```

`tests/openmw-wasm-code-cache.test.js`:

```js
// The OpenMW engine page's module compiled in a worker (src/ports/openmw/wasm-code-cache.js, wasm-compile-worker.js,
// src/host/openmw.js withWasmStream): the glue's Module.instantiateWasm given the page's hook, the module the worker
// compiled from the engine's URL instantiated here; the worker failing, the module streamed here; an instantiation that
// fails, or no module anywhere: Module.onAbort, as the glue's abort; ?omwenv=OPENMW_ORTHROS_WASMWORKER=0 leaves no hook
// (the glue's own path).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import vm from 'node:vm';
import { withWasmStream } from '../src/host/openmw.js';

const SCRIPT = fs.readFileSync(new URL('../src/ports/openmw/wasm-code-cache.js', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
/** The smallest WebAssembly module (its header). */
const EMPTY = new Uint8Array([0, 97, 115, 109, 1, 0, 0, 0]);

/** A module that imports a.b (a function): its instantiation with no such import fails. */
const IMPORTING = new Uint8Array([0, 97, 115, 109, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 4, 1, 0x60, 0, 0, 2, 7, 1, 1, 97, 1, 98, 0, 0]);

/**
 * The script run in a page at `search` whose worker answers `answer(url)` ({ module } or { error }), fails to load
 * (`answer` null) or cannot be made (`answer` 'throw'); `fetchFails`: every fetch rejected. The page's window, the
 * workers made, what fetch and instantiateStreaming were asked and what Module.onAbort was given.
 */
function page(search, answer, { fetchFails = false } = {}) {
  const workers = [], fetched = [], streamed = [], aborted = [];
  class FakeWorker {
    constructor(src) { if (answer === 'throw') throw new Error('SecurityError'); this.src = src; this.terminated = false; workers.push(this); }
    postMessage(m) {
      this.posted = m;
      setTimeout(() => (answer ? this.onmessage({ data: answer(m.url) }) : this.onerror({ message: 'blocked', preventDefault() {} })), 0);
    }
    terminate() { this.terminated = true; }
  }
  const WA = { Module: WebAssembly.Module, Instance: WebAssembly.Instance, instantiate: WebAssembly.instantiate.bind(WebAssembly), compileStreaming() {},
    instantiateStreaming: (source, imports) => Promise.resolve(source).then((r) => { streamed.push(r); return WebAssembly.instantiate(EMPTY, imports); }) };
  const window = { location: { search, href: 'http://x/ports/openmw/m/app/index.html' + search }, Module: { locateFile: (p) => '/engines/_c/abc/' + p, onAbort: (w) => aborted.push(w) } };
  const context = vm.createContext({ window, location: window.location, WebAssembly: WA, Worker: FakeWorker, URL, Promise, Error, setTimeout, decodeURIComponent, console: { warn() {}, error() {} },
    fetch: (url, o) => { fetched.push({ url, o }); return fetchFails ? Promise.reject(new TypeError('Failed to fetch')) : Promise.resolve(new Response(EMPTY, { headers: { 'content-type': 'application/wasm' } })); } });
  vm.runInContext(SCRIPT, context);
  return { window, workers, fetched, streamed, aborted };
}

/** The page's hook called as the glue does, for a failure: what Module.onAbort got (receive must not be called). */
const failing = (p, imports = {}) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  p.window.orthrosInstantiateWasm(imports, () => reject(new Error('received')));
  const wait = () => (p.aborted.length ? resolve(p.aborted[0]) : setTimeout(wait, 1));
  wait();
});

/** The page's hook called as the glue does: (instance, module) once received. */
const instantiate = (p, imports = {}) => new Promise((resolve) => { const back = p.window.orthrosInstantiateWasm(imports, (instance, module) => resolve({ instance, module })); assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(back), []); });

test("withWasmStream puts the script in the page's head, ahead of the Module literal, and gives the glue its hook", () => {
  const out = withWasmStream('<html><head><script src="/src/ports/openmw/frame-meter.js"></script></head><script>\n var Module = {\n   locateFile: f,\n</script></html>');
  assert.ok(out.startsWith('<html><head><script src="/src/ports/openmw/wasm-code-cache.js"></script><script src="/src/ports/openmw/frame-meter.js">'));
  assert.ok(out.includes('var Module = {\n   instantiateWasm: window.orthrosInstantiateWasm,\n   locateFile: f,'));
});

test("the worker's module, compiled from the engine's URL, instantiated here; the worker started early and kept", async () => {
  const module = new WebAssembly.Module(EMPTY);
  const p = page('?src=hosted', () => ({ module }));
  assert.equal(p.workers.length, 1); assert.equal(p.workers[0].posted, undefined); // (made as the script ran, before the glue asks)
  const r = await instantiate(p);
  assert.equal(p.workers.length, 1);
  assert.equal(p.workers[0].src, '/src/ports/openmw/wasm-compile-worker.js');
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(p.workers[0].posted), ['url']); assert.equal(p.workers[0].posted.url, 'http://x/engines/_c/abc/openmw.wasm');
  assert.equal(r.module, module); assert.ok(r.instance instanceof WebAssembly.Instance);
  assert.equal(p.workers[0].terminated, false);
  assert.equal(p.fetched.length, 0);
});

test('a worker that fails or answers no module: the module streamed here from the same URL', async () => {
  for (const answer of [null, () => ({ error: 'CompileError' }), () => ({ module: {} }), 'throw']) {
    const p = page('', answer);
    const r = await instantiate(p);
    assert.equal(p.fetched.length, 1); assert.equal(p.fetched[0].url, 'http://x/engines/_c/abc/openmw.wasm'); assert.equal(p.fetched[0].o.credentials, 'same-origin');
    assert.equal(p.streamed.length, 1);
    assert.ok(r.instance instanceof WebAssembly.Instance);
    if (answer === 'throw') assert.equal(p.workers.length, 0); else assert.equal(p.workers[0].terminated, true);
    assert.deepEqual(p.aborted, []);
  }
});

test("the worker's module failing to instantiate: reported through Module.onAbort, not compiled again here", async () => {
  const p = page('', () => ({ module: new WebAssembly.Module(IMPORTING) }));
  const reason = await failing(p);
  assert.ok(reason instanceof Error, String(reason));
  assert.equal(p.fetched.length, 0); assert.equal(p.streamed.length, 0);
});

test('the worker failing and the module unavailable here too: Module.onAbort, as the glue\'s abort', async () => {
  const p = page('', () => ({ error: 'NetworkError' }), { fetchFails: true });
  const reason = await failing(p);
  assert.match(String(reason && reason.message), /Failed to fetch/);
  assert.equal(p.fetched.length, 2); // (streamed, then as a whole)
});

test('?omwenv=OPENMW_ORTHROS_WASMWORKER=0 gives no hook (the glue compiles as before)', () => {
  for (const q of ['?omwenv=OPENMW_ORTHROS_WASMWORKER=0', '?x=1&omwenv=OPENMW_ORTHROS_UNIFORMS=0%2COPENMW_ORTHROS_WASMWORKER=0']) assert.equal(page(q, null).window.orthrosInstantiateWasm, undefined, q);
  assert.equal(typeof page('?omwenv=OPENMW_ORTHROS_UNIFORMS=0', null).window.orthrosInstantiateWasm, 'function');
});
```

```js
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(base + '/game/sample-plus/game.esm')).text(), 'master');
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(base + '/game/sample-plus/mods/fix-0/asset.dds')).text(), 'asset');
  // (without formerGame, its own installation; a mount is the Win32 games' way; formerGame names another game)
  delete spec.versions[0].formerGame; fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(spec));
  assert.equal(loadGameCatalog(f.games, null, { enginesDir: f.engines }).get('sample-plus').saveKey, 'orthros-port:sample-modded:plus');
  for (const [key, value, error] of [['requires', [{ game: 'sample', version: 'sample-1', mount: 'D:\\' }], /requires invalide/], ['formerGame', 'sample-modded', /formerGame/], ['formerGame', '../x', /formerGame/]]) {
    fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({ ...spec, versions: [{ ...spec.versions[0], [key]: value }] }));
    assert.throws(() => loadGameCatalog(f.games, null, { enginesDir: f.engines }), error);
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({ ...spec, defaults: { ...spec.defaults, formerGame: 'sample' } }));
  assert.throws(() => loadGameCatalog(f.games, null, { enginesDir: f.engines }), /defaults.formerGame est réservé/);
});

test('the engine page loads the build from the release, brotli when taken, and keeps the streamed game files', async (t) => {
  const f = fixture(t), release = path.join(f.engines, 'test-engine');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(release, 'index.html'), `<head></head><script>var __ENGINE_DIR = (__ENGINE_VER.charAt(0) === "_") ? "" : ("e/" + __ENGINE_VER + "/");`
    + `var Module = { setStatus: (t)=>{ if(t){ append(t); } } };StreamFS.mount('/mwdata/' + f.p, 'mwdata/' + encodeURI(f.p) + '?v=2', f.s);</script>`);
  const wasm = 'wasm-test'.repeat(1000);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(release, 'e/abc/openmw.wasm'), wasm);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(release, 'e/abc/openmw.wasm.br'), (await import('node:zlib')).brotliCompressSync(wasm));
  const base = await listen(t, createServer({ gamesDir: f.games, enginesDir: f.engines }));
  const page = await (await fetch(base + '/ports/openmw/sample-1/app/index.html')).text();
  assert.match(page, /\("\/engines\/test-engine\/e\/" \+ __ENGINE_VER \+ "\/"\)/, 'one URL for every installation');
  assert.match(page, /'mwdata\/' \+ encodeURI\(f\.p\), f\.s\)/, 'no query: the engine keeps the pieces it streamed');
  assert.match(page, /setStatus: \(t\)=>\{ window\.orthrosStatus\?\.\(t\); if\(t\)\{/);
  assert.match(page, /src\/host\/web\/data-meter\.js/);
  for (const url of ['/engines/test-engine/e/abc/openmw.wasm', '/ports/openmw/sample-1/app/e/abc/openmw.wasm']) {
    const raw = (opts) => new Promise((resolve) => http.get(base + url, opts, (r) => { const c = []; r.on('data', (d) => c.push(d)); r.on('end', () => resolve({ r, body: Buffer.concat(c) })); }));
    const br = await raw({ headers: { 'accept-encoding': 'gzip, deflate, br, zstd' } });
    assert.equal(br.r.headers['content-encoding'], 'br', url); assert.equal(br.r.headers['content-length'], undefined, 'the loader counts the decoded size');
    assert.equal((await import('node:zlib')).brotliDecompressSync(br.body).toString(), wasm);
    assert.match(br.r.headers['cache-control'], /immutable/); assert.equal(br.r.headers.vary, 'Accept-Encoding');
    const plain = await raw({ headers: { 'accept-encoding': 'gzip' } });
    assert.equal(plain.r.headers['content-encoding'], undefined); assert.equal(plain.body.toString(), wasm);
    const part = await raw({ headers: { 'accept-encoding': 'br', range: 'bytes=0-3' } });
    assert.equal(part.r.statusCode, 206); assert.equal(part.r.headers['content-encoding'], undefined); assert.equal(part.body.toString(), 'wasm');
  }
});

test('the engine page asks its gateway\'s two lists together: the mods\' list beside the manifest, taken by mountServerMods once', async () => {
  const page = `fetch('mwdata-manifest.json').then(function(r){ return r.json(); }).then(function(){ return mountServerMods(); });
    async function mountServerMods(){ if (/[?&]nomods=1\\b/.test(location.search)) return 'off'; var r = await fetch('mwdata-mods.json'); if (!r.ok) return 'none'; return (await r.json()).v; }`;
  const early = openmwWebText(page, '/ports/openmw/a/app', 'save');
  assert.notEqual(early, page);
  assert.equal(withModsListEarly('fetch(\'mwdata-manifest.json\')'), 'fetch(\'mwdata-manifest.json\')', 'a page without mountServerMods\'s fetch: unchanged');
  for (const [search, want, asked] of [['', 2, ['mwdata-mods.json', 'mwdata-manifest.json']], ['?nomods=1', 'off', ['mwdata-manifest.json']]]) {
    const asks = [];
    const fetch = async (u) => { asks.push(u); return { ok: true, json: async () => (u === 'mwdata-mods.json' ? { v: 2 } : []) }; };
    let done; const result = new Promise((r) => { done = r; });
    const ctx = { fetch, location: { search }, done };
    ctx.window = ctx;
    runInNewContext(early.replace('return mountServerMods(); });', 'return mountServerMods().then(done); });'), ctx);
    assert.equal(await result, want, search);
    assert.deepEqual(asks, asked, 'each list asked once, the mods\' first — beside the manifest');
    assert.equal(ctx.__orthrosModsList, null, 'the early answer taken once');
  }
});

test('the early mods\' list failing (a network error) is no unhandled rejection: mountServerMods still finds "no mods", the manifest\'s failure too', async (t) => {
  const page = `fetch('mwdata-manifest.json').then(function(r){ if (!r.ok) throw new Error('no data'); return r.json(); }).then(function(){ return later(); }).then(function(){ return mountServerMods(); }, function(){ return 'noGameData'; });
    async function mountServerMods(){ try { var r = await fetch('mwdata-mods.json'); if (!r.ok) return 'none'; return (await r.json()).v; } catch (e) { return 'out'; } }`;
  const early = openmwWebText(page, '/ports/openmw/a/app', 'save');
  const unhandled = [], on = (e) => unhandled.push(e);
  process.on('unhandledRejection', on); t.after(() => process.off('unhandledRejection', on));
  for (const [manifestOk, want] of [[true, 'out'], [false, 'noGameData']]) {
    const fetch = async (u) => {
      if (u === 'mwdata-mods.json') throw new TypeError('Failed to fetch');
      return { ok: manifestOk, json: async () => [] };
    };
    let done; const result = new Promise((r) => { done = r; });
    // (the mounts between the manifest and mountServerMods: the early request rejected long before its await)
    const ctx = { fetch, location: { search: '' }, later: () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 30)) };
    ctx.window = ctx;
    runInNewContext(early.replace("function(){ return 'noGameData'; });", "function(){ return 'noGameData'; }).then(done);"), { ...ctx, done });
    assert.equal(await result, want);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 30));
  }
  assert.deepEqual(unhandled, [], 'no unhandled rejection');
});

test('a gateway\'s data lists built at its start: polled until it answers (a final 404 too), then the mods\' list; given up when it exits', async () => {
  let up = 3, asked = [];
  const fetch = async (u) => {
    asked.push(new URL(u).pathname);
    if (up-- > 0) throw new Error('ECONNREFUSED');
    return new Response('[]', { status: u.endsWith('mods.json') ? 404 : 200 });
  };
  const lines = [], out = await warmGatewayLists({ port: 28999, every: 1, fetch, log: (l) => lines.push(l) });
  assert.equal(out.manifest.status, 200); assert.equal(out.mods.status, 404);
  assert.deepEqual(asked, [...Array(4).fill('/mwdata-manifest.json'), '/mwdata-mods.json']);
  assert.match(lines[0], /openmw\.lists_warm manifest 200 in \d+ ms, mods 404/);
  // (no data served — deliveryModel —: the manifest's 404 is the answer, not retried)
  asked = [];
  const none = await warmGatewayLists({ port: 28999, every: 1, fetch: async (u) => { asked.push(u); return new Response('', { status: 404 }); } });
  assert.equal(none.manifest.status, 404); assert.equal(asked.length, 2);
  // (a gateway starting, 503, then gone: given up)
  let n = 0;
  const gone = await warmGatewayLists({ port: 28999, every: 1, alive: () => n < 3, fetch: async () => { n++; return new Response('', { status: 503 }); }, log: (l) => lines.push(l) });
  assert.equal(gone.manifest, null); assert.equal(n, 3); assert.match(lines.at(-1), /gave up .*gateway exited/);
});

test('world travel scopes destinations received through the engine protocol before rebooting', async () => {
  const base = '/ports/openmw/sample-1/app';
  const code = openmwWebText('async function rebootIntoWorld(wsUrl){ return wsUrl; }', base, 'save');
  const context = { URL, location: new URL('https://games.example' + base + '/index.html') };
  runInNewContext(code, context);
  const travel = (url) => context.rebootIntoWorld(url);
  assert.equal(await travel('wss://games.example/w/friend-1'), 'wss://games.example' + base + '/w/friend-1');
  assert.equal(await travel('wss://games.example' + base + '/w/home'), 'wss://games.example' + base + '/w/home');
  assert.equal(await travel('wss://elsewhere.example/w/friend-1'), 'wss://elsewhere.example/w/friend-1');
  assert.equal(await travel('https://games.example/w/friend-1'), 'https://games.example/w/friend-1');
  assert.equal(await travel('wss://games.example:8443/w/friend-1'), 'wss://games.example:8443/w/friend-1');
  context.location = new URL('http://localhost:8080' + base + '/index.html');
  assert.equal(await travel('ws://localhost:8080/w/local'), 'ws://localhost:8080' + base + '/w/local');
});

test('native engine storage and adapted HTML share an installation-specific resume token', () => {
  class Storage {
    constructor() { this.items = new Map(); }
    getItem(key) { return this.items.get(key) ?? null; }
    setItem(key, value) { this.items.set(key, String(value)); }
    removeItem(key) { this.items.delete(key); }
  }
  const html = '<script>async function rebootIntoWorld(wsUrl){ return wsUrl; }</script>';
  const adapted = openmwWebText(html, '/ports/openmw/a/app', 'save-a');
  runInNewContext(adapted.match(/<script>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/)[1], { Storage, URL });
  const session = new Storage(), local = new Storage();
  session.setItem('omwmp:resume', 'native-token');
  assert.equal(session.getItem('save-a:mp:resume'), 'native-token');
  assert.equal(session.getItem('save-b:mp:resume'), null);
  assert.equal(session.items.has('omwmp:resume'), false);
  session.removeItem('save-a:mp:resume');
  assert.equal(session.getItem('omwmp:resume'), null, 'fresh HTML ticket clears the native token');
  local.setItem('omwmp:resume', 'old-local-token'); local.removeItem('save-a:mp:resume');
  assert.equal(local.getItem('omwmp:resume'), null, 'legacy token cleanup shares the namespace');
  session.setItem('unrelated', 'kept'); assert.equal(session.getItem('unrelated'), 'kept');
});

test('gateway HTTP proxy preserves streamed bytes, scopes world paths and cookies, and hides administration', async (t) => {
  let seen;
  const backend = http.createServer((req, res) => {
    seen = { path: req.url, headers: req.headers };
    if (req.url === '/worlds') { res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'set-cookie': 'session=value; Path=/; HttpOnly' }); res.end(JSON.stringify({ wsPath: '/w/test', name: '/w/keep-user-text' })); }
    else if (req.url === '/mwdata/archive.bsa') { res.writeHead(206, { 'content-type': 'application/octet-stream', 'content-range': 'bytes 1-3/5' }); res.end(Buffer.from([0, 255, 2])); }
    else { res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': 'text/html' }); res.end('<script src="/admin/static/play.js"></script>'); }
  });
  await listen(t, backend);
  const f = fixture(t, { files: ['Game.esm'], multiplayer: { port: backend.address().port } });
  const base = await listen(t, createServer({ gamesDir: f.games, enginesDir: f.engines }));
  const prefix = base + '/ports/openmw/sample-1/app';
  const r = await fetch(prefix + '/worlds', { headers: { 'cf-connecting-ip': 'forged', 'x-omw-client-ip': 'forged' } });
  assert.deepEqual(await r.json(), { wsPath: '/ports/openmw/sample-1/app/w/test', name: '/w/keep-user-text' });
  assert.match(r.headers.get('set-cookie'), /Path=\/ports\/openmw\/sample-1\/app\//);
  assert.equal(seen.headers['cf-connecting-ip'], undefined); assert.equal(seen.headers['x-omw-client-ip'], undefined);
  const binary = await fetch(prefix + '/mwdata/archive.bsa', { headers: { Range: 'bytes=1-3' } });
  assert.equal(binary.status, 206); assert.equal(seen.headers.range, 'bytes=1-3'); assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(await binary.arrayBuffer()), Buffer.from([0, 255, 2]));
  assert.match(await (await fetch(prefix + '/')).text(), /src="\/ports\/openmw\/sample-1\/app\/admin\/static\/play.js"/);
  const old = seen; const state = await (await fetch(prefix + '/admin/api/state')).json(); assert.equal(state.setup.deploymentMode, 'multiplayer'); assert.equal(seen, old);
  for (const rel of ['/admin', '/admin/api/settings', '/healthz', '/metrics']) assert.equal((await fetch(prefix + rel)).status, 404);
});

test('the WebSocket bridge forwards the world handshake and rejects a different origin', async (t) => {
  let upgrades = 0;
  const peers = new Set(), backend = http.createServer();
  backend.on('upgrade', (req, socket) => {
    upgrades++; peers.add(socket); socket.on('close', () => peers.delete(socket));
    assert.equal(req.url, '/w/test');
    const accept = createHash('sha1').update(req.headers['sec-websocket-key'] + '258EAFA5-E914-47DA-95CA-C5AB0DC85B11').digest('base64');
    socket.write(`HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\nSec-WebSocket-Accept: ${accept}\r\n\r\n`);
  });
  t.after(() => { for (const s of peers) s.destroy(); }); await listen(t, backend);
  const f = fixture(t, { files: ['Game.esm'], multiplayer: { port: backend.address().port } });
  const base = await listen(t, createServer({ gamesDir: f.games, enginesDir: f.engines }));
  const dial = (origin) => new Promise((resolve) => {
    const req = http.get(base + '/ports/openmw/sample-1/app/w/test', { headers: { Origin: origin, Upgrade: 'websocket', Connection: 'Upgrade', 'Sec-WebSocket-Version': '13', 'Sec-WebSocket-Key': 'dGhlIHNhbXBsZSBub25jZQ==' } });
    req.on('upgrade', (r, socket) => { socket.destroy(); resolve(r.statusCode); }); req.on('error', () => resolve(0));
  });
  assert.equal(await dial(base), 101); assert.equal(upgrades, 1);
  assert.equal(await dial('https://elsewhere.invalid'), 0); assert.equal(upgrades, 1);
});

test('Orthros sessions provision isolated players, protect tokens, scope caches and revoke port access', async (t) => {
  const players = new Map(), lockers = new Map(); let adminCreates = 0;
  const backend = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    let raw = ''; for await (const c of req) raw += c;
    const body = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
    const send = (status, value) => { res.writeHead(status, { 'content-type': 'application/json' }); res.end(JSON.stringify(value)); };
    if (req.url === '/auth/password') {
      if (players.get(body.name)?.password !== body.password) return send(401, {});
      const locker = 'locker-' + Math.random(); lockers.set(locker, body.name);
      return send(200, { ticket: 'ticket-' + Math.random(), locker, account: body.name });
    }
    if (req.url === '/admin/api/login') return send(200, { token: 'owner' });
    if (req.url === '/admin/api/logout') return send(200, {});
    if (req.url === '/admin/api/accounts/create') {
      assert.equal(body.role, ''); assert.equal(req.headers.authorization, 'Bearer owner'); adminCreates++;
      players.set(body.name, { password: body.password }); return send(200, {});
    }
    if (req.url === '/auth/profile') {
      const name = lockers.get(req.headers.authorization?.slice(7));
      if (!name) return send(401, {});
      if (req.method === 'POST') players.get(name).username = body.username;
      return send(200, { needsProfile: !players.get(name).username, username: players.get(name).username });
    }
    return send(200, {});
  });
  await listen(t, backend);
  const f = fixture(t, { files: ['Game.esm'], multiplayer: { port: backend.address().port } });
  const accounts = path.join(f.root, 'accounts'); fs.mkdirSync(accounts);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(accounts, 'openmw.json'), JSON.stringify({ secret: 'test-only-secret-must-be-at-least-32-characters', operators: { 'sample-1': { name: 'owner', password: 'private' } } }));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(f.engines, 'test-engine/index.html'), "<head></head><script>FS.mount(IDBFS, {}, '/userdata');</script>");
  const base = await listen(t, createServer({ gamesDir: f.games, enginesDir: f.engines, accountsDir: accounts }));
  async function request(route, method = 'GET', cookie, body) {
    return fetch(base + route, { method, headers: { Origin: base, ...(cookie ? { Cookie: cookie } : {}), 'content-type': 'application/json' }, ...(body ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}) });
  }
  const launch = '/api/openmw/sample-1/launch', prefix = '/ports/openmw/sample-1/app';
  assert.equal((await request(launch, 'POST')).status, 401);
  const register = async (username) => {
    const r = await request('/api/account/register', 'POST', null, { username, password: 'orthros-only-password' });
    assert.match(r.headers.get('set-cookie'), /Path=\/;/);
    return r.headers.get('set-cookie').split(';')[0];
  };
  const a = await register('player.one'), b = await register('player_two');
  const l1 = await (await request(launch, 'POST', a)).json();
  const l2 = await (await request(launch, 'POST', b)).json();
  const again = await (await request(launch, 'POST', a)).json();
  assert.notEqual(l1.account, l2.account); assert.equal(again.account, l1.account); assert.notEqual(again.ticket, l1.ticket);
  assert.equal(adminCreates, 2); assert.ok([...players.values()].every((p) => p.password !== 'orthros-only-password' && p.username));
  assert.equal((await fetch(base + launch, { method: 'POST', headers: { Origin: 'https://evil.invalid', Cookie: a } })).status, 403);
  assert.equal((await request(prefix + '/auth/password', 'POST', a)).status, 403);
  assert.equal((await request(prefix + '/worlds')).status, 401);
  assert.equal((await request(prefix + '/worlds', 'GET', a)).status, 200);
  const bearer = (cookie, token) => fetch(base + prefix + '/auth/profile', { headers: { Cookie: cookie, Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token } });
  assert.equal((await bearer(a, l1.locker)).status, 200);
  assert.equal((await bearer(b, l1.locker)).status, 403);
  const pageA = await request(prefix + '/index.html', 'GET', a), pageB = await request(prefix + '/index.html', 'GET', b);
  const htmlA = await pageA.text(), htmlB = await pageB.text();
  assert.match(htmlA, /orthrosCloudInstall/); assert.notEqual(htmlA, htmlB);
  assert.match(pageA.headers.get('cache-control'), /private, no-store/);
  assert.match(htmlA, /cloud.js/);
  assert.equal((await fetch(base + '/api/cloud/sample-1', { headers: { Cookie: a, 'X-Orthros-Player-Scope': 'other-account' } })).status, 401);
  await request('/api/account/logout', 'POST', a);
  assert.equal((await request(launch, 'POST', a)).status, 401);
  assert.equal((await request(prefix + '/worlds', 'GET', a)).status, 401);
});

/** A worker script of the OpenMW page run in a context of its own, with what it uses stubbed. */
function workerContext(file, extra = {}) {
  const ctx = { performance, setTimeout, clearTimeout, setInterval: () => 0, Intl, Math, Atomics, Int32Array, Uint8Array, Float64Array, DataView,
    SharedArrayBuffer, URL, Response, AbortController, crypto: globalThis.crypto, navigator: {}, location: { origin: 'http://x' }, postMessage: () => {}, ...extra };
  ctx.self = ctx;
  runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(new URL('../src/ports/openmw/' + file, import.meta.url), 'utf8'), ctx);
  return ctx;
}

test('the data indicator\'s worker draws what arrived of the step and its percentage while the page is held', () => {
  let tick = null, now = 0;
  const texts = [], c2d = new Proxy({}, { get: (o, k) => k === 'fillText' ? (t) => texts.push(t) : k === 'canvas' ? { width: 960, height: 180 } : k in o ? o[k] : () => ({ addColorStop() {} }), set: (o, k, v) => { o[k] = v; return true; } });
  const ctx = workerContext('../../host/web/data-meter-worker.js', { setInterval: (fn) => { tick = fn; }, performance: { now: () => now } });
  const shared = new SharedArrayBuffer(32), counter = new Int32Array(shared);
  ctx.onmessage({ data: { canvas: { getContext: () => c2d }, dpr: 2, lang: 'fr' } });
  ctx.onmessage({ data: { arrived: shared } }); ctx.onmessage({ data: { beat: 1 } });
  now = 1500; Atomics.store(counter, 4, 46080); Atomics.store(counter, 5, 122880); Atomics.add(counter, 2, 500000);
  ctx.onmessage({ data: { read: 65536 } }); tick();
  assert.ok(texts.includes('37 %'), texts.join(' | '));
  assert.ok(texts.some((t) => /^45 \/ 120 Mo/.test(t)), texts.join(' | '));
  // (the page paints again: it stays a moment — reasons that come and go do not make it blink —, then goes)
  texts.length = 0; now = 1600; ctx.onmessage({ data: { beat: 1 } }); tick(); assert.ok(texts.length > 0, 'kept a moment');
  for (; now < 3300; now += 100) { ctx.onmessage({ data: { beat: 1 } }); tick(); }
  texts.length = 0; ctx.onmessage({ data: { beat: 1 } }); tick(); assert.deepEqual(texts, [], 'gone once the moment is over');
});
```
