```js
test('bounds: records per session, entries per record, size', () => {
  const r = new PerfRecorder({ header, recordMs: 1000, minuteMs: 500 });
  r.clock(0, true, 'running');
  let n = 0;
  for (let s = 1; s <= MAX_RECORDS * 2 + 10; s++) { r.frame(30, 10); r.clock(s * 1000, true, 'running'); if (r.take(s * 1000)) n++; }
  assert.equal(n, MAX_RECORDS);
  assert.ok(r.take(1e7, true), 'the end is still sent');
  // entries over the cap: the oldest dropped, counted
  const e = new PerfRecorder({ header, minuteMs: 1000 });
  e.clock(0, true, 'running');
  for (let s = 1; s <= MAX_ENTRIES + 5; s++) { e.frame(30, 10); e.clock(s * 1000, true, 'running'); }
  const rec = e.take(1e5, true);
  assert.equal(rec.mins.length, MAX_ENTRIES); assert.ok(rec.dropped >= 5);
  // a record over the size: the histogram, then entries
  const big = { event: 'perf', mins: Array.from({ length: 12 }, () => ({ cats: Object.fromEntries(Array.from({ length: 300 }, (_, i) => ['k' + i, i])) })), tot: { h: Array.from({ length: 300 }, (_, i) => i) } };
  const fit = fitRecord(big);
  assert.ok(JSON.stringify(fit).length <= PERF_MAX_BYTES && fit.dropped > 0 && !fit.tot.h);
});

test('the probe, compact; sent once and at the end', () => {
  const p = compactProbe({ atomicsWait1: { n: 24, mean: 14, p50: 14.6, p90: 15.1, max: 16 }, setTimeout1: { n: 24, mean: 15, p50: 15.6, p90: 16, max: 17 }, battery: { charging: false, level: 0.5 }, injected: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual(p, { atomicsWait1: [14.6, 15.1, 16], setTimeout1: [15.6, 16, 17], battery: { charging: false, level: 0.5 } });
  const r = new PerfRecorder({ header, recordMs: 10000, minuteMs: 5000 });
  r.clock(0, true, 'running'); r.setProbe({ atomicsWait1: { p50: 1, p90: 2, max: 3 } });
  play(r, 0, 11, { phase: 'running' }); r.clock(11000, true, 'running');
  const r1 = r.take(11000); assert.ok(r1.probe);
  play(r, 11000, 11, { phase: 'running' });
  const r2 = r.take(22000); assert.equal(r2?.probe, undefined);
  assert.ok(r.take(23000, true).probe);
});

/** a valid record as the page sends it */
function sample() {
  const r = new PerfRecorder({ header: { ...header, runtime: 'win32' } });
  r.counters({ gpu: { state: 'on', frames: 0, ms: 0, hist: new Array(HIST_N).fill(0) }, data: { waits: 0, ms: 0 } });
  r.clock(0, true, 'running'); play(r, 0, 30, { slowEvery: 25 });
  r.setProbe({ atomicsWait1: { p50: 1, p90: 2, max: 3 }, battery: { charging: true, level: 1 } });
  const rec = r.take(30000, true);
  rec.env = { gpu: IRIS, gpuVendor: 'Google Inc. (Intel)', gpuClass: 'integrated', cores: 8, memGB: 8, ua: 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) Chrome/154.0.0.0', screen: '1920x1080@1.25' };
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(rec));
}

test('the server-side check: known fields kept, the rest dropped, bad records refused', () => {
  const rec = sample(), v = sanitizePerfRecord(rec);
  assert.ok(v.ok, v.error);
  assert.deepEqual(v.rec, rec, 'a page\'s record passes unchanged');
  const extra = { ...sample(), secret: 'x', env: { ...sample().env, email: 'a@b.c' }, mins: [{ ...sample().mins[0], name: 'me', cats: { ok: 1, 'bad key': 2, n: NaN } }] };
  const w = sanitizePerfRecord(extra);
  assert.ok(w.ok);
  assert.equal(w.rec.secret, undefined); assert.equal(w.rec.env.email, undefined); assert.equal(w.rec.mins[0].name, undefined);
  assert.deepEqual(w.rec.mins[0].cats, { ok: 1 });
  for (const [k, bad] of [['session', 'x'], ['session', '../../etc'], ['runtime', 'dos'], ['seq', -1], ['seq', MAX_RECORDS + 1], ['seq', 1.5], ['v', 2], ['mins', 'no'], ['mins', new Array(MAX_ENTRIES + 1).fill({})], ['tot', null]]) {
    assert.equal(sanitizePerfRecord({ ...sample(), [k]: bad }).ok, false, `${k}=${JSON.stringify(bad).slice(0, 30)}`);
  }
  const long = sanitizePerfRecord({ ...sample(), game: 'g'.repeat(500), mins: [{ ...sample().mins[0], ph: 'p'.repeat(100), fps: Infinity, p99: -3 }] });
  assert.equal(long.rec.game.length, 120); assert.equal(long.rec.mins[0].ph.length, 24);
  assert.equal(long.rec.mins[0].fps, undefined); assert.equal(long.rec.mins[0].p99, undefined);
  assert.equal(sanitizePerfRecord({ ...sample(), tot: { ...sample().tot, h: [1, 2, 3.5] } }).rec.tot.h, undefined);
});

test('/api/telemetry: perf records checked, limited in size, written rebuilt', async (t) => {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-perf-'));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const games = path.join(root, 'games'), tel = path.join(root, 'tel'); fs.mkdirSync(games); fs.mkdirSync(tel);
  const server = createServer({ gamesDir: games, enginesDir: path.join(root, 'engines'), telemetryDir: tel, lanLog: () => {} });
  await new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  t.after(() => new Promise((resolve) => { server.closeAllConnections?.(); server.close(resolve); }));
  const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/api/telemetry`;
  const post = (body) => fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: typeof body === 'string' ? body : JSON.stringify(body) }).then((r) => r.status);
  assert.equal(await post({ ...sample(), extra: 1 }), 204);
  assert.equal(await post({ ...sample(), runtime: 'nope' }), 400);
  assert.equal(await post({ ...sample(), pad: 'x'.repeat(PERF_MAX_BYTES) }), 413);
  assert.equal(await post({ session: 'old', samples: [{ dt: 0.5, pad: 'x'.repeat(PERF_MAX_BYTES) }] }), 204, 'other telemetry keeps its own limit');
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
  const lines = fs.readdirSync(tel).flatMap((f) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(tel, f), 'utf8').trim().split('\n')).map((l) => JSON.parse(l));
  const perf = lines.filter((l) => l.event === 'perf');
  assert.equal(perf.length, 1); assert.equal(perf[0].extra, undefined); assert.ok(perf[0].at);
  assert.equal(lines.length, 2);
});

/** A window for PerfSession: animation frames run by the test, visibility, listeners. */
function fakeWindow() {
  const listeners = {}, docListeners = {}, frames = [];
  const win = {
    document: { visibilityState: 'visible', addEventListener: (k, f) => { (docListeners[k] ??= []).push(f); }, removeEventListener: () => {} },
    addEventListener: (k, f) => { (listeners[k] ??= []).push(f); }, removeEventListener: () => {},
    requestAnimationFrame: (cb) => { frames.push(cb); return frames.length; },
    run(t) { const cbs = frames.splice(0); for (const cb of cbs) cb(t); },
    fire(k) { for (const f of listeners[k] ?? []) f(); }, fireDoc(k) { for (const f of docListeners[k] ?? []) f(); },
  };
  return win;
}

test('the page side: frames shown, the engine\'s work per frame, the GPU timer, hidden frames, the end once', (t) => {
  const win = fakeWindow(), sent = [];
  let now = 0, draws = 0, queries = 0;
  const realNow = performance.now;
  // (the engine's work: performance.now as the fake clock)
  performance.now = () => now;
  t.after(() => { performance.now = realNow; });
  const gl = { getExtension: (n) => (n === 'EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2' ? {} : null), createQuery: () => ({ id: ++queries }), beginQuery() {}, endQuery() {}, deleteQuery() {}, getParameter: () => false, getQueryParameter: (q, p) => (p === 'avail' ? true : 7e6), QUERY_RESULT_AVAILABLE: 'avail', QUERY_RESULT: 'res' };
  const s = new PerfSession({ runtime: 'openmw', game: 'mw', session: 'sess1234', win, now: () => now, probe: false, send: (r) => sent.push(r), phase: () => 'world', data: () => ({ waits: 0, ms: 0 }), env: () => ({ gpu: IRIS, cores: 8, memGB: 8 }) });
  t.after(() => clearInterval(s.timer));
  s.watchFrames({ gl: () => gl, draws: () => draws });
  // the engine: an animation frame loop drawing every frame, 12 ms of work, frames every 33 ms (30 fps)
  const engine = (ts) => { now = ts + 12; draws++; win.requestAnimationFrame(engine); };
  win.requestAnimationFrame(engine);
  for (let f = 1; f <= 30 * 70; f++) { const ts = f * 33.333; now = ts; win.run(ts); if (f % 30 === 0) { now = ts + 20; s.tick(); } }
  // hidden 30 s (no frames), then back
  win.document.visibilityState = 'hidden'; win.fireDoc('visibilitychange');
  now += 30000; s.tick();
  win.document.visibilityState = 'visible'; win.fireDoc('visibilitychange');
  const base = now;
  for (let f = 1; f <= 30 * 60; f++) { const ts = base + f * 33.333; now = ts; win.run(ts); if (f % 30 === 0) { now = ts + 20; s.tick(); } }
  assert.equal(sent.length, 1, 'one record after 2 min');
  win.fire('pagehide'); win.fire('pagehide'); s.end();
  assert.equal(sent.length, 2, 'the end once');
  const [first, last] = sent;
  assert.equal(first.runtime, 'openmw'); assert.equal(first.env.gpuClass, 'integrated');
  const m = first.mins[0];
  assert.ok(m.fps > 29 && m.fps < 31, `fps ${m.fps}`);
  assert.ok(m.p50 >= 33 && m.p50 <= 34, `p50 ${m.p50}`); assert.equal(m.f40, 0);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(m.work - 12) < 0.5, `work ${m.work}`); assert.ok(Math.abs(m.wait - 21.3) < 0.5, `wait ${m.wait}`);
  assert.equal(last.final, true);
  assert.ok(last.tot.max < 40, `the hidden gap is no frame (max ${last.tot.max})`);
  assert.ok(last.hid >= 29 && last.hid <= 31, `hidden ${last.hid}`);
  assert.ok(last.tot.gpu?.n > 0 && last.tot.gpu.mean === 7, JSON.stringify(last.tot.gpu));
  assert.ok(sanitizePerfRecord(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(last))).ok);
});

test('the page side: an engine whose animation frame comes before the meter\'s has its work of the right frame', (t) => {
  const win = fakeWindow(), sent = [];
  let now = 0, draws = 0;
  const realNow = performance.now;
  performance.now = () => now;
  t.after(() => { performance.now = realNow; });
  // (the engine's loop first: in each frame its callback runs before the meter's, its request is that frame's)
  const engine = (ts) => { now = ts + 8; draws++; win.requestAnimationFrame(engine); };
  win.requestAnimationFrame(engine);
  const s = new PerfSession({ runtime: 'goldsrc', game: 'hl', session: 'sess5678', win, now: () => now, probe: false, send: (r) => sent.push(r), phase: () => 'running', env: () => ({ gpu: IRIS }) });
  t.after(() => clearInterval(s.timer));
  s.watchFrames({ draws: () => draws });
  for (let f = 1; f <= 30 * 20; f++) { const ts = f * 33.333; now = ts; win.run(ts); if (f % 30 === 0) { now = ts + 20; s.tick(); } }
  s.end();
  const m = sent.at(-1).tot;
  assert.ok(Math.abs(m.work - 8) < 0.5, `work ${m.work}`);
  assert.equal(m.gpu, undefined, 'no context: no GPU part');
});

test('WebGL1 timer queries through the WebGL2 names', () => {
  const calls = [];
  const ext = { QUERY_RESULT_EXT: 0x8866, QUERY_RESULT_AVAILABLE_EXT: 0x8867, createQueryEXT: () => 'q', beginQueryEXT: (a, q) => calls.push(['begin', a, q]), endQueryEXT: (a) => calls.push(['end', a]), getQueryObjectEXT: (q, p) => (p === 0x8867 ? true : 5), deleteQueryEXT: () => calls.push(['delete']) };
  const gl1 = { getExtension: (n) => (n === 'EXT_disjoint_timer_query' ? ext : null), getParameter: () => false };
  const t = timerContext(gl1);
  assert.equal(t.getExtension('EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2'), ext);
  t.beginQuery(0x88bf, t.createQuery()); t.endQuery(0x88bf);
  assert.deepEqual(calls, [['begin', 0x88bf, 'q'], ['end', 0x88bf]]);
  assert.equal(t.getQueryParameter('q', t.QUERY_RESULT), 5);
  assert.equal(timerContext({ getExtension: () => null }).getExtension('EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2'), null);
});

test('--perf: sessions per game × GPU, medians, the worst minutes, slow frames\' causes, the GPU filter', (t) => {
  const mk = (session, gpu, slowEvery, game = 'g1') => {
    const r = new PerfRecorder({ header: { ...header, session, game } });
    r.clock(0, true, 'running'); play(r, 0, 125, { slowEvery, slowMs: 150 });
    const a = r.take(125000); play(r, 125000, 60, { slowEvery, slowMs: 150 }); r.setProbe({ atomicsWait1: { p50: 14.5, p90: 15, max: 16 }, battery: { charging: false, level: 0.4 } });
    const b = r.take(185000, true);
    return [a, b].map((x) => ({ at: '2026-10-23T10:00:00.000Z', ...x, env: { gpu, cores: 8, memGB: 8, ua: 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0) Chrome/154.0.0.0' } }));
  };
  const blank = new PerfRecorder({ header: { ...header, session: 's5aaaa' } }); blank.clock(0, true, 'loading'); for (let i = 1; i <= 90; i++) blank.clock(i * 1000, true, 'loading');
  const noFrame = { at: '2026-10-23T10:00:00.000Z', ...blank.take(90000, true), env: { gpu: IRIS } };
  const lines = [noFrame, ...mk('s1aaaa', IRIS, 10), ...mk('s2aaaa', IRIS, 50), ...mk('s3aaaa', 'ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (0x2560) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)', 0), ...mk('s4aaaa', IRIS, 0, 'g2'), { session: 'old', samples: [] }];
  lines.push(lines[0]); // (a record received twice)
  assert.equal(perfSessions(lines).get('s1aaaa').mins.length, 4, 'a record received twice counts once');
  const groups = perfReport(perfSessions(lines));
  assert.deepEqual(groups.map((g) => `${g.game} ${g.gpu} ${g.sessions}`), ['g1 Intel Iris Xe Graphics 2', 'g1 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 1', 'g2 Intel Iris Xe Graphics 1']);
  const iris = groups[0];
  assert.ok(iris.minutes > 6 && iris.minutes < 6.4, `minutes ${iris.minutes}`);
  assert.ok(iris.median.per40 > 0 && iris.worst.length === 3 && iris.worst[0].session === 's1aaaa');
  assert.ok(iris.merged.p99 >= 150);
  assert.ok(iris.slowShares.work > 0 && iris.slowShares.other > 0);
  assert.equal(iris.probe.atomicsWait1P50, 14.5); assert.equal(iris.probe.onBattery, 2);
  const fil = perfReport(perfSessions(lines, { gpu: 'iris', game: 'g1' }));
  assert.deepEqual(fil.map((g) => g.gpu), ['Intel Iris Xe Graphics']);
  const text = formatPerf(groups);
  assert.match(text, /g1 \(goldsrc\) × Intel Iris Xe Graphics: 2 session\(s\), [\d.]+ min of visible play; 1 session\(s\) without a frame shown/);
  assert.match(text, /worst minute: s1aaaa/);
  assert.match(text, /slow frames' time by cause/);
  assert.equal(gpuLabel('ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M2, Unspecified Version)'), 'Apple M2');
  // (the classic per-session report keeps the page's own machine: a perf record of the same session does not replace it)
  const classic = buildSessions([{ session: 's1aaaa', game: 'g1', samples: [], env: { gpu: IRIS, coi: true, version: 'b0' } }, lines[0]]);
  assert.equal(classic.get('s1aaaa').env.coi, true);
  // the command line
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-perf-report-'));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'telemetry-2026-10-23.jsonl'), lines.map((l) => JSON.stringify(l)).join('\n') + '\n');
  const out = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['tools/telemetry-report.mjs', dir, '--perf', '--gpu', 'Iris', '--game', 'g1'], { encoding: 'utf8' });
  assert.equal(out.status, 0, out.stderr);
  assert.match(out.stdout, /Intel Iris Xe Graphics: 2 session/); assert.doesNotMatch(out.stdout, /NVIDIA/);
  const js = JSON.parse(spawnSync(process.execPath, ['tools/telemetry-report.mjs', dir, '--perf', '--json'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).stdout);
  assert.equal(js.length, 3);
});

test('data waits attributed: the files, the engine\'s own stops, announced reads, the background by producer; in the totals only', () => {
  const sum = {
    files: { 'Audio/VROCK.adf': [120, 35000], 'models/gta3.img': [300, 4200], 'Audio/Water.mp3': [9, 900], 'anim/ped.ifp': [1, 20], 'x': [0, 0] },
    blocked: { count: 140, ms: 38123.4, max: 812.6, files: { 'Audio/VROCK.adf': 35100.2, 'models/gta3.img': 3000, 'Audio/Water.mp3': 23.2, 'data/x.dat': 0.1 } },
    wantWaits: 2, wantWaitMs: 310.4, wantTimeouts: 0,
    bgBy: { pf1: { requests: 10, wire: 2 << 20, raw: 3 << 20, inLoad: 1 << 20 }, mediaAhead: { requests: 3, wire: 512 << 10, raw: 512 << 10, inLoad: 0 }, idle: { requests: 0, wire: 0, raw: 0, inLoad: 0 }, 'bad key': { requests: 1, wire: 9, raw: 9, inLoad: 0 } },
  };
  const c = compactDataSum(sum);
  assert.deepEqual(c, {
    files: [['Audio/VROCK.adf', 35000, 120], ['models/gta3.img', 4200, 300], ['Audio/Water.mp3', 900, 9]],
    blocked: { n: 140, ms: 38123, max: 813, top: [['Audio/VROCK.adf', 35100], ['models/gta3.img', 3000], ['Audio/Water.mp3', 23]] },
    want: { n: 2, ms: 310, to: 0 },
    bg: { pf1: [10, 2048, 1024], mediaAhead: [3, 512, 0] },
  });
  assert.equal(compactDataSum({ files: {}, blocked: null, wantWaits: 0, bgBy: null }), null, 'nothing to say: no part');
  assert.equal(compactDataSum({ files: { ['d/'.repeat(200) + 'f.bin']: [1, 5] } }).files[0][0].length, PATH_MAX, 'a long path: its end');
  // in the record: the totals carry the session's so far, the minutes their counts only; the server keeps them
  const r = new PerfRecorder({ header });
  r.counters({ data: { waits: 0, ms: 0, sum: null } }); r.clock(0, true, 'running');
  play(r, 0, 60);
  r.counters({ data: { waits: 430, ms: 40000, sum } });
  play(r, 60000, 61);
  const rec = r.take(121000, true);
  assert.deepEqual(rec.tot.data, { n: 430, ms: 40000, ...c });
  for (const m of rec.mins) assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(m.data ?? {}).sort(), ['ms', 'n']);
  const v = sanitizePerfRecord(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(rec)));
  assert.ok(v.ok, v.error); assert.deepEqual(v.rec.tot.data, rec.tot.data);
  // (the server: the totals' data rebuilt from its known parts, bounded — paths cut, bad lists and keys dropped)
  const bad = sanitizePerfRecord({ ...rec, tot: { ...rec.tot, data: { n: 1, ms: 2, files: [['a', 1, 2], ['b', -1, 2], ['c'.repeat(400), 1, 1], ['d', 1, 1]], blocked: { n: 1, ms: 2, max: 2, top: [['a', 1, 9]], who: 'x' }, want: 'x', bg: { pf: [1, 2, 3], 'no way': [1, 2, 3], ok: [1, 2] }, secret: 1 } } });
  assert.ok(bad.ok);
  assert.deepEqual(bad.rec.tot.data, { n: 1, ms: 2, files: [['a', 1, 2], ['c'.repeat(PATH_MAX), 1, 1]], blocked: { n: 1, ms: 2, max: 2 }, bg: { pf: [1, 2, 3] } });
  assert.deepEqual(sanitizePerfRecord({ ...rec, mins: [{ ...rec.mins[0], data: { n: 1, ms: 2, files: [['a', 1, 2]] } }] }).rec.mins[0].data, { n: 1, ms: 2 }, 'a minute\'s data: its counts only');
});

test('data waits attributed: compacted only when a record takes them, the same values as compacting at every clock tick', () => {
  // the page's source (portDataSummary): `sum` a getter over live counters; the record compacts what it says when taken
  const live = { files: { 'a.bin': [1, 10] }, blocked: null, wantWaits: 0, wantWaitMs: 0, wantTimeouts: 0, bgBy: null };
  let reads = 0;
  const src = () => ({ waits: 1, ms: 10, get sum() { reads++; return { ...live, files: { ...live.files } }; } });
  const r = new PerfRecorder({ header });
  r.counters({ data: src() }); r.clock(0, true, 'running');
  for (let s = 1; s <= 30; s++) { live.files[`f${s}.bin`] = [s, s]; play(r, (s - 1) * 1000, 1); r.counters({ data: src() }); r.take(s * 1000); }
  assert.equal(reads, 0, 'the clock ticks before a record is due: no summary read, no sort');
  play(r, 30000, 100); r.counters({ data: src() });
  const rec = r.take(130000);
  assert.equal(reads, 1, 'one read for the record');
  assert.deepEqual(rec.tot.data, { n: 1, ms: 10, ...compactDataSum(live) }, 'the values at the record\'s tick');
  // the source gone (no sum any more): what it said last kept, read when it went — as compacting at each tick did
  play(r, 130000, 1); r.counters({ data: src() }); r.take(131000);
  const before = compactDataSum(live);
  r.counters({ data: { waits: 1, ms: 10 } }); assert.equal(reads, 2, 'compacted when the source goes');
  live.files['later.bin'] = [9, 9];
  r.counters({ data: null });
  play(r, 131000, 130); r.counters({ data: { waits: 1, ms: 10 } });
  assert.deepEqual(r.take(261000, true).tot.data, { n: 1, ms: 10, ...before });
});

test('a port\'s data for its record: the shared game data\'s waits by file, the engine\'s stops under its root, the link\'s producers', (t) => {
  assert.equal(portDataSummary(null), null);
  // (the shared game data counts every wait of the engine by file: data-client.js waited)
  const gd = { stats: { fileWaits: {}, misses: 0, stallMs: 0, wantWaits: 1, wantWaitMs: 40, wantTimeouts: 1 }, net: { bgBy: { pf: { requests: 2, wire: 4096, raw: 4096, inLoad: 0 } } } };
  GameData.prototype.waited.call(gd, { path: 'Audio/VROCK.adf' }, 300); GameData.prototype.waited.call(gd, { path: 'Audio/VROCK.adf' }, 200); GameData.prototype.waited.call(gd, { src: 4 }, 10);
  assert.deepEqual(gd.stats.fileWaits, { 'Audio/VROCK.adf': [2, 500], 'src:4': [1, 10] });
  assert.equal(gd.stats.misses, 3); assert.equal(gd.stats.stallMs, 510);
  const engine = { orthrosBlocked: { count: 2, ms: 520, max: 310, files: { '/game/Audio/VROCK.adf': 510, '/elsewhere/x': 10 } } };
  const d = portDataSummary(gd, engine, { root: '/game' });
  assert.equal(d.waits, 3); assert.equal(d.ms, 510);
  assert.deepEqual(d.sum, { files: gd.stats.fileWaits, blocked: { count: 2, ms: 520, max: 310, files: { 'Audio/VROCK.adf': 510, '/elsewhere/x': 10 } }, wantWaits: 1, wantWaitMs: 40, wantTimeouts: 1, bgBy: gd.net.bgBy });
  assert.equal(portDataSummary(gd).sum.blocked, null, 'an engine that does not count its stops');
  // through the page's session: the final record's totals say which file the session waited for
  const win = fakeWindow(), sent = [];
  let now = 0, draws = 0;
  const realNow = performance.now; performance.now = () => now; t.after(() => { performance.now = realNow; });
  const s = new PerfSession({ runtime: 're3', game: 'vc', session: 'sess5678', win, now: () => now, probe: false, send: (r) => sent.push(r), data: () => portDataSummary(gd, engine, { root: '/game' }), env: () => ({}) });
  t.after(() => clearInterval(s.timer));
  s.watchFrames({ draws: () => draws });
  const eng = (ts) => { now = ts + 5; draws++; win.requestAnimationFrame(eng); };
  win.requestAnimationFrame(eng);
  for (let f = 1; f <= 30 * 20; f++) { const ts = f * 33.333; now = ts; win.run(ts); if (f % 30 === 0) { now = ts + 20; s.tick(); } }
  s.end();
  const last = sent.at(-1);
  assert.equal(last.final, true);
  assert.deepEqual(last.tot.data.files[0], ['Audio/VROCK.adf', 500, 2]);
  assert.deepEqual(last.tot.data.blocked.top, [['Audio/VROCK.adf', 510], ['/elsewhere/x', 10]]);
  assert.deepEqual(last.tot.data.want, { n: 1, ms: 40, to: 1 }); assert.deepEqual(last.tot.data.bg, { pf: [2, 4, 0] });
  assert.ok(sanitizePerfRecord(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(last))).ok);
});

test('a port\'s session events: the page\'s state and storage, 20 at most, the end once', () => {
  const sent = [];
  let state = 'loading';
  const e = portEvents({ port: 're3', state: () => state, storage: { state: null }, bench: 'b1', send: (b) => sent.push(b) });
  assert.match(e.session, /^[0-9a-f]{16}$/);
  e.report('start', { engine: 'x' }); state = 'running';
  e.end({ frames: null }); e.end({ frames: null });
  assert.deepEqual(sent.map((b) => [b.event, b.port, b.state, b.bench, b.session === e.session]), [['start', 're3', 'loading', 'b1', true], ['end', 're3', 'running', 'b1', true]]);
  assert.equal(sent[0].engine, 'x'); assert.ok(sent[0].env);
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) e.report('error', {});
  assert.equal(sent.length, 20);
});
```

`tests/place-load.test.js`:

```js
// tools/openmw/place-load.mjs's pieces without a browser: the scratch games folder whose version runs another engine
// release (real folders of links the server's catalog discovers, the required game resolved, the live folder untouched,
// removed without following a link), a load's times from the page's frame gaps, and stage 3's pieces: the options, a dev
// engine release's brotli siblings, the learned places' summary, the menu-time prefetch from a proxy log; the in-play
// scenarios' pieces: the glide's line, its crossings, the learned places' ranges and a stretch's reads against them.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';
import { scratchGames, clearScratchGames, loadTimes, parseArgs, engineBrotli, placesSummary, prefetchReport, glideSpec, glideLine, crossings, learnedSets, readCoverage, glideReport } from '../tools/openmw/place-load.mjs';
import { loadGameCatalog } from '../src/host/game-catalog.js';

const openmw = (engine, extra = {}) => ({ engine, files: ['Morrowind.esm'], ...extra });
function liveGames(root) {
  const game = (g, versions) => {
    for (const v of versions) fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, g, 'versions', v.dir), { recursive: true });
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, g, 'base'), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, g, 'base', 'Morrowind.esm'), 'esm');
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, g, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, id: g, name: g, defaultVersion: versions[0].id, defaults: { runtime: 'openmw' }, versions }));
  };
  game('mw', [{ id: 'mw-en', dir: 'en', version: '1', openmw: openmw('eng-r8') }]);
  game('mw-plus', [
    { id: 'mw-plus-en', dir: 'plus-en', version: '1', requires: [{ game: 'mw', version: 'mw-en' }], openmw: openmw('eng-r8', { startCell: '-2,-9' }) },
    { id: 'mw-plus-fr', dir: 'plus-fr', version: '1', openmw: openmw('eng-r8') },
  ]);
}
const links = (dir) => { const out = []; const walk = (d) => { for (const e of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) { const f = path.join(d, e.name); if (e.isSymbolicLink()) out.push(f); else if (e.isDirectory()) walk(f); } }; walk(dir); return out; };

test('place-load: a scratch games folder whose version runs another engine, the live one untouched', () => {
  const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'place-load-'));
  try {
    const live = path.join(tmp, 'live'), out = path.join(tmp, 'games-eng-r9');
    liveGames(live);
    const manifestBefore = fs.readFileSync(path.join(live, 'mw-plus', 'manifest.json'), 'utf8');
    const made = scratchGames({ live, out, version: 'mw-plus-en', engine: 'eng-r9' });
    assert.deepEqual(made, { out, game: 'mw-plus', previous: 'eng-r8', changed: { 'mw-plus-en': { game: 'mw-plus', previous: 'eng-r8' } } });
    // (real folders of links; the measured game's manifest a file of its own; nothing new in the live folder)
    for (const g of ['mw', 'mw-plus']) assert.ok(fs.lstatSync(path.join(out, g)).isDirectory());
    assert.ok(fs.lstatSync(path.join(out, 'mw', 'manifest.json')).isSymbolicLink());
    assert.ok(fs.lstatSync(path.join(out, 'mw-plus', 'base')).isSymbolicLink());
    assert.ok(fs.lstatSync(path.join(out, 'mw-plus', 'manifest.json')).isFile());
    assert.deepEqual(links(live), []);
    assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(live, 'mw-plus', 'manifest.json'), 'utf8'), manifestBefore);
    // (the server's catalog: both games discovered, the version on the new engine, the others on their own, the
    // required game's files beneath it)
    const cat = loadGameCatalog(out, null, { enginesDir: path.join(tmp, 'engines') });
    assert.equal(cat.get('mw-plus-en').openmw.engine, 'eng-r9');
    assert.equal(cat.get('mw-plus-en').openmw.startCell, '-2,-9');
    assert.equal(cat.get('mw-plus-fr').openmw.engine, 'eng-r8');
    assert.equal(cat.get('mw-en').openmw.engine, 'eng-r8');
    // (made again: the previous one replaced; removed: links unlinked, never followed)
    scratchGames({ live, out, version: 'mw-plus-en', engine: 'eng-r10' });
    assert.equal(loadGameCatalog(out, null, { enginesDir: path.join(tmp, 'engines') }).get('mw-plus-en').openmw.engine, 'eng-r10');
    clearScratchGames(out);
    assert.equal(fs.existsSync(out), false);
    assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(path.join(live, 'mw', 'base', 'Morrowind.esm'), 'utf8'), 'esm');
    assert.throws(() => scratchGames({ live, out, version: 'nope', engine: 'eng-r9' }), /no version/);
    // (a folder it did not make is refused: a real file below a game's folder)
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(out, 'x', 'y'), { recursive: true });
    assert.throws(() => clearScratchGames(out), /not made by scratchGames/);
  } finally { fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test('place-load: a load\'s times from the frame gaps', () => {
  const gaps = [[50, 300], [1000, 1200], [1300, 9300], [9400, 9800], [12500, 13100], [30000, 30400]];
  const t = loadTimes({ gaps, from: 1000, cellAt: 10000 });
  assert.deepEqual(t.longest, [1300, 9300]);
  assert.equal(t.frozenMs, 8000); assert.equal(t.frozenStartMs, 300);
  // (stalls over 250 ms after the trigger: 8000 + 400 + 600 + 400; frames back: the last such gap within 2 s of the cell)
  assert.equal(t.stallsOver250Ms, 9400);
  assert.equal(t.steadyAt, 9800);
  assert.equal(loadTimes({ gaps, from: 1000 }).steadyAt, 30400);
  assert.deepEqual(loadTimes({ gaps: [], from: 0 }), { longest: null, steadyAt: null, frozenMs: null, frozenStartMs: null, stallsOver250Ms: 0 });
});

test('place-load: the options, resolved and checked', () => {
  const o = parseArgs(['mw-en', '--tree', '/x/tree', '--mode', 'save', '--profile', 'new', '--teach', '2', '--to', '-3,7', '--engine', 'eng-r10', '--engine-br', '--rate', '900k', '--dry']);
  assert.equal(o.id, 'mw-en'); assert.equal(o.tree, '/x/tree'); assert.equal(o.mode, 'save'); assert.equal(o.profile, 'new');
  assert.equal(o.teach, 2); assert.equal(o.runs, 2); assert.equal(o.rate, 900000); assert.equal(o.engineBr, true); assert.equal(o.dry, true);
  assert.equal(o.place, '-3,7'); assert.equal(o.target, '-3 7'); assert.equal(o.toX, -3);
  assert.equal(o.saveFile, '/tmp/orthros-scratch/mw-load/saves/-3_7.omwsave');
  // (defaults: a returning player, nothing taught, scenario C)
  const d = parseArgs(['mw-en', '--tree', 't']);
  assert.equal(d.profile, 'warm'); assert.equal(d.teach, 0); assert.equal(d.mode, 'coe'); assert.equal(d.engineBr, false); assert.equal(d.rate, 1.8e6);
  for (const [argv, why] of [
    [['--tree', 't'], /manifest id/], [['mw-en'], /--tree/], [['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--profile', 'old'], /warm or new/],
    [['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--teach', '1.5'], /integer/], [['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--teach', '-1'], /integer/],
    [['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--engine-br'], /--engine/], [['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--to', 'balmora'], /x,y/],
    [['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--rate', 'fast'], /rate/], [['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--techa', '1'], /unknown/],
    [['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--teach'], /value expected/], [['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--scratch', '/var/lib/orthros2'], /live state/],
  ]) assert.throws(() => parseArgs(argv), why, argv.join(' '));
});

test('place-load: --input-trace and its cadence, block check; only with a load', () => {

test('place-load: a dev engine release\'s brotli siblings, made once, only under the scratch root', () => {
  const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'place-load-br-'));
  try {
    const rel = path.join(tmp, 'eng-r10dev'), e = path.join(rel, 'e', 'abc');
    fs.mkdirSync(e, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(rel, 'release.json'), '{}');
    for (const n of ['openmw.js', 'openmw.wasm', 'openmw.data']) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(e, n), n.repeat(500));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(e, 'streamfs.js'), 'x');
    assert.deepEqual(engineBrotli(rel, { root: tmp, make: false }).map((r) => r.made), [false, false, false]);
    assert.equal(fs.existsSync(path.join(e, 'openmw.js.br')), false);
    const made = engineBrotli(rel, { root: tmp });
    assert.deepEqual(made.map((r) => [path.basename(r.file), r.made]), [['openmw.js', true], ['openmw.wasm', true], ['openmw.data', true]]);
    assert.equal(zlib.brotliDecompressSync(fs.readFileSync(path.join(e, 'openmw.data.br'))).toString(), 'openmw.data'.repeat(500));
    assert.equal(fs.existsSync(path.join(e, 'streamfs.js.br')), false);
    // (fresh: kept; a file newer than its sibling: made again)
    assert.deepEqual(engineBrotli(rel, { root: tmp }).map((r) => r.made), [false, false, false]);
    const later = new Date(Date.now() + 5000); fs.utimesSync(path.join(e, 'openmw.wasm'), later, later);
    assert.deepEqual(engineBrotli(rel, { root: tmp }).map((r) => r.made), [false, true, false]);
    // (a release elsewhere — a link out of the root included — refused)
    assert.throws(() => engineBrotli(rel, { root: path.join(tmp, 'other') }), /only for a release under/);
    const outside = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'place-load-out-'));
    try { fs.symlinkSync(outside, path.join(tmp, 'link')); assert.throws(() => engineBrotli(path.join(tmp, 'link'), { root: tmp }), /only for a release under/); } finally { fs.rmSync(outside, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
  } finally { fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test('place-load: the learned places\' summary, as the server stores them', () => {
  const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'place-load-pl-'));
  try {
    assert.equal(placesSummary(tmp, 'mw-en', '-2,6'), null);

    fs.writeFileSync(f, JSON.stringify([['', '-2,6', 5, 1, 1, [[0, 'Meshes/a.nif', 0, 1e6, 1, 1]]], ['fr', '-2,6', 9, 2, 2, [[0, 'Meshes/a.nif', 0, 2e6, 2, 1], [2, 'Textures/b.dds', 0, 5e5, 2, 2]]], ['', 'ald-ruhn, guild', 3, 1, 1, []]]));

});

test('place-load: the menu-time prefetch from a proxy log', () => {
  const g = (t, ms, q, wire = 1000, file = 'Meshes/a.nif') => ({ t, ms, url: `/gamez/mw-en/${file}?r=0-2000${q}`, wire, method: 'GET', status: 200 });
  const recs = [
    { t: 100, ms: 5, url: '/ports/openmw/mw-en/app/index.html' },
    { t: 2000, ms: 90, url: '/api/places/mw-en?place=-2%2C6', method: 'GET', status: 200 },
    g(3000, 500, '&p=1'), g(4000, 200, '&p=1', 1000, 'Meshes/other.nif'), g(9000, 300, '&p=1'), g(11900, 400, '&p=1', 1000, '.light/Meshes/a.nif'), g(11950, 10, '&w=1'),
    g(12500, 100, '&p=1'), g(12600, 100, '&s=1'),
    { mark: 'place-1' },
  ];
  const r = prefetchReport(recs, { docT: 100, menuT: 8000, keyT: 12000, placePaths: new Set(['Meshes/a.nif']) });
  // (the place's files in the background before the key — a light copy as its file —, not another file's, not after the key)
  assert.deepEqual(r.place, { count: 3, wireMB: 0, decodedMB: 0.01, firstS: 2.9, lastEndS: 12.2, lastEndToKeyS: 0.3, inFlightAtKey: 1 });
  assert.equal(r.want.count, 1);
  assert.equal(r.beforeMenu.count, 1); assert.equal(r.inMenu.count, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(r.places.map((p) => [p.atS, p.keyS, p.status]), [[1.9, -10, 200]]);
  // (no key: nothing counted before it; no menu time: no split; no place known: none of the background is the place's)
  assert.equal(prefetchReport(recs, { keyT: null }).place.count, 0);
  assert.equal(prefetchReport(recs, { keyT: 12000 }).inMenu, null);
  assert.equal(prefetchReport(recs, { keyT: 12000 }).place.count, 0);
});

test('place-load: scratchGames gives an re3 version of each of two games its own engine release', () => {
  const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'place-load-'));
  try {
    const live = path.join(tmp, 'live'), out = path.join(tmp, 'games-r3');
    const game = (g, v) => {
      fs.mkdirSync(path.join(live, g, 'versions', v.dir), { recursive: true }); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(live, g, 'base'), { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(live, g, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, id: g, name: g, defaultVersion: v.id, defaults: { runtime: 're3' }, versions: [v] }));
    };
    game('vc', { id: 'vc-revc', dir: 'revc', version: '1', re3: { engine: 'revc-r2' } });
    game('vc-plus', { id: 'vc-plus', dir: 'plus', version: '1', re3: { engine: 'revc-plus-r2', modes: ['story'] } });
    game('other', { id: 'other-en', dir: 'en', version: '1', re3: { engine: 'revc-r2' } });
    const made = scratchGames({ live, out, engines: { 'vc-revc': 'revc-r3', 'vc-plus': 'revc-plus-r3' } });
    assert.deepEqual(made.changed, { 'vc-revc': { game: 'vc', previous: 'revc-r2' }, 'vc-plus': { game: 'vc-plus', previous: 'revc-plus-r2' } });
    const read = (g) => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(out, g, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8')).versions[0].re3;
    assert.deepEqual(read('vc'), { engine: 'revc-r3' });
    assert.deepEqual(read('vc-plus'), { engine: 'revc-plus-r3', modes: ['story'] });
    assert.ok(fs.lstatSync(path.join(out, 'other', 'manifest.json')).isSymbolicLink()); // (an unchanged game: its own)
    assert.throws(() => scratchGames({ live, out, engines: { 'vc-revc': 'x', nope: 'y' } }), /nope: no version/);
    clearScratchGames(out);
  } finally { fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test('place-load: glide and door options', () => {
  const g = parseArgs(['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--mode', 'glide', '--glide', '1,0,600', '--seconds', '90']);
  assert.deepEqual(g.glide, { dx: 1, dy: 0, speed: 600, z: 3000 }); assert.equal(g.seconds, 90); assert.equal(g.start, '-2,-9');
  assert.equal(g.warmDir, '/tmp/orthros-scratch/mw-load/profile-warm');
  const d = parseArgs(['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--mode', 'door', '--interior', 'Balmora, Council Club', '--lead', '5']);
  // (Balmora by default, its own warm profile; the id lowercased as the engine's label has it: ASCII only)

  assert.equal(d.interior, 'balmora, council club'); assert.equal(d.leadS, 5);
  assert.equal(parseArgs(['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--mode', 'door']).interior, 'balmora, south wall cornerclub');
  assert.equal(parseArgs(['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--mode', 'door', '--interior', 'Échoppe de Île']).interior, 'Échoppe de Île'.replace(/[A-Z]/g, (c) => c.toLowerCase()));
  assert.equal(parseArgs(['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--mode', 'door', '--interior', 'ÉCHOPPE']).interior, 'Échoppe');
  assert.equal(parseArgs(['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--query', 'lead=0']).query, 'lead=0');
  const t = parseArgs(['mw-en', '--tree', 't', '--teach', '1', '--teach-query', 'lead=1']);
  assert.deepEqual([t.query, t.teachQuery], ['', 'lead=1']);
  for (const [argv, why] of [
    [['--mode', 'walk'], /coe or save or glide or door/], [['--glide', '0,0'], /direction/], [['--glide', '1'], /direction/], [['--glide', '0,1,-3'], /speed/],
    [['--seconds', '2'], />= 5/], [['--interior', 'a"b'], /no quote/], [['--lead', '-1'], />= 0/], [['--query', 'a b'], /name=value/], [['--teach-query', 'a'], /--teach-query a: name=value/],
  ]) assert.throws(() => parseArgs(['mw-en', '--tree', 't', ...argv]), why, argv.join(' '));
  assert.deepEqual(glideSpec('0,1'), { dx: 0, dy: 1, speed: 300, z: 3000 });
  // (perf.mjs's line: from the start cell's centre, the direction normalised)
  assert.deepEqual(glideLine('-2,-9', { dx: 0, dy: 2, speed: 300, z: 100 }), { x0: -12288, y0: -69632, vx: 0, vy: 300, z: 100 });
});

test('place-load: a glide\'s crossings from the probe', () => {
  const cells = [['-2 -9', 1000], ['-2 -8', 5000], ['-2 -7', 12000], ['-2 -6', 40000]];
  const gaps = [[4900, 5400], [5600, 5700], [12100, 15100], [13000, 13050]];
  const samples = [[1000, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0], [4500, 10, 1, 0, 0, 0], [11000, 300, 3, 1, 200, 40], [16000, 3300, 4, 2, 3000, 90]];
  const r = crossings({ cells, gaps, samples, from: 1000, to: 20000 });
  // (the cell glided from is not a crossing; one beyond the glide's end neither; the last one runs to the end)
  assert.deepEqual(r.map((c) => [c.cell, c.atS, c.ms]), [['-2 -8', 4, 7000], ['-2 -7', 11, 8000]]);
  assert.deepEqual(r[0], { cell: '-2 -8', atS: 4, ms: 7000, longestGapMs: 500, gapsOver250: 1, gapsOver250Ms: 500, stallMs: 290, syncFetches: 2, wantWaits: 1, wantWaitMs: 200, wants: 40 });
  assert.deepEqual([r[1].longestGapMs, r[1].gapsOver250, r[1].stallMs, r[1].wantWaitMs], [3000, 1, 3000, 2800]);
  assert.deepEqual(crossings({ cells, gaps, samples: [], from: 1000, to: 20000 })[0].stallMs, null);
});

test('place-load: the learned places\' ranges and a stretch\'s reads against them', () => {
  const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'place-load-cov-'));
  try {
    assert.equal(learnedSets(tmp, 'mw-en').size, 0);
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, 'places-mw-en.json'), JSON.stringify([
      ['', '-2,-8', 5, 1, 1, [[0, 'Morrowind.bsa', 0, 1000, 1, 1], [0, 'Morrowind.bsa', 500, 2000, 1, 2]]],
      ['fr', '-2,-8', 9, 1, 2, [[0, 'Morrowind.bsa', 0, 600, 2, 1]]],
      ['', 'balmora, guild', 3, 1, 1, [[2, 'Textures/a.dds', 0, 4000, 1, 1]]],
    ]));
    const sets = learnedSets(tmp, 'mw-en');
    // (each place's newest entry)
    assert.deepEqual([...sets.keys()], ['-2,-8', 'balmora, guild']);
    assert.deepEqual(sets.get('-2,-8').get('Morrowind.bsa'), [[0, 600]]);
    const g = (t, url) => ({ t, ms: 50, wire: 100, url });
    const recs = [
      g(100, '/gamez/mw-en/Morrowind.bsa?r=400-1400&s=x'), g(200, '/gamez/mw-en/Textures/a.dds?r=0-2000&w=1'), g(300, '/gamez/mw-en/.light/Textures/a.dds?r=1000-5000'),
      g(400, '/gamez/mw-en/Meshes/b.nif?r=0-3000&p=1'), g(500, '/api/places/mw-en'), { mark: 'x' }, g(5000, '/gamez/mw-en/Morrowind.bsa?r=0-100'),
    ];
    const r = readCoverage(recs, 0, 1000, sets, '-2,-8');
    // (the background not counted; the light copy as its file; only the bytes inside a range)
    assert.equal(r.reads, 3); assert.equal(r.MB, 0.01); assert.equal(r.placeKnown, true);
    assert.deepEqual(r.files.map((f) => f.path), ['Textures/a.dds', 'Morrowind.bsa']);
    // (a read touching a learned record of its file counts whole — the fetch units are larger than the records —; a
    // light copy's read whole when its file is in the set; the cell's set and any place's)
    const big = [g(100, '/gamez/mw-en/Morrowind.bsa?r=400000-1400000'), g(200, '/gamez/mw-en/Textures/a.dds?r=0-2000000&w=1'),
      g(300, '/gamez/mw-en/Morrowind.bsa?r=3000000-4000000'), g(400, '/gamez/mw-en/.light/Textures/a.dds?r=5000000-6000000')];
    const sets2 = new Map([['-2,-8', new Map([['Morrowind.bsa', [[0, 600000], [500000, 900000]]]])], ['x', new Map([['Textures/a.dds', [[0, 1000000]]]])]]);
    const c = readCoverage(big, 0, 1000, sets2, '-2,-8');
    assert.deepEqual([c.MB, c.inPlaceMB, c.inAnyMB], [5, 1, 4]);
    assert.deepEqual(c.files, [{ path: 'Textures/a.dds', MB: 3, unknownMB: 0 }, { path: 'Morrowind.bsa', MB: 2, unknownMB: 1 }]);
    assert.equal(readCoverage(big, 0, 1000, sets2, 'nowhere').placeKnown, false);
    // (several places: a read named by any of them)
    assert.deepEqual([readCoverage(big, 0, 1000, sets2, ['-2,-8', 'x']).inPlaceMB, readCoverage(big, 0, 1000, sets2, ['nowhere', 'x']).placeKnown], [4, true]);
  } finally { fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test('place-load: a glide run\'s report', () => {
  const P = { from: 1000, cells: [['-2 -9', 1000], ['-2 -8', 5000], ['', 6000]], gaps: [[5000, 5600]], samples: [[1000, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0], [9000, 600, 2, 1, 500, 10]] };
  const recs = [{ t: 105500, ms: 10, wire: 10, url: '/gamez/mw-en/Morrowind.bsa?r=0-1000000' }];
  const sets = new Map([['-2,-8', new Map([['Morrowind.bsa', [[0, 1000000]]]])]]);
  const r = glideReport({ P, glideEnd: 9000, recs, proxyOf: (t) => t + 100000, sets });
  assert.deepEqual(r.crossings.map((c) => [c.cell, c.ms, c.net.MB, c.net.inPlaceMB]), [['-2 -8', 4000, 1, 1]]);
  assert.deepEqual(r.total, { seconds: 8, crossings: 1, longestGapMs: 600, gapsOver250: 1, gapsOver250Ms: 600, stallMs: 600, syncFetches: 2, wantWaitMs: 500, netMB: 1, learnedMB: 1 });
  assert.deepEqual(glideReport({ P, glideEnd: null, recs, proxyOf: () => null, sets }).crossings, []);
  // (a crossing's window against the next cell's set too: the engine's preload fetched that row before it announced it)
  const P2 = { from: 1000, cells: [['-2 -9', 1000], ['-2 -8', 5000], ['-2 -7', 9000]], gaps: [], samples: [] };
  const sets2 = new Map([['-2,-7', new Map([['Morrowind.bsa', [[0, 1000000]]]])], ['-2,-6', new Map([['Morrowind.bsa', [[2000000, 3000000]]]])]]);
  const recs2 = [{ t: 105500, ms: 10, wire: 10, url: '/gamez/mw-en/Morrowind.bsa?r=0-1000000' }, { t: 110500, ms: 10, wire: 10, url: '/gamez/mw-en/Morrowind.bsa?r=2000000-3000000' }];
  const r2 = glideReport({ P: P2, glideEnd: 12000, recs: recs2, proxyOf: (t) => t + 100000, sets: sets2 });
  // (-2 -8's window: -2,-7's set, the next crossing; -2 -7's, the last: -2,-6 the same way)
  assert.deepEqual(r2.crossings.map((c) => [c.cell, c.net.MB, c.net.inPlaceMB]), [['-2 -8', 1, 1], ['-2 -7', 1, 1]]);
  assert.equal(r2.total.learnedMB, 2);
});

```

`tests/places.test.js`:

```js
// Places learned from announcements (docs/slow-network.md "Places learned from announcements"): what an engine
// announced for a place's load (POST /api/places/<manifest>), listed for a page that fetches it before the click (GET).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import http from 'node:http';
import { createServer } from '../src/host/server.js';
import { BLOCK } from '../src/vfs/http-backend.js';

// (the br-cache's generation not paused by the machine's load nor its disk: a test on a busy machine)
const QUIET = { loadLimit: Infinity, diskLimit: 1, idleMs: 0, reseedMs: 3600e3 };

/**
 * A version 'g' (languages en, fr) of files meshes/a.nif (3000 B), meshes/b.nif (5000 B), textures/t.dds (BLOCK + 3000 B),
 * a server on it (`opts` its own, learnWriteMs 10 by default) restartable over the same learn directory.
 */
const placesServer = (t, opts = {}) => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-places-'));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const game = path.join(dir, 'game'), learn = path.join(dir, 'learn');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(game, 'meshes'), { recursive: true }); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(game, 'textures')); fs.mkdirSync(learn);
  const sizes = { 'meshes/a.nif': 3000, 'meshes/b.nif': 5000, 'textures/t.dds': BLOCK + 3000 };
  for (const [f, n] of Object.entries(sizes)) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(game, f), Buffer.alloc(n, f.length));
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'man')); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'man', 'g.json'), JSON.stringify({ name: 'g', folder: game, exe: 'x.exe', languages: ['en', 'fr'] }));
  const start = async (more = {}) => {
    const server = createServer({ manifests: path.join(dir, 'man'), learnDir: learn, learnWriteMs: 10, lanLog: () => {}, placeRuntimes: ['win32'], ...opts, ...more });
    await new Promise((r) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
    const close = () => new Promise((r) => { if (!server.listening) return r(); server.closeAllConnections?.(); server.close(r); });
    t.after(close);
    const origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`, base = `${origin}/api/places/g`;
    const post = (body) => fetch(base, { method: 'POST', body: typeof body === 'string' ? body : JSON.stringify(body) });
    const get = async (q) => (await fetch(`${base}?${q}`)).json();
    return { server, origin, base, close, post, get };
  };
  return { dir, learn, sizes, start };
};

test('places: announced batches round trip — meshes, terrain, textures, each in its order; paths checked against the tree', async (t) => {
  const { start, sizes } = placesServer(t);
  const s = await start();
  const r1 = await s.post({ session: 's1', place: '-2,6', kind: 'textures', records: [['textures/t.dds', 0, -1], ['textures/nope.dds', 0, 10]] });
  assert.equal(r1.status, 200); assert.deepEqual(await r1.json(), { kept: 1 });
  // (out of the file, inverted, not integers, a path outside the tree, a light copy's — its file whole —, not a record)
  const r2 = await s.post({ session: 's1', place: '-2,6', kind: 'meshes', records: [['meshes/b.nif', 0, 5000], ['meshes/a.nif', 100, 200],
    ['meshes/a.nif', 0, 3001], ['meshes/a.nif', 50, 40], ['meshes/a.nif', 0.5, 10], ['../man/g.json', 0, 10], ['.light/meshes/a.nif', 7, 9], 'x', [1, 2, 3]] });
  assert.deepEqual(await r2.json(), { kept: 3 });
  assert.deepEqual(await (await s.post({ session: 's1', place: '-2,6', kind: 'terrain', records: [['meshes/a.nif', 0, 10]] })).json(), { kept: 1 });
  const got = await s.get('place=-2,6');
  assert.equal(got.place, '-2,6'); assert.equal(got.lang, null); assert.equal(got.sessions, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(got.list, [['meshes/b.nif', 0, 5000, 'meshes'], ['meshes/a.nif', 100, 200, 'meshes'], ['meshes/a.nif', 0, 3000, 'meshes'],
    ['meshes/a.nif', 0, 10, 'terrain'], ['textures/t.dds', 0, sizes['textures/t.dds'], 'textures']]);
  assert.equal(got.bytes, 5000 + 100 + 3000 + 10 + sizes['textures/t.dds']);
  // (a place nobody announced: an empty list; the places known)
  assert.deepEqual((await s.get('place=0,0')).list, []);
  assert.deepEqual((await s.get('')).map((e) => [e[0], e[1], e[2], e[4]]), [['-2,6', null, 1, 5]]);
  const n = await (await fetch(`${s.origin}/api/netstats`)).json();
  assert.deepEqual({ ...n.places }, { posts: 3, records: 5, dropped: 7, gets: 2, found: 1 });
});

test('places: malformed reports refused, unknown manifests 404, bodies bounded', async (t) => {
  const { start } = placesServer(t);
  const s = await start();
  const rec = [['meshes/a.nif', 0, 10]];
  assert.equal((await s.post('{')).status, 400);
  for (const bad of [{ place: '1,1', kind: 'meshes', records: rec }, { session: 'x'.repeat(41), place: '1,1', kind: 'meshes', records: rec },
    { session: 's', place: '', kind: 'meshes', records: rec }, { session: 's', place: 'a'.repeat(65), kind: 'meshes', records: rec },
    { session: 's', place: 'a\nb', kind: 'meshes', records: rec }, { session: 's', place: '1,1', kind: 'sounds', records: rec },
    { session: 's', place: '1,1', kind: 'meshes', records: 'x' }, null]) assert.equal((await s.post(bad)).status, 400, JSON.stringify(bad));
  assert.equal((await s.post({ session: 's', place: '1,1', kind: 'meshes', records: [], pad: 'x'.repeat(2 * 1024 * 1024) })).status, 413);
  // (nothing of the tree: no place made, no session counted)
  assert.deepEqual(await (await s.post({ session: 's', place: '1,1', kind: 'meshes', records: [['no.nif', 0, 1]] })).json(), { kept: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual(await s.get(''), []);
  assert.equal((await fetch(`${s.origin}/api/places/nope?place=1,1`)).status, 404);
  assert.equal((await fetch(`${s.origin}/api/places/nope`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ session: 's', place: '1,1', kind: 'meshes', records: rec }) })).status, 404);
});

test('places: a later session\'s list first, the earlier ones\' after it; a record no session of the last four announced out', async (t) => {
  const { start } = placesServer(t);
  const s = await start();
  const A = ['meshes/a.nif', 0, 3000], B = ['meshes/b.nif', 0, 5000], C = ['meshes/a.nif', 0, 100];
  await s.post({ session: 's1', place: 'balmora', kind: 'meshes', records: [A, B] });
  await s.post({ session: 's2', place: 'balmora', kind: 'meshes', records: [C, B] });
  assert.deepEqual((await s.get('place=balmora')).list.map((e) => e.slice(0, 3)), [C, B, A]);
  // (the same session's batches of one load: one session, the first rank of a record kept)
  await s.post({ session: 's2', place: 'balmora', kind: 'meshes', records: [A, C] });
  let got = await s.get('place=balmora');
  assert.equal(got.sessions, 2); assert.deepEqual(got.list.map((e) => e.slice(0, 3)), [C, B, A]);
  // (s2 announced A in its second batch: A is of s2's generation now; three sessions more without B: B out after the fourth)
  for (const sid of ['s3', 's4', 's5']) await s.post({ session: sid, place: 'balmora', kind: 'meshes', records: [A] });
  assert.deepEqual((await s.get('place=balmora')).list.map((e) => e.slice(0, 3)), [A, C, B], 'B last announced 3 sessions ago: kept');
  await s.post({ session: 's6', place: 'balmora', kind: 'meshes', records: [A] });
  got = await s.get('place=balmora');
  assert.equal(got.sessions, 6); assert.deepEqual(got.list.map((e) => e.slice(0, 3)), [A], 'B and C last announced by s2, four sessions ago: out');
});

test('places: bounded — places a version (least recently announced out), records a place (oldest out)', async (t) => {
  const { start } = placesServer(t, { placesMax: 3, placeRecords: 4 });
  const s = await start();
  for (const p of ['p1', 'p2', 'p3']) await s.post({ session: 's', place: p, kind: 'meshes', records: [['meshes/a.nif', 0, 1]] });
  await s.post({ session: 's', place: 'p1', kind: 'terrain', records: [['meshes/a.nif', 0, 2]] }); // (p1 the most recent now)
  await s.post({ session: 's', place: 'p4', kind: 'meshes', records: [['meshes/a.nif', 0, 1]] });
  assert.deepEqual((await s.get('')).map((e) => e[0]), ['p4', 'p1', 'p3']);
  assert.deepEqual((await s.get('place=p2')).list, []);
  const recs = (sid, from) => Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, i) => ['meshes/b.nif', from + i, from + i + 1]);
  await s.post({ session: 'a', place: 'p4', kind: 'meshes', records: recs('a', 100) });
  await s.post({ session: 'b', place: 'p4', kind: 'meshes', records: recs('b', 200) });
  assert.deepEqual((await s.get('place=p4')).list.map((e) => e[1]), [200, 201, 202, 100], 'the latest session\'s first, the bound drops the oldest');
});

test('places: per game language (another one\'s when it has none), kept across a restart', async (t) => {
  const { start, learn } = placesServer(t);
  const s = await start();
  await s.post({ session: 'f', place: 'balmora, guilde des mages', kind: 'meshes', lang: 'FR', records: [['meshes/a.nif', 0, 10]] });
  await s.post({ session: 'e', place: '1,1', kind: 'meshes', lang: 'en', records: [['meshes/a.nif', 0, 20]] });
  await s.post({ session: 'f', place: '1,1', kind: 'meshes', lang: 'fr', records: [['meshes/a.nif', 0, 30]] });
  await s.post({ session: 'x', place: '1,1', kind: 'meshes', lang: 'xx', records: [['meshes/a.nif', 0, 40]] }); // (not the version's: none)
  assert.deepEqual((await s.get('place=1,1&lang=en')).list[0].slice(0, 3), ['meshes/a.nif', 0, 20]);
  assert.deepEqual((await s.get('place=1,1&lang=fr')).list[0].slice(0, 3), ['meshes/a.nif', 0, 30]);
  assert.deepEqual((await s.get('place=1,1')).list[0].slice(0, 3), ['meshes/a.nif', 0, 40]);
  const fr = await s.get(`place=${encodeURIComponent('balmora, guilde des mages')}&lang=en`);
  assert.equal(fr.lang, 'fr'); assert.equal(fr.list.length, 1);
  const before = await s.get('');
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); await s.close();
  assert.ok(fs.existsSync(path.join(learn, 'places-g.json')));
  const again = await start();
  assert.deepEqual(await again.get(''), before, 'kept on disk, in their order');
  assert.deepEqual((await again.get('place=1,1&lang=fr')).list[0].slice(0, 3), ['meshes/a.nif', 0, 30]);
  // (a session after the restart: a new generation, the records kept — the same reporter, counted once)
  await again.post({ session: 'f', place: '1,1', kind: 'meshes', lang: 'fr', records: [['meshes/b.nif', 0, 30]] });
  const got = await again.get('place=1,1&lang=fr');
  assert.equal(got.sessions, 1); assert.deepEqual(got.list.map((e) => e[0]), ['meshes/b.nif', 'meshes/a.nif']);
});

test('places: the most announced places\' units precompressed after the launch set, as an announcement asks them', async (t) => {
  const { start, sizes } = placesServer(t);
  const s = await start();
  // (a learned order, so that the version is a source of the units)
  await fetch(`${s.origin}/api/prefetch/g`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ session: 'r', reads: [['meshes/b.nif', 0, 10, 5]] }) });
  await s.post({ session: 's', place: '1,1', kind: 'textures', records: [['textures/t.dds', 0, -1], ['meshes/a.nif', 100, 200]] });
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); await s.close();
  const cache = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-places-br-')); t.after(() => fs.rmSync(cache, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const b = await start({ brCacheDir: cache, brCacheOptions: QUIET, brCacheLog: () => {} });
  t.after(() => b.server.brCache?.close?.());
  await b.server.brCache.drain();
  const unit = (rel, a, z) => new Promise((res, rej) => http.get(`${b.origin}/gamez/g/${rel}?r=${a}-${z}&w=1`, { headers: { 'accept-encoding': 'br' } }, (r) => { r.resume(); res(r.headers['x-orthros-unit']); }).on('error', rej));
  // (t.dds whole: its block 0 whole, then its tail block; a.nif's piece the range is in)
  assert.equal(await unit('textures/t.dds', 0, BLOCK), 'hit');
  assert.equal(await unit('textures/t.dds', BLOCK, sizes['textures/t.dds']), 'hit');
  assert.equal(await unit('meshes/a.nif', 0, 3000), 'hit', 'a file of one piece: its block');
  assert.equal(await unit('meshes/b.nif', 0, 5000), 'hit', 'the learned order after the places');
});
```

`tests/playable-watch.test.js`:

```js
// The Windows games' playable mark (src/vfs/playable-watch.js; worker.js playableStep; server.js learnMark).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { PlayableWatch, ReadLog } from '../src/vfs/playable-watch.js';
import { BLOCK, CHUNK } from '../src/vfs/http-backend.js';
import { createServer } from '../src/host/server.js';

/** Feeds a watch a timeline: each step 250 ms, `fps` frames a second, `bps` bytes read a second; the first step it fires. */
function run(w, phases) {
  let now = 0, frames = 0, bytes = 1, videoBytes = 0, requests = 0, pacingMs = 0;
  for (const p of phases) {
    for (let t = 0; t < p.ms; t += 250) {
      now += 250; frames += (p.fps ?? 30) / 4; bytes += (p.bps ?? 0) / 4; videoBytes += (p.video ?? 0) / 4; requests += p.net ? 1 : 0; pacingMs += 250 * (1 - (p.busy ?? 0.3));
      if (w.step(now, { frames: Math.floor(frames), bytes: Math.floor(bytes), videoBytes: Math.floor(videoBytes), requests, pacingMs })) return now;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** `at` is within the stretch that begins at `from`: after it, at most `quiet` (+ a step) later */
const within = (at, from, quiet) => assert.ok(at !== null && at > from && at <= from + quiet + 250, `${at} for a stretch from ${from}`);

test('playable: the first quiet stretch drawn at a frame rate — not a loading, a movie, nor a wait on the network', () => {
  const W = () => new PlayableWatch({ quietMs: 5000, minFps: 10 });
  // a loading from this browser's copy (MB/s), then a menu
  within(run(W(), [{ ms: 10000, bps: 4e6, fps: 20 }, { ms: 20000 }]), 10000, 5000);
  // an intro movie (read at 200 KB/s, or by a movie file at any rate) first: the menu after it
  within(run(W(), [{ ms: 10000, bps: 200e3 }, { ms: 20000, bps: 20e3 }]), 10000, 5000);
  within(run(W(), [{ ms: 10000, video: 50e3 }, { ms: 20000 }]), 10000, 5000);
  // a loading over a thin link, a thread drawing its progress at 30 fps: every few seconds a read waits for the network
  assert.equal(run(W(), [{ ms: 30000, bps: 40e3, net: true }]), null);
  // a loading screen without frames (the game blocked on its reads): not before the frames come
  within(run(W(), [{ ms: 10000, fps: 1 }, { ms: 10000 }]), 10000, 5000);
  // a loading that computes, its splash screen drawn at 30 fps between steps of work, nothing read: not before its menu
  within(run(W(), [{ ms: 60000, busy: 1 }, { ms: 20000 }]), 60000, 5000);
  // menu music streamed from an archive (tens of KB a second): playable all the same
  within(run(W(), [{ ms: 10000, bps: 32e3 }]), 0, 5000);
  // once
  const w = W(); within(run(w, [{ ms: 10000 }]), 0, 5000); assert.equal(run(w, [{ ms: 10000 }]), null);
});

test('playable, by default: not a splash screen drawn between two loadings, its menu (a Windows strategy game\'s first start)', () => {
  const at = run(new PlayableWatch(), [
    { ms: 30000, bps: 3e6, fps: 1, busy: 1 }, // (loading: reads, few frames)
    { ms: 8000, fps: 10, busy: 0.5 }, { ms: 6000, fps: 23, busy: 0.45 }, // (a splash screen, then its fade)
    { ms: 120000, fps: 4, busy: 0.98 }, // (computing, the splash drawn now and then)
    { ms: 30000, fps: 30, busy: 0.25, bps: 20e3 }, // (the menu, its music streamed)
  ]);
  within(at, 164000, 10000);
});

test('ReadLog: by pieces, the first time each was read, per version, in ranges', () => {
  const l = new ReadLog();
  l.add('v', 'a.big', 10, 3 * CHUNK + 5, 1000); // (pieces 0-3 at t=0)
  l.add('v', 'a.big', 0, 100, 1500); // (again: nothing)
  l.add('dep', 'b.dat', BLOCK, BLOCK + 1, 2000);
  l.add('v', 'a.big', 10 * CHUNK, 10 * CHUNK + 1, 3000);
  const size = (p) => (p === 'a.big' ? 3 * CHUNK + 100 : 5 * BLOCK);
  assert.deepEqual(l.take('v', size), [['a.big', 0, 3 * CHUNK + 100, 0]], '(past the file: cut, or out)');
  assert.deepEqual(l.take('v', size), [], 'taken');
  l.add('v', 'a.big', 0, 10, 4000); l.add('v', 'a.big', CHUNK, CHUNK + 1, 4000);
  assert.deepEqual(l.take('v', size), [], 'read before: not again');
  assert.deepEqual(l.take('dep', size), [['b.dat', BLOCK, BLOCK + CHUNK, 1000]]);
  assert.deepEqual(l.names, ['v', 'dep']);
});

test('one session marks the version and the version it requires, each with its own reads', async (t) => {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-pw-')); t.after(() => fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const games = path.join(root, 'games'), learn = path.join(root, 'learn'); fs.mkdirSync(learn);
  for (const [g, extra] of [['base', {}], ['mod', { requires: [{ game: 'base', version: 'base-1', mount: 'C:\\BASE' }] }]]) {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(games, g, 'base'), { recursive: true }); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(games, g, 'versions', '1'), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(games, g, 'base', 'same.dat'), Buffer.alloc(2 * BLOCK, 3)); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(games, g, 'base', 'game.exe'), 'MZ');
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(games, g, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, id: g, name: g, defaultVersion: `${g}-1`, versions: [{ id: `${g}-1`, dir: '1', version: '1', exe: 'game.exe', ...extra }] }));
  }
  const server = createServer({ gamesDir: games, learnDir: learn, learnWriteMs: 10, lanLog: () => {} });
  await new Promise((r) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r)); t.after(() => new Promise((r) => { server.closeAllConnections?.(); server.close(r); }));
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
  const post = (v, body) => fetch(`${base}/api/prefetch/${v}`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  // (an earlier session learned block 1 of the mod's file — the same path as the required version's)
  await post('mod-1', { session: 'old', reads: [['same.dat', BLOCK, BLOCK + 10, 9000]] });
  // this one read block 0 of each, and block 1 of the required version's only, then marked both
  assert.equal((await post('mod-1', { session: 'w', reads: [['same.dat', 0, 10, 5]], mark: { kind: 'playable' } })).status, 204);
  assert.equal((await post('base-1', { session: 'w', reads: [['same.dat', 0, 10, 5], ['same.dat', BLOCK, BLOCK + 10, 6]], mark: { kind: 'playable' } })).status, 204);
  const mod = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/prefetch/mod-1`)).json(), dep = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/prefetch/base-1`)).json();
  assert.deepEqual(mod.map((e) => [e[1], e[4]]), [[0, 1], [1, 0]], 'the mod\'s block 1: not before playable (read by the required version only)');
  assert.deepEqual(dep.map((e) => [e[1], e[4]]), [[0, 1], [1, 1]]);
});

test('ReadReports: in order (a mark after the reports before it); a final one at once, keepalive bodies under 64 KiB', async () => {
  const { ReadReports, KEEPALIVE_BYTES, FINAL_PIECE } = await import('../src/vfs/playable-watch.js');
  const calls = [], pending = [];
  const fetch = (url, init) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => { calls.push({ url, ...init, body: JSON.parse(init.body), bytes: init.body.length }); pending.push({ resolve, reject }); });
  const r = new ReadReports({ fetch });
  const reads = (n, from = 0) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => [`Data/file${from + i}.big`, 0, 65536, 1000 + i]);
  // (a large periodic report still uploading: the mark waits for it)
  const a = r.send('v', 's', reads(3000), null);
  const b = r.send('v', 's', reads(5, 3000), { kind: 'playable', t: 9 });
  await new Promise((s) => setTimeout(s, 10));
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1, 'the mark waits');
  assert.equal(calls[0].keepalive, false); assert.equal(calls[0].body.reads.length, 3000); assert.equal(calls[0].url, '/api/prefetch/v');
  pending[0].reject(new TypeError('network')); // (a failed report does not stop the chain)
  await a; await new Promise((s) => setTimeout(s, 0));
  assert.equal(calls.length, 2); assert.deepEqual(calls[1].body.mark, { kind: 'playable', t: 9 });
  // (the final report: not behind the chain, split, keepalive while the bodies in flight stay under the limit)
  r.send('v', 's', reads(1), null);
  const before = calls.length;
  const fin = r.send('v', 's', reads(4500, 10000), null, true);
  const finals = calls.slice(before);
  assert.equal(finals.length, Math.ceil(4500 / FINAL_PIECE), 'at once, in pieces');
  assert.deepEqual(finals.flatMap((c) => c.body.reads).map((x) => x[0]), reads(4500, 10000).map((x) => x[0]), 'every read');
  assert.ok(finals.every((c) => c.bytes < KEEPALIVE_BYTES));
  const kept = finals.filter((c) => c.keepalive);
  assert.ok(kept.length >= 1 && kept.reduce((s, c) => s + c.bytes, 0) <= KEEPALIVE_BYTES, 'the keepalive ones within the budget');
  assert.ok(finals.some((c) => !c.keepalive), 'the rest as plain requests');
  for (const p of pending) p.resolve(new Response(null, { status: 204 }));
  await fin; await b;
  assert.equal(r.keepaliveBytes, 0, 'answered: the budget free again');
  // (an empty final report with a mark: one body)
  const n = calls.length; r.send('v', 's', [], { kind: 'playable', t: 1 }, true);
  assert.equal(calls.length, n + 1); assert.equal(calls[n].keepalive, true); assert.deepEqual(calls[n].body, { session: 's', reads: [], mark: { kind: 'playable', t: 1 } });
});
```

`tests/player-css-hidden.test.js`:

```js
// The page frame's header (src/host/web/shell.js) hides elements with the `hidden` attribute — the game data's pills once
// done (shell.setData), the version tag, the loader's progress. An author rule that sets `display` on them beats the
// browser's own `[hidden] { display: none }`: each such rule of player.css needs its `[hidden]` counterpart, else the
// pill stays ("Preloading 100 %", "Ready to play" in the world: seen on the Morrowind multiplayer check, 2026-10-21).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';

const css = fs.readFileSync(new URL('../src/host/web/player.css', import.meta.url), 'utf8').replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '');
const rules = [...css.matchAll(/([^{}]+)\{([^}]*)\}/g)].map((m) => ({ sel: m[1].trim(), body: m[2] }));

/** The selectors of elements the shell toggles with `hidden`, as player.css styles them. */
const TOGGLED = ['#topbar .pill', '#topbar .brand .tag', '#loader .progress', '#loader .signin'];

test('player.css: each toggled element shown by a display rule has a [hidden] rule hiding it', () => {
  for (const sel of TOGGLED) {
    const shows = rules.some((r) => r.sel.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).includes(sel) && /display\s*:\s*(?!none)/.test(r.body));
    if (!shows) continue;
    const hides = rules.some((r) => r.sel.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).includes(`${sel}[hidden]`) && /display\s*:\s*none/.test(r.body));
    assert.ok(hides, `${sel}[hidden] { display: none } missing`);
  }
});
```

`tests/png-encode.test.js`:

```js
// PNG encoding on the CPU (cursors): the image decodes back to the same RGBA (the project's decoder and zlib's
// checks: chunk CRCs, adler-32), including images larger than one 64 KiB stored deflate block; the browser display
// defines an image cursor from such PNGs at once, without any canvas (a 2D canvas waits on the GPU process).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';
import { encodePng, decodePng } from '../src/gfx/codecs/png.js';
import { BrowserDisplay } from '../src/host/browser-host.js';

const image = (w, h) => { const px = new Uint8Array(w * h * 4); for (let i = 0; i < px.length; i++) px[i] = (i * 37 + 11) & 255; return px; };

test('encodePng: decodes back to the same pixels; chunk CRCs and the zlib stream are valid', () => {
  for (const [w, h] of [[1, 1], [32, 32], [3, 7], [200, 120]]) {
    const px = image(w, h), png = encodePng(px, w, h);
    const d = decodePng(png);
    assert.equal(d.width, w); assert.equal(d.height, h);
    assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(d.data), Buffer.from(px));
    const dv = new DataView(png.buffer); let p = 8; const idat = [];
    while (p < png.length) {
      const n = dv.getUint32(p), type = Buffer.from(png.subarray(p + 4, p + 8)).toString('latin1');
      assert.equal(zlib.crc32(png.subarray(p + 4, p + 8 + n)), dv.getUint32(p + 8 + n), `${type} CRC`);
      if (type === 'IDAT') idat.push(png.subarray(p + 8, p + 8 + n));
      p += 12 + n;
    }
    const raw = zlib.inflateSync(Buffer.concat(idat)); // (throws on a bad adler-32)
    assert.equal(raw.length, (w * 4 + 1) * h);
  }
});

test('an image cursor is defined from CPU-encoded PNGs at once (no canvas), then selected', () => {
  const posts = [];
  const host = { post: (m, t) => posts.push([m, t]) };
  const display = Object.create(BrowserDisplay.prototype); display.host = host; // (no canvases: none may be used)
  const frames = [{ w: 2, h: 2, rgba: image(2, 2), hotX: 1, hotY: 0 }, { w: 2, h: 2, rgba: image(2, 2).reverse(), hotX: 1, hotY: 0 }];
  display.setCursor(0x1234, { frames, steps: [[0, 10], [1, 10]] }, 0);
  assert.equal(posts.length, 2);
  const [def, transfer] = posts[0];
  assert.equal(def.type, 'cursor-def'); assert.equal(def.id, 0x1234); assert.equal(def.frames.length, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(decodePng(new Uint8Array(def.frames[1].png)).data), Buffer.from(frames[1].rgba));
  assert.equal(transfer.length, 2, 'the PNG buffers are transferred');
  assert.deepEqual(posts[1][0], { type: 'cursor-set', id: 0x1234 });
  display.setCursor(0x1234, { frames, steps: [] }, 0);
  assert.equal(posts.length, 2, 'the same cursor again: nothing posted');
});
```

`tests/port-files.test.js`:

```js
// A browser port's game files (src/ports/port-files.js): the game data opened as soon as the page knows its version —
// beside its engine's download, with the page's manifest and tree, the learned order's list asked at the open
// (openPortData) —, its files mounted in the engine's file system only once it is ready (mountPortFiles);
// docs/slow-network.md "Opened early".
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { openPortData, mountPortFiles } from '../src/ports/port-files.js';

test('openPortData opens at once with the page\'s manifest and tree; mountPortFiles mounts once the worker answered', async (t) => {
  const workers = [], RealWorker = globalThis.Worker;
  globalThis.Worker = class { constructor() { this.sent = []; workers.push(this); } postMessage(m) { this.sent.push(m); } terminate() {} };
  t.after(() => { globalThis.Worker = RealWorker; });
  const tree = { dirs: { valve: { dirs: {}, files: { 'a.wad': { size: 3, mtime: 1 } } } }, files: {} }, manifest = { name: 'hl', runtime: 'goldsrc' };
  const data = openPortData({ name: 'hl', tree, manifest, session: 's1', lang: 'en', log() {} });
  t.after(() => data.close());
  assert.equal(workers.length, 1, 'its worker started at once');
  const init = workers[0].sent[0].init;
  assert.equal(init.name, 'hl'); assert.deepEqual(init.manifest, manifest); assert.deepEqual(init.tree, tree);
  assert.equal(init.orderAtOpen, true); assert.equal(init.prefetch, 'startup');
  assert.ok(data.times.open >= 0 && data.times.ready === null);
  // (the engine in before the worker answered: the mount waits for it)
  const made = [], FS = { mkdirTree() {}, createFile(dir, name) { const n = { dir, name, node_ops: {}, stream_ops: {} }; made.push(n); return n; } };
  let mounted = null;
  const mounting = mountPortFiles(data, { name: 'hl', files: [{ path: 'valve/a.wad' }], FS, root: '/rodir', log() {} }).then((r) => (mounted = r));
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
  assert.equal(mounted, null, 'not mounted before the worker answered'); assert.equal(made.length, 0);
  workers[0].onmessage({ data: { ready: { trees: { hl: tree }, kept: { hl: true }, manifest, real: [] } } });
  await mounting;
  assert.equal(mounted.data, data); assert.equal(mounted.nodes.size, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(made.map((n) => [n.dir, n.name]), [['/rodir/valve', 'a.wad']]);
  const s = data.snapshot();
  assert.ok(s.readyMs >= s.openMs && s.mountedMs >= s.readyMs, JSON.stringify(s));
});

test('a game data that failed to open: told where the page mounts it, never as an unhandled rejection', async (t) => {
  const workers = [], RealWorker = globalThis.Worker;
  globalThis.Worker = class { constructor() { this.sent = []; workers.push(this); } postMessage(m) { this.sent.push(m); } terminate() {} };
  t.after(() => { globalThis.Worker = RealWorker; });
  const unhandled = []; const on = (e) => unhandled.push(e); process.on('unhandledRejection', on); t.after(() => process.off('unhandledRejection', on));
  const data = openPortData({ name: 'hl', tree: { dirs: {}, files: {} }, session: 's1', log() {} });
  t.after(() => data.close());
  workers[0].onmessage({ data: { failed: 'HTTP 500' } });
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
  assert.deepEqual(unhandled, []);
  await assert.rejects(mountPortFiles(data, { name: 'hl', files: [], FS: {}, root: '/r', log() {} }), /HTTP 500/);
```

```js
// tools/port-perf.mjs: the ports' shared frame measurement — launch flags by rendering mode, the page probe (WebGL
// calls by kind, the synchronous ones, the rasterizer discarded, the work a browser frame), the reports kept off the
// server. The probe runs here on a fake window (its init script is a plain function).

import { chromeArgs, launchOptions, addProbe, quietReports, startMeasure, readMeasure, SYNC_CALLS } from '../tools/port-perf.mjs';

test('launch options: Chromium itself by default (as the bench suite), the headless shell on request, a short TMPDIR', () => {

/** A fake page: a window with a WebGL2 context type, canvases, frames on demand. */
async function fakePage(opts) {
  const log = [], frames = [];
  let now = 0;
  class WebGL2RenderingContext {
    getExtension() { return { UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL: 1 }; }
    getParameter(p) { return p === 1 ? 'Fake Renderer' : 0; }
    enable(c) { log.push(['enable', c]); }
    disable(c) { log.push(['disable', c]); }
    drawArrays() { now += 2; }
    getError() { return 0; }
    bindBuffer() {}
  }
  const ctx = new WebGL2RenderingContext();
  const win = { WebGL2RenderingContext, HTMLCanvasElement: class { getContext() { return ctx; } }, performance: { now: () => now, memory: null },
    requestAnimationFrame: (cb) => frames.push(cb) };
  win.window = win;
  let script;
  await addProbe({ addInitScript: async (fn, arg) => { script = [fn, arg]; } }, opts);
  // (the init script and the page's evaluations run with the fake window's names in scope)
  const run = (fn, arg) => {
    const names = Object.keys(win);
    return new Function(...names, 'fn', 'arg', 'return fn(arg);')(...names.map((n) => win[n]), new Function(...names, `return (${fn.toString()});`)(...names.map((n) => win[n])), arg);
  };
  run(...script);
  const page = { evaluate: async (fn, arg) => run(fn, arg) };
  /** One browser frame at time t: every callback asked for so far. */
  const frame = (t) => { now = t; for (const cb of frames.splice(0)) cb(t); };
  return { win, ctx: () => new win.HTMLCanvasElement().getContext('webgl2'), log, page, frame, advance: (ms) => { now += ms; }, probe: () => win.perfProbe };
}

test('probe: renderer, discard kept on, calls a frame with the synchronous ones, work a browser frame', async () => {
  const f = await fakePage({ discard: true, stacks: ['getError'] });
  const gl = f.ctx();
  assert.equal(f.probe().renderer, 'Fake Renderer');
  assert.deepEqual(f.log, [['enable', 0x8C89]]);
  gl.disable(0x8C89); gl.disable(0x0B71);
  assert.deepEqual(f.log.slice(1), [['disable', 0x0B71]], 'the engine cannot turn the discard off');
  await startMeasure(f.page);
  // (two loops a frame — the engine's and a meter's: one frame each time, the work up to the engine's last request)
  const engine = () => { gl.bindBuffer(); gl.drawArrays(); gl.getError(); f.advance(3); f.win.requestAnimationFrame(engine); };
  const meter = () => f.win.requestAnimationFrame(meter);
  f.win.requestAnimationFrame(meter); f.win.requestAnimationFrame(engine);
  for (let i = 1; i <= 11; i++) f.frame(i * 100);
  const m = await readMeasure(f.page);
  assert.equal(m.frames, 11);
  assert.equal(m.draws, 1);
  assert.equal(m.top.drawArrays, 1); assert.equal(m.top.getError, 1);
  assert.equal(m.syncCalls, 1); assert.deepEqual(m.sync, { getError: 1 });
  assert.equal(m.work.p50, 5, 'draw 2 ms + 3 ms, from the frame start to the engine asking for the next one');
  assert.equal(m.gaps.p50, 100);
  assert.equal(m.stacks.length, 1); assert.equal(m.stacks[0].n, 11);
  assert.ok(SYNC_CALLS.includes('checkFramebufferStatus') && !SYNC_CALLS.includes('drawArrays'));
});

  const f = await fakePage({});

  assert.deepEqual(f.log, [['disable', 0x8C89]]);
```
