`tests/quartz.test.js`:

```js
// DirectShow playback (src/win32/quartz.js) driven by a Win32 program through the COM ABI (tools/pe/quartz.c): the
// filter graph renders a movie (an MPEG-1 system stream, then an AVI), plays it over the VM clock, shows its pictures on
// the host's video layer in the video window's rectangle, mixes its sound through DirectSound, and reports the end as
// games expect it.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { Vfs, MemBackend } from '../src/vfs/vfs.js';
import { VirtualClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';
import { makeAvi } from './media-avi-writer.js';

const PE_DIR = new URL('../build/pe/', import.meta.url).pathname;
const MOVIE = new URL('./fixtures/media/movie.mpg', import.meta.url).pathname;
const skip = !fs.existsSync(PE_DIR + 'quartz.exe') && 'build/pe/quartz.exe missing (make pe-tests)';

/** quartz.exe with `movie` as C:\Test\movie.mpg (DirectShow tells files by their content): its output, what was shown and heard */
function play(movie) {
  const vfs = new Vfs(), dir = new MemBackend();
  vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend()); vfs.mount('C:\\Test', dir);
  dir.open('quartz.exe', { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(PE_DIR + 'quartz.exe'));
  dir.open('movie.mpg', { create: true }).write(0, movie);
  dir.open('notmedia.bin', { create: true }).write(0, new TextEncoder().encode('RIFF....this is not a movie'));
  const clock = new VirtualClock();
  const host = new HeadlessHost({ clock, width: 800, height: 600 });
  const shown = [];
  let hidden = 0; host.display.hideVideo = () => { hidden++; };
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host, logKinds: ['warn', 'crash'] });
  vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\quartz.exe' });
  // the sound: what the mixer renders while the pictures are shown
  let peak = 0, mixed = 0;
  const out = new Float32Array(2 * 256);
  host.display.presentVideo = (rgba, w, h, rect) => {
    const c = ((h >> 1) * w + (w >> 1)) * 4;
    shown.push({ at: clock.now(), w, h, rect: { ...rect }, center: Array.from(rgba.subarray(c, c + 3)) });
    if (vm.audio) { vm.audio.render(out, 256, 44100); mixed++; for (const v of out) peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(v)); }
  };
  const code = vm.run();
  const res = Object.fromEntries(vm.stdout.join('').trim().split('\n').map((l) => l.split('=')));
  return { vm, code, res, shown, hidden, peak, mixed };
}

function checkPlayback({ vm, code, res, shown, hidden, peak, mixed }, { fps, w, h, peakRange }) {
  assert.equal(code, 0);
  assert.equal(res.create, '0x00000000');
  assert.equal(res['render missing'], '0x80070002');
  assert.equal(res['render other'], '0x80040240', 'VFW_E_UNKNOWN_FILE_TYPE');
  assert.equal(res['empty run event'], '0x00000000'); assert.equal(res['empty run code'], '1', 'an empty graph run: EC_COMPLETE at once');
  assert.equal(res.render, '0x00000000');
  assert.equal(res['render again'], '0x80040204', 'VFW_E_ALREADY_CONNECTED');
  assert.equal(res.interfaces, '6');
  assert.equal(res.width, String(w)); assert.equal(res.height, String(h));
  assert.ok(Math.abs(Number(res['duration ms']) - 1200) < 60, `duration ${res['duration ms']}`);
  assert.equal(res.volume, '0x00000000');
  assert.equal(res.position, '0x00000000');
  assert.equal(res.run, '0x00000000');
  assert.equal(res.state, '2');
  // the end, signaled after the movie's duration (the clock runs while the program waits)
  const elapsed = Number(res['elapsed ms']);
  assert.ok(elapsed >= 1100 && elapsed <= 1350, `played in ${elapsed} ms`);
  assert.equal(res.event, '0x00000000'); assert.equal(res['event code'], '1', 'EC_COMPLETE');
  assert.equal(res['next event'], '0x80004004', 'E_ABORT: queue empty');
  assert.equal(res['signaled after'], '258', 'event handle reset once the queue is empty (WAIT_TIMEOUT)');
  assert.equal(res.notified, '1', 'WM_GRAPHNOTIFY posted to the notify window');
  assert.ok(Math.abs(Number(res['position ms']) - Number(res['duration ms'])) < 60, `position at the end ${res['position ms']}`);
  assert.equal(res.rewind, '0x00000000'); assert.equal(res['rewound ms'], '0');
  assert.equal(res.wait, '0x00000000'); assert.equal(res['wait code'], '1');
  const elapsed2 = Number(res['elapsed 2 ms']);
  assert.ok(elapsed2 >= 1100 && elapsed2 <= 1350, `played again in ${elapsed2} ms`);
  assert.equal(res['short wait'], '0x80004004', 'WaitForCompletion timing out: E_ABORT');
  assert.equal(res['last release'], '0');
  // pictures: about one per frame for each of the plays, in the child window's rectangle (owner client + 8,6)
  const n = Math.round(1.2 * fps);
  assert.ok(shown.length >= 2 * (n - 2), `${shown.length} pictures shown`);
  const owner = [...vm.wm.windows.values()].find((x) => x.title === 'movie');
  const moved = shown.findIndex((x) => x.rect.w === 64); // (the pictures shown after SetDestinationPosition)
  assert.ok(moved > 0 && shown.length - moved === 2, `the picture shown again by SetDestinationPosition and by Pause (${moved}, ${shown.length}: ${shown.slice(-4).map((x) => x.at + ':' + x.rect.w).join(' ')})`);
  for (const s of shown.slice(0, moved)) {
    assert.equal(s.w, w); assert.equal(s.h, h);
    assert.deepEqual(s.rect, { x: owner.client.l + 8, y: owner.client.t + 6, w: 128, h: 96 });
  }
  // the destination rectangle (4, 2, 64 x 48) in the window: the picture shown by Pause goes there; then hidden
  assert.equal(res.destination, '0x00000000');
  assert.deepEqual([res['dest l'], res['dest t'], res['dest w'], res['dest h']], ['4', '2', '64', '48']);
  assert.deepEqual([res['win l'], res['win t'], res['win w'], res['win h']], ['8', '6', '128', '96']);
  assert.equal(res.pause, '0x00000000'); assert.equal(res['paused state'], '1');
  for (const s of shown.slice(moved)) assert.deepEqual(s.rect, { x: owner.client.l + 12, y: owner.client.t + 8, w: 64, h: 48 });
  assert.equal(res.hide, '0x00000000');
  const gaps = shown.slice(1, n - 2).map((s, i) => s.at - shown[i].at), period = 1000 / fps;
  assert.ok(Math.max(...gaps) <= period + 5 && Math.min(...gaps) >= period - 5, `picture intervals ${gaps.join(' ')}`);
  assert.ok(shown.some((s) => s.center.some((v) => v > 40)), 'pictures are not black');
  assert.ok(hidden >= 1, 'the video layer hidden (put_Visible(OAFALSE), release)');
  // sound: a stream voice of the DirectSound mixer, stopped at the end
  assert.ok(vm.audio, 'mixer created');
  assert.equal([...vm.audio.buffers].filter((b) => b.playing).length, 0);
  assert.ok(mixed > 10 && peak > peakRange[0] && peak < peakRange[1], `sound mixed: peak ${peak}`);
}

test('quartz.exe, an MPEG-1 movie: RenderFile, Run, video window, EC_COMPLETE (event handle, message, GetEvent, WaitForCompletion), seeking', { skip }, () => {
  // (the movie's sound: a 440 Hz tone of amplitude 1/8, played at -6 dB by IBasicAudio::put_Volume)
  checkPlayback(play(fs.readFileSync(MOVIE)), { fps: 25, w: 96, h: 64, peakRange: [0.055, 0.07] });
});

test('quartz.exe, an AVI (paletted frames, PCM): the same', { skip }, () => {
  // (sound: a saw wave between -1000 and +999 / 32768, at -6 dB)
  checkPlayback(play(makeAvi(96, 64, 12, 10).bytes), { fps: 10, w: 96, h: 64, peakRange: [0.012, 0.018] });
});
```

`tests/re3-lock.test.js`:

```js
// tools/re3/lock.json: every build's patches are in tools/re3/patches/ (build.sh applies them to a copy of the pinned
// sources) and touch a submodule the lock pins; every build's engine files are pinned (build.sh refuses one that
// differs); build ids are unique. The r2 builds carry librw's sample count fix (docs/browser-ports.md, "The engine,
// built from source"); the r3 builds read sound bank 0 sample by sample (docs/slow-network.md, "Launch set after an
// engine change"); the r4 builds seek a streamed MP3/ADF by its byte estimate (docs/slow-network.md, "A radio tuned at
// its position").
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const dir = path.join(import.meta.dirname, '..', 'tools', 're3');
const lock = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'lock.json'), 'utf8'));

test('re3 lock: unique builds, engine files pinned, patches present for pinned repositories', () => {
  const ids = lock.builds.map((b) => b.id);
  assert.equal(new Set(ids).size, ids.length);
  for (const b of lock.builds) {
    // (a build added unpinned — `files: {}`, build.sh prints the files to pin at its first install — only as the latest
    // of its line: nothing after it built on it yet)
    const line = (x) => x.replace(/-r\d+$/, ''); // (a build's line: its id without its revision)
    if (!Object.keys(b.files ?? {}).length) assert.ok(!lock.builds.slice(ids.indexOf(b.id) + 1).some((x) => line(x.id) === line(b.id)), `${b.id}: unpinned, not the latest of its line`);
    else assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(b.files).sort(), ['engine/revc.mjs', 'engine/revc.wasm'], b.id);
    for (const v of Object.values(b.files)) assert.match(v, /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/, b.id);
    for (const [repo, patch] of b.patches) {
      assert.ok(repo === '.' || lock.engine.submodules[repo], `${b.id}: ${repo} not a pinned submodule`);
      assert.ok(fs.statSync(path.join(dir, 'patches', patch)).isFile(), `${b.id}: ${patch} missing`);
    }
  }
});

test('re3 lock: the r2 builds ask WebGL for multisampling only above one sample', () => {
  for (const id of ['revc-web-e312f97-r2', 'revc-web-e312f97-plus-r2']) {
    const b = lock.builds.find((x) => x.id === id);
    assert.ok(b, id);
    assert.deepEqual(b.patches, [['vendor/librw', 'librw-webgl-samples.patch']]);
  }
  const patch = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'patches', 'librw-webgl-samples.patch'), 'utf8');
  assert.match(patch, /^\+\+\+ b\/src\/gl\/gl3device\.cpp$/m);
  assert.match(patch, /^\+\tSDL_GL_SetAttribute\(SDL_GL_MULTISAMPLESAMPLES, glGlobals\.numSamples > 1 \? glGlobals\.numSamples : 0\);$/m);
  assert.match(patch, /^\+\tSDL_GL_SetAttribute\(SDL_GL_MULTISAMPLEBUFFERS, glGlobals\.numSamples > 1 \? 1 : 0\);$/m);
});

test('re3 lock: the r3 builds add the lazy sound bank to r2\'s patches, each edition', () => {
  for (const [id, cmake] of [['revc-web-e312f97-r3', undefined], ['revc-web-e312f97-plus-r3', ['-DREVC_ORTHROS_EXTRAS=ON']]]) {
    const b = lock.builds.find((x) => x.id === id);
    assert.ok(b, id);
    assert.deepEqual(b.patches, [['vendor/librw', 'librw-webgl-samples.patch'], ['.', 'revc-lazy-sfx.patch']]);
    assert.deepEqual(b.cmake, cmake);
  }
  const patch = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'patches', 'revc-lazy-sfx.patch'), 'utf8');
  const files = [...patch.matchAll(/^\+\+\+ b\/(.+)$/gm)].map((m) => m[1]).sort();
  assert.deepEqual(files, ['src/audio/AudioLogic.cpp', 'src/audio/AudioManager.cpp', 'src/audio/sampman.h', 'src/audio/sampman_oal.cpp', 'src/skel/orthros_web.cpp', 'src/skel/orthros_web.h']);
  // (only under the browser's OpenAL build without Opus banks, one switch every audio file sees; the bank no longer read
  // whole; a sample read on its first play, exactly its range, when its bytes are here)
  assert.match(patch, /^\+#if defined\(__EMSCRIPTEN__\) && defined\(AUDIO_OAL\) && !defined\(OPUS_SFX\)\n\+[^]*?#define ORTHROS_LAZY_SFX$/m);
  assert.match(patch, /^\+\t\tgBankLoaded\[nBank\] = LOADING_STATUS_LOADED;\n\+\t\treturn TRUE;$/m);
  assert.match(patch, /^\+\tif \( !OrthrosFileReady\(fd, m_aSamples\[nSfx\]\.nOffset, size\) \)$/m);
  assert.match(patch, /^\+\tif \( pread\(fd, \(void \*\)addr, size, m_aSamples\[nSfx\]\.nOffset\) != \(ssize_t\)size \)$/m);
  // (a skipped play empties its channel — a caller that starts it all the same, the police radio, plays nothing rather
  // than the channel's last sample)
  assert.match(patch, /^\+\t\tif \( nBank == SFX_BANK_0 && !EnsureSample\(nSfx\) \)\n\+\t\t\{\n\+\t\t\tif \( GetChannelUsedFlag\(nChannel\) \)\n\+\t\t\t\tStopChannel\(nChannel\);\n\+\t\t\taChannel\[nChannel\]\.Reset\(\);\n\+\t\t\treturn FALSE;$/m);
  // (a skipped play frees its slot of the audio manager, so a loop — never checked against its channel — is asked for
  // again next frame and starts once its bytes are here)
  assert.match(patch, /^\+\t+else if \(m_asActiveSamples\[k\]\.m_nBankIndex == SFX_BANK_0\) \{\n(\+\t+\/\/.*\n)+\+\t+m_asActiveSamples\[k\]\.m_nSampleIndex = NO_SAMPLE;\n\+\t+m_asActiveSamples\[k\]\.m_nEntityIndex = AEHANDLE_NONE;\n\+\t+break;$/m);
  // (the player's gear change waits for its sample before moving the gear)
  assert.match(patch, /^\+\t+if \(!channelUsed && !SampleManager\.EnsureSample\(soundOffset \+ SFX_CAR_ACCEL_1\)\)\n\+\t+return;$/m);
  // (the page's count of the samples read and skipped, for tools/re3/check.mjs)
  assert.match(patch, /^\+EM_JS\(void, OrthrosSampleCount, \(int read, int frames\)/m);
});

test('re3 lock: the r4 builds add the fuzzy stream seek to r3\'s patches, each edition', () => {
  for (const [id, cmake] of [['revc-web-e312f97-r4', undefined], ['revc-web-e312f97-plus-r4', ['-DREVC_ORTHROS_EXTRAS=ON']]]) {

  const files = [...patch.matchAll(/^\+\+\+ b\/(.+)$/gm)].map((m) => m[1]);
  assert.deepEqual(files, ['src/audio/oal/stream.cpp']);
  // (the browser build only: a streamed MP3/ADF seeks to its byte estimate, not by reading every frame from byte 0 —
  // docs/slow-network.md "A radio tuned at its position"; the desktop build's flags unchanged)
  assert.match(patch, /^\+#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__\n(\+\/\/.*\n)+\+#define ORTHROS_MPG123_FLAGS \(MPG123_SEEKBUFFER \| MPG123_GAPLESS \| MPG123_FUZZY\)\n\+#else\n\+#define ORTHROS_MPG123_FLAGS \(MPG123_SEEKBUFFER \| MPG123_GAPLESS\)\n\+#endif$/m);
```

`tests/re3.test.js`:

```js
// re3 browser ports (src/host/re3.js, src/ports/re3/, docs/browser-ports.md "re3 ports"): catalog entries without an
// executable, the engine release's availability and routes, its own game files laid over the version's, the INI editor
// of a language's settings, and the player's profile (the files the engine wrote among the mounted game files).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { loadGameCatalog } from '../src/host/game-catalog.js';
import { gameLayers } from '../src/host/game-files.js';
import { re3Problem, re3Modes } from '../src/host/re3.js';
import { createServer } from '../src/host/server.js';
import { setIni, setIniDefaults, readIni, bytesToText, textToBytes } from '../src/ports/re3/ini.js';
import { profileSnapshot, restoreProfile, setProfileIni, toCloud, findPath, casePath, languageIni, envPreRun } from '../src/ports/re3/profile.js';
import { mountFiles } from '../src/vfs/emscripten-files.js';

const ENGINE = 'eng-test-1';
const re3 = (over = {}) => ({ engine: ENGINE, ...over });
const write = (file, data) => { fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(file, data); };

/**
 * A games folder: a Win32 game, a GoldSrc port and an re3 port (`entry` merged into its version entry), the last two on
 * the same engine release; an engines folder with that release (its module, its WebAssembly, its own game files) and
 * another release no manifest names.
 */
function fixture(t, entry = {}) {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-re3-'));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const games = path.join(root, 'games'), engines = path.join(root, 'engines');
  write(path.join(games, 'win', 'base', 'game.exe'), 'MZ'); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(games, 'win', 'versions', '1'), { recursive: true });
  write(path.join(games, 'win', 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, id: 'win', name: 'Win', defaultVersion: 'win-1', versions: [{ id: 'win-1', dir: '1', version: '1', exe: 'game.exe' }] }));
  write(path.join(games, 'gs', 'base', 'valve', 'maps', 'start.bsp'), 'map'); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(games, 'gs', 'versions', '1'), { recursive: true });
  write(path.join(games, 'gs', 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, id: 'gs', name: 'GS', defaultVersion: 'gs-1', defaults: { runtime: 'goldsrc' },
    versions: [{ id: 'gs-1', dir: '1', version: '1', goldsrc: { engine: ENGINE, gameDir: 'valve', modules: { client: 'c.wasm', server: 's.wasm' }, solo: { map: 'start' } } }] }));
  const gm = path.join(games, 'gm');
  write(path.join(gm, 'base', 'Text', 'AMERICAN.GXT'), 'base text');
  write(path.join(gm, 'base', 'data', 'x.dat'), 'base x');
  write(path.join(gm, 'base', 'game.exe'), 'MZ');
  write(path.join(gm, 'versions', 'web', 'DATA', 'X.DAT'), 'version x');
  write(path.join(gm, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, id: 'gm', name: 'GM', defaultVersion: 'gm-web', defaults: { runtime: 're3' },
    versions: [{ id: 'gm-web', dir: 'web', version: 'Web', languages: ['en', 'fr'], re3: re3({ args: ['-nointro'], languages: { fr: { env: { GAME_LANG: 'fr' }, ini: { 'game.ini': { General: { Language: '1' } } } } } }), ...entry }] }));
  const release = path.join(engines, ENGINE);
  for (const f of ['release.json', 'engine/main.mjs', 'engine/main.wasm', 'engine/main.worker.mjs', 'c.wasm', 's.wasm', 'engine/index.js', 'engine/xash.wasm', 'engine/valve/extras.pk3']) write(path.join(release, f), f);
  write(path.join(release, 'gamefiles', 'TEXT', 'american.gxt'), 'engine text');
  write(path.join(release, 'gamefiles', 'models', 'extra.txd'), 'extra');
  write(path.join(engines, 'other-1', 'engine', 'main.mjs'), 'other');
  return { root, games, engines, gm, release };
}
async function serve(t, opts) {
  const server = createServer({ ...opts, lanLog: () => {} });
  await new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  t.after(() => new Promise((resolve) => { server.closeAllConnections?.(); server.close(resolve); }));
  return `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
}
const editManifest = (dir, fn) => { const f = path.join(dir, 'manifest.json'), spec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')); fn(spec); fs.writeFileSync(f, JSON.stringify(spec)); };

test('an re3 version needs no executable and is checked by its own rules', (t) => {
  const { games, engines, gm, release } = fixture(t);
  const man = loadGameCatalog(games, null, { enginesDir: engines }).get('gm-web');
  assert.equal(man.runtime, 're3'); assert.equal(man.exe, undefined);
  assert.equal(man.saveKey, 'orthros-port:gm:web'); // (the installation, as the other ports': game and version folders)
  assert.deepEqual(gameLayers(man), [path.join(release, 'gamefiles'), man.folder, man.baseFolder]); // (the engine's files over the version's)
  assert.deepEqual(man.re3.languages.fr.env, { GAME_LANG: 'fr' });
  const gs = loadGameCatalog(games, null, { enginesDir: engines }).get('gs-1');
  assert.deepEqual(gameLayers(gs), [path.join(release, 'gamefiles'), gs.folder, gs.baseFolder], 'a GoldSrc port\'s release lays its game files the same way');
  assert.equal(re3Problem({ engine: ENGINE }), null);
  assert.equal(re3Problem({ engine: ENGINE, module: 'engine/main.mjs', args: ['+set', 'a=b', '-x.y'], solo: {}, languages: { en: {}, fr: { env: { A_1: '' }, ini: { 'sub/a.ini': { 'Main Section': { 'Some key': 'v w' } } } } } }), null);
  assert.equal(re3Problem({ engine: ENGINE, defaults: { 'reVC.ini': { Display: { Subtitles: '1' } } } }), null);
  // (ways to play: their own arguments, in order; none, a single game)
  assert.equal(re3Problem({ engine: ENGINE, modes: { story: {}, free: { args: ['-freemode'] } } }), null);
  assert.deepEqual(re3Modes({ engine: ENGINE, modes: { story: {}, free: {} } }), ['story', 'free']);
  assert.deepEqual(re3Modes({ engine: ENGINE }), ['solo']);
  for (const modes of [{}, { Free: {} }, { 'a b': {} }, { free: { args: ['bad arg'] } }, { free: { args: '-x' } }, { a: {}, b: {}, c: {}, d: {}, e: {} }, { free: 1 }])
    assert.match(re3Problem({ engine: ENGINE, modes }), /re3.modes/, JSON.stringify(modes));
  for (const defaults of [{ 'a.ini': { 'a=b': { k: '1' } } }, { 'a.ini': { ';S': { k: '1' } } }, { 'a.ini': { S: {} } }, { '../a.ini': { S: { k: '1' } } }, { 'a.ini': { S: { k: ' 1' } } }, []])
    assert.match(re3Problem({ engine: ENGINE, defaults }), /re3.defaults/, JSON.stringify(defaults));
  for (const [edit, error] of [
    [(v) => { delete v.re3; }, /re3 obligatoire/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.engine = '../x'; }, /re3.engine/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.module = '../engine/main.mjs'; }, /re3.module/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.module = 'engine/main.js'; }, /re3.module/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.args = '-nointro'; }, /re3.args/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.args = ['-a b']; }, /re3.args/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.args = ['-x;rm']; }, /re3.args/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.languages = { french: {} }; }, /re3.languages/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.languages = { fr: { env: { lower: 'x' } } }; }, /re3.languages/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.languages = { fr: { env: { A: 'x\ny' } } }; }, /re3.languages/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.languages = { fr: { env: { A: 'x'.repeat(65) } } }; }, /re3.languages/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.languages = { fr: { ini: { '../game.ini': { General: { Language: '1' } } } } }; }, /re3.languages/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.languages = { fr: { ini: { '/game.ini': { General: { Language: '1' } } } } }; }, /re3.languages/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.languages = { fr: { ini: { 'game.ini': { 'Gen]eral': { Language: '1' } } } } }; }, /re3.languages/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.languages = { fr: { ini: { 'game.ini': { General: { 'Lang=uage': '1' } } } } }; }, /re3.languages/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.languages = { fr: { ini: { 'game.ini': { General: { ';Language': '1' } } } } }; }, /re3.languages/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.languages = { fr: { ini: { 'game.ini': { General: { Language: '1\n[Other]' } } } } }; }, /re3.languages/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.languages = { fr: { ini: { 'game.ini': { General: { Language: ' 1' } } } } }; }, /re3.languages/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.languages = { fr: { ini: { 'game.ini': { General: { Language: '1 ' } } } } }; }, /re3.languages/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.languages = { fr: { ini: { 'game.ini': { General: {} } } } }; }, /re3.languages/],
    [(v) => { v.re3.solo = 'yes'; }, /re3.solo/],
    [(v) => { v.requires = [{ game: 'win', version: 'win-1', mount: 'C:\\Win' }]; }, /requires invalide/],
    [(v) => { v.overlays = ['/etc']; }, /overlays est généré/],
  ]) {
    editManifest(gm, (spec) => { spec.versions[0] = { id: 'gm-web', dir: 'web', version: 'Web', re3: re3() }; edit(spec.versions[0]); });
    assert.throws(() => loadGameCatalog(games, null, { enginesDir: engines }), error);
  }
  editManifest(gm, (spec) => { spec.versions[0] = { id: 'gm-web', dir: 'web', version: 'Web', re3: re3() }; spec.defaults.overlays = ['/etc']; });
  assert.throws(() => loadGameCatalog(games, null, { enginesDir: engines }), /defaults.overlays est réservé/);
});

test('the manifest schema\'s re3 rules are the catalog\'s: what one accepts, the other does', () => {
  const schema = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(new URL('../docs/game-manifest.schema.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8'));
  const r = schema.properties.versions.items.properties.re3.properties, ini = r.languages.additionalProperties.properties.ini, defaults = r.defaults;
  const rule = (o) => (value) => value.length <= o.maxLength && new RegExp(o.pattern).test(value);
  const long = (n) => 'x'.repeat(n);
  const slots = {
    module: [rule(r.module), (v) => ({ module: v }), ['engine/main.mjs', 'a.mjs', 'e ngine/m.mjs', '../../x.mjs', '/abs.mjs', './m.mjs', 'engine/.x.mjs', '.mjs', 'a\\b.mjs', 'engine//m.mjs', 'engine/main.js', `${long(124)}.mjs`, `${long(125)}.mjs`, 'm\n.mjs', '\u00e9.mjs']],
    file: [rule(ini.propertyNames), (v) => ({ languages: { fr: { ini: { [v]: { S: { k: 'v' } } } } } }), ['game.ini', 'sub/a.ini', 'a b.ini', '../game.ini', '/game.ini', '.hidden', 'sub/.x', 'a//b', 'a/', 'a\\b', long(128), long(129), 'a\tb', '\u00e9']],
    section: [rule(ini.additionalProperties.propertyNames), (v) => ({ languages: { fr: { ini: { 'a.ini': { [v]: { k: 'v' } } } } } }), ['General', 'Main Section', 'a=b', ';c', '#c', 'Gen]eral', '[A', ' A', 'A ', '', long(64), long(65), 'a\tb', '\u00e9']],
    key: [rule(ini.additionalProperties.additionalProperties.propertyNames), (v) => ({ languages: { fr: { ini: { 'a.ini': { S: { [v]: 'v' } } } } } }), ['Language', 'Some key', 'a#b', 'a;b', 'Lang=uage', ';Language', '#k', ' k', 'k ', 'k[', 'k]', '', long(64), long(65), '\u00e9']],
    value: [rule(ini.additionalProperties.additionalProperties.additionalProperties), (v) => ({ languages: { fr: { ini: { 'a.ini': { S: { k: v } } } } } }), ['', '1', 'v w', 'a=b', '[x]', ' 1', '1 ', '1\n[Other]', long(128), long(129), '\u00e9']],
    defaultSection: [rule(defaults.additionalProperties.propertyNames), (v) => ({ defaults: { 'a.ini': { [v]: { k: 'v' } } } }), ['General', 'Main Section', 'a=b', ';c', '#c', 'Gen]eral', ' A', 'A ', '', long(64), long(65), '\u00e9']],
    defaultValue: [rule(defaults.additionalProperties.additionalProperties.additionalProperties), (v) => ({ defaults: { 'a.ini': { S: { k: v } } } }), ['', '1', 'v w', ' 1', '1 ', long(128), long(129)]],
    mode: [rule({ maxLength: 16, pattern: r.modes.propertyNames.pattern }), (v) => ({ modes: { [v]: {} } }), ['story', 'free', 'free-2', 'Free', '2free', 'a b', '', long(16), long(17), 'f\u00e9']],
    modeArg: [rule({ maxLength: 64, pattern: r.modes.additionalProperties.properties.args.items.pattern }), (v) => ({ modes: { free: { args: [v] } } }), ['-freemode', '+set', 'a=b', 'bad arg', '', '--x', long(64), long(65)]],
  };
  for (const [slot, [schemaOk, entry, samples]] of Object.entries(slots)) {
    let accepted = 0;
    for (const v of samples) {
      const ok = re3Problem({ engine: ENGINE, ...entry(v) }) === null; accepted += ok;
      assert.equal(schemaOk(v), ok, `${slot} ${JSON.stringify(v)}: catalog ${ok ? 'accepts' : 'refuses'} it`);
    }
    assert.ok(accepted > 1 && accepted < samples.length, slot);
  }
});

test('the home lists an re3 port with its page and single player; available once its engine release is installed', async (t) => {
  const { games, engines, release, root } = fixture(t);
  const base = await serve(t, { gamesDir: games, enginesDir: engines });
  const entry = async () => (await (await fetch(`${base}/api/manifests`)).json()).find((m) => m.name === 'gm-web');
  const port = await entry();
  assert.deepEqual([port.runtime, port.launchUrl, port.modes, port.exe, port.available, port.saveKey], ['re3', '/ports/re3/gm-web/', ['solo'], null, true, 'orthros-port:gm:web']);
  // (the module the page imports: the release's only one with its WebAssembly — not a worker's)
  const man = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/manifest/gm-web`)).json();
  assert.equal(man.re3.module, 'engine/main.mjs'); assert.equal(man.launchUrl, '/ports/re3/gm-web/');
  assert.equal(man.overlays, undefined); assert.equal(JSON.stringify(man).includes(root), false);
  const page = await fetch(`${base}/ports/re3/gm-web/`);
  assert.equal(page.status, 200); assert.match(await page.text(), /src\/ports\/re3\/play\.js/);
  assert.equal(page.headers.get('cross-origin-embedder-policy'), 'require-corp');
  for (const p of ['/ports/re3/win-1/', '/ports/goldsrc/gm-web/', '/ports/re3/none/']) assert.equal((await fetch(base + p)).status, 404, p);
  // (two modules with their WebAssembly: none chosen, unless the manifest names one)
  write(path.join(release, 'engine', 'tool.mjs'), 'tool'); write(path.join(release, 'engine', 'tool.wasm'), 'tool');
  assert.equal((await entry()).available, false);
  assert.equal((await (await fetch(`${base}/api/manifest/gm-web`)).json()).re3.module, null);
  editManifest(path.join(games, 'gm'), (spec) => { spec.versions[0].re3.module = 'engine/main.mjs'; });
  assert.equal((await entry()).available, true);
  fs.rmSync(path.join(release, 'engine', 'main.wasm'));
  assert.equal((await entry()).available, false, 'its WebAssembly missing');
  fs.rmSync(release, { recursive: true });
  assert.equal((await entry()).available, false, 'the release missing');
});

test('engine files are served for the releases an re3 manifest names, immutable', async (t) => {
  const { games, engines } = fixture(t);
  const base = await serve(t, { gamesDir: games, enginesDir: engines });
  const wasm = await fetch(`${base}/engines/${ENGINE}/engine/main.wasm`);
  assert.equal(wasm.status, 200); assert.equal(wasm.headers.get('content-type'), 'application/wasm'); assert.match(wasm.headers.get('cache-control'), /immutable/);
  const module = await fetch(`${base}/engines/${ENGINE}/engine/main.mjs`);
  assert.equal(module.status, 200); assert.match(module.headers.get('content-type'), /javascript/);
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(`${base}/engines/${ENGINE}/gamefiles/TEXT/american.gxt`)).text(), 'engine text');
  assert.equal((await fetch(`${base}/engines/other-1/engine/main.mjs`)).status, 404, 'a release no manifest names');
  // (only a version whose runtime is re3 names one by its re3 entry)
  editManifest(path.join(games, 'win'), (spec) => { spec.versions[0].re3 = { engine: 'other-1' }; });
  await fetch(`${base}/api/manifests`); // (the catalog read again: the Win32 version names it in an re3 entry)
  assert.equal((await (await fetch(`${base}/api/manifest/win-1`)).json()).re3.engine, 'other-1');
  assert.equal((await fetch(`${base}/engines/other-1/engine/main.mjs`)).status, 404);
  editManifest(path.join(games, 'gm'), (spec) => { spec.versions[0].re3.engine = 'other-1'; });
  await fetch(`${base}/api/manifests`); // (the catalog read again)
  assert.equal((await fetch(`${base}/engines/other-1/engine/main.mjs`)).status, 200);
});

test('the release\'s own game files lie over the version\'s, whatever their case: tree, files, compressed ranges, learned reads', async (t) => {
  const { games, engines, release } = fixture(t);
  const base = await serve(t, { gamesDir: games, enginesDir: engines });
  const tree = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/tree/gm-web`)).json();
  // (one folder of each name: the engine's spelling first, as a version's over the base's)
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(tree.dirs).sort(), ['DATA', 'TEXT', 'models']);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(tree.dirs.TEXT.files), ['american.gxt']);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(tree.dirs.models.files), ['extra.txd']);
  assert.equal(tree.dirs.TEXT.files['american.gxt'].size, 'engine text'.length);
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(`${base}/game/gm-web/text/AMERICAN.gxt`)).text(), 'engine text');
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(`${base}/game/gm-web/models/extra.txd`)).text(), 'extra');
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(`${base}/game/gm-web/data/x.dat`)).text(), 'version x'); // (the version over the base, as before)
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(`${base}/gamez/gm-web/TEXT/american.gxt?r=0-11`)).text(), 'engine text');
  const prefetch = `${base}/api/prefetch/gm-web`;
  assert.equal((await fetch(prefetch, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ session: 's1', reads: [['models/extra.txd', 0, 5, 12], ['TEXT/american.gxt', 0, 11, 3]] }) })).status, 204);
  assert.deepEqual(await (await fetch(prefetch)).json(), [['TEXT/american.gxt', 0, 1, 3], ['models/extra.txd', 0, 1, 12]]);
  // (a GoldSrc port on the same release gets them too: the release's game files, whatever the runtime)
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(`${base}/game/gs-1/TEXT/american.gxt`)).text(), 'engine text');
  // (the release not installed: no layer, the game's own file — the tree listed again by itself, as /game/ resolves:
  // the page reads both, the home page not loaded since)
  fs.rmSync(path.join(release, 'gamefiles'), { recursive: true });
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(`${base}/game/gm-web/text/american.gxt`)).text(), 'base text');
  let again = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/tree/gm-web`)).json();
  assert.equal(again.dirs.models, undefined);
  assert.equal(again.dirs.Text.files['AMERICAN.GXT'].size, 'base text'.length);
  const learned = async () => (await (await fetch(prefetch)).json()).map((r) => r[0]);
  assert.equal((await fetch(prefetch, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ session: 's2', reads: [['models/new.txd', 0, 3, 1]] }) })).status, 204);
  assert.equal((await learned()).includes('models/new.txd'), false, 'not a file of the game now');
  // (installed again, its own files changed: the tree follows without the home page either, the reads of its files learned)
  write(path.join(release, 'gamefiles', 'TEXT', 'american.gxt'), 'engine text 2');
  write(path.join(release, 'gamefiles', 'models', 'new.txd'), 'new');
  again = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/tree/gm-web`)).json();
  assert.equal(again.dirs.TEXT.files['american.gxt'].size, 'engine text 2'.length);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(again.dirs.models.files), ['new.txd']);
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(`${base}/gamez/gm-web/TEXT/american.gxt?r=0-13`)).text(), 'engine text 2');
  assert.equal((await fetch(prefetch, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ session: 's3', reads: [['models/new.txd', 0, 3, 1]] }) })).status, 204);
  assert.equal((await learned()).includes('models/new.txd'), true);
});

test('an re3 game of its own over another game\'s files (requires): beneath its own, the engine\'s over all, no Windows mount', async (t) => {
  const { games, engines } = fixture(t);
  // (a second game on the home, empty: its version requires the Win32 game's version — the original files, no copy)
  const own = path.join(games, 'gm-re3');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(own, 'base'), { recursive: true });
  write(path.join(own, 'versions', 'r', 'data', 'own.dat'), 'its own');
  write(path.join(games, 'win', 'base', 'data', 'x.dat'), 'win x');
  write(path.join(games, 'win', 'base', 'Text', 'american.gxt'), 'win text');
  write(path.join(own, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, id: 'gm-re3', name: 'GM recompiled', defaultVersion: 'gm-r', defaults: { runtime: 're3' },
    versions: [{ id: 'gm-r', dir: 'r', version: 'R', re3: re3(), requires: [{ game: 'win', version: 'win-1' }] }] }));
  const catalog = loadGameCatalog(games, null, { enginesDir: engines });
  const m = catalog.get('gm-r');
  assert.equal(m.extraMounts, undefined);
  assert.deepEqual(m.underlays, [path.join(games, 'win', 'versions', '1'), path.join(games, 'win', 'base')]);
  assert.equal(m.saveKey, 'orthros-port:gm-re3:r');
  const base = await serve(t, { gamesDir: games, enginesDir: engines });
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(`${base}/game/gm-r/data/x.dat`)).text(), 'win x');
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(`${base}/game/gm-r/data/own.dat`)).text(), 'its own');
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(`${base}/game/gm-r/text/american.gxt`)).text(), 'engine text');
  const tree = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/tree/gm-r`)).json();
  assert.ok(tree.dirs.data.files['x.dat'] && tree.dirs.data.files['own.dat'] && tree.files['game.exe']);
  // (the Win32 game's files are its own: marked so, served under it — the browsers keep one copy for both games —;
  // the re3 game's own files and the engine's over the Win32 game's are not)
  assert.deepEqual(m.underlayOwners, [{ manifest: 'win-1', dirs: [path.join(games, 'win', 'versions', '1'), path.join(games, 'win', 'base')] }]);
  assert.equal(tree.dirs.data.files['x.dat'].owner, 'win-1');
  assert.equal(tree.dirs.data.files['own.dat'].owner, undefined);
  assert.equal(tree.dirs.Text?.files['american.gxt']?.owner ?? tree.dirs.TEXT.files['american.gxt'].owner, undefined, 'the engine\'s file over it');
  assert.equal(await (await fetch(`${base}/gamez/win-1/data/x.dat?r=0-5`)).text(), 'win x');
  assert.equal((await (await fetch(`${base}/api/manifest/gm-r`)).json()).underlayOwners, undefined, 'its folders not told');
  // (two cards: each game its own, the Win32 one unchanged)
  const listed = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/manifests`)).json();
  assert.deepEqual(listed.find((v) => v.name === 'gm-r').owners, ['win-1'], 'the versions whose files it reads');
  assert.deepEqual(listed.filter((v) => ['gm-r', 'win-1'].includes(v.name)).map((v) => [v.name, v.gameId, v.runtime]).sort(), [['gm-r', 'gm-re3', 're3'], ['win-1', 'win', 'win32']]);
  // (a mount is the Win32 games' way, refused here; a GoldSrc port still requires GoldSrc ports only)
  editManifest(own, (spec) => { spec.versions[0].requires[0].mount = 'D:\\'; });
  assert.throws(() => loadGameCatalog(games, null, { enginesDir: engines }), /requires invalide/);
  editManifest(own, (spec) => { delete spec.versions[0].requires[0].mount; });
  editManifest(path.join(games, 'gs'), (spec) => { spec.versions[0].requires = [{ game: 'win', version: 'win-1' }]; });
  assert.throws(() => loadGameCatalog(games, null, { enginesDir: engines }), /n'est pas un portage goldsrc/);
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- a language's settings in the engine's ini files

test('defaults go in an ini file once, recorded there: then the player\'s choice stays; a changed default once more', () => {
  const defaults = { Display: { Subtitles: '1' } };
  const first = setIniDefaults('[General]\r\nLanguage=0\r\n[Display]\r\nSubtitles = 0\r\n', defaults);
  assert.equal(first, '[General]\r\nLanguage=0\r\n[Display]\r\nSubtitles = 1\r\n\r\n[OrthrosDefaults]\r\nDisplay.Subtitles=1\r\n');
  assert.equal(setIniDefaults(first, defaults), first, 'got already: nothing changes');
  // (the player turned them off — the engine wrote its file again, the record kept, its case its own)
  const off = '[general]\nlanguage=0\n[display]\nsubtitles=0\n[orthrosdefaults]\ndisplay.subtitles=1\n';
  assert.equal(setIniDefaults(off, defaults), off);
  assert.equal(setIniDefaults(off, { Display: { Subtitles: '2' } }), '[general]\nlanguage=0\n[display]\nsubtitles=2\n[orthrosdefaults]\ndisplay.subtitles=2\n');
  assert.equal(setIniDefaults('', defaults), '[Display]\nSubtitles=1\n\n[OrthrosDefaults]\nDisplay.Subtitles=1\n', 'a new file');
  assert.deepEqual([...readIni('\xef\xbb\xbf[A]\nk = v \n;c=1\n[a]\nK=w\nx=a=b').get('a')], [['k', 'w'], ['x', 'a=b']]);
});

test('the INI editor sets keys in place and keeps everything else byte for byte', () => {
  const text = '; settings\r\n[General]\r\nLanguage = 0  \r\nother=1\r\n\r\n[Graphics]\r\nWidth=640\r\n';
  assert.equal(setIni(text, { general: { language: '0' } }), text, 'nothing to change: the same text');
  assert.equal(setIni(text, { General: { Language: '3' } }), text.replace('Language = 0  ', 'Language = 3'));
  // (a missing key after its section's last line, a missing section at the end, in the file's line endings)
  assert.equal(setIni(text, { General: { Subtitles: '1' }, Audio: { Volume: '7', Mute: '0' } }),
    '; settings\r\n[General]\r\nLanguage = 0  \r\nother=1\r\nSubtitles=1\r\n\r\n[Graphics]\r\nWidth=640\r\n\r\n[Audio]\r\nVolume=7\r\nMute=0\r\n');
  assert.equal(setIni('', { General: { Language: '1' } }), '[General]\nLanguage=1\n');
  assert.equal(setIni('[General]\nA=1', { General: { B: '2' } }), '[General]\nA=1\nB=2\n', 'a last line without its end');
  assert.equal(setIni('x=1', { S: { k: 'v' } }), 'x=1\n\n[S]\nk=v\n');
  // (every section of that name, every line of the key: whichever the engine reads; a key of another section untouched)
  assert.equal(setIni('[A]\nk=1\n[B]\nk=1\n[a]\n  K\t=\t1\n', { A: { k: '2' } }), '[A]\nk=2\n[B]\nk=1\n[a]\n  K\t=\t2\n');
  // (comments and look-alikes are not keys; a value may hold '=')
  assert.equal(setIni('[A]\n;k=1\n#k=1\nk = a=b\n', { A: { k: 'c' } }), '[A]\n;k=1\n#k=1\nk = c\n');
  // (the same settings set again: nothing changes — a value's spaces around it are not the line's)
  for (const [before, sections] of [[text, { General: { Language: '3' } }], ['[General]\nLanguage=0\n', { General: { Language: ' 1' } }], ['[A]\nk =  v  \n', { A: { k: 'w ' } }], ['', { S: { k: ' v ' } }]]) {
    const once = setIni(before, sections);
    assert.notEqual(once, before);
    assert.equal(setIni(once, sections), once, JSON.stringify(once));
  }
  assert.equal(setIni('[General]\nLanguage=0\n', { General: { Language: ' 1' } }), '[General]\nLanguage=1\n');
  assert.equal(setIni('[A]\nk =  v  \n', { A: { k: 'v' } }), '[A]\nk =  v  \n');
  // (a byte-order mark kept; the file's other bytes, whatever they are, too)
  const bytes = Uint8Array.from([0xef, 0xbb, 0xbf, ...Buffer.from('[A]\nk=1\nname=\xe9t\xe9\n', 'latin1')]);
  const out = textToBytes(setIni(bytesToText(bytes), { a: { K: '2' } }));
  assert.deepEqual([...out], [0xef, 0xbb, 0xbf, ...Buffer.from('[A]\nk=2\nname=\xe9t\xe9\n', 'latin1')]);
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the profile among the mounted game files

/** The part of Emscripten's FS the profile uses: folders, files of bytes, nodes (a file's reads counted). */
function memFS() {
  const DIR = 0o40000, FILE = 0o100000, top = { mode: DIR | 0o755, children: new Map() };
  const split = (p) => p.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  const get = (p) => { let n = top; for (const part of split(p)) { n = n.children?.get(part); if (!n) return null; } return n; };
  const parent = (p) => { const parts = split(p), n = get('/' + parts.slice(0, -1).join('/')); if (!n?.children) throw new Error(`ENOENT ${p}`); return [n, parts.at(-1)]; };
  const FS = {
    isDir: (mode) => (mode & 0o170000) === DIR, isFile: (mode) => (mode & 0o170000) === FILE,
    lookupPath(p) { const node = get(p); if (!node) throw new Error(`ENOENT ${p}`); return { path: p, node }; },
    readdir(p) { const n = get(p); if (!n?.children) throw new Error(`ENOTDIR ${p}`); return ['.', '..', ...n.children.keys()]; },
    readFile(p) { const n = get(p); if (!n || n.children) throw new Error(`ENOENT ${p}`); n.reads = (n.reads ?? 0) + 1; return n.data.slice(); },
    writeFile(p, data) { const [dir, name] = parent(p); const old = dir.children.get(name); if (old?.children) throw new Error('EISDIR'); if (old) old.data = Uint8Array.from(data); else dir.children.set(name, { mode: FILE | 0o644, data: Uint8Array.from(data) }); },
    unlink(p) { const [dir, name] = parent(p); dir.children.delete(name); },
    mkdirTree(p) { let n = top; for (const part of split(p)) { let next = n.children?.get(part); if (!next) { if (!n.children) throw new Error(`ENOTDIR ${p}`); n.children.set(part, next = { mode: DIR | 0o755, children: new Map() }); } n = next; } },
    // (a streamed game file's node, ../src/vfs/emscripten-files.js)
    createFile(dir, name) { const node = { mode: FILE | 0o444, stream_ops: {} }; get(dir).children.set(name, node); return node; },
    // (open's checks: permissions, O_CREAT 0o100, O_EXCL 0o200, O_TRUNC 0o1000; fopen's modes as strings)
    open(p, flags) {
      const f = typeof flags === 'string' ? { r: 0, 'r+': 2, w: 0o1101, 'w+': 0o1102, wx: 0o1301, a: 0o2101 }[flags] : flags;
      const n = get(p);
      if (n && (f & 0o300) === 0o300) throw new FS.ErrnoError('EEXIST');
      if (n && (f & 3) && !(n.mode & 0o222)) throw new FS.ErrnoError('EACCES');
      if (!n) { if (!(f & 0o100)) throw new FS.ErrnoError('ENOENT'); FS.writeFile(p, new Uint8Array(0)); } else if (f & 0o1000) n.data = new Uint8Array(0);
      return { node: get(p) };
    },
    ErrnoError: class extends Error {},
  };
  return FS;
}
const text = (s) => new TextEncoder().encode(s);
/** The game data of `files` with no network: a read is recorded and fails (src/vfs/data-client.js's interface). */
const gameData = (files, fetched) => ({ file: (name, p) => ({ ...files.find((f) => f.path === p) }), read: (h) => { fetched.push(h.path); throw new Error('no network'); } });

test('the profile is every file the engine wrote among the game\'s, put back over the game files it replaced', () => {
  const FS = memFS(), game = new Set(), mount = (p, s) => { FS.mkdirTree(p.slice(0, p.lastIndexOf('/'))); FS.writeFile(p, text(s)); game.add(FS.lookupPath(p).node); };
  mount('/game/data/x.dat', 'game x'); mount('/game/TEXT/american.gxt', 'text'); mount('/game/settings.ini', '[General]\nLanguage=0\n');
  // (what the engine wrote: its user folder, its ini at the root, a game file it replaced, logs)
  FS.mkdirTree('/game/userfiles/screenshots'); FS.writeFile('/game/userfiles/save1.b', text('save'));
  FS.writeFile('/game/userfiles/screenshots/s.bmp', text('pic')); FS.writeFile('/game/engine.log', text('log'));
  FS.unlink('/game/data/x.dat'); FS.writeFile('/game/data/x.dat', text('rewritten'));
  const snap = profileSnapshot(FS, '/game', game);
  assert.deepEqual(snap.map((f) => f.path).sort(), ['data/x.dat', 'engine.log', 'userfiles/save1.b', 'userfiles/screenshots/s.bmp']);
  assert.equal([...game].reduce((n, node) => n + (node.reads ?? 0), 0), 0, 'a game file is never read: its bytes may not be here');
  assert.deepEqual(toCloud(snap).map((f) => f.path).sort(), ['data/x.dat', 'userfiles/save1.b'], 'the account keeps no logs nor screenshots');
  // (a new session: the game files mounted again, the profile put back over them)
  const FS2 = memFS(), game2 = new Set(), mount2 = (p, s) => { FS2.mkdirTree(p.slice(0, p.lastIndexOf('/'))); FS2.writeFile(p, text(s)); game2.add(FS2.lookupPath(p).node); };
  mount2('/game/data/x.dat', 'game x'); mount2('/game/userfiles', 'a file where the profile has a folder');
  const told = [];
  restoreProfile(FS2, '/game', [...snap, { path: '../escape', data: text('x') }, { path: 'a/b', data: 'not bytes' }], (line) => told.push(line));
  assert.equal(new TextDecoder().decode(FS2.readFile('/game/data/x.dat')), 'rewritten');
  assert.equal(game2.has(FS2.lookupPath('/game/data/x.dat').node), false, 'the profile\'s own copy');
  assert.deepEqual(profileSnapshot(FS2, '/game', game2).map((f) => f.path).sort(), ['data/x.dat', 'engine.log']);
  assert.equal(told.length, 4, told.join('\n')); // (two invalid entries, two under a game file that is not a folder)
});

test('the streamed game files mounted in the game\'s folder are never part of the profile, nor fetched for it', () => {
  const FS = memFS(), fetched = [];
  const files = [{ path: 'data/x.dat', size: 10, mtime: 1 }, { path: 'TEXT/american.gxt', size: 20, mtime: 1 }];
  FS.mkdirTree('/game');
  const game = mountFiles(FS, '/game', gameData(files, fetched), 'gm-web', files);
  assert.equal(game.size, 2); assert.ok([...game].every(Boolean));
  FS.mkdirTree('/game/userfiles'); FS.writeFile('/game/userfiles/save1.b', text('save')); FS.writeFile('/game/settings.ini', text('[A]\n'));
  assert.deepEqual(profileSnapshot(FS, '/game', game).map((f) => f.path).sort(), ['settings.ini', 'userfiles/save1.b']);
  assert.deepEqual(fetched, []);
});

test('a game file the engine writes anew becomes a file of the profile (rewritable streamed files); in place, read-only', () => {
  const FS = memFS(), fetched = [];
  const files = [{ path: 'settings.ini', size: 4, mtime: 1 }, { path: 'data/x.dat', size: 4, mtime: 1 }, { path: 'data/y.dat', size: 4, mtime: 1 }, { path: 'data/z.dat', size: 4, mtime: 1 }];
  FS.mkdirTree('/game');
  const game = mountFiles(FS, '/game', gameData(files, fetched), 'gm-web', files, { rewritable: true }), isGame = (p) => game.has(FS.lookupPath(p).node);
  FS.open('/game/settings.ini', 0o1101); // (O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC: fopen's "w")
  FS.open('/game/data/z.dat', 'w+');
  assert.equal(isGame('/game/settings.ini'), false); assert.equal(isGame('/game/data/z.dat'), false);
  assert.equal(FS.readFile('/game/settings.ini').length, 0);
  assert.throws(() => FS.open('/game/data/x.dat', 2), /EACCES/, 'read-write: changed in place');
  assert.throws(() => FS.open('/game/data/x.dat', 'a'), /EACCES/);
  assert.throws(() => FS.open('/game/data/x.dat', 0o1301), /EEXIST/, 'O_EXCL: there');
  assert.throws(() => FS.open('/game/data/x.dat', 'wx'), /EEXIST/);
  FS.open('/game/data/y.dat', 0);
  assert.equal(isGame('/game/data/x.dat'), true); assert.equal(isGame('/game/data/y.dat'), true);
  assert.deepEqual(profileSnapshot(FS, '/game', game).map((f) => f.path).sort(), ['data/z.dat', 'settings.ini']);
  assert.deepEqual(fetched, [], 'a file written anew is never fetched');
  // (by default — GoldSrc's — the game files stay read-only)
  const FS2 = memFS(); FS2.mkdirTree('/game'); mountFiles(FS2, '/game', gameData(files, []), 'gs-1', files);
  assert.throws(() => FS2.open('/game/settings.ini', 0o1101), /EACCES/);
});

test('a language\'s settings go into the profile\'s ini file, the game\'s own copied first, found whatever its case', () => {
  const FS = memFS(), game = new Set();
  FS.mkdirTree('/game'); FS.writeFile('/game/Settings.INI', text('; game\n[General]\nLanguage=0\nWidth=640\n')); game.add(FS.lookupPath('/game/Settings.INI').node);
  assert.equal(findPath(FS, '/game', 'settings.ini'), 'Settings.INI');
  // (the game's own file, its settings already these: still copied into the profile — a game file is read-only, and
  // the engine writes its settings there)
  assert.equal(setProfileIni(FS, '/game', 'settings.ini', { General: { Language: '0' } }, game), 'copied');
  assert.equal(game.has(FS.lookupPath('/game/Settings.INI').node), false, 'the profile\'s own copy');
  assert.equal(new TextDecoder().decode(FS.readFile('/game/Settings.INI')), '; game\n[General]\nLanguage=0\nWidth=640\n');
  assert.equal(setProfileIni(FS, '/game', 'settings.ini', { General: { Language: '0' } }, game), 'same');
  assert.equal(setProfileIni(FS, '/game', 'settings.ini', { General: { Language: '1' } }, game), 'set');
  assert.equal(new TextDecoder().decode(FS.readFile('/game/Settings.INI')), '; game\n[General]\nLanguage=1\nWidth=640\n');
  assert.equal(setProfileIni(FS, '/game', 'settings.ini', { General: { Language: '1' } }, game), 'same', 'set again: nothing to write');
  assert.deepEqual(profileSnapshot(FS, '/game', game).map((f) => f.path), ['Settings.INI']);
  // (a game file a language sets nothing in: copied as it is; a missing one with nothing to set: none made)
  FS.writeFile('/game/other.ini', text('[A]\nk=1\n')); game.add(FS.lookupPath('/game/other.ini').node);
  assert.equal(setProfileIni(FS, '/game', 'OTHER.ini', {}, game), 'copied');
  assert.equal(setProfileIni(FS, '/game', 'none.ini', {}, game), 'same');
  assert.equal(findPath(FS, '/game', 'none.ini'), null);
  assert.equal(setProfileIni(FS, '/game', 'sub/new.ini', { A: { k: 'v' } }, game), 'created');
  assert.equal(new TextDecoder().decode(FS.readFile('/game/sub/new.ini')), '[A]\nk=v\n');
  // (a new file in a folder that is there under another case: in that folder, not in a second one of the same name)
  FS.mkdirTree('/game/UserFiles/Saves');
  assert.equal(setProfileIni(FS, '/game', 'userfiles/saves/new.ini', { A: { k: 'v' } }, game), 'created');
  assert.equal(setProfileIni(FS, '/game', 'userfiles/conf/new.ini', { A: { k: 'v' } }, game), 'created');
  assert.deepEqual(FS.readdir('/game').filter((n) => n.toLowerCase() === 'userfiles'), ['UserFiles']);
  assert.deepEqual(profileSnapshot(FS, '/game', game).map((f) => f.path).sort(), ['Settings.INI', 'UserFiles/Saves/new.ini', 'UserFiles/conf/new.ini', 'other.ini', 'sub/new.ini'].sort());
  assert.deepEqual(casePath(FS, '/game', 'userfiles/SAVES/x/y.ini'), { path: 'UserFiles/Saves/x/y.ini', found: false });
});

test('a language\'s ini settings cover every file the version\'s languages name, the others\' copied as they are', () => {
  const languages = { en: { ini: { 'game.ini': { General: { Language: '0' } } } }, fr: { env: { A: 'b' }, ini: { 'Game.ini': { General: { Language: '1' } }, 'fr.ini': { S: { k: 'v' } } } }, de: {} };
  assert.deepEqual(languageIni(languages, 'fr'), [['Game.ini', { General: { Language: '1' } }], ['fr.ini', { S: { k: 'v' } }]]);
  assert.deepEqual(languageIni(languages, 'en'), [['game.ini', { General: { Language: '0' } }], ['fr.ini', {}]]);
  assert.deepEqual(languageIni(languages, 'de'), [['game.ini', {}], ['fr.ini', {}]]);
  assert.deepEqual(languageIni(undefined, 'en'), []);
});

test('a language\'s environment is set before the engine\'s runtime starts, as its C library copies it then', async () => {
  // (an Emscripten module's order: the page's overrides, ENV exported, preRun hooks, the constructors — libc's copy of
  // the environment —, then the Module handed over)
  const createEngine = async (overrides) => {
    const M = { ...overrides, ENV: { HOME: '/home/web_user' } };
    for (const hook of [].concat(M.preRun ?? [])) hook(M);
    const environ = Object.entries(M.ENV).map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`);
    return { ...M, getenv: (k) => environ.find((e) => e.startsWith(k + '='))?.slice(k.length + 1) ?? null };
  };
  const engine = await createEngine({ noInitialRun: true, preRun: [envPreRun({ GAME_LANG: 'fr', EMPTY: '' })] });
  assert.equal(engine.getenv('GAME_LANG'), 'fr'); assert.equal(engine.getenv('EMPTY'), ''); assert.equal(engine.getenv('HOME'), '/home/web_user');
  const told = [];
  envPreRun({ A: 'b' }, (line) => told.push(line))({});
  assert.deepEqual(told, ['A: the engine exposes no environment']);
  envPreRun(undefined)({ ENV: {} });
});
```

```js
// The rendering mode the emulator worker chooses (render-host.js renderMode): the render worker by default, the page's
// ?glworker= first, then the manifest's compat flag glWorker (docs/render-worker.md section 8.8).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { renderMode } from '../src/gfx/render-host.js';

test('renderMode: the render worker unless the page or the manifest asks otherwise', () => {
  assert.equal(renderMode(undefined, undefined), '1', 'default: the render worker');
  assert.equal(renderMode('', undefined), '1', 'an empty ?glworker= is no choice');
  assert.equal(renderMode(undefined, false), '0', 'manifest glWorker: false keeps the in-thread backend');
  assert.equal(renderMode(undefined, 0), '0', 'manifest glWorker: 0 keeps the in-thread backend');
  assert.equal(renderMode(undefined, true), '1');
  assert.equal(renderMode(undefined, 1), '1');
  assert.equal(renderMode(undefined, 'inline'), 'inline');
  assert.equal(renderMode('0', undefined), '0', '?glworker=0: the in-thread backend');
  assert.equal(renderMode('0', true), '0', 'the page wins over the manifest');
  assert.equal(renderMode('1', false), '1', 'the page wins over the manifest');
  assert.equal(renderMode('compare-worker', 0), 'compare-worker');
});
```

`tests/render-replay-fast.test.js`:

```js
// The render worker's replay reads the commands of every draw straight from the ring words (Replayer.applyFast); the
// general path decodes them by the command table. Random commands of those kinds — every encoding the table allows
// (uint32, int32, float64 and missing numbers, empty, short and absent word lists) — applied both ways must leave
// equal mirrors and drive their backends with the same calls.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { OP, RingWriter, CONST_FIELDS, VERSION_FIELDS } from '../src/gfx/cmd-ring.js';
import { Replayer } from '../src/gfx/d3d-mirror.js';

function replayer(words, fast, calls) {
  const r = new Replayer(words, { mem: null, ack: null, createBackend: () => ({
    drawPrimitive: (...a) => calls.push(['dp', ...a]), drawIndexedPrimitive: (...a) => calls.push(['dip', ...a]), constTouched: (...a) => calls.push(['ct', ...a]),
  }) });
  if (!fast) r.applyFast = () => false;
  return r;
}

test('replay: the per-draw commands read from the ring words equal the decoded general path', () => {
  let s = 7; const rnd = (n) => { s = (Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 0x2c1b3c6d) + 0x9e3779b9) >>> 0; return s % n; };
  const num = () => { const k = rnd(6); return k < 3 ? rnd(100000) : k === 3 ? -1 - rnd(1000) : k === 4 ? rnd(1000) / 7 : undefined; };
  for (const api9 of [1, 0]) {
    const words = new Int32Array(1 << 16), w = new RingWriter(words, () => { throw new Error('full'); });
    w.put(OP.DEVICE, 1, api9, 640, 480, 1); w.put(OP.TABLES, 8, api9 ? 16 : 0); w.put(OP.STREAMS, 4); w.put(OP.TEXTURES, 8); w.put(OP.CONSTS, 1024, 128, api9 ? 64 : 0, api9 ? 64 : 0, api9 ? 16 : 0, api9 ? 16 : 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < 3000; i++) {
      switch (rnd(11)) {
        case 0: { const n = rnd(5), t = []; for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) t.push(rnd(api9 ? 25 : 9), rnd(200), rnd(0xffffffff) | 0); w.put(OP.TSETS, Int32Array.from(t)); break; }
        case 1: w.put(OP.VERSION, rnd(VERSION_FIELDS.length), num()); break;
        case 2: w.put(OP.TEXTURE, rnd(8), rnd(50)); break;
        case 3: w.put(OP.STREAM, rnd(4), rnd(50), num(), num()); break;
        case 4: w.put(OP.INDICES, rnd(50), num()); break;
        case 5: { const k = rnd(api9 ? 6 : 2), len = [1024, 128, 64, 64, 16, 16][k], n = rnd(9), lo = rnd(len - n + 1); w.put(OP.CONST, k, lo, Int32Array.from({ length: n }, () => rnd(0xffffffff) | 0)); break; }
        case 6: { const slot = [2, 3, 256, 257, 16][rnd(5)], m = rnd(6); w.put(OP.XFORM, slot, num(), m === 0 ? null : Int32Array.from({ length: m === 1 ? 4 : 16 }, () => rnd(0xffffffff) | 0)); break; }
        case 7: w.put(OP.DRAW, rnd(6), rnd(100), rnd(100)); break;
        case 8: w.put(OP.LIGHT, rnd(6), Int32Array.from({ length: rnd(3) ? 26 : rnd(27) }, () => rnd(0xffffffff) | 0)); break;
        case 9: w.put(OP.MATERIAL, Int32Array.from({ length: rnd(3) ? 17 : rnd(18) }, () => rnd(0xffffffff) | 0)); break;
        default: w.put(OP.DRAW_INDEXED, rnd(6), rnd(100), rnd(100), rnd(100), rnd(100), num()); break;
      }
      if (rnd(500) === 0) w.put(OP.XFORMS);
      if (rnd(700) === 0) w.put(OP.LIGHTS);
    }
    const callsA = [], callsB = [], A = replayer(words, true, callsA), B = replayer(words, false, callsB);
    A.run(w.produced); B.run(w.produced);
    const a = A.devices.get(1), b = B.devices.get(1);
    assert.deepEqual(callsA, callsB, 'the same backend calls');
    for (const f of [...VERSION_FIELDS, 'textures', 'streams', 'indices']) assert.deepEqual(a[f], b[f], f);
    for (const f of CONST_FIELDS) assert.deepEqual(a[f] && Array.from(a[f]), b[f] && Array.from(b[f]), f);
    const tbl = (m) => [m.rs, ...m.tss, ...(m.samplers ?? [])].map((t) => [...t]);
    assert.deepEqual(tbl(a), tbl(b), 'state tables');
    assert.deepEqual([...a.transformSlotVersion], [...b.transformSlotVersion], 'transform versions');
    const w32 = (v) => Array.from(new Int32Array(v.buffer, v.byteOffset, v.length));
    assert.deepEqual(w32(a.material), w32(b.material), 'material words');
    assert.deepEqual([...a.lights].map(([k, v]) => [k, w32(v)]), [...b.lights].map(([k, v]) => [k, w32(v)]), 'light words');
    assert.deepEqual([...a.transforms].map(([k, v]) => [k, Array.from(new Int32Array(v.buffer, v.byteOffset, 16))]), [...b.transforms].map(([k, v]) => [k, Array.from(new Int32Array(v.buffer, v.byteOffset, 16))]), 'transform words');
  }
});
```

`tests/render-thread-worker.js`:

```js
// Node worker of tests/render-worker-thread.test.js: the render worker's replay loop (src/gfx/render-loop.js) with the
// WebGL backend on a recording context, on another thread than the recording emulator.
import { parentPort, workerData } from 'node:worker_threads';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';

  mem: new GuestMemory({ memory }), ack: new Int32Array(ack),
  createBackend: (m) => new WebGLDevice(G.gl, m, {}),
  onPresent: (m, frame) => { Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.SHOWN, frame); Atomics.notify(ctl, CTL.SHOWN); },
  onReadback: (ticket) => { publishTail(ctl, replayer); Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.READBACK, ticket); Atomics.notify(ctl, CTL.READBACK); },

Atomics.store(ctl, CTL.READY, 1);

await replayLoop(ctl, replayer, null, stats, () => Atomics.load(stop, 0) !== 0);
parentPort.postMessage({ calls: G.calls, commands: replayer.commands });
```

`tests/render-worker-bufdata.test.js`:

```js
// Render worker, buffer contents through the ring (BUF_DATA): buffers larger than one ring chunk (1 MiB), odd
// lengths, unaligned lock ranges straddling chunk boundaries, a static buffer switched to ring data by a lock that
// meets pending draws, a dynamic buffer created and filled before its first use, and buffers released while draws
// that read them are pending. The replayed backend must issue the same WebGL calls (contents compared by checksum)
// as the in-thread one, and every mirror copy must equal the guest memory at the end.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Replayer } from '../src/gfx/d3d-mirror.js';
import { RenderLink, Recorder } from '../src/gfx/d3d-recorder.js';
import { WebGLDevice } from '../src/gfx/d3d8-webgl.js';
import { d3dEnv } from './d3d-random.js';
import { fakeGl, firstDifference } from './fake-gl.js';

function session(gfx, seed, api9, onEnd) {
  const E = d3dEnv(gfx), { mem, ctx, com } = E;
  let s = seed; const rnd = (n) => { s = (Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 0x2c1b3c6d) + 0x9e3779b9) | 0; return ((s >>> 0) % n); };
  const out = E.alloc(64), pp = E.alloc(64);
  [320, 240, 22, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 75, 0, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(pp + 4 * i, v));
  if (!api9) { mem.write32(pp + 20, 1); mem.write32(pp + 24, 0); mem.write32(pp + 28, 1); mem.write32(pp + 32, 1); mem.write32(pp + 36, 75); mem.write32(pp + 40, 0); }
  const d3dPtr = E.defs[api9 ? 'Direct3DCreate9' : 'Direct3DCreate8'][1](ctx([api9 ? 32 : 220]));
  assert.equal(com.implAt(d3dPtr).CreateDevice(ctx([d3dPtr, 0, 1, 0, 0x40, pp, out])), 0);
  const devPtr = mem.read32(out), dev = com.implAt(devPtr);
  const call = (name, ...args) => dev[name](ctx([devPtr, ...args]));
  const MiB = 1 << 20;
  const create = (len, usage) => { assert.equal(call('CreateVertexBuffer', len, usage, 0x142, 0, out), 0); return mem.read32(out); };
  const fill = (ptr, off, size, flags) => {
    const b = com.implAt(ptr);
    assert.equal(b.Lock(ctx([ptr, off, size, out, flags])), 0);
    const a = mem.read32(out), n = size || b.length - off;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) mem.u8[a + i] = rnd(256);
    b.Unlock(ctx([ptr]));
  };
  const bind = (ptr) => { if (api9) { call('SetStreamSource', 0, ptr, 0, 24); call('SetFVF', 0x142); } else { call('SetStreamSource', 0, ptr, 24); call('SetVertexShader', 0x142); } };
  const draw = (b) => call('DrawPrimitive', 4, Math.max(0, Math.floor((MiB + rnd(4096) - 2048) / 24)), 1 + rnd(Math.min(200, Math.floor(b.length / 72))));
  // a dynamic buffer of 2.5 MiB + 6 bytes, filled whole before its first use; a static one of 1.5 MiB + 2 bytes
  const dyn = create(2.5 * MiB + 6, 0x208), stat = create(1.5 * MiB + 2, 0);
  fill(dyn, 0, 0, 0x2000); fill(stat, 0, 0, 0);
  call('BeginScene');
  for (let step = 0; step < 60; step++) {
    const which = rnd(3) ? dyn : stat, b = com.implAt(which);
    bind(which); draw(b);
    // (an unaligned range, often straddling a chunk boundary of the ring copy; NOOVERWRITE past what draws used, or plain)
    const off = rnd(3) === 0 ? rnd(b.length) : Math.max(0, MiB - rnd(5000)) + rnd(7), size = rnd(4) === 0 ? 0 : Math.min(b.length - off, 1 + rnd(MiB + 3000));
    fill(which, off, size, pick(rnd, [0, 0x1000, 0x2000]));
    bind(which); draw(b);
    if (rnd(8) === 0) { call('EndScene'); call('Present', 0, 0, 0, 0); call('BeginScene'); }
  }
  // released while a draw that reads it may be pending, then a new buffer (memory recycled) written and drawn
  bind(stat); draw(com.implAt(stat)); call('SetStreamSource', 0, 0, 0, ...(api9 ? [0] : []));
  com.release(com.objectAt(stat));
  const again = create(1.5 * MiB + 2, 0); fill(again, 0, 0, 0); bind(again); draw(com.implAt(again));
  call('EndScene'); call('Present', 0, 0, 0, 0);
  onEnd?.(dev, com, [dyn, again]);
}
const pick = (rnd, a) => a[rnd(a.length)];

// (both ways buffer bytes travel: at Unlock, ORTHROS_VB_LAZY=0 — the same WebGL calls; at the draws that read them —
// the same draws, compared by what they read, no stale read found by the check, and every byte not still pending
// equal to guest memory)
for (const api9 of [true, false]) for (const lazy of [false, true]) {
  test(`Direct3D ${api9 ? 9 : 8}: buffer contents through the ring — large, unaligned, switched and released buffers replayed late give the same WebGL ${lazy ? 'draws (bytes copied at draws)' : 'calls'}`, () => {
    globalThis.ORTHROS_VB_LAZY = lazy ? undefined : 0; globalThis.ORTHROS_VB_CHECK = lazy ? 1 : undefined;
    try { for (const seed of [1, 2, 3]) {
      const A = fakeGl(800, 600, { reads: lazy }), B = fakeGl(800, 600, { reads: lazy });
      session({ createDevice: (dev) => new WebGLDevice(A.gl, dev, {}) }, seed, api9);
      // (the production ring size: a 1 MiB chunk must fit)
      const words = new Int32Array(1 << 22), ack = new Int32Array(1 << 16).fill(-1);
      const replayer = new Replayer(words, { mem: null, ack, createBackend: (m) => new WebGLDevice(B.gl, m, {}) });
      const link = new RenderLink({ words, replayer, ack });
      session({ createDevice: (dev) => { replayer.mem = dev.proc.mem; return new Recorder(link, dev); } }, seed, api9, (dev, com, ptrs) => {
        link.publish(true);
        for (const p of ptrs) {
          const b = com.implAt(p), mb = replayer.res.get(b.id);
          if (!mb?.shadow) continue;
          const sh = Buffer.from(mb.shadow), g = Buffer.from(dev.proc.mem.u8.subarray(b.mem, b.mem + b.length)), lz = b.rec.lz ?? [];
          if (!lazy) { assert.ok(sh.equals(g), `seed ${seed}: buffer ${b.id} mirror copy differs from guest memory`); continue; }
          // (outside the bytes still pending, the mirror's copy is guest memory)
          for (let i = 0, at = 0; at <= b.length; i += 2) {
            const end = i < lz.length ? lz[i] : b.length;
            assert.ok(sh.subarray(at, end).equals(g.subarray(at, end)), `seed ${seed}: buffer ${b.id} differs in [${at}, ${end}) outside its pending bytes`);
            if (i >= lz.length) break;
            at = lz[i + 1];
          }
        }
      });
      const d = firstDifference(A.calls, B.calls);
      assert.equal(d, null, d ? `seed ${seed}: first difference at call ${d.index} (${d.lengths}):\nin-thread\n  ${d.a.join('\n  ')}\nreplayed\n  ${d.b.join('\n  ')}` : '');
      assert.ok(link.stats.eagerBufs >= 2 && link.stats.bufDataBytes > 4 << 20, `eager ${link.stats.eagerBufs}, ${link.stats.bufDataBytes} bytes`);
      if (lazy) assert.ok(link.stats.vbChecked > 100 && link.stats.vbStale === 0, `seed ${seed}: ${link.stats.vbChecked} draws checked, ${link.stats.vbStale} read stale bytes`);
    } } finally { globalThis.ORTHROS_VB_LAZY = undefined; globalThis.ORTHROS_VB_CHECK = undefined; }
  });
}

// Bytes copied at the draws that read them: what a draw reads is bounded by its index data, not by MinIndex /
// NumVertices (understated here), with base vertices, stream offsets, a second stream (Direct3D 9 declaration), partial
// NOOVERWRITE locks and draws over parts of what was written. Replayed late, the draws must read the same bytes as
// in-thread, the check must find no stale read, and fewer bytes must travel than with copies at Unlock.
function partialSession(gfx, seed, api9) {
  const E = d3dEnv(gfx), { mem, ctx, com } = E;
  let s = seed; const rnd = (n) => { s = (Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 0x2c1b3c6d) + 0x9e3779b9) | 0; return ((s >>> 0) % n); };
  const out = E.alloc(64), pp = E.alloc(64);
  [320, 240, 22, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 75, 0, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(pp + 4 * i, v));
  if (!api9) { mem.write32(pp + 20, 1); mem.write32(pp + 24, 0); mem.write32(pp + 28, 1); mem.write32(pp + 32, 1); mem.write32(pp + 36, 75); mem.write32(pp + 40, 0); }
  const d3dPtr = E.defs[api9 ? 'Direct3DCreate9' : 'Direct3DCreate8'][1](ctx([api9 ? 32 : 220]));
  assert.equal(com.implAt(d3dPtr).CreateDevice(ctx([d3dPtr, 0, 1, 0, 0x40, pp, out])), 0);
  const devPtr = mem.read32(out), dev = com.implAt(devPtr);
  const call = (name, ...args) => dev[name](ctx([devPtr, ...args]));
  assert.equal(call('CreateVertexBuffer', 24 * 16384, 0x208, 0x142, 0, out), 0); const vb = mem.read32(out);
  assert.equal(call('CreateVertexBuffer', 4 * 16384 + 8, 0x208, 0, 0, out), 0); const colors = mem.read32(out);
  assert.equal(call('CreateIndexBuffer', 2 * 3000, 0x208, 101, 0, out), 0); const ib = mem.read32(out);
  const lock = (ptr, off, size, flags, f) => { const b = com.implAt(ptr); assert.equal(b.Lock(ctx([ptr, off, size, out, flags])), 0); f(mem.read32(out), size || b.length - off); b.Unlock(ctx([ptr])); };
  const randomBytes = (a, n) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) mem.u8[a + i] = rnd(256); };
  let decl = 0;
  if (api9) { // (stream 0: FLOAT3 position; stream 1: D3DCOLOR color)
    const d = E.alloc(32);
    [0 | (0 << 16), 2 | (0 << 16), 1 | (0 << 16), 4 | (10 << 16), 0xff, 17].forEach((w, i) => mem.write32(d + 4 * i, w));
    assert.equal(call('CreateVertexDeclaration', d, out), 0); decl = mem.read32(out);
  }
  call('BeginScene');
  for (let frame = 0; frame < 12; frame++) {
    lock(vb, 0, 0, 0x2000, randomBytes); // (DISCARD: all of it written, parts drawn)
    lock(colors, 0, 0, 0x2000, randomBytes);
    // indices in [lo, lo + 200), the calls claiming 4 vertices from lo
    const lo = rnd(3000);
    lock(ib, 0, 0, 0x2000, (a, n) => { for (let i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) mem.write16(a + 2 * i, lo + rnd(200)); });
    for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
      const twoStreams = api9 && rnd(2) === 1, base = rnd(400), start = rnd(2000), prims = 1 + rnd(60);
      if (twoStreams) { call('SetVertexDeclaration', decl); call('SetStreamSource', 0, vb, 24 * rnd(4), 24); call('SetStreamSource', 1, colors, 4 * rnd(2) + (rnd(2) ? 8 : 0), 4); }
      else if (api9) { call('SetFVF', 0x142); call('SetStreamSource', 0, vb, 24 * rnd(4), 24); call('SetStreamSource', 1, 0, 0, 0); }
      else call('SetVertexShader', 0x142), call('SetStreamSource', 0, vb, 24);
      if (api9) { call('SetIndices', ib); call('DrawIndexedPrimitive', 4, base, lo, 4, start, prims); } else { call('SetIndices', ib, base); call('DrawIndexedPrimitive', 4, lo, 4, start, prims); }
      // a part rewritten without discarding, then a non-indexed draw over another part
      const v0 = rnd(4000);
      lock(vb, 24 * v0, 24 * 50, 0x1000, randomBytes);
      if (api9) { call('SetFVF', 0x142); call('SetStreamSource', 0, vb, 0, 24); call('SetStreamSource', 1, 0, 0, 0); }
      call('DrawPrimitive', 4, rnd(4000), 1 + rnd(30));
    }
    call('EndScene'); call('Present', 0, 0, 0, 0); call('BeginScene');
  }
  call('EndScene'); call('Present', 0, 0, 0, 0);
}

for (const api9 of [true, false]) {
  test(`Direct3D ${api9 ? 9 : 8}: buffer bytes copied at the draws that read them — bounded by the index data, not the call's vertex range; fewer bytes, the same draws`, () => {
    const bytes = {};
    try {
      for (const lazy of [false, true]) {
        globalThis.ORTHROS_VB_LAZY = lazy ? undefined : 0; globalThis.ORTHROS_VB_CHECK = 1;
        bytes[lazy] = 0;
        for (const seed of [1, 2, 3]) {
          const A = fakeGl(800, 600, { reads: true }), B = fakeGl(800, 600, { reads: true });
          partialSession({ createDevice: (dev) => new WebGLDevice(A.gl, dev, {}) }, seed, api9);
          const words = new Int32Array(1 << 20), ack = new Int32Array(1 << 16).fill(-1);
          const replayer = new Replayer(words, { mem: null, ack, createBackend: (m) => new WebGLDevice(B.gl, m, {}) });
          const link = new RenderLink({ words, replayer, ack });
          partialSession({ createDevice: (dev) => { replayer.mem = dev.proc.mem; return new Recorder(link, dev); } }, seed, api9);
          link.publish(true);
          const d = firstDifference(A.calls, B.calls);
          assert.equal(d, null, d ? `seed ${seed}, lazy ${lazy}: first difference at call ${d.index} (${d.lengths}):\nin-thread\n  ${d.a.join('\n  ')}\nreplayed\n  ${d.b.join('\n  ')}` : '');
          assert.ok(A.calls.filter((c) => c[0] === 'drawElements').length >= 100, 'indexed draws');
          assert.equal(link.stats.vbStale, 0, `seed ${seed}, lazy ${lazy}: draws that read stale bytes`);
          assert.ok(link.stats.vbChecked >= 200, `${link.stats.vbChecked} draws checked`);
          bytes[lazy] += link.stats.bufDataBytes;
        }
      }
    } finally { globalThis.ORTHROS_VB_LAZY = undefined; globalThis.ORTHROS_VB_CHECK = undefined; }
    assert.ok(bytes.true < bytes.false / 2, `bytes copied at draws ${bytes.true}, at Unlock ${bytes.false}`);
  });
}

test('pending buffer ranges: random writes and reads against a byte map — reads copy the pending bytes they meet (and short pending ranges they meet, whole), nothing else', () => {
  let s = 7; const rnd = (n) => { s = (Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 0x2c1b3c6d) + 0x9e3779b9) | 0; return ((s >>> 0) % n); };
  const link = new RenderLink({ words: new Int32Array(1 << 10), replayer: { reader: { consumed: 0 }, run() {} } });
  const LEN = 5000, copied = new Uint8Array(LEN);
  link.bufData = (b, start, size) => { for (let i = start; i < start + size; i++) { assert.equal(copied[i], 0, `byte ${i} copied twice by one read`); copied[i] = 1; } };
  const rr = {}, b = { length: LEN }, pending = new Uint8Array(LEN);
  for (let step = 0; step < 20000; step++) {
    const lo = rnd(LEN), hi = Math.min(LEN, lo + 1 + rnd(step % 7 === 0 ? LEN : 60));
    if (rnd(2)) { link.lazyAdd(rr, lo, hi); pending.fill(1, lo, hi); continue; }
    copied.fill(0);
    const before = rr.lz ? rr.lz.slice() : [];
    link.lazyTake(b, rr, lo, hi);
    for (let i = 0; i < LEN; i++) {
      if (i >= lo && i < hi && pending[i]) assert.equal(copied[i], 1, `step ${step}: pending byte ${i} in [${lo}, ${hi}) not copied`);
      if (copied[i] && (i < lo || i >= hi)) { // (outside the read: only within a short pending range the read met)
        let k = 0; while (k < before.length && before[k + 1] <= i) k += 2;
        assert.ok(k < before.length && before[k] <= i && before[k + 1] - before[k] <= 16384 && before[k] < hi && lo < before[k + 1], `step ${step}: byte ${i} outside [${lo}, ${hi}) copied`);
      }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < LEN; i++) if (copied[i]) pending[i] = 0;
    // (the ranges: sorted, disjoint, every pending byte inside one)
    const p = rr.lz;
    for (let i = 0; i + 2 < p.length; i += 2) assert.ok(p[i] < p[i + 1] && p[i + 1] < p[i + 2], `step ${step}: ranges ${p.slice(i, i + 4)}`);
    let k = 0; for (let i = 0; i < LEN; i++) { if (!pending[i]) continue; while (k < p.length && p[k + 1] <= i) k += 2; assert.ok(k < p.length && p[k] <= i, `step ${step}: pending byte ${i} in no range`); }
  }
  assert.equal(link.lazyN, rr.lz.length ? 1 : 0);
});
```
