`tests/sleep-throttle.test.js`:

```js
// The Sleep(0) throttle (kernel32.js sleep): a thread spinning on Sleep(0) + timeGetTime with nothing else to run
// sleeps 1 ms per turn once the streak is established, and the throttled sleep's re-executed call keeps the streak —
// before, the 1 ms park itself broke it and every throttle was followed by 32 unthrottled turns. Runs
// build/pe/sleepspin.exe (tools/pe/sleepspin.c) on a virtual clock: exactly repeatable.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { Vfs, MemBackend } from '../src/vfs/vfs.js';
import { VirtualClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';

const PE = new URL('../build/pe/sleepspin.exe', import.meta.url).pathname;
const PE_LOWER = new URL('../build/pe/sleepspin_lower.exe', import.meta.url).pathname;
const skip = !fs.existsSync(PE) && 'build/pe/sleepspin.exe missing (make pe-tests)';
const skipLower = !fs.existsSync(PE_LOWER) && 'build/pe/sleepspin_lower.exe missing (make pe-tests)';

function run(keep, pe = PE, dbg = {}) {
  const prev = globalThis.ORTHROS_SLEEP0_KEEP_STREAK;
  if (keep === undefined) delete globalThis.ORTHROS_SLEEP0_KEEP_STREAK; else globalThis.ORTHROS_SLEEP0_KEEP_STREAK = keep;
  const saved = Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(dbg).map((k) => [k, globalThis[k]]));
  Object.assign(globalThis, dbg);
  try {
    const vfs = new Vfs(), t = new MemBackend();
    vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend());
    vfs.mount('C:\\Test', t);
    t.open('sleepspin.exe', { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(pe));
    const clock = new VirtualClock();
    const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host: new HeadlessHost({ clock }), jit: true, logKinds: ['warn', 'crash'] });
    vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\sleepspin.exe' });
    const main = vm.proc.threads[0];
    const code = vm.run();
    return { code, st: main.sleepStats, ms: clock.now(), picks: vm.sched.picks };
  } finally {
    if (prev === undefined) delete globalThis.ORTHROS_SLEEP0_KEEP_STREAK; else globalThis.ORTHROS_SLEEP0_KEEP_STREAK = prev;
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(saved)) if (v === undefined) delete globalThis[k]; else globalThis[k] = v;
  }
}

test('Sleep(0) spin: the throttled sleep keeps the streak (a few Sleep(0) per throttle, not 33), pacing unchanged', { skip }, () => {
  const now = run(), before = run('0');
  assert.equal(now.code, 0); assert.equal(before.code, 0);
  // 150 frames of 16 ms on the guest's clock either way: the frame limiter ends at the same time
  assert.ok(Math.abs(now.ms - before.ms) < 20, `run length ${now.ms} vs ${before.ms} ms`);
  assert.ok(now.st.throttled > 1000 && before.st.throttled > 1000, `throttled ${now.st.throttled} / ${before.st.throttled}`);
  const ratio = now.st.zero / now.st.throttled, ratioBefore = before.st.zero / before.st.throttled;
  assert.ok(ratioBefore > 20, `former behaviour: ${ratioBefore.toFixed(1)} Sleep(0) per throttle`);
  assert.ok(ratio < 5, `${ratio.toFixed(1)} Sleep(0) per throttle`);
});

test('Sleep(0) spin beside a lower-priority busy thread: throttled (that thread runs in the 1 ms waits), pacing unchanged', { skip: skipLower }, () => {
  const now = run(undefined, PE_LOWER), before = run(undefined, PE_LOWER, { ORTHROS_SLEEP0_ANY_READY: 1 });
  assert.equal(now.code, 0, 'the worker ran'); assert.equal(before.code, 0);
  // 100 frames of 16 ms either way
  assert.ok(now.ms >= 1600 && Math.abs(now.ms - before.ms) < 40, `run length ${now.ms} vs ${before.ms} ms`);
  // before: the ready lower thread kept the throttle off — every Sleep(0) a slice ended for nothing (the pick took the
  // spinning thread again), the lower thread run only when starved
  assert.ok(before.st.throttled < before.st.zero / 100, `former behaviour: ${before.st.throttled} throttled of ${before.st.zero}`);
  assert.ok(now.st.throttled >= 500, `throttled ${now.st.throttled}`);
  // (measured: Sleep(0) 1 998 801 -> 4 200, scheduling decisions 2 002 004 -> 7 403)
  assert.ok(now.st.zero * 50 < before.st.zero && now.picks * 50 < before.picks, `Sleep(0) ${now.st.zero} vs ${before.st.zero}, picks ${now.picks} vs ${before.picks}`);
  assert.ok(now.st.zero / now.st.throttled < 8, `${(now.st.zero / now.st.throttled).toFixed(1)} Sleep(0) per throttle`);
  assert.equal(now.st.yields ?? 0, 0, 'no Sleep(0) counted as a yield to the lower thread');
});
```

`tests/smoke.test.js`:

```js
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory, PRIVATE_BASE, THUNK_BASE } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, ST, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';

test('guest memory: 2 GB identity-mapped space, unaligned little-endian access', () => {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  assert.equal(mem.size, 0x80000000);
  mem.write32(0x00400001, 0xdeadbeef); // unaligned
  assert.equal(mem.read32(0x00400001), 0xdeadbeef);
  assert.equal(mem.read8(0x00400001), 0xef);
  assert.equal(mem.read16(0x00400003), 0xdead);
  assert.equal(mem.readS8(0x00400001), -17);
  mem.write64(0x7ffffff0, 0x1122334455667788n);
  assert.equal(mem.read64(0x7ffffff0), 0x1122334455667788n);
  mem.writeCString(0x1000, 'hello');
  assert.equal(mem.readCString(0x1000), 'hello');
  mem.writeWString(0x2000, 'wide');
  assert.equal(mem.readWString(0x2000), 'wide');
  assert.ok(THUNK_BASE < PRIVATE_BASE);
});

test('cpu state: register accessors map onto the state block in guest memory', () => {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.eax = 0xffffffff;
  cpu.esp = 0x0012ff00;
  assert.equal(cpu.eax, 0xffffffff);
  assert.equal(mem.read32(THREAD_STATES_BASE + ST.GPR + 0), 0xffffffff);
  cpu.push32(0x11223344);
  assert.equal(cpu.esp, 0x0012fefc);
  assert.equal(cpu.pop32(), 0x11223344);
  assert.equal(cpu.esp, 0x0012ff00);
  assert.ok(cpu.eflags & F.RESERVED1);
  cpu.fpuTop = 7;
  cpu.setSt(0, 1.5);
  assert.equal(cpu.fpr(7), 1.5);
  assert.match(cpu.dump(), /eax=ffffffff/);
});
```

`tests/snapshot-key.test.js`:

```js
// The key a snapshot is kept under (src/host/web/snapshot-key.js, docs/snapshot.md): the debug flags that only measure
// the host (gpu-probe.js HOST_ONLY_DBG) are left out — a ?bench page and a plain page share their snapshots, and a
// shared-snapshot job a bench queued can be published by tools/snapshot-publish.mjs (a plain page).
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { snapshotKey, machineDbg } from '../src/host/web/snapshot-key.js';
import { HOST_ONLY_DBG } from '../src/gfx/gpu-probe.js';

const base = { gameLanguage: 'fr', timeScale: 1, interp: false, interpRange: '', jitOpts: '', noF32: false, f32Off: '' };
const key = (opts) => snapshotKey('sources-hash', 'bfme1-108', { name: 'bfme1-108', exe: 'game.exe' }, { files: { 'game.exe': { size: 2, mtime: 1 } } }, { ...base, ...opts });

test('a ?bench page and a plain page get the same snapshot key', async () => {
  // (main.js: dbg is [?dbg=, the bench's flags].join(','))
  const main = fs.readFileSync(new URL('../src/host/web/main.js', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
  const benchFlags = [...main.matchAll(/state\.bench \? '([^']*)'/g)].flatMap((m) => m[1].split(',')).map((kv) => kv.split('=')[0]);
  assert.ok(benchFlags.length, 'main.js adds its bench flags to dbg');
  for (const f of benchFlags) assert.ok(HOST_ONLY_DBG.includes(f), `${f}: a bench's flag that is not host-only would give benches a key of their own`);
  const plain = await key({ dbg: '' });
  assert.match(plain, /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/);
  assert.equal(await key({ dbg: 'ORTHROS_GL_COUNT=1' }), plain, 'a bench page');
  assert.equal(await key({ dbg: 'ORTHROS_GL_TIME=300@6000,ORTHROS_GL_PROBES=0,ORTHROS_GL_COUNT=1' }), plain, 'every host-only flag');
  assert.equal(await key({ dbg: undefined }), plain);
});

test('the flags that change the machine still change the key, in their order', async () => {
  const plain = await key({ dbg: '' }), jit = await key({ dbg: 'ORTHROS_API_FAST_OFF=1' });
  assert.notEqual(jit, plain);
  assert.equal(await key({ dbg: 'ORTHROS_API_FAST_OFF=1,ORTHROS_GL_COUNT=1' }), jit);
  assert.equal(await key({ dbg: 'ORTHROS_GL_COUNT=1,ORTHROS_API_FAST_OFF=1' }), jit);
  assert.equal(machineDbg('ORTHROS_GL_COUNT=1,ORTHROS_SLICE_INSNS=5,ORTHROS_GL_TIME=3,ORTHROS_NO_DEFER=1'), 'ORTHROS_SLICE_INSNS=5,ORTHROS_NO_DEFER=1');
  assert.notEqual(await key({ dbg: '', gameLanguage: 'en' }), plain, 'the language');
  assert.notEqual(await key({ dbg: '', timeScale: 2 }), plain, 'the options that change the machine');
});
```

`tests/snapshot-lint.test.js`:

```js
// Hidden machine state (docs/snapshot.md): a snapshot holds what is reachable from the Vm; state a module keeps in a
// variable of its own — at its top level (shared by every Vm of the page!) or in its registration closure — is not, and
// a restored game would go on with that variable's initial value. Every such declaration must say what it is: handed
// over to the snapshot registry (snapKnown(vm, ...) in the same statement), or annotated `// snapshot: <why not state>`
// (on its line or the one above: a constant, a cache rebuilt from state, host-side...). A new one fails this test.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const ROOT = new URL('..', import.meta.url).pathname;
const DIRS = ['src/core', 'src/win32', 'src/gfx/gdi', 'src/vfs'];
const SKIP = new Set(['src/core/snapshot.js', 'src/core/vm-snapshot.js']);

/**
 * A declaration that may hold mutable state: a `let`/`var` starting from a value of its own (a counter, a flag, a
 * container: not one read from existing state), or a `const` bound to a container — unless its name is in capitals
 * (FMT, MODES, K: the sources' convention for constant tables and a module's API table).
 */
const MUTABLE = /^(let|var)\s+[\w$]+\s*(=\s*(-?[\d.]|['"`]|true\b|false\b|null\b|undefined\b|\[|\{|new\s)|[;,])|^const\s+(?![A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*\s*=)[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*=\s*(new\s+(Map|Set|WeakMap|Array|Uint\w*Array|Int\w*Array|Float\w*Array)\b|\[|\{)/;
const ANNOTATED = /\/\/ snapshot:|vm\.snap\.(known|cls)\(|snap(Known|Class)\(vm,/;

/**
 * Declarations of `file` at its top level and at the top of its top-level functions taking the Vm (`vm`): the closures
 * a module registers its API in, whose variables live as long as the machine.
 */
export function hiddenStateCandidates(file) {
  const lines = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, file), 'utf8').split('\n'), out = [];
  let inReg = false;
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    if (/^(export )?function \w*\(.*\bvm\b.*\)\s*\{/.test(line)) { inReg = true; return; }
    if (inReg && /^\}/.test(line)) { inReg = false; return; }
    const top = !inReg && !/^\s/.test(line) ? line : inReg && /^ {2}\S/.test(line) ? line.slice(2) : null;
    if (top === null || !MUTABLE.test(top.replace(/^export\s+/, ''))) return;
    if (ANNOTATED.test(line) || ANNOTATED.test(lines[i - 1] ?? '')) return;
    out.push(`${file}:${i + 1}: ${line.trim().slice(0, 110)}`);
  });
  return out;
}

test('every module variable that could hold machine state is handed to snapshots or says why not', () => {
  const found = [];
  for (const dir of DIRS) for (const f of fs.readdirSync(path.join(ROOT, dir))) {
    const file = `${dir}/${f}`;
    if (f.endsWith('.js') && !SKIP.has(file)) found.push(...hiddenStateCandidates(file));
  }
  assert.deepEqual(found, [], `\n${found.join('\n')}\n(docs/snapshot.md: hand it over with vm.snap.known(...) or annotate // snapshot: <why>)`);
});

test('modules that register snapshot state are among the sources a snapshot depends on', async () => {
  // (src/host/snapshot-sources.js: a change to a module left out of the hash keeps snapshots valid — it must own no state)
  const { snapshotSourceFiles } = await import('../src/host/snapshot-sources.js');
  const sources = new Set(snapshotSourceFiles(ROOT)), out = [];
  const walk = (dir) => {
    for (const e of fs.readdirSync(path.join(ROOT, dir), { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const rel = `${dir}/${e.name}`;
      if (e.isDirectory()) { if (e.name !== 'ports') walk(rel); continue; }
      if (!e.name.endsWith('.js') || sources.has(rel) || rel === 'src/core/snapshot.js') continue;
      if (/\bsnapshotClass\(|\bsnap(Known|Class)\(vm,|\bsnap\.(known|cls|knowGraph)\(/.test(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, rel), 'utf8'))) out.push(rel);
    }
  };
  walk('src');
  assert.ok(sources.has('src/win32/kernel32.js') && sources.has('src/core/vm-snapshot.js') && !sources.has('src/cpu/jit/translate.js'), 'the closure is followed');
  assert.deepEqual(out, [], 'modules outside the snapshot sources (src/host/snapshot-sources.js) registering state');
});

test('the game data\'s transport is out of the snapshot sources, the guest-visible tree in', async () => {
  // (a data-only deploy keeps a returning player's snapshot: src/host/snapshot-sources.js DATA_TRANSPORT)
  const { snapshotSourceFiles, DATA_TRANSPORT, KEPT } = await import('../src/host/snapshot-sources.js');
  const sources = new Set(snapshotSourceFiles(ROOT));
  for (const f of DATA_TRANSPORT) assert.ok(!sources.has(f), `${f} out`);
  assert.ok(!sources.has('src/vfs/pcm-codec.js'), 'what only the transport imports out with it');
  for (const f of KEPT) assert.ok(sources.has(f), `${f} kept (which files the guest sees, their sizes)`);
  assert.ok(sources.has('src/vfs/vfs.js') && sources.has('src/host/web/worker.js'), 'the guest\'s file system and the worker kept');
});

test('what the guest sees of the game folder through the data transport is pinned (out of the snapshot key)', async () => {
  // (http-backend.js is out of the key, DATA_TRANSPORT: its answers to the guest's stat/readdir/open — case folding, the
  // listing's order, a directory's date — are restored over silently if they change. Changing one here fails this test:
  // such a change must change the key too — moved into a kept module, src/host/snapshot-sources.js KEPT —, never a
  // data-only deploy)
  const { HttpBackend } = await import('../src/vfs/http-backend.js');
  const { LIGHT_DIR } = await import('../src/vfs/game-tree.js');
  const tree = { dirs: {
    Data: { dirs: { Maps: { dirs: {}, files: { 'm1.map': { size: 7, mtime: 3 } } } }, files: { 'B.big': { size: 10, mtime: 5 }, 'a.ini': { size: 2 } } },
  }, files: { 'Game.exe': { size: 100, mtime: 9, light: 40 }, 'data.txt': { size: 1, mtime: 1 }, DATA: { size: 3 } } };
  const b = new HttpBackend('/game/g/', tree, {});
  const shape = (r) => r && (r.dir ? { dir: r.path, name: r.name } : { file: r.path, name: r.name, size: r.file.size });
  assert.deepEqual(shape(b.lookup('data/maps/M1.MAP')), { file: 'Data/Maps/m1.map', name: 'm1.map', size: 7 }, 'case folded to the tree\'s names');
  assert.deepEqual(shape(b.lookup('data')), { dir: 'Data', name: 'Data' }, 'a directory before a file of the same name (case aside)');
  assert.deepEqual(shape(b.lookup('DATA')), { dir: 'Data', name: 'Data' }, 'even an exact file name');
  assert.deepEqual(shape(b.lookup('data.txt')), { file: 'data.txt', name: 'data.txt', size: 1 });
  assert.deepEqual(shape(b.lookup('\\Data\\\\b.BIG')), { file: 'Data/B.big', name: 'B.big', size: 10 }, 'either separator, empty parts skipped');
  assert.deepEqual(shape(b.lookup('')), { dir: '', name: '' }, 'the root');
  assert.equal(b.lookup('Data/nope'), null);
  assert.equal(b.lookup('Game.exe/x'), null, 'no path through a file');
  assert.deepEqual(shape(b.lookup(`${LIGHT_DIR}/game.EXE`)), { file: `${LIGHT_DIR}/Game.exe`, name: 'Game.exe', size: 40 }, 'a light copy: its own size');
  assert.equal(b.lookup(`${LIGHT_DIR}/data.txt`), null, 'no light copy: none');
  assert.deepEqual(b.stat('data/b.big'), { size: 10, isDir: false, mtime: 5 });
  assert.deepEqual(b.stat('data/A.INI'), { size: 2, isDir: false, mtime: 0 }, 'no date: 0');
  assert.deepEqual(b.stat('data/MAPS'), { size: 0, isDir: true, mtime: 0 }, 'a directory: size and date 0');
  assert.equal(b.stat('x'), null);
  assert.deepEqual(b.readdir(''), [
    { name: 'Data', size: 0, isDir: true, mtime: 0 },
    { name: 'Game.exe', size: 100, isDir: false, mtime: 9 },
    { name: 'data.txt', size: 1, isDir: false, mtime: 1 },
    { name: 'DATA', size: 3, isDir: false, mtime: 0 },
  ], 'directories first, then files, each in the tree\'s order');
  assert.deepEqual(b.readdir('data').map((e) => e.name), ['Maps', 'B.big', 'a.ini']);
  assert.equal(b.readdir('data.txt'), null, 'a file is not listed');
});
```

`tests/snapshot-store.test.js`:

```js
// Shared snapshots (src/host/snapshot-store.js, server routes /api/snapshot/<manifest>, docs/snapshot.md stage 3): a new
// player's starting point, published by the server's own session (its token), served compressed, stale once the shared

import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';

import { toBase64 } from '../src/host/profile-seed.js';

const KEY = 'a'.repeat(32), KEY2 = 'b'.repeat(32), KEY3 = 'c'.repeat(32);
const snap = (n) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(n, 7); b.writeUInt32BE(0x4f534e50, 0); return b; };

test('shared snapshots: published by the server\'s session only, served compressed, stale with another first-launch profile', async () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-snapstore-'));
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'man')); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'learn'));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'man', 'g.json'), JSON.stringify({ name: 'g', folder: dir, exe: 'x.exe' }));
  const wanted = [], jobs = { want: (...a) => { wanted.push(a.join('|')); return true; }, job: (t, name, lang, key) => (t === 'tok' && name === 'g' && lang === 'en' && [KEY, KEY2, KEY3].includes(key) ? {} : null) };
  const s = createServer({ manifests: path.join(dir, 'man'), learnDir: path.join(dir, 'learn'), learnWriteMs: 10, profileSeedQuorum: 1, snapshotJobs: jobs });
  await new Promise((r) => s.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
  const u = (p) => `http://127.0.0.1:${s.address().port}${p}`;
  const post = (key, body, token = 'tok') => fetch(u(`/api/snapshot/g?key=${key}&lang=en&token=${token}`), { method: 'POST', body });
  try {
    // none yet: a session queued for it
    assert.equal((await fetch(u(`/api/snapshot/g?key=${KEY}&lang=en`))).status, 404);
    assert.deepEqual(wanted, [`g|en|${KEY}`]);
    assert.equal((await fetch(u('/api/snapshot/g?key=nothex&lang=en'))).status, 404);
    // published: with the job's token only, a snapshot only
    assert.equal((await post(KEY, snap(5000), 'other')).status, 403);
    assert.equal((await post(KEY, Buffer.from('not a snapshot'))).status, 400);
    assert.equal((await post(KEY, snap(300000))).status, 204);
    const r = await fetch(u(`/api/snapshot/g?key=${KEY}&lang=en`));
    assert.equal(r.status, 200); assert.equal(r.headers.get('x-snapshot-bytes'), '300000');
    assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer()), snap(300000)); // (fetch decoded it)
    const raw = await new Promise((res) => fetch(u(`/api/snapshot/g?key=${KEY}&lang=en`), { headers: { 'Accept-Encoding': 'gzip' } }).then(async (x) => res([x.headers.get('content-encoding'), Number(x.headers.get('content-length'))])));
    assert.equal(raw[0], 'gzip'); assert.ok(raw[1] < 300000 / 10);
    // another shared first-launch profile since: stale (a new session wanted)
    await fetch(u('/api/profile-seed/g'), { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ lang: 'en', session: 's1', files: [{ path: 'AppData/G/a.ini', data: toBase64(new TextEncoder().encode('x')) }] }) });
    assert.equal((await fetch(u(`/api/snapshot/g?key=${KEY}&lang=en`))).status, 404);
    assert.equal(wanted.length, 2);
    // the two most recent keys kept
    assert.equal((await post(KEY2, snap(1000))).status, 204);
    await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 20));
    assert.equal((await post(KEY3, snap(1000))).status, 204);
    const kept = fs.readdirSync(path.join(dir, 'learn', 'snapshots', 'g')).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.json')).sort();
    assert.deepEqual(kept, [`en-${KEY2}.json`, `en-${KEY3}.json`]);
    assert.ok(zlib.gunzipSync(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'learn', 'snapshots', 'g', `en-${KEY3}.gz`))).equals(snap(1000)));
  } finally { s.close(); fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test('a sandboxed server only queues the publishing sessions (their tokens in a file a runner reads)', async () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-snapqueue-'));
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'man')); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'learn'));

    assert.equal((await fetch(u(`/api/snapshot/g?key=${KEY}&lang=fr`))).status, 404); // (asked twice: queued once)

    assert.equal(q.length, 1); assert.deepEqual([q[0].name, q[0].lang, q[0].key], ['g', 'fr', KEY]); assert.match(q[0].token, /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/);
    const post = (token, key = KEY) => fetch(u(`/api/snapshot/g?key=${key}&lang=fr&token=${token}`), { method: 'POST', body: snap(2000) });
    assert.equal((await post('0'.repeat(32))).status, 403);
    assert.equal((await post(q[0].token, KEY2)).status, 403); // (a token is for its own key)

    assert.equal((await fetch(u(`/api/snapshot/g?key=${KEY}&lang=fr`))).status, 200);
  } finally { s.close(); fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
```

`tests/snapshot-watch.test.js`:

```js
// The automatic snapshot's timing (src/host/snapshot-watch.js, docs/snapshot.md stage 2).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { SnapshotWatch } from '../src/host/snapshot-watch.js';

test('a capture is due once no file was opened for a while as frames went on; kept once the session went on', () => {
  const w = new SnapshotWatch({ quietMs: 4000, minFps: 5, tries: 2, keepMs: 20000, keepFrames: 100 });
  assert.equal(w.due(0, 0, 10), false); // (first sight)
  assert.equal(w.due(3000, 60, 10), false); // (not long enough)
  assert.equal(w.due(3500, 70, 11), false); // (a file opened: the stretch starts again)
  assert.equal(w.due(7400, 200, 11), false);
  assert.equal(w.due(7600, 200, 11), true);
  const still = new SnapshotWatch({ quietMs: 4000, minFps: 5 }); still.due(0, 0, 1);
  assert.equal(still.due(5000, 5, 1), false); // (few frames meanwhile: a hang, not a screen)
  w.tried(false, 7600, 200); // (refused: another stretch first)
  assert.equal(w.due(9000, 250, 11), false);
  assert.equal(w.due(11700, 400, 11), true);
  w.tried(true, 11700, 400);
  assert.equal(w.due(12000, 410, 11), false); // (one waiting to be kept)
  assert.equal(w.ripe(20000, 600), false);
  assert.equal(w.ripe(31800, 600), true);
  w.kept();
  assert.equal(w.ripe(40000, 900), false);
  assert.equal(w.due(60000, 2000, 11), false); // (no file opened since: the same point, not taken again)
});

test('taken again at a later settled stretch after more loading, until the player acts', () => {
  const w = new SnapshotWatch({ quietMs: 1000, minFps: 0, keepMs: 5000, keepFrames: 0 });
  w.due(0, 0, 5); assert.equal(w.due(1000, 0, 5), true); w.tried(true, 1000, 0); // (an intro, its video streamed)
  assert.equal(w.ripe(6000, 0), true); w.kept();
  w.due(7000, 0, 9); assert.equal(w.due(8000, 0, 9), true); w.tried(true, 8000, 0); // (the menu, loaded after it)
  w.stop(); // (the player clicks while it waits to be kept)
  assert.equal(w.done, false);
  assert.equal(w.ripe(13000, 0), true); w.kept();
  assert.equal(w.done, true);
  const r = new SnapshotWatch({ quietMs: 1000, minFps: 0, opens: 3 }); // (restored, the reopened files counted)
  r.due(0, 0, 3); assert.equal(r.due(5000, 0, 3), false); // (nothing loaded since the restore)
  r.stop(); assert.equal(r.done, true);
});

test('a snapshot dropped (the profile changed after it) is taken again after another settled stretch', () => {
  const w = new SnapshotWatch({ quietMs: 1000, minFps: 0, tries: 3, keepMs: 5000, keepFrames: 0 });
  w.due(0, 0, 1); assert.equal(w.due(1000, 0, 1), true); w.tried(true, 1000, 0);
  assert.equal(w.due(2000, 0, 1), false);
  assert.equal(w.ripe(6000, 0), true); w.dropped(6000, 0);
  assert.equal(w.ripe(7000, 0), false); assert.equal(w.due(6500, 0, 2), false);
  assert.equal(w.due(7600, 0, 2), true); w.tried(true, 7600, 0);
  assert.equal(w.ripe(12600, 0), true); w.kept(); assert.equal(w.done, false);
});

test('refused as many times as it may be tried: no more captures', () => {
  const w = new SnapshotWatch({ quietMs: 1000, minFps: 0, tries: 2 });
  w.due(0, 0, 1); assert.equal(w.due(1000, 0, 1), true); w.tried(false, 1000, 0);
  assert.equal(w.due(2000, 0, 1), true); w.tried(false, 2000, 0);
  assert.equal(w.done, true); assert.equal(w.due(9000, 0, 1), false);
});
```

`tests/snapshot.test.js`:

```js
// Snapshots of the machine (src/core/snapshot.js, vm-snapshot.js, docs/snapshot.md). The oracle: a test program is
// run to a point, its snapshot restored in a fresh Vm, and both machines go on alike (interpreter, virtual clock: the
// same slices) — they must stay the same, guest memory and every object of the state, and print the same. A field a
// later change adds and the restore misses makes them differ here; one the walk cannot keep makes the capture refuse.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { Vfs, MemBackend } from '../src/vfs/vfs.js';
import { VirtualClock, RealClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';
import { captureVm, restoreVm, notQuiet, HOST_TIME_FIELDS } from '../src/core/vm-snapshot.js';
import { encodeSnapshot, decodeSnapshot, snapshotsDiffer, SnapshotError, SnapshotStale } from '../src/core/snapshot.js';
import { Registry } from '../src/win32/registry.js';

const PE_DIR = new URL('../build/pe/', import.meta.url).pathname;
const skip = (name) => !fs.existsSync(PE_DIR + name) && `build/pe/${name} missing (make pe-tests)`;

function boot(exe, { create = true, profile = null, registry = null } = {}) {
  const vfs = new Vfs(), test = new MemBackend();
  vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend()); vfs.mount('C:\\Test', test);
  if (profile) vfs.mount('C:\\Users\\Player', profile); // (a persistent mount: the host's, what the machine saw of it recorded)
  test.open(exe, { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(PE_DIR + exe));
  const clock = new VirtualClock(), host = new HeadlessHost({ clock, width: 800, height: 600 });
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host, jit: false, logKinds: [] });
  if (registry) { vm.registry = new Registry(); vm.registry.seed(registry); }
  if (create) vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\' + exe });
  return vm;
}
const slice = (vm) => vm.runFor(performance.now()).state; // (one time slice: the deadline is already past)
const snap = (vm) => decodeSnapshot(encodeSnapshot(captureVm(vm)));

/** Run `exe` `at` slices, restore its snapshot, run both `then` slices: what differs (empty: nothing). */
function oracle(exe, at, then = 200) {
  const a = boot(exe);
  for (let i = 0; i < at; i++) assert.notEqual(slice(a), 'exited', `${exe} exited before slice ${at}`);
  const s = snap(a), printed = a.stdout.join('').length;
  const b = restoreVm(boot(exe, { create: false }), s);
  const again = snapshotsDiffer(s, snap(b), { ignore: HOST_TIME_FIELDS });
  if (again.length) return ['restored machine is not the snapshot:', ...again];
  for (let i = 0; i < then; i++) {
    const ra = slice(a), rb = slice(b);
    if (ra !== rb) return [`slice ${i}: ${ra} vs ${rb}`];
    if (ra === 'exited') break;
  }
  const diff = a.proc.threads.every((t) => t.state === 4) ? [] : snapshotsDiffer(snap(a), snap(b), { ignore: HOST_TIME_FIELDS });
  if (a.stdout.join('').slice(printed) !== b.stdout.join('')) diff.push('printed differently');
  return diff;
}

for (const [exe, points] of [['sync.exe', [3, 15, 60]], ['priority.exe', [3, 15, 60]], ['bench.exe', [3, 60]], ['mci.exe', [3, 30]], ['dx9state.exe', [3, 15]], ['threads.exe', [3, 15]], ['dx.exe', [3]]]) {
  test(`${exe}: restored from a snapshot, goes on exactly like the machine it was taken from`, { skip: skip(exe) }, () => {
    for (const at of points) assert.deepEqual(oracle(exe, at), [], `${exe} restored at slice ${at}`);
  });
}

test('threads parked in a blocking call keep their wait and its deadline across a restore', { skip: skip('priority.exe') }, () => {
  const a = boot('priority.exe');
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) slice(a);
  const parked = a.proc.threads.filter((t) => t.state === 2);
  assert.ok(parked.length, 'a thread is parked at that point');
  const b = restoreVm(boot('priority.exe', { create: false }), snap(a));
  for (const t of parked) {
    const r = b.proc.threads.find((x) => x.id === t.id);
    assert.equal(r.state, 2); assert.equal(r.wakeAt, t.wakeAt); assert.equal(typeof r.wait.cond, 'function');
  }
});

test('a snapshot refuses what it cannot rebuild, and says where', { skip: skip('sync.exe') }, () => {
  const a = boot('sync.exe');
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) slice(a);
  a.proc.threads[0].hook = () => 1; // (a closure left in the state by some later change)
  assert.throws(() => captureVm(a), (e) => e instanceof SnapshotError && /a function \(\w+\) at vm\.\S*\.hook$/.test(e.message));
  class Gadget {}
  a.proc.threads[0].hook = new Gadget();
  assert.throws(() => captureVm(a), /an object of class Gadget \(not registered\) at vm\.\S*\.hook$/);
  const problems = [];
  captureVm(a, {}, problems);
  assert.equal(problems.length, 1, 'every refusal listed');
});

test('only at a quiet point; a snapshot is restored on the same kind of clock', { skip: skip('sync.exe') }, () => {

test('the profile stays the player\'s: a snapshot applies while what its machine saw of it is unchanged', { skip: skip('sync.exe') }, () => {
  const profile = (files) => { const p = new MemBackend(); p.seen = new Map(); p.mkdir('Saves'); for (const [f, t] of Object.entries(files)) p.open(f, { create: true }).write(0, new TextEncoder().encode(t)); return p; };
  const files = { 'options.ini': 'res=800', 'Saves/one.sav': 'A' }, reg = { 'HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\Software\\Game': { Lang: 'en' } };
  const a = boot('sync.exe', { profile: profile(files), registry: reg });
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) slice(a);
  // (what the game did with its profile up to the snapshot: read its settings, listed its saves, wrote a log)
  const read = (p) => { const f = a.vfs.open(p); f.read(0, 64); };
  read('C:\\Users\\Player\\options.ini'); a.vfs.readdir('C:\\Users\\Player\\Saves'); a.vfs.open('C:\\Users\\Player\\boot.log', { create: true }).write(0, Uint8Array.of(1));
  const s = snap(a), restore = (p, r = reg) => { const b = boot('sync.exe', { create: false, profile: p, registry: r }); return [b, () => restoreVm(b, s)]; };
  // the same profile — as the browser keeps it, with the log the session wrote — and a file never seen: restored, the
  // profile the host's (not the snapshot's copy), what was seen kept for a later snapshot
  const same = profile({ ...files, 'boot.log': '\x01', 'Saves2.txt': 'new' });
  const [b, ok] = restore(same); ok();
  assert.equal(b.vfs.mounts.find((m) => m.lower === 'c:\\users\\player').backend, same);
  assert.ok(same.files.has('saves2.txt'));
  assert.deepEqual([...same.seen.keys()].sort(), [...a.vfs.mounts.find((m) => m.lower === 'c:\\users\\player').backend.seen.keys()].sort());
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) assert.equal(slice(a), slice(b));
  // a setting changed, a save added to a folder the game listed, the registry it starts with changed: refused before
  // anything changed (the Vm starts the usual way)
  for (const [p, r, why] of [[profile({ ...files, 'options.ini': 'res=1024', 'boot.log': '\x01' }), reg, /options\.ini changed/],
    [profile({ ...files, 'Saves/two.sav': 'B', 'boot.log': '\x01' }), reg, /saves changed/],
    [profile({ ...files, 'boot.log': '\x01' }), { 'HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\Software\\Game': { Lang: 'fr' } }, /registry/]]) {
    const [c, go] = restore(p, r);
    assert.throws(go, (e) => e instanceof SnapshotStale && why.test(e.message));
    assert.equal(c.proc, null);
  }
});
```

`tests/sound-output.test.js`:

```js
// The page's sound output under the browser's autoplay rules (src/host/web/sound.js): resumed at gestures, the
// "click to enable sound" button, the audio part of the telemetry summaries; the worker's figures it reads
// (playing DirectSound buffers, audio decoder failures).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GESTURES, resumeOnGesture, soundHintNeeded, AudioStats } from '../src/host/web/sound.js';
import { audioPlaying } from '../src/win32/dsound.js';
import { AsyncAudio, audioDecodeStats } from '../src/media/mpeg-source.js';

/** an AudioContext as far as the page uses it: Chrome's autoplay policy lets resume() succeed only after a gesture */
function fakeContext(state = 'suspended') {
  const ctx = { state, calls: 0, allowed: false, resume() { this.calls++; if (this.allowed) this.state = 'running'; return Promise.resolve(); } };
  return ctx;
}

test('resumeOnGesture: every gesture kind resumes a suspended context, a running one is left alone', () => {
  const target = new EventTarget(), ctx = fakeContext();
  let tries = 0;
  const off = resumeOnGesture(ctx, target, () => tries++);
  target.dispatchEvent(new Event('mousemove')); // (not an activation)
  assert.equal(ctx.calls, 0);
  for (const g of GESTURES) target.dispatchEvent(new Event(g));
  assert.equal(ctx.calls, GESTURES.length, 'a refused resume is tried again at the next gesture');
  ctx.allowed = true; target.dispatchEvent(new Event('keydown'));
  assert.equal(ctx.state, 'running');
  const before = ctx.calls;
  target.dispatchEvent(new Event('pointerdown'));
  assert.equal(ctx.calls, before, 'running: no call');
  ctx.state = 'interrupted'; target.dispatchEvent(new Event('click')); // (the system took the output: the next click asks again)
  assert.equal(ctx.state, 'running');
  assert.equal(tries, GESTURES.length + 2);
  off(); ctx.state = 'suspended'; target.dispatchEvent(new Event('mousedown'));
  assert.equal(ctx.state, 'suspended', 'listeners removed');
});

test('resumeOnGesture: a closed context is not resumed, a rejected resume does not throw', async () => {
  const target = new EventTarget(), closed = fakeContext('closed');
  resumeOnGesture(closed, target);
  target.dispatchEvent(new Event('click'));
  assert.equal(closed.calls, 0);
  const rej = { state: 'suspended', resume: () => Promise.reject(new Error('not allowed')) };
  resumeOnGesture(rej, target);
  target.dispatchEvent(new Event('click'));
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0)); // (an unhandled rejection would fail the test run)
});

test('AudioStats: one bounded record per window — context, worklet output rate, mix level, buffers, decoder failures', () => {
  const a = new AudioStats();
  assert.equal(a.take(), null, 'nothing added: no record');
  const ctx = { state: 'suspended', sampleRate: 44100, outputLatency: 0.02, baseLatency: 0.005 };
  // 20 s: suspended for 4 s (the worklet does not play), then running (44100 frames/s)
  let frames = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= 40; i++) {
    const t = i * 500;
    if (i === 8) { ctx.state = 'running'; a.noteChange(); a.noteResume(); }
    if (ctx.state === 'running' && i > 0) frames += 22050;
    a.add({ audioPeak: i === 20 ? 0.41 : 0.1, audioPlaying: i % 7, audioBuffers: 12, audioDecodeFailures: i > 30 ? 1 : 0, audioMix: 'worklet' }, ctx, frames, t, 'voices');
  }
  const r = a.take();
  assert.equal(r.ctx, 'running'); assert.equal(r.rate, 44100); assert.equal(r.lat, 25);
  assert.equal(r.run, Math.round((33 / 41) * 100) / 100);
  assert.equal(r.out, Math.round((22050 * 33) / 20));
  assert.equal(r.peak, 0.41); assert.equal(r.play, 6); assert.equal(r.bufs, 12); assert.equal(r.dec, 1); assert.equal(r.mix, 'worklet');
  assert.equal(r.resumes, 1); assert.equal(r.changes, 1);
  assert.equal(r.err, undefined);
  assert.ok(JSON.stringify(r).length < 300, 'bounded');
  // the next window starts afresh (the counters of the session's gestures and changes go on)
  a.add({ audioPeak: 0 }, ctx, frames + 44100, 20500, 'voices');
  const r2 = a.take();
  assert.equal(r2.peak, 0); assert.equal(r2.play, 0); assert.equal(r2.out, 88200); assert.equal(r2.resumes, 1);
});
```

`tests/storage-persist.test.js`:

```js
// The browser's storage of the game data (src/host/web/storage-persist.js, docs/slow-network.md "Persistent storage"):
// persistent storage asked once, its state in every runtime's telemetry env, kept by the server's perf-record check;
// and the home's lines written from a store's probe (download.js Downloads.probed).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { storageState, askPersist, pageStorage, withStorage } from '../src/host/web/storage-persist.js';
import { sanitizePerfRecord } from '../src/host/perf-record.js';
import { PerfSession, eventEnv } from '../src/host/web/perf-page.js';

const MiB = 1 << 20;
/** a navigator whose storage persists once asked (`grant`), counting the calls */
function fakeNav({ grant = true, persisted = false, usage = 300 * MiB + 1, quota = 120000 * MiB + 7, persist = true } = {}) {
  const calls = { persist: 0 };
  const storage = {
    persisted: async () => persisted,
    estimate: async () => ({ usage, quota }),
    ...(persist ? { persist: async () => { calls.persist++; if (grant) persisted = true; return grant; } } : {}),
  };
  return { nav: { storage }, calls };
}

test('storage: its state in whole MiB, persist() asked only when not persisted, once a page; a worker (no persist) or no StorageManager', async () => {
  const a = fakeNav();
  assert.deepEqual(await storageState(a.nav), { persisted: false, usageMB: 300, quotaMB: 120000 });
  assert.deepEqual(await askPersist(a.nav), { persisted: true, usageMB: 300, quotaMB: 120000, asked: true });
  assert.equal((await askPersist(a.nav)).asked, false, 'persisted already: not asked again');
  const refused = fakeNav({ grant: false });
  assert.deepEqual(await askPersist(refused.nav), { persisted: false, usageMB: 300, quotaMB: 120000, asked: true });
  const worker = fakeNav({ persist: false });
  assert.deepEqual(await askPersist(worker.nav), { persisted: false, usageMB: 300, quotaMB: 120000, asked: false });
  assert.equal(await askPersist({}), null); assert.equal(await storageState(undefined), null);
  const throws = { storage: { persisted: async () => { throw new Error('x'); }, estimate: async () => { throw new Error('y'); }, persist: async () => { throw new Error('z'); } } };
  assert.deepEqual(await askPersist(throws), { persisted: null, usageMB: null, quotaMB: null, asked: false }, 'never throws');
  const p = fakeNav(), s = pageStorage(p.nav);
  assert.equal(s.state, null);
  await Promise.all([s.ask(), s.ask()]); await s.ask();
  assert.equal(p.calls.persist, 1, 'once a page');
  assert.deepEqual(s.state, { persisted: true, usageMB: 300, quotaMB: 120000, asked: true });
  await s.read(); assert.equal(s.state.asked, true, 'read again: asked kept');
});

test('storage in the telemetry: the env builders of every runtime, the perf record\'s check keeps it (bounded), PerfSession reads it', async () => {
  const st = { persisted: true, usageMB: 300, quotaMB: 120000, asked: true };
  assert.deepEqual(withStorage({ cores: 8 }, st), { cores: 8, storage: st });
  assert.deepEqual(withStorage({ cores: 8 }, null), { cores: 8, storage: null });
  assert.deepEqual(eventEnv(st).storage, st); assert.ok('ua' in eventEnv() && 'screen' in eventEnv());
  const rec = { event: 'perf', v: 1, session: 'sess1234', runtime: 'goldsrc', seq: 0, mins: [], tot: {}, env: { cores: 8, storage: { ...st, extra: 'x' } } };

  if (v.ok) {
    assert.deepEqual(v.rec.env.storage, st, 'kept, unknown fields dropped');

  } else assert.fail(v.error);
  // (a PerfSession: its env carries the page's storage)

  const storage = pageStorage(fakeNav().nav); await storage.ask();
  const s = new PerfSession({ runtime: 'goldsrc', game: 'hl', session: 'sess5678', win, now: () => 1000, probe: false, send: (r) => sent.push(r), env: () => ({ gpu: 'x' }), storage, recordMs: 1 });
  s.send({}); s.end();
  assert.deepEqual(sent[0].env.storage, st);

test('the home\'s lines from a probe: the launch and the whole download kept as progress, a store gone clears them, a download of this visit untouched', async () => {
  const kept = new Map();
  globalThis.localStorage = { getItem: (k) => kept.get(k) ?? null, setItem: (k, v) => kept.set(k, String(v)), removeItem: (k) => kept.delete(k) };
  try {
    const { Downloads, launchStatus, downloadStatus } = await import('../src/host/web/download.js');
    const d = new Downloads(), seen = []; d.onChange((n) => seen.push(n));
    const launch = { bytes: 100 * MiB, lightBytes: 40 * MiB, wire: 50 * MiB, lightWire: 20 * MiB, engine: 8 * MiB, engineFiles: ['/engines/r/a.wasm'] };
    assert.equal(launchStatus(launch, { st: d.get('g', 'launch', 'en'), bw: 85000 }).state, 'none', 'before: "Playable after"');
    d.probed({ name: 'g', lang: 'en', launch: { bytes: 48 * MiB, total: 48 * MiB, engine: 8 * MiB, engineFiles: launch.engineFiles, done: true }, whole: { bytes: 60 * MiB, total: 400 * MiB, done: false } });
    assert.deepEqual(seen, ['g']);
    const ln = launchStatus(launch, { st: d.get('g', 'launch', 'en'), bw: 85000 });
    assert.equal(ln.state, 'done'); assert.match(ln.text, /^Ready/);
    const wh = downloadStatus(d.get('g'), 400 * MiB);
    assert.equal(wh.state, 'paused'); assert.equal(wh.pct, 15); assert.match(wh.text, /^15% downloaded/);
    assert.ok(kept.has('orthros.launch.g.en') && kept.has('orthros.download.g'), 'kept for the next visit');
    // (a store found holding less: the line says what is left)
    d.probed({ name: 'g', lang: 'en', launch: { bytes: 18 * MiB, total: 48 * MiB, engine: 8 * MiB, engineFiles: launch.engineFiles, done: false }, whole: { bytes: 0, total: 400 * MiB, done: false } });
    assert.match(launchStatus(launch, { st: d.get('g', 'launch', 'en'), bw: 85000 }).text, /^Playable after 30/);
    assert.equal(downloadStatus(d.get('g'), 400 * MiB).state, 'none', 'no whole block here: no download progress');
    // (evicted or cleared: back to the full size)
    d.probed({ name: 'g', lang: 'en', missing: true });
    assert.equal(d.get('g', 'launch', 'en'), null); assert.equal(kept.has('orthros.launch.g.en'), false);
    // (a download of this visit running: its own count stays)
    d.live.set('orthros.download.h', { bytes: 5, total: 10, running: true });
    d.probed({ name: 'h', lang: null, launch: null, whole: { bytes: 1, total: 10, done: false } });
    assert.equal(d.get('h').bytes, 5);
  } finally { delete globalThis.localStorage; }
});
```

`tests/syncstress.test.js`:

```js
// syncstress.exe (tools/pe/syncstress.c): threads hammering a critical section, a mutex (infinite and timed waits), an
// InterlockedExchange spin lock and one file object read without a lock, yielding, sleeping and reading a network-backed
// file inside their locked sections (reads that park their thread, see ReadFile), plus an API callback (EnumWindows)
// making API calls of its own while the other threads run — under time slices of every size: no mutual-exclusion
// violation, every record of the shared file read exactly once, the callback's handler keeping its own arguments.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { Vfs, MemBackend } from '../src/vfs/vfs.js';
import { RealClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';

const EXE = new URL('../build/pe/syncstress.exe', import.meta.url).pathname;

/** a network-like file: a piece not read yet arrives asynchronously (prepare) after `delay()` ms */
function netFile(data, piece, delay) {
  const here = new Set();
  const pieces = (off, len) => { const out = []; const end = Math.min(off + len, data.length); for (let p = Math.floor(off / piece); p * piece < end; p++) out.push(p); return off >= end ? [] : out; };
  return {
    size: () => data.length,
    prepare(off, len) { const miss = pieces(off, len).filter((p) => !here.has(p)); if (!miss.length) return null; return new Promise((res) => setTimeout(() => { for (const p of miss) here.add(p); res(); }, delay())); },
    read(off, len) { for (const p of pieces(off, len)) here.add(p); const end = Math.min(off + len, data.length); return off >= end ? new Uint8Array(0) : data.slice(off, end); },
    write: () => 0, truncate() {}, close() {},
  };
}

async function runStress(sliceInsns, seed) {
  let s = seed >>> 0; const rnd = () => { s = (Math.imul(s, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0; return s / 4294967296; };
  const records = new Uint8Array(4096 * 4), rv = new DataView(records.buffer);
  for (let i = 0; i < 4096; i++) rv.setUint32(4 * i, (i ^ 0x5a5a0000) >>> 0, true);
  const random = new Uint8Array(32768 * 4), dv = new DataView(random.buffer);
  for (let i = 0; i < 32768; i++) dv.setUint32(4 * i, Math.imul(i, 2654435761) >>> 0, true);
  class Net extends MemBackend {
    stat(rel) { const r = rel.toLowerCase(); return r === 'records.bin' ? { size: records.length, isDir: false, mtime: 0 } : r === 'random.bin' ? { size: random.length, isDir: false, mtime: 0 } : super.stat(rel); }
    open(rel) { const r = rel.toLowerCase(); return r === 'records.bin' ? netFile(records, 8, () => rnd() * 6) : r === 'random.bin' ? netFile(random, 64, () => rnd() * 6) : null; }
  }
  const vfs = new Vfs(), dir = new MemBackend();
  vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend()); vfs.mount('C:\\Test', dir); vfs.mount('C:\\Net', new Net());
  dir.open('syncstress.exe', { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(EXE));
  const clock = new RealClock();
  const host = new HeadlessHost({ clock, width: 320, height: 200 });
  host.cooperative = true;
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host, logKinds: ['crash'], sliceInsns });
  vm.asyncReads = true;
  vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\syncstress.exe' });
  for (;;) { // (the browser worker's pump: runFor, then back to the event loop)
    const r = vm.runFor(performance.now() + 20);
    if (r.state === 'exited') return { code: r.code, out: vm.stdout.join('') };
    await new Promise((res) => {
      const t = setTimeout(res, r.state === 'sleep' ? Math.max(0, r.until - performance.now()) : r.state === 'idle' ? 2 : 0);
      host.wake = () => { clearTimeout(t); res(); };
    });
  }
}

test('syncstress.exe: locks, a shared file object and an API callback under any time slice', { skip: !fs.existsSync(EXE) && 'build/pe/syncstress.exe missing (make pe-tests)', timeout: 120000 }, async () => {
  for (const [slice, seed] of [[100000, 1], [997, 2], [41, 3]]) {
    const { code, out } = await runStress(slice, seed);

      mutex_plus_timeouts: 1500, records_read: 3000, bad_data: 0, read_failures: 0,
    }, `slice ${slice}: ${out}`);
    assert.equal(code, 0);
  }
});
```

```js
/** a ~20 s summary as the page builds it, from frames of `dt` ms (and every 10th of `slow` ms) */
function summary(t, dt, slow, draws = 400) {
  const w = new PerfWindow();
  let d3dFrames = 0, drawsN = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 41; i++) {
    const fs_ = new FrameStats(100), cats = new Float64Array(N_CATS);
    const n = Math.round(500 / dt);
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const d = k % 10 === 0 ? slow : dt; cats.fill(0); cats[C.guest] = d * 0.7; cats[C.draw] = d * 0.3; fs_.add(d, cats); }
    d3dFrames += n; drawsN += n * draws;
    w.add({ dt: 0.5, fps: n * 2, busy: 60, mips: 300, acct: fs_.takeInterval(), d3d: { frames: d3dFrames, draws: drawsN, gpu: { state: 'unavailable' }, glCalls: { state: 'on', frames: i * 30, calls: i * 30 * 1800, draws: i * 30 * 400 } }, gl: { gpuWaitMs: i * 10, fenceMs: 0, frameMs: i * 10, replayMs: i * 20, readbackMs: 0 }, render: 'worker' }, { t, visible: true });
  }
  return { t, event: 'summary', ...w.take() };
}
```

`tests/texture-convert.test.js`:

```js
// Texture uploads (gfx/d3d8-webgl.js surfaceToRgba): the 8- and 16-bit formats converted through a table of every
// texel value, and the conversion into a reused output buffer, give the same bytes as the per-texel conversion they
// replaced (tests/fixtures/surface-rgba-ref.js) for every texel value, at any alignment and pitch.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { surfaceToRgba } from '../src/gfx/d3d8-webgl.js';
import { FMT, surfacePitch } from '../src/win32/d3d8.js';
import { surfaceToRgbaRef } from './fixtures/surface-rgba-ref.js';

const FORMATS = [FMT.A8R8G8B8, FMT.X8R8G8B8, FMT.A8B8G8R8, 33, FMT.R8G8B8, FMT.R5G6B5, FMT.X1R5G5B5, FMT.A1R5G5B5, FMT.A4R4G4B4, FMT.X4R4G4B4, FMT.A8, FMT.L8, FMT.P8, FMT.A8L8,
  FMT.A4L4, 81, FMT.V8U8, FMT.Q8W8V8U8, FMT.V16U16, FMT.G16R16, FMT.A2B10G10R10, FMT.A2R10G10B10, FMT.DXT1, FMT.DXT5];
function rng(seed) { let s = seed >>> 0; return () => { s = (Math.imul(s, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return s >>> 24; }; }
/** a guest-memory-like object over one buffer (u8 / u32 views, bytes(addr, n)) */
function memOf(bytes) { return { u8: bytes, u32: new Uint32Array(bytes.buffer), bytes: (a, n) => bytes.subarray(a, a + n) }; }

test('surfaceToRgba: every texel value of every format, aligned or not, with a pitch, into a fresh or reused buffer', () => {
  const r = rng(7), size = 1 << 20, bytes = new Uint8Array(size), mem = memOf(bytes);
  for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) bytes[i] = r();
  // 16-bit values 0..65535 in a row of 256 x 256 texels, at an even and an odd address
  for (const base of [0x1000, 0x40001]) for (let v = 0; v < 65536; v++) { bytes[base + 2 * v] = v & 255; bytes[base + 2 * v + 1] = v >> 8; }
  const reused = new Uint8Array(1 << 19).fill(0xcd);
  for (const fmt of FORMATS) {
    const bpp = surfacePitch(fmt, 1);
    const cases = [[0x1000, 256, 256, surfacePitch(fmt, 256)], [0x40001, 256, 256, surfacePitch(fmt, 256)], [0x80003, 37, 11, surfacePitch(fmt, 37) + 6], [0x90000, 1, 1, 64], [0xa0002, 64, 3, surfacePitch(fmt, 64) + 2]];
    for (const [addr, w, h, pitch] of cases) {
      if ((fmt === FMT.DXT1 || fmt === FMT.DXT5) && (w % 4 || h % 4)) continue;
      const want = surfaceToRgbaRef(mem, fmt, addr, w, h, pitch);
      assert.deepEqual(surfaceToRgba(mem, fmt, addr, w, h, pitch), want, `format ${fmt} (${bpp} B) at 0x${addr.toString(16)} ${w}x${h} pitch ${pitch}`);
      const got = surfaceToRgba(mem, fmt, addr, w, h, pitch, reused);
      assert.equal(got.length, w * h * 4);
      assert.deepEqual(got, want, `format ${fmt} into the reused buffer`);
    }
  }
});

test('surfaceToRgba: a 2 GiB guest memory (16-bit texels read through a view of the whole memory)', () => {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(2 ** 31), mem = memOf(bytes); // (zero pages: committed lazily by the system)
  const addr = 2 ** 31 - 4096;
  for (let i = 0; i < 2048; i++) { bytes[addr + 2 * i] = i & 255; bytes[addr + 2 * i + 1] = (i * 37) & 255; }
  for (const fmt of [FMT.R5G6B5, FMT.A4R4G4B4, FMT.L8]) assert.deepEqual(surfaceToRgba(mem, fmt, addr, 32, 32, surfacePitch(fmt, 32)), surfaceToRgbaRef(mem, fmt, addr, 32, 32, surfacePitch(fmt, 32)), `format ${fmt}`);
});
```

`tests/texture-partial-upload.test.js`:

```js
// Partial texture uploads: a level whose change is confined to the rectangles locked since its last upload gets only
// that rectangle (as the Direct3D runtime uploads the dirty region of a managed texture); any other kind of change
// uploads the whole level.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { d3dCore, FMT } from '../src/win32/d3d8.js';
import { WebGLDevice, surfaceToRgba } from '../src/gfx/d3d8-webgl.js';

const mem = new GuestMemory({ sizeBytes: 1 << 20 });
let heap = 0x10000;
const proc = { mem, vmem: { alloc: (n) => { const a = heap; heap += (n + 15) & ~15; return a; }, release() {} } };
const core = d3dCore({ mem, com: {} });
const c = { proc, retAddr: 0 };
const RECT = 0x100, OUT = 0x200;
const lock = (s, rect, flags = 0) => {
  if (rect) rect.forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(RECT + 4 * i, v));
  assert.equal(s.lock(c, OUT, rect ? RECT : 0, flags), 0);
  return mem.read32(OUT + 4);
};

test('the dirty rectangle is the union of the rectangles locked since the last upload', () => {
  const s = new core.Surface({}, null, FMT.A8R8G8B8, 64, 32, 0, 1, 0);
  lock(s, [4, 5, 10, 12]); s.unlock();
  assert.equal(s.dirty, true); assert.deepEqual(s.dirtyRect, [4, 5, 10, 12]);
  lock(s, [20, 1, 30, 6]); s.unlock();
  assert.deepEqual(s.dirtyRect, [4, 1, 30, 12], 'union');
  s.dirty = false; // (uploaded)
  assert.equal(s.dirtyRect, null);
  lock(s, [-5, 20, 100, 40]); s.unlock();
  assert.deepEqual(s.dirtyRect, [0, 20, 64, 32], 'clamped to the surface');
  lock(s, null); s.unlock();
  assert.equal(s.dirtyRect, null, 'a whole lock: the whole surface');
  lock(s, [1, 1, 2, 2]); s.unlock();
  assert.equal(s.dirtyRect, null, 'still the whole surface until uploaded');
  s.dirty = false;
  lock(s, [1, 1, 2, 2], 0x10); s.unlock();
  assert.equal(s.dirty, false, 'a read-only lock changes nothing');
  lock(s, [3, 3, 3, 9]); s.unlock();
  assert.equal(s.dirtyRect, null, 'an empty rectangle: the whole surface');
  s.dirty = false;
  lock(s, [1, 1, 2, 2]); s.unlock();
  s.dirty = true; // changed another way (a copy, D3DX...)
  assert.equal(s.dirtyRect, null);
  s.dirty = false;
  s.dirty = true; // (the other way first)
  lock(s, [1, 1, 2, 2]); s.unlock();
  assert.equal(s.dirtyRect, null, 'a rectangle locked after a whole change keeps the whole surface');
});

function recordingGl(noS3tc = false) {
  const calls = []; let next = 1;
  const s3tc = { COMPRESSED_RGBA_S3TC_DXT1_EXT: 0x83f1, COMPRESSED_RGBA_S3TC_DXT3_EXT: 0x83f2, COMPRESSED_RGBA_S3TC_DXT5_EXT: 0x83f3 };
  const rec = (name) => (...a) => calls.push([name, ...a.map((x) => (ArrayBuffer.isView(x) ? Uint8Array.from(x) : x))]);
  const base = {
    canvas: { width: 800, height: 600 }, drawingBufferWidth: 800, drawingBufferHeight: 600,
    TEXTURE0: 0x84c0, TEXTURE_2D: 0x0de1, MAX_COMBINED_TEXTURE_IMAGE_UNITS: 0x8b4d,
    createTexture: () => ({ id: next++ }), getParameter: (p) => (p === 0x8b4d ? 32 : 0),
    getExtension: (n) => (n === 'WEBGL_compressed_texture_s3tc' && !noS3tc ? s3tc : null),
    texImage2D: rec('texImage2D'), texSubImage2D: rec('texSubImage2D'), compressedTexImage2D: rec('compressedTexImage2D'), compressedTexSubImage2D: rec('compressedTexSubImage2D'),
  };
  const gl = new Proxy(base, { get(t, k) { if (k in t) return t[k]; if (typeof k === 'string' && /^[A-Z0-9_]+$/.test(k)) return k.length; return () => ({}); } });
  return { gl, calls };
}
const backend = (gl) => new WebGLDevice(gl, { proc, pp: { width: 800, height: 600 }, backBuffers: [] }, {});

test('an A8R8G8B8 level locked in part: only the rectangle is converted and uploaded', () => {
  const R = recordingGl(), W = backend(R.gl);
  const s = new core.Surface({}, null, FMT.A8R8G8B8, 16, 8, 0, 1, 0);
  const base = lock(s, null); for (let i = 0; i < 16 * 8 * 4; i++) mem.u8[base + i] = i * 7; s.unlock();
  const tex = { id: 501, fmt: FMT.A8R8G8B8, levels: [s] };
  W.glTexture(tex);
  assert.equal(R.calls.at(-1)[0], 'texImage2D', 'first upload: the whole level');
  R.calls.length = 0;
  const p = lock(s, [3, 2, 9, 5]); // written through the pointer to the rectangle's corner
  assert.equal(p, base + 2 * s.pitch + 3 * 4);
  for (let y = 0; y < 3; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 6 * 4; x++) mem.u8[p + y * s.pitch + x] = 200 + x + y;
  s.unlock();
  W.glTexture(tex);
  assert.equal(R.calls.length, 1);
  const [name, , level, x, y, w, h, , , data] = R.calls[0];
  assert.deepEqual([name, level, x, y, w, h], ['texSubImage2D', 0, 3, 2, 6, 3]);
  const full = surfaceToRgba(mem, s.fmt, s.mem, 16, 8, s.pitch);
  const want = new Uint8Array(6 * 3 * 4);
  for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) want.set(full.subarray(((2 + r) * 16 + 3) * 4, ((2 + r) * 16 + 9) * 4), r * 6 * 4);
  assert.deepEqual(data, want);
  assert.equal(s.dirty, false); assert.equal(s.dirtyRect, null);
  // changed another way: the whole level again
  R.calls.length = 0; s.dirty = true; W.glTexture(tex);
  assert.deepEqual(R.calls[0].slice(0, 7), ['texSubImage2D', 0x0de1, 0, 0, 0, 16, 8]);
});

test('a DXT1 level locked in part: whole blocks of the rectangle, packed rows', () => {
  const R = recordingGl(), W = backend(R.gl);
  const s = new core.Surface({}, null, FMT.DXT1, 16, 16, 0, 1, 0); // 4x4 blocks of 8 bytes, pitch 32
  const base = lock(s, null); for (let i = 0; i < 128; i++) mem.u8[base + i] = i; s.unlock();
  const tex = { id: 502, fmt: FMT.DXT1, levels: [s] };
  W.glTexture(tex);
  assert.equal(R.calls.at(-1)[0], 'compressedTexImage2D');
  R.calls.length = 0;
  lock(s, [5, 6, 9, 7]); s.unlock(); // blocks x 1..2, y 1
  W.glTexture(tex);
  const [name, , level, x, y, w, h, f, data] = R.calls[0];
  assert.deepEqual([name, level, x, y, w, h, f], ['compressedTexSubImage2D', 0, 4, 4, 8, 4, 0x83f1]);
  assert.deepEqual(data, Uint8Array.from({ length: 16 }, (_, i) => 32 + 8 + i));
  // a rectangle reaching the right edge of a level whose width is not a multiple of 4 ends at the edge
  const t = new core.Surface({}, null, FMT.DXT1, 12, 12, 0, 1, 0);
  lock(t, null); t.unlock(); W.glTexture({ id: 503, fmt: FMT.DXT1, levels: [t] });
  R.calls.length = 0; lock(t, [0, 0, 12, 3]); t.unlock(); W.glTexture({ id: 503, fmt: FMT.DXT1, levels: [t] });
  assert.deepEqual(R.calls[0].slice(2, 7), [0, 0, 0, 12, 4]);
});

test('a DXT level locked in part without the s3tc extension (decoded on the CPU): the whole level, decoded right', () => {
  const R = recordingGl(true), W = backend(R.gl);
  const s = new core.Surface({}, null, FMT.DXT1, 16, 16, 0, 1, 0);
  const base = lock(s, null); for (let i = 0; i < 128; i++) mem.u8[base + i] = (i * 37) & 255; s.unlock();
  const tex = { id: 504, fmt: FMT.DXT1, levels: [s] };
  W.glTexture(tex);
  R.calls.length = 0;
  const p = lock(s, [5, 6, 9, 7]); mem.u8[p] ^= 0xff; s.unlock();
  W.glTexture(tex);
  const call = R.calls.find((c) => c[0] === 'texSubImage2D' || c[0] === 'texImage2D');
  assert.deepEqual(call.slice(3, 7), [0, 0, 16, 16], 'whole level');
  assert.deepEqual(call.at(-1), surfaceToRgba(mem, s.fmt, s.mem, 16, 16, s.pitch));
});
```

`tests/time-locale-api.test.js`:

```js
// The time zone and locale APIs end to end, through their handlers in a booted process with a synthetic zone
// (Central Europe) so the result does not depend on the machine: GetTimeZoneInformation's layout and return value,
// local time, FileTime <-> local FileTime, SystemTimeToTzSpecificLocalTime / back, CRT localtime / gmtime / mktime,
// GetLocaleInfoA/W sizes (LOCALE_RETURN_NUMBER: a DWORD).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { Vfs, MemBackend } from '../src/vfs/vfs.js';
import { VirtualClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';
import { Ctx } from '../src/win32/ctx.js';

const EXE = new URL('../build/pe/hello.exe', import.meta.url).pathname;
const skip = !fs.existsSync(EXE) && 'build/pe/hello.exe missing (make pe-tests)';

const lastSunday = (y, m) => { const d = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m + 1, 0)); return d.getUTCDate() - d.getUTCDay(); };
const europe = (ms) => { const y = new Date(ms).getUTCFullYear(); const a = Date.UTC(y, 2, lastSunday(y, 2), 1), b = Date.UTC(y, 9, lastSunday(y, 9), 1); return ms >= a && ms < b ? 120 : 60; };

function boot(wall) {
  const vfs = new Vfs(); const t = new MemBackend();
  vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend()); vfs.mount('C:\\Test', t);
  t.open('hello.exe', { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(EXE));
  const clock = new VirtualClock(wall); clock.zone = europe;
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host: new HeadlessHost({ clock, width: 64, height: 64 }), logKinds: [] });
  vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\hello.exe' });
  const mem = vm.mem, scratch = vm.proc.processHeap.alloc(0x1000, true), frame = vm.proc.processHeap.alloc(64, true);
  const call = (dll, name, ...args) => {
    args.forEach((a, i) => mem.write32(frame + 4 + 4 * i, a >>> 0));
    const c = new Ctx(vm); c.thread = vm.proc.threads[0]; c.cpu = c.thread.cpu; c.sp = frame;
    const r = vm.api.lookup(dll, name).fn(c); return r === undefined ? r : r >>> 0;
  };
  const st = (p) => [0, 2, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14].map((o) => mem.read16(p + o)); // year month day hour min sec ms
  return { vm, mem, scratch, call, st };
}

test('time zone APIs with a daylight-saving zone', { skip }, () => {
  const now = Date.UTC(2026, 6, 15, 10, 30, 0); // summer: CEST
  const { mem, scratch: p, call, st } = boot(now);
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'GetTimeZoneInformation', p), 2, 'TIME_ZONE_ID_DAYLIGHT');
  assert.equal(mem.readS32(p), -60); assert.equal(mem.readS32(p + 84), 0); assert.equal(mem.readS32(p + 168), -60);
  assert.deepEqual([0, 2, 4, 6, 8].map((o) => mem.read16(p + 68 + o)), [0, 10, 0, 5, 3]);
  assert.deepEqual([0, 2, 4, 6, 8].map((o) => mem.read16(p + 152 + o)), [0, 3, 0, 5, 2]);
  call('kernel32.dll', 'GetLocalTime', p + 200);
  assert.deepEqual(st(p + 200), [2026, 7, 15, 12, 30, 0, 0]);
  call('kernel32.dll', 'GetSystemTime', p + 220);
  assert.deepEqual(st(p + 220), [2026, 7, 15, 10, 30, 0, 0]);
  // a winter UTC time through the TZI the program got: one hour, and back
  const ft = (ms) => BigInt(ms) * 10000n + 116444736000000000n;
  mem.write64(p + 240, ft(Date.UTC(2026, 0, 10, 8, 0)));
  call('kernel32.dll', 'FileTimeToSystemTime', p + 240, p + 260);
  call('kernel32.dll', 'SystemTimeToTzSpecificLocalTime', p, p + 260, p + 280);
  assert.deepEqual(st(p + 280), [2026, 1, 10, 9, 0, 0, 0]);
  call('kernel32.dll', 'SystemTimeToTzSpecificLocalTime', 0, p + 260, p + 300);
  assert.deepEqual(st(p + 300), [2026, 1, 10, 9, 0, 0, 0]);
  call('kernel32.dll', 'TzSpecificLocalTimeToSystemTime', p, p + 280, p + 320);
  assert.deepEqual(st(p + 320), st(p + 260));
  // FileTimeToLocalFileTime: the current bias (Windows), round trip exact
  call('kernel32.dll', 'FileTimeToLocalFileTime', p + 240, p + 340);
  assert.equal(mem.read64(p + 340) - mem.read64(p + 240), 2n * 3600n * 10000000n);
  call('kernel32.dll', 'LocalFileTimeToFileTime', p + 340, p + 360);
  assert.equal(mem.read64(p + 360), mem.read64(p + 240));
});

test('CRT localtime / gmtime / mktime in the zone', { skip }, () => {
  const { mem, scratch: p, call } = boot(Date.UTC(2026, 0, 1));
  const t = Date.UTC(2026, 6, 15, 10, 30, 5) / 1000;
  mem.write32(p, t);
  const tm = (q) => [0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32].map((o) => mem.readS32(q + o));
  const g = tm(call('msvcrt.dll', 'gmtime', p));
  assert.deepEqual(g, [5, 30, 10, 15, 6, 126, 3, 195, 0]);
  const lp = call('msvcrt.dll', 'localtime', p), l = tm(lp);
  assert.deepEqual(l, [5, 30, 12, 15, 6, 126, 3, 195, 1], 'local, tm_isdst set in summer');
  assert.equal(call('msvcrt.dll', 'mktime', lp), t, 'mktime inverts localtime');
  mem.write32(p, Date.UTC(2026, 0, 15, 23, 30) / 1000);
  const w = tm(call('msvcrt.dll', 'localtime', p));
  assert.deepEqual(w.slice(0, 6).concat(w[8]), [0, 30, 0, 16, 0, 126, 0], 'next day locally, no daylight saving in winter');
});

test('GetLocaleInfoA/W: sizes, LOCALE_RETURN_NUMBER, short buffer', { skip }, () => {
  const { vm, mem, scratch: p, call } = boot(0);
  const LOCALE_SDECIMAL = 0x0e, LOCALE_IDIGITS = 0x11, RETURN_NUMBER = 0x20000000, ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER = 122;
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'GetLocaleInfoA', 0x409, LOCALE_SDECIMAL, 0, 0), 2);
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'GetLocaleInfoA', 0x409, LOCALE_SDECIMAL, p, 2), 2);
  assert.equal(mem.readCString(p), '.');
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'GetLocaleInfoA', 0x409, LOCALE_SDECIMAL, p, 1), 0);
  assert.equal(vm.proc.threads[0].lastError, ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER);
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'GetLocaleInfoW', 0x409, LOCALE_SDECIMAL, p, 2), 2);
  assert.equal(mem.readWString(p), '.');
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'GetLocaleInfoA', 0x409, LOCALE_IDIGITS | RETURN_NUMBER, 0, 0), 4);
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'GetLocaleInfoW', 0x409, LOCALE_IDIGITS | RETURN_NUMBER, 0, 0), 2);
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'GetLocaleInfoW', 0x409, LOCALE_IDIGITS | RETURN_NUMBER, p + 16, 2), 2);
  assert.equal(mem.read32(p + 16), 2);
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'GetLocaleInfoA', 0x409, 0x01 | RETURN_NUMBER, p + 16, 4), 4);
  assert.equal(mem.read32(p + 16), 0x409, 'LOCALE_ILANGUAGE is hexadecimal');
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'GetLocaleInfoA', 0x409, 0x5b, p, 8), 4, 'LOCALE_IGEOID (answered before the table was re-keyed)');
  assert.equal(mem.readCString(p), '244');
});
```

`tests/timer-res.test.js`:

```js
// The system timer resolution (core/timer-res.js): timed waits end at the clock interrupt (15.625 ms by default, the
// smallest timeBeginPeriod request otherwise), GetTickCount steps by the 15.625 ms tick whatever the resolution,
// timeGetTime by the interrupt, USER timers fall due at the interrupt too.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { TimerResolution, DEFAULT_TIMER_RES } from '../src/core/timer-res.js';
import { Scheduler, PARK, INFINITE } from '../src/core/sched.js';
import { VirtualClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { TS } from '../src/win32/process.js';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { Vfs, MemBackend } from '../src/vfs/vfs.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';
import { Ctx } from '../src/win32/ctx.js';
import { TICK_BASE } from '../src/cpu/jit/runtime.js';

test('TimerResolution: requests, ticks, tick counters', () => {
  const r = new TimerResolution();
  assert.equal(r.ms, DEFAULT_TIMER_RES);
  assert.equal(r.tickAt(1), 15.625, 'Sleep(1) from 0: the next tick');
  assert.equal(r.tickAt(15.625), 15.625, 'a deadline on a tick is that tick');
  assert.equal(r.tickAt(16), 31.25);
  // GetTickCount: 15 / 16 ms steps
  assert.deepEqual([0, 15.6, 15.625, 31.2, 31.25, 46.875, 62.5].map((t) => r.tickCount(t)), [0, 0, 15, 15, 31, 46, 62]);
  assert.equal(r.mmTime(20), 15);
  assert.equal(r.begin(0), false, 'period 0: TIMERR_NOCANDO');
  assert.equal(r.begin(5), true); assert.equal(r.ms, 5);
  assert.equal(r.begin(1), true); assert.equal(r.begin(1), true); assert.equal(r.ms, 1);
  assert.equal(r.tickAt(10.3 + 1), 12, 'Sleep(1) under timeBeginPeriod(1): 1 to 2 ms');
  assert.equal(r.mmTime(30.7), 30);
  assert.equal(r.tickCount(20.5), 15, 'GetTickCount keeps the 15.625 ms tick under timeBeginPeriod');
  assert.equal(r.end(1), true); assert.equal(r.ms, 1, 'one request of 1 ms left');
  assert.equal(r.end(1), true); assert.equal(r.ms, 5);
  assert.equal(r.end(1), false, 'no matching begin');
  assert.equal(r.end(5), true); assert.equal(r.ms, DEFAULT_TIMER_RES);
  assert.equal(r.end(200), false);
  // the switch's 0: the exact behaviour (no rounding anywhere)
  const exact = new TimerResolution(0);
  exact.begin(1);
  assert.deepEqual([exact.ms, exact.tickAt(10.3), exact.tickCount(20.5), exact.mmTime(20.5)], [0, 10.3, 20, 20]);
  assert.equal(r.tickAt(Infinity), Infinity);
});

test('TimerResolution: timeGetTime never goes back when the resolution changes', () => {
  const r = new TimerResolution();
  r.begin(1);
  assert.equal(r.mmTime(1010.3), 1010);
  r.end(1); // back to 15.625 ms: the last interrupt of that grid (1000) is before the value already returned
  assert.equal(r.mmTime(1010.4), 1010, 'holds until the next interrupt');
  assert.equal(r.mmTime(1015.7), 1015);
  r.begin(1); assert.equal(r.mmTime(1016.2), 1016);
  r.end(1); r.begin(7); // a period that does not divide the old one
  assert.equal(r.mmTime(1016.5), 1016);
  assert.equal(r.mmTime(1022.1), 1022);
  // randomized: any sequence of requests, the clock moving forward
  let x = 12345, now = 0, last = 0;
  const rnd = () => { x ^= x << 13; x >>>= 0; x ^= x >>> 17; x ^= x << 5; x >>>= 0; return x; };
  const q = new TimerResolution(), held = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 20000; i++) {
    now += (rnd() % 1000) / 100;
    const k = rnd() % 8;
    if (k === 0) { const p = 1 + (rnd() % 20); q.begin(p); held.push(p); } else if (k === 1 && held.length) q.end(held.splice(rnd() % held.length, 1)[0]);
    const v = q.mmTime(now);
    assert.ok(v >= last && v <= now, `timeGetTime ${v} after ${last} at ${now}`);
    last = v;
  }
});

test('Scheduler: a guest timeout ends at a tick, the emulator\'s own waits are exact', () => {
  const clock = new VirtualClock();
  const vm = { clock, proc: { threads: [], timers: [] }, warn() {}, logFn() {}, canUnwind: () => true, timerRes: new TimerResolution() };
  const s = vm.sched = new Scheduler(vm), t = { id: 1, state: TS.RUNNING };
  clock.sleep(100);
  const never = () => false;
  assert.equal(s.park(t, never, 1, 'sleep', undefined, true), PARK);
  assert.equal(t.parkWait.deadline, 109.375, 'Sleep(1) at 100 ms: the tick at 109.375');
  assert.equal(s.park(t, never, 1, 'sleep'), PARK);
  assert.equal(t.parkWait.deadline, 101, 'not a guest timeout: exact');
  assert.equal(s.park(t, never, INFINITE, 'wait', undefined, true), PARK);
  assert.equal(t.parkWait.deadline, Infinity);
  assert.equal(s.park(t, never, 0, 'wait', undefined, true), false, 'a poll still times out at once');
  vm.timerRes.begin(1);
  assert.equal(s.park(t, never, 1, 'sleep', undefined, true), PARK);
  assert.equal(t.parkWait.deadline, 101);
  clock.sleep(0.25);
  assert.equal(s.park(t, never, 1, 'sleep', undefined, true), PARK);
  assert.equal(t.parkWait.deadline, 102);
});

const EXE = new URL('../build/pe/hello.exe', import.meta.url).pathname;
const skip = !fs.existsSync(EXE) && 'build/pe/hello.exe missing (make pe-tests)';

test('handlers: GetTickCount, timeGetTime, timeBeginPeriod, Sleep and WaitForSingleObject timeouts', { skip }, () => {
  const vfs = new Vfs(); const b = new MemBackend();
  vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend()); vfs.mount('C:\\Test', b);
  b.open('hello.exe', { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(EXE));
  const clock = new VirtualClock();
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host: new HeadlessHost({ clock, width: 64, height: 64 }), logKinds: [] });
  vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\hello.exe' });
  const mem = vm.mem, frame = vm.proc.processHeap.alloc(64, true), th = vm.proc.threads[0];
  const call = (dll, name, ...args) => {
    args.forEach((a, i) => mem.write32(frame + 4 + 4 * i, a >>> 0));
    const c = new Ctx(vm); c.thread = th; c.cpu = th.cpu; c.sp = frame;
    const r = vm.api.lookup(dll, name).fn(c); return r === PARK || r === undefined ? r : r >>> 0;
  };
  clock.t = 40;
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'GetTickCount'), (TICK_BASE + 31) >>> 0);
  assert.equal(call('winmm.dll', 'timeGetTime'), (TICK_BASE + 31) >>> 0);
  // (outside the dispatcher the waits are nested: the virtual clock sleeps to the deadline)
  call('kernel32.dll', 'Sleep', 1);
  assert.equal(clock.t, 46.875, 'Sleep(1) at 40 ms: until the tick at 46.875 ms');
  clock.t = 40;
  assert.equal(call('winmm.dll', 'timeBeginPeriod', 0), 97, 'TIMERR_NOCANDO');
  assert.equal(call('winmm.dll', 'timeBeginPeriod', 1), 0);
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'GetTickCount'), (TICK_BASE + 31) >>> 0);
  assert.equal(call('winmm.dll', 'timeGetTime'), (TICK_BASE + 40) >>> 0);
  call('kernel32.dll', 'Sleep', 1);
  assert.equal(clock.t, 41);
  const ev = call('kernel32.dll', 'CreateEventA', 0, 1, 0, 0);
  clock.t = 40.5;
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'WaitForSingleObject', ev, 3), 0x102);
  assert.equal(clock.t, 44, 'a 3 ms timeout from 40.5 ms: the interrupt at 44 ms');
  assert.equal(call('winmm.dll', 'timeEndPeriod', 1), 0);
  assert.equal(call('winmm.dll', 'timeEndPeriod', 1), 97, 'no matching timeBeginPeriod');
  clock.t = 40.5;
  assert.equal(call('kernel32.dll', 'WaitForSingleObject', ev, 3), 0x102);
  assert.equal(clock.t, 46.875);
  // a USER timer (SetTimer without a window): 10 ms from 50 ms falls due at the tick at 62.5 ms
  clock.t = 50;
  const id = call('user32.dll', 'SetTimer', 0, 0, 10, 0);
  assert.equal(vm.proc.timers.find((x) => x.kind === 'wm' && x.id === id).due, 62.5);
});
```

`tests/timezone.test.js`:

```js
// The guest's time zone (src/win32/timezone.js): TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION derived from a zone's offsets (bias, the
// daylight-saving rules as Windows writes them), rules evaluated back, local <-> UTC conversions; synthetic zones so
// the test does not depend on the machine's time zone.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { timeZoneInfo, tziOffsetAt, ruleLocalMs, localToUtc, utcZone } from '../src/win32/timezone.js';

/** last Sunday of a month (UTC date) */
const lastSunday = (y, m) => { const d = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m + 1, 0)); return d.getUTCDate() - d.getUTCDay(); };
/** Central Europe: UTC+1, UTC+2 from the last Sunday of March 01:00 UTC to the last Sunday of October 01:00 UTC */
const europe = (ms) => { const y = new Date(ms).getUTCFullYear(); const a = Date.UTC(y, 2, lastSunday(y, 2), 1), b = Date.UTC(y, 9, lastSunday(y, 9), 1); return ms >= a && ms < b ? 120 : 60; };
/** a southern zone: UTC+10, UTC+11 from the first Sunday of October 16:00 UTC (02:00 local) to the first Sunday of April 16:00 UTC (03:00 local) */
const firstSunday = (y, m) => { const d = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m, 1)); return 1 + ((7 - d.getUTCDay()) % 7); };
const south = (ms) => { const y = new Date(ms).getUTCFullYear(); const end = Date.UTC(y, 3, firstSunday(y, 3) - 1, 16), start = Date.UTC(y, 9, firstSunday(y, 9) - 1, 16); return ms < end || ms >= start ? 660 : 600; };

test('TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION of a northern zone with daylight saving', () => {
  const t = timeZoneInfo(europe, 2026, { standard: 'CET', daylight: 'CEST' });
  assert.equal(t.bias, -60);
  assert.equal(t.standardBias, 0);
  assert.equal(t.daylightBias, -60);
  // daylight saving starts on the last Sunday of March at 02:00 (local standard time), ends on the last Sunday of October at 03:00
  assert.deepEqual(t.daylightDate, { year: 0, month: 3, dayOfWeek: 0, day: 5, hour: 2, minute: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual(t.standardDate, { year: 0, month: 10, dayOfWeek: 0, day: 5, hour: 3, minute: 0 });
  assert.equal(t.standardName, 'CET');
  // the rule evaluated back gives the zone's offsets, around both changes and in another year
  for (const y of [2025, 2026, 2031]) {
    for (let ms = Date.UTC(y, 0, 1); ms < Date.UTC(y + 1, 0, 1); ms += 3 * 3600000 + 17 * 60000) assert.equal(tziOffsetAt(t, ms), europe(ms), new Date(ms).toISOString());
    const a = Date.UTC(y, 2, lastSunday(y, 2), 1);
    assert.equal(tziOffsetAt(t, a - 1), 60); assert.equal(tziOffsetAt(t, a), 120);
  }
});

test('TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION of a southern zone (daylight saving across the new year)', () => {
  const t = timeZoneInfo(south, 2026);
  assert.equal(t.bias, -600);
  assert.equal(t.daylightBias, -60);
  assert.deepEqual(t.daylightDate, { year: 0, month: 10, dayOfWeek: 0, day: 1, hour: 2, minute: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual(t.standardDate, { year: 0, month: 4, dayOfWeek: 0, day: 1, hour: 3, minute: 0 });
  for (let ms = Date.UTC(2026, 0, 1); ms < Date.UTC(2027, 0, 1); ms += 5 * 3600000 + 7 * 60000) assert.equal(tziOffsetAt(t, ms), south(ms), new Date(ms).toISOString());
});

test('zones without daylight saving; rule dates; local to UTC', () => {
  const u = timeZoneInfo(utcZone, 2026);
  assert.equal(u.bias, 0); assert.equal(u.daylightDate, null); assert.equal(u.standardName, 'Coordinated Universal Time');
  const india = () => 330;
  const i = timeZoneInfo(india, 2026);
  assert.equal(i.bias, -330); assert.equal(i.daylightDate, null); assert.equal(tziOffsetAt(i, Date.UTC(2026, 5, 1)), 330);
  // occurrence 5 = the last one, whether the month has four or five of that weekday
  assert.equal(new Date(ruleLocalMs({ month: 3, dayOfWeek: 0, day: 5, hour: 2, minute: 0 }, 2026)).toISOString(), '2026-03-29T02:00:00.000Z');
  assert.equal(new Date(ruleLocalMs({ month: 2, dayOfWeek: 1, day: 5, hour: 0, minute: 0 }, 2026)).toISOString(), '2026-02-23T00:00:00.000Z');
  assert.equal(new Date(ruleLocalMs({ month: 10, dayOfWeek: 0, day: 1, hour: 2, minute: 0 }, 2026)).toISOString(), '2026-10-04T02:00:00.000Z');
  // local wall-clock -> UTC, in both halves of the year
  assert.equal(localToUtc(europe, Date.UTC(2026, 0, 15, 12)), Date.UTC(2026, 0, 15, 11));
  assert.equal(localToUtc(europe, Date.UTC(2026, 6, 15, 12)), Date.UTC(2026, 6, 15, 10));
});
```

`tests/v8-logs.test.js`:

```js
// tools/v8-logs.mjs: V8's log files under the scratch, not in the browser's working directory (the repository's root).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { v8LogArgs } from '../tools/v8-logs.mjs';
import { launchOptions } from '../tools/port-perf.mjs';

test('v8 logs: every --js-flags gets a --logfile in the directory, made first; other switches untouched', () => {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'v8-logs-')), dir = path.join(root, 'logs');
  try {
    assert.deepEqual(v8LogArgs(['--no-sandbox', '--mute-audio'], dir), ['--no-sandbox', '--mute-audio']);
    assert.equal(fs.existsSync(dir), false); // (no V8 flag, no directory)
    assert.deepEqual(v8LogArgs(['--x', '--js-flags=--prof --log-maps'], dir), ['--x', `--js-flags=--prof --log-maps --logfile=${dir}/v8.log`]);
    assert.ok(fs.statSync(dir).isDirectory());
    // (a --logfile given is kept; --logfile-per-isolate is another flag)
    assert.deepEqual(v8LogArgs(['--js-flags=--log --logfile=/x/v8.log'], dir), ['--js-flags=--log --logfile=/x/v8.log']);
    assert.deepEqual(v8LogArgs(['--js-flags=--logfile=-'], dir), ['--js-flags=--logfile=-']);
    assert.deepEqual(v8LogArgs(['--js-flags=--log --logfile-per-isolate'], dir), [`--js-flags=--log --logfile-per-isolate --logfile=${dir}/v8.log`]);
  } finally { fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

test('v8 logs: the ports\' launch options route a --js-flags through it', () => {
  const o = launchOptions({ gl: 'gpu', channel: 'shell', args: ['--js-flags=--log-function-events'] });
  assert.ok(o.args.includes('--js-flags=--log-function-events --logfile=/tmp/orthros-scratch/v8-logs/v8.log'), o.args.join(' '));
});
```
