```js
const PE = 0x20, ZE = 0x04;
const JIT_GAPS = new Set(['fist_m32', 'fistp_m32', 'fisttp_m32', 'fdiv', 'fdivr', 'fdiv_m64']);
const h = (v) => v.toString(16).padStart(4, '0');

function expected() {
  const list = cases();
  const per = new Map();
  for (const c of list) per.set(c.iname, (per.get(c.iname) ?? 0) + 1);
  const at = new Map();
  return list.map((c) => {
    const k = at.get(c.iname) ?? 0; at.set(c.iname, k + 1);
    assert.equal(HW[c.iname].length, 4 * per.get(c.iname), `${c.iname}: table size`);
    return { ...c, hw: parseInt(HW[c.iname].slice(4 * k, 4 * k + 4), 16) };
  });
}

test('x87 condition codes: the interpreter matches the reference CPU', async () => {
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(HW), Object.keys(INS));
  assert.equal(Object.keys(STACKS).length * CCS.length, HW.fcomi.length / 4);
  const list = expected(), got = await runOrthros(list, null);
  const bad = [];
  list.forEach((c, k) => {
    const m = c.hw & PE ? 0x4500 : 0x4700; // (inexact: C1 is the rounding direction)
    if ((got[k] & m) !== (c.hw & m)) bad.push(`${c.name}: hw ${h(c.hw)} interp ${h(got[k])}`);
  });
  assert.deepEqual(bad, []);
});

test('x87 condition codes: the JIT matches the interpreter (status word in a local or not)', async () => {
  const list = cases(), want = await runOrthros(list, null);
  for (const swLocal of [true, false]) {
    const got = await runOrthros(list, { swLocal }), bad = [];
    list.forEach((c, k) => {
      const m = JIT_GAPS.has(c.iname) ? ~(PE | ZE) : ~0;
      if ((got[k] & m) !== (want[k] & m)) bad.push(`${c.name}: interp ${h(want[k])} jit ${h(got[k])}`);
    });
    assert.deepEqual(bad, [], `swLocal ${swLocal}`);
  }
});

test('x87 condition codes: FXAM -> FUCOMI st(3) -> FNSTSW (the generator seeds 1034 / 1646 / 1921) keeps C1', async () => {
  // fninit ; fld m64 -1.5 x4 ; fxam (C1 = 1, C2 = 1) ; fucomi st(3) ; fnstsw ax ; fninit — and with fcomi / fucomip
  for (const ins of [[0xdb, 0xeb], [0xdb, 0xf3], [0xdf, 0xeb], [0xdf, 0xf3]]) {
    const code = Uint8Array.from([0xdb, 0xe3, ...[0, 0, 0, 0].flatMap(() => [0xdd, 0x40, 0x00]), 0xd9, 0xe5, ...ins, 0xdf, 0xe0, 0xdb, 0xe3]);
    const list = [{ name: 'fxam-fucomi', code }];
    const [interp] = await runOrthros(list, null);
    assert.equal(interp & 0x4700, 0x0600, `interp ${h(interp)}`);
    for (const swLocal of [true, false]) assert.equal((await runOrthros(list, { swLocal }))[0], interp, `swLocal ${swLocal}`);
  }
});

```

`tools/ab-virtual.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Concurrent A/B of translation options on deterministic Node runs: every variant's runs play the same scenario at once
// (the same load on the shared machine) under startbench --virtual — the virtual clock makes a run repeat its guest
// work exactly (thread interleavings, inputs, frames) as long as nothing else differs, so phases compare the same work.
// A variant that changes where time slices end (region shapes: the budget is checked at chains and backward transfers)
// can still change the interleavings: the guest instructions of each phase are printed to tell.
// Usage: node tools/ab-virtual.mjs <manifest-id> --games-dir <dir> --input <scenario> [--profile-dir <dir>] [--heat <file>]
//          [--runs 2] [--limit 900] [--keep <dir>] [--perf] [--jit-opts B='{...}'] --variant A='{}' --variant B='{"maxBlocks":96}'
//          [-- <more startbench args>]
// Each variant's JSON is the runs' ORTHROS_JIT_DEFAULTS (translate.js JIT_DEFAULTS). Prints, per phase and variant, the
// guest time per guest instruction (frame accounting's guest category) and the emulator thread's CPU per frame, each
// run's and the mean, and the mean's difference from the first variant's.
// --perf: each run under `perf record -e instructions:u,cycles:u -c 1000000` with V8's TurboFan only (`--no-liftoff`: no
// tier-up timing decides how long code runs in Liftoff); prints, per variant, the user instructions and cycles of the
// whole run in JIT-compiled code (perf's [JIT] object: the WASM regions, the runtime module and V8's JavaScript code)
// and in the process. The same guest work gives the same counts: two runs of one variant within ~0.1 % in instructions
// and ~0.5 % in cycles (BFME1 menu, load average 15-35) — the resolution the time measures lack. The process counts
// include V8's compilation (on the emulator thread with --no-liftoff), which the browser does off it. Needs perf.
// --jit-opts NAME='{...}': that variant's Jit options as well (startbench --jit-opts: nestLoops, profile...).
import { spawn, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';

const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
const dash = argv.indexOf('--');
const args = dash >= 0 ? argv.slice(0, dash) : argv, passThrough = dash >= 0 ? argv.slice(dash + 1) : [];
const opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const target = args[0];
const variants = [];
for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) if (args[i] === '--variant') { const v = args[i + 1], e = v.indexOf('='); variants.push({ name: v.slice(0, e), json: v.slice(e + 1) }); }
if (!target || target.startsWith('--') || !opt('input') || variants.length < 1) {
  console.error('usage: node tools/ab-virtual.mjs <manifest-id> --games-dir <dir> --input <scenario> --variant A=\'{}\' --variant B=\'{...}\' [--runs 2] [--profile-dir <dir>] [--heat <file>]');
  process.exit(2);
}
const jitOpts = new Map();
for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) if (args[i] === '--jit-opts') { const v = args[i + 1], e = v.indexOf('='); jitOpts.set(v.slice(0, e), v.slice(e + 1)); }
for (const v of variants) JSON.parse(v.json); // (fails early on a typo)
for (const j of jitOpts.values()) JSON.parse(j);
const perf = args.includes('--perf');
const runs = Number(opt('runs', 2));
const dir = opt('keep') ?? fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-abv-'));
fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
const bench = new URL('./startbench.mjs', import.meta.url).pathname;

const jobs = [];
for (let r = 0; r < runs; r++) for (const v of (r % 2 ? [...variants].reverse() : variants)) jobs.push({ v, r, name: `${v.name}-${r}` });
const started = jobs.map((j) => new Promise((resolve) => {
  const a = [bench, target, '--input', opt('input'), '--virtual', '--limit', opt('limit', '900'), '--phases', path.join(dir, j.name + '.json')];
  if (opt('games-dir')) a.push('--games-dir', opt('games-dir'));
  if (opt('heat')) a.push('--heat', opt('heat'));
  if (opt('profile-dir')) { const p = path.join(dir, 'profile-' + j.name); fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync(opt('profile-dir'), p, { recursive: true }); a.push('--save', p); }
  if (jitOpts.has(j.v.name)) a.push('--jit-opts', jitOpts.get(j.v.name));
  a.push(...passThrough);
  const log = fs.openSync(path.join(dir, j.name + '.log'), 'w');
  const [cmd, cargs] = perf ? ['perf', ['record', '-q', '-e', 'instructions:u,cycles:u', '-c', '1000000', '-o', path.join(dir, j.name + '.perf'), process.execPath, '--no-liftoff', ...a]] : [process.execPath, a];
  const c = spawn(cmd, cargs, { stdio: ['ignore', log, log], env: { ...process.env, ORTHROS_JIT_DEFAULTS: j.v.json } });
  c.on('exit', (code) => { fs.closeSync(log); resolve(code); });
}));
console.log(`${jobs.length} runs in ${dir}`);
await Promise.all(started);

const byPhase = new Map(); // label -> variant -> [{ ns, cpuMsPerFrame, insns }]
for (const j of jobs) {
  let res; try { res = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, j.name + '.json'), 'utf8')); } catch { console.log(`${j.name}: no phases (see ${path.join(dir, j.name + '.log')})`); continue; }
  for (const p of res) {
    if (!byPhase.has(p.label)) byPhase.set(p.label, new Map());
    const m = byPhase.get(p.label); if (!m.has(j.v.name)) m.set(j.v.name, []);
    m.get(j.v.name).push({ ns: p.guestMsPerMInsn, cpuMsPerFrame: p.frames ? (p.threadCpuS ?? p.cpuS) * 1000 / p.frames : 0, insns: p.guestInsns });
  }
}
const mean = (l) => l.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0) / Math.max(1, l.length);
for (const [label, m] of byPhase) {
  console.log(`phase ${label}`);
  const base = m.get(variants[0].name);
  for (const v of variants) {
    const l = m.get(v.name); if (!l) continue;
    const ns = mean(l.map((x) => x.ns)), cpu = mean(l.map((x) => x.cpuMsPerFrame));
    const d = base && v !== variants[0] ? ` (${(100 * (ns / mean(base.map((x) => x.ns)) - 1)).toFixed(1)} %, CPU per frame ${(100 * (cpu / mean(base.map((x) => x.cpuMsPerFrame)) - 1)).toFixed(1)} %)` : '';
    console.log(`  ${v.name.padEnd(10)} guest ${ns.toFixed(3)} ns per instruction [${l.map((x) => x.ns.toFixed(3)).join(' ')}], thread CPU ${cpu.toFixed(2)} ms per frame [${l.map((x) => x.cpuMsPerFrame.toFixed(2)).join(' ')}], ${l.map((x) => (x.insns / 1e6).toFixed(0)).join('/')} M instructions${d}`);
  }
}

// --perf: the [JIT] object's and the process's samples per event (perf report --sort dso), in G events
if (perf) {
  const counts = new Map(); // variant -> [{ jitI, jitC, allI, allC }]
  for (const j of jobs) {
    const f = path.join(dir, j.name + '.perf');
    const r = spawnSync('perf', ['report', '-i', f, '--sort', 'dso', '-n', '--stdio'], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1 << 26 });
    if (!opt('keep')) fs.rmSync(f, { force: true });
    const e = { jitI: 0, jitC: 0, allI: 0, allC: 0 };
    let ev = null;
    for (const line of (r.stdout ?? '').split('\n')) {
      const h = /^# Samples: .* of event '(\w+):u'/.exec(line); if (h) { ev = h[1]; continue; }
      const m = /^\s+[\d.]+%\s+(\d+)\s+(.*)$/.exec(line); if (!m || !ev) continue;
      const n = Number(m[1]) / 1000; // (one sample per 10^6 events: G events)
      if (ev === 'instructions') { e.allI += n; if (m[2].startsWith('[JIT]')) e.jitI += n; } else if (ev === 'cycles') { e.allC += n; if (m[2].startsWith('[JIT]')) e.jitC += n; }
    }
    if (!counts.has(j.v.name)) counts.set(j.v.name, []);
    counts.get(j.v.name).push(e);
  }
  const b = counts.get(variants[0].name);
  const pct = (x, k) => (b && x !== b ? ` (${(100 * (mean(x.map((y) => y[k])) / mean(b.map((y) => y[k])) - 1)).toFixed(2)} %)` : '');
  console.log('perf (whole run, G user events; JIT: perf\'s [JIT] object)');
  for (const v of variants) {
    const l = counts.get(v.name); if (!l) continue;
    const f = (k) => `${mean(l.map((y) => y[k])).toFixed(2)} [${l.map((y) => y[k].toFixed(2)).join(' ')}]${pct(l, k)}`;
    console.log(`  ${v.name.padEnd(10)} JIT instructions ${f('jitI')}, JIT cycles ${f('jitC')}; process instructions ${f('allI')}, cycles ${f('allC')}`);
  }
}
```

`tools/apicall-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// API dispatch microbenchmark: runs build/pe/apibench.exe (tools/pe/apibench.c) under the JIT and reports the time
// per API call handled in JavaScript (guest code -> region exit -> dispatcher -> handler -> back into translated
// code), a round trip play-time code pays tens of thousands of times per second.
// Usage: node tools/apicall-bench.mjs [--runs 5] [--src <dir with core/, cpu/...>]
//   --src: import the emulator from another source tree (e.g. a checkout of the previous commit: before/after)
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const argOf = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf(k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const RUNS = +argOf('--runs', 5);
const SRC = path.resolve(argOf('--src', new URL('../src', import.meta.url).pathname));
const imp = (p) => import(pathToFileURL(path.join(SRC, p)).href);
const { Vm } = await imp('core/vm.js');
const { Vfs, MemBackend } = await imp('vfs/vfs.js');
const { RealClock } = await imp('core/clock.js');
const { HeadlessHost } = await imp('host/display.js');
const PE = new URL('../build/pe/apibench.exe', import.meta.url).pathname;
const CALLS = 1000000;

function runOnce() {
  const vfs = new Vfs();
  const t = new MemBackend();
  vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend());
  vfs.mount('C:\\Test', t);
  t.open('apibench.exe', { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(PE));
  const clock = new RealClock();
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host: new HeadlessHost({ clock }), jit: true, logKinds: ['warn', 'crash'] });
  vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\apibench.exe' });
  const marks = [];
  const dispatch = vm.dispatchThunk.bind(vm);
  vm.dispatchThunk = (th, i) => { if (vm.api.thunk(i)?.name === 'GetCommandLineA') marks.push(performance.now()); return dispatch(th, i); };
  const code = vm.run();
  if (code !== 0 || marks.length !== 2) throw new Error(`apibench.exe: exit code ${code}, ${marks.length} marks`);
  return { call: (marks[1] - marks[0]) * 1e6 / CALLS };
}

const res = [];
for (let r = 0; r < RUNS; r++) res.push(runOnce());
const stat = (k) => { const v = res.map((x) => x[k]).sort((a, b) => a - b); return `${v[v.length >> 1].toFixed(0)} ns (min ${v[0].toFixed(0)}, max ${v[v.length - 1].toFixed(0)})`; };
console.log(`API call handled in JavaScript: ${stat('call')}`);

```

`tools/audio-units.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// What the audio units save (docs/slow-network.md "Audio units"): for each manifest with a learned order, the units of
// its launch set (as a link that is not fast reads it) and of its whole order (as a fast one does) that hold PCM sound —
// RIFF WAVE sound in a file or an archive, a raw bank by trial (src/host/pcm-units.js) —, their brotli-11 bytes (the
// precompressed units', br-cache.js) and the audio form's (src/vfs/pcm-codec.js, brotli on top, kept when ≤ 0.95 of
// brotli's, as the generator does); every container decoded and compared. Brotli 11 costs ~3 s of a core per MiB: run
// it niced; results are kept per unit in --cache (default /tmp/orthros-scratch/audio-units/units.json) between runs.
//
// Usage: nice -n 19 node tools/audio-units.mjs --learn <copy of the learn dir> [--games-dir data/games/] [--only <regex>]
//   [--cache <file>]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';
import { createServer } from '../src/host/server.js';
import { HttpBackend, BLOCK, CHUNK } from '../src/vfs/http-backend.js';
import { launchSet, forLink, entryPieces } from '../src/vfs/launch-set.js';
import { loadGameCatalog, DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR } from '../src/host/game-catalog.js';
import { resolveGameFile } from '../src/host/game-files.js';
import { LIGHT_DIR } from '../src/vfs/game-tree.js';
import { scanWaves, regionsIn, trialRegion, PCM_SHARE_MIN } from '../src/host/pcm-units.js';
import { encodePcm, decodePcm, pcmCodedBytes } from '../src/vfs/pcm-codec.js';
import { PCM_MIN_GAIN } from '../src/host/br-cache.js';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const arg = (n, d) => { const i = args.indexOf(n); return i < 0 ? d : args[i + 1]; };
const learnDir = arg('--learn'), gamesDir = path.resolve(arg('--games-dir', DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR)), only = arg('--only') ? new RegExp(arg('--only')) : null;
const cachePath = arg('--cache', '/tmp/orthros-scratch/audio-units/units.json');
if (!learnDir) { console.error('usage: node tools/audio-units.mjs --learn <learn dir copy> [--games-dir dir] [--only regex] [--cache file]'); process.exit(2); }

const catalog = loadGameCatalog(gamesDir);
const srv = createServer({ learnDir: path.resolve(learnDir), gamesDir });
await new Promise((r) => srv.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${srv.address().port}`;
const orders = {};
for (const { name } of await (await fetch(base + '/api/manifests')).json()) {
  if (only && !only.test(name)) continue;
  const list = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/prefetch/${name}`)).json().catch(() => null);
  if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) orders[name] = [list, await (await fetch(`${base}/api/tree/${name}`)).json()];
}
srv.close();

const br11 = (b) => zlib.brotliCompressSync(b, { params: { [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_QUALITY]: 11, [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_LGWIN]: b.length > 1 << 18 ? 22 : 18, [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_SIZE_HINT]: b.length } }).length;
const cache = fs.existsSync(cachePath) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(cachePath, 'utf8')) : {};
const waves = new Map();
/** { raw, br, pcm, trial, decMs } of a unit holding sound, or null */
function unitOf(f, size, kind, index) {
  const st = fs.statSync(f), k = `${f}|${st.size}|${st.mtimeMs}|${kind}${index}`;
  if (k in cache) return cache[k];
  let w = waves.get(f); if (!w) waves.set(f, w = scanWaves(f));
  const n = kind === 'b' ? BLOCK : CHUNK, start = index * n, end = Math.min(size, start + n);
  const buf = Buffer.alloc(end - start), fd = fs.openSync(f, 'r'); fs.readSync(fd, buf, 0, buf.length, start); fs.closeSync(fd);
  const u = new Uint8Array(buf.buffer, buf.byteOffset, buf.length);
  // (as the generator: the file's sounds, else a trial against the brotli unit's bytes; brotli measured first)
  let regions = regionsIn(w, start, end), trial = false, v = null, b = null;
  if (!w.length) { b = Math.min(br11(u), u.length); const t = trialRegion(u, b); if (t) { regions = [t]; trial = true; } }
  if (regions.reduce((a, r) => a + r.len, 0) >= u.length * PCM_SHARE_MIN) {
    const c = encodePcm(u, regions);
    if (pcmCodedBytes(c)) {
      const t0 = performance.now(), d = decodePcm(c), decMs = performance.now() - t0;
      if (!Buffer.from(d.buffer, d.byteOffset, d.length).equals(buf)) throw new Error(`round trip differs: ${k}`);
      b ??= Math.min(br11(u), u.length);
      v = { raw: u.length, br: b, pcm: Math.min(c.length, br11(c)), trial, decMs };
    }
  }
  cache[k] = v;
  return v;
}

const mb = (n) => (n / 1e6).toFixed(2);
for (const [name, [list, tree]] of Object.entries(orders)) {
  const man = catalog.get(name), files = new HttpBackend(`/game/${name}/`, tree), out = {};
  for (const [kind, set, fast] of [['launch', launchSet(files, list, false), false], ['order', forLink(files, list, true), true]]) {
    const t = { raw: 0, br: 0, pcm: 0, units: 0, trial: 0, decMs: 0 };
    for (const e of set) {
      const p = entryPieces(files, e); if (!p || p.path.startsWith(LIGHT_DIR + '/')) continue;
      const f = resolveGameFile(man, p.path); if (!f) continue;
      // (the units the reader asks: a block learned whole — or any block on a fast link —, else its learned pieces)
      for (const [k, i] of fast || p.whole ? [['b', p.block]] : p.pieces.map((c) => ['p', c])) {
        const v = unitOf(f, p.size, k, i);
        if (!v || v.pcm > v.br * PCM_MIN_GAIN) continue;
        t.raw += v.raw; t.br += v.br; t.pcm += v.pcm; t.units++; if (v.trial) t.trial++; t.decMs += v.decMs;
      }
    }
    out[kind] = t;
  }
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(cachePath), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(cachePath, JSON.stringify(cache));
  for (const [kind, t] of Object.entries(out)) console.log(`${name} ${kind}: ${t.units} units (${t.trial} by trial), ${mb(t.raw)} MB of file bytes, brotli-11 ${mb(t.br)} MB → audio ${mb(t.pcm)} MB (−${mb(t.br - t.pcm)} MB, ${t.br ? ((1 - t.pcm / t.br) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0.0'} %), decoded in ${t.decMs.toFixed(0)} ms`);
}
process.exit(0);

```

`tools/backend-draw-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
// Per-draw cost of the Direct3D work on the thread that does it, without a GPU: frames shaped like the games' — a
// Direct3D 9 shader scene (vertex / pixel shaders, effect-style constants, a texture and a stream per draw, a few render
// states, a dynamic vertex buffer refilled before every third draw) and a Direct3D 8 fixed-function one (world matrix, material, lights, texture stages per draw) — run through
// the Direct3D layer alone ("none"), the WebGL backend over a no-op WebGL2 context ("backend": the in-thread path, or
// what the render worker does), and the render worker's recorder with its commands dropped ("recorder": what the
// emulator thread does with ?glworker=1). Prints µs per draw (the Direct3D layer's own share included in each).
// Usage: node tools/backend-draw-bench.mjs [d3d9 | d3d8 | both] [draws per frame (300)] [frames (200)]
//        node --cpu-prof tools/backend-draw-bench.mjs d3d9 300 2000 backend   (one variant, for a profile)
// (ROUNDS=n rounds of each variant, alternated; the fastest of each after the first is reported)
import { d3dEnv } from '../tests/d3d-random.js';
import { WebGLDevice } from '../src/gfx/d3d8-webgl.js';
import { RenderLink, Recorder } from '../src/gfx/d3d-recorder.js';
import { Replayer } from '../src/gfx/d3d-mirror.js';
import { noopGl } from './noop-gl.mjs';

const ROUNDS = Number(process.env.ROUNDS ?? 7);
const which = process.argv[2] ?? 'both', DRAWS = Number(process.argv[3] ?? 300), FRAMES = Number(process.argv[4] ?? 200), only = process.argv[5] ?? null;


// vs_2_0: m4x4 oPos, v0, c0; mov oT0, v1 — ps_2_0: texld r0, t0, s0; mul r0, r0, c0; mov oC0, r0
const VS20 = [0xfffe0200, 0x0200001f, 0x80000000, 0x900f0000, 0x0200001f, 0x80000005, 0x900f0001, 0x03000009, 0xc0010000, 0x90e40000, 0xa0e40000, 0x03000009, 0xc0020000, 0x90e40000, 0xa0e40001, 0x03000009, 0xc0040000, 0x90e40000, 0xa0e40002, 0x03000009, 0xc0080000, 0x90e40000, 0xa0e40003, 0x02000001, 0xe00f0000, 0x90e40001, 0xffff];
const PS20 = [0xffff0200, 0x0200001f, 0x80000000, 0xb00f0000, 0x0200001f, 0x90000000, 0xa00f0800, 0x03000042, 0x800f0000, 0xb0e40000, 0xa0e40800, 0x03000005, 0x800f0000, 0x80e40000, 0xa0e40000, 0x02000001, 0x800f0800, 0x80e40000, 0xffff];

function session(api9, gfx) {
  const E = d3dEnv(gfx), { mem, ctx, com } = E;
  const out = E.alloc(64), scratch = E.alloc(4096);
  const pp = E.alloc(64);
  let dev, devPtr;
  if (api9) {
    [1024, 768, 22, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 75, 0, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(pp + 4 * i, v));
    const d3d = E.defs.Direct3DCreate9[1](ctx([32]));
    com.implAt(d3d).CreateDevice(ctx([d3d, 0, 1, 0, 0x40, pp, out]));
  } else {
    [1024, 768, 22, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 75, 0, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(pp + 4 * i, v));
    const d3d = E.defs.Direct3DCreate8[1](ctx([220]));
    com.implAt(d3d).CreateDevice(ctx([d3d, 0, 1, 0, 0x40, pp, out]));
  }
  devPtr = mem.read32(out); dev = com.implAt(devPtr);
  const c = ctx([devPtr]), call = (name, ...a) => { const A = c.args; for (let i = 1; i < 9; i++) A[i] = a[i - 1] ?? 0; return dev[name](c); };
  const words = (a) => { a.forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(scratch + 4 * i, v)); return scratch; };
  const tex = [], vbs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) { call('CreateTexture', 64, 64, 1, 0, 21, 1, out); tex.push(mem.read32(out)); }
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { if (api9) call('CreateVertexBuffer', 65536, 0x8, 0, 1, out); else call('CreateVertexBuffer', 65536, 0x8, 0x152, 1, out); vbs.push(mem.read32(out)); }
  // a dynamic buffer refilled (DISCARD) before every third draw, as games stream particles and interface quads
  if (api9) call('CreateVertexBuffer', 65536, 0x208, 0, 0, out); else call('CreateVertexBuffer', 65536, 0x208, 0x152, 0, out);
  const dyn = mem.read32(out), dynObj = com.implAt(dyn), dynCtx = ctx([dyn]);
  const refill = (k) => {
    const A = dynCtx.args; A[1] = 0; A[2] = 1280; A[3] = out; A[4] = 0x2000; dynObj.Lock(dynCtx);
    const p = mem.read32(out); for (let i = 0; i < 320; i++) mem.write32(p + 4 * i, k + i);
    dynObj.Unlock(dynCtx);
  };
  const ibs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { if (api9) call('CreateIndexBuffer', 65536, 0x8, 101, 1, out); else call('CreateIndexBuffer', 65536, 0x8, 101, 1, out); ibs.push(mem.read32(out)); }
  const consts = E.alloc(4096);
  for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) mem.writeF32(consts + 4 * i, i * 0.125);
  let shaders = [];
  if (api9) {
    const vsc = E.alloc(4 * VS20.length), psc = E.alloc(4 * PS20.length);
    VS20.forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(vsc + 4 * i, v)); PS20.forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(psc + 4 * i, v));
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { call('CreateVertexShader', vsc, out); const vs = mem.read32(out); call('CreatePixelShader', psc, out); shaders.push([vs, mem.read32(out)]); }
    // position float3, texcoord float2 (two declarations of the same elements, as games create per mesh)
    const el = E.alloc(64); [0x00000000, 0x00000002, 0x000c0000, 0x00050001, 0x000000ff, 0x00000011].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(el + 4 * i, v));
    call('CreateVertexDeclaration', el, out); const d1 = mem.read32(out); call('CreateVertexDeclaration', el, out); shaders.decls = [d1, mem.read32(out)];
  } else {
    // two directional lights, a material
    const L = E.alloc(128); for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) mem.writeF32(L + 4 * i, 0.5); mem.write32(L, 3);
    call('SetLight', 0, L); call('SetLight', 1, L); call('LightEnable', 0, 1); call('LightEnable', 1, 1); call('SetRenderState', 137, 1);
    shaders.light = L;
  }
  const mat = E.alloc(128), m4 = E.alloc(64);
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) mem.writeF32(m4 + 4 * i, i === 0 || i === 5 || i === 10 || i === 15 ? 1 : 0);
  call('SetTransform', 2, m4); call('SetTransform', 3, m4);
  let k = 0;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  for (let f = 0; f < FRAMES; f++) {
    call('BeginScene');
    for (let d = 0; d < DRAWS; d++, k++) {
      if (api9) {
        if (k % 10 === 0) { const s = shaders[(k / 10) % 3 | 0]; call('SetVertexShader', s[0]); call('SetPixelShader', s[1]); call('SetVertexDeclaration', shaders.decls[(k / 10) & 1]); }
        mem.writeF32(consts, k * 0.01); call('SetVertexShaderConstantF', 0, consts, 4); call('SetVertexShaderConstantF', 4, consts + 64, 8);
        if ((k & 3) === 0) call('SetPixelShaderConstantF', 0, consts + 16 * (k & 7), 2);
        call('SetTexture', 0, tex[k % tex.length]); if (k % 3 === 0) call('SetTexture', 1, tex[(k * 7) % tex.length]);
        call('SetSamplerState', 0, 5, 2); call('SetSamplerState', 0, 6, 2); call('SetSamplerState', 0, 1, 1 + ((k >> 4) & 1));
        if ((k & 7) === 0) { call('SetRenderState', 27, (k >> 3) & 1); call('SetRenderState', 14, ((k >> 4) & 1)); call('SetRenderState', 22, 2 + ((k >> 5) & 1)); }
        if (k % 3 === 0) { refill(k); call('SetStreamSource', 0, dyn, 0, 20); } else call('SetStreamSource', 0, vbs[k % vbs.length], 0, 20);
        if ((k & 7) === 0) call('SetIndices', ibs[(k >> 3) % ibs.length]);
        call('DrawIndexedPrimitive', 4, 0, 0, 100, 0, 50);
      } else {
        mem.writeF32(m4 + 48, k * 0.01); call('SetTransform', 256, m4);
        if (k & 1) { for (let i = 0; i < 17; i++) mem.writeF32(mat + 4 * i, ((k >> 1) & 3) * 0.25); call('SetMaterial', mat); }
        call('SetTexture', 0, tex[k % tex.length]);
        if (k % 5 === 0) { call('SetTextureStageState', 0, 1, 4 + ((k / 5) & 1)); call('SetTextureStageState', 0, 4, 4); }
        if ((k & 7) === 0) { call('SetRenderState', 27, (k >> 3) & 1); call('SetRenderState', 14, ((k >> 4) & 1)); }
        if (k % 3 === 0) { refill(k); call('SetStreamSource', 0, dyn, 36); } else call('SetStreamSource', 0, vbs[k % vbs.length], 36);
        call('SetIndices', ibs[k % ibs.length], 0);
        call('DrawIndexedPrimitive', 4, 0, 100, 0, 50);
      }
    }
    call('EndScene'); call('Present', 0, 0, 0, 0);
  }
  return performance.now() - t0;
}

const variants = {
  none: () => ({ createDevice: () => null }),
  backend: () => { const gl = noopGl(); return { createDevice: (dev) => new WebGLDevice(gl, dev, {}) }; },
  recorder: () => {
    const words = new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4 << 20)); // (shared, as the render worker's ring)
    const link = new RenderLink({ words, replayer: { reader: { consumed: 0 }, run() { this.reader.consumed = link.w.produced; } } });
    link.drain = function () { this.w.consumed = this.replayer.reader.consumed = this.w.produced; };
    return { createDevice: (dev) => new Recorder(link, dev) };
  },
  // (recorded, then replayed on this thread into a mirror whose backend draws over the no-op context: minus "recorder",
  // the render worker's work per draw)
  replay: () => {
    const words = new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4 << 20)), gl = noopGl();
    let mem = null;
    const replayer = new Replayer(words, { get mem() { return mem; }, ack: null, createBackend: (m) => new WebGLDevice(gl, m, {}) });
    const link = new RenderLink({ words, replayer });
    return { createDevice: (dev) => { mem = dev.proc.mem; replayer.mem = mem; return new Recorder(link, dev); } };
  },
};
const per = (ms) => ms * 1000 / (DRAWS * FRAMES);
for (const api9 of which === 'both' ? [true, false] : [which === 'd3d9']) {
  const names = only ? [only] : Object.keys(variants);
  const res = new Map(names.map((n) => [n, []]));
  for (let r = 0; r < (only ? 1 : ROUNDS); r++) for (const n of names) res.get(n).push(per(session(api9, variants[n]())));
  // (the first round warms the code up; of the others the fastest: on a shared machine the slower rounds measure its load)
  const mean = (a) => Math.min(...(a.length > 1 ? a.slice(1) : a));
  console.log(`${api9 ? 'Direct3D 9 shader scene' : 'Direct3D 8 fixed-function scene'}, ${DRAWS} draws x ${FRAMES} frames: ` + names.map((n) => `${n} ${mean(res.get(n)).toFixed(2)} us/draw [${res.get(n).map((x) => x.toFixed(2)).join(' ')}]`).join('; '));
  if (!only) console.log(`  backend adds ${(mean(res.get('backend')) - mean(res.get('none'))).toFixed(2)} us/draw, recorder adds ${(mean(res.get('recorder')) - mean(res.get('none'))).toFixed(2)} us/draw`);
}

```

`tools/backup.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Orthros backups (docs/backups.md): restic snapshots of everything here that is not disposable — data/ (games,
# engines, installers, Wine prefix, corpus, proofs), backups/manual/, the Git repository with its unpushed commits and
# branches, the local notes (CLAUDE.md, DECISIONS.md, STATUS.md), the working tree's uncommitted changes — and of the
# live services' state in /var/lib, into backups/restic/. Content-addressed and deduplicated: a file is stored once,
# whatever the number of snapshots holding it; a snapshot costs what changed since the last one.
#
# Usage (as root): tools/backup.sh <command> [...]
#   setup                      once: the password, the repository, the nightly timer (run again: nothing redone)
#   snapshot [-m <note>]       a snapshot now (tag manual: never forgotten); the note is a tag too
#   daily                      the timer's run: a snapshot (tag daily), then the retention policy
#   list                       the snapshots
#   diff <a> <b>               what changed between two snapshots (ids, or latest)
#   find <pattern>             the snapshots holding files whose name matches (a deleted file's history)
#   ls <snapshot> <path>       the files under <path> in a snapshot
#   restore <snapshot> <path> [--to <dir>] [--yes]
#                              <path> (file or folder, absolute or relative) as it was in the snapshot: in place — the
#                              current state snapshotted first (tag pre-restore), files added since removed, asked first
#                              unless --yes —, or copied to <dir>/<absolute path> with --to (nothing in place touched)
#   mount [<dir>]              every snapshot browsable as plain files (FUSE; default backups/mnt; Ctrl-C unmounts)
#   check [--full]             the repository's integrity (its structure and 1 % of the data, or all of the data)
#   forget                     the retention policy alone
#   restic <args...>           any other restic command on this repository
set -euo pipefail

ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")/.." && pwd)
export RESTIC_REPOSITORY=${ORTHROS_RESTIC_REPOSITORY:-$ROOT/backups/restic}
export RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE=${ORTHROS_RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE:-$ROOT/backups/restic-password}
export RESTIC_CACHE_DIR=${RESTIC_CACHE_DIR:-$ROOT/backups/cache}
export GOMAXPROCS=${GOMAXPROCS:-4} # (a shared server: restic's hashing and compression on 4 cores at most)
HOST=orthros                       # (one name whatever the machine's: the retention and the parent snapshot by it)

# What a snapshot holds. The repository's folder is whole but for the disposable (build/, node_modules/, generated
# tests, agent worktrees) and the backups themselves; the services' state but for caches remade on demand and the
# linked game trees their runners rebuild at each start.
SOURCES=("$ROOT" /var/lib/private/orthros2 /var/lib/private/orthros-goldsrc /var/lib/orthros-openmw /etc/orthros-openmw.env
  /etc/systemd/system/orthros.service /etc/systemd/system/orthros-snapshot-jobs.service
  /etc/systemd/system/orthros-goldsrc@.service /etc/systemd/system/orthros-openmw@.service
  /etc/systemd/system/orthros-backup.service /etc/systemd/system/orthros-backup.timer)
EXCLUDES=("$ROOT/build" "$ROOT/node_modules" "$ROOT/tests/generated" "$ROOT/.claude/worktrees"
  "$ROOT/backups/restic" "$ROOT/backups/cache" "$ROOT/backups/mnt" "$ROOT/backups/restore-*" "$ROOT/backups/restic-password"
  /var/lib/private/orthros2/brcache /var/lib/private/orthros2/covers
  '/var/lib/private/orthros-goldsrc/*/game' '/var/lib/orthros-openmw/*/gamedata')
# Retention: every snapshot of the last 14 days, then one a week for 8 weeks, one a month for 2 years; the manual ones
# and those taken before a restore, always.
KEEP=(--keep-daily 14 --keep-weekly 8 --keep-monthly 24 --keep-tag manual --keep-tag pre-restore)

die() { echo "backup: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
need_root() { [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || die "run as root (the services' state is readable by root only)"; }
need_repo() { [ -f "$RESTIC_REPOSITORY/config" ] || die "no repository in $RESTIC_REPOSITORY: tools/backup.sh setup"; }

snapshot() { # <tag> [note]
  local tag=$1 note=${2:-} src args=()
  for src in "${SOURCES[@]}"; do [ -e "$src" ] && args+=("$src"); done
  for src in "${EXCLUDES[@]}"; do args+=(--exclude "$src"); done
  args+=(--host "$HOST" --tag "$tag")
  [ -n "$note" ] && args+=(--tag "note:${note//,/;}")
  # (exit 3: some files unreadable — gone while read, say — and the snapshot saved without them)
  nice -n 10 ionice -c 3 restic backup "${args[@]}" || { local rc=$?; [ $rc = 3 ] || return $rc; echo "backup: snapshot saved, some files unreadable (above)" >&2; }
}

# (restic 0.16's diff takes ids only: latest made the newest snapshot's)
snap_id() {
  if [ "$1" = latest ]; then
    restic snapshots --host "$HOST" --json | python3 -c 'import json, sys; s = json.load(sys.stdin); print(max(s, key=lambda x: x["time"])["id"] if s else "")'
  else echo "$1"; fi
}

forget() { restic forget --host "$HOST" --group-by host "${KEEP[@]}" --prune; }

restore() { # <snapshot> <path> [--to <dir>] [--yes]
  [ $# -ge 2 ] || die "usage: restore <snapshot> <path> [--to <dir>] [--yes]"
  local snap=$1 target to='' yes=0 src
  target=$(realpath -m "$2"); shift 2
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case $1 in --to) to=$(realpath -m "$2"); shift 2 ;; --yes) yes=1; shift ;; *) die "restore: unknown option $1" ;; esac
  done
  if [ -n "$to" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$to"
    restic restore "$snap" --target "$to" --include "$target"
    [ -e "$to$target" ] || [ -L "$to$target" ] || die "$target: not in snapshot $snap"
    echo "restored to $to$target"; return
  fi
  # (staged beside the data, the same disk: a whole game restored without crossing disks, then synchronized)
  STAGE="$ROOT/backups/restore-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
  trap 'rm -rf "$STAGE"' EXIT
  restic restore "$snap" --target "$STAGE" --include "$target"
  src="$STAGE$target"
  [ -e "$src" ] || [ -L "$src" ] || die "$target: not in snapshot $snap"
  local from=$src into=$target
  if [ -d "$src" ] && [ ! -L "$src" ]; then from="$src/"; into="$target/"; fi
  local changes
  changes=$(rsync -aHAX --delete --dry-run --itemize-changes "$from" "$into" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -e "$target" ] && [ -z "$changes" ]; then echo "$target: already as in snapshot $snap"; return; fi
  echo "$target will be as in snapshot $snap — $(printf '%s\n' "$changes" | grep -c . || true) change(s):"
  printf '%s\n' "$changes" | head -20
  if [ "$yes" != 1 ]; then
    [ -t 0 ] || die "in place without --yes needs a terminal (or --to <dir> for a copy)"
    read -r -p "Replace? [y/N] " answer; [ "$answer" = y ] || [ "$answer" = o ] || die "nothing changed"
  fi
  snapshot pre-restore "before restoring $target from $snap"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"
  rsync -aHAX --delete "$from" "$into"
  echo "$target restored from snapshot $snap (the state before: the newest snapshot tagged pre-restore)"
}

setup() {
  mkdir -p "$ROOT/backups/manual"; chmod 700 "$ROOT/backups"
  if [ ! -s "$RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE" ]; then
    (umask 077; openssl rand -base64 33 > "$RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE")
    echo "password written to $RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE (keep a copy elsewhere: without it the snapshots are unreadable)"
  fi
  [ -f "$RESTIC_REPOSITORY/config" ] || restic init
  cat > /etc/systemd/system/orthros-backup.service <<EOF
# Written by $ROOT/tools/backup.sh setup (docs/backups.md)
[Unit]
Description=Orthros nightly restic snapshot (docs/backups.md)
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=$ROOT/tools/backup.sh daily
Nice=19
IOSchedulingClass=idle
CPUSchedulingPolicy=batch
Environment=GOMAXPROCS=4
EOF
  cat > /etc/systemd/system/orthros-backup.timer <<EOF
# Written by $ROOT/tools/backup.sh setup (docs/backups.md)
[Unit]
Description=Orthros nightly restic snapshot (docs/backups.md)

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 04:40:00
RandomizedDelaySec=15min
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF
  systemctl daemon-reload
  systemctl enable --now orthros-backup.timer
  systemctl list-timers orthros-backup.timer --no-pager
}

cmd=${1:-}; [ $# -gt 0 ] && shift
case $cmd in
  setup) need_root; setup ;;
  snapshot)
    need_root; need_repo; note=''
    while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do case $1 in -m) note=$2; shift 2 ;; *) die "snapshot: unknown option $1" ;; esac; done
    snapshot manual "$note" ;;
  daily) need_root; need_repo; snapshot daily; forget ;;
  list) need_repo; restic snapshots --host "$HOST" ;;
  diff) need_repo; [ $# -eq 2 ] || die "usage: diff <a> <b>"; restic diff "$(snap_id "$1")" "$(snap_id "$2")" ;;
  find) need_repo; [ $# -ge 1 ] || die "usage: find <pattern>"; restic find --host "$HOST" "$@" ;;
  ls) need_repo; [ $# -eq 2 ] || die "usage: ls <snapshot> <path>"; restic ls --recursive "$1" "$(realpath -m "$2")" ;;
  restore) need_root; need_repo; restore "$@" ;;
  mount) need_repo; dir=${1:-$ROOT/backups/mnt}; mkdir -p "$dir"; echo "snapshots under $dir/snapshots/ (Ctrl-C to unmount)"; restic mount "$dir" ;;
  check) need_repo; if [ "${1:-}" = --full ]; then restic check --read-data; else restic check --read-data-subset=1%; fi ;;
  forget) need_root; need_repo; forget ;;
  restic) need_repo; restic "$@" ;;
  *) sed -n '2,/^set -euo/p' "$0" | sed '$d; s/^# \{0,1\}//'; [ -z "$cmd" ] || exit 2 ;;
esac

```

```mjs
// owner runs it: a fresh browser (no profile: every game's first launch) opens /?benchsuite=<suite> on a running Orthros

} finally { await browser.close(); }
```

`tools/bench.mjs`:

```mjs
// CPU benchmark harness: runs build/pe/bench.exe under the interpreter and under the JIT and
// reports host wall time per phase. Usage: node tools/bench.mjs [interp|jit|both]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { Vfs, MemBackend } from '../src/vfs/vfs.js';
import { RealClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';

const which = process.argv[2] ?? 'both';
const PE = new URL('../build/pe/bench.exe', import.meta.url).pathname;

function runOnce(useJit) {
  const vfs = new Vfs();
  const t = new MemBackend();
  vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend());
  vfs.mount('C:\\Test', t);
  t.open('bench.exe', { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(PE));
  const clock = new RealClock();
  const host = new HeadlessHost({ clock });
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host, jit: useJit, logKinds: ['warn', 'crash'] });
  vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\bench.exe' });
  const lines = [];
  vm.onStdout = (s) => lines.push(s);
  const t0 = performance.now();
  vm.run();
  const total = performance.now() - t0;
  const out = lines.join('');
  const ms = [...out.matchAll(/ms 0x([0-9a-f]+)/g)].map((m) => parseInt(m[1], 16));
  const sums = [...out.matchAll(/^(\w+) 0x([0-9a-f]+)$/gm)].filter((m) => m[1] !== 'ms').map((m) => `${m[1]}=${m[2]}`);
  return { total, ms, sums, stats: useJit ? vm.jit.stats : null, icount: vm.interp.icount };
}

const results = {};
if (which !== 'jit') { results.interp = runOnce(false); console.log('interp:', Math.round(results.interp.total), 'ms; phases', results.interp.ms.join('/'), 'ms;', results.interp.sums.join(' ')); }
if (which !== 'interp') { results.jit = runOnce(true); console.log('jit   :', Math.round(results.jit.total), 'ms; phases', results.jit.ms.join('/'), 'ms;', results.jit.sums.join(' ')); console.log('jit stats:', JSON.stringify(results.jit.stats)); }
if (results.interp && results.jit) {
  const names = ['int', 'sieve', 'memory', 'string', 'fpu', 'sse', 'trans'];
  console.log('speedup total: ' + (results.interp.total / results.jit.total).toFixed(1) + 'x; per phase: ' + names.map((n, i) => `${n} ${(results.interp.ms[i] / Math.max(results.jit.ms[i], 1)).toFixed(1)}x`).join(', '));
  if (results.interp.sums.join() !== results.jit.sums.join()) console.log('CHECKSUM MISMATCH');
}
```

`tools/call-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// CALL / RET microbenchmark: ns per iteration of small loops calling functions. In the first cases the callees are
// separate regions (their entries are region boundaries, as a function reached from several regions, through a
// pointer or past the caller's region size is in real code), so every call and every return is a region-to-region
// transition; in the last ones the callees are part of the caller's region (calls are jumps, returns compare the
// return address with the region's call sites, see translate.js regionRetSites):
//   1 site      one call site, one leaf callee (chain-bench's loop)
//   8 sites     one leaf callee called from 8 sites of one loop body (its returns go to 8 places in turn)
//   random site one of 8 call sites chosen by a pseudo-random number (the return target is unpredictable)
//   indirect    call [table + index] among 4 leaf functions chosen pseudo-randomly
//   nested      a callee calling a second-level leaf twice (calls two deep)
//   recursion   recursive function, depth 40 per iteration
//   20 inlined  20 calls of a leaf included in the caller's region (the returns are local jumps)
//   helpers     a function called through a pointer, calling two helpers of its region 5 times each
//   4x5 helpers the same with four helpers (20 call sites in the region)
// Usage: node tools/call-bench.mjs [iterations] [--runs 7] [--src <dir with cpu/>] [--case <substring>] [--opts <json>]
//   --src: import the emulator from another source tree (a checkout of the previous commit: before/after in one session)
//   --opts: extra Jit options (JSON, e.g. '{"countChains":false}' as in the VM)
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import path from 'node:path';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const argOf = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf(k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const N = +(args.find((a, i) => !a.startsWith('--') && !(i > 0 && args[i - 1].startsWith('--'))) ?? 2e6);
const RUNS = +argOf('--runs', 7);
const SRC = path.resolve(argOf('--src', new URL('../src', import.meta.url).pathname));
const ONLY = argOf('--case', null);
const JOPTS = JSON.parse(argOf('--opts', '{}'));
const imp = (p) => import(pathToFileURL(path.join(SRC, p)).href);
const { GuestMemory } = await imp('cpu/memory.js');
const { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } = await imp('cpu/state.js');
const { Interp } = await imp('cpu/interp.js');
await imp('cpu/interp-x87.js');
const { Jit } = await imp('cpu/jit/jit.js');

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];

/** Minimal assembler: raw bytes, labels, rel32 fixups; `fn` marks a label as a region boundary. */
class Asm {
  constructor() { this.b = []; this.labels = new Map(); this.fix = []; this.bounds = []; }
  get pc() { return this.b.length; }
  raw(...x) { this.b.push(...x); return this; }
  label(n) { this.labels.set(n, this.pc); return this; }
  fn(n) { while (this.pc % 16) this.b.push(0x90); this.bounds.push(n); return this.label(n); }
  rel(op, n) { this.b.push(...op); this.fix.push([this.pc, n]); this.b.push(0, 0, 0, 0); return this; }
  call(n) { return this.rel([0xe8], n); }
  jmp(n) { return this.rel([0xe9], n); }
  jnz(n) { return this.rel([0x0f, 0x85], n); }
  jz(n) { return this.rel([0x0f, 0x84], n); }
  abs(n) { this.fix.push([this.pc, n, true]); this.b.push(0, 0, 0, 0); return this; }
  // edx = edx * 1103515245 + 12345 (a pseudo-random sequence; its high bits pick the call site / function)
  lcg() { return this.raw(0x69, 0xd2, ...le(1103515245), 0x81, 0xc2, ...le(12345)); }
  build() {
    for (const [at, n, abs] of this.fix) {
      const t = this.labels.get(n); if (t === undefined) throw new Error('label ' + n);
      const v = abs ? CODE + t : t - (at + 4);
      this.b.splice(at, 4, ...le(v >>> 0));
    }
    return { bytes: Uint8Array.from(this.b), bounds: this.bounds.map((n) => CODE + this.labels.get(n)), end: CODE + this.labels.get('end') };
  }
}
const leaf = (a, n) => a.fn(n).raw(0x83, 0xc0, 0x01, 0xc3); // add eax, 1 ; ret
const loopHead = (a) => a.raw(0xb9, ...le(N)).label('L'); // mov ecx, N ; L:
const loopTail = (a) => a.raw(0x49).jnz('L').label('end').raw(0xf4); // dec ecx ; jnz L ; end: hlt

/** main: L: mov eax, F ; call eax ; dec ecx ; jnz L       F: 5 x (call G0 ; ... ; call G<n-1>) ; ret     Gk: add eax, k+1 ; ret */
function helpers(a, n) {
  loopHead(a); a.raw(0xb8).abs('F').raw(0xff, 0xd0); loopTail(a);
  a.label('F'); for (let r = 0; r < 5; r++) for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) a.call('G' + k);
  a.raw(0xc3);
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) a.label('G' + k).raw(0x83, 0xc0, k + 1, 0xc3);
}

const CASES = {
  '1 site': (a) => { loopHead(a); a.call('F'); loopTail(a); leaf(a, 'F'); },
  '8 sites': (a) => { loopHead(a); for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) a.call('F'); loopTail(a); leaf(a, 'F'); },
  'random site': (a) => {
    // L: lcg ; test edx, 1<<31 ; jz A ; test edx, 1<<30 ; jz B ; ... a 3-level tree down to 8 `call F ; jmp N`
    loopHead(a); a.lcg();
    const tree = (lvl, id) => {
      if (lvl === 3) { a.label('s' + id).call('F').jmp('N'); return; }
      a.raw(0xf7, 0xc2, ...le((1 << (31 - lvl)) >>> 0)).jz(`t${lvl}_${id}`);
      tree(lvl + 1, id * 2 + 1);
      a.label(`t${lvl}_${id}`); tree(lvl + 1, id * 2);
    };
    tree(0, 0);
    a.label('N'); loopTail(a); leaf(a, 'F');
  },
  indirect: (a) => {
    // L: lcg ; mov esi, edx ; shr esi, 30 ; call [T + esi*4] ; dec ecx ; jnz L
    loopHead(a); a.lcg(); a.raw(0x89, 0xd6, 0xc1, 0xee, 0x1e, 0xff, 0x14, 0xb5).abs('T'); loopTail(a);
    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) leaf(a, 'F' + k);
    a.fn('T'); for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) a.abs('F' + k);
  },
  nested: (a) => { loopHead(a); a.call('F'); loopTail(a); a.fn('F').call('G').call('G').raw(0xc3); leaf(a, 'G'); },
  recursion: (a) => {
    // L: mov ebx, 40 ; call R ; dec ecx ; jnz L      R: dec ebx ; jz done ; call R ; done: add eax, 1 ; ret
    a.raw(0xb9, ...le(N)).label('L').raw(0xbb, ...le(40)).call('R'); loopTail(a);
    a.fn('R').raw(0x4b).jz('Rd').call('R').label('Rd').raw(0x83, 0xc0, 0x01, 0xc3);
  },
  // the callee in the caller's region (inlined at region formation): the returns stay in the region
  '20 inlined': (a) => { loopHead(a); for (let k = 0; k < 20; k++) a.call('G'); loopTail(a); a.label('G').raw(0x83, 0xc0, 0x01, 0xc3); },
  // a function reached through a pointer (its own region) calling small helpers included in its region: 2 helpers x 5
  // calls, 4 helpers x 5 calls (20 call sites), then returning to its caller in the other region
  helpers: (a) => helpers(a, 2),
  '4x5 helpers': (a) => helpers(a, 4),
};

async function once(p) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, p.bytes);
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true, ...JOPTS });
  jit.cpu = cpu; jit.boundaries = new Set(p.bounds);
  const reset = () => { cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x10000; cpu.eax = 0; cpu.edx = 1; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF; };
  const go = () => { let r; do r = jit.run({ stopAt: p.end, maxInsns: 2e9 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE); if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error('exit ' + r); };
  reset(); go(); // warm-up: translation, then V8's background tier-up of the regions
  await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 100));
  reset();
  const t0 = performance.now();
  go();
  const ms = performance.now() - t0;
  if (cpu.ecx !== 0 || cpu.esp !== DATA + 0x10000) throw new Error('did not run to the end');
  return { ns: (ms * 1e6) / N, eax: cpu.eax };
}

for (const [name, gen] of Object.entries(CASES)) {
  if (ONLY && !name.includes(ONLY)) continue;
  const a = new Asm(); gen(a); const p = a.build();
  const t = [];
  let eax;
  for (let r = 0; r < RUNS; r++) { const o = await once(p); t.push(o.ns); eax = o.eax; }
  t.sort((x, y) => x - y);
  console.log(`${name.padEnd(12)} ${t[t.length >> 1].toFixed(2).padStart(7)} ns/iter  (min ${t[0].toFixed(2)}, max ${t[t.length - 1].toFixed(2)}; eax ${eax >>> 0})`);
}

```

`tools/chain-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Region chaining microbenchmark: ns per call/return pair between two regions (a function whose entry and
// return site are region boundaries: every iteration chains twice), for integer regions and for x87 regions
// (each side touches the x87 stack: the cached stack is flushed and reloaded at every transition).
// Usage: node tools/chain-bench.mjs [iterations]
import './node-wasm-flags.mjs'; // (branch hints honoured, as in Chrome)
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const N = +(process.argv[2] ?? 2e6);
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];

function program(x87) {
  // main: mov ecx, N ; L: [fld m32 ; fstp m32] call F ; R: dec ecx ; jnz L ; hlt       F: add eax, 1 ; [fld1 ; fstp st0] ; ret
  const main = [0xb9, ...le(N)];
  const loop = main.length;
  if (x87) main.push(0xd9, 0x05, ...le(DATA), 0xd9, 0x1d, ...le(DATA + 4));
  const callAt = main.length;
  main.push(0xe8, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  const ret = main.length;
  main.push(0x49, 0x0f, 0x85, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  const jnzEnd = main.length;
  main.push(0xf4);
  const f = main.length + 16;
  while (main.length < f) main.push(0x90);
  main.push(0x83, 0xc0, 0x01);
  if (x87) main.push(0xd9, 0xe8, 0xdd, 0xd8);
  main.push(0xc3);
  const rel = (from, to) => le(to - from);
  main.splice(callAt + 1, 4, ...rel(callAt + 5, f));
  main.splice(jnzEnd - 4, 4, ...rel(jnzEnd, loop));
  return { bytes: Uint8Array.from(main), f: CODE + f, ret: CODE + ret, end: CODE + jnzEnd };
}

for (const x87 of [false, true]) {
  const p = program(x87);
  let best = Infinity;
  for (let rep = 0; rep < 5; rep++) {
    const mem = new GuestMemory();
    const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
    cpu.reset();
    mem.writeBytes(CODE, p.bytes);
    cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x10000; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
    const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true });
    jit.cpu = cpu; jit.boundaries = new Set([p.f, p.ret, p.end]);
    const t0 = performance.now();
    let r;
    do r = jit.run({ stopAt: p.end, maxInsns: 2e9 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
    const ms = performance.now() - t0;
    if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error(`exit ${r}`);
    best = Math.min(best, ms);
  }
  console.log(`${x87 ? 'x87' : 'int'}: ${(best * 1e6 / N).toFixed(1)} ns per call/return (2 chained transitions)`);
}
```

`tools/cmdring-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
// Micro-benchmark for the render-worker study (docs/render-worker.md): what recording a frame's WebGL work into a
// shared command ring costs the emulator's thread, and what a round trip to another thread costs (the synchronous
// dependencies: readbacks). Node worker_threads stand in for the render worker; the frame is a synthetic mix shaped
// like the measured ones (calls per frame by kind, uniform sizes, streamed bytes), not a real game's commands.
// Usage: node tools/cmdring-bench.mjs [--calls 1500] [--frames 2000]
import { Worker, isMainThread, parentPort, workerData } from 'node:worker_threads';

const RING_WORDS = 1 << 20; // 4 MiB command ring (int32 words)
const CTL = { HEAD: 0, TAIL: 1, PING: 2, PONG: 3 };

if (!isMainThread) {
  // consumer: replays the commands (decode + dispatch to no-op handlers), publishes its read position
  const { ring, ctl } = workerData; const i32 = new Int32Array(ring), f32 = new Float32Array(ring), c = new Int32Array(ctl);
  let tail = 0, sink = 0;
  for (;;) {
    if (Atomics.load(c, CTL.PING) !== Atomics.load(c, CTL.PONG)) { Atomics.store(c, CTL.PONG, Atomics.load(c, CTL.PING)); Atomics.notify(c, CTL.PONG); }
    const head = Atomics.load(c, CTL.HEAD);
    if (head === -1) break;
    if (tail === head) { Atomics.wait(c, CTL.HEAD, head, 1); continue; }
    while (tail !== head) {
      const op = i32[tail], n = i32[tail + 1];
      switch (op) { case 1: sink += i32[tail + 2]; break; case 2: sink += f32[tail + 3]; break; case 3: sink += i32[tail + 2 + (n >> 1)]; break; default: sink += n; }
      tail += 2 + n; if (tail >= RING_WORDS - 4096) tail = 0;
    }
    Atomics.store(c, CTL.TAIL, tail);
  }
  parentPort.postMessage(sink);
} else {
  const arg = (k, d) => { const i = process.argv.indexOf('--' + k); return i > 0 ? Number(process.argv[i + 1]) : d; };
  const CALLS = arg('calls', 1500), FRAMES = arg('frames', 2000);
  const ring = new SharedArrayBuffer(RING_WORDS * 4), ctl = new SharedArrayBuffer(64);
  const i32 = new Int32Array(ring), f32 = new Float32Array(ring), u8r = new Uint8Array(ring), c = new Int32Array(ctl);
  const guest = new Uint8Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(64 << 20)); for (let i = 0; i < guest.length; i += 4097) guest[i] = i;
  const consts = new Float32Array(1024).map((_, i) => i * 0.5);
  // the frame: per 100 calls ~ 55 state/bind calls (2-4 ints), 25 uniforms (4-16 floats; 1 in 25 a 64-float block),
  // 15 draws (4 ints), 5 buffer updates (~1.5 KiB streamed from guest memory)
  const kinds = []; for (let i = 0; i < CALLS; i++) { const r = i % 100; kinds.push(r < 55 ? 0 : r < 80 ? (r === 79 ? 4 : 1) : r < 95 ? 2 : 3); }
  let head = 0;
  const room = (words) => { if (head + words >= RING_WORDS - 4096) head = 0; }; // (benchmark: the consumer keeps up; a real ring waits on TAIL)
  const enc = {
    state(op, a, b, cc) { room(5); i32[head] = 1; i32[head + 1] = 3; i32[head + 2] = a; i32[head + 3] = b; i32[head + 4] = cc; head += 5; },
    uniform(loc, src, off, n) { room(n + 3); i32[head] = 2; i32[head + 1] = n + 1; i32[head + 2] = loc; f32.set(src.subarray(off, off + n), head + 3); head += n + 3; },
    draw(mode, count, type, offset) { room(6); i32[head] = 4; i32[head + 1] = 4; i32[head + 2] = mode; i32[head + 3] = count; i32[head + 4] = type; i32[head + 5] = offset; head += 6; },
    data(target, addr, n) { const w = (n + 3) >> 2; room(w + 4); i32[head] = 3; i32[head + 1] = w + 2; i32[head + 2] = target; i32[head + 3] = n; u8r.set(guest.subarray(addr, addr + n), (head + 4) * 4); head += w + 4; },
  };
  let sink = 0;
  const direct = { state(op, a, b, cc) { sink += a ^ b ^ cc; }, uniform(loc, src, off, n) { sink += src[off + n - 1]; }, draw(m, n) { sink += m + n; }, data(t, a, n) { sink += guest[a + n - 1]; } };
  const frame = (o, f) => { for (let i = 0; i < CALLS; i++) { const k = kinds[i]; if (k === 0) o.state(i & 7, i, f, 3); else if (k === 1) o.uniform(i & 63, consts, (i * 4) & 511, (i & 3) === 0 ? 16 : 4); else if (k === 4) o.uniform(5, consts, 0, 64); else if (k === 2) o.draw(4, 300 + (i & 127), 5123, i * 6); else o.data(34962, (i * 6151) & 0x3fffff, 1536); } };
  const time = (o) => { const t0 = process.hrtime.bigint(); for (let f = 0; f < FRAMES; f++) { frame(o, f); if (o === enc) Atomics.store(c, CTL.HEAD, head), Atomics.notify(c, CTL.HEAD); } return Number(process.hrtime.bigint() - t0) / 1e6 / FRAMES; };
  const w = new Worker(new URL(import.meta.url), { workerData: { ring, ctl } });
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { time(direct); time(enc); } // warm-up
  const base = time(direct), rec = time(enc);
  // round trip: the emulator asks, the render worker answers at its next poll (what a synchronous readback waits at least)
  const rtt = []; for (let k = 0; k < 2000; k++) { const t0 = process.hrtime.bigint(); const v = Atomics.add(c, CTL.PING, 1) + 1; Atomics.notify(c, CTL.HEAD); while (Atomics.load(c, CTL.PONG) !== v) Atomics.wait(c, CTL.PONG, Atomics.load(c, CTL.PONG), 5); rtt.push(Number(process.hrtime.bigint() - t0) / 1000); }
  rtt.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  Atomics.store(c, CTL.HEAD, -1); Atomics.notify(c, CTL.HEAD);
  await new Promise((r) => w.once('message', r));
  console.log(`frame of ${CALLS} calls: no-op calls ${base.toFixed(3)} ms, recorded into the ring ${rec.toFixed(3)} ms (${((rec - base) * 1e6 / CALLS).toFixed(0)} ns per call over a plain call; ${(CALLS * 0.05 * 1536 / 1024).toFixed(0)} KiB streamed per frame included)`);
  console.log(`round trip to the consumer thread: median ${rtt[1000].toFixed(1)} us, p99 ${rtt[1980].toFixed(1)} us (sink ${sink & 1})`);
}

```

`tools/codec-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Image codec microbenchmark (the JPEG / PNG / inflate decoders D3DX and GDI+ use to load textures): ms per decode of
// synthetic texture-like images (tools/gen/codec_images.py: gradients, grain, hard edges; 256/512/1024 squared; JPEG
// q50-q90 4:2:0 / 4:2:2 / 4:4:4 / progressive / gray; PNG RGB / RGBA / palette / smooth RGBA), median of R runs after
// a warm-up, and the difference to PIL's decode of the same file (max and mean absolute per channel: 0 for PNG, the
// IDCT's rounding for JPEG). --dir <path> loads jpeg.js / png.js from another directory (a copy of the previous
// version, for before/after in one session; alternate the two to cancel the machine's load).
// Usage: node tools/codec-bench.mjs [--dir src/gfx/codecs] [--runs 7] [--images /tmp/imgbench] [filter substring]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { pathToFileURL, fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (name, def) => { const i = args.indexOf(name); if (i < 0) return def; const v = args[i + 1]; args.splice(i, 2); return v; };
const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const dir = path.resolve(opt('--dir', path.join(here, '../src/gfx/codecs')));
const runs = +opt('--runs', 7);
const images = opt('--images', '/tmp/orthros-codec-images');
const filter = args[0] ?? '';
if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(images, 't1024_ui.png.rgba'))) {
  const r = spawnSync('python3', [path.join(here, 'gen/codec_images.py'), images], { stdio: 'inherit' });
  if (r.status) process.exit(1);
}
const { decodeJpeg } = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(dir, 'jpeg.js')).href);
const { decodePng } = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(dir, 'png.js')).href);

const names = fs.readdirSync(images).filter((n) => /\.(jpg|png)$/.test(n) && n.includes(filter)).sort((a, b) => {
  const sa = +a.match(/^t(\d+)/)[1], sb = +b.match(/^t(\d+)/)[1];
  return sa - sb || a.localeCompare(b);
});
let total = 0;
console.log(`codecs: ${dir}`);
for (const n of names) {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(fs.readFileSync(path.join(images, n)));
  const ref = fs.readFileSync(path.join(images, n + '.rgba'));
  const dec = n.endsWith('.jpg') ? decodeJpeg : decodePng;
  let img = dec(bytes); // (warm-up: until the optimizing tier has settled)
  for (let w = 0, t0 = performance.now(); w < 3 || performance.now() - t0 < 400; w++) img = dec(bytes);
  const t = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < runs; r++) { const t0 = performance.now(); img = dec(bytes); t.push(performance.now() - t0); }
  t.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  let max = 0, sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < ref.length; i++) { const d = Math.abs(img.data[i] - ref[i]); if (d > max) max = d; sum += d; }
  total += t[runs >> 1];
  console.log(`${n.padEnd(20)} ${(bytes.length / 1024).toFixed(0).padStart(5)} KB  ${t[runs >> 1].toFixed(2).padStart(8)} ms  (${t[0].toFixed(2)}-${t[runs - 1].toFixed(2)})  vs PIL max ${max} mean ${(sum / ref.length).toFixed(3)}`);
}
console.log(`total of medians: ${total.toFixed(1)} ms`);
```
