`tools/cpuprofile-report.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# A Chrome CPU profile (.cpuprofile: perf.mjs --profile, tools/port-perf.mjs) read for an engine's frame: WebAssembly
# frames named from the build's symbol map (Emscripten's --emit-symbol-map, "N:name" lines: the wasm-function[N] the
# profile names), the busy time (everything but "(idle)"), the functions by self time, the inclusive time of the
# functions whose name holds a given text (a function counted once per sample however deep it recurses), and who calls
# a function or what it calls (its inclusive time split by its direct callers or callees). Shares are of the busy time;
# --frames N adds milliseconds a frame (the measured frames, perf.mjs's "frames"). Run with python3 -I.
# Usage: python3 -I tools/cpuprofile-report.py <profile> [--symbols <openmw.js.symbols>] [--top 40] [--frames N]
#          [--match <text>]... [--callers <text>] [--callees <text>] [--depth 1]
import collections, json, re, sys

def main(argv):
    if not argv or argv[0].startswith('-'):
        sys.exit(__doc__ or 'usage: cpuprofile-report.py <profile> [options]')
    path, args = argv[0], argv[1:]
    def opt(name, default=None):
        return args[args.index(name) + 1] if name in args else default
    def opts(name):
        return [args[i + 1] for i, a in enumerate(args) if a == name and i + 1 < len(args)]
    symbols = {}
    if opt('--symbols'):
        for line in open(opt('--symbols'), encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'):
            i, _, n = line.rstrip('\n').partition(':')
            symbols[i] = n
    top, frames = int(opt('--top', 40)), int(opt('--frames', 0))
    prof = json.load(open(path))
    nodes = {n['id']: n for n in prof['nodes']}
    parent = {}
    for n in prof['nodes']:
        for c in n.get('children', []):
            parent[c] = n['id']

    def name(nid):
        f = nodes[nid]['callFrame']
        n = f.get('functionName') or '(anonymous)'
        m = re.match(r'^\$?(?:wasm-function\[(\d+)\]|(\d+))$', n)
        if m:
            n = symbols.get(m.group(1) or m.group(2), n)
        return n

    # (time per sample: the delta to the next sample)
    t = collections.Counter()
    for s, d in zip(prof['samples'], prof['timeDeltas']):
        t[s] += d / 1000.0
    total = sum(t.values())
    idle = sum(ms for nid, ms in t.items() if name(nid) in ('(idle)',))
    busy = max(1e-9, total - idle)
    selfc, incl = collections.Counter(), collections.Counter()
    callers, callees = collections.Counter(), collections.Counter()
    want_callers, want_callees = opt('--callers'), opt('--callees')
    depth = int(opt('--depth', 1))
    for nid, ms in t.items():
        if name(nid) == '(idle)':
            continue
        selfc[name(nid)] += ms
        chain, x = [], nid
        while x is not None:
            chain.append(name(x)); x = parent.get(x)
        for k in set(chain):
            incl[k] += ms
        # (chain[0] the leaf: a function's callers further along the chain, its callees before it)
        if want_callers:
            for i, k in enumerate(chain):
                if want_callers in k:
                    callers[' <- '.join(chain[i + 1:i + 1 + depth]) or '(root)'] += ms
                    break
        if want_callees:
            for i in range(len(chain) - 1, -1, -1):
                if want_callees in chain[i]:
                    callees[' -> '.join(reversed(chain[max(0, i - depth):i])) or '(self)'] += ms
                    break

    def line(ms):
        per = f' {ms / frames:7.3f} ms/frame' if frames else ''
        return f'{ms / busy * 100:6.2f}%{per}'
    print(f'total {total:.0f} ms, idle {idle:.0f}, busy {busy:.0f}' + (f' ({busy / frames:.2f} ms a frame over {frames} frames)' if frames else ''))
    print('--- self time')
    for k, v in selfc.most_common(top):
        print(f'{line(v)}  {k[:150]}')
    for m in opts('--match'):
        print(f'--- inclusive, names holding "{m}"')
        for k, v in sorted(((k, v) for k, v in incl.items() if m in k), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:top]:
            print(f'{line(v)}  {k[:150]}')
    if want_callers:
        print(f'--- callers of "{want_callers}" (its inclusive time by caller, {depth} deep)')
        for k, v in callers.most_common(top):
            print(f'{line(v)}  {k[:200]}')
    if want_callees:
        print(f'--- callees of "{want_callees}" (its inclusive time by callee, {depth} deep)')
        for k, v in callees.most_common(top):
            print(f'{line(v)}  {k[:200]}')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(sys.argv[1:])

```

`tools/crtmath-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// C-runtime SSE2 transcendental microbenchmark: ns per evaluated element of two synthetic kernels written in the
// style of the SSE2 paths of C-runtime math routines (argument classification on the high word of the double,
// range reduction with table lookups, SSE2 polynomial; written for this benchmark, not taken from any program),
// each looped over a 64-element input array. The result of every run is checked bit for bit against the
// reference interpreter's.
//   sin: x87 argument (fld m64) spilled with fstp m64 / movlpd, FNSTCW precision check, pextrw exponent tests +
//        jcc, round(x*2/pi) with the 1.5*2^52 shifter (movd of the low dword), Cody-Waite reduction (mulsd/subsd),
//        quadrant sign-mask table (movapd [ebx+eax+128]), packed sin/cos polynomial (unpcklpd, mulpd/addpd, pshufd),
//        quadrant select, xorpd sign, result back through movlpd m64 / fld m64 / fstp m64. 64 insns per element.
//   log: movlpd load, pextrw + cmp/test classification, psrlq/movd exponent, mantissa bits -> 128-entry table
//        index, andpd/orpd mantissa, cvtsi2sd, scalar mulsd/addsd polynomial, comisd + jb, movlpd store.
//        40 insns per element.
//   sinsse, sinbal: controls for `sin` — sinsse without the x87 glue (movlpd loads/stores instead, no fnstcw),
//        sinbal with each fld paired with its fstp in the same block (no x87 value alive across a branch).
// Usage: node --no-liftoff tools/crtmath-bench.mjs [passes] [sin|sinsse|sinbal|log]   (passes over the 64-element
// array, default 100000; every timed run follows a short warm-up and a pause for V8's tier-up, but under load the
// optimizing compile can still land late: --no-liftoff measures the optimized code only)
//
// Kernels (assembled with llvm-mc-18 -triple=i686-pc-windows-msvc; ebx = data, ebp = passes):
// sin: outer: lea esi,[ebx+1024] ; lea edi,[ebx+2048] ; mov ecx,64
//   L: fld qword [esi] ; fnstcw [esp+16] ; movzx eax,word [esp+16] ; and eax,0x300 ; cmp eax,0x200 ; jne Lcw
//   Lcw: fstp qword [esp+4] ; movlpd xmm0,[esp+4] ; pextrw eax,xmm0,3 ; and eax,0x7fff ; cmp eax,0x3e40 ; jb Ltiny
//      cmp eax,0x4090 ; jae Ltiny ; movapd xmm1,xmm0 ; mulsd xmm1,[ebx] ; addsd xmm1,[ebx+8] ; movd edx,xmm1
//      subsd xmm1,[ebx+8] ; movapd xmm2,xmm1 ; mulsd xmm1,[ebx+16] ; mulsd xmm2,[ebx+24] ; subsd xmm0,xmm1
//      subsd xmm0,xmm2 ; and edx,3 ; mov eax,edx ; shl eax,4 ; movapd xmm3,[ebx+eax+128] ; movapd xmm4,xmm0
//      unpcklpd xmm4,xmm4 ; mulpd xmm4,xmm4 ; movapd xmm5,[ebx+32] ; mulpd xmm5,xmm4 ; addpd xmm5,[ebx+48]
//      mulpd xmm5,xmm4 ; addpd xmm5,[ebx+64] ; mulpd xmm5,xmm4 ; pshufd xmm6,xmm5,0xee ; mulsd xmm5,xmm0
//      addsd xmm5,xmm0 ; addsd xmm6,[ebx+80] ; test edx,1 ; jz Lnoswap ; movapd xmm5,xmm6
//   Lnoswap: xorpd xmm5,xmm3 ; movlpd [esp+4],xmm5 ; fld qword [esp+4] ; jmp Lstore
//   Ltiny: fld qword [esp+4]
//   Lstore: fstp qword [edi] ; add esi,8 ; add edi,8 ; dec ecx ; jnz L ; dec ebp ; jnz outer ; hlt
// log: outer: (same) ; L: movlpd xmm0,[esi] ; pextrw edx,xmm0,3 ; cmp edx,0x7ff0 ; jae Lspecial ; test edx,0x7ff0
//      jz Lspecial ; movapd xmm1,xmm0 ; psrlq xmm1,52 ; movd eax,xmm1 ; sub eax,1023 ; and edx,0xfe0 ; shr edx,1
//      andpd xmm0,[ebx+32] ; orpd xmm0,[ebx+48] ; mulsd xmm0,[ebx+edx+4096] ; subsd xmm0,[ebx+48]
//      cvtsi2sd xmm2,eax ; mulsd xmm2,[ebx] ; addsd xmm2,[ebx+edx+4104] ; movapd xmm3,xmm0 ; mulsd xmm3,xmm3
//      movsd xmm4,[ebx+8] ; mulsd xmm4,xmm0 ; addsd xmm4,[ebx+16] ; mulsd xmm4,xmm0 ; addsd xmm4,[ebx+24]
//      mulsd xmm4,xmm3 ; addsd xmm4,xmm0 ; addsd xmm4,xmm2 ; comisd xmm4,[ebx+64] ; jb Lneg ; addsd xmm7,xmm4
//   Lneg: movlpd [edi],xmm4 ; jmp Lnext
//   Lspecial: movlpd [edi],xmm0
//   Lnext: add esi,8 ; add edi,8 ; dec ecx ; jnz L ; dec ebp ; jnz outer ; movlpd [ebx+72],xmm7 ; hlt
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-sse.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';

export const KERNELS = {
  sin: '',
  sinsse: '',
  sinbal: '',
  log: '',
};
const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const REPS = 9;

/** Guest memory, CPU and data of kernel `name` for `passes` passes over the inputs. */
export function setupKernel(name, passes) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, Uint8Array.from(KERNELS[name].match(/../g).map((h) => parseInt(h, 16))));
  const w64 = (a, v) => mem.writeF64(DATA + a, v);
  const w64bits = (a, hi, lo = 0) => { mem.write32(DATA + a, lo); mem.write32(DATA + a + 4, hi); };
  if (name.startsWith('sin')) {
    w64(0, 2 / Math.PI); w64(8, 1.5 * 2 ** 52); w64(16, 1.5707963267341256); w64(24, 6.077100506506192e-11);
    w64(32, -1 / 5040); w64(40, -1 / 720); w64(48, 1 / 120); w64(56, 1 / 24); w64(64, -1 / 6); w64(72, -0.5); w64(80, 1);
    for (let q = 0; q < 4; q++) w64bits(128 + 16 * q, q >= 2 ? 0x80000000 : 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) w64(1024 + 8 * i, i % 16 === 7 ? 1e-9 * (i + 1) : (i - 31.5) * 0.37);
  } else {
    w64(0, Math.LN2); w64(8, -0.25); w64(16, 1 / 3); w64(24, -0.5); w64(64, 0);
    w64bits(32, 0x000fffff, 0xffffffff); w64bits(40, 0x000fffff, 0xffffffff); // mantissa mask (both lanes)
    w64(48, 1); w64(56, 1);
    for (let i = 0; i < 128; i++) { const c = 1 + (i + 0.5) / 128; w64(4096 + 16 * i, 1 / c); w64(4104 + 16 * i, Math.log(c)); }
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) w64(1024 + 8 * i, i === 13 ? Infinity : i === 40 ? 0 : 0.01 + i * i * 0.731);
  }
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x10000; cpu.ebx = DATA; cpu.ebp = passes; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  return { mem, cpu };
}

/** Output bytes of a finished run: the result array (the same after any number of passes) and, with `all`, the data
 * block's scalars (the log kernel's accumulator depends on the pass count). */
export function resultOf(mem, all = true) { return Buffer.from(mem.bytes(DATA + (all ? 0 : 2048), all ? 2048 + 512 : 512)).toString('hex'); }

/**
 * Run kernel `name` for `passes` passes under the JIT. `warm`: a first short run translates the region, then V8 is
 * given time to tier it up to optimized code (its baseline compiler's code is what a short run would measure), and
 * the timed run starts over.
 */
async function runJit(name, passes, warm = true) {
  const { mem, cpu } = setupKernel(name, passes);
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true });
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  let r;
  if (warm) {
    cpu.ebp = 200;
    do r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 2e9 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
    await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 150));
    cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.ebp = passes;
  }
  const t0 = performance.now();
  do r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 2e9 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
  const ms = performance.now() - t0;
  if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error(`exit ${r}`);
  return { ms, out: resultOf(mem, passes <= 2) };
}

function runInterp(name, passes) {
  const { mem, cpu } = setupKernel(name, passes);
  const I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
  let r;
  do r = I.run({ maxInsns: 1e8 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
  if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error(`interp exit ${r}`);
  return resultOf(mem);
}

if (import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`) {
  const passes = +(process.argv[2] ?? 100000);
  const which = process.argv[3] ? [process.argv[3]] : Object.keys(KERNELS);
  for (const name of which) {
    // (the interpreter runs ~5 MIPS: it checks a 2-pass run in full, the timed runs are checked on the result array)
    const full = runInterp(name, 2);
    if ((await runJit(name, 2, false)).out !== full) throw new Error(`${name}: JIT result differs from the interpreter`);
    const ref = full.slice(2 * 2048);
    const times = [];
    for (let rep = 0; rep < REPS; rep++) {
      const { ms, out } = await runJit(name, passes);
      if (out !== ref) throw new Error(`${name}: JIT result differs from the interpreter`);
      times.push(ms);
    }
    times.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const ns = (ms) => (ms * 1e6 / passes / 64).toFixed(2);
    console.log(`crtmath ${name}: ${ns(times[REPS >> 1])} ns per element median of ${REPS}, ${ns(times[0])} best, ${ns(times[REPS - 1])} worst`);
  }
}

```

`tools/d3dx-image-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// D3DX image microbenchmark (src/win32/d3dx9-image.js: the work behind D3DXLoadSurfaceFromMemory, D3DXFilterTexture and
// D3DXCreateTexture*FromFileInMemory while maps load): ms per operation (its output hashed outside the timing) on synthetic texture-like images (gradients,
// grain, hard edges, holes in the alpha), median of R runs after a warm-up, on this thread (the browser splits large
// DXT encodes with helper workers, dxt-pool.js: every block is encoded by the same function). The output bytes of
// every operation are hashed: two trees must print the same hashes (bit-identical results).
// --dir <path> loads d3dx9-image.js from another tree's src/win32; --vs <path> times that other tree's too, its runs
// interleaved with this one's (A, B, A, B...: the same machine load for both on a shared server) and checks that both
// give the same bytes.
// Usage: node tools/d3dx-image-bench.mjs [--dir <tree>/src/win32] [--vs <base tree>/src/win32] [--runs 9] [filter substring]
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL, fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (name, def) => { const i = args.indexOf(name); if (i < 0) return def; const v = args[i + 1]; args.splice(i, 2); return v; };
const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const dir = path.resolve(opt('--dir', path.join(here, '../src/win32')));
const runs = +opt('--runs', 9), vs = opt('--vs');
const filter = args[0] ?? '';
const img = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(dir, 'd3dx9-image.js')).href);
const img2 = vs ? await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(path.resolve(vs), 'd3dx9-image.js')).href) : null;
const { FMT } = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(dir, 'd3d8.js')).href);

/** deterministic texture-like RGBA8: smooth gradients, grain, a few hard edges; alpha: 'opaque' | 'holes' | 'ramp' */
function texture(w, h, seed, alpha = 'opaque') {
  let s = seed >>> 0; const rnd = () => { s = (Math.imul(s, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return s >>> 24; };
  const px = new Uint8Array(w * h * 4);
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
    const i = 4 * (y * w + x), edge = ((x >> 5) + (y >> 4)) & 1 ? 40 : 0, g = rnd() >> 4;
    px[i] = Math.min(255, (x * 200 / w + edge + g) | 0); px[i + 1] = Math.min(255, (y * 180 / h + g + 30) | 0); px[i + 2] = Math.min(255, (((x + y) * 90 / (w + h)) + edge + (g >> 1) + 60) | 0);
    px[i + 3] = alpha === 'opaque' ? 255 : alpha === 'holes' ? (((x * 7 + y * 3) % 23) < 4 ? 0 : 255) : Math.min(255, (x * 255 / w + g) | 0);
  }
  return px;
}
/** the same image as Direct3D's A8R8G8B8 bytes (B, G, R, A) */
const toBgra = (rgba) => { const o = new Uint8Array(rgba.length); for (let i = 0; i < rgba.length; i += 4) { o[i] = rgba[i + 2]; o[i + 1] = rgba[i + 1]; o[i + 2] = rgba[i]; o[i + 3] = rgba[i + 3]; } return o; };
const fnv = (u8, h = 0x811c9dc5) => { for (let i = 0; i < u8.length; i++) h = Math.imul(h ^ u8[i], 16777619) >>> 0; return h; };
/** the mip chain below a w x h RGBA8 image as D3DXFilterTexture builds it (box filter 2:1, each level from the previous one's RGBA) */
const mipsOf = (img) => (fmt, rgba, w, h) => { const out = []; let from = rgba; for (; w > 1 || h > 1;) { const nw = Math.max(1, w >> 1), nh = Math.max(1, h >> 1); from = img.resizeRgba(from, w, h, nw, nh); out.push(img.fromRgba(fmt, from, nw, nh)); w = nw; h = nh; } return out; };
/** a TGA file (uncompressed 32-bit, bottom-up) of an RGBA8 image */
const tga = (rgba, w, h) => { const b = new Uint8Array(18 + w * h * 4); b[2] = 2; b[12] = w & 255; b[13] = w >> 8; b[14] = h & 255; b[15] = h >> 8; b[16] = 32; b[17] = 8; for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) { const s = 4 * ((h - 1 - y) * w + x), d = 18 + 4 * (y * w + x); b[d] = rgba[s + 2]; b[d + 1] = rgba[s + 1]; b[d + 2] = rgba[s]; b[d + 3] = rgba[s + 3]; } return b; };

const T256 = texture(256, 256, 1), H256 = texture(256, 256, 2, 'holes'), R256 = texture(256, 256, 3, 'ramp'), T512 = texture(512, 512, 4);
const X256 = toBgra(T256), A256 = toBgra(R256), X512 = toBgra(T512);
const DXT1_256 = img.fromRgba(FMT.DXT1, T256, 256, 256), DXT5_256 = img.fromRgba(FMT.DXT5, R256, 256, 256);
const R565_256 = img.fromRgba(FMT.R5G6B5, T256, 256, 256), A4_256 = img.fromRgba(FMT.A4R4G4B4, R256, 256, 256), A1_256 = img.fromRgba(FMT.A1R5G5B5, H256, 256, 256);
const chain = (w, h) => { const s = []; while (w > 1 || h > 1) { w = Math.max(1, w >> 1); h = Math.max(1, h >> 1); s.push([w, h]); } return s; };
const TGA256 = tga(R256, 256, 256);
const casesOf = (img, mips = mipsOf(img)) => [
  // D3DXLoadSurfaceFromMemory X8R8G8B8 256 x 256 -> DXT1 (the source read in place with its pitch, then encoded)
  ['load X8R8G8B8 256 -> DXT1', () => (img.fromRgba(FMT.DXT1, img.toRgbaRows(FMT.X8R8G8B8, X256, 256, 256, 1024), 256, 256))],
  ['load A8R8G8B8 256 -> DXT5', () => (img.fromRgba(FMT.DXT5, img.toRgbaRows(FMT.A8R8G8B8, A256, 256, 256, 1024), 256, 256))],
  ['load A8R8G8B8 256 -> DXT3', () => (img.fromRgba(FMT.DXT3, img.toRgbaRows(FMT.A8R8G8B8, A256, 256, 256, 1024), 256, 256))],
  ['load X8R8G8B8 512 -> DXT1', () => (img.fromRgba(FMT.DXT1, img.toRgbaRows(FMT.X8R8G8B8, X512, 512, 512, 2048), 512, 512))],
  ['encode DXT1 256 (holes)', () => (img.fromRgba(FMT.DXT1, H256, 256, 256))],
  // D3DXFilterTexture: the levels below 256 x 256 from the RGBA kept at the load
  ['mips DXT1 from 256', () => mips(FMT.DXT1, T256, 256, 256)],
  ['mips DXT5 from 256', () => mips(FMT.DXT5, R256, 256, 256)],
  ['mips A8R8G8B8 from 256', () => mips(FMT.A8R8G8B8, R256, 256, 256)],
  // D3DXFilterTexture as the handler runs it (the whole chain at once where the tree has mipChain)
  ['filter DXT1 256 (RGBA kept)', () => img.mipChain?.(FMT.DXT1, T256, 256, 256, chain(256, 256)) ?? mips(FMT.DXT1, T256, 256, 256)],
  ['filter A1R5G5B5 256 (decoded)', () => img.mipChain?.(FMT.A1R5G5B5, A1_256, 256, 256, chain(256, 256), FMT.A1R5G5B5) ?? mips(FMT.A1R5G5B5, img.toRgba(FMT.A1R5G5B5, A1_256, 256, 256), 256, 256)],
  // D3DXCreateTextureFromFileInMemoryEx: a DDS level converted to the texture's (smaller) size
  ['convert DXT5 256 -> 128', () => img.mipChain?.(FMT.DXT5, DXT5_256, 256, 256, [[128, 128]], FMT.DXT5)?.[0] ?? img.fromRgba(FMT.DXT5, img.resizeRgba(img.toRgba(FMT.DXT5, DXT5_256, 256, 256), 256, 256, 128, 128), 128, 128)],
  // ... from a compressed level (no RGBA kept)
  ['decode DXT1 256', () => (img.toRgba(FMT.DXT1, DXT1_256, 256, 256))],
  ['decode DXT5 256', () => (img.toRgba(FMT.DXT5, DXT5_256, 256, 256))],
  ['decode R5G6B5 256', () => (img.toRgba(FMT.R5G6B5, R565_256, 256, 256))],
  ['decode A4R4G4B4 256', () => (img.toRgba(FMT.A4R4G4B4, A4_256, 256, 256))],
  ['encode R5G6B5 256', () => (img.fromRgba(FMT.R5G6B5, T256, 256, 256))],
  ['resize 256 -> 200x100', () => (img.resizeRgba(T256, 256, 256, 200, 100))],
  ['TGA 256 image info', () => { const i = img.parseImageInfo(TGA256); return Uint32Array.of(i.width, i.height, i.depth, i.mips, i.infoFmt, i.fileFormat); }],
  ['TGA 256 parse', () => img.parseImage(TGA256).images[0][0]],
].filter(([n]) => n.includes(filter));

const cases = casesOf(img), cases2 = img2 ? casesOf(img2) : null;
console.log(`d3dx9-image: ${dir}${vs ? ` (B: ${path.resolve(vs)})` : ''}`);
const hash = (v) => (Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v]).reduce((h, a) => fnv(a, h), 0x811c9dc5);
const med = (t) => t.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b)[t.length >> 1];
let total = 0, total2 = 0;
cases.forEach(([name, f], k) => {
  const fs = cases2 ? [f, cases2[k][1]] : [f];
  const hs = fs.map((g) => hash(g()));
  if (hs.some((x) => x !== hs[0])) throw new Error(`${name}: the trees give different bytes`);
  for (const g of fs) for (let w = 0, t0 = performance.now(); w < 3 || performance.now() - t0 < 300; w++) g(); // (warm-up: the optimizing tier)
  const t = fs.map(() => []);
  for (let r = 0; r < runs; r++) fs.forEach((g, i) => { const t0 = performance.now(); const v = g(); t[i].push(performance.now() - t0); if (r === runs - 1 && hash(v) !== hs[0]) throw new Error(`${name}: result changed between runs`); });
  const m = t.map(med);
  total += m[0]; if (cases2) total2 += m[1];
  const sorted = t[0].slice().sort((a, b) => a - b);
  console.log(`${name.padEnd(30)} ${m[0].toFixed(3).padStart(8)} ms  (${sorted[0].toFixed(3)}-${sorted[runs - 1].toFixed(3)})${cases2 ? `  B ${m[1].toFixed(3).padStart(8)} ms  A/B ${(m[0] / m[1]).toFixed(2)}` : ''}  hash ${(hs[0] >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`);
});
console.log(`total of medians: ${total.toFixed(2)} ms${cases2 ? `, B ${total2.toFixed(2)} ms` : ''}`);
```

`tools/data-matrix-run.mjs`:

```mjs
// One run of the data matrix (tools/data-matrix.mjs): a new player in a fresh browser (no profile, no cache, no block
// store) opens a version as the home's Play does (/?manifest=<name>&gameLang=<l>: a Win32 game's page, or a port's page
// it hands over to) through the throttling proxy, and plays to the first moment it is playable: a Win32 game as it
// starts (the worker's PlayableWatch marks its menu), a GoldSrc port its solo map (`map <solo.map>` once running, as its
// menu's New Game), an re3 port a new game (the menu's clicks, re3/check.mjs's), an OpenMW port New Game (its menu).
// Prints one JSON line: { firstFrame, shown (loader hidden / menu), playable (the proxy saw the mark), inPlay, ... } —
// seconds from the page's navigation. Start it through tools/with-browser-slot.sh.
//   node tools/data-matrix-run.mjs --base https://127.0.0.1:<proxy> --manifest <name> [--lang en] [--seconds 1200] [--shot f.png]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const base = opt('base'), name = opt('manifest'), lang = opt('lang', null), seconds = Number(opt('seconds', 1200));
// (the proxy's certificate is its own: NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 for these two fetches, set by data-matrix.mjs)
const man = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/manifest/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`)).json();
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox', ...(opt('spki') ? [`--ignore-certificate-errors-spki-list=${opt('spki')}`] : ['--ignore-certificate-errors']), '--use-gl=angle', '--use-angle=swiftshader', '--enable-unsafe-swiftshader', '--ignore-gpu-blocklist', '--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required'] });
const out = { manifest: name, lang, firstFrame: null, shown: null, playable: null, inPlay: null, error: null, notes: [] };
const t0 = Date.now(); const at = () => Math.round((Date.now() - t0) / 100) / 10;
const marks = async () => { try { return await (await fetch(`${base}/__proxy/marks`)).json(); } catch { return []; } };
try {
  // (the proxy's certificate trusted by its key — a certificate error would turn the HTTP cache off: every worker
  // fetched the page's modules again, none of the engines' immutable files kept)
  const context = await browser.newContext({ ignoreHTTPSErrors: !opt('spki'), viewport: { width: 1280, height: 900 } });
  await context.addInitScript(() => {
    window.renderProbe = { draws: 0, frames: 0 };
    const raf = window.requestAnimationFrame.bind(window);
    window.requestAnimationFrame = (cb) => raf((t) => { window.renderProbe.frames++; cb(t); });
    for (const type of [window.WebGLRenderingContext, window.WebGL2RenderingContext]) {
      if (!type) continue;
      for (const m of ['drawArrays', 'drawElements', 'drawArraysInstanced', 'drawElementsInstanced', 'drawRangeElements']) {
        const f = type.prototype[m]; if (!f) continue; type.prototype[m] = function (...a) { window.renderProbe.draws++; return f.apply(this, a); };
      }
    }
  });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  page.setDefaultTimeout(seconds * 1000);
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => out.notes.push('pageerror ' + e.message.slice(0, 200)));
  page.on('dialog', (d) => d.accept().catch(() => {}));
  const q = new URLSearchParams({ manifest: name, ...(lang ? { gameLang: lang } : {}) });
  await page.goto(`${base}/?${q}`);
  const deadline = t0 + seconds * 1000;
  const rt = man?.runtime ?? 'win32';
  const drawRate = async (ms = 3000) => {
    const f = rt === 'openmw' ? page.frames().find((x) => x.url().includes('/app/')) ?? page.mainFrame() : page.mainFrame();
    const a = await f.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.renderProbe })).catch(() => ({ draws: 0, frames: 0 })); await page.waitForTimeout(ms);
    const b = await f.evaluate(() => ({ ...window.renderProbe })).catch(() => ({ draws: 0, frames: 0 }));
    return { perFrame: (b.draws - a.draws) / Math.max(1, b.frames - a.frames), frames: b.frames - a.frames, draws: b.draws };
  };
  const markSeen = async () => (await marks()).some((m) => m.mark?.kind === 'playable' && m.url.endsWith('/' + encodeURIComponent(name)));
  if (rt === 'win32') {
    let steadyN = 0;
    for (;;) {
      if (Date.now() > deadline) { out.error = 'timeout'; break; }
      const s = await page.evaluate(() => window.orthros?.stats ?? null).catch(() => null);
      if (out.firstFrame === null && s?.d3d?.frames > 0) out.firstFrame = at();
      if (s?.net) out.pageNet = s.net;
      if (await markSeen()) { out.playable = at(); out.shown = out.playable; break; }
      // (steady: drawing at 10 fps or more for 8 s, nothing waited for the network — the menu on this loaded machine;
      // without the worker's mark (20 fps: SwiftShader may not reach it) the run ends 30 s later)
      if (out.firstFrame !== null && s && s.fps >= 10 && !s.net?.waiting) { steadyN++; if (steadyN >= 8 && out.steady === undefined) out.steady = Math.round((at() - 8) * 10) / 10; } else steadyN = 0;
      if (out.steady !== undefined && at() - out.steady > 30) { out.error = 'no mark 30 s after steady'; break; }
      await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
    }
  } else {
    // (the port's page: running, its first draws, its loader hidden — the mark of GoldSrc / re3)
    await page.waitForURL((u) => u.pathname.startsWith('/ports/'), { timeout: 60000 });
    for (;;) {
      if (Date.now() > deadline) { out.error = 'timeout before the game showed'; break; }
      const st = await page.evaluate(() => ({ state: window.portSession?.state, draws: window.renderProbe?.draws ?? 0, hidden: !!document.querySelector('#loader')?.classList.contains('hidden') })).catch(() => ({}));
      let draws = st.draws;
      if (rt === 'openmw') { const f = page.frames().find((x) => x.url().includes('/app/')); if (f) draws = await f.evaluate(() => window.renderProbe?.draws ?? 0).catch(() => 0); }
      if (out.firstFrame === null && draws > 0) out.firstFrame = at();
      if (st.state === 'error') { out.error = 'port error'; break; }
      if (rt === 'openmw' ? st.hidden && draws > 50 : st.hidden) { out.shown = at(); break; }
      // (the OpenMW page waits at its choices — state 'ready' — for Play solo: the click a player makes)
      if (rt === 'openmw' && st.state === 'ready' && page.url().includes('/ports/openmw/')) { if (out.soloAt === undefined) out.soloAt = at(); await page.click('#solo', { timeout: 1000 }).catch(() => {}); }
      await page.waitForTimeout(500);
    }
    if (!out.error) {
      if (await markSeen()) out.playable = at();
      if (rt === 'goldsrc') {
        await page.waitForFunction(() => window.portSession?.state === 'running', null, { timeout: Math.max(1000, deadline - Date.now()) }).catch(() => {});
        await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
        await page.evaluate((m) => window.portSession.command(`map ${m}`), man.goldsrc.solo.map).catch((e) => out.notes.push('map: ' + e.message));
        out.mapAt = at();
      } else if (rt === 're3') {
        const mode = man.modes?.[0] ?? null;
        if (mode !== 'free') {
          await page.waitForTimeout(4000);
          const c = await page.locator('#canvas').boundingBox();
          await page.mouse.click(c.x + c.width * 0.3, c.y / 2); await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
          for (const [fx, fy] of [[0.5, 0.401], [0.5, 0.365]]) { await page.mouse.move(c.x + fx * c.width, c.y + fy * c.height, { steps: 4 }); await page.waitForTimeout(400); await page.mouse.down(); await page.waitForTimeout(150); await page.mouse.up(); await page.waitForTimeout(2500); }
        }
        out.newGameAt = at();
      } else if (rt === 'openmw') {
        // (the main menu's New Game: the second button of the stack under the logo, keyboard first)
        await page.waitForTimeout(5000);
        const f = page.frameLocator('#game');
        const box = await page.locator('#game').boundingBox();
        if (opt('shot')) await page.screenshot({ path: opt('shot').replace(/\.png$/, '-menu.png') }).catch(() => {});
        const ng = (opt('newgame', '0.5,0.795')).split(',').map(Number);
        await page.mouse.click(box.x + box.width * ng[0], box.y + box.height * ng[1]); out.newGameAt = at();
        void f;
      }
      // in play: many draws a frame (a 3D scene) — and the mark (OpenMW: in the world)
      for (;;) {
        if (Date.now() > deadline) { out.error = 'timeout before play'; break; }
        if (out.playable === null && await markSeen()) out.playable = at();
        const r = await drawRate(3000);
        if (r.perFrame > 60 && (rt !== 'openmw' || out.playable !== null)) { out.inPlay = at(); break; }
      }
    }
  }
  if (opt('shot')) await page.screenshot({ path: opt('shot') }).catch(() => {});
} catch (e) { out.error = String(e.message ?? e).slice(0, 300); }
finally { out.wall = at(); await browser.close().catch(() => {}); }
console.log('RESULT ' + JSON.stringify(out));
fs.writeFileSync(opt('json', '/dev/null'), JSON.stringify(out));
```
