`tools/data-matrix.mjs`:

```mjs
// Data-system matrix (docs/slow-network.md "Measuring"): every version of the catalog (/api/manifests) × link, as a new
// player in a fresh browser. Each run gets its own Orthros server (this tree's code) over a fresh copy of a learned
// directory (the live server's, copied once by hand) and a frozen copy of its precompressed units (--br-cache-frozen:
// what a player meets now, the same for every run), behind the player's-link proxy (tools/net-proxy.mjs: HTTP/2, one
// shared link, a round trip per request, Cloudflare's Accept-Encoding); the browser run is tools/data-matrix-run.mjs
// through the browser slot guard. One JSON line per run in --out: the runner's times (first frame, shown, playable,
// in play), and from the proxy's log up to the playable mark (else the end): bytes on the wire by kind (page /src,
// engine, game data demand / background, APIs), requests, the share of /gamez answers from precompressed units, and the
// demand-wait seconds (the time at least one of the game's own reads — neither `p=1` nor `a=1` — was in flight).
//
//   node tools/data-matrix.mjs --pristine <dir with learn/ brcache/ covers/> [--links 85k:150,1m:60,7m:75]
//     [--only a,b] [--skip a,b] [--parallel 2] [--seconds 85k=1800,1m=900,7m=600] [--win32-seconds N] [--out results.jsonl] [--scratch <dir>]
//     [--games-dir /srv/orthros/data/games] [--engines-dir /srv/orthros/data/engines] [--lang <code>]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawn, execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { startProxy, summarize, spkiOf, freePort, startOrigin } from './net-proxy.mjs';
import { DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR } from '../src/host/game-catalog.js';
import { DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR } from '../src/host/goldsrc.js';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const args = process.argv.slice(2), opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const pristine = opt('pristine') && path.resolve(opt('pristine')); if (!pristine) { console.error('--pristine <dir> (learn/, brcache/, covers/)'); process.exit(2); }
// (absolute: the runner's cwd is this tree — a relative --json / --shot wrote its files into it)
const scratch = path.resolve(opt('scratch', path.join(path.dirname(pristine), 'runs')));
const gamesDir = opt('games-dir', DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR), enginesDir = opt('engines-dir', DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR);
const outFile = path.resolve(opt('out', path.join(scratch, 'results.jsonl')));
const parallel = Number(opt('parallel', 2));

/** a link name (85k, 1m, 7m: KB/s of 1000 bytes, MB/s of 10^6) and its round trip: { name, rate, rtt } */
export function parseLink(s) {
  const [n, rtt] = s.split(':'); const m = /^([\d.]+)([km])$/.exec(n);
  if (!m) throw new Error(`link ${s}: <n>k|<n>m[:rtt ms]`);
  return { name: n, rate: Number(m[1]) * (m[2] === 'k' ? 1e3 : 1e6), rtt: Number(rtt ?? 50) };
}
const links = opt('links', '85k:150,1m:60,7m:75').split(',').map(parseLink);
const secs = Object.fromEntries(opt('seconds', '85k=1800,1m=900,7m=600').split(',').map((kv) => kv.split('=')).map(([k, v]) => [k, Number(v)]));

// (the proxy log's summary, tools/net-proxy.mjs: here since the matrix; tools/prepare-bench.mjs takes it from here)
export { summarize };

async function one(m, link) {
  const tag = `${m.name}-${link.name}`, dir = path.join(scratch, tag);
  fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  execFileSync('cp', ['-a', path.join(pristine, 'learn'), path.join(dir, 'learn')]);
  const origin = await startOrigin({ tree: root, learn: path.join(dir, 'learn'), telemetry: path.join(dir, 'telemetry'), brcache: path.join(pristine, 'brcache'),
    covers: path.join(pristine, 'covers'), gamesDir, enginesDir, log: path.join(dir, 'server.log') });
  const sport = origin.port;
  const proxy = await startProxy({ upstream: `127.0.0.1:${sport}`, listen: 0, rate: link.rate, rtt: link.rtt, log: path.join(dir, 'proxy.jsonl'), certs: path.join(scratch, 'cert') });
  const lang = opt('lang') && m.languages.includes(opt('lang')) ? opt('lang') : m.languages.includes('en') ? 'en' : m.languages[0];
  // (--win32-seconds: a Win32 game's window — its menu's time on a loaded machine is the CPU's (SwiftShader), its data the
  // same window for every run)
  const seconds = (m.runtime ?? 'win32') === 'win32' && opt('win32-seconds') ? Number(opt('win32-seconds')) : secs[link.name] ?? 900;
  const runJson = path.join(dir, 'run.json');
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const res = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const p = spawn('bash', [path.join(root, 'tools/with-browser-slot.sh'), process.execPath, path.join(root, 'tools/data-matrix-run.mjs'), '--base', `https://127.0.0.1:${proxy.port}`, '--manifest', m.name,
      ...(lang ? ['--lang', lang] : []), '--spki', spkiOf(path.join(scratch, 'cert')), '--seconds', String(seconds), '--json', runJson, '--shot', path.join(dir, 'end.png')], { cwd: root, env: { ...process.env, NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED: '0' }, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
    let text = ''; p.stdout.on('data', (d) => { text += d; }); p.stderr.on('data', (d) => { text += d; });
    p.on('close', (code) => resolve({ code, text }));
  });
  await proxy.close(); await origin.close();
  let run = null; try { run = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(runJson, 'utf8')); } catch { /* its output's line */ }
  if (!run) { const m = /^RESULT (.*)$/m.exec(res.text); try { run = m ? JSON.parse(m[1]) : null; } catch { /* none */ } }
  run ??= { error: `runner exited ${res.code}: ${res.text.slice(-400)}` };
  const recs = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'proxy.jsonl'), 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => JSON.parse(l));
  const nav = recs.find((r) => !r.mark && r.url.startsWith('/?manifest='))?.t ?? 0;
  const mark = recs.find((r) => r.mark?.kind === 'playable' && r.url.endsWith('/' + encodeURIComponent(m.name)));
  const row = {
    manifest: m.name, runtime: m.runtime, lang, link: link.name, rtt: link.rtt, run,
    markS: mark ? Math.round((mark.t - nav) / 100) / 10 : null,
    toPlayable: summarize(recs, mark ? mark.t : Infinity), all: summarize(recs), slotWaitS: Math.round((Date.now() - t0) / 1000 - (run?.wall ?? 0)),
  };
  fs.appendFileSync(outFile, JSON.stringify(row) + '\n');
  // (the logs kept, small; the server's copies removed)
  fs.rmSync(path.join(dir, 'learn'), { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync(path.join(dir, 'telemetry'), { recursive: true, force: true });
  execFileSync('gzip', ['-f', path.join(dir, 'proxy.jsonl')]);
  console.log(`[matrix] ${tag}: first frame ${run?.firstFrame ?? '-'} s, shown ${run?.shown ?? '-'} s, playable ${row.markS ?? '-'} s, in play ${run?.inPlay ?? '-'} s; to playable ${row.toPlayable.wireMB} MB, ${row.toPlayable.requests} req, demand wait ${row.toPlayable.demandWaitS} s${run?.error ? ` (${run.error})` : ''}`);
  return row;
}

async function main() {
  fs.mkdirSync(scratch, { recursive: true });
  // (the catalog from a throwaway server over the pristine copy: every version, hidden ones too)
  const port = await freePort();
  const srv = spawn(process.execPath, [path.join(root, 'src/host/server.js'), '--port', String(port), '--games-dir', gamesDir, '--engines-dir', enginesDir], { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'inherit'] });
  await new Promise((r) => { srv.stdout.on('data', (d) => { if (String(d).includes('orthros: http')) r(); }); setTimeout(r, 20000); });
  const catalog = await (await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/manifests`)).json(); srv.kill();
  const only = opt('only')?.split(','), skip = opt('skip')?.split(',') ?? [];
  const jobs = [];
  for (const link of links) for (const m of catalog) if (m.available && (!only || only.includes(m.name)) && !skip.includes(m.name)) jobs.push([m, link]);
  console.log(`[matrix] ${jobs.length} runs, ${parallel} at a time`);
  const running = new Set();
  for (const [m, link] of jobs) {
    while (running.size >= parallel) await Promise.race(running);
    const p = one(m, link).catch((e) => console.log(`[matrix] ${m.name}-${link.name}: ${e.stack ?? e}`)).finally(() => running.delete(p));
    running.add(p);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000));
  }
  await Promise.all(running);
}
if (process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) main();

```

`tools/disk-check.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Disk budget of Orthros' scratch on this shared server (CLAUDE.md, "Disk budget"): exits 1 with a message when the
# scratch (/tmp/orthros-scratch + the agent worktrees in .claude/worktrees) exceeds ORTHROS_SCRATCH_GB (default 30) or
# the disk holding /tmp is fuller than ORTHROS_DISK_MAX_PCT (default 85). Prints the usage otherwise.
# Usage: tools/disk-check.sh [-q]
set -u
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
max_gb=${ORTHROS_SCRATCH_GB:-30}
max_pct=${ORTHROS_DISK_MAX_PCT:-85}
dirs=()
for d in /tmp/orthros-scratch "$root/.claude/worktrees"; do [ -d "$d" ] && dirs+=("$d"); done
used_kb=0
[ ${#dirs[@]} -gt 0 ] && used_kb=$(du -sk "${dirs[@]}" 2>/dev/null | awk '{s += $1} END {print s + 0}')
used_gb=$(( used_kb / 1048576 ))
pct=$(df --output=pcent /tmp | tail -1 | tr -dc '0-9')
msg="Orthros scratch ${used_gb} GB of ${max_gb} GB; disk ${pct}% used (max ${max_pct}%)"
if [ "$used_gb" -ge "$max_gb" ] || [ "$pct" -ge "$max_pct" ]; then
  echo "disk-check: OVER BUDGET — $msg. Clean up your finished test outputs and merged worktrees first (CLAUDE.md, Disk budget)." >&2
  du -sh "${dirs[@]}" "$root"/.claude/worktrees/* 2>/dev/null | sort -rh | head -12 >&2
  exit 1
fi
[ "${1:-}" = "-q" ] || echo "disk-check: $msg"
exit 0

```

`tools/draw-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
// Direct3D 9 draw submission through the WebGL backend over a GL that only counts its calls: the JavaScript cost per
// draw of the device + backend (state application, uniforms, attributes, buffers) and the GL calls a draw issues, by
// name. A frame shaped like a game's: per draw a few render / stage / sampler state changes, a world matrix, shader
// constants, sometimes a texture, stream or index buffer change, a dynamic vertex buffer locked and filled.
// Usage: node tools/draw-bench.mjs [draws per frame (150)] [frames (400)] [--calls]
import { d3dEnv } from '../tests/d3d-random.js';
import { createWebGLBackend } from '../src/gfx/d3d8-webgl.js';

const DRAWS = Number(process.argv[2] ?? 150), FRAMES = Number(process.argv[3] ?? 400), SHOW = process.argv.includes('--calls');
const counts = new Map();
let total = 0;
function countingGl() {
  const base = { canvas: { width: 1024, height: 768 }, drawingBufferWidth: 1024, drawingBufferHeight: 768 };
  const enums = new Map(), E = (n) => { let v = enums.get(n); if (v === undefined) enums.set(n, (v = 0x1000 + enums.size)); return v; };
  // programs know their uniforms from the sources (the backend looks every active uniform up by name)
  const src = new WeakMap(), attached = new WeakMap(), uniforms = (prog) => {
    const out = [];
    for (const sh of attached.get(prog) ?? []) for (const m of (src.get(sh) ?? '').matchAll(/uniform\s+(?:(?:lowp|mediump|highp)\s+)?\w+\s+(\w+)(\[\d+\])?/g)) { const n = m[1] + (m[2] ? '[0]' : ''); if (!out.includes(n)) out.push(n); }
    return out;
  };
  const own = {
    shaderSource: (sh, s) => { src.set(sh, s); },
    attachShader: (p, sh) => { (attached.get(p) ?? attached.set(p, []).get(p)).push(sh); },
    getProgramParameter: (p, q) => (q === E('ACTIVE_UNIFORMS') ? uniforms(p).length : q === E('ACTIVE_ATTRIBUTES') ? 0 : true),
    getActiveUniform: (p, i) => ({ name: uniforms(p)[i], size: 1, type: 0 }),
    getShaderParameter: () => true, getExtension: () => null, getParameter: () => 0, getError: () => 0,
    getUniformLocation: (p, n) => ({ n }), getProgramInfoLog: () => '', getShaderInfoLog: () => '', checkFramebufferStatus: () => E('FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE'),
    getSyncParameter: () => E('SIGNALED'), isEnabled: () => false,
  };
  // (a plain object: a name is resolved once by the prototype proxy, then read as an own property as WebGL's are)
  const gl = Object.create(new Proxy({}, {
    get(t, k, recv) {
      if (typeof k !== 'string') return undefined;
      let v;
      if (/^[A-Z0-9_]+$/.test(k)) v = k === 'TEXTURE0' ? 0x84c0 : E(k);
      else { const o = own[k]; v = (...a) => { total++; counts.set(k, (counts.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); return o ? o(...a) : {}; }; }
      Object.defineProperty(recv, k, { value: v, writable: true });
      return v;
    },
  }));
  return Object.assign(gl, base);
}

function session() {
  const backend = createWebGLBackend({ getContext: () => countingGl() }, () => {});
  const E = d3dEnv(backend), { mem, ctx, com } = E;
  const out = E.alloc(64), scratch = E.alloc(4096);
  const pp = E.alloc(64); [1024, 768, 22, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 75, 0, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(pp + 4 * i, v));
  const d3dPtr = E.defs.Direct3DCreate9[1](ctx([32]));
  com.implAt(d3dPtr).CreateDevice(ctx([d3dPtr, 0, 1, 0, 0x40, pp, out]));
  const devPtr = mem.read32(out), dev = com.implAt(devPtr);
  const c = ctx([devPtr]), call = (name, ...a) => { const A = c.args; for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) A[i] = a[i - 1] ?? 0; return dev[name](c); };
  const comCall = (ptr, name, ...a) => com.implAt(ptr)[name](ctx([ptr, ...a]));
  const tex = [], vbs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) { call('CreateTexture', 64, 64, 1, 0, 21, 1, out); tex.push(mem.read32(out)); }
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { call('CreateVertexBuffer', 65536, 0x208, 0, 0, out); vbs.push(mem.read32(out)); }
  call('CreateVertexBuffer', 1 << 20, 0x208, 0, 0, out); const dyn = mem.read32(out);
  call('CreateIndexBuffer', 65536, 0x8, 101, 0, out); const ib = mem.read32(out);
  call('SetFVF', 0x152); call('SetIndices', ib);
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) mem.writeF32(scratch + 4 * i, i * 0.25);
  let k = 0, dynPos = 0;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  for (let f = 0; f < FRAMES; f++) {
    call('BeginScene');
    for (let d = 0; d < DRAWS; d++, k++) {
      call('SetRenderState', 27, k & 1); call('SetRenderState', 19, 5 + (k & 1)); call('SetRenderState', 20, 6); call('SetRenderState', 15, (k >> 1) & 1);
      call('SetTextureStageState', 0, 1, 4 + (k & 1)); call('SetTextureStageState', 1, 1, 1); call('SetSamplerState', 0, 5, 2); call('SetSamplerState', 0, 6, 2 + (k & 1));
      mem.writeF32(scratch + 48, k); call('SetTransform', 256, scratch);
      if ((k & 3) === 0) call('SetTexture', 0, tex[k % tex.length]);
      if ((k & 7) === 0) call('SetStreamSource', 0, vbs[k % vbs.length], 0, 36);
      if ((k & 15) === 5) { // a dynamic buffer filled with NOOVERWRITE / DISCARD
        const bytes = 36 * 64, flags = dynPos + bytes > (1 << 20) ? 0x2000 : 0x1000; if (flags === 0x2000) dynPos = 0;
        comCall(dyn, 'Lock', dynPos, bytes, out, flags); mem.fill(mem.read32(out), bytes, k & 0xff); comCall(dyn, 'Unlock');
        call('SetStreamSource', 0, dyn, dynPos, 36); dynPos += bytes;
      }
      call('DrawIndexedPrimitive', 4, 0, 0, 100, 0, 50);
    }
    call('EndScene'); call('Present', 0, 0, 0, 0);
  }
  return performance.now() - t0;
}
const runs = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { counts.clear(); total = 0; runs.push(session()); }
const best = Math.min(...runs.slice(1));
console.log(`${(best * 1000 / (DRAWS * FRAMES)).toFixed(3)} us per draw (best of ${runs.length - 1}; device + backend, GL calls counted only), ${(total / (DRAWS * FRAMES)).toFixed(2)} GL calls per draw`);
if (SHOW) for (const [n, v] of [...counts].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])) console.log(`  ${n.padEnd(28)} ${(v / (DRAWS * FRAMES)).toFixed(3)} per draw`);

```

`tools/effect-bind-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
// Cost of D3DX effect parameters and shader binding (setters, BeginPass / CommitChanges: parameters laid out into
// constant registers, compared with the device's, sampler parameters applied) on a game-shaped load: two effects sharing
// a Direct3D 9 device, a vertex shader with matrices (rows and columns), a bone array, a struct array, vectors, a bool
// and an int, a preshader, a pixel shader with vectors, a scalar and four sampler parameters. Per frame, OBJECTS objects
// in groups of GROUP (Begin / BeginPass, then per object its parameters set — most to the values they hold, as games do
// — and CommitChanges), alternating the effects. Prints µs per frame and ns per shader bind (CPU time of the process,
// setters included), for this tree, this tree with dbg:ORTHROS_FX_BIND_OFF=1 (the binding before the raw-word path) and
// with dbg:ORTHROS_API_OPT_OFF=1 (the reference path), and with --base <tree> another checkout — alternated in one
// process (--only <prefix>: one of them).
// Usage: node tools/effect-bind-bench.mjs [--base /path/to/other/tree] [--only branch|fx|ref|base] [--objects 300] [--frames 300] [--rounds 7] [--group 10]
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import path from 'node:path';
import { effectBinary, shader, op } from '../tests/fx-build.js';
import { PT, PC } from '../src/win32/d3dx9-fxparse.js';

const argv = process.argv.slice(2), opt = (k, d) => { const i = argv.indexOf(k); return i >= 0 ? argv[i + 1] : d; };
const OBJECTS = Number(opt('--objects', 300)), FRAMES = Number(opt('--frames', 300)), ROUNDS = Number(opt('--rounds', 7)), GROUP = Number(opt('--group', 10));
const BASE = opt('--base', null), HERE = path.resolve(path.dirname(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname), '..');

const F = PT.FLOAT, MC = PC.MATRIX_COLUMNS, V = PC.VECTOR;
function fxDesc(k) {
  const lights = { cls: PC.STRUCT, type: PT.VOID, elements: 3, members: [{ name: 'Dir', t: { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 3 } }, { name: 'Color', t: { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 4 } }] };
  const vsConsts = [
    ['ViewProj', 2, 0, 4, { cls: MC, type: F, rows: 4, cols: 4 }], ['World', 2, 4, 3, { cls: PC.MATRIX_ROWS, type: F, rows: 3, cols: 4 }],
    ['Bones', 2, 7, 48, { cls: MC, type: F, rows: 4, cols: 3, elements: 16 }], ['EyePos', 2, 55, 1, { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 3 }],
    ['Lights', 2, 56, 6, lights], ['Diffuse', 2, 62, 1, { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 4 }], ['Fog', 2, 63, 1, { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 4 }],
    ['HasShadow', 0, 0, 1, { cls: PC.SCALAR, type: PT.BOOL }], ['NumLights', 1, 0, 1, { cls: PC.SCALAR, type: PT.INT }],
  ];
  const pre = { literals: [0.5, 2], insns: [[0x1080, 1, [{ table: 2, offset: 0 }], { table: 4, offset: 0 }], [0x2050, 1, [{ table: 2, offset: 0 }, { table: 1, offset: 1 }], { table: 4, offset: 1 }]],
    inputs: [['Time', 2, 0, 1, { cls: PC.SCALAR, type: F }]], outRanges: [[64, 1]] };
  const psConsts = [['Diffuse', 2, 0, 1, { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 4 }], ['Spec', 2, 1, 1, { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 4 }], ['Shadow', 2, 2, 1, { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 4 }], ['Alpha', 2, 3, 1, { cls: PC.SCALAR, type: F }],
    ...[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => [`S${i}`, 3, i, 1, { cls: PC.OBJECT, type: PT.SAMPLER2D }])];
  const params = [
    { name: 'ViewProj', t: vsConsts[0][4] }, { name: 'World', t: vsConsts[1][4] }, { name: 'Bones', t: vsConsts[2][4] }, { name: 'EyePos', t: vsConsts[3][4] },
    { name: 'Lights', t: lights }, { name: 'Diffuse', t: vsConsts[5][4] }, { name: 'Fog', t: vsConsts[6][4] }, { name: 'HasShadow', t: vsConsts[7][4] }, { name: 'NumLights', t: vsConsts[8][4] },
    { name: 'Time', t: { cls: PC.SCALAR, type: F } }, { name: 'Spec', t: psConsts[1][4] }, { name: 'Shadow', t: psConsts[2][4] }, { name: 'Alpha', t: psConsts[3][4] },
    ...[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => ({ name: `T${i}`, t: { cls: PC.OBJECT, type: PT.TEXTURE } })),
    ...[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => ({ name: `S${i}`, t: { cls: PC.OBJECT, type: PT.SAMPLER2D }, samplers: [[[op('texture'), 0, `T${i}`], [op('samp', 1), 0, 1 + (i & 1)], [op('samp', 2), 0, 1], [op('samp', 5), 0, 2], [op('samp', 6), 0, 2], [op('samp', 7), 0, k + 1]]] })),
  ];
  const states = [{ op: op('vs'), value: shader(true, vsConsts, pre) }, { op: op('ps'), value: shader(false, psConsts) },
    { op: op('rs', 7), value: 1 }, { op: op('rs', 14), value: 1 }, { op: op('rs', 27), value: k }, { op: op('rs', 22), value: 3 }];
  return effectBinary({ params, techniques: [{ name: 'T', passes: [{ name: 'P', states }] }] });
}

async function makeSession(root, refPath) {
  const imp = (p) => import(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, p)).href);
  const [{ d3dEnv }, { defineEffects }, { apiOpt }] = await Promise.all([imp('tests/d3d-random.js'), imp('src/win32/d3dx9-effect.js'), imp('src/core/api-opt.js')]);
  const E = d3dEnv({ createDevice: () => null }), { mem, ctx, com, vm } = E;
  const out = E.alloc(64), pp = E.alloc(64);
  [1024, 768, 22, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 75, 0, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(pp + 4 * i, v));
  const d3d = E.defs.Direct3DCreate9[1](ctx([32]));
  com.implAt(d3d).CreateDevice(ctx([d3d, 0, 1, 0, 0x40, pp, out]));
  const devPtr = mem.read32(out), dev = com.implAt(devPtr);
  const call = (name, ...a) => dev[name](ctx([devPtr, ...a]));
  Object.assign(vm, { effectCtx: null, callGuest: () => 0, log: () => {} });
  const X = {}; com.interface ??= () => {};
  defineEffects(X, vm, { callMethod: (c, self, name, args) => com.implAt(self)[name](ctx([self, ...args])), textBuffer: () => 0 });
  const tex = []; for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { call('CreateTexture', 64, 64, 1, 0, 21, 1, out, 0); tex.push(mem.read32(out)); }
  const fxs = [0, 1].map((k) => {
    const bytes = fxDesc(k), src = E.alloc(bytes.length); mem.writeBytes(src, bytes);
    if (X.D3DXCreateEffect[1](ctx([devPtr, src, bytes.length, 0, 0, 0, 0, out, 0])) !== 0) throw new Error('effect not created');
    const ptr = mem.read32(out), fx = com.implAt(ptr), fc = (...a) => ctx([ptr, ...a]);
    const h = (s) => { const p = E.alloc(s.length + 1); mem.writeCString(p, s); return fx.GetParameterByName(fc(0, p)) >>> 0; };
    const H = Object.fromEntries(['ViewProj', 'World', 'Bones', 'EyePos', 'Lights', 'Diffuse', 'Fog', 'HasShadow', 'NumLights', 'Time', 'Spec', 'Shadow', 'Alpha'].map((n) => [n, h(n)]));
    H.T = [0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => h(`T${i}`));
    return { fx, fc, H };
  });
  // (the values the frames set, written to guest memory once: MATS matrices, VECS vectors, bone palettes)
  const MATS = 509, VECS = 61, PALS = 7, mats = E.alloc(64 * MATS), vecs = E.alloc(16 * VECS), bones = E.alloc(1024 * PALS), nPasses = E.alloc(4);
  for (let m = 0; m < MATS; m++) for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) mem.writeF32(mats + 64 * m + 4 * i, (i % 5 === 0 ? 1 : 0) + (i === 12 ? m : 0) + (i === 13 ? m * 0.5 : 0));
  for (let v = 0; v < VECS; v++) for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) mem.writeF32(vecs + 16 * v + 4 * i, ((v * 7 + i) % 9) * 0.125);
  for (let i = 0; i < 256 * PALS; i++) mem.writeF32(bones + 4 * i, (i % 11) * 0.25);
  // (a bound argument holder per effect: the calls cost what the effect runtime does, not the benchmark)
  for (const e of fxs) { const c = e.fc(); e.c = (a1 = 0, a2 = 0, a3 = 0) => { c.args[1] = a1; c.args[2] = a2; c.args[3] = a3; return c; }; }
  let k = 0, fn = 0;
  // (as games do: every parameter set again per object, most with the values they hold — the camera and time per
  // frame, the material every few objects — the world matrix new per object)
  const frame = () => {
    call('BeginScene'); fn++;
    for (let o = 0; o < OBJECTS; o += GROUP) {
      const { fx, c, H } = fxs[(o / GROUP) & 1];
      for (let s = 0; s < 4; s++) fx.SetTexture(c(H.T[s], tex[(k + s) % tex.length]));
      fx.Begin(c(nPasses, 1)); fx.BeginPass(c(0));
      for (let j = 0; j < GROUP; j++, k++) {
        fx.SetMatrix(c(H.ViewProj, mats + 64 * (fn % MATS)));
        fx.SetVector(c(H.EyePos, vecs + 16 * (fn % VECS)));
        fx.SetFloat(c(H.Time, 0x3f000000 + (fn & 0xff)));
        fx.SetMatrixTranspose(c(H.World, mats + 64 * ((k * 3) % MATS)));
        fx.SetVector(c(H.Diffuse, vecs + 16 * ((k >> 2) % VECS)));
        fx.SetMatrixTransposeArray(c(H.Bones, bones + 1024 * ((k >> 2) % PALS), 16));
        if ((k & 7) === 0) fx.SetTexture(c(H.T[0], tex[k % tex.length]));
        fx.CommitChanges(c());
      }
      fx.EndPass(c()); fx.End(c());
    }
    call('EndScene');
  };
  const run = () => {
    const was = [apiOpt.off, apiOpt.fxRef]; apiOpt.off = refPath === 'off'; apiOpt.fxRef = !!refPath;
    try { const t0 = process.cpuUsage(); for (let f = 0; f < FRAMES; f++) frame(); const d = process.cpuUsage(t0); return (d.user + d.system) / FRAMES; } finally { [apiOpt.off, apiOpt.fxRef] = was; }
  };
  // the state the frames leave: constants (raw words) and sampler states, to check the variants agree
  const state = () => JSON.stringify([Array.from(new Uint32Array(dev.vsConst.buffer).subarray(0, 4 * 65)), Array.from(new Uint32Array(dev.psConst.buffer).subarray(0, 16)), Array.from(dev.vsConstI.subarray(0, 4)), dev.vsConstB[0], dev.textures.slice(0, 4), [0, 1, 2, 3].map((r) => [1, 2, 5, 6, 7].map((t) => dev.samplers[r].get(t)))]);
  return { run, state };
}

let variants = [['branch', HERE, false], ['fx (FX_BIND_OFF)', HERE, 'fx'], ['ref (API_OPT_OFF)', HERE, 'off']];
if (BASE) variants.push(['base', path.resolve(BASE), false]);
if (opt('--only', null)) variants = variants.filter((v) => v[0].startsWith(opt('--only')));
const sessions = [];
for (const [name, root, ref] of variants) sessions.push({ name, s: await makeSession(root, ref), res: [] });
for (let r = 0; r < ROUNDS; r++) for (const v of sessions) v.res.push(v.s.run());
const st = sessions.map((v) => v.s.state());
for (let i = 1; i < st.length; i++) if (st[i] !== st[0]) console.log(`warning: ${sessions[i].name} left another device state than ${sessions[0].name}`);
const binds = OBJECTS * 2; // (two shaders per BeginPass / CommitChanges)
const med = (a) => { const s = [...a].slice(1).sort((x, y) => x - y); return s[s.length >> 1]; };
console.log(`effect binds: ${OBJECTS} objects x ${FRAMES} frames, ${ROUNDS} rounds (median, first round dropped)`);
for (const v of sessions) console.log(`  ${v.name.padEnd(18)} ${med(v.res).toFixed(0).padStart(6)} us/frame  ${(med(v.res) * 1000 / binds).toFixed(0).padStart(5)} ns/bind  [${v.res.map((x) => x.toFixed(0)).join(' ')}]`);

```

`tools/effect-object-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
// Cost of D3DX effect calls per drawn object, the way an engine drawing each object with its material's effect calls
// them: per object its effect's technique set, its parameters set (most to the values they hold), Begin (render states
// saved), BeginPass, then per mesh part new parameters and CommitChanges, EndPass, End — with a few device states set
// directly between objects, as engines do. EFFECTS effects share a Direct3D 9 device (runs of RUN objects per effect),
// each a technique whose pass picks its vertex shader in an array by an expression of a parameter (a bone count), with
// preshaders, render states from constants, parameters and expressions, and two sampler parameters. Prints µs per frame
// and per object (CPU time of the process, effect calls only — no draw), for this tree, this tree with
// dbg:ORTHROS_API_OPT_OFF=1 (the reference path) and with --base <tree> another checkout, alternated in one process
// (--only <prefix>: one of them). Every variant must leave the same device state (checked).
// --jit: the calls made by guest code run through the JIT instead (frames of generated x86 calling the methods' thunks),
// the deferred queue drained before every call handled in JavaScript as the VM does — what the queued calls save shows
// (no drawing: the device's draws are not called). Under `perf stat -e instructions:u`, a measure insensitive to load.
// Usage: node tools/effect-object-bench.mjs [--base /path/to/other/tree] [--only branch|ref|base] [--jit [--no-defer]] [--objects 40] [--frames 1500] [--rounds 7] [--parts 4] [--effects 6] [--run 3]
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import path from 'node:path';
import { effectBinary, shader, op } from '../tests/fx-build.js';
import { PT, PC } from '../src/win32/d3dx9-fxparse.js';

const argv = process.argv.slice(2), opt = (k, d) => { const i = argv.indexOf(k); return i >= 0 ? argv[i + 1] : d; };
const OBJECTS = Number(opt('--objects', 40)), FRAMES = Number(opt('--frames', 1500)), ROUNDS = Number(opt('--rounds', 7)), PARTS = Number(opt('--parts', 4));
const EFFECTS = Number(opt('--effects', 6)), RUN = Number(opt('--run', 3));
const BASE = opt('--base', null), HERE = path.resolve(path.dirname(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname), '..'), JIT = argv.includes('--jit');

const F = PT.FLOAT, MC = PC.MATRIX_COLUMNS, V = PC.VECTOR, S = PC.SCALAR;
const T = {
  ViewProj: { cls: MC, type: F, rows: 4, cols: 4 }, World: { cls: PC.MATRIX_ROWS, type: F, rows: 3, cols: 4 }, Bones: { cls: MC, type: F, rows: 4, cols: 3, elements: 16 },
  EyePos: { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 3 }, LightDir: { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 3, elements: 3 }, LightColor: { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 4, elements: 3 },
  Ambient: { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 4 }, Diffuse: { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 4 }, Fog: { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 4 }, Time: { cls: S, type: F },
  Opacity: { cls: S, type: F }, NumBones: { cls: S, type: PT.INT }, AlphaRef: { cls: S, type: PT.INT }, Shadow: { cls: V, type: F, rows: 1, cols: 4 },
};
const tex = { cls: PC.OBJECT, type: PT.TEXTURE }, samplerT = { cls: PC.OBJECT, type: PT.SAMPLER2D };
// expressions: out = (input >= 1 ? 1 : 0) — an array index from NumBones (0..2: min(NumBones, 2)), a bool from Opacity < 1
const ge = (lit) => ({ literals: [lit], insns: [[0x2030, 1, [{ table: 2, offset: 0 }, { table: 1, offset: 0 }], { table: 4, offset: 0 }]] });
const lt1 = { literals: [1], insns: [[0x2020, 1, [{ table: 2, offset: 0 }, { table: 1, offset: 0 }], { table: 4, offset: 0 }]] };
const minIdx = { literals: [2], insns: [[0x2000, 1, [{ table: 2, offset: 0 }, { table: 1, offset: 0 }], { table: 4, offset: 0 }]] };
const input = (name, t) => [[name, 2, 0, 1, t]];

function fxDesc(k) {
  const vsConsts = (bones) => [
    ['ViewProj', 2, 0, 4, T.ViewProj], ['World', 2, 4, 3, T.World], ['EyePos', 2, 7, 1, T.EyePos], ['LightDir', 2, 8, 3, T.LightDir], ['LightColor', 2, 11, 3, T.LightColor],
    ['Ambient', 2, 14, 1, T.Ambient], ['Fog', 2, 15, 1, T.Fog], ...(bones ? [['Bones', 2, 16, 3 * bones, { ...T.Bones, elements: bones }]] : []),
  ];
  const pre = { literals: [0.5, 2], insns: [[0x1080, 1, [{ table: 2, offset: 0 }], { table: 4, offset: 0 }], [0x2050, 1, [{ table: 2, offset: 0 }, { table: 1, offset: 1 }], { table: 4, offset: 1 }]],
    inputs: input('Time', T.Time), outRanges: [[64, 1]] };
  const vss = [0, 4, 16].map((b) => shader(true, vsConsts(b), pre));
  const ps = shader(false, [['Diffuse', 2, 0, 1, T.Diffuse], ['Shadow', 2, 1, 1, T.Shadow], ['Opacity', 2, 2, 1, T.Opacity], ['S0', 3, 0, 1, samplerT], ['S1', 3, 1, 1, samplerT]],
    { literals: [0.25], insns: [[0x2050, 1, [{ table: 2, offset: 0 }, { table: 1, offset: 0 }], { table: 4, offset: 12 }]], inputs: input('Opacity', T.Opacity), outRanges: [[3, 1]] });
  const params = [
    ...Object.entries(T).map(([name, t]) => ({ name, t })),
    { name: 'VSArr', t: { cls: PC.OBJECT, type: PT.VERTEXSHADER, elements: 3 }, shaders: vss },
    { name: 'T0', t: tex }, { name: 'T1', t: tex },
    { name: 'S0', t: samplerT, samplers: [[[op('texture'), 0, 'T0'], [op('samp', 1), 0, 1], [op('samp', 2), 0, 1], [op('samp', 5), 0, 2], [op('samp', 6), 0, 2], [op('samp', 7), 0, 2]]] },
    { name: 'S1', t: samplerT, samplers: [[[op('texture'), 0, 'T1'], [op('samp', 1), 0, 3], [op('samp', 2), 0, 3], [op('samp', 5), 0, 1 + (k & 1)], [op('samp', 6), 0, 2]]] },
  ];
  const states = [
    { op: op('vs'), select: { array: 'VSArr', expr: { ...minIdx, inputs: input('NumBones', T.NumBones) } } }, { op: op('ps'), value: ps },
    { op: op('rs', 7), value: 1 }, { op: op('rs', 14), value: k & 1 }, { op: op('rs', 22), value: 2 + (k % 2) }, { op: op('rs', 28), value: 1 },
    { op: op('rs', 27), expr: { ...lt1, inputs: input('Opacity', T.Opacity) } }, { op: op('rs', 19), value: 5 }, { op: op('rs', 20), value: 6 },
    { op: op('rs', 15), expr: { ...ge(0.5), inputs: input('Opacity', T.Opacity) } }, { op: op('rs', 24), ref: 'AlphaRef' }, { op: op('rs', 25), value: 7 },
    { op: op('sampler'), index: 0, ref: 'S0' }, { op: op('sampler'), index: 1, ref: 'S1' },
  ];
  return effectBinary({ params, techniques: [{ name: 'T', passes: [{ name: 'P', states }] }] });
}

async function makeSession(root, refPath) {
  const imp = (p) => import(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, p)).href);
  const [{ d3dEnv }, { defineEffects }, { apiOpt }] = await Promise.all([imp('tests/d3d-random.js'), imp('src/win32/d3dx9-effect.js'), imp('src/core/api-opt.js')]);
  const E = d3dEnv({ createDevice: () => null }), { mem, ctx, com, vm } = E;
  const out = E.alloc(64), pp = E.alloc(64);
  [1024, 768, 22, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 75, 0, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(pp + 4 * i, v));
  const d3d = E.defs.Direct3DCreate9[1](ctx([32]));
  com.implAt(d3d).CreateDevice(ctx([d3d, 0, 1, 0, 0x40, pp, out]));
  const devPtr = mem.read32(out), dev = com.implAt(devPtr);
  const dc = ctx([devPtr, 0, 0, 0, 0]), call = (name, a1 = 0, a2 = 0, a3 = 0) => { dc.args[1] = a1; dc.args[2] = a2; dc.args[3] = a3; return dev[name](dc); };
  Object.assign(vm, { effectCtx: null, callGuest: () => 0, log: () => {} });
  const X = {}; com.interface ??= () => {};
  defineEffects(X, vm, { callMethod: (c, self, name, args) => com.implAt(self)[name](ctx([self, ...args])), textBuffer: () => 0 });
  const texs = []; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { dev.CreateTexture(ctx([devPtr, 64, 64, 1, 0, 21, 1, out, 0])); texs.push(mem.read32(out)); }
  const fxs = Array.from({ length: EFFECTS }, (_, k) => {
    const bytes = fxDesc(k), src = E.alloc(bytes.length); mem.writeBytes(src, bytes);
    if (X.D3DXCreateEffect[1](ctx([devPtr, src, bytes.length, 0, 0, 0, 0, out, 0])) !== 0) throw new Error('effect not created');
    const ptr = mem.read32(out), fx = com.implAt(ptr), fc = (...a) => ctx([ptr, ...a]);
    const h = (s) => { const p = E.alloc(s.length + 1); mem.writeCString(p, s); return fx.GetParameterByName(fc(0, p)) >>> 0; };
    const H = Object.fromEntries([...Object.keys(T), 'T0', 'T1'].map((n) => [n, h(n)]));
    const tp = E.alloc(4); mem.writeCString(tp, 'T');
    const c = fc(0, 0, 0);
    return { fx, H, tech: fx.GetTechniqueByName(fc(tp)) >>> 0, c: (a1 = 0, a2 = 0, a3 = 0) => { c.args[1] = a1; c.args[2] = a2; c.args[3] = a3; return c; } };
  });
  // (the values the frames set, in guest memory: matrices, vectors, bone palettes)
  const MATS = 509, VECS = 61, PALS = 7, mats = E.alloc(64 * MATS), vecs = E.alloc(16 * VECS), bones = E.alloc(1024 * PALS), nPasses = E.alloc(4);
  for (let m = 0; m < MATS; m++) for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) mem.writeF32(mats + 64 * m + 4 * i, (i % 5 === 0 ? 1 : 0) + (i === 12 ? m : 0) + (i === 13 ? m * 0.5 : 0));
  for (let v = 0; v < VECS; v++) for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) mem.writeF32(vecs + 16 * v + 4 * i, ((v * 7 + i) % 9) * 0.125);
  for (let i = 0; i < 256 * PALS; i++) mem.writeF32(bones + 4 * i, (i % 11) * 0.25);
  const f32 = new Float32Array(1), u32 = new Uint32Array(f32.buffer), fw = (x) => { f32[0] = x; return u32[0]; };
  let k = 0, fn = 0;
  const frame = () => {
    call('BeginScene'); fn++;
    for (let o = 0; o < OBJECTS; o++, k++) {
      const e = fxs[((o / RUN) | 0) % EFFECTS], { fx, c, H } = e;
      // (the engine's own device states between objects: a few changes, mostly the values held)
      call('SetRenderState', 7, 1); call('SetRenderState', 27, k & 1); call('SetTextureStageState', 0, 1, 2 + (k & 1)); call('SetSamplerState', 2, 5, 2);
      fx.SetTechnique(c(e.tech));
      fx.SetMatrix(c(H.ViewProj, mats + 64 * (fn % MATS)));
      fx.SetVector(c(H.EyePos, vecs + 16 * (fn % VECS)));
      for (let l = 0; l < 3; l++) fx.SetVector(c(H.LightDir, vecs + 16 * ((fn + l) % VECS))); // (an element would be by its own handle: the whole array's first here)
      fx.SetVector(c(H.LightColor, vecs + 16 * 3)); fx.SetVector(c(H.Ambient, vecs + 16 * 4)); fx.SetVector(c(H.Fog, vecs + 16 * 5));
      fx.SetFloat(c(H.Time, fw((fn & 0xff) / 64)));
      fx.SetFloat(c(H.Opacity, fw((k % 7) === 0 ? 0.5 : 1)));
      fx.SetInt(c(H.NumBones, (k % 5) === 0 ? 4 : (k % 5) === 1 ? 1 : 0));
      fx.SetInt(c(H.AlphaRef, 96 + (k & 1)));
      fx.SetTexture(c(H.T0, texs[(k >> 1) % texs.length])); fx.SetTexture(c(H.T1, texs[(k * 3) % texs.length]));
      fx.Begin(c(nPasses, 6)); fx.BeginPass(c(0));
      for (let j = 0; j < PARTS; j++) {
        fx.SetMatrixTranspose(c(H.World, mats + 64 * ((k * 3 + j) % MATS)));
        fx.SetVector(c(H.Diffuse, vecs + 16 * ((k + j) % VECS)));
        fx.SetVector(c(H.Shadow, vecs + 16 * 7));
        if ((k % 5) === 0) fx.SetMatrixTransposeArray(c(H.Bones, bones + 1024 * ((k + j) % PALS), 16));
        fx.CommitChanges(c());
      }
      fx.EndPass(c()); fx.End(c());
    }
    call('EndScene');
  };
  const run = () => {
    const was = [apiOpt.off, apiOpt.fxRef]; apiOpt.off = !!refPath; apiOpt.fxRef = !!refPath;
    try { const t0 = process.cpuUsage(); for (let f = 0; f < FRAMES; f++) frame(); const d = process.cpuUsage(t0); return (d.user + d.system) / FRAMES; } finally { [apiOpt.off, apiOpt.fxRef] = was; }
  };
  // the state the frames leave: constants (raw words), render / sampler states, textures, shaders
  const state = () => JSON.stringify([Array.from(new Uint32Array(dev.vsConst.buffer).subarray(0, 4 * 70)), Array.from(new Uint32Array(dev.psConst.buffer).subarray(0, 16)),
    [7, 14, 15, 19, 20, 22, 24, 25, 27, 28].map((s) => dev.rs.get(s)), dev.textures.slice(0, 2), [0, 1, 2].map((r) => [1, 2, 5, 6, 7].map((t) => dev.samplers[r].get(t))),
    dev.vsObj?.code?.length ?? 0, dev.psObj?.code?.length ?? 0, dev.tss[0].get(1)]);
  return { run, state };
}

/**
 * --jit: the same frames as guest code (CYCLE different frames, repeated) calling the methods' thunks through the JIT of
 * tree `root`; a minimal VM (full guest memory, COM objects of 24 bytes as com.js makes them) built from that tree's modules.
 */
async function makeJitSession(root) {
  const imp = (p) => import(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, p)).href);
  const [{ GuestMemory, THUNK_BASE }, { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F: FL }, { Interp }, { Jit }, R, { registerDirect3D9 }, { registerDirect3D8 }, { defineEffects }] = await Promise.all(
    ['src/cpu/memory.js', 'src/cpu/state.js', 'src/cpu/interp.js', 'src/cpu/jit/jit.js', 'src/cpu/jit/runtime.js', 'src/win32/d3d9.js', 'src/win32/d3d8.js', 'src/win32/d3dx9-effect.js'].map(imp));
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  let top = 0x1000000; const alloc = (n) => { const a = top; top += (Math.max(n, 16) + 15) & ~15; return a; };
  const proc = { mem, processHeap: { alloc, free_() {} }, symbolize: () => '?' };
  const objects = new Map();
  const com = { objects, interface() {}, supports: () => true,
    create(p, iface, impl) { const ptr = alloc(24); mem.write32(ptr + 4, R.COM_MARKER); mem.write32(ptr + 16, 1); const obj = { ptr, impl, refs: 1, proc: p }; objects.set(ptr, obj); impl.comObject = obj; return ptr; },
    objectAt: (ptr) => objects.get(ptr >>> 0) ?? null, implAt: (ptr) => objects.get(ptr >>> 0)?.impl ?? null, addRef: (o) => ++o.refs, release: (o) => --o.refs, unpin() {}, dispose() {} };
  const vm = { mem, com, proc, host: { gfx: { createDevice: () => null } }, log() {}, clock: { now: () => 0 }, recentApiCalls: () => [], startApiBurst() {}, effectCtx: null, callGuest: () => 0 };
  const defs = {}, api = { define(dll, d) { Object.assign(defs, d); } };
  registerDirect3D8(api, vm); registerDirect3D9(api, vm);
  const f32 = new Float32Array(1), u32 = new Uint32Array(f32.buffer);
  const ctxAt = (sp) => ({ sp, proc, thread: { id: 1 }, get retAddr() { return mem.read32(this.sp); }, arg(i) { return mem.read32(this.sp + 4 + 4 * i); }, sarg(i) { return mem.readS32(this.sp + 4 + 4 * i); }, argF32(i) { return mem.readF32(this.sp + 4 + 4 * i); }, out32(i, v) { const a = this.arg(i); if (a) mem.write32(a, v >>> 0); } });
  const ctx = (args) => { const sp = alloc(4 + 4 * args.length); args.forEach((a, i) => mem.write32(sp + 4 + 4 * i, a >>> 0)); return ctxAt(sp); };
  const out = alloc(64), pp = alloc(64);
  [1024, 768, 22, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 75, 0, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(pp + 4 * i, v));
  const d3d = defs.Direct3DCreate9[1](ctx([32]));
  com.implAt(d3d).CreateDevice(ctx([d3d, 0, 1, 0, 0x40, pp, out]));
  const devPtr = mem.read32(out), dev = com.implAt(devPtr);
  const X = {};
  defineEffects(X, vm, { callMethod: (c, self, name, args) => com.implAt(self)[name](ctx([self, ...args])), textBuffer: () => 0 });
  const texs = []; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { dev.CreateTexture(ctx([devPtr, 64, 64, 1, 0, 21, 1, out, 0])); texs.push(mem.read32(out)); }
  const fxs = Array.from({ length: EFFECTS }, (_, k) => {
    const bytes = fxDesc(k), src = alloc(bytes.length); mem.writeBytes(src, bytes);
    if (X.D3DXCreateEffect[1](ctx([devPtr, src, bytes.length, 0, 0, 0, 0, out, 0])) !== 0) throw new Error('effect not created');
    const ptr = mem.read32(out), fx = com.implAt(ptr);
    const h = (s) => { const p = alloc(s.length + 1); mem.writeCString(p, s); return fx.GetParameterByName(ctx([ptr, 0, p])) >>> 0; };
    const tp = alloc(4); mem.writeCString(tp, 'T');
    return { ptr, H: Object.fromEntries([...Object.keys(T), 'T0', 'T1'].map((n) => [n, h(n)])), tech: fx.GetTechniqueByName(ctx([ptr, tp])) >>> 0 };
  });
  const MATS = 509, VECS = 61, PALS = 7, mats = alloc(64 * MATS), vecs = alloc(16 * VECS), bones = alloc(1024 * PALS), nPasses = alloc(4);
  for (let m = 0; m < MATS; m++) for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) mem.writeF32(mats + 64 * m + 4 * i, (i % 5 === 0 ? 1 : 0) + (i === 12 ? m : 0) + (i === 13 ? m * 0.5 : 0));
  for (let v = 0; v < VECS; v++) for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) mem.writeF32(vecs + 16 * v + 4 * i, ((v * 7 + i) % 9) * 0.125);
  for (let i = 0; i < 256 * PALS; i++) mem.writeF32(bones + 4 * i, (i % 11) * 0.25);
  const fw = (x) => { f32[0] = x; return u32[0]; };
  // the methods (their stack arguments after `this`) and their thunks
  const ARGC = { BeginScene: 0, EndScene: 0, SetRenderState: 2, SetTextureStageState: 3, SetSamplerState: 3, SetTechnique: 1, SetMatrix: 2, SetVector: 2, SetFloat: 2, SetInt: 2, SetTexture: 2, Begin: 2, BeginPass: 1,
    SetMatrixTranspose: 2, SetMatrixTransposeArray: 3, CommitChanges: 0, EndPass: 0, End: 0 };
  const METHODS = Object.keys(ARGC).map((m, i) => (i < 5 ? `IDirect3DDevice9::${m}` : `ID3DXEffect::${m}`));
  const names = METHODS.map((m) => m.split('::')[1]), argcOf = names.map((m) => ARGC[m]), Mi = Object.fromEntries(names.map((m, i) => [m, i]));
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE); cpu.reset();
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true }); jit.cpu = cpu;
  const noDefer = argv.includes('--no-defer'); // (this tree with its technique calls in JavaScript: Jit.setFxDefer)
  const SLOTS = 0x10000100, CODE = 0x20000000, STACK = 0x10090000, THUNK_SIZE = 16, CYCLE = 2, FRAME_BYTES = 1 << 20;
  METHODS.forEach((m, i) => { jit.markFast(i, `com.dll!${m}`, true); mem.write32(SLOTS + 4 * i, THUNK_BASE + i * THUNK_SIZE); });
  if (noDefer) jit.setFxDefer?.(false);
  const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24];
  let k = 0;
  for (let fn = 1; fn <= CYCLE; fn++) { // (the frames of frame(), as x86: push the arguments, call [slot])
    const code = [], c = (m, ...a) => { for (let i = a.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) code.push(0x68, ...le(a[i])); code.push(0xff, 0x15, ...le(SLOTS + 4 * Mi[m])); };
    c('BeginScene', devPtr);
    for (let o = 0; o < OBJECTS; o++, k++) {
      const e = fxs[((o / RUN) | 0) % EFFECTS], { ptr, H } = e;
      c('SetRenderState', devPtr, 7, 1); c('SetRenderState', devPtr, 27, k & 1); c('SetTextureStageState', devPtr, 0, 1, 2 + (k & 1)); c('SetSamplerState', devPtr, 2, 5, 2);
      c('SetTechnique', ptr, e.tech);
      c('SetMatrix', ptr, H.ViewProj, mats + 64 * (fn % MATS));
      c('SetVector', ptr, H.EyePos, vecs + 16 * (fn % VECS));
      for (let l = 0; l < 3; l++) c('SetVector', ptr, H.LightDir, vecs + 16 * ((fn + l) % VECS));
      c('SetVector', ptr, H.LightColor, vecs + 16 * 3); c('SetVector', ptr, H.Ambient, vecs + 16 * 4); c('SetVector', ptr, H.Fog, vecs + 16 * 5);
      c('SetFloat', ptr, H.Time, fw((fn & 0xff) / 64)); c('SetFloat', ptr, H.Opacity, fw((k % 7) === 0 ? 0.5 : 1));
      c('SetInt', ptr, H.NumBones, (k % 5) === 0 ? 4 : (k % 5) === 1 ? 1 : 0); c('SetInt', ptr, H.AlphaRef, 96 + (k & 1));
      c('SetTexture', ptr, H.T0, texs[(k >> 1) % texs.length]); c('SetTexture', ptr, H.T1, texs[(k * 3) % texs.length]);
      c('Begin', ptr, nPasses, 6); c('BeginPass', ptr, 0);
      for (let j = 0; j < PARTS; j++) {
        c('SetMatrixTranspose', ptr, H.World, mats + 64 * ((k * 3 + j) % MATS)); c('SetVector', ptr, H.Diffuse, vecs + 16 * ((k + j) % VECS)); c('SetVector', ptr, H.Shadow, vecs + 16 * 7);
        if ((k % 5) === 0) c('SetMatrixTransposeArray', ptr, H.Bones, bones + 1024 * ((k + j) % PALS), 16);
        c('CommitChanges', ptr);
      }
      c('EndPass', ptr); c('End', ptr);
    }
    c('EndScene', devPtr);
    code.push(0xf4);
    if (code.length > FRAME_BYTES) throw new Error('frame code too long');
    mem.writeBytes(CODE + (fn - 1) * FRAME_BYTES, Uint8Array.from(code));
  }
  // the dispatcher: the queue drained first (Vm.drainDeferred), then the method JavaScript handles (Vm.dispatchThunk)
  const qctx = ctxAt(0), cctx = ctxAt(0);
  const callAt = (c, idx) => { const r = com.implAt(c.arg(0))[names[idx]](c); return r === undefined ? 0 : r >>> 0; };
  const drain = () => {
    const n = mem.read32(R.DEFER_QUEUE);
    if (!n) return;
    mem.write32(R.DEFER_QUEUE, 0); mem.write32(R.DEFER_QUEUE + 4, 0); mem.write32(R.DEFER_QUEUE + 8, 0);
    for (let p = R.DEFER_QUEUE + 16, end = p + n; p < end;) {
      const idx = mem.read32(p), argc = mem.read32(p + 4), spec = mem.read32(R.DEFER_SPEC + 4 * idx), words = spec & R.DEFER_RAW ? mem.read32(p + 24) >>> 2 : (spec >>> 8) & R.DEFER_WORDS;
      qctx.sp = p + 4; callAt(qctx, idx);
      p += 4 * (2 + argc + words);
    }
  };
  let f = 0, toJs = 0;
  const frame = () => {
    cpu.eip = CODE + (f++ % CYCLE) * FRAME_BYTES; cpu.esp = STACK; cpu.eflags = FL.RESERVED1 | FL.IF;
    for (;;) {
      const r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 1e8 });
      if (r !== EXIT.THUNK) { if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error(`exit ${r}`); break; }
      drain();
      const idx = cpu.exitArg; cctx.sp = cpu.esp; toJs++;
      const eax = callAt(cctx, idx);
      cpu.eip = mem.read32(cpu.esp); cpu.esp += 4 + 4 * (argcOf[idx] + 1); cpu.eax = eax;
    }
    drain();
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < 100 * CYCLE; i++) frame(); // (warm: every frame translated before timing, see translations)
  const regions0 = jit.stats.regions;
  toJs = 0;
  const run = () => { const t0 = process.cpuUsage(); for (let i = 0; i < FRAMES; i++) frame(); const d = process.cpuUsage(t0); return (d.user + d.system) / FRAMES; };
  const state = () => JSON.stringify([Array.from(new Uint32Array(dev.vsConst.buffer).subarray(0, 4 * 70)), Array.from(new Uint32Array(dev.psConst.buffer).subarray(0, 16)),
    [7, 14, 15, 19, 20, 22, 24, 25, 27, 28].map((s) => dev.rs.get(s)), dev.textures.slice(0, 2), [0, 1, 2].map((r) => [1, 2, 5, 6, 7].map((t) => dev.samplers[r].get(t))),
    dev.vsObj?.code?.length ?? 0, dev.psObj?.code?.length ?? 0, dev.tss[0].get(1)]);
  return { run, state, calls: () => toJs, translations: () => jit.stats.regions - regions0 };
}

let variants = [['branch', HERE, false], ['ref (API_OPT_OFF)', HERE, true]];
if (BASE) variants.push(['base', path.resolve(BASE), false]);
if (opt('--only', null)) variants = variants.filter((v) => v[0].startsWith(opt('--only')));
const sessions = [];
if (JIT) variants = variants.filter((v) => !v[2]); // (the reference path's switches are the VM's: not here)
for (const [name, root, ref] of variants) sessions.push({ name, s: JIT ? await makeJitSession(root) : await makeSession(root, ref), res: [] });
for (let r = 0; r < ROUNDS; r++) for (const v of (r & 1 ? [...sessions].reverse() : sessions)) v.res.push(v.s.run());
const st = sessions.map((v) => v.s.state());
for (let i = 1; i < st.length; i++) if (st[i] !== st[0]) console.log(`warning: ${sessions[i].name} left another device state than ${sessions[0].name}`);
const med = (a) => { const s = [...a].slice(1).sort((x, y) => x - y); return s[s.length >> 1]; };
console.log(`effect objects${JIT ? ' (guest code through the JIT)' : ''}: ${OBJECTS} objects x ${FRAMES} frames, ${PARTS} commits each, ${EFFECTS} effects in runs of ${RUN}, ${ROUNDS} rounds (median, first round dropped)`);
for (const v of sessions) console.log(`  ${v.name.padEnd(18)} ${med(v.res).toFixed(0).padStart(6)} us/frame  ${(med(v.res) / OBJECTS).toFixed(2).padStart(6)} us/object  [${v.res.map((x) => x.toFixed(0)).join(' ')}]${JIT ? `  ${(v.s.calls() / (ROUNDS * FRAMES) / OBJECTS).toFixed(2)} calls to JavaScript per object, ${v.s.translations()} translations while timed` : ''}`);

```

`tools/effect-pass-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
// Cost of D3DX effect passes on the emulator thread: an fx_2_0 effect shaped like a game's — a vertex shader with a
// matrix and two vectors from parameters, a pixel shader sampling a sampler parameter (texture and filter states) with
// a color constant, nine render states one of which reads a parameter — driven per object as games do (parameters set,
// Begin, BeginPass, three draws each after new parameters and CommitChanges, EndPass, End) on a Direct3D 9 device whose
// work is recorded for the render worker ("recorder", what ?glworker=1 leaves on the emulator thread) or dropped
// ("none"). Prints µs per pass; with ORTHROS_BENCH_PROFILE unset the variants alternate.
// Usage: node tools/effect-pass-bench.mjs [passes per frame (100)] [frames (200)] [none | recorder]
import { d3dEnv } from '../tests/d3d-random.js';
import { RenderLink, Recorder } from '../src/gfx/d3d-recorder.js';
import { defineEffects } from '../src/win32/d3dx9-effect.js';
import { STATES, PT, PC } from '../src/win32/d3dx9-fxparse.js';

const PASSES = Number(process.argv[2] ?? 100), FRAMES = Number(process.argv[3] ?? 200), only = process.argv[4] ?? null;
const ROUNDS = Number(process.env.ROUNDS ?? 5);

class Words {
  constructor() { this.w = []; }
  get off() { return this.w.length * 4; }
  u32(...v) { const o = this.off; for (const x of v) this.w.push(x >>> 0); return o; }
  bytes(b) { const o = this.off; const p = new Uint8Array((b.length + 3) & ~3); p.set(b); const dv = new DataView(p.buffer); for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 4) this.w.push(dv.getUint32(i, true)); return o; }
  toBytes() { return new Uint8Array(Uint32Array.from(this.w).buffer); }
}
const cstr = (s) => new TextEncoder().encode(s + '\0');
const FOURCC = (s) => (s.charCodeAt(0) | (s.charCodeAt(1) << 8) | (s.charCodeAt(2) << 16) | (s.charCodeAt(3) << 24)) >>> 0;
const op = (cls, idx) => STATES.findIndex(([c, x]) => c === cls && (idx === undefined || x === idx));

/** shader bytecode: version, a CTAB comment for `consts` ([name, set, reg, count, class, type, rows, cols]), then `body` */
function shader(version, consts, body) {
  const ct = new Words();
  ct.u32(28, 0, version, consts.length, 28, 0, 0);
  const infoAt = ct.off / 4; for (let i = 0; i < consts.length; i++) ct.u32(0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  consts.forEach(([name, set, reg, count, cls, type, rows, cols], i) => {
    const n = ct.bytes(cstr(name)), t = ct.u32(cls | (type << 16), rows | (cols << 16), 1, 0);
    ct.w.splice(infoAt + 5 * i, 5, n, set | (reg << 16), count, t, 0);
  });
  const block = new Words(); block.u32(FOURCC('CTAB')); block.bytes(ct.toBytes());
  const w = new Words(); w.u32(version, 0xfffe | (block.w.length << 16)); w.w.push(...block.w); w.w.push(...body); return w.toBytes();
}
// vs_2_0: m4x4 oPos, v0, c0; mov oT0, v1 — ps_2_0: texld r0, t0, s0; mul r0, r0, c0; mov oC0, r0
const VS_BODY = [0x0200001f, 0x80000000, 0x900f0000, 0x0200001f, 0x80000005, 0x900f0001, 0x03000009, 0xc0010000, 0x90e40000, 0xa0e40000, 0x03000009, 0xc0020000, 0x90e40000, 0xa0e40001, 0x03000009, 0xc0040000, 0x90e40000, 0xa0e40002, 0x03000009, 0xc0080000, 0x90e40000, 0xa0e40003, 0x02000001, 0xe00f0000, 0x90e40001, 0xffff];
const PS_BODY = [0x0200001f, 0x80000000, 0xb00f0000, 0x0200001f, 0x90000000, 0xa00f0800, 0x03000042, 0x800f0000, 0xb0e40000, 0xa0e40800, 0x03000005, 0x800f0000, 0x80e40000, 0xa0e40000, 0x02000001, 0x800f0800, 0x80e40000, 0xffff];

/** fx_2_0: WVP (float4x4), LightDir, Diffuse (float4), Tex (texture), Samp (sampler2D: Tex, filters, addressing), AlphaRef (int); technique T, pass P */
function effectBinary() {
  const pool = new Words(); pool.u32(0);
  const str = (s) => { const b = cstr(s); const o = pool.u32(b.length); pool.bytes(b); return o; };
  const intType = pool.u32(PT.INT, PC.SCALAR, str(''), 0, 0, 1, 1), val = (v) => pool.u32(v);
  const wvpType = pool.u32(PT.FLOAT, PC.MATRIX_COLUMNS, str('WVP'), 0, 0, 4, 4), wvpValue = pool.u32(...Array(16).fill(0));
  const ldType = pool.u32(PT.FLOAT, PC.VECTOR, str('LightDir'), 0, 0, 4, 1), ldValue = pool.u32(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const dfType = pool.u32(PT.FLOAT, PC.VECTOR, str('Diffuse'), 0, 0, 4, 1), dfValue = pool.u32(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const txType = pool.u32(PT.TEXTURE, PC.OBJECT, str('Tex'), 0, 0), txValue = pool.u32(3);
  const smType = pool.u32(PT.SAMPLER2D, PC.OBJECT, str('Samp'), 0, 0);
  const smValue = pool.u32(6, op('texture'), 0, txType, val(3), op('samp', 6), 0, intType, val(2), op('samp', 5), 0, intType, val(2), op('samp', 7), 0, intType, val(2), op('samp', 1), 0, intType, val(1), op('samp', 2), 0, intType, val(1));
  const arType = pool.u32(PT.INT, PC.SCALAR, str('AlphaRef'), 0, 0, 1, 1), arValue = pool.u32(96);
  const anySampler = pool.u32(PT.SAMPLER2D, PC.OBJECT, str(''), 0, 0), noStates = pool.u32(0);
  const vsType = pool.u32(PT.VERTEXSHADER, PC.OBJECT, str(''), 0, 0), vsValue = pool.u32(1);
  const psType = pool.u32(PT.PIXELSHADER, PC.OBJECT, str(''), 0, 0), psValue = pool.u32(2);
  const states = [
    [op('vs'), 0, vsType, vsValue], [op('ps'), 0, psType, psValue],
    [op('rs', 7), 0, intType, val(1)], [op('rs', 14), 0, intType, val(1)], [op('rs', 27), 0, intType, val(0)], [op('rs', 22), 0, intType, val(3)],
    [op('rs', 15), 0, intType, val(1)], [op('rs', 25), 0, intType, val(7)], [op('rs', 19), 0, intType, val(5)], [op('rs', 20), 0, intType, val(6)],
    [op('rs', 24), 0, intType, val(0)], // AlphaRef = <AlphaRef>
    [op('sampler'), 0, anySampler, noStates], // Sampler[0] = <Samp>
  ];
  const tName = str('T'), pName = str('P');
  const tables = pool.off, t = new Words();
  t.u32(6, 1, 0, 4);
  for (const [ty, v] of [[wvpType, wvpValue], [ldType, ldValue], [dfType, dfValue], [txType, txValue], [smType, smValue], [arType, arValue]]) t.u32(ty, v, 0, 0);
  t.u32(tName, 0, 1); t.u32(pName, 0, states.length);
  for (const s of states) t.u32(...s);
  const vs = shader(0xfffe0200, [['WVP', 2, 0, 4, PC.MATRIX_COLUMNS, PT.FLOAT, 4, 4], ['LightDir', 2, 4, 1, PC.VECTOR, PT.FLOAT, 1, 4], ['Diffuse', 2, 5, 1, PC.VECTOR, PT.FLOAT, 1, 4]], VS_BODY);
  const ps = shader(0xffff0200, [['Samp', 3, 0, 1, PC.OBJECT, PT.SAMPLER2D, 1, 1], ['Diffuse', 2, 0, 1, PC.VECTOR, PT.FLOAT, 1, 4]], PS_BODY);
  const refs = [[0, 0, 0, 10, 'AlphaRef'], [0, 0, 0, 11, 'Samp'], [0xffffffff, 4, 0, 0, 'Tex']];
  t.u32(0, 2 + refs.length);
  t.u32(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, vs.length); t.bytes(vs);
  t.u32(0, 0, 0, 1, 0, ps.length); t.bytes(ps);
  for (const [tq, i, e, s, name] of refs) { const b = cstr(name); t.u32(tq, i, e, s, 1, b.length); t.bytes(b); }
  const head = new Words(); head.u32(0xfeff0901, tables);
  const out = new Uint8Array(8 + pool.off + t.off);
  out.set(head.toBytes(), 0); out.set(pool.toBytes(), 8); out.set(t.toBytes(), 8 + pool.off);
  return out;
}

function session(gfx) {
  const E = d3dEnv(gfx), { mem, ctx, com, vm } = E;
  const out = E.alloc(64), pp = E.alloc(64), scratch = E.alloc(4096);
  [1024, 768, 22, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 75, 0, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(pp + 4 * i, v));
  const d3d = E.defs.Direct3DCreate9[1](ctx([32]));
  com.implAt(d3d).CreateDevice(ctx([d3d, 0, 1, 0, 0x40, pp, out]));
  const devPtr = mem.read32(out), dev = com.implAt(devPtr);
  const call = (name, ...a) => { const c = ctx([devPtr, ...a]); return dev[name](c); };
  // the effect runtime over this device (COM method calls of the effect go straight to the device's handlers)
  Object.assign(vm, { effectCtx: null, callGuest: () => 0, log: (k, m) => { if (process.env.FXLOG) console.log(k, m); } });
  const X = {}; com.interface ??= () => {};
  defineEffects(X, vm, { callMethod: (c, self, name, args) => com.implAt(self)[name](ctx([self, ...args])), textBuffer: () => 0 });
  const fxBytes = effectBinary(), src = E.alloc(fxBytes.length);
  mem.writeBytes(src, fxBytes);
  const r = X.D3DXCreateEffect[1](ctx([devPtr, src, fxBytes.length, 0, 0, 0, 0, out, 0]));
  if (r !== 0) throw new Error(`effect not created (${r})`);
  const fxPtr = mem.read32(out), fx = com.implAt(fxPtr);
  const fc = (...a) => ctx([fxPtr, ...a]);
  const handle = (s) => { const p = E.alloc(s.length + 1); mem.writeCString(p, s); return fx.GetParameterByName(fc(0, p)) >>> 0; };
  const H = { wvp: handle('WVP'), ld: handle('LightDir'), df: handle('Diffuse'), tex: handle('Tex'), ar: handle('AlphaRef') };
  const tech = fx.GetTechniqueByName ? fx.GetTechniqueByName(fc((() => { const p = E.alloc(4); mem.writeCString(p, 'T'); return p; })())) >>> 0 : 0;
  const tex = []; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { call('CreateTexture', 64, 64, 1, 0, 21, 1, out, 0); tex.push(mem.read32(out)); }
  call('CreateVertexBuffer', 65536, 8, 0, 1, out, 0); call('SetStreamSource', 0, mem.read32(out), 0, 20);
  call('CreateIndexBuffer', 65536, 8, 101, 1, out, 0); call('SetIndices', mem.read32(out));
  const el = E.alloc(64); [0x00000000, 0x00000002, 0x000c0000, 0x00050001, 0x000000ff, 0x00000011].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(el + 4 * i, v));
  call('CreateVertexDeclaration', el, out); call('SetVertexDeclaration', mem.read32(out));
  const mat = scratch, vec = scratch + 64, nPasses = E.alloc(4);
  let k = 0, last = null;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  for (let f = 0; f < FRAMES; f++) {
    call('BeginScene');
    for (let o = 0; o < PASSES; o++, k++) {
      if (tech) fx.SetTechnique(fc(tech));
      mem.writeF32(vec, 0.5); mem.writeF32(vec + 4, 0.25); mem.writeF32(vec + 8, -1); mem.writeF32(vec + 12, 0); fx.SetVector(fc(H.ld, vec));
      fx.SetTexture(fc(H.tex, tex[k % tex.length]));
      if ((k & 15) === 0) fx.SetInt(fc(H.ar, 64 + (k & 31)));
      fx.Begin(fc(nPasses, 0)); fx.BeginPass(fc(0));
      for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
        for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) mem.writeF32(mat + 4 * i, (i % 5 === 0 ? 1 : 0) + (i === 12 ? k + d : 0));
        fx.SetMatrixTranspose(fc(H.wvp, mat));
        mem.writeF32(vec, (k + d) & 7); fx.SetVector(fc(H.df, vec));
        fx.CommitChanges(fc());
        call('DrawIndexedPrimitive', 4, 0, 0, 100, 0, 50);
      }
      if (f === FRAMES - 1 && o === PASSES - 1) last = { vs: !!dev.vsObj, ps: !!dev.psObj, c3x: dev.vsConst[12], want: k + 2, ar: dev.rs.get(24), wantAr: 64 + ((k & ~15) & 31), minf: dev.samplers[0].get(6), tex: dev.textures[0] === tex[k % tex.length], c4x: dev.vsConst[16] };
      fx.EndPass(fc()); fx.End(fc());
    }
    call('EndScene'); call('Present', 0, 0, 0, 0);
  }
  const ms = performance.now() - t0;
  // (the pass did reach the device: shaders, constants from the parameters, render and sampler states, the texture)
  const L = last;
  if (!L.vs || !L.ps || L.c3x !== L.want || L.ar !== L.wantAr || L.minf !== 2 || !L.tex || L.c4x !== 0.5) throw new Error(`the effect did not apply: ${JSON.stringify(L)}`);
  return ms;
}

const variants = {
  none: () => ({ createDevice: () => null }),
  recorder: () => {
    const words = new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4 << 20));
    const link = new RenderLink({ words, replayer: { reader: { consumed: 0 }, run() { this.reader.consumed = link.w.produced; } } });
    link.drain = function () { this.w.consumed = this.replayer.reader.consumed = this.w.produced; };
    return { createDevice: (dev) => new Recorder(link, dev) };
  },
};
const names = only ? [only] : Object.keys(variants), res = new Map(names.map((n) => [n, []]));
for (let r = 0; r < (only ? 1 : ROUNDS); r++) for (const n of names) res.get(n).push(session(variants[n]()) * 1000 / (PASSES * FRAMES));
const best = (a) => Math.min(...(a.length > 1 ? a.slice(1) : a));
console.log(`effect passes (1 pass, 3 draws each), ${PASSES} x ${FRAMES}: ` + names.map((n) => `${n} ${best(res.get(n)).toFixed(2)} us/pass [${res.get(n).map((x) => x.toFixed(2)).join(' ')}]`).join('; '));

```

`tools/engine-br.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Precompressed siblings of an engine release's files (<file>.br, brotli 11), as OpenMW's releases ship them: the
// server sends one to a browser that takes brotli and asks for the whole file (server.js sendEngineFile), and counts
// it as the file's wire size on the home's card (engineOf). Without one an engine file goes out as it is from the
// origin — the reverse proxy gzips it on the fly. Measured (2026-10-21, brotli 11 vs the proxy's gzip): Half-Life's
// engine 3.82 -> 3.30 MB, the arsenal 15.44 -> 14.82, Counter-Strike rebuilt 8.86 -> 8.25, Vice City 1.43 -> 1.07.
//
// Usage: node tools/engine-br.mjs [--dry-run] <release dir>...
//   Every file of the release whose name is compressible (.js .mjs .wasm .json .txt .data: not archives, media or native libraries)
//   and whose brotli 11 is at most 92 % of it gets <file>.br next to it (written to a temporary name, then renamed:
//   its mtime after the file's, as sendEngineFile requires); an existing .br newer than its file is kept. Run by the
//   install / build scripts on a release before it is moved in place (tools/goldsrc/install-engine.py,
//   tools/goldsrc/build-modules.sh, tools/re3/build.sh); an installed release: by the operator.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';

const COMPRESSIBLE = /\.(m?js|wasm|json|txt|data)$/i;
export const MIN_GAIN = 0.92;

/** brotli 11 of `buf` (generic mode: wasm and text alike) */
export const brotli11 = (buf) => zlib.brotliCompressSync(buf, { params: { [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_QUALITY]: 11, [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_SIZE_HINT]: buf.length, [zlib.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_LGWIN]: 24 } });

/** The files of `dir` that get a sibling, and those made: [{ rel, raw, br, kept }] (br: its size, null: not worth it). */
export function precompress(dir, { dryRun = false, log = () => {} } = {}) {
  const out = [];
  const walk = (d) => {
    for (const e of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true }).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))) {
      const f = path.join(d, e.name);
      // (a release's gamefiles/ is laid over the game's own files, releaseGameFiles: a sibling there would be a game file)
      if (e.isDirectory()) { if (!(d === root && e.name === 'gamefiles')) walk(f); continue; }
      if (!e.isFile() || !COMPRESSIBLE.test(e.name)) continue;
      const st = fs.statSync(f), rel = path.relative(root, f);
      if (st.size < 1024) continue;
      let old = null; try { old = fs.statSync(f + '.br'); } catch { /* none */ }
      if (old && old.mtimeMs >= st.mtimeMs) { out.push({ rel, raw: st.size, br: old.size, kept: true }); continue; }
      const raw = fs.readFileSync(f), br = brotli11(raw), worth = br.length <= raw.length * MIN_GAIN;
      out.push({ rel, raw: raw.length, br: worth ? br.length : null, kept: false });
      log(`${rel}: ${raw.length} -> ${br.length}${worth ? '' : ' (not worth it)'}`);
      if (dryRun || !worth) continue;
      const tmp = `${f}.br.tmp-${process.pid}`;
      fs.writeFileSync(tmp, br);
      // (the file must not have changed meanwhile: the sibling would claim another version's bytes)
      const now = fs.statSync(f);
      if (now.size !== st.size || now.mtimeMs !== st.mtimeMs) { fs.unlinkSync(tmp); throw new Error(`${f} changed while compressed`); }
      fs.renameSync(tmp, f + '.br');
    }
  };
  const root = path.resolve(dir);
  walk(root);
  return out;
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`) {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2), dryRun = args.includes('--dry-run'), dirs = args.filter((a) => a !== '--dry-run');
  if (!dirs.length) { console.error('usage: node tools/engine-br.mjs [--dry-run] <release dir>...'); process.exit(2); }
  for (const d of dirs) {
    if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(d, 'release.json')) && !fs.existsSync(path.join(d, 'engine'))) { console.error(`${d}: not an engine release`); process.exit(2); }
    const r = precompress(d, { dryRun, log: (m) => console.log(`  ${m}`) });
    const raw = r.reduce((n, x) => n + x.raw, 0), wire = r.reduce((n, x) => n + (x.br ?? x.raw), 0);
    console.log(`${d}: ${r.length} files, ${(raw / 1048576).toFixed(2)} MB -> ${(wire / 1048576).toFixed(2)} MB${dryRun ? ' (dry run)' : ''}`);
  }
}
```

`tools/flags-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Lazy-flags microbenchmark: ns per iteration of small integer loops whose blocks read flags set by another block
// (the lazy flag state is unknown at a block entry: a DEC/INC at the head of a block must keep the CF of whatever
// came before, a JCC right after another JCC tests the flags of the previous block's CMP), next to equivalent
// loops where every flag read is resolved within its block. Shows the cost of the run-time dispatch on the lazy op
// (Emitter.pushCondDynamic) and of the flags helper calls it may contain.
// Usage: node tools/flags-bench.mjs [iterations] [--runs 7]
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const N = +(args.find((a) => !a.startsWith('--')) ?? 2e7);
const runsArg = args.indexOf('--runs');
const RUNS = runsArg >= 0 ? +args[runsArg + 1] : 7;
const hex = (s) => Uint8Array.from(s.replace(/\s+/g, '').match(/../g).map((h) => parseInt(h, 16)));

// every case: ecx = N iterations, eax = 0, edx = 0x7fffffff, esi -> a data page (dwords 1, 0 ; at +64: 0..9, 0..5); ends on HLT
const CASES = [
  // L: dec ecx ; jnz L ; hlt                          (the block starts with DEC: CF of the previous block's DEC)
  ['dec at block head', '49 75fd f4'],
  // L: sub ecx, 1 ; jnz L ; hlt                       (reference: nothing to preserve)
  ['  ref: sub ecx, 1', '83e901 75fb f4'],
  // L: add eax, 1 ; cmp eax, edx ; je X ; jb Y ; Y: sub ecx, 1 ; jnz L ; hlt ; X: hlt   (JB alone in its block)
  ['jcc after jcc', '83c001 39d0 7408 7200 83e901 75f2 f4 f4'],
  // same, the JB's block recomputing its CMP (reference: the condition from a known lazy op)
  ['  ref: cmp in the block', '83c001 39d0 740a 39d0 7200 83e901 75f0 f4 f4'],
  // L: mov ebx, [esi] ; add ebx, eax ; test ebx, ebx ; je X ; inc dword [esi+4] ; jb Y ; Y: dec ecx ; jnz L ; hlt ; X: hlt
  // (a mixed region: memory INC, a JB after a JCC, a DEC at a block head)
  ['mixed', '8b1e 01c3 85db 740a ff4604 7200 49 75f1 f4 f4'],
  // L: mov edx, ecx ; and edx, 15 ; mov eax, [esi+edx*4+64] ; cmp eax, 5 ; je E ; jl S ; add ebx, eax ; jmp N ;
  // S: sub ebx, eax ; jmp N ; E: inc ebx ; N: dec ecx ; jnz L ; hlt     (a 3-way compare on table values 0..9: the JL
  // after the JE; the DEC at the join of three blocks leaving different lazy ops: not predicted)
  ['3-way compare', '89ca 83e20f 8b449640 83f805 740a 7c04 01c3 eb05 29c3 eb01 43 49 75e4 f4'],
];

async function once(bytes) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, bytes);
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x10000; cpu.esi = DATA; cpu.ecx = N; cpu.eax = 0; cpu.edx = 0x7fffffff;
  cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true }); jit.cpu = cpu;
  const end = CODE + bytes.length - 1;
  let r;
  const reset = () => { cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.ecx = N; cpu.eax = 0; mem.fill(DATA, 4096, 0); mem.write32(DATA, 1); for (let k = 0; k < 16; k++) mem.write32(DATA + 64 + 4 * k, k % 10); };
  reset();
  do r = jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: 2e9 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE); // warm-up: translation, then
  await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 100)); // V8's background tier-up of the region to optimized code
  reset();
  const t0 = performance.now();
  do r = jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: 2e9 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
  const ms = performance.now() - t0;
  if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error('exit ' + r);
  if (cpu.ecx !== 0) throw new Error('did not run to the end');
  return (ms * 1e6) / N;
}

// one discarded round first: the first translations of a process run slower (V8 still optimizing the JS dispatcher
// and translator), which otherwise lands on the first case
for (const [, h] of CASES) await once(hex(h));
for (const [name, h] of CASES) {
  const bytes = hex(h);
  const t = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < RUNS; k++) t.push(await once(bytes));
  t.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  console.log(`${name.padEnd(26)} ${t[t.length >> 1].toFixed(3)} ns/iter (median of ${RUNS}; min ${t[0].toFixed(3)}, max ${t[t.length - 1].toFixed(3)})`);
}

```

`tools/fpustate-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// x87 state / extended-precision microbenchmark: ns per loop iteration of the instructions that used to leave
// translated code for the interpreter (FLD/FSTP m80, FNSAVE/FRSTOR, FNSTENV/FLDENV), alone and inside the shape of a
// C-runtime math routine that saves the x87 state around SSE2 double code. Median and spread of 7 runs.
// Usage: node tools/fpustate-bench.mjs [iterations] [--root <dir holding src/>] (--root: measure another checkout,
// e.g. `git archive HEAD~1 src | tar -x -C /tmp/base` for a before/after in the same session)
//
// Kernels (hand-assembled, ebx = data, ecx = iterations):
//   m80:        L: fld tbyte [ebx+0x200] ; fstp tbyte [ebx+0x210] ; dec ecx ; jnz L
//   save:       L: fnsave [ebx+0x100] ; frstor [ebx+0x100] ; dec ecx ; jnz L
//   env:        L: fnstenv [ebx+0x100] ; fldenv [ebx+0x100] ; dec ecx ; jnz L
//   crt:        L: fnsave [ebx+0x100] ; movsd xmm0,[ebx] ; mulsd xmm0,[ebx+8] ; addsd xmm0,[ebx+16] ;
//                  movsd [ebx+0x80],xmm0 ; frstor [ebx+0x100] ; fld tbyte [ebx+0x200] ; fstp st0 ; dec ecx ; jnz L
//   (baseline)  L: fld qword [ebx+0x200] ; fstp st0 ; dec ecx ; jnz L
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import path from 'node:path';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const ri = args.indexOf('--root');
const root = ri >= 0 ? path.resolve(args.splice(ri, 2)[1]) : path.resolve(path.dirname(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname), '..');
const imp = (p) => import(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, p)).href);
const { GuestMemory } = await imp('src/cpu/memory.js');
const { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } = await imp('src/cpu/state.js');
const { Interp } = await imp('src/cpu/interp.js');
const { writeF80 } = await imp('src/cpu/interp-x87.js');
await imp('src/cpu/interp-sse.js');
const { Jit } = await imp('src/cpu/jit/jit.js');

const KERNELS = {
  m80: ['DBAB00020000 DBBB10020000 49 75F1', 1e7],
  save: ['DDB300010000 DDA300010000 49 75F1', 3e6],
  env: ['D9B300010000 D9A300010000 49 75F1', 3e6],
  crt: ['DDB300010000 F20F1003 F20F594308 F20F584310 F20F118380000000 DDA300010000 DBAB00020000 DDD8 49 75D3', 3e6],
  baseline: ['DD8300020000 DDD8 49 75F5', 1e7],
};
const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const scale = args[0] ? +args[0] : 1;

for (const [name, [hex, n0]] of Object.entries(KERNELS)) {
  const N = Math.round(n0 * scale);
  const bytes = Uint8Array.from((hex.replace(/\s+/g, '') + 'F4').match(/../g).map((h) => parseInt(h, 16)));
  const all = [];
  for (let rep = 0; rep < 7; rep++) {
    const mem = new GuestMemory();
    const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
    cpu.reset();
    mem.writeBytes(CODE, bytes);
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) mem.writeF64(DATA + 8 * i, 1 + i / 16);
    writeF80(mem, DATA + 0x200, 1.2345); // (normal extended values: the conversion's common path)
    cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x10000; cpu.ebx = DATA; cpu.ecx = N; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
    const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true });
    jit.cpu = cpu;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    let r;
    do r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 2e9 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
    const ms = performance.now() - t0;
    if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error(`${name}: exit ${r}`);
    all.push(ms * 1e6 / N);
  }
  all.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  console.log(`${name.padEnd(9)} median ${all[3].toFixed(1).padStart(7)} ns/iter  (min ${all[0].toFixed(1)}, max ${all[6].toFixed(1)})`);
}
```
