```py
    chroma = rgb / lum
    sch = src / (src.sum(-1, keepdims=True) + 1.0)
    c2 = ((chroma[..., None, :] - sch) ** 2).sum(-1) * (255.0 ** 2) * 9
    w = np.exp(-np.minimum(d2, c2 + 0.25 * d2) / (2 * sigma * sigma))
    tot = w.sum(-1, keepdims=True)
    luma = np.array([0.299, 0.587, 0.114])
    Lp = rgb @ luma + 1.0
    Ls = src @ luma + 1.0
    # target colour at the pixel's relative brightness (clean shades, no per-channel noise amplification)
    cand = dst[None, None] * (Lp[..., None] / Ls)[..., None] if rgb.ndim == 3 else dst * (Lp[..., None] / Ls)[..., None]
    mapped = (w[..., None] * cand).sum(-2) / np.maximum(tot, 1e-12)
    keep = np.clip(1.0 - tot, 0.0, 1.0)  # far from every key: unchanged
    out = a.copy()
    out[..., :3] = mapped * (1.0 - keep) + rgb * keep
    return np.clip(np.round(out), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# the importer
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Surface:
    """Triangles of one material: rest model-space corners with weights (filled by Importer)."""

    def __init__(self, material):
        self.material = material
        self.pos = []      # (n, 3) per vertex
        self.nrm = []
        self.uv = []
        self.joints = []   # (n, k) node indices
        self.weights = []  # (n, k)
        self.tris = []     # (t, 3) indices into this surface's vertices


class Importer:
    def __init__(self, path, height=None, scale=None, yaw=0.0, up="+y", forward="+z", origin="source", exclude_meshes=(),
                 exclude_materials=(), keep_joints=(), max_bones=mdl.MAXSTUDIOBONES, max_size=512, min_size=256,
                 crop=True, double_sided="auto", crease=70.0, texture_filter=None, verbose=True, gl=None,
                 strip_suffix=True, height_pose=None, place=None, materials=None):
        """path: .glb/.gltf file (or gl=: an already loaded gltf.GLTF).
        height: rest-pose height in units (uniform scale), or scale: units per glTF unit.
        up / forward: source axes of the model's up and facing directions ("+y" / "+z" in glTF; exports whose
        converter rotated the rig may differ: check the rest views).  yaw: extra turn about +z (degrees).
        origin: "source" (glTF origin over the ground) or "bbox" (rest bounding-box centre).
        exclude_meshes / exclude_materials: names (node, mesh or material) to leave out.
        keep_joints: joint names kept even without vertices (attachment carriers, motion references).
        max_size / min_size: texture size bounds (powers of two; small textures are upscaled so integer s/t
        are finer).  crop: crop textures to the used UV area.  double_sided: "auto" (back faces for the open
        surfaces of doubleSided materials), True (all of them), False.
        texture_filter(material_name, rgba uint8 (H, W, 4)) -> rgba: optional recolouring hook.
        materials: {material name: options} with any of "flags" (texture flags OR'ed in, e.g.
        STUDIO_NF_ADDITIVE | STUDIO_NF_FULLBRIGHT for a flame), "filter" (rgba -> rgba, after texture_filter),
        "max_size", "min_size", "crop", "double_sided" (True / False / "auto"), "exclude" (True).
        height_pose: (animation name, time) measured instead of the bind pose for `height`.
        place: (animation name, time): the pose whose trunk joint places the bind skeleton in the scene, instead
        of the default node pose.  Needed when the file's animations re-orient container nodes above the
        skeleton (e.g. an animation undoing a converter's axis fix): rest and animations then share one frame."""
        self.path = path
        self.g = gl if gl is not None else gltf.load(path)
        self.verbose = verbose
        self.report = []
        self.max_size, self.min_size, self.crop = max_size, min_size, crop
        self.double_sided = double_sided
        self.texture_filter = texture_filter
        self.crease = crease
        self.mat_opts = dict(materials or {})
        exclude_materials = set(exclude_materials) | {k for k, v in self.mat_opts.items() if v.get("exclude")}
        g = self.g
        G = g.world_matrices() if place is None else g.world_matrices(self._anim(place[0]), float(place[1]))

        # --- bind pose per skin -------------------------------------------------------------------
        self.bind = {}       # node -> scene-space bind world matrix (4x4)
        skin_kref = {}
        insts = []
        for ni, mi in g.mesh_instances():
            node = g.nodes[ni]
            m = g.meshes[mi]
            if node.name in exclude_meshes or m.name in exclude_meshes:
                continue
            insts.append((ni, mi))
        used_count = {}
        for ni, mi in insts:
            sk = g.nodes[ni].skin
            if sk < 0:
                continue
            for p in g.meshes[mi].primitives:
                for jn, wn in self._joint_attrs(p):
                    J, W = p.attributes[jn], p.attributes[wn]
                    for j in range(J.shape[1]):
                        nodes = np.asarray(g.skins[sk].joints)[np.clip(J[:, j], 0, len(g.skins[sk].joints) - 1)]
                        for n, w in zip(nodes, W[:, j]):
                            if w > 0:
                                used_count[int(n)] = used_count.get(int(n), 0.0) + float(w)
        for si, s in enumerate(g.skins):
            K = np.einsum("jab,jbc->jac", G[s.joints], s.inverse_bind)
            depth = [self._depth(n) for n in s.joints]
            cand = [j for j, n in enumerate(s.joints) if used_count.get(n, 0) > 0] or list(range(len(s.joints)))
            ref = min(cand, key=lambda j: (depth[j], -used_count.get(s.joints[j], 0.0), j))
            kref = K[ref]
            skin_kref[si] = kref
            for j, n in enumerate(s.joints):
                b = kref @ np.linalg.inv(s.inverse_bind[j])
                if n in self.bind and np.abs(self.bind[n] - b).max() > 1e-4 * max(1.0, np.abs(b).max()):
                    self._log(f"warning: joint {g.nodes[n].name} has different bind matrices in two skins")
                    continue
                self.bind.setdefault(n, b)
            dev = float(np.abs(K - kref).max())
            if dev > 1e-3:
                self._log(f"skin {si}: default node pose differs from the bind pose (max {dev:.3f}); rest = bind pose")

        # --- surfaces in scene space (rest = bind) -----------------------------------------------
        surfaces = {}
        for ni, mi in insts:
            node = g.nodes[ni]
            sk = node.skin
            for p in g.meshes[mi].primitives:
                if p.material >= 0 and g.materials[p.material].name in exclude_materials:
                    continue
                if len(p.triangles) == 0:
                    continue
                pos = p.attributes["POSITION"]
                if sk >= 0:
                    kref = skin_kref[sk]
                    joints, weights = [], []
                    for jn, wn in self._joint_attrs(p):
                        jj = np.clip(p.attributes[jn], 0, len(g.skins[sk].joints) - 1)
                        joints.append(np.asarray(g.skins[sk].joints)[jj])
                        weights.append(np.asarray(p.attributes[wn], dtype=np.float64))
                    joints = np.concatenate(joints, 1)
                    weights = np.concatenate(weights, 1)
                    M = kref
                else:
                    anc = node.index
                    while anc != -1 and anc not in self.bind:
                        anc = g.nodes[anc].parent
                    if anc == -1:
                        anc = node.index
                        self.bind.setdefault(anc, G[anc])
                    joints = np.full((len(pos), 1), anc, np.int64)
                    weights = np.ones((len(pos), 1))
                    M = G[node.index]
                    if anc != node.index:  # rigid on the joint: express in its bind pose
                        M = self.bind[anc] @ np.linalg.inv(G[anc]) @ G[node.index]
                P = pos @ M[:3, :3].T + M[:3, 3]
                if "NORMAL" in p.attributes:
                    Nn = p.attributes["NORMAL"] @ np.linalg.inv(M[:3, :3])  # inverse transpose
                    Nn /= np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(Nn, axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-12)
                else:
                    Nn = None
                mat = p.material
                matobj = g.materials[mat] if mat >= 0 else gltf.Material(name="default")
                uv = p.attributes.get(f"TEXCOORD_{matobj.texcoord}")
                if uv is None:
                    uv = np.zeros((len(pos), 2))
                if matobj.uv_transform is not None:
                    uv = np.c_[uv, np.ones(len(uv))] @ matobj.uv_transform.T
                    uv = uv[:, :2]
                srf = surfaces.setdefault(mat, Surface(mat))
                base = sum(len(x) for x in srf.pos)
                srf.pos.append(P)
                srf.nrm.append(Nn)
                srf.uv.append(np.asarray(uv, dtype=np.float64))
                srf.joints.append(joints)
                srf.weights.append(weights)
                srf.tris.append(p.triangles + base)
        if not surfaces:
            raise ValueError("no mesh to import")
        self.surfaces = []
        for mat in sorted(surfaces):
            s = surfaces[mat]
            k = max(j.shape[1] for j in s.joints)
            s.pos = np.concatenate(s.pos)
            s.uv = np.concatenate(s.uv)
            s.joints = np.concatenate([np.pad(j, ((0, 0), (0, k - j.shape[1])), constant_values=j[0, 0])
                                       for j in s.joints])
            s.weights = np.concatenate([np.pad(w, ((0, 0), (0, k - w.shape[1]))) for w in s.weights])
            s.tris = np.concatenate(s.tris)
            if any(n is None for n in s.nrm):
                s.nrm = None
            else:
                s.nrm = np.concatenate(s.nrm)
            self.surfaces.append(s)

        # --- model-space conversion ---------------------------------------------------------------
        yr = math.radians(yaw)
        Ry = np.array([[math.cos(yr), -math.sin(yr), 0], [math.sin(yr), math.cos(yr), 0], [0, 0, 1.0]])
        A = Ry @ axes_matrix(up, forward)
        allp = np.concatenate([s.pos for s in self.surfaces]) @ A.T
        if height_pose is not None:
            hp = self._scene_posed_points(*height_pose) @ A.T
        else:
            hp = allp
        if scale is None:
            h = float(hp[:, 2].max() - hp[:, 2].min())
            scale = 1.0 if height is None else float(height) / max(h, 1e-9)
        lo = allp.min(0) * scale
        hi = allp.max(0) * scale
        off = np.zeros(3)
        if origin == "bbox":
            off[:2] = -(lo[:2] + hi[:2]) / 2
        off[2] = -lo[2]
        self.scale = scale
        self.C = np.eye(4)
        self.C[:3, :3] = A * scale
        self.C[:3, 3] = off
        self.Cinv = np.linalg.inv(self.C)
        self.A = A
        for s in self.surfaces:
            s.pos = s.pos @ self.C[:3, :3].T + self.C[:3, 3]
            if s.nrm is not None:
                s.nrm = s.nrm @ A.T
        self._log(f"scale {scale:.4f} units per glTF unit, rest bounds {np.round(lo + off, 1)} .. {np.round(hi + off, 1)}")

        # --- skeleton -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        self._build_skeleton(keep_joints, max_bones, strip_suffix)
        self._finish_surfaces()

    # helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _log(self, msg):
        self.report.append(msg)
        if self.verbose:
            print(f"  [import {self.path.rsplit('/', 1)[-1] if isinstance(self.path, str) else ''}] {msg}",
                  file=sys.stderr)

    @staticmethod
    def _joint_attrs(p):
        out = []
        for k in range(4):
            jn, wn = f"JOINTS_{k}", f"WEIGHTS_{k}"
            if jn in p.attributes and wn in p.attributes:
                out.append((jn, wn))
        return out

    def _depth(self, n):
        d = 0
        while self.g.nodes[n].parent != -1:
            n = self.g.nodes[n].parent
            d += 1
        return d

    def _scene_posed_points(self, anim, t):
        """Skinned scene-space points of every surface at animation time t (for height_pose)."""
        a = self._anim(anim)
        G = self.g.world_matrices(a, t)
        pts = []
        for s in self.surfaces:
            S = {n: G[n] @ np.linalg.inv(self.bind[n]) for n in np.unique(s.joints)}
            w = s.weights / np.maximum(s.weights.sum(1, keepdims=True), 1e-12)
            acc = np.zeros_like(s.pos)
            for k in range(s.joints.shape[1]):
                M = np.array([S[int(n)] for n in s.joints[:, k]])
                acc += w[:, k:k + 1] * (np.einsum("nij,nj->ni", M[:, :3, :3], s.pos) + M[:, :3, 3])
            pts.append(acc)
        return np.concatenate(pts)

    def _anim(self, anim):
        if isinstance(anim, gltf.Animation):
            return anim
        if isinstance(anim, int):
            return self.g.animations[anim]
        names = [a.name for a in self.g.animations]
        if anim in names:
            return self.g.animations[names.index(anim)]
        hits = [a for a in self.g.animations if anim in a.name]
        if len(hits) == 1:
            return hits[0]
        raise KeyError(f"animation {anim!r} not found (or ambiguous) in {names}")

    def animation_names(self):
        return [a.name for a in self.g.animations]

    # skeleton ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_skeleton(self, keep_joints, max_bones, strip_suffix):
        g = self.g
        joints = set(self.bind)
        wsum = {}
        for s in self.surfaces:
            for k in range(s.joints.shape[1]):
                for n, w in zip(s.joints[:, k], s.weights[:, k]):
                    if w > 1.0 / 512:
                        wsum[int(n)] = wsum.get(int(n), 0.0) + float(w)
        name_of = {n: g.nodes[n].name for n in joints}
        keep_names = set(keep_joints)
        forced = {n for n in joints if name_of[n] in keep_names or self._clean(name_of[n]) in keep_names}
        missing = keep_names - {name_of[n] for n in forced} - {self._clean(name_of[n]) for n in forced}
        if missing:
            raise KeyError(f"keep_joints not found: {sorted(missing)}")
        used = {n for n in wsum} | forced

        def jparent(n):
            p = g.nodes[n].parent
            while p != -1 and p not in joints:
                p = g.nodes[p].parent
            return p

        def chain(n):
            out = [n]
            p = jparent(n)
            while p != -1:
                out.append(p)
                p = jparent(p)
            return out

        chains = {n: chain(n) for n in used}
        # lowest common ancestor of the used joints (per root tree)
        common = None
        for n in sorted(used):
            c = chains[n][::-1]
            common = c if common is None else [a for a, b in zip(common, c) if a == b]
        lca = common[-1] if common else None
        keep = set()
        for n in used:
            for a in chains[n]:
                keep.add(a)
                if a == lca:
                    break
        # merge least-weighted leaves while over the bone limit
        merged = {}
        while len(keep) > max_bones:
            kids = {n: 0 for n in keep}
            for n in keep:
                p = jparent(n)
                while p != -1 and p not in keep:
                    p = jparent(p)
                if p in kids:
                    kids[p] += 1
            leaves = [n for n in keep if kids[n] == 0 and n not in forced and n != lca]
            if not leaves:
                break
            victim = min(leaves, key=lambda n: (wsum.get(n, 0.0), n))
            keep.discard(victim)
            merged[victim] = True
        if merged:
            self._log(f"merged {len(merged)} joints into their parents to respect {max_bones} bones: "
                      + ", ".join(sorted(name_of[n] for n in merged)))
        dropped = sorted(name_of[n] for n in joints - keep)
        self.dropped_joints = dropped

        # bone order: depth-first, children by node index
        def kparent(n):
            p = jparent(n)
            while p != -1 and p not in keep:
                p = jparent(p)
            return p

        children = {}
        roots = []
        for n in sorted(keep):
            p = kparent(n)
            if p == -1:
                roots.append(n)
            else:
                children.setdefault(p, []).append(n)
        order = []
        stack = list(reversed(roots))
        while stack:
            n = stack.pop()
            order.append(n)
            stack.extend(reversed(children.get(n, [])))
        self.bone_nodes = order
        self.bone_of_node = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(order)}
        # map every joint to its kept bone (itself or the nearest kept ancestor; above the root: the root)
        self.map_node = {}
        for n in joints:
            a = n
            while a != -1 and a not in self.bone_of_node:
                a = jparent(a)
            self.map_node[n] = self.bone_of_node[a] if a != -1 else 0
        # names
        raw = [name_of[n] for n in order]
        names = [self._clean(x) if strip_suffix else x for x in raw]
        if len(set(names)) != len(names):
            names = raw
        names = [x[:31] for x in names]
        seen = {}
        for i, x in enumerate(names):
            if x in seen:
                names[i] = (x[:27] + f"_{i}")[:31]
            seen[names[i]] = i
        self.bone_names = names
        # rest frames (model space): heads of the bind joints
        self.rest_world_full = {}
        heads = []
        self.bind_rot = []
        for n in order:
            W = self.C @ self.bind[n]
            self.rest_world_full[n] = W
            heads.append(W[:3, 3])
            self.bind_rot.append(polar_rotation(W[:3, :3]))
        self.heads = np.array(heads)
        rg = R.Rig()
        for i, n in enumerate(order):
            p = kparent(n)
            rg.add(names[i], None if p == -1 else names[self.bone_of_node[p]], tuple(self.heads[i]))
        self.rig = rg
        self.parents = np.array([b.parent for b in rg.bones])
        self._log(f"skeleton: {len(order)} bones kept of {len(joints)} joints (root {names[0]}); "
                  f"dropped {len(dropped)}: {', '.join(dropped[:40])}{' ...' if len(dropped) > 40 else ''}")

    @staticmethod
    def _clean(name):
        """Exporter suffix "_<digits>" stripped (Sketchfab / FBX converters append node numbers)."""
        head, sep, tail = name.rpartition("_")
        return head if sep and tail.isdigit() and head else name

    def bone(self, name):
        """Bone index from a (clean or original) joint name."""
        if name in self.bone_names:
            return self.bone_names.index(name)
        for i, n in enumerate(self.bone_nodes):
            if self.g.nodes[n].name == name:
                return i
        raise KeyError(f"unknown bone {name!r}")

    # weights / normals ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _finish_surfaces(self):
        nb = len(self.bone_nodes)
        for s in self.surfaces:
            nv = len(s.pos)
            acc = np.zeros((nv, nb))
            for k in range(s.joints.shape[1]):
                b = np.array([self.map_node.get(int(n), 0) for n in s.joints[:, k]])
                np.add.at(acc, (np.arange(nv), b), s.weights[:, k])
            order = np.argsort(-acc, axis=1, kind="stable")[:, :4]
            top = np.take_along_axis(acc, order, 1)
            top = np.where(top > 1e-6, top, 0.0)
            wi = _largest_remainder(top)
            bones = np.where(wi > 0, order, -1)
            # pack used slots first (largest remainder can zero a middle slot)
            srt = np.argsort(-wi, axis=1, kind="stable")
            wi = np.take_along_axis(wi, srt, 1)
            bones = np.take_along_axis(bones, srt, 1)
            bones[wi == 0] = -1
            if bones.shape[1] < 4:   # fewer than 4 bones in the model
                pad = 4 - bones.shape[1]
                bones = np.pad(bones, ((0, 0), (0, pad)), constant_values=-1)
                wi = np.pad(wi, ((0, 0), (0, pad)))
            empty = bones[:, 0] < 0
            if empty.any():
                bones[empty, 0] = 0
                wi[empty, 0] = 255
            s.bw_bones, s.bw_weights = bones, wi
            s.main_bone = bones[:, 0].copy()
            if s.nrm is None:
                s.nrm = self._smooth_normals(s)
        nv = sum(len(s.pos) for s in self.surfaces)
        self._log(f"{nv} vertices, {sum(len(s.tris) for s in self.surfaces)} triangles, "
                  f"{sum(int((s.bw_bones >= 0).sum()) for s in self.surfaces) / max(nv, 1):.2f} weights/vertex")

    def _smooth_normals(self, s):
        """Per-vertex normals for a surface without NORMAL: weld positions, crease-angle smoothing."""
        tol = 1e-4 * float(np.ptp(s.pos, axis=0).max() + 1e-9)
        key = np.round(s.pos / tol).astype(np.int64)
        _, first, inv = np.unique(key, axis=0, return_index=True, return_inverse=True)
        inv = inv.reshape(-1)
        tm = meshmod.TriMesh(s.pos[first], inv[s.tris])
        nrm, corner = meshmod.crease_normals(tm, self.crease)
        out = np.zeros_like(s.pos)
        for f in range(len(s.tris)):
            for k in range(3):
                out[s.tris[f, k]] = nrm[corner[f, k]]
        self._log(f"material {self._matname(s.material)}: normals rebuilt (crease {self.crease:g} deg)")
        return out

    def _matname(self, mat):
        return self.g.materials[mat].name if mat >= 0 else "default"

    # animation --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def bone_world(self, anim=None, t=0.0):
        """(B, 3, 4) rigid model-space bone matrices (identity-rest convention) at animation time t
        (anim None: the rest = bind pose)."""
        nb = len(self.bone_nodes)
        out = np.zeros((nb, 3, 4))
        if anim is None:
            out[:, :, :3] = np.eye(3)
            out[:, :, 3] = self.heads
            return out
        G = self.g.world_matrices(self._anim(anim), t)
        fit = self._bone_fit_points()
        for i, n in enumerate(self.bone_nodes):
            W = self.C @ G[n]
            S = W @ np.linalg.inv(self.rest_world_full[n])  # model-space skinning matrix of the joint
            sv = np.linalg.svd(S[:3, :3], compute_uv=False)
            if np.abs(sv - 1.0).max() < 1e-4 or i not in fit:
                out[i, :, :3] = polar_rotation(S[:3, :3])
                out[i, :, 3] = W[:3, 3]
                continue
            # scaled joint (the format has no bone scale): the rigid motion closest to the true one on the
            # vertices it moves (weighted Kabsch), instead of a rotation about the joint alone
            P, w = fit[i]
            Q = P @ S[:3, :3].T + S[:3, 3]
            pc = (w[:, None] * P).sum(0) / w.sum()
            qc = (w[:, None] * Q).sum(0) / w.sum()
            H = ((P - pc) * w[:, None]).T @ (Q - qc)
            u, _, vt = np.linalg.svd(H)
            d = np.sign(np.linalg.det(vt.T @ u.T))
            Rm = vt.T @ np.diag([1.0, 1.0, d]) @ u.T
            tr = qc - Rm @ pc
            out[i, :, :3] = Rm
            out[i, :, 3] = Rm @ self.heads[i] + tr
        return out

    def _bone_fit_points(self):
        """Per bone: rest positions and weights of the vertices it influences (for the scaled-joint fit)."""
        if getattr(self, "_fit_cache", None) is None:
            fit = {}
            for s in self.surfaces:
                for k in range(4):
                    b = s.bw_bones[:, k]
                    w = s.bw_weights[:, k] / 255.0
                    for bi in np.unique(b[b >= 0]):
                        sel = (b == bi) & (w > 0)
                        fit.setdefault(int(bi), []).append((s.pos[sel], w[sel]))
            self._fit_cache = {b: (np.concatenate([x[0] for x in v]), np.concatenate([x[1] for x in v]))
                               for b, v in fit.items() if sum(len(x[0]) for x in v) >= 3}
        return self._fit_cache

    def local_from_world(self, world):
        """(B, 3, 4) world bone matrices -> (pos (B, 3), euler radians (B, 3)) local values."""
        nb = len(world)
        pos = np.zeros((nb, 3))
        rot = np.zeros((nb, 3))
        for i in range(nb):
            p = self.parents[i]
            if p < 0:
                Rl, tl = world[i, :, :3], world[i, :, 3]
            else:
                Rp = world[p, :, :3]
                Rl = Rp.T @ world[i, :, :3]
                tl = Rp.T @ (world[i, :, 3] - world[p, :, 3])
            pos[i] = tl
            rot[i] = euler_from_matrix(Rl)
        return pos, rot

    def sample(self, anim, times):
        """Local (pos (F, B, 3), rot (F, B, 3)) of an animation at the given times (seconds)."""
        P, Rr = [], []
        for t in times:
            p, r = self.local_from_world(self.bone_world(anim, float(t)))
            P.append(p)
            Rr.append(r)
        return np.array(P), np.array(Rr)

    def pose_at(self, anim, t):
        """rig.Pose of an official animation frame (degrees, offsets from rest): edit it with rig helpers."""
        p, r = self.local_from_world(self.bone_world(anim, t))
        rest = self.rig.rest_local()
        pose = R.Pose()
        for i, name in enumerate(self.bone_names):
            v = np.zeros(6)
            v[:3] = np.degrees(r[i])
            v[3:] = p[i] - rest[i]
            if np.any(np.abs(v) > 1e-9):
                pose[name] = v
        return pose

    def sequence(self, anim, name=None, fps=30.0, loop=False, t0=None, t1=None, activity=0, actweight=1,
                 root_motion=None, feet=None, motion_bone=None, events=(), speed=1.0, frames=None):
        """mdl.Sequence from an official animation.

        fps: sampling rate (frames are spaced evenly over [t0, t1], fps adjusted to fit exactly) and playback;
        speed: playback speed factor (fps of the sequence = sampling fps * speed).  frames: force a frame count.
        loop: last frame = first (the engine loops over numframes - 1 intervals).
        root_motion: None, "extract" (the motion bone's horizontal displacement over the cycle -> linearmovement,
        removed from the roots so the cycle stays in place), "feet" (after that removal, linearmovement from the
        backward speed of the planted `feet` bones: right for in-place gaits too), "lock" (displacement removed,
        no movement).  With feet given, both speeds are logged (equal = no foot sliding)."""
        a = self._anim(anim)
        t0 = a.start if t0 is None else float(t0)
        t1 = a.duration if t1 is None else float(t1)
        dur = max(t1 - t0, 1e-6)
        n = int(frames) - (1 if frames else 0) if frames else max(1, int(round(dur * fps)))
        times = [t0 + dur * i / n for i in range(n + 1)]
        worlds = [self.bone_world(a, t) for t in times]
        lm = np.zeros(3)
        info = ""
        if root_motion not in (None, "extract", "lock", "feet"):
            raise ValueError(f"root_motion {root_motion!r}")
        if root_motion is not None:
            # the motion bone's horizontal displacement over the clip, removed linearly from every bone
            mb = 0 if motion_bone is None else self.bone(motion_bone)
            d = worlds[-1][mb, :, 3] - worlds[0][mb, :, 3]
            d[2] = 0.0
            for i, w in enumerate(worlds):
                w[:, :, 3] -= d * (i / n)
            if root_motion == "extract":
                lm = d
            info = f"root displacement {np.round(d, 2)} ({np.linalg.norm(d) / dur:.1f} units/s)"
            if feet:
                spd = self.feet_speed(worlds, [self.bone(f) for f in feet], dur / n)
                info += f", planted feet {spd:.1f} units/s backward"
                if root_motion == "feet":
                    lm = np.array([spd * dur, 0.0, 0.0])
            elif root_motion == "feet":
                raise ValueError("root_motion='feet' needs feet=[bone names]")
        P = np.zeros((n + 1, len(self.bone_nodes), 3))
        Rr = np.zeros_like(P)
        for i, w in enumerate(worlds):
            P[i], Rr[i] = self.local_from_world(w)
        if loop:
            P[-1], Rr[-1] = P[0], Rr[0]
        evs = [e if isinstance(e, mdl.Event) else mdl.Event(frame=int(e[0]), event=int(e[1]),
                                                             options=str(e[2]) if len(e) > 2 else "")
               for e in events]
        mt = R._linear_flags(tuple(lm)) if np.any(np.abs(lm) > 1e-6) else 0
        seq = mdl.Sequence(name=name or a.name[:31], pos=P, rot=Rr, fps=float(n / dur * speed),
                           flags=mdl.STUDIO_LOOPING if loop else 0, activity=activity,
                           actweight=actweight if activity else 0, events=evs, motiontype=mt,
                           linearmovement=tuple(float(x) for x in lm))
        self._log(f"sequence {seq.name} <- {a.name} [{t0:.3f}, {t1:.3f}] s: {n + 1} frames @ {seq.fps:.2f} fps"
                  + (f", {info}" if info else ""))
        return seq

    @staticmethod
    def feet_speed(worlds, feet, dt):
        """Backward speed (units/s) of the feet while planted (lowest 25 % of their height range)."""
        speeds = []
        for f in feet:
            p = np.array([w[f, :, 3] for w in worlds])
            z = p[:, 2]
            low = z <= z.min() + 0.25 * max(np.ptp(z), 1e-6)
            v = -np.gradient(p[:, 0], dt)
            sel = low & (v > 0)
            if sel.any():
                speeds.append(float(np.median(v[sel])))
        return float(np.mean(speeds)) if speeds else 0.0

    def rest_sequence(self, name="bind", frames=1, fps=30.0, activity=0):
        P = np.tile(self.rig.rest_local(), (frames, 1, 1))
        return mdl.Sequence(name=name, pos=P, rot=np.zeros_like(P), fps=fps, activity=activity,
                            actweight=1 if activity else 0)

    # textures ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _texture_for(self, s, uvt, extra_filter=None):
        """Bake the texture of a surface for its triangles' (wrapped) UVs: returns (Texture, (W, H) of the
        uv space, (x0, y0) crop origin in source pixels, factor)."""
        g = self.g
        mat = g.materials[s.material] if s.material >= 0 else gltf.Material(name="default")
        if mat.base_texture >= 0:
            img = np.asarray(g.texture_image(mat.base_texture)).copy()
        else:
            img = np.full((8, 8, 4), 255, np.uint8)
        f = np.clip(mat.base_color, 0, 1)
        img = np.clip(np.round(img.astype(np.float64) * f[None, None, :]), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
        mo = self.mat_opts.get(mat.name, {})
        if self.texture_filter is not None:
            img = np.asarray(self.texture_filter(mat.name, img), dtype=np.uint8)
        if mo.get("filter") is not None:
            img = np.asarray(mo["filter"](img), dtype=np.uint8)
        if extra_filter is not None:
            img = np.asarray(extra_filter(img), dtype=np.uint8)
        max_size, min_size = mo.get("max_size", self.max_size), mo.get("min_size", self.min_size)
        H0, W0 = img.shape[:2]
        x0, y0, cw, ch = 0, 0, W0, H0
        if mo.get("crop", self.crop):
            umin, umax = uvt.reshape(-1, 2).min(0), uvt.reshape(-1, 2).max(0)
            lo = np.floor(umin * (W0, H0) + 1e-6).astype(int)
            hi = np.ceil(umax * (W0, H0) - 1e-6).astype(int)
            for ax, full in ((0, W0), (1, H0)):
                l, h = max(lo[ax], 0), min(hi[ax], full)
                if umax[ax] > 1.0 + 1e-4:   # triangles wrap across the edge: keep the whole axis
                    l, h = 0, full
                size = min(_pot_ceil(h - l), full) if (full & (full - 1)) == 0 else (h - l)
                l = min(max(l - (size - (h - l)) // 2, 0), full - size)
                if ax == 0:
                    x0, cw = l, size
                else:
                    y0, ch = l, size
        crop = img[y0:y0 + ch, x0:x0 + cw]
        # size: <= max_size, >= min_size (powers of two keep texel centres aligned)
        f = 1.0
        while max(cw, ch) * f > max_size:
            f /= 2
        while max(cw, ch) * f * 2 <= min_size:
            f *= 2
        tw, th = max(1, int(round(cw * f))), max(1, int(round(ch * f)))
        alpha_mode = mat.alpha_mode
        a = crop[..., 3]
        cutoff = mat.alpha_cutoff * 255 if alpha_mode == "MASK" else 127.5
        masked = alpha_mode in ("MASK", "BLEND") and bool((a < cutoff).any())
        src = crop.copy()
        if masked:
            src[..., 3] = np.where(a < cutoff, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
            src = _dilate_rgba(src)
        if (tw, th) != (cw, ch):
            im = Image.fromarray(src, "RGBA")
            if masked:
                rgb = im.convert("RGB").resize((tw, th), Image.LANCZOS)
                al = im.getchannel("A").resize((tw, th), Image.BILINEAR)
                src = np.dstack([np.asarray(rgb), np.asarray(al)])
            else:
                src = np.asarray(im.resize((tw, th), Image.LANCZOS))
        transparent = (src[..., 3] < 128) if masked else None
        # gutters: texels no triangle samples get the colours of the nearest used ones, so bilinear filtering
        # and mipmaps do not bleed unrelated atlas content (black backgrounds, other cells) into the seams
        stf = (uvt * (W0, H0) - (x0, y0)) * f
        cov = _coverage(stf, tw, th)
        if not cov.all():
            known = cov & (src[..., 3] >= 128) if masked else cov
            if known.any():
                rgb = texture.dilate(src[..., :3].astype(np.float64) / 255.0, known, iters=24) * 255.0
                src = src.copy()
                src[..., :3] = np.where(known[..., None], src[..., :3], np.clip(np.round(rgb), 0, 255)).astype(np.uint8)
        idx, pal = quantize_texture(src[..., :3], transparent)
        flags = (mdl.STUDIO_NF_MASKED if masked else 0) | int(mo.get("flags", 0))
        return idx, pal, flags, (x0, y0), (W0, H0), f

    # geometry ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _surface_triangles(self, s):
        """Triangle list of a surface after duplicate removal and double-sided handling, with wrapped UVs:
        (tris (T, 3) vertex ids, flipped (T,) bool, uv (T, 3, 2))."""
        tris = s.tris.copy()
        # drop exact duplicates (coincident copies of the same surface)
        key = np.sort(np.round(s.pos[tris].reshape(len(tris), -1), 4).reshape(len(tris), 3, 3), axis=1)
        _, first = np.unique(key.reshape(len(tris), -1), axis=0, return_index=True)
        dup = len(tris) - len(first)
        tris = tris[np.sort(first)]
        flipped = np.zeros(len(tris), bool)
        mat = self.g.materials[s.material] if s.material >= 0 else None
        ds = self.double_sided
        forced = mat is not None and "double_sided" in self.mat_opts.get(mat.name, {})
        if forced:
            ds = self.mat_opts[mat.name]["double_sided"]
        if ds and mat is not None and (mat.double_sided or forced):
            if ds == "auto":
                open_faces = self._single_sided_faces(s.pos, tris, self._all_pos, self._all_tris)
            else:
                open_faces = np.ones(len(tris), bool)
            if open_faces.any():
                back = tris[open_faces][:, ::-1]
                tris = np.concatenate([tris, back])
                flipped = np.concatenate([flipped, np.ones(len(back), bool)])
                self._log(f"material {mat.name}: {int(open_faces.sum())} single-sided triangles get a back face")
        if dup:
            self._log(f"material {self._matname(s.material)}: {dup} duplicate triangles dropped")
        uv = s.uv[tris]
        uv = uv - np.floor(uv.min(1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6)
        return tris, flipped, uv

    @staticmethod
    def _single_sided_faces(pos, tris, all_pos, all_tris, chunk=256, decal_gap=0.03):
        """Faces that are a thin sheet: a ray from the face centre going inward (against its normal) first meets
        the BACK of another face when the face bounds a volume; it meets nothing, or the front of another
        surface, behind a sheet (wing membranes, flames, fins): those faces need a back face in GoldSrc."""
        a, b, c = (pos[tris[:, k]] for k in range(3))
        n = np.cross(b - a, c - a)
        ln = np.linalg.norm(n, axis=1)
        good = ln > 1e-12
        n = n / np.where(good, ln, 1.0)[:, None]
        ctr = (a + b + c) / 3
        A, B, Cc = (all_pos[all_tris[:, k]] for k in range(3))
        e1, e2 = B - A, Cc - A
        N = np.cross(e1, e2)
        scale = float(np.ptp(all_pos, axis=0).max() + 1e-9)
        out = np.zeros(len(tris), bool)
        for s0 in range(0, len(tris), chunk):
            o = ctr[s0:s0 + chunk] - n[s0:s0 + chunk] * (1e-4 * scale)
            d = -n[s0:s0 + chunk]
            # Moller-Trumbore, all pairs of the chunk x all triangles
            pvec = np.cross(d[:, None, :], e2[None, :, :])
            det = np.einsum("tk,itk->it", e1, pvec)
            ok = np.abs(det) > 1e-12
            inv = np.where(ok, 1.0 / np.where(ok, det, 1.0), 0.0)
            tvec = o[:, None, :] - A[None, :, :]
            u = np.einsum("itk,itk->it", tvec, pvec) * inv
            qvec = np.cross(tvec, e1[None, :, :])
            v = np.einsum("ik,itk->it", d, qvec) * inv
            t = np.einsum("tk,itk->it", e2, qvec) * inv
            hit = ok & (u >= 0) & (v >= 0) & (u + v <= 1) & (t > 1e-6 * scale)
            t = np.where(hit, t, np.inf)
            first = np.argmin(t, axis=1)
            has = np.isfinite(t[np.arange(len(first)), first])
            facing = np.einsum("ik,ik->i", N[first], d) > 0     # hit from behind: we are inside a volume
            tf = t[np.arange(len(first)), first]
            decal = has & ~facing & (tf < decal_gap * scale)     # a decal lying on another surface
            out[s0:s0 + chunk] = good[s0:s0 + chunk] & ~(has & facing) & ~decal
        return out

    def studio(self, name, sequences, attachments=(), hitbox_groups=None, hitbox_bones=None, eyeposition=None,
               hull=None, controllers=(), skin_variants=(), min_hitbox_verts=12):
        """Assemble the mdl.Studio.

        sequences: mdl.Sequence list (from sequence(), rest_sequence() or rig.make_sequence(self.rig, ...)).
        attachments: [(name, bone, model-space rest position)].
        hitbox_groups: {bone name: HITGROUP_*} (others 0); hitbox_bones: restrict hitboxes to these bones.
        controllers: [(bone, type, start, end, index)].
        skin_variants: extra skin families, each {material name: filter(rgba) -> rgba} applied to the material's
        full source image before cropping (e.g. copy a closed-eyes cell of an expression atlas over the open one,
        or recolour); materials without a filter keep their texture.  Skin 0 is the plain conversion."""
        nb = len(self.bone_nodes)
        base = name.rsplit("/", 1)[-1].rsplit(".", 1)[0]
        offs = np.cumsum([0] + [len(x.pos) for x in self.surfaces])
        self._all_pos = np.concatenate([x.pos for x in self.surfaces])
        self._all_tris = np.concatenate([x.tris + o for x, o in zip(self.surfaces, offs)])
        textures, tex_key = [], {}
        verts, vbones, vweights, vmain = [], [], [], []
        norms, nbones, nweights, nmain = [], [], [], []
        mesh_tris, mesh_seen = {}, {}
        vkey, nkey = {}, {}
        surf_tex, surf_ti = [], []
        for s in self.surfaces:
            tris, flipped, uv = self._surface_triangles(s)
            idx, pal, flags, (x0, y0), (W0, H0), f = self._texture_for(s, uv)
            surf_tex.append((s, uv))
            key = idx.tobytes() + pal.tobytes() + flags.to_bytes(4, "little")
            if key not in tex_key:
                tex_key[key] = len(textures)
                tname = f"{base}_{self._matname(s.material)}".replace(" ", "_").replace("#", "")[:59] + ".bmp"
                if tname.lower().startswith(("dm_base", "remap")):
                    tname = "t_" + tname
                textures.append(mdl.Texture(name=tname, pixels=idx, palette=pal, flags=flags))
            ti = tex_key[key]
            surf_ti.append(ti)
            tex = textures[ti]
            st = np.round((uv * (W0, H0) - (x0, y0)) * f).astype(np.int64)
            st[..., 0] = np.clip(st[..., 0], 0, None)
            st[..., 1] = np.clip(st[..., 1], 0, None)
            if st[..., 0].max() > 2 * tex.width or st[..., 1].max() > 2 * tex.height:
                over = int(((st[..., 0] > 2 * tex.width) | (st[..., 1] > 2 * tex.height)).any(1).sum())
                self._log(f"material {self._matname(s.material)}: {over} triangles span more than one texture "
                          f"repeat (clamped)")
                st[..., 0] = np.minimum(st[..., 0], 2 * tex.width)
                st[..., 1] = np.minimum(st[..., 1], 2 * tex.height)
            out = mesh_tris.setdefault(ti, [])
            seen = mesh_seen.setdefault(ti, set())
            ndup = 0
            for fi in range(len(tris)):
                tk = (tuple(sorted(tuple(np.round(s.pos[int(v)], 4)) for v in tris[fi])), bool(flipped[fi]))
                if tk in seen:
                    ndup += 1
                    continue
                seen.add(tk)
                corner = []
                for k in range(3):
                    vi = int(tris[fi, k])
                    kv = (tuple(np.round(s.pos[vi], 5)), tuple(s.bw_bones[vi]), tuple(s.bw_weights[vi]))
                    if kv not in vkey:
                        vkey[kv] = len(verts)
                        verts.append(s.pos[vi])
                        vbones.append(s.bw_bones[vi])
                        vweights.append(s.bw_weights[vi])
                        vmain.append(s.main_bone[vi])
                    n = -s.nrm[vi] if flipped[fi] else s.nrm[vi]
                    kn = (tuple(np.round(n, 4)), kv[1], kv[2])
                    if kn not in nkey:
                        nkey[kn] = len(norms)
                        norms.append(n)
                        nbones.append(s.bw_bones[vi])
                        nweights.append(s.bw_weights[vi])
                        nmain.append(s.main_bone[vi])
                    corner.append((vkey[kv], nkey[kn], st[fi, k, 0], st[fi, k, 1]))
                out.append(corner)
            if ndup:
                self._log(f"material {self._matname(s.material)}: {ndup} triangles already drawn by another "
                          f"material with the same texture, dropped")
        # skin families: skinref = base texture index; variants substitute re-baked textures
        nbase = len(textures)
        skins = None
        if skin_variants:
            skins = [list(range(nbase))]
            for vi, variant in enumerate(skin_variants):
                fam = list(range(nbase))
                for (s, uv), ti in zip(surf_tex, surf_ti):
                    fn = variant.get(self._matname(s.material))
                    if fn is None:
                        continue
                    idx, pal, flags, _, _, _ = self._texture_for(s, uv, extra_filter=fn)
                    key = idx.tobytes() + pal.tobytes() + flags.to_bytes(4, "little")
                    if key not in tex_key:
                        tex_key[key] = len(textures)
                        t0 = textures[ti]
                        textures.append(mdl.Texture(name=(t0.name[:-4][:55] + f"_s{vi + 1}.bmp"), pixels=idx,
                                                    palette=pal, flags=flags))
                    fam[ti] = tex_key[key]
                skins.append(fam)
        meshes = [mdl.Mesh(tris=np.array(mesh_tris[ti], dtype=np.int64), skinref=ti) for ti in sorted(mesh_tris)]
        model = mdl.Model(name=base, verts=np.array(verts), vert_bone=np.array(vmain), norms=np.array(norms),
                          norm_bone=np.array(nmain), meshes=meshes,
                          vert_weights=mdl.BoneWeights(np.array(vbones), np.array(vweights)),
                          norm_weights=mdl.BoneWeights(np.array(nbones), np.array(nweights)))
        bodyparts = [mdl.BodyPart(name="body", models=[model])]
        self._log(f"model: {len(verts)} verts, {len(norms)} normals, {sum(len(m.tris) for m in meshes)} tris, "
                  f"{len(meshes)} meshes; textures " + ", ".join(f"{t.name} {t.width}x{t.height}"
                                                                + (" masked" if t.flags & mdl.STUDIO_NF_MASKED else "")
                                                                for t in textures))
        bones = self.rig.mdl_bones()

        # bounds per sequence (skinned vertices, every frame)
        V = np.array(verts)
        bw = model.vert_weights
        wv = np.where(bw.bones >= 0, bw.weights, 0) / 255.0
        bi = np.maximum(bw.bones, 0)
        hdr_lo = hdr_hi = None
        for seq in sequences:
            lo, hi = np.full(3, np.inf), np.full(3, -np.inf)
            for fr in range(seq.numframes):
                W = mdl.bone_matrices(bones, seq.pos[fr], seq.rot[fr])
                S = W.copy()
                S[:, :, 3] = W[:, :, 3] - np.einsum("bij,bj->bi", W[:, :, :3], self.heads)
                M = np.einsum("nk,nkij->nij", wv, S[bi])
                p = np.einsum("nij,nj->ni", M[:, :, :3], V) + M[:, :, 3]
                lo = np.minimum(lo, p.min(0))
                hi = np.maximum(hi, p.max(0))
            seq.bbmin, seq.bbmax = tuple(lo), tuple(hi)
            if hdr_lo is None:
                hdr_lo, hdr_hi = lo, hi

        # hitboxes: per main bone, extents of the vertices it dominates (rest pose, bone space)
        hitboxes = []
        dom = bw.bones[:, 0]
        strong = bw.weights[:, 0] >= 128
        allowed = None if hitbox_bones is None else {self.bone(b) for b in hitbox_bones}
        groups = {self.bone(k): v for k, v in (hitbox_groups or {}).items()}
        for b in range(nb):
            if allowed is not None and b not in allowed:
                continue
            sel = (dom == b) & strong
            if sel.sum() < min_hitbox_verts:
                continue
            p = V[sel] - self.heads[b]
            hitboxes.append(mdl.Hitbox(bone=b, group=groups.get(b, 0), bbmin=tuple(p.min(0)), bbmax=tuple(p.max(0))))
        atts = []
        for an, ab, apos in attachments:
            b = self.bone(ab)
            atts.append(mdl.Attachment(bone=b, org=tuple(np.asarray(apos, float) - self.heads[b]), name=an))
        ctrls = []
        for (cb, ctype, cs, ce, cidx) in controllers:
            rest = int(round(255 * (0 - cs) / (ce - cs))) if ce != cs else 0
            ctrls.append(mdl.BoneController(bone=self.bone(cb), type=ctype, start=cs, end=ce, index=cidx,
                                            rest=max(0, min(255, rest))))
        eye = eyeposition if eyeposition is not None else (0.0, 0.0, float(hdr_hi[2]) * 0.85)
        if hull is not None:
            hmin, hmax = hull
        else:
            r = float(max(abs(hdr_lo[0]), abs(hdr_hi[0]), abs(hdr_lo[1]), abs(hdr_hi[1])))
            hmin, hmax = (-r, -r, 0.0), (r, r, float(hdr_hi[2]))
        return mdl.Studio(name=name, bones=bones, sequences=list(sequences), textures=textures, bodyparts=bodyparts,
                          skins=skins, controllers=ctrls, attachments=atts, hitboxes=hitboxes,
                          eyeposition=tuple(eye), min=tuple(hmin), max=tuple(hmax), bbmin=tuple(hdr_lo),
                          bbmax=tuple(hdr_hi))

    def joint_report(self):
        """Lines: bone index, name, parent, rest head (model space), weighted vertex count."""
        counts = np.zeros(len(self.bone_nodes), int)
        for s in self.surfaces:
            np.add.at(counts, s.bw_bones[s.bw_bones >= 0], 1)
        lines = []
        for i, nm in enumerate(self.bone_names):
            p = self.parents[i]
            lines.append(f"{i:3d} {nm:28s} <- {self.bone_names[p] if p >= 0 else '-':28s} "
                         f"head {np.round(self.heads[i], 1)} verts {counts[i]}")
        return lines
```

```py
    "~": "00000 00000 01000 10101 00010 00000 00000 00000",
    "\x7f": "11111 11111 11111 11111 11111 11111 11111 11111",   # block cursor
}

# katakana-like shapes (a, i, u, e, o, ka, ki, ku, ke, ko, sa, shi, su, se, so, ta, chi, tsu, te, to,

def _parse(rows):
    r = [[c == "1" for c in row] for row in rows.split()]
    while len(r) < 8:
        r.append([False] * 5)
    return np.array(r, dtype=bool)


FONT = {k: _parse(v) for k, v in _F.items()}
KANA = [_parse(v) for v in _K]
CURSOR = "\x7f"


def glyph(ch):
    """5x8 bool array of a character (unknown characters: '?')."""
    return FONT.get(ch, FONT["?"])


def rain_glyphs():
    """The code rain's alphabet: the katakana mirrored left-right, and the digits (some mirrored too)."""
    out = [g[:, ::-1] for g in KANA]
    for i, d in enumerate("0123456789"):
        g = FONT[d]
        out.append(g[:, ::-1] if i % 3 == 1 else g)
    out += [FONT[c] for c in ":=+*<>\"|"]
    return out
```

`tools/goldsrc/assets/pokemon/balls.py`:

```py
"""Poke Balls: models/pokemon/w_pokeball.mdl (world / thrown), p_pokeball.mdl (third person, merged on the
player's right hand) and v_pokeball.mdl (first person: gloved hand and sleeved forearm holding the ball).

Skins (all three models): 0 Pikachu (yellow), 1 Charizard (orange), 2 Blastoise (blue): the stripe in the
black band, the button's glow and the emblem on the top cap (bolt, flame, drop) change; the rest is shared.

The ball is made of surfaces of revolution (exact spheres, crisp band step and button rings), the hand and
the sleeve of smooth SDF shapes.  The view model is authored LEFT-handed on the left of the view, because the
Counter-Strike client mirrors every view model across y while cl_righthand is 1 (its default,
cl_dll/StudioModelRenderer.cpp), like the stock CS view models; it appears right-handed in game.
"""
import math

import numpy as np

from .. import builder, mdl, mesh as M, rig as R, sdf, texture as T, xform

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# palette
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

RED = T.rgb("#d0202a")
RED_DARK = T.rgb("#7c0d16")
WHITE = T.rgb("#eeeeea")
WHITE_SHADOW = T.rgb("#a9adb8")
BAND = T.rgb("#151518")
RING = T.rgb("#1b1b1f")
INSIDE = T.rgb("#d9d6cc")

# per skin: (name, main colour, light colour, dark outline)
# (a Poké Ball stays neutral, the owner's choice: the three skins are the same classic ball — no emblem, a plain band,
# a white button — the species only told by the HUD and the buy menu)
NEUTRAL = (BAND, T.rgb("#f4f4f0"), T.rgb("#2a2a2e"))
SPECIES = [(name,) + NEUTRAL for name in ("pikachu", "charizard", "blastoise")]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# geometry helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def lathe(profile, n, R_=None, t=None):
    """Surface of revolution about +z: profile [(rho, z), ...] walking the cross-section boundary with the
    solid on its right (down the outer side).  An end on the axis (rho 0) closes with a pole fan, else the
    surface stays open there (a cup's inner surface can be a separate part).  Returns a TriMesh with outward
    counter-clockwise faces, rotated by R_ and translated by t."""
    prof = [(float(r), float(z)) for r, z in profile]
    pole0, pole1 = prof[0][0] == 0.0, prof[-1][0] == 0.0
    rings = prof[(1 if pole0 else 0):(len(prof) - 1 if pole1 else len(prof))]
    phi = np.arange(n) * 2 * math.pi / n
    nr = len(rings)
    off = 1 if pole0 else 0
    verts = [(0.0, 0.0, prof[0][1])] if pole0 else []
    for r, z in rings:
        verts.extend(np.stack([r * np.cos(phi), r * np.sin(phi), np.full(n, z)], 1).tolist())
    if pole1:
        verts.append((0.0, 0.0, prof[-1][1]))
    faces = []

    def vid(i, j):
        return off + i * n + (j % n)

    if pole0:
        for j in range(n):
            faces.append((0, vid(0, j), vid(0, j + 1)))
    for i in range(nr - 1):
        for j in range(n):
            a, b, c, d = vid(i, j), vid(i + 1, j), vid(i, j + 1), vid(i + 1, j + 1)
            faces.append((a, b, c))
            faces.append((b, d, c))
    if pole1:
        last = off + nr * n
        for j in range(n):
            faces.append((vid(nr - 1, j), last, vid(nr - 1, j + 1)))
    m = M.TriMesh(np.array(verts), np.array(faces))
    if R_ is not None or t is not None:
        m = m.transformed(R_, t)
    return m


def arc(r, a0, a1, steps, z0=0.0):
    """Points (rho, z) on a circle of radius r centred on the axis at z0, angles from the +z axis (deg)."""
    return [(r * math.sin(math.radians(a)), z0 + r * math.cos(math.radians(a)))
            for a in np.linspace(a0, a1, steps + 1)]


def frame_to(d):
    """Rotation whose +z goes to direction d."""
    d = np.asarray(d, dtype=np.float64)
    d = d / np.linalg.norm(d)
    return R._align((0.0, 0.0, 1.0), d)


def frame_from(x, other, z_is_second=True):
    """Rotation with +x along x and +z along `other` made orthogonal to it (columns x, y, z)."""
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    x = x / np.linalg.norm(x)
    z = np.asarray(other, dtype=np.float64)
    z = z - x * (z @ x)
    z = z / np.linalg.norm(z)
    return np.stack([x, np.cross(z, x), z], axis=1)


def flip_mesh(m, axis=1):
    """Mirror image of a mesh (winding fixed so faces stay outward)."""
    v = m.verts.copy()
    v[:, axis] = -v[:, axis]
    return M.TriMesh(v, m.faces[:, ::-1].copy())


def split_annuli(m, r):
    """(rest, rings): the flat rings of a ball-frame lathe (the band's steps and the cups' lips, normal along
    the axis, far from it) apart from the rest.  A ring's box chart is a whole disc of empty atlas around a
    thin line, so the rings get their own low-density part."""
    v = m.verts[m.faces]
    n = np.cross(v[:, 1] - v[:, 0], v[:, 2] - v[:, 0])
    n = n / np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(n, axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-12)
    rho = np.linalg.norm(v.mean(axis=1)[:, :2], axis=1)
    ring = (np.abs(n[:, 2]) > 0.9) & (rho > 0.6 * r)
    return M.TriMesh(m.verts, m.faces[~ring]).compact(), M.TriMesh(m.verts, m.faces[ring]).compact()


def signed_volume(m):
    v = m.verts[m.faces]
    return float(np.einsum("ij,ij->i", v[:, 0], np.cross(v[:, 1], v[:, 2])).sum() / 6.0)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# the ball, in its own frame: centre at the origin, +z up (top cap), +x the button, hinge at -x
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

class BallSpec:
    """Proportions of a ball of radius r (shared by the three models)."""

    def __init__(self, r, n=32, arc_steps=9):
        self.r = r
        self.n = n
        self.arc_steps = arc_steps
        self.g = 0.10 * r             # half height of the black band
        self.rb = r - 0.035 * r       # band radius (recessed step)
        self.ri = r - 0.11 * r        # inner surface radius (cups)
        self.ring_r = 0.30 * r        # black ring around the button (on the sphere)
        self.btn_r = 0.185 * r        # white button
        self.btn_h = 0.075 * r        # ring protrusion above the sphere
        self.btn_dome = 0.05 * r      # dome of the white button above the ring

    def solid(self):
        """Closed ball (held models): red cap, recessed black band, white bottom."""
        r, g, rb = self.r, self.g, self.rb
        a_band = math.degrees(math.acos(g / r))
        prof = arc(r, 0, a_band, self.arc_steps)
        prof += [(rb, g), (rb, -g)]
        prof += arc(r, 180 - a_band, 180, self.arc_steps)
        prof[-1] = (0.0, -r)
        return lathe(prof, self.n)

    def cups(self, inner_steps=4):
        """Two hollow halves (world model, opens) meeting at z = 0: (top outer, top inner, bottom outer,
        bottom inner) surfaces; each outer/inner pair shares its lip ring (no crack, two texture densities)."""
        r, g, rb, ri = self.r, self.g, self.rb, self.ri
        a_band = math.degrees(math.acos(g / r))
        lip = 0.004 * r
        a_in = math.degrees(math.acos(lip / ri))
        top = arc(r, 0, a_band, self.arc_steps) + [(rb, g), (rb, lip), (ri * math.sin(math.radians(a_in)), lip)]
        top_in = arc(ri, a_in, 0, inner_steps)
        top_in[-1] = (0.0, ri)
        bot_in = arc(ri, 180, 180 - a_in, inner_steps)
        bot_in[0] = (0.0, -ri)
        bot = [bot_in[-1], (rb, -lip), (rb, -g)] + arc(r, 180 - a_band, 180, self.arc_steps)
        bot[-1] = (0.0, -r)
        return lathe(top, self.n), lathe(top_in, self.n), lathe(bot, self.n), lathe(bot_in, self.n)

    def button(self, n=20):
        """Button on +x: black ring (sunk into the sphere) carrying the white domed button."""
        r = self.r
        h_ring = self.btn_h
        rr = self.ring_r * 0.92
        br = self.btn_r
        rr_base = math.sqrt(max(r * r - rr * rr, 0.0))
        e = 0.18 * h_ring
        prof = [(0.0, r + h_ring + self.btn_dome)]
        prof += [(br * math.sin(math.radians(a)), r + h_ring + self.btn_dome * math.cos(math.radians(a)))
                 for a in (30, 60, 90)][:-1]
        prof += [(br, r + h_ring + 0.01 * r), (br * 1.06, r + h_ring - 0.02 * r), (rr - e, r + h_ring),
                 (rr, r + h_ring - e), (rr, rr_base - 0.12 * r), (0.0, rr_base - 0.12 * r)]
        return lathe(prof, n, R_=frame_to((1, 0, 0)))

    def glow_disc(self, z, radius, thick, n=24, up=True):
        """Thin lens (additive light) lying in the plane z."""
        s = 1 if up else -1
        prof = [(0.0, z + s * thick)] + [(radius * math.sin(math.radians(a)), z + s * thick * math.cos(math.radians(a)))
                                         for a in (35, 70)]
        prof += [(radius, z), (0.0, z - s * 0.0001)]
        if not up:
            prof = [(0.0, z + 0.0001)] + [(radius, z)] + [(radius * math.sin(math.radians(a)),
                                                           z - thick * math.cos(math.radians(a))) for a in (70, 35)]
            prof += [(0.0, z - thick)]
        return lathe(prof, n)

    def button_glow(self, n=16):
        """Additive cap just over the white button (species glow)."""
        r = self.r
        z0 = r + self.btn_h + 0.012 * r
        br = self.btn_r * 0.98
        prof = [(0.0, z0 + self.btn_dome + 0.004 * r)]
        prof += [(br * math.sin(math.radians(a)), z0 + self.btn_dome * math.cos(math.radians(a))) for a in (35, 65)]
        prof += [(br, z0), (0.0, z0 - 0.001)]
        return lathe(prof, n, R_=frame_to((1, 0, 0)))

    def ao_shape(self):
        r, g, rb = self.r, self.g, self.rb
        groove = sdf.cylinder((0, 0, -g), (0, 0, g), r * 1.2) - sdf.cylinder((0, 0, -2 * g), (0, 0, 2 * g), rb)
        ball = sdf.subtract(sdf.sphere((0, 0, 0), r), groove)
        btn = sdf.cylinder((r - 0.2 * r, 0, 0), (r + self.btn_h, 0, 0), self.ring_r * 0.92, 0.02 * r)
        return ball | btn


# --- emblems (2D, in units of the ball radius; a = emblem right, b = emblem up) ------------------------

def _poly_sdf2(Q, poly):
    """Signed distance (negative inside) from 2D points Q (N, 2) to a closed polygon (M, 2)."""
    poly = np.asarray(poly, dtype=np.float64)
    A = poly
    B = np.roll(poly, -1, axis=0)
    d = np.full(len(Q), np.inf)
    inside = np.zeros(len(Q), dtype=bool)
    for a, b in zip(A, B):
        e = b - a
        w = Q - a
        t = np.clip((w @ e) / max(e @ e, 1e-12), 0, 1)
        dist = np.linalg.norm(w - np.outer(t, e), axis=1)
        d = np.minimum(d, dist)
        cond = ((a[1] > Q[:, 1]) != (b[1] > Q[:, 1]))
        xint = a[0] + (Q[:, 1] - a[1]) * (b[0] - a[0]) / np.where(abs(b[1] - a[1]) < 1e-12, 1e-12, b[1] - a[1])
        inside ^= cond & (Q[:, 0] < xint)
    return np.where(inside, -d, d)


def _teardrop(n=48, sway=0.0, width=0.62, m=1.2):
    t = np.linspace(0, 2 * math.pi, n, endpoint=False)
    y = np.cos(t)
    x = width * np.sin(t) * np.abs(np.sin(t / 2)) ** m
    x = x + sway * ((1 + y) / 2) ** 2.2
    return np.stack([x, -y * 0.9 + 0.1], 1)[::-1] * np.array([1, -1])


BOLT = np.array([(0.12, 1.0), (0.56, 1.0), (0.14, 0.16), (0.46, 0.16), (-0.36, -1.0), (-0.08, -0.12),
                 (-0.42, -0.12)])
FLAME_TONGUES = [  # (teardrop points, scale, rotation deg (positive leans left), offset)
    (_teardrop(sway=-0.22, width=0.66), 1.0, 0.0, (0.06, 0.0)),
    (_teardrop(n=36, sway=0.18, width=0.62), 0.56, 28.0, (-0.34, -0.30)),
    (_teardrop(n=36, sway=-0.15, width=0.62), 0.50, -30.0, (0.40, -0.36)),
]
FLAME_IN = (_teardrop(n=40, sway=-0.12, width=0.62), 0.46, 0.0, (0.05, -0.42))


def _tongue_sdf(Q, tongue):
    pts, sc, rot, off = tongue
    a = math.radians(rot)
    c, s_ = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
    q = (Q - np.asarray(off)) @ np.array([[c, -s_], [s_, c]]) / sc
    return _poly_sdf2(q, pts) * sc
DROP = _teardrop(width=0.7, m=1.45)


def emblem_masks(Q, skin):
    """Q (N, 2) emblem coordinates (units of the emblem half size) -> (fill colour (N, 3), fill, outline)."""
    name, col, light, dark = SPECIES[skin]
    if name == "pikachu":
        d = _poly_sdf2(Q, BOLT)
        inner = None
    elif name == "charizard":
        d = np.min([_tongue_sdf(Q, tg) for tg in FLAME_TONGUES], axis=0)
        inner = _tongue_sdf(Q, FLAME_IN)
    else:
        d = _poly_sdf2(Q, DROP)
        inner = None
    fill_c = np.tile(col, (len(Q), 1))
    if inner is not None:
        fill_c = T.mix(fill_c, light, T.edge(inner, 0.08))
    if name == "blastoise":  # a highlight in the drop
        hl = np.linalg.norm((Q - np.array([-0.18, -0.15])) / np.array([0.13, 0.26]), axis=1) - 1.0
        fill_c = T.mix(fill_c, light, T.edge(hl * 0.13, 0.05))
    if name == "pikachu":
        fill_c = T.mix(fill_c, light, T.edge(_poly_sdf2(Q, BOLT * 0.55 + np.array([0.03, 0.02])), 0.06) * 0.6)
    return fill_c, d


# --- paint of the ball ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

class BallPaint:
    """Paint functions for a ball placed in model space by (Rm, c) and optionally mirrored in y.

    local = Rm^T (P' - c) with P' = P mirrored back when the model is authored mirrored."""

    def __init__(self, spec, Rm=np.eye(3), c=(0, 0, 0), mirror=False, emblem_size=0.0, light=(0.45, 0.35, 0.82),
                 seam=False, emblem_lat=50.0, gloss=0.55, sheen=0.10):
        """gloss / sheen: painted specular highlight (fixed in ball space: keep it low on balls that spin)."""
        self.seam = seam
        self.gloss, self.sheen = gloss, sheen
        lat = math.radians(emblem_lat)
        self.e_dir = np.array([math.cos(lat), 0.0, math.sin(lat)])     # emblem centre, above the button
        self.e_up = np.array([-math.sin(lat), 0.0, math.cos(lat)])     # towards the pole
        self.e_right = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0])                        # seen from the front
        self.s = spec
        self.Rm = np.asarray(Rm, dtype=np.float64)
        self.c = np.asarray(c, dtype=np.float64)
        self.mirror = mirror
        self.emblem_size = emblem_size
        L = np.asarray(light, dtype=np.float64)
        self.light = L / np.linalg.norm(L)
        self.ao = spec.ao_shape()

    def local(self, P, N):
        P = np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64).copy()
        N = np.asarray(N, dtype=np.float64).copy()
        if self.mirror:
            P[:, 1] *= -1
            N[:, 1] *= -1
        return (P - self.c) @ self.Rm, N @ self.Rm

    def _gloss(self, N, c, power=36.0, amount=0.55, sheen=0.12):
        h = np.clip(N @ self.light, 0, 1)
        spec = amount * h ** power + sheen * h ** 5
        return np.clip(c + spec[:, None] * (1.0 - c * 0.35), 0, 1)

    def shell(self, P, N, skin, inside=None):
        p, n = self.local(P, N)
        s = self.s
        r = s.r
        z = p[:, 2] / r
        rho = np.linalg.norm(p[:, :2], axis=1)
        # base colours: red cap with a soft gradient, white bottom
        red = T.mix(RED_DARK, RED, np.clip((z - 0.05) / 0.55, 0, 1) ** 0.6)
        red = T.mix(red, T.rgb("#ff4a4a"), np.clip((z - 0.75) / 0.25, 0, 1) * 0.25)
        white = T.mix(WHITE_SHADOW, WHITE, np.clip((z + 0.95) / 0.85, 0, 1) ** 0.7)
        c = np.where((p[:, 2] > 0)[:, None], red, white)
        # the band (recessed part) and its species stripe
        band = np.abs(p[:, 2]) < s.g + 0.004 * r
        on_sphere = ~band
        name, col, light, dark = SPECIES[skin]
        az = np.abs(p[:, 2]) / s.g
        stripe = T.edge((az - 0.42) * s.g, 0.12 * s.g)
        bandc = T.mix(np.tile(BAND, (len(p), 1)), col, stripe)
        bandc = T.mix(bandc, light, stripe * np.clip(1 - az / 0.3, 0, 1) * 0.5)
        if self.seam:  # the two cups meet at z = 0: a fine dark line
            bandc = T.mix(bandc, BAND, T.edge(np.abs(p[:, 2]) - 0.012 * r, 0.012 * r) * 0.8)
        c = np.where(band[:, None], bandc, c)
        # thin dark edge where the caps meet the band
        lip = T.edge(np.abs(np.abs(p[:, 2]) - s.g) - 0.02 * r, 0.025 * r) * on_sphere
        c = T.mix(c, BAND * 1.4, lip * 0.75)
        # black ring around the button
        ang = np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(p[:, 0] / np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(p, axis=1), 1e-9), -1, 1)))
        ring_a = math.degrees(math.asin(s.ring_r / r))
        ring = T.edge((ang - ring_a) * math.pi / 180 * r, 0.035 * r)
        c = T.mix(c, RING, ring)
        # emblem on the red cap above the button, upright for someone facing the button
        if self.emblem_size:
            Q = np.stack([p @ self.e_right, p @ self.e_up], 1) / (self.emblem_size * r)
            fill_c, d = emblem_masks(Q, skin)
            top = np.clip((n @ self.e_dir - 0.45) / 0.2, 0, 1) * (p[:, 2] > 0.12 * r)
            c = T.mix(c, dark * 0.6, T.edge(d - 0.20, 0.05) * top)
            c = T.mix(c, np.tile(WHITE, (len(p), 1)), T.edge(d - 0.12, 0.05) * top)
            c = T.mix(c, fill_c, T.edge(d, 0.05) * top)
        # inside of the cups (seen when open): pale, lit by the light
        if inside is not None:
            ins = (np.linalg.norm(p, axis=1) < (s.ri + s.rb) / 2) & (np.abs(p[:, 2]) > 0.006 * r)
            glow = T.mix(INSIDE, light, 0.35)
            glow = T.mix(glow, np.ones(3), np.clip(1 - np.abs(p[:, 2]) / s.ri, 0, 1) ** 2 * 0.5)
            c = np.where(ins[:, None], glow, c)
        # shading painted in: AO, a little top light, gloss on the outside
        ao = T.ambient_occlusion(self.ao, p, n, dist=0.25 * r, steps=4)
        ao = np.where(band, np.maximum(ao, 0.8), ao)
        out = T.shade(c, n, ao=ao, ao_strength=0.5, top=0.10)
        gl = self._gloss(n, out, amount=self.gloss, sheen=self.sheen)
        gl_band = self._gloss(n, out, power=24, amount=self.gloss * 0.64, sheen=self.sheen * 0.5)
        out = np.where(band[:, None], gl_band, gl)
        if inside is not None:
            out = np.where(ins[:, None], T.shade(c, n, top=0.05), out)
        return out

    def shell_open(self, P, N, skin):
        return self.shell(P, N, skin, inside=True)

    def button(self, P, N, skin):
        p, n = self.local(P, N)
        s = self.s
        r = s.r
        name, col, light, dark = SPECIES[skin]
        rad = np.linalg.norm(p[:, 1:], axis=1)
        face = (p[:, 0] > r + s.btn_h + 0.004 * r) & (rad < s.btn_r * 1.02)
        c = np.tile(RING, (len(p), 1))
        # ring: a slightly lighter bevel catches the light
        c = T.mix(c, T.rgb("#34343a"), T.edge(np.abs(rad - s.ring_r * 0.80) - 0.035 * r, 0.03 * r) * 0.8)
        wc = T.mix(T.rgb("#c9ccd2"), WHITE, np.clip((p[:, 0] - (r + s.btn_h)) / s.btn_dome, 0, 1))
        wc = T.mix(wc, col, T.edge(np.abs(rad - s.btn_r * 0.72) - 0.05 * r, 0.03 * r) * 0.85)
        c = np.where(face[:, None], wc, c)
        out = T.shade(c, n, top=0.1)
        return self._gloss(n, out, power=30, amount=max(self.gloss * 0.9, 0.3))

    def glow(self, P, N, skin):
        """Additive light: white-hot centre fading to the species colour, black (nothing) at the rim."""
        p, n = self.local(P, N)
        name, col, light, dark = SPECIES[skin]
        rad = np.linalg.norm(p[:, :2], axis=1) / (self.s.ri)
        k = np.clip(1 - rad, 0, 1)
        c = T.mix(col * 0.6, np.array([1.0, 1.0, 0.92]), k ** 1.5)
        return c * np.clip(k * 2.2, 0, 1)[:, None] ** 0.8

    def button_glow(self, P, N, skin):
        p, n = self.local(P, N)
        name, col, light, dark = SPECIES[skin]
        rad = np.linalg.norm(p[:, 1:], axis=1) / self.s.btn_r
        ring = np.exp(-((rad - 0.72) / 0.16) ** 2)
        centre = np.clip(1 - rad / 0.5, 0, 1) ** 2
        return np.clip(col[None, :] * (0.9 * ring + 0.06)[:, None] + light * (0.18 * centre)[:, None], 0, 1)

    def band_glow(self, P, N, skin):
        """Additive line over the band's species stripe (the thrown ball stays readable in a dark map)."""
        p, n = self.local(P, N)
        name, col, light, dark = SPECIES[skin]
        az = np.abs(p[:, 2]) / self.s.g
        k = np.clip(1 - az / 0.34, 0, 1) ** 0.7
        return np.clip(col[None, :] * (0.42 * k)[:, None], 0, 1)

    def emblem_charts(self, mirror=False):
        """Part.charts options putting one box chart square on the emblem (not split across charts)."""
        e = self.Rm @ self.e_dir
        up = self.Rm @ self.e_up
        if mirror:
            e, up = e * np.array([1.0, -1.0, 1.0]), up * np.array([1.0, -1.0, 1.0])
        return {"frame": frame_from(e, up)}


def ball_parts(spec, paint, bone, prefix="", fx_group="fx", main_group="ball", button=True, glow_btn=True,
               mesh_xf=None, mirror=False, density=1.0):
    """Closed ball parts (held models) on one bone; mesh_xf(m) places a ball-frame mesh in model space."""
    xf = mesh_xf or (lambda m: m)
    shell, rings = split_annuli(spec.solid(), spec.r)
    parts = [builder.Part(prefix + "ball", mesh=xf(shell), bone=bone, paint=paint.shell, group=main_group,
                          crease=40, density=density, charts=paint.emblem_charts(mirror)),
             builder.Part(prefix + "steps", mesh=xf(rings), bone=bone, paint=paint.shell, group=main_group,
                          crease=40, density=0.15 * density, hitbox=False)]
    if button:
        parts.append(builder.Part(prefix + "button", mesh=xf(spec.button()), bone=bone, paint=paint.button,
                                  group=main_group, crease=50, density=1.6 * density, hitbox=False))
    if glow_btn:
        parts.append(builder.Part(prefix + "btnglow", mesh=xf(spec.button_glow()), bone=bone, paint=paint.button_glow,
                                  group=fx_group, crease=80, hitbox=False))
    return parts


def band_rings(spec, z0, z1, n=32):
    """Open band (additive overlay) just outside the recessed band, between heights z0 < z1."""
    rho = spec.rb + 0.012 * spec.r
    return lathe([(rho, z1), (rho, z0)], n)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# w_pokeball: world model (thrown, dropped, lying on the ground), button facing +x, hinge at the back (-x).
# Origin on the floor under the ball for the grounded sequences idle / wobble / open (dropped weaponboxes,
# a ball at rest), at the ball's centre for "fly" (tumbles about its centre in the air).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

W_R = 4.0
W_SEQS = ("idle", "wobble", "open", "fly")


def build_w():
    spec = BallSpec(W_R, n=24, arc_steps=7)
    rig = R.Rig()
    rig.add("ball", None, (0, 0, 0), tail=(0, 0, -W_R))
    hinge = (-W_R - 0.02, 0, 0.0)
    rig.add("top", "ball", hinge, tail=(0, 0, W_R))
    paint = BallPaint(spec, seam=True, gloss=0.25, sheen=0.06)
    top, top_in, bottom, bottom_in = spec.cups(inner_steps=3)
    b = builder.ModelBuilder("pokemon/w_pokeball.mdl", rig, skins=3, verbose=False)
    b.group("ball", size=(256, 256), pack="skyline")
    b.group("fx", size=(128, 128), flags=mdl.STUDIO_NF_ADDITIVE | mdl.STUDIO_NF_FULLBRIGHT, pack="skyline")
    top, top_rings = split_annuli(top, W_R)
    bottom, bottom_rings = split_annuli(bottom, W_R)
    b.add(builder.Part("top", mesh=top, bone="top", paint=paint.shell_open, group="ball", crease=40, density=1.6,
                       charts=paint.emblem_charts()))
    b.add(builder.Part("bottom", mesh=bottom, bone="ball", paint=paint.shell_open, group="ball", crease=40,
                       density=1.0))
    b.add(builder.Part("top_rings", mesh=top_rings, bone="top", paint=paint.shell_open, group="ball", crease=40,
                       density=0.15, hitbox=False))
    b.add(builder.Part("bottom_rings", mesh=bottom_rings, bone="ball", paint=paint.shell_open, group="ball",
                       crease=40, density=0.15, hitbox=False))
    b.add(builder.Part("top_in", mesh=top_in, bone="top", paint=paint.shell_open, group="ball", crease=40,
                       density=0.12, hitbox=False))
    b.add(builder.Part("bottom_in", mesh=bottom_in, bone="ball", paint=paint.shell_open, group="ball", crease=40,
                       density=0.12, hitbox=False))
    b.add(builder.Part("button", mesh=spec.button(n=18), bone="ball", paint=paint.button, group="ball", crease=50,
                       density=1.5, hitbox=False))
    b.add(builder.Part("btnglow", mesh=spec.button_glow(n=14), bone="ball", paint=paint.button_glow, group="fx",
                       crease=80, hitbox=False, density=3.0))
    lip = 0.004 * W_R
    b.add(builder.Part("bandglow_top", mesh=band_rings(spec, lip, 0.34 * spec.g, n=24), bone="top",
                       paint=paint.band_glow, group="fx", crease=80, hitbox=False, density=3.0))
    b.add(builder.Part("bandglow_bottom", mesh=band_rings(spec, -0.34 * spec.g, -lip, n=24), bone="ball",
                       paint=paint.band_glow, group="fx", crease=80, hitbox=False, density=3.0))
    b.add(builder.Part("glow_bottom", mesh=spec.glow_disc(-0.05, spec.ri * 0.97, 0.5, n=20, up=True), bone="ball",
                       paint=paint.glow, group="fx", crease=80, hitbox=False))
    b.add(builder.Part("glow_top", mesh=spec.glow_disc(0.05, spec.ri * 0.97, 0.5, n=20, up=False), bone="top",
                       paint=paint.glow, group="fx", crease=80, hitbox=False))

    def idle(t):
        p = R.Pose()
        p.move("ball", z=W_R)
        return p

    def wobble(t):
        # tilt one way, rock back past the middle, settle, rest: rolls (no sliding) on the ground
        a = R.keys(t, [(0.0, 0.0), (0.10, 0.0), (0.22, 24.0), (0.40, -17.0), (0.54, 7.0), (0.64, -2.5),
                       (0.72, 0.0), (1.0, 0.0)], interp="cubic")
        p = R.Pose()
        p.rot("ball", x=a)
        p.move("ball", y=-math.radians(a) * W_R, z=W_R)
        # the lid chatters a little at the extremes
        lid = 3.0 * R.pulse(t, 0.18, 0.22, 0.24, 0.30) + 2.0 * R.pulse(t, 0.36, 0.40, 0.42, 0.48)
        p.rot("top", y=-lid)
        return p

    def open_(t):
        # 0.6 s: a shiver, the lid springs open at the back hinge (overshoot), the ball hops and settles
        p = R.Pose()
        shiver = 5.0 * math.sin(t * 2 * math.pi * 6) * (1 - R.window(t, 0.0, 0.16)) * R.window(t, 0.0, 0.03)
        p.rot("ball", x=shiver)
        lid = R.keys(t, [(0.0, 0.0), (0.12, 4.0), (0.20, -55.0), (0.32, -104.0), (0.46, -91.0), (0.60, -97.0),
                         (1.0, -95.0)], interp="cubic")
        p.rot("top", y=lid)
        hop = R.keys(t, [(0.0, 0.0), (0.12, -0.25), (0.24, 1.3), (0.40, 0.0), (0.50, 0.25), (0.60, 0.0), (1.0, 0.0)],
                     interp="cubic")
        p.move("ball", z=W_R + max(hop, 0.0))
        p.rot("ball", y=R.keys(t, [(0.0, 0.0), (0.18, 0.0), (0.30, -9.0), (0.48, 3.0), (0.62, -1.5), (1.0, 0.0)],
                               interp="cubic"))
        return p

    b.add_sequence(R.make_sequence(rig, "idle", idle, frames=1, fps=10, loop=True, activity=mdl.ACT["IDLE"]))
    b.add_sequence(R.make_sequence(rig, "wobble", wobble, frames=30, fps=30, loop=True))
    b.add_sequence(R.make_sequence(rig, "open", open_, frames=19, fps=30, loop=False))
    b.add_sequence(R.make_sequence(rig, "fly", lambda t: R.Pose(), frames=1, fps=10, loop=True))
    b.hull = ((-W_R, -W_R, 0.0), (W_R, W_R, 2 * W_R))
    b.eyeposition = (0, 0, W_R)
    return b.write()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# p_pokeball: one bone named like the player models' right hand, merged by name by the engine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

P_R = 3.3   # held ball radius (the thrown w_ ball is 4: a smaller jump when it leaves the hand)
# Ball centre in the hand bone's frame (Biped convention: +x along the hand towards the fingers, the palm
# and the thumb on the negative y / z sides); the ball sits in the palm, held by the fingers.  Unchecked in
# game: tune it (and the button axis bx below) in chase cam on a T and a CT model.
P_OFFSET = (3.4, -2.16, -1.40)
P_BONE = "Bip01 R Hand"


def build_p():
    spec = BallSpec(P_R, n=18, arc_steps=5)
    rig = R.Rig()
    rig.add(P_BONE, None, (0, 0, 0), tail=P_OFFSET)
    # button facing away from the palm, the top cap along the fingers
    c = np.asarray(P_OFFSET, dtype=np.float64)
    bx = np.array([0.0, c[1], c[2]]) / np.linalg.norm(c[1:])
    bz = np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
    Rm = np.stack([bx, np.cross(bz, bx), bz], axis=1)
    paint = BallPaint(spec, Rm=Rm, c=c, gloss=0.25, sheen=0.06)
    xf = lambda m: m.transformed(Rm, c)  # noqa: E731
    b = builder.ModelBuilder("pokemon/p_pokeball.mdl", rig, skins=3, verbose=False)
    b.group("ball", size=(128, 128), pack="skyline")
    b.group("fx", size=(32, 32), flags=mdl.STUDIO_NF_ADDITIVE | mdl.STUDIO_NF_FULLBRIGHT, pack="skyline")
    for part in ball_parts(spec, paint, P_BONE, mesh_xf=xf, glow_btn=True):
        if part.name == "button":
            part.mesh = xf(spec.button(n=12))
        if part.name == "btnglow":
            part.mesh = xf(spec.button_glow(n=10))
        b.add(part)
    b.add_sequence(R.make_sequence(rig, "idle", lambda t: R.Pose(), frames=1, fps=10, loop=True,
                                   activity=mdl.ACT["IDLE"]))
    return b.write()




# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# the hand holding the ball (view model), first in its own frame H: origin at the wrist, +x along the
# hand towards the middle finger, +y towards the thumb, +z out of the back of the hand (palm towards -z)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

V_R = 1.8   # ball radius in the hand (diameter about 1.15 x the knuckle span)

# fingers: name, knuckle (MCP) position, splay (deg towards +y), segment lengths, radii (knuckle, PIP, DIP, tip)
FINGERS = [
    ("index", (3.55, 1.12, -0.02), 7.0, (1.50, 0.90, 0.76), (0.43, 0.40, 0.36, 0.32)),
    ("middle", (3.72, 0.37, 0.00), 1.0, (1.64, 1.00, 0.80), (0.45, 0.42, 0.37, 0.33)),
    ("ring", (3.58, -0.40, -0.03), -5.0, (1.53, 0.94, 0.77), (0.43, 0.40, 0.355, 0.31)),
    ("pinky", (3.25, -1.12, -0.10), -12.0, (1.22, 0.72, 0.66), (0.38, 0.35, 0.31, 0.28)),
]
THUMB_CMC = np.array([0.55, 0.80, -0.42])
THUMB_MCP = np.array([1.85, 1.78, -0.98])
THUMB_LEN = (1.30, 1.08)
THUMB_RAD = (0.52, 0.47, 0.40)
BALL_H = np.array([2.95, 0.40, -2.42])   # ball centre in H (resting in the fingers, off the palm)


def _rot_about(v, axis, deg):
    return xform.axis_angle_matrix(axis, deg) @ v


def curl_chain(p0, d0, lengths, radii, C, rb, max_flex=(85, 105, 80), gap=-0.06, min_flex=-15, rest_flex=20):
    """Joint positions of a finger wrapping a ball (centre C, radius rb): each segment flexes towards the
```
