```py
    ball the least that brings its end into contact (radius of the finger there + gap)."""
    p = np.asarray(p0, dtype=np.float64)
    d = np.asarray(d0, dtype=np.float64)
    d = d / np.linalg.norm(d)
    joints = [p.copy()]
    for L, r_end, mf in zip(lengths, radii[1:], max_flex):
        a = np.cross(d, C - p)
        a = a / max(np.linalg.norm(a), 1e-9)
        target = rb + r_end + gap
        thetas = np.arange(min_flex, mf + 0.5, 0.5)
        dists = np.array([np.linalg.norm(p + L * _rot_about(d, a, th) - C) for th in thetas])
        ok = np.nonzero(dists <= target)[0]
        th = thetas[ok[0]] if len(ok) else (thetas[np.argmin(dists)] if dists.min() < target + 0.6 else rest_flex)
        d = _rot_about(d, a, th)
        p = p + L * d
        joints.append(p.copy())
    return joints


def hand_layout(ball_c=None, rb=None):
    """Joints of the gripping hand in H: {"index": [MCP, PIP, DIP, tip], ..., "thumb": [CMC, MCP, IP, tip]}."""
    C = np.asarray(BALL_H if ball_c is None else ball_c, dtype=np.float64)
    rb = V_R if rb is None else rb
    out = {}
    for name, mcp, splay, lens, rads in FINGERS:
        d0 = _rot_about(np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]), (0, 0, 1), splay)
        d0 = _rot_about(d0, (0, 1, 0), 8.0)  # the knuckles flex a little at rest
        out[name] = curl_chain(mcp, d0, lens, rads, C, rb)
    d0 = THUMB_MCP - THUMB_CMC
    th = curl_chain(THUMB_MCP, d0 / np.linalg.norm(d0) + np.array([0.15, 0.1, 0.0]), THUMB_LEN, THUMB_RAD, C, rb,
                    max_flex=(60, 70))
    out["thumb"] = [THUMB_CMC] + th
    return out


def finger_sdf(joints, radii, k=0.10):
    segs = [sdf.rounded_cone(joints[i], joints[i + 1], radii[i], radii[i + 1]) for i in range(len(joints) - 1)]
    return sdf.union(*segs, k=k)


def palm_sdf(lay):
    """Back of the hand and palm (with the thumb's metacarpal and the wrist), smooth; the back is arched
    across the knuckles like a real hand's."""
    knuckles = [lay[n][0] for n in ("index", "middle", "ring", "pinky")]
    body = sdf.rounded_box((1.70, 0.02, -0.10), (1.62, 1.42, 0.42), 0.40)
    body = body.bend(-9.0, along=1, toward=2, center=(1.7, 0.0, -1.2))
    body = body.smooth_union(sdf.tube(knuckles, [0.50, 0.53, 0.50, 0.44]), 0.55)
    body = body.smooth_union(sdf.ellipsoid((1.25, -1.05, -0.32), (1.45, 0.55, 0.50)), 0.4)   # hypothenar
    body = body.smooth_union(sdf.ellipsoid((1.30, 0.95, -0.55), (1.15, 0.72, 0.60)), 0.5)    # thenar
    body = body.smooth_union(sdf.rounded_cone(THUMB_CMC, lay["thumb"][1], 0.62, THUMB_RAD[0]), 0.45)
    wrist = sdf.ellipsoid((-0.25, 0.0, -0.10), (1.05, 1.22, 0.76))
    body = body.smooth_union(wrist, 0.8)
    return body


def knuckle_guard_sdf(lay):
    """Moulded protector over the knuckles of a tactical glove."""
    knuckles = [np.asarray(lay[n][0]) for n in ("index", "middle", "ring", "pinky")]
    pts = [k + np.array([-0.30, 0.0, 0.42]) for k in knuckles]
    g = sdf.tube(pts, [0.30, 0.32, 0.30, 0.26]).stretch((1.25, 1.0, 0.62), center=pts[1])
    return g


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# v_pokeball: placement in the view (design space: right hand on the right; mirrored for the file)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

class VLayout:
    """Rest (idle) placement of the hand, forearm and ball in view space (+x forward, +y left, +z up)."""

    # the ball sits about 24 deg off the view axis (perspective stretch of its outline about 1.08), held from
    # its right: palm towards the ball, thumb across its front-top, the back of the hand towards the eye
    def __init__(self, ball=(13.1, -4.0, -3.6), hand_x=(0.6, 0.15, 0.75), palm_n=(0.0, 0.9, 0.35),
                 wrist_ext=24.0, wrist_dev=-6.0, forearm_len=11.5, ball_top=(-0.15, 0.35, 0.9),
                 ball_front=(-0.85, 0.45, -0.05)):
        self.Q = frame_from(hand_x, [-c for c in palm_n], z_is_second=True)   # H -> view
        self.W = np.asarray(ball, dtype=np.float64) - self.Q @ BALL_H
        self.lay = hand_layout()
        # forearm axis (elbow -> wrist) in H: the hand is bent back (extension) and a little sideways
        uH = _rot_about(np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]), (0, 1, 0), wrist_ext)
        uH = _rot_about(uH, (0, 0, 1), wrist_dev)
        self.u = self.Q @ uH
        self.E = self.W - forearm_len * self.u
        # arm frame A: x along the forearm, y the hand's width direction
        yA = self.Q @ np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0])
        yA = yA - self.u * (yA @ self.u)
        yA /= np.linalg.norm(yA)
        self.A = np.stack([self.u, yA, np.cross(self.u, yA)], axis=1)   # A -> view
        self.ball_c = self.to_view(BALL_H)
        # ball frame -> view: the top cap towards the camera and up, the button forward and out
        self.ball_R = frame_from(ball_front, ball_top, z_is_second=True)

    def to_view(self, pH):
        return self.Q @ np.asarray(pH, dtype=np.float64) + self.W

    def sdf_h(self, shape):
        """An SDF built in H, placed in view space."""
        return shape.transform(self.Q).translate(self.W)

    def sdf_a(self, shape):
        return shape.transform(self.A).translate(self.E)


def sleeve_sdf(L):
    """Sleeve in the arm frame A (x from the elbow to the wrist), loose fabric with folds and a cuff."""
    Lw = float(np.linalg.norm(L.W - L.E))
    x1 = Lw - 0.85
    body = sdf.rounded_cone((-3.0, 0, 0), (x1, 0, 0), 2.30, 1.70).stretch((1.0, 1.10, 0.96))
    body = body.smooth_union(sdf.ellipsoid((0.2, 0.0, -0.15), (3.2, 2.45, 2.25)), 0.8)   # fuller near the elbow

    def folds(p):
        x = p[:, 0]
        ang = np.arctan2(p[:, 2], p[:, 1])
        w = np.clip((x - 1.0) / (x1 - 1.0), 0, 1)
        f = np.sin(x * 2.3 + 1.3 * np.sin(2 * ang + 0.7) + 0.6 * np.sin(3 * ang)) * (0.05 + 0.11 * w)
        f += 0.05 * np.sin(5 * ang + x * 0.8) * w
        return f

    body = body.displace(folds, 0.17)
    cuff = sdf.rounded_cone((x1 - 1.35, 0, 0), (x1, 0, 0), 1.86, 1.80).stretch((1.0, 1.10, 0.95))
    cuff = sdf.subtract(cuff, sdf.halfspace((x1 - 0.02, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0)), k=0.15)
    cuff = cuff.round(0.06)
    tab = sdf.rounded_box((x1 - 0.65, 0.0, 1.78), (0.62, 0.55, 0.12), 0.1).bend(0.0)
    s = body.smooth_union(cuff, 0.25) | tab
    return s


def glove_cuff_sdf(L):
    """The glove's cuff around the wrist (under the sleeve's end), in A."""
    Lw = float(np.linalg.norm(L.W - L.E))
    c = sdf.rounded_cone((Lw - 2.4, 0, 0), (Lw + 0.35, 0, 0), 1.48, 1.30).stretch((1.0, 1.08, 0.80))
    strap = sdf.rounded_box((Lw - 0.25, 0, 0), (0.42, 1.50, 1.16), 0.35).stretch((1.0, 1.04, 0.95), center=(Lw, 0, 0))
    return c.smooth_union(strap, 0.15)


GLOVE = T.rgb("#61656d")        # synthetic leather, back of the hand and fingers
GLOVE_PANEL = T.rgb("#555961")  # padded panel on the back of the hand
GLOVE_PALM = T.rgb("#4b4741")   # suede palm and finger insides
GLOVE_PAD = T.rgb("#6c7078")    # moulded knuckle guard / finger pads
NEOPRENE = T.rgb("#393a3f")     # cuff
STITCH = T.rgb("#7a7d84")
SLEEVE = T.rgb("#4c5243")       # tactical ripstop, dark olive grey
SLEEVE_CUFF = T.rgb("#3a3f33")
VELCRO = T.rgb("#565c4c")


def _grain(P, scale=7.0, seed=0.0):
    """Cheap deterministic fabric/leather grain in [-1, 1] (sums of sines)."""
    x, y, z = P[:, 0] * scale, P[:, 1] * scale, P[:, 2] * scale
    g = (np.sin(x * 1.7 + y * 0.9 + seed) * np.sin(y * 1.3 - z * 1.9 + 0.5 * seed)
         + 0.6 * np.sin(z * 2.3 + x * 1.1 + 1.7) * np.sin(x * 2.9 - y * 2.1)
         + 0.4 * np.sin((x + y + z) * 3.7 + seed))
    return g / 2.0


class ArmPaint:
    """Paint of the gloved hand and the sleeve (design space)."""

    def __init__(self, L, occ, fingers_joints, thumb_joints):
        self.L = L
        self.occ = occ
        self.fj = fingers_joints
        self.tj = thumb_joints

    def h(self, P, N):
        return (P - self.L.W) @ self.L.Q, N @ self.L.Q

    def a(self, P, N):
        return (P - self.L.E) @ self.L.A, N @ self.L.A

    def _finish(self, c, P, N, ao_dist=0.6, gloss=0.0, top=0.16, rim=0.10):
        ao = T.ambient_occlusion(self.occ, P, N, dist=ao_dist, steps=4)
        out = T.shade(c, N, ao=ao, ao_strength=0.75, top=top, shadow_tint="#70788a")
        if rim:  # a painted rim light (eye at the origin) keeps the silhouette readable against dark walls
            vd = P / np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(P, axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-9)
            f = (1 - np.abs(np.einsum("ij,ij->i", N, vd))) ** 3
            out = np.clip(out + rim * f[:, None] * np.array([0.95, 1.0, 1.08]), 0, 1)
        if gloss:
            L = np.array([0.35, 0.45, 0.82])
            hl = np.clip(N @ (L / np.linalg.norm(L)), 0, 1) ** 12 * gloss
            out = np.clip(out + hl[:, None] * 0.6, 0, 1)
        return out

    def _palmar(self, P, N):
        """1 on the side facing the ball (palm, insides of the curled fingers)."""
        d = self.L.ball_c - P
        d = d / np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(d, axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-9)
        return T._sstep(0.05, 0.35, np.einsum("ij,ij->i", N, d))

    def _leather(self, P, N, base):
        c = np.tile(base, (len(P), 1)) * (1 + 0.05 * _grain(P, 9.0))[:, None]
        pal = self._palmar(P, N)
        suede = np.tile(GLOVE_PALM, (len(P), 1)) * (1 + 0.08 * _grain(P, 14.0, 2.0))[:, None]
        c = T.mix(c, suede, pal)
        seam = np.exp(-((pal - 0.5) / 0.16) ** 2)
        c = T.mix(c, GLOVE_PALM * 0.6, seam * 0.7)
        return c, pal

    def palm(self, P, N, skin):
        pH, nH = self.h(P, N)
        c, pal = self._leather(P, N, GLOVE)
        # padded panel on the back of the hand, with its stitching
        q = (pH[:, :2] - np.array([1.75, 0.0])) / np.array([1.55, 1.30])
        rr = np.linalg.norm(q ** 4, axis=1) ** 0.25
        dorsal = T._sstep(0.25, 0.6, nH[:, 2])
        panel = T.edge((rr - 1.0) * 1.3, 0.08) * dorsal
        c = T.mix(c, GLOVE_PANEL * (1 + 0.04 * _grain(P, 20.0, 1.0))[:, None], panel)
        stitch_band = np.exp(-(((rr - 1.0) * 1.3 + 0.12) / 0.035) ** 2) * dorsal
        dashes = (np.sin((pH[:, 0] + pH[:, 1]) * 22.0) > -0.2).astype(float)
        c = T.mix(c, STITCH, stitch_band * dashes * 0.8)
        # grip patch on the palm
        gp = T.ellipse(pH, (1.6, 0.0, -0.5), (1.3, 1.25, 2.0), soft=0.2) * pal
        c = T.mix(c, GLOVE_PALM * 0.75, gp * (0.5 + 0.5 * (np.sin(pH[:, 0] * 18) * np.sin(pH[:, 1] * 18) > 0)))
        return self._finish(c, P, N)

    def finger(self, name):
        joints = self.fj[name]

        def paint(P, N, skin):
            c, pal = self._leather(P, N, GLOVE)
            # pads on the proximal and middle phalanges (dorsal), a reinforced tip
            for (a, b_), w in ((joints[0], joints[1]), 1.0), ((joints[1], joints[2]), 0.8):
                a, b_ = np.asarray(a), np.asarray(b_)
                ab = b_ - a
                t = np.clip((P - a) @ ab / (ab @ ab), 0, 1)
                pad = T._sstep(0.18, 0.3, t) * (1 - T._sstep(0.72, 0.84, t)) * (1 - pal)
                c = T.mix(c, GLOVE_PAD * 0.85, pad * 0.55 * w)
            tip = np.asarray(joints[3])
            dtip = np.linalg.norm(P - tip, axis=1)
            c = T.mix(c, NEOPRENE, T.edge(dtip - 0.55, 0.15) * 0.8)
            # creases at the joints
            for j in joints[1:3]:
                dj = np.linalg.norm(P - np.asarray(j), axis=1)
                c = c * (1 - 0.25 * np.exp(-((dj - 0.42) / 0.07) ** 2) * pal)[:, None]
            return self._finish(c, P, N, ao_dist=0.45)
        return paint

    def thumb(self, P, N, skin):
        c, pal = self._leather(P, N, GLOVE)
        tip = np.asarray(self.tj[-1])
        c = T.mix(c, NEOPRENE, T.edge(np.linalg.norm(P - tip, axis=1) - 0.6, 0.15) * 0.8)
        return self._finish(c, P, N, ao_dist=0.45)

    def guard(self, P, N, skin):
        c = np.tile(GLOVE_PAD, (len(P), 1)) * (1 + 0.03 * _grain(P, 25.0, 3.0))[:, None]
        return self._finish(c, P, N, ao_dist=0.4, gloss=0.35, top=0.25)

    def cuff(self, P, N, skin):
        pA, nA = self.a(P, N)
        Lw = float(np.linalg.norm(self.L.W - self.L.E))
        c = np.tile(NEOPRENE, (len(P), 1)) * (1 + 0.06 * _grain(P, 16.0, 4.0))[:, None]
        strap = T.edge(np.abs(pA[:, 0] - (Lw - 0.25)) - 0.40, 0.06)
        c = T.mix(c, GLOVE * 0.9, strap)
        for e in (-0.33, 0.33):
            c = T.mix(c, STITCH * 0.8, np.exp(-((pA[:, 0] - (Lw - 0.25) - e) / 0.03) ** 2) * 0.6 *
                      (np.sin(np.arctan2(pA[:, 2], pA[:, 1]) * 40) > 0))
        return self._finish(c, P, N, ao_dist=0.5)

    def sleeve(self, P, N, skin):
        pA, nA = self.a(P, N)
        Lw = float(np.linalg.norm(self.L.W - self.L.E))
        x1 = Lw - 0.85
        ang = np.arctan2(pA[:, 2], pA[:, 1])
        c = np.tile(SLEEVE, (len(P), 1))
        # ripstop grid
        gx = np.abs(((pA[:, 0] / 0.55) % 1.0) - 0.5)   # coarse enough for the sleeve's texel density
        ga = np.abs(((ang * 1.9 / 0.55) % 1.0) - 0.5)
        grid = np.maximum(T._sstep(0.40, 0.48, gx), T._sstep(0.40, 0.48, ga))
        c = c * (1 + 0.04 * grid + 0.03 * _grain(P, 6.0, 5.0))[:, None]
        # cuff band and its velcro tab
        cuff = T._sstep(x1 - 1.42, x1 - 1.30, pA[:, 0])
        c = T.mix(c, SLEEVE_CUFF * (1 + 0.05 * _grain(P, 30.0, 6.0))[:, None], cuff)
        tab = (T.edge(np.abs(pA[:, 0] - (x1 - 0.65)) - 0.62, 0.05) * T.edge(np.abs(pA[:, 1]) - 0.55, 0.05)
               * (pA[:, 2] > 1.5))
        c = T.mix(c, VELCRO * (1 + 0.15 * _grain(P, 40.0, 7.0))[:, None], tab)
        seam = np.exp(-((pA[:, 0] - (x1 - 1.36)) / 0.03) ** 2)
        c = T.mix(c, SLEEVE_CUFF * 0.6, seam * 0.8)
        return self._finish(c, P, N, ao_dist=1.0, top=0.12, rim=0.07)


# set False if the client stops mirroring view models (cl_righthand 1 mirrors them, see the module docstring)
V_MIRROR = True


def mirror_pose(p):
    out = R.Pose()
    for k, v in p.items():
        w = v.copy()
        w[0], w[2], w[4] = -v[0], -v[2], -v[4]
        out[k] = w
    return out


class VModel:
    """Everything of the view model in design space (right hand), and its rig."""

    def __init__(self, layout=None):
        self.L = layout or VLayout()
        L = self.L
        lay = L.lay
        self.joints = {k: [L.to_view(p) for p in v] for k, v in lay.items()}
        rig = R.Rig()
        rig.add("root", None, (0, 0, 0))
        rig.add("arm", "root", L.E, tail=L.W)
        rig.add("hand", "arm", L.W, tail=self.joints["middle"][0])
        for name, *_ in FINGERS:
            j = self.joints[name]
            rig.add(name + "1", "hand", j[1 - 1], tail=j[1])
            rig.add(name + "2", name + "1", j[1], tail=j[3])
        tj = self.joints["thumb"]
        rig.add("thumb1", "hand", tj[1], tail=tj[2])
        rig.add("thumb2", "thumb1", tj[2], tail=tj[3])
        rig.add("ball", "hand", L.ball_c, tail=L.ball_c + np.array([0, 0, V_R]))
        self.rig = rig
        # flexion axes (rest view space) of the finger joints: curling towards the ball
        self.flex = {}
        for name in [f[0] for f in FINGERS] + ["thumb"]:
            j = self.joints[name] if name != "thumb" else self.joints["thumb"][1:]
            axes = []
            for i in range(2):
                d = j[i + 1] - j[i]
                a = np.cross(d, L.ball_c - j[i])
                axes.append(a / np.linalg.norm(a))
            self.flex[name] = axes
        self.hand_axes = L.Q.T  # rows: x_H, y_H, z_H in view space
        self.turn_axis = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0])
        h = np.cross(L.u, (0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
        self.lift_axis = h / np.linalg.norm(h)

    def rest_key(self):
        L = self.L
        return {"W": L.W.copy(), "u": L.u.copy(), "hx": L.Q[:, 0].copy(), "pn": -L.Q[:, 2].copy()}

    def pose(self, k):
        """Pose (design space) from key parameters (dict, missing = rest): W wrist position, u forearm direction
        (elbow -> wrist), hx / pn the hand's finger direction and palm normal (view space), grip finger curl
        offset (deg, - = open), thumb (its curl offset), g_<finger> extra per finger, ball None (in the hand)
        or its view-space position, ball_spin (deg).  The forearm's twist is chosen to leave the wrist
        flexing and bending, not rolling (pronation happens in the forearm)."""
        L = self.L
        rest = self.rest_key()
        W = np.asarray(k.get("W", rest["W"]), dtype=np.float64)
        u = np.asarray(k.get("u", rest["u"]), dtype=np.float64)
        u = u / np.linalg.norm(u)
        Qt = frame_from(k.get("hx", rest["hx"]), -np.asarray(k.get("pn", rest["pn"]), dtype=np.float64))
        Rhand_w = Qt @ L.Q.T
        Ralign = R._align(L.u, u)
        best = None
        for th in np.arange(-180.0, 180.0, 1.0):
            Rarm = xform.axis_angle_matrix(u, th) @ Ralign
            loc = Rarm.T @ Rhand_w
            # cost: rotation of the wrist about the forearm axis (roll) + overall angle
            ang = math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, (np.trace(loc) - 1) / 2))))
            if best is None or ang < best[0]:
                best = (ang, Rarm, loc)
        _, Rarm, Rw = best
        move = W - L.E - Rarm @ (L.W - L.E)
        p = R.Pose()
        p.set_rot("arm", *np.degrees(xform.matrix_euler(Rarm)))
        p.move("arm", *move)
        p.set_rot("hand", *np.degrees(xform.matrix_euler(Rw)))
        g = k.get("grip", 0.0)
        for name, mul in (("index", 1.0), ("middle", 0.95), ("ring", 0.9), ("pinky", 0.85), ("thumb", None)):
            gg = k.get("thumb", g * 0.7) if mul is None else g * mul + k.get("g_" + name, 0.0)
            a1, a2 = self.flex[name]
            p.set_rot(name + "1", *np.degrees(xform.matrix_euler(xform.axis_angle_matrix(a1, gg))))
            p.set_rot(name + "2", *np.degrees(xform.matrix_euler(xform.axis_angle_matrix(a2, gg * 0.8))))
        if k.get("ball_turn"):
            p.set_rot("ball", *np.degrees(xform.matrix_euler(xform.axis_angle_matrix(self.turn_axis, k["ball_turn"]))))
        if k.get("ball") is not None or k.get("ball_spin"):
            Wm = self.rig.world(p)
            hand = Wm[self.rig.index("hand")]
            cur = hand[:, :3] @ (L.ball_c - L.W) + hand[:, 3]
            target = cur if k.get("ball") is None else np.asarray(k["ball"], dtype=np.float64)
            p.move("ball", *(hand[:, :3].T @ (target - cur)))
            if k.get("ball_spin"):
                Rs = hand[:, :3].T @ xform.axis_angle_matrix((0, 1, 0), k["ball_spin"]) @ hand[:, :3]
                if k.get("ball_turn"):
                    Rs = Rs @ xform.axis_angle_matrix(self.turn_axis, k["ball_turn"])
                p.set_rot("ball", *np.degrees(xform.matrix_euler(Rs)))
        return p

    def wrist_angle(self, k):
        """Total wrist rotation (deg) a key needs (plausibility check)."""
        p = self.pose(k)
        return float(np.linalg.norm(p["hand"][:3]))

    def mirrored_rig(self):
        rig = R.Rig()
        for b in self.rig.bones:
            h = b.head * np.array([1, -1, 1])
            t = None if b.tail is None else b.tail * np.array([1, -1, 1])
            rig.add(b.name, None if b.parent < 0 else self.rig.bones[b.parent].name, h, tail=t)
        return rig


def build_v(mirror=V_MIRROR, layout=None, name="pokemon/v_pokeball.mdl", sequences=None):
    vm = VModel(layout)
    L = vm.L
    lay = L.lay
    rig_d = vm.rig
    rig = vm.mirrored_rig() if mirror else rig_d
    flipv = np.array([1.0, -1.0, 1.0])

    def shape(s):
        return s.flip(1) if mirror else s

    def unmirror(fn):
        if not mirror:
            return fn

        def g(P, N, skin):
            return fn(P * flipv, N * flipv, skin)
        return g

    def mesh(m):
        return flip_mesh(m) if mirror else m

    # --- shapes (design space)
    palm = L.sdf_h(palm_sdf(lay))
    guard = L.sdf_h(knuckle_guard_sdf(lay))
    fingers = {n: L.sdf_h(finger_sdf(lay[n], rads)) for n, _, _, _, rads in FINGERS}
    thumb = L.sdf_h(finger_sdf(lay["thumb"][1:], THUMB_RAD + (0.40,)))
    sleeve = L.sdf_a(sleeve_sdf(L))
    gcuff = L.sdf_a(glove_cuff_sdf(L))
    hand_all = sdf.union(palm, *fingers.values(), thumb, gcuff, k=0.05)
    ball_ao = sdf.sphere(L.ball_c, V_R)
    occ = sdf.union(hand_all, ball_ao, sleeve)

    ap = ArmPaint(L, occ, vm.joints, vm.joints["thumb"][1:])

    # ball, placed: ball frame -> view
    spec = BallSpec(V_R, n=30, arc_steps=8)
    Rb = L.ball_R
    bpaint = BallPaint(spec, Rm=Rb, c=L.ball_c)

    def xf(m):
        return mesh(m.transformed(Rb, L.ball_c))

    b = builder.ModelBuilder(name, rig, skins=3, verbose=False)
    b.group("arm", size=(512, 256), pack="skyline")
    b.group("ball", size=(256, 256), pack="skyline")
    b.group("fx", size=(32, 32), flags=mdl.STUDIO_NF_ADDITIVE | mdl.STUDIO_NF_FULLBRIGHT, pack="skyline")
    b.add(builder.Part("sleeve", shape(sleeve), bone="arm", paint=unmirror(ap.sleeve), group="arm", budget=680,
                       density=0.65))
    b.add(builder.Part("gcuff", shape(gcuff), bone="arm", paint=unmirror(ap.cuff), group="arm", budget=200,
                       density=0.7))
    b.add(builder.Part("palm", shape(palm), bone="hand", paint=unmirror(ap.palm), group="arm", budget=620,
                       density=1.8))
    b.add(builder.Part("guard", shape(guard), bone="hand", paint=unmirror(ap.guard), group="arm", budget=140,
                       density=1.5))
    for n in fingers:
        b.add(builder.Part(n, shape(fingers[n]), bones=[n + "1", n + "2"], paint=unmirror(ap.finger(n)), group="arm",
                           budget=180, density=1.8))
    b.add(builder.Part("thumb", shape(thumb), bones=["thumb1", "thumb2"], paint=unmirror(ap.thumb), group="arm",
                       budget=180, density=1.8))
    shell, steps = split_annuli(spec.solid(), spec.r)
    b.add(builder.Part("ball", mesh=xf(shell), bone="ball", paint=unmirror(bpaint.shell), group="ball",
                       crease=40, charts=bpaint.emblem_charts(mirror)))
    b.add(builder.Part("steps", mesh=xf(steps), bone="ball", paint=unmirror(bpaint.shell), group="ball",
                       crease=40, density=0.15, hitbox=False))
    b.add(builder.Part("button", mesh=xf(spec.button(n=18)), bone="ball", paint=unmirror(bpaint.button),
                       group="ball", crease=50, density=1.5, hitbox=False))
    b.add(builder.Part("btnglow", mesh=xf(spec.button_glow(n=14)), bone="ball", paint=unmirror(bpaint.button_glow),
                       group="fx", crease=80, hitbox=False))

    seqs = sequences(vm) if sequences else v_sequences(vm)
    for s_name, fn, frames, fps, loop, events in seqs:
        pf = (lambda f: (lambda t: mirror_pose(f(t))))(fn) if mirror else fn
        b.add_sequence(R.make_sequence(rig, s_name, pf, frames=frames, fps=fps, loop=loop, events=events))
    b.eyeposition = (0, 0, 0)
    return b.write()


def _lerp_keys(t, track, interp="cubic"):
    """Interpolate a track [(time, key dict), ...] of VModel.pose keys (vectors and scalars) at t."""
    names = sorted({n for _, k in track for n in k if n != "ball"})
    out = {}
    for n in names:
        pts = []
        for tk, k in track:
            if n in k:
                pts.append((tk, k[n]))
        out[n] = R.keys(t, pts, interp=interp)
    return out


# throw: the server spawns its world ball as the throw starts, at THROW_HANDOFF * W_R / V_R (view space,
# design: +y left; same direction, same apparent size): eye + forward * 34 + right * 10 + up * 1 (with its wall
# trace from the eye).  The client draws entities ex_interp = 0.1 s in the past (xash3d default), while the
# view model plays its throw as soon as the message arrives: on screen the world ball is at its own path's
# P(s - 0.1) at s seconds into the view's throw, and first shows up ~130 ms in, ~0.03 s along its path.
# So the view throw cocks the arm back a little (2 frames), snaps forward and lets go of the ball at
# THROW_HANDOFF at THROW_REL_S = 0.1 s (frame 3), then the view ball flies the world ball's own path scaled
# by V_R / W_R (the same screen spot and size at every instant, P(s - 0.1)) until THROW_VIS_S, overlapping
# the world ball once it shows; then it recedes along its line of sight to sub-pixel and is parked out of
# the view.  The path is the server's for a level aim (Throw(): 10 deg above the view, (90 + 10) * 6 = 600 u/s;
# ball gravity 0.6 * 800); the thrower's own velocity cancels out (the eye moves with it).
THROW_HANDOFF = (15.5, -4.5, 0.5)
THROW_FAR = 1200.0
THROW_SPEED = 600.0          # world units / s
THROW_ELEV = 10.0            # deg above the line of sight
THROW_GRAVITY = 0.6 * 800.0  # world units / s^2
THROW_SPIN = 540.0           # deg / s, rolling forward like the world ball (avelocity.x -540)
THROW_COCK_S = 0.078         # the arm cocks back, then snaps: the held ball at THROW_REL_S
THROW_REL_S = 3.0 / 30.0     # the ball at THROW_HANDOFF, leaving the hand (= the client's ex_interp)
THROW_VIS_S = 6.0 / 30.0     # the view ball flies until frame 6 (200 ms), recedes by frame 7, parked from 8


def v_sequences(vm):
    """idle (loop, subtle sway), draw, pinpull (wind-up, holds), throw (cock, snap, the ball let go at the world ball's spawn spot), holster."""
    rest = vm.rest_key()
    W0, u0, hx0, pn0 = rest["W"], rest["u"], rest["hx"], rest["pn"]
    v = lambda *a: np.array(a, dtype=np.float64)  # noqa: E731
    Lb = vm.L

    def with_rest(k):
        out = dict(rest)
        out.update(k)
        out.setdefault("grip", 0.0)
        out.setdefault("thumb", 0.7 * out["grip"])
        out.setdefault("ball_turn", 0.0)
        return out

    rest = with_rest({})

    def wrist_for(ball, hx, pn):
        """Wrist position putting the ball's centre at `ball` for a hand orientation (hx, pn)."""
        Qt = frame_from(hx, -np.asarray(pn, dtype=np.float64))
        return np.asarray(ball, dtype=np.float64) - Qt @ BALL_H

    # the wind-up: arm raised beside the head, fingers up, palm (and ball) turned towards the middle of the
    # view; the ball stays whole inside 4:3 and 16:9, its face turned towards the eye
    r_hx, r_pn = v(0.30, 0.20, 1.0), v(-0.25, 0.95, -0.05)
    READY = with_rest({"W": wrist_for((11.0, -5.6, 1.4), r_hx, r_pn), "u": v(0.25, 0.30, 1.0), "hx": r_hx,
                       "pn": r_pn, "grip": 3.0})
    Hr = vm.rig.world(vm.pose(READY))[vm.rig.index("hand")][:, :3]
    e_dir = Lb.ball_R @ np.array([math.cos(math.radians(50)), 0.0, math.sin(math.radians(50))])
    face = Hr @ e_dir
    ball_w = Hr @ (Lb.ball_c - Lb.W) + READY["W"]
    want = -ball_w / np.linalg.norm(ball_w)
    ax = np.cross(face, want)
    # the fingers roll the ball a little (at most 35 deg, the button passing between the fingers' tips)
    TURN = min(35.0, math.degrees(math.atan2(np.linalg.norm(ax), face @ want)))
    vm.turn_axis = Hr.T @ (ax / max(np.linalg.norm(ax), 1e-9))
    READY["ball_turn"] = TURN
    LOW = with_rest({"W": W0 + v(-1.5, -3.0, -8.0), "u": u0 + v(0.0, -0.1, -0.35), "hx": hx0 + v(0.0, -0.3, -0.2),
                     "pn": pn0 + v(0.0, -0.3, 0.0), "grip": -10.0})

    def idle(t):
        k = dict(rest)
        k.pop("thumb")
        br = R.breathe(t, freq=1)
        sway = R.wave(t, freq=1, phase=0.3)
        k["W"] = W0 + v(0.05 * sway, 0.10 * R.wave(t, freq=1, phase=0.05), 0.16 * br)
        k["pn"] = pn0 + v(0.03 * R.wave(t, freq=2, phase=0.1), 0.0, 0.025 * sway)
        k["hx"] = hx0 + v(0.0, 0.02 * R.wave(t, freq=1, phase=0.6), 0.0)
        # the fingers re-settle on the ball once per cycle (index first)
        k["grip"] = -5.0 * R.pulse(t, 0.55, 0.62, 0.66, 0.76)
        k["g_index"] = -5.0 * R.pulse(t, 0.50, 0.56, 0.60, 0.70)
        k["thumb"] = -4.0 * R.pulse(t, 0.52, 0.60, 0.64, 0.74)
        return vm.pose(k)

    def draw(t):
        # up from just below the view with a little overshoot, the ball tossed and caught in the hand
        track = [(0.0, with_rest(LOW)),
                 (0.36, with_rest({"W": W0 + v(0.2, 0.15, 0.55), "pn": pn0 + v(0.05, 0.0, 0.0), "grip": -6.0})),
                 (0.58, with_rest({"W": W0 + v(0.0, 0.0, -0.25), "grip": -10.0, "thumb": -12.0})),
                 (0.78, with_rest({"W": W0 + v(0.0, 0.0, 0.08), "grip": 1.5})),
                 (1.0, with_rest({"grip": 0.0}))]
        k = _lerp_keys(t, track, interp="smooth")
        pose = vm.pose(k)
        # the toss: the ball pops out of the hand (up and towards the middle of the view), spins a full turn
        hop = R.pulse(t, 0.38, 0.54, 0.54, 0.72, ease=lambda x: math.sin(x * math.pi / 2))
        if hop > 0:
            k2 = dict(k)
            Wm = vm.rig.world(pose)
            hand = Wm[vm.rig.index("hand")]
            cur = hand[:, :3] @ (Lb.ball_c - Lb.W) + hand[:, 3]
            out = Lb.Q @ np.array([0.0, 0.0, -1.0])  # out of the palm
            k2["ball"] = cur + (hand[:, :3] @ out) * 1.0 * hop + v(0.0, 0.0, 1.3) * hop
            k2["ball_spin"] = 360.0 * R.window(t, 0.40, 0.70)
            pose = vm.pose(k2)
        return pose

    def pinpull(t):
        # dip, then the arm comes up; the grip opens while the fingers roll the ball, and closes again
        track = [(0.0, dict(rest)),
                 (0.16, with_rest({"W": W0 + v(-0.6, 0.3, -0.9), "pn": pn0 + v(0.0, 0.0, 0.1), "grip": 3.0})),
                 (0.40, with_rest({"W": (W0 + READY["W"]) / 2 + v(-0.8, -0.3, 0.6), "u": (u0 + READY["u"]) / 2,
                                   "hx": (hx0 + READY["hx"]) / 2, "pn": (pn0 + READY["pn"]) / 2, "grip": -6.0,
                                   "thumb": -8.0, "ball_turn": TURN * 0.45})),
                 (0.62, with_rest({"W": READY["W"] + v(-0.6, -0.3, 0.4), "u": READY["u"] + v(-0.05, 0.0, 0.0),
                                   "hx": READY["hx"] + v(-0.1, 0.0, 0.0), "pn": READY["pn"],
                                   "grip": -5.0, "thumb": -6.0, "ball_turn": TURN * 0.92})),
                 (0.85, READY), (1.0, READY)]
        return vm.pose(_lerp_keys(t, track, interp="smooth"))

    THROW_S = 0.6
    COCK_T = THROW_COCK_S / THROW_S
    REL_T = THROW_REL_S / THROW_S        # frame 3: the ball still in the hand, at the world ball's spawn spot
    VIS_T = THROW_VIS_S / THROW_S        # last frame on the world ball's path
    FAR_T = VIS_T + 1.0 / 18.0           # next frame: far away on the same line of sight (sub-pixel)
    hand_off = np.asarray(THROW_HANDOFF, dtype=np.float64)
    park = v(0.0, 0.0, -THROW_FAR)
    kv = V_R / W_R
    el = math.radians(THROW_ELEV)
    vel = THROW_SPEED * v(math.cos(el), 0.0, math.sin(el))
    grav = v(0.0, 0.0, -THROW_GRAVITY)

    def flight(s):
        """View-space ball centre s seconds into the view's throw: the world ball's path as the client draws
        it (ex_interp behind), scaled into view space."""
        tau = s - THROW_REL_S
        return hand_off + kv * (vel * tau + 0.5 * grav * tau * tau)

    p_vis = flight(THROW_VIS_S)
    far = p_vis / np.linalg.norm(p_vis) * THROW_FAR
    # the cock: back, a little out and up, the grip tighter
    COCK = with_rest({"W": READY["W"] + v(-0.8, -0.6, 0.45), "u": READY["u"] + v(-0.10, -0.05, 0.08),
                      "hx": READY["hx"] + v(-0.12, 0.0, 0.08), "pn": READY["pn"], "grip": 5.0})
    # the snap and follow-through (times from the snap's start; the held ball passes THROW_HANDOFF 25 ms in)
    SNAP = [(0.07, with_rest({"W": v(13.2, -6.0, 0.6), "u": v(0.55, 0.3, 0.8), "hx": v(0.7, 0.2, 0.7),
                              "pn": v(0.7, 0.05, -0.7), "grip": -8.0})),
            (0.20, with_rest({"W": v(15.0, -3.6, -3.5), "u": v(0.75, 0.3, 0.3), "hx": v(0.9, 0.2, -0.3),
                              "pn": v(0.1, 0.1, -1.0), "grip": -14.0, "thumb": -10.0})),
            (0.42, with_rest({"W": v(12.5, -1.0, -13.0), "u": v(0.65, 0.45, -0.45), "hx": v(0.4, 0.45, -0.8),
                              "pn": v(-0.4, 0.3, -0.85), "grip": -10.0, "thumb": -8.0})),
            (0.70, with_rest({"W": v(9.0, 0.5, -21.0), "u": v(0.3, 0.5, -0.8), "hx": v(0.1, 0.5, -0.85),
                              "pn": v(-0.6, 0.4, -0.6), "grip": -2.0, "thumb": -4.0})),
            (1.0, with_rest({"W": v(8.0, 0.5, -24.0), "u": v(0.3, 0.5, -0.8), "hx": v(0.1, 0.5, -0.85),
                             "pn": v(-0.6, 0.4, -0.6), "grip": 4.0, "thumb": 0.0}))]
    TRACK = [(0.0, READY), (0.5 * COCK_T, COCK), (COCK_T, READY)] + \
        [(COCK_T + ts * (1.0 - COCK_T), k) for ts, k in SNAP]

    def throw_key(t):
        k = _lerp_keys(t, TRACK, interp="cubic")
        k["ball_turn"] = READY["ball_turn"]
        return k

    def throw(t):
        k = throw_key(t)
        if t > REL_T + 1e-6:
            s = t * THROW_S
            if t <= VIS_T + 1e-6:
                k["ball"] = flight(s)
            elif t <= FAR_T + 1e-6:
                k["ball"] = far
            else:
                k["ball"] = park
            k["ball_spin"] = THROW_SPIN * (min(t, FAR_T) * THROW_S - THROW_REL_S)
        return vm.pose(k)

    def holster(t):
        track = [(0.0, dict(rest)),
                 (0.18, with_rest({"W": W0 + v(0.2, 0.1, 0.45), "grip": 2.0})),
                 (1.0, with_rest({"W": W0 + v(-1.5, -3.0, -12.5), "u": u0 + v(0.0, -0.1, -0.35),
                                  "hx": hx0 + v(0.0, -0.3, -0.2), "pn": pn0 + v(0.0, -0.3, 0.0), "grip": -10.0}))]
        k = _lerp_keys(t, track, interp="smooth")
        return vm.pose(k)

    return [("idle", idle, 120, 30, True, ()),
            ("draw", draw, 25, 30, False, ()),
            ("pinpull", pinpull, 14, 30, False, ()),
            ("throw", throw, 19, 30, False, ()),
            ("holster", holster, 16, 30, False, ())]


def build(out):
    out["models/pokemon/w_pokeball.mdl"] = build_w()
    out["models/pokemon/p_pokeball.mdl"] = build_p()
    out["models/pokemon/v_pokeball.mdl"] = build_v()

```

`tools/goldsrc/assets/pokemon/blastoise.py`:

```py
"""Blastoise (Tortank): models/pokemon/blastoise.mdl.

Official model (when installed): Game Freak's Blastoise, `plain/9.glb` under $POKEMON_OFFICIAL_DIR (default
/srv/orthros/data/installers/pokemon-official; owner's decision, never copied into the repository), imported by
`official.Importer` with its own 42-bone rig, smooth skinning and textures, scaled to 60 units.  The file has no
animation: the eight sequences are authored below on its real bones (OfficialAnimator).  Without the file, the model
generated from scratch further down is built instead (make_generated_model).

Generated model: a heavy bipedal turtle about 60 units tall: blue skin, a brown carapace with a raised cream rim, a
cream segmented plastron, two silver cannons coming out of the shell over the shoulders, small pointed ears, thick
limbs with cream claws and a short tail.

Both: facing +x, origin on the ground between the feet.  Sequences (the Pokemon model contract): idle, walk, run,
attack (braces, fires both cannons with recoil at 40 %), flinch, die (falls backward onto its shell), spawn (comes
out of its shell with a roar), victory (stomps and roars).  Attachment 0 = left cannon muzzle, 1 = right cannon muzzle.
"""
import math
import os

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

from .. import builder, mdl, official, rig as R, sdf, texture as T, xform

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# palette

# light sky blue leaning to cyan: blue loses most under the maps' warm light, so it is kept light (QA r1: read
# as navy next to Charizard at #5b8fd8)
SKIN = T.rgb("#74b0f2")
SKIN_DARK = T.rgb("#4e88cc")
SKIN_LIGHT = T.rgb("#a8d6fc")
SHELL = T.rgb("#a56b3c")
SHELL_DARK = T.rgb("#74482a")
SHELL_LIGHT = T.rgb("#c8925a")
RIM = T.rgb("#f8f0d8")
PLASTRON = T.rgb("#eedc9e")
PLASTRON_LINE = T.rgb("#b3925a")
METAL = T.rgb("#aeb6c0")
METAL_DARK = T.rgb("#5b636e")
METAL_LIGHT = T.rgb("#eef3f8")
BORE = T.rgb("#16191e")
CLAW = T.rgb("#f3efe2")
MOUTH = T.rgb("#6e2230")
THROAT = T.rgb("#240a10")
TONGUE = T.rgb("#d46a7a")
SHADOW = "#5a5f9a"

SIDES = (("l", 1.0), ("r", -1.0))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# skeleton (rest heads in model space)


def side(v, s):
    return (v[0], v[1] * s, v[2])


PELVIS = (0.0, 0.0, 16.0)
SPINE = (0.0, 0.0, 24.0)
NECK = (1.6, 0.0, 40.0)
HEAD = (3.2, 0.0, 46.5)
MOUTH_Z = 48.3
JAW = (3.4, 0.0, MOUTH_Z)
EAR = (1.2, 5.2, 55.8)
EAR_TIP = (-1.5, 8.1, 59.6)
CANNON_BASE = (1.2, 14.3, 44.95)    # pivot just inside the shell, 1.5 behind where the barrel comes out
CANNON_TIP = (14.5, 14.8, 47.5)
SHOULDER = (2.5, 14.8, 37.0)
ELBOW = (4.8, 19.6, 30.0)
WRIST = (7.6, 21.0, 24.2)
HIP = (0.6, 9.0, 15.0)
KNEE = (5.2, 10.4, 8.8)
ANKLE = (0.8, 10.8, 4.3)
TAIL1 = (-10.5, 0.0, 14.6)
TAIL2 = (-15.2, 0.0, 11.6)
TAIL_END = (-19.6, 0.0, 9.2)

CANNON_DIR = np.array(CANNON_TIP) - np.array(CANNON_BASE)
CANNON_LEN = float(np.linalg.norm(CANNON_DIR))
CANNON_DIR = CANNON_DIR / CANNON_LEN


BAND = (4.4, 5.6)                 # the dark ring around the barrel, distances from the pivot
CANNON_R, CANNON_LIP_R, CANNON_BORE_R = 3.2, 3.8, 2.1
COLLAR_MAJOR, COLLAR_MINOR = 3.9, 1.15


def cannon_dir(k):
    return CANNON_DIR * np.array([1.0, k, 1.0])


def make_rig():
    rig = R.Rig()
    rig.add("root", None, (0, 0, 0))
    rig.add("pelvis", "root", PELVIS)
    rig.add("spine", "pelvis", SPINE, tail=(0, 0, 44))
    rig.add("neck", "spine", NECK, tail=HEAD)
    rig.add("head", "neck", HEAD, tail=(9, 0, 53))
    rig.add("jaw", "head", JAW, tail=(13, 0, 47))
    for s, k in SIDES:
        rig.add(f"ear_{s}", "head", side(EAR, k), tail=side(EAR_TIP, k))
    for s, k in SIDES:
        rig.add(f"cannon_{s}", "spine", side(CANNON_BASE, k), tail=side(CANNON_TIP, k))
    for s, k in SIDES:
        rig.add(f"arm_{s}", "spine", side(SHOULDER, k))
        rig.add(f"forearm_{s}", f"arm_{s}", side(ELBOW, k))
        rig.add(f"hand_{s}", f"forearm_{s}", side(WRIST, k), tail=side((9.0, 21.6, 18.0), k))
    for s, k in SIDES:
        rig.add(f"thigh_{s}", "pelvis", side(HIP, k))
        rig.add(f"shin_{s}", f"thigh_{s}", side(KNEE, k))
        rig.add(f"foot_{s}", f"shin_{s}", side(ANKLE, k), tail=side((9.0, 10.8, 1.5), k))
    rig.add("tail1", "pelvis", TAIL1)
    rig.add("tail2", "tail1", TAIL2, tail=TAIL_END)
    return rig


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# shapes

CORE_C, CORE_R = np.array([1.6, 0.0, 29.0]), np.array([12.2, 15.6, 17.6])
CARA_C, CARA_R = np.array([-3.6, 0.0, 30.4]), np.array([14.8, 19.2, 19.6])
CUT_X, CUT_TILT = 1.2, 0.10       # front edge of the shell: x = CUT_X + CUT_TILT (z - 30)
CUT_Z = 13.4                      # lower edge of the shell (legs and tail come out under it)
RIM_W = 3.6                       # width of the cream rim along the edge
PLATE_LINES = (20.5, 26.5, 32.5, 38.5)


def _edge_d(p):
    """Signed distance-like value to the shell's edge (negative on the shell side)."""
    nx = 1.0 / math.sqrt(1 + CUT_TILT ** 2)
    e1 = ((p[:, 0] - CUT_X) - CUT_TILT * (p[:, 2] - 30.0)) * nx
    e2 = CUT_Z - p[:, 2]
    k = 2.0
    h = np.clip(0.5 + 0.5 * (e1 - e2) / k, 0.0, 1.0)      # smooth max: rounded corner at the hips
    return e2 * (1 - h) + e1 * h + k * h * (1 - h)


def _plate_d(p):
    """Distance to the plastron's segment lines (curving up toward the sides)."""
    y, z = p[:, 1], p[:, 2]
    d = np.full(len(p), 1e9)
    for z0 in PLATE_LINES:
        d = np.minimum(d, np.abs(z - (z0 + 0.016 * y * y)))
    return d


def core_shape():
    core = sdf.ellipsoid(CORE_C, CORE_R)

    def groove(p):  # shallow grooves between the plastron plates (front only)
        front = np.clip((p[:, 0] - 5.0) / 3.0, 0.0, 1.0)
        return 0.45 * np.exp(-(_plate_d(p) / 0.8) ** 2) * front

    return core.displace(groove, 0.46)


def carapace_shape():
    cara = sdf.ellipsoid(CARA_C, CARA_R)
    # broad shoulders: the shell rises around the cannons' bases
    mound = sdf.ellipsoid((-2.0, 12.6, 41.5), (7.5, 6.6, 6.6)).mirror_y()
    cara = sdf.union(cara, mound, k=9.0)

    def ridge(p):  # the rim stands out along the edge
        return -1.5 * np.exp(-((_edge_d(p) + RIM_W * 0.5) / (RIM_W * 0.5)) ** 2)

    cara = cara.displace(ridge, 1.6)
    edge = sdf.SDF(_edge_d, CARA_C - CARA_R - 3, CARA_C + CARA_R + 3)
    return sdf.intersect(cara, edge, k=1.3)


def _cannon_exit(k):
    """Where the cannon's axis leaves the carapace (bisection along the axis from the pivot)."""
    return surface_point(_shell_only(), side(CANNON_BASE, k), cannon_dir(k), max_dist=12.0)


_SHELL_CACHE = []


def _shell_only():
    if not _SHELL_CACHE:
        _SHELL_CACHE.append(carapace_shape())
    return _SHELL_CACHE[0]


def collar_shape(k):
    """Raised ring around the hole the cannon comes out of (a socket for the barrel)."""
    d = cannon_dir(k)
    c = _cannon_exit(k) - 0.35 * d
    return sdf.torus(tuple(c), COLLAR_MAJOR, COLLAR_MINOR, axis=tuple(d))


def torso_shape():
    t = sdf.union(core_shape(), carapace_shape(), k=0.7)
    return sdf.union(t, collar_shape(1.0), collar_shape(-1.0), k=0.9)


def neck_shape():
    return sdf.rounded_cone((0.5, 0.0, 37.0), (3.8, 0.0, 47.0), 6.9, 6.0)


def head_full():
    skull = sdf.ellipsoid((4.6, 0.0, 51.4), (7.0, 7.7, 6.6))
    snout = sdf.ellipsoid((9.4, 0.0, 49.3), (5.0, 5.9, 4.3))
    cheeks = sdf.ellipsoid((6.0, 3.7, 48.8), (4.3, 3.7, 3.3)).mirror_y()
    brow = sdf.ellipsoid((8.9, 3.4, 54.0), (2.6, 2.7, 1.6)).mirror_y()
    h = sdf.union(skull, snout, k=3.0)
    h = sdf.union(h, cheeks, k=2.0)
    return sdf.union(h, brow, k=1.6)


def _mouth_plane(p):
    return p[:, 2] - (MOUTH_Z - 0.03 * (p[:, 0] - JAW[0]))


def jaw_region():
    below = sdf.SDF(_mouth_plane, (-30, -30, 0), (30, 30, 80))
    front = sdf.SDF(lambda p: (JAW[0] - 0.4) - p[:, 0], (-30, -30, 0), (30, 30, 80))
    return sdf.intersect(below, front)


def head_shape():
    return sdf.subtract(head_full(), jaw_region(), k=0.45)


def jaw_shape():
    return sdf.intersect(head_full(), jaw_region(), k=0.45)


def ear_shape(k):
    a, b = side(EAR, k), side(EAR_TIP, k)
    a = (a[0], a[1], a[2] + 0.6)
    cone = sdf.rounded_cone(a, b, 2.1, 0.45)
    return cone.stretch((0.6, 1.0, 1.0), center=a)


def cannon_shape(k):
    a = np.array(side(CANNON_BASE, k))
    b = np.array(side(CANNON_TIP, k))
    d = cannon_dir(k)
    barrel = sdf.cylinder(a - 5.0 * d, b, CANNON_R, round_r=0.5)     # deep in the shell: never shows its end
    lip = sdf.cylinder(b - 2.5 * d, b + 0.1 * d, CANNON_LIP_R, round_r=0.8)
    band = sdf.cylinder(a + BAND[0] * d, a + BAND[1] * d, CANNON_R + 0.35, round_r=0.45)
    c = sdf.union(barrel, lip, k=0.5)
    c = sdf.union(c, band, k=0.4)
    bore = sdf.cylinder(b - 3.0 * d, b + 2.0 * d, CANNON_BORE_R)
    return sdf.subtract(c, bore, k=0.35)



def upperarm_shape(k):
    return sdf.rounded_cone(side(SHOULDER, k), side(ELBOW, k), 5.4, 4.9)


def forearm_shape(k):
    return sdf.rounded_cone(side(ELBOW, k), side(WRIST, k), 4.9, 4.3)


HAND_C = (8.4, 21.4, 21.4)


def hand_shape(k):
    palm = sdf.ellipsoid(side(HAND_C, k), (3.9, 3.5, 3.8))
    fingers = []
    for dx, dy in ((2.3, -1.9), (3.0, 0.3), (1.5, 2.3)):
        a = side((HAND_C[0] + dx * 0.4, HAND_C[1] + dy * 0.5, 20.2), k)
        b = side((HAND_C[0] + dx, HAND_C[1] + dy, 16.6), k)
        fingers.append(sdf.rounded_cone(a, b, 1.7, 1.1))
    return sdf.union(palm, *fingers, k=1.0)


def thigh_shape(k):
    return sdf.rounded_cone(side(HIP, k), side(KNEE, k), 6.3, 5.2)


def shin_shape(k):
    return sdf.rounded_cone(side(KNEE, k), side(ANKLE, k), 5.2, 4.4)


def foot_shape(k):
    sole = sdf.ellipsoid(side((3.2, 10.8, 2.5), k), (6.4, 5.0, 3.0))
    ankle = sdf.sphere(side(ANKLE, k), 4.3)
    claws = []
    for dy in (-2.9, 0.0, 2.9):
        a = side((7.4, 10.8 + dy, 1.9), k)
        b = side((10.2, 10.8 + dy * 1.1, 1.0), k)
        claws.append(sdf.rounded_cone(a, b, 1.45, 0.55))
    f = sdf.union(sole, ankle, k=2.5)
    f = sdf.union(f, *claws, k=0.8)
    floor = sdf.halfspace((0, 0, 0.0), (0, 0, -1))
    return sdf.intersect(f, floor, k=0.6)


def tail_shape():
    return sdf.tube([(-7.5, 0.0, 16.0), TAIL1, TAIL2, TAIL_END], [4.8, 4.4, 3.0, 1.0])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# paint


def surface_point(shape, inside, direction, max_dist=40.0):
    """Point where the ray from `inside` along `direction` leaves the shape (bisection)."""
    o = np.asarray(inside, dtype=np.float64)
    d = np.asarray(direction, dtype=np.float64)
    d = d / np.linalg.norm(d)
    lo, hi = 0.0, max_dist
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if shape(o + d * mid) < 0:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return o + d * lo


class Painter:
    """Paint functions.  Baked occlusion is computed per part against what stays next to it whatever the pose:
    the trunk (torso, neck, head, tail) against the trunk, each limb segment and cannon against itself only, so
    no stain shows when an arm or a leg moves away."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.core = core_shape()
        self.cara = carapace_shape()
        self.head_sdf = head_full()
        self.trunk = sdf.union(torso_shape(), neck_shape(), self.head_sdf, tail_shape())
        self.head_ears = sdf.union(self.head_sdf, ear_shape(1.0), ear_shape(-1.0))
        self.exits = {k: _cannon_exit(k) for _s, k in SIDES}
        self.eyes = []
        for _s, k in SIDES:
            d = np.array([1.0, 0.5 * k, 0.05])
            c = surface_point(self.head_sdf, (4.8, 2.8 * k, 52.6), d)
            self.eyes.append((c, d / np.linalg.norm(d), k))
        self.nostrils = [surface_point(self.head_sdf, (9.0, 1.25 * k, 50.6), (1, 0.15 * k, 0.25)) for k in (1, -1)]

    @staticmethod
    def finish(c, P, N, occ, ao_dist=3.0, top=0.16, ao_strength=0.62):
        """Soft top light + occlusion; ao_strength (scalar or per point) also scales the cool shadow tint, so
        surfaces painted with little occlusion (the cream rim, the collars) stay clean."""
        ao = T.ambient_occlusion(occ, P, N, dist=ao_dist)
        ao = 1.0 - (1.0 - ao) * np.clip(np.asarray(ao_strength) / 0.62, 0.0, 1.0)
        return T.shade(c, N, ao=ao, ao_strength=0.62, top=top, shadow_tint=SHADOW)

    def skin(self, P, N, under=0.30, light=0.25):
        """Blue skin: lighter on top, a touch darker underneath."""
        c = T.fill(P, SKIN)
        c = T.mix(c, SKIN_LIGHT, light * T.facing(N, (0.3, 0, 1), 0.2, 1.0))
        c = T.mix(c, SKIN_DARK, under * T.facing(N, (0, 0, -1), 0.1, 1.0))
        return c

    # parts ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def torso(self, P, N, skin):
        e = _edge_d(P)
        on_shell = T.edge(self.cara(P) - self.core(P), 0.3)
        # carapace: brown, darker low, a broad sheen on the upper back, a darker band just inside the rim
        sh = T.gradient(P, (0, 0, 1), 20.0, 44.0, SHELL_DARK, SHELL)
        sh = T.mix(sh, SHELL_LIGHT, 0.7 * T.facing(N, (-0.55, 0.25, 0.8), 0.35, 1.0))
        inside_rim = T.edge(-(e + RIM_W + 2.4), 1.0) * (1 - T.edge(-(e + RIM_W + 0.1), 0.5))
        sh = T.mix(sh, SHELL_DARK, 0.42 * inside_rim)
        # plastron: cream, plate grooves with a light bevel above each one
        pl = T.fill(P, PLASTRON)
        pl = T.mix(pl, T.rgb("#f7edc4"), 0.55 * T.facing(N, (1, 0, 0.25), 0.55, 1.0))
        front = np.clip((P[:, 0] - 4.0) / 3.0, 0, 1)
        y, z = P[:, 1], P[:, 2]
        bevel = np.full(len(P), 1e9)
        for z0 in PLATE_LINES:
            bevel = np.minimum(bevel, np.abs(z - (z0 + 0.016 * y * y + 0.95)))
        pl = T.mix(pl, T.rgb("#fff6d8"), 0.75 * T.edge(bevel - 0.3, 0.3) * front)
        line = T.edge(_plate_d(P) - 0.45, 0.35) * front
        pl = T.mix(pl, PLASTRON_LINE, 0.85 * line)
        c = T.mix(pl, sh, on_shell)
        # cream rim on the raised edge of the shell, a thin dark line on its inner side
        rim = T.edge(-(e + RIM_W), 0.35) * on_shell
        c = T.mix(c, RIM, rim)
        inner = T.edge(np.abs(e + RIM_W) - 0.2, 0.25) * on_shell
        c = T.mix(c, SHELL_DARK * 0.8, 0.75 * inner)
        sep = T.edge(np.abs(e) - 0.25, 0.3) * (1 - on_shell)
        c = T.mix(c, PLASTRON_LINE * 0.75, 0.7 * sep)
        # collars around the cannon holes: a cream ring, dark inside where the barrel goes in
        collar = np.zeros(len(P))
        for _s, k in SIDES:
            d = cannon_dir(k)
            q = P - self.exits[k]
            along = q @ d
            r = np.linalg.norm(q - np.outer(along, d), axis=1)
            ring = T.edge(r - (COLLAR_MAJOR + COLLAR_MINOR + 0.35), 0.3) * T.edge(np.abs(along + 0.35) - 2.2, 0.4)
            c = T.mix(c, RIM, ring)
            c = T.mix(c, SHELL_DARK * 0.45, ring * T.edge(r - (COLLAR_MAJOR - 0.25), 0.35))
            collar = np.maximum(collar, ring)
        ao_s = 0.5 * (1 - on_shell) + 0.35 * on_shell
        ao_s = ao_s * (1 - rim) * (1 - collar) + 0.06 * np.maximum(rim, collar)
        return self.finish(c, P, N, self.trunk, ao_dist=3.5, ao_strength=ao_s)

    def neck(self, P, N, skin):
        # the top of the neck sits inside the head: it is the back of the throat seen when the jaw opens
        inside = T.edge(self.head_sdf(P) + 0.5, 0.35)
        c = T.mix(self.skin(P, N), T.mix(MOUTH, THROAT, np.clip((8.0 - P[:, 0]) / 4.0, 0, 1)), inside)
        return self.finish(c, P, N, self.trunk, ao_strength=0.62 * (1 - inside))

    def _inside(self, P, depth=0.3):
        """1 on the faces cut through the head (mouth roof / floor), 0 on its outer skin."""
        return T.edge(self.head_sdf(P) + depth, 0.2)

    def head(self, P, N, skin):
        c = self.skin(P, N)
        mp = _mouth_plane(P)
        # mouth roof: the whole cut face under the upper head
        roof = self._inside(P) * T.edge(np.abs(mp) - 0.6, 0.3)
        c = T.mix(c, T.mix(MOUTH, THROAT, np.clip((7.0 - P[:, 0]) / 5.0, 0, 1)), roof)
        # mouth line on the outside
        lip = T.edge(np.abs(mp) - 0.16, 0.2) * (P[:, 0] > JAW[0] + 1.5) * (1 - roof)
        c = T.mix(c, SKIN_DARK * 0.4, 0.9 * lip)
        for ec, ed, k in self.eyes:
            col, m = T.eye(P, ec, ed, (1.9, 2.2), iris="#6a3420", iris_radius=0.62, pupil="#120a08",
                           pupil_radius=0.34, sclera="#fbfaf4", highlight="#ffffff", highlight_pos=(0.12, 0.40),
                           highlight_radius=0.27, look=(0.18, -0.05), soft=0.12, outline="#141019",
                           outline_width=0.22)
            # heavy brow: the lid covers the upper inner part of the eye (determined look)
            q = P - ec
            upv = np.array([0, 0, 1.0])
            right = np.cross(ed, upv)
            right /= np.linalg.norm(right)
            u = q @ right * (-k)   # > 0 toward the nose
            v = q @ upv
            lid_v = 1.0 - 0.40 * u
            m = m * (1 - T.edge(-(v - lid_v), 0.12))
            c = T.mix(c, col, m)
            lidline = T.edge(np.abs(v - lid_v) - 0.22, 0.14) * T.ellipse(P, ec, (2.7, 2.7, 2.7), soft=0.4)
            c = T.mix(c, "#1b2240", 0.92 * lidline * (u > -2.25))
        for n in self.nostrils:
            c = T.mix(c, SKIN_DARK * 0.45, T.spot(P, n, 0.32, soft=0.2))
        return self.finish(c, P, N, self.head_ears, ao_dist=2.0, ao_strength=0.62 * (1 - roof))

    def jaw(self, P, N, skin):
        c = self.skin(P, N)
        mp = _mouth_plane(P)
        floor = self._inside(P) * T.edge(np.abs(mp) - 0.6, 0.3)
        tongue = T.ellipse(P, (8.6, 0.0, MOUTH_Z), (3.4, 2.5, 1.2), soft=0.5)
        inner = T.mix(MOUTH, THROAT, np.clip((6.0 - P[:, 0]) / 4.0, 0, 1))
        c = T.mix(c, T.mix(inner, TONGUE, tongue), floor)
        lip = T.edge(np.abs(mp) - 0.16, 0.2) * (P[:, 0] > JAW[0] + 1.5) * (1 - floor)
        c = T.mix(c, SKIN_DARK * 0.4, 0.9 * lip)
        return self.finish(c, P, N, self.head_sdf, ao_dist=2.0, ao_strength=0.62 * (1 - floor))

    def ear(self, P, N, skin):
        c = self.skin(P, N)
        c = T.mix(c, SKIN_DARK, 0.45 * T.facing(N, (1, 0, 0.2), 0.3, 0.8))
        return self.finish(c, P, N, self.head_ears, ao_dist=1.5)

    def cannon(self, P, N, skin):
        k = 1.0 if np.mean(P[:, 1]) > 0 else -1.0
        a = np.array(side(CANNON_BASE, k))
        d = cannon_dir(k)
        q = P - a
        along = q @ d
        radial_v = q - np.outer(along, d)
        r = np.linalg.norm(radial_v, axis=1)
        up = np.array([0, 0, 1.0]) - d * d[2]
        up /= np.linalg.norm(up)
        cosu = (radial_v @ up) / np.maximum(r, 1e-6)
        # polished metal: bright top streak, dark underside
        c = T.mix(METAL_DARK, METAL, np.clip(0.55 + 0.6 * cosu, 0, 1))
        c = T.mix(c, METAL_LIGHT, T.edge(np.abs(cosu - 0.75) - 0.14, 0.14) * (along < CANNON_LEN - 0.5))
        c = T.mix(c, BORE, T.edge(r - (CANNON_BORE_R + 0.15), 0.25) * (along > CANNON_LEN - 3.2))
        for s0 in (CANNON_LEN - 2.5, BAND[0], BAND[1]):
            c = T.mix(c, METAL_DARK * 0.8, 0.6 * T.edge(np.abs(along - s0) - 0.14, 0.2) * (r > CANNON_BORE_R + 0.2))
        # darker where it enters the collar
        c = T.mix(c, METAL_DARK * 0.6, 0.6 * T.edge(along - 1.9, 0.6))
        ao = T.ambient_occlusion(self.cannon_occ[k], P, N, dist=2.5)
        return T.shade(c, N, ao=ao, ao_strength=0.55, top=0.1)

    def limb_paint(self, shape, under=0.08, ao_dist=1.5):
        """Arm and leg segments: occluded by themselves only (they swing far from the body)."""
        def paint(P, N, skin):
            # little directional paint: it is baked in the rest pose and these parts turn far from it
            return self.finish(self.skin(P, N, under=under, light=0.1), P, N, shape, ao_dist=ao_dist,
                               ao_strength=0.45, top=0.08)
        return paint

    def hand_paint(self, shape):
        def paint(P, N, skin):
            c = self.skin(P, N, under=0.08, light=0.1)
            c = T.mix(c, CLAW, T.halfspace(P, (0, 0, 17.0), (0, 0, -1), soft=0.45))
            return self.finish(c, P, N, shape, ao_dist=1.5)
        return paint

    def foot_paint(self, shape):
        def paint(P, N, skin):
            c = self.skin(P, N)
            c = T.mix(c, CLAW, T.halfspace(P, (8.7, 0, 0), (1, 0, -0.25), soft=0.5))
            c = T.mix(c, SKIN_DARK, 0.35 * T.facing(N, (0, 0, -1), 0.5, 0.9))
            return self.finish(c, P, N, shape, ao_dist=1.5)
        return paint

    def tail(self, P, N, skin):
        return self.finish(self.skin(P, N), P, N, self.trunk)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# model


def make_builder(verbose=False):
    rig = make_rig()
    pt = Painter()
    b = builder.ModelBuilder("pokemon/blastoise.mdl", rig, verbose=verbose)
    b.group("body", size=(512, 256), pack="skyline")
    b.group("limbs", size=(512, 256), pack="skyline")
    b.group("head", size=(512, 256), pack="skyline")
    P = builder.Part
    round_charts = {"smooth_iters": 8, "min_dot": 0.2}
    b.add(P("torso", torso_shape(), bone="spine", paint=pt.torso, group="body", budget=860))
    b.add(P("tail", tail_shape(), bones=["tail1", "tail2"], paint=pt.tail, group="body", budget=90))
    b.add(P("neck", neck_shape(), bone="neck", paint=pt.neck, group="head", budget=110, density=0.5))
    b.add(P("head", head_shape(), bone="head", paint=pt.head, group="head", budget=470, density=1.3))
    b.add(P("jaw", jaw_shape(), bone="jaw", paint=pt.jaw, group="head", budget=130, density=0.6))
    pt.cannon_occ = {}
    for s, k in SIDES:
        b.add(P(f"ear_{s}", ear_shape(k), bone=f"ear_{s}", paint=pt.ear, group="head", budget=36))
        pt.cannon_occ[k] = cannon_shape(k)
        b.add(P(f"cannon_{s}", pt.cannon_occ[k], bone=f"cannon_{s}", paint=pt.cannon, group="head", budget=150,
                density=0.8))
        for name, shape, bone, budget, paint in (
                ("arm", upperarm_shape(k), "arm", 70, None), ("forearm", forearm_shape(k), "forearm", 60, None),
                ("hand", hand_shape(k), "hand", 100, pt.hand_paint), ("thigh", thigh_shape(k), "thigh", 75, None),
                ("shin", shin_shape(k), "shin", 50, None), ("foot", foot_shape(k), "foot", 110, pt.foot_paint)):
            paint = (paint or pt.limb_paint)(shape)
            b.add(P(f"{name}_{s}", shape, bone=f"{bone}_{s}", paint=paint, group="limbs", budget=budget,
                    charts=round_charts if name in ("arm", "forearm", "thigh", "shin") else None))
    return b, rig


def make_generated_model(verbose=False):
    """The model generated from scratch (used when the official source file is not installed)."""
    b, rig = make_builder(verbose)
    b.mesh_parts()
    anim = Animator(rig, b)
    for seq in anim.sequences():
        b.add_sequence(seq)
    for s, k in SIDES:
        tip = np.array(side(CANNON_TIP, k)) + cannon_dir(k) * 0.6
        b.attachment(f"cannon_{s}", f"cannon_{s}", tuple(tip))
    b.eyeposition = (8.0, 0.0, 52.5)
    b.hull = ((-16.0, -16.0, 0.0), (16.0, 16.0, 72.0))
    return b.write()


def make_model(verbose=False):
    """The official model when its source is installed, else the generated one."""
    src = official_source()
    if src is not None:
        return make_official_model(src, verbose=verbose)
    return make_generated_model(verbose)


def build(out):
    out["models/pokemon/blastoise.mdl"] = make_model()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# animation


LEGS = [("thigh_l", "shin_l", "foot_l"), ("thigh_r", "shin_r", "foot_r")]


class Animator:
    def __init__(self, rig, b):
        self.rig = rig
        self.verts = np.concatenate([p.tri.verts for p in b.parts])
        self.vbone = np.concatenate([p.vbone for p in b.parts])

    # helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def plant(self, p, targets=None, pole=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), pitch=(0.0, 0.0)):
        """Feet on the ground at their rest spots (or `targets` per side), whatever the pelvis does."""
        for i, ((up, lo, end), (s, k)) in enumerate(zip(LEGS, SIDES)):
            t = self.rig.head(end) if targets is None or targets[i] is None else np.asarray(targets[i], float)
            pl = np.array(pole, float) + np.array([0, 0.35 * k, 0])
            self.rig.solve_two_bone(p, up, lo, end, t, pole=pl, end_world_rot=xform.rot_deg(0, pitch[i], 0))
        return p

    def lowest(self, p):
        m = self.rig.skin_matrices(p)
        W = m[self.vbone]
        v = np.einsum("nij,nj->ni", W[:, :, :3], self.verts) + W[:, :, 3]
        return float(v[:, 2].min())

    def cannon_recoil(self, p, amount):
        for s, k in SIDES:
            rot = p.get_rot(f"cannon_{s}")
            d = xform.rot_deg(*rot) @ cannon_dir(k)
            p.move(f"cannon_{s}", *(-amount * d))
        return p

    def base_breath(self, p, t, amp=1.0, freq=1):
        br = R.breathe(t, freq=freq) * amp
        p.move("pelvis", z=0.25 * br)
        p.rot("spine", y=-1.0 * br)
        p.rot("neck", y=0.6 * br)
        p.rot("head", y=0.4 * br)
        for s, k in SIDES:
            p.rot(f"arm_{s}", x=1.4 * br * k)
            p.rot(f"cannon_{s}", y=-0.8 * br)
        return br

    def arms(self, p, out=0.0, swing=0.0, bend=0.0, hand=0.0, twist=0.0, sides=(1.0, 1.0)):
        """Both arms: out = abduction (deg, away from the body), swing = pitch (deg, + backward), bend = elbow
        flexion (deg, + bends the forearm forward/up), hand = wrist curl; values per side via `sides` scale."""
        for (s, k), w in zip(SIDES, sides):
            p.rot(f"arm_{s}", x=out * k * w, y=swing * w, z=twist * k * w)
            p.rot(f"forearm_{s}", y=-bend * w)
            p.rot(f"hand_{s}", y=-hand * w)
        return p

    def bone_lowest(self, p, bones):
        m = self.rig.skin_matrices(p)
        sel = np.isin(self.vbone, [self.rig.index(b) for b in bones])
        W = m[self.vbone[sel]]
        v = np.einsum("nij,nj->ni", W[:, :, :3], self.verts[sel]) + W[:, :, 3]
        return float(v[:, 2].min())

    # sequences -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def idle(self, t):
        p = R.Pose()
        br = self.base_breath(p, t, 1.0, freq=2)
        look = R.keys(t, [(0.0, 0.0), (0.18, 0.0), (0.32, 16.0), (0.5, 16.0), (0.66, -10.0), (0.84, -10.0)],
                      interp="smooth", loop=True)
        tilt = R.keys(t, [(0.0, 0.0), (0.2, 0.0), (0.34, -4.0), (0.5, -2.0), (0.68, 3.0), (0.84, 0.0)],
                      interp="smooth", loop=True)
        p.rot("neck", z=0.35 * look)
        p.rot("head", z=0.65 * look, x=tilt, y=-0.6 * abs(look) * 0.2)
        tw = R.chain_wave(t, 2, 7.0, lag=0.15, freq=2)
        p.rot("tail1", z=tw[0])
        p.rot("tail2", z=tw[1])
        for s, k in SIDES:
            t0 = 0.36 if k > 0 else 0.72
            flick = R.pulse(t, t0, t0 + 0.025, t0 + 0.05, t0 + 0.12)
            p.rot(f"ear_{s}", x=-16 * flick * k, y=-8 * flick)
        self.arms(p, out=3.0 + 0.8 * br, bend=6.0 + 1.5 * br, hand=6.0)
        return self.plant(p)

    def walk(self, t):
        p = R.Pose()
        u = 2 * math.pi * t
        # heavy waddle: the body drops hard as each foot lands and rolls over the planted leg, the shoulders
        # counter-roll so that the head stays fairly level
        bob = -1.8 + 1.9 * abs(math.sin(u - 0.25))
        p.move("pelvis", z=bob, y=2.0 * math.sin(u - 0.15))
        p.rot("pelvis", x=-7.0 * math.sin(u - 0.15), z=-6.0 * math.cos(u))
        p.rot("spine", y=5.0 + 1.2 * math.cos(2 * u - 0.5), x=4.0 * math.sin(u - 0.35), z=3.0 * math.cos(u))
        p.rot("neck", y=-3.0 + 1.5 * math.cos(2 * u - 0.7), z=-2.0 * math.cos(u), x=1.5 * math.sin(u - 0.5))
        p.rot("head", y=-1.5 + 1.5 * math.cos(2 * u - 1.0), x=1.5 * math.sin(u - 0.6), z=-1.0 * math.cos(u))
        for s, k in SIDES:
            sw = math.cos(u - 0.3) * k            # + when this arm swings back (its leg forward)
            p.rot(f"arm_{s}", y=16.0 * sw, x=(8.0 + 3.0 * math.sin(u) * k) * k)
            p.rot(f"forearm_{s}", y=-16.0 - 10.0 * max(0.0, -sw))
            p.rot(f"hand_{s}", y=-10.0)
            p.rot(f"cannon_{s}", y=2.0 * math.cos(2 * u - 0.9))
            p.rot(f"ear_{s}", x=4.0 * math.cos(2 * u - 1.0) * k)
        tw = R.chain_wave(t, 2, 11.0, lag=0.14)
        p.rot("tail1", z=tw[0], y=3 * math.cos(2 * u - 0.8))
        p.rot("tail2", z=tw[1])
        return R.walk_legs(self.rig, p, t, LEGS, stride=WALK_STRIDE, lift=4.5, duty=WALK_DUTY, phases=[0.0, 0.5],
                           pole=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), foot_pitch=-12.0)

    def run(self, t):
        p = R.Pose()
        u = 2 * math.pi * t
        # charging run: the shell pitched well forward over the legs, head driving ahead, arms pumping,
        # low at mid-stance and airborne between the steps
        mid = 2 * math.pi * RUN_DUTY * 0.5
        bob = -0.5 - 1.9 * math.cos(2 * (u - mid))
        p.move("pelvis", z=bob, x=-0.4, y=1.0 * math.sin(u - 0.3))
        p.rot("pelvis", x=-4.0 * math.sin(u - 0.3), z=-7.0 * math.cos(u))
        p.rot("spine", y=22.0 + 3.0 * math.cos(2 * (u - mid) - 0.6), z=5.0 * math.cos(u), x=2.0 * math.sin(u))
        p.rot("neck", y=-6.0 - 2.0 * math.cos(2 * (u - mid) - 1.0))
        p.rot("head", y=-2.0 - 1.5 * math.cos(2 * (u - mid) - 1.4), x=1.5 * math.sin(u))
        for s, k in SIDES:
            sw = math.cos(u - 0.2) * k
            p.rot(f"arm_{s}", y=34.0 * sw + 4.0, x=(14.0 + 3.0 * math.sin(u) * k) * k)
            p.rot(f"forearm_{s}", y=-62.0 - 10.0 * max(0.0, -sw))
            p.rot(f"hand_{s}", y=-35.0)
            p.rot(f"cannon_{s}", y=-3.0 + 3.0 * math.cos(2 * (u - mid) - 1.2))
            p.rot(f"ear_{s}", x=-6.0 * k, y=-20.0 + 3.0 * math.cos(2 * u - 1.0))
        tw = R.chain_wave(t, 2, 10.0, lag=0.16)
        p.rot("tail1", z=tw[0], y=16 + 4 * math.cos(2 * (u - mid) - 1.0))
        p.rot("tail2", z=tw[1], y=6 + 4 * math.cos(2 * (u - mid) - 1.4))
        return R.walk_legs(self.rig, p, t, LEGS, stride=RUN_STRIDE, lift=8.0, duty=RUN_DUTY, phases=[0.0, 0.5],
                           pole=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), foot_pitch=-22.0)

    def attack(self, t):
        p = R.Pose()
        hit = ATTACK_HIT
        # anticipation (crouches, draws the head in, plants both hands), the shot exactly at `hit` with the
        # cannons level, then a hard shove back that settles while the jets pour out, and an ease back
        brace = R.window(t, 0.0, 0.3, R.ease_in_out) * (1.0 - R.window(t, 0.72, 1.0, R.ease_in_out))
        build = R.window(t, 0.2, hit, R.ease_in) * (t < hit)                  # trembling before the shot
        kick = 0.0
        if t >= hit:
            x = (t - hit) / 0.3
            kick = (1.0 - math.exp(-x * 14.0)) * math.exp(-2.4 * x) * math.cos(3.6 * x) * (1.0 - R.window(t, 0.72, 1.0))
        pour = R.pulse(t, hit, hit + 0.03, 0.62, 0.74)
        buzz = math.sin(t * 2 * math.pi * 17)
        shake = buzz * (0.5 * build + 0.9 * pour)
        p.move("pelvis", z=-5.0 * brace + 0.6 * kick, x=-1.0 * brace - 4.0 * kick - 1.2 * pour)
        p.rot("spine", y=18.0 * brace - 14.0 * kick - 3.0 * pour, x=0.8 * shake)
        p.move("neck", z=-4.0 * brace, x=-2.0 * brace)             # head drawn into the shell
        p.rot("neck", y=-8.0 * brace + 5.0 * kick)
        p.rot("head", y=-8.0 * brace + 7.0 * kick, z=0.8 * shake)
        p.rot("jaw", y=5.0 * brace + 14.0 * R.pulse(t, hit - 0.06, hit, 0.6, 0.72))
        self.arms(p, out=18.0 * brace + 6.0 * kick, swing=-25.0 * brace + 14.0 * kick, bend=35.0 * brace - 8.0 * kick,
                  hand=20.0 * brace)
        for s, k in SIDES:
            # the cannons level off at the target, kick up with the recoil, settle
            p.rot(f"cannon_{s}", y=-5.0 * brace - 12.0 * kick + 0.9 * shake * k)
            p.rot(f"ear_{s}", x=(-10.0 * brace - 14.0 * kick) * k, y=-14.0 * brace)
        self.cannon_recoil(p, 3.5 * max(kick, 0.0) - 0.6 * build + 0.3 * shake)
        p.rot("tail1", y=8.0 * brace - 8.0 * kick)
        p.rot("tail2", y=6.0 * brace - 8.0 * kick)
        wide = 2.2 * brace
        targets = [self.rig.head(f"foot_{s}") + np.array([0.0, wide * k, 0.0]) for s, k in SIDES]
        return self.plant(p, targets)

    def flinch(self, t):
        p = R.Pose()
        # ducks into the shell: peak at frame 2, holds 2 frames, comes back out with a small overshoot
        back = R.window(t, 0.0, 2 / 12, R.ease_out) * (1 - R.window(t, 4 / 12, 1.0, R.ease_in_out))
        over = R.pulse(t, 0.55, 0.72, 0.78, 1.0) * 0.3
        p.move("pelvis", x=-1.3 * back, z=-2.0 * back)
        p.rot("spine", y=-6.0 * back + 3.0 * over, x=4.0 * back)
        p.move("neck", z=-6.0 * back, x=-2.5 * back)
        p.rot("neck", y=-3.0 * back - 4.0 * over, z=5.0 * back)
        p.rot("head", y=10.0 * back + 3.0 * over, x=-6.0 * back)
        p.rot("jaw", y=8.0 * back)
        self.arms(p, out=-6.0 * back, swing=20.0 * back, bend=60.0 * back, hand=18.0 * back)
        for s, k in SIDES:
            p.rot(f"cannon_{s}", y=-8.0 * back + 2.0 * over)
            p.rot(f"ear_{s}", x=-18.0 * back * k, y=-16 * back)
        self.cannon_recoil(p, 2.0 * back)
        p.rot("tail1", y=-10.0 * back)
        return self.plant(p)

    def die(self, t):
        p = R.Pose()
        # 0 .. 0.18: hit, staggers; 0.18 .. 0.6: topples backward onto the shell (pivoting on the shell's back,
        # so it lands where it stood); rocks on it; the limbs and head drop onto the ground
        stag = R.window(t, 0.0, 0.12, R.ease_out)
        fall = R.window(t, 0.18, 0.6, R.ease_in)
        rock = 0.0
        if t > 0.6:
            x = (t - 0.6) / 0.4
            rock = math.exp(-4.0 * x) * math.sin(x * 2 * math.pi * 1.6)
        limp = R.window(t, 0.62, 0.95, R.ease_out)

        def lerp(a, b):
            return a + (b - a) * limp

        p.rot("root", y=-86.0 * fall + 9.0 * rock)
        p.move("root", x=DIE_SLIDE * fall - 1.8 * rock)
        p.move("pelvis", z=-1.5 * stag * (1 - fall))
        p.rot("spine", y=-8.0 * stag + 4.0 * fall)
        p.rot("neck", y=lerp(-10.0 * stag + 18.0 * fall, DIE_NECK), z=4.0 * stag * (1 - fall))
        p.rot("head", y=lerp(-14.0 * stag + 20.0 * fall - 6.0 * rock, DIE_HEAD), z=26.0 * limp, x=-8.0 * limp)
        p.rot("jaw", y=16.0 * R.pulse(t, 0.0, 0.1, 0.6, 0.85) + 7.0 * limp)
        a_out, a_swing, a_bend, a_twist = DIE_ARM
        self.arms(p, out=lerp(34.0 * stag * (1 - fall) + 20.0 * fall, a_out),
                  swing=lerp(-50.0 * fall, a_swing), bend=lerp(30.0 * stag + 26.0 * fall, a_bend),
                  hand=lerp(14.0 * fall, 6.0), twist=a_twist * limp)
        self.cannon_recoil(p, DIE_CANNON_IN * fall)
        for s, k in SIDES:
            p.rot(f"cannon_{s}", y=-6.0 * stag + DIE_CANNON * fall)
            p.rot(f"ear_{s}", x=-16.0 * stag * k, y=-14 * stag)
            p.rot(f"thigh_{s}", y=lerp(-38.0 * fall + 6 * rock, DIE_THIGH), x=8.0 * limp * k)
            p.rot(f"shin_{s}", y=lerp(30.0 * fall, DIE_SHIN))
            p.rot(f"foot_{s}", y=lerp(-18.0 * fall, 10.0))
        p.rot("tail1", y=lerp(14.0 * fall, DIE_TAIL))
        p.rot("tail2", y=DIE_TAIL * 0.5 * limp)
        if t < 0.18:
            self.plant(p)
        # nothing goes under the ground; once down, it rests on it
        low = self.lowest(p)
        p.move("root", z=-low if t > 0.6 else max(0.0, -low))
        return p

    def spawn(self, t):
        p = R.Pose()
        # withdrawn in its shell -> pops out (overshoot) -> flexes, cannons up, cries -> settles to idle
        tuck = 1.0 - R.window(t, 0.12, 0.4, R.ease_out_back)
        legs = 1.0 - R.window(t, 0.12, 0.34, R.ease_out)
        flex = R.pulse(t, 0.4, 0.54, 0.8, 0.97, R.ease_in_out)
        cry = R.pulse(t, 0.48, 0.56, 0.76, 0.86)
        shake = math.sin(t * 2 * math.pi * 10) * R.pulse(t, 0.55, 0.6, 0.74, 0.8)
        p.move("pelvis", z=-6.0 * legs + 0.6 * flex)
        p.rot("spine", y=8.0 * tuck - 5.0 * flex)
        p.move("neck", x=-4.0 * tuck, z=-10.0 * tuck)
        p.rot("neck", y=4.0 * tuck - 8.0 * flex)
        p.rot("head", y=6.0 * tuck - 10.0 * flex + 1.5 * shake, z=3.0 * shake)
        p.rot("jaw", y=22.0 * cry)
        self.arms(p, out=-14.0 * tuck + 58.0 * flex, swing=35.0 * tuck, bend=120.0 * tuck + 100.0 * flex,
                  hand=20.0 * tuck + 25.0 * flex)
        for s, k in SIDES:
            p.move(f"arm_{s}", y=-1.5 * tuck * k, z=-1.0 * tuck)
            p.rot(f"cannon_{s}", y=10.0 * tuck - 20.0 * flex + 1.0 * shake)
            p.rot(f"ear_{s}", x=(-12.0 * tuck + 8.0 * flex) * k, y=-20 * tuck)
        self.cannon_recoil(p, 3.0 * tuck)
        p.rot("tail1", y=-12.0 * tuck)
        return self.plant(p)

    def victory(self, t):
        p = R.Pose()
        # stomp left, stomp right, then both fists up pumping in turn, a roar to the sky with the cannons raised
        st_l = R.pulse(t, 0.03, 0.12, 0.14, 0.2, R.ease_out)
        st_r = R.pulse(t, 0.22, 0.31, 0.33, 0.39, R.ease_out)
        land = R.pulse(t, 0.19, 0.2, 0.21, 0.27) + R.pulse(t, 0.38, 0.39, 0.4, 0.46)
        roar = R.pulse(t, 0.46, 0.58, 0.84, 0.98, R.ease_in_out)
        held = R.pulse(t, 0.54, 0.62, 0.82, 0.9)
        shake = math.sin(t * 2 * math.pi * 9) * R.pulse(t, 0.58, 0.62, 0.8, 0.84)
        sway = 2.6 * (st_r - st_l)
        p.move("pelvis", y=sway * 0.6, z=-0.6 * (st_l + st_r) - 1.2 * land + 0.8 * roar)
        p.rot("pelvis", x=sway * 1.2)
        p.rot("spine", y=-12.0 * roar + 3.0 * (st_l + st_r) + 3.0 * land, x=-sway)
        p.rot("neck", y=-10.0 * roar)
        p.rot("head", y=-16.0 * roar + 2.0 * shake + 4.0 * land, z=3.0 * shake)
        p.rot("jaw", y=24.0 * roar + 3.0 * shake)
        for (s, k), lift_ in zip(SIDES, (st_l, st_r)):
            pump = math.sin(2 * math.pi * (6.0 * t) + (0.0 if k > 0 else math.pi)) * held   # ~3 Hz, in turn
            p.rot(f"arm_{s}", y=-62.0 * roar - 5.0 * pump, x=(52.0 * roar + 18.0 * lift_) * k)
            p.rot(f"forearm_{s}", y=-70.0 * roar - 30.0 * lift_ - 15.0 * pump, x=-14.0 * roar * k)
            p.rot(f"hand_{s}", y=-25.0 * roar - 10 * lift_)
            p.rot(f"cannon_{s}", y=-34.0 * roar + 4.0 * pump + 1.5 * shake + 3.0 * land)
            p.rot(f"ear_{s}", x=(-12.0 * roar) * k)
        tw = R.chain_wave(t, 2, 10.0 * roar + 4.0, lag=0.15, freq=4)
        p.rot("tail1", z=tw[0])
        p.rot("tail2", z=tw[1])
        targets = []
        for (s, k), lf in zip(SIDES, (st_l, st_r)):
            targets.append(self.rig.head(f"foot_{s}") + np.array([1.2 * lf, 0.4 * k * lf, 7.0 * lf]))
        return self.plant(p, targets, pitch=(-12 * st_l, -12 * st_r))

    def sequences(self):
        rig = self.rig
        mk = R.make_sequence
        A = mdl.ACT
        return [
            mk(rig, "idle", self.idle, frames=48, fps=16, loop=True, activity=A["IDLE"]),
            mk(rig, "walk", self.walk, frames=WALK_FRAMES, fps=WALK_FPS, loop=True, activity=A["WALK"],
               linear=R.gait_linear_movement(WALK_STRIDE, WALK_DUTY)),
            mk(rig, "run", self.run, frames=RUN_FRAMES, fps=RUN_FPS, loop=True, activity=A["RUN"],
               linear=R.gait_linear_movement(RUN_STRIDE, RUN_DUTY)),
            mk(rig, "attack", self.attack, frames=ATTACK_FRAMES, fps=24, activity=A["RANGE_ATTACK1"]),
            mk(rig, "flinch", self.flinch, frames=13, fps=26, activity=A["SMALL_FLINCH"]),
            mk(rig, "die", self.die, frames=41, fps=24, activity=A["DIESIMPLE"]),
            mk(rig, "spawn", self.spawn, frames=33, fps=26, activity=A["ARM"]),
            mk(rig, "victory", self.victory, frames=41, fps=20, activity=A["VICTORY_DANCE"]),
        ]


WALK_STRIDE, WALK_DUTY = 18.0, 0.56
WALK_FRAMES = 16
WALK_FPS = WALK_FRAMES / (R.gait_linear_movement(WALK_STRIDE, WALK_DUTY) / 85.0)   # ~85 units/s at rate 1
RUN_STRIDE, RUN_DUTY = 17.0, 0.28
RUN_FRAMES = 14
RUN_FPS = RUN_FRAMES / (R.gait_linear_movement(RUN_STRIDE, RUN_DUTY) / 205.0)       # ~205 units/s at rate 1
ATTACK_FRAMES = 34
ATTACK_HIT = 0.4
DIE_SLIDE = 28.0
DIE_NECK, DIE_HEAD = -40.0, -20.0      # limp: the head lolls back and to the side, toward the ground
DIE_THIGH, DIE_SHIN = 60.0, 25.0        # limp legs droop toward the ground beyond the shell's edge
DIE_ARM = (72.0, 10.0, 12.0, 85.0)      # out, swing, bend, twist of the limp arms: lying beside the shell
DIE_TAIL = -40.0
DIE_CANNON, DIE_CANNON_IN = 25.0, 2.5
```
