```py
    Light: ambient + shade with lightvec the direction light travels (engine convention)."""
    if isinstance(seq, str):
        seq = [s["name"] for s in pm.sequences].index(seq)
    W, H = size[0] * ss, size[1] * ss
    if bounds is None:
        s = pm.sequences[seq]
        bounds = (np.array(s["bbmin"]), np.array(s["bbmax"]))
    lo, hi = np.asarray(bounds[0], float), np.asarray(bounds[1], float)
    if target is None:
        target = (lo + hi) / 2
    if dist is None:
        dist = fit_distance(lo, hi, fov)
    cam = Camera(target, yaw, pitch, dist, (W, H), fov, eye=eye)
    if grid:
        img, zbuf_bg = _ground(cam, W, H)
    else:
        img, zbuf_bg = np.tile(BG, (H, W, 1)), np.full((H, W), np.inf)
    lv_dir = np.asarray(lightvec, dtype=np.float64)
    lv_dir = lv_dir / np.linalg.norm(lv_dir)
    fam = pm.skins[skin if 0 <= skin < pm.skins.shape[0] else 0]

    opaque, additive = [], []
    for m, v, n in _posed_geometry(pm, seq, frame, body, controllers):
        for me in m.meshes:
            if len(me.tris) == 0:
                continue
            tex = pm.textures[fam[me.skinref]]
            lv = _engine_light(n, tex.flags, ambient, shade, lv_dir)
            t = me.tris
            pts = v[t[..., 0]]                      # (T, 3, 3)
            fn = np.cross(pts[:, 1] - pts[:, 0], pts[:, 2] - pts[:, 0])
            front = np.einsum("ij,ij->i", fn, cam.pos - pts[:, 0]) > 0
            t, pts = t[front], pts[front]
            entry = (pts, lv[t[..., 1]], t[..., 2:4].astype(np.float64), tex)
            (additive if tex.flags & mdl.STUDIO_NF_ADDITIVE else opaque).append(entry)

    zbuf = zbuf_bg.reshape(-1).copy()
    frame_rgb = img.reshape(-1, 3).copy()

    def fragments(entries):
        for pts, lvc, stc, tex in entries:
            scr = cam.project(pts.reshape(-1, 3)).reshape(-1, 3, 3)
            ok = (scr[..., 2] > 1e-2).all(1)
            scr, lvc_, stc_ = scr[ok], lvc[ok], stc[ok]
            tri, pix, bary, depth = _raster(scr, W, H)
            if len(tri) == 0:
                continue
            st = np.einsum("kc,kcd->kd", bary, stc_[tri])
            sx = np.floor(st[:, 0]).astype(np.int64) % tex.width     # studio textures repeat (GL_REPEAT)
            sy = np.floor(st[:, 1]).astype(np.int64) % tex.height
            idx = tex.pixels[sy, sx]
            light = np.einsum("kc,kc->k", bary, lvc_[tri])
            col = tex.palette[idx].astype(np.float64) * light[:, None]
            keep = np.ones(len(tri), dtype=bool)
            if tex.flags & mdl.STUDIO_NF_MASKED:
                keep = idx != 255
            yield pix[keep], depth[keep], col[keep]

    # opaque: z-buffer resolve, GL_LEQUAL as the engine draws studio meshes (in mesh order, an equal depth is
    # won by the later mesh: e.g. an expression decal drawn over the coincident decal it replaces)
    pix_l, dep_l, col_l = [], [], []
    for pix, dep, col in fragments(opaque):
        pix_l.append(pix)
        dep_l.append(dep)
        col_l.append(col)
    if pix_l:
        pix, dep, col = np.concatenate(pix_l), np.concatenate(dep_l), np.concatenate(col_l)
        seq = np.arange(len(pix))
        vis = dep < zbuf[pix]
        pix, dep, col, seq = pix[vis], dep[vis], col[vis], seq[vis]
        order = np.lexsort((-seq, dep, pix))
        pix, dep, col = pix[order], dep[order], col[order]
        first = np.ones(len(pix), dtype=bool)
        first[1:] = pix[1:] != pix[:-1]
        zbuf[pix[first]] = dep[first]
        frame_rgb[pix[first]] = col[first]
    # additive: depth-tested against opaque, no depth write, summed
    for pix, dep, col in fragments(additive):
        vis = dep < zbuf[pix]
        np.add.at(frame_rgb, pix[vis], col[vis])
    out = np.clip(frame_rgb, 0, 255).reshape(H, W, 3).astype(np.uint8)
    im = Image.fromarray(out, "RGB")
    if ss > 1:
        im = im.resize(size, Image.LANCZOS)
    if label:
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
        d.text((6, 4), label, fill=(225, 225, 230))
    return im


def all_bounds(pm):
    lo = np.min([s["bbmin"] for s in pm.sequences], axis=0)
    hi = np.max([s["bbmax"] for s in pm.sequences], axis=0)
    return lo, hi


def contact_sheet(pm, frames=6, cell=220, skin=0, body=0, yaw=35.0, pitch=15.0, ss=2, seqs=None, viewmodel=False):
    """Grid: one row per sequence, `frames` evenly spaced frames, common framing for all cells (viewmodel: the
    first-person camera of --viewmodel instead of the orbit one)."""
    seq_ids = list(range(len(pm.sequences))) if seqs is None else seqs
    lo, hi = all_bounds(pm)
    label_w = 150
    header = 26
    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (label_w + frames * cell, header + len(seq_ids) * cell), (24, 24, 27))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    ntri = sum(len(me.tris) for bp in pm.bodyparts for m in bp.models[:1] for me in m.meshes)
    size = hi - lo
    d.text((8, 7), f"{pm.name}   {ntri} tris   size {size[0]:.0f} x {size[1]:.0f} x {size[2]:.0f}   skin {skin}",
           fill=(230, 230, 235))
    for row, si in enumerate(seq_ids):
        s = pm.sequences[si]
        nf = s["numframes"]
        loop = bool(s["flags"] & mdl.STUDIO_LOOPING)
        last = (nf - 1) if nf > 1 else 0
        if loop:
            fs = [last * i / frames for i in range(frames)]
        else:
            fs = [last * i / max(frames - 1, 1) for i in range(frames)]
        y = header + row * cell
        d.text((8, y + 8), f"{si} {s['name']}", fill=(240, 240, 240))
        d.text((8, y + 24), f"{nf} fr @ {s['fps']:g} fps", fill=(170, 170, 175))
        d.text((8, y + 38), ("loop" if loop else "once") + f"  act {s['activity']}", fill=(170, 170, 175))
        lm = s["linearmovement"]
        if any(lm):
            d.text((8, y + 52), f"move {lm[0]:.1f},{lm[1]:.1f},{lm[2]:.1f}", fill=(170, 170, 175))
        if s["events"]:
            d.text((8, y + 66), "ev " + ",".join(str(e.frame) for e in s["events"][:6]), fill=(170, 170, 175))
        for col, f in enumerate(fs):
            fr = min(f, nf - 1)
            if viewmodel:
                im = render_frame(pm, si, fr, skin=skin, body=body, size=(cell, cell), ss=ss, eye=(0, 0, 0),
                                  target=(1, 0, 0), fov=90.0, grid=False, label=f"f{fr:.1f}")
            else:
                im = render_frame(pm, si, fr, skin=skin, body=body, yaw=yaw, pitch=pitch, size=(cell, cell), ss=ss,
                                  bounds=(lo, hi), label=f"f{fr:.1f}")
            sheet.paste(im, (label_w + col * cell, y))
    return sheet


def views_sheet(pm, seq=0, frame=0.0, cell=300, skin=0, ss=2, body=0):
    """Reference views of one pose: front, 3/4 front, side, back, 3/4 back, top."""
    lo, hi = all_bounds(pm)
    views = [("front", 0, 8), ("3/4", 35, 15), ("side", 90, 5), ("back", 180, 10), ("3/4 back", 215, 20),
             ("top", 0, 85)]
    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (cell * 3, cell * 2), (24, 24, 27))
    for i, (name, yaw, pitch) in enumerate(views):
        im = render_frame(pm, seq, frame, skin=skin, body=body, yaw=yaw, pitch=pitch, size=(cell, cell), ss=ss,
                          bounds=(lo, hi), label=name)
        sheet.paste(im, ((i % 3) * cell, (i // 3) * cell))
    return sheet


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Render a GoldSrc .mdl to PNG")
    ap.add_argument("mdl")
    ap.add_argument("out")
    ap.add_argument("--seq", default="0")
    ap.add_argument("--frame", type=float, default=0.0)
    ap.add_argument("--skin", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--body", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--yaw", type=float, default=35.0)
    ap.add_argument("--pitch", type=float, default=15.0)
    ap.add_argument("--dist", type=float, default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--size", type=int, default=512)
    ap.add_argument("--ss", type=int, default=2)
    ap.add_argument("--sheet", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--views", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--frames", type=int, default=6)
    ap.add_argument("--cell", type=int, default=220)
    ap.add_argument("--summary", action="store_true", help="print the model summary")
    ap.add_argument("--viewmodel", action="store_true",
                    help="first-person view: camera at the origin looking +x, 4:3, horizontal fov 90 as in game, no grid")
    ap.add_argument("--fov", type=float, default=None)
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    with open(a.mdl, "rb") as f:
        pm = mdl.read(f.read())
    if a.summary:
        print(mdl.summary(pm))
    if a.sheet:
        im = contact_sheet(pm, frames=a.frames, cell=a.cell, skin=a.skin, body=a.body, yaw=a.yaw, pitch=a.pitch,
                           ss=a.ss)
    elif a.views:
        im = views_sheet(pm, skin=a.skin, cell=a.cell if a.cell != 220 else 300, ss=a.ss, body=a.body)
    else:
        seq = int(a.seq) if a.seq.isdigit() else a.seq
        if a.viewmodel:
            im = render_frame(pm, seq, a.frame, skin=a.skin, body=a.body, size=(a.size * 4 // 3, a.size), ss=a.ss,
                              eye=(0, 0, 0), target=(1, 0, 0), fov=a.fov or 90.0, grid=False,
                              label=f"{a.seq} f{a.frame:g} (view model)")
            im.save(a.out, optimize=True)
            print(a.out)
            return
        im = render_frame(pm, seq, a.frame, skin=a.skin, body=a.body, yaw=a.yaw, pitch=a.pitch, dist=a.dist,
                          size=(a.size, a.size), ss=a.ss, label=f"{a.seq} f{a.frame:g}", bounds=all_bounds(pm),
                          fov=a.fov or 38.0)
    im.save(a.out, optimize=True)
    print(a.out)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/goldsrc/assets/rig.py`:

```py
"""Skeletons, poses, inverse kinematics and animation helpers.

Bones are declared by their REST head position in model space (+x forward, +y left, +z up, origin on
the ground).  Rest rotations are identity, so every bone's local axes are the model axes in the rest
pose: rotating bone "head" by y=+20 pitches it nose-down, z=+20 turns it to its left, x=+20 rolls
its left side up (engine euler order, degrees in this module).

    rig = Rig()
    rig.add("root", None, (0, 0, 0))
    rig.add("pelvis", "root", (0, 0, 12))
    rig.add("spine", "pelvis", (0, 0, 16))
    rig.add("head", "spine", (1, 0, 24), tail=(1, 0, 32))
    rig.add("thigh_l", "pelvis", (0, 4, 11)); rig.add("shin_l", "thigh_l", (1, 4, 6)); rig.add("foot_l", "shin_l", (0, 4, 1.5))

    def idle(t):                    # t in [0, 1]
        p = Pose()
        p.rot("spine", y=2 * wave(t))          # breathing
        p.move("pelvis", z=0.3 * wave(t, phase=0.25))
        return p

    seq = make_sequence(rig, "idle", idle, frames=30, fps=15, loop=True, activity=mdl.ACT["IDLE"])
"""
import math

import numpy as np

from . import mdl, xform


class RigBone:
    def __init__(self, name, parent, head, tail):
        self.name = name
        self.parent = parent
        self.head = np.asarray(head, dtype=np.float64)
        self.tail = None if tail is None else np.asarray(tail, dtype=np.float64)


class Rig:
    def __init__(self):
        self.bones = []
        self._index = {}

    def add(self, name, parent, head, tail=None):
        if name in self._index:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate bone {name}")
        if len(name) >= 32:
            raise ValueError("bone names are limited to 31 characters")
        pi = -1 if parent is None else self.index(parent)
        self._index[name] = len(self.bones)
        self.bones.append(RigBone(name, pi, head, tail))
        return name

    def index(self, name):
        if isinstance(name, (int, np.integer)):
            return int(name)
        try:
            return self._index[name]
        except KeyError:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown bone {name!r}") from None

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.bones)

    def names(self):
        return [b.name for b in self.bones]

    def children(self, name):
        i = self.index(name)
        return [b.name for b in self.bones if b.parent == i]

    def head(self, name):
        return self.bones[self.index(name)].head.copy()

    def tail(self, name):
        """Explicit tail, else the mean of the children's heads, else the head itself."""
        b = self.bones[self.index(name)]
        if b.tail is not None:
            return b.tail.copy()
        ch = [c.head for c in self.bones if c.parent == self.index(name)]
        if ch:
            return np.mean(ch, axis=0)
        return b.head.copy()

    def rest_local(self):
        pos = np.zeros((len(self.bones), 3))
        for i, b in enumerate(self.bones):
            pos[i] = b.head - (self.bones[b.parent].head if b.parent >= 0 else 0.0)
        return pos

    def mdl_bones(self):
        pos = self.rest_local()
        return [mdl.Bone(name=b.name, parent=b.parent, pos=tuple(pos[i]), rot=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
                for i, b in enumerate(self.bones)]

    def rest_world(self):
        """Rest matrices: identity rotations translated to the heads."""
        m = np.zeros((len(self.bones), 3, 4))
        m[:, :, :3] = np.eye(3)
        m[:, :, 3] = [b.head for b in self.bones]
        return m

    def local_arrays(self, pose):
        """Pose -> (pos (B, 3), rot radians (B, 3)) local values as stored in sequences."""
        pos = self.rest_local()
        rot = np.zeros((len(self.bones), 3))
        if pose:
            for name, v in pose.items():
                i = self.index(name)
                rot[i] = np.radians(v[:3])
                pos[i] = pos[i] + v[3:]
        return pos, rot

    def world(self, pose=None):
        """World 3x4 matrices of a pose."""
        pos, rot = self.local_arrays(pose)
        return mdl.bone_matrices(self.mdl_bones(), pos, rot)

    def skin_matrices(self, pose=None):
        """world(pose) @ inverse(rest): maps rest model-space points to posed model space."""
        w = self.world(pose)
        out = np.empty_like(w)
        for i, b in enumerate(self.bones):
            out[i, :, :3] = w[i, :, :3]
            out[i, :, 3] = w[i, :, 3] - w[i, :, :3] @ b.head
        return out

    # inverse kinematics -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def solve_two_bone(self, pose, upper, lower, end, target, pole=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), end_world_rot=None):
        """Set rotations of `upper` and `lower` so that `end`'s head reaches `target` (model space).

        pole: model-space direction the middle joint (knee/elbow) bends toward.
        end_world_rot: optional 3x3 world rotation for `end` (e.g. np.eye(3) keeps a foot flat).
        Existing rotations of `upper` / `lower` / `end` in the pose are replaced.
        """
        iu, il, ie = self.index(upper), self.index(lower), self.index(end)
        for n in (upper, lower, end):
            pose.set_rot(n, 0, 0, 0)
        W = self.world(pose)
        parent = self.bones[iu].parent
        Rp = W[parent][:, :3] if parent >= 0 else np.eye(3)
        A = W[iu][:, 3]
        local = self.rest_local()
        off1 = local[il] + pose.get_pos(lower)
        off2 = local[ie] + pose.get_pos(end)
        L1, L2 = np.linalg.norm(off1), np.linalg.norm(off2)
        T = np.asarray(target, dtype=np.float64)
        d = T - A
        D = np.linalg.norm(d)
        D = min(max(D, abs(L1 - L2) + 1e-4), L1 + L2 - 1e-4)
        dn = d / max(np.linalg.norm(d), 1e-9)
        T = A + dn * D
        p = np.asarray(pole, dtype=np.float64)
        p = p - dn * (p @ dn)
        if np.linalg.norm(p) < 1e-6:
            p = np.cross(dn, [0.0, 1.0, 0.0])
        p = p / np.linalg.norm(p)
        cos_a = (L1 * L1 + D * D - L2 * L2) / (2 * L1 * D)
        alpha = math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, cos_a)))
        knee = A + L1 * (math.cos(alpha) * dn + math.sin(alpha) * p)
        R1 = _align(off1, Rp.T @ (knee - A))
        W1 = Rp @ R1
        R2 = _align(off2, W1.T @ (T - knee))
        pose.set_rot(upper, *np.degrees(xform.matrix_euler(R1)))
        pose.set_rot(lower, *np.degrees(xform.matrix_euler(R2)))
        if end_world_rot is not None:
            R3 = (W1 @ R2).T @ np.asarray(end_world_rot, dtype=np.float64)
            pose.set_rot(end, *np.degrees(xform.matrix_euler(R3)))
        return pose

    def aim(self, pose, bone, direction, axis=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0)):
        """Rotate `bone` so that its local `axis` points along model-space `direction`."""
        i = self.index(bone)
        pose.set_rot(bone, 0, 0, 0)
        W = self.world(pose)
        parent = self.bones[i].parent
        Rp = W[parent][:, :3] if parent >= 0 else np.eye(3)
        R = _align(np.asarray(axis, float), Rp.T @ np.asarray(direction, float))
        pose.set_rot(bone, *np.degrees(xform.matrix_euler(R)))
        return pose


def _align(a, b):
    """Minimal rotation matrix taking direction a to direction b."""
    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64)
    b = np.asarray(b, dtype=np.float64)
    a = a / np.linalg.norm(a)
    b = b / np.linalg.norm(b)
    v = np.cross(a, b)
    c = float(a @ b)
    s = np.linalg.norm(v)
    if s < 1e-9:
        if c > 0:
            return np.eye(3)
        perp = np.cross(a, [1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
        if np.linalg.norm(perp) < 1e-6:
            perp = np.cross(a, [0.0, 1.0, 0.0])
        return xform.axis_angle_matrix(perp, 180.0)
    return xform.axis_angle_matrix(v, math.degrees(math.atan2(s, c)))


class Pose(dict):
    """bone name -> np.array([rx, ry, rz (degrees), dx, dy, dz (offset from rest)])."""

    def _get(self, bone):
        if bone not in self:
            self[bone] = np.zeros(6)
        return self[bone]

    def rot(self, bone, x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0):
        """Add euler degrees to a bone's rotation."""
        v = self._get(bone)
        v[0] += x
        v[1] += y
        v[2] += z
        return self

    def set_rot(self, bone, x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0):
        v = self._get(bone)
        v[:3] = (x, y, z)
        return self

    def move(self, bone, x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0):
        """Add an offset (model units, in the parent's frame) to a bone's position."""
        v = self._get(bone)
        v[3] += x
        v[4] += y
        v[5] += z
        return self

    def get_rot(self, bone):
        return self[bone][:3].copy() if bone in self else np.zeros(3)

    def get_pos(self, bone):
        return self[bone][3:].copy() if bone in self else np.zeros(3)

    def copy(self):
        p = Pose()
        for k, v in self.items():
            p[k] = v.copy()
        return p

    def scaled(self, w):
        p = Pose()
        for k, v in self.items():
            p[k] = v * w
        return p

    def __add__(self, other):
        p = self.copy()
        for k, v in other.items():
            p[k] = p[k] + v if k in p else v.copy()
        return p


def blend(a, b, w):
    """Linear blend of two poses (w = 0 -> a, 1 -> b)."""
    keys = sorted(set(a) | set(b))
    p = Pose()
    for k in keys:
        va = a[k] if k in a else np.zeros(6)
        vb = b[k] if k in b else np.zeros(6)
        p[k] = va * (1 - w) + vb * w
    return p


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# easing, waves, keyframes
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def clamp01(x):
    return min(1.0, max(0.0, x))


def smoothstep(x):
    x = clamp01(x)
    return x * x * (3 - 2 * x)


def ease_in(x):
    x = clamp01(x)
    return x * x * x


def ease_out(x):
    x = 1 - clamp01(x)
    return 1 - x * x * x


def ease_in_out(x):
    x = clamp01(x)
    return 4 * x * x * x if x < 0.5 else 1 - (-2 * x + 2) ** 3 / 2


def ease_out_back(x, s=1.70158):
    x = clamp01(x) - 1
    return x * x * ((s + 1) * x + s) + 1


def ease_out_elastic(x):
    x = clamp01(x)
    if x in (0.0, 1.0):
        return x
    return 2 ** (-10 * x) * math.sin((x * 10 - 0.75) * (2 * math.pi / 3)) + 1


def ease_out_bounce(x):
    x = clamp01(x)
    n1, d1 = 7.5625, 2.75
    if x < 1 / d1:
        return n1 * x * x
    if x < 2 / d1:
        x -= 1.5 / d1
        return n1 * x * x + 0.75
    if x < 2.5 / d1:
        x -= 2.25 / d1
        return n1 * x * x + 0.9375
    x -= 2.625 / d1
    return n1 * x * x + 0.984375


def wave(t, freq=1.0, phase=0.0):
    """sin(2 pi (freq t + phase)): loops for integer freq over t in [0, 1]."""
    return math.sin(2 * math.pi * (freq * t + phase))


def window(t, t0, t1, ease=smoothstep):
    """0 before t0, 1 after t1, eased in between."""
    if t1 <= t0:
        return 1.0 if t >= t1 else 0.0
    return ease((t - t0) / (t1 - t0))


def pulse(t, t0, t1, t2, t3, ease=smoothstep):
    """0 -> 1 between t0 and t1, holds, 1 -> 0 between t2 and t3."""
    return window(t, t0, t1, ease) * (1 - window(t, t2, t3, ease))


def keys(t, keyframes, interp="cubic", loop=False, period=1.0):
    """Interpolate keyframes [(time, value), ...] at t.  Values: scalars or sequences.

    interp: "linear", "smooth" (eases in/out at every key), "cubic" (Catmull-Rom), "step".
    loop: wrap t into [0, period) and interpolate the last key back to the first.
    """
    ks = sorted(keyframes, key=lambda k: k[0])
    times = [float(k[0]) for k in ks]
    vals = [np.asarray(k[1], dtype=np.float64) for k in ks]
    scalar = vals[0].ndim == 0
    n = len(ks)
    if n == 1:
        return float(vals[0]) if scalar else vals[0].copy()
    if loop:
        t = t % period
        times_ext = [times[-1] - period] + times + [times[0] + period]
        vals_ext = [vals[-1]] + vals + [vals[0]]
    else:
        if t <= times[0]:
            return float(vals[0]) if scalar else vals[0].copy()
        if t >= times[-1]:
            return float(vals[-1]) if scalar else vals[-1].copy()
        times_ext = [times[0] - (times[1] - times[0])] + times + [times[-1] + (times[-1] - times[-2])]
        vals_ext = [vals[0]] + vals + [vals[-1]]
    i = 1
    while i < len(times_ext) - 2 and times_ext[i + 1] <= t:
        i += 1
    t0, t1 = times_ext[i], times_ext[i + 1]
    u = 0.0 if t1 <= t0 else (t - t0) / (t1 - t0)
    p0, p1, p2, p3 = vals_ext[i - 1], vals_ext[i], vals_ext[i + 1], vals_ext[min(i + 2, len(vals_ext) - 1)]
    if interp == "step":
        r = p1
    elif interp == "linear":
        r = p1 + (p2 - p1) * u
    elif interp == "smooth":
        r = p1 + (p2 - p1) * (u * u * (3 - 2 * u))
    else:
        tm0, tm3 = times_ext[i - 1], times_ext[min(i + 2, len(times_ext) - 1)]
        m1 = (p2 - p0) / max(t1 - tm0, 1e-9) * (t1 - t0)
        m2 = (p3 - p1) / max(tm3 - t0, 1e-9) * (t1 - t0)
        u2, u3 = u * u, u * u * u
        r = (2 * u3 - 3 * u2 + 1) * p1 + (u3 - 2 * u2 + u) * m1 + (-2 * u3 + 3 * u2) * p2 + (u3 - u2) * m2
    return float(r) if scalar else np.asarray(r)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# procedural cycles
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def foot_cycle(t, stride, lift, duty=0.6, phase=0.0):
    """Foot offset (dx forward, dz up) relative to its neutral position for gait phase t in [0, 1).

    Stance (fraction `duty`): planted, slides from +stride/2 to -stride/2 (the body moves over it).
    Swing: travels back to +stride/2 with an eased arc of height `lift`.
    The matching linearmovement per cycle is stride / duty.
    """
    u = (t + phase) % 1.0
    if u < duty:
        s = u / duty
        return stride * (0.5 - s), 0.0
    s = (u - duty) / (1 - duty)
    e = smoothstep(s)
    return stride * (-0.5 + e), lift * math.sin(math.pi * s) ** 0.8


def gait_linear_movement(stride, duty=0.6):
    """Distance covered per gait cycle so that planted feet do not slide."""
    return stride / duty


def walk_legs(rig, pose, t, legs, stride, lift, duty=0.6, phases=None, pole=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0),
              flat_feet=True, foot_pitch=0.0):
    """Drive leg chains with IK along foot_cycle paths.

    legs: [(upper, lower, end), ...]; their rest end positions are the neutral foot positions.
    phases: per-leg phase offsets (default biped [0, 0.5]; quadruped walk e.g. [0, 0.5, 0.25, 0.75]).
    Call it after setting body motion (bob, sway) in the pose, so the IK compensates for it.
    foot_pitch: extra toe-off pitch in degrees applied during swing (0 = keep flat).
    """
    if phases is None:
        phases = [i / len(legs) for i in range(len(legs))]
    for (upper, lower, end), ph in zip(legs, phases):
        dx, dz = foot_cycle(t, stride, lift, duty, ph)
        target = rig.head(end) + np.array([dx, 0.0, dz])
        rot = None
        if flat_feet:
            u = (t + ph) % 1.0
            pitch = 0.0
            if foot_pitch and u >= duty:
                pitch = foot_pitch * math.sin(math.pi * (u - duty) / (1 - duty))
            rot = xform.rot_deg(0, pitch, 0)
        rig.solve_two_bone(pose, upper, lower, end, target, pole=pole, end_world_rot=rot)
    return pose


def chain_wave(t, n, amp, lag=0.12, decay=1.0, freq=1.0, phase=0.0):
    """Angles for an n-bone chain (tail, ears, antenna): a travelling wave delayed along the chain.
    Loops over t in [0, 1] for integer freq.  Bone i gets amp * decay**i * sin(2 pi (freq t - i lag))."""
    return [amp * decay ** i * math.sin(2 * math.pi * (freq * t + phase - i * lag)) for i in range(n)]


def spring_follow(signal, fps, freq=3.0, damping=0.5, loop=False):
    """Damped-spring follower of a sampled signal (F,) or (F, k): secondary motion with lag/overshoot.
    loop=True runs two passes so that the result is periodic."""
    x = np.asarray(signal, dtype=np.float64)
    shape = x.shape
    x = x.reshape(len(x), -1)
    dt = 1.0 / fps
    w = 2 * math.pi * freq
    y = x[0].copy()
    v = np.zeros_like(y)
    out = np.zeros_like(x)
    passes = 2 if loop else 1
    for p in range(passes):
        for i in range(len(x)):
            for _ in range(4):  # substeps for stability
                a = w * w * (x[i] - y) - 2 * damping * w * v
                v += a * dt / 4
                y += v * dt / 4
            out[i] = y
    return out.reshape(shape)


def breathe(t, amp=1.0, freq=1.0):
    """Smooth breathing curve in [-amp, amp] (slower exhale)."""
    u = (freq * t) % 1.0
    return amp * math.sin(2 * math.pi * (u + 0.08 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * u)))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sequence assembly
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def make_sequence(rig, name, pose_fn, frames, fps, loop=False, activity=0, actweight=1, linear=None,
                  events=(), flags=0, motiontype=None):
    """Sample pose_fn(t) into an mdl.Sequence.

    loop=True: `frames` distinct frames; t = i / frames, plus a final frame equal to the first
    (numframes = frames + 1, the engine loops over numframes - 1 intervals).
    loop=False: numframes = frames, t = i / (frames - 1) from 0 to 1 inclusive.
    linear: distance covered per cycle along x (float) or a 3-vector -> linearmovement, STUDIO_LX.
    events: [(frame, event, options), ...] or mdl.Event objects.
    """
    nb = len(rig)
    if loop:
        ts = [i / frames for i in range(frames)]
    else:
        ts = [i / max(frames - 1, 1) for i in range(frames)]
    P = np.zeros((len(ts) + (1 if loop else 0), nb, 3))
    R = np.zeros_like(P)
    for i, t in enumerate(ts):
        P[i], R[i] = rig.local_arrays(pose_fn(t))
    if loop:
        P[-1], R[-1] = P[0], R[0]
    lm = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    mt = 0
    if linear is not None:
        lm = (float(linear), 0.0, 0.0) if np.isscalar(linear) else tuple(float(x) for x in linear)
        mt = _linear_flags(lm)
    if motiontype is not None:
        mt = motiontype
    evs = []
    for e in events:
        if isinstance(e, mdl.Event):
            evs.append(e)
        else:
            evs.append(mdl.Event(frame=int(e[0]), event=int(e[1]), options=str(e[2]) if len(e) > 2 else ""))
    return mdl.Sequence(name=name, pos=P, rot=R, fps=float(fps),
                        flags=(mdl.STUDIO_LOOPING if loop else 0) | flags, activity=activity,
                        actweight=actweight if activity else 0, events=evs, motiontype=mt, linearmovement=lm)


def _linear_flags(lm):
    f = 0
    if lm[0]:
        f |= mdl.STUDIO_LX
    if lm[1]:
        f |= mdl.STUDIO_LY
    if lm[2]:
        f |= mdl.STUDIO_LZ
    return f

```

`tools/goldsrc/assets/sdf.py`:

```py
"""Signed distance fields for modelling: primitives, smooth booleans and domain transforms.

An SDF is a callable on points (N, 3) -> distances (N,), negative inside, carrying a conservative
axis-aligned bounding box (lo, hi) used by the mesher.  Units are GoldSrc units (~1 inch);
+x forward, +y left, +z up.

    body = ellipsoid((0, 0, 14), (9, 8, 11))
    head = sphere((2, 0, 27), 8).smooth_union(body, 3)
    ear = rounded_cone((0, 4, 33), (0, 9, 44), 2.2, 0.6)
    shape = head | ear.mirror_y()            # union (| is a hard union, see smooth_union)
    shape = shape - sphere((9, 0, 27), 1.5)  # subtract

Combinators: union(a, b, ..., k=0), subtract(a, b, k=0), intersect(a, b, k=0), and the operators
a | b, a & b, a - b.  k > 0 blends smoothly over about k units.
Transforms: .translate(v), .rotate(x=, y=, z=) (degrees, engine euler order), .rotate_axis(axis, deg),
.scale(s) (uniform), .stretch((sx, sy, sz)) (approximate), .mirror_y() (symmetric copy across y=0),
.mirror(axis), .round(r), .shell(t), .displace(fn, amplitude), .twist(deg_per_unit, axis),
.bend(deg_per_unit, ...).
"""
import math

import numpy as np

from . import xform


class SDF:
    def __init__(self, f, lo, hi):
        self.f = f
        self.lo = np.asarray(lo, dtype=np.float64)
        self.hi = np.asarray(hi, dtype=np.float64)

    def __call__(self, p):
        p = np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float64)
        if p.ndim == 1:
            return self.f(p[None])[0]
        return self.f(p)

    # booleans -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def __or__(self, other):
        return union(self, other)

    def __and__(self, other):
        return intersect(self, other)

    def __sub__(self, other):
        return subtract(self, other)

    def smooth_union(self, other, k):
        return union(self, other, k=k)

    def smooth_subtract(self, other, k):
        return subtract(self, other, k=k)

    def smooth_intersect(self, other, k):
        return intersect(self, other, k=k)

    # transforms ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def translate(self, v):
        v = np.asarray(v, dtype=np.float64)
        f = self.f
        return SDF(lambda p: f(p - v), self.lo + v, self.hi + v)

    def rotate(self, x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0, center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)):
        """Rotate by engine euler angles in degrees about `center`."""
        return self.transform(xform.rot_deg(x, y, z), center)

    def rotate_axis(self, axis, deg, center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)):
        return self.transform(xform.axis_angle_matrix(axis, deg), center)

    def transform(self, R, center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)):
        """Apply rotation matrix R about center (shape point x maps to R (x - c) + c)."""
        R = np.asarray(R, dtype=np.float64)
        c = np.asarray(center, dtype=np.float64)
        f = self.f
        corners = _corners(self.lo, self.hi)
        moved = (corners - c) @ R.T + c
        return SDF(lambda p: f((p - c) @ R + c), moved.min(0), moved.max(0))

    def scale(self, s, center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)):
        c = np.asarray(center, dtype=np.float64)
        f = self.f
        lo, hi = (self.lo - c) * s + c, (self.hi - c) * s + c
        return SDF(lambda p: f((p - c) / s + c) * s, np.minimum(lo, hi), np.maximum(lo, hi))

    def stretch(self, factors, center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)):
        """Non-uniform scale (distance is approximate: scaled by the smallest factor)."""
        fa = np.asarray(factors, dtype=np.float64)
        c = np.asarray(center, dtype=np.float64)
        f = self.f
        m = float(np.min(np.abs(fa)))
        lo, hi = (self.lo - c) * fa + c, (self.hi - c) * fa + c
        return SDF(lambda p: f((p - c) / fa + c) * m, np.minimum(lo, hi), np.maximum(lo, hi))

    def mirror(self, axis=1, keep_original=True):
        """Symmetric copy across the plane axis = 0 (|p[axis]| folding), the usual left/right mirror."""
        f = self.f

        def g(p):
            if keep_original:
                return np.minimum(f(p), f(_flip(p, axis)))
            q = p.copy()
            q[:, axis] = np.abs(q[:, axis])
            return f(q)

        lo, hi = self.lo.copy(), self.hi.copy()
        m = max(abs(lo[axis]), abs(hi[axis]))
        lo2, hi2 = lo.copy(), hi.copy()
        lo2[axis], hi2[axis] = -hi[axis], -lo[axis]
        return SDF(g, np.minimum(lo, lo2), np.maximum(hi, hi2))

    def mirror_y(self):
        return self.mirror(1)

    def flip(self, axis=1):
        """Mirror image only (p[axis] -> -p[axis])."""
        f = self.f
        lo, hi = self.lo.copy(), self.hi.copy()
        lo[axis], hi[axis] = -self.hi[axis], -self.lo[axis]
        return SDF(lambda p: f(_flip(p, axis)), lo, hi)

    def round(self, r):
        f = self.f
        return SDF(lambda p: f(p) - r, self.lo - r, self.hi + r)

    def shell(self, t):
        f = self.f
        return SDF(lambda p: np.abs(f(p)) - t, self.lo - t, self.hi + t)

    def displace(self, fn, amplitude):
        """Add fn(p) (bounded by |amplitude|) to the distance: bumps, scales, ridges."""
        f = self.f
        a = abs(float(amplitude))
        return SDF(lambda p: f(p) + fn(p), self.lo - a, self.hi + a)

    def twist(self, deg_per_unit, axis=2, center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)):
        f = self.f
        c = np.asarray(center, dtype=np.float64)
        ax = axis

        def g(p):
            q = p - c
            ang = np.radians(deg_per_unit) * q[:, ax]
            i, j = [k for k in range(3) if k != ax]
            cs, sn = np.cos(-ang), np.sin(-ang)
            r = q.copy()
            r[:, i] = cs * q[:, i] - sn * q[:, j]
            r[:, j] = sn * q[:, i] + cs * q[:, j]
            return f(r + c) * 0.9

        rad = np.max(np.abs(np.concatenate([self.lo - c, self.hi - c])))
        lo, hi = self.lo.copy(), self.hi.copy()
        for k in range(3):
            if k != ax:
                lo[k], hi[k] = c[k] - rad, c[k] + rad
        return SDF(g, lo, hi)

    def bend(self, deg_per_unit, along=0, toward=2, center=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), margin=None):
        """Bend the shape: points at distance d along `along` are rotated by d * deg_per_unit in the
        (along, toward) plane about `center` (approximate distance)."""
        f = self.f
        c = np.asarray(center, dtype=np.float64)

        def g(p):
            q = p - c
            ang = -np.radians(deg_per_unit) * q[:, along]
            cs, sn = np.cos(ang), np.sin(ang)
            r = q.copy()
            r[:, along] = cs * q[:, along] - sn * q[:, toward]
            r[:, toward] = sn * q[:, along] + cs * q[:, toward]
            return f(r + c) * 0.8

        ext = np.max(np.abs(np.concatenate([self.lo - c, self.hi - c])))
        m = ext if margin is None else margin
        return SDF(g, np.minimum(self.lo, c - m), np.maximum(self.hi, c + m))

    def with_bounds(self, lo, hi):
        return SDF(self.f, lo, hi)

    def gradient(self, p, eps=1e-3):
        """Numerical gradient (N, 3)."""
        p = np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float64)
        g = np.empty_like(p)
        for k in range(3):
            d = np.zeros(3)
            d[k] = eps
            g[:, k] = (self.f(p + d) - self.f(p - d)) / (2 * eps)
        return g

    def normal(self, p, eps=1e-3):
        g = self.gradient(p, eps)
        n = np.linalg.norm(g, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        return g / np.maximum(n, 1e-12)


def _flip(p, axis):
    q = p.copy()
    q[:, axis] = -q[:, axis]
    return q


def _corners(lo, hi):
    return np.array([[x, y, z] for x in (lo[0], hi[0]) for y in (lo[1], hi[1]) for z in (lo[2], hi[2])])


def _length(v):
    return np.sqrt(np.sum(v * v, axis=-1))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# primitives
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def sphere(center, r):
    c = np.asarray(center, dtype=np.float64)
    return SDF(lambda p: _length(p - c) - r, c - r, c + r)


def ellipsoid(center, radii):
    """Ellipsoid with semi-axes radii (approximate but well-behaved distance)."""
    c = np.asarray(center, dtype=np.float64)
    r = np.asarray(radii, dtype=np.float64)

    def f(p):
        q = p - c
        k0 = _length(q / r)
        k1 = _length(q / (r * r))
        return np.where(k1 > 1e-12, k0 * (k0 - 1.0) / np.maximum(k1, 1e-12), -np.min(r))

    return SDF(f, c - r, c + r)


def capsule(a, b, r):
    return rounded_cone(a, b, r, r)


def rounded_cone(a, b, ra, rb):
    """Exact distance to the convex hull of sphere(a, ra) and sphere(b, rb)."""
    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64)
    b = np.asarray(b, dtype=np.float64)
    ba = b - a
    l2 = float(ba @ ba)
    if l2 < 1e-12:
        return sphere(a, max(ra, rb))
    rr = ra - rb
    a2 = l2 - rr * rr
    if a2 <= 1e-9:  # one sphere contains the other
        return sphere(a, ra) if ra >= rb else sphere(b, rb)
    il2 = 1.0 / l2

    def f(p):
        pa = p - a
        y = pa @ ba
        z = y - l2
        xv = pa * l2 - np.outer(y, ba)
        x2 = np.sum(xv * xv, axis=1)
        y2 = y * y * l2
        z2 = z * z * l2
        k = math.copysign(1.0, rr) * rr * rr * x2
        out = np.empty(len(p))
        m1 = (np.sign(z) * a2 * z2) > k
        m2 = (~m1) & ((np.sign(y) * a2 * y2) < k)
        m3 = ~(m1 | m2)
        out[m1] = np.sqrt(x2[m1] + z2[m1]) * il2 - rb
        out[m2] = np.sqrt(x2[m2] + y2[m2]) * il2 - ra
        out[m3] = (np.sqrt(x2[m3] * a2 * il2) + y[m3] * rr) * il2 - ra
        return out

    lo = np.minimum(a - ra, b - rb)
    hi = np.maximum(a + ra, b + rb)
    return SDF(f, lo, hi)


def rounded_box(center, half, radius=0.0, rotation=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)):
    """Box of half-extents `half` with rounded edges (radius inside the half extents)."""
    c = np.asarray(center, dtype=np.float64)
    h = np.asarray(half, dtype=np.float64) - radius

    def f(p):
        q = np.abs(p) - h
        return _length(np.maximum(q, 0.0)) + np.minimum(np.max(q, axis=1), 0.0) - radius

    s = SDF(f, -(h + radius), h + radius)
    if any(rotation):
        s = s.rotate(*rotation)
    return s.translate(c)


def torus(center, major, minor, axis=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)):
    """Torus around `axis` through `center`."""
    c = np.asarray(center, dtype=np.float64)
    ax = np.asarray(axis, dtype=np.float64)
    ax = ax / np.linalg.norm(ax)

    def f(p):
        q = p - c
        h = q @ ax
        radial = _length(q - np.outer(h, ax))
        return np.sqrt((radial - major) ** 2 + h * h) - minor

    e = major + minor
    return SDF(f, c - e, c + e)


def cylinder(a, b, r, round_r=0.0):
    """Capped cylinder between points a and b (optionally rounded edges)."""
    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64)
    b = np.asarray(b, dtype=np.float64)
    ba = b - a
    L = float(np.linalg.norm(ba))
    ax = ba / L
    mid = (a + b) / 2
    rr = r - round_r
    hh = L / 2 - round_r

    def f(p):
        q = p - mid
        h = q @ ax
        radial = _length(q - np.outer(h, ax))
        d = np.stack([radial - rr, np.abs(h) - hh], axis=1)
        return np.minimum(np.max(d, axis=1), 0.0) + _length(np.maximum(d, 0.0)) - round_r

    e = r + L / 2
    return SDF(f, mid - e, mid + e)


def halfspace(point, normal, extent=200.0):
    """Everything behind the plane (normal points outside). Use with intersect / subtract."""
    p0 = np.asarray(point, dtype=np.float64)
    n = np.asarray(normal, dtype=np.float64)
    n = n / np.linalg.norm(n)
    return SDF(lambda p: (p - p0) @ n, p0 - extent, p0 + extent)


def tube(points, radii):
    """Smooth chain of rounded cones through points with per-point radii (tails, necks, horns)."""
    parts = [rounded_cone(points[i], points[i + 1], radii[i], radii[i + 1]) for i in range(len(points) - 1)]
    return union(*parts)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# booleans
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _smin(a, b, k):
    if k <= 0:
        return np.minimum(a, b)
    h = np.clip(0.5 + 0.5 * (b - a) / k, 0.0, 1.0)
    return b * (1 - h) + a * h - k * h * (1 - h)


def _smax(a, b, k):
    return -_smin(-a, -b, k)


def union(*sdfs, k=0.0):
    sdfs = [s for s in sdfs if s is not None]
    if len(sdfs) == 1:
        return sdfs[0]
    fs = [s.f for s in sdfs]

    def f(p):
        d = fs[0](p)
        for g in fs[1:]:
            d = _smin(d, g(p), k)
        return d

    lo = np.min([s.lo for s in sdfs], axis=0) - k * 0.25
    hi = np.max([s.hi for s in sdfs], axis=0) + k * 0.25
    return SDF(f, lo, hi)


def subtract(a, b, k=0.0):
    fa, fb = a.f, b.f
    return SDF(lambda p: _smax(fa(p), -fb(p), k), a.lo, a.hi)


def intersect(a, b, k=0.0):
    fa, fb = a.f, b.f
    return SDF(lambda p: _smax(fa(p), fb(p), k), np.maximum(a.lo, b.lo), np.minimum(a.hi, b.hi))


def blend(a, b, t):
    """Linear morph between two SDFs."""
    fa, fb = a.f, b.f
    return SDF(lambda p: fa(p) * (1 - t) + fb(p) * t, np.minimum(a.lo, b.lo), np.maximum(a.hi, b.hi))

```

`tools/goldsrc/assets/spr.py`:

```py
"""GoldSrc sprite (.spr, "IDSP" version 2) writer and reader.

Layout: dsprite_t header (40 bytes), short palette size (256) + 256 * RGB, then per frame:
int frametype (0 = single), dspriteframe_t {origin x, origin y, width, height}, width * height indices.

    frames, palette = from_rgba([img0, img1], tex_format=ADDITIVE)
    data = write(frames, palette, type=VP_PARALLEL, tex_format=ADDITIVE)
    data = make([img0, img1], tex_format=ADDITIVE)        # same in one call

Images are (H, W, 4) RGBA arrays (float [0, 1] or uint8) or PIL images.
Texture formats: NORMAL (opaque), ADDITIVE (colour added; black = nothing, used by the HUD and
effects), INDEXALPHA (one colour = palette[255], index = opacity: decals / smoke), ALPHTEST (index
255 transparent).
"""
import struct

import numpy as np

from . import texture

IDSP = 0x50534449
VERSION = 2

# orientation types
VP_PARALLEL_UPRIGHT, FACING_UPRIGHT, VP_PARALLEL, ORIENTED, VP_PARALLEL_ORIENTED = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
# texture formats
NORMAL, ADDITIVE, INDEXALPHA, ALPHTEST = 0, 1, 2, 3
# sync types
SYNC, RAND = 0, 1


class SprError(ValueError):
    pass


def write(frames, palette, type=VP_PARALLEL, tex_format=ADDITIVE, origins=None, synctype=SYNC, beamlength=0.0):
    """frames: list of (H, W) uint8 palette indices; palette (256, 3) uint8.
    origins: per-frame (x, y) of the top-left corner relative to the sprite centre
    (default centred: (-W/2, H/2), HL convention with y up)."""
    if not frames:
        raise SprError("a sprite needs at least one frame")
    pal = np.asarray(palette, dtype=np.uint8)
    if pal.shape != (256, 3):
        raise SprError("palette must be (256, 3)")
    W = max(f.shape[1] for f in frames)
    H = max(f.shape[0] for f in frames)
    radius = float(np.sqrt((W / 2.0) ** 2 + (H / 2.0) ** 2))
    out = bytearray(struct.pack("<iiiifiiifi", IDSP, VERSION, type, tex_format, radius, W, H, len(frames),
                                float(beamlength), synctype))
    out += struct.pack("<h", 256) + pal.tobytes()
    for i, f in enumerate(frames):
        f = np.ascontiguousarray(f, dtype=np.uint8)
        h, w = f.shape
        ox, oy = (origins[i] if origins is not None else (-(w // 2), h // 2))
        out += struct.pack("<iiiii", 0, int(ox), int(oy), w, h)
        out += f.tobytes()
    return bytes(out)


def read(data):
    """Parse and validate; returns dict(type, tex_format, width, height, palette, frames=[{origin, pixels}])."""
    d = bytes(data)
    if len(d) < 40 + 2:
        raise SprError("file too short")
    ident, version, typ, fmt, radius, W, H, n, beam, sync = struct.unpack_from("<iiiifiiifi", d, 0)
    if ident != IDSP or version != VERSION:
        raise SprError("not an IDSP v2 sprite")
    if not 0 <= typ <= 4 or not 0 <= fmt <= 3 or n < 1:
        raise SprError(f"bad header type={typ} format={fmt} frames={n}")
    (ncol,) = struct.unpack_from("<h", d, 40)
    if not 1 <= ncol <= 256:
        raise SprError(f"bad palette size {ncol}")
    o = 42
    pal = np.frombuffer(d, np.uint8, ncol * 3, o).reshape(ncol, 3)
    o += ncol * 3
    frames = []
    for i in range(n):
        if o + 20 > len(d):
            raise SprError(f"frame {i} header past the end")
        ft, ox, oy, w, h = struct.unpack_from("<iiiii", d, o)
        if ft != 0:
            raise SprError(f"frame {i}: only single frames are supported (type {ft})")
        if w <= 0 or h <= 0 or w > W or h > H:
            raise SprError(f"frame {i}: bad size {w}x{h} (sprite {W}x{H})")
        o += 20
        if o + w * h > len(d):
            raise SprError(f"frame {i} pixels past the end")
        frames.append({"origin": (ox, oy), "pixels": np.frombuffer(d, np.uint8, w * h, o).reshape(h, w)})
        o += w * h
    if o != len(d):
        raise SprError(f"{len(d) - o} trailing bytes")
    return {"type": typ, "tex_format": fmt, "radius": radius, "width": W, "height": H, "palette": pal,
            "frames": frames, "synctype": sync, "beamlength": beam}


def _as_rgba(img):
    a = np.asarray(img)
    if a.dtype == np.uint8:
        a = a.astype(np.float64) / 255.0
    if a.ndim == 2:
        a = np.stack([a, a, a, np.ones_like(a)], axis=-1)
    if a.shape[-1] == 3:
        a = np.concatenate([a, np.ones(a.shape[:2] + (1,))], axis=-1)
    return a


def from_rgba(images, tex_format=ADDITIVE, colour=None, dither=0.0):
    """Quantise RGBA images to frames sharing one palette.

    ADDITIVE: colour premultiplied by alpha (transparent = black).  NORMAL: alpha ignored.
    ALPHTEST: alpha < 0.5 -> index 255.  INDEXALPHA: index = alpha * 255, palette[255] = colour
    (default: mean colour of opaque texels), palette ramps from black to it."""
    imgs = [_as_rgba(i) for i in images]
    shapes = [i.shape[:2] for i in imgs]
    if tex_format == INDEXALPHA:
        if colour is None:
            allp = np.concatenate([i.reshape(-1, 4) for i in imgs])
            w = allp[:, 3]
            colour = (allp[:, :3] * w[:, None]).sum(0) / max(w.sum(), 1e-9)
        c = texture.rgb(colour) if isinstance(colour, str) else np.asarray(colour, dtype=np.float64)
        pal = np.clip(np.round(np.outer(np.arange(256) / 255.0, c) * 255), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
        pal[255] = np.clip(np.round(c * 255), 0, 255)
        frames = [np.clip(np.round(i[..., 3] * 255), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8) for i in imgs]
        return frames, pal
    # stack all frames vertically to share one palette
    if tex_format == ADDITIVE:
        rgbs = [i[..., :3] * i[..., 3:4] for i in imgs]
    else:
        rgbs = [i[..., :3] for i in imgs]
    Wm = max(s[1] for s in shapes)
    big = np.zeros((sum(s[0] for s in shapes), Wm, 3))
    trans = np.zeros(big.shape[:2], dtype=bool)
    y = 0
    for r, i in zip(rgbs, imgs):
        h, w = r.shape[:2]
        big[y:y + h, :w] = r
        trans[y:y + h, w:] = True
        if tex_format == ALPHTEST:
            trans[y:y + h, :w] = i[..., 3] < 0.5
        y += h
    if tex_format == ALPHTEST:
        idx, pal = texture.quantize(big, 256, transparent=trans, dither=dither)
    else:
        idx, pal = texture.quantize(big, 256, dither=dither)
    frames = []
    y = 0
    for s in shapes:
        frames.append(idx[y:y + s[0], :s[1]].copy())
        y += s[0]
    return frames, pal


def make(images, type=VP_PARALLEL, tex_format=ADDITIVE, origins=None, synctype=SYNC, colour=None, dither=0.0):
    """RGBA images -> sprite bytes."""
    frames, pal = from_rgba(images, tex_format, colour, dither)
    return write(frames, pal, type=type, tex_format=tex_format, origins=origins, synctype=synctype)


def to_rgba(sprite, frame=0):
    """Decoded frame of a parsed sprite as an RGBA uint8 array (for previews)."""
    f = sprite["frames"][frame]["pixels"]
    pal = sprite["palette"]
    rgb = pal[f]
    fmt = sprite["tex_format"]
    if fmt == ADDITIVE:
        a = np.full(f.shape, 255, np.uint8)
    elif fmt == ALPHTEST:
        a = np.where(f == 255, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
    elif fmt == INDEXALPHA:
        rgb = np.broadcast_to(pal[255], f.shape + (3,))
        a = f
    else:
        a = np.full(f.shape, 255, np.uint8)
    return np.dstack([rgb, a]).astype(np.uint8)

```

`tools/goldsrc/assets/test_mdl.py`:

```py
"""Tests of the asset toolchain: python3 -I tools/goldsrc/assets/test_mdl.py

Round-trips a small studio model through the writer and the reader/validator, checks the exact
animation decoding, strips, corruption detection, smooth skinning (bone weights), the glTF reader and
importer on a tiny synthetic glTF, and the kit (rig IK, meshing, sprites, wav, zip).
"""
import math
import os
import struct
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from assets import build as buildmod  # noqa: E402
from assets import builder, gltf, icons, mdl, mesh, official, render, rig as R, sdf, spr, texture, wav, xform  # noqa: E402


def cube_model(bone, center, half, base_uv=(0, 0)):
    """A cube (12 outward-CCW triangles) with one normal per face and simple UVs."""
    c = np.asarray(center, float)
    corners = np.array([[x, y, z] for x in (-1, 1) for y in (-1, 1) for z in (-1, 1)], float) * half + c
    quads = [(0, 1, 3, 2), (4, 6, 7, 5), (0, 4, 5, 1), (2, 3, 7, 6), (0, 2, 6, 4), (1, 5, 7, 3)]
    tris, norms = [], []
    for qi, (a, b, cc, d) in enumerate(quads):
        n = np.cross(corners[b] - corners[a], corners[cc] - corners[a])
        n /= np.linalg.norm(n)
        if n @ (corners[a] - c) < 0:  # make outward
            a, b, cc, d = d, cc, b, a
            n = -n
        norms.append(n)
        u0, v0 = base_uv[0] + qi * 10, base_uv[1]
        uv = {a: (u0, v0), b: (u0 + 8, v0), cc: (u0 + 8, v0 + 8), d: (u0, v0 + 8)}
        for t in ((a, b, cc), (a, cc, d)):
            tris.append([(v, qi, *uv[v]) for v in t])
    return corners, np.array(norms), np.array(tris, dtype=np.int64)


def make_studio():
    bones = [mdl.Bone("root", -1, (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 0)),
             mdl.Bone("body", 0, (0, 0, 10), (0, 0.1, 0)),
             mdl.Bone("head", 1, (1, 0, 8), (0.05, -0.2, 0.3))]
    nb = len(bones)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(5)

    def seq_arrays(nf, amp):
        P = np.tile(np.array([b.pos for b in bones], float), (nf, 1, 1))
        Rr = np.tile(np.array([b.rot for b in bones], float), (nf, 1, 1))
        t = np.linspace(0, 1, nf)
        P[:, 1, 2] += amp * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t)
        Rr[:, 2, 2] += amp * 0.1 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t + 0.3)
        Rr[:, 1, 0] += amp * 0.05 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * t)
        return P, Rr

    P, Rr = seq_arrays(31, 2.0)
    P[-1], Rr[-1] = P[0], Rr[0]
    idle = mdl.Sequence("idle", P, Rr, fps=15, flags=mdl.STUDIO_LOOPING, activity=mdl.ACT["IDLE"], actweight=1)
    # long sequence with constant stretches longer than 255 frames and repeated values
    nf = 600
    P2 = np.tile(np.array([b.pos for b in bones], float), (nf, 1, 1))
    R2 = np.tile(np.array([b.rot for b in bones], float), (nf, 1, 1))
    P2[100:150, 0, 0] = 3.0
    P2[400:, 0, 0] = np.linspace(0, 5, 200)
    R2[:, 2, 1] = np.round(rng.standard_normal(nf) * 3) / 10.0  # many repeats
    longseq = mdl.Sequence("long", P2, R2, fps=30, events=[mdl.Event(10, 5004, 0, "pokemon/x.wav")],
                           linearmovement=(12, 0, 0), motiontype=mdl.STUDIO_LX, activity=mdl.ACT["WALK"],
                           actweight=1)
    still = mdl.Sequence("still", np.array([[b.pos for b in bones]], float), np.array([[b.rot for b in bones]], float))

    tex0 = mdl.Texture("t0.bmp", (np.arange(64 * 64) % 251).astype(np.uint8).reshape(64, 64),
                       np.stack([np.arange(256)] * 3, 1).astype(np.uint8))
    tex1 = mdl.Texture("t1.bmp", np.full((32, 64), 255, np.uint8), np.zeros((256, 3), np.uint8),
                       flags=mdl.STUDIO_NF_MASKED)
    tex2 = mdl.Texture("t0b.bmp", tex0.pixels[::-1].copy(), tex0.palette, flags=mdl.STUDIO_NF_FLATSHADE)
    v1, n1, t1 = cube_model(1, (0, 0, 0), 4.0)
    v2, n2, t2 = cube_model(2, (2, 0, 0), 2.0, base_uv=(0, 10))
    t2_off = t2.copy()
    t2_off[..., 0] += len(v1)
    t2_off[..., 1] += len(n1)
    t2_off[..., 3] = np.minimum(t2_off[..., 3], 32)
    model = mdl.Model("body", np.concatenate([v1, v2]), np.array([1] * 8 + [2] * 8), np.concatenate([n1, n2]),
                      np.array([1] * 6 + [2] * 6),
                      meshes=[mdl.Mesh(t1, skinref=0), mdl.Mesh(t2_off, skinref=1), mdl.Mesh(t1[:4], skinref=1)])
    v3, n3, t3 = cube_model(0, (0, 0, 1), 1.0)
    small = mdl.Model("acc_a", v3, np.zeros(8, int), n3, np.zeros(6, int), meshes=[mdl.Mesh(t3, 0)])
    small_b = mdl.Model("acc_b", v3 * 2, np.zeros(8, int), n3, np.zeros(6, int), meshes=[mdl.Mesh(t3[:6], 0)])
    st = mdl.Studio(
        name="test/test.mdl", bones=bones, sequences=[idle, longseq, still], textures=[tex0, tex1, tex2],
        bodyparts=[mdl.BodyPart("body", [model]), mdl.BodyPart("acc", [small, small_b])],
        skins=[[0, 1], [2, 1]],
        controllers=[mdl.BoneController(bone=2, type=mdl.STUDIO_ZR, start=-45, end=45, index=0, rest=128)],
        attachments=[mdl.Attachment(bone=2, org=(3, 0, 1), name="mouth"), mdl.Attachment(bone=1, org=(0, 2, 0))],
        hitboxes=[mdl.Hitbox(1, (-4, -4, -4), (4, 4, 4), 2), mdl.Hitbox(2, (-2, -2, -2), (2, 2, 2), 1)],
        eyeposition=(0, 0, 20), min=(-8, -8, 0), max=(8, 8, 24), bbmin=(-8, -8, 0), bbmax=(8, 8, 24))
    return st


def tri_key(tris):
    """Multiset of triangles (vert, norm, s, t) per corner, invariant to rotation of the corners."""
    out = []
    for t in np.asarray(tris).tolist():
        c = [tuple(x) for x in t]
        k = min(range(3), key=lambda i: c[i])
        out.append(tuple(c[k:] + c[:k]))
    return sorted(out)


class MdlRoundTrip(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.st = make_studio()
        cls.data = mdl.write(cls.st)
        cls.pm = mdl.read(cls.data)

    def test_deterministic(self):
        self.assertEqual(mdl.write(make_studio()), self.data)

    def test_header(self):
        pm = self.pm
        self.assertEqual(pm.length, len(self.data))
        self.assertEqual(len(self.data) % 4, 0)
        self.assertEqual(pm.name, "test/test.mdl")
        self.assertEqual(pm.errors, [])
        self.assertEqual([b.name for b in pm.bones], ["root", "body", "head"])
        self.assertEqual([b.parent for b in pm.bones], [-1, 0, 1])
        self.assertEqual(pm.bones[2].controller, [-1, -1, -1, -1, -1, 0])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(pm.eyeposition, (0, 0, 20))
        self.assertEqual(pm.skins.tolist(), [[0, 1], [2, 1]])
        self.assertEqual(len(pm.attachments), 2)
        self.assertEqual(pm.attachments[0].name, "mouth")
        self.assertEqual([h.group for h in pm.hitboxes], [2, 1])
        self.assertEqual(pm.seqgroups[0]["label"], "default")
        self.assertEqual(pm.bodyparts[1].base, 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(pm.bodyparts[1].models), 2)

    def test_sequences(self):
        pm = self.pm
        self.assertEqual([s["name"] for s in pm.sequences], ["idle", "long", "still"])
        s = pm.sequences[1]
        self.assertEqual(s["numframes"], 600)
        self.assertEqual(s["activity"], mdl.ACT["WALK"])
        self.assertEqual(s["events"][0].options, "pokemon/x.wav")
        self.assertEqual(s["events"][0].event, 5004)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(s["linearmovement"], (12, 0, 0))
        self.assertTrue(pm.sequences[0]["flags"] & mdl.STUDIO_LOOPING)
        self.assertFalse(pm.sequences[2]["anim_offsets"].any())  # all defaults -> no data

    def test_animation_decoding(self):
        pm = self.pm
        adj = mdl.controller_adj(pm)[0]  # head yaw controller at its rest byte (128)
        for si, seq in enumerate(self.st.sequences):
            P, Rr = seq.pos, seq.rot.copy()
            Rr[:, 2, 2] += adj
            for f in range(seq.numframes):
                pos, q = mdl.calc_rotations(pm, si, float(f))
                for b in range(3):
                    tol_p = pm.bones[b].scale[0:3]
                    np.testing.assert_allclose(pos[b], P[f, b], atol=max(tol_p) + 1e-5)
                    want = xform.euler_matrix(Rr[f, b])
                    got = xform.quaternion_matrix(q[b])
                    self.assertLess(np.abs(want - got).max(), 1e-3, (si, f, b))
        # fractional frame: interpolation between frames 3 and 4 of idle
        pos_a, _ = mdl.calc_rotations(pm, 0, 3.0)
        pos_b, _ = mdl.calc_rotations(pm, 0, 4.0)
        pos_m, _ = mdl.calc_rotations(pm, 0, 3.5)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(pos_m, (pos_a + pos_b) / 2, atol=1e-5)
        # frame past the end wraps to 0 like the engine
        p0, _ = mdl.calc_rotations(pm, 0, 0.0)
        pw, _ = mdl.calc_rotations(pm, 0, 30.5)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(p0, pw)

    def test_controller(self):
        pm = self.pm
        _, q_rest = mdl.calc_rotations(pm, 2, 0.0)
        _, q_max = mdl.calc_rotations(pm, 2, 0.0, controllers=[255, 0, 0, 0])
        m0 = xform.quaternion_matrix(q_rest[2])
        m1 = xform.quaternion_matrix(q_max[2])
        ang = math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1, min(1, (np.trace(m0.T @ m1) - 1) / 2))))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(ang, 45 - (128 / 255 * 90 - 45), delta=0.5)

    def test_geometry(self):
        pm = self.pm
        m_in = self.st.bodyparts[0].models[0]
        m_out = pm.bodyparts[0].models[0]
        np.testing.assert_allclose(m_out.verts, m_in.verts, atol=1e-5)
        self.assertEqual(m_out.vert_bone.tolist(), m_in.vert_bone.tolist())
        self.assertEqual(len(m_out.meshes), 3)
        for me_in, me_out in zip(m_in.meshes, m_out.meshes):
            self.assertEqual(me_out.skinref, me_in.skinref)
            # normal indices were regrouped per mesh: compare through the actual vectors
            a = [(c[0], tuple(np.round(m_in.norms[c[1]], 5)), c[2], c[3]) for t in me_in.tris for c in t]
            b = [(c[0], tuple(np.round(m_out.norms[c[1]], 5)), c[2], c[3]) for t in me_out.tris for c in t]
            ka = sorted(tuple(a[i:i + 3]) for i in range(0, len(a), 3))
            kb = sorted(tuple(b[i:i + 3]) for i in range(0, len(b), 3))
            ra = sorted(min(t[k:] + t[:k] for k in range(3)) for t in ka)
            rb = sorted(min(t[k:] + t[:k] for k in range(3)) for t in kb)
            self.assertEqual(ra, rb)
        self.assertEqual(sum(me.numnorms for me in m_out.meshes), len(m_out.norms))

    def test_on_disk_winding_is_reversed(self):
        # the engine wants the opposite of outward CCW: first strip triangle (v0, v1, v2) must be inward
        m = self.pm.bodyparts[0].models[0]
        kind, vs = m.meshes[0].cmds[0]
        p = m.verts[vs[:3, 0]]
        n = np.cross(p[1] - p[0], p[2] - p[0])
        self.assertLess(n @ (p.mean(0) - np.array([0, 0, 0])), 0)

    def test_textures(self):
        pm = self.pm
        self.assertEqual([t.name for t in pm.textures], ["t0.bmp", "t1.bmp", "t0b.bmp"])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(pm.textures[0].pixels, self.st.textures[0].pixels)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(pm.textures[0].palette, self.st.textures[0].palette)
        self.assertEqual(pm.textures[1].flags, mdl.STUDIO_NF_MASKED)

    def test_validator_catches_corruption(self):
        d = bytearray(self.data)
        with self.assertRaises(mdl.MdlError):
            mdl.read(bytes(d[:-100]))
        bad = bytearray(d)
        struct.pack_into("<i", bad, 144, len(d) + 10)  # boneindex out of the file
        with self.assertRaises(mdl.MdlError):
            mdl.read(bytes(bad))
        # corrupt the first vertex index of the first strip of the first mesh
        bpindex = struct.unpack_from("<i", self.data, 208)[0]
        modelindex = struct.unpack_from("<i", self.data, bpindex + 72)[0]
        meshindex = struct.unpack_from("<i", self.data, modelindex + 76)[0]
        triindex = struct.unpack_from("<i", self.data, meshindex + 4)[0]
        bad = bytearray(d)
        struct.pack_into("<h", bad, triindex + 2, 999)
        with self.assertRaises(mdl.MdlError):
            mdl.read(bytes(bad))
        # overlapping regions are reported
        bad = bytearray(d)
        struct.pack_into("<i", bad, 168, struct.unpack_from("<i", d, 144)[0])  # seqindex = boneindex
        with self.assertRaises(mdl.MdlError):
            mdl.read(bytes(bad))

    def test_writer_rejects_bad_input(self):
        st = make_studio()
        st.bones[1].parent = 2
        with self.assertRaises(mdl.MdlError):
            mdl.write(st)
        st = make_studio()
        st.sequences[0].pos = st.sequences[0].pos[:, :2]
        with self.assertRaises(mdl.MdlError):
            mdl.write(st)

    def test_render(self):
        im = render.render_frame(self.pm, 0, 0.0, size=(96, 96), ss=1)
        a = np.asarray(im)
        self.assertEqual(a.shape, (96, 96, 3))
        self.assertGreater(len(np.unique(a.reshape(-1, 3), axis=0)), 8)


class Encoding(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rle_runs(self):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
        for trial in range(40):
            n = int(rng.integers(1, 700))
            v = np.repeat(rng.integers(-30000, 30000, size=n), rng.integers(1, 40, size=n))[:n]
            if trial % 3 == 0:
                v[:] = 7
            shorts = mdl.rle_encode(v)
            data = struct.pack("<%dh" % len(shorts), *shorts)
            for f in range(n):
                val = mdl._decode_pos_channel(data, 0, f, 0.0)
                self.assertEqual(val, v[f])
                a1, _ = mdl._decode_rot_channel(data, 0, f)
                self.assertEqual(a1, v[f])

    def test_strips(self):
        s = sdf.sphere((0, 0, 0), 5) | sdf.capsule((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 9), 2)
        m = mesh.surface_nets(s, s.lo, s.hi, 0.8)
        tris = [tuple((int(v), 0, 0, 0) for v in f) for f in m.faces]
        strips = mdl.stripify(tris)
        out = []
        for st in strips:
            for k in range(len(st) - 2):
                out.append((st[k], st[k + 1], st[k + 2]) if k % 2 == 0 else (st[k + 1], st[k], st[k + 2]))
        self.assertEqual(tri_key(out), tri_key(tris))
        self.assertLess(len(strips), len(tris) / 2)

    def test_euler_convention(self):
        a = np.radians([10.0, 20.0, 30.0])
        c, s = np.cos, np.sin
        Rx = np.array([[1, 0, 0], [0, c(a[0]), -s(a[0])], [0, s(a[0]), c(a[0])]])
        Ry = np.array([[c(a[1]), 0, s(a[1])], [0, 1, 0], [-s(a[1]), 0, c(a[1])]])
        Rz = np.array([[c(a[2]), -s(a[2]), 0], [s(a[2]), c(a[2]), 0], [0, 0, 1]])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(xform.euler_matrix(a), Rz @ Ry @ Rx, atol=1e-12)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(xform.matrix_euler(Rz @ Ry @ Rx), a, atol=1e-12)


class Kit(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_meshing(self):
        s = sdf.sphere((0, 0, 0), 10)
        m = mesh.mesh_sdf(s, budget=400)
        self.assertLessEqual(len(m.faces), 400)
        self.assertTrue(m.is_closed_manifold())
        self.assertLess(np.abs(s(m.verts)).max(), 0.05)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(m.area() / (4 * np.pi * 100), 1.0, delta=0.05)
        n, ci = m.normals(60)
        cen = m.verts[m.faces].mean(1)
        self.assertGreater(np.mean(np.sum(n[ci[:, 0]] * cen, 1) > 0), 0.99)

    def test_ik(self):
        rig = R.Rig()
        rig.add("root", None, (0, 0, 0))
        rig.add("hip", "root", (0, 3, 12))
        rig.add("knee", "hip", (0.5, 3, 6))
        rig.add("foot", "knee", (0, 3, 1))
        p = R.Pose()
        p.move("root", z=-1.0)
        target = np.array([2.0, 3.0, 2.0])
        rig.solve_two_bone(p, "hip", "knee", "foot", target, pole=(1, 0, 0), end_world_rot=np.eye(3))
        W = rig.world(p)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(W[rig.index("foot")][:, 3], target, atol=1e-6)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(W[rig.index("foot")][:, :3], np.eye(3), atol=1e-6)
        self.assertGreater(W[rig.index("knee")][0, 3], 0.5)  # bends forward

    def test_sequence_and_keys(self):
        rig = R.Rig()
        rig.add("root", None, (0, 0, 0))
        rig.add("b", "root", (0, 0, 5))
        seq = R.make_sequence(rig, "idle", lambda t: R.Pose().rot("b", z=10 * R.wave(t)), 12, 12, loop=True,
                              activity=mdl.ACT["IDLE"])
        self.assertEqual(seq.numframes, 13)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(seq.rot[0], seq.rot[-1])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(R.keys(0.5, [(0, 0.0), (1, 10.0)], "linear"), 5.0)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(R.keys(0.25, [(0, 0.0), (0.5, 10.0)], "cubic", loop=True), 5.0)

    def test_quantize(self):
        img = np.zeros((64, 64, 3))
        img[..., 0] = np.linspace(0, 1, 64)[None, :]
        img[..., 1] = np.linspace(0, 1, 64)[:, None]
        idx, pal = texture.quantize(img, 256)
        err = np.abs(pal[idx].astype(float) / 255 - img).max()
        self.assertLess(err, 0.05)
        tr = np.zeros((64, 64), bool)
        tr[:8] = True
        idx, pal = texture.quantize(img, 256, transparent=tr)
        self.assertTrue((idx[:8] == 255).all() and (idx[8:] != 255).all())

    def test_builder_small(self):
        rig = R.Rig()
        rig.add("root", None, (0, 0, 0))
        rig.add("body", "root", (0, 0, 6))
        b = builder.ModelBuilder("t/blob.mdl", rig, skins=2, verbose=False)
        b.group("main", (64, 64))
        b.add(builder.Part("body", sdf.ellipsoid((0, 0, 6), (4, 3, 6)), bone="body", budget=200,
                           paint=lambda P, N, skin: texture.fill(P, "#ff0000" if skin else "#00ff00")))
        b.add_sequence(R.make_sequence(rig, "idle", lambda t: R.Pose().move("body", z=R.wave(t)), 8, 10, loop=True))
        data = b.write()
        pm = mdl.read(data)
        self.assertEqual(len(pm.textures), 2)
        self.assertEqual(pm.skins.tolist(), [[0], [1]])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(pm.sequences[0]["bbmax"][2], 13.0, delta=0.3)

    def test_sprite_roundtrip(self):
        c = icons.Canvas(40, 30)
        c.circle(20, 15, 10, fill="#ffcc00")
        c.bolt(5, 5, 35, 25, 3, fill="#ffffff")
        for fmt in (spr.ADDITIVE, spr.ALPHTEST, spr.INDEXALPHA, spr.NORMAL):
            data = spr.make([c.rgba(), c.rgba()[::-1].copy()], tex_format=fmt)
            s = spr.read(data)
            self.assertEqual((s["width"], s["height"], len(s["frames"])), (40, 30, 2))
            self.assertEqual(s["tex_format"], fmt)
            spr.to_rgba(s, 1)

    def test_wav(self):
        x = wav.normalize(wav.osc(440, 0.5) * wav.env_adsr(wav._n(0.5)))
        for bits in (8, 16):
            y, rate, b, ch = wav.read(wav.write(x, bits=bits))
            self.assertEqual((rate, b, ch, len(y)), (22050, bits, 1, len(x)))
            self.assertLess(np.abs(y - x).max(), 2.0 / (2 ** bits / 2))
        tone = wav.osc(1000, 0.5)
        out = wav.bandpass(tone, 1000, q=4)
        far = wav.bandpass(tone, 4000, q=4)
        self.assertGreater(np.abs(out[2000:]).max(), 3 * np.abs(far[2000:]).max())
        v = wav.voice(wav.glide(300, 500, 0.3), vowels=[(0, "a"), (0.3, "i")])
        self.assertTrue(np.all(np.isfinite(v)) and len(v) == wav._n(0.3))

    def test_zip_deterministic(self):
        files = {"b/x.txt": b"hello", "a/y.txt": b"world" * 100}
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=os.environ.get("TMPDIR")) as d:
            p1, p2 = os.path.join(d, "1.pk3"), os.path.join(d, "2.pk3")
            buildmod.write_zip(p1, files)
            buildmod.write_zip(p2, dict(reversed(list(files.items()))))
            with open(p1, "rb") as f1, open(p2, "rb") as f2:
                self.assertEqual(f1.read(), f2.read())

# smooth skinning
```
