```mjs
const MOVED = 16;
const lastPos = (page) => page.evaluate(() => portSession.logs.filter((l) => /\borg \(/.test(l)).at(-1)?.match(/org \(([^)]+)\)/)?.[1]);
const heartbeat = setInterval(async () => {
  for (const { page } of clients) try { console.log('PROGRESS', await page.evaluate(() => ({ state: portSession?.state, status: document.querySelector('#status')?.textContent, draws: renderProbe?.draws }))); } catch { /* closing */ }
}, 10000);
try {
  for (let i = 0; i < (mode === 'multiplayer' ? 2 : 1); i++) {
    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 1000 } });
    await context.addInitScript(() => {
      window.renderProbe = { draws: 0, audioContexts: [] };
      for (const type of [window.WebGLRenderingContext, window.WebGL2RenderingContext]) {
        if (!type) continue;
        for (const method of ['drawArrays', 'drawElements']) {
          const original = type.prototype[method];
          type.prototype[method] = function (...a) { window.renderProbe.draws++; return original.apply(this, a); };
        }
      }
      if (window.AudioContext) { const Original = window.AudioContext; window.AudioContext = class extends Original { constructor(...a) { super(...a); window.renderProbe.audioContexts.push(this); } }; }
    });
    nicknames[i] = await signIn(context, i);
    const page = await context.newPage();
    page.on('pageerror', (error) => console.log('PAGE ERROR', error.message));
    page.on('dialog', (dialog) => { console.log('DIALOG', dialog.type(), dialog.message()); dialog.accept().catch(() => {}); });
    page.on('console', (message) => { if (message.type() === 'error') console.log('CONSOLE', message.text().slice(0, 300)); });
    clients.push({ context, page });
    if (i === 0) { // (the first player arrives from the home, as a visitor does)
      await page.goto(`${base}/?menu`);
      await page.locator(`[data-name="${manifest.gameId}"] .hm-play`).click();
      await page.waitForURL((u) => u.pathname === `/ports/goldsrc/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/`);
      console.log('HOME', 'the card opened', page.url());
      await page.goto(pageUrl);
    } else await page.goto(pageUrl);
    // (the game starts by itself: the account's saves, the engine, the files)
    await page.waitForFunction(() => ['running', 'error'].includes(window.portSession?.state), null, { timeout: bootTimeout });
    if (await page.evaluate(() => portSession.state) === 'running') { await page.waitForTimeout(3000); await enter(page); }
    const state = await page.evaluate(() => ({ state: portSession.state, status: document.querySelector('#status').textContent, draws: renderProbe.draws, multiplayer: portSession.multiplayer }));
    console.log('BOOT', i, JSON.stringify({ ...state, renderer: await rendererOf(page) }));
    if (state.state !== 'running') throw new Error(state.status);
    await page.waitForFunction(() => renderProbe.draws > 50, null, { timeout: 30000 });
    // (in the game first: a page connects in seconds but may take half a minute more to enter on a loaded machine —
    // its files, a few frames a second —, and a key pressed before the server's team menu opens is lost, the player
    // never in a team: Counter-Strike then ignores its `kill`, its score stays 0)
    if (mode === 'multiplayer' || args.includes('--no-save')) {
      const entered = await page.waitForFunction(`(${signedOn})(portSession.logs)`, null, { timeout: bootTimeout, polling: 500 }).then(() => true, () => false);
      if (!entered) throw new Error(`Player ${i + 1} did not enter the game within ${bootTimeout / 1000} s (no "client connected at" line)`);
    }
    await page.waitForTimeout(7000);
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(root, `client-${i}.png`) });
    // (each player joins as soon as it is in, before the next one starts: one browser's renderer is shared by them)
    if (keys && (mode === 'multiplayer' || args.includes('--no-save'))) {
      await focusGame(page);
      for (const k of keys.split(',')) { await page.keyboard.press(k.replace('{n}', String(i + 1))); await page.waitForTimeout(1000); }
    }
  }
  if (mode === 'multiplayer' || args.includes('--no-save')) {
    await clients[0].page.waitForTimeout(8000); // (a round may freeze players at its start)
    for (const { page } of clients) {
      await page.evaluate(() => portSession.command('status'));
      // (a status line holds the name, followed by the address on a listen server)
      await page.waitForFunction((names) => names.every((n) => portSession.logs.some((l) => l.includes(n))), nicknames.slice(0, clients.length).filter(Boolean), { timeout: 20000 });
    }
    for (const { page } of clients) {
      await page.evaluate(() => portSession.command('viewpos')); await page.waitForTimeout(100);
      const before = await lastPos(page);
      await focusGame(page);
      let after = before;
      for (const key of ['w', 'd', 's', 'a']) {
        await page.keyboard.down(key); await page.waitForTimeout(1000); await page.keyboard.up(key);
        await page.evaluate(() => portSession.command('viewpos')); await page.waitForTimeout(100);
        after = await lastPos(page);
        if (distance(before, after) >= MOVED) break;
      }
      // (a walk, not a spectator's drift: a player outside the game — a team never joined, --join-keys — floats a unit)
      if (!(distance(before, after) >= MOVED)) throw new Error(`Movement did not update the player position: ${JSON.stringify({ before, after })} (a team menu still open? --join-keys)`);
      console.log('MOVEMENT', JSON.stringify({ before, after, distance: Math.round(distance(before, after)) }));
    }
    if (arg('--min-players')) {
      // (the players status lists: a line per client after its header, bots included — status-lines.mjs)
      const page = clients[0].page;
      await page.evaluate(() => portSession.command('status')); await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
      const players = lastStatus(await page.evaluate(() => portSession.logs)).length;
      if (players < Number(arg('--min-players'))) throw new Error(`${players} players, fewer than ${arg('--min-players')}`);
      console.log('PLAYERS', players);
    }
  } else {
    const page = clients[0].page, saves = `/rwdir/${manifest.goldsrc.gameDir}/save`;
    await focusGame(page); await page.keyboard.down('w'); await page.waitForTimeout(1000); await page.keyboard.up('w');
    await page.evaluate(() => { portSession.command('save orthros_qa'); portSession.command('host_writeconfig'); });
    const listSaves = (dir) => { const FS = portSession.engine.em.FS; try { return FS.readdir(dir).filter((f) => f.startsWith('orthros_qa')).sort().map((f) => ({ f, size: FS.stat(dir + '/' + f).size })); } catch { return []; } };
    await page.waitForFunction((dir) => { try { return portSession.engine.em.FS.readdir(dir).some((f) => f.startsWith('orthros_qa')); } catch { return false; } }, saves, { timeout: 15000 });
    await page.evaluate(() => portSession.save());
    await page.evaluate(() => portSession.command('load orthros_qa')); await page.waitForTimeout(5000);
    if (args.includes('--reload')) {
      const saved = await page.evaluate(listSaves, saves);
      await page.evaluate(() => document.exitPointerLock());
      // (the header's back to the games: it saves — here and on the account — and quits, once the player confirmed)
      await page.click('#tbGames'); await page.locator('#ask button.primary').click();
      await page.waitForURL((url) => url.pathname === '/' && url.searchParams.has('menu'), { timeout: 60000 });
      const cloud = nicknames[0] ? await page.evaluate((game) => fetch(`/api/cloud/${encodeURIComponent(game)}/history`).then((r) => r.json()), name) : null;
      console.log('ACCOUNT COPY', JSON.stringify(cloud?.versions?.slice(0, 3) ?? null));
      // (signed in: started again in a new browser context — another device, nothing kept but the account; else here)
      let again = page;
      if (nicknames[0]) {
        const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 1000 } }); clients.push({ context, page: null });
        await context.addInitScript(() => { window.renderProbe = { draws: 0, audioContexts: [] }; for (const type of [window.WebGLRenderingContext, window.WebGL2RenderingContext]) { if (!type) continue; for (const method of ['drawArrays', 'drawElements']) { const original = type.prototype[method]; type.prototype[method] = function (...a) { window.renderProbe.draws++; return original.apply(this, a); }; } } if (window.AudioContext) { const Original = window.AudioContext; window.AudioContext = class extends Original { constructor(...a) { super(...a); window.renderProbe.audioContexts.push(this); } }; } });
        await signIn(context, 0, false); // (signed in again, the account's copy kept: it is what this device must find)
        again = await context.newPage(); clients.splice(0, clients.length, { context, page: again });
      }
      await again.goto(pageUrl);
      await again.waitForFunction(() => ['running', 'error'].includes(portSession?.state), null, { timeout: bootTimeout });
      const state = await again.evaluate(() => ({ state: portSession.state, status: document.querySelector('#status').textContent }));
      if (state.state !== 'running') throw new Error(state.status);
      await again.waitForTimeout(3000); await enter(again);
      await again.waitForFunction(() => renderProbe.draws > 50, null, { timeout: 30000 });
      const restored = await again.evaluate(listSaves, saves);
      if (JSON.stringify(restored) !== JSON.stringify(saved)) throw new Error('Saved files changed across quit and relaunch' + (nicknames[0] ? ' on another device' : '') + `: ${JSON.stringify({ saved, restored })}`);
      await again.evaluate(() => portSession.command('load orthros_qa')); await again.waitForTimeout(5000);
      console.log('PERSISTENCE', JSON.stringify({ saved, restored, otherDevice: !!nicknames[0] }));
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < clients.length; i++) {
    const page = clients[i].page;
    const evidence = await page.evaluate(() => ({ state: portSession.state, logs: portSession.logs.slice(-100), draws: renderProbe.draws, audio: renderProbe.audioContexts.map((c) => c.state), saveAt: portSession.lastSaveAt ?? null, escapes: window.__orthrosEscape?.sent ?? null }));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, `client-${i}.json`), JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2));
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(root, `client-${i}-final.png`) });
    if (!evidence.audio.includes('running')) throw new Error('Audio did not resume with user interaction');
    console.log('EVIDENCE', i, JSON.stringify({ state: evidence.state, draws: evidence.draws, audio: evidence.audio, escapes: evidence.escapes }));
  }
  if (mode === 'multiplayer') {
    await clients[0].page.evaluate(() => portSession.command('kill')); await clients[0].page.waitForTimeout(3000);
    for (const { page } of clients) {
      await page.evaluate(() => portSession.command('status'));
      // (player one's latest status line: -1, its suicide — "name (1)" too, the name an earlier connection still held)
      let score = null;
      for (const until = Date.now() + 10000; Date.now() < until; await page.waitForTimeout(500)) {
        score = scoreOf(await page.evaluate(() => portSession.logs.slice(-200)), nicknames[0]);
        if (score === -1) break;
      }
      // (0: the server did not count the suicide — Counter-Strike ignores `kill` from a player without a team)
      if (score !== -1) throw new Error(`Player one's score after its death: ${score} (expected -1)`);
    }
    console.log('SYNCHRONIZATION', 'both players received the same score update after player one died');
  }
  console.log('PASSED', name, mode);
} finally {
  clearInterval(heartbeat);
  // (each page's last console lines, whatever the outcome: what a failed step saw)
  for (let i = 0; i < clients.length; i++) {
    try { fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, `client-${i}-end.json`), JSON.stringify(await within(clients[i].page.evaluate(() => portSession.logs.slice(-150)), 10000), null, 1)); await clients[i].page.screenshot({ path: path.join(root, `client-${i}-end.png`), timeout: 10000 }); } catch { /* closed */ }
  }
  // (each page closed as a player's tab is — its pagehide leaves the game's server — before the browser goes)
  for (const { page } of clients) if (page) await within(page.close(), 10000);
  await browser.close();
}
```

`tools/goldsrc/cmake/emscripten-side-modules.cmake`:

```cmake
# Included after each project() of the game modules' build (tools/goldsrc/build-modules.sh): Emscripten builds a SHARED
# library as a side module (-sSIDE_MODULE=1, .wasm) that the engine, the main module, loads with dlopen.
set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY TARGET_SUPPORTS_SHARED_LIBS TRUE)
set(CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX ".wasm")
set(CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_CREATE_C_FLAGS "-sSIDE_MODULE=1")
set(CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_CREATE_CXX_FLAGS "-sSIDE_MODULE=1")
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
add_compile_options(-fPIC)
```

`tools/goldsrc/cmake/hidden-visibility.cmake`:

```cmake
# Included after project(regamedll) of the game modules' build (tools/goldsrc/build-modules.sh): the game server
# exports only what it marks DLLEXPORT. Emscripten's dynamic linker has one symbol table for every module: the client's
# same-named symbols (the weapon and entity code both share) would otherwise bind in place of the server's own.
add_compile_options(-fvisibility=hidden -fvisibility-inlines-hidden)

```

`tools/goldsrc/install-engine.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Install the pinned GoldSrc browser engine release (lock.json "browser") into data/engines/<id>/.

The release is the published Xash3D FWGS WebAssembly package plus the game modules (client/server/menu compiled to
WebAssembly) the lock names, every file checked against its SHA-256. An installed release is never overwritten.
Usage: python3 tools/goldsrc/install-engine.py [--engines-dir <dir>]
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tarfile
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
LOCK = json.loads((HERE / 'lock.json').read_text())['browser']
SCRATCH = Path('/tmp/orthros-scratch/goldsrc-engine')


def digest(file):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with file.open('rb') as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def download(url, target):
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    partial = target.with_suffix(target.suffix + '.partial')
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Orthros'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=90) as response, partial.open('wb') as output:
        shutil.copyfileobj(response, output, 1024 * 1024)
    partial.rename(target)
    return target


def safe_name(name):
    p = PurePosixPath(name)
    if p.is_absolute() or any(part in {'.', '..'} for part in p.parts) or '\\' in name:
        raise ValueError('Unsafe archive member: ' + name)
    return p


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--engines-dir', default=str(ROOT / 'data/engines'))
    release = Path(parser.parse_args().engines_dir) / LOCK['id']
    subprocess.run([str(ROOT / 'tools/disk-check.sh')], check=True)
    if (release / 'release.json').exists():
        print('Engine release already installed; preserving it.')
        return
    if release.exists():
        raise RuntimeError(f'{release} exists without release.json: review it before installing')
    stage = SCRATCH / 'stage'
    shutil.rmtree(SCRATCH, ignore_errors=True)
    stage.mkdir(parents=True)
    artifact = download(LOCK['engineArtifact']['source'], SCRATCH / 'engine.tgz')
    if digest(artifact) != LOCK['engineArtifact']['sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Engine package integrity mismatch')
    with tarfile.open(artifact) as archive:
        for member in archive.getmembers():
            name = str(safe_name(member.name))
            if member.isfile() and name.startswith('package/dist/'):
                target = stage / 'engine' / name.removeprefix('package/dist/')
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with archive.extractfile(member) as source, target.open('wb') as output:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(source, output)
    # The published JS has extensionless (TypeScript-style) relative imports: resolved for direct browser ES modules.
    fixes = []
    for file in sorted((stage / 'engine').rglob('*.js')):
        def resolve(match):
            spec = match.group(2)
            if Path(spec).suffix:
                return match.group(0)
            dest = file.parent / spec
            suffix = '/index.js' if dest.is_dir() else '.js'
            if not Path(str(dest) + suffix).is_file():
                raise ValueError('Unresolved browser import: ' + spec)
            fixes.append(str(file.relative_to(stage)) + ':' + spec + suffix)
            return match.group(1) + spec + suffix + match.group(3)
        file.write_text(re.sub(r"((?:from|import)\s*['\"])(\.{1,2}/[^'\"]+)(['\"])", resolve, file.read_text()))
    for entry in LOCK['files']:
        if 'source' in entry:
            download(entry['source'], stage / entry['path'])
    for entry in LOCK['files']:
        if digest(stage / entry['path']) != entry['sha256']:
            raise ValueError('Integrity mismatch: ' + entry['path'])
    (stage / 'release.json').write_text(json.dumps({**{k: LOCK[k] for k in ('id', 'upstream', 'commit', 'engineArtifact')}, 'browserImportFixes': fixes, 'files': LOCK['files']}, indent=2) + '\n')
    # (each compressible file's brotli 11 beside it: what the server sends a browser that takes it, tools/engine-br.mjs)
    subprocess.run(['node', str(ROOT / 'tools' / 'engine-br.mjs'), str(stage)], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    release.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(stage), str(release))
    shutil.rmtree(SCRATCH, ignore_errors=True)
    print('Installed', release)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

`tools/goldsrc/install-l10n.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Install a GoldSrc game language package into the library (docs/browser-ports.md, "Languages").

A package folder holds one folder per game id (data/games/<id>), each with the language folders the game's version
mounts over its own (goldsrc.languages.<code>.overlays), e.g. <package>/half-life/valve_french/. They are copied into
data/games/<id>/base/ — an existing different file is never replaced. Every `valve_<language>/resource/` folder also
gets the engine menu's own strings in that language (mainui_<language>.txt, from tools/goldsrc/l10n/mainui-<code>.py)
and its banner titles (gfx/shell/head_*.tga, tools/goldsrc/l10n/banners.py).
Usage: python3 -I tools/goldsrc/install-l10n.py <package> [--games-dir data/games] [--apply]"""
import filecmp, os, runpy, shutil, sys, tempfile

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
LANGS = {'french': 'fr'}  # (Steam's folder suffixes, the l10n tables' codes)

def mainui(code):
    table = runpy.run_path(os.path.join(HERE, 'l10n', f'mainui-{code}.py'))['FR' if code == 'fr' else code.upper()]
    rows = '\n'.join(f'"{k}"\t"{v}"' for k, v in table.items())
    return f'"lang"\n{{\n"Language" "{code}"\n"Tokens"\n{{\n{rows}\n}}\n}}\n'

def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if not args: sys.exit(__doc__)
    package, apply = os.path.abspath(args[0]), '--apply' in args
    games = os.path.abspath(args[args.index('--games-dir') + 1]) if '--games-dir' in args else os.path.join(HERE, '../../data/games')
    for game in sorted(os.listdir(package)):
        src = os.path.join(package, game)
        if not os.path.isdir(src) or not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(games, game, 'manifest.json')): continue
        for top in sorted(os.listdir(src)):
            for root, _, files in os.walk(os.path.join(src, top)):
                for f in files:
                    a = os.path.join(root, f); rel = os.path.relpath(a, src); b = os.path.join(games, game, 'base', rel)
                    if os.path.exists(b):
                        if not filecmp.cmp(a, b, shallow=False): sys.exit(f'refusing: {b} exists and differs')
                        continue
                    print(('copy ' if apply else 'plan ') + f'{game}/base/{rel}')
                    if apply: os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(b), exist_ok=True); shutil.copy2(a, b)
            suffix = top.rsplit('_', 1)[-1]
            if top.lower().startswith('valve_') and suffix in LANGS:
                b = os.path.join(games, game, 'base', top, 'resource', f'mainui_{suffix}.txt')
                text = mainui(LANGS[suffix]).encode('utf-8')
                if os.path.exists(b) and open(b, 'rb').read() != text and '--replace-menu' not in args: sys.exit(f'refusing: {b} differs (--replace-menu)')
                print(('write ' if apply else 'plan ') + f'{game}/base/{top}/resource/mainui_{suffix}.txt')
                if apply: os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(b), exist_ok=True); open(b, 'wb').write(text)
                shell = os.path.join(games, game, 'base', top, 'gfx', 'shell')
                print(('write ' if apply else 'plan ') + f'{game}/base/{top}/gfx/shell/head_*.tga')
                if apply:
                    banners = runpy.run_path(os.path.join(HERE, 'l10n', 'banners.py'))
                    os.makedirs(shell, exist_ok=True)
                    for name, title in banners['TITLES'][LANGS[suffix]].items(): banners['banner'](title).save(os.path.join(shell, f'head_{name}.tga'))
    print('done' if apply else 'dry run: --apply to install')

main()

```

`tools/goldsrc/l10n/banners.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The engine menu's banner titles (gfx/shell/head_*.tga: glowing orange words, drawn additively over the menu) in
another language — Orthros' own pictures, in the style of the engine release's English ones (460 x 80, black is
transparent once added). Usage: python3 -I banners.py <out dir> [code]   (code: fr)"""
import os, sys
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter, ImageFont

TITLES = {'fr': {
    'newgame': 'Nouvelle partie', 'config': 'Configuration', 'audio': 'Audio', 'video': 'Vidéo',
    'vidoptions': 'Options vidéo', 'vidmodes': 'Modes vidéo', 'controls': 'Commandes', 'advanced': 'Options avancées',
    'advoptions': 'Options avancées', 'gameopts': 'Options de jeu', 'gamepad': 'Manette', 'creategame': 'Créer une partie',
    'custom': 'Jeu personnalisé', 'customize': 'Personnaliser', 'inetgames': 'Parties Internet', 'lan': 'Réseau local',
    'load': 'Charger', 'save': 'Sauvegarder', 'saveload': 'Charger, sauvegarder', 'multi': 'Multijoueur',
    'touch': 'Tactile', 'touch_buttons': 'Boutons tactiles', 'touch_options': 'Options tactiles',
}}
FONT = '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf'

def banner(text):
    W, H = 460, 80
    size = 40
    while size > 22:
        font = ImageFont.truetype(FONT, size)
        if font.getbbox(text)[2] <= W - 24: break
        size -= 1
    mask = Image.new('L', (W, H), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(mask).text((10, 54), text, font=font, fill=255, anchor='ls')
    glow = mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(6)).point(lambda v: min(255, v * 2.6))
    core = mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(2.8))
    out = Image.new('RGB', (W, H))
    px, g, c = out.load(), glow.load(), core.load()
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            a, b = g[x, y] / 255, c[x, y] / 255
            # (a red-orange halo, an amber core turning pale at its heart)
            r = min(255, int(235 * a + 255 * b)); gg = min(255, int(70 * a + 200 * b)); bb = min(255, int(10 * a + 60 * b * b))
            px[x, y] = (r, gg, bb)
    return out

def main():
    out, code = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'fr'
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
    for name, text in TITLES[code].items():
        banner(text).save(os.path.join(out, f'head_{name}.tga'))
    print(f'{len(TITLES[code])} banners in {out}')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`tools/goldsrc/maps.mjs`:

```mjs
// Map loads of a GoldSrc port (docs/browser-ports.md, "Map loads"): a new browser (nothing kept from an earlier
// session), its page started as a visitor, then each step of --steps run in turn: `map <name>` / `changelevel <name>`
// (a console command, the game's own transition for changelevel) or `wait <seconds>` (time in the map — the background
// loading goes on meanwhile). Each map's load is timed from its command to the moment frames come steadily again
// (the first frame followed by --steady frames each within 250 ms of the previous one); its data waits are the game
// data's (src/vfs/data-client.js stats: the reads that held the engine — count, ms, bytes) between the command and that
// moment; the bytes loaded in the background beside. --net KB/s (and --latency ms, default 40): Chrome's network
// emulation from the start. The page's reports (learned order, telemetry) stay off the server unless --report (a
// session that teaches the server its learned order). --query: added to the page's address (e.g. mapreads=0: the map loads
// not announced — src/ports/goldsrc/bsp-reads.js —, to compare). JSON on the last line; evidence under
// /tmp/orthros-scratch/goldsrc-maps-<manifest>/ (--out: another folder). --proxy <rate>:<rtt> (e.g. 8m:85): the page
// behind the player's-link proxy (tools/net-proxy.mjs) in front of --url instead of Chrome's emulation — HTTP/2 on one
// connection, as the production front (Cloudflare) speaks to Chrome; Chrome trusts the proxy's self-signed key
// (--ignore-certificate-errors-spki-list); its log in the out folder, each load's window of it in the map's line
// (`proxy`: loadWindow — the game's reads, the ahead / want / background bytes) and the run's summary (`proxySummary`).
// --spki <key> (an https --url behind a proxy started elsewhere: its key trusted) or --insecure (any certificate).
// Each map's line also has its BSP's waits (`bspWaits`: count, ms — the engine's reads of the .bsp that waited) and the
// background's bytes by producer during the load (`bgByMB`: wire MB) and the link as measured at its end (`link`: bw,
// rtt, measured — NetLink.snapshot). Start it through the browser slot guard:
//   tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/goldsrc/maps.mjs <manifest> --url http://127.0.0.1:8080
//     --steps "wait 5,map c1a0,wait 30,changelevel c1a0d" [--net 1024] [--latency 40] [--proxy 8m:85] [--spki k | --insecure]
//     [--steady 20] [--report [--no-phases]] [--query q] [--out dir] [--tag t]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { chromeArgs, addProbe, quietReports } from '../port-perf.mjs';
import { startProxy, spkiOf, parseRate, readLog, loadWindow, summarize } from '../net-proxy.mjs';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), arg = (k, d) => (args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : d);
const [name] = args;
if (!name || name.startsWith('--')) { console.error('usage: maps.mjs <manifest> --steps "map c1a0,wait 30,changelevel c1a0d" [--url u] [--net KB/s]'); process.exit(2); }
const origin = arg('--url', 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'), steady = Number(arg('--steady', 20));
const steps = arg('--steps', '').split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
const root = arg('--out', `/tmp/orthros-scratch/goldsrc-maps-${name}`);
const tag = arg('--tag', '');
fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true }); process.env.TMPDIR = root;

// (--proxy: the player's link in front of the origin; its clock starts with it — pt0 — for the loads' windows of its log)
let proxy = null, proxyLog = null, pt0 = 0, spki = arg('--spki');
if (arg('--proxy')) {
  const [rate, rtt = '85'] = arg('--proxy').split(':');
  if (!(parseRate(rate) > 0)) { console.error(`--proxy ${arg('--proxy')}: <rate>:<rtt>, e.g. 8m:85`); process.exit(2); }
  const certs = path.join(root, 'cert'); fs.mkdirSync(certs, { recursive: true });
  proxyLog = path.join(root, `proxy${tag ? `-${tag}` : ''}.jsonl`);
  pt0 = Date.now();
  proxy = await startProxy({ upstream: origin, rate: parseRate(rate), rtt: Number(rtt), log: proxyLog, certs });
  spki = spkiOf(certs);
}
const base = proxy ? `https://127.0.0.1:${proxy.port}` : origin;
const tls = spki ? [`--ignore-certificate-errors-spki-list=${spki}`] : args.includes('--insecure') ? ['--ignore-certificate-errors'] : [];
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, args: [...chromeArgs('discard'), ...tls] });
const out = { name, net: arg('--net') ? Number(arg('--net')) : null, latency: arg('--net') ? Number(arg('--latency', 40)) : null, proxy: arg('--proxy') ?? null, steps, maps: [] };
const windows = [];
try {
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1024, height: 812 } });
  await addProbe(page, { discard: true });
  if (!args.includes('--report')) await quietReports(page);
  // (--report --no-phases: the reports without the session's phases — a server taught by time only, to compare)
  else if (args.includes('--no-phases')) {
    await page.route(/\/api\/prefetch\//, (route) => {
      const r = route.request(); if (r.method() !== 'POST') return route.continue();
      let body = r.postData() ?? ''; try { const o = JSON.parse(body); delete o.phases; body = JSON.stringify(o); } catch { /* as it is */ }
      return route.continue({ postData: body });
    });
  }
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => console.log('PAGE ERROR', e.message));
  page.on('crash', () => console.log('CRASH'));
  if (arg('--net')) {
    const c = await page.context().newCDPSession(page); await c.send('Network.enable');
    await c.send('Network.emulateNetworkConditions', { offline: false, latency: Number(arg('--latency', 40)), downloadThroughput: Number(arg('--net')) * 1024, uploadThroughput: 256 * 1024 });
  }
  // (every frame drawn, its time: the probe's draw count looked at each animation frame)
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    const F = window.__mapFrames = [];
    const look = () => { const P = window.perfProbe; if (P && P.draws !== look.d) { look.d = P.draws; F.push(performance.now()); if (F.length > 20000) F.splice(0, 10000); } requestAnimationFrame(look); };
    requestAnimationFrame(look);
  });
  const t0 = Date.now();
  await page.goto(`${base}/ports/goldsrc/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/${arg('--query') ? '?' + arg('--query').replace(/^\?/, '') : ''}`);
  await page.waitForFunction(() => ['running', 'error'].includes(window.portSession?.state), null, { timeout: 900000 });
  if (await page.evaluate(() => portSession.state) !== 'running') throw new Error(await page.evaluate(() => document.querySelector('#status')?.textContent));
  out.runningMs = Date.now() - t0;
  out.startup = await page.evaluate(() => portSession.startup ?? null);
  // (the BSP waits: the files ending .bsp in the waits by file; bgBy: the worker's last NetLink.snapshot, a second old at most)
  const stats = () => page.evaluate(() => {
    const f = portSession.files, s = f.stats, bsp = [0, 0];
    for (const [p, w] of Object.entries(s.fileWaits ?? {})) if (/\.bsp$/i.test(p)) { bsp[0] += w[0]; bsp[1] += w[1]; }
    return { waits: s.waits, waitMs: s.waitMs, waitBytes: s.waitBytes, syncFetches: s.syncFetches, fetchedBytes: s.fetchedBytes, wants: s.wants, bsp, bgBy: f.net?.bgBy ?? null, link: f.net ? { bw: f.net.bw, rtt: f.net.rtt, measured: f.net.measured } : null, at: performance.now(), date: Date.now() };
  });
  const bgDiff = (a, b) => (b ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(b).map(([k, v]) => [k, +(((v.wire ?? 0) - (a?.[k]?.wire ?? 0)) / 1048576).toFixed(2)]).filter(([, v]) => v)) : null);
  for (const step of steps) {
    const [verb, value] = step.split(/\s+/);
    if (verb === 'wait') { await page.waitForTimeout(Number(value) * 1000); continue; }
    const s0 = await stats();
    await page.evaluate((c) => portSession.command(c), step);
    // (steady: `steady` frames in a row each within 250 ms of the one before; at most 10 minutes)
    // (the load's end: the first frame after a silence of more than 250 ms — the load — that begins a steady run)
    const end = await page.waitForFunction(({ from, steady }) => {
      const after = window.__mapFrames.filter((t) => t > from);
      for (let i = 0; i + steady < after.length; i++) {
        if ((i === 0 ? after[0] - from : after[i] - after[i - 1]) <= 250) continue;
        let ok = true; for (let k = i + 1; k <= i + steady; k++) if (after[k] - after[k - 1] > 250) { ok = false; break; }
        if (ok) return after[i];
      }
      return null;
    }, { from: s0.at, steady }, { timeout: 600000, polling: 250 }).then((h) => h.jsonValue());
    await page.waitForTimeout(1100); // (the worker's next NetLink.snapshot: bgBy up to the load's end)
    const s1 = await stats();
    const loadMs = Math.round(end - s0.at);
    out.maps.push({ step, loadMs, waits: s1.waits - s0.waits, waitMs: Math.round(s1.waitMs - s0.waitMs), waitMB: +((s1.waitBytes - s0.waitBytes) / 1048576).toFixed(1),
      syncFetches: s1.syncFetches - s0.syncFetches, wants: s1.wants - s0.wants, backgroundMB: +((s1.fetchedBytes - s0.fetchedBytes) / 1048576).toFixed(1),
      bspWaits: { count: s1.bsp[0] - s0.bsp[0], ms: Math.round(s1.bsp[1] - s0.bsp[1]) }, bgByMB: bgDiff(s0.bgBy, s1.bgBy), link: s1.link });
    if (proxy) windows.push([out.maps.length - 1, s0.date - pt0, s0.date - pt0 + loadMs]);
    console.log(JSON.stringify(out.maps.at(-1)));
  }
  out.mapLogs = await page.evaluate(() => portSession.logs.filter((l) => /^Map /.test(String(l))).slice(-40));
  await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(root, `end${tag ? `-${tag}` : ''}.png`) });
  out.load = fs.readFileSync('/proc/loadavg', 'utf8').split(' ')[0];
} finally {
  await browser.close();
  // (the proxy's log, closed: each load's window of it, the run's summary)
  if (proxy) {
    await proxy.close();
    const recs = readLog(proxyLog);
    for (const [i, from, to] of windows) out.maps[i].proxy = loadWindow(recs, from, to);
    out.proxySummary = summarize(recs);
  }
}
console.log(JSON.stringify(out));

```

`tools/goldsrc/orthros-goldsrc@.service`:

```service
# The native dedicated servers of a GoldSrc version — its permanent one and the rooms players create (docs/browser-ports.md);
# the instance is the manifest id:
#   install -m 644 tools/goldsrc/orthros-goldsrc@.service /etc/systemd/system/ && systemctl daemon-reload
#   systemctl enable --now orthros-goldsrc@half-life-original-en
[Unit]
Description=Orthros GoldSrc dedicated servers (%i)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/node /srv/orthros/tools/goldsrc/server.mjs %i
WorkingDirectory=/srv/orthros
DynamicUser=yes
StateDirectory=orthros-goldsrc/%i
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
NoNewPrivileges=yes
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
# (the permanent server and up to 8 rooms, ~150 MB and a few threads each)
TasksMax=192
CPUQuota=300%
MemoryMax=1600M
# (a room the kernel kills for memory goes alone: the other servers stay)
OOMPolicy=continue

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

```

```patch
new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+/*
+*	Half Strike r12: English and French. The mod's client registers ars_lang (en, the default, or fr — the page sets it
+*	from the language the player chose) in the user info: the mod's own messages to a player follow that player's
+*	language (Counter-Strike's own, the game's titles.txt ones, are the game's). Bots and other clients: English.
+*/
+
+#pragma once
+
+// whether the player reads French (ars_lang fr in its user info)
+inline bool ARS_French(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	if (!pPlayer || !pPlayer->edict() || pPlayer->IsBot())
+		return false;
+
+	const char *pszLang = GET_KEY_VALUE(GET_INFO_BUFFER(pPlayer->edict()), "ars_lang");
+	return pszLang && !Q_strcmp(pszLang, "fr"); // (exactly fr, as the client's French())
+}
+
+// a message in the player's language
+inline const char *ARS_L(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, const char *pszEn, const char *pszFr)
+{
+	return ARS_French(pPlayer) ? pszFr : pszEn;
+}

+/*
+*	Half Strike r11: bricks and Fortnite-style building (wpn_shared/build.cpp; the grid: wpn_shared/build_grid.h, shared
+*	with the client's blueprint).
+*
+*	Bricks: one count per player (0..BUILD_MAX_BRICKS), set to mp_build_bricks at each new round (and at a player's
+*	first spawn). A bullet impact on the world or a brush entity (not a player, a Pokemon nor a built piece) drops a pile
+*	of BUILD_DROP bricks on the ground below it, a little towards the shooter: once per shot and surface (FireBullets3:
+*	its first brush hit; a shotgun's pellets: once per brush entity hit by the blast); an explosion near a brush surface
+*	drops one pile. Piles merge (one per BUILD_PILE_MERGE units, up to BUILD_PILE_MAX bricks), vanish after
+*	BUILD_PILE_LIFE s, at most BUILD_PILE_CAP of them (the oldest goes); humans pick them up by walking over them.
+*	Nothing drops and nothing is built with mp_build 0.
+*
+*	Building: the client asks `build_mode 0|1` (the weapon holstered, v_build in hand, the weapon's frame skipped) and
+*	`build_place <piece> <ox> <oy> <oz> <yaw> [turns]`; the server recomputes the spot (build_aim from its own view),
+*	checks it (reach, world, players and Pokemon, slot, caps, bricks) and builds (BUILD_COST bricks) or answers BuildDeny.
+*	Pieces (build_piece) grow in BUILD_GROW_TIME from a third of their health; ramps and roofs collide as steps
+*	(build_step, invisible, their damage routed to the piece). Every damage hurts them (blasts twice), except a
+*	teammate's (and its builder's own) without mp_friendlyfire; three skins by damage; destroyed: brick debris, sound,
+*	gone with its steps. All removed at each new round. Per player BUILD_PLAYER_CAP pieces, BUILD_GLOBAL_CAP in all, and
+*	BUILD_EDICT_MARGIN edicts always left free (and, for pieces, room for every pile; a new pile is not dropped past it).
+*
+*	Messages: Bricks (short count, byte picked up — 0: another change), BuildMode (byte: 1 in build mode, 2 building on),
+*	BuildDeny (byte: build_grid.h's reason).
+*/
+#pragma once
+
+#include "wpn_shared/build_grid.h"
+
+#define BUILD_DROP          5       // bricks per impact
+#define BUILD_PILE_MERGE    48.0f   // a drop this close to a pile joins it
+#define BUILD_PILE_MAX      250     // bricks in a pile at most (the Bricks message's byte)
+#define BUILD_PILE_LIFE     60.0f
+#define BUILD_PILE_CAP      120
+#define BUILD_HEALTH        300.0f  // every piece, grown
+#define BUILD_GROW_TIME     0.4f
+#define BUILD_PLAYER_CAP    60
+#define BUILD_GLOBAL_CAP    400
+// build entities (pieces and steps) at most: the client's prediction keeps MAX_PHYSENTS 600 - maxclients physents (568
+// at 32 players; map brush entities first, the rest dropped), so pieces and steps stay well under it
+#define BUILD_ENTITY_CAP    420
+#define BUILD_STEP_SEND     1024.0f // steps (invisible: prediction only) sent within that distance of a client
+#define BUILD_EDICT_MARGIN  150     // edicts left free for the game (pieces: also room for BUILD_PILE_CAP piles)
+#define BUILD_PLACE_DELAY   0.08f   // between two pieces of a player (the client's held fire: 0.12 s)
+#define BUILD_BLAST_FACTOR  2.0f    // explosions hurt pieces that much more
+
+extern cvar_t build_enabled;   // mp_build

+#define HL_NUM_SKIN 5
+// (the model files, kept for the engine: it keeps the pointers it is given to precache)
+const char *HL_SkinPath(const char *name)
+{
+	static char paths[2 * HL_NUM_SKIN][MAX_PATH];
+	for (int i = 0; i < 2 * HL_NUM_SKIN; i++)
+	{
+		const char *skin = i < HL_NUM_SKIN ? HL_SkinsT[i] : HL_SkinsCT[i - HL_NUM_SKIN];
+		if (Q_strcmp(skin, name))
+			continue;
+		if (!paths[i][0])
+			Q_snprintf(paths[i], sizeof(paths[i]), "models/player/%s/%s.mdl", skin, skin);
+		return paths[i];
+	}
+	return "models/player.mdl";
+}
+
+const char *HL_SkinForTeam(const char *name, int team)
+{
+	for (int i = 0; i < HL_NUM_SKIN; i++)
+	{
+		if (!Q_strcmp(name, HL_SkinsT[i]) || !Q_strcmp(name, HL_SkinsCT[i]))
+			return team == TERRORIST ? HL_SkinsT[i] : team == CT ? HL_SkinsCT[i] : nullptr;
+	}
+	return nullptr;
+}

+// (a long menu in several messages, as their size is limited)
+static void HL_ShowMenuText(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, int bitsValidSlots, const char *pszText)
+{
+	char chunk[176];
+	int len = Q_strlen(pszText);
+	for (int i = 0; i < len; i += sizeof(chunk) - 1)
+	{
+		Q_strlcpy(chunk, pszText + i);
+		ShowMenu(pPlayer, bitsValidSlots, -1, (i + int(sizeof(chunk)) - 1 < len) ? TRUE : FALSE, chunk);
+	}
+}

+static void HL_ShowArsenalMenu(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	char text[384];
+	Q_strlcpy(text, ARS_L(pPlayer, "\\yHalf-Life arsenal\\w\n\n", "\\yArsenal Half-Life\\w\n\n"));
+	int bits = MENU_KEY_0;
+	for (int i = 0; i < int(ARRAYSIZE(HL_BuyCategories)); i++)
+	{
+		Q_snprintf(text + Q_strlen(text), sizeof(text) - Q_strlen(text), "%d. %s\n", i + 1, ARS_L(pPlayer, HL_BuyCategories[i].title, HL_BuyCategories[i].titleFr));
+		bits |= 1 << i;
+	}
+
+	Q_strlcat(text, ARS_L(pPlayer, "\n0. Exit", "\n0. Quitter"));
+	HL_ShowMenuText(pPlayer, bits, text);
+}
+
+static void HL_ShowCategoryMenu(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, int iCategory)
+{
+	const HLBuyCategory &category = HL_BuyCategories[iCategory];
+	char text[512];
+	Q_snprintf(text, sizeof(text), ARS_L(pPlayer, "\\yHalf-Life arsenal: %s\\w\n\n", "\\yArsenal Half-Life : %s\\w\n\n"), ARS_L(pPlayer, category.title, category.titleFr));
+
+	int bits = MENU_KEY_0;
+	for (int i = 0; i < int(ARRAYSIZE(category.items)) && category.items[i].name; i++)
+	{
+		const HLBuyItem &item = category.items[i];
+		Q_snprintf(text + Q_strlen(text), sizeof(text) - Q_strlen(text), "%d. %s\\R$%d\n", i + 1, (item.nameFr && ARS_French(pPlayer)) ? item.nameFr : item.name, item.price);
+		bits |= 1 << i;
+	}
+
+	Q_strlcat(text, ARS_L(pPlayer, "\n0. Exit", "\n0. Quitter"));
+	HL_ShowMenuText(pPlayer, bits, text);
+}

+static void HL_BuyCategoryItem(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, int iCategory, int iSlot)
+{
+	const HLBuyCategory &category = HL_BuyCategories[iCategory];
+	if (iSlot < 1 || iSlot > int(ARRAYSIZE(category.items)) || !category.items[iSlot - 1].name)
+		return;
+
+	const HLBuyItem &item = category.items[iSlot - 1];
+	if (item.id == WEAPON_NONE)
+		HL_BuyARGrenade(pPlayer);
+	else
+		BuyWeaponByWeaponID(pPlayer, item.id);
+}

+/*
+*	Half-Life arsenal: the fourteen Half-Life weapons bought and used in Counter-Strike, ported from the Half-Life SDK
+*	(crowbar.cpp, glock.cpp, python.cpp, mp5.cpp, shotgun.cpp, crossbow.cpp, rpg.cpp, gauss.cpp, egon.cpp, hornetgun.cpp,
+*	hornet.cpp, handgrenade.cpp, satchel.cpp, tripmine.cpp, squeakgrenade.cpp) onto this game's weapon classes.
+*
+*	Their ids follow the 32 of Counter-Strike: pev->weapons has 32 bits, so a player's Half-Life weapons reach the
+*	client by the HLWeapons message, and the client does not predict them (clientdata m_iId is 0 while one is held,
+*	its delta field has 5 bits). Their animations come from the server, their fire effects from the Half-Life events.
+*
+*	Their numbers are Counter-Strike's scale, not Half-Life's (a player has 100 health and kevlar here): see the
+*	balance table of docs/browser-ports.md.
+*/
+#pragma once
+
+// (the arsenal's weapons past Counter-Strike's 32: Half-Life's, and Half Strike's Poke Balls and Le M's laptop
+// — pokemon.h — after them)
+inline bool IsHLWeapon(int id) { return id >= WEAPON_HL_FIRST && id <= WEAPON_COMPANION_LAST; }
+
+// The bit of a weapon in pev->weapons, none for the Half-Life weapons
+inline int WeaponBit(int id) { return (id >= 0 && id < 32) ? (1 << id) : 0; }
+
+// The share of a hit an armored player takes, as Counter-Strike's table in CBasePlayer::TakeDamage (1 for none)
+float HL_ArmorRatio(int id);
+
+// Buying a Half-Life weapon of the knife or grenade slots, and the MP5's grenades (client.cpp's menus and aliases)
+CBaseEntity *HL_BuyEquipment(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, WeaponIdType weaponID);
+bool HL_BuyARGrenade(CBasePlayer *pPlayer);
+
+// Removes what the Half-Life weapons left in the map, at each round restart
+void HL_CleanUpMap();
+
+// Their animations are sent whether or not the client predicts its weapons: it does not predict these
+class CHLWeapon: public CBasePlayerWeapon
+{
+public:
+	virtual void SendWeaponAnim(int iAnim, int skiplocal = 0) { CBasePlayerWeapon::SendWeaponAnim(iAnim, 0); }
+	virtual BOOL UseDecrement() { return TRUE; }
+
+protected:
+	// (whether its attack may fire, as Counter-Strike checks for a primary attack: not in the freeze period)
+	bool CanFire();
+};
+

+/*
+*	Half Strike: Poke Balls. Three grenade-slot items (weapon_pk_pikachu, weapon_pk_charizard, weapon_pk_blastoise),
+*	thrown like the Half-Life hand grenade; the ball opens and its Pokemon (monster_pokemon) comes out, follows its
+*	player, and charges the enemy its player shoots at or that hurts its player or itself, with its own attack.
+*
+*	Their ids follow the Half-Life arsenal's (weapontype.h): IsHLWeapon covers them too, so they reach the client by the
+*	HLWeapons message, are not predicted, and bots neither buy nor pick them up.
+*
+*	The client draws the health bars from the PokeHP message: short entity index (two bytes, low first), byte health
+*	percent (0: gone), byte species (0 Pikachu, 1 Charizard, 2 Blastoise), byte team (1 T, 2 CT, 0 none), byte owner
+*	player index. Sent to all on spawn, at each change of the percent and at death or removal, and to each client at its
+*	HUD reset (all Pokemon out).
+*
+*	The models, sprites and sounds are Half Strike's own (the asset generator), under models/pokemon, sprites/pokemon
+*	and sound/pokemon.
+*
+*	Le M (species 3, models/others, sprites/others, sound/others) is a companion of the same kind, summoned with a
+*	laptop (weapon_lem_laptop, id 49, after the balls): fired, its player types for a while, then Le M materialises
+*	where it aims, through green code rain, a hologram and a scan "compiling" him from the feet up; his attack (Hack) is a
+*	green code beam that also scrambles its victim's screen a moment (LemHack message: byte duration in hundredths of a
+*	second, byte intensity); he dissolves into pixels when he dies, and de-rezzes when he goes back. He keeps the
+*	Pokemon's class name (monster_pokemon): every rule of theirs applies to him; his kills are credited to "lem".
+*	One companion at a time per player: one ball or laptop carried, or one ball in flight, Pokemon or Le M out.
+*/
+#pragma once
+
+enum PokemonSpecies
+{
+	PK_PIKACHU = 0,
+	PK_CHARIZARD,
+	PK_BLASTOISE,
+	PK_LEM,         // (Le M: not out of a ball, from the laptop)
+	PK_NUM_SPECIES
+};
+
+#define PK_PIKACHU_PRICE    1000
+#define PK_CHARIZARD_PRICE  1400
+#define PK_BLASTOISE_PRICE  1300
+#define PK_BALL_MAX_CARRY   1
+#define PK_BALL_WEIGHT      1
+#define PK_BALL_MAX_SPEED   250.0f
+#define LEM_PRICE           1500
+
+// The share of a Pokemon's hit an armored player takes (Counter-Strike's ratio: 0.5 times this)
+#define PK_ARMOR_RATIO      1.4f
+
+inline bool IsPokeBall(int id) { return id >= WEAPON_PK_FIRST && id <= WEAPON_PK_LAST; }
+
+// A ball or Le M's laptop: the items that bring a companion out (one at a time, never dropped)
+inline bool IsCompanionItem(int id) { return id >= WEAPON_PK_FIRST && id <= WEAPON_COMPANION_LAST; }
+
+// Whether an entity is a Pokemon or Le M (its attacks are inflicted by it, credited to its player)
+bool PK_IsPokemon(entvars_t *pev);
+
+// The death notice's weapon of a companion's kill: "lem" for Le M, "pokemon" for the others
+const char *PK_KillWeaponName(entvars_t *pevInflictor);
+
+// Buying a ball or the laptop (client.cpp's BuyWeaponByWeaponID): one item carried, one companion out
+CBaseEntity *PK_BuyBall(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, WeaponIdType weaponID);
+
+// Player events (player.cpp): it fired; it was hurt; its HUD was reset
+void PK_OnPlayerAttack(CBasePlayer *pPlayer);
+void PK_OnPlayerHurt(CBasePlayer *pVictim, entvars_t *pevInflictor, entvars_t *pevAttacker);
+void PK_SendAllTo(CBasePlayer *pPlayer);

+// Removes every ball and Pokemon, at each round restart
+void PK_CleanUpMap();

+// Half Strike r11: bricks and Fortnite-style building (build.h). The grid — where a piece goes from a player's view and
+// the checks of a spot — is build_grid.h, shared with the client's blueprint: the server runs the same build_aim from
+// its own view of the player, never trusting a client's coordinates beyond the spot the server itself finds.
+
+#include "precompiled.h"
+

+cvar_t build_start_bricks  = { "mp_build_bricks", "0", FCVAR_SERVER, 0.0f, nullptr };
+

+int gmsgBuildMode = 0;
+int gmsgBuildDeny = 0;

+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// traces: the grid's engine (build_grid.h's build_engine_t)
+
+bool BUILD_IsPiece(const edict_t *pEdict)
+{
+	if (!pEdict || pEdict->free || !pEdict->pvPrivateData)
+		return false;
+
+	const char *name = STRING(pEdict->v.classname);
+	return name && (!Q_strcmp(name, "build_piece") || !Q_strcmp(name, "build_step"));
+}
+
+struct BuildTraceCtx
+{
+	edict_t *pIgnore;    // (the player: never hit)
+	edict_t *pLastHit;   // (what the last trace stopped on)
+};
+
+// A line through players, monsters and anything else but the world, brush entities and built pieces (worldOnly: the
+// world and brush entities — doors, func_wall, breakables — alone), as the client's grid trace; its fraction, end,
+// whether it started in a solid (the world, a brush entity, or without worldOnly a built piece)
+static float BUILD_TraceLine(BuildTraceCtx *ctx, const Vector &vecStart, const Vector &vecEnd, bool bWorldOnly, Vector &vecHit, bool &bStartSolid)
+{
+	TraceResult tr;
+	edict_t *pIgnore = ctx->pIgnore;
+	Vector vecFrom = vecStart;
+	const float flTotal = (vecEnd - vecStart).Length();
+
+	ctx->pLastHit = nullptr;
+	bStartSolid = false;
+	vecHit = vecEnd;
+
+	for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
+	{
+		UTIL_TraceLine(vecFrom, vecEnd, bWorldOnly ? ignore_monsters : dont_ignore_monsters, pIgnore, &tr);
+		if (i == 0 && (tr.fStartSolid || tr.fAllSolid))
+		{
+			// (inside the world, a brush entity or a piece: the start is in a solid; inside another entity: the trace
+			// starts again past it)
+			if (!tr.pHit || ENTINDEX(tr.pHit) == 0 || VARS(tr.pHit)->solid == SOLID_BSP || (!bWorldOnly && BUILD_IsPiece(tr.pHit)))
+			{
+				bStartSolid = true;
+				vecHit = vecStart;
+				ctx->pLastHit = tr.pHit;
+				return 0.0f;
+			}
+		}
+
+		if (tr.flFraction >= 1.0f || !tr.pHit)
+			break;
+
+		edict_t *pHit = tr.pHit;
+		const bool bWorld = (ENTINDEX(pHit) == 0);
+		const bool bTakes = bWorld || pHit->v.solid == SOLID_BSP || (!bWorldOnly && BUILD_IsPiece(pHit));
+		if (bTakes)
+		{
+			vecHit = tr.vecEndPos;
+			ctx->pLastHit = pHit;
+			return flTotal > 0.0f ? clamp(float((tr.vecEndPos - vecStart).Length() / flTotal), 0.0f, 0.999f) : 0.0f;
+		}
+
+		// (through it: on from where it was met, past it)
+		vecFrom = tr.vecEndPos;
+		pIgnore = pHit;
+	}
+
+	return 1.0f;
+}
+
+static float BUILD_EngineTrace(void *ctx, const float *start, const float *end, int worldOnly, float *endpos, int *startsolid)
+{
+	Vector vecHit;
+	bool bStartSolid;
+	float f = BUILD_TraceLine((BuildTraceCtx *)ctx, Vector(start[0], start[1], start[2]), Vector(end[0], end[1], end[2]), worldOnly != 0, vecHit, bStartSolid);
+	endpos[0] = vecHit.x;
+	endpos[1] = vecHit.y;
+	endpos[2] = vecHit.z;
+	*startsolid = bStartSolid ? 1 : 0;
+	return f;
+}
+
+static int BUILD_EnginePiece(void *ctx, float *origin_z)
+{
+	edict_t *pHit = ((BuildTraceCtx *)ctx)->pLastHit;
+	if (!BUILD_IsPiece(pHit))
+		return 0;
+
+	*origin_z = pHit->v.origin.z;
+	return 1;
+}
+
+static build_engine_t BUILD_Engine(BuildTraceCtx *ctx)
+{
+	build_engine_t e;
+	e.ctx = ctx;
+	e.trace = BUILD_EngineTrace;
+	e.piece = BUILD_EnginePiece;
+	return e;
+}
+
+CBaseEntity *BUILD_PieceOnLine(const Vector &vecSrc, const Vector &vecEnd, edict_t *pIgnore)
+{
+	BuildTraceCtx ctx = { pIgnore, nullptr };
+	Vector vecHit;
+	bool bStartSolid;
+	if (BUILD_TraceLine(&ctx, vecSrc, vecEnd, false, vecHit, bStartSolid) >= 1.0f || !BUILD_IsPiece(ctx.pLastHit))
+		return nullptr;
+
+	CBaseEntity *pHit = CBaseEntity::Instance(ctx.pLastHit);
+	if (pHit && FClassnameIs(pHit->pev, "build_step"))
+		return static_cast<CBuildStep *>(pHit)->Parent();
+
+	return pHit;
+}
+
+void BUILD_TraceLineSolid(const Vector &vecStart, const Vector &vecEnd, edict_t *pIgnore, TraceResult *ptr)
+{
+	UTIL_TraceLine(vecStart, vecEnd, ignore_monsters, pIgnore, ptr);
+	if (ptr->fStartSolid || ptr->fAllSolid)
+		return;
+
+	// (a piece before what that met: the line stops there)
+	BuildTraceCtx ctx = { pIgnore, nullptr };
+	Vector vecHit;
+	bool bStartSolid;
+	BUILD_TraceLine(&ctx, vecStart, ptr->vecEndPos, false, vecHit, bStartSolid);
+	if (!BUILD_IsPiece(ctx.pLastHit))
+		return;
+
+	const float flTotal = (vecEnd - vecStart).Length();
+	ptr->pHit = ctx.pLastHit;
+	ptr->vecEndPos = vecHit;
+	ptr->flFraction = flTotal > 0.0f ? clamp(float((vecHit - vecStart).Length() / flTotal), 0.0f, 0.999f) : 0.0f;
+	ptr->vecPlaneNormal = flTotal > 0.0f ? (vecStart - vecEnd) / flTotal : Vector(0, 0, 1);
+	if (bStartSolid)
+	{
+		ptr->fStartSolid = TRUE;
+		ptr->flFraction = 0.0f;
+	}
+}
+
+bool BUILD_PieceVisible(edict_t *pEdict, unsigned char *pSet)
+{
+	if (pEdict->v.solid != SOLID_BBOX || !FClassnameIs(&pEdict->v, "build_piece"))
+		return false;
+
+	CBuildPiece *pPiece = static_cast<CBuildPiece *>(CBaseEntity::Instance(pEdict));
+	return pPiece && pPiece->StepVisible(pSet);
+}
+
+bool CBuildPiece::StepVisible(unsigned char *pSet) const
+{
+	for (int i = 0; i < m_iNumSteps; i++)
+	{
+		CBaseEntity *pStep = m_hSteps[i];
+		if (pStep && ENGINE_CHECK_VISIBILITY(pStep->edict(), pSet))
+			return true;
+	}
+	return false;
+}
+
+float BUILD_BlastDistance(CBaseEntity *pEntity, const Vector &vecSrc, float flDefault)
+{
+	if (!BUILD_IsPiece(pEntity))
+		return flDefault;
+
+	// (a piece: its nearest point, whatever its size)
+	Vector d;
+	for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
+	{
+		float v = vecSrc[k];
+		d[k] = v < pEntity->pev->absmin[k] ? pEntity->pev->absmin[k] - v : v > pEntity->pev->absmax[k] ? v - pEntity->pev->absmax[k] : 0.0f;
+	}
+	return d.Length();
+}
+
+bool BUILD_BlastShielded(CBaseEntity *pEntity, const Vector &vecSrc, const Vector &vecSpot, edict_t *pInflictor)
+{
+	if (!pEntity || BUILD_IsPiece(pEntity) || !(pEntity->pev->flags & (FL_CLIENT | FL_FAKECLIENT | FL_MONSTER)))
+		return false;
+
+	CBaseEntity *pPiece = BUILD_PieceOnLine(vecSrc, vecSpot, pInflictor);
+	return pPiece != nullptr;
+}

+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(build_bricks, CBrickPile, CCSEntity)

+void CBrickPile::Precache()
+{

+	PRECACHE_SOUND("build/pickup.wav");
+}
+
+void CBrickPile::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	MAKE_STRING_CLASS("build_bricks", pev);
+	pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_TOSS;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_TRIGGER;
+	pev->takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
+	pev->gravity = 1.0f;
+	SET_MODEL(ENT(pev), BUILD_PILE_MODEL);
+	UTIL_SetSize(pev, Vector(-14, -14, 0), Vector(14, 14, 12));
+	pev->angles = Vector(0, RANDOM_FLOAT(0, 360), 0);
+	m_flBornTime = gpGlobals->time;
+	SetThink(&CBrickPile::ExpireThink);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + BUILD_PILE_LIFE;
+}
+
+void CBrickPile::SetAmount(int iAmount)
+{
+	m_iAmount = clamp(iAmount, 0, BUILD_PILE_MAX);
+	// (the model's bodies: small, medium, large)
+	pev->body = m_iAmount < 20 ? 0 : m_iAmount < 60 ? 1 : 2;
+}
+
+void CBrickPile::ExpireThink()
+{
+	UTIL_Remove(this);
+}
+
+void CBrickPile::Touch(CBaseEntity *pOther)
+{
+	if (!pOther || !pOther->IsPlayer() || !pOther->IsAlive() || !BUILD_On() || m_iAmount <= 0)
+		return;
+
+	CBasePlayer *pPlayer = static_cast<CBasePlayer *>(pOther);
+	if (pPlayer->IsBot() || pPlayer->GetObserverMode() != OBS_NONE || (pPlayer->m_iTeam != TERRORIST && pPlayer->m_iTeam != CT))
+		return;
+
+	int iTake = Q_min(m_iAmount, BUILD_MAX_BRICKS - pPlayer->m_iBricks);
+	if (iTake <= 0)
+		return;
+
+	pPlayer->m_iBricks += iTake;
+	pPlayer->m_iBricksPicked += iTake;
+	EMIT_SOUND_DYN(pPlayer->edict(), CHAN_ITEM, "build/pickup.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, PITCH_NORM + RANDOM_LONG(-4, 4));
+
+	SetAmount(m_iAmount - iTake);
+	if (m_iAmount <= 0)
+	{
+		pev->solid = SOLID_NOT;
+		UTIL_Remove(this);
+	}
+}
+
+// The piles there are (no scan of every edict per impact): the live ones first, iPiles of them
+static EHANDLE s_hPiles[BUILD_PILE_CAP];
+static int s_iPiles = 0;
+
+static void BUILD_ForgetPiles()
+{
+	for (int i = 0; i < BUILD_PILE_CAP; i++)
+		s_hPiles[i] = nullptr;
+	s_iPiles = 0;
+}
+
+static int BUILD_LivePiles()
+{
+	int n = 0;
+	for (int i = 0; i < s_iPiles; i++)
+	{
+		CBaseEntity *pPile = s_hPiles[i];
+		if (pPile && !(pPile->pev->flags & FL_KILLME))
+			s_hPiles[n++] = pPile;
+	}
+
+	for (int i = n; i < s_iPiles; i++)
+		s_hPiles[i] = nullptr;
+
+	s_iPiles = n;
+	return n;
+}
+
+void CBrickPile::Drop(const Vector &vecGround, int iAmount)
+{
+	const int iPiles = BUILD_LivePiles();
+
+	// (into a pile near enough, while it has room)
+	for (int i = 0; i < iPiles && iAmount > 0; i++)
+	{
+		CBrickPile *pPile = static_cast<CBrickPile *>((CBaseEntity *)s_hPiles[i]);
+		if ((pPile->pev->origin - vecGround).Length() > BUILD_PILE_MERGE)
+			continue;
+
+		int iAdd = Q_min(iAmount, BUILD_PILE_MAX - pPile->m_iAmount);
+		if (iAdd <= 0)
+			continue;
+
+		pPile->SetAmount(pPile->m_iAmount + iAdd);
+		pPile->pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + BUILD_PILE_LIFE; // (a growing pile lives on)
+		iAmount -= iAdd;
+	}
+
+	if (iAmount <= 0)
+		return;
+
+	// (a new one: the oldest goes past the cap; none when the edicts left are the game's — the engine's end otherwise)
+	int iOldest = -1;
+	for (int i = 0; i < iPiles; i++)
+	{
+		if (iOldest < 0 || static_cast<CBrickPile *>((CBaseEntity *)s_hPiles[i])->m_flBornTime < static_cast<CBrickPile *>((CBaseEntity *)s_hPiles[iOldest])->m_flBornTime)
+			iOldest = i;
+	}
+
+	if (iPiles < BUILD_PILE_CAP && NUMBER_OF_ENTITIES() + BUILD_EDICT_MARGIN >= gpGlobals->maxEntities)
+		return;
+
+	if (iPiles >= BUILD_PILE_CAP && iOldest >= 0)
+	{
+		CBaseEntity *pOldest = s_hPiles[iOldest];
+		pOldest->pev->solid = SOLID_NOT;
+		UTIL_Remove(pOldest);
+		s_hPiles[iOldest] = s_hPiles[--s_iPiles];
+		s_hPiles[s_iPiles] = nullptr;
+	}
+
+	CBrickPile *pPile = GetClassPtr<CCSEntity>((CBrickPile *)nullptr);
+	if (!pPile)
+		return;
+
+	pPile->Spawn();
+	pPile->SetAmount(iAmount);
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pPile->pev, vecGround);
+	if (s_iPiles < BUILD_PILE_CAP)
+		s_hPiles[s_iPiles++] = pPile;
+}
+
+// Bricks for an impact at vecPos (out of the surface, on its near side): a pile on the ground below, a little towards
+// vecToward
+static void BUILD_DropBelow(const Vector &vecPos, const Vector &vecToward)
+{
+	Vector vecBack = vecToward - vecPos;
+	vecBack.z = 0;
+	float flLen = vecBack.Length();
+	Vector vecStart = vecPos;
+	if (flLen > 0.1f)
+	{
+		Vector vecTry = vecPos + vecBack * (Q_min(16.0f, flLen) / flLen);
+		TraceResult tr;
+		UTIL_TraceLine(vecPos, vecTry, ignore_monsters, nullptr, &tr);
+		vecStart = tr.vecEndPos;
+	}
+
+	if (UTIL_PointContents(vecStart) == CONTENTS_SOLID || UTIL_PointContents(vecStart) == CONTENTS_SKY)
+		return;
+
+	// (down onto the world, a brush or a built floor: the players in between are passed through)
+	BuildTraceCtx ctx = { nullptr, nullptr };
+	Vector vecGround;
+	bool bStartSolid;
+	if (BUILD_TraceLine(&ctx, vecStart, vecStart - Vector(0, 0, 4096), false, vecGround, bStartSolid) >= 1.0f || bStartSolid)
+		return;
+
+	CBrickPile::Drop(vecGround + Vector(0, 0, 1), BUILD_DROP);
+}
+
+// A brush surface that drops bricks when hit: the world (not its sky) or a brush entity
+static bool BUILD_BrickSurface(TraceResult *ptr, const Vector &vecSrc)
+{
+	edict_t *pHit = ptr->pHit;
+	if (!pHit || ptr->flFraction >= 1.0f || pHit->v.solid != SOLID_BSP || (pHit->v.flags & (FL_CLIENT | FL_FAKECLIENT | FL_MONSTER)))
+		return false;
+
+	if (ENTINDEX(pHit) == 0)
+	{
+		Vector vecDir = (ptr->vecEndPos - vecSrc).Normalize();
+		const char *pszTexture = TRACE_TEXTURE(pHit, ptr->vecEndPos - vecDir * 4, ptr->vecEndPos + vecDir * 8);
+		if (pszTexture && !Q_stricmp(pszTexture, "sky"))
+			return false;
+	}
+
+	return true;
+}
+
+void BUILD_BulletImpact(entvars_t *pevAttacker, const Vector &vecSrc, TraceResult *ptr)
+{
+	if (!BUILD_On() || !ptr || !BUILD_BrickSurface(ptr, vecSrc))
+		return;
+
+	BUILD_DropBelow(ptr->vecEndPos + ptr->vecPlaneNormal * 4.0f, vecSrc);
+}
+
+void BUILD_ImpactOnce(entvars_t *pevAttacker, const Vector &vecSrc, TraceResult *ptr, edict_t **pHits, int &iHits, int iMax)
+{
+	if (!ptr || !ptr->pHit || ptr->flFraction >= 1.0f || ptr->pHit->v.solid != SOLID_BSP)
+		return;
+
+	for (int i = 0; i < iHits; i++)
+	{
+		if (pHits[i] == ptr->pHit)
+			return;
+	}
+
+	if (iHits >= iMax)
+		return;
+
+	pHits[iHits++] = ptr->pHit;
+	BUILD_BulletImpact(pevAttacker, vecSrc, ptr);
+}
+
+void BUILD_ExplosionImpact(entvars_t *pevAttacker, const Vector &vecSrc, float flRadius, float flDamage)
+{
+	// (a real blast — not the Egon's beam end, its small radius — by a player)
+	if (!BUILD_On() || flRadius <= 128.0f || flDamage < 20.0f || !pevAttacker)
+		return;
+
+	CBaseEntity *pAttacker = CBaseEntity::Instance(pevAttacker);
+	if (!pAttacker || !pAttacker->IsPlayer())
+		return;
+
+	// (the nearest brush surface around it, within 96 units)
+	static const Vector dirs[] = { Vector(0, 0, -1), Vector(1, 0, 0), Vector(-1, 0, 0), Vector(0, 1, 0), Vector(0, -1, 0), Vector(0, 0, 1) };
+	TraceResult best;
+	best.flFraction = 1.0f;
+	for (int i = 0; i < int(ARRAYSIZE(dirs)); i++)
+	{
+		TraceResult tr;
+		UTIL_TraceLine(vecSrc, vecSrc + dirs[i] * 96.0f, ignore_monsters, nullptr, &tr);
+		if (tr.fStartSolid || tr.flFraction >= best.flFraction || !BUILD_BrickSurface(&tr, vecSrc))
+			continue;
+
+		best = tr;
+	}
+
+	if (best.flFraction >= 1.0f)
+		return;
+
+	BUILD_DropBelow(best.vecEndPos + best.vecPlaneNormal * 4.0f, vecSrc);
+}

+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// pieces
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(build_piece, CBuildPiece, CCSEntity)
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(build_step, CBuildStep, CCSEntity)
+
+void CBuildPiece::Precache()
+{
+	for (int i = 0; i < BUILD_PIECES; i++)
+		PRECACHE_MODEL(BUILD_ModelsOptional[i]);
+}
```
