+void CBuildPiece::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	MAKE_STRING_CLASS("build_piece", pev);
+	pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_NONE;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_BBOX;
+	pev->takedamage = DAMAGE_YES;
+	pev->max_health = BUILD_HEALTH;
+	pev->health = BUILD_HEALTH / 3.0f;
+}
+
+CBuildPiece *CBuildPiece::Create(CBasePlayer *pOwner, const build_spot_t &spot)
+{
+	CBuildPiece *pPiece = GetClassPtr<CCSEntity>((CBuildPiece *)nullptr);
+	if (!pPiece)
+		return nullptr;
+
+	pPiece->Spawn();
+	entvars_t *pev = pPiece->pev;
+
+	pPiece->m_hOwner = pOwner;
+	pPiece->m_iTeam = pOwner ? pOwner->m_iTeam : UNASSIGNED;
+	pPiece->m_iPiece = spot.piece;
+	pPiece->m_iYaw = spot.yaw;
+	pPiece->m_flBornTime = gpGlobals->time;
+	pPiece->m_flDamage = 0;
+	pPiece->m_bGrowing = true;
+	pPiece->m_bDestroyed = false;
+	pPiece->m_iNumSteps = 0;
+	pPiece->m_flLastHitTime = -1;
+	pPiece->m_pLastInflictor = nullptr;
+	pPiece->m_flLastHitDamage = 0;
+	pPiece->m_flNextHitSound = 0;
+	pPiece->m_flNextChips = 0;
+
+	const Vector vecOrigin(spot.origin[0], spot.origin[1], spot.origin[2]);
+	SET_MODEL(ENT(pev), BUILD_Models[spot.piece]);
+	pev->angles = Vector(0, float(spot.yaw), 0);
+	pev->iuser1 = spot.piece;
+	pev->skin = 0;
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pev, vecOrigin);
+
+	// (its own box: the first step — the whole box for a wall or a floor)
+	float lo[3], hi[3];
+	build_step_box(&spot, 0, lo, hi);
+	UTIL_SetSize(pev, Vector(lo[0], lo[1], lo[2]) - vecOrigin, Vector(hi[0], hi[1], hi[2]) - vecOrigin);
+
+	// (growing: see-through, then whole; the model's "build" sequence if it has one)
+	pev->rendermode = kRenderTransTexture;
+	pev->renderamt = 90;
+	studiohdr_t *pStudio = (studiohdr_t *)GET_MODEL_PTR(ENT(pev));
+	if (pStudio && pStudio->numseq > 1)
+	{
+		pev->sequence = 1;
+		pev->frame = 0;
+		pev->framerate = 1.0f;
+		pev->animtime = gpGlobals->time;
+	}
+
+	// (the invisible steps of a ramp or a roof, their damage routed to it)
+	const int n = Q_min(build_steps(spot.piece), int(ARRAYSIZE(pPiece->m_hSteps)) + 1);
+	for (int i = 1; i < n; i++)
+	{
+		CBuildStep *pStep = GetClassPtr<CCSEntity>((CBuildStep *)nullptr);
+		if (!pStep)
+			break;
+
+		pStep->Spawn();
+		pStep->m_hParent = pPiece;
+		SET_MODEL(ENT(pStep->pev), BUILD_Models[spot.piece]);
+		pStep->pev->effects |= EF_NODRAW;
+		pStep->pev->angles = pev->angles;
+		UTIL_SetOrigin(pStep->pev, vecOrigin);
+		build_step_box(&spot, i, lo, hi);
+		UTIL_SetSize(pStep->pev, Vector(lo[0], lo[1], lo[2]) - vecOrigin, Vector(hi[0], hi[1], hi[2]) - vecOrigin);
+		pPiece->m_hSteps[pPiece->m_iNumSteps++] = pStep;
+	}
+
+	EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_ITEM, "build/place.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, PITCH_NORM + RANDOM_LONG(-3, 3));
+	EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_BODY, "build/build_loop.wav", 0.8f, ATTN_NORM, 0, PITCH_NORM);
+
+	pPiece->UpdateHealth();
+	pPiece->SetThink(&CBuildPiece::GrowThink);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.05f;
+	return pPiece;
+}
+
+float CBuildPiece::GrownFraction() const
+{
+	return clamp(float((gpGlobals->time - m_flBornTime) / BUILD_GROW_TIME), 0.0f, 1.0f);
+}
+
+void CBuildPiece::UpdateHealth()
+{
+	const float f = m_bGrowing ? GrownFraction() : 1.0f;
+	pev->health = BUILD_HEALTH * (1.0f + 2.0f * f) / 3.0f - m_flDamage;
+
+	// (its cracks by the damage taken)
+	const float flTaken = m_flDamage / BUILD_HEALTH;
+	pev->skin = flTaken < 1.0f / 3.0f ? 0 : flTaken < 2.0f / 3.0f ? 1 : 2;
+}
+
+void CBuildPiece::GrowThink()
+{
+	if (m_bDestroyed)
+		return;
+
+	const float f = GrownFraction();
+	pev->renderamt = 90 + int(165 * f);
+	UpdateHealth();
+
+	if (f >= 1.0f)
+	{
+		m_bGrowing = false;
+		pev->rendermode = kRenderNormal;
+		pev->renderamt = 255;
+		pev->sequence = 0;
+		pev->framerate = 0;
+		pev->frame = 0;
+		pev->animtime = gpGlobals->time;
+		UpdateHealth();
+		SetThink(nullptr);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.05f;
+}
+
+void CBuildPiece::Chips(const Vector &vecPos, const Vector &vecDir)
+{
+	if (gpGlobals->time >= m_flNextChips && s_iGibsModel)
+	{
+		m_flNextChips = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+		Vector vecVel = vecDir * -60.0f;
+		MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_PVS, SVC_TEMPENTITY, vecPos);
+			WRITE_BYTE(TE_BREAKMODEL);
+			WRITE_COORD(vecPos.x);
+			WRITE_COORD(vecPos.y);
+			WRITE_COORD(vecPos.z);
+			WRITE_COORD(4);
+			WRITE_COORD(4);
+			WRITE_COORD(4);
+			WRITE_COORD(vecVel.x);
+			WRITE_COORD(vecVel.y);
+			WRITE_COORD(vecVel.z);
+			WRITE_BYTE(6);    // random velocity (x10)
+			WRITE_SHORT(s_iGibsModel);
+			WRITE_BYTE(2);    // count
+			WRITE_BYTE(8);    // life (x0.1 s)
+			WRITE_BYTE(BREAK_CONCRETE);
+		MESSAGE_END();
+	}
+
+	if (gpGlobals->time >= m_flNextHitSound)
+	{
+		m_flNextHitSound = gpGlobals->time + 0.15f;
+		static const char *const sounds[] = { "build/hit1.wav", "build/hit2.wav", "build/hit3.wav" };
+		EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_BODY, sounds[RANDOM_LONG(0, 2)], 0.7f, ATTN_NORM, 0, PITCH_NORM + RANDOM_LONG(-5, 5));
+	}
+}
+
+void CBuildPiece::TraceAttack(entvars_t *pevAttacker, float flDamage, Vector vecDir, TraceResult *ptr, int bitsDamageType)
+{
+	if (m_bDestroyed)
+		return;
+
+	if (ptr)
+		Chips(ptr->vecEndPos - vecDir * 2.0f, vecDir);
+
+	CBaseEntity::TraceAttack(pevAttacker, flDamage, vecDir, ptr, bitsDamageType);
+}
+
+BOOL CBuildPiece::TakeDamage(entvars_t *pevInflictor, entvars_t *pevAttacker, float flDamage, int bitsDamageType)
+{
+	if (m_bDestroyed || pev->takedamage == DAMAGE_NO || flDamage <= 0.0f)
+		return FALSE;
+
+	// (a teammate's only with friendly fire; its builder may always break their own — the owner's choice: a misplaced
+	// piece is shot away)
+	CBaseEntity *pAttacker = pevAttacker ? CBaseEntity::Instance(pevAttacker) : nullptr;
+	if (pAttacker && pAttacker->IsPlayer() && friendlyfire.value == 0.0f)
+	{
+		CBasePlayer *pPlayer = static_cast<CBasePlayer *>(pAttacker);
+		if (!IsOwnedBy(pPlayer) && !CSGameRules()->IsFreeForAll() && m_iTeam != UNASSIGNED && pPlayer->m_iTeam == m_iTeam)
+			return FALSE;
+	}
+
+	if (bitsDamageType & (DMG_BLAST | DMG_EXPLOSION))
+		flDamage *= BUILD_BLAST_FACTOR;
+
+	// (an area damage meets a ramp's every step: once per inflictor and frame, the most of them)
+	if (!(bitsDamageType & (DMG_BULLET | DMG_CLUB | DMG_SLASH)) && pevInflictor)
+	{
+		if (m_flLastHitTime == gpGlobals->time && m_pLastInflictor == ENT(pevInflictor))
+		{
+			if (flDamage <= m_flLastHitDamage)
+				return FALSE;
+
+			float flMore = flDamage - m_flLastHitDamage;
+			m_flLastHitDamage = flDamage;
+			flDamage = flMore;
+		}
+		else
+		{
+			m_flLastHitTime = gpGlobals->time;
+			m_pLastInflictor = ENT(pevInflictor);
+			m_flLastHitDamage = flDamage;
+		}
+	}
+
+	m_flDamage += flDamage;
+	UpdateHealth();
+
+	if (!(bitsDamageType & (DMG_BULLET | DMG_CLUB | DMG_SLASH)) && gpGlobals->time >= m_flNextHitSound)
+	{
+		m_flNextHitSound = gpGlobals->time + 0.15f;
+		static const char *const sounds[] = { "build/hit1.wav", "build/hit2.wav", "build/hit3.wav" };
+		EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_BODY, sounds[RANDOM_LONG(0, 2)], 0.8f, ATTN_NORM, 0, PITCH_NORM + RANDOM_LONG(-5, 5));
+	}
+
+	if (pev->health <= 0.0f)
+		Destroy();
+
+	return TRUE;
+}
+
+// What rested on a piece (a pile, a dropped weapon) falls with it
+static void BUILD_WakeResting(const Vector &vecMins, const Vector &vecMaxs, CBuildPiece *pPiece, EHANDLE *pSteps, int iNumSteps)
+{
+	CBaseEntity *pList[64];
+	int n = UTIL_EntitiesInBox(pList, ARRAYSIZE(pList), vecMins - Vector(1, 1, 1), vecMaxs + Vector(1, 1, 24), 0);
+	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+	{
+		entvars_t *pevOther = pList[i]->pev;
+		if (!pevOther->groundentity || (pevOther->flags & FL_CLIENT))
+			continue;
+
+		bool bOurs = (pevOther->groundentity == pPiece->edict());
+		for (int k = 0; !bOurs && k < iNumSteps; k++)
+			bOurs = pSteps[k].IsValid() && pevOther->groundentity == pSteps[k].Get();
+
+		if (!bOurs)
+			continue;
+
+		pevOther->flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND;
+		pevOther->groundentity = nullptr;
+	}
+}
+
+void CBuildPiece::Destroy()
+{
+	if (m_bDestroyed)
+		return;
+
+	m_bDestroyed = true;
+
+	build_spot_t spot = {};
+	spot.piece = m_iPiece;
+	spot.yaw = m_iYaw;
+	spot.origin[0] = pev->origin.x;
+	spot.origin[1] = pev->origin.y;
+	spot.origin[2] = pev->origin.z;
+	build_box(m_iPiece, m_iYaw, spot.origin, spot.mins, spot.maxs);
+	Vector vecMins(spot.mins[0], spot.mins[1], spot.mins[2]), vecMaxs(spot.maxs[0], spot.maxs[1], spot.maxs[2]);
+	Vector vecCenter = (vecMins + vecMaxs) * 0.5f, vecSize = vecMaxs - vecMins;
+
+	if (s_iGibsModel)
+	{
+		static const int counts[BUILD_PIECES] = { 14, 12, 16, 12 };
+		MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_PVS, SVC_TEMPENTITY, vecCenter);
+			WRITE_BYTE(TE_BREAKMODEL);
+			WRITE_COORD(vecCenter.x);
+			WRITE_COORD(vecCenter.y);
+			WRITE_COORD(vecCenter.z);
+			WRITE_COORD(vecSize.x);
+			WRITE_COORD(vecSize.y);
+			WRITE_COORD(vecSize.z);
+			WRITE_COORD(0);
+			WRITE_COORD(0);
+			WRITE_COORD(40);
+			WRITE_BYTE(12);   // random velocity (x10)
+			WRITE_SHORT(s_iGibsModel);
+			WRITE_BYTE(counts[clamp(m_iPiece, 0, BUILD_PIECES - 1)]);
+			WRITE_BYTE(25);   // life (x0.1 s)
+			WRITE_BYTE(BREAK_CONCRETE);
+		MESSAGE_END();
+	}
+
+	// (the sound from a point entity's place: the piece itself is gone this frame)
+	UTIL_EmitAmbientSound(ENT(0), vecCenter, RANDOM_LONG(0, 1) ? "build/break1.wav" : "build/break2.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, PITCH_NORM + RANDOM_LONG(-5, 5));
+
+	BUILD_WakeResting(vecMins, vecMaxs, this, m_hSteps, m_iNumSteps);
+	Vanish();
+}
+
+void CBuildPiece::Vanish()
+{
+	m_bDestroyed = true;
+	pev->takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
+
+	for (int i = 0; i < m_iNumSteps; i++)
+	{
+		CBaseEntity *pStep = m_hSteps[i];
+		if (!pStep)
+			continue;
+
+		pStep->pev->solid = SOLID_NOT;
+		pStep->pev->takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
+		UTIL_SetOrigin(pStep->pev, pStep->pev->origin);
+		UTIL_Remove(pStep);
+	}
+
+	m_iNumSteps = 0;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_NOT;
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pev, pev->origin);
+	SetThink(nullptr);
+	UTIL_Remove(this);
+}
+
+void CBuildStep::Spawn()
+{
+	MAKE_STRING_CLASS("build_step", pev);
+	pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_NONE;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_BBOX;
+	pev->takedamage = DAMAGE_YES;
+	pev->health = 1;
+}
+
+CBuildPiece *CBuildStep::Parent() const
+{
+	CBaseEntity *pParent = m_hParent;
+	return pParent ? static_cast<CBuildPiece *>(pParent) : nullptr;
+}
+
+void CBuildStep::TraceAttack(entvars_t *pevAttacker, float flDamage, Vector vecDir, TraceResult *ptr, int bitsDamageType)
+{
+	CBuildPiece *pParent = Parent();
+	if (pParent)
+		pParent->TraceAttack(pevAttacker, flDamage, vecDir, ptr, bitsDamageType);
+}
+
+BOOL CBuildStep::TakeDamage(entvars_t *pevInflictor, entvars_t *pevAttacker, float flDamage, int bitsDamageType)
+{
+	CBuildPiece *pParent = Parent();
+	return pParent ? pParent->TakeDamage(pevInflictor, pevAttacker, flDamage, bitsDamageType) : FALSE;
+}
+
+void BUILD_CleanUpMap()
+{
+	s_iBuildRound++;
+
+	CBaseEntity *pEntity = nullptr;
+	while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "build_piece")))
+		static_cast<CBuildPiece *>(pEntity)->Vanish();
+
+	pEntity = nullptr;
+	while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "build_step")))
+	{
+		pEntity->pev->solid = SOLID_NOT;
+		UTIL_SetOrigin(pEntity->pev, pEntity->pev->origin);
+		UTIL_Remove(pEntity);
+	}
+
+	UTIL_RemoveOther("build_bricks");
+	BUILD_ForgetPiles();
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// players: bricks, build mode
+
+static void BUILD_Deny(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, int iReason)
+{
+	MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_ONE, gmsgBuildDeny, nullptr, pPlayer->pev);
+		WRITE_BYTE(iReason);
+	MESSAGE_END();
+}
+
+static void BUILD_WeaponAnim(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, int iAnim)
+{
+	pPlayer->pev->weaponanim = iAnim;
+	MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_ONE, SVC_WEAPONANIM, nullptr, pPlayer->pev);
+		WRITE_BYTE(iAnim);
+		WRITE_BYTE(0);
+	MESSAGE_END();
+}
+
+static bool BUILD_CanPlay(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	return pPlayer->IsAlive() && pPlayer->GetObserverMode() == OBS_NONE && (pPlayer->m_iTeam == TERRORIST || pPlayer->m_iTeam == CT)
+		&& !pPlayer->IsBot();
+}
+
+static void BUILD_Leave(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, bool bRedeploy)
+{
+	if (!pPlayer->m_bBuildMode)
+		return;
+
+	pPlayer->m_bBuildMode = false;
+	pPlayer->m_pBuildItem = nullptr;
+
+	if (!bRedeploy)
+		return;
+
+	if (pPlayer->m_pActiveItem && pPlayer->IsAlive())
+	{
+		pPlayer->m_pActiveItem->Deploy();
+		pPlayer->m_pActiveItem->UpdateItemInfo();
+		pPlayer->ResetMaxSpeed();
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		pPlayer->pev->viewmodel = iStringNull;
+		pPlayer->pev->weaponmodel = iStringNull;
+	}
+}
+
+static int BUILD_Enter(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	if (!BUILD_On())
+		return BUILD_DISABLED;
+
+	if (!BUILD_CanPlay(pPlayer) || pPlayer->m_pTank)
+		return BUILD_CANNOT;
+
+	if (pPlayer->m_bBuildMode)
+		return BUILD_OK;
+
+	CBasePlayerItem *pItem = pPlayer->m_pActiveItem;
+	if (pItem && !pItem->CanHolster())
+		return BUILD_CANNOT;
+
+	if (pPlayer->m_bIsDefusing)
+		return BUILD_CANNOT;
+
+	if (pItem)
+		pItem->Holster();
+
+	// (a drawn shield down, the zoom off — and the speed they gave)
+	if (pItem && pItem->IsWeapon())
+		static_cast<CBasePlayerWeapon *>(pItem)->m_iWeaponState &= ~WPNSTATE_SHIELD_DRAWN;
+	if (pPlayer->m_bShieldDrawn)
+	{
+		pPlayer->m_bShieldDrawn = false;
+		pPlayer->UpdateShieldCrosshair(true);
+	}
+
+	pPlayer->m_bBuildMode = true;
+	pPlayer->m_pBuildItem = pItem;
+	pPlayer->m_iFOV = pPlayer->m_iLastZoom = DEFAULT_FOV;
+	pPlayer->pev->fov = DEFAULT_FOV;
+	pPlayer->m_bResumeZoom = false;
+	pPlayer->ResetMaxSpeed();
+	pPlayer->pev->viewmodel = MAKE_STRING(BUILD_VIEW_MODEL);
+	pPlayer->pev->weaponmodel = iStringNull;
+	BUILD_WeaponAnim(pPlayer, BUILD_VSEQ_DRAW);
+	pPlayer->m_flNextBuild = Q_max(pPlayer->m_flNextBuild, gpGlobals->time + 0.2f);
+	return BUILD_OK;
+}
+
+// (a new round or a spawn in build mode — a survivor keeps its weapon, never deployed again by Spawn —: back to it)
+static void BUILD_LeaveForRound(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	if (!pPlayer->m_bBuildMode)
+		return;
+
+	pPlayer->m_bBuildMode = false;
+	pPlayer->m_pBuildItem = nullptr;
+	if (pPlayer->m_pActiveItem)
+	{
+		pPlayer->m_pActiveItem->Deploy();
+		pPlayer->m_pActiveItem->UpdateItemInfo();
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		pPlayer->pev->viewmodel = iStringNull;
+		pPlayer->pev->weaponmodel = iStringNull;
+	}
+}
+
+void BUILD_PlayerSpawn(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	BUILD_LeaveForRound(pPlayer);
+	pPlayer->m_bBuildMode = false;
+	pPlayer->m_pBuildItem = nullptr;
+	pPlayer->m_flNextBuild = 0;
+
+	if (pPlayer->m_iBricksRound != s_iBuildRound)
+	{
+		pPlayer->m_iBricks = BUILD_StartBricks();
+		pPlayer->m_iBricksRound = s_iBuildRound;
+	}
+}
+
+// a player just put at its spawn spot (mid-round: joining, a forced respawn): the pieces it would be stuck in break
+void BUILD_PlayerSpawned(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	// (not a client just connected: ClientPutInServer spawns it at a spawn spot, then makes it a spectator)
+	if (pPlayer->m_bJustConnected || (pPlayer->m_iTeam != TERRORIST && pPlayer->m_iTeam != CT))
+		return;
+
+	const Vector vecMins = pPlayer->pev->origin + VEC_HULL_MIN, vecMaxs = pPlayer->pev->origin + VEC_HULL_MAX + Vector(0, 0, 1);
+	CBaseEntity *pEntity = nullptr;
+	while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "build_piece")))
+	{
+		if (pEntity->pev->flags & FL_KILLME)
+			continue;
+
+		CBuildPiece *pPiece = static_cast<CBuildPiece *>(pEntity);
+		build_spot_t spot = {};
+		spot.piece = pPiece->Piece();
+		spot.yaw = pPiece->Yaw();
+		spot.origin[0] = pEntity->pev->origin.x;
+		spot.origin[1] = pEntity->pev->origin.y;
+		spot.origin[2] = pEntity->pev->origin.z;
+		build_box(spot.piece, spot.yaw, spot.origin, spot.mins, spot.maxs);
+		if (build_overlaps_box(&spot, vecMins, vecMaxs))
+			pPiece->Destroy();
+	}
+}
+
+void BUILD_PlayerKilled(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	BUILD_Leave(pPlayer, false);
+}
+
+void BUILD_PlayerNewRound(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	BUILD_LeaveForRound(pPlayer);
+	pPlayer->m_iBricks = BUILD_StartBricks();
+	pPlayer->m_iBricksRound = s_iBuildRound;
+}
+
+bool BUILD_PlayerItemFrame(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	if (!pPlayer->m_bBuildMode)
+		return false;
+
+	// (out of it: building off, dead, or another weapon in hand — bought, picked —: that one stays)
+	if (!BUILD_On() || !BUILD_CanPlay(pPlayer) || pPlayer->m_pActiveItem != pPlayer->m_pBuildItem)
+	{
+		BUILD_Leave(pPlayer, BUILD_CanPlay(pPlayer) && pPlayer->m_pActiveItem == pPlayer->m_pBuildItem);
+		return false;
+	}
+
+	if (!FStrEq(STRING(pPlayer->pev->viewmodel), BUILD_VIEW_MODEL))
+		pPlayer->pev->viewmodel = MAKE_STRING(BUILD_VIEW_MODEL);
+
+	pPlayer->pev->weaponmodel = iStringNull;
+	return true;
+}
+
+bool BUILD_LeaveForWeapon(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, CBasePlayerItem *pNext)
+{
+	if (!pPlayer->m_bBuildMode)
+		return false;
+
+	BUILD_Leave(pPlayer, !pNext || pNext == pPlayer->m_pActiveItem);
+	return true;
+}
+
+void BUILD_PlayerUpdateClient(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, bool bInitHUD)
+{
+	if (bInitHUD)
+	{
+		pPlayer->m_iBricksSent = -1;
+		pPlayer->m_iBuildModeSent = -1;
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (pPlayer->IsBot())
+		return;
+
+	if (pPlayer->m_iBricks != pPlayer->m_iBricksSent || pPlayer->m_iBricksPicked > 0)
+	{
+		MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_ONE, gmsgBricks, nullptr, pPlayer->pev);
+			WRITE_SHORT(pPlayer->m_iBricks);
+			WRITE_BYTE(Q_min(pPlayer->m_iBricksPicked, 255));
+		MESSAGE_END();
+		pPlayer->m_iBricksSent = pPlayer->m_iBricks;
+		pPlayer->m_iBricksPicked = 0;
+	}
+
+	int iMode = (pPlayer->m_bBuildMode ? 1 : 0) | (BUILD_On() ? 2 : 0);
+	if (iMode != pPlayer->m_iBuildModeSent)
+	{
+		MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_ONE, gmsgBuildMode, nullptr, pPlayer->pev);
+			WRITE_BYTE(iMode);
+		MESSAGE_END();
+		pPlayer->m_iBuildModeSent = iMode;
+	}
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// placing a piece
+
+static void BUILD_EyeOf(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, float *eye, float *angles, float &feet)
+{
+	Vector vecEye = pPlayer->pev->origin + pPlayer->pev->view_ofs;
+	eye[0] = vecEye.x;
+	eye[1] = vecEye.y;
+	eye[2] = vecEye.z;
+	angles[0] = pPlayer->pev->v_angle.x;
+	angles[1] = pPlayer->pev->v_angle.y;
+	angles[2] = 0;
+	feet = pPlayer->pev->origin.z + pPlayer->pev->mins.z;
+}
+
+// Why a spot may not be built for this player (0: it may)
+static int BUILD_Check(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, const build_engine_t *e, const build_spot_t &spot, const float *eye)
+{
+	if (pPlayer->m_iBricks < BUILD_COST)
+		return BUILD_NO_BRICKS;
+
+	// (the caps: the player's pieces, all pieces, their entities, the edicts left)
+	int iMine = 0, iAll = 0, iEntities = 0;
+	bool bTaken = false;
+	CBaseEntity *pEntity = nullptr;
+	while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "build_piece")))
+	{
+		if (pEntity->pev->flags & FL_KILLME)
+			continue;
+
+		CBuildPiece *pPiece = static_cast<CBuildPiece *>(pEntity);
+		iAll++;
+		iEntities += pPiece->Entities();
+		if (pPiece->IsOwnedBy(pPlayer))
+			iMine++;
+
+		float o[3] = { pEntity->pev->origin.x, pEntity->pev->origin.y, pEntity->pev->origin.z };
+		if (build_same_slot(&spot, pPiece->Piece(), pPiece->Yaw(), o))
+			bTaken = true;
+	}
+
+	if (iMine >= BUILD_PLAYER_CAP)
+		return BUILD_MY_CAP;
+
+	// (the edicts: the game's margin kept, and room for every pile there may be)
+	const int iNeed = build_steps(spot.piece);
+	if (iAll >= BUILD_GLOBAL_CAP || iEntities + iNeed > BUILD_ENTITY_CAP
+		|| NUMBER_OF_ENTITIES() + iNeed + BUILD_EDICT_MARGIN + BUILD_PILE_CAP - BUILD_LivePiles() > gpGlobals->maxEntities)
+		return BUILD_ALL_CAP;
+
+	if (!build_in_reach(&spot, eye))
+		return BUILD_TOO_FAR;
+
+	if (bTaken)
+		return BUILD_BLOCKED;
+
+	// (players, hostages and Pokemon in its steps)
+	CBaseEntity *pList[64];
+	int n = UTIL_EntitiesInBox(pList, ARRAYSIZE(pList), Vector(spot.mins[0], spot.mins[1], spot.mins[2]), Vector(spot.maxs[0], spot.maxs[1], spot.maxs[2]), FL_CLIENT | FL_FAKECLIENT | FL_MONSTER);
+	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+	{
+		entvars_t *pevOther = pList[i]->pev;
+		if (pevOther->solid == SOLID_NOT || pevOther->deadflag != DEAD_NO || pevOther->health <= 0.0f)
+			continue;
+
+		if (build_overlaps_box(&spot, pevOther->absmin, pevOther->absmax))
+			return BUILD_BLOCKED;
+	}
+
+	// (spawn points: not refused — the client could not show it, and a spawn area is where a round's building starts;
+	// a player spawning into pieces later in a round breaks them: BUILD_PlayerSpawned)
+
+	if (build_world_blocked(e, &spot))
+		return BUILD_BLOCKED;
+
+	return BUILD_OK;
+}
+
+// The spot the server finds for a player: its own aim with the piece (turns: the one giving the client's spot, if the
+// client sent one and any does; aimed at the client's spot's centre if the view moved since — latency —; else the
+// turns giving the client's yaw, or 0)
+static void BUILD_FindSpot(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, const build_engine_t *e, int iPiece, const build_spot_t *pAsked, int iTurns, build_spot_t &spot)
+{
+	float eye[3], angles[3], feet;
+	BUILD_EyeOf(pPlayer, eye, angles, feet);
+
+	if (pAsked)
+	{
+		build_spot_t trySpot;
+		for (int t = 0; t < 4; t++)
+		{
+			build_aim(e, eye, angles, feet, iPiece, t, &trySpot);
+			if (build_same_slot(&trySpot, pAsked->piece, pAsked->yaw, pAsked->origin))
+			{
+				spot = trySpot;
+				return;
+			}
+		}
+
+		// (the view at the asked spot's centre, from the same eye)
+		float c[3];
+		build_box(pAsked->piece, pAsked->yaw, pAsked->origin, c, trySpot.maxs);
+		for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
+			c[k] = (c[k] + trySpot.maxs[k]) / 2 - eye[k];
+
+		float flHoriz = Q_sqrt(c[0] * c[0] + c[1] * c[1]);
+		if (flHoriz > 1.0f)
+		{
+			float aimed[3] = { float(-Q_atan2(c[2], flHoriz) * 180.0 / M_PI), float(Q_atan2(c[1], c[0]) * 180.0 / M_PI), 0 };
+			// (only a small correction: a view the player had a moment ago)
+			float dyaw = Q_fabs(UTIL_AngleDiff(aimed[1], angles[1])), dpitch = Q_fabs(aimed[0] - angles[0]);
+			if (dyaw < 30.0f && dpitch < 30.0f)
+			{
+				for (int t = 0; t < 4; t++)
+				{
+					build_aim(e, eye, aimed, feet, iPiece, t, &trySpot);
+					if (build_same_slot(&trySpot, pAsked->piece, pAsked->yaw, pAsked->origin))
+					{
+						spot = trySpot;
+						return;
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		// (its own, the turns that give the asked yaw)
+		for (int t = 0; t < 4; t++)
+		{
+			build_aim(e, eye, angles, feet, iPiece, t, &trySpot);
+			if (trySpot.yaw == pAsked->yaw)
+			{
+				spot = trySpot;
+				return;
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	build_aim(e, eye, angles, feet, iPiece, iTurns & 3, &spot);
+}
+
+static void BUILD_Place(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, int iPiece, const build_spot_t *pAsked, int iTurns)
+{
+	if (!BUILD_On())
+	{
+		BUILD_Deny(pPlayer, BUILD_DISABLED);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (!pPlayer->m_bBuildMode || !BUILD_CanPlay(pPlayer) || iPiece < 0 || iPiece >= BUILD_PIECES)
+	{
+		BUILD_Deny(pPlayer, BUILD_CANNOT);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	// (a moment between two: the quiet way to refuse a held button's repeats)
+	if (gpGlobals->time < pPlayer->m_flNextBuild)
+		return;
+
+	BuildTraceCtx ctx = { pPlayer->edict(), nullptr };
+	build_engine_t e = BUILD_Engine(&ctx);
+
+	build_spot_t spot;
+	BUILD_FindSpot(pPlayer, &e, iPiece, pAsked, iTurns, spot);
+
+	float eye[3], angles[3], feet;
+	BUILD_EyeOf(pPlayer, eye, angles, feet);
+	int iReason = BUILD_Check(pPlayer, &e, spot, eye);
+	if (iReason != BUILD_OK)
+	{
+		pPlayer->m_flNextBuild = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+		BUILD_Deny(pPlayer, iReason);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (!CBuildPiece::Create(pPlayer, spot))
+	{
+		BUILD_Deny(pPlayer, BUILD_ALL_CAP);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	pPlayer->m_iBricks -= BUILD_COST;
+	pPlayer->m_flNextBuild = gpGlobals->time + BUILD_PLACE_DELAY;
+	BUILD_WeaponAnim(pPlayer, BUILD_VSEQ_PLACE);
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// commands
+
+bool BUILD_ClientCommand(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, const char *pcmd)
+{
+	if (FStrEq(pcmd, "build_mode"))
+	{
+		bool bOn = CMD_ARGC() > 1 ? Q_atoi(CMD_ARGV(1)) != 0 : !pPlayer->m_bBuildMode;
+
+		// (each one answered by a BuildMode, the state as it is then — the client counts its answers)
+		pPlayer->m_iBuildModeSent = -1;
+		if (!bOn)
+		{
+			BUILD_Leave(pPlayer, true);
+			return true;
+		}
+
+		int iReason = BUILD_Enter(pPlayer);
+		if (iReason != BUILD_OK)
+			BUILD_Deny(pPlayer, iReason);
+		return true;
+	}
+
+	if (FStrEq(pcmd, "build_place"))
+	{
+		int iPiece = CMD_ARGC() > 1 ? Q_atoi(CMD_ARGV(1)) : 0;
+		build_spot_t asked = {};
+		const build_spot_t *pAsked = nullptr;
+		int iTurns = 0;
+		if (CMD_ARGC() > 5)
+		{
+			asked.piece = iPiece;
+			asked.origin[0] = float(Q_atof(CMD_ARGV(2)));
+			asked.origin[1] = float(Q_atof(CMD_ARGV(3)));
+			asked.origin[2] = float(Q_atof(CMD_ARGV(4)));
+			asked.yaw = ((Q_atoi(CMD_ARGV(5)) % 360) + 360) % 360;
+			pAsked = &asked;
+			if (CMD_ARGC() > 6)
+				iTurns = Q_atoi(CMD_ARGV(6));
+		}
+		else if (CMD_ARGC() > 2)
+			iTurns = Q_atoi(CMD_ARGV(2));
+
+		BUILD_Place(pPlayer, iPiece, pAsked, iTurns);
+		return true;
+	}
+
+	if (FStrEq(pcmd, "build_give"))
+	{
+		if (CVAR_GET_FLOAT("sv_cheats") == 0.0f)
+		{
+			ClientPrint(pPlayer->pev, HUD_PRINTCONSOLE, "build_give needs sv_cheats 1\n");
+			return true;
+		}
+
+		int n = CMD_ARGC() > 1 ? Q_atoi(CMD_ARGV(1)) : 100;
+		pPlayer->m_iBricks = clamp(pPlayer->m_iBricks + n, 0, BUILD_MAX_BRICKS);
+		return true;
+	}
+
+	if (FStrEq(pcmd, "build_info"))
+	{
+		int iMine = 0, iAll = 0, iEntities = 0, iPiles = 0;
+		CBaseEntity *pEntity = nullptr;
+		while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "build_piece")))
+		{
+			CBuildPiece *pPiece = static_cast<CBuildPiece *>(pEntity);
+			iAll++;
+			iEntities += pPiece->Entities();
+			if (pPiece->IsOwnedBy(pPlayer))
+				iMine++;
+		}
+
+		pEntity = nullptr;
+		while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "build_bricks")))
+			iPiles++;
+
+		char line[256];
+		Q_snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "build: mp_build %d, bricks %d, build mode %d, pieces %d mine / %d all (%d entities), piles %d, edicts %d/%d\n",
+			int(build_enabled.value), pPlayer->m_iBricks, pPlayer->m_bBuildMode ? 1 : 0, iMine, iAll, iEntities, iPiles, NUMBER_OF_ENTITIES(), gpGlobals->maxEntities);
+		ClientPrint(pPlayer->pev, HUD_PRINTCONSOLE, line);
+		return true;
+	}
+
+	return false;
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// build_test (the server console's, sv_cheats 1): place [piece] — every living player, bots too, builds where it looks
+// (its reason printed when refused); hurt <n> — every piece hurt by the world; status; clear
+
+static void BUILD_TestCommand()
+{
+	if (CVAR_GET_FLOAT("sv_cheats") == 0.0f)
+	{
+		SERVER_PRINT("build_test needs sv_cheats 1\n");
+		return;
+	}
+
+	const char *arg1 = CMD_ARGC() > 1 ? CMD_ARGV(1) : "status";
+	char line[256];
+
+	if (!Q_stricmp(arg1, "place"))
+	{
+		int iAsked = CMD_ARGC() > 2 ? Q_atoi(CMD_ARGV(2)) : -1;
+		for (int i = 1; i <= gpGlobals->maxClients; i++)
+		{
+			CBasePlayer *pPlayer = UTIL_PlayerByIndex(i);
+			if (!pPlayer || !pPlayer->IsAlive() || pPlayer->GetObserverMode() != OBS_NONE)
+				continue;
+
+			int iPiece = iAsked >= 0 ? iAsked % BUILD_PIECES : RANDOM_LONG(0, BUILD_PIECES - 1);
+			BuildTraceCtx ctx = { pPlayer->edict(), nullptr };
+			build_engine_t e = BUILD_Engine(&ctx);
+			build_spot_t spot;
+			BUILD_FindSpot(pPlayer, &e, iPiece, nullptr, 0, spot);
+
+			float eye[3], angles[3], feet;
+			BUILD_EyeOf(pPlayer, eye, angles, feet);
+			int iBricks = pPlayer->m_iBricks;
+			pPlayer->m_iBricks = BUILD_MAX_BRICKS;
+			int iReason = BUILD_Check(pPlayer, &e, spot, eye);
+			pPlayer->m_iBricks = iBricks;
+
+			CBuildPiece *pPiece = iReason == BUILD_OK ? CBuildPiece::Create(pPlayer, spot) : nullptr;
+			Q_snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "build_test: %s piece %d at %.0f %.0f %.0f yaw %d (eye %.0f %.0f %.0f view %.0f %.0f): %s %d\n",
+				STRING(pPlayer->pev->netname), iPiece, spot.origin[0], spot.origin[1], spot.origin[2], spot.yaw, eye[0], eye[1], eye[2], angles[0], angles[1],
+				pPiece ? "built #" : "refused, reason", pPiece ? pPiece->entindex() : iReason);
+			SERVER_PRINT(line);
+		}
+	}
+	else if (!Q_stricmp(arg1, "hurt"))
+	{
+		float flDamage = CMD_ARGC() > 2 ? float(Q_atof(CMD_ARGV(2))) : 100.0f;
+		CBaseEntity *pEntity = nullptr;
+		while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "build_piece")))
+		{
+			if (!(pEntity->pev->flags & FL_KILLME))
+				pEntity->TakeDamage(VARS(INDEXENT(0)), VARS(INDEXENT(0)), flDamage, DMG_GENERIC);
+		}
+	}
+	else if (!Q_stricmp(arg1, "clear"))
+	{
+		BUILD_CleanUpMap();
+	}
+	else if (!Q_stricmp(arg1, "rain"))
+	{
+		// (n drops on a grid of 64 units over the first living player: no two merge — the cap's check)
+		int n = CMD_ARGC() > 2 ? Q_atoi(CMD_ARGV(2)) : 150;
+		for (int i = 1; i <= gpGlobals->maxClients; i++)
+		{
+			CBasePlayer *pPlayer = UTIL_PlayerByIndex(i);
+			if (!pPlayer || !pPlayer->IsAlive())
+				continue;
+
+			for (int k = 0; k < n; k++)
+				CBrickPile::Drop(pPlayer->pev->origin + Vector(float((k % 16) * 64 - 512), float((k / 16) * 64 - 512), 0), BUILD_DROP);
+			break;
+		}
+	}
+	else if (!Q_stricmp(arg1, "boom"))
+	{
+		// (a grenade's blast — 100, radius 350, by the first living player — 48 units in front of every piece's middle)
+		CBasePlayer *pBy = nullptr;
+		for (int i = 1; i <= gpGlobals->maxClients && !pBy; i++)
+		{
+			CBasePlayer *pPlayer = UTIL_PlayerByIndex(i);
+			if (pPlayer && pPlayer->IsAlive())
+				pBy = pPlayer;
+		}
+
+		if (!pBy)
+			return;
+
+		CBaseEntity *pList[256];
+		int n = 0;
+		CBaseEntity *pEntity = nullptr;
+		while (n < int(ARRAYSIZE(pList)) && (pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "build_piece")))
+		{
+			if (!(pEntity->pev->flags & FL_KILLME))
+				pList[n++] = pEntity;
+		}
+
+		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
+		{
+			CBuildPiece *pPiece = static_cast<CBuildPiece *>(pList[i]);
+			build_spot_t spot = {};
+			spot.piece = pPiece->Piece();
+			spot.yaw = pPiece->Yaw();
+			spot.origin[0] = pPiece->pev->origin.x;
+			spot.origin[1] = pPiece->pev->origin.y;
+			spot.origin[2] = pPiece->pev->origin.z;
+			build_box(spot.piece, spot.yaw, spot.origin, spot.mins, spot.maxs);
+			Vector vecMid((spot.mins[0] + spot.maxs[0]) / 2, (spot.mins[1] + spot.maxs[1]) / 2, (spot.mins[2] + spot.maxs[2]) / 2);
+			Vector vecAt = vecMid + Vector(0, 0, 48);
+			float flBefore = pPiece->pev->health;
+			::RadiusDamage(vecAt, pBy->pev, pBy->pev, 100, 350, CLASS_NONE, DMG_EXPLOSION);
+			Q_snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "build_test: boom on #%d piece %d: health %.0f -> %.0f\n", pPiece->entindex(), spot.piece, flBefore,
+				(pPiece->pev->flags & FL_KILLME) ? 0.0f : float(pPiece->pev->health));
+			SERVER_PRINT(line);
+		}
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		int iPieces = 0, iSteps = 0, iPiles = 0, iBricks = 0;
+		CBaseEntity *pEntity = nullptr;
+		while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "build_piece")))
+		{
+			if (pEntity->pev->flags & FL_KILLME)
+				continue;
+
+			CBuildPiece *pPiece = static_cast<CBuildPiece *>(pEntity);
+			iPieces++;
+			Q_snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "build_test: #%d piece %d at %.0f %.0f %.0f yaw %d health %.0f skin %d render %d/%.0f box %.0f %.0f %.0f .. %.0f %.0f %.0f entities %d\n",
+				pPiece->entindex(), pPiece->Piece(), pEntity->pev->origin.x, pEntity->pev->origin.y, pEntity->pev->origin.z, pPiece->Yaw(),
+				pEntity->pev->health, pEntity->pev->skin, pEntity->pev->rendermode, pEntity->pev->renderamt,
+				pEntity->pev->absmin.x, pEntity->pev->absmin.y, pEntity->pev->absmin.z, pEntity->pev->absmax.x, pEntity->pev->absmax.y, pEntity->pev->absmax.z,
+				pPiece->Entities());
+			SERVER_PRINT(line);
+		}
+
+		pEntity = nullptr;
+		while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "build_step")))
+		{
+			if (!(pEntity->pev->flags & FL_KILLME))
+				iSteps++;
+		}
+
+		pEntity = nullptr;
+		while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "build_bricks")))
+		{
+			if (pEntity->pev->flags & FL_KILLME)
+				continue;
+
+			iPiles++;
+			iBricks += static_cast<CBrickPile *>(pEntity)->m_iAmount;
+		}
+
+		Q_snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "build_test: mp_build %d mp_build_bricks %d, %d pieces, %d steps, %d piles (%d bricks), edicts %d/%d\n",
+			int(build_enabled.value), BUILD_StartBricks(), iPieces, iSteps, iPiles, iBricks, NUMBER_OF_ENTITIES(), gpGlobals->maxEntities);
+		SERVER_PRINT(line);
+
+		for (int i = 1; i <= gpGlobals->maxClients; i++)
+		{
+			CBasePlayer *pPlayer = UTIL_PlayerByIndex(i);
+			if (!pPlayer)
+				continue;
+
+			Q_snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "build_test: player %s bricks %d build mode %d\n", STRING(pPlayer->pev->netname), pPlayer->m_iBricks, pPlayer->m_bBuildMode ? 1 : 0);
+			SERVER_PRINT(line);
+		}
+	}
+}

+/*
+build_grid.h - Half Strike's building grid: where a piece goes from a player's view, and the checks of a spot.
+Shared, header-only, by the game (dlls/wpn_shared/build.cpp) and the client (cl_dll/arsenal_ui.cpp: the blueprint):
+the same function on both sides, the engine reached through callbacks only (no engine header here).
+
+The grid: tiles of BUILD_TILE (128) units, anchored to the world in x and y. In z, a cell's base is the ground under
+it (a trace down at its centre — the world, or a built piece: then that piece's levels), then levels of 128 over it.
+Pieces, each in its own frame (origin = the bottom centre of its cell; models and collision boxes match it):
+  wall   x -64..64, y -4..4, z 0..128          (yaw 0: along x; yaw 90: along y), on a tile edge
+  floor  x -64..64, y -64..64, z -4..4          (centred on the level's plane, as walls on their edge: a floor on top
+                                               of walls is level 1)
+  ramp   x -64..64, y -64..64, z 0..128        rising toward +x of its frame (yaw: the way it rises): 8 stairs of
+                                               16 x 16, step i: x -64+16i..-48+16i, z 16i..16i+16 (its underside
+                                               open: the visual's plane z = x + 56)
+  roof   x -64..64, y -64..64, z 0..64         a pyramid shell, apex (0, 0, 64); steps i = 0..3: half 56-16i,
+                                               z 16i..16i+16
+Ramps and roofs collide as those steps (build_step_box): solid boxes a player walks up. The numbers are the models'
+(tools/goldsrc/assets/pokemon/bricks.py, its PIECE CONTRACT).
+A slot (what may not be built twice): the same piece at the same origin (and, for a wall, the same axis).
+A piece is never built on the far side of what the view hit (a wall's grid line past a world wall, a floor or a roof
+rounded up over a ceiling): build_aim takes the nearer line or the lower level then, and build_world_blocked refuses a
+piece neither the aim point nor the eye reaches (the world and brush entities between them).
+*/
+#ifndef BUILD_GRID_H
+#define BUILD_GRID_H
+
+#include <math.h>
+
+#define BUILD_TILE        128
+#define BUILD_WALL_THICK  8
+#define BUILD_FLOOR_THICK 8
+#define BUILD_ROOF_HEIGHT 64
+#define BUILD_STEP        16
+#define BUILD_COST        10
+#define BUILD_REACH       ( 4 * BUILD_TILE )       // (the aim traced that far; a piece's centre at most that far + 64)
+#define BUILD_NOHIT       ( 1.5f * BUILD_TILE )    // (the aim at nothing: the point that far along it)
+#define BUILD_CLIP        34.0f                    // (the world check: the box shrunk by that much on its sides — x and
+                                                   // y: a piece may clip a quarter tile into world walls (and 2 units, a
+                                                   // face exactly there: touching), as the grid is not the map's;
+                                                   // build_reached keeps it from passing through them —...)
+#define BUILD_SHRINK      2.0f                     // (...by that much at its top...)
+#define BUILD_SINK        10.0f                    // (...and its bottom raised by that much: pieces rest on the ground)
+#define BUILD_MAX_BRICKS  999
+
+enum { BUILD_WALL, BUILD_FLOOR, BUILD_RAMP, BUILD_ROOF, BUILD_PIECES };
+
+// the steps of a piece (ramps 8, roofs 4; walls and floors: their box, 1)
+static inline int build_steps( int piece ) { return piece == BUILD_RAMP ? BUILD_TILE / BUILD_STEP : piece == BUILD_ROOF ? BUILD_ROOF_HEIGHT / BUILD_STEP : 1; }
+
+typedef struct
+{
+	int piece;
+	int yaw;          // degrees, 0/90/180/270 (walls: 0 or 90)
+	float origin[3];  // the bottom centre of the cell (walls: of the edge); integers
+	float mins[3], maxs[3]; // the whole piece's box, world (absolute)
+	int aimed;        // set by build_aim: aim (the view's hit, a unit back) and eye kept for build_world_blocked's
+	float aim[3], eye[3];   // reach check (spots made otherwise: aimed 0, no such check)
+} build_spot_t;
+
+// The engine, for build_aim / build_check: a line traced (world and brush entities, built pieces included — not
+// players; worldOnly: the world and brush entities alone), the fraction of it travelled and where it stopped; the start
+// inside a solid (a built piece too, without worldOnly): startsolid set.
+typedef struct
+{
+	void *ctx;
+	// returns the fraction (1: nothing hit), end filled, *startsolid set
+	float ( *trace )( void *ctx, const float *start, const float *end, int worldOnly, float *endpos, int *startsolid );
+	// optional (NULL: none): whether the last trace stopped on a built piece or one of its steps, and that piece's
+	// origin z (steps share their piece's origin) — a cell over a piece takes its levels (origin_z + n * 128)
+	int ( *piece )( void *ctx, float *origin_z );
+} build_engine_t;
+
+// the box of a piece at an origin and yaw (absolute)
+static inline void build_box( int piece, int yaw, const float *o, float *mins, float *maxs )
+{
+	float hx = BUILD_TILE / 2, hy = BUILD_TILE / 2, z0 = 0, z1 = BUILD_TILE;
+	if ( piece == BUILD_WALL )
+	{
+		if ( yaw % 180 == 0 ) hy = BUILD_WALL_THICK / 2;
+		else hx = BUILD_WALL_THICK / 2;
+	}
+	else if ( piece == BUILD_FLOOR ) { z0 = -BUILD_FLOOR_THICK / 2; z1 = BUILD_FLOOR_THICK / 2; }
+	else if ( piece == BUILD_ROOF ) z1 = BUILD_ROOF_HEIGHT;
+	mins[0] = o[0] - hx; maxs[0] = o[0] + hx;
+	mins[1] = o[1] - hy; maxs[1] = o[1] + hy;
+	mins[2] = o[2] + z0; maxs[2] = o[2] + z1;
+}
+
+// the i-th collision step of a piece (absolute): ramps' stairs (16 x 16 each, rising), roofs' nested slabs
+static inline void build_step_box( const build_spot_t *s, int i, float *mins, float *maxs )
+{
+	build_box( s->piece, s->yaw, s->origin, mins, maxs );
+	const float *o = s->origin;
+	if ( s->piece == BUILD_RAMP )
+	{
+		const float half = BUILD_TILE / 2, from = -half + i * BUILD_STEP, to = from + BUILD_STEP; // (along the way it rises)
+		mins[2] = o[2] + i * BUILD_STEP; maxs[2] = mins[2] + BUILD_STEP;
+		switch ((( s->yaw % 360 ) + 360 ) % 360 )
+		{
+		case 0:   mins[0] = o[0] + from; maxs[0] = o[0] + to; break;
+		case 90:  mins[1] = o[1] + from; maxs[1] = o[1] + to; break;
+		case 180: mins[0] = o[0] - to; maxs[0] = o[0] - from; break;
+		default:  mins[1] = o[1] - to; maxs[1] = o[1] - from; break;
+		}
+	}
+	else if ( s->piece == BUILD_ROOF )
+	{
+		const float half = BUILD_TILE / 2 - 8 - i * BUILD_STEP; // (56, 40, 24, 8)
+		mins[0] = o[0] - half; maxs[0] = o[0] + half;
+		mins[1] = o[1] - half; maxs[1] = o[1] + half;
+		mins[2] = o[2] + i * BUILD_STEP; maxs[2] = mins[2] + BUILD_STEP;
+	}
+}
+
+static inline int build_cell( float v ) { return (int)floorf( v / BUILD_TILE ); }
+
+// the base of a cell: the ground under the point (x, y), traced down from z (a solid start: fallback)
+static inline float build_base( const build_engine_t *e, float x, float y, float z, float fallback )
+{
+	float a[3] = { x, y, z }, b[3] = { x, y, z - 3 * BUILD_TILE }, end[3];
+	int startsolid = 0;
+	const float f = e->trace( e->ctx, a, b, 0, end, &startsolid );
+	if ( startsolid || f >= 1.0f )
+		return floorf( fallback + 0.5f );
+	float pz;
+	if ( e->piece && e->piece( e->ctx, &pz ))
+		return floorf( pz + floorf(( end[2] - pz + 8.0f ) / BUILD_TILE ) * BUILD_TILE + 0.5f ); // (on a piece: its levels)
+	return floorf( end[2] + 0.5f );
+}
+
+// the box build_world_blocked checks: the piece's, shrunk on its sides (by BUILD_CLIP: a wall's thickness to its middle
+// plane), its bottom raised (a floor: just over its top)
+static inline void build_check_box( const build_spot_t *s, float *lo, float *hi )
+{
+	for ( int k = 0; k < 2; k++ )
+	{
+		lo[k] = s->mins[k] + BUILD_CLIP; hi[k] = s->maxs[k] - BUILD_CLIP;
+		if ( lo[k] > hi[k] ) lo[k] = hi[k] = ( s->mins[k] + s->maxs[k] ) / 2;
+	}
+	lo[2] = s->mins[2] + BUILD_SINK; hi[2] = s->maxs[2] - BUILD_SHRINK;
+	if ( lo[2] > hi[2] ) lo[2] = hi[2] = s->maxs[2] + 1; // (a floor: just over its top, where it is stood on)
+}
+
+// whether the aim point or the eye reaches the piece (the nearest point of its check box), the world and brush
+// entities between them counted (worldOnly traces): no piece behind a wall or over a ceiling the view hit
+static inline int build_reached( const build_engine_t *e, const build_spot_t *s )
+{
+	float lo[3], hi[3], p[3];
+	build_check_box( s, lo, hi );
+	for ( int from = 0; from < 2; from++ )
+	{
+		const float *a = from ? s->eye : s->aim;
+		float d2 = 0;
+		for ( int k = 0; k < 3; k++ )
+		{
+			p[k] = a[k] < lo[k] ? lo[k] : a[k] > hi[k] ? hi[k] : a[k];
+			d2 += ( p[k] - a[k] ) * ( p[k] - a[k] );
+		}
+		if ( d2 < 1.0f )
+			return 1;
+		float end[3];
+		int startsolid = 0;
+		const float f = e->trace( e->ctx, a, p, 1, end, &startsolid );
+		if ( !startsolid && f >= 1.0f )
+			return 1;
+	}
+	return 0;
+}
+
+// the spot for an aim point (nearer: the wall's grid line one tile toward the eye, the level one lower)
+static inline void build_spot_at( const build_engine_t *e, const float *eye, const float *aim, float yawdeg, float feet, int piece, int turns, int nearer, build_spot_t *s )
+{
+	// (the player's facing, to the nearest quarter: 0 +x, 1 +y, 2 -x, 3 -y)
+	float yaw = fmodf( yawdeg, 360.0f );
+	if ( yaw < 0 ) yaw += 360;
+	const int facing = (int)floorf(( yaw + 45 ) / 90 ) & 3;
+	const int T = BUILD_TILE;
+	s->piece = piece;
+	float o[3];
+	if ( piece == BUILD_WALL )
+	{
+		// (across the facing — or along it, turned once —, on the grid line nearest the aim, in the aim's cell)
+		const int across = ( facing + turns ) & 1; // (0: across x — on a line x = n*128, along y; 1: across y)
+		const int ax = across, other = 1 - ax;
+		float line = floorf( aim[ax] / T + 0.5f ) * T;
+		if ( nearer )
+			line += ( eye[ax] < aim[ax] ? -T : T ) * nearer;
+		o[ax] = line;
+		o[other] = build_cell( aim[other] ) * T + T / 2;
+		// (its base: the ground of the cell on the player's side of the line)
+		float sample[2];
+		sample[ax] = line + ( eye[ax] >= line ? T / 2 : -T / 2 );
+		sample[other] = o[other];
+		const float base = build_base( e, sample[0], sample[1], eye[2], feet );
+		const int level = (int)floorf(( aim[2] - base ) / T );
+		o[2] = base + ( level > 0 ? level : 0 ) * T;
+		s->yaw = across ? 0 : 90; // (across x: the wall spans y, yaw 90)
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		o[0] = build_cell( aim[0] ) * T + T / 2;
+		o[1] = build_cell( aim[1] ) * T + T / 2;
+		const float base = build_base( e, o[0], o[1], eye[2], feet );
+		const float h = ( aim[2] - base ) / T;
+		// (ramps in the level aimed at; floors on a level line — the aim straight ahead: at the feet, at the top of a
+		// wall: over it —; roofs on the walls of the level aimed at)
+		int level = piece == BUILD_FLOOR ? (int)floorf( h + 0.25f ) : piece == BUILD_ROOF ? (int)floorf( h + 0.75f ) : (int)floorf( h );
+		if ( nearer )
+			level--;
+		o[2] = base + ( level > 0 ? level : 0 ) * T;
+		s->yaw = piece == BUILD_RAMP ? (( facing + turns ) & 3 ) * 90 : 0; // (floors and roofs: square, whichever way)
+	}
+	for ( int k = 0; k < 3; k++ ) { s->origin[k] = o[k]; s->aim[k] = aim[k]; s->eye[k] = eye[k]; }
+	s->aimed = 1;
+	build_box( piece, s->yaw, s->origin, s->mins, s->maxs );
+}
+
+static inline int build_world_blocked( const build_engine_t *e, const build_spot_t *s );
+
+// Where a piece goes: the view (eye, angles in degrees: pitch, yaw), the player's feet height, the piece and the
+// player's turns of it (R: 0..3). Always gives a spot (build_world_blocked says whether the world lets it be built).
+// A spot past what the view hit (not reached: build_reached) gives way to the nearer line or the lower level.
+static inline void build_aim( const build_engine_t *e, const float *eye, const float *angles, float feet, int piece, int turns, build_spot_t *s )
+{
+	const float pr = angles[0] * 3.14159265f / 180, yr = angles[1] * 3.14159265f / 180;
+	const float fwd[3] = { cosf( pr ) * cosf( yr ), cosf( pr ) * sinf( yr ), -sinf( pr ) };
+	float end[3], aim[3];
+	for ( int k = 0; k < 3; k++ ) end[k] = eye[k] + fwd[k] * BUILD_REACH;
+	int startsolid = 0;
+	const float f = e->trace( e->ctx, eye, end, 0, aim, &startsolid );
+	if ( f >= 1.0f || startsolid )
+		for ( int k = 0; k < 3; k++ ) aim[k] = eye[k] + fwd[k] * BUILD_NOHIT;
+	else
+		for ( int k = 0; k < 3; k++ ) aim[k] -= fwd[k]; // (a unit back: on the near side of what it hit)
+
+	build_spot_at( e, eye, aim, angles[1], feet, piece, turns, 0, s );
+	if ( !build_reached( e, s ))
+	{
+		build_spot_at( e, eye, aim, angles[1], feet, piece, turns, 1, s );
+		return;
+	}
+	// (the slot aimed at cuts into the map — a wall aimed at a map wall falls on its grid line, inside it —: the one a
+	// tile nearer, as Fortnite builds in front of what is aimed at, when the world lets it be built)
+	// (walls: up to 3 lines nearer, never past the player's own cell's line)
+	const int tries = piece == BUILD_WALL ? 3 : 1;
+	for ( int n = 1; n <= tries && build_world_blocked( e, s ); n++ )
+	{
+		build_spot_t nearer;
+		build_spot_at( e, eye, aim, angles[1], feet, piece, turns, n, &nearer );
+		if ( piece == BUILD_WALL )
+		{
+			const int ax = nearer.yaw ? 0 : 1; // (yaw 90: on a line x = n*128; yaw 0: on a line y = n*128)
+			if (( eye[ax] < aim[ax] ) ? nearer.origin[ax] < eye[ax] - BUILD_TILE : nearer.origin[ax] > eye[ax] + BUILD_TILE )
+				break;
+		}
+		if ( !build_world_blocked( e, &nearer ))
+			*s = nearer;
+	}
+}
+
+// whether two boxes overlap (by more than a unit)
+static inline int build_boxes_overlap( const float *amin, const float *amax, const float *bmin, const float *bmax )
+{
+	for ( int k = 0; k < 3; k++ )
+		if ( amin[k] >= bmax[k] - 1 || bmin[k] >= amax[k] - 1 )
+			return 0;
+	return 1;
+}
+
+// whether a box (a player's, absolute) cuts into a piece: its steps for ramps and roofs (a player in the empty part
+// over a ramp's low end does not block it), its box for the others
+static inline int build_overlaps_box( const build_spot_t *s, const float *mins, const float *maxs )
+{
+	const int n = build_steps( s->piece );
+	for ( int i = 0; i < n; i++ )
+	{
+		float lo[3], hi[3];
+		build_step_box( s, i, lo, hi );
+		if ( build_boxes_overlap( lo, hi, mins, maxs ))
+			return 1;
+	}
+	return 0;
+}
+
+// whether two spots are the same slot
+static inline int build_same_slot( const build_spot_t *a, int piece, int yaw, const float *origin )
+{
+	if ( a->piece != piece )
+		return 0;
+	for ( int k = 0; k < 3; k++ )
+		if ( fabsf( a->origin[k] - origin[k] ) > 2 )
+			return 0;
+	return piece != BUILD_WALL || ( a->yaw % 180 ) == ( yaw % 180 );
+}
+
+// in reach of the eye
+static inline int build_in_reach( const build_spot_t *s, const float *eye )
+{
+	float c[3], d2 = 0;
+	for ( int k = 0; k < 3; k++ ) { c[k] = ( s->mins[k] + s->maxs[k] ) / 2 - eye[k]; d2 += c[k] * c[k]; }
+	return d2 <= ( BUILD_REACH + 64.0f ) * ( BUILD_REACH + 64.0f );
+}
+
+// whether the world and brush entities (worldOnly traces; pieces are slots, players are checked apart) cut into the
+// piece's box, shrunk (build_check_box: pieces clip up to BUILD_CLIP into walls on their sides): its 12 edges and 4
+// diagonals traced; or (a spot from build_aim) whether the piece is on the far
+// side of them from the aim point and the eye (build_reached)
+static inline int build_world_blocked( const build_engine_t *e, const build_spot_t *s )
+{
+	float lo[3], hi[3];
+	build_check_box( s, lo, hi );
+	float c[8][3];
+	for ( int i = 0; i < 8; i++ )
+	{
+		c[i][0] = ( i & 1 ) ? hi[0] : lo[0];
+		c[i][1] = ( i & 2 ) ? hi[1] : lo[1];
+		c[i][2] = ( i & 4 ) ? hi[2] : lo[2];
+	}
+	static const int lines[16][2] = { { 0, 1 }, { 2, 3 }, { 4, 5 }, { 6, 7 }, { 0, 2 }, { 1, 3 }, { 4, 6 }, { 5, 7 },
+		{ 0, 4 }, { 1, 5 }, { 2, 6 }, { 3, 7 }, { 0, 7 }, { 1, 6 }, { 2, 5 }, { 3, 4 } };
+	for ( int i = 0; i < 16; i++ )
+	{
+		float end[3];
+		int startsolid = 0;
+		const float f = e->trace( e->ctx, c[lines[i][0]], c[lines[i][1]], 1, end, &startsolid );
+		if ( startsolid || f < 1.0f )
+			return 1;
+	}
+	return s->aimed == 1 && !build_reached( e, s );
+}
+
+// why a spot may not be built (the server's BuildDeny reasons); 0: it may
+enum { BUILD_OK, BUILD_NO_BRICKS, BUILD_BLOCKED, BUILD_TOO_FAR, BUILD_MY_CAP, BUILD_ALL_CAP, BUILD_DISABLED, BUILD_CANNOT };
+
+#endif // BUILD_GRID_H

+// Half-Life arsenal (hl_weapons.h): the Half-Life SDK's weapons on Counter-Strike's weapon classes. Their fire events
+// reach the shooter too (no FEV_NOTHOST: the client does not predict them); their timers are the decremented ones of
+// Counter-Strike's weapons, their own delays in game time. Their entities are named with MAKE_STRING_CLASS: the game
+// finds entities by classname in a table of its own, which a bare pev->classname does not enter.
+#include "precompiled.h"
+#include "ars_lang.h"
+
+extern bool g_bClientPrintEnable; // (client.cpp)

+// (the Half-Life SDK's aim cones)
+static const Vector HL_CONE_SHOTGUN(0.0675f, 0.0675f, 0.0f);
+static const Vector HL_CONE_DOUBLESHOTGUN(0.09f, 0.06f, 0.0f);
+
+float HL_ArmorRatio(int id)
+{
+	switch (id)
+	{
+		case WEAPON_HL_CROWBAR:  return 1.7f;  // (as the knife)
+		case WEAPON_HL_GLOCK:    return 1.05f; // (as the Glock 18)
+		case WEAPON_HL_PYTHON:   return 1.5f;  // (as the Desert Eagle)
+		case WEAPON_HL_CROSSBOW: return 1.7f;  // (as the Scout)
+		case WEAPON_HL_GAUSS:
+		case WEAPON_HL_EGON:     return 1.5f;
+		default:                 return 1.0f;
+	}
+}

+bool CHLWeapon::CanFire()
+{
+	return !g_pGameRules->IsMultiplayer() || (m_pPlayer->m_bCanShoot && !g_pGameRules->IsFreezePeriod() && !m_pPlayer->m_bIsDefusing);
+}
+
+// Whether a player is an enemy of a team, for the weapons that choose their target (never their owner's own)
+static bool HL_IsEnemyOf(int iTeam, CBaseEntity *pEntity, CBaseEntity *pOwner)
+{
+	if (!pEntity || pEntity == pOwner || !pEntity->IsPlayer() || !pEntity->IsAlive())
+		return false;
+
+	CBasePlayer *pPlayer = static_cast<CBasePlayer *>(pEntity);
+	if (pPlayer->m_iTeam != CT && pPlayer->m_iTeam != TERRORIST)
+		return false;
+
+#ifdef REGAMEDLL_ADD
+	if (CSGameRules()->IsFreeForAll())
+		return true;
+#endif
+
+	return pPlayer->m_iTeam != iTeam;
+}
+
+static int HL_TeamOf(edict_t *pOwner)
+{
+	CBaseEntity *pEntity = pOwner ? CBaseEntity::Instance(pOwner) : nullptr;
+	return (pEntity && pEntity->IsPlayer()) ? static_cast<CBasePlayer *>(pEntity)->m_iTeam : UNASSIGNED;
+}
+
+// The nearest enemy player a hunter sees within a range, in its field of view (the cosine, on the horizontal plane)
+static CBaseEntity *HL_FindEnemy(CBaseEntity *pHunter, int iTeam, CBaseEntity *pOwner, float flRange, float flFieldOfView)
+{
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(pHunter->pev->angles);
+	Vector2D vecForward = gpGlobals->v_forward.Make2D().Normalize();
+
+	CBaseEntity *pBest = nullptr;
+	float flBest = flRange;
+
+	for (int i = 1; i <= gpGlobals->maxClients; i++)
+	{
+		CBasePlayer *pPlayer = UTIL_PlayerByIndex(i);
+		if (!UTIL_IsValidPlayer(pPlayer) || !HL_IsEnemyOf(iTeam, pPlayer, pOwner))
+			continue;
+
+		float flDist = (pPlayer->Center() - pHunter->pev->origin).Length();
+		if (flDist >= flBest)
+			continue;
+
+		Vector2D vecLOS = (pPlayer->pev->origin - pHunter->pev->origin).Make2D().Normalize();
+		if (DotProduct(vecLOS, vecForward) <= flFieldOfView)
+			continue;
+
+		if (!pHunter->FVisible(pPlayer))
+			continue;
+
+		pBest = pPlayer;
+		flBest = flDist;
+	}
+
+	return pBest;
+}
+
+// Half-Life's radius damage, through no wall (bodies do not shield, as in Counter-Strike). On players as a grenade's
+// (DMG_EXPLOSION: the kill counts, unlike the bomb's DMG_BLAST), and not on the attacker's teammates without friendly fire.
+static void HL_RadiusDamage(Vector vecSrc, entvars_t *pevInflictor, entvars_t *pevAttacker, float flDamage, float flRadius, int bitsDamageType = DMG_EXPLOSION)
+{
+	if (!pevAttacker)
+		pevAttacker = pevInflictor;
+
+	CBaseEntity *pAttacker = CBaseEntity::Instance(pevAttacker);
+	CBasePlayer *pAttackingPlayer = (pAttacker && pAttacker->IsPlayer()) ? static_cast<CBasePlayer *>(pAttacker) : nullptr;
+
+	float falloff = flRadius ? flDamage / flRadius : 1.0f;
+	bool bInWater = (UTIL_PointContents(vecSrc) == CONTENTS_WATER);
+	vecSrc.z += 1.0f; // (in case it lies on the ground)
+
+	// (Half Strike r11: a blast by a wall drops bricks)
+	BUILD_ExplosionImpact(pevAttacker, vecSrc, flRadius, flDamage);
+
+	CBaseEntity *pEntity = nullptr;
+	while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityInSphere(pEntity, vecSrc, flRadius)))
+	{
+		if (pEntity->pev->takedamage == DAMAGE_NO)
+			continue;
+
+		// (blasts do not go into or out of water)
+		if (bInWater && pEntity->pev->waterlevel == 0)
+			continue;
+
+		if (!bInWater && pEntity->pev->waterlevel == 3)
+			continue;
+
+		if (pAttackingPlayer && pEntity->IsPlayer() && pEntity != pAttackingPlayer && !friendlyfire.value
+			&& g_pGameRules->PlayerRelationship(pAttackingPlayer, pEntity) == GR_TEAMMATE)
+			continue;
+
+		Vector vecSpot = pEntity->BodyTarget(vecSrc);
+		TraceResult tr;
+		UTIL_TraceLine(vecSrc, vecSpot, ignore_monsters, ENT(pevInflictor), &tr);
+		if (tr.flFraction != 1.0f && tr.pHit != pEntity->edict())
+			continue;
+
+		if (tr.fStartSolid)
+			tr.vecEndPos = vecSrc;
+
+		// (Half Strike r11: a player or a monster behind a built piece is shielded; a piece by its nearest point)
+		if (BUILD_BlastShielded(pEntity, vecSrc, vecSpot, ENT(pevInflictor)))
+			continue;
+
+		float flAdjustedDamage = flDamage - BUILD_BlastDistance(pEntity, vecSrc, (vecSrc - tr.vecEndPos).Length()) * falloff;
+		if (flAdjustedDamage < 1.0f)
+			continue;
+
+		pEntity->TakeDamage(pevInflictor, pevAttacker, flAdjustedDamage, bitsDamageType);
+	}
+}
+
+// An explosion at a point: the Half-Life fireball, its blast damage, a scorch mark
+static void HL_Explosion(CBaseEntity *pSource, TraceResult *pTrace, entvars_t *pevOwner, float flDamage, float flRadius, int iScale)
+{
+	Vector origin = pSource->pev->origin;
+	if (pTrace && pTrace->flFraction != 1.0f)
+		origin = pTrace->vecEndPos + pTrace->vecPlaneNormal * 8.0f; // (out of the wall a bit)
+
+	pSource->pev->origin = origin;
+	iScale = clamp(iScale, 1, 255);
+
+	int iContents = UTIL_PointContents(origin);
+	MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_PAS, SVC_TEMPENTITY, origin);
+		WRITE_BYTE(TE_EXPLOSION);
+		WRITE_COORD(origin.x);
+		WRITE_COORD(origin.y);
+		WRITE_COORD(origin.z);
+		WRITE_SHORT(iContents != CONTENTS_WATER ? g_sModelIndexFireball : g_sModelIndexWExplosion);
+		WRITE_BYTE(iScale); // scale * 10
+		WRITE_BYTE(15); // framerate
+		WRITE_BYTE(TE_EXPLFLAG_NONE);
+	MESSAGE_END();
+
+	pSource->pev->owner = nullptr; // (the blast traces must not skip the owner)
+	HL_RadiusDamage(origin, pSource->pev, pevOwner, flDamage, flRadius);
+
+	if (pTrace && pTrace->flFraction != 1.0f)
+		UTIL_DecalTrace(pTrace, RANDOM_LONG(0, 1) ? DECAL_SCORCH1 : DECAL_SCORCH2);
+}
+
+static void HL_SetZoom(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, int fov)
+{
+	pPlayer->m_iFOV = fov;
+	pPlayer->pev->fov = fov;
+}
+
+// A weapon's spread, still, moving faster than a walk, or in the air
+static float HL_Spread(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, float flStill, float flMoving, float flAir, float flWalkSpeed = 0.0f)
+{
+	if (!(pPlayer->pev->flags & FL_ONGROUND))
+		return flAir;
+
+	return pPlayer->pev->velocity.Length2D() > flWalkSpeed ? flMoving : flStill;
+}
+
+static void HL_SetViewModels(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, const char *szViewModel, const char *szWeaponModel)
+{
+	pPlayer->pev->viewmodel = ALLOC_STRING(szViewModel);
+	pPlayer->pev->weaponmodel = ALLOC_STRING(szWeaponModel);
+}

+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Crowbar
+
+enum hl_crowbar_e
+{
+	CROWBAR_IDLE = 0,
+	CROWBAR_DRAW,
+	CROWBAR_HOLSTER,
+	CROWBAR_ATTACK1HIT,
+	CROWBAR_ATTACK1MISS,
+	CROWBAR_ATTACK2MISS,
+	CROWBAR_ATTACK2HIT,
+	CROWBAR_ATTACK3MISS,
+	CROWBAR_ATTACK3HIT
+};
+
+#define HL_CROWBAR_BODYHIT_VOLUME 128
+#define HL_CROWBAR_WALLHIT_VOLUME 512
+

+void CHLCrowbar::Holster(int skiplocal)
+{
+	m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+	SendWeaponAnim(CROWBAR_HOLSTER);
+}
+
+void CHLCrowbar::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	if (!Swing(TRUE))
+	{
+		// (a miss: one more try a moment later, the target may have come closer)
+		SetThink(&CHLCrowbar::SwingAgain);
+		pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLCrowbar::SwingAgain()
+{
+	Swing(FALSE);
+}
+
+void CHLCrowbar::Smack()
+{
+	DecalGunshot(&m_trHit, BULLET_PLAYER_CROWBAR, false, m_pPlayer ? m_pPlayer->pev : nullptr, false);
+}
+
+BOOL CHLCrowbar::Swing(BOOL fFirst)
+{
+	if (!m_pPlayer)
+		return FALSE;
+
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle);
+	Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->GetGunPosition();
+	Vector vecEnd = vecSrc + gpGlobals->v_forward * 32.0f;
+
+	UTIL_TraceLine(vecSrc, vecEnd, dont_ignore_monsters, ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), &tr);
+	if (tr.flFraction >= 1.0f)
+	{
+		UTIL_TraceHull(vecSrc, vecEnd, dont_ignore_monsters, head_hull, ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), &tr);
+		if (tr.flFraction < 1.0f)
+		{
+			// (the point of the object the hull hit)
+			CBaseEntity *pHit = CBaseEntity::Instance(tr.pHit);
+			if (!pHit || pHit->IsBSPModel())
+				FindHullIntersection(vecSrc, tr, VEC_DUCK_HULL_MIN, VEC_DUCK_HULL_MAX, m_pPlayer->edict());
+
+			vecEnd = tr.vecEndPos;
+		}
+	}
+
+	if (tr.flFraction >= 1.0f)
+	{
+		if (fFirst)
+		{
+			static const int missAnims[] = { CROWBAR_ATTACK1MISS, CROWBAR_ATTACK2MISS, CROWBAR_ATTACK3MISS };
+			SendWeaponAnim(missAnims[(m_iSwing++) % 3]);
+			EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "weapons/cbar_miss1.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, 94 + RANDOM_LONG(0, 15));
+			m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.5f);
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 2.0f;
+			m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+		}
+
+		return FALSE;
+	}
+
+	static const int hitAnims[] = { CROWBAR_ATTACK1HIT, CROWBAR_ATTACK2HIT, CROWBAR_ATTACK3HIT };
+	SendWeaponAnim(hitAnims[(m_iSwing++) % 3]);
+	m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.35f);
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 2.0f;
+
+	float flVol = 1.0f;
+	bool bHitWorld = true;
+
+	CBaseEntity *pEntity = CBaseEntity::Instance(tr.pHit);
+	if (pEntity)
+	{
+		ClearMultiDamage();
+		pEntity->TraceAttack(m_pPlayer->pev, HL_CROWBAR_DAMAGE, gpGlobals->v_forward, &tr, DMG_NEVERGIB | DMG_BULLET);
+		ApplyMultiDamage(m_pPlayer->pev, m_pPlayer->pev);
+
+		if (pEntity->Classify() != CLASS_NONE && pEntity->Classify() != CLASS_MACHINE && pEntity->Classify() != CLASS_VEHICLE)
+		{
+			static const char *bodySounds[] = { "weapons/cbar_hitbod1.wav", "weapons/cbar_hitbod2.wav", "weapons/cbar_hitbod3.wav" };
+			EMIT_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_ITEM, bodySounds[RANDOM_LONG(0, 2)], VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+			m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = HL_CROWBAR_BODYHIT_VOLUME;
+
+			if (!pEntity->IsAlive())
+				return TRUE;
+
+			flVol = 0.1f;
+			bHitWorld = false;
+		}
+	}
+
+	if (bHitWorld)
+	{
+		TEXTURETYPE_PlaySound(&tr, vecSrc, vecSrc + (vecEnd - vecSrc) * 2.0f, BULLET_PLAYER_CROWBAR);
+		EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_ITEM, RANDOM_LONG(0, 1) ? "weapons/cbar_hit2.wav" : "weapons/cbar_hit1.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, 98 + RANDOM_LONG(0, 3));
+
+		// (its mark a moment later)
+		m_trHit = tr;
+		SetThink(&CHLCrowbar::Smack);
+		pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.2f;
+	}
+
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = int(flVol * HL_CROWBAR_WALLHIT_VOLUME);
+	return TRUE;
+}
+
+void CHLCrowbar::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	SendWeaponAnim(CROWBAR_IDLE);
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+}

+void CHLGlock::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	GlockFire(HL_Spread(m_pPlayer, 0.01f, 0.04f, 0.15f), 0.25f, true);
+}
+
+void CHLGlock::SecondaryAttack()
+{
+	if (!CanFire())
+		return;
+
+	GlockFire(HL_Spread(m_pPlayer, 0.07f, 0.09f, 0.2f), 0.15f, false);
+}
+
+void CHLGlock::GlockFire(float flSpread, float flCycleTime, bool bAimed)
+{
+	if (m_iClip <= 0)
+	{
+		if (m_fFireOnEmpty)
+		{
+			PlayEmptySound();
+			m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.2f);
+		}
+
+		return;
+	}
+
+	m_iClip--;
+	m_pPlayer->pev->effects |= EF_MUZZLEFLASH;
+	m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = NORMAL_GUN_VOLUME;
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponFlash = NORMAL_GUN_FLASH;
+
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle);
+	Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->GetGunPosition();
+	Vector vecDir = m_pPlayer->FireBullets3(vecSrc, gpGlobals->v_forward, flSpread, 8192, 1, BULLET_PLAYER_9MM, HL_GLOCK_DAMAGE, 0.75f, m_pPlayer->pev, true, m_pPlayer->random_seed);
+
+	PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), bAimed ? m_usFireGlock1 : m_usFireGlock2, 0.0f, (float *)&g_vecZero, (float *)&g_vecZero, vecDir.x, vecDir.y, 0, 0, m_iClip == 0, 0);
+
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = m_flNextSecondaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(flCycleTime);
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+	m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle.x -= bAimed ? 1.0f : 1.5f;
+}
+
+void CHLGlock::Reload()
+{
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0 || m_iClip == HL_GLOCK_MAX_CLIP)
+		return;
+
+	if (DefaultReload(HL_GLOCK_MAX_CLIP, m_iClip == 0 ? GLOCK_RELOAD : GLOCK_RELOAD_NOT_EMPTY, 1.5f))
+	{
+		m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_RELOAD);
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLGlock::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	ResetEmptySound();
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() || m_iClip == 0)
+		return;
+
+	int iAnim;
+	float flRand = UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 0.0f, 1.0f);
+	if (flRand <= 0.3f)
+	{
+		iAnim = GLOCK_IDLE3;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 49.0f / 16.0f;
+	}
+	else if (flRand <= 0.6f)
+	{
+		iAnim = GLOCK_IDLE1;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 60.0f / 16.0f;
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		iAnim = GLOCK_IDLE2;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 40.0f / 16.0f;
+	}
+
+	SendWeaponAnim(iAnim);
+}

+	pev->body = 1; // (the multiplayer scope)
+	return DefaultDeploy("models/v_357.mdl", "models/p_357.mdl", PYTHON_DRAW, "onehanded", 0);
+}
+
+void CHLPython::Holster(int skiplocal)
+{
+	m_fInReload = FALSE;
+	HL_SetZoom(m_pPlayer, DEFAULT_FOV);
+	m_flSoundTime = 0.0f;
+	SendWeaponAnim(PYTHON_HOLSTER);
+}
+
+void CHLPython::SecondaryAttack()
+{
+	HL_SetZoom(m_pPlayer, m_pPlayer->m_iFOV != DEFAULT_FOV ? DEFAULT_FOV : 45); // (above 40: no sniper scope over it)
+	m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+}
+
+void CHLPython::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	if (m_pPlayer->pev->waterlevel == 3)
+	{
+		PlayEmptySound();
+		m_flNextPrimaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.15f;
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (m_iClip <= 0)
+	{
+		if (!m_fFireOnEmpty)
+			Reload();
+		else
+		{
+			PlayEmptySound();
+			m_flNextPrimaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.15f;
+		}
+		return;
+	}
+
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = LOUD_GUN_VOLUME;
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponFlash = BRIGHT_GUN_FLASH;
+	m_iClip--;
+	m_pPlayer->pev->effects |= EF_MUZZLEFLASH;
+	m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle);
+	Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->GetGunPosition();
+	Vector vecDir = m_pPlayer->FireBullets3(vecSrc, gpGlobals->v_forward, HL_Spread(m_pPlayer, 0.01f, 0.04f, 0.15f), 8192, 2, BULLET_PLAYER_50AE, HL_PYTHON_DAMAGE, 0.86f, m_pPlayer->pev, true, m_pPlayer->random_seed);
+
+	PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usFirePython, 0.0f, (float *)&g_vecZero, (float *)&g_vecZero, vecDir.x, vecDir.y, 0, 0, 0, 0);
+
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.75f);
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+	m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle.x -= 4.0f;
+}
+
+void CHLPython::Reload()
+{
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0 || m_iClip == HL_PYTHON_MAX_CLIP)
+		return;
+
+	HL_SetZoom(m_pPlayer, DEFAULT_FOV);
+	if (DefaultReload(HL_PYTHON_MAX_CLIP, PYTHON_RELOAD, 2.0f))
+	{
+		m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_RELOAD);
+		m_flSoundTime = gpGlobals->time + 1.5f;
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLPython::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	ResetEmptySound();
+
+	if (m_flSoundTime != 0.0f && m_flSoundTime <= gpGlobals->time)
+	{
+		EMIT_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "weapons/357_reload1.wav", RANDOM_FLOAT(0.8f, 0.9f), ATTN_NORM);
+		m_flSoundTime = 0.0f;
+	}
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	int iAnim;
+	float flRand = UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 0.0f, 1.0f);
+	if (flRand <= 0.5f)
+	{
+		iAnim = PYTHON_IDLE1;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + (70.0f / 30.0f);
+	}
+	else if (flRand <= 0.7f)
+	{
+		iAnim = PYTHON_IDLE2;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + (60.0f / 30.0f);
+	}
+	else if (flRand <= 0.9f)
+	{
+		iAnim = PYTHON_IDLE3;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + (88.0f / 30.0f);
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		iAnim = PYTHON_FIDGET;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + (170.0f / 30.0f);
+	}
+	SendWeaponAnim(iAnim);
+}

+void CHLMP5::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	if (m_pPlayer->pev->waterlevel == 3 || m_iClip <= 0)
+	{
+		PlayEmptySound();
+		m_flNextPrimaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.15f;
+		return;
+	}
+
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = NORMAL_GUN_VOLUME;
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponFlash = NORMAL_GUN_FLASH;
+	m_iClip--;
+	m_pPlayer->pev->effects |= EF_MUZZLEFLASH;
+	m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle);
+	Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->GetGunPosition();
+	Vector vecDir = m_pPlayer->FireBullets3(vecSrc, gpGlobals->v_forward, HL_Spread(m_pPlayer, 0.03f, 0.06f, 0.2f, 140.0f), 8192, 1, BULLET_PLAYER_9MM, HL_MP5_DAMAGE, 0.84f, m_pPlayer->pev, false, m_pPlayer->random_seed);
+
+	PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usMP5, 0.0f, (float *)&g_vecZero, (float *)&g_vecZero, vecDir.x, vecDir.y, 0, 0, 0, 0);
+
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.1f);
+	if (m_flNextPrimaryAttack < UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		m_flNextPrimaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.1f;
+
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+	m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle.x -= RANDOM_FLOAT(0.3f, 0.8f);
+	m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle.y += RANDOM_FLOAT(-0.4f, 0.4f);
+}
+
+void CHLMP5::SecondaryAttack()
+{
+	if (!CanFire())
+		return;
+
+	if (m_pPlayer->pev->waterlevel == 3 || m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iSecondaryAmmoType] <= 0)
+	{
+		PlayEmptySound();
+		m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+		return;
+	}
+
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = NORMAL_GUN_VOLUME;
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponFlash = BRIGHT_GUN_FLASH;
+	m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iSecondaryAmmoType]--;
+	m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle);
+	CHLGrenade::ShootContact(m_pPlayer->pev, m_pPlayer->pev->origin + m_pPlayer->pev->view_ofs + gpGlobals->v_forward * 16.0f, gpGlobals->v_forward * 800.0f);
+
+	PLAYBACK_EVENT(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usMP52);
+
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(1.0f);
+	m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 5.0f;
+	m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle.x -= 5.0f;
+}
+
+void CHLMP5::Reload()
+{
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0 || m_iClip == HL_MP5_MAX_CLIP)
+		return;
+
+	if (DefaultReload(HL_MP5_MAX_CLIP, MP5_RELOAD, 1.5f))
+		m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_RELOAD);
+}
+
+void CHLMP5::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	ResetEmptySound();
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	SendWeaponAnim(RANDOM_LONG(0, 1) ? MP5_IDLE1 : MP5_LONGIDLE);
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+}

+	SHOTGUN_START_RELOAD,
+	SHOTGUN_DRAW,
+	SHOTGUN_HOLSTER,
+	SHOTGUN_IDLE4,
+	SHOTGUN_IDLE_DEEP
+};

+void CHLShotgun::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	Fire(1);
+}
+
+void CHLShotgun::SecondaryAttack()
+{
+	if (!CanFire())
+		return;
+
+	Fire(2);
+}
+
+void CHLShotgun::Fire(int iShells)
+{
+	if (m_pPlayer->pev->waterlevel == 3)
+	{
+		PlayEmptySound();
+		m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.15f);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (m_iClip < iShells)
+	{
+		Reload();
+		if (m_iClip == 0 || iShells > 1)
+			PlayEmptySound();
+
+		return;
+	}
+
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = LOUD_GUN_VOLUME;
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponFlash = NORMAL_GUN_FLASH;
+	m_iClip -= iShells;
+	m_pPlayer->pev->effects |= EF_MUZZLEFLASH;
+	m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle);
+	Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->GetGunPosition();
+	Vector vecAiming = gpGlobals->v_forward;
+	Vector vecCone = (iShells > 1) ? HL_CONE_DOUBLESHOTGUN : HL_CONE_SHOTGUN;
+	m_pPlayer->FireBuckshots(HL_SHOTGUN_PELLETS * iShells, vecSrc, vecAiming, vecCone, 3000.0f, 0, HL_SHOTGUN_DAMAGE, m_pPlayer->pev);
+
+	PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), iShells > 1 ? m_usDoubleFire : m_usSingleFire, 0.0f, (float *)&g_vecZero, (float *)&g_vecZero, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
+
+	float flDelay = (iShells > 1) ? 1.5f : 0.75f;
+	m_flPumpTime = gpGlobals->time + ((iShells > 1) ? 0.95f : 0.5f);
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(flDelay);
+	m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + flDelay;
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + (m_iClip ? flDelay + 4.5f : flDelay);
+	m_fInSpecialReload = 0;
+	m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle.x -= (iShells > 1) ? 10.0f : 5.0f;
+}
+
+// (shell by shell: to the side, one in, again, then the pump)
+void CHLShotgun::Reload()
+{
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0 || m_iClip == HL_SHOTGUN_MAX_CLIP)
+		return;
+
+	if (m_flNextPrimaryAttack > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	if (m_fInSpecialReload == 0)
+	{
+		m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_RELOAD);
+		SendWeaponAnim(SHOTGUN_START_RELOAD);
+		m_fInSpecialReload = 1;
+		m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.6f;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.6f;
+		m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(1.0f);
+		m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+	}
+	else if (m_fInSpecialReload == 1)
+	{
+		if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+			return;
+
+		m_fInSpecialReload = 2;
+		EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_ITEM, RANDOM_LONG(0, 1) ? "weapons/reload1.wav" : "weapons/reload3.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, 85 + RANDOM_LONG(0, 0x1f));
+		SendWeaponAnim(SHOTGUN_RELOAD);
+		m_flNextReload = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		m_iClip++;
+		m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType]--;
+		m_fInSpecialReload = 1;
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLShotgun::ItemPostFrame()
+{
+	if (m_flPumpTime != 0.0f && m_flPumpTime < gpGlobals->time)
+	{
+		EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_ITEM, "weapons/scock1.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, 95 + RANDOM_LONG(0, 0x1f));
+		m_flPumpTime = 0.0f;
+	}
+
+	CBasePlayerWeapon::ItemPostFrame();
+}
+
+void CHLShotgun::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	ResetEmptySound();
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle >= UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	if (m_iClip == 0 && m_fInSpecialReload == 0 && m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+	{
+		Reload();
+	}
+	else if (m_fInSpecialReload != 0)
+	{
+		if (m_iClip != HL_SHOTGUN_MAX_CLIP && m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+		{
+			Reload();
+		}
+		else
+		{
+			SendWeaponAnim(SHOTGUN_PUMP);
+			EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_ITEM, "weapons/scock1.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, 95 + RANDOM_LONG(0, 0x1f));
+			m_fInSpecialReload = 0;
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.5f;
+		}
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		int iAnim;
+		float flRand = UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 0.0f, 1.0f);
+		if (flRand <= 0.8f)
+		{
+			iAnim = SHOTGUN_IDLE_DEEP;
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + (60.0f / 12.0f);
+		}
+		else if (flRand <= 0.95f)
+		{
+			iAnim = SHOTGUN_IDLE;
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + (20.0f / 9.0f);
+		}
+		else
+		{
+			iAnim = SHOTGUN_IDLE4;
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + (20.0f / 9.0f);
+		}
+		SendWeaponAnim(iAnim);
+	}
+}

+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Crossbow and its bolt
+
+#define HL_BOLT_AIR_VELOCITY   2000
+#define HL_BOLT_WATER_VELOCITY 1000
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(crossbow_bolt, CHLCrossbowBolt, CCSEntity)
+
+CHLCrossbowBolt *CHLCrossbowBolt::BoltCreate()
+{
+	CHLCrossbowBolt *pBolt = GetClassPtr<CCSEntity>((CHLCrossbowBolt *)nullptr);
+	MAKE_STRING_CLASS("crossbow_bolt", pBolt->pev);
+	pBolt->Spawn();
+	return pBolt;
+}
+
+void CHLCrossbowBolt::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_FLY;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_BBOX;
+	pev->gravity = 0.5f;
+
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/crossbow_bolt.mdl");
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pev, pev->origin);
+	UTIL_SetSize(pev, Vector(0, 0, 0), Vector(0, 0, 0));
+
+	SetTouch(&CHLCrossbowBolt::BoltTouch);
+	SetThink(&CHLCrossbowBolt::BubbleThink);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.2f;
+}
+
+void CHLCrossbowBolt::Precache()
+{
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/crossbow_bolt.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/xbow_hitbod1.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/xbow_hitbod2.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/xbow_fly1.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/xbow_hit1.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("fvox/beep.wav");
+}
+
+void CHLCrossbowBolt::BoltTouch(CBaseEntity *pOther)
+{
+	SetTouch(nullptr);
+	SetThink(nullptr);
+
+	if (pOther->pev->takedamage)
+	{
+		TraceResult tr = UTIL_GetGlobalTrace();
+		entvars_t *pevOwner = VARS(pev->owner);
+
+		ClearMultiDamage();
+		pOther->TraceAttack(pevOwner, HL_CROSSBOW_BOLT_DAMAGE, pev->velocity.Normalize(), &tr, DMG_BULLET | DMG_NEVERGIB);
+		ApplyMultiDamage(pev, pevOwner);
+
+		pev->velocity = Vector(0, 0, 0);
+		EMIT_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_BODY, RANDOM_LONG(0, 1) ? "weapons/xbow_hitbod2.wav" : "weapons/xbow_hitbod1.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_BODY, "weapons/xbow_hit1.wav", RANDOM_FLOAT(0.95f, 1.0f), ATTN_NORM, 0, 98 + RANDOM_LONG(0, 7));
+
+		if (UTIL_PointContents(pev->origin) != CONTENTS_WATER)
+			UTIL_Sparks(pev->origin);
+	}
+
+	// (the multiplayer bolt explodes where it lands)
+	SetThink(&CHLCrossbowBolt::ExplodeThink);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+}
+
+void CHLCrossbowBolt::BubbleThink()
+{
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+
+	if (pev->waterlevel == 0)
+		return;
+
+	UTIL_BubbleTrail(pev->origin - pev->velocity * 0.1f, pev->origin, 1);
+}
+
+void CHLCrossbowBolt::ExplodeThink()
+{
+	entvars_t *pevOwner = pev->owner ? VARS(pev->owner) : nullptr;
+	HL_Explosion(this, nullptr, pevOwner, HL_CROSSBOW_BOLT_BLAST, 128, 10);
+	UTIL_Remove(this);
+}

+	CROSSBOW_FIRE3,     // empty

+void CHLCrossbow::Holster(int skiplocal)
+{
