+
+void CHLCrossbow::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_iFOV != DEFAULT_FOV)
+		FireSniperBolt();
+	else
+		FireBolt();
+}
+
+void CHLCrossbow::FireSniperBolt()
+{
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.75f);
+
+	if (m_iClip == 0)
+	{
+		PlayEmptySound();
+		return;
+	}
+
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = QUIET_GUN_VOLUME;
+	m_iClip--;
+
+	PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usCrossbow2, 0.0f, (float *)&g_vecZero, (float *)&g_vecZero, 0, 0, m_iClip, 0, 0, 0);
+	m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle);
+	Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->GetGunPosition() - gpGlobals->v_up * 2.0f;
+	Vector vecDir = gpGlobals->v_forward;
+
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(vecSrc, vecSrc + vecDir * 8192, dont_ignore_monsters, m_pPlayer->edict(), &tr);
+	if (tr.pHit && tr.pHit->v.takedamage)
+	{
+		ClearMultiDamage();
+		CBaseEntity::Instance(tr.pHit)->TraceAttack(m_pPlayer->pev, HL_CROSSBOW_SNIPER_DAMAGE, vecDir, &tr, DMG_BULLET | DMG_NEVERGIB);
+		ApplyMultiDamage(pev, m_pPlayer->pev);
+	}
+
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + (m_iClip ? 5.0f : 0.75f);
+}
+
+void CHLCrossbow::FireBolt()
+{
+	if (m_iClip == 0)
+	{
+		PlayEmptySound();
+		return;
+	}
+
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = QUIET_GUN_VOLUME;
+	m_iClip--;
+
+	PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usCrossbow, 0.0f, (float *)&g_vecZero, (float *)&g_vecZero, 0, 0, m_iClip, 0, 0, 0);
+	m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+
+	Vector anglesAim = m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle;
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(anglesAim);
+	anglesAim.x = -anglesAim.x;
+
+	Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->GetGunPosition() - gpGlobals->v_up * 2.0f;
+	Vector vecDir = gpGlobals->v_forward;
+
+	CHLCrossbowBolt *pBolt = CHLCrossbowBolt::BoltCreate();
+	pBolt->pev->origin = vecSrc;
+	pBolt->pev->angles = anglesAim;
+	pBolt->pev->owner = m_pPlayer->edict();
+
+	float speed = (m_pPlayer->pev->waterlevel == 3) ? HL_BOLT_WATER_VELOCITY : HL_BOLT_AIR_VELOCITY;
+	pBolt->pev->velocity = vecDir * speed;
+	pBolt->pev->speed = speed;
+	pBolt->pev->avelocity.z = 10.0f;
+
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.75f);
+	m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.75f;
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + (m_iClip ? 5.0f : 0.75f);
+}
+
+void CHLCrossbow::SecondaryAttack()
+{
+	HL_SetZoom(m_pPlayer, m_pPlayer->m_iFOV != DEFAULT_FOV ? DEFAULT_FOV : 20);
+	m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+}
+
+void CHLCrossbow::Reload()
+{
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0 || m_iClip == HL_CROSSBOW_MAX_CLIP)
+		return;
+
+	HL_SetZoom(m_pPlayer, DEFAULT_FOV);
+	if (DefaultReload(HL_CROSSBOW_MAX_CLIP, CROSSBOW_RELOAD, 4.5f))
+	{
+		m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_RELOAD);
+		EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_ITEM, "weapons/xbow_reload1.wav", RANDOM_FLOAT(0.95f, 1.0f), ATTN_NORM, 0, 93 + RANDOM_LONG(0, 0xF));
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLCrossbow::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	ResetEmptySound();
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle >= UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	if (UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 0, 1) <= 0.75f)
+		SendWeaponAnim(m_iClip ? CROSSBOW_IDLE1 : CROSSBOW_IDLE2);
+	else
+		SendWeaponAnim(m_iClip ? CROSSBOW_FIDGET1 : CROSSBOW_FIDGET2);
+
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10, 15);
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Hornet gun and its hornets
+
+enum hl_hgun_e
+{
+	HGUN_IDLE1 = 0,
+	HGUN_FIDGETSWAY,
+	HGUN_FIDGETSHAKE,
+	HGUN_DOWN,
+	HGUN_UP,
+	HGUN_SHOOT
+};
+
+#define HL_HORNET_TYPE_RED     0
+#define HL_HORNET_TYPE_ORANGE  1
+#define HL_HORNET_RED_SPEED    600.0f
+#define HL_HORNET_ORANGE_SPEED 800.0f
+#define HL_HORNET_BUZZ_VOLUME  0.8f
+#define HL_HORNET_RECHARGE     0.3f // (a hornet back, in multiplayer)
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(hornet, CHLHornet, CCSAnimating)
+
+void CHLHornet::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	MAKE_STRING_CLASS("hornet", pev);
+	pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_FLY;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_BBOX;
+	pev->takedamage = DAMAGE_YES;
+	pev->health = 1; // (weak)
+
+	m_flStopAttack = gpGlobals->time + 3.5f;
+	if (RANDOM_LONG(1, 5) <= 2)
+	{
+		m_iHornetType = HL_HORNET_TYPE_RED;
+		m_flFlySpeed = HL_HORNET_RED_SPEED;
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		m_iHornetType = HL_HORNET_TYPE_ORANGE;
+		m_flFlySpeed = HL_HORNET_ORANGE_SPEED;
+	}
+
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/hornet.mdl");
+	UTIL_SetSize(pev, Vector(-4, -4, -4), Vector(4, 4, 4));
+
+	m_hEnemy = nullptr;
+	m_vecEnemyLKP = g_vecZero;
+	m_iOwnerTeam = HL_TeamOf(pev->owner);
+	pev->dmg = HL_HORNET_DAMAGE;
+
+	SetTouch(&CHLHornet::DieTouch);
+	SetThink(&CHLHornet::StartTrack);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+	ResetSequenceInfo();
+}
+
+void CHLHornet::Precache()
+{
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/hornet.mdl");
+
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("hornet/ag_buzz1.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("hornet/ag_buzz2.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("hornet/ag_buzz3.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("hornet/ag_hornethit1.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("hornet/ag_hornethit2.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("hornet/ag_hornethit3.wav");
+
+	m_iTrail = PRECACHE_MODEL("sprites/laserbeam.spr");
+}
+
+void CHLHornet::StartTrack()
+{
+	IgniteTrail();
+	SetTouch(&CHLHornet::TrackTouch);
+	SetThink(&CHLHornet::TrackTarget);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+}
+
+void CHLHornet::StartDart()
+{
+	IgniteTrail();
+	SetTouch(&CHLHornet::DieTouch);
+	SetThink(&CBaseEntity::SUB_Remove);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 4.0f;
+}
+
+void CHLHornet::IgniteTrail()
+{
+	MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_BROADCAST, SVC_TEMPENTITY);
+		WRITE_BYTE(TE_BEAMFOLLOW);
+		WRITE_SHORT(entindex());
+		WRITE_SHORT(m_iTrail);
+		WRITE_BYTE(10); // life
+		WRITE_BYTE(2);  // width
+		if (m_iHornetType == HL_HORNET_TYPE_RED)
+		{
+			WRITE_BYTE(179); // r, g, b
+			WRITE_BYTE(39);
+			WRITE_BYTE(14);
+		}
+		else
+		{
+			WRITE_BYTE(255);
+			WRITE_BYTE(128);
+			WRITE_BYTE(0);
+		}
+		WRITE_BYTE(128); // brightness
+	MESSAGE_END();
+}
+
+void CHLHornet::Buzz()
+{
+	static const char *sounds[] = { "hornet/ag_buzz1.wav", "hornet/ag_buzz2.wav", "hornet/ag_buzz3.wav" };
+	EMIT_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, sounds[RANDOM_LONG(0, 2)], HL_HORNET_BUZZ_VOLUME, ATTN_NORM);
+}
+
+bool CHLHornet::IsEnemy(CBaseEntity *pOther)
+{
+	return HL_IsEnemyOf(m_iOwnerTeam, pOther, pev->owner ? CBaseEntity::Instance(pev->owner) : nullptr);
+}
+
+void CHLHornet::TrackTarget()
+{
+	StudioFrameAdvance();
+
+	if (gpGlobals->time > m_flStopAttack)
+	{
+		SetTouch(nullptr);
+		SetThink(&CBaseEntity::SUB_Remove);
+		pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+		return;
+	}
+
+	// (an enemy within 25 degrees of its heading, as Half-Life's)
+	if (!m_hEnemy.IsValid() || !IsEnemy(m_hEnemy))
+		m_hEnemy = HL_FindEnemy(this, m_iOwnerTeam, pev->owner ? CBaseEntity::Instance(pev->owner) : nullptr, 512, 0.9f);
+
+	if (m_hEnemy.IsValid() && FVisible(m_hEnemy))
+		m_vecEnemyLKP = m_hEnemy->BodyTarget(pev->origin);
+	else
+		m_vecEnemyLKP = m_vecEnemyLKP + pev->velocity * m_flFlySpeed * 0.1f;
+
+	Vector vecDirToEnemy = (m_vecEnemyLKP - pev->origin).Normalize();
+	Vector vecFlightDir = (pev->velocity.Length() < 0.1f) ? vecDirToEnemy : pev->velocity.Normalize();
+
+	// (how much it has to turn)
+	float flDelta = DotProduct(vecFlightDir, vecDirToEnemy);
+	if (flDelta < 0.5f)
+		Buzz();
+
+	if (flDelta <= 0 && m_iHornetType == HL_HORNET_TYPE_RED)
+		flDelta = 0.25f; // (no sharp turns for the red ones)
+
+	pev->velocity = (vecFlightDir + vecDirToEnemy).Normalize();
+
+	if (m_iHornetType == HL_HORNET_TYPE_RED)
+	{
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * (m_flFlySpeed * flDelta);
+		pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + RANDOM_FLOAT(0.1f, 0.3f);
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * m_flFlySpeed;
+		pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+	}
+
+	pev->angles = UTIL_VecToAngles(pev->velocity);
+	pev->solid = SOLID_BBOX;
+}
+
+void CHLHornet::TrackTouch(CBaseEntity *pOther)
+{
+	if (pOther->edict() == pev->owner || pOther->pev->modelindex == pev->modelindex)
+	{
+		pev->solid = SOLID_NOT;
+		return;
+	}
+
+	// (off the walls and the shooter's teammates: it stings enemies only)
+	if (!IsEnemy(pOther))
+	{
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity.Normalize();
+		pev->velocity.x *= -1.0f;
+		pev->velocity.y *= -1.0f;
+		pev->origin = pev->origin + pev->velocity * 4.0f;
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * m_flFlySpeed;
+		return;
+	}
+
+	DieTouch(pOther);
+}
+
+void CHLHornet::DieTouch(CBaseEntity *pOther)
+{
+	if (pOther && pOther->pev->takedamage && pev->owner)
+	{
+		static const char *sounds[] = { "hornet/ag_hornethit1.wav", "hornet/ag_hornethit2.wav", "hornet/ag_hornethit3.wav" };
+		EMIT_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, sounds[RANDOM_LONG(0, 2)], VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+
+		TraceResult tr = UTIL_GetGlobalTrace();
+		entvars_t *pevOwner = VARS(pev->owner);
+
+		ClearMultiDamage();
+		pOther->TraceAttack(pevOwner, pev->dmg, pev->velocity.Normalize(), &tr, DMG_BULLET);
+		ApplyMultiDamage(pev, pevOwner);
+	}
+
+	// (invisible, its trail fading out)
+	pev->modelindex = 0;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_NOT;
+	SetTouch(nullptr);
+	SetThink(&CBaseEntity::SUB_Remove);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 1.0f;
+}
+

+void CHLHornetGun::Holster(int skiplocal)
+{
+	m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+	SendWeaponAnim(HGUN_DOWN);
+
+	// (never quite empty: it is never retired)
+	if (!m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[PrimaryAmmoIndex()])
+		m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[PrimaryAmmoIndex()] = 1;
+}
+
+void CHLHornetGun::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	Fire(false);
+}
+
+void CHLHornetGun::SecondaryAttack()
+{
+	if (!CanFire())
+		return;
+
+	Fire(true);
+}
+
+// (a homing hornet, or a straight dart from one of eight points around the barrel)
+void CHLHornetGun::Fire(bool bDart)
+{
+	Reload();
+
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0)
+		return;
+
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle);
+	Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->GetGunPosition() + gpGlobals->v_forward * 16.0f + gpGlobals->v_right * 8.0f + gpGlobals->v_up * -12.0f;
+
+	if (bDart)
+	{
+		static const float phases[8][2] = { { 8, 0 }, { 8, 8 }, { 0, 8 }, { -8, 8 }, { -8, 0 }, { -8, -8 }, { 0, -8 }, { 8, -8 } };
+		const float *phase = phases[m_iFirePhase];
+		m_iFirePhase = (m_iFirePhase + 1) % 8;
+		vecSrc = vecSrc + gpGlobals->v_up * phase[0] + gpGlobals->v_right * phase[1];
+	}
+
+	CHLHornet *pHornet = GetClassPtr<CCSAnimating>((CHLHornet *)nullptr);
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pHornet->pev, vecSrc);
+	pHornet->pev->angles = m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle;
+	pHornet->pev->owner = m_pPlayer->edict();
+	pHornet->Spawn();
+
+	if (bDart)
+	{
+		pHornet->pev->velocity = gpGlobals->v_forward * 1200.0f;
+		pHornet->pev->angles = UTIL_VecToAngles(pHornet->pev->velocity);
+		pHornet->SetThink(&CHLHornet::StartDart);
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		pHornet->pev->velocity = gpGlobals->v_forward * 300.0f;
+	}
+
+	m_flRechargeTime = gpGlobals->time + HL_HORNET_RECHARGE;
+	m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType]--;
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = bDart ? NORMAL_GUN_VOLUME : QUIET_GUN_VOLUME;
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponFlash = DIM_GUN_FLASH;
+
+	static const char *sounds[] = { "agrunt/ag_fire1.wav", "agrunt/ag_fire2.wav", "agrunt/ag_fire3.wav" };
+	EMIT_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, sounds[RANDOM_LONG(0, 2)], VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+	SendWeaponAnim(HGUN_SHOOT);
+	m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+
+	if (bDart)
+	{
+		m_flNextPrimaryAttack = m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.1f;
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		m_flNextPrimaryAttack = m_flNextPrimaryAttack + 0.25f;
+		if (m_flNextPrimaryAttack < UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+			m_flNextPrimaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.25f;
+	}
+
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+	m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle.x -= RANDOM_FLOAT(0.0f, 1.0f);
+}
+
+// (the hornets grow back)
+void CHLHornetGun::Reload()
+{
+	int &ammo = m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType];
+	while (ammo < HL_HORNET_MAX_CARRY && m_flRechargeTime < gpGlobals->time)
+	{
+		ammo++;
+		m_flRechargeTime += HL_HORNET_RECHARGE;
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLHornetGun::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	Reload();
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	int iAnim;
+	float flRand = UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 0.0f, 1.0f);
+	if (flRand <= 0.75f)
+	{
+		iAnim = HGUN_IDLE1;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 30.0f / 16.0f * 2.0f;
+	}
+	else if (flRand <= 0.875f)
+	{
+		iAnim = HGUN_FIDGETSWAY;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 40.0f / 16.0f;
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		iAnim = HGUN_FIDGETSHAKE;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 35.0f / 16.0f;
+	}
+	SendWeaponAnim(iAnim);
+}

+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// RPG, its laser spot and its rocket
+
+enum hl_rpg_e
+{
+	RPG_IDLE = 0,
+	RPG_FIDGET,
+	RPG_RELOAD,    // to reload
+	RPG_FIRE2,     // to empty
+	RPG_HOLSTER1,  // loaded
+	RPG_DRAW1,     // loaded
+	RPG_HOLSTER2,  // unloaded
+	RPG_DRAW_UL,   // unloaded
+	RPG_IDLE_UL,   // unloaded idle
+	RPG_FIDGET_UL  // unloaded fidget
+};

+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(laser_spot, CHLLaserSpot, CCSEntity)

+{
+	CHLLaserSpot *pSpot = GetClassPtr<CCSEntity>((CHLLaserSpot *)nullptr);

+

+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pev, pev->origin);
+}

+void CHLLaserSpot::Suspend(float flSuspendTime)
+{
+	pev->effects |= EF_NODRAW;
+	SetThink(&CHLLaserSpot::Revive);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + flSuspendTime;

+	SetThink(nullptr);

+}

+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(rpg_rocket, CHLRpgRocket, CCSEntity)
+
+CHLRpgRocket *CHLRpgRocket::CreateRpgRocket(Vector vecOrigin, Vector vecAngles, CBaseEntity *pOwner, CHLRpg *pLauncher)
+{
+	CHLRpgRocket *pRocket = GetClassPtr<CCSEntity>((CHLRpgRocket *)nullptr);
+
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pRocket->pev, vecOrigin);
+	pRocket->pev->angles = vecAngles;
+	pRocket->Spawn();
+	pRocket->SetTouch(&CHLRpgRocket::RocketTouch);
+	pRocket->m_hLauncher = pLauncher; // (the RPG that fired it)
+	pLauncher->m_cActiveRockets++;
+	pRocket->pev->owner = pOwner->edict();
+
+	return pRocket;
+}
+
+void CHLRpgRocket::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_BOUNCE;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_BBOX;
+
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/rpgrocket.mdl");
+	UTIL_SetSize(pev, Vector(0, 0, 0), Vector(0, 0, 0));
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pev, pev->origin);
+
+	MAKE_STRING_CLASS("rpg_rocket", pev);
+
+	SetThink(&CHLRpgRocket::IgniteThink);
+
+	pev->angles.x -= 30.0f;
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(pev->angles);
+	pev->angles.x = -(pev->angles.x + 30.0f);
+
+	pev->velocity = gpGlobals->v_forward * 250.0f;
+	pev->gravity = 0.5f;
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.4f;
+	pev->dmg = HL_RPG_DAMAGE;
+}
+
+void CHLRpgRocket::Precache()
+{
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/rpgrocket.mdl");
+	m_iTrail = PRECACHE_MODEL("sprites/smoke.spr");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/rocket1.wav");
+}
+
+// (tells the launcher this rocket no longer follows its spot)
+void CHLRpgRocket::Forget()
+{
+	if (m_hLauncher.IsValid())
+	{
+		m_hLauncher->m_cActiveRockets--;
+		m_hLauncher = nullptr;
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLRpgRocket::Explode(TraceResult *pTrace)
+{
+	Forget();
+	STOP_SOUND(edict(), CHAN_VOICE, "weapons/rocket1.wav");
+
+	entvars_t *pevOwner = pev->owner ? VARS(pev->owner) : nullptr;
+	pev->model = iStringNull;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_NOT;
+	pev->effects |= EF_NODRAW;
+	HL_Explosion(this, pTrace, pevOwner, pev->dmg, pev->dmg * 2.5f, int((pev->dmg - 50) * 0.6f));
+
+	SetTouch(nullptr);
+	SetThink(&CBaseEntity::SUB_Remove);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+}
+
+void CHLRpgRocket::RocketTouch(CBaseEntity *pOther)
+{
+	if (pOther->edict() == pev->owner)
+		return;
+
+	TraceResult tr;
+	Vector vecSpot = pev->origin - pev->velocity.Normalize() * 32;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(vecSpot, vecSpot + pev->velocity.Normalize() * 64, ignore_monsters, edict(), &tr);
+	Explode(&tr);
+}
+
+void CHLRpgRocket::IgniteThink()
+{
+	pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_FLY;
+	pev->effects |= EF_LIGHT;
+
+	EMIT_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, "weapons/rocket1.wav", VOL_NORM, 0.5f);
+
+	MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_BROADCAST, SVC_TEMPENTITY);
+		WRITE_BYTE(TE_BEAMFOLLOW);
+		WRITE_SHORT(entindex());
+		WRITE_SHORT(m_iTrail);
+		WRITE_BYTE(40); // life
+		WRITE_BYTE(5);  // width
+		WRITE_BYTE(224); // r, g, b
+		WRITE_BYTE(224);
+		WRITE_BYTE(255);
+		WRITE_BYTE(255); // brightness
+	MESSAGE_END();
+
+	m_flIgniteTime = gpGlobals->time;
+	SetThink(&CHLRpgRocket::FollowThink);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+}
+
+void CHLRpgRocket::FollowThink()
+{
+	CBaseEntity *pOther = nullptr;
+	Vector vecTarget;
+	TraceResult tr;
+
+	UTIL_MakeAimVectors(pev->angles);
+	vecTarget = gpGlobals->v_forward;
+	float flMax = 4096;
+
+	// (the nearest visible laser spot ahead)
+	while ((pOther = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pOther, "laser_spot")))
+	{
+		UTIL_TraceLine(pev->origin, pOther->pev->origin, dont_ignore_monsters, ENT(pev), &tr);
+		if (tr.flFraction >= 0.9f)
+		{
+			Vector vecDir = pOther->pev->origin - pev->origin;
+			float flDist = vecDir.Length();
+			vecDir = vecDir.Normalize();
+			float flDot = DotProduct(gpGlobals->v_forward, vecDir);
+			if (flDot > 0 && flDist * (1 - flDot) < flMax)
+			{
+				flMax = flDist * (1 - flDot);
+				vecTarget = vecDir;
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	pev->angles = UTIL_VecToAngles(vecTarget);
+
+	float flSpeed = pev->velocity.Length();
+	if (gpGlobals->time - m_flIgniteTime < 1.0f)
+	{
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * 0.2f + vecTarget * (flSpeed * 0.8f + 400.0f);
+		if (pev->waterlevel == 3)
+		{
+			if (pev->velocity.Length() > 300.0f)
+				pev->velocity = pev->velocity.Normalize() * 300.0f;
+
+			UTIL_BubbleTrail(pev->origin - pev->velocity * 0.1f, pev->origin, 4);
+		}
+		else if (pev->velocity.Length() > 2000.0f)
+		{
+			pev->velocity = pev->velocity.Normalize() * 2000.0f;
+		}
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		if (pev->effects & EF_LIGHT)
+		{
+			pev->effects = 0;
+			STOP_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, "weapons/rocket1.wav");
+		}
+
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * 0.2f + vecTarget * flSpeed * 0.798f;
+		if (pev->waterlevel == 0 && pev->velocity.Length() < 1500.0f)
+		{
+			Explode(nullptr);
+			return;
+		}
+	}
+
+	if (m_hLauncher.IsValid() && ((pev->origin - m_hLauncher->pev->origin).Length() > 8192 || gpGlobals->time - m_flIgniteTime > 6.0f))
+		Forget();
+
+	if (UTIL_PointContents(pev->origin) == CONTENTS_SKY)
+	{
+		Explode(nullptr);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+}
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(weapon_rpg, CHLRpg, CCSPlayerWeapon)
+
+void CHLRpg::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	m_iId = WEAPON_HL_RPG;
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/w_rpg.mdl");
+	m_fSpotActive = 1;
+	m_cActiveRockets = 0;
+	m_pSpot = nullptr;
+	m_iDefaultAmmo = HL_RPG_MAX_CLIP + 1;
+	FallInit();
+	CBasePlayerWeapon::Spawn();
+}
+
+void CHLRpg::Precache()
+{
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/w_rpg.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/v_rpg.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/p_rpg.mdl");
+
+	UTIL_PrecacheOther("laser_spot");
+	UTIL_PrecacheOther("rpg_rocket");
+
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/rocketfire1.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/glauncher.wav");
+
+	m_usRpg = PRECACHE_EVENT(1, "events/rpg.sc");
+}

+int CHLRpg::GetItemInfo(ItemInfo *p)
+{
+	p->pszName = STRING(pev->classname);
+	p->pszAmmo1 = "rockets";
+	p->iMaxAmmo1 = HL_RPG_MAX_CARRY;
+	p->pszAmmo2 = nullptr;
+	p->iMaxAmmo2 = -1;
+	p->iMaxClip = HL_RPG_MAX_CLIP;
+	p->iSlot = 0;
+	p->iPosition = 20;
+	p->iId = m_iId = WEAPON_HL_RPG;

+}

+BOOL CHLRpg::Deploy()

+}
+
+BOOL CHLRpg::CanHolster()
+{
+	// (not while guiding a rocket)
+	return !(m_fSpotActive && m_cActiveRockets);
+}
+
+void CHLRpg::Holster(int skiplocal)
+{
+	m_fInReload = FALSE;
+	SendWeaponAnim(RPG_HOLSTER1);
+
+	if (m_pSpot)
+	{
+		m_pSpot->Killed(nullptr, GIB_NEVER);
+		m_pSpot = nullptr;
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLRpg::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	if (m_iClip)
+	{
+		m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = LOUD_GUN_VOLUME;
+		m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponFlash = BRIGHT_GUN_FLASH;
+		m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+
+		UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle);
+		Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->GetGunPosition() + gpGlobals->v_forward * 16.0f + gpGlobals->v_right * 8.0f + gpGlobals->v_up * -8.0f;
+
+		CHLRpgRocket *pRocket = CHLRpgRocket::CreateRpgRocket(vecSrc, m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle, m_pPlayer, this);
+
+		UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle); // (the rocket stomps on the globals)
+		pRocket->pev->velocity = pRocket->pev->velocity + gpGlobals->v_forward * DotProduct(m_pPlayer->pev->velocity, gpGlobals->v_forward);
+
+		PLAYBACK_EVENT(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usRpg);
+
+		m_iClip--;
+		m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(1.5f);
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.5f;
+		ResetEmptySound();
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		PlayEmptySound();
+		m_flNextPrimaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.2f;
+	}
+
+	UpdateSpot();
+}
+
+void CHLRpg::SecondaryAttack()
+{
+	m_fSpotActive = !m_fSpotActive;
+
+	if (!m_fSpotActive && m_pSpot)
+	{
+		m_pSpot->Killed(nullptr, GIB_NORMAL);
+		m_pSpot = nullptr;
+	}
+
+	m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.2f;
+}
+
+void CHLRpg::Reload()
+{
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0 || m_iClip == HL_RPG_MAX_CLIP)
+		return;
+
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.5f);
+
+	// (no reloading while a rocket in flight follows the spot)
+	if (m_cActiveRockets && m_fSpotActive)
+		return;
+
+	if (m_pSpot && m_fSpotActive)
+	{
+		m_pSpot->Suspend(2.1f);
+		m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 2.1f;
+	}
+
+	if (m_iClip == 0 && DefaultReload(HL_RPG_MAX_CLIP, RPG_RELOAD, 2))
+	{
+		m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_RELOAD);
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10, 15);
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLRpg::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	UpdateSpot();
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] || m_iClip)
+	{
+		ResetEmptySound();
+
+		int iAnim;
+		if (UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 0.0f, 1.0f) <= 0.75f || m_fSpotActive)
+		{
+			iAnim = m_iClip ? RPG_IDLE : RPG_IDLE_UL;
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 90.0f / 15.0f;
+		}
+		else
+		{
+			iAnim = m_iClip ? RPG_FIDGET : RPG_FIDGET_UL;
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 3.0f;
+		}
+
+		SendWeaponAnim(iAnim);
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLRpg::UpdateSpot()
+{
+	if (!m_fSpotActive || !m_pPlayer || !m_pPlayer->IsAlive())
+		return;
+
+	if (!m_pSpot)
+		m_pSpot = CHLLaserSpot::CreateSpot();
+
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle);
+	Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->GetGunPosition();
+
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(vecSrc, vecSrc + gpGlobals->v_forward * 8192.0f, dont_ignore_monsters, ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), &tr);
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(m_pSpot->pev, tr.vecEndPos);
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Gauss
+
+#define HL_GAUSS_PRIMARY_CHARGE_VOLUME 256
+#define HL_GAUSS_PRIMARY_FIRE_VOLUME   450
+
+enum hl_gauss_e
+{
+	GAUSS_IDLE = 0,
+	GAUSS_IDLE2,
+	GAUSS_FIDGET,
+	GAUSS_SPINUP,
+	GAUSS_SPIN,
+	GAUSS_FIRE,
+	GAUSS_FIRE2,
+	GAUSS_HOLSTER,
+	GAUSS_DRAW
+};
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(weapon_gauss, CHLGauss, CCSPlayerWeapon)
+
+void CHLGauss::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	m_iId = WEAPON_HL_GAUSS;
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/w_gauss.mdl");
+	m_iDefaultAmmo = HL_GAUSS_DEFAULT_GIVE;
+	m_fInAttack = 0;
+	m_flPlayAftershock = 0.0f;
+	FallInit();
+	CBasePlayerWeapon::Spawn();
+}
+
+void CHLGauss::Precache()
+{
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/w_gauss.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/v_gauss.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/p_gauss.mdl");
+
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/gauss2.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/electro4.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/electro5.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/electro6.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("ambience/pulsemachine.wav");
+
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("sprites/hotglow.spr");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("sprites/smoke.spr");

+	m_usGaussFire = PRECACHE_EVENT(1, "events/gauss.sc");
+	m_usGaussSpin = PRECACHE_EVENT(1, "events/gaussspin.sc");
+}

+{
+	p->pszName = STRING(pev->classname);
+	p->pszAmmo1 = "uranium";
+	p->iMaxAmmo1 = HL_URANIUM_MAX_CARRY;
+	p->pszAmmo2 = nullptr;
+	p->iMaxAmmo2 = -1;
+	p->iMaxClip = WEAPON_NOCLIP;
+	p->iSlot = 0;
+	p->iPosition = 21;

+	p->iWeight = HL_GAUSS_WEIGHT;

+}

+BOOL CHLGauss::Deploy()
+{
+	m_flPlayAftershock = 0.0f;
+	return DefaultDeploy("models/v_gauss.mdl", "models/p_gauss.mdl", GAUSS_DRAW, "m249", 0);
+}
+
+void CHLGauss::Holster(int skiplocal)
+{
+	PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(FEV_RELIABLE | FEV_GLOBAL, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usGaussFire, 0.01f, m_pPlayer->pev->origin, m_pPlayer->pev->angles, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0, 0, 0, 1);
+	SendWeaponAnim(GAUSS_HOLSTER);
+	m_fInAttack = 0;
+}
+
+void CHLGauss::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	if (m_pPlayer->pev->waterlevel == 3)
+	{
+		PlayEmptySound();
+		m_flNextSecondaryAttack = m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.15f);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] < 2)
+	{
+		PlayEmptySound();
+		m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+		return;
+	}
+
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = HL_GAUSS_PRIMARY_FIRE_VOLUME;
+	m_fPrimaryFire = TRUE;
+	m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] -= 2;
+
+	StartFire();
+	m_fInAttack = 0;
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+	m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.2f;
+}
+
+void CHLGauss::SecondaryAttack()
+{
+	// (no charging in the freeze period; a charge already going may finish)
+	if (m_fInAttack == 0 && !CanFire())
+		return;
+
+	if (m_pPlayer->pev->waterlevel == 3)
+	{
+		if (m_fInAttack != 0)
+		{
+			EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "weapons/electro4.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, 80 + RANDOM_LONG(0, 0x3f));
+			SendWeaponAnim(GAUSS_IDLE);
+			m_fInAttack = 0;
+		}
+		else
+		{
+			PlayEmptySound();
+		}
+
+		m_flNextSecondaryAttack = m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.5f);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (m_fInAttack == 0)
+	{
+		if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0)
+		{
+			EMIT_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "weapons/357_cock1.wav", 0.8f, ATTN_NORM);
+			m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+			return;
+		}
+
+		m_fPrimaryFire = FALSE;
+		m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType]--; // (one to start the spin)
+		m_flNextAmmoBurn = gpGlobals->time;
+		m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = HL_GAUSS_PRIMARY_CHARGE_VOLUME;
+
+		SendWeaponAnim(GAUSS_SPINUP);
+		m_fInAttack = 1;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+		m_flStartCharge = gpGlobals->time;
+		m_flAmmoStartCharge = gpGlobals->time + GetFullChargeTime();
+
+		PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usGaussSpin, 0.0f, (float *)&g_vecZero, (float *)&g_vecZero, 0.0f, 0.0f, 110, 0, 0, 0);
+		m_iSoundState = SND_CHANGE_PITCH;
+	}
+	else if (m_fInAttack == 1)
+	{
+		if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle < UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		{
+			SendWeaponAnim(GAUSS_SPIN);
+			m_fInAttack = 2;
+		}
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		// (charging eats one round every 0.1 s until full)
+		if (gpGlobals->time >= m_flNextAmmoBurn && m_flNextAmmoBurn != 1000)
+		{
+			m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType]--;
+			m_flNextAmmoBurn = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+		}
+
+		if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0)
+		{
+			// (out of ammo: the gun fires)
+			StartFire();
+			m_fInAttack = 0;
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+			m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+			return;
+		}
+
+		if (gpGlobals->time >= m_flAmmoStartCharge)
+			m_flNextAmmoBurn = 1000; // (fully charged: no more ammo)
+
+		int pitch = int((gpGlobals->time - m_flStartCharge) * (150 / GetFullChargeTime()) + 100);
+		if (pitch > 250)
+			pitch = 250;
+
+		bool overcharge = m_flStartCharge < gpGlobals->time - 10.0f;
+		if (!overcharge)
+			PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usGaussSpin, 0.0f, (float *)&g_vecZero, (float *)&g_vecZero, 0.0f, 0.0f, pitch, 0, (m_iSoundState == SND_CHANGE_PITCH) ? 1 : 0, 0);
+
+		m_iSoundState = SND_CHANGE_PITCH;
+		m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = HL_GAUSS_PRIMARY_CHARGE_VOLUME;
+
+		if (overcharge)
+		{
+			// (charged too long: it zaps its holder)
+			PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usGaussSpin, 0.0f, (float *)&g_vecZero, (float *)&g_vecZero, 0.0f, 0.0f, pitch, 0, 0, 1);
+			EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "weapons/electro4.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, 80 + RANDOM_LONG(0, 0x3f));
+			EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_ITEM, "weapons/electro6.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, 75 + RANDOM_LONG(0, 0x3f));
+
+			m_fInAttack = 0;
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+			m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+			SendWeaponAnim(GAUSS_IDLE);
+
+			CBasePlayer *pPlayer = m_pPlayer;
+			UTIL_ScreenFade(pPlayer, Vector(255, 128, 0), 2, 0.5f, 128, FFADE_IN);
+			pPlayer->TakeDamage(VARS(eoNullEntity), VARS(eoNullEntity), 50, DMG_SHOCK);
+			// (this weapon may be dropped now)
+			return;
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLGauss::StartFire()
+{
+	if (m_flStartCharge > gpGlobals->time)
+		m_flStartCharge = gpGlobals->time;
+
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle);
+	Vector vecAiming = gpGlobals->v_forward;
+	Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->GetGunPosition();
+
+	float flDamage;
+	if (m_fPrimaryFire)
+		flDamage = HL_GAUSS_DAMAGE;
+	else if (gpGlobals->time - m_flStartCharge > GetFullChargeTime())
+		flDamage = HL_GAUSS_MAX_CHARGE_DAMAGE;
+	else
+		flDamage = HL_GAUSS_MAX_CHARGE_DAMAGE * ((gpGlobals->time - m_flStartCharge) / GetFullChargeTime());
+
+	if (m_fInAttack != 3)
+	{
+		// (a charged shot pushes its shooter back, up too: the multiplayer gauss jump)
+		if (!m_fPrimaryFire)
+			m_pPlayer->pev->velocity = m_pPlayer->pev->velocity - gpGlobals->v_forward * flDamage * 5.0f;
+
+		m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+	}
+
+	m_flPlayAftershock = gpGlobals->time + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 0.3f, 0.8f);
+	Fire(vecSrc, vecAiming, flDamage);
+}
+
+void CHLGauss::Fire(Vector vecOrigSrc, Vector vecDir, float flDamage)
+{
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = HL_GAUSS_PRIMARY_FIRE_VOLUME;
+
+	Vector vecSrc = vecOrigSrc;
+	Vector vecDest = vecSrc + vecDir * 8192.0f;
+	edict_t *pentIgnore = ENT(m_pPlayer->pev);
+	TraceResult tr, beam_tr;
+	int fHasPunched = 0;
+	int fFirstBeam = 1;
+	int nMaxHits = 10;
+
+	// (the firing event unreliable so that it is not delayed; a reliable one, a frame later, stops the spin sound)
+	PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usGaussFire, 0.0f, m_pPlayer->pev->origin, m_pPlayer->pev->angles, flDamage, 0.0f, 0, 0, m_fPrimaryFire ? 1 : 0, 0);
+	PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(FEV_RELIABLE | FEV_GLOBAL, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usGaussFire, 0.01f, m_pPlayer->pev->origin, m_pPlayer->pev->angles, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0, 0, 0, 1);
+
+	while (flDamage > 10 && nMaxHits > 0)
+	{
+		nMaxHits--;
+		UTIL_TraceLine(vecSrc, vecDest, dont_ignore_monsters, pentIgnore, &tr);
+
+		if (tr.fAllSolid)
+			break;
+
+		CBaseEntity *pEntity = CBaseEntity::Instance(tr.pHit);
+		if (!pEntity)
+			break;
+
+		if (fFirstBeam)
+		{
+			m_pPlayer->pev->effects |= EF_MUZZLEFLASH;
+			fFirstBeam = 0;
+		}
+
+		if (pEntity->pev->takedamage)
+		{
+			ClearMultiDamage();
+			if (pEntity->pev == m_pPlayer->pev)
+				tr.iHitgroup = 0;
+			pEntity->TraceAttack(m_pPlayer->pev, flDamage, vecDir, &tr, DMG_BULLET);
+			ApplyMultiDamage(m_pPlayer->pev, m_pPlayer->pev);
+		}
+
+		if (pEntity->ReflectGauss())
+		{
+			pentIgnore = nullptr;
+			float n = -DotProduct(tr.vecPlaneNormal, vecDir);
+
+			if (n < 0.5f) // (60 degrees: it reflects)
+			{
+				Vector r = 2.0 * tr.vecPlaneNormal * n + vecDir;
+				vecDir = r;
+				vecSrc = tr.vecEndPos + vecDir * 8.0f;
+				vecDest = vecSrc + vecDir * 8192.0f;
+
+				HL_RadiusDamage(tr.vecEndPos, pev, m_pPlayer->pev, flDamage * n, flDamage * n * 2.5f);
+
+				if (n == 0.0f)
+					n = 0.1f;
+
+				flDamage = flDamage * (1.0f - n);
+			}
+			else
+			{
+				// (one hole punch at most, by the charged shot only)
+				if (fHasPunched)
+					break;
+
+				fHasPunched = 1;
+
+				if (!m_fPrimaryFire)
+				{
+					UTIL_TraceLine(tr.vecEndPos + vecDir * 8, vecDest, dont_ignore_monsters, pentIgnore, &beam_tr);
+					if (!beam_tr.fAllSolid)
+					{
+						// (backwards to the exit point)
+						UTIL_TraceLine(beam_tr.vecEndPos, tr.vecEndPos, dont_ignore_monsters, pentIgnore, &beam_tr);
+
+						n = (beam_tr.vecEndPos - tr.vecEndPos).Length();
+						if (n < flDamage)
+						{
+							if (n == 0.0f)
+								n = 1.0f;
+
+							flDamage -= n;
+							HL_RadiusDamage(beam_tr.vecEndPos + vecDir * 8, pev, m_pPlayer->pev, flDamage, flDamage * 1.75f);
+							vecSrc = beam_tr.vecEndPos + vecDir;
+						}
+						else
+						{
+							flDamage = 0;
+						}
+					}
+					else
+					{
+						flDamage = 0;
+					}
+				}
+				else
+				{
+					flDamage = 0;
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		else
+		{
+			vecSrc = tr.vecEndPos + vecDir;
+			pentIgnore = ENT(pEntity->pev);
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLGauss::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	ResetEmptySound();
+
+	// (the aftershock static discharge)
+	if (m_flPlayAftershock != 0.0f && m_flPlayAftershock < gpGlobals->time)
+	{
+		static const char *sounds[] = { "weapons/electro4.wav", "weapons/electro5.wav", "weapons/electro6.wav" };
+		int i = RANDOM_LONG(0, 3);
+		if (i < 3)
+			EMIT_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, sounds[i], RANDOM_FLOAT(0.7f, 0.8f), ATTN_NORM);
+
+		m_flPlayAftershock = 0.0f;
+	}
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	if (m_fInAttack != 0)
+	{
+		StartFire();
+		m_fInAttack = 0;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 2.0f;
+		return;
+	}
+
+	int iAnim;
+	float flRand = RANDOM_FLOAT(0.0f, 1.0f);
+	if (flRand <= 0.5f)
+	{
+		iAnim = GAUSS_IDLE;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+	}
+	else if (flRand <= 0.75f)
+	{
+		iAnim = GAUSS_IDLE2;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		iAnim = GAUSS_FIDGET;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 3.0f;
+	}
+
+	SendWeaponAnim(iAnim);
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Egon (wide beam only: it is the Half-Life multiplayer one)
+
+#define HL_EGON_PRIMARY_VOLUME 450
+#define HL_EGON_BEAM_SPRITE    "sprites/xbeam1.spr"
+#define HL_EGON_FLARE_SPRITE   "sprites/xspark1.spr"
+#define HL_EGON_SOUND_OFF      "weapons/egon_off1.wav"
+#define HL_EGON_SOUND_RUN      "weapons/egon_run3.wav"
+#define HL_EGON_SOUND_STARTUP  "weapons/egon_windup2.wav"
+#define HL_EGON_FIRE_WIDE      1
+#define HL_EGON_INTERVAL       0.1f
+
+enum hl_egon_e
+{
+	EGON_IDLE1 = 0,
+	EGON_FIDGET1,
+	EGON_ALTFIREON,
+	EGON_ALTFIRECYCLE,
+	EGON_ALTFIREOFF,
+	EGON_FIRE1,
+	EGON_FIRE2,
+	EGON_FIRE3,
+	EGON_FIRE4,
+	EGON_DRAW,
+	EGON_HOLSTER
+};
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(weapon_egon, CHLEgon, CCSPlayerWeapon)

+}

+void CHLEgon::Holster(int skiplocal)

+	SendWeaponAnim(EGON_HOLSTER);

+void CHLEgon::UseAmmo(int count)
+{
+	int &ammo = m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType];
+	ammo = ammo >= count ? ammo - count : 0;
+}
+
+void CHLEgon::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	Attack();
+}
+
+void CHLEgon::Attack()
+{
+	if (m_pPlayer->pev->waterlevel == 3)
+	{
+		if (m_fireState != FIRE_OFF || m_pBeam)
+			EndAttack();
+		else
+			PlayEmptySound();
+
+		return;
+	}
+
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle);
+	Vector vecAiming = gpGlobals->v_forward;
+	Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->GetGunPosition();
+
+	switch (m_fireState)
+	{
+		case FIRE_OFF:
+		{
+			if (!HasAmmo())
+			{
+				m_flNextPrimaryAttack = m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.25f;
+				PlayEmptySound();
+				return;
+			}
+
+			m_flAmmoUseTime = gpGlobals->time; // (ammo from now on)
+			PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usEgonFire, 0.0f, (float *)&g_vecZero, (float *)&g_vecZero, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0, HL_EGON_FIRE_WIDE, 1, 0);
+
+			m_shakeTime = 0;
+			m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = HL_EGON_PRIMARY_VOLUME;
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.1f;
+			m_flStartupTime = gpGlobals->time + 2.0f;
+			m_flDamageTime = gpGlobals->time + HL_EGON_INTERVAL;
+			m_fireState = FIRE_CHARGE;
+			break;
+		}
+		case FIRE_CHARGE:
+		{
+			Fire(vecSrc, vecAiming);
+			m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = HL_EGON_PRIMARY_VOLUME;
+
+			// (the running sound once the startup one is over)
+			if (m_flStartupTime != 0.0f && m_flStartupTime <= gpGlobals->time)
+			{
+				PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(0, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usEgonFire, 0.0f, (float *)&g_vecZero, (float *)&g_vecZero, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0, HL_EGON_FIRE_WIDE, 0, 0);
+				m_flStartupTime = 0.0f;
+			}
+
+			if (!HasAmmo())
+			{
+				EndAttack();
+				m_flNextPrimaryAttack = m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+			}
+			break;
+		}
+	}
+
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.1f;
+}
+
+void CHLEgon::Fire(const Vector &vecOrigSrc, const Vector &vecDir)
+{
+	Vector vecDest = vecOrigSrc + vecDir * 2048.0f;
+	Vector tmpSrc = vecOrigSrc + gpGlobals->v_up * -8.0f + gpGlobals->v_right * 3.0f;
+
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(vecOrigSrc, vecDest, dont_ignore_monsters, m_pPlayer->edict(), &tr);
+	if (tr.fAllSolid)
+		return;
+
+	CBaseEntity *pEntity = CBaseEntity::Instance(tr.pHit);
+	if (!pEntity)
+		return;
+
+	if (m_pSprite)
+	{
+		if (pEntity->pev->takedamage)
+			m_pSprite->pev->effects &= ~EF_NODRAW;
+		else
+			m_pSprite->pev->effects |= EF_NODRAW;
+	}
+
+	if (m_flDamageTime < gpGlobals->time)
+	{
+		ClearMultiDamage();
+		if (pEntity->pev->takedamage)
+			pEntity->TraceAttack(m_pPlayer->pev, HL_EGON_DAMAGE, vecDir, &tr, DMG_ENERGYBEAM | DMG_ALWAYSGIB);
+
+		ApplyMultiDamage(m_pPlayer->pev, m_pPlayer->pev);
+		HL_RadiusDamage(tr.vecEndPos, pev, m_pPlayer->pev, HL_EGON_DAMAGE * 0.25f, 128, DMG_ENERGYBEAM | DMG_EXPLOSION);
+
+		if (!m_pPlayer->IsAlive())
+			return;
+
+		if (gpGlobals->time >= m_flAmmoUseTime)
+		{
+			UseAmmo(1);
+			m_flAmmoUseTime = gpGlobals->time + 0.2f;
+		}
+
+		m_flDamageTime = gpGlobals->time + HL_EGON_INTERVAL;
+		if (m_shakeTime < gpGlobals->time)
+		{
+			UTIL_ScreenShake(tr.vecEndPos, 5.0f, 150.0f, 0.75f, 250.0f);
+			m_shakeTime = gpGlobals->time + 1.5f;
+		}
+	}
+
+	float timedist = (m_flDamageTime - gpGlobals->time) / HL_EGON_INTERVAL;
+	timedist = 1 - clamp(timedist, 0.0f, 1.0f);
+	UpdateEffect(tmpSrc, tr.vecEndPos, timedist);
+}
+
+void CHLEgon::UpdateEffect(const Vector &startPoint, const Vector &endPoint, float timeBlend)
+{
+	if (!m_pBeam)
+		CreateEffect();
+
+	m_pBeam->SetStartPos(endPoint);
+	m_pBeam->SetBrightness(int(255 - (timeBlend * 180)));
+	m_pBeam->SetWidth(int(40 - (timeBlend * 20)));
+	m_pBeam->SetColor(int(30 + (25 * timeBlend)), int(30 + (30 * timeBlend)), int(64 + 80 * Q_fabs(Q_sin(gpGlobals->time * 10.0f))));
+
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(m_pSprite->pev, endPoint);
+	m_pSprite->pev->frame += 8.0f * gpGlobals->frametime;
+	if (m_pSprite->pev->frame > m_pSprite->Frames())
+		m_pSprite->pev->frame = 0;
+
+	m_pNoise->SetStartPos(endPoint);
+}
+
+// (the beams are server entities for everyone, the shooter included: no client-side beam follows its aim)
+void CHLEgon::CreateEffect()
+{
+	DestroyEffect();
+
+	m_pBeam = CBeam::BeamCreate(HL_EGON_BEAM_SPRITE, 40);
+	m_pBeam->PointEntInit(pev->origin, m_pPlayer->entindex());
+	m_pBeam->SetFlags(BEAM_FSINE);
+	m_pBeam->SetEndAttachment(1);
+	m_pBeam->pev->spawnflags |= SF_BEAM_TEMPORARY;
+	m_pBeam->pev->owner = m_pPlayer->edict();
+	m_pBeam->SetScrollRate(50);
+	m_pBeam->SetNoise(20);
+
+	m_pNoise = CBeam::BeamCreate(HL_EGON_BEAM_SPRITE, 55);
+	m_pNoise->PointEntInit(pev->origin, m_pPlayer->entindex());
+	m_pNoise->SetScrollRate(25);
+	m_pNoise->SetBrightness(100);
+	m_pNoise->SetEndAttachment(1);
+	m_pNoise->pev->spawnflags |= SF_BEAM_TEMPORARY;
+	m_pNoise->pev->owner = m_pPlayer->edict();
+	m_pNoise->SetColor(50, 50, 255);
+	m_pNoise->SetNoise(8);
+
+	m_pSprite = CSprite::SpriteCreate(HL_EGON_FLARE_SPRITE, pev->origin, FALSE);
+	m_pSprite->pev->scale = 1.0;
+	m_pSprite->SetTransparency(kRenderGlow, 255, 255, 255, 255, kRenderFxNoDissipation);
+	m_pSprite->pev->spawnflags |= SF_SPRITE_TEMPORARY;
+	m_pSprite->pev->owner = m_pPlayer->edict();
+}
+
+void CHLEgon::DestroyEffect()
+{
+	if (m_pBeam)
+	{
+		UTIL_Remove(m_pBeam);
+		m_pBeam = nullptr;
+	}
+
+	if (m_pNoise)
+	{
+		UTIL_Remove(m_pNoise);
+		m_pNoise = nullptr;
+	}
+
+	if (m_pSprite)
+	{
+		m_pSprite->Expand(10, 500);
+		m_pSprite = nullptr;
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLEgon::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	ResetEmptySound();
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	if (m_fireState != FIRE_OFF)
+	{
+		EndAttack();
+		return;
+	}
+
+	int iAnim;
+	if (RANDOM_FLOAT(0.0f, 1.0f) <= 0.5f)
+	{
+		iAnim = EGON_IDLE1;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		iAnim = EGON_FIDGET1;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 3.0f;
+	}
+
+	SendWeaponAnim(iAnim);
+}
+
+void CHLEgon::EndAttack()
+{
+	bool bMakeNoise = (m_fireState != FIRE_OFF);
+	PLAYBACK_EVENT_FULL(FEV_GLOBAL | FEV_RELIABLE, m_pPlayer->edict(), m_usEgonStop, 0.0f, m_pPlayer->pev->origin, m_pPlayer->pev->angles, 0.0f, 0.0f, bMakeNoise, 0, 0, 0);
+
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 2.0f;
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+	m_fireState = FIRE_OFF;
+	DestroyEffect();
+}

+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Grenades: the hand grenade's and the MP5's
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(hl_grenade, CHLGrenade, CCSAnimating)
+
+void CHLGrenade::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	MAKE_STRING_CLASS("hl_grenade", pev);
+	pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_BOUNCE;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_BBOX;
+
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/grenade.mdl");
+	UTIL_SetSize(pev, Vector(0, 0, 0), Vector(0, 0, 0));
+
+	pev->dmg = HL_ARGRENADE_DAMAGE;
+	m_flNextHit = 0.0f;
+}
+
+void CHLGrenade::Precache()
+{
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/grenade.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/w_grenade.mdl");
+
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/grenade_hit1.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/grenade_hit2.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/grenade_hit3.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/debris1.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/debris2.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/debris3.wav");
+}
+
+CHLGrenade *CHLGrenade::ShootTimed(entvars_t *pevOwner, Vector vecStart, Vector vecVelocity, float time)
+{
+	CHLGrenade *pGrenade = GetClassPtr<CCSAnimating>((CHLGrenade *)nullptr);
+	pGrenade->Spawn();
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pGrenade->pev, vecStart);
+	pGrenade->pev->velocity = vecVelocity;
+	pGrenade->pev->angles = UTIL_VecToAngles(pGrenade->pev->velocity);
+	pGrenade->pev->owner = ENT(pevOwner);
+
+	pGrenade->SetTouch(&CHLGrenade::BounceTouch);
+	pGrenade->pev->dmgtime = gpGlobals->time + time;
+	pGrenade->SetThink(&CHLGrenade::TumbleThink);
+	pGrenade->pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+	if (time < 0.1f)
+	{
+		pGrenade->pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time;
+		pGrenade->pev->velocity = Vector(0, 0, 0);
+	}
+
+	SET_MODEL(pGrenade->edict(), "models/w_grenade.mdl");
+	pGrenade->pev->sequence = RANDOM_LONG(3, 6);
+	pGrenade->ResetSequenceInfo();
+	pGrenade->pev->framerate = 1.0f;
+
+	pGrenade->pev->gravity = 0.5f;
+	pGrenade->pev->friction = 0.8f;
+	pGrenade->pev->dmg = HL_HANDGRENADE_DAMAGE;
+	return pGrenade;
+}
+
+CHLGrenade *CHLGrenade::ShootContact(entvars_t *pevOwner, Vector vecStart, Vector vecVelocity)
+{
+	CHLGrenade *pGrenade = GetClassPtr<CCSAnimating>((CHLGrenade *)nullptr);
+	pGrenade->Spawn();
+	pGrenade->pev->gravity = 0.5f; // (aerodynamic)
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pGrenade->pev, vecStart);
+	pGrenade->pev->velocity = vecVelocity;
+	pGrenade->pev->angles = UTIL_VecToAngles(pGrenade->pev->velocity);
+	pGrenade->pev->owner = ENT(pevOwner);
+
+	pGrenade->SetThink(&CHLGrenade::FlyThink);
+	pGrenade->pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time;
+	pGrenade->pev->avelocity.x = RANDOM_FLOAT(-100, -500);
+	pGrenade->SetTouch(&CHLGrenade::ExplodeTouch);
+	pGrenade->pev->dmg = HL_ARGRENADE_DAMAGE;
+	return pGrenade;
+}
+
+void CHLGrenade::BounceTouch(CBaseEntity *pOther)
+{
+	if (pOther->edict() == pev->owner)
+		return;
+
+	// (a knock on whom it hits in flight)
+	if (m_flNextHit < gpGlobals->time && pev->velocity.Length() > 100 && pev->owner)
+	{
+		entvars_t *pevOwner = VARS(pev->owner);
+		TraceResult tr = UTIL_GetGlobalTrace();
+		ClearMultiDamage();
+		pOther->TraceAttack(pevOwner, 1, gpGlobals->v_forward, &tr, DMG_CLUB);
+		ApplyMultiDamage(pev, pevOwner);
+		m_flNextHit = gpGlobals->time + 1.0f;
+	}
+
+	if (pev->flags & FL_ONGROUND)
+	{
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * 0.8f;
+		pev->sequence = 1;
+		ResetSequenceInfo();
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		static const char *sounds[] = { "weapons/grenade_hit1.wav", "weapons/grenade_hit2.wav", "weapons/grenade_hit3.wav" };
+		EMIT_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, sounds[RANDOM_LONG(0, 2)], 0.25f, ATTN_NORM);
+	}
+
+	pev->framerate = pev->velocity.Length() / 200.0f;
+	if (pev->framerate > 1.0f)
+	{
+		pev->framerate = 1.0f;
+	}
+	else if (pev->framerate < 0.5f)
+	{
+		pev->framerate = 0.0f;
+		pev->frame = 0.0f;
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLGrenade::ExplodeTouch(CBaseEntity *pOther)
+{
+	TraceResult tr;
+	Vector vecSpot = pev->origin - pev->velocity.Normalize() * 32;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(vecSpot, vecSpot + pev->velocity.Normalize() * 64, ignore_monsters, ENT(pev), &tr);
+	Explode(&tr);
+}
+
+void CHLGrenade::TumbleThink()
+{
+	if (!IsInWorld())
+	{
+		UTIL_Remove(this);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	StudioFrameAdvance();
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+
+	if (pev->dmgtime <= gpGlobals->time)
+		SetThink(&CHLGrenade::Detonate);
+
+	if (pev->waterlevel != 0)
+	{
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * 0.5f;
+		pev->framerate = 0.2f;
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLGrenade::FlyThink()
+{
+	if (!IsInWorld())
+	{
+		UTIL_Remove(this);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.2f;
+
+	if (pev->waterlevel != 0)
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * 0.5f;
+}
+
+void CHLGrenade::Detonate()
+{
+	TraceResult tr;
+	Vector vecSpot = pev->origin + Vector(0, 0, 8);
+	UTIL_TraceLine(vecSpot, vecSpot + Vector(0, 0, -40), ignore_monsters, ENT(pev), &tr);
+	Explode(&tr);
+}
+
+void CHLGrenade::Explode(TraceResult *pTrace)
+{
+	pev->model = iStringNull; // (invisible)
+	pev->solid = SOLID_NOT;
+	pev->takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
+
+	entvars_t *pevOwner = pev->owner ? VARS(pev->owner) : nullptr;
+	HL_Explosion(this, pTrace, pevOwner, pev->dmg, pev->dmg * 2.5f, int((pev->dmg - 50) * 0.6f));
+
+	static const char *sounds[] = { "weapons/debris1.wav", "weapons/debris2.wav", "weapons/debris3.wav" };
+	EMIT_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, sounds[RANDOM_LONG(0, 2)], 0.55f, ATTN_NORM);
+
+	pev->effects |= EF_NODRAW;
+	pev->velocity = g_vecZero;
+	SetTouch(nullptr);
+	SetThink(&CHLGrenade::Smoke);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.3f;
+}
+
+void CHLGrenade::Smoke()
+{
+	if (UTIL_PointContents(pev->origin) == CONTENTS_WATER)
+	{
+		UTIL_Bubbles(pev->origin - Vector(64, 64, 64), pev->origin + Vector(64, 64, 64), 100);
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_PVS, SVC_TEMPENTITY, pev->origin);
+			WRITE_BYTE(TE_SMOKE);
+			WRITE_COORD(pev->origin.x);
+			WRITE_COORD(pev->origin.y);
+			WRITE_COORD(pev->origin.z);
+			WRITE_SHORT(g_sModelIndexSmoke);
+			WRITE_BYTE(clamp(int((pev->dmg - 50) * 0.8f), 1, 255)); // scale * 10
+			WRITE_BYTE(12); // framerate
+		MESSAGE_END();
+	}
+
+	UTIL_Remove(this);
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Hand grenade
+
+enum hl_handgrenade_e
+{
+	HANDGRENADE_IDLE = 0,
+	HANDGRENADE_FIDGET,
+	HANDGRENADE_PINPULL,
+	HANDGRENADE_THROW1, // toss
+	HANDGRENADE_THROW2, // medium
+	HANDGRENADE_THROW3, // hard
+	HANDGRENADE_HOLSTER,
+	HANDGRENADE_DRAW
+};
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(weapon_handgrenade, CHLHandGrenade, CCSPlayerWeapon)
+
+void CHLHandGrenade::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	m_iId = WEAPON_HL_HANDGRENADE;
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/w_grenade.mdl");
+	m_iDefaultAmmo = 1;
+	FallInit();
+	CBasePlayerWeapon::Spawn();
+}
+
+void CHLHandGrenade::Precache()
+{
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/w_grenade.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/v_grenade.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/p_grenade.mdl");
+
+	UTIL_PrecacheOther("hl_grenade");
+}
+
+int CHLHandGrenade::GetItemInfo(ItemInfo *p)
+{
+	p->pszName = STRING(pev->classname);
+	p->pszAmmo1 = "Hand Grenade";
+	p->iMaxAmmo1 = HL_HANDGRENADE_MAX_CARRY;
+	p->pszAmmo2 = nullptr;
+	p->iMaxAmmo2 = -1;
+	p->iMaxClip = WEAPON_NOCLIP;
+	p->iSlot = 3;
+	p->iPosition = 4;
+	p->iId = m_iId = WEAPON_HL_HANDGRENADE;
+	p->iFlags = ITEM_FLAG_LIMITINWORLD | ITEM_FLAG_EXHAUSTIBLE;
+	p->iWeight = HL_HANDGRENADE_WEIGHT;
+	return 1;
+}
+
+BOOL CHLHandGrenade::Deploy()
+{
+	m_flReleaseThrow = -1;
+	return DefaultDeploy("models/v_grenade.mdl", "models/p_grenade.mdl", HANDGRENADE_DRAW, "grenade", 0);
+}
+
+void CHLHandGrenade::Holster(int skiplocal)
+{
+	m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+	m_flStartThrow = 0.0f;
+	m_flReleaseThrow = 0.0f;
+	EMIT_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "common/null.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+		SendWeaponAnim(HANDGRENADE_HOLSTER);
+	else
+		DestroyItem();
+}
+
+void CHLHandGrenade::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	// (the pin pulled: it cooks from now on)
+	if (!m_flStartThrow && m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] > 0)
+	{
+		m_flStartThrow = gpGlobals->time;
+		m_flReleaseThrow = 0.0f;
+		SendWeaponAnim(HANDGRENADE_PINPULL);
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLHandGrenade::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	if (m_flReleaseThrow == 0.0f && m_flStartThrow)
+		m_flReleaseThrow = gpGlobals->time;
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	if (m_flStartThrow)
+	{
+		// (thrown harder upwards than downwards)
+		Vector angThrow = m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle;
+		if (angThrow.x < 0.0f)
+			angThrow.x = -10.0f + angThrow.x * ((90.0f - 10.0f) / 90.0f);
+		else
+			angThrow.x = -10.0f + angThrow.x * ((90.0f + 10.0f) / 90.0f);
+
+		float flVel = (90.0f - angThrow.x) * 6.5f;
+		if (flVel > 1000.0f)
+			flVel = 1000.0f;
+
+		UTIL_MakeVectors(angThrow);
+		Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->pev->origin + m_pPlayer->pev->view_ofs + gpGlobals->v_forward * 16.0f;
+		Vector vecThrow = gpGlobals->v_forward * flVel + m_pPlayer->pev->velocity;
+
+		float time = m_flStartThrow - gpGlobals->time + 3.0f;
+		if (time < 0.0f)
+			time = 0.0f;
+
+		CHLGrenade::ShootTimed(m_pPlayer->pev, vecSrc, vecThrow, time);
+
+		if (flVel < 500.0f)
+			SendWeaponAnim(HANDGRENADE_THROW1);
+		else if (flVel < 1000.0f)
+			SendWeaponAnim(HANDGRENADE_THROW2);
+		else
+			SendWeaponAnim(HANDGRENADE_THROW3);
+
+		m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+		// (positive: the next idle knows it was just thrown — draws the next, or puts the hand away)
+		m_flReleaseThrow = gpGlobals->time;
+		m_flStartThrow = 0.0f;
+		m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.5f);
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+
+		m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType]--;
+		if (!m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+		{
+			// (the animation finishes first)
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = m_flNextSecondaryAttack = m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.5f);
+		}
+		return;
+	}
+	else if (m_flReleaseThrow > 0.0f)
+	{
+		// (just thrown: the next one, or none left)
+		m_flStartThrow = 0.0f;
+
+		if (!m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+		{
+			RetireWeapon();
+			return;
+		}
+
+		SendWeaponAnim(HANDGRENADE_DRAW);
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+		m_flReleaseThrow = -1.0f;
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+	{
+		int iAnim;
+		if (UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 0.0f, 1.0f) <= 0.75f)
+		{
+			iAnim = HANDGRENADE_IDLE;
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+		}
+		else
+		{
+			iAnim = HANDGRENADE_FIDGET;
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 75.0f / 30.0f;
+		}
+
+		SendWeaponAnim(iAnim);
+	}
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Satchel charge and its radio
+
+enum hl_satchel_e
+{
+	SATCHEL_IDLE1 = 0,
+	SATCHEL_FIDGET1,
+	SATCHEL_DRAW,
+	SATCHEL_DROP
+};
+
+enum hl_satchel_radio_e
+{
+	SATCHEL_RADIO_IDLE1 = 0,
+	SATCHEL_RADIO_FIDGET1,
+	SATCHEL_RADIO_DRAW,
+	SATCHEL_RADIO_FIRE,
+	SATCHEL_RADIO_HOLSTER
+};
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(monster_satchel, CHLSatchelCharge, CCSAnimating)
+
+void CHLSatchelCharge::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	MAKE_STRING_CLASS("monster_satchel", pev);
+	pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_BOUNCE;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_BBOX;
+
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/w_satchel.mdl");
+	UTIL_SetSize(pev, Vector(-4, -4, -4), Vector(4, 4, 4)); // (point sized, may be stepped over)
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pev, pev->origin);
+
+	SetTouch(&CHLSatchelCharge::SatchelSlide);
+	SetThink(&CHLSatchelCharge::SatchelThink);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+
+	pev->gravity = 0.5f;
+	pev->friction = 0.8f;
+	pev->dmg = HL_SATCHEL_DAMAGE;
+	pev->sequence = 1;
+	m_lastBounceOrigin = g_vecZero;
+}
+
+void CHLSatchelCharge::Precache()
+{
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/w_satchel.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/g_bounce1.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/g_bounce2.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/g_bounce3.wav");
+}
+
+// (set off by its owner's radio)
+void CHLSatchelCharge::Use(CBaseEntity *pActivator, CBaseEntity *pCaller, USE_TYPE useType, float value)
+{
+	SetThink(&CHLSatchelCharge::Detonate);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time;
+}
+
+void CHLSatchelCharge::SatchelSlide(CBaseEntity *pOther)
+{
+	if (pOther->edict() == pev->owner)
+		return;
+
+	pev->gravity = 1; // (normal gravity now)
+
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(pev->origin, pev->origin - Vector(0, 0, 10), ignore_monsters, edict(), &tr);
+	if (tr.flFraction < 1.0f)
+	{
+		// (on the ground: it slows down)
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * 0.95f;
+		pev->avelocity = pev->avelocity * 0.9f;
+	}
+
+	if (!(pev->flags & FL_ONGROUND) && pev->velocity.Length2D() > 10.0f && pev->origin != m_lastBounceOrigin)
+	{
+		static const char *sounds[] = { "weapons/g_bounce1.wav", "weapons/g_bounce2.wav", "weapons/g_bounce3.wav" };
+		EMIT_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, sounds[RANDOM_LONG(0, 2)], VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+	}
+
+	m_lastBounceOrigin = pev->origin;
+}
+
+void CHLSatchelCharge::SatchelThink()
+{
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+
+	// (gone with its owner, as Half-Life's)
+	CBaseEntity *pOwner = pev->owner ? CBaseEntity::Instance(pev->owner) : nullptr;
+	if (!IsInWorld() || !pOwner || !pOwner->IsPlayer() || !pOwner->IsAlive())
+	{
+		UTIL_Remove(this);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (pev->waterlevel == 3)
+	{
+		pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_FLY;
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * 0.8f;
+		pev->avelocity = pev->avelocity * 0.9f;
+		pev->velocity.z += 8;
+	}
+	else if (pev->waterlevel == 0)
+	{
+		pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_BOUNCE;
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		pev->velocity.z -= 8.0f;
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLSatchelCharge::Detonate()
+{
+	TraceResult tr;
+	Vector vecSpot = pev->origin + Vector(0, 0, 8);
+	UTIL_TraceLine(vecSpot, vecSpot + Vector(0, 0, -40), ignore_monsters, ENT(pev), &tr);
+
+	entvars_t *pevOwner = pev->owner ? VARS(pev->owner) : nullptr;
+	pev->model = iStringNull;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_NOT;
+	pev->effects |= EF_NODRAW;
+	HL_Explosion(this, &tr, pevOwner, pev->dmg, pev->dmg * 2.5f, int((pev->dmg - 50) * 0.6f));
+
+	SetTouch(nullptr);
+	SetThink(&CBaseEntity::SUB_Remove);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+}
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(weapon_satchel, CHLSatchel, CCSPlayerWeapon)
+
+void CHLSatchel::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	m_iId = WEAPON_HL_SATCHEL;
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/w_satchel.mdl");
+	m_iDefaultAmmo = 1;
+	m_chargeReady = SATCHEL_IDLE;
+	FallInit();
+	CBasePlayerWeapon::Spawn();
+}
+
+void CHLSatchel::Precache()
+{
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/v_satchel.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/v_satchel_radio.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/w_satchel.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/p_satchel.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/p_satchel_radio.mdl");
+
+	UTIL_PrecacheOther("monster_satchel");
+}
+
+int CHLSatchel::GetItemInfo(ItemInfo *p)
+{
+	p->pszName = STRING(pev->classname);
+	p->pszAmmo1 = "Satchel Charge";
+	p->iMaxAmmo1 = HL_SATCHEL_MAX_CARRY;
+	p->pszAmmo2 = nullptr;
+	p->iMaxAmmo2 = -1;
+	p->iMaxClip = WEAPON_NOCLIP;
+	p->iSlot = 3;
+	p->iPosition = 5;
+	p->iId = m_iId = WEAPON_HL_SATCHEL;
+	p->iFlags = ITEM_FLAG_SELECTONEMPTY | ITEM_FLAG_LIMITINWORLD | ITEM_FLAG_EXHAUSTIBLE;
+	p->iWeight = HL_SATCHEL_WEIGHT;
+	return 1;
+}
+
+// (whether charges its holder threw are lying around)
+bool CHLSatchel::HasCharges()
+{
+	if (!m_pPlayer)
+		return false;
+
+	CBaseEntity *pCharge = nullptr;
+	while ((pCharge = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pCharge, "monster_satchel")))
+	{
+		if (pCharge->pev->owner == m_pPlayer->edict() && !(pCharge->pev->flags & FL_KILLME))
+			return true;
+	}
+
+	return false;
+}
+
+int CHLSatchel::AddToPlayer(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	int bResult = CBasePlayerWeapon::AddToPlayer(pPlayer);
+	m_chargeReady = HasCharges() ? SATCHEL_READY : SATCHEL_IDLE;
+	return bResult;
+}
+
+BOOL CHLSatchel::CanDeploy()
+{
+	return m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[PrimaryAmmoIndex()] > 0 || HasCharges();
+}
+
+BOOL CHLSatchel::Deploy()
+{
+	m_chargeReady = HasCharges() ? SATCHEL_READY : SATCHEL_IDLE;
+	m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+
+	BOOL result;
+	if (m_chargeReady == SATCHEL_READY)
+		result = DefaultDeploy("models/v_satchel_radio.mdl", "models/p_satchel_radio.mdl", SATCHEL_RADIO_DRAW, "c4", 0);
+	else
+		result = DefaultDeploy("models/v_satchel.mdl", "models/p_satchel.mdl", SATCHEL_DRAW, "grenade", 0);
+
+	if (result)
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 2.0f;
+
+	return result;
+}
+
+void CHLSatchel::Holster(int skiplocal)
+{
+	m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+	EMIT_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "common/null.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+
+	if (!m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] && !HasCharges())
+	{
+		DestroyItem();
+		return;
+	}
+
+	SendWeaponAnim(m_chargeReady == SATCHEL_READY ? SATCHEL_RADIO_HOLSTER : SATCHEL_DROP);
+}
+
+// (as Half-Life's: the click sets off the charges once one is thrown, or throws; the right click throws another)
+void CHLSatchel::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	if (m_chargeReady == SATCHEL_READY)
+		Detonate();
+	else if (m_chargeReady != SATCHEL_RELOAD)
+		Throw();
+}
+
+void CHLSatchel::SecondaryAttack()
+{
+	if (m_chargeReady != SATCHEL_RELOAD)
+		Throw();
+}
+
+// (the radio sets off every charge of its holder)
+void CHLSatchel::Detonate()
+{
+	if (m_chargeReady != SATCHEL_READY)
+		return;
+
+	SendWeaponAnim(SATCHEL_RADIO_FIRE);
+
+	edict_t *pPlayer = m_pPlayer->edict();
+	CBaseEntity *pCharge = nullptr;
+	while ((pCharge = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pCharge, "monster_satchel")))
+	{
+		if (pCharge->pev->owner == pPlayer)
+			pCharge->Use(m_pPlayer, m_pPlayer, USE_ON, 0);
+	}
+
+	m_chargeReady = SATCHEL_RELOAD;
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.5f);
+	m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+}
+
+void CHLSatchel::Throw()
+{
+	if (!m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+		return;
+
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle);
+	Vector vecThrow = gpGlobals->v_forward * 274 + m_pPlayer->pev->velocity;
+
+	CHLSatchelCharge *pCharge = GetClassPtr<CCSAnimating>((CHLSatchelCharge *)nullptr);
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pCharge->pev, m_pPlayer->pev->origin);
+	pCharge->pev->owner = m_pPlayer->edict();
+	pCharge->Spawn();
+	pCharge->pev->velocity = vecThrow;
+	pCharge->pev->avelocity.y = 400;
+
+	HL_SetViewModels(m_pPlayer, "models/v_satchel_radio.mdl", "models/p_satchel_radio.mdl");
+	Q_strlcpy(m_pPlayer->m_szAnimExtention, "c4");
+	SendWeaponAnim(SATCHEL_RADIO_DRAW);
+	m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+
+	m_chargeReady = SATCHEL_READY;
+	m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType]--;
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(1.0f);
+	m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+}
+
+void CHLSatchel::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	switch (m_chargeReady)
+	{
+		case SATCHEL_IDLE:
+			SendWeaponAnim(SATCHEL_FIDGET1);
+			break;
+
+		case SATCHEL_READY:
+			SendWeaponAnim(SATCHEL_RADIO_FIDGET1);
+			break;
+
+		case SATCHEL_RELOAD:
+		{
+			// (set off: the next charge, or none left)
+			if (!m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+			{
+				m_chargeReady = SATCHEL_IDLE;
+				RetireWeapon();
+				return;
+			}
+
+			HL_SetViewModels(m_pPlayer, "models/v_satchel.mdl", "models/p_satchel.mdl");
+			Q_strlcpy(m_pPlayer->m_szAnimExtention, "grenade");
+			SendWeaponAnim(SATCHEL_DRAW);
+
+			m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.5f);
+			m_flNextSecondaryAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+			m_chargeReady = SATCHEL_IDLE;
+			break;
+		}
+	}
+
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Tripmine
+
+enum hl_tripmine_e
+{
+	TRIPMINE_IDLE1 = 0,
+	TRIPMINE_IDLE2,
+	TRIPMINE_ARM1,
+	TRIPMINE_ARM2,
+	TRIPMINE_FIDGET,
+	TRIPMINE_HOLSTER,
+	TRIPMINE_DRAW,
+	TRIPMINE_WORLD,
+	TRIPMINE_GROUND
+};
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(monster_tripmine, CHLTripmineGrenade, CCSAnimating)
+
+void CHLTripmineGrenade::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	MAKE_STRING_CLASS("monster_tripmine", pev);
+	pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_FLY;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_NOT;
+
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/v_tripmine.mdl");
+	pev->frame = 0;
+	pev->body = 3;
+	pev->sequence = TRIPMINE_WORLD;
+	ResetSequenceInfo();
+	pev->framerate = 0;
+
+	UTIL_SetSize(pev, Vector(-8, -8, -8), Vector(8, 8, 8));
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pev, pev->origin);
+
+	m_flPowerUp = gpGlobals->time + 2.5f;
+	SetThink(&CHLTripmineGrenade::PowerupThink);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.2f;
+
+	pev->takedamage = DAMAGE_YES;
+	pev->dmg = HL_TRIPMINE_DAMAGE;
+	pev->health = 1; // (any damage sets it off)
+
+	m_pBeam = nullptr;
+	m_hOwner = nullptr;
+	m_pRealOwner = pev->owner;
+	m_iOwnerTeam = HL_TeamOf(pev->owner);
+
+	if (pev->owner)
+	{
+		EMIT_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, "weapons/mine_deploy.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+		EMIT_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_BODY, "weapons/mine_charge.wav", 0.2f, ATTN_NORM); // (charging up)
+	}
+
+	UTIL_MakeAimVectors(pev->angles);
+	m_vecDir = gpGlobals->v_forward;
+	m_vecEnd = pev->origin + m_vecDir * 2048.0f;
+}
+
+void CHLTripmineGrenade::Precache()
+{
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/v_tripmine.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("sprites/laserbeam.spr");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/mine_deploy.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/mine_activate.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("weapons/mine_charge.wav");
+}
+
+// (waits until it holds to a wall, then arms after its charge-up)
+void CHLTripmineGrenade::PowerupThink()
+{
+	TraceResult tr;
+
+	if (!m_hOwner.IsValid())
+	{
+		// (what it sits on, its owner from now on: it moves, the mine goes)
+		edict_t *oldowner = pev->owner;
+		pev->owner = nullptr;
+		UTIL_TraceLine(pev->origin + m_vecDir * 8.0f, pev->origin - m_vecDir * 32.0f, dont_ignore_monsters, ENT(pev), &tr);
+
+		if (tr.fStartSolid || (oldowner && tr.pHit == oldowner))
+		{
+			pev->owner = oldowner;
+			m_flPowerUp += 0.1f;
+			pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+			return;
+		}
+
+		if (tr.flFraction < 1.0f)
+		{
+			pev->owner = tr.pHit;
+			m_hOwner = CBaseEntity::Instance(pev->owner);
+			m_posOwner = m_hOwner->pev->origin;
+			m_angleOwner = m_hOwner->pev->angles;
+		}
+		else
+		{
+			STOP_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, "weapons/mine_deploy.wav");
+			STOP_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_BODY, "weapons/mine_charge.wav");
+			SetThink(&CBaseEntity::SUB_Remove);
+			pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+			KillBeam();
+			return;
+		}
+	}
+	else if (m_posOwner != m_hOwner->pev->origin || m_angleOwner != m_hOwner->pev->angles)
+	{
+		// (its wall moved: no mine)
+		STOP_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, "weapons/mine_deploy.wav");
+		STOP_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_BODY, "weapons/mine_charge.wav");
+		SetThink(&CBaseEntity::SUB_Remove);
+		KillBeam();
+		pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (gpGlobals->time > m_flPowerUp)
+	{
+		// (armed: solid, and its beam on)
+		pev->solid = SOLID_BBOX;
+		UTIL_SetOrigin(pev, pev->origin);
+		MakeBeam();
+		EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, "weapons/mine_activate.wav", 0.5f, ATTN_NORM, 1, 75);
+	}
+
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+}
+
+void CHLTripmineGrenade::KillBeam()
+{
+	if (m_pBeam)
+	{
+		UTIL_Remove(m_pBeam);
+		m_pBeam = nullptr;
+	}
+}
+
+void CHLTripmineGrenade::MakeBeam()
+{
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(pev->origin, m_vecEnd, dont_ignore_monsters, ENT(pev), &tr);
+	m_flBeamLength = tr.flFraction;
+
+	SetThink(&CHLTripmineGrenade::BeamBreakThink);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+
+	Vector vecTmpEnd = pev->origin + m_vecDir * 2048.0f * m_flBeamLength;
+
+	m_pBeam = CBeam::BeamCreate("sprites/laserbeam.spr", 10);
+	m_pBeam->pev->spawnflags |= SF_BEAM_TEMPORARY;
+	m_pBeam->PointEntInit(vecTmpEnd, entindex());
+	m_pBeam->SetColor(0, 214, 198);
+	m_pBeam->SetScrollRate(255);
+	m_pBeam->SetBrightness(64);
+}
+
+// (its owner's team walks through the beam)
+bool CHLTripmineGrenade::LetsThrough(CBaseEntity *pEntity)
+{
+	if (!pEntity || !pEntity->IsPlayer())
+		return false;
+
+#ifdef REGAMEDLL_ADD
+	if (CSGameRules()->IsFreeForAll())
+		return pEntity->edict() == m_pRealOwner;
+#endif
+
+	return static_cast<CBasePlayer *>(pEntity)->m_iTeam == m_iOwnerTeam;
+}
+
+void CHLTripmineGrenade::BeamBreakThink()
+{
+	bool bBlowup = false;
+
+	TraceResult tr;
+	gpGlobals->trace_flags = FTRACE_SIMPLEBOX;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(pev->origin, m_vecEnd, dont_ignore_monsters, ENT(pev), &tr);
+
+	if (!m_pBeam)
+		MakeBeam();
+
+	if (Q_fabs(m_flBeamLength - tr.flFraction) > 0.001f)
+	{
+		if (!LetsThrough(CBaseEntity::Instance(tr.pHit)))
+			bBlowup = true;
+	}
+	else if (!m_hOwner.IsValid() || m_posOwner != m_hOwner->pev->origin || m_angleOwner != m_hOwner->pev->angles)
+	{
+		// (its wall went or moved)
+		bBlowup = true;
+	}
+
+	if (bBlowup)
+	{
+		pev->owner = m_pRealOwner;
+		pev->health = 0;
+		Killed(VARS(pev->owner), GIB_NORMAL);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+}
+
+BOOL CHLTripmineGrenade::TakeDamage(entvars_t *pevInflictor, entvars_t *pevAttacker, float flDamage, int bitsDamageType)
+{
+	if (gpGlobals->time < m_flPowerUp && flDamage < pev->health)
+	{
+		// (disarmed before it is ready)
+		SetThink(&CBaseEntity::SUB_Remove);
+		pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+		KillBeam();
+		return FALSE;
+	}
+
+	return CBaseAnimating::TakeDamage(pevInflictor, pevAttacker, flDamage, bitsDamageType);
+}
+
+void CHLTripmineGrenade::Killed(entvars_t *pevAttacker, int iGib)
+{
+	pev->takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
+
+	// (the kill goes to whoever set it off by shooting it, otherwise to whom laid it)
+	pev->owner = (pevAttacker && (pevAttacker->flags & FL_CLIENT)) ? ENT(pevAttacker) : m_pRealOwner;
+
+	SetThink(&CHLTripmineGrenade::DelayDeathThink);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + RANDOM_FLOAT(0.1f, 0.3f);
+
+	EMIT_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_BODY, "common/null.wav", 0.5f, ATTN_NORM); // (the charge-up off)
+}
+
+void CHLTripmineGrenade::DelayDeathThink()
+{
+	KillBeam();
+
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(pev->origin + m_vecDir * 8, pev->origin - m_vecDir * 64.0f, dont_ignore_monsters, ENT(pev), &tr);
+
+	entvars_t *pevOwner = pev->owner ? VARS(pev->owner) : nullptr;
+	pev->model = iStringNull;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_NOT;
+	pev->effects |= EF_NODRAW;
+	HL_Explosion(this, &tr, pevOwner, pev->dmg, pev->dmg * 2.5f, int((pev->dmg - 50) * 0.6f));
+
+	SetThink(&CBaseEntity::SUB_Remove);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+}
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(weapon_tripmine, CHLTripmine, CCSPlayerWeapon)
+
+void CHLTripmine::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	m_iId = WEAPON_HL_TRIPMINE;
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/v_tripmine.mdl");
+	pev->frame = 0;
+	pev->body = 3;
+	pev->sequence = TRIPMINE_GROUND;
+	pev->framerate = 0;
+	m_iDefaultAmmo = 1;
+	FallInit();
+	CBasePlayerWeapon::Spawn();
+}
+
+void CHLTripmine::Precache()
+{
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/v_tripmine.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/p_tripmine.mdl");
+	UTIL_PrecacheOther("monster_tripmine");
+}
+
+int CHLTripmine::GetItemInfo(ItemInfo *p)
+{
+	p->pszName = STRING(pev->classname);
+	p->pszAmmo1 = "Trip Mine";
+	p->iMaxAmmo1 = HL_TRIPMINE_MAX_CARRY;
+	p->pszAmmo2 = nullptr;
+	p->iMaxAmmo2 = -1;
+	p->iMaxClip = WEAPON_NOCLIP;
+	p->iSlot = 3;
+	p->iPosition = 6;
+	p->iId = m_iId = WEAPON_HL_TRIPMINE;
+	p->iFlags = ITEM_FLAG_LIMITINWORLD | ITEM_FLAG_EXHAUSTIBLE;
+	p->iWeight = HL_TRIPMINE_WEIGHT;
+	return 1;
+}
+
+BOOL CHLTripmine::Deploy()
+{
+	pev->body = 0;
+	return DefaultDeploy("models/v_tripmine.mdl", "models/p_tripmine.mdl", TRIPMINE_DRAW, "c4", 0);
+}
+
+void CHLTripmine::Holster(int skiplocal)
+{
+	m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+	EMIT_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "common/null.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+
+	if (!m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+	{
+		DestroyItem();
+		return;
+	}
+
+	SendWeaponAnim(TRIPMINE_HOLSTER);
+}
+
+// (on the wall within reach, facing out of it)
+void CHLTripmine::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0)
+		return;
+
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle);
+	Vector vecSrc = m_pPlayer->GetGunPosition();
+	Vector vecAiming = gpGlobals->v_forward;
+
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(vecSrc, vecSrc + vecAiming * 128.0f, dont_ignore_monsters, ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), &tr);
+
+	if (tr.flFraction < 1.0f)
+	{
+		CBaseEntity *pEntity = CBaseEntity::Instance(tr.pHit);
+		if (pEntity && !(pEntity->pev->flags & FL_CONVEYOR))
+		{
+			CHLTripmineGrenade *pMine = GetClassPtr<CCSAnimating>((CHLTripmineGrenade *)nullptr);
+			UTIL_SetOrigin(pMine->pev, tr.vecEndPos + tr.vecPlaneNormal * 8.0f);
+			pMine->pev->angles = UTIL_VecToAngles(tr.vecPlaneNormal);
+			pMine->pev->owner = m_pPlayer->edict();
+			pMine->Spawn();
+
+			m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType]--;
+			m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+
+			if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0)
+			{
+				RetireWeapon();
+				return;
+			}
+
+			SendWeaponAnim(TRIPMINE_DRAW); // (the next one in hand)
+		}
+	}
+
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.3f);
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+}
+
+void CHLTripmine::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	pev->body = 0;
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0)
+	{
+		RetireWeapon();
+		return;
+	}
+
+	int iAnim;
+	float flRand = UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 0.0f, 1.0f);
+	if (flRand <= 0.25f)
+	{
+		iAnim = TRIPMINE_IDLE1;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 90.0f / 30.0f;
+	}
+	else if (flRand <= 0.75f)
+	{
+		iAnim = TRIPMINE_IDLE2;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 60.0f / 30.0f;
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		iAnim = TRIPMINE_FIDGET;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 100.0f / 30.0f;
+	}
+
+	SendWeaponAnim(iAnim);
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Snarks
+
+enum hl_w_squeak_e
+{
+	WSQUEAK_IDLE1 = 0,
+	WSQUEAK_FIDGET,
+	WSQUEAK_JUMP,
+	WSQUEAK_RUN
+};
+
+enum hl_squeak_e
+{
+	SQUEAK_IDLE1 = 0,
+	SQUEAK_FIDGETFIT,
+	SQUEAK_FIDGETNIP,
+	SQUEAK_DOWN,
+	SQUEAK_UP,
+	SQUEAK_THROW
+};
+
+#define HL_SNARK_DETONATE_DELAY 15.0f
+#define HL_SNARK_HEALTH         2
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(monster_snark, CHLSnarkGrenade, CCSAnimating)
+
+void CHLSnarkGrenade::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	MAKE_STRING_CLASS("monster_snark", pev);
+	pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_BOUNCE;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_BBOX;
+
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/w_squeak.mdl");
+	UTIL_SetSize(pev, Vector(-4, -4, 0), Vector(4, 4, 8));
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pev, pev->origin);
+
+	SetTouch(&CHLSnarkGrenade::SuperBounceTouch);
+	SetThink(&CHLSnarkGrenade::HuntThink);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+	m_flNextHunt = gpGlobals->time + 1E6f;
+
+	pev->takedamage = DAMAGE_AIM;
+	pev->health = HL_SNARK_HEALTH;
+	pev->gravity = 0.5f;
+	pev->friction = 0.5f;
+	pev->dmg = HL_SNARK_POP_DAMAGE;
+
+	m_flDie = gpGlobals->time + HL_SNARK_DETONATE_DELAY;
+	m_flNextHit = 0.0f;
+	m_flNextBite = 0.0f;
+	m_flNextBounceSound = gpGlobals->time;
+	m_posPrev = pev->origin;
+	m_vecTarget = g_vecZero;
+	m_hEnemy = nullptr;
+	m_hOwner = pev->owner ? CBaseEntity::Instance(pev->owner) : nullptr;
+	m_iOwnerTeam = HL_TeamOf(pev->owner);
+
+	pev->sequence = WSQUEAK_RUN;
+	ResetSequenceInfo();
+}
+
+void CHLSnarkGrenade::Precache()
+{
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/w_squeak.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("squeek/sqk_blast1.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("common/bodysplat.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("squeek/sqk_die1.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("squeek/sqk_hunt1.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("squeek/sqk_hunt2.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("squeek/sqk_hunt3.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("squeek/sqk_deploy1.wav");
+}
+
+CBaseEntity *CHLSnarkGrenade::FindEnemy()
+{
+	return HL_FindEnemy(this, m_iOwnerTeam, m_hOwner, 512, 0.0f);
+}
+
+// (it pops: a little blast that grew with each bite)
+void CHLSnarkGrenade::Killed(entvars_t *pevAttacker, int iGib)
+{
+	pev->model = iStringNull; // (invisible)
+	SetThink(&CBaseEntity::SUB_Remove);
+	SetTouch(nullptr);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+	pev->takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
+
+	EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_ITEM, "squeek/sqk_blast1.wav", VOL_NORM, 0.5f, 0, PITCH_NORM);
+	EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, "common/bodysplat.wav", 0.75f, ATTN_NORM, 0, 200);
+	UTIL_BloodDrips(pev->origin, BloodColor(), 80);
+
+	entvars_t *pevOwner = m_hOwner.IsValid() ? m_hOwner->pev : pev;
+	HL_RadiusDamage(pev->origin, pev, pevOwner, pev->dmg, pev->dmg * 2.5f);
+
+	if (m_hOwner.IsValid())
+		pev->owner = m_hOwner->edict();
+}
+
+void CHLSnarkGrenade::HuntThink()
+{
+	if (!IsInWorld())
+	{
+		SetTouch(nullptr);
+		UTIL_Remove(this);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	StudioFrameAdvance();
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+
+	// (its time is up)
+	if (gpGlobals->time >= m_flDie)
+	{
+		g_vecAttackDir = pev->velocity.Normalize();
+		pev->health = -1;
+		Killed(pev, 0);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	// (float in the water)
+	if (pev->waterlevel != 0)
+	{
+		if (pev->movetype == MOVETYPE_BOUNCE)
+			pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_FLY;
+
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * 0.9f;
+		pev->velocity.z += 8.0f;
+	}
+	else if (pev->movetype == MOVETYPE_FLY)
+	{
+		pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_BOUNCE;
+	}
+
+	// (hunts at each bounce, at least every 2 s)
+	if (m_flNextHunt > gpGlobals->time)
+		return;
+
+	m_flNextHunt = gpGlobals->time + 2.0f;
+
+	if (!m_hEnemy.IsValid() || !HL_IsEnemyOf(m_iOwnerTeam, m_hEnemy, m_hOwner))
+		m_hEnemy = FindEnemy();
+
+	if (m_flDie - gpGlobals->time <= 0.5f && m_flDie - gpGlobals->time >= 0.3f)
+		EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, "squeek/sqk_die1.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, 100 + RANDOM_LONG(0, 0x3F));
+
+	if (m_hEnemy.IsValid())
+	{
+		if (FVisible(m_hEnemy))
+			m_vecTarget = (m_hEnemy->EyePosition() - pev->origin).Normalize();
+
+		float flVel = pev->velocity.Length();
+		float flAdj = 50.0f / (flVel + 10.0f);
+		if (flAdj > 1.2f)
+			flAdj = 1.2f;
+
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * flAdj + m_vecTarget * 300.0f;
+	}
+
+	if (pev->flags & FL_ONGROUND)
+	{
+		pev->avelocity = Vector(0, 0, 0);
+	}
+	else if (pev->avelocity == Vector(0, 0, 0))
+	{
+		pev->avelocity.x = RANDOM_FLOAT(-100, 100);
+		pev->avelocity.z = RANDOM_FLOAT(-100, 100);
+	}
+
+	// (stuck: a random jump)
+	if ((pev->origin - m_posPrev).Length() < 1.0f)
+	{
+		pev->velocity.x = RANDOM_FLOAT(-100, 100);
+		pev->velocity.y = RANDOM_FLOAT(-100, 100);
+	}
+
+	m_posPrev = pev->origin;
+
+	pev->angles = UTIL_VecToAngles(pev->velocity);
+	pev->angles.z = 0;
+	pev->angles.x = 0;
+}
+
+void CHLSnarkGrenade::SuperBounceTouch(CBaseEntity *pOther)
+{
+	TraceResult tr = UTIL_GetGlobalTrace();
+
+	// (not its thrower until it has bounced once)
+	if (pev->owner && pOther->edict() == pev->owner)
+		return;
+
+	pev->owner = nullptr;
+	pev->angles.x = 0;
+	pev->angles.z = 0;
+
+	if (m_flNextHit > gpGlobals->time)
+		return;
+
+	// (higher pitched as it nears its end)
+	float flpitch = 155.0f - 60.0f * ((m_flDie - gpGlobals->time) / HL_SNARK_DETONATE_DELAY);
+
+	if (!(pOther->pev->flags & FL_WORLDBRUSH) && pOther->pev->takedamage && m_flNextBite < gpGlobals->time
+		&& tr.pHit == pOther->edict() && pOther->pev->modelindex != pev->modelindex && HL_IsEnemyOf(m_iOwnerTeam, pOther, m_hOwner))
+	{
+		// (a bite)
+		entvars_t *pevOwner = m_hOwner.IsValid() ? m_hOwner->pev : pev;
+		ClearMultiDamage();
+		pOther->TraceAttack(pevOwner, HL_SNARK_BITE_DAMAGE, gpGlobals->v_forward, &tr, DMG_SLASH);
+		ApplyMultiDamage(pev, pevOwner);
+
+		pev->dmg += HL_SNARK_POP_DAMAGE; // (more blast)
+		EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "squeek/sqk_deploy1.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, int(flpitch));
+		m_flNextBite = gpGlobals->time + 0.5f;
+	}
+
+	m_flNextHit = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+	m_flNextHunt = gpGlobals->time;
+
+	if (gpGlobals->time < m_flNextBounceSound)
+		return;
+
+	if (!(pev->flags & FL_ONGROUND))
+	{
+		static const char *sounds[] = { "squeek/sqk_hunt1.wav", "squeek/sqk_hunt2.wav", "squeek/sqk_hunt3.wav" };
+		EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, sounds[RANDOM_LONG(0, 2)], VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, int(flpitch));
+	}
+
+	m_flNextBounceSound = gpGlobals->time + 0.5f;
+}

+	pev->framerate = 1.0f;

+{
