+BOOL CHLSqueak::Deploy()
+{
+	EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, RANDOM_LONG(0, 1) ? "squeek/sqk_hunt3.wav" : "squeek/sqk_hunt2.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, 100);
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = QUIET_GUN_VOLUME;
+
+	BOOL result = DefaultDeploy("models/v_squeak.mdl", "models/p_squeak.mdl", SQUEAK_UP, "grenade", 0);
+	if (result)
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.7f;
+
+	return result;
+}
+
+void CHLSqueak::Holster(int skiplocal)
+{
+	m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+	EMIT_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "common/null.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+
+	if (!m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+	{
+		DestroyItem();
+		return;
+	}
+
+	SendWeaponAnim(SQUEAK_DOWN);
+}
+
+// (set down in front, launched by its holder's look and speed)
+void CHLSqueak::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	if (!m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+		return;
+
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(Vector(0, m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle.y, m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle.z));
+	Vector forward = gpGlobals->v_forward;
+	UTIL_MakeVectors(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle);
+
+	// (looking down: dropped at the feet; up: thrown forwards)
+	float flVel = (m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle.x <= 0) ? 1.0f : m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle.x / 90.0f;
+
+	Vector trace_origin = m_pPlayer->pev->origin;
+	if (m_pPlayer->pev->flags & FL_DUCKING)
+		trace_origin = trace_origin - Vector(0, 0, 1) * (flVel + 1.0f) * -18;
+
+	forward = forward * flVel + gpGlobals->v_forward * (1 - flVel);
+
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(trace_origin + forward * 24.0f, trace_origin + gpGlobals->v_forward * 60.0f, dont_ignore_monsters, nullptr, &tr);
+
+	if (tr.fAllSolid || tr.fStartSolid || tr.flFraction <= 0.25f)
+		return;
+
+	SendWeaponAnim(SQUEAK_THROW);
+	m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+
+	CHLSnarkGrenade *pSnark = GetClassPtr<CCSAnimating>((CHLSnarkGrenade *)nullptr);
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pSnark->pev, tr.vecEndPos);
+	pSnark->pev->angles = m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle;
+	pSnark->pev->owner = m_pPlayer->edict();
+	pSnark->Spawn();
+	pSnark->pev->velocity = forward * 200.0f + m_pPlayer->pev->velocity;
+
+	EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, RANDOM_LONG(0, 1) ? "squeek/sqk_hunt3.wav" : "squeek/sqk_hunt2.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM, 0, 105);
+	m_pPlayer->m_iWeaponVolume = QUIET_GUN_VOLUME;
+
+	m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType]--;
+	m_fJustThrown = 1;
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.3f);
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+}
+
+void CHLSqueak::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	if (m_fJustThrown)
+	{
+		// (the next one, or none left)
+		m_fJustThrown = 0;
+
+		if (!m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[PrimaryAmmoIndex()])
+		{
+			RetireWeapon();
+			return;
+		}
+
+		SendWeaponAnim(SQUEAK_UP);
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	int iAnim;
+	float flRand = UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 0.0f, 1.0f);
+	if (flRand <= 0.75f)
+	{
+		iAnim = SQUEAK_IDLE1;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 30.0f / 16.0f * 2.0f;
+	}
+	else if (flRand <= 0.875f)
+	{
+		iAnim = SQUEAK_FIDGETFIT;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 70.0f / 16.0f;
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		iAnim = SQUEAK_FIDGETNIP;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 80.0f / 16.0f;
+	}
+
+	SendWeaponAnim(iAnim);
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Buying, and the round restart
+
+CBaseEntity *HL_BuyEquipment(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, WeaponIdType weaponID)
+{
+	if (!pPlayer->CanPlayerBuy(true))
+		return nullptr;
+
+	WeaponInfoStruct *info = GetWeaponInfo(weaponID);
+	if (!info || !info->entityName)
+		return nullptr;
+
+	// (the crowbar once; the others as many as can be carried)
+	if (!info->ammoName2)
+	{
+		if (pPlayer->HasNamedPlayerItem(info->entityName))
+		{
+			if (g_bClientPrintEnable)
+				ClientPrint(pPlayer->pev, HUD_PRINTCENTER, "#Cstrike_Already_Own_Weapon");
+
+			return nullptr;
+		}
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		int iAmmo = CBasePlayer::GetAmmoIndex(info->ammoName2);
+		// (a pack sold whole: the snarks come by three)
+		const int pack = weaponID == WEAPON_HL_SNARK ? HL_SNARK_DEFAULT_GIVE : 1;
+		if (iAmmo >= 0 && pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[iAmmo] + pack > info->maxRounds)
+		{
+			if (g_bClientPrintEnable)
+				ClientPrint(pPlayer->pev, HUD_PRINTCENTER, "#Cannot_Carry_Anymore");
+
+			return nullptr;
+		}
+	}
+
+	if (pPlayer->m_iAccount < info->cost)
+	{
+		if (g_bClientPrintEnable)
+		{
+			ClientPrint(pPlayer->pev, HUD_PRINTCENTER, "#Not_Enough_Money");
+			BlinkAccount(pPlayer);
+		}
+
+		return nullptr;
+	}
+
+	CBaseEntity *pEntity = pPlayer->GiveNamedItem(info->entityName);
+	pPlayer->AddAccount(-info->cost, RT_PLAYER_BOUGHT_SOMETHING);
+
+	if (TheTutor)
+		TheTutor->OnEvent(EVENT_PLAYER_BOUGHT_SOMETHING, pPlayer);
+
+	return pEntity;
+}
+
+// (the MP5's: for its owner only)
+bool HL_BuyARGrenade(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	if (!pPlayer->CanPlayerBuy(true))
+		return false;
+
+	if (!pPlayer->HasNamedPlayerItem("weapon_9mmAR"))
+	{
+		if (g_bClientPrintEnable)
+			ClientPrint(pPlayer->pev, HUD_PRINTCENTER, ARS_L(pPlayer, "The MP5 grenades need the MP5", "Il faut le MP5 pour ses grenades"));
+
+		return false;
+	}
+
+	if (pPlayer->AmmoInventory(CBasePlayer::GetAmmoIndex("ARgrenades")) >= HL_ARGRENADE_MAX_CARRY)
+	{
+		if (g_bClientPrintEnable)
+			ClientPrint(pPlayer->pev, HUD_PRINTCENTER, "#Cannot_Carry_Anymore");
+
+		return false;
+	}
+
+	if (pPlayer->m_iAccount < HL_ARGRENADE_PRICE)
+	{
+		if (g_bClientPrintEnable)
+		{
+			ClientPrint(pPlayer->pev, HUD_PRINTCENTER, "#Not_Enough_Money");
+			BlinkAccount(pPlayer);
+		}
+
+		return false;
+	}
+
+	pPlayer->GiveAmmo(1, "ARgrenades", HL_ARGRENADE_MAX_CARRY);
+	EMIT_SOUND(ENT(pPlayer->pev), CHAN_ITEM, "items/9mmclip1.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+	pPlayer->AddAccount(-HL_ARGRENADE_PRICE, RT_PLAYER_BOUGHT_SOMETHING);
+	return true;
+}
+
+void HL_CleanUpMap()
+{
+	CBaseEntity *pEntity = nullptr;
+	while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "rpg_rocket")))
+	{
+		static_cast<CHLRpgRocket *>(pEntity)->Forget();
+		UTIL_Remove(pEntity);
+	}
+
+	pEntity = nullptr;
+	while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "monster_tripmine")))
+	{
+		static_cast<CHLTripmineGrenade *>(pEntity)->KillBeam();
+		UTIL_Remove(pEntity);
+	}
+
+	UTIL_RemoveOther("hl_grenade");
+	UTIL_RemoveOther("monster_satchel");
+	UTIL_RemoveOther("monster_snark");
+	UTIL_RemoveOther("hornet");
+	UTIL_RemoveOther("crossbow_bolt");
+}

+// A player still in the game, alive, on a side
+static bool PK_PlayerPlaying(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	return pPlayer && UTIL_IsValidPlayer(pPlayer) && !pPlayer->has_disconnected && pPlayer->IsAlive()
+		&& (pPlayer->m_iTeam == TERRORIST || pPlayer->m_iTeam == CT);
+}

+static Vector PK_Feet(CBaseEntity *pEntity)
+{
+	return pEntity->pev->origin + Vector(0, 0, pEntity->pev->mins.z);

+bool PK_IsPokemon(entvars_t *pev)
+{
+	return pev && FClassnameIs(pev, "monster_pokemon");
+}
+
+const char *PK_KillWeaponName(entvars_t *pevInflictor)
+{
+	CBaseEntity *pEntity = CBaseEntity::Instance(pevInflictor);
+	if (!pEntity || !PK_IsPokemon(pevInflictor))
+		return "pokemon";
+
+	return PK_Info(static_cast<CPokemon *>(pEntity)->Species()).killName;
+}
+
+static bool PK_IsLeM(int iSpecies)
+{
+	return iSpecies == PK_LEM;
+}
+
+// Its Pokemon out (not dying nor going back), if any
+static CPokemon *PK_PokemonOf(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	CBaseEntity *pEntity = nullptr;
+	while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "monster_pokemon")))
+	{
+		CPokemon *pPokemon = static_cast<CPokemon *>(pEntity);
+		if (pPokemon->IsOut() && pPokemon->IsOwnedBy(pPlayer))
+			return pPokemon;
+	}
+
+	return nullptr;
+}
+
+// A ball of its in flight
+static bool PK_BallInFlight(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	CBaseEntity *pEntity = nullptr;
+	while ((pEntity = UTIL_FindEntityByClassname(pEntity, "pokeball")))
+	{
+		CPokeBall *pBall = static_cast<CPokeBall *>(pEntity);
+		if (pBall->IsOwnedBy(pPlayer) && !pBall->IsOpened() && !(pEntity->pev->flags & FL_KILLME))
+			return true;
+	}
+
+	return false;
+}
+
+static bool PK_HasOut(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	return PK_PokemonOf(pPlayer) || PK_BallInFlight(pPlayer);
+}
+
+// A ball or the laptop in hand (its item, with the ball or the laptop in it)
+static CBasePlayerItem *PK_BallCarried(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	for (CBasePlayerItem *pItem = pPlayer->m_rgpPlayerItems[GRENADE_SLOT]; pItem; pItem = pItem->m_pNext)
+	{
+		if (IsCompanionItem(pItem->m_iId) && pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[pItem->PrimaryAmmoIndex()] > 0)
+			return pItem;
+	}
+
+	return nullptr;
+}
+
+// (a species' name in the player's language: Pikachu, Dracaufeu, Tortank, Le M in French)
+static const char *PK_NameFor(CBasePlayer *pPlayer, int iSpecies)
+{
+	static const char *const namesFr[PK_NUM_SPECIES] = { "Pikachu", "Dracaufeu", "Tortank", "Le M" };
+	return ARS_L(pPlayer, PK_Info(iSpecies).name, namesFr[clamp(iSpecies, 0, PK_NUM_SPECIES - 1)]);
+}
+
+// (what is in the way of another companion, for a message)
+static const char *PK_OutMessage(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	CPokemon *pOut = PK_PokemonOf(pPlayer);
+	return (pOut && PK_IsLeM(pOut->Species())) ? ARS_L(pPlayer, "Le M is already out", "Le M est d\xC3\xA9j\xC3\xA0 sorti") :
+		ARS_L(pPlayer, "Your Pokemon is already out", "Ton Pok\xC3\xA9mon est d\xC3\xA9j\xC3\xA0 sorti");
+}
+
+static const char *PK_CarriedMessage(CBasePlayer *pPlayer)
+{
+	CBasePlayerItem *pItem = PK_BallCarried(pPlayer);
+	return (pItem && pItem->m_iId == WEAPON_LEM_LAPTOP) ? ARS_L(pPlayer, "You already carry Le M's laptop", "Tu portes d\xC3\xA9j\xC3\xA0 l'ordinateur de Le M") :
+		ARS_L(pPlayer, "You already carry a Poke Ball", "Tu portes d\xC3\xA9j\xC3\xA0 une Pok\xC3\xA9 Ball");
+}

+static void PK_FxSprite(const Vector &pos, int iSprite, int iScale, int iBrightness)
+{
+	MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_PVS, SVC_TEMPENTITY, pos);
+		WRITE_BYTE(TE_SPRITE);
+		WRITE_COORD(pos.x);
+		WRITE_COORD(pos.y);
+		WRITE_COORD(pos.z);
+		WRITE_SHORT(iSprite);
+		WRITE_BYTE(clamp(iScale, 1, 255));
+		WRITE_BYTE(clamp(iBrightness, 0, 255));
+	MESSAGE_END();
+}
+
+// Where a flash of this half-size is drawn near pos: a sprite is depth-tested, so the floor under it would cut it flat
+// (and a ceiling over it): its centre at least its half-size (and flMinHeight) above the floor, under the ceiling when
+// there is room for it
+static Vector PK_FlashSpot(const Vector &pos, float flHalf, float flMinHeight, edict_t *pIgnore)
+{
+	float flLift = Q_max(flHalf, flMinHeight);
+	Vector vecSpot = pos;
+
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(pos + Vector(0, 0, 1), pos - Vector(0, 0, flLift), ignore_monsters, pIgnore, &tr);
+	if (tr.fStartSolid)
+		return pos;
+
+	float flFloor = (tr.flFraction < 1.0f) ? tr.vecEndPos.z : pos.z - flLift;
+	vecSpot.z = Q_max(pos.z, flFloor + flLift);
+
+	UTIL_TraceLine(Vector(pos.x, pos.y, flFloor + 1.0f), Vector(pos.x, pos.y, vecSpot.z + flHalf), ignore_monsters, pIgnore, &tr);
+	if (tr.flFraction < 1.0f && !tr.fStartSolid)
+		vecSpot.z = Q_max(flFloor + Q_min(flLift, 0.5f * (tr.vecEndPos.z - flFloor)), Q_min(vecSpot.z, tr.vecEndPos.z - flHalf));
+
+	return vecSpot;
+}
+
+// flash.spr (white, additive) at TE_SPRITE scale iScale (tenths), lifted clear of the floor
+static void PK_FxFlash(const Vector &pos, int iScale, int iBrightness, float flMinHeight, edict_t *pIgnore)
+{
+	float flHalf = 0.5f * PK_FLASH_PIXELS * 0.1f * iScale;
+	PK_FxSprite(PK_FlashSpot(pos, flHalf, flMinHeight, pIgnore), s_iSprFlash, iScale, iBrightness);
+}

+// The spawn glow shell's colour, fading with k (1 at the start, 0 at the end)
+static Vector PK_SpawnGlowColour(float k)
+{
+	return Vector(120, 170, 255) * k;
+}

+static void PK_FxBeam(const Vector &start, const Vector &end, int iSprite, int iStartFrame, int iFrameRate, int iLife, int iWidth, int iNoise, int r, int g, int b, int iBrightness, int iScroll)
+{
+	MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_PVS, SVC_TEMPENTITY, start);
+		WRITE_BYTE(TE_BEAMPOINTS);
+		WRITE_COORD(start.x);
+		WRITE_COORD(start.y);
+		WRITE_COORD(start.z);
+		WRITE_COORD(end.x);
+		WRITE_COORD(end.y);
+		WRITE_COORD(end.z);
+		WRITE_SHORT(iSprite);
+		WRITE_BYTE(iStartFrame); // starting frame
+		WRITE_BYTE(iFrameRate);  // (tenths of frames a second)
+		WRITE_BYTE(iLife);       // (tenths of seconds)
+		WRITE_BYTE(iWidth);      // (tenths of units)
+		WRITE_BYTE(iNoise);      // (hundredths)
+		WRITE_BYTE(r);
+		WRITE_BYTE(g);
+		WRITE_BYTE(b);
+		WRITE_BYTE(iBrightness);
+		WRITE_BYTE(iScroll);
+	MESSAGE_END();
+}
+
+// Pikachu's bolt: a wide yellow beam and a thin white core (30 % of it) along a zig-zag through randomly offset points —
+// the engine's beam noise grows with a beam's length, so a short beam alone would be a straight rod —, each from its own
+// frame of zap.spr (any of its 8 stands alone), flickering through them at 20 frames a second, the wide one scrolling.
+// One bolt with a hot core: the core rides the kinked line itself (no noise: two noisy beams would wander apart and
+// read as two bolts), only the wide glow crackles around it; the glow's legs run on 3 units past each kink so that
+// neighbouring legs overlap (no dark notch where two square ends meet at an angle).
+static void PK_FxBolt(const Vector &vecSrc, const Vector &vecEnd)
+{
+	Vector vecDelta = vecEnd - vecSrc;
+	float flLen = vecDelta.Length();
+	if (flLen < 1.0f)
+		return;
+
+	Vector vecDir = vecDelta * (1.0f / flLen);
+	Vector vecSide = CrossProduct(vecDir, Vector(0, 0, 1));
+	if (vecSide.Length() < 0.1f)
+		vecSide = Vector(1, 0, 0);
+
+	vecSide = vecSide.Normalize();
+	Vector vecUp = CrossProduct(vecSide, vecDir).Normalize();
+
+	// (2 to 7 legs, a kink at least every 70 units; its points off the line by 5 to 12 units, alternating sides)
+	const int MAX_LEGS = 7;
+	int iLegs = clamp(int(flLen / 70.0f) + 2, 2, MAX_LEGS);
+	float flOffset = clamp(flLen * 0.07f, 5.0f, 12.0f);
+	Vector vecPoints[MAX_LEGS + 1];
+	vecPoints[0] = vecSrc;
+	vecPoints[iLegs] = vecEnd;
+	float flSign = RANDOM_LONG(0, 1) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
+	for (int i = 1; i < iLegs; i++)
+	{
+		float flAlong = (float(i) + RANDOM_FLOAT(-0.2f, 0.2f)) / float(iLegs);
+		float flAngle = RANDOM_FLOAT(-0.6f, 0.6f);
+		float flAmount = flSign * flOffset * RANDOM_FLOAT(0.6f, 1.0f);
+		vecPoints[i] = vecSrc + vecDelta * flAlong + (vecSide * cosf(flAngle) + vecUp * sinf(flAngle)) * flAmount;
+		flSign = -flSign;
+	}
+
+	int iFrame = RANDOM_LONG(0, PK_ZAP_FRAMES - 1);
+	int iCoreFrame = (iFrame + RANDOM_LONG(1, PK_ZAP_FRAMES - 1)) % PK_ZAP_FRAMES;
+	for (int i = 0; i < iLegs; i++)
+	{
+		// (the engine's noise: about noise * length / 5000 units off the leg, none at its ends; a crackle of ~1.5 units)
+		Vector vecLeg = vecPoints[i + 1] - vecPoints[i];
+		float flLeg = vecLeg.Length();
+		int iNoise = clamp(int(7500.0f / Q_max(flLeg, 1.0f)), 30, 255);
+		Vector vecLegDir = vecLeg * (1.0f / Q_max(flLeg, 1.0f));
+		Vector vecGlowStart = (i > 0) ? vecPoints[i] - vecLegDir * 3.0f : vecPoints[i];
+		Vector vecGlowEnd = (i < iLegs - 1) ? vecPoints[i + 1] + vecLegDir * 3.0f : vecPoints[i + 1];
+		PK_FxBeam(vecGlowStart, vecGlowEnd, s_iSprZap, iFrame, PK_ZAP_FRAMERATE, 2, 50, iNoise, 255, 230, 80, 255, 35);
+		PK_FxBeam(vecPoints[i], vecPoints[i + 1], s_iSprZap, iCoreFrame, PK_ZAP_FRAMERATE, 2, 15, 0, 255, 255, 255, 255, 60);
+	}
+}
+
+// (the distance from pos to the nearest living player's eye)
+static float PK_FxEyeDistance(const Vector &pos)
+{
+	float flNearest = 1e9f;
+	for (int i = 1; i <= gpGlobals->maxClients; i++)
+	{
+		CBasePlayer *pPlayer = UTIL_PlayerByIndex(i);
+		if (!pPlayer || !UTIL_IsValidPlayer(pPlayer) || pPlayer->has_disconnected || !pPlayer->IsAlive())
+			continue;
+
+		flNearest = Q_min(flNearest, float((pos - (pPlayer->pev->origin + pPlayer->pev->view_ofs)).Length()));
+	}
+
+	return flNearest;
+}
+
+// (a puff's radius, shrunk so that it never reaches into anyone's eye: at most flFactor of its distance to it, less
+// PK_FLAME_EYE_CLEAR)
+static float PK_FxEyeClear(const Vector &pos, float flRadius, float flFactor = PK_EYE_FACTOR)
+{
+	for (int i = 1; i <= gpGlobals->maxClients; i++)
+	{
+		CBasePlayer *pPlayer = UTIL_PlayerByIndex(i);
+		if (!pPlayer || !UTIL_IsValidPlayer(pPlayer) || pPlayer->has_disconnected || !pPlayer->IsAlive())
+			continue;
+
+		float flEye = (pos - (pPlayer->pev->origin + pPlayer->pev->view_ofs)).Length();
+		flRadius = Q_min(flRadius, (flEye - PK_FLAME_EYE_CLEAR) * flFactor);
+	}
+
+	return flRadius;
+}
+
+// (the free distance from pos along dir, up to flMax: the world only)
+static float PK_FxFree(const Vector &pos, const Vector &dir, float flMax)
+{
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(pos, pos + dir * flMax, ignore_monsters, nullptr, &tr);
+	if (tr.fStartSolid || tr.fAllSolid)
+		return 0.0f;
+
+	return flMax * tr.flFraction;
+}
+
+// A puff: an effect sprite played once at its own pace (TE_EXPLOSION without its light, sound and particles: TE_SPRITE
+// plays at 10 frames a second, ~1 s for fire.spr or water.spr, and lingers), additive (the engine's 180). Never in
+// anyone's face: near a player's eye it shrinks (flEyeFactor: PK_FxEyeClear), so that a victim standing in the stream
+// still sees (no white-out). Never cut by the world in a hard seam (a sprite is a depth-tested billboard facing its
+// viewer, so any surface within its radius, seen from the side, slices it): one within its radius of the floor is
+// lifted clear of it, then it shrinks to its free distance (less 2 units) to the walls around and the ceiling, and
+// along pvecDir (where it goes: the crate behind a target); one left too small is not drawn.
+static void PK_FxPuff(const Vector &vecPos, int iSprite, float flUnits, float flRadius, int iFrameRate,
+	float flEyeFactor = PK_EYE_FACTOR, const Vector *pvecDir = nullptr)
+{
+	const float flMin = 0.5f * flUnits * 0.1f;
+	Vector pos = vecPos;
+	flRadius = PK_FxEyeClear(pos, flRadius, flEyeFactor);
+	if (flRadius < flMin)
+		return;
+
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(pos, pos - Vector(0, 0, flRadius), ignore_monsters, nullptr, &tr);
+	if (tr.fStartSolid)
+		return;
+
+	if (tr.flFraction < 1.0f)
+	{
+		pos.z = tr.vecEndPos.z + flRadius;
+		flRadius = PK_FxEyeClear(pos, flRadius, flEyeFactor);
+		if (flRadius < flMin)
+			return;
+	}
+
+	static const Vector s_vecAround[] = { Vector(1, 0, 0), Vector(-1, 0, 0), Vector(0, 1, 0), Vector(0, -1, 0), Vector(0, 0, 1) };
+	float flFree = flRadius + 2.0f;
+	for (const Vector &dir : s_vecAround)
+		flFree = PK_FxFree(pos, dir, flFree);
+
+	if (pvecDir)
+		flFree = PK_FxFree(pos, *pvecDir, flFree);
+
+	flRadius = Q_min(flRadius, flFree - 2.0f);
+	if (flRadius < flMin)
+		return;
+
+	MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_PVS, SVC_TEMPENTITY, pos);
+		WRITE_BYTE(TE_EXPLOSION);
+		WRITE_COORD(pos.x);
+		WRITE_COORD(pos.y);
+		WRITE_COORD(pos.z - 10.0f); // (an explosion's sprite is drawn 10 units up)
+		WRITE_SHORT(iSprite);
+		WRITE_BYTE(clamp(int(flRadius / flUnits * 10.0f + 0.25f), 1, 255));
+		WRITE_BYTE(clamp(iFrameRate, 1, 255));
+		WRITE_BYTE(TE_EXPLFLAG_NODLIGHTS | TE_EXPLFLAG_NOSOUND | TE_EXPLFLAG_NOPARTICLES);
+	MESSAGE_END();
+}
+
+// A puff of fire (fire.spr, 12 frames: ~0.25 to 0.4 s at 30 to 44 frames a second)
+static void PK_FxFlame(const Vector &pos, float flRadius, int iFrameRate, float flEyeFactor = PK_EYE_FACTOR, const Vector *pvecDir = nullptr)
+{
+	PK_FxPuff(pos, s_iSprFire, PK_FIRE_UNITS, flRadius, iFrameRate, flEyeFactor, pvecDir);
+}
+
+// A puff of water (water.spr, 8 frames: ~0.25 s at 28 frames a second)
+static void PK_FxWater(const Vector &pos, float flRadius, int iFrameRate, float flEyeFactor = PK_EYE_FACTOR, const Vector *pvecDir = nullptr)
+{
+	PK_FxPuff(pos, s_iSprWater, PK_WATER_UNITS, flRadius, iFrameRate, flEyeFactor, pvecDir);
+}
+
+// The red glow of a return to the ball: flash.spr tinted (a temporary env_sprite: TE_SPRITE cannot tint)
+// (lifted clear of the floor as the white flashes); Le M's green ones too
+static void PK_FxTintedFlash(const Vector &pos, float flScale, float flMinHeight, edict_t *pIgnore, int r, int g, int b)
+{
+	Vector vecSpot = PK_FlashSpot(pos, 0.5f * PK_FLASH_PIXELS * flScale, flMinHeight, pIgnore);
+	CSprite *pSprite = CSprite::SpriteCreate("sprites/pokemon/flash.spr", vecSpot, FALSE);
+	if (!pSprite)
+		return;
+
+	pSprite->SetTransparency(kRenderTransAdd, r, g, b, PK_FLASH_BRIGHTNESS, kRenderFxNoDissipation);
+	pSprite->SetScale(flScale);
+	pSprite->pev->frame = 0;
+	pSprite->AnimateAndDie(12.0f);
+}
+
+static void PK_FxReturnFlash(const Vector &pos, float flScale, float flMinHeight, edict_t *pIgnore)
+{
+	PK_FxTintedFlash(pos, flScale, flMinHeight, pIgnore, 255, 50, 40);
+}
+
+// A shower of moving sprites (additive), along a direction
+static void PK_FxSpray(const Vector &pos, const Vector &dir, int iSprite, int iCount, int iSpeed, int iNoise)
+{
+	MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_PVS, SVC_TEMPENTITY, pos);
+		WRITE_BYTE(TE_SPRAY);
+		WRITE_COORD(pos.x);
+		WRITE_COORD(pos.y);
+		WRITE_COORD(pos.z);
+		WRITE_COORD(dir.x);
+		WRITE_COORD(dir.y);
+		WRITE_COORD(dir.z);
+		WRITE_SHORT(iSprite);
+		WRITE_BYTE(iCount);
+		WRITE_BYTE(iSpeed);
+		WRITE_BYTE(iNoise);
+		WRITE_BYTE(kRenderTransAdd);
+	MESSAGE_END();
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Le M's effects: green code (coderain.spr columns, pixels.spr bits, codebeam.spr beams)
+
+// An effect sprite played once at its own pace, additive, no light nor sound (TE_EXPLOSION, drawn 10 units up)
+static void PK_FxAnimated(const Vector &pos, int iSprite, int iScale, int iFrameRate)
+{
+	MESSAGE_BEGIN(MSG_PVS, SVC_TEMPENTITY, pos);
+		WRITE_BYTE(TE_EXPLOSION);
+		WRITE_COORD(pos.x);
+		WRITE_COORD(pos.y);
+		WRITE_COORD(pos.z - 10.0f);
+		WRITE_SHORT(iSprite);
+		WRITE_BYTE(clamp(iScale, 1, 255));
+		WRITE_BYTE(clamp(iFrameRate, 1, 255));
+		WRITE_BYTE(TE_EXPLFLAG_NODLIGHTS | TE_EXPLFLAG_NOSOUND | TE_EXPLFLAG_NOPARTICLES);
+	MESSAGE_END();
+}
+
+// Code rain around a standing spot (its feet): green columns of falling glyphs, and glyphs falling from above its head,
+// within flRadius of it and flHeight up
+static void PK_FxCodeRain(const Vector &vecFeet, float flRadius, float flHeight, int iColumns)
+{
+	float flStart = RANDOM_FLOAT(0.0f, 360.0f);
+	for (int i = 0; i < iColumns; i++)
+	{
+		float a = (flStart + (360.0f / iColumns) * (i + RANDOM_FLOAT(-0.3f, 0.3f))) * (M_PI / 180.0f);
+		float r = RANDOM_FLOAT(0.55f, 1.0f) * flRadius;
+		Vector pos = vecFeet + Vector(Q_cos(a) * r, Q_sin(a) * r, RANDOM_FLOAT(0.45f, 0.6f) * flHeight);
+		PK_FxAnimated(pos, s_iSprCodeRain, LEM_RAIN_SCALE + RANDOM_LONG(-1, 1), LEM_RAIN_FRAMERATE + RANDOM_LONG(-2, 2));
+	}
+
+	for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
+	{
+		float a = RANDOM_FLOAT(0.0f, 2.0f * M_PI);
+		float r = RANDOM_FLOAT(0.2f, 0.8f) * flRadius;
+		Vector pos = vecFeet + Vector(Q_cos(a) * r, Q_sin(a) * r, flHeight + RANDOM_FLOAT(4.0f, 16.0f));
+		PK_FxSpray(pos, Vector(0, 0, -1), s_iSprPixels, 5, 130, 18);
+	}
+}
+
+// A horizontal ring (a scan line) of thin green beams around a standing spot, flHeight up, for a tenth of a second
+static void PK_FxScanRing(const Vector &vecFeet, float flHeight, float flRadius, int iBrightness)
+{
+	Vector vecCentre = vecFeet + Vector(0, 0, flHeight);
+	float flTurn = RANDOM_FLOAT(0.0f, 2.0f * M_PI / LEM_SCAN_SIDES);
+	for (int i = 0; i < LEM_SCAN_SIDES; i++)
+	{
+		float a0 = flTurn + (2.0f * M_PI / LEM_SCAN_SIDES) * i;
+		float a1 = a0 + 2.0f * M_PI / LEM_SCAN_SIDES;
+		Vector p0 = vecCentre + Vector(Q_cos(a0) * flRadius, Q_sin(a0) * flRadius, 0);
+		Vector p1 = vecCentre + Vector(Q_cos(a1) * flRadius, Q_sin(a1) * flRadius, 0);
+		PK_FxBeam(p0, p1, g_sModelIndexLaser, 0, 0, 1, 8, 0, int(LEM_GREEN.x), int(LEM_GREEN.y), int(LEM_GREEN.z), iBrightness, 0);
+	}
+}
+
+// A glitch on a body: glitch.spr's shifted slices, once, quickly (~0.27 s), somewhere between its knees and its head
+static void PK_FxGlitch(CBaseEntity *pEntity)
+{
+	float flHeight = pEntity->pev->maxs.z - pEntity->pev->mins.z;
+	Vector pos = PK_Feet(pEntity) + Vector(RANDOM_FLOAT(-6, 6), RANDOM_FLOAT(-6, 6), RANDOM_FLOAT(0.3f, 0.85f) * flHeight);
+	PK_FxAnimated(pos, s_iSprGlitch, RANDOM_LONG(4, 7), 30);
+}
+
+// Pixels thrown off a point (additive pixels.spr bits, slowly falling once out)
+static void PK_FxPixels(const Vector &pos, const Vector &dir, int iCount, int iSpeed, int iNoise)
+{
+	PK_FxSpray(pos, dir, s_iSprPixels, iCount, iSpeed, iNoise);
+}
+
+// Hack: a wide stream of green code scrolling from the hand to its target (short of a player: a wide beam to his
+// chest would fill his screen), a bright core all the way, and two thin crackling strands around it
+static void PK_FxHackBeam(const Vector &vecSrc, const Vector &vecEnd, bool bOnPlayer)
+{
+	Vector vecDelta = vecEnd - vecSrc;
+	float flLen = vecDelta.Length();
+	if (flLen < 1.0f)
+		return;
+
+	Vector vecDir = vecDelta * (1.0f / flLen);
+	float flStream = bOnPlayer ? Q_max(flLen - clamp(0.2f * flLen, 12.0f, 28.0f), 0.0f) : flLen;
+	int iFrame = RANDOM_LONG(0, 7);
+
+	if (flStream > 4.0f)
+		PK_FxBeam(vecSrc, vecSrc + vecDir * flStream, s_iSprCodeBeam, iFrame, 100, 3, 45, 0, 60, 255, 110, 220, 90);
+
+	PK_FxBeam(vecSrc, vecEnd, s_iSprCodeBeam, (iFrame + 3) & 7, 100, 3, 14, 0, 190, 255, 200, 255, 140);
+
+	// (the engine's noise: about noise * length / 5000 units off the beam; ~4 units)
+	int iNoise = clamp(int(20000.0f / flLen), 30, 200);
+	for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
+	{
+		Vector vecJitter(RANDOM_FLOAT(-3, 3), RANDOM_FLOAT(-3, 3), RANDOM_FLOAT(-3, 3));
+		PK_FxBeam(vecSrc, vecEnd + vecJitter, g_sModelIndexLaser, 0, 0, 2, 6, iNoise, 40, 255, 80, 170, 0);
+	}
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// The ball in hand
+
+enum pk_ball_e
+{
+	PKBALL_IDLE = 0,
+	PKBALL_DRAW,
+	PKBALL_PINPULL,   // wind-up, held
+	PKBALL_THROW,
+	PKBALL_HOLSTER
+};
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(weapon_pk_pikachu, CPokeBallWeapon, CCSPlayerWeapon)
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(weapon_pk_charizard, CPokeBallWeapon, CCSPlayerWeapon)
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(weapon_pk_blastoise, CPokeBallWeapon, CCSPlayerWeapon)

+}

+	m_iId = PK_Info(Species()).weaponId;
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/pokemon/w_pokeball.mdl");

+	FallInit();

+}

+	p->pszName = STRING(pev->classname);
+	p->pszAmmo1 = info.ammoName;

+	p->iMaxAmmo2 = -1;
+	p->iMaxClip = WEAPON_NOCLIP;
+	p->iSlot = 3;

+BOOL CPokeBallWeapon::Deploy()
+{
+	m_flReleaseThrow = -1;
+	m_flStartThrow = 0;
+	return DefaultDeploy("models/pokemon/v_pokeball.mdl", "models/pokemon/p_pokeball.mdl", PKBALL_DRAW, "grenade", 0);
+}
+
+void CPokeBallWeapon::Holster(int skiplocal)
+{
+	m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+	m_flStartThrow = 0.0f;
+	m_flReleaseThrow = 0.0f;
+
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+		SendWeaponAnim(PKBALL_HOLSTER);
+	else
+		DestroyItem();
+}
+
+void CPokeBallWeapon::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	if (m_flStartThrow || m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0 || !CanFire())
+		return;
+
+	// (one Pokemon at a time)
+	if (PK_HasOut(m_pPlayer))
+	{
+		PK_CenterPrint(m_pPlayer, ARS_L(m_pPlayer, "Your Pokemon is already out", "Ton Pok\xC3\xA9mon est d\xC3\xA9j\xC3\xA0 sorti"));
+		m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(1.0f);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	// (the wind-up, held while the button is)
+	m_flStartThrow = gpGlobals->time;
+	m_flReleaseThrow = 0.0f;
+	SendWeaponAnim(PKBALL_PINPULL);
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.4f;
+}
+
+void CPokeBallWeapon::Throw()
+{
+	// (thrown harder upwards than downwards, a softer lob than a grenade's)
+	Vector angThrow = m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle;
+	if (angThrow.x < 0.0f)
+		angThrow.x = -10.0f + angThrow.x * ((90.0f - 10.0f) / 90.0f);
+	else
+		angThrow.x = -10.0f + angThrow.x * ((90.0f + 10.0f) / 90.0f);
+
+	float flVel = (90.0f - angThrow.x) * 6.0f;
+	if (flVel > 800.0f)
+		flVel = 800.0f;
+
+	Vector vecFwd;
+	UTIL_MakeVectorsPrivate(angThrow, vecFwd, nullptr, nullptr);
+
+	// (out where the view model's ball leaves the hand, at the same spot of the screen and the same apparent size:
+	// v_pokeball's throw ends with its ball at view (forward 15.5, right 4.5, up 0.5), on the line of sight to here)
+	Vector vecViewFwd, vecViewRight, vecViewUp;
+	UTIL_MakeVectorsPrivate(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle, vecViewFwd, vecViewRight, vecViewUp);
+	Vector vecEye = m_pPlayer->pev->origin + m_pPlayer->pev->view_ofs;
+	Vector vecSrc = vecEye + vecViewFwd * 34.0f + vecViewRight * 10.0f + vecViewUp * 1.0f;
+
+	// (not into a wall, nor into someone, in front of the face)
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(vecEye, vecSrc, dont_ignore_monsters, m_pPlayer->edict(), &tr);
+	if (tr.flFraction < 1.0f || tr.fStartSolid)
+	{
+		vecSrc = tr.vecEndPos - vecViewFwd * 5.0f;
+		UTIL_TraceLine(vecEye, vecSrc, dont_ignore_monsters, m_pPlayer->edict(), &tr);
+		if (tr.flFraction < 1.0f || tr.fStartSolid)
+			vecSrc = vecEye;
+	}
+
+	Vector vecThrow = vecFwd * flVel + m_pPlayer->pev->velocity;
+	CPokeBall::Launch(m_pPlayer, Species(), vecSrc, vecThrow);
+
+	EMIT_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "pokemon/ball_throw.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+	SendWeaponAnim(PKBALL_THROW);
+	m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+}
+
+void CPokeBallWeapon::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	if (m_flReleaseThrow == 0.0f && m_flStartThrow)
+		m_flReleaseThrow = gpGlobals->time;
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	if (m_flStartThrow)
+	{
+		m_flStartThrow = 0.0f;
+
+		// (someone else's ball came out meanwhile: kept)
+		if (PK_HasOut(m_pPlayer))
+		{
+			SendWeaponAnim(PKBALL_DRAW);
+			m_flReleaseThrow = -1.0f;
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+			return;
+		}
+
+		Throw();
+
+		// (positive: the next idle knows it was just thrown)
+		m_flReleaseThrow = gpGlobals->time;
+		m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType]--;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = m_flNextSecondaryAttack = m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(0.6f);
+		return;
+	}
+	else if (m_flReleaseThrow > 0.0f)
+	{
+		// (just thrown: none left, or the ball came back)
+		if (!m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+		{
+			RetireWeapon();
+			return;
+		}
+
+		SendWeaponAnim(PKBALL_DRAW);
+		m_flReleaseThrow = -1.0f;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+	{
+		SendWeaponAnim(PKBALL_IDLE);
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+	}
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Le M's laptop in hand: fired, its player types a while (the view model's "type"), then hits enter ("deploy") and Le M
+// materialises where it aims; the laptop goes (no room there: kept)
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(weapon_lem_laptop, CLemLaptopWeapon, CCSPlayerWeapon)
+
+static const char *const LEM_LaptopSeqNames[CLemLaptopWeapon::SEQ_COUNT] = { "idle", "draw", "type", "deploy", "holster" };
+
+void CLemLaptopWeapon::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	m_iId = WEAPON_LEM_LAPTOP;
+
+	// (the view model's sequences by name — the model contract's order otherwise —, read through this entity's model
+	// before it gets its own)
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/others/v_laptop.mdl");
+	void *pStudio = GET_MODEL_PTR(edict());
+	for (int i = 0; i < SEQ_COUNT; i++)
+	{
+		int seq = pStudio ? ::LookupSequence(pStudio, LEM_LaptopSeqNames[i]) : ACT_INVALID;
+		m_iSeqIndex[i] = (seq >= 0) ? seq : i;
+	}
+
+	m_bSeqLoaded = true;
+	m_flEnterTime = 0.0f;
+	m_bSummoned = false;
+
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/others/w_laptop.mdl");
+	m_iDefaultAmmo = 1;
+	FallInit();
+	CBasePlayerWeapon::Spawn();
+}

+void CLemLaptopWeapon::Precache()
+{
+	// (Le M's models and sprites optional — the engine's "!": a client without them still joins, they are not drawn)
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("!models/others/w_laptop.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("!models/others/v_laptop.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("!models/others/p_laptop.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("others/laptop_type.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("others/laptop_enter.wav");
+
+	UTIL_PrecacheOther("monster_pokemon");
+}

+int CLemLaptopWeapon::GetItemInfo(ItemInfo *p)

+	p->pszAmmo1 = "LeMLaptop";
+	p->iMaxAmmo1 = PK_BALL_MAX_CARRY;
+	p->pszAmmo2 = nullptr;
+	p->iMaxAmmo2 = -1;
+	p->iMaxClip = WEAPON_NOCLIP;
+	p->iSlot = 3;
+	p->iPosition = 11; // (after the balls)
+	p->iId = m_iId = WEAPON_LEM_LAPTOP;
+	p->iFlags = ITEM_FLAG_LIMITINWORLD | ITEM_FLAG_EXHAUSTIBLE;
+	p->iWeight = PK_BALL_WEIGHT;

+	return m_bSeqLoaded ? m_iSeqIndex[iSeq] : iSeq;
+}

+BOOL CLemLaptopWeapon::Deploy()
+{
+	m_flStartThrow = 0.0f;
+	m_flReleaseThrow = -1.0f;
+	m_flEnterTime = 0.0f;

+void CLemLaptopWeapon::StopTyping()
+{
+	if (IsTyping())
+		STOP_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "others/laptop_type.wav");
+
+	m_flStartThrow = 0.0f;
+}
+
+// (switching away while typing stops it)
+void CLemLaptopWeapon::Holster(int skiplocal)
+{
+	m_pPlayer->m_flNextAttack = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 0.5f;
+	StopTyping();
+	m_flReleaseThrow = 0.0f;
+	m_flEnterTime = 0.0f;
+
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+		SendWeaponAnim(Seq(SEQ_HOLSTER));
+	else
+		DestroyItem();
+}
+
+void CLemLaptopWeapon::PrimaryAttack()
+{
+	// (the fire button held: no idle comes meanwhile)
+	if (IsBusy())
+	{
+		Advance();
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0 || !CanFire())
+		return;
+
+	// (one companion at a time)
+	if (PK_HasOut(m_pPlayer))
+	{
+		PK_CenterPrint(m_pPlayer, PK_OutMessage(m_pPlayer));
+		m_flNextPrimaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(1.0f);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	// (typing: Le M's code, a while)
+	m_flStartThrow = gpGlobals->time;
+	SendWeaponAnim(Seq(SEQ_TYPE));
+	EMIT_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "others/laptop_type.wav", 0.8f, ATTN_NORM);
+	m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + LEM_TYPE_TIME;
+	m_flNextPrimaryAttack = m_flNextSecondaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(LEM_TYPE_TIME);
+}
+
+// (the secondary button held: no idle comes meanwhile either — the laptop has no secondary attack)
+void CLemLaptopWeapon::SecondaryAttack()
+{
+	if (IsBusy())
+		Advance();
+}
+
+// Le M where its player aims (up to LEM_SUMMON_RANGE, short of what the aim meets), else nearer along its aim, else
+// in front of it, facing it — always in its sight (never through a wall or a door, however close it stands to it)
+bool CLemLaptopWeapon::Summon()
+{
+	Vector vecFwd;
+	UTIL_MakeVectorsPrivate(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle + m_pPlayer->pev->punchangle, vecFwd, nullptr, nullptr);
+	Vector vecEye = m_pPlayer->EyePosition();
+
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(vecEye, vecEye + vecFwd * LEM_SUMMON_RANGE, dont_ignore_monsters, m_pPlayer->edict(), &tr);
+	float flDist = LEM_SUMMON_RANGE * tr.flFraction;
+	bool bFloor = (tr.flFraction < 1.0f && tr.vecPlaneNormal.z > 0.7f);
+
+	Vector vecFace = vecEye - tr.vecEndPos;
+	vecFace.z = 0.0f;
+	float flYaw = vecFace.Length() > 1.0f ? UTIL_VecToYaw(vecFace) : UTIL_AngleMod(m_pPlayer->pev->v_angle.y + 180.0f);
+
+	static const float fractions[] = { 1.0f, 0.7f, 0.45f, 0.25f };
+	for (int i = 0; i < int(ARRAYSIZE(fractions)); i++)
+	{
+		// (on the floor aimed at, or his half width short of a wall or someone — never past it)
+		Vector vecSpot;
+		if (i == 0 && bFloor)
+			vecSpot = tr.vecEndPos + Vector(0, 0, 2);
+		else
+			vecSpot = vecEye + vecFwd * Q_max(Q_min(flDist * fractions[i], flDist - 20.0f), 0.0f);
+
+		if (CPokemon::Create(PK_LEM, m_pPlayer, vecSpot, flYaw, &vecEye))
+			return true;
+	}
+
+	Vector vecFlat(vecFwd.x, vecFwd.y, 0.0f);
+	vecFlat = vecFlat.Length() > 0.1f ? vecFlat.Normalize() : Vector(1, 0, 0);
+	return CPokemon::Create(PK_LEM, m_pPlayer, PK_Feet(m_pPlayer) + vecFlat * 56.0f + Vector(0, 0, 8), flYaw, &vecEye) != nullptr;
+}
+
+void CLemLaptopWeapon::WeaponIdle()
+{
+	if (IsBusy())
+	{
+		Advance();
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	if (m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+	{
+		SendWeaponAnim(Seq(SEQ_IDLE));
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + UTIL_SharedRandomFloat(m_pPlayer->random_seed, 10.0f, 15.0f);
+	}
+}
+
+void CLemLaptopWeapon::Advance()
+{
+	// (the enter key down: Le M compiles where its player aims now)
+	if (m_flEnterTime > 0.0f)
+	{
+		if (gpGlobals->time < m_flEnterTime)
+			return;
+
+		m_flEnterTime = 0.0f;
+		EMIT_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "others/laptop_enter.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+		m_pPlayer->SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1);
+
+		if (!PK_HasOut(m_pPlayer) && m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] > 0 && Summon())
+		{
+			m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType]--;
+			m_bSummoned = true;
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = m_flNextPrimaryAttack = m_flNextSecondaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(LEM_DEPLOY_HOLD);
+		}
+		else
+		{
+			// (the screen back to the code at once: never "LE M ONLINE" when he is not)
+			PK_CenterPrint(m_pPlayer, PK_HasOut(m_pPlayer) ? PK_OutMessage(m_pPlayer) : ARS_L(m_pPlayer, "No room for Le M there", "Pas de place pour Le M ici"));
+			SendWeaponAnim(Seq(SEQ_IDLE));
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + LEM_NO_ROOM_TIME;
+			m_flNextPrimaryAttack = m_flNextSecondaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(LEM_NO_ROOM_TIME);
+		}
+
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (m_flTimeWeaponIdle > UTIL_WeaponTimeBase())
+		return;
+
+	if (IsTyping())
+	{
+		m_flStartThrow = 0.0f;
+
+		// (a companion of its out meanwhile — another way —: the laptop kept)
+		if (PK_HasOut(m_pPlayer) || m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType] <= 0)
+		{
+			STOP_SOUND(ENT(m_pPlayer->pev), CHAN_WEAPON, "others/laptop_type.wav");
+			SendWeaponAnim(Seq(SEQ_IDLE));
+			m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + 1.0f;
+			return;
+		}
+
+		// (typed: the deploy sequence, its enter key down a moment later)
+		SendWeaponAnim(Seq(SEQ_DEPLOY));
+		m_flEnterTime = gpGlobals->time + LEM_ENTER_AT;
+		m_flTimeWeaponIdle = UTIL_WeaponTimeBase() + LEM_ENTER_AT;
+		m_flNextPrimaryAttack = m_flNextSecondaryAttack = GetNextAttackDelay(LEM_ENTER_AT);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	// (out: the laptop goes)
+	m_bSummoned = false;
+	if (!m_pPlayer->m_rgAmmo[m_iPrimaryAmmoType])
+		RetireWeapon();
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// The ball thrown
+
+LINK_ENTITY_TO_CLASS(pokeball, CPokeBall, CCSAnimating)
+
+void CPokeBall::Spawn()
+{
+	Precache();
+	MAKE_STRING_CLASS("pokeball", pev);
+	pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_BOUNCE;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_BBOX;
+
+	SET_MODEL(edict(), "models/pokemon/w_pokeball.mdl");
+	UTIL_SetSize(pev, g_vecZero, g_vecZero);
+
+	pev->gravity = 0.6f;
+	pev->friction = 0.6f;
+	m_iSpecies = PK_PIKACHU;
+	m_iTeam = UNASSIGNED;
+	m_flOpenTime = gpGlobals->time + PK_BALL_OPEN_TIME;
+	m_flReleaseTime = 0.0f;
+	m_flRemoveTime = 0.0f;
+	m_flNextBounceSound = 0.0f;
+	m_flYaw = 0.0f;
+	m_bLanded = false;
+	m_bResting = false;
+	m_bOpened = false;
+	m_bReleased = false;
+}
+
+void CPokeBall::Precache()
+{
+	PRECACHE_MODEL("models/pokemon/w_pokeball.mdl");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("pokemon/ball_bounce.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("pokemon/ball_open.wav");
+	PRECACHE_SOUND("pokemon/ball_return.wav");
+	s_iSprFlash = PRECACHE_MODEL("sprites/pokemon/flash.spr");
+}
+
+// (w_pokeball: 0 idle, 1 wobble, 2 open — origin on the floor under the ball —, 3 fly — origin at its centre)
+void CPokeBall::SetSequenceByName(const char *pszName, int iDefault)
+{
+	int seq = LookupSequence(pszName);
+	pev->sequence = seq >= 0 ? seq : iDefault;
+	pev->frame = 0;
+	ResetSequenceInfo();
+}
+
+CPokeBall *CPokeBall::Launch(CBasePlayer *pOwner, int iSpecies, const Vector &vecSrc, const Vector &vecVelocity)
+{
+	CPokeBall *pBall = GetClassPtr<CCSAnimating>((CPokeBall *)nullptr);
+	pBall->Spawn();
+	UTIL_SetOrigin(pBall->pev, vecSrc);
+	pBall->pev->velocity = vecVelocity;
+	pBall->pev->angles = Vector(0, pOwner->pev->v_angle.y, 0);
+	pBall->pev->avelocity = Vector(-540, 0, 0); // (rolls forward)
+	pBall->pev->owner = pOwner->edict();         // (does not hit its thrower)
+	pBall->pev->skin = iSpecies;
+
+	pBall->m_hOwner = pOwner;
+	pBall->m_iSpecies = iSpecies;
+	pBall->m_iTeam = pOwner->m_iTeam;
+
+	// (tumbles about its centre in the air)
+	pBall->SetSequenceByName("fly", 3);
+
+	pBall->SetTouch(&CPokeBall::BounceTouch);
+	pBall->SetThink(&CPokeBall::FlyThink);
+	pBall->pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+	return pBall;
+}
+
+void CPokeBall::BounceTouch(CBaseEntity *pOther)
+{
+	if (pOther->edict() == pev->owner)
+		return;
+
+	float flSpeed = pev->velocity.Length();
+	if (flSpeed > 60.0f && gpGlobals->time >= m_flNextBounceSound)
+	{
+		EMIT_SOUND_DYN(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, "pokemon/ball_bounce.wav", clamp(flSpeed / 500.0f, 0.25f, 0.9f), ATTN_NORM, 0, 95 + RANDOM_LONG(0, 12));
+		m_flNextBounceSound = gpGlobals->time + 0.15f;
+	}
+
+	// (loses its momentum quickly, and its spin on the ground)
+	pev->velocity = pev->velocity * 0.6f;
+	if (pev->flags & FL_ONGROUND)
+	{
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * 0.7f;
+		pev->avelocity = pev->avelocity * 0.5f;
+	}
+}
+
+// On the ground for the first time: upright, the floor-origin sequences from now on
+void CPokeBall::Land()
+{
+	m_bLanded = true;
+	pev->angles.x = 0.0f;
+	pev->angles.z = 0.0f;
+	pev->avelocity = g_vecZero;
+	SetSequenceByName("idle", 0);
+}
+
+void CPokeBall::FlyThink()
+{
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.1f;
+	StudioFrameAdvance();
+
+	if (!IsInWorld())
+	{
+		GiveBack();
+		UTIL_Remove(this);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	// (its thrower gone, dead or on the other side: it fizzles)
+	CBasePlayer *pOwner = m_hOwner;
+	if (!PK_PlayerPlaying(pOwner) || pOwner->m_iTeam != m_iTeam)
+	{
+		PK_FxFlash(pev->origin, 3, 120, 0.0f, edict());
+		UTIL_Remove(this);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (pev->waterlevel != 0)
+		pev->velocity = pev->velocity * 0.5f;
+
+	if (!m_bLanded && (pev->flags & FL_ONGROUND))
+		Land();
+
+	// (at rest: it wobbles, then opens)
+	if (m_bResting)
+	{
+		pev->velocity = g_vecZero;
+		if (gpGlobals->time >= m_flOpenTime)
+			Open();
+
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (m_bLanded && (pev->flags & FL_ONGROUND) && pev->velocity.Length() < 30.0f)
+	{
+		m_bResting = true;
+		SetTouch(nullptr);
+		pev->velocity = g_vecZero;
+		pev->avelocity = g_vecZero;
+		SetSequenceByName("wobble", 1);
+		m_flOpenTime = gpGlobals->time + PK_BALL_WOBBLE_TIME;
+		return;
+	}
+
+	// (still rolling or in the air after a while: it opens at once)
+	if (gpGlobals->time >= m_flOpenTime)
+		Open();
+}
+
+// The ball opens; its Pokemon comes out a moment later, the lid at its widest (Release)
+void CPokeBall::Open()
+{
+	m_bOpened = true;
+	SetTouch(nullptr);
+	pev->velocity = g_vecZero;
+	pev->avelocity = g_vecZero;
+	pev->movetype = MOVETYPE_NONE;
+	pev->solid = SOLID_NOT;
+
+	CBasePlayer *pOwner = m_hOwner;
+	Vector vecDir = pev->origin - pOwner->pev->origin;
+	vecDir.z = 0.0f;
+	m_flYaw = vecDir.Length() > 1.0f ? UTIL_VecToYaw(vecDir) : pOwner->pev->v_angle.y;
+
+	// (the lid opens away from its thrower, its light towards him)
+	pev->angles = Vector(0, m_flYaw + 180.0f, 0);
+
+	// (on the floor: the open sequence's origin is under the ball)
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(pev->origin + Vector(0, 0, 2), pev->origin - Vector(0, 0, 8), ignore_monsters, edict(), &tr);
+	if (tr.flFraction < 1.0f && !tr.fStartSolid)
+		UTIL_SetOrigin(pev, tr.vecEndPos);
+
+	SetSequenceByName("open", 2);
+	EMIT_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_VOICE, "pokemon/ball_open.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+
+	m_flReleaseTime = gpGlobals->time + PK_BALL_RELEASE_DELAY;
+	m_flRemoveTime = m_flReleaseTime + PK_BALL_KEEP_TIME;
+	pev->rendermode = kRenderNormal;
+	pev->renderamt = 255;
+	SetThink(&CPokeBall::OpenThink);
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.05f;
+}
+
+// Its Pokemon out where there is room (a little ahead of the ball, away from its thrower), or the ball goes back
+void CPokeBall::Release()
+{
+	m_bReleased = true;
+
+	CBasePlayer *pOwner = m_hOwner;
+	if (!PK_PlayerPlaying(pOwner) || pOwner->m_iTeam != m_iTeam)
+	{
+		PK_FxFlash(pev->origin, 3, 120, 0.0f, edict());
+		m_flRemoveTime = Q_min(m_flRemoveTime, gpGlobals->time + 0.2f);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	// (the light coming out: centred at its Pokemon's mid-height at least, clear of the floor)
+	PK_FxFlash(pev->origin, PK_FLASH_SCALE, PK_FLASH_BRIGHTNESS, Q_max(PK_FLASH_MIN_HEIGHT, 0.5f * PK_Info(m_iSpecies).maxs.z), edict());
+	PK_FxLight(pev->origin + Vector(0, 0, 24), 20, 255, 255, 240, 4, 60);
+
+	Vector vecFwd;
+	UTIL_MakeVectorsPrivate(Vector(0, m_flYaw, 0), vecFwd, nullptr, nullptr);
+	Vector vecNear = pev->origin;
+	TraceResult tr;
+	UTIL_TraceLine(pev->origin + Vector(0, 0, 4), pev->origin + Vector(0, 0, 4) + vecFwd * PK_BALL_RELEASE_AHEAD, ignore_monsters, edict(), &tr);
+	if (tr.flFraction >= 1.0f && !tr.fStartSolid)
+		vecNear = pev->origin + vecFwd * PK_BALL_RELEASE_AHEAD;
+
+	if (!CPokemon::Create(m_iSpecies, pOwner, vecNear, m_flYaw) && (vecNear == pev->origin || !CPokemon::Create(m_iSpecies, pOwner, pev->origin, m_flYaw)))
+	{
+		// (no room: back into its thrower's hand)
+		EMIT_SOUND(ENT(pev), CHAN_ITEM, "pokemon/ball_return.wav", VOL_NORM, ATTN_NORM);
+		PK_FxLight(pev->origin + Vector(0, 0, 16), 12, 255, 60, 40, 3, 60);
+		PK_FxReturnFlash(pev->origin, 0.3f, PK_FLASH_MIN_HEIGHT, edict());
+		GiveBack();
+		m_flRemoveTime = Q_min(m_flRemoveTime, gpGlobals->time + 0.3f);
+	}
+}
+
+void CPokeBall::OpenThink()
+{
+	StudioFrameAdvance();
+	pev->nextthink = gpGlobals->time + 0.05f;
+
+	if (!m_bReleased && gpGlobals->time >= m_flReleaseTime - 0.001f)
+		Release();
+
+	// (fades in its last tenths)
+	float flLeft = m_flRemoveTime - gpGlobals->time;
+	if (m_bReleased && flLeft <= 0.0f)
+	{
+		UTIL_Remove(this);
+		return;
+	}
+
+	if (m_bReleased && flLeft < 0.2f)
+	{
+		pev->rendermode = kRenderTransTexture;
+		pev->renderamt = clamp(flLeft / 0.2f * 255.0f, 0.0f, 255.0f);
+	}
+}
+
+void CPokeBall::GiveBack()
+{
+	CBasePlayer *pOwner = m_hOwner;
+	if (!PK_PlayerPlaying(pOwner) || pOwner->m_iTeam != m_iTeam || PK_BallCarried(pOwner))
+		return;
+
+	const PokemonInfo &info = PK_Info(m_iSpecies);
+	if (pOwner->HasNamedPlayerItem(info.weaponName))
+		pOwner->GiveAmmo(1, (char *)info.ammoName, PK_BALL_MAX_CARRY);
+	else
+		pOwner->GiveNamedItem(info.weaponName);
+
+	char msg[96];
+	Q_snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), ARS_L(pOwner, "No room for %s: the ball came back", "Pas de place pour %s : la Pok\xC3\xA9 Ball est revenue"), PK_NameFor(pOwner, m_iSpecies));
+	PK_CenterPrint(pOwner, msg);
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// The Pokemon
+
+// (its path on the bots' navigation mesh: no ladder; the crouch-only areas for the small one only)
+class PokemonPathCost
+{
+public:
+	PokemonPathCost(bool bTall) : m_bTall(bTall) {}
+
+	float operator()(CNavArea *area, CNavArea *fromArea, const CNavLadder *ladder)
+	{
+		if (!fromArea)
+			return 0.0f;
+
+		if (ladder)
+			return -1.0f;
+
+		if (m_bTall && (area->GetAttributes() & NAV_CROUCH))
+			return -1.0f;
+
+		float dist = (*area->GetCenter() - *fromArea->GetCenter()).Length();
+		float cost = dist + fromArea->GetCostSoFar();
+		if (area->GetAttributes() & NAV_JUMP)
+			cost += 2.0f * dist;
+
+		return cost;
+	}
+
+private:
+	bool m_bTall;
+};
