+static const Col C_GOLD    = { 201, 165, 90, 255 };
+static const Col C_GOLDT   = { 236, 205, 138, 255 };
+static const Col C_TEXT    = { 226, 229, 236, 255 };
+static const Col C_DIM     = { 132, 137, 150, 255 };
+static const Col C_FAINT   = { 86, 90, 102, 255 };
+static const Col C_RED     = { 232, 96, 84, 255 };
+static const Col C_GREEN   = { 124, 214, 128, 255 };
+static const Col C_TCOL    = { 226, 128, 76, 255 };
+static const Col C_CTCOL   = { 104, 160, 236, 255 };
+static const Col C_BAR     = { 255, 255, 255, 22 };
+static const Col C_SHADE   = { 6, 7, 10, 150 };
+static const Col C_WHITE   = { 255, 250, 238, 255 };
+static const Col C_EDGE    = { 255, 255, 255, 60 };
+
+static Col Alpha( Col c, float f ) { c.a = (unsigned char)( c.a * ( f < 0 ? 0 : f > 1 ? 1 : f )); return c; }
+static Col Mix( Col a, Col b, float t ) { Col c = { (unsigned char)( a.r + ( b.r - a.r ) * t ), (unsigned char)( a.g + ( b.g - a.g ) * t ), (unsigned char)( a.b + ( b.b - a.b ) * t ), (unsigned char)( a.a + ( b.a - a.a ) * t ) }; return c; }
+static float Clamp01( float f ) { return f < 0 ? 0 : f > 1 ? 1 : f; }
+
+//
+// Languages: the ars_lang cvar (en, the default, or fr — the page sets it from the language the player chose; in the
+// user info, the server's messages follow it too). Every text of the mod is a pair, chosen as it is drawn: a change
+// shows at the next frame. (fr null: the same in both — a weapon's name)
+//
+static cvar_t *g_pLang;
+static bool French( void ) { return g_pLang && g_pLang->string && !strcmp( g_pLang->string, "fr" ); } // (exactly: the server's test)
+
+struct Str { const char *en, *fr; };
+#define TR( en, fr ) { en, fr }
+#define SAME( s ) { s, NULL }
+
+static const char *L( const char *en, const char *fr ) { return French() && fr ? fr : en; }
+static const char *L( const Str &s ) { return L( s.en, s.fr ); }
+
+//
+// The catalog: Counter-Strike's figures from its server sources (weapons.h, weapontype.cpp, player.cpp's armor
+// ratios), the Half-Life arsenal's from hl_weapons.h; a cycle is the time between two shots
+//
+enum { ANY = 0, ONLY_T = 1, ONLY_CT = 2 };
+enum { POSE_FLAT, POSE_UPRIGHT };
+
+struct BuyItem
+{
+	const char *cmd; Str name, kind; const char *model;
+	int id, price, team, pose;
+	float damage; int pellets; float cycle; int clip, reserve; float speed, armor, range;
+	Str note;
+	int health; // (a Pokemon's: its figures are a creature's, its preview its own model)
+};
+
+#define GUN( cmd, name, kind, model, id, price, team, dmg, pel, cyc, clip, res, spd, arm, rng, note ) \
+	{ cmd, name, kind, "models/" model ".mdl", id, price, team, POSE_FLAT, dmg, pel, cyc, clip, res, spd, arm, rng, note }
+#define ITEM( cmd, name, kind, model, id, price, team, note ) \
+	{ cmd, name, kind, model, id, price, team, POSE_FLAT, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, note }
+// (a Poke Ball: the Pokemon standing, its figures — damage a hit, `ticks` hits an attack, an attack every `cyc` seconds,
+// its range in units, its speed)
+#define POKE( cmd, name, kind, model, id, price, health, dmg, ticks, cyc, rng, spd, note ) \
+	{ cmd, name, kind, "models/pokemon/" model ".mdl", id, price, ANY, POSE_UPRIGHT, dmg, ticks, cyc, 0, 0, spd, 0, rng, note, health }
+// (another companion: the same figures, its model elsewhere)
+#define OTHER( cmd, name, kind, model, id, price, health, dmg, ticks, cyc, rng, spd, note ) \
+	{ cmd, name, kind, "models/others/" model ".mdl", id, price, ANY, POSE_UPRIGHT, dmg, ticks, cyc, 0, 0, spd, 0, rng, note, health }

+static int LocalTeam( void )
+{

+	// entity's own index until then)
+	int team = g_PlayerExtraInfo[gHUD.m_Scoreboard.m_iPlayerNum].teamnumber;
+	cl_entity_t *me = gEngfuncs.GetLocalPlayer();
+	if ( me && me->index > 0 && me->index <= MAX_PLAYERS && ( !team || !gHUD.m_Scoreboard.m_iPlayerNum ))
+		team = g_PlayerExtraInfo[me->index].teamnumber;
+	return team;
+}

+static bool Owned( int id )
+{
+	if ( id <= 0 )
+		return false;
+	return id < 32 ? !!( gHUD.m_iWeaponBits & ( 1 << id )) : !!( gHUD.m_iWeaponBitsHL & ( 1 << ( id - 32 )));
+}

+extern bool g_bOwnsShield;

+//
+// Half Strike's Pokemon (and Le M, a companion as they are), from the server's PokeHP messages: entity index (short),
+// health percent (0: gone), species, team, owner (a player's index)
+//
+enum { SPECIES_PIKACHU, SPECIES_CHARIZARD, SPECIES_BLASTOISE, SPECIES_LEM, NUM_SPECIES };
+static const struct { Str name; float height; } g_Species[NUM_SPECIES] =
+{
+	{ SAME( "Pikachu" ), 30 }, { TR( "Charizard", "Dracaufeu" ), 78 }, { TR( "Blastoise", "Tortank" ), 60 }, { SAME( "Le M" ), 72 }, // (their models' standing heights)
+};

+// (the species an item brings out: the balls in their order, then the laptop)
+static int ItemSpecies( int id ) { return IsCompanionItem( id ) ? id - PK_PIKACHU : -1; }

+// a companion's model: a Pokemon's (its ball's too, which no PokeHP names), Le M's
+static bool CompanionModel( const char *name )
+{
+	return name && ( strstr( name, "models/pokemon/" ) || strstr( name, "models/others/lem" ));
+}
+
+#define MAX_POKEMON 64
+
+struct Pokemon
+{
+	int ent; // (0: a free slot)
+	int species, team, owner;
+	float hp;              // (the server's, 0 to 1)
+	float shown, trail;    // (the bar, eased; the health just lost, fading behind it)
+	float lastHit, born, gone; // (gone: since its 0 came, the bar fading out; -1 alive)
+	float vis, nextTrace; bool clear; // (seen from the view: the last traces, eased)
+	float stale; // (a HUD reset's time, until the server sends it again: -1 confirmed)
+	float boneTop, boneTime; int boneSeq; // (its highest bone over its origin and its sequence, when last drawn: ArsUI_StudioBones)
+	float topGap; // (its model's top over its highest bone, standing: from its idle sequence's box; 0 not seen yet)
+	float barTop; // (the bar's height over its origin, eased: 0 not placed yet)
+};
+
+static Pokemon g_Pokemon[MAX_POKEMON];
+static char g_szPokemonLevel[64]; // (the level the table is for: another one, or none, empties it)
+static float g_flBallThrown = -1; // (the local player's ball thrown, not opened yet: its time, -1 none)
+static int g_iBallThrown, g_iBallHeld; // (its weapon id; the ball last seen in hand)
+static float g_flBallHeld = -1;
+// (Le M's Hack on the local player: its screen scrambled from g_flHackStart, -1 none — ArsUI_DrawHackScramble)
+static float g_flHackStart = -1, g_flHackLength, g_flHackStrength;
+static int g_iHackWatched; // (the player watched through its eyes when it came — a spectator's —, 0 the local one's own)
+static int LemHack_Msg( const char *pszName, int iSize, void *pbuf );
+
+// The table kept across the client's VidInits (a window resize is one): emptied when the level changes or the
+// connection ends; after a HUD reset (each spawn, each connection) the server sends its live Pokemon again, so those
+// it does not confirm within a second are dropped (a reconnection to the same map, one missed while away)
+static void PokemonPurge( void )
+{
+	const float now = gEngfuncs.GetClientTime();
+	const char *level = gEngfuncs.pfnGetLevelName();
+	if ( !level )
+		level = "";
+	if ( strncmp( level, g_szPokemonLevel, sizeof( g_szPokemonLevel ) - 1 ))
+	{
+		memset( g_Pokemon, 0, sizeof( g_Pokemon ));
+		snprintf( g_szPokemonLevel, sizeof( g_szPokemonLevel ), "%s", level );
+		g_flBallThrown = g_flBallHeld = -1;
+	}
+	for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_POKEMON; i++ )
+	{
+		Pokemon &p = g_Pokemon[i];
+		if ( p.ent && p.stale >= 0 && ( now - p.stale > 1.0f || now < p.stale ))
+			p.ent = 0;
+	}
+	if ( g_flBallThrown >= 0 && ( now - g_flBallThrown > 3.0f || now < g_flBallThrown ))
+		g_flBallThrown = -1; // (it opened, or came back: what the server says rules again)
+}
+
+static Pokemon *PokemonSlot( int ent, bool create )
+{
+	Pokemon *free = NULL;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_POKEMON; i++ )
+	{
+		if ( g_Pokemon[i].ent == ent )
+			return &g_Pokemon[i];
+		if ( !g_Pokemon[i].ent && !free )
+			free = &g_Pokemon[i];
+	}
+	if ( !create )
+		return NULL;
+	if ( !free ) // (full: the one fading out the longest)
+	{
+		for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_POKEMON; i++ )
+			if ( g_Pokemon[i].gone >= 0 && ( !free || g_Pokemon[i].gone < free->gone ))
+				free = &g_Pokemon[i];
+		if ( !free )
+			return NULL;
+	}
+	memset( free, 0, sizeof( *free ));
+	free->ent = ent;
+	free->gone = free->stale = -1;
+	return free;
+}
+
+static int PokeHP_Msg( const char *pszName, int iSize, void *pbuf )
+{
+	BufferReader reader( pszName, pbuf, iSize );
+	int lo = reader.ReadByte(), hi = reader.ReadByte();
+	int ent = lo | ( hi << 8 );
+	int hp = reader.ReadByte(), species = reader.ReadByte(), team = reader.ReadByte(), owner = reader.ReadByte();
+	if ( ent <= 0 )
+		return 1;
+	PokemonPurge();
+	float now = gEngfuncs.GetClientTime();
+	Pokemon *p = PokemonSlot( ent, hp > 0 );
+	if ( !p )
+		return 1;
+	if ( hp <= 0 )
+	{
+		if ( p->gone < 0 )
+		{
+			p->hp = 0;
+			p->gone = now;
+			p->lastHit = now;
+		}
+		return 1;
+	}
+	bool fresh = p->gone >= 0 || !p->born || p->born > now || p->species != min( species, NUM_SPECIES - 1 ) ||
+		p->owner != owner;
+	if ( fresh ) // (a new one, maybe in a slot just freed by the server; or the clock went back)
+	{
+		memset( p, 0, sizeof( *p ));
+		p->ent = ent;
+		p->gone = p->stale = -1;
+		p->born = now;
+		p->shown = p->trail = min( hp, 100 ) / 100.0f;
+		p->nextTrace = 0;
+	}
+	float v = min( hp, 100 ) / 100.0f;
+	if ( v < p->hp )
+		p->lastHit = now;
+	p->hp = v;
+	if ( p->trail < v )
+		p->trail = v;
+	p->species = min( species, NUM_SPECIES - 1 );
+	p->team = team;
+	p->owner = owner;
+	p->stale = -1;
+	if ( gEngfuncs.GetLocalPlayer() && owner == gEngfuncs.GetLocalPlayer()->index )
+		g_flBallThrown = -1; // (the ball thrown has opened: this is its Pokemon)
+	return 1;
+}
+
+static int LocalIndex( void )
+{
+	cl_entity_t *me = gEngfuncs.GetLocalPlayer();
+	return me ? me->index : 0;
+}
+
+// the local player's Pokemon out (its species), -1 none; a ball thrown and not opened yet counts (the server's rule:
+// one Pokemon out, its ball in flight included)
+static int PokemonOut( void )
+{
+	PokemonPurge();
+	int me = LocalIndex();
+	for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_POKEMON; i++ )
+		if ( g_Pokemon[i].ent && g_Pokemon[i].gone < 0 && g_Pokemon[i].stale < 0 && g_Pokemon[i].owner == me )
+			return g_Pokemon[i].species;
+	if ( g_flBallThrown >= 0 )
+		return ItemSpecies( g_iBallThrown );
+	return -1;
+}
+
+// The local player's weapons changed (HLWeapons, bit 0 for id 32): a ball gone from the hand that held it was thrown,
+// the laptop gone from it has typed Le M out
+void ArsUI_WeaponBits( int oldBits, int newBits )
+{
+	const float now = Now();
+	int balls = 0;
+	for ( int id = PK_PIKACHU; id <= LEM_LAPTOP; id++ )
+	{
+		const int bit = 1 << ( id - 32 );
+		balls |= newBits & bit;
+		const bool held = gHUD.m_Ammo.CurrentWeaponId() == id ||
+			( g_iBallHeld == id && g_flBallHeld >= 0 && now - g_flBallHeld < 1.0f && now >= g_flBallHeld );
+		if (( oldBits & bit ) && !( newBits & bit ) && held && gHUD.m_Health.m_iHealth > 0 )
+		{
+			g_flBallThrown = now;
+			g_iBallThrown = id;
+		}
+	}
+	if ( balls )
+		g_flBallThrown = -1; // (a ball carried again: it came back, no room to come out)
+	// (the laptop goes 0.5 s after Le M came — his PokeHP before it —: the one out already said so)
+	if ( g_flBallThrown >= 0 )
+	{
+		const int me = LocalIndex();
+		for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_POKEMON; i++ )
+			if ( g_Pokemon[i].ent && g_Pokemon[i].gone < 0 && g_Pokemon[i].stale < 0 && g_Pokemon[i].owner == me )
+				g_flBallThrown = -1;
+	}
+}
+
+// a ball or the laptop carried
+static bool OwnsCompanionItem( void )
+{
+	for ( int id = PK_PIKACHU; id <= LEM_LAPTOP; id++ )
+		if ( Owned( id ))
+			return true;
+	return false;
+}
+
+// The price the server asks: the armor only for what is missing
+static int Price( const BuyItem &it )
+{
+	if ( !strcmp( it.cmd, "vesthelm" ) && gHUD.m_Battery.Armor() >= 100 && !gHUD.m_Battery.Helmet())
+		return 350;
+	if ( !strcmp( it.cmd, "vesthelm" ) && gHUD.m_Battery.Helmet() && gHUD.m_Battery.Armor() > 0 && gHUD.m_Battery.Armor() < 100 )
+		return 650;
+	return it.price;
+}
+
+// The local player's look is one of Half-Life's (no shield hitbox)
+static bool HLLook( void )
+{
+	cl_entity_t *me = gEngfuncs.GetLocalPlayer();
+	if ( !me || !me->model )
+		return false;
+	for ( int t = 0; t < 2; t++ )
+		for ( int i = CS_LOOKS; i < NUM_LOOKS; i++ )
+		{
+			char path[96];
+			snprintf( path, sizeof( path ), "models/player/%s/%s.mdl", g_Looks[t][i].model, g_Looks[t][i].model );
+			if ( !strcmp( me->model->name, path ))
+				return true;
+		}
+	return false;
+}
+
+// What the server refuses whatever the money: Half-Life's pistols and the shield do not go together
+static bool Refused( const BuyItem &it )
+{
+	if (( it.id == HL_GLOCK || it.id == HL_PYTHON ) && g_bOwnsShield )
+		return true;
+	if ( !strcmp( it.cmd, "shield" ) && ( Owned( HL_GLOCK ) || Owned( HL_PYTHON ) || HLLook()))
+		return true;
+	// (one companion: a ball or the laptop carried, or a Pokemon or Le M out)
+	if ( IsCompanionItem( it.id ) && ( OwnsCompanionItem() || PokemonOut() >= 0 ))
+		return true;
+	return false;
+}
+
+// What the server refuses as already had: a full vest, and the helmet with it
+static bool Full( const BuyItem &it )
+{
+	const int armor = gHUD.m_Battery.Armor();
+	const bool helmet = gHUD.m_Battery.Helmet() && armor > 0;
+	return ( !strcmp( it.cmd, "vest" ) && armor >= 100 ) || ( !strcmp( it.cmd, "vesthelm" ) && armor >= 100 && helmet );
+}
+
+// why the server refuses an item, or would (the row flashed red)
+static const char *RefusalText( const BuyItem &it )
+{
+	if ( Full( it ))
+		return L( "Already have it", "Tu l'as d\xC3\xA9j\xC3\xA0" );
+	if ( IsCompanionItem( it.id ))
+	{
+		const int out = PokemonOut();
+		if ( out == SPECIES_LEM )
+			return L( "Le M is already out: one companion at a time", "Le M est d\xC3\xA9j\xC3\xA0 sorti : un compagnon \xC3\xA0 la fois" );
+		if ( out >= 0 )
+			return L( "Your Pok\xC3\xA9mon is already out: one companion at a time", "Ton Pok\xC3\xA9mon est d\xC3\xA9j\xC3\xA0 sorti : un compagnon \xC3\xA0 la fois" );
+		if ( Owned( LEM_LAPTOP ))
+			return it.id == LEM_LAPTOP ? L( "You already carry the laptop", "Tu portes d\xC3\xA9j\xC3\xA0 l'ordinateur" ) :
+				L( "You carry the laptop: one companion at a time", "Tu portes l'ordinateur : un compagnon \xC3\xA0 la fois" );
+		if ( OwnsCompanionItem())
+			return IsBall( it.id ) ? L( "You already carry a Pok\xC3\xA9 Ball", "Tu portes d\xC3\xA9j\xC3\xA0 une Pok\xC3\xA9 Ball" ) :
+				L( "You carry a Pok\xC3\xA9 Ball: one companion at a time", "Tu portes une Pok\xC3\xA9 Ball : un compagnon \xC3\xA0 la fois" );
+	}
+	if ( !Refused( it ))
+		return L( "Not enough money", "Pas assez d'argent" );
+	return strcmp( it.cmd, "shield" ) ? L( "Not with the shield", "Pas avec le bouclier" ) :
+		L( "Not with a Half-Life pistol or look", "Pas avec un pistolet ou une apparence Half-Life" );
+}
+
+// whether the item's companion is the one out (its row's tag in gold)
+static bool CompanionOut( const BuyItem &it ) { return IsCompanionItem( it.id ) && PokemonOut() == ItemSpecies( it.id ); }
+
+// a row's short tag where "owned" goes, for a refusal that is not about the money (null: none)
+static const char *RefusalTag( const BuyItem &it )
+{
+	if ( IsCompanionItem( it.id ))
+	{
+		const int out = PokemonOut();
+		if ( out == ItemSpecies( it.id ))
+			return L( "out", "sorti" );
+		if ( Owned( it.id ))
+			return L( "owned", "poss\xC3\xA9" "d\xC3\xA9" );
+		if ( out >= 0 )
+			return out == SPECIES_LEM ? L( "Le M out", "Le M sorti" ) : L( "Pok\xC3\xA9mon out", "Pok\xC3\xA9mon sorti" );
+		if ( Owned( LEM_LAPTOP ))
+			return L( "laptop", "ordinateur" );
+		if ( OwnsCompanionItem())
+			return L( "one Pok\xC3\xA9 Ball", "une Pok\xC3\xA9 Ball" );
+		return 0;
+	}
+	if ( Owned( it.id ) || Full( it ))
+		return L( "owned", "poss\xC3\xA9" "d\xC3\xA9" );
+	if ( Refused( it ))
+		return !strcmp( it.cmd, "shield" ) ? L( "HL pistol", "pistolet HL" ) : L( "shield", "bouclier" );
+	return 0;
+}
+
+static bool ItemForTeam( const BuyItem &it )
+{
+	int team = LocalTeam();
+	return it.team == ANY || ( it.team == ONLY_T && team == TEAM_TERRORIST ) || ( it.team == ONLY_CT && team == TEAM_CT );
+}
+
+// the items of a tab the player's team may buy
+static int TabItems( int tab, int *out )
+{
+	int n = 0;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < g_Tabs[tab].count; i++ )
+	{
+		int index = g_Tabs[tab].first + i;
+		if ( ItemForTeam( g_Items[index] ))
+			out[n++] = index;
+	}
+	return n;
+}
+
+//
+// Drawing
+//
+static float SC( float v ) { return v * gHUD.m_flScale; } // (HUD units to the screen's: shapes are drawn in its pixels)
+
+// The shapes of a frame go in one batch, drawn at its end in one call, then its texts over them (in their order:
+// a shape is never drawn over a text)
+#define MAX_QUADS 1024
+#define MAX_TEXTS 320
+
+struct Quad { float x[4], y[4]; Col c[4]; };
+struct QueuedText { float x, y, maxX, scale; Col c; char s[160]; };
+
+static Quad g_Quads[MAX_QUADS];
+static int g_iQuads;
+static QueuedText g_Texts[MAX_TEXTS];
+static int g_iTexts;
+
+static void Quad4( float x, float y, float w, float h, Col c00, Col c01, Col c11, Col c10 )
+{
+	if ( w <= 0 || h <= 0 || g_iQuads >= MAX_QUADS || ( !c00.a && !c01.a && !c11.a && !c10.a ))
+		return;
+	Quad &q = g_Quads[g_iQuads++];
+	q.x[0] = q.x[1] = SC( x ); q.x[2] = q.x[3] = SC( x + w );
+	q.y[0] = q.y[3] = SC( y ); q.y[1] = q.y[2] = SC( y + h );
+	q.c[0] = c00; q.c[1] = c01; q.c[2] = c11; q.c[3] = c10;
+}
+
+// a quadrilateral of any shape (HUD units), one colour
+static void QuadPts( const float *xs, const float *ys, Col c )
+{
+	if ( g_iQuads >= MAX_QUADS || !c.a )
+		return;
+	Quad &q = g_Quads[g_iQuads++];
+	for ( int k = 0; k < 4; k++ ) { q.x[k] = SC( xs[k] ); q.y[k] = SC( ys[k] ); q.c[k] = c; }
+}
+
+static void Color( Col c ) { gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->Color4f( c.r / 255.0f, c.g / 255.0f, c.b / 255.0f, c.a / 255.0f ); }
+
+static void Grad( float x, float y, float w, float h, Col top, Col bottom ) { Quad4( x, y, w, h, top, bottom, bottom, top ); }
+
+static void GradH( float x, float y, float w, float h, Col left, Col right ) { Quad4( x, y, w, h, left, left, right, right ); }
+
+static void Fill( float x, float y, float w, float h, Col c ) { Quad4( x, y, w, h, c, c, c, c ); }
+
+static void Frame( float x, float y, float w, float h, Col c, float t = 1 )
+{
+	Fill( x, y, w, t, c );
+	Fill( x, y + h - t, w, t, c );
+	Fill( x, y + t, t, h - 2 * t, c );
+	Fill( x + w - t, y + t, t, h - 2 * t, c );
+}
+
+// a filled rectangle with a hole in it (where a model turns)
+static void FillAround( float x, float y, float w, float h, float hx, float hy, float hw, float hh, Col c )
+{
+	Fill( x, y, w, hy - y, c );
+	Fill( x, hy + hh, w, y + h - hy - hh, c );
+	Fill( x, hy, hx - x, hh, c );
+	Fill( hx + hw, hy, x + w - hx - hw, hh, c );
+}
+
+// the screen shaded but for a row of cards (same top, same height, left to right)
+static void ShadeAroundRow( const float *xs, int n, float w, float y, float h, Col c )
+{
+	float sw = ScreenWidth, sh = ScreenHeight;
+	Fill( 0, 0, sw, y, c );
+	Fill( 0, y + h, sw, sh - y - h, c );
+	float x = 0;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < n; i++ )
+	{
+		Fill( x, y, xs[i] - x, h, c );
+		x = xs[i] + w;
+	}
+	Fill( x, y, sw - x, h, c );
+}
+
+// the screen shaded but for two rows of cards (each its own left edges, width, top and height)
+static void ShadeAroundRows( const float *xs1, int n1, float w1, float y1, float h1, const float *xs2, int n2, float w2, float y2, float h2, Col c )
+{
+	float sw = ScreenWidth, sh = ScreenHeight;
+	Fill( 0, 0, sw, y1, c );
+	Fill( 0, y1 + h1, sw, y2 - y1 - h1, c );
+	Fill( 0, y2 + h2, sw, sh - y2 - h2, c );
+	const float *xs[2] = { xs1, xs2 }; const int ns[2] = { n1, n2 }; const float ws[2] = { w1, w2 }, ys[2] = { y1, y2 }, hs[2] = { h1, h2 };
+	for ( int r = 0; r < 2; r++ )
+	{
+		float x = 0;
+		for ( int i = 0; i < ns[r]; i++ ) { Fill( x, ys[r], xs[r][i] - x, hs[r], c ); x = xs[r][i] + ws[r]; }
+		Fill( x, ys[r], sw - x, hs[r], c );
+	}
+}
+
+static void FlushShapes( void )
+{
+	if ( !g_iQuads )
+		return;
+	gRenderAPI.GL_SelectTexture( 0 );
+	gRenderAPI.GL_Bind( 0, gHUD.m_WhiteTex );
+	gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->RenderMode( kRenderTransAlpha );
+	gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->CullFace( TRI_NONE );
+	gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->Brightness( 1.0f );
+	gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->Begin( TRI_QUADS );
+	for ( int i = 0; i < g_iQuads; i++ )
+	{
+		const Quad &q = g_Quads[i];
+		for ( int k = 0; k < 4; k++ )
+		{
+			gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->Color4f( q.c[k].r / 255.0f, q.c[k].g / 255.0f, q.c[k].b / 255.0f, q.c[k].a / 255.0f );
+			gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->TexCoord2f( k >= 2, k == 1 || k == 2 );
+			gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->Vertex3f( q.x[k], q.y[k], 0 );
+		}
+	}
+	gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->End();
+	gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->RenderMode( kRenderNormal );
+	g_iQuads = 0;
+}
+
+static int LineHeight( float scale = 1 ) { return (int)( gHUD.GetCharHeight() * scale ); }
+
+// The HUD font is ASCII: a French letter (UTF-8) is drawn as its plain letter with its accent drawn over it — or its
+// cedilla under it: é è ê ë à â ä ç î ï ô ö ù û ü, their capitals; œ as oe, a typographic apostrophe as '. Returns
+// the accents (their places in out, their kinds). Also ä ï ö ÿ and Ä Ï Ö Ÿ (BuildDrawBar's capitals).
+enum { ACC_ACUTE, ACC_GRAVE, ACC_CIRC, ACC_DIAER, ACC_CEDIL };
+struct Accent { int at; char kind; bool upper; };
+#define MAX_ACCENTS 24
+
+// (the second byte of a letter after 0xC3: its plain letter, its accent)
+static const struct { unsigned char b; char letter, kind; } g_LatinLetters[] =
+{
+	{ 0xA0, 'a', ACC_GRAVE }, { 0xA2, 'a', ACC_CIRC }, { 0xA4, 'a', ACC_DIAER }, { 0xA7, 'c', ACC_CEDIL },
+	{ 0xA8, 'e', ACC_GRAVE }, { 0xA9, 'e', ACC_ACUTE }, { 0xAA, 'e', ACC_CIRC }, { 0xAB, 'e', ACC_DIAER },
+	{ 0xAE, 'i', ACC_CIRC }, { 0xAF, 'i', ACC_DIAER }, { 0xB4, 'o', ACC_CIRC }, { 0xB6, 'o', ACC_DIAER },
+	{ 0xB9, 'u', ACC_GRAVE }, { 0xBB, 'u', ACC_CIRC }, { 0xBC, 'u', ACC_DIAER }, { 0xBF, 'y', ACC_DIAER },
+	{ 0x80, 'A', ACC_GRAVE }, { 0x82, 'A', ACC_CIRC }, { 0x84, 'A', ACC_DIAER }, { 0x87, 'C', ACC_CEDIL },
+	{ 0x88, 'E', ACC_GRAVE }, { 0x89, 'E', ACC_ACUTE }, { 0x8A, 'E', ACC_CIRC }, { 0x8B, 'E', ACC_DIAER },
+	{ 0x8E, 'I', ACC_CIRC }, { 0x8F, 'I', ACC_DIAER }, { 0x94, 'O', ACC_CIRC }, { 0x96, 'O', ACC_DIAER },
+	{ 0x99, 'U', ACC_GRAVE }, { 0x9B, 'U', ACC_CIRC }, { 0x9C, 'U', ACC_DIAER },
+};
+#define NUM_LATIN_LETTERS (int)( sizeof( g_LatinLetters ) / sizeof( g_LatinLetters[0] ))
+
+// the length of the UTF-8 sequence at s that Latin() draws as a letter (or as ' or a space), 0 for any other
+static int LatinSeq( const unsigned char *s )
+{
+	if ( s[0] == 0xC3 )
+	{
+		for ( int k = 0; k < NUM_LATIN_LETTERS; k++ )
+			if ( g_LatinLetters[k].b == s[1] )
+				return 2;
+		return 0;
+	}
+	if ( s[0] == 0xC5 && ( s[1] == 0x92 || s[1] == 0x93 || s[1] == 0xB8 )) // (Œ œ Ÿ)
+		return 2;
+	if ( s[0] == 0xE2 && s[1] == 0x80 && ( s[2] == 0x98 || s[2] == 0x99 )) // (‘ ’)
+		return 3;
+	if ( s[0] == 0xC2 && s[1] == 0xA0 ) // (a no-break space)
+		return 2;
+	return 0;
+}
+
+static int Latin( const char *s, char *out, int size, Accent *accents, int maxAccents )
+{
+	int n = 0, a = 0;
+	while ( *s && n < size - 1 )
+	{
+		const unsigned char c = (unsigned char)s[0], c1 = c ? (unsigned char)s[1] : 0;
+		if ( c == 0xC3 )
+		{
+			int k = 0;
+			while ( k < NUM_LATIN_LETTERS && g_LatinLetters[k].b != c1 )
+				k++;
+			if ( k < NUM_LATIN_LETTERS )
+			{
+				if ( a < maxAccents )
+				{
+					accents[a].at = n;
+					accents[a].kind = g_LatinLetters[k].kind;
+					accents[a].upper = g_LatinLetters[k].letter < 'a';
+					a++;
+				}
+				out[n++] = g_LatinLetters[k].letter;
+				s += 2;
+				continue;
+			}
+		}
+		if ( c == 0xC5 && c1 == 0xB8 ) // (Ÿ)
+		{
+			if ( a < maxAccents )
+			{
+				accents[a].at = n;
+				accents[a].kind = ACC_DIAER;
+				accents[a].upper = true;
+				a++;
+			}
+			out[n++] = 'Y';
+			s += 2;
+			continue;
+		}
+		if ( c == 0xC5 && ( c1 == 0x93 || c1 == 0x92 ) && n < size - 2 ) // (œ, Œ)
+		{
+			out[n++] = c1 == 0x93 ? 'o' : 'O';
+			out[n++] = c1 == 0x93 ? 'e' : 'E';
+			s += 2;
+			continue;
+		}
+		if ( c == 0xE2 && c1 == 0x80 && ( (unsigned char)s[2] == 0x98 || (unsigned char)s[2] == 0x99 )) // (‘ ’)
+		{
+			out[n++] = '\'';
+			s += 3;
+			continue;
+		}
+		if ( c == 0xC2 && c1 == 0xA0 ) // (a no-break space)
+		{
+			out[n++] = ' ';
+			s += 2;
+			continue;
+		}
+		// (any other UTF-8 sequence passed on whole, for the engine's own decoding — or not at all when it does not fit)
+		int len = 1;
+		if ( c >= 0xC0 && c < 0xE0 ) len = 2;
+		else if ( c >= 0xE0 && c < 0xF0 ) len = 3;
+		else if ( c >= 0xF0 && c < 0xF8 ) len = 4;
+		int k = 1;
+		while ( k < len && ( (unsigned char)s[k] & 0xC0 ) == 0x80 )
+			k++;
+		if ( n + k > size - 1 )
+			break;
+		memcpy( out + n, s, k );
+		n += k;
+		s += k;
+	}
+	out[n] = 0;
+	return a;
+}
+
+static int TextWidth( const char *s, float scale = 1 )
+{
+	char buf[192]; Accent accents[1];
+	Latin( s, buf, sizeof( buf ), accents, 0 );
+	return (int)( DrawUtils::HudStringLen( buf ) * scale );
+}
+
+static bool Scaled( float scale ) { return scale != 1 && g_iMobileAPIVersion; }
+
+// an accent over (or under) the letter at x: in the text's colour, one or two quads. The font's x-height is about
+// 0.35 of its line, from 0.30 of it down, its capitals from about 0.10, its baseline at about 0.66
+static void AccentAdd( const Accent &acc, float x, float y, float lh, float cw, Col c )
+{
+	const float xh = lh * 0.35f, len = max( 2.5f, xh * 0.6f );
+	const float tw = max( 1.2f, lh * 0.075f ); // (a stroke's width, across)
+	const float cx = x + cw * 0.5f;
+	const float yb = acc.upper ? y + lh * 0.10f - 1 : y + lh * 0.30f - 2; // (the accent's bottom: a pixel clear of its letter)
+	const float l = acc.upper ? len * 0.8f : len;
+	const float dy = l * 0.86f, dx = l * 0.5f; // (a stroke rising at 60 degrees)
+	switch ( acc.kind )
+	{
+	case ACC_ACUTE:
+	case ACC_GRAVE:
+	{
+		const bool acute = acc.kind == ACC_ACUTE;
+		const float x0 = cx - dx / 2 - tw / 2, x1 = cx + dx / 2 - tw / 2; // (bottom left to top right; the grave mirrored)
+		const float xs[4] = { acute ? x0 : x1, ( acute ? x0 : x1 ) + tw, ( acute ? x1 : x0 ) + tw, acute ? x1 : x0 }, ys[4] = { yb, yb, yb - dy, yb - dy };
+		QuadPts( xs, ys, c );
+		break;
+	}
+	case ACC_CIRC:
+	{
+		const float h = dy * 0.8f, half = max( 1.5f, cw * 0.28f );
+		const float xs1[4] = { cx - half - tw / 2, cx - half + tw / 2, cx + tw / 2, cx - tw / 2 }, ys1[4] = { yb, yb, yb - h, yb - h };
+		const float xs2[4] = { cx - tw / 2, cx + tw / 2, cx + half + tw / 2, cx + half - tw / 2 }, ys2[4] = { yb - h, yb - h, yb, yb };
+		QuadPts( xs1, ys1, c );
+		QuadPts( xs2, ys2, c );
+		break;
+	}
+	case ACC_DIAER:
+	{
+		const float d = max( 1.5f, tw * 1.2f ), off = max( 1.5f, cw * 0.22f );
+		Fill( cx - off - d / 2, yb - d, d, d, c );
+		Fill( cx + off - d / 2, yb - d, d, d, c );
+		break;
+	}
+	case ACC_CEDIL:
+	{
+		const float top = y + lh * 0.66f, h = max( 2.0f, lh * 0.16f );
+		const float xs[4] = { cx - tw / 2, cx + tw / 2, cx - tw / 2 - h * 0.5f + tw, cx - tw / 2 - h * 0.5f }, ys[4] = { top, top, top + h, top + h };
+		QuadPts( xs, ys, c );
+		break;
+	}
+	}
+}
+
+static void TextClip( float x, float y, float maxX, const char *s, Col c, float scale = 1 )
+{
+	if ( g_iTexts >= MAX_TEXTS || !c.a || !s[0] )
+		return;
+	const Col accentColour = c;
+	if ( c.a < 255 )
+	{
+		float f = c.a / 255.0f;
+		c.r *= f; c.g *= f; c.b *= f; // (the font is additive)
+	}
+	QueuedText &t = g_Texts[g_iTexts++];
+	t.x = x; t.y = y; t.maxX = maxX; t.scale = Scaled( scale ) ? scale : 0.0f; t.c = c;
+	Accent accents[MAX_ACCENTS];
+	const int na = Latin( s, t.s, sizeof( t.s ), accents, MAX_ACCENTS );
+	const float k = t.scale ? t.scale : 1.0f, lh = gHUD.GetCharHeight() * k;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < na; i++ )
+	{
+		char prefix[sizeof( t.s )];
+		memcpy( prefix, t.s, accents[i].at );
+		prefix[accents[i].at] = 0;
+		const float ex = x + DrawUtils::HudStringLen( prefix ) * k, cw = gHUD.GetCharWidth( (unsigned char)t.s[accents[i].at] ) * k;
+		if ( ex + cw > maxX )
+			break;
+		AccentAdd( accents[i], ex, y, lh, cw, accentColour );
+	}
+}
+
+static void Text( float x, float y, const char *s, Col c, float scale = 1 ) { TextClip( x, y, 100000, s, c, scale ); }
+
+static void FlushTexts( void )
+{
+	for ( int i = 0; i < g_iTexts; i++ )
+	{
+		const QueuedText &t = g_Texts[i];
+		if ( !t.scale )
+		{
+			DrawUtils::DrawHudString( (int)t.x, (int)t.y, (int)t.maxX, t.s, t.c.r, t.c.g, t.c.b );
+			continue;
+		}
+		// (enlarged: a character at a time, advanced by its width at that scale — the client's own scaled strings
+		// divide the advance by the HUD's scale once more, which overlaps them on a stretched HUD)
+		float x = t.x;
+		for ( const char *c = t.s; *c; c++ )
+		{
+			gMobileAPI.pfnDrawScaledCharacter( (int)x, (int)t.y, (unsigned char)*c, t.c.r, t.c.g, t.c.b, t.scale );
+			x += gHUD.GetCharWidth( (unsigned char)*c ) * t.scale;
+		}
+	}
+	g_iTexts = 0;
+}
+
+static int TextW( const char *s, float scale ) { return Scaled( scale ) ? TextWidth( s, scale ) : TextWidth( s ); }
+
+static void TextCenter( float cx, float y, const char *s, Col c, float scale = 1 ) { Text( cx - TextW( s, scale ) / 2, y, s, c, scale ); }
+
+static void TextRight( float rx, float y, const char *s, Col c, float scale = 1 ) { Text( rx - TextW( s, scale ), y, s, c, scale ); }
+
+// the length of s cut to at most n bytes, at a letter's start (not inside a UTF-8 sequence)
+static int CutAt( const char *s, int n )
+{
+	while ( n > 0 && ( (unsigned char)s[n] & 0xC0 ) == 0x80 )
+		n--;
+	return n;
+}
+
+// the text cut at a width, with an ellipsis
+static void FitInto( const char *s, float w, char *buf, int size )
+{
+	int len = strlen( s );
+	if ( len > size - 1 )
+		len = CutAt( s, size - 1 );
+	memcpy( buf, s, len );
+	buf[len] = 0;
+	if ( TextWidth( buf ) <= w )
+		return;
+	for ( int n = strlen( buf ); n > 0; n = CutAt( buf, n - 1 ))
+	{
+		buf[n] = 0;
+		while ( n > 0 && buf[n - 1] == ' ' )
+			buf[--n] = 0;
+		if ( n + 4 > size )
+			continue;
+		strcat( buf, "..." );
+		if ( TextWidth( buf ) <= w )
+			return;
+		buf[n] = 0;
+	}
+	buf[0] = 0;
+}
+
+static void TextFit( float x, float y, const char *s, float w, Col c )
+{
+	char buf[160];
+	FitInto( s, w, buf, sizeof( buf ));
+	Text( x, y, buf, c );
+}
+
+// The text in lines of at most a width, cut at its spaces: at most maxLines (the last cut with an ellipsis if it is
+// still too long). Returns the lines' count.
+#define WRAP_LEN 160
+static int WrapLines( const char *s, float w, char lines[][WRAP_LEN], int maxLines )
+{
+	int n = 0;
+	while ( *s == ' ' )
+		s++;
+	while ( *s && n < maxLines )
+	{
+		if ( n == maxLines - 1 || TextWidth( s ) <= w )
+		{
+			FitInto( s, w, lines[n++], WRAP_LEN );
+			break;
+		}
+		// (the longest start of it, cut at a space, that fits; none: cut anywhere)
+		int best = 0;
+		for ( int i = 1; s[i] && i < WRAP_LEN - 1; i++ )
+		{
+			if ( s[i] != ' ' )
+				continue;
+			char part[WRAP_LEN];
+			memcpy( part, s, i );
+			part[i] = 0;
+			if ( TextWidth( part ) > w )
+				break;
+			best = i;
+		}
+		if ( !best )
+		{
+			FitInto( s, w, lines[n++], WRAP_LEN );
+			break;
+		}
+		memcpy( lines[n], s, best );
+		lines[n][best] = 0;
+		n++;
+		s += best;
+		while ( *s == ' ' )
+			s++;
+	}
+	return n;
+}
+
+// a text wrapped to a width, from its top left (align 0), right edge (1) or centre (2); returns the lines drawn
+static int TextWrap( float x, float y, const char *s, float w, Col c, int maxLines, float lineH, int align = 0 )
+{
+	char lines[4][WRAP_LEN];
+	const int n = WrapLines( s, w, lines, min( maxLines, 4 ));
+	for ( int i = 0; i < n; i++ )
+	{
+		if ( align == 1 )
+			TextRight( x, y + i * lineH, lines[i], c );
+		else if ( align == 2 )
+			TextCenter( x, y + i * lineH, lines[i], c );
+		else
+			Text( x, y + i * lineH, lines[i], c );
+	}
+	return n;
+}
+
+static bool Hover( float x, float y, float w, float h ) { return g_cx >= x && g_cx < x + w && g_cy >= y && g_cy < y + h; }
+
+static bool Clicked( float x, float y, float w, float h ) { return g_bClick && Hover( x, y, w, h ); }
+
+// a key's badge: [1]
+static void KeyBadge( float x, float y, const char *key, bool lit )
+{
+	int h = LineHeight();
+	int w = TextWidth( key ) + 10;
+	Fill( x, y - 2, w, h + 4, lit ? Alpha( C_GOLD, 0.6f ) : C_SOFT );
+	Text( x + 5, y, key, lit ? C_WHITE : C_DIM ); // (the font is additive: light on the gold)
+}
+
+// a button with a key; returns whether it was clicked
+static bool Button( float x, float y, float w, float h, const char *key, const char *label, bool enabled, Col accent )
+{
+	bool hover = enabled && Hover( x, y, w, h );
+	Fill( x, y, w, h, hover ? C_HOVER : C_PANEL2 );
+	Frame( x, y, w, h, hover ? accent : C_SOFT );
+	int lh = LineHeight();
+	float tx = x + 12;
+	if ( key )
+	{
+		KeyBadge( tx, y + ( h - lh ) / 2, key, hover );
+		tx += TextWidth( key ) + 20;
+	}
+	Text( tx, y + ( h - lh ) / 2, label, enabled ? ( hover ? C_GOLDT : C_TEXT ) : C_FAINT );
+	return enabled && Clicked( x, y, w, h );
+}
+
+//
+// The models
+//
+#define MAX_PREVIEWS 10
+#define PREVIEW_DIST 9.0f
+#define BACKDROP_DIST 14.5f
+
+struct Preview
+{
+	char name[64];
+	model_t *model;
+	int sequence, pose;
+	float x, y, w, h, t0, yaw, zoom;
+	float scale; // (of the last frame, for the light)
+	bool active, failed;
+	bool laid; float layAngle; // (the screen-plane turn that lays a weapon flat: LayAngle, from its first frame's bones)
+	bool fitted; float fitCenter[3], fitHx, fitHz, fitSweep;
+	int measured; float corr; // (the scale corrected once from what its first laid frame drew: PreviewBones)
+	float frameW, frameH, mid[3];
+	float pose0[3][3], m[3][4];
+	cl_entity_t ent;
+};
+
+// the world models that do not lie as the others: `over` turned over along their length (upside down), `roll` degrees
+// in the screen's plane, `yaw` degrees around the vertical (their face toward the view)
+struct Turn { const char *model; bool over; float roll, yaw; };
+static const Turn g_Turns[] = { { "", false, 0, 0 } }; // (none: LayAngle lays them all)
+static const char *const g_Flips[] = { "models/w_9mmhandgun.mdl" };
+
+struct Backdrop
+{
+	float x, y, w, h;
+	Col c;
+};
+
+static Preview g_Previews[MAX_PREVIEWS];
+static bool g_bPreviewUsed[MAX_PREVIEWS];
+static Backdrop g_Backdrops[8], g_BackdropsNext[8];
+static int g_iBackdrops, g_iBackdropsNext;
+static vec3_t g_vViewOrg, g_vForward, g_vRight, g_vUp;
+static bool g_bView;
+
+// a model turning in a rectangle of the screen, this frame (slots keep their animation while their model stays)
+static void PreviewAdd( int slot, const char *model, float x, float y, float w, float h, int pose, float yaw, float zoom = 1 )
+{
+	if ( slot < 0 || slot >= MAX_PREVIEWS || !model || !model[0] )
+		return;
+	Preview &p = g_Previews[slot];
+	if ( strcmp( p.name, model ))
+	{
+		strncpy( p.name, model, sizeof( p.name ) - 1 );
+		p.name[sizeof( p.name ) - 1] = 0;
+		p.model = NULL;
+		p.failed = false;
+		p.laid = false; p.layAngle = 0;
+		p.fitted = false;
+		p.measured = 0; p.corr = 1;
+		p.t0 = Now();
+	}
+	p.x = x; p.y = y; p.w = w; p.h = h; p.pose = pose; p.yaw = yaw; p.zoom = zoom;
+	g_bPreviewUsed[slot] = true;
+}
+
+static void BackdropAdd( float x, float y, float w, float h, Col c )
+{
+	if ( g_iBackdropsNext >= (int)( sizeof( g_BackdropsNext ) / sizeof( g_BackdropsNext[0] )))
+		return;
+	Backdrop &b = g_BackdropsNext[g_iBackdropsNext++];
+	b.x = x; b.y = y; b.w = w; b.h = h; b.c = c;
+}
+
+static int PickSequence( studiohdr_t *hdr, int pose )
+{
+	if ( pose != POSE_UPRIGHT )
+		return 0;
+	mstudioseqdesc_t *seq = (mstudioseqdesc_t *)( (byte *)hdr + hdr->seqindex );
+	// (the model's own standing idle: by its activity, then by name — one without blends, which pose the limbs apart)
+	for ( int i = 0; i < hdr->numseq; i++ )
+		if ( seq[i].activity == 1 /* ACT_IDLE */ && seq[i].numblends <= 1 )
+			return i;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < hdr->numseq; i++ )
+		if ( !strcmp( seq[i].label, "idle1" ))
+			return i;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < hdr->numseq; i++ )
+		if ( strstr( seq[i].label, "idle" ))
+			return i;
+	return 0;
+}
+
+void ArsUI_SetView( const float *origin, const float *angles )
+{
+	VectorCopy( origin, g_vViewOrg );
+	AngleVectors( angles, g_vForward, g_vRight, g_vUp );
+	g_bView = true;
+}
+
+// the tangents of the half field of view, from where the renderer projects two points
+static void Projection( float &tx, float &ty )
+{
+	vec3_t p;
+	float screen[3];
+	tx = ty = 1;
+	VectorMA( g_vViewOrg, 100, g_vForward, p ); VectorMA( p, 100, g_vRight, p );
+	if ( !gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->WorldToScreen( p, screen ) && fabs( screen[0] ) > 0.001f )
+		tx = 1.0f / fabs( screen[0] );
+	VectorMA( g_vViewOrg, 100, g_vForward, p ); VectorMA( p, 100, g_vUp, p );
+	if ( !gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->WorldToScreen( p, screen ) && fabs( screen[1] ) > 0.001f )
+		ty = 1.0f / fabs( screen[1] );
+}
+
+// where a point of the screen (HUD units) is, at a distance in front of the view
+static void ScreenPoint( float sx, float sy, float dist, float tx, float ty, float *out )
+{
+	float nx = sx / ScreenWidth * 2 - 1, ny = 1 - sy / ScreenHeight * 2;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
+		out[i] = g_vViewOrg[i] + dist * ( g_vForward[i] + g_vRight[i] * nx * tx + g_vUp[i] * ny * ty );
+}
+
+void ArsUI_CreateEntities( void )
+{
+	if ( !g_bView )
+		return;
+	BuildThink();
+	BuildCreateGhost();
+	for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_PREVIEWS; i++ )
+	{
+		Preview &p = g_Previews[i];
+		if ( !p.active || p.failed || g_iPanel == P_NONE )
+			continue;
+		if ( !p.model )
+		{
+			p.model = IEngineStudio.Mod_ForName( p.name, 0 );
+			if (( !p.model || p.model->type != mod_studio ) && !strncmp( p.name, "models/others/", 14 ))
+			{
+				// (Half Strike's others: in the Pokemon's folder, if that is where they were put)
+				char alt[64];
+				snprintf( alt, sizeof( alt ), "models/pokemon/%s", p.name + 14 );
+				p.model = IEngineStudio.Mod_ForName( alt, 0 );
+			}
+			if ( !p.model || p.model->type != mod_studio )
+			{
+				p.model = NULL;
+				p.failed = true; // (tried once, while its name stays)
+				continue;
+			}
+			p.sequence = PickSequence( (studiohdr_t *)IEngineStudio.Mod_Extradata( p.model ), p.pose );
+		}
+		cl_entity_t *e = &p.ent;
+		memset( e, 0, sizeof( *e ));
+		e->model = p.model;
+		e->curstate.sequence = p.sequence;
+		e->curstate.framerate = 1;
+		e->curstate.animtime = p.t0;
+		e->curstate.rendermode = kRenderNormal;
+		e->curstate.renderamt = 255;
+		e->curstate.movetype = MOVETYPE_NONE;
+		// (a player model: its bone controllers and blends at their middle, the neutral pose — a weapon's are left at 0,
+		// where its maker posed it)
+		if ( p.pose == POSE_UPRIGHT )
+		{
+			for ( int k = 0; k < 4; k++ ) e->curstate.controller[k] = e->latched.prevcontroller[k] = 127;
+			e->curstate.blending[0] = e->curstate.blending[1] = e->latched.prevblending[0] = e->latched.prevblending[1] = 127;
+		}
+		e->latched.prevsequence = p.sequence;
+		float tx, ty;
+		Projection( tx, ty );
+		ScreenPoint( p.x + p.w / 2, p.y + p.h / 2, PREVIEW_DIST, tx, ty, e->origin );
+		VectorCopy( e->origin, e->curstate.origin );
+		gEngfuncs.CL_CreateVisibleEntity( ET_NORMAL, e );
+	}
+}
+
+bool ArsUI_IsPreview( cl_entity_t *ent )
+{
+	return ent >= &g_Previews[0].ent && ent <= &g_Previews[MAX_PREVIEWS - 1].ent;
+}
+
+static Preview *PreviewOf( cl_entity_t *ent )
+{
+	for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_PREVIEWS; i++ )
+		if ( ent == &g_Previews[i].ent )
+			return &g_Previews[i];
+	return NULL;
+}
+
+// The angle, in the screen's plane, that lays a model's length horizontal with its widest overhang down: its vertices,
+// placed by its bones as its sequence poses them (model space), seen in the display frame `pose` gives (x right, z up).
+struct Lay { float angle, center[3], hx, hz, sweep; bool fitted; };
+static Lay LayAngle( studiohdr_t *hdr, const float pose[3][3], float bone[][3][4] )
+{
+	Lay out = { 0, { 0, 0, 0 }, 0, 0, 0, false };
+	vec3_t lo = { 1e9f, 1e9f, 1e9f }, hi = { -1e9f, -1e9f, -1e9f };
+	// (the first body part's first model: the weapon itself)
+	double sx = 0, sz = 0, sxx = 0, szz = 0, sxz = 0; int n = 0;
+	static float px[4096], pz[4096], py[4096];
+	mstudiobodyparts_t *parts = (mstudiobodyparts_t *)( (byte *)hdr + hdr->bodypartindex );
+	for ( int bp = 0; bp < hdr->numbodyparts && n < 4096; bp++ )
+	{
+		if ( parts[bp].nummodels <= 0 )
+			continue;
+		mstudiomodel_t *model = (mstudiomodel_t *)( (byte *)hdr + parts[bp].modelindex );
+		const vec3_t *verts = (const vec3_t *)( (byte *)hdr + model->vertindex );
+		const byte *vbone = (const byte *)hdr + model->vertinfoindex;
+		for ( int v = 0; v < model->numverts && n < 4096; v++ )
+		{
+			const int b = vbone[v] < hdr->numbones ? vbone[v] : 0;
+			vec3_t w;
+			VectorTransform( verts[v], bone[b], w );
+			for ( int k = 0; k < 3; k++ ) { lo[k] = min( lo[k], w[k] ); hi[k] = max( hi[k], w[k] ); }
+			const float x = pose[0][0] * w[0] + pose[0][1] * w[1] + pose[0][2] * w[2];
+			const float z = pose[2][0] * w[0] + pose[2][1] * w[1] + pose[2][2] * w[2];
+			py[n] = pose[1][0] * w[0] + pose[1][1] * w[1] + pose[1][2] * w[2];
+			px[n] = x; pz[n] = z; n++;
+			sx += x; sz += z; sxx += x * x; szz += z * z; sxz += x * z;
+		}
+	}
+	if ( n < 8 )
+		return out;
+	for ( int k = 0; k < 3; k++ ) out.center[k] = ( lo[k] + hi[k] ) / 2;
+	const double mx = sx / n, mz = sz / n, cxx = sxx / n - mx * mx, czz = szz / n - mz * mz, cxz = sxz / n - mx * mz;
+	// (the principal axis; a nearly round item is left as it lies)
+	const double theta = 0.5 * atan2( 2 * cxz, cxx - czz );
+	const double l1 = ( cxx + czz ) / 2 + sqrt(( cxx - czz ) * ( cxx - czz ) / 4 + cxz * cxz ), l2 = cxx + czz - l1;
+	float angle = 0;
+	if ( l1 >= l2 * 1.8 )
+	{
+	// turned by -theta: the axis horizontal; then the farthest overhang (perpendicular) must point down
+	angle = (float)-theta;
+	const float c = cosf( angle ), s = sinf( angle );
+	float up = 0, down = 0;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < n; i++ )
+	{
+		const float z = s * ( px[i] - mx ) + c * ( pz[i] - mz );
+		up = max( up, z ); down = max( down, -z );
+	}
+	if ( up > down )
+		angle += M_PI;
+	}
+	// (the model's own extent once laid: the frame fitted to it, not to its file's box)
+	const float c = cosf( angle ), s = sinf( angle );
+	float x0 = 1e9f, x1 = -1e9f, z0 = 1e9f, z1 = -1e9f;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < n; i++ )
+	{
+		const float x = c * px[i] - s * pz[i], z = s * px[i] + c * pz[i];
+		x0 = min( x0, x ); x1 = max( x1, x ); z0 = min( z0, z ); z1 = max( z1, z );
+	}
+	out.angle = angle; out.hx = ( x1 - x0 ) / 2; out.hz = ( z1 - z0 ) / 2; out.fitted = true;
+	// (how far it reaches from its middle in the plane it turns in — across and in depth: the swing it needs)
+	const float cxm = ( x0 + x1 ) / 2;
+	float y0 = 1e9f, y1 = -1e9f;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < n; i++ ) { y0 = min( y0, py[i] ); y1 = max( y1, py[i] ); }
+	const float cym = ( y0 + y1 ) / 2;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < n; i++ )
+	{
+		const float x = c * px[i] - s * pz[i] - cxm, y = py[i] - cym;
+		out.sweep = max( out.sweep, sqrtf( x * x + y * y ));
+	}
+	// (its middle in model space: the laid frame's middle taken back through the laid axes)
+	const float czm = ( z0 + z1 ) / 2;
+	for ( int k = 0; k < 3; k++ )
+	{
+		const float r0 = c * pose[0][k] - s * pose[2][k], r2 = s * pose[0][k] + c * pose[2][k];
+		out.center[k] = r0 * cxm + pose[1][k] * cym + r2 * czm;
+	}
+	return out;
+}
+
+// the model's frame: its bounding box centered in the rectangle, fitted to it as it turns, the side of a weapon
+// facing the view (world models lie on that side); a player faces it, the top tilted a little toward it
+bool ArsUI_PreviewTransform( cl_entity_t *ent, float m[3][4] )
+{
+	Preview *p = PreviewOf( ent );
+	if ( !p || !g_bView )
+		return false;
+	studiohdr_t *hdr = (studiohdr_t *)IEngineStudio.Mod_Extradata( p->model );
+	vec3_t mins, maxs;
+	mstudioseqdesc_t *seq = (mstudioseqdesc_t *)( (byte *)hdr + hdr->seqindex ) + p->sequence;
+	VectorCopy( seq->bbmin, mins ); VectorCopy( seq->bbmax, maxs );
+	if ( maxs[0] - mins[0] < 0.5f || maxs[2] - mins[2] < 0.5f )
+	{
+		VectorCopy( hdr->bbmin, mins ); VectorCopy( hdr->bbmax, maxs );
+	}
+	if ( maxs[0] - mins[0] < 0.5f || maxs[2] - mins[2] < 0.5f )
+	{
+		VectorCopy( hdr->min, mins ); VectorCopy( hdr->max, maxs );
+	}
+	if ( maxs[0] - mins[0] < 0.5f )
+	{
+		mins[0] = mins[1] = mins[2] = -12;
+		maxs[0] = maxs[1] = maxs[2] = 12;
+	}
+
+	// local axes in the display frame (x: the screen's right, y: away from the view, z: its up)
+	float pose[3][3] = { { 1, 0, 0 }, { 0, 1, 0 }, { 0, 0, 1 } };
+	if ( p->pose == POSE_FLAT )
+	{
+		// (lying weapons: their up toward the view, their left up)
+		pose[0][0] = 1; pose[1][0] = 0; pose[2][0] = 0;
+		pose[0][1] = 0; pose[1][1] = 0; pose[2][1] = 1;
+		pose[0][2] = 0; pose[1][2] = -1; pose[2][2] = 0;
+	}
+	// (models that lie otherwise than the others: turned over along their length, or in the screen's plane, or a
+	// quarter turn to show their face — g_Turns)
+	for ( const Turn &t : g_Turns )
+	{
+		if ( strcmp( t.model, p->name ))
+			continue;
+		const float r = t.roll * M_PI / 180, f = t.over ? M_PI : 0, w = t.yaw * M_PI / 180;
+		// E = Rz(yaw) * Ry(roll) * Rx(over), in the display's axes (x right, y away, z up)
+		const float rx[3][3] = { { 1, 0, 0 }, { 0, cosf( f ), -sinf( f ) }, { 0, sinf( f ), cosf( f ) } };
+		const float ry[3][3] = { { cosf( r ), 0, sinf( r ) }, { 0, 1, 0 }, { -sinf( r ), 0, cosf( r ) } };
+		const float rz[3][3] = { { cosf( w ), -sinf( w ), 0 }, { sinf( w ), cosf( w ), 0 }, { 0, 0, 1 } };
+		float e1[3][3], e[3][3], q[3][3];
+		for ( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ ) for ( int j = 0; j < 3; j++ ) e1[i][j] = ry[i][0] * rx[0][j] + ry[i][1] * rx[1][j] + ry[i][2] * rx[2][j];
+		for ( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ ) for ( int j = 0; j < 3; j++ ) e[i][j] = rz[i][0] * e1[0][j] + rz[i][1] * e1[1][j] + rz[i][2] * e1[2][j];
+		for ( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ ) for ( int j = 0; j < 3; j++ ) q[i][j] = e[i][0] * pose[0][j] + e[i][1] * pose[1][j] + e[i][2] * pose[2][j];
+		memcpy( pose, q, sizeof( q ));
+	}
+	vec3_t center, half;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
+	{
+		center[i] = ( mins[i] + maxs[i] ) / 2;
+		half[i] = ( maxs[i] - mins[i] ) / 2;
+	}
+	float ex = 0, ey = 0, ez = 0;
+	for ( int j = 0; j < 3; j++ )
+	{
+		ex += fabs( pose[0][j] ) * half[j];
+		ey += fabs( pose[1][j] ) * half[j];
+		ez += fabs( pose[2][j] ) * half[j];
+	}
+	// (a lying weapon laid along the screen: the model's length — its vertices' principal axis in the shown plane —
+	// horizontal, the side reaching furthest from it (grip, magazine, stock) down; the game's files have them at any
+	// angle. Computed once per model.)
+	if ( p->pose == POSE_FLAT )
+	{
+		memcpy( p->pose0, pose, sizeof( p->pose0 )); // (for PreviewBones: the frame before laying)
+		if ( p->laid && p->layAngle )
+		{
+			const float c = cosf( p->layAngle ), sn = sinf( p->layAngle );
+			for ( int j = 0; j < 3; j++ )
+			{
+				const float x = pose[0][j], z = pose[2][j];
+				pose[0][j] = c * x - sn * z; pose[2][j] = sn * x + c * z;
+			}
+			ex = ey = ez = 0;
+			for ( int j = 0; j < 3; j++ )
+			{
+				ex += fabs( pose[0][j] ) * half[j];
+				ey += fabs( pose[1][j] ) * half[j];
+				ez += fabs( pose[2][j] ) * half[j];
+			}
+		}
+		// (fitted to its vertices: their middle at the frame's, their extent filling it)
+		if ( p->laid && p->fitted )
+		{
+			VectorCopy( p->fitCenter, center );
+			ex = p->fitHx; ez = p->fitHz; ey = min( ey, max( ex, ez ));
+		}
+	}
+	// (small items shown at a sensible size, not blown up to the frame)
+	ez = max( ez, 4.5f );
+	float radius = max( (float)sqrt( ex * ex + ey * ey ), 7.0f );
+	if ( p->laid && p->fitted )
+		radius = max( max( p->fitSweep, p->fitHx ), 7.0f ); // (its real swing: never near the view nor past the backdrop)
+	float tx, ty;
+	Projection( tx, ty );
+	float worldW = p->w / ScreenWidth * 2 * tx * PREVIEW_DIST, worldH = p->h / ScreenHeight * 2 * ty * PREVIEW_DIST;
+	float intro = Clamp01(( Now() - p->t0 ) / 0.25f );
+	intro = 1 - ( 1 - intro ) * ( 1 - intro );
+	float s = min( worldW * 0.94f / ( 2 * radius ), worldH * 0.9f / ( 2 * ez )) * p->zoom * ( 0.86f + 0.14f * intro );
+	// (never deeper than the backdrop: the model stays between it and the view)
+	s = min( s, ( BACKDROP_DIST - PREVIEW_DIST - 0.5f ) / radius );
+	s *= p->corr;
+	p->scale = s;
+
+	// (a slow sway around the side that faces the view: a close model turned edge-on would leave the frame)
+	float yaw = p->yaw + sin(( Now() - p->t0 ) * 0.8f ) * ( p->pose == POSE_UPRIGHT ? 0.55f : 0.42f ) + g_flDragYaw;
+	if ( p->pose == POSE_UPRIGHT )
+		yaw -= M_PI / 2; // (the front toward the view)
+	float cy = cos( yaw ), sy = sin( yaw );
+	float tilt = ( p->pose == POSE_UPRIGHT ? 5.0f : 9.0f ) * M_PI / 180, ct = cos( tilt ), st = sin( tilt );
+	// display = Tilt * Spin * pose
+	float spin[3][3] = { { cy, -sy, 0 }, { sy, cy, 0 }, { 0, 0, 1 } };
+	float tiltm[3][3] = { { 1, 0, 0 }, { 0, ct, -st }, { 0, st, ct } };
+	float a[3][3], d[3][3];
+	for ( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
+		for ( int j = 0; j < 3; j++ )
+			a[i][j] = spin[i][0] * pose[0][j] + spin[i][1] * pose[1][j] + spin[i][2] * pose[2][j];
+	for ( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
+		for ( int j = 0; j < 3; j++ )
+			d[i][j] = tiltm[i][0] * a[0][j] + tiltm[i][1] * a[1][j] + tiltm[i][2] * a[2][j];
+	// world = [right forward up] * display * scale
+	vec3_t mid;
+	ScreenPoint( p->x + p->w / 2, p->y + p->h / 2, PREVIEW_DIST, tx, ty, mid );
+	for ( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
+	{
+		for ( int j = 0; j < 3; j++ )
+			m[i][j] = ( g_vRight[i] * d[0][j] + g_vForward[i] * d[1][j] + g_vUp[i] * d[2][j] ) * s;
+		m[i][3] = mid[i] - ( m[i][0] * center[0] + m[i][1] * center[1] + m[i][2] * center[2] );
+	}
+	VectorCopy( mid, ent->origin );
+	memcpy( p->m, m, sizeof( p->m ));
+	p->frameW = worldW; p->frameH = worldH; VectorCopy( mid, p->mid );
+	return true;
+}
+
+// Whether points (across, in depth, up from the frame's middle), scaled by f and swaying around the up axis,
+// stay within the frame
+static bool PreviewFits( const vec3_t *pts, int n, float f, float X0, float D, float Z0, float frameW, float frameH )
+{
+	for ( int k = 0; k <= 12; k++ )
+	{
+		const float c = cosf( k / 12.0f - 0.5f ), sn = sinf( k / 12.0f - 0.5f ); // (the sway: 0.42 either way)
+		for ( int i = 0; i < n; i++ )
+		{
+			const float x = f * ( pts[i][0] * c - pts[i][1] * sn ), y = f * ( pts[i][0] * sn + pts[i][1] * c ), z = f * pts[i][2];
+			const float den = D + y;
+			if ( den < 0.5f )
+				return false;
+			if ( fabsf( D * ( X0 + x ) / den - X0 ) > 0.46f * frameW || fabsf( D * ( Z0 + z ) / den - Z0 ) > 0.42f * frameH )
+				return false;
+		}
+	}
+	return true;
+}
+
+// The preview's bones of this frame (world space, from m): the first frame of a lying weapon lays it — its bones back
+// in model space, then LayAngle — and is not drawn. False: skip drawing.
+bool ArsUI_PreviewBones( cl_entity_t *ent, float bones[][3][4], int count )
+{
+	Preview *p = PreviewOf( ent );
+	if ( !p || p->pose != POSE_FLAT )
+		return true;
+	if ( p->laid )
+	{
+		// (its first laid frame: the vertices where its bones put them, measured across, up and in depth against the
+		// frame and the room before the backdrop; the scale corrected once, and that frame not drawn)
+		if ( p->measured++ )
+			return true;
+		studiohdr_t *hdr = (studiohdr_t *)IEngineStudio.Mod_Extradata( p->model );
+		static vec3_t pts[8192];
+		int n = 0;
+		float ay = 0;
+		mstudiobodyparts_t *parts = (mstudiobodyparts_t *)( (byte *)hdr + hdr->bodypartindex );
+		for ( int bp = 0; bp < hdr->numbodyparts; bp++ )
+		{
+			if ( parts[bp].nummodels <= 0 ) continue;
+			mstudiomodel_t *model = (mstudiomodel_t *)( (byte *)hdr + parts[bp].modelindex );
+			const vec3_t *verts = (const vec3_t *)( (byte *)hdr + model->vertindex );
+			const byte *vbone = (const byte *)hdr + model->vertinfoindex;
+			for ( int v = 0; v < model->numverts; v++ )
+			{
+				const int b = vbone[v] < count ? vbone[v] : 0;
+				vec3_t w; VectorTransform( verts[v], bones[b], w );
+				vec3_t d = { w[0] - p->mid[0], w[1] - p->mid[1], w[2] - p->mid[2] };
+				ay = max( ay, sqrtf( DotProduct( d, d )));
+				if ( n < 8192 )
+				{
+					pts[n][0] = DotProduct( d, g_vRight ); pts[n][1] = DotProduct( d, g_vForward ); pts[n][2] = DotProduct( d, g_vUp );
+					n++;
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		float f = 1;
+		if ( ay > 0.001f ) f = min( f, ( BACKDROP_DIST - PREVIEW_DIST - 0.5f ) / ay ); // (turning, it reaches that far in depth)
+		// (swaying, in the perspective of a frame off the screen's middle: its nearer end grows away from it)
+		vec3_t o; VectorSubtract( p->mid, g_vViewOrg, o );
+		const float X0 = DotProduct( o, g_vRight ), D = DotProduct( o, g_vForward ), Z0 = DotProduct( o, g_vUp );
+		float lo = 0, hi = f;
+		while ( hi - lo > 0.005f && !PreviewFits( pts, n, hi, X0, D, Z0, p->frameW, p->frameH ))
+		{
+			const float m = ( lo + hi ) / 2;
+			if ( PreviewFits( pts, n, m, X0, D, Z0, p->frameW, p->frameH ))
+				lo = m;
+			else
+				hi = m;
+		}
+		p->corr = PreviewFits( pts, n, hi, X0, D, Z0, p->frameW, p->frameH ) ? hi : lo;
+		// (measured during the intro's zoom, which then ends: the correction of the final size)
+		float intro = Clamp01(( Now() - p->t0 ) / 0.25f );
+		intro = 1 - ( 1 - intro ) * ( 1 - intro );
+		p->corr *= 0.86f + 0.14f * intro;
+		return false;
+	}
+	p->laid = true;
+	if ( count <= 0 || count > 128 )
+		return false;
+	// (m = R*s | t, R orthonormal: its inverse is R^T/s | -R^T t / s)
+	float s2 = p->m[0][0] * p->m[0][0] + p->m[1][0] * p->m[1][0] + p->m[2][0] * p->m[2][0];
+	if ( s2 < 1e-12f )
+		return false;
+	float inv[3][4];
+	for ( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
+	{
+		for ( int j = 0; j < 3; j++ ) inv[i][j] = p->m[j][i] / s2;
+		inv[i][3] = -( inv[i][0] * p->m[0][3] + inv[i][1] * p->m[1][3] + inv[i][2] * p->m[2][3] );
+	}
+	static float local[128][3][4];
+	for ( int b = 0; b < count; b++ )
+		ConcatTransforms( inv, bones[b], local[b] );
+	const Lay lay = LayAngle( (studiohdr_t *)IEngineStudio.Mod_Extradata( p->model ), p->pose0, local );
+	p->layAngle = lay.angle;
+	// (a few models whose overhang misleads: the other way up)
+	for ( const char *flip : g_Flips )
+		if ( !strcmp( flip, p->name ))
+			p->layAngle += M_PI;
+	p->fitted = lay.fitted; VectorCopy( lay.center, p->fitCenter ); p->fitHx = lay.hx; p->fitHz = lay.hz; p->fitSweep = lay.sweep;
+
+	return false;
+}
+
+// a light of its own: from above the view, on its left
+void ArsUI_PreviewLighting( cl_entity_t *ent, alight_t *lighting )
+{
+	Preview *p = PreviewOf( ent );
+	if ( !p )
+		return;
+	lighting->ambientlight = 78;
+	lighting->shadelight = 168;
+	lighting->color[0] = lighting->color[1] = lighting->color[2] = 1.0f;
+	vec3_t dir;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
+		dir[i] = g_vForward[i] * 0.55f - g_vUp[i] * 0.7f + g_vRight[i] * 0.45f;
+	VectorNormalize( dir );
+	// (the bones are scaled: the light turned in their frame would be too)
+	float k = p->scale > 0.0001f ? 1.0f / p->scale : 1.0f;
+	VectorScale( dir, k, lighting->plightvec );
+}

+void ArsUI_DrawBackdrops( void )
+{
+	if ( !g_bView || !g_iBackdrops || g_iPanel == P_NONE )
+		return;
+	float tx, ty;
+	Projection( tx, ty );
+	gRenderAPI.GL_SelectTexture( 0 );
+	gRenderAPI.GL_Bind( 0, gHUD.m_WhiteTex );
+	gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->RenderMode( kRenderTransAlpha );
+	gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->CullFace( TRI_NONE );
+	for ( int i = 0; i < g_iBackdrops; i++ )
+	{
+		Backdrop &b = g_Backdrops[i];
+		vec3_t c[4];
+		ScreenPoint( b.x, b.y, BACKDROP_DIST, tx, ty, c[0] );
+		ScreenPoint( b.x, b.y + b.h, BACKDROP_DIST, tx, ty, c[1] );
+		ScreenPoint( b.x + b.w, b.y + b.h, BACKDROP_DIST, tx, ty, c[2] );
+		ScreenPoint( b.x + b.w, b.y, BACKDROP_DIST, tx, ty, c[3] );
+		Color( b.c );
+		gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->Begin( TRI_QUADS );
+		for ( int k = 0; k < 4; k++ )
+		{
+			gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->TexCoord2f( 0, 0 );
+			gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->Vertex3fv( c[k] );
+		}
+		gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->End();
+	}
+	gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->RenderMode( kRenderNormal );
+}

+bool ArsUI_HidesViewModel( void )

+extern void IN_ReleaseMouseButtons( void );
+
+static void Mouse( bool on )
+{
+	if ( on == g_bTouch || !g_iMobileAPIVersion )
+		return;
+	g_bTouch = on;
+	g_bInMouse = true;
+	if ( on )
+	{
+		// (a button held as the panel opens: its release would go to the panel, its action stay on, +attack firing)
+		IN_ReleaseMouseButtons();
+		static byte none[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
+		gMobileAPI.pfnTouchAddClientButton( "_ars_click", "*white", "+ars_click", 0, 0, 1, 1, none, 0, 1.0f, 0 );
+		gMobileAPI.pfnTouchSetClientOnly( 1 );
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		gMobileAPI.pfnTouchRemoveButton( "_ars_click" );
+		gMobileAPI.pfnTouchSetClientOnly( 0 );
+	}
+	g_bInMouse = false;
+}
+
+static void Open( int panel, int bits )
+{
+	Mouse( true );
+	if ( g_iPanel != panel )
+		g_flOpened = Now();
+	g_iPanel = panel;
+	g_iBits = bits;
+	g_iHover = g_iFocus = -1;
+	g_iKeyLevel = 0;
+	g_bClick = g_bMouseDown = g_bDragging = false;
+	g_flDragYaw = 0;
+	gHUD.m_Menu.m_fMenuDisplayed = 0;
+	gHUD.m_Menu.m_iFlags &= ~HUD_DRAW;
+}
+
+static void Close( void )
+{
+	Mouse( false );
+	g_bSuspended = false;
+	g_iPanel = P_NONE;
+	g_bClick = g_bMouseDown = g_bDragging = false;
+}
+
+static bool Allowed( int key ) { return !!( g_iBits & ( 1 << ( key - 1 ))); }

+static void Command( const char *fmt, int arg )
+{
+	char buf[64];
+	snprintf( buf, sizeof( buf ), fmt, arg );
+	ClientCmd( buf );
+}

+static int TeamCount( int team )
+{
+	int n = 0;
+	gHUD.m_Scoreboard.GetAllPlayersInfo();
+	for ( int i = 1; i <= MAX_PLAYERS; i++ )
+		if ( g_PlayerInfoList[i].name && g_PlayerInfoList[i].name[0] && g_PlayerExtraInfo[i].teamnumber == team )
+			n++;
+	return n;
+}

+static float Fade( void ) { return Clamp01(( Now() - g_flOpened ) / 0.15f ); }
+
+static void Title( float y, const char *title, const char *subtitle, float fade )
+{
+	float cx = ScreenWidth / 2;
+	TextCenter( cx, y, title, Alpha( C_GOLDT, fade ), 2.0f );
+	float ty = y + LineHeight( Scaled( 2.0f ) ? 2.0f : 1.0f ) + 8;
+	GradH( cx - 160, ty, 160, 1, Alpha( C_GOLD, 0 ), Alpha( C_GOLD, fade * 0.8f ));
+	GradH( cx, ty, 160, 1, Alpha( C_GOLD, fade * 0.8f ), Alpha( C_GOLD, 0 ));
+	if ( subtitle )
+		TextCenter( cx, ty + 10, subtitle, Alpha( C_DIM, fade ));
+}

+// a card: a model turning over its backdrop, its name under it; returns whether it was clicked. wrap: its last line
+// on two lines (the cards of a row all alike, as their caller decides)
+static bool Card( int slot, float x, float y, float w, float h, const char *model, int pose, const char *key, const char *name,
+	const char *line1, const char *line2, Col accent, bool enabled, float fade, bool wrap = false )
+{
+	bool hover = enabled && Hover( x, y, w, h );
+	int lh = LineHeight();
+	// (its info lines under its name: line1 dim, line2 faint)
+	const char *info[3] = { line1, line2, NULL };
+	Col cols[3] = { C_DIM, C_FAINT, C_FAINT };
+	int count = line2 ? 2 : line1 ? 1 : 0;
+	char lines[2][WRAP_LEN];
+	if ( wrap && count )
+	{
+		const int last = count - 1;
+		const int n = WrapLines( info[last], w - 24, lines, 2 );
+		info[last] = n > 0 ? lines[0] : "";
+		info[last + 1] = n > 1 ? lines[1] : "";
+		cols[last + 1] = cols[last];
+		count++;
+	}
+	float infoH = lh * ( 2.2f + 1.2f * count );
+	float hx = x + 1, hy = y + 1, hw = w - 2, hh = h - infoH - 1;
+	Col back = hover ? Mix( C_PANEL, accent, 0.10f ) : C_PANEL;
+	BackdropAdd( hx, hy, hw, hh, Alpha( back, fade * 0.92f ));
+	Grad( hx, hy + hh * 0.55f, hw, hh * 0.45f, Alpha( accent, 0 ), Alpha( accent, ( hover ? 0.20f : 0.08f ) * fade )); // (the floor's glow)
+	if ( model )
+		PreviewAdd( slot, model, hx + 6, hy + 8, hw - 12, hh - 14, pose, 0, hover ? 1.04f : 0.97f );
+	Fill( x, y + h - infoH, w, infoH, Alpha( hover ? C_PANEL2 : C_PANEL, fade ));
+	Fill( x, y + h - infoH, w, 2, Alpha( accent, ( hover ? 1.0f : 0.55f ) * fade ));
+	Frame( x, y, w, h, Alpha( hover ? accent : C_SOFT, fade ));
+	float ty = y + h - infoH + lh * 0.55f;
+	if ( key )
+		KeyBadge( x + 12, ty, key, hover );
+	Text( x + ( key ? 22 + TextWidth( key ) : 12 ), ty, name, Alpha( enabled ? ( hover ? C_GOLDT : C_TEXT ) : C_FAINT, fade ));
+	for ( int i = 0; i < count; i++ )
+		TextFit( x + 12, ty + lh * ( 1.3f + 1.1f * i ), info[i], w - 24, Alpha( cols[i], fade ));
+	return enabled && Clicked( x, y, w, h );
+}

+// "3 players"
+static void Players( char *buf, int size, int n )
+{
+	if ( French())
+		snprintf( buf, size, "%d joueur%s", n, n > 1 ? "s" : "" );
+	else
+		snprintf( buf, size, "%d player%s", n, n == 1 ? "" : "s" );
+}

+// the team panel: the two sides, their models turning, how many play in each; auto-select, spectate
+static void DrawTeam( void )
+{
+	float fade = Fade();
+	float sw = ScreenWidth, sh = ScreenHeight;
+	Title( sh * 0.08f, L( "CHOOSE YOUR SIDE", "CHOISIS TON CAMP" ), L( "Click a side, or press its key", "Clique sur un camp, ou appuie sur sa touche" ), fade );
+	float cw = min( 340.0f, sw * 0.28f ), ch = min( 470.0f, sh * 0.6f ), gap = min( 48.0f, sw * 0.04f );
+	float x0 = sw / 2 - cw - gap / 2, y0 = sh * 0.22f;
+	float xs[2] = { x0, x0 + cw + gap };
+	ShadeAroundRow( xs, 2, cw, y0, ch, Alpha( C_SHADE, fade ));
+	int nT = TeamCount( TEAM_TERRORIST ), nCT = TeamCount( TEAM_CT );
+	char l1[64], l2[64];
+	int look = (int)( Now() / 3.5f ) % NUM_LOOKS; // (the side's looks, in turn)
+	char model[64];
+
+	const char *goals[2] = { L( "Plant the bomb, hold the hostages", "Pose la bombe, garde les otages" ),
+		L( "Defuse the bomb, rescue the hostages", "D\xC3\xA9samorce la bombe, lib\xC3\xA8re les otages" ) };
+	const bool wrap = TextWidth( goals[0] ) > cw - 24 || TextWidth( goals[1] ) > cw - 24; // (a goal too long: both on two lines)
+	Players( l1, sizeof( l1 ), nT );
+	snprintf( model, sizeof( model ), "models/player/%s/%s.mdl", g_Looks[0][look].model, g_Looks[0][look].model );
+	if ( Card( 0, x0, y0, cw, ch, model, POSE_UPRIGHT, "1", L( "Terrorists", "Terroristes" ), l1, goals[0], C_TCOL, Allowed( 1 ), fade, wrap ))
+	{
+		Command( "jointeam %d", 1 );
+		Close();
+		return;
+	}
+	Players( l1, sizeof( l1 ), nCT );
+	snprintf( model, sizeof( model ), "models/player/%s/%s.mdl", g_Looks[1][look].model, g_Looks[1][look].model );
+	if ( Card( 1, x0 + cw + gap, y0, cw, ch, model, POSE_UPRIGHT, "2", L( "Counter-Terrorists", "Anti-terroristes" ), l1, goals[1], C_CTCOL, Allowed( 2 ), fade, wrap ))
+	{
+		Command( "jointeam %d", 2 );
+		Close();
+		return;
+	}
+	(void)l2;
+	float by = y0 + ch + 22, bh = LineHeight() * 2.2f, bw = min( 210.0f, cw * 0.62f );
+	int buttons = 1 + Allowed( 3 ) + Allowed( 6 ) + Allowed( 10 );
+	float bx = sw / 2 - ( buttons * bw + ( buttons - 1 ) * 14 ) / 2;
+	if ( Button( bx, by, bw, bh, "5", L( "Auto-select", "S\xC3\xA9lection auto" ), Allowed( 5 ), C_GOLD ))
+	{
+		Command( "jointeam %d", 5 );
+		Close();
+		return;
+	}
+	bx += bw + 14;
+	if ( Allowed( 3 ))
+	{
+		if ( Button( bx, by, bw, bh, "3", "VIP", true, C_GOLD ))
+		{
+			Command( "jointeam %d", 3 );
+			Close();
+			return;
+		}
+		bx += bw + 14;
+	}
+	if ( Allowed( 6 ))
+	{
+		if ( Button( bx, by, bw, bh, "6", L( "Spectate", "Spectateur" ), true, C_GOLD ))
+		{
+			Command( "jointeam %d", 6 );
+			Close();
+			return;
+		}
+		bx += bw + 14;
+	}
+	if ( Allowed( 10 ) && Button( bx, by, bw, bh, "0", L( "Cancel", "Annuler" ), true, C_GOLD ))
+		Close();
+}

+// the appearance panel: the side's looks, turning
+static void DrawClass( void )
+{
+	float fade = Fade();
+	float sw = ScreenWidth, sh = ScreenHeight;
+	int team = g_iClassTeam, lh = LineHeight();
+	Title( sh * 0.06f, L( "CHOOSE YOUR LOOK", "CHOISIS TON APPARENCE" ), team ? L( "Counter-Terrorists", "Anti-terroristes" ) : L( "Terrorists", "Terroristes" ), fade );
+	Col accent = team ? C_CTCOL : C_TCOL;
+	// (two rows: Counter-Strike's looks, Half-Life's; keys 1 to 9, 0 at random)
+	const int counts[2] = { CS_LOOKS, NUM_LOOKS - CS_LOOKS };
+	const char *rowNames[2] = { "Counter-Strike", "Half-Life" };
+	float gap = 12, labelH = lh * 1.6f, bh = lh * 2.2f;
+	float top = sh * 0.06f + LineHeight( Scaled( 2.0f ) ? 2.0f : 1.0f ) + lh * 2.6f;
+	float ch = min( 300.0f, ( sh - top - labelH * 2 - gap - bh - 40 ) / 2 ), cw = min( 190.0f, ( sw - 60 - gap * 4 ) / 5 );
+	float xs[2][5], ys[2];
+	for ( int r = 0; r < 2; r++ )
+	{
+		ys[r] = top + labelH + r * ( ch + gap + labelH );
+		float x0 = sw / 2 - ( counts[r] * cw + ( counts[r] - 1 ) * gap ) / 2;
+		for ( int i = 0; i < counts[r]; i++ ) xs[r][i] = x0 + i * ( cw + gap );
+	}
+	ShadeAroundRows( xs[0], counts[0], cw, ys[0], ch, xs[1], counts[1], cw, ys[1], ch, Alpha( C_SHADE, fade ));
+	bool wrap = false; // (a note too long for one line: two for all)
+	for ( int i = 0; i < NUM_LOOKS; i++ )
+		wrap |= TextWidth( L( g_Looks[team][i].note )) > cw - 24;
+	int index = 0;
+	for ( int r = 0; r < 2; r++ )
+	{
+		Text( xs[r][0], ys[r] - labelH + lh * 0.25f, rowNames[r], Alpha( C_DIM, fade ));
+		for ( int i = 0; i < counts[r]; i++, index++ )
+		{
+			const Look &l = g_Looks[team][index];
+			char model[64], key[4];
+			snprintf( model, sizeof( model ), "models/player/%s/%s.mdl", l.model, l.model );
+			snprintf( key, sizeof( key ), "%d", index + 1 );
+			if ( Card( index, xs[r][i], ys[r], cw, ch, model, POSE_UPRIGHT, key, L( l.name ), L( l.note ), NULL, accent, Allowed( index + 1 ), fade, wrap ))
+			{
+				Command( "joinclass %d", index + 1 );
+				Close();
+				return;
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	float bw = 230;
+	if ( Button( sw / 2 - bw / 2, ys[1] + ch + 16, bw, bh, "0", L( "Auto-select", "S\xC3\xA9lection auto" ), Allowed( 10 ), C_GOLD ))
+	{
+		Command( "joinclass %d", 10 );
+		Close();
+	}
+}

+static void Bar( float x, float y, float w, float h, float value, Col c )
+{
+	Fill( x, y, w, h, C_BAR );
+	value = Clamp01( value );
+	if ( value > 0 )
+		GradH( x, y, w * value, h, Alpha( c, 0.65f ), c );
+}
+
+static void StatRow( float x, float y, float w, const char *label, float value, const char *text, Col c )
+{
+	int lh = LineHeight();
+	Text( x, y, label, C_DIM );
+	// (the bar shortened for a long figure: never under it)
+	float bx = x + max( w * 0.34f, TextWidth( label ) + 12.0f ), bw = min( w * 0.42f, x + w - TextWidth( text ) - 12 - bx );
+	if ( bw > 12 )
+		Bar( bx, y + lh / 2 - 3, bw, 6, value, c );
+	TextRight( x + w, y, text, C_TEXT );
+}

+// (the server decides and tells why it refuses; the row flashes red when the price is more than the money, or for
+// what goes not with the shield)
+static void Buy( int index )
+{
+	const BuyItem &it = g_Items[index];
+	g_iFlashItem = index;
+	g_flFlash = Now();
+	g_bFlashBad = Refused( it ) || Full( it ) || Price( it ) > gHUD.m_Money.Money();
+	ClientCmd( (char *)it.cmd );
+}
+
+// a decimal number as the language writes it: 1.5, 1,5
+static void Decimal( char *buf, int size, const char *fmt, float v )
+{
+	snprintf( buf, size, fmt, v );
+	if ( French())
+		for ( char *c = buf; *c; c++ )
+			if ( *c == '.' && c > buf && c[-1] >= '0' && c[-1] <= '9' )
+				*c = ',';
+}
+
+// (the lines of a text, lineH apart, that fit from y to bottom)
+static int LinesFit( float y, float bottom, float lineH )
+{
+	const float room = bottom - y, lh = LineHeight();
+	return room < lh ? 0 : 1 + (int)(( room - lh ) / lineH );
+}
+
+// (the figures from y down, to bottom at most: the notes wrapped in the room left)
+static void ItemFigures( float x, float y, float w, float bottom, const BuyItem &it )
+{
+	int lh = LineHeight();
+	char text[48];
+	// (the rows closer on a short screen: the note's first line kept in the panel)
+	const int rows = it.health > 0 ? 5 : !it.damage ? 0 : 1 + ( it.cycle > 0 ) + ( it.armor > 0 && it.speed > 0 ) + ( it.range > 0 ) + ( it.speed > 0 ) + ( it.clip > 0 || it.reserve > 0 );
+	float row = lh * 1.55f;
+	// (a companion's two notes — its own, how it follows —, an item's one: their room kept first)
+	const float notes = it.health > 0 ? lh * 2.6f : lh * 1.3f;
+	if ( rows && y + rows * row + notes > bottom )
+		row = max( lh * 1.05f, ( bottom - y - notes ) / rows );
+	if ( it.health > 0 )
+	{
+		// (a Pokemon: its health, its attack's damage and pace, its reach, its speed)
+		snprintf( text, sizeof( text ), "%d", it.health );
+		StatRow( x, y, w, L( "HP", "PV" ), it.health / 240.0f, text, C_GREEN );
+		y += row;
+		if ( it.pellets > 1 )
+			snprintf( text, sizeof( text ), "%d x %d", (int)it.damage, it.pellets );
+		else
+			snprintf( text, sizeof( text ), "%d", (int)it.damage );
+		StatRow( x, y, w, L( "Damage", "D\xC3\xA9g\xC3\xA2ts" ), it.damage * it.pellets / 60.0f, text, C_RED );
+		y += row;
+		Decimal( text, sizeof( text ), L( "every %.1f s", "toutes les %.1f s" ), it.cycle );
+		StatRow( x, y, w, L( "Attack", "Attaque" ), 1.0f / it.cycle, text, C_GOLD );
+		y += row;
+		snprintf( text, sizeof( text ), "%d m", (int)( it.range * 0.0254f + 0.5f )); // (inches)
+		StatRow( x, y, w, L( "Range", "Port\xC3\xA9" "e" ), it.range / 800.0f, text, C_CTCOL );
+		y += row;
+		snprintf( text, sizeof( text ), "%d", (int)it.speed );
+		StatRow( x, y, w, L( "Speed", "Vitesse" ), ( it.speed - 180 ) / 140.0f, text, C_TEXT );
+		y += row;
+		const float noteH = lh * 1.25f;
+		const int room = LinesFit( y + 2, bottom, noteH );
+		y += TextWrap( x, y + 2, L( it.note ), w, C_TEXT, room > 0 ? min( 2, max( 1, room - 1 )) : 0, noteH ) * noteH;
+		const int left = LinesFit( y + 2, bottom, noteH );
+		if ( left > 0 )
+			TextWrap( x, y + 2, L( "Follows you, charges whoever you shoot or who hurts you", "Te suit, attaque ta cible ou qui te blesse" ), w, C_FAINT, min( 2, left ), noteH );
+		return;
+	}
+	if ( !it.damage )
+	{
+		TextWrap( x, y, L( it.note ), w, C_TEXT, min( 3, LinesFit( y, bottom, lh * 1.35f )), lh * 1.35f );
+		return;
+	}
+	if ( it.pellets > 1 )
+		snprintf( text, sizeof( text ), "%d x %d", (int)it.damage, it.pellets );
+	else
+		snprintf( text, sizeof( text ), "%d", (int)it.damage );
+	StatRow( x, y, w, L( "Damage", "D\xC3\xA9g\xC3\xA2ts" ), it.damage * it.pellets / 120.0f, text, C_RED );
+	y += row;
+	if ( it.cycle > 0 )
+	{
+		snprintf( text, sizeof( text ), L( "%d rpm", "%d coups/min" ), (int)( 60 / it.cycle + 0.5f ));
+		StatRow( x, y, w, L( "Fire rate", "Cadence" ), 60 / it.cycle / 900.0f, text, C_GOLD );
+		y += row;
+	}
+	if ( it.armor > 0 && it.speed > 0 )
+	{
+		float pen = min( 1.0f, it.armor * 0.5f );
+		snprintf( text, sizeof( text ), "%d%%", (int)( pen * 100 + 0.5f ));
+		StatRow( x, y, w, L( "Armor piercing", "Perforation" ), pen, text, C_CTCOL );
+		y += row;
+	}
+	if ( it.range > 0 )
+	{
+		float kept = it.range * it.range; // (damage kept at 1000 units)
+		snprintf( text, sizeof( text ), "%d%%", (int)( kept * 100 + 0.5f ));
+		StatRow( x, y, w, L( "Range", "Port\xC3\xA9" "e" ), kept, text, C_GREEN );
+		y += row;
+	}
+	if ( it.speed > 0 )
+	{
+		snprintf( text, sizeof( text ), "%d", (int)it.speed );
+		StatRow( x, y, w, L( "Mobility", "Mobilit\xC3\xA9" ), ( it.speed - 180 ) / 80.0f, text, C_TEXT );
+		y += row;
+	}
+	if ( it.clip > 0 || it.reserve > 0 )
+	{
+		if ( it.clip > 0 )
+			snprintf( text, sizeof( text ), "%d / %d", it.clip, it.reserve );
+		else
+			snprintf( text, sizeof( text ), "%d", it.reserve );
+		Text( x, y, it.clip > 0 ? L( "Magazine", "Chargeur" ) : L( "Carried", "En r\xC3\xA9serve" ), C_DIM );
+		TextRight( x + w, y, text, C_TEXT );
+		y += row;
+	}
+	TextWrap( x, y + 2, L( it.note ), w, C_FAINT, min( 2, LinesFit( y + 2, bottom, lh * 1.25f )), lh * 1.25f );
+}
+
+// the buy panel: the categories, their items, the hovered one turning with its figures
+static void DrawBuy( void )
+{
+	float fade = Fade();
+	float sw = ScreenWidth, sh = ScreenHeight;
+	int lh = LineHeight();
+	float W = min( 1120.0f, sw - 40 ), H = min( 640.0f, sh - 40 );
+	float x0 = (int)( sw - W ) / 2, y0 = (int)( sh - H ) / 2;
+	float headH = lh * 3.4f, footH = lh * 3.0f;
+	float tabsW = min( 200.0f, W * 0.2f ), listW = min( 380.0f, W * 0.36f );
+	float bodyY = y0 + headH, bodyH = H - headH - footH;
+	float dx = x0 + tabsW + listW, dw = W - tabsW - listW;
+	float px = dx + 1, py = bodyY + 1, pw = dw - 2, ph = bodyH * 0.46f; // (the model's hole)
+	int money = gHUD.m_Money.Money();
+
+	// panel, its hole
+	BackdropAdd( px, py, pw, ph, Alpha( C_PANEL, fade ));
+	Grad( px, py + ph * 0.6f, pw, ph * 0.4f, Alpha( C_GOLD, 0 ), Alpha( C_GOLD, 0.07f * fade ));
+	FillAround( x0, y0, W, H, px, py, pw, ph, Alpha( C_PANEL, fade ));
+	Grad( x0, y0, W, headH, Alpha( C_PANEL2, fade ), Alpha( C_PANEL, fade ));
+	Fill( x0, y0 + headH - 1, W, 1, Alpha( C_LINE, fade ));
+	Fill( x0, y0 + H - footH, W, 1, Alpha( C_LINE, fade ));
+	Fill( x0 + tabsW, bodyY, 1, bodyH, Alpha( C_SOFT, fade ));
+	Fill( dx, bodyY, 1, bodyH, Alpha( C_SOFT, fade ));
+	Frame( x0, y0, W, H, Alpha( C_LINE, fade ));
+	Fill( x0, y0, W, 2, Alpha( C_GOLD, fade ));
+
+	// header
+	float hy = y0 + ( headH - LineHeight( Scaled( 1.7f ) ? 1.7f : 1 )) / 2;
+	const char *buy = L( "BUY", "ACHAT" );
+	Text( x0 + 18, hy, buy, Alpha( C_GOLDT, fade ), 1.7f );
+	char sz[48];
+	snprintf( sz, sizeof( sz ), "$ %d", money );
+	TextRight( x0 + W - 18, hy, sz, Alpha( C_GREEN, fade ), 1.7f );
+	const float subX = x0 + 22 + TextW( buy, 1.7f ) + 10;
+	TextFit( subX, hy + LineHeight( Scaled( 1.7f ) ? 1.7f : 1 ) - lh - 1, L( "Anywhere, anytime  -  B, Esc or right click closes",
+		"Partout, \xC3\xA0 tout moment  -  B, \xC3\x89" "chap ou clic droit pour fermer" ), x0 + W - 18 - TextW( sz, 1.7f ) - 20 - subX, Alpha( C_DIM, fade ));
+
+	// tabs
+	float ty = bodyY + 8, tabH = min( lh * 2.25f, ( bodyH - 16 ) / NUM_TABS - 2 ); // (ten: fitted to a short screen)
+	for ( int t = 0; t < NUM_TABS; t++ )
+	{
+		int items[16], n = TabItems( t, items );
+		bool sel = t == g_iTab, hover = Hover( x0, ty, tabsW, tabH );
+		if ( sel || hover )
+			Fill( x0 + 1, ty, tabsW - 1, tabH, sel ? C_SEL : C_HOVER );
+		if ( sel )
+			Fill( x0 + 1, ty, 3, tabH, C_GOLD );
+		char key[4];
+		snprintf( key, sizeof( key ), "%d", ( t + 1 ) % 10 ); // (the tenth: 0)
+		KeyBadge( x0 + 14, ty + ( tabH - lh ) / 2, key, sel && g_iKeyLevel == 0 );
+		snprintf( key, sizeof( key ), "%d", n );
+		TextFit( x0 + 40, ty + ( tabH - lh ) / 2, L( g_Tabs[t].title ), tabsW - 40 - 12 - TextWidth( key ) - 6, Alpha( sel ? C_GOLDT : hover ? C_TEXT : C_DIM, fade ));
+		TextRight( x0 + tabsW - 12, ty + ( tabH - lh ) / 2, key, Alpha( C_FAINT, fade ));
+		if ( Clicked( x0, ty, tabsW, tabH ) && t != g_iTab )
+		{
+			g_iTab = t;
+			g_iFocus = -1;
+			g_iKeyLevel = 1;
+		}
+		ty += tabH + 2;
+	}
+
+	// items
+	int items[16], n = TabItems( g_iTab, items );
+	float lx = x0 + tabsW + 1, ly = bodyY + 8, rowH = lh * 2.4f;
+	TextFit( lx + 14, ly + 2, L( g_Tabs[g_iTab].menuTitle ), listW - 28, Alpha( C_GOLDT, fade ));
+	ly += lh * 1.8f;
+	int hovered = -1;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < n; i++ )
+	{
+		const BuyItem &it = g_Items[items[i]];
+		bool hover = Hover( lx, ly, listW - 1, rowH );
+		bool focus = items[i] == g_iFocus;
+		bool refused = Refused( it ) || Full( it ), afford = !refused && Price( it ) <= money, owned = Owned( it.id ) || Full( it );
+		if ( hover )
+			hovered = items[i];
+		float flash = items[i] == g_iFlashItem ? Clamp01( 1 - ( Now() - g_flFlash ) / 0.5f ) : 0;
+		Fill( lx + 6, ly + 1, listW - 13, rowH - 2, ( hover || focus ) ? C_HOVER : C_ROW );
+		if ( flash > 0 )
+			Fill( lx + 6, ly + 1, listW - 13, rowH - 2, Alpha( g_bFlashBad ? C_RED : C_GREEN, flash * 0.35f ));
+		if ( hover || focus )
+			Fill( lx + 6, ly + 1, 2, rowH - 2, C_GOLD );
+		char key[4];
+		snprintf( key, sizeof( key ), "%d", i + 1 );
+		float cy = ly + ( rowH - lh ) / 2;
+		KeyBadge( lx + 16, cy, key, ( hover || focus ) && g_iKeyLevel == 1 );
+		// (red only for the money; refused for another reason: dimmed, with why in a word)
+		snprintf( sz, sizeof( sz ), "$%d", Price( it ));
+		TextRight( lx + listW - 18, cy, sz, Alpha( afford ? C_GREEN : refused ? C_DIM : C_RED, fade ));
+		const char *tag = ( refused || owned ) ? RefusalTag( it ) : 0;
+		float nameRight = lx + listW - 26 - TextWidth( sz );
+		if ( tag )
+		{
+			TextRight( nameRight, cy, tag, Alpha( CompanionOut( it ) ? C_GOLD : C_DIM, fade ));
+			nameRight -= TextWidth( tag ) + 10;
+		}
+		TextFit( lx + 42, cy, L( it.name ), nameRight - lx - 42, Alpha( afford ? (( hover || focus ) ? C_GOLDT : C_TEXT ) : refused ? C_DIM : C_FAINT, fade ));
+		if ( hover && g_bClick )
+			Buy( items[i] );
+		ly += rowH + 3;
+	}
+	if ( hovered >= 0 && hovered != g_iHover )
+	{
+		g_iHover = hovered;
+		g_flHoverSince = Now();
+		g_flDragYaw = 0;
+	}
+	int shown = hovered >= 0 ? hovered : g_iFocus >= 0 ? g_iFocus : ( g_iHover >= 0 && g_iHover >= g_Tabs[g_iTab].first && g_iHover < g_Tabs[g_iTab].first + g_Tabs[g_iTab].count ) ? g_iHover : ( n ? items[0] : -1 );
+
+	// the shown item: its model, its figures
+	if ( shown >= 0 )
+	{
+		const BuyItem &it = g_Items[shown];
+		if ( it.model[0] )
+			PreviewAdd( 0, it.model, px + 10, py + 10, pw - 20, ph - 20, it.pose, 0 );
+		else
+			TextCenter( px + pw / 2, py + ph / 2 - lh / 2, L( "no model to show", "aucun mod\xC3\xA8le \xC3\xA0 afficher" ), Alpha( C_FAINT, fade ));
+		if ( Hover( px, py, pw, ph ))
+			TextRight( px + pw - 10, py + ph - lh - 8, L( "drag to turn", "glisser pour tourner" ), Alpha( C_FAINT, fade ));
+		float ix = dx + 22, iy = py + ph + 12, iw = dw - 44;
+		Text( ix, iy, L( it.name ), Alpha( C_GOLDT, fade ), 1.45f );
+		snprintf( sz, sizeof( sz ), "$%d", Price( it ));
+		bool refused = Refused( it ) || Full( it ), afford = !refused && Price( it ) <= money;
+		TextRight( ix + iw, iy, sz, Alpha( afford ? C_GREEN : refused ? C_DIM : C_RED, fade ), 1.45f );
+		iy += LineHeight( Scaled( 1.45f ) ? 1.45f : 1 ) + 4;
+		// (its kind and the side it is for: on one line, or two when that is too long)
+		const char *side = it.team == ONLY_T ? L( "Terrorists only", "Terroristes uniquement" ) :
+			it.team == ONLY_CT ? L( "Counter-Terrorists only", "Anti-terroristes uniquement" ) : NULL;
+		char kind[160];
+		snprintf( kind, sizeof( kind ), "%s%s%s", L( it.kind ), side ? "  -  " : "", side ? side : "" );
+		if ( side && TextWidth( kind ) > iw )
+		{
+			TextFit( ix, iy, L( it.kind ), iw, Alpha( C_DIM, fade ));
+			iy += lh * 1.25f;
+			TextFit( ix, iy, side, iw, Alpha( C_DIM, fade ));
+		}
+		else
+			TextFit( ix, iy, kind, iw, Alpha( C_DIM, fade ));
+		iy += lh * 1.9f;
+		ItemFigures( ix, iy, iw, y0 + H - footH - 4, it );
+	}
