+	// footer: ammo, close
+	float fy = y0 + H - footH + ( footH - lh * 2.1f ) / 2, bh = lh * 2.1f;
+	// (the buttons as wide as their labels need, at least their usual widths)
+	const char *prim = L( "Primary ammo", "Munitions principales" ), *sec = L( "Secondary ammo", "Munitions secondaires" ), *close = L( "Close", "Fermer" );
+	const float pw1 = max( 190.0f, TextWidth( prim ) + TextWidth( "," ) + 46.0f ), pw2 = max( 200.0f, TextWidth( sec ) + TextWidth( "." ) + 46.0f );
+	const float cw1 = max( 130.0f, TextWidth( close ) + TextWidth( "B" ) + 46.0f );
+	float bx = x0 + 14;
+	if ( Button( bx, fy, pw1, bh, ",", prim, true, C_GOLD ))
+		ClientCmd( "primammo" );
+	bx += pw1 + 10;
+	if ( Button( bx, fy, pw2, bh, ".", sec, true, C_GOLD ))
+		ClientCmd( "secammo" );
+	if ( Button( x0 + W - 14 - cw1, fy, cw1, bh, "B", close, true, C_GOLD ))
+		Close();
+
+	// (the keys, or why a purchase failed: the server's word when it sent one, else what it would say; a centre
+	// message of the server that came while the panel is open — on two lines when one is not enough)
+	const float noteRight = x0 + W - 14 - cw1 - 16, noteLeft = bx + pw2 + 14, noteW = noteRight - noteLeft;
+	const char *note = NULL; Col noteCol = C_FAINT;
+	char hint[96];
+	if ( g_flNote >= 0 && Now() >= g_flNote && Now() - g_flNote < 2.5f && g_szNote[0] )
+	{
+		note = g_szNote;
+		noteCol = g_bNoteBad ? C_RED : C_GOLDT;
+	}
+	else if ( g_iFlashItem >= 0 && g_bFlashBad && Now() - g_flFlash < 1.5f )
+	{
+		note = RefusalText( g_Items[g_iFlashItem] );
+		noteCol = C_RED;
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		// (the hint, shorter when the whole one does not fit)
+		const int keys = min( max( n, 1 ), 9 );
+		for ( int shorter = 0; shorter < 2; shorter++ )
+		{
+			const char *more = shorter ? "" : L( "    wheel, arrows: category", "    molette, fl\xC3\xA8" "ches : cat\xC3\xA9gorie" );
+			if ( g_iKeyLevel )
+				snprintf( hint, sizeof( hint ), n > 1 ? L( "1-%d: buy    0: categories%s", "1-%d : acheter    0 : cat\xC3\xA9gories%s" ) : L( "%d: buy    0: categories%s", "%d : acheter    0 : cat\xC3\xA9gories%s" ), keys, more );
+			else if ( NUM_TABS >= 10 )
+				snprintf( hint, sizeof( hint ), L( "1-9, 0 category%s", "1-9, 0 cat\xC3\xA9gorie%s" ), more );
+			else
+				snprintf( hint, sizeof( hint ), L( "1-%d category%s", "1-%d cat\xC3\xA9gorie%s" ), NUM_TABS, more );
+			if ( TextWidth( hint ) <= noteW )

+		}
+		note = hint;
+		noteCol = Alpha( C_FAINT, fade );
+	}
+	if ( note && noteW > 0 )
+	{
+		char lines[2][WRAP_LEN];
+		const int nl = WrapLines( note, noteW, lines, 2 );
+		const float lineH = lh * 1.1f, top = fy + ( bh - lh - ( nl - 1 ) * lineH ) / 2;
+		for ( int i = 0; i < nl; i++ )
+			TextRight( noteRight, top + i * lineH, lines[i], noteCol );
+	}

+	// dragging the model turns it
+	if ( g_bMouseDown && ( g_bDragging || Hover( px, py, pw, ph )))
+	{
+		if ( g_bDragging )
+			g_flDragYaw += ( g_cx - g_flDragLastX ) * 0.02f;
+		g_bDragging = true;
+		g_flDragLastX = g_cx;
+	}
+	else
+		g_bDragging = false;
+}

+static void NumberKey( int key )
+{
+	if ( g_iPanel == P_TEAM )
+	{
+		if ( key == 10 && Allowed( 10 ))
+			Close();
+		else if ( key >= 1 && key <= 6 && key != 4 && Allowed( key ))
+		{
+			Command( "jointeam %d", key );
+			Close();
+		}
+	}
+	else if ( g_iPanel == P_CLASS )
+	{
+		if ( Allowed( key ))
+		{
+			Command( "joinclass %d", key ); // (0: 10, a look at random)
+			Close();
+		}
+	}
+	else if ( g_iPanel == P_BUY )
+	{
+		// (0: back to the categories from the items; among the categories, the tenth — B, Esc, a right click close)
+		if ( key == 10 && g_iKeyLevel == 1 )
+		{
+			g_iKeyLevel = 0;
+			return;
+		}
+		if ( key == 10 && NUM_TABS < 10 )
+		{
+			Close();
+			return;
+		}
+		if ( g_iKeyLevel == 0 )
+		{
+			if ( key <= NUM_TABS )
+			{
+				g_iTab = key - 1;
+				g_iKeyLevel = 1;
+				g_iFocus = -1;
+			}
+			return;
+		}
+		int items[16], n = TabItems( g_iTab, items );
+		if ( key <= n )
+		{
+			g_iFocus = items[key - 1];
+			Buy( items[key - 1] );
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+static bool PanelKey( int down, int keynum, const char *pszCurrentBinding, bool repeat );
+static bool EngineKeyDown( int keynum, const char *pszCurrentBinding, bool repeat );
+
+bool ArsUI_Key( int down, int keynum, const char *pszCurrentBinding )
+{
+	bool repeat = false;
+	if ( keynum >= 0 && keynum < 256 )
+	{
+		repeat = down && g_bHeld[keynum];
+		g_bHeld[keynum] = !!down;
+	}
+	// (build mode's keys, no panel open — the releases of those it took, whatever)
+	if ( down && !repeat )
+		BuildKeyPressed( keynum );
+	if (( !down || g_iPanel == P_NONE ) && BuildKey( down, keynum, pszCurrentBinding ? pszCurrentBinding : "", repeat ))
+		return true;
+	if ( PanelKey( down, keynum, pszCurrentBinding, repeat ))
+		return true;
+	if ( down && keynum >= 0 && keynum < 256 )
+		return EngineKeyDown( keynum, pszCurrentBinding, repeat );
+	return false;
+}
+
+// A press the client did not take: the engine passes its release on only for a press the client took (key_game,
+// keys[].gamedown) — so, declined, B's "buy" opening the shop would leave B held here, its next press (closing the
+// shop) seen as an auto-repeat and swallowed. A binding of commands run on the press only (no +button) is run here,
+// as the engine would (Key_AddKeyCommands: Cbuf, the press only, its auto-repeats ignored), and the press taken: its
+// release comes back. The others (+buttons, the keys the engine handles itself or repeats): left to the engine, the
+// key forgotten (its release will not come).
+static bool EngineKeyDown( int keynum, const char *pszCurrentBinding, bool repeat )
+{
+	const char *b = pszCurrentBinding;
+	const bool own = keynum == K_ESCAPE || keynum == '`' || keynum == '~' || keynum == K_BACKSPACE || keynum == K_PAUSE
+		|| keynum == K_PGUP || keynum == K_KP_PGUP || keynum == K_PGDN || keynum == K_KP_PGDN;
+	if ( own || !b || !b[0] || strchr( b, '+' ))
+	{
+		g_bHeld[keynum] = false;
+		return false;
+	}
+	if ( !repeat )
+		ClientCmd( (char *)b );
+	return true;
+}
+
+static bool PanelKey( int down, int keynum, const char *pszCurrentBinding, bool repeat )
+{
+	if ( g_iPanel == P_NONE || !down )
+		return false; // (releases reach the game: a key held as the panel opened)
+	const char *b = pszCurrentBinding ? pszCurrentBinding : "";
+	if ( keynum == K_MWHEELUP || keynum == K_MWHEELDOWN || ( g_iPanel == P_BUY && ( keynum == K_LEFTARROW || keynum == K_RIGHTARROW || keynum == K_UPARROW || keynum == K_DOWNARROW )))
+	{
+		if ( g_iPanel == P_BUY )
+		{
+			int step = ( keynum == K_MWHEELUP || keynum == K_LEFTARROW || keynum == K_UPARROW ) ? -1 : 1;
+			g_iTab = ( g_iTab + step + NUM_TABS ) % NUM_TABS;
+			g_iFocus = -1;
+			g_iKeyLevel = 1;
+		}
+		return true;
+	}
+	if ( keynum == K_ESCAPE )
+	{
+		if ( repeat )
+			return true;
+		if ( g_iPanel == P_BUY || ( g_iPanel == P_TEAM && Allowed( 10 )))
+		{
+			Close();
+			return true;
+		}
+		// (the engine's menu opens: the mouse is its own until the game is back)
+		Mouse( false );
+		g_bSuspended = true;
+		memset( g_bHeld, 0, sizeof( g_bHeld )); // (the keys released in the engine's menu: their releases are its own)
+		return false;
+	}
+	if ( keynum >= '0' && keynum <= '9' )
+	{
+		if ( !repeat )
+			NumberKey( keynum == '0' ? 10 : keynum - '0' );
+		return true;
+	}
+	if ( keynum == K_BACKSPACE && g_iPanel == P_BUY )
+	{
+		g_iKeyLevel = 0;
+		return true;
+	}
+	if ( g_iPanel == P_BUY && ( !strcmp( b, "buy" ) || !strcmp( b, "buymenu" ) || !strcmp( b, "client_buy_open" )))
+	{
+		if ( !repeat )
+			Close();
+		return true;
+	}
+	if ( g_iPanel == P_TEAM && !strcmp( b, "chooseteam" ) && Allowed( 10 ))
+	{
+		if ( !repeat )
+			Close();
+		return true;
+	}
+	return false;
+}

+// the engine's key state cleared (the window's focus lost)
+void ArsUI_ClearStates( void ) { BuildKeysLost(); }
+
+// The engine's mouse callbacks (the client's IN_ActivateMouse / IN_DeactivateMouse): the game has the mouse again
+void ArsUI_EngineMouse( bool active )
+{
+	if ( !active )
+		BuildKeysLost(); // (the engine's menu, the console, the chat: the keys are no longer the game's)
+	if ( !g_bInMouse && active )
+	{
+		g_bSuspended = false;
+		memset( g_bHeld, 0, sizeof( g_bHeld )); // (back from the engine's menu or console: what was released there)
+	}
+}
+
+// A press of the mouse while the touch screen's client-only mode is on: finger 0 the left button, 1 the others
+bool ArsUI_Touch( int type, int finger )
+{
+	if ( !g_bTouch )
+		return false;
+	if ( finger == 0 )
+	{
+		if ( type == 0 )
+			ClickDown();
+		else if ( type == 1 )
+			ClickUp();
+	}
+	else if ( finger == 1 && type == 0 && ( g_iPanel == P_BUY || ( g_iPanel == P_TEAM && Allowed( 10 ))))
+		Close(); // (a right click closes what may be closed)
+	return true;
+}

+bool ArsUI_ShowVGUIMenu( int menuType, int bitsValidSlots )
+{
+	switch ( menuType )
+	{
+	case VGUI_TEAM:
+		Open( P_TEAM, bitsValidSlots );
+		return true;
+	case VGUI_CLASS_T:
+	case VGUI_CLASS_CT:
+		Open( P_CLASS, bitsValidSlots );
+		g_iClassTeam = menuType == VGUI_CLASS_CT;
+		return true;
+	case VGUI_BUY:
+	case VGUI_BUY_PISTOL:
+	case VGUI_BUY_SHOTGUN:
+	case VGUI_BUY_RIFLE:
+	case VGUI_BUY_SMG:
+	case VGUI_BUY_MG:
+	case VGUI_BUY_ITEM:
+		if ( g_iPanel != P_BUY )
+			Open( P_BUY, bitsValidSlots );
+		for ( int t = 0; t < NUM_TABS; t++ )
+			if ( g_Tabs[t].vgui == menuType )
+			{
+				g_iTab = t;
+				g_iKeyLevel = 1;
+			}
+		return true;
+	}
+	return false;
+}

+// (the look panel, when the look was chosen elsewhere — the console: closed once the player is alive in the game after
+// a HUD reset; the game also resets it as a player connects and on a round restart, the player then still watching)
+void ArsUI_Spawned( void )
+{
+	g_flSpawned = Now();
+	// (the server sends its live Pokemon again right after each HUD reset: those it does not are gone)
+	for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_POKEMON; i++ )
+		if ( g_Pokemon[i].ent && g_Pokemon[i].gone < 0 )
+			g_Pokemon[i].stale = g_flSpawned;
+	g_flBallThrown = -1;
+	g_flHackStart = -1; // (a scramble does not outlive its victim)
+	BuildSpawned();
+}
+
+// The server's centre messages while the buy panel is open (a purchase refused: "You have insufficient funds!"...):
+// in the panel's footer, the item just bought flashed red, instead of over the panel
+static char g_szCenter[192]; static float g_flCenter = -1;
+static void DrawCenterMessage( void );
+
+bool ArsUI_CenterPrint( const char *text )
+{
+	if ( !text )
+		return false;
+	if ( g_iPanel != P_BUY )
+	{
+		// (a message with letters the engine's font lacks — the mod's own, in French: drawn here, where the engine's go;
+		// any other, Counter-Strike's included — a player's name in Cyrillic...: left to the engine, as it was)
+		bool latin = false;
+		for ( const unsigned char *c = (const unsigned char *)text; *c; )
+		{
+			if ( *c < 0x80 )
+			{
+				c++;
+				continue;
+			}
+			const int n = LatinSeq( c );
+			if ( !n )
+				return false;
+			latin = true;
+			c += n;
+		}
+		if ( !latin )
+			return false;
+		strncpy( g_szCenter, text, sizeof( g_szCenter ) - 1 );
+		g_szCenter[sizeof( g_szCenter ) - 1] = 0;
+		g_flCenter = Now();
+		return true;
+	}
+	// (on one line, trimmed)
+	int n = 0;
+	for ( const char *c = text; *c && n < (int)sizeof( g_szNote ) - 1; c++ )
+	{
+		const char ch = ( *c == '\n' || *c == '\r' || *c == '\t' ) ? ' ' : *c;
+		if ( ch == ' ' && ( !n || g_szNote[n - 1] == ' ' ))
+			continue;
+		g_szNote[n++] = ch;
+	}
+	while ( n > 0 && g_szNote[n - 1] == ' ' )
+		n--;
+	g_szNote[n] = 0;
+	if ( !n )
+		return true;
+	const float now = Now();
+	g_flNote = now;
+	g_bNoteBad = g_iFlashItem >= 0 && now >= g_flFlash && now - g_flFlash < 1.5f; // (the answer to a purchase)
+	if ( g_bNoteBad && !g_bFlashBad ) // (refused for a reason the panel did not see: flashed red after all)
+	{
+		g_bFlashBad = true;
+		g_flFlash = now;
+	}
+	return true;
+}
+
+void ArsUI_CloseBuy( void )
+{
+	if ( g_iPanel == P_BUY )
+		Close();
+}
+
+void ArsUI_Draw( float flTime, bool intermission )
+{
+	// (what was drawn this frame is what the next one renders)
+	for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_PREVIEWS; i++ )
+		g_bPreviewUsed[i] = false;
+	g_iBackdropsNext = 0;
+
+	// (dead: the death camera, not the shop)
+	if ( g_iPanel == P_BUY && ( gHUD.m_Health.m_iHealth <= 0 || g_iUser1 || LocalTeam() == 0 || intermission ))
+		Close();
+	if ( g_flSpawned >= 0 && ( Now() < g_flSpawned || Now() - g_flSpawned > 1.5f ))
+		g_flSpawned = -1;
+	else if ( g_flSpawned >= 0 && g_iPanel == P_CLASS && gHUD.m_Health.m_iHealth > 0 && !g_iUser1 && LocalTeam() != 0 )
+	{
+		g_flSpawned = -1;
+		Close();
+	}
+	if ( g_iPanel != P_NONE && !g_bTouch && !g_bSuspended )
+		Mouse( true );
+
+	if ( g_iPanel != P_NONE )
+	{
+		int mx = 0, my = 0;
+		gEngfuncs.GetMousePosition( &mx, &my );
+		g_cx = mx / gHUD.m_flScale;
+		g_cy = my / gHUD.m_flScale;
+	}
+
+	// (Half Strike's build bar, or the brick count; a level of its own: what the last one said forgotten)
+	{
+		static char s_szLevel[64];
+		const char *level = gEngfuncs.pfnGetLevelName();
+		if ( level && strcmp( level, s_szLevel ))
+		{
+			strncpy( s_szLevel, level, sizeof( s_szLevel ) - 1 );
+			BuildNewLevel();
+		}
+	}
+	BuildDrawHud( Now(), intermission );
+
+	switch ( g_iPanel )
+	{
+	case P_TEAM: DrawTeam(); break;
+	case P_CLASS: DrawClass(); break;
+	case P_BUY: DrawBuy(); break;
+	}
+	DrawCenterMessage();
+	FlushShapes();
+	FlushTexts();
+	g_bClick = false;
+
+	// (a panel closed by a click of this frame: nothing of it in the next one)
+	if ( g_iPanel == P_NONE )
+	{
+		memset( g_bPreviewUsed, 0, sizeof( g_bPreviewUsed ));
+		g_iBackdropsNext = 0;
+	}
+	for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_PREVIEWS; i++ )
+	{
+		g_Previews[i].active = g_bPreviewUsed[i];
+		if ( !g_bPreviewUsed[i] )
+			g_Previews[i].name[0] = 0;
+	}
+	memcpy( g_Backdrops, g_BackdropsNext, sizeof( g_Backdrops ));
+	g_iBackdrops = g_iBackdropsNext;
+}
+
+// a centre message drawn by the mod (ArsUI_CenterPrint): its lines centred, as the engine's, for a moment
+static void DrawCenterMessage( void )
+{
+	const float now = Now(), t = now - g_flCenter;
+	if ( g_flCenter < 0 || t < 0 || t > 2.5f || !g_szCenter[0] )
+	{
+		g_flCenter = -1;
+		return;
+	}
+	const int lh = LineHeight();
+	const Col c = Alpha( C_WHITE, 1 - Clamp01(( t - 2.0f ) / 0.5f ));
+	float y = ScreenHeight / 3; // (the engine's own centre messages' height)
+	for ( const char *p = g_szCenter; *p; )
+	{
+		char line[WRAP_LEN];
+		int len = 0;
+		while ( p[len] && p[len] != '\n' )
+			len++;
+		const int n = CutAt( p, min( len, WRAP_LEN - 1 ));
+		memcpy( line, p, n );
+		line[n] = 0;
+		y += TextWrap( ScreenWidth / 2, y, line, ScreenWidth - 40, c, 3, lh * 1.2f, 2 ) * lh * 1.2f;
+		p += len;
+		if ( *p == '\n' )
+			p++;
+	}
+}
+
+// the server's text menus: a panel on the left, its title in gold, its keys as badges
+bool ArsUI_DrawTextMenu( const char *pszMenu )
+{
+	if ( g_iPanel != P_NONE )
+		return true;
+	char lines[24][128];
+	int n = 0;
+	for ( const char *p = pszMenu; *p && n < 24; )
+	{
+		int len = 0;
+		while ( p[len] && p[len] != '\n' )
+			len++;
+		int copy = min( len, 127 );
+		memcpy( lines[n], p, copy );
+		lines[n][copy] = 0;
+		n++;
+		p += len;
+		if ( *p == '\n' )
+			p++;
+	}
+	while ( n > 0 && !lines[n - 1][0] )
+		n--;
+	if ( !n )
+		return true;
+	int lh = LineHeight(), rowH = (int)( lh * 1.55f );
+	float w = 0;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < n; i++ )
+		w = max( w, (float)TextWidth( lines[i] ));
+	w = max( w + 70, 240.0f );
+	float h = n * rowH + 24;
+	float x = 18, y = ScreenHeight / 2 - h / 2 - 30;
+	Fill( x, y, w, h, Alpha( C_PANEL, 0.86f ));
+	Fill( x, y, 3, h, C_GOLD );
+	Frame( x, y, w, h, C_SOFT );
+	float ty = y + 12;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < n; i++ )
+	{
+		const char *s = lines[i];
+		Col c = i == 0 ? C_GOLDT : C_TEXT;
+		// (codes of a whole line: \y title, \w normal, \d disabled, \r red)
+		while ( s[0] == '\\' && s[1] )
+		{
+			if ( s[1] == 'y' ) c = C_GOLDT;
+			else if ( s[1] == 'w' ) c = C_TEXT;
+			else if ( s[1] == 'd' ) c = C_FAINT;
+			else if ( s[1] == 'r' ) c = C_RED;
+			else break;
+			s += 2;
+		}
+		if ( s[0] >= '0' && s[0] <= '9' && s[1] == '.' )
+		{
+			char key[2] = { s[0], 0 };
+			KeyBadge( x + 14, ty + ( rowH - lh ) / 2, key, false );
+			s += 2;
+			while ( *s == ' ' )
+				s++;
+			TextClip( x + 40, ty + ( rowH - lh ) / 2, x + w - 10, s, c );
+		}
+		else if ( s[0] )
+			TextClip( x + 14, ty + ( rowH - lh ) / 2, x + w - 10, s, c );
+		if ( i == 0 && n > 1 )
+			Fill( x + 14, ty + rowH - 2, w - 28, 1, C_LINE );
+		ty += rowH;
+	}
+	FlushShapes();
+	FlushTexts();
+	return true;
+}
+
+//
+// Half Strike's Pokemon: a health bar over each one in sight
+//
+#define POKE_BAR_RANGE 1500.0f // (further: hidden)
+#define POKE_BAR_FADE 400.0f   // (fading out over the last of it)
+#define POKE_MIN_AMBIENT 32     // (a Pokemon's light in the darkest shade: its unlit side...)
+#define POKE_MIN_SHADE 64       // (...and its lit side over it)
+#define POKE_BAR_LIFT 3.0f     // (over its model's top, in units: the same for all)
+#define LEM_BAR_AFTER 0.55f    // (Le M's bar shown once he is past his hologram: the server's LEM_HOLO_END)
+#define POKE_BAR_GAP 6.0f      // (and that far on the screen)
+
+// whether the point is seen from the view: the world and the brush entities in between (not the studio models — the
+// Pokemon itself, players —, not glass)
+static bool SeenFromView( const float *point )
+{
+	pmtrace_t tr;
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PlayerTrace( g_vViewOrg, (float *)point, PM_STUDIO_IGNORE | PM_GLASS_IGNORE, -1, &tr );
+	return tr.fraction >= 0.99f || ( !tr.startsolid && fabs( tr.endpos[0] - point[0] ) + fabs( tr.endpos[1] - point[1] ) + fabs( tr.endpos[2] - point[2] ) < 4 );
+}
+
+static float Approach( float v, float target, float speed, float dt )
+{
+	if ( v < target ) return min( target, v + speed * dt );
+	return max( target, v - speed * dt );
+}
+
+struct BarDraw
+{
+	Pokemon *p;
+	float sx, sy, dist, alpha, size; // (sy: the bar's bottom)
+	char owner[48];                  // (its player's name, cut to fit)
+	float wName, wOwner, total;      // (the label's widths)
+	float bw, bh, halfW, above;      // (the bar's size; its box around sx and above sy, the label included)
+};
+
+#define POKE_BAR_SMALL 0.78f // (the owner's name)
+#define POKE_BAR_EDGE 4.0f   // (kept that far inside the screen's edges)
+
+// the bar's and its label's sizes
+static void BarLayout( BarDraw &d )
+{
+	const Pokemon &p = *d.p;
+	const float k = d.size;
+	d.owner[0] = 0;
+	if ( p.owner > 0 && p.owner <= MAX_PLAYERS && g_PlayerInfoList[p.owner].name )
+	{
+		strncpy( d.owner, g_PlayerInfoList[p.owner].name, sizeof( d.owner ) - 1 );
+		d.owner[sizeof( d.owner ) - 1] = 0;
+		for ( int len = strlen( d.owner ); len > 3 && TextW( d.owner, POKE_BAR_SMALL ) > 110; len-- ) // (a long name cut)
+			strcpy( d.owner + len - 3, ".." );
+	}
+	const float gap = 5, dot = 3;
+	d.wName = TextWidth( L( g_Species[p.species].name ));
+	d.wOwner = d.owner[0] ? TextW( d.owner, POKE_BAR_SMALL ) : 0;
+	d.total = d.wName + ( d.wOwner > 0 ? gap * 2 + dot + d.wOwner : 0 );
+	d.bw = 72 * k;
+	d.bh = max( 4.0f, 7 * k );
+	d.halfW = max( d.bw / 2 + 2, d.total / 2 );
+	d.above = d.bh + 3 + LineHeight();
+}
+
+// the radar's box on the screen (HUD units), when it is drawn: false otherwise
+static bool RadarBox( float *w, float *h )
+{
+	if ( !( gHUD.m_Radar.m_iFlags & HUD_DRAW ) || ( gHUD.m_iHideHUDDisplay & HIDEHUD_HEALTH ) ||
+		gEngfuncs.IsSpectateOnly() || !( gHUD.m_iWeaponBits & ( 1 << WEAPON_SUIT )) || gHUD.m_fPlayerDead )
+		return false;
+	const wrect_t &r = gHUD.m_Radar.m_hRadarOpaque.rect;
+	*w = r.right - r.left;
+	*h = r.bottom - r.top;
+	return *w > 0 && *h > 0;
+}
+
+static void DrawPokemonBar( const BarDraw &d, float now )
+{
+	const Pokemon &p = *d.p;
+	const float k = d.size, a = d.alpha;
+	const int me = LocalIndex(), myTeam = LocalTeam();
+	const bool own = p.owner == me && me > 0;
+	Col c;
+	if ( own || ( p.team && p.team == myTeam && ( myTeam == TEAM_TERRORIST || myTeam == TEAM_CT )))
+		c = C_GREEN; // (one's own, whatever the team known: a teammate's)
+	else if ( g_iUser1 || myTeam == TEAM_SPECTATOR ) // (a spectator: the sides' colours)
+		c = p.team == TEAM_TERRORIST ? C_TCOL : p.team == TEAM_CT ? C_CTCOL : C_TEXT;
+	else if ( myTeam == TEAM_TERRORIST || myTeam == TEAM_CT )
+		c = C_RED;
+	else
+		c = C_TEXT; // (one's team not known yet: neither friend nor foe)
+
+	const float bw = d.bw, bh = d.bh;
+	const float x = (int)( d.sx - bw / 2 ), y = (int)( d.sy - bh );
+	// (the backing and its shadow)
+	Fill( x - 2, y - 2, bw + 4, bh + 4, Alpha( C_SHADE, a * 0.85f ));
+	Fill( x, y, bw, bh, Alpha( C_PANEL2, a ));
+	// (the health just lost, then the health)
+	if ( p.trail > p.shown )
+		Fill( x + bw * p.shown, y, bw * ( p.trail - p.shown ), bh, Alpha( Mix( c, C_WHITE, 0.6f ), a * 0.75f ));
+	if ( p.shown > 0 )
+	{
+		Col fill = c;
+		if ( p.hp > 0 && p.hp < 0.3f ) // (low: a slow pulse)
+			fill = Mix( c, C_WHITE, 0.22f * ( 0.5f + 0.5f * sinf( now * 7.0f )));
+		Grad( x, y, bw * p.shown, bh, Alpha( Mix( fill, C_WHITE, 0.28f ), a ), Alpha( Mix( fill, C_SHADE, 0.18f ), a ));
+		Fill( x, y, bw * p.shown, max( 1.0f, bh * 0.18f ), Alpha( C_WHITE, a * 0.22f )); // (its gloss)
+	}
+	// (quarters)
+	for ( int q = 1; q < 4; q++ )
+		Fill( x + (int)( bw * q / 4 ), y, 1, bh, Alpha( C_SHADE, a * 0.55f ));
+	// (its frame: gold around one's own)
+	if ( own )
+		Frame( x - 2, y - 2, bw + 4, bh + 4, Alpha( C_GOLD, a ), max( 1.0f, 1.5f * k ));
+	else
+		Frame( x - 1, y - 1, bw + 2, bh + 2, Alpha( C_EDGE, a ));
+
+	// (its name, and its player's, small)
+	const int lh = LineHeight(), lhs = Scaled( POKE_BAR_SMALL ) ? LineHeight( POKE_BAR_SMALL ) : lh;
+	const float gap = 5, dot = 3;
+	float tx = (int)( d.sx - d.total / 2 ), ty = y - 3 - lh;
+	Text( tx, ty, L( g_Species[p.species].name ), Alpha( own ? C_GOLDT : C_TEXT, a ));
+	if ( d.wOwner > 0 )
+	{
+		float dx = tx + d.wName + gap;
+		Fill( dx, ty + lh * 0.55f - dot / 2, dot, dot, Alpha( C_DIM, a ));
+		Text( dx + dot + gap, ty + lh - lhs, d.owner, Alpha( C_DIM, a ), POKE_BAR_SMALL );
+	}
+}
+
+// the Pokemon's highest bone, each time its model is set up (its bar follows it down when it crouches, lies...)
+void ArsUI_StudioBones( cl_entity_t *ent, float bones[][3][4], int count )
+{
+	if ( !ent || ent->index <= 0 || count <= 0 || !ent->model || !CompanionModel( ent->model->name ))
+		return;
+	Pokemon *p = PokemonSlot( ent->index, false );
+	if ( !p )
+		return;
+	float top = bones[0][2][3];
+	for ( int i = 1; i < count; i++ )
+		top = max( top, bones[i][2][3] );
+	p->boneTop = top - ent->origin[2];
+	p->boneSeq = ent->curstate.sequence;
+	p->boneTime = Now();
+}
+
+// a Pokemon's light from the map, before it is set up: kept over a floor so that it reads in the shade (the map's light
+// there can be next to nothing — ambient 3, shade 25 under dust2's arches —, where its colours went black and only its
+// bar showed); full light, dynamic lights untouched
+void ArsUI_StudioLighting( cl_entity_t *ent, alight_t *lighting )
+{
+	if ( BuildGhostLighting( ent, lighting ))
+		return;
+	if ( !ent || !ent->model || !lighting || !CompanionModel( ent->model->name ) || strstr( ent->model->name, "pokeball" ))
+		return;
+	lighting->ambientlight = max( lighting->ambientlight, POKE_MIN_AMBIENT );
+	lighting->shadelight = max( lighting->shadelight, POKE_MIN_SHADE );
+}
+
+// the bar's height over the Pokemon's origin: its model's standing height (its idle sequence's box), lower while its
+// bones are (crouched coming out, lying dead), eased
+static float BarHeight( Pokemon &p, cl_entity_t *e, float now, float dt )
+{
+	float stand = g_Species[p.species].height;
+	studiohdr_t *hdr = (studiohdr_t *)IEngineStudio.Mod_Extradata( e->model );
+	if ( hdr && hdr->numseq > 0 )
+	{
+		const mstudioseqdesc_t *seq = (const mstudioseqdesc_t *)( (byte *)hdr + hdr->seqindex );
+		if ( seq[0].bbmax[2] > 4 && seq[0].bbmax[2] < 400 )
+			stand = seq[0].bbmax[2];
+	}
+	float target = stand;
+	if ( p.boneTime > 0 && now >= p.boneTime && now - p.boneTime < 0.5f )
+	{
+		// (standing — idle, sequence 0 —, its box's top over its highest bone: an ear's tip over the ear's bone...;
+		// the same gap kept over that bone when it crouches, lies)
+		if ( p.boneSeq == 0 && p.boneTop > 0 && p.boneTop < stand )
+			p.topGap = min( stand * 0.5f, max( 0.5f, stand - p.boneTop ));
+		const float gap = p.topGap > 0 ? p.topGap : stand * 0.12f;
+		target = min( stand, max( stand * 0.25f, p.boneTop + gap ));
+	}
+	if ( p.barTop <= 0 )
+		p.barTop = target;
+	else
+		p.barTop = Approach( p.barTop, target, stand * 3.0f, dt );
+	return p.barTop;
+}
+
+void ArsUI_DrawPokemonBars( float flTime )
+{
+	static float s_flLast, s_flInfo;
+	const float now = Now(), dt = Clamp01( now - s_flLast ) ; s_flLast = now;
+	PokemonPurge();
+	{
+		const int id = gHUD.m_Ammo.CurrentWeaponId(); // (the ball in hand, for ArsUI_WeaponBits)
+		if ( IsCompanionItem( id ))
+		{
+			g_iBallHeld = id;
+			g_flBallHeld = now;
+		}
+	}
+	if ( !g_bView || g_iPanel != P_NONE )
+		return;
+	cl_entity_t *local = gEngfuncs.GetLocalPlayer();
+	if ( !local )
+		return;
+
+	// (the players' names, now and then)
+	if ( now - s_flInfo > 0.5f || now < s_flInfo )
+	{
+		for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_POKEMON; i++ )
+			if ( g_Pokemon[i].ent )
+			{
+				gHUD.m_Scoreboard.GetAllPlayersInfo();
+				s_flInfo = now;
+				break;
+			}
+	}
+
+	float radarW = 0, radarH = 0;
+	const bool radar = RadarBox( &radarW, &radarH );
+	const float lh = LineHeight();
+
+	BarDraw draws[MAX_POKEMON];
+	int n = 0;
+	bool traced = false;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_POKEMON; i++ )
+	{
+		Pokemon &p = g_Pokemon[i];
+		if ( !p.ent || p.stale >= 0 )
+			continue;
+		// (the bar eased toward the health, the lost part held a moment then drained)
+		p.shown = Approach( p.shown, p.hp, 2.5f, dt );
+		if ( p.trail > p.shown && now - p.lastHit > 0.45f )
+			p.trail = Approach( p.trail, p.shown, 0.9f, dt );
+		float life = 1;
+		if ( p.gone >= 0 )
+		{
+			life = 1 - Clamp01(( now - p.gone - 0.35f ) / 0.4f );
+			if ( life <= 0 || now < p.gone )
+			{
+				p.ent = 0; // (faded out: the slot freed)
+				continue;
+			}
+		}
+		// (in this frame's packet — in the PVS —, drawn, shown)
+		cl_entity_t *e = gEngfuncs.GetEntityByIndex( p.ent );
+		if ( !e || !e->model || e->curstate.messagenum != local->curstate.messagenum || ( e->curstate.effects & EF_NODRAW ))
+		{
+			p.vis = 0;
+			continue;
+		}
+		if ( e->curstate.rendermode != kRenderNormal && e->curstate.renderamt < 40 )
+			continue;
+		// (Le M still a hologram — his first 0.55 s, the server's LEM_HOLO_END —: his bar once he compiles)
+		if ( p.species == SPECIES_LEM && p.gone < 0 && now - p.born < LEM_BAR_AFTER && now >= p.born )
+			continue;
+		const float height = BarHeight( p, e, now, dt );
+		vec3_t top, mid, d;
+		VectorCopy( e->origin, top ); top[2] += height + POKE_BAR_LIFT;
+		VectorCopy( e->origin, mid ); mid[2] += height * 0.6f;
+		VectorSubtract( mid, g_vViewOrg, d );
+		const float dist = sqrtf( DotProduct( d, d ));
+		if ( dist > POKE_BAR_RANGE )
+		{
+			p.vis = 0;
+			continue;
+		}
+		// (hidden behind the walls: traced from the view a few times a second, each in its turn)
+		if ( now >= p.nextTrace || now < p.nextTrace - 1 )
+		{
+			if ( !traced )
+			{
+				gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetUpPlayerPrediction( false, true );
+				gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PushPMStates();
+				gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetSolidPlayers( -1 );
+				gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetTraceHull( 2 );
+				traced = true;
+			}
+			p.clear = SeenFromView( mid ) || SeenFromView( top );
+			p.nextTrace = now + 0.1f + ( i & 3 ) * 0.015f;
+		}
+		p.vis = Approach( p.vis, p.clear ? 1.0f : 0.0f, p.clear ? 6.0f : 9.0f, dt );
+		if ( p.vis <= 0 )
+			continue;
+		// (placed over its top; its top off the screen but its body in sight: held at the screen's top edge over it)
+		float screen[3], body[3];
+		const bool topIn = !gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->WorldToScreen( top, screen ) && fabs( screen[0] ) <= 1.2f && fabs( screen[1] ) <= 1.2f;
+		vec3_t low;
+		VectorCopy( e->origin, low ); low[2] += height * 0.3f;
+		const bool bodyIn = !gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->WorldToScreen( low, body ) && fabs( body[0] ) <= 1.0f && fabs( body[1] ) <= 1.0f;
+		if ( !topIn && !bodyIn )
+			continue; // (behind the view, or off the screen)
+		BarDraw &b = draws[n++];
+		b.p = &p;
+		b.sx = ( 1 + ( topIn ? screen[0] : body[0] )) * ScreenWidth / 2;
+		b.sy = topIn ? ( 1 - screen[1] ) * ScreenHeight / 2 - POKE_BAR_GAP : 0;
+		b.dist = dist;
+		b.size = 1.0f - 0.25f * Clamp01(( dist - 250 ) / 1000 ); // (a little smaller far away)
+		b.alpha = p.vis * life * Clamp01(( POKE_BAR_RANGE - dist ) / POKE_BAR_FADE ) * Clamp01(( now - p.born ) / 0.3f );
+		BarLayout( b );
+
+		// (kept inside the screen, the label whole: held at the edge a little past it, faded out further)
+		float push = 0;
+		const float minX = POKE_BAR_EDGE + b.halfW, maxX = ScreenWidth - POKE_BAR_EDGE - b.halfW;
+		const float minY = POKE_BAR_EDGE + b.above, maxY = ScreenHeight - POKE_BAR_EDGE - 2;
+		if ( minX <= maxX )
+		{
+			if ( b.sx < minX ) { push = max( push, minX - b.sx ); b.sx = minX; }
+			if ( b.sx > maxX ) { push = max( push, b.sx - maxX ); b.sx = maxX; }
+		}
+		if ( b.sy < minY ) { push = max( push, minY - b.sy ); b.sy = minY; }
+		if ( b.sy > maxY ) { push = max( push, b.sy - maxY ); b.sy = maxY; }
+		if ( !bodyIn )
+			b.alpha *= 1 - Clamp01(( push - lh ) / ( lh * 4 ));
+		// (not over the radar, in the top left corner: faded out as it nears it)
+		if ( radar )
+		{
+			const float out = max( b.sx - b.halfW - radarW, b.sy - b.above - radarH );
+			b.alpha *= Clamp01( out / 12 );
+		}
+	}
+	if ( traced )
+		gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PopPMStates();
+	if ( !n )
+		return;
+
+	// (the furthest first: the nearer over them)
+	for ( int i = 1; i < n; i++ )
+		for ( int j = i; j > 0 && draws[j].dist > draws[j - 1].dist; j-- )
+		{
+			BarDraw t = draws[j]; draws[j] = draws[j - 1]; draws[j - 1] = t;
+		}
+	for ( int i = 0; i < n; i++ )
+	{
+		if ( draws[i].alpha <= 0.01f )
+			continue;
+		DrawPokemonBar( draws[i], now );
+		FlushShapes(); // (each over the ones behind it, its name too)
+		FlushTexts();
+	}
+}
+
+// The Poke Ball in hand: its skin the ball's (0 Pikachu, 1 Charizard, 2 Blastoise)
+// The Poke Ball held in third person (p_pokeball): its skin is the holder's (the server sets the holder's skin to the
+// ball's species, 0 to 2, while one is in hand); -1 for any other weapon model, the holder then drawn as it is
+int ArsUI_HeldBallSkin( int weaponModelIndex, int holderSkin )
+{
+	model_t *m = weaponModelIndex ? gEngfuncs.hudGetModelByIndex( weaponModelIndex ) : NULL;
+	if ( !m || !strstr( m->name, "pokemon/p_pokeball" ))
+		return -1;
+	return ( holderSkin >= 0 && holderSkin <= SPECIES_BLASTOISE ) ? holderSkin : 0; // (the balls' species)
+}
+
+// The laptop in hand (v_laptop): its screen's code scrolls — its skins are the frames of it, shown in turn
+#define LAPTOP_SCREEN_RATE 12.0f // (frames a second)
+
+void ArsUI_ViewModelSkin( cl_entity_t *view )
+{
+	if ( !view || !view->model )
+		return;
+	if ( strstr( view->model->name, "others/v_laptop" ))
+	{
+		studiohdr_t *hdr = (studiohdr_t *)IEngineStudio.Mod_Extradata( view->model );
+		const int skins = hdr ? hdr->numskinfamilies : 1;
+		const float t = Now();
+		// (the skins carry the typing: they turn only while its hands type, "type" and "deploy"; else the still code)
+		bool typing = false;
+		if ( hdr && view->curstate.sequence >= 0 && view->curstate.sequence < hdr->numseq )
+		{
+			const mstudioseqdesc_t *seq = (const mstudioseqdesc_t *)( (byte *)hdr + hdr->seqindex ) + view->curstate.sequence;
+			typing = !strcmp( seq->label, "type" ) || !strcmp( seq->label, "deploy" );
+		}
+		view->curstate.skin = typing && skins > 1 && t > 0 ? (int)( t * LAPTOP_SCREEN_RATE ) % skins : 0;
+		return;
+	}
+	if ( strstr( view->model->name, "build/v_build" ))
+	{
+		view->curstate.skin = BuildSelectedPiece(); // (its tablet shows the piece chosen)
+		return;
+	}
+	if ( !strstr( view->model->name, "pokemon/v_pokeball" ))
+		return;
+	const int id = gHUD.m_Ammo.CurrentWeaponId();
+	if ( IsBall( id ))
+		view->curstate.skin = id - PK_PIKACHU;
+}
+
+//
+// Le M's Hack: the victim's screen scrambled a moment (the server's LemHack message: byte duration in hundredths of a
+// second, 0 ends it; byte strength, 255 full) — green glitch blocks, scanlines, torn slices, the view jolted; the
+// screen never hidden whole (at most a third of it covered at the peak, most of that see-through)
+//
+static int LemHack_Msg( const char *pszName, int iSize, void *pbuf )
+{
+	BufferReader reader( pszName, pbuf, iSize );
+	const int length = reader.ReadByte(), strength = reader.ReadByte();
+	if ( length <= 0 )
+	{
+		g_flHackStart = -1;
+		return 1;
+	}
+	const float now = Now(), k = strength > 0 ? strength / 255.0f : 1.0f;
+	// (hit again while scrambled: the longer of the two, the stronger)
+	if ( g_flHackStart >= 0 && now >= g_flHackStart && now < g_flHackStart + g_flHackLength )
+	{
+		g_flHackLength = max( g_flHackStart + g_flHackLength, now + length / 100.0f ) - g_flHackStart;
+		g_flHackStrength = max( g_flHackStrength, k );
+		return 1;
+	}
+	g_flHackStart = now;
+	g_flHackLength = length / 100.0f;
+	g_flHackStrength = k;
+	g_iHackWatched = g_iUser1 == OBS_IN_EYE ? g_iUser2 : 0;
+	return 1;
+}
+
+// the scramble's strength now: up fast, held, faded over its last 40 %; 0 none
+static float HackLevel( float now )
+{
+	if ( g_flHackStart < 0 || g_flHackLength <= 0 )
+		return 0;
+	const float t = now - g_flHackStart;
+	// (it ends with its victim's life — the local player's; a spectator's own health is 0: as long as it watches the
+	// same one through its eyes)
+	const bool gone = g_iHackWatched ? ( g_iUser1 != OBS_IN_EYE || g_iUser2 != g_iHackWatched ) :
+		( g_iUser1 || gHUD.m_Health.m_iHealth <= 0 );
+	if ( t < 0 || t >= g_flHackLength || gone )
+	{
+		g_flHackStart = -1;
+		return 0;
+	}
+	const float u = t / g_flHackLength;
+	return g_flHackStrength * Clamp01( t / 0.04f ) * ( u < 0.6f ? 1.0f : 1.0f - ( u - 0.6f ) / 0.4f );
+}
+
+// (a cheap hash: the same draw for a step of time, another for the next)
+static unsigned HackHash( unsigned a, unsigned b )
+{
+	unsigned h = a * 0x9E3779B1u ^ ( b + 0x7F4A7C15u + ( a << 6 ) + ( a >> 2 ));
+	h ^= h >> 15; h *= 0x2C1B3C6Du; h ^= h >> 12; h *= 0x297A2D39u; h ^= h >> 15;
+	return h;
+}
+static float HackRand( unsigned a, unsigned b ) { return ( HackHash( a, b ) & 0xFFFFFF ) / (float)0x1000000; }
+
+static const Col C_CODE  = { 70, 255, 120, 255 };
+static const Col C_CODE2 = { 20, 150, 60, 255 };
+static const Col C_CODEW = { 200, 255, 210, 255 };
+static const Col C_BLACK = { 0, 0, 0, 255 };
+
+void ArsUI_HackView( float *origin, float *angles )
+{
+	const float k = HackLevel( Now());
+	if ( k <= 0 )
+		return;
+	// (jolted at 25 steps a second, a little: the whole picture torn sideways)
+	const unsigned step = (unsigned)( Now() * 25 );
+	angles[1] += ( HackRand( step, 1 ) - 0.5f ) * 2.4f * k; // (yaw, pitch, roll)
+	angles[0] += ( HackRand( step, 2 ) - 0.5f ) * 1.2f * k;
+	angles[2] += ( HackRand( step, 3 ) - 0.5f ) * 2.0f * k;
+	(void)origin;
+}
+
+void ArsUI_DrawHackScramble( float flTime )
+{
+	const float now = Now(), k = HackLevel( now );
+	if ( k <= 0 )
+		return;
+	const float sw = ScreenWidth, sh = ScreenHeight;
+	const unsigned step = (unsigned)( now * 20 ); // (the blocks redrawn 20 times a second)
+	const float t = now - g_flHackStart;
+
+	// (a green cast over all, strongest at the hit)
+	Fill( 0, 0, sw, sh, Alpha( C_CODE2, k * ( 0.10f + 0.12f * Clamp01( 1 - t / 0.12f ))));
+
+	// (scanlines: a dark line every 4 units, rolling down)
+	const int roll = (int)( now * 60 ) & 3;
+	for ( float y = (float)roll; y < sh; y += 4 )
+		Fill( 0, y, sw, 1, Alpha( C_BLACK, 0.28f * k ));
+
+	// (torn slices: a band shifted sideways — its edge dark where the picture left, a green ghost where it went)
+	const int slices = 3 + (int)( 4 * k );
+	for ( int i = 0; i < slices; i++ )
+	{
+		const float y = HackRand( step, 10 + i ) * sh, h = 4 + HackRand( step, 30 + i ) * sh * 0.05f;
+		const float shift = ( HackRand( step, 50 + i ) - 0.5f ) * sw * 0.12f * k;
+		const float ax = fabs( shift );
+		const float x0 = shift > 0 ? 0 : sw - ax;
+		Fill( x0, y, ax, h, Alpha( C_BLACK, 0.55f * k ));
+		GradH( shift > 0 ? ax : sw - ax - sw * 0.35f, y, sw * 0.35f, h, Alpha( C_CODE, shift > 0 ? 0.20f * k : 0 ), Alpha( C_CODE, shift > 0 ? 0 : 0.20f * k ));
+		Fill( 0, y, sw, 1, Alpha( C_CODEW, 0.35f * k ));
+		Fill( 0, y + h - 1, sw, 1, Alpha( C_CODE2, 0.45f * k ));
+	}
+
+	// (glitch blocks: green and black rectangles in rows, some lit, most see-through)
+	const int blocks = (int)( 14 + 34 * k );
+	for ( int i = 0; i < blocks; i++ )
+	{
+		const float bw = 12 + HackRand( step, 100 + i ) * HackRand( step, 200 + i ) * sw * 0.35f;
+		const float bh = 3 + HackRand( step, 300 + i ) * HackRand( step, 400 + i ) * sh * 0.10f;
+		const float bx = HackRand( step, 500 + i ) * ( sw - bw ), by = HackRand( step, 600 + i ) * ( sh - bh );
+		const float kind = HackRand( step, 700 + i );
+		if ( kind < 0.45f )
+			Fill( bx, by, bw, bh, Alpha( C_CODE, ( 0.18f + 0.30f * HackRand( step, 800 + i )) * k ));
+		else if ( kind < 0.75f )
+			Fill( bx, by, bw, bh, Alpha( C_BLACK, ( 0.35f + 0.35f * HackRand( step, 800 + i )) * k ));
+		else
+		{
+			Fill( bx, by, bw, bh, Alpha( C_CODE2, 0.35f * k ));
+			Frame( bx, by, bw, bh, Alpha( C_CODEW, 0.5f * k ));
+		}
+	}
+	FlushShapes();
+
+	// (code: rows of hex and binary in the font, flickering)
+	static const char digits[] = "0123456789ABCDEF";
+	const int lines = (int)( 4 + 8 * k );
+	const int lh = LineHeight();
+	for ( int i = 0; i < lines; i++ )
+	{
+		char row[40];
+		const int len = 8 + (int)( HackRand( step, 900 + i ) * 24 );
+		const bool binary = HackRand( step, 950 + i ) < 0.4f;
+		for ( int c = 0; c < len; c++ )
+		{
+			const unsigned r = HackHash( step * 64 + i, c );
+			row[c] = ( c % 3 == 2 && !binary ) ? ' ' : binary ? ( r & 1 ? '1' : '0' ) : digits[r & 15];
+		}
+		row[len] = 0;
+		const float x = HackRand( step, 1000 + i ) * sw * 0.8f, y = HackRand( step, 1100 + i ) * ( sh - lh );
+		Text( x, y, row, Alpha( HackRand( step, 1200 + i ) < 0.3f ? C_CODEW : C_CODE, ( 0.55f + 0.45f * HackRand( step, 1300 + i )) * k ));
+	}
+	FlushTexts();
+}
+
+//
+// Half Strike's building (Fortnite-like): F (the flashlight's "impulse 100") toggles build mode — the weapon put away,
+// a build bar at the bottom (wall, floor, stairs, roof: the wheel or 1-4 choose, R turns the piece), a blueprint of
+// the piece where it would go (blue: it may be built; red: blocked, too far, not enough bricks), a click builds
+// (build_place, the spot the blueprint shows: the server checks it again with the same code, build_grid.h). The
+// server's messages: Bricks (the count, the bricks just picked up), BuildMode (build mode on, building allowed),
+// BuildDeny (why a piece was refused).
+//
+static const char *const g_BuildModels[BUILD_PIECES] = { "models/build/wall.mdl", "models/build/floor.mdl", "models/build/ramp.mdl", "models/build/roof.mdl" };
+static const Str g_BuildNames[BUILD_PIECES] = { TR( "Wall", "Mur" ), TR( "Floor", "Sol" ), TR( "Stairs", "Escalier" ), TR( "Roof", "Toit" ) };
+#define BUILD_HUD_SPRITE "sprites/build/hud.spr" // (one frame, 512 x 64, grey on black: the icons' rectangles below)
+#define BUILD_ICON_BRICK 4
+#define BUILD_ICON_BRICK_SMALL 5
+static const struct { float x, y, w, h; } g_BuildIconRects[] = { { 0, 0, 64, 64 }, { 64, 0, 64, 64 }, { 128, 0, 64, 64 }, { 192, 0, 64, 64 },
+	{ 256, 0, 48, 48 }, { 304, 0, 24, 24 } }; // (wall, floor, stairs, roof, brick, small brick)
+#define BUILD_ATLAS_W 512.0f
+#define BUILD_ATLAS_H 64.0f
+#define BUILD_REPEAT 0.16f   // (fire held: another piece where the blueprint moved, at most that often — the server
+                             // drops, silently, a player's pieces closer than BUILD_PLACE_DELAY 0.12 s: a margin for jitter)
+#define BUILD_ENTER_DELAY 0.25f // (the server takes no piece for 0.2 s after entering build mode: a click before, held)
+#define BUILD_RETRY 0.5f     // (a piece sent, neither built — no bricks spent — nor refused after that long: sent again)
+#define BUILD_SERVER_GRACE 1.0f // (after a toggle of ours, the server's other word waits that long: it may be older)
+#define MAX_BRICK_POPUPS 4
+
+static const Col C_BRICK  = { 196, 96, 64, 255 };
+static const Col C_BRICK2 = { 140, 62, 40, 255 };
+static const Col C_BLUEP  = { 92, 176, 255, 255 };
+
+static bool g_bBuild;              // (build mode, ours: the server's BuildMode follows)
+static bool g_bBuildEnabled = true; // (building allowed in this game: BuildMode's bit 1 — allowed until told)
+static bool g_bBuildKnown;         // (a BuildMode message seen since the level began)
+static bool g_bBuildServer;        // (the server's build mode, its last BuildMode — ours follows it once our toggles settle)
+static float g_flBuildToggled = -10; // (our last build_mode command)
+static float g_flBuildEntered = -10; // (our last build_mode 1)

+static int BuildSelectedPiece( void ) { return g_iBuildPiece; }
+static int g_iBricks;
+static bool g_bBricksKnown;
+static float g_flBricksChanged = -10;
+static struct { int amount; float t; } g_BrickPopups[MAX_BRICK_POPUPS];
+static int g_iBuildDeny; static float g_flBuildDeny = -10;
+// (fire held: the client's own +attack button, in_attack — its release always reaches it, even in the console or chat;
+// in build mode it never reaches the server, CL_CreateMove takes it out: ArsUI_BuildMasksAttack)
+extern kbutton_t in_attack;
+static float g_flBuildPlaced = -10; static bool g_bBuildClickQueued;
+static int g_iBuildBricksAtPlace; static bool g_bBuildPlaceAnswered; // (the last piece sent: bricks then; built or refused since)
+static build_spot_t g_BuildSpot, g_BuildLastPlaced; static bool g_bBuildSpot, g_bBuildPlacedOnce;
+static int g_iBuildReason; // (the blueprint's: BUILD_OK or why not)

+static bool g_bBuildSwallowed[256]; // (keys whose press build mode took: their release too)

+static model_t *g_pBuildModels[BUILD_PIECES]; static bool g_bBuildModelTried[BUILD_PIECES];
+static HSPRITE g_hBuildHud; static bool g_bBuildHudTried;
+static int g_iDollarSprite = -1;

+static void BuildSound( const char *name, float volume )
+{
+	gEngfuncs.pfnPlaySoundByName( (char *)name, volume );
+}
+
+static bool BuildCanUse( void )
+{
+	return gHUD.m_Health.m_iHealth > 0 && !g_iUser1 && !gHUD.m_fPlayerDead && ( LocalTeam() == TEAM_TERRORIST || LocalTeam() == TEAM_CT ) && !gEngfuncs.IsSpectateOnly();
+}
+
+static bool BuildFireHeld( void ) { return ( in_attack.state & 1 ) != 0; }
+
+static bool BuildGraceOver( float now ) { return now - g_flBuildToggled > BUILD_SERVER_GRACE || now < g_flBuildToggled; }
+
+static void BuildSet( bool on, bool tell )
+{
+	if ( on == g_bBuild )
+		return;
+	g_bBuild = on;
+	g_bBuildPlacedOnce = false;
+	g_bBuildClickQueued = false;
+	if ( tell )
+	{
+		g_flBuildToggled = Now();
+		if ( on )
+			g_flBuildEntered = g_flBuildToggled;
+		ClientCmd( on ? "build_mode 1" : "build_mode 0" );
+	}
+	// (a button held as it opens: its action stopped — its release passes; as it closes: a click of building does not
+	// go on as the weapon's fire)
+	ClientCmd( on ? "-attack\n-attack2\n-reload" : "-attack" );
+	if ( tell )
+		BuildSound( "build/toggle.wav", 0.6f );
+}
+
+// whether CL_CreateMove takes the fire buttons out of the commands sent: in build mode (fire builds, through BuildThink)
+bool ArsUI_BuildMasksAttack( void ) { return g_bBuild; }
+
+static int Bricks_Msg( const char *pszName, int iSize, void *pbuf )
+{
+	BufferReader reader( pszName, pbuf, iSize );
+	const int count = reader.ReadShort();
+	const int picked = iSize >= 3 ? reader.ReadByte() : 0;
+	g_iBricks = count < 0 ? 0 : count > BUILD_MAX_BRICKS ? BUILD_MAX_BRICKS : count;
+	if ( g_iBricks < g_iBuildBricksAtPlace )
+		g_bBuildPlaceAnswered = true; // (bricks spent: the piece sent last built)
+	g_bBricksKnown = true;
+	g_flBricksChanged = Now();
+	if ( picked > 0 )
+	{
+		const float now = Now();
+		int slot = -1;
+		for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_BRICK_POPUPS; i++ ) // (one picked a moment ago, still rising: added to it)
+			if ( g_BrickPopups[i].amount > 0 && now >= g_BrickPopups[i].t && now - g_BrickPopups[i].t < 0.3f )
+				slot = i;
+		if ( slot >= 0 )
+			g_BrickPopups[slot].amount += picked;
+		else
+		{
+			slot = 0; // (a free one, or the oldest)
+			for ( int i = 1; i < MAX_BRICK_POPUPS && g_BrickPopups[slot].amount; i++ )
+				if ( !g_BrickPopups[i].amount || g_BrickPopups[i].t < g_BrickPopups[slot].t )
+					slot = i;
+			g_BrickPopups[slot].amount = picked;
+		}
+		g_BrickPopups[slot].t = now;
+	}
+	return 1;
+}
+
+static int BuildMode_Msg( const char *pszName, int iSize, void *pbuf )
+{
+	BufferReader reader( pszName, pbuf, iSize );
+	const int flags = reader.ReadByte();
+	g_bBuildKnown = true;
+	g_bBuildEnabled = !!( flags & 2 );
+	g_bBuildServer = ( flags & 1 ) && g_bBuildEnabled;
+	// (the server's state, sent when it changes — not once per command of ours: right after a toggle of ours it may
+	// be older than the toggle; then, if it disagrees, BuildThink takes it once the grace is over. Building turned
+	// off: at once)
+	if ( !g_bBuildEnabled || BuildGraceOver( Now()) || g_bBuildServer == g_bBuild )
+		BuildSet( g_bBuildServer, false );
+	return 1;
+}
+
+static int BuildDeny_Msg( const char *pszName, int iSize, void *pbuf )
+{
+	BufferReader reader( pszName, pbuf, iSize );
+	g_iBuildDeny = reader.ReadByte();
+	g_flBuildDeny = Now();
+	g_bBuildPlaceAnswered = true; // (the piece sent last refused: not sent again)
+	BuildSound( "build/deny.wav", 0.8f );
+	if ( g_iBuildDeny == BUILD_DISABLED )
+		g_bBuildEnabled = false;
+	if ( g_iBuildDeny == BUILD_DISABLED || g_iBuildDeny == BUILD_CANNOT )
+	{
+		// (refused build mode, or a piece asked for out of it: the server is not in build mode — ours left at once,
+		// the server's word since taken as it comes)
+		g_bBuildServer = false;
+		g_flBuildToggled = -10;
+		BuildSet( false, false );
+	}
+	return 1;
+}
+
+static const char *BuildReasonText( int reason )
+{
+	switch ( reason )
+	{
+	case BUILD_NO_BRICKS: return L( "Not enough bricks", "Pas assez de briques" );
+	case BUILD_BLOCKED: return L( "Blocked", "Bloqu\xC3\xA9" );
+	case BUILD_TOO_FAR: return L( "Too far", "Trop loin" );
+	case BUILD_MY_CAP: return L( "You have built too many pieces", "Tu as construit trop de pi\xC3\xA8" "ces" );
+	case BUILD_ALL_CAP: return L( "Too many pieces in this game", "Trop de pi\xC3\xA8" "ces dans cette partie" );
+	case BUILD_DISABLED: return L( "Building is off in this game", "Construction d\xC3\xA9sactiv\xC3\xA9" "e dans cette partie" );
+	case BUILD_CANNOT: return L( "You can't build now", "Impossible de construire maintenant" );
+	}
+	return "";
+}
+
+static void BuildDenyLocal( int reason )
+{
+	g_iBuildDeny = reason;
+	g_flBuildDeny = Now();
+	BuildSound( "build/deny.wav", 0.8f );
+}
+
+static cvar_t *g_pBuildDebug; static float g_flBuildDebugNext; // (build_debug 1: the blueprint's checks printed twice a second)
+
+static void BuildInit( void )
+{
+	HOOK_MESSAGE_FUNC( "Bricks", Bricks_Msg );
+	HOOK_MESSAGE_FUNC( "BuildMode", BuildMode_Msg );
+	HOOK_MESSAGE_FUNC( "BuildDeny", BuildDeny_Msg );
+	g_pBuildDebug = gEngfuncs.pfnRegisterVariable( "build_debug", "0", 0 );
+}
+
+// (a VidInit may be a mere resize, a window or fullscreen change: build mode — the server's too — goes on; the
+// models and sprites loaded again. Another level: BuildNewLevel)
+static void BuildVidInit( void )
+{
+	memset( g_pBuildModels, 0, sizeof( g_pBuildModels ));
+	memset( g_bBuildModelTried, 0, sizeof( g_bBuildModelTried ));
+	g_hBuildHud = 0; g_bBuildHudTried = false;
+	g_iDollarSprite = -1;
+	g_bBuildSpot = false;
+}
+
+// a HUD reset (a spawn, a new round): the popups and refusals of before gone (build mode: as the server's BuildMode says)
+static void BuildSpawned( void )
+{
+	memset( g_BrickPopups, 0, sizeof( g_BrickPopups ));
+	g_iBuildDeny = 0;
+	g_bBuildClickQueued = false;
+}
+
+// a new level: what the last one's server said forgotten (BuildMode and Bricks come again)
+static void BuildNewLevel( void )
+{
+	BuildSet( false, false ); // (a new player on that server: out of build mode — its BuildMode says so again)
+	g_bBuildKnown = false;
+	g_bBuildServer = false;
+	g_bBuildEnabled = true;
+	g_bBricksKnown = false;
+	g_iBricks = 0;
+	g_bBuildPlaceAnswered = true;
+	memset( g_BrickPopups, 0, sizeof( g_BrickPopups ));
+	g_flBuildDeny = g_flBricksChanged = g_flBuildToggled = g_flBuildEntered = g_flBuildPlaced = -10;
+}
+
+// the blueprint and its checks: the world traced as the player moves
+static int BuildPieceOfName( const char *name )
+{
+	if ( !name || strncmp( name, "models/build/", 13 ))
+		return -1;
+	for ( int i = 0; i < BUILD_PIECES; i++ )
+		if ( !strcmp( name, g_BuildModels[i] ))
+			return i;
+	return -1;
+}
+
+static int BuildPieceOfModel( const model_t *m ) { return m ? BuildPieceOfName( m->name ) : -1; }
+
+static bool g_bBuildTraceOnPiece; static float g_flBuildTracePieceZ; // (the last trace: stopped on a piece or one of its steps)
+
+// What the grid's traces meet — the server's (BUILD_TraceLine): the world, brush entities (a physent with a brush
+// model: SOLID_BSP) and built pieces with their steps (SOLID_BBOX: no model pointer in their physent, their model's
+// name); through anything else (players, Pokemon, C4, satchels, grenades, bolts...). worldOnly: the world and brush
+// entities (doors, func_wall, breakables: a piece may not be built into them either)
+static int BuildIgnorePiecesToo( physent_t *pe ) { return !pe->model && BuildPieceOfName( pe->name ) < 0; }
+static int BuildIgnoreAllButBrushes( physent_t *pe ) { return !pe->model; }
+
+// (Xash3D's event API goes on past the SDK's event_api_t: its first extension, a trace with a filter)
+struct BuildEventApiExt
+{
+	event_api_t sdk;
+	void ( *EV_PlayerTraceExt )( float *start, float *end, int traceFlags, int ( *pfnIgnore )( physent_t *pe ), pmtrace_t *tr );
+};
+
+static float BuildTrace( void *, const float *start, const float *end, int worldOnly, float *endpos, int *startsolid )
+{
+	pmtrace_t tr;
+	const BuildEventApiExt *api = (const BuildEventApiExt *)gEngfuncs.pEventAPI;
+	if ( api->EV_PlayerTraceExt )
+		api->EV_PlayerTraceExt( (float *)start, (float *)end, PM_NORMAL, worldOnly ? BuildIgnoreAllButBrushes : BuildIgnorePiecesToo, &tr );
+	else // (not Xash3D: the old filter — players and Pokemon left out, other boxes not)
+		gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PlayerTrace( (float *)start, (float *)end, worldOnly ? PM_WORLD_ONLY : PM_STUDIO_IGNORE, -1, &tr );
+	VectorCopy( tr.endpos, endpos );
+	*startsolid = tr.startsolid || tr.allsolid;
+	g_bBuildTraceOnPiece = false;
+	// (the start inside the world, a brush entity or a piece: startsolid — build_grid.h's contract, the server's too)
+	if ( tr.fraction < 1.0f && !*startsolid && !worldOnly && tr.ent > 0 )
+	{
+		// (its steps carry its model and its origin)
+		physent_t *pe = gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_GetPhysent( tr.ent );
+		if ( pe && !pe->model && BuildPieceOfName( pe->name ) >= 0 )
+		{
+			g_bBuildTraceOnPiece = true;
+			g_flBuildTracePieceZ = pe->origin[2];
+		}
+	}
+	return tr.fraction;
+}
+
+static int BuildTracePiece( void *, float *origin_z )
+{
+	if ( !g_bBuildTraceOnPiece )
+		return 0;
+	*origin_z = g_flBuildTracePieceZ;
+	return 1;
+}
+
+// a piece built there already (the pieces in sight: the server's own, their origin and yaw the spot's)
+static bool BuildSlotTaken( const build_spot_t &s, cl_entity_t *local )
+{
+	for ( int i = gEngfuncs.GetMaxClients() + 1; i < 4096; i++ )
+	{
+		cl_entity_t *e = gEngfuncs.GetEntityByIndex( i );
+		if ( !e )
+			break;
+		if ( !e->model || e->curstate.messagenum != local->curstate.messagenum || ( e->curstate.effects & EF_NODRAW ))
+			continue;
+		const int piece = BuildPieceOfModel( e->model );
+		if ( piece != s.piece )
+			continue;
+		int yaw = (int)floorf( e->curstate.angles[1] + 0.5f ) % 360;
+		if ( yaw < 0 ) yaw += 360;
+		if ( build_same_slot( &s, piece, yaw, e->curstate.origin ))
+			return true;
+	}
+	return false;
+}
+
+// a player in the way (the living ones in sight, the local one included)
+static bool BuildPlayerInside( const build_spot_t &s, cl_entity_t *local )
+{
+	const int maxClients = gEngfuncs.GetMaxClients();
+	for ( int i = 1; i <= maxClients; i++ )
+	{
+		cl_entity_t *e = gEngfuncs.GetEntityByIndex( i );
+		if ( !e || !e->player || !e->model )
+			continue;
+		if ( e != local && ( e->curstate.messagenum != local->curstate.messagenum || e->curstate.solid == SOLID_NOT || ( e->curstate.effects & EF_NODRAW )))
+			continue;
+		const bool ducked = e->curstate.usehull == 1;
+		const float *o = e->origin;
+		const float mins[3] = { o[0] - 16, o[1] - 16, o[2] - ( ducked ? 18.0f : 36.0f ) };
+		const float maxs[3] = { o[0] + 16, o[1] + 16, o[2] + ( ducked ? 18.0f : 36.0f ) };
+		if ( build_overlaps_box( &s, mins, maxs ))
+			return true;
+	}
+	return false;
+}
+
+// the view the spot is computed from: the local player's eye and angles (those the server has: no punch, no bob)
+static bool BuildView( float *eye, float *angles, float *feet )
+{
+	cl_entity_t *local = gEngfuncs.GetLocalPlayer();
+	if ( !local )
+		return false;
+	float ofs[3];
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_LocalPlayerViewheight( ofs );
+	VectorAdd( local->origin, ofs, eye );
+	gEngfuncs.GetViewAngles( angles );
+	float mins[3], maxs[3];
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_LocalPlayerBounds( local->curstate.usehull == 1 ? 1 : 0, mins, maxs );
+	*feet = local->origin[2] + mins[2];
+	return true;
+}
+
+static void BuildUpdateSpot( void )
+{
+	g_bBuildSpot = false;
+	cl_entity_t *local = gEngfuncs.GetLocalPlayer();
+	float eye[3], angles[3], feet;
+	if ( !local || !BuildView( eye, angles, &feet ))
+		return;
+	build_engine_t e = { NULL, BuildTrace, BuildTracePiece };
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetUpPlayerPrediction( false, true );
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PushPMStates();
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetSolidPlayers( -1 );
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetTraceHull( 2 );
+	build_aim( &e, eye, angles, feet, g_iBuildPiece, g_iBuildTurns, &g_BuildSpot );
+	int reason = BUILD_OK;
+	bool slotOnly = false;
+	if ( !g_bBuildEnabled ) reason = BUILD_DISABLED;
+	else if ( !build_in_reach( &g_BuildSpot, eye )) reason = BUILD_TOO_FAR;
+	else
+	{
+		const bool slot = BuildSlotTaken( g_BuildSpot, local );
+		const bool other = BuildPlayerInside( g_BuildSpot, local ) || build_world_blocked( &e, &g_BuildSpot );
+		if ( slot || other ) reason = BUILD_BLOCKED;
+		else if ( g_iBricks < BUILD_COST ) reason = BUILD_NO_BRICKS;
+		slotOnly = slot && !other;
+	}
+	if ( g_pBuildDebug && g_pBuildDebug->value > 0 && Now() >= g_flBuildDebugNext )
+	{
+		g_flBuildDebugNext = Now() + 0.5f;
+		const build_spot_t &s = g_BuildSpot;
+		build_spot_t u = s; u.aimed = 0;
+		gEngfuncs.Con_Printf( "build_debug: piece %d at %.0f %.0f %.0f yaw %d aim %.0f %.0f %.0f eye %.0f %.0f %.0f feet %.0f: reason %d (slot %d player %d world %d reached %d)\n",
+			s.piece, s.origin[0], s.origin[1], s.origin[2], s.yaw, s.aim[0], s.aim[1], s.aim[2], eye[0], eye[1], eye[2], feet, reason,
+			BuildSlotTaken( s, local ), BuildPlayerInside( s, local ), build_world_blocked( &e, &u ), build_reached( &e, &s ));
+	}
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PopPMStates();
+	g_iBuildReason = reason;
+	g_bBuildSlotOnly = slotOnly;
+	g_bBuildSpot = true;
+}
+
+static bool BuildSameSpot( const build_spot_t &a, const build_spot_t &b )
+{
+	return a.piece == b.piece && a.yaw == b.yaw && a.origin[0] == b.origin[0] && a.origin[1] == b.origin[1] && a.origin[2] == b.origin[2];
+}
+
+// a click: the blueprint's spot asked for; refused at once when the blueprint says why (the server would)
+static void BuildPlace( bool repeat )
+{
+	if ( !g_bBuildSpot )
+		BuildUpdateSpot();
+	if ( !g_bBuildSpot )
+		return;
+	if ( g_iBuildReason != BUILD_OK )
+	{
+		if ( !repeat )
+			BuildDenyLocal( g_iBuildReason );
+		return;
+	}
+	if ( repeat && g_bBuildPlacedOnce && BuildSameSpot( g_BuildSpot, g_BuildLastPlaced ))
+		return;
+	const float now = Now();
+	if ( now - g_flBuildEntered < BUILD_ENTER_DELAY && now >= g_flBuildEntered )
+	{
+		// (just entered: the server would drop it, silently — held until it takes pieces)
+		if ( !repeat )
+			g_bBuildClickQueued = true;
+		return;
+	}
+	g_bBuildClickQueued = false;
+	char cmd[96];
+	snprintf( cmd, sizeof( cmd ), "build_place %d %d %d %d %d %d", g_BuildSpot.piece, (int)g_BuildSpot.origin[0], (int)g_BuildSpot.origin[1], (int)g_BuildSpot.origin[2], g_BuildSpot.yaw, g_iBuildTurns );
+	ClientCmd( cmd );
+	g_BuildLastPlaced = g_BuildSpot;
+	g_bBuildPlacedOnce = true;
+	g_flBuildPlaced = now;
+	g_iBuildBricksAtPlace = g_iBricks;
+	g_bBuildPlaceAnswered = false;
+}
+
+static void BuildChoose( int piece )
+{
+	piece = ( piece % BUILD_PIECES + BUILD_PIECES ) % BUILD_PIECES;
+	if ( piece != g_iBuildPiece )
+		BuildSound( "build/select.wav", 0.6f );
+	g_iBuildPiece = piece;
+	g_bBuildPlacedOnce = false;
+}
+
+// the keys: true when build mode took it (its release then taken too)
+// (a release swallowed only after a press swallowed: ArsUI_Key forgets each key's flag as it is pressed again — a
+// release that never came, in the console or the menu, leaves no stale flag)
+static bool BuildKey( int down, int keynum, const char *b, bool repeat )
+{
+	const bool inRange = keynum >= 0 && keynum < 256;
+	if ( !down )
+	{
+		if ( inRange && g_bBuildSwallowed[keynum] )
+		{
+			g_bBuildSwallowed[keynum] = false;
+			return true;
+		}
+		return false;
+	}
+	bool took = false;
+	if ( !strcmp( b, "impulse 100" ))
+	{
+		// (F: build mode on and off; building off in this game: the flashlight's own)
+		if ( !g_bBuildEnabled && !g_bBuild )
+			return false;
+		if ( !repeat )
+		{
+			if ( !g_bBuild && !BuildCanUse())
+				BuildDenyLocal( BUILD_CANNOT );
+			else
+				BuildSet( !g_bBuild, true );
+		}
+		took = true;
+	}
+	else if ( g_bBuild )
+	{
+		// (a text menu shown — the radio's, an old-style one —: the slot keys are its own)
+		const bool menu = gHUD.m_Menu.m_fMenuDisplayed != 0;
+		if (( keynum == K_MWHEELUP || keynum == K_MWHEELDOWN ) && ( !b[0] || !strcmp( b, "invnext" ) || !strcmp( b, "invprev" )))
+		{
+			// (the wheel, when it chooses weapons — bound to +jump or another action: that one, as ever)
+			BuildChoose( g_iBuildPiece + ( keynum == K_MWHEELUP ? -1 : 1 ));
+			took = true;
+		}
+		else if ( menu && !strncmp( b, "slot", 4 ))
+			took = false;
+		else if ( !strncmp( b, "slot", 4 ) && b[4] >= '1' && b[4] <= '4' && !b[5] )
+		{
+			if ( !repeat )
+				BuildChoose( b[4] - '1' );
+			took = true;
+		}
+		else if ( !strcmp( b, "+reload" ))
+		{
+			if ( !repeat )
+			{
+				g_iBuildTurns = ( g_iBuildTurns + 1 ) & 3;
+				g_bBuildPlacedOnce = false;
+				BuildSound( "build/select.wav", 0.5f );
+			}
+			took = true;
+		}
+		else if ( !strcmp( b, "+attack" ))
+		{
+			// (a piece at once; the key passed on: its +attack and -attack keep in_attack, held fire, BuildThink —
+			// the button never sent to the server in build mode, ArsUI_BuildMasksAttack)
+			if ( !repeat )
+				BuildPlace( false );
+		}
+		else if ( !strcmp( b, "+attack2" ))
+			took = true; // (nothing in build mode: no scope, no second fire)
+		else if ( !strncmp( b, "slot", 4 ) || !strcmp( b, "lastinv" ) || !strcmp( b, "invnext" ) || !strcmp( b, "invprev" ) || !strncmp( b, "weapon_", 7 ) || !strcmp( b, "drop" ))
+			BuildSet( false, true ); // (another weapon asked for: build mode left, the key passed on)
+	}
+	if ( took && inRange )
+		g_bBuildSwallowed[keynum] = true;
+	return took;
+}
+
+// a key pressed: its last press's swallowing forgotten (BuildKey takes the new one, if it does)
+static void BuildKeyPressed( int keynum )
+{
+	if ( keynum >= 0 && keynum < 256 )
+		g_bBuildSwallowed[keynum] = false;
+}
+
+// the game's keys lost — the console, the chat, the engine's menu, the window's focus —: the fire button let go (its
+// release may never come back to the game; in build mode, no piece built behind the player's back)
+static void BuildKeysLost( void )
+{
+	if ( g_bBuild && BuildFireHeld())
+		ClientCmd( "-attack" );
+	g_bBuildClickQueued = false;
+}
+
+// each frame: build mode left when it may not go on; fire held builds on
+static void BuildThink( void )
+{
+	// (the server's build mode, when it disagrees with ours once our toggles are settled: a refusal, a weapon bought
+	// or picked up, as ours was toggled)
+	if ( g_bBuildKnown && g_bBuildServer != g_bBuild && BuildGraceOver( Now()))
+		BuildSet( g_bBuildServer, false );
+	if ( g_bBuild && ( !BuildCanUse() || g_iPanel != P_NONE || !g_bBuildEnabled ))
+		BuildSet( false, true );
+	if ( !g_bBuild )
+	{
+		g_bBuildSpot = false;
+		return;
+	}
+	BuildUpdateSpot();
+	const float now = Now();
+	// (a piece sent neither built nor refused — dropped, sent too soon after another —: it may be sent again)
+	if ( g_bBuildPlacedOnce && !g_bBuildPlaceAnswered && ( now - g_flBuildPlaced >= BUILD_RETRY || now < g_flBuildPlaced ))
+	{
+		g_bBuildPlacedOnce = false;
+		g_bBuildPlaceAnswered = true;
+	}
+	if ( g_bBuildClickQueued && !( now - g_flBuildEntered < BUILD_ENTER_DELAY && now >= g_flBuildEntered ))
+		BuildPlace( false );
+	else if ( BuildFireHeld() && ( now - g_flBuildPlaced >= BUILD_REPEAT || now < g_flBuildPlaced ))
+		BuildPlace( true );
+}
+
+static bool BuildHidesViewModel( void )
+{
+	if ( !g_bBuild )
+		return false;
+	cl_entity_t *view = gEngfuncs.GetViewModel();
+	return !( view && view->model && strstr( view->model->name, "build/v_build" )); // (the server's build hands shown)
+}
+
+// the blueprint: the piece's model where it would go, see-through, blue or red (its fourth skin, the blueprint's grid,
+// when it has one; lit in that colour: ArsUI_StudioLighting)
+static void BuildCreateGhost( void )
+{
+	if ( !g_bBuild || !g_bBuildSpot )
+		return;
+	const int piece = g_BuildSpot.piece;
+	if ( !g_pBuildModels[piece] && !g_bBuildModelTried[piece] )
+	{
+		g_bBuildModelTried[piece] = true;
+		model_t *m = IEngineStudio.Mod_ForName( g_BuildModels[piece], 0 );
+		g_pBuildModels[piece] = ( m && m->type == mod_studio ) ? m : NULL;
+	}
+	model_t *m = g_pBuildModels[piece];
+	if ( !m )
+		return;
+	cl_entity_t *e = &g_BuildGhost;
+	memset( e, 0, sizeof( *e ));
+	e->model = m;
+	studiohdr_t *hdr = (studiohdr_t *)IEngineStudio.Mod_Extradata( m );
+	const int skins = hdr ? hdr->numskinfamilies : 1;
+	const bool ok = g_iBuildReason == BUILD_OK;
+	e->curstate.skin = skins >= 5 ? ( ok ? 3 : 4 ) : skins >= 4 ? 3 : 0;
+	const float pulse = 0.5f + 0.5f * sinf( Now() * 5.0f );
+	e->curstate.rendermode = skins >= 5 ? kRenderTransAdd : kRenderTransTexture;
+	e->curstate.renderamt = skins >= 5 ? (int)( 150 + 60 * pulse ) : (int)( 110 + 40 * pulse );
+	if ( g_bBuildSlotOnly )
+	{
+		// (that slot built already — the piece just placed, as a rule —: only a faint outline over it, the piece and
+		// its growth seen through, not a red ghost)
+		e->curstate.rendermode = kRenderTransAdd;
+		e->curstate.renderamt = (int)( 28 + 12 * pulse );
+	}
+	e->curstate.rendercolor.r = ok ? C_BLUEP.r : C_RED.r;
+	e->curstate.rendercolor.g = ok ? C_BLUEP.g : C_RED.g;
+	e->curstate.rendercolor.b = ok ? C_BLUEP.b : C_RED.b;
+	e->curstate.movetype = MOVETYPE_NONE;
+	e->curstate.framerate = 0;
+	VectorCopy( g_BuildSpot.origin, e->origin );
+	VectorCopy( e->origin, e->curstate.origin );
+	e->angles[1] = e->curstate.angles[1] = (float)g_BuildSpot.yaw;
+	gEngfuncs.CL_CreateVisibleEntity( ET_NORMAL, e );
+}
+
+static bool BuildGhostLighting( cl_entity_t *ent, alight_t *lighting )
+{
+	if ( ent != &g_BuildGhost )
+		return false;
+	const bool ok = g_iBuildReason == BUILD_OK;
+	lighting->ambientlight = 150;
+	lighting->shadelight = 60;
+	lighting->color[0] = ok ? 0.45f : 1.0f;
+	lighting->color[1] = ok ? 0.75f : 0.32f;
+	lighting->color[2] = ok ? 1.0f : 0.28f;
+	return true;
+}
+
+//
+// The build bar
+//
+struct BuildIcon { float x, y, w, h; int frame; Col c; };
+#define MAX_BUILD_ICONS 16
+static BuildIcon g_BuildIcons[MAX_BUILD_ICONS];
+static int g_iBuildIcons;
+
+static const model_t *BuildHudSprite( void )
+{
+	if ( !g_hBuildHud && !g_bBuildHudTried )
+	{
+		g_bBuildHudTried = true;
+		g_hBuildHud = SPR_Load( BUILD_HUD_SPRITE );
+	}
+	if ( !g_hBuildHud )
+		return NULL;
+	const model_t *m = gEngfuncs.GetSpritePointer( g_hBuildHud );
+	if ( !m )
+		return NULL;
+	return SPR_Width( g_hBuildHud, 0 ) >= 320 ? m : NULL; // (the atlas: another sprite of that name, drawn as shapes)
+}
+
+// the icons drawn as shapes, when the sprite is not there: a wall of bricks, a floor slab, stairs, a roof
+static void BuildShapeIcon( int frame, float x, float y, float s, Col c )
+{
+	const float u = s / 12;
+	switch ( frame )
+	{
+	case BUILD_WALL:
+		for ( int r = 0; r < 4; r++ )
+			for ( int k = 0; k < 3; k++ )
+			{
+				const float off = ( r & 1 ) ? -2 * u : 0;
+				const float bx = x + u + off + k * 4 * u, bw = 3.4f * u;
+				const float x0 = max( x + u, bx ), x1 = min( x + 11 * u, bx + bw );
+				Fill( x0, y + u + r * 2.6f * u, x1 - x0, 2.0f * u, c );
+			}
+		break;
+	case BUILD_FLOOR:
+	{
+		const float xs[4] = { x + 3 * u, x + 0.5f * u, x + 9 * u, x + 11.5f * u }, ys[4] = { y + 4 * u, y + 8 * u, y + 8 * u, y + 4 * u };
+		QuadPts( xs, ys, c );
+		Fill( x + 0.5f * u, y + 8 * u, 8.5f * u, 1.2f * u, Alpha( c, 0.7f ));
+		break;
+	}
+	case BUILD_RAMP:
+		for ( int k = 0; k < 4; k++ )
+			Fill( x + u + k * 2.5f * u, y + 11 * u - ( k + 1 ) * 2.5f * u, ( 4 - k ) * 2.5f * u, 2.0f * u, c );
+		break;
+	case BUILD_ROOF:
+	{
+		const float xs[4] = { x + 0.5f * u, x + 6 * u, x + 6 * u, x + 11.5f * u }, ys[4] = { y + 9 * u, y + 2.5f * u, y + 2.5f * u, y + 9 * u };
+		QuadPts( xs, ys, c );
+		Fill( x + 0.5f * u, y + 9 * u, 11 * u, 1.2f * u, Alpha( c, 0.7f ));
+		break;
+	}
+	default: // (a brick)
+		Fill( x + u, y + 3 * u, 10 * u, 6 * u, c );
+		Fill( x + u, y + 3 * u, 10 * u, 1.2f * u, Alpha( C_WHITE, c.a / 255.0f * 0.35f ));
+		Fill( x + u, y + 8 * u, 10 * u, 1.0f * u, Alpha( C_SHADE, c.a / 255.0f * 0.6f ));
+		break;
+	}
+}
+
+static void BuildIconAdd( int frame, float x, float y, float s, Col c )
+{
+	if ( !BuildHudSprite())
+	{
+		BuildShapeIcon( frame >= BUILD_ICON_BRICK ? BUILD_ICON_BRICK : frame, x, y, s, frame >= BUILD_ICON_BRICK ? Alpha( C_BRICK, c.a / 255.0f ) : c );
+		return;
+	}
+	if ( g_iBuildIcons >= MAX_BUILD_ICONS || !c.a )
+		return;
+	BuildIcon &i = g_BuildIcons[g_iBuildIcons++];
+	i.x = x; i.y = y; i.w = i.h = s; i.frame = frame; i.c = c;
+}
+
+static void BuildFlushIcons( void )
+{
+	const model_t *m = BuildHudSprite();
+	if ( !m || !g_iBuildIcons )
+	{
+		g_iBuildIcons = 0;
+		return;
+	}
+	gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->RenderMode( kRenderTransAdd );
+	gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->CullFace( TRI_NONE );
+	for ( int n = 0; n < g_iBuildIcons; n++ )
+	{
+		const BuildIcon &i = g_BuildIcons[n];
+		if ( !gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->SpriteTexture( (struct model_s *)m, 0 ))
+			break;
+		const float f = i.c.a / 255.0f;
+		// (its rectangle of the atlas, half a texel in)
+		const float u0 = ( g_BuildIconRects[i.frame].x + 0.5f ) / BUILD_ATLAS_W, u1 = ( g_BuildIconRects[i.frame].x + g_BuildIconRects[i.frame].w - 0.5f ) / BUILD_ATLAS_W;
+		const float v0 = ( g_BuildIconRects[i.frame].y + 0.5f ) / BUILD_ATLAS_H, v1 = ( g_BuildIconRects[i.frame].y + g_BuildIconRects[i.frame].h - 0.5f ) / BUILD_ATLAS_H;
+		gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->Color4f( i.c.r / 255.0f * f, i.c.g / 255.0f * f, i.c.b / 255.0f * f, 1.0f );
+		gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->Begin( TRI_QUADS );
+		gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->TexCoord2f( u0, v0 ); gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->Vertex3f( SC( i.x ), SC( i.y ), 0 );
+		gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->TexCoord2f( u0, v1 ); gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->Vertex3f( SC( i.x ), SC( i.y + i.h ), 0 );
+		gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->TexCoord2f( u1, v1 ); gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->Vertex3f( SC( i.x + i.w ), SC( i.y + i.h ), 0 );
+		gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->TexCoord2f( u1, v0 ); gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->Vertex3f( SC( i.x + i.w ), SC( i.y ), 0 );
+		gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->End();
+	}
+	gEngfuncs.pTriAPI->RenderMode( kRenderNormal );
+	g_iBuildIcons = 0;
+}
+
+static void BuildFlush( void )
+{
+	FlushShapes();
+	BuildFlushIcons();
+	FlushTexts();
+}
+
+// the "+5"s of bricks picked up, rising from a point (the count's), fading
+static void BuildDrawPopups( float x, float y, float now )
+{
+	const int lh = LineHeight();
+	for ( int i = 0; i < MAX_BRICK_POPUPS; i++ )
+	{
+		if ( g_BrickPopups[i].amount <= 0 )
+			continue;
+		const float t = now - g_BrickPopups[i].t;
+		if ( t < 0 || t > 1.4f )
+		{
+			g_BrickPopups[i].amount = 0;
+			continue;
+		}
+		char s[16];
+		snprintf( s, sizeof( s ), "+%d", g_BrickPopups[i].amount );
+		const float a = Clamp01( t / 0.08f ) * ( 1 - Clamp01(( t - 0.8f ) / 0.6f ));
+		const float rise = lh * 1.3f * ( 1 - ( 1 - Clamp01( t / 0.9f )) * ( 1 - Clamp01( t / 0.9f )));
+		TextRight( x, y - lh - rise, s, Alpha( C_GREEN, a ));
+	}
+}
+
+// out of build mode: the brick count by the money, small
+static void BuildDrawCountSmall( float now )
+{
+	if (( gHUD.m_iHideHUDDisplay & HIDEHUD_HEALTH ) || !( gHUD.m_iWeaponBits & ( 1 << WEAPON_SUIT )))
+		return;
+	if ( g_iDollarSprite < 0 )
+		g_iDollarSprite = gHUD.GetSpriteIndex( "dollar" );
+	float dollarW = 24;
+	if ( g_iDollarSprite >= 0 )
+	{
+		const wrect_t &r = gHUD.GetSpriteRect( g_iDollarSprite );
+		dollarW = (float)( r.right - r.left );
+	}
+	const int lh = LineHeight();
+	const float fh = (float)gHUD.m_iFontHeight;
+	const float rx = ScreenWidth - dollarW * 7 - 12, y = ScreenHeight - 3 * fh + ( fh - lh ) / 2;
+	char s[16];
+	snprintf( s, sizeof( s ), "%d", g_iBricks );
+	const float flash = 1 - Clamp01(( now - g_flBricksChanged ) / 0.8f );
+	const float tw = TextWidth( s ), icon = lh * 1.15f;
+	Fill( rx - tw - icon - 14, y - 3, tw + icon + 18, lh + 6, Alpha( C_SHADE, 0.45f + 0.2f * flash ));
+	BuildIconAdd( BUILD_ICON_BRICK, rx - tw - icon - 8, y + ( lh - icon ) / 2, icon, Alpha( C_WHITE, 0.85f ));
+	TextRight( rx, y, s, Mix( Alpha( C_TEXT, 0.8f ), C_GOLDT, flash ));
+	BuildDrawPopups( rx, y, now );
+}
+
+static void BuildDrawBar( float now )
+{
+	const int lh = LineHeight();
+	const float fh = (float)gHUD.m_iFontHeight;
+	const float S = max( 44.0f, lh * 2.8f ), gap = max( 5.0f, S * 0.1f ), W = S * BUILD_PIECES + gap * ( BUILD_PIECES - 1 );
+	const float x0 = (int)( ScreenWidth / 2 - W / 2 ), y0 = (int)( ScreenHeight - 2 * fh - S - 10 );
+	const bool afford = g_iBricks >= BUILD_COST;
+
+	// (the backing, a strip under the slots)
+	Grad( x0 - 10, y0 - 8, W + 20, S + 16, Alpha( C_PANEL, 0.0f ), Alpha( C_PANEL, 0.75f ));
+	for ( int i = 0; i < BUILD_PIECES; i++ )
+	{
+		const bool sel = i == g_iBuildPiece;
+		const float x = x0 + i * ( S + gap ), y = y0 - ( sel ? 4 : 0 );
+		Grad( x, y, S, S, Alpha( sel ? C_PANEL2 : C_PANEL, 0.92f ), Alpha( C_PANEL, 0.92f ));
+		if ( sel )
+		{
+			Fill( x, y, S, S, C_SEL );
+			Frame( x - 1, y - 1, S + 2, S + 2, C_GOLD, 2 );
+			Fill( x, y, S, 3, C_GOLDT );
+		}
+		else
+			Frame( x, y, S, S, C_SOFT );
+		const float is = S * 0.58f;
+		BuildIconAdd( i, x + ( S - is ) / 2, y + S * 0.12f, is, sel ? C_WHITE : Alpha( C_TEXT, 0.6f ));
+		// (its key, top left; its cost, bottom right — red when the bricks are short)
+		char key[2] = { (char)( '1' + i ), 0 };
+		Text( x + 4, y + 2, key, sel ? C_GOLDT : C_FAINT, 0.8f );
+		char cost[8];
+		snprintf( cost, sizeof( cost ), "%d", BUILD_COST );
+		const float bi = lh * 0.8f;
+		const Col cc = afford ? ( sel ? C_TEXT : C_DIM ) : C_RED;
+		TextRight( x + S - 4, y + S - lh - 1, cost, cc, 0.8f );
+		BuildIconAdd( BUILD_ICON_BRICK_SMALL, x + S - 6 - TextW( cost, 0.8f ) - bi, y + S - lh - 1 + ( lh - bi ) / 2, bi, Alpha( C_WHITE, afford ? 0.8f : 0.45f ));
+	}
+
+	// (the bricks, to the right: big)
+	char s[16];
+	snprintf( s, sizeof( s ), "%d", g_iBricks );
+	const float flash = 1 - Clamp01(( now - g_flBricksChanged ) / 0.8f );
+	const float big = 1.35f, icon = lh * 1.6f;
+	const float bx = x0 + W + 16, lhb = Scaled( big ) ? LineHeight( big ) : lh;
+	Fill( bx - 4, y0 + S / 2 - icon / 2 - 5, icon + TextW( s, big ) + 18, icon + 10, Alpha( C_PANEL, 0.8f ));
+	Fill( bx - 4, y0 + S / 2 - icon / 2 - 5, 3, icon + 10, afford ? C_BRICK : C_RED );
+	BuildIconAdd( BUILD_ICON_BRICK, bx + 2, y0 + S / 2 - icon / 2, icon, C_WHITE );
+	Text( bx + icon + 8, y0 + S / 2 - lhb / 2, s, Mix( afford ? C_TEXT : C_RED, C_GOLDT, flash ), big );
+	BuildDrawPopups( bx + icon + 8 + TextW( s, big ), y0 + S / 2 - lhb / 2, now );
+
+	// (the piece's name and, in red under it, why it may not go where the blueprint is: in the bar's row, right of the
+	// bricks — not over the build tablet's screen, whose picture is the bar's middle; on a screen too narrow for that,
+	// over the bar as a last resort)
+	const char *name = L( g_BuildNames[g_iBuildPiece] );
+	char title[64];
+	snprintf( title, sizeof( title ), "%s", name );
+	for ( unsigned char *c = (unsigned char *)title; *c; c++ ) // (in capitals: a UTF-8 é to É too)
+	{
+		if ( *c >= 'a' && *c <= 'z' )
+			*c -= 32;
+		else if ( *c == 0xC3 && c[1] >= 0xA0 && c[1] <= 0xBE && c[1] != 0xB7 )
+			*++c -= 32;
+		else if ( *c == 0xC5 && c[1] == 0x93 ) // (œ to Œ)
+			*++c = 0x92;
+	}
+	const bool denied = g_iBuildDeny && now - g_flBuildDeny < 1.6f && now >= g_flBuildDeny;
+	const char *why = denied ? BuildReasonText( g_iBuildDeny ) : ( g_bBuildSpot && g_iBuildReason != BUILD_OK ) ? BuildReasonText( g_iBuildReason ) : NULL;
+	if ( why && !why[0] )
+		why = NULL;
+	const float wa = !why ? 0 : denied ? 1.0f - Clamp01(( now - g_flBuildDeny - 1.1f ) / 0.5f ) : 0.75f;
+	const float lx = bx - 4 + icon + TextW( s, big ) + 18 + 14;
+	const float lw = max( (float)TextWidth( title ), why ? (float)TextWidth( why ) : 0.0f );
+	if ( lx + lw + 8 <= ScreenWidth )
+	{
+		const float ly = y0 + S / 2 - lh - 2;
+		Fill( lx - 6, ly - 4, lw + 12, 2 * lh + 12, Alpha( C_PANEL, 0.7f ));
+		Fill( lx - 6, ly - 4, 2, 2 * lh + 12, why ? Alpha( C_RED, max( wa, 0.4f )) : C_GOLD );
+		Text( lx, ly, title, C_GOLDT );
+		if ( why )
+			Text( lx, ly + lh + 4, why, Alpha( C_RED, wa ));
+	}
+	else
+	{
+		TextCenter( ScreenWidth / 2, y0 - lh - 12, title, C_GOLDT );
+		if ( why )
+			TextCenter( ScreenWidth / 2, y0 - 2 * lh - 16, why, Alpha( C_RED, wa ));
+	}
+
+	// (the keys, to the left)
+	const float kx = x0 - 16;
+	const char *const hints[3][2] = { { "R", L( "Rotate", "Tourner" ) }, { L( "LMB", "Clic G" ), L( "Build", "Construire" ) }, { "F", L( "Exit", "Quitter" ) } };
+	for ( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
+	{
+		const float y = y0 + S / 2 - 1.5f * ( lh + 6 ) + i * ( lh + 6 ) + 3;
+		const float lw = TextWidth( hints[i][1] ), kw = TextWidth( hints[i][0] ) + 10;
+		TextRight( kx, y, hints[i][1], C_DIM );
+		KeyBadge( kx - lw - 8 - kw, y, hints[i][0], false );
+	}
+}
+
+static void BuildDrawHud( float now, bool intermission )
+{
+	if ( intermission || g_iPanel != P_NONE || !gHUD.m_pCvarDraw->value || ( gHUD.m_iHideHUDDisplay & HIDEHUD_ALL ))
+		return;
+	if ( g_bBuild )
+		BuildDrawBar( now );
+	else if ( g_bBuildEnabled && BuildCanUse() && ( g_bBricksKnown || g_bBuildKnown ))
+		BuildDrawCountSmall( now );
+	else if ( g_iBuildDeny && now - g_flBuildDeny < 1.6f && now >= g_flBuildDeny )
+	{
+		// (F refused out of build mode: why, over the timer)
+		const int lh = LineHeight();
+		TextCenter( ScreenWidth / 2, ScreenHeight - 2 * gHUD.m_iFontHeight - lh - 10, BuildReasonText( g_iBuildDeny ), Alpha( C_RED, 1.0f - Clamp01(( now - g_flBuildDeny - 1.1f ) / 0.5f )));
+	}
+	BuildFlush();
+}

+// (a Half-Life brass shell: models/shell.mdl, which the server precaches for these weapons)
+static void HL_EjectShell( event_args_t *args, Vector &origin, Vector &angles, Vector &forward, Vector &right, Vector &up, const char *model, int soundtype, int count = 1 )
+{
+	Vector velocity( args->velocity );
+	Vector ShellVelocity, ShellOrigin;
+	int shell = gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_FindModelIndex( model );
+
+	for ( int i = 0; i < count; i++ )
+	{
+		EV_GetDefaultShellInfo( args, origin, velocity, ShellVelocity, ShellOrigin, forward, right, up, 20.0, -12.0, 4.0 );
+		EV_EjectBrass( ShellOrigin, ShellVelocity, angles[YAW], shell, soundtype );
+	}
