```patch
+void EV_FireGauss( event_args_t *args )
+{
+	int idx = args->entindex;
+	Vector origin( args->origin );
+	Vector angles( args->angles );
+	float flDamage = args->fparam1;
+	int m_fPrimaryFire = args->bparam1;
+	vec3_t vecSrc, vecDest, forward, right, up;
+	pmtrace_t tr, beam_tr;
+	int fHasPunched = 0;
+	int fFirstBeam = 1;
+	int nMaxHits = 10;
+
+	if ( args->bparam2 )
+	{
+		EV_StopPreviousGauss( idx );
+		return;
+	}
+
+	EV_GetGunPosition( args, vecSrc, origin );
+
+	int m_iBeam = gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_FindModelIndex( "sprites/smoke.spr" );
+	int m_iGlow = gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_FindModelIndex( "sprites/hotglow.spr" );
+	int m_iBalls = m_iGlow;
+
+	AngleVectors( angles, forward, right, up );
+	VectorMA( vecSrc, 8192, forward, vecDest );
+
+	if ( EV_IsLocal( idx ) )
+		gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_WeaponAnimation( GAUSS_FIRE2, 2 );
+
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PlaySound( idx, origin, CHAN_WEAPON, "weapons/gauss2.wav", 0.5 + flDamage * ( 1.0 / 400.0 ), ATTN_NORM, 0, 85 + gEngfuncs.pfnRandomLong( 0, 0x1f ) );
+
+	while ( flDamage > 10 && nMaxHits > 0 )
+	{
+		nMaxHits--;
+
+		gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetUpPlayerPrediction( false, true );
+		gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PushPMStates();
+		gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetSolidPlayers( idx - 1 );
+		gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetTraceHull( 2 );
+		gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PlayerTrace( vecSrc, vecDest, PM_STUDIO_BOX, -1, &tr );
+		gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PopPMStates();
+
+		if ( tr.allsolid )
+			break;
+
+		if ( fFirstBeam )
+		{
+			if ( EV_IsLocal( idx ) )
+				EV_MuzzleFlash();
+
+			fFirstBeam = 0;
+			gEngfuncs.pEfxAPI->R_BeamEntPoint( idx | 0x1000, tr.endpos, m_iBeam, 0.1, m_fPrimaryFire ? 1.0 : 2.5, 0.0,
+				m_fPrimaryFire ? 128.0 : flDamage, 0, 0, 0, 255, m_fPrimaryFire ? 128 : 255, m_fPrimaryFire ? 0 : 255 );
+		}
+		else
+		{
+			gEngfuncs.pEfxAPI->R_BeamPoints( vecSrc, tr.endpos, m_iBeam, 0.1, m_fPrimaryFire ? 1.0 : 2.5, 0.0,
+				m_fPrimaryFire ? 128.0 : flDamage, 0, 0, 0, 255, m_fPrimaryFire ? 128 : 255, m_fPrimaryFire ? 0 : 255 );
+		}
+
+		physent_t *pEntity = gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_GetPhysent( tr.ent );
+		if ( pEntity == NULL )
+			break;
+
+		if ( pEntity->solid == SOLID_BSP )
+		{
+			float n = -DotProduct( tr.plane.normal, forward );
+
+			if ( n < 0.5 ) // (60 degrees: it reflects)
+			{
+				vec3_t r;
+				VectorMA( forward, 2.0 * n, tr.plane.normal, r );
+				VectorCopy( r, forward );
+				VectorMA( tr.endpos, 8.0, forward, vecSrc );
+				VectorMA( vecSrc, 8192.0, forward, vecDest );
+
+				gEngfuncs.pEfxAPI->R_TempSprite( tr.endpos, vec3_origin, 0.2, m_iGlow, kRenderGlow, kRenderFxNoDissipation, flDamage * n / 255.0, flDamage * n * 0.5 * 0.1, FTENT_FADEOUT );
+
+				vec3_t fwd;
+				VectorAdd( tr.endpos, tr.plane.normal, fwd );
+				gEngfuncs.pEfxAPI->R_Sprite_Trail( TE_SPRITETRAIL, tr.endpos, fwd, m_iBalls, 3, 0.1, gEngfuncs.pfnRandomFloat( 10, 20 ) / 100.0, 100, 255, 100 );
+
+				if ( n == 0 )
+					n = 0.1;
+
+				flDamage = flDamage * ( 1 - n );
+			}
+			else
+			{
+				// (a tunnel)
+				HL_DecalGunshot( &tr );
+				gEngfuncs.pEfxAPI->R_TempSprite( tr.endpos, vec3_origin, 1.0, m_iGlow, kRenderGlow, kRenderFxNoDissipation, flDamage / 255.0, 6.0, FTENT_FADEOUT );
+
+				if ( fHasPunched )
+					break;
+
+				fHasPunched = 1;
+
+				// (the charged shot through the wall)
+				if ( !m_fPrimaryFire )
+				{
+					vec3_t start;
+					VectorMA( tr.endpos, 8.0, forward, start );
+
+					gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PushPMStates();
+					gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetSolidPlayers( idx - 1 );
+					gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetTraceHull( 2 );
+					gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PlayerTrace( start, vecDest, PM_STUDIO_BOX, -1, &beam_tr );
+
+					if ( !beam_tr.allsolid )
+					{
+						vec3_t delta;
+
+						// (backwards to the exit point)
+						gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PlayerTrace( beam_tr.endpos, tr.endpos, PM_STUDIO_BOX, -1, &beam_tr );
+						VectorSubtract( beam_tr.endpos, tr.endpos, delta );
+
+						float len = Vector( delta ).Length();
+						if ( len < flDamage )
+						{
+							if ( len == 0 )
+								len = 1;
+
+							flDamage -= len;
+
+							vec3_t fwd;
+							VectorSubtract( tr.endpos, forward, fwd );
+							gEngfuncs.pEfxAPI->R_Sprite_Trail( TE_SPRITETRAIL, tr.endpos, fwd, m_iBalls, 3, 0.1, gEngfuncs.pfnRandomFloat( 10, 20 ) / 100.0, 100, 255, 100 );
+
+							HL_DecalGunshot( &beam_tr );
+							gEngfuncs.pEfxAPI->R_TempSprite( beam_tr.endpos, vec3_origin, 0.1, m_iGlow, kRenderGlow, kRenderFxNoDissipation, flDamage / 255.0, 6.0, FTENT_FADEOUT );
+
+							VectorSubtract( beam_tr.endpos, forward, fwd );
+							gEngfuncs.pEfxAPI->R_Sprite_Trail( TE_SPRITETRAIL, beam_tr.endpos, fwd, m_iBalls, (int)( flDamage * 0.3 ), 0.1, gEngfuncs.pfnRandomFloat( 10, 20 ) / 100.0, 200, 255, 40 );
+
+							VectorAdd( beam_tr.endpos, forward, vecSrc );
+						}
+					}
+					else
+					{
+						flDamage = 0;
+					}
+
+					gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PopPMStates();
+				}
+				else
+				{
+					// (the primary slug never goes through: a glow and some balls)
+					gEngfuncs.pEfxAPI->R_TempSprite( tr.endpos, vec3_origin, 0.2, m_iGlow, kRenderGlow, kRenderFxNoDissipation, 200.0 / 255.0, 0.3, FTENT_FADEOUT );
+
+					vec3_t fwd;
+					VectorAdd( tr.endpos, tr.plane.normal, fwd );
+					gEngfuncs.pEfxAPI->R_Sprite_Trail( TE_SPRITETRAIL, tr.endpos, fwd, m_iBalls, 8, 0.6, gEngfuncs.pfnRandomFloat( 10, 20 ) / 100.0, 100, 255, 200 );
+
+					flDamage = 0;
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		else
+		{
+			VectorAdd( tr.endpos, forward, vecSrc );
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+// (keeps a stuck bolt where it hit)
+static void EV_BoltCallback( struct tempent_s *ent, float frametime, float currenttime )
+{
+	ent->entity.origin = ent->entity.baseline.vuser1;
+	ent->entity.angles = ent->entity.baseline.vuser2;
+}

+// The zoomed shot: an instant bolt, stuck where it lands
+void EV_FireCrossbow2( event_args_t *args )
+{
+	int idx = args->entindex;
+	Vector origin( args->origin );
+	Vector angles( args->angles );
+	vec3_t vecSrc, vecEnd, forward, right, up;
+	pmtrace_t tr;
+
+	AngleVectors( angles, forward, right, up );
+	EV_GetGunPosition( args, vecSrc, origin );
+	VectorMA( vecSrc, 8192, forward, vecEnd );
+
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PlaySound( idx, origin, CHAN_WEAPON, "weapons/xbow_fire1.wav", 1, ATTN_NORM, 0, 93 + gEngfuncs.pfnRandomLong( 0, 0xF ) );
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PlaySound( idx, origin, CHAN_ITEM, "weapons/xbow_reload1.wav", gEngfuncs.pfnRandomFloat( 0.95, 1.0 ), ATTN_NORM, 0, 93 + gEngfuncs.pfnRandomLong( 0, 0xF ) );
+
+	if ( EV_IsLocal( idx ) )
+		gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_WeaponAnimation( args->iparam1 ? CROSSBOW_FIRE1 : CROSSBOW_FIRE3, 1 );
+
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetUpPlayerPrediction( false, true );
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PushPMStates();
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetSolidPlayers( idx - 1 );
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_SetTraceHull( 2 );
+	gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_PlayerTrace( vecSrc, vecEnd, PM_STUDIO_BOX, -1, &tr );
+
+	if ( tr.fraction < 1.0 )
+	{
+		physent_t *pe = gEngfuncs.pEventAPI->EV_GetPhysent( tr.ent );
+
+		// (in the world: stuck there for a while)

+// The Half-Life arsenal's death notice icons (d_*) of the Half-Life hud.txt at a resolution, after Counter-Strike's
+// sprites: named d_hl_* where Counter-Strike has one of the same name (d_hl_grenade). Their sprite sheets are the
+// valve folder's, whose names Counter-Strike's shadow.
+static bool HL_WantedSprite( const client_sprite_t *p, int iRes )
+{
+	return p->iRes == iRes && !strncmp( p->szName, "d_", 2 );
+}
+
+static void HL_SpriteName( char *dest, const client_sprite_t *p, const char *names, int count )
+{
+	for ( int i = 0; i < count; i++ )
+	{
+		if ( !strncmp( p->szName, names + i * MAX_SPRITE_NAME_LENGTH, MAX_SPRITE_NAME_LENGTH ) )
+		{
+			snprintf( dest, MAX_SPRITE_NAME_LENGTH, "d_hl_%s", p->szName + 2 );
+			return;
+		}
+	}
+
+	strncpy( dest, p->szName, MAX_SPRITE_NAME_LENGTH );
+}
+
+// Half Strike's own HUD icons, outside any hud.txt: a whole sprite each (its first frame), named for GetSpriteIndex
+// (d_pokemon: the death notice of a kill by a Pokemon, weapon "pokemon"; d_lem: by Le M, weapon "lem")
+static const struct { const char *name, *sprite; } g_ExtraSprites[] =
+{
+	{ "d_pokemon", "sprites/pokemon/d_pokemon.spr" },
+	{ "d_lem", "sprites/others/d_lem.spr" }, // (a kill by Le M, weapon "lem": a laptop with its prompt)
+};
+#define NUM_EXTRA_SPRITES ( (int)( sizeof( g_ExtraSprites ) / sizeof( g_ExtraSprites[0] )))
+
+static void Extra_LoadSprite( int i, HSPRITE *handle, wrect_t *rect, char *name )
+{
+	*handle = SPR_Load( g_ExtraSprites[i].sprite );
+	if ( rect )
+	{
+		rect->left = rect->top = 0;
+		rect->right = *handle ? SPR_Width( *handle, 0 ) : 0;
+		rect->bottom = *handle ? SPR_Height( *handle, 0 ) : 0;
+	}
+	if ( name )
+		strncpy( name, g_ExtraSprites[i].name, MAX_SPRITE_NAME_LENGTH );
+}
```

`tools/goldsrc/perf.mjs`:

```mjs
// Frame cost of a GoldSrc port in a game (docs/browser-ports.md, "Measured"): its page started as a visitor (no
// ?debug: the player's settings), the manifest's solo map entered as its menu does (its commands run by the page: bots
// included), --join-keys pressed (a team menu), --commands run (console commands, `;` between them: an A/B of the
// engine's settings), then --seconds measured while walking (--walk: forward held, turning) after --warm seconds.
// tools/port-perf.mjs measures: the engine's work a frame, the frames shown, the WebGL calls a frame by kind and the
// synchronous ones, the renderer (--gl swiftshader|discard|gpu; --stacks getError,…: who calls them). The page's
// reports stay off the server unless --report. JSON on the last line; evidence under
// /tmp/orthros-scratch/goldsrc-perf-<manifest>/. Start it through the browser slot guard:
//   tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/goldsrc/perf.mjs <manifest> [--url http://127.0.0.1:8080] [--gl discard]
//     [--map de_dust2] [--join-keys "2,1"] [--commands "gl_vbo 1;…"] [--seconds 30] [--warm 10] [--walk] [--profile]
//     [--stacks getError] [--size 1280x720] [--query "a=b"] [--report] [--tag t] [--channel chromium|shell]
// (--channel: Chromium itself by default, as the bench suite; shell: Playwright's headless shell — tools/port-perf.mjs)
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { launchOptions, addProbe, quietReports, startMeasure, readMeasure, startProfile, stopProfile } from '../port-perf.mjs';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), arg = (k, d) => (args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : d);
const [name] = args;
if (!name || name.startsWith('--')) { console.error('usage: perf.mjs <manifest> [--url u] [--gl swiftshader|discard|gpu] [--commands "a;b"] [--seconds n] [--walk]'); process.exit(2); }
const base = arg('--url', 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'), gl = arg('--gl', 'discard'), seconds = Number(arg('--seconds', 30));
const [width, height] = arg('--size', '1280x720').split('x').map(Number);

if (manifest.runtime !== 'goldsrc') throw new Error(`${name}: not a GoldSrc version`);
const map = arg('--map', manifest.goldsrc.solo?.map);

const browser = await chromium.launch(launchOptions({ gl, channel: arg('--channel', 'chromium') }));
try {
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height: height + 44 } });
  await addProbe(page, { discard: gl === 'discard', stacks: arg('--stacks', '').split(',').filter(Boolean) });
  if (!args.includes('--report')) await quietReports(page);
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => console.log('PAGE ERROR', e.message));
  page.on('crash', () => console.log('CRASH'));
  page.on('dialog', (d) => d.accept().catch(() => {}));
  const query = arg('--query', '');
  await page.goto(`${base}/ports/goldsrc/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`);
  await page.waitForFunction(() => ['running', 'error'].includes(window.portSession?.state), null, { timeout: 300000 });
  if (await page.evaluate(() => portSession.state) !== 'running') throw new Error(await page.evaluate(() => document.querySelector('#status')?.textContent));
  console.log('RENDERER', await page.evaluate(() => perfProbe.renderer), gl === 'discard' ? '(rasterizer discarded)' : '');
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
  await page.evaluate((m) => portSession.command(`map ${m}`), map);
  await page.waitForFunction(() => perfProbe.draws > 50, null, { timeout: 60000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(7000);

  for (const c of (arg('--commands', '') || '').split(';').map((c) => c.trim()).filter(Boolean)) await page.evaluate((c) => portSession.command(c), c);
  const walk = args.includes('--walk');

  let turning = null;

    await page.keyboard.down('w');

    turning = setInterval(() => { x += dir * 25; if (Math.abs(x - (box.x + box.width / 2)) > 300) dir = -dir; page.mouse.move(x, box.y + box.height / 2).catch(() => {}); }, 200);
  }
  await page.waitForTimeout(Number(arg('--warm', 10)) * 1000);
```

`tools/goldsrc/release-gamefiles.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# A GoldSrc engine release's own game files as loose files (docs/browser-ports.md "The release's own game files"): the
# members of the archives Orthros builds for a release (the bots' profiles and navigation meshes, a build's generated
# assets — tools/goldsrc/build-modules.sh) written under the release's gamefiles/<game folder>/, which the server lays
# over the version's files (src/host/game-files.js releaseGameFiles). There they are game data — listed in the version's
# tree, read by pieces through /gamez, kept in the OPFS store, ordered by what sessions read —, not archives the page
# fetches whole before the menu (the engine reads every member's header of a mounted .pk3 at its mount: xash3d-fwgs
# filesystem/zip.c FS_LoadZip). The archives stay in the release (an older manifest's goldsrc.extras still names them);
# release.json lists each loose file ({ path, sha256, bytes }) and the archives they come from (`gameFilesFrom`).
# A loose file's time is its bytes' (`content_mtime`: a time drawn from its sha256), never its archive's — the archive is
# written anew by every build, and the browsers' blocks are keyed by path, size and time (src/vfs/opfs-store.js): a
# rebuild changes only the files whose bytes changed, and a changed file never keeps its old key, whatever its size.
# An archive given as --map-precache=<archive>: its members are what the game's server precaches at every map's load
# without the map naming them (a build's generated assets its game DLL precaches — its clients load them too);
# release.json lists them, relative to the game folder (`mapPrecache`), and the page announces them with each map it
# loads (src/ports/goldsrc/bsp-reads.js mapReads), fetched in parallel instead of a demand read each.
# An archive's game folder is the folder it lies in (counterstrike/cstrike/x.pk3 -> gamefiles/cstrike/). Two archives
# giving one path (whatever its case), a member outside its folder, or a path already there: refused.
#
# Usage:
#   python3 -I tools/goldsrc/release-gamefiles.py <release dir> [--map-precache=]<archive>...
#       the archives (release paths) of a release being built (its staging folder: build-modules.sh)
#   python3 -I tools/goldsrc/release-gamefiles.py --derive <engines dir> <from id> <new id> [--map-precache=]<archive>...
#       a new release made from an installed one without rebuilding it: its files copied (times kept), its id changed
#       (`derivedFrom`: the release it was made from), then the archives' members written; staged beside, then renamed
#       in place. An installed release is never overwritten. Run tools/engine-br.mjs on it afterwards (release.json).
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile

def safe(name):
    parts = name.split('/')
    return name and '\\' not in name and not name.startswith('/') and all(p and p not in ('.', '..') for p in parts)


EPOCH = 315532800  # (1980-01-01 UTC: the zip format's first date)


def content_mtime(digest):
    """A loose file's time from its bytes' sha256 (hex): the same bytes the same time in every build, other bytes
    (almost surely) another — within 34 years from 1980, never in the future."""
    return EPOCH + int(digest[:8], 16) % (1 << 30)


MAP_PRECACHE = '--map-precache='


def unpack(release, archives):
    """Every archive's members written under release/gamefiles/<its folder>/; release.json updated. Returns the count.
    An archive written `--map-precache=<archive>`: its members also listed in release.json `mapPrecache`."""
    marked = {a[len(MAP_PRECACHE):] for a in archives if a.startswith(MAP_PRECACHE)}
    archives = [a[len(MAP_PRECACHE):] if a.startswith(MAP_PRECACHE) else a for a in archives]
    release = pathlib.Path(release)
    meta_file = release / 'release.json'
    meta = json.loads(meta_file.read_text())
    files = meta.setdefault('files', [])
    if not isinstance(files, list):
        sys.exit(f'{meta_file}: files must be a list of {{ path, sha256, bytes }}')
    taken = {f['path'].lower() for f in files}
    seen, added, reads = {}, [], []
    for rel in archives:
        src = release / rel
        if not safe(rel) or not src.is_file() or not rel.lower().endswith('.pk3'):
            sys.exit(f'{rel}: not an archive (.pk3) of the release')
        parts = rel.split('/')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            sys.exit(f'{rel}: an archive lies in its game folder')
        game = parts[-2]
        with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as z:
            for info in sorted(z.infolist(), key=lambda i: i.filename):
                if info.is_dir():
                    continue
                if not safe(info.filename):
                    sys.exit(f'{rel}: member {info.filename!r} outside its folder')
                out = f'gamefiles/{game}/{info.filename}'
                key = out.lower()
                if key in seen:
                    sys.exit(f'{out}: in {seen[key]} and {rel}')
                if key in taken:
                    sys.exit(f'{out}: already in the release')
                seen[key] = rel
                data = z.read(info)
                dest = release / out
                dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                dest.write_bytes(data)
                digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
                os.utime(dest, (content_mtime(digest), content_mtime(digest)))
                added.append({'path': out, 'sha256': digest, 'bytes': len(data)})
                if rel in marked:
                    reads.append(info.filename)
    files.extend(added)
    meta['gameFilesFrom'] = sorted(set(meta.get('gameFilesFrom', [])) | set(archives))
    if reads:
        meta['mapPrecache'] = sorted(set(meta.get('mapPrecache', [])) | set(reads))
    meta_file.write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2) + '\n')
    return len(added)


def derive(engines, old, new, archives):
    engines = pathlib.Path(engines)
    src, dest, stage = engines / old, engines / new, engines / f'.{new}.staging'
    if not (src / 'release.json').is_file():
        sys.exit(f'{src}: not an installed release')
    if dest.exists():
        sys.exit(f'{dest}: already there; an installed release is never overwritten')
    if (src / 'gamefiles').exists():
        sys.exit(f'{src}: has its gamefiles/ already')
    shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
    shutil.copytree(src, stage, symlinks=False, copy_function=shutil.copy2)
    meta = json.loads((stage / 'release.json').read_text())
    meta = {'id': new, 'derivedFrom': old, **{k: v for k, v in meta.items() if k != 'id'}}
    (stage / 'release.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2) + '\n')
    try:
        n = unpack(stage, archives)
    except BaseException:
        shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)  # (refused: nothing left beside the releases)
        raise
    os.rename(stage, dest)
    return n


def main(argv):
    if argv[:1] == ['--derive'] and len(argv) >= 5:
        n = derive(argv[1], argv[2], argv[3], argv[4:])
        print(f'{argv[3]}: {n} game files from {", ".join(argv[4:])}')
    elif len(argv) >= 2 and not argv[0].startswith('-'):
        n = unpack(argv[0], argv[1:])
        print(f'{argv[0]}: {n} game files from {", ".join(argv[1:])}')
    else:
        sys.exit('usage: release-gamefiles.py <release dir> <archive>... | --derive <engines dir> <from id> <new id> <archive>...')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(sys.argv[1:])

```

`tools/goldsrc/server.mjs`:

```mjs
// The native dedicated servers of a GoldSrc version (docs/browser-ports.md), run by systemd
// (tools/goldsrc/orthros-goldsrc@.service, instance = the manifest id): Xash3D FWGS built from pinned sources
// (build-server.sh) in data/engines/<goldsrc.multiplayer.server>/, serving the version's files read-only on 127.0.0.1
// only — players reach them through the Orthros server's relay (/api/udp/<manifest>).
// Room 0 is the version's permanent server (goldsrc.multiplayer.port, its map, its rotation). With
// goldsrc.multiplayer.rooms, players create more — a name, a map it stays on, a size, bots — one per port of the
// range, each stopped after `IDLE` seconds without a human player. Rooms are listed and created over HTTP on
// 127.0.0.1:<goldsrc.multiplayer.port> (TCP), for the Orthros server only (src/host/goldsrc.js roomsProxy):
//   GET /rooms  -> { rooms: [{ index, port, name, map, players (bots included), humans, maxPlayers, bots, permanent, since, up }], maps,
//                    slots, maxPlayers, bots: { max } | null }
//   POST /rooms { name, map, maxPlayers, bots, options, by } -> 201 { room, key } once the server answers, or 400/409/503
//                    (`by`: the creator's address — one live room each; `key`: the room's secret, its creator's to close it)
//   DELETE /rooms/<index> { key } -> 200 { closed } (its server stopped), 403 (room 0, or not its key) or 404
// The game library is the one the game's files name, or goldsrc.multiplayer.gameLibrary: a native build in the browser
// release (tools/goldsrc/build-modules.sh). The writable state (configuration, logs, the linked game files) goes to
// $STATE_DIRECTORY, or --state <dir>; a room's to rooms/<index>/ there.
// Usage: node tools/goldsrc/server.mjs <manifest> [--games-dir <dir>] [--engines-dir <dir>] [--state <dir>]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import http from 'node:http';
import dgram from 'node:dgram';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { loadGameCatalog, DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR } from '../../src/host/game-catalog.js';
import { DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR, engineFile, linkGameLayers, parseServerInfo, roomOptionCommands, roomPort, roomRequest, roomSlots, sameRoomName } from '../../src/host/goldsrc.js';

const IDLE = 300; // (seconds a created room stays without a human player)
const args = process.argv.slice(2), arg = (k) => (args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : undefined);
const id = args[0], stateArg = arg('--state') ?? process.env.STATE_DIRECTORY;
if (!id || !stateArg) { console.error('usage: server.mjs <manifest> [--games-dir d] [--engines-dir d] [--state d]'); process.exit(2); }
const state = path.resolve(stateArg);
// (the catalog over the same engines folder: the release's own game files — gamefiles/, its bots' meshes — laid over the
// version's as the page sees them, linkGameLayers below)
const engines = path.resolve(arg('--engines-dir') ?? DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR);
const man = loadGameCatalog(path.resolve(arg('--games-dir') ?? DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR), null, { enginesDir: engines }).get(id);
const g = man?.runtime === 'goldsrc' ? man.goldsrc : null, mp = g?.multiplayer;
if (!mp) { console.error(`${id}: no GoldSrc version with a multiplayer server`); process.exit(2); }
const release = path.join(engines, mp.server);
if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(release, 'xash'))) { console.error(`${release}: dedicated-server release not installed (tools/goldsrc/build-server.sh)`); process.exit(1); }
const gameLibrary = mp.gameLibrary === undefined ? null : engineFile(engines, g.engine, mp.gameLibrary);
if (mp.gameLibrary !== undefined && !gameLibrary) { console.error(`${g.engine}/${mp.gameLibrary}: game library not installed (tools/goldsrc/build-modules.sh)`); process.exit(1); }
// (one directory for the engine: the release's game files over the version's, over the base's, linked afresh at each
// start)
const game = path.join(state, 'game');
console.log(`${id}: ${linkGameLayers(man, game)} game files linked`);
// (the archives goldsrc.extras names in the game folder, as the page mounts them: the engine's extras; an older
// release's bot profiles and navigation meshes, which a newer one has as loose game files in its gamefiles/)
const gameFolder = path.join(game, fs.readdirSync(game).find((n) => n.toLowerCase() === g.gameDir.toLowerCase()) ?? g.gameDir);
fs.mkdirSync(gameFolder, { recursive: true });
for (const extra of g.extras ?? []) {
  const file = engineFile(engines, g.engine, extra), dest = path.join(gameFolder, path.basename(extra));
  if (!file) { console.error(`${g.engine}/${extra}: archive not installed`); process.exit(1); }
  fs.rmSync(dest, { force: true }); fs.symlinkSync(file, dest);
}
// (the maps a room may be on: the manifest's list, else every map of the game folder)
const mapsDir = fs.readdirSync(gameFolder).find((n) => n.toLowerCase() === 'maps');
const MAPS = mp.maps ?? (mapsDir ? fs.readdirSync(path.join(gameFolder, mapsDir)).filter((n) => /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.bsp$/i.test(n)).map((n) => n.slice(0, -4)).sort() : [mp.map]);

/** @type {Map<number, { index: number, port: number, name: string, map: string, maxPlayers: number, bots: number, permanent: boolean, since: number, child: any, info: any, seen: number, idleSince: number, stopping?: boolean }>} */
const rooms = new Map();
const quote = (s) => String(s).replace(/["\\;]/g, '');
let shuttingDown = false;

/** A room's server started; a created room goes when it stops, room 0 starts again 5 s later. */
function launch(room) {
  room.stopping = false;
  const base = room.permanent ? state : path.join(state, 'rooms', String(room.index));
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(base, g.gameDir), { recursive: true });
  // (its settings, written at each start: its name; a created room stays on its map)
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(base, g.gameDir, 'server.cfg'), `hostname "${quote(room.name)}"\nsv_lan 1\nsv_cheats 0\nsv_maxrate 100000\nsv_minrate 10000\nmp_timelimit ${room.permanent ? 30 : 0}\n`);
  if (!room.permanent) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(base, g.gameDir, 'mapcycle.txt'), `${room.map}\n`);
  const botCommands = room.bots ? (mp.rooms?.bots?.commands ?? []).map((c) => c.replaceAll('{n}', String(room.bots))) : [];
  const optionCommands = room.permanent ? [] : roomOptionCommands(mp, room); // (its chosen settings: starting money, the bots' team…)
  const child = room.child = spawn(path.join(release, 'xash'), ['-dedicated', '-noip6', '-rodir', game, '-game', g.gameDir,
    ...(gameLibrary ? ['-dll', gameLibrary] : []), ...(room.bots ? mp.rooms?.bots?.args ?? [] : []), '-port', String(room.port), '+ip', '127.0.0.1', '+maxplayers', String(room.maxPlayers),
    // (goldsrc.multiplayer.commands: the version's settings, before the map starts; then a room's bots)
    ...[...(mp.commands ?? []), ...botCommands, ...optionCommands].flatMap((c) => c.split(' ').map((w, i) => (i ? w : `+${w}`))), '+map', room.map], {
    cwd: base,
    env: { ...process.env, XASH3D_BASEDIR: base, XASH3D_LIBDIR: release, LD_LIBRARY_PATH: release },
    stdio: room.permanent ? 'inherit' : ['ignore', 'ignore', 'inherit'],
  });
  const finish = (why) => {
    if (room.child !== child) return;
    room.child = null; room.seen = 0;
    if (room.permanent && !shuttingDown) {
      console.error(`room 0 stopped (${why}): starting it again in 5 s`);
      relaunch(room);
    } else { rooms.delete(room.index); if (!room.permanent) console.log(`room ${room.index} "${room.name}" closed (${why})`); }
  };
  // (a spawn that failed has no pid: no exit comes)
  child.on('error', (error) => { console.error(`room ${room.index}: ${error.message}`); if (child.pid === undefined) finish(error.message); });
  child.on('exit', (code, signal) => finish(code ?? signal));
}

/** Room 0 started again in 5 s (and again 5 s later while starting it fails). */
function relaunch(room) {
  clearTimeout(room.restart);
  room.restart = setTimeout(() => { if (shuttingDown) return; try { launch(room); } catch (error) { console.error(`room 0: ${error.message}`); relaunch(room); } }, 5000);
}

/** A room's server stopped: SIGTERM, then SIGKILL 10 s later if it is still there. */
function stop(room, why) {
  const child = room.child; if (!child || room.stopping) return;
  room.stopping = true; console.log(`room ${room.index} "${room.name}": ${why}, closing`);
  child.kill('SIGTERM'); setTimeout(() => { if (room.child === child) child.kill('SIGKILL'); }, 10000).unref();
}

// (every 5 s: each server's name, map and players — `info 49`, as the game's LAN search asks it)
const probe = dgram.createSocket('udp4');
probe.on('message', (bytes, from) => {
  const room = [...rooms.values()].find((r) => r.port === from.port), info = room && parseServerInfo(bytes);
  if (!info) return;
  room.info = info; room.seen = Date.now();
  // (the engine counts its human clients only: the bots are the room's own number)
  if (info.players > 0) room.idleSince = 0; else if (!room.idleSince) room.idleSince = Date.now();
});
probe.on('error', (error) => console.error(`probe: ${error.message}`));
probe.bind(0, '127.0.0.1');
const ask = (room) => { if (!shuttingDown) probe.send(Buffer.from('\xff\xff\xff\xffinfo 49', 'latin1'), room.port, '127.0.0.1'); };
const poll = setInterval(() => {
  for (const room of rooms.values()) {
    if (!room.child) continue;
    ask(room);
    // (silent a minute once it had answered: stuck — a created room goes, room 0 starts again)
    if (room.seen && Date.now() - room.seen > 60000) { room.stopping = false; stop(room, 'no answer for a minute'); continue; }
    if (!room.permanent && room.idleSince && Date.now() - room.idleSince > IDLE * 1000) stop(room, `${IDLE} s without players`);
  }
}, 5000);

const view = (r) => ({ index: r.index, port: r.port, name: r.info?.name || r.name, map: r.info?.map ?? r.map, players: (r.info?.players ?? 0) + r.bots,
  humans: r.info?.players ?? 0, maxPlayers: r.maxPlayers, bots: r.bots, options: r.options ?? {}, permanent: r.permanent, since: r.since,
  up: !!r.child && !r.stopping && Date.now() - (r.seen ?? 0) < 15000, closing: !!r.stopping });

/** A new room: the first free index, its server started, answered once it answers its info (20 s at most). */
async function create(request) {
  const checked = roomRequest(request, mp, MAPS);
  if (checked.error) return [400, { error: checked.error }];
  const { room: spec } = checked, by = typeof request?.by === 'string' ? request.by.slice(0, 64) : '';
  if ([...rooms.values()].some((r) => sameRoomName(r.name, spec.name) || (r.info?.name && sameRoomName(r.info.name, spec.name)))) return [409, { error: 'taken' }];
  if (by && [...rooms.values()].some((r) => r.by === by && !r.stopping)) return [409, { error: 'owned' }]; // (a closing one: not anymore)
  let index = 1; while (rooms.has(index) && index <= roomSlots(mp)) index++;
  if (index > roomSlots(mp)) return [503, { error: 'full' }];
  const room = { index, port: roomPort(mp, index), ...spec, by, key: randomBytes(16).toString('hex'), permanent: false, since: Date.now(), child: null, info: null, seen: 0, idleSince: Date.now() };
  rooms.set(index, room);
  try { launch(room); } catch (error) { rooms.delete(index); console.error(`room ${index}: ${error.message}`); return [503, { error: 'start' }]; }
  console.log(`room ${index} "${room.name}" on ${room.map}, ${room.maxPlayers} players, ${room.bots} bots`);
  for (let t = 0; t < 40 && rooms.get(index) === room; t++) { ask(room); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); if (room.seen) return [201, { room: view(room), key: room.key }]; }
  if (room.child) room.child.kill('SIGKILL'); else rooms.delete(index);
  return [503, { error: 'start' }];
}

const control = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  const send = (status, body) => { res.writeHead(status, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }); res.end(JSON.stringify(body)); };
  if (req.url === '/rooms' && req.method === 'GET') return send(200, { rooms: [...rooms.values()].map(view).sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index), maps: MAPS, slots: roomSlots(mp), maxPlayers: mp.maxPlayers ?? 16, bots: mp.rooms?.bots ? { max: mp.rooms.bots.max } : null });
  if (req.url === '/rooms' && req.method === 'POST' && mp.rooms) {
    let body = ''; req.on('data', (d) => { body += d; if (body.length > 4096) req.destroy(); });
    req.on('end', () => {
      let request; try { request = JSON.parse(body); } catch { return send(400, { error: 'json' }); }
      create(request).then(([status, out]) => send(status, out), (error) => { console.error(`create: ${error.message}`); send(500, { error: 'start' }); });
    });
    return;
  }
  // (a created room closed by its creator: the key its creation answered)
  const del = /^\/rooms\/(\d{1,2})$/.exec(req.url ?? '');
  if (del && req.method === 'DELETE') {
    let body = ''; req.on('data', (d) => { body += d; if (body.length > 512) req.destroy(); });
    req.on('end', () => {
      let key; try { key = JSON.parse(body)?.key; } catch { return send(400, { error: 'json' }); }
      const room = rooms.get(Number(del[1]));
      if (!room) return send(404, { error: 'none' });
      const given = Buffer.from(typeof key === 'string' ? key : ''), own = Buffer.from(room.key ?? '');
      if (room.permanent || !own.length || given.length !== own.length || !timingSafeEqual(given, own)) return send(403, { error: 'forbidden' });
      if (room.child) stop(room, 'closed by its creator'); else rooms.delete(room.index);
      send(200, { closed: room.index });
    });
    return;
  }
  send(404, { error: 'none' });
});
control.listen(mp.port, '127.0.0.1');

const permanent = { index: 0, port: mp.port, name: `Orthros - ${man.name}`, map: mp.map, maxPlayers: mp.maxPlayers ?? 16, bots: 0, permanent: true, since: Date.now(), child: null, info: null, seen: 0, idleSince: 0 };
rooms.set(0, permanent); launch(permanent);
for (const signal of ['SIGTERM', 'SIGINT']) process.on(signal, () => {
  shuttingDown = true; clearInterval(poll); clearTimeout(permanent.restart); control.close(); probe.close();
  for (const room of rooms.values()) room.child?.kill('SIGTERM');
  const done = setInterval(() => { if (![...rooms.values()].some((r) => r.child)) process.exit(0); }, 200);
  setTimeout(() => { clearInterval(done); for (const room of rooms.values()) room.child?.kill('SIGKILL'); process.exit(0); }, 8000);
});

```

`tools/goldsrc/status-lines.mjs`:

```mjs
// The players listed by the engine's `status` in a GoldSrc page's console (portSession.logs), for tools/goldsrc/check.mjs:
// after its "# score ping dev  playtime name" header, a line per client, bots included —
// "[07:34:55]  2    -1   57   mj 62.9879 qa-check-1-fgjvq". A name already on the server (the same account's earlier
// connection, until the server drops it) is played as "name (1)": still that player.

const PLAYER = /^\[[^\]]*\]\s+(\d+)\s+(-?\d+)\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+(.+?)(?: \((\d+)\))?$/;

/** One status line's player ({ slot, score, name, copy }), or null for any other line. */
export function playerLine(line) {
  const m = PLAYER.exec(line);
  return m && { slot: Number(m[1]), score: Number(m[2]), name: m[3], copy: m[4] === undefined ? 0 : Number(m[4]) };
}

/** The players of the last status printed in these logs (an empty list without one). */
export function lastStatus(logs) {
  const head = logs.findLastIndex((l) => /#\s+score\s+ping/.test(l));
  const players = [];
  for (let i = head + 1; head >= 0 && i < logs.length; i++) {
    const p = playerLine(logs[i]); if (!p) break;
    players.push(p);
  }
  return players;
}

/** The score a status in these logs gave this player (the latest one listing it), or null. */
export function scoreOf(logs, name) {
  for (let i = logs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = playerLine(logs[i]); if (p && p.name === name) return p.score; }
  return null;
}

/** Whether the engine finished entering a server in these logs: its "client connected at" line (developer messages,
 * the page's ?debug), written once every signon message arrived — the server's first menus (a team's) come after. */
export function signedOn(logs) {
  return logs.some((l) => l.includes('client connected at '));
}

/** The distance between two `viewpos` origins ("x y z", the "org ( ... )" line's), or NaN if either is missing. */
export function distance(before, after) {
  const a = before?.trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number), b = after?.trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number);
  if (a?.length !== 3 || b?.length !== 3 || [...a, ...b].some((v) => !Number.isFinite(v))) return NaN;
  return Math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]);
}

```

```mjs
async function saveProfile() {
  if (!profileDir) return;
  try {
    await page.evaluate(() => { window.orthros.profile = null; window.orthros.worker?.postMessage({ type: 'profile-dump' }); });
    let files = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !files; i++) { files = await page.evaluate(() => window.orthros.profile); if (!files) await page.waitForTimeout(100); }
    if (!files) { console.log('[profile] no profile received (not complete yet: nothing saved or removed)'); return; }
    for (const f of files) { const p = path.join(profileDir, f.path); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(p), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(p, Buffer.from(f.data, 'base64')); }
    // (a file loaded that the profile no longer has — the game deleted it, a manifest's profileMoves moved it — goes too)
    const gone = profileGone(profileLoaded, files); // (none without a complete profile: the worker answers null until then)
    for (const p of gone) fs.rmSync(path.join(profileDir, p), { force: true });
    console.log(`[profile] ${files.length} file(s) saved to ${profileDir}${gone.length ? `, ${gone.length} removed (${gone.slice(0, 4).join(', ')})` : ''}`);
  } catch (e) { console.log(`[profile] save failed: ${e.message.split('\n')[0]}`); }
}
```
