`tools/net-proxy.mjs`:

```mjs
// A player's connection in front of an Orthros server (measurement tool, docs/slow-network.md "Measuring"): an HTTP/2
// TLS proxy, as the production front (Cloudflare) speaks to Chrome — every request of the page on ONE connection, no
// six-connections-per-host queue as a local HTTP/1.1 server has (a synchronous game read queued behind six background
// downloads is a local artifact, not a player's) —, with a round trip and one downstream link whose rate the answers in
// transfer share equally (HTTP/2 interleaves its streams' frames), and the origin asked with `Accept-Encoding: gzip, br`
// (Cloudflare's: no zstd); a text answer the origin sends as it is goes gzip-compressed on the way (Cloudflare's
// `cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC`: /api/regions/<manifest> 1065 KB → 136 KB on the live site).
//
//   node tools/net-proxy.mjs --upstream http://127.0.0.1:18431 --listen 18443 --rate 7m --rtt 75 [--log <file>] [--certs <dir>] [--http1]
//
// The page is then https://127.0.0.1:18443/ (Chrome with --ignore-certificate-errors, or trusting the key of the
// self-signed certificate made with openssl in --certs, default a new temporary directory). --log: one JSON line per
// request — t (ms from the proxy's start), method, url, kind (demand: the game's own read `&s=`, bg: `&p=1`, ahead:
// `&a=1`, other), status, wire (body bytes sent + ~200 of headers), enc, unit (X-Orthros-Unit: hit, raw, miss, none),
// first (ms to the first byte), ms (total), reset when the browser cancelled it —, and a line { t, mark, url } for each
// data report carrying a mark (`/api/prefetch/<manifest>` POSTs with `mark`: a page's or worker's "playable"), which
// GET /__proxy/marks lists (not forwarded). --http1: plain HTTP/1.1 (a Node client: tools/prepare-bench.mjs).
// tools/data-matrix.mjs, tools/prepare-bench.mjs and tools/openmw/place-load.mjs use startProxy; the log's readers
// (readLog, summarize: the run's bytes by kind; loadWindow: a stretch of it — the game's own reads, their spacing, and
// the background's bytes by kind and file category) and the origin behind it (startOrigin: an Orthros server of a code
// tree on a measurement's copies, spkiOf, freePort) are theirs too.
import http from 'node:http';
import net from 'node:net';
import http2 from 'node:http2';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync, spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import zlib from 'node:zlib';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
/** "7m" / "85k" / "7000000" → bytes per second */
export function parseRate(s) { const m = /^([\d.]+)\s*([kKmM]?)/.exec(String(s)); if (!m) return NaN; return Number(m[1]) * (m[2].toLowerCase() === 'm' ? 1e6 : m[2].toLowerCase() === 'k' ? 1e3 : 1); }

/**
 * The downstream link: `rate` bytes/s shared equally by the streams with bytes to send (round robin in quanta of
 * QUANTUM bytes every tick), each stream's bytes in order.
 */
export class Shaper {
  constructor(rate, { now = () => performance.now(), tickMs = 2 } = {}) {
    this.rate = rate / 1000; this.now = now; this.tickMs = tickMs;
    /** streams with bytes waiting: { queue: Buffer[], write(buf), end?, onDone } */
    this.active = []; this.credit = 0; this.last = now(); this.timer = null; this.rr = 0;
  }
  /** queue `buf` on stream `s` (s.write(chunk) gets it once its share of the link carried it) */
  push(s, buf) { s.queue ??= []; s.queue.push(buf); if (!this.active.includes(s)) this.active.push(s); this.start(); }
  /** the stream's last byte queued: s.onEnd() runs once all of it crossed the link */
  finish(s) { s.ending = true; if (!s.queue?.length) { s.onEnd?.(); return; } if (!this.active.includes(s)) this.active.push(s); this.start(); }
  drop(s) { s.queue = []; s.dropped = true; this.active = this.active.filter((x) => x !== s); }
  start() { if (this.timer === null) { this.last = this.now(); this.timer = setInterval(() => this.tick(), this.tickMs); } }
  tick() {
    const now = this.now();
    // (credit of the idle link not hoarded: at most one tick's worth beyond what the streams take)
    this.credit = Math.min(this.credit + (now - this.last) * this.rate, Math.max(this.rate * this.tickMs * 4, 16384));
    this.last = now;
    while (this.credit >= 1 && this.active.length) {
      const n = this.active.length, share = Math.max(1, Math.floor(this.credit / n));
      for (const s of [...this.active]) {
        let give = Math.min(share, this.credit);
        while (give > 0 && s.queue.length) {
          const b = s.queue[0];
          if (b.length <= give) { s.queue.shift(); give -= b.length; this.credit -= b.length; s.write(b); }
          else { s.queue[0] = b.subarray(give); this.credit -= give; s.write(b.subarray(0, give)); give = 0; }
        }
        if (!s.queue.length) { this.active = this.active.filter((x) => x !== s); if (s.ending) s.onEnd?.(); }
      }
      if (share <= 1) break;
    }
    if (!this.active.length) { clearInterval(this.timer); this.timer = null; this.credit = 0; }
  }
}

function makeCert(dir) {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const key = path.join(dir, 'key.pem'), cert = path.join(dir, 'cert.pem');
  if (!fs.existsSync(key)) execFileSync('openssl', ['req', '-x509', '-newkey', 'rsa:2048', '-nodes', '-keyout', key, '-out', cert, '-days', '30', '-subj', '/CN=127.0.0.1', '-addext', 'subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1,DNS:localhost'], { stdio: 'ignore' });
  return { key: fs.readFileSync(key), cert: fs.readFileSync(cert) };
}

const HOP = new Set(['connection', 'keep-alive', 'transfer-encoding', 'upgrade', 'proxy-connection', 'te', 'host', 'http2-settings']);

/** a text answer the origin sent as it is: the front compresses it (Cloudflare) */
const EDGE_TEXT = /^(text\/|application\/(json|javascript|xml|wasm)|image\/svg)/;

/**
 * The proxy: a promise of { server, port, marks, close() } — opts: { upstream (URL or host:port), listen (port, 0:
 * any), rate (bytes/s), rtt (ms), log (file or null), certs (directory of the certificate), http1, edgeGzip (true) }.
 */
export function startProxy({ upstream, listen = 0, rate, rtt = 0, log = null, certs, http1 = false, edgeGzip = true }) {
  const up = new URL(/^https?:/.test(upstream) ? upstream : `http://${upstream}`);
  const agent = new http.Agent({ keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 256 });
  const shaper = new Shaper(rate);
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const out = log ? fs.createWriteStream(log) : null;
  const marks = [];
  const half = rtt / 2;
  const handler = (req, res) => {
    const start = performance.now(), url = req.url;
    // (the runner's view of the marks seen: not forwarded, not throttled)
    if (url === '/__proxy/marks') { res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': 'application/json' }); res.end(JSON.stringify(marks)); return; }
    const kind = /[?&]s=/.test(url) ? 'demand' : /[?&]a=1/.test(url) ? 'ahead' : /[?&]p=1/.test(url) ? 'bg' : 'other';
    let sent = 0, ttfb = -1, reset = false, ended = false, enc = null, unit = null, status = 0;
    const s = { write: (b) => { sent += b.length; try { res.write(b); } catch { /* gone */ } }, onEnd: () => { if (ended) return; ended = true; try { res.end(); } catch { /* gone */ } } };
    const done = () => out?.write(JSON.stringify({ t: Math.round(start - t0), method: req.method, url, kind, status, wire: sent + 200, enc, unit, first: ttfb < 0 ? null : Math.round(ttfb), ms: Math.round(performance.now() - start), ...(reset ? { reset: true } : {}) }) + '\n');
    res.on('close', () => { if (!ended) { reset = true; shaper.drop(s); } done(); });
    const headers = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(req.headers)) if (!k.startsWith(':') && !HOP.has(k)) headers[k] = v;
    headers.host = up.host;
    if (headers['accept-encoding'] !== undefined) headers['accept-encoding'] = 'gzip, br'; // (Cloudflare's to the origin)
    // (a data report's mark, seen as it goes by)
    const body = [];
    if (req.method === 'POST' && url.startsWith('/api/prefetch/')) req.on('data', (c) => body.push(c));
    req.on('end', () => {
      if (!body.length) return;
      try { const j = JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(body).toString('utf8')); if (j?.mark) { const m = { t: Math.round(start - t0), mark: j.mark, url }; marks.push(m); out?.write(JSON.stringify(m) + '\n'); } } catch { /* not JSON */ }
    });
    // (the request crosses half the round trip before the origin sees it)
    const ureq = http.request({ host: up.hostname, port: up.port, method: req.method, path: url, headers, agent }, (ures) => {
      // (its headers cross the other half)
      const h = {};
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(ures.headers)) if (!HOP.has(k)) h[k] = v;
      status = ures.statusCode; enc = ures.headers['content-encoding'] ?? null; unit = ures.headers['x-orthros-unit'] ?? null;
      let src = ures;
      if (edgeGzip && !enc && status === 200 && /gzip/.test(String(req.headers['accept-encoding'] ?? '')) && EDGE_TEXT.test(String(ures.headers['content-type'] ?? ''))
        && !(Number(ures.headers['content-length']) < 1024)) {
        src = ures.pipe(zlib.createGzip({ level: 6 })); enc = h['content-encoding'] = 'gzip'; delete h['content-length'];
      }
      const pending = [];
      let upEnded = false, headSent = false;
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (reset) { ures.destroy(); return; }
        try { res.writeHead(status, h); } catch { ures.destroy(); return; }
        headSent = true; ttfb = performance.now() - start;
        for (const b of pending.splice(0)) shaper.push(s, b);
        if (upEnded) shaper.finish(s);
      }, half);
      src.on('data', (b) => { if (reset) return; if (headSent) shaper.push(s, b); else pending.push(b); });
      src.on('end', () => { upEnded = true; if (headSent && !reset) shaper.finish(s); });
      ures.on('error', () => { try { res.destroy(); } catch { /* gone */ } });
    });
    ureq.on('error', () => { try { res.writeHead(502); res.end(); } catch { /* gone */ } });
    res.on('close', () => { if (reset) ureq.destroy(); });
    // (the request's body, if any, held for half the round trip with it)
    const held = [];
    let reqEnded = false, go = false;
    req.on('data', (c) => { if (go) ureq.write(c); else held.push(c); });
    req.on('end', () => { reqEnded = true; if (go) ureq.end(); });
    setTimeout(() => { if (reset) return; go = true; for (const c of held) ureq.write(c); if (reqEnded) ureq.end(); }, half);
  };
  const server = http1 ? http.createServer(handler) : http2.createSecureServer({ ...makeCert(certs ?? fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-proxy-'))), allowHTTP1: true, settings: { initialWindowSize: 16 << 20 } }, handler);
  return new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(Number(listen), '127.0.0.1', () => resolve({
    server, port: server.address().port, marks,
    close: () => new Promise((r) => { out?.end(); server.close(() => r()); setTimeout(r, 2000).unref?.(); }),
  })));
}

/** the base64 SHA-256 of the proxy certificate's key: the browser trusts it (--ignore-certificate-errors-spki-list) */
export const spkiOf = (dir) => execFileSync('bash', ['-c', `openssl x509 -in ${JSON.stringify(path.join(dir, 'cert.pem'))} -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform der | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary | base64`], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
/** a free local port */
export const freePort = () => new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const s = net.createServer(); s.on('error', reject); s.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => { const { port } = s.address(); s.close(() => resolve(port)); }); });

/**
 * The origin behind the proxy for a measurement: the Orthros server of the code tree `tree` (its src/host/server.js)
 * on a port of its own, with the measurement's directories — `learn` (a fresh copy: the run's reports land there),
 * `telemetry`, `brcache` (always given: the default <learn>/../brcache would start making units; served `frozen`, none
 * made), `covers` (a directory or 'off'), `gamesDir`, `enginesDir` —, its output in `log`; ready once it listens, the
 * page's modules then made brotli as on a server up for a while (every src text file asked until all come so).
 * A promise of { port, close() }.
 */
export async function startOrigin({ tree, learn, telemetry, brcache, frozen = true, covers = 'off', gamesDir, enginesDir, log, warmSrc = true }) {
  const port = await freePort();
  const srv = spawn(process.execPath, [path.join(tree, 'src/host/server.js'), '--port', String(port), '--learn', learn, '--telemetry', telemetry,
    '--br-cache', brcache, ...(frozen ? ['--br-cache-frozen'] : []), '--covers', covers, '--games-dir', gamesDir, '--engines-dir', enginesDir], { cwd: tree, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  if (log) { const w = fs.createWriteStream(log); srv.stdout.pipe(w); srv.stderr.pipe(w); }
  const exited = new Promise((r) => srv.on('exit', r));
  await new Promise((resolve) => { const on = (d) => { if (String(d).includes('orthros: http')) { srv.stdout.off('data', on); resolve(); } }; srv.stdout.on('data', on); srv.on('exit', resolve); setTimeout(resolve, 30000); });
  if (srv.exitCode !== null) throw new Error(`origin: the server exited (${srv.exitCode})${log ? `, see ${log}` : ''}`);
  if (warmSrc) {
    const srcFiles = []; const walk = (d) => { for (const e of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) { const f = path.join(d, e.name); if (e.isDirectory()) walk(f); else if (/\.(m?js|html|css|json|svg|txt)$/.test(e.name) && fs.statSync(f).size >= 512) srcFiles.push(path.relative(tree, f)); } };
    walk(path.join(tree, 'src'));
    for (let pass = 0, left = srcFiles; pass < 8 && left.length; pass++) {
      const next = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < left.length; i += 16) await Promise.all(left.slice(i, i + 16).map(async (f) => { const r = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/${f}`, { headers: { 'accept-encoding': 'br' } }).catch(() => null); await r?.arrayBuffer().catch(() => {}); if (r && r.headers.get('content-encoding') !== 'br' && r.status === 200) next.push(f); }));
      left = next; if (left.length) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));
    }
  }
  return { port, close: () => { srv.kill('SIGTERM'); return Promise.race([exited, new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5000))]); } };
}

/** A proxy log's lines (a file, gzip too): requests and marks, by request start (`t`; lines are written as they close). */
export function readLog(file) {
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(file); const text = (file.endsWith('.gz') ? zlib.gunzipSync(raw) : raw).toString('utf8');
  const recs = []; for (const l of text.split('\n')) { if (!l) continue; try { recs.push(JSON.parse(l)); } catch { /* a line cut by a kill */ } }
  return recs.sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
}

/**
 * A request's kind from its URL (the backend's rangeUrl): game data (/gamez/, /game/) read for the game itself —
 * 'demand' —, fetched ahead of it as its own read ('ahead': `a=1`, which carries the session `s=` too: the proxy's own
 * `kind` counts it as demand), announced by its engine as its next reads ('want': `w=1`, HttpBackend.wantList — the load's own
 * bytes, fetched in parallel) or in the background ('bg': `p=1`); anything else 'other'.
 */
export function urlKind(url) {
  if (!url.startsWith('/gamez/') && !url.startsWith('/game/')) return 'other';
  return /[?&]w=1/.test(url) ? 'want' : /[?&]p=1/.test(url) ? 'bg' : /[?&]a=1/.test(url) ? 'ahead' : 'demand';
}

/** A game data request's { manifest, path (decoded, without the light copies' folder), light, decoded (bytes, from `r=a-b`; null: the file) }, else null. */
export function dataRead(url) {
  const m = /^\/gamez?\/([^/?]+)\/([^?]*)(?:\?(.*))?$/.exec(url); if (!m) return null;
  let p; try { p = m[2].split('/').map(decodeURIComponent).join('/'); } catch { p = m[2]; }
  const light = p.startsWith('.light/'); if (light) p = p.slice(7);
  const r = /(?:^|&)r=(\d+)-(\d+)/.exec(m[3] ?? '');
  return { manifest: decodeURIComponent(m[1]), path: p, light, decoded: r ? Number(r[2]) - Number(r[1]) : null };
}

/** The file categories of loadWindow, the first that matches wins (`folders`: a path segment's name, any case). */
export const FILE_FOLDERS = ['Video', 'Splash', 'Music', 'Sound'];
/**
 * A game data read's category: 'upgrade' (the full file of a light copy read earlier: `lightSeen` has its path),
 * 'light', a folder of `folders`, then by format — 'texture' (dds, tga, bmp, ktx), 'mesh' (nif, kf, x), 'archive'
 * (bsa, ba2, pak, big, wad), 'content' (esm, esp, omwaddon, omwgame), '_engine' (the engine release's own data) —,
 * else 'other'.
 */
export function fileCategory(read, { lightSeen = null, folders = FILE_FOLDERS } = {}) {
  if (read.light) return 'light';
  if (lightSeen?.has(read.path)) return 'upgrade';
  if (read.path.startsWith('_engine/')) return '_engine';
  const segs = read.path.toLowerCase().split('/').slice(0, -1);
  for (const f of folders) if (segs.includes(f.toLowerCase())) return f;
  const ext = /\.([^./]+)$/.exec(read.path)?.[1]?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
  if (/^(dds|tga|bmp|ktx2?)$/.test(ext)) return 'texture';
  if (/^(nif|kf|x)$/.test(ext)) return 'mesh';
  if (/^(bsa|ba2|pak|big|wad)$/.test(ext)) return 'archive';
  if (/^(esm|esp|omwaddon|omwgame)$/.test(ext)) return 'content';
  return 'other';
}

const quant = (a, p) => { if (!a.length) return null; const s = [...a].sort((x, y) => x - y); return Math.round(s[Math.min(s.length - 1, Math.floor(s.length * p))]); };
const q3 = (a) => ({ p10: quant(a, 0.1), p50: quant(a, 0.5), p90: quant(a, 0.9) });

/**
 * A stretch [from, to] of a proxy log (ms, its clock; `recs` the whole log, readLog): the game's own reads that started
 * in it — count, decoded and wire bytes (light copies apart), start-to-start spacing, time to the first byte, transfer
 * (after the first byte), idle (from a read's end to the next one's start), the time at least one was in flight
 * (waitMs) —, the announced ranges that started in it (want: count, decoded and wire bytes — the load's own, not
 * background) and the wire bytes every request carried during it (an answer spanning an edge counted for its share of
 * time inside) by kind (demand, ahead, want, bg, other) and, for game data other than the game's own reads and announced ones, by kind × file
 * category (fileCategory; 'upgrade': a light copy read earlier in the log, at any time before that request).
 */
export function loadWindow(recs, from, to, { folders = FILE_FOLDERS } = {}) {
  const lightSeen = new Set(), demand = [], wanted = [], byKind = {}, byCategory = {}, bgByCategory = {};
  let bgWire = 0;
  const MB = (n) => Math.round(n / 1e4) / 100;
  for (const r of recs) {
    if (r.mark || r.url === undefined) continue;
    const kind = urlKind(r.url), read = kind === 'other' ? null : dataRead(r.url);
    const end = r.t + (r.ms ?? 0), inside = Math.max(0, Math.min(to, end) - Math.max(from, r.t));
    const share = end > r.t ? inside / (end - r.t) : (r.t >= from && r.t <= to ? 1 : 0);
    if (share > 0) {
      const w = r.wire * share;
      byKind[kind] = (byKind[kind] ?? 0) + w;
      if (read && kind !== 'demand' && kind !== 'want') {
        const c = fileCategory(read, { lightSeen, folders });
        bgWire += w; byCategory[c] = (byCategory[c] ?? 0) + w;
        (bgByCategory[kind] ??= {})[c] = (bgByCategory[kind][c] ?? 0) + w;
      }
    }
    if (read && kind === 'want' && r.t >= from && r.t <= to) wanted.push({ wire: r.wire, decoded: read.decoded ?? 0 });
    if (read && kind === 'demand' && r.t >= from && r.t <= to) demand.push({ t: r.t, end, first: r.first, ms: r.ms, wire: r.wire, decoded: read.decoded ?? 0, light: read.light });
    if (read?.light) lightSeen.add(read.path);
  }
  const spacing = demand.slice(1).map((d, i) => d.t - demand[i].t);
  const idle = []; let lastEnd = -Infinity;
  for (const d of demand) { if (lastEnd > -Infinity) idle.push(Math.max(0, d.t - lastEnd)); lastEnd = Math.max(lastEnd, d.end); }
  let waitMs = 0, cur = null;
  for (const d of demand) { const b = Math.min(to, d.end); if (!cur || d.t > cur[1]) { if (cur) waitMs += cur[1] - cur[0]; cur = [d.t, b]; } else cur[1] = Math.max(cur[1], b); }
  if (cur) waitMs += cur[1] - cur[0];
  const sum = (a, k) => a.reduce((n, d) => n + d[k], 0), lights = demand.filter((d) => d.light);
  const mbOf = (o) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(o).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([k, v]) => [k, MB(v)]));
  return {
    ms: Math.round(to - from),
    demand: {
      count: demand.length, decodedMB: MB(sum(demand, 'decoded')), wireMB: MB(sum(demand, 'wire')),
      light: { count: lights.length, decodedMB: MB(sum(lights, 'decoded')), wireMB: MB(sum(lights, 'wire')) },
      spacing: q3(spacing), ttfb: q3(demand.filter((d) => d.first !== null && d.first !== undefined).map((d) => d.first)),
      transfer: q3(demand.filter((d) => d.first !== null && d.first !== undefined).map((d) => d.ms - d.first)), idle: q3(idle), waitMs: Math.round(waitMs),
    },
    want: { count: wanted.length, decodedMB: MB(sum(wanted, 'decoded')), wireMB: MB(sum(wanted, 'wire')) },
    wireMB: mbOf(byKind), backgroundMB: MB(bgWire), backgroundByCategory: mbOf(byCategory),
    backgroundByKind: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(bgByCategory).map(([k, v]) => [k, mbOf(v)])),
  };
}

/**
 * The proxy log's summary up to `until` ms (its own clock): bytes and requests by kind, unit answers, demand-wait.
 * `recs`: the log's request lines.
 */
export function summarize(recs, until = Infinity) {
  const kinds = {}; let wire = 0, requests = 0, gz = 0, units = { hit: 0, raw: 0, miss: 0, none: 0 }, unitWire = { hit: 0, raw: 0, miss: 0, none: 0 };
  const demand = [];
  for (const r of recs) {
    if (r.mark || r.t > until) continue;
    // (the game's own reads: no `p=1`, `a=1` nor `w=1` — `&s=` when the backend has a session, nothing for a port's data
    // worker; `want`: the ranges an engine announced it reads next, fetched in parallel — HttpBackend.wantList)
    const k = r.url.startsWith('/gamez/') || r.url.startsWith('/game/') ? (/[?&]w=1/.test(r.url) ? 'want' : /[?&][pa]=1/.test(r.url) ? 'background' : 'demand') : r.url.startsWith('/src/') ? 'src' : r.url.startsWith('/engines/') ? 'engine' : r.url.startsWith('/api/') ? 'api' : 'page';
    const s = (kinds[k] ??= { requests: 0, wire: 0 }); s.requests++; s.wire += r.wire; wire += r.wire; requests++;
    if (k === 'demand' || k === 'background' || k === 'want') { gz++; const u = r.unit ?? 'none'; units[u] = (units[u] ?? 0) + 1; unitWire[u] = (unitWire[u] ?? 0) + r.wire; }
    if (k === 'demand') demand.push([r.t, Math.min(until, r.t + r.ms)]);
  }
  demand.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
  let waitMs = 0, cur = null;
  for (const [a, b] of demand) { if (!cur || a > cur[1]) { if (cur) waitMs += cur[1] - cur[0]; cur = [a, b]; } else cur[1] = Math.max(cur[1], b); }
  if (cur) waitMs += cur[1] - cur[0];
  const MB = (n) => Math.round(n / 1e4) / 100;
  return {
    wireMB: MB(wire), requests, byKind: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(kinds).map(([k, v]) => [k, { requests: v.requests, MB: MB(v.wire) }])),
    dataRequests: gz, units, unitMB: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(unitWire).map(([k, v]) => [k, MB(v)])), demandWaitS: Math.round(waitMs / 100) / 10,
  };
}

if (import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`) {
  const upstream = opt('upstream'), listen = opt('listen', '18443');
  const rate = parseRate(opt('rate', '7m')), rtt = Number(opt('rtt', '75'));
  if (!upstream || !(rate > 0)) { console.error('usage: node tools/net-proxy.mjs --upstream http://127.0.0.1:<port> [--listen 18443] [--rate 7m] [--rtt 75] [--log file] [--certs dir] [--http1]'); process.exit(2); }
  await startProxy({ upstream, listen, rate, rtt, log: opt('log'), certs: opt('certs'), http1: args.includes('--http1') });
  console.log(`[proxy] ${args.includes('--http1') ? 'http' : 'https'}://127.0.0.1:${listen}/ -> ${upstream}, ${(rate / 1e6).toFixed(2)} MB/s, ${rtt} ms round trip`);
}
```

`tools/nexus-get.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# A Nexus Mods file downloaded through Nexus' public API, the way mod managers (Vortex) do — no website scraping, no
# CAPTCHA: the API key (NEXUS_API_KEY in /srv/orthros/.env, Site preferences > API Access) and, for an account
# without Premium, the "Mod manager download" link the player clicks on the file's page (nxm://<game>/mods/<mod>/files/
# <file>?key=…&expires=…: valid a few minutes). With Premium, a mod page URL with file_id is enough.
# The archive goes to its own new folder (untrusted data) with a receipt (mod, file, version, URL taken, size, MD5 checked
# against Nexus' own, SHA-256). Also --info <mod url or id>: the mod's files (ids, categories, versions).
# Usage: python3 -I tools/nexus-get.py <nxm://… | https://www.nexusmods.com/<game>/mods/<id>?tab=files&file_id=<f>> [--out <dir>]
#        python3 -I tools/nexus-get.py --info <https://www.nexusmods.com/<game>/mods/<id> | id> [--game morrowind]
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, re, sys, urllib.parse, urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
API = 'https://api.nexusmods.com/v1'

def env(name):
    if os.environ.get(name):
        return os.environ[name]
    f = ROOT / '.env'
    if f.exists():
        for line in f.read_text().splitlines():
            m = re.match(rf'^{name}=(.*)$', line.strip())
            if m:
                return m.group(1).strip()
    sys.exit(f'{name} is not set (put it in {f})')

def call(path, params=None):
    url = f'{API}{path}' + ('?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(params) if params else '')
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'apikey': env('NEXUS_API_KEY'), 'Application-Name': 'orthros', 'Application-Version': '1.0',
                                               'User-Agent': 'orthros-nexus-get/1.0'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
            return json.load(r)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        sys.exit(f'Nexus API {e.code} on {path}: {e.read().decode(errors="replace")[:300]}')

def parse(link):
    u = urllib.parse.urlparse(link)
    q = dict(urllib.parse.parse_qsl(u.query))
    if u.scheme == 'nxm':
        m = re.match(r'^/mods/(\d+)/files/(\d+)$', u.path)
        if not m:
            sys.exit(f'Not an nxm file link: {link}')
        return u.netloc, m.group(1), m.group(2), {k: q[k] for k in ('key', 'expires') if k in q}
    m = re.match(r'^/([^/]+)/mods/(\d+)', u.path)
    if not m or 'file_id' not in q:
        sys.exit(f'Expected nxm://… or a mod page URL with file_id: {link}')
    return m.group(1), m.group(2), q['file_id'], {}

def main(argv):
    if not argv:
        sys.exit(__doc__ or 'usage: nexus-get.py <link> [--out dir] | --info <mod>')
    game = argv[argv.index('--game') + 1] if '--game' in argv else 'morrowind'
    if argv[0] == '--info':
        target = argv[1]
        m = re.search(r'/([^/]+)/mods/(\d+)', target)
        game, mod = (m.group(1), m.group(2)) if m else (game, target)
        info = call(f'/games/{game}/mods/{mod}.json')
        print(f"{info['name']} {info['version']} (updated {info.get('updated_time')}) by {info.get('author')}\n{info.get('summary', '')}")
        for f in call(f'/games/{game}/mods/{mod}/files.json')['files']:
            print(f"  {f['file_id']}  {f['category_name'] or '-':<14} v{f['version'] or '-':<8} {f['size_kb']:>8} KB  {f['name']}")
        return
    game, mod, file_id, auth = parse(argv[0])
    info = call(f'/games/{game}/mods/{mod}.json')
    meta = call(f'/games/{game}/mods/{mod}/files/{file_id}.json')
    links = call(f'/games/{game}/mods/{mod}/files/{file_id}/download_link.json', auth or None)
    if not links:
        sys.exit('Nexus returned no download link')
    # (the CDN's address carries the file name as is: spaces and brackets quoted, its query kept)
    u = urllib.parse.urlsplit(links[0]['URI'])
    url = urllib.parse.urlunsplit((u.scheme, u.netloc, urllib.parse.quote(urllib.parse.unquote(u.path)), u.query, u.fragment))
    out = pathlib.Path(argv[argv.index('--out') + 1]) if '--out' in argv else ROOT / 'data/installers/nexus' / f'{game}-{mod}-{file_id}'
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    try:
        fetch(url, out, meta, info, game, mod, file_id)
    except BaseException:
        for f in out.iterdir(): f.unlink()
        out.rmdir()
        raise

def fetch(url, out, meta, info, game, mod, file_id):
    name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._ -]', '_', meta.get('file_name') or f'{file_id}.bin')
    target = out / name
    md5, sha = hashlib.md5(), hashlib.sha256()
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'orthros-nexus-get/1.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=600) as r, open(target, 'wb') as w:
        while chunk := r.read(1 << 20):
            w.write(chunk); md5.update(chunk); sha.update(chunk)
    if meta.get('md5') and meta['md5'] != md5.hexdigest():
        target.unlink()
        sys.exit(f'MD5 mismatch: Nexus says {meta["md5"]}, got {md5.hexdigest()}')
    os.chmod(target, 0o644)
    receipt = {'game': game, 'mod': int(mod), 'modName': info['name'], 'author': info.get('author'), 'fileId': int(file_id),
               'fileName': meta.get('file_name'), 'name': meta.get('name'), 'version': meta.get('version'), 'category': meta.get('category_name'),
               'page': f'https://www.nexusmods.com/{game}/mods/{mod}?tab=files&file_id={file_id}', 'bytes': target.stat().st_size,
               'md5': md5.hexdigest(), 'md5CheckedAgainstNexus': bool(meta.get('md5')), 'sha256': sha.hexdigest(),
               'downloadedAt': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec='seconds')}
    (out / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(sys.argv[1:])
```

`tools/node-gfx.mjs`:

```mjs
// The Direct3D output of a headless Node run (tools/framebench.mjs, tools/startbench.mjs --gfx): the WebGL backend over a
// no-op WebGL2 context (`backend`: the in-thread path, ?glworker=0), the render worker's recorder with its commands
// dropped (`recorder`: what the default render worker leaves on the emulator thread), or nothing (`none`: the device's
// own bookkeeping only). Emulator-thread costs of a real game's frames, without a browser or a GPU.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { WebGLDevice } from '../src/gfx/d3d8-webgl.js';
import { RenderLink, Recorder } from '../src/gfx/d3d-recorder.js';
import { noopGl } from './noop-gl.mjs';
import { PROGRAM_GLSL_VERSION, ffKeyRegenerable } from '../src/gfx/program-id.js';

/**
 * Install `kind` on the headless host. `programs`: a learned programs2-<manifest>.json (compiled ahead by the
 * backend, as a session does; `raw`: with their learned sources, keys dropped).
 * @param {any} host HeadlessHost
 * @param {'backend'|'recorder'|'none'} kind
 * @param {{ programs?: string|null, raw?: boolean, log?: (l: string) => void }} [o]
 * @returns {{ kind: string, link: any, pcache: any, device: () => any }}
 */
export function installNodeGfx(host, kind, o = {}) {
  let pcache = null, dev = null, link = null;
  if (o.programs) {
    const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(o.programs, 'utf8')), sessions = Number(j.sessions) || 0;
    const list = j.programs.filter((r) => r[8] === PROGRAM_GLSL_VERSION || ffKeyRegenerable(r[1]) || ((r[8] ?? null) === null && r[7] >= sessions + 1 - 4)).sort((a, b) => a[5] - b[5]);
    pcache = { queue: list.map(([id, key, vs, fs2, attrs, , , , v]) => ({ id, key: o.raw ? '' : key, vs, fs: fs2, attrs, v })), ready: new Map(), learned: [], used: [], t0: performance.now(), parallel: true, started: 0, pending: 0, hits: 0, devices: new Set() };
    o.log?.(`programs: ${list.length} of ${j.programs.length} learned listed${o.raw ? ' (keys dropped: their sources as learned)' : ''}`);
  }
  if (kind === 'backend') { const gl = noopGl(); host.gfx = { createDevice: (d) => (dev = new WebGLDevice(gl, d, { programCache: pcache })) }; }
  else if (kind === 'recorder') {
    const words = new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(16 << 20));
    link = new RenderLink({ words, replayer: { reader: { consumed: 0 }, run() { this.reader.consumed = link.w.produced; } } });
    link.drain = function () { this.w.consumed = this.replayer.reader.consumed = this.w.produced; };
    host.gfx = { createDevice: (d) => (dev = new Recorder(link, d)) };
  } else if (kind !== 'none') throw new Error(`--gfx ${kind}: backend, recorder or none`);
  return { kind, link, pcache, device: () => dev };
}

/** The programs line of a run with learned programs (backend): built at a draw, compiled ahead, taken. */
export function programsLine(g) {
  const d = g.device();
  if (!g.pcache || !d?.stats) return null;
  const p = g.pcache;
  return `programs: built at a draw ${d.stats.programs} (${(d.stats.programMs ?? 0).toFixed(0)} ms), learned compiled ahead ${p.started}, taken ${p.hits}, regenerated from their key ${p.regenerated ?? 0}, other versions skipped ${p.stale ?? 0}`;
}
```

`tools/node-scenario.mjs`:

```mjs
// Harness scenarios (tools/scenarios/*.txt, the language of tools/headless.mjs --input) played in Node without a page:
// tools/startbench.mjs --input <file>. Mouse and keyboard events are queued on the headless host as the browser host
// queues them (the steps parsed by the page's own src/host/scenario.js: `#` comment lines, new lines or `;` between
// steps); `waitframe:min,max[,min2,max2...]` anchors on the Direct3D device's draws per frame (vm.d3dDevice), `mark:<label>` closes
// a phase and prints its guest instructions and the guest category's time per instruction (frame accounting, as the
// browser's phase reports), its frame-time percentiles and the APIs that took the most time ([apitop]: ms and calls per
// frame, µs per call), `dbg:ORTHROS_JIT_AB=<json>` switches the JIT's translation options (Jit.switchOpts), the
// API-layer switches (dbg:ORTHROS_API_OPT_OFF=1, ORTHROS_FX_BIND_OFF=1...) and other ORTHROS_* debug globals are set as
// the browser worker sets them. Other
// kinds (shot, profile, capture...) are ignored. Times are real seconds from the start, from the anchor after a wait
// (or `+t` from the first Direct3D frame), as in the harness.
import { acct, C as ACCT, FrameStats, N_CATS } from '../src/core/frame-acct.js';
import { scanCodeOfVk } from '../src/win32/dinput8.js';
import { BLOCK_COUNTS_BASE } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { refreshApiOpt } from '../src/core/api-opt.js';
import { parseScenario, inRanges, ScenarioPlayer } from '../src/host/scenario.js';
import { hostWaiter, injectedQuantum, adaptiveOn } from '../src/core/host-wait.js';

const POINTER_KINDS = new Set(['move', 'click', 'rclick', 'down', 'up']);

export class NodeScenario {
  /**
   * @param {string} text scenario
   * @param {any} vm
   * @param {(line: string) => void} log
   * @param {() => number} [nowMs]
   * @param {{ from?: [number, number] | null }} [opts] from: the display the pointer coordinates were written for (a
   *   bench scenario's `coords`): scaled to the game's display as the page's bench player scales them
   */
  constructor(text, vm, log, nowMs = () => performance.now(), opts = {}) {
    this.rootVm = vm; this.log = log; this.nowMs = nowMs; // (the time base: wall time, or a virtual clock's for a deterministic run)
    // (the page's own scaling: the device's back buffer once there is one, the host's display before)
    this.scaler = new ScenarioPlayer([], { from: opts.from ?? null, display: () => { const pp = this.vm.d3dDevice?.pp, d = vm.host.display; return pp?.width ? [pp.width, pp.height] : d ? [d.width, d.height] : null; } });
    const { steps, errors } = parseScenario(text);
    if (errors.length) throw new Error(`scenario: ${errors.join('; ')}`);
    this.events = steps.map((st) => ({ t: st.t, rel: st.rel, anchored: st.anchored, kind: st.kind, args: st.args, done: false }));
    this.t0 = this.nowMs(); this.anchorAt = null; this.firstFrameAt = null;
    this.pending = []; // [time ms, input event] (button releases, key ups)
    this.phase = null; this.nextCheck = 0;
    this.results = [];
    // (frame intervals per phase, from the Direct3D presents: percentiles in the phase report)
    this.frameDts = []; this.lastPresentAt = 0;
    // (every frame's categories, as the browser host keeps them: the phase reports' slow frames by category, the same
    // FrameStats report as the page's [frames] lines; the categories summed per phase for its totals)
    this.frameAcct = new FrameStats(); this.phaseCats = new Float64Array(N_CATS);
    this.slowApis = null; this.gc = null; // (enableSlowApis, enableGc)
    if (!vm.host.frameHook) vm.host.frameHook = () => this.framePresented();
  }
  framePresented() {
    const n = this.nowMs(), cats = acct.frame();
    for (let i = 0; i < N_CATS; i++) this.phaseCats[i] += cats[i];
    const gcMs = this.gc ? this.gcFrame() : 0;
    if (this.lastPresentAt) {
      const dt = n - this.lastPresentAt; this.frameDts.push(dt); this.frameAcct.add(dt, cats, n, acct.lastReads);
      if (this.slowApis) this.slowApiFrame(dt, cats);
      if (this.gc) { const g = this.gc; g.ms += gcMs; g.frames++; if (dt > g.over) { g.slow++; g.slowMs += gcMs; if (gcMs >= 5) g.slowWithGc++; } if (gcMs > g.maxMs) g.maxMs = gcMs; }
    }
    this.lastPresentAt = n;
  }
  /**
   * startbench --slow-apis <ms>: the APIs' time in the frames longer than that (each API's sampled time in the frame,
   * scaled to its calls; the deferred-queue drain and the heavy calls are timed on every call), summed per phase — which
   * calls make the slow frames' `api` and `draw` time.
   */
  slowApiFrame(dt, cats) {
    const s = this.slowApis, ms = acct.idxMs, k = acct.idxN, calls = acct.idxCalls;
    const len = Math.max(ms.length, calls.length);
    if (s.ms.length < len) { const g = (a) => { const b = new Float64Array(len); b.set(a); return b; }; s.ms = g(s.ms); s.n = g(s.n); s.calls = g(s.calls); s.sum = g(s.sum); s.frames = g(s.frames); }
    if (dt > s.over) {
      s.slow++; s.apiMs += cats[ACCT.api] + cats[ACCT.draw];
      for (let i = 0; i < ms.length; i++) {
        const dm = ms[i] - s.ms[i]; if (dm <= 0) continue;
        const dn = k[i] - s.n[i], dc = (calls[i] ?? 0) - s.calls[i], e = dm * Math.max(1, dn > 0 ? dc / dn : 1);
        s.sum[i] += e; s.frames[i]++;
      }
    }
    s.ms.set(ms); s.n.set(k); s.calls.set(calls);
  }
  /**
   * startbench --gc <ms>: the garbage collections of this thread (V8's GCProfiler, restarted at each present: ~5 µs)
   * per frame, by kind; per phase: their time, in the frames longer than `over` ms, the largest one in a frame.
   */
  enableGc(over, v8) { this.gc = { v8, prof: null, over, ms: 0, frames: 0, slow: 0, slowMs: 0, slowWithGc: 0, maxMs: 0, kinds: {} }; this.gcFrame(); }
  gcFrame() {
    const g = this.gc; let ms = 0;
    if (g.prof) for (const s of g.prof.stop().statistics) { ms += s.cost / 1000; g.kinds[s.gcType] = (g.kinds[s.gcType] ?? 0) + s.cost / 1000; }
    g.prof = new g.v8.GCProfiler(); g.prof.start();
    return ms;
  }
  gcReport(label) {
    const g = this.gc; if (!g) return;
    this.log(`[gc] ${label}: ${g.ms.toFixed(0)} ms of garbage collection on the emulator thread in ${g.frames} frames (${(g.ms / Math.max(1, g.frames)).toFixed(2)} ms per frame; ${Object.entries(g.kinds).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v.toFixed(0)}`).join(', ')}), most in one frame ${g.maxMs.toFixed(1)} ms; frames > ${g.over} ms: ${g.slow}, their GC ${(g.slowMs / Math.max(1, g.slow)).toFixed(2)} ms each, ${g.slowWithGc} of them with 5 ms or more`);
    Object.assign(g, { ms: 0, frames: 0, slow: 0, slowMs: 0, slowWithGc: 0, maxMs: 0, kinds: {} });
  }
  enableSlowApis(over) { const z = () => new Float64Array(0); this.slowApis = { over, slow: 0, apiMs: 0, ms: z(), n: z(), calls: z(), sum: z(), frames: z() }; }
  slowApiReport(label) {
    const s = this.slowApis; if (!s) return;
    const rows = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < s.sum.length; i++) if (s.sum[i] > 0) rows.push([this.vm.acctApiName(i), s.sum[i], s.frames[i]]);
    rows.sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    this.log(`[slowapis] ${label}: ${s.slow} frames > ${s.over} ms, api+draw ${(s.apiMs / Math.max(1, s.slow)).toFixed(2)} ms per such frame; by API (ms per such frame, frames it took time in): ${rows.slice(0, 20).map(([nm, v, f]) => `${nm} ${(v / Math.max(1, s.slow)).toFixed(2)} (${f})`).join(', ')}`);
    s.slow = 0; s.apiMs = 0; s.sum.fill(0); s.frames.fill(0);
  }
  /** the machine the scenario plays: the host's, or the child process that took the display (docs/processes.md) */
  get vm() { return this.rootVm.group?.foreground ?? this.rootVm; }
  now() { return (this.nowMs() - this.t0) / 1000; }
  push(ev) { this.vm.host.inputQueue.push(ev); }
  /** Called often (API dispatch, waits): fires the due events. */
  tick() {
    const nowMs = this.nowMs();
    if (nowMs < this.nextCheck) return;
    this.nextCheck = nowMs + 5;
    while (this.pending.length && this.pending[0][0] <= nowMs) this.push(this.pending.shift()[1]);
    const t = this.now(), d3d = this.vm.d3dDevice;
    if (this.firstFrameAt === null && d3d?.frames > 0) { this.firstFrameAt = t; this.log(`[input] first Direct3D frame at ${t.toFixed(1)}s (${(this.vm.guestInsns / 1e6).toFixed(0)} M guest instructions)`); }
    for (const ev of this.events) {
      if (ev.done) continue;
      const base = ev.rel ? this.firstFrameAt : ev.anchored ? this.anchorAt : 0;
      if (base === null) break;
      const due = base + ev.t;
      if (ev.kind === 'waitframe') {
        if (t < due) break;
        if (!d3d) break;
        // (draws per frame over 0.5 s windows, three in a row within the range)
        if (ev.at !== undefined && t - ev.at < 0.5) break;
        const prev = ev.prev; ev.prev = { draws: d3d.draws, frames: d3d.frames }; ev.at = t;
        if (!prev || d3d.frames === prev.frames) break;
        const dpf = (d3d.draws - prev.draws) / (d3d.frames - prev.frames);
        ev.streak = inRanges(dpf, ev.args) ? (ev.streak ?? 0) + 1 : 0; // (min,max[,min2,max2...]: any of the ranges)
        if (ev.streak >= 3) { ev.done = true; this.anchorAt = t; this.log(`[input] waitframe ${ev.args.join(',')}: ${dpf.toFixed(0)} draws/frame, anchor at ${t.toFixed(0)}s`); }
        break;
      }
      if (ev.kind === 'waitfps') { // F: more than F Direct3D frames per second, three 1-second windows in a row
        if (t < due) break;
        if (!d3d) break;
        if (ev.at !== undefined && t - ev.at < 1) break;
        const prev = ev.prev; ev.prev = { frames: d3d.frames }; const dt = ev.at === undefined ? 0 : t - ev.at; ev.at = t;
        if (!prev || !dt) break;
        const fps = (d3d.frames - prev.frames) / dt;
        ev.streak = fps > ev.args[0] ? (ev.streak ?? 0) + 1 : 0;
        if (ev.streak >= 3) { ev.done = true; this.anchorAt = t; this.log(`[input] waitfps ${ev.args[0]}: ${fps.toFixed(1)} fps, anchor at ${t.toFixed(0)}s`); }
        break;
      }
      if (t < due) break;
      ev.done = true;
      this.fire(ev, t);
      if (this.finished) this.mark('end', t); // (the last phase closed)
    }
  }
  fire(ev, t) {
    const [x, y] = POINTER_KINDS.has(ev.kind) ? this.scaler.scale(ev.args[0], ev.args[1]) : ev.args, at = this.nowMs();
    switch (ev.kind) {
      case 'move': this.push({ type: 'mousemove', x, y, dx: 0, dy: 0 }); break;
      case 'click': case 'rclick': {
        const b = ev.kind === 'click' ? 0 : 1;
        this.push({ type: 'mousemove', x, y, dx: 0, dy: 0 }); this.push({ type: 'mousedown', button: b, x, y });
        this.pending.push([at + 80, { type: 'mouseup', button: b, x, y }]); break;
      }
      case 'down': this.push({ type: 'mousemove', x, y, dx: 0, dy: 0 }); this.push({ type: 'mousedown', button: 0, x, y }); break;
      case 'up': this.push({ type: 'mousemove', x, y, dx: 0, dy: 0 }); this.push({ type: 'mouseup', button: 0, x, y }); break;
      case 'key': { const vk = x, scan = y || scanCodeOfVk(vk); this.push({ type: 'keydown', vk, scan, extended: false, repeat: 0 }); this.pending.push([at + 80, { type: 'keyup', vk, scan, extended: false }]); break; }
      case 'keydown': { const vk = x, scan = y || scanCodeOfVk(vk); this.push({ type: 'keydown', vk, scan, extended: false, repeat: 0 }); break; }
      case 'keyup': { const vk = x, scan = y || scanCodeOfVk(vk); this.push({ type: 'keyup', vk, scan, extended: false }); break; }
      case 'text': {
        let k = 0;
        for (const ch of ev.args[0]) {
          const vk = ch.toUpperCase().charCodeAt(0), scan = scanCodeOfVk(vk), when = at + 60 * k++;
          this.pending.push([when, { type: 'keydown', vk, scan, extended: false, repeat: 0 }], [when, { type: 'char', code: ch.charCodeAt(0) }], [when + 30, { type: 'keyup', vk, scan, extended: false }]);
        }
        this.pending.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
        break;
      }
      case 'dbg': {
        const [k, v] = ev.args[0].split('=');
        if (k === 'ORTHROS_JIT_AB' && this.vm.jit) {
          const o = v ? JSON.parse(v) : null;
          // (translations with block counters from now on: the counter area restarts, so that it holds the regions of this phase)
          if (o?.blockCounts) this.vm.mem.i32[BLOCK_COUNTS_BASE >>> 2] = 0;
          this.vm.jit.switchOpts(o); this.log(`[input] dbg ${k}=${v ?? ''}`);
        }
        // the block heat of the translations with counters made so far (Jit.collectHeat, for opts.coldExits)
        if (k === 'ORTHROS_JIT_HEAT' && this.vm.jit) this.log(`[input] dbg ${k}: ${this.vm.jit.collectHeat()} instructions executed`);
        // the visit flags of the translations made so far (opts.visit), added to the heat (Jit.harvestVisits)
        if (k === 'ORTHROS_JIT_HARVEST' && this.vm.jit) this.log(`[input] dbg ${k}: ${this.vm.jit.harvestVisits().length / 2} blocks visited`);
        // the API-layer switches, as the browser worker sets them (ORTHROS_API_OPT_OFF, ORTHROS_FX_BIND_OFF, ...: src/core/api-opt.js)
        if (/^ORTHROS_(API_OPT_OFF|FX_BIND_OFF|GL_NOCACHE|D3DX_FAST_OFF|API_FAST_OFF|DRAW_OPT_OFF|FX_DEFER_OFF)$/.test(k)) {
          globalThis[k] = v === undefined || v === '' ? undefined : Number(v);
          refreshApiOpt();
          if (k === 'ORTHROS_D3DX_FAST_OFF' || k === 'ORTHROS_API_OPT_OFF') this.vm.jit?.setD3dxFast?.(!globalThis[k]);
          if (k === 'ORTHROS_API_FAST_OFF') this.vm.setApiFastPaths?.(!globalThis[k]);
          if (k === 'ORTHROS_DRAW_OPT_OFF') this.vm.jit?.setDrawOpt?.(!globalThis[k]);
          if (k === 'ORTHROS_FX_DEFER_OFF') this.vm.jit?.setFxDefer?.(!globalThis[k]);
          this.log(`[input] dbg ${k}=${v ?? ''}`);
        } else if (/^ORTHROS_[A-Z0-9_]+$/.test(k) && !/^ORTHROS_(JIT_AB|JIT_HEAT|JIT_HARVEST)$/.test(k)) { // (other worker debug globals, as the browser worker sets them)
          globalThis[k] = v === undefined || v === '' ? undefined : Number.isNaN(Number(v)) ? v : Number(v);
          this.log(`[input] dbg ${k}=${v ?? ''}`);
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'mark': this.mark(ev.args[0], t); break;
      default: break; // (shot, profile, capture...: browser only)
    }
  }
  /** Close the running phase (its guest instructions, guest-category time per instruction) and open `label`. */
  mark(label, t) {
    // (the phase's frames' categories and the time since the last present; a run without presents: all of it)
    const rest = acct.frame(), cats = Float64Array.from(this.phaseCats, (v, i) => v + rest[i]), d3d = this.vm.d3dDevice;
    this.phaseCats.fill(0);
    const cpu = process.cpuUsage();
    // (the emulator thread's own CPU time: unlike the categories' wall-clock time, not inflated while the thread waits
    // for a core on a loaded machine)
    const tcpu = process.threadCpuUsage?.() ?? null;
    if (this.phase) {
      const p = this.phase, g = this.vm.guestInsns - p.g0, frames = (d3d?.frames ?? 0) - p.f0, secs = t - p.t;
      const cpuS = (cpu.user - p.cpu.user) / 1e6;
      const threadCpuS = tcpu && p.tcpu ? (tcpu.user + tcpu.system - p.tcpu.user - p.tcpu.system) / 1e6 : null;
      const r = { label: p.label, seconds: secs, startMs: p.epoch, endMs: Date.now(), frames, guestInsns: g, guestMs: cats[ACCT.guest], guestMsPerMInsn: g ? cats[ACCT.guest] * 1e6 / g : 0, cpuS, threadCpuS, apiMs: cats[ACCT.api], waitMs: cats[ACCT.wait], jitMs: cats[ACCT.jit], interpMs: cats[ACCT.interp] };
      const dts = this.frameDts.sort((a, b) => a - b), q = (x) => dts.length ? dts[Math.min(dts.length - 1, Math.floor(x * dts.length))] : 0;
      r.dt = { p50: q(0.5), p90: q(0.9), p99: q(0.99), max: dts[dts.length - 1] ?? 0, over34: dts.filter((d) => d > 34).length, over40: dts.filter((d) => d > 40).length };
      r.apiTop = this.apiTop();
      r.picks = (this.vm.sched?.picks ?? 0) - p.picks; // (scheduling decisions: Sleep(0) spins, yields)
      // (the page's phase report over the same frames: slow frames by category, hitches, worst frames)
      const ph = this.frameAcct.phase(label, this.nowMs());
      r.frameAcct = { ...ph, text: undefined };
      r.dt.over40PerMin = Math.round(r.dt.over40 / Math.max(1e-6, secs / 60));
      r.hostWait = { ...hostWaiter.take(), ...p.hw }; // (the host's wake-ups: overshoot, spins — core/host-wait.js)
      this.results.push(r);
      this.log(`[frames] node mark ${label}: ${ph.text}`);
      this.slowApiReport(p.label); this.gcReport(p.label);
      this.log(`[frames] node phase ${p.label}: ${secs.toFixed(1)} s, ${frames} frames, ${(g / 1e6).toFixed(0)} M guest instructions, guest ${(cats[ACCT.guest] / 1000).toFixed(2)} s = ${r.guestMsPerMInsn.toFixed(3)} ns per instruction; api ${(cats[ACCT.api] / 1000).toFixed(2)} s, jit ${(cats[ACCT.jit] / 1000).toFixed(2)} s, interp ${(cats[ACCT.interp] / 1000).toFixed(2)} s, wait ${(cats[ACCT.wait] / 1000).toFixed(2)} s, CPU ${cpuS.toFixed(1)} s${threadCpuS !== null ? `, thread CPU ${threadCpuS.toFixed(1)} s` : ''}; frame ms p50 ${r.dt.p50.toFixed(1)} p90 ${r.dt.p90.toFixed(1)} p99 ${r.dt.p99.toFixed(1)} max ${r.dt.max.toFixed(0)}, > 34 ms ${r.dt.over34}, > 40 ms ${r.dt.over40}`);
      const hw = r.hostWait.wait;
      if (hw) this.log(`[hostwait] ${p.label}: ${hw.waits} waits, overshoot mean ${hw.overMean} ms max ${hw.overMax} ms, late for the frame ${(hw.lateMs / Math.max(1, frames)).toFixed(2)} ms per frame (estimate ${r.hostWait.est} ms), early ${hw.early}, plain ${hw.plain}, spins ${hw.spins} (${hw.spinMs} ms, ${(hw.spinMs / Math.max(1, frames)).toFixed(2)} ms per frame); injected quantum ${p.hw.q || 'none'}, adaptive ${p.hw.adaptive ? 'on' : 'off'}; > 40 ms per minute ${r.dt.over40PerMin}`);
      this.log(`[apitop] ${p.label} (ms per frame, calls per frame, µs per call): ${r.apiTop.map(([k, ms, c, us]) => `${k} ${(ms / Math.max(1, frames)).toFixed(2)} (${(c / Math.max(1, frames)).toFixed(0)}, ${us.toFixed(1)})`).join(', ')}`);
      // (--jit-profile: the phase's transitions by kind, chained transitions and fallback steps)
      if (this.jitProf) this.log(`[jitprof] ${p.label}: ${this.jitProf()}`);
      for (const f of this.phaseReports ?? []) f(p.label, frames); // (a tool's own per-phase lines: startbench --sleeps, --slow-threads)
      // (startbench --d3dx-prof: D3DX image work by kind, and the surface lock patterns, as the browser worker reports them)
      const prof = this.vm.d3dxProf, ls = d3d?.lockStats, lp = p.locks ?? {};
      if (prof?.size) { this.log(`[d3dx] ${p.label} D3DX image work (ms, count): ${[...prof].sort((a, b) => b[1].ms - a[1].ms).slice(0, 16).map(([k, e]) => `${k}: ${e.ms.toFixed(0)}/${e.n}`).join('; ')}`); prof.clear(); }
      if (ls && this.vm.apiTimes) { const dl = (k) => (ls[k] ?? 0) - (lp[k] ?? 0); this.log(`[d3dx] ${p.label} locks: ${dl('whole')} whole, ${dl('rect')} rect (${(100 * dl('rectPx') / Math.max(1, dl('rectOfPx'))).toFixed(0)}% of their surfaces), ${dl('readOnly')} read-only`); }
    }
    if (!this.phase) {
      this.apiTop(); this.jitProf?.(); this.frameAcct.phase(label, this.nowMs());
      if (this.gc) Object.assign(this.gc, { ms: 0, frames: 0, slow: 0, slowMs: 0, slowWithGc: 0, maxMs: 0, kinds: {} });
      if (this.slowApis) { this.slowApis.slow = 0; this.slowApis.apiMs = 0; this.slowApis.sum.fill(0); this.slowApis.frames.fill(0); }
    }
    this.frameDts = [];
    this.phase = { label, t, g0: this.vm.guestInsns, f0: d3d?.frames ?? 0, cpu, tcpu, epoch: Date.now(), picks: this.vm.sched?.picks ?? 0, hw: { q: injectedQuantum(), adaptive: adaptiveOn() }, locks: { ...(d3d?.lockStats ?? {}) } }; // (epoch ms: phases matched with outside measurements, perf stat -I)
  }
  /**
   * The APIs that took the most time since the previous call (as the browser worker's phase report): each API's timed
   * calls (frame-acct.js samples them) scaled to all its calls; [name, ms, calls, µs per call], most time first.
   */
  apiTop(n = 30) {
    const cur = { ms: Float64Array.from(acct.idxMs), n: Float64Array.from(acct.idxN), calls: Float64Array.from(acct.idxCalls) }, prev = this.apiPrev; this.apiPrev = cur;
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < cur.calls.length; i++) {
      const calls = cur.calls[i] - (prev?.calls[i] ?? 0), k = (cur.n[i] ?? 0) - (prev?.n[i] ?? 0), ms = (cur.ms[i] ?? 0) - (prev?.ms[i] ?? 0);
      if (calls > 0 && k > 0) { out.push([this.vm.acctApiName(i), ms * Math.max(1, calls / k), calls, 1000 * ms / k]); }
    }
    return out.sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, n);
  }
  /** Every event fired (the scenario is over). */
  get finished() { return this.events.every((e) => e.done); }
}
```

```mjs
// Node's V8 (13.6, Node 24) ignores WebAssembly branch hints unless --experimental-wasm-branch-hinting is set, while
// Chrome honours them (shipped in Chrome 137): the translator's hints (wasm.js Code.hint) put exits, fault and slow
// paths out of line, which changes the code layout — Node measurements of translated code without the flag do not
// show the browser's instruction-cache behaviour (docs/jit-code-shape.md). Imported first by the measurement tools.
import v8 from 'node:v8';

v8.setFlagsFromString('--experimental-wasm-branch-hinting');
```

`tools/noop-gl.mjs`:

```mjs
// A WebGL2 context that does nothing, answering queries as a working one: the cost of the backend's own work without a
// GPU (tools/backend-draw-bench.mjs, tools/framebench.mjs). Uniforms: those a program's sources declare and use, as a
// GLSL compiler keeps them; constants: the names the backend reads, as plain properties.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const GFX = new URL('../src/gfx/', import.meta.url).pathname;

/** A WebGL2 context that does nothing, answering queries as a working one (uniforms: those the sources declare). */
export function noopGl(width = 1024, height = 768) {
  const canvas = { width, height };
  const enums = new Map(); let nextEnum = 0x8000;
  const gl = { canvas, get drawingBufferWidth() { return canvas.width; }, get drawingBufferHeight() { return canvas.height; } };
  const nop = () => {};
  for (const n of 'activeTexture attachShader bindAttribLocation bindBuffer bindFramebuffer bindRenderbuffer bindSampler bindTexture bindVertexArray blendColor blendEquationSeparate blendFuncSeparate blitFramebuffer bufferData bufferSubData clear clearColor clearDepth clearStencil colorMask compileShader compressedTexImage2D compressedTexSubImage2D cullFace deleteBuffer deleteFramebuffer deleteProgram deleteRenderbuffer deleteSampler deleteShader deleteSync deleteTexture deleteVertexArray depthFunc depthMask depthRange disable drawArrays drawElements enable enableVertexAttribArray flush framebufferRenderbuffer framebufferTexture2D pixelStorei polygonOffset readPixels renderbufferStorage samplerParameterf samplerParameteri scissor stencilFunc stencilFuncSeparate stencilMask stencilOp stencilOpSeparate texImage2D texImage3D texParameteri texSubImage2D uniform1f uniform1i uniform2f uniform4f uniform4fv uniform4iv uniformMatrix4fv useProgram vertexAttribPointer viewport'.split(' ')) gl[n] = nop;
  const obj = () => ({});
  for (const n of 'createBuffer createFramebuffer createRenderbuffer createSampler createTexture createVertexArray fenceSync'.split(' ')) gl[n] = obj;
  // programs: the uniforms their sources declare (arrays: name[i] within the size), as a linked program's active ones
  gl.createShader = () => ({ src: '' }); gl.shaderSource = (s, src) => { s.src = src; };
  gl.createProgram = () => ({ shaders: [], uniforms: null, names: [] });
  gl.attachShader = (p, s) => p.shaders.push(s);
  gl.linkProgram = (p) => {
    p.uniforms = new Map();
    // (active: declared and used — a GLSL compiler drops the uniforms a program never reads)
    for (const s of p.shaders) for (const m of s.src.matchAll(/uniform\s+\w+\s+(\w+)\s*(?:\[\s*(\d+)\s*\])?/g)) if (s.src.split(new RegExp(`\\b${m[1]}\\b`)).length > 2) p.uniforms.set(m[1], m[2] ? Number(m[2]) : 0);
    p.names = [...p.uniforms].map(([n, size]) => (size ? `${n}[0]` : n));
    p.locs = new Map();
  };
  gl.getUniformLocation = (p, name) => {
    let l = p.locs.get(name); if (l !== undefined) return l;
    const m = /^(\w+)(?:\[(\d+)\])?$/.exec(name), size = m ? p.uniforms.get(m[1]) : undefined;
    l = size === undefined || (m[2] !== undefined && Number(m[2]) >= Math.max(1, size)) ? null : { name };
    p.locs.set(name, l); return l;
  };
  gl.getProgramParameter = (p, q) => (q === gl.ACTIVE_UNIFORMS ? p.names.length : true);
  gl.getActiveUniform = (p, i) => ({ name: p.names[i] });
  gl.getShaderParameter = () => true; gl.getProgramInfoLog = () => ''; gl.getShaderInfoLog = () => '';
  gl.getExtension = () => null; gl.getError = () => 0; gl.getVertexAttrib = () => 0; gl.isEnabled = () => false;
  gl.checkFramebufferStatus = () => gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE; gl.getSyncParameter = () => gl.SIGNALED;
  gl.getParameter = (p) => (p === gl.MAX_COMBINED_TEXTURE_IMAGE_UNITS ? 32 : p === gl.MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE ? 4096 : p === gl.RENDERER ? 'noop' : 0);
  // (constants: the names the backend uses, as plain properties — a browser context has them on its prototype)
  for (const f of fs.readdirSync(GFX)) if (f.endsWith('.js')) for (const m of fs.readFileSync(path.join(GFX, f), 'utf8').matchAll(/\b(?:gl|this\.gl|ext|this\.aniso)\.([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+)\b/g)) if (!enums.has(m[1])) enums.set(m[1], m[1] === 'TEXTURE0' ? 0x84c0 : nextEnum++);
  for (const [k, v] of enums) gl[k] = v;
  for (const n of 'frontFace hint lineWidth sampleCoverage stencilMaskSeparate drawBuffers invalidateFramebuffer'.split(' ')) gl[n] ??= nop;
  return gl;
}
```

`tools/openmw/build-server-image.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Build the native multiplayer gateway's image (tools/openmw/server-node.Dockerfile, docs/openmw.md): the pinned
# upstream image (lock.json "serverImage", pulled by install-engine.py --server) with the Node.js release of lock.json
# "serverBuild"."node". The tarball is fetched once (or given with --archive), checked against the lock, used from a
# scratch context and deleted; the build itself runs without network, timestamps fixed (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH), so the
# same inputs give the same image ID. The ID is compared with lock.json "serverBuild"."image" (an empty one is
# printed, to be pinned; "config" is its config's digest, the ID a classic Docker image store gives); a different ID is
# refused unless --any-id. Tagged lock.json "serverBuild"."tag"; tools/openmw/server.mjs runs it by its ID.
# Usage: sh tools/openmw/build-server-image.sh [--archive <node-vX-linux-x64.tar.xz>] [--any-id]
set -eu
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)
here=$root/tools/openmw
archive= anyid=0
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case $1 in
    --archive) archive=$2; shift 2 ;;
    --any-id) anyid=1; shift ;;
    *) echo "unknown argument $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done
get() { python3 -I -c "import json,sys; v=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
for k in sys.argv[2].split('.'): v=v[k]
print(v)" "$here/lock.json" "$1"; }
base=$(get serverImage) version=$(get serverBuild.node.version) url=$(get serverBuild.node.url) sha=$(get serverBuild.node.sha256)
tag=$(get serverBuild.tag) want=$(get serverBuild.image) config=$(get serverBuild.config) epoch=$(get serverBuild.sourceDateEpoch)
dockerfile=$here/$(get serverBuild.dockerfile)
[ "$(get serverBuild.base)" = "$base" ] || { echo "serverBuild.base is not serverImage" >&2; exit 1; }
"$root/tools/disk-check.sh"
docker image inspect "$base" >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker pull "$base"
scratch=/tmp/orthros-scratch/openmw-server-image
mkdir -p "$scratch"
ctx=$(mktemp -d "$scratch/ctx.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$ctx"; rmdir "$scratch" 2>/dev/null || :' EXIT
if [ -n "$archive" ]; then cp "$archive" "$ctx/node.tar.xz"; else curl -fsSL -o "$ctx/node.tar.xz" "$url"; fi
echo "$sha  $ctx/node.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c -
SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$epoch docker build --no-cache --network none --pull=false --provenance=false --sbom=false -f "$dockerfile" \
  --build-arg BASE="$base" --build-arg NODE_VERSION="$version" --build-arg NODE_SHA256="$sha" \
  --output type=image,name="$tag",rewrite-timestamp=true,unpack=false "$ctx"
# (the image ID: its manifest's digest in Docker's containerd image store, its config's in the classic one)
id=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' "$tag")
echo "built $tag $id ($(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$id" --version))"
if [ -z "$want" ]; then echo "pin it: lock.json serverBuild.image = $id"
elif [ "$id" != "$want" ] && [ "$id" != "$config" ]; then
  echo "image ID $id differs from lock.json's $want" >&2
  [ $anyid = 1 ] || exit 1
fi

```

`tools/openmw/build.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Build Orthros' own releases of the OpenMW browser engine (docs/openmw.md) from the pinned upstream source
# (lock.json "source": openmw-web, installed in data/engines/src/<id>/ by install-engine.py) with a build's patches
# (tools/openmw/patches/, lock.json "builds"), into a release data/engines/<build id>/ laid out as the upstream one
# (index.html stamped with the engine's hash, e/<hash>/openmw.{js,wasm,data}, its .br siblings, streamfs.js), the
# upstream release's other files (lock.json "id": its asset pack, portal pages, notices) copied beside it.
# On the pattern of tools/re3/build.sh: the dependency sources (lock.json "build": OSG, Bullet, MyGUI, FFmpeg, Boost,
# Lua, LZ4 and the three archives OpenMW's CMake fetches) and Emscripten's ports are fetched once, with network,
# into data/engines/src/ and checked against the lock; every compilation then runs in the pinned Emscripten image
# (plus ninja and pkg-config, tools/openmw/emsdk.Dockerfile) without network, on a copy in scratch, with 8 CPUs.
# The engine's package also carries the upstream demo world (fsroot/gamedata, not in the source archive): it is taken
# from the upstream release's own package, checked against the lock. A build whose engine files differ from the
# lock's "files" is refused (an empty "files" prints them, to be pinned). An installed release is never overwritten.
# Needs git, Docker, Python 3, Node (brotli siblings).
# Usage: sh tools/openmw/build.sh [<build id>...] [--engines-dir <dir>] [--dest <dir>] [--keep]
#   --dest: where the releases go (default: the engines dir); --keep: leave the scratch build tree.
set -eu
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)
here=$root/tools/openmw
# (one compile at a time for the whole project, and only with memory to spare: CLAUDE.md "Memory budget")
exec 8>/tmp/orthros-heavy-build.lock; flock 8
"$root/tools/mem-check.sh" -w "${ORTHROS_BUILD_MEM_MIN_GB:-24}"
engines=$root/data/engines dest= ids= keep=0
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case $1 in
    --engines-dir) engines=$2; shift 2 ;;
    --dest) dest=$2; shift 2 ;;
    --keep) keep=1; shift ;;
    *) ids="$ids $1"; shift ;;
  esac
done
[ -n "$dest" ] || dest=$engines
lock=$here/lock.json
build() { python3 -c "import json,sys; v=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['build'][sys.argv[2]]; print(' '.join(v) if isinstance(v, list) else v)" "$lock" "$1"; }
top() { python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))[sys.argv[2]])" "$lock" "$1"; }
[ -n "$ids" ] || ids=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(' '.join(b['id'] for b in json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['builds']))" "$lock")
upstream=$(top id); tag=$(top tag)
source=$engines/src/$upstream/openmw-web-$tag base=$engines/$upstream
deps=$engines/$(build deps) cache=$engines/$(build emscriptenCache) image=$(build image)
"$root/tools/disk-check.sh"
# (the shared server's budget, CLAUDE.md: no heavy job while the 1-minute load is half the cores)
waitload() { while [ "$(cut -d. -f1 /proc/loadavg)" -ge 24 ]; do echo "load $(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) >= 24, waiting"; sleep 60; done; }

# ---- the upstream source and release (install-engine.py)
test -d "$source/openmw" && test -f "$base/release.json" || { echo "Install the upstream engine first: python3 tools/openmw/install-engine.py" >&2; exit 1; }

# ---- the compiler image: the pinned Emscripten image + ninja, pkg-config
if ! docker image inspect "$image" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  docker build -t "$image" -f "$here/emsdk.Dockerfile" "$here"
fi
python3 - "$lock" "$(docker run --rm --network none "$image" cat /usr/local/share/orthros-packages.txt)" <<'PY'
import json, sys
want = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['build']['imagePackages']
have = dict(l.split('\t') for l in sys.argv[2].splitlines())
if have != want: sys.exit(f'The compiler image packages differ from lock.json: {have}')
PY

# ---- the dependency sources, fetched once (network) and checked
mkdir -p "$deps/archives"
python3 - "$lock" "$deps" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, urllib.request
b = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['build']; deps = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
for name, g in b['git'].items():
    d = deps / name
    if not (d / '.git').is_dir():
        subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '-q', '--depth', '1', '--branch', g['tag'], g['url'], str(d)], check=True)
    head = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(d), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    dirty = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(d), 'status', '--porcelain'], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    if head != g['commit'] or dirty: sys.exit(f'{name}: {head} (or modified), lock.json pins {g["commit"]}')
for name, a in b['archives'].items():
    f = deps / 'archives' / name
    if not f.is_file(): urllib.request.urlretrieve(a['url'], f)
    if hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != a['sha256']: sys.exit(f'{name} differs from lock.json')
PY

# ---- Emscripten's sysroot and ports (wasm64, threads), cached once (network: the ports' archives). The marker is
# written once both steps succeeded: an interrupted fill (emcc creates ports/ with its first archive) runs again, emcc
# fetching only the archives still missing.
if [ ! -f "$cache/.orthros-filled" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$cache"
  docker run --rm -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$cache:/cache" "$image" sh -c 'cp -r /emsdk/upstream/emscripten/cache/. /cache/'
  docker run --rm --cpus 8 --memory ${ORTHROS_BUILD_MEM:-20g} --memory-swap ${ORTHROS_BUILD_MEM:-20g} -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$cache:/emsdk/upstream/emscripten/cache" "$image" nice -n 19 sh -c '
    set -e; cd /tmp; printf "int main(){return 0;}\n" > p.c
    emcc -m64 -pthread -sUSE_ICU=1 p.c -o icu.js
    emcc -m64 -pthread -sMAX_WEBGL_VERSION=2 -sFULL_ES3=1 p.c -o gl.js
    emcc -m64 -pthread -fwasm-exceptions -sMALLOC=mimalloc -sUSE_SDL=2 -sUSE_FREETYPE=1 -sUSE_HARFBUZZ=1 -sUSE_LIBPNG=1 \
      -sUSE_LIBJPEG=1 -sUSE_ZLIB=1 -sUSE_OGG=1 -sUSE_VORBIS=1 -lopenal p.c -o ports.js
    emcc -m64 -pthread -sUSE_SDL=2 -sUSE_SDL_IMAGE=2 -sSDL2_IMAGE_FORMATS="[\"png\"]" p.c -o img.js'  # (MyGUI's CMake asks for it)
  touch "$cache/.orthros-filled"
fi
python3 - "$lock" "$cache" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, sys
for name, digest in json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['build']['emscriptenPorts'].items():
    f = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2], 'ports', name)
    if not f.is_file() or hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest: sys.exit(f'Emscripten port {name} missing or different from lock.json')
PY

for id in $ids; do
  release=$dest/$id
  if [ -e "$release/release.json" ]; then echo "$id: already installed; preserving it."; continue; fi
  if [ -e "$release" ]; then echo "$release exists without release.json: review it before building." >&2; exit 1; fi

  # OpenMW's CMake would download), fsroot's demo world and ICU data, then the build's patches.
```

`tools/openmw/check.mjs`:

```mjs
// Short browser smoke check of an OpenMW port: from its home card, the Orthros frame (shell.js) around it, solo, the
// engine drawing, the frame's header told its frame rate and the mouse (frame-meter.js). Not a multiplayer or gameplay
// validation. Always invoke through tools/with-browser-slot.sh.
// Usage: tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/openmw/check.mjs <manifest> [--url origin] [--seconds N] [--lang <code>]
//   --lang: the game language chosen on the card (its flag) before Play — the version that language runs is the one
//   checked (the manifest's languageVersions: e.g. morrowind-goty-en --lang fr checks the page of morrowind-goty-fr).
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), id = args[0], arg = (k) => args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : null;
if (!id) throw new Error('Expected a manifest id');
const base = arg('--url') ?? 'http://localhost:8080', seconds = Math.max(1, Math.min(30, Number(arg('--seconds') ?? 3)));
const lang = arg('--lang');
if (lang !== null && !/^[a-z]{2}$/.test(lang)) throw new Error('--lang expects a two-letter language code');
const dir = `/tmp/orthros-scratch/openmw-check-${id}${lang ? '-' + lang : ''}`;
fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }); process.env.TMPDIR = dir;
const catalog = await (await fetch(base + '/api/manifests')).json(), entry = catalog.find((m) => m.name === id);
if (!entry?.available || entry.runtime !== 'openmw') throw new Error('OpenMW installation is not available');
const card = await (await fetch(base + `/api/manifest/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`)).json();
if (lang && !card.languages?.includes(lang)) throw new Error(`${id} offers no game language ${lang} (it has: ${(card.languages ?? []).join(', ')})`);
// (the version the language runs: its own page, languageLaunchUrls — the manifest whose saves and start cell are checked)
const target = lang && card.languageLaunchUrls?.[lang] ? decodeURIComponent(new URL(card.languageLaunchUrls[lang], base).pathname.split('/')[3]) : id;
const man = target === id ? card : await (await fetch(base + `/api/manifest/${encodeURIComponent(target)}`)).json();
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox', '--use-gl=angle', '--use-angle=swiftshader', '--enable-unsafe-swiftshader'] });
const faults = [];
try {
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1000, height: 750 } });
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => faults.push(e.message));
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    window.orthrosDraws = 0;
    for (const name of ['drawArrays', 'drawElements']) {
      const original = WebGL2RenderingContext.prototype[name];
      WebGL2RenderingContext.prototype[name] = function (...args) { window.orthrosDraws++; return original.apply(this, args); };
    }
  });
  await page.goto(base + '/?menu');
  if (lang) {
    // (the card's game-language flag: a single language is shown, not offered)
    const flag = page.locator(`[data-name="${man.gameId}"] .hm-opt[data-value="${lang}"]`);
    if (await flag.evaluate((el) => el.tagName === 'BUTTON')) await flag.click();
    await page.locator(`[data-name="${man.gameId}"] .hm-opt.on[data-value="${lang}"]`).waitFor({ timeout: 10000 });
  }
  await page.locator(`[data-name="${man.gameId}"] .hm-play`).click();
  await page.waitForURL((u) => u.pathname === `/ports/openmw/${encodeURIComponent(target)}/` && (!lang || u.searchParams.get('gameLang') === lang)); await page.click('#solo');
  const frame = page.frameLocator('#game');
  await frame.locator('#loading.hide').waitFor({ state: 'attached', timeout: 90000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(seconds * 1000);
  // (the page hides its loading screen ~2.4 s after the engine's first frame-rate report: under a loaded software
  // renderer that can come after the fixed wait — waited for, up to 30 s, instead of read at once)
  await page.locator('#loader.hidden').waitFor({ state: 'attached', timeout: 30000 }).catch(() => {});
  const state = await frame.locator('body').evaluate(async () => ({
    // (an engine drawing on its own thread, OPENMW_ORTHROS_DRAWTHREAD: its frames handed to the page, no draw here)
    isolated: crossOriginIsolated, draws: window.orthrosDraws, frames: window.__omwDrawThreadFrames ?? 0, args: window.Module?.arguments,
    databases: (await indexedDB.databases()).map((d) => d.name), log: document.querySelector('#log')?.textContent.slice(-1600),
  }));
  const header = await page.evaluate(() => ({ fps: Number(document.querySelector('#tbPerf .fps')?.textContent), mouse: document.querySelector('#tbMouse')?.textContent, save: document.querySelector('#tbSave')?.textContent, loader: document.querySelector('#loader')?.classList.contains('hidden') }));
  Object.assign(state, { header });
  // (draws: the page's WebGL draw calls; frames: the pictures an engine drawing on its own thread handed to the page)
  assert.equal(state.isolated, true);
  if (state.frames > 0) assert.ok(state.frames > 30, `Only ${state.frames} frames from the draw thread`); else assert.ok(state.draws > 100, `Only ${state.draws} draws`);
  assert.ok(header.fps > 0, 'The header shows the engine\'s frame rate'); assert.ok(header.mouse, 'The mouse indicator'); assert.ok(header.loader, 'The loading screen gone once the engine draws');
  assert.ok(state.databases.includes(man.saveKey), 'Installation-specific browser saves');
  // (a start cell is the example world's only — src/ports/openmw/play.js: a hosted game starts at its menu or its save)
  if (man.openmw.example && man.openmw.startCell) assert.ok(state.args?.includes(man.openmw.startCell), 'The manifest start cell reaches the engine');
  assert.deepEqual(faults, []);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'result.json'), JSON.stringify(state, null, 2));
  await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(dir, 'solo.png') });
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, manifest: id, ...(lang ? { lang, ran: target } : {}), draws: state.draws, frames: state.frames, isolated: state.isolated, output: dir }));
} finally { await browser.close(); }
```

`tools/openmw/cloud-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
// The OpenMW cloud bridge's cost for a sync (src/ports/openmw/cloud.js; the engine page syncs every 15 s): a profile of
// N saves of M MB in a MEMFS-like file system, uploaded once, then synced again — nothing changed, and the engine's
// settings written again with the same bytes (as its _omw_save_settings does before each sync). Timed from the sync to
// the bridge's answer to the Orthros page's flush (its upload done or skipped), median of runs. Node, no browser.
// Usage: node tools/openmw/cloud-bench.mjs [--cloud <cloud.js>] [--saves 20] [--mb 2] [--runs 9]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { runInNewContext } from 'node:vm';
import { webcrypto } from 'node:crypto';
import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), arg = (k, d) => args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : d;
const file = arg('--cloud', new URL('../../src/ports/openmw/cloud.js', import.meta.url).pathname);
```
