`tools/openmw/create-account.mjs`:

```mjs
// Provision a player on a password-only OpenMW server. Its operator API stays localhost only.
// Usage: node tools/openmw/create-account.mjs <manifest> <username> --password-stdin
//        [--games-dir dir] [--state-dir dir]
// Read the player's password from stdin; never put a credential in argv or a command log.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { loadGameCatalog, DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR } from '../../src/host/game-catalog.js';
import { OPENMW_STATE_DIR } from '../../src/host/openmw.js';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), [id, name] = args, arg = (k) => args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : null;
if (!name || !args.includes('--password-stdin')) throw new Error('Expected manifest, username and --password-stdin');
const man = loadGameCatalog(path.resolve(arg('--games-dir') ?? DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR)).get(id);
if (man?.runtime !== 'openmw' || !man.openmw.multiplayer) throw new Error('Expected an OpenMW multiplayer version');
const state = path.resolve(arg('--state-dir') ?? path.join(OPENMW_STATE_DIR, id));
if (!fs.existsSync(state)) throw new Error('Start the multiplayer server before creating players');
const password = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8').replace(/[\r\n]+$/, '');
if (!password.length || password.length > 1024) throw new Error('Expected a password on stdin (1–1024 characters)');
const file = path.join(state, 'operator.json');
if (!fs.existsSync(file)) fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({ name: 'orthros@localhost.invalid', password: randomBytes(32).toString('base64url') }), { mode: 0o600, flag: 'wx' });
const operator = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file));
const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${man.openmw.multiplayer.port}`;
async function request(route, body, token) {
  const r = await fetch(base + '/admin/api/' + route, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', ...(token ? { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}) }, body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) });
  return { ok: r.ok, body: await r.json() };
}
const setup = await request('setup/owner', operator);
// A repeated run logs in with the existing, private operator credential.
const login = await request('login', operator);
if (!login.ok || !login.body.token) throw new Error(`Cannot authenticate the local operator: ${login.body.error ?? setup.body.error}`);
try {
  const r = await request('accounts/create', { name, password, role: '' }, login.body.token);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.body.error ?? 'Player creation failed');
  console.log(`Created OpenMW player ${name}. The account has no administration privileges.`);
} finally { await request('logout', {}, login.body.token); }

```

`tools/openmw/dev-build.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Incremental development builds of the OpenMW browser engine (docs/openmw.md): a tree kept by
# `sh tools/openmw/build.sh <dev id> --keep` (its sources with the dev build's patches applied, configured and compiled
# once, /tmp/orthros-scratch/openmw-build/<dev id>/root) recompiled with extra patches over it in minutes instead of a
# whole build, and installed as a release beside the dev build's own — for measuring and checking a change before it
# becomes an engine release of tools/openmw/build.sh. Nothing here is pinned: a release that ships is built by build.sh.
#
# The patches (git diffs with paths from the tree's root, as tools/openmw/patches/) are applied over the kept tree in
# the order given, after those of the previous run are reverted (the tree's .orthros-dev-patches lists them), so a run
# builds exactly its own set. One run at a time on a tree (flock): runs from parallel agents queue. In the pinned
# Emscripten image, without network, 8 CPUs, niced, once the load allows (CLAUDE.md "Shared server budget") and no
# other engine build runs.
#   --check: compile only the .cpp files the patches touch (OpenMW's and OSG's object files), then revert them — a
#            compile check; no link, nothing installed.
#   default: OSG (build-osg.sh: its ninja, incremental), OpenMW (ninja components openmw-lib), the link
#            (link-openmw.sh), then <release dir> made from <base release> (its other files hard-linked: never written
#            through) with the new e/<hash>/openmw.{js,wasm,data}, streamfs.js and index.html. The patches stay applied.
# Usage: sh tools/openmw/dev-build.sh <kept root> <base release> <release dir> [--check] [--patch <file>]...
#   e.g. sh tools/openmw/dev-build.sh /tmp/orthros-scratch/openmw-build/openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r11dev/root \
#          /tmp/orthros-scratch/mw-perf/engines/openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r11dev /tmp/orthros-scratch/mw-perf/engines/dev-a \
#          --patch /tmp/orthros-scratch/mw-perf/patches/A.patch
set -eu
here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
# (one compile at a time for the whole project, and only with memory to spare: CLAUDE.md "Memory budget")
exec 8>/tmp/orthros-heavy-build.lock; flock 8
"$here/../mem-check.sh" -w "${ORTHROS_BUILD_MEM_MIN_GB:-24}"
[ $# -ge 3 ] || { sed -n '2,20p' "$0" >&2; exit 64; }
root=$(cd "$1" && pwd) base=$2 out=$3; shift 3
check=0 patches=
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case $1 in
    --check) check=1; shift ;;
    --patch) [ -f "$2" ] || { echo "no patch $2" >&2; exit 64; }; patches="$patches $(cd "$(dirname "$2")" && pwd)/$(basename "$2")"; shift 2 ;;
    *) echo "unknown argument $1" >&2; exit 64 ;;
  esac
done
test -f "$root/build-wasm64/build.ninja" || { echo "$root is not a kept build tree (build.sh --keep)" >&2; exit 1; }
image=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['build']['image'])" "$here/lock.json")
cache=$(cd "$here/../.." && pwd)/data/engines/$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['build']['emscriptenCache'])" "$here/lock.json")
[ -d "$cache" ] || cache=/srv/orthros/data/engines/$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['build']['emscriptenCache'])" "$here/lock.json")
bin=$(dirname "$root")/bin
state=$root/.orthros-dev-patches

exec 9>"$(dirname "$root")/dev-build.lock"
flock 9

# (the previous run's patches reverted, newest first; then this run's applied in order)
if [ -s "$state" ]; then
  tac "$state" | while read -r p; do
    git -C "$root" apply -R --whitespace=nowarn "$root/.orthros-dev-applied/$(basename "$p")" || { echo "cannot revert $p: the kept tree needs a look" >&2; exit 1; }
  done
fi
: > "$state"; rm -rf "$root/.orthros-dev-applied"; mkdir -p "$root/.orthros-dev-applied"
for p in $patches; do
  if ! git -C "$root" apply --whitespace=nowarn "$p"; then
    echo "$p does not apply over the kept tree (with the patches before it)" >&2
    tac "$state" | while read -r q; do git -C "$root" apply -R --whitespace=nowarn "$root/.orthros-dev-applied/$(basename "$q")"; done
    : > "$state"; exit 2
  fi
  cp "$p" "$root/.orthros-dev-applied/$(basename "$p")"; echo "$p" >> "$state"
done

"$here/../disk-check.sh"
while [ "$(cut -d. -f1 /proc/loadavg)" -ge 24 ]; do echo "load $(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) >= 24, waiting"; sleep 60; done
run() {
  docker run --rm --network none --cpus 8 --memory ${ORTHROS_BUILD_MEM:-20g} --memory-swap ${ORTHROS_BUILD_MEM:-20g} -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp \
    -e ROOT=/build -e EM_LIBEXEC=/emsdk/upstream/emscripten -e EMSDK_BIN=/emsdk/upstream/emscripten -e OMW_WASM64=1 -e JOBS=8 \
    -v "$root:/build" -v "$bin:/orthros-bin:ro" -v "$cache:/emsdk/upstream/emscripten/cache" -w /build "$image" nice -n 19 sh -c \
    "set -e; export PATH=/orthros-bin:\$PATH EMSDK_BIN=/emsdk/upstream/emscripten; $1"
}

if [ "$check" = 1 ]; then
  # (each touched .cpp's object file, in OpenMW's build or OSG's: a script run in the image)
  {
    echo 'set -e'
    for p in $patches; do sed -n 's|^+++ b/\(.*\.cpp\)$|\1|p' "$p"; done | sort -u | while read -r f; do
      case $f in
        deps/src/osg/*) dir=deps/src/osg/build-wasm64 rel=${f#deps/src/osg/} ;;
        openmw/*) dir=build-wasm64 rel=${f#openmw/} ;;
        *) continue ;;
      esac
      echo "t=\$(ninja -C $dir -t targets all | cut -d: -f1 | grep -F '/$(basename "$rel").o' | grep -F '$(basename "$(dirname "$rel")")' | head -3)"
      echo "[ -n \"\$t\" ] || { echo 'no object file for $f'; exit 1; }"
      echo "ninja -C $dir \$t"
    done
  } > "$root/.orthros-dev-check.sh"
  status=0
  run 'sh .orthros-dev-check.sh' > "$root/.orthros-dev-check.log" 2>&1 || status=$?
  grep -E 'error|FAILED|no object file' "$root/.orthros-dev-check.log" | head -60 || true
  tac "$state" | while read -r q; do git -C "$root" apply -R --whitespace=nowarn "$root/.orthros-dev-applied/$(basename "$q")"; done
  : > "$state"
  [ "$status" = 0 ] && echo "check: compiled ($(grep -c '\.o$\|Building' "$root/.orthros-dev-check.log") step(s))" || { echo "check: compile errors (above; whole log $root/.orthros-dev-check.log)" >&2; exit 3; }
  exit 0
fi

# (not two engine compilations at once on the shared machine: another one running — build.sh's, another tree's — is
# waited for; a --check is a few files, it does not wait)
while [ -n "$(docker ps -q --filter "ancestor=$image")" ]; do echo "another engine build is running, waiting"; sleep 30; done
start=$(date +%s)
run 'bash wasm-build/build-osg.sh >/tmp/osg.log 2>&1 || { tail -40 /tmp/osg.log; exit 1; }; ninja -C build-wasm64 components openmw-lib; bash wasm-build/link-openmw.sh' \
  > "$root/.orthros-dev-build.log" 2>&1 || true
grep -E '^(FAILED|Linked)|error:' "$root/.orthros-dev-build.log" | head -60 || true
test "$root/build-wasm64/openmw.wasm" -nt "$state" || { echo "build failed (no new openmw.wasm; whole log $root/.orthros-dev-build.log)" >&2; exit 1; }
echo "built in $(( $(date +%s) - start )) s"
python3 - "$root" "$base" "$out" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, shutil, sys
root, base, out = map(pathlib.Path, sys.argv[1:])
build, play = root / 'build-wasm64', root / 'play'
h = hashlib.sha256()
for f in (build / 'openmw.wasm', build / 'openmw.js', build / 'openmw.data', play / 'streamfs.js'): h.update(f.read_bytes())
ver = h.hexdigest()[:12]
if out.exists(): shutil.rmtree(out)
out.mkdir(parents=True)
def link(src, dst):
    # (hard links within one file system; across file systems — a live release under data/ as the base — copies: the
    # server serves a release's file only when its real path is inside the release (engineFile), a symlink out of it
    # answered 404 — the launcher, the portal, the asset pack)
    try: os.link(src, dst)
    except OSError as e:
        if e.errno != 18: raise
        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
for f in base.iterdir():
    if f.name in ('e', 'index.html', 'release.json', 'engine-version.txt'): continue
    # (the base release's other files linked, never written: the portal, notices, the asset pack)
    (shutil.copytree(f, out / f.name, copy_function=link) if f.is_dir() else link(f, out / f.name))
e = out / 'e' / ver; e.mkdir(parents=True)
for n in ('openmw.js', 'openmw.wasm', 'openmw.data', 'openmw.js.symbols'): shutil.copy2(build / n, e / n)
shutil.copy2(play / 'streamfs.js', e / 'streamfs.js')
(out / 'index.html').write_text((play / 'index.html').read_text().replace('__ENGINE_VERSION__', ver).replace('src="streamfs.js"', f'src="e/{ver}/streamfs.js"'))
(out / 'engine-version.txt').write_text(ver)
info = json.loads((base / 'release.json').read_text())
patches = [l for l in (root / '.orthros-dev-patches').read_text().split('\n') if l]
# (the engine files' own hashes: the server serves a release's engine files by the hashes its release.json lists)
import hashlib
if 'engineFiles' in info: info['engineFiles'] = {n: hashlib.sha256((e / n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in ('openmw.js', 'openmw.wasm', 'openmw.data')}
info.update({'id': out.name, 'engineVersion': ver, 'devPatches': patches,
             'files': [f'e/{ver}/{n}' for n in ('openmw.js', 'openmw.wasm', 'openmw.data', 'streamfs.js')] + [f for f in info['files'] if not f.startswith('e/')]})
(out / 'release.json').write_text(json.dumps(info, indent=2) + '\n')
print(f'installed {out} (engine {ver})')
PY
```

`tools/openmw/dev-serve.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# An Orthros server of this code tree (scratch, beside the live one) whose OpenMW pages run a development release
# (tools/openmw/dev-build.sh) in place of the engine the live manifests name: an engines directory in scratch whose
# entries of those names link to it (the upstream release linked as itself, for its assets), the live games read-only,
# a copy of the live learned orders (frozen: what the pages report is not kept), no brotli cache. For measuring and
# checking a development release with the live games' manifests unchanged.
# Usage: sh tools/openmw/dev-serve.sh <release dir> <port> [<scratch dir>]   (prints the server's pid; stop it with kill)
set -eu
release=$(cd "$1" && pwd) port=$2 dir=${3:-/tmp/orthros-scratch/openmw-dev-serve-$2}
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd) live=/srv/orthros
test -f "$release/index.html" || { echo "$release is not a release" >&2; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$dir/engines" "$dir/learn"
# (the names the live manifests give their OpenMW engine, each linked to the release under test)
names=$(python3 - "$live/data/games" <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
names = set()
for m in pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).glob('*/manifest.json'):
    try: d = json.loads(m.read_text())
    except Exception: continue
    for v in d.get('versions', []):
        e = (v.get('openmw') or {}).get('engine')
        if e: names.add(e)
# (and every Orthros release installed: a manifest switched to another one while the server runs keeps the release under test)
names |= {e.name for e in pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).parent.joinpath('engines').glob('openmw-web-*-orthros-r*') if '.' not in e.name.split('-r')[-1]}
print(' '.join(sorted(names)))
PY
)
for n in $names; do
  l="$dir/engines/$n"; [ -L "$l" ] && unlink "$l"; [ -e "$l" ] && { echo "$l exists and is not a link" >&2; exit 1; }
  ln -s "$release" "$l"
done
up="$dir/engines/openmw-web-v1.5.3"; [ -e "$up" ] || ln -s "$live/data/engines/openmw-web-v1.5.3" "$up"
cp /var/lib/orthros2/learn/*morrowind* "$dir/learn/"
cd "$root"
nohup node src/host/server.js --port "$port" --games-dir "$live/data/games" --engines-dir "$dir/engines" --learn "$dir/learn" \
  --br-cache off --covers off > "$dir/server.log" 2>&1 &
echo $!
```

`tools/openmw/dtprobe.mjs`:

```mjs
// Round-8 validation probe of the draw thread (OPENMW_ORTHROS_DRAWTHREAD), scratch only. One browser, one page variant
// (--query). Modes:
//   --pictures: the main menu (no ?start), then a new character at --start: the world held still, F12 (the PNG the
//     engine writes), the world view, the inventory (menu mode, right button), the journal (J), a door-like cell change
//     (console coc into --interior) recorded by the compositor's screencast, then a save/load cycle (F5, F9, F5): each
//     save's pump time, the save's thumbnail (JPEG) and global map overlay (PNG) extracted from the file.
//   --watch <s>: boot at --start, then <s> seconds watched: the page's notices (#omw-fatal), navigations, the frames
//     shown, the engine's log lines about the draw thread (QA values: fail, lose, crash, refuse, mismatch, ?aa=2).
//   --fullscreen: (with --watch) the canvas asked fullscreen from a click, as SDL's fullscreen window mode does.
// Usage: tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/openmw/dtprobe.mjs <manifest> --url <origin> [--query q] --out <dir>
//   (--pictures | --watch 60 [--fullscreen]) [--discard]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { launchOptions } from '../port-perf.mjs';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), id = args[0], arg = (k, d = null) => args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : d;
const base = arg('--url'), query = arg('--query', ''), dir = arg('--out'), start = arg('--start', '-2,-9');
const interior = arg('--interior', "Seyda Nihyn, auberge d'Arrile"), discard = args.includes('--discard');
fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }); process.env.TMPDIR = dir;
const out = { query, faults: [], log: [], navigations: 0 };
const browser = await chromium.launch(launchOptions({ gl: 'swiftshader', channel: 'chromium' }));
const wanted = /DIAG|omwSync|not a crash|WebGL|Too many|drawthread|draw thread|Orthros:|Global map|crash|lost|fatal|EXC|ABORT|worker sent an error|unwind|threw/i;
const app = (extra) => `${base}/ports/openmw/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/app/index.html?src=hosted&novid${extra}${query ? '&' + query : ''}`;

async function newPage() {
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 800 } });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => out.faults.push(e.message.slice(0, 300)));
  page.on('console', (m) => { const t = m.text(); if (wanted.test(t) && out.log.length < 400) out.log.push(`[${new Date().toISOString().slice(11, 23)}] ${t.slice(0, 400)}`); });
  page.on('framenavigated', (f) => { if (f === page.mainFrame()) out.navigations++; });
  await page.route((u) => /\/clientlog$|\/api\/(telemetry|prefetch|profile-seed|programs|regions)(\/|$)/.test(u.pathname), (r) => r.request().method() === 'GET' ? r.continue() : r.fulfill({ status: 204, body: '' }));
  await page.addInitScript((discard) => {
    if (discard) {
      const proto = WebGL2RenderingContext.prototype, RD = 0x8C89, enable = proto.enable, disable = proto.disable, getContext = HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.getContext;
      proto.disable = function (cap) { if (cap === RD) return; return disable.call(this, cap); };
      HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.getContext = function (...a) { const gl = getContext.apply(this, a); if (gl && gl instanceof WebGL2RenderingContext) enable.call(gl, RD); return gl; };
    }
    // (diagnostics: who loses a context, and every context-lost event with its stack)
    const ge = WebGL2RenderingContext.prototype.getExtension;
    WebGL2RenderingContext.prototype.getExtension = function (name) {
      const x = ge.call(this, name);
      if (x && name === 'WEBGL_lose_context' && !x.__w) { const l = x.loseContext; x.loseContext = function () { console.log('DIAG loseContext called, lost already: ' + this.__gl?.isContextLost?.() + ' ' + new Error().stack.slice(0, 600)); return l.call(this); }; x.__gl = this; x.__w = true; }
      return x;
    };
    addEventListener('webglcontextlost', (e) => console.log('DIAG webglcontextlost on ' + (e.target?.id || e.target?.tagName) + ' trusted ' + e.isTrusted + ' ' + new Error().stack.slice(0, 400)), true);
    const gc = HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.getContext;
    HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.getContext = function (...a) { const c = gc.apply(this, a); if (c && /webgl/.test(a[0]) && !this.__d) { this.__d = 1; this.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', (e) => console.log('DIAG canvas ' + (this.id || 'anon') + ' lost, trusted ' + e.isTrusted + ' ' + new Error().stack.slice(0, 500))); } return c; };
    const ogc = OffscreenCanvas.prototype.getContext;
    OffscreenCanvas.prototype.getContext = function (...a) { const c = ogc.apply(this, a); if (c && /webgl/.test(a[0])) console.log('DIAG offscreen context made, lost: ' + c.isContextLost() + ' ' + new Error().stack.slice(0, 400)); return c; };
    // (round 9: every __omwSync call logged, with its end or its throw — the crash notice's sync after the page aborted)
    let syncFn;

  }, discard);
  return { context, page };
}
```

`tools/openmw/frame-attr.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Where an OpenMW port's frame goes: a Chrome CPU profile (tools/openmw/perf.mjs --profile: <out>/perf.cpuprofile, the
# page's thread; --workers: <out>/perf-worker-<n>.cpuprofile, one per worker) read with the release's symbol map
# (Emscripten's --emit-symbol-map, <release>/e/<hash>/openmw.js.symbols: "N:name" lines naming the profile's
# wasm-function[N]). Run with python3 -I.
#
# Usage: python3 -I tools/openmw/frame-attr.py <profile> --symbols <openmw.js.symbols> [--frames N]
#          [--hitches MS] [--list 40] [--top N] [--callers <text>] [--callees <text>] [--skip-start 0.4] [--no-trim]
#          [--json <file>]
#
# The window: the first --skip-start seconds dropped (0.4: the profiler's own start), and on the page's thread the tail
# from perf.mjs's closing read on (its renderer's getContext outside the engine — the measured frames end there);
# --no-trim keeps it. A sample lasts until the next one (timeDeltas[i + 1]). Busy: every sample but "(idle)"
# ("(program)" and "(garbage collector)" count: the thread was not free). --frames: the measured frames (ms per frame);
# by default perf.json's "frames" beside the profile.
#
# Buckets (busy ms per frame and share): each sample goes to ONE bucket —
#   1. read-sync if a synchronous read of the game data is anywhere on its stack (JS fetchSync, fetchChunkSync,
#      readSync: the thread waits for the data worker or the network, whoever asked);
#   2. otherwise the first frame, walking from the leaf up, that a rule below matches (rules tried in this order on
#      each frame; a frame's name is its qualified function name, return type and arguments dropped):
#        wait        a thread waiting: futex / condition / semaphore / join / yield / sleep (Emscripten's waits spin
#                    or block without the profiler seeing "(idle)": a worker's pool thread waiting for work, the page's
#                    thread waiting for a worker)
#        lua-ui      LuaUi::...updateWidget / updateContent (the Lua UI's layouts applied)
#        lua-sync    MWLua::LuaManager::synchronizedUpdate (its lambdas too)
#        lua-update  MWLua::LuaManager::update (its lambdas too; with Lua's update on its own thread, r14
#                    OPENMW_ORTHROS_LUATHREAD, it is in that worker's profile, MWLua::Worker)
#        physics     MWPhysics::*, Bullet (bt*)
#        sound       MWSound::*, OpenAL's JS (AL.*, _al*)
#        gui         MWGui::*, MyGUI::*, osgMyGUI::*, Gui::*
#        mechanics   MWMechanics::*
#        osg-cull    osgUtil::CullVisitor::*, osgUtil::SceneView::cull*, osgViewer::Renderer::cull
#        osg-draw+GL osgUtil::SceneView::draw*, RenderStage/RenderBin/RenderLeaf::*, osgViewer::Renderer::draw, and
#                    every GL entry point (_emscripten_gl*, _gl*, gl*, orthrosGL*, webgl*: a GL call is GL whoever
#                    makes it)
#        osg-update  osgViewer::Viewer::updateTraversal, osgUtil::UpdateVisitor::*
#      so a leaf's own subsystem wins over the phase that called it (Lua calling into mechanics: mechanics; a cull
#      callback's engine code: osg-cull, being in no rule itself);
#   3. no rule matched: engine-other if any frame is the engine's WebAssembly, other otherwise (the page's JS, GC,
#      "(program)": the browser's own work).
#
# --hitches MS: every busy stretch longer than MS ms (consecutive non-idle samples; in a worker's profile — no
# omw_pump_frame in it — its waits end a stretch too; on the page's thread a wait is frame time): its start (s into the
# profile), length, buckets, top functions (inclusive, a function once a sample, dispatch left out) and ONE cause: per
# sample the outermost specific frame (walking from the root down, the first frame that is not dispatch — page/JS glue,
# worker entry, omw_pump_frame, OMW::Engine::frame, the viewer's frame and traversals, the graphics context's
# operations, OSG's node/visitor/render-bin plumbing, the post-processing's ping-pong cull, LuaManager's update /
# synchronizedUpdate / delayed actions and the Lua UI's element/widget/content updates, sol/Lua's interpreter, std::),
# or the leaf when every frame is dispatch; the stretch's cause is the one with the most time in it (a stretch of
# ordinary frame work names its biggest piece). Then the stretches aggregated by cause (count, total, longest, main
# bucket). --list: how many stretches printed (longest first; 40).
# --top N: the N functions with the most self time, with their bucket. --callers / --callees <text>: the inclusive time
# of the functions whose name holds <text>, split by their direct callers / callees.
# --json <file>: the same numbers, machine-readable.
import collections, json, os, re, sys

RULES = [
    ('wait', re.compile(r'^(?:_do_futex_wait|emscripten_futex_wait|__timedwait(?:_cp)?|__pthread_cond_timedwait|__wait|sem_wait'
                        r'|sem_timedwait|pthread_join|__pthread_join|sched_yield|emscripten_thread_sleep|nanosleep)$')),
    ('lua-ui', re.compile(r'^LuaUi::(?:.*::)?(?:updateWidget|updateContent)\b')),
    ('lua-sync', re.compile(r'MWLua::LuaManager::synchronizedUpdate\b')),
    ('lua-update', re.compile(r'MWLua::LuaManager::update(?:\(|$)')),
    ('physics', re.compile(r'^(?:MWPhysics::|bt[A-Z]\w*(?:::|$))')),
    ('sound', re.compile(r'^(?:MWSound::|AL\.|_al[A-Z])')),
    ('gui', re.compile(r'^(?:MWGui::|MyGUI::|osgMyGUI::|Gui::)')),
    ('mechanics', re.compile(r'^MWMechanics::')),
    ('osg-cull', re.compile(r'^(?:osgUtil::CullVisitor::|osgUtil::SceneView::cull|osgViewer::Renderer::cull$)')),
    ('osg-draw+GL', re.compile(r'^(?:osgUtil::SceneView::draw|osgUtil::(?:RenderStage|RenderBin|RenderLeaf)::|osgViewer::Renderer::draw$'
                               r'|_?emscripten_gl|_gl[A-Z]|gl[A-Z]\w*$|orthrosGL|webgl)')),
    ('osg-update', re.compile(r'^(?:osgViewer::Viewer::updateTraversal|osgUtil::UpdateVisitor::)')),
]
READ_SYNC = re.compile(r'^(?:fetchSync|fetchChunkSync|readSync)$')
BUCKETS = ['osg-draw+GL', 'osg-cull', 'osg-update', 'lua-update', 'lua-sync', 'lua-ui', 'read-sync', 'wait', 'physics', 'mechanics',
           'sound', 'gui', 'engine-other', 'other']
# (dispatch: frames passed through when looking for a hitch's cause)
DISPATCH = re.compile(
    r'^(?:\(root\)|\(anonymous\)|js-to-wasm|wasm-to-js|dynCall|invoke_|callUserCallback|tick|timed|pump\w*|_?omw_pump_frame'
    # (r20's JSPI pump: the page's frame entered through these)
    r'|choose|orthrosPumpFrame'
    r'|handleMessage|invokeEntryPoint|\S*::webThreadMain|start_thread|_?emscripten_thread_\w*'
    r'|OMW::Engine::frame|OMW::Engine::go|osgViewer::(?:ViewerBase|Viewer|CompositeViewer)::(?:frame|renderingTraversals|eventTraversal|updateTraversal|advance)'
    r'|osgViewer::Renderer::(?:cull_draw|cull|draw|operator)|osgUtil::SceneView::(?:cull|draw)\w*'
    r'|osg::GraphicsContext::runOperations|osg::GraphicsOperation::operator'
    r'|osgUtil::SceneView::cullStage|MWRender::PostProcessor::traverse|SceneUtil::NodeCallback<MWRender::PingPongCull'
    r'|MWLua::LuaManager::(?:update|synchronizedUpdate|applyDelayedActions|DelayedAction::apply)|LuaUtil::invokeProtectedCall<MWLua::LuaManager::'
    r'|LuaUi::Element::update|LuaUi::(?:.*::)?(?:updateWidget|updateContent)\b'
    r'|osgUtil::(?:RenderStage|RenderBin|RenderLeaf)::(?:draw|drawImplementation|drawInner|drawPreRenderStages|drawPostRenderStages|render)\w*'
    r'|osgUtil::CullVisitor::(?:apply|traverse|handle_cull_callbacks_and_traverse|handle_cull_callbacks_and_accept)'
    r'|osgUtil::UpdateVisitor::(?:apply|traverse|handle_callbacks)\w*'
    r'|osg::(?:Node|Group|Transform|MatrixTransform|PositionAttitudeTransform|Switch|LOD|PagedLOD|Geode|Camera|Drawable|NodeVisitor|Callback|NodeCallback|DrawableCullCallback|CallbackObject)::(?:accept|traverse|apply|run|operator)\w*'
    r'|osg::NodeVisitor::|std::|sol::|LuaUtil::invokeProtectedCall|LuaUtil::call|lua[A-Z_]|luaD_|luaV_|luaT_|luaG_|f_call|resume|precallC)')

def qualified(name):
    """A demangled C++ name's function: return type and arguments dropped ("int A::f<B::g()>(x) const" -> "A::f<B::g()>")."""
    s = name.replace('(anonymous namespace)', '{anon}')
    depth, cut = 0, len(s)
    for i, ch in enumerate(s):
        if ch == '<':
            depth += 1
        elif ch == '>' and depth:
            depth -= 1
        elif ch == '(' and depth == 0 and not s[:i].endswith('operator') and i > 0:
            cut = i
            break
    head, parts, depth, cur = s[:cut], [], 0, ''
    for ch in head:
        if ch == '<':
            depth += 1
        elif ch == '>' and depth:
            depth -= 1
        if ch == ' ' and depth == 0:
            parts.append(cur); cur = ''
        else:
            cur += ch
    parts.append(cur)
    q = parts[-1] or head
    return q.replace('{anon}', '(anonymous namespace)')

def main(argv):
    if not argv or argv[0].startswith('-'):
        sys.exit('usage: frame-attr.py <profile> --symbols <openmw.js.symbols> [--frames N] [--hitches MS] [--list 40] '
                 '[--top N] [--callers <text>] [--callees <text>] [--skip-start 0.4] [--no-trim] [--json <file>]')
    path, args = argv[0], argv[1:]
    def opt(k, d=None):
        return args[args.index(k) + 1] if k in args and args.index(k) + 1 < len(args) else d
    symbols = {}
    if opt('--symbols'):
        for line in open(opt('--symbols'), encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'):
            i, _, n = line.rstrip('\n').partition(':')
            symbols[i] = n
    else:
        print('frame-attr: no --symbols: WebAssembly frames keep their numbers', file=sys.stderr)
    frames = int(opt('--frames', 0))
    if not frames:
        pj = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), 'perf.json')
        if os.path.exists(pj):
            frames = int(json.load(open(pj)).get('frames') or 0)
    prof = json.load(open(path))
    nodes = {n['id']: n for n in prof['nodes']}
    parent = {}
    for n in prof['nodes']:
        for c in n.get('children', []):
            parent[c] = n['id']

    names, quals, wasm = {}, {}, {}
    for nid, n in nodes.items():
        f = n['callFrame']
        nm = f.get('functionName') or '(anonymous)'
        m = re.match(r'^\$?(?:wasm-function\[(\d+)\]|(\d+))$', nm)
        if m:
            nm = symbols.get(m.group(1) or m.group(2), nm)
        url = f.get('url') or ''
        wasm[nid] = url.endswith('.wasm')
        quals[nid] = qualified(nm) if wasm[nid] else nm
        names[nid] = nm if wasm[nid] or not url else f'{nm} [{url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1].split("?")[0]}]'

    stacks = {}
    def stack(nid):  # leaf first
        if nid not in stacks:
            st, x = [], nid
            while x is not None:
                st.append(x); x = parent.get(x)
            stacks[nid] = st
        return stacks[nid]

    bucket_of = {}
    def bucket(nid):
        if nid in bucket_of:
            return bucket_of[nid]
        st, b = stack(nid), None
        if any(not wasm[x] and READ_SYNC.match(quals[x]) for x in st):
            b = 'read-sync'
        else:
            for x in st:
                q = quals[x]
                for cat, rx in RULES:
                    if rx.search(q):
                        b = cat; break
                if b:
                    break
            if not b:
                b = 'engine-other' if any(wasm[x] for x in st) else 'other'
        bucket_of[nid] = b
        return b

    cause_of = {}
    def cause(nid):
        if nid not in cause_of:
            st = stack(nid)
            c = next((quals[x] for x in reversed(st) if not DISPATCH.match(quals[x])), quals[st[0]])
            cause_of[nid] = c
        return cause_of[nid]

    # (the samples, their times and durations; the window)
    samples, deltas = prof['samples'], prof['timeDeltas']
    ts, t = [], prof['startTime']
    for d in deltas:
        t += d; ts.append(t)
    dur = [(ts[i + 1] - ts[i]) / 1000.0 if i + 1 < len(ts) else max(0, prof['endTime'] - ts[i]) / 1000.0 for i in range(len(ts))]
    t0 = prof['startTime'] + float(opt('--skip-start', 0.4)) * 1e6
    lo = next((i for i, x in enumerate(ts) if x >= t0), len(ts))
    hi = len(ts)
    if '--no-trim' not in args:
        closing = lambda nid: any(quals[x] == 'getContext' for x in stack(nid)) and not any(wasm[x] for x in stack(nid))
        first = next((i for i in range(lo, len(samples)) if closing(samples[i])), None)
        if first is not None:
            hi = first
    idle_ids = {nid for nid in nodes if quals[nid] == '(idle)'}
    win = range(lo, hi)
    wall = (ts[hi - 1] - ts[lo]) / 1000.0 + dur[hi - 1] if hi > lo else 0.0

    by_bucket, selfc = collections.Counter(), collections.Counter()
    busy = 0.0
    for i in win:
        nid = samples[i]
        if nid in idle_ids:
            continue
        ms = dur[i]; busy += ms
        by_bucket[bucket(nid)] += ms
        selfc[nid] += ms
    perf = lambda ms: ms / frames if frames else None
    waited = by_bucket.get('wait', 0.0)
    out = {'profile': path, 'frames': frames, 'windowMs': round(wall, 1), 'busyMs': round(busy, 1), 'waitMs': round(waited, 1),
           'busyPerFrame': round(perf(busy), 2) if frames else None, 'buckets': {}}
    print(f'{os.path.basename(path)}: window {wall / 1000:.2f} s, busy {busy:.0f} ms ({100 * busy / max(wall, 1e-9):.1f} %)'
          + (f', {frames} frames: busy {busy / frames:.2f} ms/frame' if frames else ' (no --frames: totals only)')
          + (f'; without waits {busy - waited:.0f} ms' + (f' ({(busy - waited) / frames:.2f} ms/frame)' if frames else '') if waited else ''))
    print(f'  {"bucket":<13} {"ms":>9} {"ms/frame":>9} {"share":>7}')
    for b in BUCKETS:
        ms = by_bucket.get(b, 0.0)
        out['buckets'][b] = {'ms': round(ms, 1), 'perFrame': round(perf(ms), 3) if frames else None, 'share': round(ms / max(busy, 1e-9), 4)}
        print(f'  {b:<13} {ms:9.1f} {(f"{ms / frames:9.2f}" if frames else "        -")} {100 * ms / max(busy, 1e-9):6.1f}%')

    top = int(opt('--top', 0))
    if top:
        agg, bk = collections.Counter(), {}
        for nid, ms in selfc.items():
            agg[names[nid]] += ms; bk.setdefault(names[nid], collections.Counter())[bucket(nid)] += ms
        print(f'\nself time, top {top}:')
        out['top'] = []
        for nm, ms in agg.most_common(top):
            b = bk[nm].most_common(1)[0][0]
            out['top'].append({'name': nm, 'ms': round(ms, 1), 'bucket': b})
            print(f'  {ms:8.1f} ms {100 * ms / max(busy, 1e-9):5.1f}%  {b:<12} {nm[:150]}')

    for flag, key in (('--callers', 'callers'), ('--callees', 'callees')):
        want = opt(flag)
        if not want:
            continue
        incl, split = 0.0, collections.Counter()
        for i in win:
            nid = samples[i]
            if nid in idle_ids:
                continue
            st, ms = stack(nid), dur[i]
            hits = [k for k, x in enumerate(st) if want in names[x]]
            if not hits:
                continue
            incl += ms
            seen = set()
            for k in hits:
                other = (names[st[k + 1]] if k + 1 < len(st) else '(none)') if key == 'callers' else (names[st[k - 1]] if k > 0 else '(self)')
                if other not in seen:
                    seen.add(other); split[other] += ms
        print(f'\n{key} of functions holding "{want}": inclusive {incl:.1f} ms' + (f' ({incl / frames:.2f} ms/frame)' if frames else ''))
        out[key] = {'match': want, 'inclusiveMs': round(incl, 1), 'split': []}
        for nm, ms in split.most_common(30):
            out[key]['split'].append({'name': nm, 'ms': round(ms, 1)})
            print(f'  {ms:8.1f} ms {100 * ms / max(incl, 1e-9):5.1f}%  {nm[:150]}')

    if opt('--hitches'):
        limit, show = float(opt('--hitches')), int(opt('--list', 40))
        # (a worker's waits end its stretches: its pool waits for work; on the page's thread a wait is frame time)
        split_waits = not any(quals[x] in ('omw_pump_frame', '_omw_pump_frame') for x in nodes)
        runs, run = [], None
        for i in win:
            nid = samples[i]
            if nid in idle_ids or (split_waits and bucket(nid) == 'wait'):
                if run:
                    runs.append(run); run = None
                continue
            if run is None:
                run = {'start': (ts[i] - prof['startTime']) / 1e6, 'ms': 0.0, 'ids': []}
            run['ms'] += dur[i]; run['ids'].append((nid, dur[i]))
        if run:
            runs.append(run)
        long = [r for r in runs if r['ms'] > limit]
        by_cause = collections.defaultdict(lambda: {'n': 0, 'ms': 0.0, 'max': 0.0, 'bucket': collections.Counter()})
        out['hitches'] = []
        for r in long:
            causes, bks, incl = collections.Counter(), collections.Counter(), collections.Counter()
            for nid, ms in r['ids']:
                causes[cause(nid)] += ms; bks[bucket(nid)] += ms
                for nm in {names[x] for x in stack(nid)} - {'(root)'}:
                    incl[nm] += ms
            r['cause'] = causes.most_common(1)[0][0]
            r['buckets'], r['top'] = bks, incl
            c = by_cause[r['cause']]
            c['n'] += 1; c['ms'] += r['ms']; c['max'] = max(c['max'], r['ms']); c['bucket'].update(bks)
        long.sort(key=lambda r: -r['ms'])
        total = sum(r['ms'] for r in long)
        print(f'\nbusy stretches over {limit:g} ms: {len(long)}, {total:.0f} ms' + (f' (longest {show})' if len(long) > show else ''))
        for r in long:
            out['hitches'].append({'start': round(r['start'], 3), 'ms': round(r['ms'], 1), 'cause': r['cause'],
                                   'buckets': {k: round(v, 1) for k, v in r['buckets'].most_common()},
                                   'top': [[k, round(v, 1)] for k, v in r['top'].most_common(12)]})
        for r in long[:show]:
            bk = ', '.join(f'{k} {v:.0f}' for k, v in r['buckets'].most_common(4))
            print(f'\n  {r["ms"]:6.1f} ms at {r["start"]:7.2f} s  cause: {r["cause"][:120]}\n    buckets: {bk}')
            for nm, ms in [x for x in r['top'].most_common(30) if not DISPATCH.match(qualified(x[0].split(' [')[0]))][:8]:
                print(f'    {ms:6.1f}  {nm[:140]}')
        print(f'\nby cause:\n  {"n":>4} {"total ms":>9} {"max ms":>7}  {"bucket":<12} cause')
        out['byCause'] = []
        for k, c in sorted(by_cause.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]['ms']):
            b = c['bucket'].most_common(1)[0][0]
            out['byCause'].append({'cause': k, 'n': c['n'], 'ms': round(c['ms'], 1), 'max': round(c['max'], 1), 'bucket': b})
            print(f'  {c["n"]:4d} {c["ms"]:9.1f} {c["max"]:7.1f}  {b:<12} {k[:120]}')

    if opt('--json'):
        with open(opt('--json'), 'w') as f:
            json.dump(out, f, indent=1)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(sys.argv[1:])
```

`tools/openmw/frame-compare.mjs`:

```mjs
// Pictures of an OpenMW port's engine compared between page variants (each a query string: e.g. the engine's switches,
// ?omwenv=OPENMW_ORTHROS_UNIFORMS=0, against the defaults): for each view a new character started in its cell (?start=),
// the world held still where it can be (the console's `tai`: no AI moves; `set timescale to 0`: the sun stays), the time
// of day set (the engine's omw_debug_sethour), the camera turned (omw_debug_look), and the engine's canvas captured
// once the view settled, the page's own overlays hidden (the game data's indicator). The first variant is captured
// twice: what differs between those two captures (water, sky, particles) is the noise; a variant is the same picture
// when it differs from the first by no more than that. Per view: the mean absolute difference (0-255) and the share of
// pixels differing by more than 24 in a channel, for each variant against the first and for the repeat. Use a game
// without interface addons (their messages come and go): morrowind-goty-en. SwiftShader draws (no rasterizer discard):
// slow, the views wait. Not a gameplay check. Always through tools/with-browser-slot.sh:
//   tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/openmw/frame-compare.mjs <manifest> --url <origin> [--variant <query>]...
//     [--views day,night,interior] [--exterior -2,-9] [--interior "Seyda Neen, Arrille's Tradehouse"] [--settle 20]
//     [--frames 4] [--out <dir>]   (--frames: captures a view, 1.5 s apart, averaged — interiors' lights flicker; and
//     compared pair by pair, each capture of one run with each of the other's, the nearest pair kept — "nearest": a light
//     flickering through the whole view lands two runs on the same phase in some pair, noise and difference alike)
//   The first --variant is the reference ('' for the page's defaults); views: day (the exterior at 13 h, the camera
//   turned south-west, slightly down), night (the same at 22 h), interior (the cell --interior at 13 h).
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { launchOptions } from '../port-perf.mjs';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), id = args[0], arg = (k, d = null) => args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : d;
if (!id) throw new Error('Expected a manifest id');
const base = arg('--url', 'http://localhost:8080'), exterior = arg('--exterior', '-2,-9'), settle = Number(arg('--settle', 20)), frames = Math.max(1, Number(arg('--frames', 4)));
const variants = args.flatMap((a, i) => (a === '--variant' ? [args[i + 1] ?? ''] : []));
if (!variants.length) variants.push('');
const views = arg('--views', 'day,night,interior').split(',').filter(Boolean);
const interior = arg('--interior', "Seyda Neen, Arrille's Tradehouse");
const dir = arg('--out', `/tmp/orthros-scratch/openmw-frames-${id}`);
fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }); process.env.TMPDIR = dir;
const VIEW = {
  day: { start: exterior, hour: 13, look: [225, -8] },
  night: { start: exterior, hour: 22, look: [225, -8] },
  interior: { start: interior, hour: 13, look: [0, -5] },
};

const browser = await chromium.launch(launchOptions({ gl: 'swiftshader', channel: arg('--channel', 'chromium') }));
const shots = {}, data = {}, faults = [];
try {
  // (the reference twice — its second run the noise —, then each other variant)
  const runs = [{ name: 'ref', q: variants[0] }, { name: 'ref2', q: variants[0] }, ...variants.slice(1).map((q, i) => ({ name: `v${i + 1}`, q }))];
  for (const v of views) {
    const view = VIEW[v]; if (!view) throw new Error(`unknown view ${v}`);
    for (const run of runs) {
      const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 800 } });
      const page = await context.newPage();
      page.on('pageerror', (e) => faults.push(`${v}/${run.name}: ${e.message}`));
      // (the requests of content files' light copies: read while the engine loaded its content)
      let contentLight = 0;
      page.on('request', (r) => { if (/\/\.light\/[^?]*\.(esm|esp|omwaddon|omwgame)(\?|$)/i.test(decodeURIComponent(new URL(r.url()).pathname))) contentLight++; });
      await page.route((u) => /\/clientlog$|\/api\/(telemetry|prefetch|profile-seed|programs|regions)(\/|$)/.test(u.pathname), (r) => r.request().method() === 'GET' ? r.continue() : r.fulfill({ status: 204, body: '' }));
      await page.goto(`${base}/ports/openmw/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/app/index.html?src=hosted&start=${encodeURIComponent(view.start)}&novid${run.q ? '&' + run.q : ''}`);
      await page.waitForFunction(() => window.omw?.state?.['orthros.view'] !== undefined, null, { timeout: 900000, polling: 500 });
      await page.mouse.click(640, 400);
      await page.waitForTimeout(5000);
      // (the world held still: no AI moves, the clock stopped once set)
      await page.keyboard.press('Backquote'); await page.waitForTimeout(800);
      for (const c of ['tai', 'set timescale to 0']) { await page.keyboard.type(c); await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); await page.waitForTimeout(400); }
      await page.keyboard.press('Backquote'); await page.waitForTimeout(800);
      await page.evaluate((h) => window.Module._omw_debug_sethour?.(h), view.hour);
      await page.evaluate(([y, p]) => window.Module._omw_debug_look?.(y, p), view.look);
      await page.waitForTimeout(settle * 1000);
      // (the engine's canvas alone: the page's fixed overlays — the game data's indicator — hidden; not the layer that
      // shows the frames of an engine drawing on its own thread, OPENMW_ORTHROS_DRAWTHREAD, laid over the canvas)
      const engine = await page.evaluateHandle(() => {
        const c = window.Module?.canvas ?? document.getElementById('canvas') ?? document.querySelector('canvas');
        for (const o of document.querySelectorAll('canvas')) if (o !== c && o.id !== 'omw-drawthread-layer' && getComputedStyle(o).position === 'fixed') o.style.display = 'none';
        return c;
      });
      // (several captures 1.5 s apart, averaged when compared: interiors' lights flicker)
      const files = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < frames; k++) {
        const file = path.join(dir, `${v}-${run.name}-${k}.png`);
        await engine.asElement().screenshot({ path: file }); files.push(file);
        if (k < frames - 1) await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
      }
      (shots[v] ??= {})[run.name] = files;
      // (how the page read the game data — its content files light or not, docs/slow-network.md "Content files light
      // before the menu" —, and what it fetched)
      (data[v] ??= {})[run.name] = await page.evaluate(() => { const s = window.__streamfsStats; return s ? { content: s.content ?? null, contentLoadingMs: s.contentLoadingMs ?? null, contentLoadedMs: s.contentLoadedMs ?? null, fetchedBytes: s.fetchedBytes, wantWaits: s.wantWaits } : null; }).then((d) => d && { ...d, contentLightRequests: contentLight }).catch(() => null);
      await context.close();
    }
  }
  // (the differences, decoded in a page: two pictures' pixels side by side)
  const page = await browser.newPage();
  const diff = (a, b) => page.evaluate(async ([xs, ys]) => {
    const load = async (b64) => { const bm = await createImageBitmap(await (await fetch(`data:image/png;base64,${b64}`)).blob()); const c = new OffscreenCanvas(bm.width, bm.height), g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(bm, 0, 0); return g.getImageData(0, 0, bm.width, bm.height).data; };
    // (a run's captures averaged)
    const mean = async (list) => { const all = await Promise.all(list.map(load)), m = new Float32Array(all[0].length); for (const d of all) for (let i = 0; i < m.length; i++) m[i] += d[i] / all.length; return m; };
    const [p, q] = await Promise.all([mean(xs), mean(ys)]);
    if (p.length !== q.length) return { error: 'sizes differ' };
    let sum = 0, over = 0; const n = p.length / 4;
    for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 4) {
      const r = Math.abs(p[i] - q[i]), g = Math.abs(p[i + 1] - q[i + 1]), b = Math.abs(p[i + 2] - q[i + 2]);
      sum += (r + g + b) / 3; if (Math.max(r, g, b) > 24) over++;
    }
    // (each capture against each: the nearest pair — the same flicker phase — and the median pair)
    const all = [await Promise.all(xs.map(load)), await Promise.all(ys.map(load))], pairs = [];
    for (const x of all[0]) for (const y of all[1]) {
      if (x.length !== y.length) continue;
      let s2 = 0, o2 = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i += 4) { const r = Math.abs(x[i] - y[i]), g = Math.abs(x[i + 1] - y[i + 1]), b = Math.abs(x[i + 2] - y[i + 2]); s2 += (r + g + b) / 3; if (Math.max(r, g, b) > 24) o2++; }
      pairs.push({ meanAbs: +(s2 / n).toFixed(3), over24: +(o2 / n * 100).toFixed(3) });
    }
    pairs.sort((u, w) => u.meanAbs - w.meanAbs);
    return { meanAbs: +(sum / n).toFixed(3), over24: +(over / n * 100).toFixed(3), nearest: pairs[0] ?? null, medianPair: pairs[Math.floor(pairs.length / 2)] ?? null };
  }, [a.map((f) => fs.readFileSync(f).toString('base64')), b.map((f) => fs.readFileSync(f).toString('base64'))]);
  const report = {};
  for (const v of views) {
    const s = shots[v]; report[v] = { noise: await diff(s.ref, s.ref2) };
    variants.slice(1).forEach((q, i) => { report[v][q] = null; });
    for (let i = 1; i < variants.length; i++) report[v][variants[i]] = await diff(s.ref, s[`v${i}`]);
  }
  const out = { manifest: id, url: base, reference: variants[0], views: report, data, shots: dir, faults };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'compare.json'), JSON.stringify(out, null, 2));
  console.log(JSON.stringify(out));
} finally { await browser.close(); }
```

`tools/openmw/gles-rewrite-check.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The GLES shader rewriting of orthros-r2.patch (glesrewrite.hpp: plain scans) against the std::regex code it replaces
(the pinned source's shadermanager.cpp), natively: both compiled with clang++ into one program, which runs every
shader of the engine's files/shaders (whole, as vertex and as fragment shaders, and their concatenations as the
engine's $link merging makes them) and generated sources through both and fails on the first difference; then the
same for $link statements. It also times both over the merged sources.
Usage: python3 tools/openmw/gles-rewrite-check.py [--engines-dir <dir>] [--scratch <dir>]
"""
import argparse, json, pathlib, re, shutil, subprocess, sys

here = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root = here.parent.parent
ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument('--engines-dir', default=str(root / 'data/engines'))
ap.add_argument('--scratch', default='/tmp/orthros-scratch/openmw-gles-rewrite-check')
a = ap.parse_args()
lock = json.loads((here / 'lock.json').read_text())
source = pathlib.Path(a.engines_dir) / 'src' / lock['id'] / f"openmw-web-{lock['tag']}" / 'openmw'
scratch = pathlib.Path(a.scratch)
shutil.rmtree(scratch, ignore_errors=True)
(scratch / 'tree').mkdir(parents=True)

# The patched files: the pinned source's, with the r2 patch applied in a scratch tree (only the files it touches here)
patch = here / 'patches' / 'orthros-r2.patch'
tree = scratch / 'tree'
(tree / 'openmw/components/shader').mkdir(parents=True)
shutil.copy2(source / 'components/shader/shadermanager.cpp', tree / 'openmw/components/shader/shadermanager.cpp')
subprocess.run(['git', 'apply', '--whitespace=nowarn', '--include=openmw/components/shader/*', str(patch)], cwd=tree, check=True)
old = (source / 'components/shader/shadermanager.cpp').read_text()
new = (tree / 'openmw/components/shader/shadermanager.cpp').read_text()


def function(text, start):
    i = text.index(start)
    j = text.index('\n    }\n', i) + len('\n    }\n')
    return text[i:j]


def link(text):
    """parseLinkDirective's statement parsing, as a function of the statement."""
    body = function(text, '    bool parseLinkDirective(')
    a = body.index('        size_t lineEnd')
    b = body.index('        if (linkTarget.empty())')
    return body[a:b]


old_adjust = function(old, '    void adjustSourceForGLES(')
new_adjust = function(new, '    void adjustSourceForGLES(')
assert 'std::regex_' in old_adjust and not re.search(r'std::regex[_(]', new_adjust)
harness = f'''
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <random>
#include <regex>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include "glesrewrite.hpp"
namespace osg {{ struct Shader {{ enum Type {{ VERTEX, FRAGMENT }}; }}; }}
namespace Debug {{ enum Level {{ Error }}; }}
struct NullLog {{ template <class T> NullLog& operator<<(const T&) {{ return *this; }} }};
#define Log(x) NullLog()
namespace Old {{
{old_adjust}
    bool parseLink(std::string source, std::string& linkTarget, bool& condition, const std::string& templateName)
    {{
        size_t foundPos = 0, endPos = 5;
{link(old)}
        condition = hasCondition ? !(linkConditionExpression.empty() || linkConditionExpression == "0") != (linkMatch[3].str() == "!") : true;
        return true;
    }}
}}
namespace New {{
{new_adjust}
    bool parseLink(std::string source, std::string& linkTarget, bool& condition, const std::string& templateName)
    {{
        size_t foundPos = 0, endPos = 5;
{link(new)}
        condition = hasCondition ? !(linkConditionExpression.empty() || linkConditionExpression == "0") != negated : true;
        return true;
    }}
}}
static std::string readAll(const char* p) {{ std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary); std::stringstream s; s << f.rdbuf(); return s.str(); }}
static int failures = 0;
static void same(const std::string& in, osg::Shader::Type t, const char* what)
{{
    std::string a = in, b = in;
    Old::adjustSourceForGLES(a, t);
    New::adjustSourceForGLES(b, t);
    if (a != b && failures++ < 5)
    {{
        size_t i = 0; while (i < a.size() && i < b.size() && a[i] == b[i]) ++i;
        std::cerr << "DIFFERENT (" << what << ", type " << t << ") at " << i << ":\\n old: " << a.substr(i > 40 ? i - 40 : 0, 120)
                  << "\\n new: " << b.substr(i > 40 ? i - 40 : 0, 120) << "\\n";
    }}
}}
int main(int argc, char** argv)
{{
    std::vector<std::string> files;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) files.push_back(readAll(argv[i]));
    size_t cases = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < files.size(); ++i)
        for (auto t : {{ osg::Shader::VERTEX, osg::Shader::FRAGMENT }}) {{ same(files[i], t, argv[i + 1]); ++cases; }}
    // merged sources, as $link inlining makes them (a shader and the next ones of the list)
    std::vector<std::string> merged;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < files.size(); ++i)
    {{
        std::string m = files[i];
        for (size_t k = 1; k <= 3; ++k) m += "\\n" + files[(i + k * 7) % files.size()];
        merged.push_back(m);
        for (auto t : {{ osg::Shader::VERTEX, osg::Shader::FRAGMENT }}) {{ same(m, t, "merged"); ++cases; }}
    }}
    // generated: the rewritten names with their neighbours (word characters, spaces, dots, brackets, digits)
    const char* pieces[] = {{ "gl_ModelViewProjectionMatrix", "gl_ModelViewMatrix", "gl_ModelViewMatrixInverse", "gl_ProjectionMatrix",
        "gl_NormalMatrix", "gl_TextureMatrix[", "gl_TextureMatrix", "texture2DLod", "texture2DProjLod", "texture2DProj", "texture2DArray",
        "texture2D", "textureCubeLod", "textureCube", "textureSize2D", "shadow2DProj", "shadow2D", "gl_FrontMaterial", "gl_Fog", "emission",
        "ambient", "diffuse", "specular", "shininess", "color", "start", "end", "scale", "density", "gl_Vertex", "gl_Normal", "gl_Color",
        "gl_MultiTexCoord", "gl_ClipVertex", "attribute", "varying", "gl_FragData[", "gl_FragColor", "ftransform", "#version 120\\n",
        "uniform float x = 1.0;\\n", "#extension GL_EXT_gpu_shader4: require\\n", " ", "  ", "\\t", "\\n", "\\r", "\\v", "\\f", ".", ". ", "(", ")",
        "( )", "[", "]", "0", "1", "7", "12", "_", "a", "Z", "x_", "9", ";", "\\xe9", "//__GLES_PRELUDE__\\n", "$", "@" }};
    std::mt19937 rng(12345);
    for (int n = 0; n < 200000; ++n)
    {{
        std::string s;
        const int len = 1 + rng() % 24;
        for (int k = 0; k < len; ++k) s += pieces[rng() % (sizeof pieces / sizeof *pieces)];
        same(s, rng() % 2 ? osg::Shader::VERTEX : osg::Shader::FRAGMENT, "generated"); ++cases;
    }}
    // $link statements
    const char* lpieces[] = {{ "\\"", "lib/light.glsl", "a", " ", "\\t", "\\r", "if", "if ", "!", "0", "1", "@x", "x_1", "iff", "\\"\\"", "  ", "b" }};
    size_t links = 0;
    for (int n = 0; n < 200000; ++n)
    {{
        std::string s = "$link";
        const int len = 1 + rng() % 9;
        for (int k = 0; k < len; ++k) s += lpieces[rng() % (sizeof lpieces / sizeof *lpieces)];
        std::string ta, tb; bool ca = false, cb = false;
        const bool ra = Old::parseLink(s, ta, ca, "t"), rb = New::parseLink(s, tb, cb, "t");
        ++links;
        if ((ra != rb || (ra && (ta != tb || ca != cb))) && failures++ < 10)
            std::cerr << "LINK DIFFERENT for [" << s << "]: " << ra << " " << ta << " " << ca << " / " << rb << " " << tb << " " << cb << "\\n";
    }}
    // timing over the merged sources
    auto time = [&](auto f) {{
        auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        for (const auto& m : merged) for (auto t : {{ osg::Shader::VERTEX, osg::Shader::FRAGMENT }}) {{ std::string s = m; f(s, t); }}
        return std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count() / (2 * merged.size());
    }};
    size_t bytes = 0; for (const auto& m : merged) bytes += m.size();
    const double to = time(Old::adjustSourceForGLES), tn = time(New::adjustSourceForGLES);
    std::printf("{{\\"cases\\": %zu, \\"links\\": %zu, \\"failures\\": %d, \\"mergedSources\\": %zu, \\"meanMergedBytes\\": %zu, \\"regexMsPerSource\\": %.3f, \\"scanMsPerSource\\": %.4f}}\\n",
        cases, links, failures, merged.size(), bytes / merged.size(), to, tn);
    return failures ? 1 : 0;
}}
'''
(scratch / 'check.cpp').write_text(harness)
shutil.copy2(tree / 'openmw/components/shader/glesrewrite.hpp', scratch / 'glesrewrite.hpp')
subprocess.run(['clang++-18', '-std=c++20', '-O2', '-o', str(scratch / 'check'), str(scratch / 'check.cpp')], check=True)
shaders = sorted(str(p) for p in (source / 'files/shaders').rglob('*') if p.is_file())
r = subprocess.run([str(scratch / 'check'), *shaders])
shutil.rmtree(scratch, ignore_errors=True)
```

`tools/openmw/guard-client-ui.mjs`:

```mjs
// Keep explicitly selected UI addons out of the native simulation peer. The original addon
// files stay untouched; one final data root supplies guarded script entry points on both ends.
// Usage: node tools/openmw/guard-client-ui.mjs <game-folder> <version-id> [--id <compat-id>] <mod-id>[:TYPE,...] [...]
//   <mod-id>              a UI-only addon: every automatic entry point of its script plugins is guarded
//   <mod-id>:MENU,PLAYER  a mod with gameplay too: only the declarations whose targets are all among those types are
//                         guarded; the others (GLOBAL, CONTAINER, item scripts...) stay as shipped and still run on the
//                         simulation peer, and so do its content files (.esp, .omwaddon: left enabled in its own root).
//                         A declaration mixing both kinds is refused.
// A declaration's path may use the author's separators (`\` as well as `/`) and spaces; a wrapper requires the script
// by its module name (separators as dots), so a path with another dot than its `.lua` is refused.
//   <mod-id>:SOLO         a mod that only makes sense in solo (it drives the world from one player's side: physics on
//                         items, the player teleported…): every entry point guarded off in a shared world — on the
//                         browser clients joined to it as on its simulation peer (openmw.mp isEnabled()) —, solo unchanged.
//                         A declaration naming CUSTOM beside other types keeps a CUSTOM line under the original file
//                         (attached by name), the others wrapped.
//   --id <compat-id>      the generated root's mod id (default client-ui-compat), to guard addons installed after an
//                         earlier root; its wrappers get their own namespace (scripts/orthros_<id without -compat>/)
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const DEFAULT_ID = 'client-ui-compat';
/** The generated root's wrapper folder: client-ui-compat → scripts/orthros_client_ui (the first root's, unchanged). */
export const wrapperDir = (compatId) => `scripts/orthros_${compatId.replace(/-compat$/, '').replaceAll('-', '_')}`;

/** `selected`: mod ids, each optionally `id:TYPE,TYPE` (only those declaration types guarded). */
export function guardClientUi(folder, versionId, selected, { id: compatId = DEFAULT_ID } = {}) {
  const game = fs.realpathSync(folder), file = path.join(game, 'manifest.json');
  const spec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file)), version = spec.versions.find((v) => v.id === versionId);
  const mods = version?.openmw?.mods;
  const picks = selected.map((s) => {
    const [id, types, extra] = String(s).split(':');
    const solo = types === 'SOLO';
    const only = types === undefined || solo ? null : new Set(types.split(',').map((t) => t.trim()));
    if (extra !== undefined || (only && (!only.size || [...only].some((t) => !/^[A-Z][A-Z_]*$/.test(t)))))
      throw new Error(`Expected <mod-id>, <mod-id>:TYPE,TYPE or <mod-id>:SOLO, got ${s}`);
    return { id, only, solo };
  });
  if (!mods || !picks.length || new Set(picks.map((p) => p.id)).size !== picks.length) throw new Error('Select distinct installed UI mods');
  // (the manifest's mod id rule, src/host/openmw.js MOD_ID)
  if (!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,54}$/.test(compatId)) throw new Error('Invalid compatibility mod id');
  if (mods.some((m) => m.id === compatId)) throw new Error('Client UI compatibility is already installed');
  const versionDir = fs.realpathSync(path.join(game, 'versions', version.dir));
  const dir = `mods/${compatId}-0`, dest = path.join(versionDir, dir), ns = wrapperDir(compatId);
  if (fs.existsSync(dest)) throw new Error('Compatibility data root already exists; refusing overwrite');
  // a later root's wrappers must not replace an earlier root's (same path in the engine's file system)
  for (const part of mods.flatMap((m) => m.parts ?? []))
    if (fs.existsSync(path.join(versionDir, part.dir, ns))) throw new Error(`${ns} already exists in ${part.dir}; choose another --id`);
  const files = new Map(), selections = [], plugins = [], unguarded = [];
  let sequence = 0;
  for (const { id, only, solo } of picks) {
    const mod = mods.find((m) => m.id === id);
    if (!mod?.installed) throw new Error(`UI mod is not installed: ${id}`);
    for (const part of mod.parts ?? []) for (const plugin of part.plugins) {
      if (!/^[^/\\]+\.omwscripts$/i.test(plugin)) {
        // (a mod with gameplay too: its content files are game data every peer loads, left where they are)
        if (only) continue;
        throw new Error('Only script-only UI addons can be guarded');
      }
      if (plugins.some((p) => p.toLowerCase() === plugin.toLowerCase())) throw new Error('Duplicate UI plugin');
      const source = fs.realpathSync(path.join(versionDir, part.dir, plugin));
      if (!source.startsWith(versionDir + path.sep)) throw new Error('UI plugin outside the version directory');
      const lines = [], kept = [], wrappers = new Map();
      for (const line of fs.readFileSync(source, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
        if (!line.trim() || /^\s*#/.test(line)) continue;
        const match = /^\s*([A-Z][A-Z_, ]*):\s*([\w/\\. -]+\.lua)\s*$/.exec(line);
        // (the path's folders and name, without .lua: what the wrapper's require names, dots for separators)
        const segments = match?.[2].slice(0, -4).split(/[\\/]/);
        if (!match || segments.some((p) => !p.trim() || p.includes('.'))) throw new Error(`Unsupported UI script declaration: ${plugin}`);
        // CUSTOM scripts are attached explicitly by their original filename. Renaming that
        // declaration would break GameObject:addScript/hasScript/removeScript in the addon.
        // The guarded automatic entry points never attach them on a simulation peer.
        if (match[1].trim() === 'CUSTOM') { lines.push(line); continue; }
        let types = match[1];
        if (solo && /(^|,)\s*CUSTOM\s*(,|$)/.test(types)) {
          lines.push(`CUSTOM: ${match[2]}`);
          types = types.split(',').map((x) => x.trim()).filter((x) => x && x !== 'CUSTOM').join(', ');
        }
        if (only) {
          const targets = match[1].split(',').map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean), guarded = targets.filter((t) => only.has(t));
          // a gameplay declaration: kept as shipped, so it runs on simulation peers too
          if (!guarded.length) { lines.push(line); kept.push(line.trim()); continue; }
          if (guarded.length < targets.length) throw new Error(`Declaration mixes guarded and kept types: ${plugin}: ${match[1].trim()}`);
        }
        const wrapper = `${ns}/${sequence++}.lua`;
        const module = segments.join('.');
        wrappers.set(wrapper, solo
          ? `-- Generated solo-only entry point; original addon sources are unchanged.\nlocal ok, mp = pcall(require, 'openmw.mp')\nif ok and mp.isEnabled and mp.isEnabled() then return {} end\nreturn require(${JSON.stringify(module)})\n`
          : `-- Generated client UI entry point; original addon sources are unchanged.\nlocal ok, mp = pcall(require, 'openmw.mp')\nif ok and mp.isSystem and mp.isSystem() then return {} end\nreturn require(${JSON.stringify(module)})\n`);
        lines.push(`${types}: ${wrapper}`);
      }
      if (!lines.length) throw new Error(`Empty UI plugin: ${plugin}`);
      // (with a type selection, a plugin holding none of those types stays where it is, untouched)
      if (only && !wrappers.size) continue;
      for (const [name, text] of wrappers) files.set(name, text);
      files.set(plugin, lines.join('\n') + '\n'); plugins.push(plugin);
      selections.push({ mod: id, part, plugin, only, solo });
      for (const entry of kept) unguarded.push({ mod: id, plugin, entry });
    }
    if (!selections.some((s) => s.mod === id)) throw new Error(`No enabled UI script plugin: ${id}`);
  }
  // Validate everything before changing any installation or manifest.
  fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true });
  const hash = createHash('sha256');
  for (const [name, text] of files) {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(dest, name)), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dest, name), text, { flag: 'wx' }); hash.update(name).update('\0').update(text);
  }
  for (const { part, plugin } of selections) part.plugins = part.plugins.filter((p) => p !== plugin);
  mods.push({ id: compatId, name: compatId === DEFAULT_ID ? 'Client UI multiplayer compatibility' : `Client UI multiplayer compatibility (${compatId})`,
    installed: true, installedAt: new Date().toISOString(), generatedSha256: hash.digest('hex'),
    guardedPlugins: selections.map(({ mod, plugin, only, solo }) => ({ mod, plugin, ...(only ? { guardedTypes: [...only] } : {}), ...(solo ? { soloOnly: true } : {}) })),
    // the selected plugins' declarations kept as shipped: they still run on simulation peers
    ...(unguarded.length ? { unguardedEntries: unguarded } : {}),
    parts: [{ dir, source: 'generated client UI guards', sentinel: plugins[0], plugins, archives: [],
      files: files.size, bytes: [...files.values()].reduce((sum, s) => sum + Buffer.byteLength(s), 0) }] });
  fs.writeFileSync(file + '.new', JSON.stringify(spec, null, 2) + '\n'); fs.renameSync(file + '.new', file);
  return { plugins, wrappers: sequence };
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.argv[1])).href) {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2), at = args.indexOf('--id'), opts = {};
  if (at >= 0) { opts.id = args[at + 1]; args.splice(at, 2); }
  const [folder, version, ...ids] = args;
  if (!folder || !version || (at >= 0 && !opts.id)) throw new Error('Expected game folder, version id and UI mod ids');
  console.log(JSON.stringify(guardClientUi(folder, version, ids, opts)));
}
```

`tools/openmw/install-engine.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Install the pinned browser engine and its corresponding source, never game data."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import tarfile
import tempfile
import urllib.request
import zipfile

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
LOCK = json.loads(pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name('lock.json').read_text())


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument('--engines-dir', type=pathlib.Path, default=ROOT / 'data/engines')
    p.add_argument('--archives', type=pathlib.Path, help='use already downloaded release archives')
    p.add_argument('--server', action='store_true', help='also pull the pinned native multiplayer image and build the gateway image derived from it')
    a = p.parse_args()
    subprocess.run([ROOT / 'tools/disk-check.sh'], check=True)
    scratch = pathlib.Path('/tmp/orthros-scratch/openmw-install')
    scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=scratch) as temp:
        for key in ['bundle', 'source']:
            asset = LOCK[key]
            name = asset['url'].rsplit('/', 1)[1]
            archive = a.archives / name if a.archives else pathlib.Path(temp) / name
            if not archive.exists():
                archive.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                urllib.request.urlretrieve(asset['url'], archive)
            with archive.open('rb') as f:
                if hashlib.file_digest(f, 'sha256').hexdigest() != asset['sha256']:
                    raise SystemExit(f'Hash mismatch: {archive}')
            dest = a.engines_dir / (LOCK['id'] if key == 'bundle' else f"src/{LOCK['id']}")
            # An installed release is immutable. Re-running only checks/writes the receipt.
            if not dest.exists():
                dest.mkdir(parents=True)
                if key == 'bundle':
                    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
                        for member in z.namelist():
                            if not (dest / member).resolve().is_relative_to(dest.resolve()):
                                raise SystemExit('Unsafe archive path')
                        z.extractall(dest)
                else:
                    with tarfile.open(archive) as t:
                        t.extractall(dest, filter='data')
        dest = a.engines_dir / LOCK['id']
        source_web = a.engines_dir / 'src' / LOCK['id'] / f"openmw-web-{LOCK['tag']}" / 'server/web'
        (dest / 'portal').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for name in ['play.html', 'play.js', 'providers.js']:
            if not (dest / 'portal' / name).exists():
                shutil.copy2(source_web / name, dest / 'portal' / name)
        files = [f"e/{LOCK['engineVersion']}/{n}" for n in ['openmw.js', 'openmw.wasm', 'openmw.data', 'streamfs.js']]
        files += ['moddata/openmw-web-assets.bsa', 'LICENSE', 'NOTICE', 'THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md', 'portal/play.html', 'portal/play.js', 'portal/providers.js']
        for rel in ['index.html', 'launcher.html', *files]:
            if not (dest / rel).is_file():
                raise SystemExit(f'Incomplete release: {dest / rel}')
        (dest / 'release.json').write_text(json.dumps({**LOCK, 'runtime': 'openmw', 'files': files}, indent=2) + '\n')
    if a.server:
        subprocess.run(['docker', 'pull', LOCK['serverImage']], check=True)
        # (the gateway runs the image derived from it, its Node.js replaced: lock.json "serverBuild")
        if LOCK.get('serverBuild'):
            subprocess.run(['sh', ROOT / 'tools/openmw/build-server-image.sh'], check=True)
    print(f"Installed {LOCK['id']} in {dest}")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

`tools/openmw/install-game.mjs`:

```mjs
// Import a purchased Data Files folder, or initialize the pending installation: the original game (manifest.json) and
// its modded game (manifest-vanilla-plus.json: its mod stack over the original's files, by requires). Original files
// are copied only into the original game's empty base; never overwritten.
// Usage: node tools/openmw/install-game.mjs [--games-dir dir] [--data-files folder]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const args = process.argv.slice(2), arg = (k) => args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : null;
const games = path.resolve(arg('--games-dir') ?? path.join(here, '../../data/games'));
const lock = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(here, 'lock.json')));
function writeGame(spec) {
  const dir = path.join(games, spec.id); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'base'), { recursive: true });
  for (const v of spec.versions) fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'versions', v.dir), { recursive: true });
  if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'manifest.json'))) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify(spec, null, 2) + '\n');
  if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'cover.svg'))) fs.copyFileSync(path.join(here, 'cover.svg'), path.join(dir, 'cover.svg'));
  return dir;
}
const spec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(here, 'manifest.json')));
const game = writeGame(spec);
writeGame(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(here, 'manifest-vanilla-plus.json'))));
const input = arg('--data-files');
if (input) {
  const source = fs.realpathSync(input), dest = path.join(game, 'base');
  if (!fs.statSync(source).isDirectory()) throw new Error('Expected the Data Files folder');
  const names = new Map(fs.readdirSync(source).map((s) => [s.toLowerCase(), s]));
  for (const f of spec.versions[0].openmw.files) if (!names.has(f.toLowerCase())) throw new Error(`Missing ${f} in ${source}`);
  if (fs.readdirSync(dest).length) throw new Error(`${dest} is not empty; original game files will not be overwritten`);
  fs.cpSync(source, dest, { recursive: true, dereference: true, errorOnExist: true, force: false });
  console.log(`Imported original game files into ${dest}. Install the mod stack next.`);
} else console.log(`Prepared ${game}; original game files and pending mods are still required.`);
```
