`tools/openmw/install-mod.mjs`:

```mjs
// Install selected data roots of an already extracted mod, without touching the original game.
// No plugin/data parsing: filenames and the operator's explicit plugin selection only.
// Usage: node tools/openmw/install-mod.mjs <game-folder> <version-id> <mod-id> <source-folder>
//        --part '00 Core' --part '01 Textures' [--plugin 'Patch.esp'] [--sha256 archive-sha256]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), [folder, versionId, modId, sourceFolder] = args;
if (!folder || !versionId || !modId || !sourceFolder) throw new Error('Expected game folder, version id, mod id and extracted source folder');
const values = (key) => args.flatMap((v, i) => v === key ? [args[i + 1]] : []);
const game = fs.realpathSync(folder), source = fs.realpathSync(sourceFolder), file = path.join(game, 'manifest.json');
const spec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file)), version = spec.versions.find((v) => v.id === versionId);
const mod = version?.openmw?.mods?.find((m) => m.id === modId);
if (!mod) throw new Error('No such declared mod');
if (mod.installed) throw new Error('Already installed; original mod files will not be overwritten');
const roots = values('--part'); if (!roots.length) throw new Error('Select at least one --part (use . for the archive root)');
const wanted = values('--plugin'), parts = [];
for (const [i, rel] of roots.entries()) {
  const src = fs.realpathSync(path.resolve(source, rel));
  if (src !== source && !src.startsWith(source + path.sep)) throw new Error('Part outside source folder');
  if (!fs.statSync(src).isDirectory()) throw new Error('Part is not a data directory');
  const dir = `mods/${mod.id}-${i}`, dest = path.join(game, 'versions', version.dir, dir);
  if (fs.existsSync(dest)) throw new Error(`${dest} already exists; no overwrite`);
  const files = [];
  const walk = (dir, prefix = '') => {
    for (const ent of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      if (ent.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error('Symlink in mod source');
      const name = prefix + ent.name;
      if (ent.isDirectory()) walk(path.join(dir, ent.name), name + '/');
      else if (ent.isFile()) files.push({ name, size: fs.statSync(path.join(dir, ent.name)).size });
    }
  }; walk(src);
  // (game data the engine reads: assets, plugins, Lua scripts and shaders — an overlay of a mod's — and l10n texts)
  const sentinel = files.find((f) => /\.(dds|nif|esm|esp|omwaddon|omwscripts|lua|omwfx|yaml)$/i.test(f.name))?.name;
  if (!sentinel) throw new Error(`No game assets in ${src}`);
  // (an archive that failed to extract — RAR5 through a 7-Zip without its codec — leaves its files empty: refused)
  const empty = files.filter((f) => f.size === 0 && /\.(dds|tga|bmp|nif|kf|esm|esp|omwaddon|bsa|wav|mp3)$/i.test(f.name));
  if (empty.length) throw new Error(`Empty game assets in ${src} (a failed extraction?): ${empty.slice(0, 5).map((f) => f.name).join(', ')}`);
  parts.push({ dir, source: rel, sentinel, plugins: files.filter((f) => !f.name.includes('/') && wanted.some((n) => n.toLowerCase() === f.name.toLowerCase())).map((f) => f.name),
    archives: files.filter((f) => !f.name.includes('/') && /\.(bsa|ba2)$/i.test(f.name)).map((f) => f.name), files: files.length, bytes: files.reduce((s, f) => s + f.size, 0), src, dest });
}
for (const name of wanted) if (!parts.some((p) => p.plugins.some((f) => f.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()))) throw new Error(`Selected plugin not found: ${name}`);
for (const part of parts) fs.cpSync(part.src, part.dest, { recursive: true, force: false, errorOnExist: true });
// (readable by the services' users: cpSync keeps an archive's modes, and a file only root may read was served to nobody)
const readable = (p) => {
  const st = fs.statSync(p);
  fs.chmodSync(p, st.mode | (st.isDirectory() ? 0o555 : 0o444));
  if (st.isDirectory()) for (const n of fs.readdirSync(p)) readable(path.join(p, n));
};
for (const part of parts) readable(part.dest);
mod.parts = parts.map(({ src, dest, ...p }) => p); mod.installed = true;
if (values('--sha256')[0]) mod.sha256 = values('--sha256')[0];
mod.installedAt = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(file + '.new', JSON.stringify(spec, null, 2) + '\n'); fs.renameSync(file + '.new', file);
console.log(`Installed ${mod.name}: ${parts.reduce((s, p) => s + p.files, 0)} files in ${parts.length} data roots`);

```

`tools/openmw/keys-check.mjs`:

```mjs
// The keyboard layout of an OpenMW port in its engine (src/ports/openmw/input-keys.js, orthros-r9.patch): a new character
// in an exterior (?start=<cell>), then Space held, then E held, each time the engine's own reading of its actions
// (the player's Lua console, `luap`: input.isActionPressed for Jump and Activate, sampled 50 times over 2.5 s of game
// time, and how high the player rose) reported back through the engine's log. Expected: Space jumps (and rises), E
// activates. --seed-old: first a saved bindings file holding Morrowind's old pair (Activate on Space, Jump on E) written
// into the page's persistent user files, the page loaded again — the swap before the engine reads them, then the same
// probes. Not a gameplay check. Always through tools/with-browser-slot.sh:
//   tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/openmw/keys-check.mjs <manifest> --url <origin> [--start -2,-9] [--seed-old]
//     [--draw] [--query name=value[&...]] [--out <dir>]   (--draw: the pictures drawn — slower; by default rasterizer
//     discard, as perf.mjs --discard; --query: added to the engine page's address, e.g. omwenv=OPENMW_ORTHROS_DRAWTHREAD=1)
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { launchOptions } from '../port-perf.mjs';
import { INPUT_FILE, MARK_FILE, ACTIVATE, JUMP, SPACE, E } from '../../src/ports/openmw/input-keys.js';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), id = args[0], arg = (k, d = null) => args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : d;
if (!id) throw new Error('Expected a manifest id');
const base = arg('--url', 'http://localhost:8080'), start = arg('--start', '-2,-9'), seedOld = args.includes('--seed-old');
const dir = arg('--out', `/tmp/orthros-scratch/openmw-keys-${id}`);
fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }); process.env.TMPDIR = dir;

// (a control as the engine's ICS writes it: OpenMW's actions are auto-reversing, unbounded steps. ICS finds a control
// by its position in the file — the engine writes all of them in their actions' order, 0 to A_Last - 1 (52) —; those
// without a binder get the engine's defaults at its start)
const control = (action, key) => `    <Control name="${action}" autoChangeDirectionOnLimitsAfterStop="false" autoReverseToInitialValue="true" initialValue="0" stepSize="MAX" stepsPerSeconds="MAX">\n`
  + (key === undefined ? '' : `        <KeyBinder key="${key}" direction="INCREASE" />\n`) + `        <Channel number="${action}" direction="DIRECT" percentage="1" />\n    </Control>\n`;
const OLD = `<Controller>\n${Array.from({ length: 52 }, (_, a) => control(a, a === ACTIVATE ? SPACE : a === JUMP ? E : undefined)).join('')}</Controller>\n`;
// (one line of the player's Lua console: a sample each frame for 4 s of real time — the two actions and the player's height)
const LUA = "local t0, z0, r = core.getRealTime(), self.position.z, {j = false, a = false, top = 0, n = 0}; local function look() r.n = r.n + 1; "
  + 'if input.isActionPressed(input.ACTION.Jump) then r.j = true end; if input.isActionPressed(input.ACTION.Activate) then r.a = true end; '
  + 'local d = self.position.z - z0; if d > r.top then r.top = d end; '
  + "if core.getRealTime() - t0 < 4 then async:newUnsavableSimulationTimer(0.02, look) else "
  + "error(string.format('ORTHROS-KEYS jump=%s activate=%s rise=%.0f samples=%d', tostring(r.j), tostring(r.a), r.top, r.n)) end end; look()";

const browser = await chromium.launch(launchOptions({ gl: 'swiftshader', channel: arg('--channel', 'chromium') }));
const draw = args.includes('--draw');
// (rasterizer discard with the engine drawing on its own thread: the init script below only reaches the page's contexts —
// the draw thread's is the engine's own "discard" value)
const query = draw ? arg('--query', '') : arg('--query', '').replace(/(OPENMW_ORTHROS_DRAWTHREAD=)1(?=$|[,&])/, '$1discard');
const faults = [], lines = [];
try {
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 800 } });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => faults.push(e.message));
  // (rasterizer discard, as perf.mjs --discard: SwiftShader draws nothing, the engine runs its frames many times faster —
  // its logic and input as they are; --draw keeps the pictures, for the screenshots)
  if (!draw) await page.addInitScript(() => {
    const proto = WebGL2RenderingContext.prototype, RD = 0x8C89, enable = proto.enable, disable = proto.disable, getContext = HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.getContext;
    proto.disable = function (cap) { if (cap === RD) return; return disable.call(this, cap); };
    HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.getContext = function (...a) { const gl = getContext.apply(this, a); if (gl && gl instanceof WebGL2RenderingContext) enable.call(gl, RD); return gl; };
  });
  page.on('console', (m) => { if (/ORTHROS-KEYS|\[orthros\] saved bindings/.test(m.text())) lines.push(m.text()); });
  // (a check: nothing reported to the server — its learned order, telemetry and the gateway's client log stay clean)
  await page.route((u) => /\/clientlog$|\/api\/(telemetry|prefetch|profile-seed|programs|regions)(\/|$)/.test(u.pathname), (r) => r.request().method() === 'GET' ? r.continue() : r.fulfill({ status: 204, body: '' }));
  const url = `${base}/ports/openmw/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/app/index.html?src=hosted&start=${encodeURIComponent(start)}${query ? '&' + query : ''}`;
  const inWorld = async () => {
    await page.waitForFunction(() => window.omw?.state?.['orthros.view'] !== undefined, null, { timeout: 600000, polling: 500 });
    await page.mouse.click(640, 400);
    await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
  };
  const logText = () => page.evaluate(() => document.querySelector('#log')?.textContent ?? '');
  let seeded = null;
  await page.goto(url);
  await inWorld();
  if (seedOld) {
    // (the old pair saved, no marker: as a player who closed the Options window before the layout changed)
    await page.evaluate(async ({ file, mark, xml }) => {
      const FS = window.FS ?? window.Module.FS;
      FS.writeFile(file, xml);
      if (FS.analyzePath(mark).exists) FS.unlink(mark);
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => FS.syncfs(false, (e) => (e ? reject(e) : resolve())));
    }, { file: INPUT_FILE, mark: MARK_FILE, xml: OLD });
    await page.reload();
    await inWorld();
    seeded = await page.evaluate(({ file, mark }) => {
      const FS = window.FS ?? window.Module.FS, read = (p) => (FS.analyzePath(p).exists ? FS.readFile(p, { encoding: 'utf8' }) : null);
      return { file: read(file), mark: read(mark) };
    }, { file: INPUT_FILE, mark: MARK_FILE });
  }
  // (the reports so far: the page's console and the engine page's log, where the engine's errors land)
  const reports = async () => [...lines, ...(await logText()).split('\n')].filter((l) => l.includes('ORTHROS-KEYS'));
  const probe = async (key) => {
    const before = (await reports()).length;
    await page.keyboard.press('Backquote'); await page.waitForTimeout(800);
    await page.keyboard.type('luap'); await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); await page.waitForTimeout(400);
    await page.keyboard.type(LUA); await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); await page.waitForTimeout(200);
    await page.keyboard.press('Backquote'); await page.waitForTimeout(300);
    await page.keyboard.down(key); await page.waitForTimeout(1200); await page.keyboard.up(key);
    const end = Date.now() + 30000;
    while (Date.now() < end) {
      const all = await reports(), m = all.length > before ? /jump=(\w+) activate=(\w+) rise=(-?\d+) samples=(\d+)/.exec(all.at(-1)) : null;
      if (m) return { jump: m[1] === 'true', activate: m[2] === 'true', rise: Number(m[3]), samples: Number(m[4]) };
      await page.waitForTimeout(250);
    }
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(dir, `probe-${key}.png`) });
    return null;
  };
  const space = await probe('Space');
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500); // (landed)
  const e = await probe('KeyE');
  const ok = !!space && space.jump && !space.activate && space.rise > 10 && !!e && e.activate && !e.jump
    && (!seedOld || (/"result":"swapped"/.test(seeded.mark ?? '') && seeded.file?.includes(`<KeyBinder key="${E}" direction="INCREASE" />\n        <Channel number="${ACTIVATE}"`)));
  await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(dir, 'keys.png') });
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ manifest: id, url: base, seedOld, seeded: seeded && { mark: seeded.mark && JSON.parse(seeded.mark) }, space, e, ok, faults }));
  process.exitCode = ok ? 0 : 1;
} finally { await browser.close(); }

```

`tools/openmw/overlay-check.mjs`:

```mjs
// The data overlays of an OpenMW game against what they replace, at every engine release change (docs/openmw.md
// "Data overlays"): a mod's `overlays` entry { of, file, originalSha256, sha256 } says it replaces `file` whose original
// hash was `originalSha256`. For an overlay of the engine's own scripts (`of: "openmw built-in"`), the original is the
// file the version's engine release packs under /resources/vfs/ (its e/<build>/openmw.data, located through openmw.js's
// package list): if the new release changed it, the overlay would silently bring back the older copy — refused here
// until the overlay is regenerated from the new original or withdrawn. Every overlay's installed file is checked
// against its `sha256` too (versions/<dir>/<part dir>/<file>). Read-only; exit 1 on any mismatch.
//   node tools/openmw/overlay-check.mjs <game manifest.json> [--engines-dir data/engines] [--engine <release id>]
// (--engine: check against another release than the manifest's — the one about to replace it.)
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';

const BUILTIN = 'openmw built-in';

/** The packed files of an engine release's openmw.js: { '/resources/vfs/...': [start, end] } and its data file. */
export function enginePackage(releaseDir) {
  const e = path.join(releaseDir, 'e');
  const build = fs.readdirSync(e).find((d) => fs.existsSync(path.join(e, d, 'openmw.js')));
  if (!build) throw new Error(`${releaseDir}: no e/<build>/openmw.js`);
  const js = fs.readFileSync(path.join(e, build, 'openmw.js'), 'utf8'), files = new Map();
  for (const m of js.matchAll(/\{filename:"([^"]+)",start:(\d+),end:(\d+)/g)) files.set(m[1], [Number(m[2]), Number(m[3])]);
  if (!files.size) throw new Error(`${releaseDir}: no package list in openmw.js`);
  return { files, data: path.join(e, build, 'openmw.data') };
}

/** sha256 of a packed file of the engine (null: not packed). */
export function builtinSha256(pkg, file) {
  const r = pkg.files.get('/resources/vfs/' + file.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\/+/, ''));
  if (!r) return null;
  const fd = fs.openSync(pkg.data, 'r');
  try { const b = Buffer.alloc(r[1] - r[0]); fs.readSync(fd, b, 0, b.length, r[0]); return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex'); }
  finally { fs.closeSync(fd); }
}

/** The problems of a game manifest's overlays ([] when all agree). */
export function checkOverlays(manifestFile, { enginesDir, engine = null } = {}) {
  const man = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestFile, 'utf8')), gameDir = path.dirname(manifestFile), out = [], pkgs = new Map();
  const sha = (f) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(f)).digest('hex');
  for (const v of man.versions ?? []) {
    const rel = engine ?? v.openmw?.engine; if (!rel) continue;
    for (const mod of v.openmw?.mods ?? []) {
      for (const o of mod.overlays ?? []) {
        const at = `${v.id} ${mod.id} ${o.file}`;
        if (o.of === BUILTIN) {
          if (!pkgs.has(rel)) pkgs.set(rel, enginePackage(path.join(enginesDir, rel)));
          const now = builtinSha256(pkgs.get(rel), o.file);
          if (now === null) out.push(`${at}: ${rel} no longer has this built-in file`);
          else if (now !== o.originalSha256) out.push(`${at}: ${rel}'s built-in is ${now}, the overlay was made from ${o.originalSha256} — regenerate or withdraw it`);
        }
        const installed = (mod.parts ?? []).map((p) => path.join(gameDir, 'versions', v.dir ?? '', p.dir, o.file)).find((f) => fs.existsSync(f));
        if (mod.installed && !installed) out.push(`${at}: not installed`);
        else if (installed && o.sha256 && sha(installed) !== o.sha256) out.push(`${at}: installed file differs from the overlay's sha256`);
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

if (import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`) {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2), opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf(k); return i >= 0 ? args.splice(i, 2)[1] : d; };
  const enginesDir = path.resolve(opt('--engines-dir', 'data/engines')), engine = opt('--engine', null);
  if (args.length !== 1) { console.error('usage: overlay-check.mjs <game manifest.json> [--engines-dir dir] [--engine release]'); process.exit(64); }
  const bad = checkOverlays(path.resolve(args[0]), { enginesDir, engine });
  for (const b of bad) console.log('MISMATCH ' + b);
  console.log(bad.length ? `${bad.length} overlay problem(s)` : 'overlays: all agree with their originals');
  process.exit(bad.length ? 1 : 0);
}

```

+// Orthros (tools/openmw/patches/orthros-r1.patch). A file of the engine's file system replaced by the page (a
+// texture's light copy by the file itself): its cached image is read again and updated in place, between frames, a few
+// at a time (g_orthrosReloadBudget decoded bytes a frame, at least one file) — EmscriptenLoop::reloadUpdated.
+// `path`: within a data folder (textures/tx_a.dds) or in the engine's file system (/mwdata/Data Files/Textures/tx_a.dds),
+// any case or separator. Returns 1 when queued (a DDS file), 0 otherwise. Progress: globalThis.__orthrosTexReloads.
+namespace
+{
+    std::mutex g_orthrosUpdatedMutex;
+    std::deque<std::string> g_orthrosUpdated;
+    constexpr std::size_t g_orthrosReloadBudget = std::size_t(4) << 20;
+}
+extern "C" EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE int orthros_file_updated(const char* path)
+{
+    if (!path)
+        return 0;
+    std::string name = VFS::Path::Normalized(std::string_view(path)).value();
+    if (Misc::getFileExtension(name) != "dds")
+        return 0;
+    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_orthrosUpdatedMutex);
+    if (std::find(g_orthrosUpdated.begin(), g_orthrosUpdated.end(), name) == g_orthrosUpdated.end())
+        g_orthrosUpdated.push_back(std::move(name));
+    return 1;
+}
+
+// Orthros: the rendering's view distance (game units), as the Lua camera.setViewDistance(): applied at the next frame,
+// not saved in the settings (Options' "viewing distance" applies the setting's again). Returns 1 when applied, 0 before
+// the game's main loop or for a distance that is not a positive finite number.
+extern "C" EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE int orthros_set_view_distance(float distance)
+{
+    if (!g_emArg || !std::isfinite(distance) || !(distance > 0.f))
+        return 0;
+    MWRender::RenderingManager* rendering = MWBase::Environment::get().getWorld()->getRenderingManager();
+    if (!rendering)
+        return 0;
+    rendering->setViewDistance(distance, true);
+    return 1;
+}
+
 // Debug: point the camera (yaw/pitch in degrees) so we can verify object rendering without mouse-look.
 extern "C" EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE void omw_debug_look(float yawDeg, float pitchDeg)
 {
@@ -1569,6 +1616,62 @@ void OMW::Engine::go()
         Misc::FrameRateLimiter* frameRateLimiter;
         std::chrono::steady_clock::duration maxSimulationInterval;
 
+        // Orthros: the images of the files orthros_file_updated() named, read again, within the frame's budget
+        static void reloadUpdated(OMW::Engine* self)
+        {
+            std::size_t spent = 0;
+            int updated = 0, skipped = 0;
+            std::size_t pending = 0;
+            while (true)
+            {
+                std::string path;
+                {
+                    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_orthrosUpdatedMutex);
+                    pending = g_orthrosUpdated.size();
+                    if (pending == 0 || spent >= g_orthrosReloadBudget)
+                        break;
+                    path = std::move(g_orthrosUpdated.front());
+                    g_orthrosUpdated.pop_front();
+                    --pending;
+                }
+                // A path of the engine's file system names the file of a data folder: its leading folders off until
+                // the VFS knows it (/mwdata/data files/textures/a.dds -> textures/a.dds)
+                std::string_view rest = path;
+                while (!rest.empty() && !self->mVFS->exists(VFS::Path::Normalized(rest)))
+                {
+                    const std::size_t slash = rest.find('/');
+                    rest = slash == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view() : rest.substr(slash + 1);

+                }

+                    ++updated;
+                else
+                    ++skipped;
+                spent += bytes;
+            }

+                EM_ASM({

+                    s.skipped += $1;
+                    s.bytes += $2;
+                    s.pending = $3;
+                }, updated, skipped, static_cast<double>(spent), static_cast<int>(pending));
+                // clang-format on
+            }
+        }

+    std::size_t ImageManager::reloadImage(VFS::Path::NormalizedView path)
+    {
+        if (Misc::getFileExtension(path.value()) != "dds")
+            return 0;
+        osg::ref_ptr<osg::Object> obj = mCache->getRefFromObjectCache(path);
+        if (!obj)
+            return 0;
+        osg::ref_ptr<osg::Image> image(static_cast<osg::Image*>(obj.get()));
+        if (image == mWarningImage)
+        {
+            // (shared by every image that failed: never updated in place; the next load reads the new file)
+            mCache->removeFromObjectCache(path.value());
+            return 0;
+        }
+        // Decoded exactly as a first load, then the cached object (the one the textures hold) put back in the cache
+        mCache->removeFromObjectCache(path.value());
+        osg::ref_ptr<osg::Image> fresh = getImage(path);
+        mCache->addEntryToObjectCache(std::string(path.value()), image);
+        if (fresh == mWarningImage || !fresh->data() || !fresh->isDataContiguous())
+            return 0;
+        const std::size_t size = fresh->getTotalSizeInBytesIncludingMipmaps();
+        unsigned char* data = new unsigned char[size];
+        std::memcpy(data, fresh->data(), size);
+        // setImage() frees the old data, drops the old mipmap offsets and marks the image modified (dirty())
+        image->setImage(fresh->s(), fresh->t(), fresh->r(), fresh->getInternalTextureFormat(), fresh->getPixelFormat(),
+            fresh->getDataType(), data, osg::Image::USE_NEW_DELETE, fresh->getPacking(), fresh->getRowLength());
+        image->setMipmapLevels(fresh->getMipmapLevels());
+        image->setOrigin(fresh->getOrigin());
+        image->dirty();
+        return size;
+    }

         return mWarningImage;

+    std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized> ObjectPaging::orthrosChunkModels(
+        float size, const osg::Vec2f& center, unsigned int lodFlags, bool activeGrid)
+    {
+        // (getChunk's own level: its lodFlags' high bits)
+        const unsigned char lod = static_cast<unsigned char>(lodFlags >> (4 * 4));
+        const osg::Vec2i startCell(static_cast<int>(std::floor(center.x() - size / 2.f)),
+            static_cast<int>(std::floor(center.y() - size / 2.f)));
+        const MWBase::World& world = *MWBase::Environment::get().getWorld();
+        const MWWorld::ESMStore& store = world.getStore();
+        const std::map<ESM::RefNum, PagedCellRef> refs = mWorldspace == ESM::Cell::sDefaultWorldspaceId
+            ? collectESM3References(size, startCell, store)
+            : collectESM4References(size, startCell, mWorldspace);
+        std::set<VFS::Path::Normalized> models;
+        for (const auto& [refNum, ref] : refs)
+        {
+            if (Misc::ResourceHelpers::isHiddenMarker(ref.mRefId))
+                continue;
+            const int type = store.findStatic(ref.mRefId);
+            VFS::Path::Normalized model = getModel(type, ref.mRefId, store);
+            if (model.empty())
+                continue;
+            model = Misc::ResourceHelpers::correctMeshPath(model);
+            if (activeGrid && type != ESM::REC_STAT && type != ESM::REC_STAT4)
+                model = Misc::ResourceHelpers::correctActorModelPath(model, mSceneManager->getVFS());
+            if (!activeGrid)
+            {
+                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mLODNameCacheMutex);
+                LODNameCacheKey key{ model, lod };
+                LODNameCache::const_iterator found = mLODNameCache.lower_bound(key);
+                if (found != mLODNameCache.end() && found->first == key)
+                    model = found->second;
+                else
+                    model = mLODNameCache
+                                .emplace_hint(found, std::move(key),
+                                    Misc::ResourceHelpers::getLODMeshName(
+                                        world.getESMVersions()[refNum.mContentFile], model, *mSceneManager->getVFS(),
+                                        lod))
+                                ->second;
+            }
+            models.insert(std::move(model));
+        }
+        return std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized>(models.begin(), models.end());
+    }

+    void ObjectPaging::orthrosChunkFiles(float size, const osg::Vec2f& center, unsigned char /*lod*/,
+        unsigned int lodFlags, bool activeGrid, std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized>& meshes,
+        std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized>& /*landTextures*/)
+    {
+        if (activeGrid && !mActiveGrid)
+            return;
+        if (mCache->getRefFromObjectCache(std::make_tuple(center, size, activeGrid)))
+            return;

+        const ChunkId id = std::make_tuple(center, size, activeGrid);

+            pending = mOrthrosPending.emplace(id, orthrosChunkModels(size, center, lodFlags, activeGrid)).first;
+        meshes.insert(meshes.end(), pending->second.begin(), pending->second.end());
+    }

+#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
+    // Orthros (orthros-r10.patch): what an NPC met for the first time wears, before its inventory exists (made from its
+    // record — levelled lists drawn, the best item of each slot equipped: InventoryStore::autoEquip — only once the cell
+    // inserts it): the body parts (as Npc::getModelsToPreload picks them by sex) of autoEquip's likely choice, roughly —
+    // per armor type the best rating, per clothing type the most valuable (two rings), per weapon type (ammo too) the
+    // best damage. Not every item of the record: a merchant's stock (its restocking items, count < 0) would bring dozens
+    // of meshes and their textures into the load it never shows — but kept among the candidates, as autoEquip ranks
+    // them with the rest. Levelled lists left out (drawn later).
+    void orthrosNpcRecordModels(
+        const ESM::NPC& npc, const MWWorld::ESMStore& store, std::vector<std::string_view>& models)
+    {
+        const bool female = (npc.mFlags & ESM::NPC::Female) != 0;
+        const auto addParts = [&](const std::vector<ESM::PartReference>& parts) {
+            for (const ESM::PartReference& partRef : parts)
+            {
+                const ESM::RefId& partname = (female && !partRef.mFemale.empty()) || (!female && partRef.mMale.empty())
+                    ? partRef.mFemale
+                    : partRef.mMale;
+                const ESM::BodyPart* part = store.get<ESM::BodyPart>().search(partname);
+                if (part != nullptr && !part->mModel.getOriginal().empty())
+                    models.push_back(part->mModel.getOriginal());
+            }
+        };
+        std::map<int32_t, const ESM::Armor*> armor;
+        std::map<int32_t, std::vector<const ESM::Clothing*>> clothing;
+        std::map<int32_t, std::pair<int, const ESM::Weapon*>> weapons;
+        for (const ESM::ContItem& item : npc.mInventory.mList)
+        {
+            if (const ESM::Clothing* c = store.get<ESM::Clothing>().search(item.mItem))
+            {
+                std::vector<const ESM::Clothing*>& best = clothing[c->mData.mType];
+                best.push_back(c);
+                std::stable_sort(best.begin(), best.end(),
+                    [](const ESM::Clothing* a, const ESM::Clothing* b) { return a->mData.mValue > b->mData.mValue; });
+                best.resize(std::min<size_t>(best.size(), c->mData.mType == ESM::Clothing::Ring ? 2 : 1));
+            }
+            else if (const ESM::Armor* a = store.get<ESM::Armor>().search(item.mItem))
+            {
+                const ESM::Armor*& best = armor[a->mData.mType];
+                if (best == nullptr || a->mData.mArmor > best->mData.mArmor)
+                    best = a;
+            }
+            else if (const ESM::Weapon* w = store.get<ESM::Weapon>().search(item.mItem);
+                     w != nullptr && !w->mModel.getOriginal().empty())
+            {
+                const int damage = std::max({ w->mData.mChop[1], w->mData.mSlash[1], w->mData.mThrust[1] });
+                const auto it = weapons.find(w->mData.mType);
+                if (it == weapons.end() || damage > it->second.first)
+                    weapons[w->mData.mType] = { damage, w };
+            }
+        }
+        for (const auto& entry : armor)
+            addParts(entry.second->mParts.mParts);
+        for (const auto& entry : clothing)
+            for (const ESM::Clothing* c : entry.second)
+                addParts(c->mParts.mParts);
+        for (const auto& entry : weapons)
+            models.push_back(entry.second.second->mModel.getOriginal());
+    }

+    void Scene::orthrosReadAhead(std::span<CellStore* const> cells, std::string_view place)
+    {
+#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
+        if (cells.empty() || !VFS::orthrosReadAheadHooked())
+            return;
+        Resource::SceneManager& sceneManager = *mRendering.getResourceSystem()->getSceneManager();
+        const VFS::Manager& vfs = *sceneManager.getVFS();

+        // inventory exists: before, what its record carries, orthrosNpcRecordModels)
+        const MWWorld::ESMStore& store = *MWBase::Environment::get().getESMStore();
+        std::vector<std::string_view> models;
+        std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized> landTextures;
+        Terrain::World* terrain = mRendering.getTerrain();
+        for (CellStore* cell : cells)
+        {
+            cell->forEachConst([&](const ConstPtr& ptr) {
+                ptr.getClass().getModelsToPreload(ptr, models);
+                if (ptr.getType() == ESM::NPC::sRecordId && ptr.getRefData().getCustomData() == nullptr)
+                    orthrosNpcRecordModels(*ptr.get<ESM::NPC>()->mBase, store, models);
+                return true;
+            });
+            if (terrain != nullptr && cell->getCell()->isExterior())
+                terrain->getStorage()->orthrosLandTextures(cell->getCell()->getExteriorCellLocation(), landTextures);
+        }
+        std::sort(models.begin(), models.end());
+        models.erase(std::unique(models.begin(), models.end()), models.end());
+        // (each corrected as PreloadItem::preloadMesh does: the actor's x*.nif, and its .kf beside it)
+        std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized> files;
+        constexpr VFS::Path::ExtensionView nif("nif");
+        constexpr VFS::Path::ExtensionView kf("kf");
+        for (const std::string_view model : models)
+        {
+            try
+            {
+                VFS::Path::Normalized mesh = Misc::ResourceHelpers::correctMeshPath(VFS::Path::Normalized(model));
+                mesh = Misc::ResourceHelpers::correctActorModelPath(mesh, &vfs);
+                if (!vfs.exists(mesh))
+                    continue;
+                if (Misc::getFileName(mesh).starts_with('x') && mesh.extension() == nif)
+                {
+                    VFS::Path::Normalized kfname = mesh;
+                    kfname.changeExtension(kf);
+                    if (vfs.exists(kfname))
+                        files.push_back(std::move(kfname));
+                }
+                files.push_back(std::move(mesh));
+            }
+            catch (const std::exception&)
+            {
+                // (the load reports it)
+            }
+        }
+        sceneManager.orthrosPrefetch(files, landTextures, place);
+#else
+        (void)cells;
+        (void)place;
+#endif
+    }

+            return;
+        const osg::ref_ptr<const LandObject> land = getLand(cellLocation);
+        std::set<UniqueTextureId> ids;
+        for (std::size_t y = 0; y < ESM::Land::LAND_TEXTURE_SIZE; ++y)
+            for (std::size_t x = 0; x < ESM::Land::LAND_TEXTURE_SIZE; ++x)
+                ids.insert(getTextureIdAt(land.get(), x, y));
+        for (const UniqueTextureId& id : ids)
+        {
+            Terrain::LayerInfo info = getLayerInfo(getTextureName(id));
+            out.push_back(std::move(info.mDiffuseMap));
+            if (!info.mNormalMap.empty())
+                out.push_back(std::move(info.mNormalMap));
+        }
+    }

+    void SceneManager::orthrosPrefetch(std::span<const VFS::Path::Normalized> files,
+        std::span<const VFS::Path::Normalized> landTextures, std::string_view place)
+    {
+#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
+        // (each wait bounded: past it the reads left wait one by one, as before; measured, 340 serial reads at a
+        // 90 ms round trip and 1.8 MB/s — 37 s — come in a few seconds fetched together)
+        constexpr double waitMs = 15000;
+        if (!VFS::orthrosReadAheadHooked())
+            return;
+        const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
+        constexpr VFS::Path::ExtensionView nif("nif");
+        std::set<VFS::Path::Normalized, std::less<>> seen;
+        std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized> wanted;
+        std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized> nifs;
+        for (const auto& file : files)
+        {
+            if (!seen.insert(file).second || !mVFS->exists(file))
+                continue;
+            if (file.extension() == nif)
+            {
+                if (mCache->getRefFromObjectCache(file))
+                    continue; // (built already: its files read before)
+                nifs.push_back(file);
+            }
+            wanted.push_back(file);
+        }
+        const std::string meshesLabel = "meshes:" + std::string(place);
+        const std::size_t meshesMissing = mVFS->orthrosWillRead(wanted, meshesLabel);
+        const bool meshesHere = meshesMissing == 0 || VFS::orthrosReadWait(waitMs);
+        const auto meshesDone = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
+
+        // (now local: each NIF parsed — kept by the NIF cache for getTemplate and the collision shapes — and the
+        // textures it names asked, those loaded already left out)
+        std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized> textures;
+        for (const auto& file : nifs)
+            orthrosTexturesOf(file, textures);
+        std::erase_if(textures,
+            [&](const VFS::Path::Normalized& image) { return !seen.insert(image).second || mImageManager->orthrosCached(image); });
+        std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized> land;
+        for (const auto& image : landTextures)
+            if (seen.insert(image).second && mVFS->exists(image) && !mImageManager->orthrosCached(image))
+                land.push_back(image);
+        const std::size_t texturesMissing = mVFS->orthrosWillRead(textures, "textures:" + std::string(place))
+            + mVFS->orthrosWillRead(land, "terrain:" + std::string(place));
+        const bool texturesHere = texturesMissing == 0 || VFS::orthrosReadWait(waitMs);
+        const auto ms = [](auto d) { return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(d).count(); };
+        Log(Debug::Info) << "Orthros read-ahead " << place << ": " << wanted.size() << " meshes (" << meshesMissing
+                         << " fetched" << (meshesHere ? "" : ", timed out") << ") " << ms(meshesDone - start)
+                         << " ms, " << textures.size() << " textures + " << land.size() << " land (" << texturesMissing
+                         << " fetched" << (texturesHere ? "" : ", timed out") << ") "
+                         << ms(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - meshesDone) << " ms";
+#else
+        (void)files;
+        (void)landTextures;
+        (void)place;
+#endif
     }

+    void ChunkManager::orthrosChunkFiles(float size, const osg::Vec2f& center, unsigned char /*lod*/,
+        unsigned int lodFlags, bool /*activeGrid*/, std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized>& /*meshes*/,
+        std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized>& landTextures)
+    {
+        const ChunkKey key{ .mCenter = center, .mLod = static_cast<unsigned char>(lodFlags >> (4 * 4)), .mLodFlags = lodFlags };
+        if (mCache->getRefFromObjectCache(key))
+            return;
+        // (the cells the chunk covers, as getBlendmaps samples them: a chunk smaller than a cell lies in one)
+        const int startX = static_cast<int>(std::floor(center.x() - size / 2.f));
+        const int startY = static_cast<int>(std::floor(center.y() - size / 2.f));
+        const int endX = std::max(startX + 1, static_cast<int>(std::ceil(center.x() + size / 2.f)));
+        const int endY = std::max(startY + 1, static_cast<int>(std::ceil(center.y() + size / 2.f)));
+        for (int y = startY; y < endY; ++y)
+            for (int x = startX; x < endX; ++x)
+                mStorage->orthrosLandTextures(ESM::ExteriorCellLocation(x, y, mWorldspace), landTextures);
+    }

+    void QuadTreeWorld::orthrosReadAhead(ViewData* vd, const osg::Vec4i& grid, unsigned int first)
+    {
+        if (!VFS::orthrosReadAheadHooked())
+            return;
+        // (the entries from `first` and those put off — mDeferred, preloadSlice's, for this view —, as chunksReady
+        // and loadRenderingNode see them: one built already and unchanged reads nothing)
+        std::vector<unsigned int> entries;
+        if (mDeferredView == vd)
+            for (const auto& deferred : mDeferred)
+                entries.push_back(deferred.first);
+        for (unsigned int i = first, n = vd->getNumEntries(); i < n; ++i)
+            entries.push_back(i);
+        std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized> meshes;
+        std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized> landTextures;
+        for (const unsigned int i : entries)
+        {
+            const ViewDataEntry& entry = vd->getEntry(i);
+            if (!vd->hasChanged() && entry.mRenderingNode)
+                continue;
+            const osg::Vec2f& center = entry.mNode->getCenter();
+            const bool activeGrid
+                = (center.x() > grid.x() && center.y() > grid.y() && center.x() < grid.z() && center.y() < grid.w());
+            for (ChunkManager* m : mChunkManagers)
+                m->orthrosChunkFiles(entry.mNode->getSize(), center,
+                    static_cast<unsigned char>(DefaultLodCallback::getNativeLodLevel(entry.mNode, mMinSize)),
+                    entry.mLodFlags, activeGrid, meshes, landTextures);
+        }
+        if (meshes.empty() && landTextures.empty())
+            return;
+        // (the place: the view point's cell)
+        const float cellWorldSize = mStorage->getCellWorldSize(mWorldspace);
+        const osg::Vec3f& viewPoint = vd->getViewPoint();
+        const std::string place = std::to_string(static_cast<int>(std::floor(viewPoint.x() / cellWorldSize))) + ","
+            + std::to_string(static_cast<int>(std::floor(viewPoint.y() / cellWorldSize)));
+        mResourceSystem->getSceneManager()->orthrosPrefetch(meshes, landTextures, place);
+    }

+    std::size_t Manager::orthrosWillRead(std::span<const Path::Normalized> names, std::string_view label) const
+    {
+#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
+        // (the page's hooks are on the main thread's globalThis; a cell load runs there. Elsewhere: not announced, the
+        // reads then waiting one by one as before)
+        if (names.empty() || !emscripten_is_main_runtime_thread())
+            return 0;
+        // (lengths as int: a size_t is a BigInt in the wasm64 build's JS)
+        // records 'path\x1Foffset\x1Fsize' separated by '\x1E' (size -1: to the file's end); one call for the batch
+        std::string list;
+        std::string path;
+        for (const auto& name : names)
+        {
+            const auto found = mIndex.find(name);
+            std::uint64_t offset = 0;
+            std::uint64_t size = 0;
+            if (found == mIndex.end() || !found->second->orthrosRange(path, offset, size))
+                continue;
+            if (!list.empty())
+                list += '\x1E';
+            list += path;
+            list += '\x1F';
+            list += std::to_string(offset);
+            list += '\x1F';
+            list += size == ~std::uint64_t{ 0 } ? std::string("-1") : std::to_string(size);
+        }
+        if (list.empty())
+            return 0;
+        // clang-format off
+        const int missing = MAIN_THREAD_EM_ASM_INT({
+            var f = globalThis.orthrosWillRead;
+            try { return f ? (f(UTF8ToString($0, $1), UTF8ToString($2, $3)) | 0) : 0; } catch (e) { return 0; }
+        }, list.data(), static_cast<int>(list.size()), label.data(), static_cast<int>(label.size()));
+        // clang-format on
+        return missing > 0 ? static_cast<std::size_t>(missing) : 0;
+#else
+        (void)names;
+        (void)label;
+        return 0;
+#endif
+    }
+
+    bool orthrosReadAheadHooked()
+    {
+#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
+        if (!emscripten_is_main_runtime_thread())
+            return false;
+        // clang-format off
+        return MAIN_THREAD_EM_ASM_INT({
+            return typeof globalThis.orthrosWillRead === 'function' && typeof globalThis.orthrosReadWait === 'function' ? 1 : 0;
+        }) != 0;
+        // clang-format on
+#else
+        return false;
+#endif
+    }
+
+    bool orthrosReadWait(double timeoutMs)
+    {
+#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
+        if (!emscripten_is_main_runtime_thread())
+            return true;
+        // (1: everything announced is there, 0: the timeout; a page without the hook, or one that fails: nothing to
+        // wait for, the reads then waiting one by one as before)
+        // clang-format off
+        return MAIN_THREAD_EM_ASM_INT({
+            var f = globalThis.orthrosReadWait;
+            try { return f ? (f($0) ? 1 : 0) : 1; } catch (e) { return 1; }
+        }, timeoutMs) != 0;
+        // clang-format on
+#else
+        (void)timeoutMs;
+        return true;
+#endif
+    }

+inline State::UniformStack& State::orthrosUniformStack(UniformMap& uniformMap, const StateSet::UniformList::value_type& entry)
+{
+    // Orthros (orthros-r11.patch): the stack of a StateSet's uniform found by its name ID — a flat table instead of a
+    // descent of _uniformMap comparing strings. Every StateSet API keys a uniform by its name: checked here (one string
+    // equality), anything else takes the map as before. Not "" either: a uniform named "" (osg::Uniform() is, with no
+    // name ID, ~0u — e.g. read from a .osgt without a Name) can still get a name (Uniform::setName) while listed under
+    // "", and the walk would then apply it there; a name, and its name ID, are for good once set.
+    const Uniform* uniform = entry.second.first.get();
+    const unsigned int nameID = uniform ? uniform->getNameID() : ~0u;
+    if (nameID != ~0u && &uniformMap == &_uniformMap && !entry.first.empty() && uniform->getName() == entry.first)
+    {
+        if (nameID < _orthrosUniformStackOfName.size() && _orthrosUniformStackOfName[nameID]) return *_orthrosUniformStackOfName[nameID];
+        UniformStack& us = uniformMap[entry.first];
+        if (nameID >= _orthrosUniformStackOfName.size()) _orthrosUniformStackOfName.resize(nameID + 1, 0);
+        _orthrosUniformStackOfName[nameID] = &us;
+        return us;
+    }
+    orthrosUniformKeyMismatch(entry.first);
+    return uniformMap[entry.first];

+inline void State::orthrosUniformKeyMismatch(const std::string& key)
+{
+    // Orthros (orthros-r11.patch): a StateSet lists a uniform under a key that is not its name, under "" or a null one
+    // (see orthrosUniformStack); applying takes the map walk from now on, said once.
+    if (!_orthrosUniformMismatch)
+        OSG_NOTICE << "osg::State: a StateSet lists a uniform under another name, or none (\"" << key << "\"): uniforms applied by the map walk from now on (OPENMW_ORTHROS_UNIFORMS)" << std::endl;
+    _orthrosUniformMismatch = true;

+inline bool State::orthrosApplyUniforms(const StateSet::UniformList* uniformList)
+{
+    // Orthros (orthros-r11.patch): applyUniformList / applyUniformMap without walking _uniformMap. The walk offers
+    // every name on the stack (and the StateSet's) to the program, which ignores the names it has no location for;
+    // here the program's own active names are visited and each one's uniform is chosen as the walk chooses it: the
+    // StateSet's, unless the stack's top is OVERRIDE and the StateSet's not PROTECTED; else the stack's top. The same
+    // uniforms reach PerContextProgram's slots (applied in another order: distinct names have distinct locations), so
+    // the same glUniform* calls. False (nothing applied): a StateSet uniform not keyed by its name, or keyed "" (as in
+    // orthrosUniformStack) — the walk instead, from now on.
+    const Program::PerContextProgram* pcp = _lastAppliedProgramObject;
+
+    unsigned int stamp = ++_orthrosUniformStamp;
+    if (stamp == 0)
+    {
+        for (std::vector<OrthrosStateSetUniform>::iterator itr = _orthrosStateSetUniforms.begin(); itr != _orthrosStateSetUniforms.end(); ++itr) itr->stamp = 0;
+        stamp = _orthrosUniformStamp = 1;
+    }
+
+    if (uniformList)
+    {
+        for (StateSet::UniformList::const_iterator itr = uniformList->begin(); itr != uniformList->end(); ++itr)
+        {
+            const Uniform* uniform = itr->second.first.get();
+            const unsigned int nameID = uniform ? uniform->getNameID() : ~0u;
+            if (nameID == ~0u || itr->first.empty() || uniform->getName() != itr->first)
+            {
+                orthrosUniformKeyMismatch(itr->first);
+                return false;
+            }
+            if (nameID >= _orthrosStateSetUniforms.size()) _orthrosStateSetUniforms.resize(nameID + 1);
+            OrthrosStateSetUniform& ssu = _orthrosStateSetUniforms[nameID];
+            ssu.uniform = uniform;
+            ssu.value = itr->second.second;
+            ssu.stamp = stamp;
+        }
+    }
+
+    const Program::PerContextProgram::OrthrosUniformNames& names = pcp->orthrosUniformNames();
+    for (Program::PerContextProgram::OrthrosUniformNames::const_iterator itr = names.begin(); itr != names.end(); ++itr)
+    {
+        const unsigned int nameID = itr->nameID;
+        const UniformStack* us = nameID < _orthrosUniformStackOfName.size() ? _orthrosUniformStackOfName[nameID] : 0;
+        const UniformStack::UniformPair* top = (us && !us->uniformVec.empty()) ? &us->uniformVec.back() : 0;
+        const Uniform* uniform = 0;
+        if (nameID < _orthrosStateSetUniforms.size() && _orthrosStateSetUniforms[nameID].stamp == stamp)
+        {
+            const OrthrosStateSetUniform& ssu = _orthrosStateSetUniforms[nameID];
+            uniform = (top && (top->second & StateAttribute::OVERRIDE) && !(ssu.value & StateAttribute::PROTECTED)) ? top->first : ssu.uniform;
+        }
+        else if (top)
+        {
+            uniform = top->first;
+        }
+        if (uniform) pcp->orthrosApply(itr->slot, *uniform);
+    }
+    return true;
+}

+void Program::PerContextProgram::orthrosBuildSlots() const
+{
+    // Orthros (orthros-r11.patch): from _uniformInfoMap as apply() reads it — a name with a location >= 0 is applied
+    // there, a location's last applied uniform is shared by every name that has it (_lastAppliedUniformList's key).
+    _orthrosSlotsDirty = false;
+    _orthrosSlotOfName.clear();
+    _orthrosSlots.clear();
+    _orthrosNames.clear();
+    std::map<GLint, unsigned int> slotOfLocation;
+    for (ActiveUniformMap::const_iterator itr = _uniformInfoMap.begin(); itr != _uniformInfoMap.end(); ++itr)
+    {
+        const GLint location = itr->second._location;
+        if (location < 0) continue;
+        std::pair<std::map<GLint, unsigned int>::iterator, bool> inserted =
+            slotOfLocation.insert(std::map<GLint, unsigned int>::value_type(location, static_cast<unsigned int>(_orthrosSlots.size())));
+        if (inserted.second)
+        {
+            _orthrosSlots.push_back(OrthrosUniformSlot());
+            _orthrosSlots.back().location = location;
+        }
+        const unsigned int nameID = itr->first;
+        if (nameID >= _orthrosSlotOfName.size()) _orthrosSlotOfName.resize(nameID + 1, -1);
+        _orthrosSlotOfName[nameID] = static_cast<int>(inserted.first->second);
+        OrthrosUniformName name;
+        name.nameID = nameID;
+        name.slot = inserted.first->second;
+        _orthrosNames.push_back(name);
+    }
+}

+    // read once -- named after the uniform buffer it was meant to bring; it sizes the existing uniform instead (no
+    // UBO: OSG binds uniform blocks from GL 3.1 only, and WebGL2 reports ES 3.0). On, a LightBuffer uniform holds
+    // only the elements its PointLightCount covers: a light list's (per frame, or kept between frames by
+    // OPENMW_ORTHROS_LIGHTCACHE), the list's lights; the LightManager's own (unlit objects', PointLightCount 0), one.
+    // The shaders read LightBuffer[i] for i < PointLightCount only (lib/core/lighting_*_impl.glsl) and
+    // glUniformMatrix4fv with fewer elements than the array sets its first ones: the values read are the same, while
+    // each change of light list in a program uploads n mat4s instead of maxLights (16 from the web page: 1 KiB,
+    // copied float by float by the GL glue) and the cull allocates n. The elements past n keep the program's

+    {
+        static const bool enabled = [] {

+            Log(Debug::Info) << "Orthros: light buffers sized to their light lists: "
+                             << (on ? "on" : "off (OPENMW_ORTHROS_LIGHTUBO=0)");

+        return enabled;
+    }

+    osg::ref_ptr<osg::StateSet> LightManager::getLightListStateSet(const LightList& lightList, size_t frameNum,
+        const osg::RefMatrix* viewMatrix, osg::ref_ptr<LightListStateSets>& last)
+    {
+        if (!mLightListCacheEnabled)
+            return getLightListStateSet(lightList, frameNum, viewMatrix);
+
+        // Orthros (orthros-r11.patch): the entry for these light source ids (LightListStateSets) -- the caller's
+        // last one when its ids are the same, else the map's (created if missing).
+        LightListStateSets* entry = last.get();
+        bool same = entry && entry->mCached && entry->mKey.size() == lightList.size();
+        for (size_t i = 0; same && i < lightList.size(); ++i)
+            same = entry->mKey[i] == lightList[i]->mLightSource->getId();

+            }
+            entry = found->second.get();

+        }

+        entry->mLastUsedUpdate = mLightListUpdate;
+        const size_t parity = mLightListUpdate % 2;

+        // Filled once after each update(); later uses return it as is, as the per-frame cache returns its StateSet.
+        if (!stateset || entry->mBuiltUpdate[parity] != mLightListUpdate)
+        {

+            // (maxLights, or the list's with OPENMW_ORTHROS_LIGHTUBO: orthrosLightBuffer) changed; else that parity's
+            // StateSet, last drawn two updates ago: its "PointLightCount" is the same (the ids, so their number, are
+            // the key) and the LightBuffer elements past the list, if any, stay zero.
+            osg::Uniform* data = entry->mLightBuffer[parity];
+            const bool sized = orthrosSizedLightBuffers();

+                if (entry->mBuiltUpdate[parity] != 0)

+// Orthros (orthros-r11.patch): per-call costs of Emscripten's WebGL glue (src/lib/libwebgl.js, libwebgl2.js and
+// libint53.js, Emscripten 6.0.1) in this MEMORY64 + pthreads + ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH + FULL_ES3 build, found in OpenMW
+// frames (Seyda Neen, tier mid: ~5,800 WebGL calls a frame; growMemViews 1.6 %, bigintToI53Checked 1.4 %, the
+// getParameter of glBindVertexArray 0.75 %, the client-side array checks of every draw 0.4 % of the engine's busy
+// time). Linked after the system libraries (--js-library, link-openmw.sh): its entries replace theirs of the same name,
+// whose __sig and __deps stay (deps are only added to).
+//
+// Switch: ENV.OPENMW_ORTHROS_GLGLUE, read once, when the first WebGL context is registered (the page fills ENV in
+// preRun, before main() creates the context). "0": every replaced entry runs the library's own body, kept below as
+// orthrosGLOrig_<name>; absent or anything else: the paths below. Same WebGL calls with the same arguments either way.
+//
+// - Heap reads. With growable shared memory every HEAPxx access is (growMemViews(), HEAPxx), and growMemViews reads
+//   wasmMemory.buffer, a getter: glUniformMatrix3fv did it 9 times a matrix, glUniform1fv/1iv once an element. A view
+//   of a SharedArrayBuffer stays valid when the memory grows (a shared buffer is never detached: growth gives a longer
+//   one), so the glue keeps its own views and takes the current one only when a call reaches past their end. Small
+//   uploads still go through the pool's views (miniTempWebGL*Buffers), larger ones through a view of the heap: the
+//   WebGL overloads of before (the garbage-free ones with a heap offset stay off, as the link chose: crbug.com/324992397).
+// - glBindVertexArray asked WebGL for the VAO's element array buffer (getParameter(ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING), one a
+//   VAO bind: all ~390 getParameter a frame, from osg::Drawable::draw) to keep FULL_ES3's mirror of it,
+//   GLctx.currentElementArrayBufferBinding. The glue records that binding per VAO where WebGL changes it:
+//   glBindBuffer(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER), glDeleteVertexArrays of the bound VAO (WebGL reverts to the default one) and
+//   glDrawElements' client-side index path (it leaves null bound). The mirror is the recorded buffer's .name | 0, as
+//   it was the returned one's: a deleted buffer has name 0 whether WebGL still returns it or null. A buffer's first
+//   bind to that target is checked once with getParameter (WebGL refuses a buffer already used as other data).
+// - FULL_ES3's client-side vertex arrays: glDrawArrays/glDrawElements looped over every attribute (16) to find enabled
+//   client-side ones. The glue counts them where they change (glVertexAttrib[I]Pointer, gl{En,Dis}ableVertexAttribArray);
+//   with none, a draw with an element array buffer bound (or glDrawArrays) is the WebGL call alone.
+// - bigintToI53Checked (every pointer argument): two BigInt-Number comparisons, then the conversion. The conversion now
+//   comes first; the comparisons only run for a result at or past +-2^53 (same result; ~2.5x faster in V8).
+

+void Program::PerContextProgram::orthrosApplyValue(OrthrosUniformSlot& s, const Uniform& uniform) const
+{
+    // Orthros (orthros-r12.patch): a changed uniform (another one, or the same one set() again) often carries the bytes
+    // its location already holds — the normal matrix of a draw like the last one, a material's colours, a light count:
+    // 724 of ~1,600 glUniform* a frame at Seyda Neen (mid tier). A program's uniform storage changes only through a
+    // glUniform* while it is current — each of them made here (one slot a location; linkProgram registers base names
+    // only) or followed by resetAppliedUniforms (debugdraw's own) — or through a relink; both make the slots anew,
+    // their records not valid. So the call last made here, made again (same GL API type, element count and bytes),
+    // would set the elements it covers to the values they hold: skipped. The words compared as 32-bit integers, not
+    // floats (-0 and +0 differ, a NaN equals its own bits), as GL holds them. Not recorded (valid false, the call
+    // always made): 64-bit types (GL_DOUBLE, GL_INT64_ARB, GL_UNSIGNED_INT64_ARB), no array, no element, more than 16
+    // words, an array shorter than the call reads.
+    const Uniform::Type uniformType = uniform.getType();
+    const unsigned int num = uniform.getNumElements();
+    const void* data = 0;
+    unsigned int size = 0;
+    switch (Uniform::getInternalArrayType(uniformType))
+    {
+    case GL_FLOAT:
+        if (const FloatArray* array = uniform.getFloatArray()) { size = array->getNumElements(); data = array->getDataPointer(); }
+        break;
+    case GL_INT:
+        if (const IntArray* array = uniform.getIntArray()) { size = array->getNumElements(); data = array->getDataPointer(); }
+        break;
+    case GL_UNSIGNED_INT:
+        if (const UIntArray* array = uniform.getUIntArray()) { size = array->getNumElements(); data = array->getDataPointer(); }
+        break;
+    default:
+        break;
+    }
+    // (num checked before the product: no overflow)
+    const unsigned int words = (num >= 1 && num <= 16) ? num * static_cast<unsigned int>(Uniform::getTypeNumComponents(uniformType)) : 0;
+    if (data && words >= 1 && words <= 16 && size >= words)
+    {
+        const Uniform::Type type = Uniform::getGlApiType(uniformType);
+        const unsigned char* bytes = static_cast<const unsigned char*>(data);
+        bool same = s.valid && s.type == type && s.num == num && s.words == words;
+        for (unsigned int i = 0; same && i < words; ++i)
+        {
+            GLuint word;
+            memcpy(&word, bytes + i * sizeof(GLuint), sizeof(GLuint));
+            same = word == s.value[i];
+        }
+        if (same)
+        {
+            s.uniform = &uniform;
+            s.modifiedCount = uniform.getModifiedCount();
+            return;
+        }
+        memcpy(s.value, bytes, words * sizeof(GLuint));
+        s.type = type;
+        s.num = num;
+        s.words = words;
+        s.valid = true;
+    }
+    else
+    {
+        s.valid = false;
+    }
+    uniform.apply(_extensions.get(), s.location);
+    s.uniform = &uniform;
+    s.modifiedCount = uniform.getModifiedCount();
+}

+#if !defined(_OSG_REFERENCED_USE_ATOMIC_OPERATIONS)
+// Orthros (orthros-r12.patch): OPENMW_ORTHROS_REFATOMIC read once, at the first object made (the page sets the
+// environment in preRun and Emscripten's environ is built at constructor priority 100, before any C++ static): -1 not
+// read yet, 1 a mutex per object ("0", the previous code), 0 atomic counts (absent, or any other value). Threads making
+// their first objects at once may each read it; they read the same value and one stores and reports it. Atomic accesses
+// (relaxed: wasm's are sequentially consistent anyway) because a thread may read it while another stores it; not a
+// function-local static (a guard at every object made). Reported on stderr, not through osg::notify: its handler is
+// itself a Referenced.
+static int s_orthrosRefMutexes = -1;
+
+static bool orthrosRefMutexes()
+{
+    int mutexes = __atomic_load_n(&s_orthrosRefMutexes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
+    if (mutexes < 0)
+    {
+        const char* value = getenv("OPENMW_ORTHROS_REFATOMIC");
+        const int wanted = (value && value[0]=='0' && value[1]==0) ? 1 : 0;
+        int expected = -1;
+        if (__atomic_compare_exchange_n(&s_orthrosRefMutexes, &expected, wanted, false,
+                                        __ATOMIC_RELAXED, __ATOMIC_RELAXED))
+        {
+            fputs(wanted ? "Orthros: osg reference counts under a mutex per object (OPENMW_ORTHROS_REFATOMIC=0)\n"
+                         : "Orthros: osg reference counts atomic (OPENMW_ORTHROS_REFATOMIC)\n", stderr);
+            mutexes = wanted;
+        }
+        else mutexes = expected;
+    }
+    return mutexes != 0;
+}

+// Orthros (orthros-r12.patch): OPENMW_ORTHROS_SHADERLOG, read once (the page sets ENV before the engine starts):
+// absent or anything but "0", a shader's info log after a successful compile and a program's after a successful link
+// are read only when OSG would print them (INFO enabled: OSG_INFO's own test); "0", always read, as before. In WebGL
+// each read is one synchronous round trip to the GPU process (glGetShaderiv/glGetProgramiv(GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH) call
+// getShaderInfoLog/getProgramInfoLog), about 0.3 ms: a small cleanup, not a hitch fix. A profile shows the first
+// read of a compile burst long (17-630 ms), but that is the GPU process still busy after the first COMPILE_STATUS
+// answered; without the read, the next synchronous call (the next shader's COMPILE_STATUS) waits for it instead.
+// Defined in namespace osg without a header: Program.cpp declares it locally in linkProgram.
+static bool orthrosReadShaderLogSwitch()
+{
+    const char* value = std::getenv("OPENMW_ORTHROS_SHADERLOG");
+    const bool enabled = !(value && std::strcmp(value, "0") == 0);
+    if (!enabled) OSG_NOTICE << "OPENMW_ORTHROS_SHADERLOG=0: info logs read after every successful compile and link" << std::endl;
+    return enabled;
+}

+bool orthrosSkipSuccessLogs()

+    bool TerrainStorage::orthrosLandReady(ESM::ExteriorCellLocation cellLocation)
+    {
+        if (ESM::isEsm4Ext(cellLocation.mWorldspace))
+            return true;
+        if (mLandManager->orthrosCached(cellLocation))
+            return true;
+        const MWWorld::ESMStore& esmStore = *MWBase::Environment::get().getESMStore();
+        const ESM::Land* land = esmStore.get<ESM::Land>().search(cellLocation.mX, cellLocation.mY);
+        // (LandManager::getLand's LandObject reads the record again from its file, even when the record's own data is
+        // loaded already: ESM::Land::loadData — ESMReader::restoreContext, a std::ifstream sought to
+        // mContext.filePos, then within the record's mContext.leftRec bytes. It reads nothing for a cell without a
+        // record, a record made without a file, or one with none of the data asked)
+        if (land == nullptr || land->mContext.filename.empty()
+            || (land->mDataTypes & mLandManager->getLoadFlags()) == 0)
+            return true;
+        // (the stream reads beyond the record's end: libc++'s filebuf 4 KiB at a time, musl's FILE buffer up to 1 KiB
+        // more behind each; the page answers for its pieces, clipped to the file's size)
+        constexpr std::uint64_t streamReadAhead = 8 << 10;
+        const std::string path = Files::pathToUnicodeString(land->mContext.filename);
+        const std::uint64_t offset = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(land->mContext.filePos);
+        const std::uint64_t size
+            = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::max<std::streamsize>(land->mContext.leftRec, 0)) + streamReadAhead;
+        const bool ready = VFS::orthrosRangeReady(path, offset, size);
+        // (once: the path the page is asked with — one it does not stream answers ready, and nothing is put off)
+        static std::atomic<bool> logged{ false };
+        if (!logged.exchange(true))
+            Log(Debug::Info) << "Orthros: terrain chunks wait for their LAND records; the first asked: " << path
+                             << " bytes " << offset << "+" << size << ", " << (ready ? "ready" : "not in the page yet");
+        return ready;
+    }

+    void Storage::orthrosBlendmapLayers(float chunkSize, const osg::Vec2f& chunkCenter, ESM::RefId worldspace,
+        std::vector<Terrain::LayerInfo>& out)
+    {
+        if (ESM::isEsm4Ext(worldspace))
+            return;
+        // (getBlendmaps' ESM3 sampling, kept in step with it below: the ids it finds — the cells beside the chunk it
+        // samples an edge of included —, each once; consecutive texels mostly share one)
+        const osg::Vec2f origin = chunkCenter - osg::Vec2f(chunkSize, chunkSize) * 0.5f;
+        const int startCellX = static_cast<int>(std::floor(origin.x()));
+        const int startCellY = static_cast<int>(std::floor(origin.y()));
+        LandCache cache(startCellX - 1, startCellY - 1, static_cast<std::size_t>(std::ceil(chunkSize)) + 2);
+        std::pair lastCell{ startCellX, startCellY };
+        const LandObject* land = getLand(ESM::ExteriorCellLocation(startCellX, startCellY, worldspace), cache);
+        std::set<UniqueTextureId> ids;
+        std::optional<UniqueTextureId> lastId;
+        const auto handleSample = [&](const CellSample& sample) {
+            const std::pair cell{ sample.mCellX, sample.mCellY };
+            if (lastCell != cell)
+            {
+                land = getLand(ESM::ExteriorCellLocation(sample.mCellX, sample.mCellY, worldspace), cache);
+                lastCell = cell;
+            }
+            const UniqueTextureId id = getTextureIdAt(land, sample.mSrcRow, sample.mSrcCol);
+            if (lastId != id)
+            {
+                ids.insert(id);
+                lastId = id;
+            }
+        };
+        sampleBlendmaps(chunkSize, origin.x(), origin.y(), ESM::Land::LAND_TEXTURE_SIZE, handleSample);
+        for (const UniqueTextureId& id : ids)
+            out.push_back(getLayerInfo(getTextureName(id)));
+    }

+        // Orthros (orthros-r12.patch): the bytes a GUI vertex array held when OSGVertexBuffer::lock() handed it out
+        // again at its size, its item drawn since its previous write, compared by its unlock(). One copy for all the
+        // buffers: MyGUI's lock/unlock pairs never nest (RenderItem::renderToTarget locks its buffer, writes all its
+        // draw items, unlocks it; on the cull traversal's thread), and mOwner guards it all the same -- an unlock()
+        // whose lock() saved no copy, or whose copy a later lock() replaced, dirties as before. A copy per buffer
+        // would double the GUI's vertex memory (text-heavy windows -- the journal, the inventory -- are large). Grown
+        // to the largest array copied, never shrunk.
+        struct OrthrosVertexCopy
+        {

+        OrthrosVertexCopy sOrthrosVertexCopy;

+        // Orthros (orthros-r12.patch): whether the n bytes at a and b are equal. musl's memcmp goes byte by byte:
+        // this compares 64 bytes a step (v128 loads, unaligned ones allowed in WebAssembly), then 8 (words loaded
+        // through memcpy: no misaligned access), then the bytes left.
+        bool orthrosSameBytes(const unsigned char* a, const unsigned char* b, size_t n)
+        {
+            size_t i = 0;
+#if defined(__wasm_simd128__)
+            for (; i + 64 <= n; i += 64)
+            {
+                const v128_t d0 = wasm_v128_xor(wasm_v128_load(a + i), wasm_v128_load(b + i));
+                const v128_t d1 = wasm_v128_xor(wasm_v128_load(a + i + 16), wasm_v128_load(b + i + 16));
+                const v128_t d2 = wasm_v128_xor(wasm_v128_load(a + i + 32), wasm_v128_load(b + i + 32));
+                const v128_t d3 = wasm_v128_xor(wasm_v128_load(a + i + 48), wasm_v128_load(b + i + 48));
+                if (wasm_v128_any_true(wasm_v128_or(wasm_v128_or(d0, d1), wasm_v128_or(d2, d3))))
+                    return false;
+            }
+#endif
+            for (; i + 8 <= n; i += 8)
+            {
+                std::uint64_t x;
+                std::uint64_t y;
+                std::memcpy(&x, a + i, sizeof(x));
+                std::memcpy(&y, b + i, sizeof(y));
+                if (x != y)
+                    return false;
+            }
+            for (; i < n; ++i)
+                if (a[i] != b[i])
+                    return false;
+            return true;
+        }

     void OSGVertexBuffer::unlock()
     {
+        // Orthros (orthros-r12.patch): OPENMW_ORTHROS_GUIUPLOAD. RenderItem::renderToTarget rewrites a render item's
+        // whole buffer when any of its draw items changed (or at a view update), often with the bytes it held. An
+        // array rewritten with exactly the bytes it held at lock() -- compared over its whole size: MyGUI writes at
+        // most mNeedVertexCount vertices from its start, the tail it leaves compares equal -- is not dirtied, so not
+        // uploaded again. Invariant: this array's buffer object holds this array only (create), and its GL buffer
+        // holds either exactly the array's bytes or a pending dirty (its GLBufferObject dirty, the array's modified
+        // count ahead of the buffer entry's) that uploads the array's bytes as they are at the next draw binding it
+        // (VertexArrayState::bindVertexBufferObject, GLBufferObject::compileBuffer). The bytes change only between a
+        // lock() and its unlock(); dirtying when they differ, when no copy was saved (lock(): not drawn since its
+        // last write, or the array just made or resized -- Array::resize does not dirty, and the GL buffer's size
+        // changes), keeps it, and a pending dirty stays pending: skipping both dirty() calls on equal bytes leaves
+        // the GL buffer's bytes at every draw exactly what they would have been. Off (OPENMW_ORTHROS_GUIUPLOAD=0 or
+        // OPENMW_ORTHROS_GUIBATCHES=0): dirtied at every unlock as before. Counted with OPENMW_ORTHROS_GUISTATS=1 only.
+        OrthrosGuiStats* stats = orthrosGuiStats() ? &sOrthrosGuiStats : nullptr;
+        if (stats)

+        {
+            OrthrosVertexCopy& copy = sOrthrosVertexCopy;
+            const osg::UByteArray* array = mVertexArray[mCurrentBuffer];

+            copy.mOwner = nullptr;
+            if (saved)

+                    return;
+            }

+    bool ChunkManager::chunkReady(float size, const osg::Vec2f& center, unsigned char /*lod*/, unsigned int lodFlags,
+        bool /*activeGrid*/, const osg::Vec3f& /*viewPoint*/)
+    {
+        if (!orthrosTerrainReady() || ESM::isEsm4Ext(mWorldspace))
+            return true;
+        // (getChunk's key: its level of detail from lodFlags' high bits — the flags loadRenderingNode will build the
+        // chunk with, QuadTreeWorld::orthrosBuilds)
+        const unsigned char lod = static_cast<unsigned char>(lodFlags >> (4 * 4));
+        const ChunkKey key{ .mCenter = center, .mLod = lod, .mLodFlags = lodFlags };
+        // (asked by the sliced preload on the main thread only — preloadSlice puts nothing off without a deadline —;
+        // createChunk, which drops an entry, may run elsewhere)
+        const std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mOrthrosWaitsMutex);
+        if (mOrthrosWaits.size() > 1024)
+            mOrthrosWaits.clear(); // (chunks asked and then never built: a preload aborted, the player gone)
+        // (getChunk's branches that read nothing: the chunk cached; a template of its center and level, whose
+        // vertices, passes and composite map createChunk copies)
+        bool readsNothing = mCache->getRefFromObjectCache(key) != nullptr;
+        if (!readsNothing)
+        {
+            const TemplateKey templateKey{ .mCenter = center, .mLod = lod };
+            const auto pair = mCache->lowerBound(templateKey);
+            readsNothing = pair.has_value()
+                && templateKey == TemplateKey{ .mCenter = pair->first.mCenter, .mLod = pair->first.mLod };
+        }
+        if (readsNothing)
+        {
+            mOrthrosWaits.erase(key);
+            return true;
+        }
+        const auto [found, fresh] = mOrthrosWaits.try_emplace(key);
+        OrthrosWait& wait = found->second;
+        // (the lands of the cells the chunk covers, counted as orthrosChunkFiles does, and of the ring around them:
+        // fillVertexBuffers' fixNormal, averageNormal and fixColour read the next cells' edges, corners included, and
+        // getBlendmaps samples an edge of the cells beside — LandCache(start - 1, ceil(size) + 2) in both)
+        if (fresh)
+        {
+            const int startX = static_cast<int>(std::floor(center.x() - size / 2.f));
+            const int startY = static_cast<int>(std::floor(center.y() - size / 2.f));
+            const int endX = std::max(startX + 1, static_cast<int>(std::ceil(center.x() + size / 2.f)));
+            const int endY = std::max(startY + 1, static_cast<int>(std::ceil(center.y() + size / 2.f)));
+            for (int y = startY - 1; y <= endY; ++y)
+                for (int x = startX - 1; x <= endX; ++x)
+                {
+                    const ESM::ExteriorCellLocation cell(x, y, mWorldspace);
+                    if (!mStorage->orthrosLandReady(cell))
+                        wait.mLands.push_back(cell);
+                }
+        }
+        else
+            while (wait.mLandsReady < wait.mLands.size() && mStorage->orthrosLandReady(wait.mLands[wait.mLandsReady]))
+                ++wait.mLandsReady;
+        if (wait.mLandsReady < wait.mLands.size())
+            return false;
+        // (then the textures, listed once from the lands — parsed now and kept by the LandManager, createChunk's own
+        // soon after)
+        const Resource::ImageManager& images = *mSceneManager->getImageManager();
+        const VFS::Manager& vfs = *mSceneManager->getVFS();
+        const auto textureReady = [&](const VFS::Path::Normalized& texture) {
+            return mTextureManager->orthrosCached(texture) || images.orthrosCached(texture)
+                || vfs.orthrosDataReady(texture);
+        };
+        if (!wait.mListed)
+        {
+            wait.mListed = true;
+            std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized> textures;
+            orthrosPassTextures(size, center, size >= mCompositeMapLevel, textures);
+            for (const VFS::Path::Normalized& texture :
+                std::set<VFS::Path::Normalized>(textures.begin(), textures.end()))
+                if (!textureReady(texture))
+                    wait.mTextures.push_back(texture);
+        }
+        else
+            while (wait.mTexturesReady < wait.mTextures.size() && textureReady(wait.mTextures[wait.mTexturesReady]))
+                ++wait.mTexturesReady;
+        if (wait.mTexturesReady < wait.mTextures.size())
+            return false;
+        mOrthrosWaits.erase(found);
+        return true;
+    }

+    void ChunkManager::orthrosPassTextures(float chunkSize, const osg::Vec2f& chunkCenter, bool forCompositeMap,
+        std::vector<VFS::Path::Normalized>& out)
+    {
+        // (createChunk: a composite map's parts as createCompositeMapGeometry splits it, each drawn with
+        // createPasses(..., true): diffuse maps only; below the composite level, createPasses(..., false): the
+        // normal maps too)
+        if (forCompositeMap && chunkSize > mMaxCompGeometrySize)
+        {
+            const float half = chunkSize / 2.f;
+            const float quarter = chunkSize / 4.f;
+            orthrosPassTextures(half, chunkCenter + osg::Vec2f(quarter, quarter), true, out);
+            orthrosPassTextures(half, chunkCenter + osg::Vec2f(-quarter, quarter), true, out);
+            orthrosPassTextures(half, chunkCenter + osg::Vec2f(quarter, -quarter), true, out);
+            orthrosPassTextures(half, chunkCenter + osg::Vec2f(-quarter, -quarter), true, out);
+            return;
+        }
+        std::vector<LayerInfo> layers;
+        mStorage->orthrosBlendmapLayers(chunkSize, chunkCenter, mWorldspace, layers);
+        for (LayerInfo& layer : layers)
+        {
+            out.push_back(std::move(layer.mDiffuseMap));
+            if (!forCompositeMap && !layer.mNormalMap.empty())
+                out.push_back(std::move(layer.mNormalMap));
+        }
+    }

+    void TerrainStorage::orthrosCellRanges(ESM::ExteriorCellLocation cellLocation, std::vector<VFS::OrthrosRange>& out)
+    {
+        if (ESM::isEsm4Ext(cellLocation.mWorldspace))
+            return;
+        const MWWorld::ESMStore& esmStore = *MWBase::Environment::get().getESMStore();
+        if (const ESM::Cell* cell = esmStore.get<ESM::Cell>().searchStatic(cellLocation.mX, cellLocation.mY))
+            MWRender::orthrosCellRanges(esmStore, *cell, true, true, out);
+        else if (const ESM::Land* land = esmStore.get<ESM::Land>().search(cellLocation.mX, cellLocation.mY))
+        {
+            VFS::OrthrosRange range;
+            if (land->mDataTypes != 0 && orthrosLandRange(*land, range))
+                out.push_back(std::move(range));
+        }
+    }

+    /// Orthros (orthros-r13.patch): loading the saved game `filepath` loads the references of every cell it has a state
+    /// of (WorldModel::readRecord: CellStore::load, one cell after the other), read from the content files as they are
+    /// once the content is loaded (their light copies zeroed those details): the ranges of those cells fetched together
+    /// first — one pass over the save's record headers, each CSTA's cell id —, then one wait (bounded). Not learned as
+    /// a place's (the label's kind is none of them). Nothing off the web build, without the hooks, or on any error
+    /// (the load reads them one by one, as before).
+    void orthrosReadSavedCells(const std::filesystem::path& filepath)
+    {
+#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
+        if (!VFS::orthrosReadAheadHooked())
+            return;
+        try
+        {
+            const MWWorld::ESMStore& store = *MWBase::Environment::get().getESMStore();
+            ESM::ESMReader reader;
+            reader.open(filepath);
+            std::vector<VFS::OrthrosRange> ranges;
+            while (reader.hasMoreRecs())
+            {
+                const ESM::NAME n = reader.getRecName();
+                reader.getRecHeader();
+                if (n.toInt() == ESM::REC_CSTA)
+                    if (const ESM::Cell* cell = store.get<ESM::Cell>().search(reader.getCellId()))
+                        MWRender::orthrosCellRanges(store, *cell, true, false, ranges);
+                reader.skipRecord();
+            }
+            if (VFS::orthrosWillReadRanges(ranges, "cells:save") > 0)
+                VFS::orthrosReadWait(15000);
+        }
+        catch (const std::exception& e)
+        {
+            Log(Debug::Warning) << "Orthros: the saved game's cells not read ahead: " << e.what();
+        }
+#else
+        (void)filepath;
+#endif
+    }
+}

+    void Scene::orthrosReadCells(std::span<const ESM::Cell* const> cells, std::string_view label)
+    {
+#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
+        if (cells.empty() || !VFS::orthrosReadAheadHooked())
+            return;
+        std::vector<VFS::OrthrosRange> ranges;
+        for (const ESM::Cell* cell : cells)
+            MWRender::orthrosCellRanges(mWorld.getStore(), *cell, true, true, ranges);
+        // (bounded as the read-ahead's own waits: past it the reads left wait one by one, as before)
+        if (VFS::orthrosWillReadRanges(ranges, label) > 0)
+            VFS::orthrosReadWait(15000);
+#else
+        (void)cells;
+        (void)label;
+#endif
+    }

+    bool Scene::orthrosCellReady(const CellStore& cell) const
+    {
+#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
+        if (cell.getCell()->isEsm4())

+        return VFS::orthrosRangesReady(ranges);
+#else
+        (void)cell;
+        return true;
+#endif
+    }
