`tools/openmw/player-defaults.mjs`:

```mjs
// A version's defaults for the player's own Lua settings (OpenMW's Options → Scripts pages: OMWControls, OMWCamera, a
// mod's), given once. Those settings live in the player's storage (player_storage.bin, the player's profile), not in
// settings.cfg: the manifest's openmw.settings cannot reach them. The generated data root holds one PLAYER script that,
// on a browser client (never on a native simulation peer), sets each listed value once per player profile, only over
// the value the engine registers by default, and records it: a later choice of the player's (the Options page, a toggle
// key), or a value already moved off that default, is never overwritten. Each entry has its own record, so a later
// root may add entries; never remove this one (the records name its entries). Each record says what was done:
// 'given' (the value set) or 'kept' (the player's value already off the default); roots generated before 2026-10-30
// recorded true for both.
// Withdrawing: the root's script replaced by one that gives the registered default back, once, to each profile whose
// record says the value was given ('given', or true: those older records cannot tell given from kept) and that still
// holds it; a value the player moved since is left alone. The manifest keeps the entries under `withdrawn`.
// Usage: node tools/openmw/player-defaults.mjs <game-folder> <version-id> <defaults.json> [--id <mod-id>]
//        node tools/openmw/player-defaults.mjs <game-folder> <version-id> --withdraw [--id <mod-id>] [--because <text>]
//   defaults.json: [{ "group": "SettingsOMWControls", "key": "alwaysRun", "value": true, "default": false }, ...]
//     group: the settings group's storage section (I.Settings.registerGroup key); default: its registered default
//     or a key binding of a mod's action (Options → Scripts, an inputBinding renderer; OpenMW keeps them in the
//     OMWInputBindings section under the binding's id): { "binding": "<binding id>", "action": "<action key>",
//     "keyboard": "G" } — given once, only while that binding is unset (its registered default: none) and no binding
//     of the profile already uses that key; withdrawn only while it is still the one given
//   --id: the generated root's mod id (default orthros-player-defaults); its plugin is named after it
//     (Orthros Player Defaults.omwscripts), its script goes to scripts/<id with _>/player.lua
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const DEFAULT_ID = 'orthros-player-defaults';
const NAME = /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$/;
// (a value a settings renderer stores: a boolean, a number, a plain word or phrase)
const TEXT = /^[A-Za-z0-9 ._,-]{0,64}$/;
const luaValue = (v) => typeof v === 'boolean' ? String(v) : typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) && /^-?[0-9.]+$/.test(String(v)) ? String(v)
  : typeof v === 'string' && TEXT.test(v) ? `'${v}'` : null;

/** The entries of a defaults file, checked: [{ group, key, value, default }]. */
export function playerDefaultsEntries(list) {
  if (!Array.isArray(list) || !list.length || list.length > 256) throw new Error('Expected a non-empty list of player defaults');
  const seen = new Set();
  return list.map((d) => {
    if (d && typeof d === 'object' && 'binding' in d) {
      if (!NAME.test(d.binding ?? '') || !NAME.test(d.action ?? '') || !/^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,15}$/.test(d.keyboard ?? ''))
        throw new Error(`Bad key binding default ${JSON.stringify(d)}`);
      if (seen.has(`OMWInputBindings/${d.binding}`)) throw new Error(`binding ${d.binding} listed twice`);
      seen.add(`OMWInputBindings/${d.binding}`);
      return { binding: d.binding, action: d.action, keyboard: d.keyboard };
    }
    if (!d || typeof d !== 'object' || !NAME.test(d.group ?? '') || !NAME.test(d.key ?? '')) throw new Error(`Bad player default ${JSON.stringify(d)}`);
    if (luaValue(d.value) === null || luaValue(d.default) === null) throw new Error(`${d.group}/${d.key}: value and default must be booleans, numbers or plain words`);
    if (d.value === d.default) throw new Error(`${d.group}/${d.key}: the value is already the engine's default`);
    if (seen.has(`${d.group}/${d.key}`)) throw new Error(`${d.group}/${d.key} listed twice`);
    seen.add(`${d.group}/${d.key}`);
    return { group: d.group, key: d.key, value: d.value, default: d.default };
  });
}

/** The PLAYER script giving `entries` once, its records in storage section `records`. */
const settingRows = (entries) => entries.filter((e) => !e.binding).map((e) => `    { '${e.group}', '${e.key}', ${luaValue(e.value)}, ${luaValue(e.default)} },`).join('\n');
const bindingRows = (entries) => entries.filter((e) => e.binding).map((e) => `    { '${e.binding}', '${e.action}', '${e.keyboard}' },`).join('\n');
// (the key bindings' part of a script: none when a root lists no binding — older roots' scripts unchanged)
const bindingCode = (entries, records, withdraw) => !entries.some((e) => e.binding) ? '' : withdraw ? `
-- { binding id, action, keyboard key } this root gave
local BINDINGS = {
${bindingRows(entries)}
}
local input = require('openmw.input')
local bindings = storage.playerSection('OMWInputBindings')
local function withdrawBindings(back)
    for _, b in ipairs(BINDINGS) do
        local record = 'OMWInputBindings/' .. b[1]
        if records:get(record) == 'given' and not restored:get(record) then
            local current = bindings:get(b[1])
            if current and current.device == 'keyboard' and current.button == input.KEY[b[3]] and current.key == b[2] then
                bindings:set(b[1], nil)
                back[#back + 1] = record
            end
            restored:set(record, true)
        end
    end
end
` : `
-- { binding id, action, keyboard key }: given only while the binding is unset and no binding uses that key
local BINDINGS = {
${bindingRows(entries)}
}
local input = require('openmw.input')
local bindings = storage.playerSection('OMWInputBindings')
local function giveBindings(given)
    for _, b in ipairs(BINDINGS) do
        local record = 'OMWInputBindings/' .. b[1]
        if not records:get(record) then
            local button, taken = input.KEY[b[3]], false
            for _, other in pairs(bindings:asTable()) do
                if type(other) == 'table' and other.device == 'keyboard' and other.button == button then taken = true end
            end
            if bindings:get(b[1]) == nil and not taken and button then
                bindings:set(b[1], { key = b[2], type = 'action', device = 'keyboard', button = button })
                given[#given + 1] = record
                records:set(record, 'given')
            else
                records:set(record, 'kept')
            end
        end
    end
end
`;

export function playerDefaultsScript(entries, records) {
  const rows = settingRows(entries), binds = bindingCode(entries, records, false);
  return `-- Generated by Orthros (tools/openmw/player-defaults.mjs): the version's player settings defaults, given once.
-- Each entry is set once per player profile, only over the engine's registered default, and recorded in the
-- ${records} section: a later choice of the player's is never overwritten. Never on a simulation peer.
local ok, mp = pcall(require, 'openmw.mp')
if ok and mp.isSystem and mp.isSystem() then return {} end
local storage = require('openmw.storage')
local records = storage.playerSection('${records}')
-- { settings group, key, value, the engine's default }
local DEFAULTS = {
${rows}
}${binds}
local function apply()
    local given = {}${binds ? '\n    giveBindings(given)' : ''}
    for _, d in ipairs(DEFAULTS) do
        local record = d[1] .. '/' .. d[2]
        if not records:get(record) then
            local section = storage.playerSection(d[1])
            local current = section:get(d[2])
            if current == nil or current == d[4] then
                section:set(d[2], d[3])
                given[#given + 1] = record
                records:set(record, 'given')
            else
                records:set(record, 'kept')
            end
        end
    end
    if #given > 0 then print('[orthros] player defaults given: ' .. table.concat(given, ', ')) end
end
return { engineHandlers = { onInit = apply, onLoad = apply } }
`;
}

/** The PLAYER script withdrawing `entries` a root gave (records in section `records`): the registered default back once. */
export function playerDefaultsWithdrawalScript(entries, records) {
  const rows = settingRows(entries), binds = bindingCode(entries, records, true);
  return `-- Generated by Orthros (tools/openmw/player-defaults.mjs --withdraw): this root's entries are withdrawn. A profile
-- whose ${records} record says the value was given ('given'; true, from a root generated before 2026-10-30, may
-- also mean the player's own value was kept) and that still holds it gets the engine's registered default back, once
-- (recorded in ${records}Restored). A value the player moved since is left alone. Never on a simulation peer.
-- Never remove the root: its records name its entries.
local ok, mp = pcall(require, 'openmw.mp')
if ok and mp.isSystem and mp.isSystem() then return {} end
local storage = require('openmw.storage')
local records = storage.playerSection('${records}')
local restored = storage.playerSection('${records}Restored')
-- { settings group, key, the value this root gave, the engine's default }
local WITHDRAWN = {
${rows}
}${binds}
local function apply()
    local back = {}${binds ? '\n    withdrawBindings(back)' : ''}
    for _, d in ipairs(WITHDRAWN) do
        local record = d[1] .. '/' .. d[2]
        local done = records:get(record)
        if (done == true or done == 'given') and not restored:get(record) then
            local section = storage.playerSection(d[1])
            if section:get(d[2]) == d[3] then
                section:set(d[2], d[4])
                back[#back + 1] = record
            end
            restored:set(record, true)
        end
    end
    if #back > 0 then print('[orthros] player defaults withdrawn: ' .. table.concat(back, ', ')) end
end
return { engineHandlers = { onInit = apply, onLoad = apply } }
`;
}

const rootNames = (id) => {
  const title = id.split('-').map((w) => w[0].toUpperCase() + w.slice(1)).join(' ');
  return { title, plugin: `${title}.omwscripts`, ns: `scripts/${id.replaceAll('-', '_')}`, records: title.replaceAll(' ', '') };
};

/** Generates the root in the version and records it in its manifest (installed, with its entries). */
export function installPlayerDefaults(folder, versionId, list, { id = DEFAULT_ID } = {}) {
  const entries = playerDefaultsEntries(list);
  // (the manifest's mod id rule, src/host/openmw.js MOD_ID)
  if (!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,54}$/.test(id)) throw new Error('Invalid mod id');
  const game = fs.realpathSync(folder), file = path.join(game, 'manifest.json');
  const spec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')), version = spec.versions.find((v) => v.id === versionId);
  const mods = version?.openmw?.mods;
  if (!mods) throw new Error(`No OpenMW version with mods: ${versionId}`);
  if (mods.some((m) => m.id === id)) throw new Error(`${id} is already installed`);
  const { plugin, ns, records } = rootNames(id);
  if (mods.some((m) => (m.parts ?? []).some((p) => p.plugins.some((n) => n.toLowerCase() === plugin.toLowerCase())))) throw new Error(`${plugin} is another root's plugin`);
  const versionDir = fs.realpathSync(path.join(game, 'versions', version.dir));
  for (const part of mods.flatMap((m) => m.parts ?? []))
    if (fs.existsSync(path.join(versionDir, part.dir, ns))) throw new Error(`${ns} already exists in ${part.dir}; choose another --id`);
  const dir = `mods/${id}-0`, dest = path.join(versionDir, dir);
  if (fs.existsSync(dest)) throw new Error(`${dest} already exists; no overwrite`);
  const files = new Map([[plugin, `PLAYER: ${ns}/player.lua\n`], [`${ns}/player.lua`, playerDefaultsScript(entries, records)]]);
  const hash = createHash('sha256');
  fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true });
  for (const [name, text] of files) {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(dest, name)), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dest, name), text, { flag: 'wx' }); hash.update(name).update('\0').update(text);
  }
  // (readable by the services' users whatever the umask, as install-mod.mjs leaves a mod)
  for (const p of [dest, path.join(dest, 'scripts'), path.join(dest, ns)]) fs.chmodSync(p, 0o755);
  for (const name of files.keys()) fs.chmodSync(path.join(dest, name), 0o644);
  mods.push({ id, name: id === DEFAULT_ID ? 'Player settings defaults (Orthros)' : `Player settings defaults (Orthros, ${id})`,
    installed: true, installedAt: new Date().toISOString(), generatedSha256: hash.digest('hex'),
    playerDefaults: entries, policy: `Once per player profile, only over the engine's registered default, recorded in storage section ${records}; a player's later choice is kept; never on a simulation peer`,
    parts: [{ dir, source: 'generated player settings defaults', sentinel: plugin, plugins: [plugin], archives: [],
      files: files.size, bytes: [...files.values()].reduce((sum, s) => sum + Buffer.byteLength(s), 0) }] });
  fs.writeFileSync(file + '.new', JSON.stringify(spec, null, 2) + '\n'); fs.renameSync(file + '.new', file);
  return { plugin, script: `${ns}/player.lua`, records, entries: entries.length };
}

/**
 * Withdraws every entry of an installed root: its script replaced by the withdrawal script (playerDefaultsWithdrawalScript),
 * the manifest's entry moved to `withdrawn` (playerDefaults emptied), its hash and sizes updated. The root stays.
 */
export function withdrawPlayerDefaults(folder, versionId, { id = DEFAULT_ID, because = null } = {}) {
  const game = fs.realpathSync(folder), file = path.join(game, 'manifest.json');
  const spec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')), version = spec.versions.find((v) => v.id === versionId);
  const mod = version?.openmw?.mods?.find((m) => m.id === id);
  if (!mod) throw new Error(`${id} is not installed in ${versionId}`);
  if (!mod.playerDefaults?.length) throw new Error(`${id} has no entries to withdraw`);
  if (because !== null && (typeof because !== 'string' || !because.trim())) throw new Error('Expected a reason');
  const entries = playerDefaultsEntries(mod.playerDefaults), { plugin, ns, records } = rootNames(id);
  const part = mod.parts?.[0];
  if (!part || part.sentinel !== plugin) throw new Error(`${id} is not a generated player defaults root`);
  const dest = path.join(fs.realpathSync(path.join(game, 'versions', version.dir)), part.dir);
  const pluginText = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dest, plugin), 'utf8'), scriptPath = path.join(dest, ns, 'player.lua');
  const current = fs.readFileSync(scriptPath, 'utf8');
  const hashOf = (texts) => { const h = createHash('sha256'); for (const [n, t] of texts) h.update(n).update('\0').update(t); return h.digest('hex'); };
  if (hashOf([[plugin, pluginText], [`${ns}/player.lua`, current]]) !== mod.generatedSha256) throw new Error(`${id}: its files differ from the generated ones; no overwrite`);
  const script = playerDefaultsWithdrawalScript(entries, records);
  fs.writeFileSync(scriptPath + '.new', script, { mode: 0o644 }); fs.chmodSync(scriptPath + '.new', 0o644); fs.renameSync(scriptPath + '.new', scriptPath);
  mod.withdrawn = { at: new Date().toISOString(), entries, ...(because ? { because } : {}),
    generatedSha256Before: mod.generatedSha256 };
  mod.playerDefaults = [];
  mod.generatedSha256 = hashOf([[plugin, pluginText], [`${ns}/player.lua`, script]]);
  mod.policy = `Withdrawn: the registered default given back once to a profile whose record in storage section ${records} says the value was given and that still holds it (recorded in ${records}Restored); a player's later choice is kept; never on a simulation peer`;
  part.bytes = Buffer.byteLength(pluginText) + Buffer.byteLength(script);
  fs.writeFileSync(file + '.new', JSON.stringify(spec, null, 2) + '\n'); fs.renameSync(file + '.new', file);
  return { script: `${ns}/player.lua`, records, withdrawn: entries.length, generatedSha256: mod.generatedSha256 };
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.argv[1])).href) {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2), at = args.indexOf('--id'), opts = {};
  if (at >= 0) { opts.id = args[at + 1]; args.splice(at, 2); }
  const withdraw = args.indexOf('--withdraw');
  if (withdraw >= 0) {
    args.splice(withdraw, 1);
    const by = args.indexOf('--because');
    if (by >= 0) { opts.because = args[by + 1]; args.splice(by, 2); }
    const [folder, version] = args;
    if (!folder || !version || args.length !== 2 || (at >= 0 && !opts.id)) throw new Error('Expected game folder and version id');
    console.log(JSON.stringify(withdrawPlayerDefaults(folder, version, opts)));
    process.exit(0);
  }
  const [folder, version, list] = args;
  if (!folder || !version || !list || (at >= 0 && !opts.id)) throw new Error('Expected game folder, version id and defaults file');
  console.log(JSON.stringify(installPlayerDefaults(folder, version, JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(list, 'utf8')), opts)));
}
```

`tools/openmw/read-trace.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""A load's reads, from place-load.mjs --read-trace (data-client.js GameData.trace): what the page asked its game data
worker for, when, how long each took, which waited serially and which overlapped, what was asked while the engine stood
suspended (JSPI) — and, with the run's proxy log, what went over the link meanwhile.

usage: python3 -I tools/openmw/read-trace.py <run folder> [--from S] [--to S] [--list] [--json]
  <run folder>: place-load's run folder (read-trace.json.gz, proxy.jsonl.gz). Times in seconds from the trigger (the key
  or the COE: the row's P.from), --from/--to the window (default: the trigger to the player in the world, else +60 s).
  --list: every entry of the window (the engine's frames, loads and suspensions among them, from an engine that traces
  them — orthros-r20.patch orthrosNote —; --plain: its plain frames too); --json: the summary as one JSON line.
"""
import gzip, json, os, re, sys, urllib.parse
from collections import Counter, defaultdict


def load(run):
    with gzip.open(os.path.join(run, 'read-trace.json.gz'), 'rt') as f:
        return json.load(f)


def proxy(run):
    p = os.path.join(run, 'proxy.jsonl.gz')
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        return []
    with gzip.open(p, 'rt') as f:
        return [json.loads(l) for l in f if l.strip()]


def kind(url):
    return 'want' if re.search(r'[?&]w=1', url) else 'bg' if re.search(r'[?&]p=1', url) else 'ahead' if re.search(r'[?&]a=1', url) else 'demand' if re.search(r'[?&]s=', url) else 'other'


def short(path):
    return (path or '').split('/')[-1]


def busiest(intervals):
    """The most intervals [a, b) open at once, and the time with at least two open (ms)."""
    ev = sorted([(a, 1) for a, b in intervals] + [(b, -1) for a, b in intervals])
    n = top = 0; overlap = 0; last = None
    for t, d in ev:
        if last is not None and n >= 2:
            overlap += t - last
        n += d; top = max(top, n); last = t
    return top, round(overlap)


def main(argv):
    if not argv or argv[0].startswith('--'):
        print(__doc__); return 2
    run = argv[0]
    opt = lambda k: float(argv[argv.index(k) + 1]) if k in argv else None
    d = load(run)
    t0 = d.get('from')
    if t0 is None:
        print('no trigger time in the trace (P.from)'); return 1
    end = (d['inWorldAt'] - t0) / 1000 if d.get('inWorldAt') and d['inWorldAt'] > t0 else 60.0
    lo, hi = opt('--from') if opt('--from') is not None else 0.0, opt('--to') if opt('--to') is not None else end
    rows = [e for e in d['trace'] if lo <= (e['t'] - t0) / 1000 <= hi]
    out = {'window_s': [lo, round(hi, 2)], 'entries': len(rows)}
    by = Counter(e['k'] for e in rows)
    out['byKind'] = dict(by)
    # (the engine's waits: sync / spin / late / async, their time, and how much of them overlapped — serial or batched)
    waits = [e for e in rows if e['k'] in ('sync', 'spin', 'late', 'async') and e.get('ms') is not None]
    ms = defaultdict(int)
    for e in waits:
        ms[e['k']] += e['ms']
    out['waitMs'] = dict(ms)
    top, over = busiest([(e['t'], e['t'] + e['ms']) for e in waits if e['ms'] > 0])
    out['waitsAtOnce'] = top; out['waitOverlapMs'] = over
    out['waitsOver100ms'] = sum(1 for e in waits if e['ms'] >= 100)
    # (the background fetches — readable(): a preload's or a sound's readiness — and when: the engine suspended or not)
    bg = [e for e in rows if e['k'] == 'bg']
    out['bg'] = {'count': len(bg), 'whileBusy': sum(1 for e in bg if e.get('busy')), 'MBasked': round(sum(e['len'] for e in bg) / 1e6, 2),
                 'files': Counter(short(e['f']) for e in bg).most_common(6)}
    callers = Counter()
    for e in bg:
        st = e.get('st') or ''
        frames = [f for f in st.split(' < ') if f and 'data-client.js' not in f]
        callers[' < '.join(frames[:3])] += 1
    out['bgCallers'] = callers.most_common(5)
    # (announced batches and the waits for them)
    out['want'] = [{'atS': round((e['t'] - t0) / 1000, 2), 'seq': e['off'], 'entries': e['len'], 'MB': round(e.get('bytes', 0) / 1e6, 2), 'label': e.get('label')} for e in rows if e['k'] == 'want']
    out['wwait'] = [{'atS': round((e['t'] - t0) / 1000, 2), 'ms': e.get('ms'), 'ok': e.get('ok'), 'soon': e.get('soon', 0), 'left': e.get('left'), 'batches': [e['off'], e['len']]} for e in rows if e['k'] == 'wwait']
    # (the link meanwhile: the proxy's requests by kind, bytes on the wire — the marker aligns its clock)
    recs = proxy(run)
    mark = next((r for r in recs if r.get('url', '').startswith('/__qa/mark')), None)
    if mark and d.get('markAt') is not None:
        p0 = mark['t'] + (t0 - d['markAt'])
        wire = defaultdict(float); n = Counter()
        for r in recs:
            a = (r['t'] - p0) / 1000
            if lo <= a <= hi and ('/game/' in r['url'] or '/gamez/' in r['url']):
                k = kind(r['url']); wire[k] += r.get('wire', 0) / 1e6; n[k] += 1
        out['link'] = {k: {'requests': n[k], 'wireMB': round(v, 2)} for k, v in wire.items()}
    # (the engine's own marks, when it traces them: its suspensions by kind — count, ms —, loads, promising frames)
    js = [e for e in rows if e['k'] == 'jspi']
    if js:
        sus = defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])
        for e in js:
            if e['ev'] == 'suspended':
                sus[e['x'][0]][0] += 1; sus[e['x'][0]][1] += e['x'][2]
        out['suspended'] = {k: v for k, v in sus.items()}
        out['loading'] = [[round((e['t'] - t0) / 1000, 3), e['x']] for e in js if e['ev'] == 'loading']
        out['promising'] = [[round((e['t'] - t0) / 1000, 3), e['ev']] for e in js if e['ev'] in ('enter', 'leave', 'defer')]
    if '--json' in argv:
        print(json.dumps(out)); return 0
    for k, v in out.items():
        print(f'{k}: {json.dumps(v)}')
    if '--list' in argv:
        for e in rows:
            if e['k'] == 'jspi':
                if e['ev'] != 'plain' or '--plain' in argv:
                    print(f"{(e['t'] - t0) / 1000:8.3f} jspi  {e['ev']} {json.dumps(e.get('x'))}")
                continue
            print(f"{(e['t'] - t0) / 1000:8.3f} {e['k']:5} {e.get('ms', ''):>6} busy={e.get('busy', 0)} load={e.get('load', 0)} {short(e.get('f'))} {e.get('off')}+{e.get('len')} {e.get('label') or ''}{(' ' + e['st'][:160]) if e.get('st') and e['k'] == 'bg' else ''}")
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-fair-2026-10-31/scripts/memlog.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# avail/load every 30 s; under 16 GB available: this task's place-load (naming jspi5 scratch, with --input-trace) stopped
L=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspifair/logs/memory.log
while true; do
  a=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')
  echo "$(date +%T) avail=${a}G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg)" >> $L
  if [ "$a" -lt 16 ]; then
    for p in $(pgrep -f '^node tools/openmw/place-load\.mjs .*jspi5.*--input-trace'); do echo "$(date +%T) LOW MEMORY ${a}G: killing $p" >> $L; kill $p; done
  fi
  sleep 30
done

```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: pl.sh <19L|20c> <tag> <out jsonl> [place-load options...] — jspi5's warm profiles and pristine learned state, data-r19's engines folder and save
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19; J=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspi5; F=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspifair; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
side=$1; tag=$2; out=$3; shift 3
case $side in
  19L) eng=(--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r19); dir=$J/w19L ;;
  20c) eng=(--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20dev-c --engine-br); dir=$J/w20c ;;
  *) echo "side?"; exit 2 ;;
esac
/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh -w 24 || exit 3
echo "$(date +%T) avail=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) side=$side tag=$tag $*" >> $F/logs/runs-started.txt
cd $W && exec /srv/orthros/tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/openmw/place-load.mjs morrowind-goty-en --tree $W --warm-tree $W --scratch $dir --pristine $J/pristine --engines-dir $S/eng "${eng[@]}" --save $S/saves/-2_6.omwsave --runs 1 --tag "$tag" --out "$out" "$@"
```

```txt
PRE-REGISTERED PLAN — the fair validation of r20dev-c against the live r19 (written 2026-10-31 before the first run,
committed before it, not changed afterwards; the driver is scripts/val.sh)

Sides
  r19L  the LIVE openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r19 (engine f5eb3ec76d9b, data/engines read-only, draw thread off as shipped)
  r20c  openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20dev-c (engine c99235bfa872 = r1..r19 + orthros-r20.patch), --engine-br
  Both run this tree's page code (data-r15). Each side its own warm profile, reused from jspi5 (w19L, w20c: each made by
  its own warm-up in the fourth validation). Every run/server on its own copy of jspi5's pristine learned state (the live
  learned state and br-cache copied at 13:11), frozen br-cache. One browser at a time through tools/with-browser-slot.sh;
  each start's time, available memory and 1-minute load logged when the slot is granted (logs/runs-started.txt, "start"
  lines; "queued" lines when queued). Memory logged every 30 s (logs/memory.log); this task's jobs stopped under 16 GB.
  Order of the blocks: (1), then (2), then (3). Within a block, pair i: i odd -> r19L first, i even -> r20c first.

(1) Warm save, 6 runs a side (6 pairs)
  place-load.mjs --mode save --input-trace --input-block 2000 (a move every 50 ms, F9-free F13 every 1 s; the 2 s busy
  loop after the measured window checks the measure on every run)
  Criterion 1a: median over r20c's 6 runs of inputTrace.p95Ms <= median over r19L's 6 runs of inputTrace.p95Ms + 100 ms.
  Criterion 1b: F9 to the world (load.inWorldS): every r20c run <= the maximum of r19L's 6 runs + 0.15 s
                (r20c's spread no worse than live's spread + 0.15 s).

(2) In play, 16 runs a side (16 pairs)
  perf.mjs --query tier=mid --discard --seconds 60 --warm 0 (perf.sh: a server per run)
  Criterion 2a: fps median of r20c's 16 >= fps median of r19L's 16 - 0.3.
  Criterion 2b: work p99 median of r20c's 16 <= work p99 median of r19L's 16 + 0.5 ms.
  Computed over ALL 16 runs a side; no run dropped.

(3) New device, save, 4 runs a side (4 pairs)
  place-load.mjs --mode save --profile new --read-trace; each run started only while the 1-minute load is < 16
  (ORTHROS_LOAD_MAX=16 for the slot script: it waits otherwise; the load at the start is logged).
  Criterion 3a: menu (engineStart.menuS) median of r20c <= median of r19L + 0.3 s.
  Criterion 3b: F9 to the world (load.inWorldS) median of r20c <= median of r19L + 0.3 s.

Failed runs: a run that ends in an error, without a row, or (block 1) without inputTrace is reported as such; it is run
again once at the end of its block, same side, and the criteria use the completed runs (the failure is reported, and an
r20c page crash fails the crash criterion). No other run is added, dropped or repeated.

Verdict: SHIP only if 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b all hold, together with the fourth validation's criteria already met
(crashes, COE, 85 KB/s, pictures, two clients, lateOld, check.mjs, overlay-check, make test), which this plan does not rerun.
```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-fair-2026-10-31/validation/scripts/memlog.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# avail/load every 30 s; under 16 GB available: this task's own measuring jobs (node tools/openmw/*.mjs naming jspi5 or jspifair2 scratch) stopped
L=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspifair2/logs/memory.log
while true; do
  a=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')
  echo "$(date +%T) avail=${a}G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) disk=$(du -s /tmp/orthros-scratch 2>/dev/null | awk '{printf "%.1fG", $1/1048576}')" >> $L
  if [ "$a" -lt 16 ]; then
    for p in $(pgrep -f '^node tools/openmw/[^ ]*\.mjs .*orthros-scratch/(jspi5|jspifair2)'); do
      echo "$(date +%T) LOW MEMORY ${a}G: killing $p $(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | cut -c1-150)" >> $L; kill $p
    done
  fi
  sleep 30
done

```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-fair-2026-10-31/validation/scripts/perf.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: perf.sh <19L|20c> <port> <out dir> [perf.mjs options...]: a server of the tree on its own copy of jspi5's pristine learned state (frozen br-cache), that side's games folder (place-load's), perf.mjs through the browser slot, the server stopped
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19; J=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspi5; F=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspifair2; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
side=$1; port=$2; out=$3; shift 3
case $side in 19L) eng=openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r19 ;; 20c) eng=openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20dev-c ;; *) echo "side?"; exit 2 ;; esac
games=$J/w$side/games-$eng
run=$F/srv-$port; /bin/rm -rf $run; mkdir -p $run $out
cp -a $J/pristine/learn $run/learn
/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh -w 24 || exit 3
echo "$(date +%T) queued avail=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) perf side=$side $out $*" >> $F/logs/runs-started.txt
cd $W
node src/host/server.js --port $port --games-dir $games --engines-dir $S/eng --learn $run/learn --telemetry $run/tel --br-cache $J/pristine/brcache --br-cache-frozen --covers off --no-home-preload > $run/server.log 2>&1 &
srv=$!
for i in $(seq 60); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:$port/api/manifests >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
/srv/orthros/tools/with-browser-slot.sh $F/bin/start-log.sh "start perf $out" node tools/openmw/perf.mjs morrowind-goty-en --url http://127.0.0.1:$port --out $out "$@" > $out/perf.log 2>&1
rc=$?
kill $srv; wait $srv 2>/dev/null
cp $run/server.log $out/server.log; /bin/rm -rf $run; echo "perf rc=$rc $out"; tail -3 $out/perf.log

```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: pl.sh <19L|20c> <tag> <out jsonl> [place-load options...]: jspi5's warm profiles (each side its own) and pristine learned state copy, data-r19's engines folder and save
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19; J=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspi5; F=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspifair2; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
side=$1; tag=$2; out=$3; shift 3
case $side in
  19L) eng=(--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r19); dir=$J/w19L ;;
  20c) eng=(--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20dev-c --engine-br); dir=$J/w20c ;;
  *) echo "side?"; exit 2 ;;
esac
/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh -w 24 || exit 3
echo "$(date +%T) queued avail=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) place-load side=$side tag=$tag $* ${ORTHROS_LOAD_MAX:+loadmax=$ORTHROS_LOAD_MAX}" >> $F/logs/runs-started.txt
cd $W && exec /srv/orthros/tools/with-browser-slot.sh $F/bin/start-log.sh "start tag=$tag" node tools/openmw/place-load.mjs morrowind-goty-en --tree $W --warm-tree $W --scratch $dir --pristine $J/pristine --engines-dir $S/eng "${eng[@]}" --save $S/saves/-2_6.omwsave --runs 1 --tag "$tag" --out "$out" "$@"
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The fair validation's numbers and the pre-registered criteria (plan.txt). usage: summary.py <results dir>"""
import json, os, sys, glob, statistics as st
R = sys.argv[1]
def rows(f):
    p = os.path.join(R, f)
    return [json.loads(l) for l in open(p)] if os.path.exists(p) else []
def med(xs): xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]; return round(st.median(xs), 3) if xs else None
def each(xs): return '[' + ' '.join(str(x) for x in xs) + ']'
def ok(b): return 'MET' if b else 'NOT MET'
out = {}
for kind in ['save', 'saveNew']:
    for side in ['r19L', 'r20c']:
        Rw = rows(f'pl-{side}-{kind}.jsonl'); good = [r for r in Rw if not r.get('error')]
        it = [r.get('inputTrace') or {} for r in good]
        d = dict(tags=[r.get('tag') for r in Rw], errors=[str(r.get('error'))[:100] for r in Rw if r.get('error')],
                 menu=[(r.get('engineStart') or {}).get('menuS') for r in good], f9=[(r.get('load') or {}).get('inWorldS') for r in good],
                 steady=[(r.get('load') or {}).get('steadyS') for r in good],
                 p50=[i.get('p50Ms') for i in it], p95=[i.get('p95Ms') for i in it], mx=[i.get('maxMs') for i in it],
                 ev=[i.get('events') for i in it], mvp95=[((i.get('byKind') or {}).get('move') or {}).get('p95Ms') for i in it],
                 keyp95=[((i.get('byKind') or {}).get('key') or {}).get('p95Ms') for i in it],
                 car=[i.get('carriers') for i in it], byd=[i.get('byDispatch') for i in it], un=[i.get('unanswered') for i in it],
                 bfirst=[(i.get('block') or {}).get('firstMs') for i in it], bres=[((i.get('block') or {}).get('residual') or {}).get('max') for i in it],
                 bev=[(i.get('block') or {}).get('events') for i in it],
```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# The pre-registered fair validation (plan.txt): r20dev-c against the live r19, one browser at a time, alternating, order swapped every pair
F=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspifair2; R=$F/res; B=$F/bin
step() { echo "=== $(date +%T) $*"; }
pair() { if [ $(($1 % 2)) = 1 ]; then $2; $3; else $3; $2; fi; }
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
  step save $i; pair $i "$B/pl.sh 19L r19L-save-$i $R/pl-r19L-save.jsonl --mode save --input-trace --input-block 2000" "$B/pl.sh 20c r20c-save-$i $R/pl-r20c-save.jsonl --mode save --input-trace --input-block 2000"
done
P="--query tier=mid --discard --seconds 60 --warm 0"
for i in $(seq 1 16); do
  step perf $i; pair $i "$B/perf.sh 19L 18981 $R/perf/r19L-$i $P" "$B/perf.sh 20c 18982 $R/perf/r20c-$i $P"
done
for i in 1 2 3 4; do
  step new $i; pair $i "env ORTHROS_LOAD_MAX=16 $B/pl.sh 19L r19L-saveNew-$i $R/pl-r19L-saveNew.jsonl --mode save --profile new --read-trace" "env ORTHROS_LOAD_MAX=16 $B/pl.sh 20c r20c-saveNew-$i $R/pl-r20c-saveNew.jsonl --mode save --profile new --read-trace"
done
step VAL DONE
```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/scripts/memlog.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# avail/load every 30 s; under 16 GB available: this task's own measuring jobs (node tools/openmw/*.mjs naming jspi4 or data-r19/v3 scratch) stopped
L=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspi4/logs/memory.log
while true; do
  a=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')
  echo "$(date +%T) avail=${a}G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) disk=$(du -s /tmp/orthros-scratch 2>/dev/null | awk '{printf "%.1fG", $1/1048576}')" >> $L
  if [ "$a" -lt 16 ]; then
    for p in $(pgrep -f '^node tools/openmw/[^ ]*\.mjs .*(orthros-scratch/jspi4|orthros-scratch/data-r19/v3)'); do
      echo "$(date +%T) LOW MEMORY ${a}G: killing $p $(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | cut -c1-150)" >> $L; kill $p
    done
  fi
  sleep 30
done
```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/scripts/perfwatch.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: perfwatch.sh <runs dir> <out file> [seconds]: waits for a new run's marker request (proxy.jsonl), then records the busiest
# renderer's main thread with Linux perf (V8's --perf-basic-prof map: ORTHROS_CHROME_ARGS) for <seconds>
runs=$1; out=$2; secs=${3:-9}
before=$(ls $runs 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
for i in $(seq 900); do
  d=$(ls -td $runs/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  if [ -n "$d" ] && [ $(ls $runs | wc -l) -gt $before ] && zcat -f $d/proxy.jsonl 2>/dev/null | grep -q '__qa/mark'; then break; fi
  sleep 0.2
done
# (the renderer: the busiest chrome --type=renderer process now, of a browser on this run's profile)
scr=$(dirname $runs)
b=$(pgrep -f -- "--user-data-dir=$scr" | head -1)
desc() { for c in $(ps -o pid= --ppid $1); do echo $c; desc $c; done; }
pid=$(for c in $(desc $b); do ps -o pid=,pcpu=,args= -p $c; done | grep -- '--type=renderer' | sort -k2 -nr | head -1 | awk '{print $1}')
echo "$(date +%T) recording renderer $pid $secs s ($d)" >&2
perf record ${PERFG:-} -F 1999 -t $pid -o $out -- sleep $secs 2>&1 | tail -2 >&2
echo $pid > $out.pid

```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/scripts/phases.py`:

```py
# a warm save's phases from its read trace: the loading screen (key -> serial esm reads: waits, reads, suspensions, the
# engine's own work), the serial esm reads, after them to the world; usage: phases.py <run dir>...
import json,gzip,sys
for d in sys.argv[1:]:
  tr=json.load(gzip.open(d+'/read-trace.json.gz','rt')); k=tr['keyAt']; T=tr['trace']; w=tr.get('inWorldAt')
  esm=[e for e in T if e['t']>=k and e.get('k') in ('sync','late','spin') and (e.get('f') or '').endswith('Morrowind.esm') and e.get('ms',0)>=50]
  if not esm: print(d.split('/')[-1][:14],'no serial esm'); continue
  e0=esm[0]['t']-k; e1=esm[-1]['t']+esm[-1]['ms']-k
  ww=[e for e in T if e['t']>=k and e.get('k')=='wwait' and e['t']-k<e0]
  rd=[e for e in T if e['t']>=k and e.get('k') in ('sync','late','spin') and e['t']-k<e0]
  sus=[e for e in T if e.get('k')=='jspi' and e.get('ev')=='suspended' and k<=e['x'][1]<(w or 1e18)]
  pre={}; post={}
  for e in sus: (pre if e['x'][1]-k<e0 else post)[e['x'][0]]=(pre if e['x'][1]-k<e0 else post).get(e['x'][0],0)+e['x'][2]
  W=sum(e.get('ms',0) for e in ww); Rm=sum(e.get('ms',0) for e in rd)
  print(f"{d.split('/')[-1][:14]:14s} world {round(w-k) if w else None:>5} | load {round(e0):>5} waits {W:>5} reads {len(rd):>3}/{Rm:>4} work {round(e0-W-Rm-pre.get('breath',0)-pre.get('present',0)-pre.get('settle',0)):>5} | esm {round(e1-e0):>5} | after {round(w-k-e1) if w else None:>5} susp {({a:round(b) for a,b in post.items() if b>=1})}")

```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/scripts/profcat.py`:

```py
# a place-load CPU profile's self time from the key to the world, by category: idle, (program), wasm, GC, the page's JS by file, natives
import json,gzip,sys,collections
d=sys.argv[1]; at=float(sys.argv[2])
p=json.load(open(d+'/load.cpuprofile')); tr=json.load(gzip.open(d+'/read-trace.json.gz','rt')); k=tr['keyAt']; w=tr.get('inWorldAt') or k+6000
lo=float(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 0; hi=float(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv)>4 else (w-k)
nodes={n['id']:n for n in p['nodes']}
c=collections.Counter(); acc=p['startTime']; ts=[]
for dt in p['timeDeltas']: acc+=dt; ts.append(acc)
for i,(sid,tt) in enumerate(zip(p['samples'],ts)):
  pt=at+(tt-p['startTime'])/1000-k
  if pt<lo or pt>hi: continue
  dt=(ts[i+1]-tt)/1000 if i+1<len(ts) else 0
  cf=nodes[sid]['callFrame']; f=cf['functionName']; u=cf.get('url','').split('/')[-1]
  cat=f if f in ('(idle)','(program)','(garbage collector)') else 'wasm' if u.endswith('.wasm') else ('js:'+u) if u else ('native:'+f)
  c[cat]+=dt
print(d.split('/')[-1][:14], f'{lo:.0f}-{hi:.0f} ms', ', '.join(f'{k} {v:.0f}' for k,v in c.most_common(14)))

```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/scripts/profwin.py`:

```py
# a place-load CPU profile split by the engine's state: suspended (the trace's 'suspended' spans) or running, from the key to the world
# usage: profwin.py <run dir> [at]  — self time by function (url-file:function), top 25 each
import json,gzip,sys,collections
d=sys.argv[1]
p=json.load(open(d+'/load.cpuprofile'))
tr=json.load(gzip.open(d+'/read-trace.json.gz','rt')); k=tr['keyAt']; w=tr.get('inWorldAt') or k+6000
at=float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else None
nodes={n['id']:n for n in p['nodes']}
parent={}
for n in p['nodes']:
  for c in n.get('children',[]): parent[c]=n['id']
def name(n):
  cf=n['callFrame']; u=cf.get('url','').split('/')[-1]
  return (u+':' if u else '')+(cf['functionName'] or '(anon)')
sus=[(e['x'][1],e['x'][1]+e['x'][2],e['x'][0]) for e in tr['trace'] if e.get('k')=='jspi' and e.get('ev')=='suspended']
t=p['startTime']; base=at if at is not None else None
# page time of the profile start: the place-load row's cpuProfile.at
if base is None:
  for l in open(sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv)>3 else '/dev/null'): pass
ts=[]; acc=t
for dt in p['timeDeltas']: acc+=dt; ts.append(acc)
agg={'susp':collections.Counter(),'run':collections.Counter()}; tot={'susp':0,'run':0}
for i,(sid,tt) in enumerate(zip(p['samples'],ts)):
  pt=base+(tt-t)/1000
  if pt<k or pt>w: continue
  dt=(ts[i+1]-tt)/1000 if i+1<len(ts) else 0
  s='susp' if any(a<=pt<b for a,b,_ in sus) else 'run'
  agg[s][name(nodes[sid])]+=dt; tot[s]+=dt
for s in agg:
  print(f'== {s} {tot[s]:.0f} ms')
  for f,ms in agg[s].most_common(25): print(f'  {ms:7.1f} {f}')

```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/scripts/summary4.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The iteration-4 numbers by side (r19L = the live r19, r20b = r20dev-b): place-load rows (<R>/pl-<side>-<kind>.jsonl),
perf.json files (<R>/perf/<side>-N/), the two-client runs (<R>/mp/<side>-N/). usage: summary4.py <results dir> [sides]"""
import json, os, sys, glob, statistics
R = sys.argv[1]; SIDES = sys.argv[2].split(',') if len(sys.argv) > 2 else ['r19L', 'r20b']
def rows(f):
    p = os.path.join(R, f)
    return [json.loads(l) for l in open(p)] if os.path.exists(p) else []
def rng(xs):
    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    if not xs: return '-'
    s = f'{min(xs)}' if min(xs) == max(xs) else f'{min(xs)}-{max(xs)}'
    return s + (f' med {round(statistics.median(xs), 3)}' if len(xs) > 2 else '') + f' ({len(xs)})'
def each(xs): return '[' + ' '.join(str(x) for x in xs) + ']'
for kind in ['save', 'coe', 'saveNew', 'save85k', 'forced', 'glide85k']:
    for side in SIDES:
        Rw = rows(f'pl-{side}-{kind}.jsonl')
        if not Rw: continue
        J = [r.get('jspiProbe') or {} for r in Rw]
        A = [r.get('jspiAfter') or {} for r in Rw]
        E = [(j.get('engine') or {}) for j in J]
        inW = [(r.get('load') or {}).get('inWorldS') for r in Rw]
        print(f'{kind:8} {side:4}: tags {each([r.get("tag") for r in Rw])}\n'
              f'   menu {rng([(r.get("engineStart") or {}).get("menuS") for r in Rw])}  firstFrame {rng([(r.get("engineStart") or {}).get("firstFrameS") for r in Rw])}'
              f'  inWorld(key->world) {rng(inW)} each {each(inW)}  steady {rng([(r.get("load") or {}).get("steadyS") for r in Rw])}\n'
              f'   block {rng([j.get("blockMaxMs") for j in J])}  input p50 {rng([j.get("inputP50Ms") for j in J])} p95 {rng([j.get("inputP95Ms") for j in J])}'
              f'  freeze(frameGapMax) {rng([j.get("frameGapMaxMs") for j in J])}  after-gap {rng([a.get("frameGapMaxMs") for a in A])}\n'
              f'   lateOld {rng([(r.get("precompile") or {}).get("lateOld") for r in Rw])}  timeouts {rng([((r.get("stage3") or {}).get("load") or {}).get("timeouts") for r in Rw])}'
              f'  suspended {rng([e.get("suspendedMs") for e in E])}  faults {sum(len(r.get("faults") or []) for r in Rw)} errors {sum(1 for r in Rw if r.get("error"))}')
for side in SIDES:
    P = []
    for d in sorted((d for d in glob.glob(os.path.join(R, 'perf', f'{side}-*')) if d.rsplit('-', 1)[1].isdigit()), key=lambda d: int(d.rsplit('-', 1)[1])):
        f = os.path.join(d, 'perf.json')
        if os.path.exists(f): P.append((os.path.basename(d), json.load(open(f))))
    if P:
        p99 = [p["work"]["p99"] for _, p in P]; fps = [p.get("fps") for _, p in P]
        print(f'play     {side:4}: runs {len(P)}  fps {rng(fps)} each {each(fps)}\n   work p99 {rng(p99)} each {each(p99)}  p50 {rng([p["work"]["p50"] for _, p in P])}'
              f'  longest gap {rng([p["gap"]["max"] for _, p in P])}  stalls/min {rng([p.get("dataStallMs") for _, p in P])}')
for side in SIDES:
    out = []
    for d in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(R, 'mp', f'{side}-*'))):
        r = os.path.join(d, 'result.json')
        if os.path.exists(r):
            j = json.load(open(r)); out.append(f'{os.path.basename(d)}:{j.get("pass", j.get("ok"))}')
        else: out.append(f'{os.path.basename(d)}:?')
    if out: print(f'mp       {side:4}: ' + ' '.join(out))
```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/scripts/trsum.py`:

```py
# a place-load browser trace: busy time by 100 ms of the renderer's main thread, the GPU main thread (and what ran there:
# top-level task names), and the renderer's long tasks; time 0 = the trace's first renderer main-thread task
import json,gzip,collections,sys
D=sys.argv[1]; t=json.load(gzip.open(D+'/load.trace.json.gz','rt')); ev=t['traceEvents'] if isinstance(t,dict) else t
pn={}; tn={}
for e in ev:
  if e.get('ph')=='M' and e['name']=='process_name': pn[e['pid']]=e['args']['name']
  if e.get('ph')=='M' and e['name']=='thread_name': tn[(e['pid'],e['tid'])]=e['args']['name']
def th(name, proc):
  return [k for k,v in tn.items() if v==name and pn.get(k[0])==proc]
rm=th('CrRendererMain','Renderer'); gm=th('CrGpuMain','GPU Process'); vz=th('VizCompositorThread','GPU Process')
X=[e for e in ev if e.get('ph')=='X' and 'dur' in e]
def top(k):
  es=sorted([e for e in X if (e['pid'],e['tid']) in k], key=lambda e:(e['ts'],-e['dur'])); out=[]; end=-1
  for e in es:
    if e['ts']>=end: out.append(e); end=e['ts']+e['dur']
  return out
R=top(rm); G=top(gm); V=top(vz)
t0=min(e['ts'] for e in R)
print('renderer long tasks (>80 ms): start s, ms, name')
for e in R:
  if e['dur']>80000: print(f"  {(e['ts']-t0)/1e6:6.2f} {e['dur']/1000:6.0f} {e['name']}")
B=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 250
def buckets(L):
  b=collections.Counter()
  for e in L:
    s=e['ts']-t0; d=e['dur']
    while d>0:
      i=int(s//(B*1000)); n=min(d,(i+1)*B*1000-s); b[i]+=n; s+=n; d-=n
  return b
br=buckets(R); bg=buckets(G); bv=buckets(V)
names=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
for e in G: names[int((e['ts']-t0)//(B*1000))][e['name']]+=e['dur']
print(f'per {B} ms: renderer main busy %, GPU main busy %, viz %, GPU top tasks')
for i in range(0, max(list(br)+list(bg))+1):
  print(f"  {i*B/1000:5.2f}  R{100*br[i]/(B*1000):4.0f}%  G{100*bg[i]/(B*1000):4.0f}%  V{100*bv[i]/(B*1000):4.0f}%  ", ', '.join(f"{n.split('::')[-1][:28]}:{v/1000:.0f}" for n,v in names[i].most_common(3)))

```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/scripts/val4.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Iteration 4: r20dev-b (r1..r19 + orthros-r20.patch + r20x-b.patch) against the LIVE r19 (data/engines, read-only, its
# draw thread off as shipped), interleaved (order alternated every pair), one browser at a time; each side its own warm
# profile made by its own warm-up; servers on copies of v3/pristine (live learned state + frozen br-cache, lean 2c6b8e83)
J=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspi4; R=$J/res/val; B=$J/bin
mkdir -p $R/perf $R/mp
step() { echo "=== $(date +%T) $*"; }
pair() { if [ $(($1 % 2)) = 1 ]; then $2; $3; else $3; $2; fi; }
[ -d $J/w20b/profile-warm ] || { step warm-up 20b; $B/pl.sh 20b r20b-warm $R/pl-r20b-warm.jsonl --mode save --warm-only; }
for i in 1 2 3 4; do
  step save $i; pair $i "$B/pl.sh 19L r19L-save-$i $R/pl-r19L-save.jsonl --mode save --read-trace" "$B/pl.sh 20b r20b-save-$i $R/pl-r20b-save.jsonl --mode save --read-trace"
  step coe $i;  pair $((i+1)) "$B/pl.sh 19L r19L-coe-$i $R/pl-r19L-coe.jsonl --mode coe" "$B/pl.sh 20b r20b-coe-$i $R/pl-r20b-coe.jsonl --mode coe"
done
P="--query tier=mid --discard --seconds 60 --warm 0"
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
  step perf $i; pair $i "$B/perf.sh 19L 18971 $R/perf/r19L-$i $P" "$B/perf.sh 20b 18972 $R/perf/r20b-$i $P"
done
for i in 1 2 3; do
  step new $i; pair $i "$B/pl.sh 19L r19L-saveNew-$i $R/pl-r19L-saveNew.jsonl --mode save --profile new --read-trace" "$B/pl.sh 20b r20b-saveNew-$i $R/pl-r20b-saveNew.jsonl --mode save --profile new --read-trace"
done
for i in 1 2; do
  step 85k $i; pair $i "$B/pl.sh 19L r19L-save85k-$i $R/pl-r19L-save85k.jsonl --mode save --rate 85k --read-trace" "$B/pl.sh 20b r20b-save85k-$i $R/pl-r20b-save85k.jsonl --mode save --rate 85k --read-trace"
done
step VAL4 DONE

```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# the full validation's evidence into the worktree (jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/validation-full/)
J=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspi5; R=$J/res; O=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15/tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/validation-full
mkdir -p $O/scripts $O/logs $O/runs $O/perf $O/mp $O/check
cp $J/bin/*.sh $J/bin/*.py $O/scripts/
cp $J/logs/runs-started.txt $J/pristine/copied-at.txt $O/logs/; for f in $J/logs/*.log; do gzip -c $f > $O/logs/$(basename $f).gz; done
cp $R/*.jsonl $R/overlay-check-*.txt $O/ 2>/dev/null
grep -E "^ℹ|^# (tests|pass|fail)" $R/make-test.log > $O/make-test-summary.txt
for p in $R/perf/*/; do n=$(basename $p); mkdir -p $O/perf/$n; cp $p/perf.json $O/perf/$n/ 2>/dev/null; gzip -c $p/perf.log > $O/perf/$n/perf.log.gz; done
for m in $R/mp/*/; do n=$(basename $m); mkdir -p $O/mp/$n; cp $m/result.json $m/run.log $O/mp/$n/ 2>/dev/null; cp $m/*.gz $O/mp/$n/ 2>/dev/null; done
for c in en fr; do [ -f $R/check-$c/tool.log ] && cp $R/check-$c/tool.log $O/check/$c.log; done
if [ -d $R/fc ]; then mkdir -p $O/frame-compare; cp $R/fc/tool.log $O/frame-compare/; cp $R/fc/out/*.json $O/frame-compare/ 2>/dev/null; fi
for d in $J/w19L/runs/* $J/w20c/runs/*; do [ -d $d ] && { mkdir -p $O/runs/$(basename $d); cp $d/*.gz $O/runs/$(basename $d)/ 2>/dev/null; [ -f $d/console.log ] && gzip -c $d/console.log > $O/runs/$(basename $d)/console.log.gz; }; done
python3 -I $J/bin/summary5.py $R > $O/summary.txt
python3 -I $J/bin/phases.py $(ls -d $J/w19L/runs/*save-* $J/w20c/runs/*save-* | grep -v saveNew | grep -v forced | grep -v 85k) >> $O/summary.txt 2>&1
du -sh $O
```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/validation-full/scripts/memlog.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# avail/load every 30 s; under 16 GB available: this task's own measuring jobs (node tools/openmw/*.mjs naming jspi5 or data-r19/v3 scratch) stopped
L=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspi5/logs/memory.log
while true; do
  a=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')
  echo "$(date +%T) avail=${a}G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) disk=$(du -s /tmp/orthros-scratch 2>/dev/null | awk '{printf "%.1fG", $1/1048576}')" >> $L
  if [ "$a" -lt 16 ]; then
    for p in $(pgrep -f '^node tools/openmw/[^ ]*\.mjs .*orthros-scratch/jspi5'); do
      echo "$(date +%T) LOW MEMORY ${a}G: killing $p $(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | cut -c1-150)" >> $L; kill $p
    done
  fi
  sleep 30
done

```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/validation-full/scripts/perf.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
```
```sh
# usage: perf.sh <side 19L|20b> <port> <out dir> [perf.mjs options...]: a server of the tree (fresh learn copy of v3/pristine,
# frozen br-cache) on that side's scratch games folder (place-load's), the tool through the browser slot with --url, the server stopped
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19; V=$S/v3; J=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspi5; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
side=$1; port=$2; out=$3; tool=perf; shift 3
case $side in 19L) eng=openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r19 ;; 20*) eng=openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20dev-${side#20} ;; esac
games=$J/w$side/games-$eng
run=$J/srv-$port; /bin/rm -rf $run; mkdir -p $run $out
cp -a $J/pristine/learn $run/learn
/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh -w 24 || exit 3
echo "$(date +%T) avail=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) $tool $side $out $*" >> $J/logs/runs-started.txt
cd $W
node src/host/server.js --port $port --games-dir $games --engines-dir $S/eng --learn $run/learn --telemetry $run/tel --br-cache $J/pristine/brcache --br-cache-frozen --covers off --no-home-preload > $run/server.log 2>&1 &
srv=$!
for i in $(seq 60); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:$port/api/manifests >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
/srv/orthros/tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/openmw/perf.mjs morrowind-goty-en --url http://127.0.0.1:$port --out $out "$@" > $out/perf.log 2>&1
rc=$?
kill $srv; wait $srv 2>/dev/null
cp $run/server.log $out/server.log; /bin/rm -rf $run; tail -3 $out/perf.log

```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/validation-full/scripts/phases.py`:

```py
# a warm save's phases from its read trace: the loading screen (key -> serial esm reads: waits, reads, suspensions, the
# engine's own work), the serial esm reads, after them to the world; usage: phases.py <run dir>...
import json,gzip,sys
for d in sys.argv[1:]:
  tr=json.load(gzip.open(d+'/read-trace.json.gz','rt')); k=tr['keyAt']; T=tr['trace']; w=tr.get('inWorldAt')
  esm=[e for e in T if e['t']>=k and e.get('k') in ('sync','late','spin') and (e.get('f') or '').endswith('Morrowind.esm') and e.get('ms',0)>=50]
  if not esm: print(d.split('/')[-1][:14],'no serial esm'); continue
  e0=esm[0]['t']-k; e1=esm[-1]['t']+esm[-1]['ms']-k
  ww=[e for e in T if e['t']>=k and e.get('k')=='wwait' and e['t']-k<e0]
  rd=[e for e in T if e['t']>=k and e.get('k') in ('sync','late','spin') and e['t']-k<e0]
  sus=[e for e in T if e.get('k')=='jspi' and e.get('ev')=='suspended' and k<=e['x'][1]<(w or 1e18)]
  pre={}; post={}
  for e in sus: (pre if e['x'][1]-k<e0 else post)[e['x'][0]]=(pre if e['x'][1]-k<e0 else post).get(e['x'][0],0)+e['x'][2]
  W=sum(e.get('ms',0) for e in ww); Rm=sum(e.get('ms',0) for e in rd)
  print(f"{d.split('/')[-1][:14]:14s} world {round(w-k) if w else None:>5} | load {round(e0):>5} waits {W:>5} reads {len(rd):>3}/{Rm:>4} work {round(e0-W-Rm-pre.get('breath',0)-pre.get('present',0)-pre.get('settle',0)):>5} | esm {round(e1-e0):>5} | after {round(w-k-e1) if w else None:>5} susp {({a:round(b) for a,b in post.items() if b>=1})}")

```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/validation-full/scripts/pl.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: pl.sh <side: 18 | 19a | 19L (the live r19) | 20b (r20dev-b)...> <tag> <out jsonl> [place-load options...]: each side its own scratch and warm profile (v3/w18, v3/w19a, jspi4/w19<x>), made by its own warm-up
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19; V=$S/v3; J=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspi5; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
side=$1; tag=$2; out=$3; shift 3
case $side in
  18) eng=(--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r18); dir=$V/w18 ;;
  19a) eng=(--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r19dev-a --engine-br); dir=$V/w19a ;;
  19L) eng=(--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r19); dir=$J/w19L ;;
  20*) eng=(--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20dev-${side#20} --engine-br); dir=$J/w$side ;;
  19*) eng=(--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r19dev-${side#19} --engine-br); dir=$J/w$side ;;
  *) echo "side?"; exit 2 ;;
esac
/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh -w 24 || exit 3
echo "$(date +%T) avail=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) place-load side=$side tag=$tag $* ${ORTHROS_CHROME_ARGS:+chrome-args=$ORTHROS_CHROME_ARGS} ${ORTHROS_PLACE_PROFILE:+profile}" >> $J/logs/runs-started.txt
cd $W && exec /srv/orthros/tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/openmw/place-load.mjs morrowind-goty-en --tree $W --warm-tree $W --scratch $dir --pristine $J/pristine --engines-dir $S/eng "${eng[@]}" --save $S/saves/-2_6.omwsave --runs 1 --tag "$tag" --out "$out" "$@"
```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/validation-full/scripts/srvrun.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: srvrun.sh <side 19L|20b> <port> <out dir> <tool script> [args...]: a server of the tree (fresh learn copy of v3/pristine,
# frozen br-cache) on that side's scratch games folder (place-load's), the tool through the browser slot with --url, the server stopped
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19; V=$S/v3; J=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspi5; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
side=$1; port=$2; out=$3; tool=$4; shift 4
case $side in 19L) eng=openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r19 ;; 20*) eng=openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20dev-${side#20} ;; esac
games=$J/w$side/games-$eng
run=$J/srv-$port; /bin/rm -rf $run; mkdir -p $run $out
cp -a $J/pristine/learn $run/learn
/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh -w 24 || exit 3
echo "$(date +%T) avail=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) $tool $side $out $*" >> $J/logs/runs-started.txt
cd $W
node src/host/server.js --port $port --games-dir $games --engines-dir $S/eng --learn $run/learn --telemetry $run/tel --br-cache $J/pristine/brcache --br-cache-frozen --covers off --no-home-preload > $run/server.log 2>&1 &
srv=$!
for i in $(seq 60); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:$port/api/manifests >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
/srv/orthros/tools/with-browser-slot.sh node $tool morrowind-goty-en --url http://127.0.0.1:$port "$@" > $out/tool.log 2>&1
rc=$?
kill $srv; wait $srv 2>/dev/null
cp $run/server.log $out/server.log; /bin/rm -rf $run
echo "$tool rc=$rc $out" | tee -a $out/tool.log

```

`tools/openmw/results/jspi-iter4-2026-10-31/validation-full/scripts/summary4.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The iteration-4 numbers by side (r19L = the live r19, r20b = r20dev-b): place-load rows (<R>/pl-<side>-<kind>.jsonl),
perf.json files (<R>/perf/<side>-N/), the two-client runs (<R>/mp/<side>-N/). usage: summary4.py <results dir> [sides]"""
import json, os, sys, glob, statistics
R = sys.argv[1]; SIDES = sys.argv[2].split(',') if len(sys.argv) > 2 else ['r19L', 'r20b']
def rows(f):
    p = os.path.join(R, f)
    return [json.loads(l) for l in open(p)] if os.path.exists(p) else []
def rng(xs):
    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    if not xs: return '-'
    s = f'{min(xs)}' if min(xs) == max(xs) else f'{min(xs)}-{max(xs)}'
    return s + (f' med {round(statistics.median(xs), 3)}' if len(xs) > 2 else '') + f' ({len(xs)})'
def each(xs): return '[' + ' '.join(str(x) for x in xs) + ']'
for kind in ['save', 'coe', 'saveNew', 'save85k', 'forced', 'glide85k']:
    for side in SIDES:
        Rw = rows(f'pl-{side}-{kind}.jsonl')
        if not Rw: continue
        J = [r.get('jspiProbe') or {} for r in Rw]
        A = [r.get('jspiAfter') or {} for r in Rw]
        E = [(j.get('engine') or {}) for j in J]
        inW = [(r.get('load') or {}).get('inWorldS') for r in Rw]
        print(f'{kind:8} {side:4}: tags {each([r.get("tag") for r in Rw])}\n'
              f'   menu {rng([(r.get("engineStart") or {}).get("menuS") for r in Rw])}  firstFrame {rng([(r.get("engineStart") or {}).get("firstFrameS") for r in Rw])}'
              f'  inWorld(key->world) {rng(inW)} each {each(inW)}  steady {rng([(r.get("load") or {}).get("steadyS") for r in Rw])}\n'
              f'   block {rng([j.get("blockMaxMs") for j in J])}  input p50 {rng([j.get("inputP50Ms") for j in J])} p95 {rng([j.get("inputP95Ms") for j in J])}'
              f'  freeze(frameGapMax) {rng([j.get("frameGapMaxMs") for j in J])}  after-gap {rng([a.get("frameGapMaxMs") for a in A])}\n'
              f'   lateOld {rng([(r.get("precompile") or {}).get("lateOld") for r in Rw])}  timeouts {rng([((r.get("stage3") or {}).get("load") or {}).get("timeouts") for r in Rw])}'
              f'  suspended {rng([e.get("suspendedMs") for e in E])}  faults {sum(len(r.get("faults") or []) for r in Rw)} errors {sum(1 for r in Rw if r.get("error"))}')
for side in SIDES:
    P = []
    for d in sorted((d for d in glob.glob(os.path.join(R, 'perf', f'{side}-*')) if d.rsplit('-', 1)[1].isdigit()), key=lambda d: int(d.rsplit('-', 1)[1])):
        f = os.path.join(d, 'perf.json')
        if os.path.exists(f): P.append((os.path.basename(d), json.load(open(f))))
    if P:
        p99 = [p["work"]["p99"] for _, p in P]; fps = [p.get("fps") for _, p in P]
        print(f'play     {side:4}: runs {len(P)}  fps {rng(fps)} each {each(fps)}\n   work p99 {rng(p99)} each {each(p99)}  p50 {rng([p["work"]["p50"] for _, p in P])}'
              f'  longest gap {rng([p["gap"]["max"] for _, p in P])}  stalls/min {rng([p.get("dataStallMs") for _, p in P])}')
for side in SIDES:
    out = []
    for d in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(R, 'mp', f'{side}-*'))):
        r = os.path.join(d, 'result.json')
        if os.path.exists(r):
            j = json.load(open(r)); out.append(f'{os.path.basename(d)}:{j.get("pass", j.get("ok"))}')
        else: out.append(f'{os.path.basename(d)}:?')
    if out: print(f'mp       {side:4}: ' + ' '.join(out))

```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The full validation's numbers by side (r19L = the live r19, r20c = r20dev-c; play = the 8 primary pairs, play+ = the 4 supplementary ones, saveNewB = the 2 supplementary new-device pairs): place-load rows (<R>/pl-<side>-<kind>.jsonl),
perf.json files (<R>/perf/<side>-N/), the two-client runs (<R>/mp/<side>-N/). usage: summary4.py <results dir> [sides]"""
import json, os, sys, glob, statistics
R = sys.argv[1]; SIDES = sys.argv[2].split(',') if len(sys.argv) > 2 else ['r19L', 'r20c']
def rows(f):
    p = os.path.join(R, f)
    return [json.loads(l) for l in open(p)] if os.path.exists(p) else []
def rng(xs):
    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    if not xs: return '-'
    s = f'{min(xs)}' if min(xs) == max(xs) else f'{min(xs)}-{max(xs)}'
    return s + (f' med {round(statistics.median(xs), 3)}' if len(xs) > 2 else '') + f' ({len(xs)})'
def each(xs): return '[' + ' '.join(str(x) for x in xs) + ']'
for kind in ['save', 'coe', 'saveNew', 'saveNewB', 'save85k', 'forced', 'glide85k']:
    for side in SIDES:
        Rw = rows(f'pl-{side}-{kind}.jsonl')
        if not Rw: continue
        J = [r.get('jspiProbe') or {} for r in Rw]
        A = [r.get('jspiAfter') or {} for r in Rw]
        E = [(j.get('engine') or {}) for j in J]
        inW = [(r.get('load') or {}).get('inWorldS') for r in Rw]
        print(f'{kind:8} {side:4}: tags {each([r.get("tag") for r in Rw])}\n'
              f'   menu {rng([(r.get("engineStart") or {}).get("menuS") for r in Rw])}  firstFrame {rng([(r.get("engineStart") or {}).get("firstFrameS") for r in Rw])}'
              f'  inWorld(key->world) {rng(inW)} each {each(inW)}  steady {rng([(r.get("load") or {}).get("steadyS") for r in Rw])}\n'
              f'   block {rng([j.get("blockMaxMs") for j in J])}  input p50 {rng([j.get("inputP50Ms") for j in J])} p95 {rng([j.get("inputP95Ms") for j in J])}'
              f' [moves {rng([j.get("inputs") for j in J])}] cadence p95 {rng([j.get("cadenceP95Ms") for j in J])}'
              f'  freeze(frameGapMax) {rng([j.get("frameGapMaxMs") for j in J])}  after-gap {rng([a.get("frameGapMaxMs") for a in A])}\n'
              f'   lateOld {rng([(r.get("precompile") or {}).get("lateOld") for r in Rw])}  timeouts {rng([((r.get("stage3") or {}).get("load") or {}).get("timeouts") for r in Rw])}'
              f'  suspended {rng([e.get("suspendedMs") for e in E])}  faults {sum(len(r.get("faults") or []) for r in Rw)} errors {sum(1 for r in Rw if r.get("error"))} {[str(r.get("error"))[:80] for r in Rw if r.get("error")]}')
for label, lo, hi in [('play', 1, 8), ('play+', 9, 99), ('playAll', 1, 99)]:
  for side in SIDES:
    P = []
    for d in sorted((d for d in glob.glob(os.path.join(R, 'perf', f'{side}-*')) if d.rsplit('-', 1)[1].isdigit() and lo <= int(d.rsplit('-', 1)[1]) <= hi), key=lambda d: int(d.rsplit('-', 1)[1])):
        f = os.path.join(d, 'perf.json')
        if os.path.exists(f): P.append((os.path.basename(d), json.load(open(f))))
    if P:
        p99 = [p["work"]["p99"] for _, p in P]; fps = [p.get("fps") for _, p in P]
        print(f'{label:8} {side:4}: runs {len(P)}  fps {rng(fps)} each {each(fps)}\n   work p99 {rng(p99)} each {each(p99)}  p50 {rng([p["work"]["p50"] for _, p in P])}'
              f'  longest gap {rng([p["gap"]["max"] for _, p in P])}  stalls/min {rng([p.get("dataStallMs") for _, p in P])}')
for side in SIDES:
    out = []
    for d in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(R, 'mp', f'{side}-*'))):
        r = os.path.join(d, 'result.json')
        if os.path.exists(r):
            j = json.load(open(r)); out.append(f'{os.path.basename(d)}:{j.get("pass", j.get("ok"))}')
        else: out.append(f'{os.path.basename(d)}:?')
    if out: print(f'mp       {side:4}: ' + ' '.join(out))
```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Iteration-5 full validation: r20dev-c (engine c99235bfa872 = r1..r19 + orthros-r20.patch as committed at 09fa36b, but
# for a write-only debug field) against the LIVE r19 (data/engines read-only, f5eb3ec76d9b, draw thread off as shipped),
# interleaved (order swapped every pair), one browser at a time through the slot script; each side its own warm profile
# made by its own warm-up; every server on its own copy of jspi5/pristine (the live learned state and br-cache copied at
# 13:11, br-cache frozen: lean3 of the one package 2c6b8e83 both engines' openmw.data share)
J=/tmp/orthros-scratch/jspi5; R=$J/res; B=$J/bin; S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
E20=openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20dev-c
mkdir -p $R/perf $R/mp
step() { echo "=== $(date +%T) $*"; }
pair() { if [ $(($1 % 2)) = 1 ]; then $2; $3; else $3; $2; fi; }
FORCED='--memlog=all-renderers --memlog-sampling-rate=100000 --memlog-stack-mode=native'
step warm-ups
[ -d $J/w19L/profile-warm ] || $B/pl.sh 19L r19L-warm $R/pl-r19L-warm.jsonl --mode save --warm-only
[ -d $J/w20c/profile-warm ] || $B/pl.sh 20c r20c-warm $R/pl-r20c-warm.jsonl --mode save --warm-only
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  step save $i; pair $i "$B/pl.sh 19L r19L-save-$i $R/pl-r19L-save.jsonl --mode save --read-trace" "$B/pl.sh 20c r20c-save-$i $R/pl-r20c-save.jsonl --mode save --read-trace"
  step coe $i;  pair $((i+1)) "$B/pl.sh 19L r19L-coe-$i $R/pl-r19L-coe.jsonl --mode coe" "$B/pl.sh 20c r20c-coe-$i $R/pl-r20c-coe.jsonl --mode coe"
done
P="--query tier=mid --discard --seconds 60 --warm 0"
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
  step perf $i; pair $i "$B/perf.sh 19L 18971 $R/perf/r19L-$i $P" "$B/perf.sh 20c 18972 $R/perf/r20c-$i $P"
done
for i in 1 2 3 4; do
  step new $i; pair $i "$B/pl.sh 19L r19L-saveNew-$i $R/pl-r19L-saveNew.jsonl --mode save --profile new --read-trace" "$B/pl.sh 20c r20c-saveNew-$i $R/pl-r20c-saveNew.jsonl --mode save --profile new --read-trace"
done
for i in 1 2; do
  step 85k $i; pair $i "$B/pl.sh 19L r19L-save85k-$i $R/pl-r19L-save85k.jsonl --mode save --rate 85k --read-trace" "$B/pl.sh 20c r20c-save85k-$i $R/pl-r20c-save85k.jsonl --mode save --rate 85k --read-trace"
done
step frame-compare; $B/srvrun.sh 20c 18965 $R/fc tools/openmw/frame-compare.mjs --variant '' --variant jspi=0 --out $R/fc/out
step check; $B/srvrun.sh 20c 18966 $R/check-en tools/openmw/check.mjs --seconds 10; $B/srvrun.sh 20c 18967 $R/check-fr tools/openmw/check.mjs --lang fr --seconds 10
step overlay
for g in morrowind morrowind-vanilla-plus; do (cd $W && node tools/openmw/overlay-check.mjs /srv/orthros/data/games/$g/manifest.json --engines-dir $S/eng --engine $E20) > $R/overlay-check-$g.txt 2>&1; echo "overlay $g rc=$?" | tee -a $R/overlay-check-$g.txt; done
step mp
$B/mp.sh 20c $R/mp/r20c-1; $B/mp.sh 19L $R/mp/r19L-1; $B/mp.sh 20c $R/mp/r20c-2; $B/mp.sh 20c $R/mp/r20c-3; $B/mp.sh 19L $R/mp/r19L-2; $B/mp.sh 20c $R/mp/r20c-4
step forced
ORTHROS_CHROME_ARGS="$FORCED" $B/pl.sh 20c r20c-forced-save $R/pl-r20c-forced.jsonl --mode save
ORTHROS_CHROME_ARGS="$FORCED" $B/pl.sh 20c r20c-forced-coe $R/pl-r20c-forced.jsonl --mode coe
step VAL5 DONE
```

```mjs
  result.seconds = Math.round((Date.now() - t0) / 1000);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(S, 'result.json'), JSON.stringify(result, null, 1));
  if (browser) await browser.close().catch(() => {});
  for (const k of kids.reverse()) { if (k.exitCode === null) { k.kill('SIGTERM'); await new Promise((r) => { k.once('exit', r); setTimeout(r, 15000); }); } }
  if (games) clearScratchGames(games.out);
  log('RESULT', JSON.stringify({ ok: result.ok, checks: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(result.checks).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.ok])) }));
}
```

`tools/openmw/results/r17-2026-10-30/validation/frame-compare/xcmp.py`:

```py
# r16's reference captures against r17's: per view, the mean of the 4 frames each side (as frame-compare averages),
# then the mean absolute difference (0-255) and the share of pixels over 24 in a channel
import sys
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
a,b=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]
def avg(d,view,tag):
    return np.mean([np.asarray(Image.open(f'{d}/{view}-{tag}-{i}.png').convert('RGB'),dtype=np.float64) for i in range(4)],axis=0)
for view in ('day','night','interior'):
    out={}
    for name,(x,y) in {'r16 vs r17':(avg(a,view,'ref'),avg(b,view,'ref')),'r16 noise':(avg(a,view,'ref'),avg(a,view,'ref2')),'r17 noise':(avg(b,view,'ref'),avg(b,view,'ref2'))}.items():
        d=np.abs(x-y); out[name]=(round(d.mean(),3), round(100*(d.max(axis=2)>24).mean(),2))
    print(view, out)

```

`tools/openmw/results/r18-2026-10-30/an/build-b.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# dev build: name in $1, patch in $2 (r1..r17 + that r18)
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r18; O=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r17; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
name=$1; patch=$2
( while true; do echo "$(date +%T) avail=$(free -g | awk '/^Mem/{print $7}') load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg)"; sleep 30; done ) >> $S/logs/mem-build.log & mon=$!
cd $W
/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh; free -g | sed -n 2p; uptime
sh tools/openmw/dev-build.sh $O/build-r17/root $O/engines/openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r17dev $S/engines/$name \
  --patch $S/unbase-old-r17.patch --patch $W/tools/openmw/patches/orthros-r17.patch --patch $patch
echo BUILD-END $?
kill $mon
ln -sfn $S/engines/$name $S/eng/$name

```

`tools/openmw/results/r18-2026-10-30/an/build.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# dev build openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r18dev over the kept r17dev tree: old base reverted, main's r17, our r18
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r18; O=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r17; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
echo $$ > $S/build.pid
( while kill -0 $$ 2>/dev/null; do echo "$(date +%T) avail=$(free -g | awk '/^Mem/{print $7}') load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg)"; sleep 30; done ) >> $S/mem-build.log &
cd $W
/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh; free -g | sed -n 2p; uptime
sh tools/openmw/dev-build.sh $O/build-r17/root $O/engines/openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r17dev $S/engines/openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r18dev \
  --patch $S/unbase-old-r17.patch --patch $W/tools/openmw/patches/orthros-r17.patch --patch $W/tools/openmw/patches/orthros-r18.patch
echo BUILD-END $?
/bin/rm -f $S/build.pid
```

`tools/openmw/results/r18-2026-10-30/an/incl.py`:

```py
import json,gzip,sys,collections,re
d,rowf,lo,hi,symf=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2],float(sys.argv[3]),float(sys.argv[4]),sys.argv[5]
pat=sys.argv[6] if len(sys.argv)>6 else 'LoadingScreen'
sym={}
```

```py
import json,gzip,sys,collections,re
def run(d,rowf,lo,hi,symf):
  lo,hi=float(lo),float(hi)
  sym={}
  for l in open(symf):
    i,_,n=l.rstrip('\n').partition(':'); sym[int(i)]=n
  p=json.load(open(d+'/load.cpuprofile')); r=[json.loads(l) for l in open(rowf)][-1]; at=r['cpuProfile']['at']

    for c in n.get('children',[]): parent[c]=n['id']

    f=nodes[i]['callFrame']['functionName']; m=re.match(r'wasm-function\[(\d+)\]',f)
    return re.sub(r'\(.*','',sym.get(int(m.group(1)),f)) if m else f
  incl=collections.Counter(); selfc=collections.Counter(); t=p['startTime']
```

```sh
# avail/load every 30 s; under 16 GB available: this task's own measuring jobs (their command line names this scratch) stopped
while true; do
  a=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')
  echo "$(date +%T) avail=${a}G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg)" >> /tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r18/logs/memory.log
  if [ "$a" -lt 16 ]; then
    for p in $(pgrep -f '^node tools/openmw/(place-load|perf|mp-check|check|overlay-check|frame-compare)[^ ]*\.mjs .*orthros-scratch/data-r18'); do
      echo "$(date +%T) LOW MEMORY ${a}G: killing $p $(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | cut -c1-150)" >> /tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r18/logs/memory.log; kill $p
    done
  fi
  sleep 30
done
```

```py
import json,gzip,sys,collections
d,rowf,lo,hi=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2],float(sys.argv[3]),float(sys.argv[4])
p=json.load(open(d+'/load.cpuprofile')); r=[json.loads(l) for l in open(rowf)][-1]; at=r['cpuProfile']['at']
t0=json.load(gzip.open(d+'/read-trace.json.gz','rt'))['from']
nodes={n['id']:n for n in p['nodes']}; parent={}
for n in p['nodes']:
  for c in n.get('children',[]): parent[c]=n['id']
WAIT={'fetchSync','wantWaitFor','fetchSpin','wantWaitSoon','wantWaitForAsync','(idle)'}
def anc(i):
  out=[]
  while i in nodes and len(out)<40: out.append(nodes[i]['callFrame']['functionName']); i=parent.get(i)
  return out
t=p['startTime']; c=collections.Counter()
for s,dt in zip(p['samples'],p['timeDeltas']):
  t+=dt; rel=(at+(t-p['startTime'])/1000-t0)/1000
  if not (lo<=rel<=hi): continue
  a=anc(s); n=a[0]
  if n=='(idle)' or any(x in WAIT for x in a): k='wait'
  elif n=='(program)': k='program'
  elif n=='(garbage collector)': k='gc'
  elif n.startswith('wasm-function'): k='wasm'
  else: k='js'
  c[k]+=dt/1000
print({k:round(v) for k,v in c.items()}, 'total', round(sum(c.values())))
```

```py
import json,sys,gzip,re,urllib.parse
f=sys.argv[1]
recs=[json.loads(l) for l in gzip.open(f,'rt')]
mark=[r for r in recs if r['url'].startswith('/__qa/mark')]
t0=mark[0]['t'] if mark else 0
def kind(u):
  return 'want' if re.search(r'[?&]w=1',u) else 'bg' if re.search(r'[?&]p=1',u) else 'ahead' if re.search(r'[?&]a=1',u) else 'demand' if re.search(r'[?&]s=',u) else 'other'
for r in recs:
  u=r['url']
  if '/game' not in u and '/gamez/' not in u and '/__qa' not in u and '/api/' not in u: continue
  m=re.search(r'/gamez?/[^/]+/(.*?)\?r=(\d+)-(\d+)',u)
  name=urllib.parse.unquote(m.group(1)).split('/')[-1] if m else u[:70]
  rng=f"{int(m.group(2))}-{int(m.group(3))}" if m else ''
  sz=(int(m.group(3))-int(m.group(2))+1) if m else 0
  print(f"{(r['t']-t0)/1000:8.2f} {r.get('ms',-1000)/1000:6.2f} end {(r['t']+r.get('ms',0)-t0)/1000:7.2f} {kind(u):7} {r.get('wire',0)/1024:7.0f}K dec{sz/1024:7.0f}K {name} {rng}")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The validation's numbers by side (r17, r18): place-load rows (val/pl-<side>-<kind>.jsonl) and perf.json files."""
import json, os, sys, glob
V = sys.argv[1]
def rows(f):
    p = os.path.join(V, f)
    return [json.loads(l) for l in open(p)] if os.path.exists(p) else []
def rng(xs):
    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    return '-' if not xs else (f'{min(xs)}' if min(xs) == max(xs) else f'{min(xs)}-{max(xs)}') + f' ({len(xs)})'
for kind in ['save', 'coe', 'saveNew', 'save85k', 'forced']:
    for side in ['r17', 'r18']:
        R = rows(f'pl-{side}-{kind}.jsonl')
        if not R: continue
        J = [r.get('jspiProbe') or {} for r in R]
        A = [r.get('jspiAfter') or {} for r in R]
        print(f'{kind:8} {side}: menu {rng([r["engineStart"].get("menuS") for r in R])}  firstFrame {rng([r["engineStart"].get("firstFrameS") for r in R])}  inWorld(key->world) {rng([r["load"].get("inWorldS") for r in R])}'
              f'  steady {rng([r["load"].get("steadyS") for r in R])}  block {rng([j.get("blockMaxMs") for j in J])}  input p50 {rng([j.get("inputP50Ms") for j in J])} p95 {rng([j.get("inputP95Ms") for j in J])}'
              f'  freeze {rng([j.get("frameGapMaxMs") for j in J])}  after-gap {rng([a.get("frameGapMaxMs") for a in A])}  lateOld {rng([(r.get("precompile") or {}).get("lateOld") for r in R])}'
              f'  timeouts {rng([((r.get("stage3") or {}).get("load") or {}).get("timeouts") for r in R])}  faults {sum(len(r.get("faults") or []) for r in R)} errors {sum(1 for r in R if r.get("error"))}')
for side in ['r17', 'r18']:
    P = []
    for d in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(V, 'perf', f'{side}-*'))):
        f = glob.glob(os.path.join(d, '*.json'))
        f = [x for x in f if os.path.basename(x).startswith('perf')] or f
        if f: P.append(json.load(open(f[0])))
    if P:
        print(f'play     {side}: fps {rng([p.get("fps") for p in P])}  longest gap {rng([p["gap"]["max"] for p in P])}  stalls/min {rng([p.get("dataStallMs") for p in P])}'
              f'  work p50 {rng([p["work"]["p50"] for p in P])} p99 {rng([p["work"]["p99"] for p in P])}')
```

`tools/openmw/results/r18-2026-10-30/bench/jspi-deep.mjs`:

```mjs
// Cost of one suspension and resume of a promising export at stack depth D (wasm frames below the suspending call).
const u = (n) => { const out = []; do { let b = n & 0x7f; n >>>= 7; if (n) b |= 0x80; out.push(b); } while (n); return out; };
const sec = (id, body) => [id, ...u(body.length), ...body];
const str = (s) => [...u(s.length), ...new TextEncoder().encode(s)];
// type0: (i32)->i32 ; import f: type0 ; func1 rec(n): if n==0 then f(0) else rec(n-1)+0 ; export "rec"
const types = [1, 0x60, 1, 0x7f, 1, 0x7f];
const imports = [1, ...str('e'), ...str('f'), 0, 0];
const funcs = [1, 0];
const exports = [1, ...str('rec'), 0, 1];
const fn = [0, 0x20, 0, 0x45, 0x04, 0x7f, 0x41, 0, 0x10, 0, 0x05, 0x20, 0, 0x41, 1, 0x6b, 0x10, 1, 0x41, 1, 0x6a, 0x0b, 0x0b];
const code = [1, ...u(fn.length), ...fn];
const bytes = new Uint8Array([0, 0x61, 0x73, 0x6d, 1, 0, 0, 0, ...sec(1, types), ...sec(2, imports), ...sec(3, funcs), ...sec(7, exports), ...sec(10, code)]);
const f = new WebAssembly.Suspending(async () => { await null; return 0; });
const rec = WebAssembly.promising((await WebAssembly.instantiate(bytes, { e: { f } })).instance.exports.rec);
for (const D of [0, 1024, 4096]) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) await rec(D);
  const N = 5000, t = performance.now(); for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) await rec(D);
  console.log(`depth ${D}: ${((performance.now() - t) / N * 1000).toFixed(1)} us per call with one suspension`);
}

```

`tools/openmw/results/r18-2026-10-30/bench/jspi-import.mjs`:

```mjs
// Cost of a wasm->JS import call on the page's own stack (a plain export) against on a JSPI stack (a promising export).
// Module: (import "e" "f" (func (result i32))) (func (export "run") (param i32) (result i32) loop: call f, sum, dec)
const u = (n) => { const out = []; do { let b = n & 0x7f; n >>>= 7; if (n) b |= 0x80; out.push(b); } while (n); return out; };
const sec = (id, body) => [id, ...u(body.length), ...body];
const str = (s) => [...u(s.length), ...Buffer.from(s)];
const types = [2, 0x60, 0, 1, 0x7f, 0x60, 1, 0x7f, 1, 0x7f];
const imports = [1, ...str('e'), ...str('f'), 0, 0];
const funcs = [1, 1];
```
