`tools/openmw/results/r18-2026-10-30/lua/interp-tests.lua`:

```lua
package.path = './openmw/files/data/?.lua;./wasm-build/lua-tests/?.lua;' .. package.path
local pass, fail = 0, 0
local function check(name, ok, detail) if ok then pass = pass + 1; print('  ok   ' .. name) else fail = fail + 1; print('  FAIL ' .. name .. (detail and ('  -- ' .. detail) or '')) end end
print('s172 a late pose is not a stop, and a puppet can catch a running owner')
do
  package.loaded['scripts.mp.interp'] = nil
  local Interp = dofile('./openmw/files/data/scripts/mp/interp.lua')
  local it = Interp.new()
  -- A target running +250 u/s along y, poses every 66 ms, then the stream is late.
  for i = 0, 5 do it:push({ t = i * 0.066, x = 0, y = i * 0.066 * 250, z = 0, yaw = 0, pitch = 0, flags = 1 }) end
  local newest = 5 * 0.066
  it:target(newest) -- the first read adopts the delay this stream wants
  local d = it:delay()
  -- 40 ms past the newest sample in render time (now = newest + delay + 0.04).
  local tg = it:target(newest + d + 0.04)
  check('a query past the newest pose carries on along the last step (was clamped to it)',
    tg ~= nil and tg.y > newest * 250 + 5, string.format('y %.1f, newest %.1f', tg and tg.y or -1, newest * 250))
  local far = it:target(newest + d + 1.0)
  check('...by at most EXTRAP_S of it (a real stop overshoots <= ~22 u at a run, s172 #175)',
    far ~= nil and far.y <= newest * 250 + 0.09 * 250 + 0.5, string.format('y %.1f', far and far.y or -1))
  check('the speed feed-forward keeps reading the run through a late pose',
    it:speed(newest + d + 0.04) > 200, string.format('speed %.0f', it:speed(newest + d + 0.04)))
  local vx, vy = it:velocity(newest + d + 0.04)
  check('velocity points the way the target walks (+y), for the ahead-of-target rule',
    math.abs(vx) < 1 and vy > 200, string.format('vx %.1f vy %.1f', vx, vy))
  local pp = io.open('./openmw/files/data/scripts/mp/puppet.lua'):read('*a')
  -- Walking +y (travel heading 0). Every case must stay within 20 degrees of the travel heading:
  -- the target point a few units off to any side, ahead, behind -- the jitter cases.
  local deg = function(r) return math.abs(r) * 57.3 end
  local worst = 0
  for _, c in ipairs({ { 5, 0 }, { -5, 0 }, { 3, -2 }, { -3, 2 }, { 0, -6 }, { 40, 10 }, { -40, -10 }, { 10, -60 } }) do
    local h = Interp.walkHeading(c[1], c[2], 0, 250, math.sqrt(c[1] ^ 2 + c[2] ^ 2))
    worst = math.max(worst, deg(h))
  end
  check('a puppet following a walking target faces within 20 degrees of its travel, wherever the point is (side-to-side jitter, 180s)',
    worst <= 20.1, string.format('worst %.1f deg', worst))
  check('...and a target 3 u to the side barely turns it (was 45-90 degrees aiming at the point)',
    deg(Interp.walkHeading(3, 0.5, 0, 250, 3.04)) < 2, string.format('%.1f deg', deg(Interp.walkHeading(3, 0.5, 0, 250, 3.04))))
  check('puppet.lua steers a walking target by walkHeading',
    pp:find('Interp.walkHeading(dx, dy, vx, vy, dist2d)', 1, true) ~= nil)
  local cc = io.open('./openmw/apps/openmw/mwmechanics/character.cpp'):read('*a')
  check('puppet steering may exceed top speed to close a gap',
    pp:find('math.min(PUPPET_MAX_SPEED, (tgtV + dist2d', 1, true) ~= nil and pp:find('local PUPPET_MAX_SPEED = 1.25', 1, true) ~= nil)
  check('the engine honours it for puppets only',
    cc:find('MWMP::isPuppet(mPtr.getCellRef().getRefNum()) ? 1.25f : 1.f', 1, true) ~= nil)
  package.loaded['scripts.mp.interp'] = nil
end

print('Orthros: a teleport seen in two poses a few ms apart is not carried on 18-90x (the copy stood 15,000+ u away)')
do
  package.loaded['scripts.mp.interp'] = nil
  local Interp = dofile('./openmw/files/data/scripts/mp/interp.lua')
  -- The owner walks +x at 140 u/s, poses every 66 ms; then a pose 2 ms after the last one carries it 300 u on
  -- (a teleport, its batch handled in the same frame as the previous one), and the stream goes quiet: the
  -- server relays changes only.
  local function run(gap, jump)
    local it, t = Interp.new(), 0
    for i = 0, 20 do t = i * 0.066; it:push({ t = t, x = t * 140, y = 0, z = 0, yaw = 0, pitch = 0, flags = 1 }) end
    local x0 = t * 140
    it:push({ t = t + gap, x = x0 + jump, y = 0, z = 0, yaw = 0, pitch = 0, flags = 1 })
    local tg = it:target(t + gap + 5) -- long after: the target the copy settles on
    return tg.x - (x0 + jump)
  end
  local worst = 0
  for _, gap in ipairs({ 0.001, 0.002, 0.004, 0.0049 }) do worst = math.max(worst, math.abs(run(gap, 300))) end
  check('a 300 u jump 1-5 ms after the last pose leaves the copy where its owner stands (was 5,400-27,000 u on)', worst < 48, string.format('%.0f u off', worst))
  check('...and a jump after an ordinary gap too', math.abs(run(0.066, 300)) < 48, string.format('%.0f u off', run(0.066, 300)))
  check('an ordinary step is still carried on (a late pose is not a stop)', run(0.066, 140 * 0.066) > 5, string.format('%.1f u', run(0.066, 140 * 0.066)))
  package.loaded['scripts.mp.interp'] = nil
end

print('players said NPCs are jerky and movement rubber-bandy: the render delay adapts to the stream (it was a fixed 40 ms, below one batch interval)')
do
  package.loaded['scripts.mp.interp'] = nil
  local Interp = dofile('./openmw/files/data/scripts/mp/interp.lua')
  local function feed(it, gaps, n, speed)
    local t, y = 0, 0
    for i = 1, n do
      local g = gaps[(i % #gaps) + 1]
      t = t + g
      it:push({ t = t, x = 0, y = t * speed, z = 0, yaw = 0, pitch = 0, flags = 1 })
    end
    return t
  end
  local steady = Interp.new(); feed(steady, { 0.066 }, 40, 140)
  check('a steady 15 Hz stream settles near one interval (not 40 ms)',
    steady:wantedDelay() >= 0.07 and steady:wantedDelay() <= 0.13, string.format('%.3f', steady:wantedDelay()))
  local jitter = Interp.new(); feed(jitter, { 0.033, 0.099 }, 40, 140)
  check('a jittery stream buys itself more buffer than a steady one', jitter:wantedDelay() > steady:wantedDelay() + 0.03,
    string.format('%.3f vs %.3f', jitter:wantedDelay(), steady:wantedDelay()))
  local slow = Interp.new(); feed(slow, { 0.2 }, 30, 140)
  check('a 5 Hz mid-tier stream is interpolated over its own interval', slow:wantedDelay() >= 0.2 and slow:wantedDelay() <= 0.30,
    string.format('%.3f', slow:wantedDelay()))
  local stop = Interp.new(); feed(stop, { 0.066 }, 20, 140); stop:push({ t = 99, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, yaw = 0, pitch = 0, flags = 0 })
  check('a long silence (a stop, a cell load) is not read as jitter', stop:wantedDelay() < 0.13, string.format('%.3f', stop:wantedDelay()))
  -- RENDERED SMOOTHNESS at 60 fps. The server makes a pose every 66 ms (positions are exactly
  -- 140 u/s apart); the link delivers them bunched and late (arrival = made + 50 ms + a 0/30 ms
  -- jitter, so gaps alternate ~36/96 ms). Measured: the worst frame-to-frame speed against the
  -- real 140 u/s. REFERENCE = the previous interp.lua, verbatim in effect: samples stamped by
  -- ARRIVAL, a fixed 40 ms delay, extrapolation capped at 90 ms.
  local function arrivals()
    local out, prevA = {}, 0
    for i = 1, 80 do
      local g = i * 0.066
      local a = math.max(g + 0.05 + ((i % 2 == 0) and 0.03 or 0), prevA + 0.004)
      prevA = a
      out[#out + 1] = { t = a, y = g * 140 }
    end
    return out
  end
  local function legacyTarget(buf, rt)
    local n = #buf
    if rt <= buf[1].t then return buf[1] end
    for i = n, 1, -1 do
      if buf[i].t <= rt then
        local a, b = buf[i], buf[i + 1]
        if not b then
          local p, h = buf[i - 1], math.min(rt - a.t, 0.09)
          if not p or h <= 0 or a.t - p.t < 1e-3 then return a end
          return { y = a.y + (a.y - p.y) * h / (a.t - p.t) }
        end
        local k = (rt - a.t) / math.max(b.t - a.t, 1e-6)
        return { y = a.y + (b.y - a.y) * k }
      end
    end
    return buf[n]
  end
  local function worst(render)
    local arr, nxt, prevY, w = arrivals(), 1, nil, 0
    local last = arr[#arr].t - 0.1
    for now = 1.0, last, 1 / 60 do
      local fed = {}
      while arr[nxt] and arr[nxt].t <= now do nxt = nxt + 1 end
      for i = 1, nxt - 1 do fed[i] = arr[i] end
      local y = render(fed, nxt - 1, now)
      if y and prevY and now > 2.0 then w = math.max(w, math.abs(y - prevY) * 60 / 140) end
      prevY = y or prevY
    end
    return w
  end
  local itNew = Interp.new()
  local pushed = 0
  local wNew = worst(function(fed, n, now)
    while pushed < n do pushed = pushed + 1; itNew:push({ t = fed[pushed].t, x = 0, y = fed[pushed].y, z = 0, yaw = 0, pitch = 0, flags = 1 }) end
    local tg = itNew:target(now)
    return tg and tg.y
  end)
  local wOld = worst(function(fed, n, now)
    if n < 2 then return nil end
    local tg = legacyTarget(fed, now - 0.04)
    return tg and tg.y
  end)
  check('rendered speed stays within 1.4x of the real walking speed with the adaptive delay', wNew <= 1.4, string.format('worst %.2fx', wNew))
  check('...where the old fixed 40 ms delay on arrival stamps lurched well past it (the complaint)', wOld > wNew + 0.5, string.format('old %.2fx vs %.2fx', wOld, wNew))
  local pl = io.open('./openmw/files/data/scripts/mp/player.lua'):read('*a')
  check('a self divergence under the dead zone is not corrected (players: slightly rubber-bandy)',
    pl:find('local CORRECT_DEADZONE = 5', 1, true) ~= nil and pl:find('if dist < CORRECT_DEADZONE then return end', 1, true) ~= nil
    and pl:find('if dist < 1 then return end', 1, true) == nil)
  local it = io.open('./openmw/files/data/scripts/mp/interp.lua'):read('*a')
  check('the delay is bounded and slewed, never a jump', it:find('local MAX_DELAY = 0.30', 1, true) ~= nil and it:find('local SLEW = 0.1', 1, true) ~= nil)
  package.loaded['scripts.mp.interp'] = nil
end

print(pass .. ' passed, ' .. fail .. ' failed'); os.exit(fail == 0 and 0 or 1)
```

`tools/openmw/results/r18-2026-10-30/validation2/scripts/memlog.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# avail/load every 30 s; under 16 GB available: this task's own measuring jobs (their command line names this scratch) stopped
while true; do
  a=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')
  echo "$(date +%T) avail=${a}G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg)" >> /tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r18/logs2/memory.log
  if [ "$a" -lt 16 ]; then
    for p in $(pgrep -f '^node tools/openmw/[^ ]*\.mjs .*(orthros-scratch/data-r18|127\.0\.0\.1:189[0-9][0-9])'); do
      echo "$(date +%T) LOW MEMORY ${a}G: killing $p $(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | cut -c1-150)" >> /tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r18/logs2/memory.log; kill $p
    done
  fi
  sleep 30
done
```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: perf.sh <engine> <port> <out dir> [perf.mjs options...]: a server of the tree on a fresh learn copy and the frozen br-cache, perf.mjs, the server stopped
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r18; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
eng=$1; port=$2; out=$3; shift 3
run=$S/srv-$port; /bin/rm -rf $run; mkdir -p $run $out
cp -a $S/pristine/learn $run/learn
/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh -w 24
echo "$(date +%T) avail=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) perf $eng $out $*" >> $S/logs2/runs-started.txt
cd $W
node src/host/server.js --port $port --games-dir $S/sgames-$eng --engines-dir $S/eng --learn $run/learn --telemetry $run/tel --br-cache $S/pristine/brcache --br-cache-frozen --covers off --no-home-preload > $run/server.log 2>&1 &
srv=$!
for i in $(seq 60); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:$port/api/manifests >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
/srv/orthros/tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/openmw/perf.mjs morrowind-goty-en --url http://127.0.0.1:$port --out $out "$@" > $out/perf.log 2>&1
rc=$?
kill $srv; wait $srv 2>/dev/null
cp $run/server.log $out/server.log; /bin/rm -rf $run
echo "perf rc=$rc $out"
```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: pl.sh <side: 17|18> <tag> <out jsonl> [place-load options...]
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r18; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
side=$1; tag=$2; out=$3; shift 3
# side: 17 (live r17), 18 (r18dev), or 18<suffix> (r18dev-<suffix>, in pl18's scratch unless PLDIR says)
case $side in
  17) eng=(--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r17); dir=${PLDIR:-pl17} ;;
  17x) eng=(--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r17); dir=pl17x ;;
  18) eng=(--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r18dev --engine-br); dir=pl18 ;;
  18*) eng=(--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r18dev-${side#18} --engine-br); dir=${PLDIR:-pl18} ;;
esac
/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh -w 24
echo "$(date +%T) avail=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) side=$side tag=$tag $*" >> $S/logs2/runs-started.txt
cd $W && exec /srv/orthros/tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/openmw/place-load.mjs morrowind-goty-en --tree $W --warm-tree $W --scratch $S/$dir --pristine $S/pristine --engines-dir $S/eng "${eng[@]}" --save $S/saves/-2_6.omwsave --runs 1 --tag "$tag" --out "$out" "$@"

```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: srvrun.sh <engine> <port> <out dir> <tool script> [args...]: a server of the tree (fresh learn copy, frozen
# br-cache), the tool through the browser slot with --url, the server stopped
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r18; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
eng=$1; port=$2; out=$3; tool=$4; shift 4

/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh -w 24
echo "$(date +%T) avail=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) $tool $eng $out $*" >> $S/logs2/runs-started.txt
cd $W
node src/host/server.js --port $port --games-dir $S/sgames-$eng --engines-dir $S/eng --learn $run/learn --telemetry $run/tel --br-cache $S/pristine/brcache --br-cache-frozen --covers off --no-home-preload > $run/server.log 2>&1 &
srv=$!
for i in $(seq 60); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:$port/api/manifests >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
/srv/orthros/tools/with-browser-slot.sh node $tool morrowind-goty-en --url http://127.0.0.1:$port "$@" > $out/tool.log 2>&1
rc=$?
kill $srv; wait $srv 2>/dev/null
cp $run/server.log $out/server.log; /bin/rm -rf $run
echo "$tool rc=$rc $out" | tee -a $out/tool.log
```

`tools/openmw/results/r18-2026-10-30/validation2/scripts/summary2.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The second full validation's numbers by side (r17, r18): place-load rows (<V>/pl-<side>-<kind>.jsonl), perf.json
files (<V>/perf/<side>-N/), the two-client runs (<V>/mp/<side>-N/). usage: summary2.py <validation dir>"""
import json, os, sys, glob, statistics
V = sys.argv[1]
def rows(f):
    p = os.path.join(V, f)
    return [json.loads(l) for l in open(p)] if os.path.exists(p) else []
def rng(xs):
    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    return '-' if not xs else (f'{min(xs)}' if min(xs) == max(xs) else f'{min(xs)}-{max(xs)}') + f' ({len(xs)})'
for kind in ['save', 'coe', 'saveNew', 'save85k', 'forced', 'glide85k', 'door']:
    for side in ['r17', 'r18']:
        R = rows(f'pl-{side}-{kind}.jsonl')
        if not R: continue
        J = [r.get('jspiProbe') or {} for r in R]
        A = [r.get('jspiAfter') or {} for r in R]
        E = [(j.get('engine') or {}) for j in J]
        print(f'{kind:8} {side}: menu {rng([(r.get("engineStart") or {}).get("menuS") for r in R])}  firstFrame {rng([(r.get("engineStart") or {}).get("firstFrameS") for r in R])}  inWorld(key->world) {rng([(r.get("load") or {}).get("inWorldS") for r in R])}'
              f'  steady {rng([(r.get("load") or {}).get("steadyS") for r in R])}  block {rng([j.get("blockMaxMs") for j in J])}  input p50 {rng([j.get("inputP50Ms") for j in J])} p95 {rng([j.get("inputP95Ms") for j in J])}'
              f'  freeze {rng([j.get("frameGapMaxMs") for j in J])}  after-gap {rng([a.get("frameGapMaxMs") for a in A])}  lateOld {rng([(r.get("precompile") or {}).get("lateOld") for r in R])}'
              f'  timeouts {rng([((r.get("stage3") or {}).get("load") or {}).get("timeouts") for r in R])}  suspended {rng([e.get("suspendedMs") for e in E])} soonSuspends {rng([e.get("soonSuspends") for e in E])}'
              f'  faults {sum(len(r.get("faults") or []) for r in R)} errors {sum(1 for r in R if r.get("error"))}')
for side in ['r17', 'r18']:
    P = []
    for d in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(V, 'perf', f'{side}-*'))):
        f = [x for x in glob.glob(os.path.join(d, '*.json')) if os.path.basename(x).startswith('perf')] or glob.glob(os.path.join(d, '*.json'))
        if f: P.append(json.load(open(f[0])))
    if P:
        p99 = [p["work"]["p99"] for p in P]
        print(f'play     {side}: fps {rng([p.get("fps") for p in P])}  longest gap {rng([p["gap"]["max"] for p in P])}  stalls/min {rng([p.get("dataStallMs") for p in P])}'
              f'  work p50 {rng([p["work"]["p50"] for p in P])} p99 {rng(p99)} (median {statistics.median(p99)})')
for side in ['r17', 'r18']:
    out = []
    for d in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(V, 'mp', f'{side}-*'))):
        r = glob.glob(os.path.join(d, 'result*.json'))
        if r:
            j = json.load(open(r[0])); out.append(f'{os.path.basename(d)}:{j.get("pass", j.get("ok"))}')
        else:
            out.append(f'{os.path.basename(d)}:?')
    if out: print(f'mp       {side}: ' + ' '.join(out))

```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Full validation of r18dev-d (engine 67ba0ec0e388, this tree's page at 388dfce) against the live r17, interleaved, one browser at a time
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r18; V=$S/val2; E18=openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r18dev-d; E17=openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r17
mkdir -p $V/perf $V/mp
p17() { PLDIR=w17 $S/bin2/pl.sh 17 "$@"; }
p18() { PLDIR=w18 $S/bin2/pl.sh 18d "$@"; }
step() { echo "=== $(date +%T) $*"; }
for i in 1 2 3; do
  step save $i; p17 r17-save-$i $V/pl-r17-save.jsonl --mode save; p18 r18-save-$i $V/pl-r18-save.jsonl --mode save
  step coe $i; p17 r17-coe-$i $V/pl-r17-coe.jsonl --mode coe; p18 r18-coe-$i $V/pl-r18-coe.jsonl --mode coe
done
ln -sfn $S/w17/games-$E17 $S/sgames-$E17; ln -sfn $S/w18/games-$E18 $S/sgames-$E18
for i in 1 2 3 4; do
  step perf $i
  $S/bin2/perf.sh $E17 18961 $V/perf/r17-$i --query tier=mid --discard --seconds 60 --warm 0
  $S/bin2/perf.sh $E18 18962 $V/perf/r18-$i --query tier=mid --discard --seconds 60 --warm 0
done
for i in 1 2; do
  step new $i; p17 r17-saveNew-$i $V/pl-r17-saveNew.jsonl --mode save --profile new; p18 r18-saveNew-$i $V/pl-r18-saveNew.jsonl --mode save --profile new
  step 85k $i; p17 r17-save85k-$i $V/pl-r17-save85k.jsonl --mode save --rate 85k --read-trace; p18 r18-save85k-$i $V/pl-r18-save85k.jsonl --mode save --rate 85k --read-trace
done
step frame-compare; $S/bin2/srvrun.sh $E18 18965 $V/fc tools/openmw/frame-compare.mjs --variant '' --variant jspi=0 --out $V/fc/out
step check; $S/bin2/srvrun.sh $E18 18966 $V/check-en tools/openmw/check.mjs --seconds 10; $S/bin2/srvrun.sh $E18 18967 $V/check-fr tools/openmw/check.mjs --lang fr --seconds 10
step mp
for i in 1 2 3; do $S/bin2/mp.sh $E18 $V/mp/r18-$i; $S/bin2/mp.sh $E17 $V/mp/r17-$i; done
step forced
ORTHROS_CHROME_ARGS='--memlog=all-renderers --memlog-sampling-rate=100000 --memlog-stack-mode=native' p18 r18-forced-save $V/pl-r18-forced.jsonl --mode save
ORTHROS_CHROME_ARGS='--memlog=all-renderers --memlog-sampling-rate=100000 --memlog-stack-mode=native' p18 r18-forced-coe $V/pl-r18-forced.jsonl --mode coe
step blocking-paths
p17 r17-glide85k-1 $V/pl-r17-glide85k.jsonl --mode glide --rate 85k --seconds 90 --query preloadwait=1000 --read-trace
p18 r18-glide85k-1 $V/pl-r18-glide85k.jsonl --mode glide --rate 85k --seconds 90 --query preloadwait=1000 --read-trace
p17 r17-door-1 $V/pl-r17-door.jsonl --mode door --read-trace
p18 r18-door-1 $V/pl-r18-door.jsonl --mode door --read-trace
step VAL DONE
```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# The rest of the validation after the first round's r18 warm profile was found without the engine's lean package
```

```md
  without the archive-stream exemption: the new archive-stream test fails (`still queued`: its 5 queued read-aheads

# orthros-r18 validated against the live r17 (2026-10-31): SHIP (docs/openmw.md, r18 section)
```

`tools/openmw/results/r18-release-2026-10-31/validation/scripts/engfiles.py`:

```py
import json,sys,gzip,collections
# engine files (the release's openmw.js/wasm/data, lean or full) through the proxy: requests, wire MB, by url
for f in sys.argv[1:]:
  c=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0])
  op=gzip.open if f.endswith('.gz') else open
  for l in op(f,'rt'):
    try: j=json.loads(l)
    except: continue
    u=j.get('url') or ''
    if 'openmw.data' in u or 'openmw.wasm' in u or 'openmw.js' in u:
      k=u.split('?')[0]; k=k[k.find('/e/'):] if '/e/' in k else k[-70:]
      c[(k, u.split('?')[1][:40] if '?' in u else '')][0]+=1; c[(k, u.split('?')[1][:40] if '?' in u else '')][1]+=j.get('wire',0)
  print('==',f)
  for k,v in sorted(c.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1][1])[:8]: print(' ',v[0],'req',round(v[1]/1e6,2),'MB',k)
```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# avail/load every 30 s; under 16 GB: this task's own measuring jobs (command lines naming r18-ship scratch or its ports) stopped
L=/tmp/orthros-scratch/r18-ship/logs/memory.log
while true; do
  a=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')
  echo "$(date +%T) avail=${a}G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg)" >> $L
  if [ "$a" -lt 16 ]; then
    for p in $(pgrep -f '^node [^ ]*(tools/[^ ]*\.mjs|mp-check\.mjs) .*(r18-ship|127\.0\.0\.1:187[0-9][0-9])'); do
      echo "$(date +%T) LOW MEMORY ${a}G: killing $p $(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | cut -c1-150)" >> $L; kill $p
    done
  fi
  sleep 30
done
```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# The shared page code (r18-small's http-backend) on the other runtimes, after the OpenMW validation; one browser at a time
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/r18-ship; T=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/r18-small; O=$S/oth; mkdir -p $O
step() { echo "=== $(date +%T) $*"; }
while pgrep -f '^/bin/bash /tmp/orthros-scratch/r18-ship/bin/val.sh' >/dev/null; do sleep 20; done
# origin <tree> <port> <dir>: a server of <tree> on the live games, fresh learn copy, frozen br-cache, scratch accounts

  sleep 3
```

`tools/openmw/results/r18-release-2026-10-31/validation/scripts/srv.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: srv.sh <17|18> <port> <out dir> <tool script (r18-small's tools)> [args...]: a server of the side's tree
# (17: /srv/orthros main + live games = r17; 18: r18-small + games18 = r18) on a fresh learn copy and the frozen
# br-cache, the tool through the browser slot with --url, the server stopped
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/r18-ship; T=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/r18-small
side=$1; port=$2; out=$3; tool=$4; shift 4
case $side in 17) tree=/srv/orthros; games=/srv/orthros/data/games ;; 18) tree=$T; games=$S/games18 ;; 17x) tree=$T; games=/srv/orthros/data/games ;; 18x) tree=/srv/orthros; games=$S/games18 ;; esac
run=$S/srv-$port; /bin/rm -rf $run; mkdir -p $run $out
cp -a $S/pristine/learn $run/learn
/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh -w 24
echo "$(date +%T) avail=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) side=$side $tool $out $*" >> $S/logs/runs-started.txt
cd $tree
node src/host/server.js --port $port --games-dir $games --engines-dir /srv/orthros/data/engines --learn $run/learn --telemetry $run/tel --br-cache $S/pristine/brcache --br-cache-frozen --covers off --no-home-preload > $run/server.log 2>&1 &
srv=$!
for i in $(seq 60); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:$port/api/manifests >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
cd $T
/srv/orthros/tools/with-browser-slot.sh node $tool "$@" --url http://127.0.0.1:$port > $out/tool.log 2>&1
rc=$?
kill $srv; wait $srv 2>/dev/null
cp $run/server.log $out/server.log; /bin/rm -rf $run
echo "$tool rc=$rc $out" | tee -a $out/tool.log
```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/bench/b.c`:

```c
// JSPI cost probe: a hot call at a chosen stack depth, on the page's stack (plain export) or a JSPI stack (promising)
extern double now(void) __attribute__((import_module("env"), import_name("now")));
extern int imp(int) __attribute__((import_module("env"), import_name("imp")));
volatile int sink;
__attribute__((noinline)) int leaf(int x) { char buf[64]; buf[x & 63] = (char)x; sink += buf[(x * 7) & 63]; return x + 1; }
__attribute__((noinline)) int mid(int x) { char buf[256]; buf[x & 255] = (char)x; int r = leaf(x) + leaf(x + 1); sink += buf[(x * 3) & 255]; return r; }
__attribute__((noinline)) int down(int d, int n, int mode) {
  if (d > 0) { int r = down(d - 1, n, mode); sink += r; return r; }
  int s = 0;
  if (mode == 0) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s += mid(i);
  else for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s += imp(i);
  return s;
}
__attribute__((export_name("run"))) int run(int d, int n, int mode) { return down(d, n, mode); }
__attribute__((export_name("run2"))) int run2(int d, int n, int mode) { return down(d, n, mode); }

```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/bench/b.mjs`:

```mjs
// node b.mjs or in a page: times per call at each depth, plain vs promising
export async function bench(bytes, log = console.log) {
  const env = { now: () => performance.now(), imp: (x) => x + 1 };
  const { instance } = await WebAssembly.instantiate(bytes, { env });
  const run = instance.exports.run, prom = WebAssembly.promising(instance.exports.run2);
  const out = [];
  for (const mode of [0, 1]) for (const d of [0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 400, 800, 1024, 1500, 2000, 3000]) {
    const n = mode ? 200000 : 400000;
    const t = (f) => { let best = 1e9; for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) { const t0 = performance.now(); const r = f(); best = Math.min(best, performance.now() - t0); } return best; };
    run(d, 1000, mode); await prom(d, 1000, mode);
    const a = t(() => run(d, n, mode));
    let b = 1e9; for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) { const t0 = performance.now(); await prom(d, n, mode); b = Math.min(b, performance.now() - t0); }
    const row = { mode: mode ? 'import' : 'calls', depth: d, plainNs: +(a * 1e6 / n).toFixed(2), jspiNs: +(b * 1e6 / n).toFixed(2) };
    out.push(row); log(JSON.stringify(row));
  }
  return out;
}
if (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.argv[1]?.endsWith('b.mjs')) { const fs = await import('fs'); await bench(fs.readFileSync(new URL('./b.wasm', import.meta.url))); }
```

```mjs
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import fs from 'fs';
import { sweepSrc } from './sweep.mjs';
const bytes = [...fs.readFileSync(new URL('./b.wasm', import.meta.url))];
const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--no-sandbox'] });
const page = await browser.newPage();
page.on('console', (m) => console.error('[page]', m.text()));
await page.setContent('<html><body>bench</body></html>');
const summarize = (r) => { const s = {}; for (const k of ['calls', 'imports']) { const rows = r[k]; const med = (i) => { const v = rows.map((x) => x[i]).sort((a, b) => a - b); return v[v.length >> 1]; }; const slow = rows.filter((x) => x[2] > 2 * med(2) || x[1] > 2 * med(1)); s[k] = { plainMedNs: med(1), jspiMedNs: med(2), plainMax: Math.max(...rows.map((x) => x[1])), jspiMax: Math.max(...rows.map((x) => x[2])), slowDepths: slow.slice(0, 30) }; } return s; };
const main = await page.evaluate(async ({ src, bytes }) => { eval(src + ';globalThis.sweep=sweep'); return await globalThis.sweep(new Uint8Array(bytes)); }, { src: sweepSrc, bytes });
console.log('main', JSON.stringify(summarize(main)));
const worker = await page.evaluate(async ({ src, bytes }) => {
  const code = src + `;onmessage = async (e) => { postMessage(await sweep(new Uint8Array(e.data))); };`;
  const w = new Worker(URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([code], { type: 'text/javascript' })));
  return await new Promise((res) => { w.onmessage = (e) => res(e.data); w.postMessage(bytes); });
}, { src: sweepSrc, bytes });
console.log('worker', JSON.stringify(summarize(worker)));
fs.writeFileSync(new URL('./chrome-sweep.json', import.meta.url), JSON.stringify({ version: browser.version(), main, worker }));
console.log('version', browser.version());
await browser.close();
```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/bench/sweep.mjs`:

```mjs
// A fine depth sweep, plain vs promising, and the same in a dedicated worker (pthreads' entry is promising under -sJSPI)
export const sweepSrc = `
async function sweep(bytes) {
  const env = { now: () => performance.now(), imp: (x) => x + 1 };
  const { instance } = await WebAssembly.instantiate(bytes, { env });
  const run = instance.exports.run, prom = WebAssembly.promising(instance.exports.run2);
  const res = { calls: [], imports: [] };
  for (const [mode, key, n] of [[0, 'calls', 20000], [1, 'imports', 20000]]) {
    for (let d = 0; d <= 4000; d += (d < 400 ? 1 : 7)) {
      run(d, 200, mode); await prom(d, 200, mode);
      let a = 1e9, b = 1e9;
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { let t0 = performance.now(); run(d, n, mode); a = Math.min(a, performance.now() - t0); t0 = performance.now(); await prom(d, n, mode); b = Math.min(b, performance.now() - t0); }
      res[key].push([d, +(a * 1e6 / n).toFixed(1), +(b * 1e6 / n).toFixed(1)]);
    }
  }
  return res;
}`;
```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/scripts/byurl.py`:

```py
import gzip,json,sys,collections
p=json.load(gzip.open(sys.argv[1],'rt')); nodes={n['id']:n for n in p['nodes']}
win=float(sys.argv[2])*1e6 if len(sys.argv)>2 else 1e18
c=collections.Counter(); f=collections.Counter(); t=0
for i,sid in enumerate(p['samples']):
  t+=p['timeDeltas'][i]
  if t>win: break
  w=p['timeDeltas'][i+1] if i+1<len(p['timeDeltas']) else 0
  cf=nodes[sid]['callFrame']; u=cf.get('url','').split('/')[-1] or cf['functionName']
  c[u]+=w; f[(u,cf['functionName'])]+=w
for k,v in c.most_common(14): print(f"{v/1000:8.1f} {k}")
print('--')
for (u,n),v in f.most_common(40):
  if not u.startswith('(') and not u.endswith('.wasm') and v>5000: print(f"{v/1000:8.1f} {u} {n}")

```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/scripts/conc.py`:

```py
# mean number of background requests in flight while the engine waited on a read (boot, page clock < upto), and their bytes
import gzip,json,sys,re
run,upto=sys.argv[1],float(sys.argv[2])
tr=json.load(gzip.open(run+'/read-trace.json.gz','rt'))
px=[json.loads(l) for l in gzip.open(run+'/proxy.jsonl.gz','rt') if l.strip()]
off=[p for p in px if '/__qa/mark' in p.get('url','')][0]['t']-tr['markAt']
bg=[(p['t']-off,p['t']-off+p.get('ms',0),p.get('wire',0)) for p in px if re.search(r'[?&]p=1',p.get('url',''))]
waits=[(e['t'],e['t']+e['ms']) for e in tr['trace'] if e.get('k') in ('sync','late') and e['t']<upto and e.get('ms',0)>=20]
W=sum(b-a for a,b in waits); C=0; started=0; wire=0
for a,b in waits:
  for s,e,w in bg:
    o=max(0,min(b,e)-max(a,s)); C+=o
    if a<=s<b: started+=1; wire+=w
print(run.split('/')[-1][:20], 'waits',len(waits),'ms',int(W),'mean bg in flight',round(C/max(W,1),1),'bg started during waits',started, 'wireMB',round(wire/1e6,2), 'bg total before', len([1 for s,e,w in bg if s<upto]))

```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/scripts/cover.py`:

```py
# each slow wait (>=N ms) of a run's boot (page clock < upto): which link requests covered its bytes, their kind, size, start/end on the page's clock
import gzip,json,sys,re
run,upto,minms=sys.argv[1],float(sys.argv[2]),float(sys.argv[3])
tr=json.load(gzip.open(run+'/read-trace.json.gz','rt'))
px=[json.loads(l) for l in gzip.open(run+'/proxy.jsonl.gz','rt') if l.strip()]
mk=[p for p in px if '/__qa/mark' in p.get('url','')]
off=mk[0]['t']-tr['markAt']
reqs=[]
for p in px:
  m=re.search(r'/gamez/[^/]+/(.*)\?r=(\d+)-(\d+)',p.get('url',''))
  if m: reqs.append((m.group(1).split('/')[-1].replace('%20',' '),int(m.group(2)),int(m.group(3)),p['t']-off,p['t']-off+p['ms'],p.get('kind'),p.get('wire')))
tot={}
for e in tr['trace']:
  if e.get('k') in ('sync','late') and e['t']<upto and e.get('ms',0)>=minms:
    f=(e.get('f') or '').split('/')[-1]; a=e['off']
    cov=[r for r in reqs if r[0]==f and r[1]<=a<r[2] and r[3]<=e['t']+e['ms']+50 and r[4]>=e['t']-50]
    desc=' | '.join(f"{r[5]} {(r[2]-r[1])>>10}K {r[3]/1000:.2f}-{r[4]/1000:.2f}" for r in cov)
    k=cov[0][5] if cov else 'none'; tot[k]=tot.get(k,0)+e['ms']
    print(f"{e['t']/1000:6.2f} {e['k']:4s} {e['ms']:5d} {f[:24]:24s} {a:10d} <- {desc}")
print('wait ms by covering kind', tot)

```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/scripts/dups.py`:

```py
# requests of the same file range overlapping in time on the link (asked twice at once), from a run's proxy log
import gzip,json,sys,re,collections
for run in sys.argv[1:]:
  px=[json.loads(l) for l in gzip.open(run+'/proxy.jsonl.gz','rt') if l.strip()]
  by=collections.defaultdict(list)
  for p in px:
    m=re.search(r'/gamez/[^/]+/([^?]*)\?r=(\d+)-(\d+)',p.get('url',''))
    if m and 'ms' in p: by[(m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3))].append((p['t'],p['t']+p['ms'],p.get('wire',0)))
  n=0; wire=0; big=[]
  for k,v in by.items():
    v.sort()
    for i in range(1,len(v)):
      if any(v[i][0]<v[j][1] for j in range(i)): n+=1; wire+=v[i][2]; big.append((v[i][2],k[0].split('/')[-1],k[1]))
  big.sort(reverse=True)
  print(run.split('/')[-1][:24], 'ranges asked again while on the link:', n, 'wire MB', round(wire/1e6,2), big[:3])

```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# avail/load every 30 s; under 16 GB available: this task's own measuring jobs (their command line names this scratch) stopped
while true; do
  a=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')
  echo "$(date +%T) avail=${a}G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg)" >> /tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19/logs/memory.log
  if [ "$a" -lt 16 ]; then
    for p in $(pgrep -f '^node tools/openmw/[^ ]*\.mjs .*(orthros-scratch/data-r19|127\.0\.0\.1:189[0-9][0-9])'); do
      echo "$(date +%T) LOW MEMORY ${a}G: killing $p $(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | cut -c1-150)" >> /tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19/logs/memory.log; kill $p
    done
  fi
  sleep 30
done
```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/scripts/pair.py`:

```py
import gzip,json,sys
def load(run, upto):
  tr=json.load(gzip.open(run+'/read-trace.json.gz','rt'))['trace']
  d={}
  for e in tr:
    if e.get('k') in ('sync','late','spin') and e['t']<upto:
      k=(e.get('f'),e.get('off')); d.setdefault(k,[0,0,e['t']]); d[k][0]+=e.get('ms',0); d[k][1]+=1
  return d
a=load(sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[3])); b=load(sys.argv[2], float(sys.argv[4]))
keys=set(a)|set(b)
rows=sorted(((b.get(k,[0])[0]-a.get(k,[0])[0]),k) for k in keys)
print('total a',sum(v[0] for v in a.values()),'b',sum(v[0] for v in b.values()), 'only a', sum(v[0] for k,v in a.items() if k not in b), 'only b', sum(v[0] for k,v in b.items() if k not in a))
for dlt,k in rows[:12]+rows[-25:]:
  print(f"{dlt:6d} a={a.get(k,[None,0,None])[0]} b={b.get(k,[None,0,None])[0]} tA={a.get(k,[0,0,0])[2]/1000:.1f} tB={b.get(k,[0,0,0])[2]/1000:.1f} {k[0].split('/')[-1]} {k[1]}")
```

```py
for f in sorted(glob.glob(sys.argv[1]+'/*/perf.json')):
```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/scripts/prof-sum.py`:

```py
import gzip,json,sys,collections
p=json.load(gzip.open(sys.argv[1]))
nodes={n['id']:n for n in p['nodes']}
parent={}
for n in p['nodes']:
  for c in n.get('children',[]): parent[c]=n['id']
dt=p['timeDeltas']; s=p['samples']
t0=p['startTime']
win=(float(sys.argv[2])*1e6, float(sys.argv[3])*1e6) if len(sys.argv)>3 else (0,1e18)
self_=collections.Counter(); kind=collections.Counter()
t=0
for i,(sid,d) in enumerate(zip(s,dt)):
  t+=d
  if not(win[0]<=t<win[1]): continue
  n=nodes[sid]; cf=n['callFrame']; name=cf['functionName'] or '(anon)'; url=cf.get('url','')
  w = dt[i+1] if i+1<len(dt) else 0
  self_[(name,url.split('/')[-1][:30])]+=w
  k='wasm' if url.startswith('wasm') or 'wasm-function' in name or url.endswith('.wasm') else ('special' if name.startswith('(') else 'js')
  kind[k if k!='special' else name]+=w
tot=sum(kind.values())
print('total ms',tot/1000)
for k,v in kind.most_common(): print(f'  {k:30s} {v/1000:9.1f}')
for (n,u),v in self_.most_common(int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv)>4 else 25): print(f'{v/1000:9.1f} {n[:60]:60s} {u}')

```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/scripts/profdiff.py`:

```py
# self time per wasm function (by symbol name) in two CPU profiles, ms per frame-second, the largest differences
import json,sys,re,collections,gzip
def sym(p):
  m={}
  for l in open(p):
    i,_,n=l.rstrip('\n').partition(':'); m[i]=n
  return m
def prof(path,syms):
  p=json.load(gzip.open(path,'rt') if path.endswith('.gz') else open(path))
  nodes={n['id']:n for n in p['nodes']}
  c=collections.Counter(); dt=p['timeDeltas']; s=p['samples']
  for i,sid in enumerate(s):
    w=dt[i+1] if i+1<len(dt) else 0
    cf=nodes[sid]['callFrame']; n=cf['functionName']
    m=re.match(r'wasm-function\[(\d+)\]',n) or re.match(r'\$?(\d+)$',n)
    if m: n=syms.get(m.group(1),n)
    elif cf.get('url','').endswith('.wasm') and n in syms: n=syms[n]
    c[n]+=w
  tot=(p['endTime']-p['startTime'])
  return c,tot
a,ta=prof(sys.argv[1],sym(sys.argv[2])); b,tb=prof(sys.argv[3],sym(sys.argv[4]))
print('span s',ta/1e6,tb/1e6)
keys=set(a)|set(b)
d=sorted(((b[k]/tb-a[k]/ta)*1000,k) for k in keys)  # ms per s
for v,k in d[:15]: print(f"{v:8.2f} ms/s  a {a[k]/ta*1000:7.2f} b {b[k]/tb*1000:7.2f}  {k[:110]}")
print('...')
for v,k in d[-30:]: print(f"{v:8.2f} ms/s  a {a[k]/ta*1000:7.2f} b {b[k]/tb*1000:7.2f}  {k[:110]}")

```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# orthros-r19.patch with its engine.cpp and orthros-jspi.js sections made again from pw/b (the r19 state + the dev changes)
set -e
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19/pw; P=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15/tools/openmw/patches/orthros-r19.patch
T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19/regen.XXXX); cd $T; git init -q .
mkdir -p openmw/apps/openmw wasm-build; cp $S/pre/openmw/apps/openmw/engine.cpp openmw/apps/openmw/; git add -A; git -c user.email=x -c user.name=x commit -qm pre
cp $S/b/openmw/apps/openmw/engine.cpp openmw/apps/openmw/; cp $S/b/wasm-build/orthros-jspi.js wasm-build/; git add -A
git diff --cached -- openmw/apps/openmw/engine.cpp > eng.diff; git diff --cached -- wasm-build/orthros-jspi.js > jspi.diff
python3 - "$P" eng.diff jspi.diff <<'PY'
import re,sys
P,eng,jspi=sys.argv[1:]
s=open(P).read(); parts=re.split(r'(?m)^(?=diff --git )',s)
out=[]
for p in parts:
  m=re.match(r'diff --git a/(\S+) b/',p)
  if m and m.group(1)=='openmw/apps/openmw/engine.cpp': p=open(eng).read()
  elif m and m.group(1)=='wasm-build/orthros-jspi.js': p=open(jspi).read()
  out.append(p)
t=''.join(out).encode()
open(P+'.new','wb').write(t)
import os; os.replace(P+'.new',P)
PY
cd /; /bin/rm -rf $T; echo regenerated
```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/scripts/saveph.py`:

```py
# a save load's phases from its read trace: key -> first announced batch, the loading screen's reads, the serial esm reads after it, their end -> in world
import gzip,json,sys
for run in sys.argv[1:]:
  tr=json.load(gzip.open(run+'/read-trace.json.gz','rt')); k=tr['keyAt']; T=lambda t: round((t-k)/1000,2)
  es=[e for e in tr['trace'] if e['t']>=k]
  esm=[e for e in es if e.get('k') in ('sync','late','spin') and (e.get('f') or '').endswith('Morrowind.esm') and e.get('ms',0)>=50]
  ww=[e for e in es if e.get('k')=='wwait']
  reads=[e for e in es if e.get('k') in ('sync','late','spin') and e['t']<(esm[0]['t'] if esm else 1e18)]
  lo=[e for e in es if e.get('k')=='jspi' and e.get('ev')=='loading']
  print(run.split('/')[-1][:16], 'inWorld', T(tr['inWorldAt']) if tr.get('inWorldAt') else None,
        'wwaits', [(T(e['t']),e.get('ms')) for e in ww], 'loadOff', T(lo[-1]['t']) if lo else None,
        'esm serial', (T(esm[0]['t']), T(esm[-1]['t']+esm[-1]['ms']), len(esm)) if esm else None,
        'reads before', len(reads), 'readMs', sum(e.get('ms',0) for e in reads))
```

```sh
du -sh $O
```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/validation3/scripts/dups.py`:

```py
# requests of the same file range overlapping in time on the link (asked twice at once), from a run's proxy log
import gzip,json,sys,re,collections
for run in sys.argv[1:]:
  px=[json.loads(l) for l in gzip.open(run+'/proxy.jsonl.gz','rt') if l.strip()]
  by=collections.defaultdict(list)
  for p in px:
    m=re.search(r'/gamez/[^/]+/([^?]*)\?r=(\d+)-(\d+)',p.get('url',''))
    if m and 'ms' in p: by[(m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3))].append((p['t'],p['t']+p['ms'],p.get('wire',0)))
  n=0; wire=0; big=[]
  for k,v in by.items():
    v.sort()
    for i in range(1,len(v)):
      if any(v[i][0]<v[j][1] for j in range(i)): n+=1; wire+=v[i][2]; big.append((v[i][2],k[0].split('/')[-1],k[1]))
  big.sort(reverse=True)
  print(run.split('/')[-1][:24], 'ranges asked again while on the link:', n, 'wire MB', round(wire/1e6,2), big[:3])
```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/validation3/scripts/memlog.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# avail/load every 30 s; under 16 GB available: this validation's own measuring jobs (their command line names this scratch or its ports) stopped
L=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19/v3/logs/memory.log
while true; do
  a=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')
  echo "$(date +%T) avail=${a}G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) disk=$(du -s /tmp/orthros-scratch 2>/dev/null | awk '{printf "%.1fG", $1/1048576}')" >> $L
  if [ "$a" -lt 16 ]; then
    for p in $(pgrep -f '^node tools/openmw/[^ ]*\.mjs .*(orthros-scratch/data-r19|127\.0\.0\.1:189[0-9][0-9])'); do
      echo "$(date +%T) LOW MEMORY ${a}G: killing $p $(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | cut -c1-150)" >> $L; kill $p
    done
  fi
  sleep 30
done
```

```py
# a save load's phases from its read trace: key -> first announced batch, the loading screen's reads, the serial esm reads after it, their end -> in world
import gzip,json,sys
for run in sys.argv[1:]:
  tr=json.load(gzip.open(run+'/read-trace.json.gz','rt')); k=tr['keyAt']; T=lambda t: round((t-k)/1000,2)
  es=[e for e in tr['trace'] if e['t']>=k]
  esm=[e for e in es if e.get('k') in ('sync','late','spin') and (e.get('f') or '').endswith('Morrowind.esm') and e.get('ms',0)>=50]
  ww=[e for e in es if e.get('k')=='wwait']
  reads=[e for e in es if e.get('k') in ('sync','late','spin') and e['t']<(esm[0]['t'] if esm else 1e18)]
  lo=[e for e in es if e.get('k')=='jspi' and e.get('ev')=='loading']
  print(run.split('/')[-1][:16], 'inWorld', T(tr['inWorldAt']) if tr.get('inWorldAt') else None,
        'wwaits', [(T(e['t']),e.get('ms')) for e in ww], 'loadOff', T(lo[-1]['t']) if lo else None,
        'esm serial', (T(esm[0]['t']), T(esm[-1]['t']+esm[-1]['ms']), len(esm)) if esm else None,
        'reads before', len(reads), 'readMs', sum(e.get('ms',0) for e in reads))
```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/validation3/scripts/summary3.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The third full validation's numbers by side (r18 live, r19a = r19dev-a): place-load rows (<R>/pl-<side>-<kind>.jsonl),
perf.json files (<R>/perf/<side>-N/), the two-client runs (<R>/mp/<side>-N/). usage: summary3.py <results dir>"""
import json, os, sys, glob, statistics
R = sys.argv[1]; SIDES = ['r18', 'r19a']
def rows(f):
    p = os.path.join(R, f)
    return [json.loads(l) for l in open(p)] if os.path.exists(p) else []
def rng(xs):
    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    if not xs: return '-'
    s = f'{min(xs)}' if min(xs) == max(xs) else f'{min(xs)}-{max(xs)}'
    return s + (f' med {round(statistics.median(xs), 3)}' if len(xs) > 2 else '') + f' ({len(xs)})'
def each(xs): return '[' + ' '.join(str(x) for x in xs) + ']'
for kind in ['save', 'coe', 'saveNew', 'save85k', 'forced', 'glide85k']:
    for side in SIDES:
        Rw = rows(f'pl-{side}-{kind}.jsonl')
        if not Rw: continue
        J = [r.get('jspiProbe') or {} for r in Rw]
        A = [r.get('jspiAfter') or {} for r in Rw]
        E = [(j.get('engine') or {}) for j in J]
        inW = [(r.get('load') or {}).get('inWorldS') for r in Rw]
        print(f'{kind:8} {side:4}: tags {each([r.get("tag") for r in Rw])}\n'
              f'   menu {rng([(r.get("engineStart") or {}).get("menuS") for r in Rw])}  firstFrame {rng([(r.get("engineStart") or {}).get("firstFrameS") for r in Rw])}'
              f'  inWorld(key->world) {rng(inW)} each {each(inW)}  steady {rng([(r.get("load") or {}).get("steadyS") for r in Rw])}\n'
              f'   block {rng([j.get("blockMaxMs") for j in J])}  input p50 {rng([j.get("inputP50Ms") for j in J])} p95 {rng([j.get("inputP95Ms") for j in J])}'
              f'  freeze(frameGapMax) {rng([j.get("frameGapMaxMs") for j in J])}  after-gap {rng([a.get("frameGapMaxMs") for a in A])}\n'
              f'   lateOld {rng([(r.get("precompile") or {}).get("lateOld") for r in Rw])}  timeouts {rng([((r.get("stage3") or {}).get("load") or {}).get("timeouts") for r in Rw])}'
              f'  suspended {rng([e.get("suspendedMs") for e in E])}  faults {sum(len(r.get("faults") or []) for r in Rw)} errors {sum(1 for r in Rw if r.get("error"))}')
for side in SIDES:
    P = []
    for d in sorted((d for d in glob.glob(os.path.join(R, 'perf', f'{side}-*')) if d.rsplit('-', 1)[1].isdigit()), key=lambda d: int(d.rsplit('-', 1)[1])):
        f = os.path.join(d, 'perf.json')
        if os.path.exists(f): P.append((os.path.basename(d), json.load(open(f))))
    if P:
        p99 = [p["work"]["p99"] for _, p in P]; fps = [p.get("fps") for _, p in P]
        print(f'play     {side:4}: runs {len(P)}  fps {rng(fps)} each {each(fps)}\n   work p99 {rng(p99)} each {each(p99)}  p50 {rng([p["work"]["p50"] for _, p in P])}'
              f'  longest gap {rng([p["gap"]["max"] for _, p in P])}  stalls/min {rng([p.get("dataStallMs") for _, p in P])}')
for side in SIDES:
    out = []
    for d in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(R, 'mp', f'{side}-*'))):
        r = os.path.join(d, 'result.json')
        if os.path.exists(r):
            j = json.load(open(r)); out.append(f'{os.path.basename(d)}:{j.get("pass", j.get("ok"))}')
        else: out.append(f'{os.path.basename(d)}:?')
    if out: print(f'mp       {side:4}: ' + ' '.join(out))

```

`tools/openmw/results/r19-2026-10-31/validation3/scripts/val.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Full validation of r19dev-a (engine 515236e0e051, this tree's page at 18b5143) against the LIVE r18 (data/engines, read-only),
# interleaved (order alternated), one browser at a time; each server its own copy of v3/pristine (the live learned state and
# br-cache copied at 08:19, the br-cache frozen: the one lean package 2c6b8e83 both engines' openmw.data share)
S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19; V=$S/v3; R=$V/res; B=$V/bin
E18=openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r18; EA=openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r19dev-a
mkdir -p $R/perf $R/mp
step() { echo "=== $(date +%T) $*"; }
pair() { # pair <i> <fn18> <fn19>: odd i r18 first
  if [ $(($1 % 2)) = 1 ]; then $2; $3; else $3; $2; fi; }
FORCED='--memlog=all-renderers --memlog-sampling-rate=100000 --memlog-stack-mode=native'
step warm-ups; $B/pl.sh 18 r18-warm $R/pl-r18-warm.jsonl --mode save --warm-only; $B/pl.sh 19a r19a-warm $R/pl-r19a-warm.jsonl --mode save --warm-only
for i in 1 2 3 4; do
  step save $i; pair $i "$B/pl.sh 18 r18-save-$i $R/pl-r18-save.jsonl --mode save" "$B/pl.sh 19a r19a-save-$i $R/pl-r19a-save.jsonl --mode save"
  step coe $i;  pair $((i+1)) "$B/pl.sh 18 r18-coe-$i $R/pl-r18-coe.jsonl --mode coe" "$B/pl.sh 19a r19a-coe-$i $R/pl-r19a-coe.jsonl --mode coe"
done

  step perf $i; pair $i "$B/perf.sh $E18 18961 $R/perf/r18-$i $P" "$B/perf.sh $EA 18962 $R/perf/r19a-$i $P"
done

  step new $i; pair $i "$B/pl.sh 18 r18-saveNew-$i $R/pl-r18-saveNew.jsonl --mode save --profile new --read-trace" "$B/pl.sh 19a r19a-saveNew-$i $R/pl-r19a-saveNew.jsonl --mode save --profile new --read-trace"
  step 85k $i; pair $((i+1)) "$B/pl.sh 18 r18-save85k-$i $R/pl-r18-save85k.jsonl --mode save --rate 85k --read-trace" "$B/pl.sh 19a r19a-save85k-$i $R/pl-r19a-save85k.jsonl --mode save --rate 85k --read-trace"
done
step frame-compare; $B/srvrun.sh $EA 18965 $R/fc tools/openmw/frame-compare.mjs --variant '' --variant jspi=0 --out $R/fc/out
step check; $B/srvrun.sh $EA 18966 $R/check-en tools/openmw/check.mjs --seconds 10; $B/srvrun.sh $EA 18967 $R/check-fr tools/openmw/check.mjs --lang fr --seconds 10
step mp
$B/mp.sh $EA $R/mp/r19a-1; $B/mp.sh $E18 $R/mp/r18-1; $B/mp.sh $EA $R/mp/r19a-2; $B/mp.sh $EA $R/mp/r19a-3; $B/mp.sh $E18 $R/mp/r18-2; $B/mp.sh $EA $R/mp/r19a-4
step forced
ORTHROS_CHROME_ARGS="$FORCED" $B/pl.sh 19a r19a-forced-save $R/pl-r19a-forced.jsonl --mode save
ORTHROS_CHROME_ARGS="$FORCED" $B/pl.sh 19a r19a-forced-coe $R/pl-r19a-forced.jsonl --mode coe
```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Two more new-device pairs (in the first two, r19a's menu 26.5-27.1 s against 25.1-25.8 and its F9 12.3 against 10.9-11.2): 4 a side

while pgrep -f "^/bin/bash $V/bin/val.sh" >/dev/null; do sleep 10; done
for i in 3 4; do
  echo "=== $(date +%T) new $i"
  if [ $((i % 2)) = 1 ]; then
    $B/pl.sh 18 r18-saveNew-$i $R/pl-r18-saveNew.jsonl --mode save --profile new --read-trace; $B/pl.sh 19a r19a-saveNew-$i $R/pl-r19a-saveNew.jsonl --mode save --profile new --read-trace

  fi

echo "=== $(date +%T) VAL2 DONE"
```

```md
# OpenMW engine orthros-r20 — smoke check of the INSTALLED release (2026-10-31)

The release `openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20` (engine `ecdde7a22836`, built by build.sh at 6a487c0, installed in
data/engines) checked as it would be served, before the switch. The live service still runs r19 (main 414dce8); nothing
merged, pushed, switched or restarted.

Setup (scripts/):
- A fresh copy of the live learned state and br-cache, made at 18:09 (`logs/copied-at.txt`). The br-cache was frozen and
  includes lean3 of package 2c6b8e83 (4,133,415 bytes), which r19 and r20 share.
- A scratch games folder (`overlay.mjs`, place-load's `scratchGames`): every Morrowind version (goty-en/fr,
  goty-vanilla-plus-en/fr) names r20; the live folder is only read. Servers ran data-r15's code with
  `--engines-dir /srv/orthros/data/engines` (read only).
- The page fetched `/engines/openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20/e/` with js/wasm from the pinned hashes 421d60e9… /
  82ee01a1… (`check/engine-url-fr.txt`).
- One browser at a time through tools/with-browser-slot.sh. Memory was logged every 30 s (`logs/memory.log`): the lowest
  available was 43 GB and nothing came near 16 GB.

Results (`summary.txt`):
- **check.mjs** `morrowind-goty-vanilla-plus-en` passed in both languages:
  - EN: 38,628 draws.
  - `--lang fr` (ran goty-vanilla-plus-fr): 35,148 draws.
  - Both: cross-origin isolated, header fps 60, "Saved in this browser".
- **overlay-check.mjs** `--engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20` passed for both games (morrowind,
  morrowind-vanilla-plus): all overlays agree with their originals.
- **Warm save** (`--mode save --input-trace --input-block 2000`). R is the installed release (its own warm-up,
  `warm-r20R.json`). C is r20dev-c, run on the fair validation's warm profile (jspi5/w20c).

  | | menu | F9 → world | steady | frozen | input p50 / p95 / max | page block | 2 s block check |
  |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
  | R | 7.4 s | 3.8 s | 6.1 s | 1,917 ms | 655 / 2,602 / 2,902 ms over 179 events (none unanswered) | 898 ms | first 2,000 ms, residual ≤ 47 ms |
  | C | 7.4 s | 3.9 s | 11.1 s | 1,900 ms | 497 / 2,014 / 2,239 ms over 179 events (none unanswered) | 2,008 ms | first 1,997 ms, residual ≤ 42 ms |

  Both sides are within noise: the fair validation's six r20c runs had input p95 1,962–2,758 ms, page block
  403–2,023 ms, F9 4.0–4.1 s and one steady at 11.6 s.
- **COE** (`--mode coe`):
  - R: frozen 1,750 ms, cell reached 3.7 s, steady 5.8 s, coeSync 2,559 ms, page block 220 ms.
  - C: frozen 1,533 ms, cell reached 3.6 s, steady 5.7 s, coeSync 2,426 ms, page block 217 ms.
  - Both are within noise.
- **JSPI is on in the page:**
  - The release's openmw.js has the `_orthros_jspi` exports, `WebAssembly.Suspending` and `promising`.
  - Both COEs ran in the frame through `orthros_jspi`: `coeInFrame: true`.
  - `jspiProbe.engine.on: true`, with these suspensions:

    | | R | C |
    |---|---|---|
    | save, suspended | 2,408 ms | 2,407 ms |
    | COE, suspended | 3,053 ms | 2,793 ms |
    | soonSuspends | 9 | 9 |

  - The two-client pages counted suspensions as well: suspendedMs 3,306 and 5,579, soonSuspends 29 and 87.
  - **lateOld 0** in all four rows.
- **Two clients** (r17 mp-check.mjs, the installed release, `--engines-dir data/engines`): PASS, 9/9 checks, 222 s,
  no page error (`mp/r20R-1`).
- **Faults:** the only page faults were headless Chromium's "The root document of this element is not valid for pointer
  lock." (1 in each save row, 2 in each COE row), the same as in the earlier validations.
- **Kernel log:** no new chrome segfault or OOM kill since 18:09. `logs/dmesg-segfault-before.txt` and `-after.txt`
  are identical; the last chrome segfault is 06:06:37 that morning.
- **Load:** the one-minute load reached 28.6 during the runs (shared host); every browser start went through the slot
  gate.

Verdict: the installed r20 behaves like the validated r20dev-c.
```

`tools/openmw/results/r20-release-2026-10-31/scripts/memlog.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# avail/load every 30 s; under 16 GB available: this task's own measuring jobs (node tools/openmw/*.mjs naming r20-rel scratch) stopped
L=/tmp/orthros-scratch/r20-rel/logs/memory.log
while true; do
  a=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')
  echo "$(date +%T) avail=${a}G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) disk=$(du -s /tmp/orthros-scratch 2>/dev/null | awk '{printf "%.1fG", $1/1048576}')" >> $L
  if [ "$a" -lt 16 ]; then
    for p in $(pgrep -f '^node tools/openmw/[^ ]*\.mjs .*orthros-scratch/r20-rel'); do
      echo "$(date +%T) LOW MEMORY ${a}G: killing $p $(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | cut -c1-150)" >> $L; kill $p
    done
  fi
  sleep 30
done
```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# warm-up of R, then save (input trace, 2 s block check) R, C; COE C, R — one browser at a time
T=/tmp/orthros-scratch/r20-rel; B=$T/bin; R=$T/res
step() { echo "=== $(date +%T) $*"; }
step warm-up R; [ -d $T/w20R/profile-warm ] || $B/pl.sh R r20R-warm $R/pl-r20R-warm.jsonl --mode save --warm-only
step save R; $B/pl.sh R r20R-save-1 $R/pl-r20R-save.jsonl --mode save --input-trace --input-block 2000
step save C; $B/pl.sh C r20c-save-1 $R/pl-r20c-save.jsonl --mode save --input-trace --input-block 2000
step coe C; $B/pl.sh C r20c-coe-1 $R/pl-r20c-coe.jsonl --mode coe
step coe R; $B/pl.sh R r20R-coe-1 $R/pl-r20R-coe.jsonl --mode coe
step PL DONE
```

`tools/openmw/results/r20-release-2026-10-31/scripts/pl.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: pl.sh <R|C> <tag> <out jsonl> [place-load options...]
#   R: the INSTALLED openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20 (data/engines read only, its own .br), own warm profile (w20R, its own warm-up)
#   C: the validated dev build r20dev-c (jspi4, --engine-br), the fair validation's warm profile (jspi5/w20c, read: each run copies it)
#   both: this task's fresh pristine learned state + frozen br-cache copy, data-r19's -2,6 save
T=/tmp/orthros-scratch/r20-rel; S=/tmp/orthros-scratch/data-r19; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
side=$1; tag=$2; out=$3; shift 3
case $side in
  R) eng=(--engines-dir /srv/orthros/data/engines --engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20); dir=(--scratch $T/w20R) ;;
  C) eng=(--engines-dir $S/eng --engine openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20dev-c --engine-br); dir=(--scratch $T/w20c --profile-warm /tmp/orthros-scratch/jspi5/w20c/profile-warm) ;;
  *) echo "side?"; exit 2 ;;
esac
/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh -w 24 || exit 3
echo "$(date +%T) avail=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) place-load side=$side tag=$tag $*" >> $T/logs/runs-started.txt
cd $W && exec /srv/orthros/tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/openmw/place-load.mjs morrowind-goty-en --tree $W --warm-tree $W "${dir[@]}" --pristine $T/pristine "${eng[@]}" --save $S/saves/-2_6.omwsave --runs 1 --tag "$tag" --out "$out" "$@"

```

`tools/openmw/results/r20-release-2026-10-31/scripts/srvrun.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: srvrun.sh <port> <out dir> <tool script> <manifest> [args...]: a server of data-r15's code on the r20 overlay
# (games-r20: every Morrowind version on openmw-web-v1.5.3-orthros-r20), --engines-dir data/engines (read only), a fresh
# copy of the pristine learned state, the frozen br-cache copy (lean3 included); the tool through the browser slot
T=/tmp/orthros-scratch/r20-rel; W=/srv/orthros/.claude/worktrees/data-r15
port=$1; out=$2; tool=$3; shift 3
run=$T/srv-$port; /bin/rm -rf $run; mkdir -p $run $out
cp -a $T/pristine/learn $run/learn
/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh -w 24 || exit 3
echo "$(date +%T) avail=$(/srv/orthros/tools/mem-check.sh | tr -d '\n')G load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) $tool $out $*" >> $T/logs/runs-started.txt
cd $W
node src/host/server.js --port $port --games-dir $T/games-r20 --engines-dir /srv/orthros/data/engines --learn $run/learn --telemetry $run/tel --br-cache $T/pristine/brcache --br-cache-frozen --covers off --no-home-preload > $run/server.log 2>&1 &
srv=$!
for i in $(seq 60); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:$port/api/manifests >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:$port/api/manifest/$1 > $out/manifest-api.json; curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:$port/ports/openmw/$1/app/index.html?src=hosted" | grep -o "/engines/[^\"]*" | head -3 > $out/engine-url.txt
/srv/orthros/tools/with-browser-slot.sh node $tool "$@" --url http://127.0.0.1:$port > $out/tool.log 2>&1
rc=$?
kill $srv; wait $srv 2>/dev/null
cp $run/server.log $out/server.log; /bin/rm -rf $run
echo "$tool rc=$rc $out" | tee -a $out/tool.log

```

`tools/openmw/results/r20-release-2026-10-31/scripts/summary.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The installed r20's smoke check: place-load rows by side (R = the installed release, C = r20dev-c) and the JSPI evidence,
the two-client runs. usage: summary.py <results dir>"""
import json, os, sys, glob
R = sys.argv[1]
def rows(f):
    p = os.path.join(R, f)
    return [json.loads(l) for l in open(p)] if os.path.exists(p) else []
g = lambda o, *k: ([o := (o or {}).get(x) for x in k][-1])
for kind in ['save', 'coe']:
    for side in ['r20R', 'r20c']:
        for r in rows(f'pl-{side}-{kind}.jsonl'):
            j = r.get('jspiProbe') or {}; it = r.get('inputTrace') or {}; s = g(r, 'streamfs', 'load') or {}
            print(f'{kind:4} {side}: tag {r.get("tag")} engine {g(r, "engine", "engine")} error {str(r.get("error"))[:100]} faults {len(r.get("faults") or [])}')
            print(f'   menu {g(r, "engineStart", "menuS")} firstFrame {g(r, "engineStart", "firstFrameS")} engine inWorld {g(r, "engineStart", "inWorldS")}'
                  f'  load: F9/COE->world {g(r, "load", "inWorldS")} cellReached {g(r, "load", "cellReachedS")} steady {g(r, "load", "steadyS")}'
                  f' frozen {g(r, "load", "frozenMs")} coeInFrame {g(r, "load", "coeInFrame")} coeSync {g(r, "load", "coeSyncMs")}')
            print(f'   page block {j.get("blockMaxMs")} freeze {j.get("frameGapMaxMs")} suspended {g(j, "engine", "suspendedMs")}'
                  f'  soonSuspends {s.get("soonSuspends")} stallMs {round(s.get("stallMs") or 0)} lateOld {g(r, "precompile", "lateOld")}')
            if it:
                print(f'   input p50 {it.get("p50Ms")} p95 {it.get("p95Ms")} max {it.get("maxMs")} events {it.get("events")} unanswered {it.get("unanswered")}'
                      f'  block check: first {g(it, "block", "firstMs")} residual max {g(it, "block", "residual", "max")} moves {g(it, "block", "events")}')
for d in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(R, 'mp', '*'))):
    f = os.path.join(d, 'result.json')
    if not os.path.exists(f): print(f'mp {os.path.basename(d)}: ?'); continue
    m = json.load(open(f)); c = m.get('checks') or {}
    print(f'mp {os.path.basename(d)}: engine {m.get("engine")} ok {m.get("ok")} seconds {m.get("seconds")} checks {sum(1 for v in c.values() if (v or {}).get("ok"))}/{len(c)}'
          f' failed {[k for k, v in c.items() if not (v or {}).get("ok")]} faults {m.get("faults")}')

```

`tools/openmw/server-node.Dockerfile`:

```Dockerfile
# The native multiplayer gateway's image (tools/openmw/server.mjs): the pinned upstream image (lock.json "serverImage")
# with its Node.js replaced by the official release lock.json "serverBuild"."node" names (nodejs.org linux-x64 tarball,
# its SHA-256 checked here again), same major version, so the gateway's N-API addon (@node-rs/argon2) loads as before.
# Everything else (OpenMW binary, gateway bundle, entrypoint, user, env, healthcheck) is the upstream image's.
# Built by tools/openmw/build-server-image.sh, without network; its image ID is recorded in lock.json.
ARG BASE
FROM ${BASE}
ARG BASE
ARG NODE_VERSION
ARG NODE_SHA256
# (the tarball only bind-mounted: not kept in a layer; the image has no xz, its p7zip unpacks it; the upstream layout kept — /usr/bin/node, npm and corepack in
# /usr/lib/node_modules, their /usr/bin links unchanged, headers in /usr/include/node)
RUN --mount=type=bind,source=node.tar.xz,target=/tmp/node.tar.xz \
    echo "${NODE_SHA256}  /tmp/node.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c - \
 && mkdir /tmp/node && 7z x -so -txz /tmp/node.tar.xz | tar -xf - -C /tmp/node --strip-components=1 --no-same-owner \
 && install -m 755 /tmp/node/bin/node /usr/bin/node \
 && rm -rf /usr/lib/node_modules/npm /usr/lib/node_modules/corepack /usr/include/node \
 && cp -R /tmp/node/lib/node_modules/npm /tmp/node/lib/node_modules/corepack /usr/lib/node_modules/ \
 && cp -R /tmp/node/include/node /usr/include/node \
 && rm -rf /tmp/node \
 && test "$(node --version)" = "v${NODE_VERSION}" \
 && cd /app && node -e "require('@node-rs/argon2').hashSync('x')" \
 && node --version > /usr/local/share/orthros-node.txt
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.base.name="${BASE}" org.orthros.node.version="${NODE_VERSION}" org.orthros.node.sha256="${NODE_SHA256}"

```

`tools/openmw/server.mjs`:

```mjs
// One pinned OpenMW-Web gateway and its native simulation peers. Docker's published port
// is localhost only; Orthros owns the public HTTP/WebSocket routes. No game data in images.
// Usage: node tools/openmw/server.mjs <manifest> [--games-dir dir] [--engines-dir dir] [--state-dir dir] [--origin url] [--port n]
//   --port: the localhost port instead of the manifest's (a scratch gateway beside the live one; its container named
//   after it too)
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { spawn, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { loadGameCatalog, DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR } from '../../src/host/game-catalog.js';
import { linkGameLayers, engineFile, DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR } from '../../src/host/goldsrc.js';
import { openmwInstalled, openmwGatewayImage, openmwSimSettings, openmwVersionSettings, warmGatewayLists, OPENMW_SIM_SETTINGS, OPENMW_STATE_DIR } from '../../src/host/openmw.js';
import { resolveGameFile } from '../../src/host/game-files.js';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), id = args[0], arg = (k) => args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : null;
const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const games = path.resolve(arg('--games-dir') ?? DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR);
const man = loadGameCatalog(games).get(id);
if (man?.runtime !== 'openmw' || !man.openmw.multiplayer) throw new Error('Expected an OpenMW multiplayer manifest');
const missing = man.openmw.files.filter((f) => !resolveGameFile(man, f));
const engines = path.resolve(arg('--engines-dir') ?? DEFAULT_ENGINES_DIR);
if (!openmwInstalled(man, engines)) throw new Error(`Installation incomplete: ${missing.join(', ')}; install the engine and finish the declared mod stack before starting multiplayer`);
const releaseOf = (id) => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(engineFile(engines, id, 'release.json')));
const release = releaseOf(man.openmw.engine);
// (the upstream release's pinned image, or the one lock.json derives from it — its Node.js replaced —, by its ID)
const lock = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'tools/openmw/lock.json'), 'utf8'));
const { image: serverImage, tag } = openmwGatewayImage(release, releaseOf, lock);
if (tag && spawnSync('docker', ['image', 'inspect', serverImage], { stdio: 'ignore' }).status !== 0)
  throw new Error(`Gateway image ${tag} (${serverImage}) not built here: sh tools/openmw/build-server-image.sh`);
const state = path.resolve(arg('--state-dir') ?? path.join(OPENMW_STATE_DIR, id));
const base = `/ports/openmw/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/app`;
const port = Number(arg('--port') ?? man.openmw.multiplayer.port);
if (!Number.isInteger(port) || port < 1024 || port > 65535) throw new Error('--port: expected a port number');
const name = `orthros-openmw-${id}${arg('--port') ? '-' + port : ''}`;
const origin = new URL(arg('--origin') ?? process.env.ORTHROS_ORIGIN ?? 'http://localhost:8080').origin;
fs.mkdirSync(state, { recursive: true });
// Only this generated linked tree is rebuilt. The installed game and version files are read-only.
linkGameLayers(man, path.join(state, 'gamedata'));
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(state, 'modlist.json'), JSON.stringify({ version: 2, entries: [], mods: (man.openmw.mods ?? []).flatMap((mod) => (mod.parts ?? []).map((part, i) => ({
  slug: `${mod.id}-${i}`, name: mod.name, archive: mod.sha256 ?? mod.url ?? '', source: part.source,
  enabled: true, installedAt: mod.installedAt ?? '', plugins: part.plugins.map((file) => ({ file, enabled: true })), archives: part.archives, files: part.files, bytes: part.bytes,
}))) }, null, 2) + '\n');
if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(state, 'config.toml'))) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(state, 'config.toml'), `[server]\nname = ${JSON.stringify(man.name)}\nmaxPlayers = ${man.openmw.multiplayer.maxPlayers ?? 8}\n\n[setup]\ncompleted = true\ndeploymentMode = "multiplayer"\ndeliveryModel = "serve"\nhosting = "internal"\n\n[locker]\npublicBase = ${JSON.stringify(origin + base)}\n\n[auth]\nreturnUrl = ${JSON.stringify(origin + base + '/join')}\n\n[worlds]\nmemBudgetMb = 3072\ngatewayReserveMb = 256\n\n[rules]\npvp = false\n${man.openmw.startCell ? '\n[simPeer]\nstartCell = ' + JSON.stringify(man.openmw.startCell) + '\n' : ''}`, { mode: 0o600 });
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(state, '.mode'), 'gateway\n');
// (the version's own settings defaults for its simulation peers too, the rules its players' pages get — AI, combat,
// prices —: the image's peers read this file as additional defaults, src/host/openmw.js OPENMW_SIM_SETTINGS; rewritten
// in place at each start, before the container mounts it)
const simSettings = path.join(state, 'sim-settings.cfg');
fs.writeFileSync(simSettings, openmwSimSettings(man)); fs.chmodSync(simSettings, 0o644);
console.log(`openmw.sim_settings ${Object.values(openmwVersionSettings(man)).reduce((n, kv) => n + Object.keys(kv).length, 0)} version settings for the simulation peers`);
const child = spawn('docker', ['run', '--rm', '--init', '--name', name, '--cpus=2', '--memory=4g', '--pids-limit=256',
  '-p', `127.0.0.1:${port}:8080`, '-v', `${state}:/data`, '-v', `${games}:${games}:ro`, '-v', `${simSettings}:${OPENMW_SIM_SETTINGS}:ro`,
  '--log-driver=json-file', '--log-opt=max-size=10m', '--log-opt=max-file=3', serverImage], { stdio: 'inherit' });
// Docker forwards terminal signals to its own container. Never signal another service/process.
for (const signal of ['SIGINT', 'SIGTERM']) process.on(signal, () => { if (child.exitCode === null) child.kill(signal); });
child.on('error', (e) => { console.error(e.message); process.exitCode = 1; });
child.on('exit', (code) => { process.exitCode = code ?? 1; });
// (its data lists built now, not for its first player: the gateway walks the game tree and the mods on their first
// request — 1.5-2.8 s each — and keeps them for its life; docs/openmw.md "The gateway's lists")
warmGatewayLists({ port, alive: () => child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null, log: (l) => console.log(l) })
  .catch((e) => console.error('openmw.lists_warm', e?.message ?? e));

```

`tools/oracle/oracle.S`:

```S
# Native x86-32 reference oracle — assembly part.
# Freestanding: no libc. Provides _start, raw syscalls, and run_case which executes a test
# snippet at CODE_BASE with a fully controlled register/flag/FPU/SSE state, then captures the
# resulting state. See oracle.c for the record layouts and oracle.md for the protocol.

.intel_syntax noprefix
.text

.globl _start
_start:
    call main
    mov ebx, eax
    mov eax, 1              # exit
    int 0x80

# int sys3(int nr, int a, int b, int c)
.globl sys3
sys3:
    push ebx
    mov eax, [esp+8]
    mov ebx, [esp+12]
    mov ecx, [esp+16]
    mov edx, [esp+20]
    int 0x80
    pop ebx
    ret

# int sys6(int nr, int a, int b, int c, int d, int e, int f)
.globl sys6
sys6:
    push ebx
    push esi
    push edi
    push ebp
    mov eax, [esp+20]
    mov ebx, [esp+24]
    mov ecx, [esp+28]
    mov edx, [esp+32]
    mov esi, [esp+36]
    mov edi, [esp+40]
    mov ebp, [esp+44]
    int 0x80
    pop ebp
    pop edi
    pop esi
    pop ebx
    ret

# Signal return trampoline (SA_RESTORER).
.globl sig_restorer
sig_restorer:
    mov eax, 173            # rt_sigreturn
    int 0x80

# Record layouts (must match oracle.c / gen_cases.py):
.set CASE_REGS,   4
.set CASE_EFLAGS, 36
.set CASE_FX,     112
.set RES_REGS,    0
.set RES_EFLAGS,  32
.set RES_FX,      48

.globl code_entry
.globl saved_esp
.data
.align 4
code_entry: .long 0x20000000
saved_esp:  .long 0

.text
# void run_case(void): g_case -> execute -> g_result
.globl run_case
run_case:
    push ebx
    push esi
    push edi
    push ebp
    mov [saved_esp], esp
    fxrstor [g_case + CASE_FX]
    push dword ptr [g_case + CASE_EFLAGS]
    popfd
    mov eax, [g_case + CASE_REGS + 0]
    mov ecx, [g_case + CASE_REGS + 4]
    mov edx, [g_case + CASE_REGS + 8]
    mov ebx, [g_case + CASE_REGS + 12]
    mov ebp, [g_case + CASE_REGS + 20]
    mov esi, [g_case + CASE_REGS + 24]
    mov edi, [g_case + CASE_REGS + 28]
    mov esp, [g_case + CASE_REGS + 16]
    jmp dword ptr [code_entry]

# The snippet is followed by `jmp epilogue` written by main().
.globl epilogue
epilogue:
    mov [g_result + RES_REGS + 0], eax
    mov [g_result + RES_REGS + 4], ecx
    mov [g_result + RES_REGS + 8], edx
    mov [g_result + RES_REGS + 12], ebx
    mov [g_result + RES_REGS + 16], esp
    mov [g_result + RES_REGS + 20], ebp
    mov [g_result + RES_REGS + 24], esi
    mov [g_result + RES_REGS + 28], edi
    mov esp, [saved_esp]
    pushfd
    pop dword ptr [g_result + RES_EFLAGS]
    fxsave [g_result + RES_FX]
    # sanitize flags the snippet may have set (TF, DF, AC) before returning to C code
    pushfd
    and dword ptr [esp], 0xfffbfaff
    popfd
    pop ebp
    pop edi
    pop esi
    pop ebx
    ret

# Reached from the signal handler with esp = saved_esp (registers already captured from the
# signal context by the C handler).
.globl fault_exit
fault_exit:
    fxsave [g_result + RES_FX]
    cld
    pop ebp
    pop edi
    pop esi
    pop ebx
    ret

```

`tools/oracle/oracle.c`:

```c
// Native x86-32 reference oracle — C part (freestanding, no libc).
//
// Protocol: reads fixed-size Case records from stdin, executes each snippet natively on the
// host CPU, writes a Result record to stdout. EOF on stdin ends the run.
//
// Memory map (identical offsets are used inside Orthros' guest memory):
//   SCRATCH 0x10000000  64 KB rw   first MEM_SIZE bytes initialized from Case.mem, returned in Result.mem
//   CODE    0x20000000  64 KB rwx  Case.code followed by `jmp epilogue`
//
// Record layouts (keep in sync with oracle.S and tools/gen/gen_cases.py):
//   Case   (2688 bytes): magic u32 @0, regs[8] @4, eflags @36, codeLen @40, code[64] @48,
//                        fx[512] @112 (FXRSTOR image), mem[2048] @624
//   Result (2624 bytes): regs[8] @0, eflags @32, fault @36, faultEip @40, fx[512] @48 (FXSAVE
//                        image), mem[2048] @560

typedef unsigned int u32;
typedef unsigned char u8;

#define SCRATCH 0x10000000u
#define CODE 0x20000000u
#define REGION 0x10000u
#define MEM_SIZE 2048
#define CODE_MAX 64
#define MAGIC 0x3143524fu /* 'ORC1' */

struct Case {
  u32 magic;
  u32 regs[8];
  u32 eflags;
  u32 codeLen;
  u32 pad0;
  u8 code[CODE_MAX];
  u8 fx[512];
  u8 mem[MEM_SIZE];
  u8 pad1[16];
} __attribute__((aligned(16)));

struct Result {
  u32 regs[8];
  u32 eflags;
  u32 fault;
  u32 faultEip;
  u32 pad0;
  u8 fx[512];
  u8 mem[MEM_SIZE];
  u8 pad1[16];
} __attribute__((aligned(16)));

_Static_assert(sizeof(struct Case) == 2688, "case size");
_Static_assert(sizeof(struct Result) == 2624, "result size");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(struct Case, fx) == 112, "case fx offset");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(struct Case, mem) == 624, "case mem offset");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(struct Result, fx) == 48, "result fx offset");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(struct Result, mem) == 560, "result mem offset");

struct Case g_case;
struct Result g_result;

extern int sys3(int nr, int a, int b, int c);
extern int sys6(int nr, int a, int b, int c, int d, int e, int f);
extern void run_case(void);
extern void epilogue(void);
extern void fault_exit(void);
extern void sig_restorer(void);
extern u32 saved_esp;

#define SYS_exit 1
#define SYS_read 3
#define SYS_write 4
#define SYS_mmap2 192
#define SYS_rt_sigaction 174

static void die(const char* msg) {
  int n = 0;
  while (msg[n]) n++;
  sys3(SYS_write, 2, (int)msg, n);
  sys3(SYS_exit, 2, 0, 0);
}

static int read_full(void* buf, int len) {
  int got = 0;
  while (got < len) {
    int n = sys3(SYS_read, 0, (int)((u8*)buf + got), len - got);
    if (n == 0) return got; // EOF
    if (n < 0) die("read error\n");
    got += n;
  }
  return got;
}

static void write_full(const void* buf, int len) {
  int done = 0;
  while (done < len) {
    int n = sys3(SYS_write, 1, (int)((const u8*)buf + done), len - done);
    if (n <= 0) die("write error\n");
    done += n;
  }
}

static void memcpy_(void* d, const void* s, u32 n) {
  u8* dd = d;
  const u8* ss = s;
  while (n--) *dd++ = *ss++;
}
static void memset_(void* d, u8 v, u32 n) {
  u8* dd = d;
  while (n--) *dd++ = v;
}

// Kernel's struct sigaction for i386 rt_sigaction.
struct ksigaction {
  void (*handler)(int, void*, void*);
  u32 flags;
  void (*restorer)(void);
  u32 mask[2];
};
#define SA_SIGINFO 4
#define SA_NODEFER 0x40000000
#define SA_RESTORER 0x04000000

// i386 ucontext: uc_flags(4) uc_link(4) uc_stack(12) then sigcontext gregs.
enum { G_GS, G_FS, G_ES, G_DS, G_EDI, G_ESI, G_EBP, G_ESP, G_EBX, G_EDX, G_ECX, G_EAX, G_TRAPNO, G_ERR, G_EIP, G_CS, G_EFL };

static void on_signal(int sig, void* info, void* uctx) {
  (void)info;
  u32* g = (u32*)((u8*)uctx + 20);
  g_result.fault = sig;
  g_result.faultEip = g[G_EIP];
  g_result.regs[0] = g[G_EAX];
  g_result.regs[1] = g[G_ECX];
  g_result.regs[2] = g[G_EDX];
  g_result.regs[3] = g[G_EBX];
  g_result.regs[4] = g[G_ESP];
  g_result.regs[5] = g[G_EBP];
  g_result.regs[6] = g[G_ESI];
  g_result.regs[7] = g[G_EDI];
  g_result.eflags = g[G_EFL];
  g[G_ESP] = saved_esp;
  g[G_EIP] = (u32)fault_exit;
  g[G_EFL] &= ~(0x100u | 0x400u | 0x40000u); // clear TF, DF, AC so the harness itself keeps running
}

static void install(int sig) {
  struct ksigaction sa;
  sa.handler = on_signal;
  sa.flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_NODEFER | SA_RESTORER;
  sa.restorer = sig_restorer;
  sa.mask[0] = sa.mask[1] = 0;
  if (sys6(SYS_rt_sigaction, sig, (int)&sa, 0, 8, 0, 0) < 0) die("sigaction failed\n");
}

int main(void) {
  // PROT_READ|WRITE|EXEC = 7, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_FIXED|MAP_ANONYMOUS = 0x32
  if (sys6(SYS_mmap2, (int)SCRATCH, REGION, 3, 0x32, -1, 0) != (int)SCRATCH) die("mmap scratch failed\n");
  if (sys6(SYS_mmap2, (int)CODE, REGION, 7, 0x32, -1, 0) != (int)CODE) die("mmap code failed\n");
  install(4);  // SIGILL
  install(5);  // SIGTRAP
  install(7);  // SIGBUS
  install(8);  // SIGFPE
  install(11); // SIGSEGV

  for (;;) {
    int n = read_full(&g_case, sizeof g_case);
    if (n == 0) break;
    if (n != sizeof g_case) die("short case record\n");
    if (g_case.magic != MAGIC) die("bad magic\n");
    if (g_case.codeLen > CODE_MAX) die("code too long\n");

    memset_((void*)SCRATCH, 0, REGION);
    memcpy_((void*)SCRATCH, g_case.mem, MEM_SIZE);
    u8* code = (u8*)CODE;
    memcpy_(code, g_case.code, g_case.codeLen);
    // jmp rel32 -> epilogue
    u32 at = CODE + g_case.codeLen;
    code[g_case.codeLen] = 0xe9;
    u32 rel = (u32)epilogue - (at + 5);
    memcpy_(code + g_case.codeLen + 1, &rel, 4);
    // fill the rest with int3 so a runaway snippet traps
    memset_(code + g_case.codeLen + 5, 0xcc, REGION - g_case.codeLen - 5);

    memset_(&g_result, 0, sizeof g_result);
    // export the OS's segment selectors so the emulator can mirror them for conformance
    {
      unsigned short* sel = (unsigned short*)g_result.pad1;
      __asm__ volatile("mov %%es, %0" : "=r"(sel[0]));
      __asm__ volatile("mov %%cs, %0" : "=r"(sel[1]));
      __asm__ volatile("mov %%ss, %0" : "=r"(sel[2]));
      __asm__ volatile("mov %%ds, %0" : "=r"(sel[3]));
      __asm__ volatile("mov %%fs, %0" : "=r"(sel[4]));
      __asm__ volatile("mov %%gs, %0" : "=r"(sel[5]));
    }
    run_case();
    memcpy_(g_result.mem, (void*)SCRATCH, MEM_SIZE);
    write_full(&g_result, sizeof g_result);
  }
  return 0;
}
```

`tools/oracle/x87cc.c`:

```c
// Native runner of the x87 condition-code probe (tools/x87cc-cases.mjs, tools/x87cc-probe.mjs): runs byte sequences on
// the host FPU in 64-bit mode (the encodings used mean the same there: x87 instructions, [eax + disp] operands with
// eax < 2^32, `or word`, `mov eax, imm32`). Input file: the 256-byte data block, then (u16 length, bytes)* ; output on
// stdout: one u16 (AX after the sequence) per case. Build: clang-18 -O1 -o x87cc tools/oracle/x87cc.c
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  if (argc != 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: x87cc <cases.bin>\n"); return 2; }
  FILE *f = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
  if (!f) { perror(argv[1]); return 1; }
  uint8_t *code = mmap(NULL, 1 << 16, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE | PROT_EXEC, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_32BIT, -1, 0);
  uint8_t *data = mmap(NULL, 1 << 16, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_32BIT, -1, 0);
  if (code == MAP_FAILED || data == MAP_FAILED) { perror("mmap"); return 1; }
  uint8_t init[256], buf[4096];
  if (fread(init, 1, sizeof init, f) != sizeof init) return 1;
  uint16_t len;
  while (fread(&len, 2, 1, f) == 1) {
    if (len > sizeof buf - 8 || fread(buf, 1, len, f) != len) return 1;
    memcpy(data, init, sizeof init);
    uint32_t d = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)data;
    code[0] = 0xb8; memcpy(code + 1, &d, 4); // mov eax, data
    memcpy(code + 5, buf, len);
    code[5 + len] = 0xc3; // ret (the sequence ends with fninit)
    uint16_t ax = ((uint32_t(*)(void))code)() & 0xffff;
    fwrite(&ax, 2, 1, stdout);
  }
  return 0;
}
```
