```mjs
        const listedAgain = await until(P, 90000, (x) => x?.lobby?.valid === true && (x.lobby.characters ?? []).some((c) => c?.name === fresh));
        if (!listedAgain.ok) console.log('LOBBY', JSON.stringify({ lobby: listedAgain.state?.lobby ?? null, menu: listedAgain.state?.lobbyMenu ?? null }));
        await P.cmd(`mpdelete ${fresh}`);
        const gone = await until(P, 30000, (x) => !(x?.lobby?.characters ?? []).some((c) => c?.name === fresh));
        await check('perks', 'the test character deleted', gone.ok, { characters: (gone.state?.lobby?.characters ?? []).map((c) => c?.name) });
        const back = await join(P);
        P.slot = back.state?.slot ?? P.slot;
        await check('perks', `${P.tag} joins again as ${P.name}`, back.ok && back.state?.char === P.name, { char: back.state?.char });
      },
      async crowd() {
        // (three players or more together: every one sees every other, its lines, its stars; the shared entities owned
        // once; a fight watched by a third; one leaving and coming back; a world cheat and a garage known by all)
        const N = clients.length, [C] = clients.slice(2);
        const listed = await untilAll(60000, (st) => clients.every((c, i) => clients.every((d) => d === c || !!playerIn(st[i], d.name))));
        await check('crowd', `each lists the ${N - 1} others`, listed.ok, Object.fromEntries(clients.map((c, i) => [c.tag, (listed.states[i]?.players ?? []).map((p) => p.name)])));
        // -- all gathered at one place
        async function gather(place) {
          const spots = gathering(place, N, 3);
          for (const [i, c] of clients.entries()) await c.cmd(tpCommand(spots[i]));
          const there = await untilAll(90000, (st) => st.every((s, i) => distance(s?.pos, spots[i]) < 3));
          if (!there.ok) { await check('crowd', 'all teleported together', false, Object.fromEntries(clients.map((c, i) => [c.tag, vec(there.states[i]?.pos)]))); return false; }
          const seen = await untilAll(60000, (st) => crowdSight(clients, st).every((x) => x.ok));
          const sight = crowdSight(clients, seen.states);
          return check('crowd', 'each sees every other where it is (2 m), a copy with its name', seen.ok, { failing: sight.filter((x) => !x.ok), pairs: sight.length });
        }
        await healedAll();
        await gather(PLACES.hotel);
        // -- every player's line seen by all
        const tag = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
        for (const c of clients) await c.cmd(`say crowd ${c.tag} ${tag}`);
        const lines = await untilAll(60000, (st) => st.every((s) => clients.every((c) => chatHas(s, `crowd ${c.tag} ${tag}`))));
        await check('crowd', 'every player\'s line seen by all', lines.ok,
          Object.fromEntries(clients.map((c, i) => [c.tag, clients.filter((d) => !chatHas(lines.states[i], `crowd ${d.tag} ${tag}`)).map((d) => d.tag)])));
        // -- the shared entities: one owner each, copies on the others near them, no copy of nobody's
        await sleep(Math.min(20000, Math.max(0, left()))); // (the streets fill)
        const audits = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
          const st = await everyone();
          audits.push(entityAudit(clients.map((c, k) => ({ tag: c.tag, slot: c.slot, state: st[k] }))));
          await sleep(2500);
        }
        const last = audits[audits.length - 1], faults = persistentFaults(audits), counts = (await everyone()).map(census);
        await check('crowd', 'shared peds and cars present (owned here, copies there)', counts.some((x) => x.owned > 0) && counts.filter((x) => x.puppets > 0).length >= N - 1,
          Object.fromEntries(clients.map((c, i) => [c.tag, counts[i]])));
        await check('crowd', 'every network id owned by one client only (no duplicate)', faults.duplicates.length === 0,
          { duplicates: faults.duplicates.map((id) => ({ id, owners: last.owners[id] })), lastSample: last.duplicates.length });
        await check('crowd', 'no copy of an entity nobody owns (no ghost)', last.complete ? faults.ghosts.length === 0 : true,
          { ghosts: faults.ghosts.slice(0, 20), complete: last.complete, lastSample: last.ghosts.length });
        await check('crowd', 'every copy names its real owner', faults.wrongOwner.length === 0, { wrongOwner: faults.wrongOwner.slice(0, 20), lastSample: last.wrongOwner.length });
        const cov = audits.reduce((b, a) => (a.coverage.expected && a.coverage.present / a.coverage.expected > (b.coverage.expected ? b.coverage.present / b.coverage.expected : -1) ? a : b), audits[0]).coverage;
        await check('crowd', 'an entity near another player is a copy there (80 % or more)', cov.expected > 0 && cov.present / cov.expected >= 0.8,
          { expected: cov.expected, present: cov.present, missing: cov.missing.slice(0, 15) });
        // -- the wanted stars of one, seen by every other
        await A.cmd('cheat YOUWONTTAKEMEALIVE');
        const wanted = await until(A, 30000, (s) => (s?.wanted ?? 0) >= 2);
        const stars = await untilAll(40000, (st) => clients.every((c, i) => c === A || (playerIn(st[i], A.name)?.stars ?? 0) >= 2));
        await check('crowd', 'an admin\'s wanted level: its stars seen by every other', wanted.ok && stars.ok,
          { wanted: wanted.state?.wanted, stars: Object.fromEntries(clients.map((c, i) => [c.tag, playerIn(stars.states[i], A.name)?.stars ?? null])) });
        await A.cmd('cheat LEAVEMEALONE');
        await until(A, 30000, (s) => (s?.wanted ?? 0) === 0);
        // -- a fight: A kills B, C watches
        await healedAll();
        await gather(PLACES.hotel);
        const b0 = await B.read();
        if (!Number.isFinite(b0?.money) || b0.money < 200) { await B.cmd('money 1000'); await until(B, 15000, (s) => s?.money === 1000); }
        await A.cmd(`weapon ${o.weapon} 500`);
        await until(A, 15000, (s) => s?.weapon === o.weapon);
        await A.cmd(`aim ${B.slot}`); await sleep(1000);
        let start = await B.read(), beforeDeath = start, killed = false, hurt = false, shots = 0;
        for (; shots < 150 && left() > 120000 && !killed; shots++) {
          if (shots % 8 === 7) await A.cmd(`aim ${B.slot}`);
          const f0 = (await A.read())?.combat?.fires ?? 0;
          await A.cmd(`fire ${B.slot}`);
          await until(A, 30000, (sa) => (sa?.combat?.fires ?? 0) > f0);
          const s = await B.read();
          if (!dead(s)) beforeDeath = s;
          if (Number.isFinite(s?.health) && s.health < start.health) hurt = true;
          if (dead(s)) killed = true;
        }
        await check('crowd', 'A\'s shots hurt B, B dies', hurt && killed, { shots, start: start?.health, last: beforeDeath?.health });
        if (killed) {
          const deathPos = vec(beforeDeath?.pos);
          const feed = await untilAll(60000, (st) => st.every((s) => !!killLine(s, B.name, A.name)));
          await check('crowd', 'the kill line on every player (the watcher too)', feed.ok, Object.fromEntries(clients.map((c, i) => [c.tag, killLine(feed.states[i], B.name) ?? (feed.states[i]?.chat ?? []).slice(-3)])));
          const respawned = await until(B, RESPAWN_MS, (s) => !dead(s) && distance(s?.pos, deathPos) > 5 && s?.inWorld !== false && Number.isFinite(s?.health) && s.health > 0);
          for (const r of respawnChecks(beforeDeath, deathPos, respawned.state)) await check('crowd', r.name, r.ok && respawned.ok, r.detail);
          await check('crowd', 'respawn: 200 health (the new rule)', respawned.ok && respawned.state?.health === 200, { health: respawned.state?.health, maxHealth: respawned.state?.maxHealth });
          const watched = await untilAll(60000, (st) => clients.every((c, i) => c === B || distance(playerIn(st[i], B.name)?.pos, respawned.state?.pos) < 3));
          await check('crowd', 'every other sees B where it respawned', watched.ok, Object.fromEntries(clients.map((c, i) => [c.tag, c === B ? null : seesAt(watched.states[i], respawned.state, B.name)])));
        }
        // -- one leaves (the last: C or D): the others drop it and take over its entities; it comes back to its place
        const L = clients[N - 1], stay = clients.filter((c) => c !== L);
        await healedAll();
        await gather(PLACES.hotel);
        await sleep(Math.min(15000, Math.max(0, left())));
        const money = 3000 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 999), spot = offset(PLACES.hotel, 7, 6);
        await L.cmd(`money ${money}`); await L.cmd(tpCommand(spot));
        await until(L, 30000, (s) => s?.money === money && distance(s?.pos, spot) < 3);
        await sleep(Math.min(12000, Math.max(0, left()))); // (the character saved)
        const before = await everyone();
        const lAudit = entityAudit(clients.map((c, k) => ({ tag: c.tag, slot: c.slot, state: before[k] })));
        const lOwned = Object.keys(lAudit.owners).filter((id) => lAudit.owners[id].includes(L.tag)).map(Number);
        const copiedElsewhere = lOwned.filter((id) => stay.some((c, k) => netids(before[clients.indexOf(c)], 'puppets')?.has(id)));
        await L.cmd('leave');
        const out = await until(L, 90000, (s) => s?.inWorld === false);
        const dropped = await untilAll(40000, (st) => st.every((s) => !playerIn(s, L.name)), stay);
        await check('crowd', `${L.tag} leaves: every other drops it`, out.ok && dropped.ok, Object.fromEntries(stay.map((c, i) => [c.tag, (dropped.states[i]?.players ?? []).map((p) => p.name)])));
        await sleep(Math.min(8000, Math.max(0, left())));
        const takeover = await untilAll(40000, (st) => {
          const a = entityAudit(stay.map((c, k) => ({ tag: c.tag, slot: c.slot, state: st[k] })));
          return copiedElsewhere.every((id) => (a.owners[id]?.length ?? 0) === 1 || !stay.some((c, k) => netids(st[k], 'puppets')?.has(id)));
        }, stay);
        const ta = entityAudit(stay.map((c, k) => ({ tag: c.tag, slot: c.slot, state: takeover.states[k] })));
        const taken = copiedElsewhere.filter((id) => ta.owners[id]?.length === 1).length;
        const stillCopies = copiedElsewhere.filter((id) => !ta.owners[id] && stay.some((c, k) => netids(takeover.states[k], 'puppets')?.has(id)));
        await check('crowd', `${L.tag}'s entities taken over by those who stay (none left a copy of nobody's)`, takeover.ok && (copiedElsewhere.length === 0 || taken > 0),
          { owned: lOwned.length, copiedElsewhere: copiedElsewhere.length, takenOver: taken, stillCopies: stillCopies.slice(0, 20), duplicates: ta.duplicates });
        const again = await join(L);
        const kept = await until(L, 60000, (s) => s?.money === money && distance(s?.pos, spot) < 5);
        await check('crowd', `${L.tag} joins again: its money and its place`, again.ok && kept.ok, { money: kept.state?.money, pos: vec(kept.state?.pos), expected: { money, pos: spot } });
        L.slot = kept.state?.slot ?? again.state?.slot ?? L.slot;
        const relisted = await untilAll(60000, (st) => clients.every((c, i) => c === L || !!playerIn(st[i], L.name)));
        await check('crowd', `every other lists ${L.tag} again`, relisted.ok, {});
        // -- a world cheat on every player
        const w0 = await everyone();
        if (weatherOf(w0[0]) != null) {
          await A.cmd('cheat CATSANDDOGS');
          const changed = await until(A, 20000, (s) => JSON.stringify(weatherOf(s)) !== JSON.stringify(weatherOf(w0[0])));
          const same = await untilAll(30000, (st) => st.every((s) => JSON.stringify(weatherOf(s)) === JSON.stringify(weatherOf(changed.state))));
          await check('crowd', 'an admin\'s world cheat applied on every player', changed.ok && same.ok, Object.fromEntries(clients.map((c, i) => [c.tag, weatherOf(same.states[i])])));
          await A.cmd('cheat CATSANDDOGS');
          await untilAll(20000, (st) => st.every((s) => JSON.stringify(weatherOf(s)) === JSON.stringify(weatherOf(w0[0]))));
        } else await skip('crowd', 'an admin\'s world cheat applied on every player', 'the engine publishes no weather');
        // -- a garage: a car stored by C (or B), known by every player
        const G = C ?? B, stored = (s) => (s?.world?.garages ?? s?.garages ?? []).reduce((n, g) => n + (g?.record ?? 0), 0);
        const g0 = await everyone();
        await G.cmd(tpCommand(PLACES.garageOut));
        await until(G, 120000, (s) => distance(s?.pos, PLACES.garageOut) < 4);
        await G.cmd(`car ${o.car}`);
        const inCar = await until(G, 120000, (s) => !!s?.vehicle);
        if (!await check('crowd', `${G.tag} in a car of its own (garage)`, inCar.ok, { vehicle: inCar.state?.vehicle })) return;
        await G.cmd(tpCommand(PLACES.garageIn));
        await sleep(Math.min(15000, Math.max(0, left())));
        // (a scene loading in one page slows them all — one GPU process —: down to 0.1 frame a second, the exit key
        // pressed again while the player is still in)
        let outCar = { ok: false };
        for (let i = 0; i < 3 && !outCar.ok && left() > 120000; i++) { await G.cmd(`key ${o.exitKey}`); outCar = await until(G, 120000, (s) => !s?.vehicle); }
        if (!await check('crowd', `${G.tag} out of the car, in the hideout`, outCar.ok, { vehicle: outCar.state?.vehicle, pos: vec(outCar.state?.pos) })) return;
        await G.cmd(tpCommand(offset(PLACES.garageOut, -8)));
        const keptCar = await until(G, 240000, (s) => stored(s) > stored(g0[clients.indexOf(G)]));
        const known = await untilAll(60000, (st) => st.every((s, i) => stored(s) > stored(g0[i])));
        await check('crowd', `a car stored by ${G.tag} known by every player`, outCar.ok && keptCar.ok && known.ok,
          { before: g0.map(stored), after: known.states.map(stored) });
      },
      async freemode() {
        // (one page, no shared world: the game's free mode from its main menu, then "teleport" typed, a place chosen
        // with the arrows and Enter, the player moved there)
        const [P] = clients;
        // (the keys check.mjs --keys gives — ArrowDown, Enter, Enter —, each sent again until the menu shows it was read:
        // the menu's page and row, lobbyMenu in the engine's state)
        const menu = await until(P, 120000, (s) => s?.menuActive === true && s?.lobbyMenu?.page === 'start' && (s.lobbyMenu.rows ?? []).includes('ORT_FRE'));
        if (!await check('freemode', 'the main menu', menu.ok, { menuActive: menu.state?.menuActive, menu: menu.state?.lobbyMenu ?? null })) return;
        const row = menu.state.lobbyMenu.rows.indexOf('ORT_FRE');
        let r = { ok: false };
        for (let i = 0; i < 6 && !r.ok; i++) { await P.cmd('key DOWN'); r = await until(P, 20000, (s) => s?.lobbyMenu?.cursor === row); }
        for (let i = 0; i < 6 && r.ok; i++) { await P.cmd('key ENTER'); r = await until(P, 20000, (s) => s?.lobbyMenu?.page !== 'start'); if (r.ok) break; }
        await check('freemode', 'the menu\'s free mode page (ArrowDown, Enter)', r.ok, { menu: r.state?.lobbyMenu ?? null });
        await sleep(3000);
        await P.cmd('key ENTER'); // (its first row: Continue — a new free game on a new profile)
        const inGame = await until(P, 400000, (s) => !!vec(s?.freeMode?.pos) && s?.menuActive === false);
        if (!await check('freemode', 'the free mode: a player in the city', inGame.ok, { freeMode: inGame.state?.freeMode ?? null, menuActive: inGame.state?.menuActive })) return;
        await sleep(Math.min(20000, Math.max(0, left()))); // (the start's fade)
        const p0 = vec((await P.read())?.freeMode?.pos);
        await P.cmd('cheat TELEPORT');
        const open = await until(P, 60000, (s) => s?.teleportList === true);
        if (!await check('freemode', '"teleport" typed opens the list', open.ok, { teleportList: open.state?.teleportList })) return;
        await P.cmd('key DOWN'); await sleep(3000); await P.cmd('key ENTER');
        const closed = await until(P, 60000, (s) => s?.teleportList === false);
        // (the list's second row: the safehouses' second, the Vercetti Estate — mmo_social.cpp's list)
        const estate = [-377.06, -545.43, 16.0];
        const moved = await until(P, 180000, (s) => distance(s?.freeMode?.pos, p0) > 20 && s?.teleporting === false);
        await check('freemode', 'a place chosen with the arrows and Enter: the player moved there', closed.ok && moved.ok && distance(moved.state?.freeMode?.pos, estate) < 6,
          { from: p0, to: vec(moved.state?.freeMode?.pos), expected: estate, dist: Math.round(distance(moved.state?.freeMode?.pos, estate) * 10) / 10 });
      },
    };
    /** every player alive and healed (the health cheat: all are administrators of the test server) */
    async function healedAll() {
      for (const c of clients) {
        await until(c, RESPAWN_MS, (s) => !dead(s) && Number.isFinite(s?.health) && s.health > 0 && s?.inWorld !== false);
        await c.cmd('cheat ASPIRINE');
      }
      await untilAll(30000, (st) => st.every((s) => s?.health >= 99));
    }
    for (const name of o.scenarios) {
      if (left() < 30000) { await check(name, 'run', false, { why: 'out of time (--seconds)' }); continue; }
      console.log('SCENARIO', name);
      try { await scenarios[name](); } catch (error) { await check(name, 'run', false, { error: error.message }); }
    }
    // (each page's link over the run: what a player's connection carried, in bytes a second)
    const secs = Math.max(1, (Date.now() - started) / 1000);
    const links = await Promise.all(clients.map((c) => c.read().then((s) => s?._page?.stats ?? null).catch(() => null)));
    console.log('BANDWIDTH', JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(clients.map((c, i) => [c.tag, links[i] && {
      upBs: Math.round(links[i].sentBytes / secs), downBs: Math.round(links[i].receivedBytes / secs), connections: links[i].connections }]))));
    for (const c of clients) await c.cmd('leave').catch(() => {});
    await sleep(2000);
  } catch (error) {
    await check('setup', 'run', false, { error: error.message });
  } finally {
    clearInterval(heartbeat);
    const summary = { manifest: o.manifest, url: o.url, seconds: Math.round((Date.now() - started) / 1000), out, ...summarize(checks) };
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, 'results.json'), JSON.stringify({ summary, checks }, null, 1));
    console.log('RESULTS', JSON.stringify(summary));
    await browser.close().catch(() => {});
    process.exitCode = summary.passed ? 0 : 1;
  }
}

if (process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  main().catch((error) => { console.error('FAILED', error?.stack ?? error); process.exitCode = 1; });
}
```

```patch
+	uintptr addr = nSampleBankMemoryStartAddress[SFX_BANK_0] + m_aSamples[nSfx].nOffset - m_aSamples[BankStartOffset[SFX_BANK_0]].nOffset;

+	return TRUE;
```

`tools/re3/perf.mjs`:

```mjs
// Frame cost of an re3 port in the city (docs/browser-ports.md, "re3 ports"): its page started as a visitor, a new
// game from the game's menu, its cutscenes skipped (Enter held), then --seconds of play measured (tools/port-perf.mjs:
// the engine's work a frame — from the browser's frame callback that resumes it to its next wait for one —, the frames
// shown, the WebGL calls a frame by kind and the synchronous ones, the renderer; --gl swiftshader draws on the CPU, the
// GPU's share included; --gl discard sends every call but draws nothing — the CPU a frame costs, an upper bound). Also
// the engine's waits for its files and its memory, and the game data's indicator (meter: the seconds it was shown, those
// the engine's reads waited; meter-<s>.png at each time it shows, no-meter-<s>.png now and then). The page's reports (telemetry, learned order, first-launch profile)
// stay off the server unless --report. JSON on the last line; evidence under /tmp/orthros-scratch/re3-perf-<manifest>/.
// Start it through the browser slot guard:
//   tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/re3/perf.mjs <manifest> [--url http://127.0.0.1:8080] [--gl swiftshader|discard|gpu]
//     [--seconds 30] [--drive] [--warm 0] [--net KB/s] [--net-after KB/s] [--profile] [--stacks getError,…] [--no-calls] [--report]
//     [--size 1280x720] [--query "a=b"] [--trace <file.json>] [--car GETTHEREFAST]   (--trace: a Chrome trace of the measured seconds — the
//     renderer's main thread, the GPU process, their waits on each other —, for a closer look at the frames' gaps)
//     [--size 1280x720] [--query "a=b"] [--mem-every s] [--channel chromium|shell]
// --channel: Chromium itself by default, as the bench suite; shell: Playwright's headless shell, which floods a page that
// holds the pointer lock (the game in the city) with synthetic mouse moves — tools/port-perf.mjs
// --mem-every s: the page's memory sampled every s seconds of the measure (port-perf.mjs memSampler: JS heap, the
// engine's heap, DOM nodes and listeners) and its growth per 10 minutes — a long session's leaks
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { launchOptions, addProbe, quietReports, startMeasure, readMeasure, startProfile, stopProfile, memSampler, meterSampler } from '../port-perf.mjs';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), arg = (k, d) => (args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : d);
const [name] = args;
if (!name || name.startsWith('--')) { console.error('usage: perf.mjs <manifest> [--url u] [--gl swiftshader|discard|gpu] [--seconds n] [--drive] [--size WxH]'); process.exit(2); }
const base = arg('--url', 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'), gl = arg('--gl', 'discard'), seconds = Number(arg('--seconds', 30));
const [width, height] = arg('--size', '1280x720').split('x').map(Number);
const root = `/tmp/orthros-scratch/re3-perf-${name}`;
fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true }); process.env.TMPDIR = root;
const listed = (await (await fetch(`${base}/api/manifests`)).json()).find((m) => m.name === name);
if (!listed?.available || listed.runtime !== 're3') throw new Error(`${name}: not an available re3 version`);

// (--js-flags "<V8 flags>": e.g. --perf-basic-prof, the engine's WebAssembly named for Linux perf — `perf record -p` on
// the page's renderer process sees every thread of it, its compositor's included, where the CPU profile's "(program)"
// is all the browser's native code; --mark prints the measure's start for such a recorder)
const browser = await chromium.launch(launchOptions({ gl, channel: arg('--channel', 'chromium'), args: arg('--js-flags') ? [`--js-flags=${arg('--js-flags')}`] : [] }));
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height: height + 44 } });
await addProbe(page, { discard: gl === 'discard', stacks: arg('--stacks', '').split(',').filter(Boolean) });
if (!args.includes('--report')) await quietReports(page);
page.on('pageerror', (e) => console.log('PAGE ERROR', e.message));
page.on('crash', () => console.log('CRASH'));
const query = arg('--query', '');
// (--net KB/s: Chrome's network emulation, 50 ms round trip, from the start)
// (--net-after KB/s: that link from the measure on — the start at --net's speed or the server's, the city then streamed
// over a slower one)
let netCdp = null;
const netAt = async (kbs) => { const c = netCdp ??= await page.context().newCDPSession(page); await c.send('Network.enable'); await c.send('Network.emulateNetworkConditions', { offline: false, latency: 50, downloadThroughput: kbs * 1024, uploadThroughput: 64 * 1024 }); };
if (arg('--net')) await netAt(Number(arg('--net')));
await page.goto(`${base}${listed.launchUrl}${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`);
await page.waitForFunction(() => window.portSession?.state === 'running', null, { timeout: 300000 });
console.log('RENDERER', await page.evaluate(() => perfProbe.renderer), gl === 'discard' ? '(rasterizer discarded)' : '');
await page.waitForTimeout(5000);
const canvas = await page.locator('#canvas').boundingBox();
const at = (fx, fy) => [canvas.x + fx * canvas.width, canvas.y + fy * canvas.height];
const hold = async (key, ms = 600) => { await page.keyboard.down(key); await page.waitForTimeout(ms); await page.keyboard.up(key); };
/** Draws a frame over `ms`. */
const rate = async (ms) => { const a = await page.evaluate(() => [perfProbe.draws, perfProbe.frames]); await page.waitForTimeout(ms); const b = await page.evaluate(() => [perfProbe.draws, perfProbe.frames]); return (b[0] - a[0]) / Math.max(1, b[1] - a[1]); };
// (the game's menu: Start game, then New game — the menu's places, fractions of the canvas)
for (const fy of [0.401, 0.365]) { await page.mouse.move(...at(0.5, fy), { steps: 4 }); await page.waitForTimeout(400); await page.mouse.down(); await page.waitForTimeout(150); await page.mouse.up(); await page.waitForTimeout(2500); }
// (the intro's cutscenes skipped until the city is there and the player has the controls: a scene a while)
const t0 = Date.now(); let scenes = 0;
while (Date.now() - t0 < 300000) {
  await hold('Enter');
  const r = await rate(3000);
  scenes = r > 80 ? scenes + 1 : 0;
  if (scenes >= 4) break;
}
await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(root, 'start.png') });
// (--car <cheat>: a car of the game's own vehicle cheat, typed — GETTHEREFAST, the Sabre Turbo —, the player put in it
// and driving: W held, turning a little now and then, the city streamed in at a car's pace)
const car = arg('--car');
if (car) { await page.keyboard.type(car, { delay: 120 }); await page.waitForTimeout(1500); }
if (args.includes('--drive') || car) { await hold('Enter', 700); await page.waitForTimeout(4000); await page.keyboard.down('w'); }
let steer = null;
if (car) { let k = 0; steer = setInterval(() => { const key = (k++ % 4 < 2) ? 'a' : 'd'; hold(key, 250).catch(() => {}); }, 3000); }
// (--warm s: played that long before the measure — the intro's last loading screen out of it)
await page.waitForTimeout(Number(arg('--warm', 0)) * 1000);
const cdp = args.includes('--profile') ? await startProfile(page) : null;
// (--trace-categories a,b: fewer categories — the default set slows the page down to a few frames a second)
if (arg('--trace')) await browser.startTracing(page, { path: arg('--trace'), categories: arg('--trace-categories')?.split(',') ?? ['toplevel', 'gpu', 'cc', 'viz', 'blink', 'v8', 'disabled-by-default-devtools.timeline', 'disabled-by-default-gpu.service'] });
await page.evaluate(() => { const B = portSession.engine.orthrosBlocked; perfProbe.blocked0 = B ? { ...B, files: { ...B.files } } : {}; perfProbe.files0 = { ...portSession.files.stats }; });
await startMeasure(page, { calls: !args.includes('--no-calls') });
const memStop = arg('--mem-every') ? await memSampler(page, Number(arg('--mem-every')), '() => portSession.engine.HEAPU8.length') : null;
if (args.includes('--mark')) console.log('MEASURE START', Date.now());
if (arg('--net-after')) await netAt(Number(arg('--net-after')));
// (the game data's indicator over the measured seconds: shown only while the game truly waits — data-meter-worker.js)
const meterStop = await meterSampler(page, { shots: root });
await page.waitForTimeout(seconds * 1000);
const meter = await meterStop();
const mem = memStop ? await memStop() : null;
const measured = await readMeasure(page);
const profile = cdp ? await stopProfile(cdp, measured.frames) : null;
if (arg('--trace')) await browser.stopTracing();
const result = { ...measured, ...await page.evaluate(() => {
  const P = perfProbe, F = portSession.files.stats, F0 = P.files0 ?? {}, d = (k) => Math.round((F[k] ?? 0) - (F0[k] ?? 0));
  // (the engine's waits for its files in the measured seconds: count, total and the files)
  const B = portSession.engine.orthrosBlocked, B0 = P.blocked0 ?? {};
  // (the time the game stood still on a file read — engines that count it; else its demand waits are the closest)
  const blocked = B ? { blocks: (B.count ?? 0) - (B0.count ?? 0), blockedMs: Math.round((B.ms ?? 0) - (B0.ms ?? 0)), longestBlockMs: Math.round(B.max ?? 0), blockedFiles: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(B.files ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => [k, Math.round(v - (B0.files?.[k] ?? 0))]).filter(([, v]) => v > 0)) } : { blocks: null };
  return { ...blocked, waits: d('waits'), waitMs: d('waitMs'), waitMB: Math.round(d('waitBytes') / 1e5) / 10, syncFetches: d('syncFetches'), backgroundMB: Math.round(d('fetchedBytes') / 1e5) / 10,
    wasmMB: Math.round((portSession.engine?.HEAPU8?.length ?? 0) / 1048576) };
}) };
clearInterval(steer);
if (args.includes('--drive') || car) await page.keyboard.up('w');
await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(root, 'end.png') });
await browser.close();
if (profile) console.log('PROFILE', JSON.stringify(profile, null, 1));
console.log(JSON.stringify({ name, gl, seconds, size: `${width}x${height}`, drive: args.includes('--drive'), car: car ?? null, ...result, meter, ...(mem ? { memGrowthPer10min: mem.growthPer10min, memFirst: mem.samples[0], memLast: mem.samples.at(-1) } : {}) }));
```

`tools/render-record-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
// Recording cost of the render worker (docs/render-worker.md, D063): a frame shaped like a game's — per draw a few
// render / stage / sampler state changes, a world matrix, effect constants, sometimes a texture or stream change —
// run through the Direct3D 9 device with no backend, then with a Recorder whose commands are consumed without being
// replayed (only the emulator thread's side). The difference per draw is what recording adds to the emulator thread.
// Usage: node tools/render-record-bench.mjs [draws per frame (400)] [frames (300)]
import { d3dEnv } from '../tests/d3d-random.js';
import { RenderLink, Recorder } from '../src/gfx/d3d-recorder.js';

const DRAWS = Number(process.argv[2] ?? 400), FRAMES = Number(process.argv[3] ?? 300);
function session(gfx) {
  const E = d3dEnv(gfx), { mem, ctx, com } = E;
  const out = E.alloc(64), scratch = E.alloc(4096);
  const pp = E.alloc(64); [1024, 768, 22, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 75, 0, 0, 0].forEach((v, i) => mem.write32(pp + 4 * i, v));
  const d3dPtr = E.defs.Direct3DCreate9[1](ctx([32]));
  com.implAt(d3dPtr).CreateDevice(ctx([d3dPtr, 0, 1, 0, 0x40, pp, out]));
  const devPtr = mem.read32(out), dev = com.implAt(devPtr);
  const c = ctx([devPtr]), call = (name, ...a) => { const A = c.args; for (let i = 1; i < 9; i++) A[i] = a[i - 1] ?? 0; return dev[name](c); }; // (up to 8 arguments: CreateTexture's 7th is its out pointer)
  const tex = [], vbs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) { call('CreateTexture', 64, 64, 1, 0, 21, 1, out); tex.push(mem.read32(out)); }
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { call('CreateVertexBuffer', 65536, 0x208, 0, 0, out); vbs.push(mem.read32(out)); }
  call('CreateIndexBuffer', 65536, 0x8, 101, 0, out); const ib = mem.read32(out);
  call('SetFVF', 0x152); call('SetIndices', ib);
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) mem.writeF32(scratch + 4 * i, i * 0.25);
  let k = 0;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  for (let f = 0; f < FRAMES; f++) {
    call('BeginScene');
    for (let d = 0; d < DRAWS; d++, k++) {
      call('SetRenderState', 27, k & 1); call('SetRenderState', 19, 5 + (k & 1)); call('SetRenderState', 20, 6); call('SetRenderState', 15, (k >> 1) & 1);
      call('SetTextureStageState', 0, 1, 4 + (k & 1)); call('SetTextureStageState', 1, 1, 1); call('SetSamplerState', 0, 5, 2); call('SetSamplerState', 0, 6, 2 + (k & 1));
      mem.writeF32(scratch + 48, k); call('SetTransform', 256, scratch);
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) dev.vsConst[16 + i] = k + i; dev.gfx?.constTouched?.(0, 16, 24); dev.constVersion++;
      if ((k & 3) === 0) call('SetTexture', 0, tex[k % tex.length]);
      if ((k & 7) === 0) call('SetStreamSource', 0, vbs[k % vbs.length], 0, 36);
      call('DrawIndexedPrimitive', 4, 0, 0, 100, 0, 50);
    }
    call('EndScene'); call('Present', 0, 0, 0, 0);
  }
  return performance.now() - t0;
}
// (a link whose consumer takes everything at once without replaying it: only the recording is measured)
const words = new Int32Array(1 << 20);
const link = new RenderLink({ words, replayer: { reader: { consumed: 0 }, run() { this.reader.consumed = link.w.produced; } } });
link.drain = function () { this.w.consumed = this.replayer.reader.consumed = this.w.produced; };
const none = { createDevice: () => null }, rec = { createDevice: (dev) => new Recorder(link, dev) };
const runs = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) runs.push([i & 1 ? 'recorded' : 'no backend', session(i & 1 ? rec : none)]);
const per = (ms) => (ms * 1000 / (DRAWS * FRAMES)).toFixed(3);
for (const [k, ms] of runs) console.log(`${k.padEnd(10)} ${ms.toFixed(0)} ms, ${per(ms)} us per draw (incl. the Direct3D layer), ${(ms / FRAMES).toFixed(3)} ms per frame`);
const base = runs.filter((r) => r[0] === 'no backend').slice(1).map((r) => r[1]), recd = runs.filter((r) => r[0] === 'recorded').slice(1).map((r) => r[1]);
const avg = (a) => a.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / a.length;
console.log(`recording: ${per(avg(recd) - avg(base))} us per draw, ${((avg(recd) - avg(base)) / FRAMES).toFixed(3)} ms per frame of ${DRAWS} draws; ${(link.w.produced * 4 / FRAMES / 3 / 1024).toFixed(0)} KiB of commands per frame`);

```

`tools/server-load.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Load test of an Orthros server: N simulated players at once, each a first visit of the home (the page, its config,
// the catalog, the covers) then a game's start the way the shared reader does it (its manifest, tree and learned
// order, then its demand reads — the order's 64 KiB pieces and 1 MiB blocks, a few in flight — and background
// blocks, &p=1). A probe asks a tiny route every 25 ms the whole time: its latency is the server's event loop stall,
// what every player's next read waits for. No browser.
//
//   node tools/server-load.mjs --url http://127.0.0.1:8080 [--clients 20] [--seconds 30] [--games a,b] [--pid <server pid>]
//        [--accept 'gzip, deflate, br, zstd'] [--json]
// --pid: the server's resident memory sampled too (/proc/<pid>/status). Prints per-route latency p50/p90/p99/max (ms),
// requests, bytes, and the server's /api/netstats delta.
import fs from 'node:fs';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const arg = (k, d) => (args.includes(k) ? args[args.indexOf(k) + 1] : d);
const base = arg('--url', 'http://127.0.0.1:8080').replace(/\/$/, '');
const clients = Number(arg('--clients', 20)), seconds = Number(arg('--seconds', 30)), pid = arg('--pid');
const accept = arg('--accept', 'gzip, deflate, br, zstd');
const BLOCK = 1 << 20, CHUNK = 64 << 10;

const stats = new Map(); // route -> { t: [], bytes, errors }
const note = (route, ms, bytes, ok) => {
  let s = stats.get(route); if (!s) stats.set(route, s = { t: [], bytes: 0, errors: 0 });
  s.t.push(ms); s.bytes += bytes; if (!ok) s.errors++;
};
const get = async (route, url, headers = {}) => {
  const t0 = performance.now();
  try {
    const r = await fetch(base + url, { headers: { 'accept-encoding': accept, ...headers } });
    const b = await r.arrayBuffer();
    note(route, performance.now() - t0, Number(r.headers.get('content-length') ?? b.byteLength), r.ok || r.status === 304);
    return r.ok ? { r, b } : null;
  } catch { note(route, performance.now() - t0, 0, false); return null; }
};
const json = (x) => { try { return JSON.parse(Buffer.from(x.b).toString('utf8')); } catch { return null; } };

const deadline = performance.now() + seconds * 1000;
const live = () => performance.now() < deadline;

const catalog = json(await get('warm', '/api/manifests')) ?? [];
const wantGames = arg('--games', null)?.split(',');
const games = catalog.filter((m) => m.available && (!wantGames || wantGames.includes(m.name)));
if (!games.length) { console.error('no available game'); process.exit(2); }

const fileSize = (tree, rel) => {
  let n = tree; const parts = rel.split('/');
  for (let i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) { n = n.dirs?.[parts[i]]; if (!n) return null; }
  return n.files?.[parts.at(-1)]?.size ?? null;
};

async function player(i) {
  const session = `load${process.pid}x${i}x${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
  // home, first visit
  await Promise.all([get('home /', '/'), get('home /api/config', '/api/config'), get('home /api/manifests', '/api/manifests')]);
  await Promise.all(games.slice(0, 8).map((g) => get('home cover', `/api/cover/${encodeURIComponent(g.name)}`)));
  const g = games[i % games.length], id = encodeURIComponent(g.name);
  await get('start /api/manifest', `/api/manifest/${id}`);
  const [t, o] = await Promise.all([get('start /api/tree', `/api/tree/${id}`), get('start /api/prefetch', `/api/prefetch/${id}`)]);
  const tree = t && json(t), order = (o && json(o)) ?? [];
  if (!tree) return;
  // the reads: each learned entry's pieces (its mask) or its whole block, 4 in flight; background blocks beside, 2
  const demand = [], bg = [];
  for (const [rel, block, mask] of order) {
    const size = fileSize(tree, rel); if (size === null) continue;
    const b0 = block * BLOCK; if (b0 >= size) continue;
    const enc = rel.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/');
    if (!mask || mask === 0xffffffff || mask === -1) { demand.push(`/gamez/${id}/${enc}?r=${b0}-${Math.min(size, b0 + BLOCK)}&s=${session}`); continue; }
    for (let c = 0; c < 16; c++) if (mask & (1 << c)) { const a = b0 + c * CHUNK; if (a < size) demand.push(`/gamez/${id}/${enc}?r=${a}-${Math.min(size, a + CHUNK)}&s=${session}`); }
    bg.push(`/gamez/${id}/${enc}?r=${b0}-${Math.min(size, b0 + BLOCK)}&p=1`);
  }
  let di = 0, bi = 0;
  const lane = async (list, next, route) => { for (let k; live() && (k = next()) < list.length;) await get(route, list[k]); };
  await Promise.all([
    ...Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => lane(demand, () => di++, 'gamez demand')),
    ...Array.from({ length: 2 }, () => lane(bg, () => bi++, 'gamez bg')),
  ]);
}

const rss = [];
const rssOf = () => { try { const m = /VmRSS:\s+(\d+)/.exec(fs.readFileSync(`/proc/${pid}/status`, 'utf8')); return m ? Number(m[1]) / 1024 : null; } catch { return null; } };
const net0 = json(await get('warm', '/api/netstats'));
const probe = (async () => { while (live()) { await get('probe /api/config', '/api/config'); if (pid) rss.push(rssOf()); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 25)); } })();
const t0 = performance.now();
// players arrive over the first quarter of the run, each starting again once done
await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: clients }, async (_, i) => {
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, (i / clients) * seconds * 250));
  for (let round = 0; live(); round++) await player(i + round * clients);
}));
await probe;
const net1 = json(await get('warm', '/api/netstats'));

const q = (a, p) => a[Math.min(a.length - 1, Math.floor(a.length * p))];
const out = { clients, seconds: (performance.now() - t0) / 1000, routes: {} };
for (const [route, s] of stats) {
  if (route === 'warm') continue;
  s.t.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  out.routes[route] = { n: s.t.length, p50: +q(s.t, 0.5).toFixed(1), p90: +q(s.t, 0.9).toFixed(1), p99: +q(s.t, 0.99).toFixed(1), max: +s.t.at(-1).toFixed(1), MB: +(s.bytes / 1e6).toFixed(1), errors: s.errors };
}
if (net0 && net1) out.netstats = { requests: net1.requests - net0.requests, sentMB: +((net1.sent - net0.sent) / 1e6).toFixed(1), encodeMs: Math.round(net1.encodeMs - net0.encodeMs), cacheHits: net1.cacheHits - net0.cacheHits, brHits: net1.brHits - net0.brHits };
if (rss.length) { const r = rss.filter((x) => x !== null); out.rssMB = { first: Math.round(r[0]), max: Math.round(Math.max(...r)), last: Math.round(r.at(-1)) }; }
if (args.includes('--json')) console.log(JSON.stringify(out));
else {
  console.log(`${clients} clients, ${out.seconds.toFixed(1)} s${out.rssMB ? `, server RSS ${out.rssMB.first} -> max ${out.rssMB.max} MB` : ''}`);
  console.log('route'.padEnd(22), 'n'.padStart(6), 'p50'.padStart(8), 'p90'.padStart(8), 'p99'.padStart(8), 'max'.padStart(8), 'MB'.padStart(8), 'err'.padStart(5));
  for (const [r, s] of Object.entries(out.routes)) console.log(r.padEnd(22), String(s.n).padStart(6), String(s.p50).padStart(8), String(s.p90).padStart(8), String(s.p99).padStart(8), String(s.max).padStart(8), String(s.MB).padStart(8), String(s.errors).padStart(5));
  if (out.netstats) console.log('netstats', JSON.stringify(out.netstats));
}

```

`tools/setter-bench.mjs`:

`tools/shape-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Code-shape microbenchmarks of the JIT: small x86 kernels of common forms (written here, not taken from any program),
// each run under the JIT with the given translation options; ns per guest instruction (the guest instructions charged
// to the budget), best of 5. Compares code-generator variants without the noise of a game:
//   node tools/shape-bench.mjs [--opts '{"ifcvt":true}'] [--vs '{"ifcvt":false}'] [--only name,name]
// (with --vs: the two variants alternated, each kernel's ratio printed; --trace <kernel>: its time per repetition in one
// JIT — a large region runs in V8's baseline tier until its optimized code is ready)
import './node-wasm-flags.mjs'; // (branch hints honoured, as in Chrome)
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, A = 0x10000000, B = 0x10400000, C = 0x10800000, STACK = 0x11000000;
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };

// ---- a tiny assembler (32-bit registers: eax ecx edx ebx esp ebp esi edi = 0..7)
const [EAX, ECX, EDX, EBX, ESP, EBP, ESI, EDI] = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7];
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, (v >>> 24) & 0xff];
const rr = (op, dst, src) => [op, 0xc0 | (src << 3) | dst]; // op r/m32(dst), r32(src)
/** [base + index*4 + disp8] as a ModRM/SIB tail for register field `reg` */
const mi = (reg, base, index, disp = 0) => (disp ? [0x44 | (reg << 3), (2 << 6) | (index << 3) | base, disp & 0xff] : [0x04 | (reg << 3), (2 << 6) | (index << 3) | base]);
function asm(items) {
  const out = [], labels = new Map(), fix = [];
  for (const it of items) {
    if (typeof it === 'string') { labels.set(it, out.length); continue; }
    if (it.j32) { out.push(...it.op); fix.push([out.length, it.j32, 4]); out.push(0, 0, 0, 0); continue; }
    if (it.j) { out.push(it.op); fix.push([out.length, it.j, it.op === 0xe8 ? 4 : 1]); out.push(...(it.op === 0xe8 ? [0, 0, 0, 0] : [0])); continue; }
    out.push(...it);
  }
  for (const [at, l, n] of fix) { const d = labels.get(l) - (at + n); if (n === 1) { if (d < -128 || d > 127) throw new Error('rel8 range ' + l); out[at] = d & 0xff; } else out.splice(at, 4, ...le(d)); }
  out.push(0xc3); // (after the kernel's HLT: a RET, so that the region ends there instead of decoding the zeros after it)
  return Uint8Array.from(out);
}
const jcc = (cc, l) => ({ op: 0x70 + cc, j: l }), jmp = (l) => ({ op: 0xeb, j: l }), call = (l) => ({ op: 0xe8, j: l });
const CC = { B: 2, AE: 3, E: 4, NE: 5, BE: 6, A: 7, S: 8, NS: 9, L: 12, GE: 13, LE: 14, G: 15 };
const cmpImm = (r, v) => [0x81, 0xf8 | r, ...le(v)];

let seed = 12345;
const rnd = () => { seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0; return seed; };
const N = 4096;
/** kernels: code, data setup, outer repetitions (EDI-free counters in each) */
const KERNELS = {
  // binary search (lower bound) of random keys in a sorted array: a data-dependent diamond
  bsearch: {
    code: asm([[0xbb, ...le(0)], 'outer', [0x8b, ...mi(EDX, EDI, EBX)], [0xb8, ...le(A)], [0xb9, ...le(N)],
      'L', rr(0x85, ECX, ECX), jcc(CC.E, 'done'), rr(0x89, EBP, ECX), [0xd1, 0xe8 | EBP],
      [0x39, ...mi(EDX, EAX, EBP)], jcc(CC.GE, 'else'), [0x8d, ...mi(EAX, EAX, EBP, 4)], rr(0x29, ECX, EBP), [0x48 + ECX], jmp('L'),
      'else', rr(0x89, ECX, EBP), jmp('L'),
      'done', [0x01, 0x04, 0x24], [0x43], cmpImm(EBX, N), jcc(CC.B, 'outer'), [0xf4]]),
    setup(m) { const v = []; for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) v.push(rnd() >>> 1); v.sort((x, y) => x - y); v.forEach((x, i) => m.write32(A + 4 * i, x)); for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) m.write32(B + 4 * i, rnd() >>> 1); },
    regs: { edi: B },
  },
  // |x| of random values (a data-dependent triangle) summed
  abs: {
    code: asm([[0x31, 0xc9], 'L', [0x8b, ...mi(EAX, ESI, ECX)], rr(0x85, EAX, EAX), jcc(CC.NS, 'pos'), [0xf7, 0xd8], 'pos', rr(0x01, EBX, EAX), [0x41], cmpImm(ECX, N), jcc(CC.B, 'L'), [0xf4]]),
    setup(m) { for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) m.write32(A + 4 * i, rnd()); },
    regs: { esi: A }, reps: 4,
  },
  // a read-modify-write of an array (stores checked for self-modifying code)
  store: {
    code: asm([[0x31, 0xc9], 'L', [0x8b, ...mi(EAX, EDI, ECX)], rr(0x31, EAX, EDX), rr(0x01, EAX, ECX), [0x89, ...mi(EAX, EDI, ECX)], [0x41], cmpImm(ECX, N), jcc(CC.B, 'L'), [0xf4]]),
    setup(m) { for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) m.write32(B + 4 * i, rnd()); },
    regs: { edi: B, edx: 0x5a5a5a5a }, reps: 4,
  },
  // a loop calling a small function (call / ret, push / pop)
  calls: {
    code: asm([[0xb9, ...le(N)], 'L', [0x50 + ECX], call('f'), [0x83, 0xc4, 0x04], rr(0x01, EBX, EAX), [0x48 + ECX], jcc(CC.NE, 'L'), [0xf4],
      'f', [0x8b, 0x44, 0x24, 0x04], [0x8d, 0x04, 0x40], [0xc3]]),
    setup() {}, regs: {}, reps: 4,
  },
  // predictable branches (period 8) in a counting loop
  branchy: {
    code: asm([[0x31, 0xc9], 'L', rr(0x89, EAX, ECX), [0x83, 0xe0, 0x07], [0x83, 0xf8, 0x03], jcc(CC.NE, 's1'), [0x43], 's1', [0x83, 0xf8, 0x05], jcc(CC.B, 's2'), rr(0x01, EDX, EAX), 's2', [0x41], cmpImm(ECX, N), jcc(CC.B, 'L'), [0xf4]]),
    setup() {}, regs: {}, reps: 4,
  },
  // x87: c[i] += a[i] * b[i] (single precision)
  x87: {
    code: asm([[0x31, 0xc9], 'L', [0xd9, ...mi(0, ESI, ECX)], [0xd8, ...mi(1, EDI, ECX)], [0xd8, ...mi(0, EBX, ECX)], [0xd9, ...mi(3, EBX, ECX)], [0x41], cmpImm(ECX, N), jcc(CC.B, 'L'), [0xf4]]),
    setup(m) { for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { m.writeF32?.(A + 4 * i, 1 + (rnd() & 0xff) / 256) ?? m.write32(A + 4 * i, 0x3f800000); m.write32(B + 4 * i, 0x3f000000); m.write32(C + 4 * i, 0); } },
    regs: { esi: A, edi: B, ebx: C }, reps: 4,
  },
};

// abs with cold code in its region: a branch never taken leads to 40 blocks of 4 instructions, each with a store
// (an SMC-checked exit) or not, ending back in the loop
function coldKernel(stores) {
  const cold = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    cold.push('c' + i, rr(0x01, EDX, EAX), stores ? [0x89, ...mi(EDX, EDI, ECX)] : rr(0x31, EDX, ECX), [0x83, 0xc2, i], jcc(CC.E, 'c' + (i + 1)));
  }
  cold.push('c40', { op: [0xe9], j32: 'pos' });
  return {
    code: asm([[0x31, 0xc9], 'L', [0x8b, ...mi(EAX, ESI, ECX)], rr(0x85, EAX, EAX), jcc(CC.NS, 'pos'), [0xf7, 0xd8], 'pos', rr(0x01, EBX, EAX), cmpImm(EBX, 0x7fffffff), { op: [0x0f, 0x80 + CC.E], j32: 'c0' }, [0x41], cmpImm(ECX, N), jcc(CC.B, 'L'), [0xf4], [0xc3], ...cold]),
    setup(m) { for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) m.write32(A + 4 * i, rnd() >>> 4); },
    regs: { esi: A, edi: B }, reps: 4,
  };
}
// the x87 kernel under 24-bit precision (what Direct3D leaves the FPU in) and 53-bit precision
KERNELS.x87p24 = { ...KERNELS.x87, cw: 0x007f };
KERNELS.x87p53 = { ...KERNELS.x87, cw: 0x027f };
KERNELS.coldst = coldKernel(true);
KERNELS.coldalu = coldKernel(false);
// abs with one cold block of n instructions: stores (mov), read-modify-writes (add [m], dl) or ALU only
function coldBlock(n, kind) {
  const ins = kind === 'mov' ? [0x89, ...mi(EDX, EDI, ECX)] : kind === 'rmw' ? [0x00, ...mi(EDX, EDI, ECX)] : rr(0x01, EDX, ECX);
  const cold = ['c0']; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) cold.push(ins);
  cold.push({ op: [0xe9], j32: 'pos' });
  return {
    code: asm([[0x31, 0xc9], 'L', [0x8b, ...mi(EAX, ESI, ECX)], rr(0x85, EAX, EAX), jcc(CC.NS, 'pos'), [0xf7, 0xd8], 'pos', rr(0x01, EBX, EAX), cmpImm(EBX, 0x7fffffff), { op: [0x0f, 0x80 + CC.E], j32: 'c0' }, [0x41], cmpImm(ECX, N), jcc(CC.B, 'L'), [0xf4], [0xc3], ...cold]),
    setup(m) { for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) m.write32(A + 4 * i, rnd() >>> 4); },
    regs: { esi: A, edi: B }, reps: 4,
  };
}
for (const n of [50, 150, 350]) for (const k of ['mov', 'rmw', 'alu']) KERNELS[`cold${k}${n}`] = coldBlock(n, k);

function runKernel(k, opts, reps) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory(), cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset(); mem.writeBytes(CODE, k.code); seed = 12345; k.setup(mem);
  if (k.cw !== undefined) mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, k.cw);
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true, ...opts }); jit.cpu = cpu;
  const end = CODE + k.code.indexOf(0xf4);
  let best = Infinity, insns = 0;
  for (let rep = 0; rep < reps; rep++) {
    cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = STACK; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF; cpu.eax = cpu.ecx = cpu.edx = cpu.ebx = cpu.ebp = 0;
    for (const [r, v] of Object.entries(k.regs)) cpu[r] = v;
    mem.write32(STACK, 0);
    let n = 0, r;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    for (let i = 0; i < (k.reps ?? 1) * 40; i++) {
      cpu.eip = CODE; for (const [rg, v] of Object.entries(k.regs)) cpu[rg] = v; cpu.ecx = k === KERNELS.calls ? 0 : cpu.ecx;
      do { r = jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: 1e9 }); n += 1e9 - jit.remaining(); } while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
      if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error(`exit ${r} at ${cpu.eip.toString(16)}`);
    }
    const t = performance.now() - t0;
    if (rep > 0 && t < best) best = t; // (the first repetition translates)
    if (process.env.SHAPE_TRACE) console.log(`  rep ${rep}: ${(t * 1e6 / n).toFixed(3)} ns/insn (${t.toFixed(1)} ms)`);
    insns = n;
  }
  return best * 1e6 / insns;
}

if (opt('trace')) { process.env.SHAPE_TRACE = '1'; const k = KERNELS[opt('trace')]; runKernel(k, JSON.parse(opt('opts', '{}')), 25); process.exit(0); }
const optsA = JSON.parse(opt('opts', '{}')), optsB = opt('vs') ? JSON.parse(opt('vs')) : null;
const only = opt('only') ? opt('only').split(',') : Object.keys(KERNELS);
let gA = 0, gB = 0, n = 0;
for (const name of only) {
  const k = KERNELS[name];
  const a = [], b = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) { a.push(runKernel(k, optsA, 3)); if (optsB) b.push(runKernel(k, optsB, 3)); }
  const ma = Math.min(...a), mb = optsB ? Math.min(...b) : 0;
  gA += Math.log(ma); if (optsB) gB += Math.log(mb); n++;
  console.log(`${name.padEnd(8)} ${ma.toFixed(3)} ns/insn${optsB ? `  vs ${mb.toFixed(3)}  ratio ${(ma / mb).toFixed(3)}` : ''}`);
}
console.log(`geomean ${Math.exp(gA / n).toFixed(3)}${optsB ? ` vs ${Math.exp(gB / n).toFixed(3)} ratio ${Math.exp((gA - gB) / n).toFixed(3)}` : ''}`);

```

`tools/sleepspin-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Frame-limiter microbenchmark: runs build/pe/sleepspin.exe (tools/pe/sleepspin.c: per 16 ms frame a little work, then
// Sleep(0) + timeGetTime until the next frame, beside a thread looping on Sleep(1)) under the JIT and reports what the
// emulator spends on that pacing — process CPU time per frame (Atomics.wait sleeps cost none), Sleep(0) calls and
// scheduling decisions per frame, throttled parks — and whether pacing stayed the same (frame interval mean / p99 / max).
// Usage: node tools/sleepspin-bench.mjs [--runs 5] [--src <dir with core/, cpu/...>] [--dbg NAME=value,...]
//   --src: import the emulator from another source tree (a checkout of the previous commit: before/after)
//   --dbg: globals set before the run (the page's ?dbg= switches, e.g. ORTHROS_SLEEP0_KEEP_STREAK=0)
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const argOf = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf(k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const RUNS = +argOf('--runs', 5);
for (const kv of (argOf('--dbg', '') || '').split(',').filter(Boolean)) { const [k, v] = kv.split('='); globalThis[k] = v; }
const SRC = path.resolve(argOf('--src', new URL('../src', import.meta.url).pathname));
const imp = (p) => import(pathToFileURL(path.join(SRC, p)).href);
const { Vm } = await imp('core/vm.js');
const { Vfs, MemBackend } = await imp('vfs/vfs.js');
const { RealClock } = await imp('core/clock.js');
const { HeadlessHost } = await imp('host/display.js');
const PE = new URL('../build/pe/sleepspin.exe', import.meta.url).pathname;

function runOnce() {
  const vfs = new Vfs();
  const t = new MemBackend();
  vfs.mount('C:\\', new MemBackend());
  vfs.mount('C:\\Test', t);
  t.open('sleepspin.exe', { create: true }).write(0, fs.readFileSync(PE));
  const clock = new RealClock();
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs, clock, host: new HeadlessHost({ clock }), jit: true, logKinds: ['warn', 'crash'] });
  vm.createProcess({ exePath: 'C:\\Test\\sleepspin.exe' });
  const marks = [], frames = [];
  let cpu0 = null, cpu1 = null, picks0 = 0, picks1 = 0, st0 = null, st1 = null;
  const main = () => vm.proc.threads[0], snap = () => ({ ...(main().sleepStats ?? { zero: 0, throttled: 0 }) });
  const dispatch = vm.dispatchThunk.bind(vm);
  vm.dispatchThunk = (th, i) => {
    const n = vm.api.thunk(i)?.name;
    if (n === 'GetVersion') frames.push(performance.now());
    else if (n === 'GetCommandLineA') {
      marks.push(performance.now());
      if (marks.length === 1) { cpu0 = process.cpuUsage(); picks0 = vm.sched.picks; st0 = snap(); }
      else { cpu1 = process.cpuUsage(cpu0); picks1 = vm.sched.picks; st1 = snap(); }
    }
    return dispatch(th, i);
  };
  const code = vm.run();
  if (code !== 0 || marks.length !== 2) throw new Error(`sleepspin.exe: exit code ${code}, ${marks.length} marks`);
  const n = frames.length, iv = frames.slice(1).map((x, k) => x - frames[k]).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return {
    cpu: (cpu1.user + cpu1.system) / 1000 / n, // ms of process CPU per frame
    wall: (marks[1] - marks[0]) / n,
    zero: (st1.zero - st0.zero) / n, throttled: (st1.throttled - st0.throttled) / n, picks: (picks1 - picks0) / n,
    mean: iv.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / iv.length, p50: iv[iv.length >> 1], p90: iv[Math.floor(iv.length * 0.9)], p99: iv[Math.floor(iv.length * 0.99)], max: iv[iv.length - 1],
  };
}

const res = [];
for (let r = 0; r < RUNS; r++) res.push(runOnce());
const stat = (k, d = 2) => { const v = res.map((x) => x[k]).sort((a, b) => a - b); return `${v[v.length >> 1].toFixed(d)} (min ${v[0].toFixed(d)}, max ${v[v.length - 1].toFixed(d)})`; };
console.log(`per frame (median of ${RUNS} runs): CPU ${stat('cpu')} ms, wall ${stat('wall')} ms`);
console.log(`  Sleep(0) ${stat('zero', 1)}, throttled ${stat('throttled', 1)}, scheduling decisions ${stat('picks', 1)}`);
console.log(`  frame interval: mean ${stat('mean')} ms, p50 ${stat('p50')} ms, p90 ${stat('p90')} ms, p99 ${stat('p99')} ms, max ${stat('max')} ms`);

```

`tools/slow-net-check.mjs`:

```mjs
// Slow-network check (docs/slow-network.md): plays bench scenarios (tools/scenarios/bench) in a fresh browser profile
// over a simulated thin link — a new player's first launch on a home connection — and prints, per game and speed, the
// time of each phase (to the menu, to the first image in game), what the network carried (the game's own reads and
// the background downloads apart) and the bench outcome. Every browser goes through tools/with-browser-slot.sh (the
// project's budget of test browsers), one run at a time.
//
// Usage: node tools/slow-net-check.mjs [--bench vicecity-drive,bfme2-skirmish] [--speeds 85k,1m,5m] [--rtt 50]
//          [--learn-from <dir>] [--games-dir <dir>] [--out <dir>] [--seconds 1500] [--keep]
//   --speeds: 85k (85 KB/s, a thin home link), 1m (1 MB/s), 5m (5 MB/s), fast (no simulation), or <n>mbit
//   --learn-from: a copy of this directory is the server's learned data (what a new player gets from a live server:
//     its prefetch order, programs, regions); default none (nothing learned)
//   --keep: keep the browser profiles and logs (default: the profiles are removed, the logs kept in --out)
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import net from 'node:net';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const benches = opt('bench', 'vicecity-drive').split(',').filter(Boolean);
const speeds = opt('speeds', '85k,1m,5m').split(',').filter(Boolean);
const rtt = Number(opt('rtt', 50)), seconds = Number(opt('seconds', 1500));
const out = path.resolve(opt('out', path.join(root, 'build', 'slow-net')));
const learnFrom = opt('learn-from'), gamesDir = opt('games-dir');
const index = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'tools/scenarios/bench/index.json'), 'utf8'));

/** --net argument of the harness (ms:Mbit/s) for a speed name, or null (no simulation) */
export function netArg(speed, rttMs = 50) {
  const s = speed.toLowerCase();
  if (s === 'fast' || s === 'none') return null;
  let m;
  if ((m = /^([\d.]+)k$/.exec(s))) return `${rttMs}:${(Number(m[1]) * 1000 * 8 / 1e6).toFixed(3)}`; // KB/s (1000 bytes)
  if ((m = /^([\d.]+)m$/.exec(s))) return `${rttMs}:${(Number(m[1]) * 8).toFixed(3)}`; // MB/s
  if ((m = /^([\d.]+)mbit$/.exec(s))) return `${rttMs}:${m[1]}`;
  throw new Error(`unknown speed ${speed} (85k, 1m, 5m, fast, <n>mbit)`);
}

/** The summary of one harness run's output: phases, marks, network. */
export function parseRun(text) {
  const r = { outcome: null, phases: [], marks: null, network: null, net: null, firstFrame: null };
  for (const line of text.split('\n')) {
    let m;
    if ((m = /^\[bench\] (\w+)(?: \((.*)\))? after (\d+) s/.exec(line))) { r.outcome = m[1]; r.detail = m[2] ?? null; r.seconds = Number(m[3]); }
    else if ((m = /^\[bench\] phase (\S+): ([\d.]+) s ([\d.]+) fps/.exec(line))) r.phases.push({ label: m[1], seconds: Number(m[2]), fps: Number(m[3]) });
    else if ((m = /^\[bench\] marks: (.*)$/.exec(line))) r.marks = m[1];
    else if ((m = /^\[bench\] network: (.*)$/.exec(line))) r.network = m[1];
    else if ((m = /^\[net\] demand (.*)$/.exec(line))) r.net = m[1];
    else if ((m = /^\[input\] first Direct3D frame at (\d+)s/.exec(line))) r.firstFrame = Number(m[1]);
  }
  // times from the launch (the page's marks: when the scenario reached them): the menu, the first image in game (the
  // 'play' mark), and the bytes received by then
  r.at = {}; r.rx = {};
  for (const m of (r.marks ?? '').matchAll(/(\w+)@([\d.]+)s(?: \(([\d.]+) MB received\))?/g)) { r.at[m[1]] = Number(m[2]); if (m[3]) r.rx[m[1]] = Number(m[3]); }
  r.inGame = r.at.play ?? null;
  return r;
}

/** a TCP port free on 127.0.0.1 now (each run's fresh profile needs no fixed port; another project's server may hold any) */
function freePort() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const s = net.createServer(); s.on('error', reject); s.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => { const { port } = s.address(); s.close(() => resolve(port)); }); });
}

function run(cmd, argv, logFile) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const log = fs.createWriteStream(logFile);
    const p = spawn(cmd, argv, { cwd: root, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
    let text = '';
    p.stdout.on('data', (d) => { text += d; log.write(d); });
    p.stderr.on('data', (d) => { log.write(d); });
    p.on('close', (code) => { log.end(); resolve({ code, text }); });
  });
}

async function main() {
  fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
  const rows = [];
  for (const bench of benches) {
    const def = index.benches.find((b) => b.name === bench);
    if (!def) { console.error(`no bench ${bench} in tools/scenarios/bench/index.json`); process.exit(2); }
    for (const speed of speeds) {
      const tag = `${bench}-${speed}`, tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `orthros-slownet-${tag}-`));
      const learn = path.join(tmp, 'learn'); fs.mkdirSync(learn);
      if (learnFrom) for (const f of fs.readdirSync(learnFrom)) fs.copyFileSync(path.join(learnFrom, f), path.join(learn, f));
      const net = netArg(speed, rtt);
      const argv = [path.join(root, 'tools/with-browser-slot.sh'), 'node', 'tools/headless.mjs', def.manifests[0], '--bench', bench, '--ui', '--seconds', String(seconds),
        '--shots', '120', '--out', path.join(out, tag), '--opfs', path.join(tmp, 'profile'), '--port', String(await freePort()), '--learn', learn, '--telemetry', path.join(tmp, 'telemetry'),
        ...(gamesDir ? ['--games-dir', gamesDir] : []), ...(net ? ['--net', net] : [])];
      console.log(`[slow-net] ${tag}: ${net ? `--net ${net}` : 'no simulated link'}, fresh profile${learnFrom ? `, learned data from ${learnFrom}` : ', nothing learned'}`);
      const t0 = Date.now();
      const { text } = await run('bash', argv, path.join(out, `${tag}.txt`));
      const r = parseRun(text);
      rows.push({ tag, speed, ...r, wall: Math.round((Date.now() - t0) / 1000) });
      console.log(`[slow-net] ${tag}: ${r.outcome ?? 'no bench result'}${r.detail ? ` (${r.detail})` : ''}; first frame ${r.firstFrame ?? '-'} s; ${Object.entries(r.at).map(([k, v]) => `${k} at ${v} s${r.rx[k] !== undefined ? ` (${r.rx[k]} MB received)` : ''}`).join(', ')}`);
      if (r.network) console.log(`[slow-net]   page: ${r.network}`);
      if (r.net) console.log(`[slow-net]   server: demand ${r.net}`);
      if (!args.includes('--keep')) fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
  }
  console.log('\nbench / speed            outcome   1st frame  menu   in game  network (page)');
  for (const r of rows) console.log(`${r.tag.padEnd(25)}${String(r.outcome ?? '-').padEnd(10)}${String(r.firstFrame ?? '-').padStart(8)} s${String(r.at.menu ?? '-').padStart(6)} s${String(r.inGame ?? '-').padStart(7)} s  ${r.network ?? '-'}`);
}

if (process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) main();
```

`tools/snapshot-browser-check.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Snapshots in the page (docs/snapshot.md): the game runs with automatic snapshots on (?snapshot=auto) until its session
// took and kept one (or, --manual, until --at seconds, when orthros.saveSnapshot() takes it), then the page is opened
// again and must go on from it. Screenshots of the frame before and after, the snapshot's log lines, the state after.
// Start it through the browser slot guard:
//   tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/snapshot-browser-check.mjs <manifest> [--games-dir <dir>] [--at <s>] [--after <s>]
//     [--settle <s>] [--manual] [--tries <n>] [--query <k=v&...>] [--out <dir>]
//   --at: seconds of play at most before the snapshot is kept (--manual: before it is asked for); --settle: the page
//   opened again once no other was kept for that long (60 s); --after: seconds of
//   play after the restore; --tries (--manual): asked again every 30 s while refused; --query: more page parameters
//   (glworker=0: the WebGL backend in the game's worker)
//   --url <server>: that server instead of one of its own; --once: the page opened once, by a new player (a fresh
//   browser profile), for --after seconds — exit status 1 unless it went on from a snapshot when --expect-restored
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { createServer } from '../src/host/server.js';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const FLAGS = new Set(['--manual', '--once', '--expect-restored']);
const name = args.find((a, i) => !a.startsWith('--') && (!args[i - 1]?.startsWith('--') || FLAGS.has(args[i - 1])));
const at = Number(opt('at', 180)), after = Number(opt('after', 20)), tries = Number(opt('tries', 1)), settle = Number(opt('settle', 60)), manual = args.includes('--manual');
const out = opt('out', `/tmp/orthros-scratch/snapshot-browser-${name}`);
fs.rmSync(out, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
process.env.TMPDIR = out;
const server = opt('url') ? null : createServer({ gamesDir: opt('games-dir') });
if (server) await new Promise((r) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
const base = `${opt('url') ?? `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`}/?manifest=${encodeURIComponent(name)}&headless=1&opfs=1&snapshot=auto${opt('query') ? '&' + opt('query') : ''}`; // (opfs: the profile kept between the two starts, as a player's)
const chromeArgs = ['--enable-unsafe-swiftshader', '--ignore-gpu-blocklist', '--use-angle=swiftshader', '--enable-webgl', '--enable-features=SharedArrayBuffer', '--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required'];
const browser = await chromium.launchPersistentContext(path.join(out, 'profile'), { args: chromeArgs, viewport: { width: 1280, height: 900 } });
const page = browser.pages()[0] ?? await browser.newPage();
page.on('pageerror', (e) => console.log('[pageerror]', e.message));
const t0 = Date.now(), log = (...a) => console.log(`[${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(0)}s]`, ...a);
const running = () => page.waitForFunction(() => window.orthros?.status === 'running', null, { timeout: 120000 });
const shot = (f) => page.locator('#frame').screenshot({ path: path.join(out, f), timeout: 45000 }).catch((e) => log(`screenshot ${f}: ${e.message.split('\n')[0]}`));
const lines = (re) => page.evaluate((src) => window.orthros.logs.filter((l) => new RegExp(src).test(l)).slice(-20), re.source);
const printLines = async (re) => { for (const l of await lines(re)) console.log('  ' + l.slice(0, 300)); };
try {
  if (args.includes('--once')) {
    await page.goto(base); await running(); log(`${name} running`);
    await page.waitForTimeout(after * 1000);
    await shot('once.png');
    await printLines(/snapshot|restored|crash/);
    const s = await page.evaluate(() => ({ status: window.orthros.status, restored: window.orthros.logs.some((l) => /restored from a snapshot/.test(l)) }));
    log(`once: ${JSON.stringify(s)}`);
    if (s.status !== 'running' || (args.includes('--expect-restored') && !s.restored)) process.exitCode = 1;
    throw null; // (done)
  }
  await page.goto(base); await running(); log(`${name} running`);
  let kept = false;
  if (!manual) {
    // (the first one kept, then the later ones a session takes as its loading goes on: until none for --settle seconds)
    const until = Date.now() + at * 1000;
    kept = await page.waitForFunction(() => window.orthros.snapshotStored === true, null, { timeout: at * 1000, polling: 1000 }).then(() => true, () => false);
    while (kept && Date.now() < until) {
      const s = await page.evaluate(() => ({ at: window.orthros.snapshotKeptAt, pending: !!window.orthros.snapshotPending }));
      if (!s.pending && Date.now() - s.at > settle * 1000) break;
      await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
    }
    await printLines(/snapshot/);
    if (kept) log(`the session kept its snapshot (${await page.evaluate(() => window.orthros.snapshotsKept)} kept in turn)`);
    else { log(`no snapshot kept within ${at} s`); await printLines(/hang|busy|nested|crash/); process.exitCode = 1; }
  } else {
    await page.waitForTimeout(at * 1000);
    // (the worker answers within 15 s of a pump; none at all: it is blocked in a nested wait)
    let r;
    for (let i = 0; i < tries; i++) {
      if (i) await page.waitForTimeout(30000);
      r = await Promise.race([page.evaluate(() => window.orthros.saveSnapshot()), page.waitForTimeout(90000).then(() => ({ error: 'no answer from the worker in 90 s' }))]);
      if (r.saved || r.problems) break;
      log(`no snapshot yet: ${r.error}`);
    }
    if (r.saved) { kept = true; log(`snapshot: ${(r.bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MiB, ${r.objects} objects, ${r.pages} pages, taken in ${r.ms.toFixed(0)} ms (${Object.entries(r.timing ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v.toFixed(0)}`).join(', ')})`); }
    else { log('snapshot refused:'); for (const p of r.problems ?? [r.error]) console.log('  ' + p); await printLines(/hang|busy|nested|crash/); process.exitCode = 1; }
  }
  if (kept) {
    await shot('before.png');
    await page.goto(base); await running(); log('page opened again');
    await page.waitForTimeout(after * 1000);
    await shot('after.png');
    await printLines(/snapshot|restored|crash|warn/);
    const s = await page.evaluate(() => ({ status: window.orthros.status, fps: window.orthros.stats?.fps, failed: window.orthros.snapshotFailed ?? null, restored: window.orthros.logs.some((l) => /restored from a snapshot/.test(l)) }));
    log(`after: ${JSON.stringify(s)}`);
    if (s.failed || !s.restored || s.status !== 'running') process.exitCode = 1;
    if (!(s.fps >= 5)) { log('slow after the restore: the last log lines'); for (const l of await page.evaluate(() => window.orthros.logs.slice(-40))) console.log('  ' + l.slice(0, 400)); }
  }
} catch (e) {
  if (e === null) { /* --once: done */ } else {
  log(`failed: ${e.message.split('\n')[0]}`); process.exitCode = 1;
  const st = await page.evaluate(() => ({ status: window.orthros?.status, logs: window.orthros?.logs?.slice(-30) })).catch(() => null);
  if (st) { console.log(`  status: ${st.status}`); for (const l of st.logs ?? []) console.log('  ' + l.slice(0, 300)); }
  }
} finally { await browser.close(); server?.close(); }
```

`tools/snapshot-check.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Snapshot oracle on a game (docs/snapshot.md), in Node without rendering: the game runs on a virtual clock (with the
// JIT) to a point, its snapshot is taken and restored in a fresh Vm (its profile folder copied at that moment); then both
// machines go on alike on the interpreter (the same slices) and must stay the same — guest memory and every object of
// the state. A refused capture lists every field it cannot keep (the work left, by kind).
//   node tools/snapshot-check.mjs <manifest> --games-dir /srv/orthros/data/games [--at <virtual s>] [--then <slices>]
//     [--input <scenario> [--at-mark <label>]] [--input-after <scenario: times from the capture, played on both>] [--every <slices>] [--keep <dir>] [--log kinds]
//   --lockstep: after every slice a cheap signature of both (thread, guest instructions, API calls, registers): the first
//   slice they part, with each one's last API calls
//   --jit: both go on with an empty JIT (the original's replaced at the capture: Vm.resetJit) — the same translations,
//   the same slices, at the JIT's speed: long comparisons (a game started, played); default: the interpreter
import './node-wasm-flags.mjs';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { VirtualClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';
import { Registry } from '../src/win32/registry.js';
import { makeVfs } from '../src/host/cli.js';
import { loadGameCatalog, DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR } from '../src/host/game-catalog.js';
import { captureVm, restoreVm, HOST_TIME_FIELDS } from '../src/core/vm-snapshot.js';
import { encodeSnapshot, decodeSnapshot, snapshotsDiffer } from '../src/core/snapshot.js';
import { NodeScenario } from './node-scenario.mjs';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const name = args.find((a, i) => !a.startsWith('--') && !args[i - 1]?.startsWith('--'));
const gamesDir = opt('games-dir', DEFAULT_GAMES_DIR);
const manifest = loadGameCatalog(gamesDir).get(name);
if (!manifest) { console.error(`usage: snapshot-check.mjs <manifest> --games-dir <dir> [--at s] [--then slices]`); process.exit(2); }
const atMark = opt('at-mark'); // (a mark of --input: the capture once the scenario reached it)
const at = Number(opt('at', atMark ? 1e6 : 20)) * 1000, then = Number(opt('then', 2000)), every = Number(opt('every', 0));
const scratch = opt('keep') ?? fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(fs.existsSync('/tmp/orthros-scratch') ? '/tmp/orthros-scratch' : os.tmpdir(), 'snapshot-check-'));
if (!opt('keep')) process.on('exit', () => fs.rmSync(scratch, { recursive: true, force: true })); // (whatever the exit: a refusal, a difference)
fs.mkdirSync(scratch, { recursive: true });
const log = (...a) => console.log(`[${((performance.now()) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s]`, ...a);

function machine(saveDir, jit) {
  const clock = new VirtualClock(), host = new HeadlessHost({ clock, width: manifest.display.width, height: manifest.display.height });
  const vm = new Vm({ vfs: makeVfs(manifest, manifest.folder, saveDir), clock, host, jit, logKinds: (opt('log') ?? 'crash').split(',') });
  vm.registry = new Registry(); vm.registry.seed(manifest.registry);
  return vm;
}
const slice = (vm) => vm.runFor(performance.now()).state;
const snap = (vm) => decodeSnapshot(encodeSnapshot(captureVm(vm)));

// ---- A: to the capture point (JIT), the scenario's input on the virtual clock
const dirA = path.join(scratch, 'profile-a'), dirB = path.join(scratch, 'profile-b');
fs.rmSync(dirA, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync(dirA, { recursive: true });
const a = machine(dirA, true);
a.createProcess({ exePath: `${manifest.mount}\\${manifest.exe.replace(/\//g, '\\')}`, args: manifest.args });
const scenario = opt('input') ? new NodeScenario(fs.readFileSync(opt('input'), 'utf8'), a, (l) => log(l), () => a.clock.now()) : null;
log(`${name}: running to ${atMark ? `the scenario's mark ${atMark}` : `${at / 1000} s of guest time`}`);
const marked = () => scenario?.phase?.label === atMark || scenario?.results.some((r) => r.label === atMark);
while (a.clock.now() < at && !(atMark && marked())) {
  const r = a.runFor(performance.now() + 50); scenario?.tick();
  if (r.state === 'exited') { log(`exited (${r.code}) before the capture point`); process.exit(1); }
}
const problems = [];
let s;
try { s = captureVm(a, { manifest: name }, problems); } catch (e) { log(`capture refused: ${e.message}`); process.exit(1); }
if (problems.length) {
  const kinds = new Map();
  for (const p of problems) { const k = p.replace(/ at .*/, ''); kinds.set(k, [...(kinds.get(k) ?? []), p.replace(/^.* at /, '')]); }
  log(`capture refused: ${problems.length} fields`);
  for (const [k, l] of [...kinds].sort((x, y) => y[1].length - x[1].length)) console.log(`  ${l.length} x ${k}: ${l.slice(0, 3).join(' | ')}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const bytes = encodeSnapshot(s);
log(`captured at ${(a.clock.now() / 1000).toFixed(2)} s: ${s.graph.objects.length} objects, ${s.pages.index.length} pages, ${(bytes.length / 2 ** 20).toFixed(1)} MiB`);
fs.rmSync(dirB, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync(dirA, dirB, { recursive: true });

// ---- B: restored; both go on on the interpreter
const jit = args.includes('--jit'), lockstep = args.includes('--lockstep') || !!opt('watch');
const watch = (opt('watch') ?? '').split(',').filter(Boolean).map((x) => parseInt(x, 16)); // (--watch <hex,...>: guest words compared at every slice too)
const b = machine(dirB, jit);
const t0 = performance.now(), a0 = a.clock.now();
restoreVm(b, decodeSnapshot(bytes));
log(`restored in ${((performance.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(2)} s`);
const again = snapshotsDiffer(decodeSnapshot(bytes), snap(b), { ignore: HOST_TIME_FIELDS });
if (again.length) { log('the restored machine is not the snapshot:'); for (const d of again) console.log('  ' + d); process.exit(1); }
if (jit) a.resetJit(); else a.exec = a.interp; // (the same executor on both sides: the same slices)
const scenarioB = opt('input-after') ? new NodeScenario(fs.readFileSync(opt('input-after'), 'utf8'), b, () => {}, () => b.clock.now() - a0) : null;
const scenarioA = opt('input-after') ? new NodeScenario(fs.readFileSync(opt('input-after'), 'utf8'), a, (l) => log(l), () => a.clock.now() - a0) : null;
for (let i = 1; i <= then; i++) {
  const ra = slice(a), rb = slice(b); scenarioA?.tick(); scenarioB?.tick();
  if (lockstep) {
    const sig = (vm) => { const t = vm.lastThread, c = t?.cpu; return `t${t?.id} insns ${vm.guestInsns} api ${vm.apiCalls} eip ${c?.eip.toString(16)} eax ${c?.eax.toString(16)} esp ${c?.esp.toString(16)} clock ${vm.clock.now()}`; };
    const watched = (vm) => watch.map((x) => vm.mem.read32(x & ~3).toString(16)).join(' ');
    const sa = sig(a) + ' | ' + watched(a), sb = sig(b) + ' | ' + watched(b);
    if (sa !== sb) {
      log(`slice ${i}: they part\n  A ${sa}\n  B ${sb}`);
      for (const [n, vm] of [['A', a], ['B', b]]) console.log(`  ${n} last calls:\n    ${vm.recentApiCalls(12).join('\n    ')}`);
      const files = (vm) => [...vm.proc.handles.map].filter(([, o]) => o?.type === 'file' && o.path).map(([h, o]) => `${h}:${o.path}@${o.pos}/${o.file?.size?.() ?? '?'}${o.file?.constructor?.name ? ' ' + o.file.constructor.name : ''}`);
      const fa = files(a), fb = files(b);
      console.log(`  open files differing:\n    A ${fa.filter((x) => !fb.includes(x)).join('\n    A ')}\n    B ${fb.filter((x) => !fa.includes(x)).join('\n    B ')}`);
      process.exit(1);
    }
  }
  if (ra !== rb) { log(`slice ${i}: A ${ra}, B ${rb}`); process.exit(1); }
  if (ra === 'exited') { log(`both exited after ${i} slices`); break; }
  if ((every && i % every === 0) || i === then) {
    const d = snapshotsDiffer(snap(a), snap(b), { ignore: HOST_TIME_FIELDS });
    if (d.length) { log(`differ after ${i} slices (guest ${(a.clock.now() / 1000).toFixed(2)} s):`); for (const x of d) console.log('  ' + x); process.exit(1); }
    log(`same after ${i} slices (guest ${(a.clock.now() / 1000).toFixed(2)} s, ${a.apiCalls} API calls)`);
  }
}
```

`tools/snapshot-jobs.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Runs the shared snapshots' publishing sessions a sandboxed Orthros server queued (server --snapshot-queue, docs/snapshot.md
// stage 3): reads its queue file every 30 s and runs each request once, one at a time, through the browser slot guard
// (tools/snapshot-publish.mjs: the project's browser budget and load limit apply). Outside the server's sandbox: it needs
// the Playwright browsers and the shared /tmp of the slots.
//   node tools/snapshot-jobs.mjs --queue <learn>/snapshots/queue.json --server http://127.0.0.1:8095 [--once]
//   --once: the requests there now, then exit
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const queue = opt('queue'), server = opt('server'), once = args.includes('--once');
if (!queue || !server) { console.error('usage: snapshot-jobs.mjs --queue <file> --server <url> [--once]'); process.exit(2); }
const root = new URL('..', import.meta.url).pathname;
const done = new Set(); // (tokens run by this runner)
const log = (...a) => console.log(new Date().toISOString(), ...a);
const run = (j) => new Promise((resolve) => {
  const a = ['1500', path.join(root, 'tools/with-browser-slot.sh'), 'node', 'tools/snapshot-publish.mjs', j.name, '--url', server, '--lang', j.lang, '--key', j.key, '--token', j.token];
  const p = spawn('timeout', a, { cwd: root, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  const out = (d) => { for (const l of d.toString().split('\n').filter(Boolean)) log(`${j.name} ${j.lang}: ${l.slice(0, 300)}`); };
  p.stdout.on('data', out); p.stderr.on('data', out);
  p.on('exit', (code) => resolve(code)); p.on('error', () => resolve(-1));
});
for (;;) {
  let jobs = [];
  try { jobs = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(queue, 'utf8')).jobs ?? []; } catch { /* none yet */ }
  const todo = jobs.filter((j) => !done.has(j.token) && Date.now() - j.at < 2 * 3600e3);
  for (const j of todo) {
    done.add(j.token);
    log(`${j.name} ${j.lang}: publishing the snapshot of key ${j.key}`);
    log(`${j.name} ${j.lang}: exit ${await run(j)}`);
  }
  if (once) break;
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 30000));
}
```
