`tools/snapshot-publish.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// A shared snapshot's publishing session (docs/snapshot.md, stage 3; started by the server with --snapshot-jobs, through
// the browser slot guard): a headless browser opens the game on that server as a new player would (no profile, the
// shared first-launch one if any), with ?snapshot=publish — each snapshot the session keeps is posted to the server
// with the job's token. It goes on while the game's loading goes on (the later snapshots replace the first), then quits.
//   tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/snapshot-publish.mjs <manifest> --url <server> --lang <l> --key <key>
//     --token <token> [--at <s>] [--settle <s>]
//   --key: the key the server was asked for (the session's must be the same, else it stops); --at: seconds at most
//   (1200); --settle: done once no snapshot was kept for that long (240)
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const name = args[0], url = opt('url'), lang = opt('lang', ''), key = opt('key'), token = opt('token');
const at = Number(opt('at', 1200)), settle = Number(opt('settle', 240));
if (!name || !url || !key || !token) { console.error('usage: snapshot-publish.mjs <manifest> --url <server> --lang <l> --key <key> --token <token>'); process.exit(2); }
const scratch = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(fs.existsSync('/tmp/orthros-scratch') ? '/tmp/orthros-scratch' : os.tmpdir(), `snapshot-publish-${name.replace(/[^\w.-]/g, '_')}-`));
const t0 = Date.now(), log = (...a) => console.log(`[${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(0)}s]`, ...a);
const chromeArgs = ['--enable-unsafe-swiftshader', '--ignore-gpu-blocklist', '--use-angle=swiftshader', '--enable-webgl', '--enable-features=SharedArrayBuffer', '--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required'];
let browser = null;
try {
  browser = await chromium.launchPersistentContext(path.join(scratch, 'profile'), { args: chromeArgs, viewport: { width: 1280, height: 900 } });
  const page = browser.pages()[0] ?? await browser.newPage();
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => log('[pageerror]', e.message));
  const q = new URLSearchParams({ manifest: name, gameLang: lang, headless: '1', opfs: '1', audio: '1', snapshot: 'publish', publishToken: token });
  await page.goto(`${url}/?${q}`);
  await page.waitForFunction(() => window.orthros?.status === 'running', null, { timeout: 180000 });
  const own = await page.evaluate(() => window.orthros.snapshotKey);
  if (own !== key) throw new Error(`this session's key is ${own}, the server was asked for ${key}: nothing to publish`);
  log(`${name} (${lang || 'no language'}) running, key ${key}`);
  const until = t0 + at * 1000, shown = new Set();
  for (;;) {
    const s = await page.evaluate(() => ({ status: window.orthros.status, kept: window.orthros.snapshotsKept ?? 0, published: window.orthros.snapshotsPublished ?? 0, at: window.orthros.snapshotKeptAt ?? 0, pending: !!window.orthros.snapshotPending || (window.orthros.snapshotPublishing ?? 0) > 0 }));
    // (the snapshot lines as they come: a session that ends badly — the page crashed — has said how far it got)
    for (const l of await page.evaluate(() => window.orthros.logs.filter((x) => /snapshot/.test(x)).slice(-8))) if (!shown.has(l)) { shown.add(l); log('  ' + l.slice(0, 300)); }
    if (s.status !== 'running') throw new Error(`the game stopped (${s.status})`);
    if (s.kept && !s.pending && Date.now() - s.at > settle * 1000) { log(`done: ${s.kept} kept, ${s.published} published`); break; }
    if (Date.now() > until) { log(`time is up: ${s.kept} kept, ${s.published} published`); break; }
    await page.waitForTimeout(5000);
  }
} catch (e) {
  log(`failed: ${e.message.split('\n')[0]}`); process.exitCode = 1;
} finally {
  await browser?.close().catch(() => {});
  fs.rmSync(scratch, { recursive: true, force: true });
}

```

`tools/snapshot-shared-check.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Shared snapshots end to end (docs/snapshot.md, stage 3): a private server keeping them (--snapshot-jobs, its learn
// directory in scratch); a first new player starts the game — there is none yet: the server runs its publishing session
// (tools/snapshot-publish.mjs) — then, once it published, a second new player (a fresh browser profile) must start
// from it. This script opens no browser itself: each player and the server's session go through the browser slot guard.
//   node tools/snapshot-shared-check.mjs <manifest> [--games-dir <dir>] [--lang <l>] [--wait <s>] [--after <s>] [--queue] [--keep]
//   --queue: as a sandboxed server (--snapshot-queue), the session run by tools/snapshot-jobs.mjs
//   --wait: seconds at most for the publishing session (1800); --after: seconds each player plays (30); --keep: the
//   scratch directory (server data, screenshots) kept
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { createServer } from '../src/host/server.js';

const args = process.argv.slice(2), opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const name = args[0], lang = opt('lang', 'en'), wait = Number(opt('wait', 1800)), after = opt('after', '30');
const dir = `/tmp/orthros-scratch/snapshot-shared-${name}`;
fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'learn'), { recursive: true });
const t0 = Date.now(), log = (...a) => console.log(`[${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(0)}s]`, ...a);
const queued = args.includes('--queue');
const server = createServer({ gamesDir: opt('games-dir'), learnDir: path.join(dir, 'learn'), snapshotJobs: queued ? 'queue' : true });
await new Promise((r) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
const root = new URL('..', import.meta.url).pathname;
const player = (tag, expect) => new Promise((resolve) => {
  const a = ['node', 'tools/snapshot-browser-check.mjs', name, '--url', url, '--once', '--after', after, '--query', `gameLang=${lang}`, '--out', path.join(dir, tag), ...(expect ? ['--expect-restored'] : [])];
  const p = spawn(path.join(root, 'tools/with-browser-slot.sh'), a, { cwd: root, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  p.stdout.on('data', (d) => process.stdout.write(d.toString().split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => `  ${tag}: ${l}\n`).join('')));
  p.stderr.on('data', (d) => process.stderr.write(d));
  p.on('exit', (code) => resolve(code));
});
let ok = false;
try {
  log(`${name}: a first new player`);
  await player('first', false);
  const jobs = server.snapshotJobs;
  if (queued) {
    if (!jobs.jobs.length) throw new Error('no publishing session was queued');
    log('the runner publishes the queued snapshot');
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      const p = spawn('node', ['tools/snapshot-jobs.mjs', '--queue', jobs.file, '--server', url, '--once'], { cwd: root, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
      p.stdout.on('data', (d) => process.stdout.write(d.toString().split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => `  runner: ${l.slice(0, 250)}\n`).join('')));
      p.on('exit', resolve);
    });
  } else {
    if (!jobs.running && !jobs.queue.length && !jobs.tried.size) throw new Error('no publishing session was asked for');
    log('the server publishes its snapshot');
    const until = Date.now() + wait * 1000;
    while ((jobs.running || jobs.queue.length) && Date.now() < until) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5000));
  }
  const logs = path.join(dir, 'learn', 'snapshots');
  for (const f of fs.readdirSync(logs).filter((x) => x.startsWith('publish-') && !queued)) for (const l of fs.readFileSync(path.join(logs, f), 'utf8').split('\n').filter((x) => /snapshot|done|failed|time is up|running/.test(x)).slice(-12)) console.log(`  publish: ${l.slice(0, 250)}`);
  const kept = fs.readdirSync(path.join(logs, name.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '_'))).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.json'));
  if (!kept.length) throw new Error('nothing published');
  log(`published: ${kept.map((f) => `${f} ${fs.readFileSync(path.join(logs, name.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '_'), f), 'utf8')}`).join('; ')}`);
  log(`${name}: a second new player`);
  ok = (await player('second', true)) === 0;
  log(ok ? 'PASSED: the second player started from the shared snapshot' : 'FAILED');
} catch (e) { log(`FAILED: ${e.message}`); }
finally {
  server.close();
  if (!args.includes('--keep')) fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  process.exit(ok ? 0 : 1);
}
```

`tools/sse-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// SSE2 microbenchmark: ns per instruction of a straight-line scalar/packed double kernel (the shape of the SSE2
// math routines of C runtimes: table constants, mulsd/addsd chains, pshufd/unpcklpd, movlpd to memory), looped.
// Usage: node tools/sse-bench.mjs [iterations]
//
// Kernel (written for this benchmark, assembled with clang-18 --target=i686-pc-windows-msvc):
//   L: addsd xmm4,xmm0 ; movsd xmm0,xmm3 ; addsd xmm3,[ebx] ; mulpd xmm2,xmm7 ; subsd xmm3,[ebx] ; mulpd xmm7,xmm7
//      subsd xmm0,xmm3 ; movapd xmm3,[ebx+16] ; movapd xmm6,[ebx+32] ; mulpd xmm1,xmm7 ; addpd xmm2,xmm1
//      pshufd xmm1,xmm2,0xee ; mulsd xmm2,xmm7 ; xorpd xmm7,xmm7 ; mov edx,0x3f80 ; addsd xmm2,xmm1
//      pinsrw xmm7,edx,3 ; addsd xmm2,xmm4 ; movlpd xmm4,[ebx+48] ; movd xmm1,ecx ; mulsd xmm2,[esp+12]
//      mulsd xmm0,xmm7 ; psllq xmm1,45 ; pshufd xmm1,xmm1,0x44 ; movapd xmm7,[ebx+64] ; addsd xmm5,xmm2
//      mulpd xmm3,xmm1 ; addsd xmm0,xmm5 ; unpcklpd xmm0,xmm0 ; mulpd xmm6,xmm0 ; mulsd xmm4,xmm0 ; mulpd xmm0,xmm0
//      addpd xmm7,xmm6 ; mulpd xmm7,xmm0 ; mulsd xmm0,xmm3 ; pshufd xmm6,xmm7,0xee ; mulsd xmm0,xmm7
//      pshufd xmm5,xmm3,0xee ; mulsd xmm6,xmm3 ; mulsd xmm4,xmm3 ; addsd xmm0,xmm5 ; addsd xmm0,xmm6
//      addsd xmm0,xmm4 ; addsd xmm0,xmm3 ; movlpd [esp+4],xmm0 ; xorpd xmm0,xmm0 ; xorpd xmm4,xmm4
//      xorpd xmm5,xmm5 ; dec ecx ; jnz L ; hlt
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-sse.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';

const KERNEL = '';
const INSNS = 50; // per iteration
const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const N = +(process.argv[2] ?? 2e6);
const bytes = Uint8Array.from(KERNEL.match(/../g).map((h) => parseInt(h, 16)));

let best = Infinity;
for (let rep = 0; rep < 5; rep++) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, bytes);
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) mem.writeF64(DATA + 8 * i, 1 + i / 16); // table constants
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x10000; cpu.ebx = DATA; cpu.ecx = N; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  mem.writeF64(cpu.esp + 12, 0.5);
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true });
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  let r;
  do r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 2e9 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
  const ms = performance.now() - t0;
  if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error(`exit ${r}`);
  best = Math.min(best, ms);
}
console.log(`sse2 kernel: ${(best * 1e6 / N).toFixed(1)} ns per iteration, ${(best * 1e6 / N / INSNS).toFixed(2)} ns per instruction`);

```

`tools/ssef-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// SSE scalar single-precision microbenchmark: ns per instruction of a looped kernel with the shape of compiled 3D
// UI / camera code (movss loads, mulss/addss/subss chains, cvtsi2ss / cvttss2si, comiss / ucomiss + jcc, mixed with
// integer mov / lea / push / pop), 29 instructions per iteration, 3 blocks (a jbe that falls through, a jae taken).
// Two runs: `clean` (lanes 1-3 of every xmm register zero, as after movss loads) and `dirty` (lanes 1-3 of xmm0 —
// only ever written by cvtsi2ss, which preserves them — hold denormals, as when a register last carried integer
// data): any translation that computes the scalar ops on the whole vector then pays the host's denormal assists.
// Usage: node tools/ssef-bench.mjs [iterations]
//
// Kernel (written for this benchmark, assembled with clang-18 --target=i686-pc-windows-msvc):
//   L: mov eax,[ebx+36] ; cvtsi2ss xmm0,eax ; movss xmm1,[ebx+8] ; mulss xmm1,xmm0 ; movss xmm2,[ebx+12]
//      mulss xmm2,xmm0 ; subss xmm1,[ebx+16] ; addss xmm2,xmm1 ; movss xmm3,xmm2 ; mulss xmm3,xmm3
//      lea edx,[esi+8] ; push edx ; movss xmm4,[ebx+20] ; comiss xmm3,xmm4 ; jbe 1f ; movss xmm3,xmm4
//   1: movss [esp],xmm3 ; pop edx ; cvttss2si eax,xmm2 ; mov [ebx+24],eax ; movss xmm5,[ebx+28] ; subss xmm5,xmm2
//      mulss xmm5,xmm1 ; addss xmm5,xmm3 ; ucomiss xmm5,xmm0 ; jae 2f ; subss xmm5,xmm0
//   2: movss [ebx+32],xmm5 ; sub ecx,1 ; jnz L ; hlt
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-sse.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';

const KERNEL = '8b4324f30f2ac0f30f104b08f30f59c8f30f10530cf30f59d0f30f5c4b10f30f58d1f30f10daf30f59db8d560852f30f1063140f2fdc7604f30f10dcf30f111c245af30f2cc2894318f30f106b1cf30f5ceaf30f59e9f30f58eb0f2ee87304f30f5ce8f30f116b2083e9017593f4';
const INSNS = 29; // per iteration (the subss after the jae is skipped)
const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000;
const N = +(process.argv[2] ?? 5e6);
const bytes = Uint8Array.from(KERNEL.match(/../g).map((h) => parseInt(h, 16)));

function run(dirty) {
  let best = Infinity;
  const times = [];
  for (let rep = 0; rep < 7; rep++) {
    const mem = new GuestMemory();
    const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
    cpu.reset();
    mem.writeBytes(CODE, bytes);
    mem.write32(DATA + 36, 3);
    mem.writeF32(DATA + 8, 1.5); mem.writeF32(DATA + 12, 0.25); mem.writeF32(DATA + 16, 0.5);
    mem.writeF32(DATA + 20, 2); mem.writeF32(DATA + 28, 10);
    if (dirty) for (let k = 1; k < 4; k++) mem.write32(cpu.xmmAddr(0) + 4 * k, k); // denormals 1e-45..4e-45
    cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x10000; cpu.ebx = DATA; cpu.esi = DATA; cpu.ecx = N; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
    const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true });
    jit.cpu = cpu;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    let r;
    do r = jit.run({ maxInsns: 2e9 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
    const ms = performance.now() - t0;
    if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error(`exit ${r}`);
    if (mem.readF32(DATA + 32) !== 23 || mem.read32(DATA + 24) !== 4) throw new Error('wrong result');
    times.push(ms); best = Math.min(best, ms);
  }
  times.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const ns = (ms) => (ms * 1e6 / N / INSNS).toFixed(2);
  console.log(`ssef kernel (${dirty ? 'dirty' : 'clean'} upper lanes): ${ns(times[3])} ns per instruction median, ${ns(best)} best, ${ns(times[6])} worst (${(times[3] * 1e6 / N).toFixed(1)} ns per iteration)`);
}
run(false);
run(true);

```

`tools/startbench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Startup benchmark (Node, headless, no rendering): runs a manifest from a fresh user profile until the first call of
// an API (the end of a phase: --until-api, default CreateProcessA) and reports the wall time, the CPU time of the
// process (less sensitive than wall time to other load on a shared machine) and the guest instructions executed.
// Compares JIT variants: `ORTHROS_JIT_OPTS='{"nestLoops":true}' node tools/startbench.mjs <manifest.json>`.
//   node tools/startbench.mjs <manifest.json> [--until-api CreateProcessA] [--limit 600] [--bg | --cold] [--save <dir>] [--until-insns <M>]
//     [--input <scenario> [--coords W,H] | --bench <bench name>]
import './node-wasm-flags.mjs'; // (branch hints honoured, as in Chrome)
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { Vm } from '../src/core/vm.js';
import { normalizeWin } from '../src/vfs/vfs.js';
import { RealClock, VirtualClock } from '../src/core/clock.js';
import { HeadlessHost } from '../src/host/display.js';
import { Registry } from '../src/win32/registry.js';
import { loadManifest, makeVfs } from '../src/host/cli.js';
import { loadGameCatalog } from '../src/host/game-catalog.js';
import { decode, fmtInsn } from '../src/cpu/decoder.js';
import { listRegion } from '../src/cpu/jit/listing.js';
import { PROF_OPS_BASE, NOCHAIN_PROF, SITE_PROF } from '../src/cpu/jit/translate.js';
import { FAST_PROF, FAST_NAMES } from '../src/cpu/jit/runtime.js';
import { jitMix, jitShape } from './jit-mix.mjs';
import { NodeScenario } from './node-scenario.mjs';
import { installNodeGfx, programsLine } from './node-gfx.mjs';
import { LearnedHeat, RangeHeat } from '../src/cpu/jit/heat.js';
import { acct, C as ACCT, catsObject } from '../src/core/frame-acct.js';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const target = args.find((a, i) => !a.startsWith('--') && !args[i - 1]?.startsWith('--'));
if (!target) { console.error('usage: node tools/startbench.mjs <manifest.json> [--until-api CreateProcessA] [--limit 600]'); process.exit(2); }
const untilApi = opt('until-api', 'CreateProcessA'), limit = Number(opt('limit', 600));
// --dbg NAME=value,...: debug globals set before the run (the page's ?dbg= switches, e.g. ORTHROS_HOST_TIMER_Q=15.625)
for (const kv of (opt('dbg', '') || '').split(',').filter(Boolean)) { const [k, v] = kv.split('='); globalThis[k] = Number.isNaN(Number(v)) ? v : Number(v); }
// --until-insns <M>: stop after that many million guest instructions (a fixed amount of guest work: under
// `perf stat -e instructions:u`, the host instructions per guest instruction of a JIT variant, insensitive to the load)
const untilInsns = Number(opt('until-insns', 0)) * 1e6;
const win = opt('window') ? { a: Number(opt('window').split(':')[0]) * 1e6, b: Number(opt('window').split(':')[1]) * 1e6, c0: null, g0: 0, t0: 0 } : null;
// --games-dir <dir>: `target` is a manifest id of that game catalog (e.g. bfme2 = BFME2 1.09), as the harness takes it
const { manifest, dir } = opt('games-dir') ? (() => { const m = loadGameCatalog(opt('games-dir')).get(target); if (!m) throw new Error(`no manifest ${target}`); return { manifest: m, dir: m.folder }; })() : loadManifest(target);
// (a fresh profile: the first-launch path; --save <dir>: that empty directory, kept afterwards — the files the game wrote
// compared between variants)
const keepDir = opt('save');
if (keepDir) fs.mkdirSync(keepDir, { recursive: true });
const saveDir = keepDir ?? fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'orthros-startbench-'));
const vfs = makeVfs(manifest, dir, saveDir);
// --virtual: a virtual clock (time advances with the guest's slices and sleeps) and the scenario timed on it — a run that
// repeats itself exactly (thread interleavings included) as long as nothing else varies (no --bg / --cold)
// --timescale <x>: guest milliseconds per real millisecond (as the page's ?timescale: above 1 the guest sees a slower machine)
const clock = args.includes('--virtual') ? new VirtualClock() : new RealClock(Number(opt('timescale', 1)));
// --jitter <seed>: with --virtual, the clock jumps now and then at the end of a slice (seeded xorshift: 1 slice in 64, 1 to
// 40 ms) as when the host deschedules the emulator — other interleavings of the guest's timed threads, each seed exactly
// repeatable
if (args.includes('--virtual') && opt('jitter')) {
  let x = Number(opt('jitter')) >>> 0 || 1;
  const rnd = () => { x ^= x << 13; x >>>= 0; x ^= x >>> 17; x ^= x << 5; x >>>= 0; return x; };
  const tick = clock.tick.bind(clock);
  clock.tick = (ms) => { tick(ms); if ((rnd() & 63) === 0) tick(1 + (rnd() % 40)); };
}
const host = new HeadlessHost({ clock, width: manifest.display.width, height: manifest.display.height });
// --gfx recorder|backend: the Direct3D work goes to the render worker's recorder (commands dropped: the emulator thread's
// share of the default browser path) or to the in-thread WebGL backend over a no-op context (tools/node-gfx.mjs, as
// framebench); --programs <programs2-<manifest>.json>: learned GL programs compiled ahead (backend). Default: neither
// (the device's own bookkeeping only).
const gfx = opt('gfx') ? installNodeGfx(host, opt('gfx'), { programs: opt('programs'), log: (l) => console.log(l) }) : null;
// --bg: the background translator in a worker thread (shared guest memory), its regions installed between slices;
// --cold: with the JIT's cold tier (Jit.runCold) — what the browser worker does
const bgWanted = args.includes('--bg') || args.includes('--cold');
// --jit-profile: profiling translations (transitions by kind, chained transitions counted), printed with the report
if (args.includes('--jit-profile')) globalThis.ORTHROS_JIT_PROFILE = true;
// --jit-sites: every region exit site (indirect calls and jumps, returns leaving the region, static exits) counts its
// executions and target changes (translate.js siteProf); the report lists them by kind and the hottest sites
if (args.includes('--jit-sites')) globalThis.ORTHROS_SITE_PROF = true;
const siteReport = () => {
  const by = new Map();
  for (const [addr, kind, a] of SITE_PROF) {
    const k = kind + ':' + addr, n = vm.mem.read32(a) >>> 0, ch = vm.mem.read32(a + 8) >>> 0;
    const e = by.get(k) ?? { addr, kind, n: 0, ch: 0, last: 0 }; e.n += n; e.ch += ch; if (n) e.last = vm.mem.read32(a + 4) >>> 0; by.set(k, e);
  }
  const kinds = new Map();
  for (const e of by.values()) {

const writeHeat = () => {
  const f = opt('heat-out'); if (!f || !vm.jit) return;
  const pairs = vm.jit.harvestVisits(), byMod = new Map();
  let old = {}; try { old = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')); } catch { /* new */ }
  for (const [mod, l] of Object.entries(old)) { const h = new RangeHeat(); for (let i = 0; i + 1 < l.length; i += 2) h.add(l[i], l[i] + l[i + 1]); byMod.set(mod, h); }
  for (let i = 0; i < pairs.length; i += 2) {
    const m = vm.proc.moduleByAddr(pairs[i]); if (!m || pairs[i + 1] > m.base + m.size) continue;
    const k = m.name.toLowerCase(); if (!byMod.has(k)) byMod.set(k, new RangeHeat());
    byMod.get(k).add(pairs[i] - m.base, pairs[i + 1] - m.base);
  }
  const out = {}; let n = 0;
  for (const [k, h] of byMod) { const p = h.pairs(), l = []; for (let i = 0; i < p.length; i += 2) l.push(p[i], p[i + 1] - p[i]); out[k] = l; n += p.length / 2; }

  let x = (Number(opt('stall-seed', 0)) || Date.now()) >>> 0 || 1, stalls = 0;

// Sleep — the calls, Sleep(0)s that ran a ready thread, throttled ones, why their streaks ended — and the scheduler's picks)

      const s = t.sleepStats; if (!s) continue;
      const cur = { zero: s.zero, yields: s.yields ?? 0, lower: s.lowerReady ?? 0, throttled: s.throttled, gap: s.brokeGap ?? 0, api: s.brokeApi ?? 0, short: s.short, long: s.long, insns: t.insnsRun ?? 0 }, p = last.get(t.id) ?? {};
      last.set(t.id, cur);
      const d = (k) => ((cur[k] - (p[k] ?? 0)) / f).toFixed(1);
      if (cur.zero + cur.short + cur.long - (p.zero ?? 0) - (p.short ?? 0) - (p.long ?? 0) > 0) out.push(`t${t.id}(prio ${t.priority ?? 0}) Sleep(0) ${d('zero')} [ran another ${d('yields')}, only lower ready ${d('lower')}, throttled ${d('throttled')}, streak ends: gap ${d('gap')} calls ${d('api')}] Sleep(1-2) ${d('short')} longer ${d('long')}`);

// --slow-threads <ms> (with --threads and a scenario): the guest instructions of each thread in the frames longer than
// that, against all frames, per phase ([slowthreads] lines, M per frame): which threads make the slow frames' guest time
if (threadInsns && scenario && opt('slow-threads')) {
  const over = Number(opt('slow-threads')), fh = vm.host.frameHook;
  let last = performance.now(), prev = new Map(), slow = new Map(), all = new Map(), nSlow = 0, nAll = 0;
  vm.host.frameHook = () => {
    fh?.();
    const now = performance.now(), dt = now - last; last = now;
    for (const [id, n] of threadInsns) {
      const d = n - (prev.get(id) ?? 0); prev.set(id, n); if (!d) continue;
      all.set(id, (all.get(id) ?? 0) + d); if (dt > over) slow.set(id, (slow.get(id) ?? 0) + d);
    }
    nAll++; if (dt > over) nSlow++;
  };

}

  if (performance.now() - t0 > limit * 1000) { report('time limit'); process.exit(1); }
```

`tools/strop-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// String instruction microbenchmark: ns per REP MOVS / REP STOS instruction under the JIT, for element counts from
// 1 to 4096, byte and dword elements, both directions (DF=1 with ESI/EDI at the last element: the backward copy a C
// runtime's memmove does for overlapping buffers), non-overlapping and overlapping ranges. Each case is a loop
// `L: mov esi, S ; mov edi, D ; mov ecx, N ; [std] ; rep movs/stos ; [cld] ; dec ebx ; jnz L ; hlt`; the loop
// overhead (the same loop without the string instruction) is measured too and subtracted. Median of 7 runs.
// Usage: node tools/strop-bench.mjs [filter substring]
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, BUF = 0x10000000;
const mem = new GuestMemory();
const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
cpu.reset();
const filter = process.argv[2] ?? '';
const le = (v) => [v & 255, (v >>> 8) & 255, (v >>> 16) & 255, v >>> 24];
const OPS = { movsb: [0xf3, 0xa4], movsd: [0xf3, 0xa5], stosb: [0xf3, 0xaa], stosd: [0xf3, 0xab], none: [] };

/** ns per iteration of the loop for one case */
function run(op, sz, n, back, dstOff, reps, eax = 0x11223344) {
  const last = back ? (n - 1) * sz : 0;
  const src = BUF + 0x10000 + last, dst = BUF + 0x10000 + dstOff + last;
  const body = [0xbe, ...le(src), 0xbf, ...le(dst), 0xb9, ...le(n), ...(back ? [0xfd] : []), ...OPS[op], ...(back ? [0xfc] : []), 0x4b];
  const code = Uint8Array.from([...body, 0x75, (-(body.length + 2)) & 255, 0xf4]);
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
  mem.fill(BUF, 0x40000, 0x5a);
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true }); jit.cpu = cpu;
  const end = CODE + code.length - 1;
  const times = [];
  for (let r = -1; r < 7; r++) { // run -1 translates (and warms up) the loop
    cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = BUF + 0x3f000; cpu.ebx = r < 0 ? 100 : reps; cpu.eax = eax; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    let x; do x = jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: 2e9 }); while (x === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
    if (r >= 0) times.push(performance.now() - t0);
    if (x !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error('exit ' + x);
  }
  times.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return { med: times[3] * 1e6 / reps, lo: times[0] * 1e6 / reps, hi: times[6] * 1e6 / reps };
}

const REPS = 200000;
const base = run('none', 4, 1, false, 0x8000, REPS);
console.log(`loop overhead: ${base.med.toFixed(2)} ns/iter (subtracted below; min..max of 7 runs in brackets)`);
const cases = [];
const OV = ['', ' overlap(memmove-safe)', ' overlap(replicating)'];
for (const op of ['movsd', 'movsb', 'stosd', 'stosb']) {
  const sz = op.endsWith('d') ? 4 : 1;
  for (const back of [false, true]) {
    for (const ov of op.startsWith('movs') ? [0, 1, 2] : op === 'stosd' ? [0, 3] : [0]) {
      const name = `${op} ${back ? 'bwd' : 'fwd'}${ov === 3 ? ' eax=0(memset)' : OV[ov]}`;
      if (!name.includes(filter)) continue;
      cases.push([name, op, sz, back, ov]);
    }
  }
}
for (const [name, op, sz, back, ov] of cases) {
  const cols = [];
  for (const n of [1, 4, 16, 64, 256, 4096]) {
    // memmove-safe overlap: backward copies to a higher address, forward to a lower (what memmove picks the
    // direction for); replicating: the other way round (x86 element order repeats the first elements)
    const dstOff = ov === 1 ? (back ? 3 : -3) : ov === 2 ? (back ? -3 : 3) : 0x8000;
    const reps = Math.max(2000, Math.min(REPS, (REPS * 16 / n) | 0));
    const t = run(op, sz, n, back, dstOff, reps, ov === 3 ? 0 : 0x11223344);
    cols.push(`n=${n}: ${(t.med - base.med).toFixed(1)} [${(t.lo - base.med).toFixed(1)}..${(t.hi - base.med).toFixed(1)}]`);
  }
  console.log(`${name.padEnd(32)} ${cols.join('  ')}`);
}
```

`tools/telemetry-report.mjs`:

```mjs
// Report of the server's telemetry (src/host/server.js --telemetry: <dir>/telemetry-<date>.jsonl, one batch per line):
// per session, the machine (browser, GPU, cores, memory, screen), the game / version, the build and the options it ran
// with (render mode actually used), then
// - per stretch of play (consecutive ~0.5 s samples of one kind: a 3D scene — many draws per frame — or not) the
//   frames > 33 / > 50 ms per minute, the mean work per frame and the time by category (docs/frame-accounting.md);
// - the ~20 s summaries (frame-time percentiles, frames > 33 / 40 / 50 / 100 ms, draws and GL calls per frame, GPU
//   time per frame when the browser measures it, render worker waits) merged per stretch, with the slow frames'
//   categories;
// - the bench runs (?bench=<name>, docs/real-machine-bench.md): per phase results;
// and a comparison of the bench runs, per bench: one line per run, its phases side by side.
// - the bench suite's runs (?benchsuite=, bench-suite.js: every game in a row): per run, each game's outcome and phases
//   (frame time percentiles, frames > 40 ms, work, GPU time, data waits), the renderer, the host's timers.
// Usage: node tools/telemetry-report.mjs <telemetry dir | .jsonl file>... [--from YYYY-MM-DD] [--to YYYY-MM-DD]
//          [--session <id>] [--game <manifest>] [--bench [<name>]] [--suite [<run>]] [--players] [--perf [--gpu <name>]]
//          [--min-seconds 60] [--json]
//   --bench: only the sessions with bench runs (of that bench) and the comparison
//   --suite: only the bench suite's runs (that run: its id), per game
//   --players: the sessions of benches (marked by the page: their batches' and passive records' `bench`) left out
//   --perf [--gpu <part of its name>]: the passive session records (every runtime, src/host/perf-record.js) per game ×
//          GPU: medians over the sessions, all frames merged, the worst minutes, the slow frames' causes, host timing
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { HIST_N, histAddSparse, histQuantile } from '../src/core/frame-acct.js';
import { audioVerdict, audioText } from '../src/host/web/sound.js';
import { probeLine } from '../src/host/web/timing-probe.js';

const FILE_DATE = /telemetry-(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\.jsonl$/;

/** The .jsonl files of the arguments (directories expanded), those of dates outside [from, to] left out. */
export function telemetryFiles(inputs, { from = null, to = null } = {}) {
  const files = [];
  for (const a of inputs) {
    const list = fs.statSync(a).isDirectory() ? fs.readdirSync(a).sort().filter((f) => f.endsWith('.jsonl')).map((f) => path.join(a, f)) : [a];
    for (const f of list) {
      const d = FILE_DATE.exec(f)?.[1];
      if (d && ((from && d < from) || (to && d > to))) continue;
      files.push(f);
    }
  }
  return files;
}

/**
 * Sessions from batches (the parsed lines). `at` (the server's receipt time) filters by date when from / to are
 * given (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive).
 */
export function buildSessions(lines, { from = null, to = null, session = null, game = null } = {}) {
  /** @type {Map<string, any>} */
  const sessions = new Map();
  for (const r of lines) {
    if (!r?.session || (session && r.session !== session) || r.event === 'perf') continue; // (the passive records: --perf)
    const day = typeof r.at === 'string' ? r.at.slice(0, 10) : null;
    if (day && ((from && day < from) || (to && day > to))) continue;
    let s = sessions.get(r.session);
    if (!s) sessions.set(r.session, (s = { id: r.session, game: r.game ?? null, first: r.at ?? null, last: r.at ?? null, env: null, options: null, version: null, samples: [], summaries: [], benches: [], suites: [], bench: null, slow: 0, events: {} }));
    if (r.game) s.game = r.game;
    if (r.bench) s.bench = r.bench; // (a bench's session: the page marks its batches — its suite run, or the bench's name)
    if (r.at) { if (!s.first || r.at < s.first) s.first = r.at; if (!s.last || r.at > s.last) s.last = r.at; }
    if (r.env) { s.env = r.env; s.version ??= r.env.version ?? null; }
    for (const x of r.samples ?? []) {
      if (x.event === 'options') { s.options = x.options; s.version = x.version ?? s.version; }
      else if (x.event === 'slow') s.slow++;
      else if (x.event === 'summary') s.summaries.push(x);
      else if (x.event === 'bench') s.benches.push({ ...x, at: x.at ?? r.at ?? null, env: x.env ?? r.env ?? null, session: r.session });
      else if (x.event === 'bench-suite') s.suites.push({ ...x, at: r.at ?? null, env: x.env ?? r.env ?? null });
      else if (x.event) s.events[x.event] = (s.events[x.event] ?? 0) + 1;
      else if (x.dt) s.samples.push(x);
    }
  }
  for (const s of sessions.values()) if (game && s.game !== game) sessions.delete(s.id);
  return sessions;
}

export function readLines(files) {
  const out = [];
  for (const f of files) for (const line of fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8').split('\n')) { if (!line) continue; try { out.push(JSON.parse(line)); } catch { /* a torn line */ } }
  return out;
}

const add = (into, o, k = 1) => { for (const [n, v] of Object.entries(o ?? {})) into[n] = (into[n] ?? 0) + v * k; };
const fmt = (o, scale = 1, min = 0.3) => Object.entries(o).map(([k, v]) => [k, v * scale]).filter(([, v]) => v >= min).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v.toFixed(1)}`).join(', ');
const kindOf = (frames, draws) => (frames > 0 && draws / frames >= 50 ? '3D' : frames > 0 ? 'other' : 'no frames');

/** Consecutive samples of one kind (3D scene or not, by draws per frame) as stretches. */
export function stretches(samples) {
  const out = []; let cur = null;
  for (const x of samples) {
    const frames = (x.fps ?? 0) * x.dt, kind = kindOf(frames, x.draws ?? 0);
    if (!cur || cur.kind !== kind) out.push(cur = { kind, t0: x.t, seconds: 0, frames: 0, s33: 0, s50: 0, acctFrames: 0, work: 0, cats: {}, slowCats: {}, worst: null, busy: 0 });
    cur.seconds += x.dt; cur.frames += frames; cur.s33 += x.s33 ?? 0; cur.s50 += x.s50 ?? 0; cur.busy += (x.busy ?? 0) * x.dt;
    if (x.c) { cur.acctFrames += frames; cur.work += (x.w ?? 0) * frames; add(cur.cats, x.c, frames); }
    if (x.sc) add(cur.slowCats, x.sc);
    if (x.wf && (!cur.worst || x.wf[0] > cur.worst[0])) cur.worst = x.wf;
  }
  // (a stretch shorter than 10 s is merged into the previous one — a loading hiccup — then neighbours of one kind)
  const merge = (a, b) => { a.seconds += b.seconds; a.frames += b.frames; a.s33 += b.s33; a.s50 += b.s50; a.busy += b.busy; a.acctFrames += b.acctFrames; a.work += b.work; add(a.cats, b.cats); add(a.slowCats, b.slowCats); if (b.worst && (!a.worst || b.worst[0] > a.worst[0])) a.worst = b.worst; };
  const kept = [];
  for (const st of out) {
    const last = kept[kept.length - 1];
    if (last && (st.seconds < 10 || st.kind === last.kind)) merge(last, st); else kept.push(st);
  }
  return kept;
}

/**
 * The ~20 s summaries merged per stretch (consecutive summaries of one kind, a 3D scene or not): frame-time
 * percentiles from the merged histograms, slow-frame rates, draws / GL calls / GPU time / render waits per frame.
 */
export function summaryStretches(summaries) {
  const out = []; let cur = null;
  for (const x of summaries) {
    const kind = kindOf(x.d3dFrames ?? x.frames ?? 0, (x.drawsPerFrame ?? 0) * (x.d3dFrames ?? 0));
    if (!cur || cur.kind !== kind) out.push(cur = { kind, t0: x.t, n: 0, seconds: 0, frames: 0, s33: 0, s40: 0, s50: 0, s100: 0, max: 0, hist: new Array(HIST_N).fill(0), cats: {}, slowCats: {}, work: 0, d3dFrames: 0, draws: 0, glFrames: 0, glCalls: 0, gpuFrames: 0, gpuMs: 0, gpuHist: new Array(HIST_N).fill(0), gpuState: null, gpuMax: 0, rwWait: 0, rwReplay: 0, rwFrames: 0, render: null, visible: 0 });
    cur.n++; cur.seconds += x.seconds ?? 0; cur.frames += x.frames ?? 0;
    for (const k of ['s33', 's40', 's50', 's100']) cur[k] += x[k] ?? 0;
    if ((x.dt?.max ?? 0) > cur.max) cur.max = x.dt.max;
    histAddSparse(cur.hist, x.h);
    add(cur.cats, x.cats, x.frames ?? 0); add(cur.slowCats, x.slowCats); cur.work += (x.work ?? 0) * (x.frames ?? 0);
    if (x.drawsPerFrame !== null && x.drawsPerFrame !== undefined) { cur.d3dFrames += x.d3dFrames ?? 0; cur.draws += x.drawsPerFrame * (x.d3dFrames ?? 0); }
    if (x.glCalls?.frames) { cur.glFrames += x.glCalls.frames; cur.glCalls += x.glCalls.perFrame * x.glCalls.frames; }
    if (x.gpu?.state) cur.gpuState = cur.gpuState === 'on' ? 'on' : x.gpu.state;
    if (x.gpu?.frames) { cur.gpuFrames += x.gpu.frames; cur.gpuMs += x.gpu.mean * x.gpu.frames; histAddSparse(cur.gpuHist, x.gpu.h); if ((x.gpu.max ?? 0) > cur.gpuMax) cur.gpuMax = x.gpu.max; }
    if (x.render && x.frames) { cur.rwWait += x.render.waitMs * x.frames; cur.rwReplay += x.render.replayMs * x.frames; cur.rwFrames += x.frames; }
    if (x.renderMode) cur.render = x.renderMode;
    cur.visible += (x.visible ?? 1) * (x.seconds ?? 0);
  }
  return out.map((c) => {
    const min = c.seconds / 60, n = c.frames || 1, slowTotal = Object.values(c.slowCats).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), hasGpuHist = c.gpuHist.some((v) => v);
    return {
      kind: c.kind, at: c.t0 ? new Date(c.t0).toISOString().slice(11, 19) : null, summaries: c.n, seconds: Math.round(c.seconds), fps: c.seconds ? +(c.frames / c.seconds).toFixed(1) : 0,
      p50: histQuantile(c.hist, 0.5, c.max || Infinity), p90: histQuantile(c.hist, 0.9, c.max || Infinity), p99: histQuantile(c.hist, 0.99, c.max || Infinity), max: c.max,
      per33: min ? +(c.s33 / min).toFixed(1) : 0, per40: min ? +(c.s40 / min).toFixed(1) : 0, per50: min ? +(c.s50 / min).toFixed(1) : 0, per100: min ? +(c.s100 / min).toFixed(1) : 0,
      work: c.frames ? +(c.work / n).toFixed(1) : null, cats: c.frames ? fmt(c.cats, 1 / n) : '', slowShares: slowTotal ? fmt(c.slowCats, 100 / slowTotal, 1) : null,
      drawsPerFrame: c.d3dFrames ? Math.round(c.draws / c.d3dFrames) : null, glCallsPerFrame: c.glFrames ? Math.round(c.glCalls / c.glFrames) : null,
      gpu: c.gpuFrames ? { frames: c.gpuFrames, mean: +(c.gpuMs / c.gpuFrames).toFixed(2), p50: hasGpuHist ? histQuantile(c.gpuHist, 0.5, c.gpuMax || Infinity) : null, p99: hasGpuHist ? histQuantile(c.gpuHist, 0.99, c.gpuMax || Infinity) : null, max: c.gpuMax || null } : c.gpuState,
      renderWaitMs: c.rwFrames ? +(c.rwWait / c.rwFrames).toFixed(2) : null, replayMs: c.rwFrames ? +(c.rwReplay / c.rwFrames).toFixed(2) : null, render: c.render,
      visible: c.seconds ? +(c.visible / c.seconds).toFixed(2) : null,
    };
  });
}

/** A short description of the machine (env of the first batch). */
export function machineLine(env) {
  if (!env) return 'machine unknown';
  const ua = env.ua ?? '', chrome = /Chrome\/(\d+)/.exec(ua)?.[1], os = /Windows NT [\d.]+|Mac OS X [\d_]+|Android [\d.]+|CrOS|Linux/.exec(ua)?.[0];
  const wg = env.webgpu ? (env.webgpu.state ? `WebGPU ${env.webgpu.state}` : `WebGPU ${[env.webgpu.vendor, env.webgpu.architecture, env.webgpu.description].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'adapter'}`) : null;
  return [env.gpu ?? 'GPU ?', env.gpuVendor && !String(env.gpu ?? '').includes(env.gpuVendor) ? `(${env.gpuVendor})` : null, env.cores ? `${env.cores} cores` : null, env.memGB ? `${env.memGB} GB` : null,
    env.screen ? `screen ${env.screen}` : null, chrome ? `Chrome ${chrome}` : null, os, env.coi === false ? 'NOT cross-origin isolated' : null, wg].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
}
const renderModeOf = (s) => s.summaries.findLast?.((x) => x.renderMode)?.renderMode ?? (s.options ? (s.options.renderWorker ? 'worker' : `glworker=${s.options.glWorker ?? '?'}`) : null);

/** The report's data: one entry per session kept. */
export function report(sessions, { minSeconds = 60, bench = undefined, players = false } = {}) {
  const out = [];
  for (const s of sessions.values()) {
    if (players && (s.bench || s.benches.length || s.suites.length)) continue;
    const seconds = s.samples.reduce((a, x) => a + x.dt, 0) || s.summaries.reduce((a, x) => a + (x.seconds ?? 0), 0);
    const benches = bench === undefined ? s.benches : s.benches.filter((b) => bench === true || b.bench === bench);
    if (bench !== undefined && !benches.length) continue;
    if (seconds < minSeconds && !benches.length) continue;
    const r = { session: s.id, game: s.game, bench: s.bench, first: s.first, machine: machineLine(s.env), env: s.env, version: s.version, options: s.options, render: renderModeOf(s), seconds: Math.round(seconds), slowEvents: s.slow, events: s.events, stretches: [], summaryStretches: summaryStretches(s.summaries), audio: audioVerdict(s.summaries.map((x) => x.audio)), benches };
    for (const st of stretches(s.samples)) {
      const min = st.seconds / 60, n = st.acctFrames || 1, slowTotal = Object.values(st.slowCats).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
      r.stretches.push({ kind: st.kind, at: new Date(st.t0).toISOString().slice(11, 19), seconds: Math.round(st.seconds), fps: +(st.frames / st.seconds).toFixed(1), busy: Math.round(st.busy / st.seconds), per33: Math.round(st.s33 / min), per50: Math.round(st.s50 / min),
        work: st.acctFrames ? +(st.work / n).toFixed(1) : null, cats: st.acctFrames ? fmt(st.cats, 1 / n) : null, slowShares: slowTotal ? fmt(st.slowCats, 100 / slowTotal, 1) : null, worst: st.worst });
    }
    out.push(r);
  }
  return out;
}

/** Bench runs grouped by bench: per bench, the phases seen and one row per run. */
export function benchComparison(reports) {
  const by = new Map();
  for (const r of reports) for (const b of r.benches) {
    let g = by.get(b.bench); if (!g) by.set(b.bench, (g = { bench: b.bench, title: b.title ?? null, phases: [], runs: [] }));
    // (a phase new to the bench goes after the phase that precedes it in this run: the scenario's order)
    let at = -1;
    for (const p of b.phases ?? []) { const i = g.phases.indexOf(p.label); if (i >= 0) at = i; else g.phases.splice(++at, 0, p.label); }
    g.runs.push({ session: r.session, at: r.first, manifest: b.manifest, machine: machineLine(b.env ?? r.env), cores: (b.env ?? r.env)?.cores ?? null, version: b.version ?? r.version, render: b.options ? (b.options.renderWorker ? 'worker' : `glworker=${b.options.glWorker}`) : r.render, outcome: b.outcome, firstLaunch: !!b.firstLaunch, display: b.display ?? null, interrupted: b.interrupted ?? null,
      marks: b.marks ?? [], phases: Object.fromEntries((b.phases ?? []).map((p) => [p.label, p])) });
  }
  return [...by.values()];
}

/**
 * The bench suite's runs (bench-suite.js), oldest first: per run its suite, machine, build and, per game in the suite's
 * order, the game's bench record (or, when only the suite's own record has it, its compact result). `run`: one run's id.
 */
export function suiteRuns(sessions, run = null) {
  const runs = new Map();
  const get = (id) => { let r = runs.get(id); if (!r) runs.set(id, (r = { run: id, suite: null, title: null, at: null, env: null, version: null, record: null, games: new Map() })); return r; };
  for (const s of sessions.values()) {
    for (const b of s.benches) {
      const id = b.suite?.run; if (!id || (run && id !== run)) continue;
      const r = get(id); r.suite ??= b.suite.name ?? null; if (!r.at || (b.at && b.at < r.at)) r.at = b.at; r.env ??= b.env ?? s.env; r.version ??= b.version ?? s.version;
      r.games.set(b.suite.index ?? r.games.size + 1, { ...b, of: b.suite.of ?? null, session: s.id });
    }
    for (const x of s.suites) {
      if (!x.run || (run && x.run !== run)) continue;
      const r = get(x.run); r.record = x; r.suite = x.suite ?? r.suite; r.title = x.title ?? null; r.env = x.env ?? r.env; r.version = x.version ?? r.version; if (!r.at || (x.at && x.at < r.at)) r.at = x.at;
    }
  }
  return [...runs.values()].map((r) => {
    // (a game whose own record never came: the suite's record still has its result)
    (r.record?.results ?? []).forEach((g, i) => { if (!r.games.has(i + 1)) r.games.set(i + 1, { ...g, fromSuite: true }); });
    return { ...r, games: [...r.games.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]).map(([index, g]) => ({ index, ...g })) };
  }).sort((a, b) => String(a.at).localeCompare(String(b.at)));
}

const ms = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined ? '-' : Math.round(v * 10) / 10);
/** The text of the suite's runs: per game, its outcome and phases side by side with the figures read first. */
export function formatSuites(runs) {
  const L = [];
  for (const r of runs) {
    const done = r.games.filter((g) => g.outcome === 'done').length;
    L.push(`suite ${r.suite ?? '?'} run ${r.run} ${(r.at ?? '').slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ')}: ${done}/${r.record?.games ?? r.games.length} games done${r.record ? `, ${r.record.seconds} s` : ', no suite record (the run did not finish)'}${r.version ? `, build ${r.version}` : ''}`);
    L.push(`  machine: ${machineLine(r.env)}`);
    for (const g of r.games) {
      const probe = g.hostTiming?.[0];
      L.push(`  ${g.index}. ${g.bench} (${g.manifest ?? '?'}, ${g.runtime ?? 'win32'}): ${g.outcome}${g.detail ? ` — ${g.detail}` : ''}${g.seconds !== null && g.seconds !== undefined ? `, ${g.seconds} s` : ''}${g.firstLaunch ? ', first launch' : ''}${g.interrupted && (g.interrupted.hiddenSeconds || g.interrupted.blurs) ? ', INTERRUPTED' : ''}${g.fromSuite ? ' (from the suite record)' : ''}`);
      if (g.renderer) L.push(`      renderer ${g.renderer}${g.display ? `, display ${g.display}` : ''}`);
      for (const p of g.phases ?? []) {
        L.push(`      ${String(p.label).padEnd(10)} ${String(p.seconds ?? '?').padStart(6)} s ${String(p.fps ?? '?').padStart(5)} fps; frame ms p50 ${p.dt?.p50 ?? '-'} p90 ${p.dt?.p90 ?? '-'} p99 ${p.dt?.p99 ?? '-'}; >40 ms ${p.per40 ?? '-'}/min (${p.slow40 ?? '-'}); work p50 ${ms(p.work?.p50)} p99 ${ms(p.work?.p99)} ms; GPU ${p.gpu?.frames ? `p50 ${p.gpu.p50} p99 ${p.gpu.p99} ms` : p.gpu?.state ?? '-'}; data waits ${p.dataWaitMs ?? '-'} ms${p.drawsPerFrame !== null && p.drawsPerFrame !== undefined ? `; draws/frame ${p.drawsPerFrame}` : ''}`);
      }
      if (probe) L.push(`      timers: ${probe.atomicsWait1 && typeof probe.atomicsWait1 === 'object' ? probeLine(probe) : `Atomics.wait(1) +${probe.atomicsWait1 ?? '?'} ms, setTimeout(1) +${probe.setTimeout1 ?? '?'} ms (p50)`}`);
    }
  }
  return L.join('\n');
}

const cell = (p) => (p ? `${p.fps} fps p99 ${p.dt?.p99 ?? '?'} >33 ${p.per33}/min${p.gpu?.frames ? ` gpu p99 ${p.gpu.p99}` : ''}` : '-');

/** The text report. */
export function formatReport(reports, comparison) {
  const L = [];
  for (const r of reports) {
    L.push(`session ${r.session}${r.bench ? ` [bench ${r.bench}]` : ''} ${r.game ?? '?'} ${r.first ? r.first.slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ') : ''} ${r.seconds} s${r.version ? `, build ${r.version}` : ''}${r.render ? `, render ${r.render}` : ''}; ${r.slowEvents} slow-frame events${Object.keys(r.events).length ? `; events ${Object.entries(r.events).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v}`).join(', ')}` : ''}`);
    L.push(`  machine: ${r.machine}`);
    if (r.options) L.push(`  options: ${Object.entries(r.options).filter(([, v]) => v !== '' && v !== false && v !== null).map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`).join(' ')}`);
    for (const st of r.stretches) {
      L.push(`  ${st.at} ${st.kind.padEnd(9)} ${String(st.seconds).padStart(5)} s ${String(st.fps).padStart(5)} fps busy ${st.busy}% >33 ms ${st.per33}/min >50 ms ${st.per50}/min${st.work !== null ? `; work ${st.work} ms/frame: ${st.cats}` : ''}`);
      if (st.slowShares) L.push(`      slow frames' time (%): ${st.slowShares}; worst ${st.worst[0]} ms (work ${st.worst[1]}: ${Object.entries(st.worst[2]).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v}`).join(', ')})`);
    }
    if (r.audio && r.audio.verdict !== 'none') L.push(`  ${audioText(r.audio)}`);
    if (r.summaryStretches.length) L.push('  summaries (every ~20 s), merged per stretch:');
    for (const st of r.summaryStretches) {
      L.push(`  ${st.at ?? '--:--:--'} ${st.kind.padEnd(9)} ${String(st.seconds).padStart(5)} s ${String(st.fps).padStart(5)} fps; frame ms p50 ${st.p50} p90 ${st.p90} p99 ${st.p99} max ${st.max}; >33 ${st.per33}/min >40 ${st.per40} >50 ${st.per50} >100 ${st.per100}; draws/frame ${st.drawsPerFrame ?? '-'}, GL calls/frame ${st.glCallsPerFrame ?? '-'}; GPU ${typeof st.gpu === 'object' && st.gpu ? `${st.gpu.mean} ms/frame p50 ${st.gpu.p50} p99 ${st.gpu.p99} (${st.gpu.frames} frames timed)` : st.gpu ?? '-'}${st.renderWaitMs !== null ? `; render worker waits ${st.renderWaitMs} ms/frame, replay ${st.replayMs}` : ''}${st.visible !== null && st.visible < 0.99 ? `; visible ${Math.round(st.visible * 100)}%` : ''}`);
      if (st.work !== null) L.push(`      work ${st.work} ms/frame: ${st.cats}${st.slowShares ? `; slow frames' time (%): ${st.slowShares}` : ''}`);
    }
    for (const b of r.benches) {
      L.push(`  bench ${b.bench} (${b.manifest}): ${b.outcome}${b.detail ? ` — ${b.detail}` : ''}, ${b.seconds} s, display ${b.display ?? '?'}${b.firstLaunch ? ', first launch' : ''}${b.interrupted && (b.interrupted.hiddenSeconds || b.interrupted.blurs) ? `, INTERRUPTED (hidden ${b.interrupted.hiddenSeconds} s, ${b.interrupted.blurs} focus losses)` : ''}; marks ${(b.marks ?? []).map((m) => `${m.label}@${m.at}s`).join(' ')}`);
      if (b.audio) L.push(`    ${audioText(audioVerdict([b.audio]))}`);
      for (const p of b.phases ?? []) {
        L.push(`    ${String(p.label).padEnd(12)} ${String(p.seconds ?? '?').padStart(6)} s ${String(p.fps ?? '?').padStart(5)} fps; frame ms p50 ${p.dt?.p50 ?? '-'} p90 ${p.dt?.p90 ?? '-'} p99 ${p.dt?.p99 ?? '-'} max ${p.dt?.max ?? '-'}; >33 ${p.per33}/min >40 ${p.per40 ?? "-"} >50 ${p.per50} >100 ${p.per100}; draws/frame ${p.drawsPerFrame ?? '-'}, GL calls/frame ${p.glCalls?.perFrame ?? p.glCalls?.state ?? '-'}; GPU ${p.gpu?.frames ? `p50 ${p.gpu.p50} p99 ${p.gpu.p99} ms` : p.gpu?.state ?? '-'}${p.render ? `; render waits ${p.render.waitMs} ms/frame` : ''}`);
        if (p.mean) L.push(`      mean frame (ms): ${Object.entries(p.mean).slice(0, 6).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v}`).join(', ')}${p.excessShares && Object.keys(p.excessShares).length ? `; slow frames' excess (%): ${Object.entries(p.excessShares).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v}`).join(', ')}` : ''}${p.hitches && Object.keys(p.hitches).length ? `; hitches: ${Object.entries(p.hitches).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v}`).join(', ')}` : ''}`);
      }
      // (the host's wake-ups: core/host-wait.js per phase, the timing probes of timing-probe.js)
      for (const p of b.phases ?? []) if (p.hostWait?.waits) L.push(`    ${String(p.label).padEnd(12)} host waits: late ${p.hostWait.overMean} ms on average (max ${p.hostWait.overMax}), late for the frame ${p.hostWait.lateMsPerFrame ?? '-'} ms/frame, estimate ${p.hostWait.est} ms, timers ${p.hostWait.timerEst} ms, spin ${p.hostWait.spinMsPerFrame} ms/frame${p.hostWait.injected ? `, injected ${p.hostWait.injected} ms timer` : ''}${p.hostWait.adaptive === true ? '' : p.hostWait.adaptive ? ', adaptive switched' : ', adaptive off'}`);
      for (const pr of b.hostTiming ?? []) L.push(`    timer probe ${pr.label}@${pr.at}s: ${probeLine(pr)}`);
    }
  }
  for (const g of comparison) {
    L.push('', `bench ${g.bench}${g.title ? ` — ${g.title}` : ''}: ${g.runs.length} run(s)`);
    for (const run of g.runs) {
      L.push(`  ${(run.at ?? '').slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ')} ${run.session} ${run.manifest} ${run.outcome}${run.firstLaunch ? ' first-launch' : ''}${run.interrupted && (run.interrupted.hiddenSeconds || run.interrupted.blurs) ? ' INTERRUPTED' : ''} | ${run.machine} | build ${run.version ?? '?'} render ${run.render ?? '?'} display ${run.display ?? '?'}`);
      L.push(`      ${g.phases.map((ph) => `${ph}: ${cell(run.phases[ph])}`).join(' | ')}`);
      const m = run.marks.map((x) => `${x.label}@${x.at}s`).join(' '); if (m) L.push(`      marks ${m}`);
    }
  }
  return L.join('\n');
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- --perf: the passive session records (perf-record.js)
/** A short name of the GPU from the WebGL renderer string ("ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (0x…) Direct3D11 …)" -> "Intel Iris Xe Graphics"). */
export function gpuLabel(renderer) {
  let r = String(renderer ?? '').trim();
  if (!r) return 'GPU ?';
  if (/swiftshader/i.test(r)) return 'SwiftShader';
  const angle = /^ANGLE \((.*)\)$/.exec(r);
  if (angle) { const parts = angle[1].split(', '); r = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : parts[0]; }
  r = r.replace(/^ANGLE Metal Renderer: /, '').replace(/\((R|TM|tm|r)\)/g, '').replace(/\s*\(0x[0-9a-f]+\)/ig, '')
    .replace(/\s+(Direct3D\d*|D3D\d+|OpenGL|Vulkan|Metal)\b.*$/i, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  return r || 'GPU ?';
}
const median = (v) => { const a = v.filter((x) => typeof x === 'number' && Number.isFinite(x)).sort((x, y) => x - y); return a.length ? a[a.length >> 1] : null; };
const per = (count, seconds) => (seconds > 0 ? +(count / (seconds / 60)).toFixed(1) : null);

/** The perf records by session (their entries in order, the latest totals). `gpu`: a part of the GPU's name or renderer. */
export function perfSessions(lines, { from = null, to = null, session = null, game = null, gpu = null, players = false } = {}) {
  const by = new Map();
  for (const r of lines) {
    if (r?.event !== 'perf' || !r.session || (session && r.session !== session) || (game && r.game !== game)) continue;
    if (players && r.bench) continue; // (--players: a bench's records — its suite run, its name — left out)
    const day = typeof r.at === 'string' ? r.at.slice(0, 10) : null;
    if (day && ((from && day < from) || (to && day > to))) continue;
    let s = by.get(r.session);
    if (!s) by.set(r.session, (s = { id: r.session, game: r.game ?? null, runtime: r.runtime, first: r.at ?? null, env: null, probe: null, seqs: new Set(), mins: [], tot: null, totSeq: -1, len: 0, vis: 0, hid: 0, final: false, version: null, build: null, tier: null, bench: null }));
    if (s.seqs.has(r.seq)) continue; // (a record sent twice)
    s.seqs.add(r.seq);
    if (r.at && (!s.first || r.at < s.first)) s.first = r.at;
    if (r.env) s.env = r.env; if (r.probe) s.probe = r.probe;
    for (const k of ['version', 'build', 'tier', 'bench']) if (r[k]) s[k] = r[k];
    s.mins.push(...(r.mins ?? []));
    if (r.seq > s.totSeq) { s.totSeq = r.seq; s.tot = r.tot; s.len = r.len ?? s.len; s.vis = r.vis ?? s.vis; s.hid = r.hid ?? s.hid; }
    if (r.final) s.final = true;
  }
  for (const s of by.values()) {
    s.mins.sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
    s.gpu = gpuLabel(s.env?.gpu);
    if (gpu && !s.gpu.toLowerCase().includes(gpu.toLowerCase()) && !String(s.env?.gpu ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(gpu.toLowerCase())) by.delete(s.id);
  }
  return by;
}

/** One session's figures from its totals. */
function sessionFigures(s) {
  const t = s.tot ?? {}, sec = t.s ?? s.vis ?? 0;
  return { session: s.id, at: s.first, runtime: s.runtime, tier: s.tier, build: s.build, seconds: Math.round(sec), len: s.len, visible: s.len ? +(s.vis / s.len).toFixed(2) : null, final: s.final,
    fps: t.fps ?? null, p50: t.p50 ?? null, p90: t.p90 ?? null, p99: t.p99 ?? null, max: t.max ?? null, per40: per(t.f40 ?? 0, sec), per100: per(t.f100 ?? 0, sec),
    work: t.work ?? null, wait: t.wait ?? null, gpu: t.gpu?.n ? t.gpu : null, gpuState: t.gpu?.state ?? null, dataMsPerMin: t.data ? per(t.data.ms, sec) : null, dataWaits: t.data?.n ?? null,
    machine: machineLine(s.env), probe: s.probe };
}

/** The sessions grouped per game × GPU: medians over the sessions, the merged frame times, the worst minutes, the slow frames' causes. */
export function perfReport(sessions, { minSeconds = 60 } = {}) {
  const groups = new Map();
  for (const s of sessions.values()) {
    if ((s.tot?.s ?? s.vis ?? 0) < minSeconds) continue;
    const key = `${s.game ?? '?'}\n${s.gpu}`;
    let g = groups.get(key);
    if (!g) groups.set(key, (g = { game: s.game, gpu: s.gpu, runtime: s.runtime, sessions: [], hist: new Array(HIST_N).fill(0), max: 0, minutes: [], slow: {}, seconds: 0, noFrames: 0 }));
    if (!(s.tot?.n > 0)) { g.noFrames++; continue; } // (no frame shown: a start that never drew — counted, not in the medians)
    g.sessions.push(s); g.seconds += s.tot?.s ?? 0;
    if (s.tot?.h) histAddSparse(g.hist, s.tot.h);
    if ((s.tot?.max ?? 0) > g.max) g.max = s.tot.max;
    for (const e of s.mins) { g.minutes.push({ session: s.id, ...e }); add(g.slow, e.slow); }
  }
  return [...groups.values()].filter((g) => g.sessions.length || g.noFrames).map((g) => {
    const f = g.sessions.map(sessionFigures), slowTotal = Object.values(g.slow).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const m = (k) => median(f.map((x) => x[k]));
    // (the worst minutes: those with the most frames over 40 ms a minute, then the highest p99; at least 20 s of play)
    const worst = g.minutes.filter((e) => (e.s ?? 0) >= 20 && e.n > 0).map((e) => ({ ...e, per40: per(e.f40 ?? 0, e.s) })).sort((a, b) => (b.per40 - a.per40) || ((b.p99 ?? 0) - (a.p99 ?? 0))).slice(0, 3);
    const probes = f.map((x) => x.probe).filter(Boolean);
    return {
      game: g.game, gpu: g.gpu, runtime: g.runtime, sessions: f.length, noFrames: g.noFrames, minutes: +(g.seconds / 60).toFixed(1),
      median: { fps: m('fps'), p50: m('p50'), p90: m('p90'), p99: m('p99'), per40: m('per40'), per100: m('per100'), work: m('work'), wait: m('wait'), gpuMean: median(f.map((x) => x.gpu?.mean)), gpuP90: median(f.map((x) => x.gpu?.p90)), dataMsPerMin: m('dataMsPerMin'), visible: m('visible') },
      merged: { p50: histQuantile(g.hist, 0.5, g.max || Infinity), p90: histQuantile(g.hist, 0.9, g.max || Infinity), p99: histQuantile(g.hist, 0.99, g.max || Infinity), max: g.max || null },
      gpuStates: [...new Set(f.map((x) => x.gpuState).filter(Boolean))],
      slowShares: slowTotal ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(g.slow).map(([k, v]) => [k, Math.round(v / slowTotal * 100)]).filter(([, v]) => v >= 1).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])) : null,
      worst, probe: probes.length ? { atomicsWait1P50: median(probes.map((p) => p.atomicsWait1?.[0])), setTimeout1P50: median(probes.map((p) => p.setTimeout1?.[0])), onBattery: probes.filter((p) => p.battery && !p.battery.charging).length, n: probes.length } : null,
      perSession: f,
    };
  }).sort((a, b) => String(a.game).localeCompare(String(b.game)) || a.gpu.localeCompare(b.gpu));
}

/** The --perf text. */
export function formatPerf(groups) {
  const L = [];
  const v = (x, unit = '') => (x === null || x === undefined ? '-' : `${x}${unit}`);
  if (!groups.length) L.push('no passive session records (event "perf") in the selection');
  for (const g of groups) {
    const md = g.median;
    L.push(`${g.game ?? '?'} (${g.runtime}) × ${g.gpu}: ${g.sessions} session(s), ${g.minutes} min of visible play${g.noFrames ? `; ${g.noFrames} session(s) without a frame shown` : ''}`);
    L.push(`  medians over the sessions: ${v(md.fps)} fps; frame ms p50 ${v(md.p50)} p90 ${v(md.p90)} p99 ${v(md.p99)}; >40 ms ${v(md.per40)}/min >100 ms ${v(md.per100)}/min; work ${v(md.work)} wait ${v(md.wait)} ms/frame; GPU ${md.gpuMean !== null ? `${md.gpuMean} ms/frame p90 ${v(md.gpuP90)}` : g.gpuStates.join('/') || '-'}; data waits ${v(md.dataMsPerMin)} ms/min; visible ${md.visible !== null ? Math.round(md.visible * 100) + '%' : '-'}`);
    L.push(`  all frames merged: p50 ${v(g.merged.p50)} p90 ${v(g.merged.p90)} p99 ${v(g.merged.p99)} max ${v(g.merged.max)} ms`);
    if (g.slowShares) L.push(`  slow frames' time by cause (%): ${Object.entries(g.slowShares).map(([k, x]) => `${k} ${x}`).join(', ')}`);
    for (const w of g.worst) L.push(`  worst minute: ${w.session} t=${w.t}s ${w.ph ?? '-'} ${w.fps} fps p99 ${v(w.p99)} >40 ms ${w.per40}/min${w.work !== undefined ? ` work ${w.work} wait ${w.wait}` : ''}${w.gpu?.n ? ` gpu ${w.gpu.mean}` : ''}${w.data?.ms ? ` data ${w.data.ms} ms` : ''}${w.slow ? ` slow: ${Object.entries(w.slow).map(([k, x]) => `${k} ${x}`).join(', ')}` : ''}`);
    if (g.probe) L.push(`  host timing: Atomics.wait(1) late p50 ${v(g.probe.atomicsWait1P50)} ms, setTimeout(1) ${v(g.probe.setTimeout1P50)} ms (median of ${g.probe.n}); ${g.probe.onBattery} on battery`);
    for (const s of g.perSession) L.push(`    ${(s.at ?? '').slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ')} ${s.session} ${s.seconds} s${s.visible !== null && s.visible < 0.99 ? ` (visible ${Math.round(s.visible * 100)}%)` : ''}${s.final ? '' : ' (no end record)'}: ${v(s.fps)} fps p99 ${v(s.p99)} >40 ${v(s.per40)}/min work ${v(s.work)} gpu ${s.gpu ? s.gpu.mean : v(s.gpuState)}${s.tier ? ` tier ${s.tier}` : ''} | ${s.machine}${s.build ? ` | build ${s.build}` : ''}`);
  }
  return L.join('\n');
}

function main(args) {
  const opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf('--' + k); return i >= 0 && i + 1 < args.length && !args[i + 1].startsWith('--') ? args[i + 1] : d; };
  const valued = new Set(['--from', '--to', '--session', '--game', '--gpu', '--min-seconds']);
  const inputs = []; let benchName, suiteRun;
  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    const a = args[i];
    if (valued.has(a)) { i++; continue; }
    // (--bench [name]: a name unless the next argument is a flag or an existing path; without one, every bench)
    if (a === '--bench') { const n = args[i + 1]; if (n && !n.startsWith('--') && !fs.existsSync(n)) { benchName = n; i++; } else benchName = true; continue; }
    if (a === '--suite') { const n = args[i + 1]; if (n && !n.startsWith('--') && !fs.existsSync(n)) { suiteRun = n; i++; } else suiteRun = true; continue; }
    if (!a.startsWith('--')) inputs.push(a);
  }
  if (!inputs.length) { console.error('usage: node tools/telemetry-report.mjs <telemetry dir | file.jsonl>... [--from YYYY-MM-DD] [--to YYYY-MM-DD] [--session id] [--game manifest] [--bench [name]] [--suite [run]] [--players] [--perf [--gpu name]] [--min-seconds 60] [--json]'); return 2; }
  const range = { from: opt('from', null), to: opt('to', null) };
  if (args.includes('--perf')) {
    const groups = perfReport(perfSessions(readLines(telemetryFiles([...new Set(inputs)], range)), { ...range, session: opt('session', null), game: opt('game', null), gpu: opt('gpu', null), players: args.includes('--players') }), { minSeconds: Number(opt('min-seconds', 60)) });
    console.log(args.includes('--json') ? JSON.stringify(groups, null, 1) : formatPerf(groups));
    return 0;
  }
  const sessions = buildSessions(readLines(telemetryFiles([...new Set(inputs)], range)), { ...range, session: opt('session', null), game: opt('game', null) });
  if (suiteRun !== undefined) {
    const runs = suiteRuns(sessions, suiteRun === true ? null : suiteRun);
    if (args.includes('--json')) console.log(JSON.stringify({ suites: runs }, null, 1));
    else console.log(runs.length ? formatSuites(runs) : 'no bench suite run');
    return 0;
  }
  const reports = report(sessions, { minSeconds: Number(opt('min-seconds', 60)), bench: benchName, players: args.includes('--players') });
  const comparison = benchComparison(reports);
  if (args.includes('--json')) console.log(JSON.stringify({ sessions: reports, benches: comparison }, null, 1));
  else console.log(formatReport(reports, comparison));
  return 0;
}

if (process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) process.exitCode = main(process.argv.slice(2));
```

`tools/tierup-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// When does V8 run a region's optimized code? A small loop kernel entered over and over for a short run each time (as
// game code is in play: thousands of regions, each run for a few hundred instructions per frame), its time per guest
// instruction printed as the entries accumulate. V8 compiles a function with its baseline compiler (Liftoff) first
// and with TurboFan once it has used a tiering budget (--wasm-tiering-budget, ~13 MB of "bytes executed"); a region
// run briefly per entry may stay in the baseline tier for a long time.
//   node [--wasm-tiering-budget=N] tools/tierup-bench.mjs [iterations per entry] [entries] [--opts json]
// (Liftoff charges the budget by code position: dead bytes at a function's start made a small region tier up after
// ~4k entries instead of ~16-32k here, but changed nothing measurable in play — the option was removed.)
import './node-wasm-flags.mjs'; // (branch hints honoured, as in Chrome)
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';

const args = process.argv.slice(2).filter((a, i, l) => !a.startsWith('--') && l[i - 1] !== '--opts');
const optsI = process.argv.indexOf('--opts');
const opts = optsI >= 0 ? JSON.parse(process.argv[optsI + 1]) : {};
const ITER = Number(args[0] ?? 20), ENTRIES = Number(args[1] ?? 200000);
const CODE = 0x20000000, STACK = 0x11000000;
// xor ecx, ecx ; L: mov eax, ecx ; and eax, 7 ; cmp eax, 3 ; jne s1 ; inc ebx ; s1: cmp eax, 5 ; jb s2 ; add edx, eax ;
// s2: inc ecx ; cmp ecx, ITER ; jb L ; hlt ; ret
const le = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >>> 8) & 0xff, (v >>> 16) & 0xff, (v >>> 24) & 0xff];
const code = Uint8Array.from([0x31, 0xc9, 0x89, 0xc8, 0x83, 0xe0, 0x07, 0x83, 0xf8, 0x03, 0x75, 0x01, 0x43, 0x83, 0xf8, 0x05, 0x72, 0x02, 0x01, 0xc2,
  0x41, 0x81, 0xf9, ...le(ITER), 0x72, 0xe4, 0xf4, 0xc3]);
const mem = new GuestMemory(), cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
cpu.reset(); mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { smc: true, ...opts }); jit.cpu = cpu;
const end = CODE + code.length - 2;
let insns = 0, t0 = performance.now(), mark = 1000;
const tStart = t0;
for (let e = 1; e <= ENTRIES; e++) {
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = STACK; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  let r; do { r = jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: 1e9 }); insns += 1e9 - jit.remaining(); } while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
  if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error('exit ' + r);
  if (e === mark) {
    const t = performance.now();
    console.log(`entries ${String(e).padStart(7)}: ${((t - t0) * 1e6 / insns).toFixed(2)} ns per guest instruction (${((t - tStart) / 1000).toFixed(2)} s since start)`);
    t0 = t; insns = 0; mark *= 2;
  }
}
```

`tools/timer-clamp-check.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Browser check of the worker's short-sleep scheduling (src/host/web/worker.js schedulePump): in a cross-origin-isolated
// Chromium worker, a chain of short sleeps where each timer callback sleeps again (every pump returning 'sleep'), armed
// directly with setTimeout (the HTML nesting clamp: >= 4 ms after five levels) and through a MessageChannel hop (what
// schedulePump does from a timer callback), reports the mean / p50 / p99 oversleep per requested length. (A negative
// oversleep: setTimeout truncates its fractional delay to whole ms — the worker's pump then waits the rest inside runFor.)
// Measured 2026-10-21 (Linux Chromium headless): from the timer callback 1/2/3 ms sleeps oversleep 3.07/2.07/1.07 ms
// (the 4 ms clamp); through the hop -0.82/-0.85/-0.87 ms mean, p99 +0.08 ms.
// Usage: tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/timer-clamp-check.mjs [--n 200]
import http from 'node:http';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';

const require = createRequire(new URL('../package.json', import.meta.url));
let chromium;
try { ({ chromium } = require('playwright')); } catch { ({ chromium } = createRequire('/srv/orthros/package.json')('playwright')); }
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const N = Number(args[args.indexOf('--n') + 1] || 200);

const workerSrc = `
const N = ${N};
function chain(ms, hop) {
  return new Promise((done) => {
    const ch = new MessageChannel(); let due = 0, k = 0, last = 0; const over = [];
    ch.port1.onmessage = () => setTimeout(tick, Math.max(0, due - performance.now()));
    function arm() { last = performance.now(); due = last + ms; if (hop) ch.port2.postMessage(0); else setTimeout(tick, ms); }
    function tick() { over.push(performance.now() - due); if (++k >= N) { done(over); return; } arm(); }
    arm();
  });
}
onmessage = async () => {
  const out = [];
  for (const ms of [1, 2, 3]) for (const hop of [false, true]) {
    const o = (await chain(ms, hop)).slice(10).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    out.push({ ms, hop, mean: o.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / o.length, p50: o[o.length >> 1], p99: o[Math.floor(o.length * 0.99)] });
  }
  postMessage(out);
};`;
const page = `<!doctype html><script>
const w = new Worker(URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([${JSON.stringify(workerSrc)}], { type: 'text/javascript' })));
window.result = new Promise((r) => { w.onmessage = (e) => r(e.data); }); w.postMessage(0);
</script>`;
const server = http.createServer((q, s) => { s.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': 'text/html', 'cross-origin-opener-policy': 'same-origin', 'cross-origin-embedder-policy': 'require-corp' }); s.end(page); });
await new Promise((r) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
try {
  const p = await browser.newPage();
  await p.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/`);
  const res = await p.evaluate(() => window.result);
  for (const r of res) console.log(`${r.ms} ms sleep, ${r.hop ? 'armed from a message (hop)' : 'armed from the timer callback'}: oversleep mean ${r.mean.toFixed(3)} ms, p50 ${r.p50.toFixed(3)}, p99 ${r.p99.toFixed(3)}`);
} finally { await browser.close(); server.close(); }

```

`tools/v8-logs.mjs`:

```mjs
// V8's own log files (isolate-<address>-<pid>-v8.log: one per page, worker and process) are written when a --js-flags
// switch turns a V8 log on (--log, --log-*, --prof, …), into the browser's working directory — the tools', the
// repository's root — unless V8's --logfile names another path. Every --js-flags switch the tools pass goes through
// v8LogArgs: --logfile=<V8_LOG_DIR>/v8.log added (V8 still writes one file per isolate, its isolate- prefix put before
// the file's name), a --logfile already given kept. The directory is made first: V8 writes its log to the standard
// output when it cannot open the file.

import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';

export const V8_LOG_DIR = '/tmp/orthros-scratch/v8-logs';

/** Chromium's switches, each --js-flags given a --logfile under `dir` unless it names one. */
export function v8LogArgs(args, dir = V8_LOG_DIR) {
  return args.map((a) => {
    if (!a.startsWith('--js-flags=') || /(?:^|\s)--logfile(?:[=\s]|$)/.test(a.slice('--js-flags='.length))) return a;
    mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    return `${a} --logfile=${dir}/v8.log`;
  });
}
```
