`tools/vfs-check.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Byte-exactness of the served game folder: random ranges of random files fetched from the Orthros server (HTTP
// range requests, as the worker's VFS does) compared with direct reads of the same files. Bytes only — no file
// format is interpreted.
// Usage: node tools/vfs-check.mjs <manifest name | game folder> [samples]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createServer } from '../src/host/server.js';
import { folderManifest } from '../src/host/manifest.js';
import { loadGameCatalog, defaultGameManifest } from '../src/host/game-catalog.js';
import { resolveGameFile } from '../src/host/game-files.js';

const arg = process.argv[2];
const samples = Number(process.argv[3] ?? 2000);
if (!arg) { console.error('usage: node tools/vfs-check.mjs <manifest | game folder> [samples]'); process.exit(2); }
let name = arg, manifest;
const extra = new Map();
if (fs.existsSync(arg) && fs.statSync(arg).isDirectory()) {
  manifest = fs.existsSync(path.join(arg, 'manifest.json'))
    ? defaultGameManifest(arg)
    : folderManifest(arg);
  name = 'check'; extra.set(name, manifest);
} else manifest = loadGameCatalog().get(arg);
if (!manifest) throw new Error(`unknown version: ${arg}`);

const server = createServer({ extra });
await new Promise((r) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
const tree = await (await fetch(`${base}/api/tree/${name}`)).json();
const files = [];
(function walk(node, rel) {
  for (const [n, f] of Object.entries(node.files ?? {})) files.push({ rel: rel ? `${rel}/${n}` : n, size: f.size });
  for (const [n, d] of Object.entries(node.dirs ?? {})) walk(d, rel ? `${rel}/${n}` : n);
})(tree, '');
const total = files.reduce((a, f) => a + f.size, 0);
let seed = 12345; const rnd = () => ((seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0) / 2 ** 32);
const pick = () => { let x = rnd() * total; for (const f of files) { if ((x -= f.size) < 0) return f; } return files[files.length - 1]; };
let bad = 0, bytes = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
  const f = i < files.length ? files[i] : pick(); // every file once, then weighted by size
  if (!f.size) continue;
  const len = Math.min(f.size, 1 + Math.floor(rnd() * (rnd() < 0.2 ? 4 << 20 : 65536)));
  const start = i < files.length && rnd() < 0.5 ? f.size - len : Math.floor(rnd() * (f.size - len + 1)); // (file ends included)
  const r = await fetch(`${base}/game/${name}/${f.rel.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/')}`, { headers: { Range: `bytes=${start}-${start + len - 1}` } });
  const got = new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer());
  const want = Buffer.alloc(len); const fd = fs.openSync(resolveGameFile(manifest, f.rel), 'r'); fs.readSync(fd, want, 0, len, start); fs.closeSync(fd);
  bytes += len;
  if (r.status !== 206 || got.length !== len || Buffer.compare(Buffer.from(got), want) !== 0) { bad++; if (bad <= 10) console.log(`MISMATCH ${f.rel} [${start}, ${start + len}) status ${r.status} got ${got.length} bytes`); }
}
server.close();
console.log(`${files.length} files (${(total / 2 ** 20).toFixed(0)} MiB), ${samples} ranges, ${(bytes / 2 ** 20).toFixed(0)} MiB compared: ${bad} mismatch${bad === 1 ? '' : 'es'}`);
process.exit(bad ? 1 : 0);

```

`tools/with-browser-slot.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Run a command that starts a test browser (tools/headless.mjs, Playwright) within the project's resource budget on
# this shared server (see CLAUDE.md, "Shared server budget"): at most ORTHROS_BROWSERS (default 3) such commands at
# once for the whole project, and a new one starts only while the 1-minute load average is below ORTHROS_LOAD_MAX
# (default half the CPU count) and at least ORTHROS_MEM_MIN_GB (default 12) GB of memory are available. Otherwise it
# waits (every 20 s) for a slot. The command runs in a memory-limited scope (ORTHROS_BROWSER_MEM, default 12G, no swap):
# a browser that grows past it (SwiftShader's GPU process grows over long runs) is killed alone instead of the server
# running out of memory (incident of 2026-10-30: the server froze and rebooted). ORTHROS_BROWSER_MEM=0: no scope.
# Usage: tools/with-browser-slot.sh node tools/headless.mjs bfme2 --seconds 120 ...
set -u
# (no browser while Orthros' scratch is over its disk budget or the disk is too full: CLAUDE.md "Disk budget")
"$(dirname "$0")/disk-check.sh" -q || exit 3
max=${ORTHROS_BROWSERS:-3}
loadmax=${ORTHROS_LOAD_MAX:-$(( $(nproc) / 2 ))}
memmin=${ORTHROS_MEM_MIN_GB:-12}
mem=${ORTHROS_BROWSER_MEM:-12G}
scope=()
if [ "$mem" != "0" ] && command -v systemd-run >/dev/null && systemd-run --scope --quiet -p MemoryMax=64M -- true 2>/dev/null; then
  scope=(systemd-run --scope --quiet -p "MemoryMax=$mem" -p MemorySwapMax=0 --)
fi
while :; do
  load=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg)
  if awk -v l="$load" -v m="$loadmax" 'BEGIN { exit !(l < m) }' && "$(dirname "$0")/mem-check.sh" -q "$memmin"; then
    for i in $(seq 1 "$max"); do
      # (-E 75: "slot busy" is told apart from the command's own exit status)
      flock -n -E 75 "/tmp/orthros-browser-slot.$i" "${scope[@]}" "$@"
      rc=$?
      [ "$rc" -ne 75 ] && exit "$rc"
    done
  fi
  sleep 20
done

```

`tools/x87-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// x87 microbenchmark for the JIT: ns per iteration of a dot-product loop (FLD m64, FMUL m64,
// FADDP, two ADDs, DEC/JNZ) in three configurations:
//   pc53    one region, MSVC default control word (0x027f: 53-bit precision)
//   pc24    same loop under control word 0x007f (24-bit precision: every result goes through roundPC);
//           pc24 gen: the same with the mode tested at run time
//   chained loop body split across two regions (a region boundary in the middle): every
//           iteration flushes/reloads the cached x87 stack twice (entry/exit cost of x87 regions)
// Usage: node tools/x87-bench.mjs [iterations]
//
// The control word is set in the thread state before the run (not by an FLDCW inside the timed
// region): x87 regions are specialized for the precision/rounding control in force when they are
// translated, as a game's hot code is; `generic` runs the same loop with the mode tested at run time
// (Jit option fpuSpecialize: false).
//
// Transform mode: node tools/x87-bench.mjs xform [vertices]
//   ns per vertex of a 3D transform loop the way x87 compilers emit it (per output component:
//   FLD m32, FMUL m32, FLD m32, FMUL m32, FADDP, FLD m32, FMUL m32, FADDP, FADD m32, FSTP m32),
//   at 24-bit precision (the Direct3D FPU mode) and 53-bit precision; results checked against a
//   JavaScript reference that rounds like the x87.
//
// Transcendental mode: node tools/x87-bench.mjs trans [iterations] [--jit [reps]]
//   ns per transcendental instruction (F2XM1, FSCALE, FSIN small / 1e6 argument, FCOS, FSINCOS,
//   FPTAN, FPATAN, FYL2X, FYL2XP1, and the game's e^x sequence) with the loop shape of
//   tools/pe/bench.c's TRANS_LOOP (acc / x / dx on the register stack, one kernel applied to a copy
//   of x per iteration), under three executors:
//     jit      the JIT with the native kernels of the runtime module (fpmath-*.js)
//     jit-fb   the JIT with the transcendental handlers removed from HANDLERS: the region calls the
//              interpreter for the instruction (flush/reload of the x87 locals around the call) —
//              the translator's state before the kernels existed
//     interp   the interpreter alone (iterations / 10)
//   Each case is paired with a base loop (same body without the transcendental) so that the cost of
//   the instruction itself is the difference; a JS reference sum validates every encoding.
//   --jit [reps]: the JIT alone, median and spread of `reps` paired runs per case (CASES=name,... selects cases).
import { GuestMemory } from '../src/cpu/memory.js';
import { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST } from '../src/cpu/state.js';
import { Interp } from '../src/cpu/interp.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-x87.js';
import '../src/cpu/interp-sse.js';
import { Jit } from '../src/cpu/jit/jit.js';
import { HANDLERS } from '../src/cpu/jit/translate.js';
import { OP } from '../src/cpu/decoder.js';

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000, VEC_A = DATA + 0x1000, VEC_B = DATA + 0x3000;
const LEN = 256; // elements per pass (the loop restarts the pointers every LEN elements)
const MODE = ['trans', 'xform'].includes(process.argv[2]) ? process.argv[2] : 'dot';
const CW_PC24 = 0x007f, CW_PC53 = 0x027f;
// (the number after --jit is its repetition count, not the iteration count)
const ITER = +(process.argv.slice(2).find((a, i, v) => /^\d/.test(a) && v[i - 1] !== '--jit') ?? (MODE === 'trans' ? 1e6 : 2e6));

class Asm {
  constructor(base) { this.base = base; this.bytes = []; this.labels = new Map(); this.fixups = []; }
  get pc() { return this.base + this.bytes.length; }
  label(n) { this.labels.set(n, this.pc); return this; }
  emit(...b) { this.bytes.push(...b); return this; }
  imm32(v) { return this.emit(v & 0xff, (v >> 8) & 0xff, (v >> 16) & 0xff, (v >>> 24) & 0xff); }
  jcc(cc, n) { this.emit(0x0f, 0x80 | cc); this.fixups.push([this.bytes.length, n]); return this.imm32(0); }
  jmp(n) { this.emit(0xe9); this.fixups.push([this.bytes.length, n]); return this.imm32(0); }
  finish() {
    for (const [at, n] of this.fixups) { const rel = this.labels.get(n) - (this.base + at + 4); this.bytes[at] = rel & 0xff; this.bytes[at + 1] = (rel >> 8) & 0xff; this.bytes[at + 2] = (rel >> 16) & 0xff; this.bytes[at + 3] = (rel >>> 24) & 0xff; }
    return Uint8Array.from(this.bytes);
  }
}

/**
 * fldz ; mov ecx, ITER ; mov edx, LEN ; mov esi, A ; mov edi, B
 * L: fld [esi] ; fmul [edi] ; faddp ; add esi, 8 ; add edi, 8 ; [M:] dec edx ; jnz K ; mov edx, LEN ; mov esi, A ; mov edi, B
 * K: dec ecx ; jnz L ; fstp [DATA] ; end: hlt
 */
function program(pc24, split) {
  const a = new Asm(CODE);
  a.emit(0xd9, 0xee);
  a.emit(0xb9).imm32(ITER).emit(0xba).imm32(LEN).emit(0xbe).imm32(VEC_A).emit(0xbf).imm32(VEC_B);
  a.label('L').emit(0xdd, 0x06).emit(0xdc, 0x0f).emit(0xde, 0xc1).emit(0x83, 0xc6, 8).emit(0x83, 0xc7, 8);
  if (split) a.jmp('M');
  a.label('M').emit(0x4a).jcc(0x5, 'K').emit(0xba).imm32(LEN).emit(0xbe).imm32(VEC_A).emit(0xbf).imm32(VEC_B);
  a.label('K').emit(0x49).jcc(0x5, 'L').emit(0xdd, 0x1d).imm32(DATA);
  a.label('end').emit(0xf4);
  return { code: a.finish(), end: a.labels.get('end'), M: a.labels.get('M') };
}

function run(name, pc24, split, generic = false) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  const I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
  const jit = new Jit(mem, I, { fpuSpecialize: !generic });
  const { code, end, M } = program(pc24, split);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
  for (let i = 0; i < LEN; i++) { mem.writeF64(VEC_A + 8 * i, 1 + i * 1e-3); mem.writeF64(VEC_B + 8 * i, 2 - i * 1e-3); }
  mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, pc24 ? CW_PC24 : CW_PC53);
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  jit.cpu = cpu;
  jit.boundaries = new Set(split ? [M, end] : [end]);
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const r = jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: 1e9 });
  const ms = performance.now() - t0;
  if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error(`${name}: exit ${r}`);
  const perIter = (ms * 1e6) / ITER;
  console.log(`${name.padEnd(8)} ${ms.toFixed(0).padStart(5)} ms  ${perIter.toFixed(1).padStart(6)} ns/iter  sum=${mem.readF64(DATA).toPrecision(12)}  regions=${jit.stats.regions} chained=${jit.stats.chained} fallbacks=${jit.stats.fallbackSteps}`);
}

// ============================================================================================
// Transform mode

const NV = 64, VIN = DATA + 0x1000, VOUT = DATA + 0x2000, MAT = DATA + 0x3000;
function xformProgram() {
  const a = new Asm(CODE);
  a.emit(0xb9).imm32(ITER).emit(0xba).imm32(NV).emit(0xbe).imm32(VIN).emit(0xbb).imm32(VOUT).emit(0xbf).imm32(MAT);
  a.label('L');
  for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
    a.emit(0xd9, 0x06).emit(0xd8, 0x4f, 4 * r); // fld [esi] ; fmul [edi + 4r]
    a.emit(0xd9, 0x46, 4).emit(0xd8, 0x4f, 16 + 4 * r).emit(0xde, 0xc1); // fld [esi+4] ; fmul [edi+16+4r] ; faddp
    a.emit(0xd9, 0x46, 8).emit(0xd8, 0x4f, 32 + 4 * r).emit(0xde, 0xc1); // fld [esi+8] ; fmul [edi+32+4r] ; faddp
    a.emit(0xd8, 0x47, 48 + 4 * r).emit(0xd9, 0x5b, 4 * r); // fadd [edi+48+4r] ; fstp [ebx+4r]
  }
  a.emit(0x83, 0xc6, 12).emit(0x83, 0xc3, 12); // add esi, 12 ; add ebx, 12
  a.emit(0x4a).jcc(0x5, 'K').emit(0xba).imm32(NV).emit(0xbe).imm32(VIN).emit(0xbb).imm32(VOUT);
  a.label('K').emit(0x49).jcc(0x5, 'L');
  a.label('end').emit(0xf4);
  return { code: a.finish(), end: a.labels.get('end') };
}
function xformMode() {
  console.log(`x87 vertex transform loop, ${ITER} vertices (3 components x 10 x87 instructions + 5 integer instructions per vertex)`);
  const CW_CHOP24 = 0x0c7f; // 24-bit precision, rounding toward zero (functions that truncate their FISTPs)
  for (const [name, pc24, generic, cw] of [['pc24', true, false], ['pc24 generic', true, true], ['pc24 chop', true, false, CW_CHOP24], ['pc24 chop gen', true, true, CW_CHOP24], ['pc53', false, false], ['pc53 generic', false, true]]) {
    let best = Infinity, ok = true;
    for (let rep = 0; rep < 3; rep++) {
      const mem = new GuestMemory();
      const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
      const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu), { fpuSpecialize: !generic });
      const { code, end } = xformProgram();
      cpu.reset();
      mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
      const m = Array.from({ length: 16 }, (_, i) => Math.fround(0.5 + 0.37 * Math.sin(i + 1)));
      m.forEach((v, i) => mem.writeF32(MAT + 4 * i, v));
      for (let i = 0; i < 3 * NV; i++) mem.writeF32(VIN + 4 * i, Math.fround(Math.cos(i) * 10));
      mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, cw ?? (pc24 ? CW_PC24 : CW_PC53));
      cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
      jit.cpu = cpu; jit.boundaries = new Set([end]);
      const t0 = performance.now();
      const r = jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: 1e9 });
      best = Math.min(best, performance.now() - t0);
      if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error(`xform: exit ${r}`);
      // reference: every x87 result rounded to 24 bits (pc24) or to double (pc53), stored as float
      const chop = (x) => { const t = Math.fround(x); if (Math.abs(t) <= Math.abs(x)) return t; const b = new Float32Array([t]); new Int32Array(b.buffer)[0]--; return b[0]; };
      const rnd = cw === CW_CHOP24 ? chop : pc24 ? Math.fround : (x) => x;
      for (let v = 0; v < NV && ok; v++) for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
        const x = mem.readF32(VIN + 12 * v), y = mem.readF32(VIN + 12 * v + 4), z = mem.readF32(VIN + 12 * v + 8);
        let acc = rnd(x * m[c]); acc = rnd(acc + rnd(y * m[4 + c])); acc = rnd(acc + rnd(z * m[8 + c])); acc = rnd(acc + m[12 + c]);
        if (Math.fround(acc) !== mem.readF32(VOUT + 12 * v + 4 * c)) { ok = false; console.log(`  MISMATCH vertex ${v} component ${c}: ${mem.readF32(VOUT + 12 * v + 4 * c)} want ${Math.fround(acc)}`); break; }
      }
    }
    console.log(`${name.padEnd(13)} ${best.toFixed(0).padStart(5)} ms  ${((best * 1e6) / ITER).toFixed(1).padStart(6)} ns/vertex${ok ? '' : '  (MISMATCH)'}`);
  }
}

// ============================================================================================
// Transcendental mode

const X0 = DATA, DX = DATA + 8, OUT = DATA + 0x20, BIG = DATA + 0x40;
/**
 * mov ecx, n ; fld qword [DX] ; fld qword [X0] ; fldz            (st0 = acc, st1 = x, st2 = dx)
 * L: fld st(1) ; <body> ; faddp st(1), st ; fxch st(1) ; fadd st, st(2) ; fxch st(1) ; dec ecx ; jnz L
 * fstp qword [OUT] ; fstp st(0) ; fstp st(0) ; end: hlt
 * The body sees a copy of x in st(0) and must leave its result there at the same depth.
 */
function transProgram(body, n) {
  const a = new Asm(CODE);
  a.emit(0xb9).imm32(n);
  a.emit(0xdd, 0x05).imm32(DX).emit(0xdd, 0x05).imm32(X0).emit(0xd9, 0xee);
  a.label('L').emit(0xd9, 0xc1).emit(...body);
  a.emit(0xde, 0xc1).emit(0xd9, 0xc9).emit(0xd8, 0xc2).emit(0xd9, 0xc9).emit(0x49).jcc(0x5, 'L');
  a.emit(0xdd, 0x1d).imm32(OUT).emit(0xdd, 0xd8).emit(0xdd, 0xd8);
  a.label('end').emit(0xf4);
  return { code: a.finish(), end: a.labels.get('end') };
}

const FLD1 = [0xd9, 0xe8], FLD_ST0 = [0xd9, 0xc0], FXCH = [0xd9, 0xc9], FSTP_ST0 = [0xdd, 0xd8], FSTP_ST1 = [0xdd, 0xd9], FADDP = [0xde, 0xc1];
const F2XM1 = [0xd9, 0xf0], FYL2X = [0xd9, 0xf1], FPTAN = [0xd9, 0xf2], FPATAN = [0xd9, 0xf3], FYL2XP1 = [0xd9, 0xf9];
const FSINCOS = [0xd9, 0xfb], FRNDINT = [0xd9, 0xfc], FSCALE = [0xd9, 0xfd], FSIN = [0xd9, 0xfe], FCOS = [0xd9, 0xff];
const FLD_BIG = [0xdd, 0x05, BIG & 0xff, (BIG >> 8) & 0xff, (BIG >> 16) & 0xff, BIG >>> 24]; // fld qword [BIG] (-1023.5)
const FLDL2E = [0xd9, 0xea], FMULP = [0xde, 0xc9], FSUB_ST1_ST = [0xdc, 0xe9];
/** name, body (transcendental included), base (same body without it), x0/dx of the argument sweep, reference f(x) */
const TRANS_CASES = [
  { name: 'f2xm1', body: F2XM1, base: [], x0: -0.5, dx: 1e-6, ref: (x) => 2 ** x - 1 },
  // FSCALE with ST(1) = 1: fld1 ; fxch ; fscale ; fstp st(1)  ->  2 x
  { name: 'fscale', body: [...FLD1, ...FXCH, ...FSCALE, ...FSTP_ST1], base: [...FLD1, ...FXCH, ...FSTP_ST1], x0: -0.5, dx: 1e-6, ref: (x) => 2 * x },
  // FSCALE by trunc(-1023.5) = -1023 (|ST(1)| >= 1023: the kernel path; denormal results, exact in the reference)
  { name: 'fscale big', body: [...FLD_BIG, ...FXCH, ...FSCALE, ...FSTP_ST1], base: [...FLD_BIG, ...FXCH, ...FSTP_ST1], x0: -0.5, dx: 1e-6, ref: (x) => x * 2 ** -1023 },
  { name: 'fsin', body: FSIN, base: [], x0: -2, dx: 6e-6, ref: Math.sin },
  // |x| < pi/4: the inline polynomial path (no range reduction)
  { name: 'fsin small', body: FSIN, base: [], x0: -0.75, dx: 1.5e-6, ref: Math.sin },
  { name: 'fcos small', body: FCOS, base: [], x0: -0.75, dx: 1.5e-6, ref: Math.cos },
  { name: 'fsin 1e6', body: FSIN, base: [], x0: 1e6, dx: 1, ref: Math.sin },
  { name: 'fcos', body: FCOS, base: [], x0: -2, dx: 6e-6, ref: Math.cos },
  { name: 'fsincos', body: [...FSINCOS, ...FADDP], base: [], x0: -2, dx: 6e-6, ref: (x) => Math.sin(x) + Math.cos(x) },
  { name: 'fptan', body: [...FPTAN, ...FSTP_ST0], base: [], x0: -1, dx: 2.4e-6, ref: Math.tan },
  // atan2(x, 1): fld1 ; fpatan
  { name: 'fpatan', body: [...FLD1, ...FPATAN], base: [...FLD1, ...FSTP_ST0], x0: -2, dx: 6e-6, ref: Math.atan },
  // x log2 x: fld st(0) ; fyl2x
  { name: 'fyl2x', body: [...FLD_ST0, ...FYL2X], base: [...FLD_ST0, ...FSTP_ST0], x0: 0.5, dx: 2e-6, ref: (x) => x * Math.log2(x) },
  { name: 'fyl2xp1', body: [...FLD_ST0, ...FYL2XP1], base: [...FLD_ST0, ...FSTP_ST0], x0: -0.25, dx: 5e-7, ref: (x) => x * Math.log2(1 + x) },
  // the classic e^x = 2^(x log2 e) sequence (the game's start-up benchmark hits F2XM1 + FSCALE this way)
  { name: 'exp seq', body: [...FLDL2E, ...FMULP, ...FLD_ST0, ...FRNDINT, ...FSUB_ST1_ST, ...FXCH, ...F2XM1, ...FLD1, ...FADDP, ...FSCALE, ...FSTP_ST1], base: [], x0: -0.5, dx: 1e-6, ref: Math.exp },
];
const TRANS_OPS = [OP.F2XM1, OP.FSCALE, OP.FYL2X, OP.FYL2XP1, OP.FPATAN, OP.FSIN, OP.FCOS, OP.FSINCOS, OP.FPTAN];

/** Run one loop under an executor; returns { ms, sum, fallbacks }. */
function runTrans(exec, body, n, x0, dx) {
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  const I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
  const { code, end } = transProgram(body, n);
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, code);
  mem.writeF64(X0, x0); mem.writeF64(DX, dx); mem.writeF64(BIG, -1023.5);
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x800; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
  let r, ms, fallbacks = 0;
  if (exec === 'interp') {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    r = I.run({ stopAt: end });
    ms = performance.now() - t0;
  } else {
    const saved = TRANS_OPS.map((op) => HANDLERS[op]);
    if (exec === 'jit-fb') for (const op of TRANS_OPS) HANDLERS[op] = null;
    try {
      const jit = new Jit(mem, I);
      jit.cpu = cpu;
      jit.boundaries = new Set([end]);
      const t0 = performance.now();
      r = jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: 1e9 });
      ms = performance.now() - t0;
      fallbacks = jit.stats.fallbackSteps;
    } finally { TRANS_OPS.forEach((op, i) => { HANDLERS[op] = saved[i]; }); }
  }
  if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error(`${exec}: exit ${r}`);
  return { ms, sum: mem.readF64(OUT), fallbacks };
}

function refSum(c, n) { let s = 0, x = c.x0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { s += c.ref(x); x += c.dx; } return s; }

function transMode() {
  const EXECS = [['jit', ITER, 3], ['jit-fb', ITER, 2], ['interp', Math.max(1, Math.round(ITER / 4)), 3]];
  console.log(`x87 transcendentals, ${ITER} iterations (interp: ${EXECS[2][1]}), best of ${EXECS.map(([, , r]) => r).join('/')} runs; loop = fld st(1) ; <body> ; faddp ; fxch ; fadd st,st(2) ; fxch ; dec ; jnz (7 insns + body)`);
  console.log('ns/insn = (case - base) per iteration; jit-fb = JIT with the transcendental handlers removed (interpreter fallback inside the region)');
  console.log('case       ' + EXECS.map(([e]) => `${e.padStart(9)} ns/iter ${'base'.padStart(6)} ${'ns/insn'.padStart(7)}`).join(' |') + ' | fb/jit');
  for (const c of TRANS_CASES) {
    let line = c.name.padEnd(11), per = {};
    for (const [exec, n, reps] of EXECS) {
      let best = Infinity, bestBase = Infinity, sum = 0, fb = 0;
      for (let k = 0; k < reps; k++) {
        const r = runTrans(exec, c.body, n, c.x0, c.dx); best = Math.min(best, r.ms); sum = r.sum; fb = r.fallbacks;
        const b = runTrans(exec, c.base, n, c.x0, c.dx); bestBase = Math.min(bestBase, b.ms);
      }
      const want = refSum(c, n);
      if (!(Math.abs(sum - want) <= 1e-8 * Math.max(1, Math.abs(want)))) console.log(`  MISMATCH ${c.name} ${exec}: got ${sum} want ${want}`);
      if (exec === 'jit' && fb !== 0) console.log(`  ${c.name}: ${fb} fallbacks under the native JIT`);
      if (exec === 'jit-fb' && fb !== n * (c.name === 'exp seq' ? 2 : 1)) console.log(`  ${c.name}: ${fb} fallbacks under jit-fb (expected ${n} per transcendental)`);
      const nsIter = (best * 1e6) / n, nsBase = (bestBase * 1e6) / n;
      per[exec] = nsIter - nsBase;
      line += ` ${exec.padStart(9)} ${nsIter.toFixed(1).padStart(7)} ${nsBase.toFixed(1).padStart(6)} ${(nsIter - nsBase).toFixed(1).padStart(7)} |`;
    }
    console.log(line + ` ${(per['jit-fb'] / per['jit']).toFixed(1).padStart(5)}x`);
  }
}

/**
 * `trans --jit [reps]`: the JIT executor alone, `reps` (default 7) runs of each case paired with a run of its base
 * loop; prints the median ns/insn (case - base of the same pair) and the min..max spread, for before/after
 * comparisons on a shared machine.
 */
function transJitMode() {
  const at = process.argv.indexOf('--jit'), reps = +(process.argv[at + 1] ?? 7) || 7;
  console.log(`x87 transcendentals under the JIT, ${ITER} iterations, ${reps} paired runs: median ns/insn (case - base) [min..max]`);
  const cases = TRANS_CASES.filter((c) => !process.env.CASES || process.env.CASES.split(',').includes(c.name));
  for (const c of cases) {
    const d = [];
    let sum = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < reps; k++) {
      const r = runTrans('jit', c.body, ITER, c.x0, c.dx); sum = r.sum;
      const b = runTrans('jit', c.base, ITER, c.x0, c.dx);
      d.push(((r.ms - b.ms) * 1e6) / ITER);
    }
    d.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const want = refSum(c, ITER);
    const bad = !(Math.abs(sum - want) <= 1e-8 * Math.max(1, Math.abs(want)));
    console.log(`${c.name.padEnd(11)} ${d[d.length >> 1].toFixed(1).padStart(6)} ns  [${d[0].toFixed(1)}..${d[d.length - 1].toFixed(1)}]${bad ? `  MISMATCH got ${sum} want ${want}` : ''}`);
  }
}

if (MODE === 'trans' && process.argv.includes('--jit')) transJitMode();
else if (MODE === 'trans') transMode();
else if (MODE === 'xform') xformMode();
else {
  console.log(`x87 dot-product loop, ${ITER} iterations (7 instructions each: FLD m64, FMUL m64, FADDP, 2x ADD, DEC, JNZ)`);
  run('pc53', false, false);
  run('pc24', true, false);
  run('pc24 gen', true, false, true);
  run('chained', false, true);
}

```

`tools/x87-size.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Static size of translated x87 code: small regions shaped like compiler x87 output (the x87loop-bench loops, plus
// double-operand and register-register arithmetic) translated under several control words, measured as WASM operations
// per x87 arithmetic instruction (the listing, src/cpu/jit/listing.js), WASM body bytes per region and TurboFan machine
// code bytes per region (V8's --print-wasm-code, eager TurboFan compilation with branch hints honoured, as in Chrome).
// Usage: node tools/x87-size.mjs [--ab <root>] [--cw 0x7f,0x27f,...] [--cases a,b] [--disasm <case>@<cw>]
//   --ab <root>: also measure the src tree under <root> (e.g. a worktree of an earlier revision) and print both
//   --disasm <case>@<cw>: print the machine code of that region (this tree); --liftoff: Liftoff's code, not TurboFan's
//        node tools/x87-size.mjs --modules <dir>: the region modules a game run dumped (startbench --mix with
//   ORTHROS_X87_DUMP=<dir>, tools/jit-mix.mjs: <dir>/new and <dir>/old, the same regions translated both ways),
//   compiled the same way: WASM and machine code totals, per-region ratios
import { spawn, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import readline from 'node:readline';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import path from 'node:path';

const SELF = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
// --liftoff: the baseline tier's code instead of TurboFan's (what a region runs before it tiers up)
const TIER = process.argv.includes('--liftoff') ? ['--liftoff', '--no-wasm-tier-up'] : ['--no-liftoff'];
const ROOT = path.join(path.dirname(SELF), '..');
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (name, def) => { const i = args.indexOf(name); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : def; };
const CODE = 0x20000000;
const hex = (s) => Uint8Array.from(s.replace(/\s+/g, '').match(/../g).map((h) => parseInt(h, 16)));
const d32 = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >> 8) & 0xff, (v >> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
function xformBody() {
  let h = '';
  for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
    h += 'd90486' + 'd88f' + d32(0x100 + 4 * r) + 'd9448604' + 'd88f' + d32(0x110 + 4 * r) + 'dec1';
    h += 'd9448608' + 'd88f' + d32(0x120 + 4 * r) + 'dec1' + 'd887' + d32(0x130 + 4 * r) + 'd95c83' + (4 * r).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
  }
  return h;
}
// loop: mov eax, ecx ; and eax, 1023 ; <body> ; dec ecx ; jnz L ; ret (as tools/x87loop-bench.mjs, ending on RET: one region)
function loop(body) {
  const b = hex('89c8 25ff030000' + body);
  if (b.length + 3 <= 128) return Uint8Array.from([...b, 0x49, 0x75, -(b.length + 3) & 0xff, 0xc3]);
  const rel = -(b.length + 7);
  return Uint8Array.from([...b, 0x49, 0x0f, 0x85, rel & 0xff, (rel >> 8) & 0xff, (rel >> 16) & 0xff, (rel >>> 24) & 0xff, 0xc3]);
}
const CASES = [
  ['fcomp+test', 'd90486 d81f dfe0 f6c441 7501 42'],
  ['fcom+fchs+fstp', 'd90486 d84f04 dfe0 f6c405 7a02 d9e0 d91c83'],
  ['arith-blocks', 'd90486 d84f08 d84704 d817 dfe0 f6c401 7402 d9e0 dcc8 d84704 d91c83'],
  ['exp', 'd90486 d84f04 d9ea dec9 d9c0 d9fc dce9 d9c9 d9f0 d9e8 dec1 d9fd ddd9 d84708 d91c83'],
  ['xform', xformBody()],
  ['recurrence', 'd84f04 d80486'],
  ['fild', 'df0446 d84f04 d84708 d91c83'],
  // fld dword [esi+eax*4] ; fmul qword [edi+0x200] ; fadd qword [edi+0x208] ; fsub dword [edi+4] ; fdiv qword [edi+0x210] ;
  // fsubr qword [edi+0x218] ; fstp dword [ebx+eax*4]   (double operands: the roundF32 / double paths)
  ['m64', 'd90486 dc8f00020000 dc8708020000 d86704 dcb710020000 dcaf18020000 d91c83'],
  // fld dword [esi+eax*4] ; fld dword [edi+4] ; fmul st, st(1) ; fadd st(1), st ; fsubrp st(1), st ; fld st(0) ;
  // fdivr st, st(1) ; faddp st(1), st ; fstp dword [ebx+eax*4]   (register operands)
  ['regs', 'd90486 d94704 d8c9 dcc1 dee9 d9c0 d8f9 dec1 d91c83'],
];
const CWS = (opt('--cw', '0x7f,0x27f,0x37f,0xc7f')).split(',').map((x) => parseInt(x, 16));
const ONLY = opt('--cases', null)?.split(',');
const ARITH = /^(fadd|faddp|fiadd|fmul|fmulp|fimul|fsub|fsubp|fisub|fsubr|fsubrp|fisubr|fdiv|fdivp|fidiv|fdivr|fdivrp|fidivr)$/;

if (args[0] === '--child-modules') {
  // compile every module of a directory (V8 prints each function's code: parsed by the parent)
  let ms = 0;
  for (const f of fs.readdirSync(args[1]).filter((x) => x.endsWith('.wasm')).sort()) {
    const b = fs.readFileSync(path.join(args[1], f)), t0 = performance.now();
    new WebAssembly.Module(b);
    ms += performance.now() - t0;
  }
  process.stderr.write(`X87TIME ${ms}\n`);
  process.exit(0);
}
if (args[0] === '--child') {
  // (run under V8's code printing flags: translate every case, compile the modules eagerly, report the WASM side on stderr)
  const root = args[1];
  if (process.env.X87_SIZE_GLOBALS) Object.assign(globalThis, JSON.parse(process.env.X87_SIZE_GLOBALS)); // (translation switches, e.g. ORTHROS_NO_F32)
  const u = (f) => pathToFileURL(path.join(root, 'src', f)).href;
  const [{ GuestMemory }, { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, ST }, { translateRegion, buildRegionModule }, { listRegion }] = await Promise.all([
    import(u('cpu/memory.js')), import(u('cpu/state.js')), import(u('cpu/jit/translate.js')), import(u('cpu/jit/listing.js'))]);
  await import(u('cpu/jit/translate-x87.js'));
  const out = [];
  for (const [name, body] of CASES) {
    if (ONLY && !ONLY.includes(name)) continue;
    for (const cw of CWS) {
      const mem = new GuestMemory();
      const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
      cpu.reset();
      mem.writeBytes(CODE, loop(body));
      mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, cw);
      const opts = { fpcAssume: cw & 0xf00, smc: true };
      const { code } = translateRegion(mem, CODE, opts);
      const L = listRegion(mem, CODE, opts, { ops: false });
      let arithOps = 0, arithN = 0, insnOps = 0;
      for (const g of L.groups) {
        if (g.block < 0 || g.head || g.tail) continue;
        const m = g.label.trim().split(/\s+/)[1];
        insnOps += g.ops.length;
        if (ARITH.test(m)) { arithOps += g.ops.length; arithN++; }
      }
      const fname = `r_${name}_${cw.toString(16)}`;
      const bytes = buildRegionModule([code], [fname]);
      new WebAssembly.Module(bytes); // (compiled now: --no-wasm-lazy-compilation)
      out.push({ name, cw, fname, wasm: code.length, arithOps, arithN, insnOps });
    }
  }
  process.stderr.write('X87SIZE ' + JSON.stringify(out) + '\n');
  process.exit(0);
}

function measure(root, disasm) {
  const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, [...TIER, '--no-wasm-lazy-compilation', '--experimental-wasm-branch-hinting', '--print-wasm-code', SELF, '--child', root, ...args],
    { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1 << 30 });
  if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error(`child failed: ${r.stderr}`);
  const line = r.stderr.split('\n').find((l) => l.startsWith('X87SIZE '));
  const rows = JSON.parse(line.slice(8));
  // V8's listing: "name: <fn>" ... "Instructions (size = N)" per compiled function
  const machine = new Map();
  let cur = null, text = [];
  for (const l of r.stdout.split('\n')) {
    const n = /^name: (\S+)/.exec(l);
    if (n) { cur = n[1]; text = []; continue; }
    const s = /^Instructions \(size = (\d+)\)/.exec(l);
    if (s && cur) machine.set(cur, { size: +s[1], text });
    if (cur) text.push(l);
  }
  for (const row of rows) row.machine = machine.get(row.fname)?.size ?? NaN;
  if (disasm) { const [c, w] = disasm.split('@'); const f = `r_${c}_${parseInt(w, 16).toString(16)}`; console.log(machine.get(f)?.text.join('\n') ?? `no ${f}`); }
  return rows;
}

/** machine code size by function name of every module in `dir` (streamed: V8's listing of thousands of regions is large) */
function compileDir(dir) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const c = spawn(process.execPath, [...TIER, '--no-wasm-lazy-compilation', '--experimental-wasm-branch-hinting', '--print-wasm-code', SELF, '--child-modules', dir], { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'inherit'] });
    const sizes = new Map(); let cur = null;
    readline.createInterface({ input: c.stdout }).on('line', (l) => {
      if (l.startsWith('name: ')) cur = l.slice(6).trim();
      else if (cur && l.startsWith('Instructions (size = ')) { sizes.set(cur, parseInt(l.slice(21), 10)); cur = null; }
    });
    c.on('exit', (code) => (code === 0 ? resolve(sizes) : reject(new Error(`compile ${dir}: exit ${code}`))));
  });
}
if (opt('--modules', null)) {
  const dir = opt('--modules');
  const res = {};
  for (const v of ['old', 'new']) {
    const d = path.join(dir, v), files = fs.readdirSync(d).filter((x) => x.endsWith('.wasm'));
    const sizes = await compileDir(d);
    res[v] = new Map(files.map((f) => [f, { wasm: fs.statSync(path.join(d, f)).size, code: sizes.get(f.slice(0, -5)) ?? NaN }]));
  }
  const both = [...res.new.keys()].filter((f) => res.old.has(f) && Number.isFinite(res.old.get(f).code) && Number.isFinite(res.new.get(f).code));
  const sum = (v, k) => both.reduce((s, f) => s + res[v].get(f)[k], 0);
  const ratios = (k) => both.map((f) => res.new.get(f)[k] / res.old.get(f)[k]).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const q = (a, p) => a[Math.min(a.length - 1, Math.floor(p * a.length))];
  // --time: compilation time of each set (no code printing), alternated old / new, 3 rounds, the fastest round of each
  if (args.includes('--time')) {
    const t = { old: [], new: [] };
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) for (const v of ['old', 'new']) {
      const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, [...TIER, '--no-wasm-lazy-compilation', '--experimental-wasm-branch-hinting', SELF, '--child-modules', path.join(dir, v)], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1 << 26 });
      t[v].push(parseFloat(/X87TIME (\S+)/.exec(r.stderr)?.[1] ?? 'NaN'));
    }
    console.log(`compilation (${TIER.join(' ')}, eager): old ${Math.min(...t.old).toFixed(0)} ms -> new ${Math.min(...t.new).toFixed(0)} ms (rounds: old ${t.old.map((x) => x.toFixed(0)).join(' ')}, new ${t.new.map((x) => x.toFixed(0)).join(' ')})`);
  }
  for (const k of ['wasm', 'code']) {
    const o = sum('old', k), n = sum('new', k), r = ratios(k);
    console.log(`${k === 'wasm' ? 'WASM module bytes ' : 'machine code bytes'}: ${both.length} x87 regions, old ${(o / 1048576).toFixed(2)} MiB (${(o / both.length / 1024).toFixed(1)} KiB per region) -> new ${(n / 1048576).toFixed(2)} MiB (${(n / both.length / 1024).toFixed(1)} KiB), ${(100 * (n / o - 1)).toFixed(1)} %; per-region ratio p10 ${q(r, 0.1).toFixed(2)} median ${q(r, 0.5).toFixed(2)} p90 ${q(r, 0.9).toFixed(2)}`);
  }
  process.exit(0);
}

const disasm = opt('--disasm', null);
const cur = measure(ROOT, disasm);
const base = opt('--ab', null) ? measure(path.resolve(opt('--ab')), null) : null;
const fmt = (r) => `${String(r.wasm).padStart(6)} B wasm ${String(r.machine).padStart(6)} B code ${(r.arithN ? (r.arithOps / r.arithN).toFixed(0) : '-').padStart(4)} ops/arith`;
console.log(`x87 regions: WASM body bytes, TurboFan machine code bytes, WASM operations per x87 arithmetic instruction${base ? ' (base -> this tree)' : ''}`);
const tot = { w: [0, 0], m: [0, 0] };
for (let i = 0; i < cur.length; i++) {
  const r = cur[i], b = base?.[i];
  const label = `${r.name}@${r.cw.toString(16)}`.padEnd(22);
  if (b) {
    const pct = (x, y) => `${(100 * (y / x - 1)).toFixed(0).padStart(4)} %`;
    console.log(`${label} ${fmt(b)}  ->  ${fmt(r)}   wasm ${pct(b.wasm, r.wasm)}, code ${pct(b.machine, r.machine)}`);
    tot.w[0] += b.wasm; tot.m[0] += b.machine;
  } else console.log(`${label} ${fmt(r)}`);
  tot.w[1] += r.wasm; tot.m[1] += r.machine;
}
if (base) console.log(`total: wasm ${tot.w[0]} -> ${tot.w[1]} B (${(100 * (tot.w[1] / tot.w[0] - 1)).toFixed(1)} %), machine code ${tot.m[0]} -> ${tot.m[1]} B (${(100 * (tot.m[1] / tot.m[0] - 1)).toFixed(1)} %)`);
else console.log(`total: wasm ${tot.w[1]} B, machine code ${tot.m[1]} B`);
```

`tools/x87cc-cases.mjs`:

```mjs
// The x87 condition-code probe (tools/x87cc-probe.mjs, tests/x87-cc-hw.test.js): one instruction run from known
// condition codes C3 C2 C1 C0 on a known stack, the status word read back by FNSTSW AX. Each case is a byte sequence
// valid both in 32-bit mode (Orthros) and in 64-bit mode (the native runner, tools/oracle/x87cc.c): memory operands are
// [eax + disp] only, eax holding the data block's address (< 2^32 on both sides), set by a `mov eax, imm32` in front.
//   fninit ; fld m64 2.0 ; fld m64 0.75 ; fld m64 -1.5 ; <stack variant> ;
//   fnstenv [eax+64] ; or word [eax+68], <cc> ; fldenv [eax+64]   (the condition codes set, nothing else changed)
//   <instruction> ; fnstsw ax ; fninit
// The runner stops at the final fninit; AX is the result.

/** the data block (256 bytes) at eax */
export function dataBlock() {
  const b = new Uint8Array(256), dv = new DataView(b.buffer);
  dv.setFloat64(0, -1.5, true); dv.setFloat64(8, 2.0, true); dv.setFloat64(16, 0.75, true); dv.setFloat64(24, NaN, true);
  dv.setInt32(32, 3, true); dv.setFloat32(40, 0.5, true); dv.setUint16(56, 0x037f, true);
  dv.setFloat64(200, -0, true); dv.setFloat64(208, Infinity, true); dv.setFloat64(216, 2 ** 64, true); dv.setFloat64(224, NaN, true);
  dv.setFloat64(232, 0, true);
  return b;
}

export const INS = {
  fcomi: [0xdb, 0xf1], fucomi: [0xdb, 0xe9], fcomip: [0xdf, 0xf1], fucomip: [0xdf, 0xe9],
  fcomi_nan: [0xdd, 0x40, 0x18, 0xdb, 0xf1], fucomi_nan: [0xdd, 0x40, 0x18, 0xdb, 0xe9], // (a QNaN pushed first)
  fcom: [0xd8, 0xd1], fcomp: [0xd8, 0xd9], fcompp: [0xde, 0xd9], fucom: [0xdd, 0xe1], fucomp: [0xdd, 0xe9], fucompp: [0xda, 0xe9],
  fcom_m64: [0xdc, 0x50, 0x10], fcom_m32: [0xd8, 0x50, 0x28], ficom_m32: [0xda, 0x50, 0x20], ficomp_m32: [0xda, 0x58, 0x20], ficom_m16: [0xde, 0x50, 0x20],
  ftst: [0xd9, 0xe4], fxam: [0xd9, 0xe5],
  fld_st: [0xd9, 0xc1], fld_m64: [0xdd, 0x40, 0x10], fild_m32: [0xdb, 0x40, 0x20], fld1: [0xd9, 0xe8], fldz: [0xd9, 0xee], fldpi: [0xd9, 0xeb],
  fst_m64: [0xdd, 0x50, 0x30], fstp_m64: [0xdd, 0x58, 0x30], fst_st: [0xdd, 0xd3], fist_m32: [0xdb, 0x50, 0x30], fistp_m32: [0xdb, 0x58, 0x30], fisttp_m32: [0xdb, 0x48, 0x30],
  fadd: [0xd8, 0xc1], fadd_m64: [0xdc, 0x40, 0x10], faddp: [0xde, 0xc1], fmul: [0xd8, 0xc9], fsub: [0xd8, 0xe1], fdiv: [0xd8, 0xf1], fdivr: [0xd8, 0xf9], fdiv_m64: [0xdc, 0x70, 0x10],
  fchs: [0xd9, 0xe0], fabs: [0xd9, 0xe1], fsqrt: [0xd9, 0xfa], frndint: [0xd9, 0xfc], fscale: [0xd9, 0xfd], fxtract: [0xd9, 0xf4], fprem: [0xd9, 0xf8], fprem1: [0xd9, 0xf5],
  f2xm1: [0xd9, 0xf0], fyl2x: [0xd9, 0xf1], fyl2xp1: [0xd9, 0xf9], fsin: [0xd9, 0xfe], fcos: [0xd9, 0xff], fsincos: [0xd9, 0xfb], fptan: [0xd9, 0xf2], fpatan: [0xd9, 0xf3],
  fxch: [0xd9, 0xc9], ffree2: [0xdd, 0xc2], ffree5: [0xdd, 0xc5], fincstp: [0xd9, 0xf7], fdecstp: [0xd9, 0xf6], fnop: [0xd9, 0xd0],
  fldcw: [0xd9, 0x68, 0x38], fnstcw: [0xd9, 0x78, 0x30], fnclex: [0xdb, 0xe2], fnstsw_m: [0xdd, 0x78, 0x30],
  fcmovb: [0xda, 0xc1], fcmovnb: [0xdb, 0xc1], fcmove: [0xda, 0xc9], fcmovu: [0xda, 0xd9], fcmovnu: [0xdb, 0xd9],
};
/** after the three loads (ST(0) = -1.5, ST(1) = 0.75, ST(2) = 2.0): another ST(0) or the order changed */
export const STACKS = {
  neg: [],
  pos: [0xd9, 0xca], // fxch st(2): 2.0 on top, -1.5 in ST(2)
  negzero: [0xdd, 0x80, 200, 0, 0, 0], // fld m64 [eax+200]: -0 pushed
  inf: [0xdd, 0x80, 208, 0, 0, 0], // +inf
  big: [0xdd, 0x80, 216, 0, 0, 0], // 2^64 (trig out of range, FPREM partial)
  nan: [0xdd, 0x80, 224, 0, 0, 0], // a QNaN
  zero1: [0xdd, 0x80, 232, 0, 0, 0, 0xd9, 0xc9], // +0 pushed then exchanged: ST(1) = 0 (FPREM invalid)
};
export const CCS = [0x0000, 0x0200, 0x4500, 0x4700, 0x0100, 0x4000, 0x0400];

/** @param {string[] | null} only instruction names (null: all) @param {number[]} ccs */
export function cases(only = null, ccs = CCS) {
  const out = [];
  for (const [sname, st] of Object.entries(STACKS)) for (const cc of ccs) for (const [iname, ins] of Object.entries(INS)) {
    if (only && !only.includes(iname)) continue;
    const code = [0xdb, 0xe3, 0xdd, 0x40, 0x08, 0xdd, 0x40, 0x10, 0xdd, 0x40, 0x00, ...st,
      0xd9, 0x70, 0x40, 0x66, 0x81, 0x48, 0x44, cc & 0xff, cc >> 8, 0xd9, 0x60, 0x40,
      ...ins, 0xdf, 0xe0, 0xdb, 0xe3];
    out.push({ name: `${iname} ${sname} ${cc.toString(16).padStart(4, '0')}`, iname, sname, cc, code: Uint8Array.from(code) });
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Run the cases in Orthros: the interpreter (jitOpts null) or the JIT with these options. One guest memory and one
 * JIT for all of them, each case at its own code address. Returns AX per case.
 * @param {{ name: string, code: Uint8Array }[]} list @param {object | null} jitOpts
 */
export async function runOrthros(list, jitOpts) {
  const { GuestMemory } = await import('../src/cpu/memory.js');
  const { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F } = await import('../src/cpu/state.js');
  const { Interp } = await import('../src/cpu/interp.js');
  await import('../src/cpu/interp-x87.js');
  const { Jit } = await import('../src/cpu/jit/jit.js');
  const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000, STRIDE = 128;
  const mem = new GuestMemory(), cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE), I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
  cpu.reset();
  const ends = new Set();
  list.forEach((c, k) => {
    const at = CODE + k * STRIDE;
    if (c.code.length + 5 > STRIDE) throw new Error('case too long');
    mem.writeBytes(at, Uint8Array.from([0xb8, DATA & 0xff, (DATA >>> 8) & 0xff, (DATA >>> 16) & 0xff, DATA >>> 24, ...c.code]));
    ends.add(at + 5 + c.code.length - 2); // the final fninit
  });
  let jit = null;
  if (jitOpts) { jit = new Jit(mem, I, { smc: true, ...jitOpts }); jit.cpu = cpu; jit.boundaries = ends; }
  const data = dataBlock();
  return list.map((c, k) => {
    const at = CODE + k * STRIDE, end = at + 5 + c.code.length - 2;
    mem.writeBytes(DATA, data);
    cpu.eip = at; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x10000; cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
    const r = jit ? jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: 1e5 }) : I.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: 1e5 });
    if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error(`${c.name}: exit ${r} at ${cpu.eip.toString(16)}`);
    return cpu.eax & 0xffff;
  });
}
```

`tools/x87cc-probe.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// The x87 status word after one instruction from known condition codes (tools/x87cc-cases.mjs): the host FPU
// (tools/oracle/x87cc.c, built here with clang-18) against the interpreter and the JIT (swLocal on and off).
//   node tools/x87cc-probe.mjs [--only fcomi,fsin,...] [--scratch DIR] [--table]
// Prints, per instruction, the cases where the interpreter's condition codes (C0 C2 C3, then C1 apart: it is the
// rounding direction after an inexact result, not emulated) differ from the hardware, and where the JIT differs from
// the interpreter (whole status word). --table: the hardware values as `name hex` lines (tests/x87-cc-hw.test.js).
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { cases, dataBlock, runOrthros } from './x87cc-cases.mjs';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (k, d) => { const i = args.indexOf(k); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : d; };
const only = opt('--only', null)?.split(',') ?? null;
const scratch = opt('--scratch', '/tmp/orthros-scratch/x87cc');
fs.mkdirSync(scratch, { recursive: true });
const root = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const exe = path.join(scratch, 'x87cc');
execFileSync('clang-18', ['-O1', '-o', exe, path.join(root, 'oracle/x87cc.c')]);
const list = cases(only);
const parts = [Buffer.from(dataBlock())];
for (const c of list) { const l = Buffer.alloc(2); l.writeUInt16LE(c.code.length); parts.push(l, Buffer.from(c.code)); }
const bin = path.join(scratch, 'cases.bin');
fs.writeFileSync(bin, Buffer.concat(parts));
const hwOut = execFileSync(exe, [bin], { maxBuffer: 1 << 24 });
const hw = list.map((_, k) => hwOut.readUInt16LE(2 * k));
const h = (v) => v.toString(16).padStart(4, '0');
if (args.includes('--table')) { list.forEach((c, k) => console.log(`${c.name} ${h(hw[k])}`)); process.exit(0); }
const interp = await runOrthros(list, null), jitL = await runOrthros(list, { swLocal: true }), jit = await runOrthros(list, { swLocal: false });
const groups = { 'C0/C2/C3 hardware != interpreter': new Map(), 'C1 hardware != interpreter': new Map(), 'JIT != interpreter': new Map() };
const [gcc, gc1, gjit] = Object.values(groups);
const add = (m, k, s) => { if (!m.has(k)) m.set(k, []); m.get(k).push(s); };
list.forEach((c, k) => {
  const H = hw[k], I = interp[k];
  if ((H ^ I) & 0x4500) add(gcc, c.iname, `${c.name}: hw ${h(H)} interp ${h(I)}`);
  if ((H ^ I) & 0x200) add(gc1, c.iname, `${c.name}: hw ${h(H)} interp ${h(I)}`);
  if (jitL[k] !== I || jit[k] !== I) add(gjit, c.iname, `${c.name}: interp ${h(I)} jit(swLocal) ${h(jitL[k])} jit ${h(jit[k])}`);
});
for (const [title, m] of Object.entries(groups)) {
  console.log(`== ${title}: ${m.size} instructions`);
  for (const [n, l] of m) console.log(`  ${n} (${l.length}): ${l.slice(0, 3).join(' | ')}`);
}

```

`tools/x87loop-bench.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// x87 loop microbenchmark: ns per iteration of small loops shaped like x87 compiler output under a chosen control
// word (default 0x007f, the Direct3D FPU mode: 24-bit precision, round to nearest; 0x0c7f the same truncating, as
// code that sets the rounding control once for its FISTPs runs; 0x027f the MSVC default): FCOM-family compares whose
// condition reaches the integer side through FNSTSW AX + TEST AH,imm / SAHF + JCC, x87 values living across the
// blocks such branches create, a vertex transform, a latency-bound recurrence, the e^x sequence, FILD. Every case reads
// its operand from a 1024-entry float table indexed by the loop counter; `rand` tables hold random signs, `pos` tables
// only positive values. Each case: ecx = N iterations, esi -> table, edi -> constants (+0: 0.0f, +4: 0.5f, +8: 3.0f,
// +0x100: a 4x4 float matrix), ebx -> output table; ends on HLT. Results are checked against the interpreter first.
// Usage: node tools/x87loop-bench.mjs [iterations] [--runs 7] [--cw 0x7f] [--cases name,...] [--pos|--rand] [--full] [--ab <dir>]
//   --ab <dir>: A/B in one process — <dir>/src (an extraction of the src tree of an earlier revision) against this
//   tree's src, runs alternated (base, new, base, new...) so that both see the same machine load.
//   --stats: interpreter steps (EXIT_STEP) per iteration; --no-warm: no discarded first round; --liftoff: V8's tiers
//   as they come (default: TurboFan only, see below).
// On a loaded shared machine wall-clock times drift by +-30 % between runs; cycles spent in the translated region are
// steadier: run one case with `perf record -e cycles:u` on `node --no-liftoff --perf-prof tools/x87loop-bench.mjs N
// --runs 1 --no-warm --cases <case> --pos`, `perf inject -j`, and divide the period of the JS:r_* symbols by 2N (each
// run executes the loop twice: warm-up and timed).
import './node-wasm-flags.mjs'; // (branch hints honoured, as in Chrome: cold paths out of line)
import v8 from 'node:v8';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import path from 'node:path';

async function loadImpl(root) {
  const u = (f) => pathToFileURL(path.join(root, 'src', f)).href;
  const [{ GuestMemory }, { CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST }, { Interp }, , { Jit }] = await Promise.all([
    import(u('cpu/memory.js')), import(u('cpu/state.js')), import(u('cpu/interp.js')), import(u('cpu/interp-x87.js')), import(u('cpu/jit/jit.js'))]);
  return { GuestMemory, CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, EXIT, F, ST, Interp, Jit };
}

const CODE = 0x20000000, DATA = 0x10000000, TAB = DATA, CONST = DATA + 0x1000, OUT = DATA + 0x2000;
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const N = +(args.find((a, i) => /^\d+$/.test(a) && !['--runs', '--cw'].includes(args[i - 1])) ?? 1e7);
const opt = (name, def) => { const i = args.indexOf(name); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : def; };
const RUNS = +opt('--runs', 7);
const CW = parseInt(opt('--cw', '0x7f'), 16);
const ONLY = opt('--cases', null)?.split(',');
const AB = opt('--ab', null);
const FULL = args.includes('--full');
// (--src <dir>: the src tree of <dir> instead of this one's — one variant per process, e.g. under perf)
const NEW = await loadImpl(opt('--src', null) ? path.resolve(opt('--src', null)) : path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..'));
const BASE = AB ? await loadImpl(path.resolve(AB)) : null;
// TurboFan only (--liftoff: the default tiers): the 100 ms wait after the warm-up does not always see a region tiered
// up — larger regions (24-bit precision, every arithmetic result tested) stayed partly in Liftoff and measured up to 2x
// slower than their optimized code, mixing V8's tier-up timing into the comparison of control words (2026-10-21: xform
// 24.8 vs 10.7 ns at 0x7f / 0x27f with the tiers, 14.2 vs 10.6 ns optimized). A hot region of a game runs TurboFan code.
if (!args.includes('--liftoff')) v8.setFlagsFromString('--no-liftoff');
const hex = (s) => Uint8Array.from(s.replace(/\s+/g, '').match(/../g).map((h) => parseInt(h, 16)));

// common loop head: mov eax, ecx ; and eax, 1023  (89c8 25ff030000), tail: dec ecx ; jnz L ; hlt
const HEAD = '89c8 25ff030000';
/** head + body + dec ecx ; jnz L ; hlt (the back-edge displacement computed) */
function loop(text) {
  const [pre, body] = text.includes('|') ? text.split('|') : ['', text]; // (code before the loop: 'pre | body')
  const p = pre.trim() ? [...hex(pre)] : [], b = hex(HEAD + body);
  if (b.length + 3 <= 128) return Uint8Array.from([...p, ...b, 0x49, 0x75, -(b.length + 3) & 0xff, 0xf4]);
  const rel = -(b.length + 7); // jnz rel32
  return Uint8Array.from([...p, ...b, 0x49, 0x0f, 0x85, rel & 0xff, (rel >> 8) & 0xff, (rel >> 16) & 0xff, (rel >>> 24) & 0xff, 0xf4]);
}
const d32 = (v) => [v & 0xff, (v >> 8) & 0xff, (v >> 16) & 0xff, v >>> 24].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
function xformBody() {
  let h = '';
  for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
    h += 'd90486' + 'd88f' + d32(0x100 + 4 * r) + 'd9448604' + 'd88f' + d32(0x110 + 4 * r) + 'dec1';
    h += 'd9448608' + 'd88f' + d32(0x120 + 4 * r) + 'dec1' + 'd887' + d32(0x130 + 4 * r) + 'd95c83' + (4 * r).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
  }
  return h;
}
const CASES = [
  // fld [esi+eax*4] ; fcomp [edi] ; fnstsw ax ; test ah, 41h ; jnz S ; inc edx ; S:       (x <= 0 ?)
  ['fcomp+test ah', 'd90486 d81f dfe0 f6c441 7501 42'],
  // mov ebx, [esi+eax*4] ; cmp ebx, [edi] ; jle S ; inc edx ; S:   (reference: the same control flow, integer compare)
  ['  ref: integer cmp', '8b1c86 3b1f 7e01 42'],
  // fld [esi+eax*4] ; fcomp [edi] ; fnstsw ax ; sahf ; jae S ; inc edx ; S:                (x < 0 ?)
  ['fcomp+sahf', 'd90486 d81f dfe0 9e 7301 42'],
  // fld [edi] ; fld [esi+eax*4] ; fucompp ; fnstsw ax ; test ah, 44h ; jpe S ; inc edx ; S:   (x != 0 or unordered ?)
  ['fucompp+test 44', 'd907 d90486 dae9 dfe0 f6c444 7a01 42'],
  // fld [esi+eax*4] ; fcom [edi+4] ; fnstsw ax ; test ah, 5 ; jp S ; fchs ; S: fstp [ebx+eax*4]   (value across the branch)
  ['fcom+fchs+fstp', 'd90486 d84f04 dfe0 f6c405 7a02 d9e0 d91c83'],
  // fld [esi+eax*4] ; fmul [edi+8] ; fadd [edi+4] ; fcom [edi] ; fnstsw ax ; test ah, 1 ; jz P ; fchs ; P: fmul st, st(0) ;
  // fadd [edi+4] ; fstp [ebx+eax*4]                            (f32 arithmetic on both sides of a block boundary)
  ['arith across blocks', 'd90486 d84f08 d84704 d817 dfe0 f6c401 7402 d9e0 dcc8 d84704 d91c83'],
  // same without the branch (reference: one block)
  ['  ref: one block', 'd90486 d84f08 d84704 d817 dfe0 f6c401 d9e1 dcc8 d84704 d91c83'],
  // fld [esi+eax*4] ; fmul [edi+4] ; e^x (fldl2e ; fmulp ; fld st0 ; frndint ; fsub st(1), st ; fxch ; f2xm1 ; fld1 ;
  // faddp ; fscale ; fstp st(1)) ; fadd [edi+8] ; fstp [ebx+eax*4]      (the x87 exp sequence inside arithmetic)
  ['exp in loop', 'd90486 d84f04 d9ea dec9 d9c0 d9fc dce9 d9c9 d9f0 d9e8 dec1 d9fd ddd9 d84708 d91c83'],
  // a vertex transform: per output component r, fld [esi+eax*4] ; fmul [edi+M+4r] ; fld [esi+eax*4+4] ;
  // fmul [edi+M+16+4r] ; faddp ; fld [esi+eax*4+8] ; fmul [edi+M+32+4r] ; faddp ; fadd [edi+M+48+4r] ; fstp [ebx+eax*4+4r]
  // (M = 0x100: a 4x4 float matrix; the arithmetic of x87 3D code, e.g. under --cw 0xc7f, truncation)
  ['xform', xformBody()],
  // fldz | L: fmul [edi+4] ; fadd [esi+eax*4]      (a recurrence acc = acc * 0.5 + x: latency-bound, one rounding per op)
  ['recurrence', 'd9ee | d84f04 d80486'],
  // fild word [esi+eax*2] (the table's halves as 16-bit integers) ; fmul [edi+4] ; fadd [edi+8] ; fstp [ebx+eax*4]
  ['fild+fmul+fstp', 'df0446 d84f04 d84708 d91c83'],
  // sums of squares of differences with an accumulator kept on the stack across iterations (the shape of a fitting /
  // statistics loop: 41 x87 instructions per iteration, m32 operands, values spilled to float temporaries):
  // fldz | a = (x0 - c0) * c1 -> [ebx+20], b = (x1 - c1) * c2 -> [ebx+24], c = (x2 - c2) * c1 (st0);
  // s = b + c + a: acc += s * s; [ebx+28] += (a + b - c)^2; [ebx+2c] += (a - b + c)^2; [ebx+30] += (c - (a - b))^2
  ['sums of squares', 'd9ee | d90486 d827 d84f04 d95b20 d9448604 d86704 d84f08 d95b24 d9448608 d86708 d84f04' +
    ' d94324 d8c1 d84320 d9c0 d8c9 dec3 ddd8 d94324 d84320 d8e1 d9c0 d8c9 d84328 d95b28 ddd8' +
    ' d94320 d86324 d9c0 d8c2 d9c0 d8c9 d8432c d95b2c ddd8 dee1 d9c0 d8c9 d84330 d95b30 ddd8'],
  // fld [esi+eax*4] ; fadd qword [edi+0x208] (a float with 24 significant bits, as a double) ; fstp [ebx+eax*4]   (a double operand holding a float: the
  // sums land on 24-bit midpoints often, settled in roundF32's cold path from the operands being floats)
  ['fadd m64 midpoints', 'd90486 dc8708020000 d91c83'],
  // fld [esi+eax*4] ; fmul qword [edi+0x200] (0.9) ; fadd qword [edi+0x208] ; fstp [ebx+eax*4]   (a non-float double)
  ['fmul m64 0.9', 'd90486 dc8f00020000 dc8708020000 d91c83'],
];

function setup({ ST, F }, mem, cpu, bytes, rand) {
  cpu.reset();
  mem.writeBytes(CODE, bytes);
  let s = 12345;
  for (let k = 0; k < 1024; k++) {
    s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0;
    // (--full: values with full 24-bit significands, whose products and sums mostly fall off the 24-bit grid; else 16-bit
    // fixed-point values, whose results are often exact)
    const v = FULL ? Math.fround(0.125 + 16 * (s / 2 ** 32) * (1 + (Math.imul(s, 0x9e3779b1) >>> 0) / 2 ** 40)) : ((s >>> 8) & 0xffff) / 4096 + 0.125;
    mem.writeF32(TAB + 4 * k, rand && (s & 0x80000000) ? -v : v);
  }
  mem.writeF32(CONST, 0); mem.writeF32(CONST + 4, 0.5); mem.writeF32(CONST + 8, 3);
  mem.writeF64(CONST + 0x200, 0.9); mem.writeF64(CONST + 0x208, Math.fround(1.1)); // (doubles of the m64 cases: 0.9, a float with 24 significant bits)
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) mem.writeF32(CONST + 0x100 + 4 * i, 0.5 + 0.37 * Math.sin(i + 1)); // (xform's matrix)
  mem.write16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_CW, CW);
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.esp = DATA + 0x10000; cpu.esi = TAB; cpu.edi = CONST; cpu.ebx = OUT; cpu.edx = 0;
  cpu.eflags = F.RESERVED1 | F.IF;
}

function check(impl, name, bytes, rand) {
  const { GuestMemory, CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, Interp, Jit, EXIT, ST } = impl;
  const n = 1000, end = CODE + bytes.length - 1;
  const st = [];
  for (const useJit of [false, true]) {
    const mem = new GuestMemory();
    const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
    setup(impl, mem, cpu, bytes, rand); cpu.ecx = n;
    const I = new Interp(mem, cpu);
    let r;
    if (useJit) { const jit = new Jit(mem, I); jit.cpu = cpu; do r = jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: 1e9 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE); } else r = I.run({ stopAt: end });
    st.push([cpu.edx, cpu.eax & 0xffff, Array.from({ length: 260 }, (_, k) => mem.read32(OUT + 4 * k)).join(), mem.read16(cpu.base + ST.FPU_SW)].join('|'));
  }
  if (st[0] !== st[1]) throw new Error(`${name}: JIT and interpreter differ`);
}

async function once(impl, bytes, rand) {
  const { GuestMemory, CpuState, THREAD_STATES_BASE, Interp, Jit, EXIT } = impl;
  const mem = new GuestMemory();
  const cpu = new CpuState(mem, THREAD_STATES_BASE);
  setup(impl, mem, cpu, bytes, rand);
  const jit = new Jit(mem, new Interp(mem, cpu)); jit.cpu = cpu;
  const end = CODE + bytes.length - 1;
  let r;
  cpu.ecx = N;
  do r = jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: 2e9 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE); // warm-up: translation, then
  await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 100)); // V8's background tier-up of the region to optimized code
  cpu.eip = CODE; cpu.ecx = N;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  do r = jit.run({ stopAt: end, maxInsns: 2e9 }); while (r === EXIT.TIMESLICE);
  const ms = performance.now() - t0;
  if (r !== EXIT.HALT) throw new Error('exit ' + r);
  if (args.includes('--stats')) console.log(`  interpreter steps (EXIT_STEP) per iteration: ${((jit.stats.steps ?? 0) / (2 * N)).toFixed(3)}`);
  return (ms * 1e6) / N;
}

console.log(`x87 loops, control word 0x${CW.toString(16)}, ${N} iterations, ${RUNS} runs: median [min..max] ns/iter${AB ? `, A/B against ${AB} (alternated)` : ''}`);
const impls = BASE ? [BASE, NEW] : [NEW];
const selected = (name) => !ONLY || ONLY.includes(name.trim());
for (const [name, h] of CASES) if (selected(name)) for (const rand of [false, true]) for (const impl of impls) check(impl, name, loop(h), rand); // (the cases measured)
if (!args.includes('--no-warm')) for (const [name, h] of CASES) if (selected(name)) for (const impl of impls) await once(impl, loop(h), true); // discarded round (see flags-bench.mjs)
const stat = (t) => { t.sort((a, b) => a - b); return `${t[t.length >> 1].toFixed(2).padStart(6)} [${t[0].toFixed(2)}..${t[t.length - 1].toFixed(2)}]`; };
for (const [name, h] of CASES) {
  if (!selected(name)) continue;
  for (const rand of args.includes('--rand') ? [true] : args.includes('--pos') ? [false] : [false, true]) {
    const t = impls.map(() => []);
    for (let k = 0; k < RUNS; k++) for (let j = 0; j < impls.length; j++) t[j].push(await once(impls[j], loop(h), rand));
    const med = t.map((x) => [...x].sort((a, b) => a - b)[x.length >> 1]);
    console.log(`${name.padEnd(22)} ${rand ? 'rand' : 'pos '}  ${AB ? `base ${stat(t[0])}  new ${stat(t[1])}  ${((med[1] / med[0] - 1) * 100).toFixed(1).padStart(6)} %` : stat(t[0])}`);
  }
}
```
